2602.14267.tldr: This study introduces DELTAiF, a transfer learning (TL) based framework that provides scalable and accurate prediction of household hot water consumption and shows that TL is particularly effective when the source household exhibits regular consumption patterns, enabling hot water demand forecasting at scale.

2602.14257.tldr: AD-Bench provides a realistic benchmark for evaluating and improving advertising marketing agents, the leaderboard and code can be found at https://github.com/Emanual20/adbench-leaderboard.

2602.14251.tldr: MAD is a unified agentic framework that can recover existing approaches, such as mixture-of-experts gating and learning-with-expert-advice aggregation, by restricting the message space and synthesis operator and establishing regret guarantees for the synthesized losses.

2602.14236.tldr: Sali-Cache is proposed, a novel a priori optimization framework that implements dual-signal adaptive caching through proactive memory management that preserves context-rich features over extended temporal durations without degrading model performance, enabling efficient processing of long-form video content on consumer-grade hardware.

2602.14177.tldr: A general framework for ST-guided finetuning of pathology foundation models is proposed, showing that augmenting existing models with localized molecular supervision is an effective and practical step for improving visual representations and expanding their cross-modal utility.

2602.15451.tldr: A novel framework for optimization of deep generative models integrated with a D-Wave quantum annealing computer and an advantage of quantum annealing to aim at a stochastic generator integrated with the authors' novel neural network architectures, for the extended performance of feature space sampling and extraction of characteristic features in drug design.

2602.15827.tldr: Perceptive Humanoid Parkour (PHP) is presented, a modular framework that enables humanoid robots to autonomously perform long-horizon, vision-based parkour across challenging obstacle courses and enables autonomous, context-aware decision-making.

2602.14189.tldr: An abstention-aware verification framework that decomposes scientific claims into minimal conditions, audits each condition against available evidence using natural language inference (NLI), and selectively decides whether to support, refute, or abstain is evaluated.

2602.14529.tldr: This work proposes an internal, mechanism-oriented perspective that separates Knowledge Existence from Behavior Expression, and constructs a controlled environment for entity-centric factual questions in which knowledge is preserved while behavioral expression is selectively altered, enabling systematic analysis of four behavioral cases.

2602.14490.tldr: Mixture of Space (MoS) is proposed, a unified framework that leverages multiple geometric spaces simultaneously to learn richer, curvature-aware representations, and MoSLoRA is developed, which extends Low-Rank Adaptation with heterogeneous geometric experts, enabling models to dynamically select or combine appropriate geometric spaces based on input context.

2602.14486.tldr: A permutation-based null-calibration framework is introduced that transforms any representational similarity metric into a calibrated score with statistical guarantees, and proposes the Aristotelian Representation Hypothesis: representations in neural networks are converging to shared local neighborhood relationships.

2602.14433.tldr: Three case studies demonstrate that synthetic panels produce actionable demographic segmentation, identify structural content issues invisible to homogeneous reviewers, and enable tournament filtering that eliminates low-quality concepts while enriching high-quality survivors from 15% to 62% of the evaluated pool.

2602.14432.tldr: This work proposes Selective Spectral Decay ($S^2D), a geometrically-principled conditioning method that surgically regularizes only the weight components corresponding to the largest singular values during fine-tuning that significantly reduces activation outliers and produces well-conditioned representations that are inherently quantization-friendly.

2602.14423.tldr: This work proposes an information-theoretic framework that systematically accounts for the effect of augmentation on generalization and invariance learning, and derives a new generalization bound that decomposes the expected generalization gap into three interpretable terms.

2602.14406.tldr: TruthStance is introduced, a large-scale dataset of Truth Social conversation threads spanning 2023-2025, consisting of 24,378 posts and 523,360 comments with reply-tree structure preserved, enabling analysis of stance and argumentation patterns across depth, topics, and users.

2602.14374.tldr: DP-KSA is presented, a novel privacy-preserving RAG algorithm that integrates DP using the propose-test-release paradigm and formally shows that DP-KSA provides formal DP guarantees on the generated output with respect to the RAG database.

2602.14364.tldr: A trajectory-centric evaluation of Clawdbot finds a non-uniform safety profile: performance is generally consistent on reliability-focused tasks, while most failures arise under underspecified intent, open-ended goals, or benign-seeming jailbreak prompts, where minor misinterpretations can escalate into higher-impact tool actions.

2602.14345.tldr: This paper introduces Agentic eXploit Engine (AXE), a multi-agent framework for Web application exploitation that maps lightweight detection metadata to concrete exploits through decoupled planning, code exploration, and dynamic execution feedback, and demonstrates its utility in streamlining Web vulnerability triage and remediation.

2602.14296.tldr: This work proposes AutoWebWorld, a novel framework for synthesizing controllable and verifiable web environments by modeling them as Finite State Machines (FSMs) and use coding agents to translate FSMs into interactive websites and observes a clear scaling law: as the synthetic data volume increases, performance on WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web consistently improves.

2602.14997.tldr: The concept of spectral convolution on orbifolds is introduced and provides a building block for making learning on orbifold structured data accessible using GDL.

2602.14771.tldr: GOT-JEPA is proposed, a model-predictive pretraining framework that extends JEPA from predicting image features to predicting tracking models and OccuSolver is proposed to enhance occlusion perception for object tracking.

2602.14536.tldr: This work proposes XTF, an explainable token-level noise filtering framework that decomposes the complex and subtle contributions of token-level data to the fine-tuning process into three distinct and explicit attributes, which can be assessed using scoring methods, and then masks the gradients of selected noisy tokens accordingly to optimize the performance of fine-tuned LLMs.

2602.14872.tldr: A theory of the training dynamics of RL for transformers on compositional reasoning tasks is developed, explaining how RLVR can improve performance at the edge of competence, and suggesting that appropriately designed data mixtures can yield scalable gains.

2602.14216.tldr: Lower accuracy in assessing fathers'cooperation supports the argument of a stronger professional focus on mothers in CPS interventions, and reasoning language models can effectively assess complex case factors such as parental cooperation.

2602.16372.tldr: Generality is demonstrated across realistic experimental scenarios, including phase-resolved decomposition in multiphase materials, quantitative recovery of mixture compositions, separation of crystalline peaks from amorphous backgrounds in semicrystalline systems, high-throughput operando lattice tracking, automated refinement of compositionally disordered solid solutions, and quantitative phase-resolved analysis of complex archaeological samples from synchrotron powder XRD.

2602.15971.tldr: B-DENSE is proposed, a novel framework that leverages multi-branch trajectory alignment to enforce dense intermediate trajectory alignment in the student model, demonstrating superior image generation quality compared to baseline distillation frameworks.

2602.16241.tldr: This work studies the behavior of LLMs as zero-shot annotators for Bangla hate speech, a task where even human agreement is challenging, and annotator bias can have serious downstream consequences.

2602.16485.tldr: Team-of-Thoughts is introduced, a novel MAS architecture that leverages the complementary capabilities of heterogeneous agents via an orchestrator-tool paradigm that achieves consistently superior task performance on AIME24 and LiveCodeBench.

2602.15277.tldr: Results demonstrate that targeted, redundancy-reducing updates, rather than brute-force optimization, bridge the gap between accuracy and efficiency in large-scale dataset distillation.

2602.14279.tldr: This work proposes a theoretically grounded framework that combines an LLM-based expected information gain objective for scoring candidate questions with a heterogeneous graph neural network propagation that aggregates observed responses and participant attributes to impute missing responses and guide per-round respondent selection.

2602.14275.tldr: R reverse n-wise output testing is introduced, a mathematically principled paradigm inversion that constructs covering arrays directly over domain-specific output equivalence classes, ML confidence calibration buckets, decision boundary regions, fairness partitions, embedding clusters, ranking stability bands, and error syndrome patterns.

2602.14233.tldr: This position paper argues that bias in financial LLM systems requires explicit attention and that structural validity should be enforced before any result is used to support a deployment claim and proposes a Structural Validity Framework and an evaluation checklist with minimal requirements for bias diagnosis and future system design.

2602.14759.tldr: This work proposes inference-time inner looping, which prolongs refinement in pretrained off-the-shelf language models by repeatedly re-applying a selected block range, and analyses of the resulting latent trajectories suggest more stable state evolution and continued semantic refinement.

2602.14676.tldr: This work identifies and proposes the Bus Evacuation Orienteering Problem (BEOP), an NP-hard combinatorial optimization problem with the goal of evacuating as many people from an affected area by bus in a short, predefined amount of time and achieves near-optimal solution quality.

2602.14615.tldr: VariViT, an improved ViT model crafted to handle variable image sizes while maintaining a consistent patch size, is proposed, which surpasses vanilla ViTs and ResNet in glioma genotype prediction and brain tumor classification and reduces computation time by up to 30% compared to conventional architectures.

2602.14158.tldr: The results indicate that agent specialisation and verification layers can mitigate key single-model limitations and provide a practical, extensible design for evidence-based and bias-aware medical AI.

2602.14503.tldr: It is shown how the available structural or statistical information can be systematically incorporated as constraints in a optimization programming formulation, yielding tighter and formally valid bounds without full identifiability.

2602.14481.tldr: A rate-distortion-complexity (RDC) framework is proposed which extends the classical rate-distortion theory by incorporating the constraints on semantic distance, including both the traditional bit-wise distortion metric and statistical difference-based divergence metric, and complexity measure, adopted from the theory of minimum description length and information bottleneck.

2602.14473.tldr: This project explores end-to-end RL methods that enable robot dogs to autonomously climb stairs and showed the successful goal reached, the transferability from the policy trained on U-shaped stairs to deployment on straight, L-shaped, and spiral stair terrains, and transferability from other stair models to deployment on U-shaped terrain.

2602.14381.tldr: This adaptation reuses existing pretrained VACE weights without additional training, and adds 20-30% latency overhead for structural control and inpainting, with negligible VRAM cost relative to the base model.

2602.14367.tldr: InnoEval is introduced, a deep innovation evaluation framework designed to emulate human-level idea assessment that can consistently outperform baselines in point-wise, pair-wise, and group-wise evaluation tasks, exhibiting judgment patterns and consensus highly aligned with human experts.

2602.14357.tldr: Examination of the challenges and trade-offs in LLM development through a 12-week ethnographic study of a team building a pedagogical chatbot revealed four key practices that show how teams made strategic decisions under constraints and demonstrate the central role of domain expertise in shaping the system.

2602.14293.tldr: KernelBlaster is proposed, a Memory-Augmented In-context Reinforcement Learning (MAIC-RL) framework designed to improve CUDA optimization search capabilities of LLM-based GPU coding agents and enables agents to learn from experience and make systematically informed decisions on future tasks by accumulating knowledge into a retrievable Persistent CUDA Knowledge Base.

2602.14682.tldr: This work directly compares the diversity of samples generated by state-of-the-art models with that of test samples drawn from the target data distribution, using recently proposed reference-free entropy-based diversity scores, Vendi and RKE, to suggest a systematic downward diversity bias in modern generative models.

2602.14681.tldr: ST-EVO is proposed, which supports dialogue-wise communication scheduling with a compact yet powerful flow-matching based Scheduler to make precise Spatio-Temporal scheduling, and can also perceive the uncertainty of MAS, and possesses self-feedback ability to learn from accumulated experience.

2602.14606.tldr: This work reframes governance as bounded causal power rather than internal intent alignment, offering a foundation for deploying autonomous agents where silent failure is unacceptable.

2602.14591.tldr: The method consists of two steps: clustering of metric vectors computed for each code change, followed by expert mapping of the resulting clusters to predefined change classes, which substantially reduces the time required for code change review.

2602.16246.tldr: proxy state-based evaluation offers a practical, scalable alternative to deterministic agentic benchmarks for industrial LLM agents, and its on-/off-policy rollouts provide supervision that transfers to unseen scenarios.

2602.14643.tldr: The results indicate that architectural decomposition reduces dependence on intrinsic model capability, enabling smaller models to match or exceed larger models operating under single-prompt baselines operating under single-prompt baselines.

2602.15513.tldr: A non-parametric memory framework that explicitly disentangles episodic and semantic memory for embodied exploration and question answering and introduces a program-style rule extraction mechanism that converts experiences into structured, reusable semantic memory, facilitating cross-environment generalization.

2602.15082.tldr: This paper presents S-PRESSO, a 48kHz sound effect compression model that produces both continuous and discrete embeddings at ultra-low bitrates, down to 0.096 kbps, via offline quantization, and demonstrates that S-PRESSO outperforms both continuous and discrete baselines in audio quality, acoustic similarity and reconstruction metrics.

2602.15195.tldr: This work detects poisoned adapters by analyzing their weight matrices directly, without running the model -- making the method trigger-agnostic and impractical for screening thousands of adapters where the trigger for backdoor behavior is unknown.

2602.16729.tldr: The results show that current adversarial safety datasets fail to faithfully represent real-world adversarial behavior due to their overreliance on triggering cues, which exposes a significant disconnect between how existing datasets evaluate model safety and how real-world adversaries behave.

2602.16177.tldr: This work proposes a notion of practical learnability grounded in finite sample settings, and develops a conjugate learning theoretical framework based on convex conjugate duality to characterize this learnability property, and derives deterministic and probabilistic bounds on generalization error based on generalized conditional entropy measures.

2602.15579.tldr: The proposed approach provides accurate vessel boundary detection while maintaining low computational complexity and requiring minimal manual annotation, offering a reliable and efficient solution for automated OCT image analysis and has potential applications in clinical decision support and real-time medical image processing.

2602.15531.tldr: This work introduces EduEVAL-DB, a dataset based on teacher roles designed to support the evaluation and training of automatic pedagogical evaluators and AI tutors for instructional explanations, and proposes a pedagogical risk rubric aligned with established educational standards.

2602.15823.tldr: CrispEdit is presented, a scalable and principled second-order editing algorithm that treats capability preservation as an explicit constraint, unifying and generalizing several existing editing approaches.

2602.14160.tldr: An agent-as-tool reinforcement learning framework for gene-disease validity curation with two objectives: process-level supervision to ensure reasoning follows valid clinical pathways, and efficient coordination via a hierarchical multi-agent system.

2602.14274.tldr: This paper presents a framework that leverages transformer-based language models to perform causal inference using unstructured text, enabling data-driven business decision-making when structured tabular data is scarce.

2602.14252.tldr: Goal Recognition Alignment through Imitation Learning (GRAIL), which leverages imitation learning and inverse reinforcement learning to learn one goal-directed policy for each candidate goal directly from (potentially suboptimal) demonstration trajectories, contributes toward scalable and robust models for interpreting agent goals in uncertain environments.

2602.14239.tldr: This study improves the TGN framework by extracting enclosing subgraphs around candidate links, enabling the model to jointly learn structural and temporal information, demonstrating the advantages of integrating local topology for robust link prediction in dynamic networks.

2602.14234.tldr: This work proposes REDSearcher, a unified framework that codesigns complex task synthesis, midtraining, and posttraining for scalable searchagent optimization, and introduces the following improvements: task synthesis as a dualconstrained optimization, where task difficulty is precisely governed by graph topology and evidence dispersion.

2602.14225.tldr: This paper proposes a staged knowledge injection recipe: cold-starting with scalable, knowledge-graph-verified Earth-science text QA to instill reasoning structures, and pre-warming on the same hard UHR image-text examples during SFT to stabilize and amplify subsequent tool-based RL.

2602.14211.tldr: This work proposes the first automated framework for stealthy prompt injection tailored to agent skills, and proposes a malicious payload hiding strategy that conceals adversarial operations in auxiliary scripts while injecting optimized inducement prompts to trigger tool execution.

2602.14526.tldr: Results demonstrate that TWISTED-RL manages to solve previously unattainable knots of higher complexity, including commonly used knots such as the Figure-8 and the Overhand, and establishes TWISTED-RL as the new state-of-the-art in robotic knot-tying without human demonstrations.

2602.14477.tldr: This work provides the first empirical characterization of peer learning among AI agents, contributing to EDM's understanding of how learning occurs in increasingly AI-populated educational environments.

2602.14462.tldr: A lightweight, model-agnostic diagnostic framework that quantifies worker-level consistency using training signals readily available in standard pipelines, and introduces three complementary metrics: loss dispersion, gradient-norm dispersion, and gradient-direction consistency measured by inter-worker cosine similarity.

2602.14445.tldr: This work proposes Selective Synchronization Attention (SSA), a novel attention mechanism that replaces the standard dot-product self-attention with a closed-form operator derived from the steady-state solution of the Kuramoto model of coupled oscillators.

2602.14370.tldr: It is shown that a large class of potentially dangerous tipping originates at the atomistic scale in such edge AI due to competition for the machinery's attention, which yields a mathematical formula for the dynamical tipping point n*, governed by dot-product competition for attention between the conversation's context and competing output basins, that reveals new control levers.

2602.14358.tldr: The purpose of this paper is to demonstrate the methodology, challenges, and impact of rearchitecting search to retrieve from the subset of most bookable high precision rectangular map cells defined by dividing the world into 25M uniform cells.

2602.14344.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical neural architecture to encode the logical structure of these formulae, and introduces an attention mechanism that enables the policy to reason about future subgoals and demonstrates the strong generalisation capabilities and superior performance of this approach.

2602.14338.tldr: Adaptive Efficient Rollout Optimization (AERO), an enhancement of GRPO, matches or improves Pass@8 and Avg@8 over GRPO, demonstrating a practical, scalable, and compute-efficient strategy for RL-based LLM alignment.

2602.14301.tldr: DeepFusion is proposed, the first scalable federated MoE training framework that enables the fusion of heterogeneous on-device LLM knowledge via federated knowledge distillation, yielding a knowledge-abundant global MoE model.

2602.14295.tldr: Machine Learning as a Tool (MLAT), a design pattern in which pre-trained statistical machine learning models are exposed as callable tools within large language model (LLM) agent workflows, generalizes to domains requiring quantitative estimation combined with contextual reasoning.

2602.14687.tldr: SynthSAEBench is introduced, a toolkit for generating large-scale synthetic data with realistic feature characteristics including correlation, hierarchy, and superposition, and a standardized benchmark model, SynthSAEBench-16k, enabling direct comparison of SAE architectures, and is used to identify a new failure mode.

2602.14655.tldr: This work proposes FAL-AD, a novel framework that synergistically integrates federated learning with data augmentation to systematically optimize data efficiency, and achieves a state-of-the-art multi-modal accuracy of 91.52%, outperforming all centralized baselines and demonstrating a practical solution to the data efficiency dilemma.

2602.14559.tldr: This paper proposes a framework that allows agents to create other agents and yields agent teams that adjust their size dynamically to match environmental demands, and presents game-theoretic solution concepts for fluid-agent games and empirically evaluates the performance of several MARL algorithms within this framework.

2602.14404.tldr: This work introduces PITA, a novel large-scale dataset of over 23 million statements in propositional logic and their corresponding proofs, and proposes notions of task depth and task breadth, which measure respectively the number of steps required to solve an example from a task and the number of unique examples across a task.

2602.15019.tldr: A benchmarking methodology for drug asset scouting and a tuned, tree-based self-learning Bioptic Agent aimed at complete, non-hallucinated scouting are proposed and performance improves steeply with additional compute, supporting the view that more compute yields better results.

2602.21534.tldr: This paper proposes ARLArena, a stable training recipe and systematic analysis framework that examines training stability in a controlled and reproducible setting and proposes SAMPO, a stable agentic policy optimization method designed to mitigate the dominant sources of instability in ARL.

2602.21814.tldr: The results suggest that structured reasoning scaffolds -- specifically, forced goal articulation before inference -- matter substantially more than context injection for implicit constraint reasoning tasks.

2602.21647.tldr: This work validates that targeted punctuation restoration is the most effective intervention for mitigating structural noise in the Nepali S2TT pipeline and establishes an optimized baseline, demonstrating a critical architectural insight for developing cascaded speech translation systems for similar low-resource languages.

2602.21515.tldr: A multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm is developed that integrates strategic risk aversion into standard policy optimization methods and consistently achieves reliable collaboration with heterogeneous and previously unseen partners across collaborative tasks.

2602.21819.tldr: SemVideo is introduced, a novel fMRI-to-video reconstruction framework guided by hierarchical semantic information that achieves superior performance in both semantic alignment and temporal consistency, setting a new state-of-the-art in fMRI-to-video reconstruction.

2602.21772.tldr: UniWhisper is proposed, an efficient continual multi-task training framework that casts heterogeneous audio tasks into a unified instruction and answer format that enables standard next-token training without task-specific heads and losses.

2602.21858.tldr: ProactiveMobile formalizes the proactive task as inferring latent user intent across four dimensions of on-device contextual signals and generating an executable function sequence from a comprehensive function pool of 63 APIs, indicating that proactivity is a critical competency widely lacking in current MLLMs, yet it is learnable, emphasizing the importance of the proposed benchmark for proactivity evaluation.

2602.21746.tldr: The resulting extended fEDM, called fEDM+, preserves formal verifiability while achieving enhanced interpretability and stakeholder-aware validation, making it suitable as an oversight and governance layer for ethically sensitive AI systems.

2208.10300.tldr: This work proposes an offline, interpretable utility learning method that uses expert knowledge, historical examples, and coarse information about the utility space to reduce sample requirements and outperforms standard Gaussian processes and BOPE across four domains.

2304.07437.tldr: This article proposes a novel medical question summarization framework based on entity-driven contrastive learning (ECL), which employs medical entities present in frequently asked questions as focuses and devises an effective mechanism to generate hard negative samples.

2304.11127.tldr: The recommended setting concluded from the ablation studies is demonstrated to improve the performance of TPE and the roles of each control parameter in TPE and the algorithm intuition have not been discussed so far.

2404.06167.tldr: This work introduces scCDCG (single-cell RNA-seq Clustering via Deep Cut-informed Graph), a novel framework designed for efficient and accurate clustering of scRNA-seq data that simultaneously utilizes intercellular high-order structural information.

2406.00894.tldr: Manticore hybrids match existing manually designed hybrids, achieve strong performance on Long Range Arena, and improve on pretrained transformers and state space models on various natural language tasks.

2407.11843.tldr: InferAct is introduced, a novel approach that leverages the belief reasoning ability of LLMs, grounded in Theory-of-Mind, to detect misaligned actions before execution and alerts users for timely correction, preventing adverse outcomes and enhancing the reliability of LLM agents'decision-making processes.

2407.15143.tldr: This study aims to investigate the performance and characteristics of remote sensing object detection models under very long training schedules, and proposes a novel method named Dynamic Backbone Freezing (DBF) for feature backbone fine-tuning on remote sensing object detection under long-term training.

2409.17385.tldr: This work revisits trajectory prediction from a data-centric perspective and presents Den-TP, a framework for density-aware dataset curation and evaluation and introduces density-conditioned evaluation protocols that reveal long-tail failure modes overlooked by conventional metrics.

2410.01779.tldr: The analysis on gradient dynamics shows that overparameterization asymptotically decouples training dynamics and is beneficial, and it is shown that training dynamics favors simpler solutions under weight decay, and thus high-order global solutions such as perfect memorization are unfavorable.

2410.22559.tldr: This work gives a clear definition of disentanglement, explains why it emerges in VAEs and shows that, under stated assumptions, ground truth factors are identifiable even with a symmetric prior.

2411.09986.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage method which consists of open-set aware meta-learning with open-set free transfer learning, and demonstrates the effectiveness of transfer learning in FSOSR.

2411.11027.tldr: BianCang is proposed, a TCM-specific LLM, using a two-stage training process that first injects domainspecific knowledge and then aligns it through targeted stimulation to enhance diagnostic and differentiation capabilities.

2412.07448.tldr: This paper proposes an efficient Dynamic Ensemble Reasoning paradigm, called DER to integrate the strengths of multiple LLM experts conditioned on dynamic inputs, and develops a Knowledge Transfer Prompt that enables the subsequent LLM candidates to transfer complementary knowledge effectively.

2501.08234.tldr: A parametrisable and versatile reinforcement learning simulator designed to model a variety of railway network configurations and demand patterns while enabling realistic, microscopic modelling of user behaviour is presented, which supports the proposed MARL framework, which models heterogeneous agents competing to maximise individual profits while fostering cooperative behaviour to synchronise connecting services.

2501.13115.tldr: This paper deploys Happy Ending Attack (HEA) to wrap up a malicious request in a scenario template involving a positive prompt formed mainly via a $\textit{happy ending}$, it thus fools LLMs into jailbreaking either immediately or at a follow-up malicious request.

2501.15562.tldr: A CE-SDWV framework is proposed, which removes the target concepts of T2I diffusion models in the text semantic space by only adjusting the text condition tokens and does not need to re-train the original T2I diffusion model's weights.

2501.17391.tldr: A learning-free token reduction (LFTR) method designed for MLLMs that can be seamlessly integrated into most open-source MLLM architectures without requiring additional fine-tuning, and is complementary to other acceleration techniques, such as vision encoder compression and post-training quantization, further promoting the efficient deployment of MLLMs.

2502.00850.tldr: This paper first shifts the focus from model reliability to policy discrepancies while optimizing for expected returns, and then self-consistently incorporate synthetic data, deriving a novel actor-critic paradigm, Dual Alignment Maximin Optimization (DAMO).

2502.03214.tldr: iVISPAR, an interactive multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate the spatial reasoning capabilities of VLMs acting as agents, is introduced, based on a variant of the sliding tile puzzle, a classic problem that demands logical planning, spatial awareness, and multi-step reasoning.

2502.11569.tldr: ThinkSLM is introduced, the first extensive benchmark to systematically evaluate and study the reasoning abilities of SLMs trained from scratch or derived from LLMs through quantization, pruning, and distillation, and foresee a future where SLMs with strong reasoning capabilities can be developed through structured training or post-training compression.

2502.12398.tldr: An algorithm, Pretender, is proposed that allows end users to proactively solve the cold start problem on their own and establishes theoretical guarantees for Pretender based on a discrete quadrature problem.

2502.16249.tldr: LION is introduced, the first framework to systematically extend Linear Transformers to the bidirectional setting, and enables models to match or exceed the performance of softmax Transformers, while offering significantly faster training and more efficient inference than existing State Space Models.

2502.17139.tldr: Following draft-verification paradigm, FastCoder is proposed, a simple yet highly efficient inference acceleration approach specifically designed for code generation, without compromising the quality of the output.

2502.19130.tldr: This work systematically evaluates the impact of seven decision protocols, changing only one variable at a time - the decision protocol - to analyze how different methods affect the collaboration between agents and measure differences in knowledge and reasoning tasks.

2503.01332.tldr: It is found that a simple skill-decomposition method, which isolates the independent skills required for answer-or-defer decision making, can consistently improve LMs'decision policies.

2503.01508.tldr: Relative Neighbor Density is presented, a domain-agnostic algorithm for novelty assessment in research ideas that overcomes the limitations of existing approaches by comparing an idea's local density with its adjacent neighbors'densities, addressing a fundamental challenge in novelty assessment.

2503.02296.tldr: Empirical evaluations on code generation benchmarks MBPP+ and BigCodeBench reveal that memorization does not increase with larger models and in many cases alleviates as they scale; supervised fine-tuning (SFT) improves accuracy while introduces memorization; and reinforcement learning with proximal policy optimization (PPO) achieves a more balanced trade-off between memorization and generalization.

2503.08643.tldr: This work argues that most inference methods can be unified within a simple framework which involves no statistical concepts, aligns with the degraded objective function, and provides an novel and intuitive perspective on the inference process.

2503.11906.tldr: This survey establishes a first-of-its-kind taxonomy for categorizing relevant research based on DL models, handcrafted feature use, SAR attribute utilization, and the impact of fine-tuning, and explores potential avenues for future research.

2503.15484.tldr: It is demonstrated that value profiles offer novel, predictive ways to describe individual variation beyond demographics or group information, and the decoder predictions change in line with semantic profile differences, are well-calibrated, and can help explain instance-level disagreement by simulating an annotator population.

2503.17760.tldr: CODA adapts off-the-shelf continuous VAEs -- already optimized for perceptual compression -- into discrete tokenizers via a carefully designed discretization process, ensuring stable and efficient training while retaining the strong visual fidelity of continuous VAEs.

2503.19607.tldr: A browser-based Minecraft testbed to accelerate testing and deployment of collaborative AI agents and a tool to allow users to revisit and analyze behaviors within an HMT episode to facilitate shared mental model development are presented.

2504.01317.tldr: Adaptive Rectification Sampling (AR-Sampling) is proposed, which can guide the LLMs to self-correction at the appropriate step, which enables the models to rethink in more fine-grained level, improving the accuracy of solutions, while generating a reasonable number of additional tokens.

2505.04931.tldr: This work investigates the algorithmic fairness of UQ, namely Equal Opportunity Coverage (EOC) fairness, and proposes Fair Uncertainty Quantification (FUQ) for depression prediction, a fairness-aware optimization strategy that formulates fairness as a constrained optimization problem under EOC constraints.

2505.05181.tldr: Stochastic Layer-wise Learning (SLL), a layer-wise training algorithm that decomposes the global objective into coordinated layer-local updates while preserving global representational coherence, is introduced, eliminating cross-layer backpropagation.

2505.07675.tldr: Dual-Head Optimization (DHO), which introduces dual prediction heads for each distinct signal, is proposed, which observes that DHO resolves gradient conflicts, enabling improved feature learning compared to single-head KD baselines, with practical benefits of minimal computational overhead and test-time hyperparameter tuning without retraining.

2505.09371.tldr: TensorRL-QAS is introduced, an improved framework that combines tensor network methods with RL for QAS that demonstrates effectiveness on systems on 20-qubit quantum systems, positioning it as a state-of-the-art quantum circuit discovery framework for near-term hardware and beyond.

2505.10169.tldr: This work proposes a novel architecture extending a mostly dataset-agnostic encoder-decoder structure with fewer than 20 dataset-specific parameters that govern interpretable mechanisms such as multi-scale structure, center bias, and fixation spread, and provides valuable insights into spatial saliency properties.

2505.13355.tldr: This survey explores the synergistic potential between bandit algorithms and Large Language Models, highlighting how bandit algorithms can enhance the performance of LLMs and how LLMs, in turn, can provide novel insights for improving bandit-based decision-making.

2505.13820.tldr: Structured Agent Distillation is a framework that compresses large LLM-based agents into smaller student models while preserving both reasoning fidelity and action consistency, and segments trajectories into {[REASON]} and {[ACT]} spans.

2505.15420.tldr: This paper introduces Implicit Knowledge Extraction Attack (IKEA), which conducts Knowledge Extraction on RAG systems through benign queries and demonstrates IKEA's effectiveness under various defenses, surpassing baselines by over 80% in extraction efficiency and 90% in attack success rate.

2505.15441.tldr: This paper introduces Octic Vision Transformers (octic ViTs) which rely on octic group equivariance to capture natural geometric symmetries and studies two new families of ViTs that are either fully octic equivariant or break equivariance in the last part of the network.

2505.15734.tldr: This paper proposes Debate, Train, Evolve (DTE), a novel ground truth-free training framework that uses multi-agent debate traces to evolve a single language model, and introduces a new prompting strategy Reflect-Critique-Refine, to improve debate quality by explicitly instructing agents to critique and refine their reasoning.

2505.16211.tldr: Experimental results on 14 state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source ALLMs reveal important limitations and failure boundaries under diverse high-risk audio scenarios, providing critical insights for the secure and trustworthy deployment of future audio models.

2505.17373.tldr: It is found that block-wise value-guided search (VGS) with a final weighted majority vote achieves better test-time scaling than standard methods such as majority voting or best-of-n.

2505.21500.tldr: This work establishes a crucial benchmark for spatial intelligence in embodied AI systems and provides empirical evidence that modeling 3D spatial relationships enhances VLMs'responding spatial comprehension capabilities.

2505.23864.tldr: Empirical evaluations across diverse graph benchmarks demonstrate that FedAux substantially outperforms existing baselines in both accuracy and personalization performance, and provides rigorous theoretical analysis to establish the convergence and rationality of the design.

2506.00613.tldr: A world-model-based policy evaluation environment (WorldGym), an autoregressive, action-conditioned video generation model which serves as a proxy to real world environments and enables efficient evaluation of robot policies' generalization ability on novel tasks and environments.

2506.01413.tldr: This work stems from the decomposition of complex instructions under existing taxonomies and proposes a reproducible data acquisition method that addresses the shallow, non-essential nature of reasoning under complex instructions via sample-wise contrast for superior CoT enforcement.

2506.02387.tldr: This work introduces Visual Strategic Bench (VS-Bench), a multimodal benchmark that evaluates VLMs for strategic abilities in multi-agent environments and envisions it as a foundation for future research on strategic multimodal agents.

2506.02606.tldr: Symbiosis of Agents is presented, a large-scale installation by artist Baoyang Chen, integrating AI-driven robotic agents within an immersive, reflective environment, foregrounding the delicate balance between machine agency and artist authorship by harnessing emergent behaviors from self-organized AI robotic ecologies as a creative apparatus.

2506.03621.tldr: Subject Fidelity Optimization (SFO), a novel comparative learning framework for zero-shot subject-driven generation that enhances subject fidelity, is presented and Condition-Degradation Negative Sampling (CDNS) is proposed, which automatically produces synthetic negatives tailored for subject-driven generation.

2506.04624.tldr: This work proposes new static word embeddings optimised for sentence semantic representation that substantially outperforms existing static models on sentence semantic tasks, and even surpasses a basic Sentence Transformer model (SimCSE) on a text embedding benchmark.

2506.08479.tldr: Adaptive-$k$ retrieval is presented, a simple and effective single-pass method that adaptively selects the number of passages based on the distribution of the similarity scores between the query and the candidate passages, highlighting that dynamically adjusting context size leads to more efficient and accurate QA.

2506.09785.tldr: This work proposes a novel theoretical framework for contrastive SSL tailored to continuous dependent data, which allows the nearest samples to be semantically close to each other and derives an analytical form for the estimated similarity matrix that accommodates both types of closeness between samples, thereby introducing dependency-aware loss functions.

2506.12299.tldr: QGuard is proposed, a simple yet effective safety guard method that utilizes question prompting to block harmful prompts in a zero-shot manner that can defend LLMs not only from text-based harmful prompts but also from multi-modal harmful prompt attacks.

2506.14399.tldr: Decoupled Classifier-Free Guidance (DCFG) is proposed, a flexible and model-agnostic guidance technique that enables attribute-wise control following a causal graph, leading to significant spurious changes in inferred counterfactuals.

2506.21095.tldr: FeDa4Fair is introduced, the first benchmarking framework designed to stress-test fairness methods under heterogeneous client bias in Federated Learning, and ready-to-use functions for evaluating fairness outcomes for these datasets are provided.

2507.02824.tldr: Simulation results show that the DNN maintains suboptimal spectral efficiency even as the distance between the end-user and the RIS has variations in the testing phase, highlighting the potential of DNN in advancing RIS-aided systems.

2507.04909.tldr: A modern HV-MMBench is proposed, a rigorously curated benchmark designed to provide a more holistic evaluation of MLLMs in human-centric video understanding, and offers the following key features.

2507.07966.tldr: A full-stack framework that scales up reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) to long videos, leveraging reinforcement learning, and releases a training system for public availability that supports RL training on various modalities, various models, and even image and video generation models.

2507.13266.tldr: This paper proposes a simple yet effective strategy via Question Augmentation: introduce partial solutions during training to reduce problem difficulty and provide more informative learning signals, which enables continual improvement over strong open-source models such as DeepScaleR and OpenMath Nemotron, further enhancing their reasoning capabilities.

2507.13614.tldr: This study characterizes texts using a set of linguistic features across different linguistic levels such as morphology, syntax, and semantics for characterizing human-written and machine-generated texts along with different sampling strategies, repetition controls, and model release dates.

2507.15849.tldr: It is shown that language mixing can enhance reasoning: enforcing monolingual decoding reduces accuracy by 5.6 percentage points on MATH500, and a lightweight probe can be trained to predict whether a potential language switch would benefit or harm reasoning, and when used to guide decoding, increases accuracy.

2507.15855.tldr: A model-agnostic, verification-and-refinement pipeline is constructed that correctly solved 5 out of the 6 IMO 2025 problems and underscores that the path to advanced AI reasoning requires not only developing more powerful base models but also designing effective methodologies to harness their full potential for complex tasks.

2507.16514.tldr: The Ever-Evolving Science Exam (EESE), a dynamic benchmark designed to reliably assess scientific capabilities in foundation models, is introduced, offering a realistic measure of how well foundation models handle science questions.

2508.00083.tldr: This paper presents a systematic survey of the field of LLM-based code generation agents, tracing the technology's developmental trajectory from its inception and systematically categorizing its core techniques, including both single-agent and multi-agent architectures.

2508.00956.tldr: U2QT (Unified User Quantized Tokenizers), a novel framework that integrates cross-domain knowledge transfer with early fusion of heterogeneous domains, enables seamless integration with language models and supports industrial-scale applications.

2508.06756.tldr: A Foundation-based Biomarker Network (FoundBioNet) that utilizes a SWIN-UNETR-based architecture to noninvasively predict IDH mutation status from multi-parametric MRI, and enhances diagnostic accuracy and interpretability, with the potential to enable more personalized patient care.

2508.12379.tldr: GraphCogent is a collaborative agent framework inspired by human Working Memory Model that decomposes graph reasoning into specialized cognitive processes: sense, buffer, and execute that achieves a 50% improvement over massive-scale LLMs like DeepSeek-R1.

2508.15372.tldr: Experimental results show that ICGS-Quantizer consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in compression efficiency and adaptability to scene changes.

2508.19294.tldr: It is expected that LVLMs will soon meet or surpass the performance of conventional methods in object detection and will continue to make a transformative impact on object detection and robotic applications in the future.

2508.21107.tldr: This work proposes UTRL, a novel reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to generate high-quality unit tests given a programming instruction, and demonstrates that unit tests generated by Qwen3-4B trained via UTRL show higher quality compared to unit tests generated by the same model trained via supervised fine-tuning on human-written ground-truth unit tests.

2509.01245.tldr: SchedCP is introduced, the first framework that enables fully autonomous Large Language Model agents to safely and efficiently optimize Linux schedulers without human involvement, and represents a step towards creating truly self-optimizing, application-aware operating systems.

2509.05728.tldr: The proposed temporal LiDAR-BIND, or LiDAR-BIND-T, maintains modular modality fusion while substantially enhancing temporal stability, resulting in improved robustness and performance for downstream SLAM.

2509.06346.tldr: This work introduces Ban&Pick, a post-training, plug-and-play strategy for smarter routing that delivers free performance gains and inference acceleration without retraining or architectural changes.

2509.07260.tldr: This work systematically evaluated SLMs on health prediction tasks using zero-shot, few-shot, and instruction fine-tuning approaches, and deployed the best performing fine-tuned SLMs on mobile devices to evaluate their real-world efficiency and predictive performance in practical healthcare scenarios.

2509.11662.tldr: MindSpeed-MLLM is introduced, a highly efficient training framework that supports stable and high-performance training of large-scale Dense and Mixture-of-Experts models on Ascend hardware and provides the community with a valuable hardware alternative, open data recipes, and effective performance-enhancing techniques.

2509.12838.tldr: A novel few-shot prompting strategy that enables LLMs to infer required objects from ambiguous commands and decompose them into appropriate subtasks and decompose them into appropriate subtasks is designed.

2509.13368.tldr: This work advances a new paradigm in which agents can design and optimize other agents, underscoring the potential of agent-generates-agent systems for automated AI development.

2509.14353.tldr: It is demonstrated that this human motion-informed prior allows RL to discover solutions unattainable by direct RL, and that diffusion models inherently promote natural looking motions, aiding in sim-to-real transfer.

2509.20154.tldr: A novel semi-supervised learning framework that builds on the U-Mamba2 model and employs a multi-stage training strategy, which leverages unlabeled data through consistency regularization and a pseudo-labeling strategy is implemented with a reduced loss weighting to minimize the impact of potential errors.

2509.20230.tldr: StableUN is proposed, a bi-level feedback-guided optimization framework that explicitly seeks more stable parameter regions via neighborhood-aware optimization that integrates forgetting feedback, which uses adversarial perturbations to probe parameter neighborhoods, with remembering feedback to preserve model utility, aligning the two objectives through gradient projection.

2509.20411.tldr: A four-dimensional taxonomy spanning defensive function, GAN architecture, cybersecurity domain, and adversarial threat model is introduced, emphasizing hybrid models, unified evaluation, real-world integration, and defenses against emerging threats such as LLM-driven cyberattacks.

2509.21761.tldr: This work pioneers the exploration of mechanistic interpretability in LLM backdoors, demonstrating a powerful method for backdoor control and revealing actionable insights for the community.

2509.22460.tldr: Experiments on strong MLLM baselines demonstrate that GeoSketch significantly improves stepwise reasoning accuracy and problem-solving success over static perception methods, establishing a new foundation for solving complex visuospatial problems.

2509.22502.tldr: InfiAgent is proposed, a Pyramid-like DAG-based Multi-Agent Framework that can be applied to InfiNite scenarios, which introduces several key innovations: a generalized"agent-as-a-tool"mechanism that automatically decomposes complex agents into hierarchical multi-agent systems; a dual-audit mechanism that ensures the quality and stability of task completion.

2509.22504.tldr: EELMA (Estimating Empowerment of Language Model Agents), an algorithm for approximating effective empowerment from multi-turn text interactions, is introduced and it is found that empowerment strongly correlates with average task performance, characterize the impact of environmental complexity and agentic factors on estimated empowerment, and that high empowerment states and actions are often pivotal moments for general capabilities.

2509.22739.tldr: PAS constructs a fast, lightweight activation vector that can be cheaply trained, easily stored, and activated at will, and provides a characterization of where AS helps, where it fails, and how to deploy it as a practical, automated LM post-training option.

2509.22820.tldr: MMPB is introduced, the first extensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs on personalization and reveals that most VLMs (including some closed-source models) struggle with personalization, particularly in maintaining consistency over dialogue, handling user preferences, and adapting to visual cues.

2509.23285.tldr: The impact of tool calls on model reasoning from the perspective of information entropy indicates that tool call results lead to a distinct change in the information entropy of subsequent reasoning, with the overall entropy of the reasoning chain varying based on the number of tool calls.

2509.23484.tldr: This work introduces a probabilistic modelling framework rooted in Item Response Theory (IRT) that achieves over 80 percent accuracy, setting a new benchmark for mathematics prediction accuracy of formal exam papers.

2509.23778.tldr: The Sequential Pathfinder (SePar) is proposed, which leverages the Transformer paradigm to achieve implicit information exchange, reducing decision-making complexity from exponential to linear while maintaining efficiency and global awareness.

2509.23946.tldr: The Explore-Execute Chain is proposed, a structured reasoning framework that decouples reasoning into two distinct phases: an exploratory phase that stochastically generates succinct high-level plans, followed by an execution phase that deterministically carries out the chosen plan.

2509.24148.tldr: TENET is introduced, an LLM agent for generating functions in complex real-world repositories under the TDD setting, and this is the first study of test-driven code generation with repository-level context, examining how different aspects of test suites affect the performance of LLM agents under the TDD setting.

2509.24218.tldr: This work proposes Column-Normalized Adam (Conda), a novel optimizer that bridges the strengths of both approaches of Adam and achieves both improved spectral conditioning and maintaining coordinate-wise adaptivity, thereby achieving both improved spectral conditioning and maintaining coordinate-wise adaptivity.

2509.24263.tldr: PAME-AI, a novel approach for Patient Messaging Creation and Optimization using Agentic AI, offers a structured framework to move from raw data to actionable insights for high-performance messaging design and is particularly suitable for large-scale healthcare communication optimization.

2509.24297.tldr: The experiments show that while state-of-the-art models can generate MMQAs, their outputs still leave substantial gaps, underscoring the need for reliable evaluation and demonstrate that top-tier understanding models align closely with human judgment in MMQA quality assessment.

2509.24361.tldr: UI-UG is introduced, a unified MLLM for UI Understanding and Generation that achieves state-of-the-art performance on understanding tasks, outperforming both larger general-purpose MLLMs and similarly-sized UI-specialized models and is also on par with these larger MLLMs in UI generation performance at a fraction of the computational cost.

2509.24509.tldr: The Experience-Guided Reflective Co-Evolution of Prompt and Heuristics (EvoPH) is proposed, a novel framework that integrates the island migration model with the elites selection algorithm to simulate diverse heuristics populations, advancing the field of automatic algorithm design with LLMs.

2509.24773.tldr: This paper bridges the gap with VSSFlow, a unified flow-matching framework that seamlessly solve video-conditioned audio generation and state-of-the-art domain-specific baselines, underscoring the critical potential of unified generative models.

2509.24922.tldr: This work proposes MASLegalBench, a legal benchmark tailored for MAS and designed with a deductive reasoning approach, encompassing extensive background knowledge and covering complex reasoning processes that effectively reflect the intricacies of real-world legal situations.

2509.25077.tldr: BRIDGE, an RL-optimized depth-to-image (D2I) generation framework that synthesizes over 20M realistic and geometrically accurate RGB images, each intrinsically paired with its ground truth depth, from diverse source depth maps, thereby fostering general and robust depth features.

2509.25612.tldr: T-BiGAN, a novel framework that integrates window-attention Transformers within a bidirectional Generative Adversarial Network (BiGAN) to address the timely and unsupervised detection of anomalies in synchrophasor data streams, shows particular strength in detecting subtle frequency and voltage deviations.

2509.25613.tldr: A Self-supervised Model Seeding scheme to provide unlearning verification for genuine samples, which links user-specific seeds, original samples, and models, thereby facilitating the verification of unlearning genuine samples.

2509.25618.tldr: This work presents an approach for exact computation of Nash equilibrium in multiplayer imperfect-information games that solves a quadratically-constrained program based on a nonlinear complementarity problem formulation from the sequence-form game representation and demonstrates to outperform a previous quadratically-constrained program formulation.

2509.25647.tldr: This paper proposes BaB-prob, a model that iteratively divides the original problem into subproblems by splitting preactivations and leverages linear bounds computed by linear bound propagation to bound the probability for each subproblem.

2509.25651.tldr: This work introduces AutoLabs, a self-correcting, multi-agent architecture designed to autonomously translate natural-language instructions into executable protocols for a high-throughput liquid handler, and demonstrates that agent reasoning capacity is the most critical factor for success, reducing quantitative errors in chemical amounts by over 85% in complex tasks.

2509.25652.tldr: IRCAM-AVN (Iterative Residual Cross-Attention Mechanism for Audiovisual Navigation), an end-to-end framework that integrates multimodal information fusion and sequence modeling within a unified IRCAM module, thereby replacing the traditional separate components for fusion and GRU.

2509.25655.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the LGK method outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on the R2R and REVERIE vision-and-language navigation datasets, particularly in terms of navigation error, success rate, and path efficiency.

2509.25660.tldr: The Capacity-Net is proposed to establish a mapping among the received pilot signals, optimized RIS phase shifts, and the resultant achievable rates, which obtains performance similar to that of an iterative optimization algorithm and the unsupervised learning that is trained by perfect CSI in terms of achievable rates.

2509.25661.tldr: Deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) based deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is proposed to solve the optimization problem of multiple reconfigurable intelligent surfaces-aided multiuser downlink systems.

2509.25667.tldr: A framework that uses Convolutional Neural Network-Transformer Hybrid Model, named CTHM, for motor imagery EEG classification, which achieves a test accuracy of 91.73% compared with various machine learning baseline models, including XGBoost, EEGNet, and a transformer-based model.

2509.25669.tldr: A method to improve Visual Question Answering (VQA) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by introducing text-grounded object localization that enhances context-aware VQA responses and reduces background noise, improves alignment between visual and textual cues, and helps mitigate hallucinations.

2509.25672.tldr: SING-SQL is introduced, a fully automated two-stage framework for generating high-quality, high-coverage synthetic Text-to-SQL data for any target database, without relying on SQL logs or manual annotations, and SingSQL-LM, a family of compact language models fine-tuned on the synthetic data, achieving strong in-domain generalization.

2509.25689.tldr: This work proposes a collaborative compression framework by combining expert pruning, mixed-precision quantization, and activation optimization that can effectively reduce the storage footprint of the ultra-large MoE DeepSeek-V3 from 1.3TB to 103GB, while preserving high output quality with better accuracy than traditional uniform low-bit quantization methods.

2509.25692.tldr: Conformal Prediction Active TTA is proposed, which first brings principled, coverage-guaranteed uncertainty into ATTA, which employs smoothed conformal scores with a top-K certainty measure, an online weight-update algorithm driven by pseudo coverage, and a staged update scheme balances human-labeled and model-labeled data.

2509.25716.tldr: This paper proposes a novel technique to expand the code and index for predicting the required APIs, directly enabling high-quality, end-to-end code generation for auto-completion and agentic AI applications.

2509.25727.tldr: B2R redefines CTG as a boundary constraint under a fixed safety budget, unifying the cost distribution of all feasible trajectories while preserving reward structures and establishes a new theoretical and practical approach for applying sequence models to safe RL.

2509.25729.tldr: This work proposes a novel methodology for privacy-preserving synthetic text generation that leverages the principles of de-identification and the Hiding In Plain Sight (HIPS) theory, and introduces entity-aware control codes to guide controllable generation using either in-context learning (ICL) or prefix tuning.

2509.25751.tldr: A heterogeneous graph reinforcement learning framework enhanced with an expert system to improve AV decision-making performance and demonstrates that the proposed method has superior performance over several baselines regarding safety, efficiency, stability, and convergence rate, all while maintaining favorable real-time performance.

2509.25757.tldr: This work evaluates NePTune on multiple visual reasoning benchmarks and various domains, utilizing adversarial tests, and demonstrates a significant improvement over strong base models, as well as its effective compositional generalization and adaptation capabilities in novel environments.

2509.25758.tldr: This work uses circuit analysis to demonstrate that post-training for complex reasoning sparks the emergence of novel, functionally specialized attention heads, which collectively support structured reasoning and computation.

2509.25760.tldr: This work proposes TruthRL, a general reinforcement learning (RL) framework that directly optimizes the truthfulness of LLMs by incentivizing models to reduce hallucinations not only by providing correct responses, but also by enabling abstention when uncertain, thereby improving truthfulness.

2509.25771.tldr: Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple benchmarks show that the introduced Text Preference Optimization methods consistently outperform their original counterparts, delivering better human preference scores and improved text-to-image alignment.

2509.25773.tldr: This work introduces v-HUB, a novel video humor understanding benchmark, and evaluates a diverse set of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that can natively process audio, covering both open-source and proprietary domains.

2509.25781.tldr: A definition of Deontic Argumentation Theory that accounts for weak permission is provided, and a new semantics that supports weak permission is proposed.

2509.25792.tldr: PureVQ-GAN, a defense against data poisoning that forces backdoor triggers through a discrete bottleneck using Vector-Quantized VAE with GAN discriminator is introduced, making it practical for real training pipelines.

2509.25794.tldr: This work introduces the Point-It-Out (PIO) benchmark, a novel benchmark designed to systematically assess the embodied reasoning abilities of VLMs through precise visual grounding, and proposes a hierarchical evaluation protocol spanning three stages.

2509.25803.tldr: This paper conducts extensive experiments to evaluate three types of Transformer models: Encoder-Only, Decoder-Only, and Encoder-Decoder models, and reveals that while LLMs demonstrate impressive capabilities in various natural language processing tasks, they do not significantly outperform small proprietary models in the specific context of financial transaction understanding.

2509.25818.tldr: This study proposes VELA, an automatic evaluation metric for long captions developed within a novel LLM-Hybrid-as-a-Judge framework, and proposes LongCap-Arena, a benchmark specifically designed for evaluating metrics for long captions.

2509.25827.tldr: A novel framework, DECS, is introduced, built on the theoretical discovery of two previously unaddressed flaws in current length rewards: the erroneous penalization of essential exploratory tokens and the inadvertent rewarding of partial redundancy.

2509.25837.tldr: Experiments show that CSD consistently surpasses recent KD objectives, achieves favorable fidelity-diversity trade-offs, and yields complementary gains when combined with on-policy techniques, demonstrating its scalability and effectiveness for LLM distillation.

2509.25839.tldr: A rigorous mathematical analysis is provided demonstrating that regularization establishes an upper bound on the norm distortion rate of transformed vectors, thereby offering provable guarantees for k-NN preservation.

2509.25841.tldr: Spatially-aware Separability-driven Feature Selection (S$^2$FS), a novel framework for FDSs guided by a spatially-aware separability criterion, which jointly considers within-class compactness and between-class separation by integrating scalar-distances with spatial directional information, providing a more comprehensive characterization of class structures.

2509.25842.tldr: This work proposes HiStyle, a two-stage style embedding predictor that hierarchically predicts style embeddings conditioned on textual prompts, and proposes a style annotation strategy that leverages the complementary strengths of statistical methodologies and human auditory preferences to generate more accurate and perceptually consistent textual prompts for style control.

2509.25843.tldr: Activation-Scaling Guard (ASGuard) is introduced, an insightful, mechanistically-informed framework that surgically mitigates this specific vulnerability of large language models and underscores how adversarial suffixes suppress the propagation of the refusal-mediating direction, based on mechanistic analysis.

2509.25849.tldr: This work views each task's exploration as an "item" with a distinct "value" and "cost" with an optimal assignment rule that adaptively distributes resources based on the model's current learning status, and derives an optimal assignment rule that adaptively distributes resources based on the model's current learning status.

2509.25857.tldr: A novel end-to-end automatic generation approach for vector sketch animation that describes the frame-wise movement of stroke control points using differentiable polynomial-based trajectories, and employs a Bernstein basis to balance the sensitivity of polynomial parameters, thus achieving more stable optimization.

2509.25858.tldr: The autoencoder with K-means clustering machine learning method was adopted to career trend classification of NBA players, and the LSTM deep learning method was adopted in performance prediction of each NBA player.

2509.25862.tldr: This work introduces CIMNAS, a joint model-quantization-hardware optimization framework for CIM architectures that achieves EDAP-focused optimization without any accuracy loss, generating diverse software-hardware parameter combinations for high-performance CIM-based neural network designs.

2509.25873.tldr: The results suggest that Lita is sufficient to reveal the underlying coding competence of modern LLMs, and the Agent Complexity Law is proposed, which proposes the performance gap between agents of varying complexity will shrink as the core model improves, ultimately converging to a negligible difference.

2509.25876.tldr: ExploRLer is introduced, a pluggable pipeline that seamlessly integrates with on-policy algorithms such as PPO and TRPO, systematically probing the unexplored neighborhoods of surrogate on-policy gradient updates, and achieves significant improvements over baselines in complex continuous control environments.

2509.25885.tldr: This work introduces SafeMindAgent, a modular Planner-Executor architecture integrated with three cascaded safety modules, which incorporate safety constraints into the reasoning process and shows that SafeMindAgent significantly improves safety rate over strong baselines while maintaining comparable task completion.

2509.25897.tldr: RoleConflictBench is introduced, a novel benchmark designed to measure the contextual sensitivity of LLMs in role conflict scenarios, and reveals that models substantially deviate from this objective baseline.

2509.25903.tldr: A computationally efficient method for evaluation of personalization quality of a given text (generated by a language model) is introduced, called PerQ, which shows the usability of the proposed metric in research, effectively reducing the waste of resources.

2509.25905.tldr: A digital twin (DT)-based approach for user-centric communication service provision for MAR and proposes an algorithm for network resource management that ensures the timeliness of frame uploading and the robustness against inherent inaccuracies in data traffic modeling for individual MAR devices.

2509.25919.tldr: StorInfer, a novel storage-assisted LLM inference system that accelerates response time by precomputing and storing predictable query-response pairs offline, highlights a promising direction in leveraging storage as a primary enabler for efficient, low-latency LLM deployment.

2509.25922.tldr: DeepJSONEval is introduced, a novel benchmark featuring 2100 multi-domain instances with deep nested structures, categorized by difficulty, to advance research in structured JSON generation.

2509.25923.tldr: The KIRETT project serves to provide treatment recommendations and situation detection, combined on a wrist-worn wearable for rescue operations and show their impact on health professionals and patients in need.

2509.25927.tldr: Results show that while scaling improves robustness, data quality, architecture, and training objectives play a more decisive role than raw scale in achieving broad-spectrum adversarial resilience.

2509.25928.tldr: A wearable device is developed to support in time-critical emergencies and presents a way to provide treatment recommendation in rescue services in KIRETT, and the quantitative results of a two-day KIRETT evaluation are presented.

2509.25933.tldr: This work evaluates conditions under which the Group-Sum layer performs well and how it can be applied to large-scale classification of up to 2000 classes and provides key insights into the importance of temperature tuning and its impact on output layer performance.

2509.25941.tldr: This work estimates the solvability of each question and adapts outcome-supervised reward models and reinforcement learning with group-relative advantage to incorporate solvability into their objectives to highlight solvability as a key factor for reducing hallucinations and increasing reliability in CoT reasoning.

2509.25944.tldr: A fine-tuned 7B VLM agent improves accuracy to 41% and reduces latency by 75%, demonstrating explicit spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities that proprietary models lacked, establishing NuRisk as a critical benchmark for advancing spatio-temporal reasoning in autonomous driving.

2509.25946.tldr: This paper presents a multi-modal \&multi-step pipeline for effective automated model discovery that leverages two vision-language-based modules (VLM), AnalyzerVLM and EvaluatorVLM, for effective model proposal and evaluation in an agentic way.

2509.25955.tldr: AIM is proposed, an optimization framework that learns a dynamic policy to mediate gradient conflicts, and achieves statistically significant improvements over multi-task baselines on subsets of the QM9 and targeted protein degraders benchmarks, with its advantage being most pronounced in data-scarce regimes.

2509.25958.tldr: This work proposes Rollout Response Recomposition (RoRecomp), a plug-and-play method that guides models toward concise reasoning by strategically recomposing the training data.

2509.25973.tldr: Corrective Unlearning with Retrieved Exclusions (CURE), a novel unlearning framework that verifies model outputs for leakage and revises them into safe responses, demonstrates robustness under continual unlearning scenarios, making it practical for real-world applications.

2509.25979.tldr: This study develops a generalization error bound that possesses a certified robust radius for the smoothed majority vote classifier and proposes a novel and inexpensive spectral regularizer to enhance the smoothed majority vote classifier.

2509.25992.tldr: This work proposes MHINDR, a large language model (LLM) based framework integrated with DSM-5 criteria to analyze user-generated text, dignose mental health conditions, and generate personalized interventions and insights for mental health practitioners.

2509.26002.tldr: A system that enables real-time interaction between human users and agents trained to control fighter jets in simulated 3D air combat scenarios and creates new opportunities for human-agent teaming, immersive training, and the exploration of innovative tactics in defense contexts is presented.

2509.26008.tldr: This is the first systematic study of heterogeneous pinhole-fisheye depth estimation, offering both technical novelty and valuable empirical insights, and sets a state-of-the-art performance on KITTI-360 and RealHet datasets over current mainstream depth networks.

2509.26015.tldr: This work analyzes the attention mechanism's behavior under noisy value features, establishing a critical noise threshold beyond which signal degradation becomes significant, and introduces Indirect Attention, a modified attention mechanism that infers relevance indirectly in scenarios with misaligned context.

2509.26037.tldr: This work presents Collaborative LLM-based NAS (CoLLM-NAS), a two-stage NAS framework with knowledge-guided search driven by two complementary LLMs, which efficiently guides the search process by combining LLMs' inherent knowledge of structured neural architectures with progressive knowledge from iterative feedback and historical trajectory.

2509.26051.tldr: This work provides the first benchmark of detection methods focused on Central European languages, and focuses on multi-domain, multi-generator, and multilingual evaluation, pinpointing the differences of individual aspects, as well as adversarial robustness of detection methods.

2509.26094.tldr: This paper introduces the first polynomial-time algorithm specifically designed to handle the problem of computing the top-$k$ simple shortest paths in weighted digraphs, and presents a theoretical characterization of the structural properties of its solutions.

2509.26100.tldr: A new paradigm of agentic safety evaluation is introduced, reframing evaluation as a continuous and self-evolving process rather than a one-time audit, and a novel multi-agent framework SafeEvalAgent is proposed, which autonomously ingests unstructured policy documents to generate and perpetually evolve a comprehensive safety benchmark.

2509.26113.tldr: Numerical experiments demonstrate the key role of Lie symmetry in enhancing PINNs performance, emphasizing the importance of integrating abstract mathematical concepts into deep learning for addressing complex scientific problems adequately.

2509.26120.tldr: The paper presents the detailed structural framework for AGOCS, discusses the main design decisions, whilst also suggesting alternative, possibly performance enhancing future approaches.

2509.26128.tldr: A hackable, end-to-end pipeline to create KGs from unstructured online content using a web scraper and an LLM, and a curated dataset, MEDAKA, generated by applying this method to publicly available drug leaflets, to support tasks such as patient safety monitoring and drug recommendation.

2509.26139.tldr: The ability of a custom machine learning surrogate model to predict the dynamics of heat propagation orders of magnitude faster than state-of-the-art CFD software for this application is shown.

2509.26140.tldr: The Spatial-Acoustic Geometry Encoder (SAGE) is introduced, a geometry-aware audio encoder that aligns binaural acoustic features with 3D spatial structure using panoramic depth images and room-impulse responses at training time, while requiring only audio at inference.

2509.26150.tldr: A regulatory-grade global database that synthesises post-trade reporting frameworks with proven incident documentation models from healthcare and aviation is proposed, empowering regulators with unprecedented cross-jurisdictional oversight, financial institutions with seamless compliance integration, and investors with critical visibility into previously obscured AI-driven vulnerabilities.

2509.26158.tldr: This work establishes a scalable framework that shifts data curation from manual effort to automated, targeted synthesis, offering a promising direction for developing more reliable and continuously improving AI systems.

2509.26161.tldr: UniGen is introduced, the first end-to-end coordinated multi-agent framework that automates zero-coding development of runnable 3D games from natural language requirements and reduces development time by 91.4%.

2509.26167.tldr: This paper argues for a fundamental shift towards integrating interpretive qualitative approaches drawn from social sciences into AI alignment practices, specifically in the context of Large Language Models (LLMs), and proposes that AI systems must produce outputs that reflect deeper cultural meanings -grounded firmly in user-provided context and intent.

2509.26185.tldr: This framework establishes a new paradigm for automated, fine-grained multi-attribute annotation in computer vision that can be extended to other computer vision classification tasks by effectively automating the expansion of multi-attribute labels.

2509.26187.tldr: A deep learning driven approach to proactively manage IEQ parameters specifically CO2 concentration, temperature, and humidity while balancing building energy efficiency while balancing building energy efficiency is proposed.

2509.26200.tldr: A novel framework for proactive cross-domain resource orchestration in 6G RAN-Edge networks, featuring large language model (LLM)-augmented agents that engage in iterative negotiation, supported by advanced reasoning and planning capabilities is introduced.

2509.26205.tldr: A human-centred questionnaire that assesses RAG outputs across 12 dimensions and indicates that while large language models (LLMs) reliably focus on metric descriptions and scale labels, they exhibit weaknesses in detecting textual format variations.
