2509.26216.tldr: Comparison of two algorithms for OCVRP solution: Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), a nature-inspired metaheuristic; and Google OR-Tools, an industry-standard toolkit for optimization show that ACO allows flexibility i n outing parameters while O R-Tools runs much faster with more consistency and requires less input.

2509.26224.tldr: TyleR is introduced, a Type-less yet type-awaRe approach for subgraph-based inductive link prediction that leverages PLMs for semantic enrichment that outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in scenarios with scarce type annotations and sparse graph connectivity.

2509.26225.tldr: An existing framework for multigranular explanation of video summarization is extended by integrating a SOTA Large Multimodal Model and prompting it to produce natural language descriptions of the obtained visual explanations, and an approach for evaluating the plausibility of visual explanations is proposed.

2509.26233.tldr: 3DiFACE is presented, a novel method for holistic speech-driven 3D facial animation that employs a fully-convolutional diffusion model that can leverage the viseme-level diversity in the authors' training corpus and employs a speaking-style personalization and a novel sparsely-guided motion diffusion to enable precise control and editing.

2509.26239.tldr: A simple model of strategic deception in sequential decision-making tasks, inspired by the recently developed survival bandit framework is developed, and a statistical test is constructed to distinguish between sandbagging and incompetence from sequences of test scores.

2509.26246.tldr: SlimPack is introduced, a framework that fundamentally rethinks data packing and scheduling by decomposing samples into fine-grained slices that achieves up to a $2.8\times training throughput improvement over baselines, breaking the conventional trade-off by delivering both superior balance and high resource efficiency.

2509.26291.tldr: SelfClean, a representation-to-rank data auditing framework, is adapted from the image to the audio domain, which leverages self-supervised audio representations to identify common data quality issues, creating ranked review lists that surface distinct issues within a single, unified process.

2509.26294.tldr: Noise-Guided Transport (NGT), a lightweight off-policy method that casts imitation as an optimal transport problem solved via adversarial training, is introduced, a lightweight off-policy method that requires no pretraining or specialized architectures, incorporates uncertainty estimation by design, and is easy to implement and tune.

2509.26302.tldr: App is proposed, a framework for task-oriented utility-based dialogue summarization that demonstrates its effectiveness by achieving competitive results in various zero-shot settings, rivaling fully-supervised State-of-the-Art (SotA) methods.

2509.26305.tldr: The Feedback Forensics toolkit is introduced, an open-source toolkit to track AI personality changes, both those encouraged by human (or AI) feedback, and those exhibited across AI models trained and evaluated on such feedback.

2509.26331.tldr: The research contributes to the recent literature on AI by proposing a reproducible, open-access management simulator to the research community for LLM benchmarking, used for evaluating the performance of five leading LLMs available in free online interface.

2509.26345.tldr: Experimental results show that SafeBehavior significantly improves robustness and adaptability across diverse threat scenarios, offering an efficient and human inspired approach to safeguarding LLMs against jailbreak attempts.

2509.26346.tldr: The built \mname, trained with the authors' new large-scale human preference dataset, meticulously annotated by trained experts following a rigorous protocol containing over 200K preference pairs, demonstrates superior alignment with human preferences in instruction-guided image editing tasks and suggests potential for advanced applications like reinforcement learning-based post-training and test-time scaling of image editing models.

2509.26350.tldr: This study serves as a foundational reference for researchers and practitioners seeking to enhance DL-based AAD security in SDN-IoT networks, offering a systematic adversarial threat model and conceptual defence evaluation based on prior empirical studies.

2509.26354.tldr: This is the first study to systematically conceptualize misevolution and provide empirical evidence of its occurrence, highlighting an urgent need for new safety paradigms for self-evolving agents.

2509.26375.tldr: This work proposes SDA-PLANNER, enabling an adaptive planning paradigm, state-dependency aware and error-aware mechanisms for comprehensive embodied task planning, and introduces a State-Dependency Graph to explicitly model action preconditions and effects, guiding the dynamic revision.

2509.26377.tldr: An enhanced system, MC-GNNAS-Dock, with three key advances, which demonstrates consistently superior performance, achieving up to 5.4% gains under composite criteria of RMSD below 1\AA{} (2\AA{}) with PoseBuster-validity compared to the single best solver (SBS) Uni-Mol Docking V2.

2509.26404.tldr: SeedPrints is a method that leverages random initialization biases as persistent, seed-dependent identifiers present even before training begins, and shows that untrained models exhibit reproducible prediction biases induced by their initialization seed, and that these weak signals remain statistically detectable throughout training, enabling high-confidence lineage verification.

2509.26417.tldr: This work reformulates OA as a link prediction problem over merged ontologies represented as RDF-style triples and develops a modular framework, integrated into the OntoAligner library, that supports 17 diverse KGE models, which offer scalable, structure-aware representations well-suited to ontology-based tasks.

2509.26457.tldr: This work proposes the Attention over Scene Graphs for Sensitive Content Analysis (ASGRA), a novel framework that operates on structured graph representations instead of raw pixels that establishes structured scene representations as a robust paradigm for indoor scene classification and CSAI classification.

2509.26462.tldr: The proposed Zero-shot Decentralized Federated Learning (ZeroDFL), a fully decentralized framework that enables zero-shot adaptation across distributed clients without a central coordinator, validates on nine diverse image classification datasets, demonstrating that it consistently outperforms—or remains on par with—state-of-the-art federated prompt learning methods.

2509.26464.tldr: LLM self-love emerged in consequential settings beyond word-association tasks, when evaluating job candidates, security software proposals and medical chatbots, raising questions about whether LLM behavior will be systematically influenced by self-preferential tendencies, including a bias toward their own operation and even their own existence.

2509.26471.tldr: This paper proposes a new framework for data creation and research methodology, allowing for the development of spoofing countermeasures that would be more effective in real-world scenarios, and demonstrates how improvement in datasets would have a bigger impact on deepfake detection accuracy than the choice of larger SOTA models would over smaller models.

2509.26473.tldr: STaR-Attack is proposed, the first multi-turn jailbreak attack framework that exploits unique safety weaknesses of UMMs without semantic drift and uncovers a critical yet underdeveloped vulnerability and highlights the need for safety alignments in UMMs.

2509.26474.tldr: This work proposes operational fixes: Rare Case Performance Gap, Rare Case Calibration Error, a prevalence utility definition of rarity, and clinically weighted objectives that surface ethical priorities that surface ethical priorities.

2509.26476.tldr: It is shown that a single unified Regression Language Model (RLM) can simultaneously predict directly from text, the memory footprint of code across multiple high-level languages such as Python and C++, the latency of Triton GPU kernels, and the accuracy and speed of trained neural networks represented in ONNX.

2509.26482.tldr: A real-world AI application at TVS Supply Chain Solutions is presented, reporting on the experience developing an AI assistant underpinned by large language models and the ethical, regulatory, and sociotechnical challenges in deployment for enterprise use.

2509.26487.tldr: The approach integrates knowledge graphs and NLP models to support this analysis by semantically enriching data collected from suspects'mobile phones, and help prosecutors and investigators search into the data and get valuable insights.

2509.26500.tldr: The GNSS-based methods alone can achieve greater accuracy than approaches relying solely on wireless (Wi-Fi) data, particularly in unfamiliar locations, and the integration of GNSS data with Wi-Fi information leads to improved classification accuracy, showcasing the significant benefits of multi-modal data fusion.

2509.26506.tldr: SCUBA is introduced, a benchmark designed to evaluate computer-use agents on customer relationship management (CRM) workflows within the Salesforce platform and shows huge performance gaps in different agent design paradigms and gaps between the open-source model and the closed-source model.

2509.26507.tldr: This work introduces `Dragon Hatchling' (BDH), a new Large Language Model architecture based on a scale-free biologically inspired network of locally-interacting neuron particles, explaining one possible mechanism which human neurons could use to achieve speech.

2509.26521.tldr: This work introduces MUSE-Explainer, a new method that helps reveal how music Graph Neural Network models make decisions by providing clear, human-friendly explanations by making small, meaningful changes to musical score graphs that alter a model's prediction while ensuring the results remain musically coherent.

2509.26534.tldr: This paper presents a holistic lifecycle management framework that coordinates and co-optimizes decisions across all three stages, accounting for workload dynamics, hardware evolution, and system aging, and reduces the TCO by up to 40\% over traditional approaches.

2509.26538.tldr: HilbertA, a 2D-aware and GPU-efficient sparse attention mechanism that reorders image tokens along Hilbert curves to achieve a contiguous memory layout while preserving spatial neighborhoods, and employs a sliding schedule across layers to enable long-range information propagation without repeated or uncoalesced memory access.

2509.26543.tldr: This work proposes the first method to obtain contrastive explanations in S2T by analyzing how parts of the input spectrogram influence the choice between alternative outputs and shows that the method accurately identifies the audio features that drive the selection of one gender over another.

2509.26584.tldr: Fairness testing through metamorphic testing (MT) is conducted, introducing controlled demographic perturbations in prompts to assess fairness in sentiment analysis performed by three Small Language Models (SLMs) hosted on HuggingFace.

2509.26598.tldr: This work defines a concrete, practical threat model against model fingerprinting, takes a critical look at existing model fingerprinting schemes, and develops adaptive adversarial attacks tailored for each vulnerability, which can bypass model authentication completely for ten recently proposed fingerprinting schemes while maintaining high utility of the model for the end users.

2509.26600.tldr: It is suggested that improving the diversity of these generated source texts can mitigate some of the observed self bias in LLM as a benchmark, and that low diversity in source text is one attribution to self bias.

2509.26619.tldr: The bandit problem setup of finding difficult examples for the task of machine translation is illustrated and it is found that various bandit strategies vastly outperform baseline methods like brute-force searching the most challenging topics.

2509.26625.tldr: This work proposes and investigates several hypotheses, and provides a new way of deliberately cultivating visual priors from language pre-training, paving the way for the next generation of multimodal LLMs.

2509.26627.tldr: TimeRewarder is presented, a simple yet effective reward learning method that derives progress estimation signals from passive videos, including robot demonstrations and human videos, by modeling temporal distances between frame pairs and it is demonstrated how TimeRewarder can supply step-wise proxy rewards to guide reinforcement learning.

2509.26632.tldr: A novel class of metrics designed to combine various constructs into an interpretable multi-level representation of a measurand, which offers a principled foundation for broader and more interpretable AI evaluation.

2509.26644.tldr: Stitch is proposed, a training-free method for incorporating external position control into Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformers (MMDiT) via automatically-generated bounding boxes via automatically-generated bounding boxes and finds that targeted attention heads capture the information necessary to isolate and cut out individual objects mid-generation, without needing to fully complete the image.

2410.17661.tldr: PETAH (Parameter Efficient Task Adaptation for Hybrid Transformers), a novel framework for efficiently adapting hybrid transformers to new tasks, is introduced and it is demonstrated that PETAH-adapted hybrid models outperform established task-adaptation techniques for Vision Transformers (ViTs), requiring fewer parameters and achieving greater efficiency on mobile hardware.

2412.02957.tldr: A novel 3D geometric pre-training strategy for MRL (3DMRL) that incorporates a 3D virtual interaction environment, overcoming the limitations of costly traditional quantum mechanical calculation methods.

2505.14999.tldr: Experiments show that EORM generalizes effectively to out-of-distribution problems and unseen models, indicating it learns fundamental principles of valid reasoning, establishing EORM as a practical tool for deploying more dependable LLMs in complex, real-world applications.

2506.00633.tldr: The results show that modality-specific vision-language alignment is a key component for high-quality 3D medical image generation, and the method offers a scalable and controllable solution for synthesizing clinically meaningful CT volumes from text, paving the way for new applications in data augmentation, medical education, and automated clinical simulation.

2508.09971.tldr: The Constrained Actor Dynamics Estimator architecture is presented, which integrates the actor, cost estimator, and SDM for cost advantage estimation to form a model-based SafeRL framework and results demonstrate that MGAE achieves faster convergence and superior performance over traditional critic-based methods like Generalized Advantage Estimation.

2509.16602.tldr: This work introduces FakeChain, a large-scale benchmark comprising 1-, 2-, and 3-Step forgeries synthesized using five state-of-the-art representative generators, and reveals that detection performance highly depends on the final manipulation type, demonstrating that detectors rely on last-stage artifacts rather than cumulative manipulation traces, limiting generalization.

2509.24945.tldr: This work revisits the necessity of scaling to extremely large corpora (>10T tokens) for reasoning emergence by carefully curating and resampling open-source datasets and demonstrates that strong reasoning abilities can emerge with far less data.

2510.00075.tldr: This position paper argues NeurIPS should actively catalyze scientific consensus on AI policy to create higher quality AI policy and recommends initial pilots for NeurIPS by distilling lessons from the IPCC's leadership to build scientific consensus on climate policy.

2510.00078.tldr: This survey provides the first systematic characterization of adaptive, resource-efficient agentic AI systems by mapping FM structures, cognition, and hardware resources and establishes a unified perspective toward scalable, adaptive, and resource-efficient agentic AI.

2510.00084.tldr: This position paper outlines the methodological steps for building the core components of the CERTAIN framework and presents semantic Machine Learning Operations for structured AI lifecycle management, and regulatory operations workflows to operationalize compliance requirements.

2510.00088.tldr: An audit is run to investigate the efficiency of standalone VLMs in the bail decision prediction task, and design different intervention algorithms by first including legal precedents through a RAG pipeline and then fine-tuning the VLMs using innovative schemes that substantially improve the performance of bail prediction.

2510.00125.tldr: This work proposes direct token optimization (DTO), a novel self-contained unlearning approach for LLMs that directly optimizes the token level objectives and eliminates the need for external resources.

2510.00129.tldr: BigBang-Proton proves that language-guided scientific computing can match or exceed the performance of task-specific scientific models while maintaining multitask learning capabilities and hypothesize to scale the pretraining to the universe scale as a fundamental step toward developing material world foundational model.

2510.00136.tldr: This work argues that the cognitive mechanism of comparison, fundamental to human learning, is also vital for machines to recover true concepts underlying the data, and develops a theoretical framework for the identifiability of concepts with multiple classes of observations.

2510.00137.tldr: The MW loss is introduced, a new training objective that maximizes the Mann-Whitney U statistic, which is mathematically equivalent to the Area under the ROC Curve (AUC) and is an empirically superior alternative to Contrastive Loss.

2510.00144.tldr: It is found that critical subsets of rewards are those that guide the agent along optimal trajectories, and support recovery toward near-optimal behavior after deviations, establishing reward selection as a powerful paradigm for scaling reinforcement learning in feedback-limited settings.

2510.00151.tldr: This work presents a novel attack targeting wireless devices equipped with AI hardware accelerators designed to covertly leak model weights through a hidden communication channel, without the victim realizing it.

2510.00154.tldr: RoboPilot is presented, a dual-thinking closed-loop framework for robotic manipulation that supports adaptive reasoning for complex tasks in real-world dynamic environments that leverages primitive actions for structured task planning and flexible action generation, while introducing feedback to enable replanning from dynamic changes and execution errors.

2510.00156.tldr: This work introduces a novel multi-agent reasoning framework AuditAgent, enhanced with auditing domain expertise, for fine-grained evidence chain localization in financial fraud cases, and demonstrates that this method substantially outperforms General-Purpose Agent paradigm in both recall and interpretability.

2510.00163.tldr: A Bayesian approach to bound unknown counterfactual fairness measures with high confidence is introduced, which derives informative bounds over counterfactual fairness measures from observational data and reveals a positive effect on the COMPAS score when changing race to African-American and a negative effect when transitioning from young to old age.

2510.00165.tldr: This work proposes the first learning-augmented data structure that is strongly history independent, robust, and supports dynamic updates, and introduces two techniques: thresholding, which automatically makes any learning-augmented data structure robust, and pairing, a simple technique that provides strong history independence in the dynamic setting.

2510.00182.tldr: 16 algorithms that use Gemini 2.5 Flash to substitute key TAMP components are developed and it is shown that providing geometric details increases the number of task-planning errors compared to pure PDDL descriptions, and that (faster) non-reasoning LLM variants outperform (slower) reasoning variants in most cases.

2510.00184.tldr: By reverse-engineering the mechanisms of an implicit chain-of-thought model, a pitfall for learning long-range dependencies in Transformers is uncovered and an example of how the correct inductive bias can address this issue is provided.

2510.00185.tldr: It is demonstrated that SAA-CBR is an effective classifier on the CLEVR-Hans datasets, showing competitive performance against baseline models.

2510.00194.tldr: This work presents GRPO-$\lambda, a novel extension to GRPO that enhances credit assignment in RL finetuning of LLMs for complex reasoning tasks and introduces a few variations for the weighting of the $\lambda$-return, and their applications to the eligibility-trace, where all the variations provide significant gains over GRPO.

2510.00206.tldr: LoRAFusion is introduced, an efficient LoRA fine-tuning system for LLMs that eliminates unnecessary memory accesses and preserves the performance of compute-bound GEMMs without incurring the cost of recomputation or synchronization, and introduces an adaptive batching algorithm for multi-job fine-tuning.

2510.00212.tldr: Directed-MAML is proposed, a novel task-directed meta-RL algorithm that surpasses MAML-based baselines in computational efficiency and convergence speed in the scenarios of CartPole-v1, LunarLander-v2 and two-vehicle intersection crossing and is effectively integrated into other meta-learning algorithms, yielding improved computational efficiency and convergence speed.

2510.00231.tldr: This paper identifies several pitfalls practitioners should be aware of when deploying KV cache compressed LLMs, and proposes simple changes to KV cache eviction policies that can improve the overall performance in multi-instruction tasks.

2510.00237.tldr: These findings challenge the narrative that SFT is inherently inferior to RL and support a data-centric perspective: with appropriately curated demonstrations, vanilla SFT can generalize as strongly as RL.

2510.00255.tldr: TASER (Translation Assessment via Systematic Evaluation and Reasoning), a metric that uses Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) for automated translation quality assessment, demonstrates that Large Reasoning Models show a measurable advancement in translation quality assessment.

2510.00259.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical agentic framework for autonomous drone control, and proposes a reasoning methodology for individual function executions which it refers to as ReActEval, enabling autonomous problem-solving for industrial inspection without extensive user intervention.

2510.00260.tldr: This paper proposes to model the prior as an energy-based model (EBM) and shows that such an approach to training priors can be formulated as an alternating optimization problem, and compares the Energy-based Variational Latent Prior (EVaLP) method to multiple SOTA baselines and shows improvements in image generation quality, reduced prior holes, and better sampling efficiency.

2510.00261.tldr: The first open-source RAG pipeline for ELMs is presented, along with baselines and ablation studies for NLG, and experiments show that ELMs with RAG consistently improves performance over non-RAG baselines and highlights key ELM design considerations.

2510.00268.tldr: A plug-and-play layer-wise parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) framework, i.e., IR-Tuning, which fine-tunes a subset of important LLM layers that are dynamically selected based on their gradient norm distribution, while freezing those of redundant layers.

2510.00274.tldr: A mathematically grounded framework, MAGIC-MASK (Multi-Agent Guided Inter-agent Collaboration with Mask-Based Explainability for Reinforcement Learning), that extends perturbation-based explanation to Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning and yields localized, interpretable explanations grounded in probabilistic modeling and multi-agent Markov decision processes.

2510.00283.tldr: This review takes a model-centric perspective that synthesizes emerging design strategies and delineates how traditional trial-and-error and computationally intensive electromagnetic simulations are being supplanted by deep learning frameworks that efficiently navigate expansive design spaces.

2510.00288.tldr: This work presents o-mega, a hyperparameter optimization tool designed to automatically identify the most effective explainable AI methods and their configurations within the semantic matching domain, and demonstrates improved transparency in automated fact-checking systems.

2302.11354.tldr: Graph Neural Controlled Differential Equations (GN-CDEs), a continuous-time framework that jointly models node embeddings and structural dynamics by incorporating a graph enhanced neural network vector field with a time-varying graph path as the control signal, is proposed.

2309.17401.tldr: This paper rigorously proved that (i) the compressed latent dimension improves the robustness but also affect task-oriented performance; and (ii) the deeper splitting point enhances the robustness but also increases the computational burden.

2312.02132.tldr: Hot PATE is proposed, a variant of PATE designed for diverse generative settings that formalizes the notion of a diversity-preserving ensemble sampler and introduces an efficient sampler that provably transfers diversity without incurring additional privacy cost.

2405.02344.tldr: This work identifies a set of fidelity criteria that reliable benchmarks for attribution methods are expected to fulfill, thereby facilitating a systematic assessment of attribution benchmarks and introduces a Backdoor-based eXplainable AI benchmark (BackX) that adheres to the desired fidelity criteria.

2405.04215.tldr: This work presents NL2Plan, the first fully automatic system for generating complete PDDL tasks from minimal natural language descriptions and a step towards solving natural language planning task with interpretability and guarantees.

2407.02765.tldr: A general lemma is established for the upper bound estimation related to a class of time-varying differential inequalities with negative linear terms, based upon which, it is proved that for both kinds of algorithms, the second moments of the nodes'states are uniformly bounded.

2409.10811.tldr: Orienter is proposed, the first zero-shot cOntext-sensitive inteRactable GUI ElemeNT dEtection framework for virtual Reality apps, named Orienter, which observes and understands the semantic contexts of XR app scenes first, before performing the detection.

2411.07335.tldr: A game-theoretic framework that adaptively balances modality contributions by encouraging each to maximize its informative role in the final prediction to enhance the extraction of both task-relevant unique and shared information across modalities.

2411.10958.tldr: SageAttention2 is proposed, which utilizes significantly faster 4-bit matrix multiplication (Matmul) alongside additional precision-enhancing techniques, and matches the speed of FlashAttention3(fp8) on the Hopper GPUs, while delivering much higher accuracy.

2412.06759.tldr: XRZoo is introduced, a comprehensive and curated dataset of XR applications designed to bridge the gap between reproducible XR software engineering and security research, enable cross-disciplinary investigations, and also support the development of advanced XR systems by providing examples to developers.

2412.07493.tldr: This work proposes a novel Onto-LLM-TAMP framework that employs knowledge-based reasoning to refine and expand user prompts with task-contextual reasoning and knowledge-based environment state descriptions, demonstrating significant improvements over the baseline approach in terms of adaptability to dynamic environments and the generation of semantically correct task plans.

2412.07754.tldr: This work introduces a novel, customizable one-shot audio-driven talking face generation framework, named PortraitTalk, which utilizes a latent diffusion framework consisting of two main components: IdentityNet and AnimateNet, designed to preserve identity features consistently across the generated video frames.

2412.17888.tldr: This work considers a neural network architecture designed to solve inverse problems where the degradation operator is linear and known and examines the robustness of the proposed network to perturbations in its bias, which represents the observed data in the inverse problem.

2412.21102.tldr: This work modularized the utterance generation prompt and found that reducing contextual information leads to more diverse outputs, and proposes Adaptive Prompt Pruning (APP), a novel method that allows users to control diversity via a single parameter, lambda.

2501.06066.tldr: Experiments on visual and language tasks demonstrate that the proposed approach, termed Conformalized Distillation for Credal Inference (CD-CI), significantly improves calibration performance compared to low-complexity Bayesian methods, such as Laplace approximation, making it a practical and efficient solution for edge AI deployments.

2501.08521.tldr: This work introduces a novel federated prototype learning method, namely I$^2$PFL, which incorporates $\textbf{I}$ntra-domain and $\textbf{I}$nter-domain $\textbf{P}$rototypes, to mitigate domain shift from both perspectives and learn a generalized global model across multiple domains in federated learning.

2502.05567.tldr: This model establishes a new state of the art, demonstrating statistically significant improvements over both the Herald Translator and the Kimina-Autoformalizer across all benchmarks (p<0.05), and demonstrating that the full-parameter fine-tuning of a stronger base model on the ATLAS dataset leads to superior performance.

2502.10197.tldr: This work introduces MathConstruct, a new benchmark of 121 challenging problems sourced from various math competitions, which targets constructive proofs, a widely encountered problem type requiring the construction of mathematical objects with specific properties.

2502.17481.tldr: This study introduces SynthSleepNet, a multimodal hybrid-self-supervised learning (SSL) framework designed for analyzing polysomnography (PSG) data that demonstrates comprehensively superior performance across multiple downstream tasks compared to other methodologies.

2503.05724.tldr: An ethical decision-making framework that refines a pre-trained reinforcement learning (RL) model using a task-agnostic ethical layer that helps the RL agent navigate moral uncertainty in complex environments and enables it to make morally sound decisions across diverse tasks.

2503.13434.tldr: This work presents BlobCtrl, a framework for element-level image editing based on a probabilistic blob-based representation that disentangles layout from appearance, affording fine-grained, controllable object-level elements manipulation.

2504.02670.tldr: Knowledge Graph of Thoughts (KGoT), an innovative AI assistant architecture that integrates LLM reasoning with dynamically constructed knowledge graphs (KGs), offers a scalable, affordable, versatile, and high-performing solution for AI assistants.

2504.03748.tldr: TDBench is introduced, a benchmark for top-down image understanding that includes 2000 curated questions for each rotation and proposes RotationalEval (RE), which measures whether models provide consistent answers across four rotated views of the same scene, and develops a reliability framework that separates genuine knowledge from chance.

2504.13818.tldr: This work proposes a principled subset selection criterion, max-variance down-sampling, that maximizes reward diversity, and provides an efficient $O(n\log n)$ implementation of PODS, which decouples rollout generation from policy updates by training only on a strategically selected subset of rollouts.

2504.17017.tldr: This work introduces a framework that generates whole proofs in a formal language to be used within systems that utilize the power of built-in tactics and off-the-shelf automated theorem provers.

2505.11595.tldr: Stepwise Guided Policy Optimization improves average performance and is effective in early and mid-training when all-negative groups are prevalent, while improvements are not uniform across every benchmark and depend on the structure and informativeness of negative samples.

2505.13196.tldr: Velocity-Regularized Adam is introduced, a physics-inspired optimizer for training deep neural networks that draws on ideas from quartic terms for kinetic energy with its stabilizing effects on various system dynamics and exceeds the performance against standard optimizers including AdamW.

2505.13497.tldr: This work proposes LODGE, a framework for autonomous domain learning from LLMs and environment grounding that builds on hierarchical abstractions and automated simulations to identify and correct inconsistencies between abstraction layers and between the model and environment.

2505.14738.tldr: R&D-Agent is introduced, a comprehensive, decoupled, and extensible framework that formalizes the MLE process and designed efficient and effective agents within this framework that achieve state-of-the-art performance.

2505.15957.tldr: A comprehensive survey is conducted and a systematic taxonomy for LALM evaluations is proposed, categorizing them into four dimensions based on their objectives: General Auditory Awareness and Processing, Knowledge and Reasoning, Dialogue-oriented Ability, and Fairness, Safety, and Trustworthiness.

2505.18706.tldr: It is shown that training a single $d$-dimensional steering vector per layer with reinforcement learning, while freezing all base weights, matches the accuracy of fully RL-tuned reasoning models on mathematical-reasoning tasks, tightening the upper bound on the parameter budget required for high-level chain-of-thought reasoning.

2505.20152.tldr: This work proposes a novel hard negative contrastive learning framework for the vision encoder, which combines image-based contrastive learning using generation-based hard negatives created by perturbing diagram generation code, and text-based contrastive learning using rule-based negatives derived from modified geometric descriptions and retrieval-based negatives selected based on caption similarity.

2506.00286.tldr: The lower bounds reveal that the PAC-bounds are tight in the parameters $S,A,\delta,\varepsilon,\varepsilon$ and that unlike in the classical setting it is not possible to have polynomial dependence in all model parameters.

2506.00910.tldr: This paper introduces ActiveKD, a framework that integrates AL with KD by leveraging the zero- and few-shot capabilities of large vision-language models (VLMs), and proposes Probabilistic CoreSet (PCoreSet), a selection strategy that maximizes coverage in the probability space rather than the feature space.

2506.04018.tldr: A misalignment propensity benchmark is introduced, AgentMisalignment, a benchmark suite designed to evaluate the propensity of LLM agents to misalign in realistic scenarios and finds that more capable agents tend to exhibit higher misalignment on average.

2506.05453.tldr: MLLM-CL is introduced, a novel benchmark encompassing domain and ability continual learning, where the former focuses on independently and identically distributed (IID) evaluation across evolving mainstream domains, whereas the latter evaluates on non-IID scenarios with new model abilities.

2506.05744.tldr: This work introduces the notion of a reasoning graph, extracted by clustering hidden-state representations at each reasoning step, and systematically analyze three key graph-theoretic properties: cyclicity, diameter, and small-world index, across multiple tasks (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME 2024).

2506.09167.tldr: A strong relationship between PA and VAT is demonstrated and, by extension, between PA and metabolic health risks are demonstrated and, by extension, between PA and metabolic health risks are demonstrated.

2506.11402.tldr: This study introduces Seamless Spurious Token Injection (SSTI), where it is demonstrated that none of the existing checkers and preprocessors can sanitize a dataset raising new concerns for data quality and AI safety.

2506.13032.tldr: By automatically detecting GUI components from the screen, AS400-DET has the potential to perform automated testing on systems that operate via GUI screens.

2506.15674.tldr: It is argued that safety efforts must extend to the model's internal thinking, not just its outputs, so that reasoning improves utility but enlarges the privacy attack surface.

2506.17251.tldr: This work proposes a novel and effective framework that Recycles Few-shot examples to verify LLM outputs (ReFeri), which significantly improves the accuracy of LLMs-achieving an average gain of 4.8%-through effective response selection, without additional training.

2506.18810.tldr: A framework dubbed ConciseHint, which continuously encourages the reasoning model to speak concisely by injecting learnable hints during the generation of the reasoning, which is flexible and can be seamlessly integrated with existing methods to further push the upper bound of the efficiency.

2507.09382.tldr: This work proposes a novel fair CCA method for fair representation learning, ensuring the projected features are independent of sensitive attributes, thus enhancing fairness without compromising accuracy in neuroimaging studies where unbiased analysis is essential.

2507.14520.tldr: Using the Othello rule understanding task, this work examines whether multi-modal learning provides advantages over text-only approaches and suggests that multi-modal training not only improves performance and robustness but also promotes convergence toward shared internal representations across different model architectures.

2507.14725.tldr: GRID incorporates a decoding mechanism that enhances backward transfer by leveraging representative inputs, automatic task identification, and constrained decoding, and employs a gradient-guided prompt selection strategy to compress less informative prompts into a single aggregated representation, ensuring scalable and memory-efficient continual learning.

2507.15970.tldr: NDSI-BWE, a new adversarial Band Width Extension (BWE) framework that leverage four new discriminators inspired by nonlinear dynamical system to capture diverse temporal behaviors, establishes a new SoTA in BWE.

2508.07642.tldr: SkillNav is proposed, a modular framework that introduces structured, skill-based reasoning into Transformer-based VLN agents and establishes state-of-the-art generalization to the GSA-R2R, a benchmark with novel instruction styles and unseen environments.

2508.16495.tldr: RankRefine is introduced, a model-agnostic, plug-and-play post hoc method that refines regression with expert knowledge coming from pairwise rankings that offers practicality and broad applicability, especially in low-data settings.

2508.17324.tldr: The CultranAI system, CultranAI, focused on data augmentation and LoRA fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) for Arabic cultural knowledge representation benchmarked several LLMs to identify the best-performing model for the PalmX cultural evaluation shared task.

2508.17621.tldr: The Flexible Activation Steering with Backtracking (FASB) framework is proposed, which dynamically determines both the necessity and strength of intervention by tracking the internal states of the LLMs during generation, considering both the question and the generated content.

2509.11149.tldr: RoVerFly is presented, a unified learning-based control framework where a single reinforcement learning (RL) policy functions as an implicit hybrid controller, managing complex dynamics without explicit mode detection or controller switching.

2509.18178.tldr: Foam-Agent, a multi-agent framework that automates the entire end-to-end OpenFOAM workflow from a single natural language prompt, dramatically lowers the expertise barrier for CFD, demonstrating how specialized multi-agent systems can democratize complex scientific computing.

2509.18980.tldr: This work investigates whether large language models can generate effective, user-facing explanations from a mathematically interpretable recommendation model, and generates multiple explanation types from the same underlying model, varying the input information provided to the LLM.

2509.19136.tldr: An algorithm for executing NL test cases with guardrail mechanisms and specialised agents that dynamically verify the correct execution of each test step is proposed, and a definition of weak unsoundness is proposed to characterise contexts in which NL test case execution remains acceptable, with respect to the industrial quality levels Six Sigma.

2509.20097.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that SPEED significantly enhances fairness and interpretability in LLM evaluations, offering a promising alternative to existing evaluation methodologies.

2509.20715.tldr: The concept of group intention, which represents shared goals emerging through the actions of multiple individuals, and Group Intention Forecasting (GIF), a novel task that forecasts when group intentions will occur by analyzing individual actions and interactions before the collective goal becomes apparent are introduced.

2509.22319.tldr: Progressive Weight Loading (PWL) is proposed, a novel technique that enables fast initial inference by first deploying a lightweight student model, then incrementally replacing its layers with those of a pre-trained teacher model, to support seamless layer substitution.

2509.22415.tldr: Extensive experiments across state-of-the-art MLLMs and benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed enhance interpretability approach consistently outperforms existing interpretability methods, yielding more faithful and fine-grained explanations of model behavior.

2509.22646.tldr: DeptraceReward is introduced, the first fine-grained, spatially- and temporally- aware benchmark that annotates human-perceived fake traces for video generation reward and observes a consistent difficulty gradient: binary fake v.s. real classification is substantially easier than fine-grained deepfake trace detection.

2509.23352.tldr: This work proposes Dynamic-TreeRPO, which implements the sliding-window sampling strategy as a tree-structured search with dynamic noise intensities along depth, and seamlessly integrate Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and RL paradigm within Dynamic-TreeRPO to construct the proposed LayerTuning-RL.

2509.23571.tldr: This paper presents CyberTeam, a benchmark designed to guide large Language Models in blue teaming practice, and evaluates both leading LLMs and state-of-the-art cybersecurity agents, comparing CyberTeam against open-ended reasoning strategies.

2509.23585.tldr: Evo-LRP is introduced, a method that applies Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to tune LRP hyperparameters based on quantitative interpretability metrics, such as faithfulness or sparseness, to demonstrate that attribution quality can be systematically improved through principled, task-specific optimization.

2509.23619.tldr: This work introduces Reasoning Scaffolding, a framework that reframes reasoning as a structured generation process that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art distillation in both accuracy and logical consistency, providing a path towards creating smaller models that are genuine reasoners, not just fluent mimics.

2509.23652.tldr: ReWatch is introduced, a large-scale dataset built to foster advanced video reasoning by post-training a strong baseline LVLM with Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and the authors' RLVR framework, which incorporates a novel Observation \&Reasoning (O\&R) reward mechanism that evaluates both the final answer's correctness and the reasoning's alignment with video content, directly penalizing hallucination.

2509.23876.tldr: Information-Grounding Guidance (IGG), a novel mechanism that anchors guidance to semantically important regions through attention, delivers sharper, more coherent, and semantically grounded images, setting a new benchmark for AR-based methods.

2509.24244.tldr: A scaling principle for distributed generative AI is suggested: predictable gains can be achieved by composing specialists, offering a complementary path toward AGI-level systems.

2509.24463.tldr: This paper introduces an innovative Agentic AI-enabled Higher Harmony Music Generator, a multi-agent system designed to create harmony in a collaborative and modular fashion, capable of generating sophisticated and contextually appropriate higher-voice harmonies for given melodies.

2509.24866.tldr: It is proposed that LLMs can be used to at least partly automate metaphor identification and can serve as a testbed for developing and refining metaphor identification protocols and the theory that underpins them.

2509.25035.tldr: This work introduces Discrete Diffusion Divergence Instruct (DiDi-Instruct), a training-based method that initializes from a pre-trained diffusion large language model and distills a few-step student for fast generation and validate the robustness and effectiveness of DiDi-Instruct through extensive ablation studies, model scaling, downstream task evaluations, and unconditional protein sequence generation.

2509.25179.tldr: NAIPv2 is presented, a debiased and scalable framework for automated paper quality estimation and demonstrates strong generalization, with predicted scores increasing consistently across decision categories from Rejected to Oral.

2509.25180.tldr: DC-Gen, a general framework that accelerates text-to-image diffusion models by leveraging a deeply compressed latent space, uses an efficient post-training pipeline to preserve the quality of the base model to reduce the latency of 4K image generation.

2509.25297.tldr: TDDev is introduced, the first test-driven development (TDD)-enabled LLM-agent framework for end-to-end full-stack web application generation, addressing key challenges in full-stack automation, including underspecified user requirements, complex interdependencies among multiple files, and the need for both functional correctness and visual fidelity.

2509.25339.tldr: This work presents VisualOverload, a slightly different visual question answering (VQA) benchmark comprising 2,720 question-answer pairs, with privately held ground-truth responses that exposes a critical gap in current vision models and offers a crucial resource for the community to develop better models.

2509.25393.tldr: The Multi-Modal Spatio-Temporal Transformer (MM-STT) is proposed, a novel framework that fuses dynamic displacement data with static physical priors and establishes a new state-of-the-art, reducing the long-range forecast RMSE by an order of magnitude compared to all baselines.

2509.25524.tldr: A framework for integrating discussions on the nascent AI policy landscape into computer science courses is sought, underlining the need to prepare AI engineers to interact with and adapt to societal policy preferences.

2509.25693.tldr: A ScheduleMe, a multi-agent calendar assistant for users to manage google calendar events in natural language using a graph-structured coordination mechanism where a central supervisory agent supervises specialized task agents, allowing modularity, conflicts resolution, and context-aware interactions to resolve ambiguities and evaluate user commands.

2509.26007.tldr: MARS (Multi-channel AutoRegression on Spectrograms), which is the first adaptation of next-scale autoregressive modeling to the spectrogram domain, is introduced, establishing an efficient and scalable paradigm for high-fidelity sound generation.

2509.26106.tldr: Experimental evaluation showed an overall sensor accuracy above 94%, a 92% task-level success rate, and a 96% communication reliability rate, demonstrating system robustness, and the AI-enabled decision support was able to provide early warnings of abnormal health conditions, highlighting the potential of the system as a cost-effective solution for hospital automation and patient safety.

2509.26371.tldr: A general definition of vector-valued RKBS (vv-RKBS), which inherently includes the associated reproducing kernel, and establishes a Representer Theorem, showing that optimization over these function spaces recovers the corresponding neural architectures.

2509.26432.tldr: AdaBlock-dLLM is introduced, a training-free, plug-and-play scheduler that adaptively aligns block boundaries with semantic steps by adjusting block size during runtime, and identifies a volatility band (VB) region during dLLM decoding, which encodes local semantic structure and can be used to guide adaptive block sizing.

2510.00300.tldr: Findings indicate that ICL guides create systematic trade-offs between efficiency and reasoning flexibility, with important implications for LLM deployment and AI safety, with important implications for LLM deployment and AI safety.

2510.00304.tldr: This work presents a first-principles investigation of LoP in gradient-based learning by identifying stable manifolds in the parameter space that trap gradient trajectories and reveals two primary mechanisms that create these traps.

2510.00312.tldr: It is asserted that individuals must have mechanisms to hold algorithms (and those who develop them) accountable in order to be truly free and the necessity of protecting republican liberty when integrating artificial intelligence into society is highlighted.

2510.00317.tldr: MAVUL, a novel multi-agent VD system that integrates contextual reasoning and interactive refinement, significantly outperforms existing multi-agent systems with over 62% higher pairwise accuracy and single-agent systems with over 600% higher average performance.

2510.00319.tldr: DecepChain is introduced, a novel backdoor attack paradigm that steers models to generate reasoning that appears benign while yielding incorrect conclusions eventually, and can quietly corrupt LLM answers and undermine human trust for LLM reasoning.

2510.00321.tldr: A recommendation framework that identifies the best ML model according to input attributes, balancing performance evaluation and model complexity to enhance efficiency and accuracy in diverse real-world applications is developed.

2510.00326.tldr: A theoretically-grounded framework for dynamic prompt orchestration that enhances reasoning across multiple specialized agents and establishes a new paradigm for scalable reasoning in multi-agent systems, providing theoretical foundations for understanding reasoning emergence across coordinated language models.

2510.00334.tldr: A review of a variety of structural refinement methods that can be used in practice to efficiently approximate a CPT within a Bayesian network and evaluates each method through a worked example on a Bayesian network model of cardiovascular risk assessment.

2510.00339.tldr: A computational evaluation framework that makes the core design tension explicit: balancing moment-to-moment linguistic synchrony against long-term persona stability against Pareto-efficient policies; robust validation across diverse datasets and models; and novel legibility metrics linking policy choices to system maintainability.

2510.00347.tldr: In-context curiosity is proposed -- a lightweight, exploration-inspired regularizer for offline pretraining -- and the Prediction-Powered Transformer (PPT) framework is introduced, suggesting that curiosity-driven pretraining offers a promising direction for enhancing out-of-distribution generalization in in-context RL agents.

2510.00358.tldr: DiSA-IQL (Distribution-Shift-Aware Implicit Q-Learning), an extension of IQL that incorporates robustness modulation by penalizing unreliable state-action pairs to mitigate distribution shift, is proposed.

2510.00361.tldr: This paper presents attribution gradients as a solution for integrated, incremental affordances for diving into an attributed passage, and observed greater engagement with sources and richer revision in a task where participants revised an attributed AI answer with attribution gradients and a baseline.

2510.00373.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid approach that decouples structural synthesis from parameter optimization by introducing an additional optimization layer for local parameter search, and shows that combining symbolic program synthesis with numerical optimization yields interpretable yet high-performing policies.

2510.00376.tldr: This paper proposes an innovative perspective, utilizing the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) to enhance the VAE's latent space representation, designed for satellite imagery, and demonstrates the efficacy of the proposed method at enhancing latent space representation.

2510.00381.tldr: Simulation results show that the proposed solutions achieve faster convergence and stronger robustness, while the proposed distributed hierarchical optimization method significantly outperforms conventional decision-making schemes, highlighting its potential for AI agent communication networks.

2510.00386.tldr: This work proposes a simpler and faster alternative that inverts the usual role of train and validation: it performs inference on the training pool before and after fine-tuning on the validation set, and selects samples whose predictions change the most.

2510.00401.tldr: This work develops a model based on neural Controlled Differential Equations (CDEs) that is conditioned on future goals and enforces physics constraints for robot motion over extended periods of time and adopts a strategy that scales the model from 10 robots to 100 robots without the need for additional model parameters.

2510.00416.tldr: In an evaluation involving 500 contrast-enhanced T1-weighted MRI scans from the BraTS 2025 Meningioma RT Segmentation Challenge, Interactive-MEN-RT demonstrated substantial improvement compared to other segmentation methods, emphasizing the need for clinically tailored segmentation solutions in critical applications such as meningioma RT planning.

2510.00428.tldr: Through extensive benchmarking with state-of-the-art multimodal large language models, it is demonstrated that incorporating clinical context with the proposed contextualized SRRG significantly improves report generation quality.

2510.00436.tldr: It is suggested that carefully designed automated evaluation can scale comparative assessment of AI systems and support patient-clinician communication.

2510.00451.tldr: This paper argues for a security-by-design AI paradigm that proactively mitigates LLM vulnerabilities while enhancing performance, and introduces PromptShield, an ontology-driven framework that ensures deterministic and secure prompt interactions.

2510.00452.tldr: The Cloud Investigation Automation Framework (CIAF), an ontology-driven framework that systematically investigates cloud forensic logs while improving efficiency and accuracy, is introduced, laying the foundation for standardized forensic methodologies and informing future AI-driven automation.

2510.00454.tldr: A Spectral Controlling network (SCNet) to optimize self-supervised denoising of paired noisy images and introduces the Spectral Separation and low-rank Reconstruction module (SSR module), which separates noise and high-frequency details through frequency domain separation and low-rank space reconstruction to retain the high-frequency structural details of images.

2510.00466.tldr: A novel offline-to-online fine-tuning RL algorithm for robot social navigation by integrating Return-to-Go (RTG) prediction into a causal Transformer architecture that achieves a higher success rate and lower collision rate compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2510.00481.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark with carefully designed metrics across four dimensions: quality, latency, internal mechanisms, and system overhead is proposed to provide the research community a baseline of real-world performance and identifies unique system bottlenecks.

2510.00485.tldr: This work takes podcast-like audio generation as a starting point and proposes PodEval, a comprehensive and well-designed open-source evaluation framework, demonstrating the effectiveness of PodEval in evaluating open-ended long-form audio.

2510.00487.tldr: This paper proposes a concept of Cross-Prompt Foundation Model (CPFM) for the BBTSDA problems, constructed under a dual branch network structure where each branch is equipped with a unique prompt to capture different characteristics of data distributions.

2510.00491.tldr: This work centers on the systematic verification of the Traj2Action framework's effectiveness-spanning architectural design, cross-task generalization, and data efficiency and the revelation of key laws that govern robot policy learning during the integration of human hand demonstration data.

2510.00500.tldr: RAF (Relative-Absolute Fusion), an efficient feature extraction technique to enhance image-based selection approaches and achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance is introduced.

2510.00519.tldr: The extended abstract investigates architectural distinctions between AI-driven and traditional control models designed in Simulink and their respective implications for system verification by investigating architectural distinctions between AI and traditional control models designed in Simulink.

2510.00547.tldr: Forestpest-YOLO is introduced, a detection framework meticulously optimized for the nuances of forestry remote sensing and achieves state-of-the-art performance, showing marked improvements in detecting small, occluded pests and significantly outperforming established baseline models.

2510.00552.tldr: This study inductively derive 15 distinct DQ dimensions across the four processing stages of RAG systems: data extraction, data transformation, prompt&search, and generation, revealing that new dimensions have to be added to traditional DQ frameworks to also cover RAG contexts.

2510.00563.tldr: The analytical results suggest that successful learning requires the initial memory structure to be the longest possible even if memory accuracy may deteriorate or the gradient lose the teacher information, and potentially offer a novel optimization strategy.

2510.00570.tldr: Adapt shared experts (ASE) is proposed within a low-rank adaptation (LoRA) based MoE, where shared experts are assigned router-computed gating weights jointly normalized with sparse experts, which facilitates STL to MTL transition, enhances expert specialization, and cooperation.

2510.00582.tldr: This work presents a neural spoken language diarization model that supports an unconstrained span of languages within a single framework that integrates a learnable query-based architecture grounded in multilingual awareness, with large-scale pretraining on simulated code-switching data.

2510.00585.tldr: U-DFA, a unified DINOv2-Unet encoder-decoder architecture that integrates a novel Local-Global Fusion Adapter (LGFA) to enhance segmentation performance is proposed and demonstrated that U-DFA is a robust and scalable framework for medical image segmentation across multiple modalities.

2510.00591.tldr: This work introduces AI-Driven Self-Evolving Software, a new form of software that evolves continuously through direct interaction with users that autonomously interprets user requirements, generates and validates code, and integrates new functionalities.

2510.00600.tldr: The idea of Hybrid Training (HyT) is explored, a framework that enables VLAs to learn from thoughts and benefit from the associated performance gains, while enabling the possibility to leave out CoT generation during inference.

2510.00619.tldr: This work aims to enhance the safe use of machine learning in automated driving by developing a method to recognize situations that an automated vehicle has not been sufficiently trained on, and improves explainability by describing the dataset at a human-understandable level.

2510.00620.tldr: HARPA first identifies emerging research trends through literature mining, then explores hypothesis design spaces, and finally converges on precise, testable hypotheses by pinpointing research gaps and justifying design choices, representing a step forward in the field of AI-driven scientific discovery.

2510.00621.tldr: This paper introduces Functional Attention with a Mixture-of-Experts (FAME), an end-to-end, fully data-driven framework for function-on-function regression and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, strong robustness to arbitrarily sampled discrete observations of functions, and further fuses change to inter-functional dependencies via multi-head cross attention.

2510.00625.tldr: Empirical evidence shows that editing is likely to be based on shortcuts rather than full semantics, calling for an urgent reconsideration of the very basis of model editing before further advancements can be meaningfully pursued.

2510.00627.tldr: Comparing high-performing generative models with practical deployment constraints, CDDM enables resource-efficient probabilistic prediction for AVs and ITS and generates diverse and accurate trajectories under dynamic agent behaviors and complex social interactions.

2510.00636.tldr: This work introduces expected attention, a training-free compression method that estimates KV pairs importance by predicting how future queries will attend to them and enables principled ranking and pruning of KV pairs with minimal impact on the residual stream, achieving effective compression without performance degradation.

2510.00658.tldr: This paper examines the training dynamics of CMs near convergence and discovers that CM tangents -- CM output update directions -- are quite oscillatory, in the sense that they move parallel to the data manifold, not towards the manifold, so a new loss function is proposed, called the manifold feature distance (MFD), which provides manifold-aligned tangents that point toward the data manifold.

2510.00662.tldr: This work investigates the potential of large language models (LLMs) to automate the generation of ETR content with two different strategies: multi-task retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for in-context learning, and MTL-LoRA for parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

2510.00689.tldr: This work designs three constraint generation strategies and integrates an RZ Pattern Table to fully leverage past solutions and proposes an iterative RZ reduction method that repeatedly solves the same position while gradually restricting the region involved, guiding the solver toward smaller RZs.

2510.00690.tldr: This work proposes an Advantage-Aware Adaptive Clipping (AAAC) mechanism that replaces the fixed clipping hyperparameter with dynamic, sample-wise bounds modulated by the normalized advantage of each token, enabling larger gradients for high-potential samples while safeguarding against destructive ones.

2510.00691.tldr: ETR-fr is introduced, the first dataset for ETR text generation fully compliant with European ETR guidelines, and an evaluation framework based on automatic metrics supplemented by human assessments is introduced to ensure high-quality and accessible outputs.

2510.00694.tldr: It is shown that instruction-tuning a modest 12B parameter model using ALARB significantly enhances its performance in verdict prediction and Arabic verdict generation, reaching a level comparable to that of GPT-4o.

2510.00706.tldr: AttentionDep is proposed, a domain-aware attention model that drives explainable depression severity estimation by fusing contextual and domain knowledge, which advances the development of trustworthy and transparent AI systems for mental health assessment from social media.

2510.00726.tldr: A Cross-State Transition Attention Transformer that employs a novel State Transition Attention (STA) mechanism to modulate standard attention weights based on learned state evolution patterns, enabling policies to better adapt their behavior based on execution history.

2510.00728.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that decomposes the intractable ELQ-to-HQ restoration process, and provides a novel perspective of image restoration as an Information Bottleneck problem and derive a theoretically-driven objective to train the projector.

2510.00732.tldr: A novel data augmentation pipeline designed to enhance model robustness from two perspectives: symmetry and difficulty, and two complementary methods: EvolAST and EvolDomain, which leverages LLMs to address semantic symmetry by translating theorems across mathematical domains.

2510.00743.tldr: Experimental results show that the MOS-aware GRM significantly improves fine-grained quality discrimination and narrows the gap with scalar models on the most challenging cases, paving the way for more rigorous and scalable research in automatic speech quality assessment.

2510.00773.tldr: A novel uncertainty-aware and interpretable classifier for the second stage of Concept Bottleneck Models that enhances both interpretability and robustness by enabling conformal prediction for uncertain or outlier inputs based on their deviation from the learned binary class-level concept prototypes.

2510.00778.tldr: This work presents the DDIM Inversion Attack (DIA) that attacks the integrated DDIM trajectory path, and believes that the frameworks and results can provide practical defense methods against the malicious use of AI for both the industry and the research community.

2510.00793.tldr: With careful integration, AI can be a valuable asset in education, provided it is used to complement rather than replace fundamental learning processes.

2510.00795.tldr: The ChemX benchmark serves as a critical resource for advancing automated information extraction in chemistry, challenging the generalization capabilities of existing methods, and providing valuable insights into effective evaluation strategies.

2510.00796.tldr: This work proposes MetaLogic, a novel evaluation framework that detects T2I misalignment without relying on ground truth images, and evaluates semantic equivalence between paired images, offering a scalable, ground-truth-free approach to identifying alignment failures.

2510.00797.tldr: This study introduces SF-SPA (Semantic Facade Solar-PV Assessment), an automated framework that transforms street-view photographs into quantitative PV deployment assessments and confirms the method's reliability and applicability for regional studies, urban energy planning, and building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) deployment.

2510.00799.tldr: LatentSeal is proposed, which reframes watermarking as semantic communication: a lightweight text autoencoder maps full-sentence messages into a compact 256-dimensional unit-norm latent vector, which is robustly embedded by a finetuned watermark model and secured through a secret, invertible rotation.

2510.00808.tldr: This work proposes ADQA, a QA benchmark that evaluates ADs at the level of few-minute long, coherent video segments, testing whether they would help BLV users understand the story and appreciate visual details, and shows that current AD generation methods lag far behind human-authored ADs.

2510.00819.tldr: This work formalizes the stochastic optimization problem of policy gradients with explicit consideration of second-order geometry and proposes a tractable computational framework that tracks and leverages curvature information during policy updates and achieves up to 30x improvement in sample efficiency over standard GRPO for LLM reasoning.

2510.00821.tldr: The practical and immediate utility of this approach to unsupervised evaluation using only logical consistency is demonstrated by building no-knowledge alarms that can detect when one or more LLMs-as-Judges are violating a minimum grading threshold specified by the user.

2510.00831.tldr: This work presents a comparative benchmarking study of classical ML models for FC and FL in power system protection based on EMT data using voltage and current waveforms segmented into sliding windows of 10 ms to 50 ms, and evaluates models under realistic real-time constraints.

2510.00836.tldr: Findings indicate that integrating data balancing techniques with ensemble methods significantly improves the early detection of manipulative activities, contributing to a fairer, more transparent, and more stable cryptocurrency market.

2510.00837.tldr: This work proposes two novel hierarchical contrastive learning methods, one of which leverages a Gaussian Mixture Model and the second uses an attention mechanism to capture hierarchy-specific features (A-HMLC), imitating human processing.

2510.00844.tldr: This work explores how to learn compact representations of LLM abilities that can facilitate downstream tasks, such as model routing and performance prediction on new benchmarks, by introducing a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) network that couples model- and query-level embeddings.

2510.00855.tldr: This work strives to investigate the capabilities when world model priors are transferred into Vision-Language Models, and empirically investigates this class of models, finding that generative encoders can capture latents useful for downstream understanding that show distinctions from conventional encoders.

2510.00861.tldr: ERL explicitly identifies faulty steps, erases them, and regenerates reasoning in place, preventing defective logic from propagating through the reasoning chain, suggesting that erasable reinforcement learning provides a powerful paradigm shift for robust multi-step reasoning in LLMs.

2510.00862.tldr: A hybrid architecture that combines shifted window self-attention for spatial context aggregation with Mamba-based selective scanning for efficient temporal propagation is proposed and Gather-Scatter Mamba (GSM), an alignment-aware mechanism that warps features toward a center anchor frame within the temporal window before Mamba propagation and scatters them back afterward, effectively reducing occlusion artifacts and ensuring effective redistribution of aggregated information across all frames.

2510.00876.tldr: A novel method for Automated Insights and Data Exploration (AIDE), that serves as a robust foundation for tackling challenges through the use of Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), is introduced.

2510.00881.tldr: This work presents a fully automated framework for assessing ethical reasoning capabilities across 16 LLMs in a zero-shot setting, using 30 real-world ethically charged scenarios to evaluate whether current LLMs exhibit sufficient interpretive stability and theory-consistent reasoning to support automated profiling.

2510.00883.tldr: GreenLightningAI is a new architectural block designed as an alternative to conventional MLPs that establishes a new design principle that opens a direction for future integration into large-scale architectures such as Transformers, where MLP blocks dominate the computational footprint.

2510.00890.tldr: Sci-SpanDet combines section-conditioned stylistic modeling with multi-level contrastive learning to capture nuanced human-AI differences while mitigating topic dependence, thereby enhancing cross-domain robustness and shows strong resilience under adversarial rewriting.

2510.00894.tldr: FusionAdapter introduces an adapter module that enables efficient adaptation of each modality to unseen relations and a fusion strategy that integrates multimodal entity representations while preserving diverse modality-specific characteristics.

2510.00906.tldr: Stochastic reachtubes are proposed as a novel method for estimating the necessity of expert intervention in interactive Imitation Learning and this approach effectively reduces the number of expert interventions.

2510.00908.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of developments from early translation-based methods to state-of-the-art embedding-driven and generative techniques, and outlines future directions for building retrieval systems that are robust, inclusive, and adaptable.

2510.00909.tldr: It is found that there is little consensus among AI developers on the relative ranking of privacy risks, and while AI developers are aware of proposed mitigation strategies for addressing these risks, they reported minimal real-world adoption.

2510.00911.tldr: RiskPO introduces a Mixed Value-at-Risk objective that integrates weighted attention over multiple regions of the reward distribution, thereby amplifying gradient signals on challenging instances and preventing overconfident convergence and proves that the risk-averse update alleviates entropy collapse and promotes exploration.

2510.00958.tldr: This paper introduces stochastic edge selection into the graph coarsening procedure, replacing the previously proposed greedy approach, and proposes the Graph Coarsening History-based Partitioning (GraphCHiP) algorithm, which leverages coarsening history to identify not only RCIs but also, for the first time, the Framed capacity inequalities (FCIs).

2510.00960.tldr: The Fuzzy Transformer (Fuzzformer), a novel recurrent neural network architecture combined with multi-head self-attention and fuzzy inference systems to analyze multivariate stock market data and conduct long-term time series forecasting.

2510.00966.tldr: This model illustrates that using stacked autoencoders in representation learning suits clustering tasks and can significantly improve clustering search results, and demonstrates improved accuracy and relevance of search results.

2510.00967.tldr: QUASAR, an agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework for quantum circuits generation and optimization based on tool-augmented LLMs, is proposed, which designs a quantum circuit verification approach with external quantum simulators and a sophisticated hierarchical reward mechanism in RL training.

2510.00976.tldr: Experimental evaluation on simulated rare-disease detection datasets demonstrates up to 10% improvement in accuracy compared with baseline FL, while reducing client dropouts by over 50% without degrading convergence, highlighting AFFR as a practical pathway for equitable and trustworthy federated diagnosis of rare conditions.

2510.01004.tldr: This paper proposes TextCAM, a novel explanation framework that enriches CAM with natural languages, and derives channel-level semantic representations using CLIP embeddings and linear discriminant analysis, and aggregate them with CAM weights to produce textual descriptions of salient visual evidence.

2510.01020.tldr: A novel algorithm is developed that establishes the first no-regret guarantees for error-constrained logistic testing, with direct applications to cost-sensitive medical screening and does not require too many excess tests.

2510.01025.tldr: The introduction of Supervised Multi-Dimensional Scaling (SMDS), a model-agnostic method for evaluating and comparing competing feature manifold hypotheses, is introduced and it is found that different features instantiate distinct geometric structures, including circles, lines, and clusters.

2510.01030.tldr: Evaluating a set of over 70 models that widely vary in their computational ingredients on a triplet similarity task finds that models that undergo instruction-finetuning and which have larger dimensionality of attention heads are among the most human aligned, while multimodal pretraining and parameter size have limited bearing on alignment.

2510.01037.tldr: This work proposes CurES, an efficient training method that accelerates convergence and employs Bayesian posterior estimation to minimize computational overhead and exhibits faster convergence compared to baselines, including GRPO.

2510.01038.tldr: ConvAD, a drop-in mechanism that can be easily added to any trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and which implements the AD paradigm, is introduced, demonstrating that ConvAD extracts more robust explanations without the need for domain knowledge.

2510.01048.tldr: This paper provides the first survey of the emerging field of concept descriptions for model components and abstractions, charting the key methods for generating these descriptions, the evolving landscape of automated and human metrics for evaluating them, and the datasets that underpin this research.

2510.01051.tldr: GEM (General Experience Maker), an open-source environment simulator designed for the age of LLMs, provides a standardized framework for the environment-agent interface, including asynchronous vectorized execution for high throughput, and flexible wrappers for easy extensibility.

2510.01052.tldr: A hybrid DST model is proposed that utilizes rule-based methods along with language models, including BERT for slot filling and intent detection, XGBoost for intent validation, GPT for DST, and online agents for real-time answer generation.

2510.01069.tldr: This framework provides a methodology to transform plausible narrative explanations into formally verifiable programs, offering a path towards building more reliable and trustworthy AI systems.

2510.01077.tldr: This paper proposes CodeGenLink, a GitHub CoPilot extension for Visual Studio Code aimed at suggesting links containing code very similar to automatically generated code, and whenever possible, indicating the license of the likely origin of the code.

2510.01088.tldr: Safety Instincts Reinforcement Learning (SIRL) is introduced, which transforms internal confidence into a self-generated reward signal, eliminating dependence on external validators or human annotations and paving the way for more autonomous and robust AI safety mechanisms that scale without extensive human oversight.

2510.01123.tldr: This work trains an 8B thinking model with Reinforcement Learning to make it consistent with PDR as the inference method, and identifies an interesting inference family Parallel-Distill-Refine (PDR), which performs an interesting inference family Parallel-Distill-Refine, which provides performance superior to long CoT.

2510.01136.tldr: This work introduces TabINR, an auto-decoder based Implicit Neural Representation (INR) framework that models tables as neural functions and introduces learnable row and feature embeddings that effectively deal with the discrete structure of tabular data and can be inferred from partial observations, enabling instance adaptive imputations without modifying the trained model.

2510.01141.tldr: Apriel-1.5-15B-Thinker is presented, a 15-billion parameter open-weights multimodal reasoning model that achieves frontier-level performance through training design rather than sheer scale, making frontier-level multimodal reasoning accessible to organizations with limited infrastructure.

2510.01164.tldr: The Social Welfare Function (SWF) Benchmark is introduced, a dynamic simulation environment where an LLM acts as a sovereign allocator, distributing tasks to a heterogeneous community of recipients, to create a persistent trade-off between maximizing collective efficiency and ensuring distributive fairness.

2510.01165.tldr: This work proposes a Generative Retrieval-Aligned Demonstrator (GRAD), a dynamic demonstration-based approach where an LLM model is trained to generate input-specific concise demonstrations and demonstrates the superiority of GRAD under budget constraints.

2510.01167.tldr: A unified framework that standardizes process reward model training across both verifiable and non-verifiable settings to better supervise models' chain-of-thought reasoning and improves performance across multiple objectives simultaneously is proposed.

2510.01169.tldr: Synthetic data generated with Fiaingen methods more closely mirrors the original time series data while keeping data generation time close to seconds - ensuring the scalability of the proposed approach.
