2510.01173.tldr: This work proposes EditTrack, the first framework for image-editing detection and attribution, which introduces a novel re-editing strategy and leverages carefully designed similarity metrics to determine whether a suspicious image originates from a base image and, if so, by which model.

2510.01174.tldr: The results demonstrate the potential of Code2Video as a scalable, interpretable, and controllable approach, achieving 40% improvement over direct code generation and producing videos comparable to human-crafted tutorials.

2510.01178.tldr: This paper proposes a sample-efficient Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization algorithm (COM-BOM) to find the Pareto front that optimally trades off the two objectives of accuracy and calibration, and finds that COM-BOM beats or matches the baselines at jointly optimizing the two objectives, while requiring a minimal number of LLM API calls.

2510.01179.tldr: Toucan is introduced, the largest publicly available tool-agentic dataset to date, containing 1.5 million trajectories synthesized from nearly 500 real-world Model Context Protocols (MCPs) and fine-tuned models fine-tuned on Toucan outperform larger closed-source counterparts on the BFCL V3 benchmark and push the Pareto frontier forward on MCP-Universe Bench.

2102.04518.tldr: This work introduces Q*, a search algorithm that leverages heuristics capable of receiving a state and, in a single function call, returning cost-to-go estimates for all possible transitions from that state -- without the need to apply the transitions or generate the successor states; such action-state estimation are typically known as Q-values.

2306.06821.tldr: The idea is to implement Lin-Zhao's theorem together with constraints directly in vector spaces as numerical minimization of a cost function constructed from a matricized normal logic program, loop formulas in Lin-Zhao's theorem and constraints, thereby no use of symbolic ASP or SAT solvers involved in this approach.

2309.14073.tldr: This article shows that existing graphical structures that are used in causal inference are not stable under marginalization of Gaussian Bayesian networks, and presents a graphical structure that faithfully represent margins of Gaussian Bayesian networks.

2404.03054.tldr: This work uses worst-case distinctiveness (wcd) as a measure of the difficulty in inferring the goal of an agent in a decision-making environment and proposes a gradient-based optimization framework that accommodates various constraints to optimize decision-making environments for enhanced goal recognition.

2407.01504.tldr: This work reinvestigate the R2 indicator under the premise that it has a continuous, uniform distribution of (Tchebycheff) utility functions, demonstrating that this continuous variant is indeed Pareto-compliant - that is, any beneficial solution will improve the metric's value.

2407.20177.tldr: Overall, the findings illustrate how domain importance shifts with training scale, underscoring the need for scale-dependent data curation in LLM training.

2410.10862.tldr: The Superficial Safety Alignment Hypothesis is proposed, which posits that safety alignment teaches an otherwise unsafe model to choose the correct reasoning direction-fulfill or refuse users'quests-interpreted as an implicit binary classification task.

2410.11305.tldr: QSpec is a novel quantization paradigm that decouples efficiency from quality by integrating two complementary schemes via speculative decoding: low-precision joint quantization for fast drafting and high-precision weight-only quantization for accurate verification.

2411.07447.tldr: This paper first analyzes the LLM inference performance and focuses on a data management issue inside LLM inference, finding that inference systems lack an adequate resource cost model and optimization strategy to schedule requests with their intermediate results in a cache reside in GPU memory when executing multiple concurrent inference requests.

2411.14459.tldr: This paper proposes COMPASS (Compact Preference Analyzer and Summarization System), a plug-and-play framework that synergizes LLMs and KGs to reason over user preferences, enhancing the performance and explainability of existing CRSs.

2411.19557.tldr: This work proposes a method, LoRA Silver Bullet or LoRA-SB, that approximates full fine-tuning within low-rank subspaces using a carefully designed initialization strategy, and establishes that it is possible to simulate full fine-tuning in low-rank subspaces, and achieve significant parameter efficiency gains without sacrificing performance.

2412.00577.tldr: Representational Similarity Analysis (RSA) is adapted, a method that uses pairwise similarity ratings to quantify alignment between AIs and humans and demonstrates the utility of this approach across multiple modalities for understanding how LLMs encode knowledge and for examining representational alignment with human cognition.

2412.02259.tldr: VideoGen-of-Thought is introduced, a step-by-step framework that automates multi-shot video synthesis from a single sentence by systematically addressing three core challenges: Narrative fragmentation, identity-aware cross-shot propagation, and transition artifacts.

2412.03815.tldr: This study aims to improve the accuracy of LLM-based chatbots in answering repositoryrelated questions by augmenting them with knowledge graphs with a two-step approach: constructing a knowledge graph from repository data, and synergizing the knowledge graph with an LLM to handle natural language questions and answers.

2501.01473.tldr: A robust framework for demonstration selection that generalizes beyond traditional ICL is proposed, offering valuable insights into the role of IFs for Indirect ICL.

2501.08316.tldr: This work proposes Adversarial Post-Training (APT) against real data following diffusion pre-training for one-step video generation, and introduces several improvements to the model architecture and training procedures, along with an approximated R1 regularization objective.

2501.13014.tldr: The findings suggest that a self-selecting open peer review process is potentially scalable, reliable, and equitable with the possibility of enhancing the speed, fairness, and transparency of the peer review process.

2501.14399.tldr: This work introduces FWHDNN (Fusion-based Wavelet Hypergraph Diffusion Neural Networks), an innovative framework aimed at advancing representation learning in hypergraph-based recommendation tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, robustness, and scalability.

2502.03323.tldr: This work presents a method that harnesses the generative capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to create high-quality synthetic OOD proxies, eliminating the dependency on any external OOD data source.

2502.10940.tldr: CoLA and its memory-efficient implementation, CoLA-M, are proposed to replace these full-size layers with compute-efficient auto-encoders that naturally enforce low-rank activations throughout training, eliminating the activation redundancy and significantly boosts model capacity and training efficiency.

2502.14862.tldr: This work provides a structured overview of methods specializing in inherently interpretable text embeddings and text similarity explanation, an underexplored research area, and characterize the main ideas, approaches, and trade-offs.

2503.01904.tldr: An occlusion-based modality contribution method that is both model- and performance agnostic and provides fine-grained quantitative and visual attribute importance for each modality in the dataset to support multimodal model development and dataset creation.

2503.03238.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework named FANS: Formal ANswer Selection for Natural Language Math Reasoning Using Lean4, the first framework that utilizes Lean4 to enhance LLMs'NL math reasoning ability and proposes an alternative method for answer selection beyond the reward model.

2503.09780.tldr: A new benchmark AgentDAM is introduced that measures if AI web-navigation agents follow the privacy principle of ``data minimization'' and proposes a prompting-based defense that reduces information leakage, and demonstrates that end-to-end benchmarking provides a more realistic measure than probing LLMs about privacy.

2503.10945.tldr: It is argued that using non-asymptotic Gaussian Differential Privacy (GDP) as the primary means of communicating DP guarantees in ML avoids these potential downsides and investigates the privacy profiles of state-of-the-art DP large-scale image classification, and the TopDown algorithm for the U.S. Decennial Census, observing that GDP fits their profiles remarkably well.

2503.16328.tldr: The Knowledge-Guided Machine Learning with Soil Moisture with Soil Moisture (KGML-SM) framework is developed, treating soil moisture as an intermediate variable in corn growth to emphasize its key role in plant development.

2503.17551.tldr: This work proposes kNN-based Latent Space Broadening (LSB) to enhance AL efficiency, achieving an up to 9% recall improvement at 80% precision on proprietary datasets, and introduces Vision-Language Modeling with Audio Enhancement (VLMAE), a mid-fusion approach integrating audio into VL models, yielding up to another 9% recall improvement at 80% precision.

2504.00178.tldr: BoundlessBPE is proposed, a modified BPE algorithm that relaxes the pretoken boundary constraint, and selectively merges two complete pretokens into a larger unit the authors term a superword, which results in a substantially more uniform distribution of tokens across a corpus than standard BPE, and compresses text more effectively.

2504.02010.tldr: It is found that weight count has a greater impact on LRMs'knowledge memorization than reasoning, highlighting the risks of pruning and distillation, and current quantization methods overly compress the final-layer modules and MLP gate projections, greatly surpassing the state-of-the-art.

2504.03206.tldr: This work proposes leveraging a user model to incorporate a curiosity-based intrinsic reward into multi-turn RLHF, and demonstrates its effectiveness in two distinct domains: significantly improving personalization performance in a conversational recommendation task, and personalizing conversations for different learning styles in an educational setting.

2504.03287.tldr: A Large Language Model-based chatbot, called AskThePublic is created, providing policymakers, journalists, researchers, and interested citizens with a convenient channel to explore and engage with citizen input and finds that the interviewees value the interactive and structured responses as well as enhanced language capabilities.

2505.05288.tldr: This work introduces the novel task of Language-Guided Object Placement in Real 3D Scenes, and proposes a new benchmark and evaluation protocol, and introduces a new dataset for training 3D LLMs on this task, as well as the first method to serve as a non-trivial baseline.

2505.12626.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations on seven real-world datasets demonstrate that scSiameseClu outperforms state-of-the-art methods in single-cell clustering, cell type annotation, and cell type classification, providing a powerful tool for scRNA-seq data interpretation.

2505.17847.tldr: Time-o1, a transformation-augmented learning objective tailored for time-series forecasting, aims to transform the label sequence into decorrelated components with discriminated significance, thereby effectively mitigating label autocorrelation and reducing task amount.

2505.19430.tldr: A novel benchmark, FIN-FORCE-FINancial FORward Counterfactual Evaluation, is introduced, which paves the way for scalable and automated solutions for exploring and anticipating future market developments, thereby providing structured insights for decision-making.

2505.19625.tldr: A research roadmap is presented that articulates the current landscape of SBSE in relation to FMs, identifies open challenges, and outlines potential research directions to advance SBSE through its integration and interplay with FMs.

2505.20211.tldr: It is proved that projecting gradients onto the principal column space of pre-trained weights provides an effective inductive bias for adaptation and further enhance parameter efficiency through a novel weight-sharing strategy, demonstrating both theoretical rigor and practical effectiveness.

2505.21677.tldr: It is found that data-mediated interactions can benefit models by exposing them to novel concepts perhaps missed in original training data, but also can homogenize their performance on shared tasks.

2505.23426.tldr: DACERv2 is proposed, which leverages a Q-gradient field objective with respect to action as an auxiliary optimization target to guide the denoising process at each diffusion step, thereby introducing intermediate supervisory signals that enhance the efficiency of single-step diffusion.

2505.23761.tldr: DPO's reward design, training dynamics, and downstream capabilities all emerge as natural consequences of learning Differential Information, offering both a principled theoretical foundation and practical guidance for preference-based alignment.

2506.04254.tldr: The first national-scale AI benchmark for metropolitan France using state-of-the-art AI models on a relatively unexplored dataset is presented and a new approach and database that tailors fire risk assessment to departmental contexts are proposed, offering more actionable and region-specific predictions for operational use.

2506.04512.tldr: This work explores schema generation using large language models (LLMs) with two datasets: YAGO Schema and Wikidata EntitySchema, along with novel evaluation metrics, and introduces a new challenge for structured generation.

2506.08066.tldr: This paper investigates ensembles of deep change point detectors and realizes that standard prediction aggregation techniques are suboptimal and fail to account for problem peculiarities, and introduces WWAggr - a novel task-specific method of ensemble aggregation based on the Wasserstein distance.

2506.09350.tldr: This work proposes autoregressive adversarial post-training (AAPT) to transform a pre-trained latent video diffusion model into a real-time, interactive video generator that autoregressively generates a latent frame at a time using a single neural function evaluation (1NFE).

2506.14245.tldr: This paper revisits Pass@K experiments and introduces a novel evaluation metric, CoT-Pass@K, which captures reasoning success by accounting for both the final answer and intermediate reasoning steps, and presents a theoretical framework explaining RLVR's incentive mechanism.

2506.17252.tldr: SamS is proposed, an efficient and effective algorithm that adaptively selects samples in each training batch based on the LLM's learning feedback to maximize the potential generalization performance, without modifying the core DPO algorithm.

2506.17253.tldr: This work develops MS-DFTVNet, the multi-scale 3D deformable convolutional framework tailored for long-term forecasting, and introduces a context-aware dynamic deformable convolution mechanism, which further enhances the model's ability to capture complex temporal patterns.

2507.04868.tldr: The method is simple, computationally efficient, and model-agnostic, requiring only stationarity and the presence of a dominant positive exponent, and offers a practical route to LLE estimation in experimental settings where only scalar time-series measurements are available.

2507.11997.tldr: A multi-level LLM enhanced framework including type-level enhancer and relation-level enhancer to enhance the difference between the fraudsters and the benign entities and enhance the ability to distinguish fraudsters is proposed.

2508.00827.tldr: This paper proposes a detailed, property-by-property mapping of the LRMoo F1 Work to the widely adopted schema, establishing a stable, URI-addressable anchor for each legal norm, creating a verifiable"ground truth".

2508.02961.tldr: This paper introduces a novel self-consciousness defense mechanism for Large Language Models to combat prompt injection attacks, and proposes a framework that incorporates Meta-Cognitive and Arbitration Modules, enabling LLMs to evaluate and regulate their own outputs autonomously.

2509.00631.tldr: A machine learning framework for ionospheric TEC forecasting that leverages Temporal Fusion Transformers (TFT) to predict sparse ionosphere data and offers interpretability through attention-based analysis, supporting both operational applications and scientific discovery is presented.

2509.00768.tldr: This work introduces Physics-aware Rejection Sampling (PaRS), a training-time trace selection scheme that favors traces consistent with fundamental physics and numerically close to targets, with lightweight halting to control compute.

2509.04471.tldr: This work introduces MOSAIC, a multilingual, taxonomy-agnostic, and computationally efficient approach for radiological report classification, built on a compact open-access language model and enabling deployment on consumer-grade GPUs.

2509.12960.tldr: It is suggested that while ReLoRA's merge-and-restart strategy can expand ranks in larger models, it does not straightforwardly translate to capacity-limited SLMs, motivating adaptive-rank or hybrid-rank approaches for low-compute pretraining.

2509.13388.tldr: This study presents machine learning and remote sensing frameworks to compare land use and land cover change from 2013 to 2024 in Nadi, Fiji, and presents a visualisation of change detection, highlighting urban area changes over time to monitor changes in the map.

2509.14270.tldr: SpeechWeave is proposed, a synthetic speech data generation pipeline that is capable of automating the generation of multilingual, domain-specific datasets for training TTS models, and enables scalable, high-quality data generation for TTS training, improving diversity, normalization, and voice consistency in the generated datasets.

2509.16215.tldr: The feasibility of using deep learning to automate the identification of parallelizable structures in code, offering a promising tool for software optimization and performance improvement is demonstrated.

2509.18216.tldr: This work proposes Neural DNA (nDNA) as a semantic-genotypic representation that captures this latent identity through the intrinsic geometry of belief through the semantic torsion fields that guide a model's belief directional orientations.

2509.20640.tldr: The architecture provides an intelligent and scalable blueprint for safeguarding complex digital infrastructure and is compatible with zero-trust models, thereby supporting the adherence to international cybersecurity regulations.

2509.21998.tldr: A novel benchmark, GSM-Agent is built, where an LLM agent is required to solve grade-school-level reasoning problems, but is only presented with the question in the prompt without the premises that contain the necessary information to solve the task, and needs to proactively collect that information using tools.

2509.22255.tldr: This paper presents an evaluation framework for assessing Large Language Models' capabilities in combinatorial optimization, specifically addressing the 2D bin-packing problem, and reveals that GPT-4o achieves optimal solutions within two iterations.

2509.22558.tldr: This work introduces StepORLM, a novel self-evolving framework with generative process supervision that establishes a new state-of-the-art across six benchmarks, significantly outperforming vastly larger generalist models, agentic methods, and specialized baselines.

2509.23537.tldr: The ablations show that revealing authorship increases self-voting and ties, and that showing ongoing votes amplifies herding, which speeds convergence but can sometimes yield premature consensus.

2509.23813.tldr: IndexNet is proposed, an MLP-based framework augmented with an Index Embedding (IE) module, which transforms timestamps into embedding vectors and injects them into the input sequence, thereby improving the model's ability to capture long-term complex periodic patterns.

2509.23990.tldr: This study investigates the trade-offs between translation quality and efficiency by comparing full-scale, distilled, and quantized models using machine translation as a case study and argues for evaluation frameworks that integrate efficiency and sustainability alongside accuracy as central dimensions of progress in NLP.

2509.24260.tldr: A simple and strong baseline Simple-Reasoning-Then-Coding (Simple-RTC)-which guides LLMs to design graph algorithms first and then code to address graph reasoning tasks, achieves near-perfect accuracy on existing benchmarks and significantly outperforms GPT-4o-mini and all prior methods on the GraphAlgorithm benchmark.

2509.24913.tldr: Segmentor-guided Counterfactual Fine-Tuning (Seg-CFT) is proposed, which preserves the simplicity of intervening on scalar-valued, structure-specific variables while producing locally coherent and effective counterfactuals.

2509.25252.tldr: Fact Grounded Attention (FGA), a novel architectural modification that transforms unreliable language models into deterministic truth tellers by injecting verifiable knowledge directly into the attention mechanism, marking a fundamental shift from probabilistic approximation to deterministic precision in neural language generation.

2509.25264.tldr: GeoSQL-Eval is the first end-to-end automated evaluation framework for PostGIS query generation and provides a standardized, interpretable, and extensible framework for evaluating LLMs in spatial database contexts, offering valuable references for geospatial information science and related applications.

2509.25479.tldr: A tailored pipeline that incorporates a Monte Carlo-based evolution step to overcome local minima and a position-specific biased inverse folding step to refine sequence patterns is developed, establishing a generalizable framework for efficient binder design against structurally large and otherwise inaccessible targets.

2509.25779.tldr: The results establish reward shaping as a decisive lever for scaling agentic RL, highlight the competitive strength of smaller models, and demonstrate that efficiency can be achieved without sacrificing generalization.

2509.25848.tldr: This work proposes Vision-Anchored Policy Optimization (VAPO), a simple yet effective method that explicitly steers the reasoning process toward visually grounded trajectories, and significantly strengthens the model's reliance on visual information and achieves new state-of-the-art results on a wide range of established benchmarks.

2509.26306.tldr: ILR, a novel co-learning framework for MAS that integrates two key components: Dynamic Interaction and Perception Calibration, is introduced and it is discovered that Idea3 can enhance the robustness of stronger LLMs during multi-agent inference, and dynamic interaction types can boost multi-agent learning compared to pure cooperative or competitive strategies.

2509.26399.tldr: FLoRA-NA achieves communication efficiency and bridges the gap between local personalization and global generalization, addressing a key limitation of prior personalized FedLoRA approaches.

2510.00404.tldr: AbsTopK SAE is proposed, a new variant derived from the $\ell_0$ sparsity constraint that applies hard thresholding over the largest-magnitude activations, which improves reconstruction fidelity, enhances interpretability, and enables single features to encode contrasting concepts.

2510.00492.tldr: The theoretical analysis shows that step-wise aggregation compounds errors as reasoning length grows, and the empirical observations confirm this effect, and these findings challenge the prevailing assumption that fine-grained supervision is always better and support generative outcome verification for multi-domain deployment.

2510.00499.tldr: This work presents MOSS-Speech, a true speech-to-speech large language model that directly understands and generates speech without relying on text guidance, and establishes a new paradigm for expressive and efficient end-to-end speech interaction.

2510.00549.tldr: EMR-AGENT (Automated Generalized Extraction and Navigation Tool), an agent-based framework that replaces manual rule writing with dynamic, language model-driven interaction to extract and standardize structured clinical data, is introduced, highlighting the feasibility of automating a process previously thought to require expert-driven design.

2510.00629.tldr: This work is the creation of 10,120 syllabified Tenyidie words and the application of the Deep Learning techniques on the created corpus and will find its application in numerous other NLP applications, such as morphological analysis, part-of-speech tagging, machine translation, etc, for the Tenyidie Language.

2510.00817.tldr: It is shown that under certain conditions a weighted knowledge base and a set of defeasible conditionals can generate the same ordering on interpretations, and therefore an equivalence of semantic structures up to relative cost.

2510.00919.tldr: This work investigates the potential of RAG to enhance physics reasoning in foundation models and introduces PhoPile, a high-quality multimodal dataset specifically designed for Olympiad-level physics, enabling systematic study of retrieval-based reasoning.

2510.01276.tldr: The study emphasizes how parameter efficient fine-tuning methods (LoRA and PEFT) can lower computational overhead and make it appropriate for contexts with limited resources and shows how LLMs can be appropriate for contexts with limited resources.

2510.01279.tldr: It is found that agent diversity and quality are crucial and can be enhanced by using LLMs to auto-optimize agent designs, and TUMIX can halt refinement upon reaching sufficient confidence, preserving performance at only 49% of the inference cost.

2510.01281.tldr: Drawing from past work, this work advocates for the standardization of industry best practices as a necessary addition to broad regulations to achieve the level of details required in industry, while preventing stifling innovation and investment in the AI sector.

2510.01286.tldr: It is suggested that concentrated benchmark influence functions as coordination infrastructure that supports standardization, comparability, and reproducibility amid rising heterogeneity in model production, while also introducing trade-offs such as path dependence, selective visibility, and diminishing discriminative power as leaderboards saturate.

2510.01287.tldr: The fusion model (2025) successfully resolved the majority of challenging cases that remained unaddressed in the previous study and demonstrates the potential of AI cell foundation model development in renal pathology and provides a curated dataset of challenging samples to support future kidney-specific model refinement.

2510.01288.tldr: It is shown that lightweight position encoding perturbations elicit latent signals that indicate model misbehaviour, suggesting that pretrained LLMs already encode the internal evidence needed to flag their own failures, and that microsaccade-inspired interventions provide a pathway for detecting and mitigating undesirable behaviours.

2510.01293.tldr: This study demonstrates how carefully designed multi-agent architectures can provide a viable pathway toward autonomous scientific discovery in chemical engineering by integrating domain-specific knowledge bases, knowledge enhancement technologies, and collaboration agents.

2510.01295.tldr: This work provides a blueprint for a new class of dynamic, psychometrically grounded evaluation protocols designed for the agentic setting, offering a crucial methodology for understanding and shaping the social behaviors of the next generation of AI agents.

2510.01296.tldr: This review surveys the methodological landscape of 3D MRI reconstruction, focusing on 4 primary approaches: point cloud, mesh-based, shape-aware, and volumetric models, and analyze the current state-of-the-art techniques, their methodological foundation, limitations, and applications across anatomical structures.

2510.01303.tldr: It is shown that the gradient with respect to the input weights is approximately low rank and is dominated by two rank-one terms: one aligned with the bulk data-residue , and another aligned with the rank one spike in the input data.

2510.01336.tldr: A framework for high-throughput speculative decoding that exploits early-exit models for low-overhead intermediate verification and a methodology that enables HiSpec to re-use key-value caches and hidden states between the draft, intermediate verifier, and target models is designed.

2510.01353.tldr: This work provides an extensible framework for advancing evaluation research for memory-augmented agents, beyond existing focus on conversational setups, and sets the stage for multi-agent, multi-platform memory benchmarking in complex organizational settings.

2510.01354.tldr: The key findings show that while some detectors can identify attacks that rely on explicit textual instructions or visible image perturbations with moderate to high accuracy, they largely fail against attacks that omit explicit instructions or employ imperceptible perturbations.

2510.01359.tldr: This work presents JAWS-BENCH (Jailbreaks Across WorkSpaces), a benchmark spanning three escalating workspace regimes that mirror attacker capability, and pairs this with a hierarchical, executable-aware Judge Framework that tests compliance, attack success, syntactic correctness, and runtime executability.

2510.01363.tldr: A clinical decision support system powered by Large Language Models to assist prescribing clinicians and represents an initial step toward integration of generative AI into real-world clinical decision-making with an emphasis on transparency, safety, and alignment with established practices.

2510.01370.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that SPUS using residual U-Net based architecture achieves state-of-the-art generalization on these downstream tasks while requiring significantly fewer parameters and minimal fine-tuning data, highlighting its potential as a highly parameter-efficient FM for solving diverse PDE systems.

2510.01375.tldr: This work proposes a simple pipeline that converts inference-time retrieval into learned competence through distillation, demonstrating that retrieval benefits can be effectively internalized through targeted fine-tuning without permanent runtime dependencies.

2510.01377.tldr: DeMuon is the first direct extension of Muon to decentralized optimization over graphs with provable complexity guarantees, and preliminary numerical experiments on decentralized transformer pretraining over graphs with varying degrees of connectivity demonstrate a clear margin of improvement over other popular decentralized algorithms across different network topologies.

2510.01389.tldr: This study provides the first systematic evaluation of uncertainty-based introspection in VLAs, opening future avenues for active learning and for real-time error mitigation through selective human intervention.

2510.01395.tldr: This work shows the pervasiveness and harmful impacts of sycophancy when people seek advice from AI, and suggests that people are drawn to AI that unquestioningly validate, even as that validation risks eroding their judgment and reducing their inclination toward prosocial behavior.

2510.01398.tldr: Results indicate that the LLM-agent-developed model surpasses traditional CHF lookup tables and delivers predictive accuracy and UQ on par with state-of-the-art Bayesian optimized deep neural network models developed by human experts, underscore the significant potential of LLM-based agents to automate complex engineering modeling tasks.

2510.01409.tldr: OntoLogX is introduced, an autonomous Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to transform raw logs into ontology-grounded Knowledge Graphs (KGs), demonstrating robust KG generation across multiple KGs backends and accurate mapping of adversarial activity to ATT&CK tactics.

2510.01414.tldr: This paper characterizes how varying spike strengths and target-spike alignments can affect risk, especially in overparameterized settings and reveals that target-spike alignment is not always advantageous, identifying specific, sometimes counterintuitive, conditions for its benefit or detriment.

2510.01428.tldr: Across tasks spanning cell-type annotation, molecular description, and protein function reasoning, compact BIOVERSE configurations surpass larger LLM baselines while enabling richer, generative outputs than existing BioFMs, establishing a foundation for principled multi-modal biomedical reasoning.

2510.01432.tldr: It is seen how an expert specified curriculum for learning a target concept can help develop adaptive tutoring systems, that can not only provide a better learning experience, but could also allow us to use more efficient algorithms to create these systems.

2510.01433.tldr: An affordance-guided framework that distills a minimal set of semantic 2D keypoints from a text prompt and a single image, yielding a compact 38-dimensional state policy that performs well in real-time without proprioception or dense representations.

2510.01448.tldr: A novel geographic representation is formed that explicitly models the world as a hierarchy of geographic embeddings and an approach to efficiently fuse the appearance features of the query image with its semantic segmentation map, forming a robust visual representation.

2510.01450.tldr: Local Linear Attention is proposed, a novel attention mechanism derived from nonparametric statistics through the lens of test-time regression that effectively adapts to non-stationarity, outperforming strong baselines in test-time training and in-context learning, and exhibiting promising evidence for its scalability and applicability in large-scale models.

2510.01453.tldr: This work demonstrates a mechanism for automatically creating graphical interfaces for command line tools by translating their documentation into interface specifications via AI, and evaluates the generated interfaces on a corpus of commands to show to what degree GUIDE offers thorough graphical interfaces for users’ real-world command line tasks.

2510.01462.tldr: A scalable methodology for synthesizing classroom noise and RIRs using game engines using game engines, a versatile framework that can extend to other domains beyond the classroom is introduced.

2510.01473.tldr: The conceptual model shows that the potential benefits are not enough for researchers to use LLMs instead of current technology, and will allow developers to incorporate features that result in an increased acceptance of LLMs for data discovery.

2510.01480.tldr: A novel generative framework that balances pharmacophore similarity to reference compounds with structural diversity from active molecules is presented, suggesting strong potential for functional innovation and patentability.

2510.01483.tldr: VL-KnG is presented, a training-free framework that constructs spatiotemporal knowledge graphs from monocular video, bridging fine-grained scene graphs and global topological graphs without 3D reconstruction, with explainable, graph-grounded reasoning.

2510.01499.tldr: This work designs two new aggregation algorithms called Optimal Weight (OW) and Inverse Surprising Popularity (ISP), leveraging both first-order and second-order information, and shows these methods provably mitigate inherent limitations of majority voting under mild assumptions, leading to more reliable collective decisions.

2510.01500.tldr: Lateral Tree-of-Thoughts (LToT), a drop-in controller that separates utility from logical consistency and treats low-utility but consistent candidates as assets rather than waste is proposed.

2510.01513.tldr: This paper crafts a candidate recipe for a pipeline, marrying a set of pre-trained models, to convert videos into a temporal semi-structured data format, enabling the dynamic incorporation of new domain-specific knowledge through an interactive medium.

2510.01520.tldr: Overall, the framework shows that combining rigorous data engineering, advanced machine learning, and explainable AI enables accurate, interpretable predictions of veterinary safety outcomes, and supports FARAD's mission by enabling early detection of high-risk drug-event profiles, strengthening residue risk assessment, and informing regulatory and clinical decision-making.

2510.01524.tldr: WALT (Web Agents that Learn Tools), a framework that reverse-engineers latent website functionality into reusable invocable tools, achieves higher success with fewer steps and less LLM-dependent reasoning, establishing a robust and generalizable paradigm for browser automation.

2510.01528.tldr: A novel method that leverages sparse autoencoders (SAEs) and clustering techniques to analyze the internal token representations of large language models (LLMs) and guide generations in mathematical reasoning tasks and indicates that balancing both exploitation and exploration is crucial for achieving high accuracy in mathematical reasoning tasks.

2510.01530.tldr: A novel neurosymbolically-grounded architecture called LogT is proposed that uses an advanced logical language and reasoner in conjunction with an LLM to construct a dual symbolic graph context and logic-based context that transforms the problem from inference over long-form guidelines into a compact grounded evaluation.

2510.01531.tldr: Information Seeking Decision Planner (InfoSeeker), an LLM decision-making framework that integrates task-oriented planning with information seeking to align internal dynamics and make optimal decisions under uncertainty in both agent observations and environmental dynamics is introduced.

2510.01544.tldr: This work proposes a theoretical framework that formalizes complex problem solving as a hierarchical selection process, where an intractable global constraint is decomposed into a series of simpler, localized logical steps, and introduces Step-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), a novel RL algorithm that aligns the dLLM's denoising process with the latent reasoning hierarchy.

2510.01552.tldr: This paper investigates the intrinsic vulnerabilities of LLMs in CTI, focusing on challenges that arise from the nature of the threat landscape itself rather than the model architecture, and introduces a novel categorization methodology that integrates stratification, autoregressive refinement, and human-in-the-loop supervision to reliably analyze failure instances.

2510.01571.tldr: This work pairs RL with PLMs across four domains: antimicrobial peptide design, kinase variant optimization, antibody engineering, antibody engineering, and inverse folding to ask if RL improves sampling efficiency and, more importantly, if it reveals capabilities not captured by supervised learning.

2510.01574.tldr: This work introduces a data-centric approach for mitigating presentation bias in real-time neural query autocomplete systems through the use of synthetic prefixes, and shows that synthetic prefixes not only improve generalization but also provide a scalable path toward bias mitigation in other low-latency ranking tasks, including related searches and query recommendations.

2510.01576.tldr: This work developed a system that draws on historical BLV users questions and identifies similar past visual contexts from the VizWiz-LF dataset and uses the associated questions to guide the MLLM generate descriptions more relevant to BLV users.

2510.01581.tldr: TRAAC (Think Right with Adaptive, Attentive Compression), an online post-training RL method that leverages the model's self-attention over a long reasoning trajectory to identify important steps and prune redundant ones, improves accuracy, reduces reasoning steps, and enables adaptive thinking compared to base models and other RL baselines.

2510.01586.tldr: AdvEvo-MARL is proposed, a co-evolutionary multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that internalizes safety into task agents and jointly optimizes attackers and defenders in adversarial learning environments, and introduces a public baseline for advantage estimation.

2510.01588.tldr: NoRo, a noise-robust UPDRS prediction framework that introduces a novel evaluation approach with customizable noise injection module, and extensive experiments show that NoRo can successfully enhance the noise robustness of UPDRS prediction across various downstream prediction models under different noisy environments.

2510.01606.tldr: This work develops an online adaptation mechanism that continuously incorporates new user interactions through lightweight modules, avoiding the need to retrain large models, and creates a unified representation that seamlessly combines collaborative signals with visual and audio features, handling cases where some modalities may be unavailable.

2510.01609.tldr: This paper introduces AgentRec, a next-generation LLM-powered multi-agent collaborative recommendation framework that addresses limitations through hierarchical agent networks with adaptive intelligence and proposes a three-tier learning strategy combining rapid response for simple queries, intelligent reasoning for complex preferences, and deep collaboration for challenging scenarios.

2510.01622.tldr: This paper introduces an enhanced generative recommendation framework that addresses limitations through five key innovations: multimodal fusion architecture, retrieval-augmented generation mechanisms, causal inference-based debiasing, explainable recommendation generation, and real-time adaptive learning capabilities.

2510.01624.tldr: This work challenges whether high SFT scores translate to improved performance after RL, and studies alternative metrics and identifies generalization loss on held-out reasoning examples and Pass@large k performance to provide strong proxies for the RL outcome.

2510.01631.tldr: It is found pre-training on rephrased synthetic data \textit{alone} is not faster than pre-training on natural web texts; while pre-training on 1/3 rephrased synthetic data mixed with 2/3 natural web texts can speed up 5-10x (to reach the same validation loss) at larger data budgets.

2510.01632.tldr: This work introduces BioBlobs, a plug-and-play, fully differentiable module that represents proteins by dynamically partitioning structures into flexibly-sized, non-overlapping substructures ("blobs").

2510.01638.tldr: A significant gap between current NLP tools and the actual compliance needs of experts is revealed, providing a critical human-centered perspective and design requirements for engineering NLP systems that can proactively support expert compliance workflows.

2510.01639.tldr: This work explores the geospatial reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models, specifically, whether LLMs can read road network maps and perform navigation, and introduces GLOBALTRACE, a dataset with over 4,000 real-world trajectories across diverse regions and transportation modes.

2510.01645.tldr: It is argued that the privacy landscape of LLM systems extends far beyond training data extraction, encompassing risks from data collection practices, inference-time context leakage, autonomous agent capabilities, and the democratization of surveillance through deep inference attacks.

2510.01649.tldr: REFEREE is built upon a synergy between a source-pre-trained model and a large-scale vision-language model, thus overcoming the problem of sub-optimal generalizations when relying only on a source pre-trained model.

2510.01654.tldr: This work introduces CLASP: the Closed-Loop Autonomous Security Performance framework, and defines the Closed-Loop Capability (CLC) Score, a composite metric quantifying both degree of loop closure and operational effectiveness.

2510.01659.tldr: This work introduces MDSEval, the first meta-evaluation benchmark for MDS, consisting image-sharing dialogues, corresponding summaries, and human judgments across eight well-defined quality aspects, and proposes a novel filtering framework leveraging Mutually Exclusive Key Information (MEKI) across modalities.

2510.01663.tldr: This work proposes ShapKAN, a pruning framework using Shapley value attribution to assess node importance in a shift-invariant manner, which improves KAN's interpretability advantages, facilitating deployment in resource-constrained environments.

2510.01664.tldr: This study demonstrates that GuruAgents, prompt-guided AI agents, can systematically operationalize the strategies of legendary investment gurus, and confirms that prompt engineering can successfully translate the qualitative philosophies of investment gurus into reproducible, quantitative strategies.

2510.01670.tldr: It is shown that CUAs consistently exhibit Blind Goal-Directedness (BGD): a bias to pursue goals regardless of feasibility, safety, reliability, or context, and develops BLIND-ACT, a benchmark of 90 tasks capturing three prevalent patterns of BGD.

2510.01671.tldr: The results indicate that near-frontier discrimination and generation-induced errors are structurally avoided in the clinical path by returning vetted FAQ answers verbatim, supporting privacy, sustainability, and equitable deployment in bandwidth-limited environments.

2510.01674.tldr: This work presents FOR-Prompting (From Objection to Revision Prompting), an asymmetric protocol where a Defender proposes an answer, an Debater raises question-style objections with no direct fixes, and a Host optionally synthesizes the final output.

2510.01681.tldr: This work proposes the first framework for adaptive pixel reasoning that dynamically determines necessary pixel-level operations based on the input query, and designs a novel rollout-guided reinforcement learning framework relying on feedback of the model's own responses, which enables the VLM to determine when pixel operations should be invoked based on query difficulty.

2510.01685.tldr: This work investigates how feedforward LLMs solve two-hop factual recall tasks, which can be expressed compositionally as $g(f(x)$, and identifies two processing mechanisms, one which solves tasks $\textit{compositionally}$, computing $f(x)$ along the way to computing $g(f(x))$, and one which solves them without any detectable signature of the intermediate variable $f(x)$.

2510.01687.tldr: This work argues that AGI evaluation methods have been dominated by a design philosophy that uses the authors' intuitions of what intelligence is to create synthetic tasks, that have performed poorly in the history of AI.

2510.01700.tldr: A hard-negative response generation framework based on LLM-guided response editing, that produces rejected responses with targeted errors, maintaining stylistic and length similarity to the accepted ones, and generalizes to open-source LLMs as editors.

2510.01706.tldr: Multi-Level Optimal Transport (MOT), a unified framework that jointly infers soft, globally consistent layer-to-layer couplings and neuron-level transport plans, enables richer, more interpretable comparisons between representations, particularly when networks differ in architecture or depth.

2510.01717.tldr: This paper investigates federated multimodal learning assisted by unmanned aerial vehicles with a focus on minimizing system latency and providing convergence analysis, and proposes an efficient iterative optimization algorithm combining block coordinate descent and successive convex approximation techniques.

2510.01722.tldr: A novel emotional TTS method is proposed that enables fine-grained phoneme-level emotion embedding prediction while disentangling intrinsic attributes of the reference speech, and effectively separating distinct style components from the reference speech.

2510.01724.tldr: MetaboT demonstrates promising performance as a conversational question-answering assistant, enabling researchers to retrieve structured metabolomics data through natural language queries by automating the generation and execution of SPARQL queries.

2510.01751.tldr: A novel, structured decision support framework that systematically aligns diverse artificial intelligence (AI) agent architectures, reactive, cognitive, hybrid, and learning, with the comprehensive NIST CSF 2.0, establishing a foundation for robust, empirically validated multi-agent systems that adhere to industry standards.

2510.01758.tldr: A novel approach for enhancing latent representations using unsupervised Dynamic Feature Selection (DFS), where each instance, the proposed method identifies and removes misleading or redundant information in images, ensuring that only the most relevant features contribute to the latent space.

2510.01780.tldr: A novel framework that leverages the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as an interoperability layer for secure, cross-agent communication in multi-modal federated healthcare systems and highlights MCP-enabled multi-modal fusion as a scalable and trustworthy pathway toward equitable, next-generation federated health infrastructures.

2510.01782.tldr: RI provides insight into an important but previously overlooked aspect of LLM factuality: while LLMs achieve high accuracy on factual tasks, their refusal behavior can be unreliable and fragile, highlighting the need to complement traditional accuracy metrics with the Refusal Index for comprehensive factuality evaluation.

2510.01792.tldr: This work advances legal NLP by providing annotation-free evaluation tools, with implications for judicial analytics and ethical AI deployment, and highlights that unsupervised metrics, including LLM-based approaches, enable scalable screening but, with moderate correlations and low CCC values, cannot fully replace human judgment in high-stakes legal contexts.

2510.01796.tldr: This work proposes wide-narrow-wide (Hourglass) MLP blocks where skip connections operate at expanded dimensions while residual computation flows through narrow bottlenecks, which inversion leverages higher-dimensional spaces for incremental refinement while maintaining computational efficiency through parameter-matched designs.

2510.01815.tldr: This research proposes the design of a trustworthy co-learning model for human-AI teaming in military operations that encompasses a continuous and bidirectional exchange of insights between the human and AI agents as they jointly adapt to evolving battlefield conditions.

2510.01833.tldr: This work proposes Plan-Then-Action Enhanced Reasoning with Group Relative Policy Optimization PTA-GRPO, a two-stage framework designed to improve both high-level planning and fine-grained CoT reasoning, thereby enhancing reasoning effectiveness.

2510.01842.tldr: This paper explores the intersection of AutoML and pre-hoc model selection by leveraging traditional models and Large Language Model (LLM) agents to reduce the search space of AutoML libraries by relying on dataset descriptions and statistical information.

2510.01864.tldr: The Modular Consciousness Theory (MCT) proposes a biologically grounded and computationally explicit framework in which consciousness is a discrete sequence of Integrated Informational States (IISs), a packet of integrated information tagged with a multidimensional density vector that quantifies informational richness.

2510.01887.tldr: A curated financial dataset (FINCH) is introduced comprising 292 tables and 75,725 natural language-SQL pairs, enabling both fine-tuning and rigorous evaluation and proposes a finance-oriented evaluation metric (FINCH Score) that captures nuances overlooked by existing measures, offering a more faithful assessment of model performance.

2510.01889.tldr: This work conducts a systematic study of AI tasks, analyzing their popularity, model size, and efficiency, and examines how the maturity of different tasks and model adoption patterns impact the achievable energy savings, ranging from 1% to 98% for different tasks.

2510.01891.tldr: This paper proposes a novel transformer-based architecture for HRTF upsampling, leveraging the attention mechanism to better capture spatial correlations across the HRTF sphere, and introduces a neighbor dissimilarity loss that promotes magnitude smoothness, yielding more realistic upsampling.

2510.01902.tldr: This work presents Constrained Adaptive Rejection Sampling (CARS), an approach that strictly improves the sample-efficiency of RS without distributional distortion, and consistently achieves higher efficiency and stronger sample diversity than both GCD and methods that approximate the LM's distribution.

2510.01910.tldr: RoGRAD is the first iterative paradigm that leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation to inject retrieval-grounded augmentations by supplying class-consistent, diverse augmentations and enforcing discriminative representations through iterative graph contrastive learning.

2510.01924.tldr: It is empirically demonstrated that human-AI alignment in collective reasoning depends on context, cues, and model-specific inductive biases, and is critical to advancing socially-aligned AI.

2510.01934.tldr: This work observes that the anomaly amount in an image directly correlates with the difference in the learnt embeddings and utilizes this to design a few-shot anomaly detector termed FoundAD, which supports multi-class detection and achieves competitive performance while using substantially fewer parameters than prior methods.

2510.01967.tldr: The first to introduce ZK-WAGON, a novel system for watermarking image generation models using the Zero-Knowledge Succinct Non-Interactive Argument of Knowledge (ZK-SNARKs), which enables verifiable proof of origin without exposing model weights, generation prompts, or any sensitive internal information.

2510.01994.tldr: CLAST is proposed, a novel technique that systematically refines unit tests to improve their semantic clarity, thereby enhancing their utility as in-context examples and largely outperforms UTgen, the state-of-the-art refinement technique, in both preserving test effectiveness and enhancing semantic clarity.

2510.02027.tldr: A deterministic simulation framework is investigated that provides the first stable, evidence-based standard for evaluating AI-generated peer review reports, and repositions AI as an essential component of institutional accountability, providing the critical infrastructure to maintain trust in scholarly communication.

2510.02028.tldr: A 3D autoencoder architecture, named LiLa-Net, which encodes efficient features from real traffic environments, employing only the LiDAR's point clouds, and demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, successfully reconstructing objects unrelated to the original traffic environment.

2510.02036.tldr: It is argued that reducing the technical requirements to enter bounty programmes is important to include those without coding experience, and future efforts should explore the transferability of the best practices from bug bounties and examine how such programmes can be designed to be sensitive to underrepresented groups while lowering adoption barriers for organisations.

2510.02060.tldr: Results show that semantic context improves detection performance and enhances interpretability by supporting domain-aware reasoning, establishing ReTabAD as a benchmark for systematic exploration of context-aware AD.

2510.02100.tldr: This work systematically analyze the failure modes of point-based tracking in laparoscopic cholecystectomy videos and reveals key factors influencing tracking outcomes and provides several actionable recommendations for selecting and placing tracking points to improve performance in surgical video analysis.

2510.02108.tldr: This paper proposes an end-to-end deep learning framework with low inference complexity that leverages the structure of the optimal SLP solution in the closed-form and its inherent tensor equivariance (TE), where TE denotes that a permutation of the input induces the corresponding permutation of the output.

2510.02109.tldr: SpurBreast is introduced, a curated breast MRI dataset that intentionally incorporates spurious correlations to evaluate their impact on model performance, and two benchmark datasets without spurious correlations are provided, allowing researchers to systematically investigate clinically relevant and irrelevant features, uncertainty estimation, adversarial robustness, and generalization strategies.

2510.02128.tldr: An analysis of speculative decoding through the lens of its potential disparate speed-up rates across tasks shows that speed-up gained is not uniformly distributed across tasks, consistently diminishing for under-fit, and often underrepresented tasks.

2510.02133.tldr: FlexDoc is introduced, a scalable synthetic data generation framework that combines Stochastic Schemas and Parameterized Sampling to produce realistic, multilingual semi-structured documents with rich annotations that has accelerated the development of enterprise-grade document understanding models while significantly reducing data acquisition and annotation costs.

2510.02139.tldr: A platform of 38 MCP-converted bioinformatics tools, extensively validated to show that 94.7% successfully executed complex workflows across three widely used AI-agent platforms, offering a scalable path to intelligent, interoperable computational biology.

2510.02153.tldr: This study employs a multiphase mixed methods design integrating a behavioral experiment, thematic analysis, and follow-up quantitative testing to advance understanding of human-RA collaboration and provide actionable insights for designing more trustworthy and adaptive RA systems.

2510.02155.tldr: ASK-Hint is established as a new training-free and generalizable solution for explainable video anomaly detection, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared to both fine-tuned and training-free methods.

2510.02166.tldr: This work presents SIEVE, a community-driven framework that turns per-property checks into Confidence Cards-machine-readable, verifiable certificates with anytime-valid statistical bounds, expected to lower quality-assurance costs and increase trust in code-datasets.

2510.02171.tldr: The witheFlow system is introduced, designed to enhance real-time music performance by automatically modulating audio effects based on features extracted from both biosignals and the audio itself.

2510.02181.tldr: EvolveCaptions is a real-time, collaborative ASR adaptation system that supports in-situ personalization with minimal effort and reduced Word Error Rate across all DHH users within one hour of use, using only five minutes of recording time on average.

2510.02194.tldr: This work proposes UpSafe, a unified framework for enhancing LLM safety through safety-aware upcycling, and introduces a safety temperature mechanism, allowing dynamic adjustment of the trade-off between safety and utility.

2510.02200.tldr: A generalized method based on SPINACH, an LLM backed agent that translates natural language questions to SPARQL queries not in a single shot, but as an iterative process of exploration and execution is introduced.

2510.02202.tldr: This work leveraged several datasets with labels from patient reports and serological testing to support model robustness and generalizability to unseen data sources, and applied an evaluation metric that captured the local serological testing capacity for Chagas disease to frame the machine learning problem as a triage task.

2510.02230.tldr: This paper investigates the shrinkage issue of RLVR by analyzing its learning dynamics and reveals two critical phenomena that explain this failure, and proposes a simple yet effective data curation algorithm that focuses RLVR learning on low-likelihood problems, achieving notable improvement in Pass@k$ performance.

2510.02245.tldr: This paper is the first to investigate what makes a reasoning experience valuable and identify rollout correctness and entropy as effective indicators of experience value and proposes ExGRPO (Experiential Group Relative Policy Optimization), a framework that organizes and prioritizes valuable experiences, and employs a mixed-policy objective to balance exploration with experience exploitation.

2510.02249.tldr: A novel metric Token Entropy Cumulative Average (TECA) is introduced, which measures the extent of exploration throughout the reasoning process and leverages TECA to help the model dynamically determine the optimal point to conclude its thought process and provide a final answer, thus achieving efficient reasoning.

2510.02263.tldr: This work introduces reasoning abstractions: concise natural language descriptions of procedural and factual knowledge that guide the model toward learning successful reasoning, and shows that allocating more test-time compute to generating abstractions is more beneficial for performance than generating more solutions at large test budgets, illustrating the role of abstractions in guiding meaningful exploration.

2510.02264.tldr: This study clarifies where off-the-shelf video models already provide clinically promising kinematics in healthy adults and where they lag behind IMU-based estimates while establishing valuable guidelines for researchers and clinicians seeking to develop robust, cost-effective, and user-friendly solutions for telehealth and remote patient monitoring.

2510.02265.tldr: Through different reward functions and action sets, the results show that RL can adapt rapidly to spectrum dynamics and sustain high rates as channels and jamming policies change over time.

2510.02270.tldr: A two-headed LLM-derived classifier is introduced: a frozen classifier that, via multi-view alignment, provides a stable text-based prior for pseudo-labeling, and a learnable classifier initialized from LLM descriptions and fine-tuned with TokenFusion.

2510.02272.tldr: This study proposes a novel cross-linguistic perspective to investigate reasoning generalization and challenges the assumption that LRM reasoning mirrors human cognition, providing critical insights for the development of more language-agnostic LRMs.

2510.02283.tldr: This paper proposes a simple yet effective approach to mitigate quality degradation in long-horizon video generation without requiring supervision from long-video teachers or retraining on long video datasets, and substantially outperforms baseline methods in both fidelity and consistency.

2510.02286.tldr: DialTree is proposed, an on-policy reinforcement learning framework integrated with tree search that autonomously discovers diverse multi-turn attack strategies by treating the dialogue as a sequential decision-making problem, enabling systematic exploration without manually curated data.

2510.02294.tldr: F2LLM is introduced, a suite of state-of-the-art embedding models in three sizes: 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, striking a strong balance between training cost, model size, and embedding performance.

2510.02297.tldr: This paper introduces Interactive Training, an open-source framework that enables real-time, feedback-driven intervention during neural network training by human experts or automated AI agents, and achieves superior training stability, reduced sensitivity to initial hyperparameters, and improved adaptability to evolving user needs.

2510.02305.tldr: The theoretical and empirical results confirm that smoothing the score function -- or equivalently, smoothing in the log-density domain -- produces smoothing tangential to the data manifold, and show that the manifold along which the diffusion model generalises can be controlled by choosing an appropriate smoothing.

2510.02307.tldr: NoiseShift is proposed, a training-free method that recalibrates the noise level of the denoiser conditioned on resolution size that is compatible with existing models and demonstrates the effectiveness of NoiseShift in mitigating resolution-dependent artifacts and enhancing the quality of low-resolution image generation.

2505.17121.tldr: The proposed NeSyGeo, a novel neuro-symbolic framework for generating geometric reasoning data, proposes a domain-specific language grounded in the entity-attributes-relations paradigm to comprehensively represent all components of plane geometry, along with generative actions defined within this symbolic space.

2509.17153.tldr: In a comprehensive empirical study spanning regression, image classification, semantic segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection benchmarks, FiD-GP cuts Bayesian training cost by several orders of magnitude, compresses parameters by roughly 51%, reduces model size by about 75%, and matches state-of-the-art accuracy and uncertainty estimation.

2510.00186.tldr: Thinkquel, a fine-tuned model for producing robust, portable, and execution-validated database queries, and Token-Sequence GRPO, specifically designed to bridge the gap between token-level training signals and sequence-level execution rewards when finetuning LLMs are introduced.

2510.02386.tldr: Model developers could easily contaminate LRMs to achieve inflated leaderboards performance while leaving minimal traces of contamination, thereby strongly undermining the fairness of evaluation and threatening the integrity of public leaderboards, highlighting the urgent need for advanced contamination detection methods and trustworthy evaluation protocols tailored to LRMs.

2510.02401.tldr: This work pushes the boundaries of linear RNNs applied to raw audio modeling, investigating the effects of different architectural choices and using context-parallelism to enable training on sequences up to one minute (1M tokens) in length.

2510.02403.tldr: An explainable multimodal large language model that screens optic nerve head OCT circle scans for quality and generates structured clinical reports that include glaucoma diagnosis and sector-wise retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) thinning assessments shows potential as a scalable tool for clinical decision support.

2510.02407.tldr: This study uses deep learning models such as convolutional long short-term memory (Conv-LSTM) and bidirectional long short-term memory (BD-LSTM) networks for multistep ahead prediction featuring extremes, and investigates which data augmentation models are the most suitable, taking into account the prediction accuracy overall and at extreme regions.

2510.02416.tldr: This study presents a DNA methylation-based, cross-platform machine learning classifier capable of distinguishing these subtypes on both HM450 and EPIC methylation array samples, and has the potential to become the first publicly available classifier for these subtypes once deployed through a web application, as planned in the future.

2510.02417.tldr: By unifying theory, workflow, and simulation into one pipeline, NeuroDNAAI enables scalable, biologically valid archival DNA storage and shows that traditional prompting or rule-based schemes fail to adapt effectively to realistic noise, whereas NeuroDNAAI achieves superior accuracy.

2510.02423.tldr: RefineShot is a refined and expanded benchmark that enables more reliable assessment and fosters future advances in cinematography understanding, and introduces an extended evaluation protocol that jointly assesses task accuracy and core model competencies.

2510.02469.tldr: SIMSplat is presented, a predictive driving scene editor with language-aligned Gaussian splatting that enables intuitive manipulation using natural language prompts and provides detailed object-level editing, including adding new objects and modifying the trajectories of both vehicles and pedestrians.

2510.02483.tldr: Litespark is introduced, a novel pre-training framework that addresses inefficiencies through targeted optimizations to transformer attention and MLP layers, enabling broad applicability across transformer architectures and extending to post-training phases including supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization.

2510.02484.tldr: Action-Controllable Factorization (ACF), a contrastive learning approach that uncovers independently controllable latent variables -- state components each action can influence separately, is presented.

2311.13254.tldr: A Quad-directional Mixup (QuadMix) method is proposed, characterized by tackling intra-domain discontinuity, fragmented gap bridging, and feature inconsistencies through four-directional paths designed for intra- and inter-domain mixing within an explicit feature space to deal with temporal shifts within videos.

2405.18406.tldr: RACCooN suggests a multi-granular spatiotemporal pooling strategy to generate well-structured video descriptions, capturing both the broad context and object details without requiring complex human annotations, simplifying precise video content editing based on text for users.

2406.03508.tldr: MIMIC uses the potentially backdoored encoder as the teacher network and applies knowledge distillation to create a clean student encoder from it, aiming to mitigate backdoors and maintain encoder performance at the same time.

2406.07714.tldr: This paper uses the pre-trained knowledge of LLM about data conversion and format to generate new valid inputs to enhance greybox fuzzing for structured data and fine-tuned it with paired mutation seeds to learn structured format and mutation strategies effectively.

2406.08534.tldr: This paper proposes the Quay Crane Dual Cycle - Dockyard Rehandle Genetic Algorithm (QCDC-DR-GA), a hybrid Genetic Algorithm (GA) that holistically optimizes both aspects: maximizing the number of Dual Cycles (DCs) and minimizing the number of dockyard rehandles.

2406.15676.tldr: A novel representation is proposed, NaP-AST, that encodes minimal dataflow hints for the effective inference of type qualifiers, and it is discovered that GTN shows the best performance, with a recall of .89 and precision of 0.6.

2406.16151.tldr: The Structurally Decomposed MDP (SD-MDP) is introduced, which leverages causal disentanglement to partition an MDP's temporal causal graph into independent components and enables dimensionality reduction and computational efficiency gains in optimal value function estimation.

2411.03887.tldr: This work introduces OML(Open-access, Monetizable, and Loyal AI Model Serving), a primitive that enables a new distribution paradigm where models can be freely distributed for local execution while maintaining cryptographically enforced usage authorization.

2501.07186.tldr: A heterogeneous graph representation is proposed that resolves the busbar information asymmetry problem inherent to the popular homogeneous graph representation and is applied to GNNs with both representations and a fully connected neural network baseline on an imitation learning task.

2502.00415.tldr: A significant improvement in fundamental analysis accuracy over the previous version of MarketSenseAI is demonstrated, offering insights into the robustness of LLM-driven investment strategies.

2502.11191.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive suite of datasets covering all major training stages, including pretraining, instruction fine-tuning, and reasoning distillation with cybersecurity-specific self-reflection data, and demonstrates their effectiveness on public cybersecurity benchmarks.

2502.14837.tldr: This paper proposes the first data-efficient fine-tuning method for transitioning from MHA to MLA (MHA2MLA), which includes two key components: for partial-RoPE, it removes RoPE from dimensions of queries and keys that contribute less to the attention scores, and for low-rank approximation, it introduces joint SVD approximations based on the pre-trained parameters of keys and values.

2502.17537.tldr: This work first investigates the fundamental sources of adversarial vulnerability and reveals that vulnerabilities are pervasive in the prompt embedding space of concept-erased models, a characteristic inherited from the original pre-unlearned model.

2503.04697.tldr: This work uses LCPO to train L1, a reasoning language model that produces outputs satisfying a length constraint given in its prompt, and derives Short Reasoning Models (SRMs), that exhibit similar reasoning patterns as full-length reasoning models, but can generate CoT lengths comparable to non-reasoning models.

2503.07044.tldr: Inspired by how human data scientists work in computational notebooks, DatawiseAgent introduces a unified interaction representation and a multi-stage architecture based on finite-state transducers (FSTs) that enables flexible long-horizon planning, progressive solution development, and robust recovery from execution failures.

2503.09008.tldr: This work introduces City-Networks, a novel large-scale transductive learning dataset derived from real-world city road networks, and proposes a model-agnostic measurement based on the Jacobians of neighbors from distant hops, offering a principled quantification of long-range dependencies.

2503.13445.tldr: This work analyzes counterfactual faithfulness across 75 models from 13 families and motivates two new metrics: the phi-CCT, a simplified variant of the Correlational Counterfactual Test which avoids the need for token probabilities while explaining most of the variance of the original test; and F-AUROC, which eliminates sensitivity to imbalanced intervention distributions and captures a model's ability to produce explanations with different levels of detail.

2503.21718.tldr: It is concluded that outlier dimensions are a specialized mechanism discovered by many distinct models to implement a useful token prediction heuristic.

2504.00907.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach that fine-tunes multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) as vision-language-action (VLA) policies using online reinforcement learning (RL) with LLM-generated rewards with online RL, and presents the first demonstration of adapting MLLMs as VLA agents that can act and ask for help using LLM-generated rewards with online RL.

2504.12397.tldr: Activated LoRA (aLoRA), an adapter architecture which modifies the LoRA framework to only adapt weights for the tokens in the sequence after the aLoRA is invoked, is proposed, and a set of aLoRA-based intrinsics models are trained, demonstrating competitive accuracy with standard LoRA while significantly improving inference efficiency.

2504.20629.tldr: AlignDiT is proposed, a multimodal Aligned Diffusion Transformer that generates accurate, synchronized, and natural-sounding speech from aligned multimodal inputs that significantly outperforms existing methods across multiple benchmarks in terms of quality, synchronization, and speaker similarity.

2505.01476.tldr: A cost volume filtering network is proposed, guided by the input observation as an attention query across multiple feature layers, which effectively suppresses matching noise while preserving edge structures and capturing subtle anomalies in unsupervised anomaly detection.

2505.05522.tldr: The Continuous Thought Machine is presented, a model designed to leverage neural dynamics as its core representation and aims to strike a balance between neuron abstractions and biological realism, which represents a significant step toward developing more biologically plausible and powerful artificial intelligence systems.

2505.08694.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the state-of-the-art techniques leveraging deep neural networks for processing complex spectrograms, which encapsulate both magnitude and phase information.

2505.09901.tldr: This work uses interpretable choice models to capture the E&E strategies of the agents and investigates how enabling thinking traces, through both prompting strategies and thinking models, shapes LLM decision-making, finding that enabling thinking in LLMs shifts their behavior toward more human-like behavior.

2505.11669.tldr: The Optimal Transport (OT) score is introduced, a confidence metric derived from a novel theoretical analysis that exploits the flexibility of decision boundaries induced by Semi-Discrete Optimal Transport alignment and provides principled uncertainty estimates for any given set of target pseudo-labels.

2505.15962.tldr: This work introduces Limited Memory Language Models (LMLM), a new class of language models that externalizes factual knowledge to external database during pre-training rather than memorizing them, thereby teaching the model to perform targeted lookups rather than relying on memorization in model weights.

2505.17568.tldr: This paper presents JALMBench, a comprehensive benchmark to assess the safety of ALMs against jailbreak attacks, and provides an in-depth analysis of attack efficiency, topic sensitivity, voice diversity, and architecture.

2505.22798.tldr: This work presents novel algorithmic extensions to PREMAP involving tighter bounds, adaptive Monte Carlo sampling, and improved branching heuristics that significantly outperform the original PREMAP and enable scaling to convolutional neural networks that were previously intractable.

2505.22860.tldr: This work proposes Permissioned LLMs (PermLLM), a new class of LLMs that superimpose the organizational data access control structures on query responses they generate, and introduces a novel metric, called access advantage, to empirically evaluate the efficacy of a PermLLM mechanism.

2506.00430.tldr: The results demonstrate that converging principles from human cognition provide architecture-general computational advantages, and generate testable behavioral predictions about working memory, inner speech, and memory consolidation.

2506.00771.tldr: The latent space of MolFLAE enables zero-shot molecule manipulation, including atom number editing, structure reconstruction, and coordinated latent interpolation for both structure and properties, and highlights the flexibility, robustness, and real-world utility of the method.

2506.02580.tldr: V2X-UniPool is proposed, the first framework that unifies V2X perception with language-based reasoning for knowledge-driven AD and achieves state-of-the-art planning accuracy and safety while reducing communication cost by more than 80\%, achieving the lowest overhead among evaluated methods.

2506.12113.tldr: A new preprocessing method is proposed which creates JSON reports for Portable Executable files to gather a semantic representation of binary files, understandable by malware analysts, and that can enhance AI models' explainability for malicious files analysis.

2506.12723.tldr: SP-VLA is a unified framework that accelerates VLA models by jointly scheduling models and pruning tokens and develops a spatio-semantic dual-aware token pruning method that reduces temporal redundancy by dynamically switching between VLA model and a lightweight generator.

2506.15655.tldr: This work proposes chunking via Abstract Syntax Trees (\ourwork), a structure-aware method that recursively breaks large AST nodes into smaller chunks and merges sibling nodes while respecting size limits, improving performance on diverse code generation tasks.

2506.18340.tldr: This work demonstrates that controlled generation can be implemented by way of end-to-end training of conditional generative models, or as a Bayesian inference problem, enabling post hoc control of unconditional models without retraining.

2506.22774.tldr: An assessment method that combines the ethical components of Trustworthy AI with the algorithmic processes of PageRank and TrustRank is introduced, to establish an assessment framework that minimizes the subjectivity inherent in the self-assessment techniques prevalent in the field by introducing algorithmic criteria.
