2508.07126.tldr: Pref-GUIDE is proposed, a framework that transforms real-time scalar feedback into preference-based data to improve reward model learning for continual policy training and offers a scalable and principled approach for harnessing human input in online reinforcement learning.

2508.08477.tldr: A GRASP-based metaheuristic that combines multiple construction heuristics with a multi-neighborhood local search is introduced, demonstrating its suitability for real-time routing applications with state-dependent travel costs.

2508.16625.tldr: This paper introduces VulGate, a high quality state of the art dataset that mitigates the shortcomings of prior datasets, by removing mislabeled and duplicate samples, updating new vulnerabilities, incorporating additional metadata, integrating hard samples, and including dedicated test sets to demonstrate that improved dataset diversity and quality substantially enhances vulnerability detection.

2508.19227.tldr: This work proposes Generative Interfaces for Language Models, a paradigm in which LLMs respond to user queries by proactively generating user interfaces that enable more adaptive and interactive engagement, and introduces a multidimensional assessment framework that compares generative interfaces with traditional chat-based ones.

2508.19258.tldr: The multimethod evidence documents an unrecognized mechanism of behavioral influence in AI mediated brand relationships, offering marketers and regulators a framework for distinguishing persuasive design from manipulation at the point of exit.

2508.19317.tldr: The findings reveal that a structured moral psychology underlies public evaluation of new technologies, offering a powerful tool for anticipating public resistance and guiding responsible innovation in AI.

2508.20144.tldr: A high-level technical assessment of the foreseeable challenges that manufacturers are likely to encounter when qualifying DL-based automated inspections—specifically static models—within the existing medical device compliance landscape is presented.

2509.03525.tldr: It is highlighted that model adaptation strategies, including demonstration selection, reasoning design, and tuning method, critically influence speech-based dementia detection, and that properly adapted open-weight models can match or exceed commercial systems.

2509.09387.tldr: This work proposes MetaLLMiX, a zero-shot hyperparameter optimization framework combining meta-learning, explainable AI, and efficient LLM reasoning, which achieves competitive or superior performance to traditional HPO methods while drastically reducing computational cost.

2509.09495.tldr: OpenFake is presented, a large politically grounded dataset specifically crafted for benchmarking against modern generative models with high realism, and designed to remain extensible through an innovative crowdsourced adversarial platform that continually integrates new hard examples.

2509.12543.tldr: This work introduces a structured framework that combines automated components with human oversight to address the complexities of advertisement localization, the first work to integrate scene text detection, inpainting, machine translation (MT), and text reimposition specifically for accelerating ad localization evaluation workflows.

2509.14252.tldr: LLM-JEPA is proposed, a JEPA based solution for LLMs applicable both to finetuning and pretraining that is able to outperform the standard LLM training objectives by a significant margin across models, all while being robust to overfiting.

2509.18424.tldr: This study introduces the Scattering Transformer, a novel, training-free transformer architecture for heart murmur detection that leverages standard wavelet scattering networks by introducing contextual dependencies in a transformer-like architecture without any backpropagation.

2509.19947.tldr: A set of components to significantly improve both stealthiness and ASR based on the commonalities of attacks is proposed, including Component B, which is proposed to select samples with similarities to relevant trigger implanted samples to promote stealthiness.

2509.23058.tldr: This work proposes a new pipeline for eliciting, steering, and modulating LLMs' risk profiles, drawing on tools from behavioral economics and finance and demonstrates how post-training modulates these profiles, laying the groundwork for future research on behavioral alignment and risk-aware LLM design.

2509.23250.tldr: This work aims to elucidate the design space of VL-PRMs by exploring diverse strategies for dataset construction, training, and test-time scaling, and proposes perception-focused supervision, enabling the PRM to explicitly detect errors at the visual grounding stage of reasoning.

2509.25203.tldr: OpenCodeEdit is introduced, an open-source pipeline that leverages multiple LLMs to synthesize realistic code-edit triplets and achieves performance close to closed-source systems, narrowing the gap to GPT-4 to just 3.54%, without relying on proprietary resources or manual annotation.

2509.25834.tldr: Insight is provided into how musical AI can support rather than replace human creativity, highlighting the importance of designing tools that preserve the humanness of musical expression.

2510.00048.tldr: A hybrid deep learning ensemble framework for Alzheimer’s disease classification using structural magnetic resonance imaging achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and the framework’s potential for robust and scalable clinical decision support in neurodegenerative disease diagnostics is highlighted.

2510.00355.tldr: This work reviews this class of models, examines key design choices, test alternative variants and clarify common misconceptions, and introduces a novel type of recurrent reasoning in the latent space of transformers, achieving remarkable performance on a wide range of 2D reasoning tasks.

2510.01367.tldr: This work proposes TRACE (Truncated Reasoning AUC Evaluation), a scalable unsupervised approach for oversight where current monitoring methods prove ineffective, and shows that TRACE can discover unknown loopholes during training.

2510.02418.tldr: BrowserArena is introduced, a live open-web agent evaluation platform that collects user-submitted tasks, runs Arena-style head-to-head comparisons, and uses step-level human feedback to surface failure modes, and identifies three consistent failure modes: captcha resolution, pop-up banner removal and direct navigation to URLs.

2510.03413.tldr: A vision of next-generation ecosystems for scientific computing where AI, software, hardware, and human expertise are interwoven to drive discovery, expand access, strengthen the workforce, and accelerate scientific progress is presented.

2510.03415.tldr: Across strong code/reasoning LLMs, performance drops under nonstandard semantics despite high performance under the standard one, and the results show a promise that LLMs could serve as programming language interpreters, but points to the lack of their robust semantics understanding.

2510.04093.tldr: Experimental results on three publicly available web-based educational platform datasets demonstrate that the DLLM achieves optimal predictive performance across varying noise levels, which demonstrates that DLLM achieves noise robustness while effectively leveraging semantic knowledge from LLM.

2510.04952.tldr: A cross-market algorithmic trading system that balances execution quality with rigorous compliance enforcement and sitsuate the work at the intersection of optimal execution, safe reinforcement learning, regulatory technology, and verifiable AI, and discusses ethical considerations, limitations, and paths to real-world deployment.

2510.04956.tldr: MuFFIN, a Multi-Faceted pronunciation Feedback model with an Interactive hierarchical Neural architecture, is introduced to jointly address the tasks of MDD and APA, to better capture the nuanced distinctions between phonemes in the feature space and address the intricate data imbalance problem in MDD.

2510.05016.tldr: Five state-of-the-art LLMs on the International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics (IOAA) exams are systematically benchmarked to examine deep conceptual understanding, multi-step derivations, and multimodal analysis.

2510.05123.tldr: A cognitive digital twin framework that combines real-time EEG signals from a wearable skullcap with structural MRI data for dynamic and personalized tumor monitoring and paves the way for future advancements in intelligent brain health monitoring is proposed.

2510.05127.tldr: The results demonstrate the potential of AI-driven prediction for cost-aware autoscaling in cloud environments, reducing unnecessary provisioning while safeguarding service quality.

2510.05131.tldr: This work proposes a pragmatic hybrid semantic search system that synergistically combines lightweight typo-tolerant lexical retrieval, embedding-based vector similarity, and constrained large language model (LLM) re-ranking that leverages the organization's existing Task Repository and Knowledge Base infrastructure while ensuring trustworthiness.

2510.05136.tldr: This survey paper categorizes the existing works along several dimensions, including the levels of linguistic description, the models included, the genres analyzed, the languages analyzed, and the approach to prompting, and presents the findings made so far and exposes the current trends followed by researchers.

2510.05144.tldr: SynCED-EnDe is presented, a new resource consisting of 1,000 gold-labeled and 8,000 silver-labeled sentence pairs, balanced 50/50 between error and non-error cases, to advance safe deployment of MT in information retrieval and conversational assistants, particularly in emerging contexts such as wearable AI devices.

2510.05145.tldr: ParallelResearch is introduced, a novel framework for efficient deep research that transforms sequential processing into parallel, runtime orchestration by dynamically decomposing complex queries into tree-structured sub-tasks and enables concurrency across both research breadth and depth.

2510.05148.tldr: This work shows that the decoding mechanism of dLLMs not only enhances model utility but also can be used as a powerful tool for model attribution, and proposes a novel information extraction scheme called the Directed Decoding Map (DDM), which captures structural relationships between decoding steps and better reveals model-specific behaviors.

2510.05149.tldr: Percepta is presented, a lightweight Data Stream Processing (DSP) system tailored to support AI workloads at the edge, with a particular focus on such as Reinforcement Learning (RL).

2510.05152.tldr: It is found that good-performing delimiters steer attention towards key tokens in the input and specifying the selected delimiter in the prompt boosts robustness and offers practical recommendations for the best-performing delimiters to select.

2510.05153.tldr: This paper provides a definitive, unifying framework for the Symbol Grounding Problem by reformulating it within Algorithmic Information Theory (AIT), and establishes that meaning is the open-ended process of a system perpetually attempting to overcome its own information-theoretic limitations.

2510.05156.tldr: VeriGuard is introduced, a novel framework that provides formal safety guarantees for LLM-based agents through a dual-stage architecture designed for robust and verifiable correctness, providing a robust safeguard that substantially improves the trustworthiness of LLM agents.

2510.05157.tldr: A controlled study of adversarial reinforcement learning in network security through a custom OpenAI Gym environment that models brute-force attacks and reactive defenses on multi-port services and reveals that reward shaping and careful training scheduling are critical for learning stability in this adversarial setting.

2510.05158.tldr: Lang-PINN is presented, an LLM-driven multi-agent system that builds trainable PINNs directly from natural language task descriptions that achieves substantially lower errors and greater robustness than competitive baselines.

2510.05160.tldr: A framework based on a Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE) that learns a probabilistic mapping between a system's design parameters and its performance, enabling the generation of a diverse portfolio of high-performing candidates conditioned on a specific performance objective is introduced.

2510.05163.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive synthesis of recent work at the intersection of deep learning, biometrics, and smart card technologies for MFA, providing a roadmap for designing secure, scalable, and user-friendly authentication frameworks.

2510.05164.tldr: SATER is introduced, a dual-mode compatible approach that fine-tunes models through shortest-response preference optimization and a confidence-aware rejection mechanism that significantly reduces redundant outputs and response times, while improving both the performance of pre-generation routing and the efficiency of cascade routing.

2510.05165.tldr: A theoretically-grounded domain-adapted Granger causality framework that integrates statistical causal inference with network-specific resource modeling for real-time attack attribution is proposed that addresses key limitations of existing methods by incorporating resource contention dynamics and providing formal statistical guarantees.

2510.05169.tldr: This work proposes a novel post-training framework that cultivates self-awareness of backdoor risks and enables models to articulate implanted triggers even when they are absent from the prompt, and presents two complementary defense strategies for mitigating and detecting backdoor threats.

2510.05174.tldr: An information-theoretic framework is introduced to test -- in a purely data-driven way -- whether multi-agent LLM systems show signs of higher-order structure and establishes that multi-agent LLM systems can be steered with prompt design from mere aggregates to higher-order collectives.

2510.05181.tldr: An auditing framework is developed that enables a trusted third-party auditor who sequentially queries a provider to detect token misreporting and is guaranteed to always detect token misreporting, regardless of the provider's (mis-)reporting policy.

2510.05184.tldr: The evidence suggests that foundation models often exhibit structural regularities and semantic consistencies in their representation spaces, positioning them as strong candidates for cross-modal transfer and alignment.

2510.05186.tldr: This work forms scheduling as a constrained optimization problem that jointly accounts for memory capacity, activation reuse, and pipeline bubble minimization, and yields fine-grained schedules that reduce pipeline bubbles while adhering to strict memory budgets.

2510.05187.tldr: This framework provides a robust solution for managing IoT data, ensuring semantic completeness, and enabling real-time knowledge inference, and the integration of uncertainty reasoning methods and semantic interoperability techniques makes this framework a valuable tool for advancing IoT applications in general and in agriculture in particular.

2510.05188.tldr: Dramaturge is a task and feature oriented divide-and-conquer approach powered by hierarchical multiple LLM agents that significantly outperforms all baselines in terms of script-level overall quality and scene-level details.

2510.05189.tldr: This work introduces a novel methodology for the automatic detection of hallucinations generated during large language model (LLM) inference based on a systematic taxonomy and controlled reproduction of diverse hallucination types through prompt engineering offering a lightweight yet effective framework for improving model reliability.

2510.05192.tldr: The main finding is that an externally governed escalation channel, which guarantees a pause and independent review, reduces blackmail rates from a no-mitigation baseline of 38.73% to 1.21% (averaged across all models and conditions).

2510.05196.tldr: A novel graph-based reasoning framework that integrates large language models with structured demographic attributes and unstructured public feedback in a weakly supervised pipeline is proposed, enabling population-specific analyses based on key features such as age, gender, and the Index of Multiple Deprivation.

2510.05197.tldr: This work finds that standard methods for fitting laws suffer from statistical shortcomings that hinder predictive accuracy, especially in data-limited scenarios, and introduces a robust estimation framework, which uses a beta-binomial distribution to generate more accurate predictions from limited data.

2510.05213.tldr: VER is proposed, a Vision Expert transformer for Robot learning that reduces large-norm outliers in task-irrelevant regions and concentrates on task-critical regions, and supports parameter-efficient finetuning for scalable expert utilization and adaptive robot-domain knowledge integration.

2510.05218.tldr: The general 13-parameter permutation invariant Gaussian matrix models are found to be effective models for the correlated Gaussianity in the weight matrices, beyond the range of applicability of the simple Gaussian with independent identically distributed matrix variables, and notably well beyond the initialisation step.

2510.05283.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid reward modeling framework that integrates complementary reward paradigms: model-based rewards, where a learned reward model predicts scalar or vector scores from synthetic and human feedback, and rule-based rewards, where domain-specific heuristics provide explicit correctness signals with confidence.

2510.05285.tldr: Action Gradient (AG) is proposed, an innovative methodology that directly adjusts actions to fulfill a function analogous to that of PG, while also facilitating efficient integration with token prediction techniques and utilizes the gradient of the Q-value with respect to the action to optimize the action.

2510.05288.tldr: This work introduces adaptable gradient clipping along with other engineering enhancements to the standard DP-Adam optimizer to create DP-Adam-AC, and uses this optimizer to fine-tune examples of two localizable LLM designs, small language model and 1.58 bit quantization.

2510.05310.tldr: It is confirmed that inserting benign documents into the guardrail context alters the judgments of input and output guardrails in around 11% and 8% of cases, making them unreliable.

2510.05315.tldr: This work introduces a novel automated microscopic system powered by DeepAf, a novel auto-focus framework that uniquely combines spatial and spectral features through a hybrid architecture for single-shot focus prediction that results in a comprehensive hardware-software design enabling accessible, real-time digital pathology in resource-constrained settings while maintaining diagnostic accuracy.

2510.05325.tldr: The temporal dynamics of the identified brain regions are investigated, demonstrating that the time-dependent structure of fMRI signals are essential for shaping functional connectivity between regions: uncorrelated areas are least important for classification.

2510.05327.tldr: DeepV is introduced: a model-agnostic RAG framework to generate RTL designs by enhancing context through a large, high-quality dataset without any RTL-specific training.

2510.05335.tldr: Evaluation of M-Reason demonstrates substantial gains in efficiency and output consistency, highlighting M-Reason's potential as both a practical tool for evidence synthesis and a testbed for robust multi-agent LLM systems in scientific research.

2510.05338.tldr: It is argued for standardized benchmarks, ablation studies, and transparent reporting to rigorously determine the effectiveness of Bayesian techniques for MPC.

2510.05342.tldr: This work introduces Margin-Adaptive Direct Preference Optimization (MADPO), a method that provides a stable, data-preserving, and instance-level solution that has a well-behaved optimization landscape and is robust to reward model estimation errors.

2510.05361.tldr: MT-DAO, a family of optimizers that employs multiple slow- and fast-moving first momenta or the gradient to track update dynamics across different time scales, for which the first convergence guarantees are provided, enables effective cross-datacenter training and training over wide geographic areas.

2510.05363.tldr: Multi-Head Attention Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MHA-RAG), a framework with the number of attention heads serving as a simple hyperparameter to control soft prompt-generation across different tasks, achieves a 20-point performance gain over standard RAG, while cutting inference costs by a factor of 10X GFLOPs.

2510.05378.tldr: Investigating how humans and AI interact with symbols and co-construct their meanings reveals that shared understanding emerges not from agreement but from the reciprocal exchange and reinterpretation of symbols, suggesting new paradigms for human-AI interaction design.

2510.05381.tldr: The findings reveal a previously-unrealized limitation: the sheer length of the input alone can hurt LLM performance, independent of retrieval quality and without any distraction.

2510.05399.tldr: Deep learning sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) models based on Long Short-Term Memory networks are explored to predict 24-hour proton flux profiles following SPE onsets, finding that architectural choices can sometimes outweigh the benefits of data preprocessing.

2510.05408.tldr: This work proposes a time-reversed reconstruction framework that uses paired RGB and thermal images to recover scene states from a few seconds earlier, providing a first step toward time-reversed imaging from thermal traces.

2510.05417.tldr: This work explored how undergraduate programming novices choose and work with multimodal GenAI tools, and their criteria for choices, and investigated student modality choices for GenAI tools when completing programming problems and the underlying criteria for modality selections.

2510.05432.tldr: AInstein is introduced, a framework for testing whether LLMs can generate valid solutions to AI research problems using only their pretrained parametric knowledge -- without domain-specific fine-tuning, retrieval augmentation, or other external aids.

2510.05433.tldr: Three main classes of PIML frameworks are reviewed: physics-informed neural networks, neural ordinary differential equations (NODEs), and neural operators (NOs), highlighting their growing role in biomedical science and engineering.

2510.05442.tldr: This work proposes Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Agent Safety (ARLAS), a novel framework that leverages adversarial reinforcement learning (RL) by formulating the problem as a two-player zero-sum game and confirms that the adversarial process generates a diverse and challenging set of attacks, leading to a more robust agent compared to the base model.

2510.05451.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid neuro-symbolic framework that integrates Answer Set Programming (ASP) with transformer-based learning on the Aviation Safety Reporting System (ASRS) corpus and achieves up to an 86% reduction in rule violations on the ASRS test set.

2510.05453.tldr: The results show that the proposed Quantile DeepGR4J framework improves the predictive accuracy and uncertainty interval quality compared to baseline deep learning models, and the results demonstrate its suitability as an early warning system.

2510.05457.tldr: It is revealed that AI models mirror human patterns of overconfidence, especially in unfamiliar or low-resource domains, and that less competent models and those operating in rare programming languages exhibit stronger DKE-like bias.

2510.05468.tldr: Parameter-efficient Split Learning is implemented, which effectively balances efficiency and performance for collaborative training on low-resource devices and Adaptive Mixed bit Activation Quantization (AMAQ), a strategy that progressively compresses activations and gradients from high precision to low precision, is introduced.

2510.05480.tldr: This work proposes to model the vulnerability repair task from a reasoning perspective and train a reasoning LLM termed Vulnerability Reasoner and Repair (Vul-R2), which consists of two key modules: a domain-aware reasoning learning module, and a curriculum-based verifiable rewarded training module.

2510.05490.tldr: LANTERN, a novel LLM knowledge distillation framework tailored specifically for job person fit tasks, is introduced and extensive experimental results demonstrate that LANTERN significantly improves task specific metrics for both job person fit and explanation.

2510.05520.tldr: CAM is a prototype implementation of Constructivist Agentic Memory that simultaneously embodies the structurality, flexibility, and dynamicity of agentic memory, and demonstrates dual advantages in both performance and efficiency across diverse long-text reading comprehension tasks.

2510.05538.tldr: This work attempted to separate MLLMs'visual capabilities from their pedagogical abilities by first asking them to grade the student illustrations directly, and then by augmenting the image with a detailed human description of the illustration, finding that when the models had to analyze the student illustrations directly, they struggled.

2510.05548.tldr: This research provides an accurate decade-long emission projection that will assist policymakers in making more data-driven decisions.

2510.05554.tldr: This work identifies the critical scaling of $\beta_n \asymp \log n$ and provides a rigorous justification for attention scaling in YaRN and Qwen, clarifying why logarithmic scaling maintains sparse, content-adaptive attention at large context lengths.

2510.05562.tldr: A novel framework called the Generative Dynamic Graph Model (GDGM), which models dynamic trading behaviors and the relationships among nodes to learn representations for conspiracy spoofing detection, is proposed, which outperforms state-of-the-art models in detection accuracy.

2510.05566.tldr: This work proposes a new framework called Domain-Shift-Aware Conformal Prediction (DS-CP), which adapts conformal prediction to large language models under domain shift, by systematically reweighting calibration samples based on their proximity to the test prompt, thereby preserving validity while enhancing adaptivity.

2510.05592.tldr: AgentFlow is introduced, a trainable, in-the-flow agentic framework that coordinates four modules (planner, executor, verifier, generator) through an evolving memory and directly optimizes its planner inside the multi-turn loop, showing improved planning, enhanced tool-calling reliability, and positive scaling with model size and reasoning turns.

2510.05593.tldr: Qualitative analysis shows that the ShortCoTI method eliminates verbose explanations and repetitive refinements, producing reasoning prompts that are both concise and semantically rich, and improves computational efficiency without compromising the fidelity or visual appeal of generated images.

2510.05596.tldr: This paper proposes a multi-agent cooperative self-evolving agentic AI framework, where multiple large language models are assigned role-specialized prompts under the coordination of a supervisor agent and autonomously executes the entire life cycle without human intervention.

2510.05605.tldr: A novel LLM agent-based framework, AutoPentester, which automates the pentesting process using common security tools in an iterative process and requires significantly fewer human interactions and interventions compared to PentestGPT.

2510.05625.tldr: A GenAI-driven hierarchical multi-agent framework designed to streamline multi-task autonomous execution for zero-touch optical networks is proposed and provides a promising approach for the future development of intelligent, efficient, and collaborative network management solutions.

2510.05633.tldr: This work proposes a strategy to remove spectral peaks from images and introduces a simple linear detector that relies exclusively on frequency peaks, providing a fully interpretable baseline free from the confounding influence of deep learning.

2510.05637.tldr: A biologically grounded approach to reservoir computing (RC), in which a network of cultured biological neurons serves as the reservoir substrate, indicates that the biological reservoir can effectively support classification, highlighting its potential as a viable and interpretable computational substrate.

2510.05644.tldr: The African Languages Lab (All Lab) is presented, a comprehensive research initiative that addresses this technological gap through systematic data collection, model development, and capacity building and reveals competitive performance in several languages while identifying areas that require continued development.

2510.05649.tldr: The effectiveness of both frameworks for automated diagnosis and recovery from missing data in clinical settings are confirmed, with evaluation on the PoseGaze-AHP dataset demonstrating robust diagnostic performance.

2510.05664.tldr: GPT-4o extracted labels from radiologic reports to train competitive multi-label classification models with high accuracy, and multi-label classifiers for clavicle, elbow, and thumb radiographs performed consistently regardless of how uncertainty was handled.

2510.05678.tldr: This work introduces code-switching in-context learning (CSICL), a simple yet effective prompting strategy that progressively transitions from a target language to English within demonstrations and instruction to facilitate their latent reasoning in English.

2510.05681.tldr: This work proposes Masking Distribution Guided Selection (MG-Select), a novel test-time scaling framework for VLAs that leverages the model's internal properties without requiring additional training or external modules, and introduces a reference distribution generated by the same VLA but with randomly masked states and language conditions as inputs.

2510.05683.tldr: A model-agnostic, post-hoc framework that treats model explanations as distributions over local surrogates fit on structure-preserving perturbations of a graph, which establishes a principled, uncertainty-aware, and structure-sensitive approach to explaining quantum graph neural networks.

2510.05696.tldr: This paper uses a TopK activation inspired by SAEs on the last layer of embeddings of AASIST, a deepfake detection architecture to obtain sparse representations which are used in the decision process and shows that these representations provide better disentanglement.

2510.05698.tldr: Attention-Based In-Context Learning for Velocity Control and Data Collection Schedule (AIC-VDS) is proposed as an alternative to DRL in emergencies and simulation results show that the proposed AIC-VDS outperforms both the Deep-Q-Network (DQN) and maximum channel gain baselines.

2510.05709.tldr: A principled and practical end-to-end framework for evaluating LLM vulnerabilities to prompt injection attacks, and a Bayesian hierarchical model with embedding-space clustering to improve uncertainty quantification in the common scenario that LLM outputs are not deterministic.

2510.05710.tldr: These findings suggest that, when equipped with explicit bias controls, LLM-as-Judge protocols provide a reliable and cost-efficient alternative to human annotation, while also enabling structured error analysis.

2510.05713.tldr: A comprehensive study of FedSL frameworks tailored for resource-constrained robots in industrial scenarios, which compares synchronous, asynchronous, hierarchical, and heterogeneous FedSL frameworks in terms of workflow, scalability, adaptability, and limitations under dynamic industrial conditions.

2510.05733.tldr: The edge model achieves performance comparable to the cloud version while reducing model size by 83% and latency by 50%, offering a practical, robust, and deployable paradigm for modern intelligent diagnostics.

2510.05740.tldr: This work introduces not only a top-performing detector, but also a new benchmark and framework for furthering universal AI image detection, and introduces a new method, FusionDetect, aimed at addressing both vectors of generalization.

2510.05746.tldr: This work presents a new paradigm for automatic MAS design that pivots the focus to optimizing CoT reasoning, and introduces the Agentic Reasoning Module (ARM), an agentic generalization of CoT where each granular reasoning step is executed by a specialized reasoning module.

2510.05750.tldr: This work examines HGNNs from two perspectives: model architecture and heterogeneous information and develops a causal effect estimation framework that constructs and evaluates candidate factors under standard assumptions through factual and counterfactual analyses, with robustness validated via minimal sufficient adjustment sets, cross-method consistency checks, and sensitivity analyses.

2510.05751.tldr: An ensemble-based pipeline for estimating atmospheric transport footprints, greenhouse gas mole fraction measurements, and their uncertainties using a graph neural network emulator of a Lagrangian Particle Dispersion Model (LPDM) is presented.

2510.05769.tldr: A novel learning approach consisting of an optimal transport-based informative attention method to improve learning focal information in reference summaries and an accumulative joint entropy reduction method on named entities to enhance informative salience is proposed.

2510.05788.tldr: An end-to-end industrial pipeline for producing contextualized in-editor completion: disciplined data governance, multi-stage training that includes fill-in-the-middle and project context via supervised fine-tuning, and alignment via direct preference optimization using feedback from real-world scenarios is described.

2510.05799.tldr: This study proposes TKTO, a training paradigm that eliminates the need for paired data, enabling a more data-efficient training paradigm, and directly targets token-level units, automatically providing fine-grained alignment signals without token-level annotations.

2510.05808.tldr: This work develops high-probability Fano and Le Cam tools and derive risk level explicit minimax-quantile bounds, including a quantile-to-expectation conversion and a tight link between strict and lower minimax quantiles.

2510.05819.tldr: This work proposes a self-supervised deep learning method detecting five keyframes in short-axis (SAX) and four-chamber long-axis (4CH) cine CMR and enables temporally aligned inter- and intra-patient analysis of cardiac dynamics, irrespective of cycle or phase lengths.

2510.05825.tldr: Entropic Particle Filtering (ePF) is introduced, an algorithm that integrates two new techniques to improve PF's resilience by balancing the exploration of diverse solution spaces with the exploitation of high-reward regions, ultimately leading to higher-quality solutions.

2510.05827.tldr: VCoT-Grasp is proposed, an end-to-end grasp foundation model that incorporates visual chain-of-thought reasoning to enhance visual understanding for grasp generation and significantly improves grasp success rates and generalizes effectively to unseen objects, backgrounds, and distractors.

2510.05865.tldr: This article conducts a comprehensive literature review of World Models in the domains of autonomous driving and robotics, with a specific focus on the safety implications of scene and control generation tasks.

2510.05871.tldr: Applied to biological perturbation prediction, it is shown that the filtered subset has higher accuracy, and that supervised fine-tuning on uncertainty-filtered data outperforms unfiltered synthetic data, narrows the gap to ground-truth training, and surpasses strong LRM baselines.

2510.05881.tldr: The Segmented Full-Song Model is proposed for symbolic full-song generation and wrapped into a web application that enables users to iteratively co-create music on a piano roll with customizable structures and flexible ordering.

2510.05891.tldr: This paper introduces a discrete distribution discrepancy-aware transformer that integrates dynamic codebook frequency statistics into its attention mechanism, fusing semantic features and quantization error latent and constructs a comprehensive dataset termed ARForensics covering 7 mainstream visual AR models.

2510.05903.tldr: A novel large-scale dataset for defect detection in a logistics setting with over 230,000 images (and more than 29,000 defective instances), which is 40 times larger than MVTec-AD and contains more than 48,000 distinct objects is presented.

2510.05919.tldr: This study reports the first application of a VAE-BiLSTM-MHA architecture to ECG anomaly detection, and achieves the best performance, with an AUPRC of 0.81 and a recall of 0.85 on the held-out test set, outperforming the other architectures.

2510.05930.tldr: This work provides a mathematical framework for studying the interplay between data geometry, generalisation and memorisation in generative models, as well as a robust and scalable algorithm that can be readily integrated into existing flow matching pipelines.

2510.05935.tldr: LLM-FS-Agent is introduced, a novel multi-agent architecture designed for interpretable and robust feature selection that orchestrates a deliberative"debate" among multiple LLM agents, each assigned a specific role, enabling collective evaluation of feature relevance and generation of detailed justifications.

2510.05949.tldr: Any successfully trained JEPA can be used to get sample probabilities, e.g., for data curation, outlier detection, or simply for density estimation, and the theoretical finding is agnostic of the dataset and architecture used.

2510.05950.tldr: FETA, a multi-agent framework for training-free TSC via exemplar-based in-context reasoning, demonstrates that a multi-agent in-context reasoning framework can transform LLMs into competitive, plug-and-play TSC solvers without any parameter training.

2510.05962.tldr: The experiments find that models solve deduction more easily than induction, but they revert to standard math, and analysis reveals that math-adapted models fail to exhibit a general"skill" of reasoning, and fine-tuning on induction tasks generalizes poorly.

2510.05972.tldr: LexiCon is introduced -- a natural language-based (Lexi) constrained (Con) planning benchmark, consisting of a suite of environments, that can be used to evaluate the planning capabilities of LLMs in a principled fashion and renders LexiCon future-proof: the hardness of the generated planning problems can be increased as the planning capabilities of LLMs improve.

2510.05976.tldr: This survey provides an up-to-date critical analysis of diffusion models for LLIE, distinctively featuring an in-depth comparative performance evaluation against Generative Adversarial Network and Transformer-based state-of-the-art methods, a thorough examination of practical deployment challenges, and a forward-looking perspective on the role of emerging paradigms like foundation models.

2510.05984.tldr: ECTSpeech is proposed, a simple and effective one-step speech synthesis framework that, for the first time, incorporates the Easy Consistency Tuning (ECT) strategy into speech synthesis and achieves high-quality one-step generation while significantly reducing training complexity.

2510.05996.tldr: This work proposes a novel pre-training paradigm that initializes policies to maximize discounted empowerment, enabling agents to acquire a robust understanding of environmental dynamics and pave the way for future research to scale this framework to high-dimensional and complex tasks, further advancing the field of RL.

2510.06010.tldr: The results suggest that while classical neural policies remain dominant in current control benchmarks, quantum-enhanced architectures could offer promising efficiency advantages once hardware noise and expressivity limitations are mitigated.

2510.06014.tldr: This paper introduces ARISE (Adaptive Resolution-aware Scaling Evaluation), a novel metric specifically designed to assess the test-time scaling effectiveness of large reasoning models, and identifies Claude Opus as exhibiting superior scaling characteristics compared to other contemporary reasoning models.

2510.06026.tldr: This research evaluates two technical safeguards to curtail a model’s person re-identification capacity: index exclusion and confusion loss and identifies critical vulnerabilities in these mitigations, including potential circumvention using partial person images.

2510.06029.tldr: Overall, molFTP provides a fast, leakage-resistant fragment-target prevalence vectorization with practical safeguards (dummy masking or key-LOO) that approximate LOO at a fraction of its cost.

2510.06036.tldr: This work investigates why safety alignment fails in reasoning models through a mechanistic interpretability lens, and proposes cliff-as-a-Judge, a novel data selection method that identifies training examples exhibiting the largest refusal cliff to efficiently repair reasoning models'safety alignment.

2510.06038.tldr: This work proposes a reward-free, active human-in-the-loop learning method called Human-Guided Distributional Soft Actor-Critic (H-DSAC), which combines Proxy Value Propagation and Distributional Soft Actor-Critic to enable efficient and safe training in real-world environments.

2510.06039.tldr: This work presents a Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Chinese Large Language Models (CB-ECLLM) based on the newly constructed Chinese Data-Text Pair (CDTP) dataset, and conducts rigorous evaluations through extensive experiments and ablation studies to assess the effectiveness, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), and robustness of the benchmark.

2510.06040.tldr: The proposed VideoMiner is a hierarchical tree structure that iteratively segments, captions, and clusters long videos, forming a hierarchical tree structure, and introduces T-GRPO, a tree-based group relative policy optimization in reinforcement learning method that guides the exploration of the VideoMiner.

2510.06046.tldr: GLVD is introduced, a hybrid method for 3D face reconstruction from few-shot images that extends Learned Vertex Descent (LVD) by integrating per-vertex neural field optimization with global structural guidance from dynamically predicted 3D keypoints.

2510.06052.tldr: This work proposes MixReasoning, a framework that dynamically adjusts the depth of reasoning within a single response, which shortens reasoning length and substantially improves efficiency without compromising accuracy.

2510.06056.tldr: DeepEvolve is presented, an agent that integrates deep research with algorithm evolution, uniting external knowledge retrieval, cross-file code editing, and systematic debugging under a feedback-driven iterative loop, providing a reliable framework for advancing scientific algorithm discovery.

2510.06060.tldr: This work proposes a diffusion model by introducing a set of powerful conditioning signals derived from the full 360-degree space: a panoramic saliency map to identify regions of interest, a bounding-box-aware signed distance map to define the target viewpoint, and a descriptive caption of the entire scene.

2510.06063.tldr: TelecomTS is introduced, a large-scale observability dataset derived from a 5G telecommunications network that features heterogeneous, de-anonymized covariates with explicit scale information and supports a suite of downstream tasks, including anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and a question-answering benchmark requiring multi-modal reasoning.

2510.06071.tldr: A synthetic, annotated dataset of over 18,000 scatterplots from six data generators and 17 chart designs, and a benchmark based on it that evaluates proprietary models from OpenAI and Google using N-shot prompting on five distinct tasks derived from annotations of cluster bounding boxes, their center coordinates, and outlier coordinates is introduced.

2510.06077.tldr: A systematic analysis revealing that CoT often degrades performance in video reasoning, generating verbose but misleading internal monologues, and leading to hallucinated visual details and overridden correct intuitions - a phenomenon the authors term "visual thinking drift".

2510.06078.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed RouteLLM method reliably grounds textual preferences into constraint-aware routes, improving route quality and preference satisfaction over classical methods.

2510.06084.tldr: Spectrum Tuning is proposed, a post-training method using Spectrum Suite to improve steerability and distributional coverage and often improves over pretrained and typical instruction-tuned models, enhancing steerability, spanning more of the output space, and improving distributional alignment on held-out datasets.

2510.06090.tldr: This work presents the first open-source, anatomically coherent dataset of curated, high-resolution segmentations for these structures, supplemented with whole-heart labels produced by TS on the publicly available ImageCAS dataset consisting of 1000 cardiac computed tomography angiography (CCTA) scans.

2510.06093.tldr: A prior classical AI model is implemented and an LLM-based algorithmic decision-maker evaluated using a large reasoning model and a non-reasoning model with weighted self-consistency under a zero-shot prompting framework is developed, as proposed in recent literature.

2510.06105.tldr: It is shown that optimizing LLMs for competitive success can inadvertently drive misalignment, highlighting how market-driven optimization pressures can systematically erode alignment, creating a race to the bottom, and suggesting that safe deployment of AI systems will require stronger governance and carefully designed incentives to prevent competitive dynamics from undermining societal trust.

2510.06131.tldr: MeDiM is proposed, the first medical discrete diffusion model that learns shared distributions across modalities without modality-specific components, and unifies multiple generative tasks: translating between images and text, and jointly producing image-report pairs across domains in response to prompts.

2510.06133.tldr: This work proposes CreditDecoding, a training-free parallel decoding algorithm that accelerates the confidence convergence of correct but underconfident tokens by fusing current logits with Trace Credit, making it a readily integrable and versatile solution.

2510.06135.tldr: This work studies both sequential and parallel TTS of deep search agents, motivated by the intuition that verification in this setting is often much easier than generation, and achieves substantial improvements by allocating only a modest amount of compute to the verifier.

2510.06138.tldr: Results indicate that natural-language metadata can effectively index and recombine reusable skills within a single policy, and suggest that natural-language metadata can effectively index and recombine reusable skills within a single policy.

2510.06145.tldr: An annotation pipeline consisting of a diffusion model to lift 2D hand keypoint sequences to 4D hand motion and a diffusion loss to account for the multimodality in hand motion distribution is designed.

2510.06151.tldr: Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as policy-agnostic human proxies to generate synthetic data that mimics human decision-making, and prompt-guided diversity offers a scalable foundation for simulating policy-agnostic teammates.

2510.06195.tldr: The Latent Speech-Text Transformer (LST) is introduced, which aggregates speech tokens into latent speech patches that serve as higher-level autoregressive units that improve computational efficiency and stabilizes ASR adaptation and reduces the effective autoregressive sequence length during ASR and TTS inference.

2510.06201.tldr: Evaluation reveals TokenChain surpasses baseline accuracy 2-6 epochs earlier and yields 5-13% lower equal-epoch error with stable T2S on LibriSpeech, and reduces relative ASR WER by 56% and T2S WER by 31% on TED-LIUM with minimal forgetting, showing that chain learning remains effective with token interfaces and models

2510.06214.tldr: Stratified GRPO is proposed, whose central component, Stratified Advantage Normalization (SAN), partitions trajectories into homogeneous strata based on their structural properties and computes advantages locally within each stratum, resulting in a more pure and scale-stable learning signal.

2510.06217.tldr: TaTToo is proposed, a novel table-grounded PRM framework that reasons explicitly over tabular reasoning steps and integrates tool-based verification to provide precise reward supervision and provides a comprehensive evaluation of the policy improvement induced by the newly designed PRM.

2510.06218.tldr: EgoNight, the first comprehensive benchmark for nighttime egocentric vision, with visual question answering (VQA) as the core task, is presented, and EgoNight-VQA provides a strong foundation for advancing application-driven egocentric vision research and for developing models that generalize across illumination domains.

2209.03358.tldr: This work advances the adversarial attack side of SNNs and makes three major contributions, showing that successful white-box attacks on SNNs strongly depend on the surrogate gradient estimation technique, even for adversarially trained models.

2305.11461.tldr: A novel Hint of Pseudo Code (HoPC) prompting technique that does not require extra interpreter as in PoT and incorporates a more powerful zero-shot problem decomposition and semantic code reasoning capabilities than zero-shot CoT.

2403.04481.tldr: The Entity-level Language Model (ECLM) framework is proposed, which reformulates slot-filling as an entity recognition task and introduces a novel concept, \textit{Chain of Intent}, to enable step-by-step multi-intent recognition.

2410.01103.tldr: It is shown through a series of experiments that the task-specific performance of AprAD is comparable to methods that do not distort the output distribution, while being much more computationally efficient.

2411.04975.tldr: SuffixDecoding is introduced, a novel method that utilizes efficient suffix trees to cache long token sequences from prompts and previous outputs that effectively exploits opportunities for longer speculations while conserving computation when those opportunities are limited.

2411.17624.tldr: This study systematically analyzed 25 papers that met strict inclusion criteria from over 80 related studies, identifying all ML methods and combinations of RS data used and Sentinel-1 emerged as the most utilized remote sensing source.

2502.07218.tldr: It is shown that contrastive features are not a prerequisite for effective activation redirection, and LUNAR achieves state-of-the-art unlearning performance and superior controllability and is robust to white-box adversarial attacks and versatile in real-world scenarios, including handling sequential unlearning requests.

2502.17832.tldr: This work proposes MM-PoisonRAG, the first framework to systematically design knowledge poisoning in multimodal RAG, and introduces two complementary attack strategies: Localized Poisoning Attack (LPA) and Globalized Poisoning Attack (GPA), which inserts a single adversarial knowledge to broadly disrupt reasoning and induce nonsensical responses across all queries.

2503.02016.tldr: A multi-agent framework that simulates belief congruence, a classical group psychology theory that plays a crucial role in shaping societal interactions and preferences, is presented, revealing that LLMs exhibit amplified belief congruence compared to humans, across diverse contexts.

2503.13055.tldr: This work adapts Chain-of-Thought with Self-Consistency to mitigate reasoning loss from cross-modal distractions and incorporate an affordance predictor to guide planning based on geometric feasibility, revealing two major limitations of current MLLMs: cross-modal distraction and geometric infeasibility.

2503.19945.tldr: New state-of-the-art benchmarks are established, providing clear evidence of the advantages of multi-view architectures for mammogram interpretation, and principled insights into model design and transfer learning strategies are offered, contributing to the development of more accurate and reliable breast cancer screening tools.

2504.01382.tldr: This work conducts the first comprehensive and rigorous assessment of the current state of web agents, and presents the first comprehensive comparative analysis of current web agents, highlighting both their strengths and limitations to inspire future research.

2505.04486.tldr: This work presents $\texttt{Latent-CFM}$, which provides efficient training strategies by conditioning on the features extracted from data using pretrained deep latent variable models, and demonstrates that this approach can be used for conditional image generation conditioned on latent features, which adds interpretability to the generation process.

2505.10607.tldr: MONAQ is a novel framework that reformulates NAS into Multi-Objective Neural Architecture Querying tasks, equipped with multimodal query generation for processing multimodal time-series inputs and hardware constraints, alongside an LLM agent-based multi-objective search to achieve deployment-ready models via code generation.

2505.12891.tldr: A multi-level benchmark TIME, designed for temporal reasoning in real-world scenarios, is proposed and a human-annotated subset, TIME-Lite, a human-annotated subset to foster future research and standardized evaluation in temporal reasoning is released.

2505.15946.tldr: MoRE-Brain introduces a novel Mixture-of-Experts architecture grounded in brain network principles for neuro-decoding, and provides enhanced mechanistic insight, as the explicit routing reveals precisely how different modeled brain regions shape the semantic and spatial attributes of the reconstructed image.

2505.18356.tldr: This work investigates cross-lingual transfer to lower-resource languages where task-specific post-training data is scarce and identifies the most consistently successful modular method to be fine-tuning separate language and math experts and model merging via Layer-Swapping.

2505.21988.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage multi-modal framework that identifies whether a given logic function is implicitly present within a larger circuit, irrespective of structural variations induced by synthesis or technology mapping, and demonstrates significant performance improvements over existing structural methods.

2505.22598.tldr: This work provides a complete analytic study of the widely used global annealing procedure applied to a shallow MADE architecture for the Curie-Weiss model and establishes a clear theoretical basis for the integration of machine learning techniques into Monte Carlo sampling and optimization.

2506.02210.tldr: ExPrune is a general, dynamic pruning optimization that enables multi-granularity partial computation on a per-input basis and generalizes across model architectures in different problem domains.

2506.02548.tldr: This work introduces CyberGym, a large-scale benchmark featuring 1,507 real-world vulnerabilities across 188 software projects and highlights that CyberGym effectively differentiates agents' and models' cybersecurity capabilities.

2506.06541.tldr: KramaBench focuses on testing the end-to-end capabilities of AI systems to solve challenges which require automated orchestration of different data tasks, and features a comprehensive evaluation framework assessing the pipeline design and individual data task implementation abilities of AI systems.

2507.03318.tldr: This work proposes a framework by implementing graph neural networks (GNNs) to leverage property and structure information from activity cliff pairs to predict compound-protein affinity, and improves property prediction by integrating common and uncommon node information with sparse group lasso.

2508.01861.tldr: Results show that ACT-Tensor not only reduces pricing errors but also significantly improves risk-adjusted returns of the constructed portfolio, confirming that the method delivers highly accurate and informative imputations, offering substantial value for financial decision-making.

2508.11711.tldr: A novel, AI-driven approach for real-time detection of malicious GraphQL queries, which combines static analysis with machine learning techniques and demonstrates high accuracy in detecting various threats, including SQL injection, OS command injection, and XSS exploits, alongside effective mitigation of DoS and SSRF attempts.

2509.03540.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that dynamically constructs and expands knowledge graphs (KGs) during inference, integrating both internal knowledge extracted from LLMs and external knowledge retrieved from external sources, revealing that inference-time KG construction is a promising direction for enhancing LLM factuality in a structured, interpretable, and scalable manner.

2509.05378.tldr: This work introduces Code Like Humans: a new agentic framework for medical coding with large language models that implements official coding guidelines for human experts and is the first solution that can support the full ICD-10 coding system.

2509.07030.tldr: A minimalist Bayesian framework that places a prior only on the component of interest, such as the location of the optimum, is introduced that accommodates structured problems, including continuum-armed Lipschitz bandits and dynamic pricing.

2509.12658.tldr: A sustainable long short-term memory (LSTM)-based precoding framework for reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted millimeter-wave (mmWave) MIMO systems that demonstrates resilience under distribution mismatch and scalability to larger RIS arrays, making it a practical and energy-efficient solution for sustainable 6G wireless networks.

2509.15174.tldr: This work introduces SMARTER, a data-efficient two-stage framework for explainable content moderation using Large Language Models (LLMs), which offers a scalable strategy for low-resource settings by harnessing LLMs's self-improving capabilities for both classification and explanation.

2509.25282.tldr: A formal definition of causal structures for workflow modules; the proposal and implementation of a CVP framework that anchors agent reasoning to a user-defined causal graph; and empirical evidence demonstrating the framework's effectiveness in enhancing agent robustness and reducing errors caused by causal confusion in dynamic environments are presented.

2510.02360.tldr: Experiments across open-source and closed-source models show that history and persona together produce strong majority dominance and replicate SoS patterns, and history signals alone induce strong anchoring, indicating that without historical anchoring, SoS dynamics cannot emerge.

2510.03262.tldr: Empirical analysis reveals that inter-LoRA orthogonality alone may be insufficient for achieving true semantic compositionality, prompting a re-examination of its role in adapter merging.

2510.03268.tldr: This paper introduces the first theoretical framework for analyzing the convergent optimal representations of MCL and the modality alignment when training is optimized and proves that without any constraint or under the cone constraint, the modality gap converges to zero.

2510.03511.tldr: The Platonic Transformer is introduced, which enables combined equivariance to continuous translations and Platonic symmetries, while preserving the exact architecture and computational cost of a standard Transformer.

2510.03569.tldr: Experiments show that IMMFM outperforms existing methods in both forecasting accuracy and further downstream tasks and captures intrinsic stochasticity, handles irregular sparse sampling, and yields subject-specific trajectories.

2510.04072.tldr: Slow-Fast Policy Optimization (SFPO) is introduced, a simple yet efficient framework to address the above limitations via decomposing each step into three stages: a short fast trajectory of inner steps on the same batch, a reposition mechanism to control off-policy drift, and a final slow correction.

2510.04205.tldr: This paper establishes a rigorous polyhedral characterization of KANs, develops a complete theory of $\epsilon$-equivalent compression, and designs a dynamic programming algorithm that achieves approximately optimal compression under specified error bounds.

2510.05336.tldr: WeatherArchive-Bench is the first benchmark for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems on historical weather archives and highlights key limitations in reasoning about complex societal indicators and provides insights for designing more robust climate-focused RAG systems from archival contexts.

2510.05379.tldr: Two distinct scaling methods are introduced: Best-of-N and Beam Search, which conduct a more exhaustive search by exploring combinations of strategies from the library to discover more potent and synergistic attack vectors.

2510.06235.tldr: This work integrates multimodal representations from large language models, video encoders, audio models, and vision-language models, combining both off-the-shelf and fine-tuned variants, contributing to ongoing efforts in developing multimodal encoding models for brain activity.

2510.06238.tldr: The idea of uncertainty quantification through Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout, integrated into a fine-tuned ResNet-50 architecture for surface landmine and UXO classification, is introduced and results demonstrate the model’s ability to flag unreliable predictions under challenging conditions.

2510.06240.tldr: By integrating collaborative reasoning with knowledge grounding, KG-MASD generates high-confidence instruction-tuning data and jointly distills reasoning depth and verifiability into compact student models suitable for edge deployment, enabling trustworthy AI deployment in safety-critical industrial scenarios.

2510.06242.tldr: A two-stage evaluation framework specifically designed for human survey responses, where gibberish filtering removes nonsensical responses and three dimensions-effort, relevance, and completeness-are evaluated using LLM capabilities, grounded in empirical analysis of real-world survey data.

2510.06244.tldr: This work focuses on the scientific domain and finding the optimal word representation algorithm along with the tokenization method that could be used to represent words in the scientific domain and building a comprehensive evaluation suite that could be used to evaluate various word representation and tokenization algorithms in the scientific domain.

2510.06245.tldr: A new community-centered model is proposed to generate customizable evolving community structures where communities can grow, shrink, merge, split, appear or disappear, and the underlying temporal network is generated, where nodes can appear, disappear, or move between communities.

2510.06252.tldr: This dataset provides a novel resource for dream research, a unique resource to study the neural correlates of dreaming, to develop models for decoding dreams from brain activity, and to explore new approaches in neuroscience, psychology, and artificial intelligence.

2510.06253.tldr: A rubric-based assessment framework powered by a large language model (LLM) for measuring algebraic competence, real-world-context block coding tasks and showed strong agreement with expert judgments and consistently produced rubric-aligned, process-oriented feedback.

2510.06260.tldr: The framework represents a significant advancement toward deployable dermatological AI that enhances diagnostic precision while actively supporting the continuum of care from initial detection through patient education, ultimately improving early intervention rates for skin lesions.

2510.06261.tldr: AlphaApollo is an agentic reasoning system that targets two bottlenecks in foundation-model reasoning: limited reasoning capacity for complex, long-horizon problem solving and unreliable test-time evolution without trustworthy verification.

2510.06262.tldr: This dataset provides responses to a standardized, bilingual (English-Hindi) Prakriti Assessment Questionnaire designed to evaluate the physical, physiological, and psychological characteristics of individuals according to classical Ayurvedic principles, supporting analysis of trait distributions, correlations, and predictive modeling.

2510.06263.tldr: Results on MIMIC-IV and de-identified real EHRs demonstrate that the fully offline system can effectively produce useful summaries in under 30 seconds, and an LLM-as-Judge evaluation mechanism is incorporated to assess summary quality in terms of factual accuracy, completeness, and clarity.

2510.06266.tldr: This study utilises deep learning methods to analyse songs (lyrics) from Billboard Charts of the United States in the last seven decades and shows a significant rise in explicit content in popular music from 1990 onwards.

2510.06267.tldr: The results suggest that integrating biomedical knowledge graphs directly into diffusion noise schedules can simultaneously enhance fidelity and privacy, enabling safer data sharing for rare-disease research.

2510.06270.tldr: Experiments on multi-objective drug design benchmarks show that MCCE achieves state-of-the-art Pareto front quality and consistently outperforms baselines, highlighting a new paradigm for enabling continual evolution in hybrid LLM systems, combining knowledge-driven exploration with experience-driven learning.

2510.06274.tldr: This work proposes Complexity Out of Distribution (Complexity OoD) generalization as a framework and problem setting to define and measure reasoning, and translates this perspective into practice with recommendations for operationalizing Complexity OoD across the stack.

2510.06275.tldr: This work extends the original paper by modifying the input embeddings or deleting the output embeddings of XRec's Mixture of Experts module, and provides an open-source evaluation implementation that enhances accessibility for researchers and practitioners alike.

2510.06276.tldr: A new framework for segmenting FCD regions in 3D brain MRI images is presented and a novel loss function combining Dice loss with an anisotropic {Total Variation} (TV) term is introduced, which encourages spatial smoothness and reduces false positive clusters without relying on post-processing.

2510.06280.tldr: An evaluation protocol for healthcare settings that quantifies associated biases and assesses their operational risk is presented, highlighting the importance of bias identification in critical domains such as healthcare as AI-enabled hiring and workforce analytics can have downstream implications for equity, compliance, and patient trust.

2510.06281.tldr: A GAN-based superresolution approach is proposed to enhance low-resolution (LR) full-disk H$\alpha$ images from the Global Oscillation Network Group (GONG) to a quality comparable with HR observations from the Big Bear Solar Observatory/Goode Solar Telescope (BBSO/GST).

2510.06283.tldr: Synthetic Error Replay Diffusion (SER-Diff) is proposed, the first framework that unifies diffusion-based refinement with incremental learning and demonstrates that SER-Diff consistently outperforms prior methods.

2510.06288.tldr: This work introduces BuilderBench, a benchmark to accelerate research into agent pre-training that centers open-ended exploration, and provides a ``training wheels'' protocol, in which agents are trained and evaluated to build a single target structure from the task suite.

2510.06290.tldr: This work proposes Soft-Evidence Fusion Graph Neural Network (SEFGNN), a novel framework for CDG identification across multiple networks at the decision level that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and exhibits strong potential in discovering novel CDGs.

2510.06291.tldr: A novel model that employs a transformer backbone for both conditional information embedding and noise prediction is proposed, and it is demonstrated that Trajectory Transformer significantly enhances generation quality and effectively alleviates the deviation issues observed in prior approaches.

2510.06292.tldr: ChainMPQ (Multi-Perspective Questions guided Interleaved Chain of Image and Text), a training-free method that improves relational inference in LVLMs by utilizing accumulated textual and visual memories, is proposed.

2510.06295.tldr: Surprisingly, the on-device runtime of MobilePicasso is observed to be faster than a server-based high-resolution image editing model running on an A100 GPU.

2510.06296.tldr: The results show that generating formally verifiable code remains a profound challenge for state-of-the-art LLMs, and underscores both the difficulty of the task and the need for benchmarks like VeriEquivBench to drive progress toward scalable and reliable coding agents.

2510.06298.tldr: This thesis proposes a model architecture with a Transformer module for feature fusion that achieves a mean Euclidean error of 55.3mm on the same dataset, but it is shown that using no pre-trained GAN module leads to a mean Euclidean error of 30.1mm.

2510.06302.tldr: This paper analyzes foundational learning theories, cognitive load and motivation models, and serious game design frameworks to identify the essential requirements for a game-based learning design framework tailored to information system integration in post-merger integration.

2510.06307.tldr: This work proposes the Belief-Calibrated Consensus Seeking (BCCS) framework, a theoretical framework for selecting optimal collaborators that maximize consensus stability via selecting optimal collaborators and calibrating the consensus judgment by system-internal beliefs.

2510.06350.tldr: This paper model the relationship between rules and their enforcement at scale, introducing ModQ, a novel question-answering framework for rule-sensitive content moderation that generalize effectively to unseen communities and rules, supporting low-resource moderation settings and dynamic governance environments.

2510.06357.tldr: This work introduces a new robotic planning method that augments LLM planners with symbolic planning oversight to improve reliability and repeatability, and provide a transparent approach to defining hard constraints with considerably stronger clarity than traditional prompt engineering.

2510.06371.tldr: Everyday Multimodal and Multilingual QA and OASIS together provide a benchmark and training dataset for building multimodal LLMs for a comprehensive set of everyday tasks within cultural contexts.

2510.06381.tldr: Monte Carlo Permutation Search (MCPS), a general-purpose Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm that improves upon the GRAVE algorithm, is proposed and it is shown that using abstract codes for moves instead of exact codes can be beneficial to both MCPS and GRAVE.

2510.06383.tldr: Experimental results on two datasets show that the rewriting method can effectively prevent search-based linkages while remaining faithful to the original content and highlight that linkages remain feasible with the help of more advanced, semantics-oriented approaches.

2510.06391.tldr: The work formalizes a framework for measuring the alignment of opinions captured by RMs, investigates the extent to which RMs demonstrate sociodemographic biases, and explores the effects of prompting to steer rewards towards the preferences of a target group.

2510.06396.tldr: IMPRESS is introduced and the development and implementation of an adaptive protein design protocol and its supporting computing infrastructure are demonstrated, leading to increased consistency in the quality of protein design and enhanced throughput of protein design due to dynamic resource allocation and asynchronous workload execution.

2510.06397.tldr: This work shows that non-Euclidean foundation models increasingly place representations in curved spaces such as hyperbolic geometry, which creates a boundary-driven asymmetry that backdoor triggers can exploit and proposes a simple geometry-adaptive trigger that is evaluated across tasks and architectures.

2510.06410.tldr: This paper proposes twin tests that capture the two extremes of the off-trajectory spectrum, namely Recoverability, which tests whether LLMs can backtrack from "distractions"induced by misleading reasoning traces, and Guidability, which tests their ability to build upon correct reasoning from stronger collaborators.

2510.06433.tldr: The proposed knowledge graph serves as an example for researchers, enabling them to explore the complex interplay between dietary choices and disease management, and expands the scope of the knowledge graph by capturing nuances, adding more related data, and performing inferences on the acquired knowledge to uncover hidden relationships.

2510.06444.tldr: It is shown that adding a performance forecasting worker in a decentralized learning network, following a design similar to the Allora network, can improve the accuracy of network inferences and is found that forecasting models that predict regret or regret z-score show greater improvement than models predicting losses.

2510.06448.tldr: It is argued that the benchmarks on which these metrics are evaluated are fundamentally flawed and empirically demonstrated that their unrealistic model spaces and static performance hierarchies artificially inflate the perceived performance of existing metrics, to the point where simple, dataset-agnostic heuristics can outperform sophisticated methods.

2510.06457.tldr: This study evaluates user experiences with two distinct AI interfaces to assess their performance in exploratory, follow-up inquiry, decision-making, and problem-solving tasks and suggests that adaptive AI interfaces capable of switching between structured visualizations and conversational formats based on task requirements can significantly enhance transparency and user confidence in AI-powered systems.

2510.06475.tldr: The findings show that reasoning models outperform others in instruction-based settings, while code-based execution presents greater challenges but offers a scalable and efficient alternative.

2510.06499.tldr: This work presents a viable path toward scaling RL to pre-training levels, enabling more capable and efficient language models, and introduces the Webscale-RL pipeline, a scalable data engine that systematically converts large-scale pre-training documents into millions of diverse, verifiable question-answer pairs for RL.

2510.06503.tldr: ATLO-ML is introduced, an adaptive time-length optimization system that automatically determines the optimal input time length and sampling rate based on user-defined output time length, offering a robust solution for optimizing temporal input parameters in machine learning workflows.

2510.06505.tldr: This work introduces Medix, a novel framework designed to identify potential outliers from unlabeled data using the median operation, which outperforms existing methods across the board in open-world settings, confirming the validity of the theoretical insights.

2510.06512.tldr: This work formalizes the problem of assigning Scores for TempOral Properties (STOPs) over sequences, given potentially noisy score predictors for local properties, and proposes a scoring function called LogSTOP that can efficiently compute these scores for temporal properties represented in Linear Temporal Logic.

2510.06517.tldr: There is no free lunch in visualization, and recommendations for future work are provided as there are several paths to continue the work in this field.

2510.06532.tldr: CLAQS is presented, a compact, fully quantum token mixer for text classification that jointly learns complex-valued mixing and nonlinear transformations within a unified quantum circuit that decouples shared token embeddings from a window-level quantum feed-forward module.

2510.06538.tldr: The Auto-Prompt Ensemble (APE), an adaptive framework that automatically learns evaluation dimensions from its failure cases, incorporates a confidence-based ensemble mechanism to decide when to adopt the judgments from additional evaluation dimensions through a novel confidence estimation approach called Collective Confidence.

2510.06559.tldr: A diagnosis of hallucination as a type error; a formal Montague-ontology bridge for business/legal reasoning; and a production-oriented design that embeds typed interfaces across the pipeline are contributed.

2510.06564.tldr: The Heterogeneous Subgraph Network (HSNet) is proposed, a novel framework that efficiently leverages graph modeling while maintaining computational feasibility, and achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing reconstruction quality with computational efficiency.

2510.06567.tldr: Using AI as a supporting reader (AI-SR) is the most suitable approach for clinical trials, as it meets all criteria across various model types, even with bad models, and consistently provides reliable disease estimation, preserves clinical trial treatment effect estimates and conclusions, and retains these advantages when applied to different populations.

2510.06587.tldr: WebDART dynamically decomposes each objective into three focused subtasks: navigation, information extraction, and execution, so the model concentrates on one skill at a time, and continuously replans the decomposition as new webpages are revealed, taking advantage of newly discovered filters or shortcuts and avoiding redundant exploration.

2510.06596.tldr: The Synthetic Dataset Quality Metric (SDQM) is introduced to assess data quality for object detection tasks without requiring model training to converge, and provides actionable insights for improving dataset quality, minimizing the need for costly iterative training.

2510.06600.tldr: EICL is proposed, which introduces emotionally similar examples and uses a dynamic soft-label strategy to improve query representations in the emotion reasoning process and significantly outperforms ICL on multiple datasets.

2510.06631.tldr: An integrated AI and remote-sensor framework to address the challenge of leak detection in underground water pipelines, through deploying a sparse set of remote sensors to capture real-time flow and depth data, paired with HydroNet - a dedicated model utilizing pipeline attributes in a directed graph for higher-precision modeling.

2510.06645.tldr: Extensive evaluations on C/C++ codebases demonstrate its superiority over both base models and larger LLMs in identifying complex vulnerabilities and logical flaws, establishing FineSec as a practical and scalable solution for real-world software security.

2510.06646.tldr: This work comprehensively evaluates both zero-shot sub-resolution and super-resolution (i.e., multi-resolution) inference in MLOs and proposes a simple, computationally-efficient, and data-driven multi-resolution training protocol that overcomes aliasing and that provides robust multi-resolution generalization.

2510.06649.tldr: Inspired by FF's goodness function using layer activity statistics, Action-conditioned Root mean squared Q-Functions (ARQ), a novel value estimation method that applies a goodness function and action conditioning for local RL using temporal difference learning is introduced.

2510.06661.tldr: Focusing on two realistic risks, state/input delays and interval matrix uncertainty, the neural network (NN) controller is model with local sector bounds and exploited to derive linear, delay-independent certificates that guarantee local exponential stability across admissible uncertainties.

2510.06673.tldr: A causal Transformer with reconstruction-focused visual tokenizer, a causal Transformer learns to predict the distribution over the entire 2D spatial grid of images at each timestep, enabling the model to capture comprehensive image semantics via generative training.
