2510.06695.tldr: A novel prompt optimization method specifically designed for machine translation tasks that employs a small-parameter model trained using a back-translation-based strategy, significantly reducing training overhead for single-task optimization while delivering highly effective performance.

2209.12164.tldr: This work proposes M-SAN (Multi-modal Segment Assemblage Network) which can perform efficient and coherent segment assemblage task end-to-end and proposes a unified metric, Imp-Coh@Time, which comprehensively assesses the importance, coherence, and duration of the outputs at the same time.

2211.04774.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework called “Iterative Refinement Network (IRNet)”, aiming to purify noisy samples through two key modules, and proves that IRNet is able to reduce the noise level of the dataset and eventually approximate the Bayes optimal classifier.

2309.11975.tldr: Using the Bayesian probabilistic programming library PyMC, a method to infer the cognitive profile of a system from diverse experimental data is described and the potential for capability-oriented evaluation is showcased.

2402.09225.tldr: The Membership Inference Test (MINT), a novel approach that aims to empirically assess if given data was used during the training of AI/ML models, achieves promising results, indicating the potential to recognize if an AI model has been trained with specific data.

2403.03881.tldr: LD3M is the first method to learn gradient-based distilled latents and class embeddings end-to-end through a pre-trained latent diffusion model, and preserves the gradient signal across dozens of timesteps without requiring diffusion weight fine-tuning.

2403.16276.tldr: PA-VALOR is a comprehensive audio-visual dataset comprising over 114,081 pseudo-untrimmed videos with detailed temporal annotations and AVicuna, a model capable of aligning audio-visual events with temporal intervals and corresponding text tokens that excels in temporal localization and time-aware dialogue capabilities.

2404.12353.tldr: V2Xum-LLM, specifically V2Xum-LLaMA in this study, is the first framework that unifies different video summarization tasks into one large language model's (LLM) text decoder and achieves task-controllable video summarization with temporal prompts and task instructions.

2406.15222.tldr: An artificial intelligence-based warning system, iAorta, using non-contrast CT for AAS identification in China demonstrates remarkably high accuracy and provides clinicians with interpretable warnings, which can help avoid delayed or missed diagnosis of AAS.

2410.11031.tldr: This study proposes a novel Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based framework, NAR-*ICP, that learns the intermediate computations of classical ICP-based registration algorithms, extending the CLRS Benchmark, and achieves superior performance compared to the baselines.

2410.22371.tldr: This work develops a theoretical framework to construct tight error bounds using PINNs and derives a practical error bound that can be efficiently constructed with standard training methods, and discusses that this error-bound framework generalizes to approximate solutions of other linear PDEs.

2412.02270.tldr: This work proposes a novel Sustainable Self-Evolution Adversarial Training (SSEAT) framework, which introduces a continual adversarial defense pipeline to realize learning from various kinds of adversarial examples across multiple stages and proposes an adversarial data replay module to better select more diverse and key relearning data.

2412.08127.tldr: It is found that machine-generated prompts are characterized by a last token that is often intelligible and strongly affects the generation and some of the ablations applied to autoprompts yield similar effects in natural language inputs, suggesting that autoprompts emerge naturally from the way LMs process linguistic inputs in general.

2412.09278.tldr: A novel end-to-end multimodal large language model for the biomedical domain, named MedPLIB, which possesses pixel-level understanding and a novel Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multi-stage training strategy, which divides MoE into separate training phases for a visual-language expert model and a pixel-grounding expert model, followed by fine-tuning using MoE.

2412.18169.tldr: This paper proposes the first parameter-centric approach to handling throttling by selectively dropping replicated parameters to instantly free memory for requests, based on an unnoticed observation that model parameters are commonly replicated across GPUs for serving LLMs.

2501.05408.tldr: Tempo is described, a new DL system that combines the dynamism of eager execution with the whole-program optimizations of graph-based compilation, and concisely encodes dynamic dependencies between operators, and applies whole-program optimizations, such as algebraic simplifications, vectorization, tiling, and fusion.

2501.16379.tldr: This work proposes Personalized Federated Learning with Attentive Graph HyperNetworks (FedAGHN), which employs Attentive Graph HyperNetworks (AGHNs) to dynamically capture fine-grained collaborative relationships and generate client-specific personalized initial models.

2501.17384.tldr: With the adversarial framework, the RL agent outperforms the baseline methods by a significant margin, especially in hard-level tasks, marking a significant step forward in the generalization capabilities of deep reinforcement learning.

2501.17518.tldr: RegD, a flexible Euclidean framework that supports the use of arbitrary geometric regions -- such as boxes and balls -- as embedding representations, is presented and it is formally proved that it achieves hyperbolic-like expressiveness by incorporating a depth-based dissimilarity between regions.

2503.01505.tldr: This review outlines recent developments in neural compression applied to geospatial data, and introduces the fundamental concepts of NC including seminal works in its traditional applications to image and video compression domains with focus on lossy compression.

2503.05763.tldr: A novel integration framework that enables effective fusion between powerful pre-trained text encoders and Relational Graph Convolutional Networks (R-GCNs) enhances the alignment of textual and structural representations through a bidirectional fusion mechanism and contrastive node-level optimization.

2503.17353.tldr: This work introduces $\mathit{NdLinear}$, a drop-in replacement for linear layers that operates directly on tensors, requiring no flattening, and proves NdLinear maintains expressivity through structured Tucker decomposition while preserving VC-dimension scaling.

2504.07836.tldr: This paper introduces the first AerialVG dataset, and proposes an innovative model especially for the AerialVG task, where a Hierarchical Cross-Attention is devised to focus on target regions, and a Relation-Aware Grounding module is designed to infer positional relations.

2505.11557.tldr: AC-LoRA is an end-to-end system for access control-aware corporate LLM chatbots that maintains a strong information isolation guarantee, and it is shown that AC-LoRA matches or even exceeds the performance of state-of-the-art LoRA mixing techniques while providing strong isolation guarantees.

2505.12576.tldr: AdaDim is introduced, a training strategy that leverages SSL training dynamics by adaptively balancing between increasing $H(R)$ through feature decorrelation and sample uniformity as well as gradual regularization of $I(R;Z)$ as training progresses.

2505.16834.tldr: This work establishes SFT as a viable pathway by systematically addressing the data-scarce bottleneck, offering practical insights for efficient deep search systems.

2505.17607.tldr: This work presents a dual-agent \ac{llm}-based reasoning framework for automated planar mechanism synthesis that tightly couples linguistic specification with symbolic representation and simulation, and iteratively refines designs via critic-driven feedback.

2505.17967.tldr: This work proposes a computationally efficient and conceptually simple, two-step procedure to approximate SVD/QR-based gradient projections into lower-dimensional spaces by using a predefined orthogonal matrix of the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT).

2505.23867.tldr: The InfiMed-Series models, InfiMed-SFT-3B and InfiMed-RL-3B, are introduced, both of which deliver state-of-the-art performance across seven multimodal medical benchmarks.

2506.05516.tldr: A learning-based framework integrating Episode-based Dynamic Reward Shaping and curriculum learning is presented, which dynamically balances exploration of diverse recovery maneuvers with precise posture refinement and accelerates training by leveraging privileged information in simulation, while noise-injected observations enhance robustness against uncertainties.

2506.10974.tldr: This work introduces AutoMind, an adaptive, knowledgeable LLM-agent framework that overcomes deficiencies through three key advances: a curated expert knowledge base that grounds the agent in domain expert knowledge, an agentic knowledgeable tree search algorithm that strategically explores possible solutions, and a self-adaptive coding strategy that dynamically tailors code generation to task complexity.

2506.15828.tldr: ContextMatters is introduced, a framework that fuses LLMs and classical planning to perform hierarchical goal relaxation: the LLM helps ground symbols to the scene and, when the target is unreachable, it proposes functionally equivalent goals that progressively relax constraints, adapting the goal to the context of the agent's environment.

2506.18824.tldr: This study presents a large-scale empirical study of the thought-action-result trajectories of three state-of-the-art LLM-based agents: RepairAgent, AutoCodeRover, and OpenHands, revealing behavioral motifs and anti-patterns that distinguish successful from failed executions.

2506.19807.tldr: Experimental results on three hallucination evaluation datasets and two reasoning evaluation datasets demonstrate that KnowRL effectively mitigates hallucinations in slow-thinking models while maintaining their original strong reasoning capabilities.

2506.23274.tldr: This work discretizes progress and trains a linear probe to classify reasoning states, and introduces a two-stage fine-tuning approach that enables reasoning models to generate progress estimates during inference.

2507.12117.tldr: This work constructs a closed, composable dynamical formalism for one- and many-qubit systems in phase-space that replaces the operator algebra of the Pauli group with function dynamics on symplectic manifolds, and recasts the curse of dimensionality in terms of harmonic support on a domain that scales linearly with the number of qubits.

2507.18562.tldr: GIIFT, a two-stage Graph-guided Inductive Image-Free MMT framework that uses a cross-modal Graph Attention Network adapter to learn multimodal knowledge in a unified fused space and inductively generalize it to broader image-free translation domains is introduced.

2508.06635.tldr: A new estimator based on generalized method of moments is introduced, providing a hyperparameter-free solution with strong theoretical guarantees to address the challenge of combining model-predicted labels with real data to produce statistically valid conclusions.

2509.01845.tldr: An overview of a human-centered initiative aimed at strengthening climate resilience along Nova Scotia's Eastern Shore and a replicable model for how technology can support traditional communities, enabling them to navigate climate transformation more effectively are presented.

2509.03487.tldr: SafeProtein is introduced, the first red-teaming framework designed for protein foundation models to the best of the authors' knowledge, which achieved continuous jailbreaks on state-of-the-art protein foundation models, revealing potential biological safety risks in current protein foundation models and providing insights for the development of robust security protection technologies for frontier models.

2509.13590.tldr: This work presents an intelligent multimodal framework for medical image analysis that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in healthcare diagnostics that integrates Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and demonstrates zero-shot learning capabilities to reduce dependence on large datasets.

2509.15927.tldr: The core of AIGB-Pearl lies in constructing a trajectory evaluator to assess the quality of generated scores and designing a provably sound KL-Lipschitz-constrained score-maximization scheme to ensure safe and efficient exploration beyond the offline dataset.

2509.16765.tldr: An evaluation of 15 state-of-the-art MLMs reveals that no single model consistently outperforms others across all tasks, and introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MLM across five core use cases, each containing 1,000 manually annotated data points.

2509.20293.tldr: This work argues that without tight objectives and verifiable constructions, benchmark rankings can produce high-confidence rankings that are in fact largely noise, and introduces two mechanisms to diagnose issues and highlights design failures that undermine validity.

2509.24031.tldr: This work introduces the GPSMasked Trajectory Transformer (GPS-MTM), a foundation model for large-scale mobility data that captures patterns of normalcy in human movement that consistently outperforms on downstream tasks such as trajectory infilling and next-stop prediction.

2509.25775.tldr: Autonomy-aware clustering is introduced, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that learns and accounts for the influence of local autonomy without requiring prior knowledge of its form, and the Adaptive Distance Estimation Network (ADEN), a transformer-based attention model that learns dependencies between entities and cluster representatives within the RL loop, accommodates variable-sized inputs and outputs, and enables knowledge transfer across diverse problem instances.

2510.03363.tldr: The UCF framework, a generic post-hoc refinement framework for refining anomaly cost volume of any UAD model, is presented, consistently achieving new state-of-the-art results in both unimodal (RGB) and multimodal (RGB--3D, RGB--Text) UAD scenarios.

2510.04759.tldr: PG-Occ is presented, an innovative Progressive Gaussian Transformer Framework that enables open-vocabulary 3D occupancy prediction and achieves state-of-the-art performance with a relative 14.3% mIoU improvement over the previous best performing method.

2510.05318.tldr: BIRD-INTERACT is introduced, a benchmark that restores realism to multi-turn interactions in large language models by coupling each database with a hierarchical knowledge base, metadata files, and a function-driven user simulator, enabling models to solicit clarifications, retrieve knowledge, and recover from errors without human supervision.

2510.05942.tldr: EvalMORAAL, a transparent chain-of-thought (CoT) framework that uses two scoring methods (log-probabilities and direct ratings) plus a model-as-judge peer review to evaluate moral alignment in 20 large language models, shows real progress toward culture-aware AI while highlighting open challenges for use across regions.

2510.06687.tldr: A multi-modal light field point-cloud fusion segmentation network incorporating feature completion and depth perception to segment both camera images and LiDAR point clouds simultaneously is proposed, demonstrating its effectiveness.

2510.06708.tldr: AISysRev, an LLM-based screening tool implemented as a containerized web application that allows for manual screening through interfaces that display LLM results as guidance for human reviewers, and indicates that papers can be classified into four categories: Easy Includes, Easy Excludes, Boundary Includes, and Boundary Excludes.

2510.06711.tldr: This paper investigates how a meta-agent learns across iterations and finds that simply expanding the context with all previous agents, as proposed by previous works, performs worse than ignoring prior designs entirely, and shows that the performance improves with an evolutionary approach.

2510.06718.tldr: This work examines how 11 companies create policies and the factors that influence them to help managers safely integrate chatbots into development workflows, aiming to help managers safely integrate chatbots into development workflows.

2510.06727.tldr: This work derives a policy gradient representation that seamlessly enables standard LLM RL infrastructures to optimize both tool-use behaviors as well as summarization strategies in an end-to-end fashion and establishes summarization-based context management as a principled and scalable approach for training RL agents beyond a fixed context length limit.

2510.06732.tldr: Rank Anything First (RAF), a two-stage token optimization method that crafts concise textual perturbations to consistently promote a target item in LLM-generated rankings while remaining hard to detect, is presented.

2510.06742.tldr: MultiCNKG, an innovative framework that merges three key knowledge sources, is introduced, creating a cohesive KG that interconnects genetic mechanisms, neurological disorders, and cognitive functions and advances applications in personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnostics, and hypothesis formulation in cognitive neuroscience.

2510.06743.tldr: This work presents an evaluation methodology for LLM-based historical OCR, addressing contamination risks and systematic biases in diplomatic transcription, and introduces novel metrics including Historical Character Preservation Rate (HCPR) and Archaic Insertion Rate (AIR).

2510.06756.tldr: A tool for rigorous and automated verification of large language model (LLM)- based policies in memoryless sequential decision-making tasks and shows that open source LLMs accessed via Ollama can be verified when deterministically seeded, but generally underperform deep reinforcement learning baselines.

2510.06761.tldr: A novel Double-Loop Multi-Agent (DLMA) framework to solve the given research problem automatically, with evolution driving novelty and execution ensuring soundness.

2510.06776.tldr: This work employs Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to solve the inverse problem of the SIR model using infection data from the Robert Koch Institute (RKI) to demonstrate the utility of PINNs in localized, long-term epidemiological modeling.

2510.06828.tldr: This paper points to existing proofs that architectures with fully parallelizable forward or backward passes cannot represent classes of problems specifically interesting for long-running agentic tasks and conjecture a critical time beyond which non-recurrence-complete models fail to aggregate inputs correctly.

2510.06840.tldr: A hybrid architecture integrating convolutional feature extraction with a temporal fusion transformer (TFT) backbone to enhance multivariate time series forecasting is proposed, promising for applications requiring high-fidelity, multivariate time series forecasts.

2510.06843.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the Self-Signals Driven Multi-LLM Debate (SID) method not only outperforms existing MAD techniques in accuracy but also reduces token consumption, highlighting the effectiveness of utilizing self signals in enhancing both the performance and efficiency of multi-agent debate systems.

2510.06847.tldr: Evaluation results show that OpenJAI-v1.0 improves on the capabilities of its base model and outperforms other leading open-source Thai models on a diverse suite of benchmarks, while avoiding catastrophic forgetting.

2510.06852.tldr: The results of the research experiments show that RF can forecast data from commercial banks with a 90% accuracy rate, and the three machine learning methods proposed accurately predict the likelihood of rural bank bankruptcy.

2510.06857.tldr: This work proposes the Autoformalizer with Tool Feedback (ATF), a novel approach that incorporates syntactic and consistency information as tools into the formalization process, and demonstrates excellent inference scaling properties.

2510.06860.tldr: A Hybrid Heterogeneous Message Passing Neural Network is proposed that integrates a heterogeneous graph neural network with a scalable transformer and physics-informed positional encodings, and an approach that ensures robust N-1 generalization to high-impact contingencies through targeted augmentation of the training data is developed.

2510.06878.tldr: Tree-Guided Policy Refinement (TGPR), a novel framework that combines GRPO with a Thompson-Sampling-based tree search, is introduced, offering a general framework for enhancing iterative refinement and stateful reasoning in LLMs.

2510.06880.tldr: This work introduces MoRE-GNN (Multi-omics Relational Edge Graph Neural Network), a heterogeneous graph autoencoder that combines graph convolution and attention mechanisms to dynamically construct relational graphs directly from data.

2510.06882.tldr: A Multi-dimensional Autoscaling Platform (MUDAP) that supports fine-grained vertical scaling across both service- and resource-level dimensions and can infer an accurate regression model in merely 20 iterations is introduced.

2510.06888.tldr: This work introduces M3Retrieve, a Multimodal Medical Retrieval Benchmark, and evaluates leading multimodal retrieval models on this benchmark to explore the challenges specific to different medical specialities and to understand their impact on retrieval performance.

2510.06907.tldr: Comparative evaluations with state-of-the-art DCC methods on diverse benchmarks, along with empirical validation of theoretical insights, confirm its superior performance, scalability, and overall real-world effectiveness.

2510.06911.tldr: An integrated development environment is presented to overcome hurdles of modeling AJAN agents and at the same time to extend the user community for AJAN by the possibility to leverage Large Language Models for agent engineering.

2510.06919.tldr: A Bayesian non-parametric approach using a hierarchical Dirichlet process as a prior on the parameters of a Switching Linear Dynamical System and a Gaussian process prior to model the statistical variations in amplitude and temporal alignment within each cluster is developed.

2510.06938.tldr: The proposed method, called the Quantum Fusion Layer (QFL), replaces classical fusion schemes with a hybrid quantum-classical procedure that uses parameterized quantum circuits to learn entangled feature interactions without requiring exponential parameter growth.

2510.06949.tldr: Grouped Differential Attention is proposed, a novel approach that introduces unbalanced head allocation between signal-preserving and noise-control groups that significantly enhances signal focus by strategically assigning more heads to signal extraction and fewer to noise-control, stabilizing the latter through controlled repetition (akin to GQA).

2510.06965.tldr: This work uses a joint human expert-LLM judge approach to evaluate over 11,000 MWPs generated by open and closed LLMs and develops the first teacher-annotated dataset for standards-aligned educational MWP generation, showing their models'MWPs are more similar to human-written MWPs than those from existing models.

2510.06967.tldr: In this paper, a novel method named DirectGaussian is proposed, which focuses on generating the surfaces of 3D objects represented by surfels, and incorporates curvature constraints on the generated surface during optimization process.

2510.06969.tldr: This work proposesMapGR, an architecture designed to learn and utilize a global representations from queries, which introduces two synergistic modules: a Global Representation Learning (GRL) module, which encourages the distribution of all queries to better align with the global map through a carefully designed holistic segmentation task, and a Global Representation Guidance (GRG) module.

2510.06975.tldr: An AI-based deception framework called VelLMes is presented, which can simulate multiple protocols and services such as SSH Linux shell, MySQL, POP3, and HTTP, and offers a variety of choices for deception design based on the users' needs.

2510.06997.tldr: These findings challenge the assumption that LLMs behave like human evaluators and highlight the need for greater robustness and improved input integration in future model development.

2510.07000.tldr: A human-in-the-loop pipeline that combines translations with synthetic expansion to produce reliable and diverse Indic post-training data, providing a foundation for more inclusive and effective multilingual LLMs.

2510.07022.tldr: Experimental results show that existing methods perform poorly in realistic settings, while this approach consistently outperforms them, and FedCCCU offers a practical and scalable solution for real-world FU.

2510.07035.tldr: FlexMol is proposed, a flexible molecule pre-training framework that learns unified molecular representations while supporting single-modality input, and enables a multistage continuous learning process where both modalities contribute collaboratively during training, while ensuring robustness when only one modality is available during inference.

2510.07053.tldr: The results indicate that the model learns noise-robust, semantically salient relations about place definition, thereby enabling explainable registration under challenging visual and structural variations.

2510.07064.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework to construct a set of agents that collectively capture the diversity of a given human population through in-context learning and develops methods that offer different trade-offs regarding time complexity and performance guarantees.

2510.07073.tldr: To the knowledge, VRPAgent is the first LLM-based paradigm to advance the state-of-the-art in VRPs, highlighting a promising future for automated heuristics discovery.

2510.07074.tldr: Evidence is provided that cross-lingual instruction tuning not only improves representational alignment across languages but also the model's generative capabilities in Luxembourgish, highlighting how cross-lingual data curation can avoid the common pitfalls of machine-translated data and directly benefit low-resource language development.

2510.07077.tldr: This paper provides a systematic review of VLAs, covering their strategy and architectural transition, architectures and building blocks, modality-specific processing techniques, and learning paradigms, and to support the deployment of VLAs in real-world robotic applications.

2510.07091.tldr: This paper systematically study the effectiveness of two different action representations, proposes cognitive bandwidth perspective as a conceptual framework to qualitatively understand the differences, and empirically observe a representation-choice inflection point between ALFWorld and SciWorld, which serve as evidence of the need for scalable representations.

2510.07092.tldr: This work adapts the video generation foundation model Wan-2.2 TI2V-5B to video-state-conditioned future frame prediction, and trains a Spatio-Temporal Transformer model from scratch for compression, securing 1st place in both challenges.

2510.07105.tldr: The system for modeling human variation leverages language models' in-context learning abilities, along with a two-step meta-learning training procedure for post-training on many datasets requiring in-context learning and specializing the model via in-context meta-learning to the particular data distribution of interest.

2510.07129.tldr: This work proposes graph-based object-level representations for Graph-Conditioned-Diffusion, which generates graph nodes corresponding to each major structure in the image, encapsulating their individual features and relationships and is evaluated using a real-world histopathology use case.

2510.07133.tldr: A digital twin-driven metamorphic testing framework that addresses challenges by creating a virtual replica of the self-driving system and its operating environment by combining digital twin technology with AI-based image generative models such as Stable Diffusion.

2510.07134.tldr: A novel Vision-Language-Action model that enhances embodied visual tracking with two key modules, a spatial reasoning mechanism and a Target Identification Memory (TIM), which introduces a Chain-of-Thought paradigm, termed Polar-CoT, which infers the target's relative position and encodes it as a compact polar-coordinate token for action prediction.

2510.07161.tldr: This work proposes an interactive framework that incorporates domain knowledge, expressed in natural language, into the process discovery pipeline using Large Language Models (LLMs), and presents a fully implemented tool that supports this workflow and an extensive evaluation of multiple LLMs and prompt engineering strategies.

2510.07217.tldr: This work proposes a plug-and-play multi-agent system called GenPilot, integrating error analysis, clustering-based adaptive exploration, fine-grained verification, and a memory module for iterative optimization that operates directly on the input text.

2510.07268.tldr: The article attempts to answer three questions posed by Albert Sabater at the Debate Session of the AIHUB (CSIC) and EduCaixa Summer School, about the protection of fundamental rights in the development of AI without falling into the false dichotomy between regulation and innova-tion.

2510.07293.tldr: This work introduces AudioMarathon, a benchmark designed to evaluate both understanding and inference efficiency on long-form audio and believes it will drive the audio and multimodal research community to develop more advanced audio understanding models capable of solving complex audio tasks.

2510.07297.tldr: This work demonstrates how a generative-AI based workflow enables media researchers and analysts to query relevant historical plays using natural language rather than traditional filter-and-click interfaces, significantly increasing the NFL's operational efficiency and allowing users to focus on producing creative content and engaging storylines.

2510.07304.tldr: Cocoon is proposed, a hardware-software co-designed framework for efficient training with correlated noises that accelerates models with embedding tables through pre-computing and storing correlated noises in a coalesced format, and supports large models through a custom near-memory processing device.

2510.07307.tldr: Evaluation on the generated tasks shows that the performance of eight mainstream and cutting-edge LLMs on MLE-Smith tasks is strongly correlated with their performance on carefully human-designed tasks, highlighting the effectiveness of the MLE-Smith to scaling up MLE tasks, while maintaining task quality.

2510.07315.tldr: This work identifies core factors of the vibe check, providing a concrete path for benchmarking and developing models that better align with user preferences in coding, and presents VeriCode, a taxonomy of 30 verifiable code instructions together with corresponding deterministic verifiers.

2306.10224.tldr: It is shown that bloated disclosure is associated with adverse capital market consequences, such as lower price efficiency and higher information asymmetry, and the model is effective at constructing targeted summaries that identify firms'(non-)financial performance.

2309.02185.tldr: BEVTrack directly estimates object motion in Bird's-Eye View (BEV) using a single regression loss to enhance accuracy for targets with diverse attributes, and learns adaptive likelihood functions tailored to individual targets, avoiding the limitations of fixed distribution assumptions in previous methods.

2309.15458.tldr: A novel neural layer, LogicMP, whose layers perform mean-field variational inference over an MLN, which can be plugged into any off-the-shelf neural network to encode FOLCs while retaining modularity and efficiency.

2310.20141.tldr: A temporal difference version of contrastive predictive coding that stitches together pieces of different time series data to decrease the amount of data required to learn predictions of future events is introduced.

2311.01057.tldr: This paper illustrates the design and implementation of tiny machine-learning algorithms exploiting novel low-power processors to enable prolonged continuous operation in smart glasses for real-time object detection and develops a family of novel tiny deep-learning models based on YOLO with sub-million parameters customized for microcontroller-based inference.

2401.02843.tldr: There was broad agreement that research aimed at minimizing risks from AI systems ought to be more prioritized and research aimed at minimizing risks from AI systems ought to be more prioritized.

2403.10750.tldr: DORIS, a framework that leverages Large Language Models to integrate medical knowledge, utilizes LLMs to annotate user texts against established medical diagnostic criteria and to summarize historical posts into temporal mood courses, highlighting its potential as a supportive clinical tool.

2404.02944.tldr: The use of Transformer neural networks, with a Masked Auto-Encoder architecture, as Foundation Models for Structural Health Monitoring demonstrates the ability of these models to learn generalizable representations from multiple large datasets through self-supervised pre-training, which allows them to outperform state-of-the-art traditional methods on diverse tasks.

2405.11143.tldr: OpenRLHF is introduced, a user-friendly, scalable, and easy-to-learn open-source RLHF framework built upon Ray, vLLM, DeepSpeed, and HuggingFace Transformers, featuring a simplified design, clear code structure, and comprehensive documentation to facilitate entry for researchers and practitioners.

2409.00310.tldr: Wearable sensors and IoT/IoMT platforms support wrist-worn actimetry as a digital biomarker of FA that complements questionnaires and may facilitate privacy-preserving clinical translation.

2409.04922.tldr: Findings show that CCP-NN considerably improves classification accuracy and significantly outperforms CCP in computational runtime, and is applied to a range of machine-learning problems.

2409.13694.tldr: A standardize a benchmark dataset that combines structured and unstructured knowledge across diverse and complementary domains and develops a plug-and-play RAG framework, PruningRAG, whose main characteristic is the use of multi-granularity pruning strategies to optimize the integration of relevant information while minimizing misleading context.

2410.10190.tldr: The use of LLM embeddings over string inputs for in-context regression in Bayesian Optimization shows that representing inputs as strings enables general-purpose regression across diverse domains, including synthetic, combinatorial, and hyperparameter optimization.

2410.17933.tldr: This paper proposes a framework for global healthcare modelling using datasets from multi-continents while without sharing the local datasets, and chooses glucose management as a study model to verify its effectiveness.

2410.20600.tldr: An implementation of the protocol is provided, and empirical evidence of using the implementation to mediate interactions between an LLM and a human-agent in two areas of scientific interest (radiology and drug design) is provided.

2411.02886.tldr: This paper proposes Dynamic Token-Level KV Cache Selection (TokenSelect), a training-free method for efficient and accurate long-context inference and designs the Selection Cache based on observations of consecutive Query similarity and implemented the efficient Paged Dot Product Kernel, significantly reducing the selection overhead.

2411.15876.tldr: It is demonstrated that DUA-D2C improves generalization performance even when applied on top of other regularization methods, establishing it as a theoretically grounded and effective approach to combating overfitting in modern deep learning.

2412.00300.tldr: This work uses an evolutionary approach to generate a population of symbolic goal specifications with slight differences from the initial translation, and utilizes a trained LSTM-based validation model to assess whether each induced plan in the population adheres to the natural language specifications.

2412.01936.tldr: A novel approach to tackle binary classification tasks with imbalanced classes by leveraging Universum points to support the minority class within quadratic twin support vector machine models, showing superior performance compared to conventional classifiers and existing methods for imbalanced classification.

2412.05393.tldr: HiVeGen is proposed, a hierarchical LLM-based Verilog generation framework that decomposes generation tasks into LLM-manageable hierarchical submodules and harnesses the advantages of such hierarchical structures by integrating automatic Design Space Exploration into hierarchy-aware prompt generation, and enabling real-time human-computer interaction to lower error-correction cost.

2501.04694.tldr: A novel feature tree-based synthesis framework, which revolves around hierarchical code features derived from high-level abstractions of code, that provides precise control over the complexity of the generated code, enabling functionalities that range from function-level operations to multi-file scenarios.

2501.15081.tldr: This work proposes a systematic framework to evaluate the capability of LLMs to engage with problem structures and proposes a comprehensive evaluation framework that rigorously assesses the output fidelity of LLM-based operators across different stages of the evolutionary process.

2502.03438.tldr: This paper presents BFS-Prover, a scalable expert iteration framework, featuring three key innovations, and challenges the perceived necessity of complex tree search methods, demonstrating that BFS can achieve competitive performance when properly scaled.

2502.05957.tldr: This work introduces AutoAgent-a Fully-Automated and highly Self-Developing framework that enables users to create and deploy LLM agents through Natural Language Alone, and serves as a versatile multi-agent system for General AI Assistants.

2503.00096.tldr: The Bioinformatics Benchmark (BixBench) is presented, a dataset comprising over 50 real-world scenarios of practical biological data analysis with nearly 300 associated open-answer questions designed to measure the ability of LLM-based agents to explore biological datasets, perform long, multi-step analytical trajectories, and interpret the nuanced results of those analyses.

2503.02233.tldr: The Explicit Knowledge Boundary Modeling (EKBM) framework is proposed, integrating fast and slow reasoning systems to harmonize reliability and usability, and reveals that refinement substantially boosts accuracy while maintaining low computational overhead.

2503.02783.tldr: This work proposes Target-DPO, a new preference alignment framework that mimics human iterative debugging to refine Code LLMs and introduces the CodeFlow dataset, where samples are iteratively refined until passing tests, with modifications capturing error corrections.

2503.04596.tldr: This paper outlines the next frontier of LLM applications, characterizing them through three interconnected layers: infrastructure, protocol, and application, and describes their responsibilities and roles of each layer and demonstrates how to mitigate existing fragmentation limitations and improve security and scalability.

2503.17753.tldr: Tox-chat, a Korean chemical toxicity information agent devised within these limitations is presented, with a context-efficient architecture that reduces token consumption through hierarchical section search, and a scenario-based dialogue generation methodology that effectively distills tool-using capabilities from larger models.

2503.18156.tldr: An empirical and legal analysis of watermarking and AI labelling measures are provided, which finds that only a minority number of AI image generators currently implement adequate watermarking and deep fake labelling practices.

2503.22233.tldr: EDU-PRM is introduced, a novel entropy-driven training framework for process reward modeling that enables dynamic, uncertainty-aligned segmentation of complex reasoning steps, eliminating the need for costly manual step annotations and paving the way for more efficient and robust approaches to complex mathematical problem solving.

2503.23798.tldr: FlexiDepth, a method that dynamically adjusts the number of Transformer layers used in text generation by incorporating a plug-in router and adapter, enables adaptive computation in LLMs without modifying their original parameters.

2504.00218.tldr: This work designs apermutation-invariant adversarial attack that optimizes prompt distribution across latency and bandwidth-constraint network topologies to bypass distributed safety mechanisms within the system and demonstrates that existing defenses fail to prohibit the attack, exposing critical vulnerabilities in multi-agent systems.

2504.01444.tldr: PiCo, a novel jailbreaking framework designed to progressively bypass multi-tiered defense mechanisms in advanced MLLMs, is presented, using token-level typographic attacks to evade input filtering and embedding harmful intent within programming context instructions to bypass runtime monitoring.

2504.05220.tldr: This study offers a comprehensive approach to utilizing LLM annotations for initializing QA systems on new corpora and shows that LLM-generated annotations enhance out-of-domain retrieval performance and improve RAG outcomes compared to models trained solely on human annotations or downstream QA metrics.

2504.10063.tldr: TOHA, a TOpology-based HAllucination detector in the RAG setting, is introduced, which leverages a topological divergence metric to quantify the structural properties of graphs induced by attention matrices and suggests that analyzing the topological structure of attention matrices can serve as an efficient and robust indicator of factual reliability in LLMs.

2504.16460.tldr: T-VEC (Telecom Vectorization Model), a domain-adapted embedding model fine-tuned from the gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct backbone using a triplet loss objective, surpasses MPNet, BGE, Jina and E5, demonstrating superior domain grounding and semantic precision in telecom-specific retrieval.

2504.18114.tldr: Large-scale empirical evaluation of 6 diverse sets of hallucination detection metrics reveals concerning gaps in current hallucination evaluation, and underscores the need for more robust metrics to understand and quantify hallucinations, and better strategies to mitigate them.

2505.05145.tldr: A novel optimization method is introduced that localizes the model's few-shot ability to only a few attention heads, and derives a mathematical identity relating ``aggregation''and ``extraction''subspaces for attention heads, allowing us to track the flow of information from individual examples to a final aggregated concept.

2505.08435.tldr: Hakim is a novel state-of-the-art Persian text embedding model that achieves a 8.5% performance improvement over existing approaches on the FaMTEB benchmark, outperforming all previously developed Persian language models.

2505.13527.tldr: LogiBreak is introduced, a novel and universal black-box jailbreak method that leverages logical expression translation to circumvent LLM safety systems and preserve the underlying semantic intent and readability while evading safety constraints.

2505.14756.tldr: LLINBO: LLM-in-the-Loop BO is proposed, a hybrid framework for BO that combines LLMs with statistical surrogate experts (e.g., Gaussian Processes (GP), to leverage contextual reasoning strengths of LLMs for early exploration, while relying on principled statistical models to guide efficient exploitation.

2505.16567.tldr: An attack is proposed, FAB (Finetuning-activated Adversarial Behaviors), which compromises an LLM via meta-learning techniques that simulate downstream finetuning, explicitly optimizing for the emergence of adversarial behaviors in the finetuned models.

2505.17281.tldr: This work formally defines and quantifies sub-optimal search behaviors and demonstrates a crucial link between these inefficiencies and the models'uncertainty regarding their own knowledge boundaries, where response accuracy correlates with model's uncertainty in its search decisions.

2505.19644.tldr: STOPA is introduced, a systematically varied and metadata-rich dataset for deepfake speech source tracing, covering 8 AMs, 6 VMs, and diverse parameter settings across 700k samples from 13 distinct synthesisers, ensuring higher attribution reliability.

2505.20321.tldr: BiomedSQL is introduced, the first benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate scientific reasoning in text-to-SQL generation over a real-world biomedical knowledge base and provides a new foundation for advancing text-to-SQL systems capable of supporting scientific discovery through robust reasoning over structured biomedical knowledge bases.

2505.20435.tldr: By quantifying the shape of activation point clouds and neuron-level information flow, this framework reveals geometric invariants of representational change that complement existing linear interpretability methods.

2505.20875.tldr: Trans-EnV is introduced, a framework that automatically transforms SAE datasets into multiple English varieties to evaluate the linguistic robustness of large Language Models on multiple non-standard English varieties and reveals significant performance disparities.

2505.21904.tldr: CAST, a semi-supervised knowledge distillation (SSKD) framework that compresses pre-trained vision foundation models (VFM) into compact experts using limited labeled and abundant unlabeled data, is introduced.

2505.22021.tldr: This work presents Global with Local Parametric Generation Enhancement Network (GL-PGENet), a novel architecture designed for multi-degraded color document images, ensuring both efficiency and robustness in real-world scenarios.

2505.23742.tldr: This work introduces MAGREF, a unified and effective framework for any-reference video generation that incorporates masked guidance and a subject disentanglement mechanism, enabling flexible synthesis conditioned on diverse reference images and textual prompts.

2506.04810.tldr: This work introduces FineLogic, a fine-grained evaluation framework that assesses logical reasoning across three dimensions: overall accuracy, stepwise soundness, and representation-level probing, and conducts a comprehensive study on how different supervision formats in fine-tuning shape reasoning abilities.

2506.08022.tldr: A novel preference learning framework, Modality-Balancing Preference Optimization (MBPO), is proposed to address the modality imbalance in LMMs and can enhance LMM performance on challenging vision-language tasks and effectively reduce hallucinations.

2506.08894.tldr: A Product of Experts (PoE) framework that performs inference-time knowledge composition from heterogeneous models shows practical benefits in image and video synthesis tasks, yielding better controllability than monolithic methods and additionally providing flexible user interfaces for specifying visual generation goals.

2506.08902.tldr: A probabilistic model to predict which states an agent will visit in the temporally distant future using flow matching using flow matching, and includes in the model a latent variable capturing the user intention that increases the expressivity of the model, and enables adaptation with generalized policy improvement.

2506.09513.tldr: ReasonMed, the largest medical reasoning dataset to date, is introduced and it is found that integrating detailed CoT reasoning with concise answer summaries yields the most robust fine-tuning results.

2506.11113.tldr: This paper investigates the robustness of LLMs used as automated reviewers in the presence of adversarial attacks, and offers a comprehensive evaluation of LLM performance in automated peer reviewing and analyzes its robustness against adversarial attacks.

2506.12263.tldr: A comprehensive overview of current methodologies and organizing them around four shared performance objectives by different domains enables meaningful cross-domain comparisons and offers practical insights for selecting and designing foundation model based solutions for new IoT tasks.

2506.16724.tldr: It is found that mitigating prompt-introduced bias improves uncertainty quantification in GPT-4o and Qwen2-VL tasks and deepen the understanding of bias mitigation for uncertainty quantification and potentially inform the development of more advanced techniques.

2506.18952.tldr: HOLA is introduced, an end-to-end optimization framework for efficient LLM deployment that leverages Hierarchical Speculative Decoding (HSD) for faster inference without quality loss and blends structured pruning and quantization.

2507.02983.tldr: This work presents a rigorous benchmarking framework using a dataset of over 1,000 health questions to assess model performance across honesty, helpfulness, and harmlessness and highlights trade-offs between factual reliability and safety among evaluated models.

2507.03336.tldr: An open corpus of 5000 production-grade enterprise API specifications paired with rigorously validated, disambiguation-focused dialogues is released, offering a practical blueprint for building reliable, enterprise-ready tool-calling agents.

2507.06223.tldr: New metrics for LLM-based rerankers are proposed and an interpretable FLOPs estimator is developed to estimate the FLOPs of an LLM-based reranker even without running any experiments, studying the efficiency-effectiveness trade-off and bringing this issue to the attention of the research community.

2507.13468.tldr: The ERR@HRI 2.0 Challenge provides a multimodal dataset of LLM-powered conversational robot failures during human-robot conversations and encourages researchers to benchmark machine learning models designed to detect robot failures.

2507.14730.tldr: A new synthesis of agentic AI and participatory urbanism that integrates AI capabilities with domain expertise and public engagement is called for, calling for a new synthesis of agentic AI and participatory urbanism that integrates AI capabilities with domain expertise and public engagement.

2507.16347.tldr: HPGNN introduces an efficient high-order approximation of Personalized PageRank to capture long-range and multiscale node interactions and embedding higher-order structural information into convolutional networks, which effectively models key interactions across diverse graph dimensions.

2507.17717.tldr: This work proposes a pipeline that systematically distills real user feedback into structured checklists for note evaluation, designed to be interpretable, grounded in human feedback, and enforceable by LLM-based evaluators.

2507.19102.tldr: The approach focuses on utility-based selection rather than ranking, enabling dynamic passage selection tailored to specific queries without the need for fixed thresholds, and indicates that for complex questions, utility-based selection is more effective than relevance ranking in enhancing answer generation performance.

2507.19195.tldr: Findings underscore the need for dialect-aware evaluation, content-level stereotype auditing, and training protocols that explicitly decouple style from toxicity to prevent bias amplification through seemingly minor, style-based contamination.

2508.01696.tldr: This work proposes Collaborative Chain-of-Agents, a framework designed to enhance explicitly synergy over both parametric and retrieved knowledge, and develops CoCoA, a long-chain training strategy that synthesizes extended multi-agent reasoning trajectories from CoCoA-zero to fine-tune the LLM.

2508.09616.tldr: This work proposes MInDI-3D (Medical Inversion by Direct Iteration in 3D), a 3D conditional diffusion framework that restores volumetric data from sparse-view inputs to enable a 16-fold reduction in radiation exposure in Cone Beam Computed Tomography by acquiring fewer projections.

2508.14053.tldr: MAHL is proposed, a hierarchical LLM-based chiplet design generation framework that features six agents which collaboratively enable AI algorithm-hardware mapping, including hierarchical description generation, retrieval-augmented code generation, diverseflow-based validation, and multi-granularity design space exploration.

2508.14828.tldr: This work systematically investigates four key stages of model development--scaling, pretraining, post-training, and inference--to understand how long CoT capabilities extend beyond English, and finds that scaling reasoning model size improves multilingual task performance in En-CoT, but Target-CoT performance lags behind.

2509.00088.tldr: This work proposes AEGIS, an Automated co-Evolutionary framework for Guarding prompt Injections Schema, which enables both attackers and defenders to autonomously evolve via a Textual Gradient Optimization (TGO) module, leveraging feedback from an LLM-guided evaluation loop.

2509.05258.tldr: The large language model pretraining pipeline is demystified somewhat - in particular with respect to distributed training, managing large datasets across hundreds of nodes, and scaling up data parallelism with an emphasis on fully leveraging available GPU compute capacity.

2509.06493.tldr: The BFS-Prover-V2 system is introduced, a novel multi-turn off-policy RL framework for continually improving the performance of LLM step-prover at training time and a planner-enhanced multi-agent search architecture that scales reasoning capabilities at inference time.

2509.06694.tldr: This work introduces the Barycentric Neural Network (BNN): a compact shallow architecture that encodes both structure and parameters through a fixed set of base points and their associated barycentric coordinates, showing that the BNN enables the exact representation of continuous piecewise linear functions (CPLFs), ensuring strict continuity across segments.

2509.08729.tldr: The results demonstrate that structure-level search is a reproducible route to stronger single-turn probes and underscore the importance of threshold calibration and cross-model evaluation.

2509.08827.tldr: Research applying RL to LLMs and LRMs for reasoning abilities is examined, especially since the release of DeepSeek-R1, including foundational components, core problems, training resources, and downstream applications, to identify future opportunities and directions for this rapidly evolving area.

2509.09685.tldr: In the LLM-as-a-judge and subjective evaluation experiments, TalkPlayData 2 achieved the proposed goal in various aspects related to training a generative recommendation model for music.

2509.10510.tldr: This work presents an interpretable graph-based learning framework named FireGNN that integrates trainable fuzzy rules into GNNs for medical image classification, believed to be the first integration of trainable fuzzy rules within a GNN.

2509.11552.tldr: This paper first analyzes why existing RAG evaluation benchmarks are inadequate for assessing document chunking quality, specifically due to evidence sparsity, and proposes HiCBench, which includes manually annotated multi-level document chunking points, synthesized evidence-dense quetion answer(QA) pairs, and their corresponding evidence sources.

2509.14257.tldr: A student-centered framework in which the student generates training trajectories and the teacher corrects only the earliest error, producing training data matched to the student's ability and exposing specific weaknesses, which encourages autonomous problem-solving beyond imitation and enhances training stability.

2509.14830.tldr: ProtoMedX's prototype-based architecture is explainable by design, crucial for medical applications, especially in the context of the upcoming EU AI Act, as it allows explicit analysis of the model's decisions, especially the ones that are incorrect.

2509.15799.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical framework that combines tactical decision-making via reinforcement learning (RL) with low-level execution through Model Predictive Control (MPC), which means that high-level policies select abstract targets from structured regions of interest (ROIs) while MPC ensures dynamically feasible and safe motion.

2509.16622.tldr: An empirical study on using the diffusion-based large language model LLaDA for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and its use as an external deliberation-based processing module for Whisper-LLaMA transcripts, exploring random masking, low-confidence masking, and semi-autoregressive strategies.

2509.17694.tldr: This work contributes a multi-turn benchmark exposing LLM degradation in knowledge-grounded role-play dialogues and provides a validated hybrid evaluation framework to guide the reliable integration of LLMs in training simulations.

2509.22745.tldr: SafeMoE directly mitigates routing drift by penalizing the gap between the routing weights of a fine-tuned model and those of the initial safety-aligned model, thereby preserving the safety-aligned routing of harmful inputs to safety-critical experts.

2509.23206.tldr: PARL-MT is introduced, a framework that explicitly incorporates progress awareness into LLM training for multi-turn function calling and significantly outperforms existing methods, highlighting the effectiveness of progress awareness in enabling robust and efficient multi-turn function calling.

2509.24761.tldr: A Spatial-Functional Awareness Transformer-based Graph Archetype Contrastive Learning (SFTG) framework to enhance EEG-based visual decoding and introduces the EEG Graph Transformer (EGT), a novel graph-based neural architecture that simultaneously encodes spatial brain connectivity and temporal neural dynamics.

2509.25256.tldr: The Sandbox Configurator is proposed, a modular open-source framework that enables users to select domain-relevant tests from a shared library and generate customised sandbox environments with integrated dashboards to support a scalable and innovation-friendly European infrastructure for trustworthy AI governance.

2509.26058.tldr: This framework bridges the gap between clinical applicability and computational efficiency, which enables real-time use in wearable brain-computer interfaces and challenges the ubiquitous dependence on model depth for EEG artifact detection by demonstrating that domain-informed feature fusion surpasses complex architecture in noisy scenarios.

2509.26633.tldr: OmniRetarget is an interaction-preserving data generation engine based on an interaction mesh that explicitly models and preserves the crucial spatial and contact relationships between an agent, the terrain, and manipulated objects, and generates kinematically feasible trajectories.

2510.02173.tldr: Experiments on the RAGTruth benchmark show that RL4HS surpasses pretrained reasoning models and supervised fine-tuning, demonstrating the necessity of reinforcement learning with span-level rewards for detecting hallucination spans.

2510.02227.tldr: Adaptive Multi-Guidance Policy Optimization (AMPO) is introduced, a novel framework that adaptively leverages guidance from multiple proficient teacher models, but only when the on-policy model fails to generate correct solutions.

2510.03288.tldr: This paper proposes LogAction, a novel log-based anomaly detection model based on active domain adaptation that integrates transfer learning and active learning techniques and addresses the data distribution gap in transfer learning with minimal human labeling efforts.

2510.03426.tldr: The results show that the implementation of GOOMs, combined with efficient parallel scanning, offers a scalable and numerically robust alternative to conventional floating-point numbers for high-dynamic-range applications.

2510.04097.tldr: This work presents WebRenderBench, a large-scale benchmark of 45.1k webpages collected from real-world portal sites, offering greater diversity, complexity, and realism than prior benchmarks, and introduces the Automated Layout and Style Inspection Agent (ALISA), which integrates this metric into reinforcement learning as a reward signal to enhance training on crawled asymmetric webpages.

2510.04363.tldr: The MacroBench benchmark, a code-first benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs can synthesize reusable browser-automation programs (macros) from natural-language goals by reading HTML/DOM and emitting Selenium, is introduced to enable reproducible assessment of macro synthesis for web automation.

2510.05096.tldr: PaperTalker is proposed, the first multi-agent framework for academic presentation video generation that integrates slide generation with effective layout refinement by a novel effective tree search visual choice, cursor grounding, subtitling, speech synthesis, and talking-head rendering.

2510.05106.tldr: It is demonstrated that rule formats with low syntactic entropy and highly concentrated anchors reduce attention entropy and improve pointer fidelity, but a fundamental trade-off between anchor redundancy and attention entropy is revealed that previous work failed to recognize.

2510.05150.tldr: This work proposes Chronological Thinking, a on-the-fly conversational thinking mechanism that aims to improve response quality in full-duplex SDLMs and presents a paradigm shift from conventional LLM thinking approaches, such as Chain-of-Thought, purpose-built for streaming acoustic input.

2510.05191.tldr: This work proposes a general framework for speech attribute conversion, accompanied by theoretical analysis and guarantees under reasonable assumptions, and builds on a non-probabilistic autoencoder architecture with an independence constraint between the predicted latent variable and the target controllable variable.

2510.05492.tldr: It is demonstrated that ECG synthesizers, trained with the proposed time-frequency structural regularization scheme, can serve as personalized, high-fidelity, privacy-preserving surrogates when real data are scarce, advancing the responsible use of generative AI in healthcare.

2510.05858.tldr: This work explores continual pre-training as a scalable, self-supervised approach to adapt LLMs for downstream summarization tasks, particularly in the context of noisy real-world conversation transcripts, providing practical guidelines for applying continual pre-training in summarization-focused industrial applications.

2510.06107.tldr: This work proposes Distributional Semantics Tracing (DST), a unified framework that integrates established interpretability techniques to produce a causal map of a model's reasoning, treating meaning as a function of context (distributional semantics).

2510.06223.tldr: A concrete architecture that enables GUIs to interface with LLM-based speech-enabled assistants and future-proofs apps for upcoming OS super assistants that employ computer use agents (CUAs) and natively consume MCP if an application provides it.

2510.06674.tldr: An Agent-in-the-Loop (AITL) framework that implements a continuous data flywheel for iteratively improving an LLM-based customer support system demonstrates significant improvements in retrieval accuracy, generation quality, helpfulness and agent adoption rates.

2510.06677.tldr: An incremental summarization system for customer support agents that intelligently determines when to generate concise bullet notes during conversations, reducing agents' context-switching effort and redundant review and demonstrating that incremental summarization with continuous feedback effectively enhances summary quality and agent productivity at scale.

2510.06858.tldr: It is suggested that adapting AI architectures with improved contouring methods can enhance object detection on raw images, improving onboard AI for remote sensing.

2510.06908.tldr: Results support using PUGenAIS-9 to identify problematic GenAI use and show the need to rethink digital addiction with an ICD (infrastructures, content, and device) model to keep addiction research responsive to new media while avoiding over-pathologizing.

2510.07024.tldr: A deep tour into the factual knowledge of a frontier LLM, based on GPTKB v1.1.5, finds that the models'factual knowledge differs quite significantly from established knowledge bases, and that its accuracy is significantly lower than indicated by previous benchmarks.

2510.07328.tldr: This paper proposes a novel approach called MultiFair for multimodal medical classification, which addresses challenges with a dual-level gradient modulation process that outperforms state-of-the-art multimodal learning and fairness learning methods.

2510.07331.tldr: This paper introduces Truth-Aware Decoding (TAD), a verification-oriented decoding scheme that aligns neural language generation with knowledge bases with a lattice of semantic guards that operate at decode time.

2510.07345.tldr: This work introduces a dual-prediction diffusion module that jointly denoises RGB frames and optical flow, providing temporal inductive biases to improve motion modeling from limited samples and establishing $SurgiFlowVid$ as a promising strategy to mitigate data imbalance and advance surgical video understanding methods.

2510.07358.tldr: This work introduces Encode-Think-Decode (ETD), a method that enhances the reasoning capabilities of a base model by training it to iterate over a small subset of reasoning-relevant layers during the mid-training stage, and explores an adaptive depth strategy that adjusts the computation per input token.

2510.07401.tldr: The results establish learnability as a data-driven marker of phase transitions and highlight deep parallels between long-range order in condensed matter and the emergence of structure in modern language models.

2510.07409.tldr: Focusing on Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder as a case study, it is explored how generative AI has the potential to address current capacity constraints in neuropsychology, potentially enabling more personalized and longitudinal care pathways.

2510.07413.tldr: The research findings indicate that by setting appropriate filter parameters, quantum states corresponding to position points with extremely low occurrence probabilities can be effectively filtered out, thereby increasing the probability of obtaining the target quantum state.

2510.07432.tldr: Across four benchmarks spanning time series understanding and reasoning, TS-Agent matches or exceeds strong text-based, vision-based, and time-series language model baselines, with the largest gains on reasoning tasks where multimodal LLMs are prone to hallucinations and knowledge leakage in zero-shot settings.

2510.07437.tldr: An LLM-based scoring rubric LASER is introduced that leverages state-of-the-art LLMs' in-context learning abilities to learn from prompts with detailed examples to penalize morphological and syntactic nuances that do not significantly alter sentence semantics.

2510.07444.tldr: This work proposes a low degree of freedom deep neural network model, DeNN, as well as a high degree of freedom model, DSNN, to tackle the problem of risk management in peer-to-peer lending, and demonstrates that both models can significantly reduce the portfolio VaRs at different confidence levels.

2510.07456.tldr: ExpertAgent is developed, an innovative learning agent that provides users with a proactive and personalized learning experience that provides users with a proactive and personalized learning experience in real time.

2510.07477.tldr: HEMERA (Human-Explainable Transformer Model for Estimating Lung Cancer Risk using GWAS Data), a new framework that applies explainable transformer-based deep learning to GWAS data of single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) for predicting LC risk, is introduced.

2510.07489.tldr: The findings show that a vanilla, untrained LLM like ChatGPT (model o3) in a zero-shot setting is effective in understanding BPMN process models from images and answering queries about them intelligently at syntactic, logic, and semantic levels of depth.

2510.07491.tldr: This work formalizes this problem as a constrained optimization task and investigates three resolution paradigms: Mixed Integer Programming (MIP), Satisfiability (SAT), and Constraint Pro- gramming (CP).

2510.07497.tldr: This work investigates the effect of CoT fine-tuning for multi-stream speech LLMs, demonstrating that reasoning in text space improves the accuracy of speech LLMs by 2.4x, on average, over a suite of spoken reasoning tasks.

2510.07499.tldr: This work proposes an update strategy that iteratively refines templates derived from training data through natural-language feedback, and shows that optimized templates can be distilled into smaller open-source models, demonstrating its broad applicability and transparent reasoning reuse.

2510.07513.tldr: MLLM4TS is introduced, a novel framework that leverages multimodal large language models for general time-series analysis by integrating a dedicated vision branch and underscores the potential of integrating visual modalities with pretrained language models to achieve robust and generalizable time-series analysis.

2510.07524.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed wavelet-based representation, combined with ensemble learning, achieves an overall accuracy of 88.37% and a macro-averaged F1 score of 73.15%, outperforming conventional machine learning methods and exhibiting comparable  or superior performance to recent deep learning approaches.

2510.07535.tldr: OWL achieves about 5x higher acceptance length than EAGLE3 on long-context inputs through three innovations: an LSTM-based drafter conditioned only on the last-token state, a special token in the verifier that produces richer representation for drafter, and a hybrid algorithm combining both tree and non-tree decoding methods.

2510.07550.tldr: TRAVL is introduced, a fine-tuning recipe that combines a balanced training dataset with a trajectory-aware attention module to improve motion encoding and discrimination in VLMs, and ImplausiBench is proposed, a benchmark of 300 videos that removes linguistic biases and isolates visual-temporal understanding.

2510.07551.tldr: RECAP is presented, a hybrid framework that combines deterministic regular expressions with context-aware large language models (LLMs) for scalable PII detection across 13 low-resource locales and outperforms fine-tuned NER models and zero-shot LLMs in weighted F1-score.

2510.07556.tldr: A general-purpose Semantic Spectral-Spatial Fusion Network (S3FN) that uses contextual, classspecific textual descriptions to complement the training of an HSI classification model and highlights the synergy between textual semantics and spectral-spatial data.

2510.07557.tldr: This study applies BERTopic, a transformer-based topic modeling technique, to the lmsys-chat-1m dataset, a multilingual conversational corpus built from head-to-head evaluations of large language models (LLMs), uncovering thematic patterns in these conversations and examining their relation to user preferences.

2510.07566.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet effective multi-task pre-finetuning framework based on task-primary LoRA modules, which enables a single shared encoder backbone with modular adapters that achieves performance comparable to individual pre-finetuning while meeting practical deployment constraint.

2510.07578.tldr: A comparative analysis of liquid neural networks (LNNs) and traditional recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and their variants, such as long short-term memory networks (LSTMs) and gated recurrent units (GRUs), reveals that LNN demonstrates significant potential in handling noisy, non-stationary data, and achieving out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization.

2510.07579.tldr: The findings suggest that misinformation employs a deliberately complex rhetorical style combined with emotional cues, which may enhance perceived credibility and inform theoretical models of crisis communication and public health messaging strategies in networked media environments.

2510.07586.tldr: Temporal Graph Modelling (TGM) is introduced, a research-oriented library for ML on temporal graphs, the first to unify CTDG and DTDG approaches, and offers first-class support for dynamic node features, time-granularity conversions, and native handling of link-, node-, and graph-level tasks.

2510.07613.tldr: This work uses representational similarity analysis to correlate the geometric structure of the input embeddings and output embeddings of two open-source models with semantic, syntactic, and frequency-based metrics over the course of training, revealing distinct roles for word frequency and function.

2510.07614.tldr: Overall, this work provides a practical, data-driven method for designing, tracing, and debugging reliable, predictable, and accountable multi-agent systems.

2510.07621.tldr: This work provides the first empirically validated framework linking content-level user perceptions to retention outcomes in production systems, and offers a scalable, user-centered solution that advances both platform growth and user experience.

2510.07623.tldr: This work highlights key benefits of using generative AI to help train people to provide mental health services and presents a real-world case study in which generative AI improved the training of veterans to support one another's mental health.

2510.07632.tldr: Test-Time Matching (TTM), an iterative, self-improving algorithm that further bootstraps model performance without any external supervision, is proposed and demonstrated that TTM consistently improves model performance and advances the frontier of compositional reasoning.

2510.07635.tldr: A framework to enforce exploration of novel actions with a guarantee for safety while guaranteeing safe implementation of recommender systems is developed, and a novel framework called Deployment-Efficient Policy Learning for Safe User Exploration is proposed, which leverages safety margin and gradually relaxes safety regularization during multiple deployments.

2510.07645.tldr: Ryt AI is presented, an LLM-native agentic framework that powers Ryt Bank to enable customers to execute core financial transactions through natural language conversation, demonstrating that regulator-approved natural-language interfaces can reliably support core financial operations under strict governance.

2510.07651.tldr: The proposed Optimal Brain Cache (OBCache) quantifies token saliency by measuring the perturbation in attention outputs induced by pruning tokens, with closed-form scores derived for isolated keys, isolated values, and joint key-value pairs.

2510.07697.tldr: A new taxonomy is introduced that offers a unified perspective for summarizing existing approaches, categorizing reasoning-based backdoor attacks into associative, passive, and active, paving the way for further exploration of secure and trustworthy LLM communities.

2510.07709.tldr: A reproducible simulation framework for evaluating agents along three dimensions: safety improvement over time, including iterative plan revisions in text-visual scenarios; detection of unsafe activities across multiple categories of social situations; and social dynamics, measured as interaction counts and acceptance ratios of social exchanges.

2510.07715.tldr: Experimental results show that the proposed STL-guided RL method with online causation semantics outperforms existing relevant STLguided RL methods, providing a more robust and efficient reward generation framework for deep-RL.

2510.07730.tldr: DEtached value learning with Action Sequence (DEAS), a simple yet effective offline RL framework that leverages action sequences for value learning that consistently outperforms baselines on complex, long-horizon tasks from OGBench and can be applied to enhance the performance of large-scale Vision-Language-Action models that predict action sequences.

2510.07739.tldr: This work introduces a Memory-as-State-Highways (MeSH) scheme, which externalizes state management into an explicit memory buffer and employs lightweight routers to dynamically diversify computation across iterations, and establishes MeSH as a scalable and principled architecture for building stronger recursive models.

2510.07740.tldr: APPFORGE is a benchmark consisting of 101 software development problems drawn from real-world Android apps and incorporates the test cases within an automated evaluation framework that enables reproducible assessment without human intervention, making it easily adoptable for future research.

2510.07741.tldr: A two-stage framework that performs exposure correction via a ratio map to balance dynamic range, followed by a brightness-aware RAW denoiser to enhance detail recovery in dark regions is introduced, and a 9-stop bracketing pipeline is designed to synthesize realistic UHDR images and contribute a corresponding dataset.

2510.07748.tldr: The Haibu Mathematical-Medical Intelligent Agent (MMIA), an LLM-driven architecture that ensures reliability through a formally verifiable reasoning process, is introduced, making LLM technology viable for critical applications in medicine.

2510.07762.tldr: A novel framework that reframes TT-GDA as a generative graph restoration problem, GRAIL, that restores the target graph into a state that is well-aligned with the source domain, and introduces a reinforcement learning process guided by specialized alignment and confidence rewards.

2510.07768.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed systematic approach to automatically refactor an unstructured collection of tools into a structured tool library significantly improves tool retrieval accuracy and overall reasoning performance across multiple reasoning tasks.

2510.07773.tldr: TrajSkill, a framework for Trajectory Conditioned Cross-embodiment Skill Transfer, enabling robots to acquire manipulation skills directly from human demonstration videos by representing human motions as sparse optical flow trajectories, which serve as embodiment-agnostic motion cues by removing morphological variations while preserving essential dynamics.

2510.07778.tldr: Experimental results show that IntentionVLA substantially outperforms $\pi_0$, achieving 18\% higher success rates with direct instructions and 28\% higher than ECoT under intention instructions, and further enables zero-shot human-robot interaction with 40\% success rate, highlighting IntentionVLA as a promising paradigm for next-generation human-robot interaction (HRI) systems.

2510.07790.tldr: Group Contrastive Policy Optimization (GCPO) is introduced, a method that incorporates external standard reference answers and enables the model to emulate the problem solving strategy of the reference answer during training, thereby enhancing generalization in reasoning.

2510.07794.tldr: Hierarchical Process Rewards for Efficient agentic RAG (HiPRAG), a training methodology that incorporates a fine-grained, knowledge-grounded process reward into the RL training, demonstrates the importance and potential of fine-grained control through RL, for improving the efficiency and optimality of reasoning for search agents.

2510.07799.tldr: Inspired by conditional discrete graph diffusion models, GTD formulates topology synthesis as an iterative construction process that can generate highly task-adaptive, sparse, and efficient communication topologies, significantly outperforming existing methods in LLM agent collaboration.

2510.07813.tldr: A PursuitEvasion-Exposure-Concealment Game (PEEC) in which a pursuer agent must decide when to communicate in order to obtain the evader's position, and a multi-headed sequential reinforcement learning framework that integrates continuous navigation control, discrete communication actions, and opponent modeling for behavior prediction.
