2510.07822.tldr: This work proposes Selective Influence Machine Unlearning (SIMU), a two-step framework that enhances second-order optimizer-based unlearning by selectively updating only the critical neurons responsible for encoding the forget-set, achieving comparable unlearning efficacy while substantially outperforming current methods in retaining the model's original knowledge.

2510.07825.tldr: CityNav is proposed, a hierarchical, LLM-powered framework for large-scale multi-vehicle navigation that consistently outperforms nine classical path search and RL-based baselines in city-scale travel efficiency and congestion mitigation.

2510.07829.tldr: This paper introduces the Knowledge Sculptor (KS), a new professional archetype for Human-GenAI collaboration that transforms raw AI output into trustworthy, actionable knowledge.

2510.07835.tldr: This paper introduces MetaDefense, a novel framework for defending against finetuning-based jailbreak attacks in large language models (LLMs), achieving robust defense against harmful queries with seen and unseen attack templates while maintaining competitive performance on benign tasks.

2510.07841.tldr: This work explores a new test-time self-improvement method to create more effective and generalizable agentic LMs on-the-fly, and highlights the promise of TT-SI, demonstrating the potential of self-improvement algorithms at test-time as a new paradigm for building more capable agents toward self-evolution.

2510.07842.tldr: AdaSwitch allows the student to explore its predictions within its capability and selectively integrates teacher guidance only when divergence exceeds a context-aware threshold, which preserves generation consistency while ensuring high-quality supervision.

2510.07847.tldr: A novel meta-learning-based graph-level anomaly detection framework (MA-GAD), incorporating a graph compression module that reduces the graph size, mitigating noise interference while retaining essential node information, is proposed, which outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in graph-level anomaly detection under few-shot conditions.

2510.07853.tldr: This paper provides a proof-of-concept that utilizes the publicly available EmbryoNet dataset and demonstrates how representations learned via self-supervised learning can effectively identify toxicant-induced changes.

2510.07861.tldr: This work introduces DeepResearch-ReportEval, a comprehensive framework designed to assess DeepResearch systems through their most representative outputs: research reports, using an innovative LLM-as-a-Judge methodology achieving strong expert concordance.

2510.07865.tldr: This work proposes DM1 (MeanFlow with Dispersive Regularization for One-Step Robotic Manipulation), a novel flow matching framework that integrates dispersive regularization into MeanFlow to prevent collapse while maintaining one-step efficiency.

2510.07884.tldr: This work proposes Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization (ConG), a framework that employs contrastive decoding between pre- and post-alignment weak models to generate higher-quality samples and highlights the potential of ConG to advance weak-to-strong generalization and provide a promising pathway toward AGI.

2510.07889.tldr: The concept of meaningful transparency for civic AI systems is developed: transparencies that allow publics to engage with AI systems that affect their lives, connecting understanding with potential for action.

2510.07910.tldr: The proposed Multimodal DDI Prediction with Molecular Electron Localization Function (ELF) Maps (MMM), a novel framework that integrates three-dimensional (3D) quantum-chemical information into drug representation learning, demonstrates the potential of ELF-based 3D representations to enhance prediction accuracy and support safer combinatorial drug prescribing in clinical practice.

2510.07912.tldr: This paper proposes a unified Large Language Model-enhanced auto-grading framework that provides human-like evaluation for all types of subjective questions across various domains and has been successfully deployed in real-world training and certification exams at a major e-commerce enterprise.

2510.07920.tldr: FactFin, a framework that applies counterfactual perturbations to compel LLM-based agents to learn causal drivers instead of memorized outcomes, and surpasses all baselines in out-of-sample generalization, delivering superior risk-adjusted performance.

2510.07923.tldr: StepER employs step-wise supervision to align with evolving information and reasoning demands across stages and incorporates difficulty-aware training to progressively optimize learning by prioritizing suitable steps in multi-step retrieval-augmented frameworks.

2510.07925.tldr: This work builds on a unified definition of personalization as a conceptual foundation to derive technical requirements for adaptive, user-centered LLM-based agents and presents a framework that integrates persistent memory, dynamic coordination, self-validation, and evolving user profiles to enable personalized long-term interactions.

2510.07940.tldr: This work introduces Test-Time Optimization and Memorization (TTOM), a training-free framework that aligns VFM outputs with spatiotemporal layouts during inference for better text-image alignment in compositional scenarios.

2510.07943.tldr: Cypto Genetic Algorithm Agent (CGA-Agent), a pioneering hybrid framework that synergistically integrates genetic algorithms with intelligent multi-agent coordination mechanisms for adaptive trading strategy parameter optimization in dynamic financial environments, is introduced.

2510.07951.tldr: This work introduces AnimeText, a large-scale dataset containing 735K images and 4.2M annotated text blocks that features hierarchical annotations and hard negative samples tailored for anime scenarios and demonstrates that models trained on AnimeText achieve superior performance in anime text detection tasks compared to existing datasets.

2510.07958.tldr: A2Search is presented, an annotation-free, end-to-end training framework to recognize and handle ambiguity that resolves ambiguity and generalizes across benchmarks, highlighting that embracing ambiguity is essential for building more reliable QA systems.

2510.07959.tldr: It is argued that promoting diversity among samples is not essential; what matters is to select samples that maximise diversity in model responses, and the method, DISCO, shows empirical gains over prior methods, achieving state-of-the-art results in performance prediction across MMLU, Hellaswag, Winogrande, and ARC.

2510.07962.tldr: This work proposes LightReasoner, a novel framework that leverages the behavioral divergence between a stronger expert model (LLM) and a weaker amateur model (SLM) and offers a scalable and resource-efficient approach for advancing LLM reasoning.

2510.07972.tldr: Stepwise Hybrid Examination is proposed, an RL framework that ensures logical consistency through Stepwise Reward Policy Optimization (SRPO), and improves both reasoning quality and relevance-prediction accuracy in large-scale e-commerce settings, outperforming SFT, DPO, GRPO, and other baselines, while also enhancing interpretability and robustness.

2510.07975.tldr: This work introduces GRACE, a novel framework that grounds VLM-based reasoning through executable analytic concepts (EAC)-mathematically defined blueprints that encode object affordances, geometric constraints, and semantics of manipulation.

2510.07980.tldr: This paper derives upper bounds on the generalization error and excess error of MGS using stability analysis, systematically answering two key questions and provides the first unified analysis of how factors like learning rate, data heterogeneity, node count, per-node sample size, and communication topology impact the generalization of MGS under non-convex settings without the bounded gradients assumption.

2510.07983.tldr: This work proposes to predict data distributions using schema semantics, thereby avoiding raw data dependence, and introduces ZeroCard, the first semantics-driven cardinality estimation method that can be applied without any dependence on raw data access, query logs, or retraining on the target database.

2510.07984.tldr: This work demonstrates that a standard CNN can provide a near state-of-the-art result with significantly lower computational overhead, presenting a compelling case for its use in real-world scenarios where resource constraints are a primary concern.

2510.07988.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that ReInAgent effectively resolves information dilemmas and produces outcomes that are more closely aligned with genuine user preferences, and on complex tasks involving information dilemmas, ReInAgent achieves a 25% higher success rate than Mobile-Agent-v2.

2510.07993.tldr: A domain-specific caption generation system that integrates figure-related textual context with author-specific writing styles using the LaMP-Cap dataset demonstrates that combining contextual understanding with author-specific stylistic adaptation can generate captions that are both scientifically accurate and stylistically faithful to the source paper.

2510.08002.tldr: MUSE is proposed, a novel agent framework that introduces an experience-driven, self-evolving system centered around a hierarchical Memory Module that establishes a new paradigm for AI agents capable of real-world productivity task automation.

2510.08009.tldr: It is shown that language models not only represent numeric spaces as non-continuous but also introduce significant noise, which has implications for the many areas where embedding models are used, in-particular where high numerical precision, large magnitudes or mixed-sign values are common.

2510.08016.tldr: The results show that SBVs surpass prior attacks and is the first method to leverage merging to improve backdoor effectiveness, and IBVS provides a lightweight, general defense that remains effective even when the backdoor threat is entirely unknown.

2510.08022.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that FastUMI-100K enables high policy success rates across various baseline algorithms, confirming its robustness, adaptability, and real-world applicability for solving complex, dynamic manipulation challenges.

2510.08034.tldr: AILoRA is introduced, a novel parameter-efficient method that incorporates function-aware asymmetric low-rank priors that enables LoRA modules to better capture the specialized roles of attention parameters, thereby enhancing both finetuning performance and convergence efficiency.

2510.08039.tldr: Deep learning-based hepatic vessel volumetry demonstrated differences between healthy liver and chronic liver disease stages and shows correlations with established markers of disease severity, potentially serving as a non-invasive imaging biomarker.

2510.08044.tldr: Combined Uncertainty estimation for Reliable Embodied planning (CURE), which decomposes the uncertainty into epistemic and intrinsic uncertainty, each estimated separately, and is subdivided into task clarity and task familiarity for more accurate evaluation.

2510.08045.tldr: It is proved that verification tasks for quantized GNNs with readout are (co)NEXPTIME-complete, implying that the verification of quantized GNNs is computationally intractable, prompting substantial research efforts toward ensuring the safety of GNN-based systems.

2510.08046.tldr: LinguaSim is proposed, an LLM-based framework that converts natural language into realistic, interactive 3D scenarios, ensuring both dynamic vehicle interactions and faithful alignment between the input descriptions and the generated scenarios, and facilitates the creation of high-fidelity scenarios that enhance safety testing and training.

2510.08058.tldr: FedDTRE is proposed, a Federated adaptive aggregation strategy for Dialogue generation based on Trustworthiness Evaluation that leverages trustworthiness scores of both global and local models on a fairness-oriented evaluation dataset to dynamically regulate the global model's contribution during local updates.

2510.08062.tldr: This paper introduces a framework for a generative music infrastructure centred on direct attribution, transparent royalty distribution, and granular control for artists and rights'holders, and proposes two complementary forms of attribution: training-time attribution and inference-time attribution.

2510.08081.tldr: AutoQual is designed as a general framework for transforming tacit knowledge embedded in data into explicit, computable features, which mimics a human research process, iteratively generating feature hypotheses through reflection, operationalizing them via autonomous tool implementation, and accumulating experience in a persistent memory.

2510.08086.tldr: This paper presents a framework for provably fair AI that overcomes the limits of current bias mitigation methods by systematically removing all sensitive information and its proxies by using ontology engineering in OWL 2 QL and using optimal transport as the unique fair transformation.

2510.08104.tldr: An integrated socio-technical framework is developed that identifies the mechanisms driving the mental model evolution: data contextualization, reasoning transparency, and performance feedback and establishes mechanisms that guide the purposeful design of effective human-AI collaboration.

2510.08109.tldr: This work presents VersionRAG, a version-aware RAG framework that explicitly models document evolution through a hierarchical graph structure capturing version sequences, content boundaries, and changes between document states, making it practical for large-scale deployment.

2510.08113.tldr: By quantifying the value of expert data, this framework provides practical, information-theoretic algorithms for agents to intelligently decide when to learn from others.

2510.08114.tldr: This study investigates the manipulability of risk aversion (MoRA) in LMs, examining their ability to replicate human risk preferences across diverse economic scenarios, with a focus on gender-specific attitudes, uncertainty, role-based decision-making, and the manipulability of risk aversion.

2510.08120.tldr: This work proposes an approach for extracting high-level concept-based global policies from LLM-as-a-Judge, which consists of two algorithms: CLoVE (Contrastive Local Verifiable Explanations), which generates verifiable, concept-based, contrastive local explanations and GloVE (Global Verifiable Explanations), which uses iterative clustering, summarization and verification to condense local rules into a global policy.

2510.08132.tldr: Approximate Domain Unlearning is introduced, a novel problem setting that requires reducing recognition accuracy for images from specified domains while preserving accuracy for other domains (e.g., real) while preserving accuracy for others (e.g., real).

2510.08138.tldr: An attention enhancement method called Temporally Conditioned Attention Sharpening (TCAS) is proposed, which constructs an enhancement objective based on attention distinctions to enhance the model's temporal resolution capability, thereby improving its temporal understanding logic consistency.

2510.08149.tldr: This work introduces AI Knowledge Assist, a system that extracts knowledge in the form of question-answer (QA) pairs from historical customer-agent conversations to automatically build a knowledge base that eliminates the cold-start gap in contact centers by achieving above 90% accuracy in answering information-seeking questions.

2510.08152.tldr: This paper proposes Domain Adaptive Continual Instruction Pre-Training via Reading Comprehension (DACIP-RC), a continual pre-training technique that enhances smaller LLMs'domain adaptability for business conversational tasks and is the first work to apply instruction pre-training on business conversational data.

2510.08159.tldr: This work introduces quantum agents trained by episodic, reward-based reinforcement learning to autonomously rediscover several seminal quantum algorithms and protocols, opening the way for the automated design of novel quantum algorithms and protocols.

2510.08173.tldr: This work introduces the NavSpace benchmark, which contains six task categories and 1,228 trajectory-instruction pairs designed to probe the spatial intelligence of navigation agents, and proposes SNav, a new spatially intelligent navigation model.

2510.08175.tldr: PMFR is proposed, with a tempo- ral decoupling framework that fundamentally resolves the contradiction through asynchronous knowledge orchestra- tion, and outperforms brute-force scaling on Top- iOCQA.

2510.08178.tldr: This work proposes a bootstrapping algorithm that iteratively re-aligns training samples by progressively reducing variance and recovering the alignment assumption, and shows on four FGVC benchmarks that this method consistently outperforms equivariant, and canonicalization baselines while performing on par with augmentation.

2510.08197.tldr: The Tournament Tree Method is proposed, a novel elicitation and evaluation framework that overcomes cognitive effort, consistency by design, minimizes cognitive effort, and reduces the dimensionality of preference modeling from $m(m-1)/2$ to $m$ parameters.

2510.08202.tldr: A dataset of 200 human-SAV interactions is introduced, providing novel insights for designing conversational SAV interfaces and establishes a foundation for further exploration into advanced sentiment modeling, adaptive user interactions, and multimodal conversational systems.

2510.08203.tldr: The function token hypothesis is proposed to explain the workings of LLMs: During inference, function tokens activate the most predictive features from context and govern next token prediction (memory retrieval) and during pre-training, predicting the next tokens that follow function tokens increases the number of learned features of LLMs and updates the model parameters (memory consolidation).

2510.08207.tldr: DODO is introduced, an algorithm defining how an Agent can autonomously learn the causal structure of its environment through repeated interventions, and is often able to reconstruct with as low as zero errors the structure of the causal graph.

2510.08218.tldr: Exressive Value Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning (EVOR) is introduced, a scalable offline RL approach that integrates both expressive policies and expressive value functions and outperforms baselines on a diverse set of offline RL tasks, demonstrating the benefit of integrating expressive value learning into offline RL.

2510.08222.tldr: This paper revisits reasoning tasks from a causal perspective, seeking to understand their behavior in latent space and to offer insights for addressing their challenges, and introduces a framework that incorporates the estimated latent variables as feedback into the selection mechanism, thereby facilitating the learning of dense dependencies among latent representations.

2510.08238.tldr: This work proposes the Chain-of-Trigger Backdoor (CoTri), a multi-step backdoor attack designed for long-horizon agentic control that achieves stable, multi-step control within agents, improving their inherent robustness and task capabilities.

2510.08245.tldr: This work investigates the benefits of contrastive decoding for generating synthetic corpora and sees that training with a mix of synthetic data from contrastive decoding benefits tasks that require more reasoning skills, while synthetic data from traditional sampling helps more on tasks dependent on surface level linguistic capabilities.

2510.08255.tldr: ShapeLLM is introduced, an adaptation of model-free OS methods tailored for transformer-based agents that show that LLM agents can both shape and be shaped through interaction, establishing opponent shaping as a key dimension of multi-agent LLM research.

2510.08256.tldr: This work proposes Mix- and MoE-DPO, a framework that extends DPO with both soft mixture models and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, using a stochastic variational inference approach, enabling stable and efficient learning of specialized expert policies from preference data.

2510.08257.tldr: This work presents the architecture, the software development tools, and experimental results of a distributed and expandable emulation system for rapid prototyping of integrated circuits based on in-memory computing technologies and demonstrates the usefulness of the proposed emulator.

2510.08300.tldr: The use of Scale Equivariant Graph Metanetworks (ScaleGMNs) is explored, demonstrating the effectiveness of this approach empirically and providing a theoretical result: the gauge freedom induced by scaling symmetries is strictly smaller in convolutional neural networks than in multi-layer perceptrons.

2510.08308.tldr: This paper systematically analyze the rollouts of eight reasoning models on five mathematical datasets and proposes a question-aware early-stopping method that enhances inference-time token efficiency by stopping the reasoning process once a few plausible candidate answers are generated, thereby reducing unnecessary reflection steps.

2510.08317.tldr: IdeSearchFitter is introduced, a framework that employs Large Language Models (LLMs) as semantic operators within an evolutionary search and achieves competitive, noise-robust performance on the Feynman Symbolic Regression Database (FSReD), outperforming several strong baselines.

2510.08381.tldr: The artwork asks whether complex multi agent AI can become intuitively understandable by staging a competition between two reinforcement trained robot arms that snap a bedsheet skyward, and shows how sensory metaphors can turn a black box into a public interface.

2510.08383.tldr: This work proposes QAgent, a unified agentic RAG framework that employs a search agent for adaptive retrieval that excels at QA and serves as a plug-and-play module for real-world deployment.

2510.08385.tldr: This approach supports scalable, layout-aware legend parsing and improves the indexing and searchability of historical maps across various visual styles and reveals how prompt design, example counts, and layout alignment affect performance.

2510.08389.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet powerful method that quantifies uncertainty by measuring the effective rank of hidden states derived from multiple model outputs and different layers, contributing to a new paradigm of hallucination detection for LLM truthfulness.

2510.08404.tldr: Using the BabyLM challenge evaluation pipeline across complex benchmarks, Co$^4$ exhibits strong zero-shot and fine-tuning performance on SuperGLUE tasks, and suggests the need to rethink prevailing deep learning paradigms and associated scaling laws.

2510.08413.tldr: It is argued that widespread success of prompt engineering techniques can be more fully explained through more carefully considering data- or distribution-dependent perplexity, which acts as an effective prior and steers the optimization towards prompts that are more ``natural'' for the task at hand.

2510.08429.tldr: These findings demonstrate that embedding legal context into both decision and explanation pathways yields interpretable, auditable, and regulation-aligned quoting behavior consistent with Solvency II, NAIC RBC, and the EU AI Act.

2510.08456.tldr: This framework provides principled design guidance, moving activation choice from trial-and-error to provable stability and kernel conditioning, and establishes well-posedness, affine reparameterization laws with bias, and closure under bounded slope variation of phi'.

2510.08470.tldr: A lightweight decoder-based architecture with token-wise dynamic gating for adaptive fusion of linguistic and visual cues, feature modulation and channel attention to maximise the utility of limited visual information and auxiliary contrastive objectives for visual grounding is proposed.

2510.08483.tldr: This work establishes a new standard for efficient parallel reasoning, making high-performance reasoning more efficient, by proposing DeepPrune, a novel framework that enables efficient parallel scaling through dynamic pruning.

2510.08498.tldr: A novel AI-based approach for automatic radiology report generation tailored to cranial trauma cases that integrates an AC-BiFPN with a Transformer architecture to capture and process complex medical imaging data such as CT and MRI scans.

2510.08510.tldr: This work identifies a class of high-norm visual tokens from ViT, referred to as ViT attention sinks, and shows that these ViT sinks encapsulate high-level semantic concepts from images, allowing the LLM to perform more effective understanding and reasoning.

2510.08511.tldr: AutoMLGen is introduced, an LLM-based coding agent that integrates a domain knowledge base for high-quality prior guidance and Monte Carlo Graph Search for efficient exploration that achieves state-of-the-art performance in numerous dimensions.

2510.08517.tldr: This paper introduces Counterfactuals and Reasoning for Termination (CaRT), an approach for teaching LLMs when to stop seeking information, and finds that CaRT improves the efficiency of information gathering and task success rate compared to other fine-tuning methods.

2510.08531.tldr: This work designs a three-stage progressive training framework that establishes spatial perception through object localization, develops spatial understanding through multi-dimensional spatial tasks, and strengthens complex reasoning via reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and yields SpatialLadder, a 3B-parameter model that achieves state-of-the-art performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks.

2510.08532.tldr: Kontinuous Kontext is introduced, an instruction-driven editing model that provides a new dimension of control over edit strength, enabling users to adjust edits gradually from no change to a fully realized result in a smooth and continuous manner.

2510.08543.tldr: VideoNorms is introduced, a benchmark of over 1000 pairs from US and Chinese cultures annotated with socio-cultural norms grounded in speech act theory, norm adherence and violations labels, and verbal and non-verbal evidence that emphasizes the need for culturally-grounded video language model training.

2510.08553.tldr: Memoir employs imagination as a retrieval mechanism grounded by explicit memory: a world model imagines future navigation states as queries to selectively retrieve relevant environmental observations and behavioral histories, validating that predictive retrieval of both environmental and behavioral memories enables more effective navigation.

2510.08559.tldr: SciVideoBench is a rigorous benchmark specifically designed to assess advanced video reasoning in scientific contexts and highlights significant performance deficits in state-of-the-art proprietary and open-source LMMs, including Gemini 2.5 Pro and Qwen2.5-VL, indicating substantial room for advancement in video reasoning capabilities.

2510.08564.tldr: Two simple, robust tuning recipes are identified that learn strongly while limiting drift and match or exceed their learning-stability balance while remaining simpler, requiring no replay, auxiliary parameters, or per-stage tuning.

2510.08568.tldr: NovaFlow is presented, an autonomous manipulation framework that converts a task description into an actionable plan for a target robot without any demonstrations, and naturally transfers across platforms by decoupling task understanding from low-level control.

2510.08569.tldr: The framework provides a scalable path to continuously evolve benchmarks in step with the rapid progress of foundation models and produces verified, diverse, and fair updates that uncover new failure modes, increase difficulty while preserving test objective alignment.

2510.08572.tldr: This work proposes BLAZER, a framework that learns manipulation policies from automatically generated training data and shows BLAZER to significantly improve zero-shot manipulation in both simulated and real environments.

2406.02642.tldr: This paper identifies the reasons behind ICL's poor performance from the perspective of prototype theory and proposes an Emotion Context Learning method (E-ICL) on fine-grained emotion recognition, which relies on more emotionally accurate prototypes to predict categories by referring to emotionally similar examples with dynamic labels.

2412.08221.tldr: Generate Any Scene, a data engine that systematically enumerates scene graphs representing the combinatorial array of possible visual scenes, is introduced, a data engine that systematically enumerates scene graphs representing the combinatorial array of possible visual scenes.

2412.11142.tldr: AD-LLM is introduced, the first benchmark that evaluates how LLMs can help with NLP anomaly detection and finds that LLMs can work well in zero-shot AD, that carefully designed augmentation methods are useful, and that explaining model selection for specific datasets remains challenging.

2502.00350.tldr: OrcaLoca is introduced, an LLM agent framework that improves accuracy for software issue localization by integrating priority-based scheduling for LLM-guided action, action decomposition with relevance scoring, and distance-aware context pruning.

2502.01857.tldr: This work introduces CoNav-Maze, a simulated environment where a robot navigates with local perception while a human operator provides guidance based on an inaccurate map, and proposes Information Gain Monte Carlo Tree Search (IG-MCTS), an online planning algorithm that jointly optimizes autonomous movement and informative communication.

2502.12669.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the Perovskite-Chat-LLM system significantly outperforms existing models in both domain-specific knowledge retrieval and scientific reasoning tasks, providing researchers with effective tools for literature review, experimental design, and complex problem-solving in PSC research.

2502.15695.tldr: A dual-view denoising strategy is employed, employing low-rank SVD to the user-item interaction matrix for a denoised social graph and contrastive learning to align the original and reconstructed social graphs, addressing the interest inconsistency between social and behavioral interests.

2503.14229.tldr: Results show that explicit social modeling improves navigation robustness and reduces collisions, underscoring the necessity of human-centric approaches.

2504.16548.tldr: Results indicate that an SAV designed to be more anthropomorphic and to induce psychological ownership improved users' perceptions of the SAV's human-like qualities, and its responses were perceived as more positive but also more subjective compared to the control conditions.

2505.12151.tldr: The results indicate that RLLMs may possess broader issues with misrepresentation of problem specifics, and are offered suggestions for design choices to mitigate this weakness.

2505.14551.tldr: This work defines a new class of games, called Trustworthy Reputation games (TRep games), which aim to extract the collective beliefs on trust from the actions of rational participants, and proposes a concrete TRep game whose utility function leverages Personalized PageRank and can be instantiated through a straightforward blockchain rewards mechanism.

2505.18630.tldr: Experiments show that DDO consistently outperforms existing LLM-based approaches and achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art generation-based methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in the MC task.

2506.22200.tldr: EFRame is introduced, an Exploration-Filter-Replay framework that augments GRPO across three dimensions: additional rollouts enable deeper and more targeted exploration, online filtering removes low-quality samples to stabilize gradients and accelerate training, and experience replay amplifies rare yet informative trajectories for stable convergence.

2507.12269.tldr: This work developed and investigated a deep learning approach using chest X-rays from 163 extremely low-birth-weight infants and demonstrates that domain-specific pretraining enables accurate BPD prediction from routine day-1 radiographs.

2507.13933.tldr: A highly reliable, scalable pipeline that classifies entire websites based on an LLM text detector's outputs of multiple prose-like pages to boost accuracies, and finds LLM-dominant sites are growing in prevalence and rank highly in search results, raising questions about their impact on end users and the overall Web ecosystem.

2508.21164.tldr: These results demonstrate that perceived model identity can substantially distort both high-level judgments and fine-grained quality assessments, independent of content quality, and challenge the reliability of LLM-as-judge paradigms.

2509.03709.tldr: The goal is to present a vision for XL, introducing its unexplored design considerations and degrees of freedom, and shed light on the intuitive yet non-trivial connections between XL, graph theory, and Markov chains.

2509.21862.tldr: Shachi is introduced, a formal methodology and modular framework that decomposes an agent's policy into core cognitive components: Configuration for intrinsic traits, Memory for contextual persistence, and Tools for expanded capabilities, all orchestrated by an LLM reasoning engine.

2510.04503.tldr: Poison-to-Poison (P2P), a general and effective backdoor defense algorithm that injects benign triggers with safe alternative labels into a subset of training samples and fine-tunes the model on this re-poisoned dataset by leveraging prompt-based learning, is proposed.

2510.04888.tldr: A graph-based comparison of the obtained interconnection matrices shows that the LLM-based approach produces interconnections with the lowest diversity of ICD code connections to different diseases compared to other methods, including text-based and domain-based approaches.

2510.06250.tldr: This work introduces a scalable multilingual data curation framework designed for high-quality PII annotation across 13 underrepresented locales, covering approximately 336 locale-specific PII types.

2510.07284.tldr: Online Rubrics Elicitation (OnlineRubrics) is introduced, a method that dynamically curates evaluation criteria in an online manner through pairwise comparisons of responses from current and reference policies that enables continuous identification and mitigation of errors as training proceeds.

2510.07488.tldr: This work proposes a multi-agent framework to examine core aspects of team science: structure, diversity, and interaction dynamics, and shows that flat teams tend to perform better than hierarchical ones, while diversity has a nuanced impact.

2510.08585.tldr: This work revisit articulatory information in the era of deep learning and proposes a framework that leverages articulatory representations both as an auxiliary task and as a pseudo-input to the recognition model.

2510.08586.tldr: This work proposes a dynamic labelling strategy that derives fine-grained stress annotations from emotional labels and introduces cross-attention-based sequential models—a Unidirectional LSTM and a Transformer Encoder—to capture temporal stress progression.

2510.08589.tldr: A comprehensive comparison of fine-tuned traditional CNNs, zero-shot pre-trained multi-modal LLMs, and fine-tuned multi-modal LLMs on the challenging task of artificial text overlay detection in images shows that LLMs can be effectively fine-tuned on very limited data to achieve up to 36% accuracy improvement.

2510.08591.tldr: This paper argues that QML and SNNs may serve niche hybrid roles, but DNNs remain the dominant, practical paradigm for AI advancement.

2510.08599.tldr: Focusing on Bambara with only 32h of speech-to-text data, a new pruning recipe is proposed, which compress the embeddings with low-rank decomposition and feature distillation and preserves 90% of the original performance.

2510.08600.tldr: This work proposes Recover-LoRA, a lightweight and dataset agnostic method to recover accuracy in degraded models and investigates the utility of Recover-LoRA across a diverse set of small language models, including models with varying attention architectures, multi-head attention (MHA) and group-query attention (GQA), as well as several evaluation datasets.

2510.08601.tldr: Mnemosyne, an unsupervised, human-inspired long-term memory architecture designed for edge-based LLMs, is introduced, which demonstrates that improved factual recall, enhanced temporal reasoning, and much more natural user-facing responses can be feasible with an edge-compatible and easily transferable unsupervised memory architecture.

2510.08605.tldr: This work presents a multilingual, multi-agent large language model framework with retrieval-augmented generation that can be deployed as a web plugin into online platforms, and demonstrates the feasibility of plugin-based deployment for real-world web applications.

2510.08606.tldr: A unified model that detects per-utterance hotspots in text, audio, and video, fuses them with global features via Hotspot-Gated Fusion, and aligns modalities using a routed Mixture-of-Aligners; a cross-modal graph encodes conversational structure is presented.

2510.08608.tldr: This work proposes MMA-ASIA, a comprehensive framework to evaluate LLMs' cultural awareness with a focus on Asian contexts, and proposes a five-dimensional evaluation protocol that measures cultural-awareness disparities across countries, cross-lingual consistency, cross-modal consistency, cultural knowledge generalization, and grounding validity.

2510.08610.tldr: An effective context collection strategy to assist the large language models (LLMs) in performing better at code completion tasks by preprocess the repository into smaller code chunks and later use syntactic and semantic similarity-based code chunk retrieval with relative positioning.

2510.08612.tldr: Investigating how LLMs affect team collaboration throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) indicates that LLMs can significantly improve efficiency, enhance communication clarity, and aid cross-functional collaboration, while also introducing new challenges like model limitations and privacy concerns.

2510.08619.tldr: This work introduces AScience, a framework modeling discovery as the interaction of agents, networks, and evaluation norms, and implements it as ASCollab, a distributed system of LLM-based research agents with heterogeneous behaviors that demonstrate that socially structured, agentic networks can sustain exploratory hypothesis hunting at scale.

2510.08626.tldr: PULSE (Preference Understanding by Latent Semantic Embeddings), a framework that treats SLM-generated rationales as director learning signals, supervising them with interaction histories to jointly model user actions and their semantic drivers and yields embeddings that are more robust and generalizable.

2510.08638.tldr: It is found that representations are partly dense rather than strictly sparse, and the dictionary evolves toward greater coherence and departs from maximally orthogonal ideals (Grassmannian frames).

2510.08646.tldr: This work establishes a promising paradigm for building LLMs that simultaneously achieve high safety and low false refusal rates, and establishes a novel, fine-tuning free framework designed to resolve this challenge through dynamic, inference-time intervention.

2510.08647.tldr: Upfront CoT (UCoT) is an efficient reasoning framework with upfront thought embedding to automate CoT compression that maintains the powerful reasoning ability of executor while significantly reducing the length of CoT.

2510.08648.tldr: WILSON helps anticipate failures and approve safe optimizations so reliability and throughput can improve together without changing model architecture or training.

2510.08655.tldr: This work proposes RareNet, a subgraph-based Graph Neural Network that requires only patient phenotypes to identify the most likely causal gene and retrieve focused patient subgraphs for targeted clinical investigation, demonstrating competitive and robust causal gene prediction and significant performance gains when integrated with other frameworks.

2510.08656.tldr: A novel multi-stage framework for generating 3D models composed of parameterized primitives, guided by textual and image inputs is introduced, which can identifies the shape features of the model constituent elements, and replace the elements with parameterized primitives with high quality surface.

2510.08657.tldr: This work proposes two novel point-level methods: Learning Distribution (LD) and Learning Conditional Distribution (LCD), which eliminates internal discrepancies by fitting the internal distribution of input and output with different parameters at different time steps, while LCD utilizes neural networks to predict scaling coefficients of the output.

2510.08659.tldr: This study proposes the first provably robust few-shot classifier that is tailored for LeFMs, and proposes a twofold trimmed mean prototype and derive provable upper and lower bounds for classification scores, enabling certification under worst-case poisoning scenarios.

2510.08661.tldr: This work proposes the Classification Auxiliary Trend-Seasonal Decoupling Linear Model CATS-Linear, employing Classification Auxiliary Channel-Independence (CACI), and redesigns the trend-seasonal decomposition architecture by adding a decoupling -- linear mapping -- recoupling framework for trend components and complex-domain linear projections for seasonal components.

2510.08664.tldr: A function abstracted verifiable middleware that streamlines RTL verification in LLM-based workflows by mixing LLM-friendly code structures with a rule-based template, Faver decouples the details of circuit verification, allowing the LLM to focus on the functionality itself.

2510.08665.tldr: A controllable code generation framework utilizing the ReAct paradigm for multi-agent task execution designed to enable efficient, precise, and interpretable code generation through dynamic interactions between LLMs and external resources.

2510.08669.tldr: Frequency-aware Caching (FreqCa) is proposed which directly reuses features of low-frequency components based on their similarity, while using a second-order Hermite interpolator to predict the volatile high-frequency ones based on its continuity.

2510.08671.tldr: This study proposes a framework that employs large language models (LLMs) to critique VRP-generated routes against policy-based criteria, allowing logistics operators to evaluate and prioritise more efficient delivery plans.

2510.08705.tldr: The authors' LLM-guided local search method for contact point selection, ConPoSe, successfully selects contact points for a variety of shapes, including cuboids, cylinders, and T-shapes and scales better with the number of robots and object size than the analytical approach, and also outperforms pure LLM-based selection.

2510.08711.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that ICL holds strong promise for non-stationary MIMO equalization, and that attention mechanisms inspired by classical adaptive algorithms can substantially enhance adaptability and performance in dynamic environments.

2510.08713.tldr: UniWM is proposed, a unified, memory-augmented world model that integrates egocentric visual foresight and planning within a single multimodal autoregressive backbone that improves navigation success rates by up to 30%, substantially reduces trajectory errors against strong baselines, and scales naturally to high-dimensional humanoid control.

2510.08731.tldr: A semantic router is presented that classifies queries based on their reasoning requirements and selectively applies reasoning only when beneficial, demonstrating that semantic routing offers an effective mechanism for striking a balance between accuracy and efficiency in open-source LLM serving systems.

2510.08744.tldr: DemoDiff is introduced, which defines task contexts using a small set of molecule-score examples instead of text descriptions and matches or surpasses language models 100-1000$\times$ larger and achieves an average rank of 3.63 compared to 5.25-10.20 for domain-specific approaches.

2510.08755.tldr: It is proposed that the heuristics produced have a $\sim28\times$ better worst-case performance compared to FunSearch, improve average performance, and maintain the runtime.

2510.08761.tldr: This work proposes a novel defense framework incorporating three key biological mechanisms: foveal-peripheral processing, saccadic eye movements, and cortical filling-in that effectively mitigates adversarial noise, preserves semantic integrity, and notably requires no retraining or fine-tuning of downstream classifiers, enabling seamless integration with existing systems.

2510.08774.tldr: This work provides the first comprehensive analysis of in-process structure-aware encoding, offering a blueprint for building more powerful and contextually aware embedding models.

2510.08775.tldr: This study presents a unique pipeline for extracting high-quality key frames from videos of k\={a}k\={a} (Nestor meridionalis), a threatened forest-dwelling parrot in New Zealand, and evaluates the re-identification performance of the pipeline.

2510.08776.tldr: This study shows that GPT-5 performed the best on average in each category, while other models displayed more inconsistency across language and category, and emphasize the need for further testing on how linguistic shifts impact LLM responses across various categories and improvement in these areas.

2510.08779.tldr: This work proposes a framework that provides LLM-generated action recommendations through augmented observation spaces, allowing RL agents to learn when to follow or ignore this guidance, and demonstrates an effective method for leveraging LLM planning capabilities to accelerate RL training in challenging environments.

2510.08783.tldr: This work investigates whether MLLMs can mimic human preferences when evaluating individual UIs and comparing them and shows that MLLMs approximate human preferences on some dimensions but diverge on others, underscores both their potential and limitations in supplementing early UX research.

2510.08794.tldr: A maximin problem based on public and private means, whose solution characterizes the optimal error exponent for best private arm identification is formulated, whose solution naturally adapts its exploration according to the hardness of pulling arms based on the public suboptimality gaps.

2510.08799.tldr: This work proposes SkipSR, a simple framework for accelerating video SR by identifying low-detail regions directly from low-resolution input, then skipping computation on them entirely, only super-resolving the areas that require refinement.

2510.08800.tldr: This work proposes Chinese Commonsense Multi-hop Reasoning (CCMOR), a novel benchmark designed to evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs'ability to integrate Chinese-specific factual knowledge with multi-step logical reasoning.

2510.08814.tldr: A normalization theorem shows that every target-relevant non-neutral evidence leaf is either a safe-buffer observation or a hidden-gauge observation, implying that total message-resolving advantage is \(o(t) across \(t\) selected coordinates.

2510.08818.tldr: D-CoDe is proposed, a training-free adaptation framework that incorporates dynamic compression and question decomposition that alleviates the perception bottleneck through adaptive selection of representative frames and content-aware aggregation of spatial tokens, thereby reducing redundancy while preserving informative content.

2510.08827.tldr: This paper introduces McMining, the task of mining programming misconceptions from samples of code from a student, and develops an extensible benchmark dataset of misconceptions together with a large set of code samples where these misconceptions are manifested.

2510.08829.tldr: This work proposes a token-level sanitization process, which surgically removes any instructions directed at AI systems from tool outputs, capturing malicious instructions as a byproduct, which generalizes well across a wide range of attacks and benchmarks like AgentDojo, BIPIA, InjecAgent, ASB and SEP.

2510.08831.tldr: This study represents the first controlled comparison of attribution bias between human and artificial evaluators in aesthetic judgment, revealing that AI systems not only replicate but amplify this human tendency.

2510.08839.tldr: This work presents a reinforcement learning (RL)-based edge resource management framework for reliable 3D reconstruction to ensure high quality reconstruction within a reasonable amount of time, despite the system operating under a resource-constrained and disruptionprone environment.

2510.08850.tldr: This work presents a method for file path retrieval that fine tunes a strong LLM (Qwen3-8B) with QLoRA and Unsloth optimizations to predict relevant file paths directly from a natural language query and analyzes how multi level code signals help the LLM reason over cross file context.

2510.08855.tldr: This work introduces Adaptive Temporal Masking (ATM), a novel training approach that dynamically adjusts feature selection by tracking activation magnitudes, frequencies, and reconstruction contributions to compute importance scores that evolve over time, creating a more natural feature selection process.

2510.08867.tldr: This work validate ReviewerToo on a carefully curated dataset of 1,963 paper submissions from ICLR 2025, and proposes guidelines for integrating AI into peer-review pipelines, showing how AI can enhance consistency, coverage, and fairness while leaving complex evaluative judgments to domain experts.

2510.08874.tldr: A universal one-sided algorithm for distributed matrix multiplication that supports all combinations of partitionings and replication factors is presented, finding that this work is competitive with PyTorch DTensor, a highly optimized distributed tensor library targeting AI models.

2510.08892.tldr: This work introduces a complementary approach that explicitly promotes exploration during sampling by applying distinct temperature settings for different token types within LLMs, and systematically investigates various multi-temperature scheduling strategies and their impacts within reinforcement learning contexts.

2510.08896.tldr: The results establish a new paradigm for Text-to-SQL systems that effectively balances semantic accuracy with computational efficiency through execution-informed reinforcement learning (RL) and can be extended to broader structured generation tasks requiring both correctness and efficiency optimization.

2510.08899.tldr: This work introduces Attribution-based Contribution to Policy Optimization (ACPO), a phased framework that incorporates a difficulty-aware curriculum and significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in exploration and exploitation.

2510.08902.tldr: This paper reformulates BioNER as a text generation task and design a symbolic tagging strategy to jointly handle both flat and nested entities with explicit boundary annotation, and introduces a contrastive learning-based entity selector that filters incorrect or spurious predictions by leveraging boundary-sensitive positive and negative samples.

2510.08908.tldr: A formal Frequency-Domain Bandit Model is constructed and it is proved that the confidence bound term in the UCB algorithm is equivalent in the frequency domain to a time-varying gain applied to uncertain spectral components, a gain inversely proportional to the square root of the visit count.

2510.08928.tldr: LM Fight Arena (Large Model Fight Arena), a novel framework that evaluates LMMs by pitting them against each other in the classic fighting game Mortal Kombat II, is introduced, a challenging and engaging benchmark that bridges the gap between AI evaluation and interactive entertainment.

2510.08930.tldr: A human-AI collaborative profile for a movie recommender system that presents editable personalized interest summaries of a user's movie history is introduced, and this design invites users to directly inspect, modify, and reflect on the system's inferences.

2510.08931.tldr: RADAR (Recall vs. Reasoning Detection through Activation Representation), a novel framework that leverages mechanistic interpretability to detect contamination by distinguishing recall-based from reasoning-based model responses, demonstrates the potential of mechanistic interpretability for advancing LLM evaluation beyond traditional surface-level metrics.

2510.08936.tldr: Ro-Bench is introduced, the first benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on dynamic out-of-distribution (OOD) counterfactual video test sets and it is demonstrated that fine-tuning MLLMs with counterfactual data enhances robustness, achieving a 21.73% performance increase on Ro-Bench and a 12.78% improvement across 20 tasks in the MVBench dataset.

2311.04014.tldr: A novel operator is introduced, termed the Y operator, to elevate control performance in Actor-Critic(AC) based reinforcement learning for systems governed by stochastic differential equations(SDEs).

2403.19979.tldr: This paper revisits different parameter-efficient tuning (PET) methods within the context of continual learning and proposes incrementally tuning the shared adapter without imposing parameter update constraints, enhancing the learning capacity of the backbone.

2405.20179.tldr: ROBO-INSTRUCT is introduced, which synthesizes task-specific simulation environments on the fly during program execution, by opportunistically inferring entity properties and enforcing corresponding constraints based on how the entities are used in the task program.

2408.08083.tldr: This work simplified and extended a Bayesian approach to combining judgments using a logistic regression framework that integrates confidence-weighted judgments for any number of team members and demonstrated its effectiveness in both image classification and neuroscience forecasting tasks.

2408.15026.tldr: A novel probe movement guidance algorithm that has the potential to be applied in guiding robotic systems or novices with probe pose adjustment for high-quality standard plane image acquisition and can effectively reduce probe guidance errors compared to other advanced baseline methods.

2410.02362.tldr: This review aims to demonstrate the transformative potential of Mamba in overcoming existing barriers within medical imaging while paving the way for innovative advancements in the field.

2410.11833.tldr: SAVO is introduced, an actor architecture that generates multiple action proposals and selects the one with the highest Q-value, and approximates the Q-function repeatedly by truncating poor local optima to guide gradient ascent more effectively.

2411.19528.tldr: Extensive experiments on challenging real-world datasets demonstrate that RAGDiffusion synthesizes structurally and texture-faithful clothing assets with significant performance improvements, representing a pioneering effort in high-specification faithful generation with RAG to confront intrinsic hallucinations and enhance fidelity.

2412.01605.tldr: MedChain-Agent, an AI system that integrates a feedback mechanism and a MCase-RAG module to learn from previous cases and adapt its responses, demonstrates remarkable adaptability in gathering information dynamically and handling sequential clinical tasks, significantly outperforming existing approaches.

2412.08604.tldr: A new paradigm is proposed, namely preference discerning, which explicitly conditions a generative recommendation model on user preferences in natural language within its context within its context, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in a novel benchmark.

2502.03333.tldr: The results show that RadVLM achieves state-of-the-art performance in conversational capabilities and visual grounding while remaining competitive in other radiology tasks, and highlight the potential of RadVLM as a clinically relevant AI assistant.

2502.06379.tldr: A sequential Monte Carlo method for linear-Gaussian inverse problems which builds on Decoupled Diffusion Sequential Monte Carlo, where the generative process is designed such that larger updates to the sample are possible.

2502.06485.tldr: A generative model, Wyckoff Diffusion (WyckoffDiff), is proposed, which generates symmetry-based descriptions of crystals by considering a crystal structure representation that encodes all symmetry, and a novel neural network architecture is designed which enables using this representation inside a discrete generative model framework.

2503.22424.tldr: COSIL is introduced, an LLM-driven, powerful function-level issue localization method without training or indexing that achieves a Top-1 localization accuracy and introduces a reflection mechanism that uses additional independent queries in short contexts to enhance formatted abilities.

2503.22697.tldr: A novel framework that directly decodes fMRI signals into textual descriptions of viewed natural images, offering a powerful new methodology for probing the neural basis of complex semantic processing, refining the understanding of the distributed semantic network, and potentially developing brain-sinpired language models.

2504.03955.tldr: A confidence score is proposed to evaluate the trustworthiness of the predicted results, and a hybrid optimization workflow that combines operator learning with finite difference using the generalized minimal residual method (GMRES) for incremental solution refinement is developed, enabling efficient and trustworthy thermal optimization.

2504.05684.tldr: This paper introduces Timestep-Adaptive Representation Alignment with Onset-Aware Conditioning (TARO), a novel framework for high-fidelity and temporally coherent video-to-audio synthesis that outperforms prior methods in audio quality and synchronization precision.

2504.14241.tldr: A Knowledge-Informed Deep Learning paradigm that distills the generalization capabilities of pre-trained Large Language Models into a lightweight and stability-aware neural architecture is proposed, offering a robust and scalable solution for next-generation traffic systems.

2504.21447.tldr: This work offers the first principled study of visual layer selection in MLLMs, showing that MLLMs can often see better when they look shallower, and proposes a lightweight feature fusion method that strategically incorporates shallower layers, achieving consistent improvements over both single-layer and specialized fusion baselines.

2505.03105.tldr: Cognitio Emergens (CE) is introduced, a framework that captures the co-evolutionary nature of human-AI epistemic partnerships and provides conceptual tools for cultivating partnerships that preserve epistemic integrity while enabling transformative breakthroughs neither humans nor AI could achieve independently.

2505.09666.tldr: This work introduces the novel problem of bilevel system prompt optimization, whose objective is to design system prompts that are robust to diverse user prompts and transferable to unseen tasks, and proposes a meta-learning framework that meta- learns the system prompt by optimizing it over various user prompts across multiple datasets.

2505.12493.tldr: This study introduces K-step GUI Transition, a self-supervised inverse dynamics task in which VLMs learn GUI dynamics by predicting the initial action that causes a transition between two GUI states, and proposes GUI-Shift, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that combines rule-based optimization with data filtering to improve VLM performance.

2505.14117.tldr: This paper proposes CoOpt, a highly efficient, parallelized framework for collaborative unlabeled data optimization, thereby effectively encoding knowledge into the data itself, and facilitates scalable, reusable, and sustainable training pipelines.

2505.17312.tldr: AdaReasoner is an LLM-agnostic plugin designed for any LLM to automate adaptive reasoning configurations for tasks requiring different types of thinking, and consistently outperforms standard baselines, preserves out-of-distribution robustness, and yield gains on knowledge-intensive tasks through tailored prompts.

2505.20318.tldr: DyVec is proposed, which incorporates an Exhaustive Query Rotation strategy to extract robust semantically aggregated latent representations by mitigating variance introduced by ICL and applies Dynamic Latent Segmentation and Injection to adaptively partition representations based on task complexity and leverages REINFORCE-based optimization to learn optimal injection positions for each segment.

2505.20854.tldr: SE-Jury is presented, the first evaluation metric for LLM-as-Ensemble-Judge specifically designed to accurately assess the correctness of generated software artifacts and reaches agreement levels with human annotators that are close to inter-annotator agreement in code generation and program repair.

2505.21593.tldr: This work represents the first dedicated diffusion framework for video bokeh generation, establishing a new baseline for temporally coherent and controllable depth-of-field effects.

2506.03355.tldr: This work proposes LEAF: an efficient adversarial finetuning method for the text domain, with the ability to scale to large CLIP models, and shows that robust text encoders facilitate better reconstruction of input text from its embedding via direct optimization.

2506.05404.tldr: AD-EE, an Early Exit framework that incorporates domain characteristics of autonomous driving and leverages causal inference to identify optimal exit layers is proposed, which significantly reduces latency, enhances object detection accuracy, and enhances object detection accuracy.

2506.07180.tldr: This work proposes VISE (Video-LLM Sycophancy Benchmarking and Evaluation), the first benchmark designed to evaluate sycophantic behavior in state-of-the-art Video-LLMs across diverse question formats, prompt biases, and visual reasoning tasks, and proposes two potential training-free mitigation strategies.

2506.11034.tldr: This work introduces a comprehensive causal reasoning benchmark for multi-modal in-context learning from large vision-language models (LVLMs) and evaluates the ability of state-of-the-art open-source LVLMs on three causal reasoning tasks across three causal representation learning datasets and demonstrates their fundamental strengths and weaknesses.

2506.19028.tldr: FiSCo (Fine-grained Semantic Comparison), a novel statistical framework to evaluate group-level fairness in LLMs by detecting subtle semantic differences in long-form responses across demographic groups, is proposed.

2506.19433.tldr: Mem4Nav is introduced, a hierarchical spatial-cognition long-short memory system that can augment any VLN backbone that yields 7-13 pp gains in Task Completion, sufficient SPD reduction, and>10 pp nDTW improvement.

2507.08885.tldr: AirScape is presented, the first world model designed for six-degree-of-freedom aerial agents, and significantly outperforms existing foundation models in 3D spatial imagination capabilities, especially with over a 50% improvement in metrics reflecting motion alignment.

2507.17131.tldr: The Adaptive Reflective Interactive Agent (ARIA), an LLM agent framework designed specifically to continuously learn updated domain knowledge at test time, is proposed, demonstrating significant improvements in adaptability and accuracy compared to baselines using standard offline fine-tuning and existing self-improving agents.

2508.00047.tldr: Experimental results show that TriP-LLM consistently outperforms recent state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods across all datasets, demonstrating strong detection capabilities.

2508.01774.tldr: This paper proposes a novel Vision-augmented Asymmetric Group Preference Optimization (VAGPO) approach, which introduces an asymmetric group preference optimization strategy that significantly accelerates convergence compared to commonly used policy gradient methods.

2508.05118.tldr: A new RL framework built upon Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), designed to address this challenge directly, with the core of EGPO an entropy-enhanced advantage function that integrates the entropy of the model's Chain-of-Thought (CoT) into the policy gradient computation.

2508.06944.tldr: Adaptive Meta Fine-Tuning is introduced, a novel single-stage algorithm that learns the optimal balance between SFT's implicit, path-level reward and RL's explicit, outcome-based reward, offering a more principled and effective paradigm for LLM alignment.

2508.06956.tldr: Neural Beam Field is proposed, a hybrid neural-physical framework for efficient and interpretable spatial beam RSRP prediction that significantly outperforms conventional table-based channel knowledge maps (CKMs) and pure blackbox DNNs in prediction accuracy, training efficiency, and generalization, while maintaining a compact model size.

2508.07819.tldr: This paper proposes a parameter-efficient Convolutional Low-Rank Adaptation (Conv-LoRA) adapter to inject local inductive biases for fine-grained representation, and introduces a Dynamic Fusion Gateway (DFG) that leverages visual context to adaptively modulate text prompts, enabling a powerful bidirectional fusion.

2508.11408.tldr: This work proposes CHORD, a framework for Controllable Harmonization of On- and Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning via Dynamic Weighting, which reframes SFT not as a separate stage but as a dynamically weighted auxiliary objective within the on-policy RL process.

2508.15327.tldr: It is demonstrated that SPW enables effective joint learning from preferences and demonstrations, outperforming prior methods that leverage both feedback types on challenging robot manipulation tasks.

2508.18781.tldr: AniME produces cinematic animation with consistent characters and synchronized audio–visual elements, offering a scalable solution for AI-driven anime creation.

2508.19078.tldr: FLUX is proposed, a system designed to enable federated fine-tuning of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based large language models across participants with constrained computing resources (e.g., consumer-grade GPUs), aiming to minimize time-to-accuracy.

2509.02579.tldr: This paper introduces a novel Expectation-Maximization (EM) based latent variable modeling approach in the context of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) coordination in wildlife protection, and demonstrates superior performance in detection accuracy, adaptability, and policy convergence when compared to standard algorithms.

2509.06836.tldr: Compact, which jointly prunes rare vocabulary to shrink embedding/LM head layers and prunes FFN intermediate channels using common-token-weighted activations, aligning importance with the post-pruning token distribution, inherits strengths of both depth and width pruning.

2509.09708.tldr: This work studies two public instruction-tuned models, Gemma-2-2B-IT and LLaMA-3.1-8B-IT, using sparse autoencoders trained on residual-stream activations to search the SAE latent space for feature sets whose ablation flips the model from refusal to compliance, demonstrating causal influence and creating a jailbreak.

2509.20374.tldr: CFDLLMBench is introduced, a benchmark suite comprising three complementary components -- CFDQuery, CFDCodeBench, and FoamBench -- designed to holistically evaluate LLM performance across three key competencies: graduate-level CFD knowledge, numerical and physical reasoning of CFD, and context-dependent implementation of CFD workflows.

2510.00071.tldr: Adaptive Reasoning Suppression (ARS) is proposed, a novel training-free approach that dynamically suppresses redundant reasoning steps while preserving accuracy through adaptive certainty monitoring, achieving superior efficiency compared to static suppression methods.

2510.01171.tldr: This work introduces Verbalized Sampling, a simple, training-free prompting strategy to circumvent mode collapse and provides a new data-centric perspective on mode collapse and a practical inference-time remedy that helps unlock pre-trained generative diversity.

2510.01644.tldr: The ability of different machine learning models to distinguish jailbreak prompts from genuine uses is analysed, including the ability to identify jailbreaks that use previously unseen strategies, and explicit reflexivity in prompt structure could be a signal of jailbreak intention.

2510.01795.tldr: Nav-EE, a navigation-guided early-exit framework that precomputes task-specific exit layers offline and dynamically applies them online based on navigation priors is proposed, suggesting that coupling navigation foresight with early-exit offers a viable path toward efficient deployment of large models in autonomous systems.

2510.02387.tldr: First steps of how world models can benefit agentic coding, enable step-by-step simulation of Python code execution, and show early results of how reasoning can benefit from the latter are presented.

2510.02463.tldr: The validation results show that CLARITY surpasses human-level performance in terms of the first-attempt routing precision, naturally requiring up to 3 times shorter duration of the consultation than with a human.

2510.03016.tldr: DMIS is proposed, a unified framework for training robust Diffusion Models from Imprecise Supervision from Imprecise Supervision, which is the first systematic study within diffusion models.

2510.03243.tldr: PARS is a prompt-aware LLM task scheduler that improves serving efficiency by approximating shortest-job-first (SJF) scheduling through pairwise ranking with margin ranking loss and significantly improves performance, including for reasoning workloads.

2510.03807.tldr: This research aims to develop and validate a 6G-enabled Digital Twin framework that achieves ultra-low latency communication and real-time synchronization between physical industrial assets and their digital counterparts, specifically targeting bearing fault detection as a critical industrial use case.

2510.04020.tldr: This work proposes Spatiotemporal Forecasting as Planning (SFP), a new paradigm grounded in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, which constructs a novel Generative World Model to simulate diverse, high-fidelity future states, enabling an"imagination-based"environmental simulation.

2510.04212.tldr: This paper provides the first mechanistic explanation for a long-standing and unresolved failure case where training with flash attention in low-precision settings leads to catastrophic loss explosion.

2510.05901.tldr: This work identifies a critical flaw: existing hybrid methods inadvertently bypass the linear component, relying almost entirely on SWA, and proposes three solutions to ensure balanced component usage, maintaining computational efficiency while recovering most base model performance and ensuring genuine linear attention adoption.

2510.06189.tldr: It is argued that systems research, long focused on designing and evaluating new performance-oriented algorithms, is particularly well-suited for AI-driven solution discovery, and that human researchers will increasingly focus on problem formulation and strategic guidance in the age of AI.

2510.07414.tldr: It is argued that haystack engineering is necessary to construct noisy long contexts that faithfully capture key real-world factors -- distraction from heterogeneous biased retrievers and cascading errors in agentic workflows -- to test models'long-context robustness.

2510.07985.tldr: This work shows that modern LLM pruning methods can be maliciously exploited, and reveals a critical deployment-time security gap and underscores the urgent need for stronger security awareness in model compression.

2510.08026.tldr: A consistent positive correlation between model entropy and response length at different reasoning stages across diverse LRMs is revealed: the thinking phase exhibits higher entropy, reflecting exploratory behavior of longer responses, while the final answer phase shows lower entropy, indicating a more deterministic solution.

2510.08279.tldr: This paper introduces Neural Exposure Fields (NExF), a novel technique for robustly reconstructing 3D scenes with high quality and 3D-consistent appearance from challenging real-world captures and produces state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks improving by over 55% over best-performing baselines.

2510.08790.tldr: This work proposes COMPASS (Context-Organized Multi-Agent Planning and Strategy System), a lightweight hierarchical framework that separates tactical execution, strategic oversight, and context organization into three specialized components that improves accuracy by up to 20% relative to both single- and multi-agent baselines.

2510.08958.tldr: EphoryRAG dynamically infers implicit relations between entities to populate context, enabling deep reasoning without exhaustive pre-enumeration of relationships, and validate the efficacy of the entity-cue-multi-hop retrieval paradigm for complex question answering.

2510.08959.tldr: DualResearch is proposed, a retrieval and fusion framework that matches the epistemic structure of tool-intensive reasoning by jointly modeling two complementary graphs: a breadth semantic graph that encodes stable background knowledge, and a depth causal graph that captures execution provenance.

2510.08962.tldr: This survey employs agnostic active sampling theory within the Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) framework to analyze the generalization error and label complexity associated with learning from low-resource data in both model-agnostic supervised and unsupervised settings.

2510.08968.tldr: It is empirically demonstrated that LOs can be trained to learn and internalize the effects of traditional regularization techniques without explicitly applying them to the objective function, and suggested that LOs can inherently learn regularization properties.

2510.08981.tldr: SEER is introduced, a framework which addresses sustainability concerns in the early software development phase and is implemented using the reasoning capabilities of large language models and the agentic RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) approach.

2510.08993.tldr: PlatformX is evaluated across multiple mobile platforms, showing that it significantly reduces search overhead while preserving accuracy and energy fidelity, and outperforming MobileNet-V2 in accuracy and efficiency.

2510.08999.tldr: A unified framework for simultaneous pruning and low-bit quantization via Bayesian variational learning via Bayesian variational learning (SQS), which achieves higher compression rates than prior baselines while maintaining comparable performance.

2510.09008.tldr: The method comprises a proxy method with adversarial perturbations for identifying uncertain visual tokens efficiently and a method to mask these uncertain visual tokens during the self-attention process in the middle layers of the VE, suppressing their influence on visual encoding and thus alleviating hallucinations.

2510.09021.tldr: This work introduces agentic workflows that extract and analyze reference solutions and automatically derive problem-specific rubrics for a multi-step grading process, and instantiate and compare different design choices for the grading workflows, and evaluate their trade-offs.

2510.09025.tldr: A new training strategy to improve speech dereverberation systems in an unsupervised manner using only reverberant speech, which achieves more consistent performance across various objective metrics than the state-of-the-art.

2510.09037.tldr: This work provides a validated methodology for solving regular expressions problems in automated repair, improving the repair rate by 15.4%p over the state-of-the-art over the state-of-the-art.

2510.09038.tldr: A continuous memory that encodes each GUI trajectory into a fixed-length sequence of continuous embeddings using the VLM itself as an encoder; these embeddings are plugged directly into the backbone's input layer, sharply reducing context cost while preserving fine-grained visual information.

2510.09049.tldr: This paper proposes MEC$^3$O, a multi-expert consensus system, which extends the multi-agent debate frameworks and assigns LLMs to complexity classes based on their performance and provides them with class-specialized instructions, turning them into experts.

2510.09051.tldr: This work proposes Alif-1.0-8B-Instruct, a multilingual Urdu-English model, that tackles challenges with a unique approach and demonstrates that high-performance and low-resource language LLMs can be developed efficiently and culturally aligned using a modified self-instruct approach.

2510.09060.tldr: This work presents a training-free, inference-time control mechanism that makes the flow itself diversity-aware, and simultaneously encourages lateral spread among trajectories via a feature-space objective and reintroduces uncertainty through a time-scheduled stochastic perturbation.

2510.09072.tldr: A two-step approach to enhance the robustness and generalization of speech emotion recognition models through improved representation learning is introduced.

2510.09080.tldr: This research uses machine learning to recognize stages of robot failure from human reactions and modeling the progression of human reactions enhances error detection and understanding of repeated interaction breakdowns in HRI.

2510.09087.tldr: This work formalizes turn-based dialogue in SDGs as a Stackelberg competition, where the current player acts as the leader who strategically influences the follower's response, and proposes a reinforcement learning framework that trains agents to optimize utterances for persuasive impact.

2510.09090.tldr: By linking the level of AI model risk to the appropriate form of human oversight, the paper underscores the critical role of human involvement in the responsible deployment of AI, balancing technological innovation with the protection of individual values and rights.

2510.09096.tldr: This work uses the demonstrations of constrained experts to infer a state-only reward signal that measures task progress, and self-label reward for unknown states using temporal interpolation, and outperforms common imitation learning in both sample efficiency and task completion time.

2510.09105.tldr: Experimental results on multiple datasets, including CIFAR-10, demonstrate that the proposed MemLoss method achieves better accuracy compared to existing adversarial training methods while maintaining strong robustness against attacks.

2510.09136.tldr: Evaluating the effectiveness of controlled personalization through an A/B test conducted on the website of a major Norwegian legacy news organization suggests that even a modest level of personalization yields substantial benefits.

2510.09155.tldr: A collaborative digital framework integrating stakeholders across the care continuum, leveraging federated big data analytics and artificial intelligence for improved decision-making while ensuring privacy is contributes with a collaborative digital framework.

2510.09159.tldr: This benchmark standardises data curation and evaluation across two distinct clinical settings: the MIMIC-IV dataset for ICU tasks (mortality, phenotyping) and the EHRSHOT dataset for longitudinal care (30-day readmission, 1-year pancreatic cancer).

2510.09181.tldr: This paper demystify catastrophic forgetting by revealing that the new-task training is implicitly an adversarial attack against the old-task knowledge, which reduces forgetting by 10.8% and improves accuracy by 12.7% on average over GP methods.
