2510.09187.tldr: This paper presents the first comprehensive baseline study comparing seven different deep learning approaches across four distinct research paradigms for cricket shot classification, implementing and systematically evaluating traditional CNN-LSTM architectures, attention-based models, vision transformers, transfer learning approaches, and modern EfficientNet-GRU combinations on a unified benchmark.

2510.09200.tldr: This work curates the eXplainable Driving Action Anticipation Dataset (DAAD-X), a new multimodal, ego-centric video dataset, and proposes Video Concept Bottleneck Model (VCBM), a framework that generates spatio-temporally coherent explanations inherently, without relying on post-hoc techniques.

2510.09223.tldr: This paper presents multiple conceptual models for knowledge fusion in the field of medicine, based on a knowledge graph structure to evaluate, how knowledge fusion can be enabled and how to integrate various knowledge sources into the knowledge graph for rescue operations.

2510.09227.tldr: This work presents the first empirical investigation into the spatial computational limitations of LLMs and LRMs, offering a new framework for evaluating their advanced reasoning capabilities by introducing a novel benchmark grounded in two PSPACE-complete regular expression (regex) problems: equivalence decision (RegexEQ) and minimization (RegexMin).

2510.09228.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive review of image and video restoration techniques developed to mitigate weather-induced visual impairments, categorizing existing approaches into traditional prior-based methods and modern data-driven models, including CNNs, transformers, diffusion models, and emerging vision-language models.

2510.09230.tldr: This work focuses on the innovative application of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in the preliminary diagnosis of shoulder disorders and proposes a Hybrid Motion Video Diagnosis framework (HMVDx), which divides the two tasks of action understanding and disease diagnosis, which are respectively completed by two MLLMs.

2510.09244.tldr: This paper shows how integrating these systems leads to more capable and generalized software bots that mimic human cognitive processes for autonomous and intelligent behavior.

2510.09254.tldr: This work proposes an alternative approach that quickly generates smooth, near-optimal collision-free 3D Cartesian trajectories from a single artificial demonstration, outperforming a RRT-Connect baseline in terms of computation and execution time, as well as trajectory length, while supporting multi-modal trajectory generation for different obstacle geometries and end-effector dimensions.

2510.09259.tldr: This work conducts the first systematic study of data detection within RL post-training scenario and proposes Self-Critique, a method that significantly outperforms baseline methods across multiple models and contamination tasks, achieving an AUC improvement of up to 30%.

2510.09263.tldr: This paper documents the technical desiderata, threat models, and practical challenges of deploying such a system at internet scale, addressing key requirements of effectiveness, fidelity, robustness, and security, and benchmark SynthID-O against other post-hoc watermarking methods from the literature.

2510.09275.tldr: DyReMe is proposed, a dynamic benchmark for medical diagnostics that better reflects real clinical practice and reveals significant misalignments between the performance of state-of-the-art LLMs and real clinical practice.

2510.09278.tldr: CLARity is proposed, a cost-effective RL framework that enhances reasoning quality using only a small, general-purpose LLM and offers a generalizable solution that enables smaller models to effectively guide expert models by reasoning consistency.

2510.09302.tldr: CapGeo is introduced, a caption-assisted reasoning framework that bridges visual and textual modalities in MLLMs and incorporates a keypoint-based evaluation metric that correlates strongly with downstream CapGeo performance, enabling reliable assessment of geometric captioning ability.

2510.09325.tldr: This work characterizes the limits of non-interactive MAIL and presents the first interactive algorithm with near-optimal sample complexity, and introduces a framework that combines reward-free reinforcement learning with interactive MAIL and instantiate it with an algorithm, MAIL-WARM.

2510.09328.tldr: Randomized HyperSteiner (RHS) is introduced, a stochastic Delaunay triangulation heuristic that incorporates randomness into the expansion process and refines candidate trees via Riemannian gradient descent optimization.

2510.09332.tldr: The Fine-grained Low-Rank Compressor (FLRC), which efficiently determines an optimal rank allocation for each layer, and incorporates progressive low-rank decoding to maintain text generation quality and establish a more robust and efficient framework to improve LLM inference.

2510.09340.tldr: It is shown that a small language model can solve a deductive reasoning task by learning the underlying rules (rather than operating as a statistical learner) and that induction heads play a central role in the implementation of the rule completion and rule chaining steps involved in the logical inference required by the task.

2510.09362.tldr: Deep-REMAP is developed, a novel deep learning framework that utilizes a regularized, multi-task approach to predict stellar atmospheric parameters from observed spectra and is extensible to other surveys and synthetic libraries, demonstrating a powerful and automated pathway for stellar characterization.

2510.09373.tldr: This paper formalizes sequence variables within CP, providing a clear definition of their domain, update operations, and introducing consistency levels for constraints on this domain.

2510.09378.tldr: A practical upper bound on iteration complexity is established by applying full Gauss-Newton preconditioning to transformer models of up to 150M parameters, suggesting the GN approximation is highly effective for preconditioning and higher-order loss terms may not be critical for convergence speed.

2510.09379.tldr: It is shown that eigenvalues influence essential aspects of memory and long-range dependency modeling, revealing spectral signatures that align with task requirements, and how architectural modifications in sequence models impact both eigenvalue spectra and task performance is investigated.

2510.09389.tldr: A unified framework that makes this output operation explicit, by casting the linear combination coefficients as the outputs of autonomous linear dynamical systems driven by impulse inputs, and identifies tradeoffs between expressivity and efficient implementation, geometric constraints on input selectivity, and stability conditions for numerically stable training and information retention.

2510.09390.tldr: A taxonomy of types of ambiguity that arise in the data visualization domain is developed and proposed metrics to quantify them and it is demonstrated that the ambiguity metrics better correlate with human annotations than uncertainty baselines.

2510.09421.tldr: The _Entity Lens_ is introduced, extending the _logit-lens_ to predict multi-token mentions and bring new evidence that LLMs develop entity-specific mechanisms to represent and manipulate any multi-token entities, including those unseen during training.

2510.09458.tldr: This work presents SilvaScenes, a new dataset for instance segmentation of tree species from under-canopy images, collected across five bioclimatic domains in Quebec, Canada, and demonstrates the relevance and challenging nature of the dataset by benchmarking modern deep learning approaches for instance segmentation.

2510.09462.tldr: This work instantiates a simple adaptive attack vector by which the attacker embeds publicly known or zero-shot prompt injections in the model outputs, and shows how frontier models consistently evade diverse monitors and complete malicious tasks on two main AI control benchmarks.

2510.09474.tldr: This work introduces Multimodal Policy Internalization (MPI), a new task that internalizes reasoning-intensive multimodal policies into model parameters, enabling stronger policy-following without including the policy during inference.

2510.09493.tldr: This study designed and suggested disease predictive computer-aided designs for the diagnosis of CKD and found that Random Forest as well as Logistic Regression showed an outstanding 99% accuracy.

2510.09495.tldr: By utilizing a vector quantized-variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE), this paper circumvents one of the key drawbacks of GMMs, i.e., the number of GMM components scales exponentially to the feedback bits.

2510.09497.tldr: This work develops a transformer-based imitation learning framework with goal conditioning, relative action outputs, and automatic contrast dye injections to enable generalizable soft robotic guidewire navigation in an aneurysm targeting task.

2510.09499.tldr: This work evaluates state-of-the-art algorithms across heterogeneous and complex tasks and observes that minimising information loss when processing user interactions is critical for model robustness.

2510.09535.tldr: It is argued that the granularity of supervision plays a crucial role in balancing efficiency and accuracy, and proposed Group Relative Segment Penalization (GRSP), a step-level method to regularize reasoning, is proposed.

2510.09551.tldr: A lightweight reimplementation of Titans is presented and a comprehensive evaluation on Masked Language Modeling, Time Series Forecasting, and Recommendation tasks reveals that Titans does not always outperform established baselines due to chunking, but its Neural Memory component consistently improves performance compared to attention-only models.

2510.09567.tldr: This paper shows how data branching and declarative environments extend naturally to agents, enabling reproducibility and observability while reducing the attack surface, and outlines a path toward a fully agentic lakehouse.

2510.09577.tldr: Dyna-Mind, a two-stage training framework that explicitly teaches (V)LM agents to integrate simulation ability into AI agents, and Dyna-GRPO, an online reinforcement learning method that leverages outcome and interaction-level signals to learn better policies for long-horizon, planning-intensive tasks are introduced.

2510.09596.tldr: BaNEL (Bayesian Negative Evidence Learning), an algorithm that post-trains the model using failed attempts only, while minimizing the number of reward evaluations (NREs), is proposed, based on the idea that the problem of learning regularities underlying failures can be cast as another, in-loop generative modeling problem.

2510.09599.tldr: This work introduces Prompting Test-Time Scaling (P-TTS), a simple yet effective inference-time data augmentation strategy for enhancing LLM reasoning through finetuning, and suggests that test-time scaling effectively explores the latent space of reasoning patterns, amplifying LLM problem-solving with minimal annotation overhead, and further unlocking the reasoning potential and capabilities of LLMs.

2510.09608.tldr: This paper introduces StreamingVLM, a model designed for real-time, stable understanding of infinite visual input that applies full attention on short, overlapped video chunks, which effectively mimics the inference-time attention pattern without training on prohibitively long contexts.

1708.06233.tldr: Exposing agents to the possibility of fake news can be an effective way to curtail the spread offake news in social networks and highlights that information about the users' private beliefs and their social network structure can be extremely valuable to adversaries and should be well protected.

2110.15907.tldr: This paper presents both a sequence of tasks where cautious behavior becomes increasingly non-obvious, as well as an algorithm to demonstrate that it is possible for a system to learn to be cautious, and constructs robust policies with a k-of-N counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) subroutine given learned reward function uncertainty represented by a neural network ensemble.

2209.10587.tldr: A new approach called DeepVARwT is proposed that employs deep learning methodology for maximum likelihood estimation of the trend and the dependence structure at the same time and compares the prediction performance of this model with state-of-the-art models in the literature.

2301.13247.tldr: A new loss function learning technique for adaptively updating the loss function online after each update to the base model parameters is proposed, which consistently outperforms the cross-entropy loss and offline loss function learning techniques on a diverse range of neural network architectures and datasets.

2305.04076.tldr: The SANTA is proposed to handle these two types of noise separately with (1) Memory-smoothed Focal Loss and Entity-aware KNN to relieve the entity ambiguity problem caused by inaccurate annotation, and (2) Boundary Mixup to alleviate decision boundary shifting problem cause by incomplete annotation and a noise-tolerant loss to improve the robustness.

2310.01139.tldr: This paper incorporates training errors into the stability analysis of minibatch and local SGD, which shows how small training errors help generalization for overparameterized models and shows minibatch and local SGD achieve a linear speedup to attain the optimal risk bounds.

2310.07086.tldr: A novel NLP-based framework that harnesses the vast, abundant, and inexpensive data available on social media platforms like Twitter to understand users' perceptions of various service issues and highlights the effectiveness of the proposed framework in gauging user feedback through inexpensive social media data to understand the pain points of the transit system and plan for targeted improvements.

2401.07518.tldr: This survey reviews recent advances in NLP with a focus on solving problems relevant to the education domain and presents a taxonomy of NLP in the education domain, including question answering, question construction, automated assessment, and error correction.

2403.17214.tldr: This study empirically analyze the generated outputs of eleven popular instruct-tuned LLMs with parameters ranging from 1B up to 46.7B to demonstrate that a strategic combination of prompt engineering and regular expression can effectively extract the source code from the model generation output.

2404.04067.tldr: The results reveal a performance decline in nine out of twelve biomedical models after fine-tuning, particularly on tasks involving hallucinations, ICD10 coding, and instruction adherence, indicating a trade-off between domain-specific fine-tuning and general medical task performance.

2405.20725.tldr: This paper proposes Gradient Inversion via Neural Architecture Search (GI-NAS), which adaptively searches the network and captures the implicit priors behind neural architectures, and is the first to successfully introduce NAS to the gradient inversion community.

2407.09450.tldr: EM-LLM is introduced, a novel approach that integrates key aspects of human episodic memory and event cognition into LLMs with no fine-tuning, enabling them to handle practically infinite context lengths while maintaining computational efficiency.

2407.14788.tldr: This work presents an analytical framework for the design and analysis of LLM-based algorithms, i.e., algorithms that contain one or multiple calls of large language models (LLMs) as sub-routines and critically rely on the capabilities of LLMs, and demonstrates the proposed framework in action and derive interesting insights that generalize across scenarios.

2409.11686.tldr: This study analyzes inpatient CT scans to identify discrepancies between imaging phenotypes (characteristics derived from opportunistic CT scans) and their corresponding documentation in radiology reports and ICD coding to demonstrate opportunistic CT's potential to enhance diagnostic precision and accuracy of risk adjustment models.

2410.19274.tldr: This paper proposes Neuralink, a novel approach that accelerates LLM inference on smartphones by optimizing neuron placement in flash memory and explores a new optimization space at the intersection of sparsity-driven algorithm and storage-level system co-design for LLM inference.

2410.19349.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that pEBR significantly improves both retrieval precision and recall, and ablation studies reveal that the probabilistic formulation effectively captures the inherent differences between head-to-tail queries.

2410.20490.tldr: This work investigates the robustness of hate speech classification using LLMs particularly when explicit and implicit markers of the speaker's ethnicity are injected into the input, and finds that larger models are more robust.

2410.21341.tldr: Retrieval-Retro is proposed, which implicitly extracts the precursor information of reference materials that are retrieved from the knowledge base regarding domain expertise in the field, which enables the model to learn novel synthesis recipes more effectively.

2411.19623.tldr: This work proposes a novel fair dataset distillation (FDD) framework, namely FairDD, which can be seamlessly applied to diverse matching-based DD approaches (DDs), requiring no modifications to their original architectures, and significantly improves fairness compared to vanilla DDs.

2412.01770.tldr: CASHER shows that CASHER enables fine-tuning of pre-trained policies to a target scenario using a video scan without any additional human effort, and demonstrates zero-shot and few-shot scaling laws on three real-world tasks across diverse scenarios.

2412.08021.tldr: This analysis suggests a new MISL method (contrastive successor features) that retains the excellent performance of METRA with fewer moving parts, and highlights connections between skill learning, contrastive representation learning, and successor features.

2412.14087.tldr: SEKE, a mixture of Specialised Experts for supervised Keyword Extraction, uses DeBERTa as the backbone model and builds on the MoE framework, by integrating it with a bidirectional Long short-term memory network, to allow successful extraction even on smaller corpora, where specialisation is harder due to lack of training data.

2501.04765.tldr: This work aims to improve training efficiency as well as generative performance at the same time through routes that act as a transport mechanism for randomly selected tokens from early layers to deeper layers of the model.

2501.06994.tldr: This work instantiates an IL policy called Motion Track Policy (MT- $\pi$ ) which receives image observations and outputs motion tracks as actions, and leveraging this unified, cross-embodiment action space completes tasks with high success given just minutes of human video and limited additional robot demonstrations.

2501.15857.tldr: It is proposed, both theoretically and empirically, that Transformers learn an underlying generalizable program from training, enabling effective compositional reasoning during testing.

2501.18187.tldr: It is proved that LSA is inherently incapable of outperforming linear predictors on nonlinear tasks, underscoring why prior solutions cannot readily extend to these problems and highlighting that the feed-forward layers provide a crucial and scalable mechanism by which Transformers can express nonlinear representations for ICL.

2502.17262.tldr: A Clustering-On-Difficulty framework for downstream performance prediction, which adopts a performance scaling law to predict cluster-wise performance with theoretical support and derives a mapping function to accurately extrapolate the performance of the subset to the full set.

2502.18080.tldr: Self-improved models built upon Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct outperform other distillation-based 32B o1-like models across various math benchmarks, and achieve performance on par with the teacher model QwQ-32B-Preview that produces the seed data.

2502.18940.tldr: MathTutorBench, an open-source benchmark for holistic tutoring model evaluation, is presented and it is found that subject expertise, indicated by solving ability, does not immediately translate to good teaching.

2502.20681.tldr: This paper theoretically demonstrates how the two-stage training dynamics potentially occur in transformers and analyzes the feature learning dynamics induced by the aforementioned disentangled two-type feature structure, grounding the analysis in a simplified yet illustrative setting that comprises a normalized ReLU self-attention layer and structured data.

2503.20036.tldr: BugCraft is introduced, a novel end-to-end framework designed to automate the reproduction of crash bugs in Minecraft directly from user-submitted bug reports, addressing the critical gap in automated game bug reproduction.

2503.22215.tldr: Surprisingly, L2T attains exceptional fundamental visual capabilities, yielding up to an 18% improvement in captioning performance, while simultaneously alleviating hallucination in MLLMs.

2503.22776.tldr: This paper employs in-context learning (ICL), which directly integrates task exemplars into the input context, to post-incorporate code structural knowledge into pre-trained LLMs at test time, and proposes a greedy algorithm for CAST submodular maximization, which theoretically guarantees a optimal solution in polynomial time complexity.

2503.22982.tldr: A parameter-sharing AI model loading (PartialLoading) framework for multi-user edge inference, which exploits two key insights: the majority of latency arises from loading AI models into server GPU memory, and different AI models can share a significant number of parameters, for which redundant loading should be avoided.

2504.00339.tldr: VNJPTranslate is introduced, a pipeline designed to systematically address the Vi-Ja translation task, and employs efficient fine-tuning techniques on a capable, low-parameter autoregressive model to create a practical and high-performing translation system.

2504.11083.tldr: Quant Annealing Multi-Head Attention is proposed, a novel drop-in operator that reformulates attention as an energy-based Hamiltonian optimization problem, providing a seamlessly integrable and hardware-compatible alternative to conventional attention mechanisms.

2504.14119.tldr: CodeCrash is introduced, a stress-testing framework designed to evaluate reasoning reliability under structural perturbations and misleading natural language (NL) contexts, finding that models often shortcut reasoning by over-relying on NL cues, leading to an average performance degradation.

2504.14858.tldr: AlignRAG, a novel iterative framework grounded in Critique-Driven Alignment (CDA), and AlignRAG-auto, an autonomous variant that dynamically terminates refinement, removing the need to pre-specify the number of critique iterations, are introduced.

2505.07261.tldr: Coupled Hierarchical Diffusion (CHD) is proposed, a framework that models HL sub-goals and LL trajectories jointly within a unified diffusion process and consistently outperforms both flat and hierarchical diffusion baselines.

2505.10983.tldr: This work proposes the first unified adversarial attack benchmark for Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs), named GenoArmory, which evaluates the adversarial robustness of five state-of-the-art GFMs using four widely adopted attack algorithms and three defense strategies.

2505.11032.tldr: This paper proposes DexGarmentLab, the first environment specifically designed for dexterous (especially bimanual) garment manipulation, which features large-scale high-quality 3D assets for 15 task scenarios, and refines simulation techniques tailored for garment modeling to reduce the sim-to-real gap.

2505.11166.tldr: Experimental results show that SoLoPO enhances all these algorithms with respect to stronger length and domain generalization abilities across various long-context benchmarks, while achieving notable improvements in both computational and memory efficiency.

2505.12565.tldr: It is argued that just like tokenizing texts into meaning-bearing (sub-)word tokens instead of characters, molecules should be tokenized at the level of functional building blocks, i.e., parts of molecules that bring unique functions and serve as effective building blocks for real-world automated laboratory synthesis.

2505.13500.tldr: Investigating the robustness of safety fine-tuning in LLMs by systematically injecting Gaussian noise into model activations shows that Gaussian noise raises harmful-output rates and implies that widely-deployed safety tuning methods can fail even without adversarial prompts.

2505.15607.tldr: This work proposes an online reinforcement learning (RL)-based alignment framework that can quickly adapt LLMs into effective tutors using simulated student-tutor interactions by emphasizing pedagogical quality and guided problem-solving over simply giving away answers.

2505.16067.tldr: An empirical study on how memory management choices impact the LLM agents' behavior, especially their long-term performance, and focuses on two fundamental memory management operations-memory addition and deletion to systematically study their impact on the agent behavior.

2505.16227.tldr: This study offers the first work to systematically explore efficient, low-resource personalization of jargon detection using open-source language models, offering a practical path toward scalable, user-adaptive NLP system.

2505.16700.tldr: MCP-RADAR is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLM performance within the MCP framework, and reveals distinct capability profiles and highlights a significant trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.

2505.16743.tldr: TRIM (Targeted Row-wise Iterative Metric-driven pruning), a novel approach that applies varying sparsity ratios to individual output dimensions (rows) within each layer within each layer, is introduced.

2505.16915.tldr: The first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate T2I models'systematic abilities to handle extended textual inputs that contain complex compositional requirements is presented, revealing fundamental limitations in compositional reasoning.

2505.17370.tldr: It is argued that geometric structure - not pointwise prediction - is the right abstraction for a dynamic-agnostic foundational model, and FRIREN makes long-term forecasting both accurate and interpretable, setting a new benchmark for LTSF model design.

2505.19147.tldr: It is argued that the focus of research for efficient artificial intelligence (AI) is shifting from model-centric compression to data-centric compression, which improves AI efficiency by directly compressing the volume of data processed during model training or inference.

2505.19547.tldr: Extensive experiments show that STRAP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art STGNN baselines on STOOD tasks, demonstrating its robustness, adaptability, and strong generalization capability without task-specific fine-tuning.

2505.20096.tldr: The results highlight the effectiveness of collaborative, modular reasoning in retrieval-augmented systems: MA-RAG not only improves answer accuracy and robustness but also provides interpretable intermediate reasoning steps, establishing a new paradigm for efficient and reliable multi-agent RAG.

2505.22108.tldr: This work proposes a novel compliance-aware FL framework that enhances DP by adaptively adjusting noise based on quantifiable client compliance scores, and introduces a compliance scoring tool based on key healthcare and security standards to promote secure, inclusive, and equitable participation across diverse clinical settings.

2505.22202.tldr: The results indicate that pretrained LMs can effectively transition to abstract, structured reasoning within latent embedding spaces.

2505.23270.tldr: This work introduces a comprehensive auditing framework for unlearning evaluation, comprising three benchmark datasets, six unlearning algorithms, and five prompt-based auditing methods, and proposes a novel technique that leverages intermediate activation perturbations, addressing the limitations of auditing methods that rely solely on model inputs and outputs.

2505.23590.tldr: It is found that MLLMs, initially performing near to random guessing on the simplest jigsaw puzzles, achieve near-perfect accuracy and generalize to complex, unseen configurations through fine-tuning, and RL exhibits more effective generalization than Supervised Fine-Tuning.

2505.24293.tldr: This work maps LLM inference for a given input sequence to an equivalent and interpretable linear system which reconstructs the predicted output embedding with relative error below $10^{-13}$ at double floating-point precision, requiring no additional model training.

2506.00320.tldr: Dyna-Think, a thinking framework that integrates planning with an internal world model with reasoning and acting to enhance AI agent performance, is proposed and a promising research direction to integrate world model simulation into AI agents to enhance their reasoning, planning, and acting capabilities is suggested.

2506.00895.tldr: It is demonstrated that SCoTS significantly improves the performance and generalization capabilities of diffusion planners on offline goal-conditioned benchmarks requiring stitching and long-horizon reasoning, and augmented trajectories generated by SCoTS significantly improve the performance of widely used offline goal-conditioned RL algorithms across diverse environments.

2506.03227.tldr: This work establishes a more formal relationship between these two models by bounding the approximation error between two such related models, and shows how this novel approach is illustrated on a numerical example of a fixed-point attractor system modeled as a neural ODE.

2506.03750.tldr: MoodAngels is presented, the first specialized multi-agent framework for mood disorder diagnosis that combines granular-scale analysis of clinical assessments with a structured verification process, enabling more accurate interpretation of complex psychiatric data.

2506.04235.tldr: Findings show that structure-conditioned inverse folding models outperform others in both affinity correlation and generation tasks, and show that structure-conditioned inverse folding models outperform others in both affinity correlation and generation tasks.

2506.09522.tldr: This work proposes ReVisiT, a simple training-free decoding method that references vision tokens to guide text generation and leverages the semantic information embedded within vision tokens by projecting them into the text token distribution.

2506.11035.tldr: This work develops a differentiable parameterization of Tversky's similarity that is learnable through gradient descent, and derives basic neural network building blocks such as the Tversky projection layer, which unlike the linear projection layer can model non-linear functions such as XOR.

2506.12421.tldr: The Multiple Aspects of Planning (MAoP) is introduced, empowering LLMs with "wide-horizon thinking" to solve planning problems with multifaceted constraints and offers novel insights for evaluating sophisticated scenarios through simulation.

2506.12963.tldr: This work presents Reasoning-aware Representation Misdirection for Unlearning ($R^2MU), a novel method that effectively suppresses sensitive reasoning traces and prevents the generation of associated final answers, while preserving the model's reasoning ability.

2506.14670.tldr: StreetLens is presented, a user-configurable human-centered workflow that integrates relevant social science expertise into a VLM for scalable neighborhood environmental assessments and represents a shift toward flexible and agentic AI systems that work closely with researchers to accelerate and scale neighborhood studies.

2506.15685.tldr: Adversarial Evolution Training (AET), a simple yet powerful framework that strategically prepends an Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) phase to conventional AT, hypothesize cultivates a favorable feature manifold, enabling more efficient and effective robustness acquisition.

2506.16596.tldr: A community‐driven vision for a new knowledge infrastructure is outlined that should include sets of conventions and social structures that are adopted by contributors and leverages contemporary advances in knowledge representation and reasoning.

2506.17368.tldr: The results establish positional vulnerability as a distinct MoE-specific safety challenge and provide a practical, compute-efficient pathway for expert-level safety interventions within routed architectures.

2506.18233.tldr: This work explores a fourth dimension, virtual logical depth (VLD), which increases effective algorithmic depth without changing parameter count by reusing weights, suggesting a new scaling path beyond token-wise test-time methods.

2506.21625.tldr: This work introduces DocSAR-200, a rigorously annotated benchmark of 200 scientific documents designed specifically for evaluating SAR extraction methods, and proposes Doc2SAR, a novel synergistic framework that integrates domain-specific tools with MLLMs enhanced via supervised fine-tuning (SFT).

2507.01649.tldr: This paper introduces GradMetaNet, a novel architecture for learning on gradients, constructed from simple equivariant blocks, and proves universality results for GradMetaNet, and shows that previous approaches cannot approximate natural gradient-based functions that GradMetaNet can.

2507.04351.tldr: Experiments show that the Fabric-Llama-90B consistently outperforms pretrained vision-language baselines in both attribute ranking and selection reliability, and is released as a dataset of 220 diverse fabrics.

2507.08972.tldr: It is shown that appropriately designed PINNs can successfully simulate fully turbulent flows in both two and three dimensions, directly learning solutions to the fundamental fluid equations without traditional computational grids or training data.

2507.10605.tldr: RedOne is introduced, a domain-specific LLM designed to break the performance bottleneck of single-task baselines and establish a comprehensive foundation for the SNS, demonstrating excellent generalization across various tasks and promising applicability in real-world scenarios.

2507.10864.tldr: A new, lightweight, and efficient framework for polyp detection that combines the Local Outlier Factor (LOF) algorithm for filtering noisy data with the YOLO-v11n deep learning model is introduced, demonstrating enhanced accuracy and efficiency.

2507.11620.tldr: This work proposes novel two- and three-dimensional tensor representations for event time series, coupled with sparse autoencoders that learn physically meaningful latent representations that support a variety of downstream tasks, including anomaly detection, similarity-based retrieval, semantic clustering, and unsupervised classification.

2507.13229.tldr: This work establishes a new state of the art on Middlebury v3 and ETH3D benchmarks, significantly outperforming prior methods in most metrics while reconstructing high-quality details with competitive efficiency.

2507.16083.tldr: This paper studies the problem of text-based compositional multi-tasking, where each test example involves the simultaneous execution of multiple tasks, and proposes a benchmark comprising four practically relevant compositional tasks.

2508.01181.tldr: Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that MoSEAR achieves state-of-the-art performance, particularly under modality conflict conditions, and mitigates emotion conflicts and improves performance on consistent samples-without incurring a trade-off between audio and visual modalities.

2508.02621.tldr: This work offers a new paradigm for intelligent systems that can learn to operationalize the procedural knowledge embedded in scientific content, marking a critical step toward more autonomous and effective AI for healthcare scientific discovery.

2508.05996.tldr: MedOrch shows that the collaboration within distinct VLM-based agents can surpass the capabilities of any individual agent, and underscores the value of mediator-guided multi-agent collaboration in advancing medical multimodal intelligence.

2508.08882.tldr: MSARL, a Multi-Small-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework that explicitly decouples reasoning from tool use, is presented, demonstrating that cognitive-role decoupling with small agents is a scalable blueprint for multi-agent AI design.

2508.16396.tldr: FuXi-CMIPAlign, a generative deep learning framework for downscaling CMIP outputs, integrates Flow Matching for generative modeling with domain adaptation via MMD loss to align feature distributions between training data and inference data, thereby mitigating input discrepancies and improving accuracy, stability, and generalization across emission scenarios.

2509.00482.tldr: This report investigates approaches for prompting a tool-augmented large language model to act as a role-playing dialogue agent in the API track of the Commonsense Persona-grounded Dialogue Challenge (CPDC) 2025 and demonstrates that RRP design can substantially improve the effectiveness and reliability of role-playing dialogue agents compared with more elaborate methods such as APO.

2509.01092.tldr: It is argued that most computations over the RAG context during decoding are unnecessary and can be eliminated with minimal impact on performance, and proposed REFRAG, an efficient decoding framework that compresses, senses, and expands to improve latency in RAG applications.

2509.02785.tldr: The DrDiff is introduced, a novel framework for long-text generation that overcomes the efficiency-quality trade-off through three core technologies; a dynamic expert scheduling mechanism that intelligently allocates computational resources during the diffusion process based on text complexity, enabling more efficient handling of text generation tasks of varying difficulty.

2509.02930.tldr: A measure of sample diversity that translates ideas from ecology to machine learning -- the Vendi Score -- is adopted, allowing the user to specify and evaluate any desired form of diversity, which could support skill-diversity pretraining in new and richly interactive environments where optimising for various forms of diversity may be desirable.

2509.03937.tldr: This work proposes a new self-play fine-tuning method tailored for the Text-to-SQL task, called SPFT-SQL, which outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods during the self-play fine-tuning phase.

2509.07558.tldr: This work proposes VL Norm (Variance-reduced Length-dependent Normalization), a simple yet effective loss aggregation method tailored to the characteristic of dynamic generation lengths in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards that provides an unbiased estimate of the true policy loss but also minimizes gradient variance in theory.

2509.09942.tldr: This work proposes SmartCoder-R1 (based on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B), a novel framework for secure and explainable smart contract generation that establishes a new state of the art, achieving top performance across five key metrics.

2509.13380.tldr: ASTREA is presented, the first agentic system executed on flight-heritage hardware (TRL 9) for autonomous spacecraft operations, with on-orbit operation aboard the International Space Station (ISS), demonstrating the potential for scalable agentic supervision architectures in future autonomous spacecraft.

2509.18111.tldr: This work proposes a novel context optimization (CoOp)-based framework that integrates subspace representation learning with prompt tuning and improves ID-OOD separability by projecting the ID features into a subspace spanned by prompt vectors, while projecting ID-irrelevant features into an orthogonal null space.

2509.21240.tldr: This work proposes Tree-based Group Relative Policy Optimization (Tree-GRPO), a grouped agent RL method based on tree search, where each tree node represents the complete agent interaction step and demonstrates the superiority of the proposed tree-based RL over the chain-based RL method.

2509.22551.tldr: ConQuER bridges the gap between the advantages of quantum computing and the practical needs of controllable generation modeling, and embeds a lightweight controller circuit that can be directly combined with pre-trained IQP circuits to precisely control the output distribution without full retraining.

2509.23373.tldr: Experiments show that GCR promotes cleaner feature structure, stronger intra-class cohesion, and improved generalization, offering a new perspective on learning from prediction structure.

2509.23765.tldr: Knowledge-Level Consistency Reinforcement Learning Framework is proposed, a novel framework that focuses on the knowledge consistency between the policy model's expressed knowledge and the base model's parametric knowledge, and introduces a Dual-Fact Alignment mechanism to jointly optimize factual recall and precision.

2509.23812.tldr: This work presents a path-sensitive framework, JUnitGenie, to fill the gap by combining code knowledge with the semantic capabilities of LLMs in guiding context-aware unit test generation and demonstrates that the generated test cases can uncover real-world bugs.

2509.24869.tldr: This work proposes Retro*, a novel approach for reasoning-intensive document retrieval that introduces a rubric-based relevance scoring mechanism, enabling the model to reason about the relationship between a task and a document based on explicitly defined criteria, whereby producing a fine-grained, interpretable relevance score.

2509.25810.tldr: This work derives a sequential variational lower bound and optimize it by iteratively discovering temporally-consistent latent structures via RL, followed by fine-tuning on the bootstrapped data, suggesting that mid-training is most effective when the decision space is compact and the effective horizon is short.

2510.00240.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate substantial improvements in semantic search for threat intelligence, information retrieval, cybersecurity-focused named entity recognition, and code vulnerability detection.

2510.03418.tldr: This work presents a multi-agent contradiction-aware benchmark framework for the legal domain that generates synthetic legal-style documents, injects six structured contradiction types, and models both self- and pairwise inconsistencies.

2510.03813.tldr: This work introduces Contrastive Noise Optimization, a simple yet effective method that addresses the diversity issue from a distinct perspective and develops a contrastive loss defined in the Tweedie data space and optimize a batch of noise latents.

2510.04064.tldr: The findings reveal that LLMs develop a surprisingly well-defined internal geometry of emotion, which sharpens with model scale and significantly outperforms zero-shot prompting, and is not a final-layer phenomenon but emerges early and peaks mid-network.

2510.04087.tldr: This paper introduces a principled and flexible framework for practitioners to explicitly manage the trade-off between reliability and computational efficiency, and creates an adaptive inference strategy, best of mini-N in-loop, which partitions the generation budget into sequential loops with a calibrated, early-exit condition.

2510.04550.tldr: TRAJECT-Bench is introduced, a trajectory-aware benchmark to comprehensively evaluate LLMs'tool use capability through diverse tasks with fine-grained evaluation metrics, and reveals failure modes such as similar tool confusion and parameter-blind selection, and scaling behavior with tool diversity and trajectory length.

2510.04716.tldr: This work formalizes CBL-SAT and basic complexity and present operational operators (CBL-AC and CBL-CONS) that prune contradictions earlier on classical hardware and gives equivalent sheaf and exclusivity-graph semantics and a context-aware proof calculus that is conservative in the flat limit.

2510.04852.tldr: FreshBrew is introduced, a novel benchmark for evaluating AI agents on project-level Java migrations, with a specific focus on measuring an agent's ability to preserve program semantics and avoid reward hacking, which it is argued requires projects with high test coverage for a rigorous and reliable evaluation.

2510.05124.tldr: Applied to a real-world marketing scenario, MADS significantly improved the persuasion capacity of small LLMs, increasing the organic traffic conversion rate by 22.4% and validated its effectiveness through users' Chain-of-Attitude (CoA) modeling and dedicated LLMs'persuasion assessment.

2510.05295.tldr: AUREXA-SE jointly leverages raw audio waveforms and visual cues by employing a U-Net-based 1D convolutional encoder for audio and a Swin Transformer V2 for efficient and expressive visual feature extraction.

2510.05969.tldr: This work uses a linear probe on the final-token representations of LLMs to demonstrate that the difficulty level of math problems can be linearly modeled and reveals that difficulty perception in LLMs is not only present but also structurally organized, offering new theoretical insights and practical directions for future research.

2510.06278.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations on 80 real-valued UCI datasets demonstrate that RVFL-X consistently outperforms both the original RVFL and state-of-the-art (SOTA) RNN variants, showcasing its robustness and effectiveness across diverse application domains.

2510.06343.tldr: The potential of leveraging locally hosted large language models with retrieval-augmented generation to support cybersecurity risk assessment in the forestry domain while complying with data protection and privacy requirements that limit external data sharing is explored.

2510.06800.tldr: This work introduces FURINA-Builder, a novel multi-agent collaboration pipeline that automatically constructs fully customizable RP benchmarks at any scale, and builds FURINA-Bench, a new comprehensive role-playing benchmark featuring both established and synthesized test characters, each assessed with dimension-specific evaluation criteria.

2510.07019.tldr: Experimental results show that NHA surpasses Transformers and other hybrid baselines on recall-intensive and commonsense reasoning tasks, and pretrained LLMs can be structurally hybridized with NHA, achieving competitive accuracy while delivering significant efficiency gains.

2510.07276.tldr: A lexicographic framework for modeling MO-MAPF, along with an algorithm that directly computes a single solution aligned with a lexicographic preference over objectives, and empirically demonstrate that LCBS computes optimal solutions while scaling to instances with up to ten objectives -- far beyond the limits of existing MO-MAPF methods.

2510.07343.tldr: This work introduces Local MAP Sampling (LMAPS), a new inference framework that iteratively solving local MAP subproblems along the diffusion trajectory, offering a unified probabilistic interpretation for optimization-based methods.

2510.07974.tldr: An adaptive world model-enhanced reasoning mechanism that constructs a dynamic textual world model to track entity states and temporal sequences is proposed, which mimics how humans use implicit world models to distinguish between external events and internal beliefs.

2510.08075.tldr: The Multi-Condition Conformal Selection algorithm is proposed, which extends conformal selection to scenarios with multiple conditions and introduces a novel nonconformity score with regional monotonicity for conjunctive conditions and a global Benjamini-Hochberg procedure for disjunctive conditions, thereby establishing finite-sample FDR control with theoretical guarantees.

2510.09082.tldr: A higher-order network dynamics identification method for long-term dynamic prediction of complex networks and a dual-drive dynamic prediction module for physical data is proposed to address the problem that traditional graph machine learning can only deal with pairwise relations.

2510.09643.tldr: DRGrad’s superior performance over competing state-of-the-art MTL models, especially in terms of AUC (Area Under the Curve) metrics, indicates that it effectively manages task conflicts in multi-task learning environments without increasing model complexity, while also addressing the deficiencies in noise pro-cessing.

2510.09644.tldr: A unified framework that integrates CCTV surveillance videos with multi-source data descriptors to enhance real-time urban traffic prediction and emphasizes the need for the incorporation of video stream analytics with data from multiple sources for the design of real-time, responsive, adaptable multi-level intelligent transportation systems, which makes urban mobility smarter and safer.

2510.09646.tldr: The framework is evaluated using a dataset of 1,000 Tuberculosis patients as a use case, demonstrating low-latency event detection, scalable reasoning, and high model performance (in terms of precision, recall, and F1-score).

2510.09647.tldr: This work presents QuRA, a novel backdoor attack that exploits model quantization to embed malicious behaviors, and highlights critical vulnerability in widely used model quantization process, emphasizing the need for more robust security measures.

2510.09649.tldr: TinyViT-Batten, a few-shot Vision Transformer (ViT) framework to detect early Batten disease from pediatric brain MRI with limited training cases, demonstrates a practical AI solution for early Batten disease detection.

2510.09663.tldr: This work proposes a Convolutional Neural Network based framework for detecting rogue devices and identifying genuine ones using softmax probability thresholding and emulates an attack scenario in which adversaries attempt to mimic the RF characteristics of genuine devices.

2510.09674.tldr: The real-world deployment of AI-assisted evaluation within the pipeline of two government initiatives: corporate applications aimed at international business expansion and citizen reimbursement claims for investments in energy-efficient home improvements confirm that AI effectively enhanced processing efficiency and reduced workload across both types of applications.

2510.09677.tldr: This study provides practical and scientific contributions to the CT education community, including an inventory of AI-based initiatives for CT education useful to educators, an overview of various aspects of integrating AI into CT education, and insights into new and expanded perspectives on CT in light of AI.

2510.09682.tldr: GRASP comprises two key ideas: an SCP graph that organizes SCPs into a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) capturing dependencies and relationships, and a graph-based reasoning process that systematically guides LLMs through relevant SCPs for code generation.

2510.09685.tldr: This paper provides an extensive review of deep neural network architectures and dynamic modeling methods inspired by differential equations, as well as regularization techniques and stochastic dynamical network models informed by stochastic differential equations.

2510.09686.tldr: It is argued that it must be stopped uploading massive amounts of AI-generated survey papers to the research community, by instituting strong norms for AI-assisted review writing, and developing new infrastructures such as Dynamic Live Surveys, community-maintained, version-controlled repositories that blend automated updates with human curation.

2510.09687.tldr: This study delves into the plasticity of neural networks, offering empirical support for the notion that critical learning periods and warm-starting performance loss can be avoided through simple adjustments to learning hyperparameters, and demonstrates that these problems can be averted by employing a cyclic learning rate schedule.

2510.09691.tldr: The results suggest that adaptive privacy budgets and adaptive clipping can help maintain model accuracy while preserving privacy, and are introduced in the Gaussian mechanism.

2510.09694.tldr: Kelp is proposed, a novel plug-in framework that enables streaming risk detection within the LM generation pipeline and introduces an Anchored Temporal Consistency (ATC) loss to enforce monotonic harm predictions by embedding a benign-then-harmful temporal prior.

2510.09696.tldr: Vanishing Contributions (VCON), a unified framework for the smooth, iterative transition of DNNs into a compressed form, is introduced, which is compatible with existing compression techniques and consistently improves performance across diverse tasks.

2510.09699.tldr: This work introduces VisualDAN, a single adversarial image embedded with DAN-style commands that effectively bypasses the safeguards of aligned VLMs, forcing them to execute a broad range of harmful instructions that severely violate ethical standards.

2510.09706.tldr: It is shown how SAJD outperforms state-of-the-art jamming detection xApp in terms of accuracy and adaptability under various dynamic and previously unseen interference scenarios in the O-RAN-compliant testbed.

2510.09709.tldr: A tendency of large language models (LLMs) to generate absurd patterns despite their clear inappropriateness in a simple task of identifying regularities in number series is presented and highlights potential limitations in their capability for applied tasks requiring logical reasoning, even when employing chain-of-thought reasoning mechanisms.

2510.09711.tldr: This work proposes ReaLM, a novel and effective framework that bridges the gap between KG embeddings and LLM tokenization through the mechanism of residual vector quantization, and incorporates ontology-guided class constraints to enforce semantic consistency.

2510.09720.tldr: A Preference-Aware Memory Update Mechanism (PAMU) is proposed that enables dynamic and personalized memory refinement and constructs a fused preference-aware representation that captures both short-term fluctuations and long-term user tendencies.

2510.09722.tldr: This work presents a layout-aware and efficiency-optimized framework for automated extraction and evaluation that addresses all three challenges of resume information extraction, and demonstrates that a fine-tuned compact 0.6B LLM achieves top-tier accuracy while significantly reducing inference latency and computational cost.

2510.09723.tldr: It is demonstrated that on 5 out of 6 of these datasets, Narrative Learning became more accurate than the baseline explainable models in 2025 or earlier because of improvements in language models.

2510.09724.tldr: This work designs a hybrid framework that combines programmatic functional testing to rigorously verify interaction logic with visually-grounded qualitative testing to assess rendered outputs against reference snapshots, and presents InteractScience, a benchmark consisting of a substantial set of carefully designed questions across five scientific domains.

2510.09732.tldr: An exploratory evaluation of explanation quality under progressive behavioral-input reduction, where models are discovered from progressively smaller prefixes of a fixed log, suggests a path toward more computationally efficient, LLM-assisted process analysis in resource-constrained settings.

2510.09734.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that ARROW achieves state-of-the-art performance in global weather forecasting, establishing a promising paradigm in this field and developing an adaptive rollout scheduler based on reinforcement learning, which selects the most suitable time interval to forecast according to the current weather state.

2510.09735.tldr: InterCorpRel-LLM is proposed, a cross-modal framework that integrates GNNs with LLMs, supported by a proprietary dataset derived from FactSet supply chain records and three tailored training tasks: company graph matching, industry classification, and supply relation prediction that substantially outperforms strong baselines on a supply relation identification task.

2510.09738.tldr: This research introduces the Judge's Verdict Benchmark, a novel two-step methodology to evaluate Large Language Models as judges for response accuracy evaluation tasks, and demonstrates that judge excellence is not solely dependent on model size but on specific training strategies.

2510.09739.tldr: A bottom-up personality model is created from a classic adjective list using machine learning and compared its descriptive utility against the Big Five by analyzing one million Reddit comments, affirm the robustness of the Big Five and suggest personality's semantic structure is context-dependent.

2510.09752.tldr: This paper presents a demonstration of Patentformer, an AI-powered automated patent drafting platform designed to support patent attorneys by rapidly producing high-quality patent applications adhering to legal writing standards.

2510.09762.tldr: This paper presents PatentVision, a multimodal framework that integrates textual and visual inputs such as patent claims and drawings to generate complete patent specifications, and enhances accuracy by combining fine tuned vision language models with domain specific training tailored to patents.

2510.09768.tldr: An empirical study in the geometric task of learning interatomic potentials, which shows equivariance matters even more at larger scales; it is observed that equivariant architectures, which leverage task symmetry, scale better than non-equivariant models.

2510.09776.tldr: A theoretical analysis of Transformers'limitations for TSF through the lens of In-Context Learning (ICL) theory sheds light on several previously underexplored phenomena and offers practical insights for designing more effective forecasting architectures.

2510.09781.tldr: A foundational guardrail Safiron is proposed, combining a cross-planner adapter with a compact guardian model, and Pre-Exec Bench is released, a realistic benchmark covering diverse tools and branching trajectories, which measures detection, fine-grained categorization, explanation, and cross-planner generalization in human-verified scenarios.

2510.09783.tldr: A novel LLM-based oversampling method that conditions synthetic sample generation on both minority labels and features and fine-tune the LLM not only on minority samples but also on interpolated samples to further enrich variability.

2510.09815.tldr: It is found only some intuitive features have strong correlations with participant performance, prompting the need for further investigating of predictive features for success in these tasks.

2510.09845.tldr: The efficacy of deep learning for mapping the near real-time hourly spread of wildfire fronts and smoke plumes using an innovative self-supervised deep learning-system is demonstrated: successfully distinguishing smoke plumes from clouds using GOES-18 and TEMPO data.

2510.09846.tldr: CALM is introduced, a novel causal analysis language model specifically designed for tabular data in complex systems that significantly outperforms existing methods in both simulation studies and in a real-world application identifying causal factors in Hepatitis C virus progression.

2510.09852.tldr: The proposed ProxRouter applies an exponentially tilted aggregation mechanism to balance bias and variance in nonparametric routers, improving their robustness to outliers and enhances outlier routing while preserving inlier performance with minimal overhead.

2510.09872.tldr: This work introduces WARC-Bench (Web Archive Benchmark), a novel web navigation benchmark featuring 438 tasks designed to evaluate multimodal AI agents on subtasks, and explores two common training techniques: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

2510.09874.tldr: The paper presents the first results of an artistic research project investigating how Large Language Models (LLMs) curate and present collective memory, and suggests a way of how these efforts can be disseminated in a playful way to a general audience.

2510.09879.tldr: This work introduces CHUG: Crowdsourced User-Generated HDR Video Quality Dataset, the first large-scale subjective study on UGC-HDR quality, and expects it will advance No-Reference (NR) HDR-VQA research by offering a large-scale, diverse, and real-world UGC dataset.

2510.09894.tldr: AETHER (AlphaEarth-POI Enriched Representation Learning), a lightweight framework that adapts AlphaEarth to human-centered urban analysis through multimodal alignment guided by Points of Interest (POIs), is proposed.

2510.09898.tldr: T2J is presented, a prompt-augmentation framework that strengthens LLM-based PyTorch to JAX translation and introduces three metrics tailored to PyTorch to JAX: T2J CodeTrans Score, T2J FixCost Score, and T2J Comparison Score (LLM-as-judge).

2510.09901.tldr: The view and vision of LLM-based scientific agents and their growing role in transforming the scientific discovery lifecycle, from hypothesis discovery, experimental design and execution, to result analysis and refinement are presented.

2510.09904.tldr: A principled study on the forward (hidden states) and backward stability of Transformers under different layer normalization placements, which provides key insights into the training dynamics: whether training drives Transformers toward regular solutions or pathological behaviors.

2510.09905.tldr: It is found that identical scenarios paired with different user profiles produce systematically divergent emotional interpretations, which highlights a key challenge for memory enhanced AI: systems designed for personalization may inadvertently reinforce social inequalities.

2510.09907.tldr: An LLM-based agent which analyzes Python modules, infers function-specific and cross-function properties from code and documentation, synthesizes and executes PBTs, reflects on outputs of these tests to confirm true bugs, and finally outputs actionable bug reports for the developer is demonstrated.

2510.09912.tldr: The findings confirm that the proposed architecture improves UAV perception efficiency, enabling real-time operation for navigation, object recognition, and environmental monitoring tasks.

2510.09914.tldr: K-DREAM (Knowledge-Driven Embedding-Augmented Model), a novel framework that leverages knowledge graphs to augment diffusion-based generative models for drug discovery, generates drug candidates with improved binding affinities and predicted efficacy, surpassing current state-of-the-art generative models.

2510.09930.tldr: Experiments show that MemPromptTSS achieves 23% and 85% accuracy improvements over the best baseline in single- and multi-granularity segmentation under single iteration inference, and provides stronger refinement in iterative inference with average per-iteration gains of 2.66 percentage points.

2510.09934.tldr: This paper calls for expanding the datasets using a denoising diffusion model to include a variety of image types such as stereo, wide-angled, macro, and close-up images, and recommends enhancing the images using Controlnet to evaluate and increase the quality of the corresponding datasets, and hence improve the study of the marine ecosystem.

2510.09942.tldr: This work derives an information-theoretic bound that decomposes the token rejection rate into contributions from SLM-LLM distribution mismatch and from quantization distortion, and proposes the Sparse Quantize-and-Sample SD (SQS-SD) framework, which exploits distributional sparsity through structured sparsification and lattice-based quantization.

2510.09945.tldr: A human-in-the-loop interactive framework that enables interventional learning through targeted human corrections of segmentation outputs that improves segmentation accuracy by up to 9 mIoU points on challenging cubemap data and yields 3-4 reduction in annotation effort compared to standard retraining, while maintaining competitive performance on benchmark datasets.

2510.09965.tldr: This paper proposes Homomorphic Policy Gradient (HPG), which guarantees optimal policy equivalence under sufficient conditions, and its extension, Error-Bounded HPG (EBHPG), which balances computational efficiency and the performance loss induced by aggregation.

2510.09968.tldr: This study analyzes over 8,000 user reviews of AI development platforms from G2.com to indicate that once applied, MLOps practices are perceived as universally beneficial across organizational settings.

2510.09970.tldr: This work introduces a novel stepwise instruction dataset that decomposes fallacy classification into a series of atomic procedural steps (simple binary questions) and provides enhanced transparency into the LLMs'decision-making, highlighting a practical pathway for Neuro-symbolic architectures to address LLM reasoning deficits.

2510.10002.tldr: It is found that deliberation format had a strong impact on model behavior: GPT-4.1 and Gemini 2.0 Flash stood out as highly conforming relative to Claude 3.7 Sonnet, with their verdict behavior strongly shaped by order effects.

2510.10009.tldr: This work proposes incorporating a pre-trained squeezer model that helps the search agent understand the retrieved documents, allowing the search agent to focus on query generation for high retrieval recall, and discovers that even a small-scale 3B LLM can demonstrate a strong capability of query expansion and achieve state-of-the-art accuracy on the multi-hop QA benchmarks.

2510.10010.tldr: The three-phase protocol formed by independent analysis, cross-critique, and arbitration, filters harmful AI-generated code suggestions before production deployment, addressing how AI-assisted debugging increasingly produces modifications that introduce unnecessary complexity, break existing functionality, or address problems.

2510.10023.tldr: This work introduces a new fine-tuning strategy, STAT, to train such a student model by using the metacognition ability of a stronger large language model (LLM) as the teacher, and finds that STAT is complementary to RL via GRPO (Shao et al., 2024): after the model is improved using STAT to address skill gaps, GRPO continues to add further gains.

2510.10028.tldr: A UAV-enabled LAENet system model that jointly captures UAV mobility, user-UAV communication, and the onboard visual question answering (VQA) pipeline is proposed and a mixed-integer non-convex optimization problem to minimize task latency and power consumption under user-specific accuracy constraints is formulated.

2510.10035.tldr: CE-Graph is introduced, a framework that operationalizes a new paradigm where the optimization goal is not to maximize a scalar score, but to directly minimize a workflow's Expected Failure Mass, i.e., the integral of its failure probability density function defined over a high-dimensional Failure Signature Space (FSS).

2510.10041.tldr: This work presents the first biomedical implementation of FOSSIL (Flexible Optimization via Sample-Sensitive Importance Learning), a regret-minimizing weighting framework that adaptively balances training emphasis according to sample difficulty.

2510.10042.tldr: A novel graph-theoretic framework that cleanly separates credibility--external, a priori trust in sources--from confidence--an internal, emergent valuation induced by network structure is proposed, a principled foundation for contradiction-tolerant reasoning that activates classical logic precisely where structure supports it.

2510.10049.tldr: ALLOY enables users to express procedural preferences through natural demonstrations rather than prompts, while making these procedures transparent and editable through visualized workflows that can be generalized across task variations.

2510.10052.tldr: ViTAR is introduced, a novel VLM framework that emulates the iterative reasoning process of human experts through a cognitive chain of think-act-rethink-answer, demonstrating that embedding expert-style iterative thinking chains into VLMs enhances both performance and trustworthiness of medical AI.

2510.10060.tldr: Experiments on computer vision and natural language processing tasks show that Translution (including {\alpha}-Translution) achieves superior accuracy compared to self-attention, and a lightweight variant of Translution is proposed, named {\alpha}-Translution.

2510.10063.tldr: The Concept Language Model Network (CLMN) is proposed, a novel neural-symbolic framework that reconciles performance and interpretability through continuous concept embeddings enhanced by fuzzy logic-based reasoning that outperforms existing concept-based methods in both accuracy and explanation quality.

2510.10066.tldr: OBsmith is presented, a novel framework to systematically test JavaScript obfuscators using large language models (LLMs) and is envisioned as an important step towards automated testing and quality assurance of obfuscators and other semantic-preserving toolchains.

2510.10074.tldr: This work presents StepFly, a novel end-to-end agentic framework for troubleshooting guide automation and demonstrates that StepFly achieves a ~94% success rate on GPT-4.1, outperforming baselines with less time and token consumption.

2510.10075.tldr: This paper investigates and establishes point-based shortcut learning behavior in deep learning time series classification, and proposes a simple detection method based on other class to detect shortcut occurs without relying on test data or clean training classes.

2510.10079.tldr: A longitudinal model of AI companionship development is suggested and an empirical method to study human-AI companionship is demonstrated to demonstrate an empirical method to study human-AI companionship.

2510.10085.tldr: Pharmacist is a safety alignment data curation solution that enhances defense against harmful fine-tuning by selecting a high-quality and safety-critical core subset from the original alignment data.

2510.10108.tldr: An uncertainty aware post-detection framework that rescales detection confidences using both statistical uncertainty and domain relevant visual cues and a lightweight Confidence Refinement Network that integrates uncertainty estimates with color, edge, and texture features to adjust detection scores without modifying the base model.

2510.10117.tldr: The findings of DixitWorld reveal a key trade-off between generative creativity and discriminative understanding in multimodal abductive reasoning, a central challenge for developing more balanced and capable vision-language agents.

2510.10122.tldr: An autoencoder-based super resolution model has been developed that contains approximately 100 thousand parameters and uses the DeepFusionNet architecture and according to the results of the tests, the DeepFusionNet based super-resolution method achieved a PSNR of 25.30 and a SSIM score of 80.7 percent according to the validation set.

2510.10129.tldr: CacheClip is presented, a novel framework that achieves both fast TTFT and high generation quality in RAG systems, and integrates three techniques: auxiliary-model-guided token selection for selective KV cache recomputation, where the auxiliary model is finetuned to improve selection accuracy.

2510.10136.tldr: PermLLM, a novel post-training pruning framework that introduces learnable channel permutation (LCP) for N:M sparsity, seamlessly integrates with existing one-shot pruning methods to adaptively optimize channel permutations, effectively mitigating pruning-induced errors.

2510.10138.tldr: A systematic framework that strategically combines OCR engines with Large Language Models to optimize the accuracy-efficiency trade-off inherent in repetitive document extraction tasks, and establishes a general principle: the repetitive nature of copy-heavy tasks can be transformed from a computational burden into an optimization opportunity through structure-aware method selection.

2510.10145.tldr: FIRE is proposed, a unified frequency domain decomposition framework that provides a mathematical abstraction for diverse types of time series, so as to achieve interpretable and robust time series forecasting.

2510.10158.tldr: MSTDiff, a Multi-Scale Diffusion Transformer for joint simulation of mobile traffic and user trajectories applies discrete wavelet transforms for multi-resolution traffic decomposition and uses a hybrid denoising network to process continuous traffic volumes and discrete location sequences.

2510.10179.tldr: This study proposes MOJOFuzzer, the first adaptive LLM-based fuzzing framework designed for zero-shot learning environments of emerging programming languages, and establishes a foundational methodology for leveraging LLMs in the testing of emerging programming languages.

2510.10182.tldr: This paper presents the first comprehensive survey of inductive reasoning for LLMs, and methods for improving inductive reasoning are categorized into three main areas: post-training, test-time scaling, and data augmentation.

2510.10185.tldr: It is demonstrated that high accuracy alone is an insufficient measure of clinical or public trust, and the urgent need for transparent and auditable reasoning processes is highlighted, a cornerstone for the responsible development and deployment of medical AI.

2510.10195.tldr: Through extensive experiments, CauchyNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models in predictive accuracy, often achieving a 50% lower mean absolute error with fewer parameters.

2510.10199.tldr: The Human-AI Trust Scale (HAITS) is introduced and validated, a new measure designed to capture both the rational and relational aspects of trust in GenAI that offers a validated, culturally sensitive tool for measuring trust in GenAI and provides new insight into how trust evolves in human-AI interaction.

2510.10201.tldr: A novel perspective on shaping RLVR with flow rewards derived from latent space is offered, and RLFR is proposed, where the flow fields of model latents are constructed from either off-policy high-quality data and on-policy rejection sampling data, and the velocity deviations of policy latents within it are quantified to serve as a reward signal.

2510.10214.tldr: This work proposes a novel end-to-end finite-horizon Wasserstein DRC framework that integrates the learning of anisotropic Wasserstein metrics with downstream control tasks in a closed-loop manner, thus enabling ambiguity sets to be systematically adjusted along performance-critical directions and yielding more effective control policies.

2510.10217.tldr: The Uncertainty-driven Foresight Recurrent Neural Network (UF-RNN), a model that combines standard time-series prediction with an active "Foresight" module, is proposed, suggesting that integrating uncertainty-driven foresight into imitation learning pipelines can significantly enhance a robot’s ability to handle unpredictable real-world conditions.

2510.10221.tldr: A novel attention model is proposed that integrates predictive TD signals and saliency-based BU cues through a bi-directional attention architecture and exhibits more coherent and interpretable attention patterns than baselines, supporting the idea that developmental mechanisms contribute to robust attention formation.

2510.10223.tldr: SyTTA is presented, an inference-time framework that adapts models on-the-fly without additional supervision, supporting deployment in label-scarce domains and showing that effective test-time adaptation for language models is achievable without labeled examples.

2510.10232.tldr: The Statistical Godel Machine is introduced, the first statistical safety layer for recursive edits, which replaces proof-based requirements with statistical confidence tests (e-values, Hoeffding bounds), admitting a modification only when superiority is certified at a chosen confidence level, while allocating a global error budget to bound cumulative risk across rounds.

2510.10250.tldr: This study explores the application of deep learning techniques in the automated detection and segmentation of brain tumors from MRI scans, and investigates the use of U-Net for semantic segmentation and EfficientDet for anchor-based object detection to enhance the localization and identification of tumors.

2510.10263.tldr: An integrated, data-driven framework that combines psychological measures, behavioral analytics, and machine learning to reveal underlying gamer personas is proposed and contributes a reproducible pipeline that links correlation-driven network insights with unsupervised learning.

2510.10271.tldr: It is demonstrated that special tokens can be exploited to construct four attack primitives, with which malicious users can reliably bypass the internal safety alignment of online LLM services and circumvent state-of-the-art (SOTA) external content moderation systems simultaneously.

2510.10274.tldr: This work proposes a novel Soft Prompt approach with minimally added parameters, by infusing prompt learning concepts into cross-embodiment robot learning and introducing separate sets of learnable embeddings for each distinct data source.

2510.10278.tldr: VivaBench is introduced, a multi-turn benchmark that evaluates sequential clinical reasoning in LLM agents and provides a standardized benchmark for evaluating conversational medical AI systems for real-world clinical decision support.

2510.10285.tldr: This study proposes Functional Head Identification and Class-Conditioned Rescaling, a lightweight, training-free plugin that identifies perception- and reasoning-oriented heads and adaptively rebalances their layerwise contributions, and provides an interpretable perspective on regulating cross-layer functional dynamics to enhance the reliability of multimodal reasoning.

2510.10292.tldr: This work proposes FactoredScenes, a framework that synthesizes realistic 3D scenes by leveraging the underlying structure of rooms by leveraging the underlying structure of rooms while learning the variation of object poses from lived-in scenes.

2510.10293.tldr: This work proposes MatryoshkaThinking, a novel method that significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining state-of-the-art performance and offers new insights into the design of efficient and scalable test-time inference strategies for advanced language models.

2510.10320.tldr: The results show that drift-based retraining achieves comparable forecasting accuracy to periodic retraining in most cases, making it a costeffective strategy, however, in cases where data is changing rapidly, periodic retraining is still preferred to maximize the forecasting accuracy.

2510.10321.tldr: This hybrid framework combines topological features with semantic reasoning while avoiding the cost and privacy concerns of large cloud models, paving the way for scalable, explainable, and locally deployable tools that can shift vulnerability analysis from purely syntactic checks to deeper structural and semantic insights.

2510.10325.tldr: KG-MAS offers a robust, scalable, and flexible solution for coupling heterogeneous physical and digital robotic environments, and facilitates the automatic generation of agents from semantic descriptions, thereby simplifying system extension and maintenance.

2510.10327.tldr: This study conducts a comprehensive scientometric analysis of research on data-driven pedestrian trajectory prediction and crowd simulation, mapping its intellectual evolution and interdisciplinary structure and reveals a strong convergence between artificial intelligence, urban informatics, and crowd behavior modeling.

2510.10331.tldr: This paper employs a novel reformatting technique, the Intent, Context, and Action (ICA) format, which transforms policies and workflows into a structure more comprehensible to LLMs, and develops a synthetic data generation strategy to create training data with minimal human intervention, enabling cost-effective fine-tuning of the model.
