2510.10338.tldr: The findings suggest that organizations investing incrementally in inclusive design can achieve expanded market reach and sustained competitive advantages, while those treating these considerations as overhead face compounding disadvantages as network effects and data advantages accrue to early movers.

2510.10339.tldr: This paper examines how existing measures used in the computing literature map to AI system components, attributes, hazards, and harms and finds that most measures focus on four principles – fairness, transparency, privacy, and trust – and primarily assess model or output system components.

2510.10360.tldr: Ortho-Fuse is presented, an optical flow-based framework that enables the generation of a reliable orthomosaic with reduced overlap requirements, and employs intermediate flow estimation to synthesize transitional imagery between consecutive aerial frames, artificially augmenting feature correspondences for improved geometric reconstruction.

2510.10379.tldr: RobotFleet provides abstractions for planning, scheduling, and execution across robots deployed as containerized services to simplify fleet scaling and management and lowers the barrier to building scalable multi-robot systems.

2510.10383.tldr: Two approaches to identify dataset bias are proposed that were tested on six different datasets, including natural, synthetic, and hybrid datasets, and results indicate that this method can effectively distinguish between contextual information and background noise, and alert on the presence of background noise even without the need to use background information.

2510.10390.tldr: RefusalBench is introduced, a generative methodology that programmatically creates diagnostic test cases through controlled linguistic perturbation that finds that selective refusal is a trainable, alignment-sensitive capability, offering a clear path for improvement.

2510.10398.tldr: This work proposes \textsc{Steam}, a semantic-level knowledge editing framework that enhances integration of updated knowledge into the model's knowledge structure and improves model's ability to reason with edited knowledge and enhances semantic coherence.

2510.10402.tldr: TreeDiff is a plug-and-play inference-time method that expands the search space while keeping computation tractable and exhibits favorable inference-time scaling: it continues to improve with additional computation, while existing inference-time methods plateau early under limited resources.

2510.10406.tldr: Mesh-Gait is introduced, a novel end-to-end multi-modal gait recognition framework that directly reconstructs 3D representations from 2D silhouettes, effectively combining the strengths of both modalities and extracts discriminative features from both silhouettes and reconstructed 3D heatmaps in a computationally efficient manner.

2510.10409.tldr: This work reveals that reasoning post-training fundamentally alters the relationship between trace length and accuracy, going beyond prior work that had shown that post-training causes traces to grow longer in general (e.g.,"overthinking").

2510.10415.tldr: The framework is introduced, an evaluation framework and set of evaluation recommendations for limited-resource and high-expertise settings and it is found that inter-annotator agreement (IAA) varies by dimension: fine-grained annotation improves agreement on correctness, coarse improves agreement on relevance, and judgments on communicates-risks remain inconsistent.

2510.10417.tldr: A multi-modal and multi-task framework that combines 2D temporal silhouettes with 3D SMPL features for robust gait analysis and a multitask learning strategy that jointly performs gait recognition and human attribute estimation, including age, body mass index (BMI), and gender is proposed.

2510.10426.tldr: Human-Like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (HuLiRAG), a framework that stages multimodal reasoning as a ``what--where--reweight''cascade, improves grounding fidelity and factual consistency while reducing hallucinations, advancing multimodal question answering toward trustworthy reasoning.

2510.10432.tldr: This work proposes HiLoMoE, a hierarchical LoRA MoE framework that enables holistic scaling in a parameter-efficient manner, and employs lightweight rank-1 experts for parameter-efficient horizontal scaling, and stacks multiple MoE layers with hierarchical routing to enable combinatorially diverse expert compositions.

2510.10433.tldr: This framework introduces a novel Feature Similarity Laplacian (FSL) penalty that explicitly models the time-varying relationships between features, and adopts the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) algorithm.

2510.10451.tldr: This work addresses the ill-posed nature of the problem caused by high degrees of freedom in locomotion by estimating movement variables of an incomplete transition model as actions within an RL framework and introduces a data-driven simulator for multi-animal behavior based on deep reinforcement learning and counterfactual simulation.

2510.10454.tldr: Analysis reveals that Traj-CoA exhibits clinically aligned temporal reasoning, establishing it as a promisingly robust and generalizable approach for modeling complex patient trajectories.

2510.10459.tldr: This work introduces a novel, universal ideographic metalanguage designed as an innovative communication framework that transcends academic, linguistic, and cultural boundaries and effectively serves underprivileged populations with limited formal education.

2510.10461.tldr: This work proposes MedCoAct, a confidence-aware multi-agent framework that simulates clinical collaboration by integrating specialized doctor and pharmacist agents, and presents a benchmark, DrugCareQA, to evaluate medical AI capabilities in integrated diagnosis and treatment workflows.

2510.10462.tldr: This work introduces a fundamentally new approach with the group decision simulation framework, which works by mimicking the collaborative decision-making process of a clinical panel, and learns to represent individual annotator styles in a unique latent space.

2510.10465.tldr: A shared-auxiliary embedding (SAE) framework that decomposes the embedding into a shared base component capturing common patterns and channel-specific auxiliary components modeling unique deviations, and designs LightSAE, a parameter-efficient embedding module that operationalizes these observed characteristics through low-rank factorization and a shared, gated component pool.

2510.10475.tldr: The results demonstrate that large, non-domain-specific LLMs, when paired with effective prompt engineering, can serve as strong, scalable baselines for specialized clinical NLP tasks.

2510.10481.tldr: This work presents a case study of post-training techniques for extending the context window of diffusion LLMs (i.e., LLaDA) without retraining from scratch, and introduces UltraLLaDA, a diffusion LLM with a 128K-token context window that significantly outperforms training-free baselines on long-context tasks.

2510.10486.tldr: The first stego attack on open-source LLMs is proposed, dubbed SASER, which wields impacts through identifying targeted parameters, embedding payloads, injecting triggers, and executing payloads sequentially, and improves ASR on quantized models from 0 to 100% in all settings.

2510.10487.tldr: This study validates that VLMs possess inherent self-refinement capabilities, enabling them to generate high-quality supervised data without external inputs and thereby learn autonomously, and proposes a self-refinement framework based on a Triangular Consistency principle.

2510.10494.tldr: Latent-Trajectory signals that characterize the temporal evolution of a model's internal representations during the generation of intermediate reasoning tokens are introduced, showing that these signals predict solution accuracy more reliably than both cross-layer metrics and output-based confidence measures.

2510.10496.tldr: A future extension called general-PMGF is proposed to enhance the applicability of this framework, which incorporates bodily, environmental, and task constraints into the generation process, aiming to provide more realistic and versatile guidance across diverse sports contexts.

2510.10503.tldr: Align2Act is proposed, a motion planning framework that transforms instruction-tuned LLMs into interpretable planners aligned with human behavior and demonstrates improved planning quality and human-likeness on the real-world nuPlan closed-loop benchmark.

2510.10516.tldr: A novel framework combining population-coded Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) with Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) that achieves energy savings of up to 96.10% compared to traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) while maintaining comparable control performance.

2510.10517.tldr: Empirical studies highlight that ECO prompting significantly improves code-LLMs'ability to generate efficient code, achieving speedups of up to 7.81x while minimizing correctness loss.

2510.10541.tldr: It is concluded that current benchmarks are insufficient for evaluating generalization and three core principles for designing more faithful benchmarks are proposed: sufficient difficulty, balanced evaluation, and distributional robustness.

2510.10560.tldr: This work introduces BitMar, a quantized multimodal transformer that proposes an external human-like episodic memory for effective image-text generation on hardware with limited resources and achieves a strong quality-speed trade-off, delivering competitive captioning and multimodal understanding at low latency with a small model footprint.

2510.10586.tldr: A symmetry-based, self-contained version of predictive coding in which higher layers receive onlyarse-grained residual transformations along symmetry directions unresolved at lower layers is formulated.

2510.10592.tldr: This work proposes the entropy of method extension, which measures the independence and diversity of extensions as an indicator of the system's capacity to solve unseen questions and advances toward a more robust and extensible reasoning paradigm for LLMs in real-world problem-solving.

2510.10596.tldr: The experimental results show that the proposed distance measure method for RPSs not only overcomes the shortcomings of the existing method and is compatible with the Jousselme distance, but also has higher sensitivity and flexibility.

2510.10633.tldr: A multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that coordinates domain-specialized agents within two coupled subsystems within two coupled subsystems, each augmented with multimodal integration components, underscores the promise of collaborative, specialization-driven architectures for advancing reliable multimodal generative systems.

2510.10639.tldr: This study demonstrates that a recent model that combines boosting with interpretability, automatic piecewise linear regression (APLR), offers the best fit for predicting learning satisfaction among several state-of-the-art approaches.

2510.10649.tldr: UnCertainty-aware Advantage Shaping (UCAS), a model-free method that refines credit assignment by leveraging the model's internal uncertainty signals, is introduced, which significantly outperforms strong RLVR baselines across multiple model scales, including 1.5B and 7B.

2510.10650.tldr: DEMO, a flow-matching generative framework for audio-driven talking-portrait video synthesis that delivers disentangled, high-fidelity control of lip motion, head pose, and eye gaze, is proposed.

2510.10663.tldr: This work proposes FS-VFM, a scalable self-supervised pre-training framework, to learn fundamental representations of real face images, and introduces three learning objectives, namely 3C, that synergize masked image modeling (MIM) and instance discrimination (ID), empowering FS-VFM to encode both local patterns and global semantics of real faces.

2510.10687.tldr: A spatial information extraction-compression module that combines Mel spectrogram and Interaural Phase Difference (IPD) to reduce computational burden while maintaining performance is designed and an extremely lightweight Conv-GRU crossband-narrowband processing (CNP) module is introduced.

2510.10693.tldr: It is theoretically show that in the high-dimensional limit, STE dynamics converge to a deterministic ordinary differential equation, and reveals that STE training exhibits a plateau followed by a sharp drop in generalization error, with plateau length depending on the quantization range.

2510.10701.tldr: The Extended Triangular Method (ETM) is presented, a generalized contradiction-construction algorithm that formalizes and extends the internal mechanisms of contradiction separation and advances the contradiction separation paradigm into a generalized, scalable, and practically competitive model for automated reasoning.

2510.10703.tldr: This is the first paper to claim and verify that different NL logical reasoning problem corresponds to different optimal SL formalization for translation, and propose a methods to improve the logical reasoning performance of LLMs by adaptively selecting the most suitable SL for each problem prior to translation.

2510.10709.tldr: It is found that maintaining multiple imputation pathways may help balance the need to capture uncertainty under missingness and the need for efficiency in online settings.

2510.10713.tldr: This review demonstrates how deep learning incorporates domain knowledge through architectural design, with built-in assumptions guiding models toward physically meaningful solutions in astronomy, and evaluates where these methods offer genuine advances versus claims requiring careful scrutiny.

2510.10719.tldr: The Self-Supervised Dual-Path Prototypical Network (SS-DPPN) is proposed, a foundation model for cardiac audio representation and classification from unlabeled data that demonstrates exceptional data efficiency with a fully supervised model on three-fold reduction in labeled data.

2510.10730.tldr: The results establish ensemble sampling as a provable and practical randomized exploration approach for nonlinear contextual bandits as well as introducing techniques that address challenges specific to nonlinear models.

2510.10738.tldr: This work shows that naive fine-tuning of Whisper reduces average WER but simultaneously widens disparities and disproportionately harms lower-level learners, and proposes two strategies: proficiency-aware multitask learning, jointly optimizing ASR with proficiency classification, and targeted augmentation, applying spectrogram masking to low-proficiency speech to counter imbalance.

2510.10739.tldr: This work proposes the feasibility of dynamical systems analysis for multi-objective LLM interactions, with code generation serving as an initial validation domain.

2510.10766.tldr: An adaptive detection approach utilizing a dynamically tuned Density Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) algorithm, designed to adjust the detection threshold (ε) in real-time, provides a substantial advancement in enhancing the security and safety of AVs against GPS spoofing threats.

2510.10782.tldr: A novel framework, Disentangled Style-Content GAN (DISC-GAN), which integrates style-content disentanglement with a cluster-specific training strategy towards photorealistic underwater image synthesis and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance.

2510.10790.tldr: A bio-inspired oscillatory state system (BioOSS) designed to emulate the wave-like propagation dynamics critical to neural processing, particularly in the prefrontal cortex (PFC), where complex activity patterns emerge.

2510.10801.tldr: The Human-Centered Readability Score (HCRS), a five-dimensional evaluation framework grounded in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and health communication research, is proposed, which integrates automatic measures with structured human feedback to capture the relational and contextual aspects of readability.

2510.10803.tldr: This work proposes a novel model that integrates an optimized pruning mechanism capable of removing nodes from the graph during the training process, rather than doing so as a separate procedure, which allows the architecture to learn how to minimize prediction error while selecting the most relevant nodes.

2510.10805.tldr: A framework embedding Artificial Intelligence (AI) literacy interventions directly into mental health conversational systems is proposed, and a study plan to evaluate their impact on disclosure safety, trust, and user experience is outlined.

2510.10813.tldr: It is shown that current frontier models exhibit belief-coherent best-response behavior at targeted reasoning depths and that belief coherence, meta-reasoning, and novel heuristic formation can emerge jointly from language modeling objectives, providing a structured basis for the study of strategic cognition in artificial agents.

2510.10819.tldr: This paper examines how AI-assisted techniques are changing software engineering practice, and the related issues of trust, accountability, and shifting skills, and outlines both the opportunities and challenges of applying generative AI to coding.

2510.10822.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive bias detection and mitigation framework targeting sex, age, and race-based disparities when performing diagnostic tasks with chest X-rays, and shows that combining eXtreme Gradient Boosting retraining with active learning yields the largest reduction in bias across all demographic subgroups.

2510.10823.tldr: It is shown that durable phobic avoidance can persist even under full visibility when learned aversive costs dominate local choice, producing long detours despite globally safe routes, and it is argued that local fixes are insufficient; global failures can remain.

2510.10824.tldr: This approach combines autonomous AI agents with hybrid vector-graph knowledge systems to automate the generation of test plans and test cases and achieves remarkable accuracy improvements from 65% to 94.8% while ensuring comprehensive document traceability throughout the quality engineering lifecycle.

2510.10827.tldr: This work finds that romanization significantly outperforms other input types in 11 out of 12 evaluation settings, largely consistent with the hypothesis that it is the most effective approach to transliteration in multilingual NLP.

2510.10828.tldr: VeritasFi is presented, an innovative hybrid RAG framework that incorporates a multi-modal preprocessing pipeline alongside a cutting-edge two-stage training strategy for its re-ranking component, providing a scalable solution for both general-domain and company-specific QA tasks.

2510.10840.tldr: A new model, Adaptive Differential Evolution based Quantum Variational Autoencoder-Transformer (QVAET) Model (ADE-QVAET), which combines with QVAET to obtain high-dimensional latent features and maintain sequential dependencies, resulting in enhanced defect prediction accuracy.

2510.10864.tldr: A simple yet powerful GNN, which extracts information across the heterophily spectrum and combines salient representations through adaptive mixing, and achieves up to 9.2% accuracy improvement over leading baselines across homophilic and heterophilic graphs.

2510.10865.tldr: GRIP is presented as a robust, scalable, and explainable framework bridging simulation and real-world navigation and real-world deployment on a Jetbot validates GRIP's generalization under sensor noise and environmental variation.

2305.14019.tldr: This work attempts to demonstrate an automated design environment that explores LLMs to generate hardware logic designs from natural language specifications without retraining or finetuning, and shows broader design optimization space compared to prior work and native LLMs alone.

2308.06701.tldr: This framework outperforms the current state-of-the-art method on three datasets (COD10k, CAMO, and CHAMELEON), demonstrating its effectiveness in improving camouflaged object detection.

2311.17007.tldr: This work uncovers the potential for applications involving the identification of a network of hidden relationships between variables without a parameterized model at a remarkable scale, scope, and complexity.

2402.03941.tldr: A new framework termed Causal representatiOn AssistanT (COAT) is developed that incorporates the rich world knowledge of LLMs to propose useful measured variables for CD with respect to high-value target variables on their paired unstructured data and extends the debiased causal inference to unstructured data by discovering an adjustment set.

2406.01317.tldr: This paper presents a GNN that is interpretable by design, GNAN, which is a novel extension of the interpretable class of Generalized Additive Models, and can be visualized and fully understood by humans.

2407.02646.tldr: A task-centric taxonomy ofMechanistic interpretability is presented as a roadmap for beginners to navigate the field by helping them quickly identify impactful problems in which they are most interested and leverage MI for their benefit.

2407.18995.tldr: This approach bridges the gap between traditional watermarking and passive forensic methods, offering a robust solution for image integrity verification and introducing a local confidence metric correlated with Message Recovery Rate, enhancing the method’s practical applicability.

2407.20761.tldr: This work discovers that large-scale 3D parallel training on vision-language instruction-tuning models leads to an imbalanced computation load across different devices, and rebalance the computational load from data, model, and memory perspectives, achieving more balanced computation across devices.

2408.08686.tldr: This paper focuses on the inconsistency in outputs generated by variations in input prompt templates and item index types, even with the same user's interaction history, and proposes MVIGER, a unified variational framework that models selection among these information sources as a categorical latent variable with a learnable prior.

2408.09873.tldr: It is concluded that deep learning–based HSI analysis enables rapid and noninvasive prediction of sepsis and mortality, with a potential clinical value for enhancing diagnosis and treatment.

2408.10497.tldr: This study introduces information bottleneck theory (IB) to model the problem, offering a novel perspective that thoroughly addresses the essential properties required for context compression, and proposes a cross-attention-based approach to approximate mutual information in IB.

2410.15198.tldr: A Residual Graph Attention Network (R-GAT) is proposed that integrates multi-head attention with residual connections to capture semantic and relational dependencies in biomedical texts and demonstrates the value of lightweight graph-based architectures as reliable and resource-efficient alternatives to computationally intensive transformers in biomedical NLP.

2412.06390.tldr: D3 is developed to enable on-device execution of policy learning, when computing resources are at a premium, such as in smart manufacturing and autonomous vehicle systems, and can learn highly effective policies, on par of state-of-the-art algorithms, while utilizing significantly fewer resources.

2502.05835.tldr: This work proposes MSDCRD, a model-agnostic distillation framework that systematically decouples global features into multi-scale local features and leverages the resulting semantically rich feature samples with tailored sample-wise and feature-wise contrastive losses.

2502.06577.tldr: A graphical characterization of the minimal set of nodes guaranteed to contain the optimal conditional intervention, which maximizes the expected reward and an efficient algorithm with a time complexity of $O(|V| + |E|)$ to identify this minimal set of nodes is presented.

2502.09692.tldr: AB-UPT is introduced as a novel modeling scheme for building neural surrogates for CFD simulations and yields state-of-the-art predictive accuracy of surface and volume fields on automotive CFD simulations, and enables the enforcement of hard physical constraints on the physics predictions without degradation in performance.

2502.12575.tldr: This work proposes a novel backdoor implantation strategy called dynamic encryption, which maps the backdoor into benign content, effectively circumventing safety audits and further decomposes the backdoor into multiple sub-backdoor fragments to enhance stealthiness.

2502.15507.tldr: A novel activation-based intervention for guiding proof synthesis in LLMs is explored and it is demonstrated that this intervention improves performance under two decoding strategies (sampling and best-first search) without any further training.

2503.01450.tldr: This work identifies a pathology where value functions smear credit over irrelevant history, and demonstrates how out-of-distribution scenarios can contaminate memory, perturbing the policy far into the future, with implications for sim-to-real transfer and offline RL.

2503.07680.tldr: HBP designs a novel batch-construction method and training recipe to address inefficiencies in data packing, and designs a dynamic training pipeline specifically tailored to HBP, including curriculum learning, adaptive sequential parallelism, and stable loss.

2503.21708.tldr: This work derives DyT from the LN variant RMSNorm, and shows that a well-defined decoupling in derivative space as well as an approximation are needed to do so, and derives DyISRU, which is able to omit the approximation and obtain the exact element-wise counterpart of RMSNorm.

2504.07839.tldr: This survey systematically reviews all the stages of DL-IDS, including data collection, log storage, log parsing, graph summarization, attack detection, and attack investigation, aiming to help researchers understand the basic ideas and visions of DL-IDS research, as well as to motivate their research interests.

2504.09426.tldr: It is demonstrated that VLMs trained with the authors' synthetic dataset achieve superior performance on BabyVLM tasks compared to models trained solely on SAYCam or general-purpose data of the SAYCam size, and illustrates how compact models trained on carefully curated data can generalize effectively.

2504.09479.tldr: Draw with Thought (DwT), a training-free framework that guides MLLMs to reconstruct diagrams into editable mxGraph XML code through cognitively inspired Chain-of-Thought reasoning, is proposed, offering a scalable solution for converting static visuals into structurally valid and renderable representations and advancing machine understanding of scientific graphics.

2504.09895.tldr: This work introduces RefAlign, a versatile REINFORCE-style alignment algorithm that does not rely on reward or reference models, and utilizes language generation evaluation metrics, such as BERTScore, between sampled generations and reference answers as surrogate rewards.

2504.21776.tldr: This work proposes WebThinker, a deep research agent that empowers LRMs to autonomously search the web, navigate among web pages, and draft reports during the reasoning process, and introduces an RL-based training strategy via iterative online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

2505.05423.tldr: LITRANSPROQA integrates humans in the loop to incorporate insights from professional literary translators and researchers, focusing on critical elements in literary quality assessment such as literary devices, cultural understanding, and authorial voice, and shows broad applicability to open-source models like LLaMA3.3-70b and Qwen2.5-32b.

2505.10320.tldr: This work introduces J1, a reinforcement learning framework for teaching LLM judges to think before making decisions that develops systematic evaluation strategies, including dynamic criteria generation, reference answer creation, iterative self-correction of initial assessments, and feedback generation for low-quality responses.

2505.11243.tldr: Across a synthetic contagion task and two large-scale real-world applications, equity portfolio optimization and loan risk prediction, Set-Sequence significantly outperforms strong baselines, delivering higher Sharpe ratios, improved AUCs, and interpretable cross-sectional summaries.

2505.11740.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach based on the characteristic function distance that consistently matches or achieves better fairness and predictive accuracy than existing methods and maintains robustness and computational efficiency, making it a practical solution for real-world applications.

2505.13563.tldr: UltraDelta is designed to minimize redundancy, maximize information, and stabilize performance across inter-layer, intra-layer, and global dimensions, using three key components: Variance-Based Mixed Sparsity Allocation, Distribution-Aware Compression, and Trace-Norm-Guided Rescaling.

2505.14741.tldr: ParaStep is proposed, a novel parallelization method based on a reuse-then-predict mechanism that parallelizes diffusion inference by exploiting similarity between adjacent denoising steps, and employs lightweight, step-wise communication, substantially reducing overhead.

2505.16646.tldr: This work applies SMART: a Self-Generating and Self-Validating Multi-Dimensional Assessment Framework to 21 state-of-the-art open- and closed-source LLMs, uncovering genuine weaknesses in current LLMs and motivating a new metric, the All-Pass Score, to better capture true problem-solving capabilities.

2505.18361.tldr: This work introduces a novel Encoder-Attender-Decoder (EAD) framework and identifies convolutional recurrent neural networks (ConvRNNs) as superior encoders to purely feedforward and state-space architectures for tactile categorization, providing the first quantitative characterization of the underlying inductive biases in this system.

2505.19927.tldr: The Temporal Constraint-based Planning benchmark is introduced, which evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs and finds that even the strongest models may struggle with TCP, highlighting its difficulty and revealing limitations in LLMs'temporal constraint-based planning abilities.

2505.20333.tldr: The empirical results suggest that multi-objective alignment offers a practical lens for analyzing cross-scale information flow and guiding representation-level control.

2505.20340.tldr: The Dynamical Manifold Evolution Theory provides a unified and testable perspective for interpreting, monitoring, and guiding LLM behavior, offering new insights into the interplay between internal representation dynamics and external text generation quality.

2505.23703.tldr: The NFL-HR framework is introduced, an end-to-end framework designed to incorporate the FL expert into NL math problem-solving and mitigate the NL and FL output format gap in reasoning through an LLM-based Answer Extraction mechanism.

2505.24138.tldr: AMSbench is introduced, a benchmark suite designed to evaluate MLLM performance across critical tasks including circuit schematic perception, circuit analysis, and circuit design, and highlights significant limitations in current MLLMs, particularly in complex multi-modal reasoning and sophisticated circuit design tasks.

2506.01977.tldr: GEDRanker is a novel unsupervised GAN-based framework for GED computation that consists of a matching-based GED solver and introduces an interpretable preference-aware discriminator that enables the matching-based GED solver to achieve near-optimal solution quality without any ground-truth supervision.

2506.04651.tldr: HexMachina is proposed, a continual learning multi-agent system that separates environment discovery from strategy improvement from strategy improvement, allowing the LLM to focus on high-level strategy rather than per-turn reasoning, and preserves executable artifacts.

2506.20705.tldr: FLIPD achieves state-of-the-art performance at LID estimation, yet its theoretical underpinnings are incomplete since Kamkari et al. (2024b) only proved its correctness under the highly unrealistic assumption of affine submanifolds, so this work formally proves the correctness of FLIPD under realistic assumptions.

2506.22578.tldr: Comprehensive theoretical analysis and extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that MIO mitigates the late-stage decline in chosen-likelihood observed in DPO, achieving competitive or superior performance across various challenging reasoning and mathematical benchmarks.

2507.05195.tldr: This work demonstrates that model potential rankings obtained through train-before-test exhibit remarkable consistency across all benchmarks, and supports the recommendation to make train-before-test a default component of LLM benchmarking.

2507.08980.tldr: A systematic framework for incorporating representation guidance into diffusion models is presented and alternative decompositions of denoising models along with their associated training criteria, where the decompositions determine when and how the auxiliary representations are incorporated.

2507.09279.tldr: This work introduces Prompt4Trust, the first reinforcement learning (RL) framework for prompt augmentation targeting confidence calibration in MLLMs, and demonstrates the potential of automated yet human-aligned prompt engineering for improving the the trustworthiness of MLLMs in safety critical settings.

2507.23042.tldr: NovaDrive, a single-branch vision-language architecture that processes front-camera images, HD-map tiles, LiDAR depth, and textual waypoints in a single branch, is introduced, a single-branch vision-language architecture that processes front-camera images, HD-map tiles, LiDAR depth, and textual waypoints in a single branch.

2508.10264.tldr: Experiments show that MRFD significantly reduces hallucinations and improves response factuality without requiring model updates, and is effective across multiple LVLMs and benchmarks.

2508.10315.tldr: An FL backdoor defense framework that utilizes the zero-shot learning capabilities of vision-language pre-training models, named CLIP-Fed, that overcomes the limitations of Non-IID imposed on defense effectiveness by integrating pre-aggregation and post-aggregation defense strategies.

2508.18673.tldr: This work reframe prompt selection as a prompt curriculum design problem: constructing a well ordered set of training examples that align with the model's current capabilities, and develops a difficulty-balanced sampling strategy that ensures the selected prompt examples are diverse across both dimensions.

2508.21566.tldr: This study proposes an efficient, lightweight SNN method with nonlinear pruning and dendritic integration (NSPDI-SNN), and introduces nonlinear dendritic integration (NDI) to improve the representation of the spatiotemporal information of neurons.

2509.00975.tldr: ReaL-TG is presented, a reinforcement learning framework that fine-tunes LLMs to perform explainable link forecasting on real-world TGs and outperforms much larger frontier LLMs, including GPT-5 mini, on ranking metrics, while producing high-quality explanations confirmed by both the LLM judge and human evaluation.

2509.04310.tldr: EvoEmo is presented, an evolutionary reinforcement learning framework that optimizes dynamic emotional expression in negotiations and employs population-based genetic optimization to evolve high-reward emotion policies across diverse negotiation scenarios.

2509.05396.tldr: These results highlight important failure modes in the exchange of reasons during multi-agent debate, suggesting that naive applications of debate may cause performance degradation when agents are neither incentivised nor adequately equipped to resist persuasive but incorrect reasoning.

2509.06743.tldr: This work proposes Long-Range Graph Wavelet Networks (LR-GWN), which decompose wavelet filters into complementary local and global components and unifies short- and long-distance information flow within a principled wavelet framework.

2509.09177.tldr: FSPO (Fair Sequence Policy Optimization), a sequence-level reinforcement learning method for LLMs that enforces length-fair clipping on the importance-sampling (IS) weight, is proposed and formalized via a Length Reweighting Error (LRE) and proves that small LRE yields a cosine directional guarantee between the clipped and true updates.

2509.11645.tldr: This study presents the first comprehensive evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis (AIS) self-management and pioneered enhancing MLLMs with spinal keypoint prompting and compiled an AIS knowledge base for retrieval augmented generation (RAG), respectively.

2509.19343.tldr: This paper investigates part-of-speech tagging, an important task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) for the Nagamese language, and applies machine learning technique known as Conditional Random Fields (CRF).

2509.23135.tldr: This work presents a unified view showing canonical non-adversarial methods explicitly or implicitly maximize the likelihood of expert behavior, which is equivalent to minimizing the expected return gap, and proposes a framework that guarantees monotonic improvement in this likelihood via a Minorization-Maximization process.

2509.23468.tldr: This work factorizes the policy into a set of diffusion models, each specialized for a single representation (e.g., vision or touch), and employs a router network that learns consensus weights to adaptively combine their contributions, enabling incremental of new representations.

2509.24394.tldr: The affordance analysis provides a replicable method for evaluating what safety frameworks actually permit versus what they claim, and suggests that effective mitigation of AI risks requires more robust governance interventions beyond current industry self-regulation.

2509.24469.tldr: This work aims for interpretable and expressive control of human motion generation by seamlessly integrating the quantification methods of Laban Effort and Shape components into the text-guided motion generation models by seamlessly integrating the text embedding of pretrained diffusion models during the sampling step.

2509.24695.tldr: This work introduces SANA-Video, a small diffusion model that can efficiently generate videos up to 720x1280 resolution and minute-length duration, and designs block-wise autoregressive approach for long video generation by employing a constant-memory state, derived from the cumulative properties of linear attention.

2509.25279.tldr: This work investigates the distribution and variation trends of workloads across different RL tasks across training steps, and identifies issues such as GPU idling caused by skewed sequence length distribution, inefficient parallel strategies in dynamically varying workloads, inefficient data management mechanisms, and load imbalance.

2509.26605.tldr: This work provides the first principled analysis of this offline-to-online approach and introduces BRIDGE, a unified algorithm that integrates both signals via an uncertainty-weighted objective and achieves lower regret than both standalone behavioral cloning and online preference-based RL.

2510.02300.tldr: Equilibrium Matching is introduced, a generative modeling framework built from an equilibrium dynamics perspective that surpasses the generation performance of diffusion/flow models empirically and offers a tighter bridge between flow and energy-based models and a simple route to optimization-driven inference.

2510.04617.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that AdaR improves robustness and generalization, achieving substantial improvement in mathematical reasoning while maintaining high data efficiency.

2510.05577.tldr: FGDIP is a novel framework tailored to enhance reasoning in LLMs by utilizing dynamic and adaptive strategies for information exploration in open-domain multi-hop reasoning tasks by integrating depth-first search with an innovative node generation technique.

2510.07423.tldr: Experiments on the challenging FinanceBench benchmark demonstrate that ProSEA, even without human feedback, outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and achieves robust performance across reasoning-heavy tasks.

2510.08649.tldr: A novel approach is presented that formalizes style in personal narratives as patterns in the linguistic choices authors make when communicating subjective experiences, including a case study on a war veteran with post-traumatic stress disorder.

2510.08722.tldr: This study provides the technical foundation for leveraging semantic pairs to enhance the generalizability of the model's representation and empirically demonstrate that incorporating semantic pairs mitigates the issue of limited transformation coverage.

2510.09393.tldr: ChoirRec is a novel framework that leverages the semantic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to construct semantic user groups and enhance CVR prediction for low-activity users and conducts extensive offline and online experiments on Taobao, a leading industrial-scale e-commerce platform.

2510.09404.tldr: This review examines the design of such LLM-driven agentic systems, highlights key applications, discusses evaluation methods for planning and tool use, and outlines challenges such as error cascades, tool-use efficiency, and health IT integration.

2510.09459.tldr: The results demonstrate that FIPER better distinguishes actual failures from benign OOD situations and predicts failures more accurately and earlier than existing methods, and is considered an important step towards more interpretable and safer generative robot policies.

2510.09541.tldr: The Sandwiched Policy Gradient (SPG) is proposed that leverages both an upper and a lower bound of the true log-likelihood of the true log-likelihood to improve the accuracy over state-of-the-art RL methods for dLLMs.

2510.10895.tldr: This work introduces a game-theoretic LLM-empowered multi-agent DRL (MARL) framework, in which the uplink transmission between a base station and a varying number of user equipments is modeled as a dynamic multi-follower Stackelberg game (MFSG), capturing the network's natural hierarchical structure.

2510.10918.tldr: This work introduces DreamMakup - a novel training-free Diffusion model based Makeup Customization method, leveraging the inherent advantages of diffusion models for superior controllability and precise real-image editing.

2510.10920.tldr: CoCountER creates counterfactual data based on soft swap operations, enabling explanations for recommendations of arbitrary pairs of comparative items, and empirical experiments validate the effectiveness of this approach.

2510.10930.tldr: This paper advocates for a new paradigm that assesses AI systems' evaluation of games, and introduces a formalism for evaluating such evaluations, and shows that reasoning models are generally more aligned to people in their evaluations of games than non-reasoning language models.

2510.10938.tldr: A theoretical framework that extends classical information theory to finite and structured systems by redefining redundancy as a fundamental property of information organization rather than inefficiency is presented, establishing redundancy as a measurable and tunable quantity that bridges the asymptotic world of communication and the finite world of learning.

2510.10942.tldr: A modular hybrid retrieval framework for adaptive enterprise information access that integrates Knowledge Base Language-Augmented Models, DeepGraph representations, and embedding-driven semantic search that builds a unified knowledge graph from parsed repositories, enabling semantic similarity search, structural inference, and multi-hop reasoning.

2510.10948.tldr: This work presents a systematic study of scaling laws for general audio representations by utilizing embedding effective rank (RankMe) as a unifying metric that encapsulates the impact of diverse variables on representation quality and reveals a consistent power-law relationship between RankMe and representation quality.

2510.10956.tldr: A novel C-Rust Pointer Knowledge Graph is proposed, which enriches a code-dependency graph with two types of pointer semantics: pointer-usage information which record global behaviors such as points-to flows and map lower-level struct usage to higher-level units; and Rust-oriented annotations which encode ownership, mutability, nullability, and lifetime.

2510.10962.tldr: MC# (Mixture-Compressor-sharp), a unified framework that combines static quantization and dynamic expert pruning by leveraging the significance of both experts and tokens to achieve aggressive compression of MoE-LLMs/VLMs, is proposed.

2510.10963.tldr: This paper introduces an effective enhancement to BT-based RMs through an adaptive margin mechanism, designed to dynamically adjust the RM focus on more challenging samples through margins, based on both semantic similarity and model-predicted reward differences, which is approached from a distributional perspective solvable with Optimal Transport (OT).

2510.10965.tldr: This work introduces a fully automated pipeline for constructing a comprehensive benchmark of false premise questions and proposes a recognition enhancement framework tailored to strengthen the robustness of MLLMs to detect false premises.

2510.10971.tldr: RV-HATE is introduced, a detection framework designed to account for the dataset-specific characteristics of each hate speech dataset that effectively addresses implicit hate speech and achieves superior performance compared to conventional static methods.

2510.10976.tldr: Video-STR is presented, a novel graph-based reinforcement method for precise Video Spatio-Temporal Reasoning that introduces a reasoning mechanism using graph-based Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) method to guide the model in inferring the underlying spatio-temporal topology of scenarios during the thinking process.

2510.10982.tldr: This work proposes non-transferable examples (NEs), a training-free and data-agnostic input-side usage-control mechanism that recode inputs within a model-specific low-sensitivity subspace, preserving outputs for the authorized model while reducing performance on unauthorized models through subspace misalignment.

2510.10991.tldr: This survey explores the emerging paradigm of agentic MLLMs, delineating their conceptual foundations and distinguishing characteristics from conventional MLLM-based agents, and establishes a conceptual framework that organizes agentic MLLMs along three fundamental dimensions.

2510.11003.tldr: Failure-cause inference using the maintenance records accumulated by the proposed FBS model-based maintenance-record accumulation method showed better agreement with the set of candidate causes enumerated by experts, especially in difficult cases where the number of related cases is small and the vocabulary used differs.

2510.11004.tldr: MASSE is introduced, the first Multi-Agent System for Structural Engineering, effectively integrating large language model (LLM)-based agents with real-world engineering workflows, and can reduce expert workload from approximately two hours to mere minutes, while enhancing both reliability and accuracy in practical engineering scenarios.

2510.11014.tldr: This work presents a sampling-based pipeline that leverages large-scale pretrained generative models to produce probabilistic priors capturing environmental uncertainty and spatio-semantic relationships in a zero-shot manner, and establishes a Matterport3D benchmark of rooms partially visible through doorways.

2510.11036.tldr: XGrasp is a real-time gripper-aware grasp detection framework that generalizes to novel gripper configurations without additional training or optimization, and outperforms existing gripper-aware methods in both grasp success rate and inference speed across diverse gripper types.

2510.11057.tldr: This paper proposes a general solution to address the off-manifold phenomenon observed in diffusion models, and designs a novel guidance mechanism, `Temporal Alignment Guidance' (TAG), attracting the samples back to the desired manifold at every timestep during generation.

2510.11072.tldr: This work presents a physical-world humanoid-scene interaction system, PhysHSI, that enables humanoids to autonomously perform diverse interaction tasks while maintaining natural and lifelike behaviors and introduces a coarse-to-fine object localization module that combines LiDAR and camera inputs to provide continuous and robust scene perception.

2510.11079.tldr: This paper promotes computational models of arguments and their role in providing legally relevant explanations, with particular attention to their alignment with emerging regulatory frameworks such as the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Artificial Intelligence Act (AIA).

2510.11083.tldr: Flow Planner introduces fine-grained trajectory tokenization, which decomposes the trajectory into overlapping segments to decrease the complexity of whole trajectory modeling, and incorporates flow matching with classifier-free guidance for multi-modal behavior generation.

2510.11084.tldr: The proposed Causally Disentangled Representation Learning for Anomaly Detection (CDRL4AD) to detect anomalies and identify their causal relationships in multivariate time series outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy and root cause analysis.

2510.11085.tldr: Simulation-based comparisons of macroeconomic output evolution in China and the United States under different mechanisms-AI collaboration, network effects, and AI autonomous production show that when AI functions as an independent productive entity, the overall growth rate of social output far exceeds that of traditional human-labor-based models.

2510.11090.tldr: This paper introduces Feature Reweighting ANd Contrastive Learning NetworK (FRANCK), a novel SFOD framework specifically designed to perform query-centric feature enhancement for DETRs, and effectively adapts a source-pre-trained DETR model to a target domain with enhanced robustness and generalization.

2510.11091.tldr: A panoptic symbol spotting framework that incorporates textual annotations is proposed that outperforms existing approaches on symbol spotting tasks involving textual annotations, and exhibits superior robustness when applied to complex CAD drawings.

2510.11110.tldr: The experimental results show that PhysioME achieves high consistency and generalization performance across various missing modality scenarios, highlighting the potential of PhysioME as a reliable tool for supporting clinical decision-making in real-world settings with imperfect data availability.

2510.11119.tldr: This work investigates the capacity and limits of solutions based on an innovative approach for the power management of AI data centres, i.e., making part of the input power as dynamic as the power used for data-computing functions, and identifies a paradigm shift in the AI data centre power management.

2510.11143.tldr: ARS (Automated Research Intelligence Assistant), a spec-driven, human-in-the-loop framework for automated and interpretable data analysis, establishes a new paradigm for transparent, collaborative, and reproducible scientific discovery.

2510.11144.tldr: This work introduces $How^{2}$, a memory agent framework that enables agents to ask how-to questions, store the answers, and reuse them for lifelong learning in interactive environments, and shows that lifelong learning agents benefit most from answers that are abstracted and decoupled from the current state.

2510.11170.tldr: EAGer is proposed, a training-free generation method that leverages model uncertainty through token-wise entropy distribution to reduce redundant computation and concurrently improve overall performance on complex reasoning benchmarks such as AIME 2025.

2510.11182.tldr: Extensive and rigorous evaluations demonstrate that generic tumour segmentation by a single model is possible across cancer types, patient populations, sample preparations, and slide scanners.

2510.11188.tldr: The Protein-as-Second-Language framework is introduced, which reformulates amino-acid sequences as sentences in a novel symbolic language that large language models can interpret through contextual exemplars, and highlights that generic LLMs, when guided with protein-as-language cues, can outperform domain-specialized models.

2510.11194.tldr: Critique-Driven Reasoning Alignment (CDRA) is proposed, which reframes alignment from a scalar reward-matching task into a structured reasoning process and introduces the Personalized Generative Process Reward Model (Pers-GenPRM), which frames reward modeling as a personalized reasoning task.

2510.11195.tldr: A new class of black-box attack is developed, RAG-Pull, that inserts hidden UTF characters into queries or external code repositories, redirecting retrieval toward malicious code, thereby breaking the models'safety alignment.

2510.11217.tldr: RAGen is proposed, a scalable and modular framework for generating domain-grounded question-answer-context (QAC) triples tailored to diverse RAG adaptation approaches, especially suitable for dynamic evolving domains such as scientific research and enterprise knowledge bases.

2510.11222.tldr: The Moral Fairness Consistency metric is introduced, which quantifies the cross-domain stability of moral foundation detection and establishes MFC as a complementary, diagnosis-oriented metric for fairness-aware evaluation of moral reasoning models, enabling more reliable deployment across heterogeneous linguistic contexts.

2510.11232.tldr: LightPneumoNet is introduced, an efficient, lightweight convolutional neural network built from scratch to provide an accessible and accurate diagnostic solution for pneumonia detection from chest X-rays, demonstrating a near-perfect ability to identify true pneumonia cases and minimize clinically significant false negatives.

2510.11235.tldr: This paper analyzes 7 representative alignment techniques and 7 failure modes to understand the extent to which they overlap, and discusses the results' implications for understanding the current level of risk and how to prioritize AI alignment research in the future.

2510.11238.tldr: It is argued that injection of instructions is not necessary to manipulate agents - attackers could instead supply biased, misleading, or false information, an attack by content, which is proposed to repurpose as a cognitive self-defense tool for agents.

2510.11243.tldr: This work introduces the first benchmark dataset for NSL, consisting of 36 gesture classes with 1,500 samples per class, designed to capture the structural and visual features of the language, and assess deep learning approaches for NSL recognition.

2510.11251.tldr: CodeMark-LLM is proposed, an LLM-driven watermarking framework that embeds watermark into source code without compromising its semantics or readability, and leverages the cross-lingual generalization ability of LLM to avoid language-specific engineering and training pipelines.

2510.11260.tldr: A multi-modal and automated scale bar detection and extraction framework that provides concurrent object detection, text detection and text recognition with a Large Language Model (LLM) agent significantly enhances the efficiency and accuracy of scale bar detection and extraction in SEM images.

2510.11269.tldr: This study presents an in-depth investigation of traffic generated by three leading chatbots when accessed via Android mobile apps for both text and image generation, revealing app- and content-specific traffic patterns and highlighting new stress factors for mobile networks.

2510.11277.tldr: EASE is a novel framework for real-time fake news detection that dynamically adapts its decision-making process according to the assessed sufficiency of available evidence and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, but also significantly improves generalization to real-time news.

2510.11281.tldr: Results demonstrate that agents equipped with graph-based procedure representations offer a powerful intermediate abstraction for robust and generalizable execution, underscoring the importance of structured procedure modeling for reliable agent-driven automation.

2510.11290.tldr: Experiment confirms that AAS can effectively simulate intricate educational dynamics and is effective in fostering advanced agent cognitive abilities, providing a foundational stepping stone from the "Era of Experience" to the "Era of Simulation" by generating high-fidelity behavioral and interaction data.

2510.11292.tldr: LouisKV is proposed, an efficient KV cache retrieval framework designed for various long-sequence scenarios that introduces a semantic-aware retrieval strategy leveraging temporal locality to trigger retrieval only at semantic boundaries, drastically reducing computation and data transfer overhead.

2510.11307.tldr: This work explores how agents trained with imitation learning can learn robust representations from both optimal and suboptimal demonstrations when given access to constructive language feedback when given access to constructive language feedback as a means to contextualise different modes of behaviour.

2510.11313.tldr: This framework standardizes the pipeline from prompting and generation to normalization and alignment with ontology nodes and proposes a rigorous, ontology-grounded evaluation framework, which provides a reproducible foundation for developing ontology-faithful skill decomposition systems.

2510.11328.tldr: This is the first systematic study to uncover and validate emotion circuits in LLMs, offering new insights into interpretability and controllable emotional intelligence.

2510.11330.tldr: Diffusion-Link, a diffusion-based modality-bridging module that generatively maps audio embeddings into the text-embedding distribution, and shows a collective migration of audio embeddings toward the text distribution show that closing the modality gap is pivotal for effective coupling between multimodal encoders and LLMs.

2510.11339.tldr: EVP is proposed, an event-aware dynamic graph prompt learning framework that can serve as a plug-in to existing methods, enhancing their ability to leverage historical events knowledge.

2510.11345.tldr: ROLL Flash is presented, a system that extends ROLL with native support for asynchronous RL post-training and significantly improves resource utilization and scalability over synchronous RL post-training.

2510.11346.tldr: This work introduces a method to utilize data from unlabeled domains to train ControlNets by introducing the concept of uncertainty into the control mechanism, and Synthesizing annotated images from the Home-OCT domain using the proposed approach leads to significantly improved segmentation results without adding any further supervision.

2510.11354.tldr: This work presents the first theoretical characterization of how batch size affects Adam's generalization, analyzing two-layer over-parameterized CNNs on image data and proves Adam has a strictly smaller effective weight decay bound than AdamW, theoretically explaining why Adam requires more sensitive $\lambda$ tuning.

2510.11372.tldr: An n-gram-aware loss regulariser is introduced and it is shown that it reduces memorisation across all model families tested by up to 40% while minimising evaluation performance trade-offs when compared to an existing memorisation mitigation strategy.

2510.11380.tldr: A systematic review of the recent advancements in artificial intelligence techniques applied to anemia detection, with a focus on various models applied to anemia detection, and compares these models based on several performance metrics.

2510.11398.tldr: This paper explores how the on-device LLMs of the future will become a security concern as threat actors integrate LLMs into their living off the land attack pipeline and ways the security community may mitigate this threat.

2510.11407.tldr: This framework essentially unlocks the untapped capacity of LLMs to self-improve their knowledge awareness, opening the door to reliable, more accountable AI and safer deployment in critical applications.

2510.11442.tldr: WearECG, a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) method that reconstructs twelve-lead ECGs from three leads: II, V1, and V5, demonstrates the potential of generative modeling for ECG reconstruction and its implications for scalable, low-cost cardiac screening.

2510.11454.tldr: To the knowledge, Audio-Maestro is the first framework to integrate structured tool output into the large audio language model reasoning process, and it allows the model to analyze, transform, and interpret audio signals through specialized tools rather than relying solely on end-to-end inference.

2510.11457.tldr: The Dimension-level Reward Model (DRM), a new supervision framework that bridges the gap between process-level reward models and outcome-supervised reinforcement learning, demonstrates that multidimensional supervision of the reasoning process can improve the generalized reasoning ability of LLMs beyond the training distribution.

2510.11471.tldr: This work proposes iterative amortized inference, a class of models that refine solutions step-by-step over mini-batches, drawing inspiration from stochastic optimization, offering a scalable and extensible foundation for general-purpose task adaptation.

2510.11482.tldr: This paper compares LLM-based preprocessing to traditional algorithms across multiple text classification tasks in six European languages and indicates that LLMs are capable of replicating traditional stopword removal, lemmatization, and stemming methods with accuracies reaching 97%, 82%, and 74%, respectively.

2510.11499.tldr: The key to moving beyond the limitations of individual methods lies in a unifying perspective that views modern generative models as specific instances of learning a continuous-time generative trajectory governed by an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE).

2510.11503.tldr: This work quantitatively captures human judgments and decisions varying the amount and kind of experience people have with a game--from no experience at all ("just thinking"), to a single round of play, to indirect experience watching another person and predicting how they should play--and does so significantly better than much more compute-intensive expert-level models.

2510.11516.tldr: This study investigates how developers engage with Amazon’s CodeWhisperer, an LLM-based code-generation tool, and identifies four behavioral patterns that provide a comprehensive analysis of these patterns.

2510.11535.tldr: The results confirm the superiority of the proposed framework with respect to traditional stochastic optimization-based approaches and provide key insights into the role and interplay between data-driven DRL agents and new rule-based policies for both efficient and high-performance control of latency-critical services.

2510.11536.tldr: CodeWatcher is presented, a lightweight, unobtrusive client-server system designed to capture fine-grained interaction events from within the Visual Studio Code (VS Code) editor, enabling continuous monitoring of developer activity without modifying user workflows.

2510.11541.tldr: This work designs a Query-Specific Graph Neural Network (QSGNN) for representation learning on the Multi-information Level Knowledge Graph (Multi-L KG) and proposes two synthesized data generation strategies for pre-training the QSGNN to enhance its ability to learn robust representations.

2510.11558.tldr: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the technical architecture and deployment of zero data retention policy by consuming applications as well as big language models service providers like Open Ai, Anthropic, and Meta.

2510.11560.tldr: This paper compares Google, a traditional web search engine, with four generative search engines from two providers (Google and OpenAI) across queries from four domains, and reveals intriguing differences.

2510.11588.tldr: CC-Gen is introduced, an agentic benchmark generator with Controllable Complexity across four levels, enabling systematic evaluation of agents'ability to handle complexity and offering a unified framework for assessing policy internalization.

2510.11593.tldr: The qubit-centric transformer (QCT) is proposed, a novel and universal QEC decoder based on a transformer architecture with a qubit-centric attention mechanism that provides a scalable and robust framework for surface code decoding, advancing the path toward fault-tolerant quantum computing.

2510.11595.tldr: This paper evaluates the forthcoming reproducibility crisis within AI research through the lens of crises in other scientific domains; providing a commentary on how adopting preregistration, increased statistical power and negative result publication reproducibility protocols can enable effective AI governance.

2510.11615.tldr: This work proposes LLM-Oriented Token-Adaptive Knowledge Distillation (AdaKD), a novel framework that adapts the distillation process to the real-time learning state of each token, and introduces Inverse Difficulty Temperature Scaling (IDTS), a counterintuitive yet effective token-level temperature strategy.

2510.11616.tldr: This work develops a framework to jointly identify similar assets through factors, identify mispricing and form a trading policy that maximizes risk-adjusted performance after trading costs and shows that weak factors are important for arbitrage trading.

2510.11631.tldr: EvoCAD, a method for generating computer-aided design objects through their symbolic representations using vision language models and evolutionary optimization, is presented and two new metrics based on topological properties defined by the Euler characteristic are introduced.

2510.11632.tldr: A novel model, NV3D, is proposed, which utilizes local features acquired from voxel neighbors, as normal vectors computed per voxel basis using K-nearest neighbors (KNN) and principal component analysis (PCA) to determine the relationship between the surface and pertinent target entities, including cars, pedestrians, or cyclists.

2510.11653.tldr: MATH-B is introduced, a benchmark deliberately constructed to defeat common open-source models of up to 8B parameters even under large sampling budgets, and it is hoped MATH-B will catalyze exploration-driven RL approaches that elicit deeper reasoning capabilities.

2510.11675.tldr: This work proposes FACE (Faithful Automatic Concept Extraction), a novel framework that augments Non-negative Matrix Factorization with a Kullback-Leibler divergence regularization term to ensure alignment between the model's original and concept-based predictions.

2510.11676.tldr: It is established that an accelerated stochastic proximal subgradient method achieves a first-order oracle complexity that is universally optimal for smooth, weakly smooth, and nonsmooth convex optimization, as well as for stochastic convex optimization under heavy-tailed noise.

2510.11682.tldr: A framework combining a learned world model with sampling-based Model Predictive Control (MPC), trained on a demonstration-free offline dataset to predict future outcomes in a compressed latent space, achieves robust, real-time contact planning from proprioception and ego-centric depth images.

2510.11686.tldr: The findings suggest that deliberate exploration -- with the right notion of diversity -- is a practical path toward discovery of new behaviors beyond sharpening.

2510.11688.tldr: PACEbench is introduced, a practical AI cyber-exploitation benchmark built on the principles of realistic vulnerability difficulty, environmental complexity, and cyber defenses, and PACEagent, a novel agent that emulates human penetration testers by supporting multi-phase reconnaissance, analysis, and exploitation.

2510.11689.tldr: Phys2Real is a real-to-sim-to-real RL pipeline that combines vision-language model-inferred physical parameter estimates with interactive adaptation through uncertainty-aware fusion, and achieves substantial improvements over a domain randomization baseline.

2510.11693.tldr: This work provides a theoretical explanation of GRSL, which formally links the MLLM's generative quality to the upper bound on its representation performance, and validate it on a challenging, low-resource visual-document retrieval task, showing that continual generative pretraining before CL can further enhance the potential of a model's embedding capabilities.

2510.11694.tldr: The architecture demonstrates that a linear, non-blocking agent, operating autonomously within a controlled IDE environment, can outperform multi-agent and orchestrated systems under identical constraints.

2510.11709.tldr: It is shown how superposition - where networks represent more features than they have dimensions - creates arrangements of latent representations that adversaries can exploit, and established that superposition suffices to create adversarial vulnerability.

2510.11718.tldr: This work proposes CodePlot-CoT, a code-driven Chain-of-Thought paradigm for thinking with images in mathematics, which leverages the VLM to generate text reasoning as well as executable plotting code, which is then rendered into images as visual thought, to solve mathematical problems.

2310.10349.tldr: An optimized layerwise approximation (OLA), a systematic framework that optimizes both accuracy loss and time consumption by using different approximation polynomials for each layer in the PTA scenario, and provides a dynamic programming technique to solve the optimization problem and achieve the optimized layerwise degrees in polynomial time.

2311.02433.tldr: This paper investigates whether ChatGPT can generate loop invariants, and proposes ways of combining ChatG PT (or large language models in general) and software verifiers, and discusses current limitations and open issues.

2402.07140.tldr: This study comprehensively evaluates four graph description orders across six graph problems using six mainstream LLMs and reveals that ordered graph descriptions significantly improve LLMs' preparation for graph structures and the robustness of LLMs to graph description order varies across different tasks.

2402.10601.tldr: As LLMs become more adept at deciphering complex user ciphers--many of which cannot be preemptively included in safety training--they become increasingly exploitable.

2403.00841.tldr: This paper introduces OFF-FSP, the first practical model-free offline RL algorithm for competitive games and combines the single-agent offline RL method with Fictitious Self-Play (FSP) to approximate NE by constraining the approximate best responses away from out-of-distribution actions.

2404.07214.tldr: This classification organizes VLMs into three distinct categories: models dedicated to vision-language understanding, models that process multimodal inputs to generate unimodal (textual) outputs and models that both accept and produce multimodal inputs and outputs.

2406.02613.tldr: This work proposes ACCO, a memory-efficient optimization algorithm for distributed LLM training by synchronizing delayed gradients while computing new ones, which is significantly faster and scales effectively across heterogeneous hardware.

2408.06849.tldr: The large language model is equipped with causal tools within an agent framework, named the Causal Agent, enabling it to tackle causal problems, and demonstrates remarkable efficacy on the four-level causal problems, with accuracy rates all above 80\%.

2408.12910.tldr: DialPrompt is a dialogue-based TIS prompt generation model that emphasizes user experience for novice users and improves user-centricity by allowing users to perceive and control the creation process of TIS prompts.

2409.05674.tldr: A new approach to measuring delay in ASR systems is proposed to validate if they are usable in live interpretation scenarios and validate if they are usable in live interpretation scenarios.

2410.23223.tldr: A meta-algorithm, Convergent Meta Alignment Algorithm (COMAL), is proposed, inspired by convergent algorithms in game theory, for language model alignment with general preferences, and empirically it consistently maintains above 60.2% and 56.8% win rates.

2411.06276.tldr: This work extends PAC-Bayesian theory to multi-view learning, introducing novel generalization bounds based on R\'enyi divergence that provide an alternative to traditional Kullback-Leibler divergence-based counterparts, leveraging the flexibility of R\'enyi divergence.

2411.14214.tldr: Physics-Informed Autonomous Agent (Physics-Informed Autonomous Agent), an LLM-driven system that automates modulation design for power converters in Power Electronics Systems with minimal human intervention, is introduced.

2412.02869.tldr: This work formalizes the notion of constrained identifiability, which takes a set of constraints as another input to the classical definition of identifiability, and introduces a framework for testing constrained identifiability by employing tractable Arithmetic Circuits (ACs), which enables us to accommodate constraints systematically.

2412.15939.tldr: BLIP2IDC, an adaptation of BLIP2 to the IDC task at low computational cost, is introduced and it outperforms two-streams approaches by a significant margin on real-world IDC datasets.

2412.17534.tldr: This paper introduces citation-specific pre-training within an encoder-decoder architecture, where author-date citation tokens are masked to learn to reconstruct them to fulfill LCR, and confirms that CiteBART-Global has a cross-dataset generalization capability.

2501.14050.tldr: This work presents GragPoison, a novel attack that exploits shared relations in the underlying knowledge graph to craft poisoning text capable of compromising multiple queries simultaneously and substantially outperforms existing attacks in terms of effectiveness and scalability on multiple variations of GraphRAG.

2502.00757.tldr: AgentBreeder is introduced, a framework for multi-objective self-improving evolutionary search over scaffolds that demonstrates the risks of multi-agent scaffolding and provides a framework for mitigating them.

2502.01555.tldr: This work presents a two-stage approach combining named-entity recognition with matching, and a novel end-to-end solution using extreme multi-class classification, and validate the solutions by both offline benchmarks and the impact of online A/B test.

2502.02631.tldr: ParetoQ is presented, the first unified framework that facilitates rigorous comparisons across 1-bit, 1.58-bit, 2-bit, 3-bit, and 4-bit quantization settings and reveals a notable learning transition between 2 and 3 bits.

2502.10742.tldr: Empirical evidence of core knowledge in humans is explored, why language models fail to acquire it is analyzed, and a workable proposal for systematically integrating core knowledge into future multi-modal language models is outlined through the large-scale generation of synthetic training data using a cognitive prototyping strategy.

2502.16804.tldr: A frontier survey of this emerging intersection between NLP and multi-agent ADSs is provided with a background introduction to related concepts, followed by a categorization of existing LLM-based methods based on different agent interaction modes.

2504.04821.tldr: This work introduces ZykovColor, a novel SAT-based algorithm to solve the graph coloring problem working on top of an encoding that mimics the Zykov tree, and proposes new features that take advantage of the underlying SAT solver.

2505.11065.tldr: DeepFund is introduced, a live fund benchmark tool designed to rigorously evaluate LLM in real-time market conditions and connects directly with real-time stock market data-specifically data published after each model pretraining cutoff-to ensure fair and leakage-free evaluations.

2505.12477.tldr: The core mechanisms that distinguish each paradigm are unveiled and it is demonstrated that, unlike supervised learning, both SSL paradigms require a minimal alignment between augmentations and irrelevant features to achieve asymptotic optimality with increasing sample size.

2505.15058.tldr: AsynFusion is a novel framework that leverages diffusion transformers to achieve harmonious expression and gesture synthesis, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in generating real-time, synchronized whole-body animations, consistently outperforming existing methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

2505.16612.tldr: This work explores various strategies for personalizing automatically generated translations when few examples are available, with a focus on the challenging domain of literary translation, and demonstrates that contrastive SAE steering yields robust style conditioning and translation quality, resulting in higher inference-time computational efficiency than prompting approaches.

2505.16619.tldr: This perspective introduces a practical set of OSAI recommendations directly mapped to over 300 components of the AI ecosystem, facilitating the implementation of sustainable, reusable and transparent AI.

2505.18966.tldr: ProDVa is a novel protein design approach that integrates a text encoder for functional descriptions, a protein language model for designing proteins, and a fragment encoder to dynamically retrieve protein fragments based on textual functional descriptions that effectively designs protein sequences that are both functionally aligned and structurally plausible.

2505.21391.tldr: This paper establishes the first $L^2$ convergence rates for linear TD operating under arbitrary features, without making any algorithmic modification or additional assumptions, and develops a novel stochastic approximation result featuring convergence rates to the solution set instead of a single point.

2506.01353.tldr: The world's first large-scale, temporally aligned multimodal dataset that synchronizes egocentric vision and EEG of human brain over extended periods of time, establishing a new paradigm for human-centered behavior analysis and paves the way for a unified framework for brain-computer interface with multiple modalities.

2506.01551.tldr: Experimental results under both task-specific and cross-task training paradigms demonstrate the consistent superiority of EvolveNav over previous LLM-based VLN approaches on various popular benchmarks, including R2R, REVERIE, CVDN, and SOON.

2506.06907.tldr: This paper presents a principled way to design a novel message passing scheme that incorporates spatial-temporal noises motivated by the Gaussian Process approach to SPDE and simultaneously captures uncertainty across space and time and allows explicit control over the covariance kernel smoothness, thereby enhancing uncertainty estimates on graphs with both low and high label informativeness.

2506.07961.tldr: A novel 3D VLA model that projects 3D inputs to multiple 2D images, ensuring input alignment with the VLM backbone, and utilizes 2D heatmaps for action prediction, unifying the input and output spaces within a consistent 2D image space is introduced.

2506.21857.tldr: SPADE is introduced, a foundation model that integrates histopathology with ST data to guide image representation learning within a unified framework, in effect creating an ST-informed latent space.

2507.00546.tldr: This review frames ML‐enhanced inverse design methodologies through the lens of representation learning, classifying them into two categories: output‐side and input‐side approaches.

2507.04295.tldr: This work presents LearnLens, a modular, LLM-based system that generates personalised, curriculum-aligned feedback in science education, offering scalable, high-quality feedback that empowers both teachers and students.
