2507.08704.tldr: Inspired by research on neuroscience, KGA is rewire the self-attention module by innovatively introducing two synergistic pathways: a bottom-up knowledge fusion pathway and a top-down attention guidance pathway that supports real-time knowledge fusion.

2507.10348.tldr: A stable and efficient Feature Distillation for model-heterogeneous Federated learning, dubbed FedFD, that can incorporate aligned feature information via orthogonal projection to integrate knowledge from heterogeneous models better is proposed.

2507.16880.tldr: It is demonstrated that, even after pruning weights responsible for triggering verbatim training data replication, small perturbations to the text embeddings of previously mitigated prompts can re-trigger data replication, revealing the fragility of such defenses.

2507.19842.tldr: A knowledge-based method to support business experts in designing business processes that requires no prior expertise in Knowledge Engineering and guides designers through a structured sequence of steps to produce a diagrammatic workflow of the target process.

2508.00378.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that CoRGI consistently improves both answer accuracy and explanation faithfulness across multiple VLM backbones, suggesting that post-hoc visual grounding is a promising direction for building more trustworthy and transparent multimodal reasoning systems.

2508.02348.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework that interprets radar PCD through road layout inferred from camera for localization of NLoS pedestrians, enabling spatial scene reconstruction.

2508.12519.tldr: This paper discusses key concepts of OT and one-dimensional OT, the role of tools from integral geometry such as Radon transform in projecting measures, and statistical techniques for estimating sliced distances, and explores recent methodological advances.

2508.13423.tldr: This work proposes AdaptJobRec, the first conversational job recommendation system that leverages autonomous agent to integrate personalized recommendation algorithm tools and demonstrates that AdaptJobRec reduces average response latency by up to 53.3% compared to competitive baselines, while significantly improving recommendation accuracy.

2508.14094.tldr: These findings provide clear guidance: when budget-constrained, prioritize collecting and annotating examples where your base model struggles, as these drive nearly all learning value in GRPO fine-tuning.

2508.16463.tldr: The approach, named MoDular Embedding Recomposition (MoDER), introduces a modular framework that trains multiple textual experts, each specialized in a single seen class, and stores them in a foundational hub and queries the hub and compose the retrieved experts to synthesize a refined prototype that improves classification.

2508.16845.tldr: NinA (Normalizing Flows in Action), a fast and expressive alternative to diffusion-based decoders for VLAs that replaces the diffusion action decoder with a Normalizing Flow that enables one-shot sampling through an invertible transformation, significantly reducing inference time.

2508.20996.tldr: The evaluation, conducted by both human (blinded clinicians) and LLM-as-Judge, shows that ChatThero is superior in empathy and clinical relevance, and it is shown that stressor simulation improves robustness of ChatThero.

2509.01909.tldr: This work introduces Constructive Safety Alignment (CSA), a human-centric paradigm that protects against malicious misuse while actively guiding vulnerable users toward safe and helpful results, implemented in Oyster-I (Oy1).

2509.05933.tldr: This work introduces MapAgent, a hierarchical multi-agent plug-and-play framework with customized toolsets and agentic scaffolds for map-integrated geospatial reasoning and demonstrates substantial gains over state-of-the-art tool-augmented and agentic baselines.

2509.07330.tldr: This study explored the development of a General Demographic Pre-trained (GDP) model as a foundational model tailored to demographic attributes, focusing on age and gender, and suggests that foundation models for tabular demographic attributes offer a promising direction for improving predictive performance in healthcare applications.

2509.11178.tldr: StegOT, an autoencoder-based steganography model incorporating optimal transport theory, is proposed and the multiple channel optimal transport (MCOT) module is designed to transform the feature distribution into a single peak to achieve the trade-off of information.

2509.15380.tldr: The unique characteristics of the Quranic multilingual corpus are leveraged to examine the optimal strategies to develop an ad-hoc IR system for the Islamic domain that is designed to satisfy users' information needs in multiple languages.

2509.15666.tldr: This work proposes Training-Time and Inference-Time Scalable Discriminative Source Separation (TISDiSS), a unified framework that integrates early-split multi-loss supervision, shared-parameter design, and dynamic inference repetitions that enables flexible speed-performance trade-offs by adjusting inference depth without retraining additional models.

2509.17238.tldr: This work introduces hyper-parallel scaling, a complementary framework that improves prediction quality at the token level in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, and implements RoE, a training-free inference algorithm that turns a single MoE into a dynamic ensemble of MoEs.

2509.18180.tldr: LLMs demonstrate strong potential to reshape the OR paradigm by enhancing interpretability, adaptability, and scalability, paving the way for next-generation intelligent optimization systems.

2509.19515.tldr: The results suggest that the impact of human-AI interaction on human-human social outcomes is mediated by the extent to which people anthropomorphize the AI agent, which may be motivated by a desire for social connection.

2509.20057.tldr: This report presents a reliable assessment methodology that systematically verifies model safety and robustness based on KT's AI risk taxonomy tailored to the domestic environment and releases proprietary Guardrail : SafetyGuard that blocks harmful responses from AI models in real-time, supporting the enhancement of safety in the domestic AI development ecosystem.

2509.22926.tldr: Model performance for basic medication tasks was consistently poor, highlighting the need for domain-specific training through clinician-annotated datasets and a comprehensive evaluation framework for benchmarking performance.

2509.23564.tldr: This work introduces the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating 13 preference data cleaning methods in the context of LLM alignment, unifying disparate methods and rigorously comparing them to uncover key factors that determine the success of data cleaning in alignment tasks.

2510.01708.tldr: PolySim is introduced, a WBC training platform that integrates multiple heterogeneous simulators and yields a tighter upper bound on simulator inductive bias than single-simulator training, thereby realizing dynamics-level domain randomization.

2510.03536.tldr: TriMediQ is introduced, a triplet-structured approach that enhances the reasoning reliability of LLMs through explicit knowledge integration that structuring patient information as triplets can effectively improve the reasoning capability of LLMs in multi-turn medical QA.

2510.03597.tldr: This paper introduces Neon (for Negative Extrapolation frOm self-traiNing), a new learning method that turns the degradation from self-training into a powerful signal for self-improvement and demonstrates Neon's universality across a range of architectures and datasets.

2510.04452.tldr: This work identifies key activities in agent experience prototyping and the desired capabilities of agent prototyping systems, and instantiate those capabilities in the AgentBuilder design probe for agent prototyping.

2510.05159.tldr: This work formalizes three realistic threat models across distinct layers of the supply chain: direct poisoning of finetuning data, pre-backdoored base models, and environment poisoning, a novel attack vector that exploits vulnerabilities specific to agentic training pipelines.

2510.05180.tldr: OptiFLIDS is proposed, a novel approach that applies pruning techniques during local training to reduce model complexity and energy consumption and incorporates a customized aggregation method to better handle pruned models that differ due to non-IID data distributions.

2510.06540.tldr: This paper considers an approach that solves a Partially Observable Reinforcement Learning (PORL) problem by approximating the corresponding POMDP model into a finite-state Markov Decision Process (MDP) (called Superstate MDP).

2510.07285.tldr: The empirical results demonstrate that the proposed GTCN-G model achieves state-ofthe-art performance, significantly outperforming existing baseline models in both binary and multi-class classification tasks.

2510.07363.tldr: L2M-AID significantly outperforms traditional IDS, deep learning anomaly detectors, and single-agent RL baselines across key metrics, achieving a 97.2% detection rate while reducing false positives by over 80% and improving response times by a factor of four.

2510.08558.tldr: In environments with verifiable rewards, the results provide promising signals that early experience offers a strong foundation for subsequent reinforcement learning, positioning it as a practical bridge between imitation learning and fully experience-driven agents.

2510.09043.tldr: Both quantitative and qualitative analyses indicated a high likelihood of well-simulated consciousness, which implies that the developed models incorporating elements of psychoanalysis and personality theory can lead to building a more intuitive and adaptable AI system with humanoid consciousness.

2510.10168.tldr: PALU formulates concise reasoning as a constrained optimization problem, minimizing response length subject to a performance constraint, and then applies Lagrangian optimization to convert it into a tractable unconstrained problem, entrenching the algorithm as a practical and effective concise reasoning approach.

2510.10177.tldr: This study predicts 3D coordinates of both the object's front and back surfaces and densely samples 3D coordinates between them to create ultra-dense 2D-3D correspondences, effectively enhancing pose estimation accuracy based on the Perspective-n-Point (PnP) algorithm.

2510.10207.tldr: Adaptive Dual Reasoner (ADR) dynamically alternates between fast thinking and slow thinking based on the contextual complexity during reasoning, achieving an effective balance between reasoning performance and efficiency among state-of-the-art approaches.

2510.10332.tldr: A deep reinforcement learning framework based on Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) for safe and precise maneuvering of double-Ackermann-steering mobile robots (DASMRs) that leverages the Hindsight Experience Replay (HER) and the CrossQ overlay to encourage maneuvering efficiency while avoiding obstacles.

2510.10619.tldr: This paper presents a method for assigning guitar tablature notation to a given MIDI-based musical part (possibly consisting of multiple polyphonic tracks), employing a rudimentary method for augmenting musical information and training/testing the system with artificial data.

2510.10666.tldr: Results indicate that BrowserAgent can serve as a more advanced framework for more interactive and scalable web agents and introduce an explicit memory mechanism to store key conclusions across steps, further enhancing the model's reasoning capabilities for long-horizon tasks.

2510.10774.tldr: ParsVoice is the largest high-quality Persian speech dataset, offering speaker diversity and audio quality comparable to major English corpora, and has been made publicly available to accelerate the development of Persian speech technologies.

2510.11660.tldr: ManiAgent is introduced, an agentic architecture for general manipulation tasks that achieves end-to-end output from task descriptions and environmental inputs to robotic manipulation actions that yields VLA models with performance comparable to those trained on human-annotated datasets.

2510.11683.tldr: Boundary-Guided Policy Optimization (BGPO), a memory-efficient RL algorithm that maximizes a specially constructed lower bound of the ELBO-based objective, which allows BGPO to adopt a large MC sample size, resulting in more accurate likelihood approximations and improved RL objective estimation, which in turn leads to enhanced performance.

2510.11728.tldr: HyperLLM is introduced, a novel LLM-driven hypergraph generator that simulates the formation and evolution of hypergraphs through a multi-agent collaboration and suggests that LLM-based frameworks offer a promising new direction for hypergraph modeling.

2510.11732.tldr: This paper proposes a novel serial-parallel dual-path architecture for SSR that leverages acoustic-linguistic bimodal information and integrates the designed Acoustic-Linguistic Similarity Module to facilitate cross-modal interaction with temporal simultaneity.

2510.11734.tldr: The research develops an end-to-end evaluation framework, including individual-level analysis of stability and identifiability, as well as population-level analysis called progressive personality curves to examine the veracity and consistency of LLMs in simulating human personality.

2510.11736.tldr: The study contributes a reproducible AI framework, insights into heuristic efficacy under partial information, and open-source code, thereby advancing AI research and supporting digital preservation of cultural games.

2510.11739.tldr: It is demonstrated that follower-based linguistic features can be effectively leveraged using machine learning and neural approaches for demographic prediction in Urdu, a low-resource language.

2510.11754.tldr: This study demonstrates the feasibility of a zero-shot, LLM-driven workflow for automated IMRT treatment planning in a commercial TPS and provides a generalizable and clinically applicable solution that could reduce planning variability and support broader adoption of AI-based planning strategies.

2510.11755.tldr: This research project critically evaluates the impact of three distinct educational settings: traditional educational methods without technological integration, those enhanced by non-AI technology, and those utilising AI-driven technologies.

2510.11759.tldr: Experimental results on standard benchmarks demonstrate that AwareCompiler significantly outperforms existing baselines in both performance and efficiency, highlighting the effectiveness of the synergistic knowledge-data-driven approach.

2510.11760.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that AGVP improves both navigation efficiency and robustness while achieving superior cross-scenario generalization on previously unheard sounds.

2510.11823.tldr: BlackIce is introduced, an open-source containerized toolkit designed for red teaming Large Language Models (LLMs) and classical machine learning (ML) models, and the architecture of the container image, the process used for selecting tools, and the types of evaluations they support.

2510.11827.tldr: Janus, a framework that jointly leverages Euclidean and Hyperbolic Graph Neural Networks to capture complementary aspects of node representations, is introduced, empirically demonstrating that combining multiple geometric representations provides a robust and effective approach for identifying subtle and complex anomalies in graphs.

2510.11835.tldr: Pre-train CLIP and DINO under controlled settings -- using the same architecture, dataset, and training configuration -- achieving similar ImageNet accuracy andedding analysis shows that CLIP captures high-level semantics, while DINO is more responsive to low-level features like colors and styles.

2510.11837.tldr: An evaluation plan is outlined designed to quantify the proposed Countermind architecture's effectiveness in reducing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for form-first attacks and to measure its potential latency overhead.

2510.11883.tldr: MammoDINO achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple breast cancer screening tasks and generalizes well across five benchmark datasets and offers a scalable, annotation-free foundation for multipurpose computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) tools for mammogram.

2510.11926.tldr: This paper introduces Locaris, a decoder-only large language model (LLM) for indoor localization that can serve as calibration-free regression models for indoor localization, offering scalable and robust cross-environment performance in heterogeneous Wi-Fi deployments.

2510.11928.tldr: MIND, a user-in-the-loop fact-checking pipeline to detect factual and cultural discrepancies in multilingual QA knowledge bases, is proposed and tested on a bilingual QA system in the maternal and infant health domain and a dataset of bilingual questions annotated for factual and cultural inconsistencies.

2510.11944.tldr: TopoAlign is proposed, a framework that unlocks widely available code repositories as training resources for Math LLMs and provides substantial gains for DeepSeek-Math, improving performance by 17.77% on BEq@10 and typecheck@10 and demonstrating that training on aligned code data is beneficial even for specialized models.

2510.11953.tldr: The Programmable Prior Framework is introduced, a method built on the Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) that allows practitioners to explicitly sculpt the latent space, achieving state-of-the-art mutual independence on complex datasets like CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet without the common reconstruction trade-off.

2510.11958.tldr: It is hypothesized that once representations have been processed by the early and middle layers, the resulting hidden states may encapsulate sufficient information to support the generation of multiple tokens using only the late layers, eliminating the need to repeatedly traverse the early and middle layers.

2510.11974.tldr: Ten widely used LLMs are evaluated and it is found that most struggle in closed-book setups but show noticeable gains when augmented with security-specific knowledge through the authors' designed retrieval-augmented techniques, highlighting the limitations of general-purpose LLMs and the need for domain-tailored techniques to fully unlock their potential for CTI.

2510.11977.tldr: The Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL) is introduced, providing a standardized evaluation harness that orchestrates parallel evaluations across hundreds of VMs, reducing evaluation time from weeks to hours while eliminating common implementation bugs.

2510.11978.tldr: The recast alignment as learning-dynamics--aware optimization and introduces the Cooling-Weighted DPO (CW-DPO), a two-stage recipe that explicitly models and exploits the training trajectory and shows complementary benefits from mixing on-policy and dataset negatives.

2510.11985.tldr: This work introduces CGBench, a robust benchmark that tests reasoning capabilities of LMs on scientific publications and reveals strengths and weaknesses of LMs for precise interpretation of scientific publications, opening avenues for future research in AI for clinical genetics and science more broadly.

2510.11986.tldr: An inference-time method, Lean-FIRe, is designed to improve conjecturing and autoformalisation, which achieves the first successful end-to-end autoformalisation of 13 PutnamBench problems with GPT-4.1.

2510.11992.tldr: A novel model, PanoTPS-Net, to estimate room layout from a single panorama image by leveraging a Convolutional Neural Network and incorporating a Thin Plate Spline spatial transformation, which empowers the model to properly predict room layouts while also generalizing effectively to both cuboid and non-cuboid layouts.

2510.12015.tldr: This work introduces a novel approach for training LLMs to ask sequential questions that reveal user preferences, which significantly improves the LLM's proficiency in asking funnel questions and eliciting user preferences effectively.

2510.12029.tldr: Curative Prompt Refinement (CPR) is introduced, a plug-and-play framework for curative prompt refinement that cleans ill-formed prompts and generates additional informative task descriptions to align the intention of the user and the prompt using a fine-tuned small language model.

2510.12032.tldr: Multi-stage Prompt Refinement (MPR) is introduced, a framework designed to systematically improve ill-formed prompts across multiple stages, and provides a lightweight and adaptable solution for enhancing LLM reliability across various domains.

2510.12033.tldr: CausalTrace performs data-driven causal analysis enriched by industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs, including advanced functions such as causal discovery, counterfactual reasoning, and root cause analysis (RCA) and is designed to complement existing agents by offering transparent, explainable decision support.

2510.12044.tldr: Hierarchical Alignment is introduced, a novel method that applies targeted DPO to distinct functional blocks of a model's layers: local, intermediate, and global (factuality) and proves to be the most effective strategy for enhancing logical coherence, outperforming all baselines.

2510.12051.tldr: This paper proposes APCE as a context-aware solution to select the most important input chunks through low-dimensional semantic similarity matching with the current query to reduce the memory footprint and mitigate the ContextRot effects for long-context summarization tasks.

2510.12060.tldr: This work proposes a novel generative classifier built on recent advances in visual autoregressive (VAR) modeling, and introduces the Adaptive VAR Classifier (A-VARC), which achieves a superior trade-off between accuracy and inference speed, thereby significantly improving practical applicability.

2510.12061.tldr: A Geospatial Awareness Layer (GAL) is introduced that grounds LLM agents in structured earth data that automatically retrieves and integrates infrastructure, demographic, terrain, and weather information from external geodatabases, assembling them into a concise, unit-annotated perception script.

2510.12063.tldr: ThinkPilot is introduced, a training-free framework that automatically optimizes LRMs reasoning that uses an evolutionary process to generate think-prefixes, which are instructions that evolve driven by a taxonomy of reasoning behaviors to guide models toward superior performance.

2510.12067.tldr: This work proposes HiCoTraj (Zero-Shot Demographic Reasoning via Hierarchical Chain-of-Thought Prompting from Trajectory), a framework that leverages LLMs' zero-shot learning and semantic understanding capabilities to perform demographic inference without labeled training data.

2510.12070.tldr: A novel MEASURE (Multi-scalE minimAl SUfficient Representation lEarning) framework is proposed, which effectively reduces domain-relevant information while preserving essential temporal and spectral features for sleep stage classification.

2510.12072.tldr: This work presents EmboMatrix, the first training ground of its kind, providing massive and diverse tasks with efficient simulation and precise rewards, and cultivates EmboBrain, an LLM whose embodied decision-making abilities emerge from extensive embodied interactions.

2510.12075.tldr: The main idea is to use a model trained on a particular dataset to predict on data from a different domain of the same kind, for example - a model trained on paintings of airplanes predicting on real images of airplanes.

2510.12076.tldr: BeSTAD (Behavior-aware Spatio-Temporal Anomaly Detection for Human Mobility Data), an unsupervised framework that captures individualized behavioral signatures across large populations and uncovers fine-grained anomalies by jointly modeling spatial context and temporal dynamics is presented.

2510.12080.tldr: It is revealed that while LLMs can generate outputs that exhibit some degree of randomness, their performance is inconsistent and often deviates significantly from the expected behavior.

2510.12082.tldr: Context generally improves performance and human evaluation on 100 Java snippets confirms that context-augmented summaries are significantly preferred for Accuracy and Content Adequacy, highlighting the potential of contextual signals to enhance code comprehension.

2510.12083.tldr: The Verily behavioral health safety filter (VBHSF) demonstrated robust, generalizable performance that prioritizes sensitivity to minimize missed crises, a crucial feature for healthcare applications.

2510.12110.tldr: A comparative analysis of associative creativity between LLMs and humans reveals that while high-performing LLMs achieve scores comparable to average human performance, professional humans consistently outperform LLMs.

2510.12111.tldr: The key idea is that state space models--which naturally do not require position embeddings--can be generalized to capture any graph topology, and support the idea that data topology is a powerful inductive bias across modalities.

2510.12116.tldr: This study provides the first systematic empirical analysis of the modality gap and alignment mechanisms in LSLMs, offering both theoretical and methodological guidance for future optimization.

2510.12133.tldr: A dialogue safety moderator capable of detecting malicious intent concealed within conversations and providing MLLMs with relevant safety policies is proposed, and experimental results from several open-source models indicate that this moderator is more effective in reducing multi-turn ASR compared to existed guard models.

2510.12137.tldr: The Credal Transformer is a new architecture to mitigate hallucinations and a design paradigm that integrates uncertainty quantification directly into the model, providing a foundation for more reliable AI.

2510.12144.tldr: Budgeted learning in the context of survival datasets, which include censored instances, provides bounds and time complexity asymptotically equivalent to the standard active learning method BatchBALD and shows that the model performs better than other potential approaches on several benchmarks.

2510.12178.tldr: The rapid evolution of Meta AI's LLaMA (Large Language Model Meta AI) series - from LLaMA 1 through LLaMA 4 and the specialized parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods developed for these models are surveyed.

2510.12181.tldr: LLaDR, a Large Language Model-assisted framework for Drug Repurposing, is proposed, which improves the representation of biomedical concepts within KGs by extracting semantically enriched treatment-related textual representations of biomedical entities from large language models (LLMs) and using them to fine-tune knowledge graph embedding (KGE) models.

2510.12201.tldr: A comprehensive review of 65 user studies evaluating XAI systems across different domains and application contexts is presented and a holistic overview of the properties of XAI systems and evaluation metrics focused on human users are provided.

2510.12209.tldr: This work provides a rigorous theoretical analysis of meta-reweighting under label noise and proposes a lightweight surrogate for meta-reweighting that integrates mean-centering, row shifting, and label-signed modulation, yielding more stable performance while avoiding expensive bi-level optimization.

2510.12218.tldr: This work proposes a novel training framework GOAT, which enables fine-tuning of LLM agents in a human annotation-free setting and shows that GOAT-trained agents achieve state-of-the-art performance across multiple existing goal-oriented benchmarks.

2510.12224.tldr: This work presents MedKGEval, a novel multi-turn evaluation framework for clinical LLMs grounded in structured medical knowledge, and presents a comprehensive multi-turn benchmark of eight state-of-the-art LLMs, demonstrating MedKGEval's ability to identify subtle behavioral flaws and safety risks that are often overlooked by conventional evaluation pipelines.

2510.12245.tldr: Molecule-aware Low-Rank Adaptation (MoRA) is introduced that produces a unique set of low-rank adaptation weights for each input molecular graph that dynamically injected into a frozen LLM, allowing the model to adapt its reasoning to the structure of each molecular input, while preserving the LLM's core knowledge.

2510.12246.tldr: The PromptFlow is proposed, a modular training framework inspired by TensorFlow, which integrates meta-prompts, operators, optimization, and evaluator, and autonomously explores optimal prompt refinement trajectories through gradient-based meta-learning, requiring minimal task-specific training data.

2510.12253.tldr: A dual-axis taxonomy is established that organizes the field along two orthogonal dimensions: a function-oriented taxonomy that clarifies the roles DMs play within the RL pipeline, and a technique-oriented taxonomy that situates implementations across online versus offline learning regimes.

2510.12255.tldr: MedQA-Followup is introduced, a framework for systematically evaluating multi-turn robustness in medical question answering that distinguishes between shallow robustness and deep robustness and introduces an indirect-direct axis that separates contextual framing (indirect) from explicit suggestion (direct).

2510.12264.tldr: This work proposes to track belief deviation and develops a simple yet principled method that detects excessive deviation and truncates training trajectories to suppress uninformative tail effects and highlights belief control as a key principle for building robust LLM agents capable of active reasoning.

2510.12265.tldr: This work proposes a deployed, human-in-the-loop, data-driven framework for bandwidth estimation for real-time communications and introduces a novel distributional offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm to train a neural-network-based bandwidth estimator aimed at improving QoE for users.

2510.12266.tldr: This paper proposes HiLoRA, a training-free framework that performs adaptive hierarchical routing over LoRA pools, and defines rank-one components (ROCs), in which each rank parameter is regarded as an independent unit.

2510.12275.tldr: This paper proposes a model for brain-controlled speaker extraction, which utilizes the EEG recorded from the listener to extract the target speech and introduces MossFormer2 which combines MossFormer and RNN-Free Recurrent as separator.

2510.12278.tldr: Computational experiments show that quantum annealing is capable of producing balanced assignments in short runtimes and provide evidence of the practical applicability of quantum optimization methods in educational scheduling and, more broadly, in complex resource allocation tasks.

2510.12285.tldr: Chinese ModernBERT is introduced, a from-scratch Chinese encoder that couples a hardware-aware 32k BPE vocabulary tailored to frequent Chinese affixes/compounds, lowering the embedding budget and releasing tokenizer and weights to facilitate reproducible research.

2510.12323.tldr: RAG-Anything is presented, a unified framework that enables comprehensive knowledge retrieval across all modalities and establishes a new paradigm for multimodal knowledge access, eliminating the architectural fragmentation that constrains current systems.

2510.12325.tldr: A Causal-inspired multimodal Recommendation framework is proposed, which combines back-door adjustment with hierarchical matching and vector-quantized codebooks to block confounding paths, and applies front-door adjustment combined with causal topology reconstruction to build a deconfounded causal subgraph.

2510.12327.tldr: This study explores the implications of the MaxSim operator on the gradient flows of the training of multi-vector models and shows that such a simple linear projection has inherent, if non-critical, limitations in this setting, and suggests alternative feedforward linear networks could alleviate these limitations.

2510.12334.tldr: This paper provides the first finite-time convergence analysis of a single-timescale actor-critic algorithm in the presence of an evolving reward function under Markovian sampling, and introduces a novel analysis of distribution mismatch under Markovian sampling, improving the best-known rate by a factor of $\log^2T$ in the static-reward case.

2510.12376.tldr: A novel learnable subsampling framework that can be integrated into any neural network architecture that adapts to inputs even during inference, which results in performance gains and reduces complexity in deep neural network models.

2510.12379.tldr: A lightweight neural network (LiteVPNet) for accurately predicting Quantisation Parameters for NVENC AV1 encoders that achieve a specified VMAF score is presented, using low-complexity features, including bitstream characteristics, video complexity measures, and CLIP-based semantic embeddings.

2510.12389.tldr: A comprehensive cross-linguistic evaluation of tokenization efficiency across 200+ languages to quantify computational inequities in large language models underscores critical inequities in current AI systems.

2510.12408.tldr: This framework is designed to reconstruct high-field-like MR images from their corresponding low-field inputs, thereby bridging the quality gap without requiring expensive infrastructure and underline the potential of CFM as a powerful and scalable tool for MRI reconstruction, particularly in resource-limited clinical environments.

2510.12409.tldr: PricingLogic is the first benchmark that probes whether Large Language Models can reliably automate tourism-related prices when multiple, overlapping fare rules apply, highlighting that today's LLMs remain unreliable in revenue-critical applications without further safeguards or domain adaptation.

2510.12423.tldr: Multi-topic Opinion Simulation (MTOS), a social simulation framework integrating multi-topic contexts with large language models, is proposed, which realistically simulate dynamic opinion changes, reproduce linguistic features of news texts, and capture complex human reasoning, improving simulation interpretability and system stability.

2510.12428.tldr: A deep reinforcement learning (DRL) decision-making framework integrated with a biased attention mechanism that effectively improves both traffic efficiency and vehicle safety at the intersection, thereby proving the effectiveness of the intelligent decision-making framework in complex scenarios.

2510.12451.tldr: It is suggested that function complexity, rather than flatness, shapes the geometry of solutions, and that sharper minima can reflect more appropriate inductive biases, calling for a function-centric reappraisal of minima geometry.

2510.12482.tldr: This work proposes an early fusion framework that combines text and visual features before augmentation, preserving spatial consistency, and designs a lightweight generator that projects text embeddings into visual space, bridging semantic gaps.

2510.12490.tldr: A task-oriented dialogue framework structured as a Directed Acyclic Graph of medical questions that integrates a cold-start mechanism based on hierarchical clustering to generate efficient initial questioning without prior patient information, and automated synthesis of doctor-friendly structured reports aligned with clinical workflows is developed.

2510.12494.tldr: PubSub-VFL is proposed, a novel VFL paradigm with a Publisher/Subscriber architecture optimized for two-party collaborative learning with high computational efficiency that achieves stable convergence and is compatible with security protocols such as differential privacy.

2510.12503.tldr: This work extensively benchmarks the empirical performance of various mainstream causal discovery algorithms, which assume i.i.d. data, under eight model assumption violations, and provides the standard for reasonable evaluation of causal discovery, as well as to further promote its application in real-world scenarios.

2510.12516.tldr: The experiments suggest that the Best-of-N method does not currently transfer from mathematics to LeWiDi tasks, and potential reasons for this gap are analyzed.

2510.12537.tldr: This work shows that on par with state-of-the-art results in unconditional human motion generation are achievable with a score-based diffusion model using only careful feature-space normalization and analytically derived weightings for the standard L2 score-matching loss, while generating both motion and shape directly, thereby avoiding slow post hoc shape recovery from joints.

2510.12541.tldr: In this thesis, various pre-processing steps of ECG signals are analysed with regard to their applicability in the FACE project to develop an innovative machine learning solution for analysing long-term electrocardiograms that synergistically combines the strengths of edge and cloud computing.

2510.12555.tldr: It is argued that incorporating inclusive fitness in agents provides a foundation for the emergence of more strategically advanced and socially intelligent agents.

2510.12608.tldr: StyleDecipher is proposed, a robust and explainable detection framework that revisits LLM-generated text detection using combined feature extractors to quantify stylistic differences by jointly modeling discrete stylistic indicators and continuous stylistic representations derived from semantic embeddings.

2510.12615.tldr: The results suggest that knowledge distillation functions less as a robust compression-by-transfer mechanism and more as a data-dependent regulariser whose transfer component is biased towards negative asymmetric transfer.

2510.12624.tldr: Learning-to-Measure (L2M), which consists of i) reliable uncertainty quantification over unseen tasks, and ii) an uncertainty-guided greedy feature acquisition agent that maximizes conditional mutual information, is introduced.

2510.12630.tldr: It is shown that tools designed with control confidence as the objective function are more robust to environmental uncertainties during tool use than a pure accuracy-driven objective, and that the CMAES-based evolutionary optimization strategy for autonomous tool design outperforms other state-of-the-art optimizers by designing the optimal tool within the fewest iterations.

2510.12633.tldr: This work proposes Laminar, a scalable and robust RL post-training system built on a fully decoupled architecture that replaces global updates with a tier of relay workers acting as a distributed parameter service, and consolidates long-tail trajectories onto a few dedicated rollouts, maximizing generation throughput.

2510.12642.tldr: This work presents Aixel, a unified, adaptive, and extensible system for AI-powered data analysis, which provides unified data management capabilities, including indexing, constraint-aware discovery, task-aligned selection, and comprehensive feature management.

2510.12643.tldr: Results suggest that large-scale human rationale annotations can be replaced with LLM-based automatic annotations requiring only limited human supervision over reasoning patterns, and propose Pattern-Aware LLMs as Rationale AnnOtators (PARO), a simple yet effective framework that enables LLMs to generate rationales aligned with task-specific reasoning patterns without requiring human rationale annotations.

2510.12659.tldr: Empirical results show consistent gains over strong baselines, confirming that jointly modeling raw and target-aware views--while adaptively filtering noise--yields a more robust deep tabular learner.

2510.12680.tldr: A practical recipe is proposed that, compared to standard training, can maintain accuracy in both modes while significantly reducing no-think output length and occurrences of reasoning-supportive tokens such as ``texttt{wait}''.

2510.12692.tldr: An AI-based judge-assignment algorithm, Hybrid Lexical-Semantic Similarity Ensemble (HLSE), is developed and deployed at the Harvard President's Innovation Challenge, demonstrating that HLSE achieves human-expert-level matching quality while offering greater scalability and efficiency.

2510.12693.tldr: This work presents ERA, a two-stage framework that integrates prior knowledge learning and online reinforcement learning and introduces three key designs: self-summarization for context management, dense reward shaping, and turn-level policy optimization.

2510.12697.tldr: This work proposes a multi-agent debate judge framework where agents collaboratively reason and iteratively refine their responses, and formalizes the debate process mathematically, analyzing agent interactions and proving that debate amplifies correctness compared to static ensembles.

2510.12699.tldr: This work finds that hallucination detection metrics, particularly EigenScore, consistently outperform standard diversity and uncertainty quantification metrics, while using only model internals, providing interpretable insights into a model's internal task representations.

2510.12702.tldr: NL2Contract is introduced, the task of employing LLMs to translate informal natural language into formal functional contracts, consisting of postconditions as well as preconditions, and evaluation shows LLMs are generally effective at generating functional contracts sound for all possible inputs, and verifiers supplied with LLM inferred functional contracts produce fewer false alarms than when provided with postconditions alone.

2510.12703.tldr: This paper designs and trains a neural network, Cooperative Awareness Message-based Graph Neural Network (CAMNet), on a widely used motion forecasting dataset, and evaluates the model on a second dataset that is created from scratch using Cooperative Awareness Messages, to assess whether this type of data can be effectively exploited.

2510.12704.tldr: This work proposes a Hybrid Explanation-Guided Learning (H-EGL) framework that combines self-supervised and human-guided constraints to enhance attention alignment and improve generalization, and validate the approach on chest X-ray classification using the Vision Transformer (ViT), where H-EGL outperforms two state-of-the-art Explanation-Guided Learning methods.

2510.12713.tldr: The proposed approach leverages the principles of self-supervised learning, allowing the model to learn useful representations from unlabeled data, and enables the more efficient identification and categorization of OOD samples.

2510.12714.tldr: The rapid evolution of radiopharmaceutical therapy (RPT) highlights the growing need for personalized and patient-centered dosimetry, and Artificial Intelligence offers solutions to the key limitations in current dosimetry calculations.

2510.12727.tldr: A novel hierarchical federated learning architecture specifically designed for smart agricultural production systems and crop yield prediction, showing that local and crop-layer models closely follow actual yield patterns with consistent alignment, significantly outperforming standard machine learning models.

2510.12742.tldr: This work proposes a method, CTRL-Rec, that allows for natural language control of traditional recommender systems in real-time with computational efficiency, and finds that it was positively received by users and significantly enhanced users's sense of control and satisfaction with recommendations compared to traditional controls.

2510.12750.tldr: This work introduces VQArt-Bench, a new, large-scale VQA benchmark for the cultural heritage domain, constructed using a novel multi-agent pipeline where specialized agents collaborate to generate nuanced, validated, and linguistically diverse questions.

2510.12763.tldr: This article surveys a principled deep learning framework based on coVariance Neural Networks to infer the brain age gap from anatomical features extracted from structural neuroimaging and demonstrates that brain age gap derived from a VNN-based ML pipeline exhibit stability, transferability across multi-scale datasets, and improved interpretability.

2510.12773.tldr: Dr.LLM shows that explicitly supervised routers retrofit frozen LLMs for budget-aware, accuracy-driven inference without altering base weights, and shows that explicitly supervised routers retrofit frozen LLMs for budget-aware, accuracy-driven inference without altering base weights.

2510.12785.tldr: This work builds a video model that generates animatable multi-view videos of digital humans based on a single reference image and target expressions and significantly improves the realism, temporal consistency, and 3D consistency of generated avatars compared to previous methods.

2510.12789.tldr: UniFusion is presented, a diffusion-based generative model conditioned on a frozen large vision-language model (VLM) that serves as a unified multimodal encoder that outperforms other shallow fusion architectures on text-image alignment for generation and faithful transfer of visual information from VLM to the diffusion model which is key for editing.

2510.12795.tldr: The CuMPerLay decomposes the CMP into a combination of individual, learnable single-parameter persistence, where the bifiltration functions are jointly learned and theoretical guarantees for the stability of the vectorization under generalized Wasserstein metrics are established.

2206.13464.tldr: H2O is proposed, which introduces a dynamics-aware policy evaluation scheme, which adaptively penalizes the Q function learning on simulated state-action pairs with large dynamics gaps, while also simultaneously allowing learning from a fixed real-world dataset.

2303.03900.tldr: The authors establish conditions under which a stable outcome, a Nash equilibrium, exists and provide efficient methods to compute it and provide a powerful framework for developing more reliable models by understanding and countering worst case data perturbations.

2310.00194.tldr: This work proposes an agentic architecture, the Modular Agentic Planner (MAP), in which planning is accomplished via the recurrent interaction of the specialized modules, each implemented using an LLM, which yields significant improvements over both standard LLM methods and competitive baselines.

2405.16807.tldr: This work presents a novel analysis on compressing neural fields, with focus on images and introduces Adaptive Neural Images (ANI), an efficient neural representation that enables adaptation to different inference or transmission requirements.

2406.12736.tldr: The PrivacyGuard framework for POI is proposed, a visual reasoning task aimed at the privacy of each object in the scene, and a contextual perturbation oversampling strategy is proposed to create slightly perturbed privacy-sensitive objects in a scene graph.

2408.11976.tldr: A sentiment and emotion-aware multi-criteria fuzzy GDM system designed to enhance consensus-reaching effectiveness in group settings and demonstrate that integrating sentiment and emotion analysis into GDM systems allows everyone's feelings and opinions to be considered during discussions and significantly improves consensus among participants.

2411.02594.tldr: It is suggested that effective human-AI collaboration can enhance response quality, though merely combining human and AI efforts does not ensure improved outcomes and the Nudging configuration was shown to help improve the quality of the output when compared to AI alone.

2411.11057.tldr: This paper introduces the first publicly available computational framework for SLS, complete with a graphical user interface and benchmarking support for reinforcement learning algorithms, and establishes SLS as a negotiation-aware benchmark for MARL.

2501.01540.tldr: BoxingGym is introduced, a benchmark with 10 environments for systematically evaluating both experimental design and model discovery of LLM-based scientific agents and it is found that augmenting the LLM-based agent with an explicit statistical model does not reliably improve these results.

2504.20278.tldr: Deep Physics Prior is introduced, a novel method enabling first-order gradient-based inverse optimization with surrogate machine learning models by leveraging pretrained auxiliary Neural Operators, which enforces prior distribution constraints to ensure robust and meaningful solutions.

2505.21908.tldr: DRG-Sapphire is introduced, which uses large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) for automated DRG coding from clinical notes and observes that RL performance scales approximately linearly with the logarithm of the number of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples, suggesting that RL effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by the domain knowledge encoded in the base model.

2506.17871.tldr: The Branching Factor (BF) is introduced -- a token-invariant measure of the effective number of plausible next steps during generation that establishes BF as a powerful diagnostic for understanding and controlling LLM outputs - clarifying how alignment reduces variability, how CoT promotes stable generations, and how base models can be steered away from diversity.

2506.19847.tldr: This work introduces the Cayley-Neumann parameterization, an efficient orthogonal parameterization that approximates the matrix inversion in the Cayley transform via a truncated Neumann series and extends OFTv2 to support finetuning quantized foundation models and shows that it outperforms the popular QLoRA in training stability, efficiency, and memory usage.

2507.02253.tldr: NL2Flow is introduced, a fully automated pipeline for generating and evaluating workflow planning problems andRegression analysis shows that the influence of problem characteristics on plan generation is contingent on both model and prompt design, suggesting a benefit from neuro-symbolic integration.

2507.02737.tldr: It is found that current models are unable to encode short messages in their outputs without a monitor noticing under standard affordances, but early signs that models can perform basic encoded reasoning in a simple state-tracking problem are found.

2509.15459.tldr: A dual-query transformer decoder that integrates perturbed and latent queries within a denoising framework, which not only stabilizes optimization but also accelerates convergence is developed.

2509.22184.tldr: A method for learning group (known or unknown) equivariant functions by learning the associated quadratic form corresponding to the group from the data, which results in an invariant model that preserves norms and a scale-invariant model that captures the inter-dependencies between multiple inputs while preserving the underlying group symmetry.

2509.23144.tldr: This framework Thermodynamic Coordination Theory (TCT) is term, which demonstrates that coordination requires radical information loss and potentially explains the indefinite cycling in multi-objective gradient descent and alignment faking in Large Language Models trained with reinforcement learning with human feedback.

2510.10125.tldr: A controllable multi-view world model that can be used to evaluate and improve the instruction-following ability of generalist robot policies is introduced and it is shown that the method can accurately rank policy performance without real-world robot rollouts.

2510.12807.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark of several open-source LLMs for Persian Natural Language Processing tasks, utilizing both zero-shot and few-shot learning paradigms, reveals that Gemma 2 consistently outperforms other models across nearly all tasks in both learning paradigms, with particularly strong performance in complex reasoning tasks.

2510.12813.tldr: Evaluating the performance of 4 large language models and BioBERT in classifying cancer diagnoses from structured and unstructured electronic health records data shows reliable clinical applications will require standardized documentation practices alongside robust human oversight for high-stakes decision-making.

2510.12818.tldr: MEDEQUALQA is introduced, a counterfactual benchmark that perturbs only patient pronouns (he/him, she/her, they/them) while holding critical symptoms and conditions (CSCs) constant and offers a controlled diagnostic setting for auditing reasoning stability in medical AI.

2510.12819.tldr: This work introduces the first continuous VA framework for pet vocalization analysis, offering a more expressive representation for human-pet interaction, veterinary diagnostics, and behavioral training and shows strong potential for deployment in consumer products like AI pet emotion translators.

2510.12825.tldr: This work proposes a system that translates natural language descriptions into executable workflows, automatically predicting both the structure and detailed configuration of the flow, and compares CAG against strong single-prompt and agentic baselines, showing improved accuracy and efficiency, while substantially reducing token usage.

2510.12826.tldr: This work investigates the scheming ability and propensity of frontier LLM agents through two game-theoretic frameworks: a Cheap Talk signaling game and a Peer Evaluation adversarial game, and exhibits significant scheming propensity without prompting.

2510.12827.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of the modern era of ASR, charting its evolution from traditional hybrid systems, such as Gaussian Mixture Model-Hidden Markov Models and Deep Neural Network-HMMs, to the now-dominant end-to-end neural architectures.

2510.12835.tldr: This paper proposes a moderation-oriented guideline repurposing method that transforms guidelines into clear directives for LLMs through an LLM moderation process, and highlights the potential of this workflow to support scalable and cost-effective refinement of annotation guidelines and automated annotation.

2510.12845.tldr: A novel multilingual benchmark VLURes is introduced featuring eight vision-and-language tasks, and a pioneering unrelatedness task, to probe the fine-grained Visual and Linguistic Understanding capabilities of VLMs across English, Japanese, and low-resource languages, Swahili, and Urdu.

2510.12850.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate Ethic-BERT's superiority over baseline models, and the proposed Ethic-BERT attains 15.28% average accuracy improvement in the HardTest, contributing to performance improvement and reliable decision-making using bias-aware preprocessing and proposed enhanced AI model.

2510.12856.tldr: This empirical study finds that combining these mechanisms can increase latency in shallow six-layer models, and demonstrates that EAT achieves slightly higher accuracy than the optimized DistilBERT baseline on SST-2, illustrating the potential of dynamic computation for latency-sensitive NLP.

2510.12857.tldr: This work introduces a counterfactual bias evaluation framework that automatically generates realistic, open-ended questions over sensitive attributes such as sex, race, or religion, and constructs CAB, a human-verified benchmark spanning diverse topics, designed to enable cross-model comparisons.

2510.12864.tldr: This work introduces the Rule-Intent Distinction (RID) Framework, a novel, low-compute meta-prompting technique designed to elicit human-aligned exception handling in LLMs in a zero-shot manner and consistently produces higher-quality, intent-driven reasoning.

2510.12920.tldr: InferA is a multi-agent system that leverages large language models to enable scalable and efficient scientific data analysis and engages interactively with users to elicit their analytical intent and confirm query objectives, ensuring alignment between user goals and system actions.

2510.12948.tldr: This solution paper proves that using keyword-search is sufficient to retrieve relevant and useful code context inside large codebases, without the need for extensive GPU resources.

2510.12957.tldr: The proposed model achieves 93.2% accuracy, a 91.6% F1-score, and a 78.1% IoU-XAI on the multimodal benchmark, outperforming all baselines across every metric, while adversarial training restores 73 to 77% robustness on Fashion MNIST.

2510.12979.tldr: This work proposes DeepPlanner, an end-to-end RL framework that effectively enhances the planning capabilities of deep research agents, and shapes token-level advantage with an entropy-based term to allocate larger updates to high entropy tokens, and selectively upweights sample-level advantages for planning-intensive rollouts.

2510.13002.tldr: An innovative framework is presented that leverages a fine-tuned large language model to automatically infer DHAs from textual crash narratives, thereby improving the validity and interpretability of DHA classifications and offering new opportunities for traffic safety analysis and intervention.

2510.13011.tldr: Deliberate Lab is presented, an open-source platform for large-scale, real-time behavioral experiments that supports both human participants and large language model (LLM)-based agents, and expands the methodological repertoire for studying collective decision-making and human-centered AI.

2510.13029.tldr: This paper argues for rethinking time series with LLMs as a reasoning task that prioritizes causal structure and explainability, bringing time series analysis closer to human-aligned understanding, enabling transparent and context-aware insights in complex real-world environments.

2510.13040.tldr: Two optimizers are introduced, named Interpolational Accelerating Gradient Descent (IAGD) as well as Noise-Regularized Stochastic Gradient Descent (NRSGD), which demonstrate the potential of those two viable improvement methods in SGD.

2510.13042.tldr: SeqBench is presented, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating sequential narrative coherence in T2V generation and a Dynamic Temporal Graphs-based automatic evaluation metric which demonstrates a strong correlation with human annotations.

2510.13044.tldr: SceneAdapt is introduced, a two-stage adaptation framework that enables semantically diverse, scene-aware human motion generation from text without large-scale paired text--scene--motion data and injects scene-awareness into text-to-motion models without sacrificing semantic diversity.

2510.13052.tldr: This work introduces a structured, weight-based formulation that explicitly captures the streaming-data origin of the time-varying objective, where at each time step, an agent aims to minimize a weighted average loss over all the past data samples.

2510.13054.tldr: It is found that VLA-0 is not only effective; it is surprisingly powerful; with the right design, VLA-0 outperforms more involved models.

2510.13062.tldr: The complexity of treatment planning is explored and Human-Centric Intelligent Treatment Planning (HCITP), an AI-driven framework under human oversight, which integrates clinical guidelines, automates plan generation, and enables direct interactions with operators is introduced.

1711.05788.tldr: This paper provides analytical results characterizing the optimal QMDP solution and presents the algorithm for solving the QMMP, to which it refers as Quantile Markov Decision Processes (QMDP).

2206.02346.tldr: This work proposes a new Natural Policy Gradient Primal-Dual (NPG-PD) method that updates the primal variable via natural policy gradient ascent and the dual variable via projected subgradient descent and proves that this method achieves global convergence with sublinear rates regarding both the optimality gap and the constraint violation.

2402.03173.tldr: This paper presents MULTI, a Chinese multimodal dataset derived from authentic examination questions, a robust evaluation platform that serves not only as a robust evaluation platform but also paves the way for the development of expert-level AI.

2403.16843.tldr: A novel \emph{unsupervised} training loss of \emph{regret-loss}, which, in contrast to the supervised pre-training loss, does not require the labels of (optimal) actions, is proposed, establishing the statistical guarantee of generalization bound for regret-loss minimization, followed by the optimization guarantee that minimizing such a loss may automatically lead to known no-regret learning algorithms.

2405.09591.tldr: This survey proposes a more enlightening taxonomy that encompasses data augmentation techniques for different common data modalities by investigating how to take advantage of the intrinsic relationship between and within instances.

2409.18411.tldr: Hi-Drive is introduced, a hierarchical planning algorithm addressing uncertainties at both behavior and trajectory levels using a hierarchical Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) formulation that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art planning-based and learning-based methods across diverse urban driving situations in real-world benchmarks.

2410.13780.tldr: A universal quantizer based on nested lattices with an explicit guarantee of approximation error for any (non-random) pair of matrices is constructed and is, thus, asymptotically optimal for iid Gaussian matrices.

2410.14138.tldr: This work introduces a novel visual reasoning framework named ProReason, which features decoupled vision-reasoning capabilities and multi-run proactive perception, and disassociation of capabilities allows seamless integration of existing large language models (LLMs) to compensate for the reasoning deficits of LVLMs.

2411.08891.tldr: A novel retrieval method called Calibrated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (CalibRAG), which ensures that decisions informed by RAG are well-calibrated, is proposed and empirically validate that CalibRAG improves calibration performance as well as accuracy, compared to other baselines across various datasets.

2411.15557.tldr: This work introduces a novel approach that shifts the focus from aligning representations in absolute coordinates to aligning the relative positioning of equivalent concepts in latent spaces, ensuring that the organization of samples in visual space reflects reference inter-class relationships while preserving domain-specific characteristics.

2502.00874.tldr: This position paper advocates for a more transparent, open, and well-regulated peer review aiming to foster greater community involvement and propel advancements in the field.

2503.12115.tldr: This paper unifies two types of tokens and proposes the UniCodec, a universal speech token learning that encapsulates all semantics of speech, including linguistic and paralinguistic information, into a compact and semantically-disentangled unified token.

2503.15225.tldr: This work proposes a fully data-driven approach, based on long short-term memory neural networks, to generate original motion that captures the unique features of specific individuals, and validate the architecture using real human data from participants performing spontaneous oscillatory motion.

2504.05774.tldr: The Transferable Mask Transformer (TMT), a region-adaptive framework designed to enhance cross-domain representation learning through transferability guidance, is proposed, which incorporates region-level transferability maps directly into the self-attention mechanism of ViTs, allowing the model to adaptively focus attention on areas with lower transferability and higher semantic uncertainty.

2504.13211.tldr: This work introduces a new synthetic dataset, Mirror (Multimodal Interactive Rolling with Resistance), which is a novel synthetic dataset that pairs each client's statements with corresponding facial images that significantly enhances the AI therapist's ability to handle resistance, which outperforms existing text-based CBT approaches.

2505.00624.tldr: FineScope is introduced, a framework for deriving compact, domain-optimized LLMs from larger pretrained models that achieves highly competitive performance, outperforming several large-scale state-of-the-art LLMs in domain-specific tasks.

2505.16836.tldr: This work establishes a new paradigm for misinformation detection, bridging large-scale video understanding, reasoning-guided alignment, and interpretable verification, and proposes Fact-R1, a novel framework that integrates deep reasoning with collaborative rule-based reinforcement learning.

2505.17244.tldr: ReasoningShield is introduced, a lightweight yet robust framework for moderating CoTs in LRMs that achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming task-specific tools like LlamaGuard-4 by 35.6% and general-purpose commercial models like GPT-4o by 15.8% on benchmarks, while also generalizing effectively across diverse reasoning paradigms, tasks, and unseen scenarios.

2505.18244.tldr: The Multi-Scale Probabilistic Generation Theory (MSPGT) is introduced, a theoretical framework that models LLMs as Hierarchical Variational Information Bottleneck (H-VIB) systems and advances interpretability from descriptive observation toward predictive, information-theoretic understanding of how hierarchical structure emerges within large neural language models.

2505.19234.tldr: GUARDIAN is presented, a unified method for detecting and mitigating multiple safety concerns in GUARDing Intelligent Agent collaboratioNs by modeling the multi-agent collaboration process as a discrete-time temporal attributed graph, which captures the propagation dynamics of hallucinations and errors.

2505.20740.tldr: MSEarth provides a scalable and high-fidelity resource to enhance the development and evaluation of MLLMs in scientific reasoning, and is publicly available to foster further research and innovation in this field.

2506.06443.tldr: It is found that intermediate layers retain more general-purpose features, whereas the final-layer specializes and compresses information, and the importance of exploring the full representational depth of molecular encoders to achieve substantial performance improvements and computational efficiency.

2506.10137.tldr: A simple yet effective representation learning objective, $\text{BYOL-}\gamma$ is proposed for GCBC, which theoretically approximates the successor representation in the finite MDP case through self-predictive representations, and achieves competitive empirical performance across a suite of challenging tasks requiring combinatorial generalization.

2506.10412.tldr: Empirical results demonstrate that explicitly modeling multimodality on irregular time series data leads to substantial gains in forecasting performance, and Time-IMM and IMM-TSF provide a foundation for advancing time series analysis under real-world conditions.

2506.16096.tldr: A two-stage Brain-to-Population Graph Learning (B2P-GL) framework that integrates the semantic similarity of brain regions and condition-based population graph modeling and offers a reliable and personalized approach to brain disorder diagnosis, advancing clinical applicability.

2507.04886.tldr: It is indicated that high-level semantics are not inherent to input embeddings but are an emergent property of the Transformer's compositional architecture and data scale, which reframes the role of embeddings from meaning containers to structural primitives.

2507.17365.tldr: DynaSearcher is proposed, an innovative search agent enhanced by dynamic knowledge graphs and multi-reward reinforcement learning (RL), which leverages knowledge graphs as external structured knowledge to guide the search process by explicitly modeling entity relationships, thereby ensuring factual consistency in intermediate queries and mitigating biases from irrelevant information.

2508.14755.tldr: A method for generating large numbers of isomorphic physics problems using generative AI services such as ChatGPT, through prompt chaining and tool use, addressing key limitations in existing LLM-based methods.

2508.14896.tldr: This work identifies the presence of activation outliers, characterized by abnormally large activation values that dominate the dynamic range, and implements state-of-the-art PTQ methods and conducts a comprehensive evaluation across multiple task types and model variants.

2508.19972.tldr: GLSim is introduced, a novel training-free object hallucination detection framework that leverages complementary global and local embedding similarity signals between image and text modalities, enabling more accurate and reliable hallucination detection in diverse scenarios.

2509.01052.tldr: FlashAdventure, a benchmark of 34 Flash-based adventure games designed to test full story arc completion and tackle the observation-behavior gap, is introduced and CUA-as-a-Judge, an automated gameplay evaluator, and COAST, an agentic framework leveraging long-term clue memory to better plan and solve sequential tasks are proposed.

2509.16494.tldr: This work proposes M-Spoiler, a framework that simulates agent interactions within a multi-agent system to generate adversarial samples that are used to manipulate the target agent in the target system, misleading the system's collaborative decision-making process.

2509.18133.tldr: Extensive experiments on the public MTL5 benchmark and an industrial Tencent3 benchmark validate the effectiveness of MoE-CL for continual instruction tuning and demonstrate that MoE-CL is practical for large-scale industrial deployment where continual adaptation and stable transfer are critical.

2509.19330.tldr: LibEMER is introduced, a unified evaluation framework that provides fully reproducible PyTorch implementations of curated deep learning methods alongside standardized protocols for data preprocessing, model realization, and experimental setups that enables unbiased performance assessment on three widely-used public datasets across two learning tasks.

2509.20399.tldr: It is shown that state-of-the-art neural network stegomalware can be efficiently and effectively neutralized through shuffling the column order of the weight- and bias-matrices, or equivalently the channel-order of convolutional layers, which effectively corrupts payloads that have been embedded in neural network steganography at no cost to network accuracy.

2509.21976.tldr: Geo-R1 is proposed, a reasoning-centric reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) paradigm for few-shot geospatial referring that enforces the model to first generate explicit, interpretable reasoning chains that decompose referring expressions, and then leverage these rationales to localize target objects.

2509.22637.tldr: It is shown that rejection sampling finetuning and binary-reward RL, including GRPO, can be interpreted as local forward-KL objectives, where an implicit weighting by model accuracy naturally arises from the derivation and reveals a previously unnoticed bias toward easier questions.

2509.25724.tldr: This work proposes a method that constructs DFT initial guesses by predicting the electron density in a compact auxiliary basis representation using E(3)-equivariant neural networks, and represents the first and robust candidate for a universally transferable DFT acceleration method.

2510.00027.tldr: This work introduces TransIP: Transformer-based Inter-Atomic Potentials, a novel training paradigm for interatomic potentials achieving symmetry compliance without explicit architectural constraints and shows that learned equivariance can be a powerful and efficient alternative to equivariant or augmentation-based MLIP models.

2510.00395.tldr: The first systematic study of BPE's generalizability in multi-track symbolic music generation is studied, and the introduction of AS-KVHS for low-latency symbolic music generation is introduced, an open-source benchmark that matches or surpasses state-of-the-art models in generation quality.

2510.01427.tldr: Experiments show that Falconer closely matches state-of-the-art LLMs in instruction-following accuracy while reducing inference cost by up to 90% and accelerating large-scale knowledge mining by more than 20x, offering an efficient and scalable foundation for Deep Research.

2510.01656.tldr: This work introduces Asymmetric Proximal Policy Optimization (AsyPPO), a simple and scalable framework that restores the critics role while remaining efficient in large-model settings and highlights the importance of architectural innovations for scalable, efficient algorithms.

2510.04850.tldr: This work formally defines the task of distillation data detection, and proposes a novel and effective method Token Probability Deviation (TBD), which leverages the probability patterns of the generated output tokens to quantify how far the generated tokens' probabilities deviate from a high reference probability.

2510.05173.tldr: This work introduces SafeGuider, a two-step framework designed for robust safety control without compromising generation quality, which combines an embedding-level recognition model with a safety-aware feature erasure beam search algorithm and demonstrates exceptional effectiveness in minimizing attack success rates.

2510.07312.tldr: This work introduces a scalable method to bootstrap long-horizon reasoning capabilities using only existing, abundant short-horizon data, synthetically composes simple problems into complex, multi-step dependency chains of arbitrary length.

2510.07575.tldr: This position paper argues that the current laissez-faire approach to AI evaluation is unsustainable, and argues that true, sustainable AI advancement demands a paradigm shift: a unified, live, and quality-controlled benchmarking framework robust by construction, not by mere courtesy and goodwill.

2510.09710.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage semantic filtering and conflict-free framework for trustworthy RAG that effectively preserves useful knowledge while mitigating conflict contamination, achieving significant improvements in both generation robustness and output trustworthiness.

2510.10300.tldr: This work treats the deterministic, closed, coupled world-regulator system $(W,R) as a single self-delimiting program via a constant-size wrapper that produces the world output string $x$ fed to the regulator, and proves that the larger the complexity gap, the more world-regulator pairs with high mutual algorithmic information are favored.

2510.12364.tldr: This analysis conceptualizes VC within the metaphor of co-drifting, contrasting it with the prevalent co-piloting perspective of AI-assisted development, and argues that VC reconfigures the developers role, blurring boundaries between professional and non-developers.

2510.12563.tldr: The introduction of HardcoreLogic, a challenging benchmark of over 5,000 puzzles across 10 games, designed to test the robustness of LRMs on the"long-tail" of logical games, exposes the limitations of current LRMs and establishes a benchmark for advancing high-level logical reasoning.

2510.13093.tldr: A paradigm shift from a conventional probabilistic view to a principled information-theoretic framework, which establishes a new state-of-the-art (sota) on the challenging ternary task, and its robust representations also achieve top results on conventional binary benchmarks, reducing the False Positive Rate by over 60% on datasets like LSUN.

2510.13103.tldr: This work establishes a connection between the uncertainty of LLMs and their invariance under semantic-preserving intervention from a causal perspective and proposes a novel grey-box uncertainty quantification method that measures the variation in model outputs before and after the semantic-preserving intervention.

2510.13106.tldr: trustworthiness metrics by integrating well-known perturbation methods like AutoDAN and employing majority voting across various evaluation methods, TrustVis not only provides reliable results but also makes complex evaluation processes accessible to users.

2510.13108.tldr: DriveCritic is introduced, a novel framework featuring two key contributions: the DriveCritic dataset, a curated collection of challenging scenarios where context is critical for correct judgment and annotated with pairwise human preferences, and the DriveCritic model, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) based evaluator.

2510.13115.tldr: A system that leverages Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate multi-label clinical text eligibility classification and summarization and shows potential for automating clinical trial eligibility assessment using data-driven approaches, thereby improving research efficiency.

2510.13117.tldr: It is shown that MDMs and polynomially-padded PLTs are, in fact, equivalent in this setting, and that MDMs can solve all problems that CoT-augmented transformers can.

2510.13143.tldr: It is demonstrated that combining representative example selection with increased temperature provides the appropriate level of diversity to the ensemble and highlights the practical importance of both example selection and controlled diversity in designing effective one-shot LLM ensembles.

2510.13157.tldr: This work introduces FINDER, a novel two-step framework, to enhance LLMs'capabilities in financial numerical reasoning, which achieves a new state-of-the-art performance on both the FinQA and ConvFinQA datasets.

2510.13158.tldr: The Program Behavior Spectrum is introduced, a new representation generated by probing a program's IR with a diverse set of optimization sequences and quantifying the resulting changes in its static features, to model a program's optimization sensitivity.

2510.13194.tldr: A stress-aware speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) system that preserves word-level emphasis by leveraging LLMs for cross-lingual emphasis conversion and provides an effective, data-efficient solution for preserving paralinguistic cues in S2ST is proposed.

2510.13195.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that agents governed by the proposed framework not only exhibit behaviors congruent with their emotional states but also, in comparative assessments against other agent types, demonstrate superior ecological validity and generate decision outcomes that significantly more closely approximate human behavioral patterns.

2510.13202.tldr: LGSA is an effective strategy for bias mitigation, enhancing subgroup balance while maintaining high task accuracy and label fidelity, and is demonstrated to reduce performance disparities without compromising accuracy.

2510.13208.tldr: MimicParts is a novel framework designed to enhance stylized motion generation based on part-aware style injection and part-aware denoising network that divides the body into different regions to encode localized motion styles, enabling the model to capture fine-grained regional differences.

2510.13214.tldr: This work proposes a complementary agent system integrating small and large LLMs that reduces the computational cost of the large LLM by more than 50% with negligible accuracy loss, while consistently maintaining robust performance on complex tasks.

2510.13220.tldr: EvoTest is an evolutionary test-time learning framework that improves an agent without any fine-tuning or gradients-by evolving the entire agentic system after every episode, outperforming not only reflection and memory-only baselines but also more complex online fine-tuning methods.

2510.13230.tldr: A novel utility-based analytical model is proposed that enables perception systems of AVs to understand the driving environment and is validated that the proposed function is capable of finding the right perception for AVs.

2510.13232.tldr: CoVAND is introduced, a dataset constructed with a systematic chain-of-thought (CoT) and VQA-based pipeline to generate high-quality, instance-grounded negation data and NegToMe, a novel text token merging module that directly tackles the architectural cause of affirmative bias.

2510.13250.tldr: A super real-time model with a stem-encoder-decoder structure for crowd counting tasks, which achieves the fastest inference compared with state-of-the-arts, and the proposed network reasoning speed is the fastest.

2510.13261.tldr: A ratio-based Shapley value is introduced that replaces the standard additive formulation with a relative contribution measure and proves that it satisfies the same set of incentive conditions as the additive formulation, including adapted versions of fairness, individual rationality, and stability.
