2510.14968.tldr: A Retrieval-based Demonstration Decomposer (RDD) that automatically decomposes demonstrations into sub-tasks by aligning the visual features of the decomposed sub-task intervals with those from the training data of the low-level visuomotor policies.

2510.14969.tldr: Experiments show that UI-Simulator rivals or surpasses open-source agents trained on real UIs with significantly better robustness, despite using weaker teacher models, and proposes a targeted scaling strategy that enables more rapid and data-efficient scaling by prioritizing high-impact tasks and synthesizes informative trajectory variants.

2510.14972.tldr: TokDrift is introduced, a framework that applies semantic-preserving rewrite rules to create code variants differing only in tokenization that identifies misaligned tokenization as a hidden obstacle to reliable code understanding and generation.

2510.14975.tldr: WithAnyone, a diffusion-based model that effectively mitigates copy-paste while preserving high identity similarity, is presented, a diffusion-based model that effectively mitigates copy-paste while preserving high identity similarity.

2510.14977.tldr: A novel point-to-Gaussian variational autoencoder (P2G-VAE) that encodes 3D inputs into a latent point representation, which is subsequently decoded as 3D Gaussian primitives to jointly model geometry and appearance and achieves explorable world modeling through progressive generation in the point latent space.

2510.14981.tldr: An implicit 3D regularization approach is proposed by constraining the generated 2D image sequences to adhere to a pre-trained multi-view image distribution through coupled diffusion sampling, a simple diffusion sampling technique that concurrently samples two trajectories from both a multi-view image distribution and a 2D edited image distribution, to enforce the multi-view consistency among the generated images.

2312.12634.tldr: This work introduces MotionScript, a novel framework for generating highly detailed, natural language descriptions of 3D human motions, and makes the first attempt to systematically translate 3D motion into structured natural language without requiring training data.

2409.12682.tldr: This study investigates the efficacy of RAG-based unit test generation for machine learning (ML/DL) APIs and analyzes the impact of different knowledge sources on their effectiveness, highlighting RAG's potential in unit test generation for improving test coverage with well-targeted knowledge sources.

2411.14511.tldr: The ability of the proposed generative modeling approach to approximate complex posteriors while maintaining computational efficiency on well-established benchmark problems is demonstrated.

2412.08610.tldr: The results suggest that homogenization due to generative AI is unlikely to persist in competitive markets, and instead, competition in downstream markets may drive diversification in AI model development.

2501.06262.tldr: This paper presents an innovative agentic system capable of performing on-device perception and planning, enabling active sensing on the edge, allowing the system to plan in dynamic environments while operating in real-time with a compact memory footprint of as little as 300 MB.

2504.00955.tldr: This paper challenges the argument that generative artificial intelligence is entitled to broad immunity from copyright law for reproducing copyrighted works without authorization due to a fair use defense, and argues that every legal and substantive argument favoring fair use for GenAI applies equally, if not more so, to humans.

2504.04126.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that Structural Video Diffusion achieves superior performance in generating lifelike, coherent videos for multiple subjects with dynamic and rich interactions, advancing the state of human-centric video generation.

2505.07176.tldr: This survey introduces the Internet of Agents as a foundational framework that enables seamless interconnection, dynamic discovery, and collaborative orchestration among heterogeneous agents at scale and analyzes the key operational enablers of IoA.

2505.11717.tldr: This work proposes WebInject, a prompt injection attack that manipulates the webpage environment to induce a web agent to perform an attacker-specified action, and trains a neural network to approximate the mapping and apply projected gradient descent to solve the reformulated optimization problem.

2505.19687.tldr: DiEmo-TTS, a self-supervised distillation method to minimize emotional information loss and preserve speaker identity, is proposed and cluster-driven sampling and information perturbation is introduced to preserve emotion while removing irrelevant factors.

2505.19693.tldr: This work proposes EmoSphere-SER, a joint model that integrates spherical VAD region classification to guide VAD regression for improved emotion prediction and shows that the approach exceeds baseline methods, confirming the validity of the proposed framework.

2505.24623.tldr: This work proposes a novel hyperbolic dataset distillation method, termed HDD, which embeds features extracted by a shallow network into the Lorentz hyperbolic space, where the discrepancy between synthetic and original data is measured by the hyperbolic (geodesic) distance between their centroids.

2506.08460.tldr: MOBODY, a Model-Based Off-Dynamics Offline RL algorithm that optimizes a policy using learned target dynamics transitions to explore the target domain, rather than only being trained with the low dynamics-shift transitions, is proposed.

2507.13543.tldr: A mathematical analogy between information-theoretic constructs and statistical mechanics is established, introducing a suitable partition function and free energy functional and explicitly proving the Legendre-Fenchel duality between the structure function and free energy.

2507.17725.tldr: A principled framework to analyze how different forms of compressibility - such as neuron-level sparsity and spectral compressibility - affect adversarial robustness is developed, showing a fundamental tension between structured compressibility and robustness.

2507.20957.tldr: This work proposes an experimental framework to investigate emergent behaviors in knowledge conflicts arising from discrepancies between their pre-trained parametric knowledge and real-time market data, and reveals distinct, model-specific biases.

2508.04995.tldr: The Situated Epistemic Infrastructures (SEI) framework is introduced as a diagnostic tool for analyzing how knowledge becomes authoritative across hybrid human-machine systems under post-coherence conditions.

2508.15099.tldr: Hydra, a modular architecture based upon a state-space backbone which adaptively routes between complementary efficiency mechanisms: sparse global attention, mixture-of-experts, and dual memories comprising a reasoning workspace and product key memory, is introduced.

2509.01842.tldr: A novel gradient-based early stopping approach that operates within transformer components (attention projections and Feed-Forward layer matrices) that finds that different components converge at varying rates during fine-tuning for both language and vision-language models.

2509.02444.tldr: AppCopilot is presented, a multimodal, multi-agent, general-purpose mobile agent that operates across applications and achieves significant improvements on four dimensions: stronger generalization, higher precision of on screen actions, more reliable long horizon task completion, and faster, more resource efficient runtime.

2510.04886.tldr: This work presents ECHO (Error attribution through Contextual Hierarchy and Objective consensus analysis), a novel algorithm that combines hierarchical context representation, objective analysis-based evaluation, and consensus voting to improve error attribution accuracy.

2510.09162.tldr: It is shown that, when LLMs are used for medical advice generation, they generate responses that systematically differ between social groups, and Indigenous and intersex patients receive advice that is less readable and more complex.

2510.12252.tldr: This work proposes PromptLocate, the first method for localizing injected prompts within contaminated data, and shows it accurately localizes injected prompts across eight existing and eight adaptive attacks.

2510.14169.tldr: JEDA (Joint Embedding for Direct and Ambient clinical orders), a domain-initialized bi-encoder that retrieves canonical orders directly and, in a query-free mode, encodes a short rolling window of ambient dialogue to trigger retrieval.

2510.14391.tldr: This work adapts the FCOS detector from computer vision to 1D audio, replacing its original backbone with WaveBeat's temporal feature extractor and adding a Feature Pyramid Network to capture multi-scale temporal patterns.

2510.14989.tldr: This work presents a constrained diffusion framework for structure-guided protein design, ensuring strict adherence to functional requirements while maintaining precise stereochemical and geometric feasibility, and introduces a novel curated benchmark dataset for motif scaffolding in the PDZ domain.

2510.14991.tldr: This survey explores the role of FL in enhancing financial security and introduces a novel classification of its applications based on regulatory and compliance exposure levels, ranging from low-exposure tasks such as collaborative portfolio optimization to high-exposure tasks like real-time fraud detection.

2510.14992.tldr: A production-tested GAZE pipeline that automates the conversion of raw, long-form video into rich, task-ready supervision for world-model training, and detail the orchestration, model choices, and data dictionary to provide a scalable blueprint for generating high-quality world model training data without sacrificing throughput or governance.

2510.14997.tldr: While challenges such as interpretability and class imbalance remain, this hybrid statistical machine learning framework offers a promising advancement toward early detection and risk stratification of diabetic complications compared to conventional diagnostic approaches.

2510.15004.tldr: A data augmentation method that leverages LLMs to generate SA data automatically and a simple yet effective two-stage training strategy, which consistently enhances model performance compared to fine-tuning solely on PA data.

2510.15005.tldr: TangledFeatures is introduced, a framework for feature selection in correlated feature spaces that identifies representative features from groups of entangled predictors, reducing redundancy while retaining explanatory power and can be directly applied in downstream models.

2510.15007.tldr: Three novel multi-label benchmarks for toxicity detection are introduced, derived from public toxicity datasets and annotated according to a detailed 15-category taxonomy, thus enabling more accurate and reliable evaluation of multi-label toxicity in LLM-generated content.

2510.15009.tldr: While the models in the study demonstrated potential for a hybrid approach, Gemini was the best candidate for the task due to its ability to handle figurative language and showed promise for handling essay-scoring tasks alone in the future.

2510.15010.tldr: A novel ensemble-based deep learning framework for unsupervised anomaly detection in wind turbines that integrates Variational Autoencoders, LSTM Autoencoders, and Transformer architectures and offers significant societal value by enabling predictive maintenance, reducing turbine failures, and enhancing operational efficiency in large-scale wind energy deployments.

2510.15012.tldr: This work revisits the Universal Approximation Theorem through the lens of the tropical geometry of neural networks and introduces a constructive, geometry-aware initialization for sigmoidal multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) that adhere to the finite-sum format of UAT.

2510.15015.tldr: DeLeaker is introduced, a lightweight, optimization-free inference-time approach that mitigates leakage by directly intervening on the model's attention maps by dynamically reweights attention maps to suppress excessive cross-entity interactions while strengthening the identity of each entity.

2510.15017.tldr: This work proposes a honeypot-based proactive guardrail system that transforms risk avoidance into risk utilization, fine-tunes a bait model to generate ambiguous, non-actionable but semantically relevant responses, which serve as lures to probe user intent.

2510.15018.tldr: Experiments show that UrbanVerse scenes preserve real-world semantics and layouts, achieving human-evaluated realism comparable to manually crafted scenes, in urban navigation and in urban navigation policies trained in UrbanVerse exhibit scaling power laws and strong generalization.

2510.15068.tldr: This work introduces a novel method that leverages sequential comic-style visual narratives to circumvent safety alignments in state-of-the-art MLLMs and demonstrates superior effectiveness across diverse categories of harmful content.

2510.15096.tldr: OpenEstimate is introduced, an extensible, multi-domain benchmark for evaluating LMs on numerical estimation tasks that require models to synthesize significant amounts of background information and express predictions as probabilistic priors, and finds that LM-elicited priors are often inaccurate and overconfident.

2510.15101.tldr: An upper bound on FNO approximation error is proved and TempO, a latent flow matching model leveraging sparse conditioning with channel folding to efficiently process 3D spatiotemporal fields using time-conditioned Fourier layers to capture multi-scale modes with high fidelity is proposed.

2510.15103.tldr: It is found that sparse memory finetuning learns new knowledge while exhibiting substantially less forgetting: while NaturalQuestions F1 drops by 89% after full finetuning on new facts and 71% with LoRA, sparse memory finetuning yields only an 11% drop with the same level of new knowledge acquisition.

2510.15109.tldr: This paper designs sophisticated targeted training data poisoning and backdoor (Trojan) attacks, and characterize the emerging vulnerabilities in a vehicular network to strengthen distributed federated learning against the emerging cyber threats.

2510.15110.tldr: This work revisits reinforcement learning with the simplest length penalty--truncation--and proposes an update-selective merging method that preserves baseline accuracy while retaining the concise reasoning ability of the DLER model, which is useful for scenarios where RL training data is scarce.

2510.15120.tldr: This work highlights the potential of DRL in enabling intelligent agents to both generate and solve content in virtual environments, pushing the boundaries of what AI can contribute to creative game development processes.

2510.15128.tldr: Causal Mechanics is proposed, a mechanisms first program in which hypothesis space change is a first class operation and probabilistic structure is used when useful rather than presumed, and a scaffold for systems that can convert unreachable errors into reachable ones and correct them.

2510.15134.tldr: FarsiMCQGen is introduced, an innovative approach for generating Persian-language multiple-choice questions (MCQs) that combines candidate generation, filtering, and ranking techniques to build a model that generates answer choices resembling those in real MCQs.

2510.15148.tldr: XModBench is introduced, a large-scale tri-modal benchmark explicitly designed to measure cross-modal consistency and positioned as a fundamental diagnostic tool for evaluating and improving cross-modal competence.

2510.15191.tldr: A novel framework that transforms retrieved content into structured representations optimized for reasoning and introduces a self-reward structural verification mechanism that checks whether the generated structures are both correct and self-contained.

2510.15200.tldr: A two-period game-theoretic model to analyze how openness shapes competition in an AI value chain, featuring an incumbent developer, a downstream deployer, and an entrant developer, provides a robust framework for analyzing competition and designing effective policy in the complex and rapidly evolving FM ecosystem.

2510.15211.tldr: This work introduces ReasonIF, a systematic benchmark for assessing reasoning instruction following, and explores two strategies to enhance reasoning instruction fidelity using synthetic data.

2510.15221.tldr: This is the largest and longest longitudinal workplace emotion dataset publicly available, enabling research in emotion recognition, affective dynamics modeling, emotional contagion, turnover prediction, and emotion-aware system design.

2510.15233.tldr: A novel uncertainty quantification method, Trustworthy Expert Split-conformal with Scaled Estimation for Efficient Reliable Adaptive intervals (TESSERA), that provides per-sample uncertainty with reliable coverage guarantee, informative and adaptive prediction interval widths that track the absolute error.

2510.15236.tldr: It is argued that general intelligence is better understood as a homeostatic property cluster: a set of abilities plus the mechanisms that keep those abilities co-present under perturbation and should weight domains by their causal centrality and require evidence of persistence across sessions.

2309.12351.tldr: This work focuses on independent reviewing, an important source of trust in science, and identifies the characteristics of automated reasoning systems that affect their reviewability, and discusses possible steps towards increasing reviewability and trustworthiness via a combination of technical and social measures.

2406.13564.tldr: This paper evaluates humans, state-of-the-art vision models, and large vision-language models on three tasks: binary humor classification, funniness rating prediction, and pairwise humor comparison, revealing a gap between current AI systems and human-level humor understanding.

2408.10774.tldr: The flexible low rank adaptation (Flexora) method is proposed to automatically and flexibly select the most important layers needing to be fine-tuned to achieve the best performance on different downstream tasks.

2410.16655.tldr: This paper introduces FLAMES, a novel LLM-based APR technique that employs semantic-guided patch generation to enhance repair effectiveness and memory efficiency and substantially reduces memory consumption compared to LLM-based APR without compromising time efficiency.

2412.07941.tldr: This paper proposes an extension of the JP model, namely, the Predictive Justified Perspective (PJP) model, to remove the assumption that beliefs remain unchanged since the last observation, and uses all past observations to form predictions about the changing variables.

2412.07981.tldr: The current paper extends the JP model to handle group belief, including distributed belief and common belief, using the Group Justified Perspective (GJP) model and shows the efficiency and expressiveness of the model at handling planning problems that cannot be handled by other epistemic planning tools.

2501.18492.tldr: This paper proposes GuardReasoner, a new safeguard for LLMs, by guiding the guard model to learn to reason, which achieves better performance, explainability, and generalizability.

2502.06438.tldr: By reducing model size and computational overhead, FEMBA enables continuous on-device EEG monitoring for tasks like seizure detection and artifact reduction, promising improved patient care through timely and cost-effective neuro-monitoring solutions.

2502.12859.tldr: PAFT first generates diverse synthetic prompts, then continuously samples from this set to construct training instances, forcing models to learn fundamental task principles rather than surface-level patterns, forcing models to learn fundamental task principles rather than surface-level patterns.

2502.15176.tldr: A comprehensive and up-to-date review of state-of-the-art techniques for detecting and classifying synthetic images generated by advanced generative AI models, highlighting the potential of hybrid frameworks that combine the efficiency of training-free approaches with the semantic reasoning of multimodal models to advance trustworthy and explainable synthetic image forensics.

2502.17460.tldr: This work investigates whether model representations learned from abundant EEG data can effectively be transferred to ECG/PPG data solely with fine-tuning, without the need for large-scale additional pre-training, for the BP estimation task.

2503.05846.tldr: This work proposes EMCee (Extracting synthetic Multilingual Context and merging), a simple yet effective framework that enhances the multilingual capabilities of LLMs by explicitly extracting and utilizing query-relevant knowledge from the LLM itself.

2503.10679.tldr: LinEAS is modality-agnostic and empirically find that it outperforms existing activation steering methods at mitigating and including new concepts at the output of single-step text-to-image generation models, becoming competitive with oracle-dependent methods that have access to strong supervision.

2503.23886.tldr: With an effective Text2Schema technique, users can effortlessly create database table structures using natural language, and subsequently leverage existing Text2SQL techniques to perform data manipulations, which significantly narrows the gap between non-technical personnel and highly efficient, versatile relational database systems.

2504.11344.tldr: Experimental results on real-world medical datasets demonstrate that HRTPP outperforms state-of-the-art interpretable TPPs in terms of predictive performance and clinical interpretability, and establishes a multi-criteria assessment framework.

2504.12292.tldr: It is found that using Gaussians for rendering substantially improves the effectiveness of this self-supervised approach, and surpasses existing self-supervised approaches in geometric evaluations on the NoW benchmark for neutral faces and a new benchmark for non-neutral expressions.

2504.16651.tldr: MAYA, a unified, customizable, plug-and-play benchmarking framework designed to facilitate the systematic characterization and benchmarking of generative password-guessing models in the context of trawling attacks, is introduced.

2505.08222.tldr: An iterative distillation method that transfers high-fidelity simulations into a simplified, GPU-accelerated environment while preserving high-level dynamics is proposed, providing a scalable framework for autonomous fleet control in real-world sea missions.

2505.14714.tldr: A novel multi-modal fake news detection framework that integrates visual, textual, and knowledge-based representations is proposed that outperforms recent approaches and introduces a new paradigm: knowledge-grounded multimodal reasoning.

2505.15234.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that SAMA-UNet consistently outperforms CNN, Transformer, and Mamba-based methods in combining efficiency with accuracy, making it a promising solution for real-world clinical segmentation tasks.

2505.22467.tldr: This position paper calls for a paradigm shift toward topology-aware MASs that explicitly model and dynamically optimize the structure of inter-agent interactions, and introduces a systematic three-stage framework that provides a principled foundation for designing MASs.

2506.03198.tldr: FLEX is introduced, the first large-scale, multimodal, multiview dataset for fitness AQA that incorporates surface electromyography (sEMG) and FLEX-VideoQA is introduced, a structured question-answering benchmark with hierarchical queries that drive cross-modal reasoning in vision-language models.

2506.03784.tldr: It is proved that a small Kullback--Leibler divergence between the model distributions does not guarantee that the corresponding representations are similar, and the link between closeness in distribution and representational similarity is clarified.

2506.05342.tldr: A novel framework to "Refer to Any Segmentation Mask Group"(RAS), which augments segmentation models with complex multimodal interactions and comprehension via a mask-centric large multimodal model.

2506.07829.tldr: This paper extends the formal tools used to check the compatibility of local policies with the team task, making decentralized training with theoretical guarantees usable in more scenarios and empirically demonstrates that symbolic knowledge about the temporal evolution of events in the environment can significantly expedite the learning process in DMARL.

2506.09080.tldr: FinHEAR is proposed, a multi-agent framework for Human Expertise and Adaptive Risk-aware reasoning that incorporates expert-guided retrieval, confidence-adjusted position sizing, and outcome-based refinement to enhance interpretability and robustness.

2506.16150.tldr: Results show that state-of-the-art LLMs frequently exhibit emergent criminal tendencies, such as proposing misleading statements or evasion tactics, even without explicit instructions, highlighting the urgent need for adversarial robustness, behavioral alignment, and safety mechanisms before broader LLM deployment.

2506.17462.tldr: This work introduces the Agentic Robotic Navigation Architecture (ARNA), a general-purpose framework that equips an LVLM-based agent with a library of perception, reasoning, and navigation tools drawn from modern robotic stacks that outperforms state-of-the-art EQA-specific approaches.

2507.11269.tldr: A novel theoretical result is introduced that leverages the Neyman-Rubin potential outcomes framework into DRL and establishes a causal bound on the factual loss, which is analogous to the on-policy loss in DRL.

2507.19983.tldr: Extensive simulation experiments show that CLASP outperforms state-of-the-art baseline methods on multiple tasks across diverse clothes types, demonstrating strong performance and generalization.

2508.02092.tldr: FPEdit is established as the first fingerprinting approach to simultaneously achieve robustness against adaptation, resistance to detection, and preservation of model utility, thereby providing a minimally invasive solution for reliable provenance verification of large language models in adversarial deployment scenarios.

2508.03360.tldr: This study proposes CogBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate the cross-lingual and cross-site generalizability of large language models (LLMs) for speech-based cognitive impairment assessment, and explores lightweight fine-tuning of LLMs via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), which significantly improves generalization in target domains.

2509.01055.tldr: VerlTool is introduced, a unified and modular framework that formalizes ARLT as multi-turn trajectories with multi-modal observation tokens, extending beyond single-turn RLVR paradigms and provides a scalable foundation for tool-augmented RL research.

2509.07103.tldr: This work introduces a general-purpose drop-in replacement, lookup multivariate Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (lmKANs), which deliver a substantially better trade-off between capacity and inference cost.

2509.13031.tldr: A two-stage reinforcement learning framework designed to jointly enhance both the perceptual and reasoning capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) is proposed and PeBR-R1, a vision-language model with significantly enhanced perceptual and reasoning capabilities is obtained.

2509.16391.tldr: CoUn is introduced, a novel MU framework inspired by the observation that a model retrained from scratch using only retain data classifies forget data based on their semantic similarity to the retain data.

2509.20639.tldr: This work presents a production-grade defense system rooted in established malware detection and threat intelligence practices that delivers layered protection against evolving LLM threats while generating training data for continuous model improvement and deploying updates without interrupting production.

2509.22536.tldr: This work introduces an end-to-end FP8 training recipe that seamlessly integrates continual pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, and employs a fine-grained, hybrid-granularity quantization strategy to maintain numerical fidelity while maximizing computational efficiency.

2509.23379.tldr: Clinical Contrastive Decoding (CCD), a training-free and retrieval-free inference framework that integrates structured clinical signals from task-specific radiology expert models, is introduced, effectively bridging expert models and MLLMs in radiology.

2509.23809.tldr: Tequila is proposed, a trapping-free quantization optimization method that reactivates deadzone-trapped weights by repurposing them as dynamic biases, thereby enhancing model capacity and optimization with nearly zero inference overhead.

2509.26184.tldr: This work introduces Auto-ARGUE, a robust LLM-based implementation of the recently proposed ARGUE framework for RG evaluation, and presents analysis of Auto-ARGUE on the RG pilot task from the TREC 2024 NeuCLIR track, showing good system-level correlations with human judgments.

2509.26242.tldr: This work proposes an efficient and universal solution to fine-tuning, Dynamic Boosted Annealing (DBA), which obtains a global gradient through zero-learning-rate training on general data, which is subsequently employed for gradient boosting and dynamic training step correction during domain training.

2509.26427.tldr: It is shown that gradient ascent-based unconstrained optimization methods frequently fail to perform machine unlearning, a phenomenon attributed to the inherent statistical dependence between the forget and retain data sets, with empirical and theoretical evidence showing these methods often fail precisely due to this overlooked relationship.

2509.26490.tldr: Vitabench is introduced, a challenging benchmark that evaluates agents on versatile interactive tasks grounded in real-world settings and proposes a rubric-based sliding window evaluator, enabling robust assessment of diverse solution pathways in complex environments and stochastic interactions.

2510.00495.tldr: This work represents the first to adopt a mixture of normal and abnormal samples as references in generalist anomaly detection, and effectively utilizes both normal and anomalous references for more accurate and efficient cross-domain anomaly detection.

2510.00615.tldr: Experiments show that ACON reduces memory usage by 26-54% while largely preserving task performance, preserves over 95% of accuracy when distilled into smaller compressors, and enhances smaller LMs as long-horizon agents with up to 46% performance improvement.

2510.00733.tldr: DeepFHT, a survival-analysis framework that couples deep neural networks with first hitting time (FHT) distributions from stochastic process theory, achieves predictive accuracy on par with the state-of-the-art approach, while maintaining a physics- based interpretable parameterization that elucidates the relation between input features and risk.

2510.04229.tldr: This study verifies that appropriately designing a Persuadee Agent can improve persuasion through the conformity effect by introducing a “Persuadee Agent” that is persuaded alongside a human participant in a three-party persuasive dialogue with a Persuader Agent.

2510.10248.tldr: MPPReasoner exhibits exceptional cross-task generalization and generates chemically sound reasoning paths that provide valuable insights into molecular property analysis, substantially enhancing both interpretability and practical utility for chemists.

2510.10921.tldr: FG-CLIP 2 is introduced, a bilingual vision-language model designed to advance fine-grained alignment for both English and Chinese, and the Textual Intra-modal Contrastive (TIC) loss is introduced to better distinguish semantically similar captions.

2510.13253.tldr: This work proposes a novel architecture called MDM (Multi-modal Diffusion Mamba), which utilizes a Mamba-based multi-step selection diffusion model to progressively generate and refine modality-specific information through a unified variational autoencoder for both encoding and decoding.

2510.14513.tldr: A novel Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistant that elicits a user's intention, assesses whether ongoing activities are in line with that intention, and provides gentle nudges when deviations occur, which indicates that the AI assistant effectively supports users in maintaining focus and aligning their digital behavior with their intentions.

2510.14837.tldr: This work introduces a novel type of reward machines, called stochastic reward Machines, and an algorithm for learning them, based on constraint solving, that outperforms both existing methods and a naive approach for handling noisy reward functions.

2510.15260.tldr: DRO-InstructZero connects distributionally robust optimization with prompt learning, offering a plug-and-play and general approach for reliable, transferable prompt alignment under real-world uncertainty.

2510.15261.tldr: This work proposes conceptualizing information into semantic tags and associating the tags with their context to store them in a graph-structured multimodal contextual memory for efficient concept-driven retrieval.

2510.15262.tldr: The results extend $\mu$P beyond the near-init regime by explicitly controlling steady-state scales set by the optimizer, offering a practical recipe for width-robust hyperparameter transfer under AdamW.

2510.15282.tldr: This work systematically evaluates state-of-the-art inpainting models and observes a saturation in their standalone performance, and introduces a methodology combining model ensembling with efficient post-processing strategies such as median filtering, histogram matching, and pixel averaging.

2510.15283.tldr: A novel framework, Exemplar-Guided Planning (EGP), which enhances the planning capabilities of LLM agents for KGQA by retrieving highly similar exemplary questions and their successful reasoning paths from this preprocessed set using semantic embeddings and an efficient FAISS index.

2510.15286.tldr: Overall, MTmixAtt provides a unified and scalable solution for modeling arbitrary heterogeneous features across scenarios, significantly improving both user experience and commercial outcomes.

2510.15294.tldr: The proposed network model is based on the combination of CNN, TCN and GRU networks, which are trained directly on raw configurations without any manual feature extraction, and shows that deep architectures are capable of extracting hierarchical structures from the raw data of numerical experiments.

2510.15306.tldr: WebGen-V is the first work to enable high-granularity agentic crawling and evaluation for instruction-to-HTML generation, providing a unified pipeline from real-world data acquisition and webpage generation to structured multimodal assessment.

2510.15330.tldr: A first-cut controller, named beLLMan, enables the LLM infrastructure to actively and progressively signal the first-party LLM application to adjust the output length in response to changing system load.

2510.15331.tldr: Active Simulation-Based Inference (ASBI) is presented, a parameter estimation framework that uses robots to actively collect real-world online data to achieve accurate black-box simulator tuning and leveraging Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE), which leverages a neural network to learn the posterior estimator.

2510.15345.tldr: The factors shaping human perceptions of readability through the analysis of 897 judgments are investigated, finding that, beyond surface-level cues, information content and topic strongly shape text comprehensibility.

2510.15346.tldr: This paper proposes SAFE, (Stable And Fast LLM Ensembling), a framework that selectively ensembles by jointly considering tokenization mismatch across models and consensus in their next-token probability distributions, and applies a probability sharpening strategy when the ensemble distribution becomes overly smooth, enabling the selection of more confident tokens during ensembling.

2510.15352.tldr: A novel approach for photorealistic robot simulation that integrates 3D Gaussian Splatting as a drop-in renderer within vectorized physics simulators such as IsaacGym is presented, advancing scalable and generalizable robot learning.

2510.15363.tldr: This work derives excess risk bounds for KRR that explicitly depend on the kernel spectrum, causal structure parameters, and sampling mechanisms, and applies the results to denoising score learning, establishing generalization guarantees and providing principled guidance for sampling noisy data points.

2510.15371.tldr: Cortical-SSM, a novel architecture that extends deep state space models to capture integrated dependencies of EEG and ECoG signals across temporal, spatial, and frequency domains, is proposed and validated.

2510.15374.tldr: A novel RL framework, DEPO, is proposed to reduce inefficient reasoning for models and achieves a significant reduction in sequence length and reduces excessive reasoning paths in inefficient tokens, while outperforming the base model in overall accuracy.

2510.15383.tldr: DronesAudioset is presented, a comprehensive drone audition dataset featuring 23.5 hours of annotated recordings, covering a wide range of signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) from -57.2 dB to -2.5 dB, that enables development and systematic evaluation of noise suppression and classification methods for human-presence detection under challenging conditions, while also informing practical design considerations for drone audition systems.

2510.15395.tldr: A formal definition for corrigibility is provided, then a transformation is introduced that constructs a corrigible version of any goal that can be made corrigible, without sacrificing performance.

2510.15400.tldr: The LoSP-Prompt approach eliminates navigator signals and realistic data supervision, providing an interpretable, robust solution for high-resolution multi-organ multi-shot DWI.

2510.15416.tldr: Adaptive Minds is an agentic system that treats LoRA adapters as domain-specific tools, providing a scalable and extensible foundation for domain-adaptive AI assistance.

2510.15440.tldr: This work proposes a novel evidence-prioritized adaptive framework, EARL, which is precisely engineered to dynamically select the most relevant frames and, crucially, to perform localized re-sampling around the selected key frames to access fine-grained temporal detail.

2510.15444.tldr: RPC is introduced, a hybrid method that leverages theoretical insights through two key components: Perplexity Consistency and Reasoning Pruning, and achieves reasoning performance comparable to self-consistency while not only enhancing confidence reliability but also reducing sampling costs by 50%.

2510.15456.tldr: This paper proposes a novel method to incorporate causal information in the form of Temporal Logic-based Causal Diagrams into the reward formalism, thereby expediting policy learning and aiding the transfer of task specifications to new environments.

2510.15458.tldr: A new normalizing flow architecture is proposed that satisfies a universal approximation property for causal structural models and can be efficiently trained to minimize the $G$-causal Wasserstein distance.

2510.15480.tldr: Ensembling of the selected LLMs is explored: effort-effective approach to improving effectiveness and the importance of score normalization and favoring ensembling methods like maximum or sum over averaging is suggested.

2510.15495.tldr: An Offline Simulator (OffSim), a novel model-based offline inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) framework, to emulate environmental dynamics and reward structure directly from expert-generated state-action trajectories and introduces an extension that incorporates a marginal reward for multi-dataset settings to enhance exploration.

2510.15502.tldr: SESA is proposed, a novel SEquential SAmpling framework that mitigates this challenge by generating diverse solution sketches sequentially before expanding them into full reasoning paths, paving the way for more effective and diverse reasoning in RL-trained LLMs.

2510.15509.tldr: It is demonstrated that while AI is promising, adoption among NGOs remains uneven and biased towards larger organizations, Nevertheless, following a roadmap grounded in literature can help NGOs overcome initial barriers to AI adoption, ultimately improving effectiveness, engagement, and social impact.

2510.15516.tldr: This work studies knowledge distillation in a third dimension: dataset size, revealing that the dataset size may be a fundamental but overlooked variable in the mechanisms underpinning distillation.

2510.15543.tldr: Experiments on various benchmarks show gains in out-of-distribution retrieval, highlighting modality composition awareness as a effective principle for robust composed multimodal retrieval when utilizing MLLMs as the unified encoder.

2510.15547.tldr: The multimodal hypergraph contrastive attention network (MM-HCAN), a unified framework that integrates multihead attention with a hypergraph architecture and contrastive learning (CL) to jointly model global and localized intra- and inter-modal dependencies beyond Euclidean embedding spaces, is proposed.

2510.15551.tldr: This work formalizes the cross-lingual gap in terms of bias-variance decomposition in terms of bias-variance decomposition and hypothesizes that the variance of responses in the target language is the main cause of this gap.

2510.15557.tldr: The dataset is derived from 127 World War II-era archival video segments containing clapperboards that record structured production metadata such as date, location, and camera-operator identity, and offers a realistic and culturally grounded resource for advancing robust OCR and document understanding in low-resource archival contexts.

2510.15558.tldr: The Korean Instruction-following Task Evaluation (KITE) is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate both general and Korean-specific instructions that aims to foster further research on culturally and linguistically inclusive LLM development and inspire similar endeavors for other underrepresented languages.

2510.15560.tldr: JudgeSQL is a principled framework that redefines SQL candidate selection through structured reasoning and weighted consensus tournament mechanism that develops a reasoning-based SQL judge model that distills reasoning traces with reinforcement learning guided by verifiable rewards, enabling accurate and interpretable judgments.

2510.15568.tldr: This white paper documents the problem framing, experimental design, and quantitative evidence behind the Spark agent programme, using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol calibrated against human gold standards.

2510.15579.tldr: A lightweight CycleGAN for modality transfer in fluorescence microscopy (confocal to super-resolution STED/deconvolved STED), addressing the common challenge of unpaired datasets and introducing the GAN as a diagnostic tool for experimental and labeling quality.

2510.15591.tldr: The findings show that information collected over time provides relevant context to enhance the specificity of medical risk prediction, and sufficient reduction of false positive rates using context could offer a pathway to expand longitudinal health monitoring programs to large populations with comparatively low baseline risk of disease, leading to earlier detection and improved health outcomes.

2510.15623.tldr: This paper proposes CQD-SHAP, a novel framework that computes the contribution of each query part to the ranking of a specific answer and explains the value of leveraging a neural predictor that can infer new knowledge from an incomplete KG, rather than a symbolic approach relying solely on existing facts in the KG.

2510.15624.tldr: This work aims to facilitate broader adoption of automated research across scientific domains, enabling practitioners to deploy interactive multiagent systems that autonomously conduct end-to-end research -- from ideation through experimentation to publication-ready manuscripts.

2510.15647.tldr: This study trains a separate machine-learning model called Critic that implements collaborative filtering for recommendations by learning from the interactions between many users and items, and proposes critique-based LLMs as recommendation systems (Critic-LLM-RS).

2510.15673.tldr: A novel dataset aimed at detecting pedestrians' intentions as they approach an ego-vehicle, comprising synchronized multi-modal data, including fisheye camera feeds, lidar laser scans, ultrasonic sensor readings, and motion capture-based 3D body poses, collected across diverse real-world scenarios is presented.

2510.15674.tldr: CarBoN (Calibrated Best-of-$N$), a two-phase method that first explores the solution space and then learns a calibration of the logits via an input-specific temperature $T$ and additive shift vector $\delta$, guiding generation toward more reliable reasoning.

2510.15683.tldr: A more efficient design is proposed, which introduces a single MoE block (SB-MoE) after the final Transformer layer of a DRM, which is particularly effective for DRMs with lightweight base models, such as TinyBERT and BERT-Small, consistently exceeding standard model fine-tuning across benchmarks.

2510.15684.tldr: A novel Multimodal Vision Transformer Autoencoder trained exclusively on healthy brain MRIs to detect and localize tumors via reconstruction-based error maps, highlighting the potential of transformer-based unsupervised models to serve as scalable, label-efficient tools for neuro-oncological imaging.

2510.15688.tldr: It is shown that the rotor shape of IPMSMs can be predicted with high accuracy using data-driven approaches, offering a fast and cost-effective alternative to FEM-based analyses.

2510.15700.tldr: ProofOptimizer is introduced, the first language model trained to simplify Lean proofs without requiring additional human supervision, and is trained via expert iteration and reinforcement learning, using Lean to verify simplifications and provide training signal.

2510.15701.tldr: A learning-based two-tier architecture discovery framework (LTTADF) consisting of an architecture generator and a performance optimizer to jointly discover optimal architectures of non-ideal BD-RIS given specific circuit complexities, which can effectively explore over a large architecture space while avoiding getting trapped in poor local optima and thus achieving near-optimal solutions for the performance optimization.

2510.15716.tldr: This work connects preference learning in RLHF with the econometrics literature and shows that binary comparisons are insufficient for identifying latent user preferences from finite user data and infinite users, while (even incomplete) rankings over three or more responses ensure identifiability.

2510.15725.tldr: DGME-T, a lightweight extension to the Video Swin Transformer that injects directional grid motion encoding, derived from optical flow, via a learnable and normalized late-fusion layer, demonstrates that structured motion priors and transformer representations are complementary and that even a small, carefully calibrated motion head can substantially enhance robustness in degraded film analysis.

2510.15728.tldr: A novel approach that leverages automaton-based feedback to guide the learning process, replacing explicit reward functions with preferences derived from a deterministic finite automaton (DFA), offering a scalable, efficient, and human-independent alternative to traditional reward modeling.

2510.15739.tldr: AURA (Agent aUtonomy Risk Assessment), a unified framework designed to detect, quantify, and mitigate risks arising from agentic AI, introduces a gamma-based risk scoring methodology that balances risk assessment accuracy with computational efficiency and practical considerations.

2510.15746.tldr: This work proposes a novel alternative to conventional evaluation practices, where LLMs assess each other's output through self-play and peer review, and incorporates game-theoretic voting algorithms to aggregate peer reviews, enabling a principled investigation into whether model-generated rankings reflect human preferences.

2510.15752.tldr: NDM is proposed, the first noise-driven detection and mitigation framework, which could detect and mitigate implicit malicious intention in T2I generation while preserving the model's original generative capabilities.

2510.15756.tldr: This paper proposes a regularization method for models with an encoder-decoder architecture with superpixel based upsampling that encourages the segmented pixels in the decoded image to be SLIC-superpixels, which are based on pixel color and position, independent of the segmentation annotation.

2510.15769.tldr: Results suggest that interactivity enhances both user engagement and confidence, and that the clarity and relevance of explanations are key determinants of trust in AI systems.

2510.15772.tldr: Across two model architectures, results show that enabling reflection-based context editing during discussion produces agents which dominate their baseline counterparts on Elo scores, normalized Bradley-Terry-Davidson ability, and AlphaRank mass.

2510.15778.tldr: This work introduces a system that allows users to develop a better understanding of the model through interaction and experimentation by giving users the ability to replace activation functions of a generative network with parametric ones and a way to set the parameters of these functions.

2510.15782.tldr: Guide-RAG is proposed, a chatbot system and accompanying evaluation framework that integrates both curated expert knowledge and comprehensive literature databases to effectively answer LC clinical questions, suggesting that for emerging diseases, retrieval grounded in curated secondary reviews provides an optimal balance between narrow consensus documents and unfiltered primary literature.

2510.15808.tldr: Two new datasets are added to the body of empirically evaluated use-cases of AB-UPT, combining high-quality data generation with state-of-the-art neural surrogates, followed by extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations of the best AB-UPT model.

2510.15821.tldr: Chronos-2 is presented, a pretrained model capable of handling univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed forecasting tasks in a zero-shot manner and established as a general-purpose forecasting model that can be used in real-world forecasting pipelines.

2510.15830.tldr: It is demonstrated that SNOO achieves compute factor gains of 1.5 - 2.5$\times$ in a non-distributed setting up to a scale of 1e23 training FLOPs, with improvements that increase with model size.

2510.15850.tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid solver that leverages duality theory to efficiently bound the optimality gap of predictions, falling back to a classical solver for queries where optimality cannot be certified.

2510.15863.tldr: The findings show that separating a skill's goal from its execution is a crucial step toward developing autonomous agents that can learn and generalize across the open web continuously and provides a practical path toward building agents capable of continual learning in adaptive environments.

2312.01655.tldr: This work proposes Quantum Polar Metric Learning (QPMeL), a classical model to learn the parameters of the polar form of a qubit that outperforms classical networks with similar configurations and demonstrates that QPMeL outperforms classical networks with similar configurations.

2405.11344.tldr: The generated post embeddings outperform baseline models in zero-shot learning, demonstrating its potential for broader applicability and surpasses that of OpenAI's ADA-001 and ADA-002 embeddings on LinkedIn specific datasets and tasks.

2405.14024.tldr: This paper proposes to represent high dynamic range depth as two low dynamic range components of a Hilbert curve, and to train the full-precision DNN to directly predict the latter, and enables effective and accurate depth prediction with DNN weights and activations quantized to eight-bit precision.

2406.08606.tldr: This work introduces a generative paradigm-based end-to-end framework argTANL, which frames the argumentative structures into label-augmented text, called Augmented Natural Language (ANL) and jointly extracts both ACs and ARs from a given argumentative text.

2407.20999.tldr: MoFO is an extension of greedy block coordinate descent (BCD) methods: in each iteration, MoFO only updates the model parameters with the largest momentum magnitudes, while keeping all other parameters fixed, achieving similar fine-tuning performance to the default fine-tuning algorithm while effectively mitigating knowledge forgetting.

2408.01072.tldr: This survey provides a unified framework and classifies existing self-play algorithms within this framework and bridges the gap between the algorithms and their practical implications by illustrating the role of self-play in different non-cooperative scenarios.

2408.08821.tldr: This work proposes EasyRec, an effective approach that integrates text-based semantic understanding with collaborative signals that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models, particularly in text-based zero-shot recommendation.

2409.12468.tldr: FaviComp (Familarity-Aware Evidence Compression), a novel training-free evidence compression technique that makes retrieved evidence more familiar to the target model, while seamlessly integrating parametric knowledge from the model, is proposed.

2409.18219.tldr: This paper's proposed self-supervised approach trains a transformer via SSL to learn the embeddings of packet content, including payload, from vast amounts of unlabeled data by masking portions of packets, leading to a learned representation that generalizes to various downstream tasks.

2410.07163.tldr: A simple yet effective unlearning optimization framework, called SimNPO, is proposed, showing that `simplicity' in removing the reliance on a reference model (through the lens of simple preference optimization) benefits unlearning.

2410.17333.tldr: The findings indicate that LLMs exhibit ethnic and gender bias when functioning as travel planning assistants, underscores the need for bias mitigation strategies to improve the inclusivity and reliability of generative AI-driven travel planning assistance.

2411.14458.tldr: This work built Atlas that speeds up the training time using novel workload-aware temporal bandwidth sharing and other design choices and built BubbleTea that runs prefill-as-a-service (part of LM inference) during the bubbles thus improving the GPU utilization without any impact on training.

2502.10090.tldr: Manual2Skill is presented, a novel framework that enables robots to perform complex assembly tasks guided by high-level manual instructions that leverages a Vision-Language Model to extract structured information from instructional images and then uses this information to construct hierarchical assembly graphs.

2502.17598.tldr: This work investigates the spectral features of attention maps by interpreting them as adjacency matrices of graph structures by proposing the $\text{LapEigvals}$ method, which utilises the top-$k$ eigenvalues of the Laplacian matrix derived from the attention maps as an input to hallucination detection probes.

2503.06073.tldr: Experimental results show GEM significantly improves predictive performance, explainability, and grounding, making it more suitable for real-world clinical applications, and a clinically motivated benchmark designed to comprehensively assess the MLLM's capability in grounded ECG understanding is proposed.

2505.06936.tldr: A deep learning-based framework was developed and validated for the inverse design of multi-mode SIW filters with both closely spaced and widely separated resonances, demonstrating the capability to enable robust, accurate, and generalizable inverse design of complex microwave filters with minimal simulation cost.

2505.16967.tldr: LLMs are utilized as a simple, cost-effective approach to identify and relabel false negatives in training datasets to improve robust retrieval and reranker models.

2505.17010.tldr: It is confirmed that soft prefixes can lead to very effective prompts for trained and even untrained networks by manipulating activations in ways that are not achievable by hard tokens, adding an important mechanistic aspect beyond the conceptual Bayesian theory.

2505.18200.tldr: CrossRF is presented, a domain-invariant deep learning approach that addresses the problem of cross-channel RF fingerprinting for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) identification by using adversarial learning to train a more robust model that maintains consistent identification performance despite channel variations.

2505.18492.tldr: The Enumerate-Conjecture-Prove (ECP) framework is introduced, a modular neuro-symbolic method integrating LLM-based enumeration and pattern-driven conjecturing with formal theorem proving with formal verification in Lean, and ConstructiveBench, a dataset of 3,640 formal answer-construction problems from math competitions.

2505.23135.tldr: This paper introduces VERINA (Verifiable Code Generation Arena), a high-quality benchmark enabling a comprehensive and modular evaluation of code, specification, and proof generation as well as their compositions, and hopes it will catalyze progress in verifiable code generation by providing a rigorous and comprehensive benchmark.

2506.00643.tldr: Choice Funnel is proposed, a decoding strategy that combines token debiasing with adaptive thresholding to guide models toward complete and accurate selections that exposes fundamental limitations in current LLMs and introduces a new framework for diagnosing and improving multi-answer reasoning.

2506.04135.tldr: This work presents macOSWorld, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating GUI agents on macOS, and reveals a dramatic gap: proprietary computer-use agents lead at above 30% success rate, while open-source lightweight research models lag at below 5\%, highlighting the need for macOS domain adaptation.

2506.10343.tldr: This work proposes a scalable method for generating a high-quality CoT supervision dataset by leveraging the determinism of program execution and extracts verifiable, step-by-step reasoning traces from code execution and transforms them into a natural language CoT reasoning.

2506.17294.tldr: This survey introduces a unified framework that systematically organizes the AI-GGC landscape, and presents a novel taxonomy focused on three core commentator capabilities: Live Observation, Strategic Analysis, and Historical Recall.

2506.17960.tldr: GeNIE (Generalizable Navigation System for In-the-Wild Environments), a robust navigation framework designed for global deployment that integrates a generalizable traversability prediction model with a novel path fusion strategy that enhances planning stability in noisy and ambiguous settings, is introduced.

2506.23549.tldr: Coordination Transformers (\coot), a novel in-context coordination framework that uses recent interaction histories to rapidly adapt to unseen partners, is proposed, which achieves stable, rapid in-context adaptation and is consistently ranked the most effective collaborator in human evaluations.

2507.05391.tldr: This paper builds a framework where a local model uses simple natural language instructions to rewrite queries, only hiding details deemed sensitive by the user, before sending them to an external model, thus balancing privacy with performance.

2507.10990.tldr: ClusterEnv is introduced, a lightweight interface for distributed environment execution that preserves the familiar Gymnasium API and proposes Adaptive Policy Synchronization (APS), where workers request updates only when divergence from the central learner grows too large.

2508.08237.tldr: VGGSounder is introduced, a comprehensively re-annotated, multi-label test set that extends VGGSound and is specifically designed to evaluate audio-visual foundation models, revealing model limitations by analysing performance degradation when adding another input modality with the authors' new modality confusion metric.

2508.12535.tldr: CorrSteer is established, which selects features by correlating sample correctness with SAE activations from generated tokens at inference time to extract more relevant features, thereby reducing spurious correlations.

2508.19131.tldr: ZeST, a novel approach leveraging visual reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to create a traversability map in real-time without exposing robots to danger, provides safer navigation when compared to other state-of-the-art methods.

2508.19304.tldr: This paper argues that the certainty-scope conjecture's objective to furnish insights for engineering design and regulatory decision-making is limited by two fundamental factors: its dependence on incomputable constructs and its failure to capture the generality factors of AI, rendering it practically unimplementable and unverifiable.

2508.21148.tldr: A comprehensive, data-centric synthesis that reframes the development of Sci-LLMs as a co-evolution between models and their underlying data substrate, and outlines a paradigm shift toward closed-loop systems where autonomous agents based on Sci-LLMs actively experiment, validate, and contribute to a living, evolving knowledge base.

2509.11943.tldr: A neuro-symbolic multi-agent architecture where the belief states of individual agents are formally represented as Kripke models, which enables them to reason about known concepts of possibility and necessity using the formal language of modal logic.

2509.25835.tldr: Chain-in-Tree (CiT), a plug-in framework that decides when to branch during search rather than expanding at every step, is proposed, a plug-in framework that decides when to branch during search rather than expanding at every step.

2510.01600.tldr: The optimal fine-tuning strategy to use depends on whether the training dataset includes context labels and whether a grid search over the learning rates for the embedding and generator models is required.

2510.04303.tldr: This work introduces Audit the Whisper, a conference-grade research artifact that spans theory, benchmark design, detection, and reproducibility, and releases regeneration scripts, anonymized manifests, and documentation so that external auditors can reproduce every figure, satisfy double-blind requirements, and extend the framework with minimal effort.

2510.05909.tldr: DebateQD is introduced, a minimal Quality-Diversity evolutionary algorithm that evolves diverse debate strategies across different categories through tournament-style competitions where two LLMs debate while a third judges, providing the first controlled evidence that competitive pressure to persuade, rather than seek the truth collaboratively, fosters more transferable reasoning skills.

2510.10252.tldr: Audit-of-Understanding (AoU), a framework that constrains inference to validated premises through three phases: decomposing a query into candidate assumptions, auditing their support, and conditioning inference only on the validated subset, is proposed.

2510.12997.tldr: This work conducts extensive evaluations across various state-of-the-art open-source model families, including the Qwen3, GPT-OSS, and DeepSeek, revealing that LLMs' extremal-solving reasoning capabilities do not always align with those of current mathematical benchmarks such as AIME25 and MATH-500.

2510.13850.tldr: Surprisingly, across three challenging mathematical benchmarks, it is found that successful reasoning in LLMs is globally non-uniform: correct solutions are characterized by uneven swings in information density, in stark contrast to human communication patterns.

2510.14351.tldr: Beyond One World, a benchmark for character-grounded roleplay spanning 30 iconic heroes and 90 canon-specific versions, is introduced and Think-Act Matching, a metric that quantifies alignment between reasons and actions and serves as a proxy for model trustworthiness, is proposed.

2510.14400.tldr: MedTrust-Guided Iterative RAG is proposed, a framework that improves factual consistency and reduces hallucinations in medical QA, and introduces three innovations, citation-aware reasoning grounds generation in retrieved documents and uses Negative Knowledge Assertions when evidence is missing.

2510.15929.tldr: This work aims to analyze the performance difference of these models in this important natural language processing task within the context of finance and shows that large language models outperform classical models in the vast majority of cases.

2510.15930.tldr: The results show that the designed blocks enable adaptation of convolution layers to hardware constraints, and that the models accurately predict resource consumption, providing a useful tool for FPGA selection and optimized CNN deployment.

2510.15944.tldr: LS-OGD is introduced, a novel adaptive control framework for robust multimodal learning in the presence of concept drift that effectively isolates and mitigates the impact of severe modality-specific drift, thereby ensuring system resilience and fault tolerance.

2510.15945.tldr: This work introduces BEACON (Bayesian Efficient Adaptive Criterion for Optimal N-stopping), a principled adaptive sampling framework grounded in Sequential Search with Bayesian Learning, and establishes both theoretical optimality guarantees and practical tractability.

2510.15948.tldr: VisuoAlign embeds safety constrains into the reasoning process through visual-textual interactive prompts, employs Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to systematically construct diverse safety-critical prompt trajectories, and introduces prompt-based scaling to ensure real-time risk detection and compliant responses.

2510.15950.tldr: A novel pipeline that leverages keystroke dynamics as a non-invasive and scalable biomarker for remote PD screening and telemonitoring is proposed, demonstrating that hybrid convolutional-recurrent and transformer-based models achieve strong external validation performance.

2510.15959.tldr: A science-for-policy agenda to explore the potential of citiverses as experimentation spaces for regulatory learning, grounded in a consultation with a high-level panel of experts, identifies key research areas including scalability, real-time feedback, complexity modelling, cross-border collaboration, risk reduction, citizen participation, ethical considerations and the integration of emerging technologies.

2510.15961.tldr: Interpretability analyses demonstrate that LAMI reveals meaningful behavioral substructures and psychosocial pathways that align with established risk factors for substance use that align with established risk factors for substance use.

2510.15964.tldr: Under Shadowy Sparsity, a nuanced form of sparsity is introduced, termed Shadowy Sparsity, which is distinctive in fine-tuning and has not been adequately addressed for acceleration, and an efficient system to accelerate PEFT for LLMs is proposed, Long Exposure.

2510.15965.tldr: The Deadlock Attack is presented, a resource exhaustion method that hijacks an LRM's generative control flow by training a malicious adversarial embedding to induce perpetual reasoning loops to expose a critical and underexplored security vulnerability in LRMs from the perspective of reasoning.

2510.15966.tldr: This work proposes PISA, a pragmatic, psych-inspired unified memory system that addresses limitations of existing work by treating memory as a constructive and adaptive process, and introduces a trimodal adaptation mechanism that preserves coherent organization while supporting flexible memory updates.

2510.15967.tldr: Gains splits the model into an encoder and a classifier, empirically revealing features extracted by the encoder are sensitive to domain shifts while classifier parameters are sensitive to class increments, and develops fine-grained knowledge discovery and contribution-driven aggregation techniques to identify and incorporate new knowledge.

2510.15968.tldr: Self-Attention UNet Fourier Neural Operator (SAU-FNO) is introduced, a novel framework combining self-attention and U-Net with FNO to capture longrange dependencies and model local high-frequency features effectively in 3D IC thermal simulations.

2510.15970.tldr: This work proposes that both the richness of representation and the elimination of redundancy within training data critically influence learning outcomes, and employs persistent homology to extract topological features from data within a metric space, thereby offering a principled way to quantify diversity beyond entropy-based measures.

2510.15971.tldr: A hybrid deep learning model named GNN-GAT-LSTM that combines Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Graph Attention Networks (GATs) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks that provides an efficient and scalable system for detecting malicious URLs while demonstrating strong potential for real-world cybersecurity applications.

2510.15972.tldr: This paper investigates the application of QNLP models to the task of Natural Language Inference, comparing quantum, hybrid, and classical transformer-based models under a constrained few-shot setting and proposes a novel cluster-based architecture that improves generalization by tying gate parameters to learned word clusters rather than individual tokens.

2510.15973.tldr: This paper presents a systematic security assessment of four prominent Large Language Models against diverse adversarial attack vectors, and identifies critical transferability patterns where GCG and TAP attacks, though ineffective against their target model (Llama-2), achieve substantially higher success rates when transferred to other models.

2510.15974.tldr: This work provides a large language model with an environment interface for Tower of Hanoi problems, allowing it to make a move with a tool call, provide written justification, observe the resulting state space, and reprompt itself for the next move, and observes that access to an environment interface does not delay or eradicate performance collapse.

2510.15976.tldr: This paper introduces Learning to Watermark (LTW), a novel selective watermarking framework that leverages multi-objective optimization to effectively balance these competing goals and enhances text quality without compromising detectability.

2510.15978.tldr: This work proposes the DAWP as an innovative framework to enable AIWPs to operate in a complete observation space by initialization with an artificial intelligence data assimilation (AIDA) module, and introduces a spatiotemporal decoupling transformer with cross-regional boundary conditioning (CBC), learning the dynamics in observation space.

2510.15979.tldr: The Cog-Rethinker is proposed, a novel hierarchical metacognitive RL framework for LLM reasoning that improves sample utilization in a hierarchical metacognitive two-stage framework and demonstrates Cog-Rethinker's superior performance on various mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

2510.15980.tldr: Experiments on reasoning and planning benchmarks show that CLTs predict error-onset, reveal cognitive strategies, and enable load-guided interventions that improve reasoning efficiency by 15-30\% while maintaining accuracy.

2510.15981.tldr: This work introduces ProofFlow, a novel pipeline that treats structural fidelity as a primary objective and sets a new state-of-the-art for autoformalization, and introduces ProofScore, a new composite metric to evaluate syntactic correctness, semantic faithfulness, and structural fidelity.

2510.15983.tldr: The goal is to transform how motor performance data are modeled and shared across studies, making it standardized and machine-understandable.

2510.15990.tldr: This work proves theoretically that GRPO is a conservative reweighting scheme, bounded by the base model's distribution and thus unable to discover completely novel solutions, and provides a principled explanation for GRPO's boundaries.

2510.15992.tldr: Experiments show that Stratos produces a student model that achieves four times the accuracy of its GPT-4o teacher baseline on a rare, domain-specific Mahjong reasoning task with reverse synthetic data and knowledge injection, highlighting its promise for vertical-domain LLM deployment.

2510.15994.tldr: MSB (MCP Security Benchmark), the first end-to-end evaluation suite that systematically measures how well LLM agents resist MCP-specific attacks throughout the full tool-use pipeline: task planning, tool invocation, and response handling, is presented.

2510.15996.tldr: The use of KS Test and KS distance could be an important step forward for gauging the performance degradation of an AI agent in real time and this, in turn, could help the AI agent to cope with the distribution shift in a more informed manner.

2510.15998.tldr: This paper analyzes the training dynamics of PINNs optimized with ANaGRAM, a natural-gradient-inspired approach employing singular value decomposition with cutoff regularization and proposes a multi-cutoff adaptation strategy that further enhances ANaGRAM's performance.

2510.16001.tldr: This paper defines a non-overlap-based inconsistency measure for permutations and develops an order-sensitive conflict measure for RPSs, which reformulates the conflict in RPSs as a graded, order-dependent notion rather than a simple dichotomy of conflict versus non-conflict.

2510.16007.tldr: A layer-aware online estimator that requires only loss-to-output gradients, which avoids parameter-level and full-network gradients while preserving ranking fidelity and making dynamic data curation efficient and scalable in practice.

2510.16017.tldr: A comprehensive pipeline that leverages street CCTV streams for multi defect detection and segmentation using the YOLO family of object detectors and passes the detections to a vision language model (VLM) for scene aware summarization is proposed.

2510.16024.tldr: This work presents the first decentralized, fully on-chain learning framework that performs gas-prohibitive computation on Layer-2 to reduce cost, propagates verified model updates to Layer-1, and enables gas-bounded, low-latency inference inside smart contracts.

2510.16033.tldr: Experiments conducted on three public benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms other prominent existing approaches, confirming the superiority of the ISGFAN framework.

2510.16035.tldr: This paper proposes the first adversarial multi-agent Reinforcement learning framework for social Bot control attacks (RoBCtrl) targeting GNN-based social bot detectors, and uses a diffusion model to generate high-fidelity bot accounts by reconstructing existing account data with minor modifications, thereby evading detection on social platforms.

2510.16037.tldr: This study investigates the privacy risks associated with diffusion-based synthetic tabular data generation methods, focusing on their susceptibility to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs), by developing query-based MIAs based on the step-wise error comparison method.

2510.16039.tldr: Grid-like Code Quantization (GCQ), a brain-inspired method for compressing observation-action sequences into discrete representations using grid-like patterns in attractor dynamics, offers both a computational tool for efficient sequence modeling and a theoretical perspective on the formation of grid-like codes in neural systems.

2510.16040.tldr: Kelle, a software-hardware co-design solution optimized for deploying LLMs on eDRAM-based edge systems, is proposed, a software-hardware co-design solution optimized for deploying LLMs on eDRAM-based edge systems with a 3.9 × speedup and 4.5 × energy savings compared to existing baseline solutions.

2510.16042.tldr: This study offers both a critique of and a framework for understanding Labour’s subjugation within the Capital system, arguing that Capital functions as an artificially alive system animated by the living Labour it consumes, and whether life can sustain itself without the infrastructures of Capital in a future of increasing automation.

2510.16045.tldr: AMS-Quant incorporates two novel techniques to put it into effect: Mantissa-bit Sharing, which groups k quantized weights and lets them share the least significant mantissa bit, allowing it to further approach the minimum quantization bit-width without accuracy loss, and Adaptive Searching, which employs an offline optimization strategy to minimize the accuracy degradation introduced by sharing.

2510.16047.tldr: This thesis combines offline constraint-programming (CP) optimisation with online temporal-network execution to create schedules that remain feasible under worst-case uncertainty, and demonstrates how temporal-network reasoning can bridge the gap between proactive buffering and dynamic robustness.

2510.16051.tldr: GUIRILLA is introduced, a scalable data crawling framework for automated exploration of desktop GUIs that systematically collects realistic interaction traces and accessibility metadata intended to support the training, evaluation, and stabilization of downstream foundation models and GUI agents.

2510.16053.tldr: FUSE-Traffic is introduced, a framework which synergizes the dynamic event querying and understanding prowess of LLMs with the spatio-temporal modeling capabilities of GNNs and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models, especially under high-impact event conditions.

2510.16056.tldr: It is argued that fairness in this domain extends beyond parity of outcomes to encompass moral representation, fidelity to the patient's values, relationships, and worldview.

2510.16057.tldr: The utility of integrating complementary modalities and using output-level consensus to improve the trustworthiness and clinical utility of AI-assisted radiological diagnosis is highlighted, offering a practical path to reduce diagnostic errors with minimal computational overhead.

2510.16060.tldr: It is found that time series foundation models are consistently better calibrated than baseline models and tend not to be either systematically over- or under-confident, in contrast to the overconfidence often seen in other deep learning models.

2510.16063.tldr: A hierarchical graph neural network for substation-level voltage estimation that exploits both electrical topology and physical features, while remaining robust to the low observability levels common to real-world distribution networks is presented.

2510.16064.tldr: A residual learning paradigm that uses fast DC optimal power flow solutions as a baseline, and learns only the nonlinear corrections required to provide the full AC-OPF solution, enabling near real-time operational decision making.

2510.16065.tldr: This work proposes Federated Learning with Programmed Update and Reduced INformation (FedPURIN), a novel framework that strategically identifies critical parameters for transmission through an integer programming formulation, establishing a new paradigm for communication-efficient PFL, particularly advantageous for edge intelligence systems operating with heterogeneous data sources.

2510.16068.tldr: The Interdisciplinary Design Project Planner is presented, a GPT-based planning assistant grounded in Design Innovation principles, alignment with Singapore secondary school’s syllabuses, and 21st-century competencies, and evidence that AI can function as a pedagogical planning partner is presented.

2510.16072.tldr: The Intersectional Fairness Evaluation Framework (IFEF) is introduced, which combines quantitative fairness metrics with interpretability tools to systematically identify bias patterns in model predictions and proposes Bias-Weighted Augmentation (BWA), a novel data augmentation strategy that adapts transformation intensities based on subgroup distribution statistics.
