2510.16076.tldr: A new learning framework, called Bias-adaptive Preference distillation Learning (BPL), is introduced to gradually uncover user preferences with dual distillation strategies designed to drive high performance in both factual and counterfactual test environments.

2510.16077.tldr: ConEC-LoRA is developed from consolidations between task-shared LORA to extract common knowledge and task-specific LORA to embrace domain-specific knowledge and integrates the concept of a stochastic classifier whose parameters are sampled from a distribution, thus enhancing the likelihood of correct classifications.

2510.16078.tldr: Overall, short binary templates, fixed-payload decision-only APDUs, and constant-time matching satisfy ISO/IEC transport constraints with wide timing margin and align with ISO/IEC 24745 privacy goals.

2510.16079.tldr: This work introduces EvolveR, a framework designed to enable agent to self-improve through a complete, closed-loop experience lifecycle, presenting a comprehensive blueprint for agents that learn not only from external data but also from the consequences of their own actions, paving the way for more autonomous and continuously improving systems.

2510.16080.tldr: TriAgent is introduced, a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent framework that couples automated biomarker discovery with deep research for literature-grounded validation and novelty assessment and outperformed state-of-the-art LLM-based agentic frameworks in biomarker justification and literature-grounded novelty assessment.

2510.16081.tldr: SARHAchat is designed as a reliable, user-centered system integrating medical expertise with empathetic communication to enhance SRH care delivery and demonstrates SARHAchat's ability to provide accurate and contextually appropriate contraceptive counseling while maintaining a natural conversational flow.

2510.16083.tldr: This work introduces the concept of password reuse relations -- defined as the likelihood of users reusing passwords between websites -- and represents them as edges in a website graph using graph neural networks (GNNs) and demonstrates that the predicted results can be used to quantify password reuse likelihood as actionable risk scores.

2510.16085.tldr: This paper proposes MoPHES, a framework that integrates mental state evaluation, conversational support, and professional treatment recommendations, and develops an agent developed under this framework that uses two fine-tuned MiniCPM4-0.5B LLMs.

2510.16089.tldr: STABLE is presented, a gated continual self editing framework that constrains forgetting during sequential updates using parameter efficient fine tuning via Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA; see arXiv:2106.09685).

2510.16091.tldr: This study quantifies how prompting strategies interact with large language models (LLMs) to automate the screening stage of systematic literature reviews (SLRs) and provides a comparative benchmark and practical guidance for task-adaptive LLM deployment.

2510.16092.tldr: This work systematically evaluates various compressor models and training approaches across different model sizes, architectures, many-shot sequence lengths, and compression ratios, and proposes MemCom, a layer-wise compression method that outperforms strong baselines across all compression ratios on multiple classification tasks with large label sets.

2510.16095.tldr: A “dual principles” preliminary framework for generating trustworthy CoTs at scale in assisted reproductive technology is proposed and underscores the essential role of human expertise in evaluating generated clinical data.

2510.16097.tldr: A decision support system that uses a pre-trained AI agent to narrow down the set of actions a human can take to a subset, and then asks the human to take an action from this action set, and introduces a bandit algorithm that leverages the smoothness properties of the action sets provided by the system to efficiently optimize the level of human agency.

2510.16134.tldr: The Aria Gen 2 Pilot Dataset (A2PD) is an egocentric multimodal open dataset captured using the state-of-the-art Aria Gen 2 glasses, illustrating the device's ability to perceive the wearer, the surrounding environment, and interactions between the wearer and the environment, while maintaining robust performance across diverse users and conditions.

2510.16136.tldr: This work evaluates appearance transfer quality with a GPT-based system objectively ranking outputs, ensuring robust and human-like assessment, and proposes a principled approach inspired by universal guidance.

2510.16144.tldr: This study highlights multi- agent architectures as a credible foundation for trustworthy AI- driven autonomy in next-generation RANs by replacing tightly- coupled centralized RIC-based workflows with distributed agents, which achieves autonomy, resilience, explainability, and system-wide safety.

2510.16152.tldr: The findings show that the approach independently recovers much of the journal's editorially embedded structure without prior knowledge of its existing dual-classification schema, offering a powerful tool for detecting potential thematic trends and providing a high-level overview of scientific progress.

2510.16156.tldr: AsyncVoice Agent is presented, a system whose asynchronous architecture decouples a streaming LLM backend from a conversational voice frontend that allows narration and inference to run in parallel, empowering users to interrupt, query, and steer the model's reasoning process at any time.

2510.16187.tldr: This work empirically demonstrates that the proposed algorithm, Generalized Policy improvement for Ad hoc Teaming (GPAT), successfully enables zero-shot transfer to new teams in three simulated environments: cooperative foraging, predator-prey, and Overcooked.

2510.16196.tldr: PRISM is proposed, a model that Projects fMRI sIgnals into a Structured text space as an interMediate representation for visual stimuli reconstruction that outperforms existing methods and highlights the importance of using structured text as the intermediate space to bridge fMRI signals and image reconstruction.

2510.16233.tldr: Using methods from explainable AI highlights the influence of factors such as policy wording and metadata including political party and country representation, which underscore the potential of ML tools in supporting climate policy analysis and decision-making.

2510.16234.tldr: This work introduces ScholarEval, a retrieval augmented evaluation framework that assesses research ideas based on two fundamental criteria: soundness - the empirical validity of proposed methods based on existing literature, and contribution - the degree of advancement made by the idea across different dimensions relative to prior research.

2510.16253.tldr: A continuous-depth formulation of the Evoformer is proposed, replacing its 48 discrete blocks with a Neural ODE parameterization that preserves its core attention-based operations and produces structurally plausible predictions and reliably captures certain secondary structure elements, though it does not fully replicate the accuracy of the original architecture.

2510.16255.tldr: This work introduces the concept of a fine-tuning auditing agent and shows it can detect harmful fine-tuning prior to model deployment and is able to detect covert cipher attacks that evade safety evaluations and content moderation of the dataset.

2510.16259.tldr: This paper identifies and systematically analyzes a critical vulnerability in large reasoning models, reasoning distraction, and proposes a training-based defense that combines Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reinforcement Learning on synthetic adversarial data, improving robustness by over 50 points on challenging distractor attacks.

2510.16273.tldr: Models incorporating MuseTok outperform previous representation learning baselines in semantic understanding while maintaining comparable performance in content generation, and qualitative analyses on MuseTok codes reveal that MuseTok effectively captures underlying musical concepts from large music collections.

2510.16276.tldr: This work decomposes end-to-end latency into two primary components: LLM API latency and web environment latency, and proposes SpecCache, a caching framework augmented with speculative execution that can reduce web environment overhead.

2510.16289.tldr: An analysis of hyperedge disentanglement from a category-theoretical perspective and a novel criterion for disentanglement derived from the naturality condition are presented and experimentally showed the potential of the proposed criterion by successfully capturing functional relations of genes in genetic pathways.

2510.16293.tldr: This article introduces how artificial intelligence (AI) agents based on large language models can help researchers acquire background knowledge in chemical or data science and accelerate various aspects of the discovery process.

2510.16302.tldr: A novel dual-track KG verification and reasoning framework DTKG is proposed, inspired by the Dual Process Theory in cognitive science, which comprises two main stages: the Classification Stage and the Branch Processing Stage.

2510.16310.tldr: A novel deep learning-based approach is introduced, aimed at an improved multi-class classification, discerning various subtypes of lung cancer from CT images.

2510.16321.tldr: This work proposes a time-embedded algorithm unrolling scheme for inverse problems, introducing a novel perspective on the iteration-dependent proximal operation in vector AMP and the subsequent Onsager correction in the context of algorithm unrolling, framing them as a time-embedded neural network.

2510.16340.tldr: These findings indicate that RL-trained models not only demonstrate greater awareness of their learned behaviors and stronger generalizability to novel, structurally similar tasks than SFT models but also often exhibit weak alignment between their reasoning traces and final outputs, an effect most pronounced in GRPO-trained models.

2510.16342.tldr: This framework introduces a novel two-stage evaluation mechanism that automatically discovers optimal anchors for precise erasure while identifying critical boundary anchors to preserve related concepts and defines Sibling Exclusive Concepts as a superior class of anchors.

2510.16344.tldr: This paper treats connections as explicit, primary entities in assembly representation, directly encoding connector types, specifications, and locations for every assembly step, and presents Manual2Skill++, a vision-language framework that automatically extracts structured connection information from assembly manuals.

2510.16363.tldr: This study jointly formulates the key tasks of AM in an end-to-end fashion using Autoregressive Argumentative Structure Prediction (AASP) framework, which is based on the autoregressive structure prediction framework that has given good performance for several NLP tasks.

2510.16368.tldr: This framework explains how users with inconsistent preferences can align an engagement-driven algorithm with their interests in a Stackelberg equilibrium, highlighting both the challenges and potential remedies for achieving alignment.

2510.16371.tldr: A dataset of 3,000 phacoemulsification cataract surgery videos acquired at two surgical centers from surgeons with varying expertise helps facilitate the development of generalizable multi-task models for surgical workflow analysis, scene understanding, and competency-based training research.

2510.16373.tldr: A cost-efficient yet powerful approach to improve MH assessment capabilities of an LLM, without relying on any computationally intensive techniques, and highlights the untapped potential of steering mechanisms as computationally efficient tools for LLMs'MH domain adaptation.

2510.16374.tldr: Initial findings suggest upfront monitoring produces higher-quality initial solutions that reduce refinement needs, though evaluation beyond arithmetic reasoning is needed to establish generalisability.

2510.16376.tldr: This paper proposes a novel Feedback-Based CP (Fb-CP) framework for shrinking-horizon TO with a joint risk constraint over the entire mission time and develops a decision-focused iterative risk allocation algorithm with theoretical convergence analysis for allocating the posterior allowable risk which closely aligns with Fb-CP.

2510.16380.tldr: This work presents MoReBench: 1,000 moral scenarios, each paired with a set of rubric criteria that experts consider essential to include (or avoid) when reasoning about the scenarios, to advance process-focused reasoning evaluation towards safer and more transparent AI.

2510.16381.tldr: This work introduces a generic neuro-symbolic approach to Autonomous Trustworthy Agents, which significantly outperforms even larger models, while exhibiting perfect determinism, enhanced stability against input perturbations, and inherent immunity to prompt injection attacks.

2510.16382.tldr: Through both theoretical and empirical evaluations, it is demonstrated that HSCM outperforms existing domain generalization models, providing a more principled method for capturing causal relationships and improving model robustness.

2510.16411.tldr: SymphonySMoE is a novel family of SMoE that introduces a social graph to model interactions among experts that enhances the token routing process, addressing the robustness challenges that are inherent in conventional SMoE designs.

2510.16448.tldr: Input Domain Aware MoE is proposed, a novel routing framework that leverages a probabilistic mixture model to better partition the input space and enables experts to develop clear specialization boundaries while achieving balanced utilization.

2510.16470.tldr: This work introduces a declarative approach to handling data source heterogeneity and demonstrates that it copes with data source heterogeneity significantly better than state-of-the-art LLM-based agentic or imperative code generation systems.

2510.16476.tldr: NP-ENGINE is proposed, the first comprehensive framework for training and evaluating LLMs on NP-hard problems, and RLVR training on NP-ENGINE-DATA enables strong out-of-domain (OOD) generalization to reasoning tasks, as well as non-reasoning tasks such as instruction following.

2510.16511.tldr: OracleAD is introduced, a simple and interpretable unsupervised framework for multivariate time series anomaly detection that achieves state-of-the-art results across multiple real-world datasets and evaluation protocols, while remaining interpretable through SLS.

2510.16514.tldr: This work proposes a method for image categorization and retrieval that leverages graphs and a graph attention network (GAT)-based autoencoder, and executes the categorization and retrieval process via the representative models the authors construct for the images and image categories.

2510.16518.tldr: DIV-Nav is presented, a real-time navigation system that efficiently addresses the problem of zero-shot object navigation through a series of relaxations, and investigates how to adapt the frontier exploration objectives of online semantic mapping to such spatial search queries to more effectively guide the search process.

2510.16533.tldr: Using Doug, a typed computer language in which all typed programs may be proved to halt in polynomial time, encoded in a vector-symbolic architecture (VSA), this work hopes to describe a form of learning of skilled behaviour that follows a human-like pace of skill acquisition.

2510.16536.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the integration of multimodal inputs, few-label supervision, and CoT reasoning improves robustness and generalizability across diverse patient profiles, underscoring the promise of LLM-based few-label multimodal modeling for advancing personalized cardiovascular care.

2510.16541.tldr: A Region-aware Dynamic Aggregation and Excitation framework (GaitRDAE) that automatically searches for motion regions, assigns adaptive temporal scales and applies corresponding attention, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on several benchmark datasets.

2510.16547.tldr: How machine learning, large language models and XAI can jointly contribute to building trust and understanding in using AI to investigate human behavior is demonstrated, with significant ramifications for academics and professionals working to quantify and comprehend subjective well-being.

2510.16552.tldr: This work provides a robust method for integrating historical experiences into the LLM RL loop, creating more effective and data-efficient learning agents and enables 7B and 14B models to significantly outperform strong baselines trained with GRPO in test accuracy.

2510.16555.tldr: The proposed Urban-R1, a reinforcement learning-based post-training framework that aligns MLLMs with the objectives of UGI, effectively mitigates geo-bias and improves cross-region generalization, outperforming both SFT-trained and closed-source models.

2510.16558.tldr: This paper decomposes MCP ecosystem into three core components: hosts, registries, and servers, and decomposes the interactions and trust relationships among them, and finds a wide range of vulnerabilities that enable attackers to hijack servers, due to the lack of a vetted server submission process in registries.

2510.16573.tldr: This research advances efforts in contesting misinformation and academic misconduct in Urdu-speaking communities and contributes to the broader development of NLP tools for low resource languages.

2303.04238.tldr: The BBNP algorithm (Black-Box Naturalistic Patch): a direct, black-box, naturalistic, gradient-free method that uses the learned image manifold of a pretrained, generative adversarial network to generate naturalistic adversarial patches for object detectors.

2310.04055.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that RedJasper consistently delivers performance comparable to benign cases, highlighting its effectiveness in identifying potential attacks and eliminating malicious models with high accuracy.

2402.18012.tldr: This work proposes to perform optimization within the data manifold using diffusion models to constrain the optimization process to the data manifold, and reformulate the original optimization problem as a sampling problem from the product of the Boltzmann distribution defined by the objective function and the data distribution learned by the diffusion model.

2406.07008.tldr: This paper tackles training-free appearance transfer, which produces an image with the structure of a target image from the appearance of a reference image, and proposes explicitly rearranging the features according to the dense semantic correspondences.

2410.02805.tldr: An uncertainty-aware stacked neural network is proposed, which extends conventional uncertainty quantification by learning when predictions should be trusted, offering a more trustworthy and efficient decision-support system for high-stakes domains.

2410.07170.tldr: Explained Variance Adaptation (EVA) is introduced, an initialization scheme that uses the directions capturing the most activation variance, provably maximizing the expected gradient signal and accelerating fine-tuning to establish a new Pareto frontier compared to existing LoRA initialization schemes in both accuracy and efficiency.

2410.08949.tldr: A novel perspective on basic information representation in quantum AI models is introduced, proposing that belief functions are better suited than Bayesian approaches for handling uncertainty in quantum circuits.

2410.10807.tldr: The proposed HardNet is the first method that enables efficient and differentiable enforcement of more than one input-dependent inequality constraint, and allows unconstrained optimization of the network parameters using standard algorithms by appending a differentiable closed-form enforcement layer to the network's output.

2411.00916.tldr: A novel multi-modal learning framework that integrates clinical and imaging data to improve diagnostic accuracy and model interpretability and promotes precise and interpretable predictions, enhancing transparency and building trust in AI-driven diagnoses for clinical integration is presented.

2411.10213.tldr: This paper examines six repair systems on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark for automated bug fixing and concludes that further optimization is needed in both the LLM capability itself and the design of Agentic flow to improve the effectiveness of the Agent in bug fixing.

2411.12164.tldr: This work introduces UrbanDiT, a foundation model for open-world urban spatio-temporal learning that successfully scales up diffusion transformers in this field and sets up a new benchmark for foundation models in the urban spatio-temporal domain.

2411.15594.tldr: This paper provides a comprehensive survey of LLM-as-a-Judge, addressing the core question: How can reliable LLM-as-a-Judge systems be built?

2411.17041.tldr: A novel gradient-free and training-free framework for aligning generated videos with text prompts that significantly improves text-to-video alignment and enhances the overall video quality, and supports the flexible ensembling of multiple reward models to synergistically enhance alignment without significant computational overhead.

2412.02508.tldr: This work introduces an end-to-end text-to-expression model that explicitly focuses on emotional dynamics and learns expressive facial variations in a continuous latent space and generates expressions that are diverse, fluid, and emotionally coherent.

2412.06412.tldr: The StarWhisper Telescope system is presented, an AI agent to control amateur telescope array to make astronomical observations of cosmic transients and the agent is a blueprint for control systems of future telescope arrays where AI-based autonomy will be critical.

2501.01284.tldr: This work pioneers a new path for bias mitigation, shifting the focus from treating symptoms (political labels) to addressing the cause: the emotional encoding of partisan bias in language.

2502.03724.tldr: ActLumos is proposed, a teacher-student framework that attains single-stream inference while retaining multi-stream level accuracy, and two-view spatio-temporal SSL surpasses spatial-only or temporal-only variants without increasing inference cost.

2502.08365.tldr: A scalable, decentralized, trust-region policy search algorithm is presented to address the problem of unsupervised multi-agent reinforcement learning via task-agnostic exploration in challenging domains, showing that optimizing for a specific objective, namely mixture entropy, provides an excellent trade-off between tractability and performances.

2502.11018.tldr: GRIFFIN, a novel framework that incorporates a token-alignable training strategy and a token-alignable draft model to mitigate misalignment, is proposed, outperforming current speculative decoding state-of-the-art methods.

2502.11155.tldr: This work provides the first systematic integration of uncertainty quantification into LLM search paradigms, enhancing robustness and significantly mitigates verifier failure and boosts solution coverage, especially on OOD problems.

2502.12985.tldr: PartSDF is proposed, a supervised implicit representation framework that explicitly models composite shapes with independent, controllable parts while maintaining shape consistency, and shown to outperforms both supervised and unsupervised baselines in reconstruction and generation tasks.

2502.13681.tldr: Repo2Run is introduced, the first LLM-based agent aiming at automating the building of executable test environments for any repositories at scale, and achieves an 86.0% success rate, outperforming SWE-agent by 77.0%.

2502.14293.tldr: GADT3 is presented, a novel test-time training framework for cross-domain GAD that combines supervised and self-supervised learning during training while adapting to a new domain during test time using only self-supervised learning by leveraging a homophily-based affinity score that captures domain-invariant properties of anomalies.

2502.14807.tldr: In extensive benchmarking across a range of key fetal ultrasound applications, including classification, gestational age estimation, congenital heart defect detection, and fetal structure segmentation, FetalCLIP outperformed all baselines while demonstrating remarkable generalizability and strong performance even with limited labeled data.

2502.17403.tldr: This work converts EHR data into plain text by replacing medical codes with natural-language descriptions, enabling general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) to produce high-dimensional embeddings for downstream prediction tasks without access to private medical training data.

2502.18632.tldr: An automated, LLM-based pipeline for KC generation and tagging for open-ended programming problems and an LLM-based knowledge tracing (KT) framework to leverage these LLM-generated KCs, which are referred to as KCGen-KT are presented.

2502.20548.tldr: This work introduces Q\sharp, a value-based algorithm for KL-regularized RL that guides the reference policy using the optimal regularized Q function using distributional RL on an aggregated online dataset, offering both improved performance and theoretical guarantees.

2503.05730.tldr: This work proposes a conditional diffusion model for adversary behavior modeling, leveraging its strong distribution-fitting capabilities and introduces a mixed strategy of mixed strategies and a twisted Sequential Monte Carlo sampler for accurate sampling.

2503.06211.tldr: It is argued that this limitation can be addressed through late fusion and fission, with a fission process that accesses both high- and low-level features for speech generation, and the models implementing these principles, SmolTolk, rival or surpass state-of-the-art TSLMs trained with orders of magnitude more compute.

2503.07076.tldr: NextFrequency Image Generation (NFIG) is a novel framework that decomposes the image generation process into multiple frequency-guided stages that improves the quality of generated images but crucially reduces inference cost by efficiently establishing global structure early on.

2503.09101.tldr: By modifying attraction, the analysis makes UMAP and similar embedding methods more interpretable, more robust, and more accurate and improves the consistency of cluster formation under random initialization.

2503.13477.tldr: A deep learning framework and an annotation methodology for the automatic detection of periodontal bone loss landmarks, associated conditions, and staging are proposed and the proposed framework demonstrates the feasibility of clinically interpretable periodontal bone loss assessment.

2504.01005.tldr: This work evaluates GenRM against SC under a fixed inference budget, and derives inference scaling laws for the GenRM paradigm, revealing that compute-optimal inference favors scaling solution generation more aggressively than scaling the number of verifications.

2504.06492.tldr: This article introduces an unweighted graph poisoning attack that leverages meta-learning with weighted scheme strategies to degrade the link prediction performance of GNNs and demonstrates that this approach significantly reduces link prediction performance and consistently outperforms other state-of-the-art baselines.

2504.11558.tldr: EBD is a novel learning framework for neural networks that addresses credit assignment by directly broadcasting output errors to individual layers, circumventing weight transport of backpropagation and establishing a principled foundation for error broadcasting.

2504.12325.tldr: LLMTaxo is introduced, a novel framework leveraging large language models for the automated construction of taxonomies of factual claims from social media by generating topics at multiple levels of granularity that significantly reduces redundancy and improves information accessibility.

2504.13472.tldr: CodeVisionary is proposed, the first agent-based evaluation framework for complex code generation and achieves the best performance among three baselines for evaluating complex code generation, outperforming the best baseline with average improvements in Pearson, Spearman, and Kendall-Tau coefficients.

2504.14345.tldr: This study proposes and validates a systematic frame- work that translates return forecasts and predictive uncertainty from Large Language Models (LLMs) into the core inputs for the Black-Litterman model: investor views and their confidence.

2505.06493.tldr: This work introduces system prompt poisoning, a new attack vector against LLMs that, unlike traditional user prompt injection, poisons system prompts hence persistently impacts all subsequent user interactions and model responses.

2505.06535.tldr: Diffusion-guided Active Target Discovery is introduced, a novel method that leverages diffusion dynamics for active target discovery and offers interpretability, unlike existing black--box policies that require extensive supervised training.

2505.12575.tldr: Experimental results across multiple LLMs reveal surprising capabilities in handling research mathematics compared to competition problems, suggesting current models may already serve as valuable assistants for working mathematicians despite limitations on highly challenging problems.

2505.12680.tldr: Ineq-Comp is introduced, a benchmark built from elementary inequalities through systematic transformations, including variable duplication, algebraic rewriting, and multi-step composition, which finds that most provers -- including Goedel, STP, and Kimina-7B -- struggle significantly.

2505.12814.tldr: PsyMem is proposed, a novel framework integrating fine-grained psychological attributes and explicit memory control for role-playing, achieving the best performance in human-likeness and character fidelity in role-playing.

2505.13122.tldr: A formal framework for majority-minority learning tasks is developed, showing how standard training can favor majority groups and produce stereotypical predictors that neglect minority-specific features.

2505.13636.tldr: PEG is introduced, a training-free, game-theoretic framework for aligning LLMs through a peer elicitation mechanism involving a generator and multiple discriminators instantiated from distinct base models that proves last-iterate convergence to a truthful Nash equilibrium.

2505.13946.tldr: Empirical validation of multiple MLLMs on open-ended and closed-form question answering and object hallucination detection tasks demonstrates that Vittle consistently improves the MLLM's robustness under shifts by pursuing the learning of a minimal sufficient representation.

2505.17451.tldr: This paper presents CLIMB, a comprehensive benchmark for class-imbalanced learning on tabular data and provides practical insights on method accuracy and efficiency, highlighting the limitations of naive rebalancing, the effectiveness of ensembles, and the importance of data quality.

2505.17455.tldr: This work establishes a proactive safety benchmark, systematic evidence of model limitations, and critical directions for developing reliable protective AI for safer AI assistants that actively prevent harm rather than merely respond to requests.

2505.18601.tldr: Flex-Judge is proposed, a reasoning-guided multimodal judge model that leverages minimal textual reasoning data to robustly generalize across multiple modalities and evaluation formats, and highlights reasoning-based text supervision as a powerful, cost-effective alternative to traditional annotation-intensive approaches, substantially advancing scalable multimodal model-as-a-judge.

2505.19504.tldr: The experiments show that, while preserving the performance of the teacher model, student models distilled from the defensively generated outputs demonstrate catastrophically reduced performance, demonstrating DOGe as a practical safeguard against KD-based model imitation.

2505.19850.tldr: A method for directed sparse-reward goal-conditioned very long-horizon RL (DISCOVER), which selects exploratory goals in the direction of the target task, and finds that the directed goal selection of DISCOVER solves exploration problems that are beyond the reach of prior state-of-the-art exploration methods in RL.

2505.21077.tldr: Neural Block Linearization (NBL), a novel framework for accelerating transformer model inference by replacing self-attention layers with linear approximations derived from Linear Minimum Mean Squared Error estimators, is introduced.

2505.24760.tldr: The experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of RG in both evaluating and reinforcement learning of reasoning models, and its key innovation is the ability to generate virtually infinite training data with adjustable complexity, unlike most previous reasoning datasets, which are typically fixed.

2506.00783.tldr: Knowledge Graph-constrained Trajectory Reasoning Attribution and Chain Explanation Supervision (KG-TRACES), a novel framework that enhances the reasoning ability of LLMs through explicit supervision over reasoning paths and processes, and shows its transferability to specialized domains such as medicine.

2506.00885.tldr: This paper introduces CoVoMix2, a fully non-autoregressive framework for zero-shot multi-talker dialogue generation that directly predicts mel-spectrograms from multi-stream transcriptions using a flow-matching-based generative model, eliminating the reliance on intermediate token representations.

2506.01622.tldr: It is shown that any agent capable of generalizing to multi-step goal-directed tasks must have learned a predictive model of its environment, and that increasing the agents performance or the complexity of the goals it can achieve requires learning increasingly accurate world models.

2506.10351.tldr: A novel wavelet-based approach for physiological signal analysis is presented, aiming to capture multi-scale time-frequency features in various physiological signals, and a unified multi-modal framework is constructed by integrating pretrained EEG model.

2506.15707.tldr: DORA is proposed, a provably optimal method that mitigates this bias by decoupling direction quality from candidate count and allocating resources at the direction level and consistently outperforms strong baselines with comparable computational cost, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy.

2506.20413.tldr: P4 (Personalized, Private, Peer-to-Peer) -- a method designed to deliver personalized models for resource-constrained IoT devices while ensuring differential privacy and robustness against poisoning attacks and maintains robustness with up to 30% malicious clients.

2506.20977.tldr: A two-pass face aging framework, named Cradle2Cane, based on few-step text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models that outperforms existing face aging methods in age accuracy and identity consistency.

2507.00432.tldr: The results suggest a need to rethink standard post-training recipes, particularly the reliance on SFT-distilled data for advancing reasoning models, while reinforcement learning (RL) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) models often forget general capabilities.

2507.05011.tldr: This first comprehensive comparison of IL versus RL for surgical action planning on CholecT50 shows that distribution matching on expert-annotated test sets systematically favors IL over potentially valid RL policies that differ from training demonstrations, and provides crucial insights for surgical AI development.

2507.09966.tldr: This paper proposes a three-tier fusion architecture that achieves precise brain tumor segmentation through Transformer-based cross-modal feature fusion through multi-teacher collaborative distillation, integrating three expert teachers.

2507.10435.tldr: This work introduces the concept of thinking in substructures to efficiently extract complex composite patterns, and demonstrates that decoder-only Transformers can successfully extract substructures from attributed graphs, such as molecular graphs.

2507.15897.tldr: This paper proposes Rectified Discrete Flow (ReDi), a novel iterative method that reduces the underlying factorization error (measured as Conditional TC) by rectifying the coupling between source and target distributions, and theoretically proves that each ReDi step guarantees a monotonic decreasing Conditional TC, ensuring its convergence.

2507.18229.tldr: A calibrated Mean-Field Reinforcement Learning framework is proposed that embeds a representative agent in a fixed macroeconomic field and adjusts the cost function to reflect economic opportunity costs and provides a tractable and theoretically sound methodology for modeling learning agents in economic systems within the broader domain of computational social science.

2507.20408.tldr: This work proposes a multistage hybrid CNN-Transformer framework that combines CNN-extracted features with an attention-based architecture to classify pediatric respiratory diseases using scalogram images from both full recordings and individual breath events and offers a promising solution for scalable pediatric respiratory disease diagnosis, especially in resource-limited settings.

2507.22904.tldr: SketchMind is presented, a cognitively grounded, multi-agent framework for evaluating and improving student-drawn scientific sketches that comprises modular agents responsible for rubric parsing, sketch perception, cognitive alignment, and iterative feedback with sketch modification, enabling personalized and transparent evaluation.

2508.00222.tldr: The analysis of Pass@k curves indicates that RL-PLUS effectively resolves the capability boundary collapse problem, and provides both theoretical analysis and extensive experiments to demonstrate the superiority and generalizability of the approach.

2508.02298.tldr: A simple but efficient method-Credit Assignment Policy Optimization (CAPO) is introduced that consistently outperforms supervised learning-based and RL-based fine-tuning methods across four challenging mathematical benchmarks and three out-of-domain benchmarks.

2508.03095.tldr: Using four evaluation dimensions: security, authentication, scalability, and maintainability, architectural trade-offs between centralized control, enterprise governance, and distributed resilience are surface.

2508.12081.tldr: Experimental results show that VimoRAG significantly boosts the performance of motion LLMs constrained to text-only input, and designs the Gemini Motion Video Retriever mechanism and the Motion-centric Dual-alignment DPO Trainer, enabling effective retrieval and generation processes.

2508.16082.tldr: A rigorous theoretical foundation for task arithmetic is provided by establishing a connection between task vectors and gradients of the task losses, showing that under standard gradient descent, a task vector generated from one epoch of finetuning is exactly equivalent to the negative gradient of the loss, scaled by the learning rate.

2508.17821.tldr: It is demonstrated that as the number of selected tokens increases, the model's ability to distinguish informative tokens declines, often converging toward a uniform selection pattern and the need for more robust normalization and selection strategies in future attention architectures is motivated.

2508.18439.tldr: Triage, a two-pronged automated approach that uses Large Language Models to map CVEs to relevant techniques from the Att&ck knowledge base, shows that LLMs can be used to automatically predict the impact of cybersecurity vulnerabilities and makes the process of mapping CVEs to Att&ck more efficient.

2508.19565.tldr: This work proposes FlowDet, a high-speed detector featuring a decoupled encoder optimization strategy applied to the DETR architecture, which employs a novel Geometric Deformable Unit for traffic-aware geometric modeling and a Scale-Aware Attention module to maintain high representational power across extreme scale variations.

2508.21184.tldr: It is found that BED-LLM achieves substantial gains in performance across a wide range of tests based on the 20 Questions game and using the LLM to actively infer user preferences, compared to purely prompting-based design generation and other adaptive design strategies.

2509.02593.tldr: This paper presents a mitotic figure detection approach based on the state-of-the-art YOLOv12 object detection architecture that achieved an F1-score of 0.801 on the preliminary test set (hotspots only) and ranked second on the final test leaderboard.

2509.09702.tldr: The Creativity Benchmark is introduced, an evaluation framework for large language models (LLMs) in marketing creativity that shows tightly clustered performance with no model dominating across brands or prompt types, and highlights the need for expert human evaluation and diversity-aware workflows.

2509.12249.tldr: A No Unhealthy Representation Collapse theorem is proved: in deterministic MDPs, if training drives both the latent-transition consistency loss and the auxiliary regression loss to zero, then any pair of non-equivalent observations must map to distinct latent representations.

2509.16068.tldr: G-WindCast is introduced, a novel deep learning framework that leverages signal strength variations from 5G Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals to forecast three-dimensional atmospheric wind fields and exhibits robustness across forecast horizons and different pressure levels.

2509.16293.tldr: ByteRobust is a large-scale GPU infrastructure management system tailored for robust and stable training of LLMs that exploits the uniqueness of LLM training process and gives top priorities to detecting and recovering failures in a routine manner.

2509.16972.tldr: This paper proposes Segmentation Augmented and Selective Averaged Sa2VA (SaSaSa2VA) to address two key bottlenecks that limit segmentation performance: sparse frame sampling and reliance on a single [SEG] token for an entire video.

2509.19360.tldr: This work introduces Semantic Representation Attack, a novel paradigm that fundamentally reconceptualizes adversarial objectives against aligned LLMs and exploits the semantic representation space comprising diverse responses with equivalent harmful meanings.

2509.25748.tldr: Comparisons show reasoning-enhanced training significantly improves diagnostic accuracy, consistency, and interpretability, highlighting its importance for high-stakes medical AI.

2510.00461.tldr: A lightweight static-dynamic decomposition framework, TimeEmb, that innovatively separates time series into two complementary components: time-invariant component, captured by a novel global embedding module that learns persistent representations across time series, and time-varying component, processed by an efficient frequency-domain filtering mechanism inspired by full-spectrum analysis in signal processing.

2510.02456.tldr: This framework proposes a market-based framework that treats each training example as a tradeable contract and employs the Logarithmic Market Scoring Rule to aggregate multiple utility signals into coherent prices and unifies multi-signal data curation under fixed computational budgets for prompt-level reasoning and classification tasks.

2510.03308.tldr: Preliminary results demonstrate the effectiveness of image-based representations for generative mechanical design, showing that mechanisms with revolute and prismatic joints, and potentially cams and gears, can be represented and synthesized within a unified image generation framework.

2510.04774.tldr: It is shown that when a SoNS-enhanced robot swarm gets stuck, it can automatically solicit and run code generated by an external LLM on the fly, completing its mission with an 85% success rate.

2510.06303.tldr: The SDAR model surpasses its AR counterpart on challenging scientific reasoning benchmarks such as GPQA and ChemBench, and gains further improvements under test-time scaling methods like majority voting and pass@k, establishing SDAR as a practical paradigm that combines the strengths of autoregression and diffusion for scalable, high-throughput reasoning.

2510.08445.tldr: SymTime, a pre-trained foundation model for enhancing time series representation using symbolic information, is developed, demonstrating competitive performance across five major TSA tasks when fine-tunes with downstream tasks, rivaling foundation models pre-trained on real-world datasets.

2510.08847.tldr: The Agent GPA (Goal-Plan-Action) framework is introduced: an evaluation paradigm based on an agent's operational loop of setting goals, devising plans, and executing actions that provides a systematic way to cover a broad range of agent failures.

2510.09121.tldr: This work introduces a Multimodal Semantic Diffusion Model (MSDM) for generating realistic pixel-precise image-mask pairs for cell and nuclei segmentation, and highlights the effectiveness of multimodal diffusion-based augmentation for advancing the robustness and generalizability of cell and nuclei segmentation models.

2510.09211.tldr: DICE, a lightweight framework that guides small language models (SLMs) to refine LLMs' outputs through chain-of-thought (CoT) correction, preserves LLMs'broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities while ensuring the outputs conform to user demands.

2510.10815.tldr: DRIFT is introduced, a novel framework that enables LLMs to decompose informal mathematical statements into smaller, more tractable"sub-components" that facilitates targeted retrieval of premises from mathematical libraries such as Mathlib.

2510.11108.tldr: This position paper argues for a paradigm shift from binary access control to a more sophisticated model of information governance, positing that the core challenge is not merely about permission, but about governing the flow of information.

2510.11302.tldr: This work provides decision frameworks showing that optimal architecture choice depends on inference volume, category stability, budget, and accuracy requirements, and derive break-even thresholds for architecture selection.

2510.14588.tldr: Instance Cues is introduced -- a pixel-aligned control signal that turns sparse, user-editable hints into a dense 2.5D motion field by averaging per-instance flow and augmenting with monocular depth over the instance mask, which reduces depth ambiguity compared to 2D arrow inputs while remaining easy to use.

2510.14605.tldr: A visual language model trained with answer accuracy and format consistency as reward signals via a reinforcement learning manner is introduced, which enhances the model's reasoning, tool invocation for accurate queries, and filtering of irrelevant content in Wiki-PRF.

2510.14947.tldr: It is shown that a simple layered control architecture (LCA), a proprioceptive stabilizer running at high rate, coupled with a compact low-rate perceptual policy, enables substantially more robust performance than monolithic end-to-end designs, even when using minimal perception encoders.

2510.14959.tldr: CBF-RL is proposed, a framework for generating safe behaviors with RL by enforcing CBFs in training that internalizes the safety constraints in the learned policy -- both enforcing safer actions and biasing towards safer rewards -- enabling safe deployment without the need for an online safety filter.

2510.14980.tldr: BesiegeField is introduced, a testbed built on the machine-building game Besiege, which enables part-based construction, physical simulation and reward-driven evaluation, and key capabilities required for success, including spatial reasoning, strategic assembly, and instruction-following are identified.

2510.15244.tldr: A study exploring hybrid architectures that couple DDLMs with ARMs to assess whether their collaboration can yield complementary benefits, finding that shifting DDLM -->ARM communication from text space to latent space yields significant accuracy gains and combining a DDLM planner with an ARM executor can provide substantial computational savings with little to no impact on accuracy.

2510.15387.tldr: An automatic floorplanning engine based on reinforcement learning and relational graph convolutional neural network specifically tailored to condition the floorplan generation towards more routable outcomes is developed.

2510.16582.tldr: GraphFlow is proposed, a framework that efficiently retrieves accurate and diverse knowledge required for real-world queries from text-rich KGs for complex real-world queries from text-rich KGs using a transition-based flow matching objective and a flow estimator.

2510.16590.tldr: This work introduces a framework for molecular reasoning using general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs) that operates without requiring labeled training data, and anchors chain-of-thought reasoning to the molecular structure by using unique atomic identifiers.

2510.16591.tldr: This work evaluates the role of parameter symmetry and network expressivity in the generalisation behaviour of neural networks when learning a real-space renormalisation group (RG) transformation, and empirically validate an extension of this framework from MLPs to GNNs, elucidating the internal information processing performed by these more complex models.

2510.16611.tldr: Results indicate that the proposed framework can substantially accelerate diagnostic workflows, reduce clinician workload, and support trustworthy AI integration in time-critical healthcare environments.

2510.16635.tldr: MA-SAPO is proposed: a new Multi-Agent Reasoning for Score Aware Prompt Optimization framework that links evaluation outcomes directly to targeted refinements and ensures edits are interpretable, auditable, and controllable.

2510.16643.tldr: This work proposes to use a form of Retrieval Augmented Generation to select a subset of the 3DSG relevant to the task and encode a 3DSG in a graph database and provides a query language interface (Cypher) as a tool to the LLM with which it can retrieve relevant data for language grounding.

2510.16645.tldr: The Multi-Agent Collaboration Framework for Diverse Thinking Modes (DiMo) is introduced, which enhances both performance and interpretability by simulating a structured debate among four specialized LLM agents, allowing the framework to collaboratively explore diverse cognitive approaches.

2510.16670.tldr: C Capsule Prompt-Tuning (CaPT) is introduced, an efficient and effective solution that leverages off-the-shelf, informative instance semantics into prompt-based learning and innovatively integrates both instance-aware and task-aware information in a nearly parameter-free manner.

2510.16677.tldr: The results show that, in longitudinal monitoring, model choice is task-dependent: compact RNNs remain competitive for short-horizon risk scoring, whereas compact Transformers deliver clearer gains for point forecasting.

2510.16727.tldr: Beacon is introduced, a single-turn forced-choice benchmark that isolates sycophancy as a measurable form of normative misgeneralization, providing a reproducible foundation for studying and mitigating alignment drift in large-scale generative systems.

2510.16756.tldr: ELLSA (End-to-end Listen, Look, Speak and Act), which is the first full-duplex, end-to-end model that simultaneously perceives and generates across vision, text, speech, and action within a single architecture, enabling interaction patterns previously out of reach, yielding more natural, human-like behaviors.

2510.16772.tldr: This work proposes Region in Context, a novel framework for text-conditioned image editing that performs multilevel semantic alignment between vision and language, inspired by the human ability to reason about edits in relation to the whole scene.

2510.16774.tldr: It is argued that 3-D first-person video games are a challenging environment for real-time multi-modal reasoning and an inverse dynamics model can be learned from this dataset, which allows for impute actions on a much larger dataset of publicly available videos of human game play that lack recorded actions.

2510.16776.tldr: EMRRG is proposed, a novel X-ray report generation framework that fine-tunes pre-trained Mamba networks using parameter-efficient methods, enabling end-to-end training and achieving strong results on benchmark datasets.

2510.16783.tldr: A bilingual, multi-task evaluation benchmark designed to evaluate long-context understanding in English and Arabic, targeting context lengths ranging from 4k to over 128k tokens, with results indicating that LC-Eval presents significant challenges.

2510.16802.tldr: The Domain-Contextualized Concept Graph is proposed, a novel knowledge modeling framework that elevates domains to first-class elements of conceptual representation and enables context-aware reasoning, cross-domain analogy, and personalized knowledge modeling - capabilities unattainable under traditional ontology-based frameworks.

2510.16805.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of Mixed-Precision quantization frameworks for LMs (MXPLMs) and contrast MXPLMs with earlier mixed-precision quantization methods for deep neural networks, identifying strategies that transfer and those that face challenges in the LM setting.

2510.16814.tldr: A semi-supervised, positive-unlabeled (PU) learning strategy, implemented as a semantic segmentation model and evaluated on two datasets covering a representative range of archaeological periods, indicates that semi-supervised learning offers a promising approach to identifying undiscovered sites across large, sparsely annotated landscapes.

2510.16816.tldr: This paper presents a novel type of neural operators, Linear Attention Neural Operator (LANO), which achieves both scalability and high accuracy by reformulating attention through an agent-based mechanism, and demonstrates the universal approximation property, thereby demonstrating improved conditioning and stability properties.

2510.16829.tldr: CoRUS (COmmunity-driven Roles for User-centric Question Simulation), a framework for simulating role-based questions and provides a methodology for role-informed evaluation of conversational AI.

2510.16844.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that FinSight significantly outperforms all baselines, including leading deep research systems in terms of factual accuracy, analytical depth, and presentation quality, demonstrating a clear path toward generating reports that approach human-expert quality.

2510.16851.tldr: This paper proposes Neuronal Group Communication (NGC), a theory-driven framework that reimagines a neural network as a dynamical system of interacting neuronal groups rather than a monolithic collection of neural weights, and introduces a neuronal stability metric that quantifies the contraction of neuron activations toward stable patterns during sequence processing.

2510.16854.tldr: ArmFormer is presented, a lightweight transformer-based semantic segmentation framework that strategically integrates Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) with MixVisionTransformer architecture to achieve superior accuracy while maintaining computational efficiency suitable for resource-constrained edge devices.

2510.16872.tldr: This paper introduces DeepAnalyze-8B, the first agentic LLM designed for autonomous data science, capable of automatically completing the end-toend pipeline from data sources to analyst-grade deep research reports and proposes a curriculum-based agentic training paradigm that emulates the learning trajectory of human data scientists, enabling LLMs to progressively acquire and integrate multiple capabilities in real-world environments.

2510.16877.tldr: Inspired by the fly olfactory circuit, Fly-CL is proposed, a bio-inspired framework compatible with a wide range of pretrained backbones that substantially reduces training time while achieving performance comparable to or exceeding that of current state-of-the-art methods.

2510.16893.tldr: This work systematically investigates the role of speaker emotion in large audio-language models, constructing a dataset of malicious speech instructions expressed across multiple emotions and intensities, and evaluating several state-of-the-art LALMs.

2510.16898.tldr: A novel custom loss function that integrates Mean Absolute Error, Jensen-Shannon Divergence, and a smoothness penalty is introduced and can improve the model's performance, aligning predicted prices more closely with actual values, particularly during peak intervals.

2510.16899.tldr: A knowledge-guided framework that integrates the standardized clinical terminology SNOMED CT with the Neo4j graph database to construct a structured medical knowledge graph, providing a scalable solution for building reliable AI-assisted clinical systems.

2510.16907.tldr: This work architecturally enforce and reward the VLM agent's reasoning process via reinforcement learning (RL), formulating it as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), and designs a World Modeling Reward that provides dense, turn-level supervision for accurate state prediction.

2510.16911.tldr: This work proposes a robust yet lightweight Deep Learning pipeline combining hourly downsizing, dual-mode imputation (mean and polynomial regression), and comprehensive normalization, ultimately selecting Standard Scaling for optimal balance.

2510.16914.tldr: Adaptive Domain Transformation (DoT) is proposed, an innovative PTMs-based approach tailored to DGCL that serves as a plug-in strategy that greatly facilitates state-of-the-art CL baselines under both full parameter tuning and parameter-efficient tuning paradigms in DGCL, validated by extensive experiments.

2510.16917.tldr: SAKE is introduced, the first benchmark specifically designed for editing auditory attribute knowledge in Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs), and provides a principled framework to study how knowledge editing extends to the auditory modalities.

2510.16933.tldr: The results indicate that LLMs are quite skilled coders; however, they require tutoring to reach optimized solutions provided by parallel computing experts.

2510.16940.tldr: Results show that P-KANs consistently outperform Multi Layer Perceptron (MLP) baselines in both accuracy and calibration, achieving superior efficiency-risk trade-offs while using significantly fewer parameters.

2510.16943.tldr: This study presents a comprehensive, component-level evaluation framework for LLM-generated formulations, and indicates that GPT-5 consistently outperforms other models, with chain-of-thought, self-consistency, and modular prompting proving most effective.

2510.16956.tldr: This work proposes a novel evaluation methodology to test whether users can identify an agent's goal from an explanation of its decision-making, and finds that users's self-reported ease of identification and understanding for every explanation did not correlate with their accuracy.

2510.16958.tldr: The results show that probabilistic downscaling approaches provide more realistic spatial uncertainty representations compared to simpler stochastic methods, with each probabilistic model offering different strengths in terms of ensemble dispersion, deterministic skill, and physical consistency.

2510.16968.tldr: A comprehensive, reproducible benchmark that offers diverse distilled checkpoints and an extensible framework to facilitate future research, and establishes a comprehensive, reproducible benchmark that offers diverse distilled checkpoints and an extensible framework to facilitate future research.

2510.16973.tldr: This review article systematically categorizes studies into vision-only and vision-language FMs based on their architectural foundations, training strategies, and downstream clinical tasks, and identifies key future research directions aimed at enhancing the robustness, explainability, and clinical integration of FMs, thereby accelerating their translation into real-world medical practice.

2510.16983.tldr: This work proposes Di-Bregman, a compact framework that formulates diffusion distillation as Bregman divergence-based density-ratio matching, and highlights Bregman density-ratio matching as a practical and theoretically-grounded route toward efficient one-step diffusion generation.

2510.16996.tldr: This work introduces an LLM agentic framework for GPU kernel optimization that systematically explores the design space through multi-agent collaboration, grounded instruction, dynamic context management, and strategic search, and highlights the potential of agentic LLM frameworks to advance fully automated, scalable GPU kernel optimization.

2510.17004.tldr: ReclAIm is a multi-agent framework capable of autonomously monitoring, evaluating, and fine-tuning medical image classification models, built on a large language model core that operates entirely through natural language interaction, eliminating the need for programming expertise.

2510.17015.tldr: Justitia, a novel scheduler with three key techniques, is designed, a novel scheduler with three key techniques that can substantially enhance the scheduling efficiency with fairness preserved and experimental results show that it can substantially enhance the scheduling efficiency with fairness preserved.

2510.17038.tldr: The feasibility of multimodal, goal-conditioned architectures for catheter navigation is established, representing an important step toward reducing operator dependency and improving the reliability of catheterbased therapies.

2510.17045.tldr: During inference, the proposed approach called V-Reason (Video-Reason) adapts the value cache of the LMM via a few optimization steps on a small, trainable controller using an entropy-based objective, i.e., no supervision from any dataset or RL is necessary, which improves the model's micro-exploration and exploitation behavior during inference.

2510.17052.tldr: Experimental results on the Schema-Guided Dialogue dataset demonstrate that ToolCritic improves tool-calling accuracy by up to 13% over baselines, including zero-shot prompting and self-correction techniques, which represents a promising step toward more robust LLM integration with external tools in real-world dialogue applications.

2510.17057.tldr: Large frontier reasoning models closely track human ability in detecting motivated reasoning, but this should not give us too much solace, as frontier model developers rely on smaller models for monitoring due to their low latency and deployment costs.

2510.17058.tldr: This work introduces a novel enhancement in low-precision logarithmic fixed-point training, geared towards future hardware accelerator designs, and proposes incorporating bitwidth in the design of approximations to arithmetic operations.

2510.17062.tldr: A lightweight prompt-based mitigation approach is introduced that queries the model to review its own initial reasoning against these specific failure patterns that drive social bias aggregation and effectively reduces bias while maintaining or improving accuracy.

2510.17109.tldr: This work presents VeriMAP, a framework for multi-agent collaboration with verification-aware planning, and highlights how verification-aware planning enables reliable coordination and iterative refinement in multi-agent systems, without relying on external labels or annotations.

2510.17115.tldr: DVAGen is introduced, a fully open-source, unified framework designed for training, evaluation, and visualization of dynamic vocabulary-augmented language models that validate the effectiveness of dynamic vocabulary methods on modern LLMs and demonstrate support for batch inference, significantly improving inference throughput.

2510.17132.tldr: This work introduces a unified benchmark for evaluating latent information discovery - the ability of LLMs to reveal and utilize hidden user attributes through multi-turn interaction and provides the first systematic framework for studying latent information discovery in personalized interaction.

2510.17146.tldr: PILLM is presented, a Physics-Informed LLM framework that operates within an evolutionary loop to automatically generate, evaluate, and refine anomaly detection rules that are both adaptive and physically grounded, advancing trustworthy and deployable AI for smart building systems.

2510.17157.tldr: Experiments show that GACO-CAD achieves state-of-the-art performance under the same MLLM backbone, consistently outperforming existing methods in terms of code validity, geometric accuracy, and modeling conciseness.

2510.17163.tldr: An evaluation framework called TREAT (Code LLMs Trustworthiness / Reliability Evaluation And Testing) that provides a holistic assessment of model performance in code intelligence tasks and assesses 26 state-of-the-art models, yielding several key insights.

2510.17172.tldr: This hybrid framework provides a novel paradigm for VT/VF risk prediction by validating the use of foundation model outputs as effective, automated feature engineering for building trustworthy, explainable AI-based clinical decision support systems.

2510.17179.tldr: This study marks the first large-scale, systematic evaluation and analysis of Out-of-Distribution data detection methods in plankton recognition, particularly excelling in Far-OoD scenarios with substantial improvements in key metries.

2510.17197.tldr: A novel, zero-shot method is proposed that reframes the problem by introducing a prompt-aware perspective, explicitly modeling visual token pruning as a balance between task relevance and information diversity, and achieves performance that matches or surpasses the state-of-the-art with only minimal accuracy loss.

2510.17198.tldr: This work assembled a new dataset - a digital chronicle of loss compiled from historical Google Earth imagery of Bangladesh's most vulnerable regions, including Mokterer Char Union, Kedarpur Union, Balchipara village, and Chowhali Upazila, from 2003 to 2025, and is the first to include manually annotated data on the settlements that have vanished beneath the water.

2510.17199.tldr: Preliminary results suggest that leveraging tactical features from match footage is highly effective for predicting round outcomes in VALORANT, significantly outperforming a model trained on a dataset with the minimap information itself.

2510.17206.tldr: Soft-masking (SM) is introduced, a novel method that dynamically blends the embedding of the mask token with the embeddings of the top-k predicted tokens from the previous decoding step, for each retained mask, which provides the model with a more informative prior.

2510.17211.tldr: Temporally Detailed Hypergraph Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (TD-HNODE), which represents disease progression on clinically recognized trajectories as a temporally detailed hypergraph and learns the continuous-time progression dynamics via a neural ODE framework, is proposed.

2510.17212.tldr: A reinforcement learning framework that discretizes continuous action spaces to approximate multimodal distributions, employs entropy-regularized exploration to improve coverage of risky but rewarding actions, and introduces a dual-critic architecture for more accurate discrete value distribution estimation is proposed.

2510.17214.tldr: A deep sparse auto-encoding network is employed for the prediction and classification of high-frequency impedance in fuel cells, achieving metric of accuracy rate above 92% and deployed on an FPGA.

2510.17218.tldr: Results show that QV-M$^2 serves as an effective benchmark for training and evaluating MMR models, while FlashMMR provides a strong baseline, and the proposed benchmark and method establish a foundation for advancing research in more realistic and challenging video temporal grounding scenarios.

2510.17234.tldr: A novel Continual Audio-Visual Segmentation task is introduced, aiming to continuously segment new classes guided by audio, and a Collision-based Multi-modal Rehearsal (CMR) framework is designed to address challenges of multi-modal semantic drift and co-occurrence confusion.

2510.17235.tldr: This work presents Coinvisor, a reinforcement learning-based chatbot that provides comprehensive analytical support for cryptocurrency investment through a multi-agent framework that enables multi-step planning and flexible integration of diverse data sources.

2510.17241.tldr: This work introduces a formal framework for visibility allocation systems (VASs) which is defined as (semi-)automated systems deciding which (processed) data to present a human user with and discusses how this framework can support ongoing AI-legislative efforts to locate obligations, quantify systemic risks, and enable adaptive compliance.

2510.17252.tldr: Large-scale emotion analysis of Bengali news reveals a clear dominance of negative emotions, particularly anger, fear, and disappointment, and significant variation in how similar stories are emotionally portrayed across outlets.

2510.17253.tldr: This study introduces Augmented Web Usage Mining (AWUM), an approach that enhances web usage mining by enriching interaction data collected through the CAWAL framework, demonstrating AWUM’s superiority in precision and efficiency compared to traditional web usage mining methods.

2510.17269.tldr: FineVision is introduced, a meticulously collected, curated, and unified corpus of 24 million samples - the largest open resource of its kind - and the corpus and curation tools are released to accelerate data-centric VLM research.

2510.17301.tldr: This short paper proposes MapMuse, a storytelling-based framework for interpreting spatio-temporal datasets, transforming them into compelling, narrative-driven experiences, and argues that data storytelling drives insight, engagement, and action from spatio-temporal information.

2510.17354.tldr: This paper proposes Nyx, a unified mixed-modal to mixed-modal retriever tailored for URAG scenarios, and introduces a four-stage automated pipeline for generation and filtering, leveraging web documents to construct NyxQA, a dataset comprising diverse mixed-modal question-answer pairs that better reflect real-world information needs.

2510.17358.tldr: A novel framework for training large language models with continuously adjustable internal representations that span the full spectrum from localist (interpretable, rule-based) to distributed (generalizable, efficient) encodings, enabling practitioners to continuously interpolate between interpretable and high-performance modes while adapting architectural capacity at multiple granularities.

2510.17369.tldr: This work presents a structured finetuning and deployment pipeline evaluating two state-of-the-art VLA models (OpenVLA-OFT and $\pi_0$), and shows while out-of-the-box policies fail due to embodiment mismatch, through targeted finetuning the soft robot performs equally to the rigid counterpart.

2510.17380.tldr: This work substitutes costly smart grid simulators with surrogate models built using Phisics-informed Neural Networks (PINNs), optimizing the RL policy training process by arriving to convergent results in a fraction of the time employed by the original environment.

2510.17382.tldr: A hybrid framework that integrates a learned heuristic derived from MAGAT, a neural MAPF policy with a graph attention scheme, into a leading search-based algorithm, LaCAM, demonstrating that hybrid search offers a powerful solution for tightly coupled, challenging multi-agent coordination problems.

2510.17386.tldr: This paper investigates the use of Q-learning, a well-known reinforcement learning algorithm, for the passive inference of deterministic finite automata and builds on the core insight that the learned Q-function can be reinterpreted as the transition function of a DFA over a finite domain.

2510.17389.tldr: EduAdapt is introduced, a benchmark of nearly 48k grade-labeled QA pairs across nine science subjects, spanning Grades 1-12 and grouped into four grade levels, to foster more developmentally aligned educational AI systems through better training and prompting strategies.

2510.17402.tldr: Ladder-base is introduced, the first TCM-focused LLM trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a reinforcement learning method that improves reasoning and factual consistency by optimizing response selection based on intra-group comparisons.

2510.17405.tldr: This unified framework ensures ongoing data quality and establishes the first scalable image-captioning resource for under-represented African languages, laying the groundwork for truly inclusive multimodal AI.

2510.17415.tldr: The feasibility of developing a TCM-domain LLM through natural language-based instruction tuning and multimodal integration is demonstrated, offering a practical framework for aligning generative AI with traditional medical reasoning and a scalable pathway for real-world deployment.

2510.17418.tldr: This work establishes the feasibility of semantically-guided diverse planning in simulation-based environments, paving the way for innovative approaches in realistic, non-symbolic domains where traditional model-based approaches fail.

2510.17450.tldr: An active inference route-planning method for the autonomous control of intelligent agents, allowing agents to balance searching extensive areas of the geographical map while tracking identified target objects.

2510.17463.tldr: It is argued that legal machine learning applications need to account for label indeterminacy and it is shown that the way that labels are constructed during training can significantly affect model behaviour.

2510.17469.tldr: This work identifies a progressive emergence of layer specialization during training that correlates with generalization performance, and demonstrates that transformers develop modular, interpretable mechanisms supporting compositional reasoning, linking internal algorithmic structure to observed behavioral capabilities.

2510.17475.tldr: This work proposes a distribution-aware multi-source domain adaptation network (DAMSDAN), which integrates prototype-based constraints with adversarial learning to drive the encoder toward discriminative, domain-invariant emotion representations under cross-domain settings.

2510.17515.tldr: A novel theoretical framework based on the theory of graph limits, particularly graphons, that characterizes sparse neural networks in the infinite-width regime and empirically shows that the spectral analysis of Graphon NTK correlates with observed training dynamics of sparse networks, explaining the varying convergence behaviours of different pruning methods.

2510.17564.tldr: Through the lens of multi-objective analysis, empirical Pareto frontiers are presented that offer a complete visualization of the trade-off between return and cost in the underlying optimization problem and highlight the importance of careful cost limit selection across different regions of cost restrictiveness when evaluating safe reinforcement learning methods.

2510.17576.tldr: An intent-driven planning pipeline is proposed which can robustly construct complex manipulation tasks with varying degrees of supervisory input from a human using simple language instructions, and reliably maps operator intent to safe, executable multi-robot plans while maintaining low user effort.

2510.17584.tldr: CEPerFed, a communication-efficient personalized FL method that mitigates the effect of data heterogeneity by incorporating client-side historical risk gradients and historical mean gradients to coordinate local and global optimization, is proposed.

2510.17590.tldr: MIRAGE, an inference-time, model-pluggable agentic framework that decomposes multimodal verification into four sequential modules, demonstrates that decomposed agentic reasoning with web retrieval can match supervised detector performance without domain-specific training, enabling misinformation detection across modalities where labeled data remains scarce.

2510.17598.tldr: This work distill the reasoning capabilities of a VLLM into a smaller, more efficient model that is faster and cheaper to deploy and enables the model to transcend token-level generation and to deeply grasp the overarching structure of solutions for given problems.

2510.17614.tldr: OG-Rank is presented, a single-decoder approach that pairs a pooled first-token scoring signal with an uncertainty-gated explanation step that scores all candidates in one pass and generates a brief, structured rationale only when the list is genuinely ambiguous, keeping latency predictable.

2510.17651.tldr: The resulting framework offers a reproducible baseline for responsible, resource-aware AI in video surveillance, with extensions toward real-time, multimodal, and lifecycle-aware systems.

2510.17671.tldr: A language-in-the-loop framework that uses a large language model (LLM) to convert unstructured feedback in the form of natural language into scalar utilities to conduct BO over a numeric search space and shows that this hybrid method outperforms conventional BO baselines and LLM-only optimizers, particularly in feedback-limited regimes.

2510.17684.tldr: The proposed IC-MoE effectively supplements foundational medical image segmentation models with high-level features and pretrained structural integrity, and validate the superior generalizability of the IC-MoE across diverse medical image segmentation scenarios.

2510.17685.tldr: This work pioneers a multilingual TIPR task by developing a multilingual TIPR benchmark, and proposes Bi-IRRA: a Bidirectional Implicit Relation Reasoning and Aligning framework to learn alignment across languages and modalities.

2510.17687.tldr: This work develops CrossGuard, an intent-aware safeguard providing robust and comprehensive defense against both explicit and implicit threats, and proposes ImpForge, an automated red-teaming pipeline that leverages reinforcement learning with tailored reward modules to generate diverse implicit samples across 14 domains.

2510.17705.tldr: Contextual Attention Modulation (CAM) is proposed, a novel mechanism that dynamically modulates the representations of self-attention modules in LLMs that enhances task-specific features while preserving general knowledge, thereby facilitating more effective and efficient adaptation.

2510.17709.tldr: A novel framework to address the Sim2Real performance gap by directly adapting the simulator parameters based on real-world performance and derives and validate in simple examples the mathematical tools needed to develop bi-level RL algorithms.

2510.17720.tldr: A lightweight few-shot NER framework that addresses challenges through a new instruction tuning template with a simplified output format that combines principles from prior IT approaches to leverage the large context window of recent state-of-the-art LLMs and introduces a strategic data augmentation technique that preserves entity information while paraphrasing the surrounding context.

2510.17724.tldr: This study investigates feature learning strategies for signature forgery detection, focusing on improving cross-dataset generalization -- that is, model robustness when trained on one dataset and tested on another.

2510.17725.tldr: A holistic evaluation on the proposed AcademicEval benchmark shows that LLMs perform poorly on tasks with hierarchical abstraction levels and tend to struggle with long few-shot demonstrations, highlighting the challenge of the benchmark.

2510.17745.tldr: A multi-threading kernel that enables neuromorphic applications running at the edge, meaning they process sensory input directly and without any up-link to or dependency on a cloud service is introduced.

2510.17756.tldr: The PINN model outperforms the fully data-driven model in the daily predictions of SIV and SIC, even when trained with a small number of samples, and improves SIC predictions in melting and early freezing seasons and near fast-moving ice regions.
