2510.17771.tldr: Results show that VLMs encode reliable evidence internally but under-utilize it, and making such signals explicit can bridge the gap between perception and reasoning, advancing the diagnostic understanding and reliability of VLMs.

2510.17773.tldr: The proposed dual-encoder attention-based framework that leverages both segmented lesions and clinical metadata to enhance skin lesion classification in terms of both accuracy and interpretability achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance and significantly improves classification accuracy and average AUC compared to baseline models.

2510.17776.tldr: A sample-wise paradigm is proposed to measure what is forgotten and when backward transfer occurs and offers a practical yardstick for mapping how post-training alters pretrained knowledge at scale -- enabling progress towards generally capable AI systems.

2510.17792.tldr: This work introduces SoftMimic, a framework for learning compliant whole-body control policies for humanoid robots from example motions that leverages an inverse kinematics solver to generate an augmented dataset of feasible compliant motions, which it uses to train a reinforcement learning policy.

2510.17802.tldr: This paper investigates the layerwise sampling technique for debiasing low-rank projection mechanisms and proposes a novel and unbiased low-rank optimization method built upon GaLore's mechanism and the Muon algorithm, named GaLore Unbiased with Muon (GUM).

2402.07127.tldr: This survey summarizes video-based learning approaches, analyzes their benefits over standard datasets, survey metrics and benchmarks, and discusses open challenges and future directions in this nascent domain at the intersection of computer vision, natural language processing, and robot learning.

2402.09721.tldr: This work reduces this problem to a one-shot problem where the agent approximately best responds, and proves that if the agent uses contextual no-regret learning algorithms with regret $\mathrm{Reg}(T)$, then the principal can guarantee utility at least $U^* - \Theta\big(\sqrt{\tfrac{Reg}(T)}{T}}\big)$.

2403.00046.tldr: A novel adaptation approach named DEED, which stands for Data-Efficient adaptation with Error-Driven learning for code generation, which leverages the errors made by LLMs as learning opportunities, using error revision to overcome their own shortcomings, thus achieving efficient learning.

2404.12041.tldr: A structured framework to organize the field is formulated, based on a survey of foundational datasets and benchmarks and a taxonomy of evaluation methodologies, which together systematically document the evolution from pre-LLM to post-LLM approaches.

2404.18134.tldr: FairVIC, an innovative approach that enhances fairness in neural networks by integrating variance, invariance, and covariance terms into the loss function during training, is introduced, offering a robust, generalisable solution for fair deep learning across diverse tasks and datasets.

2408.10111.tldr: This work proposes LENS, a pre-trained model that effectively captures the complexity of financial stochastic systems through a carefully crafted model architecture and mitigates noise during pre-training by using an invertible embedding module.

2408.12112.tldr: This work focuses on LLM-designed rewards for Restless Multi-Armed Bandits, a framework for allocating limited resources among agents, and presents a principled method termed Social Choice Language Model for dealing with complex tradeoffs.

2410.04039.tldr: BlockScan is the only method that successfully detects anomalous transactions on Solana with high accuracy, whereas all other approaches achieved very low or zero detection recall scores, setting a new benchmark for applying Transformer-based approaches in blockchain data analysis.

2410.12539.tldr: A novel causal explanation formula is introduced that decomposes the counterfactual effect of an agent's action by attributing to each agent and state variable a score reflecting their respective contributions to the effect.

2412.09165.tldr: This survey categorizes the interplay between LLMs and text embeddings into three overarching themes: LLM-augmented text embedding, enhancing traditional embedding methods with LLMs; LLMs as text embedders, adapting their innate capabilities for high-quality embedding; and Text embedding understanding with LLMs, leveraging LLMs to analyze and interpret embeddings.

2501.19398.tldr: It is deduced that LLM-based agents may reveal excessive information to agents of unknown identities, and it is found that, when instructed to adopt an information-revealing level, this level is linearly encoded in the LLM's internal representations.

2502.00657.tldr: A theoretical framework is presented showing that popular LLM alignment methods, including RLHF and its variants, can be understood as divergence estimators between aligned and unaligned distributions, and a distance-based metric in the prompt representation space is proposed, which also acts as a statistically significant indicator for model safety.

2502.13935.tldr: This work introduces a system design, fueled by a novel learning approach conceptually grounded in principles of evolutionary developmental biology, that overcomes key limitations of current methods and shows promise in overcoming multiple major limitations of contemporary machine learning systems simultaneously and in an organic manner.

2503.00481.tldr: The findings reveal that current tools treat test executions as isolated events, lack explicit aggregation mechanisms, and inadequately capture variability across model versions, configurations, and repeated runs, highlighting the need for viewing correctness as a distribution of outcomes rather than a binary property.

2503.04150.tldr: This paper proposes to utilize the sexagenary year expression instead of the Gregorian year expression employed by LLMs, achieving a more uniform distribution in yearly granularity and presents a temporal representational alignment approach for post-training LLMs that effectively distinguishes time points with relevant knowledge, hence improving performance on time-related tasks, particularly over a long period.

2503.12211.tldr: STL is proposed as a promising building block for scalable and cost-efficient AI, and it is shown that theory-backed initializations lead to substantially better accuracy than random SGD initialization in DNNs.

2503.21322.tldr: This work proposes HyperGraphRAG, a novel hypergraph-based RAG method that represents n-ary relational facts via hyperedges, and consists of knowledge hypergraph construction, retrieval, and generation.

2504.10612.tldr: Energy Matching is proposed, a framework that endows flow-based approaches with the flexibility of EBMs, and learns a scalar potential energy, without time conditioning, auxiliary generators, or additional networks, marking a significant departure from recent EBM methods.

2504.13365.tldr: This work proposes VLLFL, a vision-language model-based lightweight federated learning framework that harnesses the generalization and context-aware detection capabilities of the vision-language model (VLM) and leverages the privacy-preserving nature of federated learning.

2504.15457.tldr: This work proposes a novel strategy that combines a pretrained generative model to simulate valid cooperative agent policies with adversarial training to maximize regret, and calls it GOAT: Generative Online Adversarial Training.

2504.18400.tldr: Tract2Shape enables fast, accurate, and generalizable prediction of white matter shape measures from tractography data, supporting scalable analysis across datasets and lays a promising foundation for future large‐scale white matter shape analysis.

2505.01635.tldr: It is demonstrated that networks incorporating dendritic neurons achieve superior performance compared to much larger networks without dendrites, suggesting that dendritic hardware can significantly improve computational efficiency and learning capacity of neuromorphic systems optimized for edge applications.

2505.11741.tldr: Multi-Token Reliability Estimation (MTRE), a lightweight, white-box method that aggregates logits from the first ten tokens using multi-token log-likelihood ratios and self-attention, is introduced, establishing a new state of the art in hallucination detection for open-source VLMs.

2505.14045.tldr: A large-scale, high-quality multi-way parallel corpus, TED2025, based on TED Talks is introduced, which investigates best practices for leveraging multi-way parallel data to enhance LLMs, including strategies for continued pretraining, instruction tuning, and the analysis of key influencing factors.

2505.17745.tldr: This paper introduces MetaBox-v2 as a milestone upgrade with four novel features, a unified architecture supporting RL, evolutionary, and gradient-based approaches, and a systematic case study that evaluates the built-in baselines in terms of the optimization performance, generalization ability and learning efficiency.

2505.18315.tldr: CoLoRA (Convolutional Low-Rank Adaptation) is introduced, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that provides a stable and effective alternative to full fine-tuning for medical image classification.

2505.19187.tldr: PIR (Perplexity-based Importance Refinement), a principled framework that quantitatively evaluates the importance of each reasoning step based on its impact on answer prediction confidence, is introduced, offering a practical solution for deploying reasoning-capable LLMs in scenarios where efficient test-time scaling, response time, and computational efficiency are valuable constraints.

2505.19591.tldr: This work proposes a puppeteer-style paradigm for LLM-based multi-agent collaboration, where a centralized orchestrator dynamically directs agents in response to evolving task states through reinforcement learning, enabling flexible and evolvable collective reasoning.

2505.21657.tldr: gSMILE (generative SMILE), a model-agnostic, perturbation-based framework for token-level interpretability in LLMs, is presented, demonstrating gSMILE's ability to balance model performance and interpretability, enabling more transparent and trustworthy AI systems.

2505.23564.tldr: Segment Policy Optimization (SPO), a novel RL framework that leverages segment-level advantage estimation at an intermediate granularity, achieving a better balance by offering more precise credit assignment than trajectory-level methods and requiring fewer estimation points than token-level methods, enabling accurate advantage estimation based on Monte Carlo without a critic model.

2505.23868.tldr: Drawing inspiration from the mixture-of-experts architecture, LoPE strategically integrates a dedicated poisoning expert in an asymmetric LoRA configuration and performs noise injection on the poisoning expert during fine-tuning to enhance its noise discrimination and processing ability.

2506.02537.tldr: This work investigates the bottlenecks in current MLLMs and synthesizes training data to improve their abstract visual perception, and introduces the Perceptual Riddle Synthesizer (PRS), an automated framework for generating riddles with fine-grained perceptual descriptions.

2506.06387.tldr: This work extends the well-established fingerprinting-based localization framework by simultaneously reducing its memory requirements and improving its accuracy, by using a model-based neural network to learn the location-to-channel mapping, and then serves as a generative neural channel model.

2506.07153.tldr: This paper demonstrates how attackers can exploit web-use agents by embedding malicious content in web pages that agents encounter during legitimate browsing tasks, and introduces the task-aligned injection technique that frames malicious commands as helpful task guidance rather than obvious attacks.

2506.07578.tldr: This work proposes to denoise the future and speed up inference by using only the top-p transitions, i.e., the most probable transitions with accumulated probability p, and shows that the error introduced by using only the top-p transitions is bound by $p$ and the so-called minimal mixing rate of the underlying model.

2506.11097.tldr: C-SEO Bench is the first benchmark designed to evaluate C-SEO methods across multiple tasks, domains, and number of actors, and reveals that most current C-SEO methods are not only largely ineffective but also frequently have a negative impact on document ranking, opposite to what is expected.

2506.18141.tldr: A modular organization of knowledge is suggested through compositional operations, and advance methods for efficient, targeted LLM manipulation are suggested for efficient, targeted LLM manipulation.

2506.19461.tldr: This work proposes Iterative Quantum Feature Maps (IQFMs), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that constructs a deep architecture by iteratively connecting shallow QFMs with classically computed augmentation weights that effectively reduces quantum runtime and mitigates noise-induced degradation.

2506.22498.tldr: ViFusionTST, a dual-stream Swin Transformer that processes the line plot and texture maps in parallel and fuses them through cross-attention to learn data-driven modality weights, is introduced, demonstrating that image-based fusion of load-sensor signals for time series classification is a practical and effective solution for real-time, privacy-preserving fall prevention.

2507.09871.tldr: This work defines a probabilistic space of downstream tasks obtained by adopting a distribution of tasks and by defining Task Priors, which is the first to provide answers to key questions about how to evaluate a model's performance over the set of all possible downstream tasks.

2507.15886.tldr: This paper studies how to efficiently combine multiple runtime monitors into a single monitoring protocol to maximize the probability of applying a safety intervention on misaligned outputs and shows that combining two monitors can Pareto dominate using either monitor alone.

2507.20643.tldr: This work proposes an ontology enhanced KGC method using LLMs -- OL-KGC, which first leverages neural perceptual mechanisms to effectively embed structural information into the textual space, and then uses an automated extraction algorithm to retrieve ontological knowledge from the knowledge graphs that needs to be completed.

2508.11503.tldr: This work presents a complete sim-to-real framework for developing and validating robust control policies for dynamic waypoint tracking on such challenging surfaces, and provides strong empirical evidence that agents trained with procedural diversity achieve superior zero-shot performance compared to those trained on static scenarios.

2508.11758.tldr: It is found that synthetic benchmarks reliably rank the RAGs varying in terms of retriever configuration, aligning well with human-labeled benchmark baselines, however, they do not consistently produce reliable RAG rankings when comparing generator architectures.

2508.14040.tldr: This work introduces ComputerRL, a framework for autonomous desktop intelligence that enables agents to operate complex digital workspaces skillfully and proposes Entropulse, a training strategy that alternates reinforcement learning with supervised fine-tuning, effectively mitigating entropy collapse during extended training runs.

2509.02360.tldr: SWE-PRM is introduced, an inference-time Process Reward Model that intervenes during execution to detect and course-correct trajectory-level errors, and which outperforms unguided or explicit action-prescriptive variants, increasing success rate while reducing trajectory length.

2509.06239.tldr: Proof2Silicon is presented, a novel end-to-end synthesis framework that embeds the previously proposed PREFACE flow to enable the generation of correctness-by-construction hardware directly from natural language specifications, bridging natural-language specification and silicon realization.

2509.06436.tldr: Tree of Agents enables agents to probe different reasoning orders for multi-perspective understanding, effectively mitigating position bias and reducing hallucinations and to improve processing efficiency, it incorporates prefix-hash caching and adaptive pruning strategies, achieving significant performance improvements with comparable API overhead.

2509.09710.tldr: A novel one-to-cohort realism score is featured: a composite of four metrics validated against the Connecticut Statewide Transportation Study diaries, matched across demographic variables, establishing LLM's zero-shot viability and establishing a quantifiable metric of diary realism for future synthetic diary evaluation systems.

2509.13281.tldr: RepIt, a simple and data-efficient framework for isolating concept-specific representations in LM activations, is presented, exposing vulnerabilities in current safety evaluation practices and demonstrating a need for more comprehensive, representation aware assessments.

2509.16456.tldr: This paper introduces GPO, a novel fine-tuning strategy that dives into the reasoning process to enable more effective improvements and demonstrates its effectiveness and generalizability in improving LLM reasoning by concentrating on pivotal moments within the generation process.

2509.17393.tldr: This work introduces transductive program synthesis, a new formulation of the program synthesis task that explicitly leverages test inputs during synthesis and uses an LLM to predict outputs for selected test inputs and eliminate inconsistent hypotheses.

2509.24248.tldr: This work proposes SpecExit, a novel framework that predicts both future tokens and an early-exit signal directly from a lightweight draft model without probing overhead, and leverages the inherent signals from hidden states to provide effective early-exit signals, suggesting broader use of hidden states for efficient reasoning.

2509.25528.tldr: LLM-RG is proposed, a hybrid pipeline that combines off-the-shelf vision-language models for fine-grained attribute extraction with large language models for symbolic reasoning that demonstrates the complementary strengths of VLMs and LLMs, applied in a zero-shot manner, for robust outdoor referential grounding.

2510.01195.tldr: LegiScout is introduced, an interactive visualization system that transforms static policy diagrams into dynamic, force-directed graphs, enhancing comprehension while preserving essential relationships in modern law.

2510.05092.tldr: Diff Interpretation Tuning (DIT) is introduced, a method that trains models to describe their own finetuning-induced modifications using accurate natural language descriptions.

2510.07681.tldr: Results suggest that curriculum-guided synthetic augmentation enhances model robustness and generalization for pulmonary nodule detection in chest radiographs, and indicates more anatomically focused attention under curriculum learning.

2510.08325.tldr: This work proposes Cover@tau, which measures the fraction of problems that a model can solve for which at least a tau proportion of completions are correct, and evaluates several RLVR models using Cover@tau-based metrics and illustrates how the relative rankings of popular algorithms change compared to Pass@1.

2510.08567.tldr: A vision-centric agent tuning framework that automatically synthesizes multimodal trajectories, generates step-wise preference pairs, and trains a VLM controller for robust tool-use reasoning, demonstrating scalable and effective multimodal tool use.

2510.12838.tldr: This work presents Adaptive Agent Foundation Model (A$^2$FM), a unified framework that follows a route-then-align principle: the model first learns task-aware routing and then aligns mode-specific trajectories under a shared backbone, performing competitively with frontier LLMs across agentic, reasoning, and general benchmarks.

2510.14162.tldr: FinAI Data Assistant is presented, a practical approach for natural-language querying over financial databases that combines large language models (LLMs) with the OpenAI Function Calling API that achieves lower latency and cost and higher reliability than a text-to-SQL baseline on the task suite.

2510.14207.tldr: The findings show that multi-turn and theory-grounded attacks not only succeed at high rates but also mimic human-like harassment dynamics, motivating the development of robust safety guardrails to ultimately keep online platforms safe and responsible.

2510.14253.tldr: It is found that rewards from a Generative Reward Model (GRM) outperform rigid rule-based signals for open-domain learning, and that co-evolving the GRM with the policy further boosts performance, and that co-evolving the GRM with the policy further boosts performance.

2510.14807.tldr: SimKO is proposed, a method designed to mitigate the over-concentration issue of RLVR methods, and consistently yields higher pass@K for a wide range of K, providing a simple way to improve RLVR's exploration.

2510.15301.tldr: SVG is introduced, a novel latent diffusion model without variational autoencoders, which leverages self-supervised representations for visual generation and preserves the semantic and discriminative capabilities of the underlying self-supervised representations, providing a principled pathway toward task-general, high-quality visual representations.

2510.15476.tldr: This work proposes a holistic, multi-level taxonomy that organizes attacks, defenses, and vulnerabilities in LLM prompt security, and introduces an open-source evaluation toolkit for standardized, auditable comparison of attacks and defenses.

2510.15514.tldr: This work introduces an end to end framework to systematically detect and resolve judgment inconsistencies within the reinforcement learning training loop, establishing logical consistency as a crucial and now-addressable dimension of AI feedback.

2510.15720.tldr: Proabilistic Shielding via Risk Augmentation is introduced, a model-free algorithm for safe reinforcement learning under cost constraints that provides a tight upper-bound on the cost in expectation, depending only on the backup-critic accuracy, that is always satisfied during training.

2510.15946.tldr: PatMD is introduced, a novel approach that detects harmful memes by learning from and proactively mitigating these potential misjudgment risks, and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on unseen and adversarial memes.

2510.15985.tldr: A Multi-Endogenous-view Representation Enhancement mechanism to construct enriched feature views, coupled with a Cascaded Dual-convolution Time-series Attention (CDTA) module for multi-scale temporal representation learning for sepsis prediction.

2510.16034.tldr: This study introduces Disaster Copilot, a vision for a multi-agent artificial intelligence system designed to overcome systemic challenges by unifying specialized AI tools within a collaborative framework, and detail the system architecture and proposed three-phased roadmap emphasizing the parallel growth of technology, organizational capacity, and human-AI teaming.

2510.16185.tldr: This work builds on the Runtime Monitoring Language (RML) to develop a novel class of language-based Reward Machines, leveraging the built-in memory of RML to specify reward functions for non-regular, non-Markovian tasks.

2510.16263.tldr: Using NEBULA, it is demonstrated that top-performing VLAs struggle with key capabilities such as spatial reasoning and dynamic adaptation, which are consistently obscured by conventional end-task success metrics.

2510.16601.tldr: This paper proposes a new semi-supervised Confidence Distribution Learning (ssCDL) method for UKG completion, where each triple confidence is transformed into a confidence distribution to introduce more supervision information of different confidences to reinforce the embedding learning process.

2510.17173.tldr: These early findings indicate an evaluation-first path to personalization: freeze the generator, learn subgroup-aware decision heads on typed rewards, and always report per-archetype metrics to surface subgroup harms that averages obscure.

2510.17753.tldr: The need for responsible and context-aware AI design is underscored, highlighting gaps for longitudinal research and grounded evaluation frameworks to balance benefits with emerging human-centric risks.

2510.17825.tldr: This work advances prior energy-aware studies by proposing a carbon-aware orchestration framework for ISATNs that leverages Digital Twin (DT) technology and implements a multi timescale Plan Do Check Act (PDCA) loop that combines day-ahead forecasting with real-time adaptive optimization.

2510.17826.tldr: Speak to a Protein, a new capability that turns protein analysis into an interactive, multimodal dialogue with an expert co-scientist, and enables hypothesis generation by tightly coupling language, code, and 3D structures is introduced.

2510.17832.tldr: This study proposes a methodology for generating synthetic EEG signals associated with motor imagery brain tasks using Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM), and demonstrates that these signals can effectively complement datasets, improving classification performance in EEG-based BCIs and addressing data scarcity.

2510.17844.tldr: The Psychodynamic Model simulates self-awareness, preconsciousness, and unconsciousness through agent interaction, guided by a Personalization Module combining fixed traits and dynamic needs, demonstrating its potential for adaptive, personalized cognition.

2510.17845.tldr: MAT-Agent is proposed, a novel multi-agent framework that reimagines training as a collaborative, real-time optimization process that offers a scalable, intelligent solution for optimizing complex visual models, paving the way for adaptive deep learning advancements.

2510.17846.tldr: The CARLE AI framework is introduced, which integrates advanced deep learning architectures with shallow machine learning technique to overcome limitations in generalizability and robustness under dynamic operating conditions and discusses the reliability and trustworthiness of this framework via multiple state-of-the-art explainable AI (XAI) techniques.

2510.17852.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the migration and optimization process preserves the models' original accuracy while significantly reducing system dependencies and improving operational efficiency by leveraging Chinese chips as a viable alternative for scientific computing.

2510.17866.tldr: This work introduces MUSE (Model-based Uncertainty-aware Similarity Estimation), a training-free framework designed for model-based zero-shot 2D object detection and segmentation that achieves state-of-the-art performance on the BOP Challenge 2025.

2510.17867.tldr: The principle and structure of the above model and model deformation are described, the research progress and application of each model are described, and finally the recursive and recurrent neural network models are prospected and summarized.

2510.17874.tldr: This paper develops a post-tool execution reflection component that combines large language model (LLM)-based reflection with domain-specific retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using documents describing both the specific tool being called and troubleshooting documents related to the tool.

2510.17875.tldr: This paper proposes a simple yet effective 3D weakly supervised semantic segmentation method that integrates 3D geometric priors into a class-aware guidance mechanism to generate high-fidelity pseudo labels and proposes a Label Update strategy that integrates Self-Training to propagate labels into these areas.

2510.17877.tldr: A novel IRS-assisted UAV enabled spectrum sharing system with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) and a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approach based on the actor critic framework is developed to handle highly non convex, time coupled optimization problems with a mixed continuous and discrete policy space.

2510.17880.tldr: These findings provide the first causal evidence of emotion-guided moral decisions in LLMs and reveal deficits in cost calibration and nuanced fairness judgements, reminiscent of early-stage human responses.

2510.17882.tldr: The results show that LLMs act less as universal disruptors than as selective catalysts, amplifying existing strengths and widening disciplinary divides, and highlights the need for governance frameworks that preserve trust, fairness, and accountability in an AI-enabled research ecosystem.

2510.17885.tldr: This work proposes a unified and reproducible methodology for AI model inference that integrates computational and environmental metrics under realistic serving conditions, and establishes a rigorous benchmarking framework that produces decision-ready Pareto frontiers.

2510.17889.tldr: This work presents the general form of a vector-symbolic representation of the five Lisp elementary functions, lambda expressions, and other auxiliary functions, found in the Lisp 1.5 specification McCarthy (1960), which is near minimal and sufficient for Turing-completeness.

2510.17895.tldr: This work proposes a federated unlearning approach for LLMs that is scalable and privacy preserving, decouples unlearning and retention via task-specific adapter learning and employs a hierarchical merging strategy to mitigate conflicting objectives and enables robust, adaptable unlearning updates.

2510.17896.tldr: A unified benchmark that integrates representative attention kernels and context parallel mechanisms with a modular and extensible interface for evaluation, and evaluates methods along two critical dimensions: sequence length and distributed scale, which determine performance under extreme long-context training.

2510.17899.tldr: This work proposes a new paradigm: using large language models (LLMs) to automatically generate optimization algorithms tailored to auto-tuning problems, and shows that LLM-generated optimizers can rival, and in various cases outperform, existing human-designed algorithms.

2510.17901.tldr: Sherpa.ai Blind Vertical Federated Learning (SBVFL) is introduced, a novel paradigm that leverages a distributed training mechanism enhanced for privacy and security and reduces communication by ~99% compared to standard VFL while maintaining accuracy and robustness.

2510.17902.tldr: The Cartridge Activation Space Transfer (CAST) is introduced, a novel framework that liberates LoRA-encoded behaviors by learning a direct, nonlinear mapping between the activation manifolds, the geometric structures formed by the model's internal neuron activations, of two distinct LLM architectures.

2510.17910.tldr: This is the first study to offer a structured, quantitative, and pedagogically grounded framework for interpreting LLM reasoning in mathematics education, laying the foundation for the transparent and responsible deployment of AI in STEM learning environments.

2510.17914.tldr: This work introduces NeuCo-Bench, a novel benchmark framework for evaluating (lossy) neural compression and representation learning in the context of Earth Observation, and releases SSL4EO-S12-downstream, a curated multispectral, multitemporal EO dataset.

2510.17915.tldr: This work bridges calibration and uncertainty quantification through instance-level adaptivity, offering a practical post-hoc solution that requires no model retraining while improving both probability alignment and uncertainty-aware decision-making.

2510.17916.tldr: The architecture unifies Prigogine's dissipative structures, Friston's free energy minimization, and Hopfield's attractor dynamics, demonstrating that exact hierarchical inference over network topology can be implemented with local, biologically plausible rules.

2510.17917.tldr: This work argues that forgetting occurs disproportionately across time and frequency, depending on the model and scenarios, and selectively focusing on specific time-frequency ranges during training achieves samples with higher aesthetic quality and lower noise.

2510.17918.tldr: This paper focuses on enhancing pre-training data to improve the trustworthiness and safety of LLMs, and refers to the Data with World Context as DWC, to better anchor pre-training data within real-world scenarios, thereby reducing uncertainty in model training and enhancing the model's safety and trustworthiness.

2510.17919.tldr: This paper proposes ParaVul, a parallel LLM and retrieval-augmented framework to improve the reliability and accuracy of smart contract vulnerability detection and proposes a meta-learning model to fuse the outputs of the RAG system and the LLM, thereby generating the final detection results.

2510.17920.tldr: This study develops a cancer biology-informed neural network model (CBINN) to infer the unknown parameters in the system of equations as well as to discover the missing physics from sparse and noisy measurements and test the performance of the CBINN model on three distinct nonlinear compartmental tumor-immune models.

2510.17921.tldr: This work proposes CLAWS, a method that defines and classifies mathematical solutions into typical, creative, and hallucinated categories without human evaluation, by leveraging attention weights across prompt sections and output.

2510.17922.tldr: The Select-Then-Decompose strategy is proposed, which establishes a closed-loop problem-solving process composed of three stages: selection, execution, and verification, and dynamically selects the most suitable decomposition approach based on task characteristics and enhances the reliability of the results through a verification module.

2510.17924.tldr: A hybrid moderation system architecture is proposed that optimizes human moderator workload through automated detection and incorporates continuous learning mechanisms, and provides empirical evidence for deploying cost-effective, efficient content moderation systems in dynamic online gaming environments.

2510.17925.tldr: This work builds an agent that improves both latency and code-generation quality by proactively exploring repository files during indexing and constructing speculative context that anticipates future edits in each file, and identifies the problem of future context leakage in existing benchmarks which can inflate reported performance.

2510.17928.tldr: This work introduces an evolutionary, task-agnostic, strategy-guided, executably-checkable data synthesis framework that jointly synthesizes problems, diverse candidate solutions, and verification artifacts, and iteratively discovers strategies via a consistency-based evaluator that enforces agreement between human-annotated and strategy-induced checks.

2510.17934.tldr: AtlasKV is proposed, a scalable, effective, and general way to augment LLMs with billion-scale knowledge graphs (KGs) using very little GPU memory cost (e.g. 1B triples) using very little GPU memory cost (e.g. less than 20GB VRAM).

2510.17936.tldr: XDXD is introduced, to its knowledge, the first end-to-end deep learning framework to determine a complete atomic model directly from low-resolution single-crystal X-ray diffraction data, and a case study on small peptides highlights the model's potential for extension to more complex systems.

2510.17937.tldr: This work defines six scenarios for unified model reinforcement learning, providing systematic baselines for reinforcement learning of unified understanding and generation model.

2510.17938.tldr: The integration of AI into the medical degree in Spain is incipient, fragmented, and uneven, with a low weight in ECTS, which supports the establishment of minimum standards and national monitoring of indicators.

2510.17940.tldr: This work presents a diversity aware retrieval framework that selects in context exemplars to balance intent coverage and linguistic variety, and integrates this selection with standard LLM decoders, and offers a simple, deployable selection principle for building accurate, budget constrained multi turn intent systems.

2510.17941.tldr: This work develops a framework to measure belief depth and uses it to evaluate the success of knowledge editing techniques, and introduces measurable criteria for belief depth and enables the rigorous evaluation necessary for deploying knowledge editing in real-world applications.

2510.17942.tldr: This chapter examines the multifaceted concept of trust in foundation models, particularly within a geographic context, and categorizes trust into three types: epistemic trust in the training data, operational trust in the model's functionality, and interpersonal trust in the model developers.

2510.17944.tldr: This framework is an elaboration of the recently proposed framework of Topos Causal Models (TCMs), where causal interventions are defined as subobjects using the Lawvere-Tierney topology on a topos, defined by a modal operator on the subobject classifier $\Omega$.

2510.17948.tldr: A virtual reality study with 150 university participants role-playing as a school shooter demonstrated the potential of robotic intervention to enhance safety and the pressing ethical questions surrounding their use in school environments.

2510.17998.tldr: An representative set discovery algorithm which covers a benchmark using raw evaluation scores alone and can both preserve model ranks and predict performance on a held-out set of models with near zero mean-squared error (pounce).

2510.18003.tldr: A rigorous evaluation framework with formal error guarantees (concentration bounds and calibration analysis), calibrated on real data is developed that evaluates whether fabrication-oriented paper generation agents can deceive multi-model LLM review systems.

2510.18019.tldr: STEAM is introduced, a back-translation-based detection method that restores watermark strength lost through translation, and is compatible with any watermarking method, robust across different tokenizers and languages, non-invasive, and easily extendable to new languages.

2510.18029.tldr: This work presents DynaQuery - a unified, self-adapting framework that serves as a practical blueprint for next-generation "Unbound Databases", and uncovers a key generalization principle: the transition from pure schema-awareness to holistic semantics-awareness.

2510.18030.tldr: This work revisit global structured pruning and presents GISP-Global Iterative Structured Pruning-a post-training method that removes attention heads and MLP channels using first-order, loss-based important weights aggregated at the structure level with block-wise normalization.

2510.18032.tldr: A multi-agent verbal reinforcement learning algorithm that dynamically constructs and refines multi-agent collaboration structures and defines action spaces and a feedback mechanism that evaluates communication robustness and coherence throughout the debate is proposed.

2510.18038.tldr: This study applies TriggerNet to address red palm mite (Raoiella indica) infestation, a major threat to palm cultivation and agricultural productivity, and evaluates and comparing the ML model for classifying the affected plants and detecting the infestation.

2510.18040.tldr: A formalization of a subject-event ontology is proposed for modeling complex dynamic systems without reliance on global time, ensuring the correctness of executable ontologies: monotonicity of history, acyclicity of causality, traceability.

2510.18041.tldr: The Spatio-Temporal Operator Network (STONe), a non-autoregressive neural operator that learns a stable functional mapping between heterogeneous domains, is introduced, enabling real-time prediction of complex spatiotemporal fields in physics, climate, and energy systems.

2510.18043.tldr: CompactPrompt is introduced, an end-to-end pipeline that merges hard prompt compression with lightweight file-level data compression and helps visualize real-time compression decisions and quantify cost-performance trade-offs, laying the groundwork for leaner generative AI pipelines.

2510.18046.tldr: LaMAR is introduced, a LLM-driven semantic enrichment framework designed to enrich such sequences automatically by inferring latent semantic aspects of a user's intent and item relationships from existing metadata in a few-shot setting.

2510.18052.tldr: Anti-Causal Invariant Abstractions (ACIA), a novel measure-theoretic framework for anti-causal representation learning, employs a two-level design, low-level representations capture how labels generate observations, while high-level representations learn stable causal patterns across environment-specific variations.

2510.18053.tldr: Adaptive Divergence Regularized Policy Optimization (ADRPO) is introduced, which automatically adjusts regularization strength based on advantage estimates-reducing regularization for high-value samples while applying stronger regularization to poor samples, enabling policies to navigate between exploration and aggressive exploitation according to data quality.

2510.18072.tldr: AC-Flow is presented, a robust actor-critic framework that addresses challenges through three key innovations: reward shaping that provides well-normalized learning signals to enable stable intermediate value learning and gradient control, and a scalable generalized critic weighting scheme that extends traditional reward-weighted methods while preserving model diversity through Wasserstein regularization.

2510.18074.tldr: This work proposes a novel formulation in which the objective is to maximize the probability that the cumulative return exceeds a prescribed threshold, and demonstrates that this reliable RL problem can be reformulated, via a state-augmented representation, into a standard RL problem, thereby allowing the use of existing RL and deep RL algorithms without the need for entirely new algorithmic frameworks.

2510.18081.tldr: Any-Depth Alignment (ADA), an effective inference-time defense with negligible overhead, is proposed, built based on the observation that alignment is concentrated in the assistant header tokens through repeated use in shallow-refusal training, and these tokens possess the model's strong alignment priors.

2510.18084.tldr: A novel Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based framework for dynamic resource allocation in UAV relays, which formulates an optimization problem that integrates security-aware resource allocation, latency minimization, and energy efficiency, which is solved using RL.

2510.18085.tldr: This paper introduces and study Round-Robin Behavior Cloning (R2BC), a method that enables a single human operator to effectively train multi-robot systems through sequential, single-agent demonstrations.

2510.18087.tldr: This approach expands the speed-quality Pareto frontier and provides a practical path to faster, high-quality text generation on AlpacaEval, a suite of 805 instruction-following prompts.

2510.18091.tldr: Adaptive Patch Transformers (APT) significantly reduces training and inference time without loss of performance in high-resolution dense visual tasks, achieving up to 30\% faster training and inference in visual QA, object detection, and semantic segmentation.

2510.18103.tldr: This study develops and evaluates machine learning models that integrate both structured clinical data and unstructured textual information, specifically discharge summaries and radiology reports from the MIMIC-IV database, and demonstrates the added prognostic value of unstructured clinical notes.

2510.18104.tldr: It is argued for a shift from narrow AutoRecSys tools to an Autonomous Recommender-Systems Research Lab (AutoRecLab) that integrates end-to-end automation: problem ideation, literature analysis, experimental design and execution, result interpretation, manuscript drafting, and provenance logging.

2510.18123.tldr: This work presents the first systematic study of full-stack safety and security issues in natural-language-based collaborative driving, and introduces an agentic defense pipeline that integrates a semantic firewall, language-perception consistency checks, and multi-source consensus, enabled by an agentic transformation function for cross-frame spatial alignment.

2510.18143.tldr: PaDA-Agent (Pattern-guided Data Augmentation Agent), an evaluation-driven approach that streamlines the data augmentation process for SLMs through coordinated operations, demonstrates significant improvements over state-of-the-art LLM-based data augmentation approaches for Llama 3.2 1B Instruct model fine-tuning.

2510.18154.tldr: This paper presents a sentence-level labeled dataset that enables activation-based monitoring of safety behaviors during LLM reasoning, and demonstrates the potential of activation-level techniques for improving safety oversight on reasoning.

2510.18162.tldr: A novel method is proposed that adaptively selects task-appropriate prompting techniques based on users' abstract task descriptions and automatically generates high-quality prompts without relying on pre-existing templates or frameworks, enabling non-experts to effectively leverage LLMs.

2510.18165.tldr: This work introduces efficient Sampling with Adaptive acceleration and Backtracking Enhanced Remasking (i.e., Saber), a novel training-free sampling algorithm for DLMs to achieve better inference speed and output quality in code generation.

2510.18170.tldr: This work introduces AgentChangeBench, a benchmark explicitly designed to measure how tool augmented language model agents adapt to mid dialogue goal shifts across three enterprise domains, and establishes a reproducible testbed for diagnosing and improving agent resilience in realistic enterprise settings.

2510.18176.tldr: This work introduces trace coherence, a First-Order Logic (FOL)-based measure to capture the consistency of reasoning steps by identifying errors in the traces and argues that claims of improved reasoning via RL must be examined with care, as these may be based on improved trace coherence, which may not translate into fully valid mathematical proofs.

2510.18187.tldr: VelocityNet is introduced, a dual-pipeline framework that combines head detection and dense optical flow to extract person-specific velocities and measures deviations from learned normal patterns within densely crowded environments.

2510.18188.tldr: This work introduces RadDiagSeg-D, a dataset combining abnormality detection, diagnosis, and multi-target segmentation into a unified and hierarchical task, and proposes a novel vision-language model, RadDiagSeg-M, capable of joint abnormality detection, diagnosis, and flexible segmentation.

2510.18245.tldr: A conditional scaling law is introduced that augments the Chinchilla framework with architectural information, along with a search framework for identifying architectures that are simultaneously inference-efficient and accurate, and that outperform existing open-source baselines.

2510.18252.tldr: This work provides the first empirical evidence of an optimal"sweet spot" for data augmentation in credit scoring, with practical guidelines for industry practitioners and researchers working with imbalanced datasets.

2510.18256.tldr: A hyperbolic space learning method leveraging temporal motion prior for recovering 3D human meshes from videos, and a hyperbolic mesh optimization loss to make the optimization learning process of human meshes in hyperbolic space stable and effective.

2510.18257.tldr: Working memory is introduced, through which LLMs can alleviate the deficiencies caused by their own uncertainties and further obtain key insights to guide the generation of new prompts in self-evolve manner.

2510.18258.tldr: This work introduces an extended NTK matrix for MTL and adopts spectral analysis to balance the convergence speeds of multiple tasks, thereby mitigating task imbalance and proposes a new MTL method, NTKMTL.

2510.18267.tldr: A low-dimensional mesh pose interaction method through dimensionality reduction and parallel optimization that significantly reduces computational costs without sacrificing reconstruction accuracy is designed.

2510.18269.tldr: StreamingTOM is introduced, a training-free, plug-and-play two-stage framework that addresses both pre-LLM and post-LLM bottlenecks with predictable latency and maintains state-of-the-art accuracy among training-free methods.

2510.18297.tldr: MedRGAG is proposed, a unified retrieval-generation augmented framework that seamlessly integrates external and parametric knowledge for medical QA and achieves a 12.5% improvement over MedRAG and a 4.5% gain over MedGENIE, highlighting the effectiveness of unifying retrieval and generation for knowledge-intensive reasoning.

2510.18315.tldr: This work investigates how embedding dimension affects the emergence of an internal world model in a transformer trained with reinforcement learning to perform bubble-sort-style adjacent swaps and provides quantitative evidence that transformers build structured internal world models and that model size improves representation quality in addition to end performance.

2510.18328.tldr: Time-Conditioned Contraction Matching is introduced, a novel method for semi-supervised anomaly detection in tabular data that strikes a favorable balance between detection accuracy and inference cost, outperforming state-of-the-art methods -- especially on high-dimensional and large-scale datasets.

2510.18342.tldr: This work proposes ShortcutBreaker, a novel unified feature-reconstruction framework for MUAD tasks, featuring two key innovations to address the issue of shortcuts, including a low-rank noisy bottleneck (LRNB) to project highdimensional features into a low-rank latent space, and theoretically demonstrate its capacity to prevent trivial identity reproduction.

2510.18381.tldr: Through the concept of score-space sharpness minimization, which operates during the mask search by perturbing importance scores and minimizing the corresponding robust loss, this work introduces the concept of score-space sharpness minimization in adversarial pruning.

2510.18395.tldr: Case studies reveal the method retains LLMs'santic comprehension while resolving the "Knowing-Doing Gap" through strict state-action mapping, achieving both interpretability and FSM-like reliability.

2510.18405.tldr: An automated approach for cricket video analysis that identifies wicket-taking deliveries, detects the pitch and ball, and models ball trajectories for post-match assessment is presented, highlighting its potential for supporting coaching, tactical evaluation, and data-driven decision-making in cricket.

2510.18407.tldr: Heterogeneous Adversarial Play is presented, an adversarial Automatic Curriculum Learning framework that formalizes teacher-student interactions as a minimax optimization wherein task-generating instructor and problem-solving learner co-evolve through adversarial dynamics.

2510.18417.tldr: A lightweight verification approach based on interpretable models to validate the behavior of Deep Reinforcement Learning agents for RAN slicing and scheduling in Open RAN using Decision Tree (DT)-based verifiers to perform near-real-time consistency checks at runtime.

2510.18424.tldr: By combining the Visual Guidance with tree search, this work improves the medical visual reasoning capabilities of VLMs by fine-tuning the VLMs with the proximal policy optimization (PPO) objective.

2510.18425.tldr: A foundation model-driven framework that automatically identifies waterlogged areas in surveillance images and generates structured assessment reports and enables a shift of waterlogging monitoring from perception to generation, while the collaborative framework of multiple foundation models lays the groundwork for intelligent and scalable systems.

2510.18429.tldr: This work introduces an"optimistic"version of $\lambda$-superposition that delays explosive unification problems using constraints stored along with the clauses, and it applies functional extensionality in a more targeted way.

2510.18433.tldr: This work introduces ImageGem, a dataset for studying generative models that understand fine-grained individual preferences, and proposes an end-to-end framework for editing customized diffusion models in a latent weight space to align with individual user preferences.

2510.18459.tldr: DeLoad is proposed, a novel preloading framework that addresses issues by introducing dynamic task sizing and a practical, multi-dimensional watch-time estimation method, and a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-enhanced agent is trained to optimize the download range decisions adaptively.

2510.18467.tldr: This work innovatively integrate temporal modeling into spatial learning via a novel dynamic attention mechanism, which retains attention information from historical graph snapshots to guide subsequent attention computation, thereby improving the overall discriminative representations learning of HTGs.

2510.18471.tldr: This paper proposes CodeRL+, a novel approach that integrates execution semantics alignment into the RLVR training pipeline for code generation, and enables the model to infer variable-level execution trajectory, providing a direct learning signal of execution semantics.

2510.18473.tldr: A benchmarking study on fairness-aware GNNs on knowledge graphs is introduced, which generates new graphs from three knowledge graphs that are significantly larger than the existing graph datasets used in fairness studies.

2510.18476.tldr: Early results suggest that probabilistic intent modeling can contribute to the development of socially intelligent LLM agents in multi-turn social dialogue.

2510.18483.tldr: StarBench is introduced, a turn-based RPG benchmark derived from Honkai: Star Rail that targets two human-like competencies: multimodal decision-making from pixels to actions and agentic information seeking, establishing StarBench as a reproducible yardstick for agentic information seeking and multimodal decision-making in real-client play.

2510.18488.tldr: This work enhances AndroidControl into AndroidControl-Curated, a refined version of the benchmark improved through a rigorous purification pipeline, and introduces a new SOTA model, Magma-R1- 3B, despite being 200 times smaller in parameters, which delivers performance comparable to Qwen3- VL-235B.

2510.18491.tldr: This work introduces Crucible, an agent that employs an LLM-driven, multi-level expert simulation to turn algorithms and defines a formalized metric to quantitatively evaluate their Tuning Potential, providing a new dimension for algorithm analysis and design.

2510.18493.tldr: This work proposes MASK (Modular Adaptive Sanitization Kit), a trainable and extensible framework that enables dynamic privacy adjustment based on individual preferences, enabling the creation of truly personalized, privacy-aware LLM-based detection systems that balance user trust and detection effectiveness, even beyond phone scam context.

2510.18502.tldr: A pipeline that integrates vision language models (VLMs) with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to support zero-shot recognition through text-based reasoning and demonstrates the potential of RAG-enhanced LM reasoning for scalable VMMR in smart-city applications.

2510.18541.tldr: This paper introduces a new backdooring technique, T-MTB, that enables the construction and study of transferable backdoors and demonstrates and extensively study the security risks of transferable backdoors across two attack scenarios, jailbreaking and content modulation, and across four model families of LLMs.

2510.18559.tldr: RAISE (Responsible AI Scoring and Evaluation), a unified framework that quantifies model performance across these four dimensions and aggregates them into a single, holistic Responsibility Score, is introduced.

2510.18560.tldr: WebDevJudge is introduced, a systematic benchmark for assessing LLM-as-a-judge performance in web development, with support for both non-interactive evaluation based on static observations and continuous interactive evaluation with a dynamic web environment.

2510.18561.tldr: The results show that large language models detect complex interactions in tales, enabling computational analysis of extensive text collections and facilitating cross-lingual comparisons.

2510.18569.tldr: QuantEvolve is presented, an evolutionary framework that combines quality-diversity optimization with hypothesis-driven strategy generation, and outperforms conventional baselines, validating its effectiveness.

2510.18581.tldr: It is argued that involving experts from technology, healthcare, ethics, ethics, and law across key lifecycle phases is essential to ensure value-alignment and compliance with the high-risk requirements of the AI Act.

2306.07032.tldr: This work proposes a strategy resilient to edge-level prior errors for CSL, thereby minimizing human intervention and highlights its substantial ability to resist order-reversed errors while maintaining the majority of correct prior.

2406.04082.tldr: A computational method is developed that automatically discovers project selection strategies that are optimized for real people, and an intelligent tutor is developed that teaches the discovered project selection procedures.

2408.00166.tldr: This review article discusses state-of-the-art approaches of explainable recommender systems and categorizes them based on three aspects: learning methods, explaining methods, and explanation types.

2410.15700.tldr: This work proposes an intuitive yet effective method, which utilizes a critic model to capture the preference information and to guide the search of the prover model at runtime, and analyzes the impact of the critic on various aspects of the theorem proving process during expert iteration, providing insights into its effectiveness.

2501.01166.tldr: This paper systematically examines progress across key tasks, including region-of-interest segmentation, feature extraction, and security/privacy-oriented challenges, and identifies current challenges and uncovers promising opportunities for future research.

2502.01472.tldr: Fine-grained Activation manipuLation by Contrastive Orthogonal uNalignment (FALCON), a novel representation-guided unlearning approach that leverages information-theoretic guidance for efficient parameter selection, employs contrastive mechanisms to enhance representation separation, and projects conflict gradients onto orthogonal subspaces to resolve conflicts between forgetting and retention objectives.

2502.21262.tldr: It is suggested that modeling human beliefs can improve value learning and outlines practical research directions for implementing this approach to scalable oversight.

2505.02048.tldr: YODA outperforms eight state-of-the-art DMs and GANs and challenges the presumed superiority of DMs and GANs over computationally cheap regression models for high-quality MIT, and shows that YODA-translated images are interchangeable with, or even superior to, physical acquisitions for several medical applications.

2505.03739.tldr: VITA-Audio is the first multi-modal large language model capable of generating audio output during the first forward pass, enabling real-time conversational capabilities with minimal latency and significantly outperforms open-source models of similar model size on multiple benchmarks.

2505.03835.tldr: The findings suggest that global disruptions may have accelerated preprint adoption, but the extent and trajectory are shaped by local research cultures, policy environments, and levels of open science maturity.

2505.05701.tldr: A simple yet effective plug-and-play pretraining method to initialize a feature of a Q-network to enhance data efficiency in offline RL and significantly boosts data-efficient offline RL across various data qualities and data distributions trough D4RL and ExoRL benchmarks.

2505.15009.tldr: It is shown that a class of transformers with either linear, ReLU or softmax attentions, is provably Bayes-optimal for an in-context recall task and that the expected loss converges at linear rate to the Bayes risks when being trained with gradient descent.

2505.17148.tldr: A text-to-programs framework that leverages Large Language Models to process natural language queries as executable code for analyzing historical cadastral records is presented, demonstrating the system's effectiveness in reconstructing past population information, property features, and spatiotemporal comparisons in Venice.

2506.02672.tldr: The EvaLearn benchmark is introduced, a pioneering benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on their learning capability and efficiency in challenging tasks, and it is observed that current LLMs with stronger static abilities do not show a clear advantage in learning capability across all tasks, highlighting that EvaLearn evaluates a new dimension of model performance.

2506.05188.tldr: This work studies in-context counterfactual reasoning in language models, that is, the ability to predict consequences of a hypothetical scenario, on a well-defined, synthetic linear regression task that requires noise abduction.

2506.10959.tldr: A novel connection is established between the attention mechanism and classical kernel methods, demonstrating that transformers effectively perform kernel-based prediction at a new query through its interaction with the prompt, and characterizes how the generalization error scales with the number of training tasks.

2508.03963.tldr: This work introduces SymbolBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess symbolic reasoning over real-world time series across three tasks: multivariate symbolic regression, Boolean network inference, and causal discovery, and proposes a unified framework that integrates LLMs with genetic programming to form a closed-loop symbolic reasoning system.

2508.09507.tldr: An automated multi-modal evaluation framework based on large language models and multi-agent collaboration is proposed that achieves a significant evaluation matching accuracy with human experts.

2508.17094.tldr: An agentic system PowerChain is built, which is capable of autonomously performing complex grid analyses and dynamically generates structured context by leveraging supervisory signals from self-contained power systems tools and an optimized set of expert-annotated and verified reasoning trajectories.

2508.18898.tldr: This paper proposes loss functions that pro-mote the interpretability of the model by generating sparse and localized feature maps, which improves interpretability, which correlates with reducing infractions, yielding a safer, high-performance driving model.

2509.14456.tldr: It is shown that LLMs can achieve good performance with minimal prompting in both coreference disambiguation and the detection of ambiguity in coreference, however, they cannot do both at the same time.

2510.00063.tldr: An extensive evaluation of 25 diverse MLLMs, including 22 open-source and 3 closed-source models, using AstroMMBench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs in astronomical image understanding shows that Ovis2-34B achieved the highest overall accuracy, demonstrating leading capabilities even compared to strong closed-source models.

2510.03417.tldr: NEXUS (Network Exploration for eXploiting Unsafe Sequences), a modular framework for constructing, refining, and executing optimized multi-turn attacks, uncovers stealthy, high-success adversarial paths across LLMs.

2510.08049.tldr: This survey provides a systematic overview of PRMs through the full loop: how to generate process data, build PRMs, and use PRMs for test-time scaling and reinforcement learning.

2510.08189.tldr: R-HORIZON is proposed, a method designed to stimulate long-horizon reasoning behaviors in LRMs through query composition, and positioned as a scalable, controllable, and low-cost paradigm for enhancing and evaluating the long-horizon reasoning capabilities of LRMs.

2510.10025.tldr: The research fine-tune BERT-base and DistilBERT with three objectives-cross-entropy (CE), class-weighted CE, and focal loss-under identical tokenization, sequence length, optimizer, and schedule, and finds DistilBERT with plain CE gives the strongest raw trade-off.

2510.10806.tldr: This work proposes a novel bottom-up method to linearize knowledge from tree-like structures by generating implicit, aggregated summaries at each hierarchical level, and suggests that leveraging implicit, linearized knowledge may be a highly effective and scalable strategy for handling complex, hierarchical data structures.

2510.11370.tldr: Rollout Routing Replay (R3), a method that records routing distributions from the inference engine and replays them during training significantly reduces training-inference policy KL divergence and mitigates extreme discrepancies without compromising training speed, is proposed.

2510.13982.tldr: It is argued that static, task-specific benchmarks are fundamentally inadequate and must be rethought, and a research roadmap centered on open-endedness, continuous co-evolution, and the development of resilient, socially aligned AI ecosystems is presented.

2510.15511.tldr: This work proves mathematically that transformer language models mapping discrete input sequences to their corresponding sequence of continuous representations are injective and therefore lossless, a property established at initialization and preserved during training.

2510.16028.tldr: TAO reconciles scalability with verifiability for real-world heterogeneous ML compute, and is implemented as a PyTorch-compatible runtime and a contract layer currently deployed on Ethereum Holesky testnet.

2510.17626.tldr: This work introduces Car Models in Time (CaMiT), a fine-grained dataset capturing the temporal evolution of car models, a representative class of technological artifacts, and evaluates two strategies: time-incremental pretraining, which updates the backbone, and time-incremental classifier learning, which updates only the final layer, both improving temporal robustness.

2510.17879.tldr: A novel EEG person identification approach using spiking neural networks (SNNs) with a lightweight spiking transformer for efficiency and effectiveness using spiking neural networks with lightweight spiking transformer for efficiency and effectiveness.

2510.17995.tldr: This paper formalizes the schema for agentic records, details the prompt design principles that guide generation, and introduces scalable pipelines for high-quality synthetic data, providing a reproducible, LLM-only alternative to manual collection.

2510.18155.tldr: An LLM-powered multi-agent simulation framework that models consumer decisions and social dynamics and enables generative agents to interact, express internal reasoning, form habits, and make purchasing decisions without predefined rules is introduced.

2510.18628.tldr: In this approach, data mining is used to derive association rules from data that are leveraged to increase the predictive performance of tree-based models used for a classification task and improve the corresponding explanation task through the generation of abductive explanations.

2510.18632.tldr: 3DThinker is a framework that can effectively exploits the rich geometric information embedded within images while reasoning, like humans do and is the first to enable 3D mentaling during reasoning without any 3D prior input.

2510.18633.tldr: The main finding is that estimating document relevance using rank information and human judgments yields a 35% gain in document-level precision, 15% increase in {\alpha}-nDCG, and better performance on the downstream task of long-form generation.

2510.18636.tldr: This paper proposes a novel one-shot pruning framework that leverages cause-effect relations between model predictions and structures in a progressive pruning process, and introduces a causal-aware pruning approach that leverages cause-effect relations between model predictions and structures in a progressive pruning process.

2510.18650.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that BQQ consistently achieves a superior trade-off between memory efficiency and reconstruction error than conventional methods for compressing diverse matrix data, and highlights the surprising effectiveness of binary quadratic expressions for efficient matrix approximation and neural network compression.

2510.18659.tldr: SherlockLLM is a dialogue-driven retrieval framework that learns an optimal questioning strategy via Reinforcement Learning (RL) and avoids the need for large-scale annotated dialogue data and demonstrates its ability to learn a highly effective information-seeking dialogue policy.

2510.18672.tldr: The main takeaways are that model quantization methods and speculative decoding can improve service system efficiency with small compromise to RLLM accuracy, while prefix caching, KV cache quantization may even degrade accuracy or serving performance for small RLLM.

2510.18674.tldr: An exploratory empirical study on membership inference vulnerabilities in clinical LLMs, focusing on whether adversaries can infer if specific patient records were used during model training, to strengthen the security and trustworthiness of healthcare AI systems.

2510.18699.tldr: The Fetch.ai architecture is introduced, an industrial-strength platform designed to bridge the gap by facilitating the integration of classical MAS principles with modern AI capabilities, and provides a principled architecture for moving beyond current agent implementations towards open, collaborative, and economically sustainable multi-agent ecosystems.

2510.18719.tldr: This paper proposes a generic framework of causally perturbed fairness testing, dubbed CausalFT, that serves as a higher-level framework that can be paired with diverse base generators and can better improve bias resilience in nearly all cases.

2510.18728.tldr: HarmNet, a modular framework comprising ThoughtNet, a hierarchical semantic network; a feedback-driven Simulator for iterative query refinement; and a Network Traverser for real-time adaptive attack execution is introduced.

2510.18731.tldr: This work proposes Curriculum Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Accuracy and Abstention Rewards (RLAAR), a framework that encourages models not only to generate correct answers, but also to judge the solvability of questions in the multi-turn conversation setting.

2510.18803.tldr: A comprehensive comparative evaluation of three topic modelling approaches is conducted, highlighting that while all models effectively delineate core scientific domains, BERTopic outperformed by consistently identifying more granular, coherent, and emergent themes, such as the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence.

2510.18814.tldr: Self-evolving Post-Training (SePT), a simple post-training method that alternates between self-generation and training on self-generated responses, repeatedly samples questions, uses the model itself to generate low-temperature responses, and then finetunes the model on the self-generated data.

2510.18817.tldr: A knowledge distillation framework for industrial asset health is proposed, which transfers reasoning capabilities via Chain-of-Thought (CoT) distillation from Large Language Models (LLMs) to smaller, more efficient models (SLMs).

2510.18819.tldr: A teacher--student framework which enhances both disease and symptom detection on chest X-rays by integrating two supervised heads and a self-supervised head is proposed, demonstrating promise for deployment in clinical screening and triage settings.

2510.18849.tldr: Critique-Post-Edit is proposed, a robust reinforcement learning framework that enables more faithful and controllable personalization in large language models and substantially outperforms standard PPO on personalization benchmarks.

2510.18851.tldr: Direct Perceptual Preference Optimization for Real-ISR (DP$^2$O-SR) is introduced, a framework that aligns generative models with perceptual preferences without requiring costly human annotations and proposes hierarchical preference optimization, which adaptively weights training pairs based on intra-group reward gaps and inter-group diversity, enabling more efficient and stable learning.

2510.18852.tldr: A novel Lyapunov-Based Quantum Reinforcement Learning (LQRL) framework that integrates quantum policy optimization with Lyapunov stability analysis for continuous-time vehicle control is presented, demonstrating the feasibility of integrating safety guarantees within quantum reinforcement learning architectures.

2510.18871.tldr: A "Guess-then-Refine"framework that explains how LLMs internally structure their computations to make predictions is proposed, shedding light on the layer-by-layer computations that underlie successful predictions and providing insights for future works to improve computational efficiency in transformer-based models.

2306.10407.tldr: This work proposes Fokker--Planck inverse reinforcement learning (FP-IRL), a novel physics-constrained IRL framework tailored for systems governed by Fokker--Planck dynamics, and shows that FP-IRL achieves accurate recovery of agent incentives while preserving computational efficiency and physical interpretability.

2308.08728.tldr: This research represents the first application of LLM-FuncMapper for interpreting complex design clauses into executable code, which may shed light on further adoption of LLMs in the construction domain.

2310.18608.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive analysis of recent advances in recommender system embedding techniques, and introduces emerging approaches, including AutoML, hashing techniques, and quantization methods, to enhance performance while reducing computational complexity.

2312.10107.tldr: This work formalizes the notion of context as a permutation-invariant representation of a set of data points that originate from the same domain as the input itself, and presents a method to select between the most predictive and the most robust model.

2405.11647.tldr: This work introduces a novel statistical metric, Alignment Dimension Conflict, to quantify the degree of conflict within preference datasets and develops reward models, HummerRM and HummerRM-F, which employ a hybrid sampling approach to balance diverse alignment objectives effectively.

2406.18851.tldr: This work introduces LICO, a general-purpose model that extends arbitrary base LLMs for black-box optimization, with a particular application to the molecular domain, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on its low-budget version PMO-1K.

2406.19195.tldr: To remove the unobserved confounders in the long-term observational data, an optimal transport weighting framework is introduced to align the long-term observational data to an auxiliary short-term experimental data and a generalization bound on counterfactual prediction error is established.

2409.03811.tldr: This work proposes PARCO (Parallel AutoRegressive Combinatorial Optimization), a general reinforcement learning framework designed to construct high-quality solutions for multi-agent combinatorial tasks efficiently and outperforms state-of-the-art learning methods, demonstrating strong generalization ability and remarkable computational efficiency.

2410.06019.tldr: The method enables two complementary exploration procedures: the first retrieves input instances that produce the same class probability distribution as the original instance-thus identifying elements within the same equivalence class-while the second discovers instances that yield a different class probability distribution, effectively navigating toward distinct equivalence classes.

2410.07836.tldr: This work replaces the traditional MLP prior with a Masked Generative Prior (e.g., MaskGIT Prior) and introduces GIT-STORM, a Transformer-based World Models to continuous action environments for the first time, addressing a significant gap in prior research.

2411.13022.tldr: Compressibility-inspired Unsupervised Learning via Parallel Imaging Fidelity (CUPID) is proposed for high-quality PD-DL training using only routine clinical reconstructed images exported from an MRI scanner, demonstrating its effectiveness in a zero-shot training setup for retrospectively and prospectively sub-sampled acquisitions.

2412.00744.tldr: A Curriculum-Based Training strategy that progressively enhances the tracking performance in complex environments is introduced, and a novel reinforcement learning method called GC-VAT is proposed, which aims to improve the performance of drone tracking targets in complex scenarios.

2412.01322.tldr: This study presents a methodology that utilizes Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks—a recent deep learning alternative to Multilayer Perceptrons that achieves perfect F1-Scores for fault detection and high performance in fault and severity classification tasks, including 100% F1-Scores in most cases.

2501.04961.tldr: This work introduces FINDAP, a systematic and fine-grained investigation into domain-adaptive post-training of LLMs for the finance domain, and highlights how each post-training stage contributes to distinct capabilities, uncovering specific challenges and effective solutions.

2501.13133.tldr: This work leverages the representational capabilities of diffusion models to learn meaningful embeddings for graph data by training a discrete diffusion model within an autoencoder framework, enabling both effective autoencoding and representation learning tailored to the unique characteristics of graph-structured data.

2502.00937.tldr: This work proposes ModServe, a modular LMM serving system that decouples model stages for independent optimization and adaptive scaling, and dynamically reconfigures stages and handles bursty traffic with modality-aware scheduling and autoscaling to meet tail latency SLOs while minimizing costs.

2502.02197.tldr: This paper proposes a method for identifying polarized communities that addresses a major limitation of prior methods: their tendency to produce highly size-imbalanced solutions, and introduces a novel optimization objective that avoids such imbalance.

2503.01872.tldr: This paper proposes FairGen, an adaptive latent guidance mechanism which controls the generation distribution during inference, and introduces the Holistic Bias Evaluation benchmark, which covers diverse domains and incorporates complex prompts to assess bias more comprehensively.

2503.07663.tldr: This work proposes an elegantly simple MCL paradigm called "MErge then ReAlign"(MERA) to address both forgetting and misalignment in MCL, and showcases how to adjust different components of MLLMs during continual learning.

2503.12499.tldr: A Parallel Thinking-based Facilitation Agent (PTFA) that facilitates online, text-based consensus building processes and automatically collects real-time textual input and leverages large language models (LLMs) to perform all six distinct roles of the well-established Six Thinking Hats technique in parallel thinking.

2503.12730.tldr: This work proposes text-to-SQL generation as an ideal task to study, as it combines the formal structure of toy tasks with real-world complexity and provides a robust framework for probing and comparing interpretability methods in a structured, progressively complex setting.

2503.13414.tldr: It is formally prove that Q-M, under discrete domains, does not affect the optimality of the returned policy and show that it is provably efficient in terms of sample complexity in a probabilistic sense.

2503.18129.tldr: A benchmark for evaluating tool-calling capabilities of large language models (LLMs) on multi-step geospatial tasks relevant to commercial GIS practitioners is established, and a LLM-as-Judge evaluation framework to compare agent solutions against reference solutions is developed.
