2504.07711.tldr: This paper introduces a novel approach to online topic modeling named StreamETM, which builds on the Embedded Topic Model (ETM) to handle data streams by merging models learned on consecutive partial document batches using unbalanced optimal transport.

2504.09909.tldr: This paper attempts to provide a survey on how quantum meets language by mapping state-of-the-art in this area, embracing quantum encoding techniques for classical data, QNLP models for prevalent NLP tasks, and quantum optimisation techniques for hyper parameter tuning.

2505.07897.tldr: It is found that long-context remains a weakness for all models, with performance drops such as from 29% to 3% for Claude 3.5 Sonnet, or from 70.2% to 40% for Qwen2.5.

2505.08727.tldr: The Information Bottleneck Language Modeling objective is introduced, which reframes language modeling as a constrained optimization problem: minimizing representation entropy subject to optimal prediction performance.

2505.09160.tldr: ContraWiMAE, Wireless Contrastive Masked Autoencoder, a transformer-based foundation model that unifies masked reconstruction and masked contrastive learning for wireless channel representation and exhibits superior linear separability and adaptability in diverse wireless environments.

2505.11576.tldr: This work proposes three methods to extract recurring chunks on a neural population level, complementing each other based on label availability and neural data dimensionality and shows that extracted chunks play a causal role in network behavior, as grafting them leads to controlled and predictable changes in the model's behavior.

2505.14455.tldr: CtrlDiff is proposed, a dynamic and controllable semi-autoregressive framework that adaptively determines the size of each generation block based on local semantics using reinforcement learning, and introduces a classifier-guided control mechanism tailored to discrete diffusion, which significantly reduces computational overhead while facilitating efficient post-hoc conditioning without retraining.

2505.14489.tldr: It is demonstrated that reasoning models that engage in extended chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning exhibit superior performance not only in problem-solving but also in accurately expressing their confidence.

2505.14689.tldr: A novel dynamic post-shielding framework that enforces the full class of $\omega-regular correctness properties over pre-computed probabilistic policies, and introduces a mechanism to dynamically control interference, allowing a tunable enforcement parameter to balance formal obligations and task-specific behavior at runtime.

2505.15754.tldr: This work proposes to control the continuous decision timescale directly by using temporally-extended actions and letting the planner treat the duration of the action as an additional optimization variable along with the standard action variables, and shows that this approach yields faster planning, better solutions, and that it enables solutions to problems that are not solved in the standard formulation.

2505.17950.tldr: This study explores how contemporary embedding models differ in their capability to process and interpret science-related symbolic expressions, with OpenAI's GPT-text-embedding-3-large outperforming all other examined models, though its advantage over other models was moderate rather than decisive.

2505.18817.tldr: This work proposes QHFlow, a high-order equivariant flow matching framework that generates Hamiltonian matrices conditioned on molecular geometry that achieves state-of-the-art performance and accelerates the DFT process without trading off the solution quality when initializing SCF iterations with the predicted Hamiltonian, significantly reducing the number of iterations and runtime.

2505.19955.tldr: This work introduces MLR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating AI agents on open-ended machine learning research, and validate MLR-Judge through human evaluation, showing high agreement with expert reviewers, supporting its potential as a scalable tool for research evaluation.

2505.23686.tldr: ROTATE is introduced, a regret-driven, open-ended training algorithm that alternates between improving the AHT agent and generating teammates that probe its deficiencies, thus establishing a new standard for robust and generalizable teamwork.

2505.24379.tldr: It is suggested that unlearning may, in a contradictory way, increase the risk of privacy leakage during real-world deployments, and is advocated for evaluation of unlearning methods to consider broader threat models that account not only for post-unlearning models but also for adversarial access to prior checkpoints.

2505.24625.tldr: This research proposes a novel and efficient method called the Video-3D Geometry Large Language Model (VG LLM), which utilizes a 3D visual geometry encoder to extract 3D prior information from video sequences, and achieves competitive results compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.

2506.00711.tldr: Q-Med-7B/32B is introduced, the first open generalist clinical foundation model that jointly reasons across medical images, time-series signals, and text reports and shows that DRPO training boosts diagnostic performance by 43% in macro-F1 on average across all visual domains as compared to other critic-free training methods like GRPO.

2506.04168.tldr: This work hypothesizes that the horizon is the main cause behind the poor scaling of offline RL and empirically verify this hypothesis through several analysis experiments, showing that long horizons indeed present a fundamental barrier to scaling up offline RL, and shows that various horizon reduction techniques substantially enhance scalability on challenging tasks.

2506.06407.tldr: This work proposes TimeWak, the first watermarking algorithm for multivariate time series diffusion models, which embeds a temporal chained-hashing watermark directly within the temporal-feature data space and derives the error bound of inverting multivariate time series while preserving robust watermark detectability.

2506.08800.tldr: This paper finds a dominant focus on a small subset of goal-oriented activities, largely ignoring data management and exploratory activities; a concentration on pure assistance or fully autonomous agents, without considering intermediate levels of human-AI collaboration; and an emphasis on human substitution neglecting the possibility of higher levels of automation thanks to task transformation.

2506.10946.tldr: This work proposes GUARD, a novel framework for Guided Unlearning And Retention via Data attribution, which introduces a lightweight proxy data attribution metric tailored for LLM unlearning, which quantifies the alignment between the Forget and Retain sets while remaining computationally efficient and mitigates unintended retention loss.

2506.13579.tldr: DDOT achieves performance on par with state-of-the-art non-autoregressive models and enables significant improvements in training efficiency and flexibility, and is compatible with various pretrained text denoisers.

2506.15591.tldr: A Dual LoRA Learning (DLoRAL) paradigm to train an effective SD-based one-step diffusion model, achieving realistic frame details and temporal consistency simultaneously, and achieves strong performance in both accuracy and speed.

2506.16313.tldr: This research integrates epistemic neural networks (ENN) with the conventional architecture of GFlowNets to enable more efficient joint predictions and better uncertainty quantification, thereby improving exploration and the identification of optimal trajectories.

2506.16895.tldr: The feasibility of building multimodal models with limited amount of paired data by aligning pretrained unimodal foundation models is explored and STRUCTURE, an effective regularization technique that preserves the neighborhood geometry of the latent space of unimodal encoders is introduced.

2506.16962.tldr: MICS first leverages mentor models to initialize the reasoning, one step at a time, then prompts each intern model to continue the thinking along those initiated paths, and finally selects the optimal reasoning path according to the overall reasoning performance of multiple intern models.

2506.18167.tldr: This work identifies several reasoning behaviors exhibited by thinking models, including expressing uncertainty, generating examples for hypothesis validation, and backtracking in reasoning chains, and provides a method to modulate specific aspects of the model's reasoning process, such as its tendency to backtrack or express uncertainty.

2506.21374.tldr: NANOADAM is proposed, which dynamically updates only the small-magnitude weights during finetuning and offers several practical advantages: first, this criterion is gradient-free -- the parameter subset can be determined without gradient computation; second, it preserves large-magnitude weights, which are likely to encode critical features learned during pretraining, thereby reducing the risk of catastrophic forgetting.

2507.05101.tldr: This work introduces PRING, the first comprehensive benchmark that evaluates protein-protein interaction prediction from a graph-level perspective and believes PRING provides a reliable platform to guide the development of more effective PPI prediction models for the community.

2507.05916.tldr: This article methodologically and experimentally analyzes ten explanation metrics and provides guidelines for selecting explanation methods, metrics, and hyperparameters in the context of RS image scene classification and identifies key limitations in both explanation methods and metrics.

2507.07780.tldr: It is found that simultaneously applying entropy regularisation and label smoothing yield the best calibrated raw probabilities under dataset shift, and ensembling remains one of the most effective methods to improve calibration robustness and, combined with finetuning from foundation models, yields best calibration results overall.

2507.15268.tldr: This study introduces IM-Chat, a multi-agent framework based on large language models (LLMs), designed to facilitate knowledge transfer in injection molding, and demonstrates the viability of multi-agent LLM systems for industrial knowledge workflows and establishes IM-Chat as a scalable and generalizable approach to AI-assisted decision support in manufacturing.

2508.00890.tldr: AgentTTS is proposed, an LLM-agent-based framework that autonomously searches for compute-optimal allocations through iterative feedback-driven interactions with the execution environment, and shows improved robustness to varying training set sizes and enhanced interpretability.

2508.02344.tldr: This work introduces Traffic-R1, a 3B-parameter foundation model with human-like reasoning for Traffic signal control (TSC), developed via self-exploration and iterative reinforcement of LLM with expert guidance in a simulated traffic environment that outperforms strong baselines and training-intensive RL controllers.

2508.02511.tldr: PI provides an interface to dynamically guide and regulate reasoning paths during inference through timely and proper interventions and post-intervention sampling, allowing human problem-solving expertise and cognitive science principles to be seamlessly integrated into LLMs'reasoning processes, enhancing controllability and interpretability.

2508.06098.tldr: This paper presents MeanAudio, a fast and faithful text-to-audio generator capable of rendering realistic sound with only one function evaluation (1-NFE), and achieves state-of-the-art performance in single-step audio generation.

2508.15831.tldr: The first systematic audit of disability-conditioned demographic bias across eight state-of-the-art instruction-tuned LLMs ranging from 3B to 72B parameters is presented and persistent intersections between ableism and other demographic stereotypes are revealed, pinpointing critical blind spots in current alignment strategies.

2508.21589.tldr: Middo is introduced, a self-evolving Model-informed dynamic data optimization framework that uses model-aware data selection and context-preserving data refinement for sustainable LLM training through dynamic human-AI co-evolution of data and models.

2509.05346.tldr: An empirical comparison of three state-of-the-art LLMs on a tutoring task simulating a realistic learning setting reveals that GPT-4o is generally preferred, producing feedback that is more informative and better structured than its counterparts, whereas DeepSeek-V3 and GLM-4.5 demonstrate intermittent strengths but lower consistency.

2509.17452.tldr: A training-free label-space alignment method for UniDA that aligns label spaces instead of visual spaces by filtering and refining noisy labels between the domains, and constructs a universal classifier that integrates both shared knowledge and target-private class information, thereby improving generalizability under domain shifts.

2509.18648.tldr: SPiDR, short for Sim-to-real via Pessimistic Domain Randomization -- a scalable algorithm with provable guarantees for safe sim-to-real transfer, is proposed, making it versatile and highly compatible with existing training pipelines.

2509.18942.tldr: DEAL, a novel framework that integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with a continuous fine-tuning strategy that incorporates knowledge retention and adaptive parameter update modules, mitigates the limitations of existing FT methods while maintaining efficiency.

2509.20214.tldr: Q-Palette is introduced, a versatile collection of fractional-bit quantizers that range from trellis-coded quantizers offering near-optimal distortion to simpler vector and scalar quantizers optimized for faster inference, all efficiently implemented with optimized CUDA kernels across various bitwidths.

2509.21567.tldr: This study provides a comprehensive comparison between the machine learning models that have been widely used in previous studies in the EEG-based neuromarketing such as Support Vector Machine (SVM), and the models which are not used or rarely used in the field, like Graph Neural Networks.

2509.23426.tldr: In a case study of hypercholesterolemia, ToolUniverse was used to create an AI scientist to identify a potent analog of a drug with favorable predicted properties and was used to create an AI scientist to identify a potent analog of a drug with favorable predicted properties.

2509.25434.tldr: The first open, machine-readable format for representing case and syndrome definitions is proposed, and the first comprehensive dataset of standardized case definitions and tools to convert existing human-readable definitions into machine-readable formats are introduced.

2510.03502.tldr: ALHD establishes a foundation for research related to Arabic LLM-detection and mitigating risks of misinformation, academic dishonesty, and cyber threats, and demonstrates that fine-tuned BERT models achieve competitive performance, outperforming LLM-based models.

2510.05126.tldr: This work fine-tune LLMs on datasets spanning general knowledge, mathematics, and open-ended trivia, and evaluates two metacognitive tasks: single-question confidence estimation and pairwise confidence comparison, where the model selects which of two answers it is more likely to answer correctly.

2510.06293.tldr: Conceived as a model-agnostic paradigm for video prediction, BlockGPT factorizes space-time by using self-attention within each frame and causal attention across frames, and achieves superior accuracy, event localization as measured by categorical metrics, and inference speeds up to 31x faster than comparable baselines.

2510.07364.tldr: A hybrid model is proposed where reasoning mechanisms in base models are activated at the right time to elicit thinking-model-level reasoning chains, implying that thinking models exploit already existing capabilities.

2510.08450.tldr: This paper re-examines the over-squashing phenomenon through the lens of model storage and retrieval capacity, which is defined as the amount of information that can be stored in a node's representation for later use and develops a novel GNN architecture with improved capacity.

2510.08666.tldr: dInfer decomposes the inference pipeline into four modular components--model, diffusion iteration manager, decoding strategy, and KV-cache manager--and integrates novel algorithms for each component alongside system-level optimizations, achieving substantial efficiency gains without compromising output quality on LLaDA-MoE.

2510.11474.tldr: A novel 3D multi-agent air combat environment and a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning framework are introduced to tackle these challenges and empirical results show that the hierarchical approach improves both learning efficiency and combat performance in complex dogfight scenarios.

2510.14176.tldr: This work uses FMs to automatically generate RMs from natural language specifications, and uses language embeddings with each RM automata-state to enable generalization across tasks, including evidence of zero-shot generalization.

2510.14623.tldr: LeapFactual is a novel counterfactual explanation algorithm based on conditional flow matching that generates reliable and informative counterfactuals, even when true and learned decision boundaries diverge, and can handle human-in-the-loop systems.

2510.14828.tldr: This work proposes RoboGPT-R1, a two-stage fine-tuning framework for embodied planning that combines supervised training with RL to address the model's shortcomings in visual-spatial understanding and reasoning, and designs a rule-based reward function that simultaneously considers long-horizon performance and action constraint in the environment.

2510.15020.tldr: An understanding of the coverage principle is developed, a phenomenon whereby next-token prediction implicitly optimizes toward a model with good coverage, and a mechanism that explains the power of coverage in predicting downstream performance is uncovered.

2510.15727.tldr: Methods for extracting structured information from invoice documents are presented and a set of evaluation metrics (EM) to assess the accuracy of the extracted data against annotated ground truth are proposed to assess the accuracy of the extracted data against annotated ground truth.

2510.16062.tldr: CorrectBench is introduced, a benchmark developed to evaluate the effectiveness of self-correction strategies, including intrinsic, external, and fine-tuned approaches, across three tasks: commonsense reasoning, mathematical reasoning, and code generation, which reveals that self-correction methods can improve accuracy, especially for complex reasoning tasks.

2510.16206.tldr: A concept of the Right To Be Remembered (RTBR) is presented which encompasses minimizing the risk of AI-driven information omission, embracing the right of fair treatment, while ensuring that the generated content would be maximally truthful.

2510.16708.tldr: This review provides a comprehensive overview of NLP research in cardiology from 2014 to 2025, and represents the most comprehensive synthesis of NLP research in cardiology to date.

2510.16853.tldr: It is shown that agents could either deepen existing divides or, under the right conditions, mitigate them, and a framework for analysing agentic inequality across three dimensions: availability, quality, and quantity is developed.

2510.17501.tldr: Results confirm that rubric-guided pseudo labeling, combined with contextual prompting, effectively stabilizes LLM-based scoring and establishes a general, interpretable zero-shot paradigm applicable to both generic and query-focused video summarization.

2510.17519.tldr: This is the first public release of large-scale video generation training code that exploits Megatron-Core to achieve high training efficiency and near-linear multi-node scaling, and the complete stack is open-source, including model weights, Megatron-Core-based large-scale training code, and inference pipelines for video generation and enhancement.

2510.17830.tldr: A multi-agent system where natural language is utilized to explore the complex physics regimes around fusion energy and the capacity of the multi-agent design assistant to both collaboratively and autonomously manipulate, navigate, and optimize capsule geometry is demonstrated.

2510.17947.tldr: PLAGUE is presented, a novel plug-and-play framework for designing multi-turn attacks inspired by lifelong-learning agents that dissects the lifetime of a multi-turn attack into three carefully designed phases that enable a systematic and information-rich exploration of the multi-turn attack family.

2510.18193.tldr: The framework establishes a transparent and extensible pipeline for trustworthy, data-driven officiating and athlete assessment by bridging real-time perception, explainable inference, and governance-aware design and represents a step toward equitable, accountable, and human-aligned AI in sports.

2510.18279.tldr: This paper shows that visual text representations are a practical and surprisingly effective form of input compression for decoder LLMs, exploiting the idea of rendering long text inputs as a single image and providing it directly to the model.

2510.18431.tldr: ScaleNet facilitates rapid model expansion with negligible increases in parameters, building on existing pretrained models, and shows significant potential for application in downstream vision areas, as evidenced by the validation in object detection task.

2510.18828.tldr: This work proposes a purely value-based framework for continuous control that revisits structural maximization of Q-functions, introducing a set of key architectural and algorithmic choices to enable efficient and stable learning.

2510.18888.tldr: This work proposes a fine-tuned model that jointly integrates entity recognition and disambiguation in a unified framework that leverages large language models to enrich the context of entity mentions, yielding better performance in entity disambiguation.

2510.18890.tldr: A framework to evaluate the feasibility of precise, rapid, and cost-effective information retrieval from extensive geoscience literature using freely available small language models (MiniLMs), which holds significant potential within the geoscience community for applications such as fact and image retrievals, trend analyses, contradiction analyses, and educational purposes.

2510.18893.tldr: The study formalizes observation-driven coordination for stochastic LLM agents, revealing semantic conflict rates (5-10%) and quality-performance tradeoffs, and provides empirical characterization of when parallel coordination succeeds versus fails based on task structure.

2510.18895.tldr: CosmoCore is introduced, a neuroscience-inspired reinforcement learning (RL) architecture that integrates affective signals to enhance code generation in large language models (LLMs) and extends RL from human feedback (RLHF) for more emotionally aware code assistants, with applications in IDEs and data pipelines.

2510.18897.tldr: This work explores AI-driven distributed-systems policy design by combining stochastic code generation from large language models (LLMs) with deterministic verification in a domain-specific simulator, and conjecture that AI will be crucial for scaling this methodology by helping to bootstrap new simulators.

2510.18904.tldr: This work proposes the fine-tuning of encoder-only Small Language Models (SLMs), in particular, the pre-trained models of RoBERTA and CodeBERTa using specialized datasets on source code and other natural language to prove that for the task of binary classification, SLMs outperform LLMs by a huge margin whilst using a fraction of compute.

2510.18908.tldr: This study contributes to a model-agnostic approach to enhancing topic modeling in public health related social media analysis, with broad implications for improved understanding of public discourse in health crisis as well as other important domains.

2510.18909.tldr: The Orthogonal Diversity-Aware Selection (ODiS) algorithm is proposed, which preserves both quality and diversity during data selection, and constructs the training dataset by selecting top-scored data within each orthogonal dimension, thereby ensuring both quality and diversity.

2510.18910.tldr: This work forms the brain modeling as a multitask learning and presents a scalable model architecture for multitask pretraining by tokenizing multiple brain-environment interactions (BEI) and semi-supervised finetuning by assigning pseudo-labels of pretrained BEI.

2510.18911.tldr: Generative and agentic AI can automate model generation, quantify uncertainty, and couple theory with experiment, realizing "self-driving models" that produce interpretable, reproducible, and transferable understanding of catalytic systems.

2510.18918.tldr: This work quantitatively shows that a lightweight PLM can maintain task performance while substantially reducing computational cost, and presents an explainable pipeline that retrieves faithful local and global justifications without compromising performance.

2510.18921.tldr: A performance evaluation of MLX, focusing on inference latency of transformer models, and evaluates the performance of BERT, RoBERTa, and XLM-RoBERTa models, with the intention of extending future work to include models of different modalities, thus providing a more comprehensive assessment of MLX's capabilities.

2510.18925.tldr: This work applies the Partition of Unity method, integrated with neural networks, to decompose the dynamics into local components and directly predict both macro- and micro-scale behaviors, making the framework effective for real-world applications involving complex, multi-scale phenomena.

2510.18927.tldr: This work proposes BAlanced Policy Optimization with Adaptive Clipping with Adaptive Clipping (BAPO), a simple yet effective method that dynamically adjusts clipping bounds to adaptively re-balance positive and negative contributions, preserve entropy, and stabilize RL optimization.

2510.18931.tldr: A justice-oriented scoring rubric was developed and a large language model was asked to review syllabi through a multi-perspective role simulation, showing that multiperspective evaluation aids in noting nuanced, role-specific priorities, leveraging them to fill hidden gaps in curricula design of AI/ML and related computing courses focused on fairness and ethics.

2510.18940.tldr: The proposed NeuroAda is a novel PEFT method that enables fine-grained model finetuning while maintaining high memory efficiency, and achieves state-of-the-art performance with as little as $\leq \textbf{0.02}\%$ trainable parameters, while reducing CUDA memory usage by up to 60%.

2510.18941.tldr: This work builds robust and affordable LLM-Judges to evaluate ProfBench rubrics, by mitigating self-enhancement bias and reducing the cost of evaluation by 2-3 orders of magnitude, to make it fair and accessible to the broader community.

2510.18982.tldr: This work frames verifiable test-time scaling as a transport problem, and uncovers that the sub-optimality--coverage curve exhibits three regimes: a transport regime, a policy improvement regime, and a saturation regime.

2510.18999.tldr: This work proposes OREN, a hybrid method that combines an explicit prior from octree interpolation with an implicit residual from neural network regression that achieves non-truncated (Euclidean) SDF reconstruction with computational and memory efficiency comparable to volumetric methods and differentiability and accuracy comparable to neural network methods.

2510.19001.tldr: The results demonstrate that carefully engineered prompts and contextual grounding can greatly enhance high-level driving QA with pretrained vision-language models.

2510.19003.tldr: Time-Aware $\Delta$t-Mamba3D, a novel state-space architecture adapted for longitudinal medical imaging, is presented, which can efficiently process long and complex patient screening histories of mammograms, forming a new framework for longitudinal image analysis.

2510.19008.tldr: The Plural Voices Model (PVM), a novel single-agent framework that dynamically negotiates multi-user needs through real-time value alignment, leveraging diverse public datasets on mental health, eldercare, education, and moral reasoning, is presented.

2510.19014.tldr: This comprehensive system integrating Large Language Models, Conditional Tabular Generative Adversarial Networks, CTGAN, T-learner counterfactual models, and contextual bandit approaches to provide customized, data-informed clinical recommendations overcomes cold-start limitations in online learning environments, improves computational effectiveness, and constitutes notable progress toward individualized medicine adapted to specific patient characteristics.

2510.19025.tldr: FlexiDataGen, an adaptive large language model (LLM) framework designed for dynamic semantic dataset generation in sensitive domains, effectively alleviates data shortages and annotation bottlenecks, enabling scalable and accurate machine learning model development.

2510.19031.tldr: CLiVR, a Conversational Learning system in Virtual Reality that integrates large language models, speech processing, and 3D avatars to simulate realistic doctor-patient interactions, offers a scalable, immersive supplement to SP-based training.

2510.19033.tldr: To find out what kinds of AI inclusivity bugs exist uniquely in user-facing AI products, and whether/how AI product teams might harness an existing (non-AI-oriented) inclusive design method to find and fix them, a field study with 3 AI product teams was conducted.

2510.19050.tldr: This paper proposes Preference-based Reward Invariance for Shortcut Mitigation (PRISM), which learns group-invariant kernels with feature maps in a closed-form learning objective and reduces the dependency on shortcuts in downstream policy models, establishing a robust framework for preference-based alignment.

2510.19055.tldr: The Music Understanding and Structural Evaluation (MUSE) Benchmark is introduced, an open-source resource with 10 tasks designed to probe fundamental music perception skills and provides a critical tool for evaluating invariant musical representations and driving development of more robust AI systems.

2510.19116.tldr: A domain-agnostic framework for constructing and interpreting such conflicts, along with a novel evaluation method and dataset tailored to code conflict scenarios, are proposed.

2510.19118.tldr: FedProx has the potential to be a promising approach for training precise machine learning models on non-IID local medical datasets and is focused on enhancing tumour segmentation accuracy by incorporating a modified U-Net model with attention mechanisms.

2510.19127.tldr: MusicRFM is introduced, a framework that adapts Recursive Feature Machines to enable fine-grained, interpretable control over frozen, pre-trained music models by directly steering their internal activations by directly steering their internal activations.

2510.19128.tldr: GADGET (Generalizable and Adaptive Diffusion-Guided Environment-aware Trajectory generation) is a diffusion-based planning model that generates joint-space trajectories conditioned on voxelized scene representations as well as start and goal configurations that supports zero-shot transfer to new environments and robotic embodiments without retraining.

2510.19138.tldr: Invariant Granger Causality (InvarGC) is proposed, which leverages cross-environment heterogeneity to mitigate the effects of latent confounding and to distinguish intervened from non-intervened environments with edge-level granularity, thereby recovering invariant causal relations.

2510.19150.tldr: This work introduces X-Ego-CS, a benchmark dataset consisting of 124 hours of gameplay footage from 45 professional-level matches of the popular e-sports game Counter-Strike 2, designed to facilitate research on multi-agent decision-making in complex 3D environments, and proposes Cross-Ego Contrastive Learning (CECL), which aligns teammates'egocentric visual streams to foster team-level tactical situational awareness from an individual's perspective.

2510.19173.tldr: This work directly uses the news sentiment scores derived from large language models, together with raw price and volume data, as observable inputs for reinforcement learning, and demonstrates that the news-aware approach can achieve performance superior to market benchmarks.

2510.19176.tldr: Mode Selection is identified as a more challenging variant of the Early Exit problem, as they share similar objectives but differ in decision timing, and existing methods relying solely on the information provided by models are insufficient for effectively addressing Mode Selection in scenarios with limited information.

2510.19181.tldr: A small paraphraser model is used to paraphrase the entity relationship edges retrieved from querying the knowledge graph to generate a final answer in a question answering system that operates exclusively on a knowledge graph retrieval.

2510.19183.tldr: PruneHal is a training-free, simple yet effective method that leverages adaptive KV cache pruning to enhance the model's focus on critical visual information, thereby mitigating hallucinations, and is the first to apply token pruning for hallucination mitigation in MLLMs.

2510.19202.tldr: The Active Diffusion-based Graph Neural Network (ADGNN) is proposed, which achieves active diffusion by integrating multiple external information sources that dynamically influence the diffusion process, effectively overcoming the over-smoothing problem.

2510.19205.tldr: Evaluations across thousands of trajectories from six web agents show that the graph abstraction captures cross-model regularities, highlights redundancy and inefficiency, and identifies critical decision points overlooked by outcome-based metrics.

2510.19212.tldr: This paper systematically argues that the field of statistics provides the indispensable foundation for machine learning and modern AI, and issues a call to action for education, research, and practice to re-embrace this statistical foundation.

2510.19241.tldr: SPOT is proposed, a novel method for computing decision tree policies, which formulates the optimization problem as a mixed-integer linear program (MILP), and employs a reduced-space branch-and-bound approach that decouples the MDP dynamics from tree-structure constraints, enabling efficient parallel search.

2510.19245.tldr: Results indicate that multi-modal grounding not only boosts predictive accuracy but also enhances simulation fidelity in visually complex environments, which captures nuances of human attention and decision-making that text-only agents often miss.

2510.19261.tldr: The study reveals that even if ChatGPT has access to the necessary knowledge and competencies, it is unable to assemble them, reason through, in a way that leads to an exhaustive result, a major limitation of ChatGPT.

2510.19263.tldr: This paper examines an extension of the derivation state argumentation framework (DSA-framework) to explain the reasoning according to the generalized notion of the reason model.

2510.19264.tldr: The LLM-Assisted Protocol Attack Discovery (LAPRAD) methodology is introduced, enabling security researchers with some DNS knowledge to efficiently uncover vulnerabilities that would otherwise be hard to detect.

2510.19270.tldr: A novel method named SWM-AP (Social World Model-Augmented Mechanism Design Policy Learning), which learns a social world model hierarchically modeling agents'behavior to enhance mechanism design and demonstrates that SWM-AP outperforms established model-based and model-free RL baselines in cumulative rewards and sample efficiency.

2510.19282.tldr: An ensemble approach based on a Prototypical Network (ProtoNet), a powerful method in FSL, integrating various pre-trained CNNs as encoders that enhances the richness of features extracted from medical images and ensures a more precise classification of Alzheimer's disease progression levels.

2510.19298.tldr: A model where knowledge of strategies can be specified on a fine-grained level is proposed where it is possible to distinguish first-order, higher-order, and common knowledge of strategies.

2510.19299.tldr: A multi-agent LLM simulation framework in which agents repeatedly interact, evaluate one another, and adapt their behavior through in-context learning accelerated by a coaching signal is presented, establishing a principled testbed for investigating collective dynamics in LLM populations and reveals how artificial agents may approximate or diverge from human-like social behavior.

2510.19303.tldr: A new protocol is established for securing generative AI systems, combining advanced tools, methodologies, and industry-tested methods that exhibited strong resilience under adversarial conditions against simulated quantum attacks, achieving secure API encryption and data transmission.

2510.19321.tldr: Comprehensive experiments conducted on benchmark datasets show that TS-GATR surpasses current state-of-the-art approaches, consistently achieving lower Equal Error Rates (EER) across various scenarios.

2510.19325.tldr: This paper introduces hypervolume optimization (HVO), a novel optimization strategy that dynamically adjusts the scores between groups during the reward process in RL by using the hypervolume method, thereby generating balanced summaries across multiple objectives.

2510.19327.tldr: These findings validate SORA-ATMAS as a regulation-aligned, context-aware, and verifiable governance framework that consolidates distributed agent outputs into accountable, real-time decisions, offering a resilient foundation for smart-city management.

2510.19334.tldr: The approach shows promise in reducing the time and cost associated with contract review while maintaining high accuracy in legal clause identification, and suggests that carefully optimized LLM systems could serve as valuable tools for legal professionals, potentially increasing access to efficient contract review services for organizations of all sizes.

2510.19347.tldr: A novel set of algorithms are proposed, including the negative iterative fast gradient sign method (NI-FGSM) and the negative iterative fast gradient method (NI-FGM), along with their momentum variants: the negative momentum iterative fast gradient sign method (NMI-FGSM) and the negative momentum iterative fast gradient method (NMI-FGM).

2510.19358.tldr: Results show that while models can capture what was said, they often fail to identify who said it, revealing a key gap in speaker-aware dialogue understanding.

2510.19410.tldr: ToMMeR is introduced, a lightweight model probing mention detection capabilities from early LLM layers probing mention detection capabilities from early LLM layers, providing evidence that structured entity representations exist in early transformer layers and can be efficiently recovered with minimal parameters.

2510.19414.tldr: EchoFake is presented, a comprehensive dataset comprising more than 120 hours of audio from over 13,000 speakers, featuring both cutting-edge zero-shot text-to-speech speech and physical replay recordings collected under varied devices and real-world environmental settings, which offers a more realistic foundation for advancing spoofing detection methods.

2510.19420.tldr: A dynamic defense paradigm for MAS graph structures is proposed, which continuously monitors communication within the MAS graph, then dynamically adjusts the graph topology, accurately disrupts malicious communications, and effectively defends against evolving and diverse dynamic attacks.

2510.19421.tldr: Comprehensive empirical evaluations across diverse vision and language benchmarks validate the effectiveness of FairNet, a novel framework for dynamic, instance-level fairness correction that integrates a bias detector with conditional low-rank adaptation (LoRA), which enables selective activation of the fairness correction mechanism exclusively for instances identified as biased and thereby preserve performance on unbiased instances.

2510.19425.tldr: This paper presents a new Bayesian meta-learning approach called Neural Variational Dropout Processes (NVDPs), which model the conditional posterior distribution based on a task-specific dropout and utilizes a novel prior conditioned on the whole task data to optimize the conditional posterior in the amortized variational inference.

2510.19429.tldr: This work presents NeSyPr, a novel embodied reasoning framework that compiles knowledge via neurosymbolic proceduralization, thereby equipping LM-based agents with structured, adaptive, and timely reasoning capabilities.

2510.19470.tldr: This work proposes HybridEP, a modeling-guided framework to optimize Expert Parallelism of MoE under constrained bandwidth, to dynamically transform the spatial placement of experts to reduce data communication traffic and frequency, thereby minimizing EP's communication overheads.

2510.19476.tldr: A roadmap for constructing safety cases based on chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring in reasoning models and a two-part safety case establishing that models lack dangerous capabilities when operating without their CoT, and ensuring that any dangerous capabilities enabled by a CoT are detectable by CoT monitoring.

2510.19479.tldr: This paper introduces INPO, an Influence-aware Negative Preference Optimization framework that focuses on slowing the divergence speed and improving the robustness of the model utility to the unlearning process, and designs an influence-aware message function to amplify the influence of unlearned edges and mitigate the tight topological coupling between the forget set and the retain set.

2510.19484.tldr: This work introduces KnowMol-100K, a large-scale dataset with 100K fine-grained molecular annotations across multiple levels, bridging the gap between molecules and textual descriptions, and proposes chemically-informative molecular representation, effectively addressing limitations in existing molecular representation strategies.

2510.19488.tldr: VideoAgentTrek is presented, a scalable pipeline that automatically mines training data from publicly available screen-recorded videos at web scale, eliminating the need for manual annotation, providing a scalable alternative to expensive manual annotation.

2510.19496.tldr: Though trained as a discrete classifier over a set of optional resolutions, CARES interpolates continuous resolutions at inference for fine-grained control and preserves task performance while reducing compute by up to 80%.

2510.19497.tldr: This paper applies Large Language Models within an agent-based simulation to capture decision-making in a real urban setting and concludes that combining LLMs with agent-based simulation offers a promising direction for advancing intelligent transportation systems and personalised multimodal mobility solutions.

2510.19530.tldr: The Reinforced Energy-Based Model for Bayesian Optimization (REBMBO) is proposed, which integrates Gaussian Processes for local guidance with an Energy-Based Model (EBM) to capture global structural information and dynamically adjusts the depth and direction of exploration to effectively overcome the limitations of traditional BO methods.

2510.19535.tldr: This work benchmarks three approaches, Federated kMeans (Fed-kMeans), Federated Principal Component Analysis combined with Fed-kMeans (Fed-PCA+FedkMeans), and Federated Locality-Sensitive Hashing (Fed-LSH), against their centralized counterparts on eight diverse molecular datasets.

2510.19544.tldr: It is demonstrated that Global Annealing not only surpasses the performance of Simulated Annealing but also exhibits greater robustness than Population Annealing, maintaining effectiveness across problem hardness and system size without hyperparameter tuning.

2510.19559.tldr: This paper introduces TIME10k, a benchmark dataset of over 10,000 images with temporal ground truth, and evaluates the time-awareness of 37 VLMs by a novel methodology, proposing methods to derive an explicit ''timeline'' representation from the embedding space.

2510.19593.tldr: A goal-driven framework is presented that effectively categorizes and integrates 135 papers on RCA in the context of cloud incident management based on their diverse goals, spanning the period from 2014 to 2025.

2510.19599.tldr: This work presents the first systematic benchmark for evaluating cross-modal interpretability in chest X-rays across seven CLIP-style VLM variants, and generates visual explanations using cross-attention and similarity-based localization maps, and quantitatively assess their alignment with radiologist-annotated regions across multiple pathologies.

2510.19600.tldr: Experiments show AutoPage not only generates high-quality, visually appealing pages but does so with remarkable efficiency in under 15 minutes for less than $0.1, arguing that the solution lies not in a single command, but in a collaborative, hierarchical process.

2510.19631.tldr: HSCodeComp is introduced, the first realistic, expert-level e-commerce benchmark designed to evaluate deep search agents in hierarchical rule application, and contains 632 product entries spanning diverse product categories, with these HSCodes annotated by several human experts.

2510.19641.tldr: A style-based attack, Style Attack Disguise (SAD), designed two sizes: light for query efficiency and strong for superior attack performance, which shows SAD's potential threats to multimodal tasks including text-to-image and text-to-speech generation.

2510.19666.tldr: A graph-based engine for computing chord tone soloing suggestions for guitar students to practice chord tone soloing is presented and a user-friendly system to handle input and output to this engine is discussed.

2510.19668.tldr: The findings highlight that llms require structured prompt engineering and emotion grouping to enhance their performance, and fine-tuned pre-trained models and general-purpose llms require structured prompt engineering and emotion grouping to enhance their performance.

2510.19671.tldr: This work contributes to an explainable win prediction classification solution in streaming in which input data is controlled over several sliding windows to reflect relevant game changes and can be leveraged by ranking and recommender systems for informed decision-making.

2510.19678.tldr: This work adapts classic visual search paradigms to test whether MLLMs exhibit the ``pop-out''effect, and finds that advanced MLLMs exhibit human-like pop-out effects in colour or size-based disjunctive (single feature) search, as well as capacity limits for conjunctive (multiple feature) search.

2510.19694.tldr: It is shown that while prompting affects the quality of representations, these changes do not consistently correlate with the relevance of the prompts to the target task, challenging the assumption that more relevant prompts necessarily lead to better representations.

2510.19728.tldr: This work provides a practical, privacy-preserving roadmap for trustworthy, granular model evaluation in critical care, enabling robust and reliable performance analysis across diverse patient populations without exposing sensitive EHR data, contributing to the overall trustworthiness of Medical AI.

2510.19752.tldr: This work introduces Learning from Inference-Time Execution (LITEN), which connects a VLA low-level policy to a high-level VLM that conditions on past experiences by including them in-context, allowing it to learn the affordances and capabilities of the low-level VLA.

2510.19767.tldr: The SmartSwitch inference framework is proposed, which can be easily integrated into any large language model as a plug-and-play solution, continuously monitoring the model's reasoning process to detect underthinking and guide it toward deeper exploration of promising but overlooked thoughts.

2510.19779.tldr: A novel method that incorporates selective token filtering into the KD process, enabling the distillation of a draft model that better aligns with the target model on simpler tokens, which improves the overall token acceptance rate without compromising generation quality.

2510.19792.tldr: This paper examines how journalists in Dutch media manage the integration of AI technologies into their daily routines and proposes the concept of controlled change as a heuristic to explain how journalists are proactively setting guidelines, experimenting with AI tools, and identifying their limitations and capabilities.

2510.19799.tldr: Results show that integrating transparent models, LLMs, and practitioner input yields accurate, trustworthy, and actionable case-level evaluations, offering a viable pathway for responsible AI adoption in the public and nonprofit sectors.

2510.19807.tldr: Scaf-GRPO (Scaffolded Group Relative Policy Optimization), a progressive training framework that strategically provides minimal guidance only when a model's independent learning has plateaued, provides a robust and effective methodology for unlocking a model's ability to solve problems previously beyond its reach.

2510.19818.tldr: This paper posits that instead of reconstructing future frames as pixels, world models only need to predict task-relevant semantic information about the future, and demonstrates how such a semantic world model can be used for policy improvement on open-ended robotics tasks, leading to significant generalization improvements over typical paradigms of reconstruction-based action-conditional world modeling.

2405.12961.tldr: This work introduces an algorithm called energy rank alignment (ERA) that leverages an explicit reward function to produce a gradient-based objective that is used to optimize autoregressive policies and finds that it does so robustly, searching through diverse parts of chemical space.

2406.00954.tldr: This study introduces a novel benchmark for LEC, encompassing six datasets that cover behavior classification, emotion classification, and cognition classification, and proposes the annotation guideline-based knowledge augmentation (AGKA) approach, which leverages GPT-4.0 to recognize and extract label definitions from annotation guidelines and applies random undersampling to select a representative set of examples.

2410.05056.tldr: This work demonstrates the transfer of mixing properties from the exogenous regressor to the response via coupling arguments, and studies Markov chains in random environments with drift and minorization conditions, even under non-stationary environments with favorable mixing properties.

2410.19258.tldr: This work proposes HeadKV, a head-level KV cache compression method, and HeadKV-R2, which leverages a novel contextual reasoning ability estimation for compression, both of which significantly outperforms strong baselines, particularly in low-resource settings.

2411.11843.tldr: A new line of linear-complexity LLMs under low-bit representation is pioneers a new line of linear-complexity LLMs under low-bit representation and provides the way for the design of specialized hardware optimized for efficient 1-bit Mamba-based models.

2502.07591.tldr: A novel dual-mind world model (DMWM) framework that integrates logical reasoning to enable imagination with logical consistency is proposed and extensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework yields significant improvements in terms of logical coherence, trial efficiency, data efficiency and long-term imagination over the state-of-the-art world models.

2502.09933.tldr: MIR-Bench is proposed, the first many-shot in-context reasoning benchmark for pattern recognition that asks LLM to predict output via input-output examples from underlying functions with diverse data format.

2502.11554.tldr: This paper introduces Metaphor-Fluid Design, a novel approach that dynamically adjusts metaphorical representations based on conversational use-contexts, and compares this approach to a Default VUI, which characterizes the present implementation of commercial VUIs commonly designed around the persona of an assistant.

2502.17213.tldr: This review systematically examines recent advances in deep learning approaches for EEG/iEEG-based neurological diagnostics, focusing on applications across 7 neurological conditions using 46 datasets, and proposes a standardized benchmark to evaluate models across diverse datasets and improve reproducibility.

2503.15984.tldr: DIPLI is proposed - a framework that shifts from single-frame to multi-frame training using the Back Projection technique, combined with optical flow estimation via the TVNet model, and replaces deterministic predictions with unbiased Monte Carlo estimation obtained through Langevin dynamics.

2504.01002.tldr: The evidence suggests that the token subspace is not a fiber bundle and hence also not a manifold, and when an LLM is presented with two semantically equivalent prompts, if one prompt contains a token implicated by the test, the response to that prompt will likely exhibit less stability than the other.

2505.06520.tldr: This work proposes a novel unlearning approach by imposing carefully crafted patch on the original neural network to achieve targeted"forgetting" of the requested data to delete, and proposes to strategically seek a lightweight minimum"patch" for unlearning a given data point with certifiable guarantee.

2505.07260.tldr: A novel reformulation of the attention mechanism is introduced, that reveals an underlying FFN-like structure within attention modules, that achieves superior performance through attention-based MoE layers while enabling efficient parameter sharing between FFN and attention components.

2505.09131.tldr: A new fair clustering algorithm based on a novel decomposition of the fair $K-means clustering objective function, called Fair Clustering via Alignment (FCA), which theoretically guarantees approximately optimal clustering utility for any given fairness level without complex constraints, thereby enabling high-utility fair clustering in practice.

2505.12226.tldr: Shallow Flow Matching is proposed, a novel mechanism that enhances flow matching (FM)-based text-to-speech (TTS) models within a coarse-to-fine generation paradigm within a coarse-to-fine generation paradigm.

2505.14667.tldr: SAFEPATH is a lightweight alignment method that fine-tunes LRMs to emit a short, 8-token Safety Primer at the start of their reasoning, in response to harmful prompts, while leaving the rest of the reasoning process unsupervised, to reduce harmful outputs while maintaining reasoning performance.

2505.14827.tldr: Mixture of Inputs (MoI), a training-free method for autoregressive generation that employs a Bayesian estimation method that treats the token distribution as the prior, the sampled token as the observation, and replaces the conventional one-hot vector with the continuous posterior expectation as the new model input.

2505.15034.tldr: A central innovation of Tango is its generative, process-level LLM verifier, which is trained via RL and co-evolves with the generator, which exhibits improved robustness and superior generalization compared to deterministic or SFT-trained verifiers, fostering effective mutual reinforcement with the generator.

2505.15293.tldr: Inspired by the analyzing and reasoning capability of large language models (LLMs), LLM-Explorer is designed to adaptively generate task-specific exploration strategies with LLMs, enhancing the policy exploration in RL.

2505.16722.tldr: This work analyzes cross-lingual detoxification's effectiveness through extensive settings to evaluate toxicity reduction in cross-distribution settings with limited data and investigates how mitigation impacts model performance on non-toxic tasks, revealing trade-offs between safety and knowledge preservation.

2505.19667.tldr: LeCoDe is introduced, a real-world multi-turn benchmark dataset comprising 3,696 legal consultation dialogues with 110,008 dialogue turns designed to evaluate and improve LLMs' legal consultation capability and proposes a comprehensive evaluation framework that assesses LLMs' consultation capabilities in terms of clarification capability and professional advice quality.

2505.22038.tldr: This work proposes Balanced Token Pruning (BTP), a plug-and-play method for pruning vision tokens that achieves a 78% compression rate while preserving 96.7% of the original models' performance on average.

2505.22389.tldr: It is observed that the degradation introduced during merging can be alleviated by a regularization term composed of the task vector and the Hessian matrix of the loss function, and it is shown that this term can be efficiently approximated using second-order symmetric finite differences.

2505.22601.tldr: This work defines the unlearning solution as the minimum-complexity interpolator over the retained data and proposes a new algorithmic framework that only requires access to model gradients on the retained set at the original solution.

2505.23751.tldr: This work derives an information-theoretic prior by evaluating the compressibility of various patch sequences, and learns a policy over permutations by optimizing a Plackett-Luce policy using REINFORCE, which enables efficient learning in a combinatorial permutation space.

2506.01665.tldr: This work analyses existing, differentiable safeguards, adapt them through modified mappings and gradient formulations, and integrate them into a state-of-the-art learning algorithm and a differentiable simulation, and develops the first effective safeguard for analytic gradient-based reinforcement learning.

2506.04210.tldr: An alternative test-time scaling approach, parallel thinking, inspired by Best-of-N sampling is introduced, which generates multiple independent reasoning paths within the same inference budget and selects the most consistent response via majority vote, achieving up to 20% higher accuracy compared to extended thinking.

2506.05341.tldr: This work introduces DirectLayout, a framework that directly generates numerical 3D layouts from text descriptions using generalizable spatial reasoning of large language models (LLMs) and achieves impressive semantic consistency, generalization and physical plausibility.

2506.05821.tldr: A novel multi-scale feature fusion method that reimagines the UNet decoding process as solving an initial value problem (IVP), treating skip connections as discrete nodes is proposed, independent of the encoder and decoder architectures, making it adaptable to various U-Net-like networks.

2506.07031.tldr: This work introduces HauntAttack, a novel and general-purpose black-box adversarial attack framework that systematically embeds harmful instructions into reasoning questions and modify key reasoning conditions in existing questions with harmful instructions, thereby constructing a reasoning pathway that guides the model step by step toward unsafe outputs.

2506.07520.tldr: LeVo, a language model based framework consisting of LeLM and Music Codec, which handles diverse human preferences through a semi-automatic data construction process and post-training and introduces a multi-preference alignment method based on Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

2506.13992.tldr: AssistedDS (Assisted Data Science) is introduced, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate how LLMs handle domain knowledge in tabular prediction tasks, highlighting a substantial gap in current models'ability to critically evaluate and leverage expert knowledge.

2506.19358.tldr: A cardio-focusing and -tracking algorithm to precisely track the cardiac location to ensure an efficient acquisition of high-quality radar signals and a transfer learning model (RFcardi) is proposed to extract cardio-related information from the radar signal without ECG ground truth.

2507.03220.tldr: Symbiosis enables the as-a-service deployment of the base model and decouples the execution of client-specific adapters and layers from the frozen base model layers offering them flexibility to manage their resources, to select their fine-tuning method, to achieve their performance goals.

2507.06795.tldr: This study validate the effectiveness of a DACP-based recipe across diverse foundation models and service domains, producing DACP-applied sLLMs (ixi-GEN), demonstrating that ixi-GEN models achieve substantial gains in target-domain performance while preserving general capabilities, offering a cost-efficient and scalable solution for enterprise-level deployment.

2507.16068.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that LAN2CB enables robust and flexible multi-robot coordination from natural language, significantly reducing manual engineering effort and supporting broad generalization across diverse mission types.

2507.19271.tldr: This study investigates how different configurations of programming languages and natural languages in the training data affect LM performance, particularly in comment generation, and shows that monolingual fine-tuning improves model accuracy and relevance compared to multilingual baselines.

2507.22766.tldr: This paper introduces an approach for optimizing, recurrently monitoring and adjusting the process parameters of a sensor-based sorting system based on Bayesian Optimization, Gaussian process regression models, and considers two possible optimization targets based on the requirements for both material output streams.

2508.02753.tldr: A novel Dynamic Multi-Scale Coordination Framework (DMSC) with Multi-Scale Patch Decomposition block (EMPD), Triad Interaction Block (TIB) and Adaptive Scale Routing MoE block (ASR-MoE) that consistently maintains state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance and superior computational efficiency for TSF tasks.

2508.09874.tldr: Memory Decoder is introduced, a plug-and-play pretrained memory that enables efficient domain adaptation without changing the original model's parameters and can be integrated in a plug-and-play manner, consistently enhancing performance across multiple models within the target domain.

2509.01257.tldr: A decentralized framework in which each agent solves a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP), coordinating implicitly through a shared constraint vector, showing improved performance over centralized and independent baselines, especially in large-scale settings.

2509.06213.tldr: This work investigates reinforcement learning in the Game Of Hidden Rules (GOHR) environment, a complex puzzle in which an agent must infer and execute hidden rules to clear a 6-times-6 board by placing game pieces into buckets, and explores two state representation strategies.

2509.16449.tldr: PersonaMatrix is introduced, a persona-by-criterion evaluation framework that scores summaries through the lens of six personas, including legal and non-legal users that enables refinement of legal AI summarization systems for both expert and non-expert users, with the potential to increase access to legal knowledge.

2509.17192.tldr: It is argued the ability for AI systems to influence large-scale decisions motivates additional research into the safety, interpretability, and explainability of AI in open-ended wargames.

2509.19834.tldr: TianHui, a specialized TCM LLM built through contextual data integration and domain knowledge fusion, enables systematic preservation and scalable application of TCM knowledge.

2509.20890.tldr: This work proposes FerretNet, a lightweight neural network with only 1.1M parameters that delivers efficient and robust synthetic image detection and achieves an average accuracy of 97.1% on an open-world benchmark comprising 22 generative models.

2509.25271.tldr: RADAR is proposed, a multi-agent collaborative evaluation framework that leverages multi-round debate mechanisms through four specialized complementary roles and employs dynamic update mechanisms to achieve self-evolution of risk concept distributions.

2510.02279.tldr: This work proposes using several alternative risk indicators for risk correlation experiments that improve robustness of empirical assessment of UE algorithms for NLG and proposes to use an Elo rating of uncertainty estimation methods to give an objective summarization over extensive evaluation settings.

2510.03369.tldr: This work presents a new paradigm for empowering teacher professional development with intelligent technologies, and introduces TriQuest, an AI-copilot platform designed to solve interdisciplinary teaching problems.

2510.06377.tldr: The Relational Transformer architecture is presented, which can be pretrained on diverse relational databases and directly applied to unseen datasets and tasks without task- or dataset-specific fine-tuning, or retrieval of in-context examples.

2510.07686.tldr: A systematic methodology for stress-testing model character specifications, automatically identifying numerous cases of principle contradictions and interpretive ambiguities in current model specs is presented.

2510.10603.tldr: This work proposes EA4LLM, an evolutionary algorithm for optimizing LLMs, and empirically verify full-parameter optimization from the pretraining stage across model sizes ranging from 0.5B to 32B, challenging the prevailing assumption that gradient-based optimization is the only viable approach for training neural networks.

2510.11100.tldr: HoMer, a Homogeneous-Oriented TransforMer, a Homogeneous-Oriented TransforMer for modeling sequential and set-wise contexts aligns sequence side features with non-sequential features for accurate sequence modeling and fine-grained interest representation.

2510.11824.tldr: By optimizing hyperparameters only, a large-scale empirical study is presented comprising over 82,620 experiments to evaluate cooperation, robustness, and resilience in MARL across 4 real-world environments, 13 uncertainty types, and 15 hyperparameters.

2510.12384.tldr: A multi-omics aging clock that robustly predicts diverse health outcomes and future disease risk is developed and rigorously validated, demonstrating the power of multi-omics integration to decode the molecular landscape of aging and laying the groundwork for personalized healthspan monitoring and precision strategies to prevent age-related diseases.

2510.13894.tldr: It is shown that in certain cases quantum systems can be reformulated as probabilistic equations expressed in terms of probabilistic state vectors, which can be approximated by the neural network dynamics of the Tensor Brain model.

2510.14449.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive empirical study of One-vs-Rest logistic regression on the UCI Wine dataset, comparing from-scratch gradient descent implementation against scikit-learn's optimized solvers and quantifying L1 regularization effects on feature sparsity.

2510.15001.tldr: Pretrained on the identical data mixture used for the Gemma 2 series, VaultGemma 1B represents a significant step forward in privacy-preserving large language models.

2510.15382.tldr: BREEZE introduces behavioral regularization in zero-shot RL policy learning, transforming policy optimization into a stable in-sample learning paradigm, and employs expressive attention-based architectures for representation modeling to capture the complex relationships between environmental dynamics.

2510.15398.tldr: Experiments show that the framework consistently outperforms existing OV baselines both In-Domain and Cross-Domain setting on MARIS, establishing a strong foundation for future underwater perception research.

2510.16614.tldr: Experiments on complex reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MERCI encourages richer and more varied chains of thought, significantly improves performance over strong baselines, and helps the policy escape local routines to discover better solutions, indicating that the targeted intrinsic motivation can make exploration reliable for language model reasoning.

2510.16709.tldr: This work presents HumanCM, a one-step human motion prediction framework built upon consistency models that achieves comparable or superior accuracy to state-of-the-art diffusion models while reducing inference steps by up to two orders of magnitude.

2510.16807.tldr: This work proposes SkipV1Former, a Transformer variant that uses skip connections from the first layer's Value heads to strengthen model representation and reduce KV cache, and proposes a recipe for uptraining existing MHA Transformer checkpoints to SkipV1Former with only 10-15\% additional compute.

2510.17451.tldr: It is proved that the problem admits a $1$-additive fixed-parameter approximation algorithm when parameterized by the maximum degree of $\mathcal{H}$ and a fixed-parameter algorithm when parameterized by its dimension, and that these are essentially the only such exploitable structural parameters.

2510.17621.tldr: This paper presents Gradient Update Inversion with DEnoising (GUIDE), a novel methodology that leverages diffusion models as denoising tools to improve image reconstruction attacks in FL and achieves up to 46% higher perceptual similarity, as measured by the DreamSim metric.

2510.17930.tldr: This work provides a mechanistic diagnosis of NER model adaptation, highlighting feature independence, representation overlap, and'O'tag plasticity.

2510.18254.tldr: Eight frontier models are tested on a simple, real-world task that is open-ended yet rule-constrained, with auditable success criteria: to produce valid scientific test items, then revise after considering their own critique, suggesting current LLM'reflection'lacks functional evidence of the active, goal-driven monitoring that helps humans respect constraints even on a first pass.

2510.18470.tldr: It is found that complex reasoning tasks consistently activate a sparse, specialized subset of attention heads, forming core reasoning circuits, forming core reasoning circuits in the model's internal mechanisms.

2510.19257.tldr: FnRGNN is proposed, a fairness-aware in-processing framework for GNN-based node regression that applies interventions at three levels: structure-level edge reweighting, representation-level alignment via MMD, and prediction-level normalization through Sinkhorn-based distribution matching that ensures robust fairness under complex graph topologies.

2510.19338.tldr: Benefiting from the high alignment between the training and inference engine operators, the models can undergo long-term, stable, and highly efficient optimization during the reinforcement learning phase, consistently maintaining SOTA performance across multiple challenging complex reasoning benchmarks.

2510.19351.tldr: A context-aware, semisupervised framework that uses meta-learning to generate expertspecific embeddings from only a few demonstrations, and demonstrates the efficacy of a dual-purpose mechanism, where these embeddings are used first to generate a large corpus of pseudolabels for training, and subsequently to enable on-the-fly adaptation to new experts at test-time.

2510.19562.tldr: A novel method named DAIL (Distributional Aligned Learning), featuring two key components: distributional policy and semantic alignment, featuring theoretical results that the value distribution estimation mechanism enhances task differentiability.

2510.19829.tldr: SSL-SE-EEG, a framework that integrates Self-Supervised Learning with Squeeze-and-Excitation Networks (SE-Nets) to enhance feature extraction, improve noise robustness, and reduce reliance on labeled data, is introduced.

2510.19835.tldr: A quantum-inspired algorithm for solving Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problems, which are mathematically equivalent to finding ground states of Ising spin-glass Hamiltonians, is proposed and evaluated.

2510.19836.tldr: The Analytical Reliability Benchmark (ARB) is introduced, a reproducible framework that quantifies reasoning reliability in large language models applied to energy system analysis and establishes the first quantitative method in the energy literature for verifying causal, probabilistic, and policy-driven reasoning in artificial intelligence systems.

2510.19838.tldr: Branch-and-Browse is a fine-grained web agent framework that unifies structured reasoning-acting, contextual memory, and efficient execution and demonstrates that Branch-and-Browse is a reliable and efficient framework for LLM-based web agents.

2510.19842.tldr: This framework provides a balance between free-form CoT and formal proofs systems, offering actionable diagnostics for LLMs reasoning evaluation, and introduces a metric that quantifies how well a model's CoT trajectory adheres to the DAG structure, providing evaluation beyond classical PASS@k$ metrics.

2510.19844.tldr: The proposed CourtGuard is a locally-runnable, multiagent prompt injection classifier, a court-like multiagent LLM system, where prompts are evaluated in a court-like multiagent LLM system, where a defense attorney argues the prompt is benign, a prosecution attorney argues the prompt is a prompt injection, and a judge gives the final classification.

2510.19851.tldr: While CoT provides valuable oversight in benign settings, robust deployment requires model-specific stress-testing of monitorability, and a composable and quantifiable taxonomy of prompts to elicit CoT obfuscation is developed.

2510.19866.tldr: Overall, the findings suggest that readability is significantly governed by model design, while instructional reliability and curricular alignment depend more on the prompt framework.

2510.19873.tldr: ReGraphT is proposed, a training-free, retrieval-augmented generation framework that transfers LLM-level reasoning to smaller models and enables SLMs to approach LLM-level performance without the associated privacy risks or excessive computing overhead.

2510.19882.tldr: The informativeness of 753 socio-behavioural, linguistic, relational, and psychological features is investigated, in predicting the behavioural changes of 16.8K users affected by a major moderation intervention on Reddit.

2510.19889.tldr: This study introduces a novel data-driven approach using deep neural networks, specifically leveraging the Transformer architecture, to predict equilibrium path flows directly, efficiently estimates path-level traffic flows in multi-class networks, reducing computational costs and improving prediction accuracy.

2510.19892.tldr: This work proposes game-based evaluations to holistically assess multi-modal large language models capabilities through Dixit, a fantasy card game where players must generate captions for a card that trick some, but not all players, into selecting the played card.

2510.19895.tldr: This study systematically evaluates DeepSeek-R1 across four key OR benchmarks: NL4OPT, IndustryOR, EasyLP, and ComplexOR, and includes baseline assessments, the development of a hallucination taxonomy, and the application of mitigation strategies like LLM-as-a-Judge, Few-shot Learning, Tool Calling, and a Multi-agent Framework.

2510.19897.tldr: Through extensive empirical evaluation, a memory-augmented framework that leverages both labeled data and LLM-generated critiques is proposed, which highlights the promise of memory-driven, reflective learning for building more adaptive and interpretable LLM agents.

2510.19957.tldr: UVeye layered solution for vehicle fraud is presented, representing a major leap forward in the ability to detect, mitigate and deter this new wave of fraud.

2510.19964.tldr: The study explores the potential of AI technologies in personalized learning, suggesting the prediction of academic success through leadership personality traits and machine learning modelling and offers an additional opportunity to identify students's strengths and weaknesses at an early stage of their education process and select the most suitable strategies for personalized learning.

2510.19967.tldr: This work proposes LyriCAR, a novel framework for controllable lyric translation that operates in a fully unsupervised manner, and introduces a difficulty-aware curriculum designer and an adaptive curriculum strategy, ensuring efficient allocation of training resources, accelerating convergence, and improving overall translation quality.

2510.19975.tldr: This paper explores the two-point zeroth-order gradient estimator and identifies the distribution of random perturbations that minimizes the estimator's asymptotic variance as the perturbation stepsize tends to zero, and provides a convergence analysis for stochastic gradient descent using $\delta$-unbiased random perturbations.

2510.19988.tldr: A hybrid approach that integrates the broad-coverage language processing of LLMs with the symbolic NLU capabilities of producing structured relational representations to hopefully get the best of both approaches is explored.

2510.19997.tldr: FAIGMOE provides the first comprehensive conceptual framework explicitly addressing GenAI adoption across midsize and enterprise organizations, offering actionable implementation protocols, assessment instruments, and governance templates requiring empirical validation through future research.

2510.20001.tldr: A unifying paradigm that characterizes clinical decision-making tasks along two dimensions: Clinical Backgrounds and Clinical Questions is proposed that clarifies assumptions, standardizes comparisons, and guides the development of clinically meaningful LLMs.

2510.20039.tldr: Analysis of multi-turn conversations revealed that exchanges involving participants'personal stories were most likely to trigger stance changes for both humans and LLMs, highlighting the risk of over-alignment in human-LLM interaction and the need for careful design of personalized chatbots to more thoughtfully and stably align with users.

2510.20040.tldr: An imitation learning-based framework to approximate mixed-integer Economic Model Predictive Control (EMPC) for microgrid energy management is proposed, enabling fast, real-time decision making without solving optimization problems online.

2510.20061.tldr: It is argued that this approach, the cooperative public AI red-teaming exercise, is both capable of delivering meaningful results and is also scalable to many AI developing jurisdictions.

2510.20093.tldr: This work proposes StableSketcher, a novel framework that empowers diffusion models to generate hand-drawn sketches with high prompt fidelity, and introduces SketchDUO, to the best of the authors' knowledge, the first dataset comprising instance-level sketches paired with captions and question-answer pairs, thereby addressing the limitations of existing datasets that rely on image-label pairs.

2510.20099.tldr: Through human QA and system metrics, it is demonstrated that grounded generation with explicit routing and layered safety can deliver trustworthy AI insights in high-stakes finance.

2510.20129.tldr: This work introduces a new, training-free defense paradigm, Self-Activating Internal Defense (SAID), which reframes the defense task from external correction to internal capability activation and substantially outperforms state-of-the-art defenses in reducing harmful outputs.

2510.20154.tldr: This paper automatically annotates posts in pre-existing stance detection datasets with two attributes: dialect or vernacular of a specific group and text complexity/readability, to investigate whether these attributes influence the model's stance detection decisions.

2510.20165.tldr: The new GAN-based unsupervised model, discovered in an attempt to utilize the Information Bottleneck (IB) framework to the optimization of GAN, is named IB-GAN and achieves competitive disentanglement scores to those of state-of-the-art β-VAEs and outperforms InfoGAN.
