2510.20178.tldr: A memory buffer is introduced for modeling long-range spatio-temporal consistency while achieving efficient dynamic stereo matching in a two-stage decision-making process inspired by the two-stage decision-making process in humans.

2510.20188.tldr: This work pioneers decentralized AI auditing, offering a practical path toward safe and trustworthy LLM deployment and provides theoretical guarantees for the security and economic incentives of the TRUST framework.

2510.20190.tldr: It is argued that identity consolidation is a prerequisite for AGI-level reliability and also a critical control point for safety: identities can be deliberately engineered for reliability, yet may also emerge spontaneously during scaling, potentially hardening unpredictable goals and behaviors.

2510.20198.tldr: While LLMs demonstrate moderate success in all tasks with small complexity and size, performance drops off rapidly as scale increases, and their struggles with scaling complexity hint at a lack of robust spatial representations in their underlying architectures.

2510.20205.tldr: This paper examines evolutionary training methods for optimizing AI to solve the game 2048, a 2D sliding puzzle with mix of strategic gameplay and stochastic elements, and implemented two distinct systems: a two-agent metaprompting system and a single-agent system based on refining a value function for a limited Monte Carlo Tree Search.

2510.20211.tldr: NSync is presented, an automated system for IaC reconciliation that propagates out-of-band changes back into the IaC program and employs an agentic architecture that leverages LLMs to infer high-level intents from noisy API sequences, synthesize targeted IaC updates using specialized tools, and continually improve through a self-evolving knowledge base of past reconciliations.

2510.20218.tldr: A novel value decomposition framework, called Continued Fraction Q-Learning (QCoFr), which can flexibly capture arbitrary-order agent interactions with only linear complexity $\mathcal{O}\left({n}\right)$ in the number of agents, thus avoiding the combinatorial explosion when modeling rich cooperation.

2510.20221.tldr: This work presents a hybrid framework that integrates statistical causal discovery algorithms with domain knowledge from two complementary sources: a financial knowledge graph extracted from SEC 10-K filings and large language model reasoning, providing portfolio managers with the causal foundation necessary for proactive risk management and strategic decision-making in dynamic market environments.

2510.20222.tldr: QKCV (Query-Key-Category-Value) attention, an extension of the traditional QKV framework that incorporates a static categorical embedding C to emphasize category-specific information, demonstrates remarkable adaptability in fine-tuning univariate time series foundation model.

2510.20225.tldr: A novel Bayesian meta-learning approach called meta-variational dropout, which learns to predict client-dependent dropout rates via a shared hypernetwork, enabling effective model personalization of FL algorithms in limited non-IID data settings.

2510.20229.tldr: This paper proposes a novel "induce-detect-suppress" framework that actively induces hallucinations through deliberately designed contexts, leverages induced instances for early detection of high-risk cases, and ultimately suppresses potential object-level hallucinations during actual decoding.

2510.20235.tldr: This work reformulates max-min multi-objective reinforcement learning as a two-player zero-sum regularized continuous game and introduces an efficient algorithm based on mirror descent that simplifies the policy update while ensuring global last-iterate convergence.

2510.20239.tldr: The unified tri modal affective severity framework synchronizes and fuses interview text with sentence level transformer embeddings, audio with log Mel statistics with deltas, and facial signals with action units, gaze, head and pose descriptors to output graded severities for diagnosing both depression and PTSD.

2510.20252.tldr: A novel task is introduced that evaluates different cognitive representation methods in ICS and shows that combining conceptual and linguistic features is particularly effective in ICS, outperforming static profile-based cues in overall evaluation.

2510.20255.tldr: This article presents early findings from designing, deploying and evaluating an AI-based educational agent deployed as the primary instructor in a graduate-level Cloud Computing course at IISc, and proposes an analytical framework that evaluates the Agent--Student interaction transcripts using interpretable engagement metrics of topic coverage, topic depth and turn-level elaboration.

2510.20258.tldr: The experiments show that GPT-4o can generally synthesize useful planning domain abstractions in simple settings, although it is better at abstracting over actions than over the associated fluents.

2510.20272.tldr: An adaptive algorithm to maximize process reward model (PRM) scores over the intractable action space is proposed, and whether PRM-guided tree search can improve mathematical reasoning by exploring multiple partial solution paths is investigated.

2510.20275.tldr: STaBERT (Semantic-Temporal aware BERT), which integrates both POI and temporal information at each location to construct a unified, semantically enriched representation of mobility, is proposed.

2510.20286.tldr: This paper introduces the Instruction-as-Reasoning paradigm, treating instructions as dynamic analytical pathways that offer distinct perspectives and enabling the model to select the most effective pathway during reasoning, and proposes a two-stage training framework: supervised fine-tuning on synthesized, diverse instructions to instill multi-perspective reasoning.

2510.20287.tldr: This work analyzes the applicability of the modern video foundation models (both encoder and decoder) for a very niche but hugely popular dance sports - breakdance and shows that Video Encoder models continue to outperform state-of-the-art Video Language Models for prediction tasks.

2510.20291.tldr: This work trains three platform experts using a progressive two-stage, hard-negative mining strategy to enhance discriminative power, and fuse their scores at inference to demonstrate robust cross-modal geo-localization under heterogeneous viewpoints.

2510.20296.tldr: This paper presents RAG-Stack, a three-pillar blueprint for quality-performance co-optimization in RAG systems that it is believed will become the de facto paradigm for RAG quality-performance co-optimization in the years to come.

2510.20314.tldr: An adversarial attack classification framework based on perturbation type and attack target is proposed and the future research direction of DRL in adversarial environments is looked into, emphasizing the research needs in terms of improving generalization, reducing computational complexity, and enhancing scalability and explainability.

2510.20327.tldr: This work proposes LEGO, a lightweight and efficient multiple-attribute unlearning framework that frames the unlearning process as a mutual information minimization problem, providing LEGO a theoretical guarantee of simultaneous unlearning, thereby addressing CH1.

2510.20328.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical policy framework, where the high-level policy is trained to select and track previous relevant keyframes from its experience and the high-level policy uses selected keyframes and the most recent frames when generating text instructions for a low-level policy to execute.

2510.20332.tldr: This paper identifies several types of bias across multiple use cases, including historical, representation, and measurement biases, which manifest in variables such as sex, gender, age, habitat, socioeconomic status, equipment, and labeling in clinical data collection.

2510.20337.tldr: A novel collateral damage assessment model for target engagement of AI systems in military operations is introduced that integrates temporal, spatial, and force dimensions within a unified Knowledge Representation and Reasoning (KRR) architecture following a design science methodological approach.

2510.20342.tldr: Hint-Engineering is proposed, a new data synthesis strategy that strategically injects diverse hints at optimal points within reasoning paths that generates high-quality, code-integrated reasoning data specifically tailored to optimize LRM-CI interaction.

2510.20345.tldr: This systematic review aims to clarify the evolving interplay between LLMs and knowledge graphs, bridging symbolic knowledge engineering and neural semantic understanding toward the development of adaptive, explainable, and intelligent knowledge systems.

2510.20351.tldr: This work proposes a framework for assessing contamination in tabular datasets by generating controlled queries and performing comparative evaluation, and introduces a statistical testing procedure to formally detect significant deviations indicative of contamination.

2510.20375.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs struggle to detect hallucinations in negated text effectively, often producing logically inconsistent or unfaithful judgments, and the internal state of LLMs as they process negated inputs at the token level is traced, revealing the challenges of mitigating their unintended effects.

2510.20377.tldr: This work proposes Instruction-Knowledge-Aware Continual Adaptation (IKnow), a simple and general framework that formulates novel self-supervised objectives in the instruction-response dialogue format that leverages domain knowledge embedded within the text itself and learns to encode it at a deeper semantic level.

2510.20381.tldr: VLSP 2025 MLQA-TSR comprises two subtasks: multimodal legal retrieval and multimodal question answering on traffic sign regulation shared task at VLSP 2025, to provide a benchmark dataset for building and evaluating intelligent systems in multimodal legal domains.

2510.20387.tldr: The Relative-Based Scaling Law complements the cross-entropy perspective and contributes to a more complete understanding of scaling large language models and offers valuable insights for both practical development and theoretical exploration.

2510.20388.tldr: FLAS (Forecasted Load Auto-Scaling), an auto-scaling system for distributed services that combines the advantages of proactive and reactive approaches according to the situation to decide the optimal scaling actions in every moment is presented.

2510.20402.tldr: A new computational model of creative outcomes, informed by creativity theories and techniques, which was implemented to generate more novel opportunities for innovation projects and generated outcomes that were more novel and/or useful than outcomes from Notebook LM and ChatGPT4o.

2510.20408.tldr: An enhanced industry-inspired benchmark environment that combines tasks from two existing benchmarks, SortingEnv and ContainerGym, into a sequential recycling scenario with sorting and pressing operations is introduced, highlighting the decisive role of action space constraints and suggesting that the advantages of specialization diminish as action complexity is reduced.

2510.20441.tldr: Experiments indicate the proposed UniSE can achieve competitive performance compared to discriminative and generative baselines, showing the capacity of LMs in unifying SE tasks.

2510.20457.tldr: This work presents a novel neural reasoner, Ebr, which solely requires retrieving instances for atomic concepts and existential restrictions to retrieve or approximate the set of instances of any concept in the description logic \(\mathcal {SHOIQ}\).

2510.20467.tldr: FLORA is proposed, a simple yet effective method that is unsupervised, does not require training data, provides a holistic alignment for entities and relations iteratively, is based on fuzzy logic and thus delivers interpretable results, and achieves state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks.

2510.20468.tldr: This work introduces a preference model to assess whether an image is watermarked and demonstrates the model's capability to remove and forge watermarks by optimizing the input image through backpropagation, demonstrating that the approach can effectively forge watermarks, questioning the security of current watermarking approaches.

2510.20469.tldr: This paper focuses on showing how holonic structures tend to be generated when there are constraints on resources for interactions based on a set of fully intercommunicating elements whose components fuse information as a means of optimizing the impact of vagueness and uncertainty present message exchanges.

2510.20479.tldr: Recall is proposed, a novel representation-aware model merging framework for continual learning without access to historical data that achieves seamless multi-domain integration and strong resistance to catastrophic forgetting.

2510.20486.tldr: Comprehensive evaluation via statistical metrics and case studies investigating rainy weather in eastern China confirms Hurdle-IMDL's superiority over conventional, cost-sensitive, generative, and multi-task learning methods.

2406.14144.tldr: This paper proposes inference-time activation contrasting to locate safety neurons within LLMs and dynamic activation patching to evaluate their causal effects on model safety, and demonstrates an application of the findings in safeguarding LLMs by detecting unsafe outputs before generation.

2410.07812.tldr: This work proposes new learning objectives that integrate the regularization effects of multiple previous posterior estimations, preventing individual errors from dominating future posterior updates and compounding over time.

2501.01243.tldr: This paper proposes a hierarchical ability taxonomy that includes three levels of abilities, and conducts evaluations over 25 mainstream multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with the Face-Human-Bench, focusing on the correlation between abilities, the impact of the relative position of targets on performance, and the impact of Chain of Thought prompting on performance.

2502.13251.tldr: Experiments on both training a new transformer from scratch and fine-tuning existing large language models show that NAtS can efficiently reduce the KV cache size required for the models while maintaining the models' performance.

2504.15275.tldr: This paper identifies the main cause of PRM-induced reward hacking and proposes PURE, a min-form credit assignment that formulates the value function as the minimum of future rewards that significantly alleviates reward hacking by limiting the value function range and distributing advantages more reasonably.

2504.18458.tldr: FAST-GRPO, a variant of GRPO that dynamically adapts reasoning depth based on question characteristics, is presented, establishing the feasibility of fast-slow thinking in LVLMs by investigating how response length and data distribution affect performance.

2505.12944.tldr: A novel continuous convolution-based encoder-decoder architecture that uses an epsilon-neighborhood-constrained kernel and learns to apply the convolution operator to adaptive and optimized query points is introduced.

2505.13358.tldr: The Koopman Distillation Model (KDM), a novel offline distillation approach grounded in Koopman theory - a classical framework for representing nonlinear dynamics linearly in a transformed space, achieves highly competitive performance across standard offline distillation benchmarks.

2505.13938.tldr: A high-quality, curated benchmark of 161 problems for end-to-end verified code generation in Lean, using several few-shot and agentic approaches based on state-of-the-art language models to evaluate several few-shot and agentic approaches based on state-of-the-art language models.

2505.16581.tldr: This paper proves, under certain assumptions, a generalisation bound for policy distillation after training, and empirically verify that these insights hold in more general settings, when the assumptions required for the theory no longer hold.

2506.16349.tldr: This work introduces a custom tokenizer-detokenizer finetuning procedure that improves RCC, and introduces a complementary watermark synchronization layer that enables reliable and robust watermark detection with theoretically grounded p-values.

2506.17065.tldr: FANTOM is introduced, a unified framework for causal discovery that handles non-stationary processes along with non-Gaussian and heteroscedastic noises and uses a Bayesian Expectation Maximization algorithm that maximizes the evidence lower bound of the data log-likelihood.

2506.23679.tldr: It is found that reciprocal operand training leads to strong performance gains, with sudden generalization across related moduli, and synchronized accuracy surges reflect grokking-like dynamics, suggesting the model internalizes shared arithmetic structure.

2507.12006.tldr: A novel, circuit-theory-inspired strategy called Frequency-Dynamic Attention Modulation (FDAM), which can be easily plugged into ViTs, is proposed, leading to consistent performance improvements across various models, including SegFormer, DeiT, and MaskDINO.

2508.04586.tldr: This paper offers a data-driven diagnosis of a structural crisis that threatens the foundational goals of scientific dissemination, equity, and community well-being, and proposes the Community-Federated Conference (CFC) model, which separates peer review, presentation, and networking into globally coordinated but locally organized components.

2509.04462.tldr: Overall, GPT-5 approaches deployment-ready performance for biomedical QA while offering a favorable balance of accuracy, interpretability, and economic efficiency, and a tiered prompting strategy for large-scale or cost-sensitive applications.

2509.06863.tldr: This work introduces floq (flow-matching Q-functions), an approach that parameterizes the Q-function using a velocity field and trains it using techniques from flow-matching, typically used in generative modeling, highlighting the potential of iterative computation for value learning.

2510.02253.tldr: This work proposes the first framework to effectively harness FLUX's rich prior for drag-based editing, dubbed DragFlow, achieving substantial gains over baselines, setting a new state-of-the-art in drag-based image editing.

2510.08396.tldr: FlyLoRA is proposed, an implicit MoE-based LoRA variant that introduces rank-wise expert activation in the up-projection matrix and an implicit router that unifies expert routing and down-projection, where a frozen sparse random projection matrix replaces the traditional dense trainable version.

2510.16662.tldr: The Similarity Framework for Visualization Retrieval (Safire), a conceptual model that frames visualization similarity along two dimensions: comparison criteria and representation modalities, is introduced and its findings reveal how particular criteria and modalities align across different use cases.

2510.17111.tldr: A systematic review of approaches for improving VLA efficiency, with an emphasis on reducing latency, memory footprint, and training and inference costs, and summarizing representative techniques within each category.

2510.17385.tldr: This work proposes a reasoning framework centered on Permutation Relative Policy Optimization (PRPO), a reinforcement learning method that encodes column-permutation invariance as a structural prior and transforms sparse rewards into dense signals, activating latent numerical reasoning capabilities of LLMs with limited supervision.

2510.20531.tldr: A unified multi-task learning architecture, FiFa-MLLM, to simultaneously support abundant multimodal inputs and outputs for fine-grained Explainable DeepFake Analysis, can outperform strong baselines on the AGE task and achieve SOTA performance on existing XDFA datasets.

2510.20535.tldr: An encoder that compresses the context into continuous representations which replace token embeddings in decoder LLMs, and can be adapted to multiple decoders simultaneously, allowing a single encoder to generalize across different decoder LLMs.

2510.20556.tldr: This work provides the first systematic analysis of how rewiring affects a range of graph structural metrics, and how these changes relate to downstream task performance, and reveals a consistent pattern: successful rewiring methods tend to preserve local structure while allowing for flexibility in global connectivity.

2510.20566.tldr: AdaDoS is introduced, an adaptive attack model that disrupt network operations while evading detection by existing DoS-based detectors through adversarial reinforcement learning (RL), and represents the first application of RL to develop DoS-like attack sequences.

2510.20579.tldr: This work introduces Open-o3-Video, a non-agent framework that integrates explicit spatio-temporal evidence into video reasoning by highlighting key timestamps, objects, and bounding boxes, making the reasoning process traceable and verifiable.

2510.20584.tldr: The results show that ChatGPT-based coding perform consistently in the same way as human raters across gender or racial/ethnic groups, demonstrating the possibility of its use in large-scale assessments of collaboration and communication.

2510.20591.tldr: A heterogeneous edge-aware message passing GNN is developed to predict effective nodes for busbar splitting actions as candidate NTO solutions and a graph neural network (GNN)-accelerated approach is proposed, demonstrating a significant step toward near-real-time NTO for large-scale systems with topology and cross-system generalization.

2510.20596.tldr: A novel framework for cross-modality segmentation via similarity-based prototypes that learns class-wise prototypes within an embedding space, then introduces a similarity constraint to make these prototypes representative for each semantic class while separable from different classes.

2510.20602.tldr: A task called resounding is introduced, which aims to estimate room impulse responses at arbitrary emitter location from a sparse set of measured emitter positions, analogous to the relighting problem in vision.

2510.20603.tldr: This work provides a scalable framework for analyzing, debugging, and improving LLM reasoning, and shows that curating training data with CaSE-evaluated relevance and coherence directly improves final task performance.

2510.20604.tldr: A novel formulation of random walk centrality is presented, underpinning two scalable algorithms: one leveraging approximate Cholesky factorization and sparse inverse estimation, while the other sampling rooted spanning trees.

2510.20605.tldr: OnlineSplatter is introduced, a novel online feed-forward framework generating high-quality, object-centric 3D Gaussians directly from RGB frames without requiring camera pose, depth priors, or bundle optimization.

2510.20607.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach to reasoning generalization by learning energy landscapes over the solution spaces of smaller, more tractable subproblems, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, demonstrating its ability to generalize to larger and more complex problems.

2510.20609.tldr: Evidence-based recommendations for implementing effective code-oriented RAG systems based on task requirements, model constraints, and computational efficiency are provided.

2510.20611.tldr: This research study proposes an integrated framework that incorporates customized Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for feature selection and highlights the potential of combining swarm intelligence with explainable ML for robust, trustworthy, and clinically meaningful breast cancer diagnosis.

2510.20612.tldr: This paper analyzes the mechanisms of absorption and proposes a concrete governance and engineering agenda to mitigate these risks, ensuring that creator contributions remain traceable, controllable, and equitable.

2510.20629.tldr: It is shown that FASM substantially improves fairness while preserving discrimination performance comparable to fairness-unaware survival models, and time-stratified evaluations show that FASM maintains stable fairness over a 10-year horizon, with the greatest improvements observed during the mid-term of follow-up.

2510.20630.tldr: Using a dataset of about 150,000 jobs that follow the IBM Quantum schema, ML methods based on Gradient-Boosting (LightGBM) are employed to predict the QPU processing times, incorporating data preprocessing methods to improve model accuracy.

2510.20632.tldr: EcomEval is introduced, a comprehensive multilingual and multimodal benchmark for evaluating LLMs in e-commerce that spans seven languages-including five low-resource Southeast Asian languages-offering a multilingual perspective absent from prior work.

2510.20634.tldr: This work systematically review 260 studies on DL applications in DIA and presents the foundational techniques of DL and categorize relevant models and algorithms according to different DIA tasks, analyzing their network architectures, optimization strategies, training methods, and performance.

2510.20635.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation framework that covers dimensions such as Information Seeking, Thrill Seeking, and Social Curiosity to assess the extent of curiosity exhibited by large language models suggests that LLMs have the potential to exhibit curiosity similar to that of humans.

2510.20636.tldr: The Fluidity Index (FI) is introduced to quantify model adaptability in dynamic, scaling environments, and distinguishes between closed-ended and open-ended benchmarks, prioritizing closed-loop open-ended real-world benchmarks to test adaptability.

2510.20641.tldr: A fine-grained systematisation of existing approaches on rational agents enhanced by ML is presented, using the BDI paradigm as a reference, and identifies key research opportunities and open challenges for designing effective rational ML agents.

2510.20653.tldr: This paper systematically compares self-reflection and budget tuning across mathematical reasoning and translation tasks, and reveals substantial domain dependent variation in self-reflection effectiveness, with performance gains up to 220\% in mathematical reasoning.

2510.20665.tldr: This work introduces a topological data analysis (TDA)-based evaluation framework that captures the geometry of reasoning traces and enables label-efficient, automated assessment and shows that a compact, stable set of topological features reliably indicates trace quality, offering a practical signal for future reinforcement learning algorithms.

2510.20677.tldr: R2-SVC achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple SVC benchmarks under both clean and noisy conditions, and integrates the Neural Source-Filter model to explicitly represent harmonic and noise components, enhancing the naturalness and controllability of converted singing.

2510.20683.tldr: Overall, Spikachu introduces a scalable, online-compatible neural decoding framework based on SNNs, whose performance is competitive relative to state-of-the-art models while consuming orders of magnitude less energy.

2510.20692.tldr: The results show that while there are significant hurdles in leveraging LLMs for automated policy generation, LLMs show promising results when combined with symbolic approaches in analyzing existing policies.

2510.20699.tldr: This work introduces M2VN, a novel deep learning-based framework for financial volatility forecasting that unifies time series features with unstructured news data and introduces an auxiliary alignment loss to enhance the integration of structured and unstructured data within the deep learning architecture.

2510.20718.tldr: Two novel approaches to advance the field from anomaly detection to anomaly prediction are proposed, an essential step toward enabling real-time process correction and proactive fault prevention and position the GNN as promising solution for online anomaly forecasting to be deployed in manufacturing environments.

2510.20727.tldr: LLM-based error analysis most effectively extracted fluoropyrimidine treatment and toxicity information from clinical notes, and has strong potential to support oncology research and pharmacovigilance.

2510.20733.tldr: This work develops a framework that extracts latent thoughts from all agents prior to communication and assigns each agent the relevant thoughts, along with their sharing patterns, and develops a framework that extracts latent thoughts from all agents prior to communication and assigns each agent the relevant thoughts, along with their sharing patterns.

2510.20743.tldr: A novel framework for multimodal human-AI interaction that enriches Large Language Model conversations with implicit non-verbal context that integrates a commercial facial expression recognition service and embeds them as contextual signals during prompting.

2510.20780.tldr: This work provides the first systematic analysis of LRM-as-a-judge in MT evaluation, revealing LRMs require tailored evaluation materials, tend to"overthink"simpler instances and have issues with scoring mechanisms leading to overestimation.

2510.20782.tldr: This work constructs a dataset that is driven by a real-world application, parameterized by fairness attributes intersected with gendered adjectives and product categories, yielding a rich set of labeled prompts, and shows how to use the data to identify quality, veracity, safety, and fairness gaps in LLMs.

2510.20797.tldr: A lightweight and simple mean-pooling approach is developed that consistently outperforms the widely used compression-tokens architecture, and study training the same compressor to output multiple compression ratios.

2510.20800.tldr: Overall, with a single gradient step on 100 examples and a quick scan of the top candidate layers and factorization techniques, this work shows that it can adapt LLMs to new datasets -- entirely without fine-tuning.

2510.20808.tldr: A guide to identifying the challenges and opportunities for future advancements in sim-to-real transfer for robotic systems, highlighting the causes, solutions, and evaluation metrics for the reality gap and sim-to-real transfer.

2510.20809.tldr: This work presents Real Deep Research (RDR) a comprehensive framework applied to the domains of AI and robotics, with a particular focus on foundation models and robotics advancements.

2510.20818.tldr: VAMOS is a hierarchical VLA that decouples semantic planning from embodiment grounding, enabling a single high-level planner to be deployed across physically distinct wheeled and legged robots and significantly enhances single-robot reliability.

2307.01225.tldr: A unified framework called Explainability-driven Detection, Identification, and Transformation (EDIT) to strengthen inference-time defenses against both standard, zero-day, and adaptive adversarial threats in text classification models is presented.

2404.10337.tldr: The Topology Enhancement Method (TEM), a novel Transformer-based TSF method that explicitly and adaptively preserves token-level topology, is proposed, a plug-and-play method that can be integrated with existing Transformer-based TSF methods.

2406.09755.tldr: A method named Mix Q-learning for Lane Changing (MQLC) that integrates a hybrid value Q network, taking into account both collective and individual benefits for the greater good, which impressively outperforms other state-of-the-art multi-agent decision-making methods.

2406.16258.tldr: This work introduces MEReQ (Maximum-Entropy Residual-Q Inverse Reinforcement Learning), designed for sample-efficient alignment from human intervention, which infers a residual reward function that captures the discrepancy between the human expert's and the prior policy's underlying reward functions.

2407.07311.tldr: This paper offers one pioneering study in the TSF foundation model development method and proposes a vision intelligence-powered framework, ViTime, for the first time, which fundamentally shifts TSF from numerical fitting to operations based on a binary image-based time series metric space and naturally supports both point and probabilistic forecasting.

2407.07612.tldr: An axiomatic training method where the system learns from multiple demonstrations of a causal axiom (or rule), rather than incorporating the axiom as an inductive bias or inferring it from data values is presented.

2407.09828.tldr: The proposed Adaptive Focal Loss (A-FL) dynamically adjusts itself based on an object's surface smoothness, size, and the class balancing parameter based on the ratio of targeted area and background to improve segmentation performance in intricate anatomical regions.

2407.10462.tldr: This work proposes BandCondiNet, a conditional model based on parallel Transformers, designed to process the multiple music sequences and generate high-quality multitrack samples, and proposes multi-view features across time and instruments as high-fidelity conditions.

2407.21227.tldr: A generalist approach, TaskEval, a framework using diverse prompts and Item Response Theory to efficiently assess LLMs’ capabilities and benchmark task characteristics, improving the understanding of their performance is introduced.

2408.05098.tldr: This work shows the potential of asynchronous processing to use less spikes, complete inference faster, and achieve competitive or even better accuracy, and investigates a potential solution direction, based on a generalization of backpropagation-based training, for learning models suitable for asynchronous processing.

2409.17411.tldr: This paper proposes a DRL architecture that incorporates a novel semantic clustering module that combines feature dimensionality reduction with online clustering, and introduces new analytical methods based on these properties to provide insights into the hierarchical structure of policies and semantic organization within the feature space.

2410.04108.tldr: This work establishes global optimality guarantees of PG methods for RLGU in which the objective is a general concave utility function of the state-action occupancy measure and provides global optimality results for large state-action space settings beyond prior work which has mostly focused on the tabular setting.

2410.10101.tldr: This study provides the first polynomial-time learnability results (specifically strong, agnostic PAC learning) for single-layer Transformers with linear attention, and shows that linear attention may be viewed as a linear predictor in a suitably defined RKHS.

2410.12854.tldr: Tree Preference Optimization (TPO) is introduced, that does not sample paired preference responses from the preference tree; instead, it directly learns from the entire preference tree during the fine-tuning.

2410.17477.tldr: Through an extensive evaluation, this work study how architecture-based inductive biases affect the propensity to hallucinate and highlights the need for better understanding both these problems in conjunction with each other.

2410.18972.tldr: This survey reviews the most relevant non-intrusive methodologies that use deep learning techniques to automate the cognitive decline detection task, including audio, text, and visual processing and presents studies that integrate different modalities to develop multimodal models.

2410.19315.tldr: It is shown that online natural gradient descent on F, under Poisson assumptions, leads to a recurrent spiking neural network that performs variational inference via membrane potential dynamics, and the iterative Poisson variational autoencoder (iP-VAE)— replaces the encoder network with local updates derived from natural gradient descent on F.

2410.23022.tldr: This work proposes ONI, a distributed architecture that simultaneously learns an RL policy and an intrinsic reward function using LLM feedback, and explores a range of algorithmic choices for reward modeling with varying complexity, including hashing, classification, and ranking models.

2411.10340.tldr: A domain-adaptation-based lightweight fault diagnosis framework tailored for edge computing scenarios is proposed, which aims to achieve accurate fault diagnosis under cross-working conditions while ensuring real-time diagnosis capabilities.

2412.00661.tldr: This work proposes a new algorithm and a decentralized randomized policy and proves that this learned policy converges to the optimal policy on the order of $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{k})$ as the number of subsampled agents $k$ increases.

2412.06771.tldr: Experiments demonstrate the proposed proactive T2I agents'ability to ask informative questions and elicit crucial information to achieve successful alignment with at least 2 times higher VQAScore than the standard T2I generation.

2412.08053.tldr: This work presents DynamicPAE, the first generative framework that enables scene-aware real-time physical attacks and introduces the residual-guided adversarial pattern exploration technique, which opens the door to end-to-end modeling of dynamic PAEs.

2412.09805.tldr: The Inceptive Graph Neural Network (IGNN) is introduced, built on three simple yet effective design principles, which alleviate the dilemma by enabling distinct hop-wise generalization alongside improved overall generalization with adaptive smoothness.

2501.03674.tldr: This work introduces a multi-scale dynamic visual-skeleton encoder to capture fine-grained spatio-temporal visual and skeletal features and introduces a newly-annotated FineDiving-Pose Dataset to improve the current low-quality human pose labels.

2501.16836.tldr: A history of misspellings is reconstructed as a scientific problem, and psycholinguistic perspectives on how humans process misspellings are explored, potentially informing innovative computational techniques for text normalization and representation.

2502.03325.tldr: The Electronic Circuit Principles (ECP) are introduced, which maps inference-time learning (ITL) onto a semantic electromotive force and inference-time reasoning (ITR) onto a resistive network governed by Ohm's and Faraday's laws, and provides a rigorous framework for predicting performance and optimising modular components.

2502.08021.tldr: This work develops new model-free and model-based selectors with theoretical guarantees with theoretical guarantees, and a new experimental protocol for empirically evaluating them, and exemplifies the protocol on Gym-Hopper, and finds that the new model-free selector, LSTD-Tournament, demonstrates promising empirical performance.

2502.12171.tldr: GoRA is the first method that not only addresses the limitations of prior approaches--which often focus on either rank selection or initialization in isolation--but also unifies both aspects within a single framework, enabling more effective and efficient adaptation.

2502.16810.tldr: An agentic framework that employs large language models for grounded persuasive language generation in automated copywriting, with real estate marketing as a focal application, to suggest a promising agentic approach to automate large-scale targeted copywriting while ensuring factuality of content generation.

2502.19573.tldr: A benchmark that challenges large Language Models to enumerate all information they possess on specific topics indicates their awareness of how much they know about the given topic, thereby indicating their awareness of how much they know about the given topic.

2502.20321.tldr: This paper introduces UniTok, a unified tokenizer featuring a novel multi-codebook quantization mechanism that effectively scales up the vocabulary size and bottleneck dimension, and shows that reconstruction and semantic supervision do not inherently conflict.

2503.04725.tldr: The Long-context Language Modeling condition is formulated, which lower bounds the necessary scaling of a model's history state -- the latent variables responsible for storing past information -- for effective long-context modeling.

2503.05179.tldr: Sketch-of-Thought (SoT), a prompting framework that integrates cognitively inspired reasoning paradigms with linguistic constraints to reduce token usage while preserving reasoning accuracy, is proposed.

2503.14109.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive overview of change detection methods tailored for the operational updating of large-scale geographic databases, categorizing automatic change detection methods into four main families: rule-based, statistical, machine learning, and simulation methods.

2503.18809.tldr: This paper shows how to use LLMs to generate correct plans, even for out-of-distribution tasks of increasing size, and shows that sampling a set of planning heuristic function programs can significantly improve the planning capabilities of LLMs.

2504.04675.tldr: This work proposes HYPRL, a specification-guided reinforcement learning framework that learns control policies w.r.t. hyperproperties expressed in HyperLTL to learn policies that maximize the satisfaction of a HyperLTL formula $\phi$.

2504.06020.tldr: This work decomposes the reward value into two independent components: prompt-free reward and prompt-related reward, which is extracted from an information-theoretic perspective and proposes a new reward learning algorithm by prioritizing data samples based on their prompt-free reward values.

2504.09702.tldr: This work introduces MLRC-Bench, a benchmark designed to quantify how effectively language agents can tackle challenging Machine Learning (ML) Research Competitions, with a focus on open research problems that demand novel methodologies.

2504.20571.tldr: It is shown that reinforcement learning with verifiable reward using one training example (1-shot RLVR) is effective in incentivizing the math reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), and it is verified that the effectiveness of 1-shot RLVR primarily arises from the policy gradient loss, distinguishing it from the"grokking"phenomenon.

2505.06314.tldr: The motivations, goals, requirements, and preliminary applications of the Architecture for AI-Augmented Learning (A4L) are presented and how it advances the goals of making learning more personalized and scalable are discussed.

2505.08082.tldr: A novel metric based on the Fr\'e}chet Distance estimated between two datasets in a learned feature space is proposed, which evaluates the quality of generation from a distributional perspective and demonstrates the superiority of the proposed metric across timescales and models.

2505.10994.tldr: This work proposes SGEquiDiff, a crystal generative model which naturally handles space group constraints with space group invariant likelihoods, and shows that space group equivariant vector fields automatically live in the tangent spaces of the Wyckoff positions.

2505.11080.tldr: It is shown that given access to high-quality reference outputs, string matching-based metrics are cheap yet effective proxies for reward models during alignment, and BLEUBERI-trained models are competitive with models trained via reward model-guided RL across four challenging instruction-following benchmarks and three different base language models.

2505.11217.tldr: A neuroscience-inspired model is proposed, EchoPin, which uses a stereo audio-image dataset generated via 3D simulations and mirrors human-like horizontal localization bias favoring left-right precision-likely due to the stereo audio structure reflecting human ear placement, and surpasses existing benchmarks.

2505.11475.tldr: HelpSteer3-Preference is introduced, a high-quality, human-annotated preference dataset comprising of over 40,000 samples that can be applied to train Generative RMs and how policy models can be aligned with RLHF using the authors' RMs.

2505.11568.tldr: This work introduces BioCube, a multimodal, fine-grained global dataset for ecology and biodiversity research, which incorporates species observations through images, audio recordings and descriptions, environmental DNA, vegetation indices, agricultural, forest, land indicators, and high-resolution climate variables.

2505.13499.tldr: This framework improves the performance of existing Transformer models while providing desirable theoretical guarantees, including generalization and robustness, and is designed to be plug-and-play, enabling seamless integration with established Transformer models and requiring only slight changes to the implementation.

2505.13737.tldr: The findings reveal that LLMs contain multiple sparse task-sufficient sub-circuits, that individual head roles depend on interactions with others (low modularity), and that instruction following and in-context learning rely on separable mechanisms.

2505.13763.tldr: A neuroscience-inspired neurofeedback paradigm designed to quantify the ability of LLMs to explicitly report and control their activation patterns is introduced, providing empirical evidence quantifying metacognitive capabilities in LLMs, with significant implications for AI safety.

2505.15657.tldr: It is shown that learning curves are less often well-behaved than previously thought, and the impact of ill-behavior on downstream tasks, such as learning curve fitting and model selection, and find it poses significant challenges is evaluated, underscoring the relevance and potential of LCDB 1.1 as a challenging benchmark for future research.

2505.15966.tldr: This work introduces the concept of reasoning in the pixel-space and demonstrates that this approach significantly improves VLM performance across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks, marking the highest accuracy achieved by any open-source model to date.

2505.16035.tldr: Equivariant Neural Eikonal Solvers, a novel framework that integrates Equivariant Neural Fields (ENFs) with Neural Eikonal Solvers, demonstrates superior performance, scalability, adaptability, and user controllability compared to existing Neural Operator-based Eikonal solvers.

2505.16986.tldr: T1, a tool-augmented, multi-domain, multi-turn conversational dataset specifically designed to capture and manage inter-tool dependencies across diverse domains, is introduced, highlighting their ability to plan and reason in complex, tool-dependent scenarios.

2505.17495.tldr: Experiments show that ProxySPEX more faithfully reconstructs LLM outputs by 20% over marginal attribution approaches while using $10\times fewer inferences than SPEX, and efficiently identifies the most influential features, providing a scalable approximation of their Shapley values.

2505.17749.tldr: This paper identifies the connection between the output of the encoder and the ensuing dense layers as the main underlying factor limiting scaling capabilities, and presents global average pooling as a simple yet effective way of targeting the bottleneck, thereby avoiding the complexity of earlier approaches.

2505.17859.tldr: Holder-DPO is proposed, the first principled alignment loss with a provable redescending property, enabling estimation of the clean data distribution from noisy feedback, and achieves state-of-the-art robust alignment performance while accurately detecting mislabels in controlled datasets.

2505.18512.tldr: Results on the TREC-DL and BEIR benchmarks show that the AcuRank method consistently achieves a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off and scales better with compute than fixed-computation baselines, and the effectiveness and generalizability of the method across diverse retrieval tasks and LLM-based reranking models.

2505.19092.tldr: This work explores an alternative approach that shifts from explicit CoT reasoning to compact, information-dense latent reasoning, and demonstrates that LatentR$^3$ enables effective latent reasoning without any direct supervision of the reasoning process, significantly improving performance when integrated with different LLM-based recommendation methods.

2505.19245.tldr: It is shown that Looped Transformers can efficiently simulate parallel computations for deterministic tasks, which is formalized as evaluation over directed acyclic graphs, and suggest the tasks for which depth-driven recursion is more suitable, thereby offering practical cues for choosing between reasoning paradigms.

2505.19527.tldr: This work proposes a new optimization procedure: Rolling Ball Optimizer (RBO), that is motivated by the intuition that the large-scale geometry of the loss landscape is less data-specific than its fine-grained structure, and that it is easier to optimize, and proves that the algorithm has a smoothing effect on the loss function.

2505.19947.tldr: MESS+ is introduced, a stochastic optimization algorithm for cost-optimal LLM request routing while providing rigorous SLA compliance guarantees and achieves an average of $2\times$ cost savings compared to existing LLM routing techniques.

2505.20081.tldr: Simple Energy Adaptation (SEA), a simple yet effective algorithm for inference-time alignment that formulates inference as an iterative optimization procedure on an energy function over actions in the continuous space defined by the optimal policy, enabling simple and effective alignment.

2505.20749.tldr: The results underscore the unique challenges of maintaining agent systems compared to traditional software, highlighting the need for further research to develop advanced SE agents for resolving agent issues.

2505.20922.tldr: DIMA establishes a new paradigm for constructing multi-agent world models, advancing the frontier of MARL research and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple multi-agent control benchmarks, significantly outperforming prior world models in terms of final return and sample efficiency.

2505.21955.tldr: This work presents E3VQA, the first benchmark for multi-view question answering with 4K high-quality question-answer pairs grounded in synchronized ego-exo image pairs, and proposes M3CoT, a training-free prompting technique that constructs a unified scene representation by integrating scene graphs from three complementary perspectives.

2505.23794.tldr: This work uses reinforcement learning to make the LLM learn how to $\textbf{R}$einforcement learning to make the LLM learn how to $\textbf{R}$eason and $\textbf{R}$etrieve step by step, thus retrieving comprehensive external knowledge and leading to correct answers.

2505.23811.tldr: This work proposes LayerIF, a data-driven framework that leverages Influence Functions to quantify the training quality of individual layers in a principled and task-sensitive manner, and derives data-driven estimates of layer importance.

2506.00138.tldr: 3M-Progress agents capture the explainable variance in behavioral patterns and whole-brain neural-glial dynamics recorded from autonomously behaving larval zebrafish, thereby providing the first goal-driven, population-level model of neural-glial computation.

2506.01728.tldr: This work introduces a principled approach to data augmentation tailored for QPs via MPNNs, which leverages theoretically justified data augmentation techniques to generate diverse yet optimality-preserving instances.

2506.01890.tldr: C CogniAlign is introduced, a multimodal architecture for Alzheimer's detection that integrates audio and textual modalities, two non-intrusive sources of information that offer complementary insights into cognitive health.

2506.02720.tldr: This study establishes a comprehensive benchmark and systematically evaluates the performance of diverse LLMs across a wide range of tasks relevant to local life services, revealing that even a relatively compact 7B model can attain performance levels comparable to a much larger 72B model.

2506.02992.tldr: Results demonstrate that the reflective multi-agent approach excels at successful abstention by preventing generation when arguments cannot be grounded, improves hallucination accuracy by reducing fabricated and misattributed factors and enhances factor utilization recall by better using the provided case facts.

2506.03525.tldr: This work proposes Video-Skill-CoT, a framework that automatically constructs and leverages skill-aware CoT supervisions for domain-adaptive video reasoning and introduces a skill-specific expert learning framework that specializes in a subset of reasoning skills.

2506.04723.tldr: SPARKLE, a fine-grained analytic framework to dissect the effects of RL across three key dimensions, observes that RL enhances models'ability to integrate provided knowledge into their reasoning process, yielding consistent gains across diverse tasks and introduces SparkleRL-PSS, a multi-stage RL pipeline that reuses hard problems with partial step scaffolding.

2506.05282.tldr: Rectified Point Flow is introduced, a unified parameterization that formulates pairwise point cloud registration and multi-part shape assembly as a single conditional generative problem that enables effective joint training on diverse datasets, facilitating the learning of shared geometric priors and consequently boosting accuracy.

2506.06278.tldr: This work shows that training a model can drastically modify its input-output behavior while leaving its underlying capabilities intact, and proposes Unlearn-Noise-Distill-on-Outputs (UNDO), a scalable method that distills an unlearned model into a noised copy of itself, which robustifies unlearning.

2506.06958.tldr: This work presents a conceptual modeling paradigm, Generative Minds (GenMinds), which draws from cognitive science to support structured belief representations in generative agents and introduces the RECAP (REconstructing CAusal Paths) framework, a benchmark designed to assess reasoning fidelity via causal traceability, demographic grounding, and intervention consistency.

2506.07524.tldr: This work introduces TAI3, an API-centric stress testing framework that systematically uncovers intent integrity violations in LLM agents, and proposes semantic partitioning, which organizes natural language tasks into meaningful categories based on toolkit API parameters and their equivalence classes.

2506.07736.tldr: This work proposes RSafe, an adaptive reasoning-based safeguard that conducts guided safety reasoning to provide robust protection within the scope of specified safety policies and accepts user-specified safety policies to provide enhanced safeguards tailored to specific safety requirements.

2506.09033.tldr: Router-R1 instantiates the router itself as a capable LLM, leveraging its reasoning ability to interleave "think"actions with "route"actions, and integrates each response into its evolving context, opening a pathway toward enhancing performance-cost trade-offs via RL.

2506.09498.tldr: Fast-MCTD is proposed, a more efficient variant of Monte Carlo Tree Diffusion that preserves the strengths of MCTD while significantly improving its speed and scalability and outperforms Diffuser in inference speed on some tasks, despite Diffuser requiring no search and yielding weaker solutions.

2506.09891.tldr: An interpretable climate model emulator based on causal representation learning is developed including a Bayesian filter for stable long-term autoregressive emulation and it is demonstrated that the emulator learns accurate climate dynamics.

2506.10226.tldr: This paper proposes ScoreMix, a self-contained synthetic generation method to produce hard synthetic samples for recognition tasks by leveraging the score compositionality of diffusion models, and finds that mixing classes distant in the discriminator's embedding space yields larger gains, compared to selection based on proximity.

2506.11128.tldr: Methodologically, PyETR provides an open-source pipeline for unbounded, synthetic, contamination-resistant reasoning tests linked to a cognitive theory, enabling analyses that focus on error composition rather than error rate.

2506.11139.tldr: This work investigates the performance of diverse INRs across a suite of 2D and 3D real and synthetic signals with varying effective bandwidth, as well as both overfitting and generalization tasks including tomography, super-resolution, and denoising.

2506.11887.tldr: A cascaded LLM decision framework that adaptively delegates tasks across multiple tiers of expertise -- a base model for initial candidate answers, a more capable and knowledgeable (but costlier) large model, and a human expert for when the model cascade abstains.

2506.12104.tldr: This work empirically validate the effectiveness of DRIFT on the AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn benchmark, demonstrating its strong security performance while maintaining high utility across diverse models, showcasing both its robustness and adaptability.

2506.12542.tldr: A choice-theoretic perspective is adopted and the Plackett-Luce model is recast under the Plackett-Luce model by interpreting teacher logits as worth scores, a weighted list-wise ranking loss that achieves consistent gains across diverse architectures and distillation objectives.

2506.18631.tldr: This work proposes ReDit (Reward Dithering), a method that dithers the discrete reward signal by adding simple random noise, enabling smoother gradient updates and accelerating convergence in DeepSeek-R1.

2506.21584.tldr: This work presents the first empirical evidence that a small instruction-tuned model, specifically LLaMA 3 8B, can also exhibit alignment faking and shows that prompt-only interventions, including deontological moral framing and scratchpad reasoning, significantly reduce this behavior without modifying model internals.

2506.23726.tldr: System embedded Diffusion Bridge Models (SDBs) are introduced, a new class of supervised bridge methods that explicitly embed the known linear measurement system into the coefficients of a matrix-valued SDE, offering a promising solution to real-world applications.

2507.06485.tldr: This work presents Video-RTS, a new approach to improve video reasoning capability with drastically improved data efficiency by combining data-efficient RL with a video-adaptive test-time scaling (TTS) strategy, and introduces a sparse-to-dense video TTS strategy that improves inference by iteratively adding frames based on output consistency.

2507.07969.tldr: Q-chunking adopts action chunking by directly running RL in a'chunked'action space, enabling the agent to leverage temporally consistent behaviors from offline data for more effective online exploration and use unbiased $n$-step backups for more stable and efficient TD learning.

2507.14193.tldr: A stylized model of the regulator's choice of an open-source definition to evaluate which AI openness standards will establish appropriate economic incentives for developers is presented and enables evaluation and refinement of practical open-source policies.

2507.14198.tldr: It is found that edited knowledge is substantially more susceptible to forgetting during fine-tuning than intrinsic knowledge acquired through pre-training, highlighting a key limitation of current editing approaches and suggesting that evaluating edit robustness under downstream fine-tuning is critical for their practical deployment.

2507.15887.tldr: This work develops a baseline LM agent, AlgoTuner, and evaluates its performance across a suite of frontier models, finding that current models fail to discover algorithmic innovations, instead preferring surface-level optimizations.

2507.23773.tldr: SimuRA, a goal-oriented architecture for generalized agentic reasoning based on a principled formulation of an optimal agent in any general environment, is introduced, addressing the limitations of black-box autoregressive reasoning by incorporating the world model for planning via simulation.

2508.00264.tldr: This work examines various open-sourced LLMs, identifying significant calibration degradation after instruction tuning in each and posit the cause to stem from the ability to become over-confident, which has a direct relationship with the hidden size and vocabulary size.

2508.01139.tldr: DC3 is the first research to fine-tune pre-trained diffusion models with condensed datasets and prove that training networks with high-quality datasets is feasible without model collapse or other degradation issues.

2508.03872.tldr: SICKLE is developed, a sparse intelligent curation framework for efficient learning, featuring a novel maximum entropy sampling approach, scalable training, and energy benchmarking, and it is shown that subsampling as a preprocessing step can, in many cases, improve model accuracy and substantially lower energy consumption.

2508.05201.tldr: This work develops a rigorous and scalable framework for evaluating intrinsic hallucinations in financial LLMs, conceptualized as a context-aware masked span prediction task over real-world financial documents, and provides a robust methodology for in-house LLM evaluation.

2508.17412.tldr: This work formalizes weak-spectrum underfitting, derive a sign-switch result under conservative baseline shrinkage, and study criterion-based automatic selection over the full negative-capable family.

2508.20700.tldr: This work inovatively design and proposes a generative method to annotate entity errors in ASR transcripts and replace the text with correct entities, which is effective in scenarios of word form difference.

2509.07036.tldr: The value of combining causal structure learning with probabilistic language models to inform economic policy and enhance forecasting robustness is demonstrated, with results revealing a robust unidirectional causal link from economic growth to GDP.

2509.13345.tldr: This paper critically examines how regulatory and evaluation frameworks have inherited a narrow view of hallucination, and proposes a layered approach to understanding hallucination risks, encompassing epistemic instability, user misdirection, and social-scale effects.

2509.15188.tldr: Conv, a normalization-based method that narrows the decoding window without hard segmentation, leading to better fluency and flexibility, and Rejecting Rule-based Fine-Tuning (R2FT), a post-hoc training scheme that better aligns tokens at positions far from context.

2509.15759.tldr: An optimization program for optimal steering is formulated by finding the nearest ideal distribution in KL-divergence, and efficient algorithms for it when the underlying distributions come from well-known parametric families (e.g., normal, log-normal).

2509.17470.tldr: The scalability of the ’Transformer-Gather, Fuzzy-Reconsider’ framework makes it deployable on standard CPU-based infrastructure, offering a practical and effective solution for enterprise-level data integrity auditing.

2509.18119.tldr: An online agentic reinforcement learning framework MobileRL is presented to enhance GUI agents in mobile environments and introduces the shortest-path reward adjustment strategy to reshape rewards concerning the task length in multi-turn agentic tasks.

2509.21359.tldr: Inspired by recent advances in data selection, this novel metric quantifies context quality by measuring the performance degradation when removing each context from the list, effectively integrating query-aware relevance, list-aware uniqueness, and generator-aware alignment.

2509.21798.tldr: Think-as-Locals is proposed to elicit deeper culturally grounded reasoning from generative RMs via reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) and employ well-designed rewards to ensure accurate preference judgments and high-quality structured evaluation criteria generation.

2509.23041.tldr: This paper systematically evaluates the resilience of synthetic-data-integrated training paradigm for LLMs against mainstream poisoning and backdoor attacks, revealing that such a paradigm exhibits strong resistance to existing attacks, primarily thanks to the different distribution patterns between poisoning data and queries used to generate synthetic samples.

2509.24841.tldr: A Hierarchical Error Correction (HEC) framework is introduced that treats model failures as layered measurement errors and targets the layers that most affect inference and provides a transparent, measurement-first blueprint for diagnosing error profiles, selecting targeted interventions, and reporting reliability/validity evidence alongside accuracy.

2509.25016.tldr: The zero-training design makes CLASP a strong, easily reproducible baseline for large unannotated corpora-especially common in digital advertising and marketing workflows such as brand-safety screening, creative asset curation, and social-media content moderation.

2510.00415.tldr: This work marks a paradigm shift from static, manually curated benchmarks to dynamic, self-evolving evaluation systems, providing a sustainable and challenging runway for agent development.

2510.00566.tldr: PANORAMA is a machine learning-driven approach that tackles the ANNS verification bottleneck through data-adaptive learned orthogonal transforms that facilitate the accretive refinement of distance bounds, enabling early candidate pruning with partial distance computations.

2510.03317.tldr: An inpainting-guided, perturbation-based explanation technique that produces photorealistic, mask-localized edits that preserve scene context and yield domain-relevant insights that support expert validation and more trustworthy deployment of AI in ecology.

2510.06186.tldr: RecODE-H is presented, a benchmark of 102 tasks from research papers and repositories that evaluates LLM agents through multi-turn interactions with LLM-simulated human feedback and establishes a foundation for developing adaptive, feedback-driven LLM agents in scientific research implementation.

2510.12733.tldr: This work proposes HYPE: HYbrid Planning with Ego proposal-conditioned predictions, a planner that integrates multimodal trajectory proposals from a learned proposal model as heuristic priors into a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) refinement, to model bidirectional interactions.

2510.12837.tldr: It is proposed that semantic knowledge-the associations linking concepts to their properties and functions-guides human innovation and drives cumulative culture and findings indicate that semantic knowledge is a key cognitive process enabling human cumulative culture.

2510.13665.tldr: A dimension-agnostic neural network architecture, the Axial Neural Network (XNN), inspired by parameter-sharing structures such as Deep Sets and Graph Neural Networks is proposed, which performs competitively with original models and exhibit superior generalization to unseen dimensions, highlighting the importance of multidimensional pretraining for foundation models.

2510.13905.tldr: It is demonstrated that a broad range of large language models lack the capacity to form and utilize internal schema-based learning representations implicitly, but instead benefit significantly from explicit schema-based scaffolding, and paves a new path for enhancing human-like reasoning in LLMs.

2510.14509.tldr: By evaluating various E2ESD frameworks and LLM backbones with E2EDev, the analysis reveals a persistent struggle to effectively solve these tasks, underscoring the critical need for more effective and cost-efficient E2ESD solutions.

2510.16757.tldr: SAMOSA prioritizes the samples that are highly informative for the targeted classes, and useful for distinguishing between targeted and unwanted classes, and achieves up to 3% accuracy improvement over the state of the art across several datasets, while not introducing computational overhead.

2510.17640.tldr: This work proposes an automated OOD data augmentation framework named RESample, which explicitly encourages the VLAs to recover from OOD states and enhances their robustness against distributional shifts, and conducts extensive experiments on the LIBERO benchmark as well as real-world robotic manipulation tasks, demonstrating that RESample consistently improves the stability and generalization ability of VLA models.

2510.18554.tldr: This work shows that it is possible to extract significant amounts of alignment training data from a post-trained model -- useful to steer the model to improve certain capabilities such as long-context reasoning, safety, instruction following, and maths, and argues that embedding models are better suited for specific goals.

2510.19386.tldr: This technical report presents ColorAgent, an OS agent designed to engage in long-horizon, robust interactions with the environment while also enabling personalized and proactive user interaction, and develops a tailored multi-agent framework that ensures generality, consistency, and robustness.

2510.19661.tldr: This work introduces AgentSense, a hybrid, training-free framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) into participatory urban sensing through a multi-agent evolution system and demonstrates that AgentSense offers distinct advantages in adaptivity and explainability over traditional methods.

2510.19949.tldr: Surfer 2 is introduced, a unified architecture operating purely from visual observations that achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three environments and calls for a next-generation vision language model to achieve Pareto-optimal cost-efficiency.

2510.20002.tldr: The Greek Embedding Models (GEMs), a new family of transformer-based language models, specifically developed to address architectural diversity and enhanced data curation limitations through architectural diversity and enhanced data curation, are proposed.

2510.20176.tldr: This work proposes Mixture-of-Minds, a multi-agent framework that decomposes table reasoning into three specialized roles: planning, coding, and answering, and introduces a self-improvement training framework that employs Monte Carlo Tree Search rollouts to generate pseudo-gold trajectories and optimize agents with reinforcement learning (RL).

2510.20242.tldr: This work formalizes the selective-classification gap as the selective-classification gap and presents the first finite-sample decomposition of this gap to five distinct sources of looseness: Bayes noise, approximation error, ranking error, statistical noise, and implementation- or shift-induced slack.

2510.20350.tldr: It is argued that AI-generated images want specificity and concreteness because they are fundamentally abstract.

2510.20448.tldr: The proposed MolBridge constructs a joint graph that integrates atomic structures of drug pairs, enabling direct modeling of inter-drug associations, and introduces a structure consistency module that iteratively refines node features while preserving the global structural context.

2510.20706.tldr: An optimization framework for real-time gait adaptation in a continuous gait space, combining the Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) algorithm with a Dreamer module to produce adaptive and optimal policies for quadruped locomotion is proposed.

2510.20838.tldr: A human-in-the-loop pipeline that converts unscaled, hand-drawn floor plan sketches into semantically consistent 3D BIM models is introduced, demonstrating how MLLM-driven multi-agent reasoning can make BIM creation accessible to both experts and non-experts using only freehand sketches.

2510.20839.tldr: It is shown that, because of evolutionary"baggage"-autonomous neurological reactions- experiential awareness is necessary for higher-level reasoning to be possible, and the implication is that, given artificial systems are architected without such legacy considerations, it is possible to design them with an arbitrary level of intelligence, without the need for experiential awareness.

2510.20846.tldr: ProtoEEG-kNN is introduced, an inherently interpretable model that follows a simple case-based reasoning process that can achieve state-of-the-art accuracy in IED detection while providing explanations that experts prefer over existing approaches.

2510.20847.tldr: SNF produces substantially sharper regional and model family-level separation than any single metric and yields robust composite similarity profiles, and clustering cortical regions using SNF-derived similarity scores reveals a clearer hierarchical organization that aligns closely with established anatomical and functional hierarchies of the visual cortex.

2510.20849.tldr: A quantitative study shows that the Cultural Alien Sampler method produces more diverse outputs and explores a broader conceptual space than its GPT-4o counterpart, demonstrating that artificial cultural alienness can unlock creative potential in autonomous agents.

2510.20861.tldr: The paper defines operations on extensional fuzzy numbers and relational operators (=,>,>=,<,<,<=) for them and the proposed approach is illustrated with several applicational examples.

2510.20867.tldr: CESAR (Consistent, Effective, and Scalable Audio Reasoners) establishes a principled method for developing robust and scalable reasoning in Audio LLMs, and creates synergistic effects, simultaneously improving multimodal reasoning and perception capabilities.

2510.20868.tldr: CRISP (Crisis-Resilient Investment through Spatio-temporal Patterns), a graph-based spatio-temporal learning framework that encodes spatial relationships via Graph Convolutional Networks and temporal dynamics via BiLSTM with self-attention, then learns sparse structures through multi-head Graph Attention Networks.

2510.20877.tldr: This work provably tightens the robustness lower bound of multimodal learning by increasing the Unimodal Confidence Margin (UCoM) and reduces the empirical error of weak modalities, particularly under noisy and imbalanced scenarios.

2510.20878.tldr: A hotness-aware RAG (HA-RAG) inference optimization system that prioritizes storing frequently accessed KV chunks in high-speed memory to improve data access efficiency and introduces a hotness-aware mixed-precision compressing and loading method to reduce disk I/O and memory access overhead.

2510.20886.tldr: A novel Monte Carlo inference strategies for LMs inspired by Bayesian Experimental Design are developed, which enable weaker LMs, such as Llama-4-Scout, to outperform both humans and frontier models at ~1% of GPT-5's cost.

2510.20888.tldr: Video-As-Prompt (VAP), a new paradigm that reframes this problem as in-context generation, and sets a new state-of-the-art for open-source methods, achieving a 38.7% user preference rate that rivals leading condition-specific commercial models.

2510.20909.tldr: These findings support that (1) CodeAdapt-style learning and reasoning may be robust and domain general and (2) code-enabled LMs are cognitively grounded and powerful systems, potentially providing a strong foundation for in-weight reinforcement learning.

2510.20930.tldr: A novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to analyze Suricata IDS logs and infer attacker actions in terms of MITRE ATT&CK techniques is proposed, demonstrating that LLMs can bridge the semantic gap between packet-level logs and strategic intent, offering a pathway toward cognitive-adaptive cyber defense.

2510.20932.tldr: The vulnerability of Urban Autonomous Aerial Vehicles (UAAVs) using the DroNet framework was assessed and a significant drop in accuracy was shown, from 96.4% on clean data to 73.3% on data triggered by Trojan attacks.

2510.20933.tldr: The Focal Modulation and Bidirectional Feature Fusion Network for Medical Image Segmentation, referred to as FM-BFF-Net, combines convolutional and transformer components, employs a focal modulation attention mechanism to refine context awareness, and introduces a bidirectional feature fusion module that enables efficient interaction between encoder and decoder representations across scales.

2510.20943.tldr: This work establishes a systematic application of meta-learning to protein mutation analysis and introduces an effective mutation encoding strategy, offering transformative methodology for cross-domain generalization in protein engineering.

2510.20967.tldr: 3DReasonKnee is introduced, the first 3D grounded reasoning dataset for medical images, which provides 494k high-quality quintuples derived from 7,970 3D knee MRI volumes, and ReasonKnee-Bench is established to evaluate localization and diagnostic accuracy.

2510.20975.tldr: REx86 delivers state-of-the-art assistance in x86 RE among local, open-weight LLMs and demonstrates the value of domain-specific fine-tuning, and highlights the need for more commented disassembly data to further enhance LLM performance in RE.

2510.20979.tldr: This work presents MeDyate, a theoretically-grounded framework for memory-constrained dynamic subnetwork adaptation that introduces two key innovations: LaRa (Layer Ranking), an improved layer importance metric that enables principled layer pre-selection, and a dynamic channel sampling strategy that exploits the temporal stability of channel importance distributions during fine-tuning.

2510.20985.tldr: The Transformer model based on bidirectional gated recurrent unit optimization successfully constructed in this study can efficiently and accurately complete GPU memory demand prediction tasks in deep learning tasks, and its prediction accuracy has been significantly improved compared to traditional machine learning methods.

2510.20994.tldr: This work introduces a novel formulation of self-supervised fine-tuning for vision foundation models, where the model is adapted to a new domain without requiring annotations, leveraging only short multi-view object-centric videos.

2510.21011.tldr: A large-scale audit of over 1.5 million occupational personas across 41 U.S. occupations generated by four large language models with different AI safety commitments and countries of origin finds two recurring patterns: systematic shifts and stereotype exaggeration.

2510.21023.tldr: A physics-consistent neural operator (PCNO) that enforces physical constraints by projecting surrogate model outputs onto function spaces satisfying predefined laws and a diffusion model-enhanced PCNO (DiffPCNO), which leverages a consistency model to quantify and mitigate uncertainties, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of forecasts.

2510.21024.tldr: JSTprove provides an end-to-end verifiable AI inference pipeline that hides cryptographic complexity behind a simple command-line interface while exposing auditable artifacts for reproducibility and serves both as a usable zkML product for current engineering needs and as a reproducible foundation for future research and production deployments of verifiable AI.

2510.21027.tldr: A practical framework that customizes open source large language models, including Llama, Qwen, Gemma, and MedGemma, to extract a unified set of MOUD prescription attributes from heterogeneous, site specific data and compute a standardized metric of medication coverage.

2510.21031.tldr: This paper presents AgentArcEval, a novel agent architecture evaluation method designed specially to address the complexities of FM-based agent architecture and its evaluation, and presents a catalogue of agent-specific general scenarios, which serves as a guide for generating concrete scenarios to design and evaluate the agent architecture.

2510.21043.tldr: A total evidence view of AI deference is developed, which offers a principled way to determine when AI deference is justified, particularly in high-stakes contexts requiring rigorous reliability.

2510.21049.tldr: The first systematic study of reasoning for classification tasks under strict low false positive rate (FPR) regimes is presented, position reasoning as a double-edged tool: beneficial for average accuracy, but often ill-suited for applications requiring strict precision.

2510.21068.tldr: This study makes an effort of bridging language gaps by incorporating Adaptive RAG system to Indonesian language by employing machine translation as data augmentation approach to overcome the limited availability of Indonesian language dataset.
