2510.21082.tldr: This paper demonstrates how Soppia (System for Ordered Proportional and Pondered Intelligent Assessment) operationalizes nuanced legal commands into a practical, replicable, and transparent methodology, enhancing consistency and predictability while providing a versatile and explainable tool adaptable across multi-criteria legal contexts.

2510.21088.tldr: Experiments on five standard FSMPP benchmarks demonstrate that the Motif Driven Global-Local Context Graph framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods and underscores the effectiveness of integrating global motif knowledge with fine-grained local context to advance robust few-shot molecular property prediction.

2510.21090.tldr: Self-Rewarding PPO is proposed, a novel fine-tuning method that leverages on-policy techniques to enhance generalization performance and addresses key limitations of SFT, improving generalization, data efficiency, and robustness.

2510.21093.tldr: This paper develops MedAlign, a novel framework to ensure visually accurate LVLM responses for Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA), and proposes a federated governance mechanism, where the selected expert, fine-tuned on clinical datasets based on mDPO, locally performs iterative Chain-of-Thought reasoning via the local meta-cognitive uncertainty estimator.

2510.21107.tldr: ESORT (Efficient Stein-variational and sliced Consistency-Optimized Representation for Temporal beliefs) is presented, a particle-based framework for capturing complex, multi-modal distributions in high-dimensional belief spaces that outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of belief approximation accuracy and downstream decision quality.

2510.21110.tldr: This paper proposes a novel deep reinforcement learning algorithm robust to confounding biases in observed data that consistently dominates the standard DQN in all games where the observed input to the behavioral and target policies mismatch and unobserved confounders exist.

2510.21121.tldr: GSL decomposes demonstrations into transferable and object-canonicalized skill primitives using foundation models, ensuring efficient low-level skill learning in the object frame and leading to substantial improvements in sample efficiency and generalization of the method.

2510.21127.tldr: An enhanced evolutionary multi-objective deep reinforcement learning algorithm is proposed, which integrates a long short-term memory (LSTM)-based policy network for temporal pattern recognition, a multilayer perceptron-based prospective increment model for future state prediction, and a time-varying Pareto policy evaluation method for dynamic preference adaptation.

2510.21131.tldr: This survey provides the first systematic review of LLM--TAG integration from an orchestration perspective, and introduces a novel taxonomy covering two fundamental directions: LLM for TAG, where LLMs enrich graph-based tasks, and TAG for LLM, where structured graphs improve LLM reasoning.

2510.21133.tldr: This first comprehensive evaluation of 10 leading commercial LLMs against both a novel 200-prompt CBRN dataset and a 180-prompt subset of the FORTRESS benchmark, using a rigorous three-tier attack methodology exposes critical safety vulnerabilities.

2510.21147.tldr: The core contribution is a hierarchical multi-agent design that links top-down macro screening with bottom-up fundamental analysis, offering a robust and extensible approach to factor-based portfolio construction.

2510.21148.tldr: This research proposes Evolutionary Graph Optimization for Prompting (EGO-Prompt), an automated framework to designing better prompts, efficient reasoning processes and providing enhanced causal-informed process that allows small models to reach the performence of larger models at under 20% of the original cost.

2510.21155.tldr: MU-SplitFed is proposed, a straggler-resilient SFL algorithm in zeroth-order optimization that decouples training progress from straggler delays via a simple yet effective unbalanced update mechanism.

2510.21175.tldr: Experiments show that the NuSA-CL framework not only effectively preserves zero-shot transfer capabilities but also achieves highly competitive performance on continual learning benchmarks, positioning NuSA-CL as a practical and scalable solution for continually evolving zero-shot VLMs in real-world applications.

2510.21181.tldr: This paper proposes Shylock, a novel method that can work well in both few-shot and normal MTS to find the causal relationship, and shows that Shylock outperforms two existing state-of-art methods on both few-shot and normal MTS.

2510.21184.tldr: RePULSe is introduced, a new training method that augments the standard RL loss with an additional loss that uses learned proposals to guide sampling low-reward outputs, and then reduces those outputs'probability.

2510.21188.tldr: PLAN is proposed, a framework that extends Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to enable efficient and interference-aware fine-tuning of large pre-trained models in CL settings and incorporates a novel selection mechanism that identifies and assigns basis vectors with minimal sensitivity to interference.

2510.21238.tldr: A physics-informed deep learning framework that incorporates the reflective-zone-based geometry model is proposed to learn the blockage, reflection, and scattering components, along with the beam pattern, which leverages physics prior knowledge to enhance network transferability.

2510.21254.tldr: This comprehensive review analyses OOD detection techniques within the context of safety assurance for autonomous systems, in particular in safety-critical domains and identifies a range of techniques which can be used throughout the ML development lifecycle.

2510.21270.tldr: Permuted Block-Sparse Attention is proposed, a plug-and-play method that leverages the permutation properties of attention to increase block-level sparsity and enhance the computational efficiency of LLM prefilling.

2510.21275.tldr: This paper evaluates various strategies for adaptively choosing the UCT exploration constant $\lambda$, called $\lambda$-strategies, that are agnostic to the game's reward scale and recommends using one of the newly suggested $\lambda$-strategies, which is to choose $\lambda$ as $2 \cdot \sigma$ where $\sigma$ is the empirical standard deviation of all state-action pairs'Q-values of the search tree.

2510.21276.tldr: A personalized context-aware tokenizer that incorporates a user's historical interactions when generating semantic IDs is proposed, allowing the same item to be tokenized into different semantic IDs under different user contexts, enabling GR models to capture multiple interpretive standards and produce more personalized predictions.

2510.21302.tldr: A neuro-symbolic embodied task planning framework that incorporates explicit symbolic verification and interactive validation processes during code generation that enhances the grounding of generated code, resulting in improved task reliability and success rates in complex environments is proposed.

2510.21314.tldr: This work introduces the first theoretical framework for analyzing the convergence of adaptive optimizers, including Adam and Muon, under floating-point quantization of gradients, weights, and optimizer states (e.g., moment estimates), and derives convergence rates on smooth non-convex objectives under standard stochastic gradient assumptions.

2510.21315.tldr: A computational model of the fly olfactory circuit is presented to investigate odor discrimination under varying noise conditions that simulate complex environments and demonstrates that seemingly redundant modules in biological circuits can, in fact, be essential for achieving optimal learning in complex contexts.

2510.21324.tldr: Experiments show that CXRAgent delivers strong performance, providing visual evidence and generalizes well to clinical tasks of different complexity, as well as enhancing model's capability through tool coordination, multi-step reasoning, and team collaboration.

2510.21329.tldr: TripTide is presented, the first benchmark evaluating LLM's ability to revise itineraries under realistic disruptions, and establishes a benchmark for evaluating adaptability, personalization, and resilience in LLM-based travel planning under real-world uncertainty.

2510.21333.tldr: To the best of the knowledge, this is the first model to incorporate causality through the attention mechanism in sequential recommendation, demonstrating the value of causality in generating more accurate and reliable recommendations.

2510.21342.tldr: This data paper provides filtered releases with adjustable thresholds that reduce storage needs and make the data practical to download and use across domains, and uses this filtered dataset to construct a graph-based representation of POIs enriched with attributes from both sources, enabling advanced spatial analyses and a range of downstream applications.

2510.21345.tldr: A new class of reparameterization methods for transfer learning, designed to enhance the generalization ability of fine-tuned models, is introduced.

2510.21346.tldr: The proposed CT-CLIP demonstrates strong capabilities in recognizing agricultural diseases, significantly enhances identification accuracy under complex environmental conditions, and provides an innovative and practical solution for automated disease recognition in agricultural applications.

2510.21356.tldr: A gaze-regularized framework that enhances VLMs for two key egocentric understanding tasks: fine-grained future event prediction and current activity understanding and introduces a gaze-regularized attention mechanism that aligns model focus with human visual gaze.

2510.21362.tldr: This work believes that its methodology can set a change of paradigm for nuclear medicine dosimetry allowing for 3D quantification using only planar scintigraphy without the need of expensive and time-consuming SPECT leveraging the pre-therapy information of the patients.

2510.21370.tldr: The design, implementation, and evaluation of the HIKMA framework, which includes AI dataset curation, AI-based manuscript generation, AI-assisted peer review, AI-driven revision, AI conference presentation, and AI archival dissemination, are presented.

2510.21388.tldr: This study explores knowledge distillation (KD) and pruning, to reduce the computational complexity of QCNNs while maintaining performance, and reveals that pruned QCNNs achieves similar or superior performance compared to KD while requiring less computational effort.

2510.21398.tldr: This work offers a framework integrating reinforcement learning (RL) to improve token efficiency and boost the performance of a 1.5B model for mathematical reasoning, revealing how RL can recover the losses due to long-context training and altogether improving performance in mathematical reasoning.

2510.21407.tldr: This work introduces a new RTL design approach by combining LLMs'generative capabilities with EC's broad search power, overcoming the local-search limitations of previous methods.

2510.21408.tldr: This work adapts a cognitive neuroscience associative learning paradigm and investigates how representations evolve across six models, finding that higher vocabulary interference amplifies differentiation, suggesting that representational change is influenced by both item similarity and global competition.

2510.21425.tldr: A novel taxonomy of symbolic integration in LLMs is proposed, along with a roadmap to merge symbolic techniques with LLMs, and a new categorisation framework across four dimensions is introduced by organising existing literature within these categories.

2510.21443.tldr: Evidence is contributed with evidence that SLMs are a valid alternative to LLMs for requirements classification, offering advantages in privacy, cost, and local deployability.

2510.21445.tldr: This paper proposes REMONI, an autonomous REmote health MONItoring system that integrates multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the Internet of Things (loT), and wearable devices, and demonstrates that the system is implementable and scalable for real-life scenarios, potentially reducing the workload of medical professionals and healthcare costs.

2510.21447.tldr: PhysWorld is proposed, a novel framework that utilizes a simulator to synthesize physically plausible and diverse demonstrations to learn efficient world models and achieves accurate and fast future predictions for various deformable objects, and also generalizes well to novel interactions.

2510.21453.tldr: A State-Decomposable MDP (SDMDP) is introduced that reformulates VRPs by expressing the state space as the Cartesian product of basis state spaces associated with basis VRP variants, which inherently yields the optimal basis policy for each basis VRP variant.

2510.21469.tldr: This paper shows how resilience is a fundamental characteristic of social robots, which, through it, ensure trust in the robot itself-an essential element especially when operating in contexts with elderly people, who often have low trust in these systems.

2510.21501.tldr: GranViT, a novel Vision Transformer that integrates fine-grained feature extraction with semantic alignment to Large Language Models (LLMs) via region level autoregressive training, achieves state-of-the-art results on fine-grained recognition, multimodal VQA, and OCR understanding.

2510.21524.tldr: The EU-Agent-Bench is introduced, a verifiable human-curated benchmark that evaluates an agent's alignment with EU legal norms in situations where benign user inputs could lead to unlawful actions.

2510.21535.tldr: The results of the six-stages evaluation show that the proposed trust measurement instrument is empirically reliable and valid for systematically measuring and comparing non-experts'trust in AI Medical Support Systems.

2510.21557.tldr: Co-Sight offers a scalable paradigm for reliable long-horizon reasoning in LLM-based agents through two complementary mechanisms: Conflict-Aware Meta-Verification (CAMV) and Trustworthy Reasoning with Structured Facts (TRSF).

2510.21560.tldr: This work uses ICL to train a constraint function that classifies the states of the system under consideration to safe, i.e., belong to a controlled forward invariant set that is disjoint from the unspecified failure set, and unsafe ones, i.e., belong to the complement of that set.

2510.21571.tldr: This paper presents a novel approach for pretraining robotic manipulation Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models using a large corpus of unscripted real-life video recordings of human hand activities, and designs a dexterous hand VLA model architecture and pretrain the model on this dataset.

2510.21583.tldr: Chunk-GRPO is proposed, the first chunk-level GRPO-based approach for T2I generation, to group consecutive steps into coherent'chunk's that capture the intrinsic temporal dynamics of flow matching, and to optimize policies at the chunk level.

2510.21610.tldr: Generative Correlation Manifolds (GCM) is introduced, a computationally efficient method for generating synthetic data that uses Cholesky decomposition of a target correlation matrix to produce datasets that preserve the entire correlation structure of the source dataset.

2510.21623.tldr: Information Flow Tracking (IF-Track) is introduced, that uses large language models (LLMs) as probabilistic encoder to quantify information entropy and gain at each reasoning step, and is the first successfully models the universal landscape of human reasoning behaviors within a single metric space.

2510.21631.tldr: This paper introduces a novel strategy called Counterfactual-explanation-infused Distillation CoD for few-shot task-aware knowledge distillation by systematically infusing counterfactual explanations to precisely map the teacher's decision boundary with significantly fewer samples.

2510.21638.tldr: The results indicate that diverse anomaly types often imprint on RL trajectories through a small set of low-order statistics, suggesting a compact foundation for OOD detection in complex environments.

2510.21649.tldr: A stage-aware distillation strategy that dynamically adjusts the weight of distillation loss based on the Gompertz curve, reflecting the student's learning progression: slow initial growth, rapid mid-phase improvement, and late-stage saturation.

2510.21652.tldr: AstaBench is presented, a suite that provides a holistic measure of agentic ability to perform scientific research, comprising 2400+ problems spanning the entire scientific discovery process and multiple scientific domains, and including many problems inspired by actual user requests to deployed Asta agents.

2510.21654.tldr: The method Group Inertial Poser estimates absolute distances between pairs of sensors from ultra-wideband ranging (UWB) and fuses them with inertial observations as input into structured state-space models to integrate temporal motion patterns for precise 3D pose estimation.

2510.21656.tldr: CMOMgen is presented, the first end-to-end CMOM strategy that generates complete and semantically sound mappings, without establishing any restrictions on the number of target ontologies or entities, without establishing any restrictions on the number of target ontologies or entities.

2510.21689.tldr: By pairing object detection with post-hoc explainability, this work can move beyond "black-box"predictions toward auditable, decision-supporting tools for conservation monitoring and translate these findings into actionable next steps for model development, including more targeted data curation and augmentation.

2510.21695.tldr: This work establishes the KG not merely as a data repository, but as a powerful, stateful orchestrator for creating adaptive and explainable autonomous systems.

2301.00922.tldr: A novel approximation strategy is proposed that"freezes"slow states during phases of lower-level planning and subsequently applies value iteration to an auxiliary upper-level MDP that evolves on a slower timescale, which leads to easier-to-solve lower-level problems.

2308.10133.tldr: This work proposes a superior FR model called TransFace, which contains a patch-level data augmentation strategy named Dominant Patch Amplitude Perturbation (DPAP) and a hard sample mining strategy named Entropy-guided Hard Sample Mining (EHSM), and investigates the intrinsic property of image bytes, to improve inference efficiency and user privacy protection.

2401.06915.tldr: A long-document financial QA task that extends the average context length from under 700 words in FinQA to 123k words in DocFinQA and finds that models particularly struggle on these documents.

2410.17266.tldr: This work proposes an algorithmic framework named Temporal Relational Reasoning (TRR), which seeks to emulate the spectrum of human cognitive capabilities used for complex problem-solving, which include brainstorming, memory, attention and reasoning, and is able to outperform state-of-the-art techniques on detecting stock portfolio crashes.

2412.11277.tldr: Macro2Micro is a deep learning framework that predicts brain microstructure from macrostructure using a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and explicitly encodes multiscale brain information into distinct processing branches, introducing the potential for real-time multimodal rendering in medical and research applications.

2412.15238.tldr: DIPPER is introduced, a novel, training-free framework that transforms a single LLM into an effective inference-time ensemble, by feeding the model an optimized and diverse set of prompts in parallel, leading to performance gains.

2501.09049.tldr: The proposed Dynamic-Aware INR (DA-INR) is an INR-based model for dynamic MRI reconstruction that captures the spatial and temporal continuity of dynamic MRI data in the image domain and explicitly incorporates the temporal redundancy of the data into the model structure.

2502.04465.tldr: FocalCodec is introduced, an efficient low-bitrate codec based on focal modulation that utilizes a single binary codebook to compress speech between 0.16 and 0.65 kbps, and delivers competitive performance in speech resynthesis and voice conversion at lower bitrates than the current state-of-the-art.

2502.04580.tldr: Through an information-theoretic analysis, it is shown that the diminishing efficiency is inherent to ICL, clarifying the trade-offs in adopting ICL as a universal problem solver and motivating a new generation of on-the-fly adaptive methods without the diminishing efficiency.

2502.11521.tldr: This paper introduces the first LLM-based approach, DeFiScope, for detecting DeFi price manipulation attacks in both standard and custom price models, and demonstrates its practicality by helping the industry partner confirm 147 real-world price manipulation attacks, including discovering 81 previously unknown historical incidents.

2502.13177.tldr: Experimental results show that the simple criterion of $\varepsilon$-DPO for KL penalty relaxation significantly improves DPO compared to most existing direct alignment algorithms on general chatbot benchmarks and reveal that this KL penalty control criterion can reflect confusion as a preference model and provide an efficient KL trade-off.

2503.09947.tldr: This work presents a multi-dimensional, quantitative evaluation of trustworthiness benchmarking three state-of-the-art deep learning architectures: recurrent (LSTM), operator-learning (DeepONet), and transformer-based (Informer), trained on 37 years of data from 482 U.S. basins to predict 20 water quality variables.

2503.10635.tldr: This work is the first to provide a tight analysis, which establishes a close connection between perturbation optimization and semantics, and significantly outperforming all prior state-of-the-art attack methods with lower $\ell_1/\ell_2$ perturbations.

2503.14350.tldr: This paper introduces VEGGIE, a Video Editor with Grounded Generation from Instructions, a simple end-to-end framework that unifies video concept editing, grounding, and reasoning based on diverse user instructions and shows strong performance in instructional video editing with different editing skills, outperforming the best instructional baseline as a versatile model, while other models struggle with multi-tasking.

2503.15386.tldr: An enhanced sampling strategy that refines the sampling distribution to avoid previously unsuccessful actions and leverage the concept of diffusion model decomposition to break down the primary problem into multiple smaller, more manageable sub-problems in learning, data collection, and inference, thereby enabling the system to adapt to variable failure counts.

2503.16024.tldr: Critique-Guided Improvement (CGI), a novel two-player framework, comprising an actor model that explores an environment and a critic model that generates detailed nature language feedback, is introduced, demonstrating the power of explicit iterative guidance to enhance decision-making in LLM-based agents.

2503.18971.tldr: This paper aims to provide a timely survey of the current research with an in-depth analysis, positioning LLMs as tools for formalizing and refining planning specifications to support reliable off-the-shelf AP planners.

2503.22674.tldr: QuestBench is presented, a set of underspecified reasoning tasks solvable by asking at most one question and shows that the ability to solve well-specified reasoning problems is not sufficient for success on the authors' benchmark: models struggle to identify the right question even when they can solve the fully specified version.

2504.07986.tldr: This work investigates the internal reasoning structures of LLMs and categorizes them into three primary thought types: execution, reflection, and transition thoughts, and introduces SEAL (Steerable reasoning calibration), a training-free approach that seamlessly calibrates the CoT process, improving accuracy while demonstrating significant efficiency gains.

2504.10637.tldr: This paper introduces a Rao--Blackwellized estimator that is unbiased and provably has variance less than or equal to that of the standard Monte Carlo estimator, and derives an analogous Rao--Blackwellized estimator of the gradient of the KL divergence, which leads to more stable training and produces models that more frequently appear on the Pareto frontier of reward vs. KL.

2504.18253.tldr: This letter proposes a reinforcement learning (RL) framework for ASV navigation under depth constraints, where the vehicle must reach a target while avoiding unsafe areas with only a single depth measurement per timestep from a downward-facing Single Beam Echosounder (SBES).

2504.19940.tldr: This paper investigates whether LLM-powered generative agents - autonomous entities that emulate human behavior and decision-making - can meaningfully contribute to fact-checking tasks traditionally reserved for human crowds, and demonstrates the potential of generative agents as scalable, consistent, and less biased contributors to crowd-based fact-checking systems.

2505.02347.tldr: This work shows an equivalence between a discrete time Markov Chain on a probability simplex and a global asymptotic stable (GAS) discrete time linear dynamical system, allowing it to be base on a GAS system only and provides various polynomial time algorithms and hardness results for different cases in this theoretical study.

2505.12805.tldr: A simple yet effective method that introduces a global reparameterization based on singular value decomposition (SVD) that consistently improves stability and performance across a variety of privacy settings and benchmarks, outperforming relevant baselines under both private and non-private regimes.

2505.13227.tldr: OSWorld-G, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 564 finely annotated samples across diverse task types including text matching, element recognition, layout understanding, and precise manipulation, is introduced and improved grounding with Jedi directly enhances agentic capabilities of general foundation models on complex computer tasks.

2505.13934.tldr: This paper presents RLVR-World, a unified framework that leverages reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to directly optimize world models for transition prediction metrics like accuracy or perceptual quality.

2505.16394.tldr: The proposed Raw2Drive is the only RL based end-to-end method on CARLA Leaderboard 2.0, Bench2Drive, and CARLA Leaderboard 2.0 and it achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2505.17873.tldr: This work frames experiment-guided ranking as a sequential decision-making problem and proposes an in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) framework, and decomposes hypotheses into functional elements, clusters them by mechanistic roles, and prioritizes recombinations based on feedback.

2505.19601.tldr: This paper investigates a generalized DPO loss that enables a policy model to match the target policy from a likelihood ratio estimation perspective, and proposes Bregman preference optimization (BPO), a generalized framework for ratio matching that provides a family of objective functions achieving target policy optimality.

2505.22491.tldr: Empirical evidence suggests that width-scaling considerations are surprisingly useful for predicting empirically maximal stable learning rate exponents which provide useful guidance on optimal learning rate exponents and clarifies the effectiveness and limitations of recently proposed layerwise learning rate scaling for standard initialization.

2505.23671.tldr: GSO, a benchmark for evaluating language models'capabilities in developing high-performance software, is introduced and key failure modes are identified, including difficulties with low-level languages, practicing lazy optimization strategies, and challenges in accurately localizing bottlenecks.

2506.00358.tldr: It is observed that state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised audio-visual models exhibit declining robustness as corruption severity increases, and a simple TTA approach enabling on-the-fly cross-modal fusion by penalizing high-entropy samples is proposed, which achieves improvements on VGGSOUND-2C.

2506.01281.tldr: It is shown that approximating an arbitrary distribution with bounded $f-divergence is $\mathsf{NP}$-hard for any model that can tractably compute marginals, and an exponential size gap for approximation between the class of decomposable PCs and that of decomposable and deterministic PCs is proved.

2506.01659.tldr: This paper provides a comprehensive theoretical foundation for engram research and proposes a roadmap for future inquiry into the mechanisms underlying memory, with implications for the diagnosis and treatment of memory-related disorders.

2506.04654.tldr: Analysis of injury incidents involving e-bikes and traditional bicycles using the CPSRMS and NEISS datasets reveals key differences in mechanical failure modes, injury severity patterns, and affected user groups.

2506.08010.tldr: The results suggest that test-time registers effectively take on the role of register tokens at test-time, offering a training-free solution for any pre-trained model released without them.

2506.09853.tldr: This work proposes a causal framework that characterizes CoT reasoning through the dual lenses of sufficiency and necessity, and provides a promising direction for improving LLM reasoning performance and cost-effectiveness.

2506.17113.tldr: MEXA is introduced, a training-free framework that performs modality- and task-aware aggregation of multiple expert models to enable effective multimodal reasoning across diverse and distinct domains and consistently delivers performance improvements over strong multimodal baselines.

2506.17124.tldr: It is shown formally that thought actions are equivalent to the agent choosing to perform a step of policy improvement before continuing to act and that open-source LLMs satisfy the conditions that the theory predicts are necessary for model-free RL to produce thinking-like behavior.

2507.03069.tldr: Adaptive Reward-Following (ARF) is introduced, which converts natural feedback into continuous preference trajectories and optimizes them using the novel TraceBias algorithm, demonstrating that continuous reward modeling provides a scalable path toward personalized and theoretically grounded RLHF.

2507.08441.tldr: The proposed image tokenizer, VFMTok, achieves substantial improvements in image reconstruction and generation quality, while also enhancing token efficiency and enabling high-fidelity class-conditional synthesis without the need for classifier-free guidance (CFG).

2507.11178.tldr: Gradient Regularization-based Neural Granger Causality (GRNGC) is proposed, which requires only one time series prediction model and applies regularization to the gradient between model's input and output to infer Granger causality.

2507.22828.tldr: The results demonstrate that CapRecover can accurately recover both image labels and captions without reconstructing a single pixel, and a straightforward and effective protection approach that adds random noise to the intermediate image features at each middle layer and subsequently removes the noise in the following layer is proposed.

2507.22935.tldr: This work discusses Knowledge Graph construction and breaks down the Knowledge Extraction process into its Named Entity Recognition, Coreference Resolution, Named Entity Linking, and Relation Extraction functional components, and evaluates sixteen NLP tools in concert with or in comparison to the rapidly advancing capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs).

2508.00830.tldr: BikeBench is an engineering design benchmark for evaluating generative models on problems with multiple real-world objectives and constraints and indicates that LLMs and tabular generative models fall short of hybrid GenAI+optimization algorithms in design quality, constraint satisfaction, and similarity scores, suggesting significant room for improvement.

2508.03543.tldr: EmoSteer-TTS enables fine-grained, interpretable, and continuous control over speech emotion, outperforming the state-of-the-art (SOTA) and is the first method that achieves training-free and continuous fine-grained emotion control in TTS.

2509.05818.tldr: This work presents NoteAid-Chatbot, a conversational AI that promotes patient understanding via a novel 'learning as conversation' framework, built on a multi-agent large language model (LLM) and reinforcement learning (RL) setup without human-labeled data.

2509.19271.tldr: This paper introduces the Wolof Banking Speech Intent Classification Dataset (WolBanking77), for academic research in intent classification, and presents an in-depth examination of the dataset's contents.

2509.23659.tldr: This work proposes a practical, batch-wise alignment strategy for fine-tuning LLMs, leveraging semantically equivalent multilingual data in each training batch to directly align model outputs across languages, enabling more robust and equitable multilingual AI solutions in industry.

2510.01704.tldr: InstaFormer, a network capable of holistic order prediction, is proposed, solely given an input RGB image, which returns the full occlusion and depth orderings for all the instances in the scene in a single forward pass.

2510.03548.tldr: This work introduces the first biometric leakage defense without ever looking at the reconstructed RGB video: a pose-conditioned, large-margin contrastive encoder that isolates persistent identity cues inside the transmitted latent while cancelling transient pose and expression.

2510.10281.tldr: ArtPerception is introduced, a novel black-box jailbreak framework that strategically leverages ASCII art to bypass the security measures of state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs and proposes a Modified Levenshtein Distance (MLD) metric for a more nuanced evaluation of an LLM's recognition capability.

2510.10644.tldr: This work proposes a novel hybrid framework that integrates large language model (LLM) with mathematical optimization in a dynamic hierarchical system, and leverages LLM to bridge cognitive limitations caused by problem decomposition by adaptively generating high-level objectives.

2510.12712.tldr: This work introduces the first benchmark centered on think with images, a visual tool-use reasoning benchmark that rigorously evaluates MLLMs'ability to perceive, transform, and reason across complex visual-textual tasks under the think-with-images paradigm.

2510.12822.tldr: A predictive policing algorithm, which relies on historical crime data, is contrasted with a camera-based system that records ongoing offenses, where both are designed to guide police deployment.

2510.16193.tldr: This work develops a formal model that captures epistemic states of corporations deploying sophisticated AI or information systems, introducing a continuous organisational knowledge metric $S_S(\varphi)$ which integrates a pipeline's computational cost and its statistically validated error rate.

2510.19099.tldr: The findings challenge the notion of a universal curriculum strategy and offer actionable guidance across model and task regimes, with some metrics indicating that prioritizing decision-uncertain samples can further enhance learning outcomes.

2510.19495.tldr: This approach shows that broadening the support of the policy distribution can allow imitation algorithms augmented by offline RL to solve tasks robustly, showing considerably enhanced recovery and generalization behavior.

2510.20084.tldr: ShapeX is presented, an innovative framework that segments time series into meaningful shapelet-driven segments and employs Shapley values to assess their saliency, which effectively learns a diverse set of shapelets essential for classification.

2510.20299.tldr: A double-backbone network integrating VGG16 and Xception with a Frequency-Gated Attention (FGA) Block to capture complementary local and global features is proposed, achieving highly competitive performance without augmentation which demonstrates robustness to variably sized and distributed datasets.

2510.20610.tldr: This paper investigated the effectiveness of three pre-trained transformer models: AraELECTRA, CAMeLBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa, and revealed a surprising result: the multilingual XLM-RoBERTa model achieved the highest performance with an F1 score of 0.7701, outperforming the specialized Arabic models.

2510.21735.tldr: This study develops and validates a Phase-Aware AI (PAAI) car-following model specifically for EVs that enhances traditional physics-based frameworks with an AI component that recognizes and adapts to different driving phases, such as rapid acceleration and regenerative braking.

2510.21736.tldr: A neural network-based, socially compliant AV control framework that incorporates social value orientation (SVO) is proposed that enables AVs to account for their influence on HVs and traffic dynamics, and promotes adaptive driving behaviors that reduce congestion, improve traffic efficiency, and lower energy consumption.

2510.21739.tldr: A comprehensive demonstration and automation roadmap for integrating LLMs into multi-scale UAV operations and establishes a five-level automation taxonomy that charts the evolution from current LLM-as-Parser capabilities (Level 1) to fully autonomous LLM-as-Autopilot systems (Level 5), identifying technical prerequisites and research challenges at each stage.

2510.21740.tldr: FUGU, a suite of data visualization understanding tasks, is developed to precisely characterize potential sources of difficulty and found that while providing correct coordinates helps with tasks involving one or a small number of data points, it generally worsens performance for tasks that require extracting statistical relationships across many data points.

2510.21761.tldr: J-ORA is introduced, a novel multimodal dataset that bridges the gap in robot perception by providing detailed object attribute annotations within Japanese human-robot dialogue scenarios, and it is found that there still exists a gap between proprietary and open-source VLMs.

2510.21763.tldr: This work introduces and evaluates two ControlNets specialized for artistic control: a proportion ControlNet that uses bounding boxes to dictate the position and scale of objects, and a perspective ControlNet that employs vanishing lines to control the 3D geometry of the scene.

2510.21774.tldr: The OCR-Quality dataset is presented, a comprehensive human-annotated dataset designed for evaluating and developing OCR quality assessment methods and provides a valuable benchmark for training and evaluating OCR verification systems.

2510.21780.tldr: The concave points feature of the cell nuclei is found to be the most influential feature positively impacting the classification task, and can be very helpful in improving the diagnosis and treatment of breast cancer by highlighting the key characteristics of breast tumor.

2510.21781.tldr: This work introduces EdgeSync, an efficient edge-model updating approach that enhances sample filtering by incorporating timeliness and inference results, thus ensuring training samples are more relevant to the current video content while reducing update delays.

2510.21783.tldr: This work proposes a membership inference method based on noise aggregation analysis, and introduces a single-step, low-intensity noise injection diffusion strategy to amplify differences between member and non-member samples.

2510.21786.tldr: This work introduces AVEP (Action-centric Video Event Prediction), a task that distinguishes itself from existing video prediction tasks through its incorporation of more complex logic and richer semantic information, and proposes EventFormer, a node-graph hierarchical attention based video event prediction model, which can capture both the relationships between events and their arguments and the coreferencial relationships between arguments.

2510.21792.tldr: A novel technique for statistically measuring the prediction error is introduced and the Variance-Reduction Guidance (VRG) method is proposed, which can significantly improve the generation quality of diffusion models.

2510.21793.tldr: A novel unsupervised framework, Multi-Modal Attention-Driven Fusion Restoration (MAFR), which synthesises a unified latent space from RGB images and point clouds using a shared fusion encoder, followed by attention-guided, modality-specific decoders, advancing the robustness and accuracy of industrial anomaly detection.

2510.21794.tldr: TINA (Token-level Inference-Time Alignment), a lightweight framework that freezes the base VLM and instead trains a reward model to approximate its distribution, providing token-level corrective signals without retraining the backbone.

2510.21795.tldr: This work introduces Xihe, a scalable TSFM family spanning from an ultra-efficient 9.5M parameter configuration to high-capacity 1.5B variant, and introduces HIBA, a hierarchical inter- and intra-block sparse attention architecture which employs hierarchical inter- and intra-block sparse attention to effectively capture multi-scale dependencies.

2510.21796.tldr: A novel deep learning framework, the Physics-guided Cascaded Corrector for MJO (PCC-MJO), which acts as a universal post-processor to correct MJO forecasts from dynamical models, and effectively mitigates the "Maritime Continent barrier", enabling more realistic eastward propagation and amplitude.

2510.21805.tldr: DiffGRM is proposed, a diffusion-based GR model that replaces the autoregressive decoder with a masked discrete diffusion model (MDM), thereby enabling bidirectional context and any-order parallel generation of SID digits for recommendation.

2510.21806.tldr: FDA-CLIP (Frame Difference Alpha-CLIP), which is a concise CLIP-based training framework for text-video alignment that uses frame differences to generate dynamic region masks, which are input into Alpha-CLIP as an additional Alpha channel.

2510.21807.tldr: A novel fine tuning task is introduced, Masked Prediction via Context and Commonsense, which forces models to integrate visual context and commonsense reasoning by reconstructing semantically meaningful content from occluded images, thereby laying the foundation for generalized reasoning.

2510.21808.tldr: A Semantic Relation-Enhanced CLIP (SRE-CLIP) Adapter framework, integrating a Semantic Relation Structure Loss and a Cross-Modal Alignment Retention Strategy is proposed, which achieves state-of-the-art performance on the I2AwA and I2WebV benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing approaches.

2510.21810.tldr: This paper introduces a hybrid diagnostic framework combining traditional feature extraction and deep learning (DL) to enhance DR detection, which enables scalable, accurate DR screening, crucial for diabetes-burdened regions.

2510.21811.tldr: YOLOv11's outstanding performance in accuracy and speed solidifies its position as the most effective model for surface defect detection on the NEU dataset, surpassing competing algorithms by a substantial margin.

2510.21813.tldr: This work exemplifies a data-centric modelling paradigm in which capability arises from the diversity and structure of the training data rather than from architectural complexity, and provides a lightweight, practical route to multi-modal, multi-task EO modelling, and a conceptual bridge toward future generative EO foundation models.

2510.21815.tldr: A deep learning-based multi-exposure fusion approach for HDR image generation that takes a set of differently exposed Low Dynamic Range images, typically an underexposed and an overexposed image, and learns to fuse their complementary information using a convolutional neural network.

2510.21820.tldr: The Hierarchical Attention-based Interpretable Network (HAIN), a novel architecture that unifies multi-level attention mechanisms, dimensionality reduction, and explanation-driven loss functions to deliver interpretable and robust analysis of complex biomedical data, is introduced.

2510.21821.tldr: While correctly rendered in most cases, DALL-E3 deviated from prompt specifications in 15.6% of all attributes (n=710).

2510.21822.tldr: This research presents a wavelet-based detection method that uses discrete wavelet transform (DWT) preprocessing and a ResNet50 classification layer to differentiate the StyleGAN-generated images from real ones, indicating that the GAN-generated images have unique wavelet-domain artifacts or "fingerprints."

2510.21823.tldr: An explainable deep learning framework for detecting brain tumors in MRI scans and pneumonia in chest X-ray images using two leading Convolutional Neural Networks, ResNet50 and DenseNet121 is presented.

2510.21827.tldr: This paper improves the classification Precision of chromosomes using proposed reliability thresholding metrics and deliberately engineered features and verifies suitability of the proposed metrics and pruning method for Karyotyping facilities in poor countries and lowbudget pathological laboratories.

2510.21835.tldr: An end to end, multi task system that generates factually grounded textual listings from a single image, and introduces a hierarchical generation process where the model's own predicted attributes are embedded in a prompt and fed to the text decoder to improve factual consistency.

2510.21839.tldr: It is highlighted that while ChatGPT exhibits emerging potential for medical image interpretation, its diagnostic reliability remains limited and Continued advances in visual reasoning and domain-specific adaptation are required before such models can be safely applied in clinical practice.

2510.21846.tldr: GP-MIA is proposed, an efficient and interpretable approach based on Gaussian process (GP) meta-modeling that achieves high accuracy and generalizability, offering a practical alternative to existing MIAs.

2510.21857.tldr: The perturbation kernel was leveraged to remove the pretrained PFGM++, and the sinusoidal discretization schedule and Beta noise distribution were introduced in order to facilitate adaptability and improve sample quality.

2510.21858.tldr: A privacy-preserving DFL framework tailored for MES that introduces information masking to safeguard private data while enabling recovery of decision variables and gradients required for model training and developed a privacy-preserving load pattern recognition algorithm.

2510.21860.tldr: Although LLMs have repeatedly surpassed humans in evaluations requiring analytical intelligence, it is found humans still outperform LLMs on Butter- Bench, while the mean human score is 95%.

2510.21866.tldr: These findings quantify capability-specific scaling failures in decoder-only autoregressive language models to inform resource allocation decisions and reveal high sensitivity to perturbation: swapping attention patterns between models causes catastrophic performance collapse rather than graceful degradation.

2510.21867.tldr: WM-MoE is presented, the first world model-based motion forecasting framework that unifies perception, temporal memory, and decision making to address the challenges of high-risk corner-case scenarios and indicates the promise of world model-based architectures for robust and generalizable motion forecasting in fully AVs.

2510.21872.tldr: GuitarFlow is introduced, a model designed specifically for electric guitar synthesis that is quick to train and to perform inference, requiring less than 6 hours of training data and shows significant improvement in the realism of the generated guitar audio from tablatures.

2510.21874.tldr: A physics-informed neural network framework that embeds UAV dynamics, wind disturbances, and obstacle avoidance directly into the learning process, providing a scalable and physically consistent framework for UAV trajectory optimization.

2510.21876.tldr: The proposed methodology utilizes object-based image analysis, based on deep learning algorithms to accurately identify and segment green canopies from high-resolution drone images, providing valuable insights for urban forestry management of an industrial township.

2510.21879.tldr: The TernaryCLIP is proposed, a lightweight computational framework that converts connection weights of both vision and text encoders of CLIP into the ternary format, instead of full-precision or floating ones, allowing effective and efficient deployment on resource-constrained devices.

2510.21881.tldr: The GeoThoughts dataset is developed, a comprehensive geometric reasoning corpus with two subsets: Geo-Thought-6K with 6,243 samples and its augmented version Geo-Thought-Augmented-10K containing 10,834 samples, which develops GeoThought-MLLM, a mathematical reasoning multimodal model that generates detailed thinking processes during problem-solving.

2510.21883.tldr: This paper revisit LLM generation through the lens of recommender systems, conceptualizing the decoding process as analogous to the ranking stage in recommendation pipelines, and proposes Language Ranker, a novel framework that introduces a lightweight module to rerank candidate responses using features extracted by the base model.

2510.21885.tldr: A behavior-aware sampling framework is proposed that selects safety examples based on two complementary factors: instruction-response behavior (e.g., refusal versus compliance) and semantic diversity across harm categories and substantially reduces harmful outputs while maintaining helpfulness.

2510.21887.tldr: A comprehensive taxonomy is introduced that organizes the literature and provides a cohesive framework for understanding the development of GANs, VAEs, and DMs, including their many variants and combined approaches, and highlights key innovations that have improved the quality, diversity, and controllability of generated outputs.

2510.21891.tldr: This work introduces semantic isotropy -- the degree of uniformity across normalized text embeddings on the unit sphere -- and uses it to assess the trustworthiness of long-form responses generated by LLMs, offering a practical, low-cost approach for integrating trust assessment into real-world LLM workflows.

2510.21894.tldr: The proposed NetMind, a novel framework for querying networks using natural language, introduces a tree-based configuration chunking strategy to preserve semantic coherence while enabling efficient partitioning and designs a hybrid imperative-declarative language to reduce the reasoning burden on LLMs and enhance precision.

2510.21900.tldr: Experiments show that Yours, a framework based on recurrent outline generation, substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in content coverage, structural coherence, and citation quality, while producing more accessible and better-organized surveys.

2510.21902.tldr: The first extended evaluation of SWE-Agents on controller generation for embodied tasks is presented, adapting Mini-SWE-Agent (MSWEA) to solve 20 diverse embodied tasks from the Minigrid environment.

2510.21906.tldr: This study utilizes multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as evolutionary operators to facilitate structure-aware optimization over graph data and proposes a cooperative evolutionary optimization framework that facilitates cross-domain knowledge transfer and unifies multiple sparsified variants of diverse structures.

2510.21933.tldr: An empirical analysis comparing responses from human developers, a standard GPT model, and a GPT model enhanced with RAG, using real queries from Mozilla's developer chat rooms shows the potential to apply RAG-based tools to Open Source Software to minimize the load to core maintainers without losing answer quality.

2510.21957.tldr: This paper designs a contrastive learning framework that incorporates hardware performance counters (HPC) to analyze the runtime behavior of target ransomware, and introduces a customized loss function that encourages early-stage detection of malicious activity, and significantly reduces the detection latency.

2510.21966.tldr: Overall, ArchISMiner can help architects and developers identify ARPs and extract succinct, relevant, and useful architectural knowledge from developer communities more accurately and efficiently.

2510.21970.tldr: It is concluded that small, properly optimized open-weight models are not just a viable but a more suitable alternative for domain-specific applications, offering state-of-the-art accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost.

2510.21977.tldr: Distribution Shift Alignment (DSA), a two-stage fine-tuning method that aligns both the output distributions and the distribution shifts across different backgrounds, is introduced, demonstrating its effectiveness and efficiency in survey simulation.

2510.21978.tldr: This work proposes RECAP-a replay strategy with dynamic objective reweighting for general knowledge preservation, which not only preserves general capabilities but also improves reasoning by enabling more flexible trade-offs among in-task rewards.

2510.21983.tldr: This work hypothesizes that LLMs, having been trained on large-scale human-generated text, may respond more compliantly to prompts with persuasive structures, and investigates whether LLMs themselves exhibit distinct persuasive fingerprints that emerge in their jailbreak responses.

2510.21991.tldr: This work shows that by tailoring the denoising process to the specific characteristics of embodied AI tasks -- particularly structured, low-dimensional nature of action distributions -- diffusion policies can operate effectively with as few as 5 neural function evaluations (NFE).

2510.21995.tldr: It is empirically demonstrated that Monte Carlo (MC) methods can also achieve experience stitching, and it is found that increasing critic capacity effectively reduces the generalization gap for both the MC and TD methods.

2510.21998.tldr: The notion of causal interpretability is introduced, which formalizes when counterfactual queries can be evaluated from a specific class of models and observational data and leads to a fundamental tradeoff between causal interpretability and predictive accuracy.

2510.21999.tldr: This survey first comprehensively analyzes the influential MWP research of the past decade from the perspective of human reasoning cognition and provides an integrative overall comparison across existing approaches.

2510.22003.tldr: A systematic literature review of GenAI use cases and risks in agile architecting, implications for capability building and governance, and an initial research agenda on human-AI collaboration in architecture inform responsible adoption of GenAI that accelerates digital transformation while safeguarding architectural integrity.

2510.22011.tldr: This study proposes an automatic sign language recognition system based on a hybrid CNN-LSTM architecture, using Mediapipe for gesture keypoint extraction, developed with Python, TensorFlow and Streamlit, which provides real-time gesture translation.

2510.22014.tldr: Three statistical properties are identified that strongly correlate with transfer success across numerous experimental settings and lead to a more fine-grained understanding of transferability, which is used in interventional experiments to showcase how the statistical analysis can translate into practical improvements in attack success.

2510.22027.tldr: A novel OSRL approach is proposed that frames the problem as a minimax objective and solves it by combining offline RL with online optimization algorithms, and it is proved the approximate optimality of this approach when integrated with an approximate offline RL oracle and no-regret online optimization.

2510.22034.tldr: This paper introduces LLM-AR, a pipeline inspired by neural-symbolic systems that distils LLM-generated heuristics into probabilistic rules executed by the ProbLog automated-reasoning engine, and introduces an iterative policy-evolution loop incorporates association-rule mining to progressively refine the prediction rules.

2510.22039.tldr: The role of predictive learning as a guiding principle for effective representation learning in agents navigating partial observability is suggested, and it is demonstrated that better representation learning leads to improved generalization.

2510.22045.tldr: VLM-SlideEval is introduced, an evaluation framework that probes VLMs along three axes: element-level extraction from slide images aligned to ground truth; robustness to controlled perturbations in geometry, style, and text; and higher-level comprehension, such as recovering a deck's narrative order from shuffled slides.

2510.22046.tldr: A case study applying the SpecC methodology within a system-level hardware/software co-design flow to a PCM-to-PWM converter, the core of a Class-D audio amplifier, underline the value of system-level co-design for early architectural insight, rapid validation, and actionable cost/performance trade-offs.

2510.22050.tldr: This paper offers a formal language for causal reasoning in systems that aspire to understand, not merely to predict, and instantiates structural-causal principles LAP and ICM in the ESCM context, and argues that empirical risk minimization systematically produces fractured, entangled representations.

2510.22052.tldr: The next level of AI evolution is needed in which lightweight domain-specific multimodal models with higher levels of intelligence can reason, plan, and make decisions in dynamic environments with real-time data and prior knowledge, while learning continuously and evolving in ways that enhance future decision-making capability

2510.22056.tldr: A robust deep learning framework that integrates human-centric preprocessing with spatio-temporal modeling for multi-class anomaly classification and confirms that foreground-focused preprocessing significantly enhances anomaly discrimination in real-world surveillance scenarios.

2510.22057.tldr: A novel training method is proposed which can discourage a model from leveraging sensitive features like gender for its predictions and offers benefits not only in the enforcement of ethical standards, but also to enhance interpretability of the model predictions.

2510.22075.tldr: Both SFT and RL models failed to generalize across environments, highlighting the importance of matching train-test environments for building reliable real-world code-fixing agents.

2510.22085.tldr: Jailbreak Mimicry, a systematic methodology for training compact attacker models to automatically generate narrative-based jailbreak prompts in a one-shot manner, is introduced, enabling proactive vulnerability assessment in AI-driven security systems.

2510.22087.tldr: Evaluation of QuArch reveals that while frontier models possess domain-specific knowledge, they struggle with skills that require higher-order thinking in computer architecture, highlighting persistent gaps in architectural reasoning across analysis, design, and implementation QAs.

2510.22095.tldr: This position paper argues that the field is poised for a paradigm extension from BCI to Brain-Agent Collaboration (BAC), and emphasizes reframing agents as active and collaborative partners for intelligent assistance rather than passive brain signal data processors, demanding a focus on ethical data handling, model reliability, and a robust human-agent collaboration framework.

2510.22102.tldr: Analysis of how MLLMs behave when visual positional encodings are deliberately perturbed through shuffling reveals that such perturbations induce predictable, non-random coordinate biases rather than random errors, suggesting that models rely on internal positional priors when spatial grounding signals are degraded.

2510.22108.tldr: A heterogeneous multi-agent collaborative dynamic (HMCD) optimization framework, which has two core components that incorporates an improved multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADRL) control method, which incorporates a self-attention evaluation mechanism to capture interactions between UAVs and an adaptive velocity transition mechanism to enhance training stability.

2510.22109.tldr: This work applies a scale-invariant logarithmic compression to the input tokens, and modifies the input representation itself, rather than the transformer architecture, showing that input-level logarithmic compression is a simple and effective way to extend a transformer's long-range memory.

2510.22117.tldr: A heterogeneous multi-agent control approach (HMCA) that integrates a dedicated IRS control policy with a multi-agent soft actor-critic framework for UAV control, which enables coordinated operation across heterogeneous network elements is proposed.

2510.22131.tldr: This work represents a first systematic attempt to interpret black-box NCO models by investigating their representations through various probing tasks, showcasing probing as a promising tool for analyzing their internal mechanisms and revealing insights for the NCO community.

2510.22132.tldr: This work introduces learnable thought vectors that dynamically modulate the internal reasoning process of large language models that leverages self-optimizing thought vectors with entropy minimization, and reveals distinct thought vector clusters and consistent low-entropy distributions across control conditions.

2510.22158.tldr: This paper introduces a novel deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithm specifically designed for non-stationary continuous MFGs, and learns a representation of the time-dependent population distribution using a Conditional Normalizing Flow.

2510.22170.tldr: A framework that uses situational judgment tests from realistic scenarios to probe domain-specific competencies and integrates industrial-organizational and personality psychology to design sophisticated personas which include behavioral and psychological descriptors, life history, and social and emotional functions is proposed.

2510.22178.tldr: A NeuroAI approach and inspiration from neural Reinforcement Learning are drawn to develop a derivative-free optimizer for training neural networks, Dopamine, which finds robust solutions and comparable performance to the state-of-the-art Machine Learning optimizers but is also neurobiologically more plausible.

2510.22192.tldr: OptiTree is introduced, a novel tree search approach designed to enhance modeling capabilities for complex problems through adaptive problem decomposition into simpler subproblems, achieving over 10\% improvements on the challenging benchmarks.

2510.22196.tldr: The goal is to strip away complicated engineering tricks and propose a simple, non-parametric generative model that produces high-fidelity samples on MNIST and visually compelling CIFAR-10 images.

2510.22197.tldr: A cross-dataset covariance alignment loss is introduced to align second-order statistical properties across datasets, enabling robust generalization without the need for extensive labels or per-subject calibration in task-specific pre-training.

2510.22206.tldr: A reinforcement learning framework for discovering optimal execution strategies, evaluated within a reactive agent-based market simulator and shows that the RL-derived strategies consistently outperform baselines and operate near the efficient frontier, demonstrating a strong ability to optimise for risk and impact.

2510.22210.tldr: LSPRAG is presented, a framework for concise-context retrieval tailored for real-time, language-agnostic unit test generation that leverages off-the-shelf Language Server Protocol back-ends to supply LLMs with precise symbol definitions and references in real time.

2510.22214.tldr: This paper proposes a simple yet effective GALA strategy (GALA), which combines a global k-means clustering step for target-domain samples with a cluster-wise local selection criterion, effectively tackling the above two issues in a complementary manner.

2510.22219.tldr: The model outperforms the biased Bradley-Terry model and the commutativity score in indicating LLMs'error at this task and obtains consistent estimates of LLMs'error.

2510.22224.tldr: The Formal Assurance and Monitoring Environment (FAME) is introduced, a novel framework that synergizes the mathematical rigor of offline formal synthesis with the vigilance of online runtime monitoring to create a verifiable safety net around opaque AI components.

2510.22228.tldr: It is demonstrated that pruning even one or two layers can severely impair test-time scaling, with performance collapsing drastically on long reasoning benchmarks even when performance on knowledge-intensive and shallow reasoning tasks remains stable.

2510.22242.tldr: This work introduces PaperAsk, a benchmark that systematically evaluates LLMs across four key research tasks: citation retrieval, content extraction, paper discovery, and claim verification, and develops lightweight reliability classifiers trained on PaperAsk data to identify unreliable outputs.

2510.22243.tldr: The results demonstrate the potential of CGRA4ML, with its flexibility in mapping modern layers and off-chip memory utilization for skip connections, provides a path for implementing advanced semantic segmentation networks on FPGA for real-time applications to outperform traditional GPU solutions in terms of power efficiency while maintaining competitive accuracy.

2510.22251.tldr: Sculpting is introduced, a constrained, rule-based prompting method designed to improve upon standard CoT by reducing errors from semantic ambiguity and flawed common sense, suggesting simpler prompts for more capable models.

2510.22255.tldr: PACR encodes the inductive bias that, along a well-formed reasoning trajectory, the probability of the ground-truth answer should have a generally ascending trend, and the results suggest that dense, model-intrinsic shaping signals can make RLVR training more effective and reliable.

2510.22257.tldr: LUNA (Latent Unified Network Architecture), a self-supervised foundation model that reconciles disparate electrode geometries while scaling linearly -- not quadratically -- with channel count, is introduced.

2510.22264.tldr: This work introduces PatenTEB, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 15 tasks across retrieval, classification, paraphrase, and clustering, with 2.06 million examples, and develops the patembed model family through multi-task training, revealing that multi-task training improves external generalization despite minor benchmark costs, and that domain-pretrained initialization provides consistent advantages across task families.

2510.22282.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that CityRiSE with emergent reasoning process significantly outperforms existing baselines, improving both prediction accuracy and generalization across diverse urban contexts, particularly for prediction on unseen cities and unseen indicators.

2510.22285.tldr: It is found that the LLM achieve higher accuracy on simplified tasks, restricting classification to two labels, and among LLM settings, simple ICL outperforms a longer, instruction-heavy prompt, and SFT achieves the strongest overall performance.

2510.22289.tldr: A homophily predictor is developed to discriminate test edges, facilitating adaptive test-time graph structural transformation by the confidence of predicted homophily scores, which can significantly improve the robustness and performance of pre-trained GNNs on node classifications, without requiring model training or update.

2510.22301.tldr: This study provides an efficient artificial-intelligence driven solution and establishes the feasibility scope for real-time, non-invasive estimation of laboratory values.

2510.22312.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs can generate novel battery materials by retrieving cross-domain analogs and analogy-guided exemplars to steer exploration beyond conventional dopant substitutions, and constructing in-domain analogical templates from few labeled examples to guide targeted exploitation.

2510.22318.tldr: This paper explores and evaluates how LLMs can complement the ISTQB framework for higher education and highlights the promise of LLMs in supporting ISTQB certification preparation and offer a foundation for their broader use in software engineering at higher education.

2510.22329.tldr: This paper introduces a multilevel graph coarsening and refinement strategy that aggregates customers into meta-nodes based on a spatio-temporal distance metric and demonstrates that this method significantly reduces computation time while preserving solution quality for classical heuristics.

2510.22333.tldr: An interpretable prediction framework with literature-informed fine-tuned (LIFT) LLMs for truck driving risk prediction and the contribution of the literature knowledge base and the fine-tuning process in the interpretability of the LIFT LLM is demonstrated.

2510.22334.tldr: This work introduces the first multilingual TSE benchmark, spanning Catalan, Estonian, French, Italian, Mandarin, and Spanish corpora, and manages to extend the original TSE pipeline to a multilingual setting without requiring separate models for each language.

2510.22335.tldr: MindHier is proposed, a coarse-to-fine fMRI-to-image reconstruction framework built on scale-wise autoregressive modeling that achieves superior semantic fidelity, 4.67x faster inference, and more deterministic results than the diffusion-based baselines.

2510.22344.tldr: FAIR-RAG is introduced, a novel agentic framework that transforms the standard RAG pipeline into a dynamic, evidence-driven reasoning process and significantly outperforms strong baselines on challenging multi-hop QA benchmarks.

2510.22366.tldr: T2SMark is a two-stage watermarking scheme based on Tail-Truncated Sampling (TTS), which enhances robustness by embedding bits exclusively in the reliable tail regions while randomly sampling the central zone to preserve the latent distribution.

2510.22371.tldr: A new dataset, the Deep Reasoning Dataset (DeepRD), is developed, along with a generative process for producing unlimited examples of scalable complexity, to evaluate model performance on graph connectivity and natural language proof planning and find that the performance of LRMs drop abruptly at sufficient complexity and do not generalize.

2510.22380.tldr: A Recurrent Correlation-based framework that dynamically relocates the matching region toward more promising positions, and exhibits a strong accuracy-computation trade-off, surpassing or matching the state-of-the-art performance on the non-affine OASIS dataset.

2510.22383.tldr: This paper introduces dynamic unit deactivation during training by representing neural network units as cells in a GoL grid and applying the game's rules to deactivate units, allowing for the emergence of spatial patterns that adapt to the training data, potentially enhancing the network's ability to generalize.

2304.03720.tldr: A novel representer theorem is obtained for the simultaneous task of metric and preference learning and it is shown that the representer theorem for this task can be derived by regularizing the problem with respect to the norm inherent in the task structure.

2305.05239.tldr: A general framework called Learnable Behavioral Control (LBC) is proposed to address the limitation and enables a significantly enlarged behavior selection space via formulating a hybrid behavior mapping from all policies; and constructs a unified learnable process for behavior selection.

2306.11593.tldr: A novel approach to generate richer and more informative image captions by combining the captions generated from different SoTA captioning models, which requires no additional model training and enables the generation of more suitable captions for the training of both vision-language and captioning models.

2310.01436.tldr: A new GNAS model based on large language models (LLMs) is presented and outperforms the state-of-the-art GNAS methods on four benchmark graph datasets, with an average improvement of 0.7% on the validation sets and 0.3% on the test sets.

2310.01791.tldr: A deterministic relationship for discrete POMDPs between an approximated and the optimal solution is derived and it is demonstrated that making a decision based on the deterministic guarantee may result in superior performance compared to the original algorithm without the deterministic certification.

2402.04678.tldr: FaithLM is introduced, a model-agnostic framework that evaluates and improves the faithfulness of LLM explanations without token masking or task-specific heuristics, and highlights that intervention-based evaluation, coupled with iterative optimization, provides a principled route toward faithful and reliable LLM explanations.

2404.05894.tldr: This work uses reinforcement learning to train graph neural nets to act as heuristics, that modify networks according to a learned preference function instead of at random, and achieves new state-of-the-art results on the challenging Mumford benchmark.

2404.15243.tldr: The proposed neural network classifier, which is referred to as UCINet0, is capable of predicting when no user is transmitting on the PUCCH, as well as decoding the UCI content for any number of multiplexed users (up to 12).

2406.08222.tldr: This study investigates refusal as a sociotechnical outcome through a counterfactual persona design that varies gender identity--including male, female, non-binary, and transgender personas--while keeping the classification task and visual input constant.

2407.11654.tldr: A physical layer framework is developed for resilient SFL with LLMs (R-SFLLM) over wireless networks and an adversarial training component is introduced, where controlled noise exposure significantly enhances the model’s resilience to perturbed parameters during training.

2408.10858.tldr: A novel multi-task reinforcement learning framework that integrates a centralized reward agent (CRA) and multiple distributed policy agents that functions as a knowledge pool that enhances knowledge sharing across established tasks but also adapts to new tasks by transferring meaningful reward signals.

2408.17145.tldr: This work shows that a stochastic variant of line search tames the heterogeneity in federated optimization in addition to that due to client-local gradient noise, and introduces Federated Stochastic Line Search (FedSLS), which offers linear convergence for strongly convex objectives even with partial client participation.

2409.06185.tldr: This study examines the ability of Large Language Models to generate future research ideas from scientific papers and proposes two automated evaluation metrics: Idea Alignment Score (IAScore) and Idea Distinctness Index.

2409.10372.tldr: A novel framework that integrates adaptive governance mechanisms directly into the design of sociotechnical systems through a unique separation of agent interaction networks from information flow networks and demonstrates that this RL-based governance significantly enhances cooperation compared to static information-sharing baselines.

2409.10898.tldr: Various hybrid deep learning models to predict on the CCME dataset with multiple water quality parameters from Canada, China, the UK, the USA, and Ireland, with 2.82 million data records feature-engineered and evaluated are introduced.

2409.14634.tldr: In a user study with computer science researchers, Scideator provided significantly more creativity support than a baseline using the same backbone LLM without the authors' facet-based modules, particularly in idea exploration and expressiveness.

2410.02675.tldr: This work proposes FAN, a novel neural network that effectively addresses periodicity modeling challenges while offering broad applicability similar to MLP with fewer parameters and FLOPs and reveals that compared to existing Fourier-based networks, FAN accommodates both periodicity modeling and general-purpose modeling well.

2410.02992.tldr: This work proposes guided reinforced self-training (Guided-ReST), a fine-tuning algorithm designed to improve the model's capability for effective search during inference, and introduces a novel data generation method that seamlessly incorporates optimal solutions into the model's search procedure, enabling the generation of high-quality search traces.

2410.05127.tldr: This work proves that the last-iterated policy of a proximal-point update with KL regularization converges to an equilibrium of MFG under non-strict monotonicity, and proposes the Approximate Proximal-Point algorithm, which approximately implements the PP update via a small number of MD steps.

2410.07076.tldr: This work investigates whether LLMs can discover high-quality chemistry hypotheses given only a research background-comprising a question and/or a survey-without restriction on the domain of the question, and develops an agentic LLM framework, MOOSE-Chem, that is a direct implementation of this mathematical decomposition.

2410.07592.tldr: A generative adversarial approach called Diversified and Adaptive Negative Sampling DANS on knowledge graphs equipped with a two-way generator that generates more diverse negative triplets through two pathways, and an adaptive mechanism that produces more fine-grained examples by localizing the global generator for different entities and relations.

2410.15068.tldr: CycleHDR is the first to use semantic and contextual awareness for the LDR-HDR reconstruction task in a self-supervised setup and achieves state-of-the-art performance across several benchmark datasets and reconstructs high-quality HDR images.

2412.10186.tldr: MIBP-Cert is introduced, a novel certification method based on mixed-integer bilinear programming (MIBP) that computes sound, deterministic bounds to provide provable robustness even under complex threat models.

2501.06488.tldr: NVS-SQA is proposed, a NSS quality assessment method to learn no-reference quality representations through self-supervision without reliance on human labels, and shows that NVS-SQA outperforms 17 no-reference methods by a large margin.

2501.13457.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical planning framework that enables zero-shot generalization to new STL tasks by leveraging only task-agnostic trajectory data during offline training and formally proves that this method guarantees STL satisfaction.

2501.13918.tldr: This work builds a large-scale human preference dataset focused on modern video generation models, and introduces VideoReward, a multi-dimensional video reward model, and examines how annotations and various design choices impact its rewarding efficacy.

2501.17823.tldr: This paper introduces cross-modal proxy tokens (CMPTs), which approximate the class token of a missing modality by attending only to the tokens of the available modality without requiring explicit modality generation or auxiliary networks.

2502.10818.tldr: It is shown theoretically and empirically that GNNs are by design prone to extreme gradient vanishing even after a few layers and over-smoothing is directly related to the mechanism causing vanishing gradients, and over-squashing is most easily alleviated by a combination of graph rewiring and vanishing gradient mitigation.

2502.10999.tldr: This work demonstrates that diffusion models can achieve font-controllable multilingual text rendering using just raw images without font label annotations, thereby eliminating the need for any ground-truth labels and enabling users to customize text rendering with any multilingual font of their choice.

2502.19158.tldr: It is demonstrated that performance differences between methods could reach 36% when users strongly disagree, and personalization can introduce up to 20% safety misalignment, highlighting the critical need for holistic evaluation approaches to advance the development of more effective and inclusive preference learning systems.
