2510.24813.tldr: DualCap is a novel approach that enriches the visual representation by generating a visual prompt from retrieved similar images by employing a dual retrieval mechanism, using standard image-to-text retrieval for text prompts and a novel image-to-image retrieval to source visually analogous scenes.

2510.24814.tldr: Experiments on the Freshness of the Fish Eyes dataset demonstrate that the best configuration combining Swin-Tiny features, an Extra Trees classifier, and LGBM-based feature selection achieves an accuracy of 85.99%, outperforming recent studies on the same dataset by 8.69-22.78%.

2510.24820.tldr: A multi-round safety editing framework that functions as a model-agnostic, plug-and-play module, enabling efficient safety alignment for any text-to-image model, and introduces a post-hoc safety editing paradigm that mirrors the human cognitive process of identifying and refining unsafe content.

2510.24823.tldr: This study examines whether leading AI chatbot companies implement the responsible AI principles they publicly advocate across company websites, technical documentation, and direct chatbot evaluations.

2510.24832.tldr: A novel metric, namely Reasoning Score (r-score), is introduced, which measures the query's learning difficulty based on the structure of its reasoning tree, and is proposed the Reasoning Tree Schedule (Re-Schedule), a scheduling algorithm that constructs a curriculum progressing from structurally simple to complex queries.

2510.24907.tldr: This work investigates a variant of the DUSt3R model, shedding light on the development of its latent state across blocks, the role of the individual layers, and suggests how it differs from methods with stronger inductive biases of explicit global pose.

2510.24942.tldr: This work identifies neurons of culture selectivity and performs causal tests by deactivating the neurons flagged by different identification methods and proposes a new margin-based selector - Contrastive Activation Selection (CAS), which outperforms existing probability- and entropy-based methods in identifying culture-sensitive neurons.

2510.24949.tldr: The proposed SCOUT (Scenario Coverage Oversight and Understanding Tool), a lightweight surrogate model designed to predict scenario coverage labels directly from an agent's latent sensor representations, provides an effective and practical alternative for large-scale coverage analysis.

2510.24966.tldr: This work empirically demonstrates that a wide range of modern language models exhibit low-rank structure, and shows that this low-rank structure can be leveraged for generation -- in particular, it can generate a response to a target prompt using a linear combination of the model's outputs on unrelated, or even nonsensical prompts.

2510.24976.tldr: A novel threat model referred to as Med-Hammer is proposed that combines the Rowhammer hardware fault injection with neural Trojan attacks to compromise the integrity of ViT-based medical imaging systems and demonstrate how malicious bit flips induced via Rowhammer can trigger implanted neural Trojans.

2510.24980.tldr: FT-ARM (Fine-Tuned Agentic Reflection Multimodal model), a fine-tuned multimodal large language model (MLLM) with an agentic self-reflection mechanism for pressure ulcer severity classification, advances the reliability, transparency, and clinical applicability of automated wound assessment systems.

2510.24985.tldr: This work proposes FaRAccel, a novel hardware accelerator architecture implemented on FPGA, specifically designed to offload and optimize FaR operations, effectively bridging the gap between algorithmic resilience and efficient deployment on real-world AI platforms.

2510.24986.tldr: A novel approach that integrates both real-time seizure detection and prediction, aiming to capture subtle temporal patterns in EEG data that may indicate an upcoming seizure, is proposed, allowing patients to anticipate seizures and take precautionary measures to reduce the risk of injury or other complications.

2510.25007.tldr: ProFees, the LLM-based framework that tackles E/M encoding automation complexities, achieves an increase in coding accuracy of more than 36% over a commercial CPT E/M coding system and almost 5% over the authors' strongest single-prompt baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness in addressing the real-world complexities.

2510.25013.tldr: This work trains small, attention-only transformers from scratch on a symbolic version of the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task, demonstrating that task-specific training induces highly interpretable, minimal circuits, offering a controlled testbed for probing the computational foundations of transformer reasoning.

2510.25014.tldr: This work resolves the core tension between the creative flexibility of LLMs and the procedural demands of in-game trading (browse-offer-review-confirm) by introducing Autoregressive State-Tracking Prompting (ASTP), a methodology centered on a strategically orchestrated prompt that compels an LLM to make its state-tracking process explicit and verifiable.

2510.25016.tldr: This study introduces the Human-AI RE Synergy Model (HARE-SM), a conceptual framework that integrates AI-driven analysis with human oversight to improve requirements elicitation, analysis, and validation and emphasizes ethical AI use through transparency, explainability, and bias mitigation.

2510.25017.tldr: StorageXTuner is presented, an LLM agent-driven auto-tuning framework for heterogeneous storage engines that couples an insight-driven tree search with layered memory that promotes empirical validated insights and employs lightweight checkers to guard against unsafe actions.

2510.25032.tldr: This paper proposes a deep learning strategy using YOLOv8 for license plate detection and recognition tasks, and follows a semi-supervised learning framework, combining a small set of manually labeled data with pseudo-labels generated by Grounding DINO to train the detection model.

2510.25053.tldr: These results establish predictive processing as a universal and scalable computational principle, pointing toward robust, flexible, and autonomous caregiving robots while offering theoretical insight into the human brain's ability to achieve flexible adaptation in uncertain real-world environments.

2510.25055.tldr: This study investigates the ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify research knowledge gaps in the biomedical literature and introduces a Toulmin-Abductive Bucketed Inference scheme that structures reasoning and buckets inferred conclusion candidates for validation.

2510.25096.tldr: The proposed FairMIB employs contrastive learning to maximize cross-view mutual information for bias-free representation learning and further integrates multi-perspective conditional information bottleneck objectives to balance task utility and fairness by minimizing mutual information with sensitive attributes.

2510.25113.tldr: The Neural Differential Manifold represents a fundamental shift towards geometrically structured, interpretable, and efficient deep learning systems and offers unprecedented interpretability by endowing internal representations with clear geometric meaning.

2510.25178.tldr: This work introduces Script-First Multilingual Synthesis with Adaptive Locale Resolution (SFMS-ALR), an engine-agnostic framework for fluent, real-time code-switched speech generation and establishes a modular baseline for high-quality, engine-independent multilingual TTS.

2510.25179.tldr: This work introduces Agentic Moderation, a model-agnostic framework that leverages specialised agents to defend multimodal systems against jailbreak attacks and provides modular, scalable, and fine-grained safety enforcement.

2510.25205.tldr: This work proposes an energy-efficient autonomous driving framework, called EneAD, and proposes a decision model based on reinforcement learning and design a regularization term to enhance driving stability in the face of perturbed perception results.

2510.25206.tldr: It is proved that conditioning on answer provably increases the expected utility of sampled reasoning paths, thereby transforming intractable problems into learnable ones and introducing RAVR (Reference-Answer-guided Variational Reasoning), an end-to-end framework that uses answer-conditioned reasoning as a variational surrogate for question-only reasoning.

2510.25218.tldr: This article synthesizes early evidence that these capacities buffer individual strain, reduce burnout through social support, and lower silent failure in AI-mediated workflows through team norms and risk-responsive governance.

2510.25220.tldr: Gen-Reranker, an autoregressive generator featuring a bidirectional encoder and a dynamic autoregressive decoder to generate causal reranking sequences and ordered multi-token prediction (OMTP), which trains Gen-Reranker to simultaneously generate multiple future items while preserving their order, ensuring practical deployment in real-time recommender systems.

2510.25226.tldr: This work formalizes the MPU data-generating process and establishes a generalization error bound for the proposed estimator, and assigns distinct, data-dependent weights to the positive andferred-negative loss components so that the resulting empirical objective is an unbiased estimation of the target risk.

2510.25234.tldr: Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that the method naturally generates talking faces with specified expressions while maintaining accurate lip synchronization, and achieves superior emotional expressivity compared to existing methods, without compromising lip-sync quality.

2510.25241.tldr: A data-efficient adaptation approach that learns a new humanoid motion from a single non-walking target sample together with auxiliary walking motions and a walking-trained base model, achieving superior performance across metrics.

2510.25254.tldr: An efficient implementation of basic moves, which add, delete, or reverse a single arc is given, and a preprocessing method to prune possible parent sets so as to approximately preserve the sums is devised.

2510.25268.tldr: A novel HAOI sequence generation framework SynHLMA, to synthesize hand language manipulation for articulated objects and shows a robotics grasp application that enables dexterous grasps execution from imitation learning using the manipulation sequence provided by the SynHLMA.

2510.25378.tldr: It is suggested that highly cited papers are nearly verbatimly retained in the model, indicating a threshold where generalization shifts into memorization.

2406.05948.tldr: Chain-of-Scrutiny (CoS) is proposed which leverages LLMs' unique reasoning abilities to mitigate backdoor attacks and is well-suited for the popular API-only LLM deployments, enabling detection at minimal cost and with little data.

2411.00066.tldr: The Generalized Induction-Head Model is an interpretable model for next-token prediction inspired by the observation of induction heads in LLMs, a retrieval-based module that identifies similar sequences in the input context by combining exact n-gram matching and fuzzy matching based on a neural similarity metric.

2501.05783.tldr: This work highlights the potential of dynamic NeRF-based UV mapping for creating more effective adversarial attacks on person detectors, addressing key challenges in modeling human movement and texture modification.

2502.04380.tldr: This work investigates the role of data diversity in enhancing the overall abilities of LLMs by empirically constructing contrastive data pools and theoretically deriving explanations, and proposes a new method that gives the LLM a dual identity: an output model to cognitively probe and select data based on diversity reward, as well as an input model to be tuned with the selected data.

2505.12191.tldr: This work presents a fully self-supervised framework that enables noise-robust representation learning without requiring a denoiser at inference or downstream fine-tuning, and demonstrates that denoiser-free robustness can emerge from noise-aware pretraining.

2505.12275.tldr: This work proposes Curriculum Abductive Learning (C-ABL), a method that explicitly leverages the internal structure of the knowledge base to address the ABL training challenges, and significantly improves training stability, convergence speed, and final accuracy, especially under complex knowledge setting.

2505.12371.tldr: This work introduces MedAgentBoard, a comprehensive benchmark for the systematic evaluation of multi-agent collaboration, single-LLM, and conventional approaches, and underscores the necessity of a task-specific, evidence-based approach to selecting and developing AI solutions in medicine.

2505.13904.tldr: This work explores the idea of insertion-based paradigm and proposes Learning to Construct with Insertion-based Paradigm (L2C-Insert), a novel learning-based method for constructive NCO that achieves superior performance across various problem sizes.

2505.14604.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework, Self-Braking Tuning (SBT), which tackles overthinking from the perspective of allowing the model to regulate its own reasoning process, thus eliminating the reliance on external control mechanisms.

2505.14970.tldr: Self-Evolving Curriculum (SEC), an automatic curriculum learning method that learns a curriculum policy concurrently with the RL fine-tuning process, significantly improves models'reasoning capabilities, enabling better generalization to harder, out-of-distribution test problems.

2505.15095.tldr: This paper harnesses PMP for explainable sarcasm detection for Australian and Indian English, alongside a benchmark dataset for standard English, and finds that alternative techniques such as agentic prompting mitigate context-related failures by enabling external knowledge retrieval.

2505.18766.tldr: Extensive experiments on the WikiArt and CelebA datasets demonstrate that StyleGuard outperforms existing methods in robustness against various transformations and purifications, effectively countering style mimicry in various models.

2505.21497.tldr: The first benchmark and metric suite for poster generation is introduced, which pairs recent conference papers with author-designed posters and evaluates outputs on Visual Quality-semantic alignment with human posters, and proposes PosterAgent, a top-down, visual-in-the-loop multi-agent pipeline.

2505.21996.tldr: This work enhances image-to-video models with interactive capabilities through additional action conditioning and autoregressive framework, and reveals that compounding error is inherently irreducible in autoregressive video generation, while insufficient memory mechanism leads to incoherence of world models.

2506.01158.tldr: This paper proposes Regression Training of Normalizing Flows (RegFlow), a novel and scalable regression-based training objective that bypasses the numerical instability and computational challenge of conventional maximum likelihood training in favour of a simple $\ell_2$-regression objective.

2506.01369.tldr: This work proposes a framework that incentivizes LLMs to self-verify their own answers by unifying answer generation and verification within a single reinforcement learning (RL) process, and shows that these models can not only improve post-training performance but also enable effective test-time scaling.

2506.06220.tldr: This work proposes GenIR, a generative multi-round retrieval paradigm leveraging diffusion-based image generation to explicitly reify the AI system's understanding at each round, and introduces a fully automated pipeline to generate a high-quality multi-round MIR dataset.

2506.07127.tldr: Action Preference Optimization is introduced, a method designed to refine VLA models by human-assisted preference alignment gathered through interaction with environments by empowering VLA models effectively suppress failure-prone actions while enhancing corrective action adaptation.

2506.09937.tldr: This paper introduces the multitask failure detection problem and proposes SAFE, a failure detector for generalist robot policies such as VLAs, and designs SAFE to learn from VLA internal features and predict a single scalar indicating the likelihood of task failure.

2506.10173.tldr: This work proposes the Scalable Prompt-Aware R\'eny Kernel Entropy Diversity Guidance (SPARKE) method, which dynamically conditions diversity measurement on similar prompts and enables prompt-aware diversity control and focuses on the special case of Conditional latent RKE Score Guidance.

2506.11094.tldr: A structured overview of recent advances in safety evaluation of Large Language Models is presented and a four-dimensional taxonomy is proposed, highlighting the necessity of prioritizing safety evaluation to ensure the reliable and responsible deployment of LLMs in real-world applications.

2506.20535.tldr: AIMeter is presented, a comprehensive software toolkit for the measurement, analysis, and visualization of energy use, power draw, hardware performance, and carbon emissions across AI workloads and enables in-depth correlation analysis between hardware metrics and model performance and thus facilitates bottleneck identification and performance enhancement.

2507.03704.tldr: This work enables Large Reasoning Models to approximate human intelligence through dynamic thinking speed adjustment, optimizing accuracy-efficiency trade-offs and proposes the first reasoning strategy that enables fast processing of easy steps and deeper analysis for complex reasoning.

2507.13328.tldr: It is shown that the VL models often outperform their text-only counterparts on a text-only question-answering task that requires taxonomic understanding of concepts mentioned in the questions, and VL training does improve the deployment of this knowledge in the context of a specific task, even when the presentation of the task is purely linguistic.

2507.21257.tldr: It is concluded that LLMs struggle to systematically and compositionally interpret questions and map them into SPARQL queries.

2508.01543.tldr: Refine-n-Judge, an automated iterative approach that leverages a single LLM as both a refiner and a judge to enhance dataset quality, demonstrates the effectiveness of Refine-n-Judge across a range of public datasets spanning five corpora.

2508.15030.tldr: Collab-REC, a multi-agent framework designed to counteract popularity bias and enhance diversity in tourism recommendations, is proposed, highlighting the promise of multi-stakeholder collaboration in LLM-driven recommender systems.

2508.21204.tldr: Analysis reveals that removing memory or symbolic structure degrades key cognitive behaviors, including abstraction, adaptive probing, and conceptual continuity, which support a processing-level account in which prompt-level cognitive scaffolds can reliably shape emergent instructional strategies in LLMs.

2509.01083.tldr: This paper proposes Dynamic Speculative Decoding Engine (DSDE), a training-free framework built on a predictive signal based on the variance of the Kullback-Leibler (KLD) divergence, which diagnoses the generation's regional stability and an adaptive speculation length cap to mitigate the straggler problem in per-sequence decoding.

2509.06159.tldr: A Feature-Adaptive Spatial Localization model (FASL-Seg) is proposed, designed to capture features at multiple levels of detail through two distinct processing streams, namely a Low-Level Feature Projection (LLFP) and High-Level Feature Projection (HLFP) stream, for varying feature resolutions - enabling precise segmentation of anatomy and surgical instruments.

2509.17197.tldr: SignalLLM is introduced, the first general-purpose LLM-based agent framework for general SP tasks, and introduces a principled, modular architecture that enables the flexible selection of problem solving strategies across different signal modalities, task types, and data conditions.

2509.17784.tldr: The proposed MLLM-CD is a novel framework for multimodal causal discovery from unstructured data that consists of a novel contrastive factor discovery module to identify genuine multimodal factors based on the interactions explored from contrastive sample pairs and an iterative multimodal counterfactual reasoning module to refine the discovery outcomes iteratively by incorporating the world knowledge and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs.

2509.19331.tldr: The Holographic Transformer is introduced, a physics-inspired architecture that incorporates wave interference principles into self-attention and provides a unified, physics-based framework for coherent signal modeling.

2509.21319.tldr: It is shown that Reward Models trained in this manner can outperform Bradley-Terry models when matched for data and achieve top performance on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and a fully open source recipe to align Qwen3-32B using RLBFF and the authors' Reward Model is presented.

2509.24267.tldr: This work introduces a cycle training framework to fine-tune diffusion models for improved conditioning adherence and enhanced synthetic image realism, and suggests that the cycle strategy used in CDM can be an effective method for refining diffusion-based medical image generation.

2510.08604.tldr: This work proposes LatentBreak, a white-box jailbreak attack that generates natural adversarial prompts with low perplexity capable of evading such defenses, and outperforming competing jailbreak algorithms against perplexity-based filters on multiple safety-aligned models.

2510.14904.tldr: This work trains MaskCaptioner, an end-to-end model capable of jointly detecting, segmenting, tracking and captioning object trajectories, and achieves state-of-the-art DVOC results on three existing benchmarks, VidSTG, VLN and BenSMOT.

2510.16396.tldr: A light framework that adopts an encoder-decoder architecture and introduces several key contributions aimed at improving both efficiency and accuracy is designed, demonstrating comparable accuracy to state-of-the-art approaches while significantly enhancing computational efficiency.

2510.18915.tldr: A novel, high-quality, and UNified Omni model benchmark, UNO-Bench, designed to effectively evaluate both UNi-modal and Omni-modal capabilities under a unified ability taxonomy, spanning 44 task types and 5 modality combinations is introduced.

2510.21888.tldr: It is proved that learning an $\epsilon$-optimal policy in this setting is computationally hard and established NP-hardness under a parameterized greedy policy set (argmax) and shown that - unless NP = RP - an exponential lower bound holds when the policy set contains softmax policies, under the Randomized Exponential Time Hypothesis.

2510.23127.tldr: This work lays the foundation for a new class of hybrid scientific AI agents, repositioning the developmental focus from direct sequence interpretation towards high-level knowledge synthesis, and argues for reframing Sci-LLMs not as sequence decoders, but as powerful reasoning engines over expert knowledge.

2510.23216.tldr: This paper proposes a sample-efficient DRL method tailored for training and fine-tuning agents in industrial settings such as the video game industry, and improves sample efficiency of value-based DRL by leveraging pre-collected data and increasing network plasticity.

2510.23595.tldr: Multi-Agent Evolve is proposed, a framework that enables LLMs to self-evolve in solving diverse tasks, including mathematics, reasoning, and general knowledge Q&A, and highlights MAE as a scalable, data-efficient method for enhancing the general reasoning abilities of LLMs with minimal reliance on human-curated supervision.

2510.23925.tldr: This work reformulates reasoning in LVLMs as posterior inference as posterior inference and proposes a scalable training algorithm based on amortized variational inference, which enhances the state-of-the-art LVLMs on seven reasoning benchmarks, in terms of effectiveness, generalization, and interpretability.

2510.24134.tldr: This paper introduces VC4VG (Video Captioning for Video Generation), a comprehensive caption optimization framework tailored to the needs of T2V models, and constructs VC4VG-Bench, a new benchmark featuring fine-grained, multi-dimensional, and necessity-graded metrics aligned with T2V-specific requirements.

2510.24519.tldr: A method to extract Mel scale features in time domain combining the concept of wavelet transform, thus reducing the computational burden of time-frequency conversion and the complexity of wavelet extraction is proposed.

2510.24797.tldr: Self-referential processing is implicate as a minimal and reproducible condition under which large language models generate structured first-person reports that are mechanistically gated, semantically convergent, and behaviorally generalizable.

2510.24817.tldr: This study constructs and validates two methods to generate synthetic transcripts of the AphasiaBank Cat Rescue picture description task and finds Mistral 7b Instruct best captures key aspects of linguistic degradation observed in aphasia, showing realistic directional changes in NDW, word count, and word length amongst the synthetic generation methods.

2510.25080.tldr: A modified version of Monopoly Deal is introduced as a benchmark environment that isolates this dynamic of bounded one-sided response games, and the gold-standard algorithm, Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR), converges on effective strategies without novel algorithmic extensions.

2510.25160.tldr: This work introduces the Model-Document Protocol (MDP), a general framework that formalizes how raw text is bridged to LLMs through consumable knowledge representations, and presents MDP-Agent, which realizes the protocol through an agentic process.

2510.25366.tldr: A novel framework grounded in the hypothesis that loss functions in real-world tasks swap from initial non-convexity to convexity towards the optimum is proposed, which is leverage to design an innovative two-phase optimization algorithm.

2510.25409.tldr: BhashaBench V1 is introduced, the first domain-specific, multi-task, bilingual benchmark focusing on critical Indic knowledge systems, enabling assessment of models'ability to integrate domain-specific knowledge with bilingual understanding.

2510.25744.tldr: It is argued for a shift from building and assessing task completion agents to developing collaborative agents, assessed not only by the quality of their final outputs but by how well they engage with and enhance human effort throughout the problem-solving process.

2510.25775.tldr: This paper explores adapting SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to the domain of chess analysis, aiming to attribute a chess engines evaluation to specific pieces on the board, and compute additive, per-piece contributions that explain the engines output in a locally faithful and human-interpretable manner.

2510.25783.tldr: This study proposes the LArge-Scale Target-Independent STance (LASTIST) dataset, a collection of press releases of both parties on Korean political parties, designed for various tasks in stance detection, including target-independent stance detection and diachronic evolution stance detection.

2510.25784.tldr: Experimental results show that zFLoRA compares favorably against the popular supervised fine-tuning benchmarks including low-rank adapters (LoRA) as well as full fine-tuning (FFT).

2510.25785.tldr: This work introduces HiMAE (Hierarchical Masked Autoencoder), a self supervised framework that combines masked autoencoding with a hierarchical convolutional encoder decoder that produces multi resolution embeddings that enable systematic evaluation of which temporal scales carry predictive signal.

2510.25786.tldr: This work builds on the Mechanistic Interpretability Benchmark (MIB) and proposes three key improvements to circuit discovery, including a simple ratio-based selection strategy to prioritize strong positive-scoring edges, balancing performance and faithfulness.

2510.25791.tldr: It is demonstrated that CoT accelerates generalization but does not overcome tasks with higher algorithmic complexity, such as finding list intersections; a kinetic modeling framework for understanding transformer learning is introduced and trace faithfulness is characterized as a dynamic property that emerges over training.

2510.25796.tldr: This study extends the learning and planning framework of Xu et al. (2018) from ride-hailing to ride-pooling by embedding a ride-pooling simulation within the learning mechanism to enable non-myopic decision-making and proposes a complementary policy for rebalancing idle vehicles.

2510.25798.tldr: MemEIC is proposed, a novel method for Continual and Compositional Knowledge Editing (CCKE) in LVLMs that enables compositional editing of both visual and textual knowledge sequentially and significantly improves performance on complex multimodal questions and effectively preserves prior edits.

2510.25813.tldr: A novel framework for Industry 5.0 that simplifies the deployment of AI models on edge devices in various industrial settings by enabling local inference and real-time processing and supports modular integration and maintains low resource requirements.

2510.25818.tldr: ScaleDiff is a model-agnostic and highly efficient framework for extending the resolution of pretrained diffusion models without any additional training that achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods in terms of both image quality and inference speed on both U-Net and Diffusion Transformer architectures.

2510.25819.tldr: This OpenID Foundation whitepaper outlines the resources already available for securing today's agents and presents a strategic agenda to address the foundational authentication, authorization, and identity problems pivotal for tomorrow's widespread autonomous systems.

2510.25820.tldr: F fuzzy-symbolic scaffolding is introduced, a framework in which symbolic structures are expressed as fuzzy, numerical boundaries that stabilize coherence where needed while preserving improvisation where surprise sustains engagement, overturning the assumption that tighter constraints inherently enhance play.

2510.25883.tldr: The Information-Theoretic Imperative and Compression Efficiency Principle provide a unified account of convergence across biological, artificial, and multi-scale systems, addressing the epistemic and functional dimensions of intelligence without invoking assumptions about consciousness or subjective experience.

2510.25884.tldr: This work proposes a framework for modeling diverse, persona-based preferences by learning to aggregate outputs from multiple rubric-conditioned judges, and proposes a persona-based method for synthesizing preference labels at scale and two distinct implementations of the aggregator.

2510.25904.tldr: An extensive evaluation of the (semi-)automatization of FrameNet-like semantic annotation by the use of an LLM-based semantic role labeler shows that the hybrid, semi-automatic annotation setting leads to increased frame diversity and similar annotation coverage, when compared to the human-only setting, while the automatic setting performs considerably worse in all metrics, except for annotation time.

2510.25908.tldr: SciTrust 2.0 is introduced, a comprehensive framework for evaluating LLM trustworthiness in scientific applications across four dimensions: truthfulness, adversarial robustness, scientific safety, and scientific ethics, which provides a foundation for developing more trustworthy AI systems and advancing research on model safety and ethics in scientific contexts.

2510.25914.tldr: A system simulating a realistic end-to-end industry process starting with retrieving data from various sources to consolidating and analyzing the data to generate recommendations for optimization and a set of metrics shows that the agent was able to understand, plan, and execute tasks as well as an actual FinOps practitioner.

2510.25929.tldr: Findings suggest that adaptive incentive control supports more sustainable strategic co-existence in heterogeneous agent environments and offers a structured lens for evaluating behavioral design in algorithmic trading systems.

2510.25933.tldr: Humans-Junior is introduced, a 3.8B model that matches GPT-4o on the FACTS Grounding public subset within a $\pm 5$ pp equivalence margin and achieves GPT-4o-level FACTS accuracy (equivalent within $\pm 5$ pp on Q1--Q500).

2510.25947.tldr: This study finds that combining English and multilingual data does not necessarily degrade the in-language performance of either group, and suggests that multilingual data, when balanced appropriately, can enhance language model capabilities without compromising performance, even in low-resource settings.

2510.25951.tldr: This work formally articulate the attention-aware inverse planning problem, and presents an approach to attention-aware inverse planning that combines deep reinforcement learning with computational cognitive modeling, demonstrating the scalability of estimating cognitive biases with attention-aware inverse planning.

2510.25954.tldr: This study evaluated the predictive performance of three GeoFM embedding sources for modeling 15 routine health programmatic outputs in Malawi, and compared their utility to traditional geospatial interpolation methods, concluding that the integration of multiple GeoFM sources is an efficient and valuable tool for supplementing and strengthening constrained routine health information systems.

2510.25976.tldr: Brain-IT is presented, a brain-inspired approach that addresses this challenge through a Brain Interaction Transformer (BIT), allowing effective interactions between clusters of functionally-similar brain-voxels, allowing effective interactions between clusters of functionally-similar brain-voxels.

2510.25997.tldr: An agentic pipeline is presented that extends a naive text-to-SQL baseline with orchestration by a Mistral-based ReAct agent, enabling more natural human-database interaction and concluding that agentic orchestration, rather than stronger SQL generators alone, is a promising foundation for interactive geospatial assistants.

2510.26004.tldr: DARTS integrates drones' high mobility and aerial perspective for adaptive surveillance, thermal imaging for better low-visibility performance and privacy protection, and a lightweight deep learning framework for real-time vehicle trajectory extraction and incident detection, indicating potential scalability and cost-effectiveness for use in remote areas and resource-constrained settings.

2510.26007.tldr: This work reflects on prior work that examines the robustness of fairness metrics for recommender systems as a type of AI application and summarises their key takeaways into a set of non-exhaustive guidelines for developing reliable metrics of responsible AI.

2510.26014.tldr: This work proposes a dual mixture-of-experts (MoE) framework for discrete-time survival analysis that combines a feature-encoder MoE for subgroup-aware representation learning with a hazard MoE that leverages patient features and time embeddings to capture temporal dynamics.

2510.26017.tldr: A novel, lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based model designed to predict coastal flooding under variable SLR projections and shoreline adaptation scenarios is developed, demonstrating the ability of the model to generalize across diverse geographical contexts by utilizing datasets from two distinct regions.

2510.26020.tldr: This work proposes PORTool, a reinforcement learning (RL) method that encourages a tool-use LLM to explore various trajectories yielding the correct answer, and conducts ablation studies to systematically justify the necessity and the design robustness of step-wise rewards.

2510.26024.tldr: This work systematically analyze the cross-lingual alignment trade-off by introducing a holistic evaluation framework, the transfer-localization plane, which quantifies both desirable knowledge transfer and undesirable cultural erasure, and proposes Surgical Steering, a novel inference-time method that disentangles these two objectives.

2510.26032.tldr: The role of ITFs in thyroid cancer overdiagnosis and the need for standardized reporting and more selective follow-up are underscore the need for standardized reporting and more selective follow-up.

2510.26037.tldr: This work presents SIRAJ: a generic red-teaming framework for arbitrary black-box LLM agents, using a dynamic two-step process that starts with an agent definition and generates diverse seed test cases that cover various risk outcomes, tool-use trajectories, and risk sources.

2510.26038.tldr: Overall the debiasing capability of a model is undermined post-KD, and three effective solutions to improve the distillability of debiasing methods are proposed: developing high quality data for augmentation, implementing iterative knowledge distillation, and initializing student models with weights obtained from teacher models.

2510.26052.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach for dynamic negative prompting in diffusion models that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to adaptively generate negative prompts during the denoising process and queries a VLM to produce contextually appropriate negative prompts.

2510.26057.tldr: This chapter relates the general definition of accountability to AI, what it means for AI to be accountable and unaccountable is illustrated, and approaches that can improve the chances of living in a world where all AI is accountable to those who are affected by it are explored.

2510.26061.tldr: A graph neural network-based model is designed to generate projections tailored to each QP instance, enabling us to produce high-quality solutions even for previously unseen problems, and provides a theoretical analysis of the generalization ability of solving QPs with projection matrices generated by neural networks.

2510.26068.tldr: This work lays a solid foundation for constructing fully dynamic "meta-learners" capable of autonomously evolving their geometry and topology, and it points to broad application prospects in areas such as scientific model discovery and robust representation learning.

2510.26089.tldr: Experiments on synthetic grids and real urban maps show that AN reduces average travel time versus SPF and learning baselines, maintaining 100% routing success, and highlight the potential of network-constrained MARL for scalable, coordinated, and congestion-aware routing in intelligent transportation systems.

2510.26099.tldr: Stratified Assessments of Forecasts over Earth (SAFE) is introduced, a package for elucidating the stratified performance of a set of predictions made over Earth, and for the first time asks: where do models perform best or worst, and which models are most fair?

2510.26105.tldr: PReMA is the first attack that manipulates model outputs by solely creating adversarial images, distinguishing itself from prior methods that primarily generate adversarial prompts to produce NSFW content.

2510.26113.tldr: View-GRPO is proposed, a novel reinforcement learning framework that effectively strengthens view-specific temporal reasoning while encouraging consistent comprehension across viewpoints and demonstrates its superiority over naive SFT and GRPO for improving cross-view consistency.

2510.26136.tldr: This paper introduces a quantitative ``economics of inference''framework, treating the LLM inference process as a compute-driven intelligent production activity, and constructs the first ``LLM Inference Production Frontier,'' revealing three principles: diminishing marginal cost, diminishing returns to scale, and an optimal cost-effectiveness zone.

2510.26143.tldr: This work proposes Reasoning Curriculum, a simple two-stage curriculum that first elicits reasoning skills in pretraining-aligned domains such as math, then adapts and refines these skills across other domains via joint RL.

2510.26144.tldr: FM Agent is a novel and general-purpose multi-agent framework that leverages a synergistic combination of LLM-based reasoning and large-scale evolutionary search to address complex real-world challenges and shows considerable promise for both large-scale enterprise R&D workflows and fundamental scientific research.

2510.26151.tldr: A novel Multi-View Mammography and Language Model for breast cancer classification and risk prediction, trained on a dataset of paired mammogram images and synthetic radiology reports, that exhibits strong data efficiency and achieves state-of-the-art performance in three classification tasks.

2510.26157.tldr: Experimental results show that MolBridge effectively captures fine-grained correspondences and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on a wide range of molecular benchmarks, highlighting the significance of substructure-aware alignment in molecule-text learning.

2510.26159.tldr: These findings highlight that, in scenarios with highly imbalanced and temporally uncertain data, model simplicity combined with optimized segmentation can outperform more sophisticated architectures, offering greater robustness, interpretability, and operational utility.

2510.26165.tldr: This work proposes a generative framework that learns latent representations of fund manager strategies without requiring explicit utility specification, and provides a data-driven approach for characterizing investment strategies for applications in market simulation, strategy attribution, and regulatory oversight.

2510.26172.tldr: This work presents SIA (Social Insight Agents), an LLM agent system that links heterogeneous multi-modal data -- including raw inputs, intermediate outputs, mined analytical results, and visualization artifacts -- through coordinated agent flows and enables agents to plan and execute coherent analysis strategies.

2510.26185.tldr: ACC-SGD-IE is proposed, a trajectory-aware estimator that propagates the leave-one-out perturbation across training and updates an accumulative influence state at each step, which yields more accurate influence estimates, especially over long epochs.

2510.26186.tldr: ConceptScope categorizes concepts into target, context, and bias types based on their semantic relevance and statistical correlation to class labels, enabling class-level dataset characterization, bias identification, and robustness evaluation through concept-based subgrouping.

2510.26188.tldr: These models can be used to identify the crucial factors causing readmissions and help identify patients to focus on to reduce the chances of readmission, ultimately bringing down the cost and increasing the quality of healthcare provided to the patients.

2510.26200.tldr: Together, these results demonstrate that softened ordering via timestep allocation is the critical lever for mitigating update forgetting and achieving stable and controllable diffusion text generation.

2510.26217.tldr: A certifiable hybrid pipeline purpose-built for finance-native collateral optimization under ISDA Credit Support Annexes, delivering better cost-movement-tail frontiers under governance settings and releasing governance grade artifacts-span citations, valuation matrix audit, weight provenance, QUBO manifests, and CP-SAT traces-to make results auditable and reproducible.

2510.26230.tldr: This work regards classification training as a sequential process where classes are learned sequentially, which enables modular and model-agnostic deployment as an output filter into existing classification pipelines with minimal alterations.

2510.26238.tldr: QASU (Questionnaire Analysis and Structural Understanding), a benchmark that probes six structural skills, including answer lookup, respondent count, and multi-hop inference, across six serialization formats and multiple prompt strategies, offers a simple yet versatile foundation for advancing both research and real-world practice in LLM-based questionnaire analysis.

2510.26242.tldr: An emergencyaware reasoning framework is presented, which dynamically adjusts reasoning depth based on the emergency scenario and is equipped with a novel Reviewer-based Emergency RAG (RERAG) to distill specific knowledge and guidance from historical cases, enhancing the reliability and rationality of agents' emergency decisions.

2510.26243.tldr: Experiments across multiple model families and sizes show that Angular Steering achieves robust behavioral control while maintaining general language modeling performance, underscoring its flexibility, generalization, and robustness compared to prior approaches.

2510.26270.tldr: Graph-Enhanced Policy Optimization (GEPO), which dynamically constructs a state-transition graph from agent experience and employs graph-theoretic centrality to provide three synergistic learning signals, highlights that explicitly modeling environmental structure is a robust, generalizable strategy for advancing LLM agent training.

2510.26278.tldr: The Inference-time Multi-target Generation (IMG) algorithm, which optimizes the diffusion process at inference-time to generate samples that simultaneously satisfy multiple objectives and can be viewed as an optimized diffusion process and can be integrated into existing methods to further improve their performance.

2510.26285.tldr: It is shown that properly factoring in sinusoidality is crucial when it comes to assessing how accurately LLMs encode numeric and other ordinal information, and that mechanistically enhancing this sinusoidality can also lead to reductions of LLMs'arithmetic errors.

2510.26298.tldr: An early evaluation of Atlas's web interaction capabilities using browser-based games as test scenarios, including Google's T-Rex Runner, Sudoku, Flappy Bird, and Stein suggests that while Atlas demonstrates capable analytical processing, there remain notable limitations in dynamic web environments requiring real-time interaction.

2510.26309.tldr: GraphCompliance is introduced, a framework that represents regulatory texts as a Policy Graph and runtime contexts as a Context Graph, and aligns them, suggesting that structured representations and a judge LLM are complementary for normative reasoning.

2510.26336.tldr: ACER first synthesizes a comprehensive, textbook-style curriculum by generating a table of contents for a subject and then creating question-answer pairs guided by Bloom's taxonomy, which ensures systematic topic coverage and progressively increasing difficulty.

2510.26339.tldr: GLYPH-SR is a vision-language-guided diffusion framework that aims to achieve high readability and high visual realism-delivering SR that looks right and reds right, and is designed to satisfy both objectives simultaneously.

2510.26342.tldr: It is demonstrated that integrating interventional constraints not only improves model accuracy and ensures consistency with established findings, making models more explainable, but also facilitates the discovery of new causal relationships that would otherwise be costly to identify.

2510.26345.tldr: This work proposes MisSynth, a pipeline that applies retrieval-augmented generation to produce synthetic fallacy samples, which are then used to fine-tune an LLM model, and shows substantial accuracy gains with fine-tuned models compared to vanilla baselines.

2510.26346.tldr: This work proposes a weaker state abstraction condition that trades a minor loss in accuracy for finding many more abstractions, and names this technique Ideal Pruning Abstractions in UCT (IPA-UCT), which outperforms OGA-UCT across a large range of test domains and iteration budgets as experimentally validated.

2510.26347.tldr: The results demonstrate that a modified Monte Carlo-based approach significantly outperforms traditional Q-learning and two exhaustive search patterns, illustrating its potential in adapting RL to complex environments and suggesting that reinforcement learning approaches can be effectively adapted for use in random, nonstationary, and reward-sparse environments.

2510.26352.tldr: An interaction-centric framework for automatic team composition that does not require any prior knowledge including their internal architectures, training data, or task performances is proposed and provides a new basis for the automated design of collaborative multi-agent LLM teams.

2510.26384.tldr: This work proposes a item-centric approach to benchmark subset selection, arguing that selection should be based on the intrinsic properties of the task items themselves, rather than on model-specific failure patterns, and instantiates this item-centric efficient benchmarking approach via a novel method, Scales++.

2510.26390.tldr: A Spatial Prior-Guided Cross Dual Encoder Network (SPG-CDENet), a novel two-stage segmentation paradigm designed to improve multi-organ segmentation accuracy and demonstrate the superior performance of SPG-CDENet compared to existing segmentation methods.

2510.26396.tldr: It is argued that this traditional bundle of obligations that societies confer upon entities for a variety of reasons can be unbundled, creating bespoke solutions for different contexts, and allow for the creation of practical tools without needing to resolve intractable debates about an AI's consciousness or rationality.

2510.26402.tldr: By integrating AI-driven feedback, semantic clustering, and interactive visualization, Autograder+ reduces instructor workload while supporting targeted instruction and promoting stronger learning outcomes.

2510.26406.tldr: Hi-ORS stabilizes value estimation by filtering out negatively rewarded samples during online fine-tuning, and adopts a reward-weighted supervised training objective to provide dense intermediate-step supervision, and develops an asynchronous inference-training framework that supports flexible online human-in-the-loop corrections.

2510.26411.tldr: This work advances mechanistic interpretability in medical vision by applying Medical Sparse Autoencoders (MedSAEs) to the latent space of MedCLIP, a vision-language model trained on chest radiographs and reports and proposes an evaluation framework that combines correlation metrics, entropy analyzes, and automated neuron naming via the MedGEMMA foundation model.

2510.26420.tldr: A sample-specific clean-label backdoor watermarking (i.e., SSCL-BW) is proposed, which generates unique watermarks for each sample, fundamentally overcoming the vulnerability of static watermark patterns.

2510.26444.tldr: A cross-fidelity knowledge distillation and adaptive fusion network (CFKD-AFN), which leverages abundant but low-fidelity simulation data to enhance predictions on scarce but high-fidelity trial data, and extends CFKD-AFN to an interpretable variant, enabling the exploration of latent medical semantics to support clinical decision-making.

2510.26457.tldr: This work proposes SecureReviewer, a new approach designed for enhancing LLMs'ability to identify and resolve security-related issues during code review, and introduces SecureBLEU, a new evaluation metric designed to assess the effectiveness of review comments in addressing security issues.

2510.26474.tldr: Four efficient strategies from two perspectives are introduced: distribution-reshaping and trajectory-resampling, to achieve head-tail re-balancing during the exploration-and-learning self-improvement process, and consistently improve visual reasoning capabilities.

2510.26484.tldr: The Bayesian network LLM fusion (BNLF) framework is proposed, which integrates predictions from three LLMs, including FinBERT, RoBERTa, and BERTweet, through a probabilistic mechanism for sentiment analysis, demonstrating its robustness to dataset variability and the effectiveness of probabilistic fusion for interpretable sentiment classification.

2510.26486.tldr: LINK-KG is proposed, a modular framework that integrates a three-stage, LLM-guided coreference resolution pipeline with downstream KG extraction with a type-specific Prompt Cache, enabling clean and disambiguated narratives for structured knowledge graph construction from both short and long legal texts.

2510.26493.tldr: This paper situate context engineering, provide a systematic definition, outline its historical and conceptual landscape, and examine key design considerations for practice, which aim to offer a conceptual foundation for context engineering and sketch its promising future.

2510.26494.tldr: An agent-based simulation framework that integrates real U.S. Census demographic distributions, authentic Twitter network topology, and heterogeneous large language model (LLM) agents to examine the effect of mobilization messages on voter turnout and reproduces qualitative patterns observed in field experiments.

2510.26518.tldr: This paper focuses on an important safety problem that is already challenging for humans: fact-verification of AI outputs, and finds that combining AI ratings and human ratings based on AI rater confidence is better than relying on either alone.

2510.26551.tldr: This research provides an indication of potential advances in the exploration of all four fundamental aspects of tool usage, enabling robots to master the intricate art of tool manipulation across diverse tasks.

2510.26566.tldr: This work formally defines multiclass local calibration and establishes its relationship with strong calibration, and proposes a practical method to enhance local calibration in Neural Networks, which enforces alignment between predicted probabilities and local estimates of class frequencies using the Jensen-Shannon distance.

2510.26575.tldr: InfoFlow is introduced, a systematic framework that tackles the Reward Density Optimization problem from three aspects, and significantly outperforms strong baselines, enabling lightweight LLMs to achieve performance comparable to advanced proprietary LLMs.

2510.26585.tldr: SupervisorAgent is introduced, a lightweight and modular framework for runtime, adaptive supervision that operates without altering the base agent's architecture that intervenes at critical junctures to proactively correct errors, guide inefficient behaviors, and purify observations.

2510.26603.tldr: This paper presents an agentic AI HEMS where LLMs autonomously coordinate multi-appliance scheduling from natural language requests to device control, achieving optimal scheduling without example demonstrations and open-source the complete system including orchestration logic, agent prompts, tools, and web interfaces.

2510.26658.tldr: This work introduces asynchronous thinking as a new paradigm of reasoning with large language models, which organizes the internal thinking process into concurrently executable structures, and proposes a thinking protocol where an organizer dynamically assigns sub-queries to workers, merges intermediate knowledge, and produces coherent solutions.

2510.26683.tldr: This paper proposes an ontology rule guided method Evontree to enable self-evolution of LLMs in low-resource specialized domains, which outperforms both the base models and strong baselines, achieving up to a 3.7\% improvement in accuracy.

2510.26702.tldr: A delegated authorization model enabling authorization servers to semantically inspect access requests to protected resources, and issue access tokens constrained to the minimal set of scopes necessary for the agents' assigned tasks is introduced.

2510.26721.tldr: The findings reveal that text bias arises from an intrinsic misalignment within the attention key space rather than solely from external data factors.

2510.26730.tldr: ExpertFlow is presented, a runtime system for MoE inference that combines adaptive expert prefetching and cache-aware routing that reduces cache misses and removes latency caused by expert swap-ins and demonstrates its capability to optimize MoE inference under stringent memory constraints.

2510.26732.tldr: The findings challenge conventional scaling assumptions, establish training data quality as more critical than model size, and provide actionable guidelines for model selection across educational, production, and research contexts.

2510.26740.tldr: The General Incentives-based Framework for Fairness is introduced, a novel approach for fair multi-agent resource allocation that infers fair decision-making from standard value functions and is established as a robust and principled framework for leveraging standard reinforcement learning components to achieve more equitable outcomes in complex multi-agent systems.

2510.26771.tldr: STaMP quantization is proposed, a novel strategy that applies linear transformations along thesequence dimension to exploit the strong local correlation in language and visual data and maintain model accuracy at lower (average) activations bit-widths.

2510.25779.tldr: This work investigates two-sided agentic marketplaces where Assistant agents represent consumers and Service agents represent competing businesses, and reveals how behaviors emerge across market conditions, informing the design of fair and efficient agentic marketplaces.

2510.25960.tldr: A framework that uses acoustic side- channel analysis (ASCA) to monitor and verify whether a robot correctly executes its intended commands and demonstrate that acoustic signals can support real-time, low-cost, passive verification in sensitive robotic environments without requiring hardware modifications.

2510.26380.tldr: This study investigates how the AI Mathematician (AIM) system can operate as a research partner rather than a mere problem solver and demonstrates how systematic human-AI co-reasoning can advance the frontier of mathematical discovery.

2510.26787.tldr: The Remote Labor Index (RLI), a broadly multi-sector benchmark comprising real-world, economically valuable projects designed to evaluate end-to-end agent performance in practical settings, is introduced to ground discussions of AI automation in empirical evidence.

2510.26788.tldr: This work demonstrates that simply reverting to FP16 effectively eliminates the numerical mismatch between the training and inference policies, and suggests that using FP16 uniformly yields more stable optimization, faster convergence, and stronger performance across diverse tasks, algorithms and frameworks.

2510.26790.tldr: This work proposes Gistify, a task where a coding LLM must create a single, minimal, self-contained file that can reproduce a specific functionality of a codebase, while containing only the essential components necessary to execute the provided command.

2510.26802.tldr: The findings reveal that while current video models demonstrate promising reasoning patterns on short-horizon spatial coherence, fine-grained grounding, and locally consistent dynamics, they remain limited in long-horizon causal reasoning, strict geometric constraints, and abstract logic.

2306.09445.tldr: The extent to which existing value systems support the application of robotics from an AI agent cognitive modeling perspective is examined, including single-agent and multi-agent systems, trust among agents, and human-robot interaction.

2403.02901.tldr: This survey aims to provide a comprehensive overview of ATS from a ``Process-Oriented Schema''perspective, which is best aligned with real-world implementations; comprehensively review the latest LLM-based ATS works; and deliver an up-to-date survey of ATS, bridging the two year gap in the literature.

2403.15049.tldr: Experiments show that existing continual learning methods fall short for CVLN, while PerpR and ESR achieve better performance by efficiently utilizing replay memory.

2407.20183.tldr: MindSearch is introduced to mimic the human minds in web information seeking and integration, which can be instantiated by a simple yet effective LLM-based multi-agent framework, and demonstrates significant improvement in the response quality in terms of depth and breadth.

2408.03519.tldr: RepoMasterEval is a novel benchmark for evaluating code completion models constructed from real-world repositories and shows that test argumentation is critical in improving the accuracy of the benchmark and RepoMasterEval is able to report variance in model performance in real-world scenarios.

2409.16978.tldr: The exploration of the TDA design space reveals novel tasks for data-centric explanations useful to developers, such as grouping training samples behind specific model behaviours or identifying undersampled data, and invites the TDA, XAI, and HCI communities to engage with these tasks to strengthen their research's practical relevance and human impact.

2410.05102.tldr: It is argued that not all tokens should be weighted equally during PO and proposed a flexible objective, termed SparsePO, that aims to automatically learn to weight the KL divergence and reward corresponding to each token during PO training, and two different variants of weight-masks that can either be derived from the reference model itself or learned on the fly.

2410.23953.tldr: This study proposes the representative social choice framework for the modeling of democratic representation in collective decisions, where the number of issues and individuals are too large for mechanisms to consider all preferences directly.

2411.18612.tldr: The Robust Regularized Pessimistic Value Iteration (R2PVI) algorithm is developed, which employs linear function approximation for robust policy learning in RRMDPs withf-divergence based regularization terms on transition kernels, and focuses on offline reinforcement learning.

2412.13178.tldr: The first comprehensive benchmark for safety-aware task planning of embodied LLM agents in interactive simulation environments, covering both explicit and implicit hazards is presented, covering both explicit and implicit hazards.

2501.10484.tldr: It is found that ethical behavior varies across dilemma types: LLMs maintain consistent patterns in protective scenarios but respond with more diverse and cognitively demanding decisions in harmful ones, suggesting that complex inputs reveal deeper biases.

2502.01673.tldr: This work represents the first application of SSMs to question answering tasks in Indic languages, establishing a foundational benchmark for future research in this domain and proposing enhancements to existing SSM frameworks, optimizing their applicability to low-resource settings and multilingual scenarios prevalent in Indic languages.

2502.11664.tldr: Video Rotary Position Embedding (VRoPE) is proposed, a novel positional encoding method tailored for Video-LLMs that introduces a more balanced encoding strategy that mitigates attention biases, ensuring a more uniform distribution of spatial focus.

2502.17499.tldr: This study validated the on-device algorithm FeatureDB, which delivers physician-level parameter accuracy and commercial-grade abnormality detection via single-lead devices, supporting scalable telemedicine, decentralized cardiac screening, and continuous monitoring in community and outpatient settings.

2502.17543.tldr: Experimental results show that models fine-tuned with Paprika can effectively transfer their learned decision-making capabilities to entirely unseen tasks without additional training, suggesting a promising path towards AI systems that can autonomously solve novel sequential decision-making problems that require interactions with the external world.

2502.21041.tldr: This paper proposes Fast-LS-$l_0$ that incorporates soft labels and the trade-off loss function to smooth the adversarial loss landscape, and can overcome the challenge of catastrophic overfitting, achieve state-of-the-art performance, and narrow down the performance gap between $1-step and multi-step adversarial training against sparse attacks.

2503.00333.tldr: GAS(P) is developed, an evaluation methodology for surfacing distribution-level group representational biases in generated text, tackling the setting where groups are unprompted (i.e., groups are not specified in the input to generative systems).

2503.02854.tldr: The results demonstrate that transformer LMs, whether pre-trained or fine-tuned, can learn to implement efficient and interpretable state-tracking mechanisms, and the emergence of these mechanisms can be predicted and controlled.

2503.12989.tldr: This work proposes a multi-stage framework consisting of inference, retrieval, and reranking stages, which integrates taxonomy-guided reasoning examples to enhance performance by aligning outputs with taxonomic knowledge, and provides a cost-effective alternative to frontier models like GPT-4o.

2503.16532.tldr: This study showcases how integrating eye-tracking data, temporal dynamics, and personality traits can substantially enhance the detection of both perceived and felt emotions, and informs the design of future affective computing and human-agent systems, paving the way for more adaptive and cross-individual emotional intelligence in real-world interactions.

2503.16724.tldr: iTRACE is introduced, an automated framework that leverages pre-trained vision-language models (VLM) for semantic feature extraction and train a interpretable tree-based model via RL that outperforms other interpretable policy baselines and matches the performance of black-box policies on the same interpretable feature space.

2503.19223.tldr: Findings highlight MobileNetV2 balanced performance and robustness, making it the preferred choice for spoof detection applications where reliability on new data is essential, and suggests MobileNetV2 as a practical solution for real world deployment.

2503.22575.tldr: The results of studying the extent of implementation inconsistencies, their effect on the implementations' performance, as well as their impact on the conclusions of prior studies under the assumption of interchangeable implementations showed that they are not interchangeable.

2503.23875.tldr: GenSwarm is introduced, an end-to-end system that leverages large language models to automatically generate and deploy control policies for real-world multi-robot systems based on user instructions in natural language based on user instructions in natural language.

2504.03717.tldr: RanA is proposed, a unified PTQ framework that overcomes challenges by introducing two novel components: RaBitQ-H, a variant of a randomized vector quantization method RaBitQ, designed for fast, accurate, and highly efficient quantization; and AllocateBits, an algorithm that optimally allocates bit-widths across layers based on their quantization sensitivity.

2504.15827.tldr: Through extensive experiments, it is shown that DualOptim can significantly boost MU efficacy and stability across diverse tasks, including image classification, image generation, and large language models, making it a versatile approach to empower existing MU algorithms.

2504.16115.tldr: This initial investigation aims to lay the groundwork for future theoretical developments and practical advances in understanding and harnessing the potential of objective-driven dynamical stochastic fields.

2505.00254.tldr: AVA is introduced, a VLM-powered system designed for open-ended, advanced video analytics that incorporates two key innovations: the near real-time construction of Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs) for efficient indexing of long or continuous video streams, and an agentic retrieval-generation mechanism that leverages EKGs to handle complex and diverse queries.

2505.00455.tldr: The Data Therapist is presented, a web-based system that helps domain experts externalize implicit knowledge about data provenance, quality, and intended use through a mixed-initiative process combining iterative Q&A with interactive annotation.

2505.07985.tldr: Analysis of varying levels of anonymization across diverse privacy settings and data distributions provides critical insights into the trade-offs between privacy, fairness, and utility, offering actionable guidelines for responsible AI development.

2505.09591.tldr: This work shows for the first time the effectiveness and competitive edge of variational Bayes for selective prediction in VQA and proposes an extension called "Variational VQA", which improves calibration and yields significant gains for selective prediction on VQA and Visual Reasoning.

2505.14216.tldr: It is demonstrated that RLVR struggles to improve capability as it focuses on improving the accuracy of the easier questions to the detriment of the accuracy of the most difficult questions, and it is conjecture that capability improves only when new knowledge is introduced, whereas distilling reasoning patterns only improves accuracy but not capability.

2505.15270.tldr: This work rigorously proves that standard $\mu$P of mainstream diffusion Transformers, including U-ViT, DiT, PixArt-$\alpha$, and MMDiT, aligns with that of the vanilla Transformer, enabling the direct application of existing $\mu$P methodologies.

2505.16994.tldr: This work proposes R$^2$ec, a unified large recommender model with intrinsic reasoning capability that introduces a dual-head architecture that supports both reasoning chain generation and efficient item prediction in a single model, significantly reducing inference latency.

2505.18179.tldr: Analysis reveals that GAIA's hybrid objectives encourage learning of spatially coherent, object-centric features distributed across multiple principal components rather than concentrated representations focused on reconstruction, demonstrating that combining complementary self-supervised objectives yields more transferable representations for diverse atmospheric modeling tasks.

2505.18384.tldr: It is argued that assessments should take into account an expanded threat model in the context of cybersecurity, emphasizing the varying degrees of freedom that an adversary may possess in stateful and non-stateful environments within a fixed compute budget.

2505.19022.tldr: This paper proposes three novel evaluation methods for VAD evaluation methods, establishing probabilistic AUC/AP (Prob-AUC/AP) metrics utlizing multi-round annotations to mitigate single annotation bias and developing a Latency-aware Average Precision metric that rewards early and accurate anomaly detection.

2505.23724.tldr: Subspace-Constrained LoRA (SC-LoRA) is introduced, a novel LoRA initialization framework engineered to navigate the trade-off between efficient fine-tuning and knowledge preservation, and succeeds in delivering superior fine-tuning performance while markedly diminishing knowledge forgetting, surpassing contemporary LoRA initialization methods.

2505.24003.tldr: DMMV is proposed, a novel decomposition-based multi-modal view framework that leverages trend-seasonal decomposition and a novel backcast-residual based adaptive decomposition to integrate MMVs for LTSF.

2506.00081.tldr: A study on participants who have previously used chatbots and a scenario-based testing of large language model (LLM) chatbots indicate that AI chatbots were primarily utilized as a "Five minute therapist" or as a non-judgmental companion.

2506.00413.tldr: Adapt parallel decoding (APD) is introduced, a novel method that dynamically adjusts the number of tokens sampled in parallel by defining a multiplicative mixture between the dLLM marginal probabilities and the joint probability of sequences under a small auxiliary autoregressive model.

2506.03133.tldr: This work proposes PoLAR, a parameterization inspired by the polar decomposition that factorizes the low-rank update into two direction matrices constrained to Stiefel manifolds and an unconstrained scale matrix that yields an exponentially faster convergence rate on a canonical low-rank adaptation problem.

2506.09749.tldr: A novel LLM-based framework that integrates network topology and contextual domain knowledge to optimize the sequencing of Design Structure Matrix (DSM) and results show that incorporating contextual domain knowledge significantly improves performance despite the choice of LLMs.

2506.12667.tldr: This paper explains how s(CASP), a goal-directed constraint-based answer set programming reasoner that employs a small number of mechanisms to emulate reliable and explainable human-style commonsense reasoning, supports the 16 desiderata for trustworthy AI and two additional ones: inconsistency detection and the assumption of alternative worlds.

2506.14276.tldr: It is shown that fully committing to deep learning's capacity to acquire novel abstractions yields state-of-the-art performance on ARC, and the first to propose and show deep learning can be used effectively for ARC, showing boosts of up to 260% in accuracy with AIRV and a further 300% boost with TTFT.

2506.15725.tldr: The resulting model, which is called GrIDDD, dynamically grows or shrinks the chemical graph during generation and matches or exceeds the performance of existing graph diffusion models on molecular property targeting despite being trained on a more difficult problem.

2506.19500.tldr: NaviAgent is proposed, a novel bilevel architecture that decouples task planning from tool execution through graph-based modeling of the tool ecosystem, and incorporates feedback from real tool interactions, moving beyond tool calling toward adaptive navigation of large-scale tool ecosystems.

2507.02652.tldr: Experiments on four complex, cross-modal deep search benchmarks demonstrate that HiRA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art RAG and agent-based systems, highlighting the effectiveness of decoupled planning and execution for multi-step information seeking tasks.

2507.05538.tldr: There exists a significant gap between red teaming's original intent as a critical thinking exercise and its narrow focus on discovering model-level flaws in the context of generative AI, and a comprehensive framework operationalizing red teaming in AI systems at two levels is proposed.

2507.23607.tldr: This work proposes a novel deep learning-based method, implemented as a neural network model, that leverages pre-trained language models to capture the complexities and nuances of clinical documents, transforming them into expressive representations.

2508.00943.tldr: This work shows that both frontier models and small open-sourced models can covertly sandbag against CoT monitoring 0-shot without hints, but cannot yet do so reliably: they bypass the monitor 16-36% of the time when monitor-aware, conditioned on sandbagging successfully.

2508.04412.tldr: D2Snap is proposed, a first-of-its-kind DOM downsampling algorithm that embodies a strong UI feature for LLMs and its evaluation yields that DOM-inherent hierarchy embodies a strong UI feature for LLMs.

2508.06763.tldr: SafePLUG is a novel framework that empowers MLLMs with both Pixel-Level Understanding and temporal Grounding for comprehensive traffic accident analysis and lays a foundation for fine-grained understanding of complex traffic scenes, with the potential to improve driving safety and enhance situational awareness in smart transportation systems.

2508.08325.tldr: This work analyzes competition in multi-agent reinforcement learning, and shows that when consumers have high search costs, learning algorithms can coordinate on prices lower than competitive prices, facilitating a win-win-win for consumers, sellers, and platforms.

2509.15981.tldr: Smooth Policy Regularisation from Demonstrations (SPReD) is proposed, a framework that addresses the fundamental question: when should an agent imitate a demonstration versus follow its own policy?

2509.24046.tldr: Analysis of agent reasoning shows that planners are most responsive to domain-informed prompts, specialists produce complementary feature coverage, and supervisors play an important role in aggregation, highlighting PartnerMAS as a promising framework for high-dimensional decision-making in data-rich domains.

2509.24204.tldr: BALR-SAM is proposed, a boundary-aware low-rank adaptation framework that enhances SAM for medical imaging and outperforms several state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, including fully fine-tuned MedSAM, while updating just 1.8% of its parameters.

2509.24591.tldr: PoseDiff is a conditional diffusion model that unifies robot state estimation and control within a single framework that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and real-time performance for pose estimation on the DREAM dataset.

2510.02809.tldr: This paper proposes enhancing the threshold update step by replacing the binary evaluation (inside/outside) with a broader class of functions that quantify the relevance of the prediction interval using the ground truth, which helps prevent abrupt threshold changes, potentially resulting in narrower prediction intervals.

2510.03865.tldr: This work proposes RAPO (Rewards-Aware Policy Optimization), an algorithm to promote broader yet focused exploration and enables models to surpass the base model's performance ceiling and solves previously intractable problems, advancing the frontier of RLVR for challenging reasoning tasks.

2510.05589.tldr: TimePD is proposed, the first source-free time series forecasting framework with proxy denoising, where large language models are employed to benefit from their generalization capabilities, and outperforming SOTA baselines by 9.3% on average.

2510.05743.tldr: The historical development and current trends of artificially intelligent agents (agentic AI) in the social and behavioral sciences are reviewed: from the first programmable computers, and social simulations soon thereafter, to today's experiments with large language models.

2510.09045.tldr: This work proposes a novel zero-shot code translation method that incorporates identifier replacement, which allows the LLM to focus on the logical structure of the code, by reducing token count and memory usage, which improves the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of long code translation.

2510.09780.tldr: SVTime is introduced, a novel Small model inspired by large Vision model (LVM) forecasters for long-term Time series forecasting (LTSF) that outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) lightweight models and rivals large models with 10^3 fewer parameters than LVMs, while enabling efficient training and inference in low-resource settings.

2510.16857.tldr: This represents the first dataset bridging academic machine learning research and industrial CFD practice, establishing a new standard for data-driven aerodynamic optimization in automotive development and demonstrates a paradigm for integrating high-fidelity physics simulations with Artificial Intelligence across engineering disciplines where computational constraints currently limit innovation.

2510.16988.tldr: Contrastive Alignment for ADL Recognition from Event-Triggered Sensor Streams (CARE), an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes representation learning via Sequence-Image Contrastive Alignment (SICA) and classification via cross-entropy, ensuring both cross-representation alignment and task-specific discriminability.

2510.17426.tldr: This work demonstrates that simple model merging provides a computationally efficient method for mitigating the full scope of the alignment tax, yielding models that are more capable and more reliable.

2510.17496.tldr: I-RAVEN-X is introduced, a symbolic benchmark designed to evaluate generalization and robustness in analogical and mathematical reasoning for Large Language Models and Large Reasoning Models, and extends I-RAVEN by increasing operand complexity, attribute range, and introducing perceptual uncertainty.

2510.18477.tldr: LAFA is presented, the first system that integrates LLM-agent-based data analytics with FA, and establishes a practical foundation for privacy-preserving, LLM-driven analytics that supports natural language input in the FA setting.
