2510.18637.tldr: Empsilon-Seg, a method based on hierarchical variational autoencoders (HVAEs), employing center-region masking, sparse label contrastive learning (CL), a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) prior, and clustering-free label prediction is introduced.

2510.20621.tldr: By evaluating ethical measures during model generation, this framework establishes the theoretical foundations for developing AI systems that are not only accurate and interpretable but also fair, privacy-preserving, and causally aware, i.e., trustworthy.

2510.22450.tldr: SmartMixed is introduced, a two-phase training strategy that allows networks to learn optimal per-neuron activation functions while preserving computational efficiency at inference, and shows that neurons in different layers exhibit distinct preferences for activation functions.

2510.22733.tldr: A simple yet effective unified framework E2Rank, means Efficient Embedding-based Ranking (also means Embedding-to-Rank), which extends a single text embedding model to perform both high-quality retrieval and listwise reranking through continued training under a listwise ranking objective, thereby achieving strong effectiveness with remarkable efficiency.

2510.25140.tldr: DINO-YOLO establishes state-of-the-art performance for civil engineering datasets (<10K images) while preserving computational efficiency, providing practical solutions for construction safety monitoring and infrastructure inspection in data-constrained environments.

2510.25228.tldr: A Human-AI co-creation framework for effectively incorporating sound generation AI models into the sound art creation process is proposed and new possibilities for creating and archiving sound art that extend an artist's work beyond their physical existence are suggested.

2510.25935.tldr: In tests, the CodeSight system demonstrates high precision and F1 scores in predicting deadline compliance, illustrating the value of integrating process mining with machine learning for proactive software project management.

2510.26606.tldr: This paper systematically evaluates LLMs'reasoning capabilities in the normative domain from both logical and modal perspectives and introduces a new dataset covering a wide range of formal patterns of reasoning in both normative and epistemic domains, while also incorporating non-formal cognitive factors that influence human reasoning.

2510.26697.tldr: An emergent capability for instruction-based decoding control is uncovered: the model learns to interpret natural language commands and adjusts its predicted temperature and top-p on a token-by-token basis, opening a new paradigm for steerable and interactive LLM decoding.

2510.26776.tldr: This work proposes two advanced sampling techniques based on features and logits that select a small yet representative subset of the entire dataset by considering the stochastic distribution of features or logits, thereby enhancing the accuracy of IF estimations.

2510.26804.tldr: A Scientific Machine Learning approach using Universal Differential Equations (UDEs) to model sensory adaptation dynamics in autism and establishes foundations for personalized, evidence-based interventions in autism, with direct applications to wearable technology and clinical practice.

2510.26812.tldr: This protocol outlines methods to quantify the impact of CDSS on patient and healthcare delivery outcomes in LMICs by evaluating CDSS in World Bank-defined LMICs using published data.

2510.26818.tldr: GACA-DiT is proposed, a diffusion transformer-based framework with two novel modules for rhythmically consistent and temporally aligned music generation that outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both objective metrics and human evaluation.

2510.26819.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach that directly extracts information from the speech, addressing key challenges in speech-to-talking face, and is the first method capable of generating high-resolution, high-quality talking face videos exclusively from a single speech input.

2510.26823.tldr: Results show that Self-corpus validation often overestimates performance, with UAR exceeding cross-corpus evaluation by up to 13%, underscoring that cross-corpus evaluation offers a more realistic measure of model robustness.

2510.26824.tldr: A multi-modal toolbox that employs large language models (LLMs) and vision language models (VLMs) to automatically extract and organize synthesis procedures and performance data from materials science publications, covering text and figures is proposed.

2510.26833.tldr: The VISAT dataset and benchmarking framework contribute to the understanding of model robustness for traffic sign recognition, shedding light on the challenges posed by adversarial attacks and distribution shifts.

2510.26834.tldr: Despite the negative results in statistical testing, the presented DDPMs are capable of generating high-resolution 3D $T_1$-weighted brain images and are the first 3D non-latent diffusion model for brain data without skullstripping or registration.

2510.26835.tldr: A hybrid architecture separating in-memory HNSW search from external document storage is presented, reducing miss cost from 30ms to 2ms, making low-hit-rate categories economically viable and enabling cache coverage across the entire workload distribution.

2510.26841.tldr: This work introduces a differentially private fair FL algorithm (\textit{FedPF}) that transforms this multi-objective optimization into a zero-sum game where fairness and privacy constraints compete against model utility.

2510.26843.tldr: A novel Cascade Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding (CAS-Spec) method which constructs speculative draft models by leveraging dynamically switchable inference acceleration (DSIA) strategies, including layer sparsity and activation quantization is proposed.

2510.26847.tldr: CPT-Filtering is introduced, a novel, model-agnostic with negligible-costs and near-perfect accuracy guardrail technique that aims to mitigate large Language Models attacks by leveraging the intrinsic behavior of Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers.

2510.26865.tldr: MeasureBench is introduced, a benchmark on visual measurement reading covering both real-world and synthesized images of various types of measurements, along with an extensible pipeline for data synthesis, which highlights a fundamental limitation of current VLMs in fine-grained spatial grounding.

2510.26887.tldr: This work describes in detail Denario and its modules, and illustrates its capabilities by presenting multiple AI-generated papers generated by it in many different scientific disciplines such as astrophysics, biology, biophysics, biomedical informatics, chemistry, material science, mathematical physics, medicine, neuroscience and planetary science.

2510.26892.tldr: This work establishes the first theoretical proof, based on covariance matrix analysis, that Bayesian modeling enhances sample diversity in GANs, and positions BI-DCGAN as a scalable and timely solution for applications where both diversity and uncertainty are critical, and where modern alternatives like diffusion models remain too resource-intensive.

2510.26915.tldr: SPINE-HT, a framework that addresses limitations by grounding the reasoning abilities of LLMs in the context of a heterogeneous robot team through a three-stage process, achieves nearly twice the success rate compared to prior LLM-enabled heterogeneous teaming approaches.

2510.26923.tldr: Scale Adaptive Curriculum Learning (SACL), a novel training strategy that dynamically adjusts curriculum design based on available data scale, provides a practical solution for healthcare institutions to develop effective lung nodule detection systems despite limited annotation resources.

2510.26935.tldr: RepV is introduced, a neurosymbolic verifier that unifies both views by learning a latent space where safe and unsafe plans are linearly separable, and provides a probabilistic guarantee on the likelihood of correct verification based on its position in the latent space.

2510.26940.tldr: Fairness-Guided Incremental Sampling (FGIS), a group-aware sampling strategy designed for incremental data collection settings, and Size-Aware K-Means (SAKM), a clustering method that partitions users in latent mobility space while enforcing census-derived group proportions, are introduced.

2510.26941.tldr: A hybrid framework combining Machine Learning for multi-class attack detection with Large Language Models (LLMs) for attack behavior analysis and mitigation suggestion is proposed, showing that Random Forest has the best detection model, and ChatGPT03 outperformed DeepSeek-R1 in attack analysis and mitigation.

2510.26967.tldr: It is found that websites within the European Union, where privacy regulation enforcement is more stringent, and websites outside the EU are roughly 48.3% more likely to use aesthetic manipulation than non-EU websites, highlighting their innovative responses to privacy regulation.

2510.26969.tldr: A methodology for the identification of notifiable events in the domain of healthcare that harnesses semantic frames to define fine-grained patterns and search them in unstructured data, namely, open-text fields in e-medical records is introduced.

2510.26974.tldr: The MEDIQA-OE 2025 shared task is introduced, the first challenge on extracting medical orders from doctor-patient conversations and a broad range of approaches are experimented with, including both closed- and open-weight large language models (LLMs).

2510.26981.tldr: This work proposes a fine-grained control mechanism that selectively recomputes layer activations across both iteration-wise and layer-wise levels to fulfill the attainable attack efficacy within a constrained budget.

2510.26995.tldr: FermiEval is introduced, a benchmark of Fermi-style estimation questions with a rigorous scoring rule for confidence interval coverage and sharpness, and a perception-tunnel theory is developed explaining why LLMs exhibit overconfidence.

2510.26999.tldr: Simulated evaluations demonstrate the AIoT-Based Smart Education System's effectiveness in delivering robust real-time monitoring, fostering inclusive engagement, preventing fraudulent practices, and supporting operational scalability.

2510.27001.tldr: It is shown that variance-aware algorithms can offer advantages in settings with high uncertainty where the difficulty arises from subtle differences between arm rewards, and that classical algorithms often perform equally well or better in more separable scenarios or if fine-tuned extensively.

2510.27002.tldr: Jasmine is introduced, a performant JAX-based world modeling codebase that scales from single hosts to hundreds of accelerators with minimal code changes and guarantees fully reproducible training and supports diverse sharding configurations.

2510.27009.tldr: This work trains language models with bidirectional and causal self-attention mechanisms on both spatial (board-based) and sequential data, and shows that models trained on spatial board states consistently achieve stronger playing strength than models trained on sequential data.

2510.27033.tldr: A novel neuro_symbolic framework that integrates both panoramic-image and 3D point cloud information, combining neural perception with symbolic reasoning to explicitly model spatial and logical relationships is proposed.

2510.27037.tldr: The Elastic Language Model is introduced, a novel neural architecture search method optimized for compact language models that extends existing NAS approaches by introducing a flexible search space with efficient transformer blocks and dynamic modules for dimension and head number adjustment.

2510.27038.tldr: This study introduces the first Hausa sexism detection dataset, developed through community engagement, qualitative coding, and data augmentation, and reveals a tendency for many false positives in such cases.

2510.27051.tldr: This approach demonstrates how human-in-the-loop (HITL) feedback, when structured within a data flywheel, transforms enterprise AI agents into self-improving systems.

2510.27055.tldr: The method is simple, automated, and both model- and dataset-agnostic, making it easy to integrate with benchmark evaluations, and reveals strong evidence of memorization in open-weight models with undisclosed training corpora.

2510.27062.tldr: It is argued that some alignment problems are better viewed not in terms of optimal responses, but rather as consistency issues, and thinks that BCT can simplify training pipelines by removing reliance on static datasets.

2510.27063.tldr: This work reviews existing equivalence and similarity notions and introduces EMOC: An Evaluation-Memory-Operations-Complexity framework that embeds algorithm implementations into a feature space suitable for downstream tasks and shows that EMOC features support clustering and classification of algorithm types, detection of near-duplicates, and quantification of diversity in LLM-generated programs.

2510.27080.tldr: This work introduces a RAG-based framework designed to contextualize cybersecurity data and enhance LLM accuracy in knowledge retention and temporal reasoning, and highlights the promise of hybrid retrieval in strengthening the adaptability and reliability of LLMs for cybersecurity tasks.

2510.27091.tldr: This work establishes a principled framework for entangled multimodal fusion and paves the way for quantum-inspired approaches in modelling complex cross-modal correlations in modelling complex cross-modal correlations.

2510.27094.tldr: This work introduces agentic workflows that extract and analyze reference solutions and automatically derive problem-specific rubrics for a multi-step grading process, and instantiate and compare different design choices for the grading workflows, and evaluate their trade-offs.

2510.27128.tldr: This work introduces ZEBRA, the first zero-shot brain visual decoding framework that eliminates the need for subject-specific adaptation and represents a scalable and practical step toward universal neural decoding.

2510.27153.tldr: The testing results show that the adapted Lamb, ALTO, increases the test accuracy of the current state-of-the-art optimizer by an average of 2.5% across a variety of large-batch training tasks.

2510.27163.tldr: This work proposes a marginal risk assessment framework, that avoids dependence on ground truth or absolute risk, and emphasizes three kinds of relative evaluation methodology, including predictability, capability and interaction dominance.

2510.27164.tldr: A novel pipeline that integrates vision-language models, large language models (LLMs), and object detection systems to enhance caption quality is proposed and demonstrated that it produces more detailed and reliable image captions while effectively minimizing hallucinations.

2510.27172.tldr: This work proposes Bayesian Data Scheduler, an adaptive tuning-stage defense strategy with no need for attack simulation, and introduces a neural scheduler based on amortized Bayesian learning, enabling efficient transfer to new data without retraining.

2510.27186.tldr: A novel sparse model inversion strategy, as a plug-and-play extension to speed up existing dense inversion methods with no need for modifying their original loss functions, that selectively invert semantic foregrounds while stopping the inversion of noisy backgrounds and potential spurious correlations.

2510.27190.tldr: A mechanism-centered taxonomy of 41 recurring risk patterns in commercial LLMs is presented, showing that inputs are often interpreted non-neutrally and can trigger implementation-shaped responses or unintended state changes even without explicit commands.

2510.27194.tldr: This collective contribution classifies the state of the art and proposes a practical frame of reference for SoS lifecycle management, model-based systems engineering as the semantic backbone, product lifecycle management as the governance and configuration level, CAD-CAE as model-derived domains, and digital thread and digital twin as continuous feedback.

2510.27196.tldr: MemeArena is proposed, an agent-based arena-style evaluation framework that provides a context-aware and unbiased assessment for mLLMs'understanding of multimodal harmfulness and effectively reduces the evaluation biases of judge agents.

2510.27206.tldr: A fine-grained and instance-tailored steering framework that dynamically generates sample-level interference vectors from user data and injects them into the model's forward pass for personalized adaptation, demonstrating high flexibility and data efficiency.

2510.27207.tldr: FFCA is introduced, a novel framework that analyzes the geometry of a model's learned function and provides the essential geometric context that transforms model explanation from simple quantification to a nuanced, trustworthy analysis of the entire learning process.

2510.27208.tldr: A Hierarchical Graph Neural Network model that integrates multi-source data to conduct an in-depth analysis of villages spatial morphology is proposed that achieves significant performance improvements over existing approaches in multimodal fusion and classification tasks.

2510.27210.tldr: This framework employs specialized rewards, including a history-aware objective, directly linking summary quality to subsequent action performance, which validate the framework's ability to maintain robust reasoning and generalization across diverse GUI navigation tasks.

2510.27213.tldr: By incorporating a latent replay-based mechanism into CSSL, this method mitigates catastrophic forgetting due to domain shifts during continual pretraining while ensuring data privacy and introduces a feature distillation technique that integrates Wasserstein distance-based knowledge distillation and batch-knowledge ensemble, enhancing the ability of the model to learn meaningful, domain-shift-robust representations.

2510.27222.tldr: Soft Task-Aware Routing (STAR) is introduced, a routing strategy for projection heads that models them as experts that reduces redundant feature learning by observing lower canonical correlations between invariant and equivariant embeddings.

2510.27238.tldr: Drama, an end-to-end paradigm that answers users' analytic queries in natural language on large-scale open-domain data, and develops DramaBot, a multi-agent system that comprises a data retriever that collects and transforms data by coordinating the execution of sub-agents, and a data analyzer that performs structured reasoning over the retrieved data.

2510.27244.tldr: SarseAlign is introduced, a formal framework for assessing LaaJ alignment with sparse human-labeled data that combines a novel pairwise-confidence concept with a scoresensitive alignment metric that jointly capture ranking consistency and score proximity, enabling reliable evaluator selection even when traditional statistical methods are ineffective due to limited annotated examples.

2510.27247.tldr: The findings underscore the feasibility of biosignal-based sentence-level speech synthesis for reconstructing unseen sentences, highlighting a significant step toward developing open-vocabulary neural communication systems adapted to diverse patient needs and conditions.

2510.27253.tldr: This work presents Influence-Weighted Distillation IWD, a principled framework that leverages influence functions to explicitly account for data quality in the distillation process, and empirical results suggest that integrating IWD tends to improve the quality of distilled datasets and enhance model performance.

2510.27254.tldr: LLINK (Latent Language Injection for Non-English Knowledge), a compute efficient language-as-modality method that conditions an instruction-tuned decoder without changing the tokenizer or retraining the decoder, substantially improves bilingual retrieval and achieves 81.3% preference over the base model and 63.6% over direct fine-tuning in LLM-judged Q&A evaluations.

2510.27258.tldr: Higher-order Linear Attention (HLA), a causal, streaming mechanism that realizes higher interactions via compact prefix sufficient statistics, is introduced as a principled, scalable building block that combines attention-like, data-dependent mixing with the efficiency of modern recurrent architectures.

2510.27267.tldr: MedCalc-Eval is introduced, the largest benchmark for assessing LLMs'medical calculation abilities, comprising 700+ tasks across two types: equation-based (e.g., Cockcroft-Gault, BMI, BSA) and rule-based scoring systems (e.g., Apgar, Glasgow Coma Scale).

2510.27281.tldr: HiF-DTA is proposed, a hierarchical network that adopts a dual-pathway strategy to extract both global sequence semantic and local topological features from drug and protein sequences, and models drugs multi-scale to learn atomic, substructural, and molecular representations fused via a multiscale bilinear attention module.

2510.27287.tldr: EnterpriseBench is presented, a comprehensive benchmark that simulates enterprise settings, featuring 500 diverse tasks across software engineering, HR, finance, and administrative domains, and provides a novel data generation pipeline that creates internally consistent enterprise tasks from organizational metadata.

2510.27315.tldr: The Coronary Artery Segmentation and Refinement Network (CASR-Net), a three-stage pipeline comprising image preprocessing, segmentation, and refinement, offers a robust approach to automated coronary artery segmentation, offering a valuable tool to support clinicians in diagnosis and treatment planning.

2510.27324.tldr: This paper proposes to seamlessly integrate image generation with deep image compression, using joint text and coding latent to guide the rectified flow models for precise generation of the visual scene.

2510.27329.tldr: This work introduces a new compositional learning algorithm that leverages coupled RMs: Q-learning with coupled RMs (CoRM), and shows that CoRM scales better than state-of-the-art RM algorithms for long-horizon problems with unordered subtasks.

2510.27343.tldr: By learning interpretable discriminative rules over control-flow features, this work group traces with similar desirability profiles and apply process discovery separately within each group, resulting in focused and interpretable models that reveal the drivers of both desirable and undesirable executions.

2510.27353.tldr: A detailed analysis of the heuristics produced by Large Language Models, examining both their behavior and interpretability, and proposes a new class of algorithms tailored to these specific bin packing instances, suggesting that the considered instances are themselves relatively simple.

2510.27363.tldr: This work introduces ToolScope, an agentic framework designed to unify global planning with local multimodal perception, adopting a specialized Perceive tool to mitigates visual context degradation in long-horizon VQA task.

2510.27364.tldr: Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using FVD, CLIP-SIM, and LPIPS metrics, supported by a small expert user study, demonstrate measurable improvements in cinematic fidelity and temporal stability over the base model.

2510.27379.tldr: A comprehensive analysis of SNN design models, training algorithms, and multi-dimensional performance metrics, including accuracy, energy consumption, latency, spike count, and convergence behavior concludes that SNNs are poised to propel the next phase of neuromorphic computing.

2510.27383.tldr: This work demonstrates that multi-agent RL with human constraints is a promising modelling approach for simulating realistic road user interactions and accounts for individual differences by modelling parameters controlling the human constraints as population-level distributions.

2510.27400.tldr: This work proposes IntAttn-Edit, a method that extends the associative memory paradigm to jointly update both MLP and Attn modules, and uses a knowledge balancing strategy that allocates update magnitudes in proportion to each module's measured contribution to knowledge storage.

2510.27403.tldr: A novel Federated Muon optimizer (FedMuon), which incorporates two key techniques: momentum aggregation, where clients use the aggregated momentum for local initialization and local-global alignment, where the local gradients are aligned with the global update direction to significantly reduce client drift.

2510.27413.tldr: Atat-Alignment is introduced, a framework that avoids this cost of explainable AI and mechanistic interpretability by aligning the latent space of a new model to a pre-existing, labeled Concept Atlas using only shared inputs and lightweight representational alignment methods.

2510.27419.tldr: Experimental results on challenging mathematical benchmarks show that DeepCompress consistently outperforms baseline methods, achieving superior accuracy while significantly improving token efficiency.

2510.27421.tldr: This analysis reveals an intrinsic age-related bias against younger patients that continues to persist even after controlling for confounding factors, and hypothesizes that this bias may be linked to physiological factors, a known challenge for both radiologists and automated systems.

2510.27428.tldr: This work introduces SoftAE, an uncertainty-aware active exploration framework that autonomously learns task-agnostic and generalizable dynamics models of soft robotic systems, and demonstrates that uncertainty-driven active exploration can yield scalable, reusable dynamics models across diverse soft robotic morphologies.

2510.27432.tldr: This paper introduces Text Correlation Preservation Learning, which preserves the semantic relationships encoded by the foundation model across text queries, and proposes Cross-Branch Video Alignment (CBVA), a contrastive alignment method that disentangles hierarchical video representations across temporal scales.

2510.27442.tldr: Qualitative Grad-CAM analyses show that CoMViT consistently attends to clinically relevant regions despite its compact size, highlighting the potential of principled ViT redesign for developing efficient and interpretable models in low-resource medical imaging settings.

2510.27448.tldr: GeoFM is proposed, a novel method for synthesizing geometric data that uses formal languages to explore combinations of conditions within metric space, generating high-fidelity geometric problems that differ from the originals while ensuring correctness through a symbolic engine.

2510.27462.tldr: VCORE is introduced, a principled framework that reformulates CoT supervision as a constrained optimization problem that enables a principled and adaptive allocation of supervision across tokens, thereby aligning the training objective more closely with the goal of robust reasoning generalization.

2510.27484.tldr: It is found that hints that causally affect the output without being explicitly mentioned exert a subtle and cumulative influence on the CoT that persists even if the hint is removed.

2510.27497.tldr: InertialAR devises a canonical tokenization that aligns molecules to their inertial frames and reorders atoms to ensure SE(3) and permutation invariance, and significantly outperforms strong baselines in controllable generation for targeted chemical functionality.

2510.27504.tldr: A new CL-DPFL algorithm, DP-FedPGN, is proposed, in which a global gradient norm penalty to the local loss to find the global flat minimum of models, and uses R\'enyi DP to provide strict privacy guarantees and provide sensitivity analysis for local updates.

2510.27508.tldr: This study proposes vMambaX, a lightweight multimodal framework integrating PET and CT scan images through a Context-Gated Cross-Modal Perception Module (CGM) that adaptively enhances inter-modality feature interaction, emphasizing informative regions while suppressing noise.

2510.27522.tldr: The results suggest that generalist time series foundation models, even when pretrained on data of non-neural origin or on synthetic signals, can transfer effectively to EEG, suggesting that EEG may benefit from advances in the broader time series literature.

2510.27527.tldr: TetraJet-v2 is introduced, an end-to-end 4-bit FQT method that leverages NVFP4 for activations, weights, and gradients in all linear layers and identifies two critical issues hindering low-precision LLM training: weight oscillation and outliers.

2510.27543.tldr: DialectalArabicMMLU is presented, a new benchmark for evaluating the performance of large language models (LLMs) across Arabic dialects and provides the first unified, human-curated resource for measuring dialectal understanding in Arabic, thus promoting more inclusive evaluation and future model development.

2510.27544.tldr: TempoBench is introduced, the first formally grounded and verifiable diagnostic benchmark that parametrizes difficulty to systematically analyze how LLMs perform reasoning and shows that state-of-the-art LLMs clearly understand the TCE task but perform poorly as system complexity increases.

2510.27545.tldr: A new energy-based architecture, EBT-Policy, that solves core issues in robotic and real-world settings and exhibits emergent capabilities not seen in prior models, such as zero-shot recovery from failed action sequences using only behavior cloning and without explicit retry training.

2510.27554.tldr: This work argues that reputation propagation resists Sybil attacks by making spam services with many low-reputation payers rank below legitimate services with few high-reputation payers, and builds a search method for x402 enabled services that avoids infrastructure bias and has better performance than purely volume based or semantic methods.

2510.27558.tldr: This paper presents a framework that leverages pre-trained foundation models for robotic manipulation without domain-specific training, combining multimodal perception from foundation models with a general-purpose reasoning model capable of robust task sequencing.

2510.27565.tldr: A multi-language benchmark that evaluates LLM instruction-following capabilities and is extensible to operate on any set of standalone coding problems and reveals that models exhibit differing levels of performance across multiple dimensions of instruction-following.

2510.27568.tldr: SIGMA (Search-Augmented On-Demand Knowledge Integration for AGentic Mathematical reAsoning), a unified framework that orchestrates specialized agents to independently reason, perform targeted searches, and synthesize findings through a moderator mechanism, is introduced.

2510.27571.tldr: This analysis reveals that popular benchmarks are poor predictors of general ability and that partially relevant retrieval is a dominant but overlooked scenario and provides a practical path to escape the limited scope and advance toward truly universal video retrieval.

2510.27617.tldr: VeriMoA is proposed, a training-free mixture-of-agents (MoA) framework with two synergistic innovations that exploit LLM fluency in high-resource languages while promoting solution diversity and enabling smaller models to match larger models and fine-tuned alternatives without requiring costly training.

2510.27628.tldr: This work considers other definitions of Agentic AI and proposes a new realist definition, which is a software delivery mechanism, comparable to software as a service (SaaS), which puts an application to work autonomously in a complex enterprise setting.

2510.27632.tldr: This work introduces an innovative approach exploiting user-provided sketches as intuitive constraints and demonstrates empirically the effectiveness of this new guidance method, establishing the sketch-to-layout problem as a promising research direction, which is currently under-explored.

2510.27646.tldr: VessShape is introduced, a methodology for generating large-scale 2D synthetic datasets designed to instill a shape bias in segmentation models, indicating that pre-training with a strong shape bias can be an effective strategy to overcome data scarcity and improve model generalization in blood vessel segmentation.

2510.27651.tldr: A novel layer-wise training approach based on the recently developed deterministic information bottleneck (DIB) and the matrix-based R\'enyi's $\alpha$-order entropy functional that not only outperforms existing layer-wise training baselines but also achieves performance comparable to SGD.

2510.27655.tldr: Modules of Influence is proposed, a framework that constructs a model explanation graph from per-instance attributions, applies community detection to find feature modules that jointly affect predictions, and quantifies how these modules relate to bias, redundancy, and causality patterns.

2510.27659.tldr: This report provides a conceptual and empirical review of the interplay between openness and the credit assignment problem (CAP), and presents an empirical study using representative temporal and structural algorithms in an open environment.

2510.27671.tldr: MolChord is proposed, which integrates two key techniques to align protein and molecule structures with their textual descriptions and sequential representations, and to guide molecules toward desired properties by integrating preference data and refine the alignment process using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).

2510.27688.tldr: Experiments show that CALM significantly improves the performance-compute trade-off, achieving the performance of strong discrete baselines at a significantly lower computational cost, and establish next-vector prediction as a powerful and scalable pathway towards ultra-efficient language models.

2212.10712.tldr: This work proposes two algorithms that choose exploratory actions based on a survey of nearby states based on a survey of nearby states, and finds that one of these methods consistently outperforms the Double DQN baseline in an discrete environment by 49% in terms of Eval Reward Return.

2301.12935.tldr: This work constructs an error-robust Adams solver (ERA-Solver), which utilizes the implicit Adams numerical method that consists of a predictor and a corrector that can be directly applied to any pretrained diffusion models, without extra training.

2303.13773.tldr: GNNs are not only able to learn feasibility and optimality for instances of the ONTS problem, but they can generalize to harder instances than those seen during training, and improved the expected objective value of the best solution found under the time limit.

2310.04566.tldr: This work proposes an approach that equips domestic robots to perform simple tidying tasks via knolling, the practice of arranging scattered items into neat, space-efficient layouts and treats knolling as a sequential prediction problem and employs a transformer based model to forecast each object's placement.

2310.04687.tldr: It is shown that by carefully selecting the target, targeted attacks significantly outperform untargeted attacks in poisoning diffusion models and degrading the customization image quality.

2402.09034.tldr: SST applies mathematical squaring to amplify differences between strong and weak activations as signals propagate over time, facilitating improved gradient flow and information filtering and demonstrates that SST models consistently outperform RNN-based models with baseline activations, exhibiting improved test accuracy.

2404.14757.tldr: A new time series decomposition strategy that separates time series into long-range patterns and short-range variations is introduced, and it is shown that Mamba excels at capturing long-term structures, while Transformer is more effective at modeling short-term dynamics.

2405.03869.tldr: A bridge is established between identifying detrimental training samples via influence functions and outlier gradient detection and this transformation not only presents a straightforward and Hessian-free formulation but also provides insights into the role of the gradient in sample impact.

2406.03848.tldr: OceanCastNet is presented, a machine learning approach for wave forecasting that incorporates wind and wave fields to predict significant wave height, mean wave period, and mean wave direction and suggests that machine learning approaches can achieve performance comparable to conventional wave forecasting systems for operational wave prediction applications.

2407.11041.tldr: The design of a hardware accelerator for Transformers is presented, optimized for on-device time-series forecasting in AIoT systems, which achieved precision comparable to 8-bit quantized models from related research.

2407.11511.tldr: It is found that multi-step reasoning approaches have progressed beyond math word problems, and can now successfully solve challenges in logic, combinatorial games, and robotics, sometimes by first generating code that is then executed by external tools.

2407.12543.tldr: This work introduces abstraction alignment, a methodology to compare model behavior against formal human knowledge and measures the alignment of a model’s behavior by determining how much of its uncertainty is accounted for by the human abstractions.

2407.20299.tldr: This work proposes using data distillation to train and distill a better dataset which can then be used for training a better policy model, and shows that the method is able to synthesize a dataset where a model trained on it achieves similar performance to a model trained on the full dataset or a model trained using percentile behavioral cloning.

2410.02611.tldr: Surprisingly, while almost all multilingual models demonstrate consistent encoding performance for English, they show mixed results for Indic languages, and universal models broadly exhibit better robustness compared to Indic-specific models, particularly under perturbations.

2410.07129.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs outperform traditional methods, particularly on noisy and small datasets where training examples vary significantly in text length and genre, but psycholinguistic features and encoder-based models can achieve performance comparable to language models when trained on texts from individuals with clinically confirmed depression.

2410.08478.tldr: FedVLR, a federated VLR framework specially designed for user-specific personalized fusion of vision-language representations, is introduced, a novel bi-level fusion mechanism that provides an efficient solution to implement a federated VLR system.

2410.10584.tldr: STACKFEED is introduced, a novel Structured Textual Actor-Critic Knowledge base editing with FEEDback approach that iteratively refines the KB based on expert feedback using a multi-actor, centralized critic reinforcement learning framework.

2410.13918.tldr: HKT-SmartAudit is introduced, a framework for developing lightweight models optimized for smart contract auditing that features a multi-stage knowledge distillation pipeline that integrates classical distillation, external domain knowledge, and reward-guided learning to transfer high-quality insights from large teacher models.

2410.15413.tldr: This work confirms and broadens previous findings suggesting the presence of cognitive biases in LLMs by reporting evidence of all 30 tested biases in at least some of the 20 LLMs.

2411.03343.tldr: Interventions derived from non-linear probes produce larger and more reliable effects than those from linear probes, indicating that features linked to jailbreak success are encoded non-linearly in prompt representations.

2411.10231.tldr: TaylorIR is proposed, a plug-and-play framework that enforces 1x1 patch embeddings for true pixel-wise reasoning and replaces conventional self-attention with TaylorShift, a Taylor-series-based attention mechanism enabling full token interactions with near-linear complexity.

2411.16813.tldr: Results show that Reddit-finetuned models generate safer but rhetorically rigid arguments, while cross-platform fine-tuning amplifies adversarial tone and toxicity.

2501.06164.tldr: A method that bidirectionally transfers neural activity between artificial neural networks and uses their resulting behavior as a measure of functional similarity to encourage the use of causal methods in neural similarity analyses and to suggest future explorations of network similarity methodology for model misalignment.

2501.06577.tldr: Survey Transfer Learning, which develops transfer learning paradigms from computer science for survey research to recycle existing survey data and generate empirically grounded silicon responses, outperforms LLMs, especially on sensitive measures such as racial resentment.

2502.03304.tldr: Divergence-driven Zeroth-Order (DiZO) optimization is proposed, a novel layer-wise divergence analysis that uncovers the distinct update pattern of FO and ZO optimization and demonstrates that DiZO significantly reduces the needed iterations for convergence without sacrificing throughput.

2502.03656.tldr: It is shown that a distilled dataset can train SR models that retain nearly the same reconstruction fidelity as those trained on full datasets, and foundational insights for memory- and compute-efficient generative restoration models are established.

2502.11559.tldr: FaIRMaker is an automated and model-independent framework that employs an auto-search and refinement paradigm to adaptively generate Fairwords, which act as instructions integrated into input queries to reduce gender bias and enhance response quality.

2502.14068.tldr: This paper proposes RaceGAN, a baseline model based on a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) that effectively addresses challenges in track detection and demonstrates superior performance compared to current state-of-the-art machine learning models in track detection.

2502.15855.tldr: THFlow is a novel flow matching-based multimodal generative model that explicitly models the temporal hierarchy between peptide position and conformation, and employs a polynomial-based conditional flow to accelerate positional convergence early on, and later aligns it with rotation and torsion for coordinated conformation refinement under the emerging interaction field.

2502.16411.tldr: Whether AI-based diagnostic tools can be used to enhance not only performance but also learning in the context of lung cancer diagnosis is explored, revealing AI's dual role: As a tool, it could rapidly improve novices' performance.

2502.20432.tldr: An evaluation framework grounded in behavioral game theory is introduced, disentangling reasoning capability from contextual effects in large language models, finding that GPT-o3-mini, GPT-o1, and DeepSeek-R1 dominate most games yet also demonstrate that the model scale alone does not determine performance.

2503.01422.tldr: Self-Truncation Best-of-N (ST-BoN), a decoding method that avoids fully generating all N samples and eliminates the need for reward models, and achieves the same performance as Full-BoN while saving computational cost by 70%-80%, and under the same cost, it can improve accuracy by 3-4 points.

2503.05777.tldr: The underperformance of medical-specialized models despite domain training indicates that safety emerges from sophisticated reasoning capabilities and broad knowledge integration developed during large-scale pre-training, not from narrow optimization.

2503.09658.tldr: This work develops a general framework to model user strategic behaviors and their interactions with decision-making systems under resource constraints and competitive dynamics and proposes two methods—Fair-top-k and Dynamic Continual Learning (DCL)—which significantly reduce recourse cost and improve model robustness.

2504.00509.tldr: Surprisingly, existing cutting-edge LLMs unanimously exhibits extremely severe recitation behavior; by changing one phrase in the condition, top models such as OpenAI-o1 and DeepSeek-R1 can suffer 60 percent performance loss on elementary school-level arithmetic and reasoning problems.

2504.07170.tldr: This position paper takes the position that current research practices of improving one or two aspects in isolation are insufficient and research on Trustworthy AI must account for interactions between aspects and adopt a holistic view across all relevant axes at once.

2504.16795.tldr: H Hierarchical Sparse Attention (HSA) is proposed, a novel attention mechanism that enhances RNNs with long-range random access flexibility while preserving their merits in efficiency and length generalization, and RAMba is introduced, which achieves perfect accuracy in passkey retrieval across 64 million contexts despite pre-training on only 4K-length contexts.

2504.20047.tldr: The HumanCentric Tables Question-Answering extensive benchmark (HCTQA), consisting of thousands of HCTs with several thousands of natural language questions with their respective answers, stands out for its broad complexity and diversity of covered HCTs and generated questions, its comprehensive metadata enabling deeper insight and analysis, and its novel synthetic data and QA generator.

2504.21344.tldr: By incorporating semantic features into the vision-language model, the approach surpasses the SOTA models in predicting lung cancer from CT scans collected from diverse clinical settings and provides explainable outputs, aiding clinicians in comprehending the underlying meaning of model predictions.

2505.13544.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that MTLA achieves competitive performance compared to standard Multi-Head Attention (MHA), while greatly improving inference speed and GPU memory usage, while maintaining translation quality.

2505.17050.tldr: PBLBench is introduced, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate complex reasoning grounded in domain-specific knowledge and long-context understanding, thereby challenging models with tasks that closely resemble those handled by human experts.

2505.18829.tldr: The results suggest that contextualizing computer environments for language models represents a promising direction for developing more capable computer-use agents and advancing toward AI that can interact with digital systems.

2505.18901.tldr: PromptWise is introduced, an online learning framework that assigns prompts to generative models in a cost-aware manner and can achieve performance comparable to baseline selection methods while incurring substantially lower costs.

2505.21189.tldr: It is shown that frozen LLMs can generate hundreds of accurate tokens in just one token-parallel forward pass, when provided with only two learned embeddings, revealing a surprising and underexplored multi-token generation capability of autoregressive LLMs.

2505.21478.tldr: This work trains an ensemble of reward models capable of predicting image quality scores directly from prompt-workflow combinations, eliminating the need for costly image generation during training and incorporates a classifier-free guidance based enhancement technique that extrapolates along the path between the initial and GRPO-tuned models, further improving output quality.

2505.23118.tldr: A two-stage post-training pipeline that elicits and then enhances multimodal reasoning for medical domains, and demonstrates the efficacy and reliability of \textit{MedE$^2$} in improving the reasoning performance of medical multimodal models.

2505.23945.tldr: This work introduces a novel, fine-grained evaluation pipeline for categorizing bias articulation patterns, enabling significantly more precise analysis of CoT reasoning than previous methods and reveals critical distinctions in how models process and respond to different types of biases.

2506.02269.tldr: It is shown that the parameter symmetries of the unconstrained model has nontrivial effects on the loss landscape of the equivariant subspace and under certain conditions can provably prevent learning of the global minima.

2506.06632.tldr: Drawing inspiration from curriculum learning, this work proposes to schedule tasks from easy to hard (E2H), allowing LLMs to build reasoning skills gradually, and establishes convergence guarantees for E2H Reasoner within an approximate policy iteration framework.

2506.07801.tldr: This work introduces MultiMatch, a novel semi-supervised learning algorithm combining the paradigms of co-training and consistency regularization with pseudo-labeling, which achieves state-of-the-art results on 8 out of 10 setups from 5 natural language processing datasets and ranks first according to the Friedman test among 21 methods.

2506.10821.tldr: VideoExplorer is proposed, a framework grounded in the principle of ``thinking with video'', which naturally intertwines planning, temporal grounding, and scalable perception into a coherent reasoning process, enabling faithful, efficient, and interpretable reasoning.

2506.10978.tldr: This work provides the first head-level analysis of attention perturbation in diffusion models, uncovering interpretable specialization within attention layers and enabling practical design of effective perturbation strategies.

2506.14196.tldr: A temporal mapping of how caregivers' mental wellbeing evolves across three distinct stages of the caregiving journey is developed, offering a foundation for designing dynamic, stage-sensitive interventions that holistically support caregivers' mental wellbeing.

2506.15507.tldr: This work formalizes the spatiotemporal over-squashing problem and demonstrates its distinct characteristics compared to the static case, and reveals that, counterintuitively, convolutional STGNNs favor information propagation from points temporally distant rather than close in time.

2506.17336.tldr: This work sends a generic, non-private user query to a powerful, untrusted LLM, which generates a Chain-of-Thought prompt and detailed sub-queries without accessing user data, demonstrating a first step toward systems where tasks are decomposed and split between untrusted strong LLMs and weak local ones, preserving user privacy.

2506.17784.tldr: This work proposes a new framework that rethinks multi-agent coordination through a sequential structure rather than a graph structure, offering a significantly larger topology space for multi-agent communication.

2507.04221.tldr: Installing Context Tuning initializes the trainable prompt or prefix with task-specific demonstration examples, leveraging the model's inherent In-Context Learning (ICL) ability to extract relevant information for improved few-shot learning performance.

2507.05297.tldr: It is proved that any optimal, independent, and zero unanimous fuzzy classification aggregation function of a continuum of individual classifications of individual classifications of m3 objects into m types must be a weighted arithmetic mean.

2507.05362.tldr: A controlled setting based on shortest-path tasks in layered graphs is introduced, and it is found that generalization correlates with the model's confidence in next-token prediction, suggesting that long, coherent, and locally incremental traces make the training signal easier to optimize.

2507.08619.tldr: Improved inter-agent communication strategies and advanced reasoning LLMs—such as OpenAI’s o1 or DeepSeek’s R1—may help enhance design coherency and underscore the challenges of handling large, evolving design contexts within current LLM architectures.

2507.09846.tldr: A refined variant of SF is proposed that improves robustness to momentum and performs better under large batch sizes, addressing key limitations of the original method and establishing SF as a practical, scalable, and theoretically grounded approach for language model training.

2507.10057.tldr: This work proposes Chain of Retrieval (COR), a novel iterative framework for full-paper retrieval that decomposes each query paper into multiple aspect-specific views, matches them against segmented candidate papers, and iteratively expands the search by promoting top-ranked results as new queries, thereby forming a tree-structured retrieval process.

2507.10449.tldr: CoralVQA is introduced, the first large-scale VQA dataset for coral reef analysis, and several state-of-the-art LVLMs are evaluated, revealing key limitations and opportunities that form a foundation for future LVLM development.

2507.12508.tldr: MindJourney is proposed, a test-time scaling framework that grants a VLM with this missing capability by coupling it to a controllable world model based on video diffusion, and improves upon the test-time inference VLMs trained through reinforcement learning, which demonstrates the potential of the method that utilizes world models for test-time scaling.

2507.19109.tldr: Pareto-NRPA strongly outperforms state-of-the-art evolutionary multi-objective algorithms on constrained search spaces and constitutes the first adaptation of NRPA to the multi-objective setting.

2507.20900.tldr: Through its standardized evaluation protocol, transparent data access policies, and music-specific features, Music Arena not only addresses key challenges in the TTM ecosystem but also demonstrates how live evaluation can be thoughtfully adapted to unique characteristics of specific AI domains.

2508.04925.tldr: This work develops a novel taxonomy comprising seven attention-specific fault categories, not captured by existing work, and identifies four evidence-based diagnostic heuristics that explain 33.0% of attention-specific faults, offering the first systematic diagnostic guidance for attention-based models.

2508.09780.tldr: A new shape-matching methodology, combinative matching, to combine interlocking parts for geometric shape assembly that significantly reduces local ambiguities in matching and allows a robust combination of parts in assembly.

2508.12815.tldr: This paper investigates a fine-grained steering that uses an input-specific linear shift and demonstrates that it reduces hallucinations and enforces safety in MLLMs, outperforming other static baselines.

2508.14314.tldr: Finch-Zk is presented, a black-box framework that leverages fine-grained cross-model consistency to detect and mitigate hallucinations in LLM outputs without requiring external knowledge sources and provides a practical, deployment-ready safeguard for enhancing factual reliability in production LLM systems.

2509.00285.tldr: OdinioRAG is introduced, a scalable, training-free framework that combines RAG-based evidence retrieval with LLMs to efficiently produce tailored summaries and novel reference-free verification metrics designed for sentiment-rich domains, where accurately capturing opinions and sentiment alignment is essential.

2509.01206.tldr: A novel self-supervised framework for monocular depth estimation in diverse endoscopy with outperforms state-of-the-art works on SCARED dataset and SimCol dataset and achieves the best generalization based on zero-shot depth estimation on C3VD, Hamlyn and SERV-CT dataset.

2509.03636.tldr: This work introduces CausalARC: an experimental testbed for AI reasoning in low-data and out-of-distribution regimes, modeled after the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus, formally expressed as a structural causal model.

2509.11252.tldr: The first empirical study of diffusion LLMs for code generation is presented, which explores factors impacting the effectiveness and efficiency of diffusion LLMs, and discusses several promising further directions to improve diffusion LLMs on code generation.

2509.11575.tldr: This survey defines the problem and organizes the literature by reasoning topology with three families: direct reasoning in one step, linear chain reasoning with explicit intermediates, and branch-structured reasoning that explores, revises, and aggregates.

2509.11940.tldr: It is argued that dynamical systems theory provides a principled language for modeling inference, learning, and control in both natural and artificial substrates, and can be harnessed as a resource for learning, while differential genetic programming enables the discovery of dynamical systems that implement adaptive behaviors.

2509.12235.tldr: The findings re-identify the roles of SFT and RL in the two-stage fine-tuning and discover the rotation of singular vectors as the key mechanism.

2509.13927.tldr: DSpAST is presented, a novel audio encoder based on SpatialAST that learns disentangled representations of spatial audio while having only 0.2% additional parameters, and significantly outperforms SpatialAST.

2509.14622.tldr: This work introduces ADRAG (Adversarial Distilled Retrieval-Augmented Guard), a two-stage framework for robust and efficient online malicious intent detection that achieves 98.5% of WildGuard-7B's performance, and surpasses GPT-4 by 3.3% and Llama-Guard-3-8B by 9.5% on out-of-distribution detection.

2509.16093.tldr: DeCE is a decomposed LLM evaluation framework that separates precision (factual accuracy and relevance) and recall (coverage of required concepts), using instance-specific criteria automatically extracted from gold answer requirements, requiring no predefined taxonomies or handcrafted rubrics.

2509.16527.tldr: This work proposes the Lattice Boltzmann Model (LBM), a model that decomposes visual representations into dynamic pixel lattices and solves pixel motion states through collision-streaming processes, which can efficiently adapt to real-world visual tracking tasks.

2509.18714.tldr: A generalized bisimulation metric (GBSM) is formally established between pairs of MDPs, which is rigorously proven with the three fundamental properties: GBSM symmetry, inter-MDP triangle inequality, and the distance bound on identical state spaces.

2509.20354.tldr: EmbeddingGemma, a new lightweight, open text embedding model based on the Gemma 3 language model family, outperforms prior top models, both proprietary and open, with fewer than 500M parameters, and provides performance comparable to models double its size, offering an exceptional performance-to-cost ratio.

2509.21278.tldr: ComplexCompo is introduced, a training-free framework for Seamless, High-fidelity Insertion with Neutralized Errors, featuring diverse resolutions and challenging conditions such as low lighting, strong illumination, intricate shadows, and reflective surfaces, to address the lack of rigorous benchmarks.

2509.21972.tldr: This review presents a systematic review of 70 empirical studies across computer science, education, and psychology and proposes an LLM-Risk Adapted Learning Model that illustrates how technical risks cascade through interaction and interpretation to shape educational outcomes.

2509.23488.tldr: benchmark signatures are sets of salient tokens from in-the-wild corpora whose model token perplexity, reflecting training exposure, predicts benchmark performance, suggesting that LLM semantic organization may differ from human conceptual structure.

2510.00192.tldr: PrunedLoRA is proposed, a new framework that leverages structured pruning to obtain highly representative low-rank adapters from an over-parameterized initialization and provably shows that under the impact of weight perturbation, gradient-based pruning is more robust than activation-based pruning with respect to overall loss.

2510.01258.tldr: This study employs a zero-shot classification approach to evaluate algorithmic political partisanship through a methodical combination of ideological alignment, topicality, response sentiment, and objectivity.

2510.05702.tldr: It is found that firm size and valuation consistently increase model confidence, while risk factors tend to decrease it, and this highlights representation bias in Qwen models and motivate sector-aware calibration and category-conditioned evaluation protocols for safe and fair financial LLM deployment.

2510.10142.tldr: This paper conducts a systematic investigation LLM unfairness and proposes DiffHeads, a lightweight debiasing framework for LLMs that identifies bias heads through differential activation analysis between DA and CoT, and selectively masks only those heads.

2510.10613.tldr: The proposed method first uses a large language model to obtain contextual embeddings of text and then introduces a temporal decay function and an attention mechanism, which allows the model to adjust the importance of semantic units according to time intervals and capture topic variations across different periods.

2510.12872.tldr: KVCOMM, a training-free framework that enables efficient prefilling in multi-agent inference by reusing KV-caches and aligning cache offsets of overlapping contexts under diverse prefix contexts, achieves over 70% reuse rate across diverse multi-agent workloads, including retrieval-augmented generation, math reasoning, and collaborative coding tasks, all without quality degradation.

2510.13939.tldr: Mediation analysis shows fine-tuning eliminates detectable AI quirks that penalize in-context outputs, altering the nexus between detectability and preference, providing evidence relevant to copyright's fourth fair-use factor.

2510.15259.tldr: KG-Agent is proposed, an experience-driven learning framework that structures an agent's raw pixel-level interactions into a persistent State-Action Knowledge Graph (SA-KG), and designs a hybrid intrinsic reward mechanism based on the graph topology, allowing the agent to effectively value setup actions with delayed gratification.

2510.19755.tldr: This paper systematically reviews the theoretical foundations and evolution of Diffusion Caching and proposes a unified framework for its classification and analysis, showing that Diffusion Caching evolves from static reuse to dynamic prediction, which enhances caching flexibility across diverse tasks.

2510.22405.tldr: This work proposes a novel augmentation-based approach to incorporate external knowledge in the replay-based continual learning framework and demonstrates that augmentation helps outperform baseline replay-based approaches.

2510.22765.tldr: This work introduces Jarvis, an innovative framework for a personalized AI assistant through personal KV-Cache retrieval, which stores user-specific information in the KV-Caches of both textual and visual tokens, and introduces a fine-grained benchmark built with the same distinct image patch mining pipeline.

2510.24028.tldr: This work proposes OneCast, a structured and modular forecasting framework that decomposes time series into seasonal and trend components, each modeled through tailored generative pathways, and demonstrates that OneCast mostly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2510.24284.tldr: MCP-Flow is introduced, an automated web-agent-driven pipeline for large-scale server discovery, data synthesis, and model training that provides a scalable foundation for advancing LLM agents' proficiency in real-world MCP environments.

2510.24770.tldr: A novel deep learning fiber clustering framework, namely Deep Multi-view Fiber Clustering (DMVFC), which uses joint multi-modal dMRI and fMRI data to enable functionally consistent WM parcellation and demonstrates superior performance in achieving functionally meaningful and consistent WM parcellation results.

2510.24831.tldr: The Narrative Continuity Test (NCT) is introduced -- a conceptual framework for evaluating identity persistence and diachronic coherence in AI systems and outlines conceptual requirements for future benchmarks and architectural designs that could sustain long-term identity and goal coherence in generative models.

2511.00004.tldr: Results show that selected augmentations improve classification performance, particularly for underrepresented classes, while multi-view learning introduces potential but requires further refinement.

2511.00011.tldr: An interactive model based on motion capture data that generates an artificial other by partially mimicking and also"creatively"enhancing an incoming sequence of movement data, the first model, which leverages single-person motion data and high level features in order to do so and, thus, it does not rely on low level human-human interaction data.

2511.00015.tldr: Small gadgets couple adjacent cages that share an element and enforce that a strip swap that removes exactly two adjacencies corresponds bijectively to a block move that removes exactly one decreasing adjacency in the source permutation yields a clean equivalence between exact SbSS schedules and perfect block schedules.

2511.00020.tldr: A robust multimodal fake review detection framework is proposed, integrating textual features encoded with BERT and visual features extracted using ResNet-50 and outperforms unimodal baselines, and offers a scalable solution for content moderation across various online platforms.

2511.00021.tldr: A novel machine-learning-based coral bleaching classification system based on a diverse global dataset with samples of healthy and bleached corals under varying environmental conditions, including deep seas, marshes, and coastal zones is presented.

2511.00024.tldr: A novel decision-support framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to assess corporate climate disclosure quality at scale is proposed, developing a master rubric that harmonizes narrative scoring across 11 years of CDP data (2010-2020), enabling cross-sector and cross-country benchmarking.

2511.00028.tldr: This work considers patches attached to scenes that exhibit high mutual information under natural perturbations, such as color changes and motion, as positive samples for learning with contrastive loss and considers the proposed mutual-information-informed data augmentation method as a promising direction for future research.

2511.00029.tldr: This work concludes that targeted SAE steering can overcome traditional safety-utility tradeoffs when optimal features are identified through principled selection methods and achieves an 18.9% improvement in safety performance while simultaneously increasing utility by 11.1%, demonstrating that targeted SAE steering can overcome traditional safety-utility tradeoffs.

2511.00030.tldr: To probe where unlearned models reveal knowledge holes, this work proposes a test case generation framework that explores both immediate neighbors of unlearned content and broader areas of potential failures, and demonstrates significant hidden costs of unlearning.

2511.00033.tldr: STRIDER (Instruction-Aligned Structural Decision Space Optimization), a novel framework that systematically optimizes the agent's decision space by integrating spatial layout priors and dynamic task feedback, is proposed.

2511.00039.tldr: A systematic empirical study of multi-agent reinforcement learning for retail price optimization suggests that graph-integrated MARL provides a more scalable and stable solution than independent learners for dynamic retail pricing, offering practical advantages in multi-product decision-making.

2511.00041.tldr: BiBo is a platform for empowering off-the-shelf Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as GPT-4, to control humanoid agents, thereby leveraging their strong open-world generalization to mitigate the need for extensive data collection.

2511.00047.tldr: DynBERG, a novel architecture that integrates Graph-BERT with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) layer to capture temporal evolution over multiple time steps, is introduced, demonstrating superior performance, outperforming EvolveGCN before the market shutdown and surpassing GCN after the event.

2511.00049.tldr: A novel self-supervised learning framework that leverages spatio-temporal structures to improve multi-variable weather prediction and provides a scalable and label-efficient solution for future data-driven weather forecasting systems.

2511.00050.tldr: FLoRA, a family of fused forward-backward adapters (FFBA) for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of LLMs on downstream tasks is proposed and Experimental results show that the proposed FFB adapters perform significantly better than the popularly used LoRA in both accuracy and latency for a similar parameter budget.

2511.00053.tldr: A novel quadratic-form weighted training objective is proposed, which trains the forecast model using the adaptively updated quadratic-form weighting matrix, and shows that the QDF effectively improves performance of various forecast models, achieving state-of-the-art results.

2511.00054.tldr: SpatialTraceGen is introduced, a framework to distill the reasoning processes of a large teacher model into a high-quality dataset of multi-hop, multi-tool reasoning traces, providing the structured, step-by-step examples of tool use necessary for effective fine-tuning and sample-efficient offline reinforcement learning.

2511.00059.tldr: An automated approach based on decision trees to identify and interpret MLP neurons that encode rule-based game logic, serving as a resource for researchers to test whether their interpretability methods recover meaningful computational structures.

2511.00070.tldr: It is concluded that specialized BO frameworks remain the performance leader for guaranteed convergence, but fine-tuned LLMs are validated as a promising, computationally fast alternative, contributing essential comparative metrics to the field of AI-driven optimization.

2511.00072.tldr: In the authors' experiments, it was observed that across multiple annotators and categories, CLIP outperformed alternative models by a small relative margin of 3--7\% in mean opinion scores, establishing CLIP as the most reliable backbone for production deployment.

2511.00078.tldr: RailEstate, a novel web-based system that integrates spatial analytics, natural language interfaces, and interactive forecasting to analyze how proximity to metro stations influences residential property prices in the Washington metropolitan area, is presented.

2511.00083.tldr: A novel model, called fixed-point iterative graph convolutional network (Fix-GCN), which achieves robustness against adversarial perturbations by effectively capturing higher-order node neighborhood information in the graph without additional memory or computational complexity.

2511.00084.tldr: A human-inspired model was developed to serve as a benchmark, allowing comparison between machine learning algorithms and the approach typically employed by pen and paper RPG publishers, and a specialized evaluation procedure was designed to assess model performance and facilitate meaningful comparisons.

2511.00085.tldr: MaGNet is introduced, a novel Mamba dual-hyperGraph Network for stock prediction that outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both superior predictive performance and exceptional investment returns with robust risk management capabilities.

2511.00086.tldr: Agent-REINFORCE is proposed, an LLM-agent-augmented framework that mirrors the REINFORCE pipeline by mapping sampling-gradient-update to sampling-feedback-update, where feedback serves as a textual gradient to update the probabilistic graph and efficiently search for optimal multi-LLM collaboration graphs.

2511.00092.tldr: This study introduces QuantumBench, a benchmark for the quantum domain that systematically examine how well LLMs understand and can be applied to this non-intuitive field, and is intended to guide the effective use of LLMs in quantum research.

2511.00095.tldr: The SpinalSAM-R1 is a multimodal vision-language interactive system that integrates a fine-tuned SAM with DeepSeek-R1, for spine CT image segmentation and introduces an anatomy-guided attention mechanism to improve spine segmentation performance, and a semantics-driven interaction protocol powered by DeepSeek-R1, enabling natural language-guided refinement.

2511.00097.tldr: This paper proposes Graph Domain-Incremental Learning via Knowledge Dientanglement and Preservation (GraphKeeper), to address catastrophic forgetting in Domain-IL scenario from the perspectives of embedding shifts and decision boundary deviations, and introduces deviation-free knowledge preservation to continuously fit incremental domains.

2511.00099.tldr: The proposed conditional-labeled generative adversarial network enables both unsupervised damage detection and generation of damage state measurements, providing a powerful tool for vibration-based system-level monitoring and scalable infrastructure resilience.

2511.00101.tldr: Loquetier is presented, a virtualized multi-LoRA framework that seamlessly integrates LoRA fine-tuning and serving within a single runtime and introduces two key components: a Virtualized Module that isolates PEFT-based modifications and supports multiple adapters on a shared base model and an optimized computation flow that merges fine-tuning and inference paths in forward propagation.

2511.00102.tldr: The proposed hybrid framework to automate the discovery of conserved quantities from noisy trajectory data demonstrates the robustness of a decoupled learn-then-search approach for discovering mathematical principles from imperfect data.

2511.00103.tldr: This work introduces FreeSliders, a simple yet effective approach that is fully training-free and modality-agnostic, achieved by partially estimating the CS formula during inference, and extends the CS benchmark to include both video and audio, establishing the first suite for fine-grained concept generation control with multiple modalities.

2511.00106.tldr: It is demonstrated how studying the rhetorics of ChatGPT prompt writing on social media can promote critical AI literacies and highlight takeaways for digital writing teachers and researchers who are teaching and analyzing critical AI literacies.

2511.00107.tldr: MOVAI (Multimodal Original Video AI), a novel hierarchical framework that integrates compositional scene understanding with temporal aware diffusion models for high fidelity text to video synthesis, shows particular strength in generating complex multi-object scenes with realistic temporal dynamics and fine-grained semantic control.

2511.00110.tldr: It is found that using Chain-of-Time simulation substantially improves the performance of a state-of-the-art image generation model, and highlights particular cases where the image generation model struggles to infer particular physical parameters from input images, despite being capable of simulating relevant physical processes.

2511.00112.tldr: The Real-DRL framework for safety-critical autonomous systems is introduced, enabling runtime learning of a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agent to develop safe and high-performance action policies in real plants, while prioritizing safety!

2511.00114.tldr: This work presents the first end-to-end framework that integrates generative AI and DRL to enable autonomous and reproducible cardiac US scanning, and delivers AI-driven guidance through expert-validated models that classify image type and assess quality, supports conditional generation of realistic US images, and establishes a reproducible foundation extendable to other organs.

2511.00116.tldr: This work presents LC-Opt, a Sustainable Liquid Cooling (LC) benchmark environment, for reinforcement learning (RL) control strategies in energy-efficient liquid cooling of high-performance computing (HPC) systems, and benchmarks centralized and decentralized multi-agent RL approaches.

2511.00117.tldr: DCcluster-Opt is an open-source, high-fidelity simulation benchmark for sustainable, geo-temporal task scheduling, enabling rigorous and reproducible research in sustainable computing and accelerating the development and validation of next-generation sustainable computing solutions for geo-distributed data centers.

2511.00120.tldr: VLM6D, a novel dual-stream architecture that leverages the distinct strengths of visual and geometric data from RGB-D input for robust and precise pose estimation, is presented.

2511.00122.tldr: This work demonstrates that agentic-AI-enabled AI engineers has the potential to perform complex engineering tasks autonomously, and achieves a 100% success rate across over 400 parametric configurations, with zero mesh generation failures, solver convergence issues, or manual interventions required.

2511.00124.tldr: This framework bridges discrete Markov chain theory, phase analysis, and modern generative modeling and finds that detecting these transitions directly boosts sampling efficiency, accelerates class-conditional and rare-class generation, and improves two zero-shot tasks--image classification and style transfer--without expensive grid search or retraining.

2511.00125.tldr: This work investigates the use of Large Language Models to automatically infer missing helper assertions in Dafny programs, with a primary focus on cases involving multiple missing assertions.

2511.00126.tldr: A dynamic multi-expert gating framework that adaptively selects the most reliable trajectory predictor among a physics-informed LSTM, a Transformer, and a fine-tuned GameFormer on a per-sample basis, indicating that adaptive hybrid systems enhance trajectory reliability in safety-critical autonomous driving.

2511.00136.tldr: HeraldLight is proposed, a dual LLMs architecture enhanced by Herald guided prompts that outperforms state of the art baselines, achieving a 20.03% reduction in average travel time across all scenarios and a 10.74% reduction in average queue length on the Jinan and Hangzhou scenarios.

2511.00160.tldr: It is demonstrated, using metrics such as test coverage and change comparisons, that contexts containing diffs can significantly improve performance against out of the box LLMs and, in some cases, perform better than using code.

2511.00176.tldr: Insight is contributed into the practical capability and inherent interpretability of LLM-driven temporal user profiling, outlining new research directions for developing adaptive and transparent recommender systems.

2511.00191.tldr: The recent constant modality gap phenomenon is extended to learnable prompts and then, the superiority of vision-language transfer with multi-prompt augmentation with multi-prompt augmentation is justified, empirically and theoretically.

2511.00192.tldr: This paper proposes the ``EL-MIA''framework for auditing entity-level membership risks in LLMs, and constructs a benchmark dataset for the evaluation of MIA methods on this task, revealing that existing MIA methods are limited when it comes to entity-level membership inference of the sensitive attributes.

2511.00197.tldr: An empirical study of agent trajectories, namely the execution traces capturing the steps agents take when attempting to resolve software issues, concludes that failed trajectories are consistently longer and exhibit higher variance than successful ones, with failure patterns differing significantly between agents.

2511.00206.tldr: It is concluded that LLMs can serve as tools for a more integrative and cumulative cognitive science when used judiciously to complement, rather than replace, human expertise.

2511.00211.tldr: An efficient transfer learning method that can enable a ground component to locally detect representative weather-related conditions and shows superior performance compared to the typical deep learning methods, such as YOLOv7, YOLOv9, Faster R-CNN, and R-YOLO.

2511.00218.tldr: DM-QPMNet is introduced, a dual-encoder network that treats these as distinct modalities with separate encoding streams that fuses modality-specific features at intermediate depth via multi-head attention, enabling polarized edge and texture representations to selectively integrate complementary phase information.

2511.00222.tldr: This work introduces a unified framework for evaluating and improving persona consistency in LLM-generated dialogue, and applies multi-turn reinforcement learning to fine-tune LLMs for three user roles: a patient, a student, and a social chat partner.

2511.00267.tldr: An update on how ongoing and new challenges have successfully contributed to AI research and applications of AI technologies is provided.
