2507.02554.tldr: This work formalizes AI research agents as search policies that navigate a space of candidate solutions, iteratively modifying them using operators, and shows that their interplay is critical for achieving high performance on MLE-bench.

2507.06850.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive evaluation of the LLMs security used as reasoning engines within autonomous agents, highlighting how they can be exploited as attack vectors capable of achieving computer takeovers.

2507.09378.tldr: CARMANIA (Context-Aware Regularization with Markovian Integration for Attention-Based Nucleotide Analysis), a self-supervised pretraining framework that augments next-token (NT) prediction with a transition-matrix (TM) loss, enables CARMANIA to learn organism-specific sequence structures that reflect both evolutionary constraints and functional organization.

2507.10584.tldr: ARPaCCino is an agentic system that combines Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented-Generation (RAG), and tool-based validation to automate the generation and verification of PaC rules, highlighting the potential of agentic RAG architectures to enhance the automation, reliability, and accessibility of PaC workflows.

2507.13370.tldr: The hierarchical, non-intrusive opinion guidance framework, H-NeiFi, is proposed, which establishes a two-layer dynamic model based on social roles, considering the behavioral characteristics of both experts and non-experts and introduces a non-intrusive neighbor filtering method that adaptively controls user communication channels.

2508.01670.tldr: QCBench, a Quantitative Chemistry oriented benchmark comprising 350 computational chemistry problems across 7 chemistry subfields, enables fine-grained diagnosis of computational weaknesses, reveals model-specific limitations across difficulty levels, and lays the groundwork for future improvements such as domain-adaptive fine-tuning or multimodal integration.

2508.02191.tldr: This work proposes a tripartite brain-inspired architecture comprising functionally specialized perceptual, auxiliary, and executive systems that establishes a theoretical foundation for brain-like intelligence across cognitive domains, potentially bridging the gap between artificial and biological intelligence.

2508.06534.tldr: A key feature of MetAdv is its human-in-the-loop capability: besides flexible environmental configuration for more customized evaluation, it enables real-time capture of physiological signals and behavioral feedback from drivers, offering new insights into human-machine trust under adversarial conditions.

2508.11708.tldr: Findings reveal variations in perceptions of inclusivity and accessibility across demographic groups, demonstrating that incorporating diverse user feedback can enhance machine learning models through careful data-labeling and co-production strategies.

2508.19999.tldr: This paper introduces an algorithm to select demonstration examples for in-context learning of a query set by estimating model outputs through a first-order approximation using the gradients, and shows that the gradient estimation procedure yields approximations of full inference with less than 1 error across six datasets.

2508.21666.tldr: It is suggested that integrating IoT and Generative AI into atmospherically adaptive learning technologies holds significant promise for enhancing educational engagement and fostering climate awareness.

2509.03771.tldr: This work proposes a paradigm for generating a boundless and adaptive curriculum of challenges by framing the environment generation process as an adversarial game, and suggests that adversarial co-evolution is a powerful mechanism for automatically scaling environmental complexity, driving agents towards greater robustness and strategic depth.

2509.04633.tldr: A meta-learning approach where a Large Language Model automates the generative design and optimization of experimental protocols, thereby scaling the process of environment and curriculum design and outline a multi-modal evaluation strategy that moves beyond task performance to directly measure the physical correlates of the learned world model.

2509.04731.tldr: It is argued that HTEs provide a mechanism to guide exploration, generate meaningful learning signals, and train agents to internalize hierarchical structure, enabling the development of more capable and general-purpose agents with greater sample efficiency than purely end-to-end approaches.

2509.12143.tldr: A unified pipeline that utilizes Vision Transformers (ViTs) for extracting 3D region embeddings from sMRI data and Graph Neural Network (GNN) for classification is developed that consistently outperformed the cube-based approach, highlighting the importance of using domain-specific anatomical priors for MDD detection.

2509.15207.tldr: This work transforms scalar rewards into a normalized target distribution using a learnable partition function, and then minimize the reverse KL divergence between the policy and the target distribution to promote diverse exploration and generalizable reasoning trajectories.

2509.15591.tldr: The promise of LZN is demonstrated in three increasingly complex scenarios: improving FID and achieving SoTA classification accuracy on CIFAR10, and implementing unsupervised representation learning without auxiliary loss functions.

2509.18467.tldr: LAWCAT (Linear Attention with Convolution Across Time), a novel linearization framework designed to efficiently transfer the capabilities of pre-trained transformers into a performant linear attention architecture, providing an efficient pathway to high-performance, long-context linear models suitable for edge deployment.

2509.18608.tldr: This work presents an end-to-end learning-based navigation system that maps raw 3D LiDAR data directly to control commands using a deep reinforcement learning policy trained entirely in simulation, enabling efficient policy learning without relying on labeled datasets or manually designed control interfaces.

2509.20635.tldr: This work introduces a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that leverages terrain-specialized policies and curriculum learning to enhance agility and tracking performance in complex environments, demonstrating superior adaptability and robustness across mixed-terrain scenarios.

2509.22751.tldr: VB-Score is introduced, a variance-bounded evaluation framework for entity-centric AI systems that operates without ground truth by jointly measuring effectiveness and robustness, offering a principled measurement framework for assessing AI system reliability in label-scarce domains.

2509.25263.tldr: This work proposes RainfallBench, a benchmark designed for precipitation nowcasting, a highly challenging and practically relevant task characterized by zero inflation, temporal decay, and non-stationarity, and introduces Bi-Focus Precipitation Forecaster (BFPF), a plug-and-play module that incorporates domain-specific priors to enhance rainfall time series forecasting.

2510.04276.tldr: Two basis-expansion tools for scalable causal discovery are introduced and it is shown that, when integrated into hybrid searches, BF-based methods enable interpretable and scalable causal discovery.

2510.04983.tldr: AWARE, a framework that systematically attempts to improve a transformer model's awareness for this nuanced task of identifying cultural capital themes in student reflections, provides a robust and generalizable methodology for any text classification task in which meaning depends on the context of the narrative.

2510.05862.tldr: A fine-grained analysis of the context noise is conducted and an effective metric, the Integrated Gradient (IG) score, is proposed, to detect and quantify the noise information within the context.

2510.06002.tldr: A formal Primitive API designed as a secure execution layer for reasoning over temporal knowledge graphs that model the complex evolution of legal norms, providing a blueprint for building the next generation of trustworthy legal AI.

2510.06915.tldr: Long-RewardBench is introduced, a benchmark specifically designed for long-context RM evaluation, featuring both Pairwise Comparison and Best-of-N tasks, and a general multi-stage training strategy that effectively scales arbitrary models into robust Long-context RMs (LongRMs).

2510.09801.tldr: This paper proposes PULSE, a framework for more efficient human-centric evaluation of agent designs, which comprises collecting user feedback, training an ML model to predict user satisfaction, and computing results by combining human satisfaction ratings with model-generated pseudo-labels.

2510.10642.tldr: UniCoD is introduced, which acquires the ability to dynamically model high-dimensional visual features through pretraining on over 1M internet-scale instructional manipulation videos, and is fine-tuned on data collected from the robot embodiment, enabling the learning of mappings from predictive representations to action tokens.

2510.12740.tldr: Applying DGRC, it is found that LMs prefer to continue dialogue on at-issue content, with this effect enhanced in instruct-tuned models, and reduce their at-issue preference when relevant cues are present.

2510.15748.tldr: This work proposes the first Parkinson's assessment system that formulates multimodal learning as a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem, which not only allows for more flexible modality requirements during both training and inference, but also handles modality collapse issue during multimodal information fusion.

2510.23104.tldr: It is demonstrated that hierarchical structures can improve the clarity of medical summaries generated by models while maintaining content coverage, providing a practical way to improve human preference for generated summaries.

2510.23241.tldr: The findings reveal that the proposed curriculum sampling is not tied to a specific architecture but represents a broadly applicable strategy that consistently boosts performance across diverse segmentation models, including UNet, UNETR, and SwinUNETR.

2510.24450.tldr: A concise overview of recent developments in LLM benchmarking is given, and a new taxonomy for the categorization of benchmarks that is tailored to multilingual or non-English use scenarios is proposed that could lead to a more coordinated development of benchmarks for European languages.

2510.24701.tldr: Tongyi DeepResearch is developed through an end-to-end training framework that combines agentic mid-training and agentic post-training, enabling scalable reasoning and information seeking across complex tasks, and design a highly scalable data synthesis pipeline that is fully automatic.

2510.25123.tldr: A data-driven dimensionality reduction method that is well-suited for physics-based data representing hyperbolic wave propagation using a specialized neural network architecture called low rank neural representation (LRNR) inside a hypernetwork framework is presented.

2510.25223.tldr: FELA (Feature Engineering LLM Agents), a multi-agent evolutionary system that autonomously extracts meaningful and high-performing features from complex industrial event log data, and introduces an agentic evolution algorithm, combining reinforcement learning and genetic algorithm principles to balance exploration and exploitation across the idea space.

2510.25557.tldr: To the authors' knowledge, this is the first model (RNN or otherwise) grounded in quantum operations to achieve competitive performance against strong classical baselines across a broad class of sequence-learning tasks.

2510.26205.tldr: GlobalQA is introduced -- the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate global RAG capabilities, covering four core task types: counting, extremum queries, sorting, and top-k extraction, and it is found that existing RAG methods perform poorly on global tasks.

2510.27181.tldr: A Dual-level Progressive Hardness-aware Reweighting (DPHR) strategy that exploits a training-progress signal to attenuate noisy gradients during early optimization and progressively enhance hard-negative mining as training matures is presented.

2511.00032.tldr: Skip-Block Routing (SBR), a general framework designed for Transformer-based neural operators, capable of being integrated into their multi-layer architectures, that reduces computational cost by approximately 50% in terms of Floating Point Operations (FLOPs), while still delivering up to 2x faster inference without sacrificing accuracy.

2511.00055.tldr: This paper investigates the practical implementation and effectiveness of FL in a real-world scenario, specifically focusing on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based thermal images for common thermal feature detection in urban environments, and compares several FL approaches with a centralized learning baseline across key performance metrics.

2511.00162.tldr: This paper introduces ARC-GEN, an open-source procedural generator aimed at extending the original ARC-AGI training dataset as faithfully as possible, and discusses the use of this generator in establishing a static benchmark suite to verify the correctness of programs submitted to the 2025 Google Code Golf Championship.

2511.00881.tldr: Conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models showed strong potential for generating clinically meaningful vitreous OCT images while reducing acquisition time fourfold and showed promise for clinical integration, supporting faster, higher-quality vitreous imaging.

2511.00960.tldr: The reasoning and self-assessment abilities of LLMs across seven major Indian languages-Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Tamil, and Telugu, are examined, pointing to clear gaps in multilingual reasoning.

2511.00985.tldr: This work introduces ORANGE, an online self-evolutionary framework that constructs database-specific knowledge bases by parsing SQL queries from translation logs and proposes a novel nested Chain-of-Thought SQL-to-Text strategy with tuple-semantic tracking, which reduces semantic errors during knowledge generation.

2511.01139.tldr: A symmetry category is introduced that jointly represents cyclic time shifts, positive gain scalings, and the sensor-hierarchy poset, capturing the categorical symmetry structure of the data, which achieves equivariance with respect to the categorical symmetry product.

2511.01183.tldr: This paper introduces NeuComBack, a novel benchmark dataset specifically designed for IR-to-assembly compilation and proposes a self-evolving prompt optimization method that enables LLMs to iteratively evolve their internal prompt strategies by extracting insights from prior self-debugging traces, thereby enhancing their neural compilation capabilities.

2511.01805.tldr: This paper explores how accumulating context by engaging in interactions and processing text -- talking and reading -- can change the beliefs of language models, as manifested in their responses and behaviors, and examines models'behavioral changes by designing tasks that require tool use, where each tool selection corresponds to an implicit belief.

2511.01831.tldr: This work introduces a routing-based architecture that integrates new capabilities while robustly preserving foundational knowledge, and observes that token-level routing facilitates cross-modal transfer, leveraging knowledge from one modality to bolster performance in another.

2511.01866.tldr: This work presents EdgeReasoning, a comprehensive study characterizing the deployment of reasoning LLMs on edge GPUs, and maps the Pareto frontier of achievable accuracy-latency configurations, offering systematic guidance for optimal edge deployment of reasoning LLMs.

2511.01867.tldr: DiffPace is introduced, a diffusion-based plug-and-play method for channel estimation that achieves competitive CE performance, attaining -15 dB normalized mean square error at a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of 10 dB, with 90% fewer inference steps compared to state-of-the-art schemes.

2511.01894.tldr: LGCC achieves 3x -- 5x speedup for lightweight editing and 2x for universal editing, requiring only 40% -- 50% of the inference time of BAGEL or Flux, offering a cost-efficient solution without compromising editing quality.

2511.01902.tldr: This pre-clinical playbook provides actionable guidance for development teams, accelerates the path to clinical evaluation, and establishes a shared vocabulary bridging AI researchers, healthcare practitioners, and regulatory stakeholders.

2511.01906.tldr: The findings suggest that reflective, instructor-facing use of LLMs can enhance pedagogical design in theoretically dense domains and may be adaptable to other cognitively demanding computer science courses.

2511.01907.tldr: An analysis identifies two axes of communication (referential domain and expression approach) and shows LLMs struggle with semantic drift, myths, and polysemy in clinical interactions.

2511.01911.tldr: This work proposes a mesh-free learning framework designed for high-dimensional mapping problems, seamlessly combining variational principles with quasi-conformal theory, ensuring accurate, bijective mappings by regulating conformality distortion and volume distortion, enabling robust control over deformation quality.

2511.01914.tldr: iFlyBot-VLA is introduced, a large-scale Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model trained under a novel framework that jointly supervises both the Vision-Language Model (VLM) and the action expert during training, enabling the VLM to directly contribute to action generation.

2511.01921.tldr: A novel fine-grained approach to the Incremental Network Quantization (INQ) strategy is proposed to compensate for the losses introduced by the above mentioned quantization techniques and two novel lossless compression algorithms are introduced.

2511.01924.tldr: Neural Green's Function, a neural solution operator for linear partial differential equations (PDEs) whose differential operators admit eigendecompositions, is introduced, a neural solution operator for linear PDEs whose differential operators admit eigendecompositions inspired by Green's functions.

2511.01927.tldr: This work proposes DeepContour, a novel hybrid framework that integrates a deep learning-based spectral predictor with Kernel Density Estimation for principled contour design and pioneers an efficient and robust paradigm for tackling difficult generalized eigenvalue involving matrices of high dimension.

2511.01929.tldr: This work proposes a novel trajectory generation framework based on a diffusion model, which integrates the dynamic population distribution constraints to guide high-fidelity generation outcomes and designs a dynamic population distribution aware denoising network to capture the spatiotemporal dependencies of human mobility behavior.

2511.01932.tldr: FineXL can provide natural language descriptions about each distinct aspect of personalization, along with quantitative scores indicating the level of each aspect of personalization, for personalized image generation models.

2511.01941.tldr: This work proposes two approaches: (1) combining ML and LLMs with Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to detect vulnerability-indicating issues of 21 Eclipse IoT projects and (2) fine-tuning a pre-trained BERT Masked Language Model (MLM) on 11,000 GitHub issues for classifying vulnerability-indicating issues.

2511.01947.tldr: A strategically weighted ensemble model that combines tree-based methods (LightGBM, XGBoost) with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to predict CVD risk is developed, delivering a combination of robust predictive performance and clinical transparency.

2511.01952.tldr: This work proposes the first black-box MIA framework for LVLMs, based on a prior knowledge-calibrated memory probing mechanism, to assess the model memorization of the private semantic information embedded within the suspected image data, which is unlikely to be inferred from general world knowledge alone.

2511.01956.tldr: The limitations of current AI systems - especially those rooted in LLM technology - are identified and it is argued that the fundamental causes of these weaknesses cannot be resolved through existing methods, and directions within the constructivist paradigm for transforming education are proposed to preserve the long-term advantages of human intelligence over AI tools.

2511.01999.tldr: TRACE shows that training VLMs to generate a textual CoR is an effective and robust strategy for enhancing the precision, reliability, and interpretability of VLM-based robot control.

2511.02002.tldr: InteracSPARQL is proposed, an interactive SPARQL query generation and refinement system that leverages natural language explanations (NLEs) to enhance user comprehension and facilitate iterative query refinement.

2511.02022.tldr: The results indicate that EM arises from different narrow tasks discovering the same set of shared parameter directions, suggesting that harmful behaviors may be organized into specific, predictable regions of the weight landscape.

2511.02025.tldr: The proposed framework is a new path-coordinated framework of continual learning that unites the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) theory of principled plasticity bounds, statistical validation by Wilson confidence intervals, and evaluation of path quality by the use of multiple metrics.

2511.02042.tldr: The Quantum-Enhanced Generative Model (QEGM), a hybrid classical quantum framework that integrates deep latent-variable models with variational quantum circuits, is proposed, offering robustness beyond what is achievable with purely classical methods for rare-event prediction.

2511.02044.tldr: Overall, explanation-augmented fine-tuning, whether with genuine rationales or carefully constructed random token sequences, improves accuracy and reliability for LLM classification while clarifying how token-level scaffolding shapes computation during inference.

2511.02046.tldr: This is the first pipeline proposed to automatically synthesize and validate a large-scale text-VQA dataset comprising around 72K QA pairs based on around 44K images.

2511.02062.tldr: Vortex enables an SLO-first approach to ML serving platforms, and achieves significantly lower and more stable latencies than TorchServe and Ray Serve over a wide range of workloads, often enabling a given SLO target at more than twice the request rate.

2511.02087.tldr: This paper proposes a framework to leverage physical information directly into the loss function for prediction and generative modeling tasks on systems like molecules and spins and yields physically grounded loss functions with gradients that better align with valid configurations, while being architecture-agnostic and computationally efficient.

2511.02091.tldr: This framework proposes a framework that specifies the natural building blocks for structured world models based on the fundamental stochastic processes that any world model must capture: discrete processes and continuous processes; the world model is then defined by the hierarchical composition of these building blocks.

2511.02092.tldr: An application of online learning to continuously adapt to drifting data stream for prediction of Toroidal Field coils deflection at the DIII-D fusion facility demonstrates that online learning is critical to maintain ML model performance and reduces error by 80% compared to a static model.

2511.02094.tldr: This paper demonstrates how current foundation models can effectively search over a space of reward functions to produce desirable RL agents for the Gran Turismo 7 racing game, given only text-based instructions.

2511.02100.tldr: It is shown that training on a leverage-sampled subset produces a model whose parameters and predictive risk are within $O(\varepsilon)$ of the full-data optimum, thereby providing a rigorous link between data valuation and downstream decision quality.

2511.02119.tldr: InsurAgent, an LLM-empowered agent comprising five modules including perception, retrieval, reasoning, action, and memory, is proposed, providing a valuable tool for behavioral modeling and policy analysis.

2511.02130.tldr: Re-FORC trains a lightweight adapter on reasoning models, demonstrating improved prediction with longer reasoning and larger models and allows dynamic reasoning with length control via cost-per-token thresholds while estimating computation time upfront.

2511.02146.tldr: CausalDDS is a novel framework that disentangles drug molecules into causal and spurious substructures, utilizing the causal substructure representations for predicting drug synergy, and outperforms baseline models, particularly in cold start and out-of-distribution settings.

2511.02157.tldr: This work improves the convergence rate to CCE in general-sum Markov games, reducing it from the previously best-known rate of $\mathcal{O}(\log^5 T / T)$ to a sharper $\mathcal{O}(\log T / T)$.

2511.02164.tldr: By leveraging manufacturer guarantees for radar and laser sensors and focusing testing efforts on uncertain conditions, the ScenicProver approach enables stronger probabilistic guarantees than monolithic testing with the same computational budget.

2511.02175.tldr: This research lays a foundation for reliable deep learning based spatio-temporal forecasting with incomplete observations in emerging sensing paradigms, such as real world vehicle borne mobile monitoring.

2511.02194.tldr: An Adaptive Textual-symbolic Human-centric Reasoning framework (ATHENA), organically integrating symbolic utility modeling and semantic adaptation, provides a new scheme for modeling human-centric decisions.

2511.02196.tldr: BoolSkeleton is introduced, a novel Boolean network skeletonization method that improves the consistency and reliability of design-specific evaluations and improves above 55% in the average accuracy compared to the original Boolean network for the timing prediction task.

2511.02197.tldr: This paper proposes a confidence analysis and enhancement framework for LLMs tailored to code reasoning tasks, and indicates that models with reasoning capabilities demonstrate superior confidence reliability, and that the hybrid strategy is the most effective in enhancing the confidence reliability of various models.

2511.02200.tldr: This paper proposes STRMAC, a state-aware routing framework designed for efficient collaboration in multi-agent systems, which separately encodes interaction history and agent knowledge to power the router, which adaptively selects the most suitable single agent at each step for efficient and effective collaboration.

2511.02207.tldr: A novel object-centric 3D reconstruction framework incorporating a preprocessing pipeline that leverages the Segment Anything Model v2 (SAM-2) and alpha channel background masking to achieve clean strawberry plant reconstructions is proposed, offering a scalable and non-destructive solution for strawberry plant phenotyping.

2511.02208.tldr: Experiments show that agents trained with PPP achieve substantial improvements over strong baselines such as GPT-5, demonstrating the ability to ask strategic clarifying questions, adapt to unseen user preferences, and improve task success through better interaction.

2511.02210.tldr: The first automated pipeline, autoStrain, for SLS estimation in transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) using deep learning (DL) methods for motion estimation is introduced, indicating that integrating AI-driven motion estimation with TEE can significantly enhance the precision and efficiency of cardiac function assessment in clinical settings.

2511.02216.tldr: This paper develops an adaptive transmission design for a two-hop relaying communication system and proposes a dual-agent reinforcement learning-based cooperative latency-aware transmission (DRL-CoLA) algorithm to learn latency-aware transmission policies in a distributed manner.

2511.02217.tldr: A novel traffic signal control framework that combines Graph Attention Networks (GAT) with Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) reinforcement learning to address this challenge and holds significant promise for real-world deployment in mixed-autonomy traffic systems.

2511.02228.tldr: This work proposes a Collaborative Attention and Consistent-Guided Fusion framework for MRI and PET based AD diagnosis that introduces a learnable parameter representation (LPR) block to compensate for missing modality information, followed by a shared encoder and modality-independent encoders to preserve both shared and specific representations.

2511.02238.tldr: The Deep Ideation framework is proposed, integrating a scientific network that captures keyword co-occurrence and contextual relationships, enriching LLM-driven ideation and improves the quality of generated ideas by 10.67% compared to other methods.

2511.02239.tldr: This work introduces LACY (Language-Action Cycle), a unified framework that learns such bidirectional mappings within a single vision-language model and enables a self-improving cycle that autonomously generates and filters new training data through an active augmentation strategy targeting low-confidence cases, thereby improving the model without additional human labels.

2511.02243.tldr: A new framework that decomposes modality following into two fundamental factors: relative uncertainty and inherent preference are established as the two governing principles of modality following, offering both a quantitative framework and mechanistic insight into how MLLMs resolve conflicting information.

2511.02246.tldr: An infrastructure that automatically generates queries to probe LLMs and evaluates answers to these queries using multiple LLM-as-a-judge setups and prompts is developed and it is recommended that studies using LLM evaluation use multiple LLMs as evaluators in order to avoid arriving at statistically significant but non-generalizable results.

2511.02254.tldr: The proposed algorithms are the first constant-ratio approximation algorithms for the Revenue Maximization problem with the low complexity of \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} Â£1/4-\epsilon $$ within query complexity of \documentclass[12pt]{minimal} Â£1/4-\epsilon within query complexity of

2511.02301.tldr: This work proposes a Federated Quantum Kernel Learning (FQKL) framework that integrates quantum feature maps with federated aggregation to enable distributed, privacy-preserving anomaly detection across heterogeneous IoT networks and achieves superior generalization in capturing complex temporal correlations.

2511.02302.tldr: FP8-Flow-MoE is proposed, an FP8 training recipe featuring a quantization-consistent FP8-centric dataflow with a scaling-aware transpose and fused FP8 operators that streamline computation and eliminate explicit cast operations from 12 to 2.

2511.02303.tldr: A verifiable reward mechanism is proposed that encourages deliberation by allowing the reasoning agent to discard noisy outputs, consolidate instructions, and restart its reasoning process when necessary, and unlocks the full potential of multi-agent framework for complex reasoning tasks.

2511.02304.tldr: This work presents ACC-MARL, a framework for learning task-conditioned, decentralized team policies for cooperative, temporal objectives, and shows that the value functions of learned policies can be used to assign tasks optimally at test time.

2511.02309.tldr: It is found that sequential scaling where chains explicitly build upon previous attempts consistently outperforms the dominant parallel self-consistency paradigm in 95.6% of configurations with gains in accuracy upto 46.7% and is established as the optimal test-time scaling strategy.

2511.02332.tldr: By utilizing SCALD, the key driver genes that facilitate the transformation from colon inflammation to cancer are inferred by examining the dynamic changes within regulatory networks during the process by examining the dynamic changes within regulatory networks during the process.

2511.02351.tldr: A lightweight, real-time motion recognition system that enables synergic human-machine performance through wearable IMU sensor data, MiniRocket time-series classification, and responsive multimedia control and it is demonstrated that this human-centered design reliably supports high accuracy classification.

2511.02358.tldr: Experimental results showed that M-Solomon not only surpassed the baseline without augmentation by a large margin but also outperformed the baseline that always used augmentation, providing much faster embedding latency.

2511.02370.tldr: It is revealed that AI feedback significantly moderates partisan bias and institutional distrust, surpassing traditional engagement signals such as likes and shares and demonstrating the persuasive power of generative AI.

2511.02374.tldr: AyurParam-2.9B is introduced, a domain-specialized, bilingual language model fine-tuned from Param-1-2.9B using an extensive, expertly curated Ayurveda dataset spanning classical texts and clinical guidance that demonstrates competitive or superior performance compared to much larger models.

2511.02379.tldr: A novel CNN-H-InfinityLSTM architecture is proposed to identify arrhythmic heart signals from heart sound recordings, enhancing robustness and generalization and demonstrates that the proposed model achieves stable convergence and outperforms existing benchmarks.

2511.02392.tldr: A fuzzy soft set theory-based expert system designed to assess the risk of breast cancer in patients using measurable clinical and physiological parameters and integrates Body Mass Index, Insulin Level, Leptin Level, Adiponectin Level, and age as input variables to estimate breast cancer risk.

2511.02399.tldr: EvoDev is proposed, an iterative software development framework inspired by feature-driven development that decomposes user requirements into a set of user-valued features and constructs a Feature Map, a directed acyclic graph that explicitly models dependencies between features.

2511.02400.tldr: MammoClean provides an essential, reproducible pipeline for bias-aware AI development in mammography, facilitating fairer comparisons and advancing the creation of safe, effective systems that perform equitably across diverse patient populations and clinical settings.

2511.02404.tldr: Results indicate that self-supervision coupled with ViT inductive biases yields representational geometries that more closely align feline and human visual systems than widely used CNNs and windowed Transformers, providing testable neuroscientific hypotheses about where and how cross-species visual computations converge.

2511.02414.tldr: This paper presents a new framework for estimating entire PR curves based on a binary classification standpoint, and obtains a minimax upper bound on the PR estimation risk.

2511.02426.tldr: The Kullback-Leibler divergence method is shown to select the better performed identification in linear, nonlinear, and limited information applications, providing a powerful tool for system monitoring.

2511.02460.tldr: It is proved that the spherical geometry creates an"inherently hard negative sampling"environment, naturally eliminating trivial negatives and forcing the model to learn more robust and semantically coherent representations, leading to comprehensive performance gains across all relation types.

2511.02469.tldr: This study proposes a novel framework that structurally imitates the FOMC's collective decision-making process by modeling multiple large language models as interacting agents, and introduces a latent variable representing each agent's underlying belief that mediates the perception of input information and interaction dynamics.

2511.02478.tldr: WVSC-D first encodes original video frames as semantic frames and then conducts video coding based on such compact representations, enabling the video coding in semantic level rather than pixel level, and the bandwidth efficiency improves with satisfying video transmission performance.

2511.02490.tldr: Evaluations on real-world datasets demonstrate BRAINS effectiveness in classifying disease severity and identifying early signs of cognitive decline and offers hope for future applications in the field.

2511.02525.tldr: This paper is the first to propose an end-to-end learning approach for CLRPs, following the encoder-decoder structure, and reformulate the CLRPs as a markov decision process tailored to various decisions, a general modeling framework that can be adapted to other DRL-based methods.

2511.02532.tldr: This paper introduces Agentic AI, tracing its evolution from classical agents and discussing the progress from workflows and simple AI agents to Agentic AI, and proposes a practical use case that applies Agentic principles to RAN optimization.

2511.02534.tldr: Experiments in two representative game environments demonstrate that KLPEG can more accurately locate functionalities affected by updates and complete tests in fewer steps, significantly improving both playtesting effectiveness and efficiency.

2511.02560.tldr: SigmaCollab is introduced, a dataset enabling research on physically situated human-AI collaboration that consists of a set of 85 sessions in which untrained participants were guided by a mixed-reality assistive AI agent in performing procedural tasks in the physical world.

2511.02567.tldr: This work proposes a new neighborhood constraint that restricts action selection in the Bellman target to the union of neighborhoods of dataset actions and develops a simple yet effective algorithm, Adaptive Neighborhood-constrained Q learning (ANQ), to perform Q learning with target actions satisfying this constraint.

2511.02580.tldr: The Training-free Noise Transplantation and Cultivation Diffusion Model (TAUE) is introduced, a novel framework for layer-wise image generation that requires neither fine-tuning nor additional data to achieve state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods.

2511.02600.tldr: It is demonstrated how a seemingly improved LLM, fine-tuned on a limited dataset, can introduce significant bias, to the extent that a simple LLM-based alert investigator is completely bypassed when the prompt utilizes the introduced bias.

2511.02602.tldr: A unified trust assessment pipeline on parameterized quantum classifiers is validated, uncovering correlations between uncertainty and prediction risk, an asymmetry in attack vulnerability between classical and quantum state perturbations, and privacy-utility trade-offs driven by shot noise and quantum channel noise.

2511.02606.tldr: A multi-agent psychological simulation system that models internal cognitive-affective processes to generate believable human behaviors and embodies principles of social learning, cognitive apprenticeship, deliberate practice, and meta-cognition is presented.

2511.02627.tldr: DecompSR provides a provably correct and rigorous benchmarking dataset with a novel ability to independently vary the degrees of several key aspects of compositionality, allowing for robust and fine-grained probing of the compositional reasoning abilities of LLMs.

2511.02646.tldr: GasRL, a simulator that couples a calibrated representation of the natural gas market with a model of storage-operator policies trained with deep reinforcement learning (RL), is introduced and it is found that such thresholds have a positive effect on market resilience against unanticipated shifts in the distribution of supply shocks.

2511.02647.tldr: Federated Attention (FedAttn) is proposed, which integrates the federated paradigm into the self-attention mechanism, creating a new distributed LLM inference framework that simultaneously achieves privacy protection, communication efficiency, and computational efficiency.

2511.02651.tldr: This technical report introduces the Apriel-H1 family of hybrid LLMs that combine transformer attention and SSM sequence mixers for efficient reasoning at 15B model size and shows that distilled hybrid SSM-Transformer architectures can deliver substantial efficiency gains over the pretrained transformer equivalent without substantially compromising the reasoning quality.

2511.02681.tldr: This paper proposes a method, optimal singular damage, that selectively sparsifies low-rank approximated updates by leveraging the interleaved importance of singular vectors, ensuring that the most impactful components are retained.

2511.02687.tldr: This work proposes a collaborative maze-solving benchmark that isolates collaborative capabilities, modulates problem complexity, enables scalable automated grading, and imposes no output-format constraints, preserving ecological plausibility and argues for collaboration-aware evaluation and training strategies developed to enhance collaborative capabilities.

2511.02717.tldr: It is demonstrated using the perturbation analysis that, a system with at least a zero or a non-zero known input can potentially be uniquely identified and allowed for a better understanding of the system compared to classical output-only parameter identification strategies.

2511.02720.tldr: Large Language model EXplaIns COncept Relevance Propagation (LLEXICORP), a modular pipeline that couples CRP with a multimodal large language model that integrates concept-based attribution methods with large language models can significantly lower the barrier to interpreting deep neural networks, paving the way for more transparent AI systems.

2511.02734.tldr: Evaluating leading open-sourced and proprietary models on CostBench reveals a substantial gap in cost-aware planning, with agents frequently fail to identify cost-optimal solutions in static settings, with even GPT-5 achieving less than 75% exact match rate on the hardest tasks.

2511.02749.tldr: This paper introduces span queries, which are expression trees of inference calls, linked together with commutativity constraints, and describes span query syntax and semantics, and shows how they can be automatically optimized to improve KV cache locality.

2511.02752.tldr: Results indicate that linguistic accessibility is a significant, independent barrier to equitable AI diffusion, and this work uses a weighted regression model to isolate the language effect from socioeconomic and demographic factors.

2511.02759.tldr: An LLM-supported method for semi-automated generation of formal knowledge representations that combine human readability with machine interpretability and increased expressiveness is described.

2511.02769.tldr: STAR-VAE (Selfies-encoded, Transformer-based, AutoRegressive Variational Auto Encoder), a scalable latent-variable framework with a Transformer encoder and an autoregressive Transformer decoder, suggests that a modernized, scale-appropriate VAE remains competitive for molecular generation when paired with principled conditioning and parameter-efficient finetuning.

2511.02781.tldr: Wide variation in adoption is found in adoption, with a strong correlation between AI User Share and GDP, and high uptake is concentrated in developed economies, though usage among internet-connected populations in lower-income countries reveals substantial latent demand.

2511.02794.tldr: This paper introduces modality sabotage, a diagnostic failure mode in which a high-confidence unimodal error overrides other evidence and misleads the fused result, offering insight into whether failures may arise from dataset artifacts or model limitations.

2511.02805.tldr: This work proposes MemSearcher, an agent workflow that iteratively maintains a compact memory and combines the current turn with it, and introduces multi-context GRPO, an end-to-end RL framework that jointly optimize reasoning, search strategies, and memory management of MemSearcher Agents.

2511.02815.tldr: It is shown that the most common machine learning models do indeed demonstrate a relationship between predicted win probability and the strength of the win, and that naive use of machine learning models for betting lead to significant loses.

2511.02817.tldr: The data and evaluation harness for Oolong is released, a benchmark of long-context reasoning tasks that require analyzing individual chunks of text on an atomic level, and then aggregating these analyses to answer distributional questions.

2511.02823.tldr: This work shows how to optimize attack policies in SHADE-Arena, a dataset of diverse realistic control environments by decomposing attack capability into five constituent skills -- suspicion modeling, attack selection, plan synthesis, execution and subtlety -- and optimizing each component individually.

2511.02825.tldr: This paper uses logic in a neurosymbolic framework to offer a much needed semantics for deep learning, the neural network-based technology of current AI.

2302.05610.tldr: The evaluation result shows that the deep neural network models(BiGRU, to be specific) produce the most promising results compared to traditional machine learning models, with an 87.53 % accuracy rate.

2311.13559.tldr: This study employs convolutional neural networks and transfer learning to develop a real-time computer vision system for automatic handgun detection, demonstrating promising performance comparable to related works.

2311.17228.tldr: This work unifies the current and future ethical concerns of deploying AI into society by providing a comprehensive overview that not only addresses each principle from a technical point of view but also discusses them from a social perspective.

2402.17913.tldr: This work proposes to implement numerical discretisations of partial differential equations as convolutional layers of a neural network, where the weights or filters are determined analytically rather than by training, and demonstrates the approach on a number of test cases of increasing complexity from advection-diffusion problems.

2404.11577.tldr: This work focuses on membership inference attack (MIA) based evaluation, one of the most common approaches for evaluating unlearning algorithms, and proposes a practical and efficient approximation of the induced evaluation metric that measures the data removal efficacy of unlearning algorithms.

2404.19725.tldr: CurvFed is a theoretically grounded framework that promotes fairness in FL without requiring any demographic or sensitive attribute information, a concept termed Fairness without Demographics (FWD), by optimizing the underlying loss landscape curvature.

2502.01755.tldr: This work proposes RoLoRA, a federated framework using alternating optimization to fine-tune LoRA adapters, and emphasizes the importance of learning up and down projection matrices to enhance expressiveness and robustness.

2503.09707.tldr: A surprising observation is made: parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using only labeled data often matches SSL performance, even without leveraging unlabeled data, which motivates us to revisit self-training, a conceptually simple SSL baseline, and propose ensembling multiple PEFT approaches and VFM backbones to produce more robust pseudo-labels.

2504.20462.tldr: This work proposes a tool-assisted LLM agent with multi-modality observation data for fine-grained RCA, namely TAMO, including multi-modality alignment tool, root cause localization tool, and fault types classification tool, and fault types classification tool.

2505.02184.tldr: This work proposes LASSI-EE, an automated LLM-based refactoring framework that generates energy-efficient parallel codes through a multi-stage, iterative approach integrating runtime power profiling, energy-aware prompting, self- correcting feedback loops, and an LLM-as-a-Judge agent for automated screening of code solutions.

2505.05588.tldr: This work provides results on the first in-space demonstration of using machine learning-based warm starts for accelerating trajectory optimization for the Astrobee free-flying robot onboard the International Space Station.

2505.14766.tldr: Toto uses a modern decoder-only architecture coupled with architectural innovations designed to account for specific challenges found in multivariate observability time series data, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on both BOOM and on established general purpose time series forecasting benchmarks.

2506.09397.tldr: A new framework that leverages speculative decoding, previously viewed primarily as a decoding acceleration technique for autoregressive generation of LLMs, is introduced as a promising approach specifically adapted for edge computing by orchestrating computation across heterogeneous devices.

2506.15207.tldr: This study investigates RL-based autonomous EO mission planning by modelling single-satellite operations and extending to multi-satellite constellations using MARL frameworks, and demonstrates that MARL can effectively balance imaging and resource management while addressing non-stationarity and reward interdependency in multi-satellite coordination.

2507.05724.tldr: The Omni-router Transformer is able to achieve lower training loss and consistently outperform dense and Switch Transformer models, reducing average word error rates by 11.2% and 8.2%, respectively, while providing structured expert usage and improved robustness to diverse data.

2507.10530.tldr: It is shown that flow matching, a deterministic ordinary differential (ODE) formulation, can replace SDE-based diffusion for molecular and reaction generation and demonstrate that flow matching is the future for molecular generation across chemistry.

2508.03379.tldr: A novel step-by-step code generation framework named UML2Dep is proposed by leveraging unambiguous formal specifications of complex requirements by introducing an enhanced Unified Modeling Language (UML) sequence diagram tailored for service-oriented architectures and recognizing the critical role of data flow.

2508.09805.tldr: A deep learning model is presented to automate segmentation of postmortem brain tissue from photographs, using a U-Net architecture that was trained with a combination of 1,414 manually segmented images of both fixed and fresh tissue from specimens with varying diagnoses.

2508.17540.tldr: This work proposes Activation Transport Operators (ATO), linear maps from upstream to downstream residuals later, evaluated in feature space using downstream SAE decoder projections, and develops the notion of transport efficiency, for which it is used to estimate the size of the residual stream subspace that corresponds to linear transport.

2509.08972.tldr: The Truncated-Cross-Entropy (TCE) loss function is introduced, offering a practical and generalizable tool for model robustness under synthetic-data exposure and demonstrating that confidence-aware training objectives can substantially delay collapse onset.

2509.18293.tldr: This work evaluates eight open-source LLMs' capability to detect antisemitic content, specifically leveraging in-context definition, and studies how LLMs understand and explain their decisions given a moderation policy as a guideline.

2510.12839.tldr: FaStfact first employs chunk-level claim extraction integrated with confidence-based pre-verification, significantly reducing the time and token cost while ensuring reliability, and furthermore collects document-level evidence from crawled web-pages and selectively retrieves it during verification.

2510.18442.tldr: PlanU is introduced, an LLM-based planning method that captures uncertainty within Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and introduces an Upper Confidence Bounds with Curiosity (UCC) score which estimates the uncertainty of MCTS nodes.

2510.18938.tldr: StutterZero and StutterFormer are introduced, the first end-to-end waveform-to-waveform models that directly convert stuttered speech into fluent speech while jointly predicting its transcription, and validate the feasibility of direct end-to-end stutter-to-fluent speech conversion.

2510.19444.tldr: The theory is developed coalgebraically over Polish spaces and the Giry monad and validated on finite-state models using optimal-transport solvers, with experiments corroborating the predicted contraction properties and structural stability and aligning with the theoretical value-loss bounds, thereby providing a rigorous foundation for quantitative state abstraction and representation learning in probabilistic domains.

2510.21908.tldr: The results show that explicit plasticity complements attention by enabling rapid, task-specific adaptation, and clarify when different plasticity mechanisms are most effective.

2510.22781.tldr: This work proposes an Agentic Meta-orchestrator (AMO) for handling multiple tasks and scalable agents in copilot services, which can provide both natural language and action responses and demonstrates the effectiveness of this AMO through two production use cases.

2510.23632.tldr: Experiments on multiple reanalysis datasets show that LLMCOMP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art compressors, achieving up to 30% higher compression ratios under strict error bounds, highlighting the potential of LLMs as general-purpose compressors for high-fidelity scientific data.

2510.26130.tldr: This work systematically examines how input specification completeness and retrieval-augmented generation affect class-level correctness across multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, and introduces a benchmark derived from real-world open-source repositories to evaluate generalization under practical conditions.

2511.01884.tldr: CudaForge employs two LLM agents that iteratively generate, correct, and optimize CUDA kernels, while integrating hardware feedback such as Nsight Compute (NCU) metrics, and highlights that multi-agent, training-free workflows can enable cost-effective, generalizable, and high-performance CUDA kernel optimization.

2511.01885.tldr: Findings indicate that appropriately scaled model capacities and self/other coupling foster shared neural representations in ANNs similar to biological mirror neurons, and suggest that intrinsic motivations modeled through mirror-neuron dynamics could complement existing alignment techniques by embedding empathy-like mechanisms directly within AI architectures.

2511.02219.tldr: TabDSR, a framework consisting of a query decomposer that breaks down complex questions, a table sanitizer that cleans and filters noisy tables, and a program-of-thoughts (PoT)-based reasoner that generates executable code to derive the final answer from the sanitized table, consistently outperforms existing methods.

2511.02659.tldr: A novel in situ training protocol that employs limited memory buffers of full and sketched data samples, where the sketched data are leveraged to prevent catastrophic forgetting and it is demonstrated that sketching enables the presented in situ scheme to approximately match the performance of the equivalent offline method.

2511.02842.tldr: This work investigates the use of a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered chatbot to acquire organisations'digital transformation needs, and discusses the implications of employing chatbots to elicit user information, emphasizing their potential and limitations.

2511.02851.tldr: LiteHeart introduces a region-aware distillation module to mimic how cardiologists focus on diagnostically relevant ECG regions and a cross-layer mutual information module to align the decision processes of LCCI and HCCI systems.

2511.02853.tldr: The proposed consciousness-ECG transformer that leverages electrocardiography (ECG) signals for non-invasive and reliable conscious state estimation offers a practical and robust alternative to EEG-based methods, particularly suited for dynamic clinical environments.

2511.02854.tldr: This study introduces SELF-REDRAFT, a framework built upon Self-Refine that encourages the model to propose new drafts for solutions that are fundamentally flawed and establishes a baseline for intrinsic exploration-exploration balancing in test-time scaling and identifies feedback and discrimination as key areas with potential for future advances.

2511.02868.tldr: Proof-of-Spiking-Neurons (PoSN), a neuromorphic consensus protocol inspired by spiking neural networks, is proposed, establishing a foundation for sustainable, adaptive blockchains suitable for IoT, edge, and large-scale distributed systems.

2511.02869.tldr: AdvFusion is investigated on Code Large Language Models (Code-LLMs), considering three new tasks: code generation, code translation, and commit message generation, and it is found that the other PEFT methods do not have better performance.

2511.02875.tldr: This study prototypes a ten-item, indirect-elicitation instrument embedded in a structured interpretive framework to surface voids between institutional rules and practitioner AI use.

2511.02877.tldr: The results show that the combination of delay embedding and RFF-based reservoirs reveals new dynamical structure by embedding the system in an enriched feature space, providing a computationally efficient and interpretable approach to modeling chaotic dynamics.

2511.02879.tldr: DeepForm (Stochastic Deep Graph Clustering for Practical Group Formation) is proposed, a framework designed to meet three key operational requirements: the incorporation of high-order user information, real-time group formation, and dynamic adjustment of the number of groups.

2511.02885.tldr: A quality model for AI agents based on the ISO/IEC 25010 standard, and a domain specific language to support the definition of SLAs for the services provided by these AI agents are proposed.

2511.02886.tldr: This paper shows that, by starting from a tiny recursive model that has been pre-trained on public ARC tasks, one can efficiently fine-tune on competition tasks within the allowed compute limits.

2511.02887.tldr: An AI-assisted framework for predicting Potential Fishing Zones (PFZs) using oceanographic parameters such as sea surface temperature and chlorophyll concentration is presented, designed to enhance the accuracy of PFZ identification and provide region-specific insights for sustainable fishing practices.

2511.02888.tldr: NABench is introduced, a large-scale, systematic benchmark for nucleic acid fitness prediction, which aggregates 162 high-throughput assays and curates 2.6 million mutated sequences spanning diverse DNA and RNA families, with standardized splits and rich metadata.

2511.02897.tldr: This work compares three bitstring implementations in C++: std::bitset, boost::dynamic_bitset, and a custom direct implementation, providing practical guidance for selecting the optimal method based on platform and application requirements.

2511.02933.tldr: Generative hints are proposed, a training methodology that directly enforces known functional invariances over the input distribution and consistently outperform standard data augmentation.

2511.02936.tldr: This work applies an open-source LLM, Llama 3.1-405B, to generate structured data use case labels for publications known to incorporate specific genomic datasets, and introduces a novel evaluation framework for determining the efficacy of the methods.

2511.02938.tldr: Results indicate that a purely software upgrade can endow installed narrow-band probes with broadband-like performance, potentially widening access to high-resolution ultrasound in resource-constrained settings.

2511.02944.tldr: This paper develops ROGUE-TS, a Thompson Sampling algorithm tailored to the ROGUE framework, and introduces a probability clipping procedure to balance personalization and population-level learning, with quantified trade-off that balances regret and minimum exploration probability.

2511.02997.tldr: This work systematically evaluate a range of control protocols in SHADE-Arena, a dataset of diverse agentic environments, finding that resampling for incrimination and deferring on critical actions perform best, and demonstrating the importance of denying attack policies access to protocol internals.

2511.03019.tldr: Inspired by neuroscientific evidence that human encodes knowledge as relationship cognitive maps, Structure-aware Language-Image Pretraining (SLIP) is introduced, which integrates a structural contrastive loss to align modalities while also modeling relationships between neighboring entities in a structured graph.

2511.03022.tldr: The residual correction method is introduced, a general framework for correcting for systematic biases in sensorless models after observing live telemetry data, and Adaptive-sensorless models enable more accurate cargo monitoring, early risk detection, and less dependence on full connectivity in global shipping.

2511.03023.tldr: These principles guide when and why specialization is necessary for complex analytical workflows while enabling broader access to public data through natural language interfaces.

2511.03051.tldr: A large-scale benchmarking study that systematically compares 36 LLMs, including GPT, Gemini, Claude, and Llama, across multiple product categories using a consensus-driven evaluation protocol, establishing ScalingEval as a reproducible benchmark and evaluation protocol for LLM evaluators without human annotation.

2511.03095.tldr: It is demonstrated that ensembles containing only a handful of kernels can identify statistically significant anomalous locations within representation spaces of thousands of dimensions, underscoring both the interpretability, efficiency and scalability of the proposed approach.

2511.03100.tldr: DiCoDe sets a new standard in agent-environment co-design, achieving, for example, 39% higher rewards in the warehouse setting with 66% fewer simulation samples, and is a stepping stone towards reaping the rewards of co-design in real world domains.

2511.03102.tldr: CARMA is presented, the first automatically annotated large-scale dataset of Arabic Reddit posts, providing insights into the linguistic markers of specific mental health conditions and highlighting the promise of advancing mental health detection in underrepresented languages such as Arabic.

2511.03106.tldr: This work proposes a new organizing principle guiding generalist LLM monitoring that is scalable and grounded in how these models are developed and used in practice: capability-based monitoring.

2511.03108.tldr: Deep analysis of the formal and informal statements in the miniF2F benchmark from the perspective of an AI system that is tasked to participate in a math Olympiad consisting of the problems in miniF2F suggests that a higher quality benchmark can help the community better evaluate progress in the field of formal reasoning and also better diagnose the failure and success modes of autoformalization and theorem proving models.

2511.03113.tldr: FP-AbDiff is introduced, the first antibody generator to enforce Fokker-Planck Equation (FPE) physics along the entire generative trajectory, establishing a principled approach for physically faithful and functionally viable antibody design.

2511.03114.tldr: This paper provides the tightest bounds based on the widely adopted assumption of conditional independence and develops an unsupervised metric for the representation evaluation of contrastive learning, which aligns well with the downstream performance almost without relying on additional modules.

2511.03120.tldr: This work proposes IC DefectNCD, a support set free framework that leverages Image Intrinsic Priors in IC SEM images for defect detection and novel class discovery and designs Self Defect Information Guided IC Defect Classification, which incorporates a soft mask guided attention mechanism to inject spatial defect priors into the teacher student model.

2511.03122.tldr: The EGMOF (Efficient Generation of MOFs), a hybrid diffusion-transformer framework that overcomes limitations through a modular, descriptor-mediated workflow and highlights the potential of modular inverse design workflows for broader materials discovery.

2511.03129.tldr: The analysis connects classical results such as the Minkowski--Weyl decomposition, Hoffman's bound, and the fundamental theorem of linear programming with modern network-based diffusion modeling with modern network-based diffusion modeling.

2511.03137.tldr: This study chooses the fireworks algorithm (FWA) as the basic optimizer and proposes the concept of Critical Part (CP), which extends FWA to complex high-dimensional tasks, and further utilizes the information in the optimization process with the help of the multi-modal characteristics of large language models.

2511.03143.tldr: This work introduces a novel framework for developing and evaluating context-specific empathetic large language models (LLMs) and trains empathetic expert adapters for context-specific empathy that specialize in varying empathy levels based on the recognized task.

2511.03149.tldr: This work proposes a joint forecast-anomaly loss that fine-tunes TSFMs to accurately forecast future signals even at anomalous time points, and introduces a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) module that retrieves historically relevant horizons and conditions predictions on them.

2511.03152.tldr: This paper presents a framework for stakeholder-grounded risk assessment by using LLMs, acting as judges to predict and explain risks, and generates stakeholder-specific, interpretable policies that shows how different stakeholders agree or disagree about the same risks.

2511.03153.tldr: This paper introduces RefAgent, a multi-agent LLM-based framework for end-to-end software refactoring, which consists of specialized agents responsible for planning, executing, testing, and iteratively refining refactorings using self-reflection and tool-calling capabilities.

2511.03169.tldr: The paper documents the existence of incorrect explanations computed by PyXAI on most of the datasets analyzed in the experiments, thereby confirming the importance of the proposed novel methodology for the validation of formal explainers.

2511.03186.tldr: This work presents Summit Concierge, a domain-specific AI assistant developed for Adobe Summit that handles a wide range of event-related queries and operates under real-world constraints such as data sparsity, quality assurance, and rapid deployment.

2511.03190.tldr: Through rigorous analysis, it is revealed that the effectiveness of attention in spatio-temporal time series modeling may not primarily stem from the non-linearity of softmax but rather from the attainment of a moderate and well-balanced weight distribution.

2401.07844.tldr: The celebrated Borkar-Meyn theorem is extended for stability from the Martingale difference noise setting to the Markovian noise setting, which greatly improves its applicability in reinforcement learning, especially in those off-policy reinforcement learning algorithms with linear function approximation and eligibility traces.

2403.04468.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive survey that systematically reviews existing GNN models, focusing on solutions to the four mentioned real-world challenges including imbalance, noise, privacy, and OOD in practical scenarios that many existing reviews have not considered.

2409.11316.tldr: This work proposes a new Few-shot Semantic Segmentation framework based on the Transformer architecture that introduces the spatial transformer decoder and the contextual mask generation module to improve the relational understanding between support and query images.

2410.02628.tldr: This work proposes a new learning paradigm that integrates both paired and unpaired data $\textbf{seamlessly}$ using the data likelihood maximization techniques and derives the universal approximation property, demonstrating that this approach can theoretically recover true conditional distributions with arbitrarily small error.

2410.07787.tldr: This work presents a novel hybrid robotic platform that integrates a rigid manipulator with a fully developed soft arm that is equipped with the intelligence necessary to perform flexible and generalizable tasks through imitation learning autonomously.

2410.16301.tldr: The findings suggest that LLMs will drive methodological innovation in political science through integration and improvement rather than direct substitution, offering a powerful tool that balances interpretability and predictability in social science research.

2410.16593.tldr: This work adopts an alignment-based perspective linking node feature statistics to graph spectral structure and develops two complementary notions of feature-graph alignment, and empirically validate that filter monotonicity dictates the relationship between feature variance and spectral energy.

2411.16638.tldr: This work stress test a range of automatic factuality metrics, including specialized models and LLM-based prompting methods, to probe what they actually capture and calls into question the reliability of current factuality metrics.

2412.16378.tldr: REFA is a new alignment framework that proposes probabilistic control on a structural token that controls termination, and its core innovation is a new class of regularizers that operate directly on the probability of the End-of-Sequence token, a previously unexploited control lever.

2502.08436.tldr: To reduce the computational overhead of LSR, which requires an additional LLM call at each iteration, this work proposes distilling the model into a probabilistic classifier, allowing for efficient inference.

2502.10476.tldr: This work presents Contextual Lexicographic Markov Decision Process (CLMDP), a framework that enables planning under varying lexicographic objective orderings, depending on the context, and employs a Bayesian approach to infer a state-context mapping from expert trajectories.

2502.13115.tldr: The results demonstrate that joint privacy comes at almost no additional cost, addressing the open problems posed by Azize and Basu (2024), and establish minimax convergence rates for both the central and local privacy models.

2502.14799.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive review of text-driven 360-degree panorama generation, offering an in-depth analysis of state-of-the-art algorithms and critically examine current limitations and propose promising directions for future research.

2503.07329.tldr: This study systematically evaluates the effects of random seeds on LLMs using the GLUE and SuperGLUE benchmarks, and introduces a novel metric, consistency, measuring the stability of individual predictions across runs.

2503.14234.tldr: Results show that KG-IRAG improves accuracy in complex reasoning tasks by effectively integrating external knowledge with iterative, logic-based retrieval, and three new datasets are formed to evaluate KG-IRAG's performance, demonstrating its potential beyond traditional RAG applications.

2505.12398.tldr: Traversal Verification is introduced, a novel speculative decoding algorithm that fundamentally rethinks the verification paradigm through leaf-to-root traversal, and preserves potentially valid subsequences that would be prematurely discarded by existing methods.

2505.14526.tldr: By ensuring consistency between simulation and real-world deployment, RoboRAN lowers the barrier to developing adaptable RL-based navigation strategies, and its modular design enables straightforward integration of new robots and tasks through predefined templates, fostering reproducibility and extension to diverse domains.

2505.17612.tldr: This work proposes Agent Distillation, a framework for transferring not only reasoning capability but full task-solving behavior from LLM-based agents into sLMs with retrieval and code tools, and introduces a prompting method called first-thought prefix to enhance the quality of teacher-generated trajectories.

2506.10564.tldr: The Comprehensive Equity Index (CEI), a novel metric designed to address demographic bias in high-performance face recognition systems, is introduced and an automated version of the metric is presented that enhances objectivity and simplifies practical application.

2506.14562.tldr: This paper introduces AlphaDecay, a simple yet effective method that adaptively assigns different weight decay strengths to each module of an LLM, guided by Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory, which analyzes the empirical spectral density of weight correlation matrices to quantify"heavy-tailedness."

2506.15679.tldr: It is demonstrated that dense latents tend to form antipodal pairs that reconstruct specific directions in the residual stream, and that ablating their subspace suppresses the emergence of new dense features in retrained SAEs -- suggesting that high density features are an intrinsic property of the residual space.

2506.22638.tldr: Using layer-wise ablation on base and trained variants, it is found that math reasoning depends on a few critical layers, which stay important across all post- training methods and drift from their original syntactic clusters toward representations aligned with tokens less syntactic related but potentially more useful for downstream task.

2507.06853.tldr: DiffSpectra is the first framework that unifies multi-modal spectral reasoning and joint 2D/3D generative modeling for de novo molecular structure elucidation, directly inferring 2D and 3D molecular structures from multi-modal spectra using diffusion models.

2507.11081.tldr: A novel cross-verification strategy was proposed to fully exploit the complementary abilities of region proposal networks in object recognition from different views of GPR images to reduce the human labor of inspection.

2507.13558.tldr: This paper explains why relational learning is not taking over the world -- except in a few cases with restricted relations -- and what needs to be done to bring it to it's rightful prominence.

2507.16395.tldr: Experimental results show that ColaUntangle outperforms the best-performing baseline, achieving an improvement of 44% on the C# dataset and 82% on the Java dataset, highlighting the potential of LLM-based collaborative frameworks for advancing automated commit untangling tasks.

2508.00079.tldr: There are significant improvements when the multi-agent framework is applied to problems that the models initially perform poorly on, and a new evaluation benchmark for physics problems is introduced.

2508.01522.tldr: This paper presents the first decentralized method to enable real-world 6-DoF manipulation of a cable-suspended load using a team of Micro-Aerial Vehicles (MAVs) using multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to train an outer-loop control policy for each MAV.

2508.03159.tldr: This work proposes CoTox, a novel framework that integrates LLM with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for multi-organ toxicity prediction and shows that CoTox outperforms both traditional machine learning and deep learning models.

2508.04201.tldr: ViFP is proposed, a framework for Visual False Positive Detection to Enhance Reasoning Reliability in VLMs that builds effective reasoning paths through multi-turn QA and dynamically analyzes the consistency of the reasoning path to identify potential FPs, thereby improving logical consistency and accuracy.

2508.04825.tldr: Voost is proposed—a unified and scalable framework that jointly learns virtual try-on and try-off with a single diffusion transformer, and introduces two inference-time techniques: attention temperature scaling for robustness to resolution or mask variation, and self- correcting sampling that leverages bidirectional consistency between tasks.

2508.08826.tldr: This work presents a learning-based estimator to predict diffuse indirect illumination in screen space, which then is combined with direct illumination to synthesize globally-illuminated high dynamic range (HDR) results.

2508.10409.tldr: This paper proposes AnalogSeeker, an effort toward an open-source foundation language model for analog circuit design, with the aim of integrating domain knowledge and giving design assistance, and introduces a granular domain knowledge distillation method.

2508.16607.tldr: It is found that practitioners experienced friction triaging problems at the intersection of responsible AI and accessibility practices, navigated contradictions between accessibility and responsible AI guidelines, identified gaps in data about users with disabilities, and gathered support for addressing the needs of disabled stakeholders by leveraging informal volunteer and community groups within their company.

2508.20637.tldr: The GDS agent introduces a comprehensive set of graph algorithms as tools, together with preprocessing (retrieval) and postprocessing of algorithm results, in a model context protocol (MCP) server and can be used with any modern LLM out-of-the-box.

2509.06733.tldr: This survey is, to the authors' knowledge, the first dedicated to the RL foundations of deep research systems, systematizes recent work along three axes, and distill recurring patterns, surface infrastructure bottlenecks, and offer practical guidance for training robust, transparent deep research agents with RL.

2509.10594.tldr: A structured, multi-phased framework, “SME-TEAM", positioning trust and ethics as a driving force for resilience, competitiveness, and sustainable innovation within the area of business analytics and SMEs is introduced.

2510.04263.tldr: Simulations and real-data analyses show that BOSS-FCI and GRaSP-FCI provide robust baselines, FCIT yields the best balance of precision and reliability, and LV-Dumb offers a fast, near-equivalent alternative.

2510.12214.tldr: DE3S, a Dual-Enhanced Soft-Sparse Sequence Learning framework, is proposed, which systematically solves the challenges of weak, early signals and shows the competitive performance of DE3S, particularly in early prediction windows.

2510.13890.tldr: This paper presents a systematic survey of SLM-LLM collaboration from the perspective of collaboration objectives, and proposes a taxonomy covering four goals: performance enhancement, cost-effectiveness, cloud-edge privacy, and trustworthiness.

2510.19738.tldr: The Misalignment Bounty was a crowdsourced project that collected cases of agents pursuing unintended or unsafe goals, and the bounty received 295 submissions, of which nine were awarded.

2510.21861.tldr: The results delineate when reflection is performative rather than epistemic and motivate design principles for grounded, cooperative reasoning, and suggest the mirror loop arises from shared autoregressive training objectives rather than provider-specific alignment schemes.

2510.22336.tldr: RoboCraft is proposed, a scalable humanoid co-design framework for fall recovery that iteratively improves performance through the coupled updates of control policy and morphology, underscoring the critical role of humanoid co-design.

2510.25531.tldr: The approach aligns motor performance items from different measurement instruments for mixed-effects regression and maps estimated effects back to the observed item level to quantify the treatment switch effect, highlighting the potential of modeling in joint latent representations for addressing small data challenges.

2510.27171.tldr: H2-Cache is presented, a robust and practical solution that effectively resolves the speed-quality dilemma, significantly lowering the barrier for the real-world application of high-fidelity diffusion models.

2511.00529.tldr: In this work-in-progress paper, systemic connections between human improvisational arts and the design of future experiential AI agents that could improvise alone or alongside humans-or even with other AI agents are drawn.

2511.00774.tldr: A retrospective analysis of anonymized candidate-evaluation data collected during pilot hiring campaigns conducted through AlteraSF, an AI-native resume-verification platform, suggests that a multi-dimensional verification framework can improve both hiring efficiency and trust in AI-mediated evaluation systems.
