2511.01324.tldr: It is suggested that AI is most effective when positioned as a collaborative partner rather than a replacement for human expertise, and highlights the need for RE-specific HAIC frameworks along with robust and responsible AI governance as AI adoption in RE grows.

2511.02667.tldr: A rigorous evaluation framework that unifies and extends previous approaches while reducing computational requirements from combinatorial to constant and Attribute Invariant Networks, a class of models establishing a new Pareto frontier in compositional generalization.

2511.02824.tldr: Kosmos is presented, an AI scientist that automates data-driven discovery that span metabolomics, materials science, neuroscience, and statistical genetics and makes seven discoveries that span metabolomics, materials science, neuroscience, and statistical genetics.

2511.02834.tldr: An Agent-Omni framework that coordinates existing foundation models through a master-agent system, enabling flexible multimodal reasoning without retraining and enabling future improvements as stronger models become available is proposed.

2511.02953.tldr: The suitability of EvtSlowTV for a self-supervised learning framework to capitalise on the HDR potential of raw event streams is shown and it is demonstrated that training with EvtSlowTV enhances the model's ability to generalise to complex scenes and motions.

2511.03201.tldr: This study proposes a VAE-MLP model framework where an MLP-based classifier is trained on 8-dimensional latent vectors derived from the high-dimensional train data using the encoder component of a pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE) of a pretrained variational autoencoder (VAE).

2511.03206.tldr: This work extensively investigates how current prompting methods perceive fine-grained visual details and process visual information when dealing with multiple images and proposes a new zero-shot prompting method, Question-Guided Chain-of-Captions (QG-CoC), a generalized prompting approach that effectively handles problems with an arbitrary number of images.

2511.03214.tldr: This work proposes the Language Graph Model (LGM) to enhance conceptual clarity by extracting meta-relations-inheritance, alias, and composition-from natural language by leveraging a Concept Iterative Retrieval Algorithm.

2511.03217.tldr: A modular, opensource fact-checking pipeline with fallback strategies and generalization across datasets, and conducts a targeted reannotation study showing that this approach frequently uncovers valid evidence for claims originally labeled as Not Enough Information.

2511.03251.tldr: This work proposes GMoPE (Graph Mixture of Prompt-Experts), a novel framework that seamlessly integrates the Mixture-of-Experts architecture with prompt-based learning for graphs, and introduces a soft orthogonality constraint across prompt vectors, encouraging expert specialization and facilitating a more balanced expert utilization.

2511.03255.tldr: A generative method for ultrasound CFD-greyscale video translation that worked well on ultrasound spanning several clinical domains, and expands the utility of retrospectively collected imaging and augment the dataset design toolbox for medical imaging.

2511.03261.tldr: Open-source LLMs, too, can go hand in hand with proprietary models like GPT-3.5 with better infrastructure, and this research underscores the fact that open-source LLMs, too, can go hand in hand with proprietary models like GPT-3.5 with better infrastructure.

2511.03282.tldr: The survey highlights existing articles from the last three years related to how XR utilises generative AI, providing insights into current trends and research gaps, and explores potential opportunities for future research to further empower XR through generative AI.

2511.03304.tldr: This work develops a model and fairness-score agnostic method for kernel embeddings applicable to continuous protected attributes and demonstrates that this approach in conjunction with Support Vector Regression provides competitive or improved performance across multiple datasets in comparisons to other contemporary methods.

2511.03328.tldr: Evaluating the active"thinking mode"capabilities of two leading MLLMs, Seed1.5-VL and Gemini-2.5-Flash, for medical applications reveals that the improvement from activating the thinking mode remains marginal compared to the standard non-thinking mode for the majority of the tasks.

2511.03330.tldr: OMRC-MR is proposed, a hierarchical framework that integrates QA-style OMRC summarization, multi-level contrastive learning, and structure-aware re-ranking for scholarly recommendation that provides a unified and interpretable content-based paradigm for scientific paper recommendation.

2511.03354.tldr: Six research questions are proposed, according to the preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analysis methods, to evaluate impactful GenAI strategies in methodological advancement, predictive performance, and specialization, and to identify promising approaches for advanced modeling, data-intensive discovery, and integrative biological analysis.

2511.03361.tldr: This work presents a new state-of-the-art Romanian Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) system based on NVIDIA’s FastConformer architecture that achieves state-of-the-art performance across all Romanian evaluation benchmarks, including read, spontaneous, and domain-specific speech.

2511.03367.tldr: This work proposes Adding Attributes to Prompt Learning, AAPL, a novel method that introduces adversarial token embeddings to decouple superficial visual variations introduced by augmentation from class-relevant semantic representations, which enables the learned prompts to concentrate on visually discriminative features that align with the target categories.

2511.03376.tldr: A framework that combines Large Language Models with computational image analytics for non-invasive, zero-shot prediction of IDH mutation status in brain gliomas is presented and results showcased high accuracy and balanced classification performance across heterogeneous cohorts, even in the absence of manual annotations.

2511.03405.tldr: Adaptable HER is introduced, a flexible framework that integrates HER with AlphaZero, allowing easy adjustments to HER properties such as relabeled goals, policy targets, and trajectory selection, and shows that the possibility of modifying HER is beneficial and surpasses the performance of pure supervised or reinforcement learning.

2511.03421.tldr: This work designs a lightweight linguistically induced matching mechanism for performance requirements quantification and compares LQPR against nine state-of-the-art learning-based approaches over diverse datasets, demonstrating that it is ranked as the sole best for 75% or more cases with two orders less cost.

2511.03434.tldr: A comparative study of trust models in inter-agent protocol design is presented, with hybrid trust model recommendations that mitigate reputation gaming and misinformed LLM behavior, and actionable design guidelines for safer, interoperable, and scalable agent economies are distill.

2511.03471.tldr: AAA is presented, which operationalizes WCAG-EM through a human-AI partnership model, enabling scalable, end-to-end web accessibility auditing, empowering human auditors with AI-enhanced assistance for real-world impact.

2511.03497.tldr: An MCP server for analyzing ROS and ROS2 bags, allowing for analyzing, visualizing and processing robot data with natural language through LLMs and VLMs, and provides a lightweight UI that allows the benchmarking of the tooling with different LLMs, both proprietary (Anthropic, OpenAI) and open-source (through Groq).

2511.03531.tldr: These findings demonstrate that the ENN framework offers a principled integration of signal processing concepts into neural network design, achieving a balanced trade-off between expressiveness, compactness, and interpretability.

2511.03542.tldr: SOLVE-Med is presented, a multi-agent architecture combining domain-specialized small language models for complex medical queries that achieves superior performance with ROUGE-1 of 0.301 and BERTScore F1 of 0.697, outperforming standalone models up to 14B parameters while enabling local deployment.

2511.03545.tldr: This research fills a significant gap in explainable AI (XAI) by providing a foundational understanding of the complexities of generating explanations for these models, and provides insights vital for further research in the domain of XAI.

2511.03549.tldr: A novel approach that leverages natural language artifacts from GitHub-such as pull request descriptions, issue descriptions and discussions, and commit messages-to enhance LLM-based code understanding, indicating that when insights are generated they often are helpful and non trivial, and are free from hallucinations.

2511.03553.tldr: This work generates zebra puzzles in multiple languages, themes, sizes and including 14 different clue types and 8 red herring types (uninformative clues), and finds no correlation between difficulty and the selected clue types.

2511.03559.tldr: These findings establish that localist language models provide a practical framework for applications in regulated domains requiring both transparency and capability, offering precise mathematical control over the interpretability-performance spectrum through explicit penalty thresholds and information-theoretic design principles.

2511.03565.tldr: This survey reviews the latest advances in imitation learning research, highlighting recent trends, methodological innovations, and practical applications, and proposes a novel taxonomy that is distinct from existing categorizations to better reflect the current state of the IL research stratum and its trends.

2511.03578.tldr: Constraint-Projected Learning keeps every update physically admissible by projecting network outputs onto the intersection of constraint sets defined by conservation, Rankine-Hugoniot balance, entropy, and positivity, and makes that behavior an intrinsic property of the learning process.

2511.03586.tldr: PerfLLM is introduced, a novel automatic optimization methodology leveraging Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning that allows effective optimization without prior hardware knowledge, facilitating both human analysis and RL agent training and its ability to achieve significant performance gains across diverse CPU (x86, Arm, RISC-V and GPU architectures.

2511.03617.tldr: The results indicate that the inclusion of visualization techniques can effectively influence the MLLM's judgment without compromising its self-reported confidence, and imply that practitioners must be careful of allowing users to include visualizations in generative AI applications so as to avoid undesired hallucinations.

2511.03628.tldr: Results show that high LMArena scores do not imply superior trading outcomes; models display distinct portfolio styles reflecting risk appetite and reasoning dynamics; and some LLMs effectively leverage live signals to adapt decisions, exposing a gap between static evaluation and real-world competence.

2511.03641.tldr: This paper proposes an accessible taxonomy of watermarking methods according to the stage of the LLM lifecycle at which they are applied, and proposes three normative dimensions to frame interoperability in LLM watermarking research.

2511.03656.tldr: This paper presents the Chinese Multi-Document Question Answering Dataset (ChiMDQA), specifically designed for downstream business scenarios across prevalent domains including academic, education, finance, law, medical treatment, and news.

2511.03670.tldr: A detailed study of Deep Q-Networks in finite environments, emphasizing the impact of epsilon-greedy exploration schedules and prioritized experience replay and offering practical recommendations for robust reinforcement learning in resource-constrained settings.

2511.03675.tldr: This paper introduces Whisper Leak, a side-channel attack that infers user prompt topics from encrypted LLM traffic by analyzing packet size and timing patterns in streaming responses, and underscores the need for LLM providers to address metadata leakage as AI systems handle increasingly sensitive information.

2511.03685.tldr: It is argued that parametric recalibration functions based on logistic regression can be motivated from a simple theoretical setting for both binary and multiclass classification, and lead to substantial gains over existing logistic-based calibration techniques.

2511.03690.tldr: The OpenHands Software Agent SDK is a complete architectural redesign of the agent components of the popular OpenHands framework, which uniquely integrates native sandboxed execution, lifecycle control, model-agnostic multi-LLM routing, and built-in security analysis.

2511.03718.tldr: A perspectivist annotation scheme for the HCRC MapTask corpus is introduced that separately captures speaker and addressee grounded interpretations for each reference expression, enabling us to trace how understanding emerges, diverges, and repairs over time.

2403.17467.tldr: The proposed UNK kernel maintains the limiting properties of both NNGP and NTK, exhibiting behaviors akin to NTK with a finite learning step and converging to NNGP as the learning step approaches infinity.

2406.02827.tldr: A novel Stochastic Diffusion model which learns data-driven prior knowledge at each time step by utilizing the representational power of the stochastic latent spaces to model the variability of the multivariate time series data is proposed.

2406.12264.tldr: A universal approximation theorem is obtained for continuous (possibly nonlinear) operators on arbitrary Banach spaces using the Leray-Schauder mapping and a method for operator learning in Banach spaces based on orthogonal projections on polynomial bases is introduced.

2406.17737.tldr: It is suggested that undesirable behaviors in state-of-the-art LLMs occur disproportionately more for users with lower English proficiency, of lower education status, and originating from outside the US, rendering these models unreliable sources of information towards their most vulnerable users.

2408.13406.tldr: Actionable design principles are proposed to assign complementary agent roles, enforce multi-level validation (execution, specification, physics), and prevent early consensus through adversarial or trigger-based interaction control, establishing a principled foundation for designing trustworthy LLM collaborations in engineering workflows.

2410.05500.tldr: This work introduces a plug-in module, called Residual Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (RKAN), which can be easily added into any stage (level) of traditional deep networks, where it learns to integrate supportive polynomial feature transformations to existing convolutional frameworks.

2410.18148.tldr: This work proposes the  learnable weighted hybrid AE, a hybrid approach that combines the strengths of singular value decomposition (SVD) with deep AEs through a learnable weighted framework, and finds that the introduction of learnable weighting parameters is essential.

2410.19964.tldr: It is observed that Adam's performance in training transformers degrades under random rotations of the parameter space, indicating a crucial sensitivity to the choice of basis in practice, and conventional rotation-invariant assumptions are revealed to be insufficient to capture Adam's advantages theoretically.

2410.21882.tldr: Preliminary exploration of human-like empathy-driven altruistic moral decision making is provided, contributing potential perspectives for developing ethically-aligned AI.

2410.23558.tldr: A novel black-box jailbreaking framework that integrates multiple LLM-as-Attacker strategies to deliver highly transferable and effective attacks that achieved top rankings in the Jailbreaking Attack Track.

2411.14133.tldr: Generative Adversarial Suffix Prompter (GASP) is introduced, a novel automated framework that can efficiently generate human-readable jailbreak prompts in a fully black-box setting and is an efficient and scalable solution for red-teaming LLMs.

2412.07236.tldr: A novel foundation model for EEG foundation models that can model spatial and temporal dependencies separately through two parallel attention mechanisms and utilize an asymmetric conditional positional encoding scheme which can encode positional information of EEG patches and be easily adapted to the EEG with diverse formats is proposed.

2502.09956.tldr: Along with KGGen, this work releases the first benchmark, Measure of of Information in Nodes and Edges (MINE), that tests an extractor's ability to produce a useful KG from plain text, and benchmarks the new tool against existing extractors and demonstrates far superior performance.

2503.03480.tldr: An integrated safety approach (ISA) is explored, systematically modeling safety requirements, then actively eliciting diverse unsafe behaviors, effectively constraining VLA policies via safe reinforcement learning, and rigorously assuring their safety through targeted evaluations.

2503.20110.tldr: This paper explores the transfer of fine-tuning updates between model versions, and derives the diff vector from one source model version and applies it to the base model of a different target version, showing that transferring diff vectors can significantly improve the performance of the target base model.

2503.22879.tldr: Quamba2 is presented, compatible with W8A8, W4A8, and W4A16 for both Mamba1 and Mamba2 backbones, addressing the growing demand for SSM deployment on various platforms and proposing an offline approach to quantize inputs of a linear recurrence in 8-bit by sorting and clustering for input input, combined with a per-state-group quantization for input-dependent parameters.

2505.04847.tldr: An enhanced hallucination leaderboard centered on FaithJudge that benchmarks LLMs on RAG faithfulness in summarization, question-answering, and data-to-text generation tasks and supports the development of more trustworthy generative AI systems.

2505.13567.tldr: A mathematical theory is developed describing the learning dynamics of linear RNNs trained in closed-loop contexts that shows that the learning dynamics of closed-loop RNNs are governed by an interplay between two competing objectives: short-term policy improvement and long-term stability of the agent-environment interaction.

2505.18574.tldr: This work presents Autocomp, an approach that empowers accelerator programmers to leverage domain knowledge and hardware feedback to optimize code via an automated LLM-driven search, and demonstrates that optimization schedules generated from Autocomp can be reused across similar tensor operations.

2505.18658.tldr: This survey systematically examines the nature of robustness in LLMs, including its conceptual foundations, the importance of consistent performance across diverse inputs, and the implications of failure modes in real-world applications.

2505.19853.tldr: A long-context video understanding benchmark, Causal2Needles, is proposed that assesses two crucial abilities insufficiently addressed by existing benchmarks: extracting information from two separate locations in a long video and understanding them jointly, and modeling the world in terms of cause and effect in human behaviors.

2505.20368.tldr: The Hierarchical Retrieval with Evidence Curation (HiREC) framework first performs hierarchical retrieval to reduce confusion among similar texts and then selects the most relevant passages from the documents to remove irrelevant passages.

2505.24630.tldr: Factuality-aware Step-wise Policy Optimization (FSPO) is proposed, an innovative RL fine-tuning algorithm incorporating explicit factuality verification at each reasoning step that effectively reduces hallucinations while enhancing reasoning accuracy, substantially improving both reliability and performance.

2505.24722.tldr: HELM is introduced, a family of HypErbolic Large Language Models, offering a geometric rethinking of the Transformer-based LLM that addresses the representational inflexibility, missing set of necessary operations, and poor scalability of existing hyperbolic LMs.

2506.04700.tldr: Dual-ISL is introduced, a novel likelihood-free objective for training implicit generative models that interchanges the roles of the target and model distributions in the ISL framework, yielding a convex optimization problem in the space of model densities and empirically shows that these theoretical advantages translate into practical ones.

2506.06991.tldr: This work investigates the potential of peer prediction -- a mechanism that evaluates the information within workers'sponses without using ground truth -- to mitigate LLM-assisted cheating in crowdsourcing with a focus on annotation tasks.

2506.15980.tldr: Experimental results show that SignViP achieves state-of-the-art performance across metrics, including video quality, temporal coherence, and semantic fidelity.

2507.02912.tldr: A novel graph-based deep learning framework DGL is proposed to analyze and forecast industrial CO_2 emissions, addressing high feature correlation and capturing industrial-temporal interdependencies, and is believed to be the first Graph-Temporal architecture that resolves multicollinearity by structurally encoding feature relationships.

2507.13956.tldr: A novel visual-language causality-inspired framework named Cross-modal Causal Intervention with Mediator for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis (MediAD) for diagnostic assistance that implicitly mitigates the effect of both observable and unobservable confounders through a unified causal intervention method.

2507.17978.tldr: MeAJOR (Merged email Assets from Joint Open-source Repositories) Corpus is presented, a novel, multi-source phishing email dataset designed to overcome critical limitations in existing resources and provide a reusable and consistent resource.

2508.00097.tldr: XRoboToolkit is presented, a cross-platform framework for extended reality based robot teleoperation built on the OpenXR standard that enables seamless integration across robotic platforms and simulation environments, spanning precision manipulators, mobile robots, and dexterous hands.

2508.10528.tldr: This work proposes Med-GLIP, a modality-aware grounding framework trained on Med-GLIP-5M, which implicitly acquires hierarchical semantic understanding from diverse training data-enabling it to recognize multi-granularity structures, such as distinguishing lungs from pneumonia lesions.

2509.01794.tldr: MBT-CB outperformed a comprehensive set of baselines including other BERT-based ML models, and its superior performance highlights its potential to improve CVD biomarker prediction and support clinical decision-making during pandemics.

2509.08217.tldr: This work empirically evaluates how a range of heuristics for annotator filtering affect the preservation of variation on subjective tasks, finding that conservative settings for annotator removal (<5%) are best, after which all tested methods increase the mean absolute error from the true average label.

2509.10641.tldr: A Test-Time Warmup method that adapts the MLLM per test instance by leveraging data from weakly supervised auxiliary tasks, demonstrating that'warming up'before inference can enhance MLLMs' robustness across diverse reasoning tasks.

2509.14912.tldr: Experiments show {\epsilon}ar-VAE at 44.1kHz substantially outperforms leading open-source models across diverse metrics, showing particular strength in reconstructing high-frequency harmonics and the spatial characteristics.

2509.15482.tldr: This work systematically analyzes the representational spaces of six CPath foundation models using techniques popularized in computational neuroscience to highlight opportunities to improve robustness to slide-specific features, inform model ensembling strategies, and provide insights into how training paradigms shape model representations.

2509.18629.tldr: This paper introduces HyperAdapt, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that significantly reduces the number of trainable parameters compared to state-of-the-art methods like LoRA, and establishes an upper bound on the rank of HyperAdapt's updates.

2510.05132.tldr: This work treats parallel reasoning as a set-of-next-token-prediction problem and incorporates a set-based global loss into Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) using bipartite matching between global forking tokens and unique reasoning traces to produce emergent global forking tokens.

2510.11903.tldr: A collection of public datasets are introduced, a unified formalization is proposed, and it is empirically show that models benefit from incorporating both personal and relational events.

2510.14955.tldr: RealDPO is introduced, a novel alignment paradigm that leverages real-world data as positive samples for preference learning, enabling more accurate motion synthesis and significantly improves video quality, text alignment, and motion realism compared to state-of-the-art models and existing preference optimization techniques.

2510.17697.tldr: This work designs a new MARL interaction paradigm, referred to as the targeted intervention paradigm that is applied to only a single targeted agent, so the problem of global guidance can be mitigated and the bundled relevance graph analysis of MAIDs provides a tool to identify whether an MARL learning paradigm is workable under the design of an MARL interaction paradigm.

2510.18751.tldr: This work introduces ALGae Observation and Segmentation (ALGOS), a segmentation-and-reasoning system for HAB monitoring that combines remote sensing image understanding with severity estimation and achieves robust performance on both segmentation and severity-level estimation.

2510.21814.tldr: Gestura is proposed, an end-to-end system for free-form gesture understanding that harnesses a pre-trained Large Vision-Language Model to align the highly dynamic and diverse patterns of free-form gestures with high-level semantic concepts and has developed the first open-source dataset for free-form gesture intention reasoning and understanding with over 300,000 annotated QA pairs.

2510.21849.tldr: The result is TowerVision, a family of open multilingual VLMs for both image-text and video-text tasks, built upon the multilingual text-only model Tower+.

2510.22968.tldr: This work establishes a viable and powerful new methodology for AI-driven instructional measurement, offering a path toward providing scalable, reliable, and valid feedback for educator development.

2511.00105.tldr: This systematic review synthesizes 258 studies examining AI applications across eight categories examining intelligent tutoring systems, learning analytics, automated assessment, computer vision, educational robotics, multimodal sensing, and AI-enhanced extended reality (XR) shows that most studies focus on upper elementary grades and mathematics.

2511.01019.tldr: OceanAI, a conversational platform that integrates the natural-language fluency of open-source large language models with real-time, parameterized access to authoritative oceanographic data streams hosted by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, is presented.

2511.01158.tldr: A high-throughput Spiking Neural Network (SNN) processor that supports synaptic delay-based emulation for edge applications that leverages a multicore pipelined architecture with parallel compute engines, capable of real-time processing of the computational load associated with synaptic delays.

2511.02263.tldr: LA-MARRVEL, a knowledge-grounded, language-aware LLM framework and designed for clinical robustness and practical deployment, suggests that knowledge-grounded LLM layer can enhance existing rare-disease gene prioritization workflows without altering established diagnostic pipelines.

2511.02880.tldr: NEF-NET+, an enhanced framework for realistic panoramic ECG synthesis that supports arbitrary-length signal synthesis from any desired view, generalizes across ECG devices, and compensates for operator-induced deviations in electrode placement is presented.

2511.02895.tldr: It is argued that criminology must begin to address the implications of this transition for crime and social control, and proposes a dual taxonomy to characterize the channels through which interactions among AI agents may generate deviant, unlawful, or criminal outcomes.

2511.03121.tldr: A control-based framework for aligning large language models (LLMs) by leveraging a control barrier function (CBF) to ensure user-desirable text generation to ensure user-desirable text generation is proposed.

2511.03684.tldr: This study presents an integrated 4D/5D digital-twin framework that couples Building Information Modeling with natural-language processing-based cost mapping, computer-vision-driven progress measurement, Bayesian probabilistic CPM updating, and deep-reinforcement-learning (DRL) resource-leveling to confirm that integrating AI-based analytics with probabilistic CPM and DRL enhances forecasting precision, transparency, and control resilience.

2511.03743.tldr: The response‐only model class selection capability of a novel deep convolutional neural network method is examined herein in a simple, yet effective, manner to select the model class in slight signal variations attributed to the damping behavior or hysteresis behavior on both linear and nonlinear dynamic systems, as well as on a 3D building finite element model.

2511.03747.tldr: This work presents Open-MENA (Open Memristor-in-Memory Accelerator), which, to their knowledge, is the first fully open memristor interfacing system integrating a reproducible hardware interface for memristor crossbars with mixed-signal read-program-verify loops.

2511.03749.tldr: This study proposes deep learning models tailored for univariate datasets, presenting cost-effective alternatives for grass growth forecasting and improving reliability in grass growth forecasting and contributing to the advancement of sustainable dairy farming practices.

2511.03757.tldr: LOLGORITHM, a modular multi-agent system (MAS) designed for controllable short-video comment generation on short-video platforms, is introduced, offering a promising path to enhance user engagement and creative interaction.

2511.03761.tldr: This work proposes a transaction-based framework to design very complex multi-agent systems (VCMAS) and offers to integrate transaction scheduling into the proposed framework and implements both of these ideas to develop the OptiMA framework.

2511.03771.tldr: A hierarchy-preserving contrastive framework that makes the label tree a first-class training signal and an evaluation target is presented, providing a simple, general recipe for learning medical image representations that respect the label tree and advance both performance and interpretability in hierarchy-rich domains.

2511.03782.tldr: It is found that curated data and multimodal retrieval significantly improve accuracy and depth and inform the development of trustworthy AI tools to advance scientific progress.

2511.03808.tldr: This work proposes a routing approach that assigns each problem to the smallest model likely to solve it, reducing compute without sacrificing accuracy, and demonstrates that difficulty-aware routing is effective for cost-efficient deployment of reasoning models.

2511.03823.tldr: PLLuM (Polish Large Language Model), the largest open-source family of foundation models tailored specifically for the Polish language, is presented, featuring a Responsible AI framework that incorporates strict data governance and a hybrid module for output correction and safety filtering.

2511.03825.tldr: This study conducts a thorough study on various tokenization models, systematically analyzing their efficiency in encoding assembly instructions and capturing semantic nuances, contributing to the robustness and scalability of Natural Language Model (NLM)-based binary analysis workflows.

2511.03845.tldr: A systematic benchmarking framework for assessing modality trade-offs in user-behavior reasoning across six MLLMs is presented, finding that when data is represented as images, MLLMs next-purchase prediction accuracy is improved by 87.5% compared with an equivalent textual representation without any additional computational cost.

2511.03855.tldr: This study investigates the use of fundamental noise injection techniques (Gaussian, Speckle, Poisson, and Salt and Pepper) during training and demonstrates that this technique can significantly reduce the performance gap between ID and OOD evaluation.

2511.03859.tldr: Insight is provided on the means for policymakers within institutions and their counterparts in civil society to personally engage with AI governance, based on the responses of personalized questionnaires designed to gather insight on a decision maker's institutional purview.

2511.03878.tldr: KnowThyself, an agentic assistant that advances large language model (LLM) interpretability by embedding the whole process into a conversational workflow, offers a robust foundation for accessible LLM interpretability.

2511.03882.tldr: An in silico sandbox for scalable, automated simulation of X-ray-guided spine procedures with a high degree of realism is developed and rollouts on real bi-planar X-rays suggest that the model can produce plausible trajectories, despite training exclusively in simulation.

2511.03898.tldr: This work evaluates secure code generation using the Instruct Prime, which eliminated compliance-required prompts and cue contamination, and evaluates five instruction-tuned code LLMs using a zero-shot baseline and a three-round reflexion prompting approach, finding that Reflexion prompting improves security for all models.

2511.03907.tldr: SnappyMeal is proposed, an AI-powered dietary tracking system that leverages multimodal inputs to enable users to more flexibly log their food intake and introduces goal-dependent follow-up questions to intelligently seek missing context from the user and information retrieval from user grocery receipts and nutritional databases to improve accuracy.

2511.03913.tldr: This study studies the performance of an evolutionary optimization method, namely Separable Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (sep-CMA-ES), against the widely adopted Adaptive Moment Estimation (Adam), applied to Stable Diffusion XL Turbo's prompt embedding vector, indicating that the evolutionary method provides efficient, gradient-free optimization for diffusion models, enhancing controllability without the need for fine-tuning.

2511.03925.tldr: RAMP is a novel lightweight framework that formulates program repair as a feedback-driven, iterative process for Ruby, and provides new insights into multi-agent repair strategies, and establishes a foundation for extending LLM-based debugging tools to under-studied languages.

2511.03934.tldr: This work presents an agentic flow consisting of multiple agents that combine specialized LLMs and hardware simulation tools to collaboratively complete the complex task of Register Transfer Level (RTL) generation without human intervention, providing state-of-the-art pass rates while being efficient in token counts.

2511.03939.tldr: This survey synthesizes the new frontier of alignment research by addressing critical gaps in multi-modal alignment, cultural fairness, and low-latency optimization by reviewing foundational algo- rithms, including PPO, DPO, and GRPO.

2511.03945.tldr: This paper forms a latent bridge via vector translations, which use learned mappings that enable direct semantic exchange between representation spaces, enabling collaborative AI systems that share meaning rather than tokens.

2511.03948.tldr: This paper demonstrates that DKT's strength lies in its implicit ability to model prerequisite relationships as a causal structure, rather than bidirectional relationships, and proposes an alternative method for extracting exercise relation DAGs using DKT's learned representations.

2511.03976.tldr: PETRA(Pretrained Evolutionary TRAnsformer), a novel transformer approach based on evolutionary trajectories derived from phylogenetic trees rather than raw RNA sequences, which effectively mitigates sequencing noise and captures the hierarchical structure of viral evolution.

2511.03980.tldr: Findings reveal that LLMs occupy an uncomfortable middle ground: They are responsive enough to changes in prompts to produce variation, but they are also too firmly anchored to specific cultural defaults to adequately represent cultural diversity.

2511.03985.tldr: This work introduces ArchPilot, a multi-agent system that integrates architecture generation, proxy-based evaluation, and adaptive search into a unified framework, and demonstrates that ArchPilot outperforms SOTA baselines such as AIDE and ML-Master, validating the effectiveness of the multi-agent system.

2511.03993.tldr: This work proposes a Ca$^{2+}-modulated learning framework that draws inspiration from astrocytic Ca$^{2+}$ signaling in the brain, where rapid, context-sensitive adaptation enables robust information processing in the brain and offers a generic solution for streaming detection tasks that require rapid, biologically grounded adaptation to evolving data patterns.

2511.03995.tldr: This work presents a hybrid fuzzing framework that integrates static and dynamic analysis with Large Language Model-guided input mutation and semantic feedback, highlighting the potential of combining LLM reasoning with semantic-aware feedback to accelerate and deepen vulnerability discovery.

2511.04000.tldr: This work introduces an efficient, scalable method for generating synthetic pre-training data to enable meta-learning of decision trees, using the MetaTree transformer architecture, and demonstrates that this method achieves performance comparable to pre-training on real-world data or with computationally expensive optimal decision trees.

2511.04001.tldr: A common task framework for science and engineering is introduced, which features a growing collection of challenge data sets with a diverse set of practical and common objectives to compare the diverse algorithms being rapidly developed and deployed in practice today across science and engineering.

2511.04002.tldr: This work introduces the first autoregressive-aware split computing framework designed explicitly for LLM deployment on edge devices and develops one-point split compression (OPSC), a mixed-precision quantization scheme that prevents out-of-memory failures by strategically partitioning models into front-end and back-end segments with different precision levels.

2511.04020.tldr: This work proposes a framework that integrates abductive inference into retrieval-augmented LLMs, and shows that this approach improves both answer accuracy and reasoning faithfulness of RAG systems.

2511.04032.tldr: This work provides the first systematic study of anomaly detection in Multi-Agentic AI systems, offering datasets, benchmarks, and insights to guide future research.

2511.04086.tldr: DeNoise is proposed, a robust UGAD framework explicitly designed for contaminated training data that jointly optimizes a graph-level encoder, an attribute decoder, and a structure decoder via an adversarial objective to learn noise-resistant embeddings.

2511.04090.tldr: This paper examines AI representations of diverse Latin American contexts, revealing disparities between data from economically advanced and developing regions, and advocates for equitable AI by prioritizing datasets that reflect Latin American history, indigenous knowledge, and diverse languages, while emphasizing community-centered approaches to amplify marginalized voices.

2511.04092.tldr: This paper defines and proves, for the first time, a new logical structure known as rectangular standard contradiction, and proves that partitioning a rectangular standard contradiction into a premise subset and negation of its complement $H$ can be formed, and all such theorems are logically equivalent.

2511.04093.tldr: The LLM-KGFR collaborative framework, where an LLM works with a structured retriever, the Knowledge Graph Foundation Retriever (KGFR), achieves strong performance while maintaining scalability and generalization, providing a practical solution for KG-augmented reasoning.

2511.04103.tldr: This work revisit the classic language identification problem in the setting where the learner is given the additional power of producing a list of guesses at each time step, and gives an exact characterization of collections of languages that can be identified in the limit.

2511.04114.tldr: An automated framework for detecting and interpreting DDoS attacks using machine learning (ML) that leverages the Tree-based Pipeline Optimization Tool (TPOT) to automate the selection and optimization of ML models and features, reducing the need for manual experimentation.

2511.04126.tldr: This framework integrates multiple deep learning models to detect and track players and the tennis ball in real time, while also identifying court keypoints for spatial reference, enabling coaches, broadcasters, and players to gain actionable insights into the dynamics of the game.

2511.04137.tldr: A framework that retrieves and filters tutorial videos, converts them into structured demonstration trajectories, and dynamically selects trajectories as in-context guidance during execution is proposed, suggesting that abundant online videos can be systematically distilled into actionable guidance that improves computer-use agents at inference time.

2511.04144.tldr: This study analyzed student-AI interactions through a metacognitive lens in university-level programming courses to distill design considerations for AI-powered coding assistants that aim to support rather than supplant metacognitive engagement.

2511.04153.tldr: Three multi-agent LLM pipelines are explored, with systematic performance benchmarking across a range of small to large open-source models, and it is revealed that Multi-Agent discussion can improve small model performance, with up to 10.6% increase in Execution Accuracy for Qwen2.5-7b-Instruct seen after three rounds of discussion.

2511.04157.tldr: The results show that LLMs generally align more closely with AI practitioners than with the US-representative sample, emphasizing fairness, privacy, transparency, safety, and accountability, but inconsistencies appear between the values that LLMs claim to uphold and the way they prioritize requirements.

2511.04171.tldr: Investigating how various color transformation techniques affect image registration between hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) stained images and non-linear multimodal images shows that applying color transformation before registration improves alignment between images from different modalities and supports more reliable analysis in digital pathology.

2511.04177.tldr: This work empirically shows that assistive RL agents optimizing for one human's empowerment can significantly reduce another human's environmental influence and rewards - a phenomenon that is formalized as disempowerment - and reveals a broader challenge for the AI alignment community.

2511.04179.tldr: SAFE, an Integrated Development Environment (IDE) plugin that leverages GPT-4o to explain the causes, impacts, and mitigation strategies of vulnerabilities detected by SAST tools, is presented.

2511.04183.tldr: This paper presents a reinforced genetic approach to a defined d-resource system optimization problem that has introduced several modifications and adaptations to standard genetic routines, e.g.: a migration operator which is an analogy to the biological random genetic drift.

2511.04184.tldr: This position paper systematically evaluates the trustworthiness requirements for LAAC's deployment across multiple communication domains and investigates three fundamental dimensions: Information Capture Fidelity, Reproducibility, and Query Response Integrity - reliability of recipient-facing responses without hallucination, source conflation, or fabrication.

2511.04192.tldr: A novel Adaptive Statistics Fusor which consists of Style Disentanglement Module (SDM) and High-Order Multi-Statistics Attention (HOS-Attn) and shows proficiency superiority in motion style transfers over state-of-the-arts.

2511.04217.tldr: A theoretical analysis of the existence of SLTs within MHAs and empirically validate the findings, demonstrating that the approximation error between the SLT within a source model (MHA and transformer) and an approximate target counterpart decreases exponentially by increasing the hidden dimension of the source model.

2511.04220.tldr: The Opus Workflow Reward model is introduced, a probabilistic-normative formulation for quantifying Workflow quality and efficiency that formalizes Workflow success as a probabilistic expectation over costs and outcomes and a unified optimization formulation for identifying and ranking optimal Workflows under joint Reward-Penalty trade-offs.

2511.04237.tldr: A novel GNN-based CF model called DRCSD is proposed for denoising unstable interactions and achieves statistically significant performance improvements in recommendation accuracy metrics compared to state-of-the-art baseline models.

2511.04255.tldr: This proposed model, MedSapiens, demonstrates that human-centric foundation models, inherently optimized for spatial pose localization, provide strong priors for anatomical landmark detection, yet this potential has remained largely untapped.

2511.04285.tldr: RLoop transforms the standard training process into a virtuous cycle: it first uses RL to explore the solution space from a given policy, then filters the successful trajectories to create an expert dataset, creating a superior starting point for the next iteration.

2511.04286.tldr: A hybrid framework that unifies RLHF's scalability with PBO's query efficiency by integrating an acquisition-driven module into the RLHF pipeline, thereby enabling active and sample-efficient preference gathering and consistent improvements in both sample efficiency and overall performance across these tasks.

2511.04304.tldr: This study investigates the use of synthetic training data to enhance model performance and analysed how synthetic data enhances the representation of unbalanced classes and overall model performance, taking a first step towards globally transferable detection of offshore infrastructure.

2511.04312.tldr: A novel concept localization method based on spatial linear attribution is introduced, and a comprehensive comparison of it to existing feature visualization techniques for detecting and mitigating concept misalignment is provided.

2511.04316.tldr: AdversariaLLM is introduced, a toolbox for conducting LLM jailbreak robustness research that centers on reproducibility, correctness, and extensibility, and integrates seven benchmark datasets spanning harmfulness, over-refusal, and utility evaluation.

2511.04321.tldr: AIM, comprehensive software and hardware co-design for architecture-level IR-drop mitigation in high-performance PIM, and IR-Booster, a dynamic adjustment mechanism that integrates software-level HR information with hardware-based IR-drop monitoring to adapt the V-f pairs of the PIM macro, achieving enhanced energy efficiency and performance.

2511.04328.tldr: This work proposes a novel frame-work to simulate and evaluate clinical consultation scenarios for systematically assessing the medication safety capabilities of Large Language Models, and introduces RxSafeBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for assessing medication safety in LLMs.

2511.04332.tldr: A DP framework for in-context learning that integrates nearest neighbor search of relevant examples in a privacy-aware manner is introduced, and experimental results on text classification and document question answering show a clear advantage of the proposed method over existing baselines.

2511.04333.tldr: This work proposes a novel Gibbs sampling-based method for learning DBNs from incomplete data, which treats each missing value as an unknown parameter following a Gaussian distribution, allowing for principled imputation and uncertainty estimation.

2511.04393.tldr: This work introduces Iterative Regret-Minimization Fine-Tuning (Iterative RMFT), a post-training procedure that repeatedly distills low-regret decision trajectories back into the base model and leverages the regret metric to elicit the model's own DM ability and reasoning rationales.

2511.04401.tldr: By imposing theoretical constraints at the embedding level, SCER encourages models to focus on core features while reducing sensitivity to spurious patterns, showing theoretically that worst-group error is influenced by how strongly the classifier relies on spurious versus core directions.

2511.04422.tldr: This work shows that a regression problem with M samples lying on a hyperplane has a one-to-one equivalence with a linearly separable classification task with 2M samples, and demonstrates a ``regressability'' measure, that can be used to estimate the difficulty of regressing a dataset, without needing to first learn a model for it.

2511.04451.tldr: A novel approach to approximate the Koopman operator using an LSTM-enhanced Deep Koopman model, enabling linear representations of nonlinear systems with time delays by incorporating Long Short-Term Memory layers.

2511.04464.tldr: PAVe (Personalized Agentic Vehicular Routing), a hybrid agentic assistant designed to augment classical pathfinding algorithms with contextual reasoning, is introduced and evaluated, concluding that combining classical routing algorithms with an LLM-based semantic reasoning layer is a robust and effective approach for creating personalized, adaptive, and scalable solutions for urban mobility optimization.

2511.04465.tldr: A model of subscription-based platforms where users pay a fixed fee for unlimited access to content, and creators receive a share of the revenue is studied, showing that a mechanism widely used by streaming platforms, fails to prevent fraud, but also makes detecting manipulation computationally intractable.

2511.04478.tldr: A tool that integrates synthetic data generation into the LLM-as-a-judge workflow, empowering users to create tailored and challenging test cases with configurable domains, personas, lengths, and desired outcomes, including borderline cases is presented.

2511.04481.tldr: This work provides an initial exploration of the energy and $CO_2$ cost associated with web agents from both a theoretical -via estimation- and an empirical perspective -by benchmarking.

2511.04491.tldr: RUST-BENCH is introduced, a benchmark of 7966 questions from 2031 real-world tables spanning two domains: i) RB-Science (NSF grant records) and ii) RB-Sports (NBA statistics) that evaluates LLMs jointly across scale, heterogeneity, domain specificity, and reasoning complexity.

2511.04499.tldr: This paper systematically evaluates six LLMs, applying the Big Five Inventory-2 (BFI-2) framework, to assess trait expressions under varying sampling temperatures, finding significant differences across four of the five personality dimensions.

2511.04502.tldr: This paper introduces RAGalyst, an automated, human-aligned agentic framework designed for the rigorous evaluation of domain-specific RAG systems, and finds that performance is highly context-dependent and no single embedding model, LLM, or hyperparameter configuration proves universally optimal.

2511.04527.tldr: This work uses hidden activations to control and predict a language model's uncertainty during chain-of-thought reasoning, and finds that hidden activations can predict a model's future outcome distribution, demonstrating that models implicitly represent the space of possible paths.

2511.04541.tldr: This work investigates how Large Language Models (LLM) can effectively act as world models of user preferences through pairwise reasoning over slates and reveals relationships between task performance and properties of the preference function captured by LLMs.

2511.04557.tldr: A temporal subgraph sampler is introduced that enhances global context by retrieving nodes beyond the immediate neighborhood to capture temporally relevant relationships and the Relational Graph Perceiver is proposed, a graph transformer architecture for relational deep learning that leverages a cross-attention-based latent bottleneck to efficiently integrate information from both structural and temporal contexts.

2511.04588.tldr: An auditing framework for measuring the level of representation provided by a slate of questions, based on the social choice concept known as justified representation (JR), is introduced and the first algorithms for auditing JR are presented in the general utility setting.

2511.04646.tldr: DR. WELL is presented, a decentralized neurosymbolic framework for cooperative multi-agent planning that avoids brittle step-level alignment and enables higher-level operations that are reusable, synchronizable, and interpretable.

2511.04662.tldr: VeriCoT is introduced, a neuro-symbolic method that extracts and verifies formal logical arguments from CoT reasoning and identifies premises that ground the argument in source context, commonsense knowledge, or prior reasoning steps.

2511.04671.tldr: X-Diffusion is presented, a cross-embodiment learning framework based on Ambient Diffusion that selectively trains diffusion policies on noised human actions that enables effective use of easy-to-collect human videos without sacrificing robot feasibility.

2511.04069.tldr: The proposed ResNet model achieved strong performance in identifying appendicitis across heterogeneous ultrasound views, overcoming challenges posed by low contrast, speckle noise, and anatomical variability in pediatric imaging.

2511.04071.tldr: The proposed nnUNet model achieved a mean Dice score of 93.5, demonstrating high overlap with expert annotations and outperforming several traditional segmentation approaches reported in previous studies, and exhibited robust generalization across variations in left atrial shape, contrast, and image quality.

2309.01336.tldr: A residual bootstrap algorithm to generate interval estimates of day-ahead electricity demand to provide a range of values within which the future values might lie and quantify the errors around the point estimates.

2402.18905.tldr: It is shown that differentially private full fine-tuning (DP-FFT) can distort pre-trained backbone features, and it is proved that a sequential fine-tuning strategy can mitigate the feature distortion: first-linear-probing-then-fine-tuning (DP-LP-FFT).

2403.06524.tldr: The results demonstrate that it is beneficial to separate high-level decision-making processes and low-level control actions between the reinforcement learning agent and the low-level controllers based on physical models.

2407.04396.tldr: A novel Fundus On-the-fly Test-Time Adaptation (FunOTTA) framework that effectively generalizes a fundus image diagnosis model to unseen environments, even under strong domain shifts, is proposed and compared with several state-of-the-art test-time adaptation pipelines.

2409.01083.tldr: This framework seamlessly unifies affordance learning and action generation with flow matching for robot manipulation, which leads to consistently favorable results in several robot manipulation benchmarks than some alternative behavior cloning methods.

2410.14865.tldr: A method is developed that converts generated robot programs into an automaton-based representation and verifies them against task-relevant safety specifications, and establishes a theorem that any arbitrary combination of the verified programs will also satisfy the safety specifications.

2410.15040.tldr: This work proposes a retrieval-augmented diffusion framework, termed RADAb, for efficient antibody design that leverages a set of structural homologous motifs that align with query structural constraints to guide the generative model in inversely optimizing antibodies according to desired design criteria.

2411.00696.tldr: This work introduces a Cross-Modal Temporal Pattern Discovery (CTPD) framework, designed to efficiently extract meaningful cross-modal temporal patterns from multimodal EHR data and introduces shared initial temporal pattern representations which are refined using slot attention to generate temporal semantic embeddings.

2412.05447.tldr: TOBUGraph is a graph-based retrieval framework that first constructs the knowledge graph from unstructured data dynamically and automatically, using LLMs, and extracts structured knowledge and diverse relationships among data, going beyond RAG's text-to-text similarity.

2501.03265.tldr: Cognitive Edge Computing is surveyed as a practical and methodical pathway for deploying reasoning-capable Large Language Models and autonomous AI agents on resource-constrained devices at the network edge to deliver reliable, efficient, and privacy-preserving cognitive capabilities on edge devices.

2501.08828.tldr: A new benchmark, named MMDocIR, is introduced that encompasses two distinct tasks: page-level and layout-level retrieval, and demonstrates that visual retrievers significantly outperform their text counterparts and text retrievers leveraging VLM-text significantly outperforms retrievers relying on OCR-text.

2501.09766.tldr: This work proposes an iterative reinforced fine-tuning strategy aimed at iteratively pinpointing the model's deficiency by constructing fine-grained preference pairs, and then improving it by preference optimization algorithms for targeted improvement.

2502.02421.tldr: Activation-Informed Merging (AIM) is introduced, a technique that integrates the information from the activation space of LLMs into the merging process to improve performance and robustness and is designed as a flexible, complementary solution that is applicable to any existing merging method.

2502.03503.tldr: This paper provides a mathematical analysis demonstrating that transformers cannot achieve general predictive accuracy due to inherent architectural limitations, and challenges claims from prior research that transformer-based models, when learning in context, implicitly implement standard learning algorithms.

2502.15027.tldr: InterFeedback is designed, an interactive framework, which can be applied to any LMM and dataset to assess this ability autonomously to interpret and benefit from feedback, and introduces InterFeedback-Bench which evaluates interactive intelligence using two representative datasets.

2502.16395.tldr: AIRepr, an Analyst-Inspector framework for automatically evaluating and improving the reproducibility of LLM-generated data analysis workflows, is presented and provides a foundation for transparent, reliable, and efficient human-AI collaboration in data science.

2503.04412.tldr: Empirical results show that AB-MCTS consistently outperforms both repeated sampling and standard MCTS, underscoring the importance of combining the response diversity of LLMs with multi-turn solution refinement for effective inference-time scaling.

2504.06265.tldr: This work shows that training language models through the uncertainty-aware objectives of traditional optimization methods enables their use as reliable optimizers guided by natural language, and establishes a new paradigm for reliable, uncertainty-guided optimization with LLMs.

2504.21700.tldr: An Explainable-AI solution that comparatively analyzes the behavior of censored and uncensored models to derive unique exploitable alignment patterns and a novel approach that exploits these unique patterns to break the security and alignment constraints of LLMs by targeted noise injection is proposed.

2505.13438.tldr: A novel framework, AnytimeReasoner, to optimize anytime reasoning performance, which aims to improve token efficiency and the flexibility of reasoning under varying token budget constraints and introduces verifiable dense rewards into the reasoning process.

2506.01502.tldr: This work introduces an approach that combines the JKO framework with inverse optimization techniques to learn population dynamics, and relies on a conventional adversarial training procedure that does not require restrictive architectural choices, e.g., input-convex neural networks.

2506.05305.tldr: ProRefine is introduced, an innovative inference-time optimization method that uses an agentic loop of LLMs to generate and apply textual feedback that highlights its potential for building more cost-effective and powerful hybrid AI systems, thereby democratizing access to high-performing AI.

2506.05583.tldr: This work proposes new methods that provably adapt conformal prediction to unknown subpopulation shifts, ensuring valid coverage without explicit knowledge of subpopulation structure and characterizes conditions where formal coverage guarantees remain feasible.

2506.09338.tldr: Aninstance-adaptive scaling (IAS) framework is introduced that dynamically adjusts the compute budget based on the estimated likelihood that a partial reasoning trajectory will yield a correct final answer, and the proposed IAS strategy reduces inference costs while maintaining final answer accuracy.

2506.16471.tldr: Progressive Inference-Time Annealing (PITA), a novel framework to learn diffusion-based samplers that combines two complementary interpolation techniques, enables equilibrium sampling of N-body particle systems, Alanine Dipeptide, and tripeptides in Cartesian coordinates with dramatically lower energy function evaluations.

2506.22331.tldr: Less Greedy Equivalence Search is developed, a variant of GES that retains its theoretical guarantees while partially addressing these limitations, and it is proved that LGES recovers the true equivalence class in the sample limit, even with misspecified knowledge.

2507.03279.tldr: Conformal Information Pursuit is proposed, an alternative approach to sequential information gain based on conformal prediction sets that obtains better predictive performance and shorter query-answer chains compared to previous approaches to IP and uncertainty-based chain-of-thought methods.

2507.04270.tldr: ZERO is the first vision foundation model explicitly built for domain-specific, zero-shot industrial applications, and achieves 2nd place in the CVPR 2025 Object Instance Detection Challenge and 4th place in the Foundational Few-shot Object Detection Challenge, highlighting its practical deployability and generalizability with minimal adaptation and limited data.

2507.05636.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive introduction to graph learning, focusing on key dimensions including scalable, temporal, multimodal, multimodal, generative, explainable, and responsible graph learning.

2507.09601.tldr: NMIXX (Neural eMbeddings for Cross-lingual eXploration of Finance), a suite of cross-lingual embedding models fine-tuned with 18.8K high-confidence triplets that pair in-domain paraphrases, hard negatives derived from a semantic-shift typology, and exact Korean-English translations, is introduced.

2507.21069.tldr: This work presents a multimodal dataset of physiotherapeutic and gait-related exercises, including correct and clinically relevant variants, recorded from 19 healthy subjects using synchronized IMUs and optical marker-based motion capture (MoCap).

2508.02189.tldr: This work integrates first-order MAML with subset-masked LM pretraining, producing four LLama-style decoder-only models (11M-570M params), and evaluates it on a fundamental NLP task with many settings and real-world applications.

2508.05210.tldr: A new deep learning Hybrid LSTM-Trans-Mixer-Att framework is presented that combines sequential memory, static feature interactions, global context learning, and dynamic feature weighting, providing a comprehensive solution for the heterogeneous and event-driven nature of drilling dynamics.

2508.14926.tldr: This work provides a reproducible benchmark for Safe RL with explicitly ethics-aware objectives in human-mixed traffic scenarios and highlights the potential of combining formal control theory and data-driven learning to advance ethically accountable autonomy that explicitly protects those most at risk in urban traffic environments.

2508.18312.tldr: It is shown that the quality of chosen responses plays a dominant role in optimizing the DPO objective, while the quality of rejected responses may have relatively limited impact.

2509.00616.tldr: TimeCopilot is introduced, the first open-source agentic framework for forecasting that combines multiple Time Series Foundation Models with Large Language Models through a single unified API, and achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting performance at low cost.

2509.03505.tldr: LimiX-16M and LimiX-2M are presented, two instantiations of the authors' large structured-data models that treat structured data as a joint distribution over variables and missingness, thus capable of addressing a wide range of tabular tasks through query-based conditional prediction via a single model.

2509.12386.tldr: Amulet is introduced, the first Python library for evaluating both intended and unintended interactions among ML defenses and risks, enabling the first systematic evaluation of unintended interactions across multiple risks.

2509.18116.tldr: Amortized Latent Steering (ALS) is proposed, which collapses this iterative optimization into a single offline-computed vector applied at constant cost during inference, showing that much of latent optimization's benefit can be captured offline, making sophisticated reasoning techniques viable for production deployment.

2509.18883.tldr: This work presents LongCat-Flash-Thinking, an efficient 560-billion-parameter open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning model, which exhibits exceptional efficiency in agentic reasoning, reducing average token consumption by 64.5% on AIME-25 without degrading task accuracy.

2509.21993.tldr: The results establish that training on a relational knowledge dataset induces the emergence of bilinear internal representations, which in turn support language models in behaving in a logically consistent manner after editing, suggesting that the efficacy of language model editing depends not only on the choice of algorithm but on the underlying representational geometry of the knowledge itself.

2509.23994.tldr: A regulatory machine learning framework that converts unstructured design artifacts into verifiable runtime guardrails and generates auditable rationales aligned with AI governance frameworks that enables secure-by-design deployment, continuous compliance, and scalable AI safety and AI security assurance for regulatable ML.

2510.04173.tldr: Open Agent Specification is introduced, a declarative language that defines AI agents and agentic workflows in a way that is compatible across frameworks, promoting reusability, portability and interoperability of AI agents.

2510.07871.tldr: The approach augments Falcon with collision risk understanding that learns to predict distance-based collision risk scores for surrounding humans, which enables the agent to develop more robust spatial awareness and proactive collision avoidance behaviors.

2510.15144.tldr: HugAgent (Human-Grounded Agent Benchmark) is introduced, which rethinks human reasoning simulation along three dimensions: from averaged to individualized reasoning, from behavioral mimicry to cognitive alignment, and from vignette-based to open-ended data.

2510.15418.tldr: A specialization framework that adapts MedGemma into a high-quality query generator is introduced, creating a factually-grounded query generation component critical for multimodal clinical decision support systems.

2510.16227.tldr: This work presents a theoretical analysis of the relationship between grammar, meaning, and string probability, based on simple assumptions about the generative process of corpus data, and suggests directions for future work in LM grammatical evaluation.

2510.17797.tldr: Enterprise Deep Research is presented, a multi-agent system that integrates a Master Planning Agent for adaptive query decomposition, four specialized search agents, an extensible MCP-based tool ecosystem supporting NL2SQL, file analysis, and enterprise workflows, and a Visualization Agent for data-driven insights.

2510.22115.tldr: At the trillion scale, Ling-1T establishes a new Pareto frontier of reasoning accuracy versus computational efficiency, demonstrating that sparse activation, when properly aligned with reasoning objectives, enables scalable and efficient intelligence.

2510.22780.tldr: While agents exhibit promise in their alignment to human workflows, they take an overwhelmingly programmatic approach across all work domains, even for open-ended, visually dependent tasks like design, creating a contrast with the UI-centric methods typically used by humans.

2510.22990.tldr: The Ultrasound Self-Supervised Foundation Model with Masked Autoencoding (USF-MAE), the first large-scale self-supervised MAE framework pretrained exclusively on ultrasound data, is introduced, demonstrating strong cross-anatomical generalization.

2510.24145.tldr: This paper presents OpsAgent, a lightweight, self-evolving multi-agent system for IM that employs a training-free data processor to convert heterogeneous observability data into structured textual descriptions, along with a multi-agent collaboration framework that makes diagnostic inference transparent and auditable.

2510.25441.tldr: This work introduces Learn-to-Ask, a general, simulator-free framework for learning and deploying proactive dialogue agents directly from offline expert data, bypassing the need to model complex user dynamics.

2511.01348.tldr: A shared perspective on the future of GenAI-driven software engineering is presented, grounded in cross-sector dialogue as well as experiences and findings within the GENIUS consortium, providing a foundation for reliable, scalable, and industry-ready GenAI solutions for software engineering teams.

2511.02818.tldr: Orion-MSP is introduced, a tabular ICL architecture featuring three key innovations: multi-scale processing to capture hierarchical feature interactions; block-sparse attention combining windowed, global, and random patterns for scalable efficiency and long-range connectivity; and a Perceiver-style memory enabling safe bidirectional information flow across components.

2511.03211.tldr: The role of public interest litigation in promoting accountability for AI and automated decision-making (ADM) in Australia is examined and original insights on pragmatic strategies and tactics for effective public interest litigation about ADM are presented.

2511.03724.tldr: Solly is presented, the first AI agent to achieve elite human play in reduced-format Liar's Poker, a game characterized by extensive multi-player engagement and outperformed large language models, including those with reasoning abilities, on the same metrics.

2511.03891.tldr: This paper introduces Class-Based Image Composition, an approach that allows us to reformulate training inputs through a fusion of multiple images of the same class into combined visual composites, named Composite Input Images (CoImg), that enhances the intra-class variance and improves the valuable information density per training sample.

2511.03929.tldr: Nemotron Nano V2 VL is introduced, the latest model of the Nemotron vision-language series designed for strong real-world document understanding, long video comprehension, and reasoning tasks, and major enhancements in model architecture, datasets, and training recipes are introduced.

2511.04247.tldr: This paper evaluates a diverse set of lexical, syntactic, and semantic perturbations across multiple CLIP variants using the TRECVID Ad-Hoc Video Search queries and the V3C1 video collection to highlight robustness as a critical dimension for evaluating vision-language models beyond benchmark accuracy.

2511.04682.tldr: The Load-Balance-Longest-Path (LBLP) algorithm is introduced, that dynamically assigns all CNN nodes to the available IMCE PUs, for maximizing the processing rate and minimizing latency due to efficient resources utilization.

2511.04683.tldr: This work establishes the first validated AI-agent methodology for academic citation integrity, demonstrating practical applicability for supervisors, students, and institutional quality assurance.

2511.04685.tldr: This work describes the algorithm, implementation and results submitted to the Integrated Healthcare Timetabling Competition 2024 by Team Twente, which scored third in the competition, and shares insights and lower bounds on the optimal solution values for the benchmark instances.

2511.04686.tldr: This paper examines the interplay between KV cache management strategies, the architectural context limits of models like meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8b-instruct, and the often-overlooked integrity of positional encodings, and advocates for eviction techniques that respect architectural limits, preserve positional structure, and view"cache health"holistically beyond mere size.

2511.04691.tldr: Two of the three architectural modifications introduced in the state-of-the-art EEG decoder improved performance, highlighting the promise of personalized architectures for brain-to-speech decoding and applications in brain-computer interfaces.

2511.04696.tldr: EncouRAGe is introduced, a comprehensive Python framework designed to streamline the development and evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems using Large Language Models and Embedding Models, and results show that RAG still underperforms compared to the Oracle Context, while Hybrid BM25 consistently achieves the best results across all four datasets.

2511.04697.tldr: This work develops an agent-based simulation using Large Language Models to model responses to misinformation, and shows that LLM-generated agents align closely with ground-truth labels and human predictions, supporting their use as proxies for studying information responses.

2511.04700.tldr: This work proposes WinnowRAG, a novel RAG framework designed to systematically filter out noisy documents while preserving valuable content -- a process they refer to as winnowing, and proposes two strategic merging techniques to ensure that only relevant knowledge is used for generating the final response.

2511.04703.tldr: A systematic review of 445 LLM benchmarks from leading conferences in natural language processing and machine learning finds patterns related to the measured phenomena, tasks, and scoring metrics which undermine the validity of the resulting claims.

2511.04705.tldr: A large-scale evaluation of over 10 state-of-the-art LLMs on POLIS-Bench reveals a clear performance hierarchy where reasoning models maintain superior cross-task stability and accuracy, highlighting the difficulty of compliance tasks.

2511.04707.tldr: NINJA (short for Needle-in-haystack jailbreak attack), a method that jailbreaks aligned LMs by appending benign, model-generated content to harmful user goals to reveal fundamental vulnerabilities in modern LMs.

2511.04711.tldr: This paper investigates model copyright protection by auditing whether suspicious third-party models incorporate protected soft prompts, and proposes sequential watermarking for soft prompts (SWAP), which implants watermarks into a different and more complex space.

2511.04716.tldr: This paper introduces a novel and realistic grey box threat model that exploits the explainability features of these platforms, where a model's internal knowledge state vectors are exposed to users through visualizations such as radar charts, and proposes a profile-based MIA framework that leverages both the model's final prediction probabilities and the exposed internal knowledge state vectors as features.

2511.04720.tldr: RADAR, Retrieval Augmented Diagnostic Reasoning Agents, an agentic system for rare disease detection in brain MRI is introduced, designed as a model-agnostic reasoning module that can be seamlessly integrated with diverse large language models, consistently improving their rare pathology recognition and interpretability.

2511.04727.tldr: IndicVisionBench is introduced, the first large-scale benchmark centered on the Indian subcontinent and establishes a reproducible evaluation framework that paves the way for more inclusive multimodal research.

2511.04728.tldr: This study introduces the Trustworthiness Calibration Framework (TCF), a reproducible methodology for evaluating phishing detectors across three dimensions: calibration, consistency, and robustness, and establishes a transparent and reproducible foundation for assessing model dependability in LLM-based phishing detection.

2511.04729.tldr: This work introduces a novel knowledge-based anomaly detection method for detecting network-induced shape artifacts in synthetic images that allows developers to evaluate synthetic images for known anatomic constraints and pinpoint and address specific issues to improve the overall quality of a synthetic dataset.

2511.04753.tldr: This work construct winning and losing control signals, $\mathbf{c}^{w}$ and $\mathbf{c}^{l}$, and train the model to prefer $\mathbf{c}^{w}$, which eliminates confounding factors and yields a low-variance training objective.

2511.04758.tldr: This work presents ScheduleStream, the first general-purpose framework for planning&scheduling with sampling operations with sampling operations, and proposes domain-independent algorithms that solve ScheduleStream problems without any application-specific mechanisms.

2511.04790.tldr: This work outlines a statistical and computational framework for causal structure and representation learning motivated by fundamental biomedical questions: how to effectively use observational and perturbational data to perform causal discovery on observed causal variables; how to use multi-modal views of the system to learn causal variables; and how to design optimal perturbations.

2511.04798.tldr: Manhattan Distance Mapping is a post-training DNN weight mapping technique for memristive bit-sliced compute-in-memory (CIM) crossbars that reduces parasitic resistance (PR) nonidealities and provides a lightweight, spatially informed method for scaling CIM DNN accelerators.

2511.04803.tldr: It is demonstrated that selective DQ based replay reintroducing just 5–10% of the source data effectively restores source performance, while full replay can hinder target adaptation and it is suggested that efficient training requires not only compact subsets but also retention aware learning strategies and informed domain ordering.

2511.04805.tldr: P PuzzleMoE is introduced, a training-free MoE compression method that achieves both high accuracy and efficient inference through two key innovations: first, PuzzleMoE performs sparse expert merging by identifying element-wise weight redundancy and specialization, and second, it introduces a bit-packed encoding scheme that reuses underutilized exponent bits, enabling efficient MoE inference on GPUs.

2511.04811.tldr: This work addresses bottlenecks in biomedical image segmentation by proposing a data-centric AI workflow that leverages active learning and pseudo-labeling to combine the strengths of traditional neural networks and large foundation models while minimizing human intervention.

2511.04812.tldr: The proposed Multimodal Diffusion Forcing (MDF) is a unified framework for learning from multimodal robot trajectories that extends beyond action generation and encourages the model to learn temporal and cross-modal dependencies.
