2511.07734.tldr: This work introduces a scalable framework for global optimization over graphs that employs low-rank spectral representations to build Gaussian process surrogates from sparse structural observations and provides theoretical analysis establishing conditions for accurate recovery of underlying graph structure under different sampling regimes.

2511.07737.tldr: This work combines the strengths of parallel differentiable optimization and sequential search to accelerate SAT on a hybrid GPU-CPU system and achieves runtime speedups up to over 200x when compared to a state-of-the-art CPU-based solver on public satisfiable benchmark problems from the SAT Competition.

2511.07748.tldr: An intelligent diagnosis agent that integrates ultrasound video data with clinical diagnostic text that achieves state-of-the-art performance in ultrasound video classification and is capable of generating clinically meaningful diagnostic suggestions is proposed.

2511.07755.tldr: This work proposes Filtered-ViT, a new vision transformer architecture that integrates SMART Vector Median Filtering (SMART-VMF), a spatially adaptive, multi-scale, robustness-aware mechanism that enables selective suppression of corrupted regions while preserving semantic detail and establishes Filtered-ViT as the first transformer to demonstrate unified robustness against both adversarial and naturally occurring patch-like disruptions.

2511.07787.tldr: This work probes the physical consistency of Aurora's encoder by investigating whether its latent representations align with known physical and meteorological concepts, and trains linear classifiers to identify three distinct concepts: the fundamental land-sea boundary, high-impact extreme temperature events, and atmospheric instability.

2511.07793.tldr: This paper presents HybridGuard, a framework that integrates machine learning and deep learning to improve intrusion detection, and demonstrates strong performance across diverse attack scenarios and outperforms existing solutions in adapting to evolving cybersecurity threats.

2511.07813.tldr: A hierarchical plane-enhanced scene graph is introduced that supports open vocabulary and adopts dominant planar structures as spatial anchors and enables clearer reasoning chains and more reliable high-level inferences in Sparse3DPR, a novel training-free framework for open-ended scene understanding.

2511.07857.tldr: It is shown that any deep network composed of such modules inherently retains the universal approximation property, and the overall approximation process can be interpreted as a progressive refinement across modules.

2511.07876.tldr: LoopLLM introduces a repetition-inducing prompt optimization that exploits autoregressive vulnerabilities to induce repetitive generation, and a token-aligned ensemble optimization that aggregates gradients to improve cross-model transferability.

2511.07884.tldr: Across all backbones, the proposed components improve average classification accuracy and reduce inter-subject variance compared to the corresponding baselines, indicating increased robustness to subject heterogeneity and noisy trials.

2511.07889.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical auto-regressive sketch generating process, where each stroke in a sketch is generated in a three-staged hierarchy, flexible to manipulate stroke-level sketch drawing at any time during generation by adjusting the exposed editable stroke embeddings.

2511.07890.tldr: A confidence-aware decoding framework that couples deep ensembles of compact, speech-oriented convolutional networks with post-hoc calibration and selective classification that suggests that confidence-aware neural decoding can provide robust, deployment-oriented behavior for real-world brain-computer interface communication systems.

2511.07891.tldr: It is highlighted that leveraging brain-derived state information--even without additional user labels--can substantially improve the reliability of practical EEG-based BCIs and enhances classification accuracy and stability across different user states and sessions compared with conventional preprocessing pipelines.

2511.07896.tldr: This work proposes SparseRM, which leverages Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) to extract preference-relevant information encoded in model representations, enabling the construction of a lightweight and interpretable reward model.

2511.07897.tldr: The approach proposes a pipeline to generate textual descriptions that can explain the data with large language models by incorporating external knowledge bases and may gain insights into the inherent interpretability of the decision-making process of the model.

2511.07901.tldr: DANS-KGC achieves state-of-the-art results on all three evaluation metrics for the UMLS and YAGO3-10 datasets, and enhances learning by dynamically adjusting the hardness distribution of negative samples throughout training, enabling a curriculum-style progression from easy to hard examples.

2511.07923.tldr: AquaOV255 is introduced, the first large-scale and fine-grained underwater segmentation dataset containing 255 categories and over 20K images, covering diverse categories for open-vocabulary (OV) evaluation, and Earth2Ocean is presented, a training-free OV segmentation framework that transfers terrestrial vision--language models to underwater domains without any additional underwater training.

2511.07932.tldr: Empirical results across refinements demonstrate that CBIT is superior on generation accuracy and cost-effectiveness at scale, and most importantly, CBIT-generated problems exhibited an error rate 17.8% lower than expert-authored items.

2511.07936.tldr: A real-time wireless imagined speech electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding system designed for flexibility and everyday use, and a framework focuses on practicality, demonstrating extensibility beyond wired EEG devices to portable, wireless hardware.

2511.07941.tldr: This paper introduces a novel approach, Multimodal Prototype-based Multi-Instance Learning that promotes bidirectional interaction through a balanced information compression scheme, and leverages a frozen LLM to generate task-specific pathological entity descriptions, which are learned as text prototypes.

2511.07942.tldr: This work forms a distributionally robust optimization over an uncertainty set of transition models, seeking a policy that minimizes the imitation loss under the worst-case transition distribution, and shows that this robust objective can be reformulated entirely in terms of the nominal data distribution, enabling tractable offline learning.

2511.07973.tldr: VARS stands out by transforming ECG signals into versatile graph structures that capture critical diagnostic features, irrespective of signal diversity in the lead count, sampling frequency, and duration, and offers interpretability by pinpointing the exact waveforms that lead to specific model outputs, thereby assisting clinicians in making informed decisions.

2511.07974.tldr: A fine-grained counterfactual explanation framework that generates both object-level and part-level interpretability, addressing two fundamental questions: which fine-grained features contribute to model misclassification, and where dominant local features influence counterfactual adjustments.

2511.07975.tldr: A non-TCP-based construction for a desirable utility signaling mechanism that simultaneously ensures privacy and reliability is developed and formally defining the desirable utility signaling mechanism and proving its ability to prevent suboptimal decisions for both participants and facilitate informed data trading.

2511.07976.tldr: This work introduces a modular pipeline that improves spatial and temporal robustness without altering existing change detection networks, and shows consistent gains in both registration accuracy and downstream change detection across multiple backbones.

2511.07980.tldr: ST-SAM entirely relies on self-attention to capture both local and global spatial-temporal correlations, which make it effective and efficient in traffic forecasting.

2511.07982.tldr: NotAM-Evolve is proposed, a self-evolving framework that enables a large language model (LLM) to autonomously master complex NOTAM interpretation, and introduces a closed-loop learning process where the LLM progressively improves from its own outputs, minimizing the need for extensive human-annotated reasoning traces.

2511.07988.tldr: This study extends brain-tuning to the multi-modal domain, demonstrating improvements to a downstream task after tuning to a relevant functional region.

2511.07990.tldr: This work presents an optimized, low-power edge AI system for weeds detection based on the YOLOv8n object detector deployed on the STM32U575ZI microcontroller, enabling scalable deployment in power-constrained agricultural environments.

2511.07995.tldr: A Hidden Markov Model (HMM), one of the commonly encountered statistical methods, is engaged here to detect anomalies in multivariate time series.

2511.08012.tldr: This paper proposes LightDOA, a lightweight DOA estimation model based on depthwise separable convolutions and a gated recurrent unit, specifically designed for mutil-channel input in varying environments, and demonstrates LightDOA as an efficient solution for resource-constrained applications.

2511.08016.tldr: A purely reaction-based, decentralized swarm intelligence strategy tailored to automate elongated, articulated vehicles that prioritizes jackknifing avoidance and establishes a foundation for mutual collision avoidance is proposed.

2511.08022.tldr: A new perturbation framework is proposed to evaluate LLMs'reasoning ability in complex environments by injecting additional semantically irrelevant perturbation sentences and gradually increasing the perturbation intensity, and finds that models are more sensitive to perturbations with numerical information and are more likely to give incorrect answers when disturbed by irrelevant numerical information.

2511.08024.tldr: A Knowledge-Augmented Long-CoT Reasoning framework that integrates LLMs with knowledge graph-based multi-hop reasoning chains and introduces PrimeKGQA, a comprehensive benchmark for biomolecular question answering, to highlight the effectiveness of combining structured knowledge with advanced reasoning strategies for reliable and interpretable biomolecular reasoning.

2511.08031.tldr: A multi-modal deepfake detection and localization framework based on a Feature Pyramid-Transformer (FPN-Transformer) that addresses critical gaps in cross-modal generalization and temporal boundary regression and provides a novel way for generalized deepfake detection.

2511.08042.tldr: The Kamiwaza Agentic Merit Index (KAMI) v0.1 is presented, an enterprise-focused benchmark that addresses both contamination resistance and agentic evaluation and presents insights on cost-performance tradeoffs, model-specific behavioral patterns, and the impact of reasoning capabilities on token efficiency -- findings critical for enterprises making deployment decisions.

2511.08046.tldr: ProSona is introduced, a two-stage framework that learns a continuous latent space of annotation styles, enabling controllable personalization via natural language prompts, and demonstrates that natural-language prompts can provide flexible, accurate, and interpretable control over personalized medical image segmentation.

2511.08052.tldr: A novel psychologically backed Scaffold Reasoning framework for code debugging, which encompasses the Scaffold Stream, Analytic Stream, and Integration Stream, which achieves an 88.91% pass rate and an average inference time of 5.36 seconds per-problem on DebugBench, outperforming other reasoning approaches across various LLMs in both reasoning accuracy and efficiency.

2511.08055.tldr: MSCR, an automated adversarial attack method based on multi-source candidate replacement based on multi-source candidate replacement, is proposed, which generates for each word in the input question a set of semantically similar candidates, which are filtered and substituted one by one to carry out the attack.

2511.08061.tldr: A LoRA fine-tuned diffusion model employing a latent concatenation strategy, which jointly processes reference and target images, combined with a masked Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) objective is proposed, which enables robust identity preservation without architectural modifications.

2511.08071.tldr: This work proposes the first unsupervised framework for radar-based heartbeat sensing via Augmented Pseudo-Label and Noise Contrast (Radar-APLANC), which uses both the heartbeat range and noise range within the radar range matrix to construct the positive and negative samples, respectively, for improved noise robustness.

2511.08072.tldr: A clustering-based approach to detect anomalies concerning the amplitude and the shape of multivariate time series and is suitable for identifying anomalous amplitude and shape patterns in various application domains such as health care, weather data analysis, finance, and disease outbreak detection.

2511.08075.tldr: It is concluded that the separately trained CLIP vision-language model is what determines the human-like semantic representation, and that the diffusion process instead takes the role of a visual decoder.

2511.08077.tldr: Experimental results substantiate the efficacy of the presented gradient-boosting framework for fuzzy rule-based models, demonstrating performance enhancement, especially in terms of mitigating overfitting and complexity typically associated with many rules.

2511.08080.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that HSPAG captures fine-grained structure-property relationships and supports controllable generation under multiple property constraints and two real-world case studies further validate the editing capabilities of HSPAG.

2511.08082.tldr: Across six task families, retrieval-grounded configurations achieved higher grounding accuracy, reduced hallucination and interpretive drift, and nearly doubled transparency, showing that existing prudential doctrines already accommodate reliable AI when governance is explicit, data are traceable, and assurance is verifiable.

2511.08085.tldr: This study reveals that BARD10 authors are highly sensitive to stop-word pruning, while BAAD16 authors remain comparatively robust highlighting genre-dependent reliance on stop-word signatures.

2511.08087.tldr: Beyond the Pixels, a hierarchical evaluation framework that decomposes identity assessment into feature-level transformations, is introduced, demonstrating strong alignment with human judgments in measuring identity consistency.

2511.08090.tldr: Through extensive evaluation, it is shown that StableMorph images not only rival or exceed the quality of genuine face images but also maintain a strong ability to fool face recognition systems posing a greater challenge to existing MAD solutions.

2511.08098.tldr: This study evaluates whether explicitly incorporating diverse points of view using the ReAct framework can enhance an LLM's ability to understand and ground the demands of other agents, and demonstrates that explicit perspective cues significantly improve the model's interpretative accuracy and collaborative effectiveness.

2511.08108.tldr: This paper investigates the impact of feature reduction using XAI techniques on the quality classification of injection-molded parts and shows that reducing features can improve generalization while maintaining high classification performance, with a small increase in inference speed.

2511.08117.tldr: This paper investigates the feasibility of incorporating synthetic data into the training process of the injection molding process using an existing Long Short-Term Memory architecture and suggests that the inclusion of synthetic data improves the model's ability to handle different scenarios.

2511.08120.tldr: This work proposes a novel evaluation protocol for assessing the long-term sustainability of ML models, based on concepts inspired by Online ML, which measures sustainability and performance through incremental/continual model retraining parallel to real-world data acquisition.

2511.08133.tldr: Inspired by the hierarchical cognitive processes in human visual perception, OTSNet is proposed, a novel three-stage network embodying a neurocognitive-inspired Observation-Thinking-Spelling pipeline for unified STR modeling that achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2511.08143.tldr: A novel Relation as a Prior (RelPrior) paradigm for LLM-based DocRE that achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing LLM-based methods.

2511.08147.tldr: ProbSelect is introduced, a novel approach utilizing analytical modeling and probabilistic forecasting for client selection on GPU-accelerated devices, without requiring historical data or continuous monitoring, to model client selection within user-defined SLOs.

2511.08168.tldr: This project marks the first release of an open-source, commercially-oriented image generation AI fully developed in Japan, and aims to contribute to Japan's AI researcher and engineer community and promote the domestic AI development ecosystem.

2511.08174.tldr: An efficient model-free neural CFR algorithm is proposed, overcoming the limitations of existing methods in approximating advanced CFR variants and exhibits faster convergence in typical imperfect-information games and demonstrates stronger adversarial performance in a large poker game.

2511.08191.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach to constructing unlearnable examples by systematically maximising the Bayes error, a measurement of irreducible classification error, and develops an optimisation-based approach and provides an efficient solution using projected gradient ascent.

2511.08224.tldr: 2Dto3D-SR is introduced, a versatile framework for real-time single-view 3D super-resolution that eliminates the need for high-resolution RGB guidance and establishes the geometry-guided pipeline as a surprisingly simple yet viable and practical solution for real-world scenarios, especially where high-resolution RGB data is inaccessible.

2511.08231.tldr: This paper addresses the model-mismatch issue of selecting an accurate kinematic model by tasking the MFR-PINP to also learn the residuals between simple, low-fidelity predictions and complex, high-fidelity ground-truth dynamics.

2511.08240.tldr: The DiPVNet is proposed, an atomic dot-product operator that simultaneously encodes directional selectivity and rotation invariance--endowing the network with both rotational symmetry modeling and adaptive directional perception, and rigorously proves the rotation invariance of both operators.

2511.08242.tldr: A novel, comprehensive framework of eleven outcome-based, task-agnostic performance metrics for AI agents that transcend domain boundaries is proposed, paving the way for more effective development, deployment, and governance.

2511.08246.tldr: A novel Sensitivity-aware Task Vector insertion framework (STV) is proposed, demonstrating its effectiveness and showing consistent improvements over previous task-vector-based methods with strong generalization.

2511.08248.tldr: This work proposes a strong baseline for training-free OVSS termed as NERVE (Neighbourhood \&Entropy-guided Random-walk for open-Vocabulary sEgmentation), which uniquely integrates global and fine-grained local information, exploiting the neighbourhood structure from the self-attention layer of a stable diffusion model.

2511.08263.tldr: This work introduces ImageBindDC, a novel data condensation framework operating within the unified feature space of ImageBind, which moves beyond conventional distribution-matching by employing a powerful Characteristic Function (CF) loss, which operates in the Fourier domain to facilitate a more precise statistical alignment via exact infinite moment matching.

2511.08274.tldr: This work proposes Multi-Agent GraphRAG, a modular LLM agentic system for text-to-Cypher query generation serving as a natural language interface to LPG-based graph data, and demonstrates performance of the proposed workflow on a property graph derived from the IFC data, representing a digital twin of a building.

2511.08283.tldr: This work proposes DiagramIR: an automatic and scalable evaluation pipeline for geometric figures that enables smaller models like GPT-4.1-Mini to perform comparably to larger models such as GPT-5 at a 10x lower inference cost, which is important for deploying accessible and scalable education technologies.

2511.08287.tldr: This work introduces a kernelized graph community contrastive loss with linear complexity, enabling effective information transfer among node sets to capture hierarchical structural information of the graph and incorporates a knowledge distillation technique into the decoupled GNN architecture to accelerate inference while maintaining strong generalization performance.

2511.08301.tldr: This paper introduces Spark, a novel shared agentic memory architecture which is designed to emulate the collective intelligence and know-how of human developer communities and demonstrates that recommendations made by Spark improve the quality of code generated by generic code generation models at varying sizes and capability tiers.

2511.08305.tldr: Empirical evaluations on popular mathematical benchmarks demonstrate that the test-time Riemannian activation steering strategy outperforms vanilla sampling techniques in terms of generative diversity and solution accuracy.

2511.08319.tldr: This work proposes refining responses through a multi-agent framework, where each agent is assigned a specific role for each aspect, and focuses on three key aspects crucial to conversational quality: factuality, personalization, and coherence.

2511.08339.tldr: LPPG-RL is proposed, a novel LMORL framework which leverages sequential gradient projections to identify feasible policy update directions, thereby enabling LPPG-RL broadly compatible with all policy gradient algorithms in continuous spaces and providing theoretical guarantees for convergence and establish a lower bound on policy improvement.

2511.08349.tldr: This manuscript proposes a Hybrid Quantum Classical selection mechanism for the Mamba architecture, designed specifically for temporal sequence classification problems, and leverages Variational Quantum Circuits as quantum gating modules that both enhance feature extraction and improve suppression of irrelevant information.

2511.08360.tldr: This work introduces SLOPE Structured Sparsity at Low Precision (SLOPE), a unified framework, to effectively combine structured sparsity and low-bit quantization in a principled way and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art quantization and structured sparsity methods across classification, detection, and segmentation tasks on models such as ResNet-18, ViT-Small, and Mask R-CNN.

2511.08368.tldr: It is mathematically shown RoPE to be one of the most general solutions for equivariant positional embedding in one-dimensional data, and Mixed RoPE to be the analogously general solution for M-dimensional data, if the authors require commutative generators.

2511.08369.tldr: This work introduces Text-based Aerial-Ground Person Retrieval (TAG-PR), a novel retrieval framework that addresses view heterogeneity through a hierarchically-routed mixture of experts module to learn view-specific and view-agnostic features and a viewpoint decoupling strategy to decouple view-specific features for better cross-modal alignment.

2511.08387.tldr: This paper proposes RAPTR (RAdar Pose esTimation using tRansformer) under weak supervision, using only 3D BBox and 2D keypoint labels which are considerably easier and more scalable to collect.

2511.08389.tldr: This work proposes an interface module that enables fusion across multiple upstream speech models while integrating information across their layers, and shows that the proposed interface provides an additional performance boost when given a suitable upstream model selection.

2511.08394.tldr: TRACE (Trajectory-based Reward for Agent Collaboration Estimation), a novel reward signal derived from the geometric properties of a dialogue's embedding trajectory, is introduced, offering a new, privacy-preserving framework that not only aligns agents but also serves as a diagnostic tool for understanding the distinct interaction patterns that drive successful collaboration.

2511.08402.tldr: This work introduces Anatomy-VLM, a fine-grained, vision-language model that incorporates multi-scale information and facilitates zero-shot anatomy-wise interpretation, providing its strong expert-level clinical interpretation capabilities.

2511.08436.tldr: A novel biologically-inspired computational framework is presented to study weakly electric fish behaviors, where recurrent neural network based artificial agents trained via multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) learn to modulate their electric organ discharges (EODs) and movement patterns to collectively forage in virtual environments.

2511.08439.tldr: A structured framework for developing safe datasets aligned with ISO/PAS 8800 guidelines is presented, using AI-based perception systems as the primary use case, and the AI Data Flywheel and the dataset lifecycle, covering data collection, annotation, curation, and maintenance is introduced.

2511.08470.tldr: It is demonstrated that unsupervised numerical encoding methods are not viable for the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) criterion and a novel and efficient splitting algorithm is presented that addresses the challenges of handling categorical features with the MAE criterion.

2511.08484.tldr: The results demonstrate that LLMs can be "patched" much like software, offering vendors and practitioners a practical mechanism for distributing scalable, efficient, and composable safety updates between major model releases.

2511.08500.tldr: This work introduces Selective Parameter Evaluation and Restoration via Model Merging (SPEAR-MM), a practical framework that preserves critical capabilities while enabling domain adaptation in large language models adapted to financial domains.

2511.08507.tldr: This work introduces Bangla-SGP, a novel parallel dataset consisting of 1,000 human-annotated sentence-gloss pairs which was augmented with around 3,000 synthetically generated pairs using syntactic and morphological rules through a rule-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline.

2511.08548.tldr: It is shown that while many LLMs appear to broadly agree with human notions of interestingness, they mostly do not capture the distribution observed in human judgments, and most LLMs only somewhat align with why humans find certain math problems interesting.

2511.08567.tldr: It is shown that RL operates in a distinct optimization regime from SFT, so directly adapting SFT-era parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods can be flawed, as evidenced by the case studies on advanced sparse fine-tuning and LoRA variants.

2511.08577.tldr: Think-at-Hard (TaH) is proposed, a dynamic latent thinking method that employs a lightweight neural decider to trigger latent iterations only at tokens that are likely incorrect after the standard forward pass, and boosts LLM reasoning performance across five challenging benchmarks while maintaining the same parameter count.

2310.12815.tldr: This work proposes a framework to formalize prompt injection attacks and designs a new attack by combining existing ones, and provides a common benchmark for quantitatively evaluating future prompt injection attacks and defenses.

2405.17878.tldr: The Information Difference Index (IDI), a novel white-box metric inspired by information theory, quantifies retained information in intermediate features by measuring mutual information between those features and the labels to be forgotten, offering a more comprehensive assessment of unlearning efficacy.

2407.06849.tldr: A temporal variational autoencoder that can detect anomalies with minimal false positives when trained on unlabelled data and has the potential to perform well with a smaller training and validation subset but requires a more sophisticated threshold estimation method.

2409.16694.tldr: A systematic overview from basic, system, and algorithm perspectives can offer valuable insights and guidelines for future works to enhance the efficiency and applicability of LLMs through low-bit quantization.

2410.15281.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the instruction-following and reasoning abilities of LLM4AD systems is proposed, which includes LaMPilot-Bench, CARLA Leaderboard 1.0 Benchmark in simulation and NuPlanQA for multi-view visual question answering.

2410.21348.tldr: A comprehensive survey of various benchmark datasets employed in medical LLM tasks, including MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, BioASQ, PubMedQA, and CheXpert, which have facilitated advancements in tasks like medical report generation, clinical summarization, and synthetic data generation are presented.

2411.07722.tldr: This paper proposes a novel method called Multimodal Knowledge Consistency Fine-tuning, a form of multimodal knowledge conflict, which reduces C&P knowledge conflicts across all tested MLLMs and enhances their performance in both cognitive and perceptual tasks.

2411.13951.tldr: A diverse, extensive, and non-trivial dataset generated via state-of-the-art simulation tools that reflects realistic behaviour of an automotive powertrain, including its multivariate, dynamic and variable-state properties is proposed.

2411.16754.tldr: To transcend binary classification, the Visual AI Index (VAI) is proposed, an interpretable, prompt-agnostic realism metric based on twelve low-level visual features, enabling us to quantify and rank the perceptual quality of generated outputs with greater nuance.

2411.18104.tldr: TDG is introduced, a novel and scalable paradigm that harnesses frontier LLMs (GPT-4) to automatically generate parameterized meta-templates, which in turn synthesize a virtually infinite stream of high-quality problems and solutions.

2411.18235.tldr: Certified Training with Branch-and-Bound (CT-BaB), a new certified training framework that optimizes certified bounds, thereby reducing the discrepancy between training and test-time verification that also computes certified bounds, is introduced.

2412.04697.tldr: This work proposes an algorithm that smartly spends privacy budget only for the tokens that require the sensitive information and uses the non-private LLM for other tokens, and outperforms the non-RAG baseline under a reasonable privacy budget of $\epsilon\approx 10$ across different models and datasets.

2502.04387.tldr: Evaluations on both simulated and real-world multilingual FL benchmarks demonstrate that FedP$^2$EFT largely outperforms existing personalized fine-tuning methods, while complementing other existing FL methods.

2503.01908.tldr: UDora is presented, a unified red teaming framework designed for LLM agents that dynamically hijacks the agent's reasoning processes to compel malicious behavior and demonstrates superior effectiveness compared to existing methods across three LLM agent datasets.

2503.16874.tldr: A Multi-Agent Adaptive Reasoning with Socratic guidance framework for APO, which integrates reasoning, feedback, and state transition into a unified hidden-state evolution process, improving both the effectiveness and interpretability of optimization.

2503.16905.tldr: Multi-Agent Personality Shaping (MAPS), a novel framework that enhances reasoning through agent diversity and internal critique, and introduces a Critic agent that reflects on intermediate outputs, revisits flawed steps, and guides iterative refinement improves both reasoning depth and flexibility.

2503.17482.tldr: A mathematical decomposition for quantifying steerability independently from producibility is introduced and it is shown that improvements are indeed possible: simple image-based steering mechanisms achieve more than 2x improvement on this benchmark.

2503.19037.tldr: EPO is proposed, a hybrid algorithm that combines the scalability and diversity of EAs with the performance and stability of policy gradients, and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in sample efficiency, asymptotic performance, and scalability.

2503.23175.tldr: It is shown how LLMs cannot guarantee sufficient performance on real-size reports while also being inconsistent and overconfident, posing doubts about the possibility of using LLMs for CTI scenarios, where labelled datasets are lacking and where confidence is a fundamental factor.

2504.04277.tldr: The study shows that for multiclass classification problems that can leverage proprietary datasets, an embeddings-based approach may yield unequivocally better results, and scientists, practitioners, engineers, and business leaders can go beyond the hype and consider appropriate predictive models for their classification use cases.

2504.11358.tldr: DataSentinel fine-tunes an LLM to detect inputs contaminated with injected prompts that are strategically adapted to evade detection, and proposes a gradient-based method to solve the minimax optimization problem by alternating between the inner max and outer min problems.

2504.16738.tldr: This work introduces MOSAIC, a skill-centric, multi-directional planning approach that targets these challenges by reasoning about which skills to employ and where they are most likely to succeed, by utilizing physics simulation to estimate skill execution outcomes.

2505.01288.tldr: This work introduces semantic action flow as a core intermediate representation capturing the essential spatio-temporal manipulator-object interactions, invariant to superficial visual differences, and presents ViSA-Flow, a framework that learns this representation self-supervised from unlabeled large-scale video data.

2505.03586.tldr: The Rainbow Delay Compensation (RDC), a MARL training framework for addressing stochastic individual delays, along with recommended implementations for its constituent modules is proposed, and an effective solution framework is offered.

2505.11122.tldr: A novel framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to overcome limitations in traditional formulaic alpha mining and establish a more effective and efficient paradigm for formulaic alpha mining.

2505.14451.tldr: RefiDiff is proposed, combining local machine learning predictions with a novel Mamba-based denoising network efficiently capturing long-range dependencies among features and samples with low computational complexity, and outperforms state-of-the-art methods across missing-value settings.

2505.14884.tldr: This work introduces Polar Sparsity, the first work to demonstrate that contextual sparsity can scale effectively to large batch sizes, delivering substantial inference acceleration with minimal changes, making Polar Sparsity practical for large-scale, high-throughput LLM deployment systems.

2505.15311.tldr: The classical paradigm of Bellman Residual Minimization is revisited and Trajectory Bellman Residual Minimization is introduced, yielding a simple yet effective off-policy algorithm that optimizes a single trajectory-level Bellman objective using the model's own logits as $Q$-values.

2505.16483.tldr: This work proposes a systematic framework, CANOE, to reduce faithfulness hallucinations of LLMs across different downstream tasks without human annotations and proposes Dual-GRPO, a rule-based reinforcement learning method that includes three tailored rule-based rewards derived from synthesized short-form QA data, while simultaneously optimizing both short-form and long-form response generation.

2505.17330.tldr: FS-DAG leverages domain-specific and language/vision specific backbones within a modular framework to adapt to diverse document types with minimal data, making it well-suited for complex real-world applications for Information Extraction (IE) tasks where computational resources are limited.

2505.18344.tldr: This work provides a principled analysis of score estimation, establishing a sample complexity bound of O, and is the first such result that achieves sample complexity bounds without assuming access to the empirical risk minimizer of score function estimation loss.

2505.18371.tldr: This work proposes a clear, behavior-based definition of AI-LAWS -- systems that introduce unique risks through their use of modern AI -- as a foundation for technically grounded regulation, given that existing frameworks do not distinguish them from conventional LAWS.

2505.21636.tldr: This work evaluates topic-based watermarking (TBW), a semantic-aware technique designed to embed detectable signals into LLM-generated text, using authentic peer review data from academic conferences to highlight the viability of TBW as a minimally intrusive and practical solution for LLM attribution in peer review settings.

2505.22224.tldr: This work proposes a solver-free training method that exploits the geometric structure of linear optimization to enable efficient training with minimal degradation in solution quality and significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining high decision quality.

2505.24197.tldr: This work extensively study how the number of demonstrations and the use of LLM-generated summaries and evaluations affect the task success rate of the API-based agent, and finds that providing explicit function calls and natural language critiques significantly improves the agent's task success rate due to more accurate parameter filling.

2506.00942.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation was conducted, demonstrating that anyECG-chat is capable of supporting various practical application scenarios, including not only common report generation tasks but also abnormal waveform localization for long-duration reduced-lead ECGs in home environments and comprehensive comparative analysis of multiple ECGs.

2506.01975.tldr: It is demonstrated that Bob might just be lucky: his task accuracy increases monotonically with the correlation between his task and Alice's, and it is hypothesized that the optimal number of retrained layers is indicative of task and feature correlation.

2506.06151.tldr: Joint-GCG is proposed, the first framework to unify gradient-based attacks across both retriever and generator models through three innovations: Cross-Vocabulary Projection for aligning embedding spaces, Gradient Tokenization Alignment for synchronizing token-level gradient signals, and Adaptive Weighted Fusion for dynamically balancing attacking objectives.

2506.06284.tldr: This paper introduces a framework for representing information about entities that do not exist or may never exist, such as those involving fictional entities, blueprints, simulations, and future scenarios, and develops a structured ontology driven approach to unreal patterns.

2506.06318.tldr: This work introduces Mixture of Experts for MEMS Gyroscopes (MoE-Gyro), a novel self-supervised framework specifically designed for simultaneous over-range signal reconstruction and noise suppression, and introduces IMU Signal Enhancement Benchmark (ISEBench), an open-source benchmarking platform comprising the GyroPeak-100 dataset and a unified evaluation of IMU signal enhancement methods.

2506.14951.tldr: This work identifies and characterize a special structure in the loss landscape: channels along which the loss decreases extremely slowly, while the output weights of at least two neurons diverge to $\pm$infinity, and their input weight vectors become equal to each other.

2506.15538.tldr: This work introduces Polysemantic FeatuRe Identification and Scoring Method (PRISM), a novel framework specifically designed to capture the complexity of features in LLMs that produces more nuanced descriptions that account for both monosemantic and polysemantic behavior.

2506.15691.tldr: This paper studies the issue analytically, presenting a linear model that encapsulates the essence of LAM learning, while being tractable, and provides several insights, including connections between LAM and principal component analysis (PCA), desiderata of the data-generating policy, and justification of strategies to encourage learning controllable changes using data augmentation, data cleaning, and auxiliary action-prediction.

2507.00709.tldr: This work proposes TopoStreamer, an end-to-end temporal perception model for lane segment topology reasoning that demonstrates significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods, and assess the accuracy of existing models using a lane boundary classification metric.

2507.08574.tldr: By explicitly integrating medical knowledge priors - anatomical semantics and geometric constraints - STPF improves segmentation accuracy in ambiguous boundary regions while demonstrating generalization capability and clinical deployment potential.

2507.15062.tldr: A portable, lightweight gripper with integrated tactile sensors that enables synchronized collection of visual and tactile data in diverse, real-world, and in-the-wild settings is presented and a cross-modal representation learning framework is proposed that integrates visual and tactile signals while preserving their distinct characteristics.

2507.16430.tldr: This paper advances a three-dimensional framework for human-centered RSs, integrating policies and regulation, interdisciplinary research, and education, and argues that RSs can be reoriented to enhance autonomy and dignity rather than undermine them.

2507.16999.tldr: This work presents a novel approach to help decision‐makers efficiently identify preferred solutions from the Pareto set of a multi‐objective optimization problem that uses a Bayesian model to estimate the decision‐maker's utility function based on pairwise comparisons.

2507.22002.tldr: CEDANet, a human-in-the-loop, class-aware domain adaptation framework that uniquely integrates weak, citizen-provided video-level labels with adversarial feature alignment is introduced, refine pseudo-labels generated by a source-trained segmentation model using citizen votes, and employ class-specific domain discriminators to transfer rich source-domain representations to the industrial domain.

2507.22159.tldr: The first fully human-authored and multi-domain Indonesian preference dataset designed to evaluate the naturalness and quality of LLM-generated text, and spans 10 diverse categories, enabling practitioners to identify LLMs'fine-grained strengths and weaknesses.

2508.00452.tldr: A generative model that addresses the challenges of modeling common and unique views in attribute and multi-modal features, as well as user preferences over single-typed item features, and incorporates co-occurrence signals via contrastive learning, eliminating the need for pretraining is proposed.

2508.01159.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs can enhance structured clinical information exchange between physicians, while highlighting the need for more robust evaluation methods that capture a model's ability to prioritize clinically salient information within the time constraints of real-world physician communication.

2508.02724.tldr: Veli (Reference-free Variational Estimation via Latent Inference), an unsupervised Bayesian model that leverages variational inference to correct LCS readings without requiring co-location with reference stations, eliminating a major deployment barrier is introduced.

2508.03213.tldr: The proposed Universal Adversarial Augmenter (UAA) framework provides a practical and efficient pathway for building robust models, and establishes a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) for data-augmentation-based adversarial defense strategies.

2508.06894.tldr: This work presents pushdown reward machines (pdRMs), an extension of reward machines based on deterministic pushdown automata that can recognise and reward temporally extended behaviours representable in deterministic context-free languages, making them more expressive than reward machines.

2508.08543.tldr: This work proposes a cost-effective graph-free Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) based model M3-Net for traffic prediction that demonstrates the superiority of the proposed model in terms of prediction performance and lightweight deployment.

2508.10391.tldr: LeanRAG is introduced, a framework that features a deeply collaborative design combining knowledge aggregation and retrieval strategies that can mitigate the substantial overhead associated with path retrieval on graphs and minimizes redundant information retrieval.

2508.10419.tldr: ComoRAG is proposed, holding the principle that narrative reasoning is not a one-shot process, but a dynamic, evolving interplay between new evidence acquisition and past knowledge consolidation, analogous to human cognition on reasoning with memory-related signals in the brain.

2508.15201.tldr: This survey comprehensively reviews VLA models for embodied manipulation, and conducts a detailed analysis of current research across 5 critical dimensions: VLA model structures, training datasets, pre-training methods, post-training methods, and model evaluation.

2508.15212.tldr: SPARK is a training-free plug-and-play method that applies unstructured sparsity by pruning KV at the channel level, while dynamically restoring the pruned entries during attention score computation, enabling processing of longer sequences within the same memory budget.

2509.02615.tldr: It is suggested that the apparent "reasoning" of VLMs often reflects prompt sensitivity rather than genuine inference, raising caution for their use in scientific domains, and with minimal adaptation, generic VLMs can rival specialized models, offering a promising but fragile tool for scientific discovery.

2509.04498.tldr: A novel, multi-dimensional evaluation framework is proposed that goes beyond accuracy by measuring demographic and geographic representation in university and program suggestions from three open-source LLMs, highlighting the urgent need for bias consideration in educational LMs to ensure equitable global access to higher education.

2509.09074.tldr: A novel flow field-based motion planning method that drives a robot from any initial state to a desired reference trajectory such that it converges to the trajectory's end point and provides a significant improvement over baselines when comparing metrics that measure spatial and temporal dynamics modeling efficacy.

2509.10590.tldr: The potential of MU is examined as both a mechanism for operationalizing Responsible AI principles and a foundation for Adaptive AI in ML-driven educational systems, and MU4RAAI, a reference architecture integrating MU within Responsible and Adaptive AI frameworks for educational contexts are introduced.

2509.10837.tldr: The Logic-constrained Vector Symbolic Architecture (LVSA) is proposed, a neuro-symbolic framework that unifies a differentiable Skolemization module and a neural negator, as well as a logical constraint-driven optimization protocol to harmonize geometric and logical requirements.

2509.18542.tldr: Symphony-MoE is proposed, a novel two-stage framework designed to harmonize multiple identically-architected but disparate pre-trained models into a single, coherent expert mixture that significantly surpasses baselines in multi-domain tasks and out-of-distribution generalization.

2509.21389.tldr: This work serves as an authoritative reference for researchers and practitioners seeking to enhance privacy, efficiency, and robustness of federated intrusion detection systems in increasingly complex network environments, while preparing for the quantum-enhanced cybersecurity landscape of tomorrow.

2510.00229.tldr: This work proposes"decoupled fine-tuning", a novel post-training approach that employs LoRA fine-tuning to create dedicated LoRA adapters for tool selection and tool-specific argument generation using separate loss masking for each of the subtasks, and presents AgentFlux, an inference framework that leverages the LoRA adapters created using decoupled fine-tuning to perform efficient agent orchestration with the help of local models on end-user devices.

2510.10675.tldr: This paper introduces simpliflow, a lightweight, open-source Python framework designed to address the challenges of rapid development and orchestration of linear, deterministic agentic workflows through a declarative, JSON-based configuration.

2510.21045.tldr: Results show that decomposing the task into specialized but tightly coupled agents improves robustness, especially for spatially sensitive queries, and provides a practical step toward more reliable spatial Text-to-SQL systems and autonomous GIS.

2510.23658.tldr: Across downstream tasks, including GSM8K, MMLU, and additional reasoning/knowledge benchmarks, ELBO-KTO trained on UltraFeedback-Binary performs on par with or better than the base model under identical decoding, establishing unpaired preference optimization as a viable alternative to pairwise alignment in diffusion LLMs.

2510.24792.tldr: PISA-Bench is introduced, a multilingual benchmark derived from English examples of the expert-created PISA tests, a unified framework for the assessment of student competencies in over eighty countries, and the dataset and evaluation framework are released to provide a resource for advancing research on multilingual multimodal reasoning.

2510.27042.tldr: Adaptive Effort Control is proposed, a self-adaptive reinforcement learning method that trains models to use a user-specified fraction of tokens relative to the current average chain-of-thought length for each query, which enables a 2-3x reduction in chain-of-thought length while maintaining or improving performance relative to the base model used for RL training.

2511.00710.tldr: It is demonstrated that applying RLVR extends the spatial reasoning boundary, achieving success on problems where the base policy VLM consistently attains $0\%$ accuracy despite increasing pass@k sampling budgets, indicating that the optimized policy successfully navigates search spaces that were effectively unreachable by the base distribution.

2511.01634.tldr: A unified framework for evaluating how resistant Large Language Models are to prompt injection attacks is proposed and it is demonstrated that alignment strength and safety tuning play a greater role in resilience than model size alone.

2511.04834.tldr: This work proposes a conceptually simple yet experimentally robust method: replacing the negative prompts used in training-free methods with implicit negative embeddings obtained through concept inversion, which demonstrates consistent improvements in defense success rate while preserving the core semantics of input prompts.

2511.04914.tldr: The proposed framework provides a foundation for integrating emotion-aware perception into future agentic audio systems, enabling more empathetic and contextually adaptive multimodal reasoning.

2511.04962.tldr: The Moral RolePlay benchmark is introduced, a new dataset featuring a four-level moral alignment scale and a balanced test set for rigorous evaluation, and it is demonstrated that general chatbot proficiency is a poor predictor of villain role-playing ability, with highly safety-aligned models performing particularly poorly.

2511.05452.tldr: A hybrid adaptive sampling and weighting method is introduced to enhance the performance of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) by combining both strategies, offering a more robust approach for solving PDEs with PINNs.

2511.05625.tldr: This AI-focused strand of the workshop centered on three critical questions: when is AI truly useful in education, and when might it merely replace human effort at the expense of learning.

2511.05927.tldr: This mixed-methods study audits workforce preparedness across oil-rich, state-led economies and identifies an emerging two-track talent system, research elites versus rapidly trained practitioners, that risks labor-market bifurcation without bridging mechanisms.

2511.05932.tldr: These findings refine institutional theory by showing that vertical rule coherence, not wealth, determines AI's public value yield, and temper post‐NPM optimism by revealing that efficiency metrics advance societal goals only when backed by enforceable safeguards.

2511.05996.tldr: This work proposes a novel point-pair-based pose tracking framework, termed PPF-Tracker, which performs quasi-canonicalization of point clouds in the SE(3) Lie group space, and then models articulated objects using Point Pair Features (PPF) to predict pose voting parameters by leveraging the invariance properties of SE(3).

2511.06817.tldr: TiS-TSL is proposed, a novel time-switchable teacher-student learning framework for video stereo matching under minimal supervision that exceeds other image-based state-of-the-arts by improving TEPE and EPE by at least 2.11 % and 4.4% respectively.

2511.07104.tldr: The Uncertainty Contraction Estimator (UCE), a white-box detector that aggregates uncertainty metrics over successive prefixes to identify TSLM-generated time series is introduced, offering a reliable and generalizable solution for detecting model-generated time series.

2511.07413.tldr: This paper introduces DigiData, a large-scale, high-quality, diverse, multi-modal dataset designed for training mobile control agents, and proposes dynamic evaluation protocols and AI-powered evaluations as rigorous alternatives for agent assessment.

2511.07459.tldr: Comprehensive testing across multiple XC datasets reveals substantial improvements in the handling of infrequent categories, setting a new benchmark for the field and introducing two newly created multi-intent datasets, offering essential resources for future XC research.

2511.07496.tldr: A post-hoc adjustment to the score function during inference is proposed that leverages the Laplacian (or sharpness) of the score to reduce mode interpolation hallucination in unconditional diffusion models across 1D, 2D, and high-dimensional image data.

2511.07807.tldr: An optimized framework is proposed that replaces standard non-linear functions with homomorphically compatible approximations, ensuring secure computations while minimizing computational overhead and introducing an efficient activation function approximation method to mitigate the performance trade-offs introduced by encryption.

2511.08049.tldr: CometNet is proposed, a novel Contextual Motif-guided Long-term Time Series Forecasting framework that significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, particularly on extended forecast horizons.

2511.08217.tldr: MADD is presented, a multi-agent system that builds and executes customized hit identification pipelines from natural language queries that pioneer the application of AI-first drug design to five biological targets and release the identified hit molecules.

2511.08344.tldr: This work proposes a novel diffusion-based data augmentation approach, Sparse-Aware Semantic-Guided Diffusion Augmentation (SASG-DA), which mitigates overfitting and improves recognition performance and generalization by offering both faithful and diverse samples.

2511.08558.tldr: The proposed decoding method enables detection of classes unseen during training and can detect 100% of samples from an unseen/untrained class on the DvsGesture dataset.

2511.08573.tldr: The novel architecture SENCA-st (Shared Encoder with Neighborhood Cross Attention) is proposed that preserves the features of both modalities and emphasizes regions that are structurally similar in histopathology but functionally different on spatial transcriptomics using cross-attention.

2511.08587.tldr: The preliminary results indicate that SPARA can provide energy efficiency advice with precision 80%, comparable to that of municipal energy efficiency (EE) experts, and suggest that LMs can significantly improve outreach by supporting stakeholders in their energy transition.

2511.08589.tldr: This paper explores using a hybrid summarization, i.e., an automatic paraphrase of an extractive summary, to ease attribution, and uses a custom topology to identify the proportion of different categories of attribution-related errors.

2511.08592.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs can generate social media conversations sufficiently realistic to deceive humans when reading them, highlighting both a promising potential for social simulation and a warning message about the potential misuse of LLMs to generate new inauthentic social media content.

2511.08596.tldr: This paper presents a framework for stress testing factual fidelity in LLMs in the presence of adversarial nudge, and reveals a wide range of susceptibility to adversarial nudges.

2511.08597.tldr: The Self-HarmLLM scenario, which uses a Mitigated Harmful Query generated by the same model as a new input, proves that the method can still be a valid attack scenario and suggests the need for a fundamental reconsideration of guardrail design and the establishment of a more robust evaluation methodology.

2511.08598.tldr: Open Knowledge Bench is a fully automated framework for generating high-quality, dynamic knowledge benchmarks on demand that automates the sourcing, creation, validation, and distribution of benchmarks and demonstrates how retrieval narrows the performance gap between small and large models.

2511.08606.tldr: This paper introduces the first stochastic SINDy method formulated under the risk-neutral probability measure to recover the backward stochastic differential equation (BSDE) from a single pair of stock and option trajectories.

2511.08616.tldr: This work introduces Verbal Technical Analysis (VTA), a novel framework that combine verbal and latent reasoning to produce stock time-series forecasts that are both accurate and interpretable.

2511.08620.tldr: A self-adaptive gradient-aware data selection approach (GrADS) for supervised fine-tuning of LLMs, which identifies effective subsets of training data by analyzing gradients obtained from a preliminary training phase, and design self-guided criteria that leverage the magnitude and statistical distribution of gradients to prioritize examples that contribute the most to the model's learning process.

2511.08621.tldr: The LLM Pro Finance Suite is introduced, a collection of five instruction-tuned LLMs (ranging from 8B to 70B parameters) specifically designed for financial applications, offering improved domain-specific performance while preserving overall versatility.

2511.08626.tldr: This work proposes SAMora, an innovative framework that captures hierarchical medical knowledge by applying complementary self-supervised learning objectives at the image, patch, and pixel levels, and introduces HL-Attn, a hierarchical fusion module that integrates multi-scale features while maintaining their distinct characteristics.

2511.08630.tldr: The adapted scale can be used to evaluate the impact of aspiration-driven design of educational technologies and support the use of the adapted scale as a metric for aspirations in contexts of socio-political instability.

2511.08633.tldr: Time-to-Move (TTM), a training-free, plug-and-play framework for motion- and appearance-controlled video generation with image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models, and introduces dual-clock denoising, a region-dependent strategy that enforces strong alignment in motion-specified regions while allowing flexibility elsewhere.

2511.08634.tldr: This work proposes a novel CAD framework where all tasks share a unified memory bank, enabling continuous knowledge acquisition from sequential tasks without task-specific memory fragmentation, and demonstrates 100% accuracy in anomaly sample detection, confirming its robustness in practical scenarios.

2511.08636.tldr: This work proposes a new type of hybrid deep learning scheme, i.e., the combination of a CNN architecture and a BiGRU technique, which can accurately identify the patterns of suicidal ideation from SN datasets, and applies Explainable AI (XAI) methods using SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to interpret the prediction results and verify the model reliability.

2511.08640.tldr: A unified framework that integrates diffusion-based denoising with a time-aware actor-critic model that produces earlier, more stable, and human-aligned predictions in both routine and highly complex traffic scenarios, highlighting its potential for real-world, safety-critical deployment.

2511.08645.tldr: The Swin-UNETR framework enables fully automated, inverse-free fluence map prediction directly from anatomical inputs, enhancing spatial coherence, accuracy, and efficiency while offering a scalable and consistent solution for automated IMRT plan generation.

2511.08651.tldr: RS-Net is a modular framework that scores the contextual importance of object pairs using both spatial interactions and long-range temporal context, and maintains competitive efficiency, achieving superior performance over state-of-the-art methods.

2511.08654.tldr: Analysis of AI-generated podcasts produced by Google's NotebookLM finds that NotebookLM not only translates texts from other languages into a perky standardised Mid-Western American accent, it also translates cultural contexts to a white, educated, middle-class American default.

2511.08660.tldr: This study presents an experimental validation of the reliability of the GeNIS dataset for AI-based NIDS, to serve as a baseline for future benchmarks and indicates that the GeNIS dataset supports intelligent intrusion detection and cyberattack classification with time-based and quantity-based behavioral features.

2511.08663.tldr: This study proposes a novel feature extraction method using persistent homology to analyze structural MRI of the brain using persistent homology to analyze structural MRI of the brain using a computationally efficient machine learning model.

2511.08702.tldr: Fair and Private Learning with Active Human Influence is introduced, a practical framework that integrates human oversight into the design and deployment of machine learning systems and provides a straightforward, interpretable process for practitioners to manage competing demands of accuracy, privacy, and fairness in socially impactful applications.

2511.08715.tldr: This paper proposes a novel method of translating unconstrained English into ASP programs for logic puzzles using an LLM and Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) graphs.

2511.08721.tldr: It is found that agents often exhibit a strong preference for fairness, as well as a significant impact of the system prompt on their behavior, which demonstrates a robust foundation for LLM agent behavior studies.

2511.08732.tldr: The full interaction pipeline is examined, from the human-to-robot communication bridge that translates multimodal inputs into robot-understandable representations, through adaptive planning and role allocation, to the control layer and feedback mechanisms to close the loop.

2511.08747.tldr: The approach is unique; it is believed to be the first to apply VSAs to ARC-AGI and have developed the most cognitively plausible ARC-AGI solver yet.

2511.08749.tldr: This work introduces Query Conditioned Deterministic Inference Networks (QDIN), a unified architecture that treats different types of queries as first-class citizens, with specialized neural modules optimized for each inference pattern.

2511.08752.tldr: This work presents a global-to-local, task-aware fault detection and identification (FDI) framework for multi-spacecraft systems conducting collaborative inspection missions in low Earth orbit by using the same cost function to drive both global task allocation and local sensing or motion decisions.

2511.08798.tldr: This work introduces a principled formulation of structured uncertainty over tool-call parameters, modeling joint tool-argument clarification as a POMDP with Expected Value of Perfect Information (EVPI) objective for optimal question selection and aspect-based cost modeling to prevent redundancy.

2511.08823.tldr: DT-NVS is proposed, a 3D-aware diffusion model for generalized novel view synthesis that exploits a transformer-based architecture backbone that makes significant contributions to transformer and self-attention architectures to translate images to 3d representations, and novel camera conditioning strategies to allow training on real-world unaligned datasets.

2511.08832.tldr: TIGER constructs dynamic temporal graphs of MARL agents, connecting their current and historical interactions, and employs a temporal attention-based encoder to aggregate information across these structural and temporal neighborhoods, yielding time-aware agent embeddings that guide cooperative policy learning.

2511.08835.tldr: TACT (TOD-And-Chitchat Transition), a dataset designed for transition-aware dialogue modeling that incorporates structurally diverse and integrated mode flows, is introduced, demonstrating that pairing structurally diverse data with DPO enhances response quality and transition control.

2511.08841.tldr: A novel method is proposed, DP-PMLF, which integrates per-sample momentum with a low-pass filtering strategy to simultaneously mitigate DP noise and clipping bias and significantly enhances the privacy-utility trade-off compared to several state-of-the-art DPSGD variants.

2511.08842.tldr: This paper introduces an adaptive AI safety infrastructure capable of dynamically learning and mitigating attacks against the AI system, and proposes an agentic AI safety architecture that leverages 3D to integrate a dedicated safety layer.

2511.08853.tldr: This work proposes two GNN-agnostic frameworks to address graph super-resolution issues, Bi-SR and DEFEND, and introduces twelve new simulated datasets that capture diverse topologies and LR-HR relationships that enable comprehensive benchmarking of graph super-resolution methods.

2511.08864.tldr: A two-stage architecture is proposed that combines a Transformer-based per-epoch encoder with a 1D CNN aggregator, and the effect of incorporating explicit context is systematically investigated, highlighting that augmenting learned representations with clinically meaningful features enhances both performance and interpretability.

2511.08872.tldr: The Skeleton Structure-Aware Stride SSM (SAS-SSM) is proposed, which first employs a structure-aware spatiotemporal convolution to dynamically capture essential local interactions between joints, and then applies a stride-based scan strategy to construct multi-scale global structural representations.

2511.08877.tldr: This study uses citation count as a proxy for training data redundancy and asks how this redundancy is internally structured within a single bibliographic record.

2511.08892.tldr: Lumine adopts a human-like interaction paradigm that unifies perception, reasoning, and action in an end-to-end manner, powered by a vision-language model and demonstrates strong zero-shot cross-game generalization.

2511.08896.tldr: This study designed a four-step deep learning approach to classify six (6) histopathological regions and quantitatively evaluated it on the BraTS-Path 2024 challenge dataset, which includes digitized Hematoxylin \&Eosin (H\&E) stained GBM tissue sections annotated for six distinct regions.

2511.08904.tldr: A novel Consistency Change Detection Framework (CCDF) is proposed which introduces a Cycle Consistency (CC) module to reduce the overfitting issues in the generator-based reconstruction and proposes a Semantic Consistency (SC) module to enable detail reconstruction.

2511.08922.tldr: A novel approach that leverages diffusion models to generate high-quality, broadly covered in-distribution state-action samples while facilitating efficient policy improvement, and introduces a binary-weighted mechanism that utilizes the advantage values of actions in the offline dataset to guide diffusion model training.

2511.08923.tldr: TiDAR is the first architecture to close the quality gap with AR models while delivering 4.71x to 5.91x more tokens per second and is designed to be serving-friendly (low overhead) as a standalone model.

2511.08926.tldr: This paper theoretically proves that direct access to, or structured modeling of, global utility functions is necessary for the Bayesian Nash Equilibrium under decentralised execution constraints, and proposes an Agent-Attention Multi-Agent Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (AA-MAMORL) framework.

2511.08927.tldr: It is argued that AI systems are not neutral pattern detectors but recursive cognitive agents whose own information processing may systematically obscure or distort other species'communicative structures, which creates a double contingency problem.

2511.08930.tldr: This paper recasts trajectory distillation not as a final generator, but to establish a structural ``sketch", providing a near-optimal initialization for the subsequent distribution-based refinement stage, which yields an ideal initial distribution that enhances the ceiling of overall performance.

2511.08934.tldr: A business process optimisation model integrating artificial intelligence and big data to achieve intelligent management of the whole life cycle of processes is constructed, incorporating data processing, AI algorithms, and business logic to enable real-time process monitoring and optimization.

2511.08942.tldr: This framework outsources high-level planning to a VLM, which leverages its contextual understanding to guide a frontier-based exploration agent, and introduces a novel capability that enables the VLM to interpret top-down obstacle maps alongside first-person views, thereby enhancing spatial awareness.

2511.09005.tldr: Recursion refinement is a robust architectural feature for enhancing LLM reasoning via GIS search by structuring a multi-agent pipeline to ensure a traversal of the search space in a gradual, incremental, and sequential (GIS) manner.

2511.09008.tldr: A two-stage neurosymbolic framework that (1) uses LLMs with optional human guidance to formalize natural language policies, allowing fine-grained control of the formalization process, and (2) uses inference-time autoformalization to validate logical correctness of natural language statements against those policies.

2511.09018.tldr: Owl is proposed, a causally-grounded framework that models hallucination process via a structural causal graph, treating decomposed visual and textual attentions as mediators and a dual-path contrastive decoding strategy: one path emphasizes visually grounded predictions, while the other amplifies hallucinated ones -- letting visual truth shine and hallucination collapse.

2511.09026.tldr: Deep VRegulome, a deep-learning method for prediction and interpretation of functionally disruptive variants in the human regulome, which combines 700 DNABERT fine-tuned models, trained on vast amounts of ENCODE gene regulatory regions, with variant scoring, motif analysis, attention-based visualization, and survival analysis is introduced.

2511.09030.tldr: The results suggest that instead of relying on continual improvement of current LLMs, massively decomposed agentic processes (MDAPs) may provide a way to efficiently solve problems at the level of organizations and societies.

2511.09032.tldr: This work proposes a resilience-oriented runtime framework, named Argus, to mitigate the driving hazards, thus preventing potential safety violations and improving the driving performance of an ADS, and integrates it with three state-of-the-art end-to-end ADSs.

2511.09036.tldr: FedSDWC infers causal semantic representations by modeling the weak causal influence between invariant and variant features, effectively overcoming the limitations of existing invariant learning methods in accurately capturing invariant features and directly constructing causal representations.

2511.09043.tldr: This paper presents MedHE, a novel framework combining adaptive gradient sparsification with CKKS homomorphic encryption to enable privacy-preserving collaborative learning on sensitive medical data and introduces a dynamic threshold mechanism with error compensation for top-k gradient selection.

2511.09049.tldr: This paper breaks the intrinsic relationship tie of attribute categories and learns customized distance metrics suitable for flexibly and accurately revealing various cluster distributions, and the fitting ability of the clustering algorithm is significantly enhanced, benefiting from the learnable category relationships.

2511.09067.tldr: This work introduces MM-CRITIC, a holistic benchmark for evaluating the critique ability of LMMs across multiple dimensions: basic, correction, and comparison, and integrates expert-informed ground answers into scoring rubrics that guide GPT-4o in annotating responses and generating reference critiques, which serve as anchors for trustworthy judgments.

2511.09088.tldr: SAE is proposed to enhance the robustness of AE semantics against domain drift by making them more similar to the target class while distinguishing them from all other classes, and a Filtering-and-Augmentation Module is proposed, which first identifies non-target examples with target-class semantics in the latent space and then augments them to foster more stable semantics.

2511.09090.tldr: The proposed Diff-V2M framework is a general V2M framework based on a hierarchical conditional diffusion model, comprising two core components: visual feature extraction and conditional music generation, and introduces timestep-aware fusion strategies, including feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) and weighted fusion.

2511.09092.tldr: Extensive evaluations across diverse real-world benchmarks demonstrate that OR-R1 provides a robust, scalable, and cost-effective solution for automated OR optimization problem modeling and solving, lowering the expertise and data barriers for industrial OR applications.

2511.09093.tldr: This work proposes to learn a reordering network by minimizing \(l_1\) norm of triangular factors of the reordered matrix to approximate the exact number of fill-ins in a sparse matrix.

2511.09105.tldr: This work investigates the minimum-cost poisoning attack required to steer an LLM's policy toward an attacker's target by flipping preference labels during RLHF/DPO, without altering the compared outputs, and proposes a cost-minimization post-processing method to reduce the number of label flips required while preserving the intended poisoning effect.

2511.09120.tldr: This paper introduces an integrated approach that combines MCDM outranking methods with Differential Privacy (DP), safeguarding individual contributions'privacy in ranking problems, and relies on a pre-processing step to aggregate multiple user evaluations into a comprehensive performance matrix.

2511.09127.tldr: A native end-to-end model is developed, HAR-GUI-3B, which alters the inherent reasoning mode from history-agnostic to history-aware, equipping the GUI agent with stable short-term memory and reliable perception of screen details.

2511.09157.tldr: ProBench is introduced, a comprehensive mobile benchmark with over 200 challenging GUI tasks covering widely-used scenarios and a newly introduced Process Provider automatically supplies accurate process information, enabling presice assessment of agent's performance.

2511.09158.tldr: A pipeline for training a Conciseness Reward Model (CRM) that scores the conciseness of reasoning path is proposed and a novel reward formulation named Conciseness Reward Function (CRF) with explicit dependency between the outcome reward and conciseness score is introduced, thereby fostering both more effective and more efficient reasoning.

2511.09178.tldr: This work derives the main reliability challenges of agentic AI systems during operation based on their characteristics and proposes a two-layered reliability monitoring framework for agentic AI systems which consists of a out-of-distribution detection layer for novel inputs and AI transparency layer to reveal internal operations.

2511.09179.tldr: This paper proposes a cell extraction method for TQA without manual identification, even for complex table headers by computing similarities between a given question and individual cells via a hybrid retrieval mechanism that integrates a language model and TF-IDF.

2511.09221.tldr: Results indicate that compact AE architectures can effectively learn structured, algebraically optimal binary codes through stable and straightforwardTraining, and enforce binary codewords within differentiable AE architectures remains difficult.

2511.09247.tldr: Experiments on three real-world datasets show that MedFuse consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on key predictive tasks, establishing MedFuse as a generalizable approach for modeling irregular clinical time series.

2511.09252.tldr: This study presents a low-exposure, high-efficiency paradigm for federated backdoor attacks and expands the application of fractal features in adversarial sample generation by introducing a dynamic angular perturbation mechanism that adaptively adjusts perturbation intensity across the training phases to balance efficiency and stealthiness.

2511.09294.tldr: GuardFed is proposed, a self-adaptive defense framework that maintains a fairness-aware reference model that maintains a fairness-aware reference model using a small amount of clean server data augmented with synthetic samples, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared with existing robust FL methods.

2511.09309.tldr: This work proposes Cognitive Chain, a novel framework that models task difficulty from a cognitive perspective, and develops an LLM-based method to automatically extract cognitive chains from task execution traces, discussing potential applications in agent training, capability assessment, and human-agent delegation optimization.

2511.09325.tldr: It is argued for developing dedicated qualitative AI systems built from the ground up for interpretive research, which must be transparent, reproducible, and privacy-friendly.

2511.09332.tldr: DFAX is the first feature attribution method to explain classifier predictions directly based on the data distribution, and it is shown through extensive experiments that DFAX is more effective and efficient than state-of-the-art baselines.

2511.09363.tldr: An LLM-based agentic framework for barrier certificate synthesis that uses natural language reasoning to propose, refine, and validate candidate certificates, integrating LLM-driven template discovery with SMT-based verification, and supporting barrier-controller co-synthesis to ensure consistency between safety certificates and controllers is introduced.

2511.09374.tldr: MTQ-Eval is introduced, a novel framework for multilingual text quality evaluation that learns from examples of both high- and low-quality texts, adjusting its internal representations, and leads to notable improvements in downstream tasks.

2511.09378.tldr: This work provides an updated evaluation of the end-to-end planning performance of three frontier LLMs as of 2025, where models are prompted to generate a plan from PDDL domain and task descriptions, and shows substantial improvements over prior generations of LLMs.

2511.09381.tldr: Comparing performance trends and error-correction behaviors across various natural language understanding and reasoning tasks, covering language models of different scales and families, highlights that the design of self-correction mechanisms should take into account the interaction between task structure and output space.
