2511.09404.tldr: CallosumNet is proposed, a divide-and-conquer spatio-temporal graph unlearning framework inspired by the corpus callosum structure that facilitates communication between the brain's two hemispheres that achieves complete unlearning with only 1%-2% relative MAE loss compared to the gold model, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

2511.09438.tldr: A convergence argument for the variational aggregation procedure is outlined, a differential privacy threat model based on a moments accountant is described, and applications to knowledge graph completion, recommendation-style link prediction, and citation and product graphs are presented.

2511.09443.tldr: This work establishes a generalizable foundation for bronchoscopy navigation through a robust vision-based framework and a new synthetic benchmark dataset that enables standardized and reproducible evaluation, and introduces the first public synthetic benchmark dataset for bronchoscopy navigation, addressing the lack of paired CT-endoscopy data.

2511.09450.tldr: This study assesses the performance of statistical, machine learning (ML), and deep learning (DL) models in forecasting traffic speed and flow using real-world data from California's Harbor Freeway, sourced from the Caltrans Performance Measurement System (PeMS).

2511.09454.tldr: It is demonstrated that algorithmic advice can function as a strategic signal, shaping coordination even without explicit communication, and underscore the need for careful design and oversight of algorithmic decision-support systems in competitive environments.

2511.09478.tldr: AdaCuRL is proposed, a Adaptive Curriculum Reinforcement Learning framework that integrates coarse-to-fine difficulty estimation with adaptive curriculum scheduling and incorporates a data revisitation mechanism to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

2511.09493.tldr: A complementary, architecture-agnostic approach that enhances safety through the aggregation of multiple generative models, with the aggregated model inheriting its safety from the safest subset of a given size among them.

2511.09497.tldr: The aim is to create a theoretical foundation that describes the physical embodiment, sensory perception, ability to act, learning processes, and context sensitivity of intelligent systems within a coherent framework, and form the conceptual basis for designing and evaluating physically intelligent systems.

2511.09502.tldr: This work introduces DreamPose3D, a diffusion-based framework that combines action-aware reasoning with temporal imagination for 3D pose estimation and introduces a representation encoder that incorporates kinematic joint affinity into the attention mechanism.

2511.09515.tldr: World-Model-based Policy Optimization (WMPO) is introduced, a principled framework for on-policy VLA RL without interacting with the real environment that enables the policy to perform on-policy GRPO that provides stronger performance than the often-used off-policy methods.

2511.09533.tldr: This paper investigates how individual entrepreneurs can turn creative ideas into successful solo businesses in an era increasingly shaped by Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents, and presents a framework with three key stages, focusing on the specific context of solopreneurship.

2511.09535.tldr: RPO is introduced, a formalism for adversarial optimization that avoids self-sabotage by ensuring agents remain rational--that is, their policies are optimal with respect to some possible partner policy, and achieves strong performance in several popular cooperative and general-sum environments.

2511.09549.tldr: This work theoretically and empirically compare two popular methods for escaping UHRs in breadth-first search (BrFS) and restarting random walks (RRWs) and derives the expected runtime of escaping a UHR using BrFS and RRWs, based on properties of the UHR and the random walk procedure, and identifies when RRWs will be faster in expectation than BrFS.

2511.09558.tldr: This work achieves high-performance semantic grasping without any manually collected training data by combining the global semantic understanding of internet-scale models with the geometric precision of a simulation-based locally-aware force-closure.

2410.17337.tldr: This paper introduces MMECInstruct, the first-ever, large-scale, and high-quality multimodal instruction dataset for e-commerce, and develops CASLIE, a simple, lightweight, yet effective framework for integrating multimodal information for e-commerce.

2501.14250.tldr: Siren, a learning-based multi-turn attack framework designed to simulate real-world human jailbreak behaviors, is proposed and it is hoped Siren inspires the development of stronger defenses against advanced multi-turn jailbreak attacks under realistic scenarios.

2502.18573.tldr: FactReasoner is presented, a novel neuro-symbolic based factuality assessment framework that employs probabilistic reasoning to evaluate the truthfulness of long-form generated responses to improve factual precision and recall.

2503.02034.tldr: The experiments show that Abn-BLIP outperforms state-of-the-art medical vision-language models and 3D report generation methods in both accuracy and clinical relevance, and highlight the potential of integrating multimodal learning strategies for improving radiology reporting.

2503.06161.tldr: FeatureEndo-4DGS (FE-4DGS), the first real time pipeline leveraging feature-distilled 4D Gaussian Splatting for simultaneous reconstruction and semantic segmentation of deformable surgical environments, is introduced.

2506.22837.tldr: This work proposes xLSTMAD, the first anomaly detection method that integrates a full encoder-decoder xLSTM architecture, purpose-built for multivariate time series data, and evaluates the method on the comprehensive TSB-AD-M benchmark, which spans 17 real-world datasets.

2508.05294.tldr: This survey paper reviews works that advance agentic applications and architectures, including initial efforts with GPT-style interfaces and more complex systems where AI agents function as coordinators, planners, perception actors, or generalist interfaces.

2508.12211.tldr: VLAPS offers a principled framework to: i) control test-time compute in VLA models, ii) leverage a priori knowledge of the robotic environment, and iii) integrate established planning and reinforcement learning techniques into the VLA inference process.

2508.15721.tldr: Analysis on EcomMMMU reveals that product images do not consistently improve performance and can, in some cases, degrade it, indicating that MLLMs may struggle to effectively leverage rich visual content for e-commerce tasks.

2510.01611.tldr: The proposed PsychCounsel-Bench benchmark provides a comprehensive assessment of an LLM's ability to function as a counselor, suggesting that only frontier LLMs are currently capable of meeting counseling exam standards, highlighting both the promise and the challenges of developing psychology-oriented LLMs.

2511.04939.tldr: The Search-Is-Not-Retrieve (SINR) framework is introduced, a dual-layer architecture that distinguishes between fine-grained search representations and coarse-grained retrieval contexts that enhances the composability, scalability, and context fidelity of retrieval systems by directly connecting small, semantically accurate search chunks to larger, contextually complete retrieve chunks.

2511.09563.tldr: This work presents a novel and more efficient approach that attains high-accuracy, near-optimal solutions for large-scale JRA problems and introduces a Partial Path Reconstructon (PPR) solver that first identifies key item-placeholder pairs to form a reduced subproblem, which is solved efficiently to refine the global solution.

2511.09564.tldr: An approach of Mamba-driven multi-perspective structural understanding (MPSU-Mamba) is proposed to localize molecular ground-state conformation and indicates that MPSU-Mamba significantly outperforms existing methods on QM9 and Molecule3D datasets.

2511.09570.tldr: This paper presents the competition-winning approach, based on the Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS) metaheuristic, which achieves the best results on the full competition dataset and also outperforms a more recent algorithm published afterward.

2511.09571.tldr: This work presents a novel framework, General Intelligence-based Fragmentation (GIF), that guides pretrained LLMs through spectra simulation using structured prompting and reasoning and highlights the value of using LLMs not only for spectra simulation but for enabling human-in-the-loop workflows and structured, explainable reasoning in molecular fragmentation.

2511.09572.tldr: By enabling scalable, diverse, and reliable tool ecosystems, SynthTools provides a practical path toward large-scale training and stable evaluation of tool-use agents.

2511.09576.tldr: Prostate-VarBench is introduced, a curated pipeline for creating prostate-specific benchmarks that integrates COSMIC, ClinVar, and ClinVar (expert-curated clinical variants) into a harmonized dataset of 193,278 variants supporting patient- or gene-aware splits to prevent data leakage.

2511.09600.tldr: It is proved that, while cogent extensions are weakly admissible, the converse is not true: while cogent extensions are weakly admissible, the converse is not true.

2511.09603.tldr: An explainable intrusion detection framework that integrates Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) with Random Forest (RF) to enhance detection of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs).

2511.09652.tldr: UCB-QRL is an iterative algorithm in which, at each iteration, it is shown that UCB-QRL yields a high-probability regret bound, which is a problem-dependent constant that captures the sensitivity of the underlying MDP's quantile value.

2511.09663.tldr: These findings show that fairness must be judged not only by model metrics but also by the burden imposed on users at the margins, compelling context-aware safeguards that alleviate alignment debt in Global South settings.

2511.09681.tldr: SEBA is proposed, a sample-efficient framework for black-box adversarial attacks on visual RL agents that significantly reduces cumulative rewards, preserves visual fidelity, and greatly decreases environment interactions compared to prior black-box and white-box methods.

2511.09682.tldr: It is demonstrated that Rebellion, a robust RT that trains ARMs to be robust to the worst-case representation drift, can protect against advanced audio jailbreaks without compromising performance on benign tasks, and significantly improves accuracy-safety trade-off over standard RT method.

2511.09724.tldr: PALMS+$ is proposed, a modular, image-based system that addresses indoor localization challenges by reconstructing scale-aligned 3D point clouds from posed RGB images using a foundation monocular depth estimation model (Depth Pro), followed by geometric layout matching via convolution with the floor plan.

2511.09727.tldr: It is demonstrated that purely curiosity-based signals, with no external supervision, can drive coordinated multimodal learning, imitating an infant's progression from random motor babbling to purposeful behaviors.

2511.09735.tldr: A novel deep learning model that enhances the Social LSTM with a new Dynamic Occupied Space loss function that achieves up to a 31% reduction in the collision rate and reduces the average displacement error and the final displacement error by 5% and 6%, respectively, on average across all datasets compared to the baseline.

2511.09737.tldr: This work introduces SPARC: single-phase adaptation for robust control, and tests it on varying contexts within the high-fidelity racing simulator Gran Turismo 7 and wind-perturbed MuJoCo environments, finding that it achieves reliable and robust OOD generalization.

2511.09740.tldr: This paper creates a new data subset, which, despite being much smaller, provides enough information for the segmentation method to reach comparable results in a much shorter time.

2511.09741.tldr: This work proposes TawPipe--topology-aware weight pipeline parallelism, which exploits hierarchical bandwidth in distributed clusters for improved communication efficiency and achieves superior throughput and scalability compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2511.09742.tldr: While medical pre-training is beneficial, architectural choices are critical, and pre-trained features are not universally effective, especially for complex localization tasks where supervised models remain a strong alternative.

2511.09748.tldr: Overall, compact, instruction-tuned LLMs augmented with lightweight calibration and small-sample supervision can deliver trustworthy, on-device CED for MT, enabling private, low-cost error screening in real-world translation pipelines.

2511.09765.tldr: This work establishes a novel EEG-driven optimization framework for cognitive neuromodulation, providing a foundational model for next-generation AI-integrated BCI systems aimed at personalized neurorehabilitation in FXS and related disorders.

2511.09766.tldr: This work evaluates the performance of Ksurf on estimation-based resource orchestration tasks involving highly variable workloads when employed as a contextual multi-armed bandit objective function model for cloud scenarios using Drone.

2511.09768.tldr: The approach is to formalize bias assumptions as programs in ProbLog, a probabilistic logic programming language that allows for the description of probabilistic causal relationships through logic, and concludes that ProbLog4Fairness outperforms baselines due to its ability to flexibly model the relevant bias assumptions, where other methods typically uphold a fixed bias type or notion of fairness.

2511.09774.tldr: Solvaformer is introduced, a geometry-aware graph transformer that models solutions as multiple molecules with independent SE(3) symmetries that provides an accurate, scalable, and interpretable approach to solution-phase property prediction.

2511.09775.tldr: This work proposes a novel privacy-preserving approach based on SHAP entropy regularization to mitigate privacy leakage in explainable AIoT applications, and develops a suite of SHAP-based privacy attacks that strategically leverage model explanation outputs to infer sensitive information.

2511.09788.tldr: This position paper argues for the importance of open small AI models in creative independence for interactive art practices and explores the practical applications and implications of using open small AI models in interactive art, contrasting them with closed-source alternatives.

2304.11954.tldr: Spikingformer is presented, a novel spiking transformer backbone that merges the MS Residual connection with Self-Attention in a biologically plausible way to address the non-spike computation challenge in Spikformer while maintaining global modeling capabilities.

2312.05735.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of MCER modeling methods and roughly divide MCER methods into four categories, i.e., context-free modeling, sequential context modeling, speaker-differentiated modeling, and speaker-relationship modeling.

2406.12163.tldr: A discussion-graph semantics for first-order logic with equality is formulated, enabling reasoning about discussion and argumentation in AI more generally than before, and it is shown that the set of all generalised extensions (acceptability semantics), too, are first-order characterisable.

2406.16464.tldr: A novel framework, InterCLIP-MEP, featuring a Memory-Enhanced Predictor (MEP), featuring a dynamic dual-channel memory mechanism that captures and retains valuable knowledge from test samples during inference, serving as a nonparametric classifier to enhance sarcasm detection robustness.

2408.11062.tldr: Interactive-T2S is introduced, a framework that generates SQL queries through direct interactions with databases through direct interactions with databases and includes four general tools that facilitate proactive and efficient information retrieval by the LLM.

2410.20749.tldr: Matryoshka Pilot is introduced, a lightweight white-box LLM controller that guides a large-scale black-box LLM generator by decomposing complex tasks into a series of intermediate outputs that enhances the capabilities of black-box LLMs in complex, long-horizon tasks.

2410.21597.tldr: This study conducts a comprehensive empirical evaluation of various methods, ranging from prompting, fine-tuning to preference learning and the recently proposed general alignment technique known as Circuit Breakers, and shows that it is possible to scope language models.

2412.16725.tldr: This paper aims to enhance the conflict-solving capabilities of LLMs by leveraging formal abstract argumentation, integrating language model learning with symbolic computation, and provides detailed illustrations that mitigate the lack of transparency typically associated with neural networks.

2501.02409.tldr: PerturbODE is proposed, a novel framework that incorporates biologically informative neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs) to model cell state trajectories under perturbations and derive the causal GRN from the neural ODE's parameters.

2501.11094.tldr: The identification of suicidal ideation in social media text is improved by utilising a hybrid framework that integrates Convolutional Neural Networks and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory, enhanced with an attention mechanism.

2501.18638.tldr: The GAP (Graph of Attacks with Pruning) framework is introduced, an advanced approach for generating stealthy jailbreak prompts to evaluate and enhance LLM safeguards and proves highly effective in improving content moderation systems.

2502.02390.tldr: The novel Chain-of-Associated-Thoughts (CoAT) framework is developed, which introduces an innovative synergy between the Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm and a dynamic mechanism for integrating new key information, termed'associative memory', and significantly expands the LLM search space.

2502.10012.tldr: This work designs three novel task setups in which the differentiable dynamics are combined within an end-to-end computation graph not with a policy, but a state predictor, and demonstrates how differentiable simulation enables their efficient, end-to-end learning.

2502.12143.tldr: This work proposes Mix Distillation, a simple yet effective strategy that balances reasoning complexity by combining long and short CoT examples or reasoning from both larger and smaller models, and demonstrates that it significantly improves small model reasoning performance compared to training on either data alone.

2502.13595.tldr: The Massive Multilingual Text Embedding Benchmark is introduced - a large-scale, community-driven expansion of MTEB, covering over 500 quality-controlled evaluation tasks across 250+ languages, and a novel downsampling method based on inter-task correlation is introduced, ensuring a diverse selection while preserving relative model rankings.

2504.03966.tldr: The Dynamic Course Content Integration mechanism, which dynamically retrieves course content from Canvas LMS and structures it within an LLM’s context window via prompt engineering, enabling the LLM-powered assistant, Ask ME, to deliver context-aware, curriculum-aligned responses while mitigating hallucinations.

2504.12672.tldr: It is shown that blending AIFS with NWP models improves overall forecast skill, even when AIFS alone is not the most accurate component, and statistical post-processing methods developed for NWP are directly applicable to AI models, enabling national meteorological centres to incorporate AI forecasts into existing workflows in a low-risk, incremental fashion.

2505.00787.tldr: This work shows that it significantly reduces the number of base policies needed to ensure optimality in new tasks, and proves that it is strictly more expressive than a CCS, enabling particular classes of non-linear tasks to be solved optimally.

2505.06347.tldr: A large language model (LLM)-assisted framework for quantum-circuit design that systematically scales state-preparation circuits to large lattice volumes is introduced, providing the first scalable ansatz for this class of 2+1d models.

2505.19164.tldr: This research proposes BroadGen, an innovative framework that recommends efficient and effective broad match keyphrases by utilizing historical search query data, and demonstrates that BroadGen, through token correspondence modeling, maintains better query stability over time.

2505.21538.tldr: A vision-text decoupling analysis finds that models struggling with direct visual reasoning show marked improvement when reasoning over their own generated text captions, revealing a strong need for improved VLM Chain-of-Thought (CoT) abilities, even in models that consistently exceed human performance.

2506.01939.tldr: This work undertake a pioneering exploration of RLVR through the novel perspective of token entropy patterns, comprehensively analyzing how different tokens influence reasoning performance and highlights the potential to understand RLVR through a token-entropy perspective and optimize RLVR by leveraging high-entropy minority tokens to further improve LLM reasoning.

2506.18925.tldr: A granular computer vision-based method for quantifying PD motor characteristics from video recordings that achieves a higher accuracy in MDS-UPDRS score prediction, while still providing an interpretable quantification of individual finger-tapping motor characteristics.

2506.19794.tldr: This work investigates strategies to enhance the data analysis capabilities of open-source LLMs by curating a seed dataset of diverse, realistic scenarios and evaluates model behavior across three core dimensions: data understanding, code generation, and strategic planning.

2507.10496.tldr: This work compares techniques for conditioning transformers on cameras: token-level raymap encodings, attention-level relative pose encodings, and a new relative encoding that captures complete camera frustums, both intrinsics and extrinsics, as a relative positional encoding -- Projective Positional Encoding (PRoPE).

2507.14882.tldr: A novel framework for calculating importance metrics in pruning groups not only shrinks the model size but also considers various application-specific constraints to find the best pruning coefficient for each group.

2507.20067.tldr: PITA is a novel framework that integrates preference feedback directly into the LLM's token generation, eliminating the need for a reward model, and is evaluated across diverse tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in aligning LLM outputs with user preferences.

2508.05615.tldr: This work proposes GUI-RC (Region Consistency), a test-time scaling method that constructs spatial voting grids from multiple sampled predictions to identify consensus regions where models show highest agreement, and introduces GUI-RCPO (Region Consistency Policy Optimization), a test-time reinforcement learning method that transforms consistency patterns into rewards for test-time reinforcement learning.

2508.05888.tldr: Findings support the hypothesis that the structural information modeled in the graph provides complementary signals to pure similarity matching, particularly for queries requiring sequential tool composition.

2508.06959.tldr: A novel method is proposed, named Subtle-Cue Oriented Perception Engine (SCOPE), which adaptively enhances the representational capability of low-level details and high-level semantics in the spatial domain, breaking through the limitations of fixed scales in the frequency domain and improving the flexibility of multi-scale fusion.

2508.10027.tldr: Crucially, validation on the Delaware corpus demonstrates that the proposed pipeline generalizes to early-stage impairment, supporting its potential as a scalable approach for clinically relevant early screening.

2508.17311.tldr: Bine trees maintain the generality of binomial trees and butterflies while cutting global-link traffic by up to \(33\%\) while cutting global-link traffic by up to \(33\%\) .

2509.05314.tldr: This work presents a novel framework named ManipDreamer3D for generating plausible 3D-aware robotic manipulation videos from the input image and the text instruction, which combines 3D trajectory planning with a reconstructed 3D occupancy map created from a third-person perspective, along with a novel trajectory-to-video diffusion model.

2509.05796.tldr: Evaluations on the Surface Seal Image dataset-representing sterile-barrier packaging inspection-demonstrate that the proposed methods outperform reference baselines, including MOCCA, CPCAE, and RAG-PaM, under realistic industrial constraints.

2509.06035.tldr: TinyDef-DETR, a DETR-based framework designed to achieve accurate and efficient detection of transmission line defects from UAV-acquired images, achieves superior detection performance and strong generalization capability, while maintaining modest computational overhead.

2510.01252.tldr: It is argued that the LLM+SAEs pipeline offers a scalable framework for auditing how cultural assumptions from the data are embedded in model representations.

2511.07090.tldr: A unified, operational definition of Green AI distinct from Sustainable AI is established and a calibrated measurement framework combining estimator models with direct metering to enable reproducible, provider agnostic comparisons is defined.

2502.15980.tldr: SQLsynth, a human-in-the-loop text-to-SQL data annotation system that streamlines the creation of high-quality text-to-SQL datasets through human-LLM collaboration in a structured workflow, and significantly accelerates text-to-SQL data annotation, reduces cognitive load, and produces datasets that are more accurate, natural, and diverse.

2502.17506.tldr: CLADD, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-empowered agentic system tailored to drug discovery tasks, is proposed, showing that it outperforms general-purpose and domain-specific LLMs as well as traditional deep learning approaches.

2503.09956.tldr: A comprehensive exploration of the relationship between LLMs and wireless networks is offered, presenting a vision of how these domains empower each other to drive innovation.

2503.11880.tldr: Through extensive experiments on NLP benchmarks, it is demonstrated that FedALT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art personalized federated LoRA fine-tuning methods, achieving superior local adaptation without sacrificing computational efficiency.

2503.12999.tldr: This work introduces Concept-as-Tree (CaT), which represents a concept as a tree structure, thereby enabling the data generation of positive and negative samples with varying difficulty and diversity, and can be easily extended to multi-concept scenarios.

2503.13812.tldr: Overall, this case study highlights that while AI personas can usefully surface new perspectives and prompt discussion in deliberative settings, their successful deployment depends on clarifying their limitations and emphasizing that they complement rather than replace genuine participation.

2503.19195.tldr: Mining-Gym is presented -- a configurable, open-source benchmarking environment for training, testing, and evaluating RL algorithms in mining process optimization, enabling fair evaluation of adaptive decision-making and demonstrating the strong performance potential of RL-trained schedulers.

2504.07379.tldr: A modified PIKAN architecture is introduced, tanh-cPIKAN, which is based on Chebyshev polynomials for parametrization of the univariate functions with an extra nonlinearity for enhanced performance.

2505.01812.tldr: The results demonstrate that the Self-QA protocol of Sys2-FT significantly improves models'in-weight learning of the news while preserving general capabilities, and discover the contextual shadowing effect.

2505.12684.tldr: FedGFM+ is presented, an enhanced framework with two core modules to reduce knowledge entanglement, an enhanced framework with two core modules to reduce knowledge entanglement that is evaluated on 8 diverse benchmarks across multiple domains and tasks.

2505.16270.tldr: The overall Pilot-Copilot framework is named the Transformer Copilot, which introduces a novel Copilot model design, a joint training paradigm where the Copilot continuously learns from the evolving Mistake Log alongside the Pilot, and a fused inference paradigm where the Copilot rectifies the Pilot's logits for enhanced generation.

2505.16927.tldr: This work employs a form of posterior-regularized Monte Carlo Expectation-Maximization to both identify a condensed set of the most effective latent principles and teach the LM to strategically invoke them in order to intrinsically refine its responses.

2506.03662.tldr: A novel zero-shot TIL approach dubbed EgoLoc to locate the timings of grasp actions for human-object interaction in egocentric videos, which achieves better temporal interaction localization for egocentric videos compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2506.07853.tldr: This paper proposes a structured, temporal modeling pattern grounded in the LRMoo ontology, and demonstrates that the architecture enables the exact reconstruction of any part of a legal text as it existed on a specific date.

2506.10521.tldr: The Scientists'First Exam (SFE) benchmark is presented, designed to evaluate the scientific cognitive capacities of MLLMs through three interconnected levels: scientific signal perception, scientific attribute understanding, scientific comparative reasoning.

2506.11331.tldr: MUDAS efficiently adapts models by selectively retraining the classifier in situ using high-confidence data, minimizing computational and memory requirements to suit on-device deployment, achieving good performance in a resource-constrained IoT setting.

2506.18588.tldr: This framework leverages a system of stochastic differential equations (SDEs) to capture both deterministic and stochastic forces and sheds light on how noisy supervision, parameter initialization, batch size, and mini-batch sampling trajectories, among other factors, shape the evolution of the Lipschitz continuity of neural networks.

2506.19891.tldr: FedOrtho is a federated unlearning framework that combines orthogonalized deep convolutional kernels with an activation-driven controllable one-shot soft pruning (OSP) mechanism that reduces computational and communication costs by 2-3 orders of magnitude in federated settings and achieves subsecond-level erasure in centralized scenarios while maintaining over 97% retention accuracy and mitigating membership inference risks.

2506.20893.tldr: A membership-inference attack via nearest neighbors (MIA-NN) that uses the probabilities the model assigns to neighboring classes to detect unlearned samples to mitigate privacy leakage is introduced.

2507.03745.tldr: This paper proposes StreamDiT, a streaming video generation model based on adaLN DiT with varying time embedding and window attention that enables real-time applications, e.g. streaming generation, interactive generation, and video-to-video.

2507.10624.tldr: It is argued that LLMs function as powerful pattern completion engines, but lack the architectural scaffolding for principled, compositional reasoning, and delineate the boundary of current LLM capabilities and motivate future models with metacognitive control, principle lifting, and structurally grounded execution.

2507.11017.tldr: FOEM, a novel PTQ method that explicitly incorporates first-order gradient terms to improve quantization error compensation, is proposed, and it is revealed that FOEM consistently outperforms the classical GPTQ method.

2507.14642.tldr: The goal of this study is to streamline story point estimation by evaluating a comparative learning-based framework for calibrating project-specific story point prediction models and finding the approach is more efficient than regression-based approaches.

2507.21383.tldr: This study introduces a hybrid LNN and XGBoost model to optimize ordering strategies in multi-tier supply chains, leveraging LNN's dynamic feature extraction and XGBoost's global optimization capabilities to mitigate the bullwhip effect and enhance cumulative profitability.

2507.23318.tldr: FastDriveVLA is proposed, a novel reconstruction-based vision token pruning framework designed specifically for autonomous driving that includes a plug-and-play visual token pruner called ReconPruner, which prioritizes foreground information through MAE-style pixel reconstruction.

2508.03404.tldr: MACT is introduced, a Multi-Agent Collaboration framework with agent-wise adaptive Test-time scaling that pioneers a paradigm shift to procedural scaling, adapting dynamically to the functional entities of visual documents understanding and reasoning.

2508.19257.tldr: This work proposes Temporal Token Fusion (TTF), a training-free approach that intelligently integrates historical and current visual representations to enhance VLA inference quality, and reveals that selective Query matrix reuse in attention mechanisms enhances rather than compromises performance.

2509.00625.tldr: By combining the flexibility of language-based agents with the reliability of compiled execution, NetGent provides a scalable foundation for generating the diverse, repeatable datasets needed to advance ML in networking.

2509.01348.tldr: A simple penalty expression is introduced and the resulting QUBO formulation is relaxed into a differentiable advanced torrential loss function through an approximation process, which demonstrates its superiority through the Lipschitz constant, forecast performance evaluations, consistency experiments, and ablation studies with the operational model.

2509.07733.tldr: A chatbot interface that allows users to interactively explore the carbon impact of composite meals and relate the results to familiar activities and a methodology that combines advances in LCA and publicly available databases with knowledge-augmented AI techniques to estimate cradle-to-gate carbon footprints of food products are presented.

2509.09168.tldr: This paper presents a training-free framework for adaptive token merging in pretrained vision transformers to jointly reduce inference time and transmission resource usage, and forms the selection of per-layer merging proportions as a multi-objective optimization problem to balance accuracy and computational cost.

2509.14657.tldr: A defence-in-depth architecture comprising a security protocol that treats the edge device, cellular network and cloud backend as three separate trust domains, linked by TPM-based remote attestation and mutually authenticated TLS 1.3.

2509.15901.tldr: FRAME, a modular pipeline that reframes summarization as a semantic enrichment task, and proposes P-MESA, a multi-dimensional, reference-free evaluation framework to assess if a summary fits a target reader.

2509.24967.tldr: Extensive experiments show that, by leveraging additional compute at inference, SecInfer effectively mitigates both existing and adaptive prompt injection attacks, outperforming state-of-the-art defenses as well as existing inference-time scaling approaches.

2510.06188.tldr: A dialect-aware ASR system, BRDialect, developed by fine-tuning the IndicWav2Vec model in ten Bengali regional dialects is introduced, which outperforms the baseline ASR models by 12.41-33.98% on the RegSpeech12 dataset.

2510.08068.tldr: Back-testing on Bitcoin price data from July 2024 to April 2025 shows consistent outperformance across market regimes, demonstrating that verbal feedback represents a new, scalable, and low-cost approach of tuning LLMs for financial goals.

2510.09719.tldr: A novel routing method using in-context vectors to represent model capabilities that achieves state-of-the-art routing performance in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks and allows for seamless integration of new models without retraining the router.

2510.12732.tldr: This work proposes CLUTCH, a novel deep combinatorial bandit that can observe variable length JavaScript test case representations, using an attention mechanism from deep learning and shows that CLUTCH increases efficiency in JavaScript fuzzing compared to three state-of-the-art solutions by increasing the number of valid test cases and coverage-per-testcase.

2510.14683.tldr: Improvements to COUP are presented, bringing theoretically-grounded, utilitarian algorithm configuration to the point where it is competitive with widely used, heuristic configuration procedures that offer no performance guarantees.

2510.21244.tldr: A practical, extensible, and domain-oriented standard for benchmarking LLMs in professional applications, and introduces a dynamic evaluation method that adapts to task variations, integrating automated and human-in-the-loop assessment to measure task execution accuracy, professional knowledge application, adaptability, and user experience quality.

2510.23049.tldr: This note reconciles two seemingly distinct approaches to policy gradient optimization for the Pass@K objective in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards: direct REINFORCE-style methods, and advantage-shaping techniques that directly modify GRPO.

2510.26023.tldr: StuckSolver is a novel Large Language Model (LLM) driven recovery framework that enables AVs to resolve immobilization scenarios through self-reasoning and/or passenger-guided decision-making and exhibits further improvements when passenger guidance is incorporated.

2510.27102.tldr: This paper offers a framework for ERA-based exploratory evaluation of generative audio models by adapting ERA to text-to-audio models, making the analysis tractable by looking at the expressive range of outputs for specific, fixed prompts.

2511.00098.tldr: This work proposes a filter functionality on CLE video sequences to reduce the dataset redundancy in SSL training and improve SSL training convergence and training efficiency and shows that the proposed CLE video filter can be utilized to improve training efficiency in self-supervised scenarios, resulting in a reduction of 67% in training time.

2511.00108.tldr: A novel framework is established, DPPO (Deliberate Practice Policy Optimization), inspired by human metacognition, inspired by human metacognition to train Pelican-VL 1.0, a new family of open-source embodied brain models with parameter scales ranging from 7 billion to 72 billion.

2511.05394.tldr: An AI-assisted Augmented Reality assembly workflow that uses deep learning-based object recognition to identify different assembly components and display step-by-step instructions and a case study on assembling LEGO sculptures is presented.

2511.05863.tldr: Experimental results show that EMOD achieves the state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating strong adaptability and generalization across diverse EEG-based emotion recognition scenarios.

2511.06285.tldr: FreqRec is proposed, a Frequency-Enhanced Dual-Path Network for sequential Recommendation that jointly captures inter-session and intra-session behaviors via a learnable Frequency-domain Multi-layer Perceptrons and is optimized under a composite objective that combines cross entropy with a frequency-domain consistency loss.

2511.06292.tldr: This work introduces a self-improving prompt framework driven by data-augmented optimization that steadily improves prompt accuracy on financial reasoning tasks without needing external labels, and achieves higher performance in both accuracy and robustness than standard prompt methods.

2511.06606.tldr: SPUR provides a simple recipe that transforms monaural LALMs into spatially aware models and consistently improves spatial QA and multi-speaker attribution while preserving general audio understanding.

2511.07095.tldr: This paper studies the data complexity of querying inconsistent weighted description logic (DL) knowledge bases under recently-introduced cost-based semantics and establishes that certain answers for instance queries and possible answers for conjunctive queries can be computed using first-order rewriting and thus enjoy the lowest possible data complexity.

2511.07943.tldr: Experimental results indicate that with as few as several hundred training samples, the performance of Thinker is competitive with established baselines, and when scaled to the full training set, Thinker significantly outperforms these methods across various datasets and model sizes.

2511.08015.tldr: This work employs a two-stage approach, termed Road-Style Adversary Generation and Scenario-Associated Adaptation, to maximize the attack effectiveness on the input scene while ensuring the natural appearance of the poster, allowing the attack to be carried out stealthily without drawing human attention.

2511.08086.tldr: The results indicate that global sparsity is rare, but instead the tasks show local, state-dependent sparsity in their dynamics and this sparsity exhibits distinct structures, appearing in temporally localized clusters and affecting specific subsets of state dimensions.

2511.08136.tldr: This paper proposes a novel approach, SafeMIL, to learn a parameterized cost that predicts if the state-action pair is risky via Multiple Instance Learning, and uses the learned cost to avoid non-preferred behaviors, resulting in a policy that prioritizes safety.

2511.08172.tldr: This work introduces an efficient training pipeline that combines model-based data filtering with parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling compact yet capable multimodal reasoning agents.

2511.08464.tldr: Results demonstrate that CIG yields more informative attributions both quantitatively, using MIL-AIC and MIL-SIC, and qualitatively, through visualizations that align closely with ground truth tumor regions, underscoring its potential for interpretable and trustworthy WSI-based diagnostics.

2511.08544.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive theory of JEPAs and instantiates it in LeJEPA, a lean, scalable, and theoretically grounded training objective, and introduces a novel objective to constrain embeddings to reach that ideal distribution.

2511.08628.tldr: This work proposes a topology-driven multi-subspace fusion framework that enables adaptive subspace collaboration on the Grassmannian manifold and successfully adapts the proven multi-channel interaction philosophy of Euclidean networks to non-Euclidean domains, achieving superior discriminability and interpretability.

2511.09133.tldr: This paper argues that a multifaceted understanding of humor is necessary and addresses this gap by systematically evaluating LLMs through the lens of Oogiri, a form of Japanese improvisational comedy games, and releases the annotated corpus to the community to pave the way for the development of more emotionally intelligent and sophisticated conversational agents.

2511.09914.tldr: This paper organizes the original dataset according to document attributes and generates a large-scale dataset comprising 360k training QA pairs and 10k testing QA pairs, develops domain-specific multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) and explores the impact of multimodal inputs on task performance.

2511.09923.tldr: Triangular-Distribution ES (TD-ES) is proposed, which pairs bounded triangular noise with a centered-rank finite-difference estimator to deliver stable, parallelizable, gradient-free updates and preserves early sample efficiency while enabling robust late-stage gains.

2511.10002.tldr: This paper presents the framework "PustakAI" for the design and evaluation of a novel question-answering dataset"NCERT-QA"aligned with the NCERT curriculum for English and Science subjects of grades 6 to 8, and analyzes the strengths and limitations of current open-source LLMs and high-end LLMs as AI-based learning tools in formal education systems.

2511.10067.tldr: Multifaceted Self-Refinement (MuSeR) is proposed, a data-driven approach that enhances LLMs' context-awareness along three key facets (decision-making, communication, and safety) through self-evaluation and refinement through self-evaluation and refinement.

2511.10480.tldr: Symbolic Tensor grAph GEnerator (STAGE), a framework that synthesizes high-fidelity execution traces to accurately model LLM workloads, and demonstrates its scalability by synthesizing high-fidelity LLM traces spanning over 32K GPUs, while preserving tensor-level accuracy in compute, memory, and communication.

2511.10628.tldr: This work introduces Instella, a family of fully open three billion parameter language models trained entirely on openly available data and codebase and releases two specialized variants: Instella-Long, capable of handling context lengths up to 128K tokens, and Instella-Math, a reasoning-focused model enhanced through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning on mathematical tasks.

2511.10650.tldr: This work presents an unsupervised cycle detection framework that combines structural and semantic analysis that first applies computationally efficient temporal call stack analysis to identify explicit loops and then leverages semantic similarity analysis to uncover subtle cycles characterized by redundant content generation.

2511.10651.tldr: This work proposes a method that first decomposes the complex task into several sub-tasks and designs effective system prompts and user prompts for each sub-task to enable structured data extraction as well as multi-step analysis and evaluation.

2511.10652.tldr: This work transforms biographical data into 1,774 enriched first-person memories with affective-semantic metadata, then employs two-stage retrieval achieving 0.52s prompt generation, offering a practical framework for educational, museum, and research applications requiring both accuracy and efficiency.

2511.10653.tldr: This work presents the first hybrid quantum-classical large language model (LLM) for natural language generation, HyQuT, capable of performing coherent and context-aware dialogue and providing an early demonstration of the feasibility of integrating quantum computing to large-scale generative language models.

2511.10654.tldr: It is demonstrated that temporal constraint satisfaction cannot be reliably learned through next-token prediction on natural language, even with targeted fine-tuning, and deploying such systems in time-critical applications without hybrid architectures incorporating symbolic reasoning modules represents unacceptable risk.

2511.10655.tldr: This work extends the Spectral NSR framework with modular, semantically grounded preprocessing steps that improve graph quality without altering the core spectral reasoning engine, resulting in a more robust, interpretable, and scalable reasoning system suitable for deployment in open-domain and real-world settings.

2511.10656.tldr: A novel framework named PRO is proposed, i.e., PReference Orchestrator, which features a lightweight preference adapter that automatically infers prompt-specific preference weights during both training and deployment phases, and theoretical analysis proving that the prompt-aware preference mechanism achieves superior performance compared to fixed preference weights in multi-objective alignment scenarios.

2511.10658.tldr: These findings show that open-weight LLMs can extract structured data from clinical reports across diseases, languages, and institutions, offering a scalable approach for clinical data curation.

2511.10660.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that performs Test-Time Steering via a Weighted Product of Experts (wPoE) and adaptively combines a universal compression model with a pretrained neural language model, ensuring the compression rate is at least as good as that of the best individual model.

2511.10665.tldr: This work introduces a practical, self-supervised framework for improving the semantic robustness of guard models, which leverages paraphrase sets to enforce prediction consistency using a novel, skew-aware aggregation strategy for robust target computation.

2511.10667.tldr: By analyzing 9 frontier LLMs across 15 diverse decision settings, it is found that most models struggle to achieve consistently strong accuracy across diverse domains; models can be accurate yet globally unfaithful, and there are frequent mismatches between stated rationales and factors driving predictions.

2511.10670.tldr: A transition loss is employed, enabling smooth transitions of data between stages, to effectively address the scarcity of high-quality CS speech translation data and bridge the data gap across different training stages.

2511.10675.tldr: A two-stage demonstration selection method, TopK + Label Distribution Divergence (L2D), which leverages a fine-tuned BERT-like small language model (SLM) to generate label distributions and calculate their divergence for both test inputs and candidate demonstrations, which consistently outperforms previous demonstration selection strategies.

2511.10676.tldr: This paper utilizes the activations before the attention block in the same layer with 2 linear functions and ranking-aware loss to achieve accurate prediction, which also supports prefetching in the first layer, and proposes pre-attention expert prediction to achieve accurate and lightweight expert prefetching.

2511.10689.tldr: Gender bias dynamics across three generations of recursive text generation are investigated using three complementary evaluation frameworks: rule-based pattern matching, embedding-based semantic similarity, and downstream task performance to demonstrate that semantic similarity metrics may diverge from behavioral fairness outcomes.

2511.10690.tldr: A new perspective on the hidden language of multimodal systems is offered and Reasoning-LLMs are used to uncover unexpected concept relationships that transcend textual and visual similarities, inferring how multimodal systems understand and simulate the world.

2511.10693.tldr: This study investigates whether state-of-the-art text-to-speech systems have internalized the human tendency to reduce speech rate to convey politeness - a non-obvious prosodic marker.

2511.10696.tldr: PiAttention is presented, a periodic sparse Transformer that factorizes attention into ring-local neighborhoods, deterministic $\pi-stride skips, and an adaptive fusion gate, and reveals the importance of periodic skips, adaptive fusion, and head-level sparsity coordination for efficient long-context modeling.

2511.10705.tldr: This work establishes a novel training paradigm for GUI agents, shifting from isolated optimization to an integrated, self-driven co-evolution approach, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods after just three iterations without requiring external data.

2511.10707.tldr: Bias-REstrained Prefix Representation FineTuning (BREP ReFT) is proposed, which enhances ReFT's mathematical reasoning capability by truncating training data to optimize the generation of initial reasoning prefixes, intervening on the early inference stage to prevent error accumulation, and constraining the intervention vectors'magnitude to avoid disturbing numerical encoding.

2511.10710.tldr: The preliminary experiments on synthetic datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of aggregated precision-recall curves in capturing model approximation uncertainty, enabling systematic comparison among different model architectures based on their uncertainty characteristics.

2511.10714.tldr: This work proposes BadThink, the first backdoor attack designed to deliberately induce "overthinking" behavior in CoT-enabled LLMs while ensuring stealth, demonstrating a new class of sophisticated attacks against CoT-enabled systems.

2511.10716.tldr: An axiomatic analysis of existing quality measures is conducted, uncovering several unintuitive behaviors and introducing a new measure, directed coverage, demonstrating that the choice of quality measure has a decisive impact on the characteristics of the selected set of solutions and that the proposed measure performs competitively or even favorably across a range of settings.

2511.10720.tldr: PISanitizer is proposed, which first pinpoints and sanitizes potential injected tokens (if any) in a context before letting a backend LLM generate a response, thereby eliminating the influence of the injected instruction.

2511.10761.tldr: This work demonstrates an end-to-end differentiable pipeline where a 3D U-Net full-field surrogate replaces both meshing and simulation steps by training it on the mapping between the signed distance field (SDF) of the shape and the fields of interest.

2511.10767.tldr: Novel reductions from argumentation problems to (Q)SAT are designed, linearly preserve the clique-width, resulting in directed decomposition-guided (DDG) reductions, which cannot be significantly improved under reasonable assumptions.

2511.10776.tldr: New counterfactual decision-making rules are studied by introducing two new metrics: the probabilities of potential outcome ranking (PoR) and the probability of achieving the best potential outcome (PoB).

2511.10780.tldr: Tunisian Arabic to English speech translation dataset, the first publicly available Tunisian Arabic to English speech translation dataset, is introduced and the annotation guidelines and corpus publicly available are made.

2511.10788.tldr: This survey reframes reasoning through the lens of {adaptivity}: the capability to allocate reasoning effort based on input characteristics such as difficulty and uncertainty, and proposes a systematic taxonomy organizing existing methods into training-based approaches that internalize adaptivity through reinforcement learning, supervised fine-tuning, and learned controllers.

2511.10796.tldr: A matrix-free perspective is introduced, using trace estimation to rapidly analyze the empirical, finite-width NTK, and shows so-called one-sided estimators can outperform Hutch++ in the low-sample regime, especially when the gap between the model state and parameter count is large.

2511.10804.tldr: A new mathematical model of discounted cuts is introduced, in which the cost of a cut is evaluated by excluding its most expensive edges, and establishes polynomial-time solvability for all discounted cut problems when the input is restricted to bounded-genus graphs.

2511.10810.tldr: This paper presents the Human-Agent Risk Navigation and Event Safety System (HARNESS), a modular AI framework designed to forecast hazardous events and analyze operational risks in U.S. Department of Energy environments.

2511.10837.tldr: A principled evaluation framework is introduced that differentiates between extrinsic and intrinsic hallucination categories and evaluates detection performance across a suite of curated benchmarks and proposes novel attention aggregation strategies that improve both interpretability and hallucination detection performance.

2511.10842.tldr: This work proposes HyperComplEx, a hybrid embedding framework that adaptively combines hyperbolic, complex, and Euclidean spaces via learned attention mechanisms, and releases the implementation and dataset family to facilitate reproducible research in scalable knowledge graph embeddings.

2511.10845.tldr: It is shown that such networks can resist attacks of a large class of potential attackers and maintain asymptotically optimal welfare post attack, and shows the counter-intuitive result, that attackers that aim at minimizing the social welfare post attack do not actually inflict the greatest possible damage.

2511.10846.tldr: An emergent safety issue of emotion AI reinforcing racial stereotypes through biased emotion classification is found and the need for culturally and dialect-informed affective computing systems is emphasized.

2511.10850.tldr: This work provides an effective approach for merging and transferring specialized skills across evolving LLM families, reducing redundant fine-tuning and enhancing model adaptability.

2511.10852.tldr: This study presents an adaptive DT framework that integrates Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) for physics-aware dimensionality reduction with a Koopman operator for representing nonlinear system in a linear lifted space for the real-time decision-making via model predictive control (MPC).

2511.10857.tldr: A planning support system with agentic AI that enables users to generate demand-oriented regions for disaster planning, integrating the human-in-the-loop principle for transparency and adaptability is introduced.

2511.10860.tldr: HPCAgentTester is introduced, a novel multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) framework designed to automate and enhance unit test generation for HPC software utilizing OpenMP and MPI primitives, offering a more robust and scalable solution for ensuring the reliability of parallel software systems.

2511.10862.tldr: Bangladeshi journalists' high reliance on GenAI like their Western colleagues despite limited institutional support and the near absence of AI policy is found, contributing to understanding how contextual factors shape technology adoption trajectories in non-Western journalism.

2511.10866.tldr: A Short-Window Sliding Learning framework for real-time violence detection in CCTV footages that divides videos into 1-2 second clips and applies Large Language Model (LLM)-based auto-caption labeling to construct fine-grained datasets, enabling precise recognition of rapid violent events.

2511.10872.tldr: Empirical results indicate that leveraging high and low-level intrinsic rewards from the graph encoder-decoder significantly enhances the performance of state-of-the-art GCHRL approaches with an extra small computational cost in dense and sparse reward environments.

2511.10881.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs exhibit format-level negative bias, meaning the prompt format more influences their responses than the semantics of the negative response, and the degree of negative bias can vary depending on the type of prompt, which influences the direction of the response.

2511.10890.tldr: A novel framework that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) as expert guides on the interaction of regional variables to enhance learning of disease progression from irregularly sampled longitudinal patient data and demonstrates superior prediction accuracy and interpretability compared to traditional approaches while revealing additional disease-driving factors beyond conventional connectivity measures.

2511.10892.tldr: This paper proposes Multimodal Cross-Attention Network and Contrastive Learning (MCN-CL) for multimodal emotion recognition, which uses a triple query mechanism and hard negative mining strategy to remove feature redundancy while preserving important emotional cues, effectively addressing the issues of modal heterogeneity and category imbalance.

2511.10896.tldr: An unsupervised pansharpening framework, CLIPPan, is proposed that enables model training at full resolution directly by taking CLIP, a visual-language model, as a supervisor, and forms a novel loss integrating semantic language constraints, enabling CLIPPan to use language as a powerful supervisory signal and guide fusion learning without ground truth.

2511.10903.tldr: These findings highlight the challenges of training complex deep models on limited data and underscore the value of careful data augmentation and simpler algorithms (such as augmented SVM) for Bloom's Taxonomy classification.

2511.10912.tldr: A novel dataset of 176 symptom-diagnosis pairs extracted from House M.D., a medical television series validated for teaching rare disease recognition in medical education is introduced, establishing baseline performance metrics for narrative medical reasoning and providing a publicly accessible evaluation framework for advancing AI-assisted diagnosis research.

2511.10913.tldr: This work highlights a previously underexplored content-centric misuse vector for TTS and underscores the need for robust cross-modal safeguards throughout training and deployment.

2511.10925.tldr: Results show that domain specialization and coordinated reasoning can meaningfully improve legal AI performance, providing a scalable and regulation-aware framework for trustworthy and interpretable automated compliance verification.

2511.10949.tldr: SafeAgents systematically exposes how design choices such as plan construction strategies, inter-agent context sharing, and fallback behaviors affect susceptibility to adversarial prompting, and introduces Dharma, a diagnostic measure that helps identify weak links within multi-agent pipelines.

2511.10958.tldr: TG-DFER is proposed, a text-guided weakly supervised framework that enhances MIL-based DFER by incorporating semantic guidance and coherent temporal modeling, and introduces visual prompts, which align enriched textual emotion labels with visual instance features, enabling fine-grained reasoning and frame-level relevance estimation.

2511.10983.tldr: The theory formalizes how open-ended vision queries can be quantized to MCQs and further binarized into True/False verifications, establishing a hardness ladder.

2511.10985.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive, data-centric analysis of popular open-source DPO corpora, using the Magpie framework to annotate each sample for task category, input quality, and preference reward, a reward-model-based signal that validates the preference order without relying on human annotations.

2511.11006.tldr: A novel Multi-Segment Multi-Task Fusion Network (MSMT-FN) that is uniquely designed for addressing this business demand and consistently outperforms or matches state-of-the-art methods is proposed.

2511.11017.tldr: This work presents a novel approach for integrating multiple databases using knowledge graphs, focusing on the application of large language models as semantic agents for mapping and connecting structured data across systems by leveraging existing vocabularies.

2511.11018.tldr: This work proposes a novel method to enhance diversity in automaton-based structured generation by utilizing automata traversal history to steer LLMs towards novel structural patterns.

2511.11029.tldr: A new incomplete method of breaking the symmetries of abstract structures by better exploiting their representations is demonstrated, and it is shown that this method is faster than the previous methods proposed in this paper.

2511.11034.tldr: This work introduces CrossMed, a benchmark designed to evaluate compositional generalization (CG) in medical MLLMs using a structured Modality-Anatomy-Task (MAT) schema, and evaluates two open-source MLLMs on both Related and Unrelated MAT splits.

2511.11038.tldr: SemanticNN, a semantic codec that tolerates bit-level errors in pursuit of semantic-level correctness, enabling compressive and resilient collaborative inference offloading under strict computational and communication constraints is proposed.

2511.11040.tldr: It is demonstrated that allocating roles with differing viewpoints to specific positions significantly impacts MAD's performance in reasoning tasks, and a novel role allocation strategy, "Truth Last", is found, which can improve MAD performance by up to 22% in reasoning tasks.

2511.11041.tldr: Through extensive experiments, it is shown that renormalization consistently and statistically significantly improves the performance of existing models on the Massive Multilingual Text Embedding Benchmark (MMTEB).

2511.11062.tldr: LiteAttention is introduced, a method that exploits temporal coherence to enable evolutionary computation skips across the denoising sequence and eliminates redundant attention computations without repeated profiling overheads, combining the adaptivity of dynamic methods with the efficiency of static ones.

2511.11065.tldr: This survey provides the first systematic synthesis of DR research spanning 2016-2025, consolidating results from 50+ studies and over 20 datasets and critically examines methodological advances, including self- and semi-supervised learning, domain generalization, federated training, and hybrid neuro-symbolic models.

2511.11066.tldr: A novel SFT paradigm that establishes anatomically-grounded alignment by leveraging auxiliary signals of varying granularities is proposed, highlighting a promising direction for enhancing grounding capabilities in complex, multi-modal generation tasks.

2511.11095.tldr: A novel, yet simple method is introduced that is guaranteed to learn valid generalised plans and state space pruning axioms for search, and demonstrates significant improvements over state-of-the-art (generalised) planners with respect to the 3 metrics of synthesis cost, planning coverage, and solution quality.

2511.11113.tldr: VideoP2R is proposed, a novel process-aware video RFT framework that enhances video reasoning by modeling perception and reasoning as distinct processes and achieves state-of-the-art (SotA) performance on six out of seven video reasoning and understanding benchmarks.

2511.11124.tldr: AV-Dialog is presented, the first multimodal dialog framework that uses both audio and visual cues to track the target speaker, predict turn-taking, and generate coherent responses, achieving robust streaming transcription, semantically grounded turn-boundary detection and accurate responses, resulting in a natural conversational flow.

2511.11125.tldr: It is shown that few-shot prompting approaches are sufficient to solve simple problems in a language that is otherwise not well-supported by an LLM and that is possible on-premise, thereby ensuring the protection of sensitive company data.

2511.11144.tldr: The metamodel provides an abstract representation of fairness, enabling the formal definition of fairness notions, and is used in the Tiles framework, which offers modular components that can be interconnected to represent various definitions of fairness.

2511.11162.tldr: This work proposes a novel I2I translation framework, OT-ALD, grounded in optimal transport (OT) theory, which retains the strengths of DDIB-based approach and eliminates latent distribution mismatches.

2511.11169.tldr: AlignVQA is introduced, a debate-based multi-agent framework, in which diverse specialized VLM -- each following distinct prompting strategies -- generate candidate answers and then engage in two-stage interaction, which yields confidence estimates that more accurately reflect the model's true predictive performance.

2511.11172.tldr: This paper proposes a group recommender system called Group Soft-Impute SVD, which leverages soft-impute singular value decomposition to enhance group recommendations and addresses the challenge of sparse high-dimensional data using low-rank matrix completion.

2511.11182.tldr: The Multi-agent Undercover Gaming (MUG) protocol is introduced, inspired by social deduction games like "Who is Undercover?". MUG reframes MAD as a process of detecting "undercover" agents (those suffering from hallucinations) by employing multimodal counterfactual tests.

2511.11231.tldr: DiT-Gaze is proposed, a framework that enhances 3D gaze redirection models using a novel combination of Diffusion Transformer, weak supervision across gaze angles, and an orthogonality constraint loss to set a new state-of-the-art in both perceptual quality and redirection accuracy.

2511.11240.tldr: HealSplit is presented, the first unified defense framework tailored for SFL, offering end-to-end detection and recovery against five sophisticated types of poisoning attacks, achieving superior robustness and defense effectiveness across diverse attack scenarios.

2511.11244.tldr: A new, real-world AI application for gaze target detection in autistic children, which predicts a child's point of gaze from an activity image and proposes a novel Socially Aware Coarse-to-Fine (SACF) gaze detection framework that explicitly leverages the social context of a scene to overcome the class imbalance common in autism datasets.

2511.11252.tldr: UAVBench establishes a reproducible and physically grounded foundation for benchmarking agentic AI in autonomous aerial systems and advancing next-generation UAV reasoning intelligence, and presents UAVBench_MCQ, a reasoning-oriented extension containing 50,000 multiple-choice questions spanning ten cognitive and ethical reasoning styles, ranging from aerodynamics and navigation to multi-agent coordination and integrated reasoning.

2511.11257.tldr: AIonopedia is introduced, to the best of its knowledge, the first LLM agent for IL discovery, powered by an LLM-augmented multimodal domain foundation model for ILs, which enables accurate property predictions and incorporates a hierarchical search architecture for molecular screening and design.

2511.11258.tldr: This paper presents a scalable and deterministic pipeline for generating natural language QA from KGs, with an additional refinement step using LLMs to further enhance linguistic quality.

2511.11265.tldr: The Software Quality Dataset (SQuaD), a multi-dimensional, time-aware collection of software quality metrics extracted from 450 mature open-source projects across diverse ecosystems, enables empirical research on maintainability, technical debt, software evolution, and quality assessment at unprecedented scale.

2511.11281.tldr: An appropriate notion of contrastive explanations for the special case of ABox reasoning with description logic ontologies is developed, and the computational complexity for different variants under different optimality criteria is analyzed, considering lightweight as well as more expressive description logics.

2511.11287.tldr: VOIX, a web-native framework that enables websites to expose reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving capabilities for AI agents through simple, declarative HTML elements, provides a foundational mechanism for realizing the Agentic Web.

2511.11298.tldr: These findings reveal practical trade-offs among VLA model architectures in balancing precision, generalization, and deployment cost, offering actionable insights for selecting and deploying VLAs in real-world robotic manipulation tasks.

2511.11299.tldr: This work introduces AUVIC, a novel visual concept unlearning framework for MLLMs that applies adversarial perturbations to enable precise forgetting and achieves state-of-the-art target forgetting rates while incurs minimal performance degradation on non-target concepts.

2511.11301.tldr: EcoAlign is proposed, an inference-time framework that reframes alignment as an economically rational search by treating the LVLM as a boundedly rational agent and offering a principled, economical pathway to robust LVLM alignment.

2511.11323.tldr: This work proposes RLSLM, a hybrid Reinforcement Learning framework that integrates a rule-based Social Locomotion Model, grounded in empirical behavioral experiments, into the reward function of a reinforcement learning framework, enabling socially aligned navigation policies with minimal training.

2511.11324.tldr: Quantitative evaluation shows NOVA outperforms coding-agent baselines, and a pathologist-verified case study links morphology to prognostically relevant PAM50 subtypes, demonstrating its scalable discovery potential.

2511.11340.tldr: The Multi-Domain Detection of AI-Generated Text (M-DAIGT) shared task, which focuses on detecting AI-generated text across multiple domains, particularly in news articles and academic writing, is introduced.

2511.11373.tldr: Applied to Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, MarsRL improves AIME2025 accuracy from 86.5% to 93.3% and BeyondAIME from 64.9% to 73.8%, even surpassing Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507.

2511.11393.tldr: This survey systematically reviews recent advances in robust and efficient communication strategies for MARL under realistic constraints, including message perturbations, transmission delays, and limited bandwidth and focuses on three applications involving cooperative autonomous driving, distributed simultaneous localization and mapping, and federated learning.

2511.11397.tldr: This work addresses one of the main challenges when dealing with variational quantum algorithms on general problems, namely designing an expressive and efficient quantum ansatz working on tracking events with fixed detector geometry by employing a quantum architecture search method based on Monte Carlo Tree Search to design the quantum circuits for different problem sizes.

2511.11439.tldr: RETROFIT is proposed, which regulates knowledge retention and adaptation with controlled forgetting at each update, without requiring historical data, and achieves over 2x the BLEU score of transfer learning used in prior work and surpasses all baselines in cross-representation generalization.

2511.11461.tldr: It is shown that the structural gap is identically zero for any dataset, and that the estimation variance of the recursive strategy at any horizon can be written as the one-step variance multiplied by a Jacobian-based amplification factor that measures how sensitive the composed predictor is to parameter error.

2511.11468.tldr: The research delves into the robustness of the VLLMs to plausible yet unanswerable questions, and reveals VLLMs'Limitations and demonstrates that VRD-UQA can serve as an evaluation framework for developing resilient document VQA systems.

2511.11476.tldr: Symbiotik is presented, an intelligent, context-aware adaptive visualization system that leverages neurophysiological signals to estimate mental workload (MWL) and dynamically adapt visual dashboards using reinforcement learning (RL).

2511.11502.tldr: The Prelim Attention Score (PAS), a lightweight, training-free signal computed from attention weights over prelim tokens, achieves state-of-the-art object-hallucination detection across multiple models and datasets, enabling real-time filtering and intervention.

2511.11519.tldr: Experience-Guided Reasoner (EGuR), which generates tailored strategies dynamically at inference time based on accumulated experience using an LLM-based meta-strategy -- a strategy that outputs strategies -- enabling adaptation of all strategy components (prompts, sampling parameters, tool configurations, and control logic).

2511.11533.tldr: This work introduces a new ergodic control formulation that optimizes spatial coverage using a volumetric state representation, preserves the asymptotic coverage guarantees of ergodic control, adds minimal computational overhead for real-time control, and supports arbitrary sample-based volumetric models.

2511.11558.tldr: A human-AI collaborative (HAIC) workflow that integrates large language models for hypothesis generation and analysis, with collaborative policy updates driving autonomous pulsed laser deposition (PLD) experiments for remote epitaxy of BaTiO$_3$/graphene.

2308.04371.tldr: C Cumulative Reasoning is introduced, a structured framework that enhances LLM problem-solving by emulating human-like iterative and cumulative thought processes and outperforms existing methods in logical inference tasks with up to a 9.3% improvement.

2408.14033.tldr: MLR-COPILOT, an autonomous Machine Learning Research framework powered by large language model agents, is presented, designed to enhance ML research productivity through automatic generation and implementation of research ideas within constraints.

2411.02671.tldr: This work focuses on an optimal demonstration selection approach that utilizes latent concept variables for resource-efficient task adaptation and empirically verify that the fair latent variable approach improves fairness results on tabular datasets compared to multiple heuristic demonstration selection methods.

2504.15217.tldr: DRAGON is a new approach to designing and optimizing reward functions for improving human-perceived quality, which can optimize reward functions that evaluate either individual examples or distributions of them, making it compatible with a broad spectrum of instance-wise, instance-to-distribution, and distribution-to-distribution rewards.

2505.11225.tldr: History-Aware Policy Optimization employs a novel length reward function based on this history state to incentivize the discovery of correct solutions that are more concise than those previously found, and avoids overly penalizing shorter incorrect responses with the goal of facilitating exploration towards more efficient solutions.

2506.05628.tldr: An efficient training-free method for navigating and sampling from the molecular space with a generative Chemical Language Model (CLM), while using the molecular similarity to the target as a guide, which outperforms existing training-free baseline methods.

2506.08552.tldr: This work proposes a lightweight post-training framework that refines latent reasoning trajectories using two novel strategies: Contrastive reasoning feedback, which compares reasoning embeddings against strong and weak baselines to infer effective update directions via embedding enhancement; and Residual embedding refinement, which stabilizes updates by progressively integrating current and historical gradients, enabling fast yet controlled convergence.

2506.09105.tldr: This work presents MetaTT, a Tensor Train (TT) adapter framework for fine-tuning of pre-trained transformers, and leverages the TT-ansatz to design a rank adaptive optimizer inspired by the DMRG method from many-body physics.

2506.10245.tldr: This work introduces ToxSyn, the first Portuguese large-scale corpus explicitly designed for multi-label hate speech detection across nine protected minority groups, and reveals a catastrophic, mutual generalization failure between social-media domains and ToxSyn.

2506.11305.tldr: Results show that Avey compares favorably to the Transformer across a variety of standard short-range NLP benchmarks, while significantly outperforming it on tasks requiring long-range dependency modeling.

2506.23293.tldr: This work teaches us that words arise as a side-effect of emergent symbolic order, and that human language patterns at all structural levels reflect a universal mechanism of word formation (which is subregular).

2508.07208.tldr: This paper theoretically shows that a two-layer transformer with one head per layer can indeed represent any conditional k-gram, and provides the tightest known characterization of the interplay between transformer depth and Markov order for ICL.

2510.24796.tldr: This work provides the first large-scale empirical validation of bidirectional desire dynamics in human-AI interaction and establishes mutual wanting as a measurable phenomenon with clear implications for building more trustworthy and relationally-aware AI systems.

2511.05805.tldr: This work theoretically quantify the estimation bias that arises from na\"ively aggregating performance estimates from treatment and control groups and derive the condition under which this bias leads to incorrect model selection, and proposes nuisance parameter weighting (NPW), an unbiased model evaluation approach that reweights data from the treatment group to mimic the distributions of samples that would or would not experience the outcome under no intervention.

2511.10367.tldr: DermAI is introduced, a lightweight, smartphone-based application that enables real-time capture, annotation, and classification of skin lesions during routine consultations that highlights the importance of standardized, diverse data collection aligned with healthcare needs and oriented to machine learning development.

2511.11579.tldr: This work performs a deeper dive into the positional versus symbolic dichotomy of attention heads behavior, both at the theoretical and empirical level, and provides a detailed understanding of RoPE, and how its properties relate to model behavior.

2511.11581.tldr: This work develops a state-of-the-art paged attention kernel that builds exclusively on the domain-specific just-in-time compiled language Triton to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
