2508.15874.tldr: Spatial Policy (SP), a unified spatial-aware visuomotor robotic manipulation framework via explicit spatial modeling and reasoning, is proposed, which enhances the practicality of embodied models for robotic control applications.

2508.18646.tldr: This survey introduces an anthropomorphic evaluation paradigm through the lens of human intelligence, proposing a novel three-dimensional taxonomy: Intelligence Quotient (IQ)-General Intelligence for foundational capacity, Emotional Quotient (EQ)-Alignment Ability for value-based interactions, and Professional Quotient (PQ)-Professional Expertise for specialized proficiency.

2508.18708.tldr: This work proposes FairSkillMARL, a framework that defines fairness as the dual objective of workload balance and skill-task alignment, and introduces MARLHospital, a customizable healthcare-inspired environment for modeling team compositions and energy-constrained scheduling impacts on fairness.

2509.01476.tldr: A simple yet effective refusal mechanism for refusal-post-trained RALMs that improves their overall answer quality by balancing refusal and correct answers and emphasizes that uncertainty estimation for RALMs remains an open problem deserving deeper investigation.

2509.03303.tldr: This paper shows how automatic differentiation (AD) techniques can effectively alleviate computational burdens of agent-based models (ABMs) and enables variational inference (VI) techniques for efficient parameter calibration.

2509.07463.tldr: DepthVision is presented, a multimodal framework that enables Vision--Language Models (VLMs) to exploit LiDAR data without any architectural changes or retraining and demonstrates that LiDAR-guided RGB synthesis is a practical pathway for integrating range sensing into modern vision-language systems for autonomous driving.

2509.08383.tldr: Cutmax is introduced, an HE-friendly argmax algorithm that reduces ciphertext operations compared to prior methods, enabling practical greedy decoding under encryption and the first HE-compatible nucleus (top-p) sampling method is proposed, leveraging cutmax for efficient stochastic decoding with provable privacy guarantees.

2509.10504.tldr: Inter Retrosynthesis Planning (InterRetro), a method that interacts with the tree MDP, learns a value function for worst-path outcomes, and improves its policy through self-imitation, preferentially reinforcing past decisions with high estimated advantage.

2509.12179.tldr: The 46% synergy improvement demonstrates optimal collaboration exists at the intersection, not union, of human and AI capabilities, validating the shift from single-directional to co-alignment paradigms.

2509.12443.tldr: The feasibility of agentic AI for Fortran-to-Kokkos transformation is demonstrated and a pathway for autonomously modernizing legacy scientific applications to run portably and efficiently on diverse supercomputers is offered.

2509.14926.tldr: This work pretrain 3 domain-specific masked language models for patents, using the ModernBERT architecture and a curated corpus of over 60 million patent records, which incorporates architectural optimizations, including FlashAttention, rotary embeddings, and GLU feed-forward layers.

2509.15987.tldr: This work model per-pixel depth as a mixture distribution, capturing multiple plausible depths and shifting uncertainty from direct regression to the mixture weights and shifting uncertainty from direct regression to the mixture weights.

2509.18970.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive survey of hallucinations in LLM-based agents and proposes a new taxonomy that identifies different types of agent hallucinations occurring at different stages, and conducts an in-depth examination of eighteen triggering causes underlying the emergence of agent hallucinations.

2509.19465.tldr: A unified reimplementation of widely-adopted neural forecasting networks is introduced, adapting them for the CFTL setup, and it is found that synthetic dataset pre-training does improve the accuracy of a FFM by 7% percent.

2510.08084.tldr: This study presents a novel ensemble learning architecture designed to improve IoT attack detection, providing an effective and scalable method for securing IoT environments.

2510.10205.tldr: PIXEL is proposed, a position-wise activation steering framework that learns a property-aligned subspace from dual views (tail-averaged and end-token) and selects intervention strength via a constrained geometric objective with a closed-form solution, thereby adapting to token-level sensitivity without global hyperparameter tuning.

2510.11654.tldr: FinVet is introduced, a novel multi-agent framework that integrates two Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines with external fact-checking through a confidence-weighted voting mechanism that employs adaptive three-tier processing that dynamically adjusts verification strategies based on retrieval confidence.

2510.16194.tldr: By combining independent evaluation agents with LLM majority voting, TEAM-PHI offers a practical, secure, and cost-effective solution for automatic evaluation and best-model selection in PHI de-identification, even when ground-truth labels are limited.

2510.25101.tldr: This paper proposes KnowCoder-A1, an LLM that can autonomously perform agentic reasoning on KBs to obtain answers, and trains the LLM under outcome-only supervision via a multi-stage curriculum reinforcement learning with an easy-to-hard curriculum.

2510.25327.tldr: MMEdge is proposed, a new on-device multimodal inference framework based on pipelined sensing and encoding that significantly reduces end-to-end latency while maintaining high task accuracy across various system and data dynamics.

2510.26324.tldr: It is proved that combining diffusion models with an annealed variant of Langevin dynamics achieves conditional sampling in polynomial time using merely an $L^4$ bound on the score error.

2510.26782.tldr: At its core is a lightweight geometric regularization module that can be seamlessly integrated into standard autoencoders, reshaping their latent space to provide a stable foundation for effective dynamics modeling, and offers a simple yet powerful pipeline for improving world model fidelity.

2511.00447.tldr: To "de-instructionalize" data tokens, DRIP introduces a data curation and training paradigm with a lightweight representation-editing module that edits embeddings of instruction-like tokens in the data section, enhancing security without harming utility.

2511.02340.tldr: A transformer-based framework for predicting CKD progression using multi-modal electronic health records (EHR) from the Seoul National University Hospital OMOP Common Data Model is presented, offering a promising direction for personalized CKD care.

2511.03758.tldr: This work introduces the CiteAgent framework, designed to generate citation networks based on human-behavior simulation with LLM-based agents, and establishes two LLM-based research paradigms in social science: LLM-SE and LLM-LE.

2511.04376.tldr: MusRec is introduced, a zero-shot text-to-music editing model capable of performing diverse editing tasks on real-world music efficiently and effectively and establishing a strong foundation for controllable music editing in real-world scenarios.

2511.04584.tldr: A principled framework based on a shared responsibility of query specification between user and system is developed, distinguishing unambiguous and ambiguous cooperative queries, which systems can resolve through reasonable inference, from uncooperative queries that cannot be resolved.

2511.06785.tldr: This paper designs a multi-level masking strategy to promote effective feature modeling under partial and irregular observations and proposes a hierarchical prompt learning mechanism that aggregates unmasked data into a global prompt, serving as a semantic anchor for guiding both patch-level and epoch-level feature modeling.

2511.07202.tldr: This work-in-progress paper introduces a Probabilistic Active Inference Resilience Agent (PAIR-Agent) to achieve resilience in DCC systems and theoretical validations confirm the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed framework.

2511.07991.tldr: This research enables automatic generation of TBox-validating CQs using LLMs, significantly reducing manual effort while improving semantic alignment between ontologies and expert knowledge.

2511.08945.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach based on the Hausdorff Dimension, a widely recognized concept in fractal geometry used to quantify structural complexity, which aids in enhancing the diversity of generated outputs in Fractal Generative Models.

2511.09087.tldr: The goal of Tele-LLM-Hub is to democratize the design of context aware multi-agent (MA) Large Language Model (LLM) systems and accelerate innovation in next-generation wireless networks.

2511.09148.tldr: LoopTool is introduced, a fully automated, model-aware data evolution framework that closes this loop by tightly integrating data synthesis and model training and demonstrates that closed-loop, self-refining data pipelines can dramatically enhance the tool-use capabilities of LLMs.

2511.09904.tldr: This work extends MLE-Bench, a benchmark for realistic ML tasks, with code-sabotage tasks such as implanting backdoors and purposefully causing generalisation failures, and studies agent capabilities to sandbag on MLE-Bench.

2511.10459.tldr: LocalBench is the first benchmark designed to systematically evaluate LLMs on county-level local knowledge across the United States, and reveals critical limitations: even the best-performing models reach only 56.8% accuracy on narrative-style questions and perform below 15.5% on numerical reasoning.

2511.10687.tldr: A theoretical framework is proposed that unifies cooperative game-theoretic attribution with process reward modeling to transform system evaluation into agent credit and then into response-level signals, providing a unified and auditable pathway from global evaluation to local supervision in LLM multi-agent training.

2511.10704.tldr: This framework recasts AI alignment as a problem of continuous thermodynamic control, providing a quantitative foundation for maintaining the stability and safety of advanced autonomous systems.

2511.10952.tldr: This paper characterizes requirements for agent decision making in deployed, autonomous AI systems and identifies the types of knowledge agents require to make decisions robust to agent goals and aligned with human expectations.

2511.11083.tldr: The Scalable Population Training (ScaPT) is proposed, an efficient RL training framework comprising two key components: a meta-agent that efficiently realizes a population by selectively sharing parameters across agents, and a mutual information regularizer that guarantees population diversity.

2511.11305.tldr: This work introduces MOON, a comprehensive set of sustainable iterative practices for multimodal representation learning for e-commerce applications that has already been fully deployed across all stages of Taobao search advertising system, allowing effective integration of multimodal representations with downstream tasks.

2511.11590.tldr: An Explainability-Enabled Clinical Safety Framework (ECSF) is proposed that integrates explainability into the DCB0129/0160 lifecycle, enabling Clinical Safety Officers to use interpretability outputs as structured safety evidence without altering compliance pathways.

2511.11721.tldr: This paper introduces a strategy to allocate services on a cloud system without overloading the nodes and maintaining the system stability with minimum cost, and proposes a novel genetic algorithm, where population is seeded with the outputs of other meta-heuristic algorithms.

2511.11896.tldr: Vulnerability-Adaptive Policy Optimization (VULPO), an on-policy LLM reinforcement learning framework for context-aware VD, which incorporates label-level and sample-level difficulty-adaptive reward scaling, encouraging the model to explore challenging cases while maintaining balanced reward distribution.

2511.12590.tldr: By integrating spatial and sequential priors into fine-grained queries and applying a denoising strategy to boundary-point topology reasoning, this method precisely models complex lane structures and delivers trustworthy topology predictions.

2511.12935.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that PFAvatar outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of reconstruction fidelity, detail preservation, and robustness to occlusions/truncations, advancing practical 3D avatar generation from real-world OOTD albums.

2511.12988.tldr: This work proposes a plug-and-play framework, UNSEEN, which can be integrated into existing dataset pruning methods and significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1K.

2511.13057.tldr: This work conducts a rigorous empirical study on the BEIR SciFact benchmark, evaluating the trade-offs between two primary compression strategies and shows that int8 scalar quantization provides the most effective "sweet spot," achieving a 4x compression with a negligible [~1-2%] drop in nDCG@10.

2511.13288.tldr: M-GRPO is proposed, a hierarchical extension of Group Relative Policy Optimization designed for vertical Multi-agent systems with a main agent (planner) and multiple sub-agents (multi-turn tool executors) and computes group-relative advantages for both main and sub-agents, maintaining hierarchical credit assignment.

2511.13442.tldr: Foresee, a training-free MLLM-based pipeline tailored for image forgery analysis, eliminates the need for additional training and enables a lightweight inference process, while surpassing existing MLLM-based methods in both tamper localization accuracy and the richness of textual explanations.

2511.13595.tldr: This work focuses on accurately solving the regulator equations introducing a physics-informed neural network (PINN) approach that directly approximates $\pi(w)$ and $c(w)$ by minimizing the residuals under boundary and feasibility conditions, without requiring precomputed trajectories or labeled data.

2511.13809.tldr: This work introduces a novel differentiable approach to global explainability by design, integrating feature importance estimation directly into model training, offering a scalable framework for inherently explainable machine learning.

2511.13825.tldr: KOSMOS produced one well-supported discovery, one plausible but uncertain result, and one false hypothesis, illustrating that AI scientists can generate useful ideas but require rigorous auditing against appropriate null models.

2511.13852.tldr: This paper investigates extending the methodology for bounding counterfactual probabilities in structural causal models to semi-Markovian SCMs, where exogenous variables may influence multiple endogenous variables and are capable of representing confounding relationships that Markovian models cannot.

2511.13860.tldr: The first randomized controlled trial (RCT) evaluating the impact of a domain-specific AI agent - the Microsoft Security Copilot Phishing Triage Agent - on analyst productivity and accuracy demonstrates that agent-augmented analysts achieved up to 6.5 times as many true positives per analyst minute and a 77% improvement in verdict accuracy.

2511.13865.tldr: Results from the first randomized controlled trial (RCT) evaluating an AI agent for Conditional Access policy management in Microsoft Entra demonstrate that purpose-built AI agents can significantly enhance both speed and accuracy in identity administration.

2511.13877.tldr: A new enhanced model architecture to perform classification of lumbar spine degeneration with DICOM images while using a hybrid approach, integrating EfficientNet and VGG19 together with custom-designed components is proposed, further improving feature selection and representation.

2511.13884.tldr: This paper presents two approaches submitted to the WMT 2025 Automated Translation Quality Evaluation Systems Task 3 - Quality Estimation (QE)-informed Segment-level Error Correction, and investigates a simple training-free approach - QE-informed Retranslation, and compares it with another within the same training-free paradigm.

2511.13892.tldr: This paper systematically analyzes the vulnerabilities of LVLMs integrated in Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) under carefully crafted jailbreaking attacks and introduces a novel jailbreaking attack that exploits the vulnerabilities of LVLMs through image typography manipulation and multi-turn prompting.

2511.13900.tldr: GM-Extract is introduced, a novel benchmark dataset meticulously designed to evaluate LLM performance on retrieval of control variables and a systematic evaluation of 7-8B parameter models on two multi-document tasks, demonstrating a significant change in retrieval performance simply by altering how the data is represented in the context window.

2511.13936.tldr: It is suggested that while preference learning shows promise for audio, particularly in capturing subjective qualities like naturalness and musicality, the field requires standardized benchmarks, higher-quality datasets, and systematic investigation of how temporal factors unique to audio impact preference learning frameworks.

2511.13942.tldr: A new matching algorithm called CORGI (Collection-Oriented Relational Graph Iteration) is introduced, which significantly outperforms RETE implementations from SOAR and OPS5 on a simple combinatorial matching task.

2511.13970.tldr: Across four state-of-the-art generative models, the proposed VQA Graph Score outperforms CLIP and BLIP metrics based on entropy-based validation, confirming its higher discriminative sensitivity.

2511.13981.tldr: It is demonstrated that applying PCA Whitening to input activations -- a standard preprocessing technique in classical sparse coding -- improves SAE performance across multiple metrics, and suggested that whitening should be considered as a default preprocessing step for SAE training, particularly when interpretability is prioritized over perfect reconstruction.

2511.13987.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that AI agents effectively enhance musical pattern recognition, compositional parameterization, and educational feedback, outperforming traditional automated methods in terms of interpretability and adaptability.

2511.13998.tldr: LoCoBench-Agent is introduced, a comprehensive evaluation framework specifically designed to assess LLM agents in realistic, long-context software engineering workflows and establishes a rigorous foundation for measuring agent capabilities, identifying performance gaps, and advancing autonomous software development at scale.

2511.14001.tldr: This work presents a novel method that utilizes tractable probabilistic circuits to circumvent this restriction over probability distributions and utilizes a new learning routine that trains these circuits on both the original distribution and marginal queries.

2511.14002.tldr: Evaluation on real-world flaky tests from industrial repositories shows that FlakyGuard repairs 47.6% of reproducible flaky tests with 51.8% of the fixes accepted by developers, and outperforms state-of-the-art approaches by at least 22% in repair success rate.

2511.14013.tldr: The paper argues that the rationality underlying humanity's impulse to pursue, articulate, and adhere to rules deserves to be valued and preserved and proposed a methodology to make a sense of discrimination possible and practical to identify the distinctions of the behavior of AI models with three types of decisions.

2511.14017.tldr: This work shows that narrow domain unlearning can yield compliance responses for the targeted concept, however, it may also propagate EMA to unrelated domains, and finds that the safety concept can have larger EMA impact, i.e, causing lower refusal scores, across other unrelated domains such as bias.

2511.14018.tldr: Experiments on the MQUAKE benchmark demonstrate that ALEX significantly improves both the accuracy of multi-hop answers and the reliability of reasoning paths (HopWise-ACC) and reduces the required search space by over 80% , presenting a promising path toward building scalable, efficient, and accurate knowledge editing systems.

2511.14021.tldr: A 2.5D context-aware model that leverages multi-slice information to avoid ambiguity from isolated slices and enable robust feature learning and validate the utility of the generated metadata in a brain tumor detection task.

2511.14022.tldr: Across Flask, SQLAlchemy, Pandas, and Poetry, Inc-FT with old-aware mixes delivers the best overall balance on mixed sets, ICL with English delta summaries delivers the fastest new-code lift when training is not feasible, and Full Refresh remains the ceiling when maximum NEW accuracy matters.

2511.14023.tldr: Syn-STARTS, a framework that uses LLMs to generate triage cases, and shows that the triage cases generated by Syn-STARTS were qualitatively indistinguishable from the TRIAGE open dataset generated by manual curation from training materials, strongly indicates the possibility of synthetic data in developing high-performance AI models for severe and critical medical situations.

2511.14045.tldr: Divergence-in-Behavior Attack (DIBA), the first membership inference framework specifically designed for RLVR, is proposed, revealing that even in the absence of explicit supervision, training data exposure can be reliably inferred through behavioral traces.

2511.14052.tldr: This study presents evidence supporting an instructor-governed feedback loop that converts concept-level assessment evidence into vetted micro-interventions, and formalizes intervention assignment as a binary integer program with constraints for coverage, time, difficulty windows informed by ability estimates, prerequisites encoded by a concept matrix, and anti-redundancy enforced through diversity.

2511.14056.tldr: Radial Compensation (RC) is introduced, an information-geometric method that selects the base density in the tangent space so that the likelihood depends only on geodesic distance from a pole, decoupling parameter semantics from curvature.

2511.14057.tldr: A machine learning-based multimodal framework that integrates wearable sensor data for simultaneous action recognition and stress estimation that demonstrates that integrating motion and physiological sensing can provide meaningful insights into athletes'technical and mental states.

2511.14064.tldr: CafeMed is a framework that integrates dynamic causal reasoning with cross-modal attention for safe and accurate medication recommendation, and results indicate that incorporating dynamic causal relationships and cross-modal synergies leads to more clinicallyaligned and personalized medication recommendations.

2511.14075.tldr: The proposed CFG-EC actively realigns the unconditional noise error component to be orthogonal to the conditional error component, thereby constraining the sampling error's upper bound and establishing more reliable guidance trajectories for high-fidelity image generation.

2511.14082.tldr: The Semantic-Guided Parameter Synthesizer (SGPS), a novel paradigm that takes as input minimal, multi-modal task information as little as a single example image and a corresponding clinical text description to directly synthesize the entire set of parameters for a task-specific classifier.

2511.14086.tldr: DEER-3D underscores the effectiveness of targeted, error-driven scene editing in bridging linguistic reasoning capabilities with spatial grounding in 3D LLMs by evaluating the effectiveness of the editing pipeline across multiple benchmarks for 3D grounding and scene understanding tasks.

2511.14087.tldr: GCA-ResUNet is proposed, an efficient segmentation network that integrates Grouped Coordinate Attention (GCA) into ResNet-50 residual blocks, enabling high-accuracy and resource-efficient medical image segmentation.

2511.14096.tldr: NeuroPath, an LLM-driven semantic path tracking RAG framework inspired by the path navigational planning of place cells in neurobiology, is proposed, which achieves higher accuracy and reduces token consumption compared to existing iter-based RAG methods.

2511.14098.tldr: This paper model and analyze how a network of interacting LLMs performs collaborative question-answering (CQA) in order to estimate a ground truth given a distributed set of documents and proposes a randomized utility model for this problem.

2511.14101.tldr: This work proposes APD-agents, a large language model (LLM) driven multi-agent framework for automated page design in mobile applications that fully leverages the automatic collaboration capabilities of large-model-driven multi-agent systems.

2511.14112.tldr: The proposed data-centric framework generates high-quality synthetic discharge summaries that modestly improves macro-F1 while maintaining strong micro-F1, outperforming prior SOTA and demonstrating that carefully crafted synthetic data can enhance equity in long-tail ICD code prediction.

2511.14117.tldr: This work demonstrates empirically that soft-label training, which treats annotation distributions as ground truth, preserves epistemic uncertainty and repositions annotation distributions from noisy signals to be aggregated away, to faithful representations of epistemic uncertainty that models should learn to reproduce.

2511.14119.tldr: The potential of mobile live video analytics to transform EMS operations is demonstrated, bridging the gap between bystanders, dispatchers, and EMTs, and paving the way for next-generation intelligent EMS infrastructure.

2511.14120.tldr: Evaluation on the Woven Traffic Safety dataset shows that MP-PVIR effectively translates multi-view video data into actionable insights, advancing AI-driven traffic safety analytics for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative systems.

2511.14130.tldr: PRISM is presented, a training-free framework that integrates refined system prompting, in-context learning (ICL), and lightweight multi-agent coordination for document and chunk ranking tasks and provides comprehensive feasibility analyses covering latency, token usage, and cost trade-offs to support deployment decisions.

2511.14131.tldr: Experimental results illustrate that R3 significantly outperforms other state-of-the-art methods, exceeding 3.28% and 3.30% in SPL and RGSPL respectively on the REVERIE benchmark, highlighting the effectiveness of the method in handling challenging VLN tasks.

2511.14135.tldr: The Adaptive Fairness Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (AdaFair-MARL) framework is proposed, which formulates workload fairness as an explicit constraint so that agents maintain balanced contributions while optimizing team performance, and achieves nearly perfect constraint satisfaction.

2511.14136.tldr: Evaluation of six leading agents on 300 enterprise tasks demonstrates that optimizing for accuracy alone yields agents 4.4-10.8x more expensive than cost-aware alternatives with comparable performance.

2511.14143.tldr: This work introduces SMART, an MLLM-based framework that integrates audio cues and leverages shot-level temporal structure that enriches multimodal representations by combining audio and visual features while applyingShot-aware Token Compression, which selectively retains high-information tokens within each shot to reduce redundancy and preserve fine-grained temporal details.

2511.14148.tldr: This work proposes asynchronous flow matching VLA (AsyncVLA), a novel framework that introduces temporal flexibility in asynchronous FM (AFM) and enables self-correction in action generation and achieves state-of-the-art results across general embodied evaluations due to its asynchronous generation in AFM.

2511.14166.tldr: A selective W2SG framework to avoid using weak supervision when unnecessary is proposed and a binary classifier P(IK) is trained to identify questions that a strong model can answer and use its self-generated labels for alignment, which indicates selective W2SG can help superalignment.

2511.14168.tldr: This work proposes Certified Signed Graph Unlearning (CSGU), which provides provable privacy guarantees while preserving the sociological principles underlying SGNNs, and outperforms existing methods, achieving superior performance in both utility preservation and unlearning effectiveness on SGNNs.

2511.14172.tldr: This work proposes the first symbolic localization framework that leverages symbolic linguistic and semantic knowledge to meaningfully trace the development of hallucinations across all model layers, and demonstrates that symbolic semantic knowledge provides the key to understanding and localizing hallucination mechanisms in LLMs.

2511.14178.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that VLA-Pilot substantially boosts the success rates of off-the-shelf pre-trained VLA policies, enabling robust zero-shot generalization to diverse downstream tasks and embodiments.

2511.14186.tldr: This work proposes a Unified Multi-Entity Graph Network (UMEG-Net), which achieves robust performance with limited labeled data and significantly outperforms baseline models in few-shot settings, providing a scalable and effective solution for few-shot PES.

2511.14199.tldr: HFL-FlowLLM is the first framework to apply large language models to network traffic flow classification in heterogeneous federated learning in heterogeneous federated learning, demonstrating compelling performance and strong robustness.

2511.14203.tldr: The Multi-scale Correlation-aware Transformer Network (MCFormer) is proposed, which explicitly models multi-scale correlations across the entire input set to suppress the adverse effects of outlier samples with intra-identity variations or local missing, incorporating two novel modules.

2511.14218.tldr: Experimental results show that the proposed unified hybrid Bayesian Deep Learning framework for ensemble weather forecasting improves forecast accuracy and yields better-calibrated uncertainty quantification but also achieves superior computational efficiency compared to state-of-the-art probabilistic diffusion models.

2511.14219.tldr: This work presents a two-stage architecture that first enhances encoder robustness through Adaptive Layer Attention (ALA) and further suppresses hallucinations using a multi-objective knowledge distillation (KD) framework to improve Whisper's reliability under real-world noisy conditions.

2511.14221.tldr: This work proposes LGSID, an LLM-Aligned Geographic Item Tokenization Framework for Local-life Recommendation, and proposes a hierarchical geographic item tokenization strategy, where primary tokens are derived from discrete spatial and content attributes, and residual tokens are refined using the aligned LLM's geographic representation vectors.

2511.14227.tldr: This work proposes DevPiolt, a LLM-based recommendation model for IoT device operations that first equip the LLM with fundamental domain knowledge of IoT operations via continual pre-training and multi-task fine-tuning, and employs direct preference optimization to align the fine-tuned LLM with specific user preferences.

2511.14230.tldr: This work presents one of the first multi-system approaches for correcting grammatical errors in Arabic, the Arab Enhanced Edit Selection System Complication (ArbESC+), the first Arab attempt to integrate linguistic error correction.

2511.14282.tldr: This study reveals an intriguing finding that parameters with higher variance exhibit greater pruning robustness, and proposes a Variance Amplifying Regularizer (VAR) that deliberately increases the variance of model parameters during training.

2511.14291.tldr: Gen3d is proposed, a novel method for generation of high-quality, wide-scope, and generic 3D scenes from a single image, maintaining and expanding its world model and Synthesizing high-fidelity and consistent novel views.

2511.14322.tldr: A lightweight single-stage network for sitting posture recognition on embedded edge devices termed LSP-YOLO was proposed, characterized by high efficiency, lightweight design and deployability, making it suitable for smart classrooms, rehabilitation, and human-computer interaction applications.

2511.14341.tldr: This review synthesizes findings from robotic systems, animal studies, and human research to explore how different systems encode and recall place and proposes a unifying set of concepts by which to consider and develop place recognition mechanisms.

2511.14365.tldr: This paper introduces a principled methodology to resolve a tokenization bottleneck by unifying the representation of natural language and molecular structures within a single model and provides an empirical demonstration of the effectiveness of this strategy.

2511.14422.tldr: Sigil is a mandatory watermarking framework designed specifically for capability-limited servers that defines the watermark as a statistical constraint on the server-visible activation space and embeds the watermark into the client model via gradient injection, without requiring any knowledge of the data.

2511.14428.tldr: This work proposes an approach that enables context-aware, ante-hoc explanations of (un)expectable driving manoeuvres at runtime and aims to support the bridging of correct and good explanations.

2511.14435.tldr: This vision paper argues for a symbiotic integration of RV and LLMs, arguing that RV can serve as a guardrail for LLM-driven autonomy, while LLMs can extend RV by assisting specification capture, supporting anticipatory reasoning, and helping to handle uncertainty.

2511.14445.tldr: Tell Me is a mental well-being system that leverages advances in large language models to provide accessible, context-aware support for users and researchers and highlights opportunities for interdisciplinary collaboration between NLP researchers and mental health professionals to advance responsible innovation in human-AI interaction for well-being.

2511.14446.tldr: Agentic Video Intelligence (AVI) is proposed, a flexible and training-free framework that can mirror human video comprehension through system-level design and optimization and achieves competitive performance while offering superior interpretability.

2511.14452.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid approach that uses hemodynamic simulations and unlabeled clinical data to estimate cardiovascular biomarkers directly from PPG signals and demonstrates that the proposed approach can detect fluctuations of cardiac output and stroke volume and outperform a supervised baseline in monitoring temporal changes in these biomarkers.

2511.14456.tldr: This study conducts an extensive study for analyzing the impact of participant failures on the model quality in the context of inter-organizational cross-silo FL with few participants and shows that under high skews the evaluation is optimistic and hides the real impact.

2511.14461.tldr: This work proposes several approaches to effectively increase item diversity within the domain of book recommendations, on top of a collaborative filtering algorithm, intended to improve book recommendations in the web catalogs of public libraries.

2511.14488.tldr: The proposed PAFM framework incorporates perturbation-guided training to simulate localized disturbances and leverages a dual-path velocity field to capture trajectory deviations under perturbation, enabling refined modeling of perturbed behavior to enhance the structural coherence.

2511.14533.tldr: A neuro-symbolic framework that explicitly models and propagates uncertainty from perception to planning, providing a principled connection between these two abstraction levels is presented, providing theoretical guarantees that are validated empirically.

2511.14543.tldr: A hybrid deterministic diffusion framework that separates heterogeneous features into two complementary generative channels, enabling coherent reconstruction of mixed-type incomplete data and demonstrating the importance of structure-aware diffusion processes for advancing deep learning approaches to incomplete tabular data.

2511.14559.tldr: A diffusion-based generative framework for 3D molecule design that explicitly accounts for conformational flexibility in protein binding pockets is proposed, and empirical studies demonstrate that Apo2Mol can achieve state-of-the-art performance in generating high-affinity ligands and accurately capture realistic protein pocket conformational changes.

2511.14565.tldr: This work proposes Masked Inverse Reinforcement Learning (Masked IRL), a framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to combine the strengths of both input types, and outperforms prior language-conditioned IRL methods by up to 15% while using up to 4.7 times less data.

2511.14588.tldr: A deep learning framework for robust WMH segmentation and localization is proposed, evaluated across public datasets and an independent Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, and several spatially distinct regions are reproducibly associated with diagnostic status, indicating localized vulnerability in AD.

2511.14595.tldr: A principled foundation for information-theoretic KG optimization in personalized and AI-assisted education is established and it is shown that MCQs generated from refined KGs consistently surpass those from raw notes on fifteen quality criteria.

2511.14599.tldr: A novel Cross-Modal Compositional Self-Distillation framework that can flexibly handle arbitrary combinations of input modalities and achieves state-of-the-art performance across various missing-modality scenarios, with strong generalization and stability.

2511.14601.tldr: Findings indicate that clinical features excel in identifying high-risk extremes, whereas transformer-based MRI embeddings are more sensitive to subtle markers of stability, motivating multimodal fusion strategies for AD progression modeling.

2511.14603.tldr: This study demonstrates a data-driven approach for identifying high-risk AKI patients, supporting the development of decision-support tools for early CKD detection and intervention.

2511.14619.tldr: The Fuzzy MAP EM algorithm is introduced, a novel approach that incorporates expert knowledge into the parameter estimation process by enriching the Expectation Maximization framework with fuzzy pseudo-counts derived from an expert-defined fuzzy model, effectively guiding learning in environments with limited data.

2511.14630.tldr: Step function-like behavior of near-exclusively generating the output with marginally highest probability even overrules even strong in-built LLM biases is found, and all modern LLMs tested grossly fail to follow the distributions.

2511.14631.tldr: It is shown that multi-agent systems guided by vision-language models (VLMs) improve end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery by treating plots as verifiable checkpoints, enabling agents to correct their own errors and steer exploratory data analysis in real-time.

2511.14632.tldr: The Adaptive Forecasting Transformer (Adapformer), an advanced Transformer-based framework that merges the benefits of CI and CD methodologies through effective channel management, is introduced, making it state-of-the-art in MTSF.

2511.14650.tldr: This work proposes AutoTool, a novel graph-based framework that bypasses repeated LLM inference by exploiting a key empirical observation: tool usage inertia - the tendency of tool invocations to follow predictable sequential patterns, offering a practical and scalable enhancement for inference-heavy frameworks.

2511.14659.tldr: This work introduces NORA-1.5, a VLA model built from the pre-trained NORA backbone by adding to it a flow-matching-based action expert, and highlights NORA-1.5 and reward-guided post-training as a viable path toward more dependable embodied agents suitable for real-world deployment.

2511.14670.tldr: SkillGen is introduced, a skill-based ICL framework for structured sequential reasoning that constructs an action-centric, domain-level graph from sampled trajectories, identifies high-utility actions via temporal-difference credit assignment, and retrieves step-wise skills to generate fine-grained, context-aware prompts.

2511.14688.tldr: This paper outlines the work in using large language models (LLMs) to create ground-truth annotations for historical French and Chinese texts and demonstrates that even relatively limited amounts of synthetic data can improve NLP tools for under-resourced corpora in computational humanities research.

2511.14689.tldr: It is concluded that input image resolution has a clear and consistent impact on the accuracy of age estimation in both DeepFace and InsightFace.

2511.14691.tldr: The Spiking STDP Transformer (S$^{2}$TDPT), a neuromorphic Transformer that implements self-attention through spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), embedding query--key correlations in synaptic weights, illustrates how biologically inspired attention can yield energy-efficient, hardware-friendly, and explainable neuromorphic models.

2511.14694.tldr: FOCUS (Feature-Oriented Compression for Ultra-long Self-attention), a progressive context-compression module that can be plugged into pretrained DNA LLMs, and converts effective inference scaling from O(N^2) to near-linear O(N), enabling about 100x longer inference windows on commodity GPUs with near-lossless fidelity.

2511.14719.tldr: The realism enhancement approach is a zero-shot framework that focuses on preserving the multi-level structures from synthetic videos into the enhanced one in both spatial and temporal domains, built upon a diffusion video foundational model without further fine-tuning.

2511.14761.tldr: This work forms the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus within a vision paradigm, framing it as an image-to-image translation problem, and achieves 60.4% accuracy on the ARC-1 benchmark, substantially outperforming existing methods that are also trained from scratch.

2405.15871.tldr: A novel model-agnostic attribution method to assess the causal effect of concepts i.e., predefined segments within a time series, on classification outcomes and compares these causal attributions with closely related associational attributions, both theoretically and empirically.

2406.10519.tldr: This paper proposes a new topological loss to preserve geometric shape information by computing topological signatures of both the input and reconstructed volumes, learning geometric shape information and introduces a pre-text task that predicts the positions of the centers and eight corners of 3D crops, enabling the MAE to aggregate spatial information.

2406.14265.tldr: The VeriFlow architecture is proposed as a flow-based density model tailored to allow any verification approach to restrict its search to some data distribution of interest, and it is argued that this architecture is particularly well suited for this purpose because of two major properties.

2409.05994.tldr: MessIRve is introduced, a large-scale Spanish IR dataset with almost 700,000 queries from Google's autocomplete API and relevant documents sourced from Wikipedia, which allows it to cover a wide variety of topics, unlike smaller datasets.

2409.13566.tldr: The application of TensorFlow pre-trained models in deep learning is explored, with an emphasis on practical guidance for tasks such as image classification and object detection, and the effectiveness of transfer learning is demonstrated through real-world examples and experiments.

2410.04759.tldr: This work presents an interpretable, regulation-aware decision-making framework, DriveReg, which enables autonomous vehicles to understand and adhere to region-specific traffic laws and safety guidelines and validated on the DriveReg Scenarios Dataset and real-world deployment, demonstrating strong performance and robustness across diverse environments.

2411.05034.tldr: Eguard is introduced, a novel defense mechanism designed to mitigate embedding inversion attacks, which employs a transformer-based projection network and text mutual information optimization to safeguard embeddings while preserving the utility of LLMs.

2501.03145.tldr: An efficient automated method for document image dewarping that balances accuracy with computational efficiency superior to existing deep learning approaches is developed, making it suitable for resource-constrained applications while maintaining high-quality document digitization.

2501.15791.tldr: A novel Multi-Agent framework for Knowledge Graph Error Detection (MAKGED) that utilizes multiple large language models (LLMs) in a collaborative setting and can facilitate the training of specialized agents using domain-specific knowledge graphs for error detection, which highlights the potential industrial application value of the framework.

2502.01550.tldr: This work introduces FireCastNet, a novel deep learning architecture that combines 3D convolutional encoding with GraphCast-based Graph Neural Networks to model complex spatio-temporal dependencies for global wildfire prediction, and demonstrates that FireCastNet achieves superior performance in global burned area forecasting.

2502.05934.tldr: Analysis of communication complexity and bounded-agent and sampling analysis shows that with large task spaces and finite samples, *reward hacking is globally inevitable*: rare high-loss states are systematically under-covered, implying scalable oversight must target safety-critical slices rather than uniform coverage.

2502.15488.tldr: FQ-PETR is proposed, a fully quantized framework for PETRs, featuring three key innovations, including Quantization-Friendly LiDAR-ray Position Embedding, which approximates complex non-linear functions using two cascaded linear LUTs, achieving high fidelity with minimal entries and no specialized hardware.

2502.18137.tldr: This paper proposes SpargeAttn, a universal sparse and quantized attention for any model, which significantly accelerates diverse models, including language, image, and video generation, without sacrificing end-to-end metrics.

2503.01734.tldr: This work develops a powerful new attack vector that uses RL to train agents that attack ML models efficiently and at scale and enables an adversary to generate adversarial samples with 17% more success on unseen inputs post-training.

2503.02249.tldr: RoboCrafter-QA is introduced, a novel benchmark to evaluate whether LLMs can learn representations of soft robot designs that effectively bridge the gap between high-level task descriptions and low-level morphological and material choices, and finetune an efficient, open-source LLM that achieves SOTA performance on this benchmark.

2503.02687.tldr: This paper proposes Class-Aware PillarMix (CAPMix), a novel MSDA approach that applies MixUp at the pillar level in 3D point clouds, guided by class labels, and demonstrates that this straightforward yet effective approach outperforms existing MSDA approaches across two datasets.

2503.07265.tldr: WISE is proposed, the first benchmark specifically designed for complex semantic understanding and world knowledge integration in text-to-image generation, and WiScore, a novel quantitative metric for assessing knowledge-image alignment.

2503.09215.tldr: A driving World Model named EOT-WM is proposed, unifying Ego-Other vehicle Trajectories in videos for driving simulation, and a metric based on control latent similarity to evaluate the controllability of trajectories is proposed.

2503.17979.tldr: This work demonstrates that adaptive reasoning---employing modes like Zero-Thinking, Less-Thinking, and Summary-Thinking---can effectively alleviate drawbacks of deliberative reasoning in Large Reasoning Models.

2504.10833.tldr: Surrogate Faithfulness (SURF) is proposed, which replaces prior complex surrogates with a simple, linear surrogate that measures faithfulness without changing the explanation's interpretability and introduces well-motivated metrics that assess loss across all output classes, not just the predicted class.

2504.18070.tldr: PropRAG is introduced, a novel RAG framework that shifts from triples to context-rich propositions and introduces an efficient, LLM-free online beam search over proposition paths to discover multi-step reasoning chains, advancing non-parametric knowledge integration by improving evidence retrieval through richer representation and efficient reasoning path discovery.

2505.00275.tldr: Experimental results indicate that the proposed AdCare-VLM surpasses parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enabled VLM models, such as LLaVA-V1.5 and Chat-UniVi, with absolute improvements ranging from 3.1% to 3.54% across pre-trained, regular, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) configurations.

2505.03025.tldr: An overview of how synthetic datasets are created, evaluated and being used for dialogue related tasks in the medical domain is provided and a novel typology for use in classifying types and degrees of data synthesis is proposed, to facilitate comparison and evaluation.

2505.05226.tldr: This work proposes MaxUCB, a max k-armed bandit method to trade off exploring different model classes and conducting hyperparameter optimization, which provides an efficient alternative compared to classic max k-armed bandit methods assuming heavy-tailed reward distributions.

2505.20979.tldr: A segment-wise melodic-similarity detection model that uses a MERT encoder and applies a triplet neural network to capture melodic similarity is developed that is able to outperform baseline models in detecting similar melodic fragments on the MelodySim test set.

2505.23596.tldr: Agent-SAMA is introduced, a state-aware multi-agent framework that models app execution as a Finite State Machine (FSM), treating UI screens as states and user actions as transitions, and demonstrates that structured state modeling enhances robustness and can serve as a lightweight, model-agnostic memory layer for future GUI agents.

2506.13037.tldr: Multi-Agent Argumentation and Grammar Integrated Critiquer (MAGIC), a framework using five specialized agents to evaluate prompt adherence, persuasiveness, organization, vocabulary, and grammar for both holistic scoring and detailed feedback generation, is presented.

2506.20582.tldr: This work introduces the concept of grouping observations to learn identifiable representations for disease classification in chest X-rays via an end-to-end framework and demonstrates that these causal representations improve generalisability and robustness across multiple classification tasks when grouping is used to enforce invariance w.r.t race, sex, and imaging views.

2507.20964.tldr: It is proved that deciding whether an arbitrary post-hack agent will ever violate corrigibility is undecidable by reduction to the halting problem, and a finite-horizon "decidable island" is carved out where safety can be certified in randomized polynomial time and verified with privacy-preserving, constant-round zero-knowledge proofs.

2508.07790.tldr: It is proved that ORBE policies always exist, their structure is characterized, and an algorithm to compute them with a manageable overhead compared to standard robust value iteration is presented.

2508.08343.tldr: This work proposes a data-driven ML approach leveraging interpretable models to tackle this caching problem and introduces the first Digital Twin capable of reproducing an LLM-adapter serving system, enabling efficient training data generation.

2508.16983.tldr: This paper presents a scalable method that enables LLMs to access external knowledge without depending on retrievers or auxiliary models and shows that it scales to large knowledge bases, adapts to domain-specific data, and achieves effective results.

2508.18983.tldr: This work leverages expert importance to guide decisions, substituting low-importance activated experts with functionally similar ones already cached in GPU memory, thereby preserving accuracy and reducing memory usage and data transfer while largely eliminating PCIe overhead.

2509.00055.tldr: U2UData+, the first large-scale swarm UAV autonomous flight dataset for ELH tasks and the first scalable swarm UAV data online collection and algorithm closed-loop verification platform, is presented.

2509.03733.tldr: Benefits are strongest for geometry and vision transformers, with more modest but measurable gains on LLMs, demonstrating that complexity regularization offers a principled pathway to joint efficiency-robustness optimization.

2509.07928.tldr: This work provides a practical and reproducible blueprint for deploying high-performance, real-time AI on consumer-grade devices by shifting the focus from pure model optimization to hardware-aware inference strategies that maximize throughput.

2509.18015.tldr: This work systematically assess two general-purpose MLLMs (GPT-4 and GPT-5) and a domain-specific model (MedGemma) in their ability to localize pathologies on chest radiographs, using a prompting pipeline that overlays a spatial grid and elicits coordinate-based predictions.

2509.20609.tldr: Using the recently introduced information-theoretic formulation of denoising diffusion models, it is shown the diffusion models can be used in a straightforward way to estimate Mutual information (MI), which corresponds to half the gap in the Minimum Mean Square Error between conditional and unconditional diffusion.

2509.23725.tldr: This work proposes MedLA, a logic-driven multi-agent framework built on large language models that consistently outperforms both static role-based systems and single-agent baselines on challenging benchmarks such as MedDDx and standard medical QA tasks.

2509.24006.tldr: SLA (Sparse-Linear Attention), a trainable attention method that fuses sparse and linear attention to accelerate diffusion models, and an efficient GPU kernel is implemented, which yields a 13.7x speedup in attention computation and a 2.2x end-to-end speedup in video generation on Wan2.3B.

2509.24473.tldr: This is the first systematic study showing that geometry-centric fine-tuning can confer vision-language models with broadly transferable spatial skills, and the first systematic study showing that geometry-centric fine-tuning can confer vision-language models with broadly transferable spatial skills.

2510.07492.tldr: To resolve the anatomical misalignment between normal-dose and uLDCT images caused by respiratory motion during acquisition, a novel purification strategy to construct corresponding aligned image pairs is proposed and a Frequency-domain Flow Matching model (FFM) is introduced that achieves excellent image reconstruction performance.

2510.08350.tldr: DeepEN, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based framework that personalizes enteral nutrition dosing for critically ill patients using electronic health record data, demonstrates the feasibility of conservative offline RL for individualized EN therapy and suggests that data-driven personalization may improve outcomes beyond guideline- or heuristic-based approaches.

2510.14830.tldr: RL-100, a real-world reinforcement learning framework built on diffusion visuomotor policies, unifies imitation and reinforcement learning under a single clipped PPO surrogate objective applied within the denoising process, yielding conservative and stable improvements across offline and online stages.

2510.17793.tldr: This work trains Foundational Automatic Reasoning Evaluators (FARE), a family of 8B and 20B parameter evaluators, with a simple iterative rejection-sampling supervised finetuning (SFT) approach, and sets the new standard for open-source evaluators, surpassing specialized 70B+ evaluators.

2510.19579.tldr: This work proposes a novel multi-modal co-learning framework capable of generalizing across various tasks without targeting a specific modality for inference, and demonstrates consistent predictive improvements over state-of-the-art approaches from the recent machine learning and computer vision literature, as well as EO-specific methods.

2510.20098.tldr: ARTER (Adaptive Routing and Targeted Entity Reasoning) presents a structured pipeline that achieves high performance without deep fine-tuning by strategically combining candidate generation, context-based scoring, adaptive routing, and selective reasoning.

2511.00917.tldr: Maestro largely surpasses today's VLA models for zero-shot performance on challenging manipulation skills and is easily extensible to incorporate new modules, easily editable to suit new embodiments such as a quadruped-mounted arm, and even easily adapts from minimal real-world experiences through local code edits.

2511.01767.tldr: Wonder3D++ is introduced, a novel method for efficiently generating high-fidelity textured meshes from single-view images using a cross-domain diffusion model that generates multi-view normal maps and the corresponding color images and employs a multi-view cross-domain attention mechanism that facilitates information exchange across views and modalities.

2511.02505.tldr: This method not only automates the arrangement and combination of independent shots according to specific logic, narrative requirements, or artistic styles but also learns the assembly style of reference videos, creating a coherent visual sequence or holistic visual expression.

2511.03601.tldr: Step-Audio-EditX is presented, the first open-source LLM-based audio model excelling at expressive and iterative audio editing encompassing emotion, speaking style, and paralinguistics alongside robust zero-shot text-to-speech (TTS) capabilities.

2511.05171.tldr: A simple model merging strategy is applied that interpolates NatureLM with its base language model, recovering instruction-following capabilities with minimal loss of domain expertise and setting a new state-of-the-art in closed-set zero-shot classification of unseen species.

2511.06157.tldr: This paper investigates the effectiveness of ZCPs for HAR on six benchmark datasets, and demonstrates that they discover network architectures that obtain within 5% of performance attained by full-scale training involving 1500 randomly sampled architectures.

2511.06727.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that performs fine-grained analysis at subject level equipped with a designated multi-agent collaboration strategy for addressing heterogeneous problem reasoning and significantly outperforms existing task-level model selection and multi-agent collaboration baselines in accuracy and efficiency.

2511.06761.tldr: The Spatiotemporal Relational Neural Network is introduced, a model that establishes a unified neural representation for object attributes, relations, and timeline, with computations governed by a Hebbian ``Fire Together, Wire Together''mechanism across dedicated \textit{What} and \textit{How} pathways.

2511.07663.tldr: The AISQL query execution engine addresses challenges through three novel techniques informed by production deployment data from Snowflake customers, including AI-aware query optimization, adaptive model cascades, and semantic join query rewriting.

2511.07968.tldr: TimeFlow is a novel SDE-based flow matching framework that integrates a encoder-only architecture and designs a component-wise decomposed velocity field to capture the multi-faceted structure of time series and augment the vanilla flow-matching optimization with an additional stochastic term to enhance representational expressiveness.

2511.08008.tldr: Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate the superiority of the method over state-of-the-art baselines, and it is still effective when applied to small-scale datasets, showcasing its robustness, flexibility, and generalization ability.

2511.10756.tldr: The Size-Invariant Grid Search (SIGS) is proposed, an efficient training optimization for Quantum Reinforcement Learning (QRL), and used to simulate the outputs of a trained Depth-1 EQC up to 350-node TSP instances - well beyond previously tractable limits.

2511.10894.tldr: A competitive and computationally efficient approach to probabilistic rainfall nowcasting using 3D-UNET baselines trained with an aggregate Rank Probability Score and a per-pixel Gamma-Hurdle objective.

2511.10900.tldr: This work introduces Expert-CoT, a prompting strategy that conditions chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning on specific clinical subject area and certification level, and ExpertRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that grounds responses in subject area-aligned documents and real-world patient data.

2511.11587.tldr: MedBuild AI is introduced, a hybrid-intelligence framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with deterministic expert systems to rebalance the early design and conceptual planning stages of medical building designs, fostering a reciprocal, inclusive, and equitable approach to healthcare planning.

2511.11743.tldr: A curiosity-driven quantized Mixture-of-Experts framework that addresses both through Bayesian epistemic uncertainty-based routing across heterogeneous experts (BitNet ternary, 1-16 bit BitLinear, post-training quantization) and stable inference for battery-constrained devices is presented.

2511.12060.tldr: This work introduces a deep reinforcement learning algorithm: Multi-path Differentiated Clipping Proximal Policy Optimization (MPD-PPO), which employs a multi-branch policy architecture with differentiated gradient clipping constraints to ensure stable and efficient high-dimensional policy updates.

2511.12074.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that in the highly challenging multi-factor compositional speech generation task, MF-Speech significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, achieving a lower word error rate, superior style control, and the highest subjective evaluation scores.

2511.12344.tldr: RGR-GRPO enables LLMs to receive dense and informative rewards while exploring a larger solution space during GRPO training and achieves superior pass@k performance, reflecting sustained exploration and effective breakthrough beyond existing performance bottlenecks.

2511.12882.tldr: MTV-World is proposed, an embodied world model that introduces Multi-view Trajectory-Video control for precise visuomotor prediction and achieves precise control execution and accurate physical interaction modeling in complex dual-arm scenarios.

2511.13111.tldr: NuBench is presented, an open benchmark for deep learning-based event reconstruction in neutrino telescopes, which evaluates four reconstruction algorithms - ParticleNeT and DynEdge, both actively used within the KM3NeT and IceCube collaborations, respectively, along with GRIT and DeepIce - on up to five core tasks: energy and direction reconstruction, topology classification, interaction vertex prediction, and inelasticity estimation.

2511.13326.tldr: TacEleven, a generative framework for football open-play tactic discovery developed in close collaboration with domain experts from AJ Auxerre, is proposed to assist coaches and analysts in tactical decision-making and demonstrates the potential of creatively leveraging domain data and generative models to advance tactical analysis in sports.

2511.13542.tldr: Evidence supporting an instructor-governed feedback loop that converts concept-level assessment evidence into vetted microinterventions is presented, and a tractable and auditable controller that closes the diagnostic pedagogical loop and enables equitable, load-aware personalization at the classroom scale is presented.

2511.13869.tldr: A curated multi-sequence, multimodal MRI dataset specifically designed for bladder cancer recurrence prediction is introduced and a new Hierarchical Gated Attention Multi-Branch model is proposed that enables selective weighting of features from the global (ViT) and local (CNN) paths based on contextual demands, achieving a balanced and targeted feature fusion.

2511.14010.tldr: The Mixture-of-Retrieval Agentic RAG (MoRA-RAG), a knowledge-grounded LLM framework that transforms reconnaissance reports into a structured foundation for multi-hazard reasoning, is introduced, establishing a new paradigm for transforming post-disaster documentation into actionable, trustworthy intelligence for hazard resilience.

2511.14214.tldr: The main contribution is showing that allocating explicit reasoning budget helps with chronological ordering with GPT-5 at medium/high reasoning effort achieving flawless ordering at all lengths and perfect conditional sorting, whereas low/minimal effort degrades with longer lists, mirroring earlier models.

2511.14334.tldr: Qualitative analysis shows that while large language models can produce syntactically valid and semantically plausible models, their performance drops sharply under contextual and linguistic variation, revealing shallow understanding and sensitivity to wording.

2511.14592.tldr: DSBench is introduced, the first comprehensive Driving Safety Benchmark designed to assess a VLM's awareness of various safety risks in a unified manner, and shows that fine-tuning on this dataset significantly enhances the safety performance of existing VLMs and paves the way for advancing autonomous driving technology.

2511.14715.tldr: This work proposes FLARE, an adaptive reputation-based framework that transforms client reliability assessment from binary decisions to a continuous, multi-dimensional trust evaluation, and introduces a highly evasive Statistical Mimicry attack, a benchmark adversary that blends honest gradients with synthetic perturbations and persistent drift to remain undetected by traditional filters.

2511.14768.tldr: An Emotion-aware Social Media Recommendation (ESMR) framework that personalizes content based on users' evolving emotional trajectories is proposed, and ESMR offers a path toward emotionally aware recommendations without compromising engagement performance.

2511.14769.tldr: Cluster-based Adaptive Retrieval (CAR) is introduced, an algorithm that dynamically determines the optimal number of documents by analyzing the clustering patterns of ordered query-document similarity distances, establishing an adaptive cut-off that scales with query complexity.

2511.14770.tldr: ExplainRec is presented, a framework that extends LLM-based recommendation capabilities through preference attribution, multi-modal fusion, and zero-shot transfer learning, and incorporates four technical contributions: preference attribution tuning for explainable recommendations, zero-shot preference transfer for cold-start users and items, multi-modal enhancement leveraging visual and textual content, and multi-task collaborative optimization.

2511.14772.tldr: This paper surveys techniques for improving the predictive accuracy of pretrained large language models by allocating additional compute at inference time and synthesizes existing analyses of these techniques, highlighting their respective strengths and weaknesses, and concludes by outlining promising directions for future research.

2511.14777.tldr: FSM-based evaluation offers a transparent, complexity-controlled probe for diagnosing this failure mode and guiding the design of inductive biases that enable genuine long-horizon procedural competence, grounding reasoning in measurable execution fidelity rather than surface correctness.

2511.14778.tldr: An LLM-based evolutionary algorithm is introduced that features function abstraction, leading to notable improvements in discovering elementary number theory and finite fields over hard-coded baselines.

2511.14780.tldr: Ask WhAI is presented, a systems-level framework for inspecting and perturbing belief states in multi-agent interactions and offers a reproducible way to study belief formation and epistemic silos in multi-agent scientific reasoning.

2511.14781.tldr: A methodology to systematically evaluate the contribution of individual OpenFold components to structure prediction accuracy is presented, identifying several components that are critical for most proteins, while others vary in importance across proteins.

2511.14788.tldr: A fully automated LLM-assisted workflow that processes and cleans textual location information using GPT-4o, and assigns geometries by cross-checking three independent geoinformation repositories: GADM, OpenStreetMap and Wikidata, demonstrating the potential of LLMs to extract and structure geographic information from unstructured text.

2511.14791.tldr: An open-source framework combining a service report validated public dataset, an evaluation method based on accuracy, reliability, and earliness, and baseline results implemented with EnergyFaultDetector, an open-source Python framework developed for automated anomaly detection in operational data from energy systems.

2511.14794.tldr: A first version of irace-evo is introduced, an extension of irace that integrates code evolution through large language models (LLMs) to jointly explore parameter and code spaces and demonstrates that coupling automatic configuration with LLM-driven code evolution provides a powerful, cost-efficient avenue for advancing heuristic design and metaheuristic optimization.

2511.14796.tldr: The aim of the study is to enhance opinion mining by introducing a hybrid deep neural network model that combines a bidirectional gated recurrent unit (BGRU) and long short-term memory (LSTM) layers to improve sentiment analysis, particularly addressing challenges such as contextual nuance, scalability, and class imbalance.

2511.14798.tldr: Comparisons of two AI-based grading techniques suggest that while the Direct approach is faster and straightforward, the Reverse technique often provides a more fine-grained assessment by focusing on correction effort.

2511.14803.tldr: A log analytics tool that leverages Large Language Models for log data processing and issue diagnosis, enabling the generation of automated insights and summaries is proposed and a novel approach for efficiently running LLMs on CPUs to process massive log volumes in minimal time without compromising output quality is presented.

2511.14805.tldr: This paper instantiate the design-time phase of the framework using two formal verification methods: RoboChart for functional correctness and PRISM for probabilistic risk analysis, and proposes a model-driven transformation pipeline that automatically regenerates structured assurance arguments whenever formal specifications or their verification results change, thereby ensuring traceability.

2511.14806.tldr: A hierarchical architecture that jointly optimizes a dynamic genomic tokenizer and latent Transformers with context-aware pre-training tasks, and achieves superior performance on three popular DNA benchmarks and several multi-omics tasks with fine-tuning or zero-shot evaluation.

2511.14807.tldr: By translating streamline propagation into a differentiable PyTorch framework, this work enables deeper integration of tractography into deep learning workflows, laying the foundation for a new category of macrostructural reasoning that is not only computationally robust but also scientifically rigorous.

2511.14808.tldr: The results suggest that Transformer representations are generically and persistently injective in the continuous-parameter idealization, while their practical invertibility can be probed using simple geometric diagnostics.

2511.14824.tldr: SpotlightTTS is proposed, which exclusively emphasizes style via voiced-aware style extraction and style direction adjustment, which achieves superior performance compared to baseline models in terms of expressiveness, overall speech quality, and style transfer capability.

2511.14846.tldr: This work proposes Group Turn Policy Optimization (GTPO), a novel RL algorithm specifically designed for training LLMs on multi-turn TIR tasks that introduces three key innovations: turn-level reward assignment that provides fine-grained feedback for individual turns, return-based advantage estimation where normalized discounted returns are calculated as advantages, and self-supervised reward shaping.

2511.14852.tldr: A GPU-accelerated operator library, named PolyKAN which is the first general open-source implementation of KAN and its variants, and fuses the forward and backward passes of polynomial KAN layers into a concise set of optimized CUDA kernels.

2511.14860.tldr: This study presents the first comprehensive benchmarking of convolutional neural networks, vision transformers and state-space mamba architectures for automated dental caries segmentation on panoramic radiographs through a DC1000 dataset and reveals that the CNN-based DoubleU-Net achieved the highest dice coefficient, mIoU, and precision, outperforming all transformer and Mamba variants.

2511.14870.tldr: A multi-branch latent diffusion with 3D U-Net backbone for jointly generating the SDF and per-face UDFs of a BR-DF model achieves comparable CAD generation performance against SOTA methods while reaching the unprecedented 100% success rate in producing (faceted) B-Rep models.

2511.14900.tldr: SkinR1 is a novel dermatological VLM that combines deep, textbook-based reasoning with the broad generalization capabilities of reinforcement learning (RL) and develops a novel RL paradigm that effectively transfers grounded reasoning patterns to large-scale, sparse data.

2511.14908.tldr: Evaluating open-source models for security incident classification indicates that, although proprietary models still exhibit higher accuracy, locally deployed open-source models provide advantages in privacy, cost-effectiveness, and data sovereignty.

2511.14952.tldr: This approach provides an automated and cost-effective solution for organizing laser-cutting materials, enabling operators to select the appropriate power and speed for the cutting process based on the type of material being cut.

2511.14964.tldr: This paper will assess whether to maximize overall long-term legal coherence by maintaining an object classification for all future AI systems, creating fictional legal persons associated with suitably advanced, individuated AI systems, or recognizing non-fictional legal personhood through legal identity for suitably advanced, individuated AI systems.

2511.14967.tldr: This work introduces MermaidSeqBench, a human-verified and LLM-synthetically-extended benchmark for assessing an LLM's capabilities in generating Mermaid sequence diagrams from textual prompts, and uses an LLM-as-a-judge model to assess Mermaid sequence diagram generation across fine-grained metrics.

2511.14969.tldr: Results show that combining identity-based audio and visual embeddings with emotion-tuned text representations on a quality-controlled subset of data yields consistent competitive performance for multimodal emotion recognition in conversation and provides a basis for further improvement on challenging, low-frequency emotion classes.

2511.14970.tldr: This work introduces Edge-Guided Spatial Attention (EGSA), a fusion mechanism designed to mitigate destructive interactions by incorporating boundary information into the fusion between semantic and geometric features in a robust approach capable of improving transparent object perception.

2511.14981.tldr: This work proposes a feature KD framework for training the student's backbone using feature-based losses exclusively, and introduces a knowledge quality metric for identifying which teacher layers provide the most effective knowledge for distillation.

2511.15002.tldr: A novel resource management approach that enhances the Soft Actor Critic algorithm with Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) in a distributed Multi-Agent RL (MARL) framework, which significantly outperforms conventional DRL approaches.

2511.15005.tldr: This work presents a mathematically grounded framework to understand, measure, and mitigate hallucinations in large Language Models, and draws on probabilistic modeling, information theory, trigonometric signal analysis, and Bayesian uncertainty estimation to support safer and more reliable LLMs.

2511.15032.tldr: A dynamic, time-series environment to simulate a classroom setting, with student-teacher interventions - including tutoring sessions, lectures, and exams is developed and reinforcement learning ITSs that combine learning the individual state of students while pulling from population information through the use of probing interventions are developed.

2511.15038.tldr: This work calls for sustained interdisciplinary research combining advances in machine learning, music-theory to create music AI systems that truly serve human creative and experiential needs.

2511.15046.tldr: This work proposes UniHOI, which jointly models HOI detection and generation via a unified token space, thereby effectively promoting knowledge sharing and enhancing generalization and introduces a symmetric interaction-aware attention module and a unified semi-supervised learning paradigm.

2511.15055.tldr: Macro Action Quantization (MAQ), a human-like RL framework that distills human demonstrations into macro actions via Vector-Quantized VAE, is introduced, which significantly improves human-likeness, increasing trajectory similarity scores, and achieving the highest human-likeness rankings among all RL agents in the human evaluation study.

2511.15061.tldr: OpenBioLLM is developed, a modular multi-agent framework that extends GeneGPT by introducing agent specialization for tool routing, query generation, and response validation and reduces latency by 40–50% across benchmark tasks, significantly improving efficiency without compromising model capability.

2511.15067.tldr: An AI-driven pathological model TDAM-CRC provides a robust tool for improved CRC risk stratification, reveals new molecular targets, and facilitates personalized clinical decision-making.

2511.15069.tldr: The proposed ProRAC (Progression-based Reasoning about Actions and Change), a neuro-symbolic framework that leverages LLMs to tackle RAC problems, achieves strong performance across different benchmarks, domains, LLM backbones, and types of RAC tasks.

2511.15074.tldr: Rogue One is introduced, a novel, LLM-based multi-agent framework for knowledge-informed automatic feature extraction that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on a comprehensive suite of 19 classification and 9 regression datasets and surfaces novel, testable hypotheses.

2511.15090.tldr: SciEGQA is a scientific document question answering and reasoning dataset with semantic evidence grounding, where supporting evidence is represented as semantically coherent document regions annotated with bounding boxes, which significantly improves the scientific reasoning capabilities of VLMs.

2511.15107.tldr: AdvPrompt-MIA is proposed, a method specifically designed for code completion models, combining code-specific adversarial perturbations with deep learning, which exhibits strong transferability across different models and datasets, underscoring its practical utility and generalizability.

2511.15110.tldr: The device of social robot was designed for visually impaired users, and along with a mobile application for provide functions to assist their lives, and multiple tools were adopted for developing the mobile application.

2511.15112.tldr: The contribution of the work performed accurately in industry trend prediction of the semiconductor industry by considering both the internal and external event intervention, and the prediction results provide valuable information of semiconductor industry both in research and business aspects.

2511.15137.tldr: GRPO-Verif is proposed, an algorithm that jointly optimizes solution generation and self-verification within a unified loss function, with an adjustable hyperparameter controlling the weight of the verification signal.
