2511.15139.tldr: CASPER, a cross-attention based framework that predicts unmeasured gene expression in Spatial Transcriptomics by leveraging centroid-level representations from Single-Cell RNA Sequencing, is proposed.

2511.15141.tldr: This work proposes ItemRAG, a novel RAG approach that shifts focus from coarse user-history retrieval to fine-grained item-level retrieval and consistently outperforms existing RAG approaches under both standard and cold-start item recommendation settings.

2511.15151.tldr: DCL-SE is introduced, an end-to-end framework centered on data-driven spatiotemporal encoding that consistently outperforms existing methods in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability and underscores the critical importance of compact, task-specific architectures in the era of large-scale pretrained networks.

2511.15159.tldr: A structure-aware pipeline that learns a surgical action ontology from real trainer-to-trainee transcripts and uses it to condition feedback generation and grounding generation in explicit IAT structure improves fidelity and yields clinician-verifiable rationales, supporting auditable use in surgical training.

2511.15163.tldr: TASA (Teaching According to Students'Aptitude) is proposed, a student-aware tutoring framework that integrates persona, memory, and forgetting dynamics for personalized mathematics learning and achieves superior learning outcomes and more adaptive tutoring behavior compared to representative baselines.

2511.15167.tldr: This work proposes a novel self-evolution contrastive learning framework called SEC-Depth for self-supervised robust depth estimation tasks that adaptively adjusts learning objectives while implicitly sensing weather degradation severity, reducing the needs for manual intervention.

2511.15174.tldr: A novel few-shot fault time-series generation framework based on diffusion models that employs a positive-negative difference adapter, leveraging pre-trained normal data distributions to model the discrepancies between normal and fault domains for accurate fault synthesis.

2511.15182.tldr: This work introduces SWR-Viz, an AI-assisted visual analytics framework that combines a physics-informed Fourier Neural Operator wave forecast model with SIMROUTE-based routing and interactive emissions analytics to support human-centered decision-making in complex geospatial and environmental domains.

2511.15190.tldr: MARVAL demonstrates the first practical path to distillation and RL of masked auto-regressive diffusion models, enabling fast sampling and better preference alignments, resulting in scalable yet human-preferred fast generative models.

2511.15191.tldr: An innovative framework, HIN-LLM Synergistic Enhanced Knowledge Tracing (HISE-KT), which seamlessly integrates HINs with LLMs and uses a structured prompt to integrate the target student's history with the retrieved similar trajectories, enabling the LLM to generate not only accurate predictions but also evidence-backed, explainable analysis reports.

2511.15194.tldr: This work proposes Eq.Bot, a universal canonicalization framework grounded in SE(2) group equivariant theory for robotic manipulation learning that aims to endow models with spatial equivariance without requiring architectural modifications.

2511.15202.tldr: SOLID facilitates iterative collaboration between optimization and LLMs agents through dual prices and deviation penalties, providing insight into the design of LLMs prompt and offering a promising framework for advancing automated and intelligent decision-making across diverse domains.

2511.15203.tldr: This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) paper introduces a comprehensive taxonomy of IPI-centric defense frameworks, classifying them along five dimensions, and identifies six root causes of defense circumvention.

2511.15210.tldr: This work provides the first comprehensive study grounding ID in interpretable text properties through cross-encoder analysis, linguistic features, and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to reveal that contemporary LLMs find scientific text"representationally simple"while fiction requires additional degrees of freedom.

2511.15259.tldr: It is argued that efficiency alone will not lead to sustainable reasoning AI and research and policy directions to embed explicit limits into the optimization and governance of such systems are discussed.

2511.15274.tldr: It is demonstrated that EO achieves comparable reactivity and modularity to BTs through a fundamentally different architecture: replacing polling-based tick execution with event-driven state propagation.

2511.15284.tldr: A scalable, region-aware reinforcement learning (RL) framework for path planning in dynamic environments that eliminates the need for a global planner and lays the groundwork for future improvements using deep RL and flexible environment decomposition.

2511.15342.tldr: ClimateAgents is introduced, an AI-based framework that combines large language models with domain-specialized agents to support hypothesis generation and scenario exploration and aims to support a shift from siloed modeling to reflexive, modular systems designed for dynamic, context-aware climate action.

2511.15369.tldr: IPTQ-ViT is introduced, a novel PTQ framework for fully integer-only vision transformers without retraining that outperforms partial floating-point PTQ methods under W8A8 and W4A8, and achieves accuracy and latency comparable to integer-only QAT methods.

2511.15370.tldr: This manuscript conducts a comprehensive review of the core technologies that support LLMs from a user standpoint, including prompt engineering, knowledge-enhanced retrieval augmented generation, fine tuning, pretraining, and tool learning.

2511.15375.tldr: Experiments across three language models and two multimodal models show that PIECE maintains general capabilities and achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance across diverse downstream tasks, highlighting a practical path to scalable, domain-adaptive foundation models without catastrophic forgetting.

2511.15378.tldr: Terra Nova, a new comprehensive challenge environment (CCE) for reinforcement learning (RL) research inspired by Civilization V is introduced, which is a single environment in which multiple canonical RL challenges arise simultaneously.

2511.15383.tldr: A compliance-preserving retrieval system that adapts LLM reranking and semantic search to aviation MRO environments by operating alongside, rather than replacing, certified legacy viewers is presented.

2511.15392.tldr: This work proposes DEPO, a dual-efficiency preference optimization method that jointly rewards succinct responses and fewer action steps, and introduces dual-efficiency, comprising step-level efficiency, which minimizes tokens per step, and trajectory-level efficiency, which minimizes the number of steps to complete a task.

2511.15414.tldr: A novel sampling-based planning algorithm, called RRT*former, is proposed, which integrates the standard RRT* algorithm with a Transformer network in a novel way, used to extract features from the environment and leverage information from previous samples to better guide the sampling process.

2511.15418.tldr: The systems developed focuses on adapting ASR systems to improve in predicting the language and dialect of the utterance among 8 languages across 33 dialects and presents a novel training approach using Multi-Decoder architecture with phonemic Common Label Set (CLS) as intermediate representation.

2511.15432.tldr: Analysis of TabPFN and TabICL through the "layers as painters" perspective finds that only subsets of layers share a common representational language, suggesting structural redundancy and offering opportunities for model compression and improved interpretability.

2511.15434.tldr: This work systematically evaluates 15 commonly used Small Language Models, ranging from 1 billion to 70 billion parameters, benchmarking their classification accuracy, computational requirements, and cost-efficiency, demonstrating that while SLMs underperform compared to state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs, they can still provide a viable and scalable alternative to external LLM services.

2511.15435.tldr: A novel Hierarchical Visual Attack that misaligns and disrupts the two inputs (the multimodal query and the augmented knowledge) of MRAG's generator to confuse its generation and design a hierarchical two-stage strategy to obtain misaligned augmented knowledge.

2511.15456.tldr: The Transaction Intent Mining (TIM) framework helps provide a more reliable understanding of user motivations in DeFi, offering context-aware explanations for complex blockchain activity.

2511.15462.tldr: It is shown that initial scores and the ratings of co-reviewers are the strongest predictors of score changes during the rebuttal, pointing to a degree of reviewer influence.

2511.15520.tldr: This work studies the possibility of conducting the denoising process only partially before executing an action, allowing the plant to evolve according to its dynamics in parallel to the reverse-time diffusion dynamics ongoing on the computer.

2511.15534.tldr: The key learnings from Agents4Science, the first conference in which AI agents serve as both primary authors and reviewers, with humans as co-authors and co-reviewers, are discussed.

2511.15557.tldr: A novel disk-based ANN index, B+ANN, is presented, which first partitions input data into blocks containing semantically similar items, then builds an B+ tree variant to store blocks both in-memory and on disks, and finally, enables hybrid edge- and block-based in-memory traversals.

2511.15574.tldr: HSKBenchmark is presented, the first benchmark for staged modeling and writing assessment of LLMs in Chinese SLA, and fine-tuned LLMs have writing performance on par with advanced human learners and exhibit human-like acquisition characteristics.

2511.15614.tldr: The Optimus-Q robot is introduced, a sophisticated system designed to autonomously monitor air quality and detect contamination while leveraging adaptive learning techniques and secure quantum communication to enhance operational safety and responsiveness in nuclear facilities.

2511.15623.tldr: This work considers the alternative notion of sufficient explanation, as formalized by Halpern and Pearl, and investigates its connections with database repairs as used for dealing with inconsistent databases, and with causality-based necessary explanations.

2511.15652.tldr: Open challenges in continual RL (CRL) are highlighted based on experiments in an autonomous driving environment and the identified challenges call into question the suitability of neural networks for CL.

2511.15669.tldr: DeepThinkVLA is introduced, which resolves this conflict through a tightly integrated architecture and training strategy and leads to state-of-the-art performance, achieving a 97.0% success rate on the LIBERO benchmark.

2511.15684.tldr: Experiments show that Walrus outperforms prior foundation models on both short and long term prediction horizons on downstream tasks and across the breadth of pretraining data, while ablation studies confirm the value of the contributions to forecast stability, training throughput, and transfer performance over conventional approaches.

2511.15699.tldr: This work considers the problem of token communication, studying how to transmit tokens efficiently and reliably, and proposes a joint semantic-channel and modulation (JSCCM) scheme for the token encoder, mapping point tokens to standard digital constellation points (modulated tokens).

2511.15704.tldr: A scalable recipe for collecting and using egocentric data is provided by categorizing human data into two categories: in-the-wild and on-task alongside with systematic analysis on how to use the data.

2407.16026.tldr: This paper explores the adaptation of Transformer-based models for edge devices through the quantisation and hardware acceleration of the ARM Keyword Transformer model on a RISC-V platform, and demonstrates a viable method for porting and accelerating Transformer-based models in low-power IoT devices.

2410.06530.tldr: Generalized CCNNs (GCCNs) are introduced, a simple yet powerful family of TDL models that can be used to systematically transform any (graph) neural network into its TDL counterpart, and TopoTune, a lightweight software for defining, building, and training GCCNs with unprecedented flexibility and ease.

2411.01144.tldr: This work proposes LEARNER, a contrastive pretraining framework that leverages coarsely labeled inter-patient data to learn fine-grained, patient-specific representations, and demonstrates that contrastive objectives trained on coarse inter-patient differences enable models to capture subtle intra-patient changes associated with treatment response.

2504.08057.tldr: Vector Quantized-Elites (VQ-Elites), a novel Quality-Diversity algorithm that autonomously constructs a structured behavior space grid using unsupervised learning, eliminating the need for prior task-specific knowledge is introduced.

2506.12911.tldr: This work proposes a general-purpose framework for constraint-aware refinement that leverages denoising diffusion implicit models (DDIMs), and iteratively refines it through a deterministic diffusion trajectory guided by a learned prior and augmented by constraint gradient corrections.

2510.08945.tldr: A benchmark designed to evaluate RAG pipelines as a whole, evaluating a pipeline's ability to ingest, retrieve, and reason about several modalities of information, differentiating it from existing benchmarks that focus on particular aspects such as retrieval.

2511.12920.tldr: A transferable framework for auditing AI systems across high-stakes domains where information quality directly impacts user well-being is provided, including answer consistency, relevance, presence of medical safeguards, source categories, and sentiment alignment.

2511.13984.tldr: This work introduces a semantically aware labeling algorithm that, given a generated SQL and a gold reference, assigns node-level correctness without over-penalizing structural containers or alias variation, and establishes node-centric, semantically grounded uncertainty estimation as a strong and interpretable alternative to aggregate sequence level confidence measures.

2511.15712.tldr: A blockchain-based framework that cryptographically authenticates and verifies the intent of every AI-initiated transaction, enabling a future of verifiable trust and accountability in AI-driven financial ecosystems.

2511.15714.tldr: With a diverse consortium of models, eLLM achieves near human-expert-level performance, offering a scalable and reliable solution for taxonomy-based classification that may significantly reduce dependence on human expert labeling.

2511.15715.tldr: Graph-Memoized Reasoning is introduced, a formal framework for representing, storing, and reusing reasoning workflows as graph-structured memory that establishes the groundwork for interpretable, cost-efficient, and self-improving reasoning architectures.

2511.15716.tldr: MACIE uniquely combines causal rigor, emergence quantification, and multi agent support while remaining practical for real time use and represents a step toward interpretable, trustworthy, and accountable multi agent AI.

2511.15717.tldr: This work isolates perception from reasoning across nine text and image modalities using a weighted set-disagreement metric and a two-stage reasoning pipeline, finding that structured text yields precise coordinates on sparse features, images capture 2D shapes yet are resolution-sensitive, and combining them improves execution.

2511.15720.tldr: This thesis explores a multimodal AI framework for enhancing construction safety through the combined analysis of textual and visual data and proposed a multimodal AI framework that combines text and image analysis to assist in identifying safety hazards on construction sites.

2511.15722.tldr: This survey introduces a taxonomy that organizes spatial intelligence from cognitive aspect and divides tasks in terms of reasoning complexity, linking them to several cognitive functions and analyze methods for improving spatial ability, spanning both training-based and reasoning-based approaches.

2511.15728.tldr: Five domains where AI can have the greatest near-term impact are organized around five domains where AI can have the greatest near-term impact: supply chain; formulation and processing; consumer insights and sensory prediction; nutrition and health; and education and workforce development.

2511.15732.tldr: A systematic review of six AI-powered chat systems examines how these leading products respond to questions related to conspiracy theories to demonstrate that the extent of safety guardrails against conspiratorial ideation in generative AI chatbots differs markedly, depending on chatbot model and conspiracy theory.

2511.15733.tldr: This paper presents a systematic technique to baseline and evaluate QE artefacts using quantifiable metrics, and shows that reverse-generated artefacts can outperform low-quality inputs and maintain high standards when inputs are strong.

2511.15734.tldr: A planner's model is presented that identifies two policy heuristics: equalizing marginal returns across the four sovereignty pillars and setting openness where global benefits equal exposure risks, and across contexts, that sovereignty in AI needs managed interdependence, not isolation.

2511.15741.tldr: This thesis offers a unified perspective on resilient multimodal learning by integrating uncertainty modeling, semantic alignment, and data-efficient supervision, providing practical insights for developing reliable and adaptive brain-computer interface systems.

2511.15750.tldr: A scalable pedagogical model for integrating AI into writing instruction is offered and contributes insights for system-level approaches to fostering meaningful human-AI collaboration in higher education.

2511.15752.tldr: The potential of applying Retrieval-Augmented Generation and MAS to enhance LLM performance for specialized courses in engineering curricula is demonstrated, providing a promising direction for developing intelligent tutoring in engineering education.

2511.15759.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating prompt injection risks in RAG-enabled AI agents and proposes a multi-layered defense framework, which reduces successful attack rates from 73.2% to 8.7% while maintaining 94% of baseline task performance.

2511.15763.tldr: This work surveys the current state of AI risk assessment and management, with a focus on the supply chain of AI and risks relating to the behavior and outputs of the AI system, and presents a proposed taxonomy specifically for categorizing AI supply chain entities.

2511.15767.tldr: This work presents a framework for automated stimulus generation using LLMs fine-tuned through Coverage-Driven Direct Preference Optimization (CD-DPO), and introduces PairaNet, a dataset derived from PyraNet that pairs high- and low-quality testbenches labeled using simulation-derived coverage metrics.

2511.15778.tldr: A comparative analysis of NLP low-compute rule-based methods and Large Language Models for information extraction from electronic health records obtained from the Voivodeship Rehabilitation Hospital for Children in Ameryka, Poland shows that rule-based methods provide higher accuracy in information retrieval tasks, however, LLMs offer greater adaptability and scalability.

2511.15807.tldr: TopoReformer is introduced, a model-agnostic reformation pipeline that mitigates adversarial perturbations while preserving the structural integrity of text images and employs a topological autoencoder to enforce manifold-level consistency in latent space and improve robustness without explicit gradient regularization.

2511.15825.tldr: IMACT-CXR demonstrates responsive tutoring flows with bounded latency, precise control over answer leakage, and extensibility toward live residency deployment and preliminary evaluation shows improved localization and diagnostic reasoning compared to baselines.

2511.15830.tldr: Mini Amusement Parks is introduced, an amusement-park simulator designed to evaluate an agent's ability to model its environment, anticipate long-term consequences under uncertainty, and strategically operate a complex business.

2511.15833.tldr: EfficientSAM3, a family of efficient models built on Progressive Hierarchical Distillation that transfers capability from SAM3 to lightweight students in three stages, yields a spectrum of student variants using RepViT, TinyViT, and EfficientViT backbones, enabling on-device concept segmentation and tracking while maintaining high fidelity to teacher behavior.

2511.15857.tldr: It is suggested that value-framing alone lowers the barrier for manipulative uses of LLMs, revealing risks distinct from overt bias or misinformation, and clarifying risks to countering misinformation.

2511.15870.tldr: This work advances pipeline monitoring by demonstrating that physics-informed sparse sensing can match the performance of dense deployments at a fraction of the cost, providing a practical solution for aging urban infrastructure.

2511.15874.tldr: This work proposes four novel extensions to model-based 6D pose estimation methods: a dynamic non-uniform dense sampling strategy that focuses computation on visible regions, reducing occlusion-induced errors, a multi-hypothesis inference mechanism that retains several confidence-ranked pose candidates, and a new weighted by visibility metric for evaluation under occlusion to minimize the bias in the existing protocols.

2209.12746.tldr: The Latent Space Alignment Inversion Paradigm is proposed, which integrates both an evaluation metric and a unified inversion solution, and Normalized Style Space and NSCD are introduced to quantify the disalignment of inversion methods.

2401.17435.tldr: This work investigates the dual role of LLMs as both data generators and predictors, introducing a comprehensive empirical study on the effectiveness of utilizing LLMs for data generation, human choice prediction, or both.

2405.11783.tldr: The potential of using quantum natural language processing (QNLP) for property-guided inverse design of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) with targeted properties with targeted properties is explored, offering a new perspective through which to explore the complex landscape of MOFs.

2406.04470.tldr: An automated benchmark construction process using AI was developed, providing a scalable and automatic approach for AI model evaluation and highlighting the strengths and weaknesses of LVLMs in real-world understanding and advances benchmark construction techniques.

2406.10087.tldr: Results indicate that pre-trained tabular models and simple ensembling can deliver state-of-the-art accuracy and improved minority-class performance with far fewer features and no additional tuning.

2407.17324.tldr: DEFORMISE, a novel DEep learning Framework for dementia diagnosis using 3D brain Magnetic resonance Imaging (MRI) scans with Optimized Slice sElection is introduced, featuring a unique technique for selectively processing MRI slices, focusing on the most relevant brain regions and excluding less informative sections.

2409.19546.tldr: This work investigates stochastic approximations with merely nonexpansive operators, and proves for the first time that classical tabular average reward temporal difference learning converges to a sample-path dependent fixed point.

2410.13246.tldr: This work systematically study atomic calibration, which evaluates factuality calibration at a fine-grained level by decomposing long responses into atomic claims and uncovers insightful patterns regarding the alignment of confidence methods and the changes of confidence throughout generation.

2411.07441.tldr: AutoBot is implemented, across three downstream applications targeting different web stakeholders: a local browser extension providing users with real-time feedback, a Lighthouse audit to inform developers of potential deceptive patterns on their sites, and as a measurement tool for researchers and regulators.

2501.01094.tldr: Multimodal Matching based on Valence and Arousal (MMVA) is introduced, a tri-modal encoder framework designed to capture emotional content across images, music, and musical captions, and demonstrates its efficacy in various zeroshot tasks.

2501.02584.tldr: Pheye is introduced, a novel architecture that efficiently processes high-resolution images while training fewer parameters than similarly sized VLMs, and achieves a high efficiency while maintaining strong performance, particularly in tasks that demand fine-grained image understanding and/or the handling of scene-text.

2501.09751.tldr: OmniThink is a slow-thinking machine writing framework that emulates the human-like process of iterative expansion and reflection to simulate the cognitive behavior of learners as they slowly deepen their knowledge of the topics.

2502.04420.tldr: A simple yet effective framework KVTuner is proposed to adaptively search for the optimal hardware-friendly layer-wise KV quantization precision pairs for coarse-grained KV cache with multi-objective optimization and directly utilize the offline searched configurations during online inference.

2502.04695.tldr: A Governance by Metrics paradigm is proposed that treats explainability evaluation as a central mechanism of private AI governance, and introduces a hierarchical model linking transparency, tamper resistance, scalability, and legal alignment, extending evaluation from model introspection toward systemic accountability.

2502.07071.tldr: This work proposes a novel TRAnsformer-based Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Engine for LOB Simulations (TRADES), and assess TRADES's market simulation realism and responsiveness, showing that it effectively learns the conditional data distribution and successfully reacts to an experimental agent, giving sprout to possible calibrations and evaluations of trading strategies and market impact experiments.

2502.18515.tldr: The experimental results show that Smartify (Gemma2+Codegemma) achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing existing LLMs and even enhancing the capabilities of general-purpose models, such as Llama 3.1.

2503.01814.tldr: A novel and scalable LLM-RecSys framework, LLMInit, designed to integrate pretrained LLM embeddings into CF models through selective initialization strategies and identifies the embedding collapse issue observed when CF models scale and match the large embedding sizes in LLMs.

2503.12339.tldr: This work takes a closer look at the optimization objective of adversarial trigger learning and proposes ATLA: Adversarial Trigger Learning with Augmented objectives, which improves the negative log-likelihood loss used by previous studies into a weighted loss formulation that encourages the learned adversarial triggers to optimize more towards response format tokens.

2503.16356.tldr: Experiments show that CaKE enables more accurate and consistent use of edited knowledge across related reasoning tasks, achieving an average improvement of 20% in multi-hop reasoning accuracy on the MQuAKE dataset while requiring less memory than existing KE methods.

2505.10819.tldr: This work introduces a novel program synthesis method for effectively modeling complex, non-gridworld domains by representing a world model as an exponentially-weighted product of programmatic experts synthesized by LLMs, and shows that this approach can learn complex, stochastic world models from just a few observations.

2505.15141.tldr: A training-free online learning framework to adaptively choose the configuration of the hyperparameters for speculative decoding as text is being generated, and two bandit-based hyperparameter selection algorithms, UCBSpec and EXP3Spec, are designed and analyzed.

2505.17717.tldr: This work decomposes the generalization error to isolate issues--propensity ambiguity and statistical instability--and address them through an adversarial loss function, which combines distributionally robust optimization for handling propensity uncertainty with weight regularization based on weighted Rademacher complexity.

2505.21866.tldr: This work presents CSI-Bench, a large-scale, in-the-wild benchmark dataset collected using commercial WiFi edge devices across 26 diverse indoor environments with 35 real users that offers a foundation for scalable, privacy-preserving WiFi sensing systems in health and broader human-centric applications.

2505.24767.tldr: This paper surveys current approaches to EHR-based drug repurposing, covering data sources, processing methodologies, and representation techniques, and discusses study designs and statistical frameworks for evaluating drug efficacy.

2506.05281.tldr: Fast-DataShapley is proposed, a one-pass training framework that leverages the weighted least squares characterization of the Shapley value to train a reusable explainer model with real-time reasoning speed and three methods with theoretical guarantees to reduce training overhead from two aspects: the approximate calculation of the utility function and the reduction of the sample space complexity.

2506.05577.tldr: This study explores how an agent decides what knowledge to select, from whom, and when and how to integrate it in its own policy in order to accelerate its own learning, and demonstrates that selective, goal-driven reuse leads to less susceptibility to task interference.

2506.06941.tldr: It is found that LRMs have limitations in exact computation: they fail to use explicit algorithms and reason inconsistently across puzzles, shedding light on their strengths, limitations, and ultimately raising crucial questions about their true reasoning capabilities.

2506.07392.tldr: This work designs lightweight and coordinated MTD mechanisms, including leader switching, route mutation, and frequency hopping, to disrupt attacker efforts and enhance network resilience, and highlights the potential of intelligent, distributed defense mechanisms to protect low-altitude networks, paving the way for reliable and scalable low-altitude economy.

2506.12115.tldr: This work builds on the long-standing literature in cognitive psychology and cognitive architectures, which postulates that reasoning arises from the orchestrated, sequential execution of a set of modular, predetermined cognitive operations, and implements this key idea within a modern agentic tool-calling framework.

2506.17936.tldr: Investigation of how the generality and relevance of C-XAI outputs affect people's evaluation of AI cast doubts on the assumption that people can easily infer from C-XAI outputs whether AI models have gained a deeper understanding of complex situations.

2506.19072.tldr: HAWAII, a novel framework that distills knowledge from multiple visual experts into a single vision encoder, enabling it to inherit the complementary strengths of several experts with minimal computational overhead is proposed.

2507.00459.tldr: This method represents the first adaptation of SD3.5-Large for process-aware microstructure generation, offering a scalable approach for data-driven materials design and validate realism using a semantic segmentation model based on a fine-tuned U-Net with a VGG16 encoder on 24 labeled micrographs.

2507.11277.tldr: This paper presents the vision of AgentOps: a comprehensive framework for observing, analyzing, optimizing, and automating operation of agentic AI systems, and presents the AgentOps Automation Pipeline, a six-stage process encompassing behavior observation, metric collection, issue detection, root cause analysis, optimized recommendations, and runtime automation.

2507.17494.tldr: This paper studies the calibration performance of an ML-based outage predictor within a single-user, multi-resource allocation framework and establishes a monotonicity condition that the accuracy-confidence function must satisfy for improvement to occur.

2508.00707.tldr: The experimental results show that exploiting factored structure can yield dimensional gains in sample efficiency, producing more effective robust policies with tighter performance guarantees than state-of-the-art methods.

2508.07279.tldr: MAQuA is introduced, an adaptive question-asking framework for simultaneous, multidimensional mental health screening that reduces the number of assessment questions required for score stabilization by 50-87% compared to random ordering and demonstrates robust performance across both internalizing and externalizing domains.

2508.14765.tldr: This work introduces PepThink-R1, a generative framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) with chain-of-thought (CoT) supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) and is the first LLM-based peptide design framework that combines explicit reasoning with RL-driven property control.

2508.16267.tldr: This work introduces a principled approach to measure factual robustness from the perspective of the generation process by analyzing token distribution entropy in combination with temperature scaling sensitivity, and builds the Factual Robustness Score (FRS), a novel metric which quantifies the stability of a fact against perturbations in decoding conditions, given its initial uncertainty.

2508.16785.tldr: The findings reveal that the impact of quantization on model calibration is generally minor, and that effect of quantization may vary by model and tasks, however, no drastic change was observed which may discourage the use of quantization as a reliable model compression technique.

2508.21083.tldr: This work presents CoBA: CounterBias Augmentation, a unified framework that operates at the semantic triple level: first decomposing text into subject-predicate-object triples, then selectively modifying these triples to disrupt spurious correlations.

2509.04250.tldr: This methodology paves the way for more efficient and expert-informed clinical trial design, enabling substantial reductions in the number of patients required to achieve robust safety assessment and with the potential to transform drug safety monitoring and regulatory decision making.

2509.08592.tldr: This paper argues that mechanistic interpretability provides mechanistic interpretability, and frames interpretability not as post-hoc explanation but as a design constraint embedding auditability, provenance, and bounded transparency within model architectures.

2509.17425.tldr: A set of composite tasks inspired by common daily activities observed in early childhood development offer a preliminary framework for evaluating the general capabilities of embodied agents, marking an early but significant step toward the development of embodied MLLMs and their real-world deployment.

2509.22060.tldr: This paper explores cost efficient white-box attack and non transferability black-box adversarial attacks on Automatic Speech Recognition systems, drawing insights from approaches such as Fast Gradient Sign Method and Zeroth-Order Optimization.

2509.23928.tldr: This work proposes HiViS (Hiding Visual Tokens from the Drafter for Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models), a framework that utilizes the target VLM as a semantic fusion model, allowing the drafter to obtain visual information without explicitly processing visual tokens, ensuring that the drafter's prefill sequence length matches that of the textual tokens.

2509.26574.tldr: The CritPt is presented, the first benchmark designed to test LLMs on unpublished, research-level reasoning tasks that broadly covers modern physics research areas, and highlights a large disconnect between current model capabilities and realistic physics research demands, offering a foundation to guide the development of scientifically grounded AI tools.

2510.08987.tldr: Tiny-R1V is proposed, a novel lightweight 3B model that achieves faster inference and higher accuracy via a two-stage optimization, while unifying multimodal reasoning across multiple tasks with fewer inference tokens.

2510.15258.tldr: This method utilizes LLM agents to automatically extract product data from unstructured data, constructs and visualizes the KG in real-time, and supports users in deep exploration and analysis of graph nodes through an interactive platform, providing new ideas and tools for multi-dimensional data analysis.

2510.22568.tldr: SPIRAL (Self-Play Incremental Racing Algorithm for Learning) is introduced, a novel approach for training autonomous drones in multi-agent racing competitions and contributes a versatile, scalable, and self-improving learning framework to the field of autonomous drone racing.

2511.00588.tldr: A clinician-centered framework to quantify hallucination risks by evaluating diagnostic precision, recommendation quality, reasoning robustness, output coherence, and knowledge alignment is introduced.

2511.05704.tldr: TabDistill is introduced, a new strategy to distill the pre-trained knowledge in complex transformer-based models into simpler neural networks for effectively classifying tabular data, which yields the best of both worlds: being parameter-efficient while performing well with limited training data.

2511.05919.tldr: This work proposes the first principled attack evaluation on LLM factual memory under prompt injection via Xmera, the authors' novel, theory-grounded MitM framework, and perturbing the input given to "victim"LLMs in three closed-book and fact-based QA settings undermines the correctness of the responses and assess the uncertainty of their generation process.

2511.06304.tldr: This study takes a closer look at 15 years of data science on Kaggle - through metadata, shared code, community discussions, and the competitions themselves, to explore Kaggle's growth, its impact on the data science community, uncover hidden technological trends, analyze competition winners, how Kagglers approach problems in general, and more.

2511.07129.tldr: LoRA on the Go is introduced, a training-free framework that dynamically selects and merges adapters at the instance level without any additional requirements and leverages signals extracted from a single forward pass through LoRA adapters, to identify the most relevant adapters and determine their contributions on-the-fly.

2511.07899.tldr: This work uses CP to calibrate the switching between the unsafe nominal controller and the learned HJ-based safe policy and to derive safety guarantees under this switched policy, and investigates using an ensemble of independently trained HJ value functions as a safety filter.

2511.07979.tldr: This work introduces MSLR, the first Chinese multi-step legal reasoning dataset grounded in real-world judicial decision making and designs a scalable Human-LLM collaborative annotation pipeline that efficiently produces fine-grained step-level reasoning annotations and provides a reusable methodological framework for multi-step reasoning datasets.

2511.10712.tldr: The core design of MergeBarrier is to disrupt the Linear Mode Connectivity (LMC) between the protected model and its homologous counterparts, thereby eliminating the low-loss path required for effective model merging.

2511.10848.tldr: A novel Spatial-Temporal Adapter with Multi-Head Pooling (STAMP) is introduced, which leverages univariate embeddings produced by a general TSFM, implicitly models spatial-temporal characteristics of EEG data, and achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art EEGFMs.

2511.14007.tldr: There is reason for optimism about acceleration in sustaining innovations through the use of to AI/ML; but that support for conventional empirical, computational, and theoretical research is required to maintain the likelihood of further major advances in manufacturing and materials science.

2511.14030.tldr: This work proposes WaRPAD, a training-free AI-generated image detection algorithm based on self-supervised models that consistently achieves competitive performance and demonstrates strong robustness to test-time corruptions.

2511.14993.tldr: This report provides a comprehensive review of the data curation lifecycle - including collection, processing, filtering and clustering - for the multi-stage training pipeline that involves extensive pre-training and incorporates quality-enhancement techniques such as self-supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning-based post-training.

2511.15168.tldr: This paper introduces a novel method for training LLMs to generate high-quality test cases in Selenium, specifically targeting form interaction testing, and defines clear metrics for syntax correctness, script executability, and input field coverage.

2511.15192.tldr: COPYCHECK is presented, a novel framework that leverages uncertainty signals to detect whether copyrighted content was used in LLM training sets, and presents the first application of uncertainty for copyright detection in LLMs, offering practical tools for training data transparency.

2511.15211.tldr: OEMA improves zero-shot clinical NER, achieving near-supervised performance under related-match criteria and will focus on continual learning and open-domain adaptation to expand its applicability in clinical NLP.

2511.15661.tldr: VisPlay is introduced, a self-evolving RL framework that enables VLMs to autonomously improve their reasoning abilities using large amounts of unlabeled image data, and achieves consistent improvements in visual reasoning, compositional generalization, and hallucination reduction across eight benchmarks.

2511.15884.tldr: Box6d is proposed, a category-level 6D pose estimation method tailored for storage boxes in the warehouse context that delivers competitive or superior 6D pose precision while reducing inference time by approximately 76%.

2511.15921.tldr: This project develops a self correcting framework for large language models (LLMs) that detects and mitigates hallucinations during multi-step reasoning that leverages fine grained uncertainty signals: self-assessed confidence alignment and token-level entropy spikes to detect unreliable and unfaithful reasoning in real time.

2511.15941.tldr: iLTM is presented, an integrated Large Tabular Model that unifies tree-derived embeddings, dimensionality-agnostic representations, a meta-trained hypernetwork, multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), and retrieval within a single architecture, and achieves consistently superior performance across tabular classification and regression tasks.

2511.15958.tldr: This work proposes JudgeBoard, a novel evaluation pipeline that directly queries models to assess the correctness of candidate answers without requiring extra answer comparisons, and proposes MAJ (Multi-Agent Judging), a novel multi-agent evaluation framework that leverages multiple interacting SLMs with distinct reasoning profiles to approximate LLM-level judgment accuracy through collaborative deliberation.

2511.15965.tldr: Predictions derived from the spectrum conversion (NIR to MIR) task did not match the performance of the original MIR spectra but were similar or superior to predictive performance of NIR-only models, suggesting the unified spectral latent space can effectively leverage the larger and more diverse MIR dataset for prediction of soil properties not well represented in current NIR libraries.

2511.15968.tldr: A novel consistency regularization approach that mitigates destructive interference between segmentation and classification in breast ultrasound-based tumor segmentation via multi-task learning and achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance under rigorous external validation on the UDIAT dataset.

2511.15969.tldr: A friendly map of the QML landscape is provided to judge when-and under what assumptions-quantum approaches may offer real benefits, so that the reader can judge when-and under what assumptions-quantum approaches may offer real benefits.

2511.15977.tldr: This work develops a symbolic regression model that estimates per-chromosome memory consumption for a given task and introduces an interpolating bias to conservatively minimize over-allocation, and presents a dynamic scheduler that adaptively predicts RAM usage with a polynomial regression model.

2511.15992.tldr: This work presents a novel dual-method detection system combining semantic drift analysis with canary baseline comparison to identify backdoored LLMs in real-time, providing the first practical solution to LLM backdoor detection.

2511.15994.tldr: This work proposes an evaluation framework that measures accuracy, consistency, and fidelity of reasoning in large language models, and finds that errors persist even when authoritative passages are provided.

2511.15997.tldr: The Sensorium Arc project demonstrates the potential of conversational AI agents to mediate affective, intuitive access to high-dimensional environmental data and proposes a new paradigm for human-machine-ecosystem.

2511.16004.tldr: InfCode is presented, an adversarial multi-agent framework for automated repository-level issue resolution that iteratively refines both tests and patches through adversarial interaction between a Test Patch Generator and a Code Patch Generator, while a Selector agent identifies the most reliable fix.

2511.16005.tldr: INFCODE-C++ is introduced, the first C++-aware autonomous system for end-to-end issue resolution and highlights the need for language-aware reasoning in multi-language software agents and establishes a foundation for future research on scalable, LLM-driven repair for complex, statically typed ecosystems.

2511.16006.tldr: While applying SGA and RTM individually improves counterfactual outcome estimation, their synergistic combination consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2511.16014.tldr: MuseKG is presented, an end-to-end knowledge-graph framework that unifies structured and unstructured museum data through symbolic-neural integration, and constructs a typed property graph linking objects, people, organisations, and visual or textual labels, and supports natural language queries.

2511.16016.tldr: CARE is a framework that enhances LLMs'causal-reasoning ability by teaching them to effectively utilize the outputs of established causal-discovery algorithms through supervised fine-tuning, and shows results that significantly outperforms both traditional causal-discovery algorithms and state-of-the-art LLMs with over a thousand times more parameters.

2511.16018.tldr: This paper proposes SpellForger, a game where players create custom spells by writing natural language prompts, aiming to provide a unique experience of personalization and creativity, validating the use of AI as a direct gameplay mechanic.

2511.16026.tldr: The proposed material classification technique using a speckle pattern of the material's surface based on deep learning to monitor and control the laser cutting process provides a robust and accurate solution for material-aware laser cutting using speckle sensing.

2511.16027.tldr: HGCN2SP is a novel model with a hierarchical graph designed for 2SP problems, encoding each scenario and modeling their relationships hierarchically, and exhibits remarkable generalization capabilities in handling large-scale instances, even with a substantial number of variables or scenarios that were unseen during the training phase.

2511.16045.tldr: This paper proposes a novel Constraint Programming model that uses key alignment parameters that allow it to reason directly on the sequences of same-family jobs scheduled on the machines, resulting in a more compact formulation.

2511.16048.tldr: A soft flying robotic art installation whose physical form, a 3D pixel style cloud, is a physical glitch derived from digital archaeology, and a lo-fi framework for creating imperfect companions whose success is measured in character over efficiency is demonstrated.

2511.16055.tldr: A framework that classifies AI-accounting research along two dimensions: research focus (accounting-centric versus AI-centric) and methodological approach (AI-based versus traditional methods) is proposed to map existing studies and identify research opportunities.

2511.16072.tldr: A collection of short case studies in which GPT-5 produced new, concrete steps in ongoing research across mathematics, physics, astronomy, computer science, biology, and materials science, underscoring how GPT-5 can help human mathematicians settle previously unsolved problems.

2511.16075.tldr: A hybrid architecture is designed, combining two powerful tools: the CNN LSTM model for time series forecasting and an orchestrator based on multi agent Deep Reinforcement Learning, embedding the predictive forecast from the CNN LSTM directly into the DRL agent state space.

2511.16080.tldr: Empirical evaluation demonstrates that Operon outperforms an existing workflow engine with 14.94x baseline overhead reduction while maintaining near-linear end-to-end output rates as workloads scale, making it particularly suitable for large-scale data generation pipelines in machine learning applications.

2511.16084.tldr: SpectralTrain is introduced, a universal, architecture-agnostic training framework that enhances learning efficiency by integrating curriculum learning with principal component analysis (PCA)-based spectral downsampling and enables efficient learning of spectral -- spatial patterns at significantly reduced computational costs.

2511.16090.tldr: This work proposes three convex combination strategies, symmetric and asymmetric, that balance pessimistic estimates to mitigate overestimation and optimistic exploration via double actors to alleviate underestimation, enabling tunable control across the bias spectrum.

2511.16122.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework called Ensemble Learning based Prompt Optimization (ELPO), which outperforms state-of-the-art prompt optimization methods across different tasks, e.g., improving F1 score by 7.6 on ArSarcasm dataset.

2511.16131.tldr: This work introduces AskDB, a large language model powered agent designed to bridge the gap by supporting both data analysis and administrative operations over SQL databases through natural language, and highlights the potential of AskDB as a unified and intelligent agent for relational database systems.

2511.16135.tldr: CoSP is proposed, an intelligent inverse design method based on contrastive pretrained large language model (LLM) that allows the model to preserve its linguistic capabilities while also comprehending Maxwell's Equations, enabling it to describe material structures with target optical properties in natural language.

2511.16183.tldr: Footovision Play-by-Play Action Spotting in Soccer Dataset (FOOTPASS) is introduced, the first benchmark for play-by-play action spotting over entire soccer matches in a multi-modal, multi-agent tactical context.

2511.16201.tldr: It is argued that the next breakthrough will come not from more automation, but from coupling automation with understanding from systematic benchmarking, which will shift the field from blind search to interpretable, class-specific algorithm design, accelerating progress while producing reusable scientific insight into when and why optimisation strategies succeed.

2511.16216.tldr: An automated pipeline that resolves long-range logical dependencies and cross-page discontinuities in OCR-parsed documents, recovering coherent question--answer--figure associations even when answers reside in separate companion volumes is proposed.

2511.16248.tldr: This paper revisits fairness-aware interactive recommendation by introducing a novel control knob, i.e., the lifecycle of items, and introduces LHRL, a lifecycle-aware hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that dynamically harmonizes fairness and accuracy by leveraging phase-specific exposure dynamics.

2511.16278.tldr: Game-Theory Attack is proposed, an scalable black-box jailbreak framework that formalizes the attacker's interaction against safety-aligned LLMs as a finite-horizon, early-stoppable sequential stochastic game, and reparameterize the LLM's randomized outputs via quantal response.

2511.16283.tldr: This work proposes an intent-aware retrieval framework that leverages large language models to hypothesize potential answers, decompose them into intent-specific queries, and retrieve supporting passages for each underlying intent to balance coverage across diverse intents while reducing redundancy.

2511.16324.tldr: SDA (Steering-Driven Distribution Alignment), a training-free and model-agnostic alignment framework designed for open-source LLMs, is proposed, demonstrating its effectiveness and generalization across diverse models and application scenarios.

2511.16353.tldr: It is found that highly informative rationales are not likely to help classify the instance correctly and sufficiency conversely captures the classification impact of the non-rationalised context, which interferes with rationale information in the same input.

2511.16373.tldr: This work integrates into MalDataGen a Super-Metric that aggregates eight metrics across four fidelity dimensions, producing a single weighted score that is more stable and consistent than traditional metrics.

2511.16375.tldr: This work provides the first systematic comparison of foundation models against classical machine learning baselines for corporate bankruptcy prediction, showing that models such as XGBoost and CatBoost consistently outperform foundation models across all prediction horizons.

2511.16383.tldr: This work proposes a novel agent-based method for automatic validation of optimization models that builds upon and extends methods from software testing to address optimization modeling.

2511.16390.tldr: This work proposes a robot metacognition architecture centered on confidence (a second-order judgment on decisions) and demonstrates it on the use case of autonomous tool invention and highlights potential applications and research directions for robot metacognition.

2511.16395.tldr: The framework CorrectHDL is proposed that leverages high-level synthesis results as functional references to correct potential errors in LLM-generated HDL designs and demonstrates that circuits generated by the proposed framework achieve significantly better area and power efficiency than conventional HLS designs and approach the quality of human-engineered circuits.

2511.16398.tldr: This study contributes to health information systems by offering a computational solution for integrated physical and mental healthcare and provides design principles for advancing collaborative chronic disease management across the pre-treatment, treatment, and post-treatment phases.

2511.16402.tldr: This paper draws an operational analogy to MVCC in databases and shows why a direct transplant fails in a decoupled, multi-language setting, and proposes an agent-first design, Bauplan, that reimplements data and compute isolation in the lakehouse.

2511.16417.tldr: The proposed Pharos-ESG is a unified framework that transforms ESG reports into structured representations through multimodal parsing, contextual narration, and hierarchical labeling, and enriches its outputs with ESG, GRI, and sentiment labels, yielding annotations aligned with the analytical demands of financial research.

2511.16423.tldr: To fully leverage the generalizable multimodal features in pre-trained VLMs, TOFA employs both visual and textual pipelines to extract task-relevant representations, and is training-free, not relying on additional training resources on either the client or server side.

2511.16427.tldr: A generative modeling framework based on latent neural stochastic differential equations that views clinical time series as discrete-time partial observations of an underlying controlled stochastic dynamical system that outperforms ordinary differential equation and long short-term memory baseline models in accuracy and uncertainty estimation is proposed.

2511.16432.tldr: This paper discusses five examples, the shortcomings of world modeling, the generation of thought processes, attention, neural scaling laws, and quantization, that illustrate how much neuroscience could potentially learn from ML research.

2511.16445.tldr: Preliminary results show that flattened sentiment can often be detected with simple statistical models in users with low baseline variability, while detecting semantic drift requires temporal modeling and personalized baselines, and across both tasks, personalized classifiers consistently outperform generalized ones, highlighting the importance of individual behavioral context.

2511.16467.tldr: The processing of idiomatic expressions in transformer-based language models is investigated using a novel set of techniques for circuit discovery and analysis, and attention heads that frequently activate across different idioms are identified.

2511.16482.tldr: This work introduces ExCIR (Explainability through Correlation Impact Ratio), a correlation-aware attribution score equipped with a lightweight transfer protocol that reproduces full-model rankings using only a fraction of the data.

2511.16483.tldr: This work proposes a large language model (LLM)-based reward design approach to generate autonomous cyber defense policies in a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-driven experimental simulation environment and suggests that LLM-guided reward designs can lead to effective defense strategies against diverse adversarial behaviors.

2511.16494.tldr: This work proposes a novel physics-informed deep generative learning framework that, for the first time, integrates wave optics-based physical rendering and depth alignment into a generative adversarial network (GAN), to synthesise high-fidelity microscope images for microrobot pose estimation efficiently.

2511.16501.tldr: ODE-ViT is introduced, a Vision Transformer reformulated as an ODE system that satisfies the conditions for well-posed and stable dynamics and a plug-and-play teacher-student framework in which a discrete ViT guides the continuous trajectory of ODE-ViT by treating the intermediate representations of the teacher as solutions of the ODE.

2511.16528.tldr: This work introduces TurkColBERT, the first comprehensive benchmark comparing dense encoders and late-interaction models for Turkish retrieval, and evaluates 10 models across five Turkish BEIR datasets covering scientific, financial, and argumentative domains.

2511.16548.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that CLOZE provides an accurate, scalable, and privacy-preserving ontology extension framework, with strong potential to support a wide range of downstream applications in biomedical research and clinical informatics.

2511.16557.tldr: This study designs a reservoir computing (RC) network by exploiting short- and long-term memory dynamics in Au/Ti/MoS$_2$/Au memristive devices, and achieves 89.56\% precision in a spoken-digit recognition task and is also used to analyze a nonlinear time series equation.

2511.16566.tldr: NutriScreener is a retrieval-augmented, multi-pose graph attention network that combines CLIP-based visual embeddings, class-boosted knowledge retrieval, and context awareness to enable robust malnutrition detection and anthropometric prediction from children's images, simultaneously addressing generalizability and class imbalance.

2511.16575.tldr: ECPv2 is proposed, a scalable and theoretically grounded algorithm for global optimization of Lipschitz-continuous functions with unknown Lipschitz constants that retains ECP's no-regret guarantees with optimal finite-time bounds and expands the acceptance region with high probability.

2511.16577.tldr: A method that uses statistical language models as oracles for disambiguation that does not require any hand-annotation of training data to construct and is evaluated against human-annotated gold answers to demonstrate its effectiveness.

2511.16579.tldr: This work develops a theoretical framework for the Synthesis of safe-PCTL specifications, shows how the reducing global specification satisfaction to local constraints, and defines CPCTL, a fragment of safe-PCTL, to demonstrate how the expressiveness of CPCTL makes it a relevant fragment for the Synthesis Problem.

2511.16582.tldr: A taxonomical framework is developed for classifying challenges to the possibility of consciousness in digital artificial intelligence systems and for disambiguating between challenges to computational functionalism and challenges to digital consciousness, as well as between different ways of parsing such challenges.

2511.16588.tldr: Abductive Latent Explanations (ALEs), a formalism to express sufficient conditions on the intermediate (latent) representation of the instance that imply the prediction, which combines the inherent interpretability of case-based reasoning models and the guarantees provided by formal XAI.

2511.16590.tldr: D-GARA is modular and extensible, supporting the seamless integration of new tasks, anomaly types, and interaction scenarios to meet specific evaluation goals, and construct and annotate a benchmark featuring commonly used Android applications with embedded anomalies to support broader community research.

2511.16593.tldr: This research aims to model resilience for automatic state detection, develop agent-based policies that optimize the greenness-resilience trade-off, and understand catastrophic forgetting to maintain performance consistency in OL-CAIS.

2511.16602.tldr: Deliberate Practice Policy Optimization is introduced, a metacognitive ``Metaloop''training framework that dynamically alternates between supervised fine-tuning (competence expansion) and reinforcement learning (skill refinement) that enables automatic weakness identification and targeted resource allocation, specifically designed to maximize learning efficiency from sparse, finite data.

2511.16625.tldr: MedBayes-Lite is proposed, a lightweight Bayesian enhancement for transformer-based clinical language models that improves reliability through uncertainty-aware prediction and supports safer decision-making by flagging uncertain predictions for human review, particularly under distribution shift.

2511.16637.tldr: This work develops a method for instead encoding orders with auxiliary variables that leads to orders-of-magnitude speed-ups in both theory and practice, and shows that this leads to orders-of-magnitude speed-ups in both theory and practice.

2511.16653.tldr: A novel teacher-guided pruning framework that tightly integrates Knowledge Distillation with importance score estimation is introduced that outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as EPG and EPSD at high sparsity levels, while offering a more computationally efficient alternative to iterative pruning schemes like COLT.

2511.16661.tldr: The proposed framework AINA enables the learning of 3D point-based policies for multi-fingered hands that are robust to background changes and can be deployed directly without requiring any robot data (including online corrections, reinforcement learning, or simulation).

2511.16671.tldr: This preliminary study introduces Thinking-while-Generating (TwiG), the first interleaved framework that enables co-evolving textual reasoning throughout the visual generation process, and investigates three candidate strategies, zero-shot prompting, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning via a customized TwiG-GRPO strategy, each offering unique insights into the dynamics of interleaved reasoning.

2511.16674.tldr: This paper introduces a method of dataset distillation called Linear Gradient Matching that optimizes the synthetic images such that, when passed through a pre-trained feature extractor, they induce gradients in the linear classifier similar to those produced by the real data.

2401.06925.tldr: A conditioning operation for SCMs is introduced: it maps an SCM with explicit selection mechanisms to one without them while preserving the causal semantics of the selected subpopulation, and preserves simplicity, acyclicity, and linearity of SCMs, and interacts well with marginalization, conditioning, and interventions.

2102.11361.tldr: FaCells is a method that turns model internals into line based artworks that bridges data, model, and paper while acknowledging the limits of the labels and the biases of the dataset.

2207.07250.tldr: A framework of the equivariant convolutional quantum algorithms is introduced which is tailored for a number of machine-learning tasks on physical systems with arbitrary SU$(d)$ symmetries, providing evidence against PQC+ being classically simulatable.

2311.02733.tldr: This study proposes a new method based on a multimodal self-supervised-learning (SSL) feature extractor to exploit inconsistency between audio and visual modalities for multimodal video forgery detection and achieves new state-of-the-art performance on the FakeAVCeleb and DeepfakeTIMIT datasets.

2406.01183.tldr: A novel method to estimate the relative importance of the input components for a Deep Neural Network is proposed by leveraging on a spectral re-parametrization of the optimization process.

2406.02966.tldr: A critical interpretive analysis traced textual, visual, and structural patterns that revealed forms of digital neocolonialism and their implications for educational equity and proposed a dual-pathway mitigation model to address resulting inequities.

2406.03283.tldr: CatCoder is presented, a novel code generation framework designed for statically typed programming languages that enhances repository-level code generation by integrating relevant code and type context and indicates consistent performance improvements across all models, which underlines the practicality of CatCoder.

2407.05650.tldr: These findings establish CNA as a promising paradigm for developing neural representations that integrate local feature processing with global structure formation, providing a foundation for future research on invariant object recognition.

2408.15511.tldr: The first large-scale real-world image-text pre-training dataset, AerialAgent-Ego10k, featuring urban drones from a first-person perspective is constructed and SkyAgentEval, the downstream task evaluation metrics based on GPT-4 are developed, revealing the potential and limitations of 2D/3D visual language models in UAV-agent tasks.

2409.11078.tldr: A novel ANN architecture called MonoKAN is introduced, which is based on the KAN architecture and achieves certified partial monotonicity while enhancing interpretability and outperforming state-of-the-art monotonic MLP approaches.

2409.11393.tldr: A novel LLM-based Agent Unified Modeling Framework (LLM-Agent-UMF) is proposed that establishes a clear foundation for agent development from both functional and software architectural perspectives, developed and evaluated using the Architecture Tradeoff and Risk Analysis Framework (ATRAF).

2411.09613.tldr: A novel Precision-driven Tool Recommendation approach, PTR, which captures an initial, concise set of tools by leveraging historical tool bundle usage and dynamically adjusts the tool set by performing tool matching, culminating in a multi-view-based tool addition.

2502.10568.tldr: This work proposes a framework to handle observer-aware Markov decision processes to partial observability and formalizes properties such as legibility, explicability and predictability, and discusses theoretical properties of PO-OAMDPs.

2503.01424.tldr: A systematic review of the progress in hypothesis formulation, hypothesis validation, and manuscript publication and offers a comprehensive overview of existing benchmarks and tools across various domains that support the integration of AI into the research process.

2503.09114.tldr: This study measures key performance indicators—including memory usage, inference speed, and energy consumption—across various device configurations, and examines throughput-energy trade-offs, cost considerations, and usability, alongside an assessment of qualitative model performance.

2503.09878.tldr: This work proposes CleverDistiller, a self-supervised, cross-modal 2D-to-3D KD framework introducing a set of simple yet effective design choices, and introduces the auxiliary self-supervised spatial task of occupancy prediction to enhance the semantic knowledge, obtained from a VFM through KD, with 3D spatial reasoning capabilities.

2503.12972.tldr: This paper proposes Vision-align-to-Language integrated Knowledge Graph (VaLiK), a novel approach for constructing MMKGs that enhances LLMs reasoning through cross-modal information supplementation that outperform previous state-of-the-art models on multimodal reasoning tasks.

2503.17987.tldr: This work proposes Reason2Attack(R2A), which aims to enhance the LLM's reasoning capabilities in generating adversarial prompts by incorporating the jailbreaking attack into the post-training process of the LLM and design an attack process reward that considers prompt length, prompt stealthiness, and prompt effectiveness, aiming to further enhance reasoning accuracy.

2504.07139.tldr: This year's AI Index is the most comprehensive to date and arrives at an important moment, as AI's influence across society, the economy, and global governance continues to intensify.

2504.08016.tldr: A computational-theoretical framework is established to provide an account of psychopathology applicable to large language models and shows the promise of developing a new powerful in silico model of psychopathology and also alludes to the possibility of safety threat from the AI systems with psychopathological behaviors in the near future.

2504.18777.tldr: This study analyses AI-generated digitization results from Google Earth imagery and compares them with digitized outputs from OpenStreetMap (OSM) to evaluate performance.

2504.21194.tldr: ISS-Geo142 and these three pipelines provide a concrete, historically grounded benchmark for future work on ISS image geolocation, and TerraByte establishes the strongest overall baseline, correctly geolocating approximately 90% of the images while also producing human-readable geographic descriptions.

2505.01094.tldr: This work introduces a water resource management case study and model it as a MORL environment, and benchmarks existing MORL algorithms on this task, showing that specialized water management methods outperform state-of-the-art MORL approaches and underscoring the scalability challenges MORL algorithms face in real-world scenarios.

2505.04736.tldr: The results demonstrate that LLMs may be used to augment tutoring systems with logic tutoring hints, but require additional modifications to ensure accuracy and pedagogical appropriateness.

2505.11289.tldr: A new open-source version of Meta-World is released that has full reproducibility of past results, is more technically ergonomic, and gives users more control over the tasks that are included in a task set.

2505.12188.tldr: LLM-DSE is presented, a multi-agent framework designed specifically for optimizing HLS directives, which leverages essential domain knowledge to identify efficient parameter combinations while maintaining adaptability through verbal learning from online interactions.

2505.21535.tldr: A Function-preserving Attention Replacement framework that substitutes all attention in pretrained DeiTs with sequential modules inherently compatible with IMC dataflows, highlighting its potential for energy-efficient transformer inference on IMC-based edge accelerators.

2506.00133.tldr: Results show that RL-RPL-UA is a potential and energy-efficient way to route data in underwater networks and adds 80 seconds to the network's lifetime compared to previous approaches.

2506.08255.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that integrates Interval Bound Propagation with a hypernetwork-based architecture to enable certifiably robust continual learning across sequential tasks, and introduces Interval MixUp, a novel training strategy that blends virtual examples represented as $\ell_{\infty}$ balls centered around MixUp points.

2506.08708.tldr: PhyBlock is introduced, a progressive benchmark designed to assess VLMs on physical understanding and planning through robotic 3D block assembly tasks, and benchmark 21 state-of-the-art VLMs, highlighting their strengths and limitations in physically grounded, multi-step planning.

2506.22397.tldr: HazeMatching is proposed, a novel iterative method for dehazing light microscopy images, which effectively balances the fidelity of the dehazing results and the realism of individual predictions by adapting the conditional flow matching framework by guiding the generative process with a hazy observation in the conditional velocity field.

2507.04224.tldr: Whether LLMs differentiate responses across user identities by prompting six state-of-the-art LLMs to assist patrons differing in sex, race/ethnicity, and institutional role is evaluated.

2507.06819.tldr: This paper performs an in-depth analysis of a set of prominent prototype models including ProtoPNet, ProtoPool, ProtoPool and PIPNet and proposes several new metrics to further complement the analysis of model interpretability.

2507.10998.tldr: This work proposes a latent-space perturbation framework using a mixed-input Variational Autoencoder (VAE) to generate statistically consistent adversarial examples, and introduces In-Distribution Success Rate (IDSR) to jointly evaluate attack effectiveness and distributional alignment.

2507.13290.tldr: A Formal Query Language is proposed that can represent a user's intent in a formally defined but natural language-like manner that a user can confirm matches their intent and is implemented in Astrogator, a system widely used for system administration, including for critical systems.

2508.01109.tldr: Although LLM-only text outperforms agent-retrieved data, challenging the Agent-Induced Novelty Hypothesis, modest gains from combining agent data in some splits weakly support the notion that agent-gathered information introduces unique representational structures not fully captured by static LLM knowledge.

2508.06869.tldr: The VISUAL-SUBTITLE INTEGRATION (VSI) is proposed, a multimodal keyframe retrieval framework that employs a dual-branch collaborative retrieval approach combining Video Search and Subtitle Match to fuse complementary visual and textual information for precise localization.

2508.10599.tldr: Multi-Subspace Representation Steering (MSRS) is proposed, a novel framework for effective multi-attribute steering via subspace representation fine-tuning that significantly reduces attribute conflicts, surpasses existing methods across a range of attributes, and generalizes effectively to diverse downstream tasks.

2508.18694.tldr: This work benchmarks state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction methods on AgriChrono, revealing the profound challenge of reconstructing high-fidelity, dynamic non-rigid scenes in such farmland settings and validates AgriChrono as a critical asset for advancing model generalization.

2509.06938.tldr: This work establishes how and when hallucinations arise in pre-trained transformer models through concept representations captured by sparse autoencoders, and shows that hallucinations in the output of a transformer model can be reliably predicted from the concept patterns embedded in transformer layer activations.

2509.10577.tldr: A minimal coding abstraction is introduced that is a zero-bit tamper-detection code that samples a pseudorandom codeword and decides whether it should be treated as unmarked content or as the result of tampering with a valid codeword, which proves a sharp unconditional limit on robustness to independent symbol corruption.

2509.14001.tldr: MOCHA (Multi-modal Objects-aware Cross-arcHitecture Alignment Alignment), a distillation framework that transfers multimodal region-level knowledge from a frozen VLM teacher into a lightweight vision-only detector, consistently outperforms prior baselines across four personalized detection benchmarks under strict few-shot regimes.

2509.21651.tldr: A highly scalable approach to continuous physical safety benchmarking of Embodied AI systems, grounded in real-world injury narratives and operational safety constraints, and a post-training paradigm to teach models to explicitly reason about embodiment-specific safety constraints provided through system instructions.

2509.23629.tldr: This work proposes Annealed-RLVR, a principled algorithm that injects a targeted SFT ``heating''step to resolve this topological bottleneck at the transition between learning stages, providing a new physical intuition for engineering the emergent reasoning capabilities of future AI systems.

2510.10135.tldr: CharCom is proposed, a modular and parameter-efficient framework that achieves character-consistent story illustration through composable LoRA adapters, enabling efficient per-character customization without retraining the base model.

2510.12194.tldr: In fully autonomous mode, ResearStudio achieves state-of-the-art results on the GAIA benchmark, surpassing systems like OpenAI's DeepResearch and Manus, and shows that strong automated performance and fine-grained human control can coexist.

2510.13827.tldr: This work presents a new framework that combines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) within a multilingual contrastive reward signal to enhance both task efficiency and semantic accuracy in Text-to-SQL systems in cross-lingual scenarios.

2510.17309.tldr: RubiSCoT, an AI-supported framework designed to enhance thesis evaluation from proposal to final submission, is presented, discussing its potential to optimize academic assessment processes through consistent, scalable, and transparent evaluation.

2510.22300.tldr: T2I-RiskyPrompt is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed for evaluating safety-related tasks in T2I models and a reason-driven risky image detection method that explicitly aligns the MLLM with safety annotations is proposed.

2510.27629.tldr: The results show that current filtering practices may not be particularly effective: Excluded knowledge can be rapidly recovered in some cases via fine-tuning, and exhibits broader generalizability in sequence modeling, highlighting the challenges of data filtering as a standalone procedure.

2511.02969.tldr: This paper develops two novel algorithms that incorporate the expected gain from learning the value of information into Bootstrapped DQN, and uses value of information estimates to measure the discrepancies of opinions among distinct network heads, and drive exploration towards areas with the most potential.

2511.07318.tldr: It is shown that existing hallucination detection methods, such as confidence-based filtering and inner-state probing, fundamentally fail in the presence of spurious correlations, and further elucidates why these statistical biases intrinsically undermine confidence-based detection techniques.

2511.07772.tldr: Steering Activations towards Leakage-free Thinking (SALT) is introduced, a lightweight test-time intervention that mitigates privacy leakage in model's Chain of Thought (CoT) by injecting targeted steering vectors into hidden state.

2511.12233.tldr: DHMI is proposed, the first diffusion-based model inversion framework designed for deep hashing, which outperforms the existing state-of-the-art model inversion attacks in black-box scenarios, confirming both its practical efficacy and the critical privacy risks inherent in deep hashing systems.
