2511.18633.tldr: A structuralist decision framework for classifying the implicit ontological commitments made in machine learning research on neural network representations is developed, which clarifies conceptual tensions in debates on interpretability, emergence, and epistemic trust in machine learning, and offers a rigorous foundation for future interdisciplinary work between philosophy of science and machine learning.

2511.18635.tldr: The results consistently show that while targeted mitigation can sometimes reduce bias in the intended dimension, it frequently leads to unintended and often negative consequences in others, such as increasing model bias and decreasing general coherence, which underscores the critical need for robust, multi-dimensional evaluation tools.

2511.18640.tldr: The introduction of NeuroVFM, a visual foundation model trained on 5.24 million clinical MRI and CT volumes using a scalable volumetric joint-embedding predictive architecture, establishes health system learning as a paradigm for building generalist medical AI and provides a scalable framework for clinical foundation models.

2511.18643.tldr: Kitty provides a page-centric KV layout, Triton-compatible page dequantization kernels, and a lightweight runtime pipeline that preserves coalescing and avoids divergence, enabling up to 8x larger batches and 2.1x higher throughput under the same memory budget.

2511.18651.tldr: Despite limitations related to sample size, single-case design, and study duration, the findings show that Lean 5.0 provides a transformative paradigm connecting human cognition with predictive control in construction management.

2511.18653.tldr: FHE-Agent automatically discovers feasible, 128-bit secure configurations for complex models where baseline heuristics and one-shot prompts fail to produce a valid setup, and consistently achieves better precision and lower latency than na\"ive search strategies.

2511.18670.tldr: Deterministic Continuous Replacement attains faster convergence and stronger alignment than stochastic gating and distillation baselines on controlled attention replacement, establishing a foundation for heterogeneous operator swaps.

2511.18674.tldr: Low-Rank GEMM is presented, a novel approach that leverages low-rank matrix approximations to achieve sub-quadratic complexity while maintaining hardware-accelerated performance through FP8 precision and intelligent kernel selection.

2511.18676.tldr: This work introduces MedVision, a large-scale dataset and benchmark specifically designed to evaluate and improve VLMs on quantitative medical image analysis, and provides a foundation for developing VLMs with robust quantitative reasoning capabilities in medical imaging.

2511.18692.tldr: Neuron Chunking is presented, an I/O-efficient sparsification strategy that operates on chunks and couples neuron importance with storage access cost and improves I/O efficiency by up to 4.65x and 5.76x on Jetson Orin Nano and Jetson AGX Orin, respectively.

2511.18701.tldr: ObjectAlign is introduced, a novel framework that seamlessly blends perceptual metrics with symbolic reasoning to detect, verify, and correct object-level and temporal inconsistencies in edited video sequences, and proposes learnable thresholds for metrics characterizing object consistency.

2511.18711.tldr: A novel framework of Modality-Collaborative LowRank Decomposers (MC-LRD) is introduced to decompose modality-unique and modality-shared features with different domain shift levels from each modality that are more friendly for domain alignment.

2511.18714.tldr: MAGMA-Edu, a self-reflective multi-agent framework that unifies textual reasoning and diagrammatic synthesis for structured educational problem generation, is introduced, establishing a new state of the art for multimodal educational content generation and demonstrating the effectiveness of self-reflective multi-agent collaboration in pedagogically aligned vision-language reasoning.

2511.18739.tldr: A problem-oriented framework that reinterprets existing metrics based on the specific evaluation challenges they are designed to address, rather than their mathematical forms or output structures is introduced, revealing that metric suitability must be inherently task-dependent and aligned with the operational objectives of IoT applications.

2511.18743.tldr: RhinoInsight is introduced, a deep research framework that adds two control mechanisms to enhance robustness, traceability, and overall quality without parameter updates to sustain sustained reasoning and decision-making for deep research.

2511.18746.tldr: This framework leverages the spatiotemporal vision priors in video models and the semantic awareness of VLMs to bridge the gap between fine-grained physical interaction and high-level reasoning, paving the way toward scalable, interpretable, and general-purpose embodied intelligence.

2511.18760.tldr: Her Hermes is introduced, the first tool-assisted agent that explicitly interleaves informal reasoning with formally verified proof steps in Lean, and reliably improves the reasoning accuracy of base models while substantially reducing token usage and computational cost compared to reward-based approaches.

2511.18766.tldr: ViewSense-AD is introduced, a novel framework that learns viewpoint-invariant representations by explicitly modeling geometric consistency across views, significantly outperforming existing methods in pixel, view, and sample-level visual anomaly detection and proving its robustness to large viewpoint shifts and complex textures.

2511.18772.tldr: This paper proposes ADALOC, to endow key-based model usage control with adaptability during model evolution, and strategically selects a subset of weights as an intrinsic access key, which enables all model updates to be confined to this key throughout the evolution lifecycle.

2511.18775.tldr: The proposed Re-CatVTON significantly improves performance compared to its predecessor (CatVTON) and requires less computation and memory than the high-performance Dual UNet model, Leffa.

2511.18781.tldr: A novel dual-stream streamline classification framework that jointly analyzes dMRI and functional MRI (fMRI) data to enhance the functional coherence of tract parcellation is introduced.

2511.18811.tldr: Extensive experiments show that ADC consistently improves existing HOI detectors, particularly enhancing rare category detection while preserving overall performance, confirming the effectiveness of ADC as a training-free, plug-and-play solution for long-tail bias mitigation.

2511.18834.tldr: This work identifies that Piecewised ReFlow's performance is hampered by a critical distribution mismatch during the training and proposes Online Trajectory Alignment (OTA) to resolve it and introduces a adversarial distillation objective applied directly on the ODE trajectory, improving the student's adherence to the teacher's generation trajectory.

2511.18840.tldr: A novel multi-agent framework designed to automate slide adaptation based on high-level instructor specifications is introduced, heralding a new paradigm where AI agents handle the logistical burdens of instructional design, liberating educators to focus on the creative and strategic aspects of teaching.

2511.18841.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that combining content-style disentanglement with attention-driven prototype aggregation improves personalization and robustness in heterogeneous environments without increasing communication cost.

2511.18846.tldr: WaveTuner is proposed, a Wavelet decomposition framework empowered by full-spectrum subband Tuning for time series forecasting that comprehensively tunes global trends and local variations within a unified time-frequency framework.

2511.18847.tldr: A novel personalized federated approach for organ agnostic tumor segmentation (FedOAP), that utilizes cross-attention to model long-range dependencies among the shared features of different clients and a boundary-aware loss to improve segmentation consistency is introduced.

2511.18854.tldr: A novel framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) into the Git bisect process for semantic fault localization, and adopts a weak-supervision workflow to reduce annotation overhead, incorporating human-in-the-loop corrections and self-consistency filtering.

2511.18860.tldr: Experimental results show that RCEG significantly improves the relevance and cognitive appropriateness of the generated exercises, and comprehensive evaluation metrics are used to analyze the experimental results.

2511.18874.tldr: GContextFormer, a plug-and-play encoder-decoder architecture with global context-aware hybrid attention and scaled additive aggregation achieving intention-aligned multimodal prediction without map reliance, is proposed.

2511.18878.tldr: It is demonstrated that EEG-based reinforcement learning can scale beyond locomotion tasks and provide a viable pathway for human-aligned manipulation skill acquisition and leave-one subject-out evaluations confirm that the proposed framework remains robust despite the intrinsic inter-individual variability in EEG decodability.

2511.18889.tldr: CoreEval is proposed, a robust data reflection mechanism employed to iteratively verify and refine labels, ensuring consistency between the updated and original datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating performance overestimation caused by data contamination.

2511.18890.tldr: This work aims to identify the key determinants of SLMs'real-device latency and offer generalizable principles and methodologies for SLM design and training when real-device latency is the primary consideration, and introduces a new family of hybrid SLMs, called Nemotron-Flash, which significantly advances the accuracy-efficiency frontier of state-of-the-art SLMs.

2511.18902.tldr: The proposed VADE framework integrates three key components: online sample-level difficulty estimation using Beta distributions, a Thompson sampler that maximizes information gain through the estimated correctness probability, and a two-scale prior decay mechanism that maintains robust estimation under policy evolution.

2511.18903.tldr: It is found that while curriculum-based training substantially outperforms random shuffling when using a constant LR, its advantage diminishes under standard LR decay schedules, and this incompatibility between the ascending data quality order and the decaying learning rate (LR) schedule can be mitigated.

2511.18919.tldr: Bayesian Prior-Guided Optimization (BPGO) is introduced, a novel extension of GRPO that explicitly models reward uncertainty through a semantic prior anchor and delivers consistently stronger semantic alignment, enhanced perceptual fidelity, and faster convergence than standard GRPO and recent variants.

2511.18924.tldr: DRIVEBENCH, an executable corpus of kernel$\rightarrow$driver co-evolution cases, and AUTODRIVER, a closed-loop, LLM-driven system for automating driver maintenance are introduced.

2511.18926.tldr: A definition of ECDs with formal descriptions is proposed and the first ECD evaluation benchmark - MoodBench 1.0 is designed and implemented, demonstrating that MoodBench 1.0 has excellent discriminant validity and can effectively quantify the differences in emotional companionship abilities among models.

2511.18930.tldr: The Monte Carlo-type Neural Operator is introduced, a lightweight architecture for learning solution operators for parametric PDEs by directly approximating the kernel integral using a Monte Carlo approach, providing a simple and practical alternative to spectral and graph-based neural operators.

2511.18931.tldr: Overall, built-in web search meaningfully improves factual accuracy and can be invoked selectively, yet models remain overconfident, skip retrieval when it is essential, and falter once initial search queries underperform.

2511.18933.tldr: Overall, this study highlights how jailbreaks pose a significant security threat to LLMs and identifies key intervention points for prevention, while noting that defense strategies often involve trade-offs between safety, performance, and scalability.

2511.18934.tldr: This paper formally defines the Text-to-Query task paradigm, unifying semantic parsing tasks across various query languages, and identifies query skeletons as a shared optimization target of Text-to-Query tasks, and proposes a general dynamic data augmentation framework that explicitly diagnoses model-specific weaknesses in handling these skeletons to synthesize targeted training data.

2511.18936.tldr: This work introduces SWAN, a novel, fine-tuning-free framework that eliminates significant computational overhead from explicit decompression steps, and uses an offline orthogonal matrix to rotate and prune the KV-cache, which is then used directly in the attention computation without any reconstruction.

2511.18955.tldr: This work builds on recent theory recasting EFE minimization as variational inference as variational inference, formally unifying it with Planning-as-Inference and showing the epistemic drive as a unique entropic contribution.

2511.18964.tldr: This work proposes Vision-Language Programs (VLP), which combine the perceptual flexibility of VLMs with systematic reasoning of program synthesis, and leverages the model to produce structured visual descriptions that are compiled into neuro-symbolic programs.

2511.18966.tldr: This work categorized known vulnerabilities using the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and mapped them to CVEs to study their criticality, and highlighted the need for developers to be cautious when using LLM-generated code.

2511.18977.tldr: This work proposes FastForward Pruning, a decoupled, single-step RL framework that separates policy optimization from the complex budget satisfaction problem and achieves competitive or superior results at a fraction of the computational cost, demonstrating a clear advantage in search efficiency.

2511.18980.tldr: This work presents MOCLIP (Metasurface Optics Contrastive Learning Pretrained), a nanophotonic foundation model that integrates metasurface geometry and spectra within a shared latent space to position MOCLIP as a scalable and versatile platform for next-generation photonic design and data-driven applications.

2511.18987.tldr: This paper aims to evaluate a DynamicMoE approach for continual and reinforcement learning environments and benchmark its effectiveness against existing network expansion methods.

2511.18989.tldr: This study investigates whether attention-based architectures and zero-shot learning approaches can bridge the gap between curated academic datasets and real-world agricultural conditions in plant disease classification, and evaluates three model categories: Convolutional Neural Networks, Vision Transformers, and Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training-based zero-shot models.

2511.18992.tldr: An algorithm combining simultaneously and non-sequentially the two tasks --Data embedding and Clustering-- relying on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and CEM is proposed relying on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and CEM.

2511.18999.tldr: The study shows the efficacy of transformers on retaining valuable information between detectors when doing fine-tuning from one configurations to another and leverages the strengths of transformers by incorporating attention masks inspired by the physics and detector design.

2511.19005.tldr: VRSLU is introduced, a novel SLU dataset that integrates both Visual images and explicit Reasoning and an instructional template, LR-Instruct, which first predicts labels and then generates corresponding reasoning, which helps mitigate the influence of reasoning bias on label prediction.

2511.19023.tldr: OrdMoE is proposed, a novel preference alignment framework that bypasses the reliance on external human preferences entirely by leveraging intrinsic signals within Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to achieve competitive results without requiring any human-annotated preference data.

2511.19024.tldr: The contributions of shallow and deep features to BIQA are investigated, and a effective quality feature decoding framework via GCN-enhanced layer interaction module and MoE-based feature decoupling module is proposed to decouple fused representations though different experts specialized for specific distortion types or quality dimensions.

2511.19046.tldr: The MedSAM-3 Agent is introduced, a framework that integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to perform complex reasoning and iterative refinement in an agent-in-the-loop workflow, and significantly outperforms existing specialist and foundation models.

2511.19055.tldr: An integrated approach that jointly optimizes investment decisions and charging assignments while accounting for spatial-temporal demand dynamics and their interdependencies is proposed, demonstrating a 30% reduction in total cost compared to a baseline without EV assignment.

2511.19065.tldr: An effective training scheme is designed that accelerates the formation of instantaneous velocity, then shifts emphasis from short- to long-interval average velocity, which yields faster convergence and significantly better few-step generation.

2511.19066.tldr: This work provides a theoretical analysis that maps AFL design choices to their resulting error sources when heterogeneity amplification occurs and proposes ACE (All-Client Engagement AFL), which mitigates participation imbalance through immediate, non-buffered updates that use the latest information available from all clients.

2511.19078.tldr: Experiments on various question-answering (QA) datasets demonstrate that the proposed GraphMind method achieves consistent performance improvements and significantly outperforms existing baselines in multi-step reasoning, validating the effectiveness and generalizability of the approach.

2511.19087.tldr: This work introduces kinetic path energy (KPE), a simple yet powerful diagnostic that quantifies the total kinetic effort along each generation path of ODE-based samplers, and suggests that trajectory-level analysis offers a physics-inspired and interpretable framework for understanding generation difficulty and sample characteristics.

2511.19100.tldr: This work develops a polynomial-time robustness checker for DRAs with a fixed number of registers, and combines it with passive and active automata learning algorithms that yields surrogate DRAs with statistical robustness and equivalence guarantees.

2511.19107.tldr: This is the first impossibility result showing that the core can be empty in non-centroid clustering under the max-loss objective, and identifies a two-dimensional Euclidean point set whose associated lower bound is slightly smaller than that of the general construction.

2511.19115.tldr: It is explained that while intelligence is a direct predictor of an AI system's existential threat, consciousness is not, and recognition of these distinctions can help AI safety researchers and public policymakers focus on the most pressing issues.

2511.19120.tldr: This work introduces an information-theoretic framework for discrete object naming systems, and uses it to prove that an optimal trade-off is achievable if and only if the listener's decoder is equivalent to the Bayesian decoder of the speaker.

2511.19149.tldr: The retrieval-augmented approach exhibits better factual grounding, less hallucination, and great potential for scalable deployment in various clothing domains, and the use of retrieval-augmented generation as an effective and interpretable paradigm for automated and visually grounded fashion content generation.

2511.19175.tldr: An unbiased, risk-aware framework for agentic negotiation, designed to ensure robust resource allocation in 6G network slicing, and successfully mitigates this bias, eliminating SLA violations and reducing the URLLC and eMBB p99.999 latencies by around 11%.

2511.19184.tldr: A Torsion-Space Diffusion Model that generates protein backbones by denoising torsion angles, ensuring perfect local geometry by construction and providing a promising path toward full-atom protein generation is proposed.

2511.19199.tldr: CLASH is introduced, a novel benchmark for multimodal contradiction detection, featuring COCO images paired with contradictory captions containing controlled object-level or attribute-level contradictions, and it is empirically demonstrate that targeted fine-tuning on CLASH substantially enhances conflict detection capabilities.

2511.19236.tldr: This paper presents SENTINEL, a fully end-to-end language-action model for humanoid whole-body control, which exhibits strong semantic understanding and stable execution on humanoid robots in both simulation and real-world deployment.

2511.19241.tldr: This work proposes local entropy search (LES), a Bayesian optimization paradigm that explicitly targets the solutions reachable by the descent sequences of iterative optimizers, and achieves strong sample efficiency compared to existing local and global Bayesian optimization methods.

2511.19246.tldr: This paper proposes a neural architecture search (NAS) framework that automates the design of quantum autoencoders using a genetic algorithm (GA) and lays a foundation for broader application of genetic algorithms to quantum architecture search, aiming for a robust, automated method that can adapt to varied data and hardware constraints.

2511.19254.tldr: This is the first study to investigate adversarial patch attacks for cargo-occupancy estimation in physically realistic, fully simulated 3D scenes using a convolutional cargo-occupancy classifier using fully simulated 3D environments.

2511.19256.tldr: SimDiff is a single-stage, end-to-end framework that significantly outperforms existing methods in time series point forecasting and achieves state-of-the-art point estimation performance by leveraging intrinsic output diversity and improving mean squared error accuracy through multiple inference ensembling.

2511.19257.tldr: This paper proposes Medusa, a novel framework for crafting cross-modal transferable adversarial attacks on MMed-RAG systems under a black-box setting, and formulates the attack as a perturbation optimization problem, leveraging a multi-positive InfoNCE loss to align adversarial visual embeddings with medically plausible but malicious textual targets, thereby hijacking the retrieval process.

2511.19262.tldr: A moduli-theoretic view of psychometric test batteries for AI agents is developed and the notion of a cognitive core of an agent relative to a battery is introduced and the associated AAI score is defined as the restriction of an AAI functional to that core.

2511.19263.tldr: Solar-GECO achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming several baselines, and reducing the mean absolute error for PCE prediction from 3.066 to 2.936 compared to semantic GNN (the previous state-of-the-art model).

2511.19264.tldr: This work presents an interpretability framework for SynFlowNet, a GFlowNet trained on documented chemical reactions and purchasable starting materials that generates both molecules and the synthetic routes that produce them that supports transparent and controllable molecular design.

2511.19275.tldr: The approach simulates multiple independently-moving birds per species along different moving 3D trajectories, supporting controllable chirp sequences, overlapping choruses, and realistic 3D motion in scalable soundscapes while preserving species-specific acoustic patterns.

2511.19283.tldr: Reflections are presented on how digital sites are using AI recommendation algorithms to recreate new digital societies in the region, how they have the potential to propagate algorithmic colonialism and negative gender norms, and what this means for the regional sustainable development agenda.

2511.19299.tldr: This work demonstrates that data exclusion might be circumvented by fine-tuning approaches that can, to some degree, rescue misuse-relevant capabilities of gLMs.

2511.19314.tldr: PRInTS, a generative PRM trained with dual capabilities, enhances information-seeking abilities of open-source models as well as specialized agents, matching or surpassing the performance of frontier models with a much smaller backbone agent and outperforming other strong reward modeling baselines.

2511.19316.tldr: A general threat model is established and a comprehensive evaluation framework encompassing Universality, Transmissibility, and Robustness is introduced encompassing Universality, Transmissibility, and Robustness to reveal vulnerabilities in existing watermark removal methods.

2511.19324.tldr: It is found that dense retrieval models trained specifically for CLIR consistently outperform lexical matching methods and derive little benefit from document translation, indicating that cross-lingual search systems should prioritise semantic multilingual embeddings and targeted learning-based alignment over translation-based pipelines, particularly for cross-script and under-resourced languages.

2511.19325.tldr: Results show that query length largely determines which prompting technique is effective, and that more elaborate prompts often do not yield further gains, which underline the need for more balanced multilingual and cross-lingual training and evaluation resources.

2511.19342.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach that integrates a computational tonal tension model, based on tonal interval vector analysis, into a Transformer framework and demonstrates that it effectively modulates tonal tension.

2511.19355.tldr: LEARN-Opt's demonstrated performance affirms its potential to generate high-quality reward functions without requiring any preliminary human-defined metrics, thereby reducing engineering overhead and enhancing generalizability.

2511.19367.tldr: This work establishes a transparent and reliable staging paradigm that bridges the gap between deep learning performance and clinical interpretability in lung cancer diagnosis and treatment planning.

2511.19390.tldr: This paper proposes a multiscale inference scheme for diffusion models, tailored to physical processes, and generates trajectories that are temporally fine-grained near the present and coarser as the authors move farther away, which enables capturing long-range temporal dependencies without increasing computational cost.

2511.19396.tldr: This work presents an embedded system that integrates deep learning–based tracking with beamforming to achieve precise sound source localization and directional audio capture in dynamic environments by uniting learned spatial awareness with dynamic steering.

2511.19401.tldr: Extensive experiments on three state-of-the-art generators show that video models can reliably interpret and execute visually embedded instructions, particularly in complex multi-object scenarios.

2511.19417.tldr: This work proposes BeMyEyes, a modular, multi-agent framework for extending LLMs to multimodal reasoning by orchestrating collaboration between efficient, adaptable VLMs as perceivers and powerful LLMs as reasoners through conversations, and demonstrates the effectiveness, modularity, and scalability of this multi-agent approach.

2511.19422.tldr: This work proposes SLMFix, a novel code generation pipeline that leverages a small language model (SLM) finetuned using reinforcement learning (RL) techniques to fix syntactic errors in LLM-generated programs to improve the quality of LLM-generated programs for domain-specific languages (DSLs).

2511.19423.tldr: The framework highlights how AI agents combining language models with domain-specific tools can bridge symbolic reasoning and numerical simulation, transforming LLMs from conversational assistants into partners for computational discovery.

2511.19427.tldr: This work introduces Semantic Engineering, a lightweight method for enriching program semantics so that LLM-based systems can more accurately reflect developer intent without requiring full manual prompt design, and presents Semantic Context Annotations, a language-level mechanism that allows developers to embed natural-language context directly into program constructs.

2511.19433.tldr: Mixture of horizons exploits long-term foresight and short-term precision jointly within a single model, improving both performance and generalizability to complex tasks and enables dynamic inference with adaptive horizons.

2511.19436.tldr: VDC-Agent is presented, a self-evolving framework for Video Detailed Captioning that requires neither human annotations nor larger teacher models, and attains state-of-the-art performance on the VDC benchmark with 49.08% average accuracy and 2.50 score.

2307.01449.tldr: Through comparative analyses, this framework shows its superiority over existing data fusion methods and the practical utility of the approach is exemplified by three real-world case studies, underscoring its potential for widespread application in empirical research.

2406.14909.tldr: Mixture of Attention Spans (MoA) is proposed, which automatically tailors distinct sliding-window length configurations to different heads and layers and narrows the performance gap with full attention.

2408.11515.tldr: Behavior-aware Expression Dissimilarity (BED), a principled framework for quantifying behavioral distance between mathematical expressions with free parameters, is introduced and shown to be consistent, robust, and capable of inducing a smoother, more meaningful structure over the space of expressions than syntax-based measures.

2409.12842.tldr: The results demonstrate the remarkable capability of VLMs in map parsing, with a success rate of 0.96 in tasks requiring a sequence of nine navigation actions, e.g., approaching and going through doors.

2412.04323.tldr: This work introduces a robust adaptation module that provides a mechanism for identifying and reacting to both in-distribution and out-of-distribution environment dynamics, along with a joint training pipeline that combines the goals of in-distribution adaptation and out-of-distribution robustness.

2412.14191.tldr: The proposed CyberRAG employs a two-step approach that augments the domain-specific knowledge by retrieving validated cybersecurity documents from a knowledge base to enhance the relevance and accuracy of the response, and mitigates hallucinations and misuse by integrating a knowledge graph ontology to validate the final answer.

2502.07154.tldr: It is shown, surprisingly, that training with cross-entropy (CE) loss can be misaligned with pass@N in that pass@N accuracy decreases with longer training, and a principled, modified training loss is suggested that is better aligned to pass@N by limiting model confidence and rescuing pass@N test performance.

2503.14048.tldr: Here it is demonstrated that the famous Perona-Malik algorithm for image processing is the gradient flow that maximizes the GfE action in its simple warm-up scenario and provides the geometrical and information theory foundations for the Perona-Malik algorithm.

2503.15815.tldr: Attention Pruning is introduced, a fairness-aware surrogate simulated annealing approach to prune attention heads in LLMs that disproportionately contribute to bias while minimally impacting overall model utility.

2504.08896.tldr: This position paper argues that moving beyond Euclidean geometry is not merely an optional enhancement but a necessity to maintain the scaling law for the next-generation of foundation models, and outlines a roadmap for integrating non-Euclidean geometries into foundation models.

2505.13344.tldr: RoPECraft is proposed, a training-free video motion transfer method for diffusion transformers that operates solely by modifying their rotary positional embeddings (RoPE), and outperforms all recently published methods, both qualitatively and quantitatively.

2505.16690.tldr: Disagreement-Aware Confidence Alignment (DACA), a novel unsupervised method to optimize the parameters (e.g., temperature $\tau$) in post-hoc confidence calibration, is proposed, motivated by the under-confidence issue caused by prediction disagreement between the PLM and PoLM while aligning their confidence via temperature scaling.

2505.17648.tldr: The results show that although the expectations simulated by LLM Agents are more homogeneous than those of humans, they consistently outperform LLMs relying simply on prompt engineering, and possess human-like mental mechanisms.

2505.19385.tldr: This work proposes a new method that focuses on sinogram inpainting that uses MR-SDEs, a variant of diffusion models that characterize the diffusion process with mean-reverting stochastic differential equations, to fill in missing angular data at the projection level.

2505.23575.tldr: A hybrid protocol that independently scores model reasoning and actions, and combines them using a weighted average consistently outperforms both CoT and action-only monitors across all tested models and tasks, with detection rates twice higher than action-only monitoring for subtle deception scenarios.

2506.05587.tldr: This work introduces MMTU, a large-scale benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate models ability to understand, reason, and manipulate real tables at the expert-level, and shows that MMTU require a combination of skills -- including table understanding, reasoning, and coding -- that remain challenging for today's frontier models.

2506.17967.tldr: Human studies across seven diverse environments confirm strong alignment with human judgments, establishing UNIVERSE as a lightweight, adaptable, and semantics-aware evaluator for video world model rollouts adapted under data and compute constraints.

2507.10007.tldr: This work provides a novel reliability improvement path for CoT reasoning with broad application potential by leveraging the model's intrinsic veracity encoding to calibrate the CoT reasoning accuracy by leveraging the model's intrinsic veracity encoding.

2508.08701.tldr: This work introduces a model repair module that builds on an interpretable failure attribution pipeline and uses a conditional text-to-image model to generate semantically faithful and targeted images for failure cases, and significantly reduces errors associated with rare cases.

2508.17681.tldr: This is a position paper that aims to stimulate discussion on how principled ablation tests could help distinguish models that reconstruct knowledge from those that merely retrieve it, and how such probes might guide the next generation of AI-for-Science benchmarks.

2510.02143.tldr: This paper investigates an underexplored measure for identifying high-impact research: authors'own rankings of their multiple submissions to the same AI conference and shows that self-rankings outperformed peer review scores in predicting future citation counts.

2510.03263.tldr: It is proposed that robustness in knowledge retrieval is a crucial yet underexplored evaluation measure for developing more robust and effective unlearning techniques and demonstrated that forgetting occurs in two distinct ways: short-term, where concepts can be quickly recalled, and long-term, where recovery is more challenging.

2510.13006.tldr: This work highlights the complementary roles of effectiveness research and implementation research, emphasizing hybrid study designs and the role of integrated KT, stakeholder engagement, and equity-focused co-creation in designing sustainable and generalizable solutions.

2510.19654.tldr: A new driving paradigm named Policy World Model is introduced, which not only integrates world modeling and trajectory planning within a unified architecture, but is also able to benefit planning using the learned world knowledge through the proposed action-free future state forecasting scheme.

2510.27606.tldr: Spatial-SSRL is introduced, a self-supervised RL paradigm that derives verifiable signals directly from ordinary RGB or RGB-D images and provides a practical route to stronger spatial intelligence in LVLMs.

2511.04500.tldr: This work develops a digital twin of game-theoretic experiments and introduces a systematic prompting and probing framework for machine-behavioral evaluation, demonstrating that appropriately calibrated LLMs can replicate aggregate human behavioral patterns and enable systematic exploration of unexplored experimental spaces.

2511.12937.tldr: This work proposes a novel data organization principle -- combination granularity -- to distinguish intra-sample fusion and inter-sample mixing of multimodal data (static images, multi-image sequences, and videos) and demonstrates that structured multimodal data organization significantly enhances VLM performance in embodied tasks.

2511.14198.tldr: DiverseClaire is introduced, which simulates students including neurodiverse profiles using LLMs and diverse personas and revealed that the simulated neurodiverse students struggled with learning due to lecture slides that were in inaccessible formats, highlighting the need to provide course materials in multiple formats for diverse learners.

2511.14977.tldr: SVBRD-LLM is proposed, a self-verifying behavioral rule discovery framework that automatically extracts interpretable behavioral rules from real-world traffic videos through zero-shot large language model (LLM) reasoning, and captures key AV traits in smoothness, conservatism, and lane discipline, informing safety assessment, regulatory compliance, and traffic management in mixed traffic.

2511.15076.tldr: Comprehensive benchmarking shows that GIN provides device-initiated communication within NCCL's unified runtime, combining low-latency operations with NCCL's collective algorithms and production infrastructure.

2511.15097.tldr: This work proposes an artifact-centric AI agent paradigm where behavior is driven by persistent, verifiable data artifacts rather than ephemeral tasks, solving the trustworthiness problem at the data architecture level.

2511.16839.tldr: A first ablation study with systematic design choices for input tokenization, model configuration and temporal data preprocessing for EHR-based input patient sequence, architectural model configurations, and temporal preprocessing techniques for data collection is presented.

2511.17532.tldr: ZoomDiff is proposed, a diffusion-based model for multi-scale mobile traffic generation that demonstrates strong efficiency and cross-city generalization, highlighting its potential as a powerful generative framework for modeling multi-scale mobile network dynamics.

2511.18085.tldr: Stellar VLA enables self-supervised knowledge evolution through joint learning of task latent representation and the knowledge space, reducing annotation needs, and knowledge-guided expert routing provide task specialization without extra network parameters, lowering training overhead.

2511.19457.tldr: This work presents SparOA, a CPU-GPU hybrid inference framework, which leverages both sparsity and computational intensity to optimize operator scheduling and achieves optimal energy-per-inference, consuming 7\%-16\% less energy than the SOTA co-execution baseline.

2511.19458.tldr: PIGReward is presented, a personalized reward model that dynamically generates user-conditioned evaluation dimensions and assesses images through CoT reasoning, establishing a scalable and reasoning-based foundation for personalized T2I evaluation and optimization.

2511.19460.tldr: This paper presents a backbone model of a smart grid to test alternative scenarios for the grid, and simulates disparate systems to validate assumptions before the human scale model.

2511.19464.tldr: This work evaluated 21 models ranging from 1B to 20B parameters, varying the temperature hyperparameter and measuring execution time and precision across two distinct architectures, finding that temperature has little influence on performance, whereas the number of parameters and GPU capacity are decisive factors.

2511.19465.tldr: A method to understand and to learn tourists' movements based on social network data analysis to predict future movements is proposed and a hidden Markov model representing the movements of a group of tourists is produced.

2511.19466.tldr: A Stability-Guided Online Influence Framework (SG-OIF), the first framework that treats algorithmic stability as a real-time controller, which maintains lightweight anchor IHVPs via stochastic Richardson and preconditioned Neumann and proposes modular curvature backends to modulate per-example influence scores using stability-guided residual thresholds, anomaly gating, and confidence.

2511.19470.tldr: This work proposes a framework based on Partial Information Decomposition (PID) that quantifies modality contributions by decomposing predictive information in internal embeddings into unique, redundant, and synergistic components and develops an algorithm based on the Iterative Proportional Fitting Procedure that computes layer and dataset-level contributions without retraining.

2511.19471.tldr: A compositional alternative to foundation segmentation models where the foundation model output is treated as an additional input channel and passed alongside the MRI to highlight regions of interest to study inflammation linked changes in sudden onset pediatric OCD.

2511.19475.tldr: A universal tracking and segmentation framework named SATA is proposed, which unifies a broad spectrum of tracking and segmentation subtasks with any modality input and introduces a Task-aware Multi-object Tracking (TaMOT) pipeline to unify all the task outputs as a unified set of instances with calibrated ID information, thereby alleviating the degradation of task-specific knowledge during multi-task training.

2511.19480.tldr: By positioning expert pruning as both a threat vector and a defense target, this work highlights the dual-use nature of MoE modularity and provides the first systematic evaluation framework for secure specialization of MoE-LLMs.

2511.19483.tldr: This paper proposes Z-Space, a data-generation-oriented multi-agent collaborative tool invocation framework Z-Space, which has been deployed in the Eleme platform's technical division, serving large-scale test data generation scenarios across multiple business units including Taotian, Gaode, and Hema.

2511.19488.tldr: A large LLM-generated persuasion attack dataset is introduced, which includes 134,136 attacks generated by GPT-4, Gemma 2, and Llama 3.1 on agency news, and the moral resonance of these persuasion attacks is analyzed to understand their attack vectors.

2511.19489.tldr: MADE (Multi-Agent Decomposed Evolution), a framework that tames the inherent noise of subjective evaluation through"Problem Specification," validates a fundamental paradigm shift: moving from optimizing"computable metrics" to"describable qualities,"thereby unlocking evolutionary optimization for the vast open-ended domains where no ground truth exists.

2511.19490.tldr: The proposed generative adversarial network (GAN)-based learning approach for CSI feedback preserves knowledge from past environments and ensures consistently high performance across diverse scenarios without forgetting, and enhances the generalization capability of the DAE framework while maintaining low memory overhead.

2511.19492.tldr: A model of time horizon as a function of training compute and algorithms, along with a model of how compute investment spills into algorithmic progress, derives that time horizon growth must be proportional to compute growth.

2511.19495.tldr: This study systematically examines how dominant compression techniques, knowledge distillation, structured pruning, and low-bit quantization perform both independently and in combination when applied to the Qwen2.5 3B model, offering practical insight into designing effective, ordering-aware compression pipelines for deploying LLMs in resource-limited settings.

2511.19496.tldr: This work presents Xmodel-2.5, a 1.3-billion-parameter small language model designed as a drop-in agent core that can be paired with late Muon sharpening for better downstream performance, and proves that early AdamW stability can be paired with late Muon sharpening for better downstream performance.

2511.19497.tldr: This paper redesigns the entire architecture of the vanilla Transformer and proposes a period diffuser for precise multi-period prediction and introduces an iterative grouping mechanism which can directly reduce the cross-variable redundancy.

2511.19499.tldr: This work provides a theoretical analysis explaining how the distinct optimization objectives of the GAN and DM architectures lead to different manifold coverage behaviors, and proposes the TriDetect, a semi-supervised approach that enhances binary classification by discovering latent architectural patterns within the fake class.

2511.19500.tldr: A dual-pronged machine learning framework for OPV discovery, integrating predictive modeling and generative molecular design is introduced, and a reinforcement learning strategy with three-objective policy optimization that guides molecular generation while preserving chemical validity is proposed.

2511.19518.tldr: InformationPrune is proposed, an information-theoretic framework for adaptive structural compression of VLMs and designs two complementary schemes: a training-based head pruning guided by the proposed information loss objective, and a training-free FFN compression via adaptive low-rank approximation.

2511.19528.tldr: This work proposes Discover, Lea rn and Reinforce (DLR), an information-theoretic pattern discovery framework that generates multiple distinct, high-success behavioral patterns for VLA pretraining and positions multi-pattern RL as a practical, scalable data engine for embodied foundation models.

2511.19536.tldr: AttackPilot is proposed, an autonomous agent capable of independently conducting inference attacks without human intervention that could empower non-expert ML service providers, auditors, or regulators to systematically assess the risks of ML services without requiring deep domain expertise.

2511.19537.tldr: This study investigates the cross-domain generalization of a multimodal large language model (LLM) for global PV assessment and highlights the robustness of multimodal LLMs under domain shift and their potential for scalable, transferable, and interpretable global PV mapping.

2511.19550.tldr: This paper proposes a novel semiotic framework for analyzing Large Language Models, conceptualizing them as stochastic semiotic engines whose outputs demand active, asymmetric human interpretation, and introduces a generative complexity parameter (lambda) that governs this trade-off.

2511.19555.tldr: A novel Online Differential Evolution for Sparse Feature Selection (ODESFS) in data streams is introduced, incorporating two key innovations: missing value imputation using a latent factor analysis model, and feature importance evaluation through differential evolution.

2511.19557.tldr: ThiFAN-VQA is proposed, a two-stage reasoning-based framework for visual question answering (VQA) in disaster scenarios that bridges the gap between zero-shot and supervised methods, combining flexibility with consistency.

2511.19558.tldr: This work introduces the SPQR benchmark (Safety-Prompt adherence-Quality-Robustness), a single-scored metric that provides a standardized and reproducible framework to evaluate how well safety-aligned diffusion models preserve safety, utility, and robustness under benign fine-tuning.

2511.19561.tldr: This paper proposes OTMF (Optimal Transport-based Masked Fusion), a novel model merging framework rooted in optimal transport theory to address the distribution shift that arises from naive parameter interpolation and achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of both accuracy and efficiency.

2511.19562.tldr: This work introduces TSLEC (Trust-Based Social Learning with Emergent Communication), a framework where agents explicitly teach successful strategies to peers, with knowledge transfer modulated by learned trust relationships, establishing that explicit social learning fundamentally accelerates emergent communication in multi-agent coordination.

2511.19580.tldr: This chapter presents a conceptualisation of five levels of teacher-AI teaming: transactional, situational, operational, praxical and synergistic teaming to capture the nuanced dynamics of teacher-AI interactions that may lead to the replacement, complementarity, or augmentation of teachers'competences and professional practice.

2511.19636.tldr: Rashomon Concept Bottleneck Models is introduced, a framework that learns multiple neural networks which are all accurate yet reason through distinct human-understandable concepts, offering a new mechanism for auditing, comparison, and alignment across equally accurate solutions.

2511.19641.tldr: A semantic distribution-guided reconstruction framework that uses a pre-trained vision-language foundation model to encode both the reconstructed image and auxiliary information into high-level semantic features, highlighting that vision-language foundation models can improve undersampled MRI reconstruction through semantic-space optimization.

2511.19644.tldr: A modular and agent-driven approach to cyber defense that emphasizes explainability, system-state awareness, and operational control in intrusion response is outlined, designed to deliver autonomous and policy-compliant cyber defense.

2511.19647.tldr: The Robot-Powered Data Flywheel is introduced, a framework that transforms robots from FM consumers into data generators and enables a virtuous cycle: robots perform useful tasks while collecting real-world data that improves both domain-specific adaptation and domain-adjacent generalization.

2511.19648.tldr: The results show that verifiable multi-hop reasoning does not require massive models at inference time, but rather the right architectural inductive biases combining symbolic structure with learned representations, and structured planning proving more transferable than direct answer generation.

2511.19649.tldr: This paper proposes MalSynGen, a Malware Synthetic Data Generation methodology that uses a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) to generate synthetic tabular data that preserves the statistical properties of real-world data and improves the performance of Android malware classifiers.

2511.19654.tldr: Findings demonstrate that LoRA offers a practical balance of interpretability and resource efficiency, enabling deployment in resource-constrained environments without sacrificing explanation quality, and enhances transparency, analyst confidence, and operational scalability in malware detection systems.

2511.19663.tldr: FaraGen, a novel synthetic data generation system for multi-step web tasks, and Fara-7B, a native CUA model that perceives the computer using only screenshots, executes actions via predicted coordinates, and is small enough to run on-device, are introduced.

2511.19669.tldr: This work proposes HeaRT, a foundational reasoning engine for automation loops and a first step toward intelligent, adaptive, human-style design optimization.

2511.19671.tldr: This work proposes FISCAL (Financial Synthetic Claim-Document Augmented Learning), a modular framework for generating synthetic data tailored to financial fact-checking and uses it to train MiniCheck-FISCAL, a lightweight verifier for numerical financial claims.

2511.19684.tldr: IndEgo is introduced, a multimodal egocentric and exocentric dataset addressing common industrial tasks, including assembly/disassembly, logistics and organisation, inspection and repair, woodworking, and others, where two workers jointly perform cognitively and physically intensive tasks.

2511.19703.tldr: This work studies neurovarieties for polynomial neural networks and fully characterize when they attain the expected dimension in the single-output case, establishing non-defectiveness and global identifiability for multi-output architectures.

2511.19711.tldr: CrypTorch is a compiler for MPC-based ML that disentangles these approximations with the rest of the MPC runtime, allows easily adding new approximations through its programming interface, and automatically selects approximations to maximize both performance and accuracy.

2511.19726.tldr: A general adaptive multi-agent learning framework that integrates four dynamic regimes distinguishing static versus adaptive agents and fixed versus adaptive system parameters is introduced, enabling systematic comparison of stability, performance, and interpretability across non-equilibrium, oscillatory, or drifting dynamics.

2511.19751.tldr: This work introduces PathFMTools, a lightweight, extensible Python package that enables efficient execution, analysis, and visualization of pathology foundation models, and evaluates two state-of-the-art vision-language foundation models, CONCH and MUSK, on the task of histological grading in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.

2511.19768.tldr: This paper proposes Prune-Then-Plan, a simple and effective framework that stabilizes exploration through step-level calibration of large vision-language models (VLMs) and achieves better scene coverage under equal exploration budgets on both OpenEQA and EXPRESS-Bench datasets.

2511.19773.tldr: VQA benchmarks show that VISTA-R1-8B outperforms state-of-the-art baselines with similar sizes by 9.51%-18.72%, demonstrating VISTA-Gym as an effective training ground to unlock the tool-integrated reasoning capabilities for VLMs.

2511.19780.tldr: This work introduces a neuro-symbolic framework for multi-intent understanding in mobile AI agents by integrating a structured intent ontology with compact language models and formalizes a new evaluation metric-Semantic Intent Similarity (SIS) based on hierarchical ontology depth.

2511.19798.tldr: KOM, a multi-agent system designed to automate KOA evaluation, risk prediction, and treatment prescription, has the potential to enhance care efficiency and may also offer valuable insights for developing AI-assisted management systems for other chronic conditions.

2511.19808.tldr: This paper introduces a novel framework that conceptualizes noisy label correction as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem, and defines a comprehensive state space representing data and their associated labels, an action space that indicates possible label corrections, and a reward mechanism that evaluates the efficacy of label corrections.

2511.19818.tldr: This work builds several large pre-trained language model based classifiers for depression detection from social media posts and shows that transformer ensembles improve over the single transformer-based classifiers.

2511.19820.tldr: This work introduces CropVLM as an external low-cost method for boosting performance, enabling VLMs to dynamically zoom in on relevant image regions, enhancing their ability to capture fine details.

2511.19822.tldr: The proposed Mosaic Pruning ensures that the pruned model retains a functionally complementary set of experts, much like the tiles of a mosaic that together form a complete picture of the original model's capabilities, enabling it to handle diverse downstream tasks.

2511.19829.tldr: This work establishes a performance-oriented, systematic, and comprehensive prompt evaluation framework, and develops and finetune an execution-free evaluator that predicts multi-dimensional quality scores directly from text, and demonstrates that the evaluation-instructed optimization pipeline delivers stable, interpretable, and model-agnostic improvements across diverse tasks.

2511.19830.tldr: Nirvana is presented, a multi-modal data analytics framework that incorporates programmable semantic operators while leveraging both logical and physical query optimization strategies, tailored for LLM-driven semantic query processing.

2511.19835.tldr: This paper revisits attention sparsity and proposes Rectified SpaAttn, which rectifies attention allocation with implicit full attention reference, thereby enhancing the alignment between sparse and full attention maps and proposes Gain-Aware Pooling Rectification, which ensures that the rectified gain consistently surpasses the induced error.

2511.19837.tldr: This work proposes GCGSim, a GED-consistent graph similarity learning framework centering on graph-level matching and substructure-level edit costs and demonstrates that the framework effectively learns disentangled and semantically meaningful substructure representations.

2511.19841.tldr: Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that the Cisco Time Series Model achieves superior performance on observability datasets while retaining very similar performance on a standard general-purpose forecasting benchmark (GIFT-Eval), and suggest that the multiresolution structure enables the model to make more accurate predictions on long context input.

2511.19849.tldr: This work develops a model-based RL algorithm based on linear programming, which in the limit produces a policy maximising the probability of satisfying an $\omega$-regular objective while also adhering to $\omega$-regular constraints within specified thresholds.

2511.19864.tldr: This paper introduces MicroSims a novel framework for creating lightweight, interactive educational simulations that can be rapidly generated using artificial intelligence, universally embedded across digital learning platforms, and easily customized without programming knowledge.

2511.19865.tldr: A collaborative Conversational Embodied Intelligence Network (CC-EIN) integrating multimodal feature fusion, adaptive semantic communication, task coordination, and interpretability is proposed integrating multimodal feature fusion, adaptive semantic communication, task coordination, and interpretability.

2511.19874.tldr: This work presents the first systematic study of cross-LLM behavioral backdoor detection, evaluating generalization across six production LLMs and shows that model-aware detection incorporating model identity as an additional feature achieves 90.6% accuracy universally across all evaluated models.

2511.19875.tldr: CODEFUSE-COMMITEVAL is introduced, the first benchmark designed for MCI detection using large language models (LLMs) and shows models detect inconsistent commits more reliably than consistent ones, highlighting the need for richer context and balanced data to capture high-level semantic gaps.

2310.15074.tldr: Multigranularity DAS (MG-DARTS), a unified framework that aims to discover both effective and efficient architectures from scratch by comprehensively yet memory-efficiently exploring a multigranularity search space, is proposed.

2402.04032.tldr: ProactivePIM is presented, a PIM system tailored for weight-sharing algorithms, a family of compression methods that decompose an embedding table into compact subtables, such as QR-trick and TT-Rec, and finds that these algorithms exhibit unique data locality characteristics, which are named intra-GnR locality.

2403.15511.tldr: A novel neural network architecture called MIAE, which consists of multiple sub-encoders that can process inputs from different sources with different characteristics, and a feature selection layer right after the representation layer of MIAE resulting in a new model called MIAEFS, which shows superior performance on three IDS datasets.

2406.12841.tldr: An in-depth taxonomy and a blueprint for HOGNNs are designed that help to select the most beneficial GNN model in a given scenario, and a comprehensive list of challenges and opportunities for further research into more powerful HOGNNs are presented.

2409.14993.tldr: A comprehensive overview of multi-modal generative AI, including multi-modal LLMs, diffusions, and the unification for understanding and generation is provided, including key designs including autoregressive-based and diffusion-based modeling, as well as dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures.

2410.05130.tldr: GraphAgent-Reasoner is introduced, a fine-tuning-free framework that utilizes a multi-agent collaboration strategy for explicit and precise graph reasoning and demonstrates near-perfect accuracy on polynomial-time graph reasoning tasks, significantly outperforming the best available models.

2410.13334.tldr: It is emphasized that ethical biases in LLMs can actually lead to generating unsafe output, and a method to make the LLMs more secure and unbiased is suggested, which is open-sourceed.

2410.15236.tldr: The need for continued research and cooperation within the AI community to enhance LLM security and ensure their safe deployment is emphasized, with future directions for resilient alignment strategies, advanced defenses against evolving attacks, automation of jailbreak detection, and consideration of ethical and societal impacts suggested.

2411.08706.tldr: This work proposes the Latent Program Network (LPN), a novel architecture that builds in test-time search directly into neural models and learns a latent space of implicit programs through which it can search using gradients at test time.

2411.10979.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation of 33 open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a significant performance gap between human and model capabilities, highlighting the limitations of current MLLMs in understanding complex, compiled video compositions and offers insights into areas for further improvement.

2412.03068.tldr: A novel time series generalization diffusion model (TimeControl) that pioneers the Domain-Fusion paradigm, systematically integrating information from multiple time series domains into a unified generative process via diffusion models.

2412.05718.tldr: This work uses a pretrained RL agent trained using only unlabeled, offline interactions--without task-specific supervision or labeled trajectories--to get zero-shot test-time policy inference from arbitrary natural language instructions, and is the first approach to show direct language-to-behavior generation abilities on a variety of tasks and environments without any in-domain supervision.

2412.18428.tldr: Experimental results on M$^2$EX demonstrate that the system outperforms state-of-the-art multi-modal exploration systems, excelling in both accuracy and various performance metrics, including query latency, API costs, and planning efficiency, thanks to the more effective utilization of the reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

2501.06250.tldr: This survey explores how GenAI integration is revolutionizing traditional animation workflows by lowering technical barriers, broadening accessibility for a wider range of creators through tools like AniDoc, ToonCrafter, and AniSora, and enabling artists to focus more on creative expression and artistic innovation.

2501.11357.tldr: This work proves that the box-counting dimension of the pullback attractor is bounded above by the box-counting dimension of the space of input sequences with respect to the product topology, highlighting the fact that, while a reservoir computer may possess a very high-dimensional state space, it exhibits effective low-dimensional dynamics.

2501.17690.tldr: The effectiveness of the GRN framework in optimizing segmentation performance with significantly less labeled data is suggested, offering a scalable and efficient solution for ultrasound image analysis and reducing the burdens associated with data annotation.

2503.14421.tldr: The results show that text and click supervision are both required to develop robust explainable models for deepfake videos, which are able to localize and describe the observed artifacts.

2504.09775.tldr: MIST empowers system designers to navigate the evolving landscape of LLM inference, providing actionable insights into optimizing hardware-software co-design for next-generation AI workloads.

2504.14209.tldr: Pets is proposed, a novel one-model many-tasks architecture based on the General fluctuation Pattern Assisted (GPA) framework that is adaptable to versatile model structures for time series analysis and achieves state-of-the-art performance across 60 benchmarks on various tasks.

2505.09341.tldr: This work proposes a conceptual framework based on access controls where only verified users can access dual-use outputs, and takes the first step toward giving model providers more granular tools for managing dual-use content.

2505.21740.tldr: It is found that while LLM explanations do enable users to better predict LLM outputs on counterfactuals in the summarization setting, there is significant room for improvement for medical suggestion.

2505.24298.tldr: To stabilize RL training, AReaL balances the workload of rollout and training workers to control data staleness, and adopts a staleness-enhanced PPO variant to better handle outdated training samples.

2506.04704.tldr: A holistic safety dataset and benchmark that spans all five safe/unsafe image-text combinations, providing a more robust basis for both training and evaluation (HoliSafe-Bench), and a novel modular framework for enhancing VLM safety with a visual guard module (VGM) designed to assess the harmfulness of input images for VLMs.

2506.06836.tldr: VLM4TS consistently outperforms existing language model-based TSAD methods and is on average 36x more efficient in token usage, and shows that without any time-series training, VLM4TS outperforms time-series pre-trained and from-scratch baselines in most cases.

2506.18165.tldr: This work proposes the Non-Equilibrium Annealed Adjoint Sampler (NAAS), a novel SOC-based diffusion framework that employs annealed reference dynamics as a non-stationary base SDE and can incorporate a variety of SOC solvers, thereby offering high flexibility in algorithmic design.

2507.04903.tldr: BackFed is introduced, a benchmark designed to standardize and stress-test FL backdoor evaluation by unifying attacks and defenses under a common evaluation framework that mirrors realistic FL deployments and establishes BackFed as a rigorous and fair evaluation framework that enables more reliable progress in FL backdoor research.

2507.16274.tldr: STAlloc is introduced, a GPU memory allocator for deep learning frameworks that reduces fragmentation by exploiting the spatial and temporal regularity in memory allocation behaviors of training workloads and enables more efficient, high-throughput training configurations.

2507.17777.tldr: This study applies symbolic Regression to model three-dimensional laminar flow in a rectangular channel, focusing on the axial velocity and pressure fields, and introduces an innovative hybrid framework that integrates SR with Answer Set Programming (ASP).

2508.01772.tldr: It is demonstrated that transfer learning between hematoma types is feasible and that LoRA-based methods significantly outperform conventional Unet fine-tuning for aneurysmal SAH segmentation and CP-LoRA achieved comparable performance to existing methods while using significantly fewer parameters.

2508.09022.tldr: A dual-path guided network (DPGNet) is proposed to address two key challenges: bridging the domain differences between faces generated by different generative models; and utilizing unlabeled image samples.

2508.09621.tldr: A novel framework that bridges natural language understanding and robotic execution by combining Large Language Models (LLMs) with Behavior Trees is presented, which enables robots to interpret natural language instructions given by users and translate them into executable actions by activating domain-specific plugins.

2508.10161.tldr: The introduction of LaaJMeter, a simulation-based framework for controlled meta-evaluation of LaaJs, provides a scalable and extensible solution for assessing LaaJs in low-resource settings, contributing to the broader effort to ensure trustworthy and reproducible evaluation in NLP.

2508.15577.tldr: This work proposes to minimize the model's bias instead of its variance, and is able to almost exactly match the best-case error over all possible greedy sample selection procedures for a relevant application.

2508.17811.tldr: The key idea is to leverage 2DGS as a bridge, which connects novel view synthesis to learned geometric priors and then transfers these priors to achieve surface reconstruction, and incorporates a feed-forward network to predict per-view pixel-aligned 2DGS, which enables the network to synthesize novel view images and thus eliminates the need for direct 3D ground-truth supervision.

2508.18847.tldr: ConfTuner is introduced, a simple and efficient fine-tuning method that introduces minimal overhead and does not require ground-truth confidence scores or proxy confidence estimates, and improves calibration across diverse reasoning tasks and generalizes to black-box models such as GPT-4o.

2508.21380.tldr: This work extends the logit lens to analyze the policy network of Leela Chess Zero, a superhuman chess engine, to suggest a mechanism by which heuristic priors can override tactical solutions.

2509.02966.tldr: KEPT is introduced, a knowledge-enhanced VLM framework that predicts ego trajectories directly from consecutive front-view driving frames and achieves the best open-loop performance compared with baseline methods.

2509.08015.tldr: This work proposes CardioComposer: a programmable, inference-time framework for generating multi-class anatomical label maps from interpretable ellipsoidal primitives, and develops differentiable measurement functions based on voxel-wise geometric moments, enabling loss-based gradient guidance during diffusion model sampling.

2509.12897.tldr: The core idea of CLVS is to incorporate a vision memory that smooths the attention distribution across layers, which achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across a variety of visual understanding tasks and attains comparable results on image captioning benchmarks.

2509.23901.tldr: This work aimed at interpreting the deep learning-based estimation of stellar mass via two interpretability techniques: causal analysis and mutual information decomposition, and demonstrates the gains from combining deep learning with interpretability techniques, and holds promise in promoting more data-driven astrophysical research.

2509.26536.tldr: OceanGym is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark for ocean underwater embodied agents, designed to advance AI in one of the most demanding real-world environments, and reveals substantial gaps between state-of-the-art MLLM-driven agents and human experts.

2510.10764.tldr: A NAS like training strategy called "progressive depth expansion", which begins by training neural networks at shallower depths and incrementally increases their depth as the earlier blocks converge, continuing this process until the target accuracy is reached, which cuts down future training and inference costs and facilitates deployment on edge devices.

2510.15691.tldr: This paper examines effective methods for leveraging multimodal factors and newsflow in return prediction and stock selection by introducing a fusion learning framework to learn a unified representation from factors and newsflow representations generated by an LLM.

2510.16786.tldr: This work provides the first systematic analysis of turn-control strategies, offering simple yet effective guidelines for developers to balance cost and efficacy and demonstrates that dynamic resource allocation is a superior, easy-to-implement approach for deploying powerful yet economically viable coding agents.

2510.20519.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that the approach not only substantially enhances complex reasoning abilities but also improves the model's general capabilities, reversing the degradation trend observed in other reasoning-specialized models.

2510.24151.tldr: BMGQ, a bottom-up automated method for generating high-difficulty, training-ready multi-hop questions from semi-structured knowledge sources, is presented, substantially reducing human curation effort while preserving the difficulty profile of strong evaluation benchmarks.

2510.24821.tldr: Ming-Flash-Omni achieves state-of-the-art results in text-to-image generation and generative segmentation, and sets new records on all 12 contextual ASR benchmarks, all within a single unified architecture.

2511.03826.tldr: A novel coarse-to-fine framework CORE is proposed for accurate nuclei-level registration across diverse multimodal whole-slide image (WSI) datasets and outperforms current state-of-the-art methods in terms of generalisability, precision, and robustness in bright-field and immunofluorescence microscopy WSIs.

2511.04042.tldr: A novel LLM-CRF system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to model and augment human-swarm teaming cognition and establishes the potential of LLMs to create more intuitive and effective human-swarm collaborations in high-stakes scenarios.

2511.05865.tldr: This work introduces Classifier-Guided Concept Erasure (CGCE), an efficient plug-and-play framework that provides robust concept erasure for diverse generative models without altering their original weights, and showcases the versatility of CGCE through its successful application to various modern T2I and T2V models.

2511.10037.tldr: A novel Planner-centric Plan-Execute paradigm that fundamentally resolves local optimization bottlenecks through architectural innovation is proposed, and a novel Planner model that performs global Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) planning for complex queries, enabling optimized execution beyond conventional tool coordination.

2511.14099.tldr: FAPE-IR, a Frequency-Aware Planning and Execution framework for image restoration, uses a frozen Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) as a planner to analyze degraded images and generate concise, frequency-aware restoration plans.

2511.17585.tldr: PaSE is proposed, a novel Prototype-aligned Calibration and Shapley-optimized Equilibrium framework, which enhances collaboration while explicitly mitigating modality competition, and introduces a Dual-Phase Optimization strategy.

2511.17645.tldr: The results suggest that blockwise extraction with explicit certificates is feasible for real transformer language models and offers a practical bridge between mechanistic interpretability and formal reasoning about model behaviour.

2511.17971.tldr: This work proposes a co-exploration framework that unifies these dimensions within a unified design space for efficient training and inference of tensorized neural networks on edge platforms and formulates a latency oriented search objective and solves it via a global latency-driven exploration across the unified design space.

2511.18493.tldr: This work proposes Shape-Adapting Gated Experts (SAGE), an input-adaptive framework that enables dynamic expert routing in heterogeneous visual networks, thereby facilitating flexible visual reasoning.

2511.18808.tldr: This work proposes HyperbolicRAG, a retrieval framework that integrates hyperbolic geometry into graph-based RAG, and introduces three key designs: a depth-aware representation learner that embeds nodes within a shared Poincare manifold to align semantic similarity with hierarchical containment.

2511.18958.tldr: Cutter is proposed, a dual-agent reinforcement learning framework composed of a Vital Detection Agent (VDA) and a Redundancy Detection Agent (RDA), which collaboratively identify structurally vital and redundant nodes for guided compression.

2511.19878.tldr: This work presents MAPS (Module-Wise Proximity Scheduling), the first robust fine-tuning framework for VLAs, and highlights empirically guided proximity to pretrained VLMs as a simple yet powerful principle for preserving broad generalization in VLM-to-VLA transfer.

2511.19887.tldr: Frequency-decoupled cross-modal knowledge distillation is proposed, a method designed to decouple and balance knowledge transfer across modalities by leveraging frequency-domain features.

2511.19902.tldr: A zero-knowledge framework capable of verifying deep learning inference without exposing model internal parameters, built on recursively composed zero-knowledge proofs and requiring no trusted setup is introduced.

2511.19925.tldr: A novel method for generating benchmarks to evaluate semantic similarity methods for LLM outputs, and a comparative study of semantic similarity methods including traditional natural language processing scores and LLM-as-a-judge predictions.

2511.19931.tldr: This work proposes an LLMs Enhanced Cross-domain Sequential Recommendation with Dual-phase Training (LLM-EDT) to address the imbalance issue while introducing less irrelevant noise and introduces a dual-phase training strategy to empower the domain-specific thread with a domain-shared background.

2511.19941.tldr: This work introduces an RL framework for optimizing the flip-angle schedule in MRF and demonstrates a learned schedule exhibiting non-periodic patterns that enhances fingerprint separability.

2511.19963.tldr: This work proposes MambaEye, a novel, causal sequential encoder that leverages the low complexity and causal-process based pure Mamba2 backbone, and introduces a novel diffusion-inspired loss function that provides dense, step-wise supervision, training the model to build confidence as it gathers more visual evidence.

2511.19969.tldr: This work proposes a novel Multi-Modal Multi-agent hierarchical communication graph PRUNING framework, termed M$^3$Prune, which consistently outperforms both single-agent and robust multi-agent mRAG systems while significantly reducing token consumption.

2511.19986.tldr: This work introduces an on-demand multi-task sparsity framework specifically designed to minimize switching costs by maximizing parameter reuse, and decompose weights into reusable block-granular units and align sparse structures across tasks to maximize overlap.

2511.19997.tldr: A minimal, semantics-free signature of directional friction intrinsic to causal Transformer training-one that persists even when linguistic priors, token frequencies, and corpus-level temporal asymmetries are removed is isolated.

2511.20006.tldr: This work proposes BERT-APC, a novel reference-free APC framework that corrects pitch errors while maintaining the natural expressiveness of vocal performances, and is the first APC model that leverages a music language model to achieve reference-free pitch correction with symbolic musical context.

2511.20008.tldr: A multimodal fusion network that leverages seven modality features from both visual and motion branches, aiming to effectively extract and integrate complementary cues across different modalities is proposed, achieving superior performance compared to the baseline methods.

2511.20011.tldr: A multi-context fusion Transformer that leverages diverse numerical contextual attributes across four key dimensions, encompassing pedestrian behavior context, environmental context, pedestrian localization context and vehicle motion context, to enable accurate pedestrian intention prediction is proposed.

2511.20041.tldr: A structured downsampling and upsampling strategy that preserves geometry and maintains alignment between coarse and fine resolutions is introduced that achieves best-in-class performance among point-based methods and challenges the best representation-based methods.

2511.20048.tldr: SPAgent is presented, an algorithm-system co-design framework that expands the role of speculation in search agents to reduce latency and introduces a two-phase adaptive speculation mechanism that selectively omits verification when safe.

2511.20067.tldr: An autonomous evaluation and feedback framework that uses vision-language models to assess task completion directly from screenshots and task descriptions achieves up to 73 percent accuracy in task success detection and yields an average relative improvement when evaluator feedback is applied.
