2511.18742.tldr: This work develops a text-to-image (T2I) diffusion model based on backward discretizations, dubbed ProxT2I, relying on learned and conditional proximal operators instead of score functions instead of score functions, offering a lightweight yet performant solution for human text-to-image generation.

2511.19220.tldr: Analysis of model-generated reasoning reveals confident explanations for fabricated visual interpretations across all models, suggesting varying degrees of reliance on textual shortcuts versus genuine visual analysis.

2511.21695.tldr: It is argued that existing standardization efforts remain insufficient and EvalCards are designed to enhance transparency for both researchers and practitioners while providing a practical foundation to meet emerging governance requirements.

2511.21698.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate the promising performance of the proposed TIPPo in automatic evaluation and LLM-based criteria for creativity and semantic consistency and explicit input modeling and comprehensive optimization objectives.

2511.21703.tldr: Empirically, LLM-based backbones produce embeddings that better capture higher-order, compositional numeric patterns, but are prone to adapter dominance that degrades balanced generalization; SLERP merging consistently recovers base-model structure while retaining most task gains, yielding superior tradeoffs in clustering separability, and robustness compared to model souping or models that were not merged.

2511.21706.tldr: Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation for Goal-oriented Dialogue (NRPA-GD) is presented, a novel dialogue policy planning method that completely avoids specific model training by utilizing a Large Language Model (LLM) to simulate behaviors of user and system at the same time.

2511.21707.tldr: This paper constructed a GPT-style WMLM model and trained it on a real-world large-scale dataset, leveraging wireless signals as an anchor modality for contrastive learning and validating the feasibility of using wireless signals as a universal modality and highlighting WMLM's potential to emerge as a new paradigm for future wireless networks.

2511.21708.tldr: A custom-designed quality model is developed that has been validated through a user study to gain insights into practitioners' expectations and compare the support provided by large language models with that offered by traditional data preparation tools.

2511.21709.tldr: A new unsupervised label-free Permutation Bias Metric (PBM) that directly quantifies inconsistencies in model predictions across answer permutations, providing a more precise measure of selection bias and an efficient majority voting approach called Batch Question-Context KV caching (BaQCKV), to significantly reduce computational costs while preserving bias mitigation effectiveness.

2511.21712.tldr: EulerESG combines (i) dual-channel retrieval and LLM-driven disclosure analysis over ESG reports, and (ii) an interactive dashboard and chatbot for exploration, benchmarking, and explanation.

2511.21714.tldr: This work shows the potential of a novel and effective paradigm for automatic prompting: generating adaptive, input-specific prompts without extensive optimization and without access to a task-specific training set.

2511.21722.tldr: The German General Social Survey Personas collection is introduced, a comprehensive and representative persona prompt collection built from the German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) to provide a potentially valuable resource for research on LLM-based social simulations that enables more systematic explorations of population-aligned persona prompting in NLP and social science research.

2511.21725.tldr: Results show that a compact student, guided by powerful teachers, can learn effective prompt-generation strategies that enhance response quality while maintaining alignment with user intent, and PromptTailor, a system for controllable prompt generation for open-ended text that improves model output quality by intent-aligned prompt synthesis.

2511.21726.tldr: It is demonstrated that a simple search method applied to raw data outperforms goal-agnostic and biased compression algorithms in current long-context memory tasks, arguing for new paradigms and benchmarks that are more dynamic and autonomously scalable.

2511.21729.tldr: The results show that synergistic integration matters more than the strength of any single component, that standardized metrics and labels are essential for correctly interpreting performance, and that adaptive calibration is needed to prevent overconfident over-answering even when retrieval quality is high.

2511.21730.tldr: This work presents the first benchmark that isolates procedural memory retrieval from task execution, evaluating whether agents can recognize functionally equivalent procedures that span different object instantiations and offers the first diagnostic framework separating genuine procedural understanding from surface-level memorization.

2511.21731.tldr: The results of cognitive tests on conceptual combinations, performed using specific Large Language Models (LLMs) as test subjects, point to the'systematic emergence of quantum structures in conceptual-linguistic domains', regardless of whether the cognitive agent is human or artificial.

2511.21732.tldr: This is the first work to explicitly embed cognitive structures from humor theories into multimodal humor generation, enabling a structured reasoning process from visual understanding to humor creation.

2511.21733.tldr: RoPE-aware Selective Adaptation (RoSA) is proposed, a novel PEFT framework that allocates trainable parameters in a more targeted and effective manner and outperforms existing mainstream PEFT methods under comparable trainable parameters.

2511.21734.tldr: Verification-First (VF), a strategy that prompts models to verify a provided candidate answer, even a trivial or random one, before generating a solution, is introduced, which triggers a "reverse reasoning" process that is cognitively easier and complementary to standard forward Chain-of-Thought (CoT).

2511.21735.tldr: MAIRA-X is introduced, a clinically evaluated multimodal AI model for longitudinal chest X-ray (CXR) report generation, that encompasses both clinical findings and L&T reporting and suggests that MAIRA-X can effectively assist radiologists, particularly in high-volume clinical settings.

2511.21736.tldr: By refining quantization through a residual learning mechanism, R2Q enhances performance, improves training stability, and accelerates convergence under extreme compression, and its modular design enables seamless integration with existing quantization-aware training (QAT) frameworks.

2511.21737.tldr: Polarity-Aware CCS (PA-CCS), a method for evaluating whether a model's internal representations remain consistent under polarity inversion, is introduced and two alignment-oriented metrics are proposed, Polar-Consistency and the Contradiction Index, to quantify the semantic robustness of a model's latent knowledge.

2511.21739.tldr: This first large-scale analysis of AI foundation model usage in science is presented, finding that adoption has grown rapidly, at nearly-exponential rates, with the highest uptake in Linguistics, Computer Science, and Engineering.

2511.21742.tldr: A modular function-calling LLM pipeline is introduced, a modular approach reveals specific failure modes and performance patterns, supporting the development of interpretable and effective educational QA systems, and demonstrates the value of modular function calling in improving system transparency and pedagogical alignment.

2511.21747.tldr: QuantumChem-200K and the corresponding AI assistant together provide the first scalable platform for high-throughput, LLM-driven photoinitiator screening and accelerated discovery of photosensitive materials.

2511.21748.tldr: DiagnosticSLM achieves up to 25% accuracy improvement over open-source models of comparable or larger size on the MCQ task, while also outperforming or matching them in other tasks, demonstrating effective domain-specific reasoning and generalization capabilities.

2511.21749.tldr: BRIES is introduced, a novel compound AI architecture designed to detect and measure the effectiveness of persuasion attacks across information environments and delivers a framework for enhancing human cognitive resilience through structured interventions before exposure to harmful content.

2511.21753.tldr: This research uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify all locations, impacts and impacted locations mentioned in disaster-related social media posts, including locations mentioned in informal expressions, abbreviations, and short forms, and demonstrates efficacy.

2511.21757.tldr: This work introduces Medical Malice: a dataset of 214,219 adversarial prompts calibrated to the regulatory and ethical complexities of the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS), enabling models to internalize ethical boundaries rather than merely memorizing a fixed set of refusals.

2511.21758.tldr: This paper presents the first longitudinal empirical study of privacy policies for mainstream LLM providers worldwide, compares LLM privacy policies to those of other software formats, proposes a taxonomy tailored to LLM privacy policies, annotate policy edits and align them with a timeline of key LLM ecosystem events.

2511.21762.tldr: Inference-time approaches emerged as particularly efficient, aligning outputs without retraining while supporting user intent, contextual grounding, and hallucination mitigation, and hallucination mitigation.

2511.21767.tldr: An anatomically grounded explainable artificial intelligence (AI) framework, LAYER (Layer-wise Analysis for Yielding Explainable Relevance Tissue), is developed that analyses six tissue layers in three-dimensional ultrasound and quantifies their contribution to MP prediction and reveals that non-muscle tissues contribute substantially to pain prediction.

2511.21779.tldr: This work proposes a novel protocol for aligning artificial superintelligence based on mutual verification among multiple isolated systems that self-modify to achieve alignment, and provides a framework for leveraging peer verification among superintelligent systems to solve the alignment problem.

2511.21781.tldr: BeeRNA is presented, a bio-inspired method that employs the Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) optimization algorithm that combines base-pair distance filtering with RMSD-based structural assessment using RhoFold for structure prediction, resulting in a two-stage fitness evaluation strategy.

2511.21790.tldr: The results demonstrate that AI can provide consistent evaluations that help identify borderline evaluation cases requiring additional human scrutiny while reducing the substantial resource burden of traditional internal review processes.

2511.21802.tldr: The results provide, to the authors' knowledge, the first evidence of bidder side tacit collusion by LLMs and show that market structure levers can be more effective than capability limits for mitigation.

2511.21827.tldr: Experiments across several heterogeneous dermatology datasets demonstrate that synthetic clinical notes not only enhance classification performance, particularly under domain shift, but also unlock cross-modal retrieval capabilities, a downstream task that is not explicitly optimized during training.

2511.21843.tldr: F Fault Localization Across Writing in Science (FLAWS) is introduced, an automated benchmark consisting of 713 paper-error pairs designed to evaluate how effectively LLMs detect errors that undermine key claims in research papers.

2511.21846.tldr: This work proposes LILAD (Learning In-Context Lyapunov-stable Adaptive Dynamics), a novel framework for system identification that jointly guarantees adaptability and stability and evaluates LILAD on benchmark autonomous systems and demonstrates that it outperforms adaptive, robust, and non-adaptive baselines in predictive accuracy.

2511.21860.tldr: The Consistency-Rebalanced Accuracy (CoRA) metric is presented, improving the reliability of Large Language Model (LLM) scores computed on multiple choice (MC) benchmarks by adjusting the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) scores to better reflect the level of consistency of the LLM.

2511.21861.tldr: The results suggest that large-scale pretraining across diverse physical processes can yield transferable representations of dynamics, marking a step toward unified, foundation-level surrogates for multi-physics simulation and scientific discovery.

2511.21872.tldr: While all generative approaches improved classification performance relative to the baseline, diffusion-based augmentation yielded the highest recall and overall F1-score, and a hybrid strategy combining generative-based synthesis with traditional methods achieved the best overall performance.

2511.21877.tldr: This paper presents an event-chain-driven, LLM-empowered workflow for generating validated, automotive code from natural-language requirements and achieves valid signal usage and consistent code generation without LLM retraining.

2511.21886.tldr: REMAP is proposed, an execution-informed MAPF planning framework that can be combined with leading search-based MAPF planners with minor changes and achieves up to 20% improvement in solution quality over baseline methods on benchmark maps with up to 300 agents.

2511.21901.tldr: This research presents the AI System Threat Vector Taxonomy, a structured ontology designed explicitly for Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA), which categorizes AI-specific risks into nine critical domains and is explicitly aligned with ISO/IEC 42001 controls and NIST AI RMF functions to facilitate auditability.

2511.21902.tldr: Inspired by pathologists who conducted navigation on WSIs with a combination of sampling, reasoning and self-reflection, PathReasoning is proposed, a multi-modal reasoning agent that iteratively navigates across WSIs through multiple rounds of reasoning and refinements, and can substantially outperform strong ROI-selection approaches.

2511.21903.tldr: This paper introduces the Projection-based Robust Signal Mixing (PRISM) algorithm, a training-free method that jointly optimizes photometric detrending and color mixing through online parameter adaptation based on signal quality assessment.

2511.21920.tldr: This work constructs a benchmark suite of domain-inspired prompts that reflect real-world research tasks and systematically evaluates the executability and correctness of the generated code, and introduces actionable techniques and a reusable benchmark for building more inclusive, accessible, and trustworthy AI-assisted research tools.

2511.21923.tldr: This paper presents a rigorous analysis of the impact of backdoor data on the learning process, with a particular focus on the distinct behaviors between the target class and other clean classes, and proposes a novel, dynamics-based stealthiness metric that quantifies an attack's integration at the model level.

2511.21928.tldr: This work introduces Prompted Policy Search (ProPS), a novel RL method that unifies numerical and linguistic reasoning within a single framework and shows that LLMs can perform numerical optimization in-context and that incorporating semantic signals can lead to more informed exploration and sample-efficient learning.

2511.21934.tldr: A novel heterogeneous multi-agent RL framework is proposed to enable cooperative and scalable feature transformation and introduces a state encoding technique during the optimization process to stabilize and enhance the learning dynamics of the RL agents, resulting in more robust and reliable transformation policies.

2511.21947.tldr: WalkCLIP learns walkability-aware vision-language representations from GPT-4o generated image captions, refines these representations with a spatial aggregation module that incorporates neighborhood context, and fuses the resulting features with representations from a population dynamics foundation model.

2511.21952.tldr: Experimental results on six UCI benchmark datasets across three deep neural network architectures demonstrate that the proposed Adversarially Bracketed Local Explanation (ABLE) approach achieves higher stability and fidelity than the state-of-the-art.

2511.21959.tldr: A comprehensive comparative model analysis on a novel gastrointestinal medical imaging dataset, comprised of 4,000 endoscopic images spanning four critical disease classes, establishing robust benchmarks and baselines for automated disease classification and enabling explainable AI via Grad-CAM visualization.

2511.21975.tldr: This research presents a comprehensive financial framework for quantifying AI project returns that explicitly integrates changes in organizational risk profiles, and demonstrates that accurate AI investment evaluation requires explicit modeling of control effectiveness, reserve requirements for algorithmic failures, and the ongoing operational costs of maintaining model performance.

2511.21982.tldr: A novel vision-language model for pointer meter reading recognition, termed MRLM, based on physical relation injection is proposed, which explicitly encodes the geometric and causal relationships between the pointer and the scale, aligning perception with physical reasoning in the spirit of world-model perspectives.

2203.13599.tldr: The Relational Regression Tree Learner (RRTL), a model that incrementally builds policies over structured relational inputs by selecting task-relevant relations during the learning process, is introduced, providing a proof of principle that reinforcement signals can guide the selection of structured representations.

2205.02900.tldr: A deep learning model is trained to detect new-onset diabetes using 12-lead ECG and readily available demographic information that offers an automated, more accurate method for early diabetes detection compared to current screening efforts.

2211.10360.tldr: This work introduces epsilon HQS, a scalable active learning strategy that leverages a student teacher framework to train deep neural networks efficiently and achieves higher accuracy under fixed labeling cost budgets.

2402.06165.tldr: A novel contrastive learning framework aimed for AU detection that incorporates both self-supervised and supervised signals, thereby enhancing the learning of discriminative features for accurate AU detection.

2402.07787.tldr: An Extensible Multi-Granularity Fusion Network (EMGF) that integrates dependency syntax, constituent syntax, attention-based semantics, and external knowledge graphs and employs multi-anchor triplet learning and orthogonal projection to effectively fuse multi-granularity features and strengthen their interactions without additional computational overhead is proposed.

2403.01528.tldr: This review provides an extensive analysis of recent advancements achieved through cross modeling of biomolecules and natural language and identifies several promising research directions worthy of further exploration and investment to continue advancing the field.

2406.11477.tldr: This article investigates vocabulary expansion in low-resource settings by considering embedding initialization methods and continual pre-training strategies, and establishes a set of strategies to perform vocabulary expansion for faster inference, while striving to maintain competitive downstream performance to baselines.

2408.10488.tldr: This paper introduces a new high-definition event-based sign language dataset, termed Event-CSL, which effectively addresses the data scarcity in this research area and proposes a novel event-based sign language translation framework, termed EvSLT.

2409.18924.tldr: AIPatient, an artificial intelligence system that can simulate diverse patient interactions based on existing real electronic health records, is developed and compared to an actor simulating human patients, suggesting that AI-based simulated patients could make medical education more accessible, scalable, and consistent across different training environments.

2410.00081.tldr: This work focuses on introducing biologically and economically motivated themes that have been neglected in current mainstream discussions on AI safety - namely a set of multi-objective, multi-agent alignment benchmarks that emphasize homeostasis for bounded and biological objectives, diminishing returns for unbounded, instrumental, and business objectives, sustainability principle, and resource sharing.

2410.22377.tldr: This is the first and broadest systematic literature review presenting a detailed comparison of results from current spatio-temporal GNN models applied to different domains and discusses current limitations and challenges in the application of spatio-temporal GNNs, such as comparability, reproducibility, explainability, poor information capacity, and scalability.

2411.14652.tldr: A platform-independent method that reranks participants' feeds in real time is established, establishing a method to study feed algorithms without requiring platform cooperation, enabling independent evaluation of ranking interventions in naturalistic settings.

2411.15173.tldr: Frequency-based Decentralized Adaptation (FreDA), a novel framework that decomposes globally heterogeneous data stream into locally homogeneous clusters in the Fourier space, is proposed, a novel framework that leverages decentralized learning and augmentation strategies to robustly adapt under mixed domain shifts.

2501.01457.tldr: This work proposes an externalist three-step framework Distillation-Reinforcement-Reasoning (DRR), which offers a scalable and adaptable solution for improving the reliability of reasoning in a wide range of LLMs.

2501.16607.tldr: MCTS-SQL is proposed, a novel framework that uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to guide SQL generation through multi-step refinement and a token-level prefix-cache mechanism that stores prior information during iterations, effectively improved the execution speed.

2503.02636.tldr: A scalable GAN-based framework for resting-state EEG that serves this dual role: 1) synthesis and 2) unsupervised feature extraction is introduced, and it is demonstrated that the model's learned representations can be repurposed for a downstream gender classification task.

2503.05244.tldr: This work presents WritingBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs across 6 core writing domains and 100 subdomains, and proposes a query-dependent evaluation framework that empowers LLMs to dynamically generate instance-specific assessment criteria.

2503.05355.tldr: This paper offers a reversal of the traditional explanatory order: rather than treating logic as a precondition for the articulation of knowledge, it shows how logical structure can emerge from epistemic organisation.

2503.09399.tldr: This paper introduces ForAug, a novel data augmentation operation that addresses challenges in large-scale image classification by explicitly imposing invariances into the training data, which are otherwise part of the neural network architecture.

2503.20138.tldr: A novel framework that constructs a model atlas from decentralized models and leverages centralized data to refine a global model within this structured space, which synergizes federated learning and model merging, enabling effective training under hybrid data availability.

2504.01008.tldr: IntrinsiX is introduced, a novel method that generates high-quality intrinsic images from text description that outperforms existing intrinsic image decomposition methods used with generated images by a significant margin.

2504.02821.tldr: This work extends the application of SAEs to Vision-Language Models (VLMs), such as CLIP, and introduces a comprehensive framework for evaluating monosemanticity at the neuron-level in visual representations, and reveals that SAEs trained on VLMs significantly enhance the monosemanticity of individual neurons.

2504.05408.tldr: This paper comprehensively analyzes the impact of frontier AI in cybersecurity through multiple aspects, including quantitative benchmarks, qualitative literature review, empirical evaluation, and expert survey, and provides concrete calls to action.

2504.05559.tldr: This work introduces SciSciGPT, an open-source, prototype artificial intelligence (AI) collaborator that uses the domain of science of science as a testbed to explore the potential of large language model-powered research tools, and proposes a large language model agent capability maturity model for human-AI collaboration.

2504.09936.tldr: KeepKV is proposed, a novel adaptive KV cache merging method designed to preserve performance under strict memory constraints, achieving single-step lossless compression and providing error bounds for multi-step compression.

2504.10068.tldr: Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate Mavors' superiority in maintaining both spatial fidelity and temporal continuity, significantly outperforming existing methods in tasks requiring fine-grained spatio-temporal reasoning.

2504.13987.tldr: Entropy Rectifying Guidance (ERG), a simple and effective guidance method based on inference-time changes in the attention mechanism of state-of-the-art diffusion transformer architectures, which allows for simultaneous improvements over image quality, diversity and prompt consistency.

2504.14522.tldr: Countering the typical view of AI biases as detrimental, the research proposes strategies of user choice and personalization in response to a user's political stance, applying psychological concepts of confirmation bias and cognitive dissonance.

2505.02433.tldr: This work proposes FairPO, a framework combining preference-based loss and group-robust optimization to improve fairness by targeting underperforming labels and demonstrates FairPO's versatility with reference-free variants using Contrastive (CPO) and Simple (SimPO) Preference Optimization.

2505.07899.tldr: A method named DeltaEdit is proposed that reduces conflicts between knowledge through dynamic orthogonal constraint strategies and significantly reduces superimposed noise, achieving a 16.8% improvement in editing performance over the strongest baseline.

2505.11454.tldr: This work presents HumaniBench, a unified evaluation framework designed to characterize HC alignment across realistic, socially grounded visual contexts and provides a reproducible, extensible foundation for systematic HC evaluation of LMMs and enables fine-grained analysis of alignment tradeoffs that are not captured by conventional multimodal benchmarks.

2505.13124.tldr: It is shown that 100+ layer PCNs can be trained reliably using a Depth-$\mu$P parameterisation, which is called "$\mu$PC" and enables zero-shot transfer of both weight and activity learning rates across widths and depths.

2505.14544.tldr: It is suggested that MARL-based dynamic control strategies hold substantial promise to improve urban traffic management efficiency and the application of multi-agent reinforcement learning to optimize traffic signal coordination across multiple intersections within a simulated environment.

2505.18585.tldr: A novel specification language, ESL, is designed and a runtime verification framework, RvLLM, is introduced to validate LLM output against domain-specific constraints defined in ESL, to advance misbehavior detection by incorporating domain knowledge.

2505.19194.tldr: A new query-efficient method, dynamic curvature estimation (DCE), to estimate the decision boundary curvature in a black-box setting and a new attack method, curvature dynamic black-box attack (CDBA) with improved performance using the estimated curvature.

2506.00096.tldr: This multi-center dataset links whole-slide images to driver gene mutation status, mutation subtypes, exon, and tumor mutational burden (TMB) status, with the goal of leveraging pathology images to predict mutations, subtypes, exon locations, and TMB for early genetic screening and to advance precision oncology.

2506.00979.tldr: Ivy-Fake is introduced, the first large-scale multimodal benchmark for explainable AIGC detection and Ivy-xDetector is proposed, a reinforcement learning model capable of producing explainable reasoning chains and achieving robust performance across multiple synthetic content detection benchmarks.

2506.02183.tldr: It is thought that it is increasingly difficult to consider humans uniquely intelligent, and evidence for intelligence in non-human animals, the role of written language in science and technology, progress with artificial intelligence, the history of intelligence testing (for both humans and machines), and the role of embodiment in intelligence are considered.

2506.03195.tldr: An automatic self-enhancing prompt learning framework called AutoSEP is developed to iteratively improve the description prompt using unlabeled data, based on instance-level classification scoring function, to enhance MLLM fine-grained classification capabilities in a fully unsupervised manner.

2506.04931.tldr: CzechLynx is introduced, the first large-scale, open-access dataset for individual identification, pose estimation, and instance segmentation of the Eurasian lynx (Lynx lynx), and offers a unique, flexible benchmark for robust evaluation of computer vision and machine learning models across realistic ecological scenarios.

2506.10157.tldr: Context switching enables medical AI to adapt across specialties, populations, and geographies, and establishes a foundation for medical AI that scales to infinitely many contexts while remaining reliable and suited to real-world care.

2506.12484.tldr: This work systematically evaluates many existing and novel components of unlearning methods and identifies ones crucial for irreversible unlearning, and introduces Disruption Masking, a technique in which the signs of the unlearning gradient and the retaining gradient are the same, which ensures all updates are non-disruptive.

2506.18396.tldr: Adaptive and Dynamic Neuro–Fuzzy Clustering is introduced, a novel streaming-capable framework that marries Convolutional Neural Network based feature extraction with an online fuzzy clustering engine that achieves superior cohesion and separation over static baselines.

2507.02863.tldr: This work proposes Point3R, an online framework targeting dense streaming 3D reconstruction from an ordered sequence or unordered image collections and designs a 3D hierarchical position embedding to promote this interaction and design a simple yet effective fusion mechanism to ensure that the pointer memory is uniform and efficient.

2507.04966.tldr: LAPS-Diff, a diffusion model integrated with language-aware embeddings and a vocal-style guided learning mechanism, specifically designed for Bollywood Hindi singing style is proposed, demonstrating that LAPS-Diff significantly improves the quality of the generated samples compared to the considered state-of-the-art (SOTA) model for a constrained dataset that is typical of the low resource scenario.

2507.13361.tldr: The findings show that despite gains in raw visual acuity, current models lack core visual reasoning capabilities, and a structured evaluation suite allows us to test whether VLMs can perform visual algorithms similar to those used by humans.

2507.17984.tldr: A novel learning paradigm for TSEP is introduced-Machine Unlearning TSEP-which enables a trained TSEP model to selectively forget privacy-sensitive, poisoned, or outdated data to enhance the trustworthiness and reliability of data-driven traffic TSEP.

2508.01943.tldr: ROVER (Reasoning Over VidEo Recursively), a framework that enables the model to recursively decompose long-horizon video trajectories into segments corresponding to shorter subtasks within the trajectory, facilitates more focused and accurate reasoning over temporally localized frame sequences without losing global context.

2508.02583.tldr: Empirical results on real-world datasets show that CAMA significantly improves LLM performance on challenging mathematical problems, and that incorporating asymmetric causal relationships yields greater improvements than using symmetric associations alone.

2508.04182.tldr: Causal-Oriented Policy Optimization (COPO) is proposed to mitigate these spurious correlations, thus addressing the issue of hallucinations, and imposes token-level sufficiency and necessity constraints to measure each inference token's causal contribution, thus ensuring correct and evidence-grounded output.

2508.08719.tldr: IROTE is proposed, a novel in-context method for stable and transferable trait elicitation that automatically generates and optimizes a textual self-reflection within prompts, which comprises self-perceived experience, to stimulate LLMs'trait-driven behavior.

2508.09185.tldr: CADAR is introduced, a neuro-symbolic framework for cognitive attack detection in AR that integrates neural and symbolic reasoning and provides both the adaptability of modern vision-language models and the interpretability of probabilistic symbolic reasoning.

2508.13663.tldr: A new and flexible way to interact with graph databases that allows users to specify their preferences by providing examples interactively is explored, requiring tuning only two parameters or a small neural network trained to capture soft constraints while maintaining the original ranking structure.

2508.17150.tldr: A novel density-based clustering algorithm loosely inspired by the concept of selective attention is introduced, designed to minimize reliance on parameter tuning for most applications.

2508.19625.tldr: It is demonstrated that policies promoting AI in education, if not paired with forward-looking labor market signals, may paradoxically undermine students' long-term human capital, such as by crowding out skills like persistence that are forged through intellectual struggle.

2508.20461.tldr: A novel medical image classification method that integrates dual-model weight selection with self-knowledge distillation (SKD) that overcomes the limitations of conventional approaches, which often fail to retain critical information in compact models.

2509.04449.tldr: ChronoGraph is presented, a graph-structured multivariate time series forecasting dataset built from real-world production microservices that uniquely combines multivariate time series, an explicit, machine-readable dependency graph, and anomaly labels aligned with real incidents.

2509.08095.tldr: Three end-to-end Convolutional Neural Networks were trained and evaluated offline and deployed on a differential-drive mobile robot for real-time obstacle avoidance to generate low-level steering commands from synchronized color and depth images acquired by an Intel RealSense RGB-D camera in diverse environments.

2509.13866.tldr: It is proved that three distinct energy formulations--kinetic, conditional kinetic, and geodesic energy--are mathematically equivalent under the structure of MDMs, and that MDMs minimize all three when the mask schedule satisfies a closed-form optimality condition.

2509.18355.tldr: These performance upgrades demonstrate that modular chiplet designs can achieve near-monolithic computational density while enabling cost efficiency, scalability and upgradeability, crucial for next-generation edge AI device applications.

2509.18775.tldr: This work proposes a systematic method for extracting inter-firm risk relations using Form 10-K filings -- authoritative, standardized financial documents -- as the data source and introduces a quantitative risk relation score for transparency, interpretable analysis.

2509.20048.tldr: In-depth evaluation findings suggest that early-stage diffusion serves as an ideal"local manifold explorer,"producing embeddings with greater precision than typical augmentation methods while preserving inference efficiency.

2509.21379.tldr: SAEmnesia, a supervised sparse autoencoder framework that overcomes the problem of feature splitting by enforcing one-to-one concept-neuron mappings by systematically labeling concepts during training, achieves feature centralization, binding each concept to a single, interpretable neuron.

2509.24725.tldr: Evaluations on urban main roads in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, show that Q-Net outperforms baseline methods, accurately tracking queue formation and dissipation while correcting aFCD-induced delays.

2509.26347.tldr: This work proposes a novel benchmarking approach at building a curated dataset reflecting real world physical temporal dynamics, extracting temporal signals from real-world videos using optical flow, and introduces REAL-V-TSFM, a novel dataset designed to capture rich and diverse time series derived from real-world videos.

2510.02336.tldr: The first Kurdish STS dataset is presented: 10,000 sentence pairs spanning formal and informal registers, each annotated for similarity, to establish a reproducible evaluation suite and provide a strong starting point for future research on Kurdish semantics and low-resource NLP.

2510.03381.tldr: Experiments show that STDAE-GWNET consistently outperforms thirteen state-of-the-art baselines and achieves performance comparable to models using historical ramp data, demonstrating its effectiveness in overcoming detector scarcity and its plug-and-play potential for diverse forecasting pipelines.

2510.04116.tldr: A dynamic skeleton sampling algorithm that can derive any meta reasoning skeleton in search space efficiently and adapt skeleton to evolving base reasoning context, thus enable efficient query-aware skeleton search and achieves better reasoning performance than previous works broadly.

2510.04673.tldr: Watch&Learn (W&L), a framework that converts readily available Internet videos of human computer use into executable UI trajectories at scale, is presented, which casts trajectory annotation as an inverse dynamics problem that predicts user actions from consecutive screen states, which simplifies learning and generalizes across domains.

2510.05107.tldr: The Structured Cognitive Loop (SCL) is proposed as an alternative architecture that separates cognition, memory, and control in a single prompt, and shows higher goal fidelity, fewer redundant calls, and reduced unsupported assertions.

2510.12834.tldr: Gelina is introduced, a unified framework that jointly synthesizes speech and co-speech gestures from text using interleaved token sequences in a discrete autoregressive backbone, with modality-specific decoders.

2510.15859.tldr: This work introduces ORBIT, an open-ended rubric-based incremental training framework for high-stakes medical dialogue that consistently improves consultation quality across diverse medical scenarios and applies such rubric generation and training pipeline to InfoBench, where it enhances instruction-following performance, highlighting the generality of rubric-based feedback.

2510.16499.tldr: This work introduces a structured, automated framework for agentic system composition that is inspired by the knapsack problem, and dynamically testing candidate components and modeling their utility in real-time streamlines the assembly of agentic systems and facilitates scalable reuse of resources.

2510.17529.tldr: MambaX-Net is proposed, a novel semi-supervised, dual-scan 3D segmentation architecture that computes the segmentation for time point t by leveraging the MRI and the corresponding segmentation mask from the previous time point, and introduces a semi-supervised self-training strategy that leverages pseudo-labels generated from a pre-trained nnU-Net, enabling effective learning without expert annotations.

2510.18546.tldr: This paper proposes EfficientNav to enable on-device efficient LLM-based zero-shot ObjNav, and proposes semantics-aware memory retrieval to prune redundant information in navigation maps and discrete memory caching and attention-based memory clustering to efficiently save and re-use the KV cache.

2510.19732.tldr: Memo, a transformer-based architecture and training recipe for reinforcement learning (RL) on memory-intensive, long-horizon tasks, which incorporates the creation and retrieval of memory by interleaving periodic summarization tokens with the inputs of a model during training.

2510.20784.tldr: A coherence-based measure of AGI is introduced that integrates the generalized mean over a continuum of compensability exponents, yielding an area-under-the-curve (AUC) metric spanning arithmetic, geometric, and harmonic regimes, quantifying how robust an evaluated capability remains as compensability assumptions become stricter.

2510.27191.tldr: Vectorized Online POMDP Planner (VOPP), a novel parallel online solver that leverages a recent POMDP formulation which analytically solves part of the optimization component, leaving numerical computations to consist of only estimation of expectations, is proposed.

2511.00279.tldr: This work introduces LongCat-Flash-Omni, a state-of-the-art open-source omni-modal model with 560 billion parameters, excelling at real-time audio-visual interaction and develops a modality-decoupled parallelism scheme specifically designed to manage the data and model heterogeneity inherent in large-scale multimodal training.

2511.00417.tldr: This dissertation optimizes human-AI programming roles through self-determination theory and personality psychology, introducing the Role Optimization Motivation Alignment (ROMA) framework and an ISO/IEC 29110 extension enabling Very Small Entities to implement personality-driven role optimization within established standards.

2511.03103.tldr: An adaptive approach based on machine learning for software aging detection in environments subject to dynamic workload conditions is proposed, showing that static models suffer a notable performance drop when applied to unseen workload profiles, whereas the adaptive model with ADWIN maintains high accuracy.

2511.06906.tldr: This study proposes a method for extracting counterfactual explanation (CE) in time series forecasting using exogenous variables, which are frequently encountered in fields such as business and marketing and validates the proposed method through theoretical analysis and empirical experiments.

2511.08905.tldr: iSeal is proposed, the first fingerprinting method designed for reliable verification when the model thief controls the suspected LLM in an end-to-end manner, and it injects unique features into both the model and an external module, reinforced by an error-correction mechanism and a similarity-based verification strategy.

2511.09947.tldr: This work introduces EEGAgent, a general-purpose framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to schedule and plan multiple tools to automatically complete EEG-related tasks, and designs a toolbox composed of different tools for EEG preprocessing, feature extraction, event detection, etc.

2511.10416.tldr: This paper presents a counterexample showing that existing generalization bounds fail even in the Boolean setting, and introduces a unified framework for analogical reasoning in real-valued domains based on parameterized analogies defined via generalized means.

2511.10555.tldr: This paper affirm that a style is worth one numerical code by introducing the novel task, code-to-style image generation, which produces images with novel, consistent visual styles conditioned solely on a numerical style code.

2511.10674.tldr: This work introduces a framework for continual learning from human feedback in text-to-SQL, where a learning agent receives natural language feedback to refine queries and distills the revealed knowledge for reuse on future tasks.

2511.11423.tldr: CURENet is presented, a multimodal model (Combining Unified Representations for Efficient chronic disease prediction) that integrates unstructured clinical notes, lab tests, and patients’ time-series data by utilizing large language models for clinical text processing and textual lab tests, as well as transformer encoders for longitudinal sequential visits.

2511.11772.tldr: A theory-grounded system that uses five coordinated role-based LLM agents to score learner reflections with a shared rubric and to generate short, bias-aware, learner-facing comments that are well aligned with instructional goals is presented.

2511.11784.tldr: A novel detection framework called NegBLEURT Forest is proposed to evaluate the degree of alignment between outputs elicited by adversarial prompts and expected safe behaviors, and identifies anomalous responses using the Isolation Forest algorithm, enabling reliable jailbreak detection.

2511.18192.tldr: ARIAL (Agentic Reasoning for Interpretable Answer Localization), a modular framework that orchestrates specialized tools through an LLM-based planning agent to achieve both precise answer extraction and reliable spatial grounding, is presented, providing a pathway toward trustworthy, explainable document AI systems.

2511.18734.tldr: Yo'City is presented, a novel agentic framework that enables user-customized and infinitely expandable 3D city generation by leveraging the reasoning and compositional capabilities of off-the-shelf large models and consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation aspects.

2511.19229.tldr: This work proposes a learnable memory encoder DiT-Mem, composed of stacked 3D CNNs, low-/high-pass filters, and self-attention layers, which enables plug-and-play usage at inference time and demonstrates the effectiveness of the method in improving physical rule following and video fidelity.

2511.19482.tldr: Findings show that GenAI, especially through the CRLP, improved connections between abstract standards and learners lived experiences, and Teacher Agency was the strongest domain, while Cultural Representation was the weakest.

2511.20172.tldr: Beluga is the first system that enables GPUs to directly access large-scale memory pools through CXL switches, marking a significant step toward low-latency, shared access to vast memory resources by GPUs.

2511.20236.tldr: This work proposes a method for generating Diverse, Actionable, and kNowledge-Constrained Explanations (DANCE), which incorporates feature dependencies and causal constraints to ensure plausibility and real-world feasibility of counterfactuals.

2511.20737.tldr: CANVAS is introduced, a benchmark for VLMs on tool-based user interface design and results suggest that leading models exhibit more strategic tool invocations, improving design quality.

2511.21395.tldr: This work introduces Monet, a training framework that enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason directly within the latent visual space by generating continuous embeddings that function as intermediate visual thoughts and proposes VLPO (Visual-latent Policy Optimization), a reinforcement learning method that explicitly incorporates latent embeddings into policy gradient updates.

2511.21542.tldr: E0 is introduced, a continuized discrete diffusion framework that formulates action generation as iterative denoising over quantized action tokens that achieves state-of-the-art performance across 14 diverse environments, outperforming strong baselines by 10.7% on average.

2511.21631.tldr: Qwen3-VL is introduced, the most capable vision-language model in the Qwen series to date, achieving superior performance across a broad range of multimodal benchmarks, and three key upgrades are introduced, including an enhanced interleaved-MRoPE for stronger spatial-temporal modeling across images and video.

2511.21688.tldr: G$^2$VLM is a geometry grounded vision-language model that bridges two fundamental aspects of spatial intelligence: spatial 3D reconstruction and spatial understanding and is proficient in both tasks.

2511.21990.tldr: An operational agentic risk taxonomy is defined that unifies traditional safety and security concerns with novel, uniquely agentic risks, including tool misuse, cascading action chains, and unintended control amplification among others.

2511.22001.tldr: The evidence suggests that compact general-purpose models deliver near-optimal performance for most retinal classification tasks; specialized foundation models warranted only for fine-grained discrimination under extreme class imbalance.

2511.22016.tldr: AfriStereo is introduced, the first open-source African stereotype dataset and evaluation framework grounded in local socio-cultural contexts, offering key methodologies for the AI community on building more equitable, context-aware, and globally inclusive NLP technologies.

2511.22018.tldr: This work proposes MedEyes, a novel reinforcement learning framework that dynamically models clinician-style diagnostic reasoning by progressively attending to and interpreting relevant medical image regions by incorporating off-policy expert guidance, and introduces the Confidence Value Sampler, which employs nucleus sampling and adaptive termination to create diverse yet credible exploration paths.

2511.22031.tldr: This work introduces HealthPredictor, a domain-specific AI model that provides an end-to-end pipeline linking electricity use to public health outcomes and shows how AI models can be explicitly designed to enable health-informed energy management for advancing public health and broader societal well-being.

2511.22033.tldr: This work introduces a variance spectrum-driven anchor prototype library that preserves domain-invariant pathological patterns and employs a hierarchical differential prompt gating mechanism, dynamically selecting discriminative semantic prompts from both LVLM and LLM sources to address semantic confusion between adjacent DR grades.

2511.22044.tldr: A novel framework that incorporates an improved outline filling attack to achieve dense sampling of the model's security boundaries is proposed and a ranking regression paradigm is introduced that replaces standard regression and trains the proxy model to predict which prompt yields a higher ASR.

2511.22072.tldr: A novel forecasting framework namely HyperCast is developed, leveraging the expressive power of hypergraphs to model the higher-order spatiotemporal dependencies hidden in EV charging patterns, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicitly modeling collective charging behaviors for more accurate forecasting.

2511.22076.tldr: This work introduces a Double Dutch Auction model where overloaded FAs act as the buyers to request resources, and AAs serve as the sellers for resource provision and develops a diffusion-based Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithm to solve the model.

2511.22080.tldr: A momentum-guided global perturbation from server-aggregated momentum to align clients' SAM directions with the global descent geometry, enabling a single-backprop SAM approximation that preserves efficiency and a non-IID convergence bound that explicitly models the perturbation-induced variance.

2511.22095.tldr: Binary-30K, the first heterogeneous binary dataset designed for sequence-based models like transformers, is introduced, providing pre-computed byte-level BPE tokenization alongside comprehensive structural metadata, supporting both sequence modeling and structure-aware approaches.

2511.22143.tldr: A stacked ensemble model of fine-tuned Convolutional Neural Networks was developed for two classification tasks: a binary classifier for detecting the presence of KOA, and a multiclass classifier for precise grading across the KL spectrum.

2511.22147.tldr: This paper proposes the first effective and comprehensive black-box defense framework, named RemedyGS, against computation cost attacks, safeguarding 3DGS reconstruction systems and services and incorporates adversarial training into the purifier to enforce distributional alignment between the recovered and original natural images, thereby enhancing the defense efficacy.

2511.22151.tldr: The evaluations of the logical reasoning ability of AI generated texts are significantly influenced by the preconceived views on the logical reasoning abilities of AI, and frequent AI users were less likely to believe that AI usage undermines independent thinking.

2511.22167.tldr: IMTalker is presented, a novel framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity talking face generation through implicit motion transfer, and introduces an identity-adaptive module that projects motion latents into personalized spaces, ensuring clear disentanglement between motion and identity.

2511.22176.tldr: This work introduces Focused Chain-of-Thought (F-CoT), which separates information extraction from the reasoning process and highlights structured input as a simple yet effective lever for more efficient LLM reasoning.

2511.22178.tldr: A Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) model, incorporating Chebyshev Spectral Graph Convolution and Graph Attention Networks (GAT), is presented, to increase the classification accuracy of ASD utilizing multimodal neuroimaging and phenotypic data.

2511.22181.tldr: The results suggest that transformer-based methods that are used to combine the visual features along with the kinetic features such as the past trajectory features are not effective at combining both modes to produce useful scene context embeddings, but that predicting a distribution over multiple futures instead of a single future trajectory boosts planning performance.

2511.22188.tldr: Experimental results on three facial expression recognition datasets demonstrate that the proposed ARPGNet outperforms or is comparable to state-of-the-art methods.

2511.22199.tldr: PULSE-ICU is presented, a self-supervised foundation model that learns event-level ICU representations from large-scale EHR sequences without resampling or manual feature engineering, suggesting that foundation-style modeling can improve data efficiency and adaptability.

2511.22226.tldr: This work introduces a mathematical framework for prospective learning and embedded agency centered on self-prediction, where Bayesian RL agents predict both future perceptual inputs and their own actions, and must therefore resolve epistemic uncertainty about themselves as part of the universe they inhabit.

2511.22228.tldr: Experimental results show that this approach significantly improves 3D consistency compared to existing multi-view editing methods, and enables high-quality Gaussian Splat editing with sharp details and strong fidelity to user-specified text prompts.

2511.22232.tldr: This work designs a five-stage, context-aware instruction generation paradigm underpinned by a divide-and-conquer strategy that establishes a scalable and efficient paradigm for developing medical MLLMs capable of composite reasoning, bridging the gap between biomedical literature and real-world clinical applications.

2511.22239.tldr: This model estimates mutation-induced binding free energy changes in protein-nucleic acid complexes via five-fold cross-validation and showed good performance in complex-based five-fold cross-validation, which proved its robustness.

2511.22240.tldr: It is demonstrated that higher-dimensional embeddings significantly boost search quality and neural re-rankers further improve ranking accuracy, and future directions for pipeline automation and evaluation are outlined.

2511.22263.tldr: A comprehensive comparison of BM25, SPLADE, and Expanded-SPLADE models in the context of large-scale web document retrieval shows that Expanded-SPLADE strikes the best balance between effectiveness and efficiency, particularly when handling large datasets.

2511.22275.tldr: RecToM is proposed, a novel benchmark for evaluating LLM-based ToM evaluation with human-like social reasoning, and focuses on two complementary dimensions: Cognitive Inference and Behavioral Prediction.

2511.22292.tldr: This study uses Neural Ordinary Differential Equations and Universal Differential Equations, two pillars of Scientific Machine Learning, to construct adaptive tumor growth models capable of learning from experimental data and replaces rigid terms with adaptive neural networks to capture hidden dynamics through robust modeling in the Julia programming language.

2511.22302.tldr: An AI-assisted workflow that reduces expert involvement in parameter optimization through the use of Bayesian optimization is presented, based on a sheet metal forming process, and it is shown how it enables the exploration of the design space while reducing the need for expert involvement.

2511.22311.tldr: This work presents a decentralized, agent-based framework inspired by swarm intelligence for de novo protein design that achieves efficient, objective-directed designs within a few GPU-hours and operates entirely without fine-tuning or specialized training, offering a generalizable and adaptable solution for protein design.

2511.22330.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach automating high-fidelity video colorization using rich semantic guidance derived from language and segmentation, employing a language-conditioned diffusion model to colorize grayscale frames.

2511.22331.tldr: The oracle complexity of finding an $\epsilon$-stationary point with first-order methods with first-order methods when the upper-level problem is nonconvex and the lower-level problem is strongly convex is studied.

2511.22343.tldr: A physics-informed test-time training framework that enhances the accuracy and feasibility of ML-based PF surrogates by enforcing AC power flow equalities and operational constraints directly at inference time, representing a promising direction for scalable and physics-consistent learning in power system analysis.

2511.22364.tldr: This work proposes BINDER (Bridging INstant and DEliberative Reasoning), a dual process framework that decouples strategic planning from continuous environment monitoring, and achieves substantially higher success and efficiency than SoTA baselines.

2511.22367.tldr: Surprise-prioritised Replay (SuRe), a simple, architecture-agnostic rule that ranks and stores the most surprising sequences in LLM fine-tuning, is proposed and demonstrated that surprise-based selection and slow-weight consolidation are complementary components for mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

2511.22374.tldr: This paper obtains a sound and strongly complete proof system for the logic of distributed knowledge-how, which closely resembles the logic of distributed knowledge-that in both the axioms and the proof method of completeness.

2511.22376.tldr: Methods from mathematical logic and set theory are used to analyze the grounded extension, a widely-used model of maximally skeptical reasoning, defined as the least fixed-point of a natural defense operator, and determine the complexity of deciding grounded acceptance to be maximally complex.

2511.22377.tldr: The goal is to prove general results concerning the connection between conditionals and their probabilities, to characterize the probabilities of certain conditional connectives and to understand what class of updating procedures can be represented using specific conditional connectives.

2511.22386.tldr: This work begins by showing that, despite this limitation, minimal revision is still a successful learning method in a wide range of situations, and characterize the prior plausibility assignments that enable one to learn via minimal revision.

2511.22402.tldr: The results show that LLMs exhibit structured, depth-dependent sensitivity to clinical uncertainty, suggesting that epistemic information is progressively encoded in deeper layers within these models.

2511.22420.tldr: A flow-based approach and a selection of building blocks are presented as MATCH: a framework for engineering Multi-Agent Transparent and Controllable Human-centered systems that facilitate the integration of interpretability into existing interactive systems.

2511.22434.tldr: This paper proposes an efficient and effective mechanism FastFHE to accelerate the model inference while simultaneously retaining high inference accuracy over fully homomorphic encryption and adopts the low-degree Legendre polynomial to approximate the nonlinear smooth activation function SiLU under the guarantee of tiny accuracy error.

2511.22441.tldr: Experimental results show that GEO-Detective outperforms baseline large vision language models (LVLMs) overall, particularly on images lacking visible geographic features, and exhibits stronger robustness, highlighting the need for more effective privacy safeguards.

2511.22442.tldr: It is established that F_\beta-induced rankings are meaningful and defined a shortest path between precision- and recall-induced rankings, and the problem of finding a tradeoff between two scores is framed as an optimization problem expressed with Kendall rank correlations.

2511.22448.tldr: This work presents a pipeline that leverages Vision-Language Models to extract structured JSON representations of BPMN diagrams directly from images, without requiring source model files or textual annotations, and incorporates optical character recognition (OCR) for textual enrichment.

2511.22482.tldr: Two studies, using two Brazilian Indigenous languages, related but with significant structural linguistic characteristics, indicated none or very limited influence from those training factors, suggesting differences between languages may play a significant role in the ability to produce translators by fine-tuning pre-trained models.

2511.22493.tldr: HW-GNN is proposed, a novel homophily-aware graph spectral network with Gaussian window constraints that achieves state-of-the-art bot detection performance, outperforming existing methods with an average improvement of 4.3% in F1-score, while exhibiting strong plug-in compatibility with existing spectral GNNs.

2511.22521.tldr: DocVAL is proposed, a validated chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation framework that transfers explicit spatial reasoning from large teacher models to compact, deployable student VLMs and introduces mean Average Precision (mAP) as a localization metric for document question answering and report strong spatial grounding performance under this new evaluation.

2511.22532.tldr: CoT4AD is a novel VLA framework that introduces Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning for autonomous driving to enhance both numerical and causal reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs).

2511.22536.tldr: This paper proposes a computational framework viewed through the lens of game theory that prescribes how to make boudedly rational decisions while maintaining a theory of mind about others and employs statistical techniques and approximate solutions to retain computability of the inherent computational problem.

2511.22565.tldr: A systematic analysis comparing neural CQA models with an alternative, training-free query relaxation strategy that retrieves possible answers by relaxing query constraints and counting resulting paths finds several cases where neural and relaxation-based approaches perform similarly.

2511.22567.tldr: This work extends ConvCNPs with a Mixture Density Networks output head for epistemic uncertainty estimation and suggests that epistemic uncertainty driven sensor placement more effectively reduces model error than approaches based on overall uncertainty.

2511.22570.tldr: The resulting model, DeepSeekMath-V2, demonstrates strong theorem-proving capabilities, achieving gold-level scores on IMO 2025 and CMO 2024 and a near-perfect 118/120 on Putnam 2024 with scaled test-time compute.

2511.22586.tldr: The authors' experiments reveal that visual and longer CoT mainly accelerate convergence but do not lift the final performance ceiling; concise CoT containing only essential grounding steps outperforms longer traces; and, strikingly, CoT retaining only the minimal grounding results generalizes best across different maze sizes.

2511.22594.tldr: HarmoCLIP is proposed, a novel framework designed to harmonize global and region representations within CLIP and introduces an explicit fine-grained semantic supervision term that directly aligns textual segments with their corresponding visual regions, effectively bridging the image region space and the textual space.

2511.22607.tldr: A novel shape error regularization method to constrain pupil ellipse fitting and train on open-source datasets, enhancing semantic segmentation and pupil position prediction accuracy and building a gaze vector generation model that achieves reduced gaze angle error with lower computational complexity compared to other methods.

2511.22632.tldr: This work presents a multi-phase allocation method that addresses scalability and accuracy by dividing the problem into smaller sub-problems of day and shift allocation, which significantly reduces number of computational variables and allows for targeted objective functions, ultimately enhancing both efficiency and accuracy.

2511.22651.tldr: AUTO, an LLM agent framework that treats design optimization as a gradient-free search problem guided by strategic LLM reasoning, opens the door to automating design optimization in ill-defined search spaces with limited prior information.

2511.22659.tldr: Geometrically-Constrained Agent (GCA), a training-free agentic paradigm that resolves the semantic-to-geometric gap in spatial reasoning by introducing a formal task constraint, and achieves SOTA performance on multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks.

2511.22688.tldr: An algorithm is constructed that provably performs better ascent on the reward than standard test-time methods involving the gradient of the reward and can be used to either perform exact sampling via importance weighting or principled search that identifies local maximizers of the reward-tilted distribution.

2511.22707.tldr: CoFiRec is proposed, a novel generative recommendation framework that explicitly incorporates the Coarse-to-Fine nature of item semantics into the tokenization process, and it is proved that structured tokenization leads to lower dissimilarity between generated and ground truth items, supporting its effectiveness in generative recommendation.

2511.22715.tldr: ReAG is proposed, a novel Reasoning-Augmented Multimodal RAG approach that combines coarse- and fine-grained retrieval with a critic model that filters irrelevant passages, ensuring high-quality additional context in retrieved evidence.

2511.22729.tldr: This work introduces a method that enables LLMs to process and utilize tool responses of arbitrary length without loss of information by shifting the model's interaction from raw data to memory pointers, and reduces token usage and execution time.

2511.22737.tldr: The proposed agentic AI framework is an extension beyond traditional assistive systems since it incorporates inclusiveness, personalization, and accessibility at all levels and displays the intersection of multi-agent reasoning, multi-modal interfaces, and human-centered design that will enable the development of autonomy, health, and digital equity among people with disabilities and neurodivergence.

2511.22739.tldr: A significant improvement in average F1-score is added to existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) knowledge distillation approaches in domain generalization with histopathology datasets, which helps the way of deploying robust CPath models in real-world clinical problems with heterogeneous data sources.

2511.22749.tldr: VeriDispatcher is proposed, a multi-LLM RTL generation framework that dispatches each RTL task to suitable LLMs based on pre-inference difficulty prediction, enabling cost-effective, high-quality LLM deployment in hardware design automation.

2511.22751.tldr: The results show that training differentiable agents on structured intermediate supervision could pave the way towards exact gradient-based learning of algorithmic skills.

2511.22759.tldr: Three channel DDPMs can generate realistic and anatomically consistent dual view mammograms with promising applications in dataset augmentation and the impact of channel representations on image fidelity and cross view consistency.

2511.22767.tldr: Comparison of multi-year radar, satellite, and ground-based evaluation of the northern part of Pakistan demonstrates that the multi-agent configuration enhances forecast reliability, critical success index and warning lead time compared to the baseline models, leading to the conclusion that collaborative AI agents are capable of transforming atmospheric data streams into practicable foresight and provide a platform of scalable adaptive and learning-based climate resilience.

2511.22773.tldr: Context-Aware diffusion policy via Proximal mode Expansion (CAPE) is proposed, a framework that expands trajectory distribution modes with context-aware prior and guidance at inference via a novel prior-seeded iterative guided refinement procedure, demonstrating better generalization to unseen environments.

2511.22777.tldr: This work proposes an effective and scalable framework, Naturalistic Inpainting for Context Enhancement (NICE), which minimizes out-of-distribution (OOD) gap in imitation learning by increasing visual diversity through construction of new experiences using existing demonstrations.

2511.22780.tldr: This work proposes an evaluation protocol for examining the performance of robotic manipulation policies in cluttered scenes using a unified measure of clutter that accounts for environmental factors as well as the distractors quantity, characteristics, and arrangement and shows that the clutter measure is an effective indicator of performance degradation.

2511.22781.tldr: This study examines parameters such as model size, repository activity, task type, and organizational affiliation to identify key factors influencing the environmental impact of AI development and aims to guide future efforts toward building a more ecologically responsible AI ecosystem.

2511.22823.tldr: A principled, unified framework is proposed that bypasses post-hoc adjustments by directly formulating a stable surrogate risk grounded in the structure of weakly supervised data and establishes a non-asymptotic generalization bound via Rademacher complexity that clarifies how supervision structure, model capacity, and sample size jointly govern performance.

2511.22880.tldr: LoRAServe is presented, a workload-aware dynamic adapter placement and routing framework designed to tame rank diversity in LoRA serving that maximizes throughput and minimizes tail latency under real-world workload drift.

2511.22884.tldr: This work thoroughly investigates shortcomings in InsightBench and proposes essential criteria for a high-quality insight benchmark, which is developed a data-curation pipeline to construct a new dataset named InsightEval, and introduces a novel metric to measure the exploratory performance of agents.

2511.22888.tldr: Adversarially Trained PRMs are introduced, where a Generator learns to produce reasoning errors to deceive a PRM, while the PRM concurrently learns to detect them, improving its robustness and generalization to novel errors without requiring manual step-level labels.

2511.22891.tldr: Results show that Mentalese-style compressed reasoning offers a step toward human-like cognitive efficiency, enabling real-time, cost-effective reasoning without sacrificing accuracy.

2511.22893.tldr: This work parametrize control actions via the duty cycle, a continuous variable that encodes the ON-to-OFF switching time within each forcing period, thereby respecting the intrinsic binary nature of the light intensity.

2511.22903.tldr: CORTEX (COmpositional Reasoning-aware TEXt-guided), a novel framework that integrates complementary textual cues to enhance change understanding, enables CORTEX to reason over visual and textual features and capture changes that are otherwise ambiguous in visual features alone.

2511.22911.tldr: This challenge confirms the substantial benefit of SSL for complex, instance-level medical image segmentation tasks where labeled data is scarce and benchmark and advance semi-supervised learning (SSL) as a solution for this data scarcity problem.

2511.22944.tldr: This work reinterpret adaptive subset selection as a multi-armed bandit problem, where each arm corresponds to a submodular function guiding sample selection, and introduces ONLINESUBMOD, a novel online greedy policy that optimizes a utility-driven reward and provably achieves no-regret performance under various sampling regimes.

2511.22963.tldr: Humanoid-LLA is introduced, a Large Language Action Model that maps expressive language commands to physically executable whole-body actions for humanoid robots, outperforming existing language-conditioned whole-body control methods in motion naturalness, stability, and execution success rate.

2511.22977.tldr: This work positions attention-based token encoders as robust, architecture-centric foundations for veracity tasks, isolating Transformer contributions from classifier complexity.

2511.22982.tldr: The results indicate that combining a strong multimodal backbone with a carefully designed, text-focused training recipe is sufficient to achieve reliable bilingual text rendering without resorting to oversized or proprietary models.

2511.22990.tldr: This work proposes MIMM-X, a framework that disentangles causal features from multiple spurious correlations by minimizing their mutual information, and demonstrates that MIMM-X effectively mitigates shortcut learning of multiple spurious correlations.

2511.23007.tldr: This paper proposes a Transferable Software Requirement Conflict Detection Framework based on SBERT and SimCSE, termed TSRCDF-SS, which synergistically integrates sequential and cross-domain transfer learning.

2511.23031.tldr: This work establishes visual rationalization as a task-agnostic, process-grounded paradigm for building transparent, verifiable, and trustworthy vision-language models.

2511.23036.tldr: Delta-XAI is proposed, which adapts 14 existing XAI methods through a wrapper function and introduces a principled evaluation suite for the online setting, assessing diverse aspects, such as faithfulness, sufficiency, and coherence, and proposes SWING, which incorporates past observations in the integration path to systematically capture temporal dependencies and mitigate out-of-distribution effects.

2511.23043.tldr: The model produced fields that are more spatially coherent than mean squared error based models and CRPS based models without the spectral component in the loss, showing competitive forecasts when evaluated against observations from surface weather stations.

2511.23066.tldr: Findings show that, although visually realistic, foundation model-based inpainting can obscure subtle but clinically relevant features and introduce latent bias even when edits are confined to non-diagnostic regions, underscoring the need for rigorous, task-specific validation before integrating such generative tools into clinical AI workflows.

2511.23071.tldr: The Bharat Scene Text Dataset (BSTD) is introduced - a large-scale and comprehensive benchmark for studying Indian Language Scene Text Recognition that comprises more than 100K words that span 11 Indian languages and English, sourced from over 6,500 scene images captured across various linguistic regions of India.

2511.23097.tldr: This work proposes a set of mechanisms that merge techniques from online algorithms with rules from social choice -- such as the Method of Equal Shares and the Nash Rule -- and supports them through both theoretical analysis and extensive experimental evaluation.

2511.23101.tldr: The findings show that current out-of-the-box LLMs are not yet suitable for APPT, and that careful coordination of prompt design, trait framing, and evaluation metrics is essential for interpretable results.

2511.23122.tldr: This work proposes Temporal Policy Evolution for Traffic, which uses LLMs as an evolution engine to derive specialized heuristic policies optimized for specific traffic environments, outperforming both heuristics and online LLM actors.

2511.23136.tldr: A novel reasoning framework called Multi-chain Graph Refinement&Selection (MGRS), which first generates multiple diverse reasoning trajectories for a given problem, refines candidate responses using a composite self- and cross-verification strategy, then constructs a reasoning relation graph and estimates the success rate of intermediate nodes, and finally computes cumulative success rates to select the most reliable answer and corresponding reasoning trajectory.

2511.23148.tldr: Improvements in electricity cost and peak hour demand reduction, and increase electricity selling revenue are attributed to both MARL algorithms and P2P energy trading, which together results in electricity cost and peak hour demand reduction, and increase electricity selling revenue.

2511.23159.tldr: Vibe coding, the much-touted use of AI techniques for programming, faces two overwhelming obstacles: the difficulty of specifying goals and the hallucination phenomenon.

2511.23183.tldr: This study applies text mining techniques and machine learning to data collected from Dark Web forums in Brazilian Portuguese to identify malicious posts and applies topic modeling to validate the model's outputs on unlabeled data, confirming its robustness in real-world scenarios.

2511.23184.tldr: This work employs reasoning-based generation to output both the quadruple and a natural language rationale under element prefixes within a unified template, encouraging explicit relational reasoning and interpretability and introduces a listwise preference optimization framework for improving structural validity and relational coherence.

2511.23186.tldr: UNOGrasp is presented, a learning-based vision-language model capable of performing visually-grounded obstruction reasoning to infer the sequence of actions needed to unobstruct the path and grasp the target object, and anchor each reasoning step with obstruction-aware visual cues to incentivize reasoning capability.

2511.23199.tldr: This work introduces Vision Bridge Transformer (ViBT), a large-scale instantiation of Brownian Bridge Models designed for conditional generation and proposes a variance-stabilized velocity-matching objective for robust training, highlighting the power of scaling Bridge Models for instruction-based image editing and complex video translation.

2511.23203.tldr: An error model of GAVINA, a novel architecture that supports arbitrary mixed precision and flexible undervolting, is developed and it is shown that GAV can achieve an energy efficiency boost of 20% via undervolting, with negligible accuracy degradation on ResNet-18.

2511.23235.tldr: This work establishes a foundational baseline for Hindi tourism QA systems, emphasizing the role of LORA in low-resource settings and underscoring the need for culturally contextualized NLP frameworks in the tourism domain.

2511.23249.tldr: This work proposes a novel learning-based method for estimating aboveground biomass directly from a single RGB image, opening up the possibility for a scalable, interpretable, and cost-effective solution for forest monitoring, while also enabling broader participation through citizen science initiatives.

2511.23252.tldr: Hyb-Agg is presented, a lightweight and communication-efficient secure aggregation protocol that integrates Multi-Key CKKS (MK-CKKS) homomorphic encryption with Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman-based additive masking and reduces the secure aggregation process to a single, non-interactive client-to-server transmission per round, ensuring that per-client communication remains constant regardless of the number of participants.

2511.23253.tldr: This work introduces AgroCoT, a VQA dataset that integrates Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, specifically designed to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of VLMs, and reveals a gap in their reasoning capabilities.
