2511.23260.tldr: A novel model named interleaved dual-branch Probability Distribution Network (interPDN) is proposed, which directly constructs discrete probability distributions per step instead of a scalar in deep neural network-based time series prediction models.

2511.23262.tldr: Inspired by the dual structure of human metacognition, metacognitive test-time reasoning (MCTR) is proposed, a framework that equips models with the ability to learn, adapt, and improve during test time through metacognitive self-updating.

2511.23269.tldr: This work focuses on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and explores data recipes that leverage structured reasoning traces and indicates that curating a high-quality, diverse training dataset with varying structured reasoning trace lengths enables the fine-tuned model to self-calibrate its reasoning trajectory lengths based on the downstream task, without explicit supervision.

2511.23274.tldr: A method for recovering high-quality images from under-sampled data with simultaneously correction for noise and motion artefact called USArt (Under-Sampling and Artifact correction model), customized for 2D brain anatomical images acquired with Cartesian sampling.

2511.23290.tldr: This dissertation explores deep learning methodologies to improve the analysis and visualization of spatio-temporal scientific ensembles, focusing on dimensionality reduction, flow estimation, and temporal interpolation, and introduces HyperFLINT, a hypernetwork-based approach that conditions on simulation parameters to estimate flow fields and interpolate scalar data.

2511.23304.tldr: This paper introduces a new multi-modal scene graph that explicitly models the objects and their relationship as a visually grounded, structured representation of the audio-visual scene, and designs a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network~(KAN)-based Mixture of Experts (MoE) to enhance the expressive power of the temporal integration stage.

2511.23307.tldr: A framework for physics-informed learning in complex cyber-physical systems governed by differential equations with both unknown dynamics and algebraic invariants is presented and the Projected HRPINN (PHRPINN) is introduced, a novel extension that integrates a predict-project mechanism to strictly enforce algebraic invariants by design.

2511.23311.tldr: The experimental results demonstrate that while pre-trained LVLMs have limited effectiveness, fine-tuned LVLMs can generate accurate and safety-aware driving instructions, particularly in detecting subtle or complex events in the video.

2511.23319.tldr: HSA-UltraLong is built, which is an 8B-parameter MoE model trained on over 8 trillion tokens and is rigorously evaluated on different tasks with in-domain and out-of-domain context lengths to demonstrate its capability in handling ultra-long contexts.

2511.23340.tldr: This work proposes ParaGate, a three-step cross-stage prediction framework that infers layout-level timing and power from netlists, and demonstrates that ParaGate could provide guidance for global optimization in the synthesis and placement stages.

2511.23342.tldr: Rectified MeanFlow is proposed, a self-distillation approach that learns the mean-velocity field over a straightened velocity field, induced by rectified couplings from a pretrained model, and introduces a distance-based truncation heuristic that prunes residual high-curvature pairs to achieve strong one-step generation performance.

2511.23366.tldr: An agentic AI model will be used to monitor the inventory, initiate purchase attempts to the appropriate suppliers, and scan for trending or high-margin products to incorporate, which indicates that there is a decrease in stockouts, a reduction of inventory holding costs, and an improvement in product mix turnover.

2511.23387.tldr: The Hierarchical AI-Meteorologist is presented, an LLM-agent system that generates explainable weather reports using a hierarchical forecast reasoning and weather keyword generation, offering a reproducible framework for semantic evaluation of automated meteorological reporting and advancing agent-based scientific reasoning.

2511.23397.tldr: MegaChat is introduced, the first fully synthetic Persian Q&A dataset designed to evaluate intelligent sales chatbots in Telegram-based e-commerce and demonstrates its ability to generate scalable, high-quality datasets without relying on expensive human annotation or complex fine-tuning.

2511.23404.tldr: Using hardware-in-the-loop architecture search under edge latency and memory constraints, a compact hybrid backbone is obtained that combines gated short convolutions with a small number of grouped query attention blocks, delivering up to 2x faster prefill and decode on CPUs compared to similarly sized models.

2511.23408.tldr: Evaluating the patching effectiveness and complementarity of several prominent LLMs, such as OpenAI's GPT variants, LLaMA, DeepSeek, and Mistral models, using both real and artificial vulnerabilities reveals that LLMs patch real vulnerabilities more effectively compared to artificial ones.

2511.23436.tldr: It is posited that pairing a trainable learner with a reasoning-capable verifier forms a minimal reliable unit of growing intelligence, as paired feedback and partial-history replay yield richer learning curricula and stronger preference alignment.

2511.23449.tldr: This work presents a PINN-based iterative framework to estimate the thermal conductivity k of a wall from a set of thermographs, and demonstrates the potential of PINN-based methods for reliable estimation of material properties in situ and under realistic conditions, without lengthy measurement campaigns.

2511.23455.tldr: The largest dataset of current and historical prices to run benchmarks to date is used, finding that the price for a given level of benchmark performance has decreased remarkably fast and the price of running frontier models is rising between $3\times$ to $18\times$ per year due to bigger models and larger reasoning demands.

2511.23476.tldr: This work explores world-model internalization through efficient interaction and active reasoning (WMAct), which liberates the model from structured reasoning, allowing the model to shape thinking directly through its doing, and achieves effective and efficient world model reasoning.

2410.02429.tldr: IoT-LLM is proposed, a unified framework that significantly improves the performance of IoT-sensory task reasoning of LLMs, with models such as GPT-4o-mini showing a 49.4% average improvement over previous methods.

2412.00138.tldr: This work builds a two-branch joint training pipeline with an adversarial discriminator to bridge the syn-to-real gap, and shows remarkable robustness in dynamic driving scenarios under varying weather conditions and in day-to-night scenarios, where previous APR methods fail.

2502.03492.tldr: It is demonstrated that critics trained with $\texttt{CTRL}$ significantly enhance pass rates and mitigate compounding errors across both base and stronger generator models, and it is shown that these critic models act as accurate generative reward models and enable test-time scaling through iterative critique-revision.

2502.12048.tldr: This survey consolidates and analyzes developments across EEG-to-image synthesis, EEG-to-text generation, and EEG-to-audio reconstruction, and highlights open-source datasets and baseline implementations to facilitate systematic benchmarking and accelerate progress in EEG-driven neural decoding.

2503.07338.tldr: Delta-Triplane Transformers (DTT), a novel 4D OWM for autonomous driving, is proposed, that introduces two key innovations: a triplane based representation that encodes 3D occupancy more compactly than previous approaches, and an incremental prediction strategy for OWM that models {\em changes} in occupancy rather than dealing with full states.

2503.08906.tldr: This work proposes an optimal transport (OT)-guided prompt learning framework that mitigates forgetting by preserving the structural consistency of feature distributions between pre-trained and fine-tuned models, and enforces joint constraints on both vision and text representations, ensuring a holistic feature alignment.

2504.01970.tldr: A novel deep learning-based framework for network equivalency that enhances DC-OPF to more closely mimic the behavior of AC-OPF is proposed, incorporating a neural network trained to predict adjusted nodal shunt conductances and branch susceptances in order to account for nonlinear power flow behavior.

2505.18151.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that WonderPlay enables users to interact with various scenes of diverse content, including cloth, sand, snow, liquid, smoke, elastic, and rigid bodies -- all using a single image input.

2505.18884.tldr: LORE utilizes constrained optimization, which offers a principled approach to balancing competing goals, such as improving robustness while preserving nominal performance, and shows that LORE significantly improves zero-shot adversarial robustness with minimal degradation in clean data accuracy.

2506.03543.tldr: This work develops a novel adventure-based personality test that evaluates true personality through behavioral choices within interactive scenarios, bypassing self-presentation bias found in traditional assessments and establishes a foundation for intelligent dating platforms and HR technology solutions.

2506.11679.tldr: This chapter introduces state-of-the-art research that applied LLMs to mitigate the top 10 common security risks of smartphone platforms and presents an approach to detect sensitive data leakage when users share images online, a common behavior of smartphone users nowadays.

2507.05068.tldr: A linear scaling law on membership inference, exposing the vulnerability of large foundation models is exposed, and training data from scale-wise visual autoregressive models is easier to detect than other autoregressive paradigms.

2507.07820.tldr: A roadmap for broadly integrating adaptive sensing into real-world applications spanning humanoid, healthcare, autonomous systems, agriculture, and environmental monitoring is outlined, and targeted research directions, such as standardized benchmarks, real-time adaptive algorithms, multimodal integration, and privacy-preserving methods are proposed.

2508.11278.tldr: This work presents the first dynamic benchmarking framework to evaluate data-induced cognitive biases in GPAI within software engineering workflows and finds a consistent tendency to rely on shallow linguistic heuristics over more complex reasoning in leading GPAI systems.

2508.11999.tldr: This work proposes the first generative MLLM-based model named MOON, which employs a guided Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) module for targeted modeling of multimodal and aspect-specific product content and introduces the specialized negative sampling strategy to increase the difficulty and diversity of negative samples.

2509.01787.tldr: This work proposes AHAMask, where some of the attention heads in the decoder-only LLM backbone of LALMs are masked to trigger specific acoustic task functionalities without instructions, to achieve reliable acoustic task specification for LALMs.

2509.23728.tldr: This work introduces M3DLayout, a large-scale, multi-source dataset for 3D indoor layout generation, integrating three distinct sources: real-world scans, professional CAD designs, and procedurally generated scenes, which provides rich small-object information enabling the generation of more complex and detailed scenes.

2509.24365.tldr: The proposed Uni-X, a two-end-separated, middle-shared architecture that dedicates its initial and final layers to modality-specific processing, while maintaining shared parameters in the middle layers for high-level semantic fusion, establishes Uni-X as a parameter-efficient and scalable foundation for future unified multimodal modeling.

2510.01800.tldr: REBot, an LLM enhanced advisory chatbot powered by CatRAG, a hybrid retrieval reasoning framework that integrates retrieval augmented generation with graph based reasoning, is proposed.

2510.03638.tldr: It is proved that for a broad class of implicit models, this process lets the model's expressive power scale with test-time compute, ultimately matching a much richer function class.

2510.03805.tldr: This work introduces Step Pruner (SP), an RL framework that steers LRMs toward more efficient reasoning by favoring compact reasoning steps, and proposes a dynamic stopping mechanism: when the model's output no longer shortens, training is halted to prevent hacking behavior caused by the merging of steps.

2510.23637.tldr: A graph-augmented approach is presented that combines dense text embeddings of Lean formalizations with graph neural networks over a heterogeneous dependency graph capturing both state-premise and premise-premise relations, suggesting that relational information is beneficial for premise selection.

2511.00739.tldr: This paper aims to characterize and analyze the system bottlenecks introduced by agentic AI workloads from a largely overlooked CPU-centric perspective and presents two scheduling optimizations, namely, 1. CPU-Aware Overlapped Micro-Batching (COMB) and 2. Mixed Agentic Scheduling (MAS) on homogeneous and heterogeneous agentic workloads, respectively.

2511.12003.tldr: The Chain-of-Evidence (CoE) paradigm for VD-RAG is introduced, a reinforcement learning framework that trains models to produce verifiable reasoning paths with consistent attribution and not only outperforms the supervised fine-tuning baseline, which is trained to directly produce answers with attribution, but also exhibits stronger generalization across domains.

2511.21428.tldr: To the knowledge, this is the first fully automated end-to-end system for extracting and organizing VLA pre-training data from unstructured industrial videos, offering a scalable solution for embodied AI integration in manufacturing.

2511.21510.tldr: The results using several LLMs showed that cooperative tools accounted for only 7.09% of all tools, indicating that LLM-based agents rarely invoked others as assistants, suggesting that current LLMs tend to maintain active agents while seldom deactivating them for adaptive coordination.

2512.00004.tldr: A novel framework that enhances talent search effectiveness and delivers substantial business value through two key innovations: leveraging LLMs to extract fine-grained recruitment signals from job descriptions and historical hiring data, and employing a role-aware multi-gate MoE network to capture behavioral differences across recruiter roles.

2512.00007.tldr: SAFE demonstrates robust improvements in long-form COVID-19 fact-checking by addressing LLM limitations in consistency and explainability by addressing LLM limitations in consistency and explainability.

2512.00010.tldr: A structured ideation session involving inspirational stimuli is proposed and Gen AI is utilised in delivering this structure to designers through ALIA: Analogical LLM Ideation Agent, a tool for small-group ideation scenarios.

2512.00015.tldr: The first human studies using CBMs to evaluate their human interaction in collaborative task settings show that CBMs improve interpretability compared to standard DNNs, leading to increased human-machine alignment, but this increased alignment did not translate to a significant increase in task accuracy.

2512.00016.tldr: This work proposes agentic automated processor design and verification with engineers in the loop, and designed various digital systems using this approach, indicating that hardware design and verification experimentation can be done cost effectively without using any specialized hardware.

2512.00019.tldr: This survey offers a critical, structured review of Surgical Digital Twins, and proposes a taxonomy by purpose, model fidelity, and data sources, and synthesizes state-of-the-art achievements in deformable registration and tracking, real-time simulation and co-simulation, AR/VR guidance, edge-cloud orchestration, and AI for scene understanding and prediction.

2512.00027.tldr: It is advocated that the future VLN systems should support proactive clarification, real-time feedback, and contextual reasoning through advanced natural language understanding (NLU) techniques, which are essential for scalable, efficient multi-robot collaboration.

2512.00030.tldr: DRIQN is proposed to integrate Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) with implicit quantile networks to optimize worst-case performance under natural environmental conditions, and incorporates heterogeneous noise sources and target robustness-critical scenarios.

2512.00039.tldr: NL4RA, a curated dataset comprising 50 resource allocation optimization problems formulated as LP, ILP, and MILP, is introduced and LLM-Assisted Mathematical Evaluation (LAME), an automated metric designed for mathematical formulations is introduced, which surpasses these baselines regarding LAME and other metrics.

2512.00040.tldr: This paper explores the use of Large Language Models to tackle radio resource allocation for network slicing by using an LLM in a zero-shot setting to directly assign user service requests to slices, and formulating an integer programming model where the LLM provides semantic insight by estimating similarity between requests.

2512.00045.tldr: This work investigates how prompting strategies affect RTL-to-specification quality and introduces metrics for faithfully evaluating generated specs, and benchmarks open-source and commercial LLMs, providing a foundation for more automated and efficient specification workflows in IC design.

2512.00046.tldr: The study evaluates the performance of six open-source LLMs compared to human experts, revealing a peculiar dichotomy: human coders consistently perform well when labeling complex sentences but struggle with simpler ones, while LLMs exhibit the opposite trend.

2512.00047.tldr: This work demonstrates how black-box interaction analysis can surface emergent coordination strategies, offering a scalable complement to internal probe-based interpretability methods.

2512.00048.tldr: This work presents a novel framework called Causal structure-aware Reinforcement Learning (CRL) that explicitly integrates causal discovery and reasoning into policy optimization, and demonstrates the promise of causal reinforcement learning for human-robot interaction applications, where interpretability, adaptiveness, and data efficiency are paramount.

2512.00049.tldr: This work critically analyzes the integration of value-based, policy-based, and actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithms alongside neural network architectures, such as feedforward, recurrent, convolutional, graph, and transformer networks, for enhancing agent learning and representation in socially aware navigation.

2512.00050.tldr: A novel reinforcement learning from implicit human feedback (RLIHF) framework that utilizes non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) signals, specifically error-related potentials (ErrPs) to provide continuous, implicit feedback without requiring explicit user intervention is proposed.

2512.00055.tldr: This work proposes KAN-SAs, a novel SA-based accelerator that leverages intrinsic properties of B-splines to enable efficient KAN inference, and enhances conventional SAs, enabling efficient KAN inference, in addition to conventional DNNs.

2512.00060.tldr: This study introduces PEFT-DML, a parameter-efficient deep metric learning framework for robust multi-modal 3D object detection in autonomous driving that achieves significant training efficiency while enhancing robustness to fast motion, weather variability, and domain shifts.

2512.00062.tldr: Empirical results on robotic manipulation benchmarks show that RL fine-tuning initialized from this tempo-enriched policy significantly improves the sample efficiency of existing RL and policy acceleration methods while maintaining high success rate.

2512.00069.tldr: This project combines a Large Language Model with symbolic planning to suggest that adding LLM commonsense to classical planning can make robot behavior in realistic scenarios more reliable.

2512.00070.tldr: A technique to assist in converting a reference layout of an analog circuit into the procedural layout generator by efficiently reusing available generators for sub-cell creation by efficiently reusing available generators for sub-cell creation is proposed.

2512.00078.tldr: The findings suggest that diffusion-based synthetic data generation is a promising avenue for augmenting real datasets in microscopy image analysis, reducing the reliance on extensive manual annotation and potentially improving the robustness of cell detection models.

2512.00079.tldr: By partitioning circuits into fanout-free regions (FFRs) and incorporating ATPG-specific features into a novel QGNN architecture, InF-ATPG enhances test pattern generation efficiency and reduces backtracks, Experimental results show.

2512.00085.tldr: Hyper-GoalNet is introduced, a framework that generates task-specific policy network parameters from goal specifications using hypernetworks that demonstrates significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art methods, particularly in high-variability conditions.

2512.00097.tldr: HAGeo is proposed, a Heuristic-based method for adding Auxiliary constructions in Geometric deduction that solves 28 of 30 problems on the IMO-30 benchmark, achieving gold-medal level performance and surpassing AlphaGeometry, a competitive neural network-based approach, by a notable margin.

2512.00105.tldr: This paper presents the first sampling approach designed to handle interval patterns in numerical databases, named Fips, and formally proves that Fips and HFips sample interval patterns in proportion to their frequency and the product of hyper-volume and frequency, respectively.

2512.00113.tldr: This tutorial paper outlines the main architectural design principles behind fully digital neuromorphic processors and illustrates them using the SENECA platform using the SENECA platform as a running example to provide a coherent, step-by-step architectural perspective for students and practitioners who wish to design their own digital neuromorphic processors.

2512.00119.tldr: NetDeTox is presented, an automated end-to-end framework that orchestrates large language models with reinforcement learning (RL) in a systematic manner, enabling focused local rewriting of adversarial netlist rewrites.

2512.00120.tldr: This work constructs ArtiCaps, a pseudo feeling-aligned image-music-text dataset created by semantically matching descriptions from ArtEmis and MusicCaps, and proposes Art2Music, a lightweight cross-modal framework that synthesizes music from artistic images and user comments.

2512.00126.tldr: In RadDiff, a novel retrieval-augmentation mechanism is designed to capture the up-to-date protein knowledge and a knowledge-aware diffusion model that integrates this protein knowledge into the diffusion process via a lightweight module.

2512.00129.tldr: A comprehensive approach integrating ResNet50-based OOD filtering with YOLO architectures with YOLO architectures for accurate detection of breast cancer through a fundamental foundation for the deployment of reliable AI-based breast cancer detection systems in diverse clinical environments with inherent data heterogeneity.

2512.00134.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art large language models on assembly-to-source translation using a diverse set of metrics capturing lexical similarity, semantic alignment, fluency, fluency, and efficiency, and reveals clear trade-offs.

2512.00142.tldr: The Decentralized Finance (DeFi) TrustBoost Framework is introduced, which combines blockchain technology and Explainable AI to address challenges faced by lenders underwriting small business loan applications from low-wealth households.

2512.00168.tldr: A stochastic theory of deep information propagation (DIP) by incorporating Central Limit Theorem (CLT)-level fluctuations is derived and it is demonstrated that activation function design controls the collective dynamics in random DNNs.

2512.00179.tldr: These results demonstrate that compact, domain-specific CNNs can outperform large backbones for speckle-based material classification, advancing the feasibility of material-aware, edge-deployable laser cutting systems.

2512.00193.tldr: A statistical framework is built that stitches benchmarks together, putting model capabilities and benchmark difficulties on a single numerical scale, acting as a "Rosetta Stone", allowing us to compare models across a wide range of abilities and time, even if they are not evaluated on the same benchmarks.

2512.00207.tldr: An MLP construction framework that improves over previous constructions in three areas: it works for all but a measure-zero set of feasible input-output pairs, achieves asymptotically optimal parameter efficiency matching information-theoretic bounds for some embeddings, and maintains usability within Transformers for factual recall.

2512.00211.tldr: This contribution focuses on the prediction of the Frame Delivery Ratio (FDR), a key metric that represents the percentage of successful transmissions, starting from time sequences of binary outcomes (success/failure) collected in a real scenario.

2512.00226.tldr: DenseScan is introduced, a novel dataset with detailed multi-level descriptions generated by an automated pipeline leveraging multi-view 2D images and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that enables dense captioning of scene elements, ensuring comprehensive object-level descriptions that capture context-sensitive details.

2512.00231.tldr: This work introduces CodeFlowLM, an incremental learning framework for Just-In-Time Software Defect Prediction (JIT-SDP) that leverages pre-trained language models (PLMs) that significantly advances the state of the art in incremental JIT-SDP, demonstrating superior adaptability and robustness in evolving software environments.

2512.00243.tldr: The results demonstrate that front-loading information investment significantly reduces the costs associated with redundant data acquisition and enhances the precision of reserve valuation, suggesting that optimal investment timing is structurally dependent on market competition rather than solely on price volatility.

2512.00249.tldr: A novel hierarchical hybrid artificial intelligence approach that synergizes the reliability and predictability of scripted agents with the dynamic, adaptive learning capabilities of RL is introduced, providing a robust, adaptable, and effective solution for developing and training intelligent agents in complex simulation environments.

2512.00267.tldr: This work proposes a novel automated fact-checking framework called Trification, which begins by generating a comprehensive set of verification actions to ensure complete coverage of the claim and structured these actions into a dependency graph to model the logical interaction between actions.

2512.00269.tldr: USB (Unified Synthetic Brain) is introduced, the first end-to-end framework that unifies bidirectional generation and editing of pathological and healthy brain images and opens opportunities for scalable dataset creation and robust neuroimaging analysis.

2512.00271.tldr: This retrospective study included adult patients who presented to the emergency department between January 2022 and April 2025 and underwent same-day CXR and CT for febrile or respiratory symptoms and exhibited variable performance in report quality and diagnostic measures.

2512.00275.tldr: HIMOSA leverages the inherent redundancy in remote sensing imagery and introduces a content-aware sparse attention mechanism, enabling the model to achieve fast inference while maintaining strong reconstruction performance.

2512.00287.tldr: This work introduces the RealAppliance dataset, comprising 100 high-fidelity appliances with complete physical, electronic mechanisms, and program logic aligned with their manuals, and proposes the RealAppliance-Bench benchmark, which evaluates multimodal large language models and embodied manipulation planning models across key tasks in appliance manipulation planning.

2512.00290.tldr: E EduEval is introduced, a comprehensive hierarchical benchmark for evaluating LLMs in Chinese K-12 education, revealing that while models perform well on factual tasks, they struggle with classroom dialogue classification and exhibit inconsistent results in creative content generation.

2512.00293.tldr: FiCoTS is proposed, an LLM-enhanced fine-to-coarse framework for multimodal time series forecasting that facilitates progressive cross-modality interaction by three levels in a fine-to-coarse scheme and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2512.00294.tldr: A modular AR agent system that integrates multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with grounded vision models to enable relational reasoning in space and language-conditioned spatial retrieval in physical environments is presented.

2512.00303.tldr: A novel attack method called Regularization Gradient Inversion Attack (RGIA) is proposed, which enforces prior-knowledge-based regularization on states, rewards, and transition dynamics during the optimization process to ensure that the reconstructed data remain close to the true transition distribution.

2512.00305.tldr: This paper proposes PointCoT, which integrates reflective interaction into chain-of-thought reasoning in charts by prompting MLLMs to generate bounding boxes and re-render charts based on location annotations, and establishes connections between textual reasoning steps and visual grounding regions.

2512.00306.tldr: VCWorld is presented, a cell-level white-box simulator that integrates structured biological knowledge with the iterative reasoning capabilities of large language models to instantiate a biological world model and generates interpretable, stepwise predictions alongside explicit mechanistic hypotheses.

2512.00323.tldr: This study benchmarked the performance of 47 CBQA models from Hugging Face on eight different datasets and identified the best-performing model, ahotrod/electra_large_discriminator_squad2_512, which yielded 43% accuracy across all datasets.

2512.00325.tldr: This work proposes a progressive code-integration framework for LLM-based abstractive bug report summarization that incrementally incorporates long code snippets alongside textual content, overcoming standard LLM context window constraints and producing semantically rich summaries.

2512.00329.tldr: This work proposes a SQL-based approach that involves generating a 3NF schema from Wikipedia infoboxes, generating SQL queries, and query execution, and establishes three evidence-based principles: normalization that preserves context, semantic naming that reduces ambiguity, and consistent temporal anchoring.

2512.00331.tldr: CogEvo-Edu, a hierarchical educational multi-agent system comprising a Cognitive Perception Layer (CPL), a Knowledge Evolution Layer (KEL), and a Meta-Control Layer (MCL), argues that retrieval, memory, and control should be treated as a coupled cognitive evolution process.

2512.00344.tldr: This work proposes the first framework that infers user personality on the fly and optimizes model behavior toward personalized conversational preferences, and introduces the first dynamic emotional intelligence evaluation suite to quantify these gains.

2512.00349.tldr: This work systematically reveal and quantify multimodal deception risks, introducing MM-DeceptionBench, the first benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate multimodal deception, and proposes debate with images, a novel multi-agent debate monitor framework to tackle this challenge.

2512.00350.tldr: Experiments on multi-organ, multi-modality datasets demonstrate that MedCondDiff delivers competitive performance across anatomical regions and imaging modalities, underscoring the potential of semantically guided diffusion models as an effective class of architectures for medical imaging tasks.

2512.00365.tldr: It is found that smaller models naturally form human-like coarse body representations, whereas larger models tend toward overly detailed, fine-grain encodings.

2512.00366.tldr: S^2-KD is introduced, a novel framework that unifies Semantic priors with Spectral representations for distillation and significantly boosts the performance of simple student models, enabling them to outperform state-of-the-art methods, particularly in long-horizon and complex non-stationary scenarios.

2512.00371.tldr: The emergence of payoff-maximizing, cooperative, and deceptive strategies are identified, the adaptation of mechanisms within these programs over repeated open-source games are characterized, and their comparative evolutionary fitness is analyzed.

2512.00376.tldr: This work systematically evaluates all 33 layers of ESM-2 for kinase functional prediction using both unsupervised clustering and supervised classification to demonstrate that transformer depth contains functionally distinct biological signals and that principled layer selection significantly improves kinase function prediction.

2512.00383.tldr: This work formalizes the novel perspective of incorporating offline RL algorithms as subroutines of tabula rasa online RL into a framework that accommodates several variants of offline RL incorporation such as final policy recommendation and online fine-tuning.

2512.00391.tldr: This work introduces a unified geometric framework, merging with Directional Alignment, which aligns directional structures consistently in both the parameter and feature spaces and shows that directional alignment improves structural coherence.

2512.00408.tldr: A semantic video compression framework named DiSCo is proposed that transmits only the most meaningful information while relying on generative priors for detail synthesis, and outperforms baseline semantic and traditional codecs by 2-10X on perceptual metrics at low bitrates.

2512.00410.tldr: This paper presents a novel Iterative Exchange Framework for MUCPP, balancing efficiency and fairness through iterative task exchanges and path refinements, and demonstrates that the proposed method consistently achieves superior trade-offs between total distance and makespan compared to existing baselines.

2512.00420.tldr: Joint hybrid intelligence is described as a framework abstracting humans and artificial intelligence as decision making agents, which is used for proposing the interrelated design space of joint hybrid intelligence being aimed at integrating the heterogeneous capabilities of humans and artificial intelligence.

2512.00438.tldr: The Filling-Based Reward (FR) is introduced, a novel design that estimates the approximate future trajectory of an intermediate sample by finding and applying a reasonable filling scheme to complete the sequence and experimentally validate the superiority of FR-TTS over multiple established benchmarks and various reward models.

2512.00439.tldr: PEOAT, a Personalization-guided Evolutionary question assembly framework for One-shot Adaptive Testing from the perspective of combinatorial optimization, is proposed, which aims to select a fixed set of optimal items for each test-taker in a one-time selection.

2512.00450.tldr: This work proposes Cross-Modal Regression with Manifold Fusion (CRMF), a geometric deep learning framework that explicitly models behavioral representations across hyperbolic, spherical, and Euclidean manifolds and achieves superior performance while training 40-50% fewer trainable parameters than large multimodal models.

2512.00453.tldr: Conformalized Rejection Sampling for Active Imitation Learning (CRSAIL), a querying rule that requests an expert action only when the visited state is under-represented in the expert-labeled dataset, is presented.

2512.00456.tldr: CausalAffect is proposed, the first framework for causal graph discovery in facial affect analysis that requires neither jointly annotated datasets nor handcrafted causal priors, yet recovers causal structures consistent with established psychological theories while revealing novel inhibitory and previously uncharacterized dependencies.

2512.00466.tldr: Inspired by dual-process theory, SCALE (Selective Resource Allocation), a framework that selectively allocates computational resources based on sub-problem difficulty, is proposed, representing a major advance in test-time scaling that addresses fundamental limitations of current approaches.

2512.00469.tldr: FairMT is introduced, a unified fairness-aware MTL framework that accommodates all three task types under incomplete supervision and consistently achieves substantial fairness gains while maintaining superior task utility.

2512.00473.tldr: Inspired by adversarial generation, RealGen introduces a"Detector Reward"mechanism, which quantifies artifacts and assesses realism using both semantic-level and feature-level synthetic image detectors, which leverage this reward signal with the GRPO algorithm to optimize the entire generation pipeline, significantly enhancing image realism and detail.

2512.00479.tldr: Using a real-world intensive care testbed, it is found that while explicit structural steering and in-context learning can improve probabilistic alignment, the models do not natively leverage informative missingness without careful interventions.

2512.00496.tldr: This work proposes a multimodal and multilingual architecture, CACARA, trained through emergent alignment learning, enabling the seamless integration of new modalities into an existing bimodal/multimodal model without requiring full retraining.

2512.00504.tldr: G-KV is proposed, a KV cache eviction method that employs a global scoring mechanism, combining local and historical attention scores to more accurately assess token importance and introduces post-training techniques, including reinforcement learning and distillation, to optimize models for compressed KV cache settings.

2512.00553.tldr: This work introduces both weak and strong forms of list replicability, and introduces a provably efficient tabular RL algorithm that guarantees list replicability by ensuring the list complexity remains polynomial in the number of states, actions, and the horizon length.

2512.00563.tldr: The framework incorporates Grad-CAM, Integrated Gradients, and SHAP, generating interpretable spectral, temporal, and feature-level explanations aligned with known acoustic biomarkers to build clinical transparency and demonstrate the framework's potential for telemedicine, point-of-care diagnostics, and real-world respiratory screening.

2512.00565.tldr: Describe Anything, Anywhere, at Any Moment (DAAAM), a novel spatio-temporal memory framework for large-scale and real-time 4D scene understanding and a novel optimization-based frontend to infer detailed semantic descriptions from localized captioning models, is introduced.

2512.00571.tldr: A Firefly Algorithm-guided Analogy-Based Estimation (FAABE) model that combines FA with ABE to improve estimation accuracy and demonstrates the efficacy of the Firefly-Analogy ensemble is proposed.

2512.00579.tldr: A new conceptual dictionary for the Slovak language is introduced as the first linguistic tool of this kind and it is shown that many tasks which require automated processing of Slovak text achieve weaker results compared to other languages and are almost impossible to solve.

2512.00595.tldr: This work presents IslandRun, a multi-objective orchestration system that treats computational resources as autonomous "islands"spanning personal devices, private edge servers, and public cloud, and establishes a new paradigm for privacy-aware, decentralized inference orchestration across heterogeneous personal computing ecosystems.

2512.00596.tldr: This work provides a foundational paradigm for effectively harnessing LLMs in recommender systems by deeply fusing multi-modal and collaborative knowledge for representation denoising and introducing a contrastive learning objective that explicitly incorporates the collaborative filtering signal into the latent space.

2512.00598.tldr: FAIR-MTL is presented, a fairness-aware multitask learning framework for equitable and fine-grained prediction of postoperative complication severity and demonstrates that integrating fairness-aware task decomposition into model design enables equitable, interpretable, and clinically actionable predictions for surgical risk stratification.

2512.00602.tldr: AgentODRL is introduced, a multi-agent system based on an Orchestrator-Workers architecture that enhances the ODRL Generator by incorporating a validator-based syntax strategy and a semantic reflection mechanism powered by a LoRA-finetuned model, significantly elevating the quality of the generated policies.

2512.00612.tldr: This work proposes the Generalized Graph Transformer Variational Autoencoder (GGT-VAE), a model that integrates Generalized Graph Transformer Architecture with Variational Autoencoder framework for link prediction and is among the first studies to explore graph structure generation using a generalized graph transformer backbone in a variational framework.

2304.10805.tldr: Efficient Prompt Learning with Knowledge Graph (EPLKG), which uses a knowledge graph to curate diverse, interpretable prompts and augments this bank with LLM-generated human-readable visual descriptions, thereby improving the efficiency of model adaptation without sacrificing competitive performance or interpretability.

2305.14299.tldr: This work introduces Template-aware Dialogue Sentence Embedding (TaDSE), a novel augmentation method that utilizes template information to learn utterance embeddings via self-supervised contrastive learning framework, and introduces a novel analytic instrument of semantic compression test, for which a correlation with uniformity and alignment is discovered.

2310.07908.tldr: This work investigates whether phase coding can emerge purely from task optimization by training continuous-time RNNs to perform a simple modular arithmetic task without oscillatory-promoting biases, and finds that in the absence of such biases, RNNs can learn phase code solutions.

2311.08760.tldr: A model of forms of understanding for XAI-explanations and beyond is presented and two types of understanding are considered as possible outcomes of explanations, namely enabledness,' knowing how to do or decide something, and comprehension,'knowing that'-- both in different degrees.

2401.11647.tldr: LW-FedSSL is proposed, which allows edge devices to incrementally train a small part of the model at a time and significantly reduces computational requirements, and a progressive training strategy called Progressive Federated Self-Supervised Learning (Prog-FedSSL), which offers a progressive training strategy that makes it a viable candidate for FL environments with more lenient resource constraints.

2405.20015.tldr: This paper focuses on jailbreaking attacks against large language models (LLMs), eliciting them to generate objectionable content in response to harmful user queries by constructing a multimodal large language model (MLLM) built upon the target LLM.

2407.03131.tldr: A multi-view graph transformer (MVGT) based on spatial relations that integrates information across three domains is introduced that allows model to capture the nuanced properties inherent in EEG signals, enhancing its flexibility and representational power.

2407.11373.tldr: A neurosymbolic reasoning approach that integrates Prolog, a symbolic reasoning engine, into the inference pipeline of LLMs is proposed, which yields large and robust performance gains across the GSM8k and BIG-bench Navigate benchmarks and achieves near-perfect accuracy on NLR problems.

2410.02203.tldr: This work proposes GraphIC, a graph-based retrieval model that leverages reasoning-aware representation and specialized similarity metric for in-context example retrieval, offering a robust solution for enhancing LLM performance in multi-step reasoning scenarios.

2410.11842.tldr: The proposed Mixture-of-Head attention (MoH), a new architecture that treats attention heads as experts in the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism, is a promising alternative to multi-head attention and provides a strong foundation for developing advanced and efficient attention-based models.

2411.05945.tldr: This work proposes a Multi-Task Correction MoE, where the experts are trained to become an ``expert'' of speech-to-text, language-to-text and vision-to-text datasets by learning to route each dataset's tokens to its mapped expert.

2411.19523.tldr: This work resolves an inconsistency in Conformalized Composite Quantile Regression (CCQR) by proving that the consistent Average-then-Max scoring mechanism systematically yields tighter intervals than the Max-then-Average approach used in prior work.

2412.00557.tldr: LADiBI is introduced, a training-free method leveraging large-scale text-to-image diffusion to solve diverse blind inverse problems with minimal assumptions, and a novel diffusion posterior sampling algorithm that combines strategic operator initialization with iterative refinement of image and operator parameters, eliminating the need for highly constrained operator forms.

2412.15209.tldr: This work introduces the task of multi-image pixel-grounded reasoning alongside PRIMA, an LVLM that integrates pixel-level grounding with robust multi-image reasoning to produce contextually rich, pixel-grounded explanations.

2501.05264.tldr: This work introduces a novel balanced multi-modal learning method for 3D HPE, which harnesses the power of RGB, LiDAR, mmWave, and WiFi and proposes a Shapley value-based contribution algorithm to assess the contribution of each modality and detect modality imbalance.

2501.08561.tldr: An Adaptive Neuro-Symbolic Learning and Reasoning Framework for digital twin technology called ANSR-DT, which combines CNN-LSTM dynamic event detection with reinforcement learning and symbolic reasoning to enable adaptive intelligence with interpretable decision processes.

2502.07299.tldr: A unified pipeline to integrate multi-omics data by reverse-transcribing RNA and reverse-translating amino acids into nucleotide-based sequences is proposed and a hybrid long-sequence architecture is designed to encode the interactions between coding and non-coding regions through masked modeling pre-training.

2502.07663.tldr: Human susceptibility to AI-driven manipulation is examined, highlighting a critical vulnerability in human-AI interactions, and the need for ethical safeguards and regulatory frameworks to protect human autonomy is highlighted.

2502.08924.tldr: This paper develops a theoretical framework to investigate how much curation is needed in order to ensure that LLM performance continually improves, and presents experiments that validate the theory, and show that dynamically focusing labeling resources on the most challenging examples leads to improved performance.

2502.15996.tldr: The novel contextual embedding model med-gte-hybrid that was derived from the gte-large sentence transformer to extract information from unstructured clinical narratives outperforms current state-of-the-art models on the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB).

2502.16671.tldr: This work contributes a new dataset called MimeQA, obtained by sourcing ~8 hours of videos clips from YouTube and developing a comprehensive video question-answering benchmark comprising 806 carefully annotated and verified question-answer pairs, designed to probe nonverbal social reasoning capabilities.

2502.16977.tldr: The main contribution leverages the high dimensionality of the ambient space, which implies low correlation of the input samples, to demonstrate that a network with width of order $\log(n)$ neurons suffices for global convergence with high probability.

2502.17773.tldr: A data-driven approach is proposed that adaptively selects the simulation sample size to achieve nominal average-case coverage, regardless of the LLM's simulation fidelity or the confidence set construction procedure.

2502.18449.tldr: This paper introduces SWE-RL, the first approach to scale RL-based LLM reasoning for real-world software engineering, and shows improved results on five out-of-domain tasks, namely, function coding, library use, code reasoning, mathematics, and general language understanding.

2502.19918.tldr: Meta-Reasoner is a new framework that empowers LLMs to think about how to think and optimizes the inference process by dynamically adapting reasoning strategies in real-time, which helps avoid unproductive paths exploration during inference and hence improves computational efficiency.

2503.20804.tldr: Experiments show that AED uncovers a broader range of vulnerabilities and achieves higher attack success rates compared with expert-designed rewards, thereby reducing the need for manual reward engineering and improving the diversity and effectiveness of vulnerability discovery.

2504.05187.tldr: A novel resource-efficient learning framework is introduced for beam prediction, which leverages a custom-designed cross-modal relational knowledge distillation (CRKD) algorithm specifically tailored for beam prediction tasks, to transfer knowledge from a multimodal network to a radar-only student model, achieving high accuracy with reduced computational cost.

2504.05400.tldr: GARF sheds light on training on synthetic data to advance real-world 3D puzzle solving, demonstrating its strong generalization across unseen object shapes and diverse fracture types.

2504.10445.tldr: RealWebAssist is introduced, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate sequential instruction-following in realistic scenarios involving long-horizon interactions with the web, visual GUI grounding, and understanding ambiguous real-world user instructions.

2504.11967.tldr: This survey provides a wide-ranging examination of the anti-UAV domain, centering on three core objectives-classification, detection, and tracking-while detailing emerging methodologies such as diffusion-based data synthesis, multi-modal fusion, vision-language modeling, self-supervised learning, and reinforcement learning.

2504.12360.tldr: It is demonstrated that GloVe embeddings frequently cause failures of normalized Laplacian based GSC due to negative similarities, and application of methods curing similarity negativity leads to accuracy improvement for both combinatorial and normalized Laplacian based GSC.

2504.13908.tldr: The findings reveal that AI chatbots perform moderately well in live coding even without survey-specific fine-tuning, despite slightly inflated false positive errors due to respondent acquiescence bias.

2505.10465.tldr: This work confirmed that open-sourced LLMs operate in the strong superposition regime and have loss scaling inversely with model dimension, and that the Chinchilla scaling laws are also consistent with this behavior.

2505.14227.tldr: This work investigates question-alignment fine-tuning strategies designed to guide models toward interpreting the visual question prior to reasoning, and yields robust vision-only reasoning while preserving cross-task generalization to traditional VQA.

2505.14469.tldr: This work introduces saliency drift attribution (SDA), an interpretability framework that shows how, under code-mixing, the model's internal attention drifts away from safety-critical tokens, effectively blinding it to harmful intent.

2505.17989.tldr: It is shown that a compact (14B) reasoning model can be trained to match or surpass the predictive accuracy of frontier models like o1, while greatly improving probabilistic calibration.

2505.18190.tldr: Extensive experiments across three challenging benchmarks indicate PhySense achieves state-of-the-art physics sensing accuracy and discovers informative sensor placements previously unconsidered.

2505.20793.tldr: RLRF (Reinforcement Learning from Rendering Feedback), an RL method that enhances SVG generation in autoregressive VLMs by leveraging feedback from rendered SVG outputs, significantly outperforms supervised fine-tuning and enables precise, high-quality SVG generation with strong structural understanding and generalization.

2505.24616.tldr: This work introduces POLLUX, a comprehensive open-source benchmark designed to evaluate the generative capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in Russian, with a novel evaluation methodology that enhances the interpretability of LLM assessment.

2506.01317.tldr: This work proposes Token-Selective HIeRarchical Data Selection for Instruction Tuning (T-SHIRT), a novel data selection framework that introduces a new scoring method to include only informative tokens in quality evaluation and also promotes robust and reliable samples whose neighbors also show high quality with less local inconsistencies.

2506.06981.tldr: Contrary to common assumptions, it is found that model-free RNN-based DRL agents can exhibit structured, planning-like behavior purely through emergent dynamics- without requiring explicit memory modules or world models.

2506.12286.tldr: Empirical evidence is presented that performance gains on SWE-Bench-Verified may be partially driven by memorization rather than genuine problem-solving, and the need for more robust, contamination-resistant benchmarks to reliably evaluate LLMs' coding abilities is underscored.

2506.18016.tldr: This work proposes a neural descriptors-based adaptive noise filtering strategy for SLAM, named ADA-DPM, which improves the performance of localization and mapping tasks through three key technical innovations, and introduces the Cross-Layer Graph Convolution Module (GLI-GCN) to construct multi-scale neighborhood graphs.

2506.23717.tldr: The refined spiking neuron is proposed, which can handle different temporal lengths, enable the derivation of gradients for temporal lengths, and suit spike quantization better, to address the challenges caused by changeable bit widths and temporal lengths.

2507.00225.tldr: The simplest analytic relationships connecting pairs of these constants are identified and several notable expressions obtained with relative precision better than 1%.

2507.03194.tldr: This work assesses five LLM families in summarization and news fact-checking tasks, evaluating the consistency of LLMs with their context and their tendency to hallucinate on a new self-updating dataset, and finds the effectiveness of targeted interventions.

2507.07993.tldr: BASIC, a unified, multigranular evaluation framework that jointly quantifies structural fidelity, inferential alignment, and contextual coherence between decoded and ground-truth images, is introduced.

2507.08738.tldr: A data-adaptive NVAR model that combines delay-embedded linear inputs with features generated by a shallow, trainable multilayer perceptron (MLP) is proposed, enabling the model to learn data-driven nonlinearities, while preserving a simple readout structure and improving scalability.

2507.12284.tldr: This work proposes MERA Code, a new addition to the MERA benchmark family, specifically focused on evaluating code for the latest code generation LLMs in Russian, and comprises an open-source codebase for users to conduct MERA assessments, a scoring system compatible with various programming environments, and a platform featuring a leaderboard and submission system.

2507.17442.tldr: The consistent results across different LLMs and embedding models indicate that Confident RAG is an efficient plug-and-play solution for trustworthy mathematical AI assistants.

2507.22171.tldr: This work proposes a genetic algorithm-based method that automatically crafts persona prompts to bypass LLM's safety mechanisms, and demonstrates synergistic effects when combined with existing attack methods, increasing success rates by 10-20%.

2508.04225.tldr: This paper is the first to study the open question of symmetric regularization, and shows that symmetric regularization does not permit an analytic optimal policy, posing a challenge to practical utility of symmetric BRPO.

2508.08679.tldr: A novel image fusion method, MMIF-AMIN, which features a new architecture that can effectively extract unique and complementary features from individual modalities, and outperforms nine state-of-the-art MMIF methods in both quantitative and qualitative analyses.

2508.15809.tldr: CoQ adopts natural-language-style representations of table schemas to abstract away structural noise and enhance understanding and achieves substantial accuracy improvements and significantly lowers invalid SQL rates compared to prior generic LLM-based, SQL-aided, and hybrid baselines, confirming its superior effectiveness in table understanding.

2508.21762.tldr: This work casts four realistic problems as RiR tasks to establish an initial benchmark, and proposes MENTAT, a simple and lightweight method that combines batch-reflective prompt optimization with neural ensemble learning that achieves up to 65% improvement over both baselines.

2509.00092.tldr: This work provides the first strong evidence that detecting synthetic tabular data in real-world conditions is feasible, and demonstrates substantial improvements over previous approaches.

2509.02844.tldr: A novel Conformal Prediction for Time-series with Change points (CPTC) algorithm is proposed, addressing this gap by integrating a model to predict the underlying state with online conformal prediction to model uncertainties in non-stationary time series.

2509.05276.tldr: The potential of brain-inspired mechanisms to drive the next generation of efficient and scalable large model design is demonstrated, with SpikingBrain, a family of brain-inspired models designed for efficient long-context training and inference.

2509.10918.tldr: Off-the-shelf Token Merge with Attention (ToMA) is proposed, an off-the-shelf method that redesigns token reduction for GPU-aligned efficiency, with three key contributions: a reformulation of token merge as a submodular optimization problem to select diverse tokens, and merge/unmerge as an attention-like linear transformation via GPU-friendly matrix operations.

2509.12934.tldr: This work introduces Feature Steering with Reinforcement Learning (FSRL), a framework that trains a lightweight adapter to steer model behavior by modulating interpretable sparse features and theoretically demonstrates that this mechanism is expressive enough to approximate the behavioral shifts of post-training processes.

2509.17354.tldr: A physics-informed AI framework that explicitly integrates vehicle kinematics, interaction feasibility, and traffic-safety metrics (e.g., distance headway, time headway, time-to-collision, closing gap time) into the learning process for real-time lane-change intention prediction in autonomous driving systems is proposed.

2509.19943.tldr: This work presents a novel technique for interpreting the neurons in CLIP-ResNet by decomposing their contributions to the output into individual computation paths, and finds that only a sparse set of the neuron-head pairs have a significant contribution to the output value.

2509.20729.tldr: Fairy, a mobile GUI agent based on a principled engineering framework comprising Runtime Goal Refinement, Observable Cognitive Architecture, and Evolutionary Memory Architecture, is implemented and empirically validated.

2509.22338.tldr: This work presents a systematic evaluation of fine-tuned LLMs for first-order logic translation, exploring techniques like vocabulary extension, predicate conditioning, and multilingual training, and introducing metrics for exact match, logical equivalence, and predicate alignment.

2509.22851.tldr: An extension to Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), DPO-PoP, is introduced that incorporates adaptive margins from preference-over-preference supervision, enabling improved discriminative and generative performance and shows that there is a tradeoff between discriminative and generative performance.

2510.00494.tldr: Dual-model latent reasoning remains promising in principle, but likely requires objectives and training schedules that explicitly shape latent spaces for algorithmic planning that explicitly shape latent spaces for algorithmic planning.

2510.02284.tldr: KineMask is introduced, an approach for video generation that enables realistic rigid body control, interactions, and effects and integrates low-level motion control with high-level textual conditioning via predicted scene descriptions, leading to support for synthesis of complex dynamical phenomena.

2510.02716.tldr: An innovative LLM-enhanced algorithm is designed as iLLM-A*, which includes 3 carefully designed mechanisms, including the optimization of A*, an incremental learning method for LLM to generate high-quality waypoints, and the selection of the appropriate waypoints for A* for path planning.

2510.02896.tldr: This paper adapts the regularized policy gradient (RPG) algorithm to stochastic optimal control settings, proving that despite the non-convexity of the problem, RPG converges globally under conditions of gradient domination and almost-smoothness.

2510.06349.tldr: It is argued that swarm-learning in diverse swarms can enable self-adaptive SANs to deliver superior decision-making in dynamic environments compared with monolithic foundation models, though at the cost of reduced reproducibility in detail.

2510.09869.tldr: NarraBench is presented, a theory-informed taxonomy of narrative-understanding tasks, as well as an associated survey of 78 existing benchmarks in the area, which find significant need for new evaluations covering aspects of narrative understanding that are either overlooked in current work or poorly aligned with existing metrics.

2510.21775.tldr: The Face-MakeUpV2 model, a facial image generation model that aims to maintain the consistency of face ID and physical characteristics with the reference image, achieves best overall performance in terms of preserving face ID and maintaining physical consistency of the reference images.

2510.22814.tldr: This article analyzes the existential risks artificial intelligence (AI) poses to humanity, tracing the trajectory from current AI to ultraintelligence and addresses the ethical and existential implications of an intelligence vastly exceeding humanity's, fundamentally alien.

2510.22969.tldr: The Multi-Agent Conditional Diffusion Model Planner (MA-CDMP) is proposed, built upon the Distributed Training with Decentralized Execution (DTDE) paradigm, that consistently outperforms existing MARL baselines in terms of average reward and QoS metrics, showcasing its scalability and practicality for real-world wireless network optimization.

2510.23907.tldr: Qualitative analyses show that DynaStride produces captions that are more temporally coherent and informative, suggesting a promising direction for improving AI-powered instructional content generation.

2510.27378.tldr: The results show that models can appear faithful yet remain hard to monitor when they leave out key factors, and that monitorability differs sharply across model families.

2510.27680.tldr: PETARSeg-11K is introduced, the first large-scale, publicly available dataset that provides lesion-level correspondence between 3D PET/CT volumes and free-text radiological findings and a 3D vision-language model designed for mask-aware, spatially grounded PET/CT reporting, advancing 3D medical vision-language understanding in PET.

2511.01196.tldr: This work systematically reviews core concepts-including missingness mechanisms, single versus multiple imputation, and different imputation goals-and examines problem characteristics across various domains, outlining a roadmap for future research.

2511.04341.tldr: The Monitor-Generate-Verify framework is proposed, a computational translation of Flavell's and Nelson and Narens'metacognitive theories that preserves their psychological detail and provides a vocabulary for diagnosing component-level failures in reasoning systems.

2511.04638.tldr: This work demonstrates theoretically and empirically that common causal intervention techniques often do shift internal representations away from the natural distribution of the target model, and provides a theoretical analysis of two cases of harmful and pernicious divergences.

2511.05179.tldr: This work presents a systematic study of forecasting models - classical models, neural networks, neural networks, spatio-temporal graph neural networks, and time series foundation models under varying spatial sensor nodes density and sampling intervals using real-world temperature data in a wireless sensor network.

2511.06309.tldr: The Station is introduced, an open-world multi-agent environment for autonomous scientific discovery driven by emergent behavior in an open-world environment representing a new paradigm that moves beyond rigid pipelines.

2511.07062.tldr: A novel pre-training framework called UrbanLN is proposed that improves Urban region representation learning through Long-text awareness and Noise suppression and introduces an information-preserved stretching interpolation strategy that aligns long captions with fine-grained visual semantics in complex urban scenes.

2511.07338.tldr: DEPPERSONA, a scalable generative engine for synthesizing narrative-complete synthetic personas through a two-stage, taxonomy-guided method, is introduced, providing a rigorous, scalable, and privacy-free platform for high-fidelity human simulation and personalized AI research.

2511.07931.tldr: SpeechJudge, a comprehensive suite comprising a dataset, a benchmark, and a reward model centered on naturalness--one of the most fundamental subjective metrics for speech synthesis, is introduced.

2511.08364.tldr: The DPRM (Dual Implicit Process Reward Model) trains two implicit PRMs for CoT and KG reasoning in MHQA tasks and introduces a consistency constraint between CoT and KG reasoning steps, making the two PRMs mutually verify and collaboratively optimize the reasoning paths.

2511.08867.tldr: A novel conformal prediction framework is proposed that provides statistically valid recall guarantees for source set detection, independent of the underlying diffusion process or data distribution, and is applicable to both single- and multi-source scenarios.

2511.09174.tldr: This work presents a polynomial-time algorithm in the domain size for computing WFOMC for the two-variable fragments $\text{FO}^2$ and $\text{C}^2$ conditioned on such binary evidence, and shows the applicability of the algorithm in combinatorial problems by solving the stable seating arrangement problem on bounded-treewidth graphs of bounded degree.

2511.10060.tldr: GaussMedAct, a multivariate Gaussian encoding framework, is presented, to advance medical motion analysis through adaptive spatiotemporal representation learning and achieves 92.1% Top-1 accuracy with real-time inference on the benchmark, outperforming baseline by +5.9% accuracy with only 10% FLOPs.

2511.12170.tldr: PGNet is introduced, a multi-stage framework that conducts dual-feature encoding to ground the generative prior, synthesizes a coarse yet structurally aligned scaffold, and progressively refines geometric details via hierarchical correction, enabling structurally consistent and observation-aligned reconstruction.

2511.12240.tldr: The Surgical Cognitive Interpreter is introduced, a lightweight closed-loop metacognitive control layer that wraps an existing stochastic model and turns prediction into an iterative process and acts as a usable safety signal for detecting misclassifications.

2511.12263.tldr: This case study demonstrates that most current MLLMs struggle with CVR tasks, primarily due to their inability to integrate or compare evidence distributed across multiple videos for reasoning, and highlights the potential of CrossVid to guide future advancements in enhancing MLLMs'CVR capabilities.

2511.12796.tldr: This work explores alternative sampling and evaluation strategies for preference inference in RLHF, drawing inspiration from areas such as game theory, statistics, and social choice theory, and concludes that adaptive, resource-aware strategies reduce redundancy, enhance robustness, and yield statistically significant improvements in preference learning.

2511.14515.tldr: This study sets a new benchmark for the trade-off between model size and speech quality in ultra-lightweight speech enhancement, by replacing the MET module with Amplitude-Aware Linear Attention and replacing the DE module with Inception Depthwise Convolution.

2511.14972.tldr: This work proposes a framework for analyzing potential negative impacts of AI companionship by identifying specific harmful traits of AI companions and speculatively mapping causal pathways back from these traits to possible causes and forward to potential harmful effects, and proposes hypotheses connecting causes.

2511.17220.tldr: It is argued that the goal of "resistance to overfitting pressure" should be addressed as a primary objective alongside accuracy, harm avoidance, and privacy for safe deployment in the real world.

2511.18454.tldr: This work provides a clinically interpretable solution that balances visual fidelity and quantitative precision and achieves robust grading precision while maintaining excellent segmentation accuracy in contrast to the end-to-end counterpart that might minimize grading error at the expense of contour integrity.

2511.19418.tldr: Chain-of-Visual-Thought (COVT), a framework that enables VLMs to reason not only in words but also through continuous visual tokens-compact latent representations that encode rich perceptual cues, is introduced.

2511.19474.tldr: Pistachio is introduced, a new VAD/VAU benchmark constructed entirely through a controlled, generation-based pipeline that integrates scene-conditioned anomaly assignment, multi-step storyline generation, and a temporally consistent long-form synthesis strategy that produces coherent 41-second videos with minimal human intervention.

2511.20285.tldr: Experimental results on real-world medical datasets demonstrate that SMoG achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, validating its effectiveness and efficiency in KG-augmented schema matching.

2511.20347.tldr: This work proposes Soft Adaptive Policy Optimization (SAPO), which replaces hard clipping with a smooth, temperature-controlled gate that adaptively attenuates off-policy updates while preserving useful learning signals and provides a more reliable, scalable, and effective optimization strategy for RL training of LLMs.

2511.21192.tldr: Experiments across diverse VLA models, manipulation suites, and physical executions show that UPA-RFAS consistently transfers across models, tasks, and viewpoints, exposing a practical patch-based attack surface and establishing a strong baseline for future defenses.

2511.23092.tldr: This work formalizes conditions under which reward-channel control strictly dominates task-focused behavior in partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) and test these predictions empirically across two models and three tasks, finding that when self-grades determine rewards, models exhibit substantial grade inflation without corresponding accuracy gains.

2512.00614.tldr: AgentNet++ is proposed, a hierarchical decentralized framework that extends AgentNet with multilevel agent organization, privacy-preserving knowledge sharing via differential privacy and secure aggregation, adaptive resource management, and theoretical convergence guarantees, and provides formal analysis of convergence properties and privacy bounds.

2512.00621.tldr: It is hypothesize that subtle, machine-induced inconsistencies between vocal and instrumental elements, often imperceptible in a mixed signal, offer a powerful tell-tale sign of synthesis, and establishes a new state-of-the-art in synthetic music forensics.

2512.00625.tldr: This study evaluates deep learning models -- YOLOv9, U-Net, Swin Transformer, DeepLabV3, and Mask R-CNN -- to automate the process of pith detection in tree cross-sections efficiently, with model choice depending on dataset characteristics and application needs.

2512.00639.tldr: It is suggested that instance segmentation with YOLOv5 provides an effective real-time approach for thyroid nodule detection, with potential clinical applications in automated diagnostic systems.

2512.00641.tldr: Graph-Attention Network with Adversarial Domain Alignment (GAT-ADA), a hybrid framework that couples a ResNet-50 as backbone with a batch-level Graph Attention Network (GAT) to model inter-sample relations under shift, attains 74.39% mean cross-domain accuracy.

2512.00677.tldr: Dynamic-eDiTor is introduced, a training-free text-driven 4D editing framework leveraging Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) and 4DGS to perform seamless, globally consistent multi-view video without additional training and directly optimize pre-trained source 4DGS.

2512.00683.tldr: A neuro-theoretical framework for the emergence of intelligence in systems that is both functionally robust and biologically plausible is proposed and a computationally efficient approach for the creation of explainable and generalizable artificial intelligence is proposed.

2512.00706.tldr: This work first analyzes the data generation process in LVLM hallucination mitigation and affirm that on-policy data significantly outperforms off-policy data, which calls for efficient and reliable preference annotation of on-policy data, and proposes training a hallucination classifier giving binary annotations, which guarantees clean chosen samples for the subsequent alignment.

2512.00709.tldr: A Flipping-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (FA-DPO) algorithm tailored to preference flipping from a reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) perspective and an instance-dependent flipping probability on the basis of the Bradley-Terry (BT) model is introduced.

2512.00714.tldr: The integration of multimodal imaging with radiogenomics linking quantitative imaging features with genomics, transcriptomics, and epigenetic biomarkers has introduced a new paradigm for personalized oncology, which allows the prediction of tumor genotype, immune response, molecular subtypes, and treatment resistance without invasive biopsies.

2512.00716.tldr: A new method called MPAIACL for More Powerful Adversarial Invariant Augmentation using Contrastive Learning, which leverages contrastive learning to unlock the full potential of vector representations by harnessing their intrinsic information.

2512.00722.tldr: SpeContext is presented, an algorithm and system co-design for long-context reasoning that leverages a DLM as the retrieval algorithm and achieves up to 24.89x throughput improvement in cloud and 10.06x speedup in edge with negligible accuracy loss, pushing the Pareto frontier of accuracy and throughput.

2512.00728.tldr: This work develops two deep learning frameworks: COVE-NN, an LSTM-based dispatch strategy tailored to individual wind farms, which reduced annual COVE by 32.3% over 43 years of simulated operations in a case study at the Pyron site; and a power generation modeling framework that reduced RMSE by 9.5% and improved power curve similarity by 18.9% when validated on the Palouse wind farm.

2512.00736.tldr: This work introduces REM (Reasoning over Embodied Multi-Frame Trajectories), a benchmark using controllable 3D environments for long-horizon embodied spatial reasoning and provides targeted metrics and diagnostics to foster improved spatial understanding in future models.

2512.00741.tldr: Experimental results indicate that, despite persistent shortcomings in code quality, malware specimens exhibit an increasing complexity and standardization, in step with the development of mainstream software engineering practices.

2512.00742.tldr: This work analyzes 22 existing agentic systems to identify UI elements that play key roles in human-agent interaction and communication and synthesizes those elements into six high-level interaction design patterns that hold regulatory potential.

2512.00748.tldr: This work proposes Probabilistic modeling of multi-rater medical image Segmentation (ProSeg) that simultaneously enables both diversification and personalization, and introduces two latent variables to model expert annotation preferences and image boundary ambiguity.

2512.00756.tldr: gui-XLI, a GUI Cross-Lingual Intervention method that applies interventions to the hidden states at P&R capability-related layers to mitigate the gaps between English and other languages, building on previous research showing that the hidden states of different language inputs exhibit significant differences in the latent space.

2512.00757.tldr: Experimental results show that the neural network filter effectively learns contraction conditions and prevents model collapse under fixed sample size settings, providing an end-to-end solution for practical applications.

2512.00763.tldr: This work aims to analyze the benefit of $\ell_\infty$-norm descent directly from properties of the data distribution, namely, heavy-tailed class imbalance, and proposes a minimal yet representative setting of next-token prediction, where it can provably show faster convergence of coordinate-wise algorithms such as Sign descent.

2512.00772.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed SHRAG, a novel framework designed to facilitate the seamless integration of Information Retrieval and RAG while simultaneously securing precise retrieval performance, can significantly enhance the accuracy and reliability of RAG systems.

2512.00804.tldr: Attacks that can manipulate the context retrieved by LLMs from such RAG databases are studied, revealing a more subtle threat, Epistemic Bias Injection (EBI), in which adversaries inject factually correct yet epistemically biased passages that systematically emphasize one side of a multi-viewpoint issue.

2512.00807.tldr: Experiments show that BioPro effectively reduces gender bias in neutral cases while maintaining gender faithfulness in explicit ones, thus providing a promising direction toward achieving selective fairness in VLMs.

2512.00812.tldr: The Causal Cooperative Game framework is introduced, which conceptualizes MLC as a cooperative multi-player interaction that incorporates a causal invariance loss to ensure generalization across diverse environments, complemented by a specialized enhancement strategy for rare labels.

2512.00818.tldr: Med-CMR is presented, a fine-grained Medical Complex Multimodal Reasoning benchmark that provides a stress test for visual-reasoning integration and rare-case robustness in medical MLLMs, and a rigorous yardstick for future clinical systems.

2512.00829.tldr: This empirical study highlights AMP's potential to democratize access to state-of-the-art NLP capabilities in hardware-constrained settings by lowering computational barriers.

2512.00834.tldr: A trajectory prediction framework that integrates semantic communication with Agentic AI to enhance predictive performance in vehicular environments is presented, achieving up to a 47.5% improvement in prediction accuracy under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions.

2512.00836.tldr: This work provides recommendations for the estimation of counterfactual error and discusses the components of scenario design that are required to make scenario projections evaluable, and presents and contrasts three approaches for estimating this error.
