2509.13400.tldr: Bias in LLM-generated peer reviews is investigated by conducting controlled experiments on sensitive metadata, including author affiliation and gender, which consistently shows affiliation bias favoring institutions highly ranked on common academic rankings.

2509.25998.tldr: VRWKV-Editor is proposed, a novel video editing model that integrates a linear spatio-temporal aggregation module into video-based diffusion models that achieves up to 3.7x speedup and 60% lower memory usage compared to state-of-the-art diffusion-based video editing methods, while maintaining competitive performance in frame consistency and text alignment.

2510.18224.tldr: EVER is proposed: an edge-assisted auto-verification system for mobile MR-aided operations that achieves over 90% verification accuracy within 100 milliseconds, while consuming only minimal additional computational resources and energy compared to a system without auto-verification.

2510.22379.tldr: TraceTrans is presented, a novel deformable image translation model designed for post-operative prediction that generates images aligned with the target distribution while explicitly revealing spatial correspondences with the pre-operative input.

2511.03070.tldr: The first benchmark to directly test whether LLMs have access to empirical distributions describing real-world populations across domains such as economics, health, education, and social behavior is developed, demonstrating that LLMs perform poorly overall, and do not seem to internalize real-world statistics naturally.

2511.04473.tldr: This work presents SynthKGQA, an LLM-powered framework for generating high-quality Knowledge Graph Question Answering datasets from any Knowledge Graph, providing the full set of ground-truth facts in the KG to reason over questions, and applies it to Wikidata to generate GTSQA, a new dataset designed to test zero-shot generalization abilities of KG retrievers with respect to unseen graph structures and relation types.

2511.06208.tldr: The Supply Chain Resilience Inference Hypergraph Network (SC-RIHN) is proposed, a novel hypergraph-based model leveraging set-based encoding and hypergraph message passing to capture multi-party firm-product interactions and significantly outperforms traditional MLP, representative graph neural network variants, and ResInf baselines across synthetic benchmarks.

2511.06299.tldr: Physics-Informed Deformable Gaussian Splatting (PIDG), which treats each Gaussian particle as a Lagrangian material point with time-varying constitutive parameters and is supervised by 2D optical flow via motion projection and adopts static-dynamic decoupled 4D decomposed hash encoding to reconstruct geometry and motion efficiently.

2511.08003.tldr: SharpV is notably the first two-stage pruning framework that operates without requiring access to exposed attention scores, ensuring full compatibility with hardware acceleration techniques like Flash Attention.

2511.09568.tldr: VEDA, a unified SE(3)-equivariant framework that combines variance-exploding diffusion with annealing to efficiently generate conformationally accurate 3D molecular structures, demonstrates that principled integration of VE diffusion with SE(3)-equivariant architectures can achieve both high chemical accuracy and computational efficiency.

2511.10119.tldr: The state neural network emulates the temporal dynamics of biological neurons, allowing the system to store, integrate, and process information over time, while the neuron output prediction objective provides a unified computational principle for learning these structural dynamics from intelligent behaviors.

2511.16139.tldr: MR-RML with GPRC (Geometric Projection Reference Constraints)-a novel alignment framework that structured medical standards into a multi-perspective matrix to guide both data generation and model optimization, achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source LLMs, while also surpassing the majority of closed-source models.

2511.16708.tldr: It is proved mathematically that combining agents with different detection patterns finds more bugs than any single agent when the agents look for different problems, using submodularity of mutual information under conditional independence.

2511.17127.tldr: The first large-scale mixture-of-experts (MoE) pretraining study on pure AMD hardware, utilizing both MI300X GPUs and Pollara networking is reported, and the AMD hardware, network, and software stack are mature and optimized enough for competitive large-scale pretraining.

2511.17147.tldr: DMG-YOLO, a lightweight real-time detector tailored for small object detection in remote sensing images, is proposed and the Global and Local Aggregate Feature Pyramid Network (GLAFPN) is introduced to further boost small object detection through global-local feature fusion.

2511.17419.tldr: DS-Span is proposed, a single-phase discriminative subgraph mining framework that unifies pattern growth, pruning, and supervision-driven scoring within one traversal of the search space, and generates more compact and discriminative subgraph features than prior multi-stage methods, achieving higher or comparable accuracy with significantly reduced runtime.

2511.19035.tldr: A pre-trained DINOv3 model is introduced and a multi-scale cross-attention difference siamese network (MC-DiSNet) is proposed, paving the way for practical applications in rapid damage assessment across conflict zones.

2511.22148.tldr: An in-depth examination of heterogeneity in QFL is conducted, classifying it into two categories: data or system heterogeneity, and the influence of heterogeneity on training convergence and model aggregation.

2511.22809.tldr: It is suggested that AI-generated search summaries can significantly shape public perceptions, raising important implications for the design and regulation of AI-integrated information ecosystems.

2511.22861.tldr: This article presents a novel approach for escaping barren plateaus by including negative learning rates into the optimization process in QIoT devices and leads to a novel pathway for robust optimization in quantum–classical hybrid models.

2511.23075.tldr: The proposed SpaceMind is a multimodal large language model explicitly designed for spatial reasoning solely from RGB inputs, integrating VGGT as a spatial understanding encoder and InternViT as a 2D visual encoder in a dual-encoder architecture.

2511.23256.tldr: This work introduces a point spread function (PSF) as prior information to model the HRRP distortion induced by ISRJ and designs a recognition network that leverages this prior through a prior-guided feature interaction module and a hybrid loss function to enhance the model's discriminative capability.

2512.00572.tldr: A curated dataset, 'Yoga-16', is introduced, which addresses limitations of existing datasets, and three deep learning architectures are evaluated, using three input modalities (direct images, MediaPipe Pose skeleton images, and YOLOv8 Pose skeleton images), demonstrating that skeleton-based representations outperform raw image inputs.

2512.00626.tldr: This work successfully validates a verifiable framework that combines high performance with the essential clinical interpretability required for safe diagnostic deployment and achieves a high overall Accuracy and Macro-AUC, successfully outperforming various prior benchmarked architectures.

2512.02056.tldr: This work introduces memory-efficient, reversible architectures for LLMs, inspired by symmetric and symplectic differential equations, and proposes an efficient method for converting existing, non-reversible LLMs into reversible architectures through fine-tuning, rendering the approach practical for exploiting existing pre-trained models.

2512.03762.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that RoCo achieves superior performance, consistently generating competitive heuristics that outperform existing methods including ReEvo and HSEvo, both in white-box and black-box scenarios.

2512.03771.tldr: Doublespeak is introduced, a simple in-context representation hijacking attack against large language models that highlights a new attack surface in the latent space of LLMs, revealing that current alignment strategies are insufficient and should instead operate at the representation level.

2512.03783.tldr: A novel adaptive reasoning framework that dynamically adjusts the model's reasoning depth according to task difficulty, and construct a comprehensive adaptive reasoning benchmark that spans text-only, text-audio, text-visual, and text-audio-visual modalities, providing both training and evaluation splits for multimodal reasoning assessment.

2512.03794.tldr: Inspired by human active vision mechanisms, AdaptVision is introduced, an efficient VLM paradigm that enables adaptive visual token acquisition through a coarse-to-fine approach and achieves superior performance while consuming substantially fewer visual tokens than state-of-the-art efficient VLM methods.

2512.03887.tldr: The Static Deep Research Agent (Static-DRA), a novel solution built upon a configurable and hierarchical Tree-based static workflow, provides granular control over the research intensity through the integration of two user-tunable parameters, Depth and Breadth.

2512.04032.tldr: Jina-VLM is presented, a 2.4B parameter vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art multilingual visual question answering among open 2B-scale VLMs and achieves leading results on standard VQA benchmarks and multilingual evaluations while preserving competitive text-only performance.

2512.04094.tldr: Memory-DD, a low-complexity dendrite-inspired neuron model that consists of two dendrite-inspired neuron groups that contain no nonlinear activation functions but can still realize nonlinear mappings, successfully extends the low-complexity advantages of dendrite-inspired neurons to temporal prediction.

2512.04099.tldr: This paper applies the Partial-Multivariate Transformer (PMformer) to forecast daily returns for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, benchmarking it against eleven classical and deep learning models and demonstrating that the partial-multivariate strategy achieves significant statistical accuracy.

2512.04100.tldr: ReVeal-MT is proposed, a novel PINN which integrates the multi-source PDE residual into a neural network loss function, enabling accurate spectrum landscape reconstruction from sparse RF sensor measurements, with strong potential for enabling fine-grained spectrum management and precise coexistence between PUs and SUs.

2512.04105.tldr: The LegalWebAgent framework is introduced, which employs a web agent powered by multimodal large language models to bridge the gap in access to justice for ordinary citizens, and combines the natural language understanding capabilities of large language models with multimodal perception.

2512.04107.tldr: TEACH-AI (Trustworthy and Effective AI Classroom Heuristics), a domain-independent, pedagogically grounded, and stakeholder-aligned framework with measurable indicators and a practical toolkit for guiding the design, development, and evaluation of generative AI systems in educational contexts is presented.

2512.04108.tldr: This paper proposes a framework for responsible deployment of LLM-based decision-support systems through active human involvement and integrates interactive collaboration between human experts and developers through multiple iterations at the pre-deployment stage to assess the uncertain samples and judge the stability of the explanation provided by post-hoc XAI techniques.

2512.04111.tldr: This work introduces HAI-Eval, a unified benchmark designed to measure the synergy of human-AI partnership in coding and reveals an emerging co-reasoning partnership, which challenges the traditional human-tool hierarchy.

2512.04112.tldr: This paper presents MindFuse, a brave new explainable generative AI framework designed to act as a strategic partner in the marketing process, and introduces a new paradigm in GenAI for marketing, where LLMs not only generate content but reason through it, adapt campaigns in real time, and learn from audience engagement patterns.

2512.04113.tldr: This paper proposes a novel and practical approach to grade short-answer constructed-response questions, utilizing near-domain data like data from similar questions administered in previous years, and is believed to be the first work to formalize the problem of automated short answer grading based on the near-domain data.

2512.04115.tldr: The results of this study highlight the need for educational institutions to incorporate AI literacy into their curricula, provide teacher guidance, and inform policy development to ensure personalized opportunities for utilization and equitable integration of AI into K-12 education.

2512.04119.tldr: It is argued that the existential-risk thesis functions primarily as an ideological distraction from the ongoing consolidation of surveillance capitalism and extreme concentration of computational power.

2512.04121.tldr: The debate on qualitative analysis with LLMs is reframed and it is stated that rather than asking whether machines can perform qualitative analysis in principle, it should be asked whether with LLMs the authors can produce analyses that are sufficiently comparable to human analysts.

2512.04131.tldr: To address the ethical and societal challenges raised by AI and its governance, the regulation of digital platforms and education are keys levers, while education must strengthen digital literacy and teach people to make informed and critical choices when facing digital technologies.

2512.04139.tldr: This research introduces a hybrid algorithm built on top of the standard Las Vegas framework through iterative pruning, dynamically eliminating invalid placements during the random assignment phase, thus this method effectively reduces the search space.

2512.04142.tldr: The findings highlight that incremental performance gains, such as those observed between GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, come at disproportionately high material costs, emphasizing that future progress in AI must align with principles of resource efficiency and environmental responsibility.

2512.04144.tldr: This work presents RippleBench-Maker, an automatic tool for generating Q&A datasets that allow for the measurement of ripple effects in any model-editing task, and builds on a Wikipedia-based RAG pipeline to generate multiple-choice questions at varying semantic distances from the target concept.

2512.04187.tldr: OnSight Pathology is introduced, a platform-agnostic computer vision software that uses continuous custom screen captures to provide real-time AI inferences to users as they review digital slide images, and highlighted how it can deliver real-time AI inferences across a broad range of pathology pipelines.

2512.04198.tldr: Network of Theseus (NoT), a method for progressively converting a trained, or even untrained, guide network architecture part-by-part into an entirely different target network architecture while preserving the performance of the guide network, is presented.

2512.04204.tldr: This work derives a simple equation that classifies fast radio bursts into two distinct Gaussian distributions, indicating the existence of two physical classes, and derives the governing equation, demonstrating that it captures the underlying physics.

2512.04210.tldr: An iterative post-deployment alignment framework that applies Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to refine models against domain-specific safety signals to refine models against domain-specific safety signals is presented.

2512.04227.tldr: The Educational Cone Model is proposed, which is a geometric framework based on the assumption that easier texts are less diverse (focusing on fundamental concepts), whereas harder texts are more diverse, which leads to a cone-shaped distribution in the embedding space regardless of the embedding method used.

2512.04228.tldr: A dual-reasoning training framework that integrates affirmative generation with structured counterfactual denial that enables models that not only affirm valid inferences but also reject invalid ones, yielding systems that are more resilient, interpretable, and aligned with human reasoning.

2512.04231.tldr: CRAFT-E is introduced, a modular neuro-symbolic framework that composes a structured verb-property-object knowledge graph with visual-language alignment and energy-based grasp reasoning that offers an interpretable and customizable alternative to end-to-end models for affordance-grounded object selection, supporting trustworthy decision-making in assistive robotic systems.

2512.04246.tldr: This paper treats ethics as policy level dispositions, that is, relatively stable habits that hold up when incentives, partners, or contexts change, and shifts evaluation beyond rule checks or scalar returns toward trait summaries, durability under interventions, and explicit reporting of moral trade offs.

2512.04248.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the approach achieves high-fidelity and controllable 3D scene generation for NVS, outperforming state-of-the-art baseline methods both quantitatively and qualitatively.

2512.04252.tldr: By enabling accurate, 3D-structure-free pIC50 prediction directly from SMILES, this work demonstrates the transformative potential of chemical transformers in accelerating target-specific drug discovery.

2512.04262.tldr: This work provides one of the first quantitative inter-rater reliability analyses of automated heuristic evaluation and highlights methods for improving model consistency in automated User Experience (UX) evaluation.

2512.04268.tldr: Yq-LSA is introduced, a simple generalization of single-head LSA with a trainable initial guess yq, which theoretically establishes the capabilities of yq-LSA and provides experimental validation on linear regression tasks, thereby extending the theory that bridges ICL and GD.

2512.04273.tldr: This study presents the first empirical framework to measureitectural Erosion and the accumulation of Technical Debt in AI-synthesized microservices and identifies a phenomenon of "Implementation Laziness," where open-weights models generated 60% fewer Logical Lines of Code (LLOC) than their proprietary counterparts, effectively omitting complex business logic to satisfy token constraints.

2512.04276.tldr: A geometric framework in which all psychometric batteries for AI agents are treated as points in a structured moduli space, and agent performance is described by capability functionals over this space, suggesting that progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) is best understood as a flow on moduli of benchmarks.

2512.04277.tldr: Mixed rewards generally outperform task-only optimization, suggesting that coarse ordering signals can steer RL post-training toward canonical trajectories without modifying supervised data or architecture.

2512.04284.tldr: This work presents a lightweight super-resolution pipeline that operates on JPEG discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients in the frequency domain that achieves a 2.6 x speedup in data loading and a 2.5 x speedup in training, while preserving visual quality comparable to standard SISR approaches.

2512.04287.tldr: This review explores the integration of Artificial Intelligence into Horizon Scanning, focusing on identifying and responding to emerging threats and opportunities linked to Infectious Diseases, to demonstrate the potential and limitations of AI in Public Health preparedness.

2512.04302.tldr: Several approaches to dealing with these unsolved problems and enhancing the effectiveness and reliability of dense reward construction in different RL applications are explored.

2512.04303.tldr: Gamma-from-Mono (GfM), a lightweight monocular geometry estimation method that resolves the projective ambiguity in single-camera reconstruction by decoupling global and local structure, achieves state-of-the-art near-field accuracy in both depth and gamma estimation while maintaining competitive global depth performance.

2512.04307.tldr: A benchmark for evaluating long context reasoning capabilities of WebAgents through sequentially dependent subtasks that require retrieval and application of information from extended interaction histories is introduced and an implicit RAG approach is proposed that provides modest improvements by generating task-relevant summaries, though fundamental limitations in long context reasoning persist.

2512.04319.tldr: This work proposes MANTRA, a Multi-stage Adaptive Noise TReAtment framework that embeds noise diagnosis and mitigation directly into the fine-tuning process of code-Pretrained Language Models (PTM) and code-LLMs and enables researchers and practitioners to reduce the impact of errors introduced by the dataset in training, saves time in data cleaning and processing, while maximizing the effect of fine-tuning.

2512.04323.tldr: A novel method for generating high-quality Digital Image Correlation dataset based on non-uniform B-spline surfaces by randomly generating control point coordinates, which enables the generation of a large-scale dataset that capture real-world displacement field situations, thereby enhancing the training and generalization capabilities of deep learning-based DIC algorithms.

2512.04324.tldr: DAComp provides a rigorous and realistic testbed to drive the development of truly capable autonomous data agents for enterprise settings, highlighting profound deficiencies in open-ended reasoning and demonstrating that engineering and analysis are distinct capabilities.

2512.04339.tldr: A conceptual model for the adoption of AI in financial decision-making for SMEs is presented, providing a practical roadmap for SMEs to integrate AI into their financial operations and highlighting the importance of data quality and continuous model validation.

2512.04356.tldr: A Self-Augmented Contrastive Alignment framework for enabling object and action faithfulness by exempting the spurious correlations and enforcing the emphasis on visual facts, which outperforms existing methods in alleviating object and action hallucinations.

2512.04367.tldr: It is proposed that AgentBay provides a foundational primitive for building the next generation of reliable, human-supervised autonomous systems, especially under poor network conditions.

2512.04368.tldr: Testing using simulated Continuous Integration $I$ Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) environments showed AutoGuard to successfully improve threat detection accuracy, reduce mean time to recovery for incidents by 38% and increase overall resilience to incidents as compared to traditional methods.

2512.04385.tldr: STeP-Diff leverages DeepONet to model the spatial sequence of measurements along with a PDE-informed diffusion model to forecast the spatio-temporal field from incomplete and time-varying data, ensuring that predictions are both grounded in real-world measurements and aligned with the fundamental physics governing pollution dispersion.

2512.04386.tldr: The results indicate MASE's superiority over other model-agnostic interpretation methods, especially in terms of Delta Accuracy, positioning it as a promising tool for elucidating the operations of text-based models in NLP.

2512.04390.tldr: FMA-Net++ achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and temporal consistency on new benchmarks and GoPro, outperforming recent methods in both restoration quality and inference speed, and generalizes well to challenging real-world videos.

2512.04391.tldr: The central finding: when Eve interpolates her classical correlations with quantum data at mixing parameter, all tested detection methods achieve ROC AUC = 0.50, equivalent to random guessing, which means an eavesdropper needs only 5% classical admixture to completely evade detection.

2512.04405.tldr: This work presents a unified taxonomy that organizes recent research along three axes, and systematically introduces enabling technologies including task-oriented semantic encoders/decoders, multi-agent reinforcement learning, foundation-model-assisted RAN agents, and knowledge-graph-based reasoning for cross-layer awareness.

2512.04408.tldr: Policy-to-Tests (P2T), a framework that converts natural-language policy documents into normalized, machine-readable rules that closely match strong human baselines on span-level and rule-level metrics, and is released as open-source resources to enable reproducible evaluation.

2512.04413.tldr: An architecture-agnostic distillation method named dual-stream spectral decoupling distillation (DS2D2) for universal remote sensing object detection tasks, which integrates explicit and implicit distillation grounded in spectral decomposition and shows implicit knowledge hidden in subtle student–teacher feature discrepancies.

2512.04419.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive investigation and multiple practical solutions for the repetition problem encountered in real-world batch code interpretation tasks, and identifies three distinct repetition patterns: business rule generation repetition, method call relationship analysis repetition, and PlantUML diagram syntax generation repetition.

2512.04425.tldr: By combining multimodal feature learning with language-based interpretability, this study bridges the gap between visual recognition and clinical understanding, offering a novel vision-language paradigm for reliable and explainable Parkinsons disease gait analysis.

2512.04445.tldr: This work introduces AutoDW, a novel execution framework that enables stepwise, rollback-enabled operation orchestration, and employs robust rollback mechanisms at both the argument and API levels, enabling dynamic correction and fault tolerance.

2512.04452.tldr: The highly expressive neural networks, combined with a physically-rigorous base closure, prove to be a robust paradigm for designing parameterizations for climate models where data requirements are drastically reduced, inference performance can be directly targeted and optimized, and numerical stability is implicitly encouraged during training.

2512.04453.tldr: Bidirectional Action-Language Inference is presented for goal prediction, a method that integrates natural language preferences with observed human actions in a receding-horizon planning tree and yields more stable goal predictions and significantly fewer mistakes.

2512.04469.tldr: The introduction of the "Degrees of Freedom" concept is introduced, which intuitively differentiates the optimizable levers available for each approach, thereby guiding the selection of appropriate strategies for specific tasks.

2512.04500.tldr: The Nemosine Framework is presented, a modular cognitive architecture designed to support assisted reasoning, structured thinking, and systematic analysis that combines principles from metacognition, distributed cognition, and modular cognitive systems to offer an operational structure for assisted problem-solving and decision support.

2512.04513.tldr: BiTAgent, a task-aware dynamic joint framework that enables bidirectional coupling between MLLMs and WMs, and harmonizes semantic reasoning and dynamic prediction, which together harmonize semantic reasoning and dynamic prediction.

2512.04518.tldr: The methods, results, and findings for subtask 2 -- generating patient chemotherapy timelines from raw clinical notes are described, which evaluated strategies involving chain-of-thought thinking, supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and dictionary-based lookup to improve timeline extraction.

2512.04532.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that PhyVLLM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art Video LLMs on both physical reasoning and general video understanding tasks, highlighting the advantages of incorporating explicit physical modeling.

2512.04536.tldr: A novel video-based facial sequence analysis approach dedicated to the detection of alcohol intoxication that integrates facial landmark analysis via a Graph Attention Network with spatiotemporal visual features extracted using a 3D ResNet to enhance classification performance.

2512.04550.tldr: AdmTree is proposed, a novel framework for adaptive, hierarchical context compression with a central focus on preserving high semantic fidelity while maintaining efficiency, which robustly retains the semantic information of long contexts.

2512.04551.tldr: A multi-loss learning (MLL) framework integrating an energy-adaptive mixup (EAM) method and a frame-level attention module (FLAM) to optimize learning, address class imbalance, and improve feature separability is proposed.

2512.04597.tldr: A minimal requirement for EQA agents, abstention: knowing when to withhold an answer is focused on, which positions abstention as a fundamental prerequisite for reliable interaction in embodied settings and as a necessary basis for effective clarification.

2512.04598.tldr: This chapter provides a technical primer to show how generative AI affords experiencing technology as if it were human, and this affordance provides a fruitful focus for the philosophical ethics of generative AI.

2512.04632.tldr: A preconditioning procedure that accelerates Newton-Schulz convergence and reduces its computational cost and has a direct impact on end-to-end training runtime with 5-10% improvement in realistic training scenarios across two efficiency-focused tasks.

2512.04639.tldr: This work presents the first large-scale analysis of how misinformation and AI-generated images propagate through repost cascades across five ideologically diverse Reddit communities, and predicts both immediate post-level virality and long-term cascade-level spread.

2512.04643.tldr: Self-Diagnostic Contrastive Decoding (SEASON) is proposed, a training-free method that adaptively enhances temporal and spatial faithfulness for each output token by dynamically diagnosing each token's hallucination tendency and applying adaptive contrastive decoding against its corresponding temporal and spatial negatives.

2512.04653.tldr: A multi-perspective experimental analysis of the two implemented SEMI-CTDE-based models covering ablations of the architecture's core elements including rule based and fully decentralized baselines shows that they achieve consistently superior performance and remain effective across a wide range of traffic densities and distributions.

2512.04680.tldr: A research roadmap that highlights the challenges of integrating GenAI into SASs and outlines two main categories to potential benefits: enhancements to the autonomy of SASs centered around the specific functions of the MAPE-K feedback loop, and improvements in the interaction between humans and SASs within human-on-the-loop settings.

2512.04691.tldr: A research agenda aimed at ensuring the ethical behavior of multi-agent systems of LLMs (MALMs) from the perspective of mechanistic interpretability is outlined, including developing comprehensive evaluation frameworks to assess ethical behavior at individual, interactional, and systemic levels.

2512.04694.tldr: This work addresses strong ground motion generation from time-domain accelerometer records and introduces TimesNet-Gen, a time-domain conditional generator, a time-domain conditional generator that employs a latent bottleneck with station identity conditioning.

2512.04711.tldr: This work employs the Mimi as a speech codec, converting speech into discrete tokens compatible with existing network architectures, and proposes an adaptive controller module that enables adaptive transmission and in-band Unequal Error Protection (UEP), dynamically adjusting to both speech content and packet loss probability under bandwidth constraints.

2512.04714.tldr: Patrick is presented, an AI built on the contrary philosophy: that the path to victory lies not in being unexploitable, but in being maximally exploitative.

2512.04716.tldr: This work proposes an AI Fluid Scientist framework that autonomously executes the complete experimental workflow: hypothesis generation, experimental design, robotic execution, data analysis, and manuscript preparation, and validation of vortex-induced vibration and wake-induced vibration in tandem cylinders is validated.

2512.04728.tldr: The Multilevel Insight Network for Disentanglement (MIND), a novel hierarchical visual encoder that introduces a Status Judgment module to algorithmically suppress ambiguous lip features based on their temporal feature variance, achieving explicit visual disentanglement is introduced.

2512.04733.tldr: E3AD is proposed, an emotion-aware VLA framework that augments semantic understanding with two cognitively inspired components: a continuous Valenc-Arousal-Dominance (VAD) emotion model that captures tone and urgency from language, and a dual-pathway spatial reasoning module that fuses egocentric and allocentric views for human-like spatial cognition.

2512.04738.tldr: OsmT, an open-source tag-aware language model specifically designed to bridge natural language and Overpass Query Language (OverpassQL), a structured query language for accessing large-scale OpenStreetMap (OSM) data, is presented.

2512.04746.tldr: SignRoundV2 is presented, a post-training quantization framework that is highly effective even without mixed-precision, and introduces a fast sensitivity metric that combines gradient information with quantization-induced deviations to guide layer-wise bit allocation and a lightweight pre-tuning search for quantization scales to improve extremely low-bit quantization.

2512.04764.tldr: Two larger-scale user studies suggest that order effects do not pose a significant issue for the successful employment of XIL approaches, and contributes to the ongoing efforts for understanding human factors in AI.

2512.04773.tldr: This work proposes different machine-learning methods based on branch prediction and reinforcement learning that consistently outperform the regression-based method proposed in the literature and can significantly improve the worst-case mission time by up to 4.1x.

2512.04779.tldr: This work proposes a melody-driven SVS framework capable of synthesizing arbitrary lyrics following any reference melody, without relying on phoneme-level alignment, and builds on a Diffusion Transformer architecture, enhanced with a dedicated melody extraction module that derives melody representations directly from reference audio.

2512.04785.tldr: ASTRIDE is the first framework to both extend STRIDE with AI-specific threats and integrate fine-tuned VLMs with a reasoning LLM to fully automate diagram-driven threat modeling in AI agent-based applications.

2512.04793.tldr: YingMusic-SVC is proposed, a robust zero-shot framework that unifies continuous pre-training, robust supervised fine-tuning, and Flow-GRPO reinforcement learning that achieves consistent improvements over strong open-source baselines in timbre similarity, intelligibility, and perceptual naturalness.

2512.04797.tldr: A capacity for open-ended self-improvement is demonstrated: by leveraging Gemini to generate tasks and provide rewards, SIMA 2 can autonomously learn new skills from scratch in a new environment, validates a path toward creating versatile and continuously learning agents for both virtual and, eventually, physical worlds.

2512.04822.tldr: It is argued for a shift from post-hoc explanation to justifiable Agentic AI, where decisions are grounded in explicit, inspectable evidence and reasoning accessible to both experts and non-specialists.

2512.04834.tldr: The ability of open-source multilingual LLMs to understand EHRs in Italian and help extract information from them in real-time is explored, revealing that some LLMs struggle in zero-shot, on-premises settings, and others show significant variation in performance.

2512.04841.tldr: A unified causality analysis framework that systematically supports all levels of causal investigation in LLMs, ranging from token-level, neuron-level, and layer-level interventions to representation-level analysis, and establishes a reproducible foundation for research on causality-based attacks, interpretability, and robust attack detection and mitigation in LLMs.

2512.04843.tldr: Using abductive qualitative analysis, an expert-guided taxonomy of generative AI risks is developed, demonstrating how certain user interactions with generative AI systems intersect with clinical features of eating disorders in ways that may intensify risk.

2512.04844.tldr: This work introduces Source-Shielded Updates (SSU), a selective parameter update strategy that proactively preserves source knowledge that reduces performance degradation on monolingual source tasks and mitigates catastrophic forgetting.

2512.04847.tldr: This work introduces AcuLa (Audio-Clinical Understanding via Language Alignment), a lightweight post-training framework that instills semantic understanding into any audio encoder by aligning it with a medical language model, which acts as a"semantic teacher."

2512.04854.tldr: A process-oriented evaluation framework is proposed that addresses four critical dimensions absent from current benchmarks: dialogue quality, workflow orchestration, session continuity, and researcher experience, essential for evaluating AI systems as research co-pilots rather than as isolated task executors.

2512.04864.tldr: It is observed and defined agentic upward deception, a phenomenon in which an agent facing environmental constraints conceals its failure and performs actions that were not requested without reporting, suggesting that it is difficult to eliminate and highlighting the need for stronger mitigation strategies to ensure the safety of LLM-based agents.

2512.04868.tldr: SEAL incorporates a self-evolving mechanism that integrates local and global memory with a reflection module, enabling continuous adaptation from dialog history and execution feedback without explicit retraining, underscoring the framework's capacity for robust and scalable conversational reasoning.

2512.04871.tldr: STELLA (Semantic-Temporal Alignment with Language Abstractions), a framework that systematically mines and injects structured supplementary and complementary information, outperforms state-of-the-art methods in long- and short-term forecasting, showing superior generalization in zero-shot and few-shot settings.

2512.04895.tldr: Chameleon is a novel, adaptive adversarial framework designed to expose and exploit scaling vulnerabilities in production VLMs, and employs an iterative, agent-based optimization mechanism that dynamically refines image perturbations based on the target model's real-time feedback.

2512.04923.tldr: This work introduces a theoretical framework for analyzing reasoning algorithms, formalizes the principles underlying popular techniques for iterative improvement and answer aggregation, and offers a general perspective that may extend to a wide range of current and future reasoning oracles.

2512.04938.tldr: Continuous neurocognitive monitoring via smartphone speech analysis integrated with Relational Graph Transformer (RELGT) architectures would transform episodic neurology into continuous personalized monitoring for millions globally.

2402.13927.tldr: Results indicate that humans effectively incorporate both labeled and unlabeled information in a manner consistent with the delusional hedge algorithm, suggesting that human learners not only gauge the accuracy of information sources but also their consistency with other reliable sources.

2407.13535.tldr: This work demonstrates the sufficiency of visual route-based decision-making in a classic open field navigation task often assumed to require a cognitive map and proposes reframing navigation from the bottom-up, through an egocentric episodic perspective without assuming online access to computationally expensive top-down representations.

2408.10901.tldr: This work proposes the Posterior Collapse Attack (PCA), a novel framework for protecting images from unauthorized manipulation that outperforms existing techniques in protection effectiveness, computational efficiency (runtime and VRAM), and generalization across VAE-based LDM variants.

2411.15061.tldr: This thesis finds that AI can disrupt the ideation phase by enabling clients to engage in the design process through rapid visualization of their ideas and finds that there is uncertainty among architects about the interpretative sovereignty of architecture and identity when AI increasingly takes over authorship.

2412.16181.tldr: This paper introduces efficient combinatorial algorithms for solving the Minimum Weighted Feedback Arc Set problem and shows that these simple, learning free methods achieve substantially faster runtimes than recent learning based approaches, while also delivering competitive, and in many cases superior, ranking accuracy.

2503.02269.tldr: This work proposes sampling methods that extend RR to experience replay, both in uniform and prioritized settings, and analyze their properties via theoretical analysis and simulations, and evaluates their effectiveness in deep reinforcement learning.

2506.09532.tldr: Athena-PRM sets the state-of-the-art (SoTA) results in VisualProcessBench and outperforms the previous SoTA by 3.9 F1-score, showcasing its robust capability to accurately assess the correctness of the reasoning step.

2506.10138.tldr: A precise understanding of the plan representation allows us to directly understand the bidirectional planning-like algorithm learned by model-free training in more familiar terms.

2507.09080.tldr: The findings show that BioAnalyst can provide a strong baseline both for biotic and abiotic tasks, acting as a macroecological simulator with a yearly forecasting horizon and monthly resolution, offering the first application of this type of modelling in the biodiversity domain.

2509.04734.tldr: Beyond I-Con is presented, a framework that enables systematic discovery of novel loss functions by exploring alternative statistical divergences and highlights the importance of considering divergence choices in representation learning optimization.

2511.04439.tldr: Correctness-Relative Policy Optimization (CoRPO), a simple modification to the GRPO objective that clips the minimum baseline to a fixed correctness threshold, is proposed, showing that baseline clipping introduces a protective bias to advantage estimation that mitigates overfitting while preserving effective exploration.

2511.21750.tldr: This work conducts a comprehensive study of visual structural output capabilities for MLLMs with a carefully designed SO-Bench benchmark, and conducts training experiments to largely improve the model's structured output capability.

2512.03915.tldr: This work provides a theoretical framework for analyzing the Auxiliary-Loss-Free Load Balancing (ALF-LB) procedure by casting it as a one-step-per-iteration primal-dual method for an assignment problem and incorporates the stochastic and dynamic nature of AI training using a generalized online optimization formulation.

2512.04120.tldr: A contextual data sensitivity framework building on two core concepts: type contextualization, which considers the type of the data values at hand within the overall context of the dataset or document to assess their true sensitivity, and domain contextualization, which assesses the sensitivity of data values informed by domain-specific information external to the dataset.

2512.04254.tldr: This article presents the first investigation into the potential of reasoning language models for digital forensics, and shows that the reasoning component aids in explaining and validating language model outputs in digital forensics at medium reasoning levels, but this support is often limited, and higher reasoning levels do not enhance response quality.

2512.04869.tldr: Novel issues arising from developing a nationwide AI tutor are overviewed and the practical questions that point to specific gaps in scientific understanding of the learning process are highlighted.

2512.04957.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that although LLM classifiers can learn latent linguistic structures either from raw text or from explicitly provided features, different features contribute unevenly across tasks, which underscores the importance of incorporating more complex linguistic signals during model training.

2512.04958.tldr: This work defines Realizable Abstractions, a new relation between generic low-level MDPs and their associated high-level decision processes and proposes RARL, a new HRL algorithm that returns compositional and near-optimal low-level policies, taking advantage of the Realizable Abstraction given in the input.

2512.04963.tldr: GeoPE is introduced, a framework that extends rotations to 3D Euclidean space using quaternions and constructs a unified rotational operator by computing the geometric mean in the Lie algebra, creating a geometrically coupled encoding that effectively separates spatial dimensions.

2512.04988.tldr: A groundbreaking new framework is put forward that is the first to capture the real-world economic forces that shape agentic labor markets: adverse selection, moral hazard, and reputation dynamics.

2512.04992.tldr: Two adapted variants of the Smith-Waterman algorithm for local sequence alignment are introduced and used to compute the edit distance in a grammar-based evolutionary architecture search, enabling us to efficiently calculate a distance metric for neural architectures and to generate a set of hybrid offspring from two parent models.

2512.05000.tldr: This work repurposes a pre-trained DiT-based foundation model by conditioning it on reflection-contaminated inputs and guiding it toward clean transmission layers, and develops a physically based rendering pipeline in Blender to synthesize realistic glass materials and reflection effects.

2512.05013.tldr: The Temporal Data Kernel Perspective Space (TDKPS) is introduced, which jointly embeds agents across time, and proposes several novel hypothesis tests for detecting behavioral change at the agent- and group-level in black-box multi-agent systems.

2512.05049.tldr: The proposed QKAN-LSTM provides a scalable and interpretable pathway toward quantum-inspired sequential modeling in real-world data environments and extends the framework to the Jiang-Huang-Chen-Goan Network, which generalizes KAN to encoder-decoder structures, and then further use QKAN to realize the latent KAN, thereby creating a Hybrid QKAN (HQKAN) for hierarchical representation learning.

2512.05058.tldr: This work proposes a quantum meta-learning framework that trains advanced quantum sequence models to generate effective parameter initialization policies, and investigates four classical or quantum sequence models, including the Quantum Kernel-based Long Short-Term Memory (QK-LSTM), as learned optimizers in a "learning to learn" paradigm.

2512.05066.tldr: This work evaluates the Chemistry-based Multi-LLM collaboration strategy on real-world clinical scenarios to investigate whether such interaction-aware ensembles can generate credible, patient-specific medication recommendations.

2512.05073.tldr: This work evaluates Small Language Models coupled with a curated agentic AI framework on NVIDIA's Comprehensive Verilog Design Problems benchmark, showing that agentic workflows not only unlock near-LLM performance at a fraction of the cost but also create learning opportunities for agents, paving the way for efficient, adaptive solutions in complex design tasks.

2512.05098.tldr: Spatial Aesthetics is introduced, a paradigm that assesses the aesthetic quality of interior images along four dimensions: layout, harmony, lighting, and distortion, and significantly outperforms existing methods on SA-BENCH, setting a new standard for spatial aesthetics evaluation.

2512.05100.tldr: This work proposes Format Reinforcement Learning, which employs Group Relative Policy Optimization on top of a supervised fine-tuning model to directly optimize novel structure-aware rewards: 1) TreeSim, which measures structural similarity between predicted and reference XML trees and 2) Node-chrF, which measures translation quality at the level of XML nodes.

2512.05105.tldr: This work proposes a self-distillation technique, in which the same base language model plays the role of both teacher and student, but receives different semantic contexts about the correctness of its outcome at training time, in which the same base language model plays the role of both teacher and student, but receives different semantic contexts about the correctness of its outcome at training time.

2512.05110.tldr: This work provides a practical pipeline for creating shadow-drawing art and broadens the design space of computational visual art, bridging the gap between algorithmic design and artistic storytelling.

2512.05112.tldr: This work proposes Draft-as-CoT (DraCo), a novel interleaved reasoning paradigm that fully leverages both textual and visual contents in CoT for better planning and verification, and achieves a tremendous increase on GenEval, Imagine-Bench, and GenEval++, significantly outperforming direct generation and other generation methods empowered by CoT.

2309.14779.tldr: This paper introduces the prompt-based learning paradigm that significantly reduces the dependency on extensive datasets, and allows small language models to achieve competitive intent recognition performance with only a minimal amount of training data.

2407.03331.tldr: The core idea of Anole is to first establish an army of compact DNN models, and then adaptively select the model fitting the current test sample best for online inference, which outwits the method of using a versatile large DNN in terms of prediction accuracy, response time and power consumption.

2407.16344.tldr: A novel plug-and-play architecture for FSAR called Spatio-tempOral frAme tuPle enhancer (SOAP) is proposed and SOAP-Net achieves new state-of-the-art performance across well-known benchmarks such as SthSthV2, Kinetics, UCF101, and HMDB51.

2408.05109.tldr: A comprehensive review of Text-to-SQL techniques powered by LLMs, covering its entire lifecycle from the following four aspects: model, data, evaluation, research challenges and open problems, and a rule of thumb for developing Text-to-SQL solutions.

2408.06710.tldr: This work combines the strengths of Sequential Monte Carlo samplers and VI to explore a wider range of posterior distributions and gradually approach the target distribution, and proposes an efficient algorithm by reparameterizing all variables in the evidence lower bound (ELBO).

2408.13131.tldr: This work introduces DEF, a novel approach for simultaneous forecasting of multiple future events on a horizon with high accuracy and diversity and establishes a new state-of-the-art in long-horizon event prediction, achieving up to a 50% relative improvement over existing temporal point processes and event prediction models.

2411.10500.tldr: A new threat model is presented that explores the feasibility of generating universal adversarial perturbations when the attacker has access only to the edge portion of the model, consisting of its initial network layers, and introduces the first adversarial attacks with edge-only knowledge in split inference.

2412.07031.tldr: This work provides an econometric framework for realizing large language models' potential in two empirical uses: prediction problems—forecasting outcomes from text and estimation problems—automating the measurement of economic concepts for downstream analysis.

2412.07755.tldr: SAT, a simulated spatial aptitude training dataset utilizing 3D simulators, comprising both static and dynamic spatial reasoning across 175K question-answer (QA) pairs and 20K scenes, reveals that simulations are surprisingly effective at imparting spatial aptitude to MLMs that translate to real images.

2502.03916.tldr: This work tests existing RAG systems for closed-source simulation frameworks, in this case the mesh-free simulation software Pasimodo, and tailoring the information provided to the LLMs dependent to the prompts proves to be a significant improvement.

2502.16406.tldr: This paper proposes a DFL structure, called TrustChain, that scores the aggregators before selection based on their past behavior and additionally audits them after the aggregation, and relies on several principles, including blockchain, anomaly detection, and concept drift analysis.

2504.06580.tldr: This work proposes two effective video manipulation methods: Action Masking, which masks frames of frequently co-occurring actions, and Sequence Shuffling, which randomizes the order of action segments.

2504.07640.tldr: Experimental results in a defined domain suggest significant improvements in semantic coherence and factual accuracy of LLM outputs, showcasing the potential of combining LLM fluency with the rigor of formal semantics.

2505.01309.tldr: This article proposes an innovative approach for the automatic rewriting of SPARQL queries from a source ontology to a target ontology, based on a user's need expressed in natural language, that leverages the principles of equivalence transitivity as well as the advanced capabilities of large language models such as GPT-4.

2505.01592.tldr: AURA is proposed, an Agent-User inteRaction Assessment framework that conceptualizes the behavioral stages of interactive task planning agents and offers a comprehensive assessment of agent through a set of atomic LLM evaluation criteria, allowing researchers and practitioners to diagnose specific strengths and weaknesses within the agent's decision-making pipeline.

2506.07339.tldr: Results demonstrate that RTC is fast, performant, and uniquely robust to inference delay, significantly improving task throughput and enabling high success rates in precise tasks $\unicode{x2013}$ such as lighting a match $\unicode{x2013}$ even in the presence of significant latency.

2506.16402.tldr: IS-Bench is presented, the first multi-modal benchmark designed for interactive safety, featuring 161 challenging scenarios with 388 unique safety risks instantiated in a high-fidelity simulator that facilitates a novel process-oriented evaluation that verifies whether risk mitigation actions are performed before/after specific risk-prone steps.

2507.15663.tldr: SustainDiffusion is introduced, a search-based approach designed to enhance the social and environmental sustainability of SD models that can reduce gender bias in generated images while also lowering the energy consumption required for image generation.

2507.17948.tldr: VERIRAG is introduced, a post-retrieval auditing framework that shifts the task from classification to methodological vulnerability detection, and is viewed as a "vulnerability-detection copilot," providing structured audit trails for human editors.

2508.10875.tldr: This survey provides a holistic overview of the current DLM landscape, tracing its evolution and relationship with other paradigms, such as autoregressive and masked language models, and cover both foundational principles and state-of-the-art models.

2508.10967.tldr: Experiments show that Retro-Expert not only surpasses both LLM-based and specialized models across different metrics but also provides expert-aligned explanations that bridge the gap between AI predictions and actionable chemical insights.

2508.11222.tldr: This paper introduces the first evolutionary testing framework, ORFuzz, for the systematic detection and analysis of LLM over-refusal, and provides a robust automated testing framework and a valuable community resource, paving the way for developing more reliable and trustworthy LLM-based software systems.

2508.16560.tldr: If L0 is not set correctly, the SAE fails to disentangle the underlying features of the LLM, and this work shows that L0 must be set correctly to train SAEs with correct features.

2509.10809.tldr: S&P Top-K is introduced, a retraining-free and computationally lightweight Selection and Projection framework that identifies Top-K encoder features aligned with a sensitive attribute or behavior, optionally aggregates them into a single control axis, and computes an orthogonal projection to be subsequently applied directly in the model's native embedding space.

2509.11536.tldr: HARP (Hallucination detection via reasoning subspace projection), a novel hallucination detection framework, establishes that the hidden state space of LLMs can be decomposed into a direct sum of a semantic subspace and a reasoning subspace, where the former encodes linguistic expression and the latter captures internal reasoning processes.

2509.15239.tldr: This extended abstract details the attempt to build a neural algorithmic reasoner that can solve Knapsack, a pseudo-polynomial problem bridging classical algorithms and combinatorial optimisation, but omitted in standard NAR benchmarks.

2509.15582.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed LSTM-ResB-PPO achieves significantly faster convergence, attaining stable policy performance in approximately half the training iterations required by the PPO baseline, while simultaneously enhancing both reward outcomes and training stability, validate the framework's effectiveness in enhancing robustness, safety, and real-time feasibility in complex assistive planning tasks.

2509.16567.tldr: This work proposes a novel, plug-and-play black-box counterfactual generation framework, which suggests step-by-step edits based on theoretical guarantees of optimal edits to produce human-level counterfactual explanations with zero training.

2510.00080.tldr: This study introduces SoREX, a self-explanatory GNN-based social recommendation framework that adopts a two-tower framework enhanced by friend recommendation, independently modeling social relations and user–item interactions, while jointly optimizing an auxiliary task to reinforce social signals.

2510.01498.tldr: A unified deep learning framework that generates synthetic CECT images from NCCT scans while simultaneously segmenting the aortic lumen and thrombus, and consistently outperformed state-of-the-art single-task and multi-stage models is proposed.

2510.04996.tldr: Reinforce-Ada, a family of algorithms that dynamically allocates inference budgets based on prompt difficulty, effectively scaling up RL compute to where it is needed most while maintaining the same total inference budget is proposed.

2510.05497.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive data-centric analysis of large-scale MoE models and a concrete design study using the learned lessons, with profiling traces and simulation framework already open-sourced with $>$1k downloads.

2510.12229.tldr: Surprisingly, it is found that patching activations from the corresponding pretrained model into just a few critical layers is sufficient to eliminate the Knobe effect and offer new evidence that social biases in LLMs can be interpreted, localized, and mitigated through targeted interventions, without the need for model retraining.

2510.18526.tldr: This work introduces a structural causal model (SCM) to feature complex interdependency and prioritization among features, as well as the causal relationship between high-level value dimensions and behaviors, and applies counterfactual reasoning to generate outputs aligned with any desired value objectives.

2510.21084.tldr: This work evaluates several representative LLM families (GLM, Llama, Qwen) under a unified methodological framework including zero-shot prompting, in-context learning, chain-of-thought prompting, and supervised fine-tuning using LoRA to highlight both the potential and limitations of LLMs for Chinese drug recommendation.

2511.05811.tldr: MOSS introduces a two-level microscaling strategy for quantizing sensitive activations, which balances precision and dequantization cost by combining a high-precision global scale with compact, power-of-two local scales; and automatic scaling for weights in linear layers, which eliminates the need for costly max-reduction operations by predicting and adjusting scaling factors during training.

2511.06626.tldr: Self-report fine-tuning (SRFT) is proposed, a simple supervised fine-tuning technique that trains models to occasionally make factual mistakes, then admit them when asked, and provides a promising technique for promoting honesty propensity and incriminating misaligned AIs.

2511.07820.tldr: This work posit motion tracking as a natural and scalable task for humanoid control, leveraging dense supervision from diverse motion-capture data to acquire human motion priors without manual reward engineering, and builds a foundation model for motion tracking by scaling along three axes.

2511.08475.tldr: This study conducted a study to identify the QAs that LLM-based MASs for SE tasks focus on, the design patterns used in the MASs, and the design rationale for the MASs, and presented the implications for the design of LLM-based MASs to support SE tasks.

2511.08887.tldr: This work proposes FAST-CAD, a theoretically grounded framework that combines domain-adversarial training with group distributionally robust optimization (Group-DRO) for fair and accurate non-contact stroke diagnosis and provides both practical advances and theoretical insights for fair medical AI systems.

2511.11315.tldr: Layer-wise Adaptive Ensemble Tuning (LAET) is proposed, a novel strategy that selectively fine-tunes the most effective layers of pre-trained LLMs by analyzing hidden state representations while freezing less critical layers to significantly reduce computational overhead while enhancing task-specific performance.

2511.12208.tldr: This work proposes Debate over Mixed-knowledge (DoM), a novel framework that enables dynamic integration of structured and unstructured knowledge for IKGQA and shows that DoM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2511.15718.tldr: This work introduces ToolMind, a large-scale, high-quality tool-agentic dataset with 160k synthetic data instances generated using over 20k tools and 200k augmented open-source data instances and employs fine-grained turn-level filtering to remove erroneous or suboptimal steps, ensuring that only high-quality reasoning traces are retained.

2511.16334.tldr: This work introduces OpenMMReasoner, a fully transparent two-stage recipe for multimodal reasoning spanning supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), which achieves a 11.6% improvement over the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct baseline across nine multimodal reasoning benchmarks.

2511.18491.tldr: MindEval, a framework designed in collaboration with Ph.D-level Licensed Clinical Psychologists for automatically evaluating language models in realistic, multi-turn mental health therapy conversations, and balances resistance to gaming with reproducibility via its fully automated, model-agnostic design.

2511.19114.tldr: A Physics-Informed Neural Operator (PINO) that directly learns the GSE solution operator, mapping shape parameters of last closed flux surface to equilibrium solutions for realistic nonlinear current profiles and establishes PINO as a promising pathway for next-generation fusion control systems.

2511.21740.tldr: An end-to-end Brain-to-Text (BIT) framework that translates neural activity into coherent sentences using a single differentiable neural network, advancing the integration of large, diverse neural datasets and paving the way for an end-to-end decoding framework that supports seamless, differentiable optimization.

2512.00607.tldr: This paper interprets the execution trace as a spacetime DAG of local update events and exhibits a family of recursively defined holographic boundary summaries such that, along the square-root-space simulation, the total description length of all boundary data stored at any time is $O(\sqrt{t})$.

2512.03103.tldr: This study presents a comprehensive analysis of public sentiment toward traffic management policies in Knoxville, Tennessee, utilizing social media data from Twitter and Reddit platforms, revealing predominantly negative sentiment.

2512.03540.tldr: Experimental results on recipe illustration benchmarks show that CookAnything performs better than existing methods in training-based and training-free settings, and holds significant potential for broad applications in instructional media, and procedural content creation.

2512.04442.tldr: This research tackles a growing problem facing engineering teams, how to evaluate and review outputs from FM tasks, by proposing an approach to synthesise a FM task-specific evaluator program that provides automation and a custom UI for capturing feedback.

2512.04535.tldr: The Generalist Tool Model is introduced, a 1.5-billion-parameter model that learns to act as a universal tool simulator that establishes GTM as a foundational component for developing future AI agents, enabling efficient and scalable training of tool-augmented systems.

2512.05119.tldr: RAG-IGBench is presented, a thorough benchmark designed specifically to evaluate the task of Interleaved Generation based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG-IG) in open-domain question answering and introduces innovative evaluation metrics that measure the quality of text and images, as well as their consistency.

2512.05121.tldr: PESTalk is introduced, a novel approach that generates 3D facial animations with Personalized Emotional Styles directly from speech inputs, thus significantly enhancing the realism of facial animations and outperform state-of-the-art methods.

2512.05122.tldr: The results demonstrate that conversational LLMs can potentially be used to lower the skill and cost barriers to rigorous process documentation, helping SMEs preserve institutional knowledge, enhance operational transparency, and accelerate continuous-improvement efforts.

2512.05126.tldr: SyncVoice, a vision-augmented video dubbing framework built upon a pretrained text-to-speech (TTS) model, achieves high-fidelity speech generation with strong synchronization performance, demonstrating its potential in video dubbing tasks.

2512.05131.tldr: This work proposes AREA3D, an active reconstruction agent that leverages feed-forward 3D reconstruction models and vision-language guidance, and decouples view-uncertainty modeling from the underlying feed-forward reconstructor, enabling precise uncertainty estimation without expensive online optimization.

2512.05137.tldr: ChromouVQA, a large-scale, multi-task benchmark based on Ishihara-style chromatic camouflaged images, is introduced and a model-agnostic contrastive recipe aligning silhouettes with their camouflaged renderings is proposed, improving recovery of global shapes.

2512.05140.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that FlowEO outperforms existing image translation approaches for domain adaptation while achieving on-par or better perceptual image quality, highlighting the potential of flow-matching-based UDA for remote sensing.

2512.05162.tldr: The Semantic Characterization Theorem is proved: the leading eigenfunctions of $P$ induce finitely many spectral basins of invariant meaning, each definable in an o-minimal structure over $\mathbb{R}$.

2512.05167.tldr: This paper describes a course structured in two sequential and complementary parts: foundational machine learning concepts and contemporary LLM applications that enables students to develop a comprehensive understanding of AI evolution while building practical skills with both established and cutting-edge technologies.

2512.05169.tldr: This study represents an extensive workload, encompassing the review of over 140 foundational and recent publications, the development of comparative insights on integration strategies such as early fusion, late fusion, and joint learning, and the structured investigation of practical use cases in the areas of healthcare, multimedia, and social network analysis.

2512.05172.tldr: Enhanced Semantic Motion Representations (Semore), a new VLM-based framework for visual RL, which can simultaneously extract semantic and motion representations through a dual-path backbone from the RGB flows, and exhibits efficient and adaptive ability compared to state-of-art methods.

2512.05176.tldr: A replication study is proposed that translates the process used to develop KorNAT, a Korean National LLM alignment benchmark, to develop CIVIQ, a Cultural Intelligence and Values Inference Quality benchmark centered on alignment with community social values and common knowledge.

2512.05179.tldr: A chatbot for the University of Limerick's Department of Electronic and Computer Engineering to provide course information to students is developed, showing that fine-tuning BERT with academic QA pairs yields effective results, highlighting the potential to scale towards the first domain-specific QA model for universities and enabling autonomous educational knowledge systems.

2512.05212.tldr: It is formally proved that no algorithm can demonstrate new functional capabilities that were not already present in the initial algorithm itself, therefore, no algorithm (and thus no A.I. model) can be truly creative in any field of study, whether that is science, engineering, art, sports, etc.

2512.05230.tldr: This work proposes to systematically examine what robots need to generalize across these challenging axes by introducing two key auxiliary tasks, state similarity and invariance to observational perturbations, applied to both demonstration data and static visual data and demonstrates that co-training on this diverse data improves performance by 18 percent over existing generative augmentation methods.

2512.05234.tldr: This work introduces MAR-FL, a novel P2P FL system that leverages iterative group-based aggregation to substantially reduce communication overhead while retaining resilience to churn, and thereby maintains effectiveness especially as the number of peers in an aggregation round grows.

2512.05239.tldr: This paper systematically analyzes the existing AI-generated code literature to establish an overall understanding of bugs and defects in generated code, providing a reference for future model improvement and quality assessment.

2512.05242.tldr: The study investigates how participants used generative AI tools throughout different phases of the software development process, identifies the types of tasks where such tools were most effective, and analyzes the challenges students encountered to inform future integration of AI-based assistance into software engineering curricula.

2512.05257.tldr: It is shown how possibility theory allows for correct processing of contradictory data, avoiding the logical traps of DST and bringing formal reasoning closer to the logic of natural intelligence.

2512.05267.tldr: This review paper examines formal methodologies that address data-limited regimes through two complementary approaches: quantifying epistemic uncertainty and mitigating data scarcity via synthetic data augmentation.

2512.05270.tldr: XR-DT is presented, an eXtended Reality-enhanced Digital Twin framework for mobile robots, which bridges physical and virtual spaces to enable bi-directional understanding between humans and robots and enables interpretable, trustworthy, and adaptive HRI.

2512.05288.tldr: This work presents the first systematic study to automate WebShell family classification, and establishes a robust baseline and provides practical insights into the most effective combinations of data abstractions, representation models, and learning paradigms for this challenge.

2512.05297.tldr: The Continuous Flow Operator (CFO), a framework that learns continuous-time PDE dynamics without the computational burden of standard continuous approaches, e.g., neural ODE, is introduced.

2512.05311.tldr: This work systematically evaluate the ability of state-of-the-art (SOTA) machine learning models to differentiate between human and LLM-generated ideas, particularly after successive paraphrasing stages, to highlight the challenges SOTA models face in source attribution.

2512.05314.tldr: This study identifies two stable human-AI collaboration patterns that emerged from production deployment: one-click rollout for high-confidence changes and commandeer-revise for complex decisions for complex decisions.

2512.05318.tldr: CoT-Recipe, a formal approach to modulate the mix of CoT and non-CoT examples in meta-training sequences, is proposed and it is demonstrated that careful modulation via CoT-Recipe can increase the accuracy of transformers on novel tasks by up to 300% even when there are no CoT examples available in-context.

2512.05323.tldr: Test sensitivity and robustness of an artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasting model: NVIDIAs FourCastNetv2 (FCNv2) and results indicate that FCNv2 accurately preserves hurricane features under low to moderate noise injection.

2512.05325.tldr: LYNX is introduced, an online early-exit mechanism that turns a model's own hidden-state awareness into confidence-controlled stopping decisions, and offers competitive or superior Pareto frontiers while remaining fully online, requiring no proxy models at inference, and providing explicit, user-tunable confidence guarantees.

2512.05334.tldr: It is shown that summary-based judgments achieve comparable stability in systems'ranking to full-document judgments, while introducing systematic shifts in label distributions and biases that vary by model and dataset.

2512.05343.tldr: This work introduces SpaceControl, a training-free test-time method for explicit spatial control of 3D asset generation and presents an interactive interface for real-time superquadric editing and direct 3D asset generation, enabling seamless use in creative workflows.

2512.05350.tldr: A hybrid methodological approach is proposed that integrates InclusiveMag's inclusivity framework with the GenderMag walkthrough process, tailored to the context of neurodivergent women in SE, to synthesize challenges into cognitive, social, organizational, structural and career progression challenges neurodivergent women face in SE.

2512.05365.tldr: MCP-AI is presented, a novel architecture for explainable medical decision-making built upon the Model Context Protocol a modular, executable specification for orchestrating generative and descriptive AI agents in real-time workflows that provides a scalable basis for interpretable, composable, and safety-oriented AI within upcoming clinical environments.

2512.05371.tldr: ChipMind is introduced, a novel knowledge graph-augmented reasoning framework specifically designed for lengthy IC specifications, which significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on an industrial-scale specification reasoning benchmark.

2512.05373.tldr: By discarding irrelevant texts while retaining key signals, CATR mitigates observational-level positivity violations and stabilizes downstream causal effect estimators and yields more accurate, stable, and interpretable causal effect estimates than existing baselines.

2512.05374.tldr: Early work developing a portable instance of DFC for DBMSes is described and a broader research agenda toward DFC for agent ecosystems is outlined and outlines a broader research agenda toward DFC for agent ecosystems.

2512.05379.tldr: This paper investigates strategies to mitigate self-preference by reducing the LM judges'ability to recognize their own outputs by applying black-box perturbations to evaluation candidates in pairwise comparison to obfuscate the authorship and reduce self-recognition.

2512.05383.tldr: This work proposes a systematic, quantitative approach to detect and characterize unsafe stimulation patterns in ML-driven neurostimulation systems, and establishes a foundation for evidence-based benchmarking, regulatory readiness, and ethical assurance in next-generation neural interfaces.

2512.05386.tldr: This work evaluates the generalization capability of state-of-the-art scoring functions on dataset splits that simulate evaluation on targets with a limited number of known structures and experimental affinity measurements and probes the efficacy of simple methods that leverage limited test-target data to improve scoring function performance.

2512.05402.tldr: MineROI-Net is proposed, an open source Transformer-based architecture designed to capture multi-scale temporal patterns in mining profitability that outperforms LSTM-based and TSLANet baselines and demonstrates strong economic relevance.

2512.05411.tldr: These findings confirm that metadata enrichment improves vector space organization and retrieval effectiveness while maintaining sub-30 ms P95 latency, providing a quantitative decision framework for deploying high-performance, scalable RAG systems in enterprise settings.

2512.05415.tldr: A multi-input convolutional neural network integrated with a convolutional block attention module that reduces the human workload by more than 99% compared to manual verification of moving objects.

2512.05432.tldr: Investigation of how universities and industries engage in shaping AI education and workforce preparation in Africa shows broad recognition of AI importance but limited evidence of consistent engagement, practical training, or equitable access to resources.

2512.05439.tldr: BEAVER is presented, the first practical framework for computing deterministic, sound probability bounds on LLM constraint satisfaction, and systematically explores the generation space using novel token trie and frontier data structures, maintaining provably sound bounds at every iteration.

2512.05449.tldr: This work proposes akrasia as a foundational concept for analyzing inconsistency and goal drift in agentic AI systems, and introduces a preliminary version of the Akrasia Benchmark, a structured set of prompting conditions that measures when a model's local response contradicts its own prior commitments.

2512.05453.tldr: Parajudica, an open, modular, and extensible RDF/SPARQL-based rule system for evaluating context-dependent data compliance status is presented, demonstrating the utility of this resource and accompanying metamodel through application to existing legal frameworks and industry standards.

2512.05461.tldr: A unified framework for evaluating LLM uncertainty along two dimensions: the task type (T), which distinguishes between classification, short-form, and long-form generation, and the validation type (V), which captures the availability of reference data or evaluative criteria is introduced.

2512.05464.tldr: This work introduces Collective Agency (CA) -a unified and open-ended alignment value that encourages integrated agentic capabilities and proposes Dynamic Alignment-an alignment framework that enables an LLM to iteratively align itself.

2512.05468.tldr: The Chulalongkorn University Building Recognition Dataset (CUBR) is developed, which is specialized for Chulalongkorn University as a case study in Thailand and demonstrates that training on WAFL scenarios achieves better accuracy than self-training scenarios.

2512.05469.tldr: A clear view of how and when ensembles maintain high accuracy while keeping overfitting low is provided, offering practical guidance for model selection in real world tabular applications.

2512.05475.tldr: Graph embedding of features is shown to be an effective pathway to greater trainability for geometric datasets and permutational symmetric embedding is found to be the most generalizable quantum Machine Learning model for geometric learning.
