2512.05481.tldr: UniFS, a Unified Frequency-Spatial Fusion model designed to handle multiple k-space undersampling patterns for MCMR tasks without any need for retraining, is proposed and an adaptive prompt-guided frequency fusion module for k-space learning is introduced, significantly enhancing the model's generalization performance.

2512.05508.tldr: This work presents an automated pipeline that uses LLM to extract high-dimensional lyric embeddings, capturing semantic, syntactic, and sequential information in HitMusicLyricNet, a multimodal architecture that combines audio, lyrics, and social metadata for popularity score prediction in the range 0-100.

2512.05518.tldr: A new perspective on achieving deep safety alignment is proposed by matching the token ranks of the target distribution, rather than their probabilities, which yields a surprisingly simple fix to the data augmentation defense based on regularizing the attention placed on harmful prefill tokens.

2512.05519.tldr: Examination of user comments on OpenAI's Sora examines how users make sense of AI-generated videos on OpenAI's Sora and identifies four dynamics that characterize how users negotiate authenticity, authorship, and platform governance on Sora.

2512.05529.tldr: Results show that depth-guided prompting and template-based classification offer an annotation-efficient segmentation approach to laparoscopic scene segmentation.

2512.05530.tldr: A Multi-rationale INtegrated Discriminative (MIND) reasoning framework, which is designed to endow MLLMs with human-like cognitive abilities of "Understand ->Rethink ->Correct", and achieves a paradigm evolution from passive imitation-based reasoning to active discriminative reasoning.

2512.05542.tldr: RoBoN (Routed Online Best-of-n), a sequential multi-LLM alternative to the prevailing single-model best-of-n, is proposed, providing a simple, training-free path to test-time scaling with multiple LLMs.

2512.05546.tldr: Conscious Gaze (CG-VLM), a training-free, inference-time framework that converts game-theoretic interpretability into actionable decoding control, is introduced, demonstrating that token-level sensing enables precise, context-aware intervention without compromising foundational knowledge.

2512.05557.tldr: A Human-in-the-Loop pipeline that leverages expert-verified character templates and LLM-guided narrative planning to generate highly-aligned structured data that achieves performance comparable to closed-source models in generating visual narratives.

2512.05576.tldr: This work proposes the Executor-Analyst Framework, a modular architecture that decouples the syntactic precision of tool execution from the semantic robustness of clinical reasoning, and demonstrates that a Stratified Ensemble strategy significantly outperforms global pooling by preserving evidentiary diversity, effectively addressing the information bottleneck.

2512.05579.tldr: This paper presents a cutting-edge robotic inspection solution that integrates a pair of collaborative robots, each equipped with a high-resolution camera-based vision system to accurately detect and localize surface and thread defects in aluminum high-pressure die casting (HPDC) automotive components.

2512.05594.tldr: This work introduces an Ontology Axiom Benchmark OntoAxiom, and systematically test LLMs on that benchmark for axiom identification, evaluating different prompting strategies, ontologies, and axiom types.

2512.05619.tldr: This work presents a novel clause weighting scheme that, for the first time, updates the clause weights of PMS and WPMS instances according to distinct conditions and introduces a new initialization method, which better accommodates the unique characteristics of both instance types.

2512.05638.tldr: An empirical notion of mirage regimes is proposed, where multiple distinct modular decompositions induce indistinguishable jets and thus remain observationally equivalent, and a jet-identifiability theorem is proved in the setting of two-module linear regression pipelines.

2512.05658.tldr: This work presents a method to generate multilingual reasoning traces based on medical knowledge extracted from Wikipedia, and produces 500k traces in English, Italian, and Spanish, using a retrieval-augmented generation approach over medical information from Wikipedia.

2512.05666.tldr: Whether AI-assisted end-user coding is a feasible paradigm for end-user development, which may complement or even replace the LCNC model in the future is investigated and potential implications for practice, future research, and academic teaching are discussed.

2512.05667.tldr: A dynamic programming (DP) framework that applies Bellman recursion over credible sets-state abstractions formally representing all rational follower best responses under partial leader commitments-to compute SSEs is introduced.

2512.05672.tldr: InverseCrafter is proposed, an efficient inpainting inverse solver that reformulates the 4D generation task as an inpainting problem solved in the latent space, thereby bypassing the costly bottleneck of repeated VAE operations and backpropagation.

2512.05681.tldr: A noise-aware evaluation including IDF-weighted keyword overlap as graded relevance, binarization via two thresholds, significance via paired bootstrap, and an nDCG diagnosis supported with qualitative analysis is proposed, which decisively outperforms the domain pre-trained BERT in both settings.

2512.05693.tldr: HiMoE-VLA is presented, a novel vision-language-action (VLA) framework tailored to effectively handle diverse robotic data with heterogeneity which adaptively handles multiple sources of heterogeneity across layers and gradually abstracts them into shared knowledge representations.

2512.05700.tldr: This work homogenise a collection of datasets across question answering and dialogue-based domains and implement human judgements and LLM responses within this dataset, allowing for the reproduction and trialling of faithfulness evaluation across domains.

2512.05711.tldr: Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves near-expert performance, significantly reducing communication interference and mission cost compared to model-free reinforcement learning baselines, while maintaining robust generalization in dynamic environments.

2512.05714.tldr: New trends in AI research funding are revealed, including a shift towards more industry-funded papers and their growing citation impact, greater insularity of industry-funded work than non-funded work, and a preference of industry-funded research to cite recent work.

2512.05732.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation of CICLe across diverse NLP classification benchmarks shows that CICLe consistently improves over its base classifier and outperforms few-shot prompting baselines when the sample size is sufficient for training the base classifier, and performs comparably in low-data regimes.

2512.05734.tldr: KANFormer is introduced, a novel deep-learning-based model for predicting the time-to-fill of limit orders by leveraging both market- and agent-level information and outperforms existing works in both calibration and discrimination.

2512.05760.tldr: This paper proposes evolutionary reasoning optimization (ERO) framework which performs survival of the fittest over a population of LLMs to search for individual with strong reasoning ability and claims two surprising empirical discoveries.

2512.05765.tldr: It is argued that the path to AGI runs through LLMs, not around them, and UCCT is translated into architecture with MACI, a coordination stack that implements baiting, filtering, filtering, and persistence.

2512.05774.tldr: Active Video Perception is presented, an evidence-seeking framework that treats the video as an interactive environment and acquires compact, queryrelevant evidence directly from pixels and outperforms the best agentic method by 5.7% in average accuracy.

2512.05794.tldr: It is suggested that, while TopK SAEs suffice for mapping latent features to concepts, Ordered SAEs are preferable when precise generative steering is required and advance the mechanistic interpretability of domain-specific protein language models.

2512.05803.tldr: A differentiable rendering-based framework for 3D transpedicular path planning utilizing bi-planar 2D X-rays that facilitates versatile, CT-free 3D path planning for robot-assisted vertebroplasty, effectively accommodating real-world imaging diversity without the need for preoperative CT scans.

2512.05809.tldr: This work systematically examines how test-time verifiers behave across benchmarks, uncovering both their promise and their pitfalls, and introduces a Verification through Spatial Assertions (ViSA) framework that grounds the test-time reward in verifiable, frame-anchored micro-claims.

2512.05824.tldr: A Multimodal Oncology Agent integrating a histology tool based on the TITAN foundation model for IDH1 mutation prediction in low-grade glioma, combined with reasoning over structured clinical and genomic inputs through PubMed, Google Search, and OncoKB is introduced.

2512.05825.tldr: This paper provides comprehensive mathematical and algorithmic details of this approximation algorithm used in Couckuyt et al. (2012) and bridges the gap in the literature on rigorous algorithmic description of this approximation algorithm.

2512.05830.tldr: A novel approach is introduced to enhance Phase-OTDR data analysis by transforming 1D data into grayscale images through techniques such as Gramian Angular Difference Field, Gramian Angular Summation Field, and Recurrence Plot, enabling more robust and adaptable analysis using transfer learning models.

2512.05836.tldr: This study presents an end-to-end pipeline for automatically generating client networks from 77 therapy transcripts to support case conceptualization and treatment planning and provides a proof of concept for using LLMs to create clinically relevant networks from therapy transcripts.

2512.05863.tldr: A retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) based medical QA system that combines domain-specific knowledge retrieval with open-source LLMs to answer medical questions and fine-tune two state-of-the-art open LLMs using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for efficient domain specialization.

2512.05880.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach for model selection that operates reliably on just a few unlabeled examples from the target task, based on a novel concept: Neural Coherence, which entails characterizing a model's activation statistics for source and target domains, allowing one to define model selection methods with high data-efficiency.

2512.05908.tldr: This work demonstrates that engineered natural language representations can be more effective than raw source code for scalable bug localization, providing an interpretable repository ->directory ->file search path, which is vital for building trust in enterprise AI tools by providing essential transparency.

2512.05925.tldr: A Paper Correctness Checker based on GPT-5 is developed to systematically identify mistakes in papers previously published at top AI conferences and journals, finding that published papers contain a non-negligible number of objective mistakes.

2512.05930.tldr: Through comprehensive evaluation of existing VLMs, PRiSM is introduced, a synthetic, fully dynamic, and multimodal benchmark for evaluating scientific reasoning via grounded Python code, highlighting their limitations and showcasing how PRiSM enables deeper insights into their scientific reasoning capabilities.

2512.05937.tldr: It is shown how systematically generated synthetic data can test assumptions about feature importance-based XAI and isolate factors between classification quality and XAI values and results show that such metrics can be indicative of complex properties of the training data and task, not purely of learning quality.

2512.05941.tldr: This paper investigates zoom as a strong yet underexplored prior for GUI grounding, and proposes a training-free method, ZoomClick, characterizing four key properties of zoom that unlock its full capabilities for dynamic spatial focusing and adaptive context switching.

2512.05946.tldr: Variational Quantum Rainbow DQN (VQR-DQN), which integrates ring-topology variational quantum circuits with Rainbow DQN to leverage quantum superposition and entanglement to demonstrate the potential of quantum-enhanced DRL for large-scale resource allocation.

2512.05950.tldr: The results show that adversarially trained generative models provide a scalable and principled approach for imputing and merging incomplete, heterogeneous data.

2512.05954.tldr: A large-scale synthetic benchmark of 15,045 university-level physics problems, each problem is fully parameterized, supporting an effectively infinite range of input configurations, and is accompanied by structured, step-by-step reasoning and executable Python code that produces the ground-truth solution for any parameter set.

2512.05958.tldr: MaxShapley is a special case of the celebrated Shapley value; it leverages a decomposable max-sum utility function to compute attributions with linear computation in the number of documents, as opposed to the exponential cost of Shapley values.

2512.05959.tldr: This work introduces M4-RAG, a massive-scale benchmark spanning 42 languages, 56 regional dialects and registers, and 189 countries, comprising over 80,000 culturally diverse image-question pairs for evaluating retrieval-augmented VQA across languages and modalities and builds a controlled retrieval environment containing millions of carefully curated multilingual documents relevant to the query domains.

2512.05960.tldr: This paper presents a novel underwater image enhancement model, called Adaptive Frequency Fusion and Illumination Aware Network (AQUA-Net), which integrates a residual encoder decoder with dual auxiliary branches, which operate in the frequency and illumination domains.

2512.05962.tldr: This work begins from an explicit target distribution, obtained by filtering out incorrect answers while preserving the relative probabilities of correct ones, using the $\alpha$-divergence family, which unifies prior approaches and enables direct control of the precision-diversity trade-off by interpolating between mode-seeking and mass-covering divergences.

2512.05967.tldr: ELERAG is proposed, an enhanced RAG architecture that integrates a factual signal derived from Entity Linking to improve the accuracy of educational question-answering systems in Italian and provides strong experimental evidence of the domain mismatch effect.

2205.09904.tldr: It is demonstrated that under this new taxonomy, many of the applications where transfer learning has been shown to be ineffective or even hinder performance are to be expected when taking into account the source and target datasets and the techniques used.

2310.04752.tldr: A principled learning algorithm is developed based on localized calibration to provide consistency validation across a broader range of losses and localized Lipschitz continuity to provide a fine-grained generalization bound.

2402.11192.tldr: The conclusion reveals that this “familiarity” of an LLM significantly impacts learning performance, and training with LLM-generated responses not only enhances performance but also helps maintain the model’s capabilities in other reasoning tasks after fine-tuning on a specific task.

2402.17801.tldr: The impacts of the fair use standard and AI-copyrightability on AI development, AI company profit, creators income, and consumer welfare are unraveled and underscore the need for policymakers to embrace a dynamic, context-specific approach in making regulatory decisions.

2404.18886.tldr: By separating applications for time series and spatio-temporal data, this study offers a structured perspective on model category, task type, data modality, and practical application domain.

2406.16028.tldr: TimeAutoDiff is presented, a unified latent-diffusion framework for four fundamental time-series tasks: unconditional generation, missing-data imputation, forecasting, and time-varying-metadata conditional generation that consistently improves imputation and forecasting performance.

2409.16001.tldr: The novel contributions, it is argued, draw indirect inspiration from biological principles like modular neural specialization and sparse episodic encoding, addressing computational bottlenecks while aligning with human-inspired scalability.

2410.09718.tldr: This work proposes the Wavelet-Enhanced Convolutional Network, a framework that captures multi-periodic dependencies in tidal current data and integrates a time-frequency analysis method into the framework to further address local periodic features.

2412.00238.tldr: This work provides a comprehensive mathematical framework for TCNs, demonstrating how the twisted convolution operation generalizes standard convolutions while maintaining computational tractability, and exhibits superior training stability and generalization capabilities, highlighting their robustness for non-spatial data classification tasks.

2412.05747.tldr: This work uses AI to model the structure of stories as game-theoretic objects, amenable to quantitative analysis, which allows us to not only interrogate each character's decision making, but also peer into the original author's conception of the characters'world.

2412.06861.tldr: A unified framework named CSI-BERT2 for CSI prediction and classification tasks, built on CSI-BERT, which adapts BERT to capture the complex relationships among CSI sequences through a bidirectional self-attention mechanism and achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks.

2412.10320.tldr: A novel technique rooted in the idea of searching over the grid cells (as in vanilla A*) simultaneously fitting the possible sequences of the motion primitives into these cells is suggested, and the resultant algorithm, MeshA*, provably preserves the guarantees on completeness and optimality.

2412.15701.tldr: Co-Gym is introduced, an open framework for developing and evaluating collaborative agents that engage in bidirectional communication with humans while interacting with task environments and enables the implementation of new task environments and coordination between humans and agents through a flexible, non-turn-taking interaction paradigm.

2502.01445.tldr: An improved fabric defect detection model based on YOLOv11 is proposed, and a Strip Perception Module (SPM) that improves feature capture through multi-scale convolution and a novel focal enhanced complete intersection over union (FECIoU) metric with adaptive weights is proposed.

2502.14011.tldr: DFDT is presented, a novel memory-constrained algorithm for online learning that provides a drop-in alternative to standard VFDT-based learners, enhancing the accuracy-memory-runtime trade-off while minimizing the need for hyperparameter tuning.

2502.16611.tldr: This work explores a novel enrollment strategy that encodes target speaker information from the noisy enrollment by comparing segments where the target speaker is talking with segments where the target speaker is silent (Negative Enrollments), and achieves state-of-the-art performance in the monaural target speaker extraction conditioned on noisy enrollments.

2503.16929.tldr: This work introduces an automated pipeline for systematically constructing temporality-intensive preference pairs and proposes a novel Progressive Pre-SFT Alignment strategy featuring two key innovations: a curriculum learning strategy which progressively increases perturbation difficulty to maximize data efficiency and applying preference optimization before instruction tuning to incentivize fundamental temporal alignment.

2505.11227.tldr: The findings suggest that PRM may not be essential for enhancing complex reasoning, as pure RL not only improves problem-solving skills but also inherently fosters robust PRM capabilities.

2505.18229.tldr: A novel Dynamic Chain-of-Embodied-Task paradigm based on the perception-decision-action loop is introduced, which decomposes complex UAV tasks into standardized, measurable subtasks, and a unified evaluation framework encompassing six core sub-skills is designed.

2505.20561.tldr: The resulting algorithm, BARL, instructs the LLM to stitch and switch strategies based on the observed outcomes, offering principled guidance on when and how the model should reflectively explore, and demonstrates that BARL outperforms conventional RL approaches, achieving superior test-time performance and token efficiency.

2505.21027.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark that evaluates adversarial attacks on tabular datasets with respect to both effectiveness and imperceptibility is introduced, and consistent differences between attack types are revealed.

2505.21298.tldr: This position paper highlights critical discrepancies between MAS theory and current MAS LLMs implementations, focusing on four key areas: the social aspect of agency, environment design, coordination and communication protocols, and measuring emergent behaviours.

2505.21972.tldr: Leveraging the simplex, geometric Bayesian priors are designed that encode epistemic uncertainty about judge quality and vary the priors to conduct sensitivity analyses, highlighting the importance of modeling epistemic uncertainty.

2506.00781.tldr: This paper proposes an agentic workflow to automate and scale the red-teaming process of LLMs through the Composition-of-Principles (CoP) framework, where human users provide a set of red-teaming principles as instructions to an AI agent to automatically orchestrate effective red-teaming strategies and generate jailbreak prompts.

2506.00808.tldr: The confidence pitfall is derived and exploited, a theoretical and empirical pattern showing that nodes adjacent to unlearned edges exhibit a large drop in model confidence, and an adaptive prediction mechanism is designed that applies different similarity thresholds to unlearned and other membership edges.

2506.04478.tldr: It is shown that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA) significantly improves performance in small markets, but fails to bring about a similar improvement on large instances, suggesting the need for more sophisticated strategies to improve LLMs'reasoning with larger-context inputs.

2506.19852.tldr: Radial Attention is proposed, a scalable sparse attention mechanism with $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ complexity that translates energy decay into exponentially decaying compute density, which is significantly more efficient than standard $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ dense attention and more expressive than linear attention.

2507.05630.tldr: This work methodically design an adaptive attack, DataFlip, that consistently evades KAD defenses, achieving detection rates as low as \(0\%\) while reliably inducing malicious behavior with a success rate of \(91\%\)—all without requiring white-box access to the LLM or any optimization procedures.

2507.06274.tldr: This work proposes a novel watermark scheme with Sub-vocabulary decomposed Equivalent tExture Key (SEEK), which achieves a Pareto improvement, increasing the resilience against scrubbing attacks without compromising robustness to spoofing.

2507.11473.tldr: Because CoT monitorability may be fragile, it is recommended that frontier model developers consider the impact of development decisions on CoT monitorability.

2507.14909.tldr: Step by step illustrating the protocol, giving insights concretely showing a different voice (Gilligan 1993) in the ethics of artificial intelligence, a philosophical account of technical choices will be provided together with the results of the experiments, focusing on user experience rather than statistical accuracy.

2507.16302.tldr: Estimating downstream fine-tuning as an implicit optimization problem with a Moreau envelope-based reformulation enables efficient gradient estimation to minimize the recovery of harmful behaviors and consistently outperforms prior unlearning approaches in retaining safety, while effectively preserving benign generation capability.

2507.16329.tldr: DREAM is proposed, a scalable red teaming framework to automatically uncover diverse problematic prompts from a given T2I system, and GC-SPSA, an efficient optimization algorithm that provides stable gradient estimates through the long and potentially non-differentiable T2I pipeline.

2507.18594.tldr: A novel model, DRWKV (Detailed Receptance Weighted Key Value), is proposed, which integrates the proposed Global Edge Retinex (GER) theory, enabling effective decoupling of illumination and edge structures for enhanced edge fidelity.

2507.19961.tldr: The proposed approach utilizes a two-step curriculum learning framework, beginning with the pre-training of a classification model on segmentation masks, followed by fine-tuning on grayscale, inverted ECG images, offering a reliable solution for automated CVD diagnosis.

2507.23565.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed semantic chain-of-trust achieves 100\% accuracy in trust evaluation based on historical collaborations, enabling intelligent, resource-efficient, and precise collaborator selection.

2508.01751.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that this approach, combined with the new filtering algorithm, performs competitively with existing solvers enabling the modeling of producer and consumer scheduling problems and effectively scales to large-scale problems.

2508.03183.tldr: It is found that embedding a physical high-frequency loss control coefficient β in the DeepUFNet model can significantly improve model performance in forecasting spatiotemporal wall pressure information, particularly, high-order frequency fluctuation and wall pressure variance.

2508.08005.tldr: GAT-MLP is developed, a dual-channel model that combines a Graph Attention Network to encode local graph structure with a Multilayer Perceptron to model global features and achieves superior and consistent performance, significantly outperforming all baseline methods.

2508.08222.tldr: This work investigates how transformers learn to solve symbolic multi-step reasoning problems through chain-of-thought processes, focusing on path-finding in trees, and offers insights into the emergence of reasoning abilities.

2508.09442.tldr: This paper designs and implements KV-Cloak, a novel, lightweight, and efficient defense mechanism that achieves robust security with virtually no degradation in model accuracy and minimal performance overhead, offering a practical solution for trustworthy LLM deployment.

2508.13962.tldr: Results indicated that the AI-based auto-grader could grade student-written prompts with satisfactory quality and the instructional materials supported students in improving their prompting skills through practice and led to positive shifts in their perceptions of using AI for learning.

2508.17169.tldr: The preliminary results indicate that a naive combination of natural gradients and orthogonal projections has potential issues, and this finding has motivated continued future work focused on robustly reconciling these geometric perspectives to develop a continual learning method.

2509.00997.tldr: It is argued that data systems need to adapt to more natively support agentic workloads, and a number of new research opportunities for a new agent-first data systems architecture are outlined, ranging from new query interfaces, to new query processing techniques, to new agentic memory stores.

2509.01839.tldr: A novel approach inspired by the explicit construction of the Hodge Laplacian operator in Discrete Exterior Calculus as a product of discrete Hodge operators and exterior derivatives is proposed, which results in a computationally-efficient architecture that achieves comparable performance in mesh segmentation and classification tasks, through a direct learning framework.

2509.05757.tldr: A taxonomy of the principal techniques of Hyperbolic LLMs (HypLLMs) in terms of four main categories: (1) hyperbolic LLMs through exp/log maps; (2) hyperbolic fine-tuned models; (3) fully hyperbolic LLMs, and (4) hyperbolic state-space models.

2509.10691.tldr: PrivateDFL is proposed, a new explainable and privacy-preserving framework that addresses this gap by combining a HyperDimensional Computing model with a transparent DP noise accountant tailored to decentralized learning and yields significantly tighter and more interpretable privacy-utility tradeoffs.

2509.12069.tldr: This paper presents U-Mamba2, a new neural network architecture designed for multi-anatomy CBCT segmentation in the context of the ToothFairy3 challenge, and integrates the Mamba2 state space models into the U-Net architecture, enforcing stronger structural constraints for higher efficiency without compromising performance.

2509.22601.tldr: SPEAR is proposed, a self-imitation learning (SIL) recipe for training agentic LLMs that extends the vanilla SIL, where a replay buffer stores good experience for off-policy update, by gradually steering the policy entropy across stages.

2509.24159.tldr: This work introduces Robust Enhanced Policy Optimization (RE-PO), which uses an expectation-maximization procedure to infer the posterior correctness of each label and then adaptively reweight data points in the training loss to mitigate label noise, and proves that, under a perfectly calibrated model, RE-PO recovers the true noise level of the dataset.

2509.24528.tldr: This work uses SemanticSAM with progressive granularity refinement to generate more accurate and numerous object-level masks, mitigating the over-segmentation commonly observed in mask generation models such as vanilla SAM, and improving downstream 3D semantic segmentation.

2509.25374.tldr: Saliency-conditioned generation with mild pre-alignment as a principled framework for longitudinal reasoning in medical VQA is supported and saliency-conditioned generation with mild pre-alignment as a principled framework for longitudinal reasoning in medical VQA is supported.

2509.26360.tldr: A new form of the temporal grounding problem, Task-oriented Temporal Grounding (ToTG), which is driven by the requirements of downstream tasks rather than explicit time-interval descriptions is introduced, and a new temporal-ground method TimeScope is introduced, which performs coarse-to-fine localization through a progressive reasoning process.

2510.01132.tldr: A training recipe is derived that guides co-design across the three pillars of environment, reward, and policy in multi-turn agentic RL, facilitating research and practical efforts in multi-turn agentic RL.

2510.02324.tldr: This work introduces Contrastive Activation Steering for Amortized Learning (CASAL), an efficient algorithm that connects interpretability with amortized optimization and showcases CASAL's flexibility in mitigating hallucinations in both text-only and vision-language models.

2510.05069.tldr: SwiReasoning is introduced, a training-free framework for LLM reasoning which features two key innovations: 1) SwiReasoning dynamically switches between explicit and latent reasoning, guided by block-wise confidence estimated from entropy trends in next-token distributions, to balance exploration and exploitation and promote timely convergence.

2510.06791.tldr: A heatmap-based extreme amodal object detector that addresses the problem of efficiently predicting a lot from a little with a selective coarse-to-fine decoder and establishes strong results for this new task, even outperforming less efficient generative approaches.

2510.10181.tldr: A general post-deployment learning framework Dejavu is proposed, which employs an Experience Feedback Network (EFN) and augments the frozen Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy with retrieved execution memories.

2510.13515.tldr: The advanced understanding capabilities of MLLMs are leveraged to enhance representation learning and a novel Universal Multimodal Embedding (UniME-V2) model is presented, which achieves state-of-the-art performance on average across all tasks.

2510.15087.tldr: DMRetriever is introduced, the first series of dense retrieval models (33M to 7.6B) tailored for disaster management, and achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all six search intents at every model scale.

2510.15681.tldr: ProofBridge is presented, a unified framework for automatically translating entire NL theorems and proofs into Lean 4, with a joint embedding model that aligns NL and FL (NL-FL) theorem+proof pairs in a shared semantic space, enabling cross-modal retrieval of semantically relevant FL examples to guide translation.

2510.17933.tldr: The results show that operating in a physically interpretable parameter space enables accurate and interpretable changepoint detection in nonlinear dynamical systems.

2511.04723.tldr: A novel framework that integrates Temporal Convolutional Networks for localized temporal feature extraction with a modified Temporal Fusion Transformer enhanced by Bi-LSTM encoder–decoders that advances the effectiveness of industrial prognostic systems and highlights the potential of advanced time-series transformers for RUL prediction.

2511.05852.tldr: This study systematically quantify edit decay after fine-tuning, investigating how fine-tuning affects knowledge editing, and establishes empirical baselines and actionable strategies for integrating knowledge editing with fine-tuning.

2511.06449.tldr: FLEX delivers substantial improvements on mathematical reasoning, chemical retrosynthesis, and protein fitness prediction and identifies a clear scaling law of experiential growth and the phenomenon of experience inheritance across agents, marking a step toward scalable and inheritable continuous agent evolution.

2511.08595.tldr: Semantic Similarity-Based Dynamic Pruning (SSDP), a lightweight method that is the first framework to integrate online semantic merging into parallelized tree search, enabling the clustering and pruning of redundant steps in real time, is introduced.

2511.09173.tldr: Data Fusion-Enhanced Decision Transformer is proposed, a compact pipeline that restores stitchability and improves return and stability over strong offline RL and sequence-model baselines across gravity, kinematic, and morphology shifts on D4RL-style control tasks, and further corroborate these gains with token-stitching and sequence-semantics stability analyses.

2511.18274.tldr: This is the first prospective evaluation of clinician-directed intervention software generation with an LLM in health care, demonstrating feasibility and motivating larger trials in real patient populations.

2511.20639.tldr: The theoretical analyses establishing that LatentMAS attains higher expressiveness and lossless information preservation with substantially lower complexity than vanilla text-based MAS and empirical evaluations show that LatentMAS consistently outperforms strong single-model and text-based MAS baselines.

2511.20993.tldr: This work proposes Subgoal Graph-Augmented Actor-Critic-Refiner (SGA-ACR), a framework that integrates an environment-specific subgoal graph and structured entity knowledge with a multi-LLM planning pipeline that explicitly separates generation, critique, and refinement to produce executable and verifiable subgoals.

2511.21931.tldr: This work quantifies how strongly each feature separates the two outcome groups in a binary classification task, moving beyond traditional descriptive statistics to estimate each feature's effect on the outcome.

2511.22153.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid ensemble that is explicitly designed to cope with changing generator distributions and frames this approach in terms of variance reduction and risk under mixtures of generators, and shows that the simplex constraint provides a simple way to trade off the strengths and weaknesses of each branch.

2512.00418.tldr: This manuscript introduces Significant Other Artificial Intelligence (SO-AI) as a new domain of relational AI, which reframes AI-human relationships as long-term, identity-bearing partnerships and provides a foundational blueprint for investigating whether AI can responsibly augment the relational stability many individuals lack today.

2512.01222.tldr: It is shown that logit lens can effectively translate encoded reasoning, with accuracy peaking in intermediate-to-late layers, and a fully unsupervised decoding pipeline is developed that combines logit lens with automated paraphrasing, achieving substantial accuracy in reconstructing complete reasoning transcripts from internal model representations.

2512.02195.tldr: The experiments presented by this paper demonstrate that functional and content categories can be acquired and represented by the daughter agent based on training and test data containing different amounts of exemplars generated by the adult agent.

2512.03042.tldr: PPTPilot is proposed, a structure-aware slide-editing agent that plans semantic edit sequences, routes between high-level programmatic tools and deterministic XML operations for precise control, and verifies outputs through an iterative plan-edit-check loop against task-specific constraints.

2512.04333.tldr: The results suggest that RGE-GCN shows promise as a generalizable approach for RNA-seq based early cancer detection and biomarker discovery (https://rce-gcn.streamlit.app/ ).

2512.04416.tldr: This work proposes DataGovAgent, a framework utilizing a Planner-Executor-Evaluator architecture that integrates constraint-based planning, retrieval-augmented generation, and sandboxed feedback-driven debugging that significantly boosts the Average Task Score on complex tasks and reduces debugging iterations.

2512.05117.tldr: It is shown that deep neural networks trained across diverse tasks exhibit remarkably similar low-dimensional parametric subspaces, which have significant implications for model reusability, multi-task learning, model merging, and the development of training and inference-efficient algorithms.

2512.05969.tldr: A robust experimental paradigm centered on the "Task Pair" design is established and a code framework is built that supports this paradigm and allows for easy scaling - users can add models and tasks efficiently.

2512.05971.tldr: A hybrid framework with a dominance-based multiobjective evolutionary algorithm (MOEA) that enables simultaneous optimization of feature selection and classification performance by exploring Pareto-optimal solutions in a single run is proposed.

2512.05979.tldr: A universal directed-tree process-graph representation that unifies unstructured text, molecular structures, and numeric measurements into a single machine-readable format is introduced and a multi-modal graph neural network with property-conditioned attention mechanism is developed.

2512.05982.tldr: FlockVote is introduced, a novel framework that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) to build a "computational laboratory" of LLM agents for political simulation, allowing researchers to probe agent-level rationale and analyze the stability and sensitivity of LLM-driven social simulations.

2512.05987.tldr: Results show that the method maintains model training performance while achieving significant dataset compression, outperforming traditional quantization and dataset pruning baselines under the same compression ratios.

2512.05988.tldr: VG3T, a novel multi-view feed-forward network that predicts a 3D semantic occupancy via a 3D Gaussian representation, overcomes the fragmentation and inconsistency inherent in view-by-view processing, offering a unified paradigm to represent both geometry and semantics.

2512.05993.tldr: This work establishes that domain-specialized foundation models trained on brain tissue can better capture neuropathology-specific features than models trained on general surgical pathology datasets, setting a precedent for domain-specific model development in specialized areas of digital pathology.

2512.05994.tldr: This work introduces KidSpeak, a multi-task speech-enhanced Foundation Model capable of both generative and discriminative tasks specifically tailored to children's speech patterns, and proposes the Flexible and Automatic Speech Aligner (FASA), the first comprehensive solution designed for speech and language therapy in children.

2512.05998.tldr: The key finding is not that fictional money makes models smarter; accuracy gains were modest and did not reach statistical significance in this pilot; this suggests that simple financial framing may help transform LLMs into risk-aware forecasters, making their internal beliefs visible and usable.

2512.06002.tldr: A new, lightweight, probabilistic planning algorithm, Plan-Orchestrated Tree Assembly for Lookahead (POrTAL), that combines the strengths of two baseline planning algorithms, FF-Replan and POMCP, which demonstrates that POrTAL is an anytime algorithm that generally outperforms these baselines in terms of the final executed plan length given bounded computation time.

2512.06006.tldr: This work introduces a systematic evaluation framework for agentic code optimization and uses it to study three production-level biomedical imaging pipelines, demonstrating that a simple agent framework consistently generates adaptation code that outperforms human-expert solutions.

2512.06018.tldr: Analysis of students' interaction logs reveals inquiry patterns that may indicate clinical reasoning development in GenAI-assisted contexts, providing methodological insights for health professions education assessment and informing adaptive GenAI system design that supports diverse learning pathways.

2512.06020.tldr: This work proposes a multimodal framework that leverages multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to extract rich user representations and inject them into diffusion-based image generation, highlighting the effectiveness of representation extraction and alignment for personalized generation.

2512.06040.tldr: This work presents a framework coupling physics-guided deepfake detection with uncertainty-aware in edge learning, addressing the complete threat model for networked voice authentication.

2512.06042.tldr: Auto-SPT is designed to produce Semantic Preserving Transformations (SPTs) that alter a program's syntactic structure while preserving its functionality and is instantiated on top of Large Language Models (LLMs).

2512.06046.tldr: This work presents AI4UI, a framework of autonomous front-end development agents purpose-built to meet the rigorous requirements of enterprise-grade application delivery, which emerged as one of the leaders demonstrating strong competitive standing among leading solutions.

2512.06048.tldr: Practical guidance derived from real-world deployments are presented, best practices for leveraging retrieval- and model-level adaptation are proposed, and open research directions for making GenAI more robust, precise, and auditable in cyber defense are highlighted.

2512.06060.tldr: A framework that integrates reinforcement learning with autonomous agents to enable continuous improvement in the automated process of software test cases authoring from business requirement documents within Quality Engineering (QE) workflows and establishes a continuous knowledge refinement loop driven by QE expertise.

2512.06062.tldr: The results highlight an under-explored attack surface in synthetic data generation pipelines and call for stronger privacy guarantees that account for distributional neighborhood inference rather than sample-level memorization alone, underscoring its role in privacy-preserving data publishing.

2512.06065.tldr: EgoEdit, an instruction-following egocentric video editor that supports real-time streaming inference on a single GPU, and EgoEditBench, an evaluation suite targeting instruction faithfulness, hand and interaction preservation, and temporal stability under egomotion are introduced.

2512.06097.tldr: Improvements demonstrate that preference-based alignment offers a scalable and transparent pathway toward developing trustworthy, empathetic, and clinically informed AI assistants for caregiver and healthcare communication.

2512.06102.tldr: A simulator underpinned by a principled probabilistic fire spread model based on cellular automata and implemented in JAX, which achieves 6-35x speedup over existing software and enables gradient-based optimization of simulator parameters.

2512.06105.tldr: A Cross-modal Explainable Framework for Melanoma (CEFM) is presented that leverages contrastive learning as the core mechanism for achieving interpretability, and maps clinical criteria for melanoma diagnosis into the Vision Transformer embedding space using dual projection heads, thereby aligning clinical semantics with visual features.

2512.06106.tldr: Claude 4 outperformed ChatGPT 3.5, Llama 4, and Qwen 3 in enhancing psychological, affective, and FSC outcomes, and interaction quality metrics, particularly persuasiveness, realism, and user engagement, emerged as robust predictors of psychological and affective outcomes.

2512.06123.tldr: This paper proposes HiCert, a novel masking-based certified detection technique that is the first work capable of providing such a comprehensive patch robustness certification for certified detection, and is shown to have a new state-of-the-art performance.

2512.06134.tldr: The Neural Koopman Machine is presented, a new machine learning architecture inspired by dynamical systems and attention mechanisms, designed to forecast multiple cognitive scores simultaneously using multimodal genetic, neuroimaging, proteomic, and demographic data.

2512.06154.tldr: This work introduces a new tool from information theory called Partial Information Decomposition (PID) that goes beyond classical information-theoretic measures and proposes a new multi-level optimization framework called Redundancy-guided Invariant Graph learning (RIG) that maximizes redundant information while isolating spurious and causal subgraphs, enabling OOD generalization under diverse distribution shifts.

2512.06161.tldr: A transparent and interpretable ML approach that leverages BioBERT, a state-of-the-art language model, to analyze unstructured clinical text is introduced that paves the way for more trustworthy, generalizable, and clinically actionable AI tools in neurodevelopmental diagnostics.

2512.06172.tldr: This work proposes DEFEND, which includes a poisoned model detection strategy that leverages neuron-wise magnitude analysis for attack goal identification and Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM)-based clustering and can thwart TLFAs and outperform seven baseline countermeasures, with at least 15.78% improvement.

2512.06196.tldr: This work introduces ARCANE, a framework that frames alignment as a multi-agent collaboration problem that dynamically represents stakeholder preferences as natural-language rubrics: weighted sets of verifiable criteria that can be generated on-the-fly from task context.

2512.06204.tldr: A model-agnostic metric that treats first-order sensitivities of multiple vector outputs across a temporal window to the input sequence as a temporal influence profile and summarizes it by the magnitude-weighted average lag, which offers a practical per-sequence readout of memory dependence for comparing agents and environments and for selecting the shortest sufficient context.

2512.06240.tldr: An AI-driven KYC application that integrates graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG Graph) with generative models to enhance efficiency, transparency, and decision support in KYC processes related to money-laundering detection is proposed.

2512.06244.tldr: A new class of methods with auto-exploration, or methods that automatically explore both state and action spaces in a parameter-free way, i.e., without a priori knowledge of problem-dependent parameters is introduced.

2512.06256.tldr: This work reports what happens when two large language models respond to each other for many turns without any outside input in a multi-agent setup, and describes this behavior as a form of convergence.

2512.06259.tldr: GAMENet, an end-to-end multimodal deep learning architecture for music popularity prediction that integrates modality-specific experts for audio, lyrics, and social metadata through an adaptive gating mechanism, is introduced.

2512.06274.tldr: Networked RMAB is introduced, a novel framework that integrates the RMAB model with the independent cascade model to capture interactions between arms in networked environments and proves that the approximate Bellman updates are guaranteed to converge by a modified contraction analysis.

2512.06281.tldr: This work proposes Latent Visual Reconstruction (LaVer), a novel training framework that facilitates MLLMs in learning more discriminative visual representations via masked image modeling in the joint latent semantic space of LLM.

2512.06296.tldr: A novel evaluation framework (PROBE) is proposed, which consists of a rank transformer estimating the score of each prediction based on a required level of predictive sharpness and a rank aggregator aggregating all the scores in a popularity-aware manner.

2512.06297.tldr: The role of curvature-induced entropic forces in governing both connectivity and confinement in deep learning landscapes is highlighted, with empirical finds that curvature systematically rises away from minima, producing effective forces that bias noisy dynamics back toward the endpoints.

2512.06301.tldr: CI-LLM (Chemically Informed Language Model), a framework combining HAPPY (Hierarchically Abstracted rePeat unit of PolYmer), which encodes chemical substructures as tokens, with numerical descriptors within transformer architectures, is introduced.

2512.06304.tldr: Existing attack and defense methods are classified from the perspective of input manipulation and the impact of degraded input speech across four dimensions is evaluated, including intelligibility, naturalness, timbre similarity, and subjective perception.

2512.06306.tldr: This work designs Event Temporal Slicing Convolution module to capture short-term dependencies across event slices, and combines it with Event Slice Sequencing module for structured temporal modeling, and proposes an edge-enhanced point cloud-based event representation to enhance spatial edge information under sparse event conditions.

2512.06350.tldr: It is found that differences in perspectives about existential risk arise fundamentally from differences in causal premises about design vs. emergence in complex systems, while differences in perspectives about employment risks pertain to different causal premises about the applicability of past theories vs their inapplicability.

2512.06390.tldr: This survey synthesizes the landscape of AI-enhanced defenses deployed at the edge and indicates that edge-centric AI measurably improves time-to-detect and time-to-mitigate while reducing data movement and enhancing compliance, yet introduces new risks around model abuse, poisoning, and governance.

2512.06396.tldr: AgenticCyber is introduced, a generative AI powered multi-agent system that orchestrates specialized agents to monitor cloud logs, surveillance videos, and environmental audio concurrently and enables adaptive security posture management using multimodal language models like Google's Gemini coupled with LangChain for agent orchestration.

2512.06404.tldr: GENIUS, an AI-agentic workflow that fuses a smart Quantum ESPRESSO knowledge graph with a tiered hierarchy of large language models supervised by a finite-state error-recovery machine, democratizes electronic-structure DFT simulations by intelligently automating protocol generation, validation, and repair, opening large-scale screening and accelerating ICME design loops across academia and industry worldwide.

2512.06406.tldr: UncertaintyZoo is introduced, a unified toolkit that integrates 29 uncertainty quantification methods, covering five major categories under a standardized interface, and demonstrates that UncertaintyZoo effectively reveals prediction uncertainty under the code vulnerability detection task on CodeBERT and ChatGLM3 models.

2512.06421.tldr: Self-Autoregressive Refinement (SAR) is proposed, which introduces a Stagger-Scale Rollout mechanism that performs lightweight autoregressive rollouts to expose the model to its own intermediate predictions, thereby aligning train-test patterns, and a complementary Contrastive Student-Forcing Loss (CSFL) that provides adequate supervision for self-generated contexts to ensure stable training.

2512.06426.tldr: A dual-path transformer framework that leverages CLIP to jointly model visual and attribute-driven cues for gender recognition at a distance and shows that language-guided dual-path learning offers a principled, extensible foundation for responsible gender recognition in unconstrained long-range scenarios.

2512.06431.tldr: This model offers a replicable framework for data-driven urban planning in Egyptian cities and creates city-specific planning criteria and evaluates the current coverage of public facilities.

2512.06458.tldr: This work designs the first tester of samplers with instance-dependent efficiency, allowing us to test samplers over natural numbers, and develops a novel distance estimation algorithm between an unknown and a known probability distribution using an interval conditioning framework.

2512.06471.tldr: An optimality gap is derived between more classical, often quadratic, objectives and the goal-conditioned reward, elucidating the success of goal-conditioned RL and why classical ``dense''rewards can falter.

2512.06483.tldr: This paper investigates the use of Large Language Models for automatically classifying German texts according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) into different proficiency levels, and constructs a diverse dataset by combining multiple existing CEFR-annotated corpora with synthetic data.

2512.06496.tldr: PRIMRose, a novel approach that predicts energy values for each residue given a mutated protein sequence, analyzes the localized energetic impact of double amino acid insertions or deletions at the individual residue level, enabling residue-specific insights into structural and functional disruption.

2512.06506.tldr: It is found that grids with stronger AI-specific human capital experienced a sharp surge in new firm formation, driven entirely by small firms, contributing to 6.0% of overall national firm entry, consistent with a shift toward leaner ventures.

2512.06521.tldr: A unified framework is proposed, called ShadowWolf, designed to address challenges to model robustness and adaptability in real-world scenarios by integrating and optimizing the stages of AI model training and evaluation and enhances the accuracy and efficiency of wildlife monitoring systems.

2512.06531.tldr: Two novel Deep Learning Architectures are proposed - SAETCN (Self-Attention Enhancement Tumor Classification Network) for the classification of different kinds of brain tumors and SAS-Net (Self-Attentive Segmentation Network) for the accurate segmentation of brain tumors.

2512.06533.tldr: This paper forms the generation process as a Markov Decision Process, utilizing sequence-level rewards to enforce global numerical coherence, and reveals that RL significantly enhances sampling efficiency and predictive precision, establishing decoding-based regression as a robust and accurate paradigm for general-purpose numerical prediction.

2512.06555.tldr: BEACON is proposed, a unified dual-dimension framework that integrates behavioral psychology with the tactical lifecycle of cybercrime to enable structured, interpretable, and scalable analysis of cybercrime.

2512.06556.tldr: This work analyzes three classes of semantic attacks on MCP-integrated systems and introduces a layered security framework with three components: RSA-based manifest signing to enforce descriptor integrity, LLM-on-LLM semantic vetting to detect suspicious tool definitions, and lightweight heuristic guardrails that block anomalous tool behavior at runtime.

2512.06573.tldr: It is shown that incorporating belief statements and their strengths influences an agent's resistance to (and persuasiveness against) opposing viewpoints, and the likelihood of belief change, particularly when the agent is outnumbered in a debate by opposing viewpoints, i.e., peer pressure scenarios.

2512.06582.tldr: The Quantum-Leap LSTM (QL-LSTM), a recurrent architecture designed to address both challenges of redundant gate-specific parameters and reduced ability to retain information across long temporal distances, is introduced.

2512.06590.tldr: HGLMRec is introduced, a novel Multi-LLM agent-based RS that incorporates a hypergraph encoder designed to capture complex, multi-behaviour relationships between users and items that reduces computational overhead while enriching the retrieval context.

2512.06591.tldr: It is proposed that future evaluations of agent explanation capabilities should integrate objective task performance metrics alongside subjective assessments to more accurately measure explanation quality.

2512.06595.tldr: This analysis highlights ChargingBoul's effectiveness across diverse opponent strategies and its contributions to advancing automated negotiation techniques and discusses potential enhancements, including more sophisticated opponent modeling and adaptive bidding heuristics, to improve its performance further.

2512.06629.tldr: FlatFormer, a streamlined architecture based on the novel design paradigm ofInformation Injection over Structural Stacking, achieves state-of-the-art performance and validates that high cognitive fidelity does not necessitate architectural complexity.

2512.06642.tldr: The results show that MAE pretraining, when combined with appropriate mask ratio tuning, yields a shared encoder that matches or exceeds a ViT trained from scratch, and ablate the MAE mask ratio, revealing a consistent trade-off: higher mask ratios improve classification but slightly degrade reconstruction fidelity.

2512.06657.tldr: This work proposes a novel scene text detector based on Mamba that integrates the selection mechanism with attention layers, enhancing the encoder’s ability to extract relevant information from long sequences, and adopts the Top_k algorithm to explicitly select key information and reduce the interference of irrelevant information in Mamba modeling.

2512.06665.tldr: The findings highlight the need for a more objective metric that reveals the weaknesses of an attribution method rather than that of the neural network, thus providing a more accurate evaluation of the robustness of attribution methods.

2512.06678.tldr: GradientSpace is proposed, a framework that clusters samples directly in full-dimensional gradient space and leads to coherent expert specialization and consistent accuracy gains over state-of-the-art clustering methods and finetuning techniques.

2512.06681.tldr: Experimental findings provide causal evidence that GPT-2's sentiment computation differs from the predicted hierarchical pattern, highlighting the need for further empirical characterization of contextual integration in large language models.

2512.06710.tldr: This work proposes adopting Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC), a metric from measurement science, to characterize variance in agentic benchmarking, and recommends reporting accuracy alongside ICC and within-query variance as standard practice, and proposes updated Evaluation Cards capturing these metrics.

2512.06714.tldr: The method proposed reduces the complexity of the model six times of what achieved in the literature while conserving the same accuracy, and it is found that extending the data set significantly reduces the error by about 30%.

2512.06721.tldr: ProAgent is proposed, the first end-to-end proactive agent system that harnesses massive sensory contexts and LLM reasoning to deliver proactive assistance.

2512.06726.tldr: This work focuses on the visual grounding task and analyzes the role and characteristics of entropy in comparison to reasoning tasks, and introduces ECVGPO (Entropy Control Visual Grounding Policy Optimization), an interpretable algorithm designed for effective entropy regulation.

2512.06732.tldr: This work introduces ImplicitBBQ, a benchmark extending the Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ) with implicitly cued protected attributes across 6 categories with troubling performance disparity from explicit BBQ prompts, indicating that current LLMs contain implicit biases undetected by explicit benchmarks.

2512.06734.tldr: This study proposes PDFTEMRA (Performant Distilled Frequency Transformer Ensemble Model with Random Activations), a compact transformer-based architecture that integrates model distillation, frequency-domain modulation, ensemble learning, and randomized activation patterns to reduce computational cost while preserving language understanding performance.

2512.06747.tldr: PrivLLMSwarm establishes a practical foundation for secure, LLM-enabled UAV swarms in privacy-sensitive IoT applications including smart-city monitoring and emergency response and achieves high semantic accuracy, low encrypted inference latency, and robust formation control under privacy constraints.

2512.06751.tldr: This work introduces Learning While Evaluating (LWE), a framework that allows evaluators to improve sequentially at inference time without requiring training or validation sets, and proposes Selective LWE, which updates the meta-prompt only on self-inconsistent cases, focusing computation where it matters most.

2512.06759.tldr: This work presents VisChainBench, a large-scale benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate LVLMs'ability to perform multi-step visual reasoning across sequential, interdependent tasks with minimal language guidance, constructed using a multi-agent generation pipeline, ensuring high visual diversity and controlled language bias.

2512.06811.tldr: This work introduces a novel Reconstruction-based Multimodal Adapter (RMAdapter), which leverages a dual-branch architecture and facilitates a dynamic balance between general and task-specific knowledge.

2512.06814.tldr: This paper proposes CAuSE (Causal Abstraction under Simulated Explanations), a novel framework to generate faithful NLEs for any pretrained multimodal classifier, and demonstrates that CAuSE generalizes across datasets and models through extensive empirical evaluations.

2512.06835.tldr: DoGe (Decouple to Generalize), a dual-decoupling framework that guides models to first learn from context rather than problem solving by refocusing on the problem context scenarios overlooked by synthetic data methods, is proposed.

2512.06836.tldr: This study explores the potential of Large Language Model (LLM)-based solutions in achieving grammar and instance co-evolution, with attention to their ability to preserve auxiliary information when directly processing textual instances.

2512.06850.tldr: Results show that direct RTL-to-RTL model checking achieves higher coverage efficiency and requires fewer assertions than standalone verification, especially when combined with AI-generated properties refined through HITL guidance.

2512.06854.tldr: This work proposes ArchPower, the first open-source dataset for architecture-level processor power modeling, and goes through complex and realistic design flows to collect the CPU architectural information as features and the ground-truth simulated power as labels.

2512.06859.tldr: Experimental results show that JT-DA-8B achieves strong performance in various table reasoning tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of data-centric generation and workflow-driven optimization.

2512.06866.tldr: This work proposes DyToK, a training-free paradigm that enables dynamic token compression by harnessing VLLM'inherent attention mechanisms, and shows plug-and-play compatibility with existing compression methods, such as VisionZip and FastV.

2512.06867.tldr: This work introduces a mediator as a structured translation process, inspired by exploratory factor analysis, that maps LLM-generated inventory responses into heuristics that enhances heuristic reliability and face validity compared to directly inferred heuristics, allowing to better study the effect of persona types on decision making.

2512.06879.tldr: An end-to-end agent system that transforms how researchers discover, organize, and track academic literature through three integrated modules that addresses two fundamental challenges.

2512.06885.tldr: To transfer the rich generative capabilities of existing DiT backbones learned from natural images to the panorama domain, a Joint-Face Adapter built on the cubemap representation of panoramas is proposed, which enables a pretrained DiT to jointly model and generate different views of a panorama.

2512.06902.tldr: This work introduces BabelCoder, an agentic framework that performs code translation by decomposing the task into specialized agents for translation, testing, and refinement, each responsible for a specific aspect such as generating code, validating correctness, or repairing errors.

2512.06921.tldr: The Neurosurgical Anatomy Benchmark (Neu-roABench) is introduced, the first multimodal benchmark explicitly created to evaluate anatomical understanding in the neurosurgical domain and is developed using a novel multimodal annotation pipeline with multiple review cycles.

2512.06925.tldr: The proposed hybrid QR-DQN with lexical and semantic features effectively identifies phishing threats, adapts to evolving attack strategies, and generalizes well to unseen data is suggested.

2512.06926.tldr: This study presents a systematic empirical analysis of two key data-centric factors: input sequence length and additive noise, which highlight important limitations in current DL-based forecasting pipelines and underscore the need for data-aware design strategies.

2512.06929.tldr: Experimental evaluations demonstrate that AdaMamba's combination of adaptive normalization and expert augmented contextual modeling yields consistent improvements in stability and accuracy over conventional Transformer based baselines.

2512.06932.tldr: These findings underscore the need for configuration-aware, leakage-resistant evaluation pipelines to ensure reliable performance estimation, and underscore the need for configuration-aware, leakage-resistant evaluation pipelines to ensure reliable performance estimation.

2512.06944.tldr: A unifying human-centered fairness framework is introduced that systematically covers eight distinct fairness metrics, formed by combining individual and group fairness, infra-marginal and intersectional assumptions, and outcome-based and equality-of-opportunity perspectives, to allow stakeholders to align fairness interventions with their values and contextual considerations.

2512.06963.tldr: VideoVLA explores a paradigm shift in robot learning and unlocks generalization capabilities in manipulation systems, using pre-trained video generative models for joint visual and action forecasting.

2512.06969.tldr: This work compares the classical Sherman-Morrison update used in the popular BFGS method with a novel approach called Online Gradient Regression (OGR), which performs regression of gradients against positions using an exponential moving average to estimate second derivatives online, without requiring Hessian inversion.

2512.06983.tldr: This work introduces a taxonomy that distinguishes between memory encoding and memory injection mechanisms, motivating their roles in extending the world model's memory through the lens of residual stream dynamics.

2512.06989.tldr: This work establishes the multi-head design as a superior architectural principle for FFNs, presenting FlashMHF as a powerful, efficient, and scalable alternative to FFNs in Transformers.

2512.06990.tldr: This project develops an AI system offering the only end-to-end solution by aiding doctors with both diagnosis and treatment planning, potentially saving approximately 2,250 lives.

2512.06991.tldr: This research introduces a novel “Prompting-in-a-Series” algorithm, termed psychology-informed content embeddings for personality recognition (PICEPR), featuring two pipelines: 1) contents; and 2) embeddings.

2512.06999.tldr: This paper aims to build a complete ecosystem for reference-free, multi-dimensional, and descriptive singing assessment, and establishes a new evaluation benchmark-H-TPR (Human-in-the-loop Tiered Perceptual Ranking)-which evaluates a model's ability to generate perceptually valid performance rankings, rather than predicting a noisy ''ground-truth'' score.

2512.07005.tldr: The Multi-Accent Mandarin Dry-Vocal Singing Dataset (MADVSD) was validated through benchmark experiments in singing accent recognition, demonstrating its utility for evaluating state-of-the-art speech models in singing contexts.

2512.07009.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive case study on optimizing a poultry welfare monitoring system through system-level improvements across detection, tracking, clustering, and behavioral analysis modules, and introduces a set of optimizations, including multi-level parallelization, and substituting CPU code with GPU-accelerated code, vectorized clustering, and memory-efficient post-processing.

2512.07021.tldr: This work proposes a novel three-stage training paradigm that transfers knowledge from multimodal clinical data into a powerful, yet unimodal, ECG encoder, and successfully bridges a substantial portion of the performance gap to a fully multimodal model that requires all data at inference.

2512.07022.tldr: This study investigates how an LLM-powered agent can improve file-level bug localization via lightweight query reformulation and summarization, and achieves 35% better ranking in first-file retrieval than the authors' BM25 baseline and up to +22% file retrieval performance over SWE-agent.

2512.07030.tldr: XG Boost (XGB) is selected as the top model due to its fast and highly accurate performance in detecting zero-day attacks and Random Forest (RF) performs best under both oversampling and non-oversampling conditions.

2512.07034.tldr: The proposed framework, TransCues, is a pyramidal transformer encoder-decoder architecture to segment transparent objects, and empirically shows that these two modules can be used together effectively, improving overall performance across various benchmark datasets, including glass object semantic segmentation, mirror object semantic segmentation, and generic segmentation datasets.

2512.07064.tldr: This work cast the entire pretrain-finetune workflow into a unified probabilistic framework, enabling a transparent comparison and deeper understanding of masking strategies, and reveals a surprising insight: sophisticated masking distributions offer no consistent benefit over uniform sampling for common node-level prediction tasks.

2512.07081.tldr: ClinNoteAgents is presented, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that transforms free-text clinical notes into structured representations of clinical and social risk factors for association analysis and clinician-style abstractions for HF 30-day readmission prediction.

2512.07086.tldr: ThinkTrap is proposed, a novel input-space optimization framework for DoS attacks against LLM services even in black-box environments, to identify adversarial prompts that induce extended or non-terminating generation across several state-of-the-art LLMs, achieving DoS with minimal token overhead.

2512.07090.tldr: Token Filtering is introduced, a lightweight online structured pruning technique that makes pruning decisions directly during inference without any calibration data, thereby reducing inference cost while preserving critical information.

2512.07092.tldr: The Soul Engine is proposed, a framework based on the Linear Representation Hypothesis, which posits that personality traits exist as orthogonal linear subspaces and achieves robust control over behavior via vector arithmetic, validated through extensive ablation studies.

2512.07109.tldr: The first 9-category taxonomy of all 400 tasks, validated at 97.5% accuracy via rule-based code analysis, indicates that progress requires hybrid architectures with affinity-aligned modules.

2512.07112.tldr: This paper proposes Folded Optimizer with Approximate Moment (FOAM), a method that compresses optimizer states by computing block-wise gradient means and incorporates a residual correction to recover lost information that achieves convergence rates equivalent to vanilla Adam under standard non-convex optimization settings.

2512.07122.tldr: A Large Language Model (LLM) based approach for real-time repair of risk-prone configurations (named RisConFix) that degrade drone robustness and demonstrates its capability to effectively and efficiently repair risk-prone configurations in real time.

2512.07132.tldr: This work introduces DART, a multi-agent framework that uses disagreements between multiple debating visual agents to identify useful visual tools that can resolve inter-agent disagreement and studies the tool call distribution, finding that diverse tools are reliably used to help resolve disagreement.

2512.07136.tldr: This work introduces CUHK-X, a large-scale multimodal dataset and benchmark suite for HAR, HAU, and HARn and proposes a prompt-based scene creation method that leverages LLMs to generate logically connected activity sequences, followed by human validation.

2512.07142.tldr: Concrete Ticket Search (CTS), an algorithm that frames subnetwork discovery as a holistic combinatorial optimization problem, is introduced, finding that minimizing the reverse Kullback-Leibler divergence between sparse and dense network outputs (CTS-KL) is particularly effective.

2512.07150.tldr: A novel training-free framework, FlowLPS, that solves inverse problems with pretrained flow models via a Langevin Proximal Sampling (LPS) strategy, achieving a superior balance between reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality across multiple inverse tasks on FFHQ and DIV2K, outperforming state of the art inverse solvers.

2312.13976.tldr: It was found that female hearts were positioned more posteriorly and superiorly than male, and in MI hearts were oriented more horizontally, especially for women, and post-MI women exhibited less QRS prolongation, requiring 27% more prolongation than men to exceed 120ms.

2407.11877.tldr: Using WFOMC, the Weak Connectedness Polynomial and Strong Connectedness Polynomials are defined and it turns out that these polynomials have the following interesting properties: they can be computed in polynomial time in the domain size for sentences from the two-variable fragment with counting quantifiers.

2409.14985.tldr: This work proposes Image-Guided Semantic Pseudo-LiDAR Point Generation model, a novel framework that leverages rich RGB image features to generate dense and semantically meaningful 3D points and is the first method to directly leverage image features for point generation.

2410.07618.tldr: A new Chinese calligraphy generation model ''Moyun'' is proposed, which replaces the UNet in the Diffusion model with Vision Mamba and introduces the TripleLabel control mechanism to achieve controllable calligraphy generation.

2502.03930.tldr: This work proposes Diffusion Transformer Autoregressive Modeling (DiTAR), a patch-based autoregressive framework combining a language model with a diffusion transformer that significantly enhances the efficacy of autoregressive models for continuous tokens and reduces computational demands.

2502.08943.tldr: A hierarchical statistical model is proposed that provides a more comprehensive representation of the benchmarking process by incorporating both benchmark characteristics and LLM randomness, and it is shown that leveraging multiple generations improves the accuracy of estimating the benchmark score and reduces variance.

2502.09620.tldr: The first Encoder-free 3D LMM, ENEL is presented, which rivals the state-of-the-art model, PointLLM-PiSA-13B, and shows that the encoder-free architecture is highly promising for replacing encoder-based architectures in the field of 3D understanding.

2503.04598.tldr: Extensive experiments on large-scale transformer models, including both dense and sparse variants, show that HybridNorm consistently outperforms both Pre-Norm and Post-Norm approaches across multiple benchmarks, highlighting the potential of HybridNorm as a more stable and effective technique for improving the training and performance of deep transformer models.

2504.00438.tldr: Suite-IN++, a deep learning framework for flexiwear bodynet-based pedestrian localization that fuses global features based on the data reliability of each device to capture overall motion trends and employs an attention mechanism to uncover cross-device correlations in local features, extracting motion details helpful for accurate localization.

2504.16828.tldr: This work proposes ThinkPRM, a long CoT verifier fine-tuned on orders of magnitude fewer process labels than those required by discriminative PRMs, and outperforms LLM-as-a-Judge and discriminative verifiers -- using only 1% of the process labels in PRM800K -- across several challenging benchmarks.

2505.09342.tldr: The sigma-binary attack is introduced, a novel adversarial method for binary domains, designed to achieve attack goals with minimal feature changes, and shows that sigma-binary outperforms existing attacks and exposes key vulnerabilities in state-of-the-art defenses.

2506.14683.tldr: The goal is to build a unified agent which can orchestrate and handle multiple capabilities in software development and envision USEagent as the first draft of a future AI Software Engineer which can be a team member in future software development teams involving both AI and humans.

2506.16553.tldr: This work shows that conformal prediction attains some robustness even with a single forward pass on a randomly perturbed input, and proposes a single sample robust CP (RCP1), which returns robust sets with smaller average set size compared to SOTA methods which use many passes per input.

2506.18240.tldr: This work introduces a novel Quadratic Binary Optimization (QBO) framework for training a quantized neural network and establishes the convergence of QCGD under a quantum oracle subject to randomness, bounded variance, and limited coefficient precision, and provides an upper bound on the Time-To-Solution.

2507.11331.tldr: FSA, an enhanced systolic array architecture that runs the entire FlashAttention on the array without external vector units, maximizes array utilization while preserving the original floating-point operation order of FlashAttention is proposed.

2507.20109.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Preference Optimization (APO), a dynamic integration approach that adaptively amplifies preferred responses, suppresses dispreferred ones, and encourages exploration of potentially superior solutions during training.

2507.23334.tldr: MusT-RAG, a comprehensive framework based on Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to adapt general-purpose LLMs for text-only music question answering (MQA) tasks, and MusWikiDB, a music-specialized vector database for the retrieval stage, proves substantially more effective than general Wikipedia corpora.

2508.02292.tldr: FinWorld is presented, an all-in-one open-source platform that provides end-to-end support for the entire financial AI workflow, from data acquisition to experimentation and deployment, thereby providing a strong foundation for future research and real-world applications.
