2508.03209.tldr: This work is the first to explore adversarial perturbations for defending against geolocation inference by advanced VLMs, providing a practical and effective solution to escalating privacy concerns.

2508.03929.tldr: A novel framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search that facilitates turn-based optimization between two LLM agents, and shows that MOTIF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, highlighting the promise of turn-based, multi-agent prompting for fully automated solver design.

2508.05731.tldr: Two AEPO-trained models, InfiGUI-G1-3B and InfiGUI-G1-7B, establish new state-of-the-art results across multiple challenging GUI grounding benchmarks, achieving significant relative improvements against the naive RLVR baseline on benchmarks designed to test generalization and semantic understanding.

2508.07334.tldr: This article formalizes the large language model as a probabilistic Turing machine by constructing a "computational necessity hierarchy", and for the first time proves the illusions are inevitable on diagonalization, incomputability, and information theory boundaries supported by the newlearner pump lemma.

2508.07631.tldr: Under minimal assumptions, it is shown that one can tractably sample from a distribution that is simultaneously close to the posterior of a noised prior in KL divergence and the true posterior in Fisher divergence.

2508.13157.tldr: A new dataset with rich styles of circuit diagrams as well as balanced distribution of simple and complex analog ICs is constructs and opensources and a hybrid framework, named Image2Net, is proposed for practical conversion from circuit diagrams to netlists.

2508.20549.tldr: Generative Reward Learning for Medical Reasoning (MedGR) co-develops a data generator and a reward model, enabling the automated, continuous creation of high-quality, multi-modal medical data that serves as both a superior training source for SFT and RL.

2509.21933.tldr: This work uncovers systematic patterns in when and why CoT fails in clinical contexts, which highlight a critical paradox: CoT enhances interpretability but may undermine reliability in clinical text tasks.

2509.23045.tldr: The results show that structured skill priors from Agentless training can bridge workflow and agentic frameworks for transferable coding agents, and Kimi-Dev, an open-source SWE LLM achieving 60.4\% on SWE-bench Verified, the best among workflow approaches.

2509.24282.tldr: SimuHome's time-accelerated simulation could serve as an environment for agents to pre-validate their actions before committing them to the real world, suggesting that SimuHome's time-accelerated simulation could serve as an environment for agents to pre-validate their actions before committing them to the real world.

2509.26153.tldr: This field manual shifts the focus from algorithmic development to the essential infrastructure and implementation work required to bridge the"valley of death" and successfully translate generative AI from pilot projects into routine clinical care.

2510.02695.tldr: The Risk-Aware Multimodal Actor-Critic (RAMAC) is introduced, which couples an expressive generative actor with a distributional critic and is the first model-free approach that learns risk-aware expressive generative policies.

2510.03879.tldr: This work presents ACToR (Adversarial C To Rust translator), a simple LLM agent-based approach that is the first work to show evidence that an agent-centric approach can reliably and automatically convert standalone command-line C programs at this scale.

2510.04187.tldr: A complement to constitutive modeling that augments neural networks with material principles to capture anisotropy and inelasticity at finite strains and bypass exponential-map time integration in the finite strain regime and stabilize the training of inelastic materials is proposed.

2510.10645.tldr: RetroTrim is a retrosynthesis system that successfully avoids nonsensical plans on a set of challenging drug-like targets and is not only the sole method that succeeds in filtering out hallucinated reactions, but it also results in the highest number of high-quality paths overall.

2510.14240.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation of 17 frontier deep research systems, including single-agent web search, single-agent deep research, and multi-agent systems is conducted, revealing current strengths, recurring failure modes, and key system components needed to advance reliable, insightful deep research.

2510.14861.tldr: Across applications-from cancer immunotherapy target discovery to cell engineering-LabOS shows that AI can move beyond computational design to participation, turning the laboratory into an intelligent, collaborative environment where human and machine discovery evolve together.

2511.01912.tldr: EvoMem is a multi-agent framework built on a dual-evolving memory mechanism that evolves across queries by storing task-specific rules and constraints while remains fixed within a query, and Query-feedback Memory, which evolves within a query by accumulating feedback across iterations for solution refinement.

2511.06390.tldr: GhostSpec is proposed, a lightweight yet effective method for verifying LLM lineage without access to training data or modification of model behavior, and is robust to fine-tuning, pruning, expansion, and adversarial transformations, reliably tracing lineage with minimal overhead.

2511.08340.tldr: HN-MVTS is proposed, a novel architecture that integrates a hypernetwork-based generative prior with an arbitrary neural network forecasting model, and suggests that hypernetwork-driven parameterization offers a promising direction for enhancing existing forecasting techniques in complex scenarios.

2511.11551.tldr: The results demonstrate that test-time policy shaping provides an effective and scalable solution for mitigating unethical behavior across diverse environments and alignment attributes and against prior training-time methods and general-purpose agents.

2511.15846.tldr: A graded LoC taxonomy is proposed, based on the metrics of severity and persistence, that distinguishes between Deviation, Bounded LoC, and Strict LoC and introduces a complementary framework that emphasizes three extrinsic factors: Deployment context, Affordances, and Permissions (the DAP framework).

2512.01485.tldr: This work proposes Multi-Path Perception Policy Optimization (M3PO), a novel reinforcement learning framework that explicitly injects collective insights into the reasoning process and allows each trajectory to refine its reasoning with peer feedback, thereby cultivating more reliable multi-step reasoning patterns.

2512.03072.tldr: Results indicate that the architecture achieves transparent, human-like reasoning and robust learning in unprecedented scenarios, establishing a practical and theoretical foundation for building trustworthy and aligned AGI.

2512.03728.tldr: This paper focuses on the AI/ML related technological advancements and features introduced in Release 19 within the Service and System Aspects (SA) Technical specifications group of 3GPP.

2512.04580.tldr: This paper introduces CryptoTensors, a secure and format-compatible file structure for confidential LLM distribution that incorporates tensor-level encryption and embedded access control policies, while preserving critical features such as lazy loading and partial deserialization.

2512.04829.tldr: Using a sample-efficient model-based framework that combines Bayesian optimisation with Monte Carlo Tree Search, new state-of-the-art upper bounds in dimensions $4-16 are obtained, showing that model-based search can advance computational progress in longstanding geometric problems.

2512.05156.tldr: The approach treats an LLM as a bipartite information engine where hidden layers act as a Maxwell demon controlling transformations of context into answer via prompt $Q, and proposes a thermodynamics-based semantic entropy production (SEP) metric in answer generation.

2512.05397.tldr: AI-enabled digital twins that have ``lived through''simulated life scenarios are introduced to support understanding of AI-mediated episodic prospection and raise questions about autonomy in AI-augmented decisions.

2512.06563.tldr: This perspective clarifies the limits of monolithic models under geometric and data-induced plasticity and motivates architectures and federated systems that distribute manifold complexity across many elastic models, forming a coherent world-modeling framework grounded in geometry, algebra, fixed points, and real-data complexity.

2512.07168.tldr: A two-stage self-supervised framework that combines the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture with a Density Adaptive Attention Mechanism for learning robust speech representations that provide a reversible, highly compressed, and language-model-friendly representation that is competitive with, and often more efficient than, existing neural audio codecs.

2512.07170.tldr: DiTFuse is presented, an instruction-driven Diffusion Transformer (DiT) framework that performs end-to-end, semantics-aware fusion within a single model that unifies infrared-visible, multi-focus, and multi-exposure fusion-as well as text-controlled refinement and downstream tasks-within a single architecture.

2512.07178.tldr: A Python package is proposed that extends SHAP by integrating it with a large language model (LLM), specifically OpenAI’s GPT, to generate contextualized textual explanations to improve the perceived understandability of SHAP explanations.

2512.07179.tldr: A Practical Interlinked Concept Knowledge Tracing (PICKT) model that can effectively process multiple types of input data is proposed and a knowledge map structures the relationships among concepts considering the question and concept text information, thereby enabling effective knowledge tracing even in cold start situations.

2512.07186.tldr: The START-Dataset is generated with a novel data-generation pipeline that first leverages an MLLM to translate real chart images into executable chart code, recovering the underlying data representation while preserving the visual distribution of real-world charts.

2512.07195.tldr: MASim is introduced, the first multilingual agent-based simulation framework that supports multi-turn interaction among generative agents with diverse sociolinguistic profiles that reproduces sociocultural phenomena and highlights the importance of multilingual simulation for scalable, controlled computational social science.

2512.07208.tldr: Geometry-Guided Text Prompt Calibration (GGTPC), a novel framework that directly corrects local training bias by providing clients with a global geometric prior, serving as a versatile module to enhance various FL algorithms.

2512.07218.tldr: NeSTR is proposed, a novel framework that integrates structured symbolic representations with hybrid reflective reasoning to enhance the temporal sensitivity of LLM inference and achieves superior zero-shot performance and consistently improves temporal reasoning without any fine-tuning.

2512.07228.tldr: This paper proposes Expectation Over Learned distribution of Transformation (EOLT), the framework to treat transformation distribution as a learnable component rather than a fixed design choice, and employs a policy network that learns to automatically prioritize critical transformations and adaptively generate instance-specific perturbations via reinforcement learning.

2512.07232.tldr: A two-stage pipeline consisting of rough filter and fine filter to match products from eBay and Amazon and a new framework for Entity Alignment, R elation-aware and A ttribute-aware Graph Attention Networks for E ntity A lignment (RAEA), is employed.

2512.07234.tldr: This work proposes Dropout Prompt Learning, which aims for applying dropout to improve the robustness of the vision-language models by applying dropout on the tokens of the textual and visual branches.

2512.07249.tldr: The experimental results show that the proposed pre-processing method IFFair mitigates bias of multiple accepted metrics in the classification setting, including demographic parity, equalized odds, equality of opportunity and error rate parity without conflicts.

2512.07253.tldr: A degradation-aware framework for endoscopic video enhancement is proposed, which enables real-time, high-quality enhancement by propagating degradation representations across frames and suggests that implicitly learning and propagating degradation representation offer a practical pathway for clinical application.

2512.07266.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid socially integrated DRL actor-critic approach that combines Spiking Neural Networks in the actor with Artificial Neural Networks in the critic and a neuromorphic feature extractor to capture temporal crowd dynamics and human-robot interactions.

2512.07275.tldr: An innovative encoderdecoder network architecture based on multi-scale residual structures, capable of extracting rich feature information from different receptive fields to effectively identify lesion areas is proposed, and significantly outperforms existing transformer and convolutional neural network-based models.

2512.07302.tldr: This work introduces AerialVP, the first agent framework for task prompt enhancement in UAV image perception, and introduces AerialSense, a comprehensive benchmark for UAV image perception that includes Aerial Visual Reasoning, Aerial Visual Question Answering, and Aerial Visual Grounding tasks.

2512.07306.tldr: This work introduces a constraint-programming framework for generating synthetic populations that reproduce target statistics with high precision while enforcing full individual consistency, and directly encodes aggregated statistics and structural relations.

2512.07309.tldr: Experimental results show that the RFRP-pretrained LM reduces localization error by over 40% compared to non-pretrained models and by 21% compared to those pretrained using supervised learning.

2512.07312.tldr: This work proposes a multi-core AI accelerator equipped with a shared system-level cache and application-aware management policies, which keeps the programming effort modest and explores the potential of the shared cache design to assist the development of future AI accelerator systems.

2512.07314.tldr: This study proposes Multi-Scale Spatio-Temporal AutoRegression (M-STAR), a new framework that generates long-term trajectories through a coarse-to-fine spatiotemporal prediction process and outperforms existing methods in fidelity and significantly improves generation speed.

2512.07328.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that ContextAnyone outperforms existing reference-to-video methods in identity consistency and visual quality, generating coherent and context-preserving character videos across diverse motions and scenes.

2512.07351.tldr: This study evaluates the proposed DeepAgent framework using three benchmark datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of a multi-agent approach in addressing diverse types of manipulations in deepfakes and confirms that hierarchy-based fusion enhances robustness by mitigating the weaknesses of individual modalities.

2512.07355.tldr: This work unifies supervised and unsupervised concept discovery through a shared geometric framework, providing principled metrics to measure SAE progress and assess how well discovered concept align with plausible human concepts.

2512.07360.tldr: This work proposes a structure-aware feature rectification approach that incorporates instance-specific priors derived directly from the image to refine CLIP features by enhancing local discrimination and achieves strong performance on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks.

2512.07400.tldr: By unifying CL with out-of-distribution detection, this work challenges the prevailing reliance on large buffers, suggesting that explicitly correcting these statistical artifacts could unlock robust performance with minimal replay.

2512.07415.tldr: This work proposes an approach that starts directly from the data, adopting a data mining perspective, and searches the mobility events in the data that might be possible evidences of mutual interactions between individuals, and on top of them looks for complex, persistent patterns and time evolving configurations of events.

2512.07426.tldr: This work proposes a novel image comparison measure designed to automatically detect hallucinations in normalized outputs, and systematically evaluates several well-cited normalization methods retrained on real-world data, revealing significant inconsistencies and failures that are not captured by conventional metrics.

2512.07430.tldr: A novel MSA framework designed for domain generalization that incorporates a Mixture of Invariant Experts model to extract domain-invariant features, thereby enhancing the model's capacity to learn synergistic relationships between modalities and design a Cross-Modal Adapter to augment the semantic richness of multimodal representations through cross-modal knowledge injection.

2512.07437.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that utilizing the adapted FastKAN as a drop-in replacement for the Reward and Continue predictors yields performance on par with the original MLP-based architecture, maintaining parity in both sample efficiency and training speed.

2512.07450.tldr: An explainability-driven verifier for GNN unlearning is proposed that snapshots the model before and verifies after deletion, using attribution shifts and localized structural changes (e.g., graph edit distance) as transparent evidence.

2512.07454.tldr: This paper presents Persian-Phi, a 3.8B parameter model that challenges the assumption that robust multilingual capabilities require massive model sizes or multilingual baselines, and provides a validated, scalable framework for extending the reach of state-of-the-art LLMs to underrepresented languages with minimal hardware resources.

2512.07482.tldr: This paper describes the process of data acquisition and processing of real-world data from public highway traffic, followed by the application of criticality measures on trajectory data to evaluate scenarios, as conducted within the AVEAS project ( www.aveas.org).

2512.07501.tldr: This paper proposes AutoICE, an LLM-driven evolutionary search for synthesizing verifiable C code that introduces the diverse individual initialization and the collaborative crossover to enable diverse iterative updates, thereby mitigating error propagation inherent in single-agent iterations.

2512.07522.tldr: LIME (Linguistic Metadata Embeddings), a method that enriches token embeddings with metadata capturing syntax, semantics, and contextual properties, substantially improves pre-training efficiency and improves tokenization, leading to remarkably stronger language modeling capabilities and generative task performance.

2512.07528.tldr: A proximal off-policy evaluation approach is adapted that identifies the confounded reward expectation using only observable state-action-reward trajectories under mild invertibility conditions on proxy variables and yields a surrogate MDP whose Bellman operator is well defined and consistent for state-based policies, and which integrates seamlessly with the maximum causal entropy (MaxCausalEnt) model-learning framework.

2512.07533.tldr: VulnLLM-R, the first specialized reasoning LLM for vulnerability detection, is proposed, which represents a pioneering effort to enable real-world, project-level vulnerability detection using AI agents powered by specialized reasoning models.

2512.07544.tldr: Experimental results on the public datasets ConvAI2 and MPChat demonstrate that MoCoRP outperforms existing baselines, achieving superior persona consistency and engaging, context-aware dialogue generation.

2512.07568.tldr: A Dual-Stream Residual Semantic Decorrelation Network (DSRSD-Net), a simple yet effective framework that disentangles modality-specific and modality-shared information through residual decomposition and explicit semantic decorrelation constraints, which consistently improves next-step prediction and final outcome prediction over strong single-modality, early-fusion, late-fusion, and co-attention baselines.

2512.07569.tldr: Evaluations on a nationwide ATM transaction dataset with domain-informed anomaly injection show that WECA improves SMAPE on anomaly-affected data by 6.1 percentage points compared to a normally trained baseline, with negligible degradation on normal data.

2512.07576.tldr: R2MF-Net, a recurrent residual multi-path encoder--decoder network tailored for automatic segmentation of multi-directional spine X-ray images, is proposed and evaluated on a clinical multi-view radiograph dataset comprising 228 sets of coronal, left-bending and right-bending spine X-ray images with expert annotations.

2512.07608.tldr: Evaluated on the {MedQA (US)} benchmark, Metric-Fair Prompting is shown to improve performance over standard single-item prompting, demonstrating that fairness-guided, confidence-oriented reasoning can enhance LLM accuracy on high-stakes clinical multiple-choice questions.

2512.07611.tldr: This study presents a systematic comparison of three Reinforcement Learning algorithms for improving complex reasoning in large language models (LLMs) and finds that the Dynamic Sampling component in DAPO does not improve performance; in fact, the best overall results are achieved with DAPO when DS is disabled.

2512.07612.tldr: PCMind-2.1-Kaiyuan-2B, a fully open-source 2-billion-parameter model focused on improving training efficiency and effectiveness under resource constraints, is introduced, demonstrating practical and scalable solutions for resource-limited pretraining.

2512.07624.tldr: This study highlights the generalization capability and data efficiency of TSFMs for process-related time series and provides the first systematic evaluation of temporal foundation models for PMF, indicating effective transfer of temporal structure from non-process domains.

2512.07627.tldr: This paper studies the inclusion of predefined chord constraints in melodic harmonization, i.e., where a desired chord at a specific location is provided along with the melody as inputs and the autoregressive transformer model needs to incorporate the chord in the harmonization that it generates.

2512.07631.tldr: The Agent Capability Problem (ACP), a framework for predicting whether an agent can solve a problem under resource constraints, generalizes across LLM-based and agentic workflows, linking principles from active learning, Bayesian optimization, and reinforcement learning through a unified information-theoretic lens.

2512.07652.tldr: An innovative AI-powered Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) system designed to overcome limitations by automating underwater object detection, analysis, and reporting is presented, paving the way for more effective scientific research and discovery in challenging marine environments.

2512.07674.tldr: DIST-CLIP (Disentangled Style Transfer with CLIP Guidance), a unified framework for MRI harmonization that flexibly uses either target images or DICOM metadata for guidance, is proposed, offering a flexible solution for style transfer and standardizing MRI data.

2512.07705.tldr: The findings indicate that TimesFM has the best overall performance with the lowest RMSE value and the competitive inference time, and highlights pre-trained time series foundation models as a promising direction for real-time forecasting, enabling accurate and scalable deployment with minimal model adaptation.

2512.07710.tldr: Comp CompassMax-V3-Thinking is presented, a hundred-billion-scale MoE reasoning model trained with a new RL framework built on one principle: each prompt must matter, which delivers strong performance across both internal and public evaluations.

2512.07724.tldr: This work proposes a Native Spiking Microarchitecture, treating noisy neurons as logic primitives, and introducing a Spatial Combinational Pipeline and a Sticky-Extra Correction mechanism, which reduces Linear layer latency to O(log N), yielding a 17x speedup.

2512.07729.tldr: This work demonstrates that DNNs trained using the HAA500 dataset perform almost as accurately on versions of the stimuli that show both body and background and on versions of the stimuli from which the body was removed, but are at chance-level for versions of the stimuli from which the background was removed.

2512.07796.tldr: A new paradigm for building large causal models (LCMs) that exploits the enormous potential latent in today's large language models (LLMs) is introduced, called DEMOCRITUS (Decentralized Extraction of Manifold Ontologies of Causal Relations Integrating Topos Universal Slices).

2512.07810.tldr: Although Prompt-based elicitation was not reliable, training-based elicitation consistently elicited full performance from the sandbagging models, using only a single correct demonstration of the evaluation task, so relying on elicitation as a detection strategy was prone to false-positives.

2512.07818.tldr: It is shown that next-token prediction is provably powerful for learning longer-range structure, even with common neural network architectures, and polynomial bounds are provided on the model size needed to achieve such $k$-token indistinguishability.

2512.07821.tldr: WorldReel is presented, a 4D video generator that is natively spatio-temporally consistent and brings video generation closer to 4D-consistent world modeling, where agents can render, interact, and reason about scenes through a single and stable spatiotemporal representation.

2512.07833.tldr: This study finetune a Vision-Language model to measure the relational similarity between images, and shows that while relational similarity has a lot of real-world applications, existing image similarity models fail to capture it -- revealing a critical gap in visual computing.

2309.13672.tldr: This work reformulates I2IT as an iterative decision-making problem via deep reinforcement learning (DRL) and proposes a computationally efficient RL-based I2IT (RL-I2IT) framework, to decompose a monolithic learning process into small steps with a lightweight model to progressively transform the source image to the target image.

2310.02239.tldr: A novel interleaved vision-and-language generation method, centered around the concept of "generative vokens", which exhibits substantial improvement over the baseline models on multimodal generation datasets, including MMDialog and VIST.

2310.07312.tldr: The article highlights the capabilities of diffusion models in learning complicated signal distributions, modeling wireless channels, and denoising and reconstructing distorted signals, as well as the recent advances in applying diffusion models to wireless systems.

2312.08968.tldr: A model that can accurately detect value-expressive posts in Russian social media VKontakte and provide a crucial step to a study of values within and between Russian social media users is found.

2401.15378.tldr: This work introduces MufassirQAS, a system that enhances LLM accuracy and transparency using a vector database-driven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach, and built a dataset comprising fundamental books containing Turkish translations and interpretations of Islamic texts to answer religious inquiries.

2405.17537.tldr: This work introduces a multimodal approach combining both CLIP-style contrastive learning to align images, barcode DNA, and text-based representations of taxonomic labels in a unified embedding space, allowing for accurate classification of both known and unknown insect species without task-specific fine-tuning.

2408.00540.tldr: The Energy Cost of AI Lifecycle (eCAL) of an AI model in a system is proposed and it is shown that as a trained AI model is used more frequently for inference, its energy cost per inference decreases, since the fixed training energy is amortized over a growing number of inferences.

2408.03463.tldr: This work introduces a novel, outcome-guided, subgroup analysis strategy for identifying subgroups of treatment response in both RCTs and observational studies alike, and significantly outperforms the current state-of-the-art method for subgroup analysis in both randomised and observational treatment regimes.

2409.08936.tldr: The SimSUM dataset is introduced, a benchmark dataset of 10,000 simulated patient records that link unstructured clinical notes with structured background variables that can be linked through domain knowledge to concepts of interest to be extracted from the text—namely, symptoms in the case of SimSUM.

2409.11138.tldr: The method is robust to noise and provides a good approximation of the system Hamiltonian when the state variables are sampled from a noisy observation, indicating its particular advantage for non-separable systems.

2410.17506.tldr: A novel distributional augmentation approach enabled by a tailored score-based conditional graph generation strategies to explore and synthesize unseen environments while preserving the validity and stable features of overall graph patterns is introduced.

2411.12950.tldr: NumCoKE is proposed—a numerical reasoning framework for KGs based on Mixture-of-Experts and Ordinal Contrastive Embedding, validating its superiority in both semantic integration and ordinal reasoning.

2412.08179.tldr: RAG-IT (Retrieval-Augmented Instruction Tuning), a novel framework designed to automate the generation of earnings report analysis through an LLM fine-tuned specifically for the financial domain, is introduced.

2501.06039.tldr: VirTues-derived biomarkers predict anti-PD-L1 chemo-immunotherapy response and stratify disease-free survival in an independent cohort, outperforming state-of-the-art biomarkers derived from the same datasets and current clinical stratification schemes.

2502.06909.tldr: A satisfaction function is designed that accounts for data size, Age of Information (AoI), and training latency for meta-computing and is incorporated into the utility function to incentivize IIoT nodes to participate in model training.

2502.12992.tldr: Automatic and human evaluation results demonstrate that B-cos LMs produce more faithful and human interpretable explanations than post-hoc methods, while maintaining task performance comparable to conventional fine-tuning.

2503.18549.tldr: This paper presents a reinforcement learning (RL) training environment (gym) built on a CAD geometric engine that achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) quality in generating command sequences from B-Rep geometries.

2504.15129.tldr: This work presents a task-oriented framework for end-to-end DRL in quadrotors that integrates design principles for complex task specification and reveals the interdependencies among simulated task definition, training design principles, and physical deployment.

2504.20781.tldr: This study evaluated the performance of LLMs in generating DR for architecture decisions, the pros and cons of the three prompting strategies, the strengths and limitations of LLM-generated DR, and the implications for the practical use of LLM-generated DR.

2504.21131.tldr: This work treats dynamic heuristics formally and proposes a framework that defines how the information dynamic heuristics rely on can be modified, and uses these transformations in a generic search algorithm and an instantiation that models A* with dynamic heuristics, allowing to provide general conditions for optimality.

2505.03295.tldr: This paper presents a method that treats capabilities as contracts for skill implementations and leverages large language models to generate executable code based on natural language user input and introduces a framework that allows users to incorporate their own libraries and resource interfaces into the code generation process through a retrieval-augmented generation architecture.

2505.12332.tldr: VoiceCloak is introduced, a multi-dimensional proactive defense framework with the goal of obfuscating speaker identity and degrading perceptual quality in potential unauthorized VC, and disrupting crucial conditional guidance processes within DMs.

2505.13936.tldr: The R1 Translator model combines a bidirectional LSTM encoder with a pretrained transformer-based decoder, utilizing EEG features to produce high-quality text outputs, which excels in ROUGE metrics, outperforming both T5 (previous research) and Brain Translator.

2505.19795.tldr: ViT-P is introduced, a novel two-stage segmentation framework that decouples mask generation from classification and coarse and bounding box annotations can effectively enhance classification without requiring additional training on fine annotation datasets, reducing annotation costs while maintaining strong performance.

2505.23856.tldr: OmniGuard identifies internal representations of an LLM/MLLM that are aligned across languages or modalities and then uses them to build a language-agnostic or modality-agnostic classifier for detecting harmful prompts, which improves harmful prompt classification accuracy.

2505.24554.tldr: Bench4KE is introduced, an extensible API-based benchmarking system for KE automation that provides a curated gold standard consisting of CQ datasets from 17 real-world ontology engineering projects and uses a suite of similarity metrics to assess the quality of the CQs generated.

2506.11180.tldr: An alternative approach based on the recently introduced Model Context Protocol (MCP), which allows systems to expose functionality through a standardized interface that is directly consumable by LLM-based agents, is presented.

2506.12200.tldr: Pro-V-R1 is introduced, the first trainable open-source agentic framework for autonomous RTL verification and an efficient reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that uses verification-specific rewards derived from program-tool feedback to optimize the end-to-end verification workflow.

2506.14262.tldr: This work casts adaptation as `correction' of old posteriors of existing adaptation methods and shows that a wide-variety of existing adaptation methods follow this very principle, including those used for continual learning, federated learning, unlearning, and model merging.

2506.17114.tldr: This work introduces the RFMDataset (Reveal Failure Modes), a collection of 200 diverse mathematical proof problems, and thoroughly evaluates advanced models' performance on it, revealing that models's self-reflection is insufficient to resolve the current logical dilemmas, necessitating formalized and fine-grained logical training.

2506.20024.tldr: ERDM is introduced, the first framework to successfully unify a rolling forecast structure with the principled, performant design of Elucidated Diffusion Models (EDM), and offers a flexible and powerful general framework for tackling diffusion-based dynamics forecasting problems where modeling uncertainty propagation is paramount.

2507.00269.tldr: Systematic evidence is provided for dual encoding in neural representations, meaningful nonlinearly encoded feature interactions, and an architectural paradigm shift from post-hoc feature analysis to integrated computational design is introduced, establishing foundations for next-generation SAEs.

2507.08143.tldr: Compactor, a training-free, query-agnostic KV compression strategy that uses approximate leverage scores to determine token importance, is presented, and a procedure for context-calibrated compression is introduced: inferring the maximum compression a given context supports before significant performance loss.

2507.15771.tldr: Scenario-specific experiments show that LLMs are sensitive to context but still display strong preferences for low unemployment and low inequality even in monetary-policy settings, andumerical sensitivity tests reveal intuitive responses to quantitative changes but also uncover non-linear patterns such as loss aversion.

2507.19523.tldr: This work introduces ATGC-Gen, an Automated Transformer Generator for Controllable Generation, which leverages cross-modal encoding to integrate diverse biological signals and achieves notable improvements in controllability and functional relevance.

2508.04503.tldr: Across the diverse UEA multivariate time-series archive as well as specific benchmarks in human activity recognition, sleep staging, and biomedical signals, PRISM matches or outperforms state-of-the-art CNN and Transformer models while using significantly fewer parameters and markedly lower computational cost.

2508.04652.tldr: A multi-agent, multi-turn algorithm, Multi-Agent Group Relative Policy Optimization (MAGRPO), to solve LLM collaboration as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem, building on current RL approaches for LLMs as well as MARL techniques.

2508.13544.tldr: This work proposes FLAIR (Frequency- and Locality-Aware Implicit Neural Representations), a novel activation designed for joint frequency selection and spatial localization under the constraints of the time-frequency uncertainty principle, which consistently outperforms existing INRs in 2D image representation, as well as 3D shape reconstruction and novel view synthesis.

2508.15769.tldr: This work presents SceneGen, a novel framework that takes a scene image and corresponding object masks as input, simultaneously producing multiple 3D assets with geometry and texture, and introduces a novel feature aggregation module that integrates local and global scene information from visual and geometric encoders within the feature extraction module.

2508.18321.tldr: KAIROS is introduced, a benchmark that simulates quiz-style collaboration with peer agents whose rapport levels and behaviours can be precisely controlled in both historical interactions and the current round, and model scale is a primary factor moderating susceptibility to social influence.

2508.21058.tldr: This work recast long-context video generation as an internal information retrieval task and proposes a simple, learnable sparse attention routing module, Mixture of Contexts (MoC), as an effective long-term memory retrieval engine.

2508.21302.tldr: Locus features an agentic framework with program analysis tools to synthesize and iteratively refine the candidate predicates, while ensuring the predicates strictly relax the target states to prevent false rejections via symbolic execution.

2509.03817.tldr: The Meta-Policy Deliberation Framework is introduced, where agents learn a decentralized policy over a set of high-level meta-cognitive actions: Persist, Refine, and Concede, and SoftRankPO, a novel reinforcement learning algorithm that stabilizes training by shaping advantages based on the rank of rewards mapped through smooth normal quantiles, making the learning process robust to reward variance.

2509.04622.tldr: This work systematically assesses the discriminative capacity of commonly used metrics including RSA, linear predictivity, Procrustes, and soft matching to provide the first systematic comparison of similarity metrics through a separability lens.

2509.16959.tldr: SON-GOKU is introduced, a scheduler that computes gradient interference, constructs an interference graph, and then applies greedy graph-coloring to partition tasks into groups that align well with each other, which improves the effectiveness of any underlying multi-task learning optimizer without additional tuning.

2509.20215.tldr: VCD-RNK is proposed, a discriminator model tailored for efficient Verilog code reranking that incorporates Verilog-specific reasoning by distilling expert knowledge across three dimensions: code semantic analysis, test case generation, and functional correctness assessment.

2509.24552.tldr: This work introduces SWAX, a hybrid architecture consisting of sliding-window attention and xLSTM linear RNN layers that significantly outperforms regular window attention both on short and long-context problems.

2509.25643.tldr: SOCK is introduced, a benchmark command line interface (CLI) that measures large language models' (LLMs) ability to self-replicate without human intervention and provides the first formalized definitions and benchmark suite for evaluating LLM self-replication.

2510.02350.tldr: Rather than serving as an update, LLMSQL is introduced as an LLM-ready benchmark, enabling straightforward generation and evaluation for modern natural-language-to-SQL models.

2510.03291.tldr: UniPruning is presented, a unified post-training pruning framework that combines the speed of local saliency metrics with the stability of global coordination, enabled by a mirror descent based optimization, all without updating model weights.

2510.05526.tldr: The DPO-COV algorithm is simple to implement without reward estimation, and is proved to be equivalent to the RLHF-COV algorithm, which directly implies the equivalence between the vanilla RLHF and DPO algorithms.

2510.05535.tldr: This work advances a privacy-preserving knowledge fusion strategy to derive a unified representation space without sharing sensitive raw data and incorporates a sample-aware weighting strategy to address distributional imbalance among heterogeneous local clients.

2510.16809.tldr: It is highlighted that for code translation, the quality of a few well-chosen examples outweighs sheer quantity, challenging the universal efficacy of "more is better" for ICL and underscoring the task-dependent nature of optimal prompting strategies.

2510.17923.tldr: This work introduces COMPASS (Composite Path and Answer Self-Scoring), a novel test-time reward mechanism that operates without external supervision that systematically enhances the model's analytical capabilities.

2510.20812.tldr: Speculative Verdict (SV), a training-free framework inspired by speculative decoding that combines multiple lightweight draft experts with a large verdict model, achieves both error correction and cost-efficiency compared to large proprietary models or training pipelines.

2510.23856.tldr: This paper reports IBM's experience developing and piloting the Computer Using Generalist Agent (CUGA), which has been open-sourced for the community and outlines requirements and next steps for advancing research-grade architectures like CUGA into robust, enterprise-ready systems.

2510.24411.tldr: OS-Sentinel is proposed, a novel hybrid safety detection framework that synergistically combines a Formal Verifier for detecting explicit system-level violations with a VLM-based Contextual Judge for assessing contextual risks and agent actions that achieves 10%-30% improvements over existing approaches across multiple metrics.

2511.01935.tldr: A new, systematic model based on machine learning (ML) is introduced to make this process more objective of sample size justification, enhancing transparency, and strengthening the epistemological foundation of qualitative inquiry through evidence-based, systematic decision-making.

2511.07904.tldr: It is argued that TdRL offers a novel perspective for representing task objectives, which could be helpful in addressing the reward design challenges in RL applications, and an algorithm implementation of TdRL is developed.

2511.10240.tldr: ProgRAG, a multi-hop knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) framework that decomposes complex questions into sub-questions, and progressively extends partial reasoning paths by answering each sub-question, is proposed, offering improved reliability and reasoning quality.

2511.10384.tldr: The dual role of LLMs as both proxies for human-like biases and as auditors capable of tracing information fidelity are demonstrated, demonstrating the dual role of LLMs as both proxies for human-like biases and as auditors capable of tracing information fidelity.

2511.11599.tldr: This work introduces SynBullying, a synthetic multi-LLM conversational dataset for studying and detecting cyberbullying (CB), and evaluates its utility across five dimensions, including conversational structure, lexical patterns, sentiment/toxicity, role dynamics, harm intensity, and CB-type distribution.

2511.12083.tldr: The Embedding CFR algorithm is proposed, a novel approach for solving strategies in IIEFGs within an embedding space that pre-trains information set abstractions via low-dimensional embedding for strategy solving and is the first algorithm in poker AI that pre-trains information set abstractions via low-dimensional embedding for strategy solving.

2511.13625.tldr: This approach proposes to decouple QN updates using a coroutine while batching the acquisition function calls, which yields the theoretically identical convergence to the sequential MSO but also drastically reduces the wall-clock time compared to the previous approaches.

2511.14295.tldr: A AraLingBench benchmark is presented, a fully human annotated benchmark for evaluating the Arabic linguistic competence of large language models (LLMs), showing that many models succeed through memorization or pattern recognition rather than authentic comprehension.

2511.15593.tldr: This work analyzes agent trajectories on MLE-bench to reveal that different models and agent scaffolds yield varying degrees of ideation diversity, and that higher-performing agents tend to have increased ideation diversity.

2511.16205.tldr: This work proposes ChemLabs, a hierarchical multi-agent framework that mimics human expert collaboration through specialized agents for problem decomposition, perception, reasoning, and auditing, and establishes a new state-of-the-art in automated chemical problem-solving.

2511.21667.tldr: This work introduces RARO (Relativistic Adversarial Reasoning Optimization), a method that learns strong reasoning capabilities from only expert demonstrations via Inverse Reinforcement Learning, enabling robust reasoning learning even when task-specific verifiers are unavailable.

2511.22334.tldr: This study evaluates the inference performance and energy efficiency of commercial CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs for running SLMs, and shows that designs optimized for both efficiency and performance offer a clear advantage for edge workloads.

2512.00218.tldr: This work introduces a novel methodology for measuring monitorability according to whether a monitor can predict a key latent variable using the model's reasoning, and finds that adversarial optimisation (penalising monitor accuracy) degrades monitor performance, while direct optimisation for monitorability does not reliably lead to improvements.

2512.01354.tldr: The findings demonstrate that modelling human cognitive limitations -- not copying surface data -- enables synthetic data with genuine functional gain, offering a viable technical pathway toward resolving the AI data-collapse crisis.

2512.02530.tldr: Comprehensive experiments on the proposed benchmark (AIR-Bench) validate that Aetheria not only generates detailed and traceable audit reports but also demonstrates significant advantages over baselines in overall content safety accuracy, especially in the identification of implicit risks.

2512.04007.tldr: The results indicate that, although the use of traditional positional encodings is valid for modeling sketches as sequences, absolute coordinates consistently outperform relative ones.

2512.04207.tldr: A large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent clinical decision support system built on an orchestrator-specialist architecture, designed to perform explicit and interpretable secondary headache diagnosis from free-text clinical vignettes, is presented.

2512.04463.tldr: While MARL shows promise for small-scale deployments (2-4 robots), significant scaling challenges remain and requires extensive hyperparameter tuning -- particularly extended epsilon annealing for sparse reward discovery.

2512.04529.tldr: SlideGen is introduced, an agentic, modular, and visual in the loop framework for scientific paper to slide generation that outperforms existing methods in visual quality, content faithfulness, and readability, positioning it as the new state of the art in automated slide generation.

2512.04921.tldr: The first version of the AI Consumer Index (ACE) is introduced, a benchmark for assessing whether frontier AI models can perform everyday consumer tasks, and it is found that models are prone to hallucinating key information, such as prices.

2512.05033.tldr: Arbitrage is proposed, a novel step-level speculative generation framework that routes generation dynamically based on the relative advantage between draft and target models, reducing inference latency by up to $\sim2\times$ at matched accuracy.

2512.05964.tldr: The results suggest that training-time action conditioning is a practical drop-in replacement for inference-time inpainting in real-time robot control and maintains both task performance and speed parity with inference-time RTC while being computationally cheaper.

2512.06616.tldr: This analysis positions MPA as a distinct construct relative to information asymmetry, privacy, surveillance, and customer relationship management, and argues that protecting mutual forgetting, or at least mutual control over memory, should become a central design and policy goal in the AI age.

2512.07094.tldr: This work presents VIGIL (Verifiable Inspection and Guarded Iterative Learning), a reflective runtime that supervises a sibling agent and performs autonomous maintenance rather than task execution, and demonstrates meta level self repair in a deployed agent runtime.

2512.07135.tldr: The integrated model achieved a score of 51.08 on the navsim ICCV benchmark, securing third place, and employs Reinforcement Learning to fine-tune the trajectory scoring mechanism.

2512.07215.tldr: A comprehensive visual comparison between CLIP based and DINOv2 based approaches for 3D pose estimation in hand object grasping scenarios is presented and shows that CLIP based methods achieve better semantic consistency, while DINOv2 based approaches demonstrate competitive performance with enhanced geometric precision.

2512.07487.tldr: The contours of an overlooked but intensifying technological arms race for nuclear (in)visibility are laid out, driven by the interplay between proliferation‐enabling technologies (PETs) and detection‐enhancing technologies (DETs).

2512.07497.tldr: This work investigates how large language models (LLMs) fail when operating as autonomous agents with tool-use capabilities and identifies four recurring failure archetypes: premature action without grounding, over-helpfulness that substitutes missing entities, vulnerability to distractor-induced context pollution, and fragile execution under load.

2512.07785.tldr: This study establishes the first LLM-agent-driven automated data-analysis framework in HEP, enabling systematic benchmarking of model capabilities, stability, and limitations in real-world scientific computing environments.

2512.07814.tldr: This work provides the first causal evidence that leakage risks are type-dependent and offers guidance for developing type-aware and learnability-aware defenses for LLM4Code.

2512.07843.tldr: Across six challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, ThreadWeaver achieves accuracy comparable to cutting-edge sequential reasoning models while delivering up to 1.53x average speedup in token latency, establishing a new Pareto frontier between accuracy and efficiency.

2512.07844.tldr: This paper theoretically quantify the harm of a pronounced misalignment between the feature and the classifier weight spaces through an optimal error exponent analysis and proposes three explicit alignment strategies that plug-and-play into existing long-tail methods without architectural change.

2512.07845.tldr: Two novel audiospatial scene datasets are presented, AudioScanNet and AudioRoboTHOR, designed to explore audioconditioned tasks within 3D environments and enable research on how audio signals interact with spatial context.

2512.07850.tldr: A model-agnostic, gradient-free, test-time safeguard that adds mutation-gated verification, injects targeted reflection before mutating steps, and performs block-based context cleaning, which argues for action-level analysis, targeted safeguards, and reliable evaluations as prerequisites for robust multi-turn agents.

2512.07853.tldr: A framework is proposed that predicts the peak GPU memory usage by analyzing the model architecture and training behavior of multimodal models and decomposes the multimodal model into its constituent layers and applies factorization to estimate the memory usage of each layer.

2512.07866.tldr: A method for detecting DGA domains using Deep Learning and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques and demonstrated that the Neural Network approach presents superiority in detecting complex patterns, reaching 97.2% accuracy and reducing the false positive rate in ambiguous lawful traffic scenarios.

2512.07867.tldr: A transparent and fully auditable LLM-based pipeline for macro-financial stress testing, combining structured prompting with optional retrieval of country fundamentals and news is developed, demonstrating that LLM-generated macro scenarios can provide a scalable and interpretable complement to traditional stress-testing frameworks.

2512.07869.tldr: This work peek inside a SOTA foundation model of neural activity as a physiologist might, characterizing each neuron based on its temporal response properties to parametric stimuli, gaining insights into the biological relevance of its internals through the novel analysis of its neurons' joint temporal response patterns.

2512.07871.tldr: This report develops the mathematical foundation of QCRM, defines its parameterized circuit architecture, and shows how logical rules can be encoded as unitary transformations over proposition-qubit states, and proposes the Quantum Reasoning Layer as a differentiable hybrid component for composable reasoning models applicable to scientific, biomedical, and chemical inference domains.

2512.07882.tldr: This data indicates that accurate proton resonance frequency MR thermometry is essential for monitoring temperature rise during thermal ablation with high intensity focused ultrasound (FUS) with conventional referenceless methods.

2512.07884.tldr: Generalized Spatial Propagation Network-2 establishes a new efficiency frontier for modeling global spatial context in vision applications through its unique combination of structured matrix transformations and GPU-optimized implementation.

2512.07885.tldr: The proposed framework achieves good tracking skills in terms of Probability of Detection and False Alarm Rate, accurately reproduces Seasonal and Inter-Annual Variability, and reconstructs reliable, smooth and coherent TC tracks, highlighting the potential of integrating deep learning and computer vision to provide robust, computationally efficient and skillful data-driven alternatives to TC tracking.

2512.07888.tldr: Functional Random Forest with Adaptive Cost-Sensitive Splitting (FRF-ACS) is introduced, a novel ensemble framework designed for imbalanced functional data classification that significantly improves minority class recall and overall predictive performance compared to existing functional classifiers and imbalance handling techniques.

2512.07898.tldr: This paper introduces MARINE (Multi-Agent Recursive IN-context Enhancement), a theoretically grounded framework that reconceptualizes test-time reasoning as iterative refinement of a persistent reference trajectory, fundamentally departing from conventional one-shot or multi-sample paradigms.

2512.07907.tldr: A data workflow for cleaning and harmonizing multiple community science datasets is presented, which is implemented in a case study using eBird, iNaturalist, GBIF, and other datasets to model the impact of highly pathogenic avian influenza in populations of birds in the subantarctic.

2512.07917.tldr: CFD-copilot is introduced, a domain-specialized LLM framework designed to facilitate natural language-driven CFD simulation from setup to post-processing and indicates that domain-specific adaptation and the incorporation of the MCP jointly enhance the reliability and efficiency of LLM-driven engineering workflows.

2512.07921.tldr: DeepCode is introduced, a fully autonomous framework that fundamentally addresses the challenge of high-fidelity document-to-codebase synthesis through principled information-flow management and establishes new foundations for autonomous scientific reproduction that can accelerate research evaluation and discovery.

2512.07926.tldr: This paper argues for a paradigm shift from the use of AI in independent data component operations towards a more holistic and autonomous handling of the entire data lifecycle, and explores how each stage of the modern data stack can be autonomously managed by intelligent agents to build self-sufficient systems that can be used not only by human end-users, but also by AI itself.

2512.07983.tldr: An empirical framework to evaluate semantic preservation in LESS by mining model evolution data from HuggingFace via a reproducible pipeline using the native HF hub API and empirical case studies illustrating semantic drift in practice are introduced.

2512.07990.tldr: The gray literature investigation shows various definitions of fairness requirements in AI systems, commonly emphasizing non-discrimination and equal treatment across different demographic and social attributes, and the need for consistent frameworks and practices to integrate fairness into AI software, paying as much attention to fairness as to effectiveness.

2512.07993.tldr: SkipKV is presented, a KV compression method that performs selective eviction and generation removal, operating at a coarse-grained, sentence-level sequence removal for efficient CoT reasoning, and introduces asentence-scoring metric to identify and remove highly similar sentences while maintaining semantic coherence.

2512.08016.tldr: FEDA is introduced, a benchmark for testing complex open-ended cartographic reasoning in LVLMs and reveals a persistent gap in multi-step cartographic reasoning, positioning FRIEDA as a rigorous benchmark to drive progress on spatial intelligence in LVLMs.

2512.08026.tldr: A secure, scalable proof-of-concept system for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-augmented patient-trial matching that addresses key implementation challenges: integrating heterogeneous electronic health record data, facilitating expert review, and maintaining rigorous security standards is presented.

2512.08057.tldr: Experimental results show that ChatGPT excels in general language understanding and text generation, while DeepSeek demonstrates superior performance in programming tasks due to its efficiency-focused design.

2512.08108.tldr: Through experiments on highly challenging tasks with large-scale datasets of up to 100M transitions, it is shown that MAC achieves the best performance among offline model-based RL algorithms, especially on challenging long-horizon tasks.

2512.08124.tldr: A novel machine learning based portfolio management method that manages a group of cryptocurrencies by analyzing the relative relationship by utilizing the neural network in each time step to predict the rank of the future return of the managed cryptocurrencies and place weights accordingly.

2512.08130.tldr: The BBG Framework, including the Bacterial Biothreat Schema, seeks to offer a robust, re-usable structure for evaluating bacterial biological risks arising from LLMs across multiple levels of aggregation, which captures the full scope of technical and operational requirements for biological adversaries, and which accounts for a wide spectrum of biological adversary capabilities.

2512.08145.tldr: A novel dual-agent HUI framework that constructs two independent LLM agents (a task planning agent, and an execution agent) and applies different Prompt Engineering to separately handle the understanding, planning, and execution of tasks.

2512.08153.tldr: TreeGRPO is introduced, a novel RL framework that dramatically improves training efficiency by recasting the denoising process as a search tree, providing a scalable and effective pathway for RL-based visual generative model alignment.

2512.08160.tldr: The result is a principled framework that illustrates how to construct LayerPipe architectures, predicts their delay requirements, and mitigates their storage burden, thereby enabling scalable pipelined training with controlled communication computation tradeoffs.

2512.08169.tldr: AIDR achieves higher accuracy and 40.6% latency reduction versus Chain-of-Thought, with robustness to data corruption and out-of-distribution generalization, enabling auditable and efficient SOC triage with full data residency compliance.

2512.08185.tldr: This proposal establishes a foundation for comparative security assessment of medical-specialist models and defense mechanisms, advancing the broader goal of ensuring safe and trustworthy medical AI systems.

2512.08188.tldr: Embodied Tree of Thoughts (EToT), a novel Real2Sim2Real planning framework that leverages a physics-based interactive digital twin as an embodied world model, is proposed and validated on a suite of short- and long-horizon manipulation tasks, where it consistently outperforms baselines.

2512.08193.tldr: ClinicalTrialsHub is presented, an interactive search-focused platform that consolidates all data from ClinicalTrials.gov and augments it by automatically extracting and structuring trial-relevant information from PubMed research articles, with potential to make access easier for patients, clinicians, researchers, and policymakers, advancing evidence-based medicine.

2512.08218.tldr: A Pseudo-Riemannian Capsule Network is derived, which models data in pseudo-Riemannian manifolds of adaptive curvature, for graph representation learning and outperforms state-of-the-art models, validating PR-CapsNet's strong representation power for complex graph structures.

2512.08228.tldr: MM-CoT is introduced, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to probe the visual grounding and logical coherence of CoT reasoning in MMs, and shows low correlation with existing benchmarks, confirming that it measures a unique combination of visual grounding and logical reasoning.

2512.08230.tldr: In an empirical study, this work systematically test how children and adults use cues to empowerment to infer causal relations, and design effective causal interventions.

2512.08238.tldr: SpeechQualityLLM is introduced, a multimodal speech quality question-answering system that couples an audio encoder with a language model and is trained on the NISQA corpus using template-based question-answer pairs covering overall MOS and four perceptual dimensions in both single-ended and double-ended setups.

2512.08240.tldr: HTC-VLM is introduced, a hybrid framework that disentangles semantics and appearance through dual channels and demonstrates that a minimalist hybrid design can resolve the efficiency-fidelity dilemma and advance scalable VLMs.

2512.08243.tldr: A novel deep hybrid Residual-SwinCA-Net segmentation framework is proposed in the study, which improves the BUSI lesion diagnostic performance and strengthens timely clinical decision-making.

2512.08247.tldr: This work proposes a sparse query-based approach, Future Temporal Knowledge Distillation (FTKD), which effectively transfers future frame knowledge from an offline teacher model to an online student model, and presents a future-aware feature reconstruction strategy to encourage the student model to capture future features without strict frame alignment.

2512.08261.tldr: Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that KPI outperforms state-of-the-art methods in predictive accuracy and provides clinically valid explanations that closely align with patient narratives, highlighting its practical value for patient-centered healthcare delivery.

2512.08270.tldr: This paper evaluates state-of-the-art reasoning models on a set of mock CFA exams consisting of 980 questions across three Level I exams, two Level II exams, and three Level III exams, and finds that most models clear all three levels.

2512.08273.tldr: This research introduces Generative Agents, which can rapidly and cost-effectively evaluate AI-generated content, simulating human judgment by rating aspects such as coherence, interestingness, clarity, fairness, fairness, and relevance.

2512.08286.tldr: By combining interactive code querying, automated project scaffolding, and human-AI collaboration, SolidGPT provides a practical, privacy-respecting edge assistant that accelerates real-world development workflows, ideal for intelligent mobile and software engineering contexts.

2512.08300.tldr: A novel reinforced strategy injection mechanism, that enables any LLM to become an RLM by employing a small planner to guide the LLM's CoT through the adaptive injection of reasoning strategies, and Experimental results show that rSIM enables Qwen2.5-0.5B to become an RLM and significantly outperform Qwen2.5-14B.

2512.08326.tldr: This work proposes Argus, a multi-agent collaborative framework for detecting sensitive information that employs a three-tier detection mechanism that integrates key content, file context, and project reference relationships to effectively reduce false positives and enhance overall detection accuracy.

2512.08329.tldr: This study provides a systematic, explainable AI analysis using a unified framework that integrates white-box feature-space inspection and black-box signal-level probing, indicating that contemporary image protection operates through structured feature-level deformation rather than semantic dislocation.

2512.08343.tldr: Through extensive experimentation, the study found that the Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) algorithm provided the best performance, achieving R-squared values of 80.4% for MDD and 89.1% for OMC on a separate dataset.

2512.08344.tldr: A novel XAI framework tailored for graph-based machine learning is developed, aiming to offer adaptable, computationally efficient explanations for GNNs, moving beyond individual feature analysis to capture how graph structure influences predictions.

2512.08345.tldr: This study leverages Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Systems to simulate 1-on-1 adversarial debates, creating a controlledociological sandbox, and demonstrates that agent-based modeling provides a reproducible, ethical alternative to human-subject research for measuring the mechanics of social friction.

2512.08360.tldr: A novel Conditional Neural Cellular Automata architecture capable of growing distinct topological structures from a single generic seed, guided solely by a spatially broadcasted class vector is proposed.

2512.08379.tldr: DeepFeature is proposed, the first LLM-empowered, context-aware feature generation framework for wearable biosignals that outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on five tasks while maintaining comparable performance on the remaining tasks.

2512.08449.tldr: The Impact-Driven AI Framework (IDAIF) represents a paradigm shift from model-centric to impact-centric AI development, providing engineers with concrete architectural patterns for building ethical, trustworthy, and socially beneficial AI systems.

2512.08451.tldr: The development process involved three complementary approaches: 1) web-based prompt generation, 2) red teaming, and 3) mining existing benchmark corpora, to generate over 7,000 potential benchmarks linked to the Task-Query Architecture that was developed during the first component of the project.

2512.08459.tldr: Overall, the pilot demonstrated that the B3 dataset offers a viable, nuanced method for rapidly assessing the biosecurity risk posed by a LLM, identifying the key sources of that risk and providing guidance for priority areas of mitigation priority.

2512.08463.tldr: The studies show that learning a high-performance skill can require richer information than executing it, and learning conditions can be kind or wicked depending solely on the goal, not on dynamics or policy complexity.

2512.08478.tldr: By unifying inference and rendering directly in the browser, Visionary significantly lowers the barrier to reproduction, comparison, and deployment of 3DGS-family methods, serving as a unified World Model Carrier for both reconstructive and generative paradigms.

2512.08503.tldr: This work introduces ReasonBreak, a novel adversarial framework specifically designed to disrupt hierarchical reasoning in MLRMs through concept-aware perturbations, and establishes a new paradigm for privacy protection against reasoning-based threats.

2512.08536.tldr: Concept2Plan, an interactive research prototype demonstrating how a human and a Large Language Model can collaborate to produce context-sensitive ethical rules and guide automated planning, showcases the potential of human-LLM collaboration for making ethical automated planning more practical and feasible.

2512.08542.tldr: A new quaternion Wasserstein distance is defined and a novel Wasserstein quaternion generative adversarial network is proposed, which surpasses both the (quaternion) generative adversarial networks and the Wasserstein generative adversarial network in terms of generation efficiency and image quality.

2512.08545.tldr: A hierarchical multi-agent architecture that distributes reasoning across a 64*64 grid of lightweight agents, supported by a selective oracle, is introduced, demonstrating improved stability, reduced oracle usage, and stronger long-range reasoning from distributed agent cooperation.

2512.08548.tldr: This work proposes a semantically grounded linguistic representation to normalize actions for efficient pretraining, and uses the motion representation to narrows the feature distance between action tokens and standard vocabulary tokens, mitigating modality gaps.

2512.08567.tldr: The results showed that the GNN model was able to achieve better performance than the baseline LSTM model on both datasets, which confirms the effectiveness of exploiting financial news using graph-based models.

2512.08577.tldr: A user study involving surgeons demonstrated that videos generated by the proposed view-synthesis method were superior to those produced by conventional methods in terms of the ease of confirming the surgical area and the comfort during video viewing.

2512.08592.tldr: The SMART+ Framework - a structured model built on the pillars of Safety, Monitoring, Accountability, Reliability, and Transparency, and further enhanced with Privacy&Security, Data Governance, Fairness&Bias, and Guardrails - provides a robust foundation for effective AI governance in clinical research.

2512.08596.tldr: Teachers can encourage active engagement, while future EWAs may integrate automatic labeling and monitoring to prompt students to move from questioning to writing, enabling fuller benefits from GenAI-supported learning.

2512.08613.tldr: This work presents a transformer-based model that applies attention mechanisms to protein sequence data to predict structural motifs and shows strong ability to generalize across variable-length sequences while effectively capturing both local and long-range residue interactions.

2512.08629.tldr: This work introduces the novel Embodied Smartphone Operation (ESO) task and presents See-Control, a framework that enables smartphone operation via direct physical interaction with a low-DoF robotic arm, offering a platform-agnostic solution.

2512.08657.tldr: This experience report showcases the software architecture reusability techniques applied while building Ocean Guard, an MLES for anomaly detection in the maritime domain and highlights the challenges and lessons learned to reuse the Ports and Adapters pattern to support building multiple microservices from a single codebase.

2512.08713.tldr: This paper introduces the first publicly available dataset for Automatic Essay Scoring (AES) and feedback generation in Basque, targeting the CEFR C1 proficiency level and proposes a novel evaluation methodology for assessing feedback generation, combining automatic consistency metrics with expert-based validation of extracted learner errors.

2512.08715.tldr: A probabilistic framework is adopted and it appears that the corresponding weighted mean is known to be the summarization, and that only some remarkable scores assign to the summarized performance a value equal to a weighted arithmetic mean of the values assigned to the domain-specific performances.

2512.08733.tldr: A distribution-based framework for evaluating and mitigating individual fairness in skin lesion classification is introduced, treating skin tone as a continuous attribute rather than a categorical label, and employing kernel density estimation (KDE) to model its distribution.

2512.08740.tldr: This work provides the first engineering proof for "cognitive equity" and opens up a new path for AI governance: constructing a verifiable and intervenable governance paradigm through"transparency of interaction protocols"rather than prying into the internal mechanisms of models.

2512.08755.tldr: Simulation results reveal that STAR-RIS outperforms RIS in low-altitude scenarios due to its full-space coverage capability, whereas RIS delivers better performance near the base station at higher altitudes.

2512.08767.tldr: A Transformer-based approach for dynamic parameter estimation supported by an automated pipeline that generates diverse robot models and enriched trajectory data using Jacobian-derived features is proposed, contributing to improved sim-to-real transfer in robotic systems.

2512.08769.tldr: This paper provides a practical, end-to-end guide for designing, developing, and deploying production-quality agentic AI systems and offers a foundational reference to build robust, extensible, and production-ready agentic AI workflows.

2512.08774.tldr: Self-refining diffusion, a novel framework that enhances image generation quality by detecting flaws, is proposed, which employs an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) based flaw highlighter to produce flaw activation maps (FAMs) that identify artifacts and unrealistic regions.

2512.08777.tldr: A post-training method for lower-resource languages that preserves fluency of language models even when aligned by disfluent reward models, and shows that the on-policy aspect is crucial and outperforms the alternatives without relying on any hard-to-obtain data.

2512.08789.tldr: A matte vision transformer (MatteViT) is proposed, a novel shadow removal framework that applies spatial and frequency-domain information to eliminate shadows while preserving fine-grained structural details in downstream tasks, improving recognition performance over prior methods.

2512.08798.tldr: This work introduces TabPFN-GN, which transforms graph data into tabular features by extracting node attributes, structural properties, positional encodings, and optionally smoothed neighborhood features, which enables TabPFN to perform direct node classification without any graph-specific training or language model dependencies.

2512.08802.tldr: This approach offers a self-sustained, low-overhead, and low-maintenance solution, allowing security professionals to guide model learning as expert ``teachers''.

2512.08819.tldr: This work demonstrates that growth via gradual middle stacking yields more effective utilization of model depth, alters the residual stream structure, and facilitates the formation of permutable computational blocks and proposes a lightweight modification of MIDAS that yields further improvements in downstream reasoning benchmarks.

2512.08820.tldr: This work characterize the vision-language relationship between semantic concepts, which typically has a hierarchical tree structure, in the hyperbolic space instead of the traditional Euclidean space, and finds that this unique property is particularly effective for embedding hierarchical data structures using the Poincar\'e ball model.

2512.08826.tldr: This work presents CARLoS, a large-scale framework for characterizing LoRAs without requiring additional metadata, and develops an efficient retrieval framework that semantically matches textual queries to relevant LoRAs while filtering overly strong or unstable ones, outperforming textual baselines in automated and human evaluations.

2512.08833.tldr: A closer look at two prominent knowledge representation formalisms, description logics and logic programming, and discuss theoretical results and practical methods for computing interpolants.

2512.08873.tldr: The proposed SOLI (Siamese-Driven Optimization for Low-Resolution Image Latent Embedding in Image Captioning) approach employs a Siamese network architecture to optimize latent embeddings, enhancing the efficiency and accuracy of the image-to-text translation process.

2512.08875.tldr: This work introduces a simple No-box Membership Inference Attack (MIA) called LevAtt that assumes adversarial access to only the generated synthetic data and targets the string sequences of numeric digits in synthetic observations and proposes two methods, including a novel sampling strategy that strategically perturbs digits during generation.

2512.08879.tldr: DAO-GP (Drift-Aware Online Gaussian Process), a novel, fully adaptive, hyperparameter-free, decayed, and sparse non-linear regression model that features a built-in drift detection and adaptation mechanism that dynamically adjusts model behavior based on the severity of drift.

2512.08889.tldr: This work proposes an annotation-free training framework that improves both reasoning and grounding, and combines the strengths of modern AI systems: advanced language-only reasoning models for decomposing spatial queries into simpler subtasks, and strong vision specialist models improved via performant VLM critics.

2512.08894.tldr: This paper proposes a direct framework to model the scaling of benchmark performance from the training budget and finds that for a fixed token-to-parameter ratio, a simple power law can accurately describe the scaling behavior of log accuracy on multiple popular downstream tasks.

2512.08923.tldr: This work introduces two new benchmarks REST and REST+ (Render-Equivalence Stress Tests) to enable systematic evaluation of cross-modal inconsistency in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and finds that the degree of modality inconsistency varies substantially, even when accounting for problems with text recognition.

2406.00532.tldr: The integration of various XAI approaches, such as SHAP, LIME, Grad-CAM, and others, with machine learning and deep learning models utilized in breast cancer detection and classification are discussed.

2410.08060.tldr: This work proposes a novel alternative framework to address the Monge-Kantorovich problem based on a projection type gradient descent scheme, and demonstrates that the resulting dynamics recovers random maps with favourable computational performance.

2502.17801.tldr: Experimental results show that this method has significant advantages in detection accuracy, response efficiency, and resource utilization, providing a new solution for cloud computing security protection.

2507.02442.tldr: Categorical modeling in this paper clarifies and formalizes the structural interplay between residuals and parameters in supervised learning, and proposes applying a semantic perspective developed in theoretical computer science as a formal foundation for Explicability in AI.

2512.01317.tldr: This work reframes MIE detection as a data-driven learning problem that assumes no prior knowledge of state preparation, and trains a neural network in a self-supervised manner to predict the uncertainty metric for MIE--the gap between upper and lower bounds of the average post-measurement bipartite entanglement.
