2512.08959.tldr: A unified benchmarking framework focused on evaluating EEG-based foundation models in clinical applications, which shows that while foundation models achieve strong performance in certain settings, simpler models often remain competitive, particularly under clinical distribution shifts.

2512.08960.tldr: Experiments show that PS-LoRA outperforms state-of-the-art methods by preserving the stability of learned representations while efficiently adapting to new domains by preserving the stability of learned representations while efficiently adapting to new domains.

2512.08965.tldr: This work introduces FIFE, a novel, high-difficulty benchmark designed to assess LM instruction-following capabilities for financial analysis tasks, and evaluates 53 models (proprietary, open-weight, open-source) in a zero-shot setting.

2512.08967.tldr: CERT, a novel framework for certifying LLM robustness via clustering-guided denoising smoothing, is proposed, which introduces a semantic clustering filter that reduces noisy samples and retains meaningful perturbations, supported by theoretical analysis.

2512.08973.tldr: This research presents a novel approach to enhancing automatic speech recognition systems by integrating noise detection capabilities directly into the recognition architecture that incorporates a dedicated noise identification module that operates concurrently with speech transcription.

2512.08978.tldr: An institutional AI platform is built and ran in a six-month, 300-user pilot, showing that a university of applied sciences can offer advanced AI with fair access, transparent risks, controlled costs, and alignment with European law.

2512.08979.tldr: MECOT (Multi-Event instruction fine-tuning with Chain-of-Thought), which trains models on detailed, event-by-event video descriptions and using chain-of-thought prompts at inference to enhance temporal awareness is proposed, implying effectiveness of temporal understanding.

2512.08981.tldr: Experimental results show that UTIE consistently reduces bias metrics while maintaining, or even improving in several cases, the face verification accuracy, which promotes fairer verification performance across groups.

2512.08982.tldr: Consist-Retinex is presented, the first framework adapting consistency modeling to Retinex-based low-light enhancement and introduces two core innovations: a dual-objective consistency loss combining temporal consistency with ground-truth alignment under randomized time sampling, and an adaptive noise-emphasized sampling strategy that prioritizes training on large-noise regions essential for one-step conditional generation.

2512.08983.tldr: HSCP is a Hierarchical Spectral Clustering Pruning framework that combines layer pruning with channel pruning to achieve extreme compression, high performance, and efficient inference and maintains superior robustness even in low signal-to-noise ratio environments.

2512.08984.tldr: This work introduces RAG-HAR, a training-free retrieval-augmented framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) for HAR, and moves beyond known behaviors, enabling the recognition and meaningful labelling of multiple unseen human activities.

2512.08986.tldr: A quality-control framework is proposed, ensuring only high-standard data is used for evaluation and AI training, and the agreement between annotators calculated using derived formulas determines the usability of the annotations.

2512.08987.tldr: A 3D Inverse Design framework that directly navigates the 3D design space by coupling a continuous latent representation with a physics-aware optimization strategy, which enables 3DID to generate high-fidelity 3D geometries, outperforming existing methods in both solution quality and design versatility.

2512.08992.tldr: A better classification framework of chest disease that relies on EfficientNetV2-M and incorporates superior training approaches such as Automatic Mixed Precision training, AdamW, Cosine Annealing learning rate scheduling, and Exponential Moving Average regularization is suggested.

2512.08996.tldr: A novel generative model that predicts 3D dose distributions based solely on user-defined preference flavors that enables planners to prioritize specific trade-offs between organs-at-risk (OARs) and planning target volumes (PTVs) offering greater flexibility and personalization is introduced.

2512.08998.tldr: This work introduces the DermETAS-SNA LLM Assistant that integrates Dermatology-focused Evolutionary Transformer Architecture Search with StackNet Augmented LLM, and creates a proof-of-concept prototype that fully integrates the DermETAS-SNA LLM into the AI assistant to demonstrate its practical feasibility for real-world clinical and educational applications.

2512.09001.tldr: A novel methodology for generating large-scale, physically valid defect datasets with pixel-level annotations is proposed, feasible for robust AI-based Measurement/Inspection (MI) in semiconductor fabrication.

2512.09006.tldr: This research investigates Large Language Models, which are considered among the most performant AI models to date, for the CVD task, and highlights the importance of fine-tuning to resolve the task, the performance of Double tuning, as well as the potential of Llama models for CVD.

2512.09010.tldr: Lossless Ultimate Vision tokens Compression (LUVC) systematically compresses visual tokens until complete elimination at the final layer of LLM, so that the high-dimensional visual features are gradually fused into the multimodal queries.

2512.09065.tldr: ShelfAware is a semantic particle filter for robust global localization that treats scene semantics as statistical evidence over object categories rather than fixed landmarks, yielding fast, targeted hypothesis generation on low-cost, vision-only hardware.

2512.09066.tldr: This work presents ORCA (Open-ended Response Correctness Assessment), a framework that models the variability in human judgments using Beta distributions to predict both expected correctness and uncertainty.

2512.09076.tldr: These findings demonstrate that interpretable additive models remain competitive with both traditional and complex approaches, offering a practical balance of accuracy, transparency, and ease of deployment.

2512.09085.tldr: By disentangling different mental models of AI, this work can study human-AI interaction with more precision to better navigate the detailed design of anthropomorphized AI and prompting interfaces.

2512.09088.tldr: The findings show that hallucinations do not result in blanket mistrust but instead lead to context-sensitive trust calibration, and validate the recursive trust calibration process proposed by Blöbaum and extend it by including intuition as a user-related trust factor.

2512.09108.tldr: This work presents ARTEMIS, a no-code evolutionary optimization platform that jointly optimizes agent configurations through semantically-aware genetic operators that can optimize agents based on both commercial and local models.

2512.09127.tldr: A Knowledge-Guided Large Language Model (KG-LLM) that integrates a pediatric dental knowledge graph, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and a multi-stage safety validation pipeline for evidence-grounded antibiotic recommendation is proposed.

2512.09134.tldr: AngioAI-QFR provides a practical, near real time pipeline that unifies computer vision, functional profiling, and virtual PCI with automated angiography derived physiology.

2512.09148.tldr: This work develops a lightweight post-hoc hallucination detector, Graph Grounding and Alignment (GGA), which outperforms strong semantic and confidence-based baselines across AUC and F1 and offers insights into how structural limitations in LLMs contribute to hallucinations, informing the design of more reliable GraphRAG systems in the future.

2512.09164.tldr: WonderZoom is presented, a novel approach to generating 3D scenes with contents across multiple spatial scales from a single image that enables users to "zoom into" a 3D region and auto-regressively synthesize previously non-existent fine details from landscapes to microscopic features.

2512.09187.tldr: WOLF moves deception evaluation beyond static datasets, offering a dynamic, controlled testbed for measuring deceptive and detective capacity in adversarial multi-agent interaction.

2512.09190.tldr: This paper presents the first EEG-based comparison of cognitive load, fatigue, valence, and arousal across the two driving modes, and highlights the need for scenario-specific data and models when developing next-generation driver monitoring systems for autonomous vehicles.

2512.09198.tldr: This work proposes a data-driven clinical support tool to identify the optimal valve type with the objective of minimizing the risk of permanent pacemaker implantation (PPI), a predominant postoperative complication in TAVR.

2512.09199.tldr: This work investigates the applicability and consistency of LLMs for analog circuit design -- a task requiring domain-specific reasoning, adherence to physical constraints, and structured representations -- focusing on AI-assisted design where humans remain in the loop.

2512.09202.tldr: This work enables real-time PDE solving on edge devices and paves the way for energy-efficient scientific computing at scale.

2512.09222.tldr: CORE is proposed, a concept-first interaction layer that improves multi-turn stability without modifying model weights and offers a model-agnostic mechanism that separates conceptual reasoning from language generation, suggesting a scalable direction for more stable multi-turn systems.

2512.09244.tldr: The proposed deep CNN achieved a remarkable classification performance, attaining 100% accuracy in the early detection of chronic kidney disease (CKD), demonstrating strong potential for addressing critical clinical diagnostic challenges and enhancing early medical intervention strategies.

2512.09251.tldr: GLACIA is introduced, the first framework that integrates large language models with segmentation capabilities to produce both accurate segmentation masks and corresponding spatial reasoning outputs and enables intuitive disaster preparedness and informed policy-making in the context of rapidly changing glacial environments.

2512.09264.tldr: This study proposes a frequency-based black-box attack method for AIGC detection that leverages the Discrete Cosine Transform for fine-grained spectral partitioning and selects frequency bands as query subspaces, improving both query efficiency and image quality.

2512.09292.tldr: This work curates a dataset of student essays and assesses 16 different detection systems for bias across four attributes: gender, race/ethnicity, English-language learner (ELL) status, and economic status, finding that while biases are generally inconsistent across systems, there are several key issues.

2512.09318.tldr: A Genetic Algorithm-based approach called GENESIS is proposed, which evolves three sine-function-activated Neural Networks, and funnels their output to a Gaussian distribution and an A* algorithm to optimise all three sub-problems simultaneously.

2512.09319.tldr: This dissertation develops an efficiency grounded computational framework that enables data lean, physics-aware, and deployment ready intelligence for modern manufacturing environments and extends visual understanding through zero-shot vision language reasoning augmented by domain specific retrieval, enabling generalizable assessment in previously unseen scenarios.

2512.09340.tldr: This paper examines image labeling performance across human participants and deep neural networks, focusing on low-resolution, perceptually degraded stimuli, and highlights key parallels and divergences between biological and artificial systems in representation, inference, and confidence calibration.

2512.09355.tldr: The results indicate that for MILP branching, the computational cost of expressive GNNs currently outweighs their gains in decision quality, suggesting that future research must focus on efficiency-preserving expressivity.

2512.09375.tldr: Quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that using a log RGB color space consistently improves rendering quality, exhibits greater robustness across scenes, and performs particularly well in low light conditions while using the same bit-depth input images.

2512.09386.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed CONCUR method outperforms the best single strategy and strong existing routing techniques with higher end-to-end accuracy and lower inference cost in both continual and non-continual settings, while also reducing training cost in the continual setting.

2512.09396.tldr: GAIR is a novel MLLM-based GUI automation agent framework designed for integrating knowledge and combining capabilities from heterogeneous models to build GUI automation agent systems with higher performance.

2512.09398.tldr: ConFormer (Conditional Transformer), a novel framework that integrates graph propagation with guided normalization layer that surpasses the state-of-the-art STAEFormer in both predictive performance and efficiency, achieving lower computational costs and reduced parameter demands is proposed.

2512.09406.tldr: A transferable representation that bridges the embodiment gap is introduced: by inpainting the robot arm in training videos to obtain a clean background and overlaying a simple visual cue, a generative model is conditioned to insert the robot arm back into the scene.

2407.01630.tldr: This survey systematically reviews, categories, and discusses the impact of recommenders in four human-AI ecosystems -- social media, online retail, urban mapping and generative AI ecosystems.

2502.04499.tldr: An intriguing phenomenon is observed that layer-selection strategy does not matter (much) in intermediate-layer matching in knowledge distillation -- even seemingly nonsensical matching strategies such as reverse matching still result in surprisingly good student performance.

2503.05507.tldr: A series of billion-scale GrammarCoder models are developed, incorporating grammar rules in the code generation process, and analysis shows that grammar-based representations enhance LLMs'ability to discern subtle code differences, reducing semantic errors caused by minor variations.

2505.14295.tldr: The most commonly used types of encoding methods are studied and benchmarked them using different datasets, enabling more efficient data separation in complex feature spaces that may be inaccessible to classical methods.

2505.16056.tldr: This paper proposes two metrics to measure local routing consistency of MoE models and reveals that domain-specialized experts contribute more to routing consistency than vocabulary-specialized ones, and that most models balance between cache effectiveness and efficiency with cache sizes approximately twice the active experts.

2507.10580.tldr: EmoSApp serves as a blueprint for future innovations in portable, secure, and highly tailored AI-driven mental health support by prioritizing on-device deployment and specialized domain-specific adaptation.

2508.06389.tldr: Results show that NCAs grown in close proximity are more stable compared with the original NCA model, and emergent movement from the stable organisms is observed, with increasing prevalence for models with multiple identity values.

2508.06485.tldr: WGAST is the first end-to-end deep learning framework designed for daily 10 m LST estimation via spatio-temporal fusion of Terra MODIS, Landsat 8, and Sentinel-2, and outperforms existing methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

2508.19366.tldr: A rigorous information-geometric framework is presented, grounded in diffusion dynamics, to quantify hallucinations in MLLMs where model outputs are embedded via spectral decompositions of multimodal graph Laplacians, and their gaps to a truth manifold define a semantic distortion metric.

2509.15872.tldr: Extension to multistep CRMs relevant to prebiotic chemistry, demonstrates the ability of DeepMech in effectively reconstructing 2 pathways from simple primordial substrates to complex biomolecules such as serine and aldopentose.

2509.20409.tldr: This paper synthesizes a series of formal proofs to construct a unified theory on the logical limits of the Symbol Grounding Problem, demonstrating through a four-stage argument that meaningful grounding within a formal system must arise from a process that is external, dynamic, and non-fixed algorithmic.

2510.03506.tldr: OneFlow surpasses both autoregressive and diffusion-based approaches while unlocking new capabilities for concurrent generation, iterative refinement, and natural reasoning-like generation.

2510.06249.tldr: The results show that aligning mid-level layers using TRepLiNa (CKA+REPINA) is a low-cost, practical approach to improving LRL translation, especially in data-scarce settings.

2510.06961.tldr: It is observed that Conformer-based encoders paired with transformer-based decoders achieve the best average WER, while connectionist temporal classification and token-and-duration transducer decoders offer superior RTFx, making them better suited for long-form and batched processing.

2510.09660.tldr: This work derives the score relation for anisotropic forward covariances and shows that, under full support, the learned score converges to the true data score as $t\!\to-0$, while anisotropy reshapes the probability-flow path from noise to data.

2510.15731.tldr: An empirical analysis of DLM attention patterns, focusing on the attention sinking phenomenon, reveals that DLMs also exhibit attention sinks, but with distinct characteristics, and provides new insights into the inner workings of diffusion-based language models.

2510.20690.tldr: This work provides the first formal tail bounds for hallucination probability in ensembled language models, reframing it as a second-moment reliability problem and explaining 94.3% of empirical reliability variation seen across parallel configurations.

2511.14256.tldr: Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that PathMind consistently outperforms competitive baselines, particularly on complex reasoning tasks with fewer input tokens, by identifying essential reasoning paths.

2512.06813.tldr: A cooperative neural network framework is proposed for the partial inverse design of high-performance concrete that integrates an imputation model with a surrogate strength predictor and learns through cooperative training and provides an accurate and computationally efficient foundation for constraint-aware, data-driven mix proportioning.

2512.07332.tldr: RicciKGE is proposed to have the KGE loss gradient coupled with local curvatures in an extended Ricci flow such that entity embeddings co-evolve dynamically with the underlying manifold geometry towards mutual adaptation.

2512.07509.tldr: This paper provides a more general overview of possible vector systems for NN training along with their properties and methods for vector system construction.

2512.07564.tldr: This work proposes a training-free self-correction framework enabling VLMs to iteratively refine responses through uncertainty-guided visual re-attention, which combines multidimensional uncertainty quantification with attention-guided cropping of under-explored regions.

2512.07877.tldr: This work presents a machine learning-driven framework that automates NoC design space exploration using BookSim simulations and reverse neural network models to predict optimal NoC parameters given target performance metrics.

2512.08317.tldr: This work proposes a geometry-aware distribution-matching framework, called GeoDM, which operates in the Cartesian product of Euclidean, hyperbolic, and spherical manifolds, with flat, hierarchical, and cyclical structures all captured by a unified representation.

2512.08518.tldr: The findings suggest that physiological comfort thresholds in human-robot interaction differ from human-human dynamics and can be effectively modeled using interpretable logic.

2512.08580.tldr: Lumo-1 is introduced, a generalist vision-language-action (VLA) model that unifies robot reasoning with robot action, and builds upon the general multi-modal reasoning capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs), progressively extending them to embodied reasoning and action prediction, and ultimately towards structured reasoning and reasoning-action alignment.

2512.09434.tldr: This benchmark trains and evaluates LLMs in generating accurate, readable summaries from long judicial texts by benchmarking small and large LLMs using reference-based metrics, factual-consistency checks, LLM-as-judge, and expert ranking.

2512.09441.tldr: In this framework, task-specific adapters are added to the pre-trained and frozen image encoder to learn new knowledge, and a novel cross-task representation calibration strategy based on a mixture of light-weight projectors is used to help better separate all learned classes in a unified feature space, alleviating class confusion across tasks.

2512.09458.tldr: This chapter argues that the reliability of agentic and generative AI is chiefly an architectural property, and proposes a practical taxonomy-tool-using agents, memory-augmented agents, planning and self-improvement agents, multi-agent systems, and embodied or web agents.

2512.09461.tldr: This work designs a human-in-the-loop annotation pipeline to curate a biologically validated CS dataset from TLI videos, and proposes a two-stage deep learning framework that classifies CS presence at the frame level and localizes CS regions in positive cases.

2512.09463.tldr: Results demonstrate that task-specific obfuscation enables effective monitoring with reduced privacy risks, establishing the framework's readiness for real-world adoption and providing cross-domain recommendations for responsible, human-centric AI deployment in industry.

2512.09471.tldr: A Video Vision Transformer (ViViT)-based framework with temporal-spatial fusion embedding for MSI reconstruction in cloud-covered regions is proposed, which effectively enhances spectral reconstruction quality for robust agricultural monitoring.

2512.09477.tldr: This work explores how color is encoded in a generative model through a systematic analysis of the latent representations in Stable Diffusion, revealing that color information is encoded along circular, opponent axes predominantly captured in latent channels c_3 and c_4, whereas intensity and shape are primarily represented in channels c_1 and c_2.

2512.09485.tldr: SecLoop constitutes the first fully automated framework that integrates large language models (LLMs) across the entire lifecycle of security strategy generation, orchestration, response, and feedback, enabling intelligent and adaptive defenses in dynamic network environments, thus tackling the first challenge.

2512.09487.tldr: A RL-based framework that enables LLMs to perform multi-turn and adaptive graph-text hybrid RAG and significantly outperforms existing RAG baselines is introduced, highlighting the benefits of end-to-end RL in supporting adaptive and efficient retrieval for complex reasoning.

2512.09496.tldr: This work proposes the latent separation hypothesis, which states that a partially fine-tuned model's dependence on subgroup representation is determined by the degree of separation between subgroups in the latent space of the pre-trained model, and provides theoretical analysis, empirical analysis, and a practical application to foundation model fine-tuning.

2512.09524.tldr: Experimental results indicate that NeuroSketch achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across all evaluated datasets, positioning it as a powerful tool for neural decoding.

2512.09563.tldr: A novel three-stage LLM-based framework: Prompt Engineering, Supervised Fine-tuning, and LLM Merging is proposed, demonstrating superior performance over baseline methods in detecting fine-grained hate speech.

2512.09570.tldr: It is argued that effective AI governance must be intersectional, enforceable, and inclusive, key to moving beyond tokenism toward meaningful equity and preventing reinforcement of existing inequalities.

2512.09577.tldr: Auto-BenchmarkCard is presented, a workflow for generating validated descriptions of AI benchmarks by combining multi-agent data extraction from heterogeneous sources with LLM-driven synthesis and evaluates factual accuracy through atomic entailment scoring using the FactReasoner tool.

2512.09579.tldr: Comparisons of different types of ViTs against traditional CNN models across various tasks, including object recognition, detection, and medical image classification indicate that Vision Transformers are competitive and, in many cases, outperform traditional CNNs, especially in scenarios requiring the understanding of global visual contexts like medical imaging.

2512.09586.tldr: An automated framework that discovers and refines variational quantum circuits (VQCs) using graph-based Bayesian optimization with a graph neural network (GNN) surrogate is presented, providing a scalable and interpretable route to automated quantum circuit discovery.

2512.09591.tldr: The results show that multiple pretraining methods achieve comparable performance for sleep staging, apnea diagnosis, and age estimation, however, for mortality and disease prediction, contrastive learning significantly outperforms other approaches while also converging faster during pretraining.

2512.09610.tldr: This paper iteratively design and develop a novel multimodal text generation system called ImageTalk through a tailored proxy-user-based and an end-user-based design phase, demonstrating pronounced keystroke savings and consistent performance and high user satisfaction.

2512.09616.tldr: An efficient post-training and inference framework that enhances a video MLLM's reasoning capability and suggests that long, human-like CoT reasoning may not be necessary for general video reasoning, and that concise reasoning can be both effective and efficient.

2512.09629.tldr: This work presents an end-to-end framework for planning supported by verifiers that can be integrated with any PDDL planning engine and validator and represents a significant step toward end-to-end planning aided by LLMs.

2512.09662.tldr: It is found that LLM-generated annotations can reliably reflect performance trends across classification models, correlating with human evaluations, suggesting their potential as proxy evaluators in subjective NLP tasks.

2512.09678.tldr: It is demonstrated that F-Muon and S-Muon consistently match Muon's performance, while outperforming vanilla Muon on a synthetic linear least squares problem.

2512.09682.tldr: A family of deterministic games is introduced, designed for scaling studies for MARL, which shows that two off-the-shelf MARL algorithms perform competitively with the baseline for a small number of agents, but scalability issues arise as the number of agents increase.

2512.09727.tldr: This work introduces a method that uses Gaussian Process Regression to obtain value estimates for promising actions that were not trialed in the environment, and demonstrates that this approach outperforms existing aggregation strategies while requiring a modest increase in inference time.

2512.09729.tldr: Ethics Readiness Levels bridge high-level ethical principles and everyday engineering by turning ethical values into concrete prompts, checks, and controls within real use cases, and promotes a shift from narrow technological solutionism to a more reflective, ethics-by-design mindset.

2512.09736.tldr: This work systematically study three fundamental factors: the relationship between solution optimality and execution performance, the sensitivity of system performance to inaccuracies in kinodynamic modeling, and the tradeoff between model accuracy and plan optimality to understand how key planner design choices affect performance in realistic scenarios.

2512.09742.tldr: The results show that narrow finetuning can lead to unpredictable broad generalization, including both misalignment and backdoors, including both misalignment and backdoors.

2512.09757.tldr: This work presents a mechanistic analysis of autoregressive transformers trained on drug-like small molecules to reveal the computational structure underlying their capabilities across multiple levels of abstraction, and identifies computational patterns consistent with low-level syntactic parsing and more abstract chemical validity constraints.

2512.09775.tldr: This paper proposes to adapt and jointly utilize a set of selected techniques to evaluate the relevance of model predictions at runtime and applies and evaluates these proposals in the highly heterogeneous and evolving domain of Human Activity Recognition (HAR).

2512.09779.tldr: The Virtual Patient Engine models continuous latent disease trajectories from sparse clinical anchors, using generative modeling to synthesize physiologically plausible, fully labeled 3D cohorts and a dynamic Lattice-of-Experts (LoE) organizes specialized networks within a pathology-aware topology, enabling robust zero-shot generalization to unseen data without target-domain fine-tuning.

2512.09806.tldr: A novel approach for quantifying and comprehending hallucination artifacts to ensure trustworthy computer vision models and uses conformalized quantile regression to assess hallucination levels in a distribution-free manner is introduced.

2512.09829.tldr: RIFT (Reinforcement Learning-guided Intelligent Fault Targeting), a scalable framework that automates the discovery of minimal, high-impact fault scenarios for efficient design-time fault assessment, is introduced.

2512.09831.tldr: It is argued that this cognitive-geometric perspective clarifies the epistemic boundaries of influence in both human and artificial systems, and offers a general foundation for analyzing belief dynamics across heterogeneous agents.

2512.09872.tldr: FlipLLM is proposed, a reinforcement learning architecture-agnostic framework that formulates BFA discovery as a sequential decision-making problem and offers the first scalable and adaptive methodology for exploring the BFA vulnerability of both language and multimodal foundation models, paving the way for comprehensive hardware-security evaluation.

2512.09892.tldr: This work studies a query learning model with logit queries that reflects the access model for common APIs and gives what they believe is the first end-to-end learning guarantee for a generative model that plausibly captures modern language models.

2512.09895.tldr: MatSci-YAMZ's underlying model has the capacity to enhance semantic transparency and reduce time required for consensus building and metadata vocabulary development, and has the potential for scalability across domains.

2512.09897.tldr: SCOPE (Subgoal-COnditioned Pretraining for Efficient planning), a one-shot hierarchical planner that leverages LLM-generated subgoals only at initialization to pretrain a lightweight student model, removes the need for repeated LLM queries, significantly improving efficiency, though at the cost of reduced explainability and potentially suboptimal subgoals.

2512.09898.tldr: A vision-based, data-driven framework for real-time UAV-UGV integration that demonstrates strong potential for deployment in GPS/GNSS-denied environments, supporting reliable multi-agent coordination under realistic dynamic conditions is proposed.

2512.09908.tldr: A categorical framework where moralisation and triangulation are modelled as functors between a category of Bayesian networks and one of Markov networks, which highlights the distinctions between syntactic and semantic modifications.

2512.09909.tldr: This paper proposes STACHE, a comprehensive framework for generating local, black-box explanations for an agent's specific action within discrete Markov games, and introduces an exact, search-based algorithm that circumvents the fidelity gaps of surrogate models.

2512.09910.tldr: This study establishes Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a parameter-efficient framework to address challenges in dedicated NMT architectures and introduces a novel gradient-based regularization strategy specifically designed for low-rank decomposition matrices.

2512.09912.tldr: Across real and simulated datasets, attention weighting improves predictive performance while preserving interpretability, and theory shows that attention-weighting linear models attain lower mean squared error than the standard linear model under mixture-of-models data-generating processes with known subgroup structure.

2512.09914.tldr: This work proposes Few-step Accurate Likelihoods for Continuous Flows (FALCON), a method which allows for few-step sampling with a likelihood accurate enough for importance sampling applications by introducing a hybrid training objective that encourages invertibility.

2512.09920.tldr: LISN-Bench is presented, the first simulation-based benchmark for language-instructed social navigation and Social-Nav-Modulator, a fast-slow hierarchical system where a VLM agent modulates costmaps and controller parameters, reduces reliance on high-frequency VLM inference while improving dynamic avoidance and perception adaptability.

2306.01270.tldr: This work proposes a path planning method, MAPPOHR, which combines heuristic search, empirical rules, and multi-agent reinforcement learning and shows that the planning performance of MAPPOHR is better than that of existing learning and heuristic methods.

2408.14338.tldr: This work considerably improves the state-of-the-art SMT solving on first-order quantified problems by efficient machine learning guidance of quantifier selection and shows a considerable increase of the system's holdout-set performance after training it on a large set of first-order problems collected from the Mizar Mathematical Library.

2411.00612.tldr: A novel Contrastive Learning-based Link-based hierarchical self-supervised architecture, CLP, is proposed, which employs a multi-view hierarchical self-supervised architecture to encode spatial and temporal heterogeneity and encodes the spatial and temporal distribution heterogeneity from a contrastive learning perspective.

2411.10036.tldr: This work reevaluate the UNet architecture for end-to-end MMIF, identifying that widely used batch normalization limits performance by smoothing crucial sparse features, and proposes a hybrid of instance and group normalization to maintain sample independence and reinforce intrinsic feature correlations.

2411.16326.tldr: This work systematically evaluated over 30 state-of-the-art networks with varying network architectures, training datasets, and training regimes for the presence or absence of brain-like properties and found network architecture had the strongest impact on brain-like properties compared to dataset and training regime variations.

2411.17438.tldr: This work presents a novel, brain-inspired, deep-learning architecture that learns from pixels to interpret, control, and reason about its environment, using object-centric representations and shows how to manipulate grounded object representations, as a key inductive bias for unsupervised learning, to enable behavioral reasoning.

2412.01782.tldr: This analysis reveals that DETRs employ an optimal specialist strategy: one prediction per object is trained to be well-calibrated, while the remaining predictions are trained to suppress their foreground confidence to near zero, even when maintaining accurate localization.

2412.02912.tldr: Experimental results show that ShapeWords produces images that are more text-compliant, aesthetically plausible, while also maintaining 3D shape awareness.

2412.21051.tldr: LLM-PD is presented, a novel defense architecture that proactively mitigates various DoS threats in cloud networks and can flexibly self-evolve based on experience learned from previous interactions and adapt to new attack scenarios without additional training.

2501.03403.tldr: This work reformulates existing Document AI tasks into a Question-Answering task, making it a suitable resource for training and evaluating Large Language Models and releases the OCR of all the documents and includes the exact position of the answer to be found in the document image as a bounding box.

2502.01113.tldr: GFM-RAG is a novel graph foundation model (GFM) for retrieval augmented generation powered by an innovative graph neural network that reasons over graph structure to capture complex query-knowledge relationships, making it the first graph foundation model applicable to unseen datasets for retrieval without any fine-tuning required.

2502.09884.tldr: The first nonasymptotic central limit theorem is derived with respect to the Wasserstein-1 distance for two-time-scale stochastic approximation with Polyak-Ruppert averaging with expected error achieved by Polyak-Ruppert averaging significantly improves on the rates of convergence in prior works.

2503.11901.tldr: This study characterizes GPU resilience in Delta 1, a large-scale AI system that consists of 1,056 A100 and H100 GPUs, with over 1,300 petaflops of peak throughput and finds that significant overprovisioning of 5% is necessary to handle GPU failures.

2504.00597.tldr: An extensive assessment of LLMs'ability to make consistent use of a relevant passage regardless of its language, respond in the expected language, and focus on the relevant passage even when multiple `distracting'passages in different languages are provided in the context reveals a surprising ability of LLMs to extract the relevant information from passages in a different language than the query.

2504.01538.tldr: Applied to a large, noisy dataset of mechanics experiments, AI-Newton successfully rediscovers foundational and universal laws, such as Newton's second law, the conservation of energy, and the universal gravitation.

2504.01951.tldr: Results indicate that while models can infer gender with moderate accuracy, their decisions are often rooted in stereotypical associations between product categories and gender, highlighting the persistent nature of gender biases in LLMs and emphasize the need for robust bias-mitigation strategies.

2504.05537.tldr: This work proposes a deep learning-based framework to enable real-time video motion transfer which is critical for enabling bandwidth-efficient applications such as video conferencing, remote health monitoring, virtual reality interaction, and vision-based anomaly detection.

2504.20566.tldr: The BISON method proposes an inclusive training separation strategy using dual classifiers so that knowledge from both old and new classes can effectively be integrated into the model, while introducing implicit approaches for transferring knowledge across the two classifiers.

2505.01730.tldr: PASCAL is proposed, which performs ANN-SNN conversion in such a way that the resulting SNN is mathematically equivalent to an ANN with QCFS-activation, thereby yielding similar accuracy as the source ANN with minimal inference timesteps.

2505.10537.tldr: The dApps concept is leveraged to enable real-time RF spectrum classification with LibIQ, a novel library for RF signals that facilitates efficient spectrum monitoring and signal classification by providing functionalities to read I/Q samples as time-series, create datasets and visualize time-series data through plots and spectrograms.

2505.13631.tldr: Adaptive Constrained Equivariance (ACE), a constrained optimization approach that starts with a flexible, non-equivariant model and gradually reduces its deviation from equivariance, consistently improves performance metrics, sample efficiency, and robustness to input perturbations compared with strictly equivariant models and heuristic equivariance relaxations.

2505.13847.tldr: The results demonstrate that certain segmental features commonly used in forensic voice comparison (FVC) are effective in identifying deep-fakes, whereas some global features provide little value.

2505.17012.tldr: This work aims to conduct a holistic assessment of the spatial understanding capabilities of modern MLLMs and proposes complementary data-driven and agent-based solutions and introduces SpatialScore, the most comprehensive and diverse benchmark for multimodal spatial intelligence to date.

2505.19086.tldr: This work introduces MaskedManipulator, a generative control policy distilled from a tracking controller trained on large-scale human motion capture data that produces goal-directed manipulation behaviors that expand the scope of interactive animation systems beyond task-specific solutions.

2506.01524.tldr: A Verbal Variational Auto-Encoding (V-VAE) framework, containing a variational auto-encoding module and fine-grained control space which dynamically adapts dialogue behaviour based on fine-grained, interpretable latent variables across talking style, interaction patterns, and personal attributes is proposed.

2506.01625.tldr: This work proposes two novel algorithms based on distinct formulations of robust satisficing, and shows that they are instances of a general robust satisficing framework, and derives two regret bounds: one that is sublinear over time, assuming certain conditions on the adversary and the satisficing threshold $\tau$, and another that scales with the perturbation magnitude but requires no assumptions on the adversary.

2506.08001.tldr: POET is a novel reParameterized training algorithm that uses Orthogonal Equivalence Transformation to optimize neurons and reparameterizes each neuron with two learnable orthogonal matrices and a fixed random weight matrix to stably optimize the objective function.

2506.11375.tldr: This work proposes ChemTable-a large scale benchmark of chemical tables constructed from real-world literature, containing expert-annotated cell layouts, logical structures, and domain-specific labels, and provides a realistic testing platform for evaluating scientific multimodal understanding.

2506.13018.tldr: This survey provides an overview of parameter space symmetry, summarize existing literature, uncover connections between symmetry and learning theory, and identify gaps and opportunities in this emerging field.

2506.14933.tldr: It is necessary to implement automated detection tools related to policies to address the growing criminality in the cryptocurrency realm.

2506.18156.tldr: Findings reveal that large language models often produce coherent narratives, show susceptibility to positive framing, exhibit moral judgments aligned with Liberty/Oppression concerns, and demonstrate self-contradictions tempered by extensive rationalization.

2507.12820.tldr: This paper presents the solution for the NLPCC 2025 Task 8 ESC evaluation, where large-scale language models enhanced by prompt engineering and finetuning techniques are leveraged to improve the model's ability to generate supportive and contextually appropriate responses.

2507.13162.tldr: This work develops a model using simple design choices, and without additional supervision or sensors, such as maps, depth, or multiple cameras, which yields state-of-the-art performance, despite having only 469M parameters and being trained on 280h of video data.

2508.03663.tldr: The trade-off between the number of items and the number of responses per item needed for reliable machine learning evaluation is investigated and can be used to help ML practitioners get more effective test data by finding the optimal metrics and number of items and annotations per item to collect to get the most reliability for their budget.

2508.03772.tldr: GTPO (Group-relative Trajectory-based Policy Optimization), which prevents conflicting gradients on valuable tokens by skipping negative updates while amplifying positive ones and filters out completions whose entropy exceeds a provable threshold, to prevent policy collapse.

2508.08139.tldr: This work investigates how in-context information influences model behavior and whether LLMs can identify their unreliable responses, and proposes a reliability estimation that leverages token-level uncertainty to guide the aggregation of internal model representations.

2508.15432.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive synthetic data generation framework that facilitates scalable, configurable, and high-fidelity generation of synthetic data tailored for these training paradigms, significantly reducing the overhead of data preparation in LLM training pipelines.

2509.08157.tldr: This work introduces a framework for Risk-Bounded Multi-Agent Path Finding, where agents share a user-specified global risk budget and investigates two distribution strategies: a greedy surplus-deficit scheme for rapid feasibility repair, and a market-inspired mechanism that treats risk as a priced resource to guide improved allocation.

2509.17158.tldr: This work introduces Meta Agents Research Environments (ARE), a research platform for scalable creation of environments, integration of synthetic or real applications, and execution of agentic orchestrations and proposes Gaia2, a benchmark built in ARE and designed to measure general agent capabilities.

2509.17552.tldr: In-Context Representation Learning (ICRL) is the first training-free framework for integrating non-text modality representations into text-based LLMs, presenting a promising direction for adaptable, multi-modal generalization.

2509.26631.tldr: This work introduces the first SIM(3)-equivariant shape completion network, whose modular layers successively canonicalize features, reason over similarity-invariant geometry, and restore the original frame, establishing full SIM(3) equivariance as an effective route to truly generalizable shape completion.

2510.04522.tldr: GeoMancer is proposed: a novel Riemannian graph diffusion framework for both generation and prediction tasks that replaces exponential mapping with an isometric-invariant Riemannian gyrokernel approach and decouple multi-level features onto their respective task-specific manifolds to learn optimal representations.

2510.15952.tldr: This paper introduces the Structured Cognitive Loop (SCL) as an executable epistemological framework for emergent intelligence, arguing that real progress requires not larger models but architectures that realize cognitive principles structurally.

2510.16069.tldr: Investigation of the reliability and perceived accuracy of AI-assisted assessment vis-à-vis TA-assisted assessment in evaluating student posters in design thinking education showed low statistical agreement between instructor and AI scores for empathy and pain points, though slightly higher alignment for visual communication.

2510.19195.tldr: This work introduces Dream4Drive, a novel synthetic data generation framework designed for enhancing the downstream perception tasks, and conducts comprehensive experiments to show that Dream4Drive can effectively boost the performance of downstream perception models under various training epochs.

2510.20875.tldr: CC-GRMAS, a framework leveraging a series of satellite observations and environmental signals to enhance the accuracy of landslide forecasting, is introduced, which offers a scalable and proactive solution for climate resilient disaster preparedness across vulnerable mountainous terrains.

2510.23972.tldr: This work proposes an all-transistor probabilistic computer that implements powerful denoising models at the hardware level and indicates that devices based on this architecture could achieve performance parity with GPUs on a simple image benchmark using approximately 10,000 times less energy.

2511.00090.tldr: LeMiCa is presented, a training-free and efficient acceleration framework for diffusion-based video generation that achieves a 2.9x speedup on the Latte model and reaches an LPIPS score of 0.05 on Open-Sora, outperforming prior caching techniques.

2511.06696.tldr: Magnitude-Modulated Equivariant Adapter (MMEA), a novel equivariant fine-tuning method which employs lightweight scalar gating to modulate feature magnitudes on a per-order and per-multiplicity basis, suggests that, in many practical scenarios, modulating channel magnitudes is sufficient to adapt equivariant models to new chemical environments without breaking symmetry.

2511.14566.tldr: This work investigates techniques to identify the best possible alignment and evaluation method between claim sets, with the aim of providing a reliable evaluation framework for model-extracted and human-annotated claim sets.

2511.16203.tldr: This paper introduces VLA-Fool, a comprehensive study of multimodal adversarial robustness in embodied VLA models under both white-box and black-box settings, and incorporates a VLA-aware semantic space into linguistic prompts, developing the first automatically crafted and semantically guided prompting framework.

2511.18271.tldr: PicWorld is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark that assesses the grasp of implicit world knowledge and physical causal reasoning of T2I models, and PW-Agent, an evidence-grounded multi-agent evaluator to hierarchically assess images on their physical realism and logical consistency by decomposing prompts into verifiable visual evidence.

2511.18735.tldr: This work introduces FSU-QA, a new Visual Question-Answering dataset specifically designed to elicit and evaluate Foresight Intelligence, and positions FSU-QA as a principled foundation for developing next-generation models capable of truly anticipating and understanding future events.

2511.19575.tldr: HuyuanOCR demonstrates superior performance, outperforming commercial APIs, traditional pipelines, and larger models (e.g., Qwen3-VL-4B), and confirms the critical role of high-quality data and demonstrates that Reinforcement Learning strategies yield significant performance gains in OCR tasks.

2511.20586.tldr: The Parallel Trust Assessment System (PaTAS), a framework for modeling and propagating trust in neural networks using Subjective Logic (SL), provides a foundation for evaluating model reliability across the AI lifecycle.

2511.21838.tldr: The approach cannot eliminate deep ambiguity, but it offers a systematic approach to reason about extreme, low-probability events in frontier AI, tempering complacency and overreaction.

2512.03040.tldr: Video4Spatial is presented, a framework showing that video diffusion models conditioned solely on video-based scene context can perform complex spatial tasks, and results advance video generative models toward general visuospatial reasoning.

2512.03454.tldr: ThinkDeeper, a framework that reasons about future spatial states before making grounding decisions, and shows strong robustness and efficiency in challenging scenes (long-text, multi-agent, ambiguity) and retains superior performance even when trained on 50% of the data.

2512.04629.tldr: This work introduces BioMedGPT-Mol, a molecular language model designed to support molecular understanding and generation tasks, and curates and unifying existing public instruction datasets to assemble a large-scale, comprehensive, and high-quality training dataset.

2512.06392.tldr: Large-scale evaluations show that RLAX improves QwQ-32B's pass@8 accuracy by 12.8% in just 12 hours 48 minutes on 1024 v5p TPUs, while remaining robust to preemptions during training.

2512.07019.tldr: The application of LaRT reveals a strong negative correlation between the latent ability and latent speed in all benchmarks, with stronger correlation for more difficult benchmarks, which supports the intuition that higher reasoning ability correlates with slower speed and longer response latency.

2512.07702.tldr: Negative Prompting for Image Correction (NPC) is introduced, an automated pipeline that improves alignment by identifying and applying negative prompts that suppress unintended content in diffusion models.

2512.07730.tldr: SAVE (Sparse Autoencoder-Driven Visual Information Enhancement), a framework that mitigates hallucination by steering the model along Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latent features, confirms the robustness and generalizability of the approach.

2512.08609.tldr: CogMCTS tightly integrates the cognitive guidance mechanism of LLMs with MCTS to achieve efficient automated heuristic optimization and outperforms existing LLM-based AHD methods in stability, efficiency, and solution quality.

2512.08868.tldr: EcomBench is a holistic E-commerce Benchmark designed to evaluate agent performance in realistic e-commerce environments and covers multiple task categories within e-commerce scenarios and defines three difficulty levels that evaluate agents on key capabilities such as deep information retrieval, multi-step reasoning, and cross-source knowledge integration.

2512.09111.tldr: This paper introduces SAGES (Semantic Autonomous Guidance Engine for Space), a trajectory-generation framework that translates natural-language commands into spacecraft trajectories that reflect high-level intent while respecting nonconvex constraints.

2512.09443.tldr: A human-in-the-loop workflow for interactive theorem proving and discovery with LLMs is proposed, providing a practical template for integrating large language models into frontier mathematical research, enabling faster exploration of proof space and algorithm design while maintaining transparent reasoning responsibilities.

2512.09543.tldr: Current agentic frameworks, designed for powerful LLMs, fail to operate efficiently with SLMs, and viable low-energy solutions require shifting from passive orchestration to architectures that actively manage SLM weaknesses.

2512.09874.tldr: A robust two-stage matching pipeline combining LLM-based extraction with fuzzy validation reliably aligns parsed formulas with ground truth despite format inconsistencies across parsers, providing actionable guidance for practitioners selecting parsers for downstream applications.

2512.09931.tldr: ExaCraft is an AI system that generates personalized examples by adapting to the learner's dynamic context, combining user-defined profiles with real-time analysis of learner behavior to ensure examples are both culturally relevant and tailored to individual learning needs.

2512.09932.tldr: The prototype, Suzume-chan, is a small, soft AI agent running locally with a language model and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that learns from spoken explanations and responds through dialogue, reducing psychological distance and making knowledge sharing warmer and more human-centered.

2512.09934.tldr: IoTEdu, an integrated platform that combines access control, incident detection, and automatic blocking of IoT devices, is presented, showing a reduction in manual intervention, standardization of responses, and unification of the processes of registration, monitoring, and incident response.

2512.09935.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the two-stage approach achieves superior performance compared to baseline methods, highlighting the value of combining automated scoring with collaborative reasoning for complex verification tasks.

2512.09939.tldr: Using LLM-based agents with tool access and typed message protocols, it is shown that regulated, simulator-driven decision environments are most naturally modelled as norm-governed, simulator-coupled multi-agent systems.

2512.09946.tldr: A simple profiling tool, ELANA, designed as a lightweight, academic-friendly profiler for analyzing model size, key-value cache size, prefilling latency, generation latency, and end-to-end latency of LLMs on both multi-GPU and edge GPU platforms is released.

2512.09953.tldr: This work introduces ZK APEX, a zero-shot personalized unlearning method that operates directly on the personalized model without retraining, and shows the first practical framework for verifiable personalized unlearning on edge devices.

2512.09976.tldr: A new fuzzy optimization framework that extends FCM causality is proposed and the main objectives and the orientation of this framework is expounded and exemplified; this framework is meant for service optimization of information transmission in service process design.

2512.10031.tldr: Adaptive bounding box scaling and symmetry-prior-based orientation prediction are introduced, called ABBSPO, that is a framework for WS-OOD that achieves state-of-the-art results, outperforming existing methods.

2512.10034.tldr: DynaMate is presented, a modular multi-agent framework that autonomously designs and executes complete MD workflows for both protein and protein-ligand systems, and offers free energy binding affinity calculations with the MM/PB(GB)SA method.

2512.10040.tldr: Four new weighting strategies are introduced: two offline methods that leverage held-out validation signal; one online method that uses a sliding-window estimator to reduce overfitting; one online method that treats reference weighting as a $K$-armed bandit via Thompson Sampling; and an online method that treats reference weighting as a $K$-armed bandit via Thompson Sampling.

2512.10047.tldr: This work is an attempt to establish a macroscopic dynamics theory of complex AI systems, aiming to elevate the study of AI agents from a collection of engineering practices to a science built on effective measurements that are predictable and quantifiable.

2512.10051.tldr: DB2-TransF is introduced, a novel Transformer-inspired architecture that replaces the self-attention mechanism with a learnable Daubechies wavelet coefficient layer that efficiently captures multi-scale local and global patterns and enhances the modeling of correlations across multiple time series for the time series forecasting task.

2512.10054.tldr: The Parallel Decoder Transformer is presented, a frozen-trunk architecture that augments a decoder with a planner-seeded latent workspace and a synchronized multi-stream output protocol that shifts parallel task decomposition from an external prompting strategy to a model-internal coordination mechanism over the output interface of a frozen language model.

2512.10058.tldr: It is argued that integrating technical safety work with normative ethics--via shared benchmarks, cross-institutional venues, and mixed-method methodologies--is essential for building AI systems that are both robust and just.

2512.10065.tldr: It is shown that LLMs develop linear representations of user demographics within activation space, wherein stereotypically associated attributes are encoded along interpretable geometric directions, which allow us to explain demographic inferences implicitly formed by LLMs during conversation.

2512.10066.tldr: A novel classification framework is developed by re-purposing AlphaFold2 to generate conformational ensembles via a multiple sequence alignment sampling method that provides a powerful new approach for discovering metamorphic proteins and deepens the understanding of their role in their molecular function.

2512.10081.tldr: This work positions LA as a rigorous science of state transition systems based on observability, establishing the theoretical foundation necessary for the field's maturation as a scholarly discipline.

2512.10092.tldr: This work proposes using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to create SAE embeddings: representations whose dimensions map to interpretable concepts whose dimensions map to interpretable concepts that are more cost-effective and reliable than LLMs and more controllable than dense embeddings.

2512.10100.tldr: Information-theoretic limitations for robustness of AI security and alignment are established by extending Godel's incompleteness theorem to AI and broader implications for cognitive reasoning limitations of AI systems are proven.

2512.10114.tldr: AgriRegion, a Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework designed specifically for high-fidelity, region-aware agricultural advisory, is introduced and demonstrated that AgriRegion reduces hallucinations by 10-20% compared to state-of-the-art LLMs systems and significantly improves trust scores according to a comprehensive evaluation.

2512.10117.tldr: This work proposes CHyLL (Continuous Hybrid System Learning in Latent Space), which learns a continuous neural representation of a hybrid system without trajectory segmentation, event functions, or mode switching, and applies it to the stochastic optimal control problem.

2512.10120.tldr: VocSim, a training-free benchmark probing the intrinsic geometric alignment of frozen embeddings, and top embeddings predict avian perceptual similarity, improve bioacoustic classification, and achieve state-of-the-art results on the HEAR benchmark are introduced.

2512.10121.tldr: The DeepNews Framework is proposed, an agentic workflow that explicitly models the implicit cognitive processes of seasoned financial journalists that is significantly outperforming the 0% acceptance rate of zero-shot generation by a state-of-the-art (SOTA) model (GPT-5).

2512.10132.tldr: The construction replaces backward dynamic programs by forward-only recomputation and organizes the time order into a height-compressed recursion tree whose nodes expose small"middle frontiers''across which every optimal path must pass, supporting the view that space-efficient traceback is a structural property of width-bounded DP DAGs rather than a peculiarity of grid-based algorithms.

2512.10148.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage prompting framework that infers both explicit and implicit personas directly from short review texts, highlighting the effectiveness of persona-augmented prompting in enhancing the relevance and personalization of automated responses without requiring model fine-tuning.

2512.10150.tldr: This paper considers the fine-tuning-as-a-service setup where the user uploads their data to a service provider to get a customized model that excels on the user's selected task.

2512.10159.tldr: This paper presents an enhanced end-to-end circuit problem-solving framework built upon Gemini, and demonstrates the robustness, scalability, and practical applicability of the proposed framework for engineering education and real-world circuit analysis tasks.

2512.10169.tldr: The current state of transparency for foundation model developers is revealed, how it may change given newly enacted policy, and where more aggressive policy interventions are necessary to address critical information deficits are revealed.

2512.10172.tldr: Offscript, an automated auditing tool that efficiently identifies potential instruction following failures in LLMs, is presented, suggesting that automated auditing serves as a viable approach for evaluating compliance to behavioral instructions related to information seeking.

2512.10208.tldr: A generalisation approach based on multi-objective reinforcement learning approach is proposed with certain stages completed and phases outstanding that is aimed to help demonstrate the efficiency of using multi-objective reinforcement learning.

2512.10211.tldr: This work extends the current Predict-and-Search (PAS) framework to parametric general parametric MIPs and introduces ID-PAS+, an identity-aware learning framework that enables the ML model to handle heterogeneous variable types more effectively.

2512.10224.tldr: This work proposes an important weight aggregation strategy to prioritize parameters that significantly influence predictions of local models during aggregation, and enforce (domain) invariance across local models with the help of a novel technique, latent space inversion, which enables better client privacy.

2512.10234.tldr: InFerActive enables on-demand exploration through probability-based filtering and evaluation features, while bridging the semantic gap between computational tokens and human-readable text through adaptive visualization techniques.

2512.10248.tldr: RobustSora is presented, the benchmark designed to assess watermark robustness in AIGC video detection, and findings indicate partial watermark dependency and highlight the need for watermark-aware training strategies.

2512.10271.tldr: RLTune is presented, an application-agnostic reinforcement learning (RL)-based scheduling framework that dynamically prioritizes and allocates DL jobs on heterogeneous GPU clusters to optimize system-wide objectives such as job completion time (JCT), queueing delay, and resource utilization.

2512.10273.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that guides LLMs through reverse thinking to identify necessary conditions and pinpoint missing elements, providing a promising direction for enhancing LLMs' logical completeness and reasoning robustness.

2512.10280.tldr: This paper presents a Graph Neural Network Based Adaptive Threat Detection framework designed to learn latent user resource interaction patterns from IAM audit trails in real time, and achieves higher detection precision and recall than baseline LSTM and GCN classifiers, while maintaining scalability across multi tenant cloud environments.

2512.10296.tldr: This paper proposes a novel side-channel fingerprinting attack, leveraging flow-level and packet-level statistics of encrypted wireless traffic from an FL client to infer its deep learning model architecture, exposing a critical side-channel vulnerability in current FL systems.

2512.10300.tldr: A novel interpretability framework is proposed to systematically analyze the internal mechanisms of VLMs, focusing on the functional roles of attention heads in multimodal reasoning, and introduces CogVision, a dataset that decomposes complex multimodal questions into step-by-step subquestions designed to simulate human reasoning through a chain-of-thought paradigm.

2512.10304.tldr: The Ten Criteria for Trustworthy Orchestration AI are presented, a comprehensive assurance framework that integrates human input, semantic coherence, audit and provenance integrity into a unified Control-Panel architecture.

2512.10305.tldr: Comprehensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that InfoCom achieves near-lossless perception while reducing communication overhead from megabyte to kilobyte-scale, representing 440-fold and 90-fold reductions per agent compared to Where2comm and ERMVP, respectively.

2512.10336.tldr: The results reveal that dataset translation remains a major bottleneck in multilingual VLM performance, with data quality limiting the effectiveness of training and evaluation, and suggest that future efforts should focus on native-language dataset collection and improved translation strategies.

2512.10339.tldr: This work derives a simple path existence criterion that predicts exactly when collapse occurs from noise schedules and exponents alone and introduces Adaptive path Correction with Exponents (ACE), which extends Feynman-Kac steering to time-varying exponents and guarantees a valid probability path.

2512.10348.tldr: REMISVFU is proposed, a plug-and-play representation misdirection framework that enables fast, client-level unlearning in splitVFL systems and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on public benchmarks.

2512.10362.tldr: Through extensive experiments, it is demonstrated that Visual Funnel significantly outperforms naive single-crop and unstructured multi-crop baselines and further validate that simply adding more unstructured crops provides limited or even detrimental benefits, confirming that the hierarchical structure of the portfolio is key to resolving Contextual Blindness.

2512.10365.tldr: The Generalized Policy Gradient (GPG) Theorem is presented, specifically designed for Transformer-based policies, and its practical applications in training Large Language Models (LLMs), offering new insights into efficient policy optimization.

2512.10370.tldr: EmerFlow is a novel LLM-empowered representation learning framework that generates distinctive embeddings for emerging items that first enriches the raw features of emerging items through LLM reasoning, then aligns these representations with the embedding space of the existing recommendation model.

2512.10371.tldr: This work proposes AgentProg, a program-guided approach for agent context management that reframes the interaction history as a program with variables and control flow, and integrates a global belief state mechanism inspired by Belief MDP framework to handle partial observability and adapt to unexpected environmental changes.

2512.10372.tldr: Prot, a decentralized data marketplace that unifies federated learning, blockchain arbitration, and economic incentives into a single framework for privacy-preserving data sharing, is presented, which ensures privacy, maintains robustness under adversarial conditions, and scales efficiently with the number of participants.

2512.10375.tldr: A 3D convolutional neural network designed for PSZ reproduction with flexible control microphone grid and alternative reproduction target is presented, utilizing the virtual target scene as inputs and the PSZ pre-filters as output.

2512.10384.tldr: The Fine-grained Recognition Open World (FROW) benchmark is introduced, designed for detailed evaluation of LVLMs with GPT-4o, and a novel optimization strategy from two perspectives is proposed, to improve the performance of LVLMs.

2512.10388.tldr: A dual-branch modeling architecture is devised that enables the model to capture both the multi-granular semantics within SID while preserving the unique collaborative identity of HID, and a dual-level alignment strategy is introduced that bridges the two representations, facilitating knowledge transfer and supporting robust preference modeling.

2512.10433.tldr: This work introduces TAFAP (Trajectory Alignment via Fine-tuning with Adversarial Perturbations), the first method to successfully achieve effective TDP by controlling the entire training trajectory, and provides a new framework for controlling and tracing alterations in diffusion model outputs.

2512.10437.tldr: An efficient algorithmic framework for real-time identification, classification, and evaluation of human physiotherapy exercises using mobile devices that interprets a kinetic movement as a sequence of static poses, which are estimated from camera input using a pose-estimation neural network.

2512.10443.tldr: CFLHKD, a novel personalization scheme for integrating hierarchical cluster knowledge into CFL, built upon multi-teacher knowledge distillation, enables inter-cluster knowledge sharing while preserving cluster-specific personalization and adopts a bi-level aggregation to bridge the gap between local and global learning.

2512.10461.tldr: The T-SKM-Net framework systematically integrates SKM-type methods into neural network constraint satisfaction, and provides theoretical proof of post-processing effectiveness in expectation and end-to-end trainability guarantees based on unbiased gradient estimators, demonstrating that despite non-differentiable operations, the framework supports standard backpropagation.

2512.10551.tldr: This work proposes LLM-Auction, which to the best of its knowledge is the first learning-based generative auction mechanism that integrates auction and LLM generation for LLM-native advertising and introduces Iterative Reward-Preference Optimization (IRPO) algorithm that alternately optimizes the reward model and the LLM.

2512.10596.tldr: This work introduces the Remote Sensing Rich Text (RSRT) dataset, a new benchmark featuring multiple structured captions per image, and proposes a fully training-free, text-only retrieval reference called TRSLLaVA, which reformulates cross-modal retrieval as a text-to-text (T2T) matching problem, leveraging rich text descriptions as queries against a database of VLM-generated captions within a unified textual embedding space.

2512.10640.tldr: A Refinement Contrastive Learning framework that explicitly incorporates cell-gene interactions to derive more informative representations and develops a refinement module that integrates gene-correlation structure learning to enhance cell embeddings by capturing underlying cell-gene associations.

2512.10655.tldr: CAPTAIN is introduced, a training-free framework that mitigates memorization by directly modifying latent features during denoising by applies frequency-based noise initialization and injects semantically aligned features from non-memorized reference images into localized latent regions, suppressing memorization while preserving prompt fidelity and visual quality.

2512.10665.tldr: This work constructed multi-agent simulations where communities with varying numbers of agents engaged in open-ended interactions and constitution formation show that value diversity enhances value stability, fosters emergent behaviors, and brings more creative principles developed by the agents themselves without external guidance.

2512.10671.tldr: This proposed framework, which considers varying depths and layers for exit branches along with adaptive threshold tuning, designs early-exit networks that achieve higher accuracy with the same or lower average number of MACs compared to the state-of-the-art approaches.

2512.10687.tldr: It is established that effective user-welfare safety evaluation requires evaluators to assess responses against diverse user profiles, as realistic user context disclosure alone proves insufficient, particularly for vulnerable populations.

2512.10691.tldr: Under a unified evaluation pipeline, the RL-optimized RadVLM models outperform their baseline counterparts and reach state-of-the-art performance on both report generation and grounding, highlighting clinically aligned RL as a powerful complement to SFT for medical VLMs.

2512.10696.tldr: A significant memory-scaling effect is observed: Qwen3-8B equipped with ReMe outperforms larger, memoryless Qwen3-14B, suggesting that self-evolving memory provides a computation-efficient pathway for lifelong learning.

2512.10698.tldr: This work investigates how Deep Reinforcement Learning with vehicle-to-vehicle communication can be used to ethically select an emergency breaking profile in scenarios where overall, or collective, three-vehicle harm reduction or collision avoidance shall be obtained instead of single-vehicle such.

2512.10702.tldr: The CA-GPT-based AI-OCT system achieved superior decision-making agreement versus a general-purpose large language model and junior physicians across both PCI planning and assessment phases, demonstrating significant potential to augment operator expertise and optimize OCT-guided PCI.

2512.10735.tldr: A novel Line Graph Aggregation Network (LGAN) is proposed, that constructs a line graph from the induced subgraph centered at each node to perform the higher-order aggregation and theoretically proves that the LGAN not only possesses the greater expressive power than the 2-WL under injective aggregation assumptions, but also has lower time complexity.

2512.10766.tldr: An underexplored vulnerability of T2I models to metaphor-based jailbreak attacks (MJA), which aims to attack diverse defense mechanisms without prior knowledge of their type by generating metaphor-based adversarial prompts is revealed.

2512.10772.tldr: This work investigates scaling as an efficient strategy for adapting pretrained models to new target languages and finds that, once exposed to sufficient target-language data, larger upscaled models can match or surpass the performance of smaller models continually pretrained on much more data, demonstrating the benefits of scaling for data efficiency.

2512.10785.tldr: This study presents the design of an LLM-based feedback system for physics problem solving grounded in evidence-centered design (ECD) and evaluates its performance within the German Physics Olympiad and discusses the risks associated with uncritical reliance on LLM-based feedback.

2512.10789.tldr: The architecture, implementation, and test methodology on synthetic network context datasets are described and it is discussed how this approach can evolve into a scalable auditable and human centered workflow for firewall policy management.

2512.10791.tldr: An online leaderboard suite and associated set of benchmarks that comprehensively evaluates the ability of language models to generate factually accurate text across diverse scenarios, designed to provide a robust and balanced assessment of a model's overall factuality.

2512.10793.tldr: LabelFusion is a fusion ensemble for text classification that learns to combine a traditional transformer-based classifier with one or more Large Language Models to deliver accurate and cost-aware predictions across multi-class and multi-label tasks.

2512.10794.tldr: Surprisingly, the simple method, termed iREPA, consistently improves convergence speed of REPA, across a diverse set of vision encoders, model sizes, and training variants (such as REPA, REPA-E, Meanflow, JiT etc).

2512.10817.tldr: It is reported that binary encoding allows neural networks to extrapolate periodic functions beyond their training bounds and internal activation analysis reveals that NB2E induces bit-phase representations, enabling MLPs to learn and extrapolate signal structure independently of position.

2512.10821.tldr: It is found that Agile Deliberation achieves 7.5% higher F1 scores than automated decomposition baselines and more than 3% higher than manual deliberation, while participants reported clearer conceptual understanding and lower cognitive effort.

2512.10857.tldr: This work iteratively update a transport map between corrupted and clean data samples using only access to the corrupted dataset as well as black box access to the corruption channel, resulting in a self-consistent stochastic interpolant (SCSI), which is computationally efficient compared to variational alternatives.

2512.10863.tldr: MMSI-Video-Bench is introduced, a fully human-annotated benchmark for video-based spatial intelligence in MLLMs, revealing a striking human--AI gap: many models perform near chance, and the best reasoning model lags humans by nearly 60%.

2512.10866.tldr: Results show that linear baselines (Linear, NLinear, DLinear) consistently outperform more complex Transformer-family architectures, with DLinear achieving the best overall accuracy across all splits.

2512.10895.tldr: It is shown that the LLM rankings correlate strongly with the human rankings, and that LLM performance is no worse than that of human reviewers in identifying proposals with high publication potential, while costing over two orders of magnitude less.

2512.10903.tldr: This work proposes a node-level pruning framework for circuit discovery that addresses both scalability and granularity limitations, and introduces learnable masks across multiple levels of granularity, from entire blocks to individual neurons, within a unified optimization objective.

2512.10932.tldr: This work introduces BabyVLM-V2, a developmentally grounded framework for infant-inspired vision-language modeling that extensively improves upon BabyVLM-V1 through a longitudinal, multifaceted pretraining set, a versatile model, and, most importantly, DevCV Toolbox for cognitive evaluation.

2512.10935.tldr: Any4D directly generates per-pixel motion and geometry predictions for N frames, in contrast to prior work that typically focuses on either 2-view dense scene flow or sparse 3D point tracking, and achieves superior performance across diverse setups.

2512.10936.tldr: This work suggests utilizing advanced projection-free methods, known as modified Frank-Wolfe methods, to construct white-box adversarial attacks on the given input data to estimate the adversarial robustness of a neural network.

2512.10938.tldr: Its simplicity and stronger performance make Derf a practical choice for normalization-free Transformer architectures, and it is suggested that the performance gains of Derf largely stem from its improved generalization rather than stronger fitting capacity.
