2512.10941.tldr: Mull-Tokens -- modality-agnostic latent tokens pre-trained to hold intermediate information in either image or text modalities to let the model think free-form towards the correct answer, demonstrates that Mull-Tokens improve upon several baselines utilizing text-only reasoning or interleaved image-text reasoning.

2512.10943.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that AlcheMinT achieves visual quality matching state-of-the-art video personalization methods, while, for the first time, enabling precise temporal control over multi-subject generation within videos.

2512.10946.tldr: This work proposes ImplicitRDP, a unified end-to-end visual-force diffusion policy that integrates visual planning and reactive force control within a single network, and introduces Structural Slow-Fast Learning, a mechanism utilizing causal attention to simultaneously process asynchronous visual and force tokens.

2512.10949.tldr: This study conducts the first systematic study of RL for text-to-3D autoregressive generation across several dimensions, and develops AR3D-R1, the first RL-enhanced text-to-3D model, expert from coarse shape to texture refinement.

2512.10957.tldr: This work decouple the de-occlusion model from 3D object generation, and enhance it by leveraging image datasets and collected de-occlusion datasets for much more diverse open-set occlusion patterns.

2512.10098.tldr: This work introduces MedXAI (An Explainable Framework for Medical Imaging Classification), a unified expert knowledge based framework that integrates deep vision models with clinician-derived expert knowledge to improve generalization, reduce rare-class bias, and provide human-understandable explanations.

2512.10341.tldr: This work introduces a cloud-native privacy-preserving architecture that integrates federated learning, differential privacy, zero-knowledge compliance proofs, and adaptive governance powered by reinforcement learning that supports secure model training and inference without centralizing sensitive data, while enabling cryptographically verifiable policy enforcement across institutions and cloud platforms.

2512.10414.tldr: This paper proposes Selective-adversarial Entropy Intervention, namely SaEI, which enhances policy entropy by distorting the visual input with the token-selective adversarial objective coming from the entropy of sampled responses, thereby improving policy performance.

1207.5293.tldr: The Probability Bracket Notation is extended to BNs with continuous variables and a customized Healthcare BN is introduced that includes both continuous and discrete random variables, utilizes user-specific data, and provides tailored predictions via discrete-display nodes that proxy for their continuous-variable parents.

2301.00866.tldr: A novel grasping strategy is proposed, named 3DSGrasp, that predicts the missing geometry from the partial PCD to produce reliable grasp poses and outperforms the best state-of-the-art method on PCD completion tasks and largely improves the grasping success rate in real-world scenarios.

2312.04180.tldr: Heterogeneous analyses reveal that U.S. web developers tend to benefit more from ChatGPT's launch compared to their counterparts in other regions, and experienced translators seem more likely to exit the market than less experienced translators.

2402.03216.tldr: A novel self-knowledge distillation approach, where the relevance scores from different retrieval functionalities can be integrated as the teacher signal to enhance the training quality and improve the discriminativeness of embeddings.

2405.21047.tldr: This paper proposes adaptive sampling with approximate expected futures (ASAp), a decoding algorithm that guarantees the output to be grammatical while provably producing outputs that match the conditional probability of the LLM's distribution conditioned on the given grammar constraint.

2407.00900.tldr: This work shows the first analysis of how mathematical reasoning abilities of several open-weight LLMs develop during pre-training and post-training, and constructs MathCAMPS, a synthetic dataset of novel mathematical reasoning problems grounded in 44 fine-grained skills taken from the Common Core curriculum.

2407.21202.tldr: A new mapping is introduced, which justifies the human heuristics to AI biases reflections and it is envisioned that this approach will contribute in revisiting AI fairness under deeper human-centric case studies, revealing hidden biases cause and effects.

2409.13115.tldr: This work introduces MarbliX (Multimodal Association and Retrieval with Binary Latent Indexed matriX), a self-supervised framework that learns to embed WSIs and immunogenomic profiles into compact, scalable binary codes, termed “monogram.”

2409.15371.tldr: This work revisits the causes of LoRA's slow convergence, and proposes Matrix Shard Sharing (MiSS), which updates shards of the original weight matrix using a single shared trainable matrix $\boldsymbol{D}$, initialized to zeros.

2410.10868.tldr: This paper proposes a stable-plasticity balanced coefficient to avoid knowledge interference in continual instruction tuning, and finds the optimal balance weight can be automatically determined by the gradients and learned parameters.

2410.14040.tldr: WARPD (World model Assisted Reactive Policy Diffusion), a method that generates closed-loop policies (weights for neural policies) directly, instead of open-loop trajectories, offers two major advantages: (1) extended action horizons with robustness to perturbations, while maintaining high task performance, and (2) significantly reduced inference costs.

2501.05928.tldr: Surprisingly, it is revealed that backdoor attacks designed to be stealthy in input and feature spaces can be mitigated by examining backdoored models in parameter space, and a novel supply-chain attack called Grond is proposed, which outperforms all 12 backdoor attacks against state-of-the-art defenses on CIFAR-10, GTSRB, and a subset of ImageNet.

2501.06382.tldr: This work defines spontaneous topic changes in self-attention architectures, revealing both their similarities and their divergences from spontaneous human thought, and empirically validate that these dynamics persist in modern, state-of-the-art LLMs.

2501.09761.tldr: A joint measurement-recovery framework for AI-native transceivers post deployment, called VERITAS, that continuously looks for distribution shifts in the received signals and triggers finite re-training spurts, and VERTIAS compares the bit probabilities of the AI-native and the reference receivers for the same received data inputs, and decides whether or not a retraining process needs to be initiated.

2502.06490.tldr: This survey systematically synthesizes the existing taxonomy and recent innovations in discrete speech tokenization, conducts a critical examination of the strengths and limitations of each paradigm, and presents systematic experimental comparisons across token types.

2502.10712.tldr: This work introduces FuncGenFoil, a novel function-space generative model that directly reconstructs airfoil geometries as function curves, offering a powerful and flexible framework for high-fidelity airfoil design.

2502.11028.tldr: A comprehensive analysis on calibration in LLMs is presented across nine LLMs and three factual Question-Answering datasets, systematically comparing standard free-generation settings against structured distractor-augmented prompts to identify persistent calibration failures.

2502.12088.tldr: This work introduces meta-statistical learning, an amortized learning framework that recasts estimator design as an optimization problem via supervised learning that opens a path to automate the discovery of generalizable and flexible statistical estimators.

2502.18581.tldr: This work proposes self-certainty, a novel and efficient metric that leverages the inherent probability distribution of LLM outputs to estimate response quality without requiring external reward models and establishes self-certainty as a practical and efficient way for improving LLM reasoning capabilities.

2503.01220.tldr: Tera-MIND offers an efficient generative modeling of whole virtual organisms, paving the way for integrative applications in biomedical research.

2503.05860.tldr: To improve benchmarking standards, the proposed BenchFrame, a unified approach to improve benchmark quality is proposed, which features corrected errors, improved language conversion, higher test coverage, and greater difficulty in HumanEvalNext.

2503.07020.tldr: Extensive experiments in adverse driving conditions with the CARLA simulator demonstrate that LLM-RCO promotes proactive maneuvers over purely risk-averse actions in perception deficit scenarios, underscoring its value for boosting autonomous driving resilience against perception loss challenges.

2503.09348.tldr: MOAT is the first benchmark to explicitly evaluate LMMs'ability to ground complex text and visual instructions, which is essential for many real-world applications, and is the first benchmark to explicitly evaluate VL capabilities of large multimodal models.

2503.14572.tldr: This work proposes the general \texttt{IMPRINT} framework, identifying three main components: generation, normalization, and aggregation, and proposes a novel variant of imprinting which outperforms previous work on transfer learning tasks by 4\%.

2503.24379.tldr: This work presents Any2Caption, a novel framework for controllable video generation under any condition that interprets diverse inputs into dense, structured captions that offer backbone video generators with better guidance.

2504.21228.tldr: CachePrune is proposed, a defense method that identifies and prunes task-triggering neurons from the KV cache of the input prompt context and enhances the efficacy of neural attribution by leveraging an observed triggering effect inherent in the model's response generation behavior.

2505.13572.tldr: Q2Forge is open source, generic, extensible and modular, meaning that the different modules of the application can be used separately, as an integrated pipeline, or replaced by alternative services, supporting the creation of reference question-query sets for any target KG.

2505.16368.tldr: Saturn, a SAT-based RL framework that uses Boolean Satisfiability (SAT) problems to train and evaluate LLMs reasoning and enables scalable task construction, rule-based verification, and precise difficulty control is proposed.

2506.00731.tldr: An iterative multi-objective PINN ensemble Kalman filter (iPINNER) framework that improves the robustness and accuracy of PINNs in both forward and inverse problems by using the ensemble Kalman filter and the NSGA-III and the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-III).

2506.01004.tldr: Results establish that structured manipulation of diffusion noise trajectories enables controllable and high-quality video editing under semantic shifts and achieves superior semantic mixing and temporal coherence without retraining.

2506.14855.tldr: Feedback-MPPI (F-MPPI), a novel framework that augments standard MPPI by computing local linear feedback gains derived from sensitivity analysis inspired by Riccati-based feedback used in gradient-based MPC, is introduced.

2506.15368.tldr: A model, CountVid, is introduced that leverages an image-based counting model, and a promptable video segmentation and tracking model, to enable automated open-world object counting across video frames, and significantly outperforms strong baselines.

2506.21546.tldr: RobustSeg is introduced, a segmentation VLM trained with counterfactual fine-tuning (CFT) to learn when to segment and when to abstain, and experimental results confirm RobustSeg reduces hallucinations by 30%, while improving segmentation performance on FP-RefCOCO(+/g).

2507.05178.tldr: This work implements and evaluates several state-of-the-art LLM-based multi-agent Agentic AI frameworks, uncovering significant performance gaps that highlight the unsolved challenges in large-scale coordination, communication, spatial reasoning, and long-horizon planning under uncertainty.

2507.13171.tldr: A novel reinforcement learning from implicit human feedback (RLIHF) framework that utilizes non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG) signals, specifically error-related potentials (ErrPs) to provide continuous, implicit feedback without requiring explicit user intervention is proposed.

2508.11272.tldr: This work proposed a framework that includes the Pyramid Matching Model with Training-Free Refinement (PMTFR) that surpasses state-of-the-art methods in supervised CIR tasks and enhanced the Pyramid Matching Model's understanding of visual information at different granularities.

2508.15447.tldr: By fusing cutting-edge AI technologies with deep business insights, BusiAgent marks a substantial step forward in AI-driven enterprise decision-making, empowering organizations to navigate complex business landscapes more effectively.

2508.18316.tldr: This study proposes and validates a Federated Learning (FL) framework to proactively identify at-risk students while preserving data privacy, and investigates the practical trade-offs between model complexity and the impact of local data balancing.

2509.18234.tldr: A series of adversarial stress tests are introduced to systematically assess the robustness of flagship models and medical benchmarks and reveal significant competency gaps of frontier AI in attaining real-world readiness for health applications.

2509.19112.tldr: CARGO is introduced, a scalable multi-label causal discovery method for sparse, high-dimensional event sequences comprising of thousands of unique event types using two pretrained causal Transformers as domain-specific foundation models for event sequences.

2509.19312.tldr: Extensive simulations show that the proposed CSC-SA-Net outperforms traditional separated designs, revealing the advantage of cross-modal channel-source semantic fusion.

2509.19972.tldr: This work develops an effective control strategy for a leader, combining reinforcement learning (RL) with artificial forces acting on the system, and applies the generalized Vicsek model to the problem of the effective evacuation by a robot-rescuer of large groups of people from hazardous places.

2510.04573.tldr: Empirical results show that LaDiR consistently improves accuracy, diversity, and interpretability over existing autoregressive, diffusion-based, and latent reasoning methods, revealing a new paradigm for text reasoning with latent diffusion.

2510.08442.tldr: This framework augments visual RL with a learnable foveal attention mechanism (Gaze), guided by a self-supervised signal derived from the agent's experience pursuing higher returns (the Prize), and achieves up to 2.52x improvement in sample efficiency and can solve challenging tasks from the ManiSkill3 benchmark that the baseline fails to learn, without modifying the underlying algorithm or hyperparameters.

2510.16309.tldr: This work introduces MedRule-KG, a compact typed knowledge graph coupled with a symbolic verifier, designed to enforce mathematically interpretable rules in reasoning tasks, and demonstrates how MedRule-KG provides a general scaffold for safe mathematical reasoning.

2510.17281.tldr: This work proposes a user feedback simulation framework and a comprehensive benchmark covering multiple domains, languages, and types of tasks to evaluate the continual learning abilities of LLMsys and hopes this benchmark could pave the way for future studies on LLM memory and optimization algorithms.

2510.18221.tldr: This work uses modern hardware along with a new multi-agent simulator to scale the environment and population to sizes much larger than previously attempted, reaching populations of over 60,000 agents each with their own evolved neural network policy.

2511.06634.tldr: CaberNet is proposed, a causal and interpretable deep sequence model that learns invariant (Markov blanket) representations for robust cross-domain prediction in a purely data-driven fashion and without requiring any prior knowledge.

2511.06682.tldr: The Textual Self-Attention Network (TSAN) is proposed, a new paradigm for test-time preference optimization that requires no parameter updates and outperforms supervised models like Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct and surpasses the current state-of-the-art test-time alignment method by effectively leveraging multiple candidate solutions.

2511.07895.tldr: A soft multitask learning framework is developed that incorporated a maximum mean discrepancy-based alignment module to enhance class discrimination while minimizing domain-related variability and highlights the potential of EEG-based assistive systems for communication in language impaired individuals.

2511.11907.tldr: This work presents KVSwap, a software framework tailored for local devices that achieves high memory efficiency while effectively leveraging disk storage, and shows that across representative LMs and storage types, KVSwap delivers higher throughput under tight memory budgets while maintaining generation quality over existing KV cache offloading schemes.

2511.12963.tldr: MedRule-KG, a compact knowledge-graph scaffold paired with a lightweight verifier that steers generation toward mathematically and biomedically valid outputs, is presented, a compact knowledge-graph scaffold paired with a lightweight verifier that steers generation toward mathematically and biomedically valid outputs.

2511.13387.tldr: The Generalized Denoising Diffusion Codebook Models (gDDCM) is proposed, which establishes a unified theoretical framework and introduces a generic de-noise and Back-trace sampling strategy that significantly outperforms DDCM in terms of reconstruction quality and perceptual fidelity.

2511.15351.tldr: This work proposes Octopus: Agentic Multimodal Reasoning with Six-Capability Orchestration, a new paradigm for multimodal agentic reasoning that is capable of autonomously exploring during reasoning and dynamically selecting the most appropriate capability based on the current state.

2511.16979.tldr: A semantic-aware prompt enhancement module to decompose images into discriminative semantic tokens, enabling nuanced vision-language alignment beyond coarse category labels, and a semantic-guided diffusion module that synthesizes pseudo-unknowns by perturbing extracted semantic tokens.

2511.18078.tldr: StableUASim is proposed, a pre-trained conditional latent diffusion surrogate model that captures the stochastic dynamics of underwater acoustic communication channels and provides a scalable, data-efficient, and physically consistent surrogate model for both system design and machine learning-driven underwater applications.

2512.00307.tldr: ASGL is presented, a privacy-preserving adversarial signed graph learning method that preserves high utility while achieving node-level DP and a constrained breadth-first search tree strategy that fuses with balance theory to identify the edge signs between generated node pairs.

2512.00396.tldr: Ultra-light separable CNNs provide a superior accuracy-efficiency-generalization trade-off to fixed thresholds for wearable PD gait detection and underscore the value of tailored time-series models for edge deployment.

2512.00862.tldr: HBLLM is introduced, a wavelet-enhanced high-fidelity $1-bit post-training quantization method for Large Language Models (LLMs) that significantly improves quantization fidelity while maintaining minimal overhead.

2512.02551.tldr: The proposed CUDA-L2 shows that even the most performance-critical, heavily-optimized kernels like HGEMM can be improved through LLM-guided RL automation by systematically exploring configuration spaces at scales impractical for humans.

2512.02830.tldr: It is argued that robustness evaluations should assess not only the resistance of a model to transferred attacks but also its propensity to produce transferable adversarial examples, and it is shown that adversarially trained models produce perturbations that transfer more effectively than those from standard models.

2512.03343.tldr: This work introduces the Idea-Gated Transformer, a novel architecture that separates semantic planning from syntactic generation and proposes a differentiable gating mechanism that suppresses semantically irrelevant tokens, effectively pruning the search space in real-time.

2512.05943.tldr: TRACE, a framework for Transparent Reasoning And Consistency Evaluation that diagnoses reasoning trajectories rather than only end results, is introduced, showing that consistency across ARS correlates with final-answer correctness and helps pinpoint the reasoning steps where failures arise, offering actionable signals for model improvement.

2512.07462.tldr: The FAIRGAME framework is extended to systematically evaluate LLM behaviour in repeated social dilemmas through two complementary advances: a payoff-scaled Prisoners Dilemma isolating sensitivity to incentive magnitude, and an integrated multi-agent Public Goods Game with dynamic payoffs and multi-agent histories.

2512.09142.tldr: SDialog, an MIT-licensed open-source Python toolkit that unifies dialog generation, evaluation and mechanistic interpretability into a single end-to-end framework for building and analyzing LLM-based conversational agents, enables researchers to build, benchmark and understand conversational systems more systematically.

2512.10041.tldr: MetaVoxel is introduced, a generative joint diffusion modeling framework that models the joint distribution over imaging data and clinical metadata by learning a single diffusion process spanning all variables, and demonstrates that joint multimodal diffusion offers a promising direction for unifying medical AI models and enabling broader clinical applicability.

2512.10206.tldr: CP-Env is introduced, a controllable agentic hospital environment designed to evaluate large language models across end-to-end clinical pathways, and a three-tiered evaluation framework encompassing Clinical Efficacy, Process Competency, and Professional Ethics is proposed.

2512.10279.tldr: An algorithm for computing evolutionarily stable strategies (ESSs) in symmetric perfect-recall extensive-form games of imperfect information and its main algorithm is for two-player games, and how it can be extended to multiplayer games is described.

2512.10313.tldr: EpiPlanAgent provides an effective, scalable solution for intelligent epidemic response planning, demonstrating the potential of agentic AI to transform public health preparedness.

2512.10317.tldr: This work addresses the problem of translating informal mathematical proofs expressed in natural language into formal proofs in Lean4 under a constrained computational budget by proposing a two stage framework that significantly reduces the complexity of tactic generation and improves alignment with informal reasoning patterns.

2512.10416.tldr: This work releases WildRoad, a global off-road road network dataset constructed efficiently with a dedicated interactive annotation tool tailored for road-network labeling and introduces MaGRoad (Mask-aware Geodesic Road network extractor), a path-centric framework that aggregates multi-scale visual evidence along candidate paths to infer connectivity robustly.

2512.10501.tldr: A training-free architecture that utilizes LLM agents for zero-shot PCG parameter configuration, demonstrating that off-the-shelf LLMs can be effectively repurposed as generalized agents for arbitrary PCG tools and offering a scalable framework for mastering complex software without task-specific fine-tuning.

2512.10534.tldr: This work makes the first attempt to build a medalist-level LLM agent for geometry and presents InternGeometry, which solves 44 of 50 IMO geometry problems (2000-2024), exceeding the average gold medalist score, using only 13K training examples, just 0.004% of the data used by AlphaGeometry 2.

2512.10734.tldr: This evaluation reveals that LLMs fine-tuned on debiased data do not consistently show improved performance on bias benchmarks, exposing critical gaps in current evaluation methodologies and highlighting the need for targeted data manipulation to address manifested model bias.

2512.10739.tldr: This paper introduces Intern-S1-MO, a long-horizon math agent that conducts multi-round hierarchical reasoning, composed of an LRM-based multi-agent system including reasoning, summary, and verification and proposes OREAL-H, an RL framework for training the LRM using the online explored trajectories to simultaneously bootstrap the reasoning ability of LRM and elevate the overall performance of Intern-S1-MO.

2512.10926.tldr: A novel algorithm is proposed that achieves this by optimizing the policy against a distilled critic for partial action chunks, constructed by optimistically backing up from the original chunked critic to approximate the maximum value achievable when a partial action chunk is extended to a complete one.

2512.10960.tldr: A pilot study was attempted to empirically measure the magnitude of skills-based uplift caused by access to an AI reasoning model, compared with a control group that had only internet access.

2512.10961.tldr: A three-level model of AI engagement is proposed -- from passive acceptance through iterative collaboration to cognitive direction -- and it is argued that the transition between levels requires not technical training but development of domain expertise and metacognitive skills.

2512.10963.tldr: A Multi-Modal Emotion and Intent Recognition Model (MMEI) based on a BERT-based Cross-Modal Transformer with Attention-Based Fusion, integrated into a cloud-native personalized AIGC recommendation framework is proposed, highlighting the potential of cross-modal emotional intelligence for next-generation AIGC ecosystems.

2512.10966.tldr: MREF-AD is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that models meso-scale brain regions in each modality as an independent expert and employs two-level gating networks to learn subject-specific fusion weights, underscoring its utility as a general framework for adaptive and interpretable multimodal fusion in neuroimaging.

2512.10975.tldr: A novel multi-agent framework for training multimodal emotion recognition systems, where each modality encoder and the fusion classifier operate as autonomous agents coordinated by a central supervisor is proposed.

2512.10978.tldr: A novel interpretability framework is proposed to systematically analyze the roles and behaviors of attention heads, which are key components of LLMs, and shows that cognitive heads play a vital role in reasoning tasks - removing them leads to performance degradation, while augmenting them enhances reasoning accuracy.

2512.10980.tldr: Across all key metrics, including throughput, job wait times, fairness variance, and starvation, dynamic multi-objective schedulers consistently outperform single-objective heuristics.

2512.10990.tldr: Dora is presented, a framework for QoE aware hybrid parallelism in distributed edge AI training and inference that achieves 1.1--6.3 times faster execution and reduces energy consumption by 21--82 percent, all while maintaining QoE under runtime dynamics.

2512.10991.tldr: MolSculpt is a novel framework that sculpts 3D molecular geometries from chemical syntax and deeply integrates 1D latent chemical knowledge into the 3D generation process through end-to-end optimization.

2512.10996.tldr: This paper introduces MedBioRAG, a retrieval-augmented model designed to improve biomedical QA performance through a combination of semantic and lexical search, document retrieval, and supervised fine-tuning, and highlights the effectiveness of semantic search-based retrieval and LLM fine-tuning in biomedical applications.

2512.11000.tldr: This work defines representational ambiguity as the conditional entropy H(I|R) over possible interpretations I given a representation R, and demonstrates that neural networks can exhibit the low-ambiguity representations posited as necessary (though not sufficient) by theoretical accounts of consciousness.

2512.11002.tldr: A beyond-memristor computing paradigm is theoretically sensible and experimentally practical and can play a unique role (that cannot be played by a memristor) in neuromorphic computing, deep learning and brain-inspired computers.

2512.11015.tldr: The proposed methodologies contribute to addressing the pivotal challenge of demographic bias in gender classification from facial images by leveraging semantic information from image captions during model training to improve generalization capabilities.

2512.11016.tldr: This work presents SoccerMaster, the first soccer-specific vision foundation model that unifies diverse understanding tasks within a single framework via supervised multi-task pretraining, and develops an automated data curation pipeline to generate scalable spatial annotations.

2512.11067.tldr: KathDB is proposed, a new system that combines relational semantics with the reasoning power of foundation models over multimodal data and includes human-AI interaction channels during query parsing, execution, and result explanation, such that users can iteratively obtain explainable answers across data modalities.

2512.11074.tldr: MultiScript30k is proposed, a new Multi30k dataset extension for global languages in various scripts, created by translating the English version of Multi30k (Multi30k-En) using NLLB200-3.3B.

2512.11075.tldr: This work presents a deep learning-based solution for automating bee population counting using CSRNet and introduces ASUBEE, the FIRST high-resolution dataset specifically designed for this task, offering scalable and precise monitoring solutions for honey bee populations.

2512.11087.tldr: This work introduces the linear constraint-driven clipping framework, a class of scalable and efficient methods designed to enhance the efficacy of NN verifiers, and develops two novel algorithms that efficiently utilize linear constraints to reduce portions of the input space that are either verified or irrelevant to a subproblem in the context of branch-and-bound.

2512.11110.tldr: FIBER is presented, a multilingual benchmark for evaluating factual knowledge in single- and multi-entity settings and indicates that the language of the prompt can influence the model's generated output, particularly for entities associated with the country corresponding to that language.

2512.11114.tldr: TAMO is presented, a fully amortized, universal policy for multi-objective black-box optimization that uses a transformer architecture that operates across varying input and objective dimensions, enabling pretraining on diverse corpora and transfer to new problems without retraining.

2512.11131.tldr: Fairness and action smoothness are two crucial considerations in many online optimization problems, but they have yet to be addressed simultaneously, and this paper proposes FairOBD (Fairness-regularized Online Balanced Descent), which reconciles the tension between minimizing the hitting cost, switching cost, and fairness cost.

2512.11147.tldr: This work presents MiniScope, a framework that enables tool calling agents to operate on user accounts while confining potential damage from unreliable LLMs, and introduces a novel way to automatically and rigorously enforce least privilege principles by reconstructing permission hierarchies that reflect relationships among tool calls and combining them with a mobile-style permission model.

2512.11167.tldr: This work presents a detailed reproduction and critical analysis of the Monkey Vision-Language Model (VLM) and confirms the key finding of the original Monkey VLM work, namely that tiling effectively recovers local details.

2512.11169.tldr: This work introduces a proof of concept CORL framework that end to end fine tunes an MILP scheme using reinforcement learning on real world data to maximize its operational performance and validate the CORL method in a simple illustrative combinatorial sequential decision making example.

2512.11187.tldr: This is the first work to establish that a Deep Neural Network-based constructor can reliably provide high-quality seeds for (multi-start) improvement heuristics, with applicability beyond the \textit{m1-PDSTSP} to a broad class of selective traveling salesperson problems and pickup and delivery problems.

2512.11201.tldr: It is pointed out that EXP3 can be implemented in constant time per round, and more practical algorithms are proposed, and the trade-offs between the regret bounds and time complexities of these algorithms are analyzed.

2512.11202.tldr: The Automated Mission Classifier (amc), a tool that uses large language models (LLMs) to identify and categorize telescope references by processing large quantities of paper text, is presented, demonstrating that LLM-based applications offer powerful and scalable assistance for library sciences.

2512.11213.tldr: The proposed FutureWeaver proposes FutureWeaver, a framework for planning and optimizing test-time compute allocation in multi-agent systems under fixed budgets that introduces modularized collaboration, formalized as callable functions that encapsulate reusable multi-agent workflows.

2512.11221.tldr: The method introduces a reversible soft-freeze mechanism that temporarily suspends key-value (KV) updates for low-importance tokens identified within a sliding attention window, and extends the framework with sublinear freeze scheduling, where freeze duration grows sublinearly with repeated low-importance detections, preventing over-aggressive compression.

2512.11225.tldr: A generative forecaster that performs autoregressive flow matching in VFM feature space that produces sharper and more accurate predictions than regression across all modalities and suggests that stochastic conditional generation of VFM features offers a promising and scalable foundation for future world models.

2512.11255.tldr: A simple generalisation of Dherin et al. (2025)'s theory on simple in-context linear regression tasks is provided and the relationship between the implicit updates related to different tokens within and between blocks is investigated.

2512.11258.tldr: A survey of recent advances in multi-intent SLU is presented and an in-depth overview of previous research from two perspectives: decoding paradigms and modeling approaches is provided.

2512.11269.tldr: Cerium is the first GPU system to execute bootstrapping in under 10 milliseconds, achieving 7.5 milliseconds, and is the first to demonstrate encrypted inference for BERT-Base and Llama3-8B in 8 seconds and 134 seconds, respectively.

2512.11270.tldr: An agentic large language model (LLM)-based framework for automated MDP modeling and policy generation (A-LAMP), that automatically translates free-form natural language task descriptions into an MDP formulation and trained policy, and consistently achieves higher policy generation capability than a single state-of-the-art LLM model.

2512.11271.tldr: TriFlow is presented, a progressive multi-agent framework that unifies structured reasoning and language-based flexibility through a three-stage pipeline of retrieval, planning, and governance that progressively narrows the search space, assembles constraint-consistent itineraries via rule-LLM collaboration, and performs bounded iterative refinement to ensure global feasibility and personalisation.

2512.11282.tldr: Experiments across seven mainstream language models show that CIP consistently enhances reasoning quality and reliability, and suggest that causal reasoning may serve as a promising paradigm for improving the explainability, stability, and efficiency of large language models.

2512.11296.tldr: The proposed framework was demonstrated to be suitable for verification of manually generated G-code that is typically developed in CNC training, and showed that few-shot prompting led to overall enhancement of detecting HMI errors and discrepancies with the G-code for more comprehensive debugging.

2512.11317.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework for continual learning on dynamic graphs, named Condensation-Concatenation-based Continual Learning (CCC), which condenses historical graph snapshots into compact semantic representations while aiming to preserve the original label distribution and topological properties.

2512.11323.tldr: A novel CAPTCHA benchmark is introduced for the first time, named CAPTURE CAPTCHA for Testing Under Real-world Experiments, specifically for LVLMs, that encompasses 4 main CAPTCHA types and 25 sub-types from 31 vendors and enables a multi-dimensional and thorough evaluation of LVLM performance.

2512.11350.tldr: This paper proposes an accident detection model based on a transformer architecture using pre-extracted spatial video features that employs convolutional layers to extract local correlations across diverse patterns within a frame, while leveraging transformers to capture sequential-temporal dependencies among the retrieved features.

2512.11402.tldr: This paper investigates the efficacy of 19 small, quantized LLMs (under 20 billion parameters) for the C to Java translation task using a novel, hybrid pipeline that leverages Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) for semantic decomposition and employs a highly constrained, rule based prompting strategy.

2512.11412.tldr: A novel multi-task learning (MTL) framework designed to jointly enhance accuracy and interpretability by imposing an L1 sparsity penalty on task-specific attention modules, which provides chemically intuitive visualizations that reveal the specific fragments influencing predictions, thereby enhancing insight into the model's decision-making process.

2512.11421.tldr: A task completion framework that enables LLM-based agents to act under explicit behavioral guidance in environments described by reinforcement learning formalisms with defined observation, action, and reward signals is presented.

2512.11426.tldr: AgentBalance is presented, a framework for constructing cost-effective MAS under explicit token-cost and latency budgets via a backbone-then-topology design and functions as a plug-in for existing MAS, improving performance under the same token-cost and latency constraints.

2512.11433.tldr: This work introduces a novel baseline by leveraging recent work in feature visualisation to artificially produce a model-dependent baseline that removes information without being overly OOD, thus improving on the trade-off when compared to other existing baselines.

2512.11438.tldr: By learning to insert and denoise frames in a sequence, Flowception seamlessly integrates different tasks such as image-to-video generation and video interpolation, and allowing to learn the length of videos jointly with their content.

2512.11463.tldr: This work introduces Motif-2-12.7B-Reasoning, a 12.7B parameter language model designed to bridge the gap between open-weight systems and proprietary frontier models in complex reasoning and long-context understanding, and details a robust Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning pipeline that stabilizes training via difficulty-aware data filtering and mixed-policy trajectory reuse.

2512.11464.tldr: MetaCanvas is proposed, a lightweight framework that lets MLLMs reason and plan directly in spatial and spatiotemporal latent spaces and interface tightly with diffusion generators, suggesting that treating MLLMs as latent-space planners is a promising direction for narrowing the gap between multimodal understanding and generation.

2512.11474.tldr: The scientific knowledge on agroecological crop protection that is generated by either web-grounded or non-grounded large language models (LLMs) is verified and LLMs may pose a powerful tool to support farm-level decision-making and unleash scientific creativity.

2512.11482.tldr: This first comprehensive study that systematically evaluates the effectiveness of Differential Privacy in CodeLLMs finds that DP substantially reduces memorization in CodeLLMs across all the tested snippet types and observes that DP slightly increases perplexity but preserves the code generation capabilities of CodeLLMs, which makes it feasible to apply DP in practice without significantly compromising model utility.

2512.11505.tldr: This work proposes BAID, a comprehensive evaluation framework for AI detectors across various types of biases, and introduces over 200k samples spanning 7 major categories: demographics, age, educational grade level, dialect, formality, political leaning, and topic.

2512.11525.tldr: This work proposes NeuralOGCM, an ocean modeling framework that fuses differentiable programming with deep learning, which maintains long-term stability and physical consistency, significantly outperforming traditional numerical models in speed and pure AI baselines in accuracy.

2512.11526.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that Co-TSFA improves performance under anomalous conditions while maintaining accuracy on normal data, and introduces a latent-output alignment loss that ties representation changes to forecast changes that encourages invariance to irrelevant perturbations while preserving sensitivity to meaningful distributional shifts.

2512.11532.tldr: This work introduces Parallax, a framework that accelerates mobile DNN inference without model refactoring or custom operator implementations, and delivers up to 30% energy savings compared with state-of-the-art frameworks.

2512.11544.tldr: This research is the first to empirically confirm that LLMs exhibit features resembling metabolic dysfunction when processing clinical information, proposing the innovative concept of AI-Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (AI-MASLD).

2512.11545.tldr: The UATR-GTransformer is proposed, a non-Euclidean DL model that integrates Transformer architectures with graph neural networks (GNNs) and effectively extracts rich frequency-domain information, highlighting its potential for applications in ocean engineering.

2512.11546.tldr: This paper shows that, in some cases, less is more when considering datasets, by reframing the data selection problem: rather than tuning model hyperparameters, the model is fixed and the composition of the training data itself is optimized.

2512.11558.tldr: The largest annotated multimodal dataset for dentistry to date was constructed by aggregating over 120k dental images paired with detailed descriptions that highlight diagnostically relevant visual features, making it the multimodal dataset with the most extensive collection of dental images to date.

2512.11560.tldr: This work proposes to process multiple frames from a satellite image time series of the same glacier in parallel and exchange temporal information between the corresponding feature maps to stabilize each prediction, achieving a new state-of-the-art performance on the CaFFe benchmark dataset.

2512.11584.tldr: This work introduces Atomic Action Slicing (AAS), a planner-aligned approach that decomposes long-horizon demonstrations into short, typed atomic actions that are easier for planners to use and policies to learn.

2512.11588.tldr: Dynamic, inclusive benchmarking will ensure evaluation keeps pace with AI evolution and supports responsible, reproducible, and accessible AI deployment, and community efforts can provide a foundation for AI Benchmark Carpentry.

2512.11635.tldr: This study demonstrates the scalability and contextual sensitivity of BERTopic as an alternative to traditional approaches, offering richer insights into historical discourses extracted from newspaper archives, contributing to historical, nuclear, and social-science research.

2512.11661.tldr: A user study with researchers across multiple disciplines to characterize current practices, benefits, and pain points in using LLMs to investigate related work finds a framework that addresses limitations and models real-world LLM-assisted writing, advancing trust through verifiable actions and fostering practical collaboration between researchers and AI systems.

2512.11682.tldr: How retrieval quality for function (tool) calls influences overall model performance is analyzed and performance gains achieved through improved tool-retrieval strategies are demonstrated.

2511.12306.tldr: UpBench provides a scalable, human-centered foundation for evaluating agentic systems in authentic labor-market contexts, offering a path toward a collaborative framework, where AI amplifies human capability through partnership rather than replacement.

2512.05103.tldr: TV2TV is presented, a unified generative modeling framework which decomposes video generation into an interleaved text and video generation process and offloads much of the responsibility for deciding what should happen next to the language modeling tower, enabling improved visual quality and prompt alignment of generated videos.

2512.11743.tldr: This work introduces a new SNN paradigm, named Cognition-aware SNN (CogniSNN), by incorporating Random Graph Architecture (RGA) and designs a Key Pathway-based Learning without Forgetting (KP-LwF) approach, which selectively reuses critical neural pathways while retaining historical knowledge, enabling efficient multi-task transfer.

2512.11748.tldr: The GPD framework enables the generation of new designs along with their corresponding parametric solutions given as a reduced basis, enhancing predictive modeling and real-time decision-making in engineering applications.

2512.11779.tldr: To overcome sample-inefficiency and overfitting issues of existing metrics, the cast conditional coverage estimation as a classification problem, and the resulting family of metrics excess risk of the target coverage (ERT) is called.

2512.11783.tldr: A proposed countermeasure, DeltaGuard, significantly improves the detection of malicious prompts generated through Super Suffixes and increases the non-benign classification rate to nearly 100%, making DeltaGuard a valuable addition to the guard model stack and enhancing robustness against adversarial prompt attacks.

2512.11798.tldr: A feed-forward approach that, given a single static 3D mesh of an everyday object, directly infers all attributes of the underlying articulated structure, including its 3D parts, kinematic structure, and motion constraints, much faster than prior approaches that require per-object optimization.

2210.00858.tldr: A neurosymbolic architecture for coupling language-guided visual reasoning with robot manipulation, marrying the interpretability and systematic generalization benefits of discrete symbolic approaches with the scalability and representational power of deep networks is presented.

2401.08930.tldr: P Pose Analysis by Diffusion Synthesis PADS is proposed, a unified generative modeling framework for 3D human pose analysis that removes the need for task-specific supervision or retraining, offering flexibility and scalability across diverse conditions.

2404.03354.tldr: A comprehensive review of self-supervised learning frameworks designed for recommender systems, encompassing a thorough analysis of over 170 papers, and elaborate on different self-supervised learning paradigms, namely contrastive learning, generative learning, and adversarial learning.

2405.07293.tldr: WWC-Predictor is proposed, a novel method for efficiently estimating the wrong-way cycling ratio, defined as the proportion of wrong-way cycling events relative to the total number of cycling movements over a given time period using an autoregressive moving average model.

2406.07926.tldr: The proposed Temporal Neural Common Neighbor (TNCN) improves upon NCN by efficiently preserving and updating temporal neighbor dictionaries for each node and by using multi-hop common neighbors to learn more expressive pairwise representations.

2407.12051.tldr: Dy-mer is proposed, an interpretable and robust DNA representation scheme based on dictionary learning that reconstructs DNA sequences as concatenations of dynamic-length subsequences (dymers) through a convolution operation and simultaneously optimize a learnable dymer dictionary and sparse representations.

2407.21600.tldr: ROGER is introduced, a robust SMS MRI reconstruction method based on deep generative priors that consistently outperforms existing methods, enhancing both anatomical and functional imaging with strong out-of-distribution generalization.

2408.06069.tldr: This work introduces a fully Bayesian framework that models kernel hyperparameters as random variables and utilizes coupled stochastic differential equations (SDEs) to jointly learn their posterior distributions alongside those of inducing points and validates its effectiveness in handling intricate dynamic behaviors.

2409.07770.tldr: The layer-aware time-delay neural network (L-TDNN), which directly performs layer/frame-wise processing on the layer-wise hidden state outputs from pre-trained models, extracting fixed-size speaker vectors, consistently demonstrated robust verification performance and exhibited inference efficiency comparable to the existing systems.

2409.11169.tldr: The experiment results show that MAISI's capabilities in generating realistic, anatomically accurate images for diverse regions and conditions reveal its promising potential to mitigate challenges using synthetic data.

2411.14507.tldr: FuseGPT is introduced, a compression paradigm that reframes structured pruning as iterative knowledge grafting rather than simple removal, and proposes Macro Influence (MI), a dynamic fusion-aware metric that continuously re-evaluates block redundancy as the network topology evolves.

2412.07259.tldr: A new reasoning method for DatalogMTL is introduced which exploits the magic sets technique—a rewriting approach developed for (non-temporal) Datalog to simulate top-down evaluation with bottom-up reasoning.

2501.10100.tldr: A novel framework for learning world models that accurately capture complex, partially observable, and stochastic dynamics is introduced that employs a dual-autoregressive mechanism and self-supervised training to achieve reliable long-horizon predictions without relying on domain-specific inductive biases.

2501.15693.tldr: This work proposes a simple, realistic and readily usable regulatory framework which does not rely on benchmarks, and calls for interdisciplinary collaboration to find new ways to address this crucial problem of opaqueness of AI models.

2502.13764.tldr: A real-time evaluation mechanism for comprehensive rice grain assessment is proposed, integrating a one-stage object detection approach, a deep convolutional neural network, and traditional machine learning techniques, which enables rice variety identification, grain completeness grading, and grain chalkiness evaluation.

2502.16840.tldr: This research demonstrates that TabPFN, coupled with a simple sliding memory strategy, consistently outperforms ensembles of Hoeffding trees, such as Adaptive Random Forest, and Streaming Random Patches, across all non-stationary benchmarks.

2503.07874.tldr: It is demonstrated that distance-based supervision alone is insufficient to guarantee anatomically faithful reconstruction, and that explicit enforcement of multi-structure anatomical relations provides a principled and robust pathway toward reliable patient-specific cardiac modeling.

2503.10253.tldr: This work proposes Physics-Informed Multi-Scale Recurrent Learning (PIMRL), a novel framework specifically designed for burst-sampled spatiotemporal data that combines macro-scale latent dynamics inference with micro-scale adaptive refinement guided by incomplete prior information from partial differential equations (PDEs).

2503.11950.tldr: The Privacy–Ethics Alignment in AI (PEA-AI) model, which conceptualizes privacy decision-making as a dynamic negotiation among stakeholders, is introduced, which provides a scalable foundation for adaptive, youth-centered AI privacy governance.

2503.14505.tldr: This work introduces MusicInfuser, an approach that aligns pre-trained text-to-video diffusion models to generate high-quality dance videos synchronized with specified music tracks, significantly reducing training costs while preserving rich prior knowledge, even with limited, specialized datasets.

2503.18702.tldr: It is established that non-trivial grammatical knowledge has been acquired and the parameter configuration of this computational laboratory environment determined using training data generated by the mother language model is validated in a second experiment resulting in the acquisition of non-trivial categories.

2504.03494.tldr: This work introduces a practical robustness definition grounded in distributional robustness, explicitly tailored to industrial CPS, and proposes a systematic framework for robustness evaluation, and publicly releases a robustness benchmark to encourage further research and reproducibility.

2505.05019.tldr: Despite improving overall quality, HPO alone fails to prevent violations of essential clinical survival constraints, and the necessity of integrating explicit domain knowledge alongside HPO to generate high-quality synthetic datasets is underscored.

2505.06256.tldr: A novel spectrum foundation model, termed SpectrumFM, is proposed, establishing a new paradigm for spectrum management and achieving superior performance in terms of accuracy, robustness, adaptability, few-shot learning efficiency, and convergence speed, consistently outperforming conventional methods across multiple benchmarks.

2505.08919.tldr: A neural implicit function-based method to learn a 3D surface to achieve anatomy-aware, precise pulmonary segment reconstruction, represented as a shape by deforming a learnable template is proposed.

2505.12923.tldr: This work introduces The Traitors, a multi-agent simulation framework inspired by social deduction games, designed to probe deception, trust formation, and strategic communication among large language model (LLM) agents under asymmetric information.

2505.13948.tldr: MemoryEQA, an EQA framework centered on memory, which establishes mechanisms for memory storage, update, and retrieval, allowing memory information to contribute throughout the entire exploration process, underscores the memory capability's pivotal role in solving complex tasks.

2505.15201.tldr: For challenging task sets where conventional pass@1 optimization stalls, the proposed Pass-at-k Policy Optimization (PKPO) approach unblocks learning, likely due to better exploration by prioritizing joint utility over the utility of individual samples.

2505.16130.tldr: This work explores pathways beyond message-passing and introduces Generative Graph Pattern Machine (G$^2$PM), a generative Transformer pre-training framework for graphs that consistently outperforms strong baselines, establishing a compelling foundation for scalable graph learning.

2505.18231.tldr: NSNQuant, a calibration-free Vector Quantization (VQ) technique designed for low-bit compression of the KV cache, is introduced, offering strong generalization and up to 3$\times$ throughput gain over full-precision baselines.

2505.19609.tldr: A novel perspective on data scheduling to address the challenges posed by the heterogeneous data distributions in Long-SFT is presented and Skrull, a dynamic data scheduler specifically designed for efficient long-SFT is proposed, a dynamic data scheduler specifically designed for efficient long-SFT.

2505.19700.tldr: A novel \textit{Residual Alignment Model} (\textit{RAM}) that formalizes the alignment process as a type of importance sampling, which enables a natural detachment of the alignment module from the target aligned model, improving flexibility and scalability.

2505.21717.tldr: LrcSSM is presented, a non-linear recurrent model that processes long sequences as fast as today's linear state-space layers by forcing its Jacobian matrix to be diagonal, and can be generalized to other non-linear recurrent models, demonstrating broader applicability.

2505.24592.tldr: This work theoretically reveals a general condition for label-preserving augmentations to bring robustness to diverse distribution shifts through the lens of flat minima and generalization bound, which de facto turns out to be strongly correlated with robustness against different distribution shifts in practice.

2505.24850.tldr: This paper addresses the critical question: How can both positive and negative distilled reasoning traces be effectively leveraged to maximize LLM reasoning performance in an offline setting and finds that a simple REINFORCE-style objective, which is termed the Reinforcement Distillation (REDI), outperforms established preference optimization methods like DPO and SimPO in this distillation context.

2506.00227.tldr: Ctrl-Crash is proposed, a controllable car crash video generation model that conditions on signals such as bounding boxes, crash types, and an initial image frame that enables counterfactual scenario generation where minor variations in input can lead to dramatically different crash outcomes.

2506.02454.tldr: Formal Description of Visualization (FDV) is proposed, a structured textual representation of charts that enables LLMs to learn from and generate diverse, high-quality visualizations that achieves an 82% overall win rate over the baseline method.

2506.03682.tldr: This work introduces PART, a self-supervised learning approach that leverages continuous relative transformations between off-grid patches to overcome limitations of grid-based approaches and opens up a new trajectory for universal self-supervised pretraining across diverse datatypes.

2506.07927.tldr: This work proposes an informal yet verifiable task formulation, recasting inequality proving into two automatically checkable subtasks: bound estimation and relation prediction, and develops a novel LLM-as-judge evaluation framework, combining a final-answer judge with four step-wise judges designed to detect common reasoning flaws.

2506.12041.tldr: An entirely new meta-learning framework for network pruning that can learn complex pruning rules automatically via a neural network (metanetwork) and has great generality that can prune without any special training is proposed.

2506.13925.tldr: HVLFormer, a Hierarchical Vision Language transFormer, which achieves domain aware and domain robust alignment between visual and textual representations within a mask transformer architecture and ensures stable vision language alignment during decoding.

2506.20130.tldr: An AI-driven reproducibility Copilot that analyzes manuscripts, code, and supplementary materials to generate structured Jupyter Notebooks and recommendations aimed at facilitating computational reproducibility suggests that AI tools can meaningfully reduce the burden of reproducibility efforts and contribute to more transparent and verifiable scientific communication.

2506.21127.tldr: A meta-policy switching framework in which a meta-level polic dynamically selects among multiple robust policies to counter unknown adversarial shifts, ensuring adaptive robustness to OOD attacks and exhibiting emergent antifragile behavior under uncertainty is proposed.

2506.21329.tldr: This perspective contends that progress turns on closing three mutually reinforcing gaps in abstraction, reasoning and empirical grounding, and that the inherent ambiguity in feedback from simulations and experiments, and underlying uncertainties make human judgment indispensable.

2506.21502.tldr: This work sets forth a method that performs unsupervised characterization of system states and state transitions from low-level sensor data, uses several process mining techniques to model faults through interpretable stochastic Petri nets, simulates such Petri nets for a comprehensive understanding of system behavior under faulty conditions, and performs Petri net-based fault diagnosis.

2506.23046.tldr: The results show that LVLMs perform significantly worse than humans on SoMi-ToM: the average accuracy gap between humans and models is 40.1% in first-person evaluation and 26.4% in third-person evaluation, which indicates that future LVLMs need to further improve their ToM capabilities in embodied, complex social interactions.

2506.23260.tldr: This survey introduces a unified end-to-end threat model for LLM-agent ecosystems, covering host-to-tool and agent-to-agent communications, and presents the first integrated taxonomy bridging input-level exploits and protocol-layer vulnerabilities in LLM-agent ecosystems.

2507.00057.tldr: A measure of incorrectness, called *incoherence*, is proposed that can be estimated efficiently in the absence of an oracle and allows us to establish a lower bound on the error, i.e., the probability that the LLM-generated program for that specification is incorrect.

2507.05622.tldr: A comprehensive study evaluating dataset auditing from an adversarial perspective, including a new benchmark, DATABench, comprising 17 evasion attacks, 5 forgery attacks, and 9 representative auditing methods that reveal that none of the evaluated auditing methods are sufficiently robust or distinctive under adversarial settings.

2507.06268.tldr: The path forward is not merely more data and compute, and not merely more attention paid to cognitive or symbolic representations, but a thorough blending of economic and social concepts with computational and inferential concepts at the level of algorithm design.

2507.18577.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive overview of FFMs, with a taxonomy spanning three key modalities: financial language foundation models (FinLFMs), financial time-series foundation models (FinTSFMs), and financial visual-language foundation models (FinVLFMs), and identifies critical challenges in data availability, algorithmic scalability, and infrastructure constraints.

2507.19929.tldr: D DynamiX is introduced, a novel large-scale social network simulator dedicated to dynamic social network modeling that exhibits marked improvements in attitude evolution simulation and collective behavior analysis compared to static networks, and opens a new theoretical perspective on follower growth prediction.

2508.03584.tldr: This article motivates to use the communication engineering perspective for developing a holistic understanding of the phytobiome communication and bridge the gap between the phytobiome communication and smart agriculture.

2508.07710.tldr: This work introduces a Multi-basis Exponential Decay (MBE) neuron that combines exponential decay with a multi-basis encoding strategy to effectively approximate nonlinear operations, eliminating the need for weight modifications in pretrained ANNs.

2508.09219.tldr: A mixed-methods survey study is presented to examine the ethical perceptions, practices, and knowledge of individuals involved in various AI development roles to underscore the importance of a collaborative, role-sensitive approach that involves diverse stakeholders in ethical decision-making throughout the AI development lifecycle.

2508.10019.tldr: This work proposes a new framework that decouples understanding from reasoning by mapping natural language problems into a canonical problem space-a semantically simplified yet expressive domain, and introduces DURIT (Decoupled Understanding from Reasoning via Iterative Training), a three-step algorithm that iteratively improves the robustness of reasoning.

2508.11009.tldr: SproutBench is introduced, an innovative evaluation suite comprising 1,283 developmentally grounded adversarial prompts designed to probe risks such as emotional dependency, privacy violations, and imitation of hazardous behaviors, which yield practical guidelines for advancing child-centric AI design and deployment.

2508.11849.tldr: LocoMamba is introduced, a vision-driven cross-modal DRL framework built on selective state-space models, specifically leveraging Mamba, that achieves near-linear-time sequence modeling, effectively captures long-range dependencies, and enables efficient training with longer sequences.

2508.13426.tldr: Fine-tuning LLMs on native speakers' word-association norms is introduced, leveraging cognitive psychology findings that such associations capture cultural knowledge to demonstrate that a few million of culture-grounded associations achieve value alignment without expensive retraining.

2508.15782.tldr: An AI driven approach that leverages Vision Transformers (ViTs) to automatically classify children s engagement using visual cues such as gaze direction, interaction, and peer collaboration is presented.

2508.15811.tldr: A multi-stage framework designed for progressive alignment between the generation policy and user intent is introduced, and a Gaussian Reward Model (GaRM) is developed that represents user preferences as probability distributions rather than point estimates.

2508.16325.tldr: This work introduces ConceptGuard, a novel framework that leverages Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to identify interpretable concepts within LLM internals associated with different jailbreak themes, and provides evidence for a shared activation geometry for jailbreak attacks in the representation space.

2508.16634.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework built upon Dual-Granularity Representations, termed the Dual-Granularity Guidance Network (DGGN), which decouples feature learning into two parallel streams, and designs a Boundary-Aware Exemplar Prioritization strategy to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

2508.16994.tldr: A novel evaluation framework that models task difficulty along two orthogonal dimensions, defined by the number of inference steps (hops) and semantic distance between the query and its supporting evidence, and provides a scalable foundation for evaluating and improving multi-hop reasoning in real-world applications.

2508.17364.tldr: The Condition Modulated Expert (CoMoE) module is proposed, a dynamic, snake-like connection mechanism that enables effective interaction between global text-level control from the backbone and fine-grained control from conditional branches that effectively mitigates feature entanglement and redundant computation in multi-condition scenarios.

2509.02718.tldr: This work introduces the first training-free algorithm for online routing scenarios that leverages approximate nearest neighbor search to efficiently estimate query features and performs a one-time optimization over a small set of initial queries to learn a routing strategy that guides future routing.

2509.04467.tldr: This paper proposes a pruning method that is highly integrated with PD disaggregation, enabling more precise pruning of blocks, and achieves improved performance and faster inference.

2509.09810.tldr: The goal of this paper is to review instances of what can be considered autoformalization and to propose a unified framework, encouraging cross-pollination between different fields to advance the development of next generation AI systems.

2509.11656.tldr: MALLM (Multi-Agent Large Language Models), an open-source framework that enables systematic analysis of MAD components, is introduced, enabling researchers to systematically configure, run, and evaluate debates for their problems, facilitating the understanding of the components and their interplay.

2509.16339.tldr: This work proposes CISIR that incorporates correlation, Monotonically Decreasing Involution (MDI) importance, and stratified sampling, and experimental results indicate that CISIR can achieve lower error and higher correlation than some recent methods.

2509.19633.tldr: This work proposes an approach that applies spectrum scaling to pre-trained Mamba models to enable robust long-context generalization by selectively modulating the spectrum of $\mathbf{A}$ matrices in each layer, and shows that this can significantly improve performance in settings where simply modulating $\Delta_t$ fails.

2509.22621.tldr: It is shown that ICL and SFT produce distinct activation patterns, indicating that the two methods achieve adaptation through different functional mechanisms, and ICL Activation Alignment (IA2), a self-distillation technique which aims to replicate ICL's activation patterns in SFT models and incentivizes ICL-like internal reasoning is introduced.

2509.23687.tldr: A secure and spectral efficient ISAC framework for multi-UAV networks is proposed, and a two-stage optimization approach is developed to jointly design hybrid beamforming (HBF), artificial noise (AN) injection, and UAV trajectories.

2509.24250.tldr: The study surfaced unique challenges in representing learning as programs and in enabling users to teach collaborative physical activities, which are discussed and mitigation strategies are outlined.

2509.25540.tldr: This evaluation explicitly validates RadOnc-GPT across two clearly defined tiers of increasing complexity: a structured quality assurance (QA) tier, assessing the accurate retrieval of demographic and radiotherapy treatment plan details, and a complex clinical outcomes labeling tier involving determination of mandibular osteoradionecrosis in head-and-neck cancer patients and detection of cancer recurrence.

2510.02967.tldr: This study establishes RAG as an effective, reliable, and scalable approach for applying generative AI in healthcare, enabling cost-effective access to medical guidelines.

2510.04146.tldr: It is shown that although DLMs can achieve higher arithmetic intensity than ARMs by leveraging parallelism across token positions, they fail to scale effectively with longer contexts, and opportunities for accelerating DLM inference are highlighted.

2510.07084.tldr: This work introduces Hybrid Temporal and Multivariate Embeddings (HTME), and combines HTME with the Transformer architecture, leveraging the enhanced feature extraction capability of the HTME extractor to build a lightweight forecaster.

2510.07620.tldr: DGTEN delivers standout gains where it matters most: in single-timeslot prediction on Bitcoin-OTC, it improves MCC by +12.34% over the best dynamic baseline; in the cold-start scenario on Bitcoin-Alpha, it achieves a +25.00% MCC improvement, the largest across all tasks and datasets; while under adversarial on-off attacks, it surpasses the baseline by up to +10.23% MCC.

2510.12859.tldr: It is concluded that AI is neither a singular break nor merely incremental progress: it is both evolutionary and revolutionary: predictable in its median effects yet carrying singularity-class tail risks.

2510.14925.tldr: H-Risk, a composite instability index integrating spectral margin, conditioning, temporal sensitivity, and innovation amplification, is formalized in linear-Gaussian state-space models via H-Risk, a composite instability index integrating spectral margin, conditioning, temporal sensitivity, and innovation amplification.

2510.14982.tldr: A CUDA-based parallelization of state-of-the-art Artificial Protozoa Optimizer leveraging GPU acceleration is presented and a significant performance gain i.e. up to 6.7 times speed up is achieved with proposed parallel version.

2510.17904.tldr: The Adversarial Prompt Deconstruction guardrail is introduced, a defense that utilizes a secondary LLM to perform a "Literal Transcription"--extracting all human-readable text to isolate and reveal the user's true harmful intent.

2510.21720.tldr: A comprehensive, multi-faceted framework designed to bridge the gap between isolated predictive modeling and an interactive system for psychological analysis is presented, demonstrating a complete research-to-deployment pipeline that integrates predictive analysis with generative dialogue.

2510.25130.tldr: A Lipschitz-aware linearity grafting method is proposed that removes dominant approximation errors, which are crucial for tightening the local Lipschitz constant, thereby improving certified robustness, even without certified training.

2511.00139.tldr: A Shared Autonomy framework that divides control between macro and micro motions is proposed that generates high-quality data with minimal manpower and achieves a 90% success rate across diverse objects, including unseen instances.

2511.07665.tldr: FractalCloud is proposed, a fractal-inspired hardware architecture for efficient large-scale 3D point cloud processing that achieves 21.7x speedup and 27x energy reduction over state-of-the-art accelerators while maintaining network accuracy, demonstrating its scalability and efficiency for PNN inference.

2511.07935.tldr: DiffRegCD is presented, an integrated framework that unifies dense registration and change detection in a single model that consistently surpasses recent baselines and remains reliable under wide temporal and geometric variation, establishing diffusion features and classification based correspondence as a strong foundation for unified change detection.

2511.12876.tldr: Experiments in economic simulation show that LAMP outperforms both MARL and LLM-only baselines in cumulative return, robustness, and interpretability, demonstrating the potential of language-augmented policies to deliver more effective and robust economic strategies.

2511.16020.tldr: A sequence-level optimization framework is introduced to generate natural, printable adversarial textures for shirts, trousers, and hats that remain effective throughout entire walking videos in both digital and physical settings.

2511.16689.tldr: This work introduces an interpretability technique based on the Concept Gradient (CG) method which provides a more causal interpretation by measuring how changes in concepts directly affect the output of the model, an extension of traditional gradient-based methods in machine learning.

2512.04524.tldr: Prototype-based Semantic Consistency Alignment (PSCA), a two-stage framework for effective domain adaptive retrieval, is proposed, and extensive experiments validate PSCA's superior performance across multiple datasets.

2512.08290.tldr: This Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) aims to provide a comprehensive taxonomy of risks in the MCP ecosystem, distinguishing between adversarial security threats and epistemic safety hazards, and concludes with a roadmap for securing the transition from conversational chatbots to autonomous agentic operating systems.

2512.11836.tldr: A machine learning pipeline that predicts the comprehensive Food Compass Score 2.0 (FCS) from text descriptions using multi-headed neural networks that combine semantic text embeddings, lexical patterns, and domain heuristics alongside USDA Food and Nutrient Database for Dietary Studies (FNDDS) data.

2512.11837.tldr: Vision Foundry is introduced, a code-free, HIPAA-compliant platform that democratizes pre-training, adaptation, and deployment of foundational vision models, and enables domain experts to develop state-of-the-art clinical AI tools with minimal annotation overhead.

2512.11851.tldr: Whether attention key value states computed for one prompt for a small LLM can be reused to accelerate inference on a new similar prompt, giving an increase to the space to its context memory using an approach called token recycling is investigated.

2512.11852.tldr: The TFT model is leveraged to automate actuator settings for optimal greenhouse management and demonstrates the varying influence of each sensor on real-time greenhouse adjustments, ensuring transparency and enabling adaptive fine-tuning for improved crop yield and resource efficiency.

2512.11862.tldr: An integrated air-ground collaborative network is proposed and a time-dependent integer nonlinear programming problem that jointly optimizes UAV trajectory planning and task offloading decisions is formulated, which outperforms baselines in energy efficiency, task success rate, and convergence performance.

2512.11882.tldr: The design and pilot evaluation of RockStartIT Tutor, an AI-powered assistant developed for a digital programming and computational thinking course within the RockStartIT initiative, highlight a pragmatic approach to AI integration that requires no model training, using structure and prompts to shape behavior.

2512.11887.tldr: This study consolidates critical research gaps in ADS testing and outlines key future research directions, including comprehensive testing criteria, cross-model collaboration in V2X systems, cross-modality adaptation for foundation model-based testing, and scalable validation frameworks for large-scale ADS evaluation.

2512.11902.tldr: Mirror Mode, a new game mode where the enemy AI mimics the personal strategy of a player to challenge them to keep changing their gameplay, is introduced.

2512.11907.tldr: This work introduces a compilation process that transforms a user's knowledge graph with dependencies into a set of abstract macro-facets, and proves that common hierarchical and quota-based constraints over these macro-facets form a valid laminar matroid.

2512.11909.tldr: Evaluating causal reasoning in LLMs and humans on the same tasks provides hence a more comprehensive understanding of their respective strengths and weaknesses.

2512.11925.tldr: FloraForge is presented, an LLM-assisted framework that enables domain experts to generate biologically accurate, fully parametric 3D plant models through iterative natural language Plant Refinements (PR), minimizing programming expertise.

2512.11933.tldr: The architecture remains compatible with today's model-risk rules yet closes critical observability and control gaps, providing a practical path toward resilient, adaptive AI governance in financial systems.

2512.11935.tldr: AGAPI (AtomGPT.org API), an open-access agentic AI platform that integrates more than eight open-source LLMs with over twenty materials-science API endpoints, unifying databases, simulation tools, and machine-learning models through a common orchestration framework, is introduced.

2512.11941.tldr: A unified framework that establishes robust, multi-scale visual-semantic correspondences and dynamically refines them at inference time to enhance generalization, and demonstrates that DynaPURLS significantly outperforms prior art, setting new state-of-the-art records.

2512.12677.tldr: Experiments show that the embedding-based method significantly outperforms the instruction-tuned method in F1-score, and is very competitive with - even surpassing - fine-tuned domain-specific models (e.g. BERT) on the same tasks.

2512.12683.tldr: Q-NeRF provides a foundational step toward scalable quantum-enabled 3D scene reconstruction and a baseline for future quantum neural rendering research, and highlights the potential of quantum encodings to alleviate spectral bias in implicit representations.

2512.12686.tldr: Memoria is presented, a modular memory framework that augments LLM-based conversational systems with persistent, interpretable, and context-rich memory that enables scalable, personalized conversational artificial intelligence (AI) by bridging the gap between stateless LLM interfaces and agentic memory systems.

2512.12692.tldr: This work introduces WebOperator, a tree-search framework that enables reliable backtracking and strategic exploration inLLM-based agents, and incorporates a best-first search strategy that ranks actions by both reward estimates and safety considerations, along with a robust backtracking mechanism that verifies the feasibility of previously visited paths before replaying them, preventing unintended side effects.

2512.12693.tldr: A novel Bayesian framework for efficient exploration in contextual multi-task multi-armed bandit settings, where the context is only observed partially and dependencies between reward distributions are induced by latent context variables, which demonstrates that this method outperforms baselines such as hierarchical model bandits.
