2512.12703.tldr: Experimental results indicate that the proposed robust part-level masked generation model successfully outperforms baselines on both clean and noisy datasets in terms of motion quality, semantic consistency and diversity.

2512.12706.tldr: This work proposes SMART (Structural Mapping for Augmented Reinforcement Testing), a novel framework that synergizes structural verification and functional validation for game update testing and demonstrates that SMART significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2512.12736.tldr: A behaviorally realistic demographic based data augmentation strategy that expands a small QoE dataset six fold by modeling varying user sensitivities to streaming impairments such as rebuffering, bitrate variation, and quality degradation is introduced.

2512.12760.tldr: This paper presents an integrated system for scientific literature exploration that combines large-scale data acquisition, hybrid retrieval, semantic topic modeling, and heterogeneous knowledge graph construction and contributes an extensible foundation for AI-assisted scientific discovery.

2512.12762.tldr: Theoretical analysis supports FLFA's design by showing how it alleviates local drift and demonstrates robust convergence for both local and global models, and empirical evaluations illustrate that FLFA can enhance other FL methods demonstrating its effectiveness.

2512.12773.tldr: The role of HCI is pointed out in the development of autonomous vehicles and addresses numerous needs with respect to those enforced safety and security standards and how personalized interfaces can enhance significantly both user engagement and satisfaction is demonstrated.

2512.12777.tldr: To truly understand the process that LLMs do, research must move beyond reading the reasoning tokens as text and focus on decoding them as state, which explains how the tokens can drive correct reasoning without being a faithful explanation when read as text.

2512.12785.tldr: This paper introduces Online Classification with Weighted Average (OLC-WA), an adaptive, hyperparameter-free online classification model equipped with an automated optimization mechanism that achieves performance comparable to batch models in stationary environments, maintaining accuracy within 1-3%, and surpasses leading online baselines by 10-25% under drift.

2512.12787.tldr: The Friedman test is employed along with corresponding post-hoc tests to compare multiple online regression models across various datasets and indicates that there is still room for improvement in certain aspects of state-of-the-art methods.

2512.12792.tldr: This work evaluates the LRT on Sudoku as a controlled testbed for structured reasoning and shows that it achieves strong performance, reaching 98.68% digit accuracy and 36.30% full-puzzle accuracy without using symbolic rules or search.

2512.12806.tldr: A Fault-Tolerant Sandboxing framework designed to mitigate safety risks through a policy-based interception layer and a transactional filesystem snapshot mechanism, hypothesize that wrapping agent actions in atomic transactions can guarantee safety with acceptable latency, outperforming the heavy initialization overhead of containers or the interactive friction of commercial CLIs.

2512.12809.tldr: The results indicate that operator-programmed, landscape-aware per-instance design is a practical way forward beyond ad hoc metaphor-based algorithms in black-box optimization.

2512.12812.tldr: Overall, this study indicates that while interaction tone can matter in specific interpretive settings, modern LLMs are broadly robust to tonal variation in typical mixed-domain use, providing practical guidance for prompt design and model selection in real-world deployments.

2512.12817.tldr: Through a systematic qualitative and quantitative analysis, grounded in the rhetorical principles, the strengths and limitations of human and GPT in debate reasoning are identified, outlining areas where AI's focus and justifications align with or diverge from human reasoning.

2512.12818.tldr: Hindsight is presented, a memory architecture that treats agent memory as a structured, first-class substrate for reasoning by organizing it into four logical networks that distinguish world facts, agent experiences, synthesized entity summaries, and evolving beliefs.

2512.12821.tldr: This work investigates a potential topological constraint: when the prior distribution and target distribution have mismatched topology, the optimal velocity field under standard flow matching objectives may exhibit spatial discontinuities, with magnitude approaching infinity as time approaches the target distribution.

2512.12822.tldr: This work develops a structured patchification and tokenization scheme that preserves spatial context, and a three-stage training curriculum that progressively builds capabilities from object-level recognition to scene-level spatial reasoning, providing a unified foundation for advancing 3D spatial intelligence in real-world applications.

2512.12824.tldr: This paper systematically evaluates a hierarchy of strategies, ranging from training-free hybrid prototyping to deep parameter adaptation via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and identifies an "augmentation divergence": while strong data augmentation degrades the performance of linear probing in low-shot settings, it is essential for stabilizing LoRA fine-tuning.

2512.12840.tldr: PRIVEE obfuscates confidence scores while preserving critical properties such as relative ranking and inter-score distances, mitigating the risk of reconstruction attacks without degrading model prediction accuracy.

2512.12842.tldr: The key idea is to disentangle high-level semantic intent from low-level visuomotor control by explicitly grounding task objectives in the observed environment by explicitly grounding task objectives in the observed environment by leveraging multimodal foundation models.

2512.12844.tldr: This work proposes a unified framework that integrates conformal prediction with selective classification, and develops two algorithms under this framework, which are a calibration-only variant that provides PAC-style probabilistic guarantees while being more computational efficient.

2512.12856.tldr: The Memory-Aware Retention Schema (MaRS) is introduced, a novel framework for human-centered memory management in generative agents, coupled with six theoretically-grounded forgetting policies that balance performance, privacy, and computational efficiency.

2512.12858.tldr: A novel application of GRPO for aligning LLMs toward information consistency, reframing variability not as an acceptable feature of generative diversity, but as a correctable flaw in enterprise deployments is proposed.

2512.12868.tldr: The Frequency-Based Probabilistic Ranker (FBPR), a lightweight method that scores options with a smoothed Naive Bayes over concept-diagnosis co-occurrence statistics from a large corpus, achieves comparable performance to the corresponding LLMs pretrained on that same corpus.

2512.12870.tldr: This work proposes a novel AL framework to construct a robust classification model by minimizing noise levels, and introduces a new sampling method to identify the best query points, reducing the impact of label noise on classifier performance.

2512.12885.tldr: A novel zero-shot recognition framework that adapts the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) paradigm to address this challenge, demonstrating the viability of RAG-based architectures for creating scalable and accurate systems for road sign recognition without task-specific training.

2512.12888.tldr: It is demonstrated that Meta-GPT can learn the compositional rules of light-matter interactions through METASTRINGS, laying a rigorous foundation for AI-driven photonics and representing an important step toward a metasurface genome project.

2512.12914.tldr: This work proposes an alternative approach to privacy alignment, inspired by safety alignment in LLMs, and demonstrates its effectiveness on a CTI use case, and shows that the framework is generic enough to be applicable to other sensitive domains.

2512.12918.tldr: This paper investigates a modular alternative that couples the ILP system PyGol with the SMT solver Z3, and demonstrates how a modular SMT-ILP architecture can extend the expressivity of symbolic rule learning, complementing prior numerical ILP approaches while providing a flexible basis for future extensions toward richer theory-aware induction.

2512.12921.tldr: Cisco's Integrated AI Security and Safety Framework is presented, a unified, lifecycle-aware taxonomy and operationalization framework that can be used to classify, integrate, and operationalize the full range of AI risks.

2512.12929.tldr: MADTempo is introduced, a video retrieval framework developed by the AIO_Trinh team that unifies temporal search with web-scale visual grounding, paving the way for more semantically aware and adaptive retrieval across large-scale video corpora.

2512.12935.tldr: Qualitative analysis demonstrates that the proposed unified multimodal moment retrieval system effectively handles ambiguous queries, retrieves temporally coherent sequences, and dynamically adapts fusion strategies, advancing interactive moment search capabilities.

2512.12936.tldr: This paper proposes a content adaptive based motion alignment framework that improves performance by adapting encoding strategies to diverse content characteristics by introducing a two-stage flow-guided deformable warping mechanism that refines motion compensation with coarse-to-fine offset prediction and mask modulation, enabling precise feature alignment.

2512.12950.tldr: A human-AI collaborative approach for building a multilingual legal terminology database, based on a multi-agent framework that integrates advanced large language models and legal domain experts throughout the entire process-from raw document preprocessing, article-level alignment, to terminology extraction, mapping, and quality assurance.

2512.12970.tldr: A DF AI model schema based on the state of the art is outlined, and the systemic complexity is identified and addressed with the adoption of human-readable artifacts and open standards.

2512.12987.tldr: Among the two models, the AR-CADPG approach demonstrates superior path-tracking accuracy and robustness, highlighting the effectiveness of combining temporal memory, adversarial resilience, and attention mechanisms in AVs.

2512.12997.tldr: This work proposes a novel adversarial fine-tuning objective for CLIP considering both prediction accuracy and uncertainty alignments, and reparameterizing the output of CLIP as the concentration parameter of a Dirichlet distribution that captures relative semantic structure and the magnitude of predictive confidence.

2512.13033.tldr: An optimization framework is proposed that leverages an asymmetric projection to decompose the backward-pass gradients into parallel spans and orthogonal violations, while keeping the canonical forward-pass QKV structure intact, confirming the framework's fundamental validity and suggesting significant potential gains on larger datasets and deeper training regimes.

2512.13063.tldr: A unified mathematical framework for modeling concession dynamics based on a hyperbolic tangent curve is introduced, and two metrics burstiness tau and the Concession-Rigidity Index (CRI) are proposed to quantify the timing and rigidity of offer trajectories.

2512.13070.tldr: This work introduces M-GRPO (Momentum-Anchored Group Relative Policy Optimization), a framework that leverages a slowly evolving momentum model to provide a stable training target and proposes an adaptive filtering method based on the interquartile range (IQR) that dynamically prunes low-entropy trajectories, preserving essential policy diversity.

2512.13074.tldr: A simple and effective framework named SCI is proposed comprising two synergistic modules: a symmetric representation alignment module that employs an innovative input-swapping mechanism to unify the dual-tower representation space without adding parameters, and an consistent indexing with dual-tower synergy module that redesigns retrieval paths using a dual-view indexing strategy to maintain consistency from training to inference.

2512.13094.tldr: This paper proposes a method termed Sequence of Experts (SoE), a temporal alternation policy that enhances closed-loop performance without increasing model size or data requirements, and demonstrates that SoE method consistently and significantly improves the performance of all the evaluated models, and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2512.13100.tldr: It is demonstrated that state-of-the-art generalist policies such as OpenVLA and $\pi_0$ benefit from fine-tuning on OXE-AugE, improving success rates on previously unseen robot-gripper combinations across four real-world manipulation tasks.

2512.13106.tldr: This work investigates a novel semi-supervised RLVR paradigm that utilizes a small labeled set to guide RLVR training on unlabeled samples, and proposes an effective policy optimization algorithm, TraPO, that identifies reliable unlabeled samples by matching their learning trajectory similarity to labeled ones.

2512.13109.tldr: This research first identifies an additional factor: initial saliency, which means that in the attention computation for each token, tokens with higher attention weights relative to the initial token tend to receive more attention in the prediction of the next token.

2512.13111.tldr: Hierarchical Approximate Bayesian Neural Network is presented, a novel approach that uses a Gaussian-inverse-Wishart distribution as a hyperprior of the network's weights to increase both the robustness and performance of the model.

2512.13122.tldr: DePT3R is proposed, a novel framework that simultaneously performs dense point tracking and 3D reconstruction of dynamic scenes from multiple images in a single forward pass, substantially enhancing its adaptability and efficiency in dynamic environments with rapid changes.

2512.13131.tldr: This paper proposes a unified Hierarchical Implicit Periodicity (HIP) learning approach for audio-inspired 3D gesture generation that outperforms the state-of-the-art co-speech gesture generation methods by both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

2512.13154.tldr: This paper proposes MAC (Multi-Agent Clarification), an interactive multi-agent framework specifically optimized to resolve user ambiguities by strategically managing clarification dialogues and introduces a novel taxonomy categorizing user ambiguities to systematically guide clarification strategies.

2512.13157.tldr: This work introduces Intrinsic Image Fusion, a method that reconstructs high-quality physically based materials from multi-view images that outperform state-of-the-art methods in material disentanglement on both synthetic and real scenes, producing sharp and clean reconstructions suitable for high-quality relighting.

2512.13159.tldr: SpeakRL is introduced, a reinforcement learning (RL) method that enhances agents' conversational capabilities by rewarding proactive interactions with users, such as asking right clarification questions when necessary, and presents a systematic analysis of reward design for conversational proactivity.

2512.13165.tldr: This work forms the Soft Actor-Critic with n-step returns (SAC$n) algorithm that is experimentally verify on MuJoCo simulated environments and presents an approach to applying numerically stable importance sampling with simplified hyperparameter selection.

2512.13186.tldr: PolySet is introduced, a framework that represents a polymer as a finite, weighted ensemble of chains sampled from an assumed molar-mass distribution, independent of chemical detail, compatible with any molecular representation and illustrated here in the homopolymer case using a minimal language model.

2512.13190.tldr: A differentiated data-driven approach recasting a long sequence of port-to-port international vessel trajectories as a nested sequence structure based on spatial grids mitigates the spatio-temporal bias of AIS data while preserving the detailed resolution of the original.

2512.13235.tldr: This research presents Contrastive Masked Feature Reconstruction (CORE), a novel graph self-supervised learning framework that integrates contrastive learning into MFR, and proposes a novel theoretical insight: under specific conditions, the objectives of MFR and node-level GCL converge, despite their distinct operational mechanisms.

2512.13240.tldr: Reflective Preference Optimization (RPO), a new framework that incorporates hint-guided reflection into the DPO paradigm, uses external models to identify hallucination sources and generate concise reflective hints, enabling the construction of on-policy preference pairs with stronger contrastiveness and clearer preference signals.

2512.13290.tldr: LINA (Learning INterventions Adaptively), a novel framework that learns to predict prompt-specific interventions, which employs (1) targeted guidance in the prompt and visual latent spaces, and (2) a reallocated, causality-aware denoising schedule.

2512.13297.tldr: This paper proposes MedInsightAgent, an automated agent framework for medical data analysis, composed of three modules: Visual Root Finder, Analytical Insight Agent, and Follow-up Question Composer, and demonstrates that MedInsightAgent can improve the performance of general LMMs in medical data insight discovery.

2512.13298.tldr: The instruction-tuned version of MiniLingua outperforms EuroLLM, a model with a similar training approach but a larger training budget, on summarization, classification and both open- and closed-book question answering, and remains competitive with more advanced state-of-the-art models on open-ended generation tasks.

2512.13300.tldr: A fine-grained Knowledge transfer framework for Asymmetric Multi-Label data (KAML) is proposed and an attribution-driven masking strategy (ADM) is introduced to better utilize data with asymmetric multi-label data in training to maximize the utility of unlabeled samples.

2512.13316.tldr: AlIGN-FL, a novel approach to distributed learning that addresses the challenge of learning from highly disjoint data distributions through selective sharing of generative components, enables privacy-preserving learning by transferring only generative capabilities across clients, while the server performs global training using synthetic samples.

2512.13317.tldr: This work evaluates several existing approximate class unlearning methods in the context of face retrieval and proposes a simple yet effective dispersion-based unlearning approach that achieves superior forgetting behavior while preserving retrieval utility.

2512.13323.tldr: An error-driven optimization framework for arithmetic reasoning that enhances a Code Generation Agent (CGA) and enabling small models to surpass larger language models (GPT-3.5 Turbo) in a privacy-compliant manner is introduced.

2512.13325.tldr: The findings of these experiments indicate that, especially the latest reasoning models, can detect a watermarked text, Nevertheless, all models fail to extract the watermark unless implementation details in the form of source code are provided.

2512.13330.tldr: FIN-bench-v2 consolidates Finnish versions of widely used benchmarks together with an updated and expanded version of the original FIN-bench into a single, consistently formatted collection, covering multiple-choice and generative tasks across reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, sentiment analysis, world knowledge, and alignment.

2512.13356.tldr: A reinforcement learning (RL) framework for controlling and stabilizing the Twin Rotor Aerodynamic System (TRAS) at specific pitch and azimuth angles and tracking a given trajectory and the results illustrated the effectiveness of the RL control method.

2512.13363.tldr: This study detects sentence-level emotions and measures emotion drift scores using pre-trained transformer models such as DistilBERT and RoBERTa to provide insights into patterns of emotional escalation or relief in mental health conversations.

2512.13374.tldr: Results show that LLMs exhibit moderate ability to recover feature information from problem instances, either through direct querying or probing, and the predictive power of LLM hidden-layer representations proves comparable to that achieved through traditional feature extraction, suggesting that LLMs capture meaningful structural information relevant to optimization performance.

2512.13399.tldr: Differentiable Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning is proposed, a bilevel framework that enables the autonomous discovery of optimal reward signals and achieves state-of-the-art performance on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, significantly outperforming methods relying on heuristic rewards, especially in out-of-distribution scenarios.

2512.13402.tldr: End2Reg is presented, an end-to-end deep learning framework that jointly optimizes segmentation and registration, eliminating the need for weak segmentation labels and manual steps.

2512.13438.tldr: UIFormer is the first automated optimization framework that synthesizes UI transformation programs by conducting constraint-based optimization with structured decomposition of the complex synthesis task, and is presented as a lightweight plugin that applies transformation programs for seamless integration with existing LLM agents, requiring minimal modifications to their core logic.

2512.13494.tldr: SkipCat is proposed, a novel low-rank compression framework that enables the use of higher ranks while achieving the same compression rates, and introduces an intra-layer shared low-rank projection method, where multiple matrices that share the same input use a common projection that reduces redundancy and improves compression efficiency.

2512.13501.tldr: Adaptive Feature Poisoning is proposed, a lightweight and proactive defense mechanism designed specifically for realistic black box scenarios that leverages traffic profiling, change point detection, and adaptive scaling to selectively perturb features that an attacker is likely exploiting, based on observed deviations.

2512.13510.tldr: This work proposes MedCEG, a framework that augments medical language models with clinically valid reasoning pathways by explicitly supervising the reasoning process through a Critical Evidence Graph (CEG), representing a solid advancement in reliable medical AI reasoning.

2512.13559.tldr: A stance-aware structural modeling that encodes each post in a discourse with its stance signal and aggregates reply embedddings by stance category enabling a scalable and semantically enriched representation of the entire thread is proposed.

2512.13568.tldr: An information-theoretic framework measuring a neural representation's effective degrees of freedom is presented, enabling principled measurement of how neural networks organize information under computational constraints, connecting superposition to adversarial robustness.

2512.13583.tldr: Extensive experiments on benchmark tasks show that the proposed DP-CSGP achieves comparable model accuracy with significantly lower communication cost than existing decentralized counterparts with exact communication.

2512.13586.tldr: ReFusion is introduced, a novel masked diffusion model that integrates sequence reorganization into the causal attention framework and simultaneously unlocks full KV cache reuse and reduces learning complexity from an intractable token combination space to a manageable slot-level permutation space.

2512.13600.tldr: A simple yet effective domain-adaptive self-supervised adaptor that realigns pretrained PFM features to the TURBT domain without fine-tuning the foundational model itself, demonstrating that lightweight domain adaptation with self-supervision can effectively enhance PFM-based MIL pipelines for clinically challenging histopathology tasks.

2512.13607.tldr: This work proposes cascaded domain-wise reinforcement learning (Cascade RL) to develop general-purpose reasoning models, Nemotron-Cascade, capable of operating in both instruct and deep thinking modes, reducing engineering complexity and delivering state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of benchmarks.

2512.13641.tldr: The study highlights the need to incorporate robustness assessments in the development of intelligent systems for agriculture, particularly in regions with technological limitations, and suggests that lightweight and specialized models may be more suitable for real-world applications in edge devices, where robustness and efficiency are critical.

2512.13644.tldr: To enable fine-grained dexterity, DexWM is introduced, a Dexterous Manipulation World Model that predicts the next latent state of the environment conditioned on past states and dexterous actions, and an auxiliary hand consistency loss that enforces accurate hand configurations.

2512.13654.tldr: It is shown that prompt-based models with memories, such as DeepSeek, can be more robust than previous BERT-based models on both tasks scoring about 2 points better than previous models not based on prompting.

2512.13658.tldr: Findings show that embedding-based alignment scores can facilitate scalable personalization by confirming alignment with learning outcomes, which allows teachers to focus on tailoring content to diverse learner needs.

2512.13678.tldr: Steer3D demonstrates that it is possible to add a new modality to steer the generation of pretrained image-to-3D generative models with 100k data, and more faithfully follows the language instruction and maintains better consistency with the original 3D asset, while being 2.4x to 28.5x faster.

2512.13690.tldr: This work proposes DiffusionBrowser, a model-agnostic, lightweight decoder framework that allows users to interactively generate previews at any point (timestep or transformer block) during the denoising process, and systematically probe the model using the learned decoders, revealing how scene, object, and other details are composed and assembled during the otherwise black-box denoising process.

2312.04960.tldr: A self-supervised AT method, MIMIR, is proposed that employs an MI penalty to facilitate adversarial pre-training by masked image modeling with autoencoders and demonstrates superior robustness against unforeseen attacks and common corruption data.

2507.17985.tldr: A replicable, LLM-assisted qualitative analysis pipeline that supports inductive theme discovery, codebook development, and large-scale annotation while preserving researcher control over conceptual synthesis is introduced.

2510.20768.tldr: This work proposes that the robustness of modern RAG defenses can be accelerated by applying source credibility algorithms on corpora, using PageRank as an example and demonstrates quantitatively that the algorithm applies a lower authority score to malicious documents while promoting trusted content.

2512.08786.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation framework is introduced that systematically assesses the trade-off between alignment quality and fairness when using different aggregation strategies for human preferences and introduces a novel adaptive scheme that dynamically adjusts preference weights based on a group's historical alignment performance.

2512.10984.tldr: Symmetry-Loss is a brain-inspired algorithmic principle that enforces invariance and equivariance through a differentiable constraint derived from environmental symmetries, showing how efficient, stable, and compositional representations can emerge from symmetry-based self-organization.

2512.13700.tldr: A secure, modular framework for automated structured feature extraction from clinical notes leveraging locally deployed large language models (LLMs) on institutionally approved, Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPPA)-compliant compute infrastructure is presented.

2512.13701.tldr: A blind radio map construction framework that infers user trajectories from indoor multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO)-Orthogonal Frequency-Division Multiplexing (OFDM) channel measurements without relying on location labels is presented.

2512.13702.tldr: The AI Product Passport addresses transparency gaps in healthcare AI, meeting regulatory and ethical demands, and is a web-based platform with a relational data model supporting auditable documentation that aligns with FUTURE-AI principles.

2512.13703.tldr: The Safe2Harm Semantic Isomorphism Attack method is proposed, which achieves efficient jailbreaking through four stages: first, rewrite the harmful question into a semantically safe question with similar underlying principles; second, extract the thematic mapping relationship between the two; third, let the LLM generate a detailed response targeting the safe question; finally, reversely rewrite the safe response based on the thematic mapping relationship to obtain harmful output.

2512.13704.tldr: Adjudicator is presented, a system that addresses the critical data mining challenge of automatically identifying and correcting label noise and has been validated for production deployment, serving as a vital proof-of-concept for generating golden datasets in strictly governed industrial environments.

2512.13705.tldr: This work investigates the transferability of annealing dynamics in large language model training and refine a generalized predictive framework for optimizing annealing strategies under the Warmup-Steady-Decay (WSD) scheduler, demonstrating that smaller models can serve as reliable proxies for optimizing the training dynamics of larger models.

2512.13713.tldr: LoopBench is introduced, a benchmark to evaluate LLM reasoning in distributed symmetry breaking and meta-cognitive thinking, and shows that while standard LLMs and classical heuristics struggle, advanced reasoning models (e.g., O3) devise strategies to escape deadlocks.

2512.13714.tldr: This paper presents an AI-based annotation pipeline that systematically identifies, labels, and fixes for instability patterns on LLM output and combines the models of automated weak supervision and confidence-based annotation with the target human validation to guarantee the reliability and moral uprightness of feedback information.

2512.13715.tldr: An adaptive Meta Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (Meta-HRL) framework is proposed, inspired by Model Agnostic Meta Learning (MAML), to jointly optimize resource allocation and network slicing in O-RAN.

2512.13716.tldr: ValuePilot is a two-phase value-driven decision-making framework comprising a dataset generation toolkit DGT and a decision-making module DMM trained on the generated data, capable of generating scenarios based on value dimensions and closely mirroring real-world tasks.

2512.13717.tldr: The proposed FFSL framework can support effective patient-adaptive seizure detection under realistic data-availability and privacy constraints and is suggested to support shared representation learning without centralizing EEG recordings.

2512.13724.tldr: PRETON generated neurological hypotheses that were evaluated across molecular, organoid, and clinical systems, defining a path for AI-driven discovery in neurological disease.

2512.13726.tldr: The experiments explore the use of reinforcement learning to recommend items for users using Alibaba's Personalized Re-ranking dataset supporting slate optimization in e-commerce contexts and empirical evidence that on-policy and off-policy control can improve performance under tight time budgets than traditional contextual bandit-based methods.

2512.13728.tldr: CurvaDion is introduced, which uses Relative Maximum Momentum Change (RMMC) to detect high-curvature regions requiring synchronization, and it is demonstrated that CurvaDion achieves 99\% communication reduction while matching baseline convergence across models from 160M to 1.3B parameters.

2512.13729.tldr: The novel composite classifier-free guidance (CCFG) can be dropped into any pre-trained diffusion model trained with standard CFG dropout and it is demonstrated that CCFG outputs are higher-fidelity than those from CFG on wind super-resolution tasks.

2512.13730.tldr: The model improved students'digital skills and strategic cognition while addressing AI ethics, providing a replicable approach combining technical and critical learning in design education.

2512.13731.tldr: A novel expression tokenizer, and a new representation called Structured Mathematical Language, which explicitly models the hierarchical and spatial structure of expressions beyond LaTeX format are introduced, which significantly outperforms existing MER models and MLLMs on CMER-Bench.

2512.13733.tldr: learning to Low-Rank Compress (LLRC), a gradient-based approach which directly learns the weights of masks that select singular values in a fine-tuning-free setting, which outperforms competing ranking selection methods that similarly require no post-compression fine-tuning across various compression rates on common-sense reasoning and open-domain question-answering tasks.

2512.13734.tldr: A FR training framework with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) based embedding designed to reduce the volume of embedding parameters that need to be transmitted and the use of Residual Quantized Variational Autoencoders (RQ-VAE) as a novel PEFT strategy within this framework is proposed.

2512.13735.tldr: DARTs, a robust long short-term dual-path framework with window-aware spatiotemporal soft fusion mechanism, which can be primarily decomposed into three complementary components, is proposed, which demonstrate the superiority and robustness of the proposed DARTs.

2512.13736.tldr: A time-frequency fusion and multi-domain cross-loss (TF-MCL) model for MDD detection that generates time-frequency hybrid representations through the use of a fusion mapping head (FMH), which efficiently remaps time-frequency domain information to the fusion domain, and thus can effectively enhance the model's capacity to synthesize time-frequency information.

2512.13739.tldr: This paper explores pathways for controllable image production in journalism's special coverage and proposes a human-AI collaboration mechanism for AIGC assisted image production in special coverage and recommends evaluating Character Identity Stability (CIS), Cultural Expression Accuracy (CEA), and User-Public Appropriateness (U-PA).

2512.13741.tldr: It is demonstrated that Semantic Turbulence serves not only as a lightweight, real-time jailbreak detector but also as a non-invasive diagnostic tool for categorizing the underlying safety architecture of black-box models.

2512.13744.tldr: This work surveys and evaluates robustness for state-of-the-art audio deepfake detection models and presents a reproducible framework that mixes MS-SNSD noises with ASVspoof 2021 DF utterances to evaluate under controlled signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs).

2512.13745.tldr: The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed H-STQGCN algorithm outperforms the current methods in terms of prediction accuracy and stability, validating the unique advantages of the quantum-enhanced mechanism in capturing high-dimensional spatial dependencies.

2512.13747.tldr: The empirical study shows that text-only reasoning consistently outperforms vision-only or vision-text settings, with multimodal inputs often performing worse than text alone.

2512.13750.tldr: Human creative contributions to AI-generated works may warrant protection, but the raw algorithmic output should remain in the public domain, advocates for a clear distinction.

2512.13751.tldr: Memory-Infused Depth Up-Scaling (MIDUS) is introduced, which replaces FFNs in duplicated blocks with a head-wise memory (HML) layer, enabling head-wise retrieval and injecting information into subsequent layers while preserving head-wise functional structure.

2512.13752.tldr: This work introduces STAR: a STacked AutoRegressive scheme for task-progressive unified multimodal learning, which freezes the parameters of the fundamental autoregressive (AR) model and progressively stacking isomorphic AR modules to avoid cross-task interference while expanding the model's capabilities.

2512.13758.tldr: This work presents the Hybrid Directed-Attention Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network (HDA-STGNN), an inductive deep learning framework designed to tackle the network-wide volume estimation problem and levers speed profiles, static road attributes, and road network topology to predict daily traffic volume profiles across all road segments in the network.

2512.13762.tldr: An interaction-level auditing framework based on observable behavior is proposed and learned incapacity (LI) is introduced as a behavioral descriptor for this selective withholding without implying intentionality or internal mechanisms, warranting further investigation across users and models.

2512.13764.tldr: A density theorem is interpreted as evidence that mathematics and coding provide ``universal coordinates'' for evaluation, and that formal mathematics is a natural ignition domain for recursive self-improvement in advanced AI agents.

2512.13765.tldr: A proof-of-concept deep learning framework is proposed as an efficient surrogate for forward solvers in electrocardiology, and the contributions of convolutional encoders, time-aware attention, and spectral entropy loss are confirmed.

2512.13768.tldr: The authors argue that the sustainable and cost-effective development of this capacity depends on its integration into education at every level, from professional training to lifelong learning, and establishes a theoretical foundation for future research on the pedagogical implementation and empirical validation of well-being effectiveness in multiple contexts.

2512.13771.tldr: The Semantic Grounding Index (SGI), defined as the ratio of angular distances from the response to the question versus the context on the unit hypersphere, provides computationally efficient, theoretically grounded infrastructure for identifying responses that warrant verification in production RAG deployments.

2512.13806.tldr: The proposed Disentangled Decoding Decomposition (D3), a weakly supervised method for training deep learning models across EEG datasets, gives researchers a tool to separate individual brain processes and potentially even uncover heretofore unknown dynamics.

2512.13834.tldr: The VajraV1 model architecture is presented, which introduces architectural enhancements over existing YOLO-based detectors to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy among real-time object detectors while maintaining competitive inference speed.

2512.13860.tldr: Verification-Guided Context Optimization (VGCO) is proposed, a framework that uses LLMs as editors to automatically refine tool-related documentation and knowledge base context and achieves significant improvements in accuracy, robustness, and generalization across LLMs.

2512.13880.tldr: An end-to-end infant cry analysis pipeline that integrates a denoising autoencoder, a convolutional tokenizer, and a Transformer encoder trained with communication-efficient federated learning (FL) is presented.

2512.13904.tldr: The work presents a validated, end-to-end system design that offers a practical roadmap for deploying scalable, real-time generative AI applications in multilingual communication platforms.

2512.13910.tldr: The results of this research confirm the viability of DL models for climate forecasting, solidifying a global trend in major meteorological and climate forecasting centers.

2512.13912.tldr: This book chapter reviews how systems of simple motile agents can be used as a pathway to intelligent systems and explores the approach of emergent computing in which specialized active matter systems are designed to directly solve a given task through emergent behavior.

2512.13914.tldr: This work establishes conversation branching as a fundamental primitive for AI-assisted exploratory work, demonstrating that isolation prevents context pollution when exploring alternatives and establishing version control semantics to LLM interactions.

2512.13930.tldr: Across two chemical applications, CO adsorption on Cu-surface transition metal (M) adatoms and on M-N-C catalysts, reasoning-driven exploration reduces required atomistic simulations by up to 90% relative to trial-and-error selection.

2512.13935.tldr: This work proposes a likelihood-free BO method that bypasses explicit surrogate modeling and directly leverages priors from general LLMs and chemistry-specific foundation models to inform acquisition functions, enabling efficient candidate selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search.

2210.12590.tldr: MetaEMS improves learning efficiency by transferring knowledge from previously solved tasks to new ones through group-level and building-level adaptation, enabling fast adaptation and effective control across diverse building environments.

2305.13127.tldr: A structurally transparent, clinically aligned framework for depression detection in social media to the information systems literature, which can generate dynamic emotional profiles for social platform users, assisting in the targeted allocation of mental health support resources.

2402.11542.tldr: The spatio-temporal complex question answering (STCQA) method is proposed, which jointly embeds temporal and spatial features into KG representations and dynamically filters answers through constraint-aware reasoning, achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing baselines.

2404.11496.tldr: This paper analyzes EDO on a three-objective function LOTZk, which is a modification of the two-objective benchmark function (LeadingOnes, TrailingZeros), and proves that the GSEMO computes a set of all Pareto-optimal solutions in O(kn3) expected iterations.

2406.07151.tldr: CrossPT-EEG is presented, a benchmark for cross-participant and cross-time generalization of visual decoding from EEG that highlights the dataset's potential to enhance EEG-based visual brain-computer interfaces, deepen the understanding of visual perception in biological systems, and suggest promising applications for improving machine vision models.

2410.07553.tldr: This work introduces COMMA: a novel puzzle benchmark designed to evaluate the collaborative performance of multimodal multi-agent systems through language communication, providing a comprehensive evaluation across four key categories of agentic capability in a communicative collaboration setting.

2410.10021.tldr: OCEAN is introduced, a novel online multi-modal causal structure learning method for root cause localization that employs a dilated convolutional neural network to capture long-term temporal dependencies and graph neural networks to learn causal relationships among system entities and key performance indicators.

2410.13597.tldr: This paper proposes a text-guided multi-property molecular optimization method utilizing transformer-based diffusion language model (TransDLM), which surpasses state-of-the-art methods in maintaining molecular structural similarity and enhancing chemical properties on the benchmark dataset.

2410.18127.tldr: This paper introduces DRPO, a novel method that views human preference alignment as a Learning-to-Rank (LTR) task that optimizes the preference ranking of entire response lists by computing holistic utility scores through NDCG, a standard LTR metric.

2411.09471.tldr: A Self-Supervised Learning framework that exploits the multi-resolution structure of Whole histological Slide Images to reduce annotation requirements while maintaining reliable diagnostic performance is investigated, demonstrating stable classification performance across all validation settings.

2411.12977.tldr: MindForge agents demonstrate sophisticated behaviors, including expert-novice knowledge transfer, collaborative problem solving, and adaptation to out-of-distribution tasks through accumulated cultural experiences through accumulated cultural experiences.

2411.13602.tldr: CardioNets is proposed, a deep learning framework that translates 12-lead ECG signals into CMR-level functional parameters and synthetic images, enabling scalable cardiac assessment and suggesting that CardioNets offers a promising, low-cost alternative to CMR for large-scale CVD screening, particularly in resource-limited settings.

2412.17744.tldr: A new benchmark, named RepoTransBench, is proposed, which is a real-world multilingual repository-level code translation benchmark featuring 1,897 real-world repository samples across 13 language pairs with automatically executable test suites and introduces RepoTransAgent, a general agent framework to perform repository-level code translation.

2502.14704.tldr: This work introduces the Self-Correction with Adaptive Mask (SCAM), which discards overfitted components and selectively replaces them with pseudo labels generated from reconstructions in a self-supervised paradigm, improving generalization for any predictor.

2502.21112.tldr: The ability of current-generation LLMs to identify text related to environmental activities is investigated and it is demonstrated that their performance can be significantly enhanced through fine-tuning on a combination of original and synthetically generated data.

2503.09330.tldr: This work addresses the overlooked problem of non-uniformly distributed forget sets, which it refers to as group-robust machine unlearning, and presents MIU (Mutual Information-aware Machine Unlearning), the first approach for group robustness in approximate machine unlearning.

2504.13676.tldr: This work introduces Trace Gadgets, a novel code representation that minimizes code context by removing non-related code that surpasses the detection capabilities of industry-standard static scanners such as GitHub's CodeQL by at least 4% on a fully unseen dataset.

2504.15610.tldr: A cost-effective method for adapting large language models for academic advising with study-abroad contexts in mind and for application in low-resource methods for acculturation, which support the effective application of instruction-tuned LLMs within educational advisers, especially in low-resource institutional scenarios.

2505.13109.tldr: The proposed FreeKV, a training-free algorithm-system co-optimization framework to enhance KV retrieval efficiency while preserving accuracy, introduces speculative retrieval to shift the KV selection and recall processes out of the critical path, combined with fine-grained correction to ensure accuracy.

2505.16097.tldr: TrialPanorama is introduced, a large-scale structured resource that aggregates 1.6M clinical trial records from fifteen global registries and links them with biomedical ontologies and associated literature and provides a solid foundation for future scaling of AI for clinical research.

2506.01983.tldr: The results of this research show that the proposed method have a significant improvement in the accuracy and efficiency of the prediction of antimicrobial peptides and are able to provide the best results compared to the existing methods.

2507.06249.tldr: This study aims to eliminate the need for pronunciation lexicons and propose a latent variable model based method, with phonemes being treated as discrete latent variables, and finds that in language domain adaptation, JSA-SPG outperforms the standard practice of language model fusion via the auxiliary support of the G2P model by 9% error rate reductions.

2507.14417.tldr: Five distinct failure modes when models reason for longer are identified, suggesting that while test-time compute scaling remains promising for improving model capabilities, it may inadvertently reinforce problematic reasoning patterns.

2508.00969.tldr: MORPHEUS is the first multimodal pre-training strategy that integrates histopathology images and multi-omics data within a shared transformer-based architecture and shows substantial improvements over supervised and SSL baselines across diverse tasks and modality combinations.

2508.01031.tldr: This work presents an agent for CAD conceptual design powered by large language models (LLMs) that generates high-quality CAD modeling code based on a novel Explicit Context Imperative Paradigm (ECIP).

2508.01977.tldr: The Sunshine-thinking LLM family is developed, a series of Tibetan-centric LLMs equipped with chain-of-thought capabilities comparable to state-of-the-art (SOTA) multilingual LLMs, enabling high-quality Tibetan language processing through both resource creation and model innovation.

2508.06453.tldr: The proposed Text-Swin-UMamba model outperformed prior approaches: 37% improvement over the LLM-driven LanGuideMedSeg model, and surpassed the purely image-based xLSTM-UNet and nnUNet models by 1.74% and 0.22%, respectively.

2508.16313.tldr: REFINE introduces three systematic queries to construct structured feedback to enhance multimodal reasoning by prioritizing relevant visual information, diagnosing critical failure points, and formulating corrective actions, and optimizes structured feedback retrieval.

2508.18395.tldr: Latent Self-Consistency (LSC) is introduced, which selects the most semantically consistent response using learnable token embeddings using learnable token embeddings and provides well-calibrated confidence estimates, maintaining low expected calibration error across both answer formats.

2509.12875.tldr: A Latent Thought-Augmented Training Framework--LTA-Thinker is proposed, which improves distributional variance and enhances reasoning performance from two perspectives and introduces a distribution-based directional optimization paradigm that jointly constrains both distribution locality and distribution scale.

2509.14287.tldr: A geometry-preserving variational autoencoder framework, called PrIVAE, which learns latent sequence embeddings that respect the geometry of their property space, and evaluates the utility of the framework for two generative tasks: design of DNA sequences that template fluorescent metal nanoclusters and design of antimicrobial peptides.

2509.17116.tldr: It is theoretically prove that MCTS-EP achieves better performance bounds than conventional on-policy algorithms when the loss function is strongly convex, and it is demonstrated that it can be formulated as a search-enhanced variant of GAIL.

2509.18054.tldr: This paper introduces a new recommendation method to make this expertise accessible, based on a Knowledge Graph-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) framework, which is tested on a use case consisting of six problems comprising of complex multi-objective and multi-constraint FLP case.

2509.18638.tldr: Prima is the first vision language model serving as an AI foundation for neuroimaging that supports real-world, clinical MRI studies as input and demonstrates algorithmic fairness across sensitive groups and can help mitigate health system biases, such as prolonged turnaround times for low-resource populations.

2509.20935.tldr: GALAX (Graph Augmented LAnguage model with eXplainability), an innovative framework that integrates pretrained Graph Neural Networks into Large Language Models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning guided by a Graph Process Reward Model (GPRM), providing a scalable and biologically grounded framework for explainable, reinforcement-guided subgraph reasoning toward reliable and interpretable target discovery in precision medicine.

2509.22284.tldr: PD-SSM is proposed, a structured sparse parametrization of transition matrices in SSMs that enables FSA state tracking with optimal state size and depth, while keeping the computational cost of the recurrence comparable to that of diagonal SSMs.

2509.23085.tldr: Odd-sigmoid activations are introduced and an activation aware initialization tailored to any function in this class is proposed, suggesting that diagonal-plus-noise weights provide a practical alternative when Gaussian initialization breaks down.

2510.01115.tldr: This work treats the supply chain network as a KG, allowing them to use structural network science principles for retrieval, and employs novel ``context shells''-- descriptive templates that embed raw figures in natural language -- to make quantitative data fully intelligible to the LLM.

2510.10767.tldr: This paper theoretically characterize this reward gap and provide non-vacuous bounds for general diffusion models, along with sharper convergence rates for Variance Exploding (VE) and Variance Preserving (VP) Gaussian models, and adopts the generalized denoising diffusion implicit models (gDDIM) framework.

2510.14112.tldr: This article proposes spatial–temporal-enhanced safe multiagent coordination (STEMS), a novel safety-constrained multiagent reinforcement learning (RL) framework for coordinated building energy management that demonstrates strong robustness during extreme weather conditions and maintains effectiveness across different building types.

2511.01170.tldr: DART provides a stable and general paradigm for efficient reasoning, advancing the development of adaptive intelligence in LLMs and across multiple mathematical benchmarks, experimental results demonstrate its remarkable efficiency.

2511.09605.tldr: TomoGraphView is a novel framework that integrates omnidirectional volume slicing with spherical graph-based feature aggregation that samples both canonical and non-canonical cross-sections generated from uniformly distributed points on a sphere enclosing the volume.

2511.10210.tldr: This work proposes a novel advanced black-box tuning method that achieves comparable or superior accuracy to query-intensive approaches, while significantly reducing API costs, and offers a robust and high-efficiency paradigm for language model adaptation.

2511.10333.tldr: An entropy-driven dynamic gradient compression framework called EDGC is proposed, to adjust the compression rate during LLM training based on the evolving trends of gradient entropy, taking into account both compression efficiency and error.

2511.10400.tldr: CP-WBFT, a confidence probe-based weighted Byzantine Fault Tolerant consensus mechanism to enhance the stability of MAS with different topologies by employing a probe-based, weighted information flow transmission method to improve the reliability of LLM-based agents, achieves superior performance across diverse network topologies under extreme Byzantine conditions.

2511.15407.tldr: The proposed IPR (Interactive Physical Reasoner), using world-model rollouts to score and reinforce a VLM's policy, and PhysCode, a physics-centric action code aligning semantic intent with dynamics to provide a shared action space for prediction and reasoning support physics-centric interaction as a path to steadily improving physical reasoning.

2511.17558.tldr: Experimental results on the publicly available SEVIR dataset demonstrate that WaveC2R achieves state-of-the-art performance in satellite-based radar retrieval, particularly excelling at preserving high-intensity precipitation features and sharply defined meteorological boundaries.

2511.19317.tldr: This study developed a new Bangla abstractive summarization dataset to generate concise summaries of Bangla articles from diverse sources to provide a solid foundation for building robust summarization systems and helps expand NLP resources for low-resource languages.

2511.21626.tldr: This work extends KAG analysis to MNIST digit classification using 2-layer MLPs with systematic spatial analysis at multiple scales and finds that KAG emerges during training and appears consistently across spatial scales, from local 7-pixel neighborhoods to the full 28x28 image.

2511.23442.tldr: ASTRO is proposed, a data augmentation framework that generates distributionally novel and dynamics-consistent trajectories for offline RL and outperforms prior offline RL augmentation methods across various algorithms, achieving notable performance gain on the challenging OGBench suite and demonstrating consistent improvements on standard offline RL benchmarks such as D4RL.

2512.00204.tldr: Tree Matching Networks (TMN) is able to achieve significantly better results with a significantly reduced memory footprint and much less training time than the BERT based model on the SNLI task, while both models struggled to preform well on the SemEval.

2512.00888.tldr: A fully reproducible benchmark that reports test accuracy together with wall-clock latency, peak CPU RAM, and peak GPU VRAM on four public datasets on four public datasets is presented to quantify the substantial hardware-versus-accuracy trade-offs in current tabular FMs.

2512.02716.tldr: This study introduces Menta, the first optimized SLM fine-tuned specifically for multi-task mental health prediction from social media data, and highlights the potential for scalable, privacy-preserving mental health monitoring.

2512.05442.tldr: This study highlights the advantages of non-ideal negative samples and proposes the IdealTSF framework, which integrates both ideal positive and negative samples for time series forecasting and is particularly well-suited for applications with noisy samples or low-quality data.

2512.06112.tldr: WAM-Flow, a vision-language-action model that casts ego-trajectory planning as discrete flow matching over a structured token space, establishes discrete flow matching as a new promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving.

2512.07829.tldr: FAE (Feature Auto-Encoder), a simple yet effective framework that adapts pre-trained visual representations into low-dimensional latents suitable for generation using as little as a single attention layer, while retaining sufficient information for both reconstruction and understanding.

2512.08743.tldr: This work argues that the next frontier is endowing FMs with native multi-agent intelligence, and outlines key research directions -- spanning dataset construction, evaluation, training paradigms, and safety considerations -- for building FMs with native multi-agent intelligence.

2512.08980.tldr: This work proposes IMAgent, an open-source vision agent trained via end-to-end reinforcement learning dedicated for complex multi-image tasks, and develops two specialized tools for visual reflection and confirmation, allowing the model to proactively reallocate its attention to image content during inference.

2512.11811.tldr: VPR-AttLLM, a model-agnostic framework integrating the semantic reasoning and geospatial knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) into VPR pipelines via attention-guided descriptor enhancement, offers a scalable solution for rapid geo-localization of crowdsourced crisis imagery, advancing cognitive urban resilience.

2512.11827.tldr: It is concluded that MLLMs can support, but not replace, context sensitive greenspace evaluation in planning practice, and the need for human oversight and complementary participatory approaches is underscored.

2512.11870.tldr: Methods for establishing an on-road emissions baseline and evaluating policies that leverage socio-economic indicators and Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) to accelerate ZEV adoption and reduce VMT are presented.

2512.11872.tldr: WAM-Diff is presented, a VLA framework that employs masked diffusion to iteratively refine a discrete sequence representing future ego-trajectories, supporting scenario-aware decoding strategies for trajectory generation and providing a promising alternative to autoregressive and diffusion-based policies.

2512.11919.tldr: This paper provides quantifying measures that capture the strength and nature of causal effects on events, and shows that the common measures of treatment effect can recover the common measures of treatment effect as special cases.

2512.12012.tldr: This work introduces Semantic-Drive, a local-first, neuro-symbolic framework for semantic data mining, and implements a"System 2"inference-time alignment strategy, utilizing a multi-model"Judge-Scout" consensus mechanism to mitigate hallucination.

2512.12045.tldr: In this study, AI functioned as a third agent, an active participant that mediated feedback, supported inquiry, and extended teachers' instructional reach while preserving human judgment and teacher authority.

2512.12066.tldr: The stability of safety refusal decisions across random seeds and temperature settings is investigated, demonstrating that single-shot safety evaluations are insufficient for reliable safety assessment and that evaluation protocols must account for stochastic variation in model behavior.

2512.12791.tldr: An end-to-end Agent Assessment Framework with four evaluation pillars encompassing LLMs, Memory, Tools, and Environment is proposed and validated on a representative Autonomous CloudOps use case, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing runtime uncertainties.

2512.13164.tldr: A Correlation-Regulated Alignment Framework for Tissue Synthesis (CRAFTS), the first generative foundation model for pathology-specific text-to-image synthesis, is introduced, effectively unlocking the creation of robust diagnostic tools for rare and complex cancer phenotypes.

2512.13293.tldr: This paper proposes a novel coordinated-exploration multi-robot RL algorithm introducing an intrinsic motivation exploration designed to collectively alleviate policy conservatism, and demonstrates the proposed algorithm's superior performance over existing state-of-the-art methods across crucial metrics.

2512.13955.tldr: A MUlti-dimensional Reputation-based Incentive Mechanism that jointly considers client reliability, privacy, resource capacity, and fairness while preventing malicious or unreliable clients from earning undeserved rewards is proposed.

2512.13978.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark of four frontier models: GPT-5-Thinking, Gemini-3-Pro, Claude-Sonnet-4.5-Thinking, Grok-4, and Grok-4 against the classic curriculum of Randomized Algorithms by Motwani and Raghavan is presented.

2512.13979.tldr: This work segments the model's reasoning into steps, identifies the steps corresponding to reflection, and extracts a reflection direction in the latent space that governs this behavior, and proposes a stepwise steering method that can control reflection frequency.

2512.13996.tldr: DTop-p MoE is proposed, a sparsity-controllable dynamic Top-p routing mechanism that consistently outperforms both Top-k and fixed-threshold Top-p baselines and exhibits strong scaling properties with respect to expert granularity, expert capacity, model size, and dataset size.

2512.14012.tldr: Investigating how experienced developers use agents in building software finds that while experienced developers value agents as a productivity boost, they retain their agency in software design and implementation out of insistence on fundamental software quality attributes, employing strategies for controlling agent behavior leveraging their expertise.

2512.14014.tldr: This work introduces MobileWorldBench, a benchmark that evaluates the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to function as world models for mobile GUI agents and proposes a novel framework that integrates VLM world models into the planning framework of mobile agents, demonstrating that semantic world models can directly benefit mobile agents by improving task success rates.

2512.14017.tldr: KFS-Bench is proposed, the first benchmark for key frame sampling in long video question answering (QA), featuring multi-scene annotations to enable direct and robust evaluation of sampling strategies, and a novel sampling quality metric that correlates with QA accuracy is designed.

2512.14018.tldr: PerfCoder is introduced, a family of LLMs specifically designed to generate performance-enhanced code from source code via interpretable, customized optimizations, and rises the performance of 32B models and GPT-5 to new levels on code optimization, substantially surpassing their original performance.

2512.14031.tldr: Overall, the findings indicate that VLA offers practical advantages for changing tasks by reducing programming effort and enabling useful performance with minimal data, while DQN provides a viable baseline when sufficient tuning effort is acceptable.

2512.14032.tldr: This system is the first one to achieve strict real-time in neural implicit RGB-D SLAM by relying on a SCR-based representation, and introduces a novel SCR architecture specifically tailored for this purpose.

2512.14043.tldr: This is the first work explicitly evaluating the feasibility of SLM as engines for dairy farming decision-making, with central emphases on privacy and computational efficiency.

2512.14048.tldr: This work proposes RoutingGen, a novel difficulty-aware routing framework that dynamically adapts prompting strategies for code generation and introduces a structured reasoning strategy, termed Intention Chain-of-Thought (ICoT), which is introduced to guide the model in capturing task intention.

2512.14051.tldr: This work introduces OpenDataArena (ODA), a holistic and open platform designed to benchmark the intrinsic value of post-training data, and envisions a shift from trial-and-error data curation to a principled science of Data-Centric AI.

2512.14056.tldr: Extensive experiments validate that talking face editing and generation emerge as subtasks of speech-conditional motion infilling; FacEDiT produces accurate, speech-aligned facial edits with strong identity preservation and smooth visual continuity while generalizing effectively to talking face generation.

2512.14058.tldr: A multimodal deep learning framework that predicts indoor workplane illuminance distributions in real time from non-intrusive images with temporal-spatial features by extracting image features only from the side-lit window areas rather than interior pixels is proposed.

2512.14067.tldr: A continuous pretraining scheme with a block-wise attention pattern, which remains causal across blocks while enabling bidirectional modeling within each block is introduced, which can better preserve pretrained AR models'weight distributions than fully bidirectional modeling, and leads to a win-win in accuracy and efficiency.

2512.14068.tldr: SDAR-VL sets a new state of the art among diffusion-based vision-language models and, under matched settings, matches or surpasses strong AR baselines such as LLaVA-OneVision as well as the global diffusion baseline LLaDA-V, establishing block-wise diffusion as a practical backbone for VLU.

2512.14069.tldr: RADAR is proposed, a novel speculative sampling method with RL-based dynamic draft trees that formulates the draft tree generation process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and employs offline reinforcement learning to train a prediction model, which enables real-time decision on the calls to the draft model, reducing redundant computations and further accelerating inference.

2512.14079.tldr: This work proposes a more structured framework that explores the same space through a fixed set of simple, composable components, and shows that, despite lacking the generative flexibility of LLMs during the candidate generation stage, this method outperforms prior approaches on four out of five benchmarks across two domains.

2512.14080.tldr: A memory-efficient algorithm to compute the forward and backward passes of MoEs with minimal activation caching for the backward pass is proposed, and a novel"token rounding" method that minimizes the wasted compute due to padding in Grouped GEMM kernels is proposed.

2512.14092.tldr: ProtoFlow is introduced, a novel framework that learns dynamic scene graph prototypes to model complex surgical workflows in an interpretable and robust manner and represents a significant step toward developing more transparent, reliable, and data-efficient AI systems.

2512.14102.tldr: This work introduces RUNE (Reasoning Using Neurosymbolic Entities), an approach that combines Large Language Models (LLMs) with neurosymbolic AI to retrieve images by reasoning over the compatibility between detected entities and First-Order Logic expressions derived from text queries.

2512.14112.tldr: This study proposes a hybrid LNN+XGBoost model for multi-tier supply chains that aims to minimize the bullwhip effect and increase profitability, addressing the need for efficiency and adaptability in intelligent SCM.

2512.14138.tldr: This work introduces LAPPI (LLM-Assisted Preference-based Problem Instantiation), an interactive approach that uses large language models to support users in this instantiation process of problem instantiation.

2512.14141.tldr: This work presents the first benchmark dataset specifically designed to evaluate and improve ML models'ability to detect anti patterns in traces, and proposes a novel iterative approach: a lightweight ML model first detects trace segments with anti patterns, followed by a large language model (LLM) for fine grained classification and targeted feedback.

2512.14157.tldr: Ophiuchus is introduced, a versatile, tool-augmented framework that equips an MLLM to decide when additional visual evidence is needed, determine where to probe and ground within the medical image, and seamlessly weave the relevant sub-image content back into an interleaved, multimodal chain of thought.

2512.14179.tldr: This work contributes an effective, fine-tuning-free solution for low-resource dialect translation, offering a practical blueprint for preserving linguistic diversity.

2512.14181.tldr: Evaluations across diverse datasets and encoder designs demonstrate XQAI-Eyes's potential to support the exploration of the relationship between encoder design and QNN effectiveness, offering a holistic and transparent approach to optimizing quantum encoders.

2512.14185.tldr: ELVIS (End-to-end Learning-based VIdeo Streaming Enhancement Pipeline), an end-to-end architecture that combines server-side encoding optimizations with client-side generative in-painting to remove and reconstruct redundant video data, is introduced.

2512.14202.tldr: Hyper++ is introduced, a new hyperbolic deep RL agent that consists of three components: feature regularization guaranteeing bounded norms while avoiding the curse of dimensionality from clipping; a categorical value loss for stable critic training; and a more optimization-friendly formulation of hyperbolic network layers.

2512.14211.tldr: This work proposes embedding the fundamental physics of MRI, the Bloch equation, in the loss of PINN, which is solely based on target scan data and does not require a pre-defined training database, and establishes a theoretical foundation for evaluating the PINN's quantitative accuracy.

2512.14220.tldr: This work proposes a new method for estimating problem difficulty, LLM compare, that represents a significant step towards replacing time-consuming human annotations and synthetic data generation, and will be an important driver for curriculum design, model evaluation, and AI-assisted research ideation.

2512.14233.tldr: PentestEval is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLMs across six decomposed penetration testing stages: Information Collection, Weakness Gathering and Filtering, Attack Decision-Making, Exploit Generation and Revision, and Revision.

2512.14252.tldr: A new approach to computer theorem proving is introduced, one that employs specialized language models for Lean4 proof generation combined with recursive decomposition of difficult theorems into simpler entailing propositions.

2512.14263.tldr: This paper introduces an inherently interpretable decision tree-based surrogate model capable of handling both categorical and continuous data, and scalable to large datasets, and applies it to the real-world Sushi dataset.

2512.14277.tldr: SPARQL-LLM is an open-source and triplestore-agnostic approach, powered by lightweight metadata, that generates SPARQL queries from natural language text that demonstrates a substantial increase in the F1 Score on the state-of-the-art challenge, adaptability to high-resource languages such as English and Spanish, as well as ability to form complex and federated bioinformatics queries.

2512.14278.tldr: TAIGHA and TAIGHA-S are validated instruments for assessing user trust and distrust in AI-generated health advice, and the short scale is well-suited for time-constrained settings.

2512.14288.tldr: The potential of human-LLM collaboration in advancing ontology engineering, particularly in complex domains like PD, is underscored and promising directions for future research are suggested, including the development of specialized GPT models for ontology construction.

2512.14312.tldr: Results confirm that VLMs, particularly with zero-shot, can replace YOLOv8 for efficient, annotation-free WWTP classification, enabling scalable remote sensing.

2512.14320.tldr: The Immunization Success Rate (ISR) is introduced, a novel metric designed to rigorously quantify true immunization efficacy for the first time, and shows the SIFM achieves the state-of-the-art performance for safeguarding visual content against malicious diffusion-based manipulation.

2512.14330.tldr: It is concluded that globally harmonized legal standards are essential to foster technological innovation while ensuring minimum risk and clear liability attribution.

2512.14332.tldr: The Step-Tagging framework is introduced, a lightweight sentence-classifier enabling real-time annotation of the type of reasoning steps that an LRM is generating and demonstrated that online monitoring of the count of specific steps can produce effective interpretable early stopping criteria of LRM inferences.

2512.14333.tldr: A Dual Attention-Guided Noise Perturbation (DANP) immunization method that adds imperceptible perturbations to disrupt the model's semantic understanding and generation process and exhibits impressive immunity against malicious edits.

2512.14341.tldr: Transferable Defense Against Malicious Image Edits (TDAE) is proposed, a novel bimodal framework that enhances image immunity against malicious edits through coordinated image-text optimization and introduces FlatGrad Defense Mechanism, which incorporates gradient regularization into the adversarial objective.

2512.14354.tldr: This work proposes a novel self-explaining framework that integrates Shapley value estimation as an auxiliary task during training, which achieves two key advancements: a fair allocation of the model prediction scores to image patches, and enhanced interpretability with minor structural modifications, preserving model performance and compatibility.

2512.14361.tldr: This work proposes CaDyT, a novel method for causal discovery on dynamical systems addressing both challenges of real world systems evolving in continuous-time according to their underlying causal relationships, and outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both regularly and irregularly sampled data.

2512.14391.tldr: By continually pre-training on the OLMo-2 1B&7B models, it is demonstrated that RePo consistently enhances performance on tasks involving noisy contexts, structured data, and longer context length, while maintaining competitive performance on general short-context tasks.

2512.14417.tldr: PortAgent is proposed, an LLM-driven vehicle dispatching agent that fully automates the VDS transferring workflow and bears three features: no need for port operations specialists; low need of data; and fast deployment.

2512.14427.tldr: Investigation of how different document-packing strategies influence the latent multi-hop reasoning abilities of LLMs indicates that packing can improve model performance compared to training on individual documents, at the expense of more compute.

2512.14429.tldr: This paper introduces the first Model Context Protocol (MCP) server suite for SPECFEM (supporting 2D, 3D Cartesian, and 3D Globe versions), which decomposes the entire simulation process into discrete, agent-executable tools spanning from parameter generation and mesh partitioning to solver execution and visualization.

2512.14448.tldr: This work introduces Generative Style Injection (GSI), an attack method that rewrites retrieved documents into pathological tones without altering underlying facts or using explicit triggers, demonstrating that reasoning style is a distinct, exploitable vulnerability, necessitating process-level defenses beyond static content analysis.

2512.14474.tldr: Inspired by classical AI planning, Model-First Reasoning is proposed, a two-phase paradigm in which the LLM first constructs an explicit model of the problem, defining entities, state variables, actions, and constraints, before generating a solution plan.

2512.14477.tldr: A new publicly available dataset containing annotated images of three different tunnel linings, capturing typical defects: cracks, leaching, and water infiltration, designed to support supervised, semi-supervised, and unsupervised DL methods for defect detection and segmentation.

2512.14481.tldr: SASQ exclusively optimizes only the quantization factors (without changing pre-trained weights), enabling static inference with high accuracy while maintaining deployment efficiency, and not only surpasses existing SOTA quantization schemes but also outperforms the corresponding FP16 models.

2512.14491.tldr: Experimental results show that SMMT maintains competitive predictive performance while significantly reducing training time, memory usage, and energy consumption compared to dense attention baselines, demonstrating its suitability as a resource-aware architectural component for scalable intelligent systems.

2512.14527.tldr: A novel scheduler that adaptively adjusts the learning rate during training based on the current loss, which is easy to implement, computationally efficient, and could be considered a good default scheduler for training.

2512.14540.tldr: The results indicate that learning rich, context-aware instance representations before aggregation is an effective and scalable alternative to complex pooling for whole-slide analysis.

2512.14560.tldr: This work proposes a novel correspondence-aware feature refinement framework, termed CLNet, that explicitly bridges the semantic and geometric gaps between different views, and can jointly capture both high-level semantics and fine-grained alignments.

2512.14562.tldr: PolyPersona, a generative framework for synthesizing persona-conditioned survey responses across multiple domains, provides an efficient and reproducible approach for survey data generation, supporting scalable evaluation while facilitating bias analysis through transparent and open protocols.

2512.14563.tldr: The proposed Residual GRU with Multi-Head Self-Attention with residual bidirectional gated recurrent units provides a strong balance between accuracy and efficiency for clinical risk prediction, supporting deployment in resource-constrained healthcare settings.

2512.14576.tldr: This tutorial presents strategies for tackling the challenges of data scarcity and cultural variance, offering hands-on methods and modeling frameworks that focus on fair, reproducible, and community-informed development approaches, grounded in real-world scenarios.

2512.14585.tldr: This study presents a GPT-2-based Nepali language model trained using several training strategies inspired by GPT-3, including optimized learning rate schedules, batch scaling, and architectural refinements, demonstrating its capability to generate coherent Nepali news-style text.

2512.14601.tldr: FakeRadar introduces Forgery Outlier Probing, which employs dynamic subcluster modeling and cluster-conditional outlier generation to synthesize outlier samples near boundaries of estimated subclusters, simulating novel forgery artifacts beyond known manipulation types.
