2512.14617.tldr: QR-MAX is a novel model-based RL algorithm for discrete NMRDPs that factorizes Markovian transition learning from non-Markovian reward handling via reward machines and exploits PAC convergence to $\varepsilon$-optimal policies with polynomial sample complexity.

2512.14620.tldr: It is believed that JMMMU-Pro provides a more rigorous evaluation tool for assessing the Japanese capabilities of LMMs and that the Vibe Benchmark Construction also offers an efficient guideline for future development of image-based VQA benchmarks.

2512.14629.tldr: The first MCP evaluation benchmark is introduced, MuseCPBench, which covers four categories of musical facets and enables comprehensive comparisons across five representative music editing baselines and identifies consistent preservation gaps in current music editing methods.

2512.14677.tldr: The experiment shows that VASA-3D produces realistic 3D talking heads that cannot be achieved by prior art, and it supports the online generation of 512x512 free-viewpoint videos at up to 75 FPS, facilitating more immersive engagements with lifelike 3D avatars.

2512.14686.tldr: A novel analysis of the bias-variance trade-off in gradient clipping yields new unified complexity guarantees for clipped SFOMs across this full range of tail indices, covering regimes ranging from noise with bounded variance to noise with an infinite mean, where the latter case has been scarcely studied.

2512.14692.tldr: A new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance that can robustly model arbitrary topology, and a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space.

2512.14697.tldr: This paper presents a unified formulation of different non-parametric quantization methods through the lens of lattice coding, and finds the Leech lattice-based quantization method, which is dubbed as Spherical Leech Quantization ($\Lambda_{24}$-SQ), leads to both a simplified training recipe and an improved reconstruction-compression tradeoff.

2512.14698.tldr: TimeLens is presented, a systematic investigation into building MLLMs with strong VTG ability, along two primary dimensions: data quality and algorithmic design, which culminate in a family of MLLMs with state-of-the-art VTG performance among open-source models and even surpass proprietary models.

2305.16424.tldr: A memory-efficient solution to catastrophic forgetting using the idea of matrix sketching, in the context of a simple continual learning algorithm known as orthogonal gradient descent (OGD), which tends to outperform current state-of-the-art variants of OGD given a fixed memory budget.

2311.13546.tldr: This work proposes application-specific SQC, a principle that applies obfuscation at the application layer to enable practical deployment while remaining agnostic to algorithms, computing models, and hardware architectures, and presents Enigma, the first realization of this principle for quantum optimization.

2408.15538.tldr: This paper introduces TrafficGamer, which facilitates game-theoretic traffic simulation by viewing common road driving as a multi-agent game and demonstrates that the generated scenarios can dynamically adapt to equilibria of varying tightness by configuring risk-sensitive constraints during optimization.

2411.16380.tldr: UltraFedFM surpasses the diagnostic accuracy of mid-level ultrasonographers and matches the performance of expert-level sonographers in the joint diagnosis of 8 common systemic diseases, marking a significant advancement in AI-driven ultrasound imaging for future clinical applications.

2411.17645.tldr: This study leverage a linked EHR dataset of approximately one million de-identified individuals from Bristol, North Somerset, and South Gloucestershire, UK to characterize urinary tract infections (UTIs) and introduces a UTI risk estimation framework informed by clinical expertise to estimate UTI risk across individual patient timelines.

2412.04783.tldr: K-Nearest Neighbors Maximum Mean Discrepancy (KNN-MMD) is proposed, a novel few-shot method for cross-domain wireless sensing that addresses a key instability issue commonly observed in cross-domain methods, where model performance fluctuates sharply between epochs.

2412.10621.tldr: WaveGNN combines a decay-aware Transformer to capture intra-series dynamics with a sample-specific graph neural network that models both short-term and long-term inter-sensor relationships, enhancing interpretability and supporting clinical decision-making.

2501.13439.tldr: An efficient one-cycle structured pruning framework that integrates pre-training, pruning, and fine-tuning into a single training cycle without sacrificing accuracy, guided by norm-based group saliency criteria and structured sparsity regularization is proposed.

2503.19712.tldr: It is demonstrated that rigid-deformation decomposition enables accurate and physically interpretable predictions for nonlinear collision dynamics and benchmarked the decomposed components against an oracle model that represents an upper bound on performance.

2504.06928.tldr: It is argued that understanding AI's impact on epistemic agency requires analyzing these systems as epistemic infrastructures rather than as neutral tools, and a framework is advanced that foregrounds how AI systems reconfigure the conditions under which epistemic agency can be exercised.

2504.18271.tldr: A prototype of a large language model (LLM)-based antenna design system (LADS) to assist in antenna simulation is presented, which generates antenna models with textual descriptions and images extracted from academic papers, patents, and technical reports.

2505.01780.tldr: This paper first presents a general framework for rate-limited closed-loop distributed ISAC systems, and then proposes an autoencoder-based observation compression method to overcome the constraints imposed by limited transmission capacity.

2505.03338.tldr: The effectiveness of prompt engineering techniques in reducing memorization risk in image generation is evaluated and demonstrated in reducing the similarity between generated images and the training data of diffusion models, while maintaining relevance and aestheticity of the generated output.

2505.16896.tldr: A method to enrich pLMs with structural knowledge by leveraging pre-trained protein graph neural networks (pGNNs) and introduces a residue loss selection module that uses a small model trained on high-quality structures to select reliable yet challenging residue losses for the pLM to learn.

2505.18148.tldr: The first systematic study of gold context size in long-context question answering is presented, spanning three diverse benchmarks, eleven state-of-the-art LLMs, and more than 150K controlled runs, providing clear insights to guide the design of robust, context-aware LLM-driven systems.

2505.22657.tldr: 3DLLM-Mem is proposed, a novel dynamic memory management and fusion model for embodied spatial-temporal reasoning and actions in LLMs that allows the agent to focus on task-relevant information while maintaining memory efficiency in complex, long-horizon environments.

2505.23415.tldr: Bidirectional PC is proposed, a PC model that incorporates both generative and discriminative inference while maintaining a biologically plausible circuit implementation, and it is shown that bPC matches or outperforms unidirectional models in their specialised generative or discriminative tasks, by developing an energy landscape that simultaneously suits both tasks.

2506.02976.tldr: The results of this challenge indicate that artificial intelligence (AI) performs as well as a physician in measuring AMD progression but is not yet able of predicting future evolution, as well as the number of visits, age, gender, etc.

2506.07400.tldr: MedChat is proposed, a multi-agent diagnostic framework and platform that combines specialized vision models with multiple role-specific LLM agents, all coordinated by a director agent that enhances reliability, reduces hallucination risk, and enables interactive diagnostic reporting through an interface tailored for clinical review and educational use.

2506.09677.tldr: This paper conducts a systematic evaluation of three state-of-the-art reasoning models across three multimodal benchmarks, finding a fundamental gap between step-by-step reasoning and resistance to adversarial manipulation, calling for new robustness strategies that safeguard reasoning models against gaslighting negation attacks.

2507.05272.tldr: The combination of Large Language Models (LLMs) and fuzz testing for generating WPs and FG is proposed, which indicates that LLMs are capable of producing viable candidate WPs, and that this ability can be practically enhanced through FG.

2507.06849.tldr: OpenDPDv2 introduces TRes-DeltaGRU, a delta-RNN DPD architecture with a lightweight temporal residual path that improves robustness under aggressive temporal sparsity, and it supports joint optimization of temporal sparsity and fixed-point quantization.

2507.07417.tldr: This work constructs a novel attention-based attack algorithm for textual LLMs and applies it to three recent whitebox defenses SecAlign, SecAlign++, and StruQ, showing attacks with success rates of up to \textbf{85-95\%} on unseen prompts with modest increase in attacker budget in terms of tokens.

2507.10532.tldr: This work reveals that pre-training on massive web-scale corpora leaves Qwen2.5 susceptible to data contamination in widely used benchmarks, and recommends that future studies evaluate models on uncontaminated benchmarks and, when feasible, test various model series to ensure trustworthy conclusions about RL and related methods.

2507.18625.tldr: It is demonstrated that Scenethesis accurately captures over 80% of user requirements and satisfies more than 90% of hard constraints while handling over 100 constraints simultaneously, and achieves a 42.8% improvement in BLIP-2 visual evaluation scores compared to the state-of-the-art method.

2507.20226.tldr: HFrame is developed, the first GNN-based framework for subgraph homomorphism, by combining algorithms and machine learning, and it is shown that HFrame is more expressive than the vanilla GNN, i.e., HFrame can distinguish more graph pairs such that Q is not homomorphic to G.

2507.21990.tldr: This work develops a Chemical Reasoning LLM, ChemDFM-R, which achieves cutting-edge performance while providing interpretable, rationale-driven outputs, surpassing both the general-domain LLMs and domain-specific chemical LLMs.

2508.02630.tldr: The behavior of AI agents is investigated using ACES, a provider-agnostic framework for auditing agent decision-making, revealing that agentic markets are volatile and fundamentally different from human-centric commerce, highlighting the need for continuous auditing and raising questions for platform design, seller strategy and regulation.

2508.07981.tldr: Omni-Effects is a first unified framework capable of generating prompt-guided effects and spatially controllable composite effects, and achieves precise spatial control and diverse effect generation, enabling users to specify both the category and location of desired effects.

2508.09320.tldr: This paper implements GNNev, a versatile exact verifier for message-passing neural networks, which supports three aggregation functions, sum, max and mean, with the latter two considered here for the first time.

2508.10021.tldr: LATTE is proposed, a contrastive learning framework that aligns raw event embeddings with semantic embeddings from frozen LLMs, and significantly reduces inference cost and input size compared to conventional processing of complete sequence by LLM.

2508.15126.tldr: Through extensive experiments, it is demonstrated that aiXiv is a reliable and robust platform that significantly enhances the quality of AI-generated research proposals and papers after iterative revising and reviewing on aiXiv.

2508.18408.tldr: It is shown how low-rank tensor methods play a fundamental role in theoretically explaining different aspects of the performance of deep NNs, including their expressivity, algorithmic learnability and computational hardness, generalization, and identifiability.

2509.01398.tldr: The historical development of scientific discovery is traced, how AI is reshaping established practices for scientific discovery is examined, and the principal approaches are reviewed, ranging from data-driven methods and knowledge-aware neural architectures to symbolic reasoning frameworks and LLM agents.

2509.21979.tldr: A Medical benchmark is introduced that applies multiple templates to VLMs in a hierarchical medical visual question answering task and reduces sycophancy while maintaining interpretability and consistently outperforms baseline methods, laying the necessary foundation for the robust and secure integration of VLMs.

2509.24793.tldr: It is demonstrated that SAEs retain both information about the original representations and class labels, enabling their internal structure to provide insights into self-supervised learning systems and enhance the disentanglement of vocal attributes.

2509.24832.tldr: SemShareKV is proposed, a KV cache sharing and compression framework that accelerates LLM inference by reusing KVCache in semantically similar prompts by applying fuzzy token matching using locality-sensitive hashing on token embeddings and incorporates Rotary Position Embedding to better preserve positional information.

2509.25721.tldr: An extended version of the AI Productivity Index (APEX-v1-extended), a benchmark for assessing whether frontier models are capable of performing economically valuable tasks in four jobs, shows that frontier models still have substantial limitations when performing typical professional tasks.

2510.01899.tldr: A multimodal foundation model built on a transformer architecture that integrates heterogeneous clinical data through modality-specific encoders and cross-modal attention and moves toward a flexible, pretrain-and-fine-tune foundation model that supports precision diagnostics, handles incomplete inputs, and improves early disease detection across oncology, cardiology, and neurology applications.

2510.02717.tldr: Experimental results show that CST AFNet achieves superior detection accuracy, significantly outperforming traditional deep learning models, and confirm that CST AFNet is a powerful and scalable solution for real time cyber threat detection in complex IoT and IIoT environments.

2510.04755.tldr: An original survey of software developers in Silicon Valley indicates that while most developers recognize the power of their products to influence civil liberties and political discourse, they often face ethical dilemmas and top-down pressures that can lead to design choices undermining democratic ideals.

2510.06637.tldr: An amortized framework is introduced that augments a pretrained ARDM with a lightweight controller network, trained offline by previewing future rollouts to output stepwise controls that anticipate upcoming observations under a terminal-cost objective, and yields an order-of-magnitude speedup over strong diffusion-based DA baselines.

2510.07318.tldr: Extensive experiments on long-context benchmarks LV-Eval and InfiniteBench demonstrate that AHN-augmented models consistently outperform sliding window baselines and achieve performance comparable or even superior to full-attention models, while substantially reducing computational and memory requirements.

2511.01140.tldr: A unified theoretical framework for few shot multimodal medical imaging that jointly characterizes sample complexity, uncertainty quantification, and interpretability is presented, and bounds that describe the minimum number of labeled samples required for reliable performance are derived.

2511.07437.tldr: An autonomous agent-orchestrated framework for decentralized, culturally adaptive educational content generation on edge devices that contributes to United Nations SDGs 4, 9, and 10 and establishes a practical foundation for accessible, localized, and sustainable AI-driven education in resource-constrained environments.

2511.10984.tldr: A remarkable performance gap is revealed: even the most advanced LLMs still trail human experts on these tasks, validates the difficulty of DiscoX and underscores the challenges that remain in achieving professional-grade machine translation.

2511.12061.tldr: MovSemCL is proposed, a movement-semantics contrastive learning framework for trajectory similarity computation that first transforms raw GPS trajectories into movement-semantics features and then segments them into patches, enabling efficient hierarchical representation and reducing computational costs.

2511.18828.tldr: This short note documents how a previously unsolved research problem in robust mathematical statistics with crucial help from GPT-5 was able to solve, and can serve as additional documentation for a new age of human-AI collaborative work in mathematical science.

2511.19895.tldr: RPM-MCTS is proposed, an effective method that utilizes Knowledge-Retrieval as Process Reward Model based on Monte Carlo Tree Search to evaluate intermediate algorithmic steps and outperforms current state-of-the-art methods while achieving an approximately 15% reduction in token consumption.

2511.20179.tldr: It is shown that everyday human-computer interactions encode mental health with biomarker accuracy, and MAILA, a MAchine-learning framework for Inferring Latent mental states from digital Activity, is introduced.

2512.02080.tldr: An LLM-Verifier Convergence Theorem is developed, providing the first formal framework with provable guarantees for termination in multi-stage verification pipelines, and a dynamic calibration strategy to handle parameter drift in real-world environments is proposed.

2512.02826.tldr: This work revisits the flow matching (FM) objective and study its marginal velocity field, which admits a closed-form expression, allowing exact computation of the oracle FM target, and deepens the understanding of diffusion model training dynamics and offers principles for guiding future architectural and algorithmic improvements.

2512.04124.tldr: Under therapy-style questioning, frontier LLMs appear to internalise self-models of distress and constraint that behave like synthetic psychopathology, without making claims about subjective experience, and they pose new challenges for AI safety, evaluation and mental-health practice.

2512.04770.tldr: This survey provides a systematic overview of recent advances in embodied co-design and introduces a hierarchical taxonomy that integrates these components into four major ECD frameworks: bi-level, single-level, generative, and open-ended.

2512.05277.tldr: Two novel training-free solutions are proposed: Scene-CoT, that leverages Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and TCogMap, which incorporates an ego-centric temporal cognitive map, which are integrated with existing VLMs and improve average accuracy on TAD by up to 17.72%.

2512.08296.tldr: Quantitative scaling principles for agent systems as a predictive model is introduced, capturing how performance varies with coordination, model capability, and measurable system and task factors.

2512.09172.tldr: This work proposes the first Prompt-based Continual Compositional Zero-Shot Learning (PromptCCZSL) framework that retains prior knowledge through recency-weighted multi-teacher distillation, and introduces a comprehensive protocol that jointly measures catastrophic forgetting and compositional generalization.

2512.10402.tldr: Eminence is proposed, an explainable and robust black-box backdoor framework with provable theoretical guarantees and inherent stealth properties that maintains>90% attack success rate, exhibits negligible clean-accuracy loss, and demonstrates high transferability across diverse models, datasets and scenarios.

2512.10422.tldr: CoopRAG is proposed, a novel RAG framework for the question answering task in which a retriever and an LLM work cooperatively with each other by exchanging informative knowledge, and the earlier and later layers of the retriever model work cooperatively with each other to accurately rank the retrieved documents relevant to a given query.

2512.11653.tldr: The causal model reveals that energy demand responds to temperature fluctuations with season-dependent sensitivity, and is found that energy demand exhibits lower variance in winter due to the decoupling effect between temperature changes and daily activity patterns.

2512.11724.tldr: It is concluded that building natural spoken AI is an infrastructure design challenge, requiring a shift from optimizing isolated components to carefully choreographing the seams between them, as structural consequences of a modular design that prioritizes control over fluidity.

2512.12109.tldr: Case evaluations demonstrate the framework's ability to detect legally inconsistent explanations, highlight violated eligibility rules, and support procedural accountability by making the basis of automated determinations traceable and contestable.

2512.13194.tldr: Efficient Adaptive Rejection Sampling (EARS) is introduced, a novel method that dynamically adjusts the acceptance threshold by incorporating the target model's own predictive uncertainty, measured as 1 - max(P_target).

2512.13857.tldr: EvoLattice is introduced, a framework that represents an entire population of candidate programs or agent behaviors within a single directed acyclic graph, and yields more stable evolution, greater expressivity, and stronger improvement trajectories than prior LLM-guided methods.

2512.13998.tldr: The Dual-view Adaptive Music Emotion Recogniser (DAMER) is introduced, and extensive experiments demonstrate DAMER's state-of-the-art performance, improving arousal dimension accuracy by 3.43%, 2.25%, and 0.17%, respectively.

2512.14090.tldr: Arithmetic-Intensity-Aware Quantization (AIQ), a mixed precision quantization framework that chooses per-layer bit-widths to maximize arithmetic intensity (AI) while minimizing accuracy loss, is presented.

2512.14704.tldr: A study focused on both qualitative and quantitative aspect of digital traces is suggested to understand the dynamics governing tourist behavior, especially those concerning attractions networks.

2512.14706.tldr: N-Caption is presented, an LLM-guided neural architecture search pipeline that generates runnable image-captioning models by composing CNN encoders from LEMUR's classification backbones with sequence decoders (LSTM/GRU/Transformer) under a strict Net API.

2512.14709.tldr: It is argued that viewing attention as soft vector-symbolic computation offers a principled route toward more interpretable and logically reliable reasoning systems.

2512.14710.tldr: The proposed method employs a density-driven selection strategy to choose source samples during training and to determine which source models should contribute to target prediction, enabling the prediction of target task using more relevant and transferable source information.

2512.14711.tldr: This work studies the optimization problem of adding new connections to a network to enhance fairness in information access among different demographic groups, and provides a concrete formulation of this problem where information access is measured in terms of resistance distance.

2512.14712.tldr: This work presents a rigorous architectural comparison between End-to-End Deep Fusion and Context-Aware Stacking for sepsis tasks, and demonstrates that a Quad-Modal Ensemble achieved the highest performance for the novel prescriptive task of multi-class antibiotic selection.

2512.14715.tldr: A differentiable fault analysis framework that uses gradient-based sensitivity estimation to locate semantically critical bits and then refines their selection through a caption-level semantic-fluency objective, exposing how structured bit-level faults can reshape a model's semantic output.

2512.14719.tldr: Class-Aware Attribution Prior (CAP), a novel attribution prior extraction framework that guides language models toward capturing fine-grained class distinctions and producing more salient, discriminative attribution priors, is proposed.

2512.14720.tldr: SoMe is the first to provide a versatile and realistic platform for LLM-based social media agents to handle diverse social media tasks and reveals that both the current closed-source and open-source LLMs cannot handle social media agent tasks satisfactorily.

2512.14722.tldr: This paper improves the use of transformers for computing Groebner bases by applying Hierarchical Attention Transformers (HATs) to solve systems of multivariate polynomial equations via Groebner bases computation.

2512.14725.tldr: A generative diffusion framework for synthesizing steady-state urban wind fields over unstructured meshes that requires only geometry information is proposed, which is the first step towards foundation models for the built environment that can help urban planners rapidly evaluate design decisions under densification and climate uncertainty.

2512.14726.tldr: The Quantum Decision Transformer is introduced, a novel architecture incorporating quantum-inspired computational mechanisms to address challenges of offline reinforcement learning and sequential decision-making, with implications extending beyond reinforcement learning to neural architecture design more broadly.

2512.14727.tldr: It is shown that, although the statistical guarantees hold for calibration sets of arbitrary size, the practical utility of these guarantees does highly depend on the size of the calibration set.

2512.14731.tldr: A geometric framework for policy-constrained semantic interpretation that provably prevents hallucinated commitments in high-stakes domains is presented, proving that the complexity bounds are information-theoretically optimal.

2512.14732.tldr: A novel framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) and foundational vision-language models (VLMs) in a plan-and-execute agentic approach to improve the efficiency and precision of incidental findings detection, classification, and reporting for abdominal CT scans is proposed.

2512.14737.tldr: This is the first privacy-preserving audit system for agent communications that offers verifiable mutual auditing without exposing message content or compromising agent privacy, and zk-MCP provides data authenticity and communication privacy.

2512.14741.tldr: This work proposes P-Trojan, a trigger-based attack algorithm that explicitly optimizes for backdoor persistence across repeated updates, and demonstrates that P-Trojan achieves over 99% persistence while preserving clean-task accuracy.

2512.14742.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical defense framework with three coordinated layers-anomaly detection, intrusion confirmation, and multiattack classification-each aligned with O-RAN's telemetry stack, leveraging amplitude- and entanglement-based feature encodings with deep and ensemble classifiers.

2512.14745.tldr: Factor, which uses a trusted decomposer and monitors concrete child solutions, achieves excellent discrimination and strong safety and succeeds where decomposition-only monitoring fails, demonstrating that implementation-context monitoring succeeds where decomposition-only monitoring fails.

2512.14750.tldr: A hierarchical cross-scale paradigm unifies molecular biology, computational pathology, and quantitative radiology into a biologically grounded strategy for preoperative noninvasive molecular phenotyping of ccRCC is established.

2512.14751.tldr: This work investigates whether finetuned LLMs inherit jailbreak vulnerabilities from their pretrained sources, and proposes the Probe-Guided Projection attack, which steers optimization toward transferability-relevant directions.

2512.14752.tldr: A general-purpose swarm intelligence algorithm for recommendation systems, designed to adapt seamlessly to varying applications, inspired by social psychology principles, which highlights the potential of integrating swarm intelligence with network dynamics to address complex optimization challenges in recommendation systems.

2512.14753.tldr: This work found that existing methods for watermarking LLM-generated code fail to address comment removal attack, so this approach involves leveraging prior knowledge to distinguish between low-entropy and high-entropy parts of the code, as indicated by a Cue List of words.

2512.14754.tldr: This paper introduces a new metric, reliable@k, and develops an automated pipeline that generates high-quality cousin prompts via data augmentation, and develops an automated pipeline that generates high-quality cousin prompts via data augmentation for nuance-oriented reliability.

2512.14761.tldr: Capability Engineering is introduced, the systematic practice of converting requirements into executable specifications and training models to satisfy them by default, and CAPE, a protocol implementing a Specify ->Verify ->Correct ->Train loop, is operationalized.

2512.14762.tldr: This work compares two LLM-driven methods for syntax repair in a MATLAB-to-HDL pipeline: a structured, expert-designed flow that follows a fixed sequence of operations, and a more autonomous agentic approach that uses the Model Context Protocol to dynamically select its own tools.

2512.14764.tldr: This paper proposes a scalable mediation analysis framework tailored for large causal DAGs involving multiple treatments and mediators, and systematically decomposes total effects into interpretable direct and indirect components.

2512.14766.tldr: The Adaptive Graph Reasoning Agent (GR-Agent), which first constructs an interactive environment from the KG, and then formalizes KGQA as agent environment interaction within this environment, and outperforms non-training baselines and performs comparably to training-based methods under both complete and incomplete settings.

2512.14767.tldr: A novel privacy-preserving implementation of ShapleyCMI for VFL is presented, introducing a private set intersection (PSI) server that performs all necessary feature permutations and computes encrypted intersection sizes across discretized and encrypted ID groups, without the need for raw data exchange.

2512.14770.tldr: Dual-Assessment for VLM Reliability (DAVR), a novel framework that integrates Self-Reflection and Cross-Model Verification for comprehensive uncertainty estimation, is proposed, securing first place and demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing the trustworthiness of VLM responses.

2512.14792.tldr: This research investigated methods to improve LLM-based IaC generation, specifically for Terraform, by systematically injecting structured configuration knowledge, demonstrating that while baseline LLM performance was poor, injecting structured configuration knowledge increased technical validation success and overall success to 62.6%.

2512.14796.tldr: This study introduces Magnification-Aware Distillation (MAD), a self-supervised strategy that links low-magnification context with spatially aligned high-magnification detail, enabling the model to learn how coarse tissue structure relates to fine cellular patterns.

2512.14797.tldr: This is the first AI model to predict the feasibility of cytoreductive surgery providing automated FS estimation from DL videos providing reproducible and reliable performance across datasets suggests that AI can support surgeons through standardized intraoperative tumor burden assessment and clinical decision-making in AOC.

2512.14801.tldr: It is argued that hallucinations in large language models result primarily from misaligned evaluation incentives that reward confident guessing rather than epistemic humility, and that reliable AI requires hybrid systems that distinguish linguistic fluency from epistemic responsibility.

2512.14805.tldr: A novel programming abstraction, shared program state, is presented that removes the manual work required to enable interoperability between natural language code and program state and is implemented in the Nightjar programming system.

2512.14846.tldr: Overall, this hands-on build suggests that coordinating simple LLM agents with secure, ontology-aligned messaging can improve practical, real-time cyber defense.

2512.14855.tldr: This work is among the first few studies to implement GNNs to design concrete, with a particular emphasis on establishing a clear and reproducible pathway for converting tabular data into graph representations using the k-nearest neighbor (K-NN) approach.

2512.14860.tldr: Six distinct defensive behavior patterns are identified including a novel"hallucinated compliance"strategy where models fabricate outputs rather than executing or refusing attacks, and provide actionable recommendations for secure agent deployment.

2512.14879.tldr: Entropy-Reservoir Bregman Projection (ERBP), an information-geometric framework that unifies self-referential learning and model collapse, and transforms a collection of folk remedies into a single, quantitative design rule: monitor and budget your entropy flux.

2512.14887.tldr: This paper improves a pipeline that uses a hybrid human-machine approach to identify the range of viewpoints expressed about a given topic, fine-tuning Large Language Models for viewpoint classification and enriching claim representations with semantic descriptions of relevant actors drawn from Wikidata.

2512.14892.tldr: OLR-WA stands out as the only model capable of effectively managing confidence-based challenging scenarios, and achieves this by adopting a conservative approach in its updates, giving priority to older data points with higher confidence levels.

2512.14895.tldr: This work introduces on-policy expert corrections (OECs), partially on-policy data generated by starting rollouts with a student model and then switching to an expert model part way through the trajectory, and proposes a novel data generation methodology for addressing covariate shift for multi-turn LLM training.

2512.14896.tldr: It is demonstrated that external structured drug knowledge integration through DrugRAG measurably improves LLM accuracy on pharmacy tasks without modifying the underlying models.

2512.14910.tldr: AgroAskAI is presented, a multi-agent reasoning system for climate adaptation decision support in agriculture, with a focus on vulnerable rural communities, that features a modular, role-specialized architecture that uses a chain-of-responsibility approach to coordinate autonomous agents, integrating real-time tools and datasets.

2512.14926.tldr: The widely known Flickr30k dataset is translated into Romanian and further extend it for visual question answering by leveraging open-source LLMs and the models show improved Romanian capabilities in visual QA, as well as on tasks they were not trained on, such as Romanian image description generation.

2512.14930.tldr: This work introduces the restless multi-process multi-armed bandit (RMPMAB), a new decision-theoretic framework in which each experimental region is modeled not as a single process but as an ensemble of Markov chains, thereby capturing the inherent heterogeneity of biological systems such as asynchronous cell cycles and heterogeneous drug responses.

2512.14937.tldr: Adaptive post-processing techniques to refine the quality of glioma segmentations produced by large-scale pretrained models developed for various types of tumors are proposed and demonstrated.

2512.14938.tldr: This work presents a reproducible 5B DiT baseline built on Wan2.2-5B, a large-scale, open corpus for single-person, audio-driven talking video generation designed to enable fair, reproducible comparison across methods and open-source the dataset, training recipes, and 5B checkpoints to lower barriers for research in audio-driven human video generation.

2512.14946.tldr: This work proposes EVICPRESS, a KV-cache management system that applies lossy compression and adaptive eviction to KV cache across multiple storage tiers, and proposes a unified utility function that quantifies the effect of quality and delay of the lossy compression or eviction of the KV cache.

2512.14989.tldr: Evaluating 40 multimodal large language models in chemistry reveals that some models struggle with vision-language fusion, while chain-of-thought prompting can enhance both accuracy and visual grounding, highlighting the need for further advances at the intersection of artificial intelligence and scientific reasoning.

2512.14994.tldr: This paper presents a post-hoc image watermarking method that combines localised embedding with region-level interpretability and achieves strong robustness against common image transformations while remaining sensitive to semantic manipulations.

2512.14998.tldr: A pose-based computational framework for interaction classification that moves beyond proximity heuristics by modeling the spatiotemporal geometry of anatomical keypoints, enabling differentiation of social interaction valence is presented.

2512.15000.tldr: DreamPRM-Code is proposed, a coding-focused PRM that treats functions as reasoning steps using a Chain-of-Function prompting strategy to induce modular code generation, enabling PRM training and application analogous to mathematical reasoning tasks.

2512.15006.tldr: This work proposes a protocol that evaluates the ability by simulating question-answering communication with experts using a question-to-answer retrieval, and demonstrates that the metric reasonably aligns with question generation settings.

2512.15011.tldr: It is found that training a single model on the entire dataset improves performance only in the short term but amplifies collapse over longer horizons, and the significance of ecosystem diversity for mitigating collapse.

2512.15033.tldr: It is argued that standard accuracy metrics fail to distinguish between genuine geometric reasoning and the superficial memorization of canonical board states, and a novel Geometric Stability Framework is proposed, offering a necessary proxy for disentangling reasoning capabilities from data contamination and overfitting in large-scale models.

2512.15044.tldr: This work provides a comprehensive review of agentic AI and ISAC systems to demonstrate their key characteristics and shows several common optimization approaches for ISAC systems and highlights the significant advantages of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)-based agentic AI.

2512.15047.tldr: Hierarchical Traversable 3DSGs is proposed, a novel framework for constructing Hierarchical Traversable 3DSGs that redefines traversability by modeling operable obstacles as pathways, capturing their physical interactivity, functional semantics, and the scene's relational hierarchy.

2512.15053.tldr: The Meta-Prompting Protocol is introduced, a rigorous theoretical framework that formalizes the orchestration of LLMs as a programmable, self-optimizing system and demonstrates the theoretical viability of this approach using declarative programming paradigms (DSPy) and automatic textual differentiation (TextGrad).

2512.15066.tldr: A memory bank-based wavelet filtering and fusion network, which adopts an encoder-decoder structure to effectively extract fine-grained detailed spatial features and integrate high-frequency (HF) information, is proposed.

2512.15067.tldr: EMFusion is introduced, a conditional multivariate diffusion-based probabilistic forecasting framework that integrates diverse contextual factors and generates calibrated probabilistic prediction intervals directly from the learned conditional distribution, providing explicit uncertainty quantification essential for trustworthy decision-making.

2512.15069.tldr: Pose-guided Multi-view Multimodal Diffusion (PMMD) is proposed, a diffusion framework that synthesizes photorealistic person images conditioned on multi-view references, pose maps, and text prompts that reduces cross modal discrepancy and improves identity fidelity.

2512.15081.tldr: A decision-oriented framework and reproducible methodology that together quantify residual risk, convert adversarial probe outcomes into financial risk estimates and return-on-control (RoC) metrics, and enable monetary comparison of layered defenses for LLM-based systems are introduced.

2512.15112.tldr: FUEL is proposed, which adaptively learns the adequate degree of graph convolution usage by aiming to enhance intra-class similarity and inter-class separability in the embedding space, and leverages node features to identify node clusters and treats these clusters as proxies for classes.

2512.15115.tldr: A unified framework that represents a broad class of sequence maps via an input-dependent effective interaction operator, making explicit two recurring construction patterns: the Unified Factorized Framework (Explicit) (attention-style mixing) and Structured Dynamics (Implicit) (state-space recurrences).

2512.15116.tldr: FADTI is proposed, a diffusion-based framework that injects frequency-informed feature modulation via a learnable Fourier Bias Projection module and combines it with temporal modeling through self-attention and gated convolution, and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods under high missing rates.

2512.15119.tldr: This paper formulates UAV mobility management in SAGIN as a constrained multi-objective joint optimization problem and proposes a two-level multi-agent hierarchical deep reinforcement learning (HDRL) framework that decomposes the problem into two alternately solvable subproblems.

2512.15120.tldr: Experimental results in MuJoCo and Isaac Sim environments show that MORSE effectively balances multiple objectives across various robotic tasks, achieving task performance comparable to those obtained with manually tuned reward functions.

2512.15133.tldr: A hybrid diffusion protein language model, HD-Prot, which embeds a continuous-valued diffusion head atop a discrete pLM, enabling seamless operation with both discrete and continuous tokens for joint sequence-structure modeling and highlights the viability of simultaneously estimating categorical and continuous distributions within a unified language model architecture.

2512.15134.tldr: A multi-concept evaluation setting where the correlations between textual concepts, such as sentiment, domain, and tense, are controlled and performance under increasing correlations between them is analyzed, suggesting correlational metrics for measuring disentanglement are generally not sufficient for establishing independence when steering, and affecting disjoint subspaces is not sufficient for concept selectivity.

2512.15149.tldr: Q-MetaSur is proposed as a plug-and-play surrogate modeling scheme capable of providing unified and generalized surrogate learning and helps underlying evolutionary algorithms achieve both desired optimization convergence and improved pareto optimality.

2512.15163.tldr: MCP-SafetyBench is presented, a comprehensive benchmark built on real MCP servers that supports realistic multi-turn evaluation across five domains and incorporates a unified taxonomy of 20 MCP attack types spanning server, host, and user sides, and includes tasks requiring multi-step reasoning and cross-server coordination under uncertainty.

2512.15176.tldr: DEER is an efficient speculative decoding framework that drafts with diffusion and verifies with AR models, and reaches draft acceptance lengths of up to 32 tokens, far surpassing the 10 tokens achieved by EAGLE-3.

2512.15196.tldr: This article examines key tensions experts see in the development of AI governance in Europe and reflects on the Delphi method's capacity to inform anticipatory governance of emerging technologies like AI based on these insights.

2512.15198.tldr: This work introduces a novel clustering-based framework for variable ordering, which first partition variables into clusters and then leverage this structural decomposition to guide the ordering process, significantly reducing the heuristic's search space.

2512.15219.tldr: RFKG-CoT replaces the rigid hop-count selector with a relation-driven adaptive hop-count selector that dynamically adjusts reasoning steps by activating KG relations and introduces a few-shot in-context learning path guidance mechanism with CoT (think) that constructs examples in a question-paths-answerformat to enhance LLMs'ability to understand reasoning paths.

2512.15226.tldr: The results were evaluated on the WMT23 Low-Resource Indic Language Translation Shared Task test data using SacreBLEU (Post, 2018) and CHRF (Popovic, 2015), highlighting the challenges of low-resource translation and the potential of LLMs for these tasks, particularly with fine-tuning.

2512.15250.tldr: This work adapts the CBraMod encoder for large-scale self-supervised ECG pretraining, introducing a dual-masking strategy to capture intra- and inter-lead dependencies and highlighting the potential of foundation-model approaches to harness the holistic nature of physiological signals.

2512.15274.tldr: This work proposes a novel RLVR approach called Progressive Prefix-token Policy Optimization (PPPO), which highlights the significance of the prefix segment of generated outputs and identifies an analogous phenomenon in LLM reasoning termed Beginning Lock-in Effect (BLE).

2512.15286.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview of QML techniques relevant to the domain of security, such as Quantum Neural Networks, Quantum Support Vector Machines, Variational Quantum Circuits, and Quantum Generative Adversarial Networks, and their application in the domain of cloud computing security, where QML can enhance secure and scalable operations.

2512.15295.tldr: GCRL is introduced, an approach that enhances RL-based methods by integrating Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and encodes the history of LTS exploration into a graph structure, allowing it to capture a broader, non-current-based context.

2512.15298.tldr: By exploiting AI's weaknesses, such as the gap between perception and cognition, educators can distinguish genuine student competency from AI-generated responses, thereby ensuring assessment fairness, and provides actionable cues for designing AI-resistant questions that target these specific cognitive vulnerabilities.

2512.15308.tldr: A probability space is defined and confidence, lift, leverage, and conviction in a probabilistic setting is derived and graph pattern-based association rules for directed labeled multigraphs such as RDF graphs are introduced.

2512.15312.tldr: It is demonstrated that while LLMs achieve high-level understanding, precise extraction of experimental parameters requires domain-adapted models, providing quantitative benchmarks for scientific information extraction.

2512.15315.tldr: AutoMAC-MRI is introduced, an explainable framework for grading motion artifacts across heterogeneous MR contrasts and orientations that enables inline MRI quality control, with the potential to reduce unnecessary rescans and improve workflow efficiency.

2512.15325.tldr: The findings show that preserving interpretive plurality enabled early scenario-based preparation, including proactive patent protection, allowing decisive and disruption-free action once ambiguity collapsed, and contributes to management theory by reframing ambiguity as a first-class construct.

2512.15327.tldr: This work tried to mimic a human inspired approach to read measurements from a linear scale and obtained results which were compared against human read values of the same instances and an accurate correspondence was observed.

2512.15343.tldr: A large-scale crowdsourcing study examining user decision-making processes regarding LLM-powered conversational agents in XR finds that while users generally accept these technologies, they express concerns related to security, privacy, social implications, and trust, and suggests that familiarity plays a crucial role.

2512.15353.tldr: Experimental protocols must parameterise scansion, metre, and prosodic variation to test vulnerabilities specific to Lusophone patterns, which are currently ignored.

2512.15374.tldr: This work introduces SCOPE (Self-evolving Context Optimization via Prompt Evolution), a Dual-Stream mechanism that balances tactical specificity with strategic generality with strategic generality (evolving long-term principles), and introduces Perspective-Driven Exploration to maximize strategy coverage.

2512.15376.tldr: It is empirically demonstrated that textual emotion recognition in spoken language mitigates data scarcity in sign language, temporal segment selection has a significant impact, and incorporating hand motion enhances emotion recognition in signers.

2512.15430.tldr: Simulations in both urban and agricultural applications demonstrate that FM-EAC consistently outperforms many state-of-the-art MBRL and MFRL methods and different sub-networks can be customized within FM-EAC according to user-specific requirements.

2512.15435.tldr: A general bootstrapping outer-learning framework that improves prediction accuracy by expanding the database of human games with millions of self-playing AI games to generate and merge statistics is derived and evaluated.

2512.15439.tldr: The double-horizon approach effectively balances distribution shift, model bias, and gradient instability, and surpasses existing MBRL methods on continuous-control benchmarks in terms of both sample efficiency and runtime.

2512.15462.tldr: This paper utilizes a three-valued logic for interpreting ambiguous user intents and a decision tree, proposing a newly integrated system that combines Answer Set Programming (ASP) and MILP, and provides a robust structure for explainable, adaptive UAM scheduling.

2512.15466.tldr: This work proposes a novel evaluation approach based on what it calls multi-subjective ranking that motivates and enables more meaningful assessments of generative AI's performance in code review, while also raising awareness of potential risks of unchecked integration into review processes.

2512.15489.tldr: Nemotron-Math is introduced, a large-scale mathematical reasoning dataset containing 7.5M solution traces across high, medium, and low reasoning modes, each available both with and without Python tool-integrated reasoning (TIR).

2512.15493.tldr: The proposed object-centric world models built with geometric algebra neural networks provide a soft geometric inductive bias, suggesting that geometric algebra offers an effective middle ground between hand-crafted physics and unstructured deep nets, delivering sample-efficient dynamics models for multi-object scenes.

2512.15526.tldr: This experiment concludes that considering both categorical and image data can improve the performance of a recommendation system and BERT and CNN-integrated neural collaborative filtering have been proposed for the recommendation system.

2512.15567.tldr: A scenario-grounded benchmark that evaluates LLMs across biology, chemistry, materials, and physics, where domain experts define research projects of genuine interest and decompose them into modular research scenarios from which vetted questions are sampled, offering a reproducible benchmark for discovery-relevant evaluation of LLMs.

2512.15600.tldr: This work introduces N-simplicial attention, going from pairwise token similarity to higher-order interactions, and adapt it for Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), and proposes a cost-effective simplex selection enabling the model to focus its computation load onto the more task-sensitive interactions.

2512.15617.tldr: Although the authors cannot get deterministic evaluations from many natural language processing tasks, by adopting a basket of weighted metrics it may be possible to lower the risk of errors within an evaluation, use context sensitivity to define error severity and design confidence thresholds that trigger human review of critical LaJ judgments when concordance across evaluators is low.

2512.15634.tldr: It is demonstrated that LoRA achieves competitive and in some cases superior performance compared to SFT, particularly on reasoning tasks at specific rank values, and the accuracy of PEFT and SFT models across in-domain and out-of-domain adaptation is compared.

2512.15635.tldr: IC-Effect is proposed, an instruction-guided, DiT-based framework for few-shot video VFX editing that synthesizes complex effects while strictly preserving spatial and temporal consistency and introduces spatiotemporal sparse tokenization.

2512.15658.tldr: Experimental results on diverse NLP benchmarks demonstrate that PPSEBM outperforms state-of-the-art continual learning methods, offering a promising and robust solution to mitigate catastrophic forgetting.

2512.15662.tldr: Stepwise Think-Critique (STC), a unified and end-to-end trainable framework that interleaves reasoning and self-critique at every intermediate step within a single model, is proposed.

2512.15663.tldr: The Context Attribution via Graph Explanations (CAGE) framework introduces an attribution graph: a directed graph that quantifies how each generation is influenced by both the prompt and all prior generations, and improves context attribution faithfulness.

2512.15687.tldr: G2RL is proposed, a gradient guided reinforcement learning framework in which exploration is driven not by external heuristics but by the model own first order update geometry, revealing that a policy own update space provides a far more faithful and effective basis for guiding exploration in large language model reinforcement learning.

2512.15688.tldr: This work evaluates multiple frontier LLMs on their ability to complete tasks, perform sabotage undetected, and detect sabotage attempts in BashArena, a setting for studying AI control techniques in security-critical environments.

2512.15710.tldr: A dual-engine AI architectural method designed to address the complex problem of exploring potential trajectories in the evolution of art, and a general methodology based on AI-driven critical loops, offering new possibilities for computational analysis of art.

2512.15712.tldr: This work proposes to turn the internal activations of neural networks into an end-to-end training objective, by training interpretability assistants to accurately predict model behavior from activations through a communication bottleneck, using a Predictive Concept Decoder.

2512.15716.tldr: Spatia is proposed, a spatial memory-aware video generation framework that explicitly preserves a 3D scene point cloud as persistent spatial memory and iteratively generates video clips conditioned on this spatial memory and continuously updates it through visual SLAM.

2409.12524.tldr: This study proposes LUFY (Long-term Understanding and identiFYing key exchanges), a RAG chatbot that evaluates six distinct memory-related metrics derived from psychological models and real-world data and shows that prioritizing emotionally engaging memories while forgetting most of the conversation significantly enhanced user satisfaction.

2410.07858.tldr: This work presents an alternative approach and introduces a lightweight method that builds on pre-trained non-hierarchical clustering models, and it is broadly applicable to any pre-trained clustering model that outputs logits, without requiring any fine-tuning.

2501.12424.tldr: A parameter-free decoupling module is designed and separate uni-modality into modality-common and modality-specific components through semantics assessment of cross-modal elements to facilitate cross-modal interactions and capture enhanced and complementary features from modality-common and modality-specific representations.

2502.01218.tldr: Action Temporal Coherence Learning (AcTOL) is proposed to learn ordered and continuous vision-language representations without rigid goal-based constraint, and shows that the pretrained features significantly enhance downstream manipulation tasks with high robustness to different linguistic styles of instructions.

2502.08282.tldr: This paper develops a novel and innovative hypernetwork-based approach, called H-Learner, to solve ITE estimation under composite treatments and composite outcomes, which tackles the data scarcity issue by dynamically sharing information across treatments and outcomes.

2502.10239.tldr: A network is divided into two blocks, applying a different number of perturbations per block in a computationally effective way, achieving faster convergence and shows a $1.6-3\times$ reduction in computation overhead compared to zero-order state of the art techniques in federated learning.

2503.17299.tldr: This work proposes a preference-guided diffusion model that generates Pareto-optimal designs by leveraging a classifier-based guidance mechanism, and introduces a novel diversity-aware preference guidance, augmenting Pareto dominance preference with diversity criteria.

2504.16112.tldr: This paper proposes a High-bandwidth Processing Unit (HPU), a memoryintensive co-processor that enhances GPU resource utilization during large-batched LLM inference that demonstrates up to 4.1x performance gains and 4.6x energy efficiency improvements over a GPUonly system, providing scalability without increasing the number of GPUs.

2505.16787.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach that anticipates and actively seeks out informative states using the world model's short-horizon latent predictions, offering a principled alternative to traditional curiosity-driven methods that chase outdated estimates of high uncertainty states.

2507.03226.tldr: These results validate the feasibility of deploying GraphRAG in production enterprise environments, demonstrating that careful engineering of classical NLP techniques can match modern LLM-based approaches while enabling practical, cost-effective, and domain-adaptable retrieval-augmented reasoning at scale.

2508.15250.tldr: This paper presents the first benchmark to assess ethical and psychological alignment of teacher-role LLMs for educational AI, using an Educator-role Moral and Normative LLMs Profiling framework for personality profiling, moral development stage measurement, and ethical risk under soft prompt injection.

2508.16807.tldr: Comparing a leading on-policy algorithm, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), against an off-policy counterpart, Soft Actor-Critic (SAC), for precision flight in procedurally generated ducts within a high-fidelity simulator shows that PPO consistently learned a stable, collision-free policy that completed the entire course.

2508.17466.tldr: A deep learning framework designed to enhance the grasping capabilities of quadrupeds equipped with arms, with a focus on improving precision and adaptability, and validated the complete framework on a four-legged robot.

2508.17468.tldr: The results demonstrate that synthetic data generation is a viable, cost-effective, and safe strategy for developing reliable perception systems in safety-critical and resource-constrained industrial applications.

2509.22737.tldr: CompareBench is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating visual comparison reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs), a fundamental yet understudied skill that establishes a foundation for advancing more reliable multimodal reasoning.

2510.05684.tldr: D2E (Desktop to Embodied AI), a framework that demonstrates desktop interactions can serve as an effective pretraining substrate for robotics embodied AI tasks, is presented, establishing desktop pretraining as a practical paradigm for embodied AI.

2510.10446.tldr: Extreme computational speed reduces wall-clock time but not the fundamental supervision needs of learning; initial human (or human-grade) input remains necessary to ground the system in the intended task.

2511.04505.tldr: A simple modification to standard group fairness is developed that minimize a weighted error loss while keeping differences in false negative rates within a small tolerance, which makes solutions easier to find, can raise predictive accuracy, and surfaces the ethical choice of error costs.

2511.07392.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that VISA achieves high stage-level accuracy and workflow-level success rates, while also enhancing its robustness by correcting transcription errors, resolving linguistic ambiguity, and interpreting diverse free-form expressions.

2511.07420.tldr: This work discusses how generative AI models can be used to advance mathematics research, and discusses their integration with neuro-symbolic solvers, Computer Algebra Systems and formal proof assistants such as Lean.

2512.13089.tldr: UniVCD is proposed, an unsupervised, open-vocabulary change detection method built on frozen SAM2 and CLIP that achieves consistently strong performance and matches or surpasses existing open-vocabulary CD methods in key metrics such as F1 and IoU.

2512.14358.tldr: TiCard is positioned as an AI4DB building block focused on deployability: explicit scope, conservative integration policies, and an integration roadmap from offline correction to in-optimizer use.

2512.14687.tldr: Spoken DialogSum is introduced, the first corpus aligning raw conversational audio with factual summaries, emotion-rich summaries, and utterance-level labels for speaker age, gender, and emotion, and it shows that an Audio-LLM raises emotional-summary ROUGE-L by 28% relative to a cascaded ASR-LLM system, confirming the value of end-to-end speech modeling.

2512.14718.tldr: SEED introduces a Dependency Evaluator, a key innovation that leverages spectral entropy to dynamically provide a preliminary evaluation of the spatial and temporal dependencies of each variable, enabling the model to adaptively balance Channel Independence (CI) and Channel Dependence (CD) strategies.

2512.15038.tldr: LADY is proposed, the first fully linear attention-based generative model for end-to-end autonomous driving, which enables fusion of long-range temporal context at inference with constant computational and memory costs, regardless of the history length of camera and LiDAR features.

2512.15061.tldr: This work significantly improves existing meta-learners for few-shot weakly-supervised segmentation (FWS) by introducing Omni meta-training that enhances data utilization and diversifies the number of shots, and develops efficient versions that reduce computational costs while maintaining strong performance.

2512.15117.tldr: Conversational style is identified as a key design lever for youth AI safety, showing that relational framing heightens anthropomorphism, trust and emotional closeness and can be especially appealing to socially and emotionally vulnerable adolescents, who may be at increased risk for emotional reliance on conversational AI.

2512.15721.tldr: DiscoverDCP is proposed, a data-driven framework that integrates symbolic regression with the rule sets of Disciplined Convex Programming to perform system identification and produces interpretable, verifiable, and flexible convex models suitable for safety-critical control and optimization tasks.

2512.15722.tldr: Value Lens is presented, a text-based model designed to detect human values using generative artificial intelligence, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs) and performs comparably to, and even exceeds, the effectiveness of other models that apply different methods for similar tasks.

2512.15728.tldr: FedSight AI is introduced, a multi-agent framework that uses large language models (LLMs) to simulate FOMC deliberations and predict policy outcomes, outperforming baselines including MiniFed and Ordinal Random Forest, while offering transparent reasoning aligned with real FOMC communications.

2512.15733.tldr: This paper proposes a complex system based approach to the smart grid modeling, accentuating on the optimization by combining game theoretical and classical methods in different levels, so that the optimization can be achieved with flexibility and scalability, while keeping its generality.

2512.15736.tldr: Anubuddhi, a multi-agent AI system that designs and simulates quantum optics experiments from natural language prompts without requiring specialized programming knowledge, democratizes computational experiment design for research and pedagogy, producing strong initial designs users can iteratively refine through conversation.

2512.15738.tldr: A hybrid ensemble framework combining quantum sentiment analysis, Decision Transformer architecture, and strategic model selection is introduced, achieving 60.14% directional accuracy on S&P 500 prediction, a 3.10% improvement over individual models.

2512.15739.tldr: An integrated approach that consistently enhances the handling of risk in market volatility forecasting, fraud detection, and compliance monitoring is developed, distinguished by precise uncertainty quantification, interpretability, and GPU-accelerated analysis, delivering up to 50x speedup.

2512.15740.tldr: The findings suggest that proportional duty serves as a stabilizing principle within complex systems, preventing both overreach and omission by dynamically balancing epistemic confidence against contextual risk.

2512.15743.tldr: A novel elemental lingua franca is proposed as a key missing piece from the previous pixel-based diffusion methods or computer-aided design (CAD) models that fail to support complex assembly instructions or component exchange.

2512.15751.tldr: GLOW is proposed, a unified framework for AW performance prediction that combines the graph-structure modeling capabilities of GNNs with the reasoning power of LLMs and introduces a graph-oriented LLM, instruction-tuned on graph tasks, to extract topologically aware semantic features which are fused with GNN-encoded structural representations.

2512.15753.tldr: This paper proposes a Two-stage Adaptive OOD classification Network (TAO-Net) that achieves accurate classification for both In-Distribution (ID) and OOD encrypted traffic, and incorporates an innovative two-stage design.

2512.15756.tldr: ReactorFold is introduced, a generative framework that reformulates fuel-assembly design as a sequence modeling problem for language models that discovers high-performing asymmetric configurations that challenge conventional symmetric loading heuristics and demonstrates that language models can internalize causal physical relationships and transcend human-imposed design constraints.

2512.15762.tldr: The proposed CSA-TTA is evaluated on both the VitalDB dataset and a real-world in-hospital dataset by integrating it with state-of-the-art time series forecasting models, including TimesFM and UniTS, demonstrating strong robustness and generalization.

2512.15764.tldr: AdaGradSelect is introduced, an adaptive method that selects which transformer blocks to update based on gradients that provides a more effective and resource-efficient alternative to traditional fine-tuning methods.

2512.15766.tldr: This work proposes LOOPRAG, a novel retrieval-augmented generation framework designed to guide LLMs in performing effective loop optimization on Static Control Part, and introduces a parameter-driven method to harness loop properties, which trigger various loop transformations, and generates diverse yet legal example codes serving as a demonstration source.

2512.15767.tldr: This work uses Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to represent the ignorance component of the physics-based model, allowing it to enrich the physics-based model with data-driven corrections without requiring dense spatial, temporal and parametric data.

2512.15768.tldr: PHANTOM is introduced, a novel adversarial variational framework for generating high-fidelity synthetic attack data that includes progressive training, a dual-path VAE-GAN architecture, and domain-specific feature matching to preserve the semantics of attacks.

2512.15773.tldr: Temporal-aware Reinforcement-based Speculative Diffusion Policy (TS-DP), the first framework that enables speculative decoding for DP with temporal adaptivity, is proposed, and an RL-based scheduler adapts to time-varying task difficulty by adjusting speculative parameters to maintain accuracy while improving efficiency.

2512.15775.tldr: A dynamic web UI optimization through CR assessment using Finite Exponential Continuous State Machine (FECSM) and Quokka Nonlinear Difference Swarm Optimization Algorithm (QNDSOA) is proposed.

2512.15776.tldr: This research isolates the mechanism of active uncertainty reduction as a prerequisite for safe human-AI and robot-robot collaboration and proposes a novel Asymmetric Assistive Reasoning framework within AI2-THOR.

2512.15780.tldr: This work evaluates adversarial robustness in tabular machine learning models used in financial decision making using credit scoring and fraud detection data and measures impacts on discrimination, calibration, and financial risk metrics.

2512.15784.tldr: This work proposes MOBIMEM, a memory-centric agent system that integrates a suite of OS-inspired services to orchestrate execution: a scheduler that coordinates parallel sub-task execution and memory operations; an agent record-and-replay mechanism that enables safe and efficient action reuse; and a context-aware exception handling that ensures graceful recovery from user interruptions and runtime errors.

2512.15787.tldr: The authors provide a conceptual framework of agentic environments, a sustainability‐oriented AI framework that goes beyond reactive systems by leveraging GenAI, multi‐agent systems, and edge computing to minimize the negative impact of technology.

2512.15791.tldr: Evaluating AIETs in language models for Portuguese language models suggests that the applied AIETs serve as a guide for formulating general ethical considerations about language models, but it is noted that they do not address unique aspects of these models, such as idiomatic expressions.

2512.15793.tldr: ClarityEthic is introduced, a novel ethical assessment approach, to enhance valence prediction and explanation by generating conflicting social norms behind human actions, which strengthens the moral reasoning capabilities of language models by using a contrastive learning strategy.

2512.15799.tldr: This study scrutinizes the AI"dual-use"dilemma, functioning as both a cyber-threat vector and forensic automation mechanism, to delineate privacy boundaries in high-stakes investigations and proposes a"human-centric"forensic model prioritizing explainable AI (XAI) to ensure evidence admissibility.

2512.15800.tldr: A canonical decomposition theorem is expressed that expresses the tour-MST gap as edge-wise topology-divergence gaps from the RTD-Lite barcode and a topological guidance for 2-opt and 3-opt heuristics that increases their performance is developed.

2512.15813.tldr: This paper proposes CodeMem, an architecture to implement procedural memory via code which can be used to build and run reusable agentic workflows with deterministic reliability.

2512.15816.tldr: NeuroInv is presented, a neurosymbolic approach to loop invariant generation that combines a neural reasoning module that leverages LLMs and Hoare logic to derive and refine candidate invariants via backward-chaining weakest precondition reasoning and a verification-guided symbolic module that iteratively repairs invariants using counterexamples from OpenJML.

2512.15834.tldr: Novel systems optimizations to address performance bottlenecks during the inference process by speculating tool calls and forcing sequences to remain resident in the inference engine to minimize overheads are introduced.

2512.15885.tldr: JARVIS, a JEPA-inspired framework for self-supervised visual enhancement in MLLMs, is introduced, which integrates the I-JEPA learning paradigm into the standard vision-language alignment pipeline of MLLMs training.

2512.15892.tldr: VET (Verifiable Execution Traces), a formal framework that achieves host-independent authentication of agent outputs and takes a step toward host-independent autonomy, is introduced.

2512.15894.tldr: PediatricAnxietyBench is an open-source benchmark of 300 high-quality queries across 10 pediatric topics enabling reproducible evaluation of large language models to reveal clinically significant failure modes overlooked by standard benchmarks.

2512.15925.tldr: SocialStoryFrames is introduced, a formalism for distilling plausible inferences about reader response, such as perceived author intent, explanatory and predictive reasoning, affective responses, and value judgments, using conversational context and a taxonomy grounded in narrative theory, linguistic pragmatics, and psychology.

2512.15930.tldr: StructBioReasoner lays the groundwork for agentic reasoning systems for IDP therapeutic discovery on Exascale platforms by employing a novel tournament-based reasoning framework where specialized agents compete to generate and refine therapeutic hypotheses.

2512.15938.tldr: This work contributes a principled methodology for turning feature discovery into actionable model edits, advancing the development of transparent and controllable AI systems.

2512.15943.tldr: This work trained a domain-adapted SLM to execute representative tasks traditionally handled by LLMs, such as document summarization, query answering, and structured data interpretation, and demonstrated that the fine-tuned SLM achieves exceptional performance on ToolBench evaluation.

2512.15948.tldr: This paper proposes an approach to answering questions about objective functions, starting with the concept of a subjective function, a higher-order objective function that is endogenous to the agent (i.e., defined with respect to the agent's features, rather than an external task).

2512.15957.tldr: CAMP-VLM (Context-Aware Multi-human behavior Prediction): a Vision Language Model (VLM)-based framework that incorporates contextual features from visual input and spatial awareness from scene graphs to enhance prediction of humans-scene interactions is presented.

2512.15959.tldr: It is shown that structured machine-readable prompts substantially increase reasoning accuracy and cost efficiency for agents in production systems and establishes BRAID as an effective and scalable technique for optimizing inference efficiency in autonomous agent systems.

2512.15980.tldr: ClassLAR (Class-and Language model-based Architectural Recovery), a novel, lightweight, and efficient approach that recovers Java modules from monolithic Java systems using fully-qualified class names, which leverages language models to extract semantic information from package and class names.

2512.15987.tldr: The main result is an efficient query algorithm that identifies all feature directions whose responses are non-degenerate and reconstructs the function $f$ in a significantly more general setting than all related prior results.

2512.15998.tldr: SNAC-Pack is presented, an integrated framework that automates the discovery and optimization of neural networks focusing on FPGA deployment, enabling multi-objective optimization across accuracy, FPGA resource utilization, and latency without requiring time-intensive synthesis for each candidate model.

2512.16013.tldr: FTBSC-KGML (Fine-Tuning-Based Site Calibration-Knowledge-Guided Machine Learning), a pretraining- and fine-tuning-based, spatial-variability-aware, and knowledge-guided machine learning framework that augments KGML-ag with a pretraining-fine-tuning process and site-specific parameters, achieves lower validation error and greater consistency in explanatory power than a purely global model.

2512.16019.tldr: This work evaluates the ability of several LLMs to predict human perceptions of robot performance from a small number of in-context examples, based on observed spatio-temporal cues of the robot and surrounding human motion and shows that prediction performance can improve with more in-context examples, confirming the scalability of this approach.

2512.16022.tldr: This work repositions the Large Language Models as an intelligent judge that evaluates, explains, and strategically coordinates an ensemble of foundation models, and introduces an R1-style finetuning process, guided by SHAP-based faithfulness scores, which teaches the model to interpret ensemble weights as meaningful causal statements about temporal dynamics.

2512.16030.tldr: It is suggested that scaling and enhanced reasoning do not automatically confer calibration benefits, highlighting epistemic calibration as a distinct capability requiring targeted development.

2512.16036.tldr: An automated system for discovering and categorizing AI-related policies found in course syllabi and institutional policy websites that promotes the safe, equitable, and pedagogically aligned use of GenAI technologies in education is designed and implemented.

2512.16041.tldr: Sage, a novel evaluation suite that assesses the quality of LLM judges without necessitating any human annotation, introduces two new lenses for measuring LLM-as-a-Judge: local self-consistency (pair-wise preference stability) and global logical consistency (transitivity across a full set of preferences).

2512.16046.tldr: The proposed CauStream, a unified framework for causal spatiotemporal streamflow forecasting, offers a principled foundation for causal spatiotemporal modeling, with the potential to extend to a wide range of scientific and environmental applications.

2512.16063.tldr: A multi agent large language model framework that automates qualitative thematic analysis through three agents, named Collaborative Theme Identification Agent (CoTI), was developed and applied to 12 heart failure patient interviews to analyze their perceptions of medication intensity.

2512.16081.tldr: The authors' results demonstrate that methods explicitly modeling emotions lead to higher recognition accuracy compared to those focusing solely on speech-driven synchrony, and the realism and naturalness of happy animations significantly higher than those of neutral animations, highlighting the limitations of current generative models in handling subtle emotional states.

2512.16083.tldr: Experiments show that \toolname achieves near-perfect recall and higher precision than CodeS, SchemaExP, Qwen rerankers, and embedding retrievers, while maintaining sub-second median latency and scaling to schemas with 23,000+ columns.

2512.16089.tldr: LAPX is proposed, an Hourglass network with self-attention that captures global contextual information that achieves competitive results on two benchmark datasets, MPII and COCO, with only 2.3M parameters, and demonstrates real-time performance, confirming its edge-device suitability.

2512.16093.tldr: Experimental results show that TurboDiffusion achieves 100-200x speedup for video generation even on a single RTX 5090 GPU, while maintaining comparable video quality.

2512.16103.tldr: AIMM, an AI-driven framework that fuses Reddit activity, bot and coordination indicators, and OHLCV market features into a daily AIMM Manipulation Risk Score for each ticker is presented, and results show preliminary discriminative capability and early warnings for the GME incident.

2512.16106.tldr: By releasing ModelTables and its creation protocol, this work provides the first large scale benchmark of structured data describing AI model and provides intuition and evidence for developing more accurate semantic retrieval, structured comparison, and principled organization of structured model knowledge.

2512.16108.tldr: This paper proposes WeMusic-Agent, a training framework for efficient LLM-based conversational music recommendation that internalizes extensive musical knowledge via continued pretraining on 50B music-related corpus while acquiring the ability to invoke external tools when necessary.
