2411.01431.tldr: This survey discusses recent efficient deep learning infrastructures for embedded computing systems from the lens of efficient manual network design for embedded computing systems, efficient automated network design for embedded computing systems, efficient network compression for embedded computing systems, efficient on-device learning for embedded computing systems, and efficient intelligent applications for embedded computing systems.

2411.15206.tldr: This paper presents an end-to-end graph representation learning model to align the conditional distributions of weakly and strongly augmented features over the original features, which enables the CDL model to effectively preserve intrinsic semantic information when both weak and strong augmentations are applied to graph-structured data.

2412.13405.tldr: It is proposed that AI, like horses, should complement rather than replace human capabilities, and move beyond traditional benchmarks such as the Turing test, which emphasize AI's ability to mimic human intelligence, to advocate for a symbiotic relationship where distinct intelligences enhance each other.

2503.00566.tldr: This work modify and leverage the multi-agent large language model framework as well as the cloud-mapping integration to study the air quality during the Los Angeles wildfires to assess the Instructor-Worker LLM system's health recommendations based on air quality during the Los Angeles wildfires.

2503.01298.tldr: This work proposes Functionality-oriented eXperts (FoXperts), an expert-parallel architecture in the model FoX, which assigns experts by function, and develops a multi-task joint training scheme that equips the model with all capabilities required for each MCoT step in a disentangled manner.

2503.02341.tldr: GRADEO is introduced, one of the first specifically designed video evaluation models, which grades AI-generated videos for explainable scores and assessments through multi-step reasoning, and shows that it aligns better with human evaluations than existing methods.

2504.14757.tldr: This work presents SWE-Synth, a framework for synthesizing realistic, verifiable, and process-aware bug-fix datasets at the repository level, and highlights the potential of synthetic, agent-generated data to advance the state of the art in APR and software engineering automation.

2504.17129.tldr: In N-PACE, each agent explicitly models the learning dynamics of its peer agent while inferring their objective functions and updating its own control policy accordingly in real time, which leads to unbiased and fast learning of the unknown objective function of the peer agent.

2505.01912.tldr: No existing model achieves strong generalization across all tasks: even the top-performing model exhibited an average OOD error 3x higher than in-distribution, so developing models with strong OOD generalization is a new frontier challenge in chemical ML.

2505.03819.tldr: A novel rationale in favor of sharedness of features among classes indicates their reliability for a single sample, and two novel test-time fine-tuning methods to improve uncertain model predictions are proposed.

2507.12898.tldr: Vidar, consisting of an embodied video diffusion model as the generalizable prior and a masked inverse dynamics model (MIDM) as the adapter, is presented, suggesting a scalable recipe for "one prior, many embodiments": strong, inexpensive video priors together with minimal on-robot alignment.

2507.17765.tldr: This work adapts a recent joint ASR+SD framework to ASR+RD by freezing the ASR transducer and training an auxiliary RD transducer in parallel to assign a role to each ASR-predicted word, and proposes task-specific predictor networks and higher-layer ASR encoder features as input to the RD encoder.

2507.20423.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed code-based prompting method outperforms conventional text-based prompting on ten benchmarks across English, Arabic, Finnish, Danish, and German datasets, indicating the effectiveness of explicitly structuring NER instructions.

2508.11733.tldr: SafeSieve is presented, a progressive and adaptive multi-agent pruning algorithm that dynamically refines the inter-agent communication through a novel dual-mechanism, and establishes SafeSieve as an efficient, GPU-free, and scalable framework for practical multi-agent systems.

2508.13057.tldr: While MAE retains advantages in simplicity and efficiency, HEF proves more effective for long-term planning and complex contexts, and constitutes a robust and adaptive alternative for model selection and hyperparameter optimization in highly variable demand forecasting environments.

2508.20262.tldr: This study uses a content moderation task to examine parallels between human decision times and model reasoning effort, measured using the length of the chain-of-thought (CoT).

2509.00251.tldr: Instruction-Level Weight Shaping (ILWS) operates at the instruction layer until controlled distillation, it generalizes to dynamic domains (legal, medical, engineering) requiring adaptive reasoning, tool creation, and low-latency deployment.

2509.08713.tldr: This paper identifies four potential failure modes in contemporary AI scientist systems: inappropriate benchmark selection, data leakage, metric misuse, and post-hoc selection bias and demonstrates that access to trace logs and code from the full automated workflow enables far more effective detection of such failures than examining the final paper alone.

2510.06445.tldr: This work provides a comprehensive taxonomy of over 160 papers, explaining how agents are used in downstream cybersecurity applications, inherent threats to agentic systems, and countermeasures designed to protect them.

2510.12691.tldr: This work proposes a new method for training diffusion models with Expectation-Maximization (EM) from corrupted data, which utilizes conditional diffusion models to reconstruct clean data from observations in the E-step, and then uses the reconstructed data to refine the conditional diffusion model in the M-step.

2510.17638.tldr: This comprehensive evaluation reveals that many LLMs already exhibit impressive forecasting capabilities, but also uncover key bottlenecks towards achieving superior predictive intelligence via LLM-as-a-Prophet, such as LLMs' inaccurate event recalls, misunderstanding of data sources and slower information aggregation compared to markets when resolution nears.

2510.22295.tldr: This work curated the first large-scale Vietnamese ALT dataset (VietLyrics), comprising 647 hours of songs with line-level aligned lyrics and metadata, and fine-tuned Whisper models on the VietLyrics dataset, achieving superior results compared to existing multilingual ALT systems, including LyricWhiz.

2510.22732.tldr: This work introduces WebATLAS (Actor-Critic Task-completion with Look-ahead Action Simulation), a memory-augmented LLM web agent that learns a lightweight internal model of the environment from interaction experience and performs hypothetical action rollouts before acting in the real world.

2511.13524.tldr: This work introduces FreeAskWorld, an interactive simulation framework that integrates large language models for high-level behavior planning and semantically grounded interaction, informed by theories of intention and social cognition, and underscores that interaction itself serves as an additional information modality.

2511.21728.tldr: Experiments show that AffectMind outperforms strong LLM-based baselines in emotional consistency, persuasive success rate, and long-term user engagement, highlighting emotion-grounded proactivity as a key capability for commercial multimodal agents.

2512.03578.tldr: MAGNETS (Mask-and-AGgregate NEtwork for Time Series), an inherently interpretable neural architecture for TSER that learns a compact set of human-understandable concepts without requiring any annotations, is proposed.

2512.06737.tldr: It is shown that both a limiting variant of ArcGD and a momentum augmented ArcGD, recover sign-based momentum updates, revealing a clear conceptual link between ArcGD's phase structure and the core mechanism of the Lion Optimiser.

2512.16733.tldr: PDDL-style representations can be used to efficiently learn and model an input BBAI's planning capabilities and theoretical results show soundness, completeness and convergence of the learned models.

2512.17910.tldr: This work presents the first LLM serving engine that supports cross-model prefix cache reuse between base and adapted models via Activated LoRA (aLoRA), enabling efficient and fine-grained adapter switching during inference.

2512.17911.tldr: RMLLMU-Bench is the first benchmark for RMLLM unlearning that extends standard forgetting metrics with dedicated measures of reasoning leakage and reasoning retention, and proposes R-MUSE, a training-free and inference-time intervention framework that steers internal representations to forget both answers and reasoning traces while explicitly preserving general reasoning.

2512.17912.tldr: Graph-O1 is introduced, an agentic GraphRAG framework that enables LLMs to conduct stepwise, interactive reasoning over graphs, and integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search with end-to-end reinforcement learning, allowing the model to selectively explore and retrieve only the most informative subgraph components.

2512.17913.tldr: A novel Byzantine fault-tolerant multi-agent system specifically designed for healthcare applications, integrating gossip-based message propagation with cryptographic validation mechanisms, and maintains consensus accuracy of 100% with up to 33% Byzantine nodes.

2512.17916.tldr: This work evaluates two families of approaches for ticket prioritization: embedding-based pipelines that combine dimensionality reduction, clustering, and classical classifiers, and a fine-tuned multilingual transformer that processes both textual and numerical features.

2512.17917.tldr: KVReviver is proposed, a reversible KV cache compression method based on the sketch algorithm that allows reconstructing compressed tokens from an additional data structure, thus enabling full-scale computation within limited memory.

2512.17920.tldr: The Compression-Decay Comprehension Test (CDCT) is introduced, a benchmark that independently measures constraint compliance (CC) and semantic accuracy (SA) across compression levels, and demonstrates that RLHF-trained helpfulness behaviors are the dominant cause of constraint violations at medium compression.

2512.17928.tldr: A gradient-based meta learning framework that directly feeds optimization gradients into lightweight neural networks, thereby removing the need for pre-training and enabling fast adaptation and confirming the scalability and practicality of the proposed GML method for large-scale STAR-RIS-assisted communications.

2512.17934.tldr: The RF model demonstrated superior predictive performance for LC mortality rates, emphasizing the critical roles of smoking prevalence, housing values, and the percentage of Hispanic ethnic population.

2512.17941.tldr: This paper presents a general DT learning framework that is amenable to acceleration on reconfigurable hardware such as FPGAs, enabling substantial speedup and energy efficiency and shows the usage of this technique in DT guided synthetic data generation for Type 1 Diabetes and proactive coronary artery disease detection.

2512.17943.tldr: NystagmusNet is proposed, an AI-driven system that predicts high-risk visual environments and recommends real-time visual adaptations and includes a rule-based recommendation engine for adaptive filter suggestions.

2512.17946.tldr: This paper identifies the least emotion-relevant layer within MIDIBERT and introduces a Mode-guided Feature-wise linear modulation injection (MoFi) framework to inject explicit mode features, thereby enhancing the model's capability in emotional representation and inference and validate the effectiveness of mode-guided modeling in symbolic music emotion recognition.

2512.17950.tldr: The results provide the first theoretical study for reviewer nomination policies, offering both conceptual insights and practical directions for authors to wisely choose which co-author should serve as the nominated reciprocal reviewer.

2512.17952.tldr: The results suggest that the inherent computational limitations of AI agents can lead to situations where equilibrium is not reached, creating a more lively and unpredictable trade environment than traditional models would predict.

2512.17953.tldr: This work presents a systematic analysis of background bias across classification models, contrastive text-image pretrained models, and Video Large Language Models and finds that all exhibit a strong tendency to default to background reasoning.

2512.17958.tldr: A practical multimodal framework for frame-accurate human-robot interaction intent detection that fuses camera-invariant 2D skeletal pose and facial emotion features extracted from monocular RGB video is presented.

2512.17968.tldr: A critical analysis of the evolution of Monte Carlo algorithms, focusing on the persistent tension between statistical efficiency and computational cost, is presented.

2512.17969.tldr: This work extends the convolutional neural operator model to few-shot learning scenarios by first pre-training a convolutional neural operator using a source dataset and then adjusting the parameters of the trained neural operator using only a small target dataset and finds that the neuron linear transformation strategy enjoys the highest surrogate accuracy in solving PDEs such as Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation, Brusselator diffusion-reaction system, and Navier-Stokes equations.

2512.17970.tldr: This work presents CodeGEMM, a codebook-centric GEMM kernel that replaces dequantization with precomputed inner products between centroids and activations stored in a lightweight Psumbook, and supports the systematic exploration of latency-memory-accuracy trade-offs under a unified implementation.

2512.17983.tldr: This papers investigates parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, specifically Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Quantized LoRA, as scalable alternatives to full model fine-tuning for HAR and demonstrates that both LoRA and QLoRA can match the recognition performance of full fine-tuning while significantly reducing the number of trainable parameters, memory usage, and training time.

2512.17984.tldr: Results show that combining inductive flow imputation with transductive speed, traffic simulations and external geospatial improves accuracy for the task described above.

2512.18004.tldr: This work explores and compares the performance of traditional OCR-MT pipelines with Vision Large Language Models that aim to unify these stages and directly translate handwritten text images in a single, end-to-end step to enable efficient legal document processing, even in low-resource environments.

2512.18014.tldr: ReGal, a framework that integrates Multi-Task Instruction Tuning with Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), is introduced, a framework that underperforms on standard evaluation metrics compared to supervised and proprietary models.

2512.18031.tldr: A labelled ICU dataset and benchmarks for AF detection and promising potential for using AI to build an automatic patient monitoring system are published.

2512.18043.tldr: This research develops a lifecycle-aware security framework specifically designed for agentic AI systems using the Design Science Research (DSR) methodology and provides a structured, standardized, and framework-based approach for the secure deployment and governance of agentic AI in enterprise environments.

2512.18057.tldr: FOODER, a real-time, privacy-preserving radar-based framework that integrates OOD-based facial authentication with facial expression recognition, outperforms state-of-the-art OOD detection methods and several transformer-based architectures while operating efficiently in real time.

2512.18077.tldr: Overall, sequence-based family modelling plus mutation analysis provides a fine-grained account of how promotional bot behaviour adapts over time.

2512.18082.tldr: A region-level, uncertainty-gated retrieval mechanism that improves segmentation accuracy and calibration under domain shift is proposed that achieves an 11.3% increase in mean intersection-over-union while reducing retrieval cost by 87.5%.

2512.18092.tldr: It is observed that neuron identification can be viewed as the inverse process of machine learning, which allows for guarantees for neuron explanations, and the first theoretical analysis of two fundamental challenges is presented, presenting the first theoretical analysis of two fundamental challenges.

2512.18094.tldr: This work first bridge insights from neuroscience and complex networks to MAS, highlighting how SW structures balance local clustering and long-range integration, and introduces an uncertainty-guided rewiring scheme for scaling MAS, where long-range shortcuts are added between epistemically divergent agents using LLM-oriented uncertainty signals.

2512.18126.tldr: This work replaces dense agent interaction graphs with a hierarchical tree topology that induces structured sparsity in inter-agent communication and introduces a runtime adaptive mechanism that selectively terminates or skips downstream agent invocations using semantic agreement and confidence signals from intermediate outputs.

2512.18131.tldr: This study presents a comprehensive empirical evaluation of six state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for code generation, including both general-purpose and code-specialized models, and provides actionable recommendations for developers and practitioners.

2512.18133.tldr: A relation diffusion-based graph augmentation model Grad is proposed, which leverages a supervised graph contrastive learning module to enhance the fraud-benign difference and employs a guided relation diffusion generator to generate auxiliary homophilic relations from scratch.

2512.18135.tldr: This survey systematically review recent advancements at the intersection of causal inference and RL, and categorizes existing approaches into causal representation learning, counterfactual policy optimization, offline causal RL, causal transfer learning, and causal explainability.

2512.18146.tldr: This work introduces the interactive Swarm Leader Identification (iSLI) problem, a novel approach where an adversarial probing agent identifies a swarm's leader by physically interacting with its members, and employs Deep Reinforcement Learning, specifically Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), to train the prober's policy.

2512.18160.tldr: Propose, Solve, Verify (PSV) a simple self-play framework where formal verification signals are used to create a proposer capable of generating challenging synthetic problems and a solver trained via expert iteration, which shows that performance scales with the number of generated questions and training iterations.

2512.18177.tldr: Overall, NEURO-GUARD bridges symbolic medical reasoning with subsymbolic visual learning, enabling interpretable, knowledge-aware, and generalizable medical image diagnosis while achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple datasets.

2512.18189.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that NL2CA enables scalable, interpretable, and human-aligned cognitive modeling from unstructured textual data, offering a novel paradigm to automatically design symbolic cognitive agents.

2512.18199.tldr: A comprehensive XAI framework designed to bridge the trust gap in Security Operations Centers (SOCs) by making graph-based detection transparent by providing insight into the model's reasoning, which aims to improve analyst trust and triage speed.

2512.18202.tldr: Sophia, a "Persistent Agent"wrapper that grafts a continuous self-improvement loop onto any LLM-centric System 1/2 stack, and fusing psychological insight with a lightweight reinforcement-learning core advances a possible practical pathway toward artificial life.

2512.18211.tldr: LLaViDA is proposed, a Large Language Vision Driving Assistant that leverages a Vision-Language Model (VLM) for object motion prediction, semantic grounding, and chain-of-thought reasoning for trajectory planning in autonomous driving.

2512.18215.tldr: This work introduces MSSR, a group-free RLVR framework that achieves both stable optimization and effective multimodal reasoning performance via an entropy-based advantage-shaping mechanism that adaptively regularizes advantage magnitudes, preventing collapse and maintaining training stability.

2512.18244.tldr: This work proposes Human-like Psychological Manipulation (HPM), a black-box jailbreak method that dynamically profiles a target model's latent psychological vulnerabilities and synthesizes tailored multi-turn attack strategies, prioritizing the development of psychological defense mechanisms against deep cognitive manipulation.

2512.18245.tldr: A novel network termed Spectral Discrepancy and Cross-Modal semantic consistency learning (SDCM) is proposed, which facilitates the extraction of consistent information across a wide range of hyperspectral bands while utilizing the spectral dimension to pinpoint regions of interest.

2512.18246.tldr: The striking data saturation in offline behavioral data is uncovered: policy performance rapidly saturates when trained on a small fraction of the dataset, attributed to the weak alignment between policy performance and test loss, revealing substantial room for improvement through data selection.

2512.18247.tldr: This work constructs the first Ancient Plant Seed Image Classification (APS) dataset and designs a framework specifically for the ancient plant seed classification task (APSNet), which introduces the scale feature (size) of seeds based on learning fine-grained information to guide the network in discovering key"evidence" for sufficient classification.

2512.18256.tldr: MSC-180, a benchmark for evaluation based on the MSC2020 mathematical subject classification, provides a discriminative and systematic benchmark for driving the development of next-generation AI systems with genuine mathematical reasoning abilities.

2512.18263.tldr: An existing retrieval-based method is extended, Text-Embedding KNN for SICL (TICL), introducing an acoustic reranking step to create TICL+.

2512.18264.tldr: This work proposes a novel protection method that jointly optimizes privacy suppression and utility preservation under a visual consistency constraint and introduces VPI-COCO, a publicly available benchmark comprising 522 images with hierarchically structured privacy questions and corresponding non-private counterparts, enabling fine-grained and joint evaluation of protection methods in terms of privacy preservation and user experience.

2512.18265.tldr: This framework establishes a collaborative intelligence system integrating Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Model-based agents to bridge the gap between human decision-makers and critical operational insights, empowering manufacturing professionals through natural language interfaces for complex operational analysis.

2512.18273.tldr: An evolutionary belief propagation decoder for quantum error correction, which incorporates trainable weights into the BP algorithm and optimizes them via the differential evolution algorithm, which achieves better decoding performance and lower computational complexity than BP+OSD.

2512.18295.tldr: This work proposes AL GNN, a novel framework for continual graph learning that eliminates the need for backpropagation and replay buffers, and leverages principles from analytic learning theory to formulate learning as a recursive least squares optimization process.

2512.18309.tldr: This work analyzes stability conditions for bounded internal embeddings under Lipschitz continuity and spectral constraints, discusses computational complexity, and examines theoretical properties including contraction behavior and fairness-performance tradeoffs of Embedded Safety-Aligned Intelligence.

2512.18311.tldr: This work proposes three evaluation archetypes (intervention, process, and outcome-property) and a new monitorability metric, and introduces a broad evaluation suite and demonstrates that these evaluations can catch simple model organisms trained to have obfuscated CoTs, and that CoT monitoring is more effective than action-only monitoring in practical settings.

2512.18317.tldr: A framework that enables safe and energy-efficient operation under realistic boundary conditions and a multi-level explainability pipeline combining input perturbation tests, gradient-based sensitivity analysis, and SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) feature attribution are developed.

2512.18318.tldr: A parallel and asynchronous Transformer framework designed for efficient and accurate multilingual lip synchronization in real-time video conferencing systems and advances the development of low-latency, resource-efficient multimodal communication frameworks for next-generation AIoT systems.

2512.18333.tldr: Training results show the faster training time of the proposed thrust vector controller in comparison to the conventional RPM controllers, and simulation results show smoother and more accurate path-following for the proposed thrust vector controller.

2512.18336.tldr: The positive effect the dynamic entropy tuning in Reinforcement Learning algorithms that train a stochastic policy has on controlling the quadcopter by preventing catastrophic forgetting and improving exploration efficiency is shown.

2512.18344.tldr: The integration of semi-supervised learning with agronomic priors provides a promising approach for enhancing remote sensing-based precision agriculture.

2512.18360.tldr: A novel neurosymbolic framework for RDF-to-text generation, in which the model is trained through collaborative interactions among multiple LLM agents rather than traditional backpropagation, which is fully interpretable, requires no supervised training data, and generates text nearly instantaneously using only a single CPU.

2512.18388.tldr: This work examines an approach grounded in the Geneplore model of creative cognition and instantiate it in a human-AI co-creation system, HAICo, for creative image generation, and demonstrates that HAICo outperforms ChatGPT across multiple dimensions of creativity and usability.

2512.18399.tldr: A AraToken is presented, an Arabic-optimized tokenizer built on SentencePiece Unigram algorithm with a comprehensive normalization pipeline addressing Arabic-specific orthographic variations including Alif variants, diacritics, and Arabic-Indic numerals.

2512.18411.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive-Debiased Ensemble Multi-Prompt Learning, abbreviated as AmPLe, to mitigate the two types of bias simultaneously, and shows that AmPLe can widely outperform existing methods.

2512.18412.tldr: The structural graph scheme with concepts enables learning from multiple examples without backpropagation of error and provides built-in explanations through an explicit graph structure.

2512.18436.tldr: This paper curates a new system-verification benchmark suite, VeruSAGE-Bench, which consists of 849 proof tasks extracted from eight open-source Verus-verified Rust systems and designs different agent systems to match the strengths and weaknesses of different LLMs.

2512.18437.tldr: MeniMV, a multi-view benchmark dataset specifically designed for horn-specific meniscus injury grading, is introduced, offering more than double the pathology-labeled data volume of prior datasets while uniquely capturing the dual-view diagnostic context essential in clinical practice.

2512.18440.tldr: An agentic framework for training general practitioner student skills that unifies configurable, evidence-based vignette generation, controlled persona-driven patient dialogue with optional retrieval grounding, and standards-based assessment and feedback for both communication and clinical reasoning is introduced.

2512.18441.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that HSTE-GNN outperforms strong spatio-temporal baselines such as ST-GRAPH, and confirm that the proposed framework provides a scalable, adaptive, and efficient solution for next-generation intelligent transportation systems and large-scale logistics platforms.

2512.18444.tldr: This paper introduces Decentralised Preference Discovery (DPD), the problem of determining the collective will of an electorate under constraints of censorship resistance, partial information, and asynchronous communication, and proposes Snowveil, a novel framework for this task.

2512.18450.tldr: This work proposes an agent-based framework for detecting drift and assessing its severity in multisite clinical AI systems, and suggests that adaptive, site-aware agent-based drift monitoring can enhance reliability of multisite clinical decision support systems.

2512.18452.tldr: The hypothesis that MLP layers in dense LLM models can be well approximated by sparsely-activating Mixture of Experts (MoE) layers is validated, and the experimental explorations suggest new directions for more efficient MoE architecture design based on low-rank routers.

2512.18456.tldr: This SoK surveys the landscape of AI4Code security across three core applications, identifying recurring gaps: benchmark dominance by Python and toy problems, lack of standardized security datasets, data leakage in evaluation, and fragile adversarial robustness.

2512.18462.tldr: This work introduces Log-Frequency LMI (LF-LMI) to accurately detect semantic artifacts and generates a high-quality synthetic contrast set via an LLM-synthesis pipeline with multi-judge verification through Dynamic Balanced Sampling.

2512.18483.tldr: A post-hoc ITD framework that integrates explicit and implicit graph representations with temporal modelling to capture complex user behaviour patterns is proposed, highlighting the effectiveness of combining graph-based and temporal representations for robust ITD.

2512.18489.tldr: It is found that while LLM belief updates resemble Bayesian posteriors, they are more accurately characterized by an exponential forgetting filter with a model-specific discount factor smaller than one, which reveals systematic discounting of older evidence that varies significantly across model architectures.

2512.18495.tldr: It is demonstrated that integrating ensemble-based uncertainty with conformal prediction provides a more reliable safeguard against misclassifications under extreme dataset shifts, particularly in the presence of packed malware, thereby offering practical benefits for real-world security operations.

2512.18500.tldr: This paper presents PlantDiseaseNet-RT50, a novel fine-tuned deep learning architecture based on ResNet50 for automated plant disease detection, offering a computationally efficient solution for rapid and accurate plant disease diagnosis.

2512.18522.tldr: This study applies machine learning techniques to link drought indices with historical drought impact records to generate short-term impact forecasts and supports the development of an Ecological Drought Information Communication System for New Mexico and demonstrates the potential for broader application in similar drought-prone regions.

2512.18527.tldr: A robust detection framework that leverages multiple uncertainty measures to decide whether to trust or reject a model’s predictions, and maintains high acceptance of accurate predictions for natural images and in-domain AI data is presented.

2512.18552.tldr: The results, albeit early, suggest a path where agents autonomously gather extensive learning experiences from real-world software repositories, ultimately enabling superintelligent systems that exceed human capabilities in understanding how systems are constructed, solving novel challenges, and autonomously creating new software from scratch.

2512.18554.tldr: This work proposes MEDALIGN, a simple, lightweight alignment distillation framework that transfers visual alignment knowledge from a domain-specific Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) model to Med-LVLMs, yielding more visually grounded outputs.

2011.03783.tldr: This work introduces the construction of a machine translation assisted and human-in-the-loop multilingual parallel corpus with annotations of multi-word expressions (MWEs), named AlphaMWE, and presents a categorisation of the error types encountered by MT systems in performing MWE-related translation.

2306.00029.tldr: The design principles, the architecture, key modules and components, and compare with other related library tools are described and hope CodeTF is able to bridge the gap between machine learning/generative AI and software engineering, providing a comprehensive open-source solution for developers, researchers, and practitioners.

2306.02766.tldr: This work introduces networked communication to mean-field games by introducing networked communication to MFGs, in particular to settings that use a single, non-episodic run of decentralised agents to simulate the infinite population, as is likely to be most reasonable in real-world deployments.

2401.16310.tldr: In security code review, LLMs significantly outperform state-of-the-art static analysis tools, and the reasoning-optimized LLM performs better than general-purpose LLMs.

2402.06118.tldr: A novel framework, ViGoR (Visual Grounding Through Fine-Grained Reward Modeling) is introduced that utilizes fine-grained reward modeling to significantly enhance the visual grounding of LVLMs over pre-trained baselines over automated methods.

2404.06324.tldr: This paper proposes a systematic and generic approach to obtain the solution for the solution for the impacts of wireless channels and users’ datasets on the FL execution, and shows the efficiency of <monospace>DCLM</monospace> via numerical simulations.

2407.16292.tldr: Despite improvements in the technical aspects of image generation, the level of reproduction of potentially harmful autism-related stereotypes remained largely unaffected, with significant differences between the models.

2408.10566.tldr: By enabling model growth with sparsified gradients and parameters, SparseGrow paves the way for building scalable lifelong learning systems capable of continual adaptation with better knowledge retention.

2408.11607.tldr: It is theoretically that exchanging policy information helps networked agents outperform both independent and even centralised agents in function-approximation settings, and empirically it is shown that the communication network allows decentralised agents to estimate the mean field for population-dependent policies.

2408.15510.tldr: It is found that: all methods show a clear tradeoff between completeness and selectivity; more complete and reliable methods have a greater impact on LLM behavior; and nonlinear interventions are almost always more reliable than linear interventions.

2409.01382.tldr: A comparative study of code generated by four distinct LLMs reveals critical granularity-dependent inversions: while modern models (Claude, GPT-OSS, Claude 3 Haiku, Claude Haiku 4.5, and GPT-OSS are more detectable at the class level, GPT-3.5 is an anomaly that uniquely excels at the function level.

2410.15178.tldr: This paper introduces Task-Specific Uncertainty Maps (TSUMs), which abstract the acceptable levels of state estimation uncertainty across different regions, and proposes GUIDE, a policy-conditioning framework that incorporates these uncertainty requirements into the robot’s decision-making process.

2410.24116.tldr: This work introduces a novel approach that leverages outpainting to mitigate the problem of annotated data scarcity by generating artificial contexts and annotations, significantly reducing manual labeling efforts in autonomous driving, urban planning, and environmental monitoring.

2411.07019.tldr: This work proposes UniHR, a Unified Hierarchical Representation learning framework, which consists of a learning-optimized Hierarchical Data Representation (HiDR) module and a unified Hierarchical Structure Learning (HiSL) module, which incorporates intra-fact and inter-fact message passing, focusing on enhancing both semantic information within individual facts and enriching the structural information between facts.

2411.19000.tldr: A multimodal smart home platform designed for continuous, at-home rehabilitation of post-stroke patients, integrating wearable sensing, ambient monitoring, and adaptive automation, that offers a scalable, patient-centered framework with potential for long-term use in broader neurorehabilitation and aging-in-place applications.

2412.14031.tldr: This work establishes non-asymptotic convergence bounds for the Gauss-Newton method in training neural networks with smooth activations, and proposes adaptive, curvature-aware regularization schedules that ensure fast geometric convergence to a global optimum at a rate independent of the minimum eigenvalue of the neural tangent kernel.

2412.14579.tldr: GSRender is proposed, which uses 3D Gaussian Splatting for weakly-supervised occupancy estimation, simplifying the sampling process, and introduces the Ray Compensation module, which reduces duplicated predictions by compensating for features from adjacent frames.

2501.10190.tldr: This paper proposes a new interpretation of existing formalisms in the field of Actual Causality in which SEM's are viewed as mechanisms transforming the dynamics of exogenous variables into the dynamics of endogenous variables, and introduces a temporal logic, CPLTL, for causal reasoning about such structures.

2501.15240.tldr: The proposed Homogeneous-Device Aware Pruning (HDAP) is a hardware-aware DNN compression framework explicitly designed for homogeneous edge devices, aiming to achieve optimal average performance of the compressed model across all devices.

2502.12489.tldr: A comprehensive review of video-to-music generation using deep generative AI techniques, focusing on three key components: conditioning input construction, conditioning mechanism, and music generation frameworks, and categorizing existing approaches based on their designs for each component.

2503.04162.tldr: A novel approach to contrastive learning that leverages the semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities of LLMs to generate expressive embeddings that capture both user preferences and item characteristics and introduces a learnable sample synthesizer that optimizes the contrastive sample generation process during model training.

2503.04521.tldr: An Auction-based Edge Inference Pricing Mechanism (AERIA) is proposed for revenue maximization to tackle the multi-dimensional optimization problem of DNN model partition, edge inference pricing, and resource allocation and validates the efficacy of AERIA for on-demand DNN inference in the Edge-AI market.

2503.11185.tldr: DEEPALIGN is introduced - an inherent defense framework that enhances the safety of LLMs by applying contrastive hidden-state steering at the midpoint of response generation, enabling continuous intrinsic toxicity detection and intervention throughout the generation process.

2503.14428.tldr: Comp-Attn is proposed, a composition-aware cross-attention variant that follows a Present-and-Align paradigm that decouples the two challenges by enforcing subject presence at the condition level and achieving relational alignment at the attention-distribution level.

2505.01353.tldr: This paper discusses the computation of solution sensitivities of general nonlinear programs (NLPs) using the implicit function theorem (IFT) and smoothed optimality conditions treated in interior-point methods (IPM) using the implicit function theorem (IFT) and smoothed optimality conditions treated in interior-point methods (IPM).

2505.08438.tldr: This survey aims to serve as an essential reference and provides a clear and motivating roadmap toward advancing the state of the art in event-driven 3D reconstruction.

2505.11792.tldr: SIRL is a novel framework that significantly improves the authenticity of LLMs for optimization modeling using Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward by leveraging external optimization solvers as verifiers by leveraging external optimization solvers as verifiers.

2505.15662.tldr: Experiments on a D-Wave quantum annealer show that Tx-NQDT-informed schedules significantly improve success probabilities despite hardware noise and calibration drift, and demonstrate a practical, data-driven route to improved quantum annealing performance on real hardware.

2505.15925.tldr: VLM-Embedded Reasoning for autonomous Driving (VERDI) is proposed, a training-time framework that distills the reasoning process and commonsense knowledge of VLMs into the AD stack and outperforms existing e2e methods that do not embed reasoning.

2505.18822.tldr: AdaCtrl is proposed, a novel framework to support both difficulty-aware adaptive reasoning budget allocation and explicit user control over reasoning depth that dynamically adjusts its reasoning length based on self-assessed problem difficulty, while also allowing users to manually control the budget to prioritize either efficiency or effectiveness.

2505.20063.tldr: This work proposes input and output scores to characterize and locate two types of features: input features, which mainly capture patterns in the model's input, and output features, which have a human-understandable effect on the model's output.

2505.23950.tldr: This work presents an initial exploration through the InterMT -- the first preference dataset for multi-turn multimodal interaction, grounded in real human feedback, and introduces InterMT-Bench to assess the ability of MLLMs in assisting judges with multi-turn, multimodal tasks.

2505.24099.tldr: This research focuses on predicting changes in long-term statistical patterns of the gKS model that result from varying the dispersion relation or the length of the spatial domain and uses transfer learning to adapt ESNs to different parameter settings and successfully capture changes in the underlying chaotic attractor.

2505.24511.tldr: TimeReasoner is presented, a systematic empirical study that reformulates TSF as a conditional reasoning process performed entirely at inference time, and induces multi-step temporal reasoning in pretrained slow-thinking LLMs through chain-of-thought prompting and rollout-based reasoning strategies.

2506.11712.tldr: A Symmetric Multimodal Preference Optimization (SymMPO), which conducts symmetric preference learning with direct preference supervision with direct preference supervision for visual understanding enhancement, while maintaining rigorous theoretical alignment with standard DPO.

2506.13702.tldr: The results demonstrate that RPO outperforms existing single-trajectory baselines such as DRO and Kahneman-Tversky Optimization and confirm that RPO is a simple, effective, and theoretically grounded method for single-trajectory policy optimization.

2506.16506.tldr: Subspace Boosting is introduced, which operates on the singular value decomposed task vector space and maintains task vector ranks and proposes employing Higher-Order Generalized Singular Value Decomposition to quantify task similarity, offering a new interpretable perspective on model merging.

2507.07935.tldr: It is found that the most common and successful AI-assisted work activities involve information work--the creation, processing, and communication of information.

2507.10216.tldr: This paper introduces Absher, a comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to assess LLMs performance across major Saudi dialects, and evaluates several state-of-the-art LLMs, including multilingual and Arabic-specific models.

2507.17860.tldr: A state-of-the-art generative model is trained to generate synthetic data in a controllable manner to assess the fairness of publicly available skin cancer classifiers and confirms that highly realistic synthetic images facilitate model fairness verification.

2507.21176.tldr: A novel framework combining knowledge graphs (KGs) with auxiliary (agentic) LLMs to systematically reveal complex bias patterns in medical LLMs to generate more effective red-teaming questions for bias evaluation and utilize those questions more effectively in revealing complex biases.

2507.22782.tldr: TAAC is introduced, a reinforcement learning algorithm designed to enhance multi-agent collaboration in cooperative environments that employs a Centralized Training/Centralized Execution scheme incorporating multi-headed attention mechanisms in both the actor and critic.

2508.14075.tldr: This paper considers other embeddings of documents, in particular, based on the GloVe embedding idea, based on the GloVe embedding idea, for explainability of Graph Spectral Clustering results for textual documents.

2509.06278.tldr: This paper proposes TableMind, a tuning-based autonomous programmatic table agent that simulates the human-like cognitive schema of multi-turn interaction within a lightweight LLM and learns to internalize planning, action, and reflection through a principled two-stage training strategy.

2509.09284.tldr: This work reframe GRPO into a staged training paradigm, leveraging a teacher's MCTS rollouts to construct a tree structured curriculum of prefixes, and proposes Staged Advantage Estimation (SAE), a framework for computing low variance, prefix aware advantages by projecting rewards onto a constraint set that respects the tree's hierarchy.

2509.23004.tldr: This work proposes an open-source algebraic geometry-based system that, given an incomplete axiom system expressible as polynomials and a hypothesis that the axioms cannot derive, generates a minimal set of candidate axioms that provably derive the (possibly noisy) hypothesis.

2509.25300.tldr: A systematic empirical investigation of scaling behaviors in RL-based post-training, with a particular focus on mathematical reasoning, provides a principled foundation and practical guidelines for efficiently scaling the reasoning capabilities of LLMs through RL post-training.

2510.03248.tldr: Neural operators augmented with multimodal fusion can accurately predict full-field brain displacement from heterogeneous inputs and offer inference times orders of magnitude faster than finite element solvers.

2510.04978.tldr: This work provides a comprehensive overview of physical AI, establishing clear distinctions between theoretical physics reasoning and applied physical understanding while systematically examining how physics-grounded methods enhance AI's real-world comprehension across structured symbolic reasoning, embodied systems, and generative models.

2510.09595.tldr: Detailed analyses indicate that robust reasoning models prioritize precise problem analysis over excessive exploration, suggesting future models should emphasize structured analysis and minimize unnecessary exploration.

2510.11496.tldr: This paper introduces AndesVL, a suite of mobile-side MLLMs with 0.6B to 4B parameters based on Qwen3's LLM and various visual encoders, and introduces a 1+N LoRA architecture alongside a Quantization-Aware LoRA Fine-Tuning framework to facilitate efficient task adaptation and model compression during mobile-side deployment of AndesVL.

2510.12399.tldr: This survey provides the first comprehensive and systematic review of Vibe Coding with large language models, establishing both theoretical foundations and practical frameworks for this transformative development approach and providing the first comprehensive taxonomy in this domain.

2510.24072.tldr: Findings reveal that smart devices have been covertly capturing personal data, especially with smart toys and voice-activated smart gadgets built for youth, and have significant implications for policy development and the transparency of data collection for smart devices.

2511.02376.tldr: AutoAdv is presented, a training-free framework for automated multi-turn jailbreaking that achieves an attack success rate of up to 95% on Llama-3-8B within six turns, a 24% improvement over single-turn baselines.

2511.02864.tldr: It is demonstrated that large language model-guided evolutionary search can autonomously discover mathematical constructions that complement human intuition, at times matching or even improving the best known results, highlighting the potential for significant new ways of interaction between mathematicians and AI systems.

2511.05844.tldr: A differentiable calibration objective based on the Smooth Expected Calibration Error (Smooth ECE) is proposed, which improves classifier calibration with minimal fine-tuning and yields measurable improvements in Frechet Inception Distance (FID).

2511.09392.tldr: This paper focuses on the Profile Pollution Attack that subtly contaminates partial user interactions to induce targeted mispredictions, and proposes a constrained reinforcement driven attack CREAT that synergizes a bi-level optimization framework with multi-reward reinforcement learning to balance adversarial efficacy and stealthiness.

2511.11646.tldr: A Conditional Tabular Variational Autoencoder (CTVAE) that learns the conditional joint distribution of product attributes and consumer characteristics from large-scale tabular data and outperforms existing tabular generative models in capturing conditional consumer attribute distributions.

2511.17582.tldr: GateRA is proposed, a unified framework that introduces token-aware modulation to dynamically adjust the strength of PEFT updates, and an entropy-based regularization that encourages near-binary gating decisions is introduced to promote confident and efficient modulation.

2511.20277.tldr: HVAdam is proposed, a novel optimizer that associates all dimensions of the parameters to find a new parameter update direction, leading to a refined parameter update strategy for an increased convergence rate.

2512.04618.tldr: This work presents a first attempt to decode speech from a fully implantable and wireless epidural recording system offering perspectives for long-term use and presents an offline speech decoding pipeline based on an encoder-decoder deep neural architecture, integrating Vision Transformers and contrastive learning to enhance the direct regression of speech from ECoG signals.

2512.10713.tldr: This work presents Precise Automatically Checked Instruction Following In Code (PACIFIC), a novel framework designed to automatically generate benchmarks that rigorously assess sequential instruction-following and code dry-running capabilities in LLMs, while allowing control over benchmark difficulty.

2512.11077.tldr: A log-probability foundation model is introduced that unifies denoising, phase classification, and OP extraction within a single probabilistic framework that demonstrates universality across hundreds of prototypes, robustness under strong thermal and defect-induced disorder, and accurate treatment of complex systems such as ice polymorphs, ice--water interfaces, and shock-compressed Ti.

2512.11469.tldr: This paper applies PatternBoost transformer learning and reinforcement learning to this problem for the first time, comparing them against ILP, and shows that classical optimization remains essential for exact solutions while AI methods offer competitive performance on smaller instances.

2512.12608.tldr: Verification on a benchmark of 60 semantically diverse question--solution pairs demonstrates that the proposed entropy-guided approach achieves stronger coverage of unseen questions and significantly greater internal diversity than a random baseline, confirming its effectiveness in discovering more generalizable and human-inspired methods.

2512.13458.tldr: A cross-subject EEG-based emotion recognition through source selection with adversarial strategy is introduced and achieves outstanding performance on two EEG-based emotion datasets, SEED and SEED-IV.

2512.13907.tldr: This paper presents a structured mapping that translates high-level AI Act requirements into concrete, implementable verification activities applicable across the AI lifecycle, and provides a reusable reference for consistent, technology-agnostic compliance verification under the AI Act.

2512.14806.tldr: Preliminary findings from extensive evaluation across multiple ADRS frameworks are presented, which demonstrate that ADRS-generated solutions can match or even outperform human state-of-the-art designs.

2512.15109.tldr: This paper argues that large artificial intelligence models (LAMs) can endow base stations with perception, reasoning, and acting capabilities, thus transforming them into intelligent base station agents (IBSAs), and proposes a holistic evaluation framework and benchmark considerations that jointly cover communication performance, perception accuracy, decision-making reliability, safety, and energy efficiency.

2512.15396.tldr: The main idea of the approach is to alleviate the influence of cross-view distributional shifts, thereby facilitating semantic matching contrastive learning to fully exploit semantic relationships in both aligned and unaligned data.

2512.15584.tldr: This work provides a principled method for determining when an AI is aligned enough for a given context, shifting the focus from achieving perfect alignment to managing the risks and rewards of delegation under uncertainty.

2512.16214.tldr: PDE-Agent is introduced, the first toolchain-augmented multi-agent collaboration framework, inheriting the reasoning capacity of LLMs and the controllability of external tools and enabling automated PDE solving from natural language descriptions, to validate and evaluate this new paradigm of toolchain-augmented multi-agent PDE solving.

2512.16244.tldr: A Coarse-to-Fine open-set Classification (CFC) framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) for graph datasets and improves OOD detection by ten percent over state-of-the-art methods on graph and text domains and achieves up to seventy percent accuracy in OOD classification on graph datasets.

2512.16280.tldr: Investigating romance-baiting scams and the role of Large Language Models in both current and future automation suggests that romance-baiting scams may be amenable to full-scale LLM automation, while existing defenses remain inadequate to prevent their expansion.

2512.16301.tldr: Post-training methods, adaptive memory architectures, and agent skills are reviewed; their trade-offs in cost, flexibility, and generalization are compared; and evaluation practices are summarized across deep research, software development, computer use, and drug discovery.

2512.16515.tldr: A way of reading the universe's history as the evolution of dynamics itself, culminating in biological and artificial systems capable of modeling, predicting, and deliberately perturbing their own future trajectories is presented.

2512.16661.tldr: An Attention-Based Subgraph Retriever model is proposed, a GNN-as-retriever model that applies attention-based pruning to extract a refined subgraph, which is then passed to a large language model for advanced knowledge reasoning.

2512.16707.tldr: This work formalizes two independent computational limitations that constrain algorithmic intelligence: formal incompleteness and dynamical unpredictability and shows that these two extrema together impose structural bounds on an agent's ability to reason about its own predictive capabilities.

2512.17100.tldr: UniCoMTE, a model-agnostic framework for generating counterfactual explanations for multivariate time series classifiers, is introduced and results show that the approach produces concise, stable, and human-aligned explanations that outperform existing methods in both clarity and applicability.

2512.17145.tldr: This work proposes a Solomonoff-inspired method that weights LLM-generated hypotheses by simplicity and predictive fit, and produces Solomonoff-weighted mixtures for per-cell predictions, yielding conservative, uncertainty-aware outputs even when hypotheses are noisy or partially incorrect.

2512.17370.tldr: TakeAD is proposed, a novel preference-based post-optimization framework that fine-tunes the pre-trained IL policy with this disengagement data to enhance the closed-loop driving performance and mitigating the open-loop gap.

2512.18561.tldr: The Adaptive Accountability Framework is presented, an end-to-end runtime layer that records cryptographically verifiable interaction provenance, detects distributional change points in streaming traces, and applies cost-bounded interventions-reward shaping and targeted policy patching-to steer the system back toward compliant behavior.

2512.18567.tldr: This work builds a high-precision detection pipeline and a representative benchmark to distinguish AIGCode from human-written code, and applies them to development commits from the top 1,000 GitHub repositories (2022-2025) and 7,000+ recent CVE-linked code changes.

2512.18571.tldr: This work proposes ESearch-R1, a cost-aware embodied reasoning framework that unifies interactive dialogue, episodic memory retrieval, and physical navigation into a single decision process and introduces HC-GRPO (Heterogeneous Cost-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization).

2512.18573.tldr: A hybrid 3D deep learning model for automated PAS detection from volumetric MRI scans is proposed and developed and evaluated on a retrospective dataset of 1,133 MRI volumes, demonstrating a clear potential to assist radiologists by providing a robust decision support to improve diagnostic consistency across interpretations, and ultimately enhance the accuracy and timeliness of PAS diagnosis.

2512.18575.tldr: This work provides the first empirical evidence for modality-specific memory optimization in neuromorphic systems, achieving 603x energy efficiency over traditional neural networks.

2512.18593.tldr: This paper presents the work for the JUST-NLP 2025 Legal MT shared task, focusing on English-Hindi translation using Transformer-based approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of domain adaptation in enhancing translation quality and demonstrating the potential of L-MT systems to improve access to justice and legal transparency in multilingual contexts.

2512.18607.tldr: An inherent representational bias in modern DNNs is uncovered and interaction order is established as a powerful lens for interpreting and guiding deep representations in DNNs.

2512.18613.tldr: Text2Graph VPR is presented, an explainable semantic localization system that converts image sequences into textual scene descriptions, parses those descriptions into structured scene graphs, and reasons over the resulting graphs to identify places.

2512.18614.tldr: PTTA is presented, a pure text-to-animation framework for high-quality animation creation and extensive visual evaluations show that the proposed approach consistently outperforms comparable baselines in animation video synthesis.

2512.18616.tldr: A practical human-AI teaming framework grounded in shared mental models, a deception-based strategy for insider threat detection, and empirical evidence of enhanced robustness under adversarial conditions are contributed.

2512.18618.tldr: A solver tailored for practical packaging-planning scenarios with richer constraints, including multiple placeholder options, time-frame restrictions, and multi-class item packaging is developed, significantly outperforming the shaking-based exact solver.

2512.18619.tldr: Qualitative results demonstrate that the model preserves spatial coherence during non-contact motion and generates plausible contact predictions, while the LLM-based judge distinguishes collision from non-collision trajectories.

2512.18622.tldr: MATS, a novel Text2SQL framework designed specifically for Large Language Models, uses a multi-agent mechanism that assigns specialized roles to auxiliary agents, reducing individual workloads and fostering interaction, thereby maintaining competitive performance despite a limited LLM size.

2512.18623.tldr: LLM-CAS is proposed, a framework that formulates real-time hallucination correction as a hierarchical reinforcement learning problem and provides an efficient and context aware solution for improving the reliability of LLMs, with promising potential for future multimodal extensions.

2512.18633.tldr: ARC (Attribute Representation via Compositional Learning), a cross-problem learning framework that learns disentangled attribute representations by decomposing them into two complementary components, achieves state-of-the-art performance across in-distribution, zero-shot generalization, few-shot adaptation, and real-world benchmarks.

2512.18661.tldr: The ASTIF (Adaptive Semantic-Temporal Integration for Cryptocurrency Price Forecasting), a hybrid intelligent system that adapts its forecasting strategy in real time through confidence-based meta-learning, is proposed, a scalable, knowledge-based solution for fusing quantitative and qualitative data in non-stationary environments.

2512.18665.tldr: It is proposed that chunking mechanisms play an essential role and shown how the CogAct computational model grounds concept learning in fundamental cognitive processes and structures (such as chunking, attention, STM and LTM), and integrated into the broader theories of cognitive psychology.

2512.18669.tldr: IntelliCode demonstrates how persistent learner modeling, orchestrated multi-agent reasoning, and principled instructional design can be combined to produce transparent and reliable LLM-driven tutoring.

2512.18674.tldr: Remoe is a heterogeneous MoE inference system tailored for serverless computing that assigns non-expert modules to GPUs and expert modules to CPUs, and offloads infrequently activated experts to separate serverless functions to reduce memory overhead and enable parallel execution.

2512.18703.tldr: A novel trajectory planning framework that integrates causal prior knowledge into the control process and achieves a closer alignment with human driving behaviors is proposed, providing methodological support for human-like trajectory planning and practical value for improving safety, stability, and realism in autonomous vehicle testing and traffic simulation platforms.

2512.18709.tldr: A Knowledge Mastery-State Disambiguation for Knowledge Tracing model (KeenKT), which represents a student's knowledge state at each interaction using a Normal-Inverse-Gaussian distribution, thereby capturing the fluctuations in student learning behaviors and introducing an NIG-distance-based attention mechanism to model the dynamic evolution of the knowledge state.

2512.18732.tldr: A geometric framework in which conceptual growth is modeled as admissible basis extension evaluated under a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion, and distinguish representational counterfactuals--counterfactuals over an agent's conceptual basis--from causal or value-level counterfactuals, and show how MDL provides a normative selection principle governing representational change.

2512.18733.tldr: This work proposes XG-Guard, an explainable and fine-grained safeguarding framework for detecting malicious agents in MAS, and utilizes a bi-level agent encoder to jointly model the sentence- and token-level representations of each agent.

2512.18735.tldr: A challenging new testbed to catalyze the development of next-generation models with a more holistic understanding of the dynamic visual world, built upon paired videos that provide multi-perspective observations of an indoor scene before and after a state change.

2512.18737.tldr: PIPCFR is introduced, a novel approach that incorporates post-treatment variables to improve pseudo-outcome imputation and achieves significantly lower ITE errors compared to existing methods.

2512.18747.tldr: IPCV is proposed, a training-free, information-preserving compression framework for MLLM visual encoders that substantially reduces end-to-end computation and outperforms state-of-the-art training-free token compression methods across diverse image and video benchmarks.

2512.18755.tldr: MEEA leverages repeated low-toxicity semantic exposure to induce a gradual shift in a model's effective safety threshold, enabling progressive erosion of alignment constraints over sustained interactions, and demonstrates that LLM safety behavior is inherently dynamic and history-dependent.

2512.18791.tldr: A universal watermarking scheme for TTS diffusion models, termed Smark, is proposed by designing a lightweight watermark embedding framework that operates in the common reverse diffusion paradigm shared by all TTS diffusion models.

2512.18792.tldr: This work argues for a pragmatic statistical-causal reframing: explanations of computational systems should be treated as parameters of a (statistical) model, inferred from computational traces, and interpretability methods become statistical estimators.

2512.18797.tldr: Using a quantum kernel in audio deepfake detection reduces falsepositive rates without increasing model size, and compares quantum-kernel SVMs (QSVMs) with classical SVMs using identical mel-spectrogram preprocessing and stratified 5-fold cross-validation across four corpora.

2512.18809.tldr: This work proposes an on-device federated learning framework for video violence detection that integrates self-supervised VideoMAE representations, LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation, and defense-in-depth privacy protection and reduces the trainable parameter count to 5.5M.

2512.18815.tldr: Stochastic Decomposition Layers (SDL) is introduced for converting deterministic machine learning weather models into probabilistic ensemble systems and requires less than 2\% of the computational cost needed to train the baseline model.

2512.18826.tldr: This survey reviews hyperbolic graph embedding models, and evaluates them on anomaly detection, highlighting their advantages over Euclidean methods in capturing complex structures and provides an open-source library to foster further research in this field.

2512.18857.tldr: This work introduces CORE (Concept-Oriented REinforcement), an RL training framework that turns explicit concepts into a controllable supervision signal, and provides fine-grained conceptual supervision that bridges problem-solving competence and genuine conceptual reasoning, while remaining algorithm- and verifier-agnostic.

2512.18878.tldr: CrashChat is proposed, a multimodal large language model (MLLM) for multitask traffic crash analysis, built upon VideoLLaMA3, which acquires domain-specific knowledge through instruction fine-tuning and employs a novel multitask learning strategy based on task decoupling and grouping, which maximizes the benefit of joint learning within and across task groups while mitigating negative transfer.

2512.18880.tldr: It is suggested that general problem-solving capability does not imply an understanding of human cognitive struggles, highlighting the challenge of using current models for automated difficulty prediction.

2512.18892.tldr: This work introduces a structural reinforcement learning (SRL) method which treats prices via simulation while exploiting agents'sructural knowledge of their own individual dynamics and yields a general and highly efficient global solution method for heterogeneous agent models.

2512.18908.tldr: Results demonstrate that expert-knowledge-guided probabilistic reasoning can significantly enhance automated triage systems, offering a promising approach to supporting emergency responders in MCIs.

2512.18930.tldr: This paper introduces a training- and inference-light, interpretable method for representing and transferring artistic style, achieving or surpassing existing methods on style evaluations (VGG Style Loss and CLIP Score Style) while being 1.7-20x faster and, critically, interpretable.

2512.18947.tldr: A novel algorithm centered on a Clustering-based Autoencoder prediction dynamic response mechanism, which utilizes an autoencoder model to process matched clusters to generate a highly diverse initial population is proposed.

2512.18950.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that structured external memory with Bayesian selection and contrastive refinement enables sample-efficient, interpretable, and continually improving agents without LLM parameter updates.

2512.18969.tldr: SASOW is proposed, an enhancement of KG-SP that considers the weighting of states and objects while improving composition recognition accuracy, and introduces self-attention mechanisms into the classifiers for states and objects, leading to enhanced accuracy in recognizing both.

2512.18986.tldr: R-GenIMA is introduced, an interpretable multimodal large language model that couples a novel ROI-wise vision transformer with genetic prompting to jointly model structural MRI and single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) variations that yields biologically meaningful explanations in Alzheimer's disease.

2512.18991.tldr: A global geometric association strategy that establishes consistent instance correspondences by estimating an optimal transformation between instance-level point sets and a global geometry-aware soft matching mechanism that enforces spatially coherent point-wise correspondences grounded in the spatial distribution of instance point sets is proposed.

2512.18999.tldr: Experimental results show that while the end-to-end approach frequently fails on lengthy and complex forms, the modular method-built on task decomposition, semantic clustering, and flow management-substantially improves dialog stability and extraction accuracy, highlighting the necessity of integrating external control mechanisms when deploying LLMs in high-stakes medical follow-up scenarios.

2512.19004.tldr: A training-free interface is proposed that injects prompt-conditioned priors from a lightweight auxiliary model into the diffusion initialization, and instantiate it with two mechanisms: discrete token injection and representation-level embedding interpolation.

2512.19024.tldr: This work introduces IndoorUAV, a novel benchmark and method specifically tailored for VLN with indoor UAVs, and introduces the IndoorUAV-Agent, a novel navigation model designed for this benchmark, leveraging task decomposition and multimodal reasoning.

2512.19026.tldr: Across CUB, Stanford Cars, and animal Re-ID benchmarks, Finer-Personalization Rank more faithfully reflects identity retention than semantic-only metrics and reveals substantial identity drift in several popular personalization methods.

2512.19061.tldr: This paper introduces a graph transformation technique that first identifies connected components via hard links, merges them into super-nodes, and then reconstructs a weighted soft-link graph amenable to efficient embedding and clustering that provides a scalable and practical solution for industrial-scale fraud detection systems.

2512.19069.tldr: This work leverages existing techniques for extracting high-level concepts from larger models to investigate their transferability to smaller language models (SLM) during inference, and introduces inference-time scaling to enhance performance by dynamically adjusting the steering intensity.

2512.19081.tldr: The proposed Population-Evolve, a training-free method inspired by Genetic Algorithms to optimize LLM reasoning, maintains a dynamic population of candidate solutions for each problem via parallel reasoning, and establishes a unification framework that interprets existing test-time scaling strategies through the lens of genetic algorithms.

2512.19093.tldr: A framework that joins reasoning and calculation using NuminaMath-7B-TIR, GPT-4o, and Mistral-7B using adaptive routing, tool-based reinforcement learning, and knowledge distillation to connect different reasoning paths.

2512.19096.tldr: A new conditioning rule is introduced for Accept-Desirability models, based on the idea that observing an event introduces new indifferences between options, and two interesting special cases where all of the AGM axioms for belief revision still hold are investigated.

2512.19107.tldr: The FC-MIR framework is proposed, leveraging keyframe sampling and adaptive concatenation, it cuts visual redundancy to boost inference efficiency, while integrating state-of-the-art closed-source MLLMs or fine-tuned models for trajectory summarization and intent prediction, and deployed in a real-world setting.

2512.19114.tldr: This work introduces HyperLoad, a cross-modality framework that exploits pre-trained large language models (LLMs) to overcome data scarcity and consistently surpasses state-of-the-art baselines, demonstrating its practicality for sustainable green data center management.

2512.19154.tldr: A meta-algorithm (Adaptive Stacking) is proposed for achieving exactly that with convergence guarantees and quantify the reduced computation and memory constraints for MLP, LSTM, and Transformer-based agents.

2512.19155.tldr: A hierarchical design principle is suggested: GWT provides broadcast capacity, while HOT provides quality control, while GWT-style broadcasting amplifies internal noise, creating extreme fragility.

2512.19178.tldr: The Vision-Language-Policy (VLP) model, based on a vision-language model fine-tuned on real-world data, can interpret semantic instructions and integrate reasoning over the current task scene to generate behavior policies that control the robot to accomplish the task.

2512.19180.tldr: It is suggested that quantum derived information becomes most valuable when integrated through principled multimodal fusion rather than used in isolation or loosely appended to classical features.

2512.19184.tldr: A new Rademacher generalization bound is derived for this framework, explicitly addressing underfitting and overfitting through kernel refinement strategies, and a novel deep learning framework, deep vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (vvRKHS), is proposed.

2512.19199.tldr: A tighter bound is proposed than those derived from conventional norm based methods by leveraging small condition numbers in the weight matrices and introducing a tailored Sobolev space as an expanded hypothesis space, offering a more precise theoretical understanding of multitask deep learning in the context of kernel methods.

2512.19206.tldr: MixKVQ is proposed, a novel plug-and-play method that introduces a lightweight, query-aware algorithm to identify and preserve critical key channels that need higher precision, while applying per-token quantization for value cache.

2512.19210.tldr: An interactive framework for evaluating whether large language models (LLMs) exhibit genuine "understanding" in a simple yet strategic environment, focusing on Rock-Paper-Scissors, provides a practical and interpretable proxy for mind-like inference in sequential games, offering insights into both the strengths and limitations of current LLM reasoning.

2512.19219.tldr: Across screen-centric grounding and referring benchmarks spanning text-heavy to image-heavy regimes, Image-LoRA matches or closely approaches standard LoRA accuracy while using fewer trainable parameters and lower adapter-only training FLOPs.

2512.19221.tldr: Overall, this study demonstrates that graph-based structure provides expressive, generalizable, and interpretable signals for modelling urban perception, advancing human-centric and context-aware urban analytics.

2512.19228.tldr: This work investigates the extent to which LLMs, adapted on domain-specific code and data through different fine-tuning strategies, can generate rule-based plausibility checks for forgery detection on constrained hardware resources and demonstrates that the models are capable of generating executable and effective verification procedures.

2512.19234.tldr: The proposed DeliveryBench is a city-scale embodied benchmark grounded in the real-world profession of food delivery and reveals a substantial performance gap to humans, and finds that VLM-based embodied agents are short-sighted and frequently break basic commonsense constraints.

2512.19240.tldr: ChemATP is introduced, a framework that decouples chemical knowledge from the reasoning engine and enables frozen LLMs to explicitly retrieve and reason over this information dynamically, ensuring interpretability and adaptability while preserving the LLM's intrinsic general intelligence.

2512.19247.tldr: A novel prompt optimization pipeline for frame detection in logistics texts is proposed, combining retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, and automatic CoT synthesis (Auto-CoT) to generate highly effective task-specific prompts.

2512.19275.tldr: This study evaluates four different GenAI models across two primary evaluation tasks to assess their ability to restore gait patterns from reference videos under varying conditions of complexity and transfer these gait patterns to different visual identities, and exposes a fundamental flaw in appearance-based gait recognition.

2512.19287.tldr: Vibe Reasoning is introduced, a human-AI collaborative paradigm for solving complex mathematical problems that transforms AI's latent potential into manifested capability through generic meta-prompts, agentic grounding, and model orchestration, and suggests that lightweight human guidance can unlock frontier models'hematical reasoning potential.

2512.19297.tldr: Causal-Guided Detoxify Backdoor Attack (CBA) is proposed, a novel backdoor attack framework specifically designed for open-weight LoRA models that enables post-training control over attack intensity through causal influence-based weight allocation, eliminating the need for repeated retraining.

2512.19311.tldr: The training-testing discrepancy problem for improving the diffusion models is studied and a novel training approach, named MixFlow, is presented, motivated by the Slow Flow phenomenon, which leverages the interpolations at the slowed timesteps, named slowed interpolation mixture, for post-training the prediction network for each training timestep.

2512.19317.tldr: SafeMed-R1 is introduced, a hybrid defense framework that ensures robust performance while preserving high-quality, interpretable medical reasoning and demonstrates that models trained with explicit chain-of-thought reasoning exhibit superior adversarial robustness compared to instruction-only variants.

2512.19320.tldr: MAGIC is a plug-and-play framework that rectifies layer-wise magnitudes in feature and weight spaces, with three variants that consistently boosts performance across diverse Computer Vision tasks and NLP tasks without additional training.

2512.19323.tldr: Some tentative experiments are reported, where the original sinusoidal version of the alternative functions is substantially outperformed, which strongly suggests that the alternative functions may have a wider use in other transformer architectures.

2512.19349.tldr: VIGOR+ (Variational Information Gain for iterative cOnfounder Refinement), a novel framework that closes the loop between LLM-based confounder generation and CEVAE-based statistical validation and establishes an iterative feedback mechanism that guides subsequent LLM generation rounds.

2512.19350.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark, \textit{PENDULUM}, comprises approximately 2,000 human-curated Visual Question Answering pairs specifically designed to elicit sycophantic responses, and proposes novel metrics to quantify sycophancy in visual reasoning, offering deeper insights into its manifestations across different multimodal contexts.

2512.19355.tldr: This work considers the use of first-order languages in goal-conditioned RL and generalized planning, and shows that further performance gains can be achieved when states and goals are represented by sets of atoms.
