2512.16378.tldr: Hearing to Translate is presented, the first comprehensive test suite rigorously benchmarking 5 state-of-the-art SpeechLLMs against 16 strong direct and cascade systems that couple leading speech foundation models (SFM), with multilingual LLMs, finding that cascaded systems remain the most reliable overall.

2512.17864.tldr: This study introduces an interpretable attention-guided Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), CBAM-VGG16, for plant leaf disease detection, integrating Convolution Block Attention Module (CBAM) at each convolutional stage, which enhances feature extraction and disease localization.

2512.18748.tldr: This work introduces Code2Doc, a quality-first curated dataset for function-level code documentation generation that is constructed using a four-stage curation pipeline that enforces documentation completeness and clarity, filters functions based on structural and complexity criteria, removes exact and near-duplicate code, and identifies documentation likely to be AI generated.

2512.20605.tldr: To discover temporally-abstract actions, a higher-order, non-causal sequence model is introduced whose outputs control the residual stream activations of a base autoregressive model, suggesting internal RL as a promising avenue for realizing hierarchical RL within foundation models.

2512.20968.tldr: This paper proposes a new distributed attention algorithm, Mesh-Attention, by rethinking the design space of distributed attention with a new matrix-based model that leads to a much lower communication complexity and exhibits good scalability comparing to other current algorithms.

2512.20974.tldr: A novel deep BRL method, Generalised Linear Models in Deep Bayesian RL with Learnable Basis Functions (GLiBRL), that enables efficient and accurate learning of transition and reward models, with fully tractable marginal likelihood and Bayesian inference on task parameters and model noises.

2512.20978.tldr: GenTSE, a two-stage decoder-only generative LM approach for TSE: Stage-1 predicts coarse semantic tokens, and Stage-2 generates fine acoustic tokens, separates semantics and acoustics stabilizes decoding and yields more faithful, content-aligned target speech.

2512.20983.tldr: An automatic pipeline that extracts mistakes LLMs make in patient-doctor conversations and converts them into a benchmark of single-shot QA pairs is introduced, which found that GPT models, Claude and Grok obtained the best performance on MedMistake-Bench.

2512.20985.tldr: A single architecture model comprising of LangChain-based multi-agent system with a permissioned blockchain to guarantee constant monitoring, policy enforcement, and immutable auditability of agentic action is suggested to provide a universal system of implementing high-impact agentic AI applications that are autonomous yet responsible.

2512.20991.tldr: A price aware agentic AI system, which combines personal finance management with diet optimization, can locally combine affordability with nutritional adequacy and provide a viable avenue of capacity-building towards sustainable and fair diet planning in line with Sustainable Development Goals on Zero Hunger and Good Health.

2512.20996.tldr: The proposed TrafficSimAgent is an LLM-based agent framework that serves as an expert in experiment design and decision optimization for general-purpose traffic simulation tasks and yields superior performance when compared with other systems and SOTA LLM based methods.

2512.21010.tldr: It is demonstrated that CSD provides a more nuanced and context-aware ranking than traditional aggregate scoring and static pairwise models, representing a vital step towards risk-informed, next-generation LLM evaluation.

2512.21017.tldr: This study advances LLM fine-tuning by explicitly balancing CoT learning with additional optimization on answer-relevant tokens with an average accuracy improvement exceeding 5\% over conventional SFT, while preserving the ability to generate correct formats.

2512.21024.tldr: This work reformulates the learning problem by utilizing LLMs to perform optimization directly in the space of programmatic policies, and formalizes this process as PIBR, an algorithm where the policy code is optimized by textual gradients, using structured feedback derived from game utility and runtime unit tests.

2512.21054.tldr: DexAvatar is introduced, a novel framework to reconstruct bio-mechanically accurate fine-grained hand articulations and body movements from in-the-wild monocular sign language videos, guided by learned 3D hand and body priors.

2512.21075.tldr: It is shown that the same mechanism causes feature-learning collapse in the first internal layer at large depth, providing a structural explanation for the empirical failure of depth-muP, and proposed a depth-aware learning-rate correction that counteracts the collapse and empirically restores depth-wise hyperparameter transfer, yielding stronger performance in deeper ResNets.

2512.21107.tldr: This work suggests a different approach: utilizing semi-supervised learning techniques, which leverage both labeled and unlabeled data, to improve the performance on the safety task, and demonstrates the importance of using task-specific augmentations, which significantly increase the performance when compared to general-purpose augmentation techniques.

2512.21118.tldr: STLDM is a diffusion-based model that learns the latent representation from end to end alongside both the Variational Autoencoder and the conditioning network, and achieves superior performance compared to the state of the art, while also improving inference efficiency.

2512.21127.tldr: Failure analysis reveals that, in this setting, the dominant failure mechanism is contextual reasoning rather than missing medication knowledge, with five primary patterns: overconfidence in uncertainty, applying standard guidelines without adjusting for patient context, misunderstanding how healthcare is delivered in practice, factual errors, and process blindness.

2512.21132.tldr: This work presents AutoBaxBuilder, a framework that generates tasks and tests for code security benchmarking from scratch, and introduces a robust pipeline with fine-grained plausibility checks, leveraging the code understanding capabilities of LLMs to construct functionality tests and end-to-end security-probing exploits.

2512.21135.tldr: TGC-Net, a CLIP-based framework focusing on parameter-efficient, task-specific adaptations, is proposed, which incorporates a Semantic-Structural Synergy Encoder that augments CLIP's ViT with a CNN branch for multi-scale structural refinement.

2512.21152.tldr: It is shown that MODE achieves (1-1/e)-approximation with O(n \log n) complexity and demonstrates competitive accuracy while providing interpretable insights into data utility evolution.

2512.21165.tldr: Across challenging WAN regimes, BALLAST substantially reduces recovery time and unwritable time compared to standard randomized timeouts and common heuristics, while remaining competitive on stable LAN/WAN settings.

2512.21201.tldr: Evaluations in simulation and on a physical Go2 quadruped robot demonstrate that Schrodinger's Navigator outperforms strong ZSON baselines, achieving more robust self-localization, object localization, and safe navigation under severe occlusions and latent hazards.

2512.21204.tldr: This paper introduces SpidR-Adapt for rapid adaptation to new languages using minimal unlabeled data and constructs a multi-task adaptive pre-training (MAdaPT) protocol which formulates the adaptation process as a bi-level optimization framework.

2512.21221.tldr: This work proposes a lightweight two-stage retrieval pipeline that leverages event-centric entity extraction to incorporate temporal and contextual signals from real-world captions to highlight the effectiveness of combining event-guided filtering with long-text vision-language modeling for accurate and efficient retrieval in complex, real-world scenarios.

2512.21236.tldr: SPELL is proposed, a comprehensive testing framework specifically designed to evaluate the weakness of security alignment in malicious code generation and reveal significant security gaps in current LLM implementations and provide valuable insights for improving AI safety alignment in code generation applications.

2512.21241.tldr: This paper proposes a momentum-based algorithm, ARS-OPT, which proactively estimates the gradient with respect to a future ray direction inferred from accumulated momentum, and provides a theoretical analysis of its convergence behavior, showing that ARS-OPT enables more accurate directional updates and achieves faster, more stable optimization.

2512.21243.tldr: LookPlanGraph is proposed - a method that leverages a scene graph composed of static assets and object priors and continuously updates the graph with relevant objects, either by verifying existing priors or discovering new entities during plan execution.

2512.21246.tldr: Findings reveal that perception dimensions actively mediate AI-augmented learning and that the developmental stage moderates their interdependencies, establishing a foundation for the development of AI integration strategies that respond to learners'velopmental levels and account for age-specific dimensional structures in student-AI interactions.

2512.21288.tldr: This analysis introduces a "cross-task heterogeneity"term that formally captures the mismatch between diverse fine-tuned model priors and the target multi-task distributions, and operationalizes this objective via SAMerging, a method that employs Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) to find flat minima.

2512.21316.tldr: Findings suggest continued model scaling could boost U.S. productivity by approximately 20% over the next decade.

2512.21326.tldr: The all-pairs paired method is proposed, which applies the paired analysis to all pairs of LLMs and measures all the noise components based on millions of question-level predictions across many evals and settings, revealing clear patterns.

2512.21332.tldr: This work presents C2LLM - Contrastive Code Large Language Models, a family of code embedding models in both 0.5B and 7B sizes that adopts a Pooling by Multihead Attention (PMA) module for generating sequence embedding from token embeddings.

2512.21336.tldr: This work establishes Denoising Entropy as a principled tool for understanding and controlling generation, effectively turning the uncertainty in MDMs from a liability into a key advantage for discovering high-quality solutions.

2312.02519.tldr: It is shown that creative agents are the first AI agents accomplishing diverse building creation in the survival mode of Minecraft, and a novel evaluation metrics for open-ended creative tasks utilizing GPT-4V is proposed, which holds many advantages over existing metrics.

2405.04875.tldr: This work proposes SFL with Concatenated Activations and Logit Adjustments (SCALA), in which activations from client-side models are concatenated as the input of the server-side model to centrally adjust label distribution across different clients, and logit adjustments in the loss functions of both server-side and client-side models are performed.

2405.05512.tldr: The characteristic generator is proposed, a novel one-step generative model that combines the efficiency of sampling in Generative Adversarial Networks with the stable performance of flow-based models and achieves high-quality and high-resolution sample generation with the efficiency of just a single neural network evaluation.

2407.15192.tldr: This paper presents an approach based on Error Detection Rules (EDR) that allow for learning explainable rules about the failure modes of machine learning models and is effective in detecting machine learning errors and recovering constraints, is noise tolerant, and can function as a source of knowledge for neurosymbolic models on multiple datasets, including a newly introduced military vehicle recognition dataset.

2409.14051.tldr: A method to significantly reduce token cost in multi-agent debates by dividing all agents into multiple debate groups, with agents engaging in debates within their respective groups and sharing interim debate results between groups.

2411.02455.tldr: The use of three representative LLMs for automated course evaluation at both the micro level (classroom discussion analysis) and the macro level (holistic course review) is investigated, demonstrating that LLMs can extract key pedagogical features and generate structured evaluation results aligned with expert judgement.

2412.20166.tldr: Implemented via an MLIR-based compiler and evaluated on a cycle-accurate simulator, PIMphony significantly improves throughput for long-context LLM inference, enabling more efficient deployment of LLMs in real-world long-context applications.

2501.07774.tldr: A novel tokenization approach is introduced, referred to as Sensor Snapshot Tokenization (SST), which preserves variable-specific representations of power delay profile (PDP) and enhances attention mechanisms by effectively capturing multi-variate correlation, making Transformer models more efficient and suitable for resource-constrained scenarios.

2501.09926.tldr: This work proposes a low-cost forest fire detection system that utilizes a central gateway device with computer vision capabilities to monitor a 360° field of view for smoke at long distances, leveraging real-time sensor data from distributed IoT devices.

2501.15544.tldr: This work proposes an innovative solution that enhances LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation for automatic problem formulation, code generation, and customizing optimization and shows LLMs' potential in energy optimization of the IoT-enabled microgrids and promotes intelligent DSM solutions.

2502.03688.tldr: The task of predicting an outcome using a short text for comparison is used, and the output of DeepSeek is most similar to those of Gemini and Claude (and among all five LLMs, Claude and Gemini have the most similar outputs).

2502.04963.tldr: A fast adaptive anti-jamming channel access approach guided by the intuition of ``learning faster than the jammer", where a synchronously updated coarse-grained spectrum prediction serves as an auxiliary task for the deep Q network (DQN) based anti-jamming model.

2502.09990.tldr: X-Boundary is proposed, which aims to push harmful representations away from boundary-safe representations and obtain an exact distinction boundary, so that harmful representations can be precisely erased without disrupting safe ones.

2502.18848.tldr: Causal Diagnosticity is presented, a testbed framework for evaluating faithfulness metrics for natural language explanations, and the concept of diagnosticity is used, and model-editing methods are employed to generate faithful-unfaithful explanation pairs.

2502.20565.tldr: DPZV is proposed, a communication-efficient and differentially private ZO-VFL framework with tunable privacy guarantees based on zeroth-order (ZO) optimization that injects calibrated scalar-valued DP noise on the downlink, significantly reducing variance amplification while providing equivalent protection against targeted inference attacks.

2503.09626.tldr: Robust Multi-modal Neural Processes (RMNP) is proposed, which aims to enhance the robustness of multi-modal neural processes to modality inconsistencies caused by social bot camouflage, and is shown to be effective in classification and uncertainty estimation, as well as its robustness to modality conflicts.

2503.17903.tldr: This is the first work to introduce Mamba and explicit spectral information to UGLAD, a novel framework that adapts the selective state space model into UGLAD field and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior performance in UGLAD.

2504.03814.tldr: This paper confirms that using different human datasets leads to distribution shifts of different magnitudes, and identifies a set of properties predicting distribution shift magnitudes, which are found to amplify these shifts, while semantic diversity and data quality mitigate them.

2504.13460.tldr: A novel few-shot learning framework to capture action commonalities and variations, which includes a semantic-aware text-visual alignment module designed to align the query and support videos at different levels and a Chain-of-Evidence reasoning method that progressively guides the Vision Language Model and Large Language Model to generate CoE text descriptions for videos.

2505.04891.tldr: This work proposes CCCVAE, a novel variational autoencoder framework that incorporates CCC signals into single-cell representation learning and encodes biologically informed priors into the latent space, demonstrating the value of embedding biological priors into deep generative models for unsupervised single-cell analysis.

2506.04049.tldr: WANDER is the first such system to unify prediction, exploration, and explanation for HPC tuning under a common query interface and introduces a composite trade-off score that ranks suggestions based on prediction uncertainty, consistency between feature-target relationships using causal models, and similarity between feature distributions against historical data.

2506.13464.tldr: This work decomposes general learning ability into three distinct, complementary dimensions: Learning from Instructor (acquiring knowledge via explicit guidance), Learning from Concept (internalizing abstract structures and generalizing to new contexts), and Learning from Experience ( adapting through accumulated exploration and feedback).

2507.06558.tldr: This paper establishes update magnitude as the fundamental driver of LoRA performance and proposes LoRAM, a magnitude-driven"Basis&Basis"initialization scheme that matches spectral methods without their inefficiencies, and serves as a strong baseline, retaining the full efficiency of LoRA while matching or outperforming spectral initialization across benchmarks.

2507.14270.tldr: The APTx Neuron is derived from the APTx activation function, thereby eliminating the need for separate activation layers and making the architecture both optimization-efficient and elegant, pointing toward a new paradigm in unified neuron design and the architectures built upon it.

2507.21386.tldr: ECHO, an efficient NCO solver, is proposed that outperforms state-of-the-art NCO solvers across varying numbers of vehicles and nodes, and exhibits well-performing generalization across both scales and distribution patterns.

2508.04440.tldr: This work introduces ThinkingF, a data synthesis and training pipeline that improves two key abilities for effective autoformalization: comprehensive mastery of formal-language domain knowledge, and reasoning capability of natural language problem understanding and informal-formal alignment.

2508.06259.tldr: This paper introduces SIFThinker, a spatially-aware "think-with-images"framework that mimics human visual perception that outperforms state-of-the-art methods in spatial understanding and fine-grained visual perception, while maintaining strong general capabilities.

2510.08878.tldr: This study recast controllable TTA generation as a multi-task learning problem and introduces a progressive diffusion modeling approach, ControlAudio, which adeptly fits distributions conditioned on more fine-grained information, including text, timing, and phoneme features, through a step-by-step strategy.

2510.18802.tldr: This technical report develops computational foundations that formalize two critical dimensions of coopetition: interdependence and complementarity in i* structural dependency analysis, and formalizes complementarity following Brandenburger and Nalebuff's Added Value concept.

2510.21855.tldr: Schema-Induced Games for Naming (SIGN), a naming game that examines how lightweight structure can steer convention formation, is introduced and results suggest that minimal structure can act as a simple control knob for efficient multi-agent coordination, pointing toward broader applications beyond the naming game.

2510.23620.tldr: It is demonstrated that combining traditional machine learning with graph-based deep learning enables a scalable and interpretable framework for metastasis risk prediction in precision oncology.

2510.23638.tldr: KANalogue is introduced, a fully analogue realization of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that instantiates univariate basis functions directly using negative-differential-resistance (NDR) devices, and establishes a device-grounded route toward scalable, energy-efficient, fully analogue neural networks.

2510.23671.tldr: It is found that neither feature sparsity nor feature importance cause discontinuous phase changes, and that network sparsity (the ratio of active to total experts) better characterizes MoEs.

2511.00846.tldr: The first comprehensive multimodal VQA benchmark specifically designed to assess the multimodal comprehension capabilities of MLLMs in brain imaging analysis with closed- and open-ended evaluations is introduced, establishing a new standard to assess MLLMs in brain imaging analysis.

2511.02845.tldr: This study developed a real-time, AI-based Wi-Fi sensing and visualization system using a single transceiver pair, and designed experiments focusing on human pose estimation and indoor localization that confirm the theoretical findings.

2511.08653.tldr: CGAR (Curriculum-Guided Adaptive Recursion) enables efficient training of recursive models on modest hardware by treating depth as a scheduled parameter and prevents overfitting, making these models practical for neurosymbolic AI and program synthesis.

2511.09109.tldr: Bi-RAR is proposed, a novel retrieval-augmented reasoning framework that evaluates each intermediate step jointly in both forward and backward directions and adopts a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework with a cascading reward structure that emphasizes early trajectory alignment.

2511.10861.tldr: An LRP-based dynamic pruning method is proposed that suppresses this cascading accuracy degradation and compresses the pre-trained model while preserving task-specific performance in a small-data environment and achieves higher classification accuracy compared to existing LRP-based pruning methods.

2511.12712.tldr: Adaptive Focus Memory is presented, a lightweight context management system that dynamically assigns each past message one of three fidelity levels: Full, Compressed, or Placeholder, based on semantic relevance, temporal decay, and importance classification, and it is demonstrated that effective dialogue memory requires more than retaining prior text.

2511.14262.tldr: STICA represents each observation as a set of object-centric tokens, together with tokens for the agent action and the resulting reward, enabling the world model to predict token-level dynamics and interactions, and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agents in both sample efficiency and final performance.

2511.19067.tldr: DynaMix is proposed, a novel method that effectively combines manually labeled multi-camera and large-scale pseudo-labeled single-camera data and dynamically adapts to the structure and noise of the training data through three core components.

2511.21760.tldr: Across various benchmarks, fMRI-LM achieves strong zero-shot and few-shot performance, and adapts efficiently with parameter-efficient tuning (LoRA), establishing a scalable pathway toward a language-aligned, universal model for structural and semantic understanding of fMRI.

2512.07015.tldr: FVA-RAG (Falsification-Verification Alignment RAG), a pipeline that inverts the standard RAG workflow by treating the initial response as a draft hypothesis and explicitly retrieving anti-context to stress-test it, demonstrates that targeted counter-evidence retrieval is decisive for mitigating premise-confirming hallucinations.

2512.09673.tldr: This paper investigates the impact of equivariance constraints on the expressivity of equivariant and layer-wise equivariant networks and constructs an example showing that equivariance constraints could strictly limit expressive power.

2512.14693.tldr: The Universal Reasoning Model (URM) is proposed, which enhances the UT with short convolution and truncated backpropagation, and substantially improves reasoning performance on ARC-AGI.

2512.16917.tldr: Generative Adversarial Reasoner is introduced, an on-policy joint training framework designed to enhance reasoning by co-evolving an LLM reasoner and an LLM-based discriminator through adversarial reinforcement learning.

2512.17218.tldr: The analysis demonstrates that integrating the principles of Maqasid al-Shariah, particularly hifz al-ird and hifz al-nafs, provides a strong normative foundation for governing the responsible use of digital technology.

2512.17299.tldr: M2RU is introduced, a mixed-signal architecture that implements the minion recurrent unit for efficient temporal processing with on-chip continual learning and is established as a scalable and energy-efficient platform for real-time adaptation in edge-level temporal intelligence.

2512.18020.tldr: The concept of LLM code smells is introduced and five recurrent problematic coding practices related to LLM inference in software systems, based on relevant literature are formalized.

2512.18190.tldr: This paper proposes the External Hippocampus framework, which models language model reasoning from a cognitive dynamics perspective as the flow of information energy in semantic space through dimensionality reduction projection, enabling precise navigation and intervention of energy flow at test time while avoiding substantial computational requirements and demonstrating predictable intervention patterns.

2512.18564.tldr: Vox Deorum is introduced, a hybrid LLM+X architecture that establishes a viable architecture for integrating LLMs in commercial 4X games, opening new opportunities for game design and agentic AI research.

2512.19864.tldr: This work proposes an agentic framework that systematically decomposes complex oncology data extraction into modular, adaptive tasks, and uses large language models (LLMs) as reasoning agents, equipped with context-sensitive retrieval and iterative synthesis capabilities, to exhaustively and comprehensively extract structured clinical variables from real-world oncology notes.

2512.20312.tldr: This work introduces TableGPT-R1, a specialized tabular model built on a systematic RL framework that achieves state-of-the-art performance on authoritative benchmarks, significantly outperforming baseline models while retaining robust general capabilities.

2512.20548.tldr: A novel asymmetric attention-based multimodal teacher sentiment analysis model, AAM-TSA, which significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in terms of accuracy and interpretability on the T-MED dataset.

2512.21220.tldr: RoboSafe is a hybrid reasoning runtime safeguard for embodied agents through executable predicate-based safety logic that is both interpretable and executable as code, while maintaining near-original task performance.

2512.21343.tldr: EcoNet is introduced, a Bayesian approach to household and neighborhood energy management that is based on active inference that is to improve energy management and coordination, while accommodating uncertainties and taking into account potentially conditional and conflicting goals and preferences.

2512.21344.tldr: The results show that spatial learning from atomistic simulation data can accurately reproduce temperature trends in friction stir welding while remaining consistent with physical deformation and flow mechanisms observed at the atomic scale.

2512.21345.tldr: Query Carefully, a pipeline that integrates LLM-based SQL generation with explicit detection and handling of unanswerable inputs and a lightweight user interface that surfaces interim SQL, execution results, and abstentions, supporting transparent and reliable text-to-SQL in biomedical applications.

2512.21348.tldr: Correlation Tuning (CoT), a novel pre-processing approach designed to mitigate bias by adjusting data correlations, introduces the Phi-coefficient, an intuitive correlation measure, to systematically quantify correlation between sensitive attributes and labels, and employs multi-objective optimization to address the proxy biases.

2512.21351.tldr: CosmoCore-Evo, an extension that incorporates evolutionary algorithms to enhance adaptability and novelty in code generation tasks, is introduced, which treats RL trajectories as ``genomes'' that undergo mutation and selection during the nocturnal replay phase.

2512.21352.tldr: A multi-agent committee framework in which diverse vision-enabled LLMs collaborate through a three-round voting protocol to reach consensus on testing actions is proposed, enabling reproducible research and practical deployment of LLM-based software testing in CI/CD pipelines.

2512.21354.tldr: Empirical results show that Reflection-Driven Control substantially improves the security and policy compliance of generated code while largely preserving functional correctness, with minimal runtime and token overhead, indicating that Reflection-Driven Control is a practical path toward trustworthy AI coding agents.

2512.21360.tldr: The proposed multi-agent framework, by dividing roles, decouples feature recognition from psychological inference and offers a new paradigm for digital mental-health services confirms the potential of multimodal large models as standardized tools for projective assessment.

2512.21373.tldr: AInsteinBench measures a model's ability to move beyond surface-level code generation toward the core competencies required for computational scientific research by leveraging evaluation in executable environments, scientifically meaningful failure modes, and test-driven verification.

2512.21404.tldr: A novel adversarial attack framework that exploits the generative and reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to bypass ML-based Android malware classifiers, and proposes an adversarial training-based defense strategy that reduces the ASR by more than 30% on average, significantly enhancing model robustness against LAMLAD-style attacks.

2512.21421.tldr: While using similarity classes is a common method of analyzing incomplete information in the literature, the proposed concept of approximability and the two approaches in conceptual formulation point out new promising directions.

2512.21422.tldr: The findings show that teaching failure patterns could be a viable approach to mitigating overreliance, but success depends on better automated failure-discovery methods and using metrics like the authors'.

2512.21439.tldr: An empirically grounded moral-context dataset, a reproducible pipeline combining human judgments with model-based context learning and LLM semantics, and an interpretable alternative to end-to-end LLMs for context-sensitive moral prediction and explanation are presented.

2512.21452.tldr: A new paradigm for automated GPR-based defect detection is established, balancing computational efficiency with high accuracy in complex subsurface environments, by establishing a novel multimodal chain and global attention network (MCGA-Net).

2512.21476.tldr: A novel architecture is proposed, named Gated Progressive Fusion network, to selectively fuse features from multiple levels using gates in a fully connected way for polyp ReID to achieve layer-wise refinement of semantic information through multi-level feature interactions.

2512.21482.tldr: LogicLens is a unified framework for Visual-Textual Co-reasoning that reformulates these objectives into a joint task and establishes a significant lead over other MLLM-based methods in mF1, CSS, and the macro-average F1.

2512.21487.tldr: FinDEP is proposed, a fine-grained task scheduling algorithm for DEP that maximizes task overlap to improve MoE inference throughput and introduces three innovations: partitioning computation/communication into smaller tasks for fine-grained pipelining, formulating a scheduling optimization supporting variable granularity and ordering, and developing an efficient solver for this large search space.

2512.21494.tldr: Oogiri-Master and Oogiri-Corpus are introduced, which are a benchmark and dataset designed to enable rigorous evaluation of humor understanding in LLMs and demonstrate that state-of-the-art models approach human performance and that insight-augmented prompting improves the model performance.

2512.21506.tldr: Qualitative analysis confirms that MotionTeller captures circadian structure and behavioral transitions, while PCA plots reveal enhanced cluster alignment in embedding space post-training, positioning MotionTeller as a scalable, interpretable system for transforming wearable sensor data into fluent, human-centered descriptions.

2512.21514.tldr: A structure-aware regularization is introduced, which enforces stronger early-stage constraints to preserve diversity without compromising reward optimization efficiency and establishes a new Pareto frontier between image quality and diversity for GRPO-based image generation.

2512.21526.tldr: This work introduces Selective LLM Guided Regularization, a model-agnostic and computation efficient framework that activates LLM based pairwise ranking supervision only when a trainable gating mechanism informing by user history length, item popularity, and model uncertainty predicts the LLM to be reliable.

2512.21529.tldr: This work combines two objectives: Tree-Path KL Divergence (TP-KL) aligns predictions along the ground-truth label path for vertical coherence, while Hierarchy-Sibling Smoothed Cross-Entropy (HiSCE) encourages consistent predictions among sibling classes to provide an efficient strategy for adapting VLMs to structured taxonomies.

2512.21540.tldr: This work proposes Leash (adaptive LEngth penAlty and reward SHaping), a reinforcement learning framework for efficient reasoning in LLMs that balance reasoning capabilities with computational budgets and reduces the average reasoning length across diverse tasks.

2512.21551.tldr: This workshop focuses on bidirectional human-AI alignment, a dynamic, reciprocal process where humans and AI co-adapt through interaction, evaluation, and value-centered design to advance value-centered AI and reciprocal human-AI collaboration.

2512.21552.tldr: This chapter develops the concept of bidirectional human-AI alignment in education, emphasizing that trustworthy learning environments arise not only from embedding human values into AI systems but also from equipping teachers, students, and institutions with the skills to interpret, critique, and guide these technologies.

2512.21562.tldr: This research provides empirical evidence for improv ing the reproducibility of AIGC detection technologies and offers reference directions for researchers to disclose ex perimental details more comprehensively and verify the generalizability of their proposed methods.

2512.21583.tldr: A diagnostic framework built upon LLaVA that combines vision-language alignment with logic-regularized reasoning and improves diagnostic accuracy and yields more interpretable reasoning traces on multimodal tasks, while remaining competitive on text-only settings is proposed.

2512.21593.tldr: Residual Prior Diffusion (RPD) is proposed, a two-stage framework in which a coarse prior model first captures the large-scale structure of the data distribution, and a diffusion model is then trained to represent the residual between the prior and the target data distribution.

2512.21595.tldr: LLM-I2I, a data-centric framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to mitigate data quality issues, is proposed, which consistently improves recommendation accuracy, particularly for long-tail items.

2512.21623.tldr: By seamlessly integrating autonomous execution with human guidance, OrchestRA democratizes therapeutic design, transforming drug discovery from a stochastic search to a programmable evidence-based engineering discipline.

2512.21626.tldr: This paper proposes a variant of multiple-play stochastic bandits tailored to resource allocation problems arising from LLM applications, edge intelligence, etc, and addresses nontrivial technical challenges arising from optimizing and learning under a special nonlinear combinatorial utility function induced by the prioritized resource sharing mechanism.

2512.21641.tldr: This work proposes TrackTeller, a temporal multimodal grounding framework that integrates LiDAR-image fusion, language-conditioned decoding, and temporal reasoning in a unified architecture and demonstrates that TrackTeller consistently improves language-grounded tracking performance.

2512.21648.tldr: Inverse-RPO is introduced, a general methodology that systematically derives prior-based UCTs from any prior-free UCB, and two new prior-based tree policies that incorporate variance estimates into the search are obtained.

2512.21652.tldr: CardioMM, a generalist reconstruction foundation model capable of dynamically adapting to heterogeneous fast CMR imaging scenarios, is introduced, providing the first evidence that such extreme acquisition speed can preserve key cardiac phenotypes, quantitative myocardial biomarkers, and diagnostic image quality without compromising clinical integrity.

2512.21654.tldr: A structure-induced exploration framework that integrates structural priors into the search process of the ant colony optimization (ACO) and provides a scalable and interpretable framework that can be readily applied to logistics, surveillance, and search-and-rescue applications where reliable large-scale coordination is essential.

2512.21657.tldr: It is proved that sparse relaxations recover coalition structures whose welfare is arbitrarily close to optimal in polynomial time with high probability, in contrast, broad classes of DP and MILP algorithms require exponential time before attaining comparable solution quality.

2512.21673.tldr: Comparing the performance of DL models, including YOLO-NAS and YOLOv8, for a detection-based perception task will allow the relevant research community to understand the models' performance under real-world use case scenarios.

2512.21685.tldr: RIPCN is proposed, a Road Impedance Principal Component Network that integrates domain-specific transportation theory with spatiotemporal principal component learning for PTFF, and introduces a dynamic impedance evolution network that captures directional traffic transfer patterns driven by road congestion level and flow variability.

2512.21694.tldr: This work developed and used a self-collected dataset of Bengali handwriting samples, and used a self-collected dataset of Bengali handwriting samples to propose a method for generating Bengali handwritten words.

2512.21699.tldr: This paper presents a Responsible (RAI) and Explainable (XAI) AI Agent Architecture for production-grade agentic workflows based on multi-model consensus and reasoning-layer governance, and evaluates the architecture across multiple real-world agentic AI workflows, demonstrating that consensus-driven reasoning improves robustness, transparency, and operational trust across diverse application domains.

2512.21702.tldr: This study provides the first systematic benchmark of Bengali deepfake audio detection and highlights the effectiveness of e-tuned deep learning models for this low-resource language.

2512.21706.tldr: This work introduces a framework that enables reasoning over conversational behaviors by modeling this process as causal inference within a Graph-of-Thoughts (GoT), and formalizes the intent-to-action pathway with a hierarchical labeling scheme.

2512.21709.tldr: This work advances AI-generated text detection in Bengali and establishes a foundation for building robust systems to counter AI-generated content.

2512.21711.tldr: This paper focuses on Chain-of-Continuous-Thought (COCONUT), which claims better efficiency and stability than explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) while maintaining performance, and reposition COCONUT as a pseudo-reasoning mechanism that generates plausible traces that conceal shortcut dependence rather than faithfully representing reasoning processes.

2512.21715.tldr: This work proposes CATCH (Controllable Theme Detection with Contextualized Clustering and Hierarchical Generation), a unified framework that integrates three core components: a context-aware topic representation, which enriches utterance-level semantics using surrounding topic segments; preference-guided topic clustering, which jointly models semantic proximity and personalized feedback to align themes across dialogue.

2512.21720.tldr: Viewing the compressor LM as a noisy channel, a simple estimator of mutual information between the context and its compression is introduced to quantify compression quality in a task-independent way, and it is shown that mutual information strongly predicts downstream performance, independent of any specific task.

2512.21723.tldr: A Hierarchical Embodied Language Planner, called HELP, consisting of a set of LLM-based agents, each dedicated to solving a different subtask, is proposed and evaluated on a household task and real-world experiments with an embodied agent are performed.

2512.21746.tldr: This study addresses the related issues of pseudo-correlation, causality, and combinatorial reasons for tabular data in NN predictors and proposes a causal explanation method, CENNET, and a new explanation power index using entropy for the method.

2512.21757.tldr: This first empirical study comparing agent- and human-authored performance optimization commits, analyzing 324 agent-generated and 83 human-authored PRs from the AIDev dataset across adoption, maintainability, optimization patterns, and validation practices finds that AI-authored performance PRs are less likely to include explicit performance validation than human-authored PRs.

2512.21760.tldr: An Adaptive Quaternion Cross-Fusion Network (A-QCF-Net) that learns a single unified segmentation model from completely separate and unpaired CT and MRI cohorts is proposed, providing a robust and clinically viable paradigm for unlocking the large unpaired imaging archives that are common in healthcare.

2512.21775.tldr: The Compliance Rating Scheme (CRS) is introduced, a framework designed to evaluate dataset compliance with critical transparency, accountability, and security principles, and an open-source Python library built around data provenance technology is released.

2512.21782.tldr: The SAGA framework employs a bi-level architecture in which an outer loop of LLM agents analyzes optimization outcomes, proposes new objectives, and converts them into computable scoring functions, while an inner loop performs solution optimization under the current objectives.

2512.21803.tldr: This paper proposes CellMamba, a lightweight and accurate one-stage detector tailored for fine-grained biomedical instance detection that outperforms both CNN-based, Transformer-based, and Mamba-based baselines in accuracy, while significantly reducing model size and inference latency.

2512.21804.tldr: Convolution Neural Network (CNN), the best-known tool so far for image classification, is used on the multi-dimensional stock numbers taken from the market mimicking them as a vector of historical data matrices (read images) and the model achieves promising results.

2512.21861.tldr: It is indicated that lightweight feature fusion can enhance generalization across heterogeneous datasets, supporting scalable binary DR screening workflows where both accuracy and throughput are critical.

2512.21866.tldr: Overall, tree-region distillation enables trustworthy, deployable fraud analytics with interpretable global rules, per-case rationales with quantified uncertainty, and strong privacy properties suitable for multi-institution settings and regulatory audit.

2512.21871.tldr: A novel tool-augmented defense framework for copyright compliance is introduced, which reduces infringement risks in all scenarios and reveals that even state-of-the-art closed-source LVLMs exhibit significant deficiencies in recognizing and respecting the copyrighted content, even when presented with the copyright notice.

2512.21878.tldr: MASFIN is introduced, a modular multi-agent framework that integrates LLMs with structured financial metrics and unstructured news, while embedding explicit bias-mitigation protocols to demonstrate the promise of bias-aware, generative AI frameworks for financial forecasting and highlight opportunities for modular multi-agent design to advance practical, transparent, and reproducible approaches in quantitative finance.

2512.21897.tldr: Overall, MMCTOP advances multimodal trial modeling by combining controlled narrative normalization, context-conditioned expert fusion, and operational safeguards aimed at auditability and reproducibility in biomedical informatics.

2512.21924.tldr: Two novel modules are proposed, forming a new PHI reconstruction framework that outperforms 17 state-of-the-art methods and suppresses abnormal residuals in PHI by reducing abnormal pixels input through edge-only input, and effectively reconstructs normal regions using the preserved structural details in the edges.

2512.21985.tldr: The LVLM-Aided Visual Alignment method provides a bidirectional interface that translates model behavior into natural language and maps human class-level specifications to image-level critiques, enabling effective interaction between domain experts and the model.

2512.22010.tldr: LongFly proposes a history-aware spatiotemporal modeling strategy that transforms fragmented and redundant historical data into structured, compact, and expressive representations that outperforms state-of-the-art UAV VLN baselines across both seen and unseen environments.

2512.22022.tldr: This paper proposes CONTRA, a framework that, for the first time, jointly optimizes THOs and CHOs within the O-RAN architecture and relies on a practical meta-learning algorithm that adapts to runtime observations and guarantees performance comparable to an oracle with perfect future information (universal no-regret).

2512.22029.tldr: This study underscores the necessity of resource-aware and semantically robust CL strategies, and offers LibContinual as a foundational toolkit for future research in realistic continual learning.

2512.22031.tldr: This is the first study to explicitly frame hit-like molecule generation as a standalone task and empirically test whether generative models can directly support this stage of the drug discovery pipeline, and investigates if such models can be trained to generate hit-like molecules.

2512.22065.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage autoregressive adaptation and acceleration framework that applies autoregressive distillation and adversarial refinement to adapt a high-fidelity human video diffusion model for real-time, interactive streaming and develops a one-shot, interactive, human avatar model capable of generating both natural talking and listening behaviors with coherent gestures.

2512.22100.tldr: The goal is to establish a robust evaluation framework for Turkish NLU, empower researchers with valuable resources, and provide insights into generating high-quality semi-automated datasets.

2512.22101.tldr: It is claimed that by coupling a quality-assured Analyzer with a narrative Presenter, A2P-Vis operationalizes co-analysis end-to-end, improving the real-world usefulness of automated data analysis for practitioners.

2512.22106.tldr: This work derives a simple equilibrium-driven pruning algorithm that jointly updates network parameters and participation variables without relying on explicit importance scores, and shows that dominated players collapse to zero participation under mild conditions, providing a principled explanation for pruning behavior.

2512.22113.tldr: PRAXIS is an orchestrator that manages and deploys an agentic workflow for diagnosing code- and configuration-caused cloud incidents, and improves RCA accuracy by up to 3.1x while reducing token consumption by 3.8x.

2207.11143.tldr: The Transformation And Distillation (TAD) framework is proposed, which reformulates a multi-agent MDP as a special single-agent MDP with a sequential structure and enables decentralized execution by distilling the learned policy on the derived"single-agent"MDP.

2306.05499.tldr: This study deconstructs the complexities and implications of prompt injection attacks on actual LLM-integrated applications and forms HouYi, a novel black-box prompt injection attack technique, which draws inspiration from traditional web injection attacks.

2311.15759.tldr: Modular Visual Memory (MVM), a component integrated into the internal blocks of LLMs, designed to store open-world visual information efficiently, is introduced, a component integrated into the internal blocks of LLMs designed to store open-world visual information efficiently.

2401.07468.tldr: This paper investigates the feasibility of estimating vehicle speed using only a single low-cost inertial sensor: a three-axis accelerometer embedded in a commodity smartphone, and presents CarSpeedNet, a learning-based inertial estimation framework designed to infer speed from raw accelerometer measurements, without access to gyroscopes, wheel odometry, vehicle bus data, or external positioning during inference.

2403.00336.tldr: This work investigates NBAgent in embodied robots, a pioneering language-conditioned Never-ending Behavior-cloning Agent, which can continually learn observation knowledge of novel 3D scene semantics and robot manipulation skills from skill-shared and skill-specific attributes, respectively.

2403.15728.tldr: A collaborative sensing model of sensors is developed to enhance detection capabilities of WSNs, by leveraging the collaborative information derived from the combination rule under the framework of evidence theory.

2406.04208.tldr: This paper provides an alternative perspective to contemporary LLM Agents on how recent progress in LLMs can be leveraged for decision-making agents, and is hoped will illuminate a path towards developing more generally capable agents for video games and beyond.

2407.06459.tldr: This work characterize and test a little-used teaching signal: progress, designed to represent the completion percentage of a task, and finds that progress indicates whether the task is successfully performed, reflects the degree of task completion, identifies unproductive but harmless behaviors, and is likely to be more consistent across participants.

2410.11378.tldr: TPFed is proposed, a Trust-free Personalized Decentralized Federated Learning framework that introduces an "all-in-one" knowledge distillation protocol that simultaneously handles knowledge transfer, model quality evaluation, and similarity verification via a public reference dataset.

2410.13264.tldr: A novel two-stage framework that compresses atomic structures into discrete latent representations, explicitly embedding structural constraints, thereby decoupling constraint handling from generation and performs efficient denoising diffusion in this latent space to produce structurally valid and diverse all-atom conformations.

2412.06474.tldr: Inspired by dropout regularization, this work introduces uncertainty-guided token dropout, which applies the dropout principle to input visual tokens instead of model parameters, and during inference rather than training, to robustly mitigate errors arising from visual token misinterpretations.

2412.10321.tldr: AdvPrefix is introduced, a plug-and-play prefix-forcing objective that selects one or more model-dependent prefixes by combining two criteria: high prefilling attack success rates and low negative log-likelihood.

2501.06491.tldr: This study emphasizes the domain of requirements engineering by applying the SMOTE-Tomek preprocessing technique, combined with stratified K-fold cross-validation, to address class imbalance in the PROMISE dataset, leading to a notable improvement in classification accuracy.

2501.09934.tldr: A framework for multi-model training in dynamic VEC-HFL is proposed with the goal of minimizing global training latency while ensuring balanced training across various tasks-a problem that turns out to be NP-hard.

2502.05407.tldr: This work investigates whether the underlying learned features of a model can be efficiently retrieved through feedback from an agent, such as a large language model, in the form of relativeplet comparisons, and analyzes the feedback complexity associated with learning a feature matrix in sparse settings.

2502.05684.tldr: A unified mathematical framework based on information-theoretic regularization to address both data point unlearning and feature unlearning and reveals intriguing connections between machine unlearning, information theory, optimal transport, and extremal sigma algebras.

2502.07347.tldr: It is proved that zero loss, in the sense of the proposed measure, is a highly exceptional limiting case rather than a realistic benchmark for ordinary evaluative practice, and it is shown that the framework leads naturally to an optimization problem for comparing alternative admissible CGPs.

2502.12018.tldr: This work leverages the memoryless property of Markov processes to minimize reliance on historical context and proposes a Markovian reasoning process, which enables seamless integration with various test-time scaling methods, thereby improving their scaling efficiency.

2503.03140.tldr: This article describes the system architecture and problem setting for TAF, and presents a three-way roadmap and categorize recent studies in three directions: collaborative data expansion, collaborative data refinement, and collective data harmonization in the federation.

2503.06551.tldr: This paper critically examines the recent publication “ChatGPT-4 in the Turing Test” by Restrepo Echavarría and refutes key aspects of the criticized study, laying a solid foundation for future research on objective measures of how closely an AI’s behavior aligns with, or deviates from, that of a human.

2503.14376.tldr: This work presents Tiled Flash Linear Attention (TFLA), a novel kernel algorithm for linear RNNs that enables arbitrary large chunk sizes and high arithmetic intensity by introducing an additional level of sequence parallelization within each chunk.

2504.09906.tldr: The Plasticity-Aware Mixture of Experts (PA-MoE), a novel learning framework that dynamically modulates network plasticity by balancing memory retention with selective forgetting, is proposed, and it is revealed that the model effectively mitigates plasticity loss by optimizing neuron utilization.

2504.12039.tldr: This article presents RadMamba, a parameter-efficient, micro-Doppler-oriented Mamba SSM tailored to radar HAR under on-sensor compute, latency, and energy constraints typical of distributed radar systems.

2504.12961.tldr: A novel algorithm, QLLM, is proposed, which facilitates the automatic construction of credit assignment functions using large language models (LLMs), and the concept of TFCAF is introduced, wherein the credit allocation process is represented as a direct and expressive nonlinear functional formulation.

2505.13010.tldr: This work performs sentence-level bias classification by fine-tuning a RoBERTa-based model on the expert-annotated BABE dataset by presenting a pipeline that combines the model with an already-existing bias-type classifier.

2506.10516.tldr: This paper introduces a challenging task called Context-guided Streaming Video Reasoning (CogStream), which simulates real-world streaming video scenarios, requiring models to identify the most relevant historical contextual information to deduce answers for questions about the current stream.

2506.11938.tldr: This work proposes a defense framework that formulates model defense as a contrastive representation learning (CRL) problem, using a triplet-based loss combined with adversarial hard negative mining to encourage separation between benign and harmful representations.

2507.06952.tldr: A technique is developed that examines how foundation models adapt to synthetic datasets generated from some postulated world model to find that foundation models trained on orbital trajectories consistently fail to apply Newtonian mechanics when adapted to new physics tasks.

2507.15898.tldr: This work proposes a Conditional AutoEncoder framework to simultaneously model and characterize galaxy morphology, and demonstrates that the CAE approach can accurately and efficiently infer complex structural properties, offering a powerful alternative to existing methods.

2507.16859.tldr: A heterogeneous and multiple source fatigue detection framework that adaptively utilizes the available modalities in the target domain while exploiting diverse configurations in the source domains through alignment across domains and modality imputation is designed.

2507.18925.tldr: This work introduces LLVIP-C and FLIR-C, two cross-modality out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks built by applying corruptions to standard IR datasets and proposes WiSE-OD, a weight-space ensembling method with two variants: WiSE-OD, which combines RGB zero-shot and IR fine-tuned weights, and WiSE-OD-LP, which blends zero-shot and linear probing.

2508.01956.tldr: Results demonstrate that a modular LLM agent-based system can scale expert-level feature generation from clinical notes, while enabling interpretable use of unstructured EHR text in outcome prediction and preserving generalizability across a variety of settings and conditions.

2508.03332.tldr: This work presents LieQ Layer-wise information effectiveness Quantization, a hardware-native, metric-driven post-training quantization framework that addresses the critical challenge of maintaining accuracy in sub-8B models, model parameters less than 8B, under extreme low-bit compression.

2508.03448.tldr: This paper introduces SonicMaster, the first unified generative model for music restoration and mastering that addresses a broad spectrum of audio artifacts with text-based control and significantly improves sound quality across all artifact categories.

2508.11354.tldr: The first adaptation of RETFound for joint optic disc (OD) and optic cup (OC) segmentation in fundus camera images is introduced, with strong stability and generalization on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data, providing stable OD and OC segmentation.

2508.13246.tldr: A worrying new vulnerability in Large Language Models (LLMs) is disclosed, which is distinct in that it does not involve a specific attack objective, such as generating instructions for building a bomb.

2508.20368.tldr: This paper proposes AI SearchPlanner, a novel reinforcement learning framework designed to enhance the performance of frozen QA models by focusing on search planning, which outperforms existing RL-based search agents in both effectiveness and efficiency, while exhibiting strong generalization capabilities across diverse frozen QA models and data domains.

2509.00490.tldr: A new STVH (spatiotemporal interleaved video hashing) technique for the first time is proposed, which incorporates hierarchical feature integration through multi-focused representation learning, allowing the model to jointly focus on activity semantics features and object visual features.

2509.13688.tldr: This work proposes CraftMesh, a novel framework for high-fidelity generative mesh manipulation via Poisson Seamless Fusion, which utilizes a hybrid SDF/Mesh representation with normal blending to achieve harmonious geometric integration, and Poisson Texture Harmonization for visually consistent texture blending.

2509.22836.tldr: This work introduces a novel framework for fully controllable adversarial patch generation, where the attacker can freely choose both the input image x and the target class y target, thereby dictating the exact misclassification outcome.

2510.14973.tldr: Elastic-Cache is proposed, a training-free, architecture-agnostic strategy that performs adaptive, layer-aware cache updates for diffusion LLMs, reducing redundant computation and accelerating decoding with negligible loss in generation quality.

2510.15545.tldr: Inspired by Dynamic Time Warping (DTW), a classic algorithm for aligning time series, the algorithm TokenTiming is proposed for universal speculative decoding, enabling a universal approach for draft model selection and making SD a more versatile and practical tool for LLM acceleration.

2510.16074.tldr: This work proposes two consistent and validation-set-free criteria: a quantitative metric for heavy-tailed dynamics and a novel spectral signature indicative of convergence that highlights the utility of RMT for monitoring and diagnosing the progression of Transformer model training.

2510.21118.tldr: A novel faithfulness annotation framework is proposed, which introduces an intermediate category, Out-Dependent, to classify cases where external knowledge is required for verification, and constructs VeriGray (Verification with the Gray Zone) -- a new unfaithfulness detection benchmark in summarization.

2511.00709.tldr: The findings suggest that LLM-powered virtual patient simulations are a viable and scalable tool for training clinicians, capable of producing high-fidelity, clinically relevant practice scenarios.

2511.12439.tldr: A proof-of-concept conversational self-triage system that guides LLMs with 100 clinically validated flowcharts from the American Medical Association, providing a structured and auditable framework for patient decision support.

2511.12695.tldr: This analysis uncovers federated feature distortion, a phenomenon where local fine-tuning destabilizes globally learned features, and theoretically characterizes how LP-FT mitigates this via phased parameter updates.

2511.14083.tldr: A fully automated, deep learning-based pipeline for glenoid bone-loss measurement on CT scans can be a clinically reliable tool to assist clinicians with preoperative planning for shoulder instability.

2511.14819.tldr: Through careful publication of AI-generated research papers, this work investigates how the scholarly ecosystem responds to AI authorship and discusses the implications of AI authorship on publishers, researchers, and the scientific system at large.

2511.17085.tldr: This work introduces an evaluation suite of diverse and realistic staged misconduct scenarios to assess agents for LLM whistleblowing, and finds that both black-box methods and probes on model activations show lower evaluation awareness in the authors' settings than in comparable previous work.

2511.19486.tldr: This paper develops a two-stage framework that combines fine-tuning and rectification, and optimally allocates limited labeled samples across the two stages, and leverages the scaling law of fine-tuning to optimally allocate the limited labeled human data between the fine-tuning and rectification stages.

2511.20663.tldr: MTTR-A (Mean Time-to-Recovery for Agentic Systems), a runtime reliability metric that measures cognitive recovery latency in MAS, is introduced, adapting classical dependability theory to agentic orchestration, capturing the time required to detect reasoning drift and restore coherent operation.

2511.20821.tldr: This work challenges the necessity of a trained prior at all by employing Optimization-based Visual Inversion (OVI), a training-free and zero-shot alternative, to replace the need for a prior.

2512.00127.tldr: Models trained on the Verified-Code-CoT method achieve substantial improvements on reasoning tasks, with gains of up to 30 points on output prediction and 28 points on input prediction over base models, alongside competitive explanation and code generation performance.

2512.01987.tldr: Forecasting in Non-stationary Offline RL is introduced, a framework that unifies conditional diffusion-based candidate state generation, trained without presupposing any specific pattern of future non-stationarity, and zero-shot time-series foundation models, and aims to bridge the gap between offline RL and the complexities of real-world, non-stationary environments.

2512.02910.tldr: While LLM-generated data appear useful for early-stage, group-level psychometric prototyping, but not as substitutes for individual-level validation, they do not approximate individual-level data properties.

2512.12548.tldr: It is demonstrated that artificial foragers equipped with learned world models naturally converge to MVT-aligned strategies, suggesting that predictive world models can serve as a foundation for more explainable and biologically grounded decision-making in AI systems.

2512.17851.tldr: InfSplign is introduced, a training-free inference-time method that improves spatial alignment by adjusting the noise through a compound loss in every denoising step, achieving substantial performance gains over the strongest existing inference-time baselines and even outperforming the fine-tuning-based methods.

2512.17923.tldr: These findings suggest LLMs possess emergent capabilities for detecting complex financial mechanisms through pure structural reasoning, with implications for systematic strategy development, risk management, and the understanding of how transformer architectures process financial market dynamics.

2512.20745.tldr: The evaluations show that AgentMath achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging mathematical competition benchmarks including AIME24, AIME25, and HMMT25 and validate the effectiveness of the approach and pave the way for building scalable mathematical reasoning agents.

2512.21227.tldr: The first large-scale dynamical-stability benchmark for dynamical stability in AI-generated crystals is established, and the identification of 28,119 crystal structures that are phonon-stable across the entire Brillouin zone is identified, providing a substantial pool of reliable candidates for future materials exploration.

2512.21420.tldr: Comparison results demonstrate that the proposed conflict resolution models outperform the conventional approaches by unifying weighted agent-issue evaluation with consistency and non-consistency measures to enable the systematic identification of not only feasible strategies but also optimal solutions.

2512.21884.tldr: This work presents the first systematic study of the resource allocation problem in distributed LLM inference, with focus on two important decisions: block placement and request routing, and develops a light-weighted CPU-only simulator capable of predicting the performance of distributed LLM inference on GPU servers.

2512.22125.tldr: GPU-Virt-Bench enables systematic comparison between software virtualization approaches and ideal MIG behavior, providing actionable insights for practitioners deploying GPU resources in multi-tenant environments.

2512.22129.tldr: This work introduces \Collab, a language-based framework that classifies partner types using a behavior rubric derived from trajectory features, and extends it to \ReCollab, which incorporates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to stabilize inference with exemplar trajectories and demonstrates the potential of LLMs as behavioral world models for AHT.

2512.22135.tldr: It is argued that decoupling memory from application logic eliminates the structural basis of data lock-in, while shifting from explicit manual instruction to implicit intent alignment resolves cognitive overload by offloading execution complexity.

2512.22139.tldr: This work explores several hardware-aware compression techniques on a state-of-the-art PointMLP-Elite model, including replacing FPS with URS, parameter quantization, layer fusion, and input-points pruning, yielding PointMLP-Lite, a 4x less complex variant with only 2% accuracy drop on ModelNet40.

2512.22144.tldr: This work transforms AI from a forecasting tool into a discovery microscope, establishing a reproducible template for extracting fundamental dynamical constructs from complex systems.

2512.22145.tldr: An experimental study that gathered ground-truth reviewer ratings from OpenReview and used various frontier open-weight LLMs to generate reviews of papers to gauge the safety and reliability of incorporating LLMs into the scientific review pipeline, demonstrating the utility of frontier open-weight LLMs as pre-review screening agents despite highlighting fundamental misalignment risks when deployed as autonomous reviewers.

2512.22147.tldr: This work presents an end-to-end LLM framework with performance feedback that optimizes kernels without building the full application, and enables practical, low-cost GPU kernel optimization.

2512.22148.tldr: Layer Attentive Pooling (LAP), a novel strategy for aggregating inter-layer representations from pre-trained speech models for speaker verification, which assesses the significance of each layer from multiple perspectives time-dynamically, and employs max pooling instead of averaging.

2512.22152.tldr: An end-to-end deep learning framework for short-term forecasting of global sea surface dynamics based on sparse satellite altimetry data and shows that end-to-end neural forecasts outperform the baseline across all lead times, with particularly notable improvements in high variability regions.

2512.22154.tldr: A high-level safety case sketch is introduced as a tool for understanding and comparing these monitoring protocols, focusing on three forms of monitoring with different latency-safety trade-offs: synchronous, semi-synchronous, and asynchronous monitoring.

2512.22171.tldr: This paper plans missions for a fleet of agents in undirected graphs, such as grids, with multiple goals, and implements a corresponding planner that finds conflict-free optimized routes for the agents.

2512.22174.tldr: This work introduces BitFlipScope, a scalable, software-based framework for identifying fault-affected regions within transformer architectures under two deployment scenarios that enables effective fault diagnosis but also supports lightweight performance recovery without fine-tuning, offering a practical path to restoring corrupted models.

2512.22175.tldr: This work proxy motion encoding in video diffusion timesteps by the trade-off between appearance editing and motion preservation induced when injecting new conditions over specified timestep ranges, and characterize this proxy through a large-scale quantitative study.

2512.22176.tldr: This study quantitatively evaluates the impact of MRI scanner magnetic field strength on the performance and generalizability of deep learning-based segmentation algorithms and indicates that magnetic field strength in the training data substantially influences the performance of deep learning-based segmentation models.

2512.22178.tldr: TIDES (Traffic Intelligence with DeepSeek-Enhanced Spatial-temporal prediction), a novel LLM-based framework that captures spatial-temporal correlations for urban wireless traffic prediction, is proposed.

2512.22180.tldr: A novel approach to harness an iOS device via distributed pipeline parallelism is presented, achieving significant benefits in a lesser compute environment by accelerating modest model training, batch inference, and agentic LRM tool-usage.

2512.22181.tldr: The discipline similarity score emerged as a crucial factor, positively affecting new and persistent patterns while negatively impacting discontinued collaborations, and high productivity and seniority were positively associated with discontinued links.

2512.22182.tldr: This paper provides a comprehensive mathematical model of AI-enhanced LLE, demonstrating its application in real-world healthcare scenarios through a series of experiments and indicating a significant improvement in data processing accuracy and operational efficiency.

2512.22186.tldr: A reinforcement learning framework that integrates a custom tennis simulation environment with a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network trained using curriculum learning, highlighting a limitation of win-rate driven optimization in simplified sports simulations and emphasizing the importance of reward design for realistic sports reinforcement learning.

2512.22188.tldr: HookMIL is proposed, a context-aware and computationally efficient MIL framework that leverages compact, learnable hook tokens for structured contextual aggregation that achieves state-of-the-art performance, with improved computational efficiency and interpretability.

2512.22195.tldr: MatKV is proposed, a scheme that precomputes the key-value vectors of RAG objects, materializes them in inexpensive but fast and power-efficient flash storage, and reuses them at inference time instead of recomputing the KVs using costly and power-inefficient GPU.

2512.22199.tldr: Bidirectional RAG is introduced, a novel RAG architecture that enables safe corpus expansion through validated write back of high quality generated responses that demonstrates that self improving RAG is feasible and safe when governed by rigorous validation, offering a practical path toward RAG systems that learn from deployment.

2512.22201.tldr: It was showed that steering towards traits does not reliably increase models'tendency to persuade unprompted, however, SFT does, showing that emergent harmful persuasion can arise and should be studied further.

2512.22203.tldr: A density-level classification loss is introduced, which discretizes crowd density into distinct grades, thereby regularizing the training process and enhancing the model's classification power across varying levels of crowd density.

2512.22206.tldr: The results demonstrate that simple geometric measures of feature incompatibility provide a principled and effective signal for dynamic residual routing while reducing computation, without auxiliary supervision, distillation, or task-specific heuristics.

2512.22207.tldr: GamiBench is introduced, a benchmark designed to evaluate spatial reasoning and 2D-to-3D planning in MLLMs through origami-inspired folding tasks and introduces new diagnostic metrics--viewpoint consistency (VC) and impossible fold selection rate (IFSR)--to measure how well models handle folds of varying complexity.

2512.22209.tldr: Findings indicate that diffusion-based super-resolution is a promising approach for enhancing non-invasive medical imaging, particularly in capsule endoscopy where image resolution is fundamentally constrained.

2512.22210.tldr: It is shown how algorithmic fairness techniques can be effectively applied to humanitarian contexts, providing decision-makers with tools to implement more equitable disaster recovery strategies, and demonstrates how algorithmic fairness techniques can be effectively applied to humanitarian contexts.

2512.22211.tldr: This framework provides a robust and adaptable methodology for organizations to navigate the complexities of agentic AI, enabling rapid and effective innovation while ensuring the safe, secure, and responsible deployment of agentic AI systems.

2512.22214.tldr: Signal-SGN++ is proposed, a topology-aware spiking graph framework that integrates structural adaptivity with time-frequency spiking dynamics, and achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, outperforming existing SNN-based methods and achieving competitive results against state-of-the-art GCNs under substantially reduced energy consumption.

2512.22217.tldr: VLM-PAR, a modular vision-language framework built on frozen SigLIP 2 multilingual encoders, achieves significant accuracy improvement on the highly imbalanced PA100K benchmark, setting a new state-of-the-art performance, while also delivering significant gains in mean accuracy across PETA and Market-1501 benchmarks.

2512.22220.tldr: This model can accurately identify the complete 3D location of a hidden object on the first try significantly faster than a naive random search and hope to provide household robots with the skills necessary to save time and effort when looking for lost objects.

2512.22223.tldr: ReGAIN is a multi-stage framework that combines traffic summarization, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning for transparent and accurate network traffic analysis, and outperforms rule-based, classical ML, and deep learning baselines while providing unique explainability through trustworthy, verifiable responses.

2512.22225.tldr: An AI-driven framework powered by large language models and guided by advanced prompt engineering techniques to automate the identification of nutraceutical-producing microbes from unstructured scientific text demonstrates robust performance across multiple configurations, with DeepSeekV3 outperforming LLaMA2 in accuracy.

2512.22226.tldr: VideoScaffold is a dynamic representation framework that adaptively adjusts event granularity according to video duration while preserving fine-grained visual semantics, seamlessly extending existing image-based MLLMs to continuous video comprehension.

2512.22231.tldr: The proposed framework employs distributed stream processing, containerized microservices, and elastic resource orchestration to enable low-latency ingestion, real-time anomaly detection, and advanced analytics that integrates artificial intelligence with edge and cloud computing.

2512.22236.tldr: The results indicate that, even on relatively simple portrait images, humans struggle to reliably detect AI-generated content, and highlight the need for greater awareness and ethical guidelines as AI-generated media becomes increasingly indistinguishable from reality.

2512.22237.tldr: A meta-information guided cross-domain synergistic diffusion model (MiG-DM) that integrates comprehensive cross-modal priors to generate high-quality PET images and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in enhancing PET image quality and preserving physiological details is introduced.

2512.22238.tldr: This work proposes Masters (Masking Teacher and Reinforcing Student), a mask-progressive reinforcement learning (RL) distillation framework that leverages pre-generated responses from masked teachers to help students to achieve strong performance without requiring the think-answer process.

2512.22239.tldr: A hybrid knowledge distillation framework for developing a lightweight yet high-performance convolutional neural network that combines inverted residual blocks with dense connectivity and trains it under the guidance of a ResNet18 teacher network using a multi-objective strategy.

2512.22241.tldr: Two gradient-based meta-learning algorithms, i.e., Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) and Reptile, are investigated to enable rapid adaptation to new deposition conditions with limited data to demonstrate effective knowledge transfer across heterogeneous L-DED settings.

2512.22242.tldr: The JustEFAB ethical framework is used to evaluate potential performance disparities and fairness in two AI-based risk estimation models for lung cancer screening: the Sybil lung cancer risk model and the Venkadesh21 nodule risk estimator and highlights the importance of improving model performance across underrepresented subgroups in lung cancer screening.

2512.22245.tldr: This work introduces linear probes trained with a Brier score-based loss to provide calibrated uncertainty estimates from reasoning judges'hidden states, requiring no additional model training, and demonstrates that interpretability-based uncertainty estimation provides a practical and scalable plug-and-play solution for LLM judges in production.

2512.22252.tldr: A novel Graph Attention Adaptive Transfer Network (GAATNet) that combines the advantages of pre-training and fine-tuning to capture global node embedding information across datasets of different scales, ensuring efficient knowledge transfer and improved LP performance.
