2512.22256.tldr: A systematic survey of 126 recent studies at the forefront of LLM-based agentic software issue resolution research is presented, highlighting how the emergence of agentic reinforcement learning has brought a paradigm shift in the design and training of agentic systems for software engineering.

2512.22258.tldr: These results demonstrate that LSP improves determinism, interpretability, and consistency without sacrificing performance, supporting its use in clinical, regulated, and safety critical decision support systems.

2512.22260.tldr: ReVEAL is presented, a graph-learning-based method for reverse engineering of multiplier architectures to improve algebraic circuit verification techniques and demonstrate applicability across diverse multiplier benchmarks and show improvements in scalability and accuracy compared to traditional rule-based approaches.

2512.22266.tldr: This paper proposes a comprehensive benchmark, LLMTM (Large Language Models in Temporal Motifs), which includes six tailored tasks across nine temporal motif types and develops a tool-augmented LLM agent that leverages precisely engineered prompts to solve these tasks with high accuracy.

2512.22275.tldr: Current artificial intelligence models are not yet clinically competent for complex, multimodal reasoning, and their safe deployment should currently be limited to supportive, text-based roles.

2512.22280.tldr: This work presents Valori, a deterministic AI memory substrate that replaces floating-point memory operations with fixed-point arithmetic (Q16) and models memory as a replayable state machine and suggests that deterministic memory is a necessary primitive for trustworthy AI systems.

2512.22288.tldr: Co-GRPO is introduced, which reformulates MDM generation as a unified Markov Decision Process (MDP) that jointly incorporates both the model and the inference schedule and aligns training with inference more thoroughly and substantially improves generation quality.

2512.22290.tldr: Methodologically, the paper shows how Double Machine Learning can be used to estimate conditional indirect effects in organizational research without forcing the data into a linear shape.

2512.22291.tldr: A Multi-Head Spectral-Adaptive Graph Neural Network (MHSA-GNN) that effectively preserves high-frequency abnormal signals and significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, especially showing excellent robustness on highly heterogeneous datasets.

2512.22303.tldr: Results demonstrate near-perfect ranking across attacks, low calibration error, minimal abstention risk, and controlled degradation under regrain, establishing a modular, data-efficient, and practically deployable baseline for attack-aware detection with calibrated probabilities and actionable heatmaps.

2512.22306.tldr: This work introduces a comprehensive benchmark for Multi-Vulnerability Detection across four major languages: C, C++, Python, and JavaScript, and evaluates five state-of-the-art LLMs, including GPT-4o-mini, Llama-3.3-70B, and the Qwen-2.5 series.

2512.22307.tldr: The evaluation results show that LLA can withstand a broad range of oracle-guided key optimization attacks, while incurring a minimal computational overhead of less than 0.1% for 7,168 key bits.

2512.22309.tldr: The theoretical foundations of LLMBoost are established, proving that sequential integration guarantees monotonic improvements under bounded correction assumptions and that extensive experiments on commonsense reasoning and arithmetic reasoning tasks demonstrate that LLMBoost consistently boosts accuracy while reducing inference latency.

2512.22315.tldr: VideoZoomer is proposed, a novel agentic framework that enables MLLMs to dynamically control their visual focus during reasoning, and delivers diverse and complex reasoning patterns, yielding strong performance across a broad set of long video understanding and reasoning benchmarks.

2512.22317.tldr: A language-aware multimodal nowcasting framework (LangPrecip) that treats meteorological text as a semantic motion constraint on precipitation evolution and enables efficient and physically consistent integration of textual and radar information in latent space is proposed.

2512.22323.tldr: SpotEdit is proposed, a training-free diffusion editing framework that selectively updates only the modified regions and achieves efficient and precise image editing.

2512.22331.tldr: This work introduces a multi-view latent representation learning framework based on variational autoencoders (VAE) to integrate complementary radiomic features derived from post-contrast T1-weighted and Fluid-Attenuated Inversion Recovery (FLAIR) magnetic resonance imaging (MRI).

2512.22335.tldr: Findings from the study showed the usability of jointly evaluated H&E and IHC images on end-to-end ViTs-based models for HER2 scoring and the applicability of the proposed pipeline was investigated using WSIs patches as comparable to human pathologists.

2512.22336.tldr: This paper proposes Agent2World, a tool-augmented multi-agent framework that achieves strong inference-time world-model generation and also serves as a data engine for supervised fine-tuning, by grounding generation in multi-agent feedback.

2512.22337.tldr: This paper considers a regularized approximate replay approach which penalizes KL divergence with respect to the initial model and interleaves in data for next token prediction from a different, yet similar, open access corpus to what was used in pre-training.

2512.22349.tldr: It is shown that a perception-informed pseudo-colouring technique, previously demonstrated to enhance human ECG interpretation, can improve both explainability and few-shot learning in deep neural networks analysing complex physiological data, and demonstrate that human-like perceptual encoding can bridge data efficiency, explainability, and causal reasoning in medical machine intelligence.

2512.22364.tldr: This paper presents the first systematic evaluation of cloud compute costs for LLM-generated SQL queries, evaluating six state-of-the-art LLMs across 180 query executions on Google BigQuery using the StackOverflow dataset, measuring bytes processed, slot utilization, and estimated cost.

2512.22367.tldr: The proposed compilation makes it possible to effectively use subgoaling heuristics to estimate goal distance in numeric planning problems involving control parameters and demonstrate that this approach is an effective and computationally feasible way of applying traditional numeric heuristics to settings with an infinite number of possible actions.

2512.22374.tldr: Self-E is the first from-scratch, any-step text-to-image model, offering a unified framework for efficient and scalable generation, and improves monotonically as inference steps increase, enabling both ultra-fast few-step generation and high-quality long-trajectory sampling within a single unified model.

2512.22378.tldr: A novel framework, termed Fourier-Activated Adapter (FAA), for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large pre-trained language models, by incorporating random Fourier features into lightweight adapter modules, enabling frequency-aware modulation of semantic information.

2512.22382.tldr: It is demonstrated that, with the right parameterisation, hyperparameter transfer holds even in the per-module hyperparameter regime, and significant training speed improvements in Large Language Models with the transferred per-module hyperparameters are demonstrated.

2512.22388.tldr: BLISS, a Bandit Layer Importance Sampling Strategy, uses multi-armed bandits to dynamically select the most informative nodes at each layer, balancing exploration and exploitation to ensure comprehensive graph coverage.

2512.22396.tldr: HalluMatData is introduced, a benchmark dataset for evaluating hallucination detection methods, factual consistency, and response robustness in AI-generated materials science content, and the Paraphrased Hallucination Consistency Score (PHCS) is introduced to quantify inconsistencies in LLM responses across semantically equivalent queries, offering deeper insights into model reliability.

2512.22398.tldr: GatedBias is proposed, a lightweight inference-time personalization framework that adapts frozen KG embeddings to individual user contexts without retraining or compromising global accuracy, and introduces structure-gated adaptation.

2512.22402.tldr: Pick and Spin is introduced, a practical framework that makes self-hosted LLM orchestration scalable and economical and integrates a unified Helm-based deployment system, adaptive scale-to-zero automation, and a hybrid routing module that balances cost, latency, and accuracy using both keyword heuristics and a lightweight DistilBERT classifier.

2512.22408.tldr: This work highlights a unified, multi-disciplinary methodology, resulting in a robust and operational autonomous delivery system capable of real-world deployment, with deterministic, PID-based motor control through rigorous memory and task management.

2512.22414.tldr: This work introduces a simple co-training recipe, and finds that human-to-robot transfer emerges once the VLA is pre-trained on sufficient scenes, tasks, and embodiments, and suggests that this emergent capability arises because diverse pretraining produces embodiment-agnostic representations for human and robot data.

2512.22423.tldr: Bright-4B is introduced, a 4 billion parameter foundation model that learns on the unit hypersphere to segment subcellular structures directly from 3D brightfield volumes without fluorescence, auxiliary channels, or handcrafted post-processing.

2512.22425.tldr: FluenceFormer, a backbone-agnostic transformer framework for direct, geometry-aware fluence regression, is introduced and the generality of the framework is evaluated across multiple transformer backbones, including Swin UNETR, UNETR, nnFormer, and MedFormer.

2512.22442.tldr: This work presents HiFi-RAG (Hierarchical Filtering RAG), the winning closed-source system in the Text-to-Text static evaluation of the MMU-RAGent NeurIPS 2025 Competition, and moves beyond standard embedding-based retrieval via a multi-stage pipeline.

2512.22466.tldr: AMBIT is developed, a gray-box framework that augments physical mobility baselines with interpretable tree models that provides a reproducible pipeline, rich diagnostics, and spatial error analysis designed for urban decision-making.

2512.22470.tldr: DarkPatterns-LLM is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark dataset and diagnostic framework for fine-grained assessment of manipulative content in LLM outputs across seven harm categories: Legal/Power, Psychological, Emotional, Physical, Autonomy, Economic, and Societal Harm.

2512.22481.tldr: Evaluations on multiple datasets demonstrate that SPECTRE establishes a new state-of-the-art for movement decoding, significantly outperforming both supervised baselines and generic SSL approaches.

2512.22491.tldr: This method designs a three-tier text representation (phoneme, syllable, prosodic) and a cross-modal hierarchical attention mechanism for multi-granular alignment to handle agglutination and introduces a hierarchical contrastive loss to guide structured acoustic-linguistic correspondence.

2512.22492.tldr: RobustRL is presented, the first comprehensive robust system to handle GPU machine errors for RL post-training Effective Training Time Ratio improvement and replaces static collective communication with dynamic, UCX-based (Unified Communication X) point-to-point communication.

2512.22496.tldr: This work introduces Hierarchical Pedagogical Oversight (HPO), a framework that adapts structured adversarial synthesis to educational assessment, and establishes adversarial reasoning as a critical mechanism for deploying reliable, low-compute pedagogical oversight in resource-constrained environments.

2512.22508.tldr: This study investigates the feasibility of predicting correctness by analyzing a general-purpose model and a reasoning-centric model on a multiple-choice prosthodontics exam and reveals that prompting strategies, despite not affecting overall accuracy, significantly alter the models'internal behaviors and the predictive utility of their metadata.

2512.22536.tldr: CoAgent is proposed, a collaborative and closed-loop framework for coherent video generation that formulates the process as a plan-synthesize-verify pipeline and significantly improves coherence, visual consistency, and narrative quality in long-form video generation.

2512.22545.tldr: SR-MCR is introduced, a lightweight and label-free framework that aligns reasoning by exploiting intrinsic process signals derived directly from model outputs, integrated into a normalized, reliability-weighted reward that provides fine-grained process-level guidance.

2512.22550.tldr: TimePerceiver is proposed, a unified encoder-decoder forecasting framework that is tightly aligned with an effective training strategy and consistently and significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art baselines across a wide range of benchmark datasets.

2512.22560.tldr: RollArc is a distributed system designed to maximize throughput for multi-task agentic RL on disaggregated infrastructure, built on three core principles: hardware-affinity workload mapping, which routes compute-bound and bandwidth-bound tasks to bestfit GPU devices, fine-grained asynchrony, which manages execution at the trajectory level to mitigate resource bubbles, and statefulness-aware computation, which offloads stateless components to serverless infrastructure for elastic scaling.

2512.22562.tldr: All-or-Here Attention (AHA), which utilizes a binary router per attention head to dynamically toggle between full attention and local sliding window attention for each token, reveals that full attention is largely redundant, and that efficient inference requires only on-demand access to the global context.

2512.22564.tldr: This work introduces a framework that enhances the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) using Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM), which optimizes the geometry of the loss surface, guiding the model toward flatter minima that generalize better to unseen patients.

2512.22568.tldr: It is argued that a rekindling of the historically fruitful exchange of ideas between brain science and AI will help pave the way towards safe and interpretable human-centered AI.

2512.22579.tldr: This paper proposes SANet, a novel semantic-aware AgentNet architecture for wireless networks that can infer the semantic goal of the user and automatically assign agents associated with different layers of the network to fulfill the inferred goal.

2512.22601.tldr: Tyee demonstrates consistent practical effectiveness and generalizability, outperforming or matching baselines across all evaluated tasks (with state-of-the-art results on 12 of 13 datasets).

2512.22605.tldr: This work leverages multi-modal spatial-temporal knowledge to characterize mobility dynamics for the location recommendation task, and proposes an STKG-guided cross-modal alignment to inject spatial-temporal dynamic knowledge into the static image modality.

2512.22621.tldr: Improve the interpretability of model outputs with beat detection, reporting some of the best results in the field and providing qualitative analysis on chord classifiers and pitch augmentation in generative models.

2512.22625.tldr: The findings suggest that deliberation may be a viable strategy for improving LLM forecasting, and providing LLMs with additional contextual information did not improve forecast accuracy, limiting the ability to study information pooling as a mechanism.

2512.22629.tldr: DICE (Discrete Interpretable Comparative Evaluation) is introduced, a two-stage, evidence-coupled framework that advances explainability and robustness in RAG evaluation and is established as a responsible, explainable, and efficient paradigm for trustworthy RAG system assessment.

2512.22650.tldr: This work proposes Selective TTS, a process-based refinement framework that scales inference across different stages in multi-agent pipeline, instead of repeated refinement over time by prior work, and aims to serve as the first step toward to scaling complex, open-ended tasks with unverifiable rewards, such as scientific discovery and story generation.

2512.22657.tldr: This study investigates the effectiveness of several deep learning architectures for LVEF estimation from echocardiography videos, including 3D Inception, two-stream, and CNN-RNN models, and systematically evaluates architectural modifications and fusion strategies to identify configurations that maximize prediction accuracy.

2512.22664.tldr: A novel Cluster Attention Adapter (CLAdapter) is proposed, which refines and adapts the rich representations learned from large-scale data to various data-limited downstream tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in unleashing the potential of foundation vision models via adaptive transfer.

2512.22671.tldr: This work connects two previously distinct research areas, demonstrating that MAW-guided width pruning acts as a selective filter, reducing parametric knowledge while preserving or enhancing behavioral alignment, and quantifies context-dependent efficiency trade-offs.

2512.22682.tldr: VACP is proposed, a framework that leverages semantic masking and temperature-adjusted scoring to reduce the effective prediction space while provably maintaining marginal coverage and provides a theoretical analysis of vocabulary reduction and release the implementation for reproducibility.

2512.22692.tldr: This paper studies the suitability of a radically different field as an alternative to the ultrametric and non-archimedean space of $p$-adic numbers, $\mathbb{Q}_p$ and illustrates how simple Quillian semantic networks can be represented as a compact $p$-adic linear network, a construction which is not possible with the field of reals.

2512.22705.tldr: A multilingual framework for hope speech detection with a focus on Urdu is presented, using pretrained transformer models such as XLM-RoBERTa, mBERT, EuroBERT, and UrduBERT to apply simple preprocessing and train classifiers for improved results.

2512.22733.tldr: The FoldAct framework enables stable training of long-horizon search agents with context folding, addressing the non-stationary observation problem while improving training efficiency with 5.19$\times$ speedup.

2512.22738.tldr: This work reformulates BioNER as a structured JSON generation task and leverages the novel Hybrid Superfiltering strategy, a weak-to-strong data curation method that uses a homologous weak model to distill a compact, high-impact training dataset, to achieve state-of-the-art performance.

2512.22742.tldr: This paper presents a parameter-efficient framework for CTA that trains models over prompt-augmented data via Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), mitigates sensitivity to prompt variations while drastically reducing the number of necessary trainable parameters, achieving robust performance across datasets and templates.

2512.22757.tldr: An iterative active constraint learning (ACL) algorithm, within the learning from demonstrations (LfD) paradigm, which intelligently solicits informative demonstration trajectories for inferring an unknown constraint in the demonstrator's environment is presented.

2512.22768.tldr: It is shown formally that fast transfer is equivalent to useful transfer for compute-optimal grid search, meaning that transfer is asymptotically more compute-efficient than direct tuning.

2512.22771.tldr: An active learning algorithm with Fisher Information that quantifies the informativeness of candidate views with respect to both semantic Gaussian parameters and deformation networks is proposed, providing a principled alternative to heuristic or random strategies.

2512.22772.tldr: GRExplainer is proposed, the first universal, efficient, and user-friendly explanation method for TGNNs, and a generative model based on Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), enabling automated and continuous explanation generation.

2512.22777.tldr: An algorithm for zero-shot compositional generalization which relies on access to qualitative domain knowledge in form of a causal graph for intra-domain structure and discrepancies oracle for inter-domain mechanism sharing is designed.

2512.22793.tldr: A novel framework for dimensionality reduction by decomposing the problem into a horizontal RA sub-game and a vertical RA sub-game and introducing a HJ-based tracking control algorithm in each sub-game that not only guarantees capture of the attacker but also tracking of the attacker thereafter is proposed.

2512.22795.tldr: This work evaluates rule-based baselines, domain-specific transformer models, and large language models for clinical note segmentation using a curated dataset of 1,000 notes from MIMIC-IV to provide guidance for method selection and lay the groundwork for downstream tasks such as information extraction, cohort identification, and automated summarization.

2512.22804.tldr: This paper presents Mixture-of-Representations (MoR), a novel, per-tensor and sub-tensor level quantization framework that dynamically analyzes a tensor's numerical properties to select between a variety of different representations for both per-tensor and sub-tensor level granularities.

2512.22827.tldr: FasterPy is proposed, a low-cost and efficient framework that adapts LLMs to optimize the execution efficiency of Python code, and experimental results demonstrate that the method outperforms existing models on multiple metrics.

2512.22857.tldr: A unified pipeline for automated and scalable synthesis of simulated environments associated with high-difficulty but easily verifiable tasks and an environment level RL algorithm that not only effectively mitigates user instability but also performs advantage estimation at the environment level, thereby improving training efficiency and stability are proposed.

2512.22868.tldr: It is argued that the main role of bodies is not to compute, and information and computation should be deployed to bodies to understand why they have evolved in particular ways and to design optimal bodies (robots).

2512.22876.tldr: Reinforcement Networks is introduced, a general framework for MARL that organizes agents as vertices in a directed acyclic graph (DAG) that extends hierarchical RL to arbitrary DAGs, enabling flexible credit assignment and scalable coordination while avoiding strict topologies, fully centralized training, and other limitations of current approaches.

2512.22878.tldr: Bridging visual perception with linguistic understanding, SwinTF3D establishes a practical and interpretable paradigm for interactive, text-driven 3D medical image segmentation, opening perspectives for more adaptive and resource-efficient solutions in clinical imaging.

2512.22883.tldr: This chapter argues for a shift from prevention-centric security toward agentic cyber resilience, culminating in an AI-augmented paradigm where autonomous agents participate directly in sensing, reasoning, action, and adaptation across cyber and cyber-physical systems.

2512.22895.tldr: A Segmented Allocation with Momentum-Adjusted Utility for Multi-agent Portfolio Management via Hierarchical Deep Reinforcement Learning (SAMP-HDRL) embeds structural market constraints directly into the DRL pipeline, offering improved adaptability, robustness, and interpretability in complex financial environments.

2512.22899.tldr: HiSciBench establishes a new standard for evaluating scientific Intelligence and offers actionable insights for developing models that are not only more capable but also more reliable, as well as cross-lingual evaluation.

2512.22910.tldr: Sat-EnQ is introduced, a two-phase framework that first learns to be ``good enough'' before optimizing aggressively, and proves theoretically that satisficing induces bounded updates and cannot increase target variance, with a corollary quantifying conditions for substantial reduction.

2512.22941.tldr: This paper systematically discusses heterogeneity in MARL from the perspectives of definition, quantification, and utilization, and designs a heterogeneity-based multi-agent dynamic parameter sharing algorithm that has better interpretability and stronger adaptability.

2512.22953.tldr: This work introduces Alpha-Divergence Preference Optimization (APO), an anchored framework that uses Csiszar alpha-divergence to continuously interpolate between forward and reverse KL behavior within the same anchored geometry, and derives unified gradient dynamics parameterized by alpha.

2512.22999.tldr: JADAI is introduced, a framework that jointly amortizes Bayesian adaptive design and inference by training a policy, a history network, and an inference network end-to-end end-to-end.

2512.23025.tldr: The LENS framework is introduced, a framework that aligns multimodal sensing data with language models to generate clinically grounded mental-health narratives and outperforms strong baselines on standard NLP metrics and task-specific measures of symptom-severity accuracy.

2512.23029.tldr: It is demonstrated that a carefully configured on-premises setup with emerging consumer hardware and a quantized open-source model can achieve performance comparable to cloud-based services, offering SMBs a viable pathway to deploy powerful LLMs without prohibitive costs or privacy compromises.

2512.23032.tldr: It is shown that larger inference-time token budgets greatly increase hint verbalization and even non-verbalized hints can causally mediate prediction changes through the CoT, suggesting much apparent unfaithfulness is due to tight token limits.

2512.23036.tldr: The findings suggest that LLMs alone are unlikely to match the effectiveness of established intelligent tutoring systems, and that responsible tutoring requires hybrid frameworks that incorporate learner modelling.

2512.23076.tldr: Multimodal Functional Maximum Correlation is proposed, a principled SSL framework that maximizes higher-order multimodal dependence through a Dual Total Correlation (DTC) objective and captures joint multimodal interactions directly, without relying on pairwise contrastive losses.

2512.23078.tldr: It is found that while artist identity and prior transaction history dominate overall predictive power, visual embeddings provide a distinct and economically meaningful contribution for fresh-to-market works where historical anchors are absent.

2512.23089.tldr: A segmentation-guided CXR classification pipeline that integrates MedSAM as a lung region extraction module prior to multi-label abnormality classification is proposed, indicating a trade-off between abnormality-specific classification and normal case screening.

2512.23097.tldr: A unified framework for Large Language Model fine-tuning that integrates Imitation Learning and Reinforcement Learning is presented, enabling efficient GPU implementation.

2512.23109.tldr: Finite-sample uniform convergence bounds for accuracy and calibration functionals of VLM-induced classifiers under Lipschitz stability with respect to prompt embeddings are given and implications for data-limited biomedical modeling are concluded.

2512.23128.tldr: TheTRAP is introduced, an evaluation for studying how persuasion techniques misguide autonomous web agents on realistic tasks and provides a modular social-engineering injection framework with controlled experiments on high-fidelity website clones, allowing for further benchmark expansion.

2512.23144.tldr: This work proposes a computational account in which paralysis arises from convergence failure in a hierarchical decision process, treating autism as an extreme regime of a general, inference-based, decision-making continuum.

2512.23145.tldr: This study focuses on a matrix multiplication free language model (MatMul-free LM) and further reducing the training cost through an architecture inspired by reservoir computing, partially fix and share the weights of selected layers in the MatMul-free LM and insert reservoir layers to obtain rich dynamic representations without additional training overhead.

2512.23150.tldr: Computational experiments indicate that the proposed BRKGA can efficiently explore the problem solution space, providing high-quality approximate solutions within low computational times, and provide better solutions than the CP model under the same computational settings, i.e., three minutes of time limit and a single thread.

2512.23163.tldr: The position that current frameworks for evaluating emotional intelligence (EI) in artificial intelligence (AI) systems need refinement because they do not adequately or comprehensively measure the various aspects of EI relevant in AI is developed.

2512.23167.tldr: SPIRAL (Symbolic LLM Planning via Grounded and Reflective Search), a novel framework that embeds a cognitive architecture of three specialized LLM agents into an MCTS loop that demonstrates that structuring LLM reasoning as a guided, reflective, and grounded search process yields more robust and efficient autonomous planners.

2512.23173.tldr: Equacode is proposed, a novel multi-strategy jailbreak approach for large language models via equation-solving and code completion via equation-solving and code completion that transforms malicious intent into a mathematical problem and then requires the LLM to solve it using code.

2512.23184.tldr: In practical settings with limited numbers of runs, model belief explains and predicts ground-truth model choice better than model choice itself, and reduces the computation needed to reach sufficiently accurate estimates by roughly a factor of 20.

2512.23185.tldr: This work utilizes cross-modal transformers to fuse metadata representations with image representations, thereby effectively addressing the information asymmetry problem between them and leveraging medical domain pre-trained models to encode medical images, effectively bridging the domain gap for image representation.

2512.23196.tldr: The results show that the proposed ForCM method improves forest cover mapping, achieving overall accuracies of 94.54 percent with ResUNet-OBIA and 95.64 percent with AttentionUNet-OBIA, compared to 92.91 percent using traditional OBIA.

2308.03427.tldr: A structured framework tailored for LLM-based AI Agents is proposed and two distinct types of agents are designed to execute the inference process, which emphasizes the substantial potential of these models, while also identifying areas that need more investigation and improvement.

2403.17381.tldr: The paradigm of application-driven research in machine learning is described, contrasting it with the more standard paradigm of methods-driven research, and how this approach can productively synergize with methods-driven work is illustrated.

2410.01324.tldr: This work theoretically analyze that forgetting occurs if the average gradient vector of the current task data is in an opposite direction compared to the average gradient vector of a sensitive group, which means their inner products are negative and proposes a fair class-incremental learning framework to reduce the forgetting of underperforming groups and achieve fairness.

2410.22374.tldr: This paper introduces a novel unlearning approach based on Forgetting Neural Networks, a neuroscience-inspired architecture that explicitly encodes forgetting through multiplicative decay factors, and provides the first concrete implementation and demonstrates their effectiveness for targeted unlearning.

2412.18387.tldr: Empirical validations across multiple vision-language benchmarks show that model performance matches the prediction from scaling relationship, and theoretical analysis reveals two distinct scaling regimes: sublinear scaling for less vision tokens and linear scaling for more vision tokens.

2412.19284.tldr: The algorithm leverages the latent space of a generative model for rapid sampling and employs a Pearson correlated surrogate model to predict the figure of merit of the true design metric, achieving a state-of-the-art maximum design efficiency and an improved maximum figure-of-merit gain.

2501.01516.tldr: This work applies synonymity weighting, a method that amends measures of trustworthiness and vulnerability assessments by incorporating the semantic similarity of perturbed words, leading to a more faithful understanding of an XAI system's true resilience against adversarial manipulation.

2501.09653.tldr: The Heap is released, a large multilingual dataset covering 57 programming languages that has been deduplicated with respect to other open datasets of code, enabling researchers to conduct fair evaluations of large language models without significant data cleaning overhead.

2502.17951.tldr: A Progressive Spectrum Diffusion Model (PSDM) is proposed that integrates diverse clinical annotations–such as segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and colonoscopy reports–by transforming them into compositional prompts, allowing the model to capture both broad spatial structures and fine details, generating clinically accurate synthetic images.

2504.10340.tldr: This work systematically evaluate a diverse suite of models, including fine-tuned decoder-based large language models and encoder-based transformers, on tasks of event occurrence prediction, temporal ordering, and survival analysis.

2504.21491.tldr: The results show that the ClassWise-CRF architecture significantly improves segmentation performance and further optimizes the fused results using unary and pairwise potentials in CRF to ensure spatial consistency and boundary accuracy.

2507.18262.tldr: ReSemAct is a novel unified manipulation framework that introduces Semantic Structuring and Affordance Refinement (SSAR), powered by the automated synergistic reasoning between Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and Vision Foundation Models (VFMs).

2508.06435.tldr: A lightweight, open-source LLM framework using fine-tuned LLaMA 3.2-3B models to classify immigration-related tweets across 13 languages is developed and it is demonstrated that LLMs fine-tuned in just one or two languages can generalize topic understanding to unseen languages.

2508.07185.tldr: DySK-Attn is a novel framework that enables LLMs to efficiently integrate real-time knowledge from a dynamic external source, and synergizes an LLM with a dynamic Knowledge Graph (KG) that can be updated instantaneously.

2508.08270.tldr: This work introduces Doctor Sun, a large multimodal generative model specialized in medicine, developed to encode, integrate, and interpret diverse biomedical data modalities such as text and images.

2508.09323.tldr: The results demonstrate that prompt-optimized LLMs can serve as effective, scalable alternatives to traditional supervised models in biomedical NER, particularly in rare disease applications where annotated data is scarce.

2509.02351.tldr: Research indicates that adaptive label correction using label distributions is an effective strategy to enhance the robustness and accuracy of ordinal classification models in the presence of noisy data.

2509.15965.tldr: RLinf is a high-performance RL training system built atop a novel RL system design paradigm called macro-to-micro flow transformation (M2Flow), which automatically breaks down high-level, easy-to-compose RL workflows at both the temporal and spatial dimensions and recomposes them into optimized execution flows.

2509.25987.tldr: This work proposes R-Log, a novel reasoning-based paradigm that mirrors the structured, step-by-step analytical process of human engineers, and employs Reinforcement Learning to optimize the model within a simulated O&M environment, thereby reducing hallucinations by directly rewarding correct outcomes.

2510.13343.tldr: A novel MARL architecture that cooperates with a subtask focused on predicting the next agent to act, integrated into a Proximal Policy Optimization based loss function to synergistically maximize the advantage of the sequential decision-making is introduced.

2510.15552.tldr: ParallaxRAG is introduced, a symmetric multi-view framework that decouples queries and KGs into aligned, head-specific semantic spaces and constructs more accurate, cleaner subgraphs and guides LLMs through grounded, hop-wise reasoning.

2510.17703.tldr: A new approach to detect Parkinson's disease that consists of two stages: the first stage classifies based on their drawing type(circle, meander, spiral), and the second stage extracts the required features from the images and detects Parkinson's disease.

2510.24170.tldr: A symbolic discovery framework is proposed-namely, Symbolic Matrix Preconditioning (SymMaP)-to learn efficient symbolic expressions for preconditioning parameters, which allows for high inference efficiency and excellent interpretability, making it simple and reliable for deployment.

2511.00115.tldr: ProtoMBTI is presented, a cognitively aligned framework for MBTI inference that operationalizes prototype theory within an LLM-based pipeline and indicates that aligning the inference process with psychological prototype reasoning yields gains in accuracy, interpretability, and transfer for text-based personality modeling.

2511.12706.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that ATLAS vastly outperforms random sampling approaches, particularly when sampling solvable pairs is unlikely, and show that mutations leveraging the structure of both tasks and levels accelerate convergence to performant policies.

2511.12808.tldr: This work harnesses the expressive power of quantitative Linear Temporal Logic on finite traces to synthesize reward monitors that generate a dense stream of rewards for runtime-observable state trajectories and outperform Boolean monitors in maximizing a quantitative measure of task completion and in reducing convergence time.

2511.18595.tldr: A model that combines convolutional features with a state-space sequence method consistently gave the best balance of accuracy and efficiency, while some transformer models reached higher AUC values but required much more computation.

2512.00616.tldr: The 6-alternative proof and 7-alternative counterexample were obtained with the use of SAT solving and the SAT encoding underlying this proof and counterexample is applicable far beyond SC and SSV: it can be used to test properties of any voting method whose choice of winners depends only on the ordering of margins of victory by size.

2512.00968.tldr: This work forms relevance modeling in Xiaohongshu search as a reasoning task and introduces a Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based training framework to enhance the grounded reasoning capabilities of GRMs, and distill the large-scale RL-tuned model to a lightweight version suitable for real-world search systems.

2512.09427.tldr: ODMA advances generation-length prediction by addressing two critical limitations in production workloads: (i) distribution drift that invalidates static bucket boundaries, and (ii) performance fragility under heavy-tailed request patterns.

2512.14044.tldr: OmniDrive-R1 is an end-to-end VLM framework designed for autonomous driving, which unifies perception and reasoning through an interleaved Multi-modal Chain-of-Thought (iMCoT) mechanism and introduces an annotation-free, process-based grounding reward.

2512.16531.tldr: A systematic quantification of multimodal central-processing-unit-only scaling for local language and vision-language workloads is provided, and model compression and input-resolution preprocessing are identified as effective, low-cost levers for sustainable edge inference.

2512.17956.tldr: This work was conducted by a single operator (n=1) and is intended as hypothesis-generating; it explicitly invite replication, critique, and extension by the research community.

2512.21110.tldr: This analysis demonstrates the circumvention of reliable safety mechanisms through emotional framing, progressive revelation, and academic justification techniques, and reveals that current architectural designs create systematic vulnerabilities.

2512.21798.tldr: The study shows that TimeGAN produces synthetic data with distributional shapes, volatility patterns, and autocorrelation behaviour that are close to those observed in real returns, which supports the use of synthetic datasets as substitutes for real financial data in portfolio analysis and risk simulation, particularly when models are able to capture temporal dynamics.

2512.23206.tldr: A novel dataset, BiomedTLDR, is proposed, containing a large sample of researcher-authored summaries from scientific papers, which leverages the common practice of including authors'comments alongside bibliography items and reveals that LLMs generally exhibit a greater affinity for the original text's lexical choices and rhetorical structures, hence tend to be more extractive rather than abstractive in general, compared to humans.

2512.23208.tldr: This work proposes to generate RGB-based synthetic data using a photorealistic visual tool, Unreal Engine, for military target detection in a cross-domain setting and benchmark the state-of-the-art domain adaptation methods distinguished by the degree of supervision on this proposed train-val dataset pair.

2512.23217.tldr: The feasibility of TCEval is confirmed as an ecologically valid Cognitive Turing Test for AI, demonstrating that current LLMs possess foundational cross-modal reasoning ability but lack precise causal understanding of the nonlinear relationships between variables in thermal comfort.

2512.23221.tldr: A novel Holistic Detection Transformer (Holi-DETR) that detects fashion items in outfit images holistically, by leveraging contextual information by incorporating three types of contextual information: the co-occurrence probability between fashion items, the relative position and size based on inter-item spatial arrangements, and the spatial relationships between items and human body key-points.

2512.23227.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that leverages a pre-trained text-guided image-to-image translation model and image retrieval model to efficiently generate synthetic defect images that significantly reduces the cost for data collection while improving the anomaly detection performance.

2512.23244.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations on multiple RSCD benchmarks demonstrate that ViLaCD-R1 substantially improves true semantic change recognition and localization, robustly suppresses non-semantic variations, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy in complex real-world scenarios.

2512.23304.tldr: This study presents a critical comparison between two fundamentally different AI architectures: the specialized open-source agent MedGemma and the proprietary large multimodal model GPT-4 for diagnosing six different diseases, demonstrating superior diagnostic capability and notably higher sensitivity.

2512.23310.tldr: Splitwise, a novel Lyapunov-assisted deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for fine-grained, adaptive partitioning of LLMs across edge and cloud environments, reduces end-to-end latency by 1.4 × –2.8 × and cuts energy consumption by up to 41% compared with existing partitioners.

2512.23312.tldr: The combined analysis demonstrates that explainable AI(XAI) techniques can illuminate hidden failure modes, guide architectural refinements, and inform obstacle aware deployment strategies for learning based IK.

2512.23324.tldr: It is shown that model-checking of $\exists^*\forall^*$ hyperproperties is closely related to the problem of computing a conformant plan, and the converse direction is established: Every conformant planning problem is, itself, a hyperproperty model-checking task.

2512.23343.tldr: This work elucidate the definition and function of memory along a progressive trajectory from cognitive neuroscience through LLMs to agents, and provides a comparative analysis of memory taxonomy, storage mechanisms, and the complete management lifecycle from both biological and artificial perspectives.

2512.23347.tldr: This work proposes ECG-RAMBA, a framework that separates morphology and rhythm and then re-integrates them through context-aware fusion, and introduces a numerically stable Power Mean pooling operator that emphasizes high-evidence segments while avoiding the brittleness of max pooling and the dilution of averaging.

2512.23366.tldr: This paper constructs an iterative data factory that synthesizes RL-ready data characterized by high correctness and precise semantic-logic alignment, ensured by strict verification, and introduces a novel Agentic Reinforcement Learning framework.

2512.23419.tldr: This paper introduces a computationally-embedded perspective that represents an embedded agent as an automaton simulated within a universal (formal) computer that is always constrained, and proves that it is equivalent to an agent that interacts with a partially observable Markov decision process over a countably infinite state-space.

2512.23424.tldr: This work proposes AKG kernel agent (AI-driven Kernel Generator), a multi-agent system that automates kernel generation, migration, and performance tuning, designed to support multiple domain-specific languages (DSLs), including Triton, TileLang, CPP, and CUDA-C.

2512.23453.tldr: CoFi-Dec is proposed, a training-free decoding framework that mitigates hallucinations by integrating generative self-feedback with coarse-to-fine visual conditioning, and introduces a Wasserstein-based fusion mechanism that reconciles high-level semantic consistency with fine-grained visual grounding, leading to more robust and faithful outputs.

2512.23457.tldr: Hindsight instruction Replay is proposed, a novel sample-efficient RL framework for complex instruction following tasks, which employs a select-then-rewrite strategy to replay failed attempts as successes based on the constraints that have been satisfied in hindsight.

2512.23461.tldr: A novel information-theoretic debiasing method called DIR that not only effectively mitigates target inductive biases but also enhances RLHF performance across diverse benchmarks, yielding better generalization abilities.

2512.23464.tldr: This work presents HY-Motion 1.0, a series of state-of-the-art, large-scale, motion generation models capable of generating 3D human motions from textual descriptions, and introduces a comprehensive, full-stage training paradigm to ensure precise alignment with the text instruction and high motion quality.

2512.23480.tldr: Experimental outcomes indicate that agentic AI can facilitate the transition to self defending, proactive software supply chains rather than reactive verification ones, and show that agentic AI can facilitate the transition to self defending, proactive software supply chains.

2512.23485.tldr: FRoD is proposed, a novel fine-tuning method that combines hierarchical joint decomposition with rotational degrees of freedom that enhances expressiveness and efficiency, leading to faster and more robust convergence.

2512.23487.tldr: This work develops ML Compass, a framework that treats model selection as constrained optimization over a capability-cost frontier and produces recommendations that can differ materially from capability-only rankings, and clarifies how trade-offs between capability, cost, and safety shape optimal model choice.

2512.23493.tldr: A Bayesian optimization (BO) driven Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) method is proposed, which determines the device served order sequence and the corresponding modulation and coding scheme adaptively based on the imperfect CSI, and achieves faster convergence and higher sum-rate performance compared to existing solutions.

2512.23508.tldr: It is shown that addressing these challenges requires AI agents that can reason under uncertainty and handle both incomplete and non-Archimedean preferences.

2512.23515.tldr: Alpha-R1, an 8B-parameter reasoning model trained via reinforcement learning for context-aware alpha screening, is proposed, an 8B-parameter reasoning model trained via reinforcement learning for context-aware alpha screening.

2512.23541.tldr: Act2Goal is proposed, a general goal-conditioned manipulation policy that integrates a goal-conditioned visual world model with multi-scale temporal control and introduces Multi-Scale Temporal Hashing (MSTH), which decomposes the imagined trajectory into dense proximal frames for fine-grained closed-loop control and sparse distal frames that anchor global task consistency.

2512.23545.tldr: This work proposes PathFound, an agentic multimodal model designed to support evidence-seeking inference in pathological diagnosis and achieves state-of-the-art diagnostic performance across diverse clinical scenarios and demonstrates strong potential to discover subtle details, such as nuclear features and local invasions.

2512.23547.tldr: A simple yet powerful approach that enriches hallucination self-detection by converting LLM responses into knowledge graphs of entities and relations and using these graphs to estimate the likelihood that a response contains hallucinations is proposed.

2512.23557.tldr: A Cross-Agent Multimodal Provenanc- Aware Defense Framework whereby all the prompts, either user-generated or produced by upstream agents, are sanitized and all the outputs generated by an LLM are verified independently before being sent to downstream nodes.

2512.23562.tldr: This work presents VL-RouterBench, a systematic, reproducible benchmark for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs), and will open-source the complete data construction and evaluation toolchain to promote comparability, reproducibility, and practical deployment in multimodal routing research.

2512.23617.tldr: Le Cam Distortion is introduced, quantified by the Deficiency Distance, as a rigorous upper bound for transfer risk conditional on simulability, and provides the first principled framework for risk-controlled transfer learning in domains where negative transfer is unacceptable: medical imaging, autonomous systems, and precision medicine.

2512.23626.tldr: This work proposes I-PERI, a novel federated algorithm that first recovers the CPDAG of the union of client graphs and then orients additional edges by exploiting structural differences induced by interventions across clients.

2512.23633.tldr: The results suggest that pedagogically fine-tuned AI tutoring systems may play a promising role in delivering effective, individualized learning support at scale.

2512.23647.tldr: This work proposes Nested Browser-Use Learning (NestBrowse), which introduces a minimal and complete browser-action framework that decouples interaction control from page exploration through a nested structure, and simplifies agentic reasoning while enabling effective deep-web information acquisition.

2512.23676.tldr: This work introduces the Web World Model (WWM), a middle ground where world state and ``physics'' are implemented in ordinary web code to ensure logical consistency, while large language models generate context, narratives, and high-level decisions on top of this structured latent state.

2512.23684.tldr: It is found that prompt injection induces substantial changes in review scores and accept/reject decisions for English, Japanese, and Chinese injections, while Arabic injections produce little to no effect.

2403.07688.tldr: Demon Pruning is introduced, a method that controls the proliferation of dead neurons through a combination of noise injection on active units and a one-cycle schedule regularization strategy, dynamically leading to network sparsity.

2404.15834.tldr: This work proposes an approach that builds upon the existing protocol structure with end goal a decentralized marketplace for federated learning and LLM training, and presents a proof-of-concept implementation over public NOSTR relays.

2406.10973.tldr: This work introduces ExPLoRA, a highly effective technique to improve transfer learning of pre-trained vision transformers (ViTs) under domain shifts, and demonstrates state-of-the-art results on satellite imagery, even outperforming fully pre-training and fine-tuning ViTs.

2408.05992.tldr: Experimental results from a laboratory-scale testbed show that TL-SbPGs improve production efficiency and reduce power consumption compared to vanilla SbPGs, and the applicability of the SbPG framework to transfer learning is formally established.

2408.07666.tldr: A new taxonomic approach is proposed that exhaustively discusses existing model merging methods and theories, and the application of model merging techniques in large language models, multimodal large language models, and more than ten machine learning subfields, including continual learning, multi-task learning, few-shot learning, and so on.

2409.15272.tldr: This work introduces OmniBench, a novel benchmark designed to rigorously evaluate models'ability to recognize, interpret, and reason across visual, acoustic, and textual inputs simultaneously, and defines language models capable of such tri-modal processing as the omni-language models (OLMs).

2410.18565.tldr: This work introduces Bielik 7B v0.1, a 7-billion-parameter generative text model for Polish language processing, a substantial advancement in Polish language AI, offering a powerful tool for diverse linguistic applications and setting new benchmarks in the field.

2412.03154.tldr: A new benchmark for NN verification, named SoundnessBench, is developed, specifically for testing the soundness of NN verifiers, that consists of instances with deliberately inserted counterexamples that are hidden from adversarial attacks commonly used to find counterexamples.

2412.07454.tldr: By leveraging the permutation equivariance and invariance properties of neural networks via weight shuffling and shuffled model validation, Tazza enhances resilience against diverse poisoning attacks, while ensuring data confidentiality and high model accuracy.

2412.12641.tldr: This work compares the performance of LIP with the performance of the Whittle Index Policy, both heuristic policies known to be asymptotically optimal under certain natural conditions, and proposes reinforcement learning algorithms to obtain online learning schemes for LIP in the model-free setting.

2412.15241.tldr: The impact of content position and input size on text embeddings is investigated and the sensitivity of retrieval systems is quantified and a new lens towards embedding model robustness is suggested.

2503.08990.tldr: A black-box Jailbreak method with Cross-Behavior attacks (JCB), that can automatically and efficiently find successful jailbreak prompts and leverages successes from past behaviors to help jailbreak new behaviors, thereby significantly improving the attack efficiency.

2503.22942.tldr: This work proposes AINav, an adaptive interactive navigation approach that proactively interacts with environments to create feasible paths to achieve originally unreachable goals, and presents a primitive skill tree for task planning with large language models (LLMs), facilitating effective reasoning to determine interaction objects and sequences.

2503.23037.tldr: This work finds that agentic LLMs provide a solution for the problem of LLMs running out of training data: inference-time behavior generates new training states, such that LLMs can keep learning without needing ever larger datasets.

2504.02382.tldr: Findings suggest that interactive segmentation approaches, integrating human decision-making with task-relevant information, may be essential for improving model reliability and clinical applicability in automated fracture segmentation.

2504.05646.tldr: This paper introduces \model, a novel recurrent neural network (RNN) mechanism that leverages the inherent low-rank structure of K-V matrices to efficiently compress the cache into a fixed number of memory slots, achieving sub-quadratic complexity.

2504.19354.tldr: Aerial+ is introduced, a novel neurosymbolic ARM method that leverages an under-complete autoencoder to create a neural representation of the data, capturing associations between features, and extracts rules from this neural representation by exploiting the model's reconstruction mechanism.

2505.00742.tldr: Zoomer is introduced, a visual prompting framework that delivers token-efficient, detail-preserving image representations for black-box MLLMs and establishes a principled methodology for robust, resource-aware multimodal understanding in settings where model internals are inaccessible.

2505.03452.tldr: This study explores the largest RAG HPO search space to date that includes full grid-search evaluations, and uses three evaluation metrics as optimization targets, and shows that RAG HPO can be done efficiently, either greedily or with random search, and that it significantly boosts RAG performance for all datasets.

2505.08151.tldr: A time-series foundation model is investigated, that is, a large pre-trained time-series model for capacity degradation forecasting, and a degradation-aware fine-tuning strategy is proposed that aligns the model to capacity trajectories while retaining broadly transferable temporal structure.

2505.20730.tldr: This paper proposes a simple and effective method to improve LLMs’ reasoning capabilities using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over the user-item interaction matrix with four different prompting strategies and shows that the LLM outperforms the MF model whenever the authors provide relevant information in a clear and easy-to-follow format, and prompt the LLM to reason based on it.

2505.24830.tldr: This work introduces a novel atomic fact-checking framework designed to enhance the reliability and explainability of LLMs used in medical long-form question answering, addressing a major gap in current medical AI applications.

2506.01482.tldr: This paper presents Skip-BART, an end-to-end model that directly learns from experienced lighting engineers and predict vivid, human-like stage lighting, and is the first work to conceptualize ASLC as a generative task rather than merely a classification problem.

2506.04245.tldr: This work proposes a reinforcement learning framework that further instills in models the reasoning necessary to achieve contextual integrity (CI), and shows that this method substantially reduces inappropriate information disclosure while maintaining task performance across multiple model sizes and families.

2506.08899.tldr: Experiments on legal norms from the Australian Telecommunications Consumer Protections Code demonstrate that, when guided effectively, LLMs can produce formalizations that align closely with expert-crafted representations, underscoring their potential for scalable legal informatics.

2506.15301.tldr: The task of trial-patient matching is analyzed and emerging LLM-based approaches in clinical trial recruitment are contextualized to critically examine existing benchmarks, approaches and evaluation frameworks, the challenges to adopting LLM technologies in clinical research and exciting future directions.

2506.20049.tldr: This work implements SceneSense, a diffusion model designed and trained for predicting 3D occupancy maps given partial observations that probabilistically fuses into a running occupancy map in real-time, resulting in significant improvements in map quality and traversability.

2507.05405.tldr: PT-LiRPA is presented, a novel framework that combines over-approximation techniques from LiRPA-based approaches with a sampling-based method to compute tight intermediate reachable sets and results in a valuable solution for challenging competition entries where state-of-the-art formal verification methods fail.

2507.15351.tldr: Experiments on a real-world ride-hailing dataset show that both GRPO and OSPO achieve promising performance across all scenarios, efficiently optimizing pickup times and the number of served orders using simple Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) networks.

2507.17974.tldr: A comprehensive survey of NLP research for Tigrinya, analyzing over 50 studies from 2011 to 2025, reveals a clear trajectory from foundational, rule-based systems to modern neural architectures, with progress consistently driven by milestones in resource creation.

2508.00743.tldr: It is shown that multi-step retrieval enhances diagnostic reliability, especially in deployable mid-sized LLMs, and reduces hallucinations and provided clinically relevant evidence in 46% of cases, improving factual grounding.

2508.05667.tldr: A comprehensive instruction tuning dataset, ITDR, which encompasses seven subtasks across two root tasks: user-item interaction and user-item understanding and the impact of task descriptions and data scale on instruction tuning effectiveness is constructed.

2508.07307.tldr: MCITlib is presented, a comprehensive library for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning, which implements 8 representative algorithms and conducts evaluations on 3 benchmarks under 2 backbone models.

2508.08947.tldr: This paper proposes a model named GenCast, the core idea of which is to exploit external knowledge to compensate for the missing observations and to enhance generalisation, and integrates physics-informed neural networks into GenCast, enabling physical principles to regularise the learning process.

2508.12897.tldr: This work provides a scalable and effective pathway for safety alignment in reasoning-intensive AI systems, addressing the core trade-off between safety and functional performance.

2508.14556.tldr: A new music source separation model tailored for accurate vocal isolation that leverages Mamba2, a recent state space model, to better capture long-range temporal dependencies and combines a band-splitting strategy with dual-path architecture.

2508.16620.tldr: STRelay models future spatiotemporal contexts in a relaying manner, which is subsequently integrated with the encoded historical representation from a base location prediction model, enabling multi-task learning by simultaneously predicting the next time interval, next moving distance interval, and finally the next location.

2508.16623.tldr: This work proposes RAST, a universal framework that integrates retrieval-augmented mechanisms with spatio-temporal modeling to address challenges in traffic prediction and demonstrates that RAST achieves superior performance while maintaining computational efficiency.

2509.01560.tldr: This work introduces In-N-Out, the first expert-annotated dataset of API graphs built from two real-world API benchmarks and their documentation, and highlights the promise of using explicit API graphs for tool agents and the utility of In-N-Out as a valuable resource.

2509.02761.tldr: An iterative verification framework in which a Judge LLM critiques action sequences and a Planner LLM applies the revisions, yielding progressively cleaner and more spatially coherent trajectories, which provides a scalable path to higher-quality training data for imitation learning in embodied AI.

2509.09009.tldr: Comparison of open reference datasets reveals that training on NemoTron-CC HQ consistently outperforms other reference datasets, followed by DCLM-baseline and FineWeb-Edu.

2509.24274.tldr: This work proposes a simulation framework for controlled modeling of ESP cheaters, non-cheaters, and trajectory-based detectors and introduces a structured cheater model that dynamically switches between cheating and non-cheating behaviors based on detection risk.

2510.03257.tldr: A centralized Single Agent Reinforcement Learning method designed specifically for large-scale order dispatching on ride-sharing platforms, built on a variant TD3, that addresses the vast action space through an action decomposition strategy that breaks down the joint action probability into individual driver action probabilities.

2510.10161.tldr: This survey presents a systematic investigation organized around four interrelated dimensions: Model Sourcing, Model Structure Sourcing, Training Data Sourcing, and External Data Sourcing, that classifies existing sourcing methods into prior-based (proactive traceability embedding) and posterior-based (retrospective inference) approaches.

2510.17884.tldr: This study conducts an empirical investigation into the efficacy of pre-trained LLMs for password cracking using synthetic user profiles and identifies key limitations in the generative reasoning of LLMs when applied to the domain-specific task of password guessing.

2510.25890.tldr: In the evaluated AUTOSAR setting, ATLAS consistently produces schema-valid single-file outputs and preserves perfect file completeness and XSD validity at multi-file scale, while SHACL/SMT checks and result analysis continue to expose residual system-level defects.

2510.26714.tldr: This work illustrates that this is particularly relevant for MU methods that are deterministic, i.e., which always produce the same result when started from the same trained model, and recommends that empirical comparisons of MU algorithms should also reflect the variability across different model training seeds.

2510.26745.tldr: It is argued that the rise of such a geometry, as against a lookup of local associations, cannot be straightforwardly attributed to typical supervisory, architectural, or optimizational pressures, and that it arises naturally despite the lack of various pressures.

2510.26954.tldr: This work expands upon the original imitation game by accounting for an additional factor: the energy spent answering the questions, which compels society to weigh the time savings of using artificial intelligence against its total resource cost.

2511.03179.tldr: Overall, this work demonstrates how collaborative AI agents equipped with structured knowledge representations can enhance efficiency, consistency, and quality in the engineering design process.

2511.07017.tldr: High-quality, context-rich benchmark for fine-grained LLM evaluation in code review, Evaluating eight leading LLMs reveals that textual context yields greater performance gains than code context alone, while current LLMs remain far from human-level review ability.

2511.13719.tldr: This work explores scaling up multimodal foundation models to cultivate spatial intelligence within the SenseNova-SI family, built upon established multimodal foundations including visual understanding models and unified understanding and generation models.

2511.18869.tldr: HEAR, a robust music aesthetic evaluation framework that combines a multi-source multi-scale representations module to obtain complementary segment- and track-level features, a hierarchical augmentation strategy to mitigate overfitting, and a hybrid training objective that integrates regression and ranking losses for accurate scoring and reliable top-tier song identification is proposed.

2511.19156.tldr: A novel metric, Derivation Entropy, is introduced, which quantifies the effective work required to compute a target state from a given logical depth and suggests that the minimization of Derivation Entropy is a governing principle for the evolution of both biological and artificial intelligence.

2511.20143.tldr: This work integrates image data augmentation techniques, such as cropping, scaling, and padding, into grid-based models to enhance their ability to recognize discontinuous entities and handle segmentation challenges.

2511.22998.tldr: TIM-PRM (Tool-Integrated Multimodal PRM), a novel agentic framework that transforms verification from a passive classification task into an active, tool-augmented investigation, significantly outperforming much larger models like Qwen2.5-72B and InternVL-78B, while offering interpretable insights into the verification process.

2512.00738.tldr: This paper demonstrates that coalition failures stem from fundamental architectural limitations in centralized operator models rather than operational deficiencies, and argues further that neither closed nor coalition systems can scale in intelligence-driven paradigms where AI agents mediate commerce and demand trustless, protocol-based coordination that existing architectures cannot provide.

2512.06205.tldr: By operationalizing a philosophical inquiry about representation, this work equip philosophers of science, computer scientists, linguists, and mathematicians with a common language and technical framework for systematic investigation of grounding and meaning.

2512.06337.tldr: DaGRPO incorporates two core mechanisms: Sequence-level Gradient Rectification, which utilizes fine-grained scoring to dynamically mask sample pairs with low distinctiveness, thereby eradicating gradient conflicts at the source and Off-policy Data Augmentation, which introduces high-quality anchors to recover training signals for challenging tasks.

2512.07540.tldr: This work applies Minimum Bayes Risk decoding to generative ESD, and uses a sentence- or span-level similarity function for MBR decoding, which selects candidate hypotheses based on their approximate similarity to the human annotation.

2512.10807.tldr: This paper proposes HAROOD, a comprehensive benchmark for HAR in OOD settings, which is highly modular and easy to extend for new datasets, algorithms, comparisons, and analysis, with the hope to facilitate the research in OOD-based HAR.

2512.11843.tldr: This manifesto proposes a paradigm for framing popular AI models in terms of spiking networks and polychronization, and suggests a path toward converting AI models into a novel class of architectures with much smaller size yet combinatorially large encoding capacity, offering the promise of a thousandfold improvement in performance.

2512.13886.tldr: This work introduces OPTIMA, a practical one-shot post-training pruning method that balances accuracy and scalability and implements an accelerator-friendly QP solver that accumulates one Hessian per layer and solves many small QPs in parallel, enabling one-shot post-training pruning at scale on a single accelerator without fine-tuning.

2512.14297.tldr: This study proposes a threshold-triggered Deep Q-Network self-healing agent that autonomically detects, analyzes, and mitigates network disruptions while adapting routing behavior and resource allocation in real time, and outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

2512.16251.tldr: The Consensus-Bottleneck Asset Pricing Model is introduced, which embeds aggregate analyst consensus as a structural bottleneck, treating professional beliefs as a sufficient statistic for the market's high-dimensional information set, and achieves interpretability-by-design.

2512.16907.tldr: The EgoMAN model is introduced, a reasoning-to-motion framework that links vision-language reasoning and motion generation via a trajectory-token interface and yields accurate and stage-aware trajectories with generalization across real-world scenes.

2512.17083.tldr: An evaluation framework that reports boundary density and segment alignment diagnostics (purity and coverage) alongside window-tolerant F1 (W-F1) alongside window-tolerant F1 (W-F1) is introduced by separating boundary scoring from boundary selection.

2512.20407.tldr: This study introduces AUDRON (AUdio-based Drone Recognition Network), a hybrid deep learning framework for drone sound detection, employing a combination of Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients, Short-Time Fourier Transform, and convolutional neural networks processed with convolutional neural networks, recurrent layers for temporal modeling, and autoencoder-based representations.

2512.20589.tldr: This study serves as a proof of concept demonstrating that DE-enabled mission simulations combined with advanced analytical tools offer a mission-agnostic framework for improving ME practice; which can be extended to more complicated fleet design and selection problems in the future from a mission-first perspective.

2512.21776.tldr: This research study extends the initially proposed VAE-GAN video generation model by employing a novel, memory-efficient approach to generate long videos composed of hundreds or thousands of frames ensuring their temporal continuity, consistency and dynamics.

2512.22251.tldr: This framework provides a path toward mechanistic drug modeling: moving beyond binary drug-disease association tasks to granular transcriptional effects of therapeutic intervention.

2512.23020.tldr: The Active Cognition-based Reasoning (ACR) module is designed to overcome the fundamental limitation of pre-defined OLTs by progressively augmenting the cognitive scope of VLMs by progressively augmenting the cognitive scope of VLMs.

2512.23380.tldr: CoLog represents a significant advancement in log anomaly detection, providing a sophisticated and effective solution to point and collective anomaly detection through a unified framework and a solution to the complex challenges automatic log data analysis poses.

2512.23435.tldr: A mobile-efficient SER system based on DistilHuBERT, a distilled and 8-bit quantized transformer that achieves approximately 92% parameter reduction compared to full-scale Wav2Vec 2.0 models while maintaining competitive accuracy is presented.

2512.23512.tldr: The unified structure with a concise model, UniHetero, under large-scale pretraining (>200M samples), demonstrates a superior scaling trend compared to understanding alone, revealing a more effective way to learn vision-only knowledge directive from vision modality rather than captioning to text.

2512.23624.tldr: NeuroSPICE leverages PINNs to solve circuit differential-algebraic equations (DAEs) by minimizing the residual of the equations through backpropagation, which enables the simulation of emerging devices, including highly nonlinear systems such as ferroelectric memories.

2512.23710.tldr: This study contributes to digital humanities research by offering an automated pipeline for interpreting digitized historical documents, addressing challenges like layout variability and terminology differences, and exploring the applicability and strength of an advanced generative AI model.

2512.23712.tldr: A comprehensive framework for evaluating and improving consistency in LLM-generated structured outputs, combining a novel similarity metric balancing semantic flexibility with structural strictness when comparing JSON outputs, and a consistency scoring framework aggregating multiple STED measurements across repeated generations to quantify reliability is introduced.

2512.23713.tldr: This work addresses Bangla-to-Python code generation by introducing BanglaCodeAct, an agent-based framework that leverages multi-agent prompting and iterative self-correction within a Thought-Code-Observation loop, enabling dynamic generation, testing, and refinement of code from Bangla instructions.

2512.23717.tldr: HarmTransform is introduced, a multi-agent debate framework for systematically transforming harmful queries into stealthier forms while preserving their underlying harmful intent, and reveals that debate acts as a double-edged sword.

2512.23726.tldr: The combination of the MuPa-ZTE acquisition and the physics-informed diffusion model is termed q3-MuPa, a quick, quiet, and quantitative multi-parametric mapping framework, and its findings highlight its strong clinical potential.

2512.23738.tldr: This work presents Agent-C, a novel framework that provides run-time guarantees ensuring LLM agents adhere to formal temporal safety properties, and demonstrates that Agent-C achieves perfect safety (100% conformance, 0% harm), while improving task utility compared to state-of-the-art guardrails and unrestricted agents.

2512.23739.tldr: NOAM (Non-visible Object Allocation Model), a hybrid agent pipeline that combines structured scene understanding with large language model inference, is introduced, designed for modular deployment within broader robotic systems.

2512.23740.tldr: A factor abstraction with five fundamental operations that serve as a universal interface for manipulating factors regardless of their underlying representation is introduced, allowing representation-agnostic probabilistic programming where users can freely mix different representations within a single unified framework.

2512.23747.tldr: Mify-Coder achieves comparable accuracy and safety while significantly outperforming much larger baseline models on standard coding and function-calling benchmarks, demonstrating that compact models can match frontier-grade models in code generation and agent-driven workflows.

2512.23753.tldr: This work designs a general family of activation functions and corresponding evidential regularizers that provide an alternative pathway for consistent evidence updates across activation regimes and empirically validate the developed theory and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed generalized regularized evidential models.

2512.23755.tldr: A self-supervised learning framework that extracts latent factors endogenously from time series residuals without external data to model evolving social influence, memory, and bias patterns, and is integrated into a state-of-the-art backbone model as an attention map.

2512.23757.tldr: Deep learning methods apply in enhancing the diagnosis of respiratory diseases such as COVID-19, lung cancer, and pneumonia from chest x-rays, with high accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores.

2512.23760.tldr: Audited Skill-Graph Self-Improvement (ASG-SI), a framework that treats self-improvement as iterative compilation of an agent into a growing, auditable skill graph, is proposed, offering a practical path toward reproducible evaluation and operational governance of self-improving AI agents.

2512.23762.tldr: A novel methodology to evaluate the stability of datasets and a benchmark workflow that can be used to compare datasets are proposed, based on a concept drift detection method that also uses ML feature weights to boost the detection performance.

2512.23765.tldr: Entropy-Aware Speculative Decoding (EASD), a training-free enhancement that incorporates a dynamic entropy-based penalty, and proves that the efficiency of EASD is comparable to that of SD.

2512.23767.tldr: This work presents MERINDA (Model Recovery in Reconfigurable Dynamic Architecture), an FPGA-accelerated MR framework designed to make physical AI practical on resource-constrained devices and demonstrates that it can bring accurate, explainable MR to the edge for real-time monitoring of autonomous systems.

2512.23773.tldr: Through extensive experiments on crypto futures in a high-frequency trading environment with high fidelity and 5x leverage, it is demonstrated that FineFT outperforms 12 SOTA baselines in 6 financial metrics, reducing risk by more than 40% while achieving superior profitability compared to the runner-up.

2512.23777.tldr: This study investigates fraud detection in ride-hailing platforms through Graph Neural Networks, focusing on the effectiveness of various models, and outlines a structured overview of GNN architectures and methodologies applied to anomaly detection.

2512.23809.tldr: Zero-Trust Agentic Federated Learning (ZTA-FL), a defense in depth framework combining a TPM-based cryptographic attestation achieving less than 0.0000001 false acceptance rate, a novel SHAP-weighted aggregation algorithm providing explainable Byzantine detection under non-IID conditions with theoretical guarantees, and privacy-preserving on-device adversarial training is proposed.

2512.23813.tldr: The results demonstrate that focused cross-condition transfer from stress-related disorders (+1% F1 over vanilla RoBERTa) provides stronger representations than general mental health training.

2512.23816.tldr: This paper demonstrates that existing offline algorithms in fact provide stronger guarantees -- simultaneously in terms of corruption level and privacy parameters -- than previously known, and presents the first set of results for private and robust online alignment.
