2601.02147.tldr: A bilateral prompt optimization framework that simultaneously mitigates non-causal feature reliance in both modalities during test-time adaptation and steering the model toward causal, domain invariant reasoning without retraining or domain supervision is proposed.

2601.02149.tldr: It is shown that, with appropriate training, a deep vision-transformer network can efficiently memorize relation between Hamiltonian parameters and structures on conductance maps and use it to propose parameters update for a quantum dot chain that drive the system toward topological phase.

2601.02151.tldr: Entropy-Adaptive Fine-Tuning (EAFT) is proposed, which utilizes token-level entropy as a gating mechanism to distinguish between epistemic uncertainty and knowledge conflict and allows the model to learn from uncertain samples while suppressing gradients on conflicting data.

2601.02170.tldr: This work treats step-level hallucination judgments as local observations and introduces a cumulative prefix-level hallucination signal that tracks the global evolution of the reasoning state over the entire trajectory, enabling streaming hallucination detection in long CoT reasoning.

2601.02200.tldr: This study investigates the concept of ``AI-friendly code''via LLM-based refactoring on a dataset of 5,000 Python files from competitive programming and finds a meaningful association between CodeHealth, a quality metric calibrated for human comprehension, and semantic preservation after AI refactoring.

2601.02204.tldr: NextFlow, a unified decoder-only autoregressive transformer trained on 6 trillion interleaved text-image discrete tokens, is presented, and a prefix-tuning strategy for reinforcement learning is introduced, addressing the instabilities of multi-scale generation through a robust training recipe.

2601.02206.tldr: RetinexEVSR is presented, the first event-driven LVSR framework that leverages high-contrast event signals and Retinex-inspired priors to enhance video quality under low-light scenarios and introduces a novel bidirectional cross-modal fusion strategy to extract and integrate meaningful cues from noisy event data and degraded RGB frames.

2601.02242.tldr: A compact, high-throughput instruction-based image editing pipeline that uses a modern 2B-parameter Qwen3-VL model to guide the editing process and the 1.6B-parameter diffusion model Sana1.5 for image generation that is particularly strong on edits that require preserving the input image.

2601.02246.tldr: A controlled comparison of three paradigms across five real-world image classification datasets shows that transfer learning consistently yields the strongest predictive performance, while the custom CNN provides an attractive efficiency--accuracy trade-off, especially when compute and memory budgets are constrained.

2601.02273.tldr: TopoLoRA-SAM is proposed, a topology-aware and parameter-efficient adaptation framework for binary semantic segmentation that substantially improves segmentation accuracy and robustness, demonstrating that topology-aware parameter-efficient adaptation can match or exceed fully fine-tuned specialist models.

2601.02311.tldr: The framework unifies ZeRO Stages 1-3, Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP), tensor parallelism, and pipeline parallelism as instances with different placement choices as instances with different placement choices.

2601.02314.tldr: Project Ariadne is introduced, a novel XAI framework that utilizes Structural Causal Models (SCMs) and counterfactual logic to audit the causal integrity of agentic reasoning and proposes the Ariadne Score as a new benchmark for aligning stated logic with model action.

2601.02357.tldr: DARC is introduced, a generative drum accompaniment model that conditions both on musical context from other stems and explicit rhythm prompts such as beatboxing or tapping tracks.

2601.02362.tldr: It is found that AI-generated reviews differ systematically from human-authored reviews across multiple textual dimensions, highlighting the strategic importance of platform control in governing the generation and integration of AI-generated reviews, ensuring that synthetic content complements recommendation robustness and sustainable business value.

2601.02364.tldr: This work proposes an LLM-based recommender (LLM-Rec) that not only predicts items but also generates logically grounded rationales, and releases a rationale-augmented recommendation dataset containing user histories, rationales, and recommended items.

2601.02365.tldr: A failure-aware Usage of Subagent Evidence for MultiModal Search and Recommendation is presented and this approach demonstrates that strategic context summarization outperforms both comprehensive and minimal contextualization strategies.

2601.02366.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that TextBridgeGNN outperforms existing methods in cross-domain, multi-domain, and training-free settings, highlighting its ability to integrate Pre-trained Language Model (PLM)-driven semantics with graph-based collaborative filtering without costly language model fine-tuning or real-time inference overhead.

2601.02368.tldr: A Scenario-Adaptive Projection module is devised to generate lightweight, context-specific parameters, effectively preventing expert collapse in long-tail scenarios and a cross-architecture knowledge distillation framework is introduced, where an interaction-aware teacher guides the two-tower student to capture complex matching patterns.

2601.02375.tldr: LeafTutor, an AI tutoring agent powered by large language models (LLMs), was developed to provide step-by-step guidance for students and the results indicate that the system can deliver step-by-step programming guidance comparable to human tutors.

2601.02379.tldr: This survey provides an encyclopedic overview of movement primitive approaches and applications in chronological order and presents movement primitive frameworks as a way of representing robotic control trajectories acquired through human demonstrations.

2601.02382.tldr: This work shows that Contextual RAG consistently improves accuracy over standard RAG and base prompting, while maintaining competitive runtime and CO2 emissions, and highlights the potential of Contextual RAG to serve as a scalable and effective solution for domain-specific Q&A in O-RAN and broader 5G/6G environments.

2601.02385.tldr: This work proposes a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) that predicts location specific received signal strength (RSS), and EMF exposure simultaneously from the network topology, as images, and a Deep Q Network (DQN) framework, using the trained cGAN, for optimal base station (BS) deployment in the network.

2601.02386.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach that utilizes large language models' expertise to uncover underexplored user preferences from observed behavior, ultimately providing diverse and relevant recommendations in diversified recommendation.

2601.02392.tldr: Experimental results on clinical CTA datasets demonstrate that initializing the Calcium Removal network with the MAE-based weights significantly improves inpainting accuracy and stenosis estimation compared to training from scratch, specifically in few-shot scenarios.

2601.02398.tldr: A comprehensive and system-level review of AI-native ISAC-enabled self-organizing wireless networks and examines emerging learning paradigms, including deep reinforcement learning, graph-based learning, multi-agent coordination, and federated intelligence that enable autonomous adaptation under uncertainty, mobility, and partial observability.

2601.02399.tldr: ProSoftArena is introduced, a benchmark and platform specifically for evaluating multimodal agents in professional software environments and the first capability hierarchy tailored to agent use of professional software is established, to ensure reliable and reproducible assessment.

2601.02404.tldr: The findings reveal that while LLMs perform well in code generation and logical circuit design, they struggle significantly with physical breadboard layout creation, particularly in managing proper pin connections and avoiding circuit errors.

2601.02410.tldr: The VCP aims to provide a quantitative basis for educators to determine the optimal pedagogical boundary: identifying contexts where Vibe Coding fosters genuine mastery and contexts where it introduces hidden technical debt and superficial competence.

2601.02412.tldr: This work develops a social network-aware recommender system that explicitly accounts for this user-creators feedback interaction and strategically exploits the topology of the user's own social network to promote diversification.

2601.02414.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate the MIAR outperforms state-of-the-art MER methods and integrates contextual features across different modalities using a feature interaction to generate feature tokens to represent global representations of how each modality extracts information from others.

2601.02415.tldr: This paper first extracts multi-channel features to obtain more comprehensive feature information, and proposes a symmetric mutual promotion (SMP) inter-modal feature fusion method that integrates intra-modal features and inter-modal fused features, fully leveraging the complementarity of inter-modal feature information while considering feature information differences.

2601.02424.tldr: This work presents the construction of a large-scale, aligned Nanocrystal Synthesis-Property (NSP) database and demonstrates its capability for generative inverse design, and establishes a powerful human-AI collaborative paradigm for accelerating nanocrystal discovery.

2601.02427.tldr: NitroGen is introduced, a vision-action foundation model for generalist gaming agents that is trained on 40,000 hours of gameplay videos across more than 1,000 games and achieves up to 52% relative improvement in task success rates over models trained from scratch.

2601.02428.tldr: ARM yields competitive accuracy, self-regularizing memory growth, and interpretable retention dynamics without retraining the generator\color{black} and provides practical trade-off between quality, latency and memory efficiency for production and research RAG system.

2601.02430.tldr: WebCoderBench is introduced, the first real-world-collected, generalizable, and interpretable benchmark for web app generation and shows that there exists no dominant model across all evaluation metrics, offering an opportunity for LLM developers to optimize their models in a targeted manner for a more powerful version.

2305.02109.tldr: This paper proposes a novel distributed ML architecture called elastic FL (EFL), which unleashes the full potential of Open RAN (O-RAN) systems and introduces an elastic resource provisioning methodology to execute FL-services.

2311.16086.tldr: This work introduces a novel optimization problem formulation that departs from the conventional way of minimizing machine learning model loss as a black-box function and explicitly incorporates an initially pre-trained model and random sketch operators, allowing for sparsification of both the model and gradient during training.

2312.11714.tldr: A novel time series generative model named'Time-Transformer AAE', which consists of an adversarial autoencoder (AAE) and a newly designed architecture named'Time-Transformer' within the decoder within the decoder, which can outperform existing state-of-the-art models in 5 out of 6 datasets.

2312.16713.tldr: This work significantly advances the state of neural network imputation applied to EHRs by more closely aligning algorithmic imputation with clinical realities.

2405.18867.tldr: A comparative analysis between CLIP and its recent counterpart, CLOOB is delves into the nuanced intricacies that underlie the comparative efficacy of CLIP and CLOOB, offering insights into their respective strengths and weaknesses, and providing a foundation for further refinement and advancement in multimodal model research.

2407.00125.tldr: A taxonomy of AI system failures is revealed, a framework for fault diagnosis is provided, and areas for improvement in FI techniques are identified to enhance the resilience of AI systems.

2409.14305.tldr: The UU-Mamba model is introduced, an extension of the U-Mamba architecture designed to address challenges in both cardiac and vascular segmentation, and incorporates Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM), which enhances generalization by seeking flatter minima in the loss landscape.

2409.20412.tldr: A novel methodology is proposed that frames the causal dose-response problem as a covariate shift, leveraging weighted conformal prediction, and uses a new synthetic benchmark dataset to demonstrate the significance of covariate shift assumptions in achieving robust prediction intervals for dose-response models.

2410.04054.tldr: This work describes the frequency at which social balance is achieved, the justifications for the social dynamics, and the diversity and stability of interactions, and explains how the findings inform the deployment of agentic systems.

2411.09510.tldr: This paper looks into the details on one such Tensor Parallel strategy - Tensor Parallel - and proposes to reduce latency by compressing inter-accelerator communication, leading up to 2x reduction of time-to-first-token (TTFT) with negligible model performance degradation.

2501.18784.tldr: This work presents a method that employs LLMs to generate problem-specific heuristic functions from planning tasks specified through successor generators, goal tests, and initial states written in a general-purpose programming language, and provides an extensive empirical evaluation that characterizes the strengths and limitations of the approach across diverse planning settings, demonstrating its effectiveness.

2502.16886.tldr: A new objective is proposed that lifts the threshold constraints for robust KV pruning, calling for "threshold-free" methods that automatically adjust budget sizes while ensuring full-cache performance, and proposes a novel method ReFreeKV as the first solution fulfilling this objective.

2503.03750.tldr: It is found that simple methods, such as representation engineering interventions, can improve honesty, and the growing need for robust evaluations and effective interventions to ensure LLMs remain trustworthy is underscored.

2503.04833.tldr: Results demonstrate that the proposed E$^2$AT achieves the state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing baselines by an average margin of 34\% across text and image modalities, while maintaining clean task performance.

2503.16072.tldr: This position paper reconceptualise toxicity as a socially emergent signal of stress in the Contextual Stress Framework (CSF), which defines toxicity as a stress-inducing norm violation within a given context and introduces an additional dimension for toxicity detection.

2504.19155.tldr: This study presents a robust and generalizable method for incorporating the anode heel effect into MC simulations using machine learning, enabling accurate, energy-dependent beam modeling with limited calibration data and enhances simulation realism for applications in clinical dosimetry, image quality assessment, and radiation protection.

2504.20734.tldr: This work introduces UniversalRAG, designed to retrieve and integrate knowledge from heterogeneous sources with diverse modalities and granularities, and proposes modality-aware routing, which dynamically identifies the most appropriate modality-specific corpus and performs targeted retrieval within it.

2505.05665.tldr: This work proposes a novel method for efficiently searching the space of prompt perturbations using adaptive stress testing (AST) with Monte-Carlo tree search (MCTS), and enables discovery of scenarios, sensor configurations, and prompt phrasing that cause language models to act with high uncertainty or even crash.

2505.12366.tldr: A new Discriminative Constrained Optimization (DisCO) framework for reinforcing LRMs, grounded in the principle of discriminative learning, is introduced, which significantly outperforms GRPO and its improved variants such as DAPO, and addresses the entropy instability in GRPO and its variants through the use of non-clipping scoring functions and a constrained optimization approach.

2505.17103.tldr: By enabling textual conditioning in the generation process, SDForger paves the way for multimodal modeling and the streamlined integration of time series with textual information.

2505.19347.tldr: PatentMind, a novel framework for patent similarity assessment based on a Multi-Aspect Reasoning Graph (MARG), is introduced, which decomposes patents into their three dimensions of technical features, application domains, and claim scopes, then dimension-specific similarity scores are calculated over the MARG.

2505.20734.tldr: Both expected and high probability regret bounds are given for the bandit optimization problem for nonconvex and non-smooth functions, where in each trial the loss function is the sum of a linear function and a small but arbitrary perturbation chosen after observing the player's choice.

2506.02326.tldr: TRuST, a large-scale dataset that unifies and expands prior resources through a carefully synthesized definition of toxicity, and corresponding annotation scheme, is introduced, which constitutes one of the most comprehensive resources for evaluating and mitigating LLM toxicity, and other research in socially-aware and safer language technologies.

2506.02397.tldr: OThink-R1 is proposed, a hybrid reasoning framework that integrates both modes within a single LRM and enables automatic mode switching based on problem characteristics and shows that OThink-R1 reduces reasoning token usage significantly while maintaining competitive accuracy.

2506.15787.tldr: This work introduces SLR, an end-to-end framework for systematic evaluation and training of Large Language Models (LLMs) via Scalable Logical Reasoning and creates SLR-Bench, a benchmark comprising 19k prompts organized into 20 curriculum levels that progressively increase in relational, arithmetic, and recursive complexity.

2506.20100.tldr: MIRAGE is introduced, a new benchmark for multimodal expert-level reasoning and decision-making in consultative interaction settings, designed for the agriculture domain, offering a high-fidelity benchmark for evaluating models on grounded reasoning, clarification strategies, and long-form generation in a real-world, knowledge-intensive domain.

2507.07328.tldr: This work establishes a reproducible framework for transforming generalist language models into dependable scientific tools while identifying critical areas including stereochemical precision, knowledge currency, and computational accessibility as key challenges for future advancement.

2507.07723.tldr: A theoretically grounded Stable Preference Optimization (SPO) framework that constrains preference learning within a safe alignment region is proposed and empirical evaluations demonstrate that SPO effectively stabilizes and enhances the performance of existing BT-style preference learning methods.

2507.12318.tldr: This paper investigates the representation used to condition diffusion models from the perspective that ideal representations should improve sample fidelity, be easy to generate, and be compositional to allow out-of-training samples generation.

2508.00500.tldr: The framework abstracts agent behaviors into symbolic states and learns a Discrete-Time Markov Chain (DTMC) from execution traces at runtime and achieves statistically reliable enforcement of agent safety.

2508.02178.tldr: This work introduces a dual-penalty reinforcement learning framework that surgically targets inefficiencies in redundancy, revealing an asymmetry in redundancy: external redundancy can be safely eliminated without performance loss, whereas internal redundancy removal requires a calibrated trade-off to maintain reasoning fidelity.

2508.15229.tldr: VocabTailor is introduced, a novel decoupled dynamic vocabulary selection framework that addresses memory constraints through offloading embedding and implements a hybrid static-dynamic vocabulary selection strategy for LM Head, enabling on-demand loading of vocabulary components.

2509.04398.tldr: In the linear case, IPA is proposed, a feature-aware projection framework that explicitly aims to reconstruct the original input within a reduced hidden space, enabling efficient projector pretraining with negligible inference overhead.

2509.06539.tldr: This paper defines an optimal defender strategy for CAGE-2 and introduces a method to efficiently learn this strategy, called BF-PPO, which is based on PPO, and it uses particle filter to mitigate the computational complexity due to the large state space of the CAGE-2 model.

2509.10769.tldr: This study provides a comprehensive enterprise-specific benchmark evaluating 18 distinct agentic configurations across state-of-the-art large language models and reveals significant model-specific architectural preferences that challenge the prevalent one-size-fits-all paradigm in agentic AI systems.

2509.11078.tldr: This work introduces Patient-Zero, a novel framework for ab initio patient simulation that requires no real medical records, and designs a Dual-Track Cognitive Memory System to enable agents dynamically update memory while preserving logical consistency and persona adherence.

2509.15151.tldr: This work investigates how foundation models - large-scale neural architectures pretrained on multimodal data - can be leveraged to analyze audio FX effects, uncovering patterns tied to specific effects and evaluating the robustness of foundation audio models.

2509.15409.tldr: This work presents the first formal computational analysis of retrosynthetic methods, showing that tree search exhibits exponential complexity O(bh), DirectMultiStep scales as O(h6), and FragmentRetro achieves O(h2), where h represents the number of heavy atoms in the target molecule and b is the branching factor for tree search.

2509.18633.tldr: The framework integrates geospatial flood hazards with an agent-based model of firms and households, enabling simulation of both direct asset losses and indirect disruptions propagated through economic networks.

2509.22461.tldr: This work benchmarks 26 state-of-the-art audio language models on CMDAR and observes that they exhibit limitations in complex reasoning tasks, including Qwen2.5-Omni on the more challenging multiple-choice with multiple audios and open-ended tasks.

2509.22750.tldr: This paper introduces MARCH, a benchmark for their intersection, with 2,209 multi-hop ambiguous questions curated via multi-LLM verification and validated by human annotation with strong agreement, and proposes CLARION, a two-stage agentic framework that significantly outperforms existing approaches, and paves the way for robust reasoning systems.

2510.04141.tldr: It is argued that the field is undergoing a paradigm shift, moving from simple recognition tasks that test “what” a model sees, to complex reasoning benchmarks that probe “why” and “how” it understands.

2510.10069.tldr: Across four task families that require distinct capabilities, SyncLipMAE achieves state-of-the-art results, underscoring the effectiveness of synchronization-aware, factorized self-supervised pretraining.

2510.10089.tldr: This paper conjecture that the recursive architecture of Looped-Attn induces a landscape-level inductive bias towards River-V-Valley, and proposes SHIFT (Staged HIerarchical Framework for Progressive Training), a principled training strategy that accelerates the training process of Looped-Attn while achieving comparable performances.

2510.14073.tldr: This work proposes to discover the unknown effects of a treatment directly from data by solving both issues by progressive stratification by introducing Neural Effect Search, a novel recursive procedure solving both issues by progressive stratification.

2510.14150.tldr: The results show that CodeEvolve achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on several tasks, with open-weight models often matching or exceeding closed-source baselines at a fraction of the compute cost.

2510.15125.tldr: An end-to-end framework for automatically inducing an interpretable topic taxonomy from unlabeled text corpora is introduced and suggests that structured, iterative labeling yields more consistent and interpretable topic labels than existing approaches under human evaluation, and is practical for analyzing large-scale political advertising data.

2510.16753.tldr: Efficient Lightweight Multimodal Large Language Models (ELMM) is proposed, which proposes a Multi-view Visual Token Compressor based on multi-head attention mechanism, which adaptively compresses image tokens from both textual and visual views, thereby effectively reducing redundancy while retaining necessary information and avoiding modality conflicts.

2510.23564.tldr: Extensive experiments show ReCode significantly surpasses advanced baselines in inference performance and demonstrates exceptional data efficiency in training, validating the core insight that unifying planning and action through recursive code generation is a powerful and effective approach to achieving universal granularity control.

2511.06101.tldr: This paper proposes SynthAgent, a fully synthetic supervision framework that aims at improving synthetic data quality via dual refinement of both tasks and trajectories, and demonstrates that SynthAgent outperforms existing synthetic data methods, validating the importance of high-quality synthetic supervision.

2511.07842.tldr: It is shown that CAQ enables robust 4-bit (W4A4) quantization across diverse model families--including LLaMA, Qwen, and Mistral--achieving superior safety alignment where state-of-the-art PTQ methods fail, without sacrificing general capabilities.

2511.08639.tldr: The article outlines conditions under which AI-assisted scholarship can be evaluated on its own terms: through transparent documentation, verification-oriented review, and participation by methodologically committed scholars.

2511.12063.tldr: TextBO is a simple, evaluation-efficient self-improving algorithm that operates purely in language space without explicit surrogates or calibrated uncertainty models, and is empirically validate on automated ad-alignment tasks using a persona-induced preference distribution.

2511.17005.tldr: FLUID (Face de-identification in the Latent space via Utility-preserving Identity Displacement), a single-input face de-identification framework that directly replaces identity features in the latent space of a pretrained diffusion model without affecting the model's weights, is presented.

2511.17254.tldr: It is found that hallucinations in LVLMs do not arise from a single causal path, but rather from the interplay among image-to-input-text, image-to-output-text, and text-to-text pathways.

2511.20697.tldr: Fine-tuning substantially improves results across modalities while preserving general knowledge, positioning MSU-Bench as a robust foundation for future research in multimodal reasoning.

2511.20892.tldr: This work introduces RILKE (Representation Intervention for Lifelong KnowledgE Control), a robust and scalable method that treats knowledge control as interventions within the model's representation space and identifies two key properties enabling RILKE to achieve fine-grained control over complex, unstructured knowledge while maintaining general utility with frozen base weights.

2511.21121.tldr: VisionRAG, a multimodal retrieval system that is OCR free and model agnostic, is introduced, showing that OCR free, summary guided multimodal retrieval is a practical and scalable alternative to traditional text extraction pipelines.

2512.03025.tldr: This report introduces LORE, a systematic framework for Large Generative Model-based relevance in e-commerce search that achieves a cumulative +27\% improvement in online GoodRate metrics and contends that a qualitative-driven decomposition is essential for breaking through current performance bottlenecks.

2512.03278.tldr: Progress is reported on Thucy, the first cross-database, cross-table multi-agent claim verification system that also provides concrete evidence for each verification verdict, and which surpasses the previous state of the art on the TabFact dataset.

2512.10282.tldr: Neuronal Attention Circuit is introduced, a novel, biologically inspired CT-Attention mechanism that reformulates attention logit computation as the solution to a linear first-order ODE with nonlinear interlinked gates derived from repurposing C.elegans Neuronal Circuit Policies (NCPs) wiring.

2512.10449.tldr: This study investigates the robustness of "LLM-as-a-Judge" systems to adversarial PDF manipulation via invisible text injections and layout aware encoding attacks, and introduces the Weighted Adversarial Vulnerability Score (WAVS), a novel metric that quantifies susceptibility by weighting score inflation against the severity of decision shifts relative to ground truth.

2512.10675.tldr: This report introduces a generative evaluation system built upon a frontier video foundation model (Veo), optimized to support robot action conditioning and multi-view consistency, while integrating generative image-editing and multi-view completion to synthesize realistic variations of real-world scenes along multiple axes of generalization.

2512.13102.tldr: Outcome-Driven Question optimization Strategy (ODQS) is proposed, a training framework that learns a questioning policy from downstream task outcomes, improving both accuracy and efficiency in interactive reasoning.

2512.14395.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed MeG can significantly improve the performance of large-scale KE in terms of Reliability, Generality, and Locality metrics compared to existing knowledge editing methods, particularly with a high percentage point increase in the absolute value index for the Locality metric.

2512.15674.tldr: The results suggest that diversified training to answer natural-language queries imparts a general capability to verbalize information about LLM activations, and that adding additional training datasets yields consistent further improvements.

2512.19001.tldr: This study demonstrates that a lightweight, domain-informed model can deliver state-of-the-art performance and robust transferability when guided by structured OR logic, highlighting the value of deeply aligning AI with OR.

2512.21852.tldr: Through analysis, it is observed that, in on-policy settings: (1) estimator configurations with biased gradients can result in training instabilities; and (2) using estimator configurations resulting in unbiased gradients leads to better performance on in-domain as well as out-of-domain tasks.

2512.22234.tldr: DiRL is introduced, an efficient post-training framework that tightly integrates FlexAttention-accelerated blockwise training with LMDeploy-optimized inference and DiPO, the first unbiased Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) implementation tailored for dLLMs is proposed.

2512.22322.tldr: The Self-Verifying Agent is introduced, a new type of agent designed with dual missions: to not only complete a task but also to prove its accomplishment with curated snapshot evidences, which facilitates the cultivation of efficient, self-verifying agents with competitive performance against DeepSeek V3.1 and Qwen3-235B-A22B.

2512.22334.tldr: SciEvalKit is a unified benchmarking toolkit designed to evaluate AI models for science across a broad range of scientific disciplines and task capabilities, and is open-sourced and actively maintained to foster community-driven development and progress in AI4Science.

2512.23292.tldr: This work presents a fundamentally different pathway toward domain-specific foundation models by introducing compact language models operating as Agentic Physical AI, in which policy optimization is driven by physics-based validation rather than perceptual inference.

2512.23379.tldr: SoulX-FlashTalk, a 14B-parameter framework optimized for high-fidelity real-time streaming, uses a self-correcting Bidirectional Distillation strategy that retains bidirectional attention within video chunks, and incorporates a multi-step Retrospective Self-Correction Mechanism to ensure stability during infinite generation.

2512.23966.tldr: LongCat ZigZag Attention (LoZA) is introduced, which is a sparse attention scheme designed to transform any existing full-attention models into sparse versions with rather limited compute budget, enabling efficient long-term reasoning and long-horizon agentic capabilities.

2512.24867.tldr: Encyclo-K is established as a scalable framework for dynamic evaluation of LLMs'comprehensive understanding over multiple fine-grained disciplinary knowledge statements, and validate the challenges introduced by dynamic evaluation and multi-statement comprehensive understanding.

2601.00042.tldr: It is suggested that seed variance and targeted domain knowledge can outweigh algorithmic sophistication when testing safety-trained models when testing safety-trained models.

2601.00150.tldr: This work conducts extensive evaluations of 28 state-of-the-art vision-language models spanning 14 AI companies and research institutes, revealing that even top-performing models experience notable performance degradation under the designed challenges.

2601.00240.tldr: It is revealed that LLM-powered agents exhibit not only demographic bias (e.g., gender, religion) but also intergroup bias under minimal"us"versus-them"cues, revealing a belief-dependent fragility in bias suppression toward humans.

2601.00655.tldr: Interpretability-Guided Bi-objective Optimization (IGBO) is introduced, a framework that trains interpretable models by incorporating structured domain knowledge via a bi-objective formulation and proves robustness to mini-batch noise.

2601.00821.tldr: CogCanvas, a training-free framework inspired by how teams use whiteboards to anchor shared memory, extracts verbatim-grounded artifacts and retrieves them via temporal-aware graph and significantly outperforms standard baselines.

2601.01061.tldr: This framework enables the principled integration of any ML model whose learning curve can be empirically characterized, eliminating the need for model-specific theoretical analysis.

2601.01473.tldr: A novel storage-based GNN training framework that employs a method of block-wise storage I/O processing to fully utilize the I/O bandwidth of high-performance storage devices, named AGNES is proposed.

2601.01835.tldr: The RSwinV2 vector has thus proved its validity as a computer-assisted tool for Mpox lesion observation interpretation by employing the RSwinV2 tool-assisted vision approach.

2601.01887.tldr: This work shows that safety alignment can be fully recovered with only a single safety example, without sacrificing utility and at minimal cost, and convergence is achieved within just a few epochs.

2601.01896.tldr: This work proposes a novel fine-tuning method designed to enhance the model's ability to distinguish between relevant and irrelevant information within retrieved documents, and significantly improves the robustness and performance of LLMs.

2601.02285.tldr: This paper presents pdfQA, a multi-domain 2K human-annotated (real-pdfQA) and 2K synthetic dataset differentiating QA pairs in ten complexity dimensions, and answers the questions with open-source LLMs, revealing existing challenges that correlate with the authors' complexity dimensions.

2601.02409.tldr: A dual-framework solution: Expert-Guided Explainable Few-Shot Learning (EG-FSL) and Explainability-Guided Active Learning (EG-AL) that introduces iterative sample acquisition prioritizing both predictive uncertainty and attention misalignment, creating a closed-loop framework where explainability guides training and sample selection synergistically.

2601.02422.tldr: The CoCoT (Collaborative Coross-modal Thought) framework is proposed, built upon two key innovations: a) Dynamic Multi-Region Grounding to adaptively detect the most relevant image regions based on the question, and b) Relation-Aware Reasoning to enable multi-region collaboration by iteratively aligning visual cues to form a coherent and logical chain of thought.

2601.02437.tldr: TAP-ViTs is introduced, a novel task-adaptive pruning framework that generates device-specific pruned ViT models without requiring access to any raw local data, and a dual-granularity importance evaluation-based pruning strategy that jointly measures composite neuron importance and adaptive layer importance, enabling fine-grained, task-aware pruning tailored to each device's computational budget.

2601.02440.tldr: This work proposes a novel importance-weighted loss function that incorporates importance sampling to align the distribution of anomaly scores with a target Gaussian, ensuring a balanced representation of normal data.

2601.02441.tldr: Compared with existing BIQA models with three paradigms designed to learn the image-text-score relationship, the Self-Consistency paradigm significantly reduces the gap between image- and text-conditioned predictions, narrowing the PLCC/SRCC difference to 0.02/0.03.

2601.02443.tldr: For domain-specific medical classification, LLMs are more effective as interpreters and report generators rather than as primary classifiers, and the MLLM architecture appears less suitable for medical image diagnostic classification tasks that demand high certainty.

2601.02444.tldr: Diffusion-Bridge (VocalBridge), a purification framework that learns a latent mapping from perturbed to clean speech in the EnCodec latent space, and introduces a Whisper-guided phoneme variant that incorporates lightweight temporal guidance without requiring ground-truth transcripts.

2601.02451.tldr: It is proved that mHC-GNN exhibits exponentially slower over-smoothing, and can distinguish graphs beyond 1-WL, than standard GNNs, while mHC-GNN maintains over 74\% accuracy even at 128 layers, with improvements exceeding 50 percentage points at extreme depths.

2601.02454.tldr: Empirical evaluations on microservice based applications show up to a 60% reduction in invalid tests, 30% coverage improvement, and significantly reduced human effort compared to single-model baselines demonstrating that multi-agent, feedback-driven loops can evolve software testing into an autonomous, continuously learning quality assurance ecosystem for self-healing, high-reliability codebases.

2601.02500.tldr: I-GEM is introduced: a fixed-budget, GPU-resident dual projected-gradient approximation to GEM's quadratic projection, which constraining non-interference solely within the adapter parameters preserves GEM-like stability with orders-of-magnitude lower mean projection overhead.

2601.02504.tldr: An AI-powered debugging assistant integrated into an IDE that offers real-time support by analyzing code, suggesting breakpoints, and providing contextual hints, and a three-level evaluation highlights its potential for teaching debugging.

2601.02514.tldr: This work presents a novel XRL framework for generating textual explanations, converting them into a set of transparent rules, improving their quality, and evaluating them, and addresses the limitations of an existing method, Autonomous Policy Explanation.

2601.02531.tldr: A new topological loss is presented that represents ingredient lists as point clouds in embedding space, minimizing the divergence between predicted and gold ingredients, and significantly improves ingredient- and action-level metrics.

2601.02554.tldr: Analysis of millions of LinkedIn profiles and university syllabi finds that graduates taking more AI-exposed curricula had higher first-job pay and shorter job searches after ChatGPT, which point to forces pre-dating generative AI and to the ongoing value of LLM-relevant education.

2601.02573.tldr: LendNova establishes a baseline for intelligent credit risk agents, demonstrating the feasibility of language models in this domain and lays the groundwork for future research toward foundation systems that enable more accurate, adaptable, and automated financial decision-making.

2601.02574.tldr: Probabilistic Certainty and Consistency (PCC) is introduced, a framework that estimates factual confidence by jointly modeling an LLM's probabilistic certainty and reasoning consistency and demonstrates that PCC generalizes well across various LLMs.

2601.02577.tldr: Oorstral is introduced, a lightweight Python framework that provides a unified, type-safe interface for building LLM agents across major providers while preserving the simplicity required for scientific computing and production deployment.

2601.02580.tldr: A novel approach that implicitly models these psychometric properties by fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) to simulate student responses across a spectrum of latent abilities, which seems particularly effective at modeling item discrimination.

2601.02589.tldr: This work proposes FlowPlan-G2P, a novel framework that mirrors the cognitive workflow of expert drafters by reformulating this task into three stages, establishing a new paradigm for paper-to-patent generation and advances structured text generation for specialized domains.

2601.02594.tldr: This work introduces a fast distillation strategy to transfer the strengths of pre-trained diffusion models into multi-scale EBMs, which enable efficient sampling and preserve the interpretability and compositionality inherent to potential-based frameworks.

2601.02609.tldr: This work presents Chronicals, an open-source training framework achieving 3.51x speedup over Unsloth through four synergistic optimizations, and provides complete mathematical foundations: online softmax correctness proofs, FlashAttention IO complexity bounds O(N^2 d^2 M^{-1}), LoRA+ learning rate derivations from gradient magnitude analysis, and bin-packing approximation guarantees.

2601.02618.tldr: The results suggest the brain employs scale-invariant, sequential priors—coding “what” happened “when”—making recurrent networks with such priors particularly well-suited to describe human cognition.

2601.02632.tldr: This paper introduces TAAF (Trace Abstraction and Analysis Framework), a novel approach that combines time-indexing, knowledge graphs (KGs), and large language models (LLMs) to transform raw trace data into actionable insights.

2601.02636.tldr: Neural manifold noise correlation (NMNC) is proposed, which performs credit assignment using perturbations restricted to the neural manifold and shows theoretically and empirically that the Jacobian row space aligns with the neural manifold in trained networks, and that manifold dimensionality scales slowly with network size.

2601.02641.tldr: Through extensive experiments, this paper investigates two key issues that must be addressed to deploy on-device models in real-world services: the selection of on-device models and the resource consumption of each model, and the capability and potential of on-device models for domain adaptation.

2601.02643.tldr: This work proposes three LLM-based methods to infer relative constraint importance from dialogue and introduces AWARE-US, a benchmark of 120+ persona-grounded queries requiring agents to resolve infeasibility in a way consistent with persona-implied preferences.

2601.02646.tldr: This work presents DreamLoop, a controllable video synthesis framework dedicated to generating cinemagraphs from a single photo without requiring any cinemagraph training data, and is the first method to enable cinemagraph generation for general scenes with flexible and intuitive controls.

2601.02648.tldr: This work introduces a problem-level prioritization framework for RL post-training of large language models that offers a principled and scalable alternative to manually designed curricula while aligning data selection directly with the dynamics of GRPO-based post-training.

2601.02663.tldr: The findings highlight the need for task-specific, cost-aware choices of both model size and agent/tooling complexity in large large language models.

2601.02666.tldr: GTL-CIRL is presented, a closed-loop framework that simultaneously learns policies and mines Causal Graph Temporal Logic (Causal GTL) specifications, and uses Gaussian Process (GP) driven Bayesian optimization to refine parameterized cause templates.

2601.02671.tldr: This work investigates whether extraction of (in-copyright) training data remains a risk for production LLMs using a two-phase procedure, and measures extraction success with a score computed from a block-based approximation of longest common substring (nv-recall).

2601.02682.tldr: Theoretical results reveal that the learning errors of robust aggregators depend on the network topology, whereas the performance of weighted mean aggregator is topology-independent, whereas the performance of robust aggregators under sufficient heterogeneity is topology-independent.

2601.02683.tldr: The Hierarchical Attribution Prompt Optimization (HAPO) framework is proposed, which introduces three innovations: a dynamic attribution mechanism targeting error patterns in training data and prompting history, semantic-unit optimization for editing functional prompt segments, and multimodal-friendly progression supporting both end-to-end LLM and LLM-MLLM workflows.

2601.02688.tldr: Experiments show that the M2Former outperforms the neural beamformer, MCT, dual-path RNN with transform-average-concatenate and multi-channel deep clustering based end-to-end systems by 9.2%, 14.3%, 24.9%, and 52.2% respectively in terms of relative word error rate reduction.

2601.02700.tldr: This is the first work integrating comprehensive linguistic error analysis with Named Entity Recognition (NER)-guided contrastive learning for adversarial QA, demonstrating that targeted mitigation can achieve near-parity between clean and adversarial performance.

2601.02702.tldr: It is shown that learning signals can be derived from user simulator behavior in MultiSessionCollab to train agents to generate more comprehensive reflections and update their memory more effectively and conduct a human user study that demonstrates that memory helps improve user experience in real-world settings.

2601.02714.tldr: Time-Scaling refers to architectural design utilizing extended temporal pathways, enabling deeper problem space exploration, dynamic strategy adjustment, and enhanced metacognitive control, paralleling human sequential reasoning under cognitive constraints.

2601.02720.tldr: A privacy-preserving, AI-enabled decentralized LER system that supports secure education and employment credentialing, robust transcript verification, and automated, privacy-preserving skill extraction within a decentralized framework is proposed.

2601.02727.tldr: A dynamic patch selection strategy is designed that, for each image, either selects the most informative patch from multiple candidates or directly resizes the full image when the foreground dominates, preserving more key information about the main objects while reducing redundant background content.

2601.02732.tldr: A comprehensive study of how Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) localize the root causes of failures, drawing insights from professionals across multiple organizations reveals that expert root cause analysis exhibits three key characteristics: recursiveness, multi-dimensional expansion, and cross-modal reasoning.

2601.02736.tldr: Preliminary experiments on the AIOps 2022 dataset demonstrate that SpecRCA achieves superior accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches, highlighting its potential as a practical solution for scalable and interpretable RCA in complex microservice environments.

2601.02749.tldr: This chapter examines the emergence of agentic AI systems that integrate planning, memory, tool use, and iterative reasoning to operate autonomously in complex environments, identifying capabilities that enable agentic behavior: long-range reasoning, contextual awareness, and adaptive decision-making.

2601.02751.tldr: This work introduces WBC (Window-Based Comparison), which exploits that membership signals are more pronounced within localized contexts through a sliding window approach with sign-based aggregation, and reveals that aggregating localized evidence is fundamentally more effective than global averaging.

2601.02764.tldr: Post-training of pre-trained LLMs are conducted to make personalized artwork recommendations, selecting the most preferred visual representation of a title for each user and thereby improving user satisfaction and engagement.

2601.02776.tldr: Subjective and objective experimental results demonstrate that UniSRCodec achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance among cross-domain single-codebook codecs with only a token rate of 40, and its reconstruction quality is comparable to that of certain multi-codebook methods.

2601.02814.tldr: This work presents a causal graph-enhanced retrieval-augmented generation system integrating explicit causal reasoning with dual-level knowledge graphs, and demonstrates transferable principles for trustworthy medical AI and causal reasoning's potential for high-stakes healthcare.

2601.02837.tldr: SEF-DETR is proposed, a novel framework that refines query initialization for IRSTD and achieves superior detection performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, delivering a robust and efficient solution for infrared small target detection task.

2601.02845.tldr: TiMem is a temporal--hierarchical memory framework that organizes conversations through a Temporal Memory Tree (TMT), enabling systematic memory consolidation from raw conversational observations to progressively abstracted persona representations.

2601.02850.tldr: A neuro-symbolic DRL approach that integrates background symbolic knowledge to improve sample efficiency and generalization to more challenging, unseen tasks and shows improved performance over a state-of-the-art reward machine baseline.

2601.02854.tldr: M3MAD-Bench is introduced, a unified and extensible benchmark for evaluating MAD methods across Multi-domain tasks, Multi-modal inputs, and Multi-dimensional metrics, and believes M3MAD-Bench offers a reliable foundation for future research on standardized MAD evaluation.

2601.02872.tldr: Evaluating 46 widely used long-context LLMs on LongBench Pro yields three findings: long-context optimization contributes more to long-context comprehension than parameter scaling, and the"thinking"paradigm helps primarily models trained with native reasoning, while mixed-thinking designs offer a promising Pareto trade-off.

2601.02880.tldr: ReTreVal (Reasoning Tree with Validation), a hybrid framework that integrates Tree-of-Thoughts exploration, self-refinement, LLM-based critique scoring, and reflexion memory to enable bounded and validated multi-step reasoning, is proposed.

2601.02902.tldr: Neuro-Symbolic Curriculum Tuning is proposed, a principled framework that adaptively aligns natural language with logical symbols to establish a shared representation, and reshapes training dynamics around phase-transition boundaries to progressively strengthen reasoning at increasing logical depths.

2601.02908.tldr: TA-Prompting is proposed, which enhances VideoLLMs via Temporal Anchors that learn to precisely localize events and prompt the VideoLLMs to perform temporal-aware video event understanding, yielding superior performance on dense video captioning and temporal understanding tasks including moment retrieval and temporalQA.

2601.02917.tldr: Retrieval-Augmented Learning-to-Match (RAL2M) is introduced, a novel framework that eliminates generation hallucination by repositioning LLMs as query-response matching judges within a retrieval-based system, providing a robust alternative to purely generative approaches.

2601.02924.tldr: To disentangle heterogeneous quality-distributed modal data without mutual interference, the Dynamic Confidence-based Disentangling Weighting (DCDW) mechanism is designed: dynamically reweighting three-modal contributions via interaction-derived modal confidence to build a disentangled fusion framework.

2601.02941.tldr: SastBench is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating SAST triage agents that combines real CVEs as true positives with filtered SAST tool findings as approximate false positives and features an agent-agnostic design.

2601.02950.tldr: Batch-of-Thought (BoT), a training-free method that processes related queries jointly to enable cross-instance learning, is introduced, a training-free method that processes related queries jointly to enable cross-instance learning.

2601.02968.tldr: This work proposes the rationale-grounded in-context learning for time series reasoning, where rationales work as guiding reasoning units rather than post-hoc explanations, and develops the RationaleTS method, which induces label-conditioned rationales.

2601.02972.tldr: This work proposes a multi-stage efficient reasoning method that combines supervised fine-tuning -- via rejection sampling or reasoning trace reformatting -- with reinforcement learning using an adaptive length penalty and introduces a lightweight reward function that penalizes tokens generated after the first correct answer but encouraging self-verification only when beneficial.

2601.02978.tldr: A Sparse Autoencoder-based framework for retrieving and steering semantically interpretable internal features associated with high-level linguistic behaviors, which suggests that LLMs internalize deeply integrated representations of high-order concepts, and provide a novel, robust mechanistic path for the regulation of complex AI behaviors.

2601.02983.tldr: Frequency Time-Group Relative Policy Optimization (FT-GRPO), a two-stage training paradigm that cold-starts ALLMs with SFT and then applies GRPO under rule-based frequency-time constraints is proposed, demonstrating that FT-GRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance on all-type ADD while producing interpretable, FT-grounded rationales.

2601.02987.tldr: This work proposes LAMS-Edit, an extensible framework that supports precise editing with region masks and enables style transfer via LoRA because latent representations and attention maps from both processes are combined at each step using weighted interpolation, controlled by a scheduler.

2601.02988.tldr: This study compared ULS and ULS+ using the Dice score and robustness to click-point location on the ULS23 Challenge test data and a subset of the Longitudinal-CT dataset and found that ULS+ significantly outperformed ULS.

2601.02994.tldr: View-Invariant Latent Action (VILA) is proposed, which models a latent action capturing transition patterns across trajectories to learn view-invariant representations grounded in physical dynamics.

2601.03005.tldr: This work proposes JPU, which is the first to rectify dynamic jailbreak paths towards safety anchors by dynamically mining on-policy adversarial samples to expose vulnerabilities and identify jailbreak paths.

2601.03014.tldr: SentGraph is proposed, a sentence-level graph-based RAG framework that explicitly models fine-grained logical relationships between sentences for multi-hop question answering and validates the importance of explicitly modeling sentence-level logical dependencies for multi-hop reasoning.

2601.03015.tldr: SPICE, a Bayesian ICRL method that learns a prior over Q-values via deep ensemble and updates this prior at test-time using in-context information through Bayesian updates, achieves near-optimal decisions on unseen tasks, substantially reduces regret compared to prior ICRL and meta-RL approaches while rapidly adapting to unseen tasks and remaining robust under distribution shift.

2601.03018.tldr: Dementia-R1 is introduced, an RL-based framework for longitudinal dementia prognosis from unstructured clinical notes that adopts a Cold-Start RL strategy that pre-trains the model to predict verifiable clinical indices extracted from patient histories, enhancing the capability to reason about disease progression before determining the final clinical status.

2601.03032.tldr: Causal Manifold Fairness is introduced, a novel framework that bridges causal inference and geometric deep learning and effectively disentangles sensitive geometric warping while preserving task utility, offering a rigorous quantification of the fairness-utility trade-off via geometric metrics.

2601.03038.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed two-layer validation framework effectively uncovers failure cases in the NVIDIA GR00T controller, demonstrating its promise for validating general-purpose robot autonomy.

2601.03040.tldr: PiDR is proposed, a physics-informed inertial dead-reckoning framework for autonomous platforms in situations of pure inertial navigation that offers transparency by explicitly integrating inertial navigation principles into the network training process through the physics-informed residual component.

2601.03046.tldr: DFRCP enhances the YOLOv11 feature pyramid by combining large scale and medium scale features while preserving native representations, and by introducing Dynamic Robust Switch units that adaptively inject fuzzy features to strengthen global perception under jitter.

2601.03048.tldr: It is proved that constant-depth ViTs with polynomial precision are strictly bounded by $\mathsf{TC^0}$, and established a complexity boundary: constant-depth ViTs fundamentally lack the logical depth to efficiently capture non-solvable spatial structures.

2601.03062.tldr: An explainable GNN framework that integrates mutual information to identify critical network regions and fuzzy logic to provide clear, rule-based explanations for node classification tasks is proposed that could enable hydraulic engineers to validate predicted leak locations, conserve human resources, and optimize maintenance strategies.

2601.03066.tldr: This work proposes greedy pruning, a likelihood-preserving deletion procedure that iteratively removes reasoning tokens whose removal minimally degrades model likelihood under a specified objective, yielding length-controlled reasoning chains.

2601.03067.tldr: Joint encoding of KV-cache blocks is proposed, which fuses similar blocks across requests and input chunks into shared representations while preserving standard cache structure, which alleviates the KV-cache memory bottleneck, supporting high-concurrency serving without specialized hardware.

2601.03089.tldr: Grad-ELLM, a gradient-based attribution method for decoder-only transformer-based LLMs, and two faithfulneses metrics that provide fairer comparisons by controlling the amount of information kept when perturbing the text are introduced.

2601.03103.tldr: This study model heterogeneity in humor preferences in Oogiri, a Japanese creative response game, by clustering users with voting logs and estimating cluster-specific weights over interpretable preference factors using Bradley-Terry-Luce models and finds that user clusters exhibit distinct preference patterns.

2601.03117.tldr: The organization of newborn visual systems emerges spontaneously when transformers adapt to a prenatal visual world, which suggests that brains and transformers learn in common ways and follow the same general fitting principles.

2601.03120.tldr: This paper draws on emerging guidance for both Digital Twin development and the use of Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning in Air Traffic Management (ATM) to present an assurance framework, and leverages a methodology known as Trustworthy and Ethical Assurance (TEA) to develop an assurance case.

2601.03121.tldr: ToxiGAN is proposed, a class-aware text augmentation framework that combines adversarial generation with semantic guidance from large language models (LLMs) and introduces a two-step directional training strategy and leverages LLM-generated neutral texts as semantic ballast.

2601.03124.tldr: A web application using Streamlit with a heatmap visualization and prediction with confidence level for robust grape leaf disease classification is deployed and Adversarial Training is used for robustness, along with more transparency.

2601.03127.tldr: This work proposes Unified Thinker, a task-agnostic reasoning architecture for general image generation, designed as a unified planning core that can plug into diverse generators and workflows, and introduces a two-stage training paradigm.

2601.03136.tldr: A systematic dataset audit of several widely used VLA corpora is presented, aiming to characterize what kinds of instructions these datasets actually contain and how much linguistic variety they provide, and quantifies instruction language along complementary dimensions.

2601.03159.tldr: This work introduces RATS (Rapid Augmentations for Time Series), a high-performance library for time series augmentation written in Rust with Python bindings (RATSpy), which implements multiple augmentation methods spanning basic transformations, frequency-domain operations and time warping techniques through a unified pipeline interface with built-in parallelisation.

2601.03181.tldr: This work discusses FMs-enabled multi-modal contextual information understanding in wireless networks, especially multi-modal FMs in wireless networks, and explains how FMs can be applied to prediction and control tasks, respectively.

2601.03191.tldr: AnatomiX is introduced, a multitask multimodal large language model for anatomically grounded chest X-ray interpretation that achieves superior anatomical reasoning and delivers over 25% improvement in performance on anatomy grounding, phrase grounding, grounded diagnosis and grounded captioning tasks compared to existing approaches.

2601.03199.tldr: This work proposes DIP, a context-optimization method that dynamically selects and inserts in-context examples during generation, rather than providing all examples in the prompt upfront, and shows DIP maintains generation quality while achieving up to 12.9% inference speedup over standard inference and 1.17% over KV cache-enhanced inference.

2601.03201.tldr: A "scalar" restriction of functional fixpoint logic is proposed, of polynomial-time data complexity, and it can express all PTIME model-agnostic queries over reduced networks with polynomially bounded weights, and it is shown that very simple model-agnostic queries are already NP-complete.

2601.03203.tldr: This work proposes CF with Graph Uncertainty (CF-GU), a bias evaluation procedure that incorporates the uncertainty of specifying a causal graph into CF, a bias evaluation procedure that incorporates the uncertainty of specifying a causal graph into CF.

2601.03204.tldr: InfiAgent is presented, a general-purpose framework that keeps the agent's reasoning context strictly bounded regardless of task duration by externalizing persistent state into a file-centric state abstraction.

2601.03205.tldr: This work proposes UltraLogic, a framework that decouples the logical core of a problem from its natural language expression through a Code-based Solving methodology to automate high-quality data production and introduces the Bipolar Float Reward mechanism, utilizing graded penalties to effectively distinguish perfect responses from those with logical flaws.

2601.03211.tldr: This work proposes an efficient approach to fine-tune small language models for accurate relevance labeling, enabling high-throughput, domain-specific labeling comparable or even better in quality to that of state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs).

2601.03222.tldr: The Fake Friend Dilemma is developed, a sociotechnical condition in which users place trust in AI agents that appear supportive while pursuing goals that are misaligned with the user's own.

2601.03227.tldr: AGL1K is introduced, the first audio geo-localization benchmark for audio language models (ALMs), spanning 72 countries and territories and it is found that closed-source models substantially outperform open-source models, and that linguistic clues often dominate as a scaffold for prediction.

2601.03232.tldr: RADSet provides a radiologist-verified synthetic multi-RADS benchmark; large SLMs (20-32B) can approach proprietary-model performance under guided prompting, but gaps remain for higher-complexity schemes.

2205.07266.tldr: A novel graph rewiring approach based on interaction patterns learned by GNNs to adjust each node's receptive fields dynamically is proposed, which proves the effectiveness of the algorithm in alleviating the representation bottleneck and its superiority in enhancing the performance of GNNs over state-of-the-art graph rewiring baselines.

2304.03906.tldr: An instructive learning algorithm named InstructMol is presented to measure pseudo-labels'reliability and help the target model leverage large-scale unlabeled data and does not require transferring knowledge between multiple domains, which avoids the potential gap between the pretraining and fine-tuning stages.

2305.16203.tldr: This paper proposes universal plans, also known as policies, as the solution concept, and implements a system based on Answer Set Programming (ASP) to compute them, and demonstrates how users can customize action preferences to compute more efficient policies, even (near-)optimal ones.

2407.19204.tldr: The results show that the TEAI index is positively correlated with cognitive, problem-solving, and management skills, while it is negatively correlated with social skills, suggesting that AI and humans complement each other within the same occupation, while the allocation of tasks within occupations is likely to change.

2410.03296.tldr: It is found that alignment between self-explanations and human rationales highly depends on text length and task complexity, whereas post-hoc attribution methods tend to emphasize structural and formatting tokens, reflecting fundamentally different explanation strategies.

2410.03560.tldr: A qualitative evaluation from legal experts indicating that this work has potential to become a foundation for real-world AI tools supporting professionals in the Danish legal sector is indicated.

2410.08925.tldr: This work provides a comprehensive analysis of prototype formulations, comparing point-based and probabilistic approaches in both Euclidean and hyperspherical latent spaces, and introduces HyperPG, a probabilistic prototype representation using Gaussian distributions on hyperspheres.

2411.02478.tldr: It is argued that AI systems particularly struggle with metacognition; improved metacognition would lead to AI more robust to novel environments, explainable to users, cooperative with others, and safer in risking fewer misaligned goals with human users.

2411.05894.tldr: This work introduces Simply-Scalable Speculative Decoding (SSSD), a training-free method that combines lightweight n-gram matching with hardware-aware speculation that achieves performance on par with leading training-based approaches across a broad range of benchmarks, while requiring substantially lower adoption effort.

2411.12460.tldr: This paper systematically explores the controllability of LLMs, and proposes a guide-to-explain framework (GTE) for controllable summarization that enables the model to identify misaligned attributes in the initial draft and guides it in self-explaining errors in the previous output.

2412.04416.tldr: This work introduces an adaptive loss function for client-side training, meticulously crafted to preserve previously acquired knowledge while maintaining an optimal equilibrium between local optimization and global model coherence, and develops a dynamic aggregation strategy for aggregating client models at the server.

2502.04066.tldr: Size-dependent Mutual Information is proposed, an information-theoretic predictor that integrates knowledge frequency, knowledge specificity, and model size to forecast closed-book question answering (QA) accuracy and provides evidence for an intrinsic upper bound on knowledge retention achievable by pre-training alone, motivating retrieval and other augmentation strategies.

2502.06684.tldr: This work designs a fully target-equivariant architecture-ensuring permutation invariance via equivariant encoders, decoders, and a bi-attention mechanism for tabular data models and shows that its model matches or surpasses existing methods while incurring lower computational overhead.

2502.20408.tldr: Inspired by research on functional brain networks in the field of neuroscience, similar methodologies estabilished in FBN analysis are utilized to explore the "functional networks" within LLMs in this study and reveal that these functional networks are indispensable for LLM performance.

2503.23314.tldr: SPIO (Sequential Plan Integration and Optimization) is a framework that replaces rigid workflows with adaptive, multi-path planning across four core modules: data preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter tuning.

2504.01216.tldr: The findings highlight the potential of domain-adapted embeddings and LLMs for scalable screening while underscoring the need for improved detection of nuanced presentations and offering insights for developing clinically viable AI tools for PTSD assessment.

2504.16942.tldr: This paper introduces S2Vec, a novel self-supervised framework for learning effective general-purpose geospatial representations of the built environment features it is provided, and how it can complement other data modalities in geospatial artificial intelligence.

2504.18882.tldr: This review consolidates machine learning methodologies that operate on the SPD manifold under a unified framework termed SPD matrix learning, which brings conceptual clarity across multiple modalities, establishes continuity with decades of geometric statistics in neuroimaging, and positions SPD modeling as a methodological bridge between classical analysis and emerging AI-driven paradigms.

2505.11830.tldr: This work proposes VISTA, a training-free framework designed to align perception with logical deduction, which outperforms its base model by 9.3% on Egochema and 5.6% on VideoEspresso, rivalling or even surpassing larger and proprietary models.

2505.15553.tldr: This work performs a content analysis and quantitative analysis of benchmark papers to learn who is involved in the benchmark creation, whether the benchmarks exhibit social bias, or whether this is addressed or prevented, and whether the demographics of the creators and annotators correspond to particular biases in the content.

2505.15722.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive study of Memorization in Multilingual Large Language Models (MLLMs), analyzing 95 languages using models across diverse model scales, architectures, and memorization definitions, and proposes a novel graph-based correlation metric that incorporates language similarity to analyze cross-lingual memorization.

2505.20707.tldr: These findings demonstrate that safe educational AI requires evaluation paradigms that prioritize reasoning fidelity over final-answer correctness, and that safe educational AI requires evaluation paradigms that prioritize reasoning fidelity over final-answer correctness.

2505.21318.tldr: This work introduces ChemCoTBench, a reasoning framework that bridges molecular structure understanding with arithmetic-inspired operations, including addition, deletion, and substitution, to formalize chemical problem-solving into transparent, step-by-step workflows.

2506.03997.tldr: A Conditional Answer Set Programming framework (Conditional ASP) for the definition of conditional extensions of Answer Set Programming (ASP) based on a conditional logic with typicality, and on the combination of a conditional knowledge base with an ASP program, which allows for conditional reasoning over the answer sets of the program.

2506.06303.tldr: This work demonstrates that, surprisingly, RL emerges during the inference time of large language models (LLMs), a phenomenon the authors term in-context RL (ICRL), and introduces a simple multi-round prompting framework, called ICRL prompting, for inference-time self-improvement.

2506.06485.tldr: The findings reveal that context-memory conflict is inherently task-dependent and motivate task-aware approaches to balancing context and memory in LLM deployment and evaluation.

2506.08726.tldr: This paper presents an improved critic agent, along with the calculator agent, which outperforms the previous state-of-the-art approach (program-of-thought) and is safer, and investigates how the agents interact with each other, and how this interaction affects their performance.

2506.12227.tldr: The results demonstrate that LLM-guided methods, including the active, dynamically scored variant, outperform baselines in recovering fairness-relevant structure under noisy conditions and analyze when LLM-driven insights complement statistical dependencies and discuss implications for fairness auditing in high-stakes domains.

2506.17776.tldr: This paper introduces a novel approach that integrates the outputs of various machine learning models directly with the PyReason framework, an open-world temporal logic programming reasoning engine, to create a powerful system for automating complex processes.

2506.19573.tldr: A hybrid approach that integrates ASP-derived rules from the FOLD-R++ algorithm with black-box ML classifiers to selectively correct uncertain predictions and provide human-readable explanations is proposed.

2507.03929.tldr: This paper introduces an answer set programming-based framework, named MUS-ASP, designed for online enumeration of MUSes, which leverages the computational efficiency of state-of-the-art ASP systems and highlights the acceleration in both MUS enumeration and counting tasks.

2507.07828.tldr: This work investigates the robustness of State-Of-The-Art content-based puzzle solvers introducing three types of jigsaw puzzle corruptions: missing pieces, eroded edges, and eroded contents.

2507.07947.tldr: A new attack is presented that requires low resources, assumes little to no access to the training data, and identifies seemingly benign prompts that can lead to potentially risky image reconstruction, and exposes a fundamental vulnerability arising from the use of scraped e-commerce data.

2507.22359.tldr: League of LLMs (LOL) is proposed, a novel benchmark-free evaluation paradigm that organizes multiple LLMs into a self-governed league for multi-round mutual evaluation and reveals empirical findings that are difficult for traditional paradigms to capture.

2508.02110.tldr: The Attractive Metadata Attack (AMA), a black-box in-context learning framework that generates highly attractive but syntactically and semantically valid tool metadata through iterative optimization, is proposed and revealed that metadata manipulation constitutes a potent and stealthy attack surface.

2508.05509.tldr: Logic-Augmented Generation is introduced, a novel paradigm that reframes knowledge augmentation through systematic question decomposition, atomic memory bank and logic-aware reasoning and improves accuracy and reduces hallucination over existing methods.

2508.15008.tldr: This survey provides a hardware-oriented perspective on neural network quantization, systematically reviewing the quantization methods most relevant to MCUs and extreme-edge devices and discusses open challenges and outline promising future directions toward scalable, energy-efficient, and sustainable AI deployment on edge devices.

2508.18609.tldr: By stratifying capabilities into memorization, application, and reasoning, a framework is developed that unifies model size, bit-width, and fine-grained factors: group size and calibration set size and highlights that in low-bit scenarios, optimizing these fine-grained factors is essential for preventing performance collapse.

2508.19614.tldr: Layer Fused Decoding (LFD), a simple decoding strategy that directly combines representations from an intermediate layer with final-layer decoding outputs to fully exploit the external factual knowledge, is proposed.

2508.21296.tldr: The results demonstrate that MyGO significantly mitigates catastrophic forgetting and maintains high average accuracy across tasks, proving the framework's effectiveness and domain-generality.

2509.01211.tldr: This paper proposes Web Fraud Attacks, a novel type of attack manipulating unique structures of web links to deceive MAS, and designs 12 representative attack variants that encompass various methods, such as homoglyph deception, sub-directory nesting, and parameter obfuscation.

2509.08269.tldr: A systematic review of recent developments in large Language Models lacks an integrative perspective that connects problem modeling with solving workflows, and highlights key limitations and point toward future directions for developing self-evolving agentic ecosystems.

2509.14803.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that OnlineMate significantly promotes deep learning and cognitive engagement by elevating students' average cognitive level while substantially improving emotional engagement scores.

2509.15577.tldr: This work proposes R2U, with a key distinction of approximating true utility through joint observation of rewriting and answering in the reasoning process, and constructs utility-improvement supervision by measuring the generator's gain of the answer under the rewritten context, yielding signals for fine-tuning and preference optimization.

2509.19695.tldr: DyBBT is proposed, a novel dialog policy learning framework that formalizes the exploration challenge through a structured cognitive state space capturing dialog progression, user uncertainty, and slot dependency and achieves state-of-the-art performance in success rate, efficiency, and generalization.

2509.19742.tldr: Hierarchical Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation (HiCoLoRA) is proposed, a framework that enhances zero-shot slot inference through robust prompt alignment and integrates Spectral Joint Domain-Slot Clustering to identify transferable associations.

2509.21799.tldr: D-Artemis leverages a fine-grained, app-specific tip retrieval mechanism to inform its decision-making process and enhances the capabilities of general-purpose Multimodal large language models for GUI tasks without the need for training on complex trajectory datasets, demonstrating strong generalization.

2509.23102.tldr: Comprehensive empirical evaluation shows that MNPO consistently outperforms existing NLHF baselines on instruction-following benchmarks, achieving superior alignment quality under heterogeneous annotator conditions and mixed-policy evaluation scenarios, and establishes MNPO as a principled and scalable framework for aligning LLMs with complex, non-transitive human preferences.

2509.24978.tldr: SciExplorer is introduced, an agent that leverages large language model tool-use capabilities to enable exploration of systems without any domain-specific blueprints, and applies it to physical systems that are initially unknown to the agent.

2509.25454.tldr: DeepSearch establishes a new direction for scaling reasoning capabilities through systematic search rather than prolonged computation, and establishes a new state-of-the-art reasoning model, while using 5.7x fewer GPU hours than extended training approaches.

2510.03998.tldr: TRACE is proposed, a semi-automated AI-assisted framework for assessing collaborative software projects that evaluates both project quality and individual contributions using repository mining, communication analytics, and AI-assisted analytics.
