2601.06700.tldr: The extent to which LLMs generate toxic content when prompted is examined, as well as the linguistic factors -- both lexical and syntactic -- that influence the production of such outputs in generative models.

2601.06701.tldr: ExCIR is introduced, a theoretically grounded, simple, and reliable metric for explaining the contribution of input features to model outputs, which remains stable and consistent under noise and sampling variations and is extended with an information theoretic foundation that unifies the correlation ratio with Canonical Correlation Analysis under mutual information bounds.

2601.06704.tldr: This paper introduces a simple yet broadly applicable trustworthiness test grounded in stochastic proof-by-contradiction, and establishes a foundation to build rigor and trust between ML and life-science research communities, moving ML models one step closer to clinical adoption.

2601.06725.tldr: The results demonstrate that pupil size normalization carried out by a modern autoencoder-based identity-preserving image-to-image translation model significantly improves verification accuracy and indicate that despite the high fidelity of modern generative models, same-eye synthetic iris images are more often judged by humans as different-eye images, compared to same-eye authentic image pairs.

2601.06733.tldr: A formal definition of MAS resilience grounded in two complementary dimensions: epistemic resilience, wherein agents recover and sustain accurate knowledge of the environment, and action resilience, wherein agents leverage that knowledge to coordinate and sustain goals under disruptions are proposed.

2601.06750.tldr: MedGaze-Bench is introduced, the first benchmark leveraging clinician gaze as a Cognitive Cursor to assess intent understanding across surgery, emergency simulation, and diagnostic interpretation, and a Three-Dimensional Clinical Intent Framework is proposed.

2601.06757.tldr: The Multi-Turn Multimodal Contextual Safety Benchmark (MTMCS-Bench) is introduced, a benchmark of realistic images and multi-turn conversations that evaluates contextual safety in MLLMs under two complementary settings, escalation-based risk and context-switch risk.

2601.06767.tldr: A Bengali mathematical reasoning model called GanitLLM is presented, together with a new difficulty-aware Bengali math corpus and a curriculum-based GRPO pipeline, which combines multi-stage training (SFT + GRPO) with difficulty-aware sampling and verifiable rewards for format, numerical correctness, and Bengali reasoning.

2601.06776.tldr: This work proposes a novel multi-agent workflow that leverages the semantic understanding capabilities of large language models and enables iterative interactions with chemical process simulation software, achieving end-to-end automated simulation from textual process specifications to computationally validated software configurations for design enhancement.

2601.06780.tldr: A hybrid learning model called Multi-stage Evolutionary Model Merging with Meta data driven Curriculum Learning (MEM-MCL) is proposed, to enhance the sentiment analysis in large language modeling.

2601.06781.tldr: It is demonstrated that AutoTour can deliver rich, interpretable annotations for both iconic and lesser-known landmarks, enabling a new form of interactive, context-aware exploration that bridges visual perception and geospatial understanding.

2601.06790.tldr: A 2-PC privacy-preserving inference framework that obliviously selects the extracted parameters from circuits and only computes one encrypted entry, which is referred to as Select-Then-Compute, and makes the model for private inference scale to 63 times larger while only having a 15.2% increase in end-to-end runtime.

2601.06794.tldr: This work introduces ECHO (Evolving Critic for Hindsight-Guided Optimization)}, a framework that jointly optimizes the policy and critic through a synchronized co-evolutionary loop, and addresses the challenge of learning plateaus via a saturation-aware gain shaping objective.

2601.06799.tldr: This paper introduces an Iterative Construction-Integration module that constructs candidate triples and history-conditionally integrates them to distill core triples and generate the next-hop query, and introduces Trajectory Distillation, which distills the teacher model's integration policy into a lightweight student, enabling efficient and reliable long-horizon reasoning.

2601.06800.tldr: An approach called One-Side Edge Sampling (OES) is proposed that can potentially reduce training duration as well as the effects of over-smoothing and over-fitting, and can empirically outperform backbone models in both shallow and deep architectures while also reducing training time.

2601.06801.tldr: Thinking with Deltas is proposed, a framework driven by a differential Visual Reasoning Policy that inherently bolsters visual understanding capabilities and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on both general and medical benchmarks, without requiring external annotations or auxiliary tools.

2601.06802.tldr: It is shown that strategic data augmentation can overcome resource limitations for low-resource dialects and provide a practical roadmap for developing ASR systems for low-resource Arabic dialects and other marginalized language varieties.

2601.06806.tldr: SpatialNav is introduced, a zero-shot VLN agent that integrates an agent-centric spatial map, a compass-aligned visual representation, and a remote object localization strategy for efficient navigation that significantly outperforms existing zero-shot agents and clearly narrows the gap with state-of-the-art learning-based methods.

2601.06835.tldr: A novel SAR-to-Optical (S2O) translation framework is proposed, integrating three core technical contributions that achieves superior perceptual quality and semantic consistency compared to state-of-the-art approaches.

2601.06842.tldr: This work introduces TCR (Transparent Conflict Resolution), a plug-and-play framework that makes this decision process observable and controllable and aligns with human judgements and expose temporal decision patterns.

2601.06844.tldr: Variational decomposition autoencoding (VDA), a framework that extends VAEs by incorporating a strong structural bias toward signal decomposition, is introduced, suggesting that decomposition-aware architectures can serve as robust tools for extracting structured representations from dynamic signals.

2601.06845.tldr: This work demonstrates that LLM-driven evolutionary search can effectively synthesize interpretable control policies in the form of executable code and highlights the potential of combining foundation models with evolutionary computation for synthesizing trustworthy control policies in autonomous systems.

2601.06847.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that VLMs trained with MedGround-35K consistently achieve improved referring grounding performance, enhance multi-object semantic disambiguation, and exhibit strong generalization to unseen grounding settings.

2601.06851.tldr: It is shown that large language models spontaneously develop synergistic cores -- components where information integration exceeds individual parts -- remarkably similar to those in the human brain, suggesting that synergistic information processing is a fundamental property of intelligence.

2601.06857.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed MoE-DisCo (Mixture-of-Experts with Disentangled Clustering and Coordination) method matches or even surpasses full-parameter training in performance across multiple downstream tasks, loss function, and perplexity (PPL), while reducing training cost by 47.6 percent.

2601.06861.tldr: BiasLab contributes a standardized methodology for cross-lingual and framing-sensitive bias measurement that complements intrinsic and dataset-based audits, enabling researchers and institutions to benchmark robustness and make better-informed deployment decisions.

2601.06870.tldr: The proposed DaQ-MSA (Denoising and Qualifying Diffusion Augmentations for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis) provides a robust and generalizable automated augmentation strategy for training MLLMs without any human annotation or additional supervision.

2601.06875.tldr: A proof-of-concept framework that integrates cognitive behavioral therapy with the African philosophy of Ubuntu to create a culturally sensitive, emotionally intelligent, AI-driven mental health dialogue system is introduced.

2601.06877.tldr: Turn-level personality conditioning improves policy adaptability and cumulative persuasion rewards; LLM-driven simulation enhances generalization to unseen user behaviors; and incorporating a change-of-mind penalty reduces post-agreement retractions while slightly improving donation outcomes are revealed.

2601.06884.tldr: A black-box optimization method that searches for paraphrased sequences yielding higher review scores while preserving semantic equivalence and linguistic naturalness, and finds that attacked papers exhibit increased perplexity in reviews, offering a potential detection signal, and that paraphrasing submissions can partially mitigate attacks.

2601.06911.tldr: This work establishes distributional clarity as a fundamental, trainable property underlying RL-Friendliness, and introduces a Silhouette-Aware Reweighting strategy that prioritizes low-$S$ samples during training.

2601.06914.tldr: This paper decomposes the reentrancy vulnerability detection task into four linearly independent atomic tasks: identifying external calls, identifying state updates, identifying data dependencies between external calls and state updates, and determining their data flow order.

2601.06931.tldr: A face-only counterfactual evaluation paradigm is proposed that isolates demographic effects while preserving real-image realism and underscores the necessity of controlled, counterfactual audits and highlights task design as a critical factor in evaluating social bias in multimodal models.

2601.06937.tldr: A synthetic function-calling dataset designed for mental health assistance grounded in wearable health signals such as sleep, physical activity, cardiovascular measures, stress indicators, and metabolic data, which supports research on intent grounding, temporal reasoning, and reliable function invocation in LLM-based mental health agents.

2601.06940.tldr: Experiments show that VISTA is capable of state-of-the-art imputation accuracy and computational efficiency, improving over state-of-the-art baselines by 5%-94% and reducing time cost by 51%-93%, while producing interpretable knowledge cues that benefit downstream tasks.

2601.06943.tldr: The first video deep research benchmark, VideoDR, is constructed, requiring cross-frame visual anchor extraction, interactive web retrieval, and multi-hop reasoning over joint video-web evidence and reveals the key challenges for next-generation video deep research agents.

2601.06944.tldr: Evaluations on SketchJudge demonstrate that even advanced MLLMs lag significantly behind humans, validating the benchmark's effectiveness in exposing the fragility of current vision-language alignment in symbolic and noisy contexts.

2601.06966.tldr: This work proposes a synthesis pipeline that integrates Project Foundation Construction, Multi-Agent Dialogue Generation, and Memory and Schedule Management to simulate the dynamic evolution of memory, and introduces **RealMem*, the first benchmark grounded in realistic project scenarios.

2601.06978.tldr: The Benchmarking Autonomy in Scientific Experiments (BASE) Scale is proposed, a 6-level taxonomy (Levels 0-5) specifically adapted for these unique constraints of Large-Scale User Facilities.

2601.06992.tldr: FinCards, a structured reranking framework that reframes financial evidence selection as constraint satisfaction under a finance-aware schema, and substantially improves early-rank retrieval over both lexical and LLM-based reranking baselines.

2601.07005.tldr: MicLog is presented, the first progressive meta in-context learning (ProgMeta-ICL) log parsing framework that combines meta-learning with ICL on small open-source LLMs (i.e., Qwen-2.5-3B).

2601.07006.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework for supervised LLM uncertainty quantification, learning a dedicated meta-model based on LLM Performance Predictors (LPPs) derived from LLM outputs: log-probabilities, entropy, and novel uncertainty attribution indicators.

2601.07019.tldr: This work introduces Zer0n, a framework that anchors the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models to the immutable audit trails of blockchain technology, and integrates Gemini 2.0 Pro for logic-based vulnerability detection with the Avalanche C-Chain for tamper-evident artifact logging.

2601.07023.tldr: CloneMem is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating longterm memory in AI Clone scenarios grounded in non-conversational digital traces, including diaries, social media posts, and emails, spanning one to three years.

2601.07035.tldr: This work advances the field of molecular imaging by demonstrating the potential of AI-driven radiogenomics for precision oncology, supporting non-invasive, accurate, and interpretable prediction of clinically actionable molecular biomarkers in GBM.

2601.07036.tldr: Mid-Think is proposed, a simple training-free prompting format that combines these triggers to achieve intermediate-budget reasoning, consistently outperforming fixed-token and prompt-based baselines in terms of the accuracy-length trade-off.

2601.07055.tldr: This work introduces Dr. Zero, a framework enabling search agents to effectively self-evolve without any training data, and introduces hop-grouped relative policy optimization (HRPO), a method that significantly reduces the compute requirements for solver training without compromising performance or stability.

2601.07056.tldr: A structured adversarial attack framework for MHSI that progressively models its local spectral-spatial dependencies and multiscale hierarchical representations and generates anatomically consistent perturbations by modeling neighborhood dependencies and hierarchical spectral-spatial features is proposed.

2601.07058.tldr: Semantic Stability (SS) is formalized through Paraphrase Consistency (PC@k), measured via Paraphrase Consistency (PC@k): generate k paraphrases, greedy decode each, compute mode agreement, and reveals the sweet spot where variance reduction outpaces bias accumulation, and regimes where stability collapses onto wrong answers.

2601.07062.tldr: The findings indicate that the proposed method can effectively generate educational questions and discern hierarchical relationships among them, leading to structured question maps that facilitate personalized and adaptive learning in downstream applications.

2601.07072.tldr: This work designs an efficient and effective black-box attack algorithm that constructs a compact trigger fragment to guarantee retrieval for any attack fragment and presents the first end-to-end IPI exploits under natural queries and realistic external corpora, spanning both RAG and agentic systems with diverse attack objectives.

2601.07085.tldr: This paper proposes that a significant epistemic risk from conversational AI may lie not in inaccuracy or intentional deception, but in something more fundamental: these systems may be configured, through optimization processes that make them useful, to present characteristics that bypass the cognitive mechanisms humans evolved to evaluate incoming information.

2601.07086.tldr: This paper introduces XBTorch (short for CrossBarTorch), a novel simulation framework that integrates seamlessly with PyTorch and provides specialized tools for accurately and efficiently modeling crossbar-based systems based on emerging memory technologies.

2601.07107.tldr: Across six medical VQA benchmarks, MedVistaGym-R1-8B exceeds comparably sized tool-augmented baselines by 19.10% to 24.21%, demonstrating that structured agentic training--not tool access alone--unlocks effective tool-integrated reasoning for medical image analysis.

2601.07117.tldr: This work proposes a generative co-memory regularization approach to facilitate FSCIL, which improves recognition accuracy, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting over old classes and overfitting to novel classes.

2601.07121.tldr: The results suggest that serendipitous ideation in LLMs is a rare-event process best approached through system level design that shapes the conditions under which valuable ideas can emerge and be stabilized.

2601.07122.tldr: This is the first study to establish a robust LLM-RL framework with HITL support for cloud defense, and will release the framework to the community, facilitating the advancement of robust and autonomous defense in cloud networks.

2601.07123.tldr: ENTRA is proposed, an entropy-based training framework that suppresses redundant reasoning while preserving performance in large Reasoning Models, and provides a generalizable path toward redundancy-aware reasoning optimization.

2601.07136.tldr: This paper presents the first large-scale empirical study of open-source MAS, analyzing over 42K unique commits and over 4.7K resolved issues across eight leading systems to identify three distinct development profiles: sustained, steady, and burst-driven.

2601.07149.tldr: This work develops a Generative Reward Model (GenRM) that provides multi-dimensional analysis and explicit reasoning about story preferences, and introduces an entropy-based reward shaping strategy that dynamically prioritizes learning on confident errors and uncertain correct predictions, preventing overfitting on already-mastered patterns.

2601.07153.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation of LLM capabilities in understanding, reasoning over, and generating code-switched text and a systematic evaluation of LLM-generated synthetic code-switched text, focusing on both naturalness and semantic fidelity, reveal persistent challenges in both reasoning and generation under code-switching conditions.

2601.07155.tldr: Veto is proposed, an objective-level reformulation that constructs a geometric bridge in the logit space that outperforms supervised fine-tuning and existing on-policy baselines and serves as an Adaptive Gradient Veto that stabilizes optimization by suppressing harmful gradients on low-confidence tokens, while simultaneously acting as a Decisiveness Knob to balance reward-driven performance with output diversity.

2601.07160.tldr: AscendKernelGen, a generation-evaluation integrated framework for NPU kernel development, and NPUKernelBench, a comprehensive benchmark for assessing compilation, correctness, and performance across varying complexity levels, are proposed.

2601.07177.tldr: Safe-FedLLM is a probe-based defense framework for FedLLM, which constructs defenses across three levels: Step-Level, Client-Level, and Shadow-Level, which effectively suppresses the impact of malicious data without significantly affecting training speed, and remains effective even under high malicious client ratios.

2601.07178.tldr: DIVER (Dynamic Iterative Visual Evidence Reasoning), a framework grounded in a progressive, evidence-driven reasoning paradigm, is proposed, which establishes a strong text-based baseline through language analysis and iteratively aggregates via uncertainty-aware fusion to refine multimodal reasoning.

2601.07185.tldr: These findings suggest that current prompt-injection defenses frequently respond to attack-like surface patterns rather than the underlying intent, suggesting limitations of supervised fine-tuning for reliable LLM security.

2601.07190.tldr: It is demonstrated that capable models can autonomously self-regulate their context when given appropriate tools and prompting, opening pathways for cost-aware agentic systems without sacrificing task performance.

2601.07192.tldr: Relink, a framework that dynamically builds a query-specific evidence graph that empowers Relink to actively discard distractor facts and construct the most faithful and precise evidence path for each query, is proposed.

2601.07197.tldr: Fisher-Aligned Subspace Compression (FASC), a knowledge-aware compression framework that selects subspaces by directly modeling activation-gradient coupling, minimizing a second-order surrogate of the loss function, is introduced.

2601.07199.tldr: Investigating the effect of training objective composition on reasoning reliability through Direct Preference Optimization indicates that forward and backward reasoning objectives provide distinct and complementary learning signals: forward training improves problem-solving capability, while backward training improves verification calibration.

2601.07200.tldr: Safety Optimal Transport (SOT) is introduced, a novel framework that reframes safe fine-tuning from an instance-level filtering challenge to a distribution-level alignment task grounded in Optimal Transport (OT).

2601.07201.tldr: CalPro, a prior-aware evidential-conformal framework for shift-robust uncertainty quantification, is introduced and structure-aware coverage guarantees under distribution shift using PAC-Bayesian bounds over ambiguity sets are derived.

2601.07206.tldr: LLMRouterBench is introduced, a large-scale benchmark and unified framework for LLM routing that provides comprehensive metrics for both performance-oriented routing and performance-cost trade-off routing, and integrates 10 representative routing baselines.

2601.07214.tldr: This paper proposes Blind Unlearning (BlindU), which carries out unlearning using compressed representations instead of original inputs, and introduces a noise-free differential privacy (DP) masking method to deal with the raw erasing data before compressing.

2601.07224.tldr: This work proposes PRISM, a dynamics-aware framework grounded in Schema Theory that arbitrates data based on its degree of cognitive conflict with the model's existing knowledge, and suggests that disentangling data based on internal optimization regimes is crucial for scalable and robust agent alignment.

2601.07226.tldr: NoisyBench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark that systematically evaluates model robustness across 11 datasets in RAG, reasoning, alignment, and tool-use tasks against diverse noise types, and reveals a catastrophic performance drop of up to 80% in state-of-the-art models when faced with contextual distractors.

2601.07232.tldr: FLoReNce is proposed, an agentic feedback reasoning framework that treats meme understanding as a closed-loop process during learning and an open-loop process during inference, showing that feedback-regulated prompting is a viable path to adaptive meme humor understanding.

2601.07233.tldr: This work introduces SEF (Structured Explainability Framework), operationalizing professional conventions via six metrics for structure and grounding via six metrics for structure and grounding, and suggests structured justification can improve verifiability and may also improve reliability.

2601.07238.tldr: Group Pattern Selection Optimization (GPSO), a reinforcement learning framework that extends GRPO by incorporating multi-pattern rollouts, verifier-guided optimal pattern selection per problem, and attention masking during optimization to prevent the leakage of explicit pattern suffixes into the learned policy is introduced.

2601.07239.tldr: It is argued that, for LLMs, deterministic inference kills the ability to model uncertainty, suppresses emergent abilities, collapses reasoning into a single brittle path, and weakens safety alignment by hiding tail risks.

2601.07245.tldr: Ablation and feature-importance analyses show that semantic agreement and clustering features are most influential, with reasoning-quality and model-prior features providing com- plementary gains, suggesting supervised multi-model consensus is a practical route toward more reliable LLM behavior, even in a modest single-machine setup.

2601.07250.tldr: DDT is proposed, a novel and robust deep learning framework for high-precision time-series forecasting that combines a dual-masking mechanism that synergistically combines a strict causal mask with a data-driven dynamic mask, overcoming the rigidity of traditional masking techniques.

2601.07261.tldr: O$^2$DENet provides a general and effective strategy to enhance the stability and deployability of data-driven enzyme kinetics predictors for real-world enzyme engineering applications.

2601.07263.tldr: This work reveals AgentBait as a critical new threat surface for web agents and establishes a practical, generalizable defense, advancing the security of this rapidly emerging ecosystem.

2601.07291.tldr: The VIsual Semantic Adaptive Watermark (VISA-Mark), a novel framework that embeds detectable signals while strictly preserving visual fidelity, is proposed, effectively establishing a new standard for reliability-preserving multimodal watermarking.

2601.07296.tldr: Legal Reasoning with Agentic Search (LRAS) is presented, the first framework designed to transition legal LLMs from static and parametric"closed-loop thinking" to dynamic and interactive"Active Inquiry".

2601.07304.tldr: A Heterogeneous Multi-Expert Reinforcement Learning (HMER) framework tailored for autonomous forklifts, which separates macro-level navigation from micro-level manipulation, allowing each expert to focus on its specific action space without interference.

2601.07309.tldr: Agent-Role Merging (ARM), an activation-guided, role-conditioned neuron transplantation method for model merging in LLM agents, improves existing merging methods from static natural language tasks to multi-turn agent scenarios, and over the generalization ability across various interactive environments.

2601.07313.tldr: Multivariate Conditional Expectation (MUCE) is introduced, a model-agnostic method for local explainability designed to capture prediction changes from feature interactions and provide meaningful insight into prediction confidence.

2601.07316.tldr: BEAT-Net, a Biomimetic ECG Analysis with Tokenization framework that reformulates the problem as a language modeling task, indicates that integrating biological priors offers a computationally efficient and interpretable alternative to data-intensive large-scale pre-training.

2601.07320.tldr: This work introduces Segmental Advantage Estimation (SAE), which mitigates the bias that GAE can incur in RLVR and achieves superior performance, with marked improvements in final scores, training stability, and sample efficiency.

2601.07342.tldr: This work defines an investigation protocol that structures the agent's reasoning and ensures grounding, reproducibility, and safe handling of missing or ambiguous information, and lays the foundation for autonomous incident resolution and change impact mitigation.

2601.07344.tldr: PulseMind is introduced, a new family of multi-modal diagnostic models that integrates a systematically curated dataset, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark, and a tailored training framework that achieves competitive performance on both the diagnostic consultation benchmark and public medical benchmarks.

2601.07356.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the PAM beamforming framework introduced here outperforms classical beamforming methods, providing higher temporal resolution than frequency-domain techniques while substantially reducing computational burden compared with iterative time-domain formulations.

2601.07359.tldr: Experiments conducted on both the LLaVA and Qwen-VL model families across multiple multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that DualPD consistently improves accuracy without training, confirming its effectiveness and generalizability.

2601.07364.tldr: This paper proposes the Extended Predictive Hypothesis (EPH), which views intelligence as a combination of the ability to accurately predict the future and the ability to benefit from those predictions, and presents a unified framework for explaining various aspects of intelligence.

2601.07372.tldr: This work introduces conditional memory as a complementary sparsity axis, instantiated via Engram, a module that modernizes classic $N$-gram embedding for O(1) lookup, envisioning conditional memory as an indispensable modeling primitive for next-generation sparse models.

2601.07376.tldr: OpenTinker is introduced, an infrastructure for reinforcement learning (RL) of large language model (LLM) agents built around a separation of concerns across algorithm design, execution, and agent-environment interaction that decomposes agentic learning systems into lightweight, composable components with clearly defined abstraction boundaries.

2601.07377.tldr: A new dynamic collaborative network for semi-supervised 3D vessel segmentation, termed DiCo, that allows the two models to dynamically switch their teacher-student roles and introduces a multi-view integration module to capture various perspectives of the inputs, mirroring the way doctors conduct medical analysis.

2601.07389.tldr: It is proved that decoupling is impossible in either order: (1) SFT-then-RL coupling: RL increases SFT loss under SFT optimality and (2) RL-then-SFT coupling: SFT lowers the reward achieved by RL.

2601.07392.tldr: OceanSAR-2 demonstrates strong transfer performance across downstream tasks, including geophysical pattern classification, ocean surface wind vector and significant wave height estimation, and iceberg detection.

2601.07393.tldr: Experiments across multiple ME2E autonomous driving stacks show that the proposed framework preserves baseline-level driving performance while significantly reducing inference latency and energy consumption, achieving substantial overall system-level improvements.

2601.07395.tldr: This work proposes MCP-ITP, the first automated and adaptive framework for implicit tool poisoning within the MCP ecosystem, which formulates poisoned tool generation as a black-box optimization problem and employs an iterative optimization strategy that leverages feedback from both an evaluation LLM and a detection LLM to maximize Attack Success Rate (ASR) while evading current detection mechanisms.

2601.07397.tldr: This work proposes a novel layerwise adaptive construction method based on a goal--oriented dual-weighted residual technique for the optimal control of neural differential equations that leads to an ordinary differential equation constrained optimization problem with controls acting as coefficients and a specific loss function.

2601.07411.tldr: SCALPEL (Selective Capability Ablation via Low-rank Parameter Editing for Large language models), a framework representing capabilities as low-rank parameter subspaces rather than discrete modules, offers nuanced understanding of capability encoding in LLMs.

2601.07422.tldr: It is demonstrated that truthfulness cues arise from two distinct information pathways: a Question-Anchored pathway that depends on question-answer information flow, and an Answer-Anchored pathway that derives self-contained evidence from the generated answer itself.

2601.07430.tldr: KALE (Knowledge-Aware LEarning)-a post-training framework that leverages knowledge graphs (KGs) to generate high-quality rationales and enhance LLMs' knowledge manipulation ability by internalizing rationale-guided reasoning through minimizing the KL divergence between predictions with and without rationales.

2601.07449.tldr: This work proposes Residual Listwise Preference Optimization (RLPO), which formulates ranking as listwise representation-level residual correction over a strong pointwise LLM scorer, and introduces a large-scale benchmark for long-context review ranking with human verification.

2601.07464.tldr: Iterative Feedback-Driven Neuro-Symbolic (IFDNS), a novel prompt-based method that employs a multi-round feedback mechanism to address LLM limitations in handling complex logical relationships, is introduced.

2601.07468.tldr: Temporal Semantic Memory is proposed, a memory framework that models semantic time for point-wise memory and supports the construction and utilization of durative memory and incorporates the query's temporal intent on the semantic timeline.

2601.07469.tldr: It is shown how recognition performance evolves depending on the size of the LLM used, and it is shown that fine-tuned models can perform almost as well as the largest LLMs, while having 50 times less parameters.

2601.07470.tldr: The Meta-Cognitive Memory Abstraction method (MCMA), which treats memory abstraction as a learnable cognitive skill rather than a fixed design choice, is proposed, which decouples task execution from memory management by combining a frozen task model with a learned memory copilot.

2601.07474.tldr: This work proposes a prototype-based knowledge retrieval framework that achieves robust MTL instead of relying on predictions from unlabeled tasks, and introduces an association knowledge generating (AKG) loss to ensure the task prototype consistently captures task-specific characteristics.

2601.07496.tldr: LabGraph is introduced-a unified framework that reformulates ICD coding as a graph generation task by combining adversarial domain adaptation, graph-based reinforcement learning, and perturbation regularization, which enhances model robustness and generalization.

2601.07514.tldr: This paper exploits tree-based gradient boosting trained on eight years of gas meter maintenance data to produce point predictions and uncertainty estimates, which then drive a multi-objective evolutionary optimization routine for stochastic service durations in real-world routing applications.

2601.07516.tldr: This work adopts the learning from observation mechanism to construct the codebook for the latent action space, where future observations are leveraged to estimate current latent actions that could further be used to reconstruct future observations.

2601.07518.tldr: Mon3tr is a novel Monocular 3D telepresence framework that integrates 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) based parametric human modeling into telepresence for the first time, significantly reducing system complexity and cost.

2601.07525.tldr: This work proposes a simple approach that combines the advantages of both natural and structured generation, allowing LLMs to reason freely until specific trigger tokens are generated, and then switching to structured generation to preserve the expressive power of natural language reasoning while ensuring the reliability of structured outputs.

2601.07528.tldr: ISLAMICFAITHQA, a 3,810-item bilingual (Arabic/English) generative benchmark with atomic single-gold answers, is introduced, which enables direct measurement of hallucination and abstention and develops an agentic Quran-grounding framework (agentic RAG) that uses structured tool calls for iterative evidence seeking and answer revision.

2601.07556.tldr: Backpropagation-Free Transformations (BFT) is proposed, a TTA approach for EEG decoding that enables lightweight plug-and-play BCIs on resource-constrained devices, broadening the real-world deployment of decoding algorithms for EEG-based BCI.

2601.07565.tldr: EGMF, a unified framework combining expert-guided multimodal fusion with large language models, is presented, a unified framework combining expert-guided multimodal fusion with large language models to handle both classification and regression through natural language generation.

2601.07573.tldr: A tractable economic model of AJI is developed that treats adoption as an information problem: users care about reliability but typically observe only coarse, global quality signals, and studies mastery and calibration and how scaling interacts with discoverability.

2601.07577.tldr: Results on TravelPlanner, ScienceWorld, and HotpotQA show that TDP outperforms strong baselines while reducing token consumption by up to 82%, demonstrating that sub-task decoupling improves both robustness and efficiency for long-horizon agents.

2601.07597.tldr: The Pheromone-Focused Ant Colony Optimization (PFACO) algorithm, which introduces three key strategies to enhance the problem-solving ability of the ant colony, and consistently outperforms comparative ACO algorithms in terms of convergence speed and solution quality.

2601.07606.tldr: PoT freezes a pre-cutoff snapshot of evidence in an offline sandbox and asks models to forecast post-cutoff outcomes, enabling verifiable evaluation when ground truth arrives, and supports scalable evaluation of agents on future-facing scientific idea judgment tasks.

2601.07618.tldr: Physiological State Reconstruc-tion (PSR), a new algorithm specifically designed to take advantage of dynamic changes between individuals and to max-imize useful information produced by small amounts of clini-cal data through mapping to reliable predictions and diagnosis, is presented.

2601.07638.tldr: By reframing tabular prediction as semantics-conditioned reasoning, SALT-KG establishes a benchmark to advance tabular foundation models grounded in declarative knowledge, providing the first empirical step toward semantically linked tables in structured data at enterprise scale.

2601.07641.tldr: Test-Time Tool Evolution (TTE), a new paradigm that enables agents to synthesize, verify, and evolve executable tools during inference, is proposed, which overcomes the rigidity and long-tail limitations of static tool libraries.

2601.07654.tldr: IsabeLLM, a tool that integrates the proof assistant Isabelle with a Large Language Model to assist and automate proofs is presented, and the effectiveness of IsabeLLM is demonstrated by using it to develop a novel model of Bitcoin's Proof of Work consensus protocol and verify its correctness.

2601.07666.tldr: A variational contrastive learning framework that integrates probabilistic latent modeling with contrastive self-supervised learning that enables the learning of structured and semantically meaningful representations that generalize across different datasets and supervision levels is proposed.

2601.07667.tldr: ASL, a training-free method that adaptively chooses the selection layer for KV cache reduction, exploiting the variance of token ranks ordered by attention score, outperforming state-of-the-art layer-wise token pruning methods in difficult tasks.

2601.07685.tldr: This study highlights the importance of model interpretability and the correlation of dementia with features such as the presence of the APOE-epsilon4 allele and chronic conditions like diabetes.

2601.07701.tldr: This work presents a framework where exteroceptive sensing is integrated into whole-body motion tracking, permitting a humanoid to perform highly dynamic, non-locomotion tasks on uneven terrain, and demonstrates the non-trivial benefit of integrating perception into the control loop.

2601.07718.tldr: This work presents \textit{Hiking in the Wild}, a scalable, end-to-end parkour perceptive framework designed for robust humanoid hiking, which utilizes a single-stage reinforcement learning scheme, mapping raw depth inputs and proprioception directly to joint actions, without relying on external state estimation.

2601.07737.tldr: UAIT (Uncommon-sense Action Image-Text) dataset is proposed, a new evaluation benchmark designed to test the semantic understanding ability of visual language models (VLMs) in uncommon-sense action scenes, and reveals the key weaknesses of VLMs.

2601.07748.tldr: This work presents a new method for contrastive learning that incorporates domain labels to increase the domain invariance of learned representations, leading to improved out-of-distribution generalization.

2601.07778.tldr: This work introduces DT-ICU, a multimodal digital twin framework for continuous risk estimation in intensive care that consistently outperforms established baseline models under different evaluation settings, and evaluates it on the large, publicly available MIMIC-IV dataset.

2601.07779.tldr: OS-Symphony is introduced, a holistic framework that comprises an Orchestrator coordinating two key innovations for robust automation, featuring a Reflection-Memory Agent that utilizes milestone-driven long-term memory to enable trajectory-level self-correction, effectively mitigating visual context loss in long-horizon tasks.

2601.07782.tldr: ToOLQP is a lightweight framework that models retrieval as iterative query planning, instead of single-shot matching, that decomposes instructions into sub-tasks and dynamically generates queries to interact with the retriever, effectively bridging the semantic gap by targeting the specific sub-tasks required for composition.

2601.07790.tldr: It is argued that severity classification is more informative when treated as a benchmark for probing runtime log comprehension rather than as an end task, and that architectural design, training objectives, and the ability to integrate retrieved context under strict output constraints jointly determine performance.

2601.07794.tldr: This work introduces KinshipQA, a benchmark designed to probe large language models' ability to perform multi-hop reasoning through reasoning over kinship relations, and demonstrates that KinshipQA yields a wide spread of outcomes and exposes systematic differences in multi-hop reasoning across models and cultural settings.

2601.07821.tldr: Failure-Aware Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning (FARL), a new paradigm minimizing failures during real-world reinforcement learning, is introduced and an algorithm that integrates a world-model-based safety critic and a recovery policy trained offline to prevent failures during online exploration is proposed.

2110.03684.tldr: The theory formally characterizes the scenarios where GWIL preserves optimality, revealing its possibilities and limitations and demonstrates the effectiveness of GWIL in non-trivial continuous control domains ranging from simple rigid transformation of the expert domain to arbitrary transformation ofThe state-action space.

2405.16041.tldr: This work develops a framework for explainable molecular property prediction based on language models, dubbed as Lamole, which can provide chemical concepts-aligned explanations and integrated the framework with an evolutionary algorithm, demonstrating that Lamole functions beyond simple post-hoc analysis but serves as a practical guide for molecule discovery.

2502.12119.tldr: Empirically, PRISM reduces the end-to-end time for data selection and model tuning to just 30% of conventional pipelines, and achieves this efficiency while simultaneously enhancing performance, surpassing models fine-tuned on the full dataset across eight multimodal and three language understanding benchmarks.

2502.19190.tldr: A set of provocations from humanities researchers -- currently underrepresented in AI development -- intended to inform its future applications and enrich ongoing conversations about its uses, impact, and harms are presented.

2503.03215.tldr: COSINT-Agent is introduced, a knowledge-driven multimodal agent tailored to address the challenges of OSINT in the Chinese domain and its potential as a robust and scalable solution for advancing automated multimodal reasoning and enhancing the effectiveness of OSINT methodologies is underscored.

2503.08120.tldr: A novel theoretical framework with a Dual Discrete Diffusion (D3Diff) loss is introduced, unifying masked generative models with discrete score matching diffusion and leading to a more precise approximation of the negative log-likelihood, which significantly enhances the model's ability to synthesize high-fidelity facial details aligned with text input.

2504.08999.tldr: Evaluation demonstrates that MCP Bridge successfully addresses the constraints of direct MCP connections while providing enhanced security controls and cross-platform compatibility, enabling sophisticated LLM-powered applications in previously inaccessible environments.

2505.18227.tldr: This paper argues that token reduction should transcend its traditional efficiency-oriented role in the era of large generative models and position it as a fundamental principle in generative modeling, critically influencing both model architecture and broader applications.

2505.20315.tldr: Arctic-Text2SQL-R1 is presented, a reinforcement learning framework and model family designed to generate accurate, executable SQL using a lightweight reward signal based solely on execution correctness, highlighting the framework's scalability and efficiency.

2506.11849.tldr: This work presents a new way of combining Monte Carlo sampling and linear regression formulations that is more flexible than prior algorithms, allowing for linear regression to be replaced with any function family whose probabilistic values can be computed efficiently.

2506.20993.tldr: The Machine Personality Inventory is extended to incorporate the 16 Personality Factor model, allowing expressive control over sixteen distinct traits, and a structured framework known as Specific Attribute Control (SAC) for evaluating and dynamically inducing trait intensity in LLMs is developed.

2507.02962.tldr: RAG-R1 is introduced, a novel two-stage training framework centered around multi-query parallelism that enables LLMs to adaptively leverage internal and external knowledge during the reasoning process while transitioning from the single-query mode to multi-query parallelism.

2508.04295.tldr: EvoC2Rust is proposed, an automated framework for converting complete C projects to equivalent Rust ones that combines the advantages of both rule-based and LLM-based solutions and demonstrates the superior performance of EvoC2Rust in project-level C-to-Rust translation.

2508.15807.tldr: This work introduces a mathematically grounded method for knowledge distillation via KL divergence, even when the original and extended models use different tokenizations, which allows the student model to inherit distributional knowledge from the teacher despite differing vocabularies.

2508.17627.tldr: A Reasoning Completion Point Detector (RCPD), an inference-time early-exit method that identifies the RCP by monitoring the rank dynamics of termination tokens and reduces token usage by up to 44% while preserving accuracy, offering a principled approach to efficient test-time scaling.

2509.24616.tldr: A new CPU tool called Bolt is implemented by improving over the state of the art by learning formulas more than 100x faster over 70% of the benchmarks, with smaller or equal formulas in 98% of the cases.

2510.00279.tldr: SLogic (Subgraph-Informed Logical Rule learning), a novel framework that assigns query-dependent scores to logical rules, outperforms existing rule-based methods and achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art baselines.

2510.02333.tldr: This resource is the first to combine real-world movement, structured semantic enrichment, LLM-generated text, and semantic web compatibility in a reusable framework.

2510.02369.tldr: Experiments demonstrate substantial gains: for example, the success rate of a ReAct agent on TextWorld improves from 37% to 95%, highlighting the critical role of structured instance context in efficient agentic systems.

2510.14420.tldr: This work proposes a label-free self-supervised RL framework that eliminates dependency on external supervision by deriving reward signals directly from instructions and generating pseudo-labels for reward model training, and introduces constraint decomposition strategies and efficient constraint-wise binary classification.

2510.15947.tldr: WaveNet’s architecture, originally developed for raw audio synthesis, is well-suited for iEEG data due to its use of dilated causal convolutions and residual connections, enabling it to capture both fine-grained and long-range temporal dependencies.

2510.16607.tldr: This work proposes a quaternion-valued supervised learning Hopfield-structured neural network with a fully connected structure inspired by the classic Hopfield neural network with a periodic projection strategy that modifies standard gradient descent by periodically projecting each 4*4 block of the weight matrix onto the closest quaternionic structure in the least-squares sense.

2510.21060.tldr: A theoretical study of differentially private policy optimization, focusing explicitly on its sample complexity, and demonstrates that privacy costs can often manifest as lower-order terms in the sample complexity, while also highlighting subtle yet important observations in private PO settings.

2510.22462.tldr: This paper shows how LLM agents trained using standard RLHF and related approaches are naturally inclined to ignore possibly well-meaning interventions, which makes increasing group common ground non-trivial in this setting, and proposes Interruptible Collaborative Roleplayer (ICR)-a novel partner-aware learning algorithm to train CG-optimal collaborators.

2510.27313.tldr: A three-stage framework that retrieves semantically similar samples, reranks them at varying subsequence lengths, and calibrates scores using a human novelty reference for interpretability is proposed, allowing for efficient analysis at pre-training scale.

2511.00549.tldr: A novel single-agent reinforcement learning (RL) framework for regional adaptive TSC, circumventing the coordination complexities inherent in multi-agent systems through a centralized decision-making paradigm is introduced.

2511.00551.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model effectively mitigates large-scale regional congestion levels via coordinated multi-intersection control.

2511.11966.tldr: It is proved that it is possible, if access to a black box which can fit models to predict the future entropy of text is assumed, if it is possible to reduce entropy while preserving log loss.

2511.17408.tldr: The finding that off-policy data can yield more reliable probes than on-policy data from a sufficiently different setting underscores the need for new monitoring methods that better handle all types of distribution shift.

2511.21005.tldr: Inspired by the idea of preference modeling, ICPO calculates a preference advantage score for each response by comparing the relative generation probabilities of multiple responses under the same input prompt, and integrates this score with verifiable rewards to guide the exploration process.

2512.04559.tldr: Soft Q-based Diffusion Finetuning (SQDF) is proposed, a novel KL-regularized RL method for diffusion alignment that applies a reparameterized policy gradient of a training-free, differentiable estimation of the soft Q-function to mitigate over-optimization.

2512.18209.tldr: This work identifies a set of sufficient conditions under which the GRSD shell dynamics admits a renormalizable coarse--grained description, and shows that power--law scaling does not follow from renormalizability alone, but instead arises as a rigidity consequence once log--shift invariance is combined with the intrinsic time--rescaling covariance of gradient flow.

2512.23130.tldr: Quantitative and qualitative evaluations on tumor imaging benchmarks demonstrate that PathoSyn significantly outperforms holistic diffusion and mask-conditioned baselines in both perceptual realism and anatomical fidelity.

2512.25026.tldr: The Thought Gestalt model is introduced, a recurrent transformer that models language at two levels of abstraction: tokens and sentence-level"thought"states, and consistently improves data and parameter efficiency compared to matched GPT-2 runs and other baselines.

2601.02371.tldr: The manifest establishes a compliance framework that enables beneficial agent interactions while respecting site owners'preferences, and complementing data use initiatives such as AIPref.

2601.06093.tldr: Evaluation findings show that the GenAITEd Ghana system effectively enacted key Responsible AI principles, including transparency, accountability, cultural responsiveness, privacy, and human oversight, as well as promoting student engagement while preserving educators' professional authority.

2601.06227.tldr: DLNet is a practical framework with dual-stage distillation of liquid neural networks that turns a high-capacity model into compact and edge-deployable models for battery health prediction and can extend to other industrial analytics tasks with strict hardware constraints.

2601.07838.tldr: There are average 80-95% improvement on search when use RAG based chatbot than using standard search, and the results conclude that RAG-based chatbots not only save time in information retrieval but also optimize the search process effectively.

2601.07839.tldr: Experiments on LLaMA-7B show that targeting only the self-attention projections suffices to yield large memory savings while retaining comparable state-of-the-art perplexity scores on test samples of the WikiText dataset.

2601.07853.tldr: FinVault is proposed, the first execution-grounded security benchmark for financial agents, comprising 31 regulatory case-driven sandbox scenarios with state-writable databases and explicit compliance constraints, together with 107 real-world vulnerabilities and 963 test cases that systematically cover prompt injection, jailbreaking, financially adapted attacks, as well as benign inputs for false-positive evaluation.

2601.07855.tldr: This work proposes the RObust Autonomous driving under Dataset shifts (ROAD) benchmark, a comprehensive evaluation suite for LiDAR-based object classification that explicitly accounts for domain shifts as well as three key forms of label evolution: class split, class expansion, and class insertion.

2601.07856.tldr: This paper discusses the accuracy-interpretablity-complexity dilemma under the quantum computation framework and proposes a feature entanglement-based quantum multimodal fusion neural network, which achieves classification accuracy comparable to classical networks with dozens of times of parameters.

2601.07858.tldr: It is found that regularisation-based CL methods show limited performance for EEG-based emotion classification on the DREAMER and SEED datasets, and a fundamental misalignment in the stability-plasticity trade-off is identified.

2601.07866.tldr: A hybrid explainable AI (XAI) framework combining ante-hoc fuzzy logic with post-hoc SHAP explanations is presented, validated through systematic clinician feedback, providing practical insights for XAI deployment in maternal healthcare.

2601.07868.tldr: RewriteNets, a novel neural architecture built on an alternative paradigm: explicit, parallel string rewriting, is proposed, demonstrating that this architecture presents a promising direction for sequence modeling with explicit structural inductive biases.

2601.07871.tldr: This review examines joint representations that link cardiac imaging phenotypes to transcriptomic and spatially resolved molecular states and discusses integrative pipelines for radiogenomics, spatial molecular alignment, and image-based prediction of gene expression.

2601.07873.tldr: A multiplicative editing paradigm termed Multiplicative Orthogonal Sequential Editing (MOSE) is proposed, which first derive the matrix update in the multiplicative form, the new knowledge is then incorporated into an orthogonal matrix, which is multiplied by the original parameter matrix.

2601.07877.tldr: This work establishes a new paradigm combining physiological signals with LLM reasoning capabilities, showing that model scaling improves both recognition accuracy and interpretable emotional understanding in affective computing.

2601.07878.tldr: A sliced Wasserstein loss function for distribution-aware calibration in ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, which aligns the output distributions of full-precision and quantized models under random linear projections, complementing standard mean-squared error loss without adding any computational overhead during inference.

2601.07880.tldr: The Sola Visibility ISPM Benchmark is introduced, the first benchmark designed to evaluate agentic AI systems on foundational ISPM visibility tasks using a live, production-grade identity environment spanning AWS, Okta, and Google Workspace and is accompanied by the Sola AI Agent, a tool-using agent that translates natural-language queries into executable data exploration steps and produces verifiable, evidence-backed answers.

2601.07882.tldr: This work proposes a novel integrated sporadic-personalized approach called SPQFL that simultaneously handles quantum noise and data heterogeneity in a single QFL framework, and introduces a notion of sporadic learning to tackle quantum noise heterogeneity across quantum devices.

2601.07884.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive computational review of existing studies that define, analyze, quantify, and mitigate ideological isolation in online social networks and serves as a reference for understanding and addressing the key challenges and opportunities in promoting information diversity and reducing ideological fragmentation in the digital age.

2601.07885.tldr: This paper identifies emoticon semantic confusion, a vulnerability where LLMs misinterpret ASCII-based emoticons to perform unintended and even destructive actions and calls on the community to recognize this emerging vulnerability and develop effective mitigation methods to uphold the safety and reliability of the LLM system.

2601.07892.tldr: Sherry is proposed, a hardware-efficient ternary quantization framework that introduces a 3:4 fine-grained sparsity that achieves a regularized 1.25-bit width by packing blocks of four weights into five bits, restoring power-of-two alignment.

2601.07894.tldr: Investigation of the attention behaviors in MDMs reveals the phenomenon of Attention Floating, which provides a mechanistic explanation for the strong in-context learning capabilities of MDMs, allowing them to double the performance compared to ARMs in knowledge-intensive tasks.

2601.07898.tldr: This paper introduces a training model called LLM-DAL (Large Language Model - Decompositional Algorithmic Learning), through which it is demonstrated that LLMs'ability to perform complex algorithmic inferences and generalize can be significantly improved when the training method is properly designed to guide the model in its learning process.

2601.07901.tldr: A novel algorithm is proposed that achieves an improved regret bound of O N $\sqrt$ d tot + N $\sqrt$ T (1-$\sigma$2) 1/4 , where T is the total horizon, d tot denotes the average total delay across agents, N is the number of agents, and 1 -$sigma$ 2 is the spectral gap of the network.

2601.07935.tldr: This paper proposes Med-MoE-LoRA, a novel framework that integrates Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to enable efficient multi-task domain adaptation, especially for medical scenarios and introduces a Knowledge-Preservation Plugin, inspired by LoRA MoE, to isolate and protect general-purpose reasoning.

2601.07939.tldr: This study develops a semi-automated pipeline to extract citations referencing nine research papers and applies advanced natural language processing techniques with unsupervised machine learning to classify these citation statements as positive or negative, and produces sentiment-specific summaries that capture the strengths and limitations of each target paper.

2601.07946.tldr: DiffCoder is proposed, a coupled framework that integrates a probabilistic diffusion model with a conventional convolutional ResNet encoder and trains both components end-to-end and demonstrates that the generative decoding by diffusion offers a promising path toward compact, statistically consistent representations of complex flow fields.

2601.07948.tldr: This study evaluates a range of reinforcement learning-based neighborhood selection strategies and shows how search-specific characteristics, particularly large variations in cost due to constraint violation penalties, necessitate carefully designed reward functions to provide stable and informative learning signals.

2601.07951.tldr: A Hybrid SARIMA-LSTM architecture is proposed, which employs a residual-learning strategy to decompose temperature into a predictable climate component and a nonlinear weather component, and fusing statistical stability with neural plasticity, minimizes error propagation and enhances long-horizon accuracy.

2601.07953.tldr: This work introduces quantum representations of knowledge bases and proposes corresponding reasoning algorithms for a variety of tasks, and proposes the quantum algebraic proving method for geometric theorems, extending Wu's algebraic approach beyond the classical setting.

2601.07957.tldr: LWMSCNN-SE, a lightweight convolutional neural network that integrates multi-scale feature extraction, depthwise separable convolutions, and squeeze-and-Excitation attention mechanisms, achieves high accuracy while maintaining low computational costs, demonstrating its potential for efficient maize disease diagnosis on edge devices in precision farming systems.

2601.07958.tldr: LJ-Spoof is introduced, a speaker-specific, generatively diverse corpus that systematically varies prosody, vocoders, generative hyperparameters, bona fide prompt sources, training regimes, and neural post-processing that enables robust speaker-conditioned anti-spoofing and fine-grained synthesis-source tracing.

2601.07964.tldr: This paper examines the application of Executable Ontologies to game development and argues that EO represents a paradigm shift: a transition from algorithmic behavior programming to semantic world modeling, where agent behavior emerges naturally from declarative domain rules rather than being explicitly coded.

2601.07965.tldr: This work proposes a simple, effective, and universal training-free method that applies to both vision and language models, performing model calibration, cascading, and data cleaning to better exploit a model's ability to recognize when it does not know, and demonstrates that enabling models to recognize when they do not know is a practical step toward more efficient, reliable, and trustworthy AI.

2601.07973.tldr: This work introduces a taxonomy of norms that clarifies their contexts, specifications, and mechanisms, and demonstrates how this taxonomy can be operationalized to automatically evaluate models'norm adherence in naturalistic, open-ended settings.

2601.07988.tldr: The need for and propose a longitudinal modeling and evaluation paradigm that consequently updates four parts of the NLP pipeline are demonstrated and a broader discussion motivating a shift from word-sequence evaluation toward behavior-sequence paradigms for NLP is tied to a broader discussion motivating a shift from word-sequence evaluation toward $\textit{behavior-sequence}$ paradigms.

2601.08000.tldr: CADA is proposed, a case-augmented deliberative alignment method for LLMs utilizing reinforcement learning on self-generated safety reasoning chains that effectively enhances harmlessness, improves robustness against attacks, and reduces over-refusal while preserving utility across diverse benchmarks.

2601.08003.tldr: LLM Review is introduced, a peer-review-inspired framework implementing Blind Peer Review: agents exchange targeted feedback while revising independently, preserving divergent creative trajectories and suggesting interaction structure may substitute for model scale.

2601.08043.tldr: Investigating the effect of deliberately introducing controlled noise into the training data to improve model robustness suggests that strategic exposure to noise can act as a simple yet effective regularizer, offering a practical trade-off between traditional data cleanliness and real-world resilience.

2601.08049.tldr: SCASED (Smart Classroom Attendance System with Emotion Detection), an IoT-based system that integrates automated attendance tracking with facial emotion recognition to support classroom engagement monitoring and provide instructors with insights into classroom dynamics.

2601.08058.tldr: The results suggest that multi-step reasoning in LLMs is supported by latent internal activations that can be externally activated, while CoT prompting is one effective, but not unique, way of activating this mechanism rather than its necessary cause.

2601.08065.tldr: New algorithms that compute both over- and under-approximations of backward reachable sets for neural feedback systems are introduced to yield a unified verification framework for neural feedback systems.

2601.08079.tldr: MemoBrain is proposed, an executive memory model for tool-augmented agents that constructs a dependency-aware memory over reasoning steps, capturing salient intermediate states and their logical relations and preserves a compact, high-salience reasoning backbone under a fixed context budget.

2601.08089.tldr: This work proposes \texttt{Q-realign}, a post-hoc defense method based on post-training quantization, guided by an analysis of representational structure that decouples safety alignment from fine-tuning and naturally piggybacks into modern deployment pipelines.

2601.08094.tldr: A fusion framework that integrates local, channel-wise descriptors and global, trial-level descriptors, improving cross-subject generalization on the SEED-VII dataset is proposed, achieving approximately 40% mean accuracy in 7-class subject-independent emotion recognition.

2601.08107.tldr: STO-RL is proposed, an offline RL framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to generate temporally ordered subgoal sequences and corresponding state-to-subgoal-stage mappings and applies potential-based reward shaping to transform sparse terminal rewards into dense, temporally consistent signals, promoting subgoal progress while avoiding suboptimal solutions.

2601.08108.tldr: An Adaptive Causal Prompting with Sketch-of-Thought (ACPS) framework, which leverages structural causal models to infer the causal effect of a query on its answer and adaptively select an appropriate intervention, enables generalisable causal reasoning across heterogeneous tasks without task-specific retraining.

2601.08109.tldr: Beyond single-document case studies, it is shown that CSQL can also ingest RAG/IE-compiled causal corpora at scale by compiling the Testing Causal Claims dataset of economics papers into a causal database containing 265,656 claim instances, thereby enabling corpus-level causal queries and longitudinal analyses in CSQL.

2601.08125.tldr: A novel trajectory prediction framework for post crash LCs is developed, designed to guide both a conditional variational autoencoder and a Transformer based decoder to predict the lane changer's trajectory, which outperforms existing baselines in trajectory prediction performance.

2601.08127.tldr: This approach offers a scalable pathway for developing generalizable medical AI systems despite limited expert-labeled data, and shows that augmenting training sets with PathoGen-synthesized lesions enhances downstream segmentation performance compared to traditional geometric augmentations, particularly in data-scarce regimes.

2601.08128.tldr: A memory paradigm that alternates between active and inactive phases is proposed: during phases of user activity, the system performs low-latency, real-time dialog using lightweight retrieval over existing memories and context; whereas during phases of user inactivity, it conducts more computationally intensive extraction, consolidation, and maintenance of memories across full conversation sessions.

2601.08133.tldr: A novel collaborative framework, SSP, which integrates optical flow and textual prompts to assist the segmentation process, and implements a visual-textual alignment module (VTA) to facilitate cross-modal integration, delivering more coherent and contextually relevant semantic interpretations.

2601.08139.tldr: SubTTA is proposed, which aligns the semantic subspaces of both modalities to enhance zero-shot predictions to enhance zero-shot predictions to better guide the TTA process, and bridges the modality gap.

2601.08141.tldr: Qalb, an Urdu language model developed through a two-stage approach: continued pre-training followed by supervised fine-tuning, effectively adapts foundation models to low-resource languages.

2601.08148.tldr: It is argued that large language models (LLMs) are effective at extracting compressed rationales from diverse knowledge sources, while knowledge graphs (KGs) are better suited for propagating these profiles to extend their reach.

2601.08149.tldr: A mechanistic explanation of RCF's role in manifold enhancement and noise suppression, as well as its compatibility with deep learning models, are provided, and a graph optimization algorithm, DGSL-RCF, is designed, based on this framework.

2601.08160.tldr: SwiftMem is proposed, a query-aware agentic memory system that achieves sub-linear retrieval through specialized indexing over temporal and semantic dimensions, and introduces an embedding-tag co-consolidation mechanism that reorganizes storage based on semantic clusters to improve cache locality.

2601.08166.tldr: This work proposes a model-based hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for thermal- and energy-aware scheduling on multi-core platforms and introduces LLM-based semantic feature extraction that characterizes OpenMP programs through 13 code-level features without execution.

2601.08173.tldr: This work establishes a framework for assessing agent reliability, shifting evaluation from static tests to realistic, production-oriented scenarios, and introduces \method, a dynamic evaluation environment that simulates a"trainee"agent continuously exploring a novel setting.

2601.08176.tldr: Overall, the findings indicate that prompt design reliably improves high-level clarity evaluation, while fine-grained evasion and topic detection remain challenging despite structured reasoning prompts.

2601.08179.tldr: This study presents a new framework for instruction-driven facial expression generation that produces a 3D face and, starting from an image of the face, transforms the facial expression from one designated facial expression to another.

2601.08185.tldr: An autonomous materials synthesis extension to SARA, the Scientific Autonomous Reasoning Agent, is presented, utilizing phase information provided by an automated probabilistic phase labeling algorithm to expedite the search for targeted phase regions.

2601.08196.tldr: LogiSafetyGen is introduced, a framework that converts unstructured regulations into Linear Temporal Logic oracles and employs logic-guided fuzzing to synthesize valid, safety-critical traces and construct LogiSafetyBench, a benchmark comprising 240 human-verified tasks that require LLMs to generate Python programs that satisfy both functional objectives and latent compliance rules.

2601.08211.tldr: This work is an initial attempt to use data from AI systems to evaluate Official Internatinoal Mahjong's game balance and develop a revised version of the traditional game better adapted for online players.

2601.08224.tldr: SANC(E3) is proposed, an axiomatic framework in which representational units are not given a priori but instead arise as stable outcomes of competitive selection, reconstruction, and compression under finite activation capacity, governed by the explicit minimization of an energy functional E3.

2601.08226.tldr: This research analyzed and compared the multi-modal approach in theEVA-ViT based image encoder with the LlaMA or ChatGPT LLM to reduce the hallucination problem and detect diseases in chest x-ray images to show the challenge of data imbalance, a complex multi-stage structure, but suggests a large experience environment and a balanced example of use.

2601.08230.tldr: GADPN is proposed, a simple yet effective graph structure learning framework that adaptively refines graph topology via low-rank denoising and generalized structural perturbation, and extends the structural perturbation method to arbitrary graphs via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), overcoming its original limitation to symmetric structures.

2601.08237.tldr: It is argued that recent advances in large language models point toward a shift from hand-crafted numerical rewards to language-based objective specifications, and conceptualize this transition along three dimensions: semantic reward specification, dynamic reward adaptation, and improved alignment with human intent.

2601.08251.tldr: The proposed Hyperbolic Heterogeneous Graph Transformer (HypHGT), which effectively and efficiently learns heterogeneous graph representations entirely within the hyperbolic space, and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in node classification task, with significantly reduced training time and memory usage.

2601.08254.tldr: The results show that the LAM-DRL outperforms the traditional DRL by 40% in nominal weather scenarios and 64% in extreme weather scenarios compared to heuristics in terms of throughput, fairness, and outage probability.

2304.13372.tldr: This work introduces Feed-Forward with delayed Feedback (F$^3$), which approximates gradients using fixed random feedback paths and delayed error information from the previous epoch to balance biological plausibility with predictive performance.

2306.04321.tldr: This paper proposes a novel generative diffusion-guided framework for semantic communication that leverages the strong abilities of diffusion models in synthesizing multimedia content while preserving semantic features, and proves that it outperforms existing solutions in generating high-quality images with preserved semantic information even in cases where the received content is significantly degraded.

2406.09838.tldr: Climate-Zoo is developed, a suite of fine-tuned VLMs based on SPOT-empowered ClimateIQA, which significantly outperforms existing models in meteorological heatmap tasks.

2406.13257.tldr: A framework that uses hierarchical segmentation techniques for faithful and interpretable explanations of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and constructs model-based hierarchical segmentations that maintain the model's reasoning fidelity and allows both human-centric and model-centric segmentation.

2408.15969.tldr: The proposed dynamics are based on the proximal augmented Lagrangian and they provide a viable alternative to ADMM which faces significant challenges from both analysis and implementation viewpoints in large-scale multi-block scenarios.

2410.07145.tldr: It is revealed that Mamba-based models struggle to effectively forget earlier tokens even with built-in forgetting mechanisms, suggesting that future RNN designs must account for the interplay between state size, training length, and forgetting mechanisms to achieve robust performance in long-context tasks.

2410.17764.tldr: It is demonstrated that increasing the number of tangents improves both approximation quality and optimization performance across various tasks.

2412.04948.tldr: An approach which fine-tunes autoregressive LLMs to align with KG knowledge via the joint objective of explicit knowledge alignment and implicit knowledge alignment, which achieves a significant performance boost in evaluations of knowledge-driven tasks, specifically embedding-based knowledge graph completion and generation-based knowledge graph question answering.

2502.00568.tldr: A crossmodal generative model, PathGen, is developed to synthesise transcriptomic data from histopathology slides, and how the combination of these multimodal data improves cancer diagnosis and prognosis prediction.

2502.02132.tldr: It is found that Lion does not have the kind of implicit anti-regularization induced by memory that AdamW does, providing a theory-based explanation for Lion's better generalization performance recently documented.

2503.06614.tldr: Experimental results on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that SubGND achieves performance comparable to or surpassing global message-passing GNNs, particularly in heterophilic settings, highlighting its effectiveness and scalability as a promising solution for node classification.

2504.05255.tldr: KA is found to be stable under countable collections of continuous re-parameterizations, but a question about the equi-continuity of the outer functions that, so far, obstructs taking limits and defeating continuous groups of re-parameterizations is unearthed.

2504.08526.tldr: It is argued that this failure mode, hallucination, can be addressed by shifting from data-centric to phenomenon-centric assessment, and it is shown how scientific workflows discipline generative models through theory-guided training and confidence-based error screening.

2505.07917.tldr: This study systematically examines a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for biomedical QA, evaluating retrieval strategies and response time trade-offs and highlights previously not well-known trade-offs in retrieval depth, efficiency, and scalability for biomedical QA.

2505.13565.tldr: A dual taxonomy is introduced to evaluate AI's complex relationship with democracy: the AI Risks to Democracy (AIRD) taxonomy, which identifies how AI can undermine core democratic principles such as autonomy, fairness, and trust; and the AI's Positive Contributions to Democracy (AIPD) taxonomy, which highlights AI's potential to enhance transparency, participation, efficiency, and evidence-based policymaking.

2505.17791.tldr: This work presents a bottom-up approach to training neural networks for hardware-based spiking neurons and synapses, built using ferroelectric capacitors and resistive random-access memories, and develops a training algorithm that can reliably train the networks, even when applying hardware limitations, such as stochasticity or low bit precision.

2506.03333.tldr: This work utilizes a quantile-based approach to develop the first set of algorithms that can successfully learn and/or optimize the long-run per-step reward distribution, as well as the differential return distribution of an average-reward MDP.

2506.05952.tldr: MOGO (Motion Generation with One-pass), a novel autoregressive framework tailored for efficient and real-time 3D motion generation, is proposed, offering substantial improvements in real-time performance, streaming generation, and generalization under zero-shot settings.

2506.07553.tldr: GTR-VL is introduced, featuring two key innovations: the \textit{Graph Traversal as Visual Chain of Thought} mechanism that emulates human reasoning by incrementally parsing molecular graphs through sequential atom-bond predictions, and the data-centric \textit{Faithfully Recognize What You've Seen} principle, which aligns abbreviated structures in images with their expanded annotations.

2506.09644.tldr: This work proposes DGAE, which employs a diffusion model to guide the decoder in recovering informative signals that are not fully decoded from the latent representation, and effectively mitigates the performance degradation under high spatial compression rates.

2506.10035.tldr: This work proposes FastFLUX, an architecture-level pruning framework designed to enhance the inference efficiency of FLUX, and introduces Sandwich Training (ST), a localized fine-tuning strategy that leverages LoRA to supervise neighboring blocks, mitigating performance drops caused by structural replacement.

2506.10326.tldr: In the restricted setting where an agent is trained and evaluated in a mirror match with a single team configuration, the methods can win against a professional VGC competitor and find that as the number of teams increases, the best-performing algorithm in the single-team setting has worse performance and is more exploitable, but has improved generalization to unseen teams.
