2601.13018.tldr: The BiAtt-BiRNN-HateXplain (Bidirectional Attention BiRNN HateXplain) model is proposed which is easier to explain compared to LLMs which are more complex in view of the need for transparency, and will take into account the sequential aspect of the input data during explainability thanks to a BiRNN layer.

2601.13020.tldr: The pathway activation subspace (PASs), a LoRA-induced subspace that reflects which low-rank pathway directions an input activates in each expert, is introduced, providing a capability-aligned coordinate system for routing and preservation.

2601.13048.tldr: This work presents the first systematic kernel interpretability study of the diagonalized state-space model (S4D) trained on a real-world task (vulnerability detection in source code) and shows that the long-range modeling capability of S4D varies significantly under different model architectures, affecting model performance.

2601.13054.tldr: A novel, edge-first IoT framework that integrates Tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) for intelligent, offline-capable precision irrigation and provides a practical, cost-effective blueprint for bridging the technological divide in agriculture and enhancing water-use efficiency through on-device artificial intelligence.

2601.13060.tldr: The results establish MagicGUI-RMS as a principled and effective foundation for building self-improving GUI agents driven by reward-based adaptation.

2601.13075.tldr: METIS, a tool-augmented, stage-aware assistant with literature search, curated guidelines, methodology checks, and memory, is built and evaluated against GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 across six writing stages.

2601.13111.tldr: CORE-T is proposed, a scalable, training-free framework that enriches tables with LLM-generated purpose metadata and pre-computes a lightweight table-compatibility cache and improves table-selection F1 by up to 22.7 points while retrieving up to 42% fewer tables.

2601.13114.tldr: This work introduces IntAgent, an intelligent intent LLM agent that integrates NWDAF analytics and tools to fulfill the network operator's intents, and develops an intent tools engine directly within the NWDAF analytics engine, allowing the agent to utilize live network analytics to inform its reasoning and tool selection.

2601.13122.tldr: The goal of developing responsible general-purpose AI can be achieved by formally modeling application- or domain-dependent RAI requirements along C2V2 dimensions, and taking a system design approach to suitably combine various techniques to meet the desiderata.

2601.13142.tldr: This work introduces an offline graph-based abstraction of real-world TV navigation that enables reproducible and deployment-free evaluation and proposes a framework that injects topology awareness into LVLMs, a foundation model specialized for TV navigation.

2601.13160.tldr: A unified dynamical perspective is proposed that characterizes training stability as an intrinsic property of learning systems, organized along four interacting dimensions: optimization, environmental/data, parametric, and learning-signal stability, providing a descriptive foundation for studying learning dynamics beyond final performance outcomes.

2601.13166.tldr: This work proposes a U-Net CNN architecture combined with strategies leveraging anatomical priors and neuroimaging domain knowledge that trained 1-2 orders of magnitude faster and were 10 times smaller than competing transformer-based approaches.

2601.13186.tldr: Results indicate that observability-aware evaluation can reveal non-monotonic effects within multi-agent pipelines and that memory-augmented agents can jointly maximize security robustness, real-time performance, operational cost savings, and environmental sustainability without modifying underlying model weights.

2601.13206.tldr: Simulated negotiations between paired agents under strict deadlines are used to investigate how LLMs adjust their behavior in time-sensitive settings, revealing a systematic lack of LLM time awareness that will constrain LLM deployment in many time-sensitive applications.

2601.13217.tldr: Mr Dre is introduced, an evaluation suite that establishes multi-turn report revision as a new evaluation axis for DRAs and reveals a critical limitation: while agents can address most user feedback, they also regress on 16-27% of previously covered content and citation quality over multiple revision turns.

2601.13222.tldr: Crucible is presented, a Nugget-Augmented Generation System that preserves explicit citation provenance by constructing a bank of Q&A nuggets from retrieved documents and uses them to guide extraction, selection, and report generation.

2601.13227.tldr: Comparisons with nugget-based RAG systems, including Ginger and Crucible, against strong baselines such as GPT-Researcher show that near-perfect evaluation scores can be achieved when elements of the evaluation are leaked or can be predicted.

2601.13228.tldr: Any-order Any-subset Autoregressive modeling (A3), a generalized framework that extends the standard AR factorization to arbitrary token groups and generation orders and preserves the probabilistic rigor and multi-layer dependency modeling of AR while inheriting diffusion models'flexibility for parallel and bidirectional generation.

2601.13235.tldr: This work introduces RubRIX (Rubric-based Risk Index), a theory-driven, clinician-validated framework for evaluating risks in LLM caregiving responses, and evaluates six state-of-the-art LLMs on over 20,000 caregiver queries from Reddit and ALZConnected.

2601.13236.tldr: A general framework for pixel-wise uncertainty quantification in parallel MRI reconstructions is introduced, enabling automatic identification of unreliable regions without access to any ground-truth reference image and evaluation of reconstruction quality without access to fully-sampled ground-truth reference images.

2601.13238.tldr: This paper focuses on rainy scenarios and introduces the first adversarial framework that exploits realistic weather to attack VLMs, using a two-stage, parameterized perturbation model based on semantic decoupling to analyze rain-induced shifts in decision-making.

2601.13240.tldr: This work presents KOCO-BENCH, a novel benchmark designed for evaluating domain specialization methods in real-world software development, and reveals that KOCO-BENCH poses significant challenges to state-of-the-art LLMs.

2601.13247.tldr: WorldMind is introduced, a framework that autonomously constructs a symbolic World Knowledge Repository by synthesizing environmental feedback that unifies Process Experience to enforce physical feasibility via prediction errors and Goal Experience to guide task optimality through successful trajectories.

2601.13262.tldr: CURE-MED is proposed, a curriculum-informed reinforcement learning framework that integrates code-switching-aware supervised fine-tuning and Group Relative Policy Optimization to jointly improve logical correctness and language stability in LLMs.

2601.13268.tldr: This work introduces a multi-agent refinement framework designed to enhance the safety and reliability of medical LLMs through structured, iterative alignment, and presents a scalable, regulator-aligned, and cost-efficient paradigm for governing medical AI safety.

2601.13317.tldr: A comparative analysis of climate discourse across paid advertisements on Meta and public posts on Bluesky from July 2024 to September 2025 is presented and it is shown that platform-level incentives are reflected in the thematic structure, stance alignment, and temporal responsiveness of climate narratives.

2601.13327.tldr: PepEDiff is presented, a novel peptide binder generator that designs binding sequences given a target receptor protein sequence and its pocket residues, and leverages the global protein embedding manifold as a semantic prior, allowing the model to propose novel peptide sequences in previously unseen regions of the protein space.

2601.13348.tldr: This study examines how to characterize AI chatbot addiction--why users become addicted, the symptoms commonly reported, and the distinct types it comprises, to inform future strategies for prevention, diagnosis, and intervention.

2601.13352.tldr: LLM-as-RNN, an inference-only framework that turns a frozen LLM into a recurrent predictor by representing its hidden state as natural-language memory, significantly outperforms zero-shot, full-history, and MemPrompt baselines, while producing interpretable, human-readable learning traces absent in standard context accumulation.

2601.13358.tldr: It is established that the cost of thought is determined not by task difficulty but by manifold geometry - offering a blueprint for inference acceleration where topology permits.

2601.13376.tldr: This article outlines a research pathway grounded in bounded rationality, and argues that conversational AI should be designed to work with human heuristics rather than against them, and identifies key directions for detecting cognitive vulnerability, supporting judgment under uncertainty, and evaluating conversational systems beyond factual accuracy.

2601.13383.tldr: AgentForge is presented, a lightweight, open-source Python framework designed to democratize the construction of LLM-driven autonomous agents through a principled modular architecture that achieves competitive task completion rates while reducing development time by 62% compared to LangChain and 78% compared to direct API integration.

2601.13392.tldr: A benchmark for deterministic finite automata construction from regular languages, comprising factual knowledge questions, seen construction problems from public sources, and two types of unseen problems: hand-crafted instances with multiple interacting constraints and systematically generated problems via Arden's theorem.

2601.13398.tldr: RoundTripCodeEval is presented, a comprehensive benchmark consisting of four distinct code execution reasoning tasks designed to rigorously test round-trip consistency, which provides an execution-free, exact-match evaluation of bijection fidelity.

2601.13400.tldr: This work proposes DIP-$\ell_0, a deep image prior framework that incorporates the $\ell_0$ gradient regularizer and develops an alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm that utilizes an off-the-shelf gradient minimization solver.

2601.13401.tldr: This work proposes QVLM (Quantitative Vision-Language Model), a code-generation architecture that maintains pixel precision by decoupling language understanding from visual analysis, and reveals that, for quantitative spatial reasoning, architectural decoupling enables better accuracy on quantitative tasks.

2601.13404.tldr: Local and global explanation methods for black-box models that generate explanations in terms of human-recognizable primitive concepts are introduced and it is shown that the explanations maintain high fidelity and coverage with respect to the blackbox models they seek to explain in challenging vision datasets.

2601.13406.tldr: The Virtual Operating Room Team Experience (VORTeX), a multi-user virtual reality (VR) platform that integrates immersive team simulation with large language model (LLM) analytics to train and evaluate communication, decision-making, teamwork, and leadership, is introduced.

2601.13412.tldr: The application of deep learning techniques for predicting cleansing quality in colon capsule endoscopy (CCE) images is explored, demonstrating the effectiveness of pruning in improving efficiency from 84% without compromising performance.

2601.13422.tldr: The TrustEnergy framework is implemented and evaluated by working with an electricity provider in Florida, and the results show the TrustEnergy can achieve a 5.4% increase in prediction accuracy and 5.7% improvement in uncertainty quantification compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

2601.13437.tldr: This work introduces the first multilingual open-set learning and discovery (MOSLD) benchmark for text categorization by topic, comprising 960K data samples across 12 languages, and proposes a novel framework for the OSLD task, which integrates multiple stages to continuously discover and learn new classes.

2601.13443.tldr: This work introduces Explicit Cognitive Allocation, a general principle for structuring AI-assisted inference through the explicit separation and orchestration of epistemic functions, and instantiates this principle in the Cognitive Universal Agent (CUA), an architecture that organizes inference into distinct stages of exploration and framing, epistemic anchoring, instrumental and methodological mapping, and interpretive synthesis.

2601.13462.tldr: The results show that grounding methods substantially improve both pass rate and coverage, while abstention remains a dominant factor due mainly to missing detections.

2601.13464.tldr: It is shown that sufficient context and/or the transcript can significantly improve the efficacy of audio deepfake detectors and that CADD, via its use of context and/or transcripts, is more robust to 5 adversarial evasion strategies.

2601.13474.tldr: The theory formalizes the preconditioning effect induced by spectral orthogonalization, offering insight into Muon's effectiveness in these matrix optimization problems and potentially beyond.

2601.13476.tldr: A novel PRobabilistic variational imputation framework that leverages the power of large lAnguage models and retrIeval-augmented Memory (PRAIM) to overcome data sparsity and lead to substantial improvements in downstream forecasting performance.

2601.13481.tldr: Experimental results show that APOLO consistently improves diagnostic accuracy and robustness across domain-specific and stratified benchmarks, demonstrating a scalable and generalizable paradigm for trustworthy LLM applications in mental healthcare.

2601.13508.tldr: CatMaster is presented, a large-language-model (LLM)-driven agent system that turns natural language requests into complete calculation workspaces, including structures, inputs, outputs, logs, and a concise run record to help catalysis researchers focus on modeling choices and chemical interpretation rather than workflow management.

2601.13515.tldr: By integrating the Random Forest classification algorithm from machine learning, attacks are assessed and predicted, dynamically adjusting the maximum pod parameter in the HPA to manage attack traffic, this approach enables the adjustment of HPA parameters using machine learning scripts in targeted attack scenarios while effectively managing attack traffic.

2601.13528.tldr: It is shown that the efficacy of elicitation attacks scales with the capability of the frontier model and the amount of generated fine-tuning data, and the challenge of mitigating ecosystem level risks with output-level safeguards is demonstrated.

2601.13533.tldr: The Entropy-Guided Latent Reasoning (EGLR) recommendation model is introduced, specifically designed for the high-difficulty nature of list generation by enabling real-time reasoning during generation and being compatible with existing generative re-ranking models to enhance their performance.

2601.13546.tldr: A multi-agent-based TS Evolution algorithm named TSEvol is proposed and the TS Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (TKTO) to enhance ChatAD's cross-task generalization capability is proposed to enhance ChatAD's cross-task generalization capability.

2601.13547.tldr: A four-component metric suite designed to evaluate the reasoning quality of model explanations that is intended as a diagnostic complement to reveal interpretability failures and annotation inconsistencies that are invisible to standard metrics like Accuracy or F1.

2601.13558.tldr: It is demonstrated that social media and dating app text data can provide valuable insights into risk and protective behaviors and highlight the potential of large language model-based methods to support scalable and personalized public health interventions for MSM.

2601.13559.tldr: This work proposes AgentGC, the first evolutionary Agent-based GD Compressor, consisting of 3 layers with multi-agent named Leader and Worker, and designed to support diverse scenarios: CP for compression-ratio priority, TP for throughput priority, and BM for balanced mode.

2601.13562.tldr: It is hypothesized that reasoning is a modality: reasoning should exist as a distinct channel separate from the low-level workspace on which rules are applied, consistent with a shift away from plausible probability blobs toward controller-driven reasoning.

2601.13564.tldr: Across comprehensive benchmarks, LUMOS consistently outperforms baseline models in terms of accuracy, generalizability and physical plausibility for fluorescence property prediction, and demonstrates superior performance in multi-objective scaffold- and fragment-level molecular optimization.

2601.13566.tldr: It is proved that coherence optimization is equivalent to description-length regularization, and that among all such regularization schemes, it is optimal for semi-supervised learning when the regularizer is derived from a pretrained model.

2601.13580.tldr: It is demonstrated that transformer middle layers can support efficient modular transfer for decoder-only architectures, enabling privacy-preserving expertise sharing through checkpoint distribution, and cross-domain transfer at billion-parameter scale reveals unexpected regularization benefits.

2601.13581.tldr: ScriptMind, an integrated framework for LLM-based scam detection that bridges automated reasoning and human cognition, is proposed, achieving superior performance over commercial models in detection accuracy, false-positive reduction, scammer utterance prediction, and rationale quality.

2601.13588.tldr: TREX is introduced, a regression-based framework that efficiently predicts the optimal data mixture for tokenizer training and enables scalable mixture search before large-scale tokenizer training, mitigating the accuracy-cost trade-off in multilingual tokenizer design.

2601.13589.tldr: A multi-agent artificial intelligence system that generates response-oriented media content in real time based on audio-derived emotional signals that enables interpretability and extensibility, making it applicable to child-adjacent media, therapeutic applications, and emotionally responsive smart devices.

2601.13591.tldr: DSAEval is introduced, a benchmark comprising 641 real-world data science problems grounded in 285 diverse datasets, covering both structured and unstructured data, and it is demonstrated that multimodal perception consistently improves performance on vision-related tasks.

2601.13592.tldr: This study investigates critical limitations inherent to hybrid forecasting frameworks that embed deep neural networks into numerical prediction models, with a specific focus on two fundamental bottlenecks: coupling compatibility and long-term integration stability.

2601.13600.tldr: An adaptive divide-and-conquer algorithm that identifies minimal inconsistent subsets (MUSes) of facts and optionally computes minimal repairs through hitting-sets is proposed, offering a scalable framework for linguistic consistency verification with LLM-based evaluators.

2601.13614.tldr: CauScientist is a collaborative framework that synergizes LLMs as hypothesis-generating data scientists with probabilistic statistics as rigorous"verifiers" and substantially outperforms purely data-driven baselines.

2601.13622.tldr: This work proposes Context-Aware Image Representation Prioritization via Ensemble (CARPE), a lightweight framework that integrates raw vision features with aligned LLM representations through vision-integration layers and a context-aware ensemble mechanism to improve representation utilization within autoregressive LVLMs.

2601.13645.tldr: A quadratic upper bound (QUB) is derived on the adversarial training (AT) loss function and proposed to utilize the bound with existing FAT methods and show that applying QUB loss to the existing methods yields significant improvement of robustness.

2601.13647.tldr: An improved version of the Segment Transformer is proposed, termed the Fusion Segment Transformer, which enhances the architecture for full-audio AI-generated music detection by introducing a Gated Fusion Layer that effectively integrates content and structural information, enabling the capture of long-term context.

2601.13655.tldr: The first large-scale empirical study of 705 real-world failures from the open-source DeepSeek, Llama, and Qwen ecosystems reveals a paradigm shift: white-box orchestration relocates the reliability bottleneck from model algorithmic defects to the systemic fragility of the deployment stack.

2601.13657.tldr: A DRL controller trained in GPU-accelerated Nvidia Isaac Sim that enables followers to learn complex emergent behaviors - balancing flocking and obstacle avoidance - using only local perception, allowing the swarm to implicitly follow the leader while robustly addressing perceptual challenges such as occlusion and limited field-of-view.

2601.13659.tldr: This work proposes TSDA, Temporal-Spatial Decouple before Act, which explicitly decouples each modality into temporal dynamics and spatial structural context before any interaction, and shows that TSDA outperforms baselines.

2601.13671.tldr: This paper consolidates and formalizes the technical composition of orchestrated multi-agent systems, presenting a unified architectural framework that integrates planning, policy enforcement, state management, and quality operations into a coherent orchestration layer.

2601.13684.tldr: HeteroCache features a hierarchical storage mechanism where representative heads monitor attention drift to trigger asynchronous, on-demand context retrieval, thereby hiding I/O latency and achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-context benchmarks.

2601.13693.tldr: This work presents an end-to-end reverse screening strategy leveraging HelixFold3, a high-accuracy biomolecular structure prediction model akin to AlphaFold3, which simultaneously models the folding of proteins from a protein library and the docking of small-molecule ligands within a unified framework.

2601.13697.tldr: This work proposes GRADFILTERING, an objective-agnostic, uncertainty-aware data selection framework that utilizes a small GPT-2 proxy with a LoRA ensemble and aggregates per-example gradients into a Gradient Signal-to-Noise Ratio (G-SNR) utility.

2601.13698.tldr: An information-theoretic measure Chernoff Information is utilized to characterize the fundamental trade-off between fairness, privacy, and accuracy, as induced by the input data distribution, and the Chernoff Information Neural Estimator is developed, the first neural network-based estimator of Chernoff Information for unknown distributions.

2601.13707.tldr: Attention-space Contrastive Guidance is proposed, a single-pass mechanism that operates within self-attention layers to construct both vision-language and language-only attention paths in a single forward computation, reducing latency by up to 2x compared to prior contrastive decoding methods that require multiple forward passes.

2601.13709.tldr: Deception in the Social Deduction Game (SDG) Mafia is studied, where success is dependent on deceiving others through conversation and an asynchronous multi-agent framework is used which better simulates realistic social contexts.

2601.13717.tldr: It is concluded that RF on pre-cutoff events is methodologically flawed and recommended against using SI-based retrospective setups to benchmark forecasting capabilities, and it is demonstrated that prompts cannot reliably"rewind"model knowledge.

2601.13719.tldr: HAVEN is presented, a unified framework for long-video understanding that enables coherent and comprehensive reasoning by integrating audiovisual entity cohesion and hierarchical video indexing with agentic search and preserves semantic consistency.

2601.13722.tldr: This work proposes \textbf{Self-ReCheck}, a lightweight, model-agnostic memory filtering mechanism that mitigates over-personalization while preserving personalization performance in memory-augmented dialogue systems.

2601.13735.tldr: This work introduces three classes of inter-step causality perturbations that systematically disrupt dependencies between reasoning steps while preserving local fluency, and proposes a contrastive causality metric that explicitly isolates inter-step causal dependencies, and yields more faithful output selection than existing probability-based approaches.

2601.13749.tldr: Puzzling internal representations of open-weight models reveals that ``Artificial Intelligence'' exhibits the highest similarity to generic prompts for academic fields under positive, negative, and neutral framings alike, indicating valence-invariant representational centrality.

2601.13752.tldr: This paper proposes Reasoning Belief Engineering (RELIEF), a simple yet effective framework that shapes LRM behavior by aligning the model's self-concept with a target belief blueprint, and completely bypasses the need for reasoning-trace supervision.

2601.13770.tldr: The Look-Ahead-Bench is introduced, a standardized benchmark measuring look-ahead bias in Point-in-Time (PiT) Large Language Models (LLMs) within realistic and practical financial workflows and provides a practical framework for identifying models suitable for real-world deployment.

2601.13798.tldr: CFM is proposed, a language-aligned concept foundation model for vision that provides fine-grained concepts, which are human-interpretable and spatially grounded in the input image, and when paired with a foundation model with strong semantic representations, gets explanations for any of its downstream tasks.

2601.13846.tldr: Simulation analysis revealed culturally embedded typologies as core identity-forming elements, positioning VU as a viable framework for AI-augmented urban analysis, outlining a path toward automated, multi-parameter identity metrics.

2601.13864.tldr: This work introduces HardSecBench, a benchmark with 924 tasks spanning Verilog Register Transfer Level (RTL) and firmware-level C, covering 76 hardware-relevant Common Weakness Enumeration entries, and proposes a multi-agent pipeline that decouples synthesis from verification and grounds evaluation in execution evidence, enabling reliable evaluation.

2601.13880.tldr: This paper introduces LifeAgentBench, a large-scale QA benchmark for long-horizon, cross-dimensional, and multi-user lifestyle health reasoning, containing 22,573 questions spanning from basic retrieval to complex reasoning, and proposes LifeAgent as a strong baseline agent for health assistant that integrates multi-step evidence retrieval with deterministic aggregation.

2601.13885.tldr: This work presents a principled extension of IRT-based adaptive testing to continuous bounded scores (ROUGE, BLEU, LLM-as-a-Judge) by replacing the Bernoulli response distribution with a heteroskedastic normal distribution.

2601.13895.tldr: OmniOVCD is a standalone framework designed for OVCD, which first fuses the semantic, instance, and presence outputs of SAM 3 to construct land-cover masks, and then decomposes them into individual instance masks for change comparison.

2601.13897.tldr: This work proposes TractRLFusion, a novel GPT-based policy fusion framework that integrates multiple RL policies through a data-driven fusion strategy that outperforms individual RL policies as well as state-of-the-art classical and DRL methods in accuracy and anatomical reliability.

2601.13920.tldr: Empirical simulations show that, even when strong monotonicity cannot be achieved, the asymmetric regularization is enough to converge to an equilibrium and stabilize the trajectory.

2601.13938.tldr: IF-GEO is proposed, a "diverge-then-converge" framework comprising two phases: mining distinct optimization preferences from representative latent queries and synthesizing a Global Revision Blueprint for guided editing by coordinating preferences via conflict-aware instruction fusion.

2601.13942.tldr: Glance-or-Gaze (GoG) is proposed, a fully autonomous framework that shifts from passive perception to active visual planning and introduces a Selective Gaze mechanism that dynamically chooses whether to glance at global context or gaze into high-value regions, filtering irrelevant information before retrieval.

2601.13969.tldr: ARK is introduced, an agentic KG retriever that gives a language model control over this breadth-depth tradeoff using a two-operation toolset: global lexical search over node descriptors and one-hop neighborhood exploration that composes into multi-hop traversal.

2601.13992.tldr: Compact is introduced, a framework that adaptively fuses supervisions from different teachers by dynamically weighting teacher gradients based on the student's real-time compatibility evaluated by a multi-dimensional metric, achieving state-of-the-art performance on various benchmarks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

2601.13994.tldr: torchsla is an open-source PyTorch library that enables GPU-accelerated, scalable, and differentiable sparse linear algebra and seamlessly integrates with PyTorch autograd for end-to-end differentiable simulations.

2401.10061.tldr: DiffusionAgent is introduced, a unified, language-model-driven agent that casts the entire prompt comprehension-expert routing-image synthesisloop into a agentic framework and activates the optimal generative path for open-domain prompts without retraining or fine-tuning any expert.

2401.13770.tldr: AlphaMapleSAT is introduced, a Cube-and-Conquer (CnC) parallel SAT solver that integrates Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with deductive feedback to efficiently solve challenging combinatorial SAT problems.

2502.09680.tldr: A novel object-centric latent action learning framework that centers on objects rather than pixels to disentangle the movement of the agent and distracting background dynamics, enabling better imitation learning and efficient adaptation of the agent with just a few action-labeled trajectories.

2503.19075.tldr: This work introduces practices for thicker evaluations of representation that expand the understanding of representation underpinning AI evaluations and by co-constructing metrics with communities, bringing measurement in line with the experiences of communities on the ground.

2504.13745.tldr: ESLoRA is presented, a flexible fine-tuning framework specifically designed to enhance spatial consistency in generative models without increasing generation time or compromising the quality of the outputs, and outperforms CoMPaSS, the current baseline framework, on spatial consistency benchmarks.

2504.15364.tldr: KeyDiff, a training-free KV cache eviction method based solely on key similarity, is proposed, a training-free KV cache eviction method that can process arbitrarily long prompts within strict resource constraints and efficiently generate responses.

2505.11574.tldr: This framework is quantizer- and architecture-agnostic within the evaluated regimes, and turns low-bit degradation from a global accuracy problem into a local, reproducible process intervention.

2505.17344.tldr: A new hybrid Multi-Head Attention Soft Random Forest (MHASRF) model that integrates attention mechanisms into a random forest model using probabilistic soft splitting instead of hard splitting is proposed, offering deeper insights into patient no-show predictors.

2507.12286.tldr: This paper advocates a semantics for SHACL validation in the presence of ontologies based on core universal models, and provides a technique for constructing these models for ontologies in the rich data-tractable description logic Horn-ALCHIQ.

2509.04492.tldr: This work provides a lightweight technique to enhance the trustworthiness of LLM responses, at the token level, after a single generation pass, for QA and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

2509.23038.tldr: GeLoc3r is presented, a novel approach to relative camera pose estimation that enhances pose regression methods through Geometric Consistency Regularization (GCR), and represents a paradigm shift in how neural networks learn camera geometry, achieving both the speed of regression and the geometric understanding of correspondence methods.

2510.13872.tldr: The proposed method is the first EBM-based hybrid to scale to high-resolution datasets with high training stability, simultaneously achieving state-of-the-art discriminative and generative performance on ImageNet 256x256 and uniquely combines generative quality with adversarial robustness.

2510.15566.tldr: SpikeVox is proposed, a novel framework for enabling energy-efficient speech therapy solutions through spike-driven generative language model that potentially addresses the significant global speech therapy access gap.

2510.20543.tldr: CenterBench is introduced, a dataset of 9,720 comprehension questions on center-embedded sentences where relative clauses nest recursively, creating processing demands from simple to deeply nested structures, to identify when models shift from structural analysis to pattern matching.

2511.16073.tldr: It is demonstrated that an appropriately structured two-step fine-tuning pipeline can effectively be used to transfer a small language model into humanlike candidate evaluation, surpassing shortcoming of both traditional ATS systems and unrefined uses of reinforcement learning.

2512.17853.tldr: This work introduces three AnyTask agents for generating expert demonstrations aiming to solve as many tasks as possible, and trains behavior cloning policies on generated data, validate them in simulation, and deploy them directly on real robot hardware.

2601.00814.tldr: The paper uses a fine-tuned transformer based multilingual model for generating better embeddings, and uses cosine similarity to find positive ontology entities pairs and then applies threshold filtering to retain only highly similar entities.

2601.13734.tldr: Active recap learning enables models to revisit and summarize earlier content through targeted sequence construction during contined pretraining and retrospective summarization at inference, thereby establishing a recursive memory mechanism across paragraphs.

2601.14012.tldr: This work proposes Matryoshka Audio-Text Embeddings (MATE), a dual-encoder framework that encodes multiple embedding granularities within a single vector via nested sub-embeddings ("prefixes") and introduces a PCA-guided prefix alignment.

2601.14022.tldr: A machine learning-based framework for like-for-like operational assessment of internal combustion engine vehicles and electric vehicles under identical, real-world driving conditions, which offers a scalable foundation for credible, data-driven assessments of vehicle carbon performance under real-world operating conditions.

2601.14027.tldr: Numina-Lean-Agent is introduced, which combines Claude Code with Numina-Lean-MCP to enable autonomous interaction with Lean, retrieval of relevant theorems, informal proving and auxiliary reasoning tools, and is motivated by a general coding agent providing a natural interface for diverse reasoning tasks beyond proving.

2601.14039.tldr: It is established that enabling models to selectively ignore corrupted samples is a powerful and generalizable strategy for building more reliable segmentation models.

2601.14041.tldr: This Perspective identifies ten fundamental challenges ranging from architectural inertia and gradient sparsity to the limitations of linear reasoning that prevent DLMs from reaching their ``GPT-4 moment'' and proposes a strategic roadmap organized into four pillars: foundational infrastructure, algorithmic optimization, cognitive reasoning, and unified multimodal intelligence.

2601.14051.tldr: Kakugo, a novel and cost-effective pipeline designed to train general-purpose Small Language Models (SLMs) for low-resource languages using only the language name as input, offers an accessible method for communities to develop language-specific AI.

2601.14053.tldr: LLMOrbit is presented, a comprehensive circular taxonomy navigating the landscape of large language models spanning 2019-2025, documenting architectural innovations, training methodologies, and efficiency patterns defining modern LLMs, generative AI, and agentic systems.

2601.14055.tldr: This work introduces SVGFormer, a decoder-free pipeline built upon a content-aware grouping stage that partitions the volume into a semantic graph of supervoxels, and establishes that a graph-based, encoder-only paradigm offers an accurate and inherently interpretable alternative for 3D medical image representation.

2601.14056.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that POCI-Diff produces high-quality images consistent with the specified 3D layouts and edits, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in both visual fidelity and layout adherence while eliminating warping-induced geometric artifacts.

2601.14063.tldr: XCR-Bench is introduced, a Cross(X)-Cultural Reasoning Benchmark consisting of 4.9k parallel sentences and 1,098 unique CSIs, spanning three distinct reasoning tasks with corresponding evaluation metrics, showing that state-of-the-art LLMs exhibit consistent weaknesses in identifying and adapting CSIs related to social etiquette and cultural reference.

2601.14069.tldr: This paper first considers a deep feature extractor network, providing a set of representative video features during each task without assuming any class or task information, and progressively builds a series of deep clusters from the extracted features.

2601.14084.tldr: DermaBench is introduced, a clinician-annotated dermatology VQA benchmark built on the Diverse Dermatology Images (DDI) dataset, released as a metadata-only dataset to respect upstream licensing and is publicly available at Harvard Dataverse.

2601.14086.tldr: A new two-stream transformer video classifier, which extracts spatio-temporal information from content and optical flow representing movement information and identifies self-attention features across the joint optical flow and temporal frame domain.

2601.14087.tldr: This work proposes the hardware implementation of a comparison-free sorting unit optimized for Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) by leveraging approximate computing to group population counts into coarse-grained buckets and achieves hardware area reductions while preserving the link power benefits of data reordering.

2601.14091.tldr: This study explores the potential of foundation models to enhance the adaptability and generalizability of task planning in construction robots using lightweight, open-source large language models (LLMs) and vision language models (VLMs).

2601.14099.tldr: This paper proposes a causal feature selection framework based on time-delayed cross mapping, which achieves the highest average performance, while TDPCM improves soft sensor stability and performance in the worst scenario.

2601.14115.tldr: The Riemannian Liquid Spatio-Temporal Graph Network (RLSTG), a framework that unifies continuous-time liquid dynamics with the geometric inductive biases of Riemannian manifolds, and achieves superior performance on graphs with complex structures.

2601.14124.tldr: The results show that diffusion-based style transfer can generate high-entropy, semantically faithful synthetic data without reliance on pretrained LLMs, providing an effective and flexible framework for mitigating gender bias in sensitive, low-resource mental health domains.

2601.14152.tldr: An in-depth investigation on a striking case: in multiple-choice question answering, placing context before the questions and options (CQO) outperforms the reverse order (QOC) by over 14%p, consistently over a wide range of models and datasets.

2601.14154.tldr: MIRACLE employs a hyperspherical embedding space fusion of heterogeneous inputs, enabling the extraction of robust, discriminative features from both structured clinical records and high-dimensional radiological images, and incorporates an interventional deep learning module in MIRACLE to enhance transparency of prediction and clinical utility.

2601.14160.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs adapted with the authors' synthetic dataset significantly outperform their baseline counterparts on German legal question answering tasks, highlighting the feasibility of using carefully designed synthetic data as a robust alternative to manual annotation in high-stakes, knowledge-intensive domains.

2601.14171.tldr: This work introduces the first multi-agents framework that reframes rebuttal generation as an evidence-centric planning task, and generates an inspectable response plan before drafting that ensures that every argument is explicitly anchored in internal or external evidence.

2601.14175.tldr: This model provides an alternative to suggestions that errors made by LLMs on long repetitive tasks indicate the ``collapse of reasoning'', or an inability to express ``compositional''functions, and shows how to construct prompts to reduce the error rate.

2601.14192.tldr: Efficiency from three core components of agents: memory, tool learning, and planning is investigated, considering costs such as latency, tokens, steps, etc, and characterize efficiency in two complementary ways.

2601.14209.tldr: Intervention Training is introduced, a training paradigm in which the model performs fine-grained credit assignment on its own reasoning traces by proposing short, targeted corrections that steer trajectories toward higher reward, and is shown to serve as a far better initialization for RL training.

2601.14230.tldr: This work proposes MASCOT, a generalizable framework for multi-perspective socio-collaborative companions that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and provides a practical roadmap for engineering the next generation of socially intelligent multi-agent systems.

2601.14232.tldr: KAGE-Env is introduced, a JAX-native 2D platformer that factorizes the observation process into independently controllable visual axes while keeping the underlying control problem fixed, providing a clean abstraction for visual generalization.

2601.14255.tldr: Video Mask-to-Matte Model (VideoMaMa) is presented that converts coarse segmentation masks into pixel accurate alpha mattes, by leveraging pretrained video diffusion models, and outperforms the same model trained on existing matting datasets in terms of robustness on in-the-wild videos.

2110.06726.tldr: A new algorithm is introduced that is able to construct formulas an order of magnitude larger than previous methods, and it is anytime, meaning that it in most cases successfully outputs a formula, albeit possibly not of minimal size.

2205.12787.tldr: This work utilises the game of Nim as a concrete and illustrative case study to reveal critical limitations of AlphaZero-style and similar self-play RL algorithms, and introduces a novel conceptual framework distinguishing between champion and expert mastery to evaluate RL agent performance.

2306.12150.tldr: A benchmark dataset is proposed that allows for quantifying explanation performance in a realistic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) classification task and shows that popular XAI methods applied to the same underlying model differ vastly in performance, even when considering only correctly classified examples.

2402.07191.tldr: This paper proposes Graph Sinkhorn Attention (GSINA), a fully differentiable, cardinality-constrained attention mechanism that assigns sparse-yet-soft edge weights via Sinkhorn iterations and induces node attention and uses a Gumbel reparameterization to stabilize training.

2403.04343.tldr: A novel Adaptive Task Balancing approach tailored for visual instruction tuning (VisATB), which measures two critical dimensions for visual task balancing based on validation performance and proposes prioritizing three categories of tasks with greater weight: those that offer substantial contributions to others, those that receive minimal contributions from others, and those that present high learning difficulties.

2403.05131.tldr: It is concluded that text-to-video generation is adept at world modeling, although homework in several aspects, such as the diversity-consistency trade-offs, remains to be addressed.

2404.00971.tldr: This study established a comprehensive taxonomy of code hallucinations, encompassing 3 primary categories and 12 specific categories, and performs an in-depth analysis on the causes and impacts of various hallucinations, aiming to provide valuable insights into hallucination mitigation.

2406.05516.tldr: This work introduces Verbalized Probabilistic Graphical Modeling (vPGM), a Bayesian agentic framework that guides LLM agents in following key principles of PGMs through natural language and refines the resulting posterior distributions via numerical Bayesian inference.

2406.11547.tldr: GECOBench, a rigorous quantitative evaluation framework for benchmarking popular XAI methods, is provided, showing a clear dependency between explanation performance and the number of fine-tuned layers, where XAI methods are observed to benefit particularly from fine-tuning or complete retraining of embedding layers.

2409.20302.tldr: This study systematically analyse similarities and differences between OM and OV and formalise an OM4OV framework to offer more advanced OV support and proposes an optimisation method called the cross-reference (CR) mechanism, which builds on existing OM alignments to reduce the number of matching candidates and to improve overall OV performance.

2410.14951.tldr: The Universal KAN (Uni-KAN) framework is introduced, a novel abstraction that formally unifies all KAN-style networks through dense and sparse representations and proves their interchangeability and provides an open-source library for this framework, facilitating future research.

2410.19360.tldr: LArctan-SKAN significantly improves test set accuracy over existing models, outperforming all pure KAN variants compared, and surpasses mixed MLP-based models such as MLP+rKAN and MLP+fKAN in accuracy.

2411.17792.tldr: H3Fusion is more helpful, less harmful, and more honest in three aspects: it outperforms each individually aligned model by 11.37%, provides stronger robustness compared to the state-of-the-art LLM ensemble approaches by 13.77% and model-merging approaches by 6.18%.

2501.09328.tldr: This paper proposes Neural Honeytrace, a plug-and-play watermarking framework that operates without retraining, designing a training-free multi-step transmission strategy that leverages the long-tailed effect of backdoor learning to achieve efficient and robust watermark embedding.

2501.09595.tldr: This proof-of-concept study demonstrates IFRA’s potential as an automated, complementary approach for fall risk stratification in post-stroke patients, and shows promising discriminative capability, particularly for identifying high-risk individuals.

2501.19128.tldr: The proposed approach performs reward shaping not only by utilizing non-zero-reward transitions but also by employing the Semi-Supervised Learning technique combined with a novel data augmentation to learn trajectory space representations from the majority of transitions, thereby improving the efficacy of reward shaping.

2502.00681.tldr: This thorough survey of Quantized Graph Representation (QGR) learning, which represents the graph structure with discrete codes instead of conventional continuous embeddings, is undertaken to promote its rapid future prosperity and inspire future research.

2502.18770.tldr: Preference As Reward (PAR), a novel approach that leverages the latent preferences embedded within the reward model as the signal for reinforcement learning, is proposed and exhibited remarkable data efficiency, requiring only a single reference reward for optimal performance.

2503.10331.tldr: This paper introduces a dynamically configurable and highly automated LLM/LVLM-powered pipeline for evaluating OSM solutions called OSMa-Bench (Open Semantic Mapping Benchmark), and introduces a scene graph evaluation method to analyze the ability of models to interpret semantic structure.

2504.16918.tldr: OptAI, a framework for solving Optimization problems described in natural language by leveraging LLM-powered AI agents, and achieve superior performance over current state-of-the-art methods is introduced.

2505.15091.tldr: ThinkRec is a thinking-based framework that shifts LLM4Rec from System 1 to System 2 (rational system) and introduces a thinking activation mechanism that augments item metadata with keyword summarization and injects synthetic reasoning traces, guiding the model to form interpretable reasoning chains.

2505.16888.tldr: This paper identifies a critical supply-chain vulnerability: conditional system prompt poisoning, where an adversary injects a ``sleeper agent''into a benign-looking prompt, and optimizes system prompts to trigger LLMs to output targeted, compromised responses only for specific queries.

2505.20310.tldr: A multi-agent system, Manalyzer, is proposed, which achieves end-to-end automated meta-analysis through tool calls, and achieves significant performance improvements over the LLM baseline in multi meta-analysis tasks.

2505.22843.tldr: This work proposes Aurora, a framework to evaluate malware classifiers based on their confidence quality and operational resilience, and investigates whether malware classifiers maintain reliable and stable confidence estimates under distribution shifts and exploring the tensions between scientific advancement and practical impacts when they do not.

2505.23062.tldr: CompFlow, a principled framework built on the theoretical connection between flow matching and optimal transport, is proposed, which model the online dynamics as a conditional flow built upon the output distribution of a pretrained offline flow, rather than learning it directly from a Gaussian prior.

2506.11106.tldr: PankRAG is proposed, a framework designed to capture and resolve the latent relationships within complex queries that prior methods overlook through a synergistic combination of a globally-aware hierarchical resolution pathway and a dependency-aware reranking mechanism.

2506.14170.tldr: A Progressive Multimodal Interaction Network (PMIN) is proposed that integrates image, audio, and water-wave data for fish feeding intensity quantification and outperforms both homogeneous and heterogeneous comparison models.

2507.00966.tldr: This paper proposes a novel hybrid architecture, MambAttention, which combines Mamba and shared time- and frequency-multi-head attention modules for generalizable single-channel speech enhancement and explores integrating the shared time- and frequency-multi-head attention modules with LSTM and xLSTM, which yields a notable performance improvement on the out-of-domain datasets.

2507.05386.tldr: A comparative analysis of two core post-training paradigms: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT), investigating their respective impacts on knowledge retention during CPT demonstrates the superiority of RFT as a robust paradigm for continual post-training.

2507.05999.tldr: This work proposes a structured post-hoc geo-registration method that accurately aligns LiDAR point clouds with satellite images where reliable GNSS information is unavailable or degraded, enabling city-scale geo-registration as a post-processing solution.

2507.19992.tldr: This proof-of-concept NIRS ontology demonstrates how clinical concepts can be formally represented and queried, offering a foundation for future validation, EHR integration, and evidence-based refinement of NIRS practices.

2508.03774.tldr: U-PINet is proposed, a fully end-to-end, physics-informed hierarchical network for efficient RCS prediction via 3D electromagnetic scattering reconstruction that achieves EM-solver-level RCS accuracy and 3D object reconstruction with orders-of-magnitude speedups, and generalizes well to unseen geometries under limited training data.

2508.04339.tldr: The Deliberative Reasoning Network is introduced, a novel paradigm that reframes logical reasoning from probability maximization to uncertainty minimization, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization, indicating that uncertainty-driven deliberation learns transferable reasoning principles.

2508.06433.tldr: This work proposes Memp, a dynamic repository that distills past agent trajectories into both fine-grained, step-by-step instructions and higher-level, script-like abstractions, and investigates strategies to endow agents with a learnable, updatable, and lifelong procedural memory.

2508.07690.tldr: Inspired by human cognitive processes of mastering unseen tools through discovering and applying the logical information from prior experience, a novel Logic-Guided Semantic Bridging framework for inductive tool retrieval is introduced, namely, LoSemB, which aims to mine and transfer latent logical information for inductive tool retrieval without costly retraining.

2508.17825.tldr: FairGamer is introduced, the first benchmark to evaluate social biases across three interaction patterns: transaction, cooperation, and competition, and reveals that larger LLMs display more severe social biases, suggesting that increased model capacity inadvertently amplifies these biases.

2509.01631.tldr: This work presents a novel neuron-level interpretability method that focuses on the role of safety-related knowledge neurons and proposes SafeTuning, a fine-tuning strategy that reinforces safety-critical neurons to improve model robustness against jailbreaks.

2509.03122.tldr: This work designs a rule-based code-mixing fingerprint that maps natural-query-like prompts to multi-candidate targets, reducing accidental triggering via high-complexity code-mixing formulations and introduces Multi-Candidate Editing (MCEdit), which jointly optimizes multi-candidate targets and enforces margins between target and non-target outputs to improve post-modification detectability.

2509.06093.tldr: This work recast synthesis planning as a text reasoning task enabled by a lightly structured text database, which preserves the conditional logic and causal contexts essential for expert-like decision-making in complex materials processing processes.

2509.09312.tldr: This work identifies minimal supports, minimal sub-tournaments in which the candidate is guaranteed to win regardless of how the rest of the tournament is completed, and shows how minimal supports can serve to produce compact, certified, and intuitive explanations for tournament solutions.

2509.10011.tldr: The Intrinsic Dimension Estimating Autoencoder is introduced, which identifies the underlying intrinsic dimension of a wide range of datasets whose samples lie on either linear or nonlinear manifolds and reconstructs the original dataset by working directly within the projection space identified by the network.

2509.19094.tldr: PoT models the thinking as an iterative decision process, where the model dynamically selects among cognitive operations such as reasoning, revision, personalization, and clarification, which enables exploration of multiple reasoning trajectories and yields a final personalized response that benefits from the complementary strengths of diverse reasoning paths.

2509.19774.tldr: PPGFlowECG is proposed, a two-stage framework that aligns PPG and ECG in a shared latent space using the CardioAlign Encoder and then synthesizes ECGs with latent rectified flow and supports scalable, wearable-first CVD screening when standard ECG acquisition is unavailable.

2509.22661.tldr: Experiments on real world ride hailing datasets demonstrate that the proposed model consistently outperforms state of the art methods, validating the effectiveness of semantic trajectory abstraction and dual stream spatiotemporal attention for individualized mobility behavior modeling.

2509.23885.tldr: Comprehensive evaluation on benchmark datasets, clinical data, photon counting CT data, and across all three anatomical planes demonstrates that EGenDiff enables extendable generalization multi-dose, yielding reconstructions that consistently outperform leading existing methods.

2509.25247.tldr: This work focuses on automatically sampling In-Context Learning (ICL) demonstrations which can improve model performance and enhance the interpretability of the generated code using AST-based analysis on outputs from the MBPP test set.

2510.00956.tldr: Using RouteNet-Fermi, it is shown that fine-tuning a pre-trained model with a small real dataset significantly improves performance and reduces the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) in packet delay prediction.

2510.01958.tldr: This work proposes RWSA-MambaUNet, a novel and efficient hybrid model combining Mamba and multi-head attention in a U-Net structure for improved cross-corpus performance, and achieves state-of-the-art generalization performance on two out-of-domain test sets.

2510.08593.tldr: HAREN-CTC is proposed, a hierarchical adaptive representation encoder with prior knowledge that disengages and re-aligns acoustic and semantic information through asymmetric cross-attention, enabling fine-grained acoustic patterns to be interpreted in semantic context.

2510.10111.tldr: The In-Context Forensic Chain (ICFC) is proposed, a training-free framework that leverages multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) for interpretable IML tasks and enables systematic exploitation of MLLM reasoning for image-level classification, pixel-level localization, and text-level interpretability.

2510.15231.tldr: This work introduces Partial YaRN, a training-free, modality-decoupled extension method that modifies only audio token positions, leaving text positions intact to preserve the base LLM's text capabilities, and proposes Virtual Longform Audio Training (VLAT), a training strategy that extends Partial YaRN into a training-time positional augmentation.

2510.16306.tldr: This work introduces ScaffAug, a scaffold-aware VS framework that addresses three major challenges: class imbalance, structural imbalance among active molecules where certain scaffolds dominate, and the need to identify structurally diverse active compounds for novel drug development.

2510.17795.tldr: Executable Knowledge Graphs (xKG), a pluggable, paper-centric knowledge base that automatically integrates code snippets and technical insights extracted from scientific literature, is proposed, demonstrating its effectiveness as a general and extensible solution for automated AI research replication.

2510.17932.tldr: This benchmark will drive advances in multimodal reasoning and foster the development of more robust and general-purpose LMMs, and is expected to drive advances in multimodal reasoning and foster the development of more robust and general-purpose LMMs.

2510.24709.tldr: It is hypothesized that ViTs represent whether two patches belong to the same object, a property the authors term IsSameObject, and it is discovered that IsSameObject is encoded in a low-dimensional subspace on top of object features, and that this signal actively guides attention.

2510.24909.tldr: This technical report introduces trust as a two-layer system with immediate trust responding to current behavior and reputation tracking violation history and develops a structured translation framework enabling practitioners to instantiate computational trust models from i* dependency networks encompassing mixed motives of actors.

2511.07301.tldr: This paper proposes a novel SFOD framework that leverages VFMs as external knowledge sources to jointly enhance feature alignment and label quality and designs three VFM-based modules that achieves state-of-the-art SFOD performance.

2511.09149.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that Interlat outperforms both fine-tuned chain-of-thought prompting and single-agent baselines, even across heterogeneous models, promoting more exploratory behavior and enabling genuine utilization of latent information.

2511.11689.tldr: This single arm naturalistic observational study provides initial evidence that a GAI foundation model for mental health can deliver accessible, engaging, effective, and safe mental health support.

2511.16107.tldr: A mechanism to generate and select text prompts that best implicitly describe the differences between two distinct low-level vision tasks, and a novel inference framework that combines perceptual score-based reasoning with traditional evaluation metrics to perform cross-task VICL are proposed.

2511.19699.tldr: Two new layers are proposed: an Agent Communication Layer (L8) and an Agent Semantic Layer (L9) that provide the foundation for scalable, distributed agent collaboration, enabling the next generation of multi-agentic systems.

2512.00332.tldr: Assertion-Conditioned Compliance (A-CC) is introduced, a novel evaluation paradigm for multi-turn function-calling dialogues that provides holistic metrics that evaluate a model's behavior when confronted with misleading assertions originating from two distinct vectors.

2512.03196.tldr: This study investigates whether physics-informed self-supervised VERDICT (ssVERDICT) fitting when combined with ultra-strong gradient data, enhances prostate microstructural characterization relative to current fitting approaches and clinical gradient systems and underscores that meaningful gains in non-invasive prostate cancer characterization arise from the combination of advanced gradient systems and deep learning-based modelling.

2512.07062.tldr: This paper introduces D3-Predictor, a noise-free deterministic diffusion-based dense prediction model built by reformulating a pretrained diffusion model without stochasticity noise that achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance in diverse scenarios.

2512.07404.tldr: This work identifies a correctness representation inside LLMs by contrasting the hidden states between pairs of correct and incorrect code for the same programming tasks, and demonstrates how leveraging internal representations can enhance code generation systems and make LLMs more reliable, thus improving confidence in automatically generated code.

2512.08809.tldr: PrivTune is an efficient and privacy-preserving fine-tuning framework via Split Learning that reduces the attack success rate to 10% with only a 3.33% drop in utility performance, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines.

2512.10758.tldr: A theoretically grounded framework for designing AI-resilient assessments is presented, supported by formal analysis and empirical validation, which translates into a practical assessment design procedure that enables educators to construct evaluations that promote deeper engagement, reflect industry practice, and resist trivial AI delegation.

2512.11509.tldr: This work investigates how three hallucination-reduction techniques: Chain of Verification (CoVe), Decoding by Contrasting Layers (DoLa), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), affect creativity in LLMs and finds that these methods have opposing effects on divergent creativity.

2512.11771.tldr: This work formalizes threat models that encompass both white- and black-box access and two attack goals: fingerprint removal, which erases identifying traces to evade attribution, and fingerprint forgery, which seeks to cause misattribution to a target model.

2512.11893.tldr: The paper argues that UBI should be embedded within a broader socio-technical governance ecosystem encompassing skills development, proportional regulation, and creativity preservation within a broader socio-technical governance ecosystem encompassing skills development, proportional regulation, and creativity preservation.

2512.19691.tldr: This work audits MedCalc-Bench, a clinical benchmark for medical score computation whose labels were partly derived with LLM assistance, and develops a scalable physician-in-the-loop stewardship pipeline to reassess them.

2512.20260.tldr: A two-stage WSCOD framework consisting of Debate-Enhanced Pseudo Labeling and Frequency-Aware Progressive Debiasing, which significantly narrows the gap between weakly and fully supervised COD, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.

2512.20905.tldr: Diffusion Embedded Clustering (DiEC), an unsupervised framework that performs clustering by leveraging optimal intermediate representations from pretrained diffusion models, achieves excellent clustering performance across multiple benchmark datasets.

2512.24565.tldr: MCPAgentBench is proposed, a benchmark based on real-world MCP definitions designed to evaluate the tool-use capabilities of agents and introduces comprehensive metrics to measure both task completion rates and execution efficiency.

2601.01090.tldr: It is shown that toxic responses are more likely following toxic stimuli, and, at the same time, cumulative toxic exposure (repeated over time) significantly increases the probability of toxic responding, and the number of toxic stimuli alone enables accurate prediction of whether an agent will eventually produce toxic content.

2601.01129.tldr: This paper presents RovoDev Code Reviewer, an enterprise-grade LLM-based code review automation tool designed and deployed at scale within Atlassian's development ecosystem with seamless integration into Atlassian's Bitbucket.

2601.04339.tldr: Using offline, reward-weighted post-training with fully self-generated synthetic data, this approach enables improvements in multimodal image generation across four diverse T2I benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of reward-weighting both modalities and strategically designed post-training data.

2601.04854.tldr: Projected Autoregression establishes a concrete alternative to token-selection autoregression: language generation can be organized around continuous-state prediction with delayed discrete commitment, and exposes continuous state space as a broader algorithmic design space for language generation.

2601.06052.tldr: This work proposes mastery-gated, sample-level, soft reinforcement learning compression that penalizes long rollouts only when the model already solves the problem and has produced a shorter rollout, and shows two-way transfer between non-agent CoT and tool-use agents.

2601.06111.tldr: This work presents a general framework for constructing Social Digital Twins - virtual population replicas where Large Language Models serve as cognitive engines for individual agents, and demonstrates monotonic and bounded responses to policy variations, establishing behavioral plausibility.

2601.06196.tldr: MB-ICL is proposed, a manifold-based demonstration sampling framework for selecting in-context demonstrations that leverages latent representations extracted from frozen LLMs that outperforms standard ICL selection baselines in the majority of evaluated settings, with particularly strong gains on dialogue and summarization tasks.

2601.08223.tldr: Compared with existing methods, DNF uses lower-perplexity triggers, remains undetectable under fingerprint detection attacks, and is relatively robust to incremental fine-tuning and model merging.

2601.09117.tldr: It is shown how monetized, community-driven generative AI platforms can produce gendered harms, raising questions about consent, governance, and enforcement.

2601.11534.tldr: The proposed interviewer is a scalable, privacy-conscious solution that advances AI-assisted qualitative data collection and is built on a locally hosted large language model (LLM) that generates coherent dialogue while preserving data privacy.

2601.12003.tldr: This work introduces *robust CSGs* and their subclass *interval CSGs* and their subclass *interval CSGs* (ICSGs), which capture epistemic uncertainty about transition probabilities in CSGs, and proposes a novel framework for robust verification of these models under worst-case assumptions about transition uncertainty.

2601.12276.tldr: Results show that GPT-RAG provides more accurate cost and performance estimates than individual or crowd human estimates, while yielding comparable usability insights, and Repeated querying with response averaging significantly improves accuracy, suggesting that LLMs can emulate crowd aggregation effects consistent with the law of large numbers.

2601.12534.tldr: A novel gaze detection model that uses self-supervised eye movement reconstruction that can effectively leverage unlabeled video is developed and it is concluded self-supervised eye movement reconstruction is an effective method for encoding the affective signal they carry.

2601.12805.tldr: This work systematically evaluates a wide range of state-of-the-art general-purpose and biomedical LLMs, revealing substantial heterogeneity in gene-level reasoning capabilities and persistent challenges in generating faithful, complete, and literature-grounded functional interpretations.

2601.13563.tldr: The key insight: training these rotations with quantization reduces activation outliers and stabilizes extreme low bit training, where static methods collapse.

2601.13599.tldr: This work proposes Diffusion in Diffusion, a'draft-then-refine'framework designed to overcome the irreversibility and myopia problems inherent in block diffusion models, and sets a new benchmark for discrete diffusion models on the OpenWebText dataset.

2601.13704.tldr: This work proposes a reparameterization technique based on feature noise injection that enables joint optimization of performance and computational complexity during training using SGD-based methods and demonstrates the effectiveness of the method through three case studies.

2601.13761.tldr: DARC (Decoupled Asymmetric Reasoning Curriculum) is introduced, a two-stage framework that stabilizes the self-evolution process and consistently outperforms all baselines and approaches the performance of fully supervised models without relying on human annotations.

2601.13809.tldr: This work introduces a novel concept of autonomous aerial manipulation system capable of interpreting high-level natural language commands to retrieve objects and deliver them to a human user through real-world experiments for localization and navigation.

2601.13904.tldr: This work presents PREFAB, a low-budget retrospective self-annotation method that targets affective inflection regions rather than full annotation, and improves annotator confidence without degrading annotation quality.

2601.13964.tldr: RL-BioAug is proposed, a framework that leverages a label-efficient reinforcement learning (RL) agent to autonomously determine optimal augmentation policies and suggests its potential to replace conventional heuristic-based augmentations and establish a new autonomous paradigm for data augmentation.

2601.14235.tldr: This white paper surveys the current landscape of AI/ML across DESC's primary cosmological probes and cross-cutting analyses, revealing that the same core methodologies and fundamental challenges recur across disparate science cases.

2601.14259.tldr: Results confirm that the proposed framework enables efficient, real-time emotion recognition and adaptive feedback in applications such as intelligent customer service, virtual tutoring systems, and affective computing interfaces, marking an important step toward cloud-native affective computing and emotionally intelligent interactive systems.

2601.14263.tldr: Call2Instruct is presented, a novel end-to-end automated pipeline that integrates five sequential modules: audio processing, noise suppression, ASR, text processing, semantic extraction and vectorization, Q&A dataset generation using embedding-based similarity matching, and dataset validation through LLM fine-tuning.

2601.14265.tldr: The study aims to evaluate the effectiveness, reliability, and perceived usability of RAG based chatbots in higher education, exploring their potential to enhance educational practices and outcomes as well as supporting the broader adoption of AI technologies in language specific educational contexts.

2601.14268.tldr: Comparisons with humans in a gambling task with repeated happiness ratings reveal an emerging psychology of machines and have direct implications for AI ethics and for thinking about how LLMs might be integrated into clinical decision support and other high-stakes domains.

2601.14269.tldr: The findings suggest that the robustness of LLM safety boundaries cannot be inferred solely through single-turn tests; it is necessary to fully consider the wear and tear on safety boundaries caused by different interaction pressures and characteristics in extended dialogues.

2601.14271.tldr: This paper establishes an impossibility result for ontological neutrality: neutrality, understood as interpretive non-commitment and stability under incompatible extensions, is incompatible with the inclusion of causal or normative commitments at the foundational layer.

2601.14274.tldr: A two-phase framework that explicitly dividing, refining, and recombining multimodal representations as a principled strategy for advancing emotion recognition and demonstrates consistent improvements across multiple MERC backbones is proposed.

2601.14279.tldr: It is hypothesized that circular dependence between future queries and generation trajectories contributes to this difficulty in SIP, as marginal information in KV representations beyond position and prefill attention appears limited for importance prediction.

2601.14280.tldr: This work proposes a hallucination-free multi-agent generation framework that breaks down MCQ generation into discrete, verifiable stages, and introduces an agent-led refinement process that uses counterfactual reasoning and chain-of-thought to iteratively improve hallucination in question generation.

2601.14283.tldr: A benchmark to evaluate the performance of fifteen models across these different algorithmic foundations by assessing the pharmaceutical properties of the generated molecules and their docking affinities and poses with specified target proteins and identifies key improvement areas for each model category.

2601.14288.tldr: It is demonstrated that the DeepInflation agent can successfully discover simple and viable single-field slow-roll inflationary potentials consistent with the latest observations or any given $n_s and $r, and provide accurate theoretical context for obscure inflationary scenarios.

2601.14289.tldr: RPC-Bench is introduced, a large-scale question-answering benchmark built from review-rebuttal exchanges of high-quality computer science papers, containing 15K human-verified QA pairs, and a fine-grained taxonomy aligned with the scientific research flow is designed to assess models'ability to understand and answer why, what, and how questions in scholarly contexts.

2601.14298.tldr: This study proposes a Flexible Adaptive Sequencing mechanism with trust and safety modules, that can be used to implement safety guardrails for the development and deployment of LLMs.

2601.14302.tldr: The dual-domain approach achieves substantial temporal-spatial resource conservation while maintaining attack effectiveness, and enables practical deployment of comprehensive adversarial robustness testing in resource-constrained real-time applications where computational efficiency directly impacts mission success.

2601.14305.tldr: An explainable AI (XAI) framework based on an optimized Decision Tree classifier with both local and global importance methods: SHAP values that estimate feature attribution using local explanations, and Morris sensitivity analysis that identifies the feature importance in a global view is suggested.

2601.14310.tldr: A white-box, model-side adversary that fine-tunes lightweight LoRA adapters on the model while keeping the detector fixed is studied, and CORVUS, an efficient red-teaming procedure that learns to camouflage detector-visible telemetry under teacher forcing, is introduced.

2601.14311.tldr: Through analysis of 95 publications, this work identifies key methodologies concerning data generation, watermarking, bias measurement, data curation, data privacy, and the inherent trade-off between transparency and opacity.

2601.14323.tldr: This work proposes SILENTDRIFT, a stealthy black-box backdoor attack exploiting a fundamental security flaw in modern VLA systems: the combination of action chunking and delta pose representations creates an intra-chunk visual open-loop.

2601.14334.tldr: A novel self-supervised framework for SAR image despeckling based on score-based generative models operating in the transformed log domain, which exhibits significantly shorter inference times compared to many existing self-supervised techniques.

2601.14339.tldr: CityCube is introduced, a systematic benchmark designed to probe cross-view reasoning capabilities of current VLMs in urban settings and indicates the task correlations and fundamental cognitive disparity between VLMs and human-like reasoning.

2601.14346.tldr: DiSPA (Differential Substructure-Pathway Attention), a framework that models bidirectional interactions between chemical substructures and pathway-level gene expression, is presented, providing exploratory insights into region-specific drug sensitivity patterns without ground-truth validation.

2601.14351.tldr: This paper demonstrates that AI agents can achieve reliability without acquiring perfect components, but through careful orchestration of imperfect ones, and describes the architecture of such a system in practice: specialized agent teams organized into an organization with clear goals, coordinated through a remote code executor that keeps data transformations and tool invocations separate from reasoning models.

2601.14401.tldr: The paper develops a five-level analytical scale distinguishing simple iteration, cumulative iteration, parametric recursion, reflexive recursion, reflexive recursion, and meta-recursion, and proposes three operational criteria: state memory, rule evolvability, and reflexive visibility.

2601.14429.tldr: An automatic and scalable feature-extraction pipeline to measure data and code availability in transportation research is introduced, representing a critical step toward the automated measurement and monitoring of open science practices in transportation research.

2601.14437.tldr: A use case for wildfire search and rescue is designed to demonstrate the efficiency of the edge-enabled architecture, enabling high SAR coverage, reduced mission completion times, and a higher level of autonomy compared to traditional approaches.

2601.14438.tldr: A novel framework is presented that transforms a single frontal-view camera image into a concise natural language description, effectively capturing spatial layouts, semantic relationships, and driving-relevant cues, and integrates these features to generate contextually rich and detailed scene descriptions.

2601.14440.tldr: VisTIRA is introduced, a tool-integrated reasoning framework that enables structured problem solving by iteratively decomposing a given math problem into natural language rationales and executable Python steps to determine the final answer, and it is highlighted that modality gap severity inversely correlates with model size.

2601.14446.tldr: This paper explores diffusion LLMs for BBO, leveraging their bidirectional modeling and iterative refinement capabilities, and introduces masked diffusion tree search, which casts the denoising process as a step-wise Monte Carlo Tree Search that dynamically balances exploration and exploitation.

2601.14456.tldr: This work fine-tune a 1.7B-parameter LLM on 40,000 domain-problem-plan tuples from 10 IPC 2023 domains, and evaluates both in-domain and cross-domain generalization.
