2601.14470.tldr: An analysis of token consumption patterns in an LLM-MA system within the Software Development Life Cycle, aiming to understand where tokens are consumed across distinct software engineering activities, suggests that the primary cost of agentic software engineering lies not in initial code generation but in automated refinement and verification.

2601.14472.tldr: A vocoder that introduces prosody-guided harmonic attention to enhance voiced segment encoding and directly predicts complex spectral components for waveform synthesis via inverse STFT is proposed, setting a strong foundation for expressive neural vocoding.

2601.14475.tldr: A deep-learning model is demonstrated to automate the human-intensive process of fire perimeter determination using 12-channel, medium to high altitude aerial wildfire images similar to those used in current US wildfire missions and achieves 96% classification accuracy, 74% Intersection-over-Union(IoU), and 84% recall surpassing past methods.

2601.14476.tldr: A GPU-accelerated, open-source simulated annealing framework based on p-bits that models key device variability factors-timing, intensity, and offset-to reflect real-world device behavior and achieves a two-order magnitude speedup over CPU implementations on the MAX-CUT benchmark.

2601.14477.tldr: This work proposes XD-MAP, a novel approach to transfer sensor-specific knowledge from an image dataset to LiDAR, an entirely different sensing domain that does not require direct overlap between sensors and enables extending the angular perception range from a front-view camera to a full 360° view.

2601.14485.tldr: This work enhances the scalability of the group selection strategy by introducing a knee-point-based selection mechanism to identify a promising subset of activities before evaluating their combinations, and develops a multi-tree GP framework to evolve both types of rules simultaneously.

2601.14514.tldr: A "Just-in-Time" framework for simulation-based reasoning that demonstrates how reduced representations can be constructed online with minimal added computation and finds strong empirical support for this account over alternative models in a grid-world planning task and a physical reasoning task across a range of behavioral measures.

2601.14523.tldr: This work proposes PhyloEvolve, an LLM-agent system that reframes GPU-oriented algorithm optimization as an In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) problem, and introduces a phylogenetic tree representation that captures inheritance, divergence, and recombination among algorithm variants, enabling backtracking, cross-lineage transfer, and reproducibility.

2601.14525.tldr: This work builds an automated executor to implement ideas and launches large-scale parallel GPU experiments to verify their effectiveness, and thoroughly analyze the executed ideas and training dynamics to facilitate future efforts towards execution-grounded automated AI research.

2601.14553.tldr: It is shown that large language models suffer from similar limitations in their ability to approximate what decisions they would make under counterfactual knowledge in offsetting gender and race biases and overcoming sycophancy, and that access to the responses of a blinded replica enables fairer decisions, while providing greater transparency to distinguish implicit from intentionally biased behavior.

2601.14568.tldr: A fuzzy controller (FC-r) is developed based on key system parameters and inference-related metrics, where the spatiotemporal correlation of targets across adjacent video frames is leveraged and achieves a balance between resource utilization and inference performance.

2601.14589.tldr: KRIYA is an AI wellbeing companion that supports co-interpretive engagement with personal wellbeing data and discusses design implications for AI companions that support curiosity, self-compassion, and reflective sensemaking of personal health data.

2601.14595.tldr: IntelliSA is presented, an intelligent static analyzer for IaC security smell detection that integrates symbolic rules with neural inference, and demonstrates the best cost-effectiveness.

2601.14597.tldr: It is proved that for any dimension, any norm, and any norm-monotone cost function, there exists an $\epsilon$-DP staircase mechanism that is optimal among all additive mechanisms.

2601.14599.tldr: A bottom-up experiment pipeline is proposed that connects to multi-armed bandit learning with extremely large discrete action space, which offers theories to corroborate the experiment findings and reveals new understanding of the design choice.

2601.14609.tldr: Simulation studies and real-world clinical applications demonstrate that FedRD outperforms local and federated baselines in both estimation accuracy and prediction performance, providing an architecturally feasible solution for absolute risk assessment in privacy-restricted, multi-site clinical studies.

2601.14615.tldr: This work proposes SearchGym, a simulation environment designed to bootstrap robust search agents and introduces SearchGym-RL, a curriculum learning methodology that progressively optimizes agent policies through purified feedback, evolving from basic interactions to complex, long-horizon planning.

2601.14620.tldr: This work provides the first evidence that ALMs could address annotation scarcity in ambiguous emotion recognition, but highlights the need for more advanced prompting or generation strategies to handle highly ambiguous cases.

2601.14628.tldr: Neuromorphic Vision-Language-Action (NeuroVLA), a framework that mimics the structural organization of the bio-nervous system between the cortex, cerebellum, and spinal cord, is presented, a first deployment of a neuromorphic VLA on physical robotics, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

2601.14637.tldr: Forest-Chat is introduced, an LLM-driven agent for forest change analysis, enabling natural language querying across multiple RSICI tasks, including change detection and captioning, object counting, deforestation characterisation, and change reasoning, demonstrating that interactive, LLM-driven systems can support accessible and interpretable forest change analysis.

2601.14658.tldr: It is shown that tokenization can betray LLM reasoning through one-to-many token ID mappings, indicating that part of apparent reasoning deficiency originates in the tokenizer layer, motivating tokenizer-level remedies before incurring the cost of training ever-larger models on ever-larger corpora.

2601.14660.tldr: NeuroFilter is proposed, a guardrail framework that operationalizes contextual integrity by mapping norm violations to simple directions in the model's activation space, enabling detection even when semantic filters are bypassed, and reduces the computational inference cost by several orders of magnitude when compared to LLM-based agentic privacy defenses.

2601.14662.tldr: This work proposes AGEA (Agentic Graph Extraction Attack), a framework that leverages a novelty-guided exploration-exploitation strategy, external graph memory modules, and a two-stage graph extraction pipeline combining lightweight discovery with LLM-based filtering that significantly outperforms prior attack baselines under identical query budgets.

2601.14667.tldr: Infection-Aware Guard, INFA-Guard is proposed, a novel defense framework that explicitly identifies and addresses infected agents as a distinct threat category, and achieves state-of-the-art performance, reducing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) by an average of 33%, while exhibiting cross-model robustness, superior topological generalization, and high cost-effectiveness.

2601.14672.tldr: GEGO is evaluated on standard unimodal, multimodal, and composite benchmark functions from the CEC2017 suite, where it consistently outperforms its constituent algorithms and several classical metaheuristics in terms of solution quality and robustness.

2601.14673.tldr: Across multiple neural network architectures and market scenarios, the convexified ReLU DNN achieves solution quality comparable to PWL and MIP-based reformulations while significantly improving computational performance and preserving model fidelity, unlike penalty-based reformulations.

2601.14677.tldr: This review summarises modern techniques by examining architectural innovations, generative model integration, and the use of temporal information to enhance robustness and accuracy of semantic object detection by covering CNN-based detectors, GAN-assisted approaches, and temporal fusion methods.

2601.14678.tldr: Cross-domain classification performance among lung, colon, breast, and kidney adenocarcinomas is evaluated and using Integrated Gradients reveals that DANNs consistently attribute importance to biologically meaningful regions such as densely packed nuclei, indicating that the model learns clinically relevant features and can apply them to unlabeled cancer types.

2601.14679.tldr: HCVR (High Compatibility Virtual Reality Environment Generation) is introduced, a novel framework that generates virtual scenes inherently optimized for alignment-based RDW controllers and employs ENI++, a novel, boundary-sensitive metric to evaluate the incompatibility between physical and virtual spaces.

2601.14683.tldr: A Structured Framework for Adaptive Anonymizer (SFAA) is introduced that includes three steps: detection, classification, and adaptive anonymization that incorporates four anonymization strategies: rule-based substitution, context-aware rewriting, generalization, and suppression.

2601.14686.tldr: IB-GRPO (Indicator-Based Group Relative Policy Optimization), an indicator-guided alignment approach for LLM-based LPR, uses the dominance indicator to compute group-relative advantages over multiple objectives, avoiding manual scalarization and improving Pareto trade-offs.

2601.14693.tldr: This work forms symbolic regression as a goal-conditioned reinforcement learning problem and incorporate hindsight experience replay, allowing the action-value network to generalize common mapping patterns from diverse input-output pairs, and designs an all-point satisfaction binary reward function that encourages the action-value network to focus on structural patterns rather than low-error expressions.

2601.14694.tldr: GNN memorization is established as a new perspective for understanding graph unlearning and MGU, a Memorization-guided Graph Unlearning framework is proposed, a Memorization-guided Graph Unlearning framework that provides accurate and practical difficulty assessment across different GU tasks and develops an adaptive strategy that dynamically adjusts unlearning objectives based on difficulty levels.

2601.14695.tldr: The proposed CoScale-RL is able to improve an LRM's ability boundary without an extensive SFT dataset and provides a new scaling direction to further improve LRM's reasoning ability.

2601.14697.tldr: OCR-text consistently matches or surpasses standard text embeddings for Semantic ID learning in both unimodal and multimodal settings, and OCR-based Semantic IDs remain robust under extreme spatial-resolution compression, indicating strong robustness and efficiency in practical deployments.

2601.14702.tldr: This work presents AutoDriDM, a decision-centric, progressive benchmark with 6,650 questions across three dimensions - Object, Scene, and Decision, and evaluates mainstream VLMs to delineate the perception-to-decision capability boundary in autonomous driving, and reveals weak alignment between perception and decision-making performance.

2601.14705.tldr: POEM (Proximal Policy Optimization with Evolutionary Mutations with Evolutionary Mutations), a novel modification to PPO that introduces an adaptive exploration mechanism inspired by evolutionary algorithms, is proposed.

2601.14710.tldr: The Implicit Bayesian Markov Decision Process (IBMDP), a model-based RL framework designed for such simulator-free settings, achieves significantly higher alignment with this optimal policy than a deterministic value iteration alternative that uses the same similarity-based model, demonstrating the superiority of the ensemble planner.

2601.14711.tldr: GRPO-Adaptive is introduced, an efficient LLM post-training strategy that enhances both reasoning and numerical precision by dynamically updating the reference policy during training, and DARA is proposed, a novel dual-phase framework that decomposes the decision-making process into two stages.

2601.14713.tldr: QuFid is presented, an adaptive and noise-aware framework that determines measurement budgets online by leveraging circuit structure and runtime statistical feedback and significantly reduces measurement cost compared to fixed-shot and learning-based baselines while consistently maintaining acceptable fidelity bias.

2601.14716.tldr: The proposed offline RL method provides superior training stability and efficiency over standard online RL methods such as GRPO, and demonstrates offline RL as a stable and efficient paradigm for advancing reasoning in LLMs.

2601.14728.tldr: AQAScore is introduced, a backbone-agnostic evaluation framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of audio-aware large language models (ALLMs) and reformulates assessment as a probabilistic semantic verification task; rather than relying on open-ended text generation, it estimates alignment by computing the exact log-probability of a"Yes"answer to targeted semantic queries.

2601.14730.tldr: Extensive evaluation demonstrates that FSX achieves superior explanation fidelity with significantly reduced runtime, while providing unprecedented insights into the structural logic underlying model predictions--specifically, how important sub-structures exert influence by governing the stability of key internal computational pathways.

2601.14764.tldr: An overview of types of ASP explanations in connection with user questions for explanation is provided, guided by an XAI perspective, and how their coverage by current theory and tools is described is described.

2601.14765.tldr: This work proposes an anytime, yet complete approach leveraging limited discrepancy search, distributing the computational effort more evenly across the entire tree structure, and thus ensuring that a high-quality decision tree is available at any interruption point.

2601.14773.tldr: This work designs a novel frame-level semantic alignment attention mechanism and integrates it into a keyframe selector, which guides the Transformer-based generator within the adversarial framework to better reconstruct videos.

2601.14777.tldr: Experiments across monologue, narration, dialogue, and multi-speaker scenes show that the proposed FunCineForge dubbing model consistently outperforms SOTA methods in audio quality, lip sync, timbre transfer, and instruction following.

2601.14780.tldr: Recognizing and navigating client resistance is critical for effective mental health counseling, yet detecting such behaviors is particularly challenging in text-based interactions, so PsyFIRE, a theoretically grounded framework capturing 13 fine-grained resistance behaviors alongside collaborative interactions, is proposed.

2601.14784.tldr: This work derives the first bound-consistent algorithm for the no-overlap constraint by building on the no-overlap MDD defined by Cir\'e and van Hoeve, and limits the width of the MDD to a threshold, creating a relaxed MDD that can be used to relax the bound-consistent filtering.

2601.14786.tldr: This paper constrain the number of trainable parameters in the generative model to match that of the MusicGen-small benchmark, and replace its Transformer backbone with the emerging class of state-space models (SSMs).

2601.14790.tldr: Partitioning the complex interaction logic of UI components into a set of unified tool primitives accessible to agents is introduced, a semantic encapsulation mechanism that abstracts the complex interaction logic of UI components into a set of unified tool primitives accessible to agents.

2601.14822.tldr: This system advances melanoma detection by providing a scalable, equipment-independent solution suitable for diverse healthcare environments, bridging the gap between specialized and general clinical practices.

2601.14827.tldr: This work investigates how to quantify and mitigate abstraction errors by leveraging medical taxonomies and proposes risk-constrained thresholding and taxonomy-aware fine-tuning with radial embeddings, which reduce severe abstraction errors to below 2 per cent while maintaining competitive performance.

2601.14844.tldr: Conditionally-Adaptive Gaussian Avatars (CAG-Avatar), a framework that resolves this key limitation of current animation techniques, is introduced, which confirms a significant improvement in reconstruction fidelity, particularly for challenging regions such as teeth, while preserving real-time rendering performance.

2601.14848.tldr: Multi-layered LSTM architecture to train the AoI model with ExiD drone dataset is utilized and the results show great promise on horizons up to 4 seconds with prediction accuracy starting from about 76% for the AoI and 94% for the general highway scenarios on the maximum horizon.

2601.14875.tldr: A novel hybrid NeRF framework, called Geometry-Aware-Transformer-Enhanced NeRF (GAT-NeRF) for high-fidelity and controllable 4D facial avatar reconstruction, which integrates the Transformer mechanism into the NeRF pipeline.

2601.14888.tldr: This study presents a systematic empirical study of quantization-aware training (QAT) for reasoning models, and shows that it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PTQ methods across multiple LLM backbones and reasoning datasets.

2601.14894.tldr: A neuro-symbolic method that reliably outputs predictions consistent with a Description Logic ontology that formalizes domain-specific knowledge is developed, and a tighter integration between the Deep Learning and Knowledge Representation fields is obtained.

2601.14895.tldr: Experiments show that SpatialMem maintains stable layout reasoning, offline guidance, and hierarchical retrieval across these evaluated scenes despite increasing clutter and occlusion, and position SpatialMem as an efficient and extensible memory interface for spatially grounded long-horizon video understanding.

2601.14901.tldr: This paper argues that awareness offers a more productive and methodologically tractable alternative to artificial consciousness, and introduces a practical method for evaluating awareness across diverse systems, where awareness is understood as encompassing a system's abilities to process, store and use information in the service of goal-directed action.

2601.14917.tldr: A deep learning-based approach for personalized blood glucose prediction, leveraging patient-specific data to improve prediction accuracy and responsiveness in real-world scenarios, and shows that personalized models significantly improve the prediction of adverse events, enabling more precise and timely interventions in real-world scenarios.

2601.14921.tldr: This work investigates the deployment of VLMs on ORAN/MEC infrastructure using the Unitree G1 humanoid robot as an embodied testbed and designs a WebRTC-based pipeline that streams multimodal data to an edge node and evaluates LLaMA-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct deployed at the edge versus in the cloud under real-time conditions.

2601.14925.tldr: The resulting model, Fast-ULCNet, performs on par with the state-of-the-art original ULCNet architecture on a speech enhancement task, while reducing its model size by more than half and decreasing its latency by 34% on average.

2601.14945.tldr: This work proposes TIDAL (Temporally Interleaved Diffusion and Action Loop), a hierarchical framework that decouples semantic reasoning from high-frequency actuation for diffusion-based VLAs, and addresses the insensitivity of static vision encoders to velocity by incorporating a differential motion predictor.

2601.14952.tldr: CorpusQA is introduced, a new benchmark scaling up to 10 million tokens, generated via a novel data synthesis framework that indicates that memory-augmented agentic architectures offer a more robust alternative, suggesting a critical shift is needed from simply extending context windows to developing advanced architectures for global information synthesis.

2601.14955.tldr: The Transition-Aware Graph Attention Network (TGA) is proposed, a linear-complexity approach for modeling multi-behavior transitions that outperforms all state-of-the-art models while significantly reducing computational cost.

2601.14958.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark of modern LMs on a diverse corpus of Unicode and Romanized Sinhala shows that the Mistral-Nemo-Base-2407 model achieves the strongest predictive performance on Unicode text and the Mistral-7B-v0.3 model for Romanized text.

2601.14982.tldr: A unified framework that enables bounded, auditable, and least-privilege delegation across heterogeneous identity ecosystems is introduced that advances interoperable delegation and auditability and provides a foundation for future standardization, implementation, and integration of autonomous agents into trusted digital identity infrastructures.

2601.14994.tldr: This work investigates contamination dynamics in multilingual settings by fine-tuning several open-weight LLMs on varying proportions of Arabic datasets and evaluating them on original English benchmarks and proposes Translation-Aware Contamination Detection, which identifies contamination by comparing signals across multiple translated benchmark variants rather than English alone.

2601.15037.tldr: This work designs a self-evaluation mechanism based on knowledge restoration, which provides intrinsic feedback signals by projecting structured triplets into semantic consistency scores, and proposes a prompt optimizer based on a textual gradient that can internalize historical experiences to iteratively optimize prompts, which can better guide LLMs to handle subsequent extraction tasks.

2601.15038.tldr: A curriculum-based deep reinforcement learning (CB-DRL) framework designed to resolve instability in existing DRL models, which achieves high feasibility rates and competitive solution quality on out-of-distribution instances where standard DRL baselines fail.

2601.15042.tldr: This work presents a federated learning framework for brain tumor localization that enables multi-institutional collaboration without sharing sensitive patient data, and provides strong justification for federated learning when dealing with complex tasks and high-dimensional input data.

2601.15059.tldr: Unless organizations explicitly redesign decision boundaries or reassign responsibility away from individual decisions toward batch- or system-level ownership, responsibility vacuum remains an invisible but persistent failure mode in scaled agent deployments.

2601.15061.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework for differential privacy generation, which employs an Error Feedback Stochastic Gradient Descent method and introduces a reconstruction loss and noise injection mechanism into the training process.

2601.15064.tldr: A set of guidelines to aid researchers in designing effective incentive schemes for their studies is curated, called the Incentive-Tuning Framework, outlining how researchers can undertake, reflect on, and document the incentive design process.

2601.15077.tldr: This work model each agent as enforcing a distinct family of validity constraints on a shared solution state, and shows that a MAS implements a factorized composition of constraint-enforcement operators.

2601.15086.tldr: A benchmark that explicitly tests continual memory updating under partial observability is introduced, and classic recurrent models, despite their simplicity, demonstrate greater flexibility and robustness in memory rewriting tasks than modern structured memories, and transformer-based agents, which often fail beyond trivial retention cases.

2601.15111.tldr: An interpretable, information-theoretic framework for auditing unlearning using Partial Information Decomposition (PID), and proposes a representation-based risk score that can guide abstention on sensitive inputs at inference time, providing a practical mechanism to mitigate privacy leakage.

2601.15123.tldr: This paper investigates the robustness of promptable segmentation models to natural variations in bounding box prompts, and introduces BREPS, a method for generating adversarial bounding boxes that minimize or maximize segmentation error while adhering to naturalness constraints.

2601.15130.tldr: It is argued for a curriculum shift, emphasizing that true digital literacy relies not only in knowing how to use Generative AI, but also on knowing when not to use it, to help developers determine when to use Generative AI and, crucially, when to avoid it.

2601.15131.tldr: This paper presents a novel routing network embedding module which creates local node embedding vectors and a context-aware global graph representation and incorporates the remaining finite time horizon into the network embedding module to provide a proper routing context to the embedding module.

2601.15153.tldr: An automated agent-based system for visualization generation and a validated framework for systematically capturing human domain knowledge and codifying tacit expert knowledge into AI agents are proposed, demonstrating that non-experts can achieve expert-level outcomes in specialized domains.

2601.15161.tldr: This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented multi-agent framework designed to automate the generation of instance-specific evaluation rubrics, which provides a scalable and transparent foundation for both evaluating and improving medical LLMs.

2601.15164.tldr: V-CAGE, a closed-loop framework for generating robust, semantically aligned manipulation datasets at scale, is introduced with a context-aware instantiation mechanism that enforces geometric consistency during scene synthesis and a hierarchical instruction decomposition module to bridge the gap between abstract intent and low-level control.

2601.15177.tldr: This paper proposes a MEC-oriented solution in 5G mobile networks to detect network anomalies in real-time and in autonomic way and uses policies in order to provide an efficient and dynamic management system of the computing resources used in the anomaly detection process.

2601.15188.tldr: The study highlights the high potential of powerful LLMs for ABAP development processes, especially in iterative error correction, while smaller models perform significantly weaker.

2601.15195.tldr: A large-scale study of 33k agent-authored PRs made by five coding agents across GitHub finds that tasks related to documentation, CI, and build update achieve the highest merge success, whereas performance and bug-fix tasks perform the worst.

2601.15241.tldr: This paper formalizes retrieval as a sequence of candidate evidence sets and characterize conditions under which feasibility in the limit implies feasibility at finite retrieval depth, and shows that monotone truncation suffices to guarantee finite witnessability for individual queries.

2601.15267.tldr: The major difficulties involved in assessing LLM performance in the legal domain are analyzed, including outcome correctness, reasoning reliability, and trustworthiness, and existing evaluation methods and benchmarks are reviewed and categorized.

2601.15279.tldr: MolecularIQ enables fine-grained evaluation of reasoning over molecular graphs and reveals capability patterns that localize model failures to specific tasks and molecular structures, providing actionable insights into the strengths and limitations of current chemistry LLMs.

2601.15282.tldr: A comprehensive robotics benchmark, RBench, designed to evaluate robot-oriented video generation across five task domains and four distinct embodiments, and a refined four-stage data pipeline, resulting in RoVid-X, the largest open-source robotic dataset for video generation with 4 million annotated video clips.

2601.15286.tldr: An iterative test-time strategy in which a T2I model progressively refines its generations across multiple steps, guided by feedback from a vision-language model as the critic in the loop is proposed, which can be flexibly applied to a wide range of image generators and vision-language models.

2305.19922.tldr: This framework provides a new perspective on reinforcement learning, highlighting the importance of policy representation in determining optimal exploration-exploitation strategies, and demonstrates the effectiveness of this framework through its application to evolutionary and policy gradient-based approaches.

2404.11833.tldr: This work shows that by using LLMs to produce the code for the search components the authors can solve the entire datasets with 100\% accuracy with only a few calls to the LLM, and argues for a responsible use of compute resources.

2405.10739.tldr: This survey summarizes the timeline of representative efficient MLLMs, the current state of research in structures and strategies, and the applications, and the limitations of current efficient MLLM research and promising future directions are discussed.

2406.12205.tldr: An algorithm is proposed, which yields an exponential form of simple regret of $\exp ( - \Omega(n/H) )$ where $n$ is the number of data samples and $H$ denotes an instance-dependent hardness quantity that depends explicitly on the suboptimality gap of each action.

2409.06518.tldr: This study examines large language models' internal knowledge structures through the lens of historical Olympic medal tallies, evaluating LLMs on two tasks: retrieving medal counts for specific teams and identifying rankings of each team.

2501.06078.tldr: This work studies abductive explanations such as ''minimum sufficient reasons'', which correspond to sets of features in x that are enough to guarantee its classification, and counterfactual explanations based on the minimum distance feature changes one would have to perform in x to change its classification.

2501.12962.tldr: A necessary high-level introduction of both concepts targeting legal and computer science-oriented scholars and an in-depth analysis of the AI Act's relationship between legal non-discrimination regulations and algorithmic fairness are aimed at.

2501.15446.tldr: It is proved that SSV, in this specification, is NP-complete by constructing a polynomial-time reduction from 3-Satisfiability (3-SAT), and it is argued that more realistic verification scenarios likely face even greater complexity.

2503.03592.tldr: This article quantizes Llama3.3 70B on importance matrices written in three languages (English, Norwegian, and Malayalam) and evaluating them on the MixEval dataset in both English and Norwegian yielded non-significant results indicating that current quantization practices do not disproportionately harm multilingual performance.

2503.05793.tldr: MedSimAI, an AI-powered simulation platform that enables deliberate practice through interactive patient encounters with immediate, structured feedback, is developed, positioning MedSimAI as a scalable formative platform for history-taking and communication.

2504.00035.tldr: This paper proposes WIND (Watermarking via Implicit and Non-disruptive Disentanglement), a novel zero-watermarking, verifiable and implicit scheme that safeguards creative writing databases by providing verifiable copyright protection.

2504.03729.tldr: Predictive modeling, use of free text, and country-specific features advance state-of-the-art for duplicate detection in pharmacovigilance.

2505.03005.tldr: RADLADS is presented, a protocol for rapidly converting softmax attention transformers into linear attention decoder models, along with two new RWKV-variant architectures, and models converted from popular Qwen2.5 open source models in 7B, 32B, and 72B sizes.

2505.03336.tldr: RecLM is proposed, a unified framework that bridges the gap between retrieval and generation by instantiating three grounding paradigms under a single architecture: embedding-based retrieval, constrained generation over rewritten item titles, and discrete item-tokenizer generation.

2505.05577.tldr: Though a context-aware geometric deep learning method is found that outperforms the evaluated SoTA and domain-specific baseline methods, the model is unable to generalize to unseen cell types or incorporate additional modalities, highlighting PyTDC's capacity to facilitate an exciting avenue of research developing multimodal, context-aware, foundation models for open problems in biomedical AI.

2505.10309.tldr: A method for assessing commonsense knowledge in AI, specifically in large language models (LLMs), that incorporates empirically observed heterogeneity among humans by measuring the correspondence between a model's judgment and that of a human population is proposed.

2505.23709.tldr: SLIMP combines the appearance and the metadata of individual skin lesions with patient-level metadata relating to their medical record and other clinically relevant information and improves performance compared to other pre-training strategies on downstream skin lesions classification tasks highlighting the learned representations quality.

2505.24133.tldr: Experimental results show that R-KV consistently outperforms existing KV cache compression baselines across two mathematical reasoning datasets, and preserves nearly 100% of the full KV cache performance using only 10% of the KV cache, substantially outperforming existing KV cache baselines.

2506.03088.tldr: A novel variational-conditional model is proposed to learn to encode the space of hearing loss directly from recordings of neural activity in the auditory midbrain of healthy and noise exposed animals, to enable future development of parametrised hearing loss compensation models trained to directly restore normal neural coding in hearing impaired brains.

2506.09049.tldr: This work introduces VIKI-Bench, the first hierarchical benchmark tailored for embodied multi-agent cooperation, featuring three structured levels: agent activation, task planning, and trajectory perception, and proposes VIKI-R, a two-stage framework that fine-tunes a pretrained vision-language model (VLM) using Chain-of-Thought annotated demonstrations, followed by reinforcement learning under multi-level reward signals.

2506.14079.tldr: A novel form-filling benchmark consisting of 432 fields spread across 55 documents and 3 tasks, finding that baseline VLAs achieve less than 1% accuracy in most cases, primarily due to poor localization ability.

2506.18930.tldr: This work proposes a dynamic exploration scheme for constructing segment-proposal graphs, where the graph is built on demand during the search for optimal paths, and applies Q-learning to compute edge weights only for visited transitions and adaptively expand the action space when connectivity is insufficient.

2507.03251.tldr: Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCCs) are used as spectral features to bridge the gap between computational emotion processing and human auditory perception to improve robustness and feature diversity in Speech Emotion Recognition.

2507.11935.tldr: A comprehensive and structured overview of AI-Native ORAN for NTN is provided and the orchestrated AI-Native ORAN-based NTN framework is proposed and discussed its key technological enablers.

2507.14625.tldr: VTarbel is introduced, a two-stage, minimal-knowledge attack framework explicitly designed to evade detector-enhanced VFL inference and outperforms four state-of-the-art baselines, evades detection, and retains effective against three representative privacy-preserving defenses.

2507.14629.tldr: VMask is the first framework to offer a tunable privacy budget to defenders, allowing for flexible control over the levels of label privacy according to actual requirements, and achieves the best privacy-utility trade-off.

2507.21184.tldr: This work demonstrates that SLDAgent can automatically discover laws that exhibit consistently more accurate extrapolation than their established, human-derived counterparts across all tasks, showing that AI systems can understand their own scaling behavior, and can contribute novel and practical knowledge back to the research community.

2508.01693.tldr: SURE-Med, a unified framework that systematically reduces uncertainty across three critical dimensions: visual, distributional, and contextual, sets a new benchmark for reliability in medical report generation and offers a robust step toward trustworthy clinical decision support.

2508.04037.tldr: This paper designs an automatic pipeline to generate verifiable task trajectories for training and introduces Efficient Step-wise Reinforcement Learning to reduce the substantial computational overhead of long-horizon training and introduces a model enhancement method that integrates grounding and planning capabilities into a single model without additional training.

2508.04174.tldr: This paper presents EDQC, an effective framework for cohesive group discovery under explicit density constraints that leverages a lightweight energy diffusion process to rank vertices for localizing promising candidate regions and statistical analysis confirms that EDQC significantly outperforms the baselines.

2508.18665.tldr: This work designs several membership inference attacks (MIAs) aimed to revealing whether system prompts include victims' historical interactions, and confirms that the MIA threat to LLM RecSys is realistic: inquiry and poisoning attacks show significantly high attack advantages.

2508.20097.tldr: This work investigates whether large language models can discover and analyze U.S. tax-minimization strategies and identifies an entirely novel tax strategy, highlighting these models' potential to revolutionize tax agencies' fight against tax abuse.

2509.05882.tldr: The results show that an intervention agent that is robust to action modification significantly outperforms common alignment baselines in supporting correct task outcomes.

2509.16346.tldr: The results demonstrate that ForestGen3D enhances the utility of ALS only environments by inferring ecologically plausible sub-canopy structure while faithfully preserving the landscape heterogeneity encoded in ALS observations, thereby providing a richer 3D representation for ecological analysis, structural fuel characterization and related remote sensing applications.

2509.24592.tldr: Despite requiring more input context, the BPMN Assistant approach reduces generation latency by approximately 43% and output token count by over 75%, offering a more reliable and responsive solution for interactive process modeling.

2510.03129.tldr: This work proposes the Signature Informed Transformer to address the fundamental mismatch where minimizing prediction errors fails to yield robust portfolios, and employs path signatures to encode complex path dependencies and introduces a specialized attention mechanism that targets geometric asset relationships.

2510.04704.tldr: The AtomWorld benchmark is introduced to evaluate LLMs on tasks based in Crystallographic Information Files (CIFs), a standard structure representation format, and lays the ground for advancing LLMs toward robust atomic-scale modeling, crucial for accelerating materials research and automating scientific workflows.

2510.04842.tldr: This work introduces the first class of distributionally robust CAs and their associated learning algorithms and provides theoretical guarantees for both empirical and Gaussian environments, enabling principled selection of ambiguity set radii and establishing quantitative guarantees on worst-case abstraction error.

2510.17873.tldr: It is demonstrated that targeted, data-centric interventions can meaningfully improve fairness in gender classification and position BalancedFace as a practical resource for future research.

2510.24235.tldr: This work proposes the Preference-aware Task-adaptive Reward Model (PaTaRM), which enables robust pointwise training using readily available pairwise data via a novel Preference-Aware Reward (PAR) mechanism, eliminating the need for explicit rating labels.

2511.06943.tldr: This study introduces PlantTraitNet, a multi-modal, multi-task uncertainty-aware deep learning framework that predicts four key plant traits from citizen science photos using weak supervision and consistently outperforms existing trait maps across all evaluated traits.

2511.07603.tldr: This work proposes Homogeneous Expert Routing (HER), an MoE layer for Heterogeneous Graph Transformers (HGT) that stochastically masks type embeddings during routing to encourage type-agnostic specialization and demonstrates that regularizing type dependence in expert routing yields more generalizable, efficient, and interpretable representations--a new design principle for heterogeneous graph learning.

2511.10501.tldr: A comprehensive review of mainly GNN, DRL, and PTM methods with a focus on their potential incorporation in strategic multiagent settings, and champion the use of GNN as a potential answer to effectively modeling relationships and interactions in multiagent settings.

2511.16485.tldr: This work leverages Large Language Models to perceive evolutionary dynamics and enable operator-level meta-evolution, and achieves co-evolution of solutions and operators within a unified optimization framework, introducing a novel paradigm for enhancing the efficiency and adaptability of EAs.

2511.16665.tldr: Evaluations demonstrate that TLT achieves over 1.7x end-to-end RL training speedup over state-of-the-art systems, preserves the model accuracy, and yields a high-quality draft model as a free byproduct suitable for efficient deployment.

2511.20257.tldr: A physics-guided, interpretable-by-design spatiotemporal learning framework that decomposes the spatiotemporal behavior of air pollutant concentrations into two transparent, additive modules that provides a more reliable foundation for operational air-quality management in real-world applications.

2512.06193.tldr: GAUGE (Guarding Affective Utterance Generation Escalation), logit-based framework for the real-time detection of hidden conversational escalation, measures how an LLM's output probabilistically shifts the affective state of a dialogue.

2512.06247.tldr: DUET mimics how hardware design experts develop an understanding of complex designs: not just via a one-off readthrough of the RTL, but via iterative experimentation using a number of tools.

2512.19849.tldr: UCCL-EP is presented, a portable EP communication system that delivers DeepEP-level performance across heterogeneous GPU and NIC hardware and emulates various ordering semantics required by specialized EP communication modes using RDMA immediate data, enabling correctness on NICs that lack such ordering, e.g., AWS EFA.

2512.22431.tldr: This paper introduces Monadic Context Engineering (MCE), a novel architectural paradigm leveraging the algebraic structures of Functors, Applicative Functors, and Monads to provide a formal foundation for agent design that enables developers to construct complex, resilient, and efficient AI agents from simple, independently verifiable components.

2601.01747.tldr: A black-box jailbreak attack on LVLMs via Zeroth-Order optimization using Simultaneous Perturbation Stochastic Approximation (ZO-SPSA), which provides three key advantages: gradient-free approximation by input-output interactions without requiring model knowledge, model-agnostic optimization without the surrogate model and lower resource requirements with reduced GPU memory consumption.

2601.01910.tldr: Experimental results show that MMP-A*, a multimodal framework that integrates the spatial grounding capabilities of vision-language models with a novel adaptive decay mechanism achieves near-optimal trajectories with significantly reduced operational costs, demonstrating its potential as a perception-grounded and computationally efficient paradigm for autonomous navigation.

2601.06037.tldr: TeleMem is proposed, a unified long-term and multimodal memory system that maintains coherent user profiles through narrative dynamic extraction, ensuring that only dialogue-grounded information is preserved in long-term interactions.

2601.06487.tldr: This work proposes ArenaRL, a reinforcement learning paradigm that shifts from pointwise scalar scoring to intra-group relative ranking, and introduces a process-aware pairwise evaluation mechanism, employing multi-level rubrics to assign fine-grained relative scores to trajectories.

2601.06795.tldr: Group Dual-dynamic and Equal-right-advantage Policy Optimization (GDEPO), a method incorporating three core mechanisms that enhances data utilization and optimization efficiency, offering a novel training paradigm for ATP.

2601.07903.tldr: Inspired by in-context learning (ICL), LVICL uses the authors' vector-injected ICL to inject example information into a frozen LLM, eliciting its in-context learning ability and thereby enhancing its performance on the example-related task (i.e., TSF).

2601.11109.tldr: This work introduces VIGA (Vision-as-Inverse-Graphics Agent), an interleaved multimodal reasoning framework where symbolic logic and visual perception actively cross-verify each other, and introduces BlenderBench, a challenging visual-to-code benchmark.

2601.12061.tldr: This work proposes codebook-injected segmentation, which conditions boundary decisions on downstream annotation criteria, and evaluates LLM-based segmenters against standard and retrieval-augmented baselines, and introduces evaluation metrics for span consistency, distinctiveness, and human-AI distributional agreement.

2601.12471.tldr: MedAbstain is introduced, a unified benchmark and evaluation protocol for abstention in medical multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) -- a discrete-choice setting that generalizes to agentic action selection -- integrating conformal prediction, adversarial question perturbations, and explicit abstention options.

2601.13710.tldr: Findings support an ML-first, GenAI- augmented workflow: deploy calibrated ML for primary triage of surgical candidacy, with GenAI as an explainer to enhance transparency and shared decision-making.

2601.14264.tldr: Results indicate that feature-rich conditioning enhances validity but does not resolve systematic divergences in psychometric comparability, and future work should prioritize delineating the effective boundaries of digital twins, establishing the precise contexts in which they function as reliable proxies for human cognition and behavior.

2601.14691.tldr: By systematically rewriting agent CoTs while holding actions and observations fixed, it is demonstrated that manipulated reasoning alone can inflate false positive rates of state-of-the-art VLM judges by up to 90% across 800 trajectories spanning diverse web tasks.

2601.14758.tldr: Diffusion post-training does not simply adjust model parameters, but reorganizes internal computation to support non-sequential global planning and observes a transition from sharp, localized specialization in ARMs to distributed integration in MDMs.

2601.15120.tldr: RISE, a "Real-to-Virtual" method designed to mitigate intent deviation, synthesizes virtual trajectories and generates diverse negative samples through mutation on critical parameters and fine-tunes backbone LLMs via the two-stage training for intent alignment.

2601.15160.tldr: This work presents a post-training pipeline, based on a combination of supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL), in which knowledge graphs act as implicit reward models, and suggests that grounding the reasoning process in structured knowledge is a scalable and efficient path toward intelligent reasoning.

2601.15280.tldr: A real-time AI-facilitated multimodal feedback system that integrates structured textual explanations with dynamic multimedia resources, including the retrieved most relevant slide page references and streaming AI audio narration is introduced.

2601.15290.tldr: This framework establishes a powerful environment for orchestrating agents to simulate human users with cognitive plausibility, decomposing the simulation into specialized sub-agents that reflect distinct aspects of human thought processes applicable across interactive domains.

2601.15296.tldr: Entropy-Tree is proposed, a tree-based decoding method that exploits entropy as a signal for branching decisions--expanding the search tree only at positions where the model exhibits genuine uncertainty.

2601.15304.tldr: AIMM-X is presented, an explainable monitoring pipeline that combines market microstructure-style signals derived from OHLCV time series with multi-source public attention signals to surface time windows that merit analyst review.

2601.15305.tldr: Gated Sparse Attention (GSA) incorporates a gated lightning indexer with sigmoid activations that produce bounded, interpretable selection scores, an adaptive sparsity controller that modulates the number of attended tokens based on local uncertainty, and dual gating at the value and output stages.

2601.15306.tldr: The results indicate that AI systems is still imperfectly trained on noisy, sometimes non-causal signals that do not reliably reflect true patient acuity, and more needs to be done to ensure the safe and responsible deployment of AI technologies in clinical settings.

2601.15307.tldr: DeepSurvey-Bench is proposed, a novel benchmark designed to comprehensively evaluate the academic value of generated surveys, and proposes a comprehensive academic value evaluation criteria covering three dimensions: informational value, scholarly communication value, and research guidance value.

2601.15308.tldr: This article explores the integration of XR and GenAI through three concrete use cases, showing how they address key obstacles in scalability and natural interaction, and identifying technical challenges that must be resolved to enable broader adoption.

2601.15316.tldr: This is the first comprehensive survey to systematically document and analyze the transformative role of LVLMs in combating multimodal fake news, and establishes a structured taxonomy covering model architectures, datasets, and performance benchmarks.

2601.15319.tldr: The findings indicate that interview-grounded LLMs can produce coherent and above-chance simulations of neurodevelopmental traits, supporting their potential use as synthetic participants in early-stage psychometric research, while highlighting clear domain-specific constraints.

2601.15322.tldr: The DFAH is introduced, a framework for measuring trajectory determinism and evidence-conditioned faithfulness in tool-using agents deployed in financial services and Tier 1 models with schema-first architectures achieved determinism levels consistent with audit replay requirements.

2601.15326.tldr: ECGomics harmonizes diagnostic precision, interpretability, and data efficiency by providing a deployable software ecosystem, and establishes a robust foundation for digital biomarker discovery and personalized cardiovascular medicine.

2601.15330.tldr: This work proposes Illocution-Calibrated Policy Optimization (ICPO), a novel training framework that sensitizes the model to instruction ambiguity, and presents a practical path toward more robust and collaborative conversational AI that can better navigate the nuances of human interaction.

2601.15331.tldr: A resource-efficient adversarial prompting approach that eliminates the need for retraining by matching new prompts to a database of pre-trained adversarial prompts, providing a practical framework for scalable red-teaming and security evaluation of aligned LLMs, including in settings where model internals are inaccessible.

2601.15334.tldr: It is found that models consistently deny being sentient: they attribute consciousness to humans but not to themselves, and classifiers trained to detect underlying beliefs provide no clear evidence that these denials are untruthful.

2601.15335.tldr: Extensive experiments on synthetic and public tool-calling workloads demonstrate that ToolCaching with VAAC achieves up to 11% higher cache hit ratios and 34% lower latency compared to standard policies, effectively accelerating LLM tool-calling in practical applications.

2601.15336.tldr: This work presents an experimental framework for training CANs to perform successor-like transitions between stable attractor states in the absence of externally provided displacement signals, and demonstrates that topology strictly limits the capacity for learned transitions.

2601.15339.tldr: A multilingual speech-driven framework for code understanding that accepts spoken queries in a user native language, transcribes them using Automatic Speech Recognition, applies code-aware ASR output refinement using Large Language Models (LLMs), and interfaces with code models to perform tasks such as code question answering and code retrieval through benchmarks such as CodeSearchNet, CoRNStack, and CodeQA are developed.

2601.15347.tldr: A systematic theory, technique and application of the concept'knowledge graph network' and its application in medical and healthcare domain and its definition, development, reasoning, computing and application under different conditions such as unsharp, uncertain, multi-modal, vectorized, distributed, federated is developed.

2601.15348.tldr: Gen-AI significantly reduces vocal aggressiveness, with acoustic analysis showing improvements in Harmonic to Noise Ratio, Cepstral Peak Prominence, and Shimmer, and sentiment analysis reduced aggression by 63.3-85.6%, with major improvements in chorus sections.

2601.15351.tldr: OmniSpectra is the first foundation model to learn simultaneously from multiple real-world spectra surveys with different configurations at a large scale, establishing itself as the next-generation astronomy foundation model.

2601.15369.tldr: A family of advanced vision encoder that learns a single, unified visual representation that can serve both image understanding and image generation, and provides empirical evidence that generation and understanding are mutually beneficial in the architecture.

2601.15370.tldr: The model learns implicit modality-aware allocation, routing vision tokens to null experts more aggressively than text, without explicit modality routing, and yields a more compute-efficient frontier than weight sparsity alone.

2601.15392.tldr: GeMM-GAN is presented, a novel Generative Adversarial Network conditioned on histopathology tissue slides and clinical metadata, designed to synthesize realistic gene expression profiles and outperforms standard generative models and generates more realistic and functionally meaningful gene expression profiles.

2601.15395.tldr: This work introduces Chameleon, a dataset of 5,001 contextual psychological profiles from 1,667 Reddit users, each measured across multiple contexts, and finds that reward models react to user state, but inconsistently: different models favor or penalize the same users in opposite directions.

2601.15408.tldr: CURE fine-tunes a multimodal instructional model on phrase grounding, grounded report generation, and anatomy-grounded report generation using public datasets and dynamically adjusts sampling based on model performance, emphasizing harder samples to improve spatial and textual alignment.

2601.15412.tldr: An operational checklist is contributed to help guide the development and design of more trustworthy, safe, and user-friendly chatbots to ensure ethical and effective chatbot design.

2601.15416.tldr: Experimental results on the LUNA16 and ToothFairy datasets demonstrate that DuFal significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in preserving high-frequency anatomical features, particularly under extremely sparse-view settings.

2601.15417.tldr: Ambient Dataloops is an iterative framework for refining datasets that makes it easier for diffusion models to learn the underlying data distribution, and a dataset-model co-evolution process; at each iteration of the method, the dataset becomes progressively higher quality, and the model improves accordingly.

2601.15442.tldr: This work introduces a tensor network formalism, which captures sparsity principles originating in the different approaches in tensor decompositions, and describes a basis encoding scheme for functions and model neural decompositions as tensor decompositions.

2601.15457.tldr: Results demonstrate that two-stage retrieval mechanisms are essential for achieving the precision required for domain-specific policy question answering, though structural constraints in document segmentation remain a significant bottleneck for multi-step reasoning tasks.

2601.15473.tldr: Panther is presented, a PyTorch-compatible library that consolidates established RandNLA algorithms into a single high-performance framework and achieves significant memory savings on BERT while maintaining comparable loss.

2601.15476.tldr: It is concluded that trustworthy legal AI requires rigor-focused, retrieval-based architectures emphasizing verification and traceability, and provides an evaluation framework applicable to other high-risk domains.

2601.15479.tldr: A unified evaluation framework is provided, built on a dataset validated with high inter-annotator agreement, and all data, code, and prompts publicly available to spur further research on pairwise causal discovery from text.

2601.15482.tldr: This paper introduces Martingale Foresight Sampling (MFS), a principled framework that reformulates LLM decoding as a problem of identifying an optimal stochastic process by modeling the quality of a reasoning path as a stochastic process.

2601.15484.tldr: It is found that semantic similarity between the two platforms decays across article sections and diverges more strongly on controversial topics than on randomly sampled ones and that both encyclopedias predominantly exhibit left-leaning framings.

2601.15485.tldr: Findings provide large-scale evidence that the rise of LLMs is reshaping how scientific ideas are positioned, selected, and translated into publicly funded research, with implications for portfolio governance, research diversity, and the long-run impact of science.

2601.15487.tldr: By automating the creation of gold standard evaluation datasets that reflect the latent thematic structure of proprietary corpora, MiRAGE provides the necessary infrastructure to rigorously benchmark the next generation information retrieval systems.

2601.15488.tldr: This work proposes Multi-Persona Thinking (MPT), a simple inference-time framework that reduces social bias by encouraging reasoning from multiple perspectives and achieves a lower bias than the existing prompting-based methods while maintaining the core reasoning ability.

2601.15495.tldr: This work introduces TRACK (Testing Reasoning Amid Conflicting Knowledge), a new benchmark for studying how LLMs propagate new knowledge through multi-step reasoning when it conflicts with the model's initial parametric knowledge.

2601.15533.tldr: This survey argues that visual realism is an unreliable proxy for world understanding, and proposes a reframing of world models as actionable simulators rather than visual engines, emphasizing structured 4D interfaces, constraint-aware dynamics, and closed-loop evaluation.

2601.15538.tldr: This paper analyzes why low-bit quantization undermines unlearning, and proposes a quantization-aware unlearning method to mitigate this, and introduces a logits space hinge loss that ensures forgotten examples remain distinguishable even after quantization.

2601.15539.tldr: The results demonstrate that direct pixel-level learning captures diagnostic patterns beyond handcrafted features and that purpose-built lightweight architectures can outperform large pretrained models for small, domain-specific medical datasets.

2601.15544.tldr: RDumb++ is proposed, a principled extension of RDumb that introduces two drift-detection mechanisms i.e entropy-based drift scoring and KL-divergence drift scoring, together with adaptive reset strategies that allow the model to detect when accumulated adaptation becomes harmful and to recover before prediction collapse occurs.

2601.15549.tldr: VIOLA (Video In-cOntext Learning with minimal Annotation), a label-efficient framework that synergizes minimal expert supervision with abundant unlabeled data and significantly outperforms various baselines in low-resource settings, achieving robust adaptation with minimal annotation costs.

2601.15551.tldr: ALIGNAgent (Adaptive Learner Intelligence for Gap Identification and Next-step guidance) is a multi-agent educational framework designed to deliver personalized learning through integrated knowledge estimation, skill-gap identification, and targeted resource recommendation.

2601.15575.tldr: Results show that PromptHelper significantly increases users' perceived exploration and expressiveness without increasing cognitive workload, and Qualitative findings illustrate how prompt recommendations help users branch into new directions, overcome uncertainty about what to ask next, and better articulate their intent.

2601.15578.tldr: This paper introduces MapViT, a two-stage Vision Transformer (ViT)-based framework inspired by the success of pre-train and fine-tune paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs), designed to predict both environmental changes and expected radio signal quality.

2601.15593.tldr: The results show that MDLMs still lag behind comparably sized autoregressive models, mainly because parallel probabilistic modeling weakens inter-token dependencies and a Generate-then-Edit paradigm is provided, which mitigates dependency loss while retaining the efficiency of parallel decoding.

2601.15595.tldr: Data-Free Selective Unlearning (DFSU) is proposed, a novel privacy-preserving framework that removes sensitive PII from an LLM without requiring its training data.

2601.15596.tldr: DeepASMR is introduced, the first framework designed for zero-shot ASMR generation and it is demonstrated that a single short snippet of a speaker's ordinary, read-style speech is sufficient to synthesize high-fidelity ASMR in their voice, eliminating the need for whispered training data from the target speaker.

2601.15625.tldr: Fission-GRPO is proposed, a framework that converts execution errors into corrective supervision within the RL training loop, and improves the error recovery rate of Qwen3-8B by 5.7% absolute and outperforming specialized tool-use agents.

2601.15626.tldr: It is demonstrated that GenAI, when paired with a structured, criterion-referenced framework using binary questions, can grade engineering mathematical assessments with an accuracy comparable to human experts.

2601.15628.tldr: CogToM is introduced, a comprehensive, theoretically grounded benchmark comprising over 8000 bilingual instances across 46 paradigms, validated by 49 human annotator and reveals significant performance heterogeneities and highlights persistent bottlenecks in specific dimensions.

2601.15630.tldr: A proposed Unified Agent Lifecycle Management blueprint derived from a rapid, practice-oriented synthesis of governance standards, agent security literature, and healthcare compliance requirements offers healthcare CIOs, CISOs, and clinical leaders an implementable pattern for audit-ready oversight that preserves local innovation and enables safer scaling across clinical and administrative domains.

2601.15652.tldr: This work demonstrates that domain knowledge encoded in signal architecture provides superior data efficiency compared to scaling LLM judges, achieving strong performance with lightweight (less than 1M parameter), explainable models suitable for production deployment.

2601.15655.tldr: This work introduces Event-VStream, an event-aware framework that represents continuous video as a sequence of discrete, semantically coherent events that triggers language generation only at those boundaries that enable long-horizon reasoning while maintaining low latency.

2601.15657.tldr: This work proposes SMSKD (Sequential Multi Stage Knowledge Distillation), a flexible framework that sequentially integrates heterogeneous KD methods, and introduces an adaptive weighting mechanism based on the teacher true class probability that dynamically adjusts the reference loss per sample to balance knowledge retention and integration.

2601.15663.tldr: TempoNet is introduced, a novel generative model that combines multi-task learning with multi-mark temporal point processes to jointly model inter-arrival times and all packet- and flow-header fields and produces temporally consistent, high-fidelity traces, validated on real-world datasets.

2601.15664.tldr: Skywork UniPic 3.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance on single-image editing benchmark and surpasses both Nano-Banana and Seedream 4.0 on multi-image composition benchmark, thereby validating the effectiveness of the data pipeline and training paradigm.

2601.15671.tldr: This work presents StreetDesignAI, an interactive system that enables designers to ground evaluation in real street context through imagery and map data, receive parallel feedback from simulated cyclist personas spanning confident to cautious users, and iteratively modify designs while the system surfaces conflicts across perspectives.

2601.15679.tldr: The primary focus was on understanding methodological issues in conducting such tests, rather than examining test results or model capabilities, which marks an important step forward as participants work together to advance the science of agentic evaluations.

2601.15687.tldr: This work proposes FARM (Field-Aware Resolution Model), a two-stage architecture for automated applet generation with full configuration that achieves 81% joint accuracy on Gold and achieves 81% joint accuracy on Gold at the function level, where both trigger and action functions must match the ground truth.

2601.15690.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive overview, critical analysis, and practical design patterns, arguing that mastering the new trend of uncertainty is essential for building the next generation of scalable, reliable, and trustworthy AI.

2601.15698.tldr: Beyond Visual Safety (BVS) is proposed, a novel image-text pair jailbreaking framework specifically designed to probe the visual safety boundaries of MLLMs, exposing critical vulnerabilities in the visual safety alignment of current MLLMs.

2601.15703.tldr: A unified Dual-Process Agentic UQ (AUQ) framework that transforms verbalized uncertainty into active, bi-directional control signals and enables the agent to balance efficient execution and deep deliberation dynamically.

2601.15706.tldr: This work represents an initial step toward a shared framework for multilingual safety testing of advanced AI systems and calls for continued collaboration with the wider research community and industry.

2601.15709.tldr: Agent Semantic Memory (AgentSM), an agentic framework for Text-to-SQL that builds and leverages interpretable semantic memory that enables systematic reuse of reasoning paths, which allows agents to scale to larger schemas, more complex questions, and longer trajectories efficiently and reliably.

2601.15710.tldr: FlexLLM bridges algorithmic innovation in LLM inference and high-performance accelerators with minimal manual effort, and provides a comprehensive quantization suite to support accurate low-bit deployment.

2601.15717.tldr: This study systematically investigates the generalisation ability of GP-evolved scheduling rules under diverse DFJSS conditions and provides new insights into the generalisation ability of GP in DFJSS.

2601.15721.tldr: This work proposes the first large language model framework for negative feedback modeling with special designed context-discerning modules and designs a Progressive GRPO training paradigm that enables the model to dynamically balance the positive and negative behavioral context utilization.

2601.15724.tldr: VideoThinker is an agentic Video Large Language Model trained entirely on synthetic tool interaction trajectories that significantly outperforms both caption-only language model agents and strong video model baselines across long-video benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of tool augmented synthetic data and adaptive retrieval and zoom reasoning for long-form video understanding.

2601.15729.tldr: DualShield is introduced, a planning and control framework that leverages Hamilton-Jacobi reachability value functions in a dual capacity that preserves the rich exploration capabilities of diffusion models while providing principled safety assurance under uncertain and even adversarial interactions.

2601.15731.tldr: FAIR-ESI is proposed, a novel framework that adaptively refines feature importance across different views, including FFTbased spectral feature refinement, weighted temporal feature refinement, and self-attention-based patch-wise feature refinement.

2601.15737.tldr: This paper presents the first approach to enhance formal theorem proving in the physics domain, composed of theorems sampled from PhysLean and data generated by a conjecture-based formal data generation pipeline, and trains the model PhysProver.

2601.15754.tldr: CAFE-GB (Chunk-wise Aggregated Feature Estimation using Gradient Boosting), a scalable feature selection framework designed to produce stable and globally consistent feature rankings for high-dimensional malware detection, is proposed.

2601.15761.tldr: SigEnt-SAC is introduced, an off-policy actor-critic method that learns from scratch using a single expert trajectory that prevents negative-entropy-driven optimization toward out-of-distribution actions and reduces Q-function oscillations.

2601.15778.tldr: This work introduces the problem of Agentic Confidence Calibration and proposes Holistic Trajectory Calibration (HTC), a novel diagnostic framework that extracts rich process-level features ranging from macro dynamics to micro stability across an agent's entire trajectory, providing a framework for diagnosing and enhancing the reliability of AI agents.

2601.15797.tldr: It is argued that recent advances in generative AI have rendered the Intentional Agency Condition increasingly problematic, both descriptively and functionally, and proposed replacing the IAC with a consistency requirement, according to which creativity tracks the reliable generation of novel and valuable products.

2601.15798.tldr: VitalDiagnosis is introduced, an LLM-driven ecosystem designed to shift chronic disease management from passive monitoring to proactive, interactive engagement and has the potential to enhance patient self-management and reduce avoidable clinical workload.

2601.15802.tldr: To ensure a precise fleet positioning a constellation of beacons deployed by aerial or surface drones establish a synthetic landmark network that will guide the fleet of UUVs along an optimized path from the continental shelf to the goal on the shore.

2601.15808.tldr: DeepVerifier is presented, a rubrics-based outcome reward verifier that leverages the asymmetry of verification and outperforms vanilla agent-as-judge and LLM judge baselines by 12%-48% in meta-evaluation F1 score.

2601.15810.tldr: A mobile application based on CNNs was developed to recognize different types of flowers to provide non-specialists with quick and easy access to information about flower types, showing that CNNs can be used for flower classification in mobile applications.

2601.15816.tldr: The results show that LLMs can serve as trustworthy virtual traffic police officers that can adapt conventional TSC methods to unforeseen traffic incidents with significantly improved operational efficiency and reliability.

2601.15869.tldr: AV-HuBERT's perceptual bio-fidelity is evaluated by benchmarking its response to incongruent audiovisual stimuli against human observers to suggest that current self-supervised architectures mimic multisensory outcomes but lack the neural variability inherent to human speech perception.

2601.15888.tldr: These findings indicate that better alignment between pretraining and downstream tasks, measured by simple divergence metrics such as maximum-mean-discrepancy (MMD) between the same features before and after fine-tuning, correlates with greater performance improvements and faster convergence, emphasizing the importance of designing and analyzing pretraining objectives with downstream applicability in mind.

2601.15894.tldr: The Iterative Amortized Hierarchical Variational Autoencoder is proposed, which expands on amortized inference with a hybrid scheme containing an initial amortized guess and iterative refinement with decoder gradients, enabling real-time applications with very high model depths.

2601.15909.tldr: Findings show that pretrained vision models applied to image-based MEG representations can effectively capture the structure of imagined speech in non-invasive neural signals.

2601.15912.tldr: Experiments on MuJoCo and Meta-World benchmarks show that text-conditioned hypernetworks offer a practical way to build compact, language-driven controllers for ressource-constrained robot control tasks with real-time requirements.

2601.15915.tldr: It is proved that, under mild regularity conditions, Prog-PowerHP converges to a small neighborhood of the global optimum with an iteration complexity scaling nearly as $O(d^2\varepsilon^{-2})$.

2601.15924.tldr: The design of a class and confidence-aware re-weighting scheme for long-tailed learning that has a complementary nature to the existing methods performing the adjustment of the logits and is corroborated by significant experimental results performed on the CIFAR-100-LT, ImageNet-LT, and iNaturalist2018 datasets.

2601.15931.tldr: This paper proposes ICON (Invariant Counterfactual Optimization with Neuro-symbolic priors), a framework integrating causal and topological priors integrating causal and topological priors, and demonstrates exceptional robustness against occlusion, background interference, and localization noise.

2601.15949.tldr: MarScope is presented, a planetary-scale vision-language framework enabling natural language-driven, label-free mapping of Martian landforms, and establishes a new paradigm where natural language serves as a direct interface for scientific discovery over massive geospatial datasets.

2601.15953.tldr: The Decoupled DT is proposed, which simplifies the architecture by processing only observation and action sequences through the Transformer, using the latest RTG to guide the action prediction.

2601.15995.tldr: PUMA is presented, an end-to-end learning framework that integrates visual perception and foothold priors into a single-stage training process, and leverages terrain features to estimate egocentric polar foothold priors, guiding the robot in active posture adaptation for parkour tasks.

2601.16007.tldr: A broad range of recent models and video generation models is evaluated on PhysicsMind and found to rely on appearance heuristics while often violating basic mechanics, underscoring PhysicsMind as a focused testbed for physics-aware multimodal models.

2601.16011.tldr: The proposed THOR, a "computeadaptive" foundation model that solves both input heterogeneity and deployment rigidity, and is the first architecture to unify data from Copernicus Sentinel-1, -2, and -3 satellites, processing their native 10 m to 1000 m resolutions in a single model.

2601.16027.tldr: This work proposes CS-VAR, a lightweight, domain-specific model that performs fast session-level risk inference, guided during training by a Large Language Model that reasons over retrieved cross-session behavioral evidence and transfers its local-to-global insights to the small model.

2601.16038.tldr: It is found that one-shot prompting with aligned exemplars consistently performs best and a checklist-style self-correction loop mainly improves executability in zero-shot settings and offers limited additional retrieval gains once a good exemplar is present.

2401.18034.tldr: This work introduces PARAMANU, the first family of Indian-only autoregressive language models trained from scratch on open-source language-specific data for the five most spoken Indian languages: Bengali, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, and Telugu, designed for affordability and trained on a single GPU with a budget under $1,000.

2501.16448.tldr: An information-theoretic formalization of the distinction between two fundamental AI safety failure modes: deceptive alignment and goal drift is proposed and offered, offering novel perspectives on their underlying causes.

2503.10883.tldr: Experiments show that Chat-TS achieves state-of-the-art performance in multimodal reasoning tasks by maintaining strong natural language proficiency while improving time-series reasoning.

2504.15211.tldr: This work proposes a unified framework that embraces multiplicity by modelling the distribution of harmful behaviour across the entire space of decoding knobs and prompts, quantifying risk through tail-focused metrics, and integrating stakeholder preferences.

2507.01001.tldr: SciArena is presented, an open and collaborative platform for evaluating foundation models on scientific literature-grounded tasks, and SciArena-Eval, a meta-evaluation benchmark based on collected preference data, which measures the accuracy of models in judging answer quality by comparing their pairwise assessments with human votes.

2507.02921.tldr: Experiments show that PlaceRep outperforms most state-of-the-art graph-based graph-based geospatial representation learning methods and achieves up to a 100x speedup in generating region-level representations on large-scale POI graphs.

2508.12260.tldr: Mantis, a foundation model trained entirely on mechanistic simulations, enables out-of-the-box forecasting across diseases, regions, and outcomes, even in settings with limited historical data, and consistently ranked in the top two models across evaluation metrics.

2510.23761.tldr: Results indicate that modern LLMs, when embedded in a narrowly engineered, test-driven workflow, already achieve human-level test resolution -- with the final frontier for fully autonomous repository repair being the accurate generation of valid reproduction tests.

2511.13273.tldr: This work uncovers a systematic motion perception deficit in current ALLMs and introduces AudioMotionBench, the first benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate auditory motion understanding, providing both a diagnostic tool and new insight for enhancing spatial cognition in future Audio-Language Models.

2601.08875.tldr: SAR-Net, a unified framework that addresses image registration under domain shift through principled scene-appearance disentanglement, is proposed and validated on the ANHIR challenge benchmark, where multi-stain histopathology images exhibit coupled domain shift from different staining protocols and geometric distortion from tissue preparation.

2601.14490.tldr: This work introduces a grounded OCR evaluation protocol and shows that GutenOCR-7B more than doubles the composite grounded OCR score of its Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone on 10.5K held-out business and scientific pages (0.40 to 0.82).

2601.15209.tldr: This study compares the usability of natural language input via spoken English; with Alexa's automatic speech recognition and a Wizard-of-Oz setting with a trained facilitator re-speaking commands against that of a large language model (LLM)-assisted touch interface in a mixed-methods study.

2601.15249.tldr: It is proved that truthfulness holds even when the utility function is merely nondecreasing and additive, and this finding represents a substantial relaxation of the assumptions required in prior work.
