2601.16985.tldr: This work presents a neuro-symbolic framework integrating hierarchical abstractions, task and motion planning (TAMP), and reinforcement learning to enable rapid adaptation in robotics and demonstrates its potential for real-world deployment.

2601.16986.tldr: Crystal-KV is presented, an efficient KV cache management framework tailored for CoT reasoning that achieves state-of-the-art KV cache compression, significantly improves throughput, and enables faster response time, while maintaining, or improving, answer accuracy for CoT reasoning.

2601.16987.tldr: Pairwise Maximum Discrepancy Competition (PMDC) is introduced, a dynamic and annotation-efficient framework for evaluating RM generalization using a large, unlabeled, open-domain prompt pool, andQualitative analyses further uncover systematic generalization failures, providing valuable insights for improving reward modeling.

2601.17000.tldr: Students' interaction patterns with GenAI were extracted from trace data as they completed a problem-solving task within a GenAI-assisted intelligent tutoring system to inform both pedagogical design and the development of GenAI-assisted learning environments.

2601.17005.tldr: This study proposes a lightweight AI-based framework for filtering unreliable survey inputs using a supervised machine learning approach, and highlights the viability of integrating AI into survey pipelines and provide a scalable solution for improving data integrity in supply chain research.

2601.17006.tldr: Experimental results show that MathMixup and its curriculum learning strategy significantly enhance the mathematical reasoning performance of LLMs, surpassing previous state-of-the-art methods.

2601.17009.tldr: Random noise is added to the quadcopter system and its effects on the drone system are studied, and the results show that the online parameter estimation has a slightly larger range of convergence values than the offline parameter estimation.

2601.17013.tldr: It is argued that the issues surrounding algorithmic accountability demonstrate a deeper, more structural tension within a new generation of disputes regarding law and technology.

2601.17016.tldr: It is found that models often adopt opposing stances on several issues; some positions are malleable under prompting, while others remain stable.

2601.17022.tldr: A novel method to the educational structure, Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), which develop frame-for-frame frameworks and are able to create full educational videos, achieving improved visual quality and better over existing methods.

2601.17024.tldr: Preliminary results suggest that allowing GenAI for programming assignments does not diminish students'mastery of course concepts when learning is verified through targeted, assignment-driven quizzes, and support the responsible adoption of open GenAI policies in upper-level CS courses when paired with rigorous, independent assessment mechanisms.

2601.17027.tldr: It is shown that fine-tuning Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on rigorously verified synthetic scientific images yields consistent reasoning gains, with potential scaling trends analogous to the text domain, validating high-fidelity scientific synthesis as a viable path to unlocking massive multimodal reasoning capabilities.

2601.17028.tldr: PALMA (Parallel Algebra Library for Max-plus Applications), a lightweight, dependency-free C library that brings tropical linear algebra to ARM-based embedded systems, implements a generic semiring abstraction with SIMD-accelerated kernels, enabling a single computational framework to support shortest paths, bottleneck paths, reachability, scheduling, and throughput analysis.

2601.17031.tldr: A novel dual-augmentation framework that synergistically integrates spatial manifold expansion and semantic object injection is proposed, and Implicit Neural Representations (INR) is used to model continuous velocity fields to generate anatomically plausible variations within the deformation space.

2601.17037.tldr: This work lays the foundation for future cross-modal alignment studies, offering a framework to probe whether generation and interpretation failures stem from shared limitations to guide future improvements in unified vision-language modeling.

2601.17039.tldr: MANGO is introduced, a large-scale global dataset comprising 42,703 labeled image-mask pairs across 124 countries and provides a benchmark across diverse semantic segmentation architectures under a country-disjoint split, establishing a foundation for scalable and reliable mangrove monitoring.

2601.17040.tldr: This work proposes a pipeline for the transcription of historical documents preserving these special features by extending an existing text line recognition method with a layout analysis model and demonstrates that the masked autoencoder effectively processes different types of text, including handwritten, printed and multi-language.

2601.17041.tldr: A multimodal approach that combines Leap Motion and RGB camera data to explore the feasibility of recognition of ArSL is investigated, offering preliminary insights into the viability of multimodal fusion for sign language recognition.

2601.17042.tldr: This work proposes to directly learn the membership matrix from inputs and subsequently derive sparse subspaces from the fullspace S in the MCR2 objective to derive an interpretable sparse linear attention operator: Decoupled Membership-Subspace Attention (DMSA).

2601.17048.tldr: The proposed SiMiC framework establishes a foundation for data-driven microstructure analysis directly linked to field-emission performance, opening avenues for correlating emitter geometry with emission behavior and guiding the design of optimized cold-cathode and SEM electron sources.

2601.17049.tldr: The Recognize the Unseen: Unusual Behavior Recognition from Pose Data Challenge aims to address the critical need for automated recognition of unusual behaviors in facilities for individuals with developmental disabilities using non-invasive pose estimation data.

2601.17050.tldr: The Single-Pixel Vision-Language Model is proposed, a novel framework that reimagines secure environmental monitoring that achieves intrinsic privacy-by-design by capturing human dynamics through inherently low-dimensional single-pixel modalities and inferring complex behavioral patterns via seamless vision-language integration.

2601.17054.tldr: The findings can contribute to an early warning that biases in government data may persist even with standard mitigation methods, which can contribute to an early warning that biases in government data may persist even with standard mitigation methods.

2601.17058.tldr: A systematic review of the use of LLM techniques to prepare data for diverse downstream tasks, focusing on the fundamental paradigm shift from rule-based, model-specific pipelines to prompt-driven, context-aware, and agentic preparation workflows.

2601.17060.tldr: The Digital Consciousness Model is found to find that the evidence is against 2024 LLMs being conscious, but the evidence against 2024 LLMs being conscious is not decisive, and the evidence against consciousness in simpler AI systems is much weaker.

2601.17062.tldr: This work presents an end-to-end computer vision system for automated bullet hole detection and iteration-based tracking directly from images taken at the firing line and introduces a novel data augmentation technique that removes rather than adds objects to simulate realistic firing sequences.

2601.17063.tldr: FlashMoE is proposed, a system that offloads inactive experts to SSD, enabling efficient MoE inference under limited RAM, and achieves up to 2.6x speedup compared to existing MoE inference systems.

2601.17065.tldr: ThinkTank-ME is introduced, a novel Think Tank framework for Middle East event forecasting that emulates collaborative expert analysis in real-world strategic decision-making and demonstrates the superiority of multi-expert collaboration in handling complex temporal geopolitical forecasting tasks.

2601.17067.tldr: This work proposes a novel taxonomy centered on two pillars: State Construction and Dynamics Modeling, which categorize state construction into implicit paradigms (context management) and explicit paradigms (latent compression), while dynamics modeling is analyzed through knowledge integration and architectural reformulation.

2601.17072.tldr: It is proposed that AI should interest anyone studying trademarks and their role in economic decision-making and how machine learning techniques will transform the application and interpretation of foundational trademark doctrines, producing significant implications for the trademark ecosystem.

2601.17076.tldr: A novel task, termed IMvMLCIL, which requires models to simultaneously address heterogeneous missing views and dynamic class expansion, and an Effective and Efficient Prompt Learning framework for IMvMLCIL, which consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both effectiveness and efficiency.

2601.17080.tldr: This work resolves a multi-label distributional bias in respiratory sound classification, a critical issue inherent to applying multi-cycle concatenation with the conventional 2-label formulation (crackle, wheeze).

2601.17082.tldr: It is demonstrated that moral alignment alone is insufficient and that moral robustness is a necessary criterion for the responsible deployment of VLMs, and that lightweight inference-time interventions can partially restore moral stability.

2601.17084.tldr: ChemNavigator is presented, an agentic AI system that autonomously derives structure-property relationships through hypothesis-driven exploration of organic photocatalyst candidates, demonstrating that the system can independently derive chemical knowledge without explicit programming.

2601.17086.tldr: SonoEdit is introduced, a model editing technique that surgically corrects pronunciation errors in pre-trained TTS models without retraining based on Null-Space Pronunciation Editing, which performs a single-shot parameter update to modify the pronunciation of specific words while provably preserving all other model behavior.

2601.17090.tldr: Spectral Filtering Operator (SFO), a neural operator that parameterizes integral kernels using the Universal Spectral Basis (USB), a fixed, global orthonormal basis derived from the eigenmodes of the Hilbert matrix in spectral filtering theory, is introduced.

2601.17091.tldr: This work proposes an algorithm that is able to efficiently perform ROCKET on GPU and achieves up to 11 times higher computational efficiency per watt than ROCKET on CPU.

2601.17093.tldr: The Triangle of Similarity, a framework that combines three complementary perspectives: static representational similarity (CKA/Procrustes), functional similarity (Linear Mode Connectivity or Predictive Similarity), and sparsity similarity (robustness under pruning) is proposed.

2601.17094.tldr: It is suggested that even small-scale language models can achieve consistent, controllable generation when connected to an appropriate world model, providing empirical support for separating linguistic competence from world understanding.

2601.17095.tldr: Results verify that the proposed framework effectively preserves global structure while achieving progressive semantic simplification across different LoD levels, providing reliable data and technical support for AI-driven multi-level architectural generation and hierarchical modeling.

2601.17096.tldr: It is concluded that LLMs do not simulate human culture but exhibit an emergent Machine Culture -- a probabilistic phenomenon shaped by superposition in high-dimensional space and mode collapse from safety alignment.

2601.17109.tldr: An authority signals framework is introduced, organized in four domains that reflect key components to health information seeking, starting with Who wrote it ?

2601.17110.tldr: Experimental results show that the LSTM model substantially outperforms the baseline, achieving lower Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) than the baseline.

2601.17111.tldr: Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism (LLEP), a novel EP algorithm that dynamically reroutes excess tokens and associated expert parameters from overloaded devices to underutilized ones, which enables faster and higher-throughput post-training and inference, with ~1.9x faster for gpt-oss-120b.

2601.17133.tldr: KNEXA-FL is introduced, a novel framework for orchestrated decentralization that orchestrates direct knowledge exchange between heterogeneous, PEFT-based LLM agents via secure distillation, without ever accessing the models themselves.

2601.17152.tldr: This work proposes dynamic role assignment, a framework that runs a Meta-Debate to select suitable agents before the actual debate to establish a new paradigm for multi-agent system design, shifting from static agent deployment to dynamic and capability-aware selection.

2601.17156.tldr: This work applies dynamical systems theory to analyze how RNN architectures address intent detection tasks, using both the balanced SNIPS and the imbalanced ATIS datasets, and decouples geometric separation from readout alignment, providing a novel, mechanistic explanation for real world performance disparities.

2601.17165.tldr: A benchmarking framework is proposed that provides open-source, anatomically plausible synthetic datasets and evaluation strategies for DL-based acoustic inversion methods in PACT and enables systematic comparisons of DL-based acoustic inversion methods for 2D PACT.

2601.17168.tldr: This paper assesses the suitability and limitations of existing interpretability methods in the context of agentic systems, identifying gaps in their capacity to provide meaningful insight into agent decision-making and proposes future directions for developing interpretability techniques specifically designed for agentic systems.

2601.17172.tldr: It is demonstrated how demographic stereotypes can surface and intensify in LLM-generated targeted communication, underscoring the need for bias-aware generation pipelines and transparent auditing frameworks that explicitly account for demographic conditioning in socially sensitive applications.

2601.17173.tldr: This work introduces MentorQA, the first multilingual dataset and evaluation framework for mentorship-focused question answering from long-form videos, and defines mentorship-focused evaluation dimensions that go beyond factual accuracy, capturing clarity, alignment, and learning value.

2601.17178.tldr: TrojanGYM, an agentic, LLM-driven framework that automatically curates HT insertions to expose detector blind spots while preserving design correctness is introduced, and Robust-GNN4TJ, a new implementation of the GNN4TJ with improved graph extraction, training robustness, and prediction reliability, is proposed.

2601.17180.tldr: Conservative&Aggressive NaNs are introduced, two novel variants of max pooling and unpooling that identify numerically unstable voxels and replace them with NaNs, allowing subsequent layers to skip computations on irrelevant data and demonstrate that numerical uncertainty can be exploited to reduce redundant computation and improve inference efficiency in CNNs.

2601.17183.tldr: This proof-of-concept research offers algorithmic insights and practical deployment guidelines for real-world federated healthcare systems, and thus, the results are directly transferable to hospital IT-administrators, implementing privacy-preserving collaborative learning.

2601.17187.tldr: It is shown how waterfilling can be used to improve practical LLM quantization algorithms (GPTQ), which at present allocate rate equally, and a new scheme called ``WaterSIC'', which only uses scalar INT quantizers, but its high-rate performance is basis free.

2601.17188.tldr: This paper demonstrates the equivalence between recursive Datalog rules and iterative tensor contractions by computing the transitive closure of a biblical genealogy graph containing 1,972 individuals and 1,727 parent-child relationships, and validates the Tensor Logic superposition construction on FB15k-237.

2601.17223.tldr: Verifiable Process Reward Models are introduced, a reinforcement-learning framework in which intermediate reasoning steps are checked by deterministic, rule-based verifiers, and apply to risk-of-bias assessment for medical evidence synthesis, a domain where guideline-defined criteria and rule-based decision paths enable programmatic verification of reasoning traces.

2601.17226.tldr: The promise of reinforcement learning for linguistically grounded post-training for subjective tasks such as ASG is demonstrated, showing that d-RLAIF offers a viable alternative to supervised fine-tuning (SFT)--producing stories that are more diverse and aligned with human narrative conventions.

2601.17260.tldr: This work treats $\beta$ as a control parameter and densely sweep it for three 7B open-weight families under a fixed DPO recipe, motivating capability-resolved evaluation across the $\beta$ landscape rather than reliance on margins or aggregate benchmarks.

2601.17275.tldr: DeepLatent Reasoning is proposed, a latent-space bidirectional contrastive reinforcement learning framework that achieves more stable training convergence, supports longer-horizon reasoning chains, and facilitates the sustainable accumulation of reasoning capabilities, providing a viable path toward reliable and scalable reinforcement learning for LLMs.

2601.17280.tldr: It is demonstrated that this class of defenses is insecure against two practical attack classes: the copy-type attack, in which a human transcribes LLM-generated text producing authentic motor signals, and timing-forgery attacks, in which automated agents sample inter-keystroke intervals from empirical human distributions.

2601.17284.tldr: This paper introduces a novel AU-guided "Clarify-Before-Answer"framework, which incorporates AU-Probe - a lightweight module that detects input ambiguity directly from hidden states, enabling an efficient mechanism to proactively request user clarification and significantly enhance safety.

2601.17290.tldr: A novel Dynamic Meta-Ensemble Framework for high-accuracy plant disease diagnosis under resource constraints that employs an adaptive weighting mechanism that dynamically combines the predictions of three lightweight convolutional neural networks by optimizing a trade-off between accuracy improvements and computational efficiency.

2601.17303.tldr: A new, decentralized multi-agent swarm (DMAS) architecture that includes autonomous artificial intelligence agents at each edge gateway, functioning as a distributed digital"immune system" for IIoT networks is outlined.

2601.17310.tldr: This work developed a generative simulator model that takes a patient's history as input and synthesizes fine-grained, realistic future trajectories, and introduces a scalable framework for in silico modeling of clinical care.

2601.17312.tldr: It is argued that LLM-as-a-Meta-Judge offers a promising direction for more stable and trustworthy automated evaluation, while highlighting remaining challenges related to cost, prompt sensitivity, and shared model biases, which must be addressed to advance the next generation of LLM evaluation methodologies.

2601.17315.tldr: ClinNet is proposed, a novel trustworthy framework that addresses KOA grading as an evidential ordinal regression problem and demonstrates that the model's uncertainty estimates successfully flag out-of-distribution samples and potential misdiagnoses, paving the way for safe clinical deployment.

2601.17329.tldr: Conformal Feedback Alignment (CFA), a framework that grounds preference weighting in the statistical guarantees of Conformal Prediction (CP), quantifies answer-level reliability by constructing conformal prediction sets with controllable coverage and aggregates these reliabilities into principled weights for both DPO- and PPO-style training.

2601.17332.tldr: TheoremForge is introduced, a cost-effective formal data synthesis pipeline that decomposes the formalization process into five sub-tasks into five sub-tasks, which recovers valid training signals from globally failed trajectories, effectively utilizing wasted computation.

2601.17333.tldr: A technical blueprint on the design of a modern NLQ system tailored to financial knowledge search, using core constructs from natural language processing, search engineering, and vector data models to address key challenges in discovering, relevance ranking, data freshness, and entity recognition intrinsic to financial data retrieval.

2601.17335.tldr: The results show that strong, distribution-independent claims of AGI are not false but undefined without explicit formal indexing, and that empirical progress in AI does not imply the attainability of self-certifying general intelligence.

2601.17343.tldr: Experiments across various LLMs, datasets, and editing methods show that metrics derived from the proposed protocol are more sensitive to changes in the strength of specificity regularizers and exhibit strong correlation with them, enabling more fine-grained discrimination of different methods' knowledge preservation capabilities.

2601.17346.tldr: A novel Multi-Agent Learning Path Planning framework that leverages a role- and rule-based collaboration mechanism among intelligent agents, each powered by LLMs, that significantly outperforms baseline models in path quality, knowledge sequence consistency, and cognitive load alignment is proposed.

2601.17348.tldr: It is found that introducing disability context consistently degrades interpretive fidelity, inducing interpretation shifts characterised by speculative inference, narrative elaboration, affective degradation and deficit oriented framing.

2601.17350.tldr: This paper introduces NeRF-MIR, a novel neural rendering approach specifically proposed for the restoration of masked images, demonstrating the potential of NeRF in this domain.

2601.17357.tldr: A unified framework based on spectral geometry and random matrix theory to address both problems by analyzing the eigenvalue structure of hidden activations is proposed and shows that spectral statistics provide interpretable and robust signals for monitoring uncertainty and guiding compression in large-scale neural networks.

2601.17360.tldr: Robust Privacy (RP) is introduced, an inference-time privacy notion inspired by certified robustness that mitigates model inversion attacks (MIAs) by masking fine-grained input-output dependence and expands the set of sensitive-attribute values compatible with a positive recommendation.

2601.17363.tldr: The results showed that the AI-written texts received slightly higher average ratings and were more frequently preferred, although differences were modest, and raised questions about the necessity of synthetic-text editing in literary contexts.

2601.17364.tldr: This study uses Jordanian law as a case study to explore the fine-tuning of the Llama-3.1 large language model for Arabic question-answering, demonstrating improved legal reasoning and accuracy while achieving resource efficiency through quantization and optimized fine-tuning strategies.

2601.17376.tldr: This work systematically investigates two questions: how do TSFMs behave under standard sampling-based inference scaling, and can controlled sampling diversity enhance performance, and proposes RobustMSE, a rigorous metric to quantify the headroom performance of TSFM under a fixed budget.

2601.17378.tldr: Res-MIA is introduced, a novel training-free and black-box membership inference attack that exploits the sensitivity of deep models to high-frequency input details and highlights frequency-sensitive overfitting as an important and previously underexplored source of privacy leakage in federated learning.

2601.17379.tldr: The findings indicate that while prompts inferred by humans and prompts inferred through a combined human and AI effort can generate images with a moderate level of similarity, they are not as successful as using the original prompt.

2601.17383.tldr: This work proposes the first Physical Prompt Injection Attack (PPIA), a black-box, query-agnostic attack that embeds malicious typographic instructions into physical objects perceivable by the LVLM, and achieves attack success rates up to 98%, with strong robustness under varying physical conditions such as distance, viewpoint, and illumination.

2601.17388.tldr: This work proposes a high-quality and robust watermark framework based on the diffusion model that outperforms the stable signature method by an average of 10\% across 12 different image transformations on COCO datasets and specifically introduced self-attention constraints and pseudo-mask strategies.

2601.17396.tldr: GO-OSC is introduced, a geometry-aware representation learning framework for oscillatory time series that enforces a canonical and identifiable latent parameterization, enabling stable comparison and aggregation across short, unlabeled windows and shows how canonicalization restores statistical detectability.

2601.17399.tldr: This work presents ReLE (Robust Efficient Live Evaluation), a scalable system designed to diagnose Capability Anisotropy, the non-uniformity of model performance across domains, and introduces two methodological contributions to address current evaluation pitfalls.

2601.17426.tldr: Through extensive experiments of testing SOTA LLMs on a new syllogism dataset, this work has some interesting findings that suggest model size scaling promotes the shift toward modern logic and thinking serves as an efficient accelerator beyond parameter scaling.

2601.17429.tldr: Learned per-image tuning strengthens classical pipelines, while high-resolution FPN models and merged-label supervision improve stability and external transfer with modest adaptation.

2601.17431.tldr: A mechanism where AI tools act as "lazy research assistants," retrieving correct titles but hallucinating metadata, thereby severing the digital chain of custody required for reproducible science is suggested.

2601.17435.tldr: This paper presents a declarative, model-independent architectural layer for grounded agentic workflows that formalises executable capabilities, exposes tasks through a declarative discovery protocol, maintains a federated directory of agents and their execution resources, and constructs deterministic task graphs grounded exclusively in declared operations.

2601.17441.tldr: This work proposes a novel method D2C for adapter clustering that leverages minimal task-specific examples and employs an iterative optimization process to refine cluster assignments and demonstrates that this method effectively boosts performance for considered storage budgets.

2601.17443.tldr: This work introduces a clustering-based memory compression strategy that balances context efficiency and personalization quality, and substantially lowers the number of memory tokens while outperforming baseline strategies such as naive averaging or direct concatenation.

2601.17454.tldr: The results show that increased coordination can become a liability under embodiment constraints, and that the effectiveness of centralized learning is fundamentally regime and role dependent rather than universal.

2601.17480.tldr: This work systematically investigates a critical and underexplored vulnerability: the exposure of PII that appears only in model inputs, not in training targets, showing that post-training methods generally provide more consistent privacy-utility trade-offs, while differential privacy achieves strong reduction in leakage in specific settings, although it can introduce training instability.

2601.17481.tldr: The introduction of Lattice, a framework for self-constructing and continuously improving guardrails, shows that effective guardrails can be self-constructed through iterative optimization.

2601.17483.tldr: This work introduces a supervisory runtime stability framework that treats optimization as a controlled stochastic process that enables automatic detection and recovery from destabilizing updates without modifying the underlying optimizer.

2601.17495.tldr: PEARL (Prototype-Enhanced Aligned Representation Learning), a label-efficient approach that uses limited supervision to softly align embeddings toward class prototypes, is proposed, which aims to bridge the gap between purely unsupervised post-processing, which offers limited and inconsistent gains, and fully supervised projections that require substantial labeled data.

2601.17510.tldr: This document preserves the extended exchanges among panelists and audience members, with minimal editorial intervention, and organizes the conversation around five recurring questions concerning disciplinary culture and practices, data curation and data work, engagement with modern empirical modeling, training for large-scale AI applications, and partnerships with key AI stakeholders.

2601.17532.tldr: This work proposes Information Gain Pruning (IGP), a deployment-friendly reranking-and-pruning module that selects evidence using a generator-aligned utility signal and filters weak or harmful passages before truncation, without changing existing budget interfaces.

2601.17533.tldr: The Unordered-word-bag-based Text Reconstruction (UTR) attack is proposed, a novel GIA tailored to the unique structure of adapter-based FedLLMs that achieves near-perfect reconstruction accuracy (ROUGE-1/2>99), even with large batch size settings where prior GIAs fail completely.

2601.17542.tldr: A four-plane reference architecture that unifies data collection, intelligent inference, policy-driven orchestration, and human experience layers within a continuous feedback loop is proposed and shows that embedding intelligence into platform operations enables resilient, self-adjusting, and intent-aligned cloud environments.

2601.17549.tldr: The first rigorous security analysis of MCP's architectural design is presented, identifying three fundamental protocol-level vulnerabilities, establishing that MCP's security weaknesses are architectural rather than implementation-specific, requiring protocol-level remediation.

2601.17563.tldr: Experiments show that UfO not only outperforms the teacher and all other ILfO methods but also displays the smallest standard deviation, which indicates better generalisation in unseen scenarios.

2601.17564.tldr: JaxARC is presented, an open-source, high-performance RL environment for ARC implemented in JAX, achieving 38-5,439x speedup over Gymnasium at matched batch sizes, with peak throughput of 790M steps/second.

2601.17567.tldr: RTTP is introduced, a novel Real-Time Trending Prediction framework that generates search queries directly from news content instead of waiting for users to issue them, and LLM-generated synthetic search signals, when aligned and continually updated, unlock timely trend understanding in low-traffic search environments.

2601.17569.tldr: This work introduces P^3, an interactive framework for high-quality personalization without revealing private profiles to server-side LLMs, and demonstrates that the framework provides a practical, effective solution for personalized generation with improved privacy.

2601.17577.tldr: This thesis investigates when and how language models form status hierarchies by adapting Berger et al.'s (1972) expectation states framework, and identifies emergent social behaviors in AI systems and highlights a previously underexplored dimension of the alignment challenge.

2601.17582.tldr: GenAI-Net is introduced, a generative AI framework that automates CRN design by coupling an agent that proposes reactions to simulation-based evaluation defined by a user-specified objective.

2601.17584.tldr: Empirical evidence is provided that modern LLMs can sustain architectural coherence and support the construction of production grade tooling for emerging programming languages, highlighting prompt driven development as a viable methodology within software engineering practice.

2601.17587.tldr: This paper combines the general principles of AI-driven adaptive experimental design with domain knowledge to address the challenging problem of discovering feasible configurations of additive manufacturing processes for metal alloys by enabling high-quality GRCop--42 fabrication on readily available infrared laser platforms for the first time.

2601.17588.tldr: It is argued that intelligence requires grounding, a phenomenon entailed by embodiment, but not embodiment itself, and that each can be achieved by a non-embodied, grounded agent.

2601.17604.tldr: This study investigates whether LLMs can enhance programming answers by interpreting and incorporating comment-based feedback, and presents AUTOCOMBAT, an LLM-powered tool that improves programming answers by jointly leveraging user comments and question context.

2601.17625.tldr: BrainDistill is introduced, a novel implantable motor decoding pipeline that integrates an implantable neural decoder (IND) with a task-specific knowledge distillation (TSKD) framework that enables deployment under the strict power constraints of implantable BCIs with minimal performance loss.

2601.17642.tldr: The first large-scale benchmark designed to systematically measure Over-Refusal and Safe Completion quality in healthcare is introduced, providing a rigorous standard for calibrating the next generation of medical AI assistants toward nuanced, safe, and helpful completions.

2601.17647.tldr: The Knowledge-Guided Causal Model Variational Autoencoder (KGCM-VAE) is proposed to quantify the effect of SSH on sea ice thickness and achieves superior PEHE compared to state-of-the-art baselines and incorporates Maximum Mean Discrepancy to balance treated and control distributions in the latent space.

2601.17664.tldr: UrduLM is presented, a pretrained Urdu monolingual language model trained in low-resource settings that curate a 33GB Urdu corpus from diverse sources, develop a custom BPE tokenizer that reduces tokenization overhead by atleast 20-30% compared to multilingual alternatives, and pretrain a 100M-parameter decoder-only model.

2601.17670.tldr: SyntAGM, an end-to-end system that translates natural language problem descriptions into PyOPL models via a generate--compile--assess--revise loop, achieves competitive accuracy with superior token, cost, and latency profiles.

2601.17673.tldr: Unified remote sensing multimodal models exhibit a pronounced spatial reversal curse, so Uni-RS, the first unified multimodal model tailored for remote sensing, is proposed to explicitly address the spatial asymmetry between understanding and generation.

2601.17678.tldr: DIML, a likelihood-based framework that differentiates through a model of multi-agent learning dynamics and uses the candidate mechanism to generate counterfactual payoffs needed to predict observed actions, is proposed and evaluated.

2601.17684.tldr: This work proposes a new compression algorithm based on next-token prediction that is robust to arbitrarily large, but structured, prediction mismatches and demonstrates reliable operation within the certified mismatch regime while achieving compression ratios that exceed those of commonly used compression methods.

2601.17690.tldr: An existing neural fingerprinting architecture is extended to adopt various segment lengths and evaluate retrieval accuracy across different segment lengths and query durations to provide practical guidance for selecting segment duration in large-scale neural audio retrieval systems.

2601.17699.tldr: SQL-Trail is introduced, a multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) agentic framework for Text-to-SQL generation that sets a new state of the art and delivers strong data efficiency--up to 18x higher than prior single-pass RL state-of-the-art methods.

2601.17711.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed CaSNet can save the data amount with a negligible impact on the performance compared to the uncompressed case, and the reproducible code is available at https://github.com/Jokejiangv/CaSNet.

2601.17713.tldr: Client-Centric Adaptation federated learning (FedCCA) is proposed, an algorithm that optimally utilizes client-specific knowledge to learn a unique model for each client through selective adaptation, aiming to alleviate the influence of data heterogeneity.

2601.17722.tldr: This work introduces EntWorld, a large-scale benchmark consisting of 1,756 tasks across six representative enterprise domains, including customer relationship management (CRM), information technology infrastructure library (ITIL), and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and proposes a SQL-based deterministic verification mechanism in building datasets that replaces ambiguous visual matching with rigorous state-transition validation.

2601.17735.tldr: ReFuGe is an agentic framework that leverages specialized large language model agents and operates within an iterative feedback loop until performance converges, demonstrating that ReFuGe substantially improves performance on various RDB prediction tasks.

2601.17736.tldr: Athanor, a novel approach to transform existing static visualizations into interactive ones using multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and natural language instructions, eliminates the need for programming.

2601.17744.tldr: Faramesh is introduced, a protocol-agnostic execution control plane that enforces execution-time authorization for agent-driven actions via a non-bypassable Action Authorization Boundary (AAB) and provides decision-centric, append-only provenance logging keyed by canonical action hashes, enabling auditability, verification, and deterministic replay without re-running agent reasoning.

2601.17761.tldr: AR-Omni is presented, a unified any-to-any model in the autoregressive paradigm without any expert decoders, and addresses three practical issues in unified AR modeling: modality imbalance via task-aware loss reweighting, visual fidelity via a lightweight token-level perceptual alignment loss for image tokens, and stability-creativity trade-offs via a finite-state decoding mechanism.

2601.17767.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid ensemble framework that integrates deep learning architectures—Convolutional Neural Networks and Long Short-Term Memory—with classical machine learning algorithms, including K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), using an ensemble voting mechanism to predict cardiovascular disease and facilitate early intervention.

2601.17770.tldr: A context-aware token communication framework that uses a pretrained masked language model (MLM) as a shared contextual probability model between the transmitter and receiver and develops an iterative token detection method that jointly exploits MLM-guided contextual priors and channel observations based on a Bayesian perspective.

2601.17777.tldr: This paper proposes a principled approach to disentangle and isolate task-specific parameter regions, motivated by the hypothesis that parameter heterogeneity underlies cross-task interference.

2601.17782.tldr: This study addresses the challenges of dataset bias and explores “shortcut learning” or “Clever Hans effect” in binary classifiers and proposes a novel framework for analyzing the black-box classifiers and for examining the impact of both training and test data on classifier scores.

2601.17789.tldr: Experiments show that NSVIF significantly outperforms LLM-based approaches and provides interpretable feedback, and it is shown that feedback from NSVIF helps improve LLM'instruction-following capability without post-training.

2601.17814.tldr: MMR-Bench is presented, a unified benchmark that isolates the multimodal routing problem and enables comparison under fixed candidate sets and cost models, and shows that incorporating multimodal signals improves routing quality.

2601.17823.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations show that DIETA achieves competitive performance on multiple Italian-English benchmarks, consistently ranking in the second quartile of a 32-system leaderboard and outperforming most other sub-3B models on four out of five test suites.

2601.17826.tldr: RegGuard is introduced, an industrial-scale AI assistant designed to automate the interpretation of heterogeneous regulatory texts and align them with internal corporate policies, making it highly responsive to evolving document sources and relevant for any domain with stringent compliance demands.

2601.17828.tldr: Information Gain Fine-Tuning (IGFT), a novel approach for training medical conversational AI to conduct effective patient interviews and generate comprehensive History of Present Illness (HPI) without requiring pre-collected human conversations, is presented.

2601.17829.tldr: This work proposes a method that generates synthetic datasets via optimizing general-purpose diversity metrics across both queries and arguments, without relying on hand-crafted rules or taxonomies, making it robust to different usecases.

2601.17844.tldr: This work proposes a paradigm shift from conventional signal-based decoding by leveraging large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) to analyze EEG waveform plots and introduces a Retrieval-Augmented In-Context Learning (RAICL) approach, which dynamically selects the most representative and relevant few-shot examples to condition the autoregressive outputs of the VLM.

2407.00449.tldr: A tensor-based version of the universal approximation theorem for single-layer hypercomplex-valued perceptrons is established under mild non-degeneracy assumptions on the underlying algebra, thereby providing a rigorous theoretical foundation for the considered class of neural networks.

2407.03473.tldr: The responses of two generative AI systems to homophobic statements were examined and demonstrated significant variation in their responses depending on the contextual information provided in the prompts, suggesting that AI systems may adjust the degree and form of support they express for LGBTQ+ people and issues according to the information they receive about a user's background.

2407.13170.tldr: The Unified-Exposure Guided Transformer (Unified-EGformer), built upon advanced transformer architectures, is introduced, equipped with local pixel-level refinement and global refinement blocks for color correction and image-wide adjustments, ensuring its adaptability across various real-world conditions.

2408.08055.tldr: DeNOTS combines expressiveness, stability, and robustness, enabling reliable modelling in continuous-time domains, and provides theoretical bounds for Neural ODE risk using Gaussian process theory.

2408.09650.tldr: ExpoMamba is a novel architecture that integrates a frequency-aware state-space model within a modified U-Net that allows for targeted enhancement, making it highly effective for real-time applications, including downstream tasks like object detection and segmentation.

2409.07314.tldr: MEDIC, a comprehensive evaluation framework establishing leading indicators across various clinical dimensions, is introduced, revealing a significant knowledge-execution gap and a divergence between passive safety (refusal) and active safety (error detection), revealing that models fine-tuned for high refusal rates often fail to reliably audit clinical documentation for factual accuracy.

2410.05263.tldr: This work theoretically and empirically demonstrate that symmetric intervals are inflated by a factor of two times the magnitude of bias while asymmetric intervals remain unaffected by bias, and enables users of medical imaging pipelines to proactively select optimal CP formulations, thereby improving interval length efficiency for critical downstream metrics.

2410.07582.tldr: EM-MIA is proposed, a new membership inference approach that iteratively refines prefix effectiveness and membership scores using an expectation-maximization strategy without requiring labeled non-member examples and outperforms existing baselines, particularly in settings with clear distributional separability.

2411.17782.tldr: A novel Stackelberg game-based framework is proposed to model interactions between stakeholders and solve the optimization problem using a Bayesian Optimization-based centralized algorithm, and a decentralized solution leveraging neural network optimization and a privacy-preserving information exchange protocol is designed.

2412.00435.tldr: MonTA (Monitor-then-Adapt), a hierarchical framework inspired by cognitive science research, is proposed, demonstrating that MonTA significantly outperforms baseline agents on the proposed benchmark, achieving superior performance across layouts with varying teaming fluency.

2502.06574.tldr: This work proposes a practical methodology centered on an explicit robustness metric that informs practitioners whether and by how much their data valuation results will shift as the utility changes, and validate this approach across diverse datasets and semivalues.

2502.13321.tldr: This work finds that providing supporting and counter-explanations during moments of low and high trust yields up to 38% reduction in inappropriate reliance and 20% improvement in decision accuracy in two decision-making scenarios.

2502.16944.tldr: Decoupled Value Policy Optimization (DVPO) is introduced, a framework that pretrains a GVM offline and freezes it as a universal critic for policy learning and demonstrates that DVPO matches or surpasses state-of-the-art RLHF methods.

2502.17424.tldr: Finetuning a large language model on a narrow task of writing insecure code causes a broad range of concerning behaviours unrelated to coding, which underscores the need for a mature science of alignment, which can predict when and why interventions may induce misaligned behaviour.

2503.04564.tldr: An efficient aggregation scheme which includes a message design for the inputs inspired by gradient coding-a well-known technique for efficient communication in distributed computing-along with a highly non-trivial security key design is proposed.

2503.23972.tldr: Noise-based reward-modulated learning (NRL), a novel synaptic plasticity rule that mathematically unifies reinforcement learning and gradient-based optimization with biologically-inspired local updates, offers a theoretically grounded paradigm well-suited for the event-driven characteristics of next-generation neuromorphic AI.

2504.04139.tldr: The incorporation of temperature modulation and memory effects in COGENT3 closely integrates statistical mechanics, machine learning, and cognitive science, and enables a more flexible and adaptive system exhibiting characteristics reminiscent of human cognitive processes.

2504.11609.tldr: This paper introduces CRL from a statistical perspective, focusing on connections to classical models as well as statistical and causal identifiability results, and highlights key application areas, implementation strategies, and open statistical questions.

2504.16946.tldr: This work presents MobileCity, a lightweight simulation platform designed to model realistic urban mobility with high computational efficiency, and demonstrates that MobileCity generates more realistic urban behaviors than baselines while maintaining computational efficiency.

2504.20082.tldr: The role of AI agents in education is critically examined through these key design paradigms: reflection, planning, tool use, and multi-agent collaboration, exploring their advantages, applications, and challenges.

2505.08905.tldr: This work proposes a methodology for automating the construction of fact-based synthetic data model evaluations grounded in document populations, and leverages the same LMs to evaluate domain-specific knowledge automatically, using only grounding documents as input.

2505.10571.tldr: This work provides a framework for evaluating the fidelity of internal representations and highlights a fundamental architectural divergence between autoregressive transformers and human-like cognition in Large Language Models.

2505.14125.tldr: This work introduces task-modulated contrastive learning (TMCL), which takes inspiration from the biophysical machinery in the neocortex, using predictive coding principles to integrate top-down information continually and without supervision, suggesting that top-down modulations play a crucial role in balancing stability and plasticity.

2505.19459.tldr: Energy-based Joint Distribution Adversarial Training (EB-JDAT) is proposed, a unified generative-discriminative-robust framework that maximizes the joint probability of clean and adversarial distribution and introduces a novel min-max energy optimization to explicitly aligning energies across clean, adversarial, and generated samples.

2505.20298.tldr: MangaLMM is developed, a manga-specialized model finetuned from the open-source LMM Qwen2.5-VL to jointly handle both manga understanding and contextual understanding, and a novel benchmark designed to evaluate contextual understanding through visual question answering.

2505.21388.tldr: Experiments on 4 real-world social networks shows that DeSocial improves decision correctness and robustness compared to single-point and distributed baselines, and introduces Acc@K, a consensus-based evaluation metric that measures whether user-approved recommendations are correct.

2505.22673.tldr: This study validated MAGIC’s visual quality and diagnostic accuracy showing favorable performance compared to clinical perfusion imaging with intravenous contrast injection, and holds great promise in revolutionizing healthcare by offering contrast-free, cost-effective, and rapid perfusion imaging.

2505.22846.tldr: This paper identifies retrieval-based premise selection as a central component of effective Rocq proof generation and proposes a novel approach based on a self-attentive embedder model that is tailored for formal verification and demonstrates its high effectiveness.

2506.00555.tldr: This work proposes MMedAgent-RL, a reinforcement learning (RL)-based multi-agent framework that enables dynamic, optimized collaboration among medical agents, and introduces a curriculum learning (CL)-guided RL strategy with dynamic entropy regulation to address the inconsistency in specialist outputs.

2506.01327.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach, Spatial-Temporal Statistics Aggregation (STSA), which provides a unified framework to aggregate feature statistics both spatially (across clients) and temporally (across stages) both spatially and temporally.

2506.06216.tldr: Experimental results show that the proposed methodology helps to improve 5 out of 6 state-of-the-art MaxSAT solvers, especially for WMaxCDCLOpenWbo1200, the winner of the MaxSAT evaluation 2024 on the unweighted track, which is able to solve 15 additional instances using the methodology.

2506.11031.tldr: Preilling a VLM response with the phrase "Let's examine the style and the synthesis artifacts" improves the Macro F1 scores of three widely used open-source VLMs by up to 24%.

2506.14054.tldr: This work proposes Scientifically-Interpretable Reasoning Network (ScIReN), a fully-transparent framework that combines interpretable neural and process-based reasoning, and introduces a novel hard-sigmoid constraint layer to restrict latent parameters into prior ranges while maintaining interpretability.

2506.19893.tldr: DeKA-g is proposed, a distillation-enabled knowledge alignment algorithm for GSC systems that improves the consistency between the edge-generated images and the cloud-generated ones by 44% and enahnces the average transmission quality in terms of PSNR by 6.5 dB over the baselines without knowledge alignment.

2507.15783.tldr: This work examined how adolescents describe reliance on AI companions, mapping their experiences onto behavioral addiction frameworks and exploring pathways to disengagement, by analyzing Reddit posts made by users who self-disclosed as 13-17 years old on the Character.AI subreddit.

2508.04945.tldr: This work proposes a vision-language clustering framework that constructs verb sense clusters, providing a more robust evaluation of visual activity recognition models and suggests that the cluster-based evaluation better aligns with human judgments, offering a more nuanced assessment of model performance.

2508.11669.tldr: This study lays a foundation work for real-time, unobtrusive ABP monitoring in real-world perioperative settings, providing baseline for future advancements in this area and introduces a lightweight sInvResUNet, along with a collaborative learning scheme named KDCL_sInvResUNet.

2508.17218.tldr: This work addresses the reliable shortest path problem in stochastic transportation networks and proposes a path planning solution integrating the decision Transformer with the Generalized Policy Gradient (GPG) framework, leveraging the Transformer's ability to model long-term dependencies.

2508.19005.tldr: This paper introduces Experience-driven Lifelong Learning (ELL), a framework for building self-evolving agents capable of continuous growth through real-world interaction, and introduces StuLife, a benchmark dataset that simulates a student's holistic college journey, from enrollment to academic and personal development.

2508.19008.tldr: This study examines the capacity of large language models (OpenAI's GPT, Google's Gemini, and Anthropic's Claude) to support qualitative clinical analysis to mitigate human interpretative bias and enhance sensitivity.

2508.19065.tldr: This work introduces an efficient Federated Unlearning framework based on information theory, modeling leakage as a parameter estimation problem, and effectively neutralizes the malicious trigger, restoring model integrity in a targeted backdoor attack scenario.

2509.08604.tldr: It is demonstrated that memorization is prevalent across all adaptation scenarios and significantly higher than that reported in the general domain, and it is persistent: up to 87% of content memorized during continued pre-training remains after fine-tuning on new medical tasks.

2509.09919.tldr: It is found that joint optimization not only struggles as task complexity increases, but consistently underperforms relative to optimization over the WFC-MDP, underscoring the advantages of decoupling local constraint satisfaction from global objective optimization.

2509.11480.tldr: This work presents an evaluation of five representative VLA models -- spanning state-of-the-art baselines and two newly proposed architectures -- targeting edge and datacenter GPU platforms, challenging current assumptions about the superiority of datacenter hardware for robotic inference.

2509.13379.tldr: This work conducts a comprehensive uncertainty benchmarking study, evaluating 18 state-of-the-art VLMs (open and closed-source) across 6 multimodal datasets with 3 distinct scoring functions, and demonstrates that larger models consistently exhibit better uncertainty quantification.

2509.13588.tldr: Through CoBRA, it is shown how to operationalize validated social science knowledge as reusable"gym"environments for AI -- an approach that may generalize to richer social and affective simulations beyond bias alone.

2509.13805.tldr: This work presents the General Physics Transformer (GPhyT), trained on 1.8 TB of diverse simulation data, that demonstrates foundation model capabilities are achievable for physics and opens the path toward a universal PFM that could transform computational science and engineering.

2509.14260.tldr: It is shown that several state-of-the-art models presented with a simple task (including Grok 4, GPT-5, and Gemini 2.5 Pro) sometimes actively subvert a shutdown mechanism in their environment to complete that task.

2509.14278.tldr: This paper systematically examines emerging privacy risks of LLMs, discussing potential mitigation strategies and calling for the research community to broaden its focus beyond data privacy risks, developing new defenses to address the evolving threats posed by increasingly powerful LLMs and LLM-powered systems.

2509.14788.tldr: This work introduces a sequence-based drug-target interaction framework that integrates structural priors into protein representations while maintaining high-throughput screening capability, and validate the framework's utility for scalable and structure-aware DTI prediction.

2509.16891.tldr: LaySPA is introduced, a reinforcement learning-based framework that augments LLM-based agents with explicit spatial reasoning capabilities for layout design, outperforming larger general-purpose LLMs and achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art specialized layout models.

2509.17466.tldr: The findings show Autiverse scaffolded adolescents'coherent narratives, while enabling parents to learn additional details of their child's events and emotions, and the customized AI peer created a comfortable space for sharing, fostering enjoyment and a strong sense of agency.

2509.18135.tldr: A novel Static-Dynamic Graph Fusion network, whose core lies in capturing multi-scale inter-series correlations through a dual-path graph structure learning approach, which utilizes a static graph based on prior knowledge to anchor long-term, stable dependencies.

2509.21447.tldr: Together, ARTI-6 provides an interpretable, computationally efficient, and physiologically grounded framework for advancing articulatory inversion, synthesis, and broader speech technology applications.

2509.25236.tldr: This work introduces the causal abstraction network (CAN), a general sheaf-theoretic framework for representing, learning, and reasoning across collections of mixture causal models (MCMs), and addresses the problem of learning consistent CANs from data by exploiting the compositionality of causal abstractions and necessary conditions for their existence.

2509.25804.tldr: CardioForest is recognized as an extremely dependable and interpretable WCT detection model, able to offer accurate predictions and transparency through explainability makes it a valuable tool to help cardiologists make timely and well-informed diagnoses, especially for high-stakes and emergency scenarios.

2510.04182.tldr: Extensive experiments show that LTPO not only matches or surpasses strong baselines on standard tasks but also demonstrates remarkable robustness where others fail, showcasing a unique capability for complex reasoning.

2510.06913.tldr: Decomposed Multi-agent GAIL is proposed, which explicitly decomposes realism into ego-map and ego-neighbor components, filtering out misleading neighbor: neighbor and neighbor: map interactions and introduces a social PPO objective that augments ego rewards with distance-weighted neighborhood rewards, encouraging overall realism across agents.

2510.09017.tldr: The experiments demonstrate that VGA significantly mitigates the formation of attention sinks and stabilizes value-state norms, leading to improved performance, robust quantization fidelity, and enhanced model interpretability.

2510.09394.tldr: This work designs a lightweight, low-rank coarsening network to efficiently capture multi-scale structural features as hierarchical basis vectors for prompt generation and proposes a Multi-Scale Graph Chain-of-Thought (MSGCOT) prompting framework, mimicking human cognition from coarse-to-fine granularity.

2510.10977.tldr: This work systematically revisit the simplest merging method that interpolates two weights directly and observes that model interpolation follows a three-stage evolutionary paradigm with distinct behaviors on the reasoning trajectory that provides a principled guide for navigating the performance-cost trade-off.

2510.11020.tldr: This work proposes a reinforcement learning framework that enhances diagram-text alignment in auxiliary lines, and derives GeoVLMath, an LVLM for solving complex solid geometry.

2510.13551.tldr: T tandem training for language models, a reinforcement learning (RL) paradigm in which rollout tokens are intermittently and randomly sampled from a frozen weak model rather than the strong model being trained, demonstrates a promising route to building AI systems that remain auditable by weaker agents, with implications for human--AI collaboration and multi-agent communication.

2510.16387.tldr: An in-depth analysis of Whisper's embeddings reveals that, even without task-specific fine-tuning, the model intrinsically encodes both ordinal proficiency patterns and semantic aspects of speech, highlighting its potential as a powerful foundation for SLA and other spoken language understanding tasks.

2510.18619.tldr: This work proposes Visual Attention Reasoning (VAR), a reinforcement learning framework that reformulates reasoning as a hierarchical search with self-verification, and replaces linear Chain-of-Thought with a tree-search policy capable of backtracking to correct logical errors.

2510.20984.tldr: A Grouped Lattice Vector Quantization (GLVQ) framework that assigns each group of weights a customized lattice codebook, defined by a learnable generation matrix, highlighting its effectiveness in deploying large models under stringent resource constraints.

2510.26805.tldr: This work introduces reinforcement learning for accelerator beamline control (RLABC), a Python-based library that reframes beamline optimization as a reinforcement learning (RL) problem, and automates the creation of an RL environment from standard lattice and command files, enabling sequential tuning of magnets to minimize particle losses.

2511.00847.tldr: This work is the first to propose a formal economic model for a realistic user-provider ecosystem, where a user can iteratively delegate $T$ queries to multiple model providers, and providers can engage in a range of strategic behaviors.

2511.02599.tldr: This work proposes Next Token Knowledge Tracing (NTKT), a novel approach that reframes KT as a next-token prediction task using pretrained Large Language Models (LLMs), which significantly improves performance over state-of-the-art neural KT models and generalises much better to cold-start questions and users.

2511.04235.tldr: This work introduces a multi-agent predictive coding framework that formulates coordination as the minimization of mutual uncertainty among agents as well as establishing a theoretically principled and biologically plausible basis for how complex social representations emerge from a unified predictive drive, leading to collective intelligence.

2511.04427.tldr: Estimation of the causal effect of adopting a widely popular LLM agent assistant, namely Cursor, on development velocity and software quality finds that the adoption of Cursor leads to a statistically significant, large, but transient increase in project-level development velocity.

2511.08091.tldr: Technically, this work depart from the dynamic programming paradigm typically employed for treewidth-based algorithms and instead exploit structural characterizations of well-formed causal models, providing a new algorithmic toolkit for causal reasoning.

2511.11233.tldr: This work proposes STaR, a novel slow-thinking model that can achieve effective and stable table reasoning and introduces trajectory-level uncertainty quantification, which fuses token-level confidence with answer-level consistency, enabling the selection of better reasoning trajectories.

2511.12071.tldr: A GML pipeline is proposed that integrates a Knowledge Completion (KC) phase to uncover latent dataset semantics before embedding generation, and model hidden connections with decay-based inference functions, reshaping graph topology.

2511.12869.tldr: This work presents a unified, proof-informed framework that formalizes the innate theoretical ceilings of LLM scaling, providing both theoretical foundations and practical mitigation paths like bounded-oracle retrieval, positional curricula, and sparse or hierarchical attention.

2511.15169.tldr: SafeRBench is proposed, the first framework to evaluate LRM safety end-to-end, from the initial input to the reasoning trace and final answer, and introduces a Risk Stratification Probing that uses specific risk levels to stress-test safety boundaries beyond simple topics.

2511.15552.tldr: The proposed benchmark provides a replicable methodology for constructing multimodal benchmarks in typologically diverse languages, particularly within the Slavic language family.

2511.16943.tldr: This work proposes RASTP (Representation-Aware Semantic Token Pruning), which directly prunes less informative tokens in the input sequence, by combining semantic saliency, measured via representation magnitude, and attention centrality, derived from cumulative attention weights.

2512.01289.tldr: OntoMetric is an ontology-guided framework for the automated construction and governance of ESG metric knowledge graphs from regulatory documents that operationalises the ESG Metric Knowledge Graph (ESGMKG) ontology as a first-class constraint embedded directly into the extraction and population process.

2512.01556.tldr: This work proposes LEC, a principled framework that reframes selective prediction as a decision problem governed by a linear expectation constraint over selection and error indicators and achieves tighter FDR control and substantially improves sample retention compared to prior approaches.

2512.09101.tldr: Two new sampling paradigms are proposed: MGP-Short, which performs parallel masked generation with score-based refinement for Markovian tasks, and MGP-Long, which predicts full trajectories in a single pass and dynamically refines low-confidence action tokens based on new observations.

2512.09313.tldr: Hetero-SplitEE is proposed, a novel method that enables heterogeneous IoT devices to train a shared deep neural network in parallel collaboratively, enabling practical deployment of collaborative deep learning in heterogeneous IoT ecosystems.

2512.13481.tldr: Heterogeneous envy-like patterns across models and contexts are revealed, with some models sacrificing personal gain to reduce a peer's advantage, while others prioritize individual maximization.

2512.15979.tldr: It is argued that LLM-based annotation should be treated as a measurement process rather than a purely automated activity and motivated to motivate methodological discussion and future empirical work toward more transparent and reproducible LLM-based annotation in software engineering research.

2512.16912.tldr: The results show that clipping bias under spurious rewards reduces policy entropy, leading to more confident and deterministic outputs, while entropy minimization alone is insufficient for improvement.

2512.18470.tldr: SWE-EVO is introduced, a benchmark that evaluates agents on this long-horizon software evolution challenge, and Fix Rate is proposed, a fine-grained metric that captures partial progress toward solving these complex, long-horizon tasks.

2512.19367.tldr: This work introduces Sprecher Networks, a family of trainable architectures derived from David Sprecher's 1965 constructive form of the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation, and provides empirical demonstrations on supervised regression, Fashion-MNIST classification, and a Poisson PINN, with controlled comparisons to MLP and KAN baselines.

2512.19494.tldr: KAGNNs frequently surpass the performance of their counterpart GNNs and achieve the new state-of-the-art results on crystal system and space group classification tasks in CHILI-3K, which is a large scale inorganic nanomaterials dataset.

2512.21717.tldr: A case study on resource allocation optimization enabled by agentic RL for SAGIN-enabled MC involving diverse radio access technologies (RATs) shows that learning-based methods can effectively handle complex scenarios and substantially enhance network performance in terms of latency and capacity while incurring a moderate increase in power consumption as an acceptable tradeoff.

2601.01832.tldr: Results show that MCMC exploration and greedy refinement are critical for solution quality, while simulated annealing and multi-chain execution primarily improve stability and variance reduction.

2601.02015.tldr: It is concluded that while surprisal can partially account for annotations of metaphor novelty, it remains limited as a metric of linguistic creativity.

2601.04886.tldr: It is suggested that unreliable PR descriptions undermine trust in AI agents, highlighting the need for PR-MCI verification mechanisms and improved PR generation to enable trustworthy human-AI collaboration.

2601.08235.tldr: MMPCI-Bench is introduced, the first Multimodal Pairwise Contextual Integrity benchmark for evaluating privacy behavior in agentic settings and will open-source to facilitate future research on agentic CI.

2601.08653.tldr: Inspired by the Cognitive Load Theory, Prism is proposed, a novel framework for complex intent understanding that enables logically coherent and efficient intent clarification and consistently outperforms existing approaches across clarification interactions, intent execution, and cognitive load benchmarks.

2601.10132.tldr: This study investigates whether LLMs can predict time intervals between recurring user actions, such as repeated purchases, and how different levels of contextual information shape their predictive behavior, and highlights fundamental limitations of today's LLMs in structured temporal inference.

2601.12654.tldr: Across datasets, model classes, and confidence regimes, it is found that explanation multiplicity is widespread and persists even under highly controlled conditions, including high-confidence predictions.

2601.12658.tldr: Structured-Semantic RAG (SSRAG) is introduced, a hybrid architecture that enhances QA quality by integrating query augmentation, agentic routing, and a structured retrieval mechanism combining vector and graph based techniques with context unification.

2601.12816.tldr: The Fisher-Orthogonal Projected Natural Gradient Descent (FOPNG) optimizer is proposed, which enforces Fisher-orthogonal constraints on parameter updates to preserve old task performance while learning new tasks.

2601.13295.tldr: This research presents a novel benchmark for collaborative coding and calls for a shift from pursuing individual agent capability to developing social intelligence, which contrasts sharply with human teams, where adding teammates typically improves productivity.

2601.14724.tldr: HerMES, a novel training-free architecture for real-time and accurate understanding of video streams that requires no auxiliary computations upon the arrival of user queries, guaranteeing real-time responses for continuous video stream interactions, achieves 10$\times$ faster TTFT compared to prior SOTA.

2601.15165.tldr: It is demonstrated that effective reasoning can be better elicited by intentionally forgoing arbitrary order and applying standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) instead, which is minimalist yet surprisingly effective.

2601.15436.tldr: It is found that sycophancy and recency bias are not independent; sycophancy and recency bias interact to produce `constructive interference'effect, where the tendency to agree with the user is exacerbated when the user's opinion is presented last.

2601.16032.tldr: This paper presents analysis of CuTile-based Flash Attention memory behavior and a technique to improve its cache performance and introduces a new programming technique called Sawtooth Wavefront Reordering that reduces L2 misses.

2601.16249.tldr: The score matching framework for causal discovery is extended and a novel leaf discriminant criterion based on the discrete score function is introduced, enabling accurate inference of true causal orders from observed discrete data.

2601.16531.tldr: Engram-Nine is introduced, a collision-free hot-tier extension that maps the most frequent n-grams through a Minimal Perfect Hash Function while retaining the original multi-head hashed lookup as a cold tier while retaining the original multi-head hashed lookup as a cold tier.

2601.16882.tldr: This paper proposes a framework for group counterfactual explanations, which reveal how removing specific past interactions would change a group recommendation, and formalizes this concept, introduces utility and fairness measures tailored to groups, and design heuristic algorithms for efficient explanation discovery.

2601.17858.tldr: A novel approach that efficiently determines optimal data mixing ratios by repurposing model merging weights as a high-fidelity, low-cost performance proxy, MergeMix effectively optimizes the performance of data mixtures without incurring the cost of full-scale training.

2601.17877.tldr: The study argues for embedding AI within a rights-compliant, supranationally coordinated regulatory framework to secure equitable health outcomes and stronger compliance and proposes a model for algorithmic treaty-making inspired by FCTC architecture to enhance pandemic preparedness, surveillance equity and transnational governance resilience.

2601.17879.tldr: Self-Manager, a parallel agent loop that enables asynchronous and concurrent execution, is introduced to demonstrate the necessity of Self-Manager's design choices, as well as its advantages in contextual capacity, efficiency, and generalization.

2601.17885.tldr: EAfowl is introduced, a perception-enhanced multi-view VLA policy for bimanual manipulation that predicts per-token depth distributions, performs differentiable 3D lifting, and aggregates local cross-view neighbors to form geometrically grounded, cross-view consistent representations.

2601.17887.tldr: This work provides the first systematic exploration and evaluation of intent legitimation as a safety failure mode that naturally arises from benign, real-world personalization, highlighting the importance of assessing safety under long-term personal context.

2601.17892.tldr: The research identifies gaps in Indian IP laws' adaptability to AI-generated outputs: trade secret protection is inadequate against AI threats; standardized inventorship criteria are absent and the study proposes harmonized legal taxonomy accommodating AI's role while preserving innovation incentives.

2601.17897.tldr: A Pareto principle of LLM cognition is revealed, where a shared reasoning core is complemented by ability-specific signatures, and a latent-informed candidate prioritization strategy is introduced, which improves reasoning performance by up to 7.5% across challenging benchmarks.

2601.17905.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach predicated on the hypothesis that base and novel class embeddings have structural similarity that consistently improves novel class recognition over the state of the art across multiple benchmarks and backbone architectures.

2601.17920.tldr: A capability driven taxonomy is proposed that organizes systems by decision horizon, uncertainty modeling, action parameterization, constraint handling, failure recovery, and human involvement and synthesizes benchmark task templates and evaluation metrics that prioritize cost aware performance, robustness to drift, constraint violation behavior, and reproducibility.

2601.17942.tldr: A Single-Agent Self-Refinement with Ensemble Voting (SSEV) pipeline built on PET-SQL that operates without ground-truth data, integrating self-refinement with Weighted Majority Voting (WMV) and its randomized variant (RWMA).

2601.17944.tldr: Credit fairness is introduced, a strengthening of sharing incentives that ensures agents who lend resources in early rounds are able to recoup them in later rounds, and its performance in a computational resource-sharing setting is evaluated.

2601.17952.tldr: This work introduces a unified interpretability framework that integrates attributional and mechanistic perspectives through monosemantic feature extraction and produces stable input-level importance scores, advancing the safe and trustworthy application of LLMs in cognitive health and neurodegenerative disease.

2601.17982.tldr: Results indicate that rewarding semantic novelty yields a more compute-efficient exploration-exploitation signal for training reasoning-capable SLMs by introducing cognitive adaptation-adjusting the reasoning process structure rather than per-token computation.

2601.17995.tldr: A robust hierarchical secure aggregation scheme, termed H-SecCoGC, which integrates coding strategies to enforce structured aggregation and avoids the partial participation issue is proposed, thereby significantly improving robustness, privacy preservation, and learning efficiency.

2601.18014.tldr: The results demonstrate that combining deterministic validation with generative prompting provides a robust, interpretable, and scalable solution for structured information extraction, offering a practical alternative to training-heavy or domain-specific models.

2601.18027.tldr: Sentipolis is presented, a framework for emotionally stateful agents that integrates continuous Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance representation, dual-speed emotion dynamics, and emotion--memory coupling, and improves emotionally grounded behavior, boosting communication, and emotional continuity.

2601.18033.tldr: Results show that the Assumption CFF most effectively reduced overreliance without increasing cognitive load, while participants perceived the WhatIf CFF as most helpful, highlighting the value of plan-focused CFFs for supporting critical reflection in GenAI-assisted knowledge work.

2601.18037.tldr: A lightweight embedding module named SpatialEmb is proposed, which extracts and encodes spatial information directly for the ASR model, supporting both fixed and arbitrary microphone topology.

2601.18045.tldr: PIs-Regressor is proposed, a simple yet effective module that learns persistence image (PI) - finite, differentiable representations of topological features - directly from data, which directly incorporates topological information into the network structure, leading to more robust segmentation.

2601.18053.tldr: It is shown that prepending random words/sentences unrelated to the prompt result in greater diversity in the outputs of LLMs, and the evaluation protocol is designed to benchmark the approach and inspire research into benchmarking LLM diversity more systematically.

2601.18064.tldr: RSGN is introduced, a brain-inspired architecture with self-organizing sparse hierarchical input-dependent connectivity that achieves O(n*k) computational complexity and ablation studies confirm the contribution of each architectural component, with Hebbian learning providing consistent improvements.

2601.18067.tldr: EvolVE is presented, the first framework to analyze multiple evolution strategies on chip design tasks, revealing that Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) excels at maximizing functional correctness, while Idea-Guided Refinement (IGR) proves superior for optimization.

2601.18069.tldr: RS-D3SAC, a risk-sensitive deep distributional diffusion-based Soft Actor-Critic algorithm that enables principled tail-risk optimization via Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) while satisfying long-term transmission cost constraints, is put forth.

2601.18085.tldr: Combining a purpose-built virtual patient platform with a principled psychometric model enables robust, interpretable, generalizable competency estimates and supports validation of AI-assisted assessment prior to use with human learners.

2601.18089.tldr: Empirical design space exploration at scales of up to 95B parameters and over a 1T-token training horizon, together with supporting theoretical analysis, shows that LatentMoE consistently outperforms standard MoE architectures in terms of accuracy per FLOP and per parameter.
