2601.18105.tldr: This paper presents a framework designed to mitigate the security risks outlined in the OWASP Top 10, and leverages LLM-enabled intelligent agents, offering a new approach to proactively identify, assess, and counteract security threats in real-time.

2601.18111.tldr: Scaling a general-purpose model is sufficient for state-of-the-art medium-range prediction, eliminating the need for tailored training recipes and proving effective across the full spectrum of probabilistic frameworks.

2601.18118.tldr: LungCRCT is introduced: a latent causal representation learning based lung cancer analysis framework that retrieves causal representations of factors within the physical causal mechanism of lung cancer progression that enables causal intervention analysis for lung cancer treatments.

2601.18119.tldr: The first benchmark for enterprise-level SQL reasoning and debugging with LLMs is introduced, built on an automated construction workflow that uses reverse engineering to systematically inject realistic bugs into large-scale SQL code, enabling scalable and diverse benchmark generation.

2601.18125.tldr: Qualitatively examined computer science students' in-the-moment disclosure and protection behaviors, as well as the reasoning underlying these behaviors, across a range of realistic chatbot tasks to investigate how this fostered privacy awareness, encouraged protective actions, and supported context-specific reasoning about what information to protect and how.

2601.18127.tldr: An institutional perspective and common fallacies in policy implementations of data disclosures for AI are identified and affirmative paths for transparency that are effective rather than merely symbolic are identified.

2601.18129.tldr: Typhoon S is presented, a minimal and open post-training recipe that combines supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and small-scale RFT that transforms both sovereign-adapted and general-purpose base models into instruction-tuned models with strong general performance.

2601.18130.tldr: RouteMoA is proposed, an efficient mixture-of-agents framework with dynamic routing that outperforms MoA across varying tasks and model pool sizes, reducing cost by 89.8% and latency by 63.6% in the large-scale model pool.

2601.18132.tldr: These findings demonstrate the diversity in LLM medical reasoning and the effectiveness of aligning such reasoning in highly uncertain clinical tasks by incorporating calibrated reasoning into a single model, which enables accurate, privacy-preserving, and scalable rare disease risk screening suitable for large-scale local deployment.

2601.18137.tldr: DeepPlanning is introduced, a challenging benchmark for practical long-horizon agent planning that features multi-day travel planning and multi-product shopping tasks that require proactive information acquisition, local constrained reasoning, and global constrained optimization.

2601.18151.tldr: Inspired by existing findings that synergistic effects enhance mutual information between inputs and predictions to generate information gain, this work quantifies graph information gain to identify subgraphs embodying synergistic effects from explanatory subgraphs.

2601.18175.tldr: It is proved that success conditioning exactly solves a trust-region optimization problem, maximizing policy improvement subject to a $\chi^2$ divergence constraint whose radius is determined automatically by the data.

2601.18184.tldr: This report presents VibeVoice-ASR, a general-purpose speech understanding framework built upon VibeVoice, designed to address the persistent challenges of context fragmentation and multi-speaker complexity in long-form audio that remain despite recent advancements in short-form speech recognition.

2601.18188.tldr: A lightweight VLN framework that incorporates inverse dynamics supervision (IDS) as an explicit objective to embed action-grounded visual dynamics into policy learning and achieves superior navigation performance compared to state-of-the-art methods with fewer parameters.

2601.18197.tldr: The GUI Action Critic's Data Flywheel System (GAIA) is proposed, a training framework that enables the models to have iterative critic capabilities, which are used to improve the Test-Time Scaling (TTS) of basic GUI agents' performance.

2601.18200.tldr: This paper formulate heterogeneous CSI batch construction as a partitioning optimization problem that minimizes zero-padding overhead while preserving scenario diversity, and develops a scale-aware adaptive batching strategy that aligns CSI samples of similar scales, and design a double-masking mechanism to isolate valid signals from padding artifacts.

2601.18202.tldr: An agentic pipeline that automatically generates high quality, difficulty-controlled deep search question-answer pairs for a given corpus and a target difficulty level is proposed, and shows SAGE generates questions that require diverse reasoning strategies, while significantly increases the correctness and difficulty of the generated data.

2601.18207.tldr: This work proposes training agents to search and reason over scientific papers -- this tests technical question-answering, it is directly relevant to real scientists, and the capabilities will be crucial to future AI Scientist systems.

2601.18217.tldr: It is shown that increasing state information richness alone can already effectively improve cross-domain robustness and proposed a randomization technique, which is low-overhead and broadly applicable: add small amounts of distractive goal-irrelevant features to the state to make it richer without altering the task.

2601.18218.tldr: This work designed PaperTok, an end-to-end system that automates the initial creative labor by generating script options and corresponding audiovisual content from a source paper, and offers implications for future generative tools that support science outreach.

2601.18225.tldr: This paper introduces ShopSimulator, a large-scale and challenging Chinese shopping environment that evaluates LLMs across diverse scenarios, and reveals that agents struggle with deep search and product selection in long trajectories, fail to balance the use of personalization cues, and to effectively engage with users.

2601.18234.tldr: An early snapshot of GenAI engagement among Saudi nationals is provided and priorities for policymakers and developers are highlighted: expanding AI literacy, ensuring culturally and linguistically aligned GenAI solutions, and strengthening frameworks for privacy and responsible deployment.

2601.18241.tldr: TAM-Eval is introduced, a framework and benchmark designed to evaluate model performance across three core test maintenance scenarios: creation, repair, and updating of test suites, and released as an open-source framework to support future research in automated software testing.

2601.18250.tldr: By learning fundamental, joint-agnostic radiological semantics from large-scale multimodal data, OrthoFoundation overcomes the limitations of conventional models, which provides a robust framework for reducing annotation burdens and enhancing diagnostic accuracy in clinical practice.

2601.18252.tldr: Co-PLNet is presented, a point-line collaborative framework that exchanges spatial cues between the two tasks, where early detections are converted into spatial prompts via a Point-Line Prompt Encoder (PLP-Encoder), which encodes geometric attributes into compact and spatially aligned maps.

2601.18253.tldr: Experiments on industrial datasets show that BoRP (Qwen3-8B/14B) significantly outperforms generative baselines (even Qwen3-Max) in alignment with human judgments, and reduces inference costs by orders of magnitude, enabling full-scale monitoring and highly sensitive A/B testing via CUPED.

2601.18255.tldr: Empirical results demonstrate that OSW uniquely succeeds in preserving fragile coding abilities where Replay fails, while simultaneously maintaining high plasticity for novel tasks, emphasize the necessity of evaluating structural safety alongside average retention in LLM continual learning.

2601.18264.tldr: This work develops an explicit kernel polynomial method to derive an universal approximation of continuous functions, which is characterized not only by the refined Totik-Ditzian-type modulus of continuity, but also by polytopical domain decomposition.

2601.18278.tldr: This work formalizes learned measurement functions as a distinct focus of evaluation and introduces measurement stability, a property capturing invariance of the measured quantity across admissible realizations of the learning process and across contexts.

2601.18296.tldr: This work proposes Temp-R1, the first autonomous end-to-end agent for TKGQA trained through reinforcement learning, and establishes a new paradigm for autonomous temporal reasoning agents.

2601.18306.tldr: It is highlighted that static one-size-fits-all calibration is suboptimal and that tailoring calibration data plays a crucial role in robustly quantizing multilingual LLMs, and that tailoring calibration sets to the evaluation language yields the largest improvements for individual languages.

2601.18308.tldr: Climate RADAR (Risk-Aware, Dynamic, and Action Recommendation system), a generative AI-based reliability layer that reframes disaster communication from alerts delivered to actions executed, is introduced, offering practical pathways toward compliance-ready disaster resilience infrastructures.

2601.18320.tldr: This work proposes MultiVis-Agent, a logic rule-enhanced multi-agent framework for reliable multi-modal and multi-scenario visualization generation, and introduces a four-layer logic rule framework that provides mathematical guarantees for system reliability while maintaining flexibility.

2601.18335.tldr: A GCC-PHAT-based data augmentation (GDA) method that leverages peak characteristics to alleviate intra-task distribution skews and an Analytic dynamic imbalance rectifier (ADIR) with task-adaption regularization, which enables analytic updates that adapt to inter-task dynamics.

2601.18353.tldr: It is found that experts preferred human writing in 82.7% of cases under the in-context prompting condition but this reversed to 62% preference for AI after fine-tuning on authors'complete works, which challenges discourse about AI's creative limitations and raises fundamental questions about the future of creative labor.

2601.18381.tldr: An integrated AI agent framework enabling a transition from static code translation toward dynamic and adaptive analytical behavior is developed, enabling a transition from static code translation toward dynamic and adaptive analytical behavior.

2601.18383.tldr: This work uses attention maps to analyze the influence of reasoning traces and uncover an interesting phenomenon: only some decision-critical tokens in a reasoning trace steer the model toward the final answer, while the remaining tokens contribute negligibly.

2601.18419.tldr: The experimental results show that approaches using MATE with temporal-difference measure (MATE\textsubscript{TD}), AutoMATE, MEDIATE-I, and MEDIATE-S achieved high cooperation levels across all dilemmas, demonstrating that communication is a viable mechanism for fostering emergent cooperation in Quantum Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning.

2601.18420.tldr: This work proposes Gradient-Regularized Natural Gradients (GRNG), a family of scalable second-order optimizers that integrate explicit gradient regularization with natural gradient updates and establishes convergence guarantees for GRNG, showing that gradient regularization improves stability and enables convergence to global minima.

2601.18447.tldr: This paper addresses the problem of counterfactual explanations for deep graph learning models by introducing a generative model-level counterfactual explanation approach called GCFX, which is based on deep graph generation and outperforms existing methods in terms of counterfactual validity and coverage.

2601.18451.tldr: 3DGesPolicy is introduced, a novel action-based framework that reformulates holistic gesture generation as a continuous trajectory control problem through diffusion policy from robotics and a Gesture-Audio-Phoneme (GAP) fusion module that can deeply integrate and refine multi-modal signals, ensuring structured and fine-grained alignment between speech semantics, body motion, and facial expressions.

2601.18464.tldr: Fair-Eye Net is developed, a fair, reliable multimodal AI system closing the clinical loop from glaucoma screening to follow-up and risk alerting, offering a reproducible path for clinical translation and large-scale deployment to advance global eye health equity.

2601.18483.tldr: This work introduces an evaluation framework for fine-grained controllability for both single- and dual-concept scenarios, focusing on linguistically distinct concept pairs, and offers a principled approach for measuring the ability of future methods for multi-concept control.

2601.18491.tldr: A new fine-grained agentic safety benchmark (ATBench) and a Diagnostic Guardrail framework for agent safety and security (AgentDoG) are introduced that can diagnose the root causes of unsafe actions and seemingly safe but unreasonable actions, offering provenance and transparency beyond binary labels to facilitate effective agent alignment.

2601.18510.tldr: This work introduces Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning (JitRL), a training-free framework that enables test-time policy optimization without any gradient updates, and theoretically proves that this additive update rule is the exact closed-form solution to the KL-constrained policy optimization objective.

2601.18521.tldr: A hybrid H3+topology clustering method that yields 12 balanced route clusters and enables efficient distributed training and a global LSTM with cluster-aware features achieves the best trade-off between accuracy and efficiency.

2601.18554.tldr: MOSAIC (MOdular Synthetic Assessment of Instruction Compliance), a modular framework that uses a dynamically generated dataset with up to 20 application-oriented generation constraints to enable a granular and independent analysis of this capability, is introduced.

2601.18569.tldr: An Attention-Based Neural-Augmented Kalman Filter with a neural compensator that uses an attention mechanism to infer error conditioned on foot-slip severity and then applies this estimate as a post-update compensation to the InEKF state (i.e., after the filter update).

2601.18579.tldr: FastInsight overcomes two novel fusion operators: the Graph-based Reranker (GRanker), which functions as a graph model-based search, and Semantic-Topological eXpansion (STeX), which operates as a vector-graph search.

2601.18586.tldr: A generic decision-support framework that couples an integrated assessment model (IAM) with reinforcement learning (RL) to learn adaptive, multi-decade investment pathways under uncertainty, illustrating the framework's transferability to other hazards and cities.

2601.18595.tldr: This work proposes a novel method that uses feedback from the logic solver to augment a logic problem with commonsense relations provided by the LLM, in an iterative manner, and achieves considerable improvements over existing techniques.

2601.18617.tldr: This work investigates whether and when phonemic, lexical, and syntactic representations emerge in the activations of artificial neural networks during their training, and delineates a promising path to understand the computations underpinning language acquisition.

2601.18675.tldr: For in-ICU mortality prediction, embedding models consistently outperform end-to-end predictors, improving accuracy from 0.72-0.75 to 0.83, which indicates that learning embeddings as an intermediate step is more effective than direct end-to-end learning.

2601.18681.tldr: It is proved that solving ART-RL recovers the optimal ART schedule, which enables practical actor--critic updates to learn the latter in a data-driven way and improves Fr\'echet Inception Distance on CIFAR-10 over a wide range of budgets and transfers to AFHQv2, FFHQ, and ImageNet without the need of retraining.

2601.18694.tldr: A few-shot voice cloning system for Nepali speakers, designed to synthesize speech in a specific speaker's voice from Devanagari text using minimal data is presented, demonstrating the feasibility of few-shot voice cloning for the Nepali language and establishing a foundation for personalized speech synthesis in low-resource scenarios.

2601.18700.tldr: TEA-Bench is introduced, the first interactive benchmark for evaluating tool-augmented agents in ESC, featuring realistic emotional scenarios, an MCP-style tool environment, and process-level metrics that jointly assess the quality and factual grounding of emotional support.

2601.18706.tldr: Health-SCORE provides two practical benefits beyond standalone evaluation: it can be used as a structured reward signal to guide reinforcement learning with safety-aware supervision, and it can be incorporated directly into prompts to improve response quality through in-context learning.

2601.18707.tldr: This work introduces SMART, a neural surrogate model that predicts physical quantities at arbitrary query locations using only a point-cloud representation of the geometry, without requiring access to the simulation mesh.

2601.18713.tldr: By implementing Point Transformer, a self-attention network designed for point cloud analysis, this work is able to improve the performance of heterogeneity analysis on CryoEM data, and characterize the dynamics of highly complex protein systems in a more human-interpretable way.

2601.18714.tldr: MinkUNeXt-VINE is proposed, a lightweight, deep-learning-based method that surpasses state-of-the-art methods in vineyard environments thanks to its pre-processing and Matryoshka Representation Learning multi-loss approach and demonstrates the efficiency of the trade-off output produced by this approach.

2601.18716.tldr: A novel, Generative AI–based drug design approach to promote targeted degradation of Aβ42 via the ubiquitin–proteasome system (UPS), using E3 ligase–directed molecular glues, which offers a promising framework for designing UPS-targeted therapies for neurodegenerative diseases.

2601.18724.tldr: Analysis of papers published at ACL, NAACL, and EMNLP in 2024 and 2025 reveals that nearly 300 papers contain at least one HalluCitation, most of which were published in 2025, indicating that this issue is rapidly increasing.

2601.18731.tldr: Meta Reward Modeling (MRM) is proposed, which reformulates personalized reward modeling as a meta-learning problem and represents each user's reward model as a weighted combination of base reward functions, and optimize the initialization of these weights using a Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML)-style framework to support fast adaptation under limited feedback.

2601.18732.tldr: This paper provides decision problem agnostic conditions under which separation training preference free and applying preferences ex post is optimal, and provides design guidance: preserve optionality through post-processing when objectives may shift; embed preferences when decision-stage frictions dominate.

2601.18733.tldr: The Multi-Agent Robotic System (MARS) Challenge is proposed, held at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on SpaVLE, where participants explore multi-agent embodied planning using vision-language models (VLMs) to coordinate tasks and policy execution to perform robotic manipulation in dynamic environments.

2601.18735.tldr: Experiments on five multimodal benchmarks show that Agora outperforms strong VLMs and heuristic multi-agent strategies, e.g., achieving +8.5% accuracy over the best baseline on MMMU while reducing cost by over 3x.

2601.18744.tldr: TSRBench is introduced, a comprehensive multi-modal benchmark designed to stress-test the full spectrum of time series reasoning capabilities and reveals that strong reasoning does not guarantee accurate context-aware forecasting, indicating a decoupling between semantic understanding and numerical prediction.

2601.18747.tldr: It is proposed that a retrieval engine must be capable of evaluating any polynomial-time property directly over its index in a computationally efficient manner, and the theoretical foundation for turning the search index into a general-purpose computational engine is established.

2601.18751.tldr: TriTrust-PBRL (TTP) is introduced, a unified framework that jointly learns a shared reward model and expert-specific trust parameters from multi-expert preference feedback, enabling the model to automatically invert adversarial preferences and recover useful signal rather than merely discarding corrupted feedback.

2601.18753.tldr: The Hallucination Risk Bound is introduced, a unified theoretical framework that formally decomposes hallucination risk into data-driven and reasoning-driven components, linked respectively to training-time mismatches and inference-time instabilities, providing a principled foundation for analyzing how hallucinations emerge and evolve.

2601.18754.tldr: The first large-scale evaluation suite for assessing the security-aware autonomy of LLM-based UAV agents under realistic adversarial interference is introduced, introducing $\alpha^{3}$-SecBench, the first large-scale evaluation suite for assessing the security-aware autonomy of LLM-based UAV agents under realistic adversarial interference.

2601.18771.tldr: Dep-Search is proposed, a dependency-aware search framework that advances beyond existing search frameworks by integrating structured reasoning, retrieval, and persistent memory through GRPO.

2601.18777.tldr: A statistical framework extending Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that combines minimal human annotations with LLM judgments to produce reliable estimates of metrics which require sub-instance annotations at the query-document level is presented.

2601.18779.tldr: Privileged On-Policy Exploration (POPE) is introduced, an approach that leverages human- or other oracle solutions as privileged information to guide exploration on hard problems, unlike methods that use oracle solutions as training targets (e.g., off-policy RL methods or warmstarting from SFT).

2601.18783.tldr: This work presents a Proximal Policy Optimization based multi-objective reinforcement learning framework that learns a continuous set of policies explicitly representing these trade-offs and evaluates it on a scalable simulation platform for tactical decision making in trucks.

2601.18785.tldr: This extended abstract outlines some design techniques and evaluation considerations associated with an LLM system that uses an LLM to transform author-created story schemas into player-driven playthroughs of Dramamancer.

2601.18791.tldr: Analysis of 26,939 cross-linguistic homographs reveals that 48.7% receive different segmentations across related languages, with variation correlating to phylogenetic distance, and quantitative macro-linguistic insights into lexical patterns across typologically diverse languages within a unified analytical framework.

2601.18796.tldr: This work develops an open-source, domain-agnostic ELM architecture and training framework, design training tasks for clinical trials, and introduces an expert-validated synthetic dataset to align Large Language Models to embeddings of clinical trials using the recently reported Embedding Language Model (ELM) method.

2304.13894.tldr: This study proposes a deep learning-based method to identify IoT devices using the Aalto dataset using Convolutional Neural Networks to classify devices by converting network packet payloads into pseudo-images, and compares it against a feature-based fingerprinting method.

2404.04254.tldr: This work conducts the first systematic study on watermark-based, user-level attribution of AI-generated content and shows that watermark-based attribution inherits both the accuracy and (non-)robustness properties of the underlying watermark.

2407.06098.tldr: A novel framework that combines knowledge from epistemology to enhance the detection of implicit injustices in text using NLP models to address these complexities and offer explainability is introduced.

2410.11234.tldr: This paper proposes modeling offline MBRL as a Bayes Adaptive Markov Decision Process (BAMDP), which is a principled framework for addressing model uncertainty, and proposes a novel Bayes Adaptive Monte-Carlo planning algorithm capable of solving BAMDPs in continuous state and action spaces with stochastic transitions.

2411.03709.tldr: An automatic system for efficiently and accurately constructing GameUI, AutoGameUI, based on a two-stage multimodal learning pipeline to obtain the optimal correspondences between UI and UX designs, conveying significant practical value for game UI development.

2411.07559.tldr: Zer0-Jack, a method that bypasses the need for white-box access by leveraging zeroth-order optimization and achieving a high attack success rate across various models, surpassing previous transfer-based methods and performing comparably with existing white-box jailbreak techniques.

2501.07639.tldr: The study reveals the impact of LLM architecture, size, and fine-tuning and demonstrates the framework’s ability to handle realistic grid components and constraints and introduces PowerGraph-LLM, the first framework explicitly designed for solving OPF problems using Large Language Models (LLMs).

2502.10495.tldr: SWA-LDM (Stealthy Watermark for LDM), a lightweight framework that enhances stealth by dynamically randomizing the embedded watermarks using the Gaussian-distributed latent noise inherent to diffusion models, enabling secure deployment of watermarked generative AI in real-world applications.

2502.17498.tldr: This work treats the result of Monte Carlo sampling as a single sample from the prior ground-truth Binomial distribution, and quantifies the sampling error as the mismatch between posterior estimated distribution and ground-truth distribution, which is thus optimized via distribution selection optimization.

2502.20772.tldr: A damper characteristics-based Bayesian physics-informed neural network (Damper-B-PINN) framework to estimate dynamic wheel load, which leverages the suspension dynamics as physical guidance of PINN while employing Bayesian inference to mitigate the effects of system noise and uncertainty.

2503.01098.tldr: This work introduces SolBench, a comprehensive benchmark and automated testing pipeline for Solidity that emphasizes functional correctness via differential fuzzing, and proposes Retrieval-Augmented Repair (RAR), a cost-effective framework that integrates execution feedback into code repair.

2503.14228.tldr: This work proposes a transformer-based person detection and localization method that combines panoramic-image remapping and the tokenization procedure and demonstrates that this method outperforms conventional methods on large-scale datasets.

2505.06047.tldr: A unified framework for irregular time series classification is introduced, and the first standardized dataset repository for irregular time series classification is built on a common array format to enhance interoperability.

2505.14140.tldr: RL-of-Thoughts (RLoT), where a lightweight navigator model with reinforcement learning (RL) to adaptively enhance LLM reasoning at inference time is proposed, which is able to make sub-10B LLMs comparable to 100B-scale counterparts.

2505.14549.tldr: How LLMs can consistently mishandle broad classes of human names even in short text snippets due to ambiguous linguistic cues in the contexts is revealed and called for a systematic investigation into their privacy failure modes and countermeasures.

2505.19514.tldr: Experiments across question answering and reasoning benchmarks show that SIPDO outperforms standard prompt tuning methods, highlighting the value of integrating data synthesis into prompt learning workflows.

2505.21372.tldr: HollM is proposed, a novel global optimization algorithm that enhances LLM-driven sampling by partitioning the search space into promising subregions and consistently matches or surpasses leading global optimization methods, while substantially outperforming global LLM-based sampling strategies.

2505.22338.tldr: Text2Grad is introduced, a reinforcement-learning paradigm that turns free-form textual feedback into span-level gradients, suggesting that natural-language feedback can serve not only as explanations, but also as actionable training signals for fine-grained alignment.

2505.23785.tldr: It is argued that large language models (LLMs) can make cultural context, and therefore human meaning, legible at an unprecedented scale in AI-based sociotechnical systems and frame this as a crucial direction for the application of generative AI.

2506.00452.tldr: An Attention-aided MMSE (A-MMSE), a model-based DNN framework that learns the linear MMSE filter via the Attention Transformer and its rank-adaptive extension provide an improved performance-complexity trade-off, providing a powerful and highly efficient solution for practical channel estimation.

2506.01297.tldr: MoRA is presented, a human-centric geospatial framework that leverages a mobility graph as its core backbone to fuse various data modalities, aiming to learn embeddings that represent the socio-economic context and functional role of a location.

2506.10139.tldr: A new unsupervised algorithm, Internal Coherence Maximization (ICM), is introduced, to fine-tune pretrained language models on their own generated labels, without external supervision, on GSM8k-verification, TruthfulQA, and Alpaca reward modeling tasks.

2506.11062.tldr: A generative model is introduced, to learn this underlying representation from detailed connectivity maps of mouse cortical microcircuits, and it is found that specific, interpretable directions within this space directly relate to understandable network properties.

2506.12241.tldr: By designing Camber, a framework for context disambiguation, it is shown that model-generated decision rationales can reveal ambiguities and that systematically disambiguating context based on these rationales leads to significant accuracy improvements and reductions in prompt sensitivity.

2506.14852.tldr: Evaluation across multiple real-world agent applications shows that the proposed Agentic Plan Caching (APC) system can reduce costs and latency by 50.31% and latency by 27.28% on average while maintaining performance, offering a more efficient solution for serving LLM-based agents that complements existing LLM serving infrastructures.

2506.14988.tldr: A novel probing framework that strategically gathers information about selected arms before allocation is introduced, and a greedy probing algorithm is developed that achieves sublinear regret while maintaining fairness.

2506.22506.tldr: This work presents the first study of backdoor attacks in Federated Prompt Learning, and proposes SABRE-FL, a lightweight, modular defense that filters poisoned prompt updates using an embedding-space anomaly detector trained offline on out-of-distribution data.

2507.06196.tldr: This work introduces UQLM, a Python package for LLM hallucination detection using state-of-the-art uncertainty quantification (UQ) techniques, and offers a suite of UQ-based scorers that compute response-level confidence scores ranging from 0 to 1.

2507.07981.tldr: The main finding is that IM-RMs rely more heavily on superficial token-level cues than EX-RMs under token-level distribution shifts, as well as in-distribution, which highlights that seemingly minor design choices can substantially impact the generalization behavior of reward models.

2507.12619.tldr: This work presents the first in-depth characterization of LLM training startup overhead based on real production data, and analyzes the components of startup cost, quantify its direct impact, and examine how it scales with job size.

2507.13550.tldr: A transparent hybrid solution that combines the recall capacity of LLMs with the precision of symbolic systems, thereby laying the foundation for dependable AI applications in sensitive domains.

2508.01475.tldr: This work takes an analysis-driven approach to investigate text-graph representation complementarity via a unified architecture that supports knowledge co-distillation (CoD) by tracking how these dual representations evolve during training, and provides insights into when and why their integration is beneficial.

2508.03785.tldr: The proposed SoilNet is a multimodal multitask model designed to address complex hierarchical classification, where the number of possible labels is very large, imbalanced and non-trivially structured and the method is designed to address complex hierarchical classification.

2508.05792.tldr: Holistic eXplainable AI (H-XAI) is introduced, a framework that integrates causality-based rating methods with post-hoc explanation techniques to support transparent, stakeholder-aligned evaluation of AI systems deployed in online decision contexts.

2508.06832.tldr: A language-centered framework for remote sensing interpretation is proposed that treats LLMs as the cognitive central hub integrating perceptual, task, knowledge and action spaces to enable unified understanding, reasoning, and decision-making.

2508.09156.tldr: This work applies a differentiable post-training procedure that minimizes weak-form residuals of governing partial differential equations (PDEs) to enforce physical constraints and solve inverse problems in scientific systems, opening new avenues for simulation-augmented discovery and data-efficient modelling of physical systems.

2508.09239.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations across diverse real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GDAGS achieves superior rendering quality while effectively mitigating over-reconstruction, suppressing over-densification, and constructing compact scene representations.

2508.10530.tldr: It is shown on-policy data is not always optimal, with systematic effectiveness difference emerging between static and on-policy preference candidates, and the alignment stage assumption is proposed, which divides the alignment process into two distinct stages: the preference injection stage, which benefits from diverse data, and the preference fine-tuning stage, which favors high-quality data.

2508.10539.tldr: This paper identifies that the estimation error primarily arises from high variance rather than bias, and the MC estimator is a Minimum Variance Unbiased Estimator (MVUE), and proposes the ComMCS method, which constructs an unbiased estimator by linearly combining the MC estimators from the current and subsequent steps.

2509.15098.tldr: This work proposes TextMineX: the first dataset, evaluation framework and ontology-guided large language model (LLM) pipeline for knowledge extraction from text in the HMA domain, and introduces a bias-aware evaluation framework that combines human-annotated triples with an LLM-as-Judge protocol to mitigate position bias in reference-free scoring.

2509.17477.tldr: LingoQ is presented, an AI-mediated system that allows workers to practice English using quizzes generated from their LLM queries during work, and design implications for leveraging workers'growing reliance on LLMs to foster proficiency and engagement while respecting work boundaries and ethics are discussed.

2509.18561.tldr: SoundCompass is proposed, an effective directional clue integration framework centered on a Spectral Pairwise INteraction (SPIN) module that captures cross-channel spatial correlations in the complex spectrogram domain to preserve full spatial information in multichannel signals.

2509.21028.tldr: SciTrek is introduced, a diagnostic question-answering benchmark designed to probe long-context numerical reasoning in large language models (LLMs) and provides verifiable reasoning traces for fine-grained error analysis and enables efficient scaling to longer contexts with minimal human supervision.

2509.21044.tldr: This study draws inspiration from prior work on edge attribution patching to investigate the internal differences of LLMs before and after RL fine-tuning, and shows two robust effects of online RL post-training.

2509.24196.tldr: It is shown that an LLM, fed with descriptive inputs of arbitrarily shaped metasurface geometries, can learn the physical relationships needed for spectral prediction and inverse design, and it is demonstrated that 1-D token-wise LLMs provide a practical tool for designing 2-D arbitrarily shaped metasurfaces.

2509.26201.tldr: This work repurposes LangGraph's tool functionality to supply agents with a black box function to interrogate, and provides proof of concept for this approach through a children's parlor game, demonstrating the role of trial-and-error and persistence in knowledge discovery, and the strong path-dependence of results.

2510.01812.tldr: This work introduces SingMOS-Pro, a dataset for automatic singing quality assessment, and extends the annotations of the additional data to include lyrics, melody, and overall quality, offering broader coverage and greater diversity.

2510.03252.tldr: Diffusion Router (DR) is proposed, a unified diffusion-based framework that models all central and non-central translations with a single noise predictor conditioned on the source and target domain labels and establishes DR as a scalable and versatile framework for universal translation across multiple domains.

2510.05115.tldr: SAC-Opt is proposed, a backward-guided correction framework that grounds optimization modeling in problem semantics rather than solver feedback, and highlights the importance of semantic-anchored correction in LLM-based optimization workflows to ensure faithful translation from problem intent to solver-executable code.

2510.09110.tldr: Synthetic Object Compositions (SOC) is introduced, an accurate and scalable data synthesis pipeline via a novel object-centric composition strategy that enables controllable dataset construction for different use cases and boosts performance in both low-data and closed-vocabulary scenarios.

2510.09805.tldr: The method introduces a smooth monotone mapping $t \mapsto \tau(t)$ that regularizes near-singular behavior of the underlying flow while preserving its conservation laws.

2510.10718.tldr: HYPERDOA is introduced, a novel estimator leveraging Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) that achieves ~35.39% higher accuracy than state-of-the-art methods in low-SNR, coherent-source scenarios and consumes ~93% less energy than competing neural baselines on an embedded NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX platform.

2510.11001.tldr: Dynamic Nested Depth is introduced, a novel method that improves performance for off-the-shelf LLMs by selecting critical tokens to reprocess in a nested depth manner and directly integrating it into pre-trained dense and MoE models during a post-training phase.

2510.11358.tldr: This work formalizes LLM-specific utility as the performance improvement of a target LLM when a passage is provided, compared to answering without evidence, and introduces the LLM-specific utility judgment task, which shows that utilitarian passages are model-dependent and non-transferable.

2510.12953.tldr: This work proposes Salient Epistemic Disentanglement (SED), which injects an expert-curated bipartite graph into the model to decouple view-disease associations and to steer preference selection along clinically faithful steps via reinforcement learning, which mitigates variability across diseases and heterogeneity across views.

2510.14401.tldr: A CPR simulation framework that removes explicit reward signals and embeds cultural-evolutionary mechanisms that reveal systematic model differences in sustaining cooperation and norm formation, positioning the framework as a rigorous testbed for studying emergent norms in mixed-motive LLM societies.

2510.14459.tldr: Across SFT, DPO, and SimPO, and over diverse backbones and datasets, ICA-based reweighting consistently improves model alignment with minimal overhead and is analyzed sensitivity to score update frequency and the number of in-context holdout examples.

2510.15303.tldr: DSSmoothing provides provable robustness guarantees for dataset ownership verification by ensuring that WR consistently exceeds PP under bounded dual-space perturbations.

2510.20691.tldr: Graph-RFT is proposed, a novel two-stage reinforcement fine-tuning KGQA framework with a'plan-KGsearch-and-Websearch-and-Websearch-during-think'paradigm, that enables LLMs to perform autonomous planning and adaptive retrieval scheduling across KG and web sources under incomplete knowledge conditions.

2510.20795.tldr: This paper implements a novel Bayesian graph deep learning framework for estimating key cosmological parameters in a primordial magnetic field (PMF) cosmology from simulated Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) maps, enabling robust cosmological inference in the era of precision cosmology.

2510.23634.tldr: In the important case of an infinite ground set, it is shown that MAS functions do not exist, but a model called the authors' which provably enjoys a relaxed MAS property is provided, which is stable in the sense of Holder continuity and is stable in the sense of Holder continuity.

2510.25065.tldr: Experiments on multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that integrating the TACReward into sparse reward frameworks encourages the policy model to improve the structural quality of reasoning, which leads to consistent performance improvements over existing sparse reward frameworks.

2510.26601.tldr: ResMatching is presented, a novel CSR method that uses guided conditional flow matching to learn improved data-priors and consistently achieves competitive results, demonstrating in all cases the best trade-off between data fidelity and perceptual realism.

2510.27486.tldr: The first Federated AdamW algorithm is proposed, called FedAdamW, for training and fine-tuning various large models, and it is proved that FedAdamW achieves a linear speedup convergence rate of O（p（L∆σ2l ）/（SKRε2） + （L∆）/R） without heterogeneity assumption.

2511.02531.tldr: This Review examines methodological foundations spanning structural causal models, disentangled causal representation learning, and techniques for interventional prediction and counterfactual reasoning on graphs and proposes tiered frameworks distinguishing causally-inspired architectures from causally-validated discoveries.

2511.09486.tldr: Numerical experiments show that the proposed adaptive framework can be used to significantly improve well-known projection methods when employed for various learning tasks, with improvements measurable through both quantitative metrics and the quality of low-dimensional visualizations.

2511.12529.tldr: It is found that AI-generated abstracts hold potential to reach comparable levels of acceptability to human-written ones with minimal revision, and that perceptions of AI authorship, rather than objective quality, drive much of the observed editing behavior.

2512.03102.tldr: Empirical evaluations on realistic hazardous-gas localization tasks show that the proposed diffusion-driven Bayesian exploration framework substantially outperforms classical SMC perturbations and RL-based methods under misalignment, and provides theoretical guarantees that DEPF resolves S-PSI while maintaining statistical rigor.

2512.06652.tldr: This work introduces Adaptive Test-Time Training (AdaTTT), an enhanced TTT framework tailored for EHR-based IMV prediction in ICU settings that incorporates prototype learning and employ Partial Optimal Transport (POT) for flexible, partial feature alignment while maintaining clinically meaningful patient representations.

2512.08931.tldr: An autoregressive denoising architecture and a noise-augmented history memory is used to avoid over-reliance on past frames to balance responsiveness with temporal coherence, and an action-aware adapter is introduced that directly injects action signals into the denoising process.

2512.12576.tldr: CoVRL is proposed, which bridges variational inference and reinforcement learning by coupling prior and posterior distributions through a hybrid sampling strategy, and enables efficient exploration while preserving strong thought-answer coherence.

2512.22287.tldr: The proposed Cluster Aggregated GAN framework is established, a hybrid generative approach that routes each appliance to a specialized branch based on its behavioral characteristics that consistently outperforms baseline methods across metrics measuring realism, diversity, and training stability.

2601.01857.tldr: Jenius-Agent is presented, a system-level agent framework grounded in real-world deployment experience that integrates adaptive prompt generation, context-aware tool orchestration, and layered memory mechanism to stabilize execution and improve robustness in long-horizon, tool-augmented tasks.

2601.06188.tldr: This work constructs an omniscient offline algorithm to compute the novel optimality condition of DCOSP and presents the Dynamic Incremental Neighborhood Stochastic Search (D-NSS) algorithm, an incomplete online decomposition-based DDCOP approach that converges to near-optimal solutions and outperforms DDCOP baselines in terms of solution quality, computation time, and message volume.

2601.08323.tldr: This paper deconstructs high-level memory processes into fundamental atomic CRUD operations, transforming the memory workflow into a learnable decision process and proposes AtomMem, which reframes memory management as a dynamic decision-making problem.

2601.09851.tldr: The Video Summary Information Loss (ViSIL) score is proposed, an information-theoretic framework that quantifies the video information not captured by a summary via vision-language model (VLM) inference and is a unified metric that enables direct comparison across multimodal summary formats despite their structural discrepancies.

2601.12542.tldr: Deep Research is introduced, a multi-agent system enabling interactive scientific investigation with turnaround times measured in minutes, and analysis of architectural constraints, including open access literature limitations and challenges inherent to automated novelty assessment, informs practical deployment considerations for AI-assisted scientific workflows.

2601.13687.tldr: This work introduces SocialMindChange, a benchmark that moves from tracking minds to changing minds in social interaction, using a structured four-step framework and constructing 1,200 social contexts, covering 6000 scenarios and over 90,000 questions, each validated for realism and quality.

2601.13887.tldr: It is argued that human simulation strategies cannot be fully learned from language material alone, and that human-like reasoning processes and action-grounded reasoning methods are essential for robust adaptation and effective interaction with real-world environments.

2601.15301.tldr: A supervised contrastive learning (SCL) framework that learns discriminative style embeddings is proposed that learns discriminative style embeddings and exposes fundamental challenges in building domain-agnostic detectors.

2601.15547.tldr: This work introduces the first systematic framework for learning neural operators from partial observation and introduces two novel components designed explicitly to address the core difficulties of partial observations, a mask-to-predict training strategy that creates artificial supervision by strategically masking observed regions, and a Physics-Aware Latent Propagator that reconstructs solutions through boundary-first autoregressive generation in latent space.

2601.15751.tldr: A new task, Tabular Incremental Inference (TabII), is introduced, which aims to enable trained models to incorporate new columns during the inference stage, enhancing the practicality of AI models in scenarios where tables are dynamically changed.

2601.15828.tldr: Low burstiness and narrative contradiction emerged as the most reliable indicators of synthetic authorship, with unexpected calques, semantic loans and syntactic transfer from English also reported, while features such as grammatical accuracy and emotional tone frequently led to misclassification.

2601.16632.tldr: The Dual-Prototype Adaptive Disentanglement framework is proposed, a model-agnostic auxiliary method that equips forecasting models with the ability of pattern disentanglement and context-aware adaptation and consistently improves forecasting performance and reliability of state-of-the-art models across diverse real-world benchmarks.

2601.16778.tldr: Generative Traffic Agents (GTA) is introduced for simulating large-scale, context-sensitive transportation choices using LLM-powered, persona-based agents and offers new opportunities for modeling how future innovations, from bike lanes to transit apps, shape mobility decisions.

2601.17581.tldr: Agentic PRs differ substantially from Human PRs in commit count and show moderate differences in files touched and deleted lines and exhibit slightly higher description-to-diff similarity across all measures, which provides a large-scale empirical characterization of how AI coding agents contribute to open source development.

2601.17644.tldr: An empirical study is performed to analyze the privacy risks inherent in the mRAG pipeline observed through standard model prompting and implement a case study that attempts to determine whether a visual asset is included in the mRAG, and to leak the metadata related to it.

2601.17717.tldr: This framework describes how LLMs are utilized to generate data across six distinct modalities, and systematically categorizes intrinsic metrics for evaluating synthetic data from two dimensions: quality and trustworthiness.

2601.17737.tldr: A novel, end-to-end agentic framework for dialogue-to-cinematic-video generation, which significantly improves script faithfulness and temporal fidelity across all tested video models and uncovers a crucial trade-off in current SOTA models between visual spectacle and strict script adherence.

2601.17756.tldr: This work proposes and addresses the challenging Multi-View S2V (MV-S2V) task, which synthesizes videos from multiple reference views to enforce 3D-level subject consistency, and introduces Temporally Shifted RoPE (TS-RoPE) to distinguish between different subjects and distinct views of the same subject in reference conditioning.

2601.17912.tldr: It is suggested that the causal pre-training in TabPFN is helpful but insufficient for algorithmic fairness, highlighting implications for deploying TabPFN (and similar) models in practice and the need for further fairness interventions.

2601.17917.tldr: This work proposes Streaming-dLLM, a training-free framework that streamlines inference across both spatial and temporal dimensions and introduces attenuation guided suffix modeling to approximate the full context by pruning redundant mask tokens.

2601.18418.tldr: A systematic study of agentic mid-training, establishing both the data synthesis principles and training methodology for effective agent development at scale and verifying the model's agentic capabilities on `SWE-Bench Verified'.

2601.18798.tldr: ELF is introduced, an encoder-free ELM that replaces the ECG encoder with a single projection layer trained jointly with the LLM, and it is shown that ELF, and potentially other ELMs, often rely more on benchmark artifacts and language priors than ECG-derived information, highlighting limitations in current evaluation practices and ELM design.

2601.18799.tldr: This paper presents a taxonomy of agentic DTs organised around three fundamental dimensions: the locus of agency (external, internal, distributed), the tightness of coupling (loose, tight, constitutive), and model evolution (static, adaptive, reconstructive).

2601.18814.tldr: This study validates a practical hybrid quantum--classical learning paradigm for coronary angiography analysis, providing a feasible pathway for deploying quantum machine learning in medical imaging applications.

2601.18818.tldr: This work introduces LabelKAN, a novel framework based on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to learn inter-label connections from predictions of each label, and demonstrates strong improvements for rare and difficult-to-predict species, which are often the most important when setting biodiversity targets under frameworks like GBF.

2601.18821.tldr: This work explores the scope of Frequent Sequence Mining in the domain of Lossy Image Compression with a combination of closed frequent sequence mining and k-means clustering to handle the redundant data effectively.

2601.18824.tldr: Differential Voting is introduced, a unifying framework that constructs instance-wise, differentiable loss functions whose population-level optima provably correspond to distinct classical voting rules whose population-level optima provably correspond to distinct classical voting rules.

2601.18827.tldr: This paper presents methods to enable structural testing of LLM-based agents and demonstrates how structural testing enables the adaptation of software engineering best practices to agents, including the test automation pyramid, regression testing, test-driven development, and multi-language testing.

2601.18828.tldr: Interactive Project-Based Clustering (IPBC), a framework that reframes clustering as an iterative human-guided visual analysis process, turns clustering into a collaborative discovery process in which machine representation and human insight reinforce one another.

2601.18829.tldr: This work designs a learnable channel-wise filter that decomposes the raw signal into disentangled multi-scale representations, which form the basis of the perceptual space and calculates losses within this space to optimize the model.

2601.18833.tldr: This position paper outlines how process mining has laid the foundations on top of which agents can sense process states, reason about improvement opportunities, and act to maintain and optimize performance, thus redefining the boundaries of process automation and governance.

2601.18834.tldr: CanonBench is introduced, a simple and reproducible stress test for privacy leakage in cluster-level conversation summaries and a minimal defense combining a minimum cluster-size publication threshold and regex-based redaction eliminates measured canary leakage and PII indicator hits in the reported run while maintaining a similar cluster-coherence proxy.

2601.18844.tldr: This first comprehensive empirical study of diverse LLM-based false alarm reduction techniques in an industrial context at Tencent, one of the largest IT companies in China, shows the huge potential of LLMs for reducing false alarms in industrial settings and is cost-effective, with per-alarm savings compared to manual review.

2601.18846.tldr: This work explores whether large language models embedded in an evolutionary loop can be used to design optimisation problems with clearly defined high-level landscape characteristics, using the LLaMEA framework to guide an LLM to generate problem code from natural-language descriptions of target properties.

2601.18847.tldr: MulVul, a retrieval-augmented multi-agent framework designed for precise and broad-coverage vulnerability detection, and cross-model prompt evolution, a prompt optimization mechanism where a generator LLM iteratively refines candidate prompts while a distinct executor LLM validates their effectiveness.

2601.18858.tldr: Across controlled experiments, HE predicts out-of-distribution (OOD) compositional generalization under noise injection, and results indicate the potential of HE to be both a diagnostic and an actionable training signal for improving compositional generalization.

2601.18897.tldr: This study develops an Interval Type-2 Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (IT2-ANFIS) that generates interpretable prediction intervals through fuzzy rule structures that achieves comparable predictive performance to first order ANFIS with substantially reduced variance across training runs.

2601.18904.tldr: Experiments indicate the proposed post-training recipe utilizes only high resource speech data intending to strengthen model's in-context learning capability consistently outperforms direct fine-tuning in low-resource scenario.

2601.18924.tldr: RIFT, Reordered Instruction Following Testbed, is introduced to assess instruction following by disentangling structure from content, revealing structural sensitivity as a fundamental limitation in current architectures, with direct implications for applications requiring non-sequential control flow such as workflow automation and multi-agent systems.

2601.18933.tldr: BabyReasoningBench is introduced, a GPT-5.2 generated benchmark of 19 reasoning tasks grounded in classic paradigms from developmental psychology, spanning theory of mind, analogical and relational reasoning, causal inference and intervention selection, and core reasoning primitives known to be confounded by memory and pragmatics.

2601.18943.tldr: The p-bit is re-engineer by decoupling its stochastic signal path from its input data path, giving rise to a modular p-bit that enables the realization of probabilistic neurons (p-neurons) with a range of configurable probabilistic activation functions, including a probabilistic version of the widely used Logistic Sigmoid, Tanh and Rectified Linear Unit (ReLU) activation functions.

2601.18949.tldr: This approach uses a taxonomy-guided prompting framework to generate machine-originated bugs while preserving original human defects and program structure, enabling analysis of mixed-origin error behavior, multi-bug repair robustness, and reliability in hybrid human-machine code.

2601.18953.tldr: This review discusses the key ideas and core concepts in reinforcement learning with a particular focus on quantum systems, and highlights experimental implementations that exemplify the increasing role of reinforcement learning in shaping the development of quantum technologies.

2601.18963.tldr: Sprout is a developer platform designed to address limitations in robotics through an emphasis on safety, expressivity, and developer accessibility, and expands access to capable humanoid platforms and provides a practical basis for developing embodied intelligence in real human environments.

2601.18993.tldr: FreeOrbit4D is an effective training-free framework that tackles geometric ambiguity by recovering a geometry-complete 4D proxy as structural grounding for video generation and opens a potential avenue for practical applications such as edit propagation and 4D data generation.

2601.18999.tldr: This work gives the first unified mathematical model that captures the core trade-offs between KV cache eviction and query routing and leads to principled algorithms that integrate provably competitive randomized KV cache eviction with learning-based methods to adaptively route queries with evolving patterns, thus balancing query load and cache hit rate.

2601.19030.tldr: This work provides a novel finite-sample analysis of a canonical algorithm for this setting, LSTDQ, and develops error bounds that depend on a novel coverage parameter, the feature-dynamics coverage, which can be interpreted as linear coverage in an induced dynamical system for feature evolution.

2601.19053.tldr: This work investigates how to guide LLMs to act as design mentors by applying the Cognitive Apprenticeship Model, which emphasizes demonstrating reasoning through six methods: modeling, coaching, scaffolding, articulation, reflection, and exploration.

2601.19055.tldr: This paper first derive bounds for learning algorithms that learn from each of these feedback types namely preferences, supervised labels, and cost, and proposes a simple ensembling procedure to jointly learn from these feedback types.

2601.19060.tldr: PixSearch is proposed, the first end-to-end Segmenting Large Multimodal Model (LMM) that unifies region-level perception and retrieval-augmented reasoning and substantially improves factual consistency and generalization.

2601.19066.tldr: It is shown that cogeneration allows the APR agent to generate BRTs for at least as many bugs as a dedicated BRT agent, without compromising the generation rate of plausible fixes, thereby reducing engineering effort in maintaining and coordinating separate generation pipelines for fix and BRT at scale.

2601.19072.tldr: HalluJudge is designed that aims to assess the grounding of generated review comments based on the context alignment and can serve as a practical safeguard to reduce developers' exposure to hallucinated comments, fostering trust in AI-assisted code reviews.

2601.19082.tldr: This work investigates how payoff magnitude and linguistic context shape LLM strategies in repeated social dilemmas, using a payoff-scaled Prisoner's Dilemma to isolate sensitivity to incentive strength.

2601.19090.tldr: A cooperative-competitive learning approach termed differentially private synthetic distillation that learns to convert a pretrained model (teacher) into its privacy-preserving counterpart (student) via a trainable generator without access to private data is proposed.

2601.19091.tldr: This work introduces NOVA, a route to generalizable neural physics solvers that can provide rapid, accurate solutions to scenarios even under distributional shifts in partial differential equation parameters, geometries and initial conditions.

2601.19106.tldr: This paper proposes a post-processing framework that parses generated code into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) and validates it against a dynamically-generated Knowledge Base (KB) built via library introspection and uses deterministic rules to find and fix both API and identifier-level conflicts.

2601.19112.tldr: UA-3DTalk outperforms state-of-the-art methods like DEGSTalk and EDTalk by 5.2% in E-FID for emotion alignment, 3.1% in SyncC for lip synchronization, and 0.015 in LPIPS for rendering quality.

2601.19122.tldr: This work proposes a novel adversarial data augmentation method that employs reinforcement learning to systematically identify and target the weaknesses of function call LLMs and advances the development of more robust FC models.

2601.19132.tldr: The opportunities of in-network collective operations for accelerated collective operations in artificial intelligence (AI) workloads are summarized to make this important field accessible to nonexperts in AI or networking, fostering a connection between these communities.

2601.19138.tldr: This work introduces AgenticSCR, an agentic AI for secure code review for detecting immature vulnerabilities during the pre-commit stage, augmented by security-focused semantic memories, and empirically evaluates how accurate is AgenticSCR for localizing, detecting, and explaining immature vulnerabilities.

2601.19142.tldr: This work proposes LAIN (Length-Adaptive Interest Network), a plug-and-play framework that explicitly incorporates sequence length as a conditioning signal to balance long- and short-sequence modeling and significantly improves accuracy for short-sequence users without sacrificing longsequence effectiveness.

2601.19151.tldr: TS-Debate is presented, a modality-specialized, collaborative multi-agent debate framework for zero-shot time series reasoning that preserves modality fidelity, exposes conflicting evidence, and mitigates numeric hallucinations without task-specific fine-tuning.

2601.19155.tldr: To implement hierarchical reasoning, the RER architecture (Reasoner-Executor-Recorder) is designed, which employs role separation and context compression to prevent the drifting problem in multi-step reasoning and a suite of clue exploration tools that provide diverse evidence to support location reasoning.

2601.19170.tldr: A multi-agent framework that formulates procedural graph extraction as a multi-round reasoning process with dedicated structural and logical refinement, which allows agents to target distinct error types without supervision or parameter updates.

2601.19174.tldr: SHIELD is introduced, a multi-agent, auto-healing defense framework centered on a three-stage Defense Agent that integrates semantic similarity retrieval, pattern matching, and LLM-based reasoning that consistently outperforms perplexity-based and standalone LLM defenses.

2601.19178.tldr: CollectiveKV, a cross-user KV sharing mechanism that captures the information shared across users through a learnable global KV pool is proposed, and can compress the KV cache to only 0.8% of its original size, while maintaining or even enhancing model performance.

2601.19180.tldr: SNR-Edit is introduced, a training-free framework achieving faithful Latent Trajectory Correction via adaptive noise control via adaptive noise control that yields smoother latent trajectories and ensures high-fidelity structural preservation without requiring model tuning or inversion.

2601.19193.tldr: CoReTab is introduced, a code-driven reasoning framework that produces scalable, interpretable, and automatically verifiable annotations by coupling multi-step reasoning with executable Python code and establishes CoReTab as a robust and generalizable supervision framework for improving multi-step reasoning in multimodal table understanding.

2601.19197.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation framework that systematically assesses LLM-powered recommender systems across five human-centered dimensions, revealing critical quality dimensions invisible to traditional metrics is introduced and released as an open-source toolkit to advance human-centered evaluation practices in the recommender systems community.

2601.19204.tldr: MATA (Multi-Agent hierarchical Trainable Automaton), a multi-agent system presented as a hierarchical finite-state automaton for visual reasoning whose top-level transitions are chosen by a trainable hyper agent, achieves the state of theart results compared with monolithic and compositional baselines.

2601.19205.tldr: This work proposes EnzyPGM, a unified framework that jointly generates enzymes and substrate-binding pockets conditioned on functional priors and substrates, with a particular focus on learning accurate pocket-substrate interactions.

2601.19214.tldr: A hybrid pipeline combining a high-recall RoBERTa classifier trained with a precision-recall surrogate to reduce unrecoverable false negatives with a controlled, instruction-tuned LLM for suggestion extraction, categorization, clustering, and summarization is evaluated.

2601.19216.tldr: This work proposes URF-GS, a unified radio-optical radiation field representation framework for accurate and generalizable 3D radio map construction based on 3D Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) and inverse rendering that establishes a foundation for next-generation wireless networks by integrating perception, interaction, and communication through holistic radiation field reconstruction.

2601.19222.tldr: This work proposes UniPCB, the first unified vision-language benchmark for open-ended PCB quality inspection, and introduces PCB-GPT, an MLLM trained on a new instruction dataset generated by this pipeline, utilizing a novel progressive curriculum that mimics the learning process of human experts.

2601.19232.tldr: The Step-wise Optimization of Latent Diffusion Model (SOLD) is proposed, a novel RL framework that optimizes single-step noise without sampling the full diffusion trajectory, achieving efficient refinement of multiple structural objectives.

2601.19249.tldr: The Global Verifier (GLOVE) is proposed, a framework that introduces a new design dimension for LLM memory systems by establishing a relative notion of truth and substantially improves agent success rates, suggesting a robust pathway to cognitive agents capable of self-evolving.

2601.19255.tldr: This work proposes a framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to systematically encode human expertise into interpretable, logic-based rules for detecting anomaly patterns in supply chain time series data and demonstrates how LLMs can bridge the gap between scalable automation and expert-driven decision-making in operational settings.

2601.19257.tldr: PCEvo enumerates multiple chemically feasible edit paths between retrieved similar molecular pairs under topological dependency constraints and introduces a path-consistency objective that enforces prediction invariance across alternative paths connecting the same two molecules.

2601.19258.tldr: Quantitative evaluations with VLMs show that models fine-tuned on GhostUI outperform baseline VLMs, particularly in predicting hidden interactions and inferring post-interaction screens, underscoring GhostUI's potential as a foundation for advancing mobile task automation.

2601.19273.tldr: A simple pipeline for creating and evaluating analogy-based riddles and shows that while models often guess the main intended answer, they frequently miss other valid interpretations, highlighting the value of riddles as a lightweight tool for examining reasoning coverage and ambiguity handling in language models.

2601.19275.tldr: This work introduces Tactile Memory with Soft Robot (TaMeSo-bot), a system that integrates a soft wrist with tactile retrieval-based control to enable safe and robust manipulation and shows remarkable capability to adapt to unseen pegs and conditions.

2601.19276.tldr: Talos is proposed, a loss function that replaces the complex ranking-dependent operations into simpler comparisons between predicted scores and learned score thresholds and incorporates a tailored surrogate function to address discontinuity and enhance robustness against distribution shifts.

2601.19280.tldr: This work proposes Multi-Adversary Group Distributionally Robust Optimization (GDRO), an optimization-first framework that moves beyond uniform reasoning models by dynamically adapting the training distribution and shows an emergent curriculum: the adversaries shift resources to the evolving reasoning frontier, enhancing the reasoning model's performance.

2601.19306.tldr: Analysis indicates that AppCards are particularly effective for multi step and cross application tasks, while improvements depend on the backbone model, and case studies further confirm that AppCards reduce ambiguity, shorten exploration, and support stable execution trajectories.

2601.19314.tldr: This work introduces InstaRadar, an instance segmentation-guided expansion method that leverages pre-trained segmentation masks to enhance Radar density and semantic alignment, producing a more structured representation and integrates the pre-trained RCDPT into the BEVDepth framework as a replacement for its depth module.

2601.19325.tldr: Innovator-VL, a scientific multimodal large language model designed to advance understanding and reasoning across diverse scientific domains while maintaining excellent performance on general vision tasks, demonstrates that principled training design and transparent methodology can yield strong scientific intelligence with substantially reduced data requirements.

2601.19334.tldr: DeconIEP is a decontamination framework that operates entirely during evaluation by applying small, bounded perturbations in the input embedding space, guided by a relatively less-contaminated reference model that steers the evaluated model away from memorization-driven shortcut pathways.

2601.19336.tldr: The Event-Aware World Model (EAWM) is proposed, a general framework that learns event-aware representations to streamline policy learning without requiring handcrafted labels and is presented as a unified formulation of seemingly distinct world model architectures.

2601.19337.tldr: This work proposes a modular robustness testing framework that applies a given set of perturbations to test data and applies it to a real-world autonomous rail inspection system composed of multiple deep networks and demonstrates how the approach enables fine-grained robustness analysis beyond conventional end-to-end metrics.

2601.19341.tldr: This work proposes Difference Reconstruction Uncertainty Estimation (DRUE), a method that mitigates this limitation of uncertainty estimation by reconstructing inputs from two intermediate layers and measuring the discrepancy between their outputs as the uncertainty score.

2601.19362.tldr: On-Demand Communication (ODC) is proposed, which adapts PS into Fully Sharded Data Parallel (FSDP) by replacing collective all-gather and reduce-scatter with direct point-to-point communication and is a superior fit for the prevalent imbalanced workloads in LLM post-training.

2601.19375.tldr: This work proposes Selective Steering, a mathematically rigorous norm-preserving rotation formulation that maintains activation distribution integrity and discriminative layer selection that applies steering only where feature representations exhibit opposite-signed class alignment.

2601.19376.tldr: It is suggested that tangible, visualization-based approaches can make machine learning concepts accessible and engaging for young learners while maintaining technical depth.

2601.19399.tldr: RT-MAE, a novel masked autoencoder framework that augments the supervised attributes-based modeling with unsupervised residual trainable tokens, designed to encode the information not explained by explicit labeled factors, is introduced.

2601.19406.tldr: This work presents SimHum, a co-training framework to simultaneously extract kinematic prior from simulated robot actions and visual prior from real-world human observations, which achieves data-efficient and generalizable robotic manipulation in real-world tasks.

2601.19435.tldr: It is demonstrated that applying the VCG auction mechanism to this genre-based framework yields approximately dominant strategy incentive compatibility (DSIC) and individual rationality (IR), as well as approximately optimal social welfare, while maintaining high computational efficiency.

2601.19447.tldr: KG-CRAFT is presented, a method that improves automatic claim verification by leveraging large language models augmented with contrastive questions grounded in a knowledge graph that achieves a new state-of-the-art in predictive performance.

2601.19452.tldr: Adaptive Policy Composition is proposed, a hierarchical model that adaptively composes multiple data-driven Normalizing Flow (NF) priors that accelerates learning when demonstrations are aligned, remains robust under severe misalignment, and leverages suboptimal demonstrations to bootstrap exploration while avoiding performance degradation caused by overly strict adherence.

2601.19479.tldr: Overall, this study provides a novel proof of concept: survival modelling with DeepHit shows strong potential to advance injury forecasting in football, offering accurate, explainable, and actionable insights for injury prevention across competitive levels.

2601.19487.tldr: LLM-VA is proposed, which aligns the model's willingness to answer causally dependent on its safety assessment through closed-form weight updates, making the model's willingness to answer causally dependent on its safety assessment -- without fine-tuning or architectural changes.

2601.19498.tldr: Cor2Vox is introduced, a cortex-grounded generative framework for brain magnetic resonance image (MRI) synthesis that ties image generation to continuous structural priors of the cerebral cortex and preserved fine-grained cortical morphology at the sub-voxel level, exhibiting remarkable robustness to variations in cortical geometry and disease phenotype without retraining.

2601.19503.tldr: This work introduces GradPruner, which can prune layers of LLMs guided by gradients in the early stages of fine-tuning, and demonstrates that it has achieved a parameter reduction of 40% with only a 0.99% decrease in accuracy.

2601.19519.tldr: A novel motion capture system that reconstructs full-body 3D motion using only sparse pairwise distance measurements from body-mounted UWB sensors, which achieves low joint position error and demonstrates accurate 3D motion reconstruction for both human and animal subjects in-the-wild.

2601.19532.tldr: Omni-MATH-2, a manually revised version of the Omni-MATH dataset comprising a clean, exact-answer subset and a tagged, non-standard subset, is presented, demonstrating that dataset quality and judge reliability are both critical to develop accurate benchmarks of model performance.

2601.19533.tldr: SLM-SS is proposed, a novel approach that applies speech language models to SS, aiming to enhance the intelligibility and coherence of the separated signals, and introduces a non-autoregressive model to improve decoding efficiency for residual tokens.

2601.19551.tldr: This work formulates a structural requirement for state-space model's scale-consistent latent dynamics across iterative refinement, and derives Fractal of Stationary Transformations (FROST), which enforces a self-similar representation manifold through a fractal inductive bias.

2601.19561.tldr: This work proposes AROMMA, a framework that learns a unified embedding space for single molecules and two-molecule mixtures, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in both single-molecule and molecule-pair datasets, demonstrating a robust generalization in two domains.

2601.19568.tldr: Results indicate that efficiency-aware training naturally improves quality through eliminating noisy redundant signals, enabling high-performance cost-effective localization agents.

2601.19588.tldr: DGRC is proposed, which constructs a learning path from atomic knowledge to reasoning chains by dynamically deriving two complementary curricula from disagreements in reasoning pathways by dynamically deriving two complementary curricula from disagreements in reasoning pathways.

2601.19595.tldr: It is argued that true fairness requires addressing bias at the intersections of protected groups, and a unified framework that leverages Mixed-Integer Optimization (MIO) to train intersectionally fair and intrinsically interpretable classifiers is proposed.

2601.19606.tldr: GMS-CAVP is proposed, a novel framework that combines Multi-Scale Video-Audio Alignment and Multi-Scale Spatial-Temporal Diffusion-based pretraining objectives to enhance V-A correspondence modeling and introduces a multi-scale contrastive learning strategy that captures semantic and temporal relations across varying granularities.

2601.19607.tldr: ComAgent, a multi-LLM agentic AI framework, achieves expert-comparable performance in complex beamforming optimization and outperforms monolithic LLMs across diverse wireless tasks, highlighting its potential for automating design in emerging wireless networks.

2601.19611.tldr: This work proposes Multi-head Explicit Attention (MEA), a simple yet effective attention variant that explicitly models cross-head interaction and explores the parameter efficiency of MEA by reducing the number of attention heads and leveraging HLC to reconstruct them using low-rank"virtual heads".

2601.19613.tldr: This work introduces PIP: a Parallel Inference Paradigm for KIE, a tailored mask pre-training strategy and large-scale supervised datasets that achieve a 5-36x inference speedup with negligible performance degradation compared to traditional autoregressive base models.

2601.19618.tldr: A large-scale evaluation of initialization strategies for differentially private medical image analysis, using chest radiograph classification as a representative benchmark with more than 800,000 images, establishes initialization strategy as a central determinant of utility, fairness, and generalization in differentially private medical imaging.
