2512.06343.tldr: NormBT is an adaptive pair-wise normalization scheme that rescales updates to balance representation-driven effects and focuses learning signals on prediction error, a lightweight, drop-in modification to BT loss with negligible overhead.

2512.06749.tldr: DoVer, an intervention-driven debugging framework, which augments hypothesis generation with active verification through targeted interventions through targeted interventions, highlights intervention as a practical mechanism for improving reliability in agentic systems and open opportunities for more robust, scalable debugging methods.

2512.07846.tldr: This work proposes MixLM, a novel LLM-based ranking framework, which significantly improves the system throughput via reducing the input context length, while preserving the semantic strength of cross-encoder rankers.

2512.08366.tldr: DuSAR (Dual-Strategy Agent with Reflecting) is proposed -- a demonstration-free framework that enables a single frozen LLM to perform co-adaptive reasoning via two complementary strategies: a high-level holistic plan and a context-grounded local policy.

2512.11325.tldr: This work proposes to disentangle the visual and textual knowledge embedded within MLLMs and introduces a dedicated approach to selectively erase target visual knowledge while preserving textual knowledge, and is the first to evaluate the robustness of MLLM unlearning against relearning attacks.

2512.11883.tldr: It is found that aesthetic-aligned generation models frequently default to conventionally beautiful outputs, failing to respect instructions for low-quality or negative imagery and penalizing anti-aesthetic images even when they perfectly match the explicit user prompt.

2512.12168.tldr: This work introduces MEDAL, an inference-time scaling framework that integrates Monte Carlo Tree SEarch initialization for Diffusion LAnguage Model inference, and employs Monte Carlo Tree Search at the initialization stage to explore promising unmasking trajectories, enabling efficient inference-time scaling.

2512.13732.tldr: The Physical Inversion Solver (PIS) is proposed, a unified framework that couples Set-Conditioned Flow Matching with a Cosine-Annealed Sparsity Curriculum to enable stable inversion from arbitrary, off-grid sensors even under minimal guidance.

2512.20042.tldr: This work proposes a multimodal pipeline that augments visual input with external textual knowledge that generates significantly more informative captions compared to traditional methods, showing strong potential for real-world applications requiring deeper visual-textual understanding.

2512.22088.tldr: This work formalizes the learning dynamics of transformer-based language models as an ordinary differential equation (ODE) system, then approximates this process to kernel behaviors, and establishes a theoretical upper bound on excess risk characterized by a distinct phase transition.

2512.23410.tldr: These findings establish the foundation for Subspace-Native Distillation: a paradigm where student models target this intrinsic manifold directly, bypassing the high-dimensional optimization bottleneck to realize the vision of "Train Big, Deploy Small".

2512.23719.tldr: This survey organizes recent work by workflow step in meshing and geometry practitioners with limited AI background, and reviews AI guidance for unstructured meshing, block-structured meshing in 2D and 3D, and volumetric parameterization, including reconstruction from implicit or sampled geometry.

2512.24300.tldr: Generative Video Compression (GVC), a new framework that redefines the limits of video compression by leveraging modern generative video models to achieve extreme compression rates while preserving a perception-centric, task-oriented communication paradigm, is introduced within the AI Flow framework.

2601.00269.tldr: In-depth analysis shows hallucinations arise from systematic internal state variations in visual perception, cross-modal reasoning, and language decoding, and different internal signals provide complementary diagnostic cues, and hallucination patterns vary across VLM architectures, offering new insights into the underlying causes of multimodal hallucinations.

2601.01215.tldr: This work presents a framework to measure execution-time memory stability across multiple correct generations and introduces Dynamic Mean Pairwise Distance (DMPD), which uses Dynamic Time Warping to compare the shapes of memory-usage traces after converting them into Monotonic Peak Profiles (MPPs) to reduce transient noise.

2601.03708.tldr: This work presents MHRC-Bench, the first benchmark designed for multilingual hardware code completion at the repository level, and conducts a comprehensive evaluation of models on MHRC-Bench-Eval.

2601.04809.tldr: SCALER introduces a scalable synthesis pipeline that converts real-world programming problems into verifiable reasoning environments with controllable difficulty and unbounded instance generation, enabling RL training beyond finite datasets while preserving strong correctness guarantees.

2601.09635.tldr: This work proposes LEAN-LLM-OPT, a LightwEight AgeNtic workflow construction framework for LLM-assisted large-scale OPTimization auto-formulation, and introduces Large-Scale-OR and Air-NRM, the first comprehensive benchmarks for large-scale optimization auto-formulation.

2601.10457.tldr: The successful deployment of NSR-Boost within the core financial risk control system of Qfin Holdings is reported, where empirical results on real-world online traffic exhibit superior performance improvements and a significant reduction in the bad rate.

2601.12638.tldr: This work proposes a mixed precision framework designed for PointPillars that provides mixed precision models without training in the PTQ pipeline, while the QAT pipeline achieves the performance competitive to FP models.

2601.13435.tldr: A learnable wavelet-based long-short Transformer that jointly performs multi-scale decomposition and return-oriented decision learning, and introduces a low-guided high-frequency injection (LGHI) module that refines low-frequency representations with high-frequency cues while controlling training stability.

2601.13465.tldr: This work shows that encoding global structural constraints as an inductive bias enables a non-autoregressive model to generate solutions via direct forward passes, without search, supervision, or sequential decision-making, on the Travelling Salesman Problem.

2601.13570.tldr: GeoDynamics is introduced, a geometric state-space neural network that tracks latent brain-state trajectories directly on the high-dimensional SPD manifold, demonstrating its scalability and robustness in modeling complex spatiotemporal dynamics across diverse domains.

2601.14598.tldr: Across six architectures drawn from x86, ARM, and MIPS, \textsc{HELIOS} reduces the spread in functional correctness while keeping syntactic correctness consistently high, all without fine-tuning.

2601.15197.tldr: LangForce is a novel framework that enforces instruction following via Bayesian decomposition and significantly improves generalization in Vision-Language-Action models, including an 11.3% improvement on the challenging OOD SimplerEnv benchmark.

2601.16286.tldr: SemanticALLI is introduced, a pipeline-aware architecture within Alli (PMG's marketing intelligence platform), designed to operationalize redundant reasoning, and decomposing generation into Analytic Intent Resolution (AIR) and Visualization Synthesis (VS), which elevates structured intermediate representations (IRs) to first-class, cacheable artifacts.

2601.16327.tldr: Experiments conducted on two- and three-host configurations demonstrate consistent coordination, conflict-free parking behavior, and scalable performance across distributed Autoware instances, confirming that the proposed DMV-AVP supports cooperative AVP simulation and establishes a foundation for future real-world and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

2601.16336.tldr: The Distributed Multi-Autonomous Vehicle Architecture (DMAVA), a simulation architecture that enables concurrent execution of multiple independent vehicle autonomy stacks distributed across multiple physical hosts within a shared simulation environment, is presented.

2601.16725.tldr: This work introduces LongCat-Flash-Thinking-2601, a 560-billion-parameter open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning model with superior agentic reasoning capability, and introduces a Heavy Thinking mode that enables effective test-time scaling by jointly expanding reasoning depth and width through intensive parallel thinking.

2601.16874.tldr: A model-centric diagnostic framework that treats training state as a latent variable and unifies a family of internal readouts -- head-gradient norms, confidence, entropy, margin, and related signals -- as anchor-relative projections of that state is presented.

2601.19094.tldr: This work argues that dynamic programming (DP), which solves problems by iteratively refining a global state, offers a more powerful and suitable learning paradigm, and introduces FloydNet, a new architecture that embodies this principle.

2601.19199.tldr: MAGNET is introduced, a memory-driven adaptive agent framework with dual-level memory: stationary memory linking diverse visual features to stable functional semantics for robust action grounding and procedural memory capturing stable task intents across varying workflows for robust action grounding and generalization in evolving software environments.

2601.20245.tldr: It is found that AI use impairs conceptual understanding, code reading, and debugging abilities, without delivering significant efficiency gains on average, which suggests that AI-enhanced productivity is not a shortcut to competence and AI assistance should be carefully adopted into workflows to preserve skill formation.

2601.21260.tldr: This work defined how Music Plagiarism Detection is different from other MIR tasks and explained what problems need to be solved and proposed a method based on segment transcription as one way to solve the task.

2601.21448.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark for AI-aided chip design that rigorously evaluates LLMs across three critical tasks: Verilog generation, debugging, and reference model generation, and provides an automated toolbox for high-quality training data generation to help enhance LLM reference model generation.

2601.21526.tldr: KAPSO iteratively performs ideation, code synthesis and editing, execution, evaluation, and learning to improve a runnable artifact toward measurable objectives to target long-horizon failures common in coding agents.

2601.21571.tldr: It is shown that filtering tokens is more effective than filtering documents, achieving the same hit to undesired capabilities at a lower cost to benign ones and can be robust to noisy labels with sufficient pretraining compute.

2601.21754.tldr: This work proposes SCOUT (Sub-Scale Collaboration On Unseen Tasks), a novel framework that decouples exploration from exploitation and employs lightweight"scouts"(e.g., small MLPs) to probe environmental dynamics at a speed and scale far exceeding LLMs.

2601.21844.tldr: A decision-centric simulation software framework that enables systematic evaluation of forecasting models in realistic inventory management setting, and links demand forecasting and inventory management, shifting evaluation from predictive accuracy toward operational relevance in the automotive aftermarket and related domains.

2601.21900.tldr: By selectively suppressing these causal chains, TraceRouter physically severs the flow of harmful information while leaving orthogonal computation routes intact, achieving a superior trade-off between adversarial robustness and general utility.

2602.00002.tldr: This work proposes Disentangled Click-Through Rate Prediction (DiseCTR), which introduces a causal perspective of recommendation and disentangles multiple aspects of user interests to alleviate the OOD issue in recommendation.

2602.00007.tldr: This work proposes PPoGA (Predictive Plan-on-Graph with Action), a novel KGQA framework inspired by human cognitive control and problem-solving that achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing methods.

2602.00009.tldr: It is demonstrated that hybrid graph-grounding significantly advances clinical information retrieval, offering a safer, more comprehensive alternative to standard LLM deployments and demonstrating that hybrid graph-grounding significantly advances clinical information retrieval.

2602.00010.tldr: This research highlights the potential of heuristic-based methods for real-world, resource-constrained RAG use cases and introduces ChunkNorris, a novel heuristic-based technique designed to optimise the parsing and chunking of PDF documents.

2602.00011.tldr: A Large Language Model-based chained prompt engineering framework for the automated development of search strategies in systematic reviews confirms the capacity of LLM-based pipelines to yield transparent, reproducible, and high-performing search strategies, and highlights their potential as scalable instruments for supporting evidence synthesis and evidence-based practice.

2602.00014.tldr: This review assesses how artificial intelligence (AI), including machine learning and optimization, improves the efficiency of operational HPC systems and highlights integration opportunities such as LLM-based operating-system concepts and underscore the need for advances in MLOps, standardization of AI components, and benchmarking methodology.

2602.00015.tldr: G-MemLLM is proposed, a memory-augmented architecture that integrates a frozen LLM backbone with a trainable latent memory Bank that allows the model to selectively update, preserve, or overwrite latent memory slots, preventing the vanishing gradients of knowledge common in recurrent systems.

2602.00016.tldr: This work introduces PTCBENCH, a systematic benchmark designed to quantify the consistency of LLM personalities under controlled situational contexts, and establishes an extensible framework for evaluating personality consistency in realistic, evolving environments.

2602.00017.tldr: This work introduces SafeTalkCoach, a diversity-driven multi-agent dialogue generation framework that simulates parent-child conversations about sexual health, and presents an accompanying dataset to support both AI research and health communications practices.

2602.00019.tldr: By replacing rigid, script-based workflows with a protocol-driven, LLM-coordinated architecture, the framework improves reproducibility, reduces manual overhead, and ensures extensibility, portability, and auditability across the entire drug design process.

2602.00026.tldr: This work shows how explicitly controlling AI behavior during exams prevents AI from becoming a shortcut to certainty, and introduces MindMosaicAIExam, an exam system that integrates controllable AI tools and requires students to provide initial answers, critically evaluate AI outputs, and iteratively refine their reasoning.

2602.00027.tldr: This paper develops a comprehensive operational model for HMES that fully captures the nonlinear dynamics and multi-physics process of HESS and proposes an enhanced deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework by integrating the emerging representation learning techniques, enabling substantially accelerated and improved policy optimization for spatially and temporally coupled complex networked systems.

2602.00029.tldr: This work first builds a dual-layer enterprise ontology from structured databases and unstructured text, subsequently fusing these sources into a comprehensive enterprise ontology, and proposes a unified three-stage training pipeline to enable instruction-aligned reasoning.

2602.00034.tldr: This work investigates whether Item Response Theory (IRT) difficulty parameters can be accurately estimated without student testing by modeling the response process and explores the relative contribution of different feature types to prediction accuracy.

2602.00037.tldr: The proposed CFA method greatly improves upon individual model performance, as well as out-performs other Bitcoin price prediction models.

2602.00038.tldr: LSSF is introduced, a novel safety re-alignment framework with low-rank characteristics of safety information in LLMs that can effectively restore the safety alignment of fine-tuned models with minimal impact on their performance in downstream tasks.

2602.00040.tldr: This work proposes LTSM-DIFF (Large-scale Temporal Sequential Memory with Diffusion), a novel learning framework that integrates the expressive power of large language models with the generative capability of diffusion models, establishing a new paradigm for time series analysis under data scarcity.

2602.00042.tldr: This paper proposes the JSR-Guided Fusion Network (JSR-GFNet), a multi-modal architecture that learns a physically intuitive strategy: prioritizing spectral energy integration in noise-limited regimes while shifting focus to phase precision in high-SNR scenarios to resolve modulation ambiguities.

2602.00047.tldr: This work proposes a data-centric optimization framework that leverages dataset pruning to achieve resource-efficient edge learning and validate dataset pruning as a vital, complementary paradigm for enhancing the sustainability and scalability of learning on resource-constrained mobile edge devices.

2602.00048.tldr: This study aims to provide an overview of the contributions made to bridge quantum computing and machine learning, offering insights and guidance to support its future development and pave the way for broader adoption in the coming years.

2602.00052.tldr: In simulated extraction workflows, AI-assisted tasks are completed 40% faster, are rated as less cognitively demanding and are strongly preferred by users, suggesting that AI-assisted extraction can enable protocol intelligence at scale.

2602.00053.tldr: A rigorous benchmarking analysis comparing two prominent deployment paradigms is presented: a lightweight, Python-based REST service using FastAPI, and a specialized, high-performance serving engine, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server, which validates the hybrid model as a best practice for enterprise clinical AI and offers a blueprint for secure, high-availability deployments.

2602.00057.tldr: HoloBrain and HoloGraph are introduced, a brain-inspired framework that models oscillatory synchronization to overcome limitations of graph neural networks and enable more efficient, robust learning.

2602.00059.tldr: TextBFGS is introduced, a Case-Based Reasoning (CBR) framework inspired by the Quasi-Newton optimization method that achieves superior pass rates with fewer model calls, establishing an efficient, experience-driven paradigm for LLM-based code optimization.

2602.00060.tldr: GEOFRAIL, a longitudinal geospatial multimodal dataset collected from community-dwelling frail older adults following hospital discharge, demonstrates internal consistency across geospatial, sensor-derived, and clinical measures and reports baseline performance of machine learning models for characterizing recovery trajectories.

2602.00061.tldr: Across five model families, this approach consistently outperforms principle-based, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and other baselines across benchmarks, establishing role assignment as a powerful, interpretable paradigm for AI alignment and LLM-as-a-Judge construction.

2602.00063.tldr: It is found that even small reductions in model accuracy can lead to large variations in the generated counterfactuals on average and on individual instances, underscore the need for uncertainty-aware explanation methods in domains such as finance and the social sciences.

2602.00065.tldr: This paper proposes a taxonomy of AI mental health support types -- assessment-, intervention-, and information synthesis-oriented -- each with distinct risks and evaluative requirements, and illustrates its use through case studies.

2602.00067.tldr: NSG (Node Splitting Graph)-MoE, a multimodal graph learning framework that integrates a node-splitting and graph-rewiring mechanism with a structured Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture, is proposed, which explicitly decomposes each node into modality-specific components and assigns relation-aware experts to process heterogeneous message flows.

2602.00074.tldr: ChatEHR is developed, a system that enables the use of LLMs with the entire patient timeline spanning several years and provides an opportunity for health systems to maintain agency via a vendor-agnostic, internally governed LLM platform.

2602.00078.tldr: The paper argues that AI systems are typically components within larger sociotechnical systems, requiring a layered approach where horizontal standards define process obligations and evidence structures while sectoral profiles specify domain-specific thresholds and acceptance criteria.

2602.00082.tldr: The results indicate that the multi-agent framework can effectively enhance the risk-adjusted return of REITs trading, and the fine-tuned small model performs close to or even better than the general-purpose large model in some scenarios.

2602.00083.tldr: This work proposes SPARC-RAG, a multi-agent framework that coordinates sequential and parallel inference-time scaling under a unified context management mechanism, and introduces a lightweight fine-tuning method with process-level verifiable preferences that improves the efficiency of sequential scaling and effectiveness of parallel scaling.

2602.00085.tldr: CARE-RFT (Confidence-Anchored Regularized Reinforcement Finetuning), a novel method that replaces standard reverse KL regularization with a skew reverse KL divergence, establishes that careful, confidence-aware regularization is key to building both capable and trustworthy reasoning models.

2602.00087.tldr: This paper introduces ECCO, a framework that bridges interpretable reasoning with combinatorial search, and proposes a collaborative inference mechanism where the LLM functions as a strategist, defining optimization intents that dynamically guide the mutation operations of a genetic algorithm.

2602.00088.tldr: The Symbolic Transition Mechanism (STM) is proposed a novel framework that bridges numeric time series data and language models through symbolic abstraction and prompt engineering, enabling fast engineering based predictions in which language models focus on critical parts of time series data.

2602.00091.tldr: It is discussed how SMEs can navigate both the promises and challenges of GAI and a sailing metaphor is introduced that reveals key strategic dimensions for GAI deployment: competency of employees, effective leadership and work values, organizational culture, collaboration and cooperation, and relationships with third parties.

2602.00095.tldr: A case study demonstrating that leveraging identified error patterns to preemptively detect and rectify recognition errors, with only minimal human intervention, can significantly enhance the robustness of the deployed AI-enabled grading system on unseen student solutions.

2602.00096.tldr: Simulate Anything is presented, a graphics-driven world modeling and simulation framework that enables efficient generation of high-fidelity embodied training data using only multi-view environment videos and off-the-shelf assets and provides a unified, editable, and physically grounded world model.

2602.00100.tldr: A mechanism for finding the frequency of a sequence which will yield significant reduction in the code table size is proposed, and is tested by compressing benchmark datasets yielding an improvement of 45% in compression ratios, often outperforming the existing alternatives.

2602.00102.tldr: The survey identifies open challenges in standardization, domain shift, and clinical deployment, and outlines future directions such as hybrid radiomics-artificial intelligence models, multimodal fusion, federated learning, and standardized benchmarking.

2602.00103.tldr: An integrated multiagent AI ecosystem for polymer discovery that unifies high-throughput materials workflows, artificial intelligence, and computational modeling within a single Polymer Research Lifecycle (PRL) pipeline is presented and metacognitive control in a polystyrene case study is demonstrated.

2602.00104.tldr: R3G, a modular Reasoning-Retrieval-Reranking framework, first produces a brief reasoning plan that specifies the required visual cues, then adopts a two-stage strategy, with coarse retrieval followed by fine-grained reranking, to select evidence images.

2602.00105.tldr: HYPE-EDIT-1 is introduced, a 100-task benchmark of reference-based marketing/design edits with binary pass/fail judging that combines model price with human review time and releases 50 public tasks and maintains a 50-task held-out private split for server-side evaluation.

2602.00108.tldr: Experiments show that the SITUATE dataset helps to improve generalization for out-of-distribution images, since a finetune of Qwen VL 2.5 7B on SITUATE improves accuracy on the Pixmo count test data, but not vice versa.

2602.00117.tldr: This study proposes a conversational, code-generating agent that transforms natural-language queries into executable, auditable Python workflows and outputs verifiable code, which turns EO analysis into a transparent, reproducible process.

2602.00122.tldr: A rigorously human-annotated and evaluated benchmark specifically designed to assess image editing models on multilingual and complex visual document editing tasks, and introduces a decoupled evaluation framework that systematically quantifies editing performance at the OCR parsing level, enabling fine-grained assessment of text modification accuracy.

2602.00125.tldr: The design of MiniTensor's architecture is described, including its efficient memory management, dynamic computation graph for gradients, and integration with Python via PyO3.

2602.00133.tldr: PredictionMarketBench is introduced, a SWE-bench-style benchmark for evaluating algorithmic and LLM-based trading agents on prediction markets via deterministic, event-driven replay of historical limit-order-book and trade data.

2602.00144.tldr: Low-Rank Factorized RGDA (LR-RGDA), a scalable classifier that combines RGDA's expressivity with the efficiency of linear classifiers is proposed, providing a scalable solution for large-scale class-incremental learning with ViTs.

2602.00150.tldr: Reversible Diffusion Decoding (RDD), a decoding framework that introduces reversibility into block-wise diffusion generation, allows decoding to recover from early commitment errors while maintaining the parallel efficiency of diffusion-based generation.

2602.00152.tldr: Results demonstrate that HPPI-Net achieves a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off and provides explainable predictions, establishing a practical solution for wearable, industrial, and smart home HAR on memory-constrained edge platforms.

2602.00153.tldr: A lightweight compressed-domain tracking model that operates directly on video streams, without requiring full RGB video decoding, is proposed, achieving a computational speed-up of order up to 3.7 with only a slight 4% mAP@0.5 drop vs RGB baseline on MOTS15/17/20 datasets.

2602.00154.tldr: ReasoningBomb is presented, a reinforcement-learning-based PI-DoS framework that is guided by a constant-time surrogate reward and trains a large reasoning-model attacker to generate short natural prompts that drive victim LRMs into pathologically long and often effectively non-terminating reasoning.

2602.00159.tldr: The theory and mathematical modelling behind the sheaf neural network (SNN) algorithm is elucidated and it is shown how SNN can effectively answer to biomedical questions in a concrete case study and outperform the most popular graph neural networks as graph convolutional networks (GCNs), graph attention networks (GAT) and GraphSage.

2602.00161.tldr: This paper forms block removal as a constrained binary optimization problem that can be mapped to a physical system (Ising model), whose energies are a strong proxy for downstream model performance and enables an efficient ranking of a large number of candidate block-removal configurations.

2602.00164.tldr: The results indicate that test case failures and prior resolution of the same issues by other PRs are the most common causes of non integration, whereas build or deployment failures are comparatively rare.

2602.00170.tldr: The results reconcile ES scalability with non-monotonic training dynamics and suggest that high-dimensional fine-tuning may admit a broader class of viable optimization methods than worst-case theory implies.

2602.00173.tldr: GASP (Guided Adversarial Self-Play), a robustification method that explicitly trains detect-and-repair capabilities using only outcome verification, is introduced, and analysis shows that adversarial corruptions induce an effective curriculum.

2602.00175.tldr: This paper proposes IVO (Initial Latent Variable Optimization), a concise and powerful attack framework that reactivates dormant memories by reconstructing the broken mappings in initial latent variables to realign the noise distribution of unlearned models with their original unsafe states.

2602.00176.tldr: A noise--frequency Continuation framework is proposed that constructs a continuous family of intermediate posteriors whose likelihood enforces measurement consistency only within a noise-dependent frequency band and is instantiated with a stabilized posterior sampler that combines a diffusion predictor, band-limited likelihood guidance, and a multi-resolution consistency strategy.

2602.00180.tldr: This paper provides practitioners with a comprehensive guide to specification rigor-spec-first, spec-anchored, and spec-as-source-with clear guidance on when each applies, and concludes with a decision framework helping practitioners determine when SDD provides value and when simpler approaches suffice.

2602.00182.tldr: It is shown how this architecture yields sovereign agents -- prediction-market judges, trading bots, and scientific assistants -- that enjoy state-of-the-art performance while inheriting security from Ethereum's validator base.

2602.00184.tldr: A Visible Singularities Guided Correlation network for LACT reconstruction (VSGC), inspired by the theory of visible and invisible singularities, which delivers more prominent performance in small angular ranges, with the PSNR improvement of 2.45 dB and the SSIM enhancement of 1.5\%.

2602.00185.tldr: This work introduces QUASAR, a universal autonomous system for atomistic simulation designed to facilitate production-grade scientific discovery and provides initial evidence supporting the potential deployment of agentic AI as a component of computational chemistry research workflows, while identifying areas requiring further development.

2602.00188.tldr: This work proposes ADEPT (Additive DEcomposition for Pricing with cross-elasticity and Time-adaptive learning)-a projection-free, gradient-free online learning algorithm that operates directly in attribute space and achieves a sublinear regret of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{d}T^{3/4})$.

2602.00189.tldr: A generic method, LPIPS-AttnWav2Lip, for reconstructing face images of any speaker based on audio, using the U-Net architecture based on residual CBAM to better encode and fuse audio and visual modal information.

2602.00190.tldr: This work investigates Causal Induction: the ability to infer governing laws from observational data, by tasking Large Language Models with reverse-engineering Video Game Description Language (VGDL) rules from gameplay traces, and shows that the SCM-based approach more often produces VGDL descriptions closer to the ground truth than direct generation.

2602.00192.tldr: This work introduces Inpainting Exchange (INP-X), an operation that restores original pixels outside the edited region while preserving all synthesized content, and provides a theoretical analysis linking this behavior to high-frequency attenuation caused by VAE information bottlenecks.

2602.00198.tldr: This work introduces a novel framework that enables end-to-end training with real, non-differentiable codecs by leveraging data-driven surrogate gradients derived from actual compression errors, which facilitates the alignment between training objectives and deployment performance.

2602.00202.tldr: A novel SemiEarth model that introduces vision-language models (VLMs) to address the S4 issues for the remote sensing (RS) domain is proposed, and a VLM pseudo-label purifying (VLM-PP) structure is invented to purify the teacher network's pseudo-labels, achieving substantial improvements.

2602.00204.tldr: A novel anomaly detection approach that leverages semantic embeddings generated by Large Language Models (LLMs) that outperforms widely used unsupervised baseline methods, including Isolation Forest, One-Class Support Vector Machine, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

2602.00208.tldr: By explicitly targeting explanation diversity while maintaining model quality, this work is able to construct ensembles that are more diverse, more complementary, and ultimately more effective for unsupervised anomaly detection.

2602.00211.tldr: This work proposes a novel Multi-Hop Visual Chain of Reasoning (VCoR) framework that reformulates registration as a progressive reasoning process that achieves competitive registration accuracy while offering rich intermediate visualizations and confidence measures.

2602.00213.tldr: TessPay is a unified infrastructure that replaces implicit trust with a'Verify-then-Pay'architecture separating control and verification from settlement, and preserves a tamper-evident audit trail to enable clear accountability for dispute resolution.

2602.00214.tldr: This work proposes a geometric multimodal Foundation Model (FM), named MFM-Geom, that learns representations from bp-MRI and clinical reports, encoding visual findings and information from the context of clinical variables.

2602.00219.tldr: A semantics-driven federated IDS framework that incorporates language-derived semantic supervision into federated optimization, enabling open-set and zero-shot intrusion detection for previously unseen attack behaviors and achieves over 80% zero-shot detection accuracy on unseen attack patterns.

2602.00238.tldr: Diverge is proposed, a plug-and-play agentic RAG framework with novel reflection-guided generation and memory-augmented iterative refinement, which promotes diverse viewpoints while preserving answer quality, and achieves the best diversity-quality trade-off in open-ended questions.

2602.00249.tldr: Through extensive experiments on six state-of-the-art T2I models, it is demonstrated that SANEval's automated evaluations provide a more faithful proxy for human assessment; the metric achieves a Spearman's rank correlation with statistically different results than those of existing benchmarks across tasks of attribute binding, spatial relations, and numeracy.

2602.00259.tldr: The roles of eight types of reasoning cues in a high-stakes clinical decision (treating patients with sepsis in intensive care) are explored and it is found that reasoning cues have distinct patterns of influence that can directly inform design.

2602.00262.tldr: A contrastive self-supervised framework designed for clustering incomplete data, Contrastive Subspace Clustering (CSC), which consistently outperforms both classical and deep learning baselines, demonstrating strong robustness to missing data and scalability to large datasets.

2602.00266.tldr: Using Chang's completeness theorem, it is shown that for every functional equivalence class, all ReLU networks in that class are connected by a finite set of symmetries corresponding to the finite set of axioms of Lukasiewicz logic.

2602.00267.tldr: Extensive quantitative evaluations and user studies demonstrate that PLACID surpasses state-of-the-art methods in multi-object compositing, achieving superior identity, background, and color preservation, with less omitted objects and visually appealing results.

2602.00268.tldr: This work proposes a simple, inference-time method that mitigates temporal drift by identifying and removing unstable latent tokens before they are reused for conditioning, and significantly improves long-horizon temporal consistency.

2602.00269.tldr: VoxServe introduces a model-execution abstraction that decouples model architecture from system-level optimizations, thereby enabling support for diverse SpeechLM architectures within a single framework and implements streaming-aware scheduling and an asynchronous inference pipeline to improve end-to-end efficiency.

2602.00276.tldr: This work proposes iteratively augmenting instructions with Localized In-Context Learning with targeted corrections for specific failing steps, which is much effective than explicit instructions or traditional ICL, which adds complete problem-solving trajectories, and many other baselines.

2602.00277.tldr: Fault Tolerant Hybrid-Shared Data Parallelism (FT-HSDP) can reduce the stall time due to failure recovery from 10 minutes to 3 minutes, increasing effective training time from 44\% to 80\%.

2602.00282.tldr: This work analyses the sample complexity of a constrained bilevel RL algorithm with a non-smooth objective function using the Moreau envelope and is the first ones to analyse the generally parameterized policy gradient-based RL algorithm with a non-smooth objective function using the Moreau envelope.

2602.00292.tldr: LogicGaze is introduced, a novel benchmark framework designed to rigorously interrogate whether VLMs can validate sequential causal chains against visual inputs, specifically targeting the pervasive issue of hallucination.

2602.00294.tldr: This work shows that self-attention is efficiently computable to arbitrary precision with constant cost per token, achieving orders-of-magnitude reductions in memory use and computation.

2602.00295.tldr: This work introduces a new Multi-speaker Conversational Audio Deepfakes Dataset (MsCADD), a foundation for future research on deepfake detection in conversational scenarios, which is a highly underexplored area of research but also a major area of threat to trustworthy information in audio settings.

2602.00298.tldr: This work is the first to provide a taxonomic ranking of emergent misalignment by domain, which has implications for AI security and post-training, and standardizes a recipe for constructing misaligned datasets.

2602.00305.tldr: These results show that even high-performing detectors are vulnerable to low-cost, semantics-preserving evasion, and introduce a metric of joint robustness across different attack methods/carriers.

2602.00309.tldr: The proposed SAM2CT is the first promptable segmentation model designed to convert radiologist annotations into 3D segmentations in CT volumes and demonstrates strong zero-shot performance on select Emergency Department findings, suggesting that large-scale mining of historical GSPS annotations represents a promising and scalable approach for generating 3D CT segmentation datasets.

2602.00318.tldr: BOCLOAK is introduced to systematically evaluate the robustness of GNN-based social bot detection via both edge editing and node injection adversarial attacks under realistic constraints and shows that optimal transport provides a lightweight, principled framework for bridging the gap between adversarial attacks and real-world bot detection.

2602.00319.tldr: This study examines the temporal emergence of AI-generated content in peer reviews by applying a detection model trained on historical reviews to later review cycles at International Conference on Learning Representations and Nature Communications to provide suggestive evidence of a rapidly increasing presence of AI-assisted content.

2602.00327.tldr: The results prove the feasibility of next-utterance prediction with LLMs from multimodal cues and emphasize the (i) indispensable role of multimodal cues and (ii) actively predictive processing as the foundation of natural human interaction, which is missing in current MLLMs.

2602.00340.tldr: A pioneering Synergistic Neural Agents Network (SynerNet) framework designed to mitigate the phenomenon of cross-modal alignment degeneration in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) when encountering Out-of-Distribution (OOD) concepts.

2602.00343.tldr: The results support a standardized carbon accounting method that acts as a prerequisite for reproducible'green'FL evaluation and validate the proposed approach on two representative workloads: CIFAR-10 image classification and retinal optic disk segmentation.

2602.00344.tldr: MAD-RAG is proposed, a training-free intervention that decouples visual grounding from context integration through a dual-question formulation, combined with attention mixing to preserve image-conditioned evidence.

2602.00347.tldr: This work presents AdaFuse, an adaptive multimodal fusion framework that leverages reinforcement learning (RL) to learn patient-specific modality selection and fusion strategies for lung cancer risk prediction, and demonstrates the potential of reinforcement learning for personalized multimodal fusion in medical imaging.

2602.00353.tldr: The results reveal that conventional benchmarks are insufficient for safety-critical mental health settings, and MHDash is presented, an open-source platform designed to support the development, evaluation, and auditing of AI systems for mental health applications.

2602.00359.tldr: The position is that agentic evolution represents the inevitable future of LLM adaptation, elevating evolution itself from a fixed pipeline to an autonomous evolver agent, and a new scaling axis-evolution is proposed, which treats deployment-time improvement as a deliberate, goal-directed optimization process over persistent system state.

2602.00370.tldr: A guided generation framework is proposed that introduces interpretable semantic axes, such as Demographics, Laboratory Parameters, and Behavioral Factors, to steer EC generation to offer a middle ground between specificity and usability, enabling clinicians to guide generation without specifying exact entities.

2602.00372.tldr: This work introduces Sparse Knowledge Distillation (SparseKD), a post-training method that compresses transformer models by combining structured SVD pruning with self-referential knowledge distillation, enabling surprisingly strong quality recovery after aggressive pruning.

2602.00397.tldr: FastForward is introduced, a predictive sparsity framework that accelerates LLM prefill through block-wise, context-aware FFN sparsity, substantially reducing Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) for efficient, long-context LLM inference on constrained hardware.

2602.00400.tldr: KEPO is proposed, a unified post-training framework that integrates a quality-gated on-policy distillation objective that selectively applies dense teacher guidance only to high-quality trajectories, and a knowledge-enhanced exploration strategy that leverages hints learned from a teacher model to rejectively sample reward-positive on-policy trajectories for RL, thereby mitigating exploration collapse.

2602.00401.tldr: ZEST (Zero-shot Embodied Skill Transfer), a streamlined motion-imitation framework that trains policies via reinforcement learning from diverse sources -- high-fidelity motion capture, noisy monocular video, and non-physics-constrained animation -- and deploys them to hardware zero-shot, is introduced.

2602.00405.tldr: This work proposes robustDebias, a novel mechanism which adapts Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) to debias language models during fine-tuning, focusing on BERT models due to their widespread use in language understanding tasks.

2602.00412.tldr: A pipeline that transforms categorical data into numerical data so that an AutoML can handle categorical data transformed by more advanced encoding schemes, and benchmark the current robustness of AutoML methods on a set of dirty datasets and compare it with the proposed pipeline.

2602.00415.tldr: PolarMem is introduced, a training-free Polarized Latent Graph Memory designed to ground agent reasoning in verifiable evidence, and transforms fuzzy perceptual likelihoods into discrete logical constraints through non-parametric distributional partitioning.

2602.00420.tldr: This work introduces Text-DJ, a novel jailbreak attack that bypasses LVLMs' OCR capabilities that are not robust to dispersed, multi-image adversarial inputs, highlighting the need for defenses for fragmented multimodal inputs.

2602.00426.tldr: This review article forms LLMs as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models with attention-based dependencies, enabling principled analysis of alignment-induced behaviors, inference-time phenomena, and extensions like continual learning, while serving as a concise reference for interpretation and further theoretical development.

2602.00428.tldr: A comprehensive study on the Mandela effect in LLM-based multi-agent systems, focusing on its existence, causing factors, and mitigation strategies, and proposes strategies to mitigate this effect.

2602.00449.tldr: Overall, this work delineates when CODI-style latent-CoT yields faithful iterative computation versus compressed or shortcut strategies, and highlights challenges in designing robust latent-CoT objectives for sequential reasoning.

2602.00454.tldr: DebateOCR is introduced, a cross-modal compression framework that replaces long textual debate traces with compact image representations, which are then consumed through a dedicated vision encoder to condition subsequent rounds.

2602.00456.tldr: UnderWRITE is presented, an expert-first, multi-turn insurance underwriting benchmark designed in close collaboration with domain experts to capture real-world enterprise challenges and provides insights for developing benchmarks that better align with enterprise deployment requirements.

2602.00458.tldr: LatentTrack (LT), a sequential neural architecture for online probabilistic prediction under nonstationary dynamics, achieves lower negative log-likelihood and mean squared error than stateful sequential and static uncertainty-aware baselines, with competitive calibration, demonstrating that latent-conditioned function evolution is an effective alternative to traditional latent-state modeling under distribution shift.

2602.00465.tldr: PAIR-Former (Pool-Aware Instance-Relational Transformer), a BR-MIL pipeline that performs a cheap full-pool scan, selects up to $K$ diverse CTSs on CPU, and applies a permutation-invariant Set Transformer aggregator on the selected tokens.

2602.00469.tldr: A learned projection model that predicts Lancaster sensorimotor norms from word lexical embeddings is presented, suggesting a path towards computationally proposing candidate phonosthemes from text data.

2602.00471.tldr: This work proposes L2-VMAS, a novel model-agnostic framework that enables inter-agent collaboration with dual latent memories that decouple the perception and thinking while dynamically synthesizing dual latent memories and introduces an entropy-driven proactive triggering that replaces passive information transmission with efficient, on-demand memory access.

2602.00473.tldr: This model uses an attention mechanism, realized through swap tests and a parameterized quantum circuit, to extract correlations within quantum states and perform ground-state classification, offering a scalable and data-efficient approach for quantum phase recognition in complex many-body systems.

2602.00478.tldr: This work introduces a novel reformulation of the Quality-Diversity optimization as a multi-objective optimization (MOO) problem with a huge number of optimization objectives to enable the direct adoption of well-established MOO methods to solve QD problems through a collaborative search process.

2602.00485.tldr: This work proposes MoR, a federated alignment framework based on GRPO with Mixture-of-Rewards for heterogeneous VLMs, and provides a scalable solution for privacy-preserving alignment of heterogeneous VLMs under federated settings.

2602.00497.tldr: This paper synthesizes existing evidence on multilingual model behavior, data asymmetries, and sociotechnical harm, and articulates a culturally grounded governance framework for MLLMs and argues that culturally grounded governance is essential for ensuring that multilingual language models do not reproduce existing global inequalities under the guise of scale and neutrality.

2602.00505.tldr: SarseCut is proposed, a general cross-modal fusion architecture for MLLMs, introducing sparse shortcut connections between the cross-modal encoder and the LLM, which enable the efficient and hierarchical integration of visual features at multiple levels, facilitating richer semantic fusion without increasing computational overhead.

2602.00510.tldr: PCBSchemaGen is introduced, the first training-free framework for PCB schematic design that comprises LLM agent and Constraint-guided synthesis and demonstrates that PCBSchemaGen significantly improves design accuracy and computational efficiency.

2602.00515.tldr: This paper offers a comprehensive review of contrastive learning-based privacy-preserving techniques specifically for privacy preservation in Industrial Internet of Things systems and emphasizes the unique characteristics of industrial data, system architectures, and various application scenarios.

2602.00526.tldr: A waveform-conditional generative framework that preserves fine-grained respiratory dynamics while constraining the EEG target space through discrete tokenization is proposed, highlighting the feasibility of remote, non-contact neurological assessment during sleep.

2602.00528.tldr: This paper proposes ToolPoker, a tool-integrated reasoning framework that combines external solvers for GTO-consistent actions with more precise professional-style explanations and achieves state-of-the-art gameplay while producing reasoning traces that closely reflect game-theoretic principles.

2602.00533.tldr: This work develops a framework clearly separating the underlying world, the data generation process and the resulting model representations to study adaptation, and shows that training on multiple relational tasks reliably produces convergent world representations, but lurking divergent tasks can catastrophically harm new entity integration via fine-tuning.

2602.00547.tldr: This work proposes a cross-modal alignment framework that directly maps mass spectra into the chemically meaningful molecular structure embedding space of a pretrained chemical language model and demonstrates strong generalization under a global retrieval setting.

2602.00559.tldr: OmniVCHall is introduced, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate both isolated and compositional hallucinations in video multimodal large language models (VLLMs), and TriCD, a contrastive decoding framework with a triple-pathway calibration mechanism is proposed.

2602.00561.tldr: The Adaptive Flow Routing Network (AFR-Net) is proposed, a physics-informed framework that models how structural constraints give rise to functional communication patterns (FC), enabling interpretable discovery of critical neural pathways.

2602.00576.tldr: It is shown, for the first time, that SAM induces a lower simplicity bias (SB) and is demonstrated that altering the training data distribution by upsampling or augmenting examples learned later in training similarly reduces SB and leads to improved generalization.

2602.00580.tldr: TSP-MDF, a novel instance modification framework that equips traditional deterministic heuristic tour constructors with guided-sampling capability, and introduces a neural-based instance modifier that strategically shifts node coordinates to sample multiple modified instances, allowing traditional tour constructors to explore higher-quality tours and escape local optima.

2602.00583.tldr: A diffusion-based multi-modal framework that jointly generates a large collection of photorealistic facial expressions and anatomically consistent AU labels, including both occurrence and intensity, conditioned on a single descriptive text prompt.

2602.00585.tldr: This work investigates how to consolidate heterogeneous information-seeking agents into a single foundation agentic model with two complementary consolidation strategies: data-level consolidation, which jointly trains a unified model on a mixture of domain-specific datasets, and parameter-level consolidation, which merges independently trained agent models at the parameter level.

2602.00586.tldr: Results establish that topology-only and retrieval-augmented approaches serve complementary purposes: structural prediction tasks are solved by network topology alone, while functional interpretation uniquely benefits from retrieved knowledge.

2602.00590.tldr: An interpretable multimodal machine learning framework that unifies heterogeneous analytical systems for end-to-end characterization on carbon nanotube (CNT) films whose properties are highly sensitive to microstructural variations is proposed.

2602.00592.tldr: DockSmith treats environment construction not only as a preprocessing step, but as a core agentic capability that exercises long-horizon tool use, dependency reasoning, and failure recovery, yielding supervision that transfers beyond Docker building itself.

2602.00597.tldr: Her Hermes, an LLM-based automated subtitling framework that achieves state-of-the-art diarization performance and generates expressive, contextually coherent translations, thereby advancing research in interlingual subtitling.

2602.00608.tldr: This work demonstrates that resolving the ``Memory Wall''via architectural co-design is not merely an optimization, but a prerequisite for enabling high-fidelity, responsive neural gameplay.

2602.00616.tldr: This work proposes an inference-only prompt projection framework that selectively intervenes on high-risk prompts via a surrogate objective with verification, mapping them into a tolerance-controlled safe set while leaving benign prompts effectively unchanged, without retraining or fine-tuning the generator.

2602.00619.tldr: This work casts Weak-to-Strong Jailbreaking as a forecast aggregation problem and derive an optimal aggregation strategy characterized by a Gradient Shift in the loss-induced dual space, and proposes a new hybrid aggregation rule.

2602.00620.tldr: TIC-FM is proposed, an in-context learning framework that treats the labeled training set as context and predicts labels for all test instances in a single forward pass, without parameter updates, providing theoretical justification that in-context inference can subsume trained classifiers and can emulate gradient-based classifier training within a single forward pass.

2602.00624.tldr: This work proposes MoDEx, a lightweight Mixture of Depth-specific Experts, which replaces complex backbones with depth-specific MLP experts, which achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on seven real-world benchmarks, ranking first in 78 percent of cases, while using significantly fewer parameters and computational resources.

2602.00629.tldr: This work introduces a simple yet novel state discretisation transformation and proposes Offline State-Only DecQN (Algo), a value-based algorithm designed to pre-train state policies from action-free data that integrates the transformation to scale efficiently to high-dimensional problems while avoiding instability and overfitting associated with continuous state prediction.

2602.00635.tldr: S$^3$POT is a contrast-driven framework synergizing face generation with self-supervised spatial prompting, to achieve occlusion segmentation, inspired by the insights of modern face generators' ability to realistically reconstruct occluded regions, creating an image that preserve facial geometry while eliminating occlusion.

2602.00665.tldr: This study investigates instruction-tuned low-parameterized SLMs for context-summarized multi-turn customer-service QA, using a history summarization strategy to preserve essential conversational state and introduces a conversation stage-based qualitative analysis to evaluate model behavior across different phases of customer-service interactions.

2602.00669.tldr: A computationally efficient super-resolution step is introduced that imputes slices to generate anatomically consistent isotropic volumes from anisotropic 3D reconstructions of dissection photographs, which strengthens the bridge between neuropathology and neuroimaging.

2602.00676.tldr: OpenGuanDan is proposed, a novel benchmark that enables both efficient simulation of GuanDan (a popular four-player, multi-round Chinese card game) and comprehensive evaluation of both learning-based and rule-based GuanDan AI agents.

2602.00682.tldr: RecGOAT is a novel yet simple dual semantic alignment framework for LLM-enhanced multimodal recommendation, which offers theoretically guaranteed alignment capability and achieves instance-level and distribution-level semantic alignment via cross-modal contrastive learning and optimal adaptive transport (OAT), respectively.

2602.00685.tldr: HUMANSTUDY-BENCH is introduced, a benchmark and execution engine that orchestrates LLM-based agents to reconstruct published human-subject experiments via a Filter--Extract--Execute--Evaluate pipeline, replaying trial sequences and running the original analysis pipeline in a shared runtime that preserves the original statistical procedures end to end.

2602.00694.tldr: This study demonstrates how the use of Federated Learning (FL) and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks can be employed to achieve this objective, highlighting the trade-off between data sharing and forecasting accuracy.

2602.00699.tldr: This study investigates three LLM-based approaches, including pre-trained LLM-driven method, in-context learning (ICL) method and fine-tuning method to extract terms and relations from domain-specific texts using limited data, and uses the best-performing method to build a casting ontology that validated by domian expert.

2602.00707.tldr: Self-Guard is proposed, a lightweight safety defense framework that reinforces safety compliance at the representational level and exhibits strong generalization across diverse unseen risks and varying model scales, offering a cost-efficient solution for LRM safety alignment.

2602.00709.tldr: A physics-informed Diffusion Generation framework to interpolate incomplete geomagnetic maps and imposes a physics-informed constraint on the diffusion generation results following the kriging principle of geomagnetic maps, ensuring strict adherence to the laws of physics.

2602.00711.tldr: An IntelliJ IDEA plugin prototype is presented that uses code-level software metrics to identify potentially security-critical methods and large language models to generate prevention-oriented explanations and lays the foundation for code-level security-aware metrics and enhanced explanations.

2602.00717.tldr: This work proposes direct forecasting with kernelized moment balancing (KMB-DF), which derives a tractable and differentiable objective that enables efficient estimation from empirical samples and seamless integration into gradient-based training pipelines.

2602.00726.tldr: Qualitative analysis reveals that trust is actively constructed through verification, with interaction strategies diverging by expertise: junior clinicians used the system as cognitive scaffolding to structure their analysis, while experts engaged in adversarial verification to challenge the AI's logic.

2602.00733.tldr: EchoReview is proposed, a citation-context-driven data synthesis framework that systematically mines implicit collective evaluative signals from academic citations and transforms scientific community's long-term judgments into structured review-style data.

2602.00740.tldr: ExperienceWeaver is a hierarchical framework that shifts the focus from data retrieval to experience learning, and consistently improves performance, surpassing state-of-the-art models such as Gemini-3 Pro in small-sample settings.

2602.00743.tldr: SA-VLA is proposed, a spatially-aware RL adaptation framework that preserves spatial grounding during policy optimization by aligning representation learning, reward design, and exploration with task geometry, and employs a spatially-conditioned annealed exploration strategy tailored to flow-matching dynamics.

2602.00747.tldr: Decouple Searching from Training Mix (DeMix) is proposed, a novel framework that leverages model merging to predict optimal data ratios and decouples search from training costs, enabling evaluation of unlimited sampled mixtures without extra training burden and thus facilitating better mixture discovery through more search trials.

2602.00751.tldr: This paper presents an industry case study of the ``Maria''platform, a production-grade AI system in primary healthcare that addresses this gap in trust, and presents the platform as a reference architecture, offering practical lessons for engineers building maintainable, scalable, and accountable AI-enabled systems in high-stakes domains.

2602.00753.tldr: Graph Neural Networks have become a standard approach for learning from graph-structured data, however, their reliance on parametric classifiers limits interpretability and sometimes hinders generalization.

2602.00759.tldr: An analysis of the decomposer is conducted, revealing how the RLVR process affects its performance and behavior, and which type of guidance is better suited for enhancing the reasoner's exploration and exploitation abilities.

2602.00763.tldr: Evaluating deep learning-based nerve segmentation in ultrasound images of the brachial plexus using a U-Net architecture finds that training on combined data from multiple ultrasound machines provides regularization benefits for lower-performing acquisition sources, though it does not surpass single-source training when matched to the target domain.

2602.00767.tldr: The results show that targeted training-time constraints on internal mechanisms can mitigate emergent misalignment without degrading target-task performance.

2602.00769.tldr: A novel elicitation method based on iterated in-context learning is proposed and applied to elicit trustworthiness priors using the Trust Game from behavioral game theory and shows that variation in elicited trustworthiness can be well predicted by a stereotype-based model grounded in perceived warmth and competence.

2602.00780.tldr: EcoVLA is a training-free, plug-and-play adaptive pruning framework that supports orthogonal combination with existing VLA acceleration methods that delivers state-of-the-art performance and is validated on real-world robots.

2602.00782.tldr: UCCS (Utility-Controlled Contrastive Steering), which steers protein generation with a constrained dataset by constructing contrastive sets that maximize differences in repetition while tightly controlling for structural utility.

2602.00785.tldr: This paper discusses how world models, viewed as models of dynamics, rewards, and task distributions, can overcome fundamental barriers of high-cost actions such as extreme off-policy learning and sample inefficiency in long-horizon tasks and demonstrates how world models can provide critical and rich learning signals to agents across a broad set of domains.

2602.00788.tldr: RESCUE (REducing Sampling cost with Causal Understanding and Estimation), a multi-objective MFBO method that incorporates causal calculus to systematically address this challenge, and improves sample efficiency over state-of-the-art MF optimization methods on synthetic and real-world problems in robotics, machine learning, and healthcare.

2602.00792.tldr: This work establishes explicit Masked Diffusion Duality, proving that the masked process arises as the projection of a continuous Gaussian process via a novel maximum-value index preservation mechanism, and introduces Masked Consistency Distillation (MCD), a principled framework that leverages this duality to analytically construct the deterministic coupled trajectories required for consistency distillation, bypassing numerical ODE solvers.

2602.00800.tldr: Rigorous isoFLOPs analysis further confirms that JTok-M fundamentally shifts the quality-compute Pareto frontier, achieving comparable model quality with 35% less compute relative to vanilla MoE architectures, and it is validated that token-indexed parameters exhibit a predictable power-law scaling behavior.

2602.00811.tldr: MissMAC-Bench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed to establish fair and unified evaluation standards from the perspective of cross-modal synergy and provides a solid foundation for advancing robust multimodal affective computing and promotes the development of multimedia data mining.

2602.00815.tldr: This work establishes a theoretical lower bound on the sample complexity required to unlock reasoning capabilities in RLVR, and empirically validate that strong performance can be achieved with a surprisingly small number of training instances, and proposes Dynamic One-Shot Policy Refinement (DoPR), an uncertainty-aware RL strategy that dynamically selects a single informative training sample per batch for policy updates.

2602.00838.tldr: It is demonstrated how unary G EMM can be effectively used for energy-efficient compute in future edge AI accelerators and weight sparsity analysis across eight pretrained convolutional neural networks and the LLaMA2 large language model is performed.

2602.00848.tldr: This work introduces Factuality-Controlled Generation (FCG), a framework that enables users to specify factuality constraints alongside their queries and proposes to train models on the FCG task using synthetic data, and shows that synthetic training significantly improves models'ability to both respect factuality requirements and maintain informativeness in their outputs.

2602.00849.tldr: RMFlow is introduced, an efficient multimodal generative model that integrates a coarse 1-NFE MeanFlow transport with a subsequent tailored noise-injection refinement step that approximates the average velocity of the flow path using a neural network trained with a new loss function that balances minimizing the Wasserstein distance between probability paths and maximizing sample likelihood.

2602.00854.tldr: This paper argues that prevailing approaches to transparency, user control, literacy, and governance do not define the foundational understanding humans must retain for oversight under sustained AI delegation, and defines the Cognitive Integrity Threshold (CIT) as the minimum comprehension required to preserve oversight, autonomy, and accountable participation under AI assistance.

2602.00861.tldr: This work proves that both excess hallucination probability and excess head redundancy scale with PoA, unifying two distinct failure modes into a single mechanism, and bounds the Price of Anarchy by $\Gamma(G)$, the off-diagonal mass of a head interaction matrix capturing weight and gradient coupling.

2602.00862.tldr: An efficient multiscale graph-based learning framework tailored to proteins that preserves the desired maximal expressiveness and improves prediction accuracy and reduces computational cost across various benchmarks is proposed.

2602.00866.tldr: The results show that one pretrained CAN model can adapt effectively to diverse predictive tasks, validating that the foundation modeling paradigm, proven in NLP and CV, also holds for CAN data.

2602.00869.tldr: This paper introduces a new partial differential equation characterization for the error between the learned and exact probability paths, along with its solution, and shows that the total variation gap between the two probability paths is bounded above by a combination of the CFM loss and an associated divergence loss.

2602.00871.tldr: Experiments across diverse reasoning tasks demonstrate that SELF-THOUGHT improves accuracy, robustness, and generalization for both large and small models, offering a scalable path toward more reliable self-correcting language systems.

2602.00883.tldr: DIAMOND is proposed, a training-free method that applies trajectory correction to mitigate artifacts during inference that provides a robust, zero-shot path to high-fidelity, artifact-free image synthesis without the need for additional training or weight modifications in modern generative architectures.

2602.00888.tldr: GAPNet is proposed, a Graph Adaptation Plug-in Network that jointly learns task-specific topology and representations in an end-to-end manner and is shown to consistently enhance the profitability and stability in comparision to the state-of-the-art models.

2602.00913.tldr: Under this benchmark, the HO structure is more useful as an inductive bias than as a rigid routing rule, and compact LLMs underperform supervised encoders as stand-alone systems, although they sometimes add useful diversity in hybrid ensembles.

2602.00914.tldr: A lightweight multimodal baseline for emotion recognition in conversations using the SemEval-2024 Task 3 dataset built from the sitcom Friends is presented, highlighting when multimodal fusion improves over unimodal models.

2602.00924.tldr: This paper supervise (decoder-only) SAEs to reconstruct feature vectors by jointly learning sparse concept embeddings and decoder weights and demonstrates compositional generalization, successfully reconstructing images with concept combinations unseen during training, and enabling feature-level intervention for semantic image editing without prompt modification.

2602.00929.tldr: This work introduces TheoryCoder-2, a new TBRL agent that leverages LLMs' in-context learning ability to actively learn reusable abstractions rather than relying on hand-specified ones, by synthesizing abstractions from experience and integrating them into a hierarchical planning process.

2602.00931.tldr: It is proved that learning with K strategies yields a Theta(K log K) improvement in sample complexity over binary preferences, and that DPO converges to the entropy-regularized utility-maximizing policy.

2602.00933.tldr: MCP-Atlas is introduced, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating tool-use competency, comprising 36 real MCP servers and 220 tools, and the task schema, containerized harness, and a 500-task public subset of the benchmark dataset are released to facilitate reproducible comparisons and advance the development of robust, tool-augmented agents.

2602.00937.tldr: This work introduces Contrastive Learning for 3D Multi-View Action-Conditioned Robotic Manipulation Pretraining (CLAMP), a novel 3D pre-training framework that utilizes point clouds and robot actions and demonstrates that CLAMP outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across six simulated tasks and five real-world tasks.

2602.00945.tldr: This work argues that language defaultness is governed by a sparse, low-rank control circuit, language neurons, that can be mechanistically isolated and safely steered, yielding controllable target-language defaultness.

2602.00947.tldr: This work formalizes cognitive overload as O = max(0, m - v - W) where m is task-relevant items, v is visible items, and W is working memory capacity, and formalizes cognitive overload as O>0, error probability increases and analytical biases (anchoring, confirmation, change blindness) amplify.

2602.00948.tldr: Reframing strategy evaluation as an ecological game formalism, FinEvo provides a unified, mechanism-level protocol for analyzing robustness, adaptation, and emergent dynamics in multi-agent financial markets, and may offer a means to explore the potential impact of macroeconomic policies and financial regulations on price evolution and equilibrium.

2602.00950.tldr: A clinically grounded risk taxonomy is introduced, developed in collaboration with PhD-level psychologists, that identifies actionable harm while preserving space for safe, non-crisis therapeutic content in large language models.

2602.00951.tldr: R-HTN is presented, a general algorithm for online HTN planning under directives \D, and it is found that R-HTN agents never violate directives, and aim to achieve the user-given goals if feasible though not necessarily as the user expected.

2602.00954.tldr: This paper proposes MixDPO, a simple yet effective difficulty-aware training strategy that orders preference data from easy to hard (a curriculum over margin-defined difficulty), and routes difficult pairs to an SFT objective while applying a preference loss to easy pairs.

2602.00960.tldr: It is demonstrated empirically that Mixture Density Networks achieve superior generalization, interpretability, and sample efficiency across a range of inverse, multistable, and chaotic scientific regression tasks.

2602.00979.tldr: This paper introduces GradingAttack, a fine-grained adversarial attack framework that systematically evaluates the vulnerability of LLM based ASAG models, and designs token-level and prompt-level strategies that manipulate grading outcomes while maintaining high camouflage.

2602.00981.tldr: Comprehensive experimental results on benchmarks demonstrate that MedSpeak significantly improves the accuracy of medical term recognition and overall medical SQA performance, establishing MedSpeak as a state-of-the-art solution for medical SQA.

2602.00982.tldr: The winning approaches from Team HCMUS_TheFangs for both tracks of the NeurIPS 2025 Mouse vs. AI: Robust Visual Foraging Competition are presented and conventional assumptions about model complexity in visuomotor learning are challenged.

2602.00983.tldr: DISPO is introduced, a simple yet effective REINFORCE-style algorithm that decouples the up-clipping and down-clipping of importance sampling weights for correct and incorrect responses, yielding four controllable policy update regimes.

2602.00993.tldr: HEMMES is proposed, a holistic risk-aware end-to-end multimodal driving framework designed to inject explicit long-tail risk cues into trajectory planning and introduces a Tri-Modal Driving Module that fuses multi-view perception, historical motion cues, and semantic guidance, ensuring risk-aware accurate trajectory planning under long-tail scenarios.

2602.00994.tldr: This paper introduces a Linear Effect Attribution System (LEAS), which provides quantitative evidence of interference between reasoning and tool-use behaviors and proposes Disentangled Action Reasoning Tuning, a simple and efficient framework that explicitly decouples parameter updates for reasoning and tool-use via separate low-rank adaptation modules.

2602.00996.tldr: DeALOG, a decentralized multi-agent framework for multimodal question answering that uses specialized agents: Table, Context, Visual, Summarizing and Verification, that communicate through a shared natural-language log as persistent memory is introduced.

2602.00997.tldr: This work proposes Error Taxonomy-Guided Prompt Optimization (ETGPO), a prompt optimization algorithm that adopts a top-down approach that achieves accuracy that is comparable to or better than state-of-the-art methods, while requiring roughly one third of the optimization-phase token usage and evaluation budget.

2602.01002.tldr: A formal analysis of how alignment from human feedback can increase this failure mode by identifying an explicit amplification mechanism that causally links optimization against a learned reward to bias in the human preference data used for alignment.

2602.01003.tldr: A full parameter fine-tuning framework that tightly combines the zero-order search in parameter space from Evolution Strategies (ES) with the Sharpness-Aware Maximization (SAM) to improve generalization and achieves an extremely low GPU memory usage.

2602.01017.tldr: Mechanistic analysis reveals that models learn to encode internal uncertainty by resolving inconsistent reasoning steps, which suggests the emergence of implicit self-verification from autoregressive training.

2602.01018.tldr: This work introduces LOKI, a three-stage end-to-end learning framework designed for offline skill discovery and hierarchical imitation, and demonstrates that the discovered skills are semantically meaningful, aligning with human intuition, and exhibit compositionality by successfully sequencing them to solve a novel, unseen task.

2602.01019.tldr: Overall, EEG variability should be treated as both a practical constraint to manage and a meaningful signal to leverage for precision neuroscience and robust neurotechnology.

2602.01025.tldr: This work proposes Universal and transferable jailbreak (UltraBreak), a framework that constrains adversarial patterns through transformations and regularisation in the vision space, while relaxing textual targets through semantic-based objectives to enable universal and transferable jailbreaks.

2602.01031.tldr: This work introduces a challenging multi-turn hallucination benchmark with 950 seed questions spanning four high-stakes domains, and operationalizes groundedness by requiring inline citations for factual assertions, and proposes a judging pipeline that iteratively retrieves evidence via web search.

2602.01032.tldr: HierCon is proposed, a hierarchical layer attention framework combined with margin-based contrastive learning that models dependencies across temporal frames, neighbouring layers, and layer groups, while encouraging domain-invariant embeddings in audio deepfakes.

2602.01034.tldr: A novel framework designed to provide continuous reward signals is proposed, which introduces a Step-wise Marginal Information Gain (MIG) mechanism that quantifies the intrinsic value of reasoning steps against a Monotonic Historical Watermark, effectively filtering out training noise.

2602.01037.tldr: Visual Expert Quantization (VEQ), a dual-aware quantization framework designed to simultaneously accommodate cross-modal differences and heterogeneity between experts, is proposed, demonstrating superior robustness across various multimodal tasks.

2602.01039.tldr: FLood dynamically counteracts the adverse effects of heterogeneity through a dual-weighting mechanism that jointly governs local training and global aggregation, and functions as an orthogonal plug-in module that seamlessly integrates with existing FL algorithms to boost their performance under heterogeneity without modifying their core optimization logic.

2602.01045.tldr: The finding that superposition leads to rapid training with a data-independent power law exponent may have important implications for a wide range of neural networks that employ superposition, including production-scale large language models.

2602.01058.tldr: The proposed PEAR (Policy Evaluation-inspired Algorithm for Offline Learning Loss Re-weighting), an SFT-stage method that corrects this mismatch and better prepares the model for RL, consistently improves post-RL performance over canonical SFT.

2602.01060.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework, TLDiffGAN, which consists of two complementary branches that incorporates a latent diffusion model into the GAN generator for adversarial training, thereby making the discriminator's task more challenging and improving the quality of generated samples.

2602.01062.tldr: This work introduces a set level diversity objective defined over sampled trajectories using kernelized similarity and derives a leave-one-out marginal contribution for each sampled trajectory and integrates this objective as a plug-in advantage shaping term for policy optimization.
