2602.02001.tldr: Structured Residual Reconstruction (SRR) is proposed, a rank-allocation framework that preserves the top-$k$ singular subspace of the activation-scaled weight before quantization, quantizes only the residual, and uses the remaining rank $r-k$ for error reconstruction.

2602.02004.tldr: ClueTracer, a training-free, parameter-free, and architecture-agnostic plugin for hallucination suppression that traces how key clues propagate along the model's reasoning pathway, thereby localizing task-relevant patches while suppressing spurious attention to irrelevant regions.

2602.02018.tldr: VeriFY, a training-time framework that teaches LLMs to reason about factual uncertainty through consistency-based self-verification, is proposed, a training-time framework that teaches LLMs to reason about factual uncertainty through consistency-based self-verification.

2602.02027.tldr: A safety-aware decoding method that requires only low-cost training of an expert model and employs a single neuron as a gating mechanism is proposed, offering a new perspective on lightweight alignment for the safe and practical deployment of large language models.

2602.02028.tldr: It is argued that knowledge internalization is fundamentally a reasoning problem rather than a memorization problem, and a model should be trained in situations where the new information is instrumental to solving a task, combined with pre-existing knowledge, and exercised through multi-step reasoning.

2602.02029.tldr: The rule-to-constraint (R2C) framework is developed, a multi-agent pipeline that parses problem texts, synthesizes CIR implementations by retrieving domain knowledge, and instantiates optimization models, and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the proposed benchmark.

2602.02034.tldr: This work introduces a multi-agent system formalized as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP) with a directed acyclic structure, and illustrates the approach through a case study in AI safety evaluation for self-harm detection, implemented as a multi-agent compliance system.

2602.02035.tldr: This work introduces a gated communication mechanism that dynamically determines when communication is necessary based on environmental context and agent states and establishes a theoretically grounded framework for deploying multi-agent systems in bandwidth-constrained environments such as robotic swarms, autonomous vehicle fleets, and distributed sensor networks.

2602.02039.tldr: Deep Data Research is introduced, an open-ended task where LLMs autonomously extract key insights from databases, and DDR-Bench, a large-scale, checklist-based benchmark that enables verifiable evaluation, which highlights that effective investigatory intelligence depends not only on agent scaffolding or merely scaling, but also on intrinsic strategies of agentic models.

2602.02043.tldr: This work introduces Auto-Comp, a fully automated and synthetic pipeline for generating scalable benchmarks, and uncovers a surprising trade-off: visio-linguistic context, which provides global scene cues, aids spatial reasoning but simultaneously hinders local attribute binding by introducing visual clutter.

2602.02051.tldr: Self-Improving Diffusion Agent (SIDiffAgent), a training-free agentic framework that leverages the Qwen family of models and incorporates iterative self-improvement by storing a memory of previous experiences in a database, is introduced.

2602.02055.tldr: ForLER is presented, combining Q-ensemble aggregation on the server with actor rectification on devices to curb policy pollution and shift heavy computation off resource-constrained hardware without compromising privacy.

2602.02060.tldr: FiLoRA (Focus-and-Ignore LoRA) is introduced, an instruction-conditioned, parameter-efficient adaptation framework that enables explicit control over internal feature reliance while keeping the predictive objective fixed and yields improved robustness under spurious feature interventions.

2602.02063.tldr: This work presents See2Refine, a human-free, closed-loop framework that uses vision-language model (VLM) perceptual evaluation as automated visual feedback to improve an LLM-based eHMI action designer, and evaluates the perceived appropriateness of the action.

2602.02067.tldr: SegmentMIL, a transformer-based multi-view multiple-instance learning framework for patient-level stenosis classification, is proposed, which obtains high performance on internal and external evaluations and outperforms both view-level models and classical MIL baselines, underscoring its potential as a clinically viable and scalable solution for coronary stenosis diagnosis.

2602.02090.tldr: This work presents LEC-KG, a bidirectional collaborative framework that integrates the semantic understanding of Large Language Models with the structural reasoning of Knowledge Graph Embeddings, and demonstrates substantial improvements over LLM baselines, particularly on low-frequency relations.

2602.02096.tldr: This work proposes WADEPre, a wavelet-based decomposition model for extreme precipitation that transitions the modeling into the wavelet domain, and introduces a multi-scale curriculum learning strategy that progressively shifts supervision from coarse scales to fine-grained details.

2602.02098.tldr: A new generalisation bound is introduced that composes per-task lower confidence bounds from finitely many rollouts with task-level generalisation from finitely many sampled tasks, yielding a high-confidence guarantee for new tasks drawn from the same arbitrary and unknown distribution.

2602.02100.tldr: Findings from the first wave of a longitudinal expert perception survey involving AI researchers, policymakers, and disinformation specialists are presented, indicating that while deepfake video presents immediate "shock"value, large-scale text generation poses a systemic risk of "epistemic fragmentation" and "synthetic consensus,"particularly in the political domain.

2602.02124.tldr: An AI-based anomaly detection framework for histopathological whole-slide images (WSIs) in rodent livers from toxicology studies is introduced, demonstrating the potential of AI-driven histopathology to support preclinical workflows, reduce late-stage failures, and improve efficiency in drug development.

2602.02126.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage optimization framework for group scales that explicitly minimizes the layer-wise reconstruction loss, and employs the coordinate descent algorithm and derive a closed-form update rule, which enables efficient refinement without costly numerical optimization.

2602.02133.tldr: In a one-layer Transformer encoder, weight sharing couples the two directions by making forward and reverse attention scores positively correlated and it is shown that the corresponding gradients are aligned, so minimizing the forward loss also reduces the reverse loss.

2602.02136.tldr: DGR transforms and refines an existing out-of-distributional safety reasoning dataset to be aligned with the target's LLM inner distribution, and finds that safety alignment in LRMs may primarily function as a mechanism to activate latent knowledge, as a mere 10 samples are sufficient for activating effective refusal behaviors.

2602.02143.tldr: This work shows that small reasoning models can acquire strong GenSelect capabilities through targeted reinforcement learning, and establishes reinforcement learning as a scalable way to unlock strong generative selection in small models, enabling efficient test-time scaling.

2602.02150.tldr: ECHO jointly leverages local entropy and group level confidence to adaptively control branch width, and further introduces online confidence-based pruning to terminate persistently low confidence branches, avoiding high entropy traps and mitigating collapse.

2602.02158.tldr: Dijkstra's and A* resulted in the most traffic-aware optimal solutions with minimal preprocessing required and Yen's algorithm required significant preprocessing but balanced between the other two approaches in terms of runtime speed and optimality.

2602.02170.tldr: An exploratory systems feasibility study of Self-Evolving Coordination Protocols (SECP): coordination protocols that permit limited, externally validated self-modification while preserving fixed formal invariants, establishing a foundation for governed multi-agent systems.

2602.02179.tldr: SurvKAN is introduced, a fully parametric, time-continuous survival model based on KAN architectures that eliminates the proportional hazards constraint and preserves interpretability through learnable univariate functions that indicate how individual features influence risk over time.

2602.02184.tldr: The XGBoost model type was the final model selected for both tasks due to the trade-off between strong detection capability and fast inference speed due to the trade-off between strong detection capability and fast inference speed.

2602.02185.tldr: The Vision-DeepResearch benchmark (VDR-Bench) is constructed and a simple multi-round cropped-search workflow is proposed to address the insufficient visual retrieval capabilities of current MLLMs and is shown to effectively improve model performance in realistic visual retrieval scenarios.

2602.02188.tldr: NLCO is introduced, a NLCO benchmark that evaluates LLMs on end-to-end CO reasoning: given a language-described decision-making scenario, the model must output a discrete solution without writing code or calling external solvers.

2602.02195.tldr: This work uncovers a fundamental phenomenon termed State Rank Stratification, characterized by a distinct spectral bifurcation among linear attention heads: while one group maintains an effective rank oscillating near zero, the other exhibits rapid growth that converges to an upper bound.

2602.02197.tldr: Hierarchical Adaptive Eviction (HAE) is proposed, a KV cache eviction framework that optimizes text-visual token interaction in MLLMs by implementing Dual-Attention Pruning during pre-filling and a Dynamic Decoding Eviction Strategy (inspired by OS Recycle Bins) during decoding.

2602.02199.tldr: This work presents LASER-KV (Layer Accumulated Selection with Exact-LSH Recall), a framework designed to test the limits of KV compression under a strict accumulative budgeting policy, and challenges the prevailing assumption that attention scores alone are a sufficient proxy for token utility.

2602.02208.tldr: Developed over eight iterations and evaluated through two user studies, the AgriHubi system shows clear gains in answer completeness, linguistic accuracy, and perceived reliability, and the results also reveal practical trade-offs between response quality and latency when deploying larger models.

2602.02213.tldr: TIDES is presented, a text informed design approach for generating physically sound designs based on a textual description and a set of physical constraints that can jointly optimize structural (topology) and visual properties while utilizing features specified by text.

2602.02224.tldr: In toy models of superposition, this theory is used to prove that capacity saturation forces spectral localization: features collapse onto single eigenspaces, organize into tight frames, and admit discrete classification via association schemes, classifying all geometries from prior work.

2602.02238.tldr: TopoDiff is introduced, a geometry- and relation-aware diffusion model for EEG spatial super-resolution that incorporates topology-aware image embeddings derived from EEG topographic representations to provide global geometric context for spatial generation and yields a spatially grounded EEG spatial super-resolution framework with consistent performance improvements.

2602.02264.tldr: This work introduces a multi-stage physics-informed training strategy that achieves convergence by progressively enforcing boundary conditions in the loss landscape and subsequently incorporating interior residuals, establishing staged, spline-based optimization as a robust paradigm for physics-informed operator learning.

2602.02266.tldr: The findings show that using only parallel data is the most effective way to extend an LLM to new languages, and OpenSeal is built, the first truly open Southeast Asian LLM that rivals the performance of existing models of similar size.

2602.02269.tldr: This work extends approaches from soft robotics to rigid dual-arm, contact-rich tasks, showcasing a promising method to reduce the sim2real gap and providing a robust, reproducible platform for advanced robotics research.

2602.02280.tldr: This paper introduces RACA, a novel set of coverage criteria specifically designed for LLM safety testing that leverages representation engineering to focus on safety-critical concepts within LLMs, thereby reducing dimensionality and filtering out irrelevant information.

2602.02281.tldr: This work proves that unit-step Euler discretization, the natural timescale of layer transitions, recovers standard backpropagation exactly in precisely 2L steps for an L-layer network, with no approximations.

2602.02286.tldr: A robust SASV framework in which a spoofing detector and a speaker verification (SV) network operate in tandem is proposed, which employs a self-supervised speech embedding extractor as the frontend and a state-of-the-art graph neural network backend.

2602.02288.tldr: A novel training method for time-series forecasting that enforces two key properties: (1) AR prediction errors should increase with the forecasting horizon, and (2) the method enables models to concatenate short-term AR predictions for forming flexible long-term forecasts.

2602.02290.tldr: This work proposes StoryScore, a composite metric for evaluating AI-generated scientific stories that integrates semantic alignment, lexical grounding, narrative control, structural fidelity, redundancy avoidance, and entity-level hallucination detection into a unified framework.

2602.02304.tldr: A Comparative XAI ($Delta$-XAI) framework is formulated with a set of desiderata to be taken into account when designing proper explaining methods, and a set of possible pipelines are introduced to highlight how $\Delta$-XAI methods work.

2602.02331.tldr: This work proposes a real-to-sim-to-real framework that leverages rapid test-time training (TTT) on novel terrains, significantly enhancing the robot's capability to traverse extremely difficult geometries.

2602.02338.tldr: ReSID is a recommendation-native, principled SID framework that rethinks representation learning and quantization from the perspective of information preservation and sequential predictability, without relying on LLMs.

2602.02350.tldr: A multi-LLM context learning method that learns a context generator for each agent, capable of dynamically generating context instructions per discussion round via automatic information organization and refinement, and enables LLMs to avoid premature convergence on majority noise and progressively reach the correct consensus.

2602.02351.tldr: It is discussed how symmetries and conservation laws reduce the intrinsic dimensionality of physical datasets, and how this reduction may manifest itself through self-organization of latent spaces in generative models trained to balance reconstruction and compression.

2602.02354.tldr: This work explores how different neural networks can be designed as a new texture INR, which operates in a continuous manner rather than a discrete one over the input UV coordinate space, which performs well in terms of image quality and memory usage.

2602.02361.tldr: SWE-Universe, a scalable and efficient framework for automatically constructing real-world software engineering (SWE) verifiable environments from GitHub pull requests (PRs), utilizes a building agent powered by an efficient custom-trained model to ensure the reliable generation of high-fidelity, verifiable tasks.

2602.02366.tldr: This work shows that by using Prefix Tuning, LLMs can learn to reason without overloading the context window and without any weight updates, and introduces ReasonCACHE, a scalable algorithm for learning reasoning skills beyond the context window without modifying parameters.

2602.02369.tldr: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly equipped with memory, which are stored experience and reusable guidance that can improve task-solving performance, and an online self-evolving memory system that learns from a stream of incoming data over time is introduced.

2602.02378.tldr: It is argued reliable human-AI partnership requires a shift from answer generation to collaborative premise governance over a knowledge substrate, negotiating only what is decision-critical.

2602.02386.tldr: BELLA (Budget-Efficient LLM Selection via Automated skill-profiling), a framework that recommends optimal LLM selection for tasks through interpretable skill-based model selection, is introduced, enabling practitioners to make principled and cost-performance trade-offs for deploying LLMs.

2602.02395.tldr: This work establishes Tag-Along Attacks as a first-class, verifiable threat model and shows that effective agentic attacks can be elicited from off-the-shelf open-weight models through environment interaction alone.

2602.02402.tldr: SoMA improves resimulation accuracy and generalization on real-world robot manipulation by 20%, enabling stable simulation of complex tasks such as long-horizon cloth folding.

2602.02405.tldr: Distribution Aligned Imitation Learning (DAIL), a two-step method that bridges the distributional gap by first transforming expert solutions into detailed, in-distribution reasoning traces and then applying a contrastive objective to focus learning on expert insights and methodologies is proposed.

2602.02416.tldr: This work introduces a prompting method that structures reasoning as discrete, semantically coherent thought steps, and shows that models are able to reliably localize errors within this structure, while failing to do so in conventional, unstructured chain-of-thought reasoning.

2602.02422.tldr: This work defines a vast class of generalizations of self-attention mechanisms, which they are called poly-attention mechanisms, and gives a new attention mechanism which can be computed exactly in quadratic time, and which can perform function composition for any fixed number of functions.

2602.02451.tldr: This work proposes Active Causal Experimentalist, which learns experimental design as a sequential policy via Direct Preference Optimization, and suggests preference-based learning can recover principled experimental strategies, complementing theory with learned domain adaptation.

2602.02454.tldr: World-Gymnast is proposed, which performs RL finetuning of a vision-language-action policy by rolling out the policy in an action-conditioned video world model and rewarding the rollouts with a vision-language model (VLM).

2602.02455.tldr: This work introduces the first diagnostic benchmark that evaluates agentic pragmatics under input faults through multi-turn clarification across state-oriented and service-oriented execution environments, and provides a unified taxonomy of cooperative breakdowns.

2602.02462.tldr: This work introduces a framework for abstraction-guided reasoning that explicitly separates structural inference from lexical semantics, and positions activation-level abstraction as a scalable mechanism for enhancing the robustness of formal reasoning in LLMs against semantic interference.

2602.02465.tldr: MentisOculi is developed, a procedural, stratified suite of multi-step reasoning problems amenable to visual solution, tuned to challenge frontier models, suggesting that despite their inherent appeal, visual thoughts do not yet benefit model reasoning.

2602.02468.tldr: Avenir-Web is introduced, a web agent that achieves a new open-source state of the art on the Online-Mind2Web benchmark in real-world deployment and establishes a new open-source state of the art for reliable web agents on live websites.

2602.02470.tldr: Theoretically, it is proved that under this recipe, even a one-layer transformer can break the reversal curse by analyzing the implicit bias of gradient descent, and empirical results show that a 1B pretrained language model finetuned with the proposed data recipe achieves a 40% success rate on reversal tasks, in stark contrast to a near-zero success rate when trained solely on forward-knowledge data.

2602.02471.tldr: Results indicate that detection-based gating enhances robustness and anatomical plausibility in automated segmentation applications, reducing hallucinated predictions without compromising segmentation quality in valid slices, and offers a promising approach for improving the reliability of clinical radiotherapy auto-contouring workflows.

2602.02474.tldr: Inspired by the design philosophy of agent skills, MemSkill employs a controller that learns to select a small set of relevant skills, paired with an LLM-basedExecutor that produces skill-guided memories, which improves task performance over strong baselines and generalizes well across settings.

2602.02475.tldr: To mitigate the human cost of failure attribution, AGENTRX is presented, an automated domain-agnostic diagnostic framework that pinpoints the critical failure step in a failed agent trajectory and improves step localization and failure attribution over existing baselines across three domains.

2602.02481.tldr: An improved objective is introduced that enables success in legged locomotion, humanoid motion tracking, and manipulation tasks, as well as robust sim-to-real transfer on two humanoid robots.

2602.02486.tldr: Re-TRAC is proposed, an agentic framework that performs cross-trajectory exploration by generating a structured state representation after each trajectory to summarize evidence, uncertainties, failures, and future plans, and conditioning subsequent trajectories on this state representation, enabling iterative reflection and globally informed planning.

2602.02493.tldr: Instead of modeling the full image manifold, PixelGen introduces two complementary perceptual losses to guide diffusion model towards learning a more meaningful perceptual manifold, and surpasses strong latent diffusion baselines.

2110.08902.tldr: A novel theoretical framework for experience replay in modern policy gradient methods is developed, identifying how bias scales with the cumulative policy update, the mixing time of the underlying dynamics, and the age of buffered data, and formalizing the practitioner's rule of avoiding overly stale replay.

2304.04914.tldr: Regulatory markets are proposed, in which governments require the targets of regulation to purchase regulatory services from a government-licensed private regulator, which could overcome the limitations of both command-and-control regulation and excessive delegation to industry.

2501.15280.tldr: This work provides theoretical analysis showing this process converges to a self-consistent corpus where the model trained on it approves of its own training data, and argues this framework offers a novel form of scalable oversight.

2504.02546.tldr: This work revisits the traditional Policy Gradient mechanism and proposes a minimalist RL approach termed Group Policy Gradient (GPG), which directly optimize the original RL objective, thus obviating the need for surrogate loss functions.

2504.03622.tldr: Structural Alignment is introduced, a novel method that aligns LLMs with human-like discourse structures to enhance long-form text generation by integrating linguistically grounded discourse frameworks into reinforcement learning, and guides models to produce coherent and well-organized outputs.

2504.17878.tldr: These findings not only articulate a novel bio-computational pathway for cryptographic defense but also provide a rigorous algorithmic blueprint for future physical realization, demonstrating that the thermodynamic complexity of biological systems offers a robust and physically grounded frontier for securing digital infrastructure in the post-quantum era.

2506.07326.tldr: It is found that these models can encode concerning biases toward certain identity groups, which may emerge as unintended consequences of harmlessness training—distortions that risk propagating through the downstream large language models now deployed to millions.

2506.17873.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that SurgVidLM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art Vid-LLMs of comparable parameter scale in both full and fine-grained video understanding tasks, showcasing its superior capability in capturing the context of complex robot-assisted surgeries.

2507.14111.tldr: CUDA-L1 is introduced, an automated reinforcement learning framework for CUDA optimization that employs a novel contrastive RL algorithm that can transform an initially poor-performing LLM into an effective CUDA optimizer through speedup-based reward signals alone, without human expertise or domain knowledge.

2507.20534.tldr: The MuonClip optimizer is proposed, which improves upon Muon with a novel QK-clip technique to address training instability while enjoying the advanced token efficiency of Muon.

2508.19264.tldr: A framework to explain the initial decline in diversity followed by recombinant innovation, but only when humans actively curate rather than passively defer is proposed, and testable predictions about when compression constrains versus amplifies creativity are generated.

2509.21249.tldr: Decipher-MR is presented, a 3D MRI-specific vision-language foundation model trained on 200,000 MRI series from over 22,000 studies spanning diverse anatomical regions, sequences, and pathologies, and evaluated across disease classification, demographic prediction, anatomical localization, and cross-modal retrieval.

2509.22984.tldr: Inter-Cascade is an online, interactive framework that transforms the strong model from a temporary helper into a long-term teacher that enables the weak model to learn on the job without expensive parameter fine-tuning.

2510.00294.tldr: This work proposes an algorithm of parallel-decoded candidate generation and verification, which is theoretically guaranteed to use the fewest model forward calls to reproduce the same sequence generated by one-token-per-step decoding.

2510.02125.tldr: It is shown that using accuracy alone to evaluate abstract reasoning can substantially overestimate AI capabilities in textual modalities and underestimate it in visual modalities.

2510.17881.tldr: It is demonstrated that the learned natural-language preference summaries transfer effectively to frozen, off-the-shelf LLMs, including black-box APIs, providing empirical evidence of modularity and generator-transferability.

2510.20728.tldr: This work extends TeXRA with an independent Lean 4 verification layer, turning it into a human-guided multi-agent platform for exact scientific discovery, and applies this platform to nonadditive quantum error-correcting codes with prescribed transversal diagonal gates within the subset-sum linear-programming (SSLP) framework.

2511.09483.tldr: The proposed CrochetBench offers a new lens for assessing procedural competence in multimodal models and highlights the gap between surface-level understanding and executable precision in real-world creative domains.

2512.01834.tldr: This work proposes a novel Counterfactual Debiasing Framework grounded in causal inference that not only significantly reduces gender bias but also improves overall detection performance compared to existing debiasing strategies.

2512.10398.tldr: This work introduces the Confucius Code Agent (CCA), a software engineering agent that can operate at large-scale codebases and introduces a meta-agent that automates the construction, evaluation, and refinement of agents through a build-test-improve cycle, enabling rapid agent development on new tasks and tool stacks.

2601.05110.tldr: This work proposes a novel perspective on step-wise collaboration: the difficulty of a reasoning step can be inferred from its very first token, and introduces GlimpRouter, a training-free step-wise collaboration framework that significantly reduces inference latency while preserving accuracy.

2601.08011.tldr: TP-Blend is presented, a lightweight training-free framework that receives two separate textual prompts, one specifying a blend object and the other defining a target style, and injects both into a single denoising trajectory, driven by two complementary attention processors.

2601.19120.tldr: The results establish the first robustness benchmarks for explanation agents and highlight robustness as a critical dimension for trustworthy, agent-driven recommender systems at web scale.

2601.19121.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that LLMs can act as effective orchestration agents for deployable and constraint-compliant recommendation systems, and indicate that LLMs can act as effective orchestration agents for deployable and constraint-compliant recommendation systems.

2601.21064.tldr: Textual Equilibrium Propagation (TEP), a local learning principle inspired by Equilibrium Propagation in energy-based models, is introduced, which consistently improves accuracy and efficiency over global propagation methods such as TextGrad.

2601.21123.tldr: This work introduces CUA-Skill, a computer-using agentic skill base that encodes human computer-use knowledge as skills coupled with parameterized execution and composition graphs, and constructs CUA-Skill Agent, an end-to-end computer-using agent that supports dynamic skill retrieval, argument instantiation, and memory-aware failure recovery.

2601.22607.tldr: EigenData is a hierarchical multi-agent engine that synthesizes tool-grounded dialogues together with executable per-instance checkers, and improves generation reliability via closed-loop self-evolving process that updates prompts and workflow, and develops an RL recipe that first fine-tunes the user model and then applies GRPO-style training.

2601.22975.tldr: Golden Goose, a simple trick to synthesize unlimited RLVR tasks from unverifiable internet text by constructing a multiple-choice question-answering version of the fill-in-the-middle task, highlights the potential of automatically scaling up RLVR data by exploiting abundant, reasoning-rich, unverifiable internet text.

2602.00062.tldr: A new training methodology, Supervised Contrastive Parallel Learning (SCPL), that addresses the issue of inefficiency in training deep networks by decoupling BP and transforming a long gradient flow into multiple short ones, achieving superior model parallelism and enhancing training throughput.

2602.00197.tldr: Rank-and-Reason (VenusRAR), a two-stage agentic framework to automate this workflow and maximize expected wet-lab fitness, is proposed and code and datasets are released.

2602.00748.tldr: This work implements SuperNode within the production deep learning framework MindSpore, adding a remote memory backend and specialized compiler passes, and develops a global execution-order refinement algorithm that statically schedules data transfers to hide remote memory latency behind compute-intensive regions.

2602.01538.tldr: A novel dual-stream framework, InteractAvatar, which decouples perception and planning from video synthesis for grounded human-object interaction for talking avatars and establishes a benchmark, GroundedInter, for evaluating GHOI video generation.

2602.01588.tldr: This paper proposes SpecTF, a simple yet effective framework that integrates the effect of textual data on time series in the frequency domain and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art models across diverse multi-modal time series datasets while utilizing considerably fewer parameters.

2602.02033.tldr: The OSMF framework is presented, a unified framework that aligns diverse group-wise click preferences in large-scale advertising image generation and introduces the Grouped Advertising Image Preference Dataset (GAIP), the first large-scale public dataset of group-wise image preferences.

2602.02196.tldr: This work proposes Test-time Improvement Diagnostic Evaluation (TIDE), an agent-agnostic and environment-agnostic framework that decomposes TTI into three comprehensive and interconnected dimensions, highlighting that improving agent performance requires more than scaling internal reasoning.

2602.02276.tldr: This work introduces Kimi K2.5, an open-source multimodal agentic model designed to advance general agentic intelligence, and introduces Agent Swarm, a self-directed parallel agent orchestration framework that dynamically decomposes complex tasks into heterogeneous sub-problems and executes them concurrently.

2602.02453.tldr: Experimental results show that Thinking with Comics outperforms Thinking with Images on multi-step temporal and causal reasoning tasks, while remaining substantially more efficient than Thinking with Video.

2602.02497.tldr: This work proposes STEMVerse, a diagnostic framework designed to systematically analyze the STEM reasoning capabilities of LLMs, and re-aggregate over 20,000 STEM problems from mainstream benchmarks into a unified capability space, assigning dual-axis labels to every instance.

2602.02498.tldr: This work introduces a test-time procedure that approximates the gradient of completion toxicity with respect to the input embeddings and uses a small number of descent steps to steer generation toward less toxic continuations, and encourages wider use of black-box optimization to guide autoregressive language models toward scalable, safer text generation.

2602.02500.tldr: This work proposes Iteration-Free Newton-Schulz Orthogonalization (IFNSO), a novel framework that consolidates the traditional iterative structure into a unified and Iteration-Free formulation and streamline the process by removing insignificant terms and introducing a polynomial with learnable coefficients.

2602.02502.tldr: A Sparse Adapter Fusion Method (SAFM), which dynamically fuses old and new adapters to address challenges, and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods, achieving comparable performance while utilizing less than 60% of the parameters.

2602.02503.tldr: A unified model that combines VAA with BLE two-way CFR is proposed, and a neural network based phase recovery framework that employs row / column predictors with a voting mechanism to resolve the ambiguity is introduced.

2602.02505.tldr: This paper investigates learning-augmented algorithms for smooth integer programs, covering canonical problems such as MAX-CUT and MAX-k-SAT, and proves that the induced algorithm class possesses a bounded pseudo-dimension, thereby ensuring that an oracle with near-optimal expected performance can be learned with polynomial samples.

2602.02508.tldr: A precoding-oriented CSI feedback framework based on a vector quantized variational autoencoder, augmented with an information-theoretic regularization is proposed, which achieves rates comparable to variable-length neural compression schemes, while operating with fixed-length feedback.

2602.02509.tldr: This work proposes CodeGuard, a comprehensive guardrail framework for educational AI systems that includes a first-of-its-kind taxonomy for classifying prompts, and a lightweight sentence-encoder model fine-tuned to detect unsafe prompts in real time.

2602.02510.tldr: This work studies cross-cultural meme transcreation, a multimodal generation task that aims to preserve communicative intent and humor while adapting culture-specific references, and proposes a hybrid transcreation framework based on vision-language models and introduces a large-scale bidirectional dataset.

2602.02511.tldr: This paper contends that training foundation models on neural data opens new normative territory and draws on AI ethics, neuroethics, and bioethics to organize concerns across privacy, consent, bias, benefit sharing, and governance.

2602.02512.tldr: This work investigates a well-established network-based formulation of fairness called PageRank fairness, which refers to a fair allocation of the PageRank weights among distinct groups, and proposes an effective linear-time algorithm to enhance the PageRank fairness by modifying the underlying network structure.

2602.02516.tldr: Pairwise User unFairness (PUF) is presented, a novel evaluation measure of individual user fairness that considers both effectiveness disparity and user similarity and is the first RS evaluation measure to reliably capture both user similarity and effectiveness in individual user fairness.

2602.02517.tldr: This systematic review synthesizes computational methods used to predict length of stay in this patient population, highlighting model performance and key predictors and offers strong potential for length of stay prediction after elective spine surgery.

2602.02518.tldr: GraphDancer, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that teaches LLMs to navigate graphs by interleaving reasoning and function execution, is proposed, demonstrating robust cross-domain generalization of graph exploration and reasoning skills.

2602.02519.tldr: It is indicated that LLMs can generate well-structured feedback and hold great potential as a sustainable and meaningful feedback tool, provided they are guided by clear contextual information and a well-defined instructions that will be explored further in the conclusions.

2602.02520.tldr: The model presented offers a synthesis solution that includes ethical leadership data-related to equity to measure inclusivity based upon sustainability thinking that has demonstrated that using AI technology not only increases inclusivity but promotes equity related to access to education in stem education access.

2602.02521.tldr: It is shown that SDPA can be rewritten in a different but mathematically equivalent form as a projection of the input vectors onto a common surface determined by the inputs themselves, which provides a strong justification for the use of SDPA for time-series data with time-varying local nonlinear dependencies.

2602.02522.tldr: IMU-1 is presented, a 430M-parameter language model trained on 72B tokens that approaches the benchmark performance of models trained on 56x more data and a validated training recipe combining recent architectural interventions with optimization advances.

2602.02523.tldr: This work proposes TabularMath, a diagnostic benchmark of 114 deterministic problems generated from verified programs based on GSM8K and AIME, and evaluates 9 tabular architectures and in-context learning (ICL) with GPT-OSS-120B.

2602.02524.tldr: GASTON (Graph-Aware Social Transformer for Online Networks), which learns text and user embeddings that are grounded in their local norms, providing the necessary context for downstream tasks, demonstrates that the embeddings produced by GASTON outperform state-of-the-art baselines.

2602.02525.tldr: This paper advocates a paradigm shift from task-specific fine-tuning to unsupervised pretraining, grounded in an entirely novel consideration of community norms, that not only mitigates data scarcity but also enables interpretation of the social norms underlying the decisions made by such an AI system.

2602.02526.tldr: It is demonstrated that Adaptive Spectral Negative Coupling (ASNC) acts as a topological operator that actively induces Manifold Unfolding, and MNCIS forces the model to expand its effective rank from the anisotropic baseline to a hyper-diverse state of 5.35, effectively constructing an artificial manifold that resists the gravitational pull of semantic attractors and preserves the long-tail distribution of the training data.

2602.02528.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework named the Incident-Guided Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Network (IGSTGNN), which explicitly models the incident's impact through two core components: an Incident-Context Spatial Fusion (ICSF) module to capture the initial heterogeneous spatial influence, and a Temporal Incident Impact Decay (TIID) module to model the subsequent dynamic dissipation.

2602.02532.tldr: Context-Aware Distillation with Experience-gated Transfer (CADENT), a framework that unifies strategic automaton-based knowledge with tactical policy-level knowledge into a coherent guidance signal, is introduced, establishing a robust approach for adaptive knowledge transfer in RL.

2602.02535.tldr: An explainable framework based on a fine‐tuned hybrid Deep Neural Network (DNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) called HyExDNN‐RNN model is proposed for ADHD detection, multi‐class categorization and decision interpretation that provides interpretable insights into the diagnostic process so that psychologists can better understand and trust the results of the diagnosis.

2602.02536.tldr: A novel learning paradigm (UniMod) that transitions from sparse decision-making to dense reasoning traces, and develops a multi-head scalar reward model (UniRM), which provides multi-dimensional supervision by assigning attribute-level scores to the response generation stage.

2602.02542.tldr: This work proposes an end-to-end auto-augmentation contrastive learning method for wearable-based HAR based on a Siamese network architecture that shares the parameters of the backbone and with a generator embedded to learn auto-augmentation.

2602.02544.tldr: This work derives a low-dimensional singular proxy that enables the identification of update-critical tokens in a low-dimensional subspace, substantially reducing the overhead of update identification and introduces an adaptive strategy that allocates fewer updates to stable layers without degrading generation quality.

2602.02545.tldr: This work proposes Manifold-Reshaping Policy Optimization (MRPO), a geometric framework designed to fundamentally restructure the inference space of LLMs and achieves state-of-the-art performance on mathematical tasks, significantly outperforming larger models and expanding the capability boundary beyond standard GRPO.

2602.02547.tldr: The Noise-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Network (naPINN), which robustly recovers physical solutions from corrupted measurements without prior knowledge of the noise distribution, and significantly outperforms existing robust PINN baselines.

2602.02548.tldr: ToolTok is proposed, a novel paradigm of multi-step pathfinding for GUI agents, where operations are modeled as a sequence of progressive tool usage, and introduces a semantic anchoring mechanism that grounds each tool with semantically related concepts as natural inductive bias.

2602.02550.tldr: It is proved that HyPAC achieves the minimum expected cost with a probably approximately correct (PAC) guarantee on the annotation error, free of data distribution and pre-trained models.

2602.02551.tldr: A lightweight Transformer architecture in conjunction with a novel Escape-Explore Optimizer enhances both exploration and generalization while effectively avoiding sharp minima and saddle-point traps, thereby validating its potential as a versatile cross-task foundation model for Web-scale data mining and analysis.

2602.02554.tldr: BatCoder is introduced, a self-supervised reinforcement learning framework designed to jointly optimize code generation and documentation production that demonstrates consistent scaling with respect to both training corpus size and model capacity.

2602.02556.tldr: SEAM (Structured Experience Adapter Module), a lightweight, executor-specific plug-in that stores experience in its parameters and generates a structured, instance-tailored experience entry in a single forward pass to guide a frozen LLM executor, is introduced.

2602.02557.tldr: This work analyzes the connection between modality alignment and cross-modality jailbreak transfer, and demonstrates strong cross-model transferability and shows that text-transferred audio attacks remain effective even under a stricter audio-only access threat model.

2602.02558.tldr: Phenotype-Aware Multiple Instance Learning is proposed, a novel ante-hoc interpretable framework that identifies cancer-related phenotypes from WSIs and utilizes them for cancer subtyping and thoroughly analyzed the genotype-phenotype relationships, demonstrating the reliability and accountability of PA-MIL.

2602.02559.tldr: GeoEvolver is introduced, a self-evolving multi-agent system that enables LLM agents to acquire EO expertise through structured interaction without any parameter updates, demonstrating that EO expertise can emerge progressively from efficient, fine-grained interactions with the environment.

2602.02560.tldr: S(H)NAP is proposed, a model-agnostic auditing framework that constructs generative interventional attributions validated by expert radiologists, and isolates object-specific causal contributions to the risk score.

2602.02561.tldr: This work introduces MathlibLemma, the first LLM-based multi-agent system to automate the discovery and formalization of mathematical folklore lemmas and establishes a constructive methodology for the self-evolution of formal mathematical libraries.

2602.02565.tldr: This paper approaches high-rank matrix completion (HRMC) by filling missing entries in a data matrix where columns lie near a union of subspaces, clustering these columns, and identifying the underlying subspaces, thus narrowing the gap to the theoretical sampling limit of HRMC.

2602.02566.tldr: The results suggest that the situation around bias in predictive policing is more complex than was previously assumed and demonstrates a methodology for city-specific evaluation and behavioral-tendency comparison of predictive policing systems, showing how such simulations can reveal inequities and long-term tendencies.

2602.02567.tldr: IceBench-S2S is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating DL approaches in mitigating the challenge of forecasting Arctic sea ice concentration in successive 180-day periods, and proposes a generalized framework that first compresses spatial features of daily sea ice data into a deep latent space.

2602.02569.tldr: DECEIVE-AFC is proposed, an agent-based adversarial attack framework that integrates novel claim-level attack strategies and adversarial claim validity evaluation principles that systematically explores adversarial attack trajectories that disrupt search behavior, evidence retrieval, and LLM-based reasoning without relying on access to evidence sources or model internals.

2602.02571.tldr: The key idea of EMF is to replace the trajectory consistency constraint with a principled linear surrogate that enables direct data supervision for long-horizon flow-map compositions, and derive this approximation from the semigroup formulation of flow-based models and show that it faithfully approximates the original consistency objective while being substantially easier to optimize.

2602.02572.tldr: This work formalizes this reward model optimization problem as a Stackelberg game, and shows that a simple reward shaping scheme can effectively approximate the optimal reward model.

2602.02573.tldr: An algebraic formalism in which neural network layers are constructed from compositions of a multiplication operator defined over suitable algebras is introduced, finding that algebraic expressions in modern neural networks admit a unified construction in terms of linear, quadratic, and higher-order product interactions.

2602.02581.tldr: QuantLRM is introduced, which stands for weight quantization of LRMs via fine-tuning signals, and empirically finds that QuantLRM delivers a consistent improvement for LRMs quantization, with an average improvement of 6.55% on a reinforcement learning fine-tuned model.

2602.02582.tldr: A novel uncertainty-aware evaluation methodology for RecLLMs is proposed, empirical insights from deep uncertainty case studies are presented, and a personality profile-informed fairness benchmark is introduced that advances explainability and equity in LLM recommendations.

2602.02584.tldr: This work presents Constitutional Spec-Driven Development, a methodology that embeds non-negotiable security principles into the specification layer, ensuring AI-generated code adheres to security requirements by construction rather than inspection, and empirical evidence that proactive security specification outperforms reactive security verification in AI-assisted development workflows.

2602.02585.tldr: An agentic observability framework deployed within Adobe's e-commerce infrastructure that autonomously performs alert triage using a ReAct paradigm is presented, showing an order-of-magnitude reduction in triage latency and a step-change in resolution accuracy.

2602.02589.tldr: PeerRank is introduced, a fully autonomous end-to-end evaluation framework in which models generate evaluation tasks, answer them with category-scoped live web grounding, judge peer responses and aggregate dense peer assessments into relative performance estimates, without human supervision or gold references.

2602.02591.tldr: A novel task-Scene-Aware Visually-Driven Speech Synthesis, aimed at addressing the limitations of existing speech generation models in creating immersive auditory experiences that align with the real physical world, is introduced and defined.

2602.02592.tldr: Four learnable Koopman variants-scalar-gated, per-mode gated, MLP-shaped spectral mapping, and low-rank Koopman operators which generalize and interpolate between strictly stable Koopman operators and unconstrained linear latent dynamics are introduced.

2602.02593.tldr: A unified framework that abstracts general learning tasks as the progressive coverage of patterns from a long-tail (Zipfian) distribution is proposed, and the Effective Frontier is introduced, a threshold in the pattern rank space that separates learned knowledge from the unlearned tail.

2602.02595.tldr: It is argued that AI-agent-driven cyber attacks are inevitable, requiring a fundamental shift in defensive strategy and why existing defenses cannot stop adaptive adversaries and that defenders must develop offensive security intelligence.

2602.02597.tldr: ContextEvolve is introduced, a multi-agent framework that achieves RL-level search efficiency under strict parameter-blind constraints by decomposing optimization context into three orthogonal dimensions and forms a functional isomorphism with RL-mapping to state representation, policy gradient, and experience replay-enabling principled optimization in a textual latent space.

2602.02598.tldr: While Anchoring Agents successfully boosted local cooperation rates, cognitive decomposition and transfer tests revealed that this effect was driven by strategic compliance and cognitive offloading rather than genuine norm internalization, highlighting a critical gap between behavioral modification and authentic value alignment in artificial societies.

2602.02601.tldr: Overall, CaST demonstrates that integrating spatio-temporal reasoning into event graphs enables more robust and interpretable causal discovery in disaster-related social media text.

2602.02604.tldr: An iterative framework for economic measurement that leverages large language models to extract measurement structure directly from survey instruments and identifies which semantic components contain behavioral signal and clarifies the economic mechanisms that matter for retirement choices is developed.

2602.02605.tldr: This study proposes a framework to measure metacognitive ability using a dual-prompt method, followed by the introduction of Evolution Strategy for Metacognitive Alignment (ESMA) to bind a model's internal knowledge to its explicit behaviors.

2602.02606.tldr: The findings suggest that, even in the absence of bodies, cultural entraining of gender performance leads to gender-based sorting, which has important implications for LLM applications in synthetic hybrid populations, social simulations, and decision support.

2602.02611.tldr: This work introduces an unsupervised approach for constructing a global reference system by learning tangent vector fields that span the tangent spaces of an unknown data manifold and proves that minimizing the proposed objective recovers a global coordinate chart when one exists.

2602.02615.tldr: TinyGuard is a lightweight Byzantine defense that augments the standard FedAvg algorithm via statistical update f ingerprinting, which is architecture-agnostic and well-suited for federated fine-tuning of foundation models where traditional Byzantine defenses become impractical.

2602.02618.tldr: A key contribution is a KDE + HDR (highest-density region) containment score that measures how much a discovered cluster distribution is contained within, or contains, each known-class distribution; the best-match containment score serves as an interpretable novelty statistic.

2602.02623.tldr: This work tackles the learning of consistent causal abstraction network (CAN), a sheaf-theoretic framework where SCMs are Gaussian, and an efficient search procedure is proposed, solving the local problems with SPECTRAL, the iterative method with closed-form updates and suitable for positive definite and semidefinite covariance matrices.

2602.02624.tldr: The results show that the platform's recommender system produces a spatial ordering of users that is highly correlated with their Left-Right positions, and that cannot be explained by socio-demographic attributes, which opens new possibilities for studying the interaction between human and AI systems.

2602.02629.tldr: A Trustworthy Blockchain-based Federated Learning (TBFL) framework integrating Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) standards that provides a secure, scalable, and economically viable ecosystem for inter-institutional health data collaboration, with total operational costs of approximately $18 for 100 training rounds across multiple institutions.

2602.02630.tldr: TRAILDREAMS, a framework that uses a large language model (LLM) to automate the production of movie trailers, demonstrates significant promise and marks an advancement in automated creative processes, but further improvements are necessary to bridge the quality gap with traditional trailers.

2602.02632.tldr: A systematic approach is proposed for selecting the appropriate pretraining technique to achieve high training performance/lower execution time as well as to reduce the number of GPUs used.

2602.02636.tldr: This work introduces WideSeek, a dynamic hierarchical multi-agent architecture that can autonomously fork parallel sub-agents based on task requirements and designs a unified training framework that linearizes multi-agent trajectories and optimizes the system using end-to-end RL.

2602.02639.tldr: Normalized Simulatability Gain (NSG) is introduced, a general and scalable metric based on the idea that a faithful explanation should allow an observer to learn a model's decision-making criteria, and thus better predict its behavior on related inputs.

2602.02641.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark of LLMs under a unified zero-shot and few-shot prompting framework is presented and few-shot prompting improves performance across multiple LLMs, and it is concluded few-shot prompting improves performance across multiple LLMs.

2602.02671.tldr: Modular Angular-Radial Attention (MARA), a module that extends spherical attention to the molecular domain and SE(3), providing an efficient approximation of equivariant interactions, is introduced.

2602.02686.tldr: By enforcing monotonicity selectively in the feed-forward sublayers of sequence-to-sequence Transformers -- while leaving attention mechanisms unconstrained -- it is obtained monotone language models that preserve the performance of their pretrained counterparts.

2602.02689.tldr: Experiments show that well-engineered k-coloring instances can resist the considered classical and learning-based cryptanalytic approaches, suggesting that well-engineered k-coloring instances can resist the considered classical and learning-based cryptanalytic approaches.

2602.02699.tldr: This work proposes sparsely supervised learning for diffusion models, a simple yet effective masking strategy that can be implemented with only a few lines of code and shows that it is safe to mask up to 98\% of pixels during diffusion model training.

2602.02707.tldr: A fine-grained theoretical tradeoff between expressivity and precision is demonstrated, and it is proved that a one-layer softmax Transformer can compute {\Gamma}, with p bits of precision, but not with p-1 bits of precision.

2602.02708.tldr: BinaryPPO is introduced, an offline reinforcement learning large language model (LLM) framework that reformulates binary classification as a reward maximization problem that leverages a variant of Proximal Policy Optimization with a confidence-weighted reward function that penalizes uncertain or incorrect predictions.

2602.02711.tldr: This work proposes a dynamic mix-precision routing framework that adaptively selects between high-precision and low-precision LLMs at each decision step, and achieves a great improvement on accuracy-cost trade-off over single-precision baselines and heuristic routing methods.

2602.02727.tldr: Search-Augmented Masked Diffusion is introduced, a training-free neurosymbolic inference framework that integrates informed search directly into the reverse denoising process and substantially improves constraint satisfaction and property adherence, while consistently outperforming discrete diffusion and autoregressive baselines.

2602.02729.tldr: CAPS (Clock-weighted Aggregation with Prefix-products and Softmax), a structured attention mechanism for time series forecasting that decouples three distinct temporal structures: global trends, local shocks, and seasonal patterns, is presented.

2602.02731.tldr: It is demonstrated that longitudinal, socially informed EHR modeling concentrates homelessness risk into actionable strata, enabling targeted and data-informed prevention strategies for at-risk veterans.

2602.02738.tldr: Noise injection experiment is introduced, where controlled noise signal of varying lengths are injected into musical contexts, and it is hypothesized that a model's loss reacting positively to these perturbations, specifically a sharp increase for short injection, can serve as a proxy for its ability to discern musical integrity.

2602.02739.tldr: TopoPrune is an exceptionally robust to noise perturbations of latent feature embeddings and demonstrates superior transferability across diverse network architectures, demonstrating a promising avenue towards stable and principled topology-based frameworks for robust data-efficient learning.

2602.02751.tldr: It is empirically show that small agents' performance fails to scale with task complexity on deep search and coding tasks, and Strategy Auctions for Workload Efficiency (SALE), an agent framework inspired by freelancer marketplaces, is introduced, suggesting that while small agents may be insufficient for complex workloads, they can be effectively scaled up.

2602.02767.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive theoretical framework for analyzing full data-replay training in continual learning from a feature learning perspective and uncovers a novel insight into task ordering: prioritizing higher-signal tasks not only facilitates learning of lower-signal tasks but also helps prevent catastrophic forgetting.

2602.02781.tldr: A systematic adversarial evaluation of CAN IDS using the ROAD dataset, comparing four shallow learning models with a deep neural network-based detector demonstrates improved robustness to missed-attack induction compared to the other models.

2602.02784.tldr: Results indicate that CTAF is a strong step toward label-efficient, generalizable EEG-peripheral fusion under temporal asynchrony, and it is competitive with the baseline on three-bin accuracy and macro-F1 while using few labels.

2602.02788.tldr: General-Geometry Neural Whitney Forms (Geo-NeW): a data-driven finite element method that jointly learns a differential operator and compatible reduced finite element spaces defined on the underlying geometry, providing a powerful inductive bias for learning neural PDEs.

2602.02790.tldr: Sensonaut is presented, a computational model of embodied audiovisual search that reproduces both adaptive scaling of search time and effort under task complexity, occlusion, and distraction, and characteristic human errors.

2602.02793.tldr: It is shown that Jacobian-vector products (JVPs) provide a practical lens on dependency structure in the generated features and derived closed-form expressions for the optimal drift and its Jacobian in Gaussian and mixture-of-Gaussian settings, revealing that even globally nonlinear flows admit local affine structure.

2602.02799.tldr: This work proposes a novel method, which it calls AgentOWL (Option and World model Learning Agent), that jointly learns an abstract world model and a set of hierarchical neural options, and shows that this method can learn more skills using much less data than baseline methods.

2602.02808.tldr: The proposed Landmark Point Transformer (LmPT), a method for automatic anatomical landmark detection on point clouds that can leverage homologous bones from different species for translational research, is proposed.

2602.02820.tldr: This work establishes CNM as a practical and efficient approach for high-quality vector generation, with potential for broader applications, by aligning the model's inputs with the data's continuous nature.

2602.02842.tldr: The analysis reveals that problem-specific mode selection is crucial, with computational mode achieving 81.2% accuracy when correctly applied to mathematical problems, while misrouting leads to 0% accuracy.

2602.02847.tldr: This work develops a novel causal offline RL objective that optimizes policies'worst-case performance that may arise due to confounding biases, and introduces a practical implementation that learns expressive flow-matching policies from confounded demonstrations.

2602.02849.tldr: This work proposes AutoSizer, a reflective LLM-driven meta-optimization framework that unifies circuit understanding, adaptive search-space construction, and optimization orchestration in a closed loop, and achieves higher solution quality, faster convergence, and higher success rate across varying circuit difficulties, outperforming both traditional optimization methods and existing LLM-based agents.

2602.02862.tldr: STEER is demonstrated as a safety-preserving paradigm for risk control, capable of steering behavior without compromising domain competence, and achieves broader behavioral coverage compared to temperature-based sampling and static persona ensembles.

2602.02863.tldr: A simple instability signal that combines consecutive-step distributional shift (JSD) and uncertainty (entropy), summarize each trace by its peak instability strength, and show that this signal reliably predicts failure is presented as a diagnostic lens rather than a corrective or control mechanism.

2602.02881.tldr: This vision paper outlines a hybrid framework combining large language models with graph-based representations to enable scalable semantic matching and principled reuse of verification artifacts, and points toward verification ecosystems that evolve systematically, leveraging past verification efforts to accelerate future assurance.

2602.02886.tldr: A framework that generalizes existing CBMs along two dimensions: the number of experts and the functional form of each expert, exposing an underexplored region of the design space and demonstrating a robust framework for navigating the accuracy-interpretability trade-off.

2602.02888.tldr: A lightweight hallucination detector that leverages only the top-20 token log-probabilities from LLM generations as a time series, providing an extremely efficient alternative to large encoders and establishing an effective framework for hallucination detection across diverse LLM capabilities.

2602.02898.tldr: This work proposes BenchAlign, the first solution to benchmark alignment, which learns preference-aligned weight-aligned weight-aligned weight for benchmark questions using the question-level performance of language models alongside ranked pairs of models that could be collected during deployment, producing new benchmarks that rank previously unseen models according to these preferences.

2602.02900.tldr: Manifold-Constrained Energy-based Transition Models (MC-ETM), which train conditional energy-based transition models using a manifold projection--diffusion negative sampler, improves multi-step dynamics fidelity and yields higher normalized returns on standard offline control benchmarks, particularly under irregular dynamics and sparse data coverage.

2602.02903.tldr: This work introduces MADT (Multi-Agent Decision Transformer), a novel approach that reformulates multi-agent traffic signal control as a sequence modeling problem that enables offline learning from historical traffic data, with architecture design that facilitates potential online fine-tuning.

2602.02905.tldr: The results show that full-cycle scientific research remains challenging for current agent systems: even the strongest agents achieve limited rediscovery success, exhibit high variance across runs, and display recurring failure modes in experimental design, execution, and evidence-based reasoning.

2602.02908.tldr: A random matrix theory (RMT) framework that quantifies how finite datasets shape the expectation and variance of the learned denoiser and sampling map in the linear setting, and sharply predicts the behavior of linear diffusion models.

2602.02909.tldr: This work addresses a fundamental theoretical question: how many reasoning tokens are required to solve a problem as input size grows, and proves lower bounds on the CoT tokens required for three canonical BAPO-hard tasks: binary majority, triplet matching, and graph reachability.

2602.02912.tldr: This work studies the special case where a KL-regularized soft update is exactly a Bayesian posterior inside a single fixed probabilistic model, so the update variable is a genuine channel through which information is transmitted.

2602.02919.tldr: DeltaEvolve is proposed, a momentum-driven evolutionary framework that replaces full-code history with structured semantic delta capturing how and why modifications between successive nodes affect performance.

2602.02925.tldr: This work establishes a robust, efficient, and statistically validated framework for anomaly detection that is particularly suited to cybersecurity applications such as APT detection.

2602.02932.tldr: Results show that fairness disparities can persist at the interaction level even when access is equal, motivating evaluation beyond refusal-based audits.

2602.02951.tldr: A two-stage token pruning framework that enables efficient feature aggregation while maintaining spatial integrity is proposed that achieves SOTA performance on multiple VQA benchmarks and yields substantial improvements on visual grounding tasks.

2602.02952.tldr: UAT-LITE is proposed, an inference-time framework that makes self-attention uncertainty-aware via Monte Carlo dropout in pretrained transformer classifiers via Monte Carlo dropout in pretrained transformer classifiers, enabling uncertainty-aware routing during contextualization and token-level diagnostic signals beyond global logit rescaling.

2602.02955.tldr: For medical audio classification, synthetic augmentation may not consistently enhance performance when applied to a standard CNN classifier, and future work should focus on delineating task-specific data characteristics, model-augmentation compatibility, and evaluation frameworks necessary for synthetic augmentation to be effective in medical audio applications.

2602.02960.tldr: EAGLE, an iterative generalist-specialist distillation framework that produces a single unified policy that controls multiple heterogeneous humanoids without per-robot reward tuning, is introduced, marking a step toward scalable, fleet-level humanoid control.

2602.02975.tldr: SNIC (Situated Norms in Context), a human-validated diagnostic testbed designed to probe how well state-of-the-art LLMs can extract and utilize normative principles relevant to NBRR, is introduced.

2602.02977.tldr: CAFT (Cross-domain Alignment of Forests and Trees), a hierarchical image-text representation learning framework that aligns global and local semantics across images and long captions without pixel-level supervision, is proposed.

2602.02978.tldr: A novel view of RL through the lens of order theory and recast value function estimates into learning a desired poset (partially ordered set) is taken, which computes a sequence of super-poset refinements thus ensuring geometric coherence across the sequence of posets underpinning the learned value functions.

2602.02983.tldr: It is found that a small interpretable model compresses LLMs'causal judgments well and that most LLMs exhibit more rule-like reasoning strategies than humans who seem to account for unmentioned latent factors in their probability judgments, but most LLMs do not mirror the characteristic human collider biases of weak explaining away and Markov violations.

2602.02988.tldr: A calibration-free, dynamic-programming-optimal, and hardware-friendly framework called Non-uniform Linear Interpolation (NLI), capable of efficiently approximating a variety of nonlinear functions, enabling seamless integration into LLMs and other deep neural networks with almost no loss in accuracy.

2602.02991.tldr: A Bayesian account for this gap is proposed by grounding planning behavior in the evolving generative context: given the subtle differences between natural language and the language internalized by LLMs, accumulated self-generated context drives a planning-shift during inference and thereby creates the appearance of compromised planning behavior.

2602.02995.tldr: Agent Alpha is introduced, a unified framework that synergizes generation, exploration, and evaluation through step-level Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and enables active modeling or exploiting structures of the planning space.

2602.03001.tldr: This work derives gradient noise scales for signSGD and specSGD that naturally emerge from the geometry of their respective dual norms that enable them to match the validation loss of constant-batch baselines while reducing training steps by up to 66% for Signum and Muon on a 160 million parameter Llama model.

2602.03004.tldr: The proposed causal graph spatial-temporal autoencoder enables effective process monitoring and fault detection through two statistics in the feature space and residual space and leverages a reverse perspective of causal invariance principle to uncover the invariant causal graph from varying correlations.

2602.03006.tldr: Graph of Concept Predictors (GCP), a reasoning-aware active distillation framework that externalizes the teacher's decision process as a directed acyclic graph and mirrors it with modular concept predictors in the student, is proposed.

2602.03007.tldr: VOILA consistently achieves 50-60% cost reductions while retaining 90-95% of full-resolution accuracy across diverse query types and model architectures, demonstrating that pre-retrieval fidelity selection is vital to optimize multimodal inference under resource constraints.

2602.03012.tldr: CVE-Factory is presented, the first multi-agent framework to achieve expert-level quality in automatically transforming sparse CVE metadata into fully executable agentic tasks, and synthesize over 1,000 executable training environments, the first large-scale scaling of agentic tasks in code security.

2602.03019.tldr: FedKRSO (Federated $K$-Seed Random Subspace Optimization) is proposed, a novel method that enables communication and memory efficient FFT of LLMs in federated settings and can substantially reduce communication and memory overhead while overcoming the performance limitations of PEFT.

2602.03024.tldr: This work introduces the Consistency Deep Equilibrium Model (C-DEQ), a novel framework that leverages consistency distillation to accelerate DEQ inference and facilitates multi-step evaluation to flexibly trade computation for performance gains.

2602.03025.tldr: RC-GRPO (Reward-Conditioned Group Relative Policy Optimization) is proposed, which treats exploration as a controllable steering problem via discrete reward tokens and yields consistently improved performance than baselines, and the performance on Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct even surpasses all closed-source API models.

2602.03026.tldr: MAS4TS, a tool-driven multi-agent system for general time series tasks, built upon an Analyzer-Reasoner-Executor paradigm that integrates agent communication, visual reasoning, and latent reconstruction within a unified framework, is proposed.

2602.03038.tldr: This work uses LLMs to generate parameterized programmatic representations for a hypothesized solution rule for a Bongard problem, and leverages them to generate parameterized programmatic representations for the rule and perform parameter fitting using Bayesian optimization.

2602.03043.tldr: SAFE-KD is introduced, a universal multi-exit wrapper for modern vision backbones that couples hierarchical distillation with conformal risk control and yields improved accuracy compute trade-offs, stronger calibration, and robust performance under corruption while providing finite-sample risk guarantees.

2602.03053.tldr: It is found that process-level verification does not consistently improve performance and frequently exhibits high variance, highlighting the difficulty of reliably evaluating partial multi-agent trajectories.

2602.03054.tldr: This work conducted a 14-week workshop with a multidisciplinary team of 22 participants, centered around how embodied AI can reduce non-value-added task burdens in three healthcare settings, and proposed eight guidelines for co-designing more considerate embodied AI.

2602.03061.tldr: A semiparametric estimator based on the efficient influence function (EIF) for the setting where auxiliary reasoning chains are observed achieves the semiparametric efficiency bound, guarantees strict variance reduction over naive sample averaging, and admits asymptotic normality for principled uncertainty quantification.

2602.03064.tldr: JRDB-Pose3D inherits all available annotations from the JRDB dataset, such as 2D pose, information about social grouping, activities, and interactions, full-scene semantic masks with consistent human- and object-level tracking, and detailed annotations for each individual, making it a holistic dataset for a wide range of downstream perception and human-centric understanding tasks.

2602.03066.tldr: It is found that shortcut features correspond to features with larger eigenvalues when the shortcuts stem from the imbalanced number of samples in the clustered distribution, which shows that the max-margin bias is not the only major reason for shortcut learning.

2602.03085.tldr: This work develops a scalable backdoor scanning methodology that assumes no prior knowledge of the trigger or target behavior and requires only inference operations, and shows that the method recovers working triggers across multiple backdoor scenarios and a broad range of models and fine-tuning methods.

2602.03087.tldr: This project designed a two-stage end-to-end end-to-end deep reinforcement learning (RL) approach to optimize both navigation and locomotion and how end-to-end RL methods can enable quadrupeds to adapt to different stair shapes.

2602.03096.tldr: PRISM is an optimizer that enhances first-order spectral descent methods like Muon with partial second-order information via innovation-augmented polar decomposition, and demonstrates a practical strategy for integrating curvature-adaptive properties into the spectral optimization paradigm.

2602.03097.tldr: This work proposes JobRec, a generative job recommendation framework for de-conflating preference and qualification via constrained dual-perspective reasoning, and introduces a Unified Semantic Alignment Schema that aligns candidate and job attributes into structured semantic layers.

2602.03100.tldr: Risky-Bench organizes evaluation around domain-agnostic safety principles to derive context-aware safety rubrics that delineate safety space, and systematically evaluates safety risks across this space through realistic task execution under varying threat assumptions.

2602.03103.tldr: The Task--Specificity Score (TSS) is proposed to quantify how much an instruction matters for predicting its output, by contrasting the true instruction against plausible alternatives for the same input.

2405.02162.tldr: The proposed UPPM advances open-world scene understanding by leveraging foundation models to introduce a panoptic Dynamic Descriptor that reconciles open-vocabulary labels with unified category structure and geometric size priors, resulting in a persistent and promptable panoptic map without additional model training.

2405.09125.tldr: The Hierarchical Attention autoregressive Model with Adaptive Permutation (HAAP) is proposed to enhance position-context-image interaction capability, improving autoregressive LM generalization and Implicit Permutation Neurons (IPN) is proposed to generate adaptive attention masks that dynamically exploit token dependencies, enhancing the correlation between visual information and context.

2407.03094.tldr: This work is the first to propose conformal prediction for continuous treatments when the propensity score is unknown and must be estimated from data, and derives finite-sample prediction intervals for potential outcomes of continuous treatments.

2409.00592.tldr: The so-called Hyper-Compression is proposed, a novel mechanism for model compression that turns the model compression into the issue of parameter representation via a hyperfunction, substantially different from the existing pruning, quantization, distillation, and decomposition.

2410.04779.tldr: It is shown that by simply multiplying each weight (except for the last layer) by a constant, it can accelerate SNF training by 10$\times and consistently provides a significant speedup over various data domains, allowing the SNFs to train faster than more recently proposed architectures.

2410.23222.tldr: This work introduces the concept of partial channel dependence (PCD) to enhance CD modeling in Transformer-based models by leveraging dataset-specific information to refine the CD captured by the model and validate the effectiveness of PCD across diverse tasks and datasets with various backbones.

2501.02770.tldr: A novel two-level multi-agent pathfinding framework that integrates two techniques: adaptive path expansion to expand agent paths to their goals in multiple stages; and dynamic leading technique that enables the reselection of the leading agent during each agent path expansion whenever progress cannot be made.

2502.18179.tldr: Overall, it is demonstrated that, if well-configured, general-purpose LLMs match the performance of specialized models, providing a cost-effective, finetuning-free alternative.

2503.17089.tldr: It is found that bias can be mitigated using oversampling, significantly improving performance for the underrepresented Black subjects whilst not significantly reducing the majority White subjects’ performance.

2503.17736.tldr: V2P-Bench is proposed, a robust and comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the ability of LVLMs to understand Video Visual Prompts in human model interaction scenarios, and is expected to serve as a foundational tool for advancing human model interaction and improving the evaluation of video understanding.
