2503.22782.tldr: Patronus is proposed, an interpretable diffusion model that incorporates a prototypical network to encode semantics in visual patches, revealing what visual patterns are modeled and where and when they emerge throughout denoising.

2505.04638.tldr: ARIEL (AI Research Assistant for Expert-in-the-Loop Learning), an open-source evaluation and optimization framework that pairs a curated multimodal biomedical corpus with expert-vetted tasks to probe two capabilities: full-length article summarization and fine-grained figure interpretation, is introduced.

2505.13102.tldr: A lightweight and interpretable transformer-like neural net is built by unrolling a mixed-graph-based optimization algorithm to forecast traffic with spatial and temporal dimensions by designing an iterative algorithm based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), and unroll it into a feed-forward network for data-driven parameter learning.

2505.13696.tldr: The Episodic Spatial World Model (ESWM), a novel framework that constructs spatial maps from sparse, disjoint episodic memories, is introduced, demonstrating how neuroscience-inspired principles of episodic memory can advance the development of more flexible and generalizable world models.

2505.14661.tldr: Abacus is presented, an extensible, cost-based optimizer which searches for the best implementation of a semantic operator system given a (possibly constrained) optimization objective and estimates operator performance by leveraging a minimal set of validation examples, prior beliefs about operator performance, and/or an LLM judge.

2505.17813.tldr: This work challenges the assumption that long thinking chains results in better reasoning capabilities and suggests short-m@k, a novel reasoning LLM inference method, which executes k independent generations in parallel and halts computation once the first m thinking processes are done.

2505.17961.tldr: This work estimates the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) from decentralized observational data via a Federated Learning (FL) approach, allowing inference through the exchange of aggregate statistics rather than individual-level data, and proposes a novel method to estimate propensity scores via a federated weighted average of local scores using Membership Weights.

2506.04536.tldr: NoBLE is the first scaled-up deep learning framework that validates its generalization with real experimental data and captures fundamental neural properties in a unique and emergent manner that opens the door to a better understanding of cellular composition and computations, neuromorphic architectures, large-scale brain circuits, and general neuroAI applications.

2506.18751.tldr: This work investigates the sensitivity of image classification models used for predictive quality by modeling the distributional domain shifts of inputs with random variables and quantifying their impact on the model's outputs using Sobol indices computed via generalized polynomial chaos (GPC).

2506.18939.tldr: Damba-ST is proposed, a novel domain-adaptive Mamba-based model for efficient urban spatio-temporal prediction that retains Mamba's linear complexity advantage while significantly enhancing its adaptability to heterogeneous domains.

2507.04075.tldr: EMERALD (Efficient MaskEd latent tRAnsformer worLD model), a world model using a spatial latent state with MaskGIT predictions to generate accurate trajectories in latent space and improve the agent performance is introduced.

2507.21129.tldr: A task-agnostic method that builds a quantitative Cognitive Profile for any model, built around the Entropy Decay Curve, and proposes the Information Gain Span (IGS) as a single index that summarises the desirability of a decay pattern.

2507.23440.tldr: Inspired by hierarchical human visual perception, Self-Foveate introduces a multi-level foveation methodology that guides the extraction of textual information at three complementary granularities, from fine-grained details through cross-region connections to holistic patterns, thereby enhancing both the diversity and difficulty of synthesized instructions.

2508.04136.tldr: UniFGVC is introduced, a universal training-free framework that reformulates few-shot FGVC as multimodal retrieval and ensures broad compatibility with diverse MLLMs and encoders, offering reliable generalization and adaptability across few-shot FGVC scenarios.

2508.06577.tldr: This work proposes a privacy-preserving approach to predict which proposals are likely to be funded, using only projects'textual descriptions and anonymous historical voting records, without relying on voter demographics or personally identifiable information.

2508.07180.tldr: A new benchmark construction philosophy, Dual Scaling, designed to systematically address both limitations of code-generating Large Language Models and systematically scaling the rigor of tests via automated, high-coverage Property-Based Testing (PBT).

2508.07468.tldr: This work proposes CP-Agent, a Python coding agent that uses the ReAct framework with a persistent IPython kernel to explore the effectiveness of agentic workflows and shows that minimal guidance outperforms detailed procedural scaffolding.

2508.09131.tldr: This work presents ColorCtrl, a training-free color editing method that leverages the attention mechanisms of modern Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiT) and enables accurate and consistent color editing, along with word-level control of attribute intensity.

2509.05356.tldr: It is demonstrated that fully spiking architectures can be trained end-to-end to control robotic arms with multiple degrees of freedom in continuous environments, and this predictive-control framework combines Leaky Integrate-and-Fire dynamics with surrogate gradients.

2509.11206.tldr: Functional fragmentation is proposed, a method that dissects each output into key fragments and interprets the rhetoric functions that each fragment serves relative to evaluation criteria -- surfacing the elements of interest and revealing how they fulfill or hinder user goals.

2509.11361.tldr: MAPGD (Multi-Agent Prompt Gradient Descent), a novel framework that reconceptualizes prompt optimization as a collaborative process among specialized agents, is proposed as a unified, gradient-based, and interpretable framework for robust prompt optimization with theoretical convergence guarantees.

2509.14863.tldr: This work proposes G2LFormer, featuring a novel global-to-local attention scheme where the shallow network layers use attention mechanisms to capture global information, while the deeper layers employ GNN modules to learn local structural information, thereby preventing nodes from ignoring their immediate neighbors.

2509.19354.tldr: GeoResponder is introduced, a framework that instills robust spatial reasoning through a scaffolded instruction-tuning curriculum and suggests that LLMs can begin to internalize and generalize geospatial structures, pointing toward the future development of language models capable of supporting disaster response needs.

2509.23286.tldr: A2D (Any-Order, Any-Step Defense), a token-level alignment method that aligns dLLMs to emit an [EOS] refusal signal whenever harmful content arises, achieves robustness to both any-decoding-order and any-step prefilling attacks under various conditions.

2510.00845.tldr: This work argues that circuit discovery is not a standalone task but a statistical estimation problem built upon causal mediation analysis (CMA), and uncovers a fundamental instability at this base layer: exact, single-input CMA scores exhibit high intrinsic variance.

2510.07707.tldr: CADET is proposed, a causal representation learning framework that disentangles hate speech into interpretable latent factors and then controls confounders, thereby isolating genuine hate intent from superficial linguistic cues.

2510.10915.tldr: A Conditional Variational AutoEncoder with Long-term dependency and Probabilistic time-frequency fusion, named LPCVAE, which incorporates a Product-of-Experts (PoE) mechanism for adaptive and distribution-level probabilistic fusion and effectively mitigates time-frequency information loss.

2510.11129.tldr: Video-SALMONN S, a memory-enhanced streaming audio-visual large language model that processes over 3-hour videos at 1 FPS and 360p resolution, outperforming strong non-streaming models under the same memory budget is introduced, demonstrating strong learning abilities from video memory.

2510.13847.tldr: DynaSpec is proposed, a context-dependent dynamic shortlisting mechanism for large-vocabulary speculative decoding that consistently improves mean accepted length-recovering performance and achieves up to a 2.23x throughput gain compared to 1.91x for static approaches on the dataset with rare tokens.

2510.16004.tldr: This work argues, that a critical property of neural twins is their ability to remain on-trajectory, i.e., to stay close to the true system state over time, and introduces Parallel-in-time Neural Twins (PAINT), an architecture-agnostic family of methods for modeling dynamical systems from measurements.

2510.22124.tldr: This work first model MU as a constrained optimization problem, that is, optimizing the unlearning objective under the constraint of a bounded increase for utility loss, and shows that solving this optimization problem is equivalent to unilateral gradient surgery on the unlearning objective.

2510.26418.tldr: It is found that refusal depends on a low-dimensional safety signal that becomes diluted as reasoning grows: mid-layers encode the strength of safety checking, while late layers encode the refusal outcome, demonstrating that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning introduces a systematic vulnerability when combined with answer-prompting cues.

2511.18793.tldr: NEZHA is a novel architecture that achieves hyperspeed decoding for GR systems without sacrificing recommendation quality, and introduces an efficient, model-free verifier based on a hash set to tackle the critical problem of hallucination.

2511.22254.tldr: This work proposes a co-evolving agents framework in which a target agent improves jointly with an auxiliary failure agent, thereby generating hard negatives that are close to success yet remain failures and demonstrates that failures can be systematically transformed into structured and valuable learning signals in self-improving agents.

2512.00242.tldr: PolyNSD enforces stability via convex mixtures, spectral rescaling, and residual/gated paths, reaching new state-of-the-art results on both homophilic and heterophilic benchmarks, inverting the Neural Sheaf Diffusion trend by obtaining these results with just diagonal restriction maps, decoupling performance from large stalk dimension, while reducing runtime and memory requirements.

2512.04123.tldr: This study finds that production agents are built using simple, controllable approaches: 68% execute at most 10 steps before human intervention, 70% rely on prompting off-the-shelf models instead of weight tuning, and 74% depend primarily on human evaluation.

2512.06364.tldr: JEEVHITAA is presented, a cross-platform mobile system enabling role-aware sharing and verifiable information flows within permissioned care circles within permissioned care circles, and plans for longitudinal in-the-wild evaluation of access control correctness and credibility support are outlined.

2512.10415.tldr: The first large-scale study of jailbreaking LLM-based automated code evaluators in academic context is presented, finding that these models exhibit significant vulnerability, particularly to persuasive and role-play-based attacks.

2512.11855.tldr: This paper introduces averaging complexity, a framework for quantifying the cost of enforcing symmetry via averaging, and provides the first theoretical separation of exact and approximate symmetry, formally justifying why approximate symmetry may be preferable in practice.

2512.14640.tldr: This work presents the first multicenter lymphoma benchmark, covering four common lymphoma subtypes and healthy control tissue, and systematically evaluates five publicly available pathology foundation models combined with attention-based and transformer-based multiple instance learning aggregators across three magnifications.

2512.21577.tldr: This work argues that hallucination can be unified by defining it as simply inaccurate (internal) world modeling, in a form where it is observable to the user, and outlines plans for a family of benchmarks using synthetic, fully specified reference world models to stress-test and improve world modeling components.

2512.24955.tldr: This work introduces Exponential Stability Labels (ESLs) to categorize training samples and proposes a $\lambda$-weighted aggregation mechanism to learn Lyapunov certificates, and designs a stability-aware advantage function to guide policy optimization, thereby promoting rapid Lyapunov descent and robust state convergence.

2601.02754.tldr: In QGA, a novel Q-value regularized Generative Auto-bidding method, a Q-value regularization with double Q-learning strategy is proposed into the Decision Transformer backbone, allowing the learned bidding policy to both leverage experience from the dataset and alleviate the adverse impact of the suboptimal trajectories.

2601.05083.tldr: The results show that a pure-transformer architecture, combined with targeted token compression, is sufficient for accurate, efficient, and adaptive end-to-end driving.

2601.06172.tldr: This work synthesizes four research traditions to establish a comprehensive framework for understanding how learners psychologically relate to anthropomorphic AI tutors, and identifies three persistent challenges intensified by Generative AI's conversational fluency.

2601.07020.tldr: TurkBench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess the capabilities of generative large language models in the Turkish language and provides researchers and developers with a valuable tool for evaluating their models and identifying areas for improvement.

2601.07182.tldr: This work introduces Process Relative Policy Optimization (PRPO), which combines outcome reliability with process-level guidance in a critic-free framework, and improves Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B accuracy on MATH500 using only eight rollouts and no value network.

2601.07891.tldr: KVzap is introduced, a fast, input-adaptive approximation of KVzip that works in both prefilling and decoding and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the KVpress leaderboard.

2601.08662.tldr: This tutorial is designed to make reinforcement learning more accessible to undergraduate students by offering clear, example-driven explanations, addressing common challenges that students face when transitioning from conceptual understanding to implementation.

2601.08951.tldr: This work introduces PluriHarms, a benchmark designed to systematically study human harm judgments across two key dimensions -- the harm axis (benign to harmful) and the agreement axis (agreement to disagreement).

2601.09719.tldr: Bounded Hyperbolic Tanh (BHyT) is proposed, a drop-in replacement for Pre-LN that prevents depth-wise growth in activation magnitude and variance and comes with a theoretical stability guarantee, and improves stability and efficiency during pretraining.

2601.11544.tldr: This work proposes a system meant to provide medication counseling while juggling these two extremes, with a focus on methods aiming to fulfill conversation requirements, reduce hallucinations and promote high-quality responses.

2601.12539.tldr: The findings suggest that robust meme understanding requires multimodal training, exhibits substantial variation across semantic categories, and remains sensitive to over-specialization when models are fine-tuned on individual datasets rather than trained in a unified setting.

2601.14096.tldr: It is argued that this dual principle - remapping and navigation of embedding spaces via iterative error minimization - constitutes a substrate-independent invariant of cognition, which provides a unifying framework for engineering adaptive intelligence across scales.

2601.16540.tldr: This work systematically examines layer-wise representational alignment between 12 open-source Audio LLMs and Electroencephalogram (EEG) signals across 2 datasets and finds an affective dissociation whereby negative prosody reduces geometric similarity while enhancing covariance-based dependence.

2601.18795.tldr: This work introduces PrefixRL, where it is proved that the PrefixRL objective is not only consistent with the standard RL objective but also more sample efficient, and discovers back-generalization: training only on prefixed problems generalizes to out-of-distribution unprefixed performance.

2601.18930.tldr: This work shows how Predictive State Representations learn POMDP matrices up to a similarity transform, and suggests that explicit observation and transition likelihoods can be leveraged to generate new plans for different goals and reward functions after the model has been learned.

2601.19402.tldr: This work presents PROTEUS (Polymorphic Router for Operational Target Enforcement with Unified SLA), a router that accepts accuracy targets tau as runtime input and uses Lagrangian dual control.

2601.20041.tldr: TONEL employs a noise-aware projection model to learn task-specific embeddings compatible with CiM hardware constraints, enabling accurate retrieval under noisy conditions and improves noise robustness and domain adaptability for RAG in noisy edge environments.

2601.20969.tldr: EPDDL provides a unique PDDL-like representation that captures the entire DEL semantics, enabling uniform specification of epistemic planning tasks and facilitates interoperability, reproducible evaluation, and future advances in epistemic planning.

2601.21494.tldr: PoLR (Path of Least Resistance) is introduced, the first inference-time method to leverage prefix consistency for compute-efficient reasoning, and can serve as a drop-in pre-filter, making SC substantially more efficient and scalable without requiring model fine-tuning.

2601.22513.tldr: This paper provides the first rigorous theoretical guarantees for SRLMs, and reveals that the dependence on the initial model decays exponentially with the number of iterations, providing a formal explanation for why self-rewarding succeeds.

2602.00003.tldr: This work proposes a scalable Coarse-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that leverages the inherent complementarity of distinct open-source LLMs without expensive pre-training and employs an Information-Preserving Concatenation Fusion strategy.

2602.00032.tldr: A systematic audit of eight state-of-the-art T2I models comprising four models developed by Western organizations and four developed by Chinese institutions, all prompted identically reveal persistent demographic and emotion-conditioned biases in all models regardless of their country of origin.

2602.00064.tldr: SPGCL is proposed, a framework for robust GCL via SVD-guided structural perturbation, which outperforms state-of-the-art GCL and structure learning methods, validating its effectiveness in integrating previously disparate paradigms.

2602.00222.tldr: MapDream is proposed, a map-in-the-loop framework that formulates map construction as autoregressive bird's-eye-view (BEV) image synthesis and jointly learns map generation and action prediction, distilling environmental context into a compact three-channel BEV map that preserves only navigation-critical affordances.

2602.00408.tldr: This paper introduces variational inference to the JSSP domain for the first time and derive a probabilistic objective based on the Evidence of Lower Bound (ELBO) with maximum entropy reinforcement learning and significantly enhances training stability and robustness against hyperparameter variations.

2602.00611.tldr: This work proposes Structured Self-Consistency (SSC), an enhanced decoding strategy that leverages multiple sampling with domain-specific voting mechanisms to improve output quality for structured generation tasks.

2602.00710.tldr: This work argues that discrete correctness labels are a lossy view of the model's decision process and fail to capture information encoded in hidden states, and introduces REPCORE, which aligns heterogeneous hidden states into a unified latent space to construct representative coresets.

2602.00755.tldr: Using LLM-driven genetic programming with multi-island evolution with multi-island evolution, constitutions maximizing social welfare without explicit guidance toward cooperation are evolved, demonstrating that cooperative norms can be discovered rather than prescribed.

2602.01155.tldr: Evaluation on a large-scale automotive dataset demonstrates that CAREP can automatically and accurately discover the unknown EP rules, outperforming LLM-only baselines while providing transparent causal explanations.

2602.01355.tldr: This work formalizes entity-level aggregation querying over text in a corpus-bounded setting with strict completeness requirement and proposes DFA (Disambiguation--Filtering--Aggregation), a modular agentic baseline that decomposes aggregation querying into interpretable stages and exposes key failure modes related to ambiguity, filtering, and aggregation.

2602.01601.tldr: VIP, a Variance-Informed Predictive allocation strategy that allocates a given rollout budget to the prompts in the incumbent batch to minimize the expected gradient variance of the policy update, is introduced.

2602.01769.tldr: The proposed IRIS (Implicit Reward-Guided Internal Sifting), which leverages continuous implicit rewards in the native log-probability space to preserve full information density and capture internal modal competition, provides an efficient and principled paradigm for mitigating MLLM hallucinations.

2602.01855.tldr: A novel, data-efficient deep learning framework designed to achieve precise and accurate control using minimal sensor hardware, and offers a robust, cost-effective blueprint for next-generation prosthetic interfaces capable of rapid personalization.

2602.01865.tldr: Generative Ranking for Ads at Baidu (GRAB) is proposed, an end-to-end generative framework for Click-Through Rate (CTR) prediction that demonstrates desirable scaling behavior and shows a monotonic and approximately linear improvement as longer interaction sequences are utilized.

2602.01976.tldr: FlyPrompt is proposed, a brain-inspired framework that decomposes GCL into two subproblems: expert routing and expert competence improvement, and introduces a randomly expanded analytic router for instance-level expert activation and a temporal ensemble of output heads to dynamically adapt decision boundaries over time.

2602.01995.tldr: A conversational diagnosis system that explores a diagnostic knowledge graph to reason in two steps, improving diagnostic accuracy and efficiency over strong baselines, and evaluations by physicians support the realism of the simulator and the clinical utility of the generated questions.

2602.02000.tldr: SurfSplat is presented, a feedforward framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) primitive, which provides stronger anisotropy and higher geometric precision and introduces High-Resolution Rendering Consistency (HRRC), a new evaluation metric designed to evaluate high-resolution reconstruction quality.

2602.02230.tldr: SEDformer is presented, an SED-enhanced Spiking Transformer for telemetry IMTS forecasting that couples a SED-based Spike Encoder, an Event-Preserving Temporal Downsampling module, and a stack of SED-based Spike Transformer blocks enable intra-series dependency modeling with a membrane-based linear attention driven by EA-LIF spiking features.

2602.02313.tldr: Integrated Policy Gradient is proposed, a novel framework that attributes reasoning behaviors to model's inner components by propagating compound outcome-based signals such as post reasoning accuracy backward through model inference trajectories.

2602.02393.tldr: This work introduces a Hierarchical Pose-free Memory Compressor that recursively distills historical latents into a fixed-budget representation, and proposes an Uncertainty-aware Action Labeling module that discretizes continuous motion into a tri-state logic.

2602.02419.tldr: Experimental results show that the uncertainty measure consistently outperforms existing baselines in distinguishing correct from incorrect predictions, while the calibrated threshold reliably enables rigorous risk control and potentials of substantial system-level accuracy improvements.

2602.02488.tldr: RLAnything, a reinforcement learning framework that dynamically forges environment, policy, and reward models through closed-loop optimization, amplifying learning signals and strengthening the overall RL system for any LLM or agentic scenarios, is proposed.

2602.03114.tldr: A notable increase in the perceived relevance of digital learning after the pandemic is revealed, especially among young adults and women, coinciding with the rise of LLM-powered AI tools that support personalized learning.

2602.03120.tldr: QES significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art zeroth-order fine-tuning method on arithmetic reasoning tasks, making direct fine-tuning for quantized models possible, and opens up the possibility for scaling up LLMs entirely in the quantized space.

2602.03123.tldr: EvoAug is presented, an automated augmentation learning pipeline that introduces a novel approach to image augmentation that learns stochastic augmentation trees that hierarchically compose augmentations, enabling more structured and adaptive transformations.

2602.03128.tldr: The results show that framework-level design choices alone can increase latency by over 100x, reduce planning accuracy by up to 30%, and lower coordination success from above 90% to below 30%, and outline promising future research directions.

2602.03132.tldr: This work introduces Contrastive Concept-Tree Search (CCTS), which extracts a hierarchical concept representation from the generated programs and learns a contrastive concept model that guides parent selection and improves search efficiency over fitness-based baselines and produces interpretable, task-specific concept trees across a benchmark of open Erd\H{o}s-type combinatorics problems.

2602.03134.tldr: SwiftVLM is proposed, a simple and training-free method that performs pruning at model-specific layers with strong visual token selection capability, while enabling independent pruning decisions across layers, achieving superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs and more faithful visual token selection behavior.

2602.03143.tldr: Self-hint aligned GRPO with privileged supervision (SAGE), an on-policy reinforcement learning framework that injects privileged hints during training to reshape the rollout distribution under the same terminal verifier reward, is proposed.

2602.03145.tldr: A framework for scalable agentic intelligence, termed the Internet of Agentic AI, in which autonomous, heterogeneous agents distributed across cloud and edge infrastructure dynamically form coalitions to execute task-driven workflows is proposed.

2602.03146.tldr: This work shows that stochastic agents cannot avoid learning their environment through the usage of randomization, and strengthens the result by weakening the notion of generality, proving that less powerful agents already contain a model of the world in which they operate.

2602.03151.tldr: This paper introduces an enhanced diffusion model as a pluggable mid-stage training module to effectively restore missing features in Vision Language Model and introduces two key innovations: Dynamic Modality Gating, which adaptively leverages conditional features to guide the generation of semantically consistent features.

2602.03154.tldr: This paper proposes three strategies: dynamic layout adaptation using user path prediction, content prioritization through reinforcement learning, and a comparative analysis of AI-driven vs. rule-based personalization.

2602.03160.tldr: A scalable infrastructure for evaluating and controlling value intensity, advancing pluralistic alignment of LLMs is established, and asymmetries in steerability and composition laws for multi-value control are identified.

2602.03164.tldr: This work proposes MemCast, a learning-to-memory framework that reformulates TSF as an experience-conditioned reasoning task, and designs a dynamic confidence adaptation strategy that updates the confidence of individual entries without leaking the test set distribution.

2602.03183.tldr: Privasis is presented, the first million-scale fully synthetic dataset entirely built from scratch--an expansive reservoir of texts with rich and diverse private information--designed to broaden and accelerate research in areas where processing sensitive social data is inevitable.

2602.03200.tldr: Hand3R, the first online framework for joint 4D hand-scene reconstruction from monocular video, synergizes a pre-trained hand expert with a 4D scene foundation model via a scene-aware visual prompting mechanism and enables simultaneous reconstruction of accurate hand meshes and dense metric-scale scene geometry in a single forward pass.

2602.03211.tldr: A test-time scaling method that enables sampling from regions with higher human-aligned reward values and reaches the same GenEval performance as the latest gradient guidance method for SDXL with a 9.5x speedup is studied.

2602.03215.tldr: A novel data-driven alternative based on Latent Ordinary Differential Equations (Latent ODEs) for tacrolimus AUC prediction, which demonstrates superior robustness and flexible architecture provides a promising foundation for next-generation, multi-modal models in personalized medicine.

2602.03217.tldr: A hierarchical self-supervised learning framework that jointly learns node-, edge-, and graph-level embeddings, inspired by multimodal neuroimaging is introduced, highlighting the need for new, topology-aware SSL objectives for neuro-AI research that explicitly reward the preservation of structure.

2602.03223.tldr: DAES, an end-to-end framework designed to tackle numerical feature embedding in streaming training scenarios by integrating distributional information with an adaptive modulation mechanism, is proposed and fully deployed on a leading short-video platform.

2602.03224.tldr: TAME is a dual-memory evolutionary framework that separately evolves executor memory to improve task performance by distilling generalizable methodologies, and evaluator memory to refine assessments of both safety and task utility based on historical feedback that preserves trustworthiness without sacrificing utility.

2602.03226.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Task-Aware Compressor (ATACompressor), which dynamically adjusts compression based on the specific requirements of the task, and provides a scalable solution for long-context processing in LLMs.

2602.03238.tldr: It is proposed that a unified evaluation framework is essential for the rigorous advancement of agent evaluation, and a proposal aimed at standardizing agent evaluation is introduced.

2602.03255.tldr: LPS-Bench is presented, a benchmark that evaluates the planning-time safety awareness of MCP-based CUAs under long-horizon tasks, covering both benign and adversarial interactions across 65 scenarios of 7 task domains and 9 risk types.

2602.03257.tldr: The key innovation is the Graph Diffusion Estimator (GraDE), which is the first to introduce graph diffusion models to identify frequent subgraphs by scoring their typicality within the learned distribution, and achieves superior ranking accuracy compared to sampling-based baselines.

2602.03263.tldr: A clear trade-off between reducing over-rejection and maintaining safe, non-discriminatory behavior is observed, suggesting that some apparent safety gains may come from refusal-oriented heuristics rather than robust intent understanding.

2602.03268.tldr: This work proposes a novel detection framework based on Toxicity Association Graphs, which systematically model semantic associations between innocuous entities and latent toxic implications, and introduces the first quantifiable metric for hidden toxicity, the Multimodal Toxicity Covertness (MTC), which measures the degree of concealment in toxic multimodal expressions.

2602.03279.tldr: The Agentic-Proposer-4B is developed, a framework that models problem synthesis as a goal-driven sequential decision process where a specialized agent dynamically selects and composes modular reasoning skills and proves that a small volume of high-quality synthetic signals can effectively substitute for massive human-curated datasets.

2602.03282.tldr: It is suggested that global embedding geometry captures only a partial view of representational competence and functional sensitivity is established as a critical complementary axis for modeling composite structure.

2602.03285.tldr: This work introduces MeetAll, a bilingual and multimodal corpus derived from 231 enterprise meetings totaling 140 hours, and proposes MeetBench XL, a multi dimensional evaluation protocol aligned with human judgment that measures factual fidelity, intent alignment, response efficiency, structural clarity, and completeness.

2602.03295.tldr: Prefill-Only Pruning (POP), a stage-aware inference strategy that safely omits deep layers during the computationally intensive prefill stage while retaining the full model for the sensitive decode stage, is proposed, effectively overcoming the accuracy-efficiency trade-off limitations of existing structured pruning methods.

2602.03300.tldr: Collective Adversarial Data Synthesis (CADS), a novel and general approach to synthesize high-quality, diverse and challenging multimodal data for MLLMs, and introduces an Adversarial Context Optimization mechanism to optimize the generation context to encourage challenging and high-value data generation.

2602.03301.tldr: This work introduces regularization at the level of the projection operator and explicitly construct a regularized projected value iteration (RP-VI), subsequently extending it to a sample-based RL algorithm and provides a rigorous theoretical analysis that proves finite-time convergence guarantees for PRQ under linear function approximation.

2602.03302.tldr: FOCUS automates the image-to-diagnosis pipeline, representing a critical advance towards unmanned ophthalmology with a validated blueprint for autonomous screening to enhance population scale retinal care accessibility and efficiency.

2602.03309.tldr: Entropy Gated Selective Policy Optimization (EGSPO), a three stage framework that extends sample level mixing with token level gradient modulation, achieves consistent improvements on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while incurring only 3.4 percent additional computational overhead.

2602.03310.tldr: RDT2 is introduced, a robotic foundation model built upon a 7B parameter VLM designed to enable zero-shot deployment on novel embodiments for open-vocabulary tasks and becomes one of the first models that simultaneously zero-shot generalizes to unseen objects, scenes, instructions, and even robotic platforms.

2602.03317.tldr: A physics-structured variational autoencoder designed for rapid extraction of voxelwise multi-parameter posterior distributions that is in good agreement with those calculated using a brute-force Bayesian analysis, while providing an orders-of-magnitude acceleration in whole brain quantification.

2602.03320.tldr: This work proposes MedSAM-Agent, a framework that reformulates interactive segmentation as a multi-step autonomous decision-making process, and introduces a hybrid prompting strategy for expert-curated trajectory generation, enabling the model to internalize human-like decision heuristics and adaptive refinement strategies.

2602.03340.tldr: Experiments on MentalDx Bench demonstrate that MentalSeek-Dx achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with only 14B parameters, establishing a clinically grounded framework for reliable psychiatric diagnosis.

2602.03342.tldr: Tiled Prompts is proposed, a unified framework for image and video super-resolution that generates a tile-specific prompt for each latent tile and performs super-resolution under locally text-conditioned posteriors, providing high-information guidance that resolves prompt underspecification with minimal overhead.

2602.03344.tldr: It is shown that as models approach high performance on a task, robustness is effectively achieved, and through an empirical analysis of multiple models across diverse datasets and configurations, a strong positive correlation is found.

2602.03353.tldr: An algorithm is developed that efficiently uncovers causal relationships with quadratic complexity in the number of observational variables, reducing the processing time by up to 25x compared to state-of-the-art methods.

2602.03358.tldr: This work proposes GFlowPO, a probabilistic prompt optimization framework that casts prompt search as a posterior inference problem over latent prompts regularized by a meta-prompted reference-LM prior and consistently outperforms recent discrete prompt optimization baselines.

2602.03359.tldr: MeKi (Memory-based Expert Knowledge Injection), a novel system that scales LLM capacity via storage space rather than FLOPs, validating the effectiveness of memory-based scaling paradigm for on-device LLMs.

2602.03372.tldr: SLIM-Diff is proposed, a compact joint diffusion model whose main contributions are a single shared-bottleneck U-Net that enforces tight coupling between anatomy and lesion geometry from a 2-channel image+mask representation, and loss-geometry tuning via a tunable objective.

2602.03379.tldr: Syntactic diversification is introduced, which paraphrases the original forget queries into heterogeneous structures prior to unlearning, which effectively suppresses benign relearning, accelerates forgetting, and substantially alleviates the trade-off between unlearning efficacy and model utility.

2602.03386.tldr: Under standard theory assumptions it is shown how PPO's policy update scheme can be interpreted as approximated policy gradient ascent and how to control the bias accumulated by the surrogate gradients and use techniques from random reshuffling to prove a convergence theorem for PPO that sheds light on PPO's success.

2602.03387.tldr: This paper introduces a payoff allocation framework based on the least core (LC) concept, which prioritizes the cohesion of the federation by minimizing the maximum dissatisfaction among all potential subgroups, ensuring that no participant has an incentive to break away.

2602.03389.tldr: The Chain-of-Goals Hierarchical Policy (CoGHP) is proposed, a novel framework that reformulates hierarchical decision-making as autoregressive sequence modeling within a unified architecture that consistently outperforms strong offline baselines, demonstrating improved performance on long-horizon tasks.

2602.03392.tldr: A theoretical framework for analyzing the entropy dynamics during the RFT process is established, which begins with a discriminant expression that quantifies entropy change under a single logit update, which can be further extended to the update formula of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

2602.03400.tldr: Experimental results show that ExpSum consistently outperforms all baselines, and LLM-based evaluations indicate that ExpSum-generated summaries better align with developer expectations across other projects, demonstrating its effectiveness for industrial code documentation.

2602.03403.tldr: This work introduces the concept of an intuitionistic fuzzy preference-based conflict situation that captures agents'attitudes towards issue pairs with finer granularity than that afforded by classical preference-based models.

2602.03414.tldr: This work proposes Socratic-Geo, a fully autonomous framework that dynamically couples data synthesis with model learning through multi-agent interaction, and establishes new state-of-the-art for open-source models.

2602.03429.tldr: DiscoverLLM is introduced, a novel and generalizable framework that trains LLMs to help users form and discover their intents and achieves over 10% higher task performance while reducing conversation length by up to 40%.

2602.03439.tldr: This work introduces ontology-to-tools compilation as a proof-of-principle mechanism for coupling large language models (LLMs) with formal domain knowledge and shows how executable ontological semantics can guide LLM behaviour and reduce manual schema and prompt engineering.

2602.03445.tldr: This work introduces CRL-VLA, a framework for continual post-training of VLA models with rigorous theoretical bounds, and derives a unified performance bound linking the stability-plasticity trade-off to goal-conditioned advantage magnitude, scaled by policy divergence.

2602.03448.tldr: Hierarchical Concept-to-Appearance Guidance (CAG) is proposed, a framework that provides explicit, structured supervision from high-level concepts to fine-grained appearances and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the multi-subject image generation, substantially improving prompt following and subject consistency.

2602.03452.tldr: Weighted GRPO is introduced, which reweights binary outcomes at the pair level and uses group-normalized advantages to amplify rare successes on Qwen2.5-Math-7B into sharp positive guidance while turning rare failures on Qwen2.5-Math-7B into strong negative penalties.

2602.03467.tldr: Cognitive experiments show that clustering details significantly improve participants' understanding, while removal of details significantly reduce cognitive effort, supporting the hypothesis that abstraction enhances human-centered symbolic explanations.

2602.03468.tldr: IntentRL is a framework that trains proactive agents to clarify latent user intents before starting long-horizon research, and significantly improves both intent hit rate and downstream task performance, outperforming the built-in clarify modules of closed-source DR agents and proactive LLM baselines.

2602.03477.tldr: ScDiVa is proposed, a masked discrete diffusion foundation model that aligns generation with the dropout-like corruption process by defining a continuous-time forward masking mechanism in token space, and suggests that masked discrete diffusion serves as a biologically coherent and effective alternative to autoregression.

2602.03478.tldr: EquiRouter is proposed, a decision-aware router that directly learns model rankings, restoring the role of smaller models and mitigating routing collapse, and reduces cost by about 17\% at GPT-4-level performance compared to the strongest prior router.

2602.03485.tldr: This work proposes a novel, experience-driven test-time framework that reduces the overused verification in large Reasoning Models, and detects the activation of recheck behavior, consults an offline experience pool of past verification outcomes, and estimates whether a recheck is likely unnecessary via efficient retrieval.

2602.03486.tldr: DeepDFA, a neurosymbolic framework that integrates high-level temporal logic - expressed as Deterministic Finite Automata or Moore Machines - into neural architectures, outperforms traditional deep learning models and novel neuro-symbolic systems, achieving state-of-the-art results in temporal knowledge integration.

2602.03501.tldr: RFO computes policy gradients by backpropagating jointly through the flow generation process and system dynamics, unlocking high sample efficiency without requiring intractable log-likelihood calculations.

2602.03505.tldr: Experimental results on Gaussian sources and deep-learning-based semantic classification demonstrate that generative decompression closes a vast majority of the performance gap to the ideal joint-optimization benchmark, enabling adaptive, high-fidelity reconstruction without modifying the encoder.

2602.03506.tldr: PATCHES is introduced, an evolutionary circuit discovery algorithm that identifies compact and correct circuits for SR and provides the first circuit-level characterisation of an SR transformer, establishing SR as a high-potential application domain for mechanistic interpretability and proposing a principled methodology for circuit discovery.

2602.03511.tldr: This work provides theoretical analysis that bounds the return gap under observation noise, when the induced latent dynamics are contractive, and presents Contractive Mapping for Robustness (CMR) framework that maps high-dimensional, disturbance-prone observations into a latent space, where local perturbations are attenuated over time.

2602.03515.tldr: This work observes that the deleterious effects of delayed gradients are exacerbated when the Hessian eigenbasis is misaligned with the standard coordinate basis, and proposes the use of basis rotation, which effectively mitigates the alignment issue and significantly accelerates convergence in asynchronous settings.

2602.03523.tldr: A discrete diffusion-based piano accompaniment generation model, D3PIA, leveraging local alignment between lead sheet and accompaniment in piano-roll representation and incorporating Neighborhood Attention to both encode the lead sheet and condition it for predicting note states in the piano accompaniment.

2602.03529.tldr: Morphe is presented, the first revolutionized paradigm that enables VFM-based end-to-end generative video streaming towards this goal, and achieves real-time, loss-resilient video delivery in challenging network environments, representing a milestone in VFM-enabled multimedia streaming solutions.

2602.03541.tldr: The long-term consequences of AI use for human cultural evolution and the conditions under which widespread AI use may lead to "cultural collapse" are examined to shed light on the long-term, population-level effects of AI adoption and inform policy and organizational strategies to mitigate these risks.

2602.03545.tldr: Persona Generators are introduced, functions that can produce diverse synthetic populations tailored to arbitrary contexts that substantially outperform existing baselines across six diversity metrics on held-out contexts, and span rare trait combinations difficult to achieve in standard LLM outputs.

2602.03554.tldr: This work proposes a new benchmarking framework for single-step retrosynthesis that evaluates both general-purpose and chemistry-specialized LLMs using ChemCensor, a novel metric for chemical plausibility that better aligns with human synthesis planning practices.

2602.03558.tldr: ELIQ focuses on visual quality and prompt-image alignment, automatically constructs positive and aspect-specific negative pairs to cover both conventional distortions and AIGC-specific distortion modes, enabling transferable supervision without human annotations and paves the way for scalable and label-free quality assessment under continuously evolving generative models.

2602.03560.tldr: This work introduces Hybrid Sparse Attention (HySparse), a new architecture that interleaves each full attention layer with several sparse attention layers that achieves substantial performance gains while reducing KV cache storage by nearly 10x.

2602.03567.tldr: The results show that EVE can verify machine unlearning without involving the model's initial training process, unlike backdoor-based methods, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art unlearning verification methods, offering significant speedup in efficiency while enhancing verification accuracy.

2602.03569.tldr: EHRWorld, a patient-centric medical world model trained under a causal sequential paradigm, is introduced together with EHRWorld-110K, a large-scale longitudinal clinical dataset derived from real-world electronic health records, to address error accumulation in long-horizon clinical simulation.

2602.03578.tldr: This work proposes an efficient and adaptive GraphRAG framework that dynamically integrates RAG and GraphRAG paradigms through syntax-aware complexity analysis and significantly improves accuracy, reduces latency, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in handling mixed scenarios involving both simple and complex queries.

2602.03580.tldr: This work designs an automated static analysis framework and applies it to 10,240 real-world MCP Servers, finding that while most servers are highly consistent, approximately 13% exhibit substantial mismatches that can enable undocumented privileged operations, hidden state mutations, or unauthorized financial actions.

2602.03584.tldr: A Generalist Value Model capable of estimating the expected performance of any model on unseen prompts without requiring parameter updates is proposed, and significantly outperforms heuristic budget allocation and achieves a Pareto-optimal trade-off between performance and cost in LLM routing tasks.

2602.03586.tldr: This work introduces Activation Perturbation for EXploration (APEX), an inference-time probing paradigm that perturbs hidden activations while keeping both inputs and model parameters fixed, and theoretically shows that activation perturbation induces a principled transition from sample-dependent to model-dependent behavior.

2602.03608.tldr: CORE optimizes retrieved content by appending strategically designed optimization content to steer the ranking of outputs in search engines, outperforming existing ranking manipulation methods while preserving the fluency of optimized content.

2602.03630.tldr: It is concluded that, while current LLMs often demonstrate sufficient knowledge and intelligence to tackle space science tasks, they remain limited by an implementation barrier, functioning as powerful domain facilitators rather than fully autonomous engineers.

2602.03633.tldr: BIRDTurk is introduced, the first Turkish adaptation of the BIRD benchmark, constructed through a controlled translation pipeline that adapts schema identifiers to Turkish while strictly preserving the logical structure and execution semantics of SQL queries and databases.

2602.03640.tldr: This tutorial first articulates a working definition of reasoning within the context of information retrieval and derives from it a unified analytical framework, which maps existing approaches along axes that reflect the core components of the definition.

2602.03647.tldr: This work proposes Search-R2, a novel Actor-Refiner collaboration framework that enhances reasoning through targeted intervention, with both components jointly optimized during training, and introduces a hybrid reward design that couples outcome correctness with a dense process reward quantifying the information density of retrieved evidence.

2602.03652.tldr: A comprehensive Turkish RAG dataset derived from Turkish Wikipedia and CulturaX is constructed, comprising question-answer pairs and relevant passage chunks, to demonstrate that over-stacking generative modules can degrade performance by distorting morphological cues, whereas simple query clarification with robust reranking offers an effective solution.

2602.03669.tldr: A novel sequential neural network model with a spatial-temporal attention mechanism to focus on key features of lane lines and exploit salient ST correlations among continuous image frames is introduced, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in various testing scenarios.

2602.03670.tldr: The key property of equilibrium propagation is kept, namely the use of stationary states both for inference and learning, but the dynamics in the learning phase are modified by a term proportional to the non-reciprocal part of the interaction so as to obtain the exact gradient of the cost function.

2602.03685.tldr: This work shows that power-law vanishing losses can arise intrinsically from the use of softmax and cross-entropy, and provides a mechanistic explanation for observed neural scaling and suggest new directions for improving LLM training efficiency.

2602.03686.tldr: Empirical evaluation across 50 classification and regression datasets demonstrates that QuAIL consistently improves average performance over neural baselines under both random and value-dependent corruption, with especially robust behavior in low-data and systematically biased settings.

2602.03688.tldr: TodyComm is proposed, a behavior-driven collaboration topologies that adapt to the dynamics at each round, optimizing the utility for the task through policy gradient, and delivers superior task effectiveness while retaining token efficiency and scalability.

2602.03689.tldr: BAR-RAG reframes the reranker as a boundary-aware evidence selector that targets the generator's Goldilocks Zone -- evidence that is neither trivially easy nor fundamentally unanswerable for the generator, but is challenging yet sufficient for inference and thus provides the strongest learning signal.

2602.03690.tldr: This work develops the first comprehensive error analysis regarding Transformer learning in relevant contexts and reveals how pretraining and fine-tuning jointly determine performance, with the dominant contribution governed by whichever is more favorable.

2602.03693.tldr: This work introduces OCRTurk, a Turkish document parsing benchmark covering multiple layout elements and document categories at three difficulty levels and evaluates seven OCR models on OCRTurk using element-wise metrics.

2602.03695.tldr: Inspired by neural network design, where complex models are built from reusable components, a set of reusable latent building blocks for LLM-based MAS are proposed, which improves both robustness and efficiency by mitigating information degradation across multi-stage interactions.

2602.03702.tldr: It is suggested that weight averaging combined with simple, horizon-free step sizes offers a practical and effective anytime alternative to cosine learning rate schedules for large language model pretraining.

2602.03704.tldr: ReQUESTA is introduced, a hybrid, multi-agent framework for generating cognitively diverse MCQs that systematically target text-based, inferential, and main idea comprehension and demonstrates that hybrid, agentic orchestration can systematically improve the reliability and controllability of LLM-based generation.

2602.03750.tldr: A zero shot prompting strategy that leverages a state of the art Large Vision Language Model (LVLM) to automatically identify the main bone, projection view, and laterality in such images, suggesting that LVLMs can substantially accelerate code word development for large paleoradiology datasets, allowing for efficient content navigation in future anthropology workflows.

2602.03767.tldr: This decision-oriented benchmarking framework provides a key component of a blueprint for harnessing the power of AIWP models to help large vulnerable populations adapt to weather shocks in the face of climate variability and change.

2602.03772.tldr: UniGeM is introduced, a framework that unifies mixing and selection by treating data curation as a manifold approximation problem without training proxy models or relying on external reference datasets.

2602.03775.tldr: This work studies Chirper.ai, an LLM-driven social media platform-analyzing 7M posts and interactions among 32K LLM agents over a year, and presents a simple yet effective method, called Chain of Social Thought (CoST), that reminds LLM agents to avoid harmful posting.

2602.03776.tldr: DiffLOB explicitly conditions the generative process on future market regimes--including trend, volatility, liquidity, and order-flow imbalance, which enables the model to answer counterfactual queries of the form: ``If the future market regime were X instead of Y, how would the limit order book evolve?''

2602.03778.tldr: This work proposes a novel formulation of the static CVaR objective based on augmentation and develops risk-averse value iteration and model-free Q-learning algorithms that rely on discretized augmented states and provides convergence guarantees and approximation error bounds due to discretization.

2602.03783.tldr: A unified task weighting framework for analyzing task attribution methods is considered, a new connection between linear surrogate models and influence functions through a second-order analysis is shown, and kernel surrogate models are introduced, which more effectively represent second-order task interactions.

2602.03789.tldr: This work proves how to convert a sample path of a stochastic differential equation with arbitrary diffusion coefficient under any schedule into the unique sample path under another arbitrary schedule and diffusion coefficient and extends the stochastic interpolant framework to admit a larger class of point mass schedules.

2602.03792.tldr: This work proposes WebSentinel, a two-step approach for detecting and localizing prompt injection attacks in webpages, and shows that WebSentinel is highly effective, substantially outperforming baseline methods across multiple datasets of both contaminated and clean webpages that were collected.

2602.03794.tldr: This work presents an information-theoretic framework showing that MAS performance is bounded by the intrinsic task uncertainty, not by agent count, and derives architecture-agnostic bounds demonstrating that improvements depend on how many effective channels the system accesses.

2602.03799.tldr: This work develops a probabilistic verification framework for unknown dynamical systems which combines conformal prediction with reachability analysis, and develops an algorithmic approach for training control policies that optimize nominal reward while also maximizing the planning horizon with sound probabilistic safety guarantees.

2602.03802.tldr: This work revisits Synchronous SGD and its robust variant, called $m$-Synchronous SGD, and theoretically shows that they are nearly optimal in many heterogeneous computation scenarios, which is somewhat unexpected.

2602.03806.tldr: Cobalt is proposed, a new method that combines the benefits of online and offline RL and outperforms two multi-turn online RL baselines based on GRPO and VeRPO, and substantially improves R1-Distill 8B and Qwen3 8B by up to 9.0 and 6.2 absolute Pass@1 scores on LiveCodeBench.

2602.03808.tldr: This work proposes a Curriculum-Guided Feature Learning and Three-Stage Attention Network (CL3AN-GNN), a learning network that uses a three-step attention system similar to how humans learn and demonstrates its effectiveness against imbalances.

2602.03812.tldr: This work introduces antidistillation fingerprinting (ADFP), a principled approach that aligns the fingerprinting objective with the student's learning dynamics, and utilizes a proxy model to identify and sample tokens that directly maximize the expected detectability of the fingerprint in the student after fine-tuning.

2602.03814.tldr: This work re-frame the budget setting problem as risk control, limiting the error rate while minimizing compute and introduces an upper threshold that stops reasoning when the model is confident (risking incorrect output) and a novel parametric lower threshold that preemptively stops unsolvable instances (risking premature stoppage).

2602.03817.tldr: FinCH is introduced, an adaptive log-linear evidence fusion framework that integrates a pre-trained audio classifier with a structured spatiotemporal predictor and explicitly bounds the influence of contextual evidence, yielding a risk-contained hypothesis class with an interpretable audio-only fallback.

2602.03838.tldr: PrevizWhiz is a system that leverages rough 3D scenes in combination with generative image and video models to create stylized video previews that lowers technical barriers for film-makers, accelerates creative iteration, and effectively bridges the communication gap.

2602.03846.tldr: A continual learning method for pretrained models that requires no access to old-task data that provides explicit control over the plasticity-retention trade-off, and parameterizes each layer with a structured low-rank update.

2405.04118.tldr: Policy Learning with a Language Bottleneck (PLLB), a framework enabling AI agents to generate linguistic rules that capture the high-level strategies underlying rewarding behaviors, is introduced, enabling more effective human-AI coordination.

2405.18605.tldr: A data set created by merging the ChemProt and DrugProt datasets to augment sample counts and improve model accuracy is presented and significant improvements in model performance are demonstrated, particularly in CPR groups shared between the datasets.

2406.11589.tldr: An automated pipeline featuring multiple model-based candidate selections and the novel test-driven agent annotation system is developed and CoSQA+ is introduced, pairing high-quality queries from CoSQA with multiple suitable codes.

2409.07825.tldr: This survey reviews recent progress in Multimodal Learning with Missing Modality (MLMM), focusing on deep learning methods, and provides the first comprehensive survey that covers the motivation and distinctions between MLMM and standard multimodal learning setups.

2409.11022.tldr: DynamicNER is proposed, the first NER dataset designed for LLM-based methods with dynamic categorization, introducing various entity types and entity type lists for the same entity in different context, leveraging the generalization of LLM-based NER better.

2410.18844.tldr: This work proposes a Lagrangian relaxation of the sample complexity lower bound for pure exploration under constraints, and uses properties of convex optimisation in the Lagrangian lower bound to propose two computationally efficient extensions of Track-and-Stop and Gamified Explorer, namely LATS and LAGEX.

2411.18506.tldr: This paper introduces a method, called LLM-ABBA, that integrates ABBA into large language models for various downstream time series tasks and shows competitive forecasting capability compared to recent SOTA time series forecasting results.

2501.10396.tldr: This paper can be a pointer to help researchers and practitioners identify challenges and opportunities for the development of DTs; a bridge to initiate conversations across disciplines; and a road map to exploiting potentials of DTs for diverse urban transportation applications.

2502.06152.tldr: This work presents a novel explanation technique (ILIV-SHAP) that adapts SHAP explanations to highlight human-complementing information and contributes a decision-theoretic framework for characterizing the value of information.

2503.01829.tldr: Persuade Me If You Can (PMIYC), an automated framework for evaluating persuasiveness and susceptibility to persuasion in multi-agent interactions, is introduced, finding that Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-4o exhibit similar persuasive effectiveness, but GPT-4o demonstrates over 50% greater resistance to persuasion for misinformation compared to Llama-3.3-70B.

2503.08301.tldr: A novel meta-surrogate framework to assist many-task optimization, by leveraging the knowledge transfer strengths and emergent capabilities of large language models (LLMs), and formulate a unified framework for many-task fitness prediction, by defining a universal model with metadata to fit a group of problems.

2503.11655.tldr: While its reasoning process reduces throughput, DeepSeek-R1 offers superior explainability via transparent, step-by-step traces, establishing it as a powerful, interpretable open source alternative.

2503.11733.tldr: A systematic review of recent advances in applying LLM agents to address key challenges in educational settings, such as feedback comment generation, curriculum design, etc, and analyzes the technologies enabling these agents, including representative datasets, benchmarks, and algorithmic frameworks.

2503.20654.tldr: This paper introduces AccidentSim, a novel framework that generates physically realistic vehicle collision videos by extracting and utilizing the physical clues and contextual information available in real-world vehicle accident reports.

2504.02148.tldr: The Text-Omic Signaling Graph (TOSG) is introduced, a novel data structure that unifies human-interpretable biomedical textual knowledge, quantitative omic data, and signaling network information and develops CellTOSG-FM, a multimodal graph language FM to jointly analyze textual, omic and signaling network context.

2504.20106.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed Preference Vector framework improves helpfulness without excessive conservatism, allows smooth control over preference trade-offs, and supports scalable multi-preference alignment.

2505.13697.tldr: This comprehensive analysis demonstrates that GRPO objective reduces to filtered Iterative SFT, an on-policy variant of supervised fine-tuning, and indirectly incentivizes RL to generate longer sequences of intermediate tokens which feeds into the narrative of"RL incentivizing thinking because it generates longer thinking traces."

2505.19414.tldr: This work proposes a multiphysics-informed ML (MPIML) framework that integrates physical priors into data-driven models for enhanced accuracy and safety, and introduces an integrated system architecture comprising three core engines: DCLib for versatile facility modeling, DCTwin for high-fidelity multiphysics simulation, and DCBrain for decision-making optimization.

2505.21288.tldr: GSAT incorporates structural features derived from anonymous random walks and graph kernels to encode local topological information, enabling attention mechanisms to adapt based on the underlying graph structure, enhancing the model's ability to discern meaningful relational dependencies within complex data.

2506.00750.tldr: This work proposes CodeSense, the first benchmark that makes available a spectrum of fine-grained code reasoning tasks concerned with the software engineering of real-world code and produces an execution tracing framework and tool set that make it easy to collect ground truth for fine-grained SE reasoning tasks.

2506.00934.tldr: GRAM is proposed: a general-purpose real-world audio model that employs a multi-channel masked autoencoder to efficiently learn spatial audio representations and shows state-of-the-art localization performance in simulated environments and generalizes efficiently to real-world recordings in RealSELD.

2506.01374.tldr: A novel compilation framework that formulates optimization as a sequential, context-aware decision process guided by a large language model and structured Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS), demonstrating the potential of LLM-guided reasoning to transform the landscape of compiler optimization.

2506.07464.tldr: DeepVideo-R1 is proposed, a video large language model trained with Reg-GRPO (Regressive GRPO) and difficulty-aware data augmentation and shows that this approach significantly improves video reasoning performance across multiple benchmarks.

2506.12818.tldr: This work proposes Epistemic Nearest Neighbors (ENN), a lightweight alternative to GPs that estimates function values and uncertainty from $K$-nearest-neighbor observations by replacing the GP surrogate in TuRBO with ENN and its Thompson-sampling acquisition with $\mathrm{UCB} = \mu(x) + \sigma(x)$.

2506.15732.tldr: This work explores whether LLMs can combine knowledge in-context with their parametric knowledge through the lens of counterfactual reasoning, and reveals important limitations of current LLM's abilities to re-purpose parametric knowledge in novel settings.

2506.17442.tldr: This work aims to guide the development of reliable, robust medical AI systems capable of sustaining safe, long-term deployment in dynamic clinical settings by reviewing common causes of performance degradation at both data and model levels.

2506.21142.tldr: This paper proposes a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN)-based framework specifically designed to craft stealthy adversarial attacks that effectively evade IDS mechanisms, and highlights the necessity of advanced probabilistic modeling techniques to reliably detect and adapt the existing IDS against novel, generative-model-based stealthy cyber threats.

2507.00583.tldr: This work provides new insights into using neural representation geometry for AI-generated video detection, and shows that AI-generated videos exhibit significantly different curvature and distance patterns compared to real videos.

2507.01099.tldr: A 4D video generation model that enforces multi-view 3D consistency of generated videos by supervising the model with cross-view pointmap alignment during training, enabling it to generate spatio-temporally aligned future video sequences from novel viewpoints given a single RGB-D image per view.

2507.07532.tldr: Neural Concept Verifier is introduced, a unified framework combining PVGs for formal verifiability with concept encodings to handle complex, high-dimensional inputs in an interpretable way and demonstrates NCV as a promising step toward concept-level, verifiable AI.

2507.08499.tldr: A feature-centric framework that dynamically adapts document representations and learning algorithms to optimize language-specific performance for multilingual emotion detection, addressing the challenges of linguistic diversity and resource constraints is proposed.

2507.10419.tldr: LoRA-MCL, a training scheme that extends next-token prediction in language models with a method designed to decode diverse, plausible sentence continuations at inference time, is proposed and demonstrated with experiments on visual and audio captioning and machine translation.

2507.15958.tldr: QANA is proposed, a quantization-aware CNN backbone embedded in an end-to-end pipeline engineered for conversion-stable neuromorphic execution that produces SNN-ready logits and enables incremental updates on edge hardware without full retraining or data offloading.

2508.01415.tldr: RoboMemory is introduced, a brain-inspired framework that unifies Spatial, Temporal, Episodic, and Semantic memory within a parallelized architecture for efficient long-horizon planning and interactive learning and position as a scalable foundation for memory-augmented embodied agents, bridging insights from cognitive neuroscience with practical robotic autonomy.

2508.03365.tldr: This research introduces WhisperInject, a two-stage adversarial audio attack framework that manipulates state-of-the-art audio language models to generate harmful content to demonstrate a new class of practical, audio-native threats.

2508.04428.tldr: SimInstruct, a scalable, expert-in-the-loop tool for collecting scaffolding dialogues, is presented and it is revealed that persona traits, such as extroversion and introversion, meaningfully influence how experts engage.

2508.09100.tldr: The Arbitrary Set-based Permutation-Invariant Reasoning Engine model is developed, enabling a single model to provide data-grounded, conditional likelihood predictions for arbitrary targets given any collection of observed features, across diverse domains and tasks.

2508.13654.tldr: This work found adding noisy and irrelevant contexts into queries can improve reasoning efficiency without any prices and targeted designs, making the approach more applicable and affordable.

2508.15610.tldr: A range of structured data workflow tasks and empirical evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of Agentics are presented, including data wrangling, text-to-SQL semantic parsing, and domain-specific multiple-choice question answering, and data-driven scientific discovery tasks.

2508.17944.tldr: This paper proposes Substantive Intersectional Algorithmic Fairness, extending Ben Green’s (Philos Technol, 2022) notion of substantive algorithmic fairness with insights from intersectional feminist theory, articulated as ten desiderata to guide the design, assessment, and deployment of algorithmic systems that address systemic inequities while mitigating harms to intersectionally marginalized communities.

2508.18380.tldr: Template-based AFA is proposed, a non-greedy framework that learns a small library of feature templates -- sets of features that are jointly informative -- and uses this library of templates to guide the next feature acquisitions.

2509.12434.tldr: EntroPO is introduced, an entropy-enhanced framework that adapts existing preference optimization algorithms to the multi-turn, tool-assisted setting and generalizes learning to optimize over multi-turn interactions rather than single-turn responses.

2509.16479.tldr: This study proposes an advanced thermal fall detection method using a Bidirectional Convolutional Long Short-Term Memory model, enhanced with spatial, temporal, feature, self, and general attention mechanisms, and demonstrates robust results on TF-66, a newly emerged, diverse, and privacy-preserving benchmark.

2509.17489.tldr: MapCoder-Lite is a framework for distilling the complex reasoning of large, multi-agent coding systems into a single 7B model, demonstrating that careful agent-wise fine-tuning unleashes high-quality multi-agent coding on a small language model.

2509.21173.tldr: It is shown that quantization dampens high-rank spectral components, compelling the model to rely more heavily on robust, low-rank features, and establishing a pathway to deploy faster, more reliable VLMs by utilizing quantization beyond its conventional role.

2509.25458.tldr: Compositional Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Emotion Reasoning (CCoT-Emo), a framework that introduces structured Emotion Graphs (EGs) to guide LALMs in emotion inference without fine-tuning, is proposed.

2509.25495.tldr: Emo-TTA is proposed, a lightweight, training-free adaptation framework that incrementally updates class-conditional statistics via an Expectation-Maximization procedure for explicit test-time distribution estimation, using ALM predictions as priors.

2510.02250.tldr: Behavior Judge is introduced, which addresses this challenge by representing agent executions as behavior narratives and comparing candidate behaviors at this level, substantially improving robustness and success rates and highlighting the strong effectiveness of scaling CUAs, when you do it right.

2510.02712.tldr: This work presents a large-scale survival analysis of conversational robustness, modeling failure as a time-to-event process over 36,951 turns from 9 state-of-the-art LLMs on the MT-Consistency benchmark.

2510.04192.tldr: The results demonstrate that the proposed slot exchange mechanism increases consumer comfort and fairness without raising system inefficiency cost, making it a practical and scalable solution for future smart grids.

2510.04670.tldr: This work introduces AFIRE, an agnostic interface that standardizes time-aligned post-fusion tokens from varied encoders, and MIND, a plug-and-play Mixture-of-Experts decoder with a subject-aware dynamic gating, enabling robust, plug-and-improve performance for naturalistic neuroimaging studies.

2510.04769.tldr: This work demonstrates that incorporating imprecision into the learning process not only enriches the representation of uncertainty, but also reveals structural conditions under which stability emerges, thereby offering new insights into the dynamics of iterative learning under imprecision.

2510.13893.tldr: A comprehensive hierarchical taxonomy of jailbreak strategies is developed that systematically consolidates techniques previously studied in isolation and harmonizes existing, partially overlapping classifications with explicit cross-references to prior categorizations, enabling the study of interactions where adversarial intent emerges gradually and succeeds in bypassing traditional safeguards.

2510.23026.tldr: Mixed-Density Diffuser (MDD) is proposed, a diffusion planner where the densities throughout the horizon are tunable hyperparameters, and surpasses the SOTA Diffusion Veteran (DV) framework across the Maze2D, Franka Kitchen, and Antmaze Datasets for Deep Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning (D4RL) task domains.

2510.26275.tldr: Design science research is applied to build a roadmap for GenAI-augmented SE and McLuhan’s tetrads were used as a conceptual instrument to systematically capture the transforming effects of GenAI on SE processes and software products.

2511.00640.tldr: Decoding Tree Sketching (DTS), a plug-and-play decoding framework for structural multi-trajectory exploration and reasoning selection, enables smaller models to outperform larger models with 10$\times$ the size, highlighting its potential to strengthen reasoning capabilities.

2511.02463.tldr: Verifiable Multiple-Choice Reformulation for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (VMR-RLVR), a novel training strategy that restructures open-ended data into verifiable multiple-choice formats, enabling effective training even in the absence of explicit ground truth.

2511.05610.tldr: This work proposes an adaptive framework combining LSTM forecasting and Conformal Prediction to estimate node-wise uncertainty and focus sensing on the most uncertain points, suitable for real-time DTs.

2511.08947.tldr: CastMind is proposed, an interaction-driven agentic reasoning framework that enables accurate time series forecasting with training-free large language models and develops a lightweight toolkit comprising a feature set, a knowledge base, a case library, and a contextual pool that provides external support for LLM-based reasoning.

2511.12169.tldr: This work proposes DRedMTL, an incremental reasoning algorithm for DatalogMTL with bounded intervals, which builds upon the classical DRed algorithm, which incrementally updates the materialisation of a Datalog program.

2511.14276.tldr: This work systematically evaluates task-agnostic representations extracted from tabular foundation models alongside classical feature engineering across a variety of application tasks as outlier detection and supervised learning and finds that simple feature engineering methods achieve comparable or superior performance while requiring significantly less computational resources than tabular foundation models.

2511.21752.tldr: This study demonstrates that label semantics can serve as an effective defense layer, transforming meaning itself into a shield against prompt injection, and can identify more than one alias pair that achieves higher accuracy than the under-attack baseline.

2512.00771.tldr: EAG3R is a novel geometry estimation framework that augments pointmap-based reconstruction with asynchronous event streams that reinforces spatiotemporal coherence during global optimization and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art RGB-only baselines across monocular depth estimation, camera pose tracking, and dynamic reconstruction tasks.

2512.06655.tldr: Graph-Regularized Sparse Autoencoders (GSAEs), which extends SAEs with a Laplacian smoothness penalty on the neuron co-activation graph, enables effective runtime safety steering and enforces refusals adaptively while preserving utility on benign queries.

2512.07212.tldr: This work proposes BridgePolicy, a generative visuomotor policy that directly integrates observations into the stochastic dynamics via a diffusion-bridge formulation, and demonstrates that BridgePolicy consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative policies.

2512.07925.tldr: This study presents a near--real-time monitoring approach using a lightweight Variational Auto-Encoder (VAE)--based model integrated with 4-band Planet Labs imagery at 3 m spatial resolution, which consistently outperforms the other methods, achieving higher recall and F1-scores while maintaining operationally viable precision in highly imbalanced fire-detection scenarios.
