2512.10322.tldr: This paper proposes a paradigm shift that positions user feedback, specifically episode-level success confirmations and goal-level corrections, as a primary and general-purpose supervision signal for VLN, and introduces a user-feedback-driven learning framework featuring a topology-aware trajectory construction pipeline.

2512.19097.tldr: DIVER-1, a family of models trained on the largest and most diverse corpus to date, is introduced, providing both a powerful generalist model and actionable guidelines for efficient development of future neuro-AI systems.

2512.20112.tldr: DCL-ENAS is introduced, a novel method that employs two stages of contrastive learning to train the neural predictor and fine-tuning with contrastive learning is performed to accurately predict the relative performance of different architectures rather than their absolute performance.

2512.21066.tldr: This study proposes an agentic XAI framework combining SHAP-based explainability with multimodal LLM-driven iterative refinement to generate progressively enhanced explanations, and suggests that strategic early stopping is needed for optimizing practical utility, challenging assumptions about monotonic improvement and providing evidence-based design principles for agentic XAI systems.

2512.22387.tldr: An empirical study investigating whether LLM-generated code can be executed successfully in a clean environment with only OS packages and using only the dependencies that the model specifies, and introduces a three-layer dependency framework to quantify execution reproducibility.

2601.02954.tldr: This work introduces a system that enables large audio-language models (LALMs) to understand and reason about the complex acoustic world and provides a clear pathway for leveraging the powerful reasoning abilities of LALMs towards holistic ASA, advancing from"mono"semantic recognition to spatial intelligence.

2601.09465.tldr: EvoFSM is proposed, a structured self-evolving framework that achieves both adaptability and control by evolving an explicit Finite State Machine (FSM) instead of relying on free-form rewriting.

2601.11073.tldr: HIMVH, a Hippocampus-Inspired Multi-View Hypergraph learning model for web finance fraud detection is proposed, which designs a cross-view inconsistency perception module that captures subtle discrepancies and behavioral heterogeneity across multiple transaction views and introduces a novelty-aware hypergraph learning module that measures feature deviations from neighborhood expectations and adaptively reweights messages.

2601.13632.tldr: A Risk-Aware Dynamic Routing (RADR) framework which integrates Spatiotemporal Graph Neural Networks (ST-GNN) with combinatorial optimization with empirical evidence confirms that the proposed data-driven approach can effectively balance delivery efficiency and operational safety.

2601.14157.tldr: ConceptCaps is introduced, a dataset of 21k music-caption-tags triplets with explicit labels from a 200-attribute taxonomy that separates semantic modeling from text generation and improves coherence and controllability over end-to-end approaches.

2601.15313.tldr: This work identifies the Orthogonality Constraint: reliable memory requires orthogonal keys, but semantic embeddings cannot be orthogonal because training clusters similar concepts together, and proposes Knowledge Objects (KOs), structured facts with hash-based identity, controlled vocabularies, and explicit version chains.

2601.18496.tldr: The proposed DeepMed model improves its base model by 9.79\% on average and outperforms larger medical reasoning and DR models and brings a monitor to help validate hypotheses within a controlled number of steps and avoid context rot.

2601.18973.tldr: A scaling law lower bound for meta-learning is derived showing that the adaptation gain saturates exponentially with gradient steps and scales linearly with task variance, providing a quantitative criterion for when adaptation justifies its overhead.

2601.19929.tldr: This work introduces Stingy Context, a hierarchical tree-based compression scheme achieving 18:1 reduction in LLM context for auto-coding tasks and reduces a real source code base of 239k tokens to 11k tokens while preserving task fidelity.

2601.20601.tldr: This study proposes CLEAR-Mamba, an enhanced framework built upon MedMamba with optimizations in both architecture and training strategy that provides an effective solution that balances generalizability and reliability for modality-specific medical image classification tasks.

2601.21164.tldr: This work proposes to train a MLLM Interpreter to generate geometric descriptions for the visual diagram, and an off-the-shelf LLM is utilized to perform reasoning, choosing Conditional Declaration Language (CDL) as the geometric description as its conciseness eases the MLLM Interpreter training.

2601.21436.tldr: MADI is proposed, a multi-modal LLM enhanced with fine-grained alignment and disentangled interaction, featuring Patch-level Alignment, which enforces physically grounded fine-grained correspondence across heterogeneous modalities, and Discrete Disentangled Interaction, which separates modality-common semantics into compact discrete latents and adaptively synergizes the purified modality-unique information.

2601.23228.tldr: This work proposes finetuning multiagent systems with per-action process rewards from AI feedback (MAPPA) to address both credit assignment across agents and sample efficiency of expensive multiagent rollouts, and validates that per-action supervision can lead to improvements across different multiagent systems on various domains.

2602.00157.tldr: ProDCARL, a reinforcement-learning alignment framework that couples a diffusion-based protein generator with sequence property predictors for AMP activity and peptide toxicity, is introduced and qualified analyses suggest candidates show plausible AMP-like structural and semantic characteristics.

2602.00158.tldr: RAPTOR (Ridge-Adaptive Logistic Probe), a simple L2-regularized logistic probe whose validation-tuned ridge strength yields concept vectors from normalized weights is proposed, explaining how penalty strength mediates probe accuracy and concept-vector stability and yielding structural predictions that qualitatively align with trends observed on real LLM embeddings.

2602.01009.tldr: This work shows that enforcing ODE consistency does not require expensive nonlinear integration: a token-wise locally linear ODE representation preserves physical fidelity while scaling to foundation-model regimes, and proposes novel token representations that respect locally linear ODE evolution.

2602.01075.tldr: An agentic divide-and-conquer framework that offloads parsing to an external tool to construct an abstract syntax tree (AST) and enforces recursive reasoning over each intermediate sub-expression with focused context is proposed.

2602.01705.tldr: By decoupling latent-space exploration from text-space generation, it is shown that latent diffusion-based optimization is more effective than text-space policy optimization alone, while a complementary text policy provides additional gains when combined with latent exploration.

2602.02343.tldr: A unified preference-utility analysis is proposed that separates control effects into preference, defined as the tendency toward a target concept, and utility, defined as coherent and task-valid generation, and measures both on a shared log-odds scale using polarity-paired contrastive examples.

2602.02515.tldr: CreditAudit is proposed, a deployment oriented credit audit framework that evaluates models under a family of semantically aligned and non adversarial system prompt templates across multiple benchmarks, reporting mean ability as average performance across scenarios and scenario induced fluctuation sigma as a stability risk signal.

2602.02734.tldr: This paper details the methodology for data collection, annotation, and quality control of WAXAL, a large-scale, openly accessible speech dataset for 24 languages representing over 100 million speakers, and provides a detailed statistical overview of the dataset.

2602.02834.tldr: This work introduces RASA (Relation-Aware Sparse Attention), a minimal architectural modification that provides structural inductive bias for relational reasoning and demonstrates that minimal architectural modifications, grounded in complexity-theoretic analysis, can substantially improve multi-hop reasoning.

2602.03104.tldr: Findings show that participants prioritised felt memory over factual accuracy and editing was deemed unacceptable if it touched upon a person's identity if it touched upon a person's identity.

2602.03351.tldr: A custom transformer model is built to study how neural networks make moral decisions on trolley-style dilemmas, demonstrating that biases localize to distinct computational stages among other findings.

2602.03516.tldr: Plausible Negative Samples (PNS), a method that synthesizes high-quality negative samples exhibiting expected format and structural coherence while ultimately yielding incorrect answers, is proposed.

2602.03849.tldr: The analysis reveals that while AI agents demonstrate high alignment with human experts in recognizing established breakthroughs, they exhibit greater divergence in forecasting prospective questions, suggesting that human judgment remains crucial for evaluating subjective, forward-looking challenges.

2602.03852.tldr: Perceptions and experiences of AI-CBT chatbots among Chinese graduate students recruited through social media indicate a cautious openness to AI-CBT chatbots, while data privacy, emotional safety, and uncertainty about `fit' for complex problems restricted the intention to use.

2602.03872.tldr: This work develops the first theoretical framework for analyzing DP-SGD on long-tailed data from a feature learning perspective, and shows that the test error of DP-SGD-trained models on the long-tailed subpopulation is significantly larger than the overall test error over the entire dataset.

2602.03873.tldr: This work introduces the first benchmark for ambiguous emotion recognition in speech with ALMs under test-time scaling, and highlights key future directions for bridging the gap between model assumptions and the complexity of real-world human emotion.

2602.03876.tldr: This work introduces Group Ordinal Policy Optimization (GOPO), a policy optimization method that uses only the ranking of the rewards and discards their magnitudes, and demonstrates consistent improvements across a range of tasks and model sizes.

2602.03879.tldr: TruKAN outperforms other KAN models in terms of accuracy, computational efficiency and memory usage on the complex vision task, demonstrating advantages beyond the limited settings explored in prior KAN studies.

2602.03882.tldr: PriorProbe is introduced, a novel elicitation approach grounded in Markov Chain Monte Carlo with People that recovers fine-grained, individual-specific priors that yield substantial performance gains and provides a general and interpretable framework for personalizing deep neural networks.

2602.03883.tldr: An explainable computer vision framework for pore detection and criticality assessment in three-dimensional tomographic volumes enables transparent defect assessment and provides actionable insights for process optimization and quality control in additive manufacturing.

2602.03892.tldr: MQ-Auditor is proposed, a multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based auditor that explicitly reasons over multimodal cues and mask information to produce quantitative and qualitative mask quality assessments and can be integrated with existing Ref-AVS systems to detect segmentation failures and support downstream segmentation improvement.

2602.03894.tldr: This study investigates whether state-of-the-art Vision Transformer foundation models can reduce thousands of unlabeled animal images directly to species-level clusters, and demonstrates near-perfect species-level clustering and intentional over-clustering can reliably extract intra-specific variation including age classes, sexual dimorphism, and pelage differences.

2602.03899.tldr: This work provides the first proof that MultiKrum is a robust aggregation rule, and bound its robustness coefficient, and introduces $\kappa^\star$, the optimal *robustness coefficient* of an aggregation rule, which quantifies the accuracy of mean estimation in the presence of adversaries in a tighter manner compared with previously adopted notions of robustness.

2602.03900.tldr: Findings suggest that TMK functions not merely as context, but also as a mechanism that steers reasoning models away from their default linguistic modes to engage formal, code-execution pathways in the context of the experiments, suggesting the potential to bridge the gap between semantic approximation and symbolic manipulation.

2602.03902.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that GPCRLMD achieves state-of-the-art performance in GPCR-ligand dynamics simulation, faithfully reproducing thermodynamic observables and critical ligand-receptor interactions.

2602.03906.tldr: The GeoIB improves invariance and optimization stability by unifying distributional and geometric regularization under a single bottleneck multiplier.

2602.03907.tldr: This work introduces HY3D-Bench, an open-source ecosystem designed to establish a unified, high-quality foundation for 3D generation, and introduces structured part-level decomposition, providing the granularity essential for fine-grained perception and controllable editing.

2602.03915.tldr: This work investigates the accuracy of a suite of image tokenizers across a range of metrics designed to measure the fidelity of PDE properties in both physical and spectral space and proposes Phaedra, inspired by classical shape-gain quantization and proper orthogonal decomposition, which consistently improves reconstruction across a range of PDE datasets.

2602.03921.tldr: A novel eviction policy is proposed that exploits MoE's predictable expert access patterns to reduce collision misses by up to $85\times$ over LRU and achieves over $88\%$ hit rates with up to $34.7\%$ Time-to-first-token (TTFT) reduction on OLMoE at only 5GB of VRAM cache capacity.

2602.03924.tldr: WIND is introduced, a single pre-trained foundation model capable of replacing specialized baselines across a vast array of tasks, in contrast to previous atmospheric foundation models, and offers a computationally efficient paradigm shift in AI-based atmospheric modeling.

2602.03927.tldr: It is shown that MagNet provides a unifying and expressive ansatz capable of describing both FQH states and electron crystals within the same architecture, highlighting the power of first-principles AI for solving strongly interacting many-body problems and finding competing phases without external training data or physics pre-knowledge.

2602.03942.tldr: Overall, narrative-style spans--common in advice and precaution decisions--are a consistent blind spot under exact matching, suggesting that downstream systems should incorporate boundary-tolerant evaluation and extraction strategies for clinical decisions.

2602.03949.tldr: It is shown that architectural compute limits act as implicit rate constraints, yielding exponential improvements in semantic accuracy with model depth and inference time compute, while multimodal observation eliminates the geometric mean penalty inherent to remote encoding.

2602.03955.tldr: This paper proposes AgentArk, a novel framework to distill multi-agent dynamics into the weights of a single model, effectively transforming explicit test-time interactions into implicit model capabilities, and investigates three hierarchical distillation strategies across various models, tasks, scaling, and scenarios.

2602.03974.tldr: Active Epistemic Control is presented, an epistemic-categorical planning layer that integrates model-based belief management with categorical feasibility checks and achieves competitive success with fewer replanning rounds than strong LLM-agent baselines.

2602.03975.tldr: This work proposes a state-level selective verification framework that combines deterministic feasibility gating over a structured move interface, pre-verification ranking using a hybrid of learned state-distance and residual scoring, and adaptive allocation of verifier calls based on local uncertainty.

2602.03978.tldr: A holistic view of how monitorability emerges under RLVR is provided, clarifying when gains are likely to occur and when they are not and attribute monitorability gains primarily to response distribution sharpening and increased attention to the prompt.

2602.03980.tldr: This paper shows that next-word predictions of a transformer (GPT2) are increasingly unaffected by observations from outside the current context across epochs of training, and that the extent of pooling is affected by context frequency, context number and context variability in a similar way to hierarchical regression.

2602.03981.tldr: The DeXposure-FM is empirically validated on two machine learning benchmarks; it consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches, including a graph foundation model and temporal graph neural networks, for measuring and forecasting inter-protocol credit exposure on DeFi networks.

2602.04006.tldr: The Rational-ANOVA Network (RAN), a foundational architecture grounded in functional ANOVA decomposition and Pad\'e-style rational approximation, which provides an explicit low-order interaction bias for data efficiency and interpretability, while the rational parameterization significantly improves extrapolation.

2602.04028.tldr: An axiomatic framework built on a set of desirable properties for counterfactual explainers is introduced, which proves impossibility theorems showing that no single explainer can satisfy certain axiom combinations simultaneously, and fully characterizes all compatible sets.

2602.04029.tldr: PluRel is introduced, a framework to synthesize multi-tabular relational databases from scratch and observes for the first time that RFM pretraining loss exhibits power-law scaling with the number of synthetic databases and total pretraining tokens.

2602.04033.tldr: Self-correlation distance indicates that even a high average agreement with human data, when considering LLM responses independently, does not guarantee structural alignment in responses, and recommends CoT prompting, sampling-based decoding with dozens of samples, and robust analysis using multiple metrics, including self-correlation distance.

2602.04078.tldr: A principled understanding of the principles of Lipschitz continuity in neural networks within the paradigm of machine learning is advanced by investigating how Lipschitz continuity modulates the behavior of neural networks with respect to features in the input data, particularly its role in governing frequency signal propagation.

2602.04083.tldr: A structure-informed hybrid estimator is proposed that formulates pilot-limited MIMO channel estimation as low-rank tensor completion from sparse pilot observations -- a severely underdetermined inverse problem that prior tensor approaches avoid by assuming fully observed received signal tensors.

2602.04089.tldr: ORBIT is introduced, a multi-task, multi-episode meta-reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to learn from interaction in context, and a relatively small open-source model demonstrates substantially improved in-context online learning on entirely unseen environments.

2602.04095.tldr: This study presents a cognitive and computational model of dream process that involves episodic learning and random activation of stored experiences and demonstrates that random signals may result in learning and memory consolidation.

2602.04101.tldr: It is shown that most queries are handled primarily by the small-model and tool stack, with the large LLM operating only on distilled context, yielding competitive accuracy while shifting the bulk of computation away from the most expensive and monolithic models.

2602.04102.tldr: This work proposes DMS2F-HAD, a novel dual-branch Mamba-based model that utilizes Mamba's linear-time modeling to efficiently learn distinct spatial and spectral features in specialized branches, which is then integrated by a dynamic gated fusion mechanism to enhance anomaly localization.

2602.04109.tldr: Tinker Tales is presented, a tangible storytelling system designed with narrative and social-emotional scaffolding to support child-AI collaboration that shows that children treated the AI as an attentive, responsive collaborator, while scaffolding supported coherent narrative refinement without diminishing children's agency.

2602.04116.tldr: PANET is proposed, a novel framework employing a Divide-and-Conquer strategy to decouple modality interaction and alignment across distinct granularities and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse graph-centric and multimodal generative tasks.

2602.04120.tldr: This work proposes Explainability-as-a-Service (XaaS), a distributed architecture for treating explainability as a first-class system service and evaluates the performance of XaaS on three real-world edge-AI use cases.

2602.04127.tldr: Results show that coarse morphosyntax alone is insufficient for robust LVC detection under controlled contrasts, while lexical identity supports LVC judgments but is sensitive to calibration and normalization choices, and that ``lemma-only'' is not a single, well-defined representation, but one that depends critically on how normalization is operationalized.

2602.04129.tldr: KGLAMP is introduced, a knowledge-graph-guided LLM planning framework for heterogeneous multi-robot teams that maintains a structured knowledge graph encoding object relations, spatial reachability, and robot capabilities, which guides the LLM in generating accurate PDDL problem specifications.

2602.04144.tldr: OMG-Agent is presented, a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from static mapping to a dynamic coarse-to-fine Agentic Workflow and consistently surpasses state-of-the-art methods, maintaining robustness under extreme missingness.

2602.04152.tldr: A training-free graph alignment algorithm is developed that efficiently merges partial query graphs from individual agents into a unified global scene graph, enabling conventional single-agent systems to operate collaboratively without requiring any learnable parameters.

2602.04153.tldr: This work proposes TL-GPSTGN, a transfer-oriented spatiotemporal framework that enhances sample efficiency and out-of-distribution generalization by selectively pruning non-optimized graph context, and suggests that explicit context pruning serves as a powerful inductive bias for improving the robustness of graph-based forecasting models.

2602.04166.tldr: Topology-Aware Revival is proposed, a lightweight one-shot post-pruning procedure that improves static sparsity without dynamic rewiring and outperforms dynamic sparse training baselines with a median gain of +13.5%.

2602.04182.tldr: This work proposes an efficient EAR framework named HoloEv-Net, which achieves state-of-the-art performance on THU-EACT-50-CHL, HARDVS and DailyDVS-200, outperforming existing methods by 10.29%, 1.71% and 6.25%, respectively.

2602.04184.tldr: This work adapts OpenEMMA, an open-source MLLM-based end-to-end driving framework, to this setting, presenting a reproducible instruction-conditioned baseline on doScenes, and integrates doScenes directives as passenger-style prompts within OpenEMMA's vision-language interface, enabling linguistic conditioning before trajectory generation.

2602.04197.tldr: It is demonstrated that Toxic Proactivity is a widespread behavioral phenomenon and two major tendencies are revealed, including an active failure mode in which an agent, driven by the optimization for Machiavellian helpfulness, disregards ethical constraints to maximize utility.

2602.04206.tldr: Soft-FSM is proposed, a neuro-symbolic architecture that enforces monotonic progress over accumulated Key Information Units (KIUs) via an external deterministic state controller and can be reliably enforced through explicit and verifiable external state control in legal cross-examination domains.

2602.04208.tldr: Experiments on simulated and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that SCALE improves state-of-the-art VLAs and outperforms existing TTS methods while maintaining single-pass efficiency.

2602.04212.tldr: This work investigates whether LLMs can use in-context representations from context to complete simple downstream tasks, and seeks to inspire novel methods for encouraging models to not only encode information presented in-context, but to do so in a manner that supports flexible deployment of this information.

2602.04213.tldr: InterPReT takes user instructions to continually update the policy structure and optimize its parameters to fit user demonstrations, which enables end-users to interactively give instructions and demonstrations, monitor the agent's performance, and review the agent's decision-making strategies.

2602.04224.tldr: A Risk-Aware Preference Optimization (RAPO) framework is proposed that enables LRM to adaptively identify and address the safety risks with appropriate granularity in its thinking content, and generalizes multiple LRMs'safe reasoning adaptively across diverse attack prompts whilst preserving general utility.

2602.04248.tldr: Empirical-MCTS is introduced, a dual-loop framework that transforms stateless search into a continuous, non-parametric learning process and significantly outperforms both stateless MCTS strategies and standalone experience-driven agents on complex reasoning benchmarks.

2602.04252.tldr: This paper proposes ACIL, a novel active learning framework for class incremental learning settings that can drastically reduce annotation cost and can also avoid catastrophic forgetting, and extensive empirical analyses on several vision datasets corroborate the promise and potential of the framework against relevant baselines.

2602.04256.tldr: AppleVLM is proposed, an advanced perception and planning-enhanced VLM model for robust end-to-end driving that introduces a novel vision encoder and a planning strategy encoder to improve perception and decision-making.

2602.04264.tldr: Deep Bernstein Networks can act as residual-free architecture while simultaneously optimize trainability and representation power, and it is established that the approximation error for Bernstein-based networks decays exponentially with depth, a significant improvement over the polynomial rates of ReLU-based architectures.

2602.04265.tldr: T2T (Thickening-to-Thinning), a dynamic reward framework inspired by human learning processes, is introduced, which significantly outperforms standard GRPO and recent baselines, achieving superior performance.

2602.04271.tldr: SkeletonGaussian is proposed, a novel framework for generating editable dynamic 3D Gaussians from monocular video input that decomposes motion into sparse rigid motion explicitly driven by a skeleton and fine-grained non-rigid motion.

2602.04277.tldr: This study introduces an integrated generative design and machine learning driven framework to optimize UPTIS type spoke geometries for passenger vehicles, enabling systematic development of high performance, next generation UPTIS spoke structures.

2602.04284.tldr: This work proposes Agent-Omit, a unified training framework that empowers LLM agents to adaptively omit redundant thoughts and observations and introduces an omit-aware agentic reinforcement learning approach, incorporating a dual sampling mechanism and a tailored omission reward to incentivize the agent's adaptive omission capability.

2602.04291.tldr: INFORM is introduced, an interpretability analysis that treats orchestration as an explicit, analyzable computation, enabling the decoupling of expert interaction structure, execution order, and causal attribution in multi-expert systems.

2602.04294.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation on multiple mainstream LLM applications reveals that few-shot demonstrations produce opposite effects on RoP and ToP: few-shot enhances RoP's safety rate by up to 4.5% through reinforcing role identity, while it degrades ToP's effectiveness by up to 21.2% through distracting attention from task instructions.

2602.04296.tldr: ProxyWar is a novel framework that systematically assesses code generation quality by embedding LLM-generated agents within diverse, competitive game environments, and lays a foundation for research into LLM-driven algorithm discovery, adaptive problem solving, and the study of practical efficiency and robustness.

2602.04297.tldr: This work systematically study and compare the sensitivity of underspecified prompts and prompts that provide specific instructions, and finds that underspecified prompts exhibit higher performance variance and lower logit values for relevant tokens, while instruction-prompts suffer less from such problems.

2602.04304.tldr: This work introduces Visual Activation by Query (VAQ), a metric that identifies the layer whose attention map is most relevant to query-specific visual grounding by measuring attention sensitivity to the input query, and proposes LASER (Layer-adaptive Attention-guided Selective visual and decoding Enhancement for Reasoning), a training-free inference procedure that adaptively selects task-appropriate layers for visual localization and question answering.

2602.04306.tldr: This paper proposes a framing-aware debiasing method that encourages LLMs to be more consistent across framings and reduces overall bias and improves robustness against framing disparities, enabling LLMs to produce fairer and more consistent responses.

2602.04323.tldr: Across benchmark datasets for order-2 dielectric, order-3 piezoelectric, and order-4 elastic tensor prediction, CEITNet surpasses prior high-order prediction methods on key accuracy criteria while offering high computational efficiency.

2602.04326.tldr: PCE, a Planner-Composer-Evaluator framework that converts the fragmented assumptions latent in LLM reasoning traces into a structured decision tree, is introduced, establishing a principled route for turning latent LLM assumptions into reliable strategies for uncertainty-aware planning.

2602.04337.tldr: Collaborative Fine-Tuning is proposed, an unsupervised adaptation framework that leverages unlabeled data through a dual-model, cross-modal collaboration mechanism that enhances adaptation via iterative fine-tuning, momentum contrastive learning, and LLM-generated prompts.

2602.04340.tldr: This work introduces two learnable prompts in the textual branch of CLIP and proposes a robust uncertainty modeling framework for active CLIP adaptation based on dual-prompt tuning, demonstrating that this method consistently outperforms existing active learning methods under the same annotation budget.

2602.04344.tldr: This work demonstrates that Masked Diffusion Language Models are inherently amenable to advanced search strategies, owing to their iterative and non-autoregressive generation process, and proposes UnMaskFork (UMF), a framework that formulates the unmasking trajectory as a search tree and employs Monte Carlo Tree Search to optimize the generation path.

2602.04349.tldr: This work proposes the first pipeline that leverages the high-fidelity VecSet Large Reconstruction Model (LRM) as a backbone for mesh editing and introduces Mask-guided Token Seeding and Attention-aligned Token Gating strategies to precisely localize target regions using only 2D image conditions.

2602.04360.tldr: CF-HyperGNNExplainer is introduced, a counterfactual explanation method for HGNNs that identifies the minimal structural changes required to alter a model's prediction, producing concise and structurally meaningful explanations.

2602.04361.tldr: SparVAR is presented, a training-free acceleration framework that dynamically predict the sparse attention pattern of later high-resolution scales from a sparse decision scale, and construct scale self-similar sparse attention via an efficient index-mapping mechanism, enabling high-efficiency sparse attention computation at large scales.

2602.04380.tldr: Group-Based Mirror Policy Optimization is introduced, a framework that extends group-based policy optimization to flexible Bregman divergences, including hand-designed alternatives (L2 in probability space) and learned neural mirror maps, establishing divergence choice as a critical, previously unexplored design dimension in group-based policy optimization for LLM reasoning.

2602.04381.tldr: The UltraSeg family is presented, providing not only a CPU-native solution for colonoscopy but also a reproducible blueprint for broader minimally invasive surgical vision applications.

2602.04384.tldr: Preliminary results show that FL models have performance almost equivalent to the ideal setting in which parties share data with each other, and are notably superior to models built by individual parties without sharing data, cutting waste and boosting efficiency.

2602.04385.tldr: This work proposes a modular and interoperable solution that enables seamless AI pipeline integration into CPS by minimizing configuration and decoupling the roles of DTs and AI components, where DTs orchestrate data management and intelligent augmentation.

2602.04396.tldr: A principled framework unifying low-rank optimization with infrequent synchronization with a full-rank quasi-hyperbolic update is proposed and achieves near-parity with low-rank $\texttt{LoRDO}$ in language modeling and downstream tasks at model scales of $125$M--$720$M, while reducing communication by $\approx 10 \times$.

2602.04398.tldr: This work proposes a framework for detecting stereotype-inducing words and attributing neuron-level bias in LLMs, without the need for fine-tuning or prompt modification, and mitigate bias by directly intervening on their activations at the projection layer.

2602.04413.tldr: The H-GIVR framework can significantly improve cross-modal reasoning accuracy while maintaining low computational cost and enabling dynamic correction of errors and improving answer accuracy.

2602.04416.tldr: This work introduces Med-MMFL, the first comprehensive MMFL benchmark for the medical domain, encompassing diverse modalities, tasks, and federation scenarios, and evaluates six representative state-of-the-art FL algorithms, covering different aggregation strategies, loss formulations, and regularization techniques.

2602.04417.tldr: This work replaces the fixed anchor policy during RL with an Exponential Moving Average (EMA), similar to a target network in deep Q-learning, and introduces Top-k KL estimator, which allows for flexible interpolation between exact KL and sampled KL.

2602.04418.tldr: SPEAR is presented, a multi-agent coordination framework for smart contract auditing that applies established MAS patterns in a realistic security analysis workflow that compares the multi-agent design with centralized and pipeline-based alternatives under controlled failure scenarios.

2602.04442.tldr: This work explores machine translation for five Turkic language pairs: Russian-Bashkir, Russian-Kazakh, Russian-Kyrgyz, English-Tatar, English-Chuvash, and results show zero-shot or retrieval-based approaches for Tatar, while for Kyrgyz the zero-shot approach reached 45.6.

2602.04447.tldr: Mixture-of-Masters (MoM), the first chess mixture-of-experts model with small-sized GPT experts emulating world-class grandmasters, is introduced, the first chess mixture-of-experts model with small-sized GPT experts emulating world-class grandmasters to counteract homogenization.

2602.04448.tldr: This work proposes RASA, a routing-aware expert-level alignment framework that explicitly repairs Safety-Critical Experts while preventing routing-based bypasses, and suggests that robust MoE safety alignment benefits from targeted expert repair rather than global parameter updates.

2602.04456.tldr: It is found that, across models and contexts, LLMs consistently prioritize values related to Exploration&Growth over Benevolence&Connection, highlighting a potential risk of value homogenization in AI-mediated advice, raising concerns about how such systems may shape decision-making and normative outcomes at scale.

2602.04466.tldr: This work verified mDAPT on proprietary IT product knowledge for real-world questions in IT technical support operations and clarifies mDAPT's effectiveness in the knowledge aspect and its bottlenecks in other aspects.

2602.04492.tldr: It is found that LLM-based tree search autonomously discovers predictive models that significantly outperform established forecasting baselines and provide guidance for modeling real-world neural recordings and offer a broader template for AI-driven scientific discovery.

2602.04496.tldr: ReThinker is introduced, a confidence-aware agentic framework that orchestrates retrieval, tool use, and multi-agent reasoning through a stage-wise Solver-Critic-Selector architecture, and dynamically allocates computation based on model confidence, enabling adaptive tool invocation, guided multi-dimensional reflection, and robust confidence-weighted selection.

2602.04512.tldr: This work introduces BrainVista, a multimodal autoregressive framework designed to model the causal evolution of brain states, and proposes a novel Stimulus-to-Brain (S2B) masking mechanism to synchronize high-frequency sensory stimuli with hemodynamically filtered signals, enabling strict, history-only causal conditioning.

2602.04518.tldr: A novel method to automatically learn value systems from observations and human demonstrations is proposed, using a formal model of the value system learning problem, its instantiation to sequential decision-making domains based on multi-objective Markov decision processes, as well as tailored preference-based and inverse reinforcement learning algorithms to infer value grounding functions and value systems.

2602.04525.tldr: This work introduces a new semi-supervised segmentation framework designed to mitigate the class imbalance and feature degradation inherent in standard semi-supervised learning pipelines and proposes a new Prototype Bank System that enforces semantic consistency by anchoring predictions to historically learned high-fidelity feature representations.

2602.04541.tldr: By preserving the functional diversity of attention heads, the proposed LycheeDecode fine-grained strategy overcomes the performance bottlenecks of existing methods, providing a powerful and validated pathway to both efficient and high-quality long-context LLM inference.

2602.04542.tldr: This work reformulates continual learning as a control problem where learning and preservation signals compete within neural activity dynamics, and converts regularization penalties into preservation signals that protect prior-task representations.

2602.04547.tldr: OmniRad is introduced, a self-supervised radiological foundation model pretrained on 1.2 million medical images, designed with radiology-inspired principles emphasizing representation reuse and cross-task transferability, allowing for improved feature clustering and modality-related separation.

2602.04566.tldr: This work presents a novel Digital Twin-enabled scheduling framework inspired by Dual Mind World Model architecture, for learning-informed and imagination-driven network control that achieves superior performance in bursty, interference-limited, and deadline-sensitive environments, while maintaining interpretability and sample efficiency.

2602.04572.tldr: This work proposes a framework of sequential interaction, in which a GenAI system proposes questions to a forum that can publish some of them, and captures several intricacies of such a collaboration, including non-monetary exchanges, asymmetric information, and incentive misalignment.

2602.04581.tldr: Trust The Typical (T3), a framework that operationalizes robust safety comes not from enumerating what is harmful, but from deeply understanding what is safe, is introduced, a framework that operationalizes this principle by treating safety as an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection problem.

2602.04605.tldr: RexBERT, a family of BERT-style encoders designed specifically for e-commerce semantics, is introduced and it is demonstrated that high quality in-domain data combined with a principled training approach provides a stronger foundation for e-commerce applications than indiscriminate scaling alone.

2602.04616.tldr: It is concluded that a multidisciplinary approach, merging technical, design, policy, and ethical expertise is essential to successfully embed privacy into the core of HCAI, thereby ensuring these technologies advance in a manner that respects and ensures human autonomy, trust and dignity.

2602.04640.tldr: This position paper outlines how explicit structure, persistent and evolving state, and the integration of execution-grounded feedback can help SE agents perform more coherent and reliable reasoning in long-horizon tasks.

2602.04663.tldr: This work shows that adopting an evidence lower bound (ELBO) based model likelihood estimator is the dominant factor enabling effective, efficient, and stable RL optimization, outweighing the impact of the specific policy-gradient loss functional.

2602.04669.tldr: It is found that RMS-normalized updates yield more stable optimization than first-moment updates, and while spectral compression provides strong stabilization benefits under first-moment updates, the Muon update does not consistently outperform Adam.

2602.04674.tldr: This work test whether LLM-simulated survey respondents, prompted with participant profiles drawn from social survey data measuring network, demographic, attitudinal and behavioral features, can reproduce human patterns of misinformation belief and sharing.

2602.04678.tldr: The continuous Multi-Expert LDL achieves the best overall performance, while the Pattern-Aware LDL-MoE provides enhanced interpretability through component-wise analysis, making them suitable for real-world forecasting applications where both performance and actionable insights are crucial.

2602.04680.tldr: This work proposes to train ControlNet models on top of pre-trained T2A backbones to achieve controllable generation over loudness, pitch, and event roll and extends this framework to audio editing, proposing T2A-Editor for removing and inserting audio events at time locations specified by instructions.

2402.10192.tldr: An inductive bias inspired by the remarkably successful few-body interaction models used in quantum many-body physics is formalized for the classical mePS framework and employed to tackle the exponential complexity associated with naive implementations of hypergraphs.

2506.06571.tldr: This paper proposes SpectRe -- a new topological descriptor for graphs that integrates spectral information into PH diagrams and introduces notions of global and local stability to analyze existing descriptors and establish that SpectRe is locally stable.

2507.06969.tldr: This work determines that bounds on attack success can take the same unified form across re-identification, attribute inference, and data reconstruction risks, and provides a principled framework for interpreting and calibrating the degree of protection in DP against specific levels of re-identification, attribute inference, or data reconstruction risk.

2507.21802.tldr: A novel framework that leverages the flexibility of mixed sampling strategies through the integration of stochastic differential equations (SDE) and ordinary differential equations (ODE) and streamlines the optimization process within the MDP to improve efficiency and boost performance is proposed.

2507.21833.tldr: This work presents a systematic effective field theory analysis of FNOs in an infinite-dimensional function space, deriving closed recursion relations for the layer kernel and four-point vertex and examining three practically important settings-analytic activations, scale-invariant cases and architectures with residual connections.

2509.06165.tldr: UNO (UNified Object-centric VidSGG), a single-stage, unified framework that jointly addresses both tasks within an end-to-end architecture to minimize task-specific modifications and maximize parameter sharing, enabling generalization across different levels of visual granularity is presented.

2509.20645.tldr: This work investigates whether evaluation outcomes can be forecast before any experiments are conducted, and studies text-only performance prediction, where models estimate performance from task descriptions and experimental configurations alone, without access to dataset instances.

2509.24798.tldr: Causal-Adapter is a modular framework that adapts frozen text-to-image diffusion backbones for counterfactual image generation with state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets.

2510.03122.tldr: The HAVIR model, which separates the visual cortex into two hierarchical regions and extracts distinct features from each, enhances both the structural and semantic quality of reconstructions, even in complex scenes, and outperforms existing models.

2510.11955.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that the proposed Y-shaped generative flows method recovers hierarchy-aware structures, improves distributional metrics over strong flow-based baselines, and reaches targets in fewer steps.

2511.17729.tldr: Evaluations of representative state-of-the-art Multimodal LLMs reveal persistent gaps in multimodal MCP tool use, particularly in argument fidelity and structure consistency, underscoring the need for methods that jointly reason over images, text, and tool graphs.

2601.07048.tldr: Jasper builds on the Vamana graph index and overcomes existing bottlenecks via three contributions: a CUDA batch-parallel construction algorithm that enables lock-free streaming insertions, a GPU-efficient implementation of RaBitQ quantization that reduces memory footprint up to 8x without the random access penalties, and an optimized greedy search kernel that increases compute utilization.

2601.08891.tldr: The proposed Explanation-Guided Training (EGT), a multi-objective framework that improves interpretability and consistency in early-exit networks through attention-based regularization, makes early-exit networks more suitable for explainable AI applications in resource-constrained environments.

2601.21343.tldr: This work utilizes an existing strong, post-trained model to both rewrite pretraining data and to judge policy model rollouts, thus using reinforcement earlier in training, and shows this can give strong gains in quality, safety, factuality and reasoning.

2601.21358.tldr: Empirical results reveal a distinct trade-off: while PLaT achieves lower greedy accuracy than baselines, it demonstrates superior scalability in terms of reasoning diversity, which indicates that PLaT learns a robust, broader solution space, offering a transparent and scalable foundation for inference-time search.

2601.23174.tldr: DyCAST is introduced, a Dynamic Character-Aligned Speech Tokenizer that enables variable-frame-rate tokenization through soft character-level alignment and explicit duration modeling and further introduces a retrieval-augmented decoding mechanism that enhances reconstruction fidelity without increasing bitrate.

2602.04712.tldr: By recovering past image examples with known true target types, the proposed SAR-RAG system can compare similar vehicle categories, achieving improved ATR prediction accuracy, and metrics all show improvements when SAR-RAG is added to an MLLM baseline method as an attached ATR memory bank.

2602.04713.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Prompt Elicitation (APE), a technique that adaptively poses visual queries to help users refine prompts without extensive writing, a principled approach to prompting that offers an effective and efficient complement to the prevailing prompt-based interaction paradigm with text-to-image models.

2602.04718.tldr: This work disentangle the decoder matrix into almost orthogonal features, and empirically show that these increasingly orthogonalized features allow for isolated interventions, and finds that the distance between embedded feature explanations increases with stricter orthogonality penalty, a desirable property for interpretability.

2602.04726.tldr: This paper developed an agentic AI solution for automatic test scenario generation from a detailed requirements description, and developed an agentic AI solution for the document retrieval task in the context of software engineering documents.

2602.04735.tldr: Data2Behavior is introduced, a new task for predicting unintended model behaviors prior to training that achieves reliable prediction while consuming only about 20% of the GPU resources required for fine-tuning, and Manipulating Data Features (MDF), a lightweight approach that summarizes candidate data through their mean representations and injects them into the forward pass of a base model.

2602.04739.tldr: It is demonstrated that MLLM harmlessness is neither uniform nor stable across updates, underscoring the need for longitudinal, multimodal benchmarks to track evolving safety behaviour.

2602.04750.tldr: Findings show that contextual prompts significantly boost accuracy, with improvements ranging from +17.5\% to +38.5\%, achieving up to 74\% accuracy that surpasses previous approaches, and underscore the value of incorporating user-level context to enhance LLM performance in nuanced political classification tasks.

2602.04753.tldr: Two comprehensive studies are conducted to explore the perspectives of industry professionals and students on different AML vulnerabilities and their educational strategies and provide detailed recommendations emphasizing the critical need for integrated security education within the ML curriculum.

2602.04763.tldr: A2MAML models each modality-specific feature as a stochastic estimate with uncertainty prediction, actively selects reliable agent-modality pairs, and aggregates information via Bayesian inverse-variance weighting, and provides a principled mechanism to suppress corrupted or noisy modalities.

2602.04768.tldr: The GraphBFF is presented: the first end-to-end recipe for building billion-parameter Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) for arbitrary heterogeneous, billion-scale graphs and the first neural scaling laws for general graphs are presented.

2602.04785.tldr: Empirical results on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate that T$^2$ outperforms state-of-the-art methods in producing high-quality tabular data, highlighting its potential to support downstream models when direct data collection is practically infeasible.

2602.04805.tldr: SkinTokens is introduced: a learned, compact, and discrete representation for skinning weights that leads to a 98%-133% improvement in skinning accuracy over state-of-the-art methods, while the full TokenRig framework, refined with RL, enhances bone prediction by 17%-22%.

2602.04811.tldr: This work introduces SE-Bench, a diagnostic environment that obfuscates the NumPy library and its API doc into a pseudo-novel package with randomized identifiers, establishing a rigorous diagnostic platform for self-evolution with knowledge internalization.

2602.04813.tldr: The findings provide an empirical baseline indicating that current agents excel at retrieval-grounded advising but require stronger adaptation and compliance platforms to move from early-stage systems to dependable systems.

2602.04820.tldr: A machine learning-based model for automated classification of nail diseases based on a publicly available dataset, which contains 3,835 images scaling six categories, could be a helpful support for doctors, making nail disease diagnosis more accurate and faster.

2602.04821.tldr: STREAM-RL, a unified framework to propagate calibrated uncertainty from forecasting through anomaly detection to safe policy learning with end-to-end theoretical guarantees, is presented, the first framework to propagate calibrated uncertainty from forecasting through anomaly detection to safe policy learning with end-to-end theoretical guarantees.

2602.04832.tldr: This work investigates the mechanism by which gradient descent achieves this through analyzing the learning dynamics at the level of individual neurons in single hidden layer ReLU networks, and explains the mechanism behind the lottery ticket conjecture.

2602.04837.tldr: Group-Evolving Agents (GEA) is introduced, a new paradigm for open-ended self-improvements, which treats a group of agents as the fundamental evolutionary unit, enabling explicit experience sharing and reuse within the group throughout evolution.

2602.04843.tldr: A mechanistic analysis of how QwQ-32B - a model specifically trained to produce extensive reasoning traces - process abstract structural information finds that one of the factors driving reasoning model performance is in-context refinement of token representations, which are dubbed Fluid Reasoning Representations.

2602.04849.tldr: El Agente Estructural mimics how human experts directly manipulate molecular systems in three dimensions by integrating a comprehensive set of domain-informed tools and vision-language models, enabling precise control over atomic or functional group replacements, atomic connectivity, and stereochemistry without the need to rebuild extensive core molecular frameworks.

2602.04850.tldr: El Agente Quntur is introduced, a hierarchical, multi-agent AI system designed to operate not merely as an automation tool but as a research collaborator for computational quantum chemistry, and a roadmap toward a fully autonomous end-to-end computational chemistry research agent.

2602.04861.tldr: The results establish BSCT as both a validation metric and as an "in-the-loop" model design proxy that alerts MLIP developers to physical challenges that cannot be efficiently evaluated by current MLIP benchmarks.

2602.04863.tldr: This work introduces Logit-Linear-Selection (LLS), a method that prescribes how to select subsets of a generic preference dataset to elicit a wide range of hidden effects in generic datasets, and applies LLS to discover subsets of real-world datasets so that models trained on them exhibit behaviors ranging from having specific preferences, to responding to prompts in a different language not present in the dataset.

2602.04868.tldr: A novel benchmark suite for CRL based on realistically simulated robots in the Gazebo simulator is introduced, designed to be easily extensible and enables controlled studies of continual reinforcement learning in robotic settings with high physical realism, and in particular allow the use of almost arbitrary simulated sensors.

2602.04872.tldr: A novel, linearized cross-attention mechanism is introduced, which is study in the regime where both the number of cross-attention layers and the context length are large and it is shown that this cross-attention mechanism is provably Bayes optimal when optimized using gradient flow.

2602.04879.tldr: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization is proposed, which substitutes heuristic clipping with a more principled constraint based on a direct estimate of policy divergence (e.g., Total Variation or KL), offering a more robust foundation for RL-based LLM fine-tuning.

2602.04881.tldr: This paper reviews the usage of contrastive continual learning for IoT, connecting algorithmic design (replay, regularization, distillation, prompts) with IoT system realities (TinyML constraints, intermittent connectivity, privacy), and presents a unifying problem formulation and common objectives that blend contrastive and distillation losses.

2602.04883.tldr: Protein autoregressive modeling (PAR) is presented, the first multi-scale autoregressive framework for protein backbone generation via coarse-to-fine next-scale prediction and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization, supporting flexible human-prompted conditional generation and motif scaffolding without requiring fine-tuning.

2403.01673.tldr: A method to Construct Auxiliary Time Series (CATS) is introduced that functions like a 2D temporal-contextual attention mechanism, which generates Auxiliary Time Series (ATS) from Original Time Series (OTS) to effectively represent and incorporate inter-series relationships for forecasting.

2404.15617.tldr: This work introduces Differential Reinforcement Learning (Differential RL), a novel framework that reformulates RL from a continuous-time control perspective via a differential dual formulation that induces a Hamiltonian structure that embeds physics priors and ensures consistent trajectories without requiring explicit constraints.

2405.14982.tldr: This work reformulates time series forecasting tasks as input tokens by constructing a series of (lookback, future) pairs within the tokens, which aligns more closely with the inherent in-context mechanisms, and is more parameter-efficient without the need of using pre-trained LLM parameters.

2406.17835.tldr: This chapter explores some of the fundamentals of robot scientists in the philosophy of science, and maps the activities of a robot scientist to machine learning paradigms, and argues that the scientific method shares an analogy with active learning.

2410.03159.tldr: WAVE attention that incorporates the full ARMA structure into existing autoregressive attention mechanisms is introduced, and it is shown that WAVE attention that incorporates the ARMA structure consistently improves the performance of various AR attentions on TSF tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results.

2410.13431.tldr: A prior error elimination framework based on Optimal Transport (OT) is proposed, providing a universal and rigorous solution for optimizing the performance of DMs and is revealed to be highly compatible with the intrinsic mechanism of the diffusion process.

2412.19755.tldr: An automated data generation framework is developed that leverages LLM hallucinations to mimic common student errors, thereby constructing a dataset of 2,197 instances and evaluating 4 Multimodal Large Language Models, highlighting which MLLMs are better suited for such tasks while also pointing out to drawbacks of the remaining MLLMs.

2501.01741.tldr: EvoTox is presented, an automated testing framework for LLMs’ inclination to toxicity, providing a way to quantitatively assess how much LLMs can be pushed towards toxic responses even in the presence of alignment.

2502.03740.tldr: A novel method, called Multiple Invertible and Partial-Equivariant Transformation (MIPE-Transformation), which integrates two main parts: invertible and Partial-Equivariant Transformation, guaranteeing an invertible latent-to-transformed-latent mapping while preserving partial input-to-latent equivariance in the transformed latent space.

2502.04700.tldr: EigenLoRAx is introduced, a parameter-efficient finetuning method that recycles existing adapters to create a principal subspace aligned with their shared domain knowledge which enables rapid adaptation to new tasks by learning only lightweight coefficients on the principal components of the subspace - eliminating the need to finetune entire adapters.

2502.07244.tldr: This work shows that a single linear attention layer can be interpreted as a dynamic vector autoregressive (VAR) structure, and proposes Structural Aligned Mixture of VAR (SAMoVAR), a linear Transformer variant that integrates interpretable dynamic VAR weights for multivariate TSF.

2502.10154.tldr: EMSYNC is introduced, an automatic video-based symbolic music generator that creates music aligned with a video's emotional content and temporal boundaries that outperforms state-of-the-art models in objective and subjective evaluations across different video datasets.

2502.10311.tldr: This paper shows how a large set of local explanations can be reduced to a small "proxy set" of simple models, which can act as a generative global explanation, and shows that this reduction procedure is competitive with other model aggregation methods.

2502.15798.tldr: This paper analytically decomposes the LS-induced loss, exposing two key terms: a regularization term that dampens overconfidence only when the prediction is correct, and an error-amplification term that arises under misclassifications.

2502.21086.tldr: This work evaluates general-purpose time series models on age prediction, seizure detection, and classification of clinically relevant EEG events to indicate that foundational time series models can reduce the reliance on large task-specific datasets and models, making them valuable in clinical practice.

2503.06749.tldr: This work proposes the reasoning MLLM, Vision-R1, to improve multimodal reasoning capability and proposes Progressive Thinking Suppression Training (PTST) strategy and employs Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with the hard formatting result reward function to gradually refine the model's ability to learn correct and complex reasoning processes on a 10K multimodal math dataset.

2503.18238.tldr: The results suggest AI agents drive changes in productivity, performance, and output diversity by reshaping teamwork by reshaping teamwork.

2503.21843.tldr: This work proposes a spatiotemporal attention modal decomposition alignment fusion strategy to tackle the problem of the mixed distribution of sensor data and conducts experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of the model.

2504.15259.tldr: This work introduces a fully automated, semantically controllable framework for generating PBR-ready 3D facial assets without requiring dedicated scans, and supports controllable face generation and post-editing in real time and exports directly to standard rendering and animation pipelines.

2505.10960.tldr: The Relational Graph Transformer (RelGT), the first graph transformer architecture designed specifically for relational tables, is introduced, establishing Graph Transformers as a powerful architecture for Relational Deep Learning.

2505.17004.tldr: This work proposes a general framework for conditional sampling in PDE-based inverse problems, targeting the recovery of whole solutions from extremely sparse or noisy measurements, and is the first diffusion-based framework to operate independently of discretization.

2505.17406.tldr: The Decoupling Hypothesis is investigated: that correct answers often mask fragile, post-hoc rationalizations that are not causally tied to the model's prediction, and multi-step and commonsense tasks are significantly more susceptible to this decoupling than logical tasks.

2505.20295.tldr: The SelfReflect metric is developed, an information-theoretic distance between a given summary and a distribution over answers of an LLM's actual internal distribution over answers, which shines a light at the universal way of communicating LLM uncertainties whose future development the SelfReflect score enables.

2506.04022.tldr: This work introduces LLE-MORL, an approach that achieves interpretability by design by utilising a training scheme based on the local relationship between the parameter space and the performance space, and provides an interpretation of policy parameters in terms of the objectives.

2506.12474.tldr: A novel Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) framework that captures human-like decision-making by inferring diverse reward functions, enabling robust cross-scenario adaptability in Out-of-Distribution settings that is competitive with fine-tuning is presented.

2506.13342.tldr: This study evaluates 12 pre-trained LLMs and one specialized fact-verifier, including frontier LLMs and open-weight reasoning LLMs, using a collection of examples from 14 fact-checking benchmarks, and discovers that frontier LLMs with few-shot in-context examples, often overlooked in previous works, achieve top-tier performance.

2506.13771.tldr: This paper introduces LittleBit, a novel framework for extreme LLM compression that targets quantization rates as low as $0.1$ bits per weight (BPW), achieving a memory reduction of approximately $31\times, which effectively compresses Llama2-13B to under $0.9$ GB.

2506.14665.tldr: Skala is introduced, a deep learning-based XC functional that surpasses state-of-the-art hybrid functionals in accuracy across the main-group chemistry benchmark set GMTKN55 with an error of 2.8 kcal/mol, while retaining the lower computational cost characteristic of semi-local DFT.

2506.17208.tldr: The first comprehensive study of all submissions to the SWE-Bench Lite and Verified leaderboards is presented, revealing the dominance of proprietary LLMs (especially Claude 3.5), the presence of both agentic and non-agentic designs, and a contributor base spanning from individual developers to large tech companies.

2506.21996.tldr: This framework sheds new light on classical game-solving algorithms, offering rigorous evidence and analytical tools to advance the understanding of these methods under a richer, more challenging, and yet tractable model.

2506.24068.tldr: A novel few-shot-prompted input and output classifier outperforms state-of-the-art open-weight safeguard model ShieldGemma across three attacks and two datasets, and suggests specific mitigations that developers could use to thwart staged attacks.

2507.01028.tldr: This presentation investigates iterative procedures commonly used in non-contrastive approaches to self-supervised learning to avoid representation collapse from the dual viewpoints of optimization and dynamical systems and shows that they are, in general, asymptotically stable.

2507.04756.tldr: CoSteer is proposed, a collaborative framework that enables tuning-free, real-time personalization via decoding-time adaptation, and generates high-quality personalized content, ensuring both effectiveness and computational efficiency.

2507.13579.tldr: This work presents a novel framework, Preference Learning Using Summarization (PLUS), that uses reinforcement learning (RL) to learn to produce text-based summaries of each user's preferences, characteristics, and past conversations that condition the reward model, enabling it to make personalized predictions about the types of responses valued by each user.

2507.16838.tldr: This study proposes self-alignment GOP (GOP-SA) that enables the use of CTC-trained ASR models for MDD, and defines a more general segmentation-free method that takes all possible segmentations of the canonical transcription into account (GOP-SF).

2508.01151.tldr: Sage is introduced, a large-scale dataset capturing diverse safety boundaries across 1,000 simulated user profiles, covering complex risks often missed by traditional datasets and establishing personalization as a vital direction for creating adaptive, user-centered, and responsible generative AI.

2508.02016.tldr: This paper proposes Amadeus, a training-free framework that can significantly enhance persona consistency even when responding to questions that lie beyond a character's knowledge, and finds that the proposed method effectively models not only the knowledge possessed by characters, but also various attributes such as personality.

2508.02276.tldr: This work introduces CellForge, a multi-agent framework that autonomously designs and synthesizes neural network architectures tailored to specific single-cell datasets and perturbation tasks, and demonstrates that the models generated by CellForge are highly competitive with established baselines, while revealing systematic patterns of architectural innovation.

2508.04349.tldr: Dynamic Entropy Weighting is proposed, which systematically define entropy-based weight ratios and similar variants to redistribute rewards and get fine-grained rewards through two new algorithms: Group Token Policy Optimization (GTPO), which assigns an entropy-weighted reward to each token and synthesizes token-specific advantage function to drive the model toward optimal path.

2508.06616.tldr: For the first time in the literature, a hierarchical framework built on Mamba-SSM is proposed that introduces GenAI across all stages of the IDN pipeline, and significantly improves network performance through intelligent automation, surpassing existing IDN approaches.

2508.18175.tldr: It is demonstrated that deep learning enables the design of scalable and transferable samplers by introducing Prose, a 285 million parameter all-atom transferable normalizing flow trained on a corpus of peptide molecular dynamics trajectories up to 8 residues in length.

2508.21051.tldr: It is shown how combining up-front translation of plain-text rules into formal logic programs, combined with intelligently retrieved exemplars for formal case representations, can dramatically improve performance on this task and reduce costs to well below real-world averages.

2509.03493.tldr: This work proposes AEnt, an entropy control method that utilizes a new clamped entropy bonus with an automatically adjusted coefficient, and it is observed that AEnt outperforms the baselines consistently across multiple benchmarks.

2509.03531.tldr: An annotation methodology that leverages web search to annotate model responses with grounded labels indicating which tokens correspond to fabricated entities, and finds that annotated responses from one model can be used to train effective classifiers on other models to facilitate reuse.

2509.06690.tldr: This work introduces a lightweight semantic segmentation framework tailored for real-time bioprinting applications, and proposes a BioLite U-Net architecture that leverages depthwise separable convolutions to drastically reduce computational load without compromising accuracy.

2509.11298.tldr: Opal, a canonicalization algorithm that determines whether two preference objectives are algebraically equivalent by producing either a canonical form or a concrete witness of non-equivalence is introduced.

2509.16295.tldr: This work analyzes 637 GitHub repositories to trace transitions from founder-led to shared governance, and document trajectories to community governance by extracting institutional roles, actions, and deontic cues from version-controlled project constitutions GOVERNANCE .md.

2509.19391.tldr: TensLoRA is introduced, a unified framework that aggregates LoRA updates into higher-order tensors and models a broad family of tensor-based low-rank adaptations, allowing parameter budgets to be tailored according to the modality and task.

2509.22352.tldr: SurvDiff is the first end-to-end diffusion model explicitly designed for generating synthetic survival data and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative baselines in both distributional fidelity and survival model evaluation metrics across multiple medical datasets.

2510.00771.tldr: A vocoder-free framework for audio super-resolution that employs a flow matching generative model to capture the conditional distribution of complex-valued spectral coefficients and directly reconstructs waveforms via the inverse Short-Time Fourier Transform (iSTFT), thereby eliminating the dependence on a separate vocoder.

2510.02345.tldr: This work demonstrates that structural reorganization is a principled path toward scalable, efficient, and memory-effective MoE LLMs.

2510.02480.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach to limit the degree to which harmful context can degrade model performance, using distribution-free risk control (DFRC) to control the extent to which the user-provided context can decay performance below this safe zero-shot baseline.

2510.03969.tldr: This work proposes C$^3LLM, a novel, principled statistical Certification framework for Catastrophic risks in multi-turn Conversation for LLMs that bounds the probability of an LLM generating catastrophic responses under multi-turn conversation distributions with statistical guarantees.

2510.08176.tldr: This work introduces WEALY, a fully reproducible pipeline that leverages Whisper decoder embeddings for lyrics matching tasks, and establishes robust and transparent baselines, while also exploring multimodal extensions that integrate textual and acoustic features.

2510.08667.tldr: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework that integrates Sentence-Transformers for semantic embeddings with FAISS-based vector search to deliver context-aware ticket resolution recommendations and significantly improves resolution accuracy, fix quality, and knowledge reuse in modern DevOps environments is proposed.

2510.08859.tldr: Evaluating PE-CoA on twelve LLMs spanning ten harm categories achieves state-of-the-art performance and uncovers pattern-specific vulnerabilities and LLM behavioral characteristics, highlighting limitations of safety training and indicating the need for pattern-aware defenses.

2510.09712.tldr: AdComment, an adaptive adversarial training framework for robustness enhancement against diverse malicious comments, is proposed, which categorize adversarial comments into Fact Distortion, Logical Confusion, and Emotional Manipulation, and leverage LLMs to synthesize diverse, category-specific perturbations.

2510.11300.tldr: An agent-based approach toward a more natural interface between humans and machines that enables operators to talk or text with machines and is universally designed and can be applied to any machine that supports the OPC UA standard.

2510.17196.tldr: This work establishes a new state-of-the-art for training-free length extrapolation, successfully generalizing models trained on a 4K context to 32 million tokens on RULER and BABILong and provides a theoretical motivation for intra-chunk information processing and landmark generation.

2510.17314.tldr: This work introduces a training-free framework based on iterative rubric learning that locally induces discriminative criteria via verification-driven refinement, and globally compresses the candidate criteria pool into a compact core set by maximizing an information-theoretic coding rate objective.

2510.18713.tldr: This work adopts the Plackett-Luce model for ranking feedback over action subsets and proposes M-AUPO, an algorithm that selects multiple actions by maximizing the average uncertainty within the offered subset, and establishes a near-matching lower bound of $K$, which is the maximum subset size.

2510.21618.tldr: To teach general-purpose tool use efficiently and stably, an end-to-end reinforcement learning strategy, namely ToolPO, is developed that leverages LLM-simulated APIs and applies tool-call advantage attribution to assign fine-grained credit to the tool invocation tokens.

2510.22031.tldr: Empirical evaluations demonstrate the robust performance of the proposed gradient-based optimization of conditional independence constraints approach in low-sample regimes, surpassing traditional constraint-based and score-based baselines on a real-world dataset.

2510.25502.tldr: TempoPFN, a univariate time series foundation model based on linear Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) pre-trained exclusively on synthetic data, achieves top-tier competitive performance, outperforming all existing synthetic-only approaches and surpassing the majority of models trained on real-world data.

2510.25634.tldr: This paper introduces a hierarchical framework that frames this challenge of long-horizon contact-rich bimanual manipulation as an integrated skill planning&scheduling problem, going beyond purely sequential decision-making to support simultaneous skill invocation.

2511.11007.tldr: VisMem is proposed, a cognitively-aligned framework that equips VLMs with dynamic latent vision memories, a short-term module for fine-grained perceptual retention and a long-term module for abstract semantic consolidation, allowing VLMs to maintain both perceptual fidelity and semantic consistency across thinking and generation.

2511.15120.tldr: This work demonstrates the ability of neural networks to effectively learn hierarchical functions with respect to both sample and time efficiency.

2511.16886.tldr: This work shows how a policy improvement perspective on recursive steps can explain model behavior and provide insights for further improvements, and proposes to use a training schemes from reinforcement learning and diffusion methods for latent reasoning models.

2512.04949.tldr: CARL is proposed, a critical-action-focused reinforcement learning algorithm tailored for long-horizon agentic reasoning that leverages entropy as a heuristic proxy for action criticality and achieves focused training by assigning rewards to high-criticality actions while excluding low-criticality actions from model updates, avoiding noisy credit assignment and redundant computation.

2512.10962.tldr: A scalable data synthesis pipeline is introduced that transforms noisy rollouts into reliable supervision without human annotation and establishes step-level filtering as a key principle for scalable CUA training and construct two new datasets and a lightweight process reward model as practical tools to advance robust and efficient CUAs.

2601.05828.tldr: This work investigates the influence of parallel processing within hardware accelerators on correlation-based side-channel attacks that exploit power consumption and derives equations that describe how the correlation decreases with increasing levels of parallelism.

2601.07209.tldr: A synthetic dataset generation framework that path-traces 3D glass models over real background imagery to create physically accurate reflection scenarios with varied glass properties, camera settings, and post-processing effects is introduced.

2601.08641.tldr: This work proposes a manipulation-resistant copy-trading system based on a multi-agent architecture powered by a multi-modal large language model (LLM) and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, demonstrating the effectiveness of agent-based defenses and predictability of trader profitability in adversarial meme coin markets.

2601.09361.tldr: Geometry-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation is proposed, a low-rank adaptation method tailored for RLVR that exploits the anisotropic and compressible structure of RL update subspace, and extracts its principal directions via Singular Value Decomposition to initialize low-rank adapters, while freezing residual components as a structural anchor during training.

2601.11049.tldr: The GPT-4 family consistently aligned with human behavior, outperforming GPT-5 and open-source models in both predictive accuracy and fidelity to human-like bias patterns.

2601.12535.tldr: This work investigates a self-supervised reinforcement learning fine-tuning for translation in low-resource settings using round-trip bootstrapping with the No Language Left Behind (NLLB) family of models and argues that this method can further benefit from scale, enabling models to increasingly leverage their pretrained knowledge and continue self-improving.

2601.13948.tldr: Stream-Voice-Anon is presented, which adapts modern causal LM-based NAC architectures specifically for streaming SA by integrating anonymization techniques, and achieves substantial improvements in intelligibility and emotion preservation compared to the previous state-of theart streaming method DarkStream.

2601.15075.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework reliably pinpoints pivotal historical events and sentences behind the agent behavior, offering a critical step toward safer and more accountable agentic systems.

2601.15397.tldr: This work introduces LOGIC (Logit-Space Integration for Contextual Biasing), an efficient and robust framework that operates directly in the decoding layer that decouples context injection from input processing, ensuring constant-time complexity relative to prompt length.
