2602.06256.tldr: This work provides the first systematic evaluation of specificity in model steering, showing that standard efficacy and specificity checks are insufficient, because without robustness evaluation, steering methods may appear reliable even when they compromise model safety.

2602.06258.tldr: It is shown that a single unlabeled prompt is sufficient to reliably unalign safety-aligned models while largely preserving their utility, and that GRP-Oblit achieves stronger unalignment on average than existing state-of-the-art techniques.

2602.06260.tldr: This systematic study has three dimensions: which stance is induced in the LLM response, how the polemic question is formulated, and how the arguments are shown and remarkably finds that opinion steering occurs across (i)-(iii) for diverse models, number of arguments, and topics.

2602.06286.tldr: The approach provides falsifiable conditions under which the reported probabilities cannot correspond to the true beliefs of any rational agent and is applied to multiple medical diagnostic domains with evaluations across several LLMs.

2602.06287.tldr: It is shown that incorporating output noise improves the representation of climate relevant multiscale variability, and a simple method to achieve this is proposed, and is proposed a simple method to achieve this.

2602.06300.tldr: A novel approach that restructures the Vision Transformer by replacing linear layers and layer normalization operations with carefully designed convolutional operators enables DeiT to fully utilize the acceleration capabilities of BPUs, while allowing the original weight parameters to be inherited by the restructured models without retraining or fine-tuning.

2602.06319.tldr: GrAlgoBench is introduced, a benchmark designed to evaluate LRMs through graph algorithm problems, which establishes graph algorithm problems as a rigorous, multidimensional, and practically relevant testbed for advancing the study of reasoning in LRMs.

2602.06337.tldr: CauGym, a comprehensive dataset comprising seven core causal tasks for training and five diverse test sets, provides the first systematic evidence that targeted post-training can produce reliable and robust LLM-based causal reasoners.

2602.06339.tldr: Focusing on latent-variable generative policies, it is shown that hallucinations often arise from structural mismatches between feasible robot behavior and common model architectures, and three such barriers are studied -- topological, precision, and horizon -- and how they impose unavoidable tradeoffs.

2602.06345.tldr: This work proposes a zero-trust runtime verification framework that enforces explicit context binding and consume-once mandate semantics using dynamically generated, time-bound nonces, ensuring that authorization decisions are evaluated at execution time rather than assumed from static issuance properties.

2602.06351.tldr: Trifuse is proposed, an attention-based grounding framework that explicitly integrates complementary spatial anchors in GUI images and integrates attention, OCR-derived textual cues, and icon-level caption semantics via a Consensus-SinglePeak (CS) fusion strategy that enforces cross-modal agreement while retaining sharp localization peaks.

2602.06358.tldr: A scalable hypernetwork that can map diverse meaningful contexts into high-quality LoRA adapters for large language models (LLM) by reusing the frozen LLM's own parameters in an in-context hypernetwork design and introducing architectural innovations, SHINE overcomes key limitations of prior hypernetworks and achieves strong expressive power with a relatively small number of parameters.

2602.06359.tldr: Orthogonal Gradient Selection (OGS) is proposed, a data-centric method that harmonizes domain performance, general capability retention, and training efficiency that ensures naturally safe updates for target models without modifying the optimizer or incurring runtime projection costs.

2602.06369.tldr: This work proposes Observer-Centric Salient Object Detection (OC-SOD), where salient regions are predicted by considering not only the visual cues but also the observer-specific factors such as their preferences or intents, enabling personalized and context-aware saliency prediction.

2602.06375.tldr: This paper proposes Difficulty-Estimated Policy Optimization (DEPO), a novel framework designed to optimize the efficiency and robustness of reasoning alignment, and demonstrates that DEPO achieves up to a 2x reduction in rollout costs without compromising model performance.

2602.06390.tldr: A simple, model agnostic post processing framework that can be applied on top of any synthetic data generator to improve the quality and empirical privacy of synthetic tabular data, while complementing approaches that provide formal differential privacy guarantees are studied.

2602.06394.tldr: This work presents QA-Token (Quality-Aware Tokenization), which incorporates data reliability directly into vocabulary construction and makes three key contributions: a bilevel optimization formulation that jointly optimizes vocabulary construction and downstream performance, a reinforcement learning approach that learns merge policies through quality-aware rewards with convergence guarantees, and an adaptive parameter learning mechanism via Gumbel-Softmax relaxation for end-to-end optimization.

2602.06395.tldr: An empirical study of adversarial robustness and explainability drift across two cybersecurity domains phishing URL classification and network intrusion detection and introduces a quantitative metric, the Robustness Index (RI), defined as the area under the accuracy perturbation curve.

2602.06400.tldr: TFusionOcc is presented, a T-primitive-based object-centric multi-sensor fusion framework for 3D semantic occupancy prediction, including a family of Students t-distribution-based T-primitives, including the plain T-primitive, T-Superquadric, and deformable T-Superquadric with inverse warping.

2602.06413.tldr: This work derives Theorem~A, showing that decision advantage in single-path autoregressive reasoning decays exponentially with execution length, imposing a fundamental bound on maintainable reasoning chains, which implies a structural consequence: stable long-horizon reasoning requires discrete segmentation.

2602.06430.tldr: This study investigated the validity of Plutchik's wheel of emotion by creating and analyzing a semantic networks of emotion words and showed that each network's structure was, for the most part, similar to that of the wheel of emotion, but locally different.

2602.06431.tldr: This study examines the hierarchical structure of financial needs as articulated in social media discourse, employing generative AI techniques to analyze large-scale textual data and provides novel insights into the content and themes of financial discussions online.

2602.06440.tldr: A history-aware RL-based jailbreak framework that analyzes and reweights vulnerability signals from prior steps to guide future decisions and offers a principled pathway for advancing adversarial research on LLM safeguards is proposed.

2602.06443.tldr: This work forms the task of Trajectory Anomaly Detection, a critical capability for enabling trustworthy LLM agents and proposes TrajAD, a specialized verifier trained with fine-grained process supervision, demonstrating that specialized supervision is essential for building trustworthy agents.

2602.06446.tldr: CORE (Comprehensive Ontological Relation Evaluation), a dataset of 225K multiple-choice questions spanning 74 disciplines, together with a general-domain open-source benchmark of 203 rigorously validated questions covering 24 semantic relation types with equal representation of unrelated pairs is introduced.

2602.06448.tldr: PiEvo, a principle-evolvable framework that treats scientific discovery as Bayesian optimization over an expanding principle space, enables agents to autonomously refine their theoretical worldview by integrating Information-Directed Hypothesis Selection via Gaussian Process and an anomaly-driven augmentation mechanism.

2302.11337.tldr: This book is primarily a summary of purpose, significance of important Bayesian matrix decomposition methods, e.g., real-valued decomposition, nonnegative matrix factorization, Bayesian interpolative decomposition and the origin and complexity of the methods which shed light on their applications.

2410.09771.tldr: A new class of dense layers that generalize standard fully-connected feedforward layers, EuGens, that reduce the parameter count and computational overhead while preserving the expressive power and adaptability of FFLs and leads to the first unbiased algorithms approximating FFLs with arbitrary polynomial activation functions.

2411.18212.tldr: This paper proposes SCoTT, a wireless-aware path planning framework that leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to co-optimize average path gains and trajectory length using wireless heatmap images and ray-tracing data from a digital twin (DT).

2501.00382.tldr: It is shown that the resulting embeddings substantially improve the predictive accuracy of sales ranks and prices and that they lead to more credible causal estimates of price elasticity, uncovering strong heterogeneity in price elasticity driven by these product-specific features.

2501.15802.tldr: This paper proposes a hybrid framework using Graph Neural Network embeddings and collaborative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) for efficient, adaptive and scalable resource management in the Cloud-Edge Continuum.

2501.16093.tldr: This work proposes a stepwise task augmentation framework with relation learning that decomposes ASQP into a sequence of auxiliary subtasks with increasing relational granularity, and incrementally constructs auxiliary data by augmenting the training data with pairwise and overall relation tasks.

2502.16174.tldr: Multi-Layer Prototype Moderator is introduced, a lightweight and highly customizable input moderation tool that integrates smoothly into end-to-end moderation pipelines and further improves response safety when combined with output moderation techniques.

2504.13707.tldr: OpenDeception is introduced, a lightweight framework for jointly evaluating deception risk from both sides of human-AI dialogue that consists of a scenario benchmark with 50 real-world deception cases, an IntentNet that infers deceptive intent from agent reasoning, and a TrustNet that estimates user susceptibility.

2506.06522.tldr: This work conducts the first comprehensive side-by-side analysis of two prominent open post-training datasets, Tulu-3-SFT-Mix and SmolTalk, and designs a principled curation recipe that produces a new data mixture, TuluTalk, which contains 14% fewer samples than either source dataset while matching or exceeding their performance on key benchmarks.

2506.07822.tldr: This work proposes a novel approach to consistency distillation for offline reinforcement learning that directly incorporates reward optimization into the distillation process and achieves single-step sampling while generating higher-reward action trajectories through decoupled training and noise-free reward signals.

2506.08618.tldr: Poly2Graph is introduced: a high-performance, open-source pipeline that automates the mapping of 1-D crystal Hamiltonians to spectral graphs, and HSG-12M is presented, the first large-scale dataset of spatial multigraphs -- graphs embedded in a metric space where multiple geometrically distinct trajectories between two nodes are retained as separate edges.

2506.12014.tldr: This pioneering study investigates the impact of LLMs on code style, with a focus on naming conventions, complexity, maintainability, and similarity, and identifies measurable trends in the evolution of coding style that align with characteristics of LLM-generated code.

2507.02735.tldr: Results show that Meta SecAlign, despite being trained only on generic instruction-tuning samples, surprisingly confers security in unseen downstream tasks, including tool-calling and web-navigation, in addition to general instruction-following.

2507.02917.tldr: E Echo State Transformers (EST), a hybrid architecture that resolves this challenge while demonstrating state of the art performance in classification and detection tasks, and leverages several reservoirs in parallel as a lightweight and efficient working memory.

2507.04341.tldr: This work empirically shows that ratio-matching performed by minimizing the denoising cross-entropy between the clean and corrupted data enables models to outperform those utilizing score-entropy with up to 10% lower perplexity/generative-perplexity, and 15% faster training steps.

2507.05820.tldr: Constella is designed, an LLM-based multi-agent tool that supports storywriters’ interconnected character creation process and discusses how multi-agent interactions can help distribute writers’ attention and effort across the character cast.

2507.16184.tldr: Agentic Flow thus functions as an implementation instance of the Structured Cognitive Loop, illustrating how a unified cognitive form can emerge not from abstraction, but from the necessities of real-world reasoning.

2508.01309.tldr: D-SCoRE is introduced, a training-free framework that leverages LLMs and prompt engineering to automatically generate diverse, rich QA datasets with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) from arbitrary textual sources to enable rapid, high-performance domain-adaptive fine-tuning on consumer-grade hardware.

2508.06214.tldr: This work establishes that under sample reuse, RPG naturally optimizes a PPO-style surrogate objective via Backpropagation Through Time, providing a unified framework for both on- and off-policy updates, and integrates a clipped policy gradient mechanism tailored for RPG and employs explicit Kullback-Leibler divergence regularization.

2508.12840.tldr: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are exploited to learn patterns and relational structures within epistemic states, to guide the planning process, and integrate predictive heuristics into an epistemic planning pipeline and evaluate them against standard baselines, showing improvements in the scalability of multi-agent epistemic planning.

2510.00468.tldr: It is provided evidence that eigenanalysis of the empirical neural tangent kernel (eNTK) can surface the features used by trained neural networks and that the evolution of the eNTK spectrum can be used to diagnose the grokking phase transition.

2510.07210.tldr: A novel hybrid learning-assisted planning method for solving the collision-free navigation problem for self-driving cars in partially observable traffic environments that combines methods for multi-agent behavior prediction, deep reinforcement learning with proximal policy optimization and approximated online POMDP planning with heuristic confidence-based vertical pruning.

2510.10216.tldr: TyFlow is a novel system that internalizes type reasoning within code generation to guide the model to learn the type system, enabling a new code representation based on synthesis decision sequences rather than traditional text-based token sequences.

2510.13215.tldr: Pxplore is introduced, a novel framework for PLPP that integrates a reinforcement-based training paradigm and an LLM-driven educational architecture that designs a structured learner state model and an automated reward function that transforms abstract objectives into computable signals.

2510.14444.tldr: This work revisits post-pruning adaptation and study local reconstruction, and identifies a broad "free lunch" regime in reconstruction granularity: across a wide range of submodel sizes, final quality remains essentially unchanged, allowing granularity to be chosen based on memory constraints.

2510.19585.tldr: This study establishes a comprehensive baseline for processing Latin within mixed-language corpora, supporting quantitative analysis in intellectual history and historical linguistics and demonstrating that reliable Latin detection with contemporary zero-shot models is achievable, yet these models lack a functional comprehension of Latin.

2510.23912.tldr: Validating the Query weight removal on decoder-only GPT-style small models trained from scratch, it is found that reduced models match baseline performance despite fewer parameters, and outperform baselines when saved parameters are reallocated.

2511.00732.tldr: A novel, fully-programmable RISC-V-based system-on-chip (FeNN-DMA), tailored to simulating SNNs on modern UltraScale+ FPGAs, which shows that FeNN-DMA has comparable resource usage and energy requirements to state-of-the-art fixed-function SNN accelerators, yet it supports more complex neuron models and network topologies.

2511.10936.tldr: It is demonstrated that GraphToxin can successfully subvert the regulatory guarantees expected from graph unlearning, it can recover not only a deleted individual's information and personal links but also sensitive content from their connections, thereby posing substantially more detrimental threats.

2512.04904.tldr: Investigation of the root causes of exposure bias in Flow Matching finds that the model lacks generalization to biased inputs during training, and insufficient low-frequency content captured during early denoising, leading to accumulated bias, and proposes ReflexFlow, a simple and effective reflexive refinement of the Flow Matching learning objective that dynamically corrects exposure bias.

2512.15922.tldr: A novel RAG framework is proposed that uses a spreading activation algorithm to retrieve information from a corpus of documents connected by an automatically constructed heterogeneous knowledge graph and achieves better or comparable performance to several state-of-the-art RAG methods and can be integrated as a plug-and-play module with different iterative RAG pipelines.

2512.22894.tldr: It is shown that dark patterns are highly effective in steering agent trajectories, posing a significant risk to agent robustness, and DECEPTICON, an environment for testing individual dark patterns in isolation, is introduced, an environment for testing individual dark patterns in isolation.

2512.24985.tldr: This work presents DarkEQA, an open-source benchmark for evaluating EQA-relevant perceptual primitives under multi-level low-light conditions, and systematically reveals VLMs'limitations when operating under these challenging visual conditions.

2601.08052.tldr: A Deep Reinforcement Learning framework for efficient load scheduling in dairy farms, focusing on battery storage and water heating under realistic operational constraints is proposed, demonstrating scalability and effectiveness for sustainable energy management in modern dairy farming.

2601.08776.tldr: This report presents struecture of a CycleGAN model for unpaired image-to-image translation from microscopy to pseudo H\&E stained histopathology images.

2601.18226.tldr: The In-Situ Self-Evolving paradigm is proposed, which treats sequential task interactions as a continuous stream of experience, enabling the system to distill short-term execution feedback into long-term, reusable capabilities without access to ground-truth labels.

2601.18282.tldr: This work proposes Think-Augmented Function Calling (TAFC), a novel framework that enhances function calling accuracy through explicit reasoning at both function and parameter levels, and proposes reasoning-guided optimization to align generated reasoning with human expectations.

2601.18642.tldr: FadeMem is proposed, a biologically-inspired agent memory architecture that incorporates active forgetting mechanisms mirroring human cognitive efficiency and consolidates related information while allowing irrelevant details to fade, validating the effectiveness of biologically-inspired forgetting in agent memory systems.

2601.19311.tldr: Results show that smaller open-weights models can lower energy usage while preserving task quality, and a comparative analysis across language models of varying scales shows that smaller open-weights models can lower energy usage while preserving task quality.

2601.19585.tldr: LLM-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning is proposed, a novel hierarchical recommendation framework that integrates the semantic planning power of LLM with the fine-grained adaptability of RL and significantly improves long-term user satisfaction when compared with state-of-the-art baselines.

2602.00169.tldr: This survey charts a practical roadmap towards autonomous, safety-aware LLM agents aimed at discovering novel and useful materials and contrast passive, reactive approaches with agentic design, cataloging current contributions while motivating systems that pursue long-horizon goals with autonomy, memory, and tool use.

2602.00329.tldr: This work demonstrates that data attribution is inherently optimizer-dependent: it is shown that SGD-based proxies diverge significantly from true contributions under Adam, rendering them ineffective for modern training pipelines and proposes Adam-Aware In-Run Data Shapley, a closed-form approximation that restores additivity by redefining utility under a fixed-state assumption.

2602.00731.tldr: This survey outlines the context of modern maintenance, defines key concepts, establishes a generalized framework, reviews current modeling approaches and challenges, and introduces the proposed focus on Neuro-symbolic AI (NESY).

2602.02262.tldr: OmniCode is proposed, a novel software engineering benchmark that contains a broader and more diverse set of task categories beyond code or patch generation and aims to serve as a robust benchmark and spur the development of agents that can perform well across different aspects of software development.

2602.02546.tldr: D$^2$Quant is proposed, a novel weight-only PTQ framework that improves quantization from both the weight and activation perspectives, and a Dual-Scale Quantizer (DSQ) tailored to down-projection matrices, with an absorbable scaling factor that significantly improves accuracy without increasing the bit budget.

2602.02614.tldr: This survey adopts a storage-centric view of system testing and organizes existing techniques according to the execution properties and failure mechanisms they target, and examines fuzzing as an automated testing paradigm.

2602.03868.tldr: This paper presents a benchmarking framework for evaluating ASR performance in agricultural contexts across Hindi, Telugu, and Odia languages, and introduces evaluation metrics including Agriculture Weighted Word Error Rate (AWWER) and domain-specific utility scoring to complement traditional metrics.

2602.04009.tldr: Experiments across text-to-image, text-to-text, and image-captioning settings demonstrate that PromptSplit accurately detects ground-truth behavioral differences and isolates the prompts responsible, offering an interpretable tool for detecting where generative models disagree.

2602.04210.tldr: This work proposes Scalable Interactive Oversight, a framework that decomposes complex intent into a recursive tree of manageable decisions to amplify human supervision and demonstrates that this framework can be optimized via Reinforcement Learning using only online user feedback, offering a practical pathway for maintaining human control as AI scales.

2602.05027.tldr: Sparse Autoencoders are trained across all encoder layers of Whisper and HuBERT, an extensive evaluation of their stability, interpretability, and practical utility is provided, and SAE features correlated with human EEG activity during speech perception are found, indicating alignment with human neural processing.

2602.05305.tldr: This work identifies an underexplored property of block diffusion: cross-step redundancy of attention within a block, and proposes FlashBlock, a cached block-external attention mechanism that reuses stable attention output, reducing attention computation and KV cache access without modifying the diffusion process.

2602.05353.tldr: This work proposes AgentXRay, a search-based framework that formulates AWR as a combinatorial optimization problem over discrete agent roles and tool invocations in a chain-structured workflow space, and achieves higher proxy similarity and reduces token consumption compared to unpruned search, enabling deeper workflow exploration under fixed iteration budgets.

2602.05386.tldr: This work proposes Spider-Sense framework, an event-driven defense framework based on Intrinsic Risk Sensing (IRS), which allows agents to maintain latent vigilance and trigger defenses only upon risk perception, and introduces S$^2$Bench, a lifecycle-aware benchmark featuring realistic tool execution and multi-stage attacks.

2602.06470.tldr: UNO (User log-driveN Optimization), a unified framework for improving LLM systems (LLMsys) with user logs that first distills logs into semi-structured rules and preference pairs, then employs query-and-feedback-driven clustering to manage data heterogeneity, and finally quantifies the cognitive gap between the model's prior knowledge and the log data.

2602.06471.tldr: A Transformer variant is developed that replaces the conventional FFN with a deeper hourglass-shaped FFN, comprising a stack of hourglass sub-MLPs connected by residual pathways to prompt a rethinking of the narrow-wide-narrow MLP convention and the balance between attention and FFN towards efficient and expressive modern language models.

2602.06476.tldr: Prism is a parameter sharing framework that induces inter-agent diversity by representing shared networks in the spectral domain via singular value decomposition (SVD), which encourages inter-agent diversity and preserves scalability.

2602.06478.tldr: This work proposes Efficient-LVSM, a dual-stream architecture that achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to unseen view counts, and enables incremental inference with KV-cache, thanks to its decoupled designs.

2602.06485.tldr: The first systematic study on training agentic models at the 4B-parameter scale is presented, and a holistic training framework featuring parameter-space model fusion, reward signal denoising, and contextual information refinement is introduced.

2602.06486.tldr: Experiments on BizBench show that JADE improves evaluation stability and reveals critical agent failure modes missed by holistic LLM-based evaluators, and strong alignment with expert-authored rubrics and effective transfer to a medical-domain benchmark, validating JADE across professional domains.

2602.06526.tldr: DREAM is proposed, a multi-round debate-based relevance assessment framework with LLM agents, built on opposing initial stances and iterative reciprocal critique that yields more accurate labeling for certain cases and more reliable AI-to-human escalation for uncertain ones.

2602.06527.tldr: HyPER is proposed, a training-free online control policy for multi-path decoding in mixture-of-experts models that reallocates computation under a fixed budget using lightweight path statistics and consistently achieves a superior accuracy-compute trade-off.

2602.06533.tldr: LogicSkills is introduced, a benchmark that isolates three fundamental logical skills: Translating premises into first-order logic, showing that an argument is logically invalid by constructing a finite countermodel, and determining whether a conclusion follows from a set of premises.

2602.06540.tldr: This work presents AgentCPM-Report, a lightweight yet high-performing local solution composed of a framework that mirrors the human writing process and an 8B-parameter deep research agent that outperforms leading closed-source systems, with substantial gains in Insight.

2602.06546.tldr: This work releases MTQE.en-he, the first publicly available English-Hebrew benchmark for Machine Translation Quality Estimation, which contains 959 English segments from WMT24++ paired with a machine translation into Hebrew, and Direct Assessment scores of the translation quality annotated by three human experts.

2602.06547.tldr: This work constructs the first labeled dataset of malicious agent skills by behaviorally verifying 98,380 skills from two community registries, confirming 157 malicious skills with 632 vulnerabilities.

2602.06550.tldr: DMA*-SH is proposed, a framework where a single hypernetwork, trained solely via dynamics prediction, generates a small set of adapter weights shared across the dynamics model, policy, and action-value function, which imparts an inductive bias matched to actuator inversion.

2602.06554.tldr: This paper systematically analyzes how different combinations of policy update mechanisms and advantage estimation methods affect convergence properties in single/multi-turn scenarios and proposes SeeUPO (Sequence-level Sequential Update Policy Optimization), a critic-free approach with convergence guarantees for multi-turn interactions.

2602.06556.tldr: This work systematically rethinks VLA benchmarking from both evaluation and data perspectives, introducing LIBERO-X, a benchmark featuring a hierarchical evaluation protocol with progressive difficulty levels targeting three core capabilities: spatial generalization, object recognition, and task instruction understanding.

2602.06557.tldr: A novel alignment gain metric is introduced that quantifies the geometric distortion between the input signal and label subspaces that yields a principled, computation-efficient criterion to rank and select the optimal GSO for any prediction task prior to training, eliminating the need for extensive search.

2602.06574.tldr: A transformer-based neural network is introduced to fit parameters such as metabolite concentrations, exchange and relaxation rates of a physical model derived from Bloch-McConnell equations to in-vitro CEST spectra and it is shown that the self-supervised trained neural network clearly outperforms the solution of classical gradient-based solver.

2602.06577.tldr: It is shown that in some scenarios CVNNs are more robust than RVNNs and that both are very susceptible to phase changes with the Phase Attacks decreasing the model performance more, than equally strong regular attacks, which can attack both phase and magnitude.

2602.06578.tldr: It is shown that the choice of $\ell_1$ or $\ell_2$ is suboptimal in most cases and the optimal $p$ value is dependent on the specific task, highlighting the importance of principled norm selection when designing and evaluating adversarial attacks.

2602.06585.tldr: Noise-based pre-training offers a lightweight and general alternative to traditional random initialization, enabling more efficient optimization of deep neural networks, and is particularly effective for implicit neural representations and Deep Image Prior (DIP)-style networks.

2602.06592.tldr: This work presents ProtoQuant, a novel architecture that achieves prototype stability and grounded interpretability through latent vector quantization through latent vector quantization by constraining prototypes to a discrete learned codebook within the latent space.

2602.06593.tldr: AgentStepper is introduced, the first interactive debugger for LLM-based software engineering agents, that enables developers to inspect, control, and interactively manipulate agent trajectories and improves the ability of participants to interpret trajectories.

2602.06596.tldr: The results suggest that personality-based personalisation in behaviour change systems may operate primarily through aggregate exposure rather than per-message optimisation, with implications for how adaptive systems are designed and evaluated in sustained human-AI interaction.

2602.06599.tldr: JBR is introduced, a drop-in modification to PSRO that collects trajectories once under the current meta-strategy profile and reuses this joint dataset to compute BRs for all agents simultaneously, which amortizes environment interaction and improves the sample efficiency of best-response computation.

2602.06602.tldr: Speech Diffusion Tokenizer (SiTok), a diffusion autoencoder that jointly learns semantic-rich representations through supervised learning and enables high-fidelity audio reconstruction with diffusion and enables low bit rates and low token rates.

2602.06609.tldr: This review aims to synthesise the current state‐of‐the‐practice in this domain of high‐level system testing of applications that use data from e‐Government services as input.

2602.06613.tldr: DAVE isolates locally equivariant and stable components of the effective input--output mapping of ViTs from architecture-induced artifacts and other sources of instability by exploiting architectural properties of ViTs.

2602.06627.tldr: This work derives Bhattacharyya-TRPO (BTRPO) and Bhattacharyya-PPO (BPPO), enforcing overlap constraints via square-root ratio updates, suggesting overlap constraints as a practical, principled alternative to KL for stable policy optimization.

2602.06652.tldr: A representation-aware and frequency-aware evaluation framework that measures internal embedding drift, spectral sensitivity, and structural smoothness (spatial consistency of vision tokens), alongside standard label-based metrics is introduced.

2602.06653.tldr: System-centric experiments show that RAPID reduces the setup time for multi-modal configurations by two orders of magnitude compared to traditional workflows and preserves policy execution under runtime sensor hot-unplug events.

2602.06654.tldr: A staged pretraining strategy is proposed, which guides the model to focus on specialized tasks at each stage, enabling it to effectively attend to and utilize multimodal features, and allowing flexible control over the training process at each stage to avoid the one-epoch problem.

2602.06665.tldr: Selective Layer Restoration (SLR), a training-free method that restores selected layers in a post-trained model to their pre-trained weights, yielding a hybrid model with the same architecture and parameter count, incurring no additional inference cost is proposed.

2602.06706.tldr: This work presents SaDiT, a novel framework that accelerates protein backbone generation by integrating SaProt Tokenization with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that outperforms state-of-the-art models in both computational speed and structural viability.

2602.06707.tldr: ARK (Auto-Regressive Knowledge Graph Generation), a family of autoregressive models that generate KGs by treating graphs as sequences of (head, relation, tail) triples, is presented, revealing that model capacity is more critical than architectural depth for KG generation.

2602.06717.tldr: This work derives the probability that updates miss rare-correct modes as a function of group size, showing non-monotonic behavior, and characterize how updates redistribute mass within the correct set, revealing that unsampled-correct mass can shrink even as total correct mass grows.

2602.06718.tldr: CiteVerifier is developed, an open-source framework for large-scale citation verification, and the first comprehensive study of citation validity in the LLM era through three experiments built on it, revealing an accelerating crisis where unreliable AI tools, combined with inadequate human verification by researchers and insufficient peer review scrutiny, enable fabricated citations to contaminate the scientific record.

2602.06733.tldr: HMAGAT (Hypergraph Multi-Agent Attention Network), a novel architecture that leverages attentional mechanisms over directed hypergraphs to explicitly capture group dynamics, is introduced, illustrating that appropriate inductive biases are often more critical than the training data size or sheer parameter count for multi-agent problems.

2602.06737.tldr: A novel approach for verifying properties of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks, a class of neural networks characterized by nonlinear, univariate activation functions typically implemented as piecewise polynomial splines or Gaussian processes, by replacing each KAN unit with a piecewise affine function.

2602.06746.tldr: This work presents a novel task embedding technique leveraging a new generation of semantic LTL-to-automata translations, originally developed for temporal synthesis, which achieves state-of-the-art performance and is able to scale to complex specifications where existing methods fail.

2602.06748.tldr: This work presents a proof-of-concept framework that leverages generative representations learned from multispectral Sentinel-2 imagery to identify gold-bearing regions from space, demonstrating that generative embeddings capture transferable mineralogical patterns even with limited labeled data.

2602.06754.tldr: This work shows that most existing and widely used watermarking schemes can in fact be derived from a principled constrained optimization problem, and unifies existing watermarking methods and explicitly reveals the constraints that each method optimizes.

2602.06774.tldr: This work presents the first systematic analysis of what SSM-based code models actually learn and performs the first comparative analysis of SSM and Transformer-based code models, revealing that SSMs outperform Transformers at capturing code syntax and semantics in pretraining but forgets certain syntactic and semantic relations during fine-tuning on task, especially when the task emphasizes short-range dependencies.

2602.06777.tldr: This project explores large language models (LLMs) for anomaly detection across heterogeneous log sources with practical feasibility, with inference times of 0.3-0.5 seconds per session and operational costs below 50 USD per day.

2602.06795.tldr: This work proposes a data-driven approach to automatically construct highly granular reasoning error taxonomies to enhance LLM-driven error detection on unseen reasoning traces and extends the usage of reward rubrics from assessing qualitative model behavior to assessing quantitative model correctness on tasks typically learned via RLVR rewards.

2602.06807.tldr: SuReNav is proposed, a superpixel graph-based constraint relaxation and navigation method that imitates human-like safe and efficient navigation that achieves the highest human-likeness score of complete navigation while maintaining a balanced trade-off between efficiency and safety.

2602.06818.tldr: The results suggest that "confirmation bias" may not be a cognitive error, but rather a rational adaptation for maintaining tractable inference in the sparse, open-ended hypothesis spaces characteristic of human thought.

2602.06820.tldr: ScaleEnv is introduced, a framework that constructs fully interactive environments and verifiable tasks entirely from scratch and ensures environment reliability through procedural testing, and guarantees task completeness and solvability via tool dependency graph expansion and executable action verification.

2602.06822.tldr: Extensive evaluations across diverse LFMs, including large language models (LLMs), mixture-of-experts models (MoEs), and vision-language models (VLMs), demonstrate that POP consistently delivers higher accuracy than existing pruning approaches while incurring smaller computational overhead and minimizing inference latency.

2602.06825.tldr: A detailed analysis of the internal attention dynamics during GRPO training is conducted and a key insight is uncovered: attention entropy can serve as a powerful dual-signal proxy.

2602.06836.tldr: A game-theoretic framework for predicting and steering the behavior of populations of large language models (LLMs) through Nash equilibrium (NE) analysis, and shows that a population of LLMs may exhibit political exclusion, pathologies where some subpopulations are ignored by all LLM agents, which can be avoided by the method.

2602.06843.tldr: This work finds that task-specific representations embedded in distinct subspaces are largely transformable into one another via linear mappings, indicating that representations share relational structure despite being located in distinct subspaces.

2602.06850.tldr: This work proposes Position-aligned and Keyword-scoped Attention (PKA), a highly efficient framework designed to eliminate redundancies in multi-conditioned generation, and introduces a Conditional Sensitivity-Aware Sampling (CSAS) strategy that reweights the training objective towards critical denoising phases, drastically accelerating convergence and enhancing conditional fidelity.

2602.06852.tldr: The Quantum Sieve Tracer is introduced, a hybrid quantum-classical framework designed to characterize factual recall circuits, and it is demonstrated that quantum kernels can distinguish between these constructive (recall) and reductive (suppression) mechanisms.

2602.06875.tldr: TraceCoder is presented, a collaborative multi-agent framework that emulates the observe-analyze-repair process of human experts, and significantly outperforms leading iterative methods in terms of both accuracy and cost-efficiency.

2602.06879.tldr: NanoFLUX, a 2.4B text-to-image flow-matching model distilled from 17B FLUX using a progressive compression pipeline designed to preserve generation quality, is introduced, demonstrating the feasibility of high-quality on-device text-to-image generation.

2602.06900.tldr: This work defines a novel EIG estimator using neural likelihood estimation and identifies optimization as a key bottleneck of gradient based EIG maximization and shows that a simple multi-start parallel gradient ascent procedure can substantially improve reliability and performance.

2602.06911.tldr: TimpBench is introduced, the first unified framework to systematically evaluate the tamper resistance of LLMs, and yields novel insights, including effects of post-training on tamper resistance, that jailbreak-tuning is typically the most severe attack, and that Triplet emerges as a leading alignment-stage defense.

2602.06920.tldr: The results show that question answering is consistently easier than dialogue summarization, while sentence-level hallucinations remain challenging even for the strongest models, and Halluverse-M^3 provides a realistic and challenging benchmark for studying hallucinations in multilingual, multi-task settings.

2602.06923.tldr: The results demonstrate that simple architectural choices determine whether an AI becomes a curve-fitter or a physicist, marking a critical step toward automated scientific discovery.

2602.06939.tldr: It is shown that TD errors can be viewed as 1-cochain in the topological space of state transitions, while Markov dynamics are then interpreted as topological integrability, which enables a Hodge-type decomposition of TD errors into an integrable component and a topological residual, through a Bellman-de Rham projection.

2602.06941.tldr: This work uses sparse autoencoder latents to steer model activations and identifies 26 SAE latents that activate differentially during off-topic content and are causally linked to ESR in Llama-3.3-70B, finding that ESR can be deliberately enhanced through both prompting and training.

2602.06942.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive, principled study of Turkish subword tokenization, a "subwords manifest", that jointly varies vocabulary size and tokenizer training corpus size (data and vocabulary coupling), compares multiple tokenizer families under matched parameter budgets, and evaluates across semantic, syntactic, and morphology-sensitive probes.

2602.06948.tldr: Pre-execution assessment with strictly less information tends to yield better discrimination than standard post-execution review, though differences are not always significant, and adversariesarial prompting reframing assessment as bug-finding achieves the best calibration.

2602.06949.tldr: Systematic evaluation on multiple challenging out-of-distribution (OOD) benchmarks verifies the significance of the method for simulating open-world, contact-rich tasks, paving the way for general-purpose robot world models.

2602.06964.tldr: It is found that diffusion loss decreases smoothly with compute and reliably predicts downstream utility, and generative meta-models offer a scalable path toward interpretability without restrictive structural assumptions.

2309.00071.tldr: YaRN is presented, a compute-efficient method to extend the context window of RoPE models, requiring 10x less tokens and 2.5x less training steps than previous methods, and it is demonstrated that LLaMA models can effectively utilize and extrapolate to context lengths much longer than their original pre-training would allow.

2310.08785.tldr: A novel framework called DeltaEdit is proposed, which maps the CLIP visual feature differences to the latent space directions of a generative model during the training phase, and predicts the latent space directions from the CLIP textual feature differences during the inference phase, and endows DeltaEdit with two advantages: text-free training and generalization to various text prompts for zero-shot inference.

2401.06157.tldr: The Cognitive Edge Device (CED) computing platform for the detection of crayfish and plastic and four You Only Look Once (YOLO) variants were trained and evaluated for crayfish and plastic object detection.

2402.05346.tldr: This work introduces knowledge-centric metacognitive learning based on three key principles: natural abstractions, knowledge-guided interactions through interpretation, and the composition of interactions for problem solving.

2406.11871.tldr: By rigorously emulating more than >50K LLM voting personas in 363 real-world voting elections, this work disentangle how AI-generated choices differ from human choices and how this affects collective decision outcomes.

2407.01476.tldr: This work proposes an inference-time search algorithm for LM agents to explicitly perform exploration and multi-step planning in interactive web environments, and is the first tree search algorithm for LM agents that shows effectiveness on realistic web tasks.

2407.12040.tldr: YOLO11n also recorded the fastest inference speed (2.4 ms), outperforming YOLOv8n, YOLOv9 GELAN-s, YOLOv10n, and YOLOv12n, affirming its suitability for real-time orchard applications.

2408.02697.tldr: Theoretical analysis demonstrates that MRePU satisfies criticality conditions necessary for stable training, placing it in a distinct universality class, and highlights the potential of MRePU as a robust alternative for building deep neural networks.

2408.16633.tldr: The results show that the integrated machine learning model significantly outperforms traditional methods, effectively addressing the challenges of peak order processing, reducing operational errors, and improving overall logistics efficiency.

2410.13147.tldr: This work proposes AgentDrug, an agentic workflow that leverages LLMs in a structured refinement process to achieve significantly higher accuracy, and defines a nested refinement loop that uses feedback from cheminformatics toolkits to validate molecular structures.

2410.20088.tldr: RARe exhibits stronger out-of-domain generalization compared to models using queries without in-context examples, similar to what is seen for in-context learning in LLMs.

2411.09580.tldr: The significance of Software Performance Engineering (SPE) in FMware is highlighted, identifying four key challenges: cognitive architecture design (i.e., the structural design that defines how AI components interact, reason, and interface with classical software components), communication protocols, tuning and optimization, and deployment.

2411.17461.tldr: This work presents the first Systematization of Knowledge (SoK) on DeAI, offering a formal definition, a taxonomy of existing solutions based on the AI lifecycle, and an in-depth investigation of the roles of blockchain in enabling secure and incentive-compatible collaboration.

2411.19870.tldr: Decoupled Momentum Optimization (DeMo), a drop-in replacement for any momentum-based optimizers that significantly reduces the communication bandwidth while maintaining convergence, is proposed.

2412.12144.tldr: Findings provide robust evidence that the proposed LLM-based AIG approach can produce culturally appropriate and psychometrically sound SJTs with efficiency comparable to or exceeding traditional methods.

2412.21001.tldr: This paper proposes a offLine prEference-bAsed RL with high Sample Efficiency (LEASE) algorithm, where a learned transition model is leveraged to generate unlabeled preference data, and provides the generalization bound of reward model to analyze the factors influencing reward accuracy.

2501.06708.tldr: Grad-Mimic is proposed, a two-stage framework that re-weights samples online to accelerate training and aggregates sample utilities offline to construct effective data filters, and shows that using mimic scores to guide training improves data efficiency, accelerates convergence, yields consistent performance gains across six image datasets, and enhances CLIP models with 20.7% fewer training steps.

2501.10711.tldr: A code benchmark guideline HOW2BENCH with 55 checklists is introduced, taking a clear position: Code benchmarks must prioritize rigor in benchmark construction, reliability in evaluation, and reproducibility in release.

2501.16371.tldr: This study investigates the performance of Self-Scaled BFGS, Self-Scaled Broyden (SSBroyden) methods and other advanced quasi-Newton schemes and other advanced quasi-Newton schemes, including BFGS and L-BFGS with different line search strategies, and provides state-of-the-art results with orders-of-magnitude accuracy improvements.

2502.11090.tldr: This work designs a two-tier hierarchical safety taxonomy of LLMs that considers 6 safety dimensions and generates more than 4000 multi-turn dialogues in both Chinese and English under 22 dialogue scenarios, and constructs an innovative assessment framework of LLMs.

2502.17420.tldr: It is shown that orthogonality alone does not imply independence under intervention, motivating the notion of representational independence that accounts for both linear and non-linear effects.

2502.18534.tldr: This work introduces MAFE, a suite of Multi-Agent Fair Environments designed to simulate realistic, modular, and dynamic systems in which fairness emerges from the interplay of multiple agents and provides a foundation for systematic progress in dynamic, multi-agent fairness research.

2502.18851.tldr: STONE is presented, a syntax-aware watermarking method that embeds watermarks only in non-syntactic tokens and preserves code integrity and introduces STEM, a comprehensive metric that balances three critical dimensions: correctness, detectability, and imperceptibility.

2503.03444.tldr: PLAT is a new benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to predict the legitimacy of additional tax penalties and struggles particularly with the"AC"stages of"IRAC" even for advanced reasoning models like o3, which actively employ inference-time scaling.

2503.10602.tldr: An in-depth exploration of LVLM internal states with OH issues finds that LVLM internal states are high-specificity per-token indicators of hallucination behaviors, and proposes Truthful-Guided Pre-Intervention (TruthPrInt) that first learns the truthful direction of LVLM decoding and then applies truthful-guided inference-time intervention during LVLM decoding.

2503.21164.tldr: A new class of physical-world adversarial examples, AdvWT, which draws inspiration from the naturally occurring phenomenon of `wear and tear', an inherent property of physical objects, achieves an effective attack success rate, greater robustness, and a more natural appearance compared to existing physical-world adversarial examples.

2504.02128.tldr: This paper introduces a novel deliberation-based consensus mechanism where Large Language Models (LLMs) act as rational agents engaging in structured discussions to reach a unanimous consensus.

2504.08734.tldr: An extensive literature review of 146 relevant studies published between September 2007 and August 2024 is conducted and a research roadmap that outlines key opportunities for future research is proposed that outlines key opportunities for future research.

2504.11239.tldr: Through continuously scaling analysis, NPPC can provide critical insights into the limits of LLMs'reasoning capabilities, exposing fundamental limitations and suggesting future directions for further improvements.

2504.12474.tldr: This work proposes BiGTex (Bidirectional Graph Text), a novel architecture that tightly integrates GNNs and LLMs through stacked Graph-Text Fusion Units, and achieves state-of-the-art performance in node classification and generalizes effectively to link prediction.

2504.20997.tldr: This work illustrates how LLMs can be used to explicitly implement an existing RL algorithm (Posterior Sampling for Reinforcement Learning) whose capacity for statistically-efficient exploration is already well-studied.

2505.10989.tldr: DRAG is introduced, a framework that combines a data-construction modeling approach with a scalable synthetic data-generation pipeline, specifically designed to optimize domain-specific retrieval performance and bolster retriever robustness and observes consistent end-to-end improvements in system accuracy.

2505.11556.tldr: HiddenBench is introduced, a 65-task benchmark grounded in the Hidden Profile paradigm, which isolates collective reasoning under distributed information from individual reasoning ability, and provides a theory-grounded, reproducible framework for diagnosing collective reasoning failures.

2505.15693.tldr: This work presents the first model-free RL framework that translates absolute liveness specifications to average-reward objectives and introduces a reward structure for lexicographic multi-objective optimization, where the goal is to maximize an external average-reward objective among the policies that also maximize the satisfaction probability of a given absolute liveness omega-regular specification.

2505.19238.tldr: A novel technique is proposed that effectively minimizes the constraint value function--to satisfy the constraints; on the other hand, when all the constraints are satisfied, it can simply maximize the robust reward value function.

2505.20162.tldr: A jailbreaking scaling curve is derived that predicts attack success for a fixed target based on attacker-target capability gap, suggesting that fixed-capability attackers may become ineffective against future models, increasingly capable open-source models amplify risks for existing systems, and model providers must accurately measure and control models' persuasive and manipulative abilities to limit their effectiveness as attackers.

2505.22441.tldr: This work shows that with redesign, NeRFs can be taught to learn from multipath signals, and thereby see the environment, and enables forward applications, such as indoor signal prediction and basic ray tracing.

2506.07022.tldr: The effectiveness of AlphaSteer is demonstrated, which significantly improves the safety of LLMs without compromising general capabilities, and considers activation steering as a learnable process with two principled learning objectives: utility preservation and safety enhancement.

2506.07820.tldr: Beyond single-model reasoning, Guideline Forest generalizes to enhance diverse reasoning paradigms and supports multi-model collaboration, highlighting its flexibility and scalability.

2506.08277.tldr: It is found that instruction-tuned video MLLMs significantly outperform in-context learning (ICL) multimodal models, non-instruction-tuned multimodal models, and unimodal baselines, consistent with an association between task-specific instructions and stronger brain-MLLM alignment, and open new avenues for mapping joint information processing in both systems.

2506.08390.tldr: Evidence is found that LRMs pre-plan the reasoning strengths in their activations even before generation, with this reasoning strength causally controlled by the magnitude of a pre-allocated directional vector embedded in the activations of the model.

2506.08487.tldr: The Vacuous Neutrality Framework (VaNeu) is introduced, a multi-dimensional evaluation paradigm designed to assess SLM fairness prior to deployment that presents the first large-scale audit of SLMs in the 0.5-5B parameter range.

2506.18221.tldr: It is suggested that relying solely on large pretrained networks is not always the most effective way to improve model generalization, and fostering richer, more diverse representations -- e.g. - through model ensembles -- can substantially enhance transfer learning performance.

2507.03152.tldr: This work proposes MedVAL, a novel, self-supervised, data-efficient distillation method that leverages synthetic data to train evaluator LMs to assess whether LM-generated medical outputs are factually consistent with inputs, without requiring physician labels or reference outputs.

2507.05077.tldr: It is shown that SASHA matches state-of-the-art methods that analyze the WSI fully at high resolution, albeit at a fraction of their computational and memory costs, and significantly outperforms competing, sparse sampling methods.

2507.08249.tldr: This position paper argues that giving AI agents access to cryptocurrencies as well as to the smart contracts that transact them could lead to formidable new vectors of AI harm, and calls for more technical research aimed at preventing and mitigating these new vectors of AI harm.

2507.09202.tldr: This work demonstrates that the gradient of the 4DVar cost function serves as a physically grounded interface that maps heterogeneous observations into a common state space and enables XiChen, a global weather observation-to-forecast ML system via four-dimensional variational (4DVar) gradient-guided flexible assimilation to flexibly assimilate diverse conventional and raw satellite observations.

2507.09992.tldr: A comparison between different environmental conditions revealed that stronger predator hunting capability promoted stronger fear reward, while less food supply promoted more negative social reward, suggesting that actively hunting predators played an important role in its evolution.

2507.17307.tldr: R-Stitch is introduced, a training-free hybrid decoding framework that leverages token-level entropy as an uncertainty proxy to delegate computation between a small language model (SLM) and an LLM, and shows that high-entropy tokens are more likely to induce errors, motivating an entropy-guided routing strategy that lets the SLM efficiently handle low-entropy tokens while delegating uncertain ones to the LLM.

2507.19595.tldr: This work analyzes the incorporation of efficient attention into largescale pre-trained language models, including both architectures built entirely on efficient attention and hybrid designs that combine local and global components.

2508.00960.tldr: This paper derives new forward and backward propagation operators for phantom parallelism, implements them as custom autograd operations within an end-to-end phantom parallel training pipeline and compares its parallel performance and energy-efficiency against those of conventional tensor parallel training pipelines.

2508.01116.tldr: TensorHyper-VQC is introduced, a novel tensor-train (TT)-guided hypernetwork framework that significantly improves the robustness and scalability of VQC and positions TensorHyper-VQC as a scalable and noise-resilient framework for advancing practical quantum machine learning on near-term devices.

2508.05342.tldr: Graph-Fused Vision-Language-Action (GF-VLA) is proposed, a framework that enables dual-arm robotic systems to perform task-level reasoning and execution directly from RGB and Depth human demonstrations, demonstrating strong generalization and robustness across diverse spatial and semantic variations.

2508.08266.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs can georeference early-modern records as accurately and significantly faster and cheaper than traditional GIS workflows, enabling scalable spatial analysis of colonial archives.

2508.13333.tldr: HiFo-Prompt is introduced, a framework that guides LLMs with two synergistic prompting strategies: Foresight and Hindsight, which significantly outperforms state-of-the-art LLM-based AHD methods, generating higher-quality heuristics while achieving substantially faster convergence and superior query efficiency.

2508.14313.tldr: This paper introduces AIRL-S, the first natural unification of RL-based and search-based TTS, and leverages adversarial inverse reinforcement learning (AIRL) combined with group relative policy optimization (GRPO) to learn a dense, dynamic PRM directly from correct reasoning traces, entirely eliminating the need for labeled intermediate process data.

2509.10652.tldr: Tensions between efficiency-driven prototyping and reflection are found, introducing new asymmetries in trust, responsibility, and social stigma within teams in the age of vibe coding.

2509.16010.tldr: Fed-PISA improves style expressivity, naturalness, and speaker similarity, outperforming standard federated baselines with minimal communication costs, and the aggregation method, inspired by collaborative filtering, is introduced to create custom models for each client by learning from stylistically similar peers.

2509.20102.tldr: This work reframe the task of adversarial scenario generation as a multi-objective preference alignment problem and introduces a new framework named SAGE, a data-efficient offline alignment method that learns to balance competing objectives by decoupling hard feasibility constraints from soft preferences.

2509.21265.tldr: Experiments show that MedVSR significantly outperforms existing VSR models in reconstruction performance and efficiency, and designs an Inner State-Space Reconstruction (ISSR) module that enhances tissue structures and reduces artifacts with joint long-range spatial feature learning and large-kernel short-range information aggregation.

2509.21266.tldr: The Reflective Cognitive Architecture is proposed, a novel framework designed to enable Large Language Models (LLMs) to learn directly from tabular data through experience and reflection that achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance and superior robustness to data noise while simultaneously generating clear, logical, and evidence-based explanatory statements.

2509.21391.tldr: MIXRAG is a Mixture-of-Experts Graph-RAG framework that introduces multiple specialized graph retrievers and a dynamic routing controller to better handle diverse query intents and is effective across a wide range of graph-based tasks in different domains.

2509.21549.tldr: This work proposes a self-training pipeline that samples diverse reasoning paths and mines shared decision pivots, compresses each trace into pivot-focused short-path reasoning using an auxiliary verifier, and post-trains the model using its self-generated outputs.

2509.22964.tldr: This work revisits functional critics within the actor-critic framework and identifies two critical aspects that render them a necessity rather than a luxury, and provides a convergent off-policy AC algorithm under linear functional approximation that dismantles several longstanding barriers between theory and practice.

2509.23573.tldr: This paper introduces a human-in-the-loop categorization framework that robustly labels failure modes across the CTI lifecycle, avoiding the brittleness of automated"LLM-as-a-judge"pipelines and identifies three domain-specific cognitive failures.

2509.24372.tldr: It is demonstrated that ES can indeed search over extremely high-dimensional parameter spaces and outperform established RL implementations across multiple axes, including improved tolerance to long-horizon and delayed rewards, robustness across diverse base LLMs, reduced susceptibility to reward hacking, and improved training stability.

2509.24510.tldr: This work proposes a model in which TTT achieves a substantially smaller in-distribution test error than global training, and empirically validate the model's key assumptions by training a sparse autoencoder on ImageNet, showing that semantically related data points are explained by only a few shared concepts.

2509.25416.tldr: Emotion-Aware Stepwise Preference Optimization (EASPO), a post-training framework that aligns diffusion TTS with fine-grained emotional preferences at intermediate denoising steps, enabling controllable emotional shaping.

2510.00181.tldr: This paper introduces CHAI (Command Hijacking against embodied AI), a physical environment indirect prompt injection attack that exploits the multimodal language interpretation abilities of AI models and underscores the urgent need for defenses that extend beyond traditional adversarial robustness.

2510.00508.tldr: This work proposes CopyPasteLLM, a fully automated pipeline that transforms generated responses into high-copying preference data for training CopyPasteLLM, and reveals that CopyPasteLLM recalibrates reliance on internal parametric knowledge rather than external knowledge during generation.

2510.01474.tldr: A AIReg-Bench is introduced: the first open benchmark dataset designed to test how well LLMs can assess compliance with the EU AI Act (AIA), and whether frontier LLMs can reproduce the experts'compliance labels.

2510.05228.tldr: CMT-Benchmark is presented, a dataset of 50 problems covering condensed matter theory (CMT) at the level of an expert researcher, designed and verified by a panel of expert researchers from around the world to guide development toward capable AI research assistants and tutors.

2510.06473.tldr: Beyond standard validation, MobilityGen enables analyses that have been difficult with earlier models, including how access to urban space varies across travel modes and how co-presence dynamics shape social exposure and segregation.

2510.07733.tldr: SurveyG, an LLM-based agent framework that integrates Hierarchical citation graph, is proposed, thereby embedding structural and contextual knowledge into the survey generation process and outperforms state-of-the-art frameworks.

2510.08948.tldr: Sherlock, a framework that integrates structured domain knowledge with LLM-based reasoning through three core modules, and develops an integrated platform for operations and annotation to drive a self-evolving data flywheel to counteract adversarial drifts.

2510.09891.tldr: This work introduces a probabilistic error correction framework based on a conditional Variational Autoencoder model to map the conditional distribution of observations given the biased model prediction and shows that the adjusted forecasts are better calibrated, closer to the observational distribution, and have smaller errors than climatological mean adjusted forecasts.

2510.13876.tldr: GateSkip is introduced, a simple residual-stream gating mechanism that enables token-wise layer skipping in decoder-only LMs and combines easily with quantization, pruning, and self-speculative decoding.

2510.20647.tldr: This work systematically compares an LRM's reasoning in English versus the language of the question, and finds that reasoning in English generally yields higher final-answer accuracy, with the performance gap increasing as tasks become more complex.

2510.22009.tldr: This work proposes OpenPhone, a mobile GUI agent system that leverages device-cloud collaboration to tap the cost-efficiency of on device models and the high capability of cloud models, while avoiding their drawbacks.

2510.22063.tldr: This work connects deep ensembles to the bootstrap estimator by decomposing it into data variability and training stochasticity; specifically, it shows that deep ensembles capture the training stochasticity component.

2511.04919.tldr: This work proposes BudgetMem, a novel memory augmented architecture that learns what to remember rather than remembering everything, and provides a practical pathway for deploying capable long context systems on modest hardware, democratizing access to advanced language understanding capabilities.

2511.05540.tldr: The Mental Bayesian Causal World Model is proposed and instantiate it as the Tokenized Intent World Model (TIWM), a novel cognitive computing architecture that offers a neuro-symbolic, cognition-first alternative to reconstruction-based planners, establishing a new direction: planning as active understanding, not passive reaction.

2511.10262.tldr: Experimental results reveal that current FD-SLMs face difficulties in maintaining consistent performance across multiple rounds and evaluation dimensions, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of the MTR-DuplexBench benchmark.

2511.14043.tldr: AISAC contributes a governed execution substrate that operationalizes key requirements for deploying agentic AI in scientific practice, including explicit role semantics, budgeted context management, traceable execution, and reproducible interaction with tools and knowledge.

2511.18715.tldr: HuggingR$^4$ is proposed, the first framework to recast model selection as an iterative reasoning process rather than one-shot retrieval, and progressively decomposes user intent, retrieves candidates through multi-round deliberation, refines selections via fine-grained analysis, and validates results through reflection.

2511.18842.tldr: An adaptive timing mechanism that dynamically adjusts the delay before offering a suggestion based on real-time developer feedback is proposed, which increases acceptance and substantially reduce wasted inference calls by 75%, making LLM-based code assistants more efficient and cost-effective in practice.

2511.18845.tldr: UNeMo is introduced, a novel framework designed for the collaborative optimization of visual state reasoning and navigational decision-making that takes visual features, language instructions, and navigational actions as inputs to jointly predict subsequent visual states, enabling cross-modal reasoning.

2511.18849.tldr: A lightweight pre-filtering model is introduced that predicts the likelihood of suggestion acceptance before invoking the LLM, using only real-time developer telemetry such as typing speed, file navigation, and editing activity, highlighting the value of timing-aware, privacy-preserving adaptation mechanisms.

2512.01047.tldr: This work proposes \textsc{AutoSpec], a framework that searches for a logical specification refinement whose satisfaction implies satisfaction of the original specification, but which provides additional guidance therefore making it easier for reinforcement learning algorithms to learn useful policies.

2512.01952.tldr: Reinforcement Learning with World Grounding is introduced, a self-supervised post-training framework that aligns pretrained world models with a physically verifiable structure through geometric and perceptual rewards in order to bridge generative pretraining and grounded behavior.

2512.04480.tldr: The proposed framework establishes Prescriptive AI as a general, realizable class of decision-support systems applicable across safety-critical domains in which interpretability, contestability, and normative alignment are essential.

2512.05136.tldr: An AI-ECG model using CCTA as the reference standard to estimate severe or complete coronary artery stenosis in the four major coronary arteries is developed and validated, supporting the feasibility of AI-ECG for complementary CAD risk screening and warrant prospective evaluation.

2512.10937.tldr: A bridge is built between the agent-environment interaction in artificial intelligence, causal structure in the foundations of physics, and logic in computer science by establishing a correspondence between equivalence classes of agent-state policies for deterministic POMDPs and one-input process functions.

2512.19707.tldr: It is revealed that human-AI partnerships improve accuracy and metacognitive ability not only for radiologists supported by AI, but also for AI agents supported by radiologists.

2512.20806.tldr: This work introduces a different paradigm: framing safety alignment as a non-zero-sum game between an Attacker LM and a Defender LM trained jointly via online reinforcement learning, driving iterative improvement.

2512.22730.tldr: This study fine-tuned the Ultrasound Self-Supervised Foundation Model with Masked Autoencoding (USF-MAE), pretrained on over 370,000 unlabelled ultrasound images, and confirmed that performance improvements achieved by USF-MAE were statistically significant.

2601.03322.tldr: HEEGNet is proposed, a hybrid hyperbolic network architecture to capture the hierarchical structure in EEG and learn domain-invariant hyperbolic embeddings, which combines both Euclidean and hyperbolic encoders and employs a novel coarse-to-fine domain adaptation strategy.

2601.05047.tldr: This work highlights four architecture research opportunities: High Bandwidth Flash for 10X memory capacity with HBM-like bandwidth; Processing-Near-Memory and 3D memory-logic stacking for high memory bandwidth; Processing-Near-Memory and 3D memory-logic stacking for high memory bandwidth; and low-latency interconnect to speedup communication.

2601.07553.tldr: VirtualEnv is presented, a next-generation simulation platform built on Unreal Engine 5 that enables fine-grained benchmarking of LLMs in embodied and interactive scenarios and integrates large-scale LLMs and vision-language models, such as GPT-based models, to generate novel environments and structured tasks from multimodal inputs.

2601.11840.tldr: CodeLogician is presented, a neurosymbolic agent for precise analysis of software logic, integrated with ImandraX, an industrial automated reasoning engine deployed in financial markets and safety-critical systems, demonstrating that neurosymbolic integration is essential for scaling program analysis toward rigorous, autonomous software understanding.

2601.14541.tldr: The report recommends NSF to foster AI/EDA collaboration, invest in foundational AI for EDA, develop robust data infrastructures, promote scalable compute infrastructure, and invest in workforce development to democratize hardware design and enable next-generation hardware systems.

2601.18012.tldr: This work examines whether models can understand a payroll schema, apply rules in the right order, and deliver cent-accurate results in a compact, reproducible framework and practical guidance for deploying LLMs in settings that demand both accuracy and assurance.

2601.18588.tldr: This work empirically validate how stabilizing training dynamics affects the induced generation distribution and indicates that optimization stability and generative expressivity are not inherently aligned, and that stability alone is an insufficient indicator of generative quality.

2601.19612.tldr: This work proves that SOOPER guarantees safety throughout learning, and establish convergence to an optimal policy by bounding its cumulative regret, and demonstrates that SOOPER is scalable, outperforms the state-of-the-art and validate the theoretical guarantees in practice.

2601.20125.tldr: SAMA (Subset-Aggregated Membership Attack), which addresses the sparse signal challenge through robust aggregation and transforms sparse memorization detection into a robust voting mechanism, and reveals significant, previously unknown vulnerabilities in DLMs.

2601.21008.tldr: Two benchmarks that place the solver in the evaluation loop with verifiable oracles enable targeted training that outperforms scale and demonstrate that process-level evaluation with verifiable oracles enables targeted training that outperforms scale.

2601.21083.tldr: OpenSec is introduced, a dual-control reinforcement learning (RL) environment that evaluates IR agents under realistic prompt injection scenarios with execution-based scoring: time-to-first-containment (TTFC), evidence-gated action rate (EGAR), blast radius, and per-tier injection violation rates.

2601.21183.tldr: This work introduces \emph{sycophantic anchors} -- sentences identified via counterfactual analysis that commit models to user agreement that enable sentence-level detection and quantification of model misalignment mid-inference.

2601.21239.tldr: TIDE, a Tuning-Integrated Dynamic Evolution framework designed to decouple structural reasoning from parameter optimization, is proposed, which discovers heuristics that significantly outperform state-of-the-art baselines in solution quality while achieving improved search efficiency and reduced computational costs.

2601.21459.tldr: Her introduces dual-layer thinking, which distinguishes characters' first-person thinking from LLMs'third-person thinking, and trains HER models based on Qwen3-32B via supervised and reinforcement learning.

2601.21475.tldr: The Adaptive meta Black-box Optimization Model (ABOM), which performs online parameter adaptation using solely optimization data from the target task, obviating the need for predefined task distributions, enables zero-shot optimization.

2601.21760.tldr: Zero-Shot Statistical Downscaling (ZSSD), a zero-shot framework that performs statistical downscaling without paired data during training, is proposed and Unified Coordinate Guidance is introduced to enable robust inference across varying GCMs and ensures consistency with large-scale fields.

2601.22013.tldr: Vidmento supported narrative development and exploration by systematically expanding initial materials with generative media, enabling expressive video storytelling aligned with creative intent.

2601.22636.tldr: This work proposes a scaling-aware Best-of-N estimation of risk, SABER, for modeling jailbreak vulnerability under Best-of-N sampling, and derives an analytic scaling law that enables reliable extrapolation of large-N attack success rates from small-budget measurements.

2602.01465.tldr: This work presents a fully automated multi-agent system that explicitly models software engineering as an organizational process, replicating the structure of an engineering team, and suggests that replicating team structure, methodology, and communication is a powerful paradigm for autonomous software engineering.

2602.01740.tldr: Model-aware Counterfactual Data based Contrastive Decoding (MACD) is proposed, a new inference strategy that combines model-guided counterfactual construction with decoding and consistently reduces hallucination while maintaining or improving task accuracy across diverse Video-LLMs, including Qwen and InternVL families.

2602.01777.tldr: This work constructs a gradient estimator that adaptively contracts noisy mini-batch gradients toward a stable estimator derived from historical momentum, and incorporates this into the Adam optimizer, yielding SR-Adam, a practical algorithm with negligible computational cost.

2602.02138.tldr: CAM is proposed, the first Causality-basedalysis framework for Multi-Agent Code Generation Systems that systematically quantifies the contribution of different intermediate features for system correctness and identifies important features for system correctness and aggregate their importance rankings.

2602.02408.tldr: ReasonEdit is proposed, the first VLM editor to let users explain their reasoning during editing, introducing a new, practical model editing setup and showing that using human reasoning during editing greatly improves edit generalization.

2602.02600.tldr: This work presents a fundamental analytical framework for step-wise refusal dynamics, enabling comparison between AR and diffusion sampling, and introduces the Step-Wise Refusal Internal Dynamics (SRI) signal, which supports interpretability and improved safety for both AR and DLMs.

2602.03306.tldr: A Query-Aware Adaptive Dimension Selection framework that learns to predict per-dimension importance directly from query embedding, and shows that the learned dimension selector improves retrieval effectiveness over the full-dimensional baseline as well as PRF-based masking and supervised adapter baselines.
