2602.03786.tldr: A unified, framework-agnostic agent abstraction that models any agent as a tuple Instruction, Context, Tools, Model, enabling the system to spawn specialized executors for each task on demand, and enables a controllable performance-cost trade-off, allowing the system to approach Pareto-efficient.

2602.03881.tldr: The Diffusion-Guided Attention Network (DiGAN), which integrates latent diffusion modelling with an attention-guided convolutional network, synthesizes realistic longitudinal neuroimaging trajectories from limited training data, enriching temporal context and improving robustness to unevenly spaced visits.

2602.03950.tldr: Iteratively Improved Program Construction (IIPC) is introduced, a reasoning method that iteratively refines programmatic reasoning chains and combines execution feedback with the native Chain-of-thought abilities of the base LLM to maintain high-level contextual focus.

2602.03994.tldr: The results show that CoT faithfulness varies substantially across models and tasks and cannot be inferred from behavior alone, motivating causal, layerwise audits when using CoT as a transparency signal.

2602.04019.tldr: A unified projected residual view of PEFT on top of a frozen base model is developed, and the Layer Card, a reusable diagnostic that summarizes residual signal strength, compute cost, and performance for each layer of a given model is introduced.

2602.04894.tldr: The introduction of Feature--Security Table (FSTab) with two components enables a black-box attack that predicts likely backend vulnerabilities from observable frontend features and knowledge of the source LLM, without access to the backend or source code.

2602.04902.tldr: An Orthogonality Theorem is formalized proving that DC (semantic) and AC (mechanistic) signals segregate into orthogonal frequency bands when Low-Pass RoPE interacts with High-Pass Momentum.

2602.04935.tldr: Activation Steering Adapter (ASA), a training-free, inference-time controller that performs a single-shot mid-layer intervention and targets tool domains via a router-conditioned mixture of steering vectors with a probe-guided signed gate to amplify true intent while suppressing spurious triggers is proposed.

2602.05494.tldr: A unified clipping framework is introduced that characterizes existing methods via a general notion of policy divergence, encompassing both likelihood ratios and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergences and extending to alternative measures.

2602.05625.tldr: This work introduces Resin (Reactive Signal Inference), a probabilistic programming language that merges probabilistic logic with reactive programming, and proposes Reactive Circuits (RCs), a reactive, asynchronous, probabilistic reasoning perspective that achieves several orders of magnitude of speedup over frequency-agnostic inference.

2602.05656.tldr: The main theoretical contribution is a conditional impossibility result: under finite behavioral evaluation and evaluation-aware policies, observed compliance does not uniquely identify latent alignment, but only membership in an equivalence class of conditionally compliant policies, under explicit assumptions on policy expressivity and observability.

2602.05818.tldr: This work proposes TKG-Thinker, a novel agent equipped with autonomous planning and adaptive retrieval capabilities for reasoning over TKGs, which performs in-depth temporal reasoning through dynamic multi-turn interactions with TKGs via a dual-training strategy.

2602.06000.tldr: Two attention-based pooling methods are proposed, Multi-head Attentive Average Pooling and QKV Pooling, designed to efficiently reduce the dimensionality of Whisper representations while preserving emotional features, to demonstrate the effectiveness of attention-based pooling for dimension reduction.

2602.06967.tldr: The results demonstrate that leveraging human-inspired group formation and negotiation principles significantly enhances the efficiency of heterogeneous multi-robot collaboration.

2602.06973.tldr: This work evaluates the impact of script-tokenizer alignment within the DualGPT architecture on four Indonesian low-resource local languages and shows that the Llama 2 tokenizer performs significantly worse than a custom tokenizer, with improvements of up to 30.15 chrF++.

2602.06975.tldr: BomechAgent, a code-generating AI agent that enables biomechanical analysis through natural language and allows users to querying databases, generating visualizations, and even interpret data without requiring users to write code, is presented.

2602.06976.tldr: This paper proposes ILA-agent, a general ILA framework that equips LLMs with a set of behavioral primitives and demonstrates that ILA-agent significantly outperforms retrieval-augmented baselines.

2602.06981.tldr: By interrogating safety discourses as artifacts of power, this paper advances a critical agenda for human-computer interaction scholarship on artificial intelligence by cautioning human-computer interaction scholars against legitimizing corporate framings, instead foregrounding accountability, equity, and justice.

2602.06982.tldr: A reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-aided HAPS-based SAGIN framework with a deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) algorithm that optimizes the HAPS beamforming weights to form spatial nulls toward interference sources while maintaining robust links to the desired signals.

2602.06983.tldr: A novel hybrid deep learning framework designed to enhance the robustness of CSI-based Human Activity Recognition within bandwidth-constrained Wi-Fi sensing environments, which confirms a marked superiority over standalone deep learning baselines, especially in the most constrained low-bandwidth scenarios.

2602.06984.tldr: The findings provide empirical evidence of the process through which people's fairness notions emerge via grounding in model features, and uncover a diverse set of individuals' custom-defined criteria for both outcome and procedural fairness.

2602.06994.tldr: A novel spherical surface-based brain age prediction network (SurfAge-Net) that leverages multiple morphological metrics to capture region-specific developmental patterns with enhanced robustness and clinical interpretability and established fine-grained brain age prediction as a promising paradigm for advancing neurodevelopmental research and supporting early clinical assessment.

2602.06997.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive application of liquid neural networks for EEG-based emotion recognition with a proposed multimodal framework that combines convolutional feature extraction, liquid neural networks with learnable time constants, and attention-guided fusion to model temporal EEG dynamics with complementary peripheral physiological and personality features.

2602.07000.tldr: The proposed architecture employs a three-level hierarchical prediction, with high-level, medium-level, and low-level predictors operating across different temporal resolutions, to achieve long-term prediction stability, intermediate interpolation, and fine-grained refinement, respectively.

2602.07009.tldr: Experiments show that MSTH consistently improves accuracy, eliminates catastrophic failures and enhances recovery from perturbations, positioning MSTH as a foundation for building robust, resilient and biologically faithful intelligence.

2602.07010.tldr: A neuro-bridge framework is proposed that links data-driven learning with minimal, biophysically grounded simulations, enabling bidirectional interpretation between machine learning signatures and circuit-level mechanisms in AD, and advancing mechanistic understanding of EEG biomarkers.

2602.07012.tldr: RetSAM delivers robust multi-target segmentation and standardized biomarker extraction, supporting downstream ophthalmologic studies and oculomics correlation analyses, and enables large-scale ophthalmic research and translation.

2602.07014.tldr: This work introduces Vectra, to the best of the knowledge, the first reference-free, MLLM-driven visual quality assessment framework for e-commerce IIMT, and demonstrates that Vectra achieves state-of-the-art correlation with human rankings, and the model outperforms leading MLLMs, including GPT-5 and Gemini-3, in scoring performance.

2602.07017.tldr: Qualitative results further confirm cleaner and more anatomically consistent attribution maps with fewer artifacts, highlighting that the incorporation of multimodal vision-language representations into perturbation-based XAI frameworks significantly enhances both interpretability and efficiency, thereby enabling transparent and clinically deployable medical image segmentation systems.

2602.07021.tldr: Key findings indicate that AI-driven dynamic key management, adaptive encryption schemes, and optimized computational efficiency in HE, alongside AI-enhanced protocol optimization and fault mitigation in MPC, significantly improve the security of environmental data processing.

2602.07023.tldr: This work operationalizes four behavioral-finance drivers-loss aversion, herding, wealth differentiation, and price misalignment-as personality traits set via prompting and stored long-term, and introduces four alignment metrics and uses Mann-Whitney U tests to compare agents's strategy switching behavior with financial theory.

2602.07025.tldr: This work analyzes the representational geometry of open-weight VLMs (Qwen, InternVL, Gemma), comparing methodologies to distill"concept vectors"- latent directions encoding visual concepts, and observes that the geometric overlap between these vectors strongly correlates with specific error patterns.

2602.07026.tldr: The Fixed-frame Modality Gap Theory is proposed, which decomposes the modality gap within a frozen reference frame into stable biases and anisotropic residuals and introduces ReAlign, a training-free modality alignment strategy.

2602.07028.tldr: This work compares standard CNNs with their ANFIS-augmented counterparts on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under gradient-based and gradient-free attacks and suggests that neuro-fuzzy augmentation can enhance robustness in specific architectures but is not universally beneficial.

2602.07032.tldr: This paper presents LLM-FSM, a benchmark that evaluates how well large language models (LLMs) can recover finite-state machine (FSM) behavior from natural-language specifications and translate it into correct register transfer-level (RTL) implementations.

2602.07034.tldr: ST-Raptor offers an interactive analysis environment that combines visual editing, tree-based structural modeling, and agent-driven query resolution to support accurate and user-friendly table understanding, and demonstrates that ST-Raptor outperforms existing methods in both accuracy and usability.

2602.07035.tldr: DLLM-Searcher is proposed, an optimization framework for dLLM-based Search Agents that designs a two-stage post-training pipeline encompassing Agentic Supervised Fine-Tuning (Agentic SFT) and Agentic Variance-Reduced Preference Optimization Agentic VRPO, which enhances the backbone dLLM's information seeking and reasoning capabilities.

2602.07036.tldr: This work introduces MENASpeechBank, a reference speech bank comprising about 18K high-quality utterances from 124 speakers spanning multiple MENA countries, covering English, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), and regional Arabic varieties, and develops a controllable synthetic data pipeline that generates role-play conversations with an LLM.

2602.07037.tldr: A spiking Bayesian neural network (SBNN) framework that unifies the dynamic models of intrinsic device stochasticity and stochastic threshold neurons to leverage noise as a functional Bayesian resource and exhibits superior robustness.

2602.07040.tldr: An AI agent for autonomous scientific discovery capable of operating over 20 times faster than existing frameworks, Aster's significant reduction in the number of iterations required for novel discovery expands the domain of tractable problems to include tasks with long evaluation durations, such as multi-hour machine learning training runs.

2602.07044.tldr: PipeMFL-240K is introduced, a large-scale, meticulously annotated dataset and benchmark for complex object detection in pipeline MFL pseudo-color images that provides a critical foundation for efficient pipeline diagnostics as well as maintenance planning and is expected to accelerate algorithmic innovation and reproducible research in MFL-based pipeline integrity assessment.

2602.07045.tldr: Experimental results reveal significant bottlenecks in existing state-of-the-art MLLMs, providing critical insights for advancing multimodal reasoning within the remote sensing community.

2602.07050.tldr: It is found that scalar quantities such as speed and acceleration are available from early layers onwards, whereas motion direction becomes accessible only at the Physics Emergence Zone, suggesting that modern video models do not use factorized representations of physical variables like a classical physics engine and use a distributed representation that is nonetheless sufficient for making physical predictions.

2602.07051.tldr: This research presents Neural Sentinel, a novel unified approach that leverages Vision Language Models (VLMs) to perform license plate recognition, state classification, and vehicle attribute extraction through a single forward pass, and introduces a Human-in-the-Loop continual learning framework that incorporates user corrections while preventing catastrophic forgetting through experience replay.

2602.07055.tldr: Towards Theory of Space, defined as an agent's ability to actively acquire information through self-directed, active exploration and to construct, revise, and exploit a spatial belief from sequential, partial observations, is proposed.

2602.07056.tldr: MTSCSNet, a CS framework based on Multiscale Tensor Summation (MTS) factorization, a structured operator for efficient multidimensional signal processing, achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance on RGB images, with notable PSNR gains and faster inference, even compared to recent diffusion-based CS methods.

2602.07058.tldr: FADE (Fast Adapter for Data Erasure), a two-stage unlearning method for image generation that combines parameter localization with self-distillation, achieves strong concept erasure and high retainability across various domains, making it a suitable solution for selective unlearning in diffusion-based image generation models.

2602.07059.tldr: This paper introduces a structured reproducibility checklist and applies it through a systematic manual assessment of the selected corpus, and proposes RECAP (REproducibility Checklist Automation Pipeline), an LLM-based system that automatically evaluates reproducibility signals from paper text and associated code repositories.

2602.07061.tldr: TACIT (Transformation-Aware Capturing of Implicit Thought), a diffusion-based transformer for interpretable visual reasoning, which provides a foundation for understanding how neural networks develop implicit reasoning strategies that operate below and before language.

2602.07063.tldr: EMSYNC emerges as a fully automatic video-based music generator that consistently outperforms existing methods in terms of music richness, emotional alignment, temporal synchronization, and overall preference, setting a new state-of-the-art in video-based music generation.

2602.07068.tldr: A comprehensive comparison of three state-of-the-art generative models for T1-to-T2 MRI reconstruction: Pix2Pix GAN, CycleGAN, and Variational Autoencoder (VAE) provides valuable insights for researchers and clinicians selecting appropriate generative models for MRI synthesis applications based on their specific requirements and data constraints.

2602.07069.tldr: Bird-SR is proposed, a bidirectional reward-guided diffusion framework that formulates super-resolution as trajectory-level preference optimization via reward feedback learning (ReFL) and introduces a dynamic fidelity-perception weighting strategy that emphasizes structure preservation at early stages and progressively shifts focus toward perceptual optimization at later diffusion steps.

2602.07071.tldr: This literature review explores how artificial intelligence is being leveraged to address critical challenges to OSS sustainability, including maintaining contributor engagement, securing funding, ensuring code quality and security, fostering healthy community dynamics, and preventing project abandonment.

2602.07073.tldr: A novel graph neural network model for identifying weighted shortest paths aids in detecting network misconfigurations and high-risk connectivity paths that threaten critical assets, potentially exploited in zero-day attacks -- cyber-attacks exploiting undisclosed vulnerabilities.

2602.07075.tldr: LatentChem is introduced, a latent reasoning interface that decouples chemical computation from textual generation, enabling models to perform multi-step reasoning directly in continuous latent space while emitting language only for final outputs.

2602.07077.tldr: This work proposes Class-Conditional Sparse Attention Vectors for Large Audio-Language Models, a few-shot classification method that learns class-dependent importance weights over attention heads that allows individual heads to specialize in distinct semantic categories and to contribute to ensemble predictions proportionally to their estimated reliability.

2602.07078.tldr: This work derives the Optimal Token Baseline (OTB) from first principles, proving that gradient updates should be weighted inversely to their cumulative gradient norm, and proposes the Logit-Gradient Proxy that approximates the gradient norm using only forward-pass probabilities.

2602.07080.tldr: This work aims to identify the structural signatures that distinguish sound reasoning from logical failure within the model's internal circuits within the model's internal circuits, and establishes internal introspection as a decodable property for verifying generated code.

2602.07081.tldr: A generalized federated prompt-tuning framework for practical scenarios where local datasets are multi-modal and exhibit different distributional patterns of missing features at the input level, which allows prompt instructions to complement one another and be combined effectively.

2602.07082.tldr: This paper presents a new inference-time computing technique for on-device embodied AI, namely \emph{MosaicThinker}, which enhances the on-device small VLM's spatial reasoning capabilities on difficult cross-frame reasoning tasks.

2602.07083.tldr: CivilInstruct is introduced as a domain-specific dataset that formalizes structural engineering knowledge and constraint reasoning to enable simulation-ready model generation and MBEval is presented as a verification-driven benchmark that evaluates executability and structural dynamics consistency through closed-loop validation.

2602.07084.tldr: AbFlow is introduced, a flow-matching framework that leverages optimal transport to design full-atom antibodies end-to-end and markedly improves the binding affinity of generated antibodies.

2602.07085.tldr: QuantaAlpha, an evolutionary alpha mining framework that treats each end-to-end mining run as a trajectory and improves factors through trajectory-level mutation and crossover operations, indicates strong robustness of QuantaAlpha under market distribution shifts.

2602.07086.tldr: These findings establish retrieval-policy design as a key determinant of production-grade natural language interfaces, showing that iterative query decomposition outperforms both top-k retrieval and binary relevance filtering under documentation heterogeneity.

2602.07087.tldr: This work proposes a method for learning electron-informed molecular representations without additional computation costs by transferring readily accessible electron-level information about small molecules to large molecules of the authors' interest.

2602.07090.tldr: SPARSE selectively perturbs privacy-sensitive dimensions for user-defined concepts while preserving non-sensitive semantics, and consistently reduces privacy leakage while achieving superior downstream performance compared to state-of-the-art DP methods.

2602.07092.tldr: Lemon Agent is introduced, a multi-agent orchestrator-worker system built on a newly proposed AgentCortex framework, which formalizes the classic Planner-Executor-Memory paradigm through an adaptive task execution mechanism and proposes a self-evolving memory system, which can extract multi-dimensional valid information from all historical experiences to assist in completing similar tasks.

2602.07095.tldr: The proposed dataset and methods significantly narrow the gap with GPT-4o and Nano-Banana, demonstrating competitive performance not only in instruction following but also in knowledge plausibility, where many open-source systems typically struggle.

2602.07102.tldr: An amortization strategy for diffusion posterior sampling is introduced that preserves explicit likelihood guidance by amortizing the inner optimization problems arising in variational diffusion posterior sampling, which accelerates inference for in-distribution degradations while maintaining robustness to previously unseen operators, thereby improving the trade-off between efficiency and flexibility in diffusion-based inverse problems.

2602.07103.tldr: This work presents scDFM, a generative framework based on conditional flow matching that models the full distribution of perturbed cells conditioned on control states and introduces the Perturbation-Aware Differential Transformer, a backbone architecture that leverages gene interaction graphs and differential attention to capture context-specific expression changes.

2602.07104.tldr: PI3D is introduced, a prompt injection attack against MLLMs in 3D environments, realized through text-bearing physical object placement rather than digital image edits, and formulate and solve the problem of identifying an effective 3D object pose with injected text.

2602.07106.tldr: Ex-Omni reduces learning difficulty by decoupling semantic reasoning from temporal generation, leveraging speech units as temporal scaffolding and a unified token-as-query gated fusion (TQGF) mechanism for controlled semantic injection.

2602.07125.tldr: This work proposes a data-centric framework that decouples these roles by externalizing reasoning before retrieval, using a strong Vision--Language Model, and makes implicit semantics explicit by densely captioning visual evidence in corpus entries, resolving ambiguous multimodal references in queries, and rewriting verbose instructions into concise retrieval constraints.

2602.07142.tldr: Findings from an exploratory qualitative study with 33 K12 teachers who interacted with Phoenix, a voice-based conversational agent designed to function as a near-peer in face-to-face group collaboration are presented.

2602.07144.tldr: BONSAI is introduced, a default-aware BO policy that prunes low-impact deviations from a default configuration while explicitly controlling the loss in acquisition value, and theoretically bound the regret incurred by BONSAI.

2602.07150.tldr: It is shown that trajectories diverge early, often within the first few percent of tokens, and that these small differences cascade into different solution strategies, and that these small differences cascade into different solution strategies.

2602.07153.tldr: A trajectory expansion framework Anchor is presented that bootstraps scalable desktop supervision from a small set of verified seed demonstrations, and models fine-tuned on the expanded corpus achieve consistent improvements over zero-shot agents and representative synthesis baselines, and generalize across applications and operating systems.

2602.07154.tldr: A matching framework that selects samples relative to an adaptive centroid and iteratively refines the representation distribution is proposed that achieves better results under asymmetric meta-distributions, which is extended to non-Gaussian and multimodal real-world settings.

2602.07156.tldr: This work presents the first attempt to apply Mimetic initialization to channel mixing layers, namely multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), and presents the extremely simple technique to give the first layer a nonzero mean.

2602.07160.tldr: A free-energy (log-sum-exp) read that applies a value-driven, per-channel log-linear tilt to a fast prior over indices, which consistently outperforms strong baselines on NLP, vision, and time-series at matched parameter budgets.

2602.07164.tldr: It is shown that LLMs already contain persona-specialized subnetworks in their parameter space, suggesting that diverse human-like behaviors are not merely induced in LLMs, but are already embedded in their parameter space, pointing toward a new perspective on controllable and interpretable personalization in large language models.

2602.07176.tldr: Open TutorAI is presented, an open-source educational platform based on LLMs and generative technologies that provides dynamic, personalized tutoring that contributes to the development of next-generation intelligent tutoring systems.

2602.07179.tldr: An information theoretic framework for analyzing how explanation modality specifically, voice versus text affects user comprehension and trust calibration in AI systems is introduced, demonstrating that text explanations achieve higher comprehension efficiency, while voice explanations yield improved trust calibration.

2602.07187.tldr: PreFlect is introduced, a prospective reflection mechanism that shifts the paradigm from post hoc correction to pre-execution foresight by criticizing and refining agent plans before execution by distill planning errors from historical agent trajectories.

2602.07190.tldr: This paper proposes a question answering system that can deconstruct domain-specific vocabulary for better retrieval from source documents, parse complex document layouts while isolating sections and footnotes and linking them appropriately, and generate comprehensive answers using precise domain-specific vocabulary.

2602.07200.tldr: A novel backdoor attack on spiking neural networks that exploits hyperparameter variations of spiking neurons to inject backdoor behavior into the model is proposed and a trigger optimization process is proposed to achieve better attack performance while making trigger patterns less perceptible.

2602.07203.tldr: It is proved that non-parametric identifiability of do-Shapley values requires only the identification of interventional effects for the $d$ singleton coalitions, rather than all classes.

2602.07206.tldr: This work introduces Dual-scale Softmax Loss (DSL), which infers effective sharpness from the sampled competition itself and provides a theoretical, distributionally robust optimisation (DRO) analysis, which demonstrates how DSL reshapes the robust payoff and the KL deviation for ambiguous instances.

2602.07207.tldr: A novel recommender framework that unifies multimodal and sequential recommendation paradigms, MuSTRec (Multimodal and Sequential Transformer-based Recommendation), that captures cross-item similarities and collaborative filtering signals, by building item-item graphs from extracted text and visual features.

2602.07208.tldr: This work proposes MuSICRec (Multimodal Sequence-Item Contrastive Recommender), a multi-view graph-based recommender that combines collaborative, sequential, and multimodal signals and observes the largest gains for short-history users, mitigating sparsity and cold-start challenges.

2602.07215.tldr: This work proposes a Multi-Agentic AI framework for latency- and fairness-aware multi-modal LM inference in mobile edge networks that adapts quickly without fine-tuning, offering a generalizable solution for optimizing GenAI services in edge environments.

2602.07218.tldr: This work proposes Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation, or CoLoRA, which exploits task similarity to collaboratively and efficiently fine-tune personalized foundation models and theoretically study CoLoRA on heterogeneous linear regression and provides provable guarantees for ground truth recovery.

2602.07219.tldr: A constant-depth, linear-width construction that achieves exponentially small approximation error with respect to the uniform distribution over the unit hypercube is presented.

2602.07235.tldr: This work derives the first capacity characterization of multi-bit watermarking, demonstrating that LM watermarking is fundamentally a channel coding problem, paving the way for principled coding-theoretic approaches to watermark design.

2602.07238.tldr: Clear evidence of developer-specific efficiency advantages is found, but their importance depends on where models lie in the performance distribution; a firm can train two models with more than 40x compute efficiency difference; and substantial variation of model efficiency within companies.

2602.07243.tldr: This proposed generative framework creates household datasets at scale through loosely coupled generation of long-term human-robot interactions and environments through multi-modal embeddings and key metrics: cosine similarity, mutual information gain, intervention analysis, and iterative improvement validation.

2602.07251.tldr: AdvSR is presented, a framework demonstrating that adversarial behavior can be embedded directly into SR model weights during training, requiring no access to inputs at inference time and highlighting a new model-level threat for imaging pipelines.

2602.07253.tldr: This work revisits hallucination detection through the lens of out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, and suggests that reframing hallucination detection as OOD detection provides a promising and scalable pathway toward language model safety.

2602.07256.tldr: This work proposes and studies a new and unexplored paradigm: directly increasing the graph homophily via a carefully designed graph transformation, and is the first method that explicitly transforms the graph to directly improve the graph homophily.

2602.07259.tldr: A new perspective on AI safety grounded in Stackelberg Security Games (SSGs), a class of game-theoretic models designed for adversarial resource allocation under uncertainty, is proposed, highlighting how game-theoretic deterrence can make AI oversight proactive, risk-aware, and resilient to manipulation.

2602.07261.tldr: This chapter reviews several cognitive systems that are centered to mimic explicit memory, and others that are neuroanatomically based and are implemented to simulate those memory impairments mentioned above.

2602.07264.tldr: The aerial-autonomy-stack is introduced, an open-source, end-to-end framework designed to streamline the pipeline from (GPU-accelerated) perception to (flight controller-based) action and shows that it supports over 20x faster-than-real-time, end-to-end simulation of a complete development and deployment stack of perception-based autonomy.

2602.07265.tldr: The proposed method, namely XShare, requires no retraining and dynamically adapts to each batch by maximizing the total gating score of selected experts, reducing expert activation by up to 30% under standard batching and cutting peak GPU load by up to 3x in expert-parallel deployments.

2602.07267.tldr: BRIDGE is proposed, a unified psychometric framework that learns the latent difficulty scale from model responses and anchors it to human task completion time, and it is demonstrated that latent task difficulty varies linearly with the logarithm of human completion time.

2602.07274.tldr: TermiGen is introduced, an end-to-end pipeline for synthesizing verifiable environments and resilient expert trajectories and employs a Generator-Critic protocol that actively injects errors during trajectory collection, synthesizing data rich in error-correction cycles.

2602.07276.tldr: STEER2ADAPT is a lightweight framework that adapts LLMs by composing steering vectors rather than learning new ones from scratch, and is a data-efficient, stable, and transparent inference-time adaptation method for LLMs.

2602.07278.tldr: Laplacian-LoRA is proposed, a simple and interpretable low-rank spectral adaptation of standard GCNs that systematically delays the onset of oversmoothing, extending the effective depth of GCNs by up to a factor of two.

2602.07297.tldr: This work proposes a cost-effective searching algorithm that incrementally refines the candidate set through a hierarchy of searches, starting from low-dimensional embeddings and progressing into higher, target-dimensionality, enabling scalable and high-performance retrieval even for large databases.

2602.07303.tldr: KRONE is proposed, the first hierarchical anomaly detection framework that automatically derives execution hierarchies from flat logs to enable modular, multi-level anomaly detection.

2602.07307.tldr: By leveraging relation-specific message passing, the deep model prioritizes pedagogical relevance over raw connectivity, resulting in superior, high-quality, domain-specific recommendations.

2602.07308.tldr: This work develops and evaluates a system that adaptively scaffolds cognitive engagement by dynamically selecting worked examples in two different ICAP modes: (active) Guided examples and (constructive) Buggy examples, and demonstrates that both adaptive policies significantly improved student performance on test problems.

2602.07309.tldr: LinkedIn's LLM-based semantic search framework for AI Job Search and AI People Search is presented, combining an LLM relevance judge, embedding-based retrieval, and a compact Small Language Model trained via multi-teacher distillation to jointly optimize relevance and engagement.

2602.07311.tldr: This study introduces LUCID (Learning Unified vision-language sparse Codes for Interpretable concept Discovery), a unified vision-language sparse autoencoder that learns a shared latent dictionary for image patch and text token representations, while reserving private capacity for modality-specific details.

2602.07319.tldr: A risk-sensitive evaluation framework that quantifies hallucinations through the presence of risk-bearing language, including treatment directives, contraindications, urgency cues, and mentions of high-risk medications is proposed and applied to three instruction-tuned language models using controlled patient-facing prompts designed as safety stress tests.

2602.07322.tldr: Action-to-Action flow matching (A2A) is proposed, a novel policy paradigm that shifts from random sampling to initialization informed by the previous action, and exhibits superior robustness to visual perturbations and enhanced generalization to unseen configurations.

2602.07333.tldr: This work proposes a novel Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework to synthesize a unified textual representation for each member of a recommender system, which leverages implicit user engagement signals as the primary reward to distill salient information.

2602.07338.tldr: This paper proposes to decouple intent understanding from task execution through a Mediator-Assistant architecture that effectively bridges the gap between vague user intent and model interpretation, and demonstrates that this method significantly mitigates performance degradation in multi-turn conversations across diverse LLMs.

2602.07339.tldr: RAPiD is presented, a deterministic policy extraction framework that distills a pretrained diffusion-based planner into an efficient policy while eliminating diffusion sampling using score-regularized policy optimization.

2602.07342.tldr: This work establishes a principled benchmark for studying reliable long-horizon orchestration in real-world operational settings and highlights significant room for improvement in LLM-based supply chain agents.

2602.07343.tldr: This work proposes CLARITY, a dynamic fusion strategy that dynamically adapts its fusion strategy to the detected scene condition, and introduces two mechanisms, i.e., one which preserves valid dark-object semantics that prior noise-suppression methods incorrectly discard, and a hierarchical decoder that enforces structural consistency across scales to sharpen boundaries on thin objects.

2602.07359.tldr: This work proposes the Wide and Deep research agent, a framework designed to investigate the behavior and performance of agents when scaling not only depth but also width via parallel tool calling, and demonstrates that scaling width significantly improves performance on deep research benchmarks while reducing the number of turns required to obtain correct answers.

2602.07374.tldr: The results suggest that native 1-bit training is a promising direction for efficient neural language models, and layer-wise quantization analysis showing that middle transformer layers exhibit highest compatibility with extreme quantization, informing future non-uniform precision strategies.

2602.07382.tldr: A framework to enhance extractive neural summarization models by incorporating domain-specific pre-trained encoders tailored for legal texts by incorporating domain-specific pre-trained encoders tailored for legal texts is proposed.

2602.07391.tldr: NAAMSE, an evolutionary framework that reframes agent security evaluation as a feedback-driven optimization problem, employs a single autonomous agent that orchestrates a lifecycle of genetic prompt mutation, hierarchical corpus exploration, and asymmetric behavioral scoring and shows that evolutionary mutation systematically amplifies vulnerabilities missed by one-shot methods.

2602.07397.tldr: Sketch&Walk Attention is introduced, a training-free sparse attention method that determines sparsity with lightweight sketches and deterministic walk that can slightly outperform dense attention in some settings, while achieving up to 6x inference speedup.

2602.07398.tldr: AgentSys is presented, a framework that defends against indirect prompt injection through explicit memory management and remains robust to adaptive attackers and across multiple foundation models, showing that explicit memory management enables secure, dynamic LLM agent architectures.

2602.07399.tldr: A novel framework for few-shot VLA adaptation that employs a finetuned VLA as a high-recall proposal generator and introduces the geometrically grounded Transformer critic to resolve fine-grained geometric ambiguities is proposed.

2602.07408.tldr: LINCSQA is presented, a novel benchmark for predicting target gene regulation under complex chemical perturbations in bulk-cell environments and PBio-Agent, a multi-agent framework that integrates difficulty-aware task sequencing with iterative knowledge refinement, enabling even smaller models to predict and explain complex biological processes without additional training.

2602.07414.tldr: An evaluation framework is introduced that enables direct comparison of human-human and LLM-LLM behaviors in dispute resolution dialogues with respect to Big Five Inventory (BFI) personality traits and highlights the need for psychological grounding and validation in AI simulations before real-world use.

2602.07415.tldr: This work proposes the chiral determinant kernel to encode the SE(3)-invariant chirality matrix and employs cross-attention to integrate stereochemical information from local chiral centers into the global molecular representation.

2602.07422.tldr: SecCoderX first bridges vulnerability detection and secure code generation by repurposing mature detection resources in two ways: synthesizing diverse, reality-grounded vulnerability-inducing coding tasks for online RL rollouts, and training a reasoning-based vulnerability reward model that provides scalable and reliable security supervision.

2602.07429.tldr: This work introduces Brep2Shape, a novel self-supervised pre-training method designed to align abstract boundary representations with intuitive shape representations, and proposes a Dual Transformer backbone with parallel streams that independently encode surface and curve tokens to capture their distinct geometric properties.

2602.07433.tldr: The findings demonstrate the potential of multi-agent systems for creating social norm interventions and offer insights into leveraging social identity dynamics to promote prosocial behavior in virtual environments.

2602.07434.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that the approach significantly outperforms unimodal baselines in naturalness, emotional clarity, and modal coherence, advancing socially expressive humanoid robotics for diverse real-world environments.

2602.07439.tldr: TextOp is a real-time text-driven humanoid motion generation and control framework that supports streaming language commands and on-the-fly instruction modification during execution that unlocks free-form intent expression and enables smooth transitions across multiple challenging behaviors such as dancing and jumping, within a single continuous motion execution.

2602.07441.tldr: Pro proximal action replacement (PAR), a plug-and-play training sample replacer that progressively replaces low-value actions with high-value actions generated by a stable actor, broadening the action exploration space while reducing the impact of low-value data.

2602.07457.tldr: Clean Pull Request is proposed, a mid-training paradigm that leverages real-world GitHub pull requests as a training signal for repository-level editing that demonstrates that repository-level code understanding and editing capabilities can be effectively internalised into model weights under a simplified, agentless protocol, without relying on heavy inference-time scaffolding.

2602.07470.tldr: A controlled evaluation framework is introduced that perturbs a model's own CoT at fixed timesteps and provides new evidence on how RLLMs maintain reasoning integrity, identify doubt as a central recovery mechanism, and highlight trade-offs between robustness and efficiency that future training methods should address.

2602.07473.tldr: This work introduces posterior-deterministic POMDPs, a novel class of POMDPs that includes all MDPs and captures classical non-trivial examples such as the Tiger POMDP, one of the largest known classes of POMDPs for which the reachability value can be approximated.

2602.07491.tldr: A multi-agent framework guided by large-scale knowledge graphs to find sustainable substitutes for per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)-chemicals currently under intense regulatory scrutiny is introduced.

2602.07517.tldr: This paper proposes MemPot, the first theoretically verified defense framework against memory extraction attacks by injecting optimized honeypots into the memory, and generates trap documents that maximize the retrieval probability for attackers while remaining inconspicuous to benign users.

2602.07533.tldr: JRM is proposed, which jointly optimizes preference learning and language modeling on a shared vision-language backbone and achieves state-of-the-art results on MMRB2 and EditReward-Bench, and significantly improves stability and performance in downstream online reinforcement learning.

2602.07534.tldr: This paper presents a deep learning-based approach for classifying cat breeds using a subset of the Oxford-IIIT Pet Dataset, which contains high-resolution images of various domestic breeds, and employs the Global Context Vision Transformer architecture-tiny for cat breed recognition.

2602.07535.tldr: Findings suggest that encoder-derived feature manifolds reflect underlying tissue phenotypes and state transitions, providing insight into imaging-based quantification of stroke evolution.

2602.07549.tldr: The Epistemic Ledger is introduced, an evaluation framework that tracks evidential support and agents'beliefs for each constraint throughout multi-turn reasoning throughout multi-constraint reasoning, and whether explicit constraint-state tracking during execution mitigates these failures via LiveLedger, an inference-time tracker.

2602.07550.tldr: This study investigates the intrinsic few-shot semantic segmentation capabilities of frozen DINOv3 features through a training-free baseline, FSSDINO, utilizing class-specific prototypes and Gram-matrix refinement to identify a significant performance gap between the standard last-layer features and globally optimal intermediate representations.

2602.07555.tldr: This work proposes a compact 3B-parameter Vision-Language-Action agent that performs human-like embodied reasoning for both object recognition and action selection, removing the need for stitched multi-model pipelines.

2602.07559.tldr: Verify-RL is introduced, a framework where every parent-child decomposition satisfies three verifiable conditions: strictly decreasing structural complexity, solution containment, and formal rule derivation, and it is demonstrated that eliminating invalid decompositions yields sizable gains.

2602.07562.tldr: Gaussian Match-and-Copy (GMC), a minimalist benchmark that isolates long-range retrieval through pure second-order correlation signals, is introduced, and an implicit-bias regime in which gradient descent drives the parameters to diverge while their direction aligns with the max-margin separator, yielding hard match selection is identified.

2602.07566.tldr: This work establishes a subspace-theoretic feature disentanglement framework for collaborative cross-camera cow identification, offering a new paradigm for precise animal monitoring in uncontrolled smart farming environments.

2602.07570.tldr: This study investigates how the temporal context length of video clips and the narrative-task prompting shape brain-model alignment during naturalistic movie watching to position long-form narrative movies as a principled testbed for probing biologically relevant temporal integration and interpretable representations in long-context MLLMs.

2602.07573.tldr: This work proposes a novel homophily-agnostic approach that effectively transfers knowledge between graphs with varying degrees of homophily and adopts a divide-and-conquer strategy that first separately reconstructs highly homophilic and heterophilic variants of both the source and target graphs, and then performs knowledge alignment separately between corresponding graph variants.

2602.07590.tldr: The results show that synthetic data can support supervised joint trace detection when real data are scarce and supports reliable joint mapping and provides a basis for further work on domain adaptation and evaluation.

2602.07594.tldr: Interestingly, it is found that the reverse direction of this asymmetry behaves differently: learning to self-verify can effectively improve generation performance, achieving accuracy comparable to standard generation training while yielding more efficient and effective reasoning traces.

2602.07595.tldr: A systematical post-training framework that organizes supervised policy shaping, reward-driven reinforcement learning, and preference-based refinement into a single stability-constrained optimization stack that provides a clear blueprint for building scalable post-training pipelines that remain stable, extensible, and effective in real-world deployment settings.

2602.07596.tldr: This work proposes Astro, an Activation-guided Structured Regularization framework designed to suppress the negative effects of outliers in a hardware-friendly and efficient manner, and actively reconstructs intrinsically robust weights, aggressively suppressing weight outliers corresponding to high-magnitude activations without sacrificing model accuracy.

2602.07609.tldr: This study analyzed 980 ADRs across 109 GitHub repositories using a multi-model pipeline in which one LLM primary screens potential decision violations, and three additional LLMs independently validate the reasoning.

2602.07616.tldr: SERE dynamically reduces the number of active experts in an input-aware manner by re-routing tokens from secondary experts to their most similar primary counterparts, thereby preventing capability loss and providing a practical solution for cost-efficient and latency-sensitive large-scale MoE deployment.

2602.07624.tldr: Experiments show that M2A significantly outperforms baselines, demonstrating that transforming personalization from one-shot configuration to a co-evolving memory mechanism provides a viable path for high-quality individualized responses in long-term multimodal interactions.

2602.07625.tldr: AD-MIR, a framework designed to decode advertising intent via a two-stage architecture, achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing the strongest general-purpose agent, DVD, by 1.8% in strict and 9.5% in relaxed accuracy.

2602.07628.tldr: A Sleep Foundation Model engineered to master both hour-long sleep architectures and fine-grained signal morphologies, which outperforms existing foundation models across a diverse suite of downstream tasks, demonstrating superior generalizability and label-efficient adaptation for clinical sleep analysis.

2602.07642.tldr: This work proposes TabRAG, a framework that enables MLLMs to answer queries over large collections of table images by significantly outperforms existing methods in retrieval recall and answer accuracy, offering a practical solution for real-world table understanding tasks.

2602.07645.tldr: An API-based pipeline that converts a static infographic into a native, editable Google Slides slide by extracting a region-level specification with a vision-language model (VLM), mapping pixel geometry into slide coordinates, and recreating elements using the Google Slides batch update API is described.

2602.07659.tldr: Although isotropic mutation occasionally attains higher peak performance, geometry-compiled mutation yields faster, more reliable progress, demonstrating that semantically aligned mutation can substantially improve search efficiency without modifying the underlying evolutionary algorithm.

2602.07662.tldr: A Reference Ontology of Trust (ONTrust) was developed, grounded on the Unified Foundational Ontology and specified in OntoUML, which formally characterizes the concept of trust and its different types, describes the different factors that can influence trust, as well as explains how risk emerges from trust relations.

2602.07668.tldr: This research proposes an augmentation to the looking-in-looking-out (LILO) framework, making a case for the audio modality as an additional source of information to understand the driver, and in the evolving autonomy landscape, also the passengers and those outside the vehicle.

2602.07670.tldr: For dense-reward VEG tasks, compute should be allocated to sample diversity and intelligent selection rather than gradient adaptation, and the surprisal-guided selection principle may generalize to other execution-grounded domains where optimal solutions occupy the distribution tail.

2602.07679.tldr: Spectral Gating Networks (SGN) is introduced, a drop-in spectral reparameterization that consistently improves accuracy-efficiency trade-offs under comparable computational budgets, achieving 93.15% accuracy on CIFAR-10 and up to 11.7x faster inference than spline-based KAN variants.

2602.07689.tldr: Process-of-Thought (PoT) Reasoning for Videos is proposed, a framework that makes the reasoning process explicit by structuring video inference into a sequence of lightweight, verifiable steps, and introduces a unified representation for PoT traces that aligns intermediate decisions with temporal segments, which improves robustness to distractors and reduces hallucinated explanations.

2602.07697.tldr: This work shows that the set of width- and depth-stable feature-learning parameterisations for PC is exactly the same as for BP, and shows that these results hold in practice for deep nonlinear networks, as long as an activity equilibrium seem to be reached.

2602.07730.tldr: This work introduces the Laplacian Keyboard (LK), a hierarchical framework that goes beyond the linear span and establishes theoretical bounds on zero-shot approximation error and demonstrates empirically that LK surpasses zero-shot solutions while achieving improved sample efficiency compared to standard RL methods.

2602.07739.tldr: This work introduces hyperbolic dense retrieval, developing two model variants in the Lorentz model of hyperbolic space: HyTE-FH, a fully hyperbolic transformer, and HyTE-H, a hybrid architecture projecting pre-trained Euclidean embeddings into hyperbolic space.

2602.07749.tldr: Geo-coder is proposed -- the first inverse programming framework for geometric images based on a multi-agent system and exhibits equivalent performance to the original ones in multimodal reasoning tasks, which fully validates the robustness of the framework.

2602.07755.tldr: This paper introduces ALMA (Automated meta-Learning of Memory designs for Agentic systems), a framework that meta-learns memory designs to replace hand-engineered memory designs, therefore minimizing human effort and enabling agentic systems to be continual learners across diverse domains.

2602.07764.tldr: This work introduces D^3PO, a PPO-based framework that reorganizes multi-objective policy optimization to address two structural issues in current methods: destructive gradient interference caused by premature scalarization and representational collapse across the preference space.

2602.07765.tldr: The proposed DisIV framework is a novel method for causal inference based on networked observational data with latent confounders that exploits network homogeneity as an inductive bias and employs a structural disentanglement mechanism to extract individual-specific components that serve as latent IVs.

2602.07768.tldr: This work proposes PAND (Prompt-Aware Neighborhood Distillation), a two-stage framework that decouples semantic calibration from structural transfer in Fine-Grained Visual Classification, and incorporates Prompt-Aware Semantic Calibration to generate adaptive semantic anchors.

2602.07783.tldr: This work proposes LintCFG, a domain-specific language (DSL)-driven, LLM-based compilation approach to automate linter configuration generation for coding standards, independent of programming languages, coding standards, and linters.

2602.07787.tldr: Minitap is presented, a multi-agent system that achieves 100% success on the AndroidWorld benchmark, the first to fully solve all 116 tasks and surpassing human performance and released as open-source software.

2602.07798.tldr: CausalTaD is presented, a method that injects causal knowledge into LLMs for tabular anomaly detection by identifying the causal relationships between columns and reorder them to align with these causal relationships.

2602.07799.tldr: This work provides the first theoretical analysis of reward-level fairness in LLM alignment, establishing provable fairness certificates for Faro-trained rewards with controllable slack and the existence of a non-empty Pareto frontier.

2602.07801.tldr: This work proposes VideoTemp-o3, a unified agentic thinking-with-videos framework that jointly models video grounding and question answering, which exhibits strong localization capability, supports on-demand clipping, and can refine inaccurate localizations.

2602.07803.tldr: SoulX-Singer is introduced, a high-quality open-source SVS system designed with practical deployment considerations in mind, and SoulX-Singer-Eval, a dedicated benchmark with strict training-test disentanglement facilitating systematic assessment in zero-shot settings.

2602.07804.tldr: A game-theoretic framework that formulates layer pruning as a cooperative game in which each layer acts as a player and model performance serves as the utility is proposed, achieving more efficient and effective layer-wise pruning for large language models.

2602.07814.tldr: This work presents the first comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of 16 state-of-the-art detection methods, comprising 23 pretrained detector variants (due to multiple released versions of certain detectors), across 12 diverse datasets, and challenges the ``one-size-fits-all''detector paradigm.

2602.07824.tldr: Data Darwinism, a ten-level taxonomy that conceptualizes data-model co-evolution: advanced models produce superior data for next-generation systems is introduced, confirming that higher-level processing unlocks latent data value.

2602.07828.tldr: This work finetune an LLM with a simple auxiliary loss, training 16 of its 3072 residual stream dimensions to be inert interpretability flags that simply indicate what concepts are required for generation, allowing the model to steer generation at inference time.

2602.07830.tldr: VeriTime is introduced, a framework that tailors LLMs for time series reasoning through data synthesis, data scheduling, and RL training that enables compact 3B, 4B models to achieve reasoning capabilities on par with or exceeding those of larger proprietary LLMs.

2602.07832.tldr: This paper introduces rePIRL, an inverse RL-inspired framework that learns effective process reward models with minimal assumptions about expert policies, and designs a dual learning process that updates the policy and the PRM interchangeably.

2602.07833.tldr: SAGE, a train-free visual evidence-calibrated framework that improves visual routing and aligns reasoning with perception, is proposed, a train-free visual evidence-calibrated framework that improves visual routing and aligns reasoning with perception.

2602.07839.tldr: This work introduces TodoEvolve, a meta-planning paradigm that autonomously synthesizes and dynamically revises task-specific planning architectures within a unified codebase encompassing topology, initialization, adaptation, and navigation, thereby providing a common interface for heterogeneous planning patterns.

2602.07852.tldr: It is found that models can just learn the narrow dataset task, but that the general solution appears to be more stable and more efficient, and a linear representation of the narrow solution also exists, and can be learned by introducing a KL divergence loss.

2602.07865.tldr: AttentionGuard, a framework that detects engagement-attention states from privacy-preserving behavioral signals and adapts interface elements accordingly, is presented, contributing empirically validated UI patterns for attention-adaptive interfaces and evidence that behavioral attention detection can meaningfully support neurodivergent learning experiences.

2602.07873.tldr: Noise-Conditioned Langevin Q-Learning (NC-LQL), which integrates multi-scale noise perturbations into the value function and achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art diffusion-based methods, providing a simple yet powerful solution for online RL.

2602.07878.tldr: This paper introduces a new Fill and Squeeze attack strategy targeting the state transition of the scheduler, and reveals that system-level optimization such as continuous batching provides a logical isolation to mitigate contagious latency impact on co-located users.

2602.07881.tldr: Evaluations over AWGN and 5G-NR fading channels demonstrate that DeepVLF substantially outperforms state-of-the-art learned feedback codes and achieves the same block error rate with 20%-55% fewer channel uses and lowers error floors by orders of magnitude, particularly in high-rate regimes.

2602.07884.tldr: GRAFT (Gated Residual Accelerated Failure Time), a novel AFT model that decouples prognostic ranking from calibration, combines a linear AFT model with a non-linear residual neural network, and it also integrates stochastic gates for automatic, end-to-end feature selection.

2602.07885.tldr: This work proposes MemFly, a framework grounded in information bottleneck principles that facilitates on-the-fly memory evolution for LLMs, and develops a hybrid retrieval mechanism that seamlessly integrates semantic, symbolic, and topological pathways.

2602.07886.tldr: Rich-ARQ is presented, a paradigm that introduces neural-coded feedback for collaborative physical-layer channel coding between transmitter and receiver, and develops a novel asynchronous feedback code that eliminates stalling from feedback delays, adapts dynamically to channel fluctuations, and features a lightweight encoder suitable for on-device deployment.

2602.07891.tldr: SAGE pioneers the adaptation of geometric foundation models via Internet video, establishing a scalable paradigm for general-purpose 3D learning.

2602.07901.tldr: A novel approach is introduced that incrementally constructs connected factor graphs, ensuring the incorporation of all available sensor data by choosing the optimal graph topology based on the external evaluation criteria, and facilitates graph compression, reducing the number of nodes (optimized variables) by ∼30% on average while maintaining map quality at a level comparable to conventional approaches.

2602.07903.tldr: A novel variant of PageRank named motif-based personalized PageRank (MPPR) is proposed to measure the influence of one node to another on the basis of considering higher-order motif relationships, and the experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms almost all of the baselines on accuracy, stability, and time consumption.

2602.07904.tldr: LMABO is introduced, a novel framework that casts a pre-trained Large Language Model as a zero-shot, online strategist for the BO process, proving its advantage stems from its ability to process and synthesize the complete optimization state into an effective, adaptive policy.

2602.07905.tldr: This paper proposes MedCoG, a Medical Meta-Cognition Agent with Knowledge Graph, where the meta-cognitive assessments of task complexity, familiarity, and knowledge density dynamically regulate utilization of procedural, episodic, and factual knowledge.

2602.07915.tldr: This work aims to provide a comprehensive and systematic evaluation of TSCD methods under assumption violations, thereby facilitating their broader adoption in real-world applications and providing hyperparameter sensitivity analyses to deepen the understanding of these findings.

2602.07919.tldr: TRUST (Targeted Robust Selective fine Tuning), a novel approach for dynamically estimating target concept neurons and unlearning them through selective finetuning, empowered by a Hessian based regularization, is proposed.

2602.07928.tldr: Motivated by classical mechanics, Kinetic Path Energy (KPE) is introduced, an action-like, per-sample diagnostic that measures the accumulated kinetic effort along an Ordinary Differential Equation trajectory and motivates Kinetic Trajectory Shaping (KTS), a training-free two-phase inference strategy that boosts early motion and enforces a late-time soft landing, reducing memorization and improving generation quality across benchmark tasks.

2602.07943.tldr: The results show the potential of LLMs to discover valid instrumental variables from a large observational database and introduce IV Co-Scientist, a multi-agent system that proposes, critiques, and refines IVs for a given treatment-outcome pair.

2602.07958.tldr: This work proposes an uncertainty-aware offloading framework that dynamically decides whether to perform inference locally or offload it to the ES, based on token-level uncertainty and resource constraints, and defines a margin-based token-level uncertainty metric and demonstrates its correlation with model accuracy.

2602.07962.tldr: LOCA-bench is introduced, a benchmark for LOng-Context Agents that leverages automated and scalable control of environment states to regulate the agent's context length and enables LOCA-bench to extend the context length potentially to infinity in a controlled way while keeping the underlying task semantics fixed.

2602.07966.tldr: A multi-task similarity measure based on Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques, specifically Accumulated Local Effects (ALE) curves, that aligns with intuitive expectations of task similarity across both tabular and non-tabular data, making it a valuable tool for exploring relationships between tasks and supporting informed decision-making.

2602.07983.tldr: An agentic framework that operationalizes end-to-end discovery through a Bayesian optimization inspired two-phase search, in which a Generator proposes candidate hypotheses and an Experimenter evaluates them empirically, which consistently discovers 2-4x more statistically significant hypotheses that are 7-17 percent more predictive than prior approaches.

2602.07993.tldr: This work proposes MCIE-E1, a Multimodal Large Language Model-Driven Complex Instruction Image Editing method that integrates two key modules: a spatial-aware cross-attention module and a background-consistent cross-attention module that enhances instruction-following capability.

2602.08003.tldr: This work proposes a simple greedy mutual-information selection algorithm that estimates the required information terms directly from data and iteratively builds an ensemble under a query budget that consistently outperforms strong baselines under the same query budget.

2602.08005.tldr: DeltaKV is proposed, a residual-based KV cache compression framework motivated by long-range inter-token similarity and highly shared latent components in KV representations that encodes semantic residuals relative to retrieved historical references, preserving fidelity while substantially reducing storage.

2602.08006.tldr: This work presents ForecastOcc, the first framework for vision-based semantic occupancy forecasting that jointly predicts future occupancy states and semantic categories, and proposes a novel architecture that incorporates a temporal cross-attention forecasting module, a 2D-to-3D view transformer, a 3D encoder for occupancy prediction, and a semantic occupancy head for voxel-level forecasts across multiple horizons.

2602.08007.tldr: TSR-Adam is proposed, which brings two-sided low-rank communication to Adam-family updates (TSR-Adam) by synchronizing a compact core, reducing the dominant per-step payload from $O(mn)$ to $O(r^2)$ while keeping moment states in low-dimensional cores.

2602.08009.tldr: RAPS is a reputation-aware publish-subscribe paradigm for adaptive, scalable, and robust coordination of LLM agents, allowing LLM agents to exchange messages based on their declared intents rather than predefined topologies.

2602.08013.tldr: Results show that SAG achieves superior performance compared to a single giant model, both with and without additional optimization or retrieval-augmented generation, and suggest that the synergistic reasoning represented by SAG can substitute for model parameter growth in clinical settings.

2602.08014.tldr: ICBAC is an intelligent contract-based access control framework that integrates permissioned blockchain (Hyperledger Fabric) with federated learning (FL), and provides effective anomaly detection under IID and non-IID data with zero raw-data sharing.

2602.08021.tldr: This work presents a structure-aware and robustness-oriented counterfactual search method based on the conditional Gaussian network classifier (CGNC), which has a generative structure that encodes conditional dependencies and potential causal relations among features through a directed acyclic graph (DAG).

2602.08024.tldr: FlashVID is a training-free inference acceleration framework for VLLMs that utilizes Attention and Diversity-based Token Selection (ADTS) to select the most representative tokens for basic video representation, then applies Tree-based Spatiotemporal Token Merging (TSTM) for fine-grained spatiotemporal redundancy elimination.

2602.08041.tldr: This work introduces Implicit Strategic Optimization (ISO), a prediction-aware framework in which each agent forecasts the current strategic context and uses it to update its policy online, and proves sublinear contextual regret and equilibrium convergence guarantees whose dominant terms scale with the number of context mispredictions.

2602.08043.tldr: V-ABFT is a variance-based adaptive threshold algorithm that achieves tighter error bounds by directly modeling the verification difference and is integrated into fault-tolerant GEMM implementations on both NPUs and GPUs.

2602.08052.tldr: A Deep Reinforcement Learning framework using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and a Graph Neural Network (GNN), allowing the PPO agent to learn a direct scheduling policy and provides a robust and scalable solution for complex manufacturing scheduling.

2602.08054.tldr: Across various safety-critical tasks, including Safety-Gymnasium benchmarks, EpiFlow achieves competitive returns with near-zero empirical safety violations, demonstrating the effectiveness of epigraph-guided policy synthesis.

2602.08057.tldr: A multimodal weak-supervision framework is proposed and achieves state-of-the-art results on the iMiGUE tennis-interview dataset and validates that an"MLP-ified"key-point backbone can match - or even surpass - GCN-based counterparts in this task.

2602.08058.tldr: This paper proposes the Picasso dataset, a collection of 10 contact-rich real-world scenes with ground truth annotations, as well as a metric to quantify physical plausibility, and provides an extensive evaluation of Picasso, a physics-constrained reconstruction pipeline that builds multi-object scene reconstructions by considering geometry, non-penetration, and physics.

2602.08059.tldr: DICE (Disentanglement of artist Style from Content via Contrastive Subspace Decomposition), a training-free framework for on-the-fly artist style erasure, is proposed, formalizing this disentanglement process as a solvable generalized eigenvalue problem, which achieves precise identification of the style subspace.

2602.08061.tldr: A five-tier Biosecurity Data Level (BDL) framework for categorizing pathogen data is introduced, based on their expected ability to contribute to capabilities of concern when used to train AI models, and technical restrictions appropriate to its level of risk are proposed.

2602.08064.tldr: SiameseNorm is a two-stream architecture that couples Pre-Norm-like and Post-Norm-like streams with shared parameters, retaining the distinct characteristics of both Pre-Norm and Post-Norm by enabling all residual blocks to receive combined gradients inherited from both paradigms.

2602.08082.tldr: It is discovered that single layer spectral features act as near-perfect hallucination detectors: Llama L26 Smoothness achieves 98.2\% recall (213/217 hallucinations caught) with a single threshold, and Mistral L3 Entropy achieves 94.7\% recall, which suggests hallucination is not merely a wrong token but a thermodynamic state change: the model's attention becomes noise when it errs.

2602.08085.tldr: This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent advances in applying large language models to the study of spreading dynamics across two representative domains: digital epidemics, such as misinformation and rumors, and biological epidemics, including infectious disease outbreaks.

2602.08088.tldr: Online Domain-aware Decoding framework (ODD) is introduced, which performs probability-level fusion between a base LLM and a prefix-tree prior, guided by adaptive confidence modulation using disagreement and continuity signals, making it suitable for dynamic LLM applications.

1808.07645.tldr: This paper proposes a novel policy-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) method, which enables the questioner agent to learn the optimal policy of question selection through continuous interactions with users and also proposes to use a reward network to estimate the more informative reward.

2403.11852.tldr: This work proposes DAROM, a Delay-Aware Reinforcement Learning framework for On-ramp Merging that is robust to stochastic delays and develops a unified RL agent for joint longitudinal and lateral control.

2405.04605.tldr: A public, reproducible multi-dataset benchmark for lung nodule detection and nodule-level cancer classification and quantify cross-dataset generalizability is established.

2407.04259.tldr: It is shown that Wasserstein ball and parametric ambiguity sets can be approximated by finite ambiguity sets, allowing the algorithm to be used as a generic solver beyond the finite setting.

2409.01392.tldr: ComfyAgent is developed, a novel framework that empowers LLM-based agents to autonomously design collaborative AI systems by generating workflows and constructs a multi-agent system that cooperates to learn from existing workflows and generate new workflows for a given task.

2411.17257.tldr: DiPE-Linear is a novel model that disentangles this monolithic mapping into a sequence of specialized, parameter-efficient modules, and reduces parameter complexity from quadratic to linear and computational complexity to log-linear.

2412.14869.tldr: By adding two layers to the co-scale convolutional attention (CCA) classifier architecture, a novel approach for ICH detection is introduced, introducing a novel uncertainty-based fuzzy integral operator to fuse information from different CT scan slices and significantly improves detection accuracy.

2501.17207.tldr: This study re-examines graph deep learning versus classical machine learning models based on four large-scale neuroimaging studies and proposes a hybrid model combining a linear model with a graph attention network through dual pathways, achieving robust predictions and enhanced interpretability by revealing both localized and global neural connectivity patterns.

2502.13313.tldr: Efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA mitigate privacy risks similar to private fine-tuning methods like DP, which directly contradicts prevailing wisdom that privacy and efficiency objectives are at odds during fine-tuning.

2502.15487.tldr: ExpliCa is introduced, a new dataset for evaluating LLMs in explicit causal reasoning that uniquely integrates both causal and temporal relations presented in different linguistic orders and explicitly expressed by linguistic connectives.

2503.03802.tldr: RiskAgent is presented, which synergizes language models with hundreds of validated clinical decision tools supported by evidence-based medicine, to provide generalizable and faithful recommendations to complex clinical decision-making.

2503.05066.tldr: This work proposesCapacity-Aware Token Drop, which enforces expert capacity limits by discarding excess tokens from overloaded experts, effectively reducing load imbalance with minimal performance impact, and introduces Expanded Drop, which allows tokens to include additional local experts in their candidate set before enforcing strict local capacity constraints, thereby improving load balance and enhancing the utilization of underused experts.

2503.07660.tldr: It is argued that superalignment is achievable and research on it should advance immediately, through simultaneous and alternating optimization of task competence and value conformity, and that superalignment is not merely a safeguard for ASI but also necessary for its responsible realization.

2503.08609.tldr: This work proposes an advanced pyramid vision transformer (PVT)-based model, leveraging its hierarchical attention mechanisms to capture both local and global spatial dependencies in brain CT scans, and introduces an entropy-aware aggregation strategy along with a fuzzy integral operator for decision fusion, ensuring a more comprehensive and reliable scan-level diagnosis.

2505.11731.tldr: A novel distributional distillation framework (Dist2ill) is proposed that trains an LLM to produce multiple diverse reasoning paths within one inference pass, while using a lightweight parametric module to approximate empirical confidence scores derived from the sampling distribution.

2505.14185.tldr: Rather than residing in distinct directions, this work shows that safety is highly entangled with the general learning components of the model, suggesting that subspace-based defenses face fundamental limitations and underscores the need for alternative strategies to preserve safety under continued training.

2505.14238.tldr: ABBA is introduced, a new PEFT architecture that reparameterizes the update as a Hadamard product of two independently learnable low-rank matrices, leading to significantly higher expressivity under the same parameter budget.

2505.15047.tldr: The introduction of PiFlow, an information-theoretical framework, treating automated scientific discovery as a structured uncertainty reduction problem guided by principles, establishes a novel paradigm shift in highly efficient agentic scientific discovery, paving the way for more robust and accelerated AI-driven research.

2506.00175.tldr: This work introduces estimators that efficiently quantify stage effects without retraining the model, accounting for both the data and key aspects of model optimization dynamics, including learning rate schedules, momentum, and weight decay.

2506.16982.tldr: Language Bottleneck Models are proposed, where an encoder LLM produces textual knowledge state summaries, which a decoder LLM uses to predict future performance, which demonstrates that the encoder and decoder can be fine-tuned with reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning respectively to improve both summary quality and predictive performance.

2506.19385.tldr: The results demonstrate that integrating intent transition structures with semantic retrieval creates a synergistic effect that neither approach achieves independently, establishing CID-GraphRAG as an effective framework for real-world multi-turn dialogue systems in customer service and other knowledge-intensive domains.

2507.00075.tldr: This paper theoretically model the training dynamics of self-improvement via the concept of solver-verifier gap, inspired by the conjecture that the performance enhancement of self-improvement stems from the gap between LLM's solver capability and verifier capability.

2507.03041.tldr: This work presents extensive evaluations across five real-world compound systems to demonstrate that Optimas outperforms strong baselines by an average improvement of 11.92%, offering a general and effective approach for improving compound systems.

2507.04034.tldr: Lyria, a neuro-symbolic reasoning framework building on the integration of LLMs, genetic algorithms, and symbolic systems, comprising 7 essential components is proposed, and LAFT which enables a weaker model to imitate the reasoning process of a stronger model that reason under the Lyria reasoning framework is introduced.

2507.05713.tldr: DRAGOn, method to design a RAG benchmark on a regularly updated corpus features recent reference datasets, a question generation framework, an automatic evaluation pipeline, and a public leaderboard to track the development of RAG systems and encourage community participation.

2507.12412.tldr: This work proposes NOCTA, a Non-Greedy Objective Cost-Tradeoff Acquisition framework that sequentially acquires the most informative features at inference time while accounting for both temporal dynamics and acquisition cost.

2507.13428.tldr: This paper presents PhyWorldBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate video generation models based on their adherence to the laws of physics, and introduces a novel Anti-Physics category, where prompts intentionally violate real-world physics, enabling the assessment of whether models can follow such instructions while maintaining logical consistency.

2508.13786.tldr: A novel dynamic event graph-guided diffusion transformer framework for open-vocabulary controllable audio generation, and a quality-balanced data selection pipeline that combines hierarchical event annotation with multi-criteria quality scoring, resulting in a curated dataset with semantic diversity.
