2508.13898.tldr: Fisher-Orthogonal Projection (FOP), a novel technique that restores the effectiveness of the second-order method at very large batch sizes, enabling scalable training with improved generalization and faster convergence is introduced.

2508.15305.tldr: This work proposes Coarse-to-Fine Grounded Memory (\The authors'), a novel framework that grounds coarse-to-fine memories with LLM, thereby fully leverage them for flexible adaptation to diverse scenarios.

2508.19819.tldr: The findings indicate that, under an honest-but-curious server assumption, high-fidelity image reconstruction via gradient inversion does not constitute a critical privacy risk in production-optimized federated learning systems, and that practical risk assessments must carefully distinguish diagnostic attack settings from real-world deployments.

2508.20033.tldr: DeepScholar-bench is far from saturated: no system surpasses a geometric mean of $31\%$ across all metrics, which highlights both the difficulty and importance of DeepScholar-bench as a foundation for advancing AI systems capable of generative research synthesis.

2509.05614.tldr: This paper points out spatial-temporal consistency in VLA tasks: input images in consecutive steps exhibit high similarity, and proposes SpecPrune-VLA, a training-free, two-level pruning method with heuristic control, which achieves up to 1.57% speedup in LIBERO simulation and 1.70% on real-world tasks, with negligible success rate degradation.

2509.07820.tldr: CGR is introduced, a model-agnostic adaptive inference procedure that periodically probes whether the current reasoning supports a confident final answer and terminates early once a target certainty threshold is reached, otherwise continuing until the end-of-thinking token or the budget limit.

2509.10625.tldr: This work extracts activations after a question is read but before any tokens are generated, and trains linear probes to predict whether the model's forthcoming answer will be correct, indicating a deeper signal than dataset-specific spurious features, and outperforming black-box baselines and verbalised predicted confidence.

2509.21765.tldr: LLR-BC is proposed, a novel lifelong learning paradigm for neural VRP solvers, where multiple tasks with diverse distributions and scales arise sequentially over time and addresses the catastrophic forgetting issue, maintaining their plasticity, and improving zero-shot generalization ability.

2509.21880.tldr: This work introduces Reinforcement Learning with Zero-Variance Prompts (RL-ZVP), a novel algorithm that extract learning signals from zero-variance prompts and directly rewards correctness and penalizes errors even without contrasting responses, modulating feedback with token-level characteristics to preserve informative, nuanced signals.

2509.21886.tldr: TRACE employs a Hierarchical Transformer that mirrors the step-by-step flow of computation, providing a faithful architectural backbone that replaces the flawed permutation-invariant aggregation and a novel objective that decouples the learning problem.

2509.22219.tldr: A modular, data-driven framework for jointly learning unknown functional mappings and discovering the underlying one-parameter symmetry subgroup governing the data, which yields models whose invariance or equivariance is guaranteed by construction and admits formal proofs.

2509.22246.tldr: ASSESS (A Semantic and Structural Evaluation Framework for Statement Similarity), which captures syntactic structure by transforming formal statements into operator trees and computes a real-valued similarity score using the authors' novel TransTED (Transformation Tree Edit Distance) Similarity metric by incorporating semantic transformations.

2509.23248.tldr: A joint optimization framework for efficient LLM reasoning deployment in MEGI and a distributed framework that synergizes reasoning enhancement via adaptive CoT prompting with scalable deployment through a distributed MoE architecture is presented.

2509.24385.tldr: Vid-LLM is proposed, a video-based 3D-MLLM that directly processes video inputs without requiring external 3D data, making it practical for real-world deployment and demonstrating the superior multi-task capabilities.

2510.01220.tldr: This paper proposes a framework grounded in joint human-machine uncertainty, combining epistemic uncertainty from the model with hesitation cues and confidence signals from human speakers to guide interaction, query selection, and memory retention.

2510.04787.tldr: This paper presents TiMi (Trade in Minutes), a rationality-driven multi-agent system that architecturally decouples strategy development from minute-level deployment and proposes a two-tier analytical paradigm from macro patterns to micro customization, layered programming design for trading bot implementation, and closed-loop optimization driven by mathematical reflection.

2510.07760.tldr: This paper proposes Validation-Aligned Optimization (VAO), a principled data-sharing method that adaptively reweights cross-task data contributions based on validation performance feedback and introduces a unified generative autobidding framework that generalizes across multiple tasks using a single model and all available task data.

2510.08529.tldr: This work introduces Co-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems (CoMAS), a novel framework that enables agents to improve autonomously by learning from inter-agent interactions without external supervision, thereby enabling decentralized and scalable co-evolution in LLM-based agents.

2510.09885.tldr: Masked fine-tuning for arLLMs substantially improves the efficacy of knowledge injection and improves the gap between arLLMs and dLLMs, and it is demonstrated that the same demasking objective improves supervised fine-tuning on math tasks over standard SFT, suggesting broader applicability of the demasking objective.

2510.10238.tldr: This paper proposes a Perturbation-based Causal Identification of Critical Neurons method to systematically locate such critical neurons in LLMs, revealing three key insights: LLMs contain ultra-sparse critical neuron sets, which can offer guidance for developing more robust model architectures and improving deployment security in safety-critical applications.

2510.13077.tldr: An unsupervised deep learning framework for real-time scalable and generalizable downlink beamforming in multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) systems and surpasses the WMMSE benchmark in underloaded systems and even in overloaded systems when the overloading factor is below certain threshold.

2510.13201.tldr: Paper Copilot is presented, a system that creates durable digital archives of peer reviews across a wide range of computer-science venues, an open dataset that enables researchers to study peer review at scale, and a large-scale empirical analysis of ICLR reviews spanning multiple years.

2510.16070.tldr: Compared with free-text reporting, SR enhanced efficiency by directing visual attention to the image, while AI-SR improved diagnostic accuracy.

2510.18184.tldr: ActivationReasoning is introduced, a framework that embeds explicit logical reasoning into the latent space of LLMs and enables structured reasoning, reliable control, and alignment with desired behaviors, providing a path toward more reliable and auditable AI.

2510.21280.tldr: The boundary proposal network (BPN) is inspired by work in image object detection and aims to reduce the number of false positive detections by using intermediate latent representations computed within the backbone classification model to gate the final output.

2510.25404.tldr: GPTOpt is introduced, an optimization method that equips LLMs with continuous black-box optimization capabilities by fine-tuning Llama 3.1 8B on structured Bayesian optimization (BO) data, including surrogate model information, which shows favorable performance compared to traditional optimizers and transformer-based alternatives.

2510.26098.tldr: This work provides a structured framework for assessing GUI knowledge and supports the selection of VLMs with greater potential prior to downstream training and provides insights for building more capable GUI agents.

2511.05165.tldr: This work proposes an automated generation of SADs from source code by combining reverse engineering (RE) techniques with Large Language Model (LLM), suggesting a viable path toward reducing manual effort while enhancing system understanding and long-term maintainability.

2511.05921.tldr: IDALC (Intent Detection and Active Learning based Correction), a semi-supervised framework designed to detect user intents and rectify system-rejected utterances while minimizing the need for human annotation, is introduced.

2511.06625.tldr: An Explainable Cross-Disease Reasoning Framework is proposed that enables interpretable cardiopulmonary risk assessment from a single LDCT scan, bridging the gap between image-based prediction and mechanism-based medical interpretation.

2511.08579.tldr: It is suggested not only that LMs can learn to reliably explain their internal computations, but that such explanations offer a scalable complement to existing interpretability methods.

2511.10339.tldr: This work applies their solver, enhanced with Grundy numbers for reducing game trees of impartial games, to the Sprouts game, a case study motivated by the long-standing Sprouts Conjecture and presents the first massively parallel version of Proof-Number Search that scales efficiently even on a large number of CPUs.

2511.12844.tldr: The results demonstrate that mapping implicit fNIRS signals to agent performance is feasible and can be improved, laying the foundation for future Reinforcement Learning from Neural Feedback (RLNF) systems.

2511.14220.tldr: Across discrete and continuous environments TSMCTS outperforms the SMC baseline as well as a popular modern version of MCTS as a policy improvement operator, scales favorably with sequential compute, reduces estimator variance and mitigates the effects of path degeneracy while retaining the properties that make SMC natural to parallelize.

2511.20694.tldr: Reasoning With a Star, a newly contributed heliophysics dataset applicable to reasoning, is presented and it is found that decomposing workflows through systems engineering principles outperforms direct prompting on problems requiring deductive reasoning rather than pure inductive recall.

2511.21438.tldr: ChatDRex democratizes access to bioinformatics as an important resource for drug repurposing and enables clinical experts to generate hypotheses and explore drug repurposing opportunities, ultimately accelerating the discovery of novel therapies and advancing personalized medicine and translational research.

2512.00008.tldr: This study presents an efficient solution on how to build very efficient motion-based models only using triaxial accelerometer sensors and finds that the neural network provided the best balance between accuracy, latency, and memory use.

2512.01152.tldr: This paper develops CoLOR, a method that is guaranteed to solve open-set recognition even in the challenging case where the background distribution shifts, and proves that the method works under benign assumptions that the novel class is separable from the non-novel classes, and provides theoretical guarantees that it outperforms a representative baseline in a simplified overparameterized setting.

2512.05377.tldr: This work focuses on statistical downscaling, which establishes statistical relationships between low-resolution and high-resolution historical data using statistical models, and relies on a diffusion-based downscaling framework named CorrDiff, which can generate fine-scale details that lead to more realistic predictions compared to the corresponding deterministic regression models.

2512.06914.tldr: It is demonstrated that diverse threats, from prompt injection to tool poisoning, share a common root cause: the desynchronization between dynamic trust states and static authorization boundaries.

2512.12932.tldr: This work investigates the feasibility of data pruning for BioFM pretraining and proposes a post-hoc influence-guided data pruning framework tailored to biological domains, which consistently outperforms random selection baselines under an extreme pruning rate of over 99 percent.

2512.13478.tldr: This work proposes Non-Resolution Reasoning (NRR), a framework treating ambiguity retention as a valid reasoning mode and challenges the assumption that meaning must collapse to be useful.

2512.15769.tldr: This work investigates backdoor propagation in such emerging generative data supply chain, namely, Data-Chain Backdoor (DCB), and finds that open-source diffusion models can become hidden carriers of backdoors.

2512.20761.tldr: First empirical results derived from operating TS-Arena over one year of energy time series demonstrate that established TSFMs accumulate robust longitudinal scores over time, while the continuous nature of the benchmark simultaneously allows newcomers to demonstrate immediate competitiveness.

2512.22522.tldr: The Adaptive Sharpness Surrogate Gradient (ASSG) is introduced, which adaptively evolves the shape of the surrogate function according to the input distribution during attack iterations, thereby enhancing gradient accuracy while mitigating gradient vanishing.

2512.23075.tldr: Trust Region Masking (TRM) is proposed, which masks entire sequences violating the trust region, enabling the first non-vacuous monotonic improvement guarantees for long-horizon LLM-RL.

2512.23126.tldr: This work proposes Intrinsic Self-reflective Preference Optimization (InSPO), deriving a globally optimal policy conditioning on both context and alternative responses, and proves this formulation superior to DPO/RLHF while guaranteeing invariance to scalarization and reference choices.

2601.00181.tldr: Sad utterances show reduced left-periphery marker usage relative to other emotions, aligning with accounts linking left-periphery markers to active discourse management, and suggesting sadness relies more on discourse history than overt pragmatic signaling.

2601.04510.tldr: A fully convolutional, conditionally parameterized U-Net surrogate designed to extrapolate far beyond its training data in both space and time, and is a first stepping stone towards high-fidelity extrapolation in both space and time of phase-field simulation for LMD.

2601.05106.tldr: FusionRoute is proposed, a robust and effective token-level multi-LLM collaboration framework in which a lightweight router simultaneously selects the most suitable expert at each decoding step and contributes a complementary logit that refines or corrects the selected expert's next-token distribution via logit addition.

2601.06133.tldr: A novel taxonomy is proposed that categorizes existing approaches into four distinct families--Action-Gradient, Q-Weighting, Proximity-Based, and Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT) methods--based on their policy improvement mechanisms and provides concrete guidelines for algorithm selection tailored to specific operational constraints.

2601.08257.tldr: Experiments on 21 multi-label datasets using several representative methods demonstrate that performance rankings differ markedly from those reported under single-label settings, suggesting the possibility of multi-label evaluation settings for fair and reliable comparison of unsupervised feature selection methods.

2601.19171.tldr: This work conducted a thematic analysis of UI prompting guidelines, identifying key design semantics and discovering that they are hierarchical and interdependent, and developed a system that enables users to specify semantics, visualize relationships, and extract how semantics are reflected in generated UIs.

2601.19261.tldr: This paper develops a beyond-backpropagation training method for split learning, in which the client and server train their model partitions semi-independently, using local loss signals instead of propagated gradients.

2601.20800.tldr: Experiments show that naive adaptations of existing HPI estimators yield misleading or uninterpretable importances in conditional settings, whereas condPED-ANOVA consistently provides meaningful importances that reflect the underlying conditional structure.

2601.22896.tldr: Algorithm Space Response Oracles (ASRO), a game-theoretic framework that reframes heuristic discovery as a program level co-evolution between solver and instance generator, achieving substantially improved generalization and robustness on diverse and out-of-distribution instances.

2602.00056.tldr: This work examines the environmental, social, and economic costs of large-scale data in AI through a sustainability lens, and proposes Data PROOFS recommendations spanning provenance, resource awareness, ownership, openness, frugality, and standards to mitigate these costs.

2602.01011.tldr: This work finds that -- unlike human teams -- LLM teams consistently fail to match their expert agent's performance, even when explicitly told who the expert is, incurring performance losses of up to 37.6%.

2602.01105.tldr: This work introduces \nameA{} (\fullname{}), which combines spectral control from orthogonalized update directions with $\ell_\infty$-style coordinate control from sign updates, and proves convergence under a mild, empirically verified diagonal-isotropy assumption.

2602.01227.tldr: This position paper advocates Token Priority as the essential bridge, formalizing Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) not as simple optimization but as a precise distribution reshaping process that aligns raw data with the ideal alignment manifold.

2602.01401.tldr: A taxonomy for the symbiotic evolution of agentic HLS is proposed, clarifying how responsibility shifts from human designers to AI agents as systems advance from copilots to autonomous design partners.

2602.01655.tldr: ProjDevBench, an end-to-end benchmark that provides project requirements to coding agents and evaluates the resulting repositories, is introduced, combining Online Judge (OJ) testing with LLM-assisted code review to evaluate agents on system architecture design, functional correctness, and iterative solution refinement.

2602.02139.tldr: The approach EvoMU automatically finds task-specific losses that match or outperform existing losses from the literature, without the need for a human-in-the-loop, and surpasses previous loss-based unlearning formulations on TOFU-5%, TOFU-10%, MUSE and WMDP by synthesizing novel unlearning losses.

2602.02296.tldr: This paper identifies that the model's generalization and privacy risks exist in different regions in deep neural network architectures and proposes Privacy-Preserving Training Principle (PPTP) to protect model components from privacy risks while minimizing the loss in generalizability.

2602.02841.tldr: GeLDA is proposed, a semantics-aware generative latent data augmentation framework that leverages conditional diffusion models to synthesize samples in an FM-induced latent space that enables efficient, high-quality data generation.

2602.03219.tldr: TDScaling is proposed, a Trajectory Diversity Scaling-based data synthesis framework for code agents that scales performance through diversity rather than raw volume, improving both tool-use generalization and inherent coding proficiency.

2602.03969.tldr: An unprecedented surge in publication output following the introduction of ChatGPT is revealed, with academic institutions continuing to provide the largest volume of research, but it is observed that academic--industry collaboration is still suppressed, as measured by a Normalized Collaboration Index (NCI) that remains significantly below the random-mixing baseline across all major subfields.

2602.04162.tldr: The origin of stochasticity in diffusion sampling is revisited and Inter-Slice Consistent Stochasticity (ISCS) is introduced, a simple yet effective strategy that encourages interslice consistency during diffusion sampling that can effectively improve the performance of medical 3D imaging problems based on 2D diffusion models.

2602.04915.tldr: The spherical Yat-kernel is expressed as a nonnegative mixture of polynomial-exponential product kernels and derive a strictly positive random-feature approximation enabling linear-time O(L) attention, which represents the closest linear-time approximation to softmax attention reported to date.

2602.05636.tldr: Any domain with expert vocabulary, validity constraints, and accumulated exemplars is a candidate for Generative Ontology, a framework synthesizing complementary strengths: ontology provides the grammar; the LLM provides the creativity.

2602.05787.tldr: Bagging-based rObust mOdel Merging (BOOM) is proposed, which trains multiple embedding models on sampled subsets and merges them into a single model, improving robustness while retaining single-model inference efficiency.

2602.06214.tldr: This work proposes a novel, differentiable vehicle-model framework that rolls out predicted action sequences to their corresponding ego-frame waypoint trajectories while supervising in waypoint space, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on NAVSIM.

2602.06638.tldr: The Temperature Scaling Attack (TSA) is presented, a training-time attack that degrades calibration while preserving accuracy, and establishes calibration integrity as a critical attack surface in federated learning.

2602.06841.tldr: This work empirically compares attribution-based explanations used in static classification tasks with trace-based diagnostics used in agentic benchmarks (TAU-bench Airline and AssistantBench), showing that while attribution methods achieve stable feature rankings in static settings, they cannot be applied reliably to diagnose execution-level failures in agentic trajectories.

2602.06859.tldr: GAD-MoRE is proposed, a novel framework for zero-shot Generalizable Graph Anomaly Detection with a Mixture of Riemannian Experts architecture that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art generalist GAD baselines, and even surpasses strong competitors that are few-shot fine-tuned with labeled data from the target domain.

2602.06960.tldr: InftyThink+ is proposed, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the entire iterative reasoning trajectory, building on model-controlled iteration boundaries and explicit summarization, and significantly reduces inference latency and accelerates reinforcement learning training, demonstrating improved reasoning efficiency alongside stronger performance.

2602.08019.tldr: This survey examines the foundational principles of MoE, with an in-depth exploration of its core components—the routing network and expert network and extends beyond the centralized paradigm to the decentralized paradigm, which unlocks the immense untapped potential of decentralized infrastructure, enables democratization of MoE development for broader communities, and delivers greater scalability and cost-efficiency.

2602.08092.tldr: This paper proposes Epistemic Source Alignment (ESA), a robust method that utilizes sparse safety axioms to judge the source of the feedback rather than the signal itself, and proves that this"judging the judges"mechanism guarantees convergence to the true objective, even when a majority of evaluators are biased.

2602.08099.tldr: A lightweight text-based alignment strategy is introduced which maps dense video captions to short summaries and enables task-related video-text embedding learning without visual supervision and outperforms current methods across common video retrieval benchmarks.

2602.08100.tldr: It is found that the model spontaneously learns a structured search process in latent space, which achieves in activation space what chain-of-thought achieves through words: the ability to be wrong, notice, and recover.

2602.08121.tldr: This study provides the first systematic safety evaluation of GenAI-delivered DBT coaching for HIV and substance use risk reduction, and reveals vulnerabilities requiring mitigation before clinical trials.

2602.08124.tldr: This paper uses prompt engineering to elicit product suggestions from LLMs for various race and gender groups and employs three analytical methods-Marked Words, Support Vector Machines, and Jensen-Shannon Divergence-to identify and quantify biases.

2602.08136.tldr: Novel split-image visual jailbreak attacks (SIVA) are introduced that exploit a new vulnerability in the current VLM safety alignment and leverages a novel adversarial knowledge distillation algorithm to substantially improve cross-model transferability.

2602.08145.tldr: Critical issues, including bias and fairness, security and privacy, uncertainty, explainability, and distribution shift are explored, as well as methods like alignment and Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC) detection.

2602.08149.tldr: This work proposes DIAL-SUMMER's taxonomy of errors to comprehensively evaluate dialogue summaries at two hierarchical levels: DIALOGUE-LEVEL that focuses on the broader speakers/turns, and WITHIN-TURN-LEVEL that focuses on the information talked about inside a turn.

2602.08159.tldr: That centroid distance in the low-dimensional subspace matches probe performance indicates class separation is a mean shift, making detection geometric rather than learned, making detection geometric rather than learned.

2602.08167.tldr: R&B-EnCoRe enables models to distill reasoning that is predictive of successful control, bypassing manual annotation engineering while grounding internet-scale knowledge in physical execution.

2602.08186.tldr: This paper conducts an empirical study on a large number of real-world schemas and observes that join graphs when represented as adjacency matrices exhibit two key properties: high sparsity and low-rank structure, and proposes Nexus, an end-to-end solution using only metadata.

2602.08194.tldr: This work proposes Dreaming in Code (DiCode), a framework in which foundation models synthesize executable environment code to scaffold learning toward increasing competence, and suggests that code-level environment design provides a practical mechanism for curriculum control, enabling the construction of intermediate environments that bridge competence gaps in open-ended worlds.

2602.08213.tldr: This work proposes DrugR, an LLM-based method that introduces explicit, step-by-step pharmacological reasoning into the optimization process, and achieves comprehensive enhancement across multiple properties without compromising structural similarity or target binding affinity.

2602.08214.tldr: Based on Recursive Entropy, a resource exhaustion attack via Recursive Entropy guided Counterfactual Utilization and Reflection is introduced, which constructs counterfactual questions to verify the inherent flaws and risks of LRMs.

2602.08218.tldr: A sparsity-aware evolutionary (SAE) framework for model merging that involves iterative pruning-merging cycles to act as a novel mutation operator is proposed, which incorporates the sparsity constraints into the score function, which steers the evolutionary process to favor more sparse models, in addition to other conventional performance scores.

2602.08221.tldr: This work proposes CoRect (Context-Aware Logit Contrast for Hidden State Rectification), which identifies layers that exhibit high parametric bias without requiring ground-truth labels and rectifies the hidden states to preserve evidence-grounded information.

2602.08222.tldr: By identifying recoverable learning gaps via entropy dynamics and reinforcing them through compensatory learning, WMSS enables strong agents to improve beyond conventional post-training saturation, and achieves effective performance improvements, while incurring zero additional inference cost.

2602.08229.tldr: A decentralized evaluation framework that enables hardware and parameter diversity through large-scale benchmarking across heterogeneous compute nodes and incentivizes global contributors to act as independent validators, using a robust reward system to ensure evaluation integrity and discourage dishonest participation is proposed.

2602.08230.tldr: MA-ADV is proposed, a novel adversarial framework that ensures a 100\% attack success rate with minimal perturbation cost, and also demonstrates enhanced robustness against defenses, underscoring the critical security challenges facing future event-based perception systems.

2602.08233.tldr: Tutti, a unified framework designed for structured multi-singer generation, is proposed, introducing a Structure-Aware Singer Prompt to enable flexible singer scheduling evolving with musical structure, and proposing Complementary Texture Learning via Condition-Guided VAE to capture implicit acoustic textures that are complementary to explicit controls.

2602.08235.tldr: This work introduces the first conceptual and methodological framework for unintended CUA behaviors, by defining their key characteristics, automatically eliciting them, and analyzing how they arise from benign inputs, and establishes a foundation for systematically analyzing unintended behaviors in realistic computer-use settings.

2602.08236.tldr: This work presents an in-depth analysis of test-time visual imagination as a controllable resource for spatial reasoning, and introduces AVIC, an adaptive test-time framework with world models that explicitly reasons about the sufficiency of current visual evidence before selectively invoking and scaling visual imagination.

2602.08239.tldr: Insight into fine-tuning through the lens of linearization shows that fine-tuning dynamics become equivalent to learning with the positive-definite neural tangent kernel (NTK), and gives spectral perturbation bounds on the NTK induced by the choice of layers selected for fine-tuning.

2602.08240.tldr: This work proposes Prompt-Tuned Spiking Neural Networks (PTS-SNN), a parameter-efficient neuromorphic adaptation framework that aligns frozen SSL backbones with spiking dynamics, and introduces a Temporal Shift Spiking Encoder to capture local temporal dependencies via parameter-free channel shifts, establishing a stable feature basis.

2602.08241.tldr: SAYO is proposed, a visual reasoning model trained with a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that introduces a region-level visual attention-based reward that explicitly aligns optimization signals with visually grounded reasoning steps, enabling the model to learn more reliable attention behaviors.

2602.08244.tldr: It is demonstrated that ICPRL enables strong in-context generalization to unseen tasks, achieving performance comparable to ICRL methods trained with full reward supervision, and alternative preference-native frameworks for I-PRL and T-PRL that directly optimize TM policies from preference data without requiring reward signals nor optimal action labels.

2602.08245.tldr: STEP, a lightweight spatiotemporal consistency prediction mechanism to construct high-quality warm-start actions that are both distributionally close to the target action and temporally consistent, without compromising the generative capability of the original diffusion policy is proposed.

2602.08253.tldr: G-LNS is proposed, a generative evolutionary framework that extends LLM-based AHD to the automated design of Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) operators and discovers heuristics that achieve near-optimal solutions with reduced computational budgets but also exhibit robust generalization across diverse and unseen instance distributions.

2602.08254.tldr: Evaluation of more than 100 generated patients demonstrated that GPT-5 and Claude 4.5 Sonnet achieved the highest fidelity as the core engine in the proposed MAS framework, outperforming Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-R1.

2602.08267.tldr: The method, Transformation-Inverting Energy Diffusion (TIED), relies on a new trivialized target-score identity that enables efficient score-based sampling of the transformation posterior and focuses on test-time equivariance, where the objective is to improve the robustness of pretrained neural networks to input transformations.

2602.08272.tldr: This paper rigorously analyzes the comparative sample efficiency of MARL and SARL within the context of LLM, and formally defines SARL and MARL setups for LLMs, derive explicit sample complexity bounds, and systematically characterize how task decomposition and alignment influence learning efficiency.

2602.08276.tldr: The Structural Context Model is proposed, a formal model for analyzing and comparing LLM agents from the perspective of context structure and a sustainable agent engineering workflow, which provides principled insights into agent mechanisms and supports rapid, systematic design iteration.

2602.08277.tldr: PISCO, a video diffusion model for precise video instance insertion with arbitrary sparse keyframe control, and Variable-Information Guidance for robust conditioning and Distribution-Preserving Temporal Masking to stabilize temporal generation, together with geometry-aware conditioning for realistic scene adaptation are introduced.

2602.08282.tldr: This paper introduces an innovative pseudo-label aggregation strategy for PO data based on the geographic coverage of satellite imagery, enabling geographic alignment between the label space and remote sensing feature space and achieves superior predictive performance in scenarios with limited PA coverage and pronounced distribution shifts.

2602.08287.tldr: The results sculpt a new connection between signal propagation in neural networks and interpretability, with noise stability emerging as a powerful tool for understanding and improving modern Transformers.

2602.08290.tldr: This paper proposes a novel trust-based incentive mechanism designed to evaluate and reward the quality of contributions in FL systems, and explores the integration of blockchain technology and smart contracts to automate the trust evaluation and incentive distribution processes, ensuring transparency and decentralization.

2602.08295.tldr: The central claim is that the significance of GenAI lies in its functional access to operationalized tacit regularities: context-sensitive patterns embedded in practice that cannot be fully specified through explicit algorithmic rules.

2602.08297.tldr: It turns out that simple symmetry breakers, especially combining few variables and permutations, most consistently reduce work time.

2602.08302.tldr: The results demonstrate that grokking does not require depth or representation learning, and can emerge even in linear models through the dynamics of the bias term, and can emerge even in linear models through the dynamics of the bias term.

2602.08311.tldr: This first systematic study of moral sycophancy in VLMs is presented, analyzing ten widely-used models on the Moralise and M^3oralBench datasets under explicit user disagreement and revealing that VLMs frequently produce morally incorrect follow-up responses even when their initial judgments are correct.

2602.08316.tldr: SWE-ContextBench is introduced, a benchmark designed to explicitly evaluate context reuse in programming agents and shows that correctly selected summarized context improves resolution accuracy and substantially reduces runtime and token cost, particularly on harder tasks.

2602.08329.tldr: Pre-hoc Sparsity (PrHS) is proposed, which selects KV entries before attention scoring and provides explicit accuracy control and derives an upper bound on the mutual-information loss that depends only on the dropped mass.

2602.08332.tldr: Thinking States is proposed, a method that performs reasoning while the input is processing, which captures the recurrent nature of CoT, but where the thought tokens are generated as input is processing.

2602.08333.tldr: This work proves a local stability property: outside measure-zero sets of parameters and inputs, sufficiently small parameter perturbations preserve the activation pattern of a fixed input, implying locally affine behavior within activation regions within ReLU-based models.

2602.08335.tldr: The Shapley-based Hierarchical Attribution for Reinforcement Policy (SHARP) is introduced, a novel framework for optimizing multi-agent reinforcement learning via precise credit attribution and effectively stabilizes training by normalizing agent-specific advantages across trajectory groups.

2602.08339.tldr: This work proposes CoTZero, an annotation-free paradigm with two components: a dual-stage data synthesis approach and a cognition-aligned training method, which introduces Cognitively Coherent Verifiable Rewards in Reinforcement Fine-Tuning to further strengthen VLMs'hierarchical reasoning and generalization.

2602.08340.tldr: An effect-centric, admissibility-first framework is proposed that treats discovered graphs as structural hypotheses and evaluates them by identifiability, stability, and falsification rather than by graph recovery accuracy alone, suggesting that graph-level metrics alone are inadequate proxies for causal reliability for a given target query.

2602.08342.tldr: This work proposes UGE, a two-stage training strategy that progressively and stably aligns images, text, and spatial structures by combining instruction-guided contrastive learning with graph-based spatial encoding, and introduces UGBench, a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate how spatially grounded embeddings support diverse urban understanding tasks.

2602.08343.tldr: ManifoldKV is proposed, a training-free scorer that ranks tokens by Euclidean distance to the key centroid, capturing both angular and radial deviations, and WindowedManifoldKV, which restores accuracy to 84.3% at 25% compression, a 49-point recovery over global L2 and +3.2 points over KeyDiff.

2602.08344.tldr: Outline-Guided Path Exploration (OPE), which explicitly partitions the solution space by generating diverse reasoning outlines prior to parallel path reasoning, thereby reducing information redundancy and improving the diversity of information captured across exploration paths.

2602.08353.tldr: The TKG evolution benchmark is introduced, which includes four bias-corrected datasets and two novel tasks closely aligned with the evolution process, promoting a more accurate understanding of the challenges in TKG evolution modeling.

2602.08362.tldr: The utility of the contributions is illustrated by using them to enumerate all sufficient reasons, necessary reasons and contrastive explanations of decisions; to compute the robustness of decisions; and to identify all shortest ways to flip the decisions made by random forest classifiers learned from a wide range of datasets.

2602.08363.tldr: A roadmap to quantum aesthetics is proposed that examines how quantum concepts become aesthetic phenomena through artistic mediation rather than direct representation, opening new directions for artistic practice and pedagogy at the intersection of art, data, artificial intelligence and quantum science.

2602.08369.tldr: MemAdapter, a memory retrieval framework that enables fast alignment across agent memory paradigms, and enables effective zero-shot fusion across memory paradigms, highlighting its potential as a plug-and-play solution for agent memory systems.

2602.08370.tldr: The first zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of anthropomorphic badminton skills to a humanoid robot is demonstrated, successfully replicating the kinetic elegance and functional precision of human athletes in the physical world.

2602.08373.tldr: The Verifiable Iterative Refinement Framework (VIRF) is introduced, a neuro-symbolic architecture that shifts the paradigm from passive safety gatekeeping to active collaboration and demonstrates a principled pathway toward building fundamentally trustworthy and verifiably safe embodied agents.

2602.08377.tldr: Comprehensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that RLBF significantly reduces attack success rates across diverse benchmarks and model scales, achieving superior safety outcomes while critically preserving foundational model utility.

2602.08382.tldr: A cognitively inspired framework for efficient long-context inference based on chunk-wise compression and selective memory recall, rather than processing all raw tokens, which achieves up to a 2 times reduction in peak GPU memory usage and a 6 times inference speedup over MemAgent.

2602.08392.tldr: BiManiBench is introduced, a hierarchical benchmark evaluating MLLMs across three tiers: fundamental spatial reasoning, high-level action planning, and low-level end-effector control, which isolates unique bimanual challenges, such as arm reachability and kinematic constraints, thereby distinguishing perceptual hallucinations from planning failures.

2602.08400.tldr: Across multi-domain knowledge settings, SCOUT-RAG achieves performance comparable to centralized baselines, including DRIFT and exhaustive domain traversal, while substantially reducing cross-domain calls, total tokens processed, and latency.

2602.08401.tldr: This paper presents AGENTWM, the first watermarking framework designed specifically for agentic models, which exploits the semantic equivalence of action sequences, injecting watermarks by subtly biasing the distribution of functionally identical tool execution paths.

2602.08403.tldr: This work explores reinforcement learning (RL)-based UI adaptation to personalize alerting strategies that balance the benefits of highlighting critical events against the cognitive costs of interruptions and integrates models of users'gaze behavior to simulate attentional dynamics during monitoring.

2602.08422.tldr: It is argued that stronger security guarantees can be obtained by enforcing security constraints during code generation (e.g., via constrained decoding), rather than relying solely on post-hoc detection and repair.

2602.08426.tldr: Prism is introduced, a training-free spectral-aware approach that decomposes block selection into high-frequency and low-frequency branches that restores the attenuated positional signals directly from pooled representations, enabling block importance estimation using purely block-level operations, thereby improving efficiency.

2602.08448.tldr: Vista is model-agnostic and integrates seamlessly with a variety of vision-language backbones, enabling long-context reasoning without compromising latency or memory efficiency, and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2602.08456.tldr: This paper introduces a decentralized learning algorithm based on regret-matching, grounded in internal regret minimization, that confirms the not-yet-unleashed potential of scalable decentralized solutions and questions the need for the heavy signaling overheads and architectural complexity associated with emerging centralized solutions like Multi-Access Point Coordination.

2602.08479.tldr: This study presents a gesture classification framework using 2D pose estimation applied to real-world video sequences from the WIVW dataset and demonstrates that hand position and movement velocity are especially discriminative in distinguishing between gesture classes.

2602.08482.tldr: CLEAR transforms raw AIS data into complete, interpretable, and easily explorable vessel trajectories through a Structured Data-derived Knowledge Graph (SD-KG) by leveraging the reasoning and generative capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs).

2602.08499.tldr: This work formulates rollout scheduling in RLVR as a contextual bandit problem and proposes a unified neural scheduling framework that adaptively selects high-value rollouts throughout training that supports both noise-aware intra-group selection and adaptive global reuse of historical rollouts within a single principled framework.

2602.08563.tldr: The ability of a model to carry state across otherwise independent interactions by encoding information in its own outputs and later recovering it when those outputs are reintroduced as input is introduced, which does not require any explicit memory module.

2602.08565.tldr: This work introduces a hybrid foresight workflow, wherein agents broaden systemic coverage, and humans provide contextual grounding, and proposes a hybrid foresight workflow, wherein agents broaden systemic coverage, and humans provide contextual grounding.

2602.08585.tldr: LU-KV is proposed, a novel framework that optimizes head-level budget allocation through a convex-hull relaxation and a marginal-utility-based greedy solver to achieve near-optimal precision and is implemented with a data-driven offline profiling protocol.

2602.08593.tldr: Results show that careful last-mile integration, not novel circuitry, unlocks the latent value of existing Agri-IoT for smallholders.

2602.08597.tldr: A lightweight top-down modality selector operating on top of a frozen multimodal global workspace improves robustness while using far fewer trainable parameters than end-to-end attention baselines, and the learned selection strategy transfers better across downstream tasks, corruption regimes, and even to a previously unseen modality.

2602.08603.tldr: This work is the first to reformulate agentic CIR from a heuristic search process into a principled trajectory optimization problem, and achieves superior performance using only 10% of training data, demonstrating strong generalization of planning logic rather than dataset-specific memorization.

2602.08616.tldr: DGRL is proposed, combining Sampled Dynamic Neighborhoods (SDN) and Distance-Based Updates (DBU) to enable efficient RL in spaces with up to 10 actions, and demonstrates performance improvements of up to 66% against state-of-the-art benchmarks across regularly and irregularly structured environments, while simultaneously improving convergence speed and computational complexity.

2602.08619.tldr: This work proposes the first hybridization of a Genetic Algorithm with a Graph Neural Network for solving timetabling problems, and demonstrates that the proposed hybridization brings statistically significant improvements in both the time efficiency and solution quality metrics, compared to the standalone methods.

2602.08621.tldr: This work introduces the Router Safety importance score (RoSais) to quantify the safety criticality of each layer's router, and proposes a Fine-grained token-layer-wise Stochastic Optimization framework to discover more concrete Unsafe Routes (F-SOUR), which explicitly considers the sequentiality and dynamics of input tokens.

2602.08629.tldr: CauScale is presented, a neural architecture designed for efficient causal discovery that scales inference to graphs with up to 1000 nodes that achieves 99.6% mAP on in-distribution data and 84.4% on out-of-distribution data, while delivering 4-13,000 times inference speedups over prior methods.

2602.08630.tldr: Surprisingly, it is found that PSPACE/poly (the class of problems which debate can efficiently decide) is precisely the class of functions decidable with O(log n) queries, which shows that debate is remarkably query-efficient: even for highly complex problems, logarithmic oversight suffices.

2602.08632.tldr: It is argued that memorization, as commonly studied in data science, should not be equated with copying and should not be used as a proxy for copyright infringement, and advocate for an output-level, risk-based evaluation process that aligns technical assessments with established copyright standards and provides a more principled foundation for research, auditing, and policy.

2602.08638.tldr: This paper presents Learnable Fusion of Tri-view Tokens (LEFT), a unified unsupervised TSAD framework that models anomalies as inconsistencies across complementary representations and introduces a novel objective that reconstructs fine-grained targets from coarser multi-scale structure.

2602.08660.tldr: A new fairness definition for generative models is introduced, termed as equalized generative treatment (EGT), which requires comparable generation quality across all sensitive groups, with quality measured via a reference f-divergence, and demonstrates that min-max methods consistently achieve fairer outcomes compared to other approaches from the literature, while maintaining competitive overall performance for both tasks.

2602.08675.tldr: 6G-Bench defines a taxonomy of 30 decision-making tasks extracted from ongoing 6G and AI-agent standardization activities in 3GPP, IETF, ETSI, ITU-T, and the O-RAN Alliance, and organizes them into five standardization-aligned capability categories.

2602.08686.tldr: CompilerKV is proposed, a risk-adaptive and head-aware compression framework that compiles offline experience into reusable decision tables for prefill-only deployment that dominates SOTA methods under a 512-token budget.

2602.08706.tldr: It is argued that, although it is intuitive to think that increasing accuracy would legitimise ideal ERTs, in the case of ERTs accuracy does not straightforwardly justify their deployment, and may, in some contexts, provide a reason for regulatory restraint.

2602.08708.tldr: Light is shed on the question whether this small solution hypothesis for STRIPS$^1_1$ is true, calling a SAT solver for small instances, introducing the literal graph, and mapping it to Petri nets.

2602.08715.tldr: A novel taxonomy is introduced to classify these approaches, identifying seven key features that distinguish different SAIG methods, and reveals a concerning lack of consensus on the most effective XAI evaluation techniques.

2602.08717.tldr: Three training-free pipelines are proposed and systematically evaluated: a segmentation-driven rule-based system leveraging pre-trained multi-organ segmentation models, a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) guided by radiologist-defined rules, and a segmentation-aware MLLM that combines visual input with explicit anatomical evidence.

2602.08722.tldr: QUOKA: Query-oriented KV selection for efficient attention, a training-free and hardware agnostic sparse attention algorithm for accelerating transformer inference under chunked prefill, achieves near-baseline accuracy, utilizing 88% fewer key-value pairs per attention evaluation.

2602.08727.tldr: A computationally efficient hybrid deep-learning framework that combines the strengths of 2D and 3D models is proposed that presents a robust and efficient solution for high-quality 3D CT image post-processing.

2602.08745.tldr: It is proved that the full WL hierarchy cannot, in general, distinguish between satisfiable and unsatisfiable instances, and it is shown that indistinguishability under higher-order WL carries over to practical limitations for WL-bounded solvers that set variables sequentially.

2602.08754.tldr: This paper defines and investigates a particular kind of cognitive offloading in human-AI interaction, belief offloading, in which people's processes of forming and upholding beliefs are offloaded onto an AI system with downstream consequences on their behavior and the nature of their system of beliefs.

2602.08764.tldr: A novel approach to skull strip T1-weighted images in a robust and efficient manner, aiming to consistently segment the outer surface of the brain, including the sulcal cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), while excluding the full extent of the subarachnoid space and meninges.

2602.08765.tldr: Scylla is introduced, an evaluation framework for benchmarking agentic coding tools through structured ablation studies that uses seven testing tiers progressively adding complexity to isolate what directly influences results and how, suggesting that architectural complexity does not always improve quality.

2602.08768.tldr: Results demonstrate genuine frequency-level knowledge discovery with formal theoretical guarantees on attribution quality, and demonstrate genuine frequency-level knowledge discovery with formal theoretical guarantees on attribution quality.

2602.08774.tldr: The results provide no evidence that default hyperparameters encode useful directional information for optimization, and recommend that practitioners treat hyperparameter tuning as an integral part of model development and favor principled, data-driven search strategies over heuristic reliance on library defaults.

2602.08783.tldr: This paper views latent chain-of-thought as a manipulable causal process in representation space by modeling latent steps as variables in a structural causal model and analyzing their effects through step-wise $\mathrm{do}$-interventions.

2602.08792.tldr: This work proposes MultiDeepSAD, an extension of the DeepSAD algorithm for multiple modalities with a new loss formulation that significantly outperforms baseline approaches, exhibiting enhanced sensitivity to real arcing events even under domain shifts and limited availability of real arcing observations.

2602.08796.tldr: This study investigates whether AI tools can support Q-matrix development by comparing AI-generated Q-matrices with a validated Q-matrix from Li and Suen (2013) for a reading comprehension test, and shows substantial variation across AI models.

2602.08797.tldr: A semi-supervised teacher-student framework that combines an uncertainty-aware pseudo-labeling teacher with a progressive, confidence-based curriculum for the student is proposed, showing that confidence-driven curricula and selective unlearning provide robust segmentation under limited supervision and noisy pseudo-labels.

2602.08804.tldr: A residual-connection-based RCA method using large language model (LLM), named RC-LLM, is proposed, designed to integrate multi-source telemetry data and contextual reasoning capability of large language models is leveraged to model temporal and cross-microservice causal dependencies.

2602.08810.tldr: A unified software library that implements several modern LRNN architectures under a common interface, allowing users to work directly with core components or higher-level model abstractions to improve accessibility, reproducibility, and extensibility of LRNN research and applications.

2602.08815.tldr: Negative-Aware Diffusion model for TKG Extrapolation (NADEx) is introduced, which encodes subject-centric histories of entities, relations and temporal intervals into sequential embeddings and derives a cosine-alignment regularizer derived from batch-wise negative prototypes, which tightens the decision boundary against implausible candidates.

2602.08816.tldr: This work empirically audit 124,278 dataset $\rightarrow$ model $\rightarrow$ application supply chains, spanning 3,338 datasets, 6,664 models, and 28,516 applications across Hugging Face and GitHub, and finds that an astonishing 96.5% of datasets and 95.8% of models lack the required license text, and attribution rarely propagates downstream.

2602.08826.tldr: This paper proposes affective flow language model for emotional support conversation (AFlow), a framework that introduces fine-grained supervision on dialogue prefixes by modeling a continuous affective flow along multi-turn trajectories and can estimate intermediate utility over searched trajectories and learn preference-consistent strategy transitions.

2602.08829.tldr: This work adopts WildChat as an interaction source and proposes a pipeline to extract reliable human feedback, yielding 186k high-quality instances for training WildReward via ordinal regression directly on user feedback without preference pairs, and observes that WildReward benefits directly from user diversity, where more users yield stronger reward models.

2602.08847.tldr: It is shown that under GRPO-style optimization, a global normalization baseline may deviate from diverse agents'reward distributions, which ultimately leads to gradient-norm instability, which theoretically pinpoints a key reason for training instability when extending group-based RL to multi-agent LLM systems.

2602.08848.tldr: This paper proposes a formal framework unifying several forms of extensions and combinations of qualitative formalisms, including multi-scale reasoning, temporal sequences, and loose integrations, and generalizes the main definition of qualitative formalism to include qualitative formalisms excluded from the definitions of the literature.

2602.08857.tldr: The method is to faithfully re-parameterize a Transformer as a RASP program and then apply causal interventions to discover a small sufficient sub-program, which provides the most direct evidence so far that Transformers internally implement simple RASP programs.

2602.08858.tldr: FlattenGPT is proposed, a novel way to detect and reduce depth-wise redundancies in transformer blocks by flatting two adjacent blocks into one, which compresses the network depth and enables more effective parameter redundancy detection and removal.

2602.08864.tldr: This work proposes ANIRA, a unified recurrent Transformer framework that supports per-token variable-depth computation while isolating compute allocation decisions from other model factors, and uses this framework to conduct a systematic analysis of token-level adaptive computation across alignment with complexity, generalization, and decision timing.

2602.08868.tldr: This work presents AnomSeer, a novel time-series grounded policy optimization that incorporates two additional components beyond standard reinforcement learning: a time-series grounded advantage based on optimal transport and an orthogonal projection to ensure this auxiliary granular signal does not interfere with the primary detection objective.

2602.08873.tldr: LLMScholarBench is introduced, a benchmark for auditing LLM-based scholar recommendation that jointly evaluates model infrastructure and end-user interventions across multiple tasks and results show that end-user interventions do not yield uniform improvements but instead redistribute error across dimensions.

2602.08878.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework for non-myopic policy optimization in general online matching relying on potentials, a concept originally introduced for kidney exchange, and develops scalable and accurate ways of learning potentials that are higher-dimensional and more expressive than prior approaches.

2602.08887.tldr: This work proposes and evaluates the LLM-based (GPT-4o) approach "DeepQuali", for assessing and improving requirements quality in agile software development, and applies it to projects in two small companies, where it was compared with LLM-based quality assessments with expert judgments.

2602.08889.tldr: This paper demonstrates that LLM-based elicitation can extend structured expert judgment to settings where traditional methods are infeasible, reducing elicitation time from months to minutes.

2602.08896.tldr: This work presents OmniReview, a comprehensive dataset constructed by integrating multi-source academic platforms encompassing comprehensive scholarly profiles through the disambiguation pipeline, yielding 202, 756 verified review records, and proposes Profiling Scholars with Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (Pro-MMoE), a novel framework that synergizes Large Language Models with Multi-task Learning.

2602.08905.tldr: Spatio-Temporal Pruning (STP), a framework designed to simultaneously improve the efficiency and stability of RL for dLLMs, and strictly reduces the variance of the log-likelihood estimation, thereby ensuring more stable policy updates.

2602.08914.tldr: This work investigates how communication strategies evolve through repeated collaboration as people coordinate on shared procedural abstractions, and extends probabilistic models of convention formation to multimodal settings, capturing shifts in modality preferences.

2602.08917.tldr: An automated, domain-adaptive QE framework that builds in-domain exemplar pools by harvesting pseudo-relevant passages using a BM25-MonoT5 pipeline and a two-LLM ensemble in which two heterogeneous LLMs independently generate expansions and a refinement LLM consolidates them into one coherent expansion is presented.

2602.08934.tldr: The results expose significant robustness gaps in current AI-text detection and establish StealthRL as a principled adversarial evaluation protocol through LLM-based quality evaluation via Likert scoring.

2602.08939.tldr: Preliminary experiments reveal a Four-Quadrant Control Landscape where static audit policies universally fail, a finding that demonstrates CausalT5K's value for advancing trustworthy reasoning systems.

2602.08948.tldr: CoRefine is introduced, a confidence-guided self-refinement method that achieves competitive accuracy using a fraction of the tokens via a lightweight 211k-parameter Conv1D controller atop a frozen LLM, indicating that confidence dynamics reliably signal correctness without ground-truth verification.

2602.08949.tldr: By uniting real-time bidirectional DTs with agentic AI, IVSR offers a scalable, semi-automated decision-support paradigm for proactive, adaptive wildfire disaster management, indicating marked reductions in detection-to-intervention latency and more effective resource coordination versus traditional systems.

2602.08961.tldr: This work introduces MotionCrafter, a video diffusion-based framework that jointly reconstructs 4D geometry and estimates dense motion from a monocular video, and introduces a new data normalization and VAE training strategy that better transfers diffusion priors and greatly improves reconstruction quality.

2602.08964.tldr: A framework for evaluating goal-directedness that integrates behavioural evaluation with interpretability-based analyses of models'internal representations is proposed, finding that performance scales with task difficulty while remaining robust to difficulty-preserving transformations and complex goal structures.

2602.08983.tldr: This work formalizes this misalignment and proves that rotary position embedding (RoPE) is mathematically incapable of representing non-affine temporal warping, and proposes Symplectic Positional Embeddings (SyPE), a learnable encoding framework derived from Hamiltonian mechanics.

2602.08984.tldr: Next Concept Prediction, a generative pretraining paradigm built on top of Next Token Prediction, predicts discrete concepts that span multiple tokens, thereby forming a more challenging pretraining objective and leading to more powerful language models by introducing a harder pretraining task.

2602.08986.tldr: A weighted loss objective for neural networks is proposed that combines node-wise imbalance weighting with focal weighting components, the latter leveraging modern quantification of ensemble uncertainties, and aids convolutional networks on challenging tasks, as in situations with suboptimal encoders or limited data.

2602.08990.tldr: This work introduces InternAgent-1.5, a unified system designed for end-to-end scientific discovery across computational and empirical domains that achieves leading performance that demonstrates strong foundational capabilities.

2602.09000.tldr: Iterative Group Relative Policy Optimization (iGRPO), a two-stage extension of GRPO that adds dynamic self-conditioning through model-generated drafts, is introduced, demonstrating the potential of iterative, self-feedback-based RL for advancing verifiable mathematical reasoning.

2602.09002.tldr: This paper presents a social robot navigation framework that integrates geometric planning with contextual social reasoning, and distills social reasoning from large foundation models into a smaller and efficient model, allowing the framework to perform real-time adaptation in diverse human–robot interaction contexts.

2602.09003.tldr: This work argues that the development of AGI is entering a new phase of data-model co-evolution, in which models actively guide data management while high-quality data, in turn, amplifies model capabilities.

2602.09006.tldr: Adaptively Rotated Optimization is presented, a new matrix optimization framework that treats gradient rotation as a first class design principle that accelerates LLM training by performing normed steepest descent in a rotated coordinate system, where the rotation is determined by a novel norm-informed policy.

2602.09009.tldr: Adapt neural connection reassignment (ANCRe), a principled and lightweight framework that parameterizes and learns residual connectivities from the data, is introduced, a principled and lightweight framework that parameterizes and learns residual connectivities from the data.

2602.09012.tldr: This work introduces Next-Gen CAPTCHAs, a scalable defense framework designed to secure the next-generation web against the advanced agents, and exploits the persistent human-agent "Cognitive Gap" in interactive perception, memory, decision-making, and action.

2602.09014.tldr: This work proposes ArcFlow, a few-step distillation framework that explicitly employs non-linear flow trajectories to approximate pre-trained teacher trajectories and implements ArcFlow via trajectory distillation on pre-trained teacher models using lightweight adapters to ensure fast, stable convergence while preserving generative diversity and quality.

2602.09018.tldr: ViT policies are markedly more OOD-robust than comparably sized CNN/FC, and FM features yield state-of-the-art success at a latency cost, and actionable design rules for OOD-robust driving policies are yielded.

2204.05138.tldr: How this architecture can lead to iterative shift in the distribution of coactive representations, ultimately leading to mental continuity between processing states, and thus to human-like thought and cognition is explored.

2402.17888.tldr: This work proposes a novel theoretical framework grounded in Bregman divergence, which extends distribution considerations to encompass an exponential family of distributions and devise an unbiased and analytically tractable estimator of the partition function using the Monte Carlo-based importance sampling technique.

2403.04202.tldr: Using an Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma environment with a partner selection mechanism, the extent to which the prevalence of diverse moral agents in populations affects individual agents' learning behaviors and emergent population-level outcomes is investigated.

2404.14442.tldr: This paper develops a unified ODE-based convergence framework that applies to standard Q-learning and several soft/smoothed variants, including those built on the log-sum-exponential softmax, Boltzmann softmax, and mellowmax operators.

2406.16821.tldr: BADGER, a general binding-affinity guidance framework for diffusion models in SBDD, is introduced and extended to multiconstraint diffusion guidance, jointly optimizing for binding affinity, drug-likeness (QED), and synthetic accessibility to design realistic and synthesizable drug candidates.

2409.17538.tldr: It is shown theoretically that the low-rank adaptation mechanism of LoRA is equivalent to fine-tuning adapters with noisy batch gradients, with the noise variance being a decreasing function of adaptation rank ($r$).

2410.02387.tldr: BiSSL is introduced, a novel bilevel training framework that enhances the alignment of self-supervised pretrained models with downstream tasks prior to fine-tuning, and a general training algorithm is proposed that is compatible with a broad range of pretext and downstream tasks.

2411.07976.tldr: DINO-LG is introduced, a novel label-guided extension of DINO that incorporates targeted augmentation on annotated calcified regions during self-supervised pre-training that enhances CAC scoring accuracy by feeding the UNET model with relevant slices, improving diagnostic precision while lowering healthcare costs by minimizing unnecessary tests and treatments.

2411.13883.tldr: A method is described, that is grounded in stochastic approximation theory, to come up with a dynamical system model that asymptotically approximates the mean behavior of the stochastic model and captures the coupled evolution of the population preferences and the learning algorithm.

2412.07818.tldr: A real-time chest X-ray decision support system designed for hospitals in remote locations that integrates a fine-tuned ResNet50 deep learning model for disease classification with Fast DDS real-time middleware to ensure reliable and low-latency communication between healthcare practitioners and the inference system.

2502.01521.tldr: This work proposes Symmetry-Guided Memory Augmentation (SGMA), a framework that improves training efficiency by combining structured experience augmentation with memory-based context inference, and leverages robot and task symmetries to generate additional, physically consistent training experiences without requiring extra interactions.

2502.08987.tldr: Neural Force Field is presented, a framework extending Neural Ordinary Differential Equation to learn complex object interactions through force field representations, which can be efficiently integrated through an Ordinary Differential Equation solver to predict object trajectories.

2503.16449.tldr: Conversational quality, specifically perceived interestingness and naturalness, is the dominant driver of re-engagement, indicating that LLM-driven robot design should prioritize engaging, natural dialogue over affective impression management or anthropomorphic cues.

2503.17684.tldr: This work argues for the need to extend the typical automatic fact-checking pipeline with automatic generation of full fact-checking articles, and develops QRAFT, an LLM-based agentic framework that mimics the writing workflow of human fact-checkers.

2504.17490.tldr: Plasticine is introduced, the first open-source framework for benchmarking plasticity optimization in deep RL, and provides single-file implementations of over 13 mitigation methods, 6 evaluation metrics, and learning scenarios with increasing non-stationarity levels from standard to continually varying environments.

2505.15054.tldr: MolLangBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate fundamental molecule-language interface tasks: language-prompted molecular structure recognition, editing, and generation, and highlights the shortcomings of current AI systems in handling even preliminary molecular recognition and manipulation tasks.

2505.17133.tldr: Two machine learning models are proposed: Exact-MLP and Mask-MLP, which are trained on a small set of reliable subpopulations and are able to predict PNS bounds for all other subpopulations and validate their models across four Structural Causal Models.

2505.17653.tldr: This paper formalizes the Program-to-Geometry task, which challenges models to translate programmatic drawing code into accurate and abstract geometric reasoning, and presents GeoGramBench, a benchmark of 500 carefully refined problems organized by a tailored three-level taxonomy that considers geometric complexity rather than traditional mathematical reasoning complexity.

2505.19013.tldr: This work identifies that existing group-level extensions of Data Shapley are vulnerable to shell company attacks, and proposes Faithful Group Shapley Value (FGSV), a provably fast and accurate approximation algorithm for computing FGSV.

2508.04337.tldr: A novel, unambiguous annotation schema that is explicitly designed for reliable automatic processing is introduced and a comprehensive evaluation of a wide range of large language models (LLMs) on the task of classifying rhetorical roles according to this schema is presented.

2508.06617.tldr: This work revisits existing empirical scaling laws and proposes a generalized scaling law to provide a unified framework that is applicable to both dense and sparse large language models and demonstrates that the proposed law captures the scaling behavior of existing scaling laws.

2508.08688.tldr: STELAR-Vision is introduced, a training framework for topology-aware reasoning that achieves 4.3% higher overall accuracy on in-distribution datasets and consistently outperforms across all OOD benchmarks.

2508.08712.tldr: A systematic survey of parallel text generation methods is presented, categorizing existing approaches into AR-based and Non-AR-based paradigms, and providing a detailed examination of the core techniques within each category.

2508.21540.tldr: HealthProcessAI provides a standardized framework that reduces technical and training barriers in healthcare process mining while maintaining scientific objectivity and represents a novel methodological advance in translating complex process mining results into potentially actionable insights for healthcare applications.

2509.03219.tldr: This work presents a generic adaptive exploration framework that employs uncertainty to address this important issue in a principled manner and experimentally demonstrates that this framework gives rise to adaptive exploration strategies that outperform standard ones across several environments.

2509.13666.tldr: DREAM, a Vision Language Model (VLM)-guided autonomy framework for long-term underwater exploration and habitat monitoring is presented and the results show that the framework is highly efficient in finding and exploring target objects without prior location information.

2509.13761.tldr: This work introduces TIRGen, a multi-agent based pipeline for constructing high-quality datasets of tool-integrated reasoning paths, and introduces an RL strategy that jointly optimizes for both episode-level problem solving and step-level code generation, which demonstrates strong generalization across diverse models.

2509.16596.tldr: This work evaluates closed-book question answering (CBQA) performance across five large language models from the LLaMA-2 and LLaMA-3 families and reveals that up to 90% of parameter updates during SFT do not contribute to knowledge enhancement.

2509.21836.tldr: Axiomatic Choice is introduced as a framework for making and evaluating decisions based on formal normative statements about decisions that capture a wide array of desiderata, e.g., ethical constraints, beyond the typical treatment in Social Choice.

2509.25289.tldr: ClustRecNet is introduced, a novel end-to-end deep learning framework that recommends a suitable clustering algorithm by directly learning high-order representations of raw tabular data, and is the first to successively apply deep learning to automatically recommend suitable clustering algorithms for tabular data at hand.

2510.01879.tldr: This work introduces REPAIR (Robust Editing via Progressive Adaptive Intervention and Reintegration), a lifelong editing framework designed to support precise and low-cost model updates while preserving non-target knowledge.

2510.02840.tldr: It is argued, in a learning-paradigm-agnostic framework, that OSA fails in realistic conditions: approximation, estimation, and optimization errors guarantee systematic deviations from the intended objective, regardless of the quality of its specification.

2510.04391.tldr: This framework offers quantitative metrics for evaluating offline world models in cognitive agents via imagination vividness ratings, distinguishing offline world models (persistent memory structures accessed independent of immediate goals) from online models (task-specific representations).

2510.04772.tldr: This work establishes a methodological reference point for robust, privacy-preserving AI systems in surgical video analysis through rigorous statistical analysis of current FL limitations through rigorous statistical analysis.

2510.06477.tldr: This work presents a surprising connection between attention sinks and compression valleys, tracing both to the formation of massive activations in the residual stream, and proposes the Mix-Compress-Refine theory of information flow, an attempt to explain how LLMs organize their computation in depth by controlling attention and representational compression via massive activations.

2510.09425.tldr: An efficient algorithm for the offline budgeted matching problem is devised, and an efficient UCB-like algorithm is developed that achieves a regret bound of $\tilde O(U\sqrt{TK})$.

2510.12985.tldr: By grounding physical safety in temporal logic and applying verification methods across multiple levels, SENTINEL provides a rigorous foundation for systematically evaluating the safety of FM-based embodied agents in simulation-based physical environments, and can effectively expose potential safety violations in interpreting, planning, and executing the tasks.

2510.13068.tldr: NeuroRVQ tokenizer establishes a strong prior for codebook-based general-purpose brainwave models, enabling advances in neural decoding, generative modeling and multimodal biosignal integration.

2510.14406.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that, when using Qwen3-8B-Instruct as the base model and training it with the IMAGINE framework, the model achieves an 82.7% Final Pass Rate on the TravelPlanner benchmark, far exceeding the 40% of DeepSeek-R1-671B, while maintaining a much smaller model size.

2510.16596.tldr: This paper is the first to trace LVLM hallucinations to visual encoders and identifies three key issues: statistical bias, inherent bias, and vulnerability and proposes SHIELD, a training-free framework that mitigates hallucinations through three strategies.

2510.23631.tldr: Ranked Choice Preference Optimization (RCPO) is introduced, a unified framework that bridges preference optimization with (ranked) choice modeling via maximum likelihood estimation and offers an extensible foundation for incorporating (ranked) choice modeling into LLM training.

2511.02424.tldr: Experiments show ReAcTree consistently outperforms strong task-planning baselines such as ReAct across diverse LLMs and integrates two complementary memory systems: each agent node retrieves goal-specific, subgoal-level examples from episodic memory and shares environment-specific observations through working memory.

2511.14584.tldr: Evaluated zero-shot across diverse interactive tasks without task-specific engineering, ReflexGrad achieves strong single-execution performance, demonstrating that gradient-free inference-time learning is not just theoretically appealing but practically viable.

2511.16449.tldr: VLA-Pruner is a versatile plug-and-play VLA-specific token pruning method that aligns with the dual-system nature of VLA models and exploits the temporal continuity in robot manipulation and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple VLA architectures and diverse robotic tasks.

2511.17528.tldr: Evaluating the application of Device-First Continuum AI to critical energy sector operations establishes that DFC-AI addresses the unique challenges of energy sector operations, ensuring intelligent agents remain available and functional in remote oil fields, offshore platforms, and other challenging environments characteristic of the industry.

2511.18894.tldr: The proposed MetaDCSeg is a robust framework that dynamically learns optimal pixel-wise weights to suppress the influence of noisy labels while preserving reliable annotations, and enables more precise handling of structural boundaries, which are often overlooked by existing methods.

2512.08082.tldr: A practical proxy to MCL is introduced, called Distributionally Aware MCL (DaMCL), that does not require knowledge of the actual next-token and is compatible with sampling strategies beyond greedy decoding, and develops an intuitive decoding algorithm that leverages the detector to identify and boost tokens that are long-range-relevant.

2512.15771.tldr: This work extends the Time-Evolving Natural Gradient framework to address Dirichlet boundary conditions, integrating natural gradient optimization with numerical time-stepping schemes, including Euler and Heun methods, to ensure both stability and accuracy.

2512.22399.tldr: This paper introduces Space AI as a unified interdisciplinary field at the intersection of artificial intelligence and space science and technology, and proposes a systematic framework that organises Space AI into four mission contexts.
