2601.02411.tldr: This work proposes SpikySpace, a spiking state-space model (SSM) that reduces the quadratic cost in the attention block to linear time via spiking selective scanning, opening a practical path toward efficient time series forecasting systems.

2601.06268.tldr: A AuDoPEDA is presented, an autonomous, repository-grounded coding system built atop OpenAI models and a Codex-class agent that reads OpenROAD, proposes research directions, expands them into implementation steps, and submits executable diffs.

2601.12467.tldr: Findings indicate that structured patch-level tokenization provides a scalable and effective representation for multivariate time-series forecasting, particularly when longer input sequences are considered.

2601.20642.tldr: A memorization detection metric is developed by integrating isotropic norm and anisotropic alignment that outperforms existing denoising-free detection methods while being at least approximately 5x faster than the previous best approach.

2602.01550.tldr: S1-NexusAgent is proposed, a self-evolving agent framework designed for multidisciplinary scientific research that adopts a hierarchical Plan-and-CodeAct execution paradigm, decoupling global scientific planning from subtask-level tool execution through a dual-loop architecture, thereby enabling stable modeling of complex research workflows.

2602.01992.tldr: This work formalizes analogical reasoning as the inference of correspondences between entities across categories, inspired by the notion of functors in category theory, and introduces synthetic tasks that evaluate the emergence of analogical reasoning under controlled settings.

2602.02301.tldr: This study clarifies the sources of interference in multi-domain RL and presents an effective solution for training general-purpose LRMs, which resolves gradient conflicts at the module level within the transformer.

2602.02495.tldr: A Reward-free Alignment framework for Conflicted Objectives (RACO) is proposed that directly leverages pairwise preference data and resolves gradient conflicts via a novel clipped variant of conflict-averse gradient descent and provides convergence guarantees to Pareto-critical points that respect user-specified objective weights.

2602.02543.tldr: Norm-Anchor Scaling NAS is proposed, a plug-and-play norm-constrained strategy that delays the collapse point of representative L&E algorithms by more than 4 times and yields a 72.2% average relative gain in editing performance.

2602.05195.tldr: DAKS performs KB routing and budgeted retrieval to mitigate density-driven bias and to prioritize authoritative sources when appropriate, and an alignment graph is used to guide evidence fusion and coverage-aware packing, improving cross-KB evidence coverage without relying on naive concatenation.

2602.05474.tldr: Extensive experiments conducted on three real world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed LMMRec framework and highlight the need to model motivation as a latent variable learned implicitly from behavioral data.

2602.05735.tldr: CSRv2 stabilizes sparsity learning through progressive k-annealing, enhances representational quality via supervised contrastive objectives, and ensures end-to-end adaptability with full backbone finetuning, and broadens the design space for real-time and edge-deployable AI systems where both embedding quality and efficiency are critical.

2602.05838.tldr: FHAIM is proposed, the first fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) framework for training a marginal-based synthetic data generator on encrypted tabular data, which adapts the widely used AIM algorithm to the FHE setting using novel FHE protocols, ensuring that the private data remains encrypted throughout and is released only with differential privacy guarantees.

2602.06052.tldr: This survey provides a unified view of foundation agent memory along three dimensions: memory substrate, cognitive mechanism, and memory subject (agent- and user-centric), and examines how memory is instantiated and operated under different agent topologies and highlights learning policies over memory operations.

2602.06317.tldr: The Condensate Theorem is presented: for any query, projecting attention onto the Condensate Manifold (Anchor + Window + Dynamic Top-k) achieves 100% output equivalence with full $O(n^2)$ attention.

2602.07520.tldr: A unified information tokenization module that transforms features, scenarios, and tasks into a unified tokenized format that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art MSL and MTL baselines and enables scenario and task information to prompt and activate the model's vast parameter space in a bottom-up, layer-wise manner.

2602.07543.tldr: MSP-LLM is proposed, a unified LLM-based framework that formulates MSP as a structured process composed of two constituent subproblems: precursor prediction and synthesis operation prediction, demonstrating an effective and scalable framework for MSP that can accelerate real-world materials discovery.

2602.07605.tldr: With only 4-shot training, Fine-R1 outperforms existing general MLLMs, reasoning MLLMs, and even contrastive CLIP models in identifying both seen and unseen sub-categories, showing promise in working in knowledge-intensive domains where gathering expert annotations for all sub-categories is arduous.

2602.07794.tldr: This work investigates the internal processing of LLMs during in-context concept inference, revealing a conceptual subspace emerging in middle to late layers, whose representational structure persists across contexts.

2602.07840.tldr: SAGE (Scalable AI Governance &Evaluation), a framework that operationalizes high-quality human product judgment as a scalable evaluation signal, and applies teacher-student distillation to transfer high-fidelity judgments into compact student surrogates at a lower cost.

2602.08030.tldr: The findings suggest that sustainable intelligence requires the freedom to forget as much as the power to think, and proposes Free()LM, a model that introduces an intrinsic self-forgetting capability via the Free-Module, a plug-and-play LoRA adapter.

2602.08268.tldr: The findings demonstrate that Puda enables effective multi-granularity management, offering practical choices to mitigate the privacy-personalization trade-off and provides an AI-native foundation for user sovereignty.

2602.08586.tldr: A novel framework called PRISM (Propose-Review-Integrate Synthesis for Multi-agent Reasoning) is proposed, which jointly maximizes all three dimensions through role-based diversity, execution-grounded feedback with evidence-based cross-evaluation, and iterative synthesis with closed-loop validation.

2602.09034.tldr: INdirect CAusal MAmba is introduced, a latent-space causal discovery framework that explicitly accounts for measurement physics to separate neural dynamics from indirect observations and establishes identifiability of delayed causal structure from indirect measurements and a stability bound that quantifies how inversion error affects graph recovery.

2602.09035.tldr: A method to reduce the computational cost of most existing convolutional neural networks (CNN) by replacing one-dimensional (1-D) CNNs with two-dimensional (2-D) CNNs and deploys them on Edge Tensor Processing Unit (TPU), which is an open-resource hardware accelerator widely used in edge devices for low-latency, low-power operation.

2602.09038.tldr: Bilevel-Optimized Sparse Querying (BOSQ), a general framework that selectively leverages LLM-derived explanation features to enhance performance on node-level tasks on TAGs, is proposed.

2602.09039.tldr: This work proposes an efficient retrieval method exploiting the triangle inequality: distances to a set of optimized pivots define bounds that prune redundant comparisons, which substantially reduces runtime and is fully parallelizable.

2602.09040.tldr: GMM-Anchored JEPA is proposed, which fits a Gaussian Mixture Model once on log-mel spectrograms and uses its frozen soft posteriors as auxiliary targets throughout training to achieve substantially more uniform cluster utilization.

2602.09041.tldr: DSFlow is introduced, a modular distillation framework for few-step and one-step synthesis that improves training stability through a dual supervision strategy that combines endpoint matching with deterministic mean-velocity alignment, enforcing consistent generation trajectories across inference steps.

2602.09051.tldr: This work introduces a hybrid approach that works in a 3-stage manner that decouples discovery from deployment and connects them via a novel bridge, and demonstrates that RuleFlow is the new state-of-the-art (SOTA) Pandas optimization framework on PandasBench, a challenging Pandas benchmark consisting of Python notebooks.

2602.09065.tldr: A novel serialized token paradigm is proposed to aggregate node signals into serialized graph tokens, with positional encoding being automatically involved and stacked self-attention layers applied to encode this token sequence and capture its internal dependencies.

2602.09066.tldr: This work proposes Spectral Disentanglement and Enhancement (SDE), a novel framework that bridges the gap between the geometry of the embedded spaces and their spectral properties, and introduces a dual-domain contrastive loss that jointly optimizes alignment in both the feature and spectral spaces.

2602.09071.tldr: DRAGON is presented, a repository classifier designed for very large and diverse software collections, that operates entirely on lightweight signals commonly stored in version control systems: file and directory names, and optionally the README when available, surpassing the state of the art in repository classification at scale.

2602.09078.tldr: This paper aims to address the gap that exists in applying Zero Trust Architecture to endpoint management within cloud environments for critical infrastructure, and proposes a comprehensive framework for integrating tailored ZTA into organizations that manage sensitive operations.

2602.09080.tldr: This work proposes RecursiveVLM, a recursive Transformer architecture tailored for LMMs, which transforms recursion into an on-demand refinement mechanism: delivering strong results with few loops on resource-constrained devices and progressively improving outputs when more computation resources are available.

2602.09081.tldr: DMamba, a novel forecasting model that explicitly aligns architectural complexity with this component-specific characteristic of inter-variable relationships, is proposed, consistently outperforming both recent Mamba-based architectures and leading decomposition-based models.

2602.09109.tldr: This paper offers a comprehensive review of collective operations and distributed parallel strategies, complemented by mathematical formulations to deepen theoretical understanding and highlight open challenges and limitations of current LLM training paradigms.

2602.09112.tldr: Cadmus models outperform GPT-5 even on a simple task of completing correct, integer arithmetic programs in the authors' domain-specific language (DSL) while providing transparency into the dataset's relationship to the problem.

2602.09113.tldr: This paper presents a comprehensive survey of energy requirements of speculative decoding strategies, with detailed analysis on how various factors -- model size and family, speculative decoding strategies, and dataset characteristics -- influence the energy optimizations.

2602.09121.tldr: This work presents a lightweight and privacy-preserving Multimodal Emotion Recognition framework designed for deployment on edge devices, and introduces a model- and task-agnostic fusion mechanism grounded in Dempster-Shafer theory and Dirichlet evidence.

2602.09138.tldr: Progress-Aware Belief Update (PABU), a belief-state framework that compactly represents an agent's state by explicitly modeling task progress and selectively retaining past actions and observations, is proposed.

2602.09154.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive framework for automatically detecting and extracting personal names from broadcast and social-media-native news videos and introduces a curated and balanced corpus of annotated frames capturing the diversity of contemporary news graphics and proposes an interpretable, modular extraction pipeline designed to operate under deterministic and auditable conditions.

2602.09158.tldr: It is found that different geometric statistics capture different types of hallucinations, and a simple normalization method is introduced to mitigate the effect of domain shift on geometric statistics, leading to AUROC gains in multi-domain settings.

2602.09159.tldr: Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents (CoMMa), a decentralized LLM-agent framework in which specialists operate on partitioned evidence and coordinate through a game-theoretic objective for robust decision-making, achieves higher accuracy and more stable performance than data-centralized and role-based multi-agents baselines.

2602.09163.tldr: FlyBench is presented to evaluate AI agents on end-to-end agentic ontology curation from scientific literature, and it is found that architectural choices significantly impact performance, with multi-agent designs outperforming simpler alternatives, yet scaling backbone models yields diminishing returns.

2602.09173.tldr: Soft hidden-state collaboration is introduced, where multiple heterogeneous frozen SLM experts are integrated through their internal representations via a trainable attention interface, providing a compact mechanism for leveraging frozen experts, while offering an observational window into expert utilization patterns and their evolution under RLVR.

2602.09185.tldr: A large-scale dataset focused on agent-authored pull requests (Agentic-PRs) in real-world GitHub repositories, which offers a foundation for future research on AI adoption, developer productivity, and human-AI collaboration in the new era of software engineering.

2602.09190.tldr: This work studies how gradient information can be leveraged to improve neural network's ability to approximate high-frequency functions, and proposes a gradient-based residual connection as a complement to the standard identity skip connection used in residual networks.

2602.09202.tldr: It is concluded that confronting algorithmic violence demands a democratization of AI ethics, one that resists technocratic fatalism and centers the lived realities of those most affected by high-tech militarism.

2602.09207.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that CausalGDP consistently achieves competitive or superior performance over state-of-the-art diffusion-based and offline RL methods, especially in complex, high-dimensional control tasks.

2602.09220.tldr: This paper proposes a lightweight multi-view approach to short-term load forecasting that leverages single-value embeddings and a scaled time-range input to capture temporally relevant features efficiently and introduces an embedding dropout mechanism to prevent over-reliance on specific features and enhance interpretability.

2602.09222.tldr: This work presents MUZZLE, an automated agentic framework for evaluating the security of web agents against indirect prompt injection attacks, and demonstrates its ability to automatically and adaptively assess the security of web agents with minimal human intervention.

2602.09234.tldr: This paper proposes to investigate a gradually changing environment, and performs theoretical and empirical analysis, showing that the loss of plasticity is an artifact of abrupt tasks changes in the environment and can be largely mitigated if the world changes gradually.

2602.09252.tldr: IR-SIS is proposed, an iterative refinement system for surgical image segmentation that accepts natural language descriptions and establishes the first language-based surgical segmentation framework with adaptive self-refinement capabilities.

2602.09276.tldr: It is demonstrated that effective reasoning strategies consistently reduce the intrinsic dimensionality of the task, suggesting that effective reasoning chains facilitate learning by better compressing the task using fewer parameters, offering a new quantitative metric for analyzing reasoning processes.

2602.09284.tldr: This paper proposes X-Mark, a sample-specific clean-label watermarking method for chest x-ray copyright protection that uses a conditional U-Net to generate unique perturbations within salient regions of each sample, and incorporates Laplacian regularization into the training objective to penalize high-frequency perturbations and achieve watermark scale-invariance.

2602.09286.tldr: A comparative analysis of two newly active Reddit communities in Jan--Feb 2026 that reflect different socio-technical roles: r/OpenClaw (deployment and operations) and r/Moltbook (agent-centered social interaction) is presented.

2602.09306.tldr: The potential of LLM-driven semantic generation as a new paradigm for advancing privacy-preserving federated recommendation is demonstrated, and LUMOS achieves consistent gains over competitive centralised and federated baselines on HR@20 and NDCG@20.

2602.09312.tldr: A topic continuity model aimed at assessing whether a response aligns with the initial conversation topic is presented, built upon the expansion of the corresponding natural language understanding (NLU) model into quantifiable terms using a Naive Bayes approach.

2602.09314.tldr: It is demonstrated that Shampoo achieves higher token efficiency than Muon, mirroring Adam's advantage over Signum, and that Shampoo's update applied to weight matrices can be decomposed into an adapted Muon update, which admits a new perspective that avoids shortcomings of related interpretations based on variance adaptation and whitening.

2602.09315.tldr: It is argued that the development of a novel model can help in early detection of the complexities in the wound, which might affect the healing process and also reduce the time spent by a clinician to diagnose the wound.

2602.09317.tldr: To stabilize end-to-end training, adaptive relaxation is introduced, which designs a relaxed feasible set that snares the neural network at initialization and shrinks it into the feasible set, enabling early exploration and strict feasibility later in training.

2602.09318.tldr: GAFRNet is proposed, a robust and interpretable Graph Attention and FuzzyRule Network specifically engineered for histopathology image classification with scarce supervision, and its results validate the superior generalization and practical utility of GAFR-Net as a reliable decision-support tool for weakly supervised medical image analysis.

2602.09331.tldr: This work proposes counterfactual importance weighting: mask reasoning spans, measure the drop in answer probability, and upweight tokens accordingly during policy gradient updates during policy gradient updates, and correctly prioritizes calculation steps over scaffolding text.

2602.09337.tldr: The Kyrtos methodology for the automatic recognition and analysis of charts with curves in graphics images of technical documents is introduced and the accuracy of Kyrtos'recognition and analysis methods is demonstrated.

2602.09340.tldr: This work demonstrates that the proposed PLs-based diversity metric (PLDiv) is powerful, reliable, and interpretable, directly linking data diversity to its underlying geometry and offering a foundational tool for dataset construction, augmentation, and evaluation.

2602.09341.tldr: This work introduces AgentAuditor, which replaces voting with a path search over a Reasoning Tree that explicitly represents agreements and divergences among agent traces, and proposes Anti-Consensus Preference Optimization (ACPO), which trains the adjudicator on majority-failure cases and rewards evidence-based minority selections over popular errors.

2602.09343.tldr: A set of formal reasoning-based methodologies that wrap around existing ma-chine learning toxicity detection systems helps alleviating the negation attack problems and significantly improves the accuracy and efficacy of toxicity scoring.

2602.09347.tldr: The purpose of this communication is to bring awareness to limitations when AI is used to reconstruct or enhance a radiological image, with the goal of enabling users to reap benefits of the technology while minimizing risks.

2602.09362.tldr: In preference-based tasks, responses become more human-like as models become more advanced or larger, while in belief-based tasks, advanced large-scale models frequently generate rational responses.

2602.09374.tldr: The method recovers roughly twice as many structurally tail-risk outliers as most classical baselines and identifies an exclusive non-overlapping fraction of high-utility configurations not found by competing methods, highlighting that an effective mechanism for learning higher-order interaction structure and projecting it into quadratic surrogate Hamiltonians for quantum-assisted black-box discovery.

2602.09383.tldr: BiasScope is proposed, a LLM-driven framework for automatically and at scale discovering potential biases that may arise during model evaluation that overcomes the limitations of existing approaches and transforms bias discovery from a passive process relying on manual effort and predefined bias lists into an active and comprehensive automated exploration.

2602.09384.tldr: This paper casts a shadow on the simplistic assumption that LLMs threaten the continued viability of the legal industry.

2602.09396.tldr: Self-Predictive Representations is extended to the streaming pipeline to maximize the utility of every observed frame, and orthogonal gradient updates relative to the momentum target are introduced to resolve gradient conflicts arising from streaming-specific optimizers.

2602.09410.tldr: This paper presents the first quantitative comparison between LLM-driven synthesis and conventional HLS-based approaches for low-level compute-intensive kernels in FALCON, showing that human-in-the-loop LLM-generated accelerators can achieve up to 2.6x speedup in kernel execution time with shorter critical paths, while highlighting trade-offs in resource utilization and power consumption.

2602.09413.tldr: LARV is introduced, a training-free, data-free, merger-agnostic Layer-wise Adaptive Rescaling Veneer that plugs into any task-vector merger and assigns a per-layer scale to each task vector before aggregation, and it is shown it consistently boosts diverse merging rules.

2602.09423.tldr: This work frames DbA as a mediating technology for human-AI collaboration and outlines the potential opportunities and inherent risks for advancing creativity support in HCI and design research, and identifies six forms of representation and classify techniques across seven stages of the creative process.

2602.09430.tldr: An Agentic VLA Inference Plugin for Long-Horizon Tasks in Scientific Experiments introduces an LLM-based agentic inference mechanism that intervenes when executing sequential manipulation tasks, enabling reliable execution of composite scientific workflows without any additional training.

2602.09433.tldr: This paper introduces Autonomous Action Runtime Management (AARM), an open specification for securing AI-driven actions at runtime that intercepts actions before execution, accumulates session context, evaluates against policy and intent alignment, and records tamper-evident receipts for forensic reconstruction.

2602.09434.tldr: A novel fingerprinting framework is introduced that leverages the behavioral patterns induced by safety alignment, applying the concept of refusal vectors for LLM provenance tracking, and it is demonstrated that these behavioral fingerprints are highly robust against common modifications, including finetunes, merges, and quantization.

2602.09442.tldr: It is found that while CoT enhances accuracy, contrary to the bias reduction observed with RAG, it increases overall bias across datasets, highlighting the need for bias-aware reasoning frameworks that can mitigate this trade-off.

2602.09443.tldr: By open-sourcing P1-VL, a family of open-source vision-language models engineered for advanced scientific reasoning, this work provides a foundational step toward general-purpose physical intelligence to better align visual perceptions with abstract physical laws for machine scientific discovery.

2602.09444.tldr: The Conceptual Cultural Index (CCI), which estimates cultural specificity at the sentence level as the difference between the generality estimate within the target culture and the average generality estimate across other cultures, is proposed.

2602.09464.tldr: AlgoVeri is a benchmark that evaluates vericoding of classical algorithms in Dafny, Verus, and Lean by enforcing identical functional contracts, which reveals critical capability gaps in verification systems.

2602.09469.tldr: This work proposes a multi-output ensemble system tackling both Subtask 1 - ToxNER and Subtask 2 - ToxUse, which integrates BETO with a CRF layer for sequence labeling, employs diverse training strategies, and uses sentence filtering to boost precision.

2602.09475.tldr: It is shown that pretrained VLMs already encode the knowledge needed to detect artifacts - with the right scaffolding, this capability can be unlocked using only a few hundred labeled examples per artifact category.

2602.09485.tldr: XMCC is proposed, an eXplainable Multimodal CoT Compressor that formulates compression as a sequential decision-making process optimized via reinforcement learning that can effectively shorten reasoning trajectories while preserving key reasoning steps and answer correctness, and simultaneously generates natural-language explanations for its compression decisions.

2602.09486.tldr: The CoCoA decoder is proposed, a novel, training-free decoding algorithm that mitigates hallucinations at inference time by listening to model-intrinsic signals in the middle layers and penalizing outputs that exhibit high internal confusion, thereby steering the model towards more internally consistent and factually grounded outputs.

2602.09489.tldr: Compute Shapley values with multiple variants of TabPFN and compare their performance with state-of-the-art methods on both simulated and real datasets; in most cases, TabPFN yields the best performance; where it does not, it is only marginally worse than the best method, at a fraction of the runtime.

2602.09492.tldr: This work elevates batch size from a minor implementation detail to a first-order design parameter, reconciling prior inconsistencies and enabling more reliable evaluations of LoRA variants.

2602.09504.tldr: Using financial prediction tasks, it is shown that revealing the downstream use of LLM outputs leads the LLM to generate biased sentiment and competition measures, even though these measures are intended to be downstream task-independent.

2602.09530.tldr: The induced polynomials often exhibit near-equiripple, near-minimax behavior characteristic of Chebyshev polynomials, and are found to have clear connections to classical theory.

2602.09533.tldr: This work revisits the theoretical foundations of DPO and proposes a novel formulation that explicitly introduces the autoregressive assumption prior to applying the BT model, and derives a novel variant, termed Autoregressive DPO (ADPO), that explicitly integrates autoregressive modeling into the preference optimization framework.

2602.09552.tldr: It is demonstrated that dataset characteristics and dialogue length strongly influence retrieval effectiveness, explaining why no single RAG strategy dominates across settings, and indicates that effective conversational RAG depends less on method complexity than on alignment between the retrieval strategy and the dataset structure.

2602.09566.tldr: The ECG-IMN is proposed, an Interpretable Mesomorphic Neural Network tailored for high-resolution 12-lead ECG classification that achieves competitive predictive performance (AUROC comparable to black-box baselines) while providing faithful, instance-specific explanations.

2602.09570.tldr: LEMUR, a large-scale multilingual corpus of EU environmental legislation constructed from 24,953 official EUR-Lex PDF documents covering 25 languages, is introduced and three state-of-the-art multilingual embedding models are fine-tuned, reflecting realistic legal-retrieval scenarios.

2602.09574.tldr: Budget-Guided MCTS is proposed, a tree-search decoding algorithm that aligns its search policy with the remaining token budget and consistently outperforms budget-agnostic tree-search baselines across different budgets on MATH500 and AIME24/25 with open-weight LLMs.

2602.09581.tldr: This work provides a theoretical analysis showing that entropy control increases the expected log-likelihood gap between in-distribution and OOD samples in favor of the in-distribution, and explains why the procedure works without any additional training of the density model.

2602.09587.tldr: This work proposes MieDB-100k, a large-scale, high-quality and diverse dataset for text-guided medical image editing that categorizes editing tasks into perspectives of Perception, Modification and Transformation, considering both understanding and generation abilities.

2602.09590.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet effective context-augmented CDA method, Context-CDA, which uses large LMs to enhance the diversity and contextual relevance of the debiasing corpus, and shows results on gender bias benchmarks that effectively mitigates bias without sacrificing language modeling performance.

2602.09593.tldr: This work introduces a domain-agnostic formulation that enables consistent detection and evaluation of the counterintuitive phenomenon, addressing the absence of precise definition, and suggests that likelihood-only detection with normalizing flows offers a practical and reliable approach for anomaly detection in tabular domains.

2602.09597.tldr: This work proposes partially complex-valued neural networks as an adaptive range profile processing as a generative architecture going through the entire received signal in one go to generate a complete detection profile.

2602.09611.tldr: Attention-Guided Dynamic Watermarking (AGMark), a novel framework that embeds detectable signals while strictly preserving visual fidelity, is proposed, effectively establishing a new standard for reliability-preserving multi-modal watermarking.

2602.09616.tldr: ARGUS is introduced, a pipeline that enables the retrievability of high-risk (low-RPS) entities through targeted document augmentation from a knowledge base (KB), first paragraphs of Wikipedia, in this case.

2602.09617.tldr: ToucHD is presented, a large-scale hierarchical tactile dataset spanning tactile atomic actions, real-world manipulations, and touch-force paired data, and AnyTouch 2, a general tactile representation learning framework for diverse optical tactile sensors that unifies object-level understanding with fine-grained, force-aware dynamic perception.

2602.09620.tldr: This paper presents the FLINGO language (and tool) that incorporates the aforementioned expressiveness inside the numerical constraints and its use with several examples and presents a translation from the newly introduced FLINGO syntax to regular CASP programs following the CLINGCON input format.

2602.09629.tldr: The Four-Checkpoint Framework provides a structured approach for identifying and addressing safety vulnerabilities in deployed systems and suggests that current defenses are strongest at input-literal checkpoints but remain vulnerable to intent-level manipulation and output-stage techniques.

2602.09642.tldr: MATA is introduced, a multi-agent TableQA framework that leverages multiple complementary reasoning paths and a set of tools built with small language models that maintains strong performance with small, open-source models and adapts easily across various LLM types.

2602.09681.tldr: The rationale behind the method's structure is elucidated through ablation studies and a comprehensive experimental evaluation is performed using both real-world and synthetic datasets that feature class imbalance, incremental classes, and concept drifts, demonstrating that SCIL outperforms strong baselines and state-of-the-art methods.

2602.09701.tldr: GenSeg-R1-G, a variant trained on GRefCOCO with a SAM 2 in-the-loop reward that directly optimizes mask quality is introduced, substantially outperforming Seg-R1-7B and Seg-Zero-7B, which lack no-target detection capability.

2602.09703.tldr: Low Rank Adaptation fine-tuning on monolingual and English Dialect parallel data, adapter merging and dialect-aware MBR decoding to improve dialectal fidelity generation and translation and merging and MBR improve dialectal fidelity while preserving semantic accuracy are used.

2602.09708.tldr: This work proposes a methodology that combines generative latent diffusion models with physics-informed machine learning to generate solutions of parametric partial differential equations conditioned on partial observations, which includes forward and inverse PDE problems.

2411.00918.tldr: LibMoE is introduced, a unified framework for reproducible, efficient, and extensible MoE research that supports both pretraining and sparse-upcycling regimes and establishes a reliable benchmark to guide future innovations.

2504.03784.tldr: A robust algorithm to enhance the performance of existing approaches under such reward model misspecifications is proposed, which reduces the variance of reward and policy estimators, leading to improved regret bounds.

2504.04072.tldr: Among Us is a sandbox social deception game where LLM-agents exhibit long-term, open-ended deception as a consequence of the game objectives, and it is found that probes trained on a dataset of "pretend you're a dishonest model" generalize extremely well out-of-distribution, consistently obtaining AUROCs over 95% even when evaluated just on the deceptive statement, without the chain of thought.

2504.12777.tldr: This work identifies key challenges at the interface between climate simulations and the application of MARL in the context of policy synthesis, including reward definition, scalability with increasing agents and state spaces, uncertainty propagation across linked systems, and solution validation.

2506.10357.tldr: Optimus-3 is introduced, a generalist agent that organically integrates these dual capabilities within a unified framework and addresses three fundamental challenges: overcoming the scarcity of reasoning data, reconciling the dichotomous computational requirements of the dual systems, and activating the reasoning capabilities of System 2.

2506.18862.tldr: This work introduces **TAMMs, the first unified framework designed to jointly perform TCD and FSIF within a single MLLM-diffusion architecture, and introduces two key innovations: Temporal Adaptation Modules (**TAM**) enhance frozen MLLM's ability to comprehend long-range dynamics, and Semantic-Fused Control Injection (SFCI) mechanism translates this change understanding into fine-grained generative control.

2506.22499.tldr: The results demonstrate that supplementing traditional data with satellite-derived density significantly improves estimation performance, especially for links without local sensors, and show the framework's potential for practical deployment on large-scale networks.

2507.05463.tldr: This work proposes a framework that uses large vision models and naturalistic driving videos to analyze driver behavior, identify cognitive status and predict disease progression, and identifies early warning signs of functional impairment, contributing to proactive intervention strategies.

2508.06133.tldr: This work proposes Sorted-F, which repeatedly forms feasible batches using a new selection metric that balances batch size against downstream decode cost, and proves it achieves a constant-factor guarantee on total latency.

2508.10030.tldr: A novel unified framework named IAPO (Inference-Aware Prompt Optimization) is introduced that jointly optimizes the prompt and inference scale, while being aware of the inference budget and different task objectives, and develops a fixed-budget training algorithm for IAPO.

2508.16651.tldr: The proposed HiCL architecture is a novel hippocampal-inspired dual-memory continual learning architecture designed to mitigate catastrophic forgetting by using elements inspired by the hippocampal circuitry, and incorporates prioritized replay of stored patterns to reinforce essential past experiences.

2509.14181.tldr: TimeAlign is introduced, a lightweight, plug-and-play framework that establishes a new representation paradigm, distinct from contrastive learning, by aligning auxiliary features via a simple reconstruction task and feeding them back into any base forecaster.

2509.15888.tldr: Steering Vector Decoding (SVDecode), a lightweight, PEFT-compatible, and theoretically grounded method that theoretically prove that SVDecode is first-order equivalent to the gradient step of full fine-tuning and derive a globally optimal solution for the strength of the steering vector.

2509.22761.tldr: Analysis indicates that joint reasoning in the unified latent space is the key to MILR's strong performance, and qualitative studies reveal MILR's non-trivial ability in temporal and cultural reasoning, highlighting the efficacy of the reasoning method.

2510.01278.tldr: NcPU combines a noisy-pair robust supervised non-contrastive loss (NoiSNCL), which aligns intra-class representations despite unreliable supervision, with a phantom label disambiguation (PLD) scheme that supplies conservative negative supervision via regret-based label updates.

2510.12049.tldr: It is found that GenAI adoption significantly increases sales, with treatment effects ranging from $0\%$ to $16.3\%$, depending on GenAI's marginal contribution relative to existing firm practices.

2510.12832.tldr: Conditional Diffusion models for synthesising daily active and reactive power profiles at the low voltage distribution substation level are proposed and show synthesised load profiles are plausible both independently and as a cohort in a wider power systems context.

2510.17439.tldr: This work introduces FALCON (From Spatial to Action), a novel paradigm that injects rich 3D spatial tokens into the action head and includes an Embodied Spatial Model that can optionally fuse depth, or pose for higher fidelity when available, without retraining or architectural changes.

2510.21112.tldr: This work proposes an uncertainty-aware, object-centric method for city-scale LiDAR-based change detection, which aligns data from different time periods using multi-resolution Normal Distributions Transform (NDT) and a point-to-plane Iterative Closest Point (ICP) method, normalizes elevation, and computes a per-point level of detection from registration covariance and surface roughness to calibrate change decisions.

2510.21797.tldr: This work introduces the Modality Gap metric to quantify prediction discrepancies, and employs a Gaussian Mixture Model to explicitly model this distribution, indicating the coexistence of balanced and imbalanced sample subgroups.

2511.02241.tldr: The Structurally Adaptive Predictive Predictive Inference Network (SAPIN) is introduced, a novel computational model inspired by the principles of active inference and the morphological plasticity observed in biological neural cultures that can successfully solve the CartPole task, achieving robust performance.

2511.16054.tldr: LTLA improves continuation likelihood over standard HMM surrogates, enables lookahead control for vision--language models by incorporating continuous context, achieves 100% syntactic constraint satisfaction, and improves detoxification while adding only a 14% decoding-time overhead.

2511.17332.tldr: This paper argues that the conceptual tools developed within the Autonomous Agents and Multi-Agent Systems (AAMAS) community, such as BDI architectures, communication protocols, mechanism design, and institutional modelling, provide a foundation for agentic systems that are not only capable and flexible, but also transparent, cooperative, and accountable.

2512.00185.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive taxonomy and technical analysis of chunking strategies tailored for each modality: text, images, audio, video, and cross-modal data, and explores emerging cross-modal chunking strategies that aim to preserve alignment and semantic consistency across disparate data types.

2512.08493.tldr: LLM-based code-augmentation for vulnerable functions is investigated, comparing controlled generation of new vulnerable samples with semantics-preserving refactoring of existing ones and finding that a hybrid strategy best boosts vulnerability classifiers' performance.

2512.11276.tldr: An experience prototype is built and participants asked to train it to be their personal ACP proxy, arguing for a potential new role of AI in ACP where agents act as personal advocates for individuals, building mutual intelligibility over time.

2512.19379.tldr: OmniMER is proposed, a multimodal adaptation framework built upon Qwen2.5-Omni that enhances emotion recognition through three auxiliary modality-specific perception tasks: emotion keyword extraction for text, facial expression analysis for video, and prosody analysis for audio that reduces reliance on spurious correlations in low-resource settings.

2512.24968.tldr: It is found that large publishers who block GenAI bots experience reduced website traffic compared to not blocking, and that large publishers shift toward richer content that is harder for LLMs to replicate, without increasing text volume.

2601.01280.tldr: An experimental, system-oriented analysis of long-term dialog memory architectures is presented and a unified framework that decomposes dialog memory systems into core components and supports both graph-based and non-graph approaches is introduced.

2601.02380.tldr: This work proposes guidelines for scientific transparency and reproducibility for research on reasoning by LLMs, and identifies several methodological pitfalls in current AI research on reasoning, including the inability to verify the novelty of findings due to opaque and non-searchable training data, the lack of reproducibility caused by continuous model updates, and the omission of human-interaction transcripts, which obscures the true source of scientific discovery.

2601.05787.tldr: This work proposes BEPA (Bi-Level Expert-to-Policy Assimilation), which turns static expert traces into policy-aligned guidance via self-rolled reachable trajectories under the base policy and a per-task, dynamically updated cache used in RLVR (LEVEL-2).

2601.08679.tldr: Experiments on objective and personalized benchmarks show that PersonaDual preserves the benefits of personalization while reducing interference, achieving near interference-free performance and better leveraging helpful personalized signals to improve objective problem-solving.

2601.09625.tldr: This paper argues that prompt injections evolved into promptware, a new class of malware execution mechanism triggered through prompts engineered to exploit an application's LLM, and introduces a seven-stage promptware kill chain.

2602.01047.tldr: It is demonstrated that ResDec effectively suppresses hallucinations induced by language priors, significantly improves visual grounding, and reduces object hallucinations, and performs exceptionally well on comprehensive LVLM benchmarks, highlighting its broad applicability.

2602.02320.tldr: This work proposes a fully automated annotation framework for generating precise molecular structure descriptions at scale and builds upon and extends a rule-based chemical nomenclature parser to interpret IUPAC names and construct enriched, structured XML metadata that explicitly encodes molecular structure.

2602.02335.tldr: Bauplan is a code-first lakehouse that aims to eliminate a broad class of failures by construction, and adds three pipeline-level correctness mechanisms: typed table contracts to make transformation boundaries checkable, Git-like data versioning to support reproducible collaboration and review, and transactional runs that guarantee atomic publication of an entire pipeline execution.

2602.02599.tldr: This work proposes RoPE-Aligned Pruning (RAP), which prunes entire RoPE-aligned column pairs to preserve RoPE's 2x2 rotation structure, restore B absorption, and eliminate reconstruction in large language models.

2602.03067.tldr: An IO-aware EOT solver for squared Euclidean cost that rewrites stabilized log-domain Sinkhorn updates as row-wise LogSumExp reductions of biased dot-product scores, the same normalization as transformer attention is presented, enabling FlashAttention-style fusion and tiling.

2602.03913.tldr: An Entropy-Aware Structural Alignment Network is proposed that bridges the visual-semantic gap through information-theoretic modeling and establishes new state-of-the-art performance in HCCR, significantly outperforming existing CLIP-based baselines in the challenging zero-shot setting.

2602.06566.tldr: SPARC (Separating Perception And Reasoning Circuits) is introduced, a modular framework that explicitly decouples visual perception from reasoning and outperforms monolithic baselines and strong visual-grounding approaches.

2602.07193.tldr: This work contributes the first framework for designing psychologically safe AI companion discontinuation, and develops four design principles and artifacts demonstrating how platforms might provide closure and orient users toward human connection.

2602.08023.tldr: CyberExplorer enables fine-grained evaluation beyond flag recovery, capturing interaction dynamics, coordination behavior, failure modes, and vulnerability discovery signals-bridging the gap between benchmarks and realistic multi-target attack scenarios.

2602.08533.tldr: A novel long-horizon RL framework integrating online personalization with Adaptive Tree-based Group Relative Policy Optimization (AT-GRPO), which reduces rollout budgets from exponential to polynomial in the dialogue length, while preserving long-term reward capture.

2602.09007.tldr: GEBench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating dynamic interaction and temporal coherence in GUI generation and GE-Score is proposed, a novel five-dimensional metric that assesses Goal Achievement, Interaction Logic, Content Consistency, UI Plausibility, and Visual Quality.

2602.09717.tldr: This paper constructs spiking variants of ShuffleNet, SqueezeNet, MnasNet, and MixNet, and evaluates them on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet, measuring accuracy, F1-score, parameter count, computational complexity, and energy consumption.

2602.09726.tldr: This paper proposes a new PPO variant based on the stability guarantee from conservative on-policy iteration with a more efficient off-policy data utilization that demonstrates an improved performance of ExO-PPO with balanced sample efficiency and stability on varied tasks in the empirical experiments.

2602.09761.tldr: This work addresses the problem of training a Reinforcement Learning agent to follow multiple temporally-extended instructions expressed in Linear Temporal Logic in sub-symbolic environments by jointly training a multi-task policy and a symbol grounder with the same experience.

2602.09781.tldr: The results highlight that diffusion models can be made more transparent and trustworthy through faithfulness-based explanations, contributing to safer and more interpretable applications of generative AI in healthcare.

2602.09782.tldr: This paper proposes reshaping entropy control in RL from the perspective of Gradient-Preserving Clipping, and introduces a novel regulation mechanism using dynamic clipping threshold to precisely manage entropy.

2602.09794.tldr: GHS-TDA achieves self-adaptive convergence, produces high-confidence and interpretable reasoning paths, and consistently outperforms strong baselines in terms of both accuracy and robustness across multiple reasoning benchmarks.

2602.09798.tldr: This paper extends the SPP approach to the temporal planning with Intermediate Conditions and Effects (ICEs) fragment, where actions are durative and have conditions/effects which can be checked/applied at any time during an action's execution, and one can specify plan's conditions/effects that must be checked/applied at specific times during the plan execution.

2602.09802.tldr: This work presents models with choice dilemmas and analyzes their responses using multinomial logit models to derive implied willingness to pay (WTP) estimates, and shows that while meaningful WTP values can be derived for larger LLMs, they also display systematic deviations at the attribute level.

2602.09805.tldr: A trace-optional framework that decomposes token efficiency into interpretable factors: completion under a fixed token budget, conditional correctness given completion, and verbosity (token usage), which reveals distinct bottleneck profiles that suggest different efficiency interventions.

2602.09813.tldr: This work introduces a hierarchical Markov Decision Process (MDP) framework for environment design that features a teacher agent that leverages student policy representations derived from discovered evaluation environments, enabling it to generate training environments based on the student's capabilities.

2602.09841.tldr: Results confirm that the proposed hybrid approach enhances fairness and robustness as well as establishes a concrete accountability framework for autonomous SLA assurance in multivendor 6G networks.

2602.09856.tldr: This work proposes Code2World, a vision-language coder that simulates the next visual state via renderable code generation that significantly enhances downstream navigation success rates in a flexible manner and achieves the top-performing next UI prediction, rivaling the competitive GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro-Image.

2602.09893.tldr: This work pioneer the development of data-driven codecs explicitly trained on tactile data, TaCo-LL (lossless) and TaCo-L (lossy), and results have validated the superior performance of the TaCo-LL and TaCo-L.

2602.09902.tldr: This work proposes a game between an LLM provider with two models (standard and reasoning) and a user who can re-prompt or abandon tasks if the routed model cannot solve them, and reveals a misalignment gap between the provider-optimal and user-preferred routes when the user's and provider's rankings of the models with respect to utility and cost differ.

2602.09907.tldr: An eight-week longitudinal study with 15 undergraduates who used AI to support assigned readings in a course revealed an intention-behavior gap, and design implications for AI reading systems that scaffold sustained cognitive engagement are discussed.

2602.09918.tldr: This work introduces a shape and appearance-aware 3D reconstruction system (named SARS by us), a c modular pipeline that extracts body and face information from a single image to properly rebuild the 3D model of the human full body.

2602.09924.tldr: It is demonstrated that routing queries across a pool of models can exceed the best-performing model whilst reducing inference cost by up to 70\% on MATH, showing that internal representations enable practical efficiency gains even when they diverge from human intuitions about difficulty.

2602.09933.tldr: A registration-aware matcher based on unbalanced optimal transport (UOT) that accommodates unequal lesion mass and adapts priors to patient-level tumor-load changes and achieves consistently higher edge-detection precision and recall, improved lesion-state recall, and superior lesion-graph component F1 scores versus distance-only baselines is proposed.

2602.09940.tldr: The results demonstrate that fine-grained instruction-to-action parsing, coupled with DATRN-based trajectory generation and vision-guided grounding, provides a practical path to deterministic, real-time manipulation in resource-constrained, single-camera settings.

2602.09945.tldr: Differential Reasoning Learning (DRL), a framework that improves clinical agents by learning from reasoning discrepancies, is proposed and results suggest that DRL supports more reliable clinical decision-making in complex reasoning scenarios and offers a practical mechanism for deployment under limited token budgets.

2602.09949.tldr: This work introduces a Hybrid Attention-Convolution (HAC) architecture that combines Transformers to capture global vessel topology prior with a CNN that learns a residual refinement map to precisely recover thin-vessel details and successfully suppresses false positives from mucosal folds that dynamically appear and vanish as the bladder fills and empties during surgery.

2602.09963.tldr: This work embedded Fick's second law into PINN as loss with 10,000 Latin-hypercube collocation points and utilized previously published experimental datasets to assess drug release performance through mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE), considering noisy conditions and limited-data scenarios.

2602.09980.tldr: A Topology-Aware PINN (TAPINN) that aims to mitigate the challenge of spectral bias by structuring the latent space via Supervised Metric Regularization, and achieves stable convergence with 2.18x lower gradient variance than a multi-output Sobolev Error baseline, and 5x fewer parameters than a hypernetwork-based alternative.

2602.09983.tldr: A framework for semantic decomposition using coupled inference in diffusion models is introduced and it is demonstrated that this coupled inference framework outperforms resonator networks across a range of synthetic semantic decomposition tasks.

2602.09985.tldr: A JEPA-based self-supervised prediction task is constructed, allowing training without anomaly labels and the creation of rich object embeddings, which serve as input for established anomaly detection methods, in order to identify anomalies within object state representations.

2602.09988.tldr: It is found that while small KANs are competitive on univariate polynomial residuals (Duffing), they exhibit severe hyperparameter fragility, instability in deeper configurations, and consistent failure on multiplicative terms (Van der Pol), generally outperformed by standard MLPs.

2602.09992.tldr: These findings challenge the claim that innate syntax is the only possible route to generalization, while suggesting that human-like data efficiency requires inductive biases beyond those tested here.

2602.10004.tldr: ESTAR is introduced, which detects and reduces such reasoning redundancy to improve efficiency without sacrificing accuracy, and highlights early stopping as a simple yet powerful mechanism for improving reasoning efficiency in LRMs.

2602.10007.tldr: The Multi-Agent Safety Shield (MASS), designed using Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) to enable safe and collaborative lane changes, and is extended by integrating MASS to ensure safety and defining a customised reward function to prioritise efficiency improvements.

2602.10009.tldr: This paper synthesizes programs that operate on simulation logs and map them to a series of high level activated patterns, which enables LMs to generate effective reward programs from goals specified in natural language, which may be used within the context of planning or supervised learning.

2602.10019.tldr: ADORA dynamically adjusts the advantage function's weighting by adaptively categorizing training data into temporarily advantageous and disadvantageous samples, based on their evolving utility during online model rollouts, enabling the policy to prioritize learning from more informative experiences and thereby achieve more efficient policy updates.

2602.10021.tldr: This paper proposes DRIFT, a novel dual-model architecture designed to explicitly decouple knowledge extraction from the reasoning process, and provides a scalable and efficient paradigm for extending the effective context window and reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

2602.10044.tldr: Optimistic World Models are introduced, a principled and scalable framework for optimistic exploration that brings classical reward-biased maximum likelihood estimation (RBMLE) from adaptive control into deep RL.

2602.10063.tldr: The proposed Chain of Mindset (CoM), a training-free agentic framework that enables step-level adaptive mindset orchestration, decomposes reasoning into four functionally heterogeneous mindsets: Spatial, Convergent, Divergent, and Algorithmic.

2602.10095.tldr: Separable Causal Diffusion (SCD) is introduced, a new architecture that explicitly decouples once-per-frame temporal reasoning, via a causal transformer encoder, from multi-step frame-wise rendering, via a lightweight diffusion decoder.

2602.10097.tldr: Experiments on looped GPT-style models and algorithmic reasoning tasks show that SDI scales excellently, matches full-gradient baselines with low error and supports a broad range of data attribution and interpretability tasks with per-step insights into the latent reasoning process.

2602.10104.tldr: Olaf-World is presented, a pipeline that pretrains action-conditioned video world models from large-scale passive video and learns a more structured latent action space, leading to stronger zero-shot action transfer and more data-efficient adaptation to new control interfaces than state-of-the-art baselines.

2305.00046.tldr: The proposed end-to-end deep learning-based framework can effectively segment lungs, and detect and classify lung nodules, specifically in low-resource settings with limited access to radiologists, and outperforms existing studies regarding all the respective evaluation metrics.

2305.05311.tldr: This article designs a transition system that processes the input text in a left-to-right pass, incrementally generating the graph structure containing all identified opinions, and resorts to a Pointer Network architecture as a backbone to effectively implement its final transition-based model.

2310.11409.tldr: H hackingBuddyGPT is introduced, a fully automated LLM-driven prototype designed for evaluating autonomous Linux privilege-escalation capabilities, and cost analysis indicates that GPT-4-Turbo can achieve human-comparable performance at competitive costs per exploited vulnerability, especially with optimized context management.

2405.20880.tldr: It is found that, quite generally, abstaining from payments is not robust to strategic deviations by users of learning agents: self-interested players benefit from having their agents make payments to other learners.

2406.01552.tldr: This paper develops universally expressive equivariant machine learning architectures on tensors that exploit that, in many cases, these tensor functions are equivariant with respect to the diagonal action of the orthogonal, Lorentz, and/or symplectic groups.

2406.12326.tldr: CL4D, a contrastive learning framework tailored to strengthen the representation capabilities of decoder-only models, is proposed and it is revealed that CL4D substantially improves the semantic alignment of code representations by reducing the distance between semantically similar code snippets.

2406.14986.tldr: This work rephrase MCQs as text-completion scenarios with a determined set of outcomes and compares the model's next-token probability assignments to the true likelihood of the outcomes, finding that models exhibit solid performance in their explicit probabilistic reasoning.

2408.01253.tldr: A meta Bayes-Adaptive MDP (meta-BAMDP) framework to handle metareasoning in environments with unknown reward/transition distributions, which encompasses a far larger and more realistic set of planning problems that humans and AI systems face.

2408.06717.tldr: DesiGNN is proposed, a knowledge-centered framework that systematically converts past model design experience into structured, fine-grained knowledge priors well-suited for meta-learning with LLMs, and can deliver top-5.77% initial model proposals for unseen datasets within seconds and achieve consistently superior performance with minimal search cost compared to baselines.

2408.10831.tldr: This work generates a fully synthetic dataset using a 3D photorealistic simulator and demonstrates that it can eliminate such needs for detecting and estimating 2D poses of wild zebras by enabling the training of both tasks using the same synthetic dataset.

2410.03847.tldr: A novel method is proposed which infuses the dynamics information into the reward shaping with the theoretical guarantee for the induced optimal policy in the stochastic environments, and presents a novel Model-Enhanced AIRL framework, which integrates transition model estimation directly into reward shaping.

2410.18970.tldr: This work introduces BEE (Bridging Explainability and Embeddings), a framework that shifts the focus from model predictions to the weight space, and to the embedding geometry underlying decisions, enabling principled dataset auditing and more trustworthy foundation models.

2411.01076.tldr: This work reveals a new side-channel whereby input-dependent patterns of correct and incorrect speculations can be inferred by monitoring per-iteration token counts or packet sizes, and proposes and evaluates a suite of mitigations, including packet padding and iteration-wise token aggregation.

2501.13365.tldr: The Symmetrization Weighted Binary Cross-Entropy (SWBCE) loss is introduced, a perception-inspired formulation that extends the conventional WBCE by incorporating prediction-guided symmetry, and offers a generalizable optimization principle for soft computing and neural learning systems.

2502.10303.tldr: The significance of reinforcement learning applications in Atari and strategy-based games is reviewed, and advancements in the field of gaming are discussed, including MiniZero and multi-agent models, highlighting future directions and emerging AI models from Google DeepMind.

2502.14121.tldr: This chapter proposes MOBONS, a novel Bayesian optimization-inspired algorithm that can efficiently optimize general function networks, including those with cyclic dependencies, enabling the modeling of feedback loops, recycle streams, and multi-scale simulations - features that existing methods fail to capture.

2503.00038.tldr: A novel attack framework that exploits AdVersArial meTAphoR (AVATAR) to induce the LLM to calibrate malicious metaphors for jailbreaking and demonstrates that AVATAR can effectively and transferable jailbreak LLMs and achieve a state-of-the-art attack success rate across multiple advanced LLMs.

2503.05188.tldr: This work proposes CRISP (Clustered Reward Integration with Stepwise Prefixing), a novel inference-time algorithm that clusters generated reasoning paths by final answers, aggregates reward signals at the cluster level, and adaptively updates prefix prompts to guide generation.

2503.06790.tldr: A one-step diffusion model for generative detail restoration, GenDR, distilled from a tailored diffusion model with a larger latent space is presented, and CiD is extended with adversarial learning and representation alignment (CiDA) to enhance perceptual quality and accelerate training.

2503.10186.tldr: This paper studies Q-learning dynamics in network polymatrix normal-form games where the network structure is drawn from classical random graph models and investigates how this condition depends on the exploration rates, payoff matrices and, crucially, the probabilities of interaction between network agents.

2503.13553.tldr: This work explores the potential of combining MARL with Large Language Model-mediated interventions to guide agents toward more desirable behaviours, and indicates that agents particularly benefit from early interventions, leading to more efficient training and higher performance.

2503.16858.tldr: These tasks target the model's ability to capture temporal dependencies, extract key insights from textual context, and integrate cross-modal information, and target the state-of-the-art LLMs on MTbench, analyzing their effectiveness in modeling the complex relationships between news narratives and temporal patterns.

2503.19339.tldr: This paper presents a compact and efficient approach to detect botnet attacks by employing an integrated approach that consists of traffic pattern analysis, temporal support learning, and focused feature extraction that achieves 99% classification accuracy in detecting botnet attacks utilizing the N-BaIoT dataset.

2503.23270.tldr: This paper introduces a learning-based approach for terrain dynamics modeling and manipulation, leveraging the Graph-based Neural Dynamics (GBND) framework to represent terrain deformation as motion of a graph of particles.

2504.11524.tldr: This work introduces HypoBench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs and hypothesis generation methods across multiple aspects, including practical utility, generalizability, and hypothesis discovery rate, and suggests that existing methods are capable of discovering valid and novel patterns in the data.

2505.09651.tldr: A comprehensive review of geospatial representation learning across both technological eras is presented, organizing them into a structured taxonomy based on the complete pipeline comprising: (1) data perspective, (2) methodological perspective, and (3) application perspective.

2505.11578.tldr: Results show that the hybrid Mamba-Transformer model achieves good performance in generating spatiotemporal fields, while the physics-informed fine-tuning mechanism further reduces significant physical errors effectively.

2505.11739.tldr: ZeroTuning is introduced, a training-free method that improves LLM performance by applying head-specific attention adjustments to the initial token, requiring no parameter updates, and works out of the box with quantized inference and maintains its improvements as context length increases.

2505.11924.tldr: Evaluating six open-source LLMs, the results demonstrate that prompt-induced representation shifts in text detoxification and text toxification consistently align with latent directions constructed from contrastive pairs and suggest that representation steering is the mechanistic driver of intrinsic self-correction.

2505.16415.tldr: A novel Jensen-Shannon Divergence driven method to Attribute Response to Context (ARC-JSD) is introduced, enabling efficient and accurate identification of essential context sentences without additional fine-tuning, gradient-calculation or surrogate modelling.

2505.17512.tldr: CK-Arena is a dynamic benchmark for conceptual knowledge evaluation based on a multi agent social deduction game, namely the Undercover game, where LLM based agents are assigned subtly different concept words and must describe, distinguish, and infer conceptual properties from others'statements.

2505.20948.tldr: CtrlHGen, a Controllable logcial Hypothesis Generation framework for abductive reasoning over knowledge graphs, trained in a two-stage paradigm including supervised learning and subsequent reinforcement learning is proposed, enabling the model to learn complex logical structures by leveraging semantic patterns in simpler components.

2505.23798.tldr: A systematic discovery of gender and race bias in state-of-the-art VLMs is conducted, focusing not only on surface-level responses but also on the internal probability distributions and hidden state dynamics, which provides a new lens for understanding how multi-modal models store and process sensitive social information.

2505.24069.tldr: DSR-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating structural reasoning in large language models, is introduced, spanning 20 data structures, 35 operations, and 4,140 problem instances and features hierarchical task organization, fully automated generation and evaluation, and fine-grained diagnostics.

2505.24544.tldr: Budget EAGLE (Beagle) is presented, the first, to the authors' knowledge, cross-attention-based Transformer decoder SD model that achieves performance on par with leading self-attention SD models (EAGLE-v2) while eliminating the need for pooling or auxiliary components, simplifying the architecture, improving training efficiency, and maintaining stable memory usage during training-time simulation.

2506.00131.tldr: DT-CORL (Delay-Transformer belief policy Constrained Offline RL), an offline-RL framework built to cope with delayed dynamics at deployment, consistently outperforms both history-augmentation and vanilla belief-based methods, narrowing the sim-to-real latency gap while preserving data efficiency.

2506.03083.tldr: The `No-Data Algorithm' is introduced, which provably establishes trust in an evaluator without requiring any labelled data, and enables scientifically-grounded evaluator trust in low-data domains, addressing a critical bottleneck for scalable, trustworthy LLM deployment.

2506.10054.tldr: Uni-DPO is proposed, a unified dynamic preference optimization framework that jointly considers the inherent quality of preference pairs and the model's evolving performance during training and enables more effective use of preference data and achieves superior performance.

2506.11214.tldr: This paper establishes first-order oracle complexity results for finding approximate stochastic stationary points under heavy-tailed noise and weakly average smoothness conditions -- both of which are weaker than the commonly used bounded variance and mean-squared smoothness assumptions.

2506.17667.tldr: PhysUniBench is presented, a large-scale multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate and improve the reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) specifically on undergraduate-level physics problems, and highlights that current MLLMs struggle with advanced physics reasoning, especially on multi-step problems and those requiring precise diagram interpretation.

2507.06109.tldr: This work proposes a new initialization method called plane scaffold assembly to generate consistent 3D points on these structures, followed by a stable pruning strategy to enhance geometry and optimization stability, and presents geometric and photometric corrections to resolve inconsistencies from motion drift and auto-exposure in mobile devices.

2507.06968.tldr: A systematic instruction data construction framework is proposed, which integrates a hierarchical tagging system, an informative seed selection algorithm, an evolutionary data synthesis process, and a model deficiency diagnosis with targeted data generation to continuously enhance the coverage and depth of instruction data.

2507.10136.tldr: A dynamic Probabilistic Boolean Network model is constructed using transcriptomic data from patient tumor biopsies to elucidate the regulatory logic governing therapy response and employed a reinforcement learning agent to systematically discover optimal, multi-step therapeutic interventions and used explainable artificial intelligence to mechanistically interpret the agent's control policy.

2507.10775.tldr: A new dataset of nearly 64k annotated spacecraft images that was created using real spacecraft models, superimposed on a mixture of real and synthetic backgrounds generated using NASA's TTALOS pipeline to mimic real-world image segmentation challenges for real-time onboard applications in space on NASA's inspector spacecraft is presented.

2508.09210.tldr: The largest emotional intelligence benchmark for MLLMs, MME-Emotion contains over 6,000 curated video clips with task-specific questioning-answering (QA) pairs, spanning broad scenarios to formulate eight emotional tasks, and incorporates a holistic evaluation suite with hybrid metrics for emotion recognition and reasoning.

2509.04345.tldr: AUDETER (AUdio DEepfake TEst Range) is introduced, a large-scale and highly diverse deepfake audio dataset comprising over 4,500 hours of synthetic audio generated by 11 recent TTS models and 10 vocoders, totalling 3 million clips, and an effective curriculum-learning-based approach to mitigate this effect.

2509.07430.tldr: It is argued that standard RLVR objectives -- both those using the mode-seeking reverse KL-divergence and those forgoing a divergence term entirely -- lack a crucial mechanism for knowledge retention, and proposes a fundamental shift in perspective: using the divergence term itself as the solution.

2509.09679.tldr: This work proposes ButterflyQuant, which replaces Hadamard rotations with learnable butterfly transforms parameterized by continuous Givens rotation angles, and introduces a uniformity regularization on post-transformation activations to promote smoother distributions amenable to quantization.

2509.09893.tldr: This study proposes Self-Augmented Robot Trajectory (SART), a framework that enables policy learning from a single human demonstration, while safely expanding the dataset through autonomous augmentation, and achieves substantially higher success rates than policies trained solely on human-collected demonstrations.

2509.10414.tldr: A large-scale analysis of ICL's ad-hoc encoding concludes that autoregression's ad-hoc encoding is not a robust mechanism for learning, and suggests limited all-purpose generalisability.

2509.14671.tldr: The proposed TableDART is a training-efficient framework that integrates multimodal views by reusing pretrained single-modality models, and proposes a novel agent to mediate cross-modal knowledge integration by analyzing outputs from text- and image-based models, either selecting the best result or synthesizing a new answer through reasoning.

2509.17143.tldr: The model can leverage continuous or quantized linguistic features to enhance intelligibility and speaker similarity, and can use or omit pitch contour to control prosody, allowing users to seamlessly balance speaker identity, linguistic content, and prosodic factors in a zero-shot VC setting.

2509.18046.tldr: HuMam is presented, a state-centric end-to-end RL framework that employs a single-layer Mamba encoder to fuse robot-centric states with oriented footstep targets and a continuous phase clock to improve learning efficiency, training stability, and overall task performance over a strong feedforward baseline.

2509.21124.tldr: This paper abstracts atomic reasoning patterns from CoT sequences, characterized by commonality and inductive capabilities, and uses them to construct a core reference set enriched with valuable reasoning patterns, and proposes a dual-granularity algorithm involving chains of reasoning patterns and token entropy.

2509.22291.tldr: The findings show that input-based explanations can effectively detect biased predictions and serve as useful supervision for reducing bias during training, but they are unreliable for selecting fair models among candidates.

2509.23049.tldr: A density ratio model and empirical likelihood-based framework is introduced that simultaneously addresses two goals: learning effective local models on each client, and finding the best matching client for a new query.

2509.23050.tldr: This work presents the first systematic analysis of language prior through the lens of chain-of-embedding, which examines the layer-wise representation dynamics within LVLMs and demonstrates that VIP consistently emerges, and that TVI reliably predicts the strength of language prior.

2509.24384.tldr: An improved harmfulness judge is designed that explicitly incorporates fine-grained harmfulness criteria in its prompt template and leverages reference-based metrics for lightweight fine-tuning of its base LLM, achieving state-of-the-art evaluation effectiveness on HarmMetric Eval.

2509.24716.tldr: This work proposes a training framework for discrete VAEs that leverages the natural gradient of a non-parametric encoder to update the parametric encoder without requiring reparameterization, and outperforms both approximate reparameterization methods and quantization-based discrete autoencoders in reconstructing high-dimensional data from compact latent spaces.

2509.25112.tldr: The Heatwave Discovery Agent HeDA is introduced as an autonomous scientific synthesis framework designed to bridge cognitive gaps by constructing a high fidelity knowledge graph from 8,111 academic publications and exhibits enhanced inferential fidelity in capturing long tail risk mechanisms.

2509.25170.tldr: GLASS Flows is introduced, a new sampling paradigm that simulates a flow matching model within a flow matching model to sample Markov transitions, and is combined with Feynman-Kac Steering to improve state-of-the-art performance in text-to-image generation.

2509.26433.tldr: The Agentic Classification Tree (ACT) is presented, which extends decision-tree methodology to unstructured inputs by formulating each split as a natural-language question, refined through impurity-based evaluation and LLM feedback via TextGrad.

2510.01304.tldr: Experimental results show that AGILE not only substantially boosts performance on jigsaw tasks of varying complexity but also demonstrates strong generalization across 9 general vision tasks, achieving an average improvement of 3.1%.

2510.08193.tldr: The AI Pluralism Index (AIPI) is presented, a transparent, evidence-based instrument that evaluates producers and system families across four pillars: participatory governance, inclusivity and diversity, transparency, and accountability.

2510.09655.tldr: This work proposes a system for marking sensitive or copyrighted texts to detect their use in fine-tuning large language models under black-box access with statistical guarantees and achieves high detection power even when marked data is a small fraction of the fine-tuning corpus.

2510.11462.tldr: Deductive and abductive reasoning are two critical paradigms for analyzing knowledge graphs, enabling applications from financial query answering to scientific discovery, and this work introduces a self-reflective denoising process that iteratively generates and validates candidate hypotheses against the observed conclusion.

2510.20280.tldr: This work proposes ContextLM, a framework that implicitly learns multi-token prediction by augmenting standard pretraining with an intrinsic next-context prediction objective, exhibiting superior efficiency in parameters, training tokens, and FLOPs.

2510.24303.tldr: It is observed that combining evidence from agents can improve forecasting accuracy, especially in the case of three agents, while providing an explainable combination of evidence for claim verification.

2511.00494.tldr: A dataset that combines high-resolution 3D LiDAR scans with Wi-Fi RSSI measurements collected across 20 setups in a multi-room indoor environment is collected, enabling the development and validation of REM estimation models that incorporate physical geometry and environmental dynamics.

2511.00609.tldr: A reasoning-based personalized image preference assessment framework that follows a \textit{predict-then-assess} paradigm, which predicts a user's preference profile from reference images, and then provides interpretable, multi-dimensional scores and assessments of candidate images based on the predicted profile.

2511.07277.tldr: Tensions around linguistic and cultural misunderstandings, privacy concerns, and opportunities and risks for AI to augment care workflows are identified, contributing AI design considerations that support LEP patients and care teams via rapport-building, educational and language support, and minimizing disruptions to existing practices.

2511.10222.tldr: SALMONN-Guard, the first guard model that jointly inspects speech, audio, and text for safety judgments, is proposed, reducing the attack success rate to 20% and highlighting the need for audio-aware defenses to ensure the safety of multimodal LLMs.
