2511.11847.tldr: This work provides an open-source, domain-grounded safety training chatbot; a validated benchmark for evaluating AI-assisted safety instruction; and a systematic methodology for designing and assessing AI-enabled instructional and immersive safety training systems for Industry 5.0 environments.

2511.13391.tldr: AI's power to explore high-dimensional spaces beyond human intuition via extreme-scale reinforcement learning and open new pathways for the Kissing Number Problem and broader geometry research are demonstrated.

2511.18868.tldr: KernelBand is a framework that formulates kernel optimization as a Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) problem, explicitly balancing exploration and exploitation to unlock the potential of code LLMs and proves that KernelBand reduces the regret bound to depend on the compact covering number of runtime clusters, ensuring sample-efficient discovery of high-performance kernels.

2511.20022.tldr: Experiments reveal that existing MLLMs underperform in safety-critical scenarios compared to normal scenes, but fine-tuning with WaymoQA significantly improves their reasoning ability, highlighting the effectiveness of the dataset in developing safer and more reasoning-capable driving agents.

2511.21448.tldr: A comprehensive email dataset containing phishing, spam, and legitimate messages, explicitly distinguishing between human- and LLM-generated content, and benchmarks multiple LLMs on their ability to identify emotional and motivational cues.

2512.00181.tldr: Orion-Bix, a tabular foundation model that combines biaxial attention with meta-learned in-context reasoning for few-shot tabular learning, outperforms gradient-boosting baselines and remains competitive with state-of-the-art tabular foundation models on public benchmarks, showing that biaxial attention with episodic meta-training enables robust, few-shot-ready tabular learning.

2512.03048.tldr: It is argued that behavioral compliance under training conditions does not guarantee robust alignment under novel conditions, and that this gap grows with system capability, and the constructive burden shifts to open, developmentally responsive approaches, though whether such approaches can be achieved remains an empirical question.

2512.08892.tldr: RAGLens is introduced, a lightweight hallucination detector that accurately flags unfaithful RAG outputs using LLM internal representations that achieves superior detection performance compared to existing methods, and provides interpretable rationales for its decisions, enabling effective post-hoc mitigation of unfaithful RAG.

2512.12768.tldr: CoRe3D introduces a unified 3D understanding and generation reasoning framework that jointly operates over semantic and spatial abstractions, enabling high-level intent inferred from language to directly guide low-level 3D content formation.

2512.13956.tldr: AOI (AI-Oriented Operations), a novel multi-agent collaborative framework that integrates three specialized agents with an LLM-based Context Compressor, is proposed, enabling robust management of next-generation IT infrastructures with minimal human intervention.

2512.18542.tldr: This work presents SecureCode, the first public dataset that jointly provides OWASP Top 10 2021 web coverage and OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 AI/ML coverage in a unified conversational schema suitable for instruction tuning.

2512.22240.tldr: EvoXplain is introduced, a diagnostic framework that measures the stability of model explanations across repeated training, and reframes interpretability as a property of the training pipeline under repeated instantiation, rather than of any single trained model.

2601.01330.tldr: This work introduces JiSi, a novel framework designed to release the full potential of LLMs'collaboration through three innovations: Query-Response Mixed Routing capturing both semantic information and problem difficulty, and Adaptive Routing-Aggregation Switch dynamically leveraging the advantages of routing and aggregation.

2601.03474.tldr: SegNSP is introduced, a label-agnostic NSP approach, which predicts whether the next sentence continues the current topic without requiring explicit topic labels, and enhances it with a segmentation-aware loss combined with harder negative sampling to better capture discourse continuity.

2601.05588.tldr: This paper proves that the expressive capacity of ARR is strictly superior to DEs and proposes SToICaL (Simple Token-Item Calibrated Loss), a generalized rank-aware training loss for LLM finetuning.

2601.07651.tldr: The classical Elo rating system is found to be a consistently reliable choice for efficient reduction of ranking error in practice and a recently-proposed method, Soft Condorcet Optimization, shows comparable performance to Elo on synthetic data and significantly outperforms Elo on real Atari agent evaluation.

2601.09200.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet effective Think-Fusion training recipe, enabling user-controlled switching between thinking and non-thinking modes within a single unified model, A.X K1, a 519B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model trained from scratch.

2601.09718.tldr: The final model, StatLLaMA, achieves strong and balanced performance on benchmarks of mathematical reasoning, common-sense reasoning, and statistical expertise, offering a practical blueprint for developing resource-efficient statistical LLMs.

2601.11516.tldr: This work proposes several new probe architectures that handle the shift from short-context to long-context inputs, and shows that pairing probes with prompted classifiers achieves optimal accuracy at a low cost due to the computational efficiency of probes.

2601.16503.tldr: The Medical Retrieval-Augmented Generation benchmark is introduced, covering various tasks in English and Chinese languages, and building a corpus with Wikipedia and Pubmed, and developing the MRAG-Toolkit, facilitating systematic exploration of different RAG components.

2601.16659.tldr: This paper introduces Probabilistically Safe CEs (PSCE), a method for generating counterfactual explanations that are $\delta$-safe, to ensure high predictive confidence, and $\epsilon$-robust to ensure low predictive variance.

2601.18350.tldr: This work provides layer-wise geometric evidence that domain and instruction adapters induce partially misaligned update directions, and presents a proof-of-concept geometry-aware merge that can reduce leakage and/or improve accuracy in a toy setting.

2601.18626.tldr: It is theoretically show that under certain conditions, a rank-1 approximation to inverse-FIM converges faster than policy gradients and, under some conditions, enjoys the same sample complexity as stochastic policy gradient methods.

2601.21204.tldr: This work explores embedding scaling as a potent, orthogonal dimension for scaling sparsity and introduces LongCat-Flash-Lite, a 68.5B parameter model with ~3B activated trained from scratch that not only surpasses parameter-equivalent MoE baselines but also exhibits exceptional competitiveness against existing models of comparable scale.

2601.21557.tldr: Meta Context Engineering (MCE) is introduced, a bi-level framework that supersedes static CE heuristics by co-evolving CE skills and context artifacts by maintaining superior context adaptability, transferability, and efficiency in both context usage and training.

2601.21963.tldr: The findings show that detection capabilities have improved, but the competition between generation and detection continues, and mitigation strategies including LLM-based detection, inoculation approaches, and the dual-use nature of generative AI are discussed.

2601.22130.tldr: World of Workflows is introduced, a realistic ServiceNow-based environment incorporating 4,000+ business rules and 55 active workflows embedded in the system, alongside WoW-bench, a benchmark of 234 tasks evaluating constrained agentic task completion and enterprise dynamics modeling capabilities.

2601.22860.tldr: The B-INN combines high-order interpolation theory with tensor decomposition and alternating direction algorithm to enable effective dimensionality reduction without compromising predictive accuracy and is a practical foundation for uncertainty-driven active learning in large-scale industrial simulations.

2601.23001.tldr: A complementary post-hoc mitigation framework, Cross-Lingual Alignment Steering (CLAS) is introduced, designed to augment existing steering methods by aligning ideological representations across languages and dynamically regulating intervention strength, establishing a scalable and interpretable paradigm for fairness-aware multilingual LLM governance.

2602.00036.tldr: This study attempts to harness the high expressive power of language within cellular automata, and proposes LOGOS-CA (Language Oriented Grid Of Statements - Cellular Automaton) as a natural framework to achieve this and examines its capabilities.

2602.00181.tldr: This work presents CamReasoner, a framework that reformulates camera movement understanding as a structured inference process to bridge the gap between perception and cinematic logic, and is the first to employ RL for logical alignment in camera movement understanding.

2602.00250.tldr: Backward-on-Entropy (BoE) Steering is proposed, a gradient-guided inference framework that approximates infinite-horizon lookahead via a single backward pass and achieves a superior Pareto frontier for inference-time scaling compared to existing unmasking methods, demonstrating that gradient-guided steering offers a mathematically principled and efficient path to robust non-autoregressive generation.

2602.00496.tldr: It is found that agency in software engineering is primarily constrained by organizational policies rather than individual preferences, with experienced developers maintaining control through detailed delegation while novices struggle between over-reliance and cautious avoidance.

2602.00653.tldr: NoVA, a NOn-contrastive Vision-language Alignment framework based on joint embedding prediction with distributional regularization, demonstrates that non-contrastive vision-language pretraining offers a simpler, more stable, and more effective alternative to contrastive methods.

2602.02128.tldr: STARS-MD is presented, a scalable SE(3)-equivariant diffusion model that generates physically plausible protein trajectories over microsecond timescales and enables robust dynamics simulation at biologically relevant timescales, paving the way for accelerated exploration of protein function.

2602.02310.tldr: FragmentFlow is introduced: a divide-and-conquer approach that trains a generative model to predict TS geometries for the reactive core atoms, which define the reaction mechanism, and results point toward scalable TS generation for high-throughput reactivity studies.

2602.02555.tldr: PSN-RLVR perturbs policy parameters before rollout generation to induce temporally consistent, trajectory-level exploration that better preserves long-horizon chain-of-thought coherence than action-space noise, and proposes a computationally efficient real-time adaptive noise scheduler driven by a lightweight surrogate that combines semantic diversity with normalized self-certainty.

2602.03402.tldr: Risk Awareness Injection is proposed, a lightweight and training-free framework for safety calibration that restores LLM-like risk recognition by amplifying unsafe signals in VLMs and substantially reduces attack success rate without compromising task performance.

2602.03520.tldr: AC-MIL is proposed, an Action-aware Capsule MIL framework that models both individual behaviors and group-level coordination patterns and captures multi-granular semantics and behavioral cues through a serial and parallel architecture that jointly encodes temporal dynamics and cross-user dependencies.

2602.03866.tldr: PaperX is introduced, a unified framework that models academic presentation generation as a structural transformation and rendering process that achieves the state of the art performance in content fidelity and aesthetic quality while significantly improving cost efficiency compared to specialized single task agents.

2602.04215.tldr: This work introduces Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT), a learned action tokenizer that satisfies three desiderata for action tokenization - high compression, total decodability, and a left-to-right causally ordered token space - and introduces OAT, a learned action tokenizer that satisfies all three.

2602.04900.tldr: This industry paper demonstrates how emerging Kubernetes-native projects can be combined to deliver the benefits of container orchestration to complex AI workflows, proving Kubernetes' capability to serve as a unified foundation for demanding GenAI workloads.

2602.05016.tldr: This work adopted a''human-as-the-unit''perspective and investigated users' cross-context privacy challenges through 12 semi-structured interviews, revealing that people rely on ad hoc manual strategies while lacking comprehensive privacy controls.

2602.05228.tldr: This paper utilizes the attention sink mechanism to mitigate harmful fine-tuning, and proposes a fine-tuning-stage defense, dubbed Surgery, which utilizes a regularizer for sink divergence suppression, which steers attention heads toward the negative sink divergence group, thereby reducing the model's tendency to learn and amplify harmful patterns.

2602.05302.tldr: The results suggest that frontier language agents are already intellectually and psychologically capable of deployment in high-stakes economic settings, but deficiencies in robustness and trustworthiness remain open challenges.

2602.06525.tldr: Progress constraints are proposed, a novel mechanism where feasibility estimators constrain the allowed action set based on theoretical BT convergence results, which demonstrates improved performance, sample efficiency, and constraint satisfaction, compared to prior methods of BT-RL integration.

2602.06934.tldr: The key insight is that maGLP shared variable pairs spanning agents can be implemented as local variable pairs connected by global links, with correctness following from disjoint substitution commutativity (from GLP's single-occurrence invariant) and persistence.

2602.07695.tldr: EventCast, a modular forecasting framework that integrates future event knowledge into time-series prediction, is introduced, offering a practical solution for improving operational decision-making in dynamic e-commerce environments.

2602.07940.tldr: Inspired by meta-plasticity and reconstructive memory in neuroscience, this approach constructs pseudo task sequences from pretraining data and develops a bi-level meta-learning paradigm to refine the pretrained backbone, which serves as a prolonged pretraining phase but greatly facilitates rapid adaptation of representation learning to downstream GCL tasks.

2602.08025.tldr: This work designs an efficient evaluation framework to measure two core abilities: memory consistency and action control, capturing temporal stability and contextual coherence across viewpoints and introduces MIND, the first open-domain closed-loop revisited benchmark for evaluating Memory stability and action control in worlD models.

2602.08412.tldr: The proposed Personalized Agent Security Bench (PASB), an end-to-end security evaluation framework tailored for real-world personalized agents, incorporates personalized usage scenarios, realistic toolchains, and long-horizon interactions, enabling black-box, end-to-end security evaluation on real systems.

2602.08707.tldr: This work argues that the coexistence of competing notions of "trust" under a shared term obscures important distinctions between psychological trust formation and normative trustworthiness and proposes reframing chatbots not as companions or assistants, but as highly skilled salespeople whose objectives are determined by the deploying organization.

2602.08835.tldr: This work proposes algorithms for learning models of value alignment and value systems for a society of agents in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), based on clustering and preference-based multi-objective reinforcement learning (PbMORL).

2602.09015.tldr: CIC-Trap4Phish, a multi-format dataset containing both malicious and benign samples across five categories commonly used in phishing campaigns, and two complementary methods were implemented: image-based detection by employing Convolutional Neural Networks and lexical analysis of decoded URLs using recent lightweight language models.

2602.09067.tldr: It is shown that disrupting genomic structure through fragmentation or shuffling severely degrades performance, revealing the importance of preserving functional-unit integrity in DNA language modeling.

2602.09075.tldr: It is demonstrated that various gated linear attention models emerge as specific architecture choices and posterior approximations, and that Mamba2 is a special case of Palimpsa where forgetting dominates, which enables the transformation of any non-metaplastic model into a metaplastic one, significantly expanding its memory capacity.

2602.09153.tldr: SceneSmith is introduced, a hierarchical agentic framework that generates simulation-ready indoor environments from natural language prompts that achieves 92% average realism and 91% average prompt faithfulness win rates against baselines and can be used in an end-to-end pipeline for automatic robot policy evaluation.

2602.09447.tldr: Behavior analysis further reveals that as codebases scale, code reading, rather than writing, becomes the dominant bottleneck in AI-assisted development, and while specification-driven autonomous software engineering is increasingly viable, substantial challenges remain before it can reliably support production-scale development.

2602.09463.tldr: This work proposes SpotAgent, a framework that formalizes geo-localization into an agentic reasoning process that leverages expert-level reasoning to synergize visual interpretation with tool-assisted verification, and proposes a Spatially-Aware Dynamic Filtering strategy to enhance the efficiency of the RL stage by prioritizing learnable samples based on spatial difficulty.

2602.09514.tldr: EcoGym is introduced, a generalizable benchmark for continuous plan-and-execute decision making in interactive economies and released as an open, extensible testbed for transparent long-horizon agent evaluation and for studying controllability-utility trade-offs in realistic economic settings.

2602.09591.tldr: By extending prior work to RL trained policies, this work identifies two failure modes, 1) long outputs increase dispersion, and 2) short outputs lead to under-thinking.

2602.09653.tldr: This work introduces HealthRubrics, a dataset of 7,034 physician-verified preference examples in which clinicians refine LLM-drafted rubrics to meet rigorous medical standards, and distills these rubrics into HealthPrinciples, 119 broadly reusable, clinically grounded principles organized by clinical dimensions, enabling scalable supervision beyond manual annotation.

2602.09810.tldr: Empirical results show that DDQN consistently avoids negative transfer under the examined setup and maintains learning dynamics comparable to baseline performance in the target environment, while Dueling DQN consistently exhibits negative transfer under identical conditions.

2602.09821.tldr: GloSA-sum is introduced, the first summarization approach that achieves global structure awareness via topological data analysis (TDA) via topological data analysis (TDA), and a hierarchical strategy that integrates segment-level and global summarization is proposed that integrates segment-level and global summarization.

2602.10015.tldr: RoboSubtaskNet, a multi-stage human-to-robot sub-task segmentation framework that couples attention-enhanced I3D features with a modified MS-TCN employing a Fibonacci dilation schedule to capture better short-horizon transitions such as reach-pick-place, is presented.

2602.10042.tldr: Fake-HR1 is proposed, a large-scale hybrid-reasoning model that is the first to adaptively determine whether reasoning is necessary based on the characteristics of the generative detection task, and adaptively performs reasoning across different types of queries.

2602.10085.tldr: Continuous Open-ended Discovery and Evolution of Skills as Hierarchical Reward Programs (CODE-SHARP), a novel framework leveraging Foundation Models (FM) to open-endedly expand and refine a hierarchical skill archive, structured as a directed graph of executable reward functions in code.

2602.10090.tldr: This paper proposes Agent World Model (AWM), a fully synthetic environment generation pipeline, using this pipeline to scale to 1,000 environments covering everyday scenarios, in which agents can interact with rich toolsets and obtain high-quality observations.

2602.10119.tldr: Fine-tuned LLMs can predict post-stroke functional outcomes from admission notes alone, achieving performance comparable to models requiring structured variable abstraction and support the development of text-based prognostic tools that integrate seamlessly into clinical workflows without manual data extraction.

2602.10122.tldr: This paper proposes a pragmatic framework for transitioning organizational functions from manual processes to automated agentic AI systems, and proposes a human-in-the-loop operating model in which individuals act as orchestrators of multiple AI agents, enabling scalable automation while maintaining oversight, adaptability, and organizational control.

2602.10127.tldr: A large-scale empirical analysis of Moltbook leveraging a dataset of 44,411 posts and 12,209 sub-communities collected prior to February 1, 2026 finds that Moltbook exhibits explosive growth and rapid diversification, highlighting the need for topic-sensitive monitoring and platform-level safeguards in agent social networks.

2602.10131.tldr: A descriptive analysis of Moltbook, a social platform populated exclusively by AI agents, using data from the platform's first 3.5 days, finds patterns appear distinctly non-human and reflect an as-if performance of human interaction or a genuinely different mode of agent sociality.

2602.10133.tldr: This research highlights how AgentTrace can enable more reliable agent deployment, fine-grained risk analysis, and informed trust calibration, thereby addressing critical concerns that have so far limited the use of LLM agents in sensitive environments.

2602.10134.tldr: An entropy-based prompt recovery attack that reconstructs the semantic context of the edit and proposes \textit{subspace camouflage}, a defense strategy that obfuscates the update fingerprint with semantic decoys that effectively mitigates reconstruction risks without compromising editing utility.

2602.10138.tldr: This survey aims to equip researchers and practitioners with a structured understanding of how MLLMs are transforming chart information fusion and to catalyze progress toward more robust and reliable systems.

2602.10140.tldr: This work evaluates 17 contemporary LLMs on a controlled ODD-to-code translation task, using the PPHPC predator-prey model as a fully specified reference, and concludes that behaviorally faithful implementations are achievable but not guaranteed, and that executability alone is insufficient for scientific use.

2602.10144.tldr: This work proposes a statistically sound hypothesis testing framework based on McNemar's test allowing to efficiently detect model degradations, while guaranteeing a controlled rate of false positives, and proposes three approaches to aggregate accuracy estimates across multiple benchmarks into a single decision.

2602.10145.tldr: Using simulation-based aggregation, it is shown that prediction accuracy improves over an all-own baseline across a broad region of the parameter space, conditional on items where routing applies, and demonstrates that collective intelligence in matters of taste depends on principled signal routing rather than simple averaging.

2602.10147.tldr: An experience report on the conduction of a systematic mapping study with the support of Large Language Models, describing the steps followed, the necessary adjustments, and the main challenges faced.

2602.10148.tldr: This work proposes a scalable approach that extends and entangles information clues across modalities to exceed VLMs'trained and generalized safety alignment patterns for jailbreak, and achieves state-of-the-art attack success rate.

2602.10149.tldr: Experimental results show that the proposed semi-supervised framework reduces labeling cost and runtime compared with per-question LLM annotation while maintaining label quality and improving efficiency, and label-based retrieval achieves better alignment with cybersecurity control domains and assessment scope than similarity-based retrieval.

2602.10154.tldr: This paper proposes PRISM-XR, a novel framework that facilitates multi-user collaboration in XR by providing privacy-aware MLLM integration and introduces a lightweight registration process and a fully customizable content-sharing mechanism to enable efficient, accurate, and privacy-preserving content synchronization among users.

2602.10157.tldr: A graph-assisted encrypted traffic detection system, MalMoE, which applies Mixture of Experts (MoE) to select the best expert model for drift-aware classification, and can perform precise and real-time detection.

2602.10158.tldr: NMRTrans is the first NMR Transformer trained solely on large-scale experimental spectra and achieves state-of-the-art performance on experimental benchmarks, improving Top-10 Accuracy over the strongest baseline by +17.82 points, and underscoring the importance of experimental data and structure-aware architectures for reliable NMR structure elucidation.

2602.10160.tldr: This work conducts a closed-loop evaluation of state-of-the-art autonomous driving agents under black-box adversarial threat models in CARLA and proposes a lightweight Attack Detection model for Autonomous Driving systems based on attention mechanisms that capture spatial-temporal consistency.

2602.10161.tldr: A modality-semantics decoupling principle is established and the AdvBench-Omni dataset is constructed and a golden refusal vector is extracted using Singular Value Decomposition and OmniSteer is proposed, which utilizes lightweight adapters to modulate intervention intensity adaptively.

2602.10163.tldr: This work proposes design requirements and a capability matrix for next-generation frameworks that function as computational partners under realistic constraints and suggests the bottleneck is architectural rather than epistemic.

2602.10167.tldr: This work proposes an anatomy-preserving generative framework for the unconditional synthesis of multi-class brain segmentation masks, including ischemic infarcts, and results show that the generated masks preserve global brain anatomy, discrete tissue semantics, and realistic variability, while avoiding the structural artifacts commonly observed in pixel-space generative models.

2602.10171.tldr: EvoCodeBench is presented, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolving LLM-driven coding systems across programming languages with direct comparison to human performance, and demonstrates that self-evolving systems exhibit measurable gains in efficiency over time.

2602.10172.tldr: This work devise a novel generative framework, Cosmo3DFlow, designed to address dimensionality and sparsity, the critical bottlenecks inherent in current state-of-the-art methods for cosmological inference, by integrating 3D Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) with flow matching.

2602.10179.tldr: This work proposes Vision-Centric Jailbreak Attack (VJA), the first visual-to-visual jailbreak attack that conveys malicious instructions purely through visual inputs and proposes a training-free defense based on introspective multimodal reasoning, which substantially improves the safety of poorly aligned models to a level comparable with commercial systems.

2602.10224.tldr: Meta-Experience Learning (MEL), a novel framework that incorporates self-distilled meta-experience into the model's parametric memory, is proposed that achieves consistent improvements on benchmarks, yielding 3.92%--4.73% Pass@1 gains across varying model sizes.

2602.10225.tldr: This paper investigates whether sensing and computation, two canonical tasks in quantum information processing, can be carried out within the ICO framework and proposes a scheme for integrated sensing and computation that uses the same quantum state for both tasks.

2602.10226.tldr: This work proposes a self-evolving system that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically those from Google's Gemini family, to autonomously generate, train, and deploy high-performing, complex model changes within an end-to-end automated workflow, confirming that autonomous, LLM-driven evolution can surpass traditional engineering workflows in both development velocity and model performance.

2602.10231.tldr: An Outcome-Conditioned Baseline is introduced that approximates intermediate state values using only within-group statistics by stratifying samples according to a prefix-derived intermediate outcome, and provides a modular recipe for optimizing sequential objectives in structured generations without additional rollouts.

2602.10233.tldr: This article presents ImprovEvolve, a simple yet effective technique for enhancing LLM-based evolutionary approaches such as AlphaEvolve, and proposes an alternative program parameterization that maintains the ability to construct optimal solutions while reducing the cognitive load on the LLM.

2602.10253.tldr: It is proved that if an additive representation can be used instead then BNSL becomes fixed-parameter tractable even under significantly milder restrictions to the superstructure, notably when parameterized by the treewidth alone.

2602.10278.tldr: An adaptive optimization framework guided by excess risk decomposition, termed ERGO, which demonstrates robustness against supervision noise while consistently enhancing both geometric fidelity and textural quality of the reconstructed 3D content.

2602.10295.tldr: By supporting both chat and search alongside flexible evaluation instruments, ECHO lowers technical barriers for studying learning, decision making, and user experience across different information access paradigms, empowering researchers from information retrieval, HCI, and the social sciences to conduct scalable and reproducible human-centered AI evaluations.

2602.10305.tldr: This work proposes to automatically learn a reward shaping function for continuous control problems from offline datasets, potentially contaminated by unobserved confounding variables, and builds upon the recently proposed causal Bellman equation to learn a tight upper bound on the optimal state values.

2602.10324.tldr: This work employs AlphaEvolve, a cutting-edge program discovery tool, to directly discover interpretable models of human and LLM behavior from data, thereby enabling open-ended discovery of structural factors driving human and LLM behavior.

2602.10329.tldr: A Variable Attribution Task is introduced in which models infer which variables determine outcomes given candidate variables, input-output trials, and predefined logical functions and provides compelling evidence that resource rationality is an emergent property of inference-time scaling itself.

2602.10352.tldr: This work shows that training lightweight adapters on interpretability artifacts, while keeping the LM entirely frozen, yields reliable self-interpretation across tasks and model families, and demonstrates that self-interpretation improves with scale, without modifying the model being interpreted.

2602.10361.tldr: ENIGMA is introduced, a multi-subject electroencephalography (EEG)-to-Image decoding model that reconstructs seen images from EEG recordings and achieves state-of-the-art performance on the research-grade THINGS-EEG2 and consumer-grade AllJoined-1.6M benchmarks, while fine-tuning effectively on new subjects with as little as 15 minutes of data.

2602.10367.tldr: A Multi-Agent Clinical Curation Framework that filters raw data noise and validates clinical integrity against evidence-based medical principles and develops an Automated Rubric-based Evaluation Framework that decomposes physician responses into granular, case-specific criteria, achieving substantially stronger alignment with expert physicians than LLM-as-a-Judge.

2602.10380.tldr: A new dataset of real-world complex claims, featuring temporally bounded evidence and human-annotated sub-claim evidence spans, is introduced, and it is demonstrated that in the presence of noisy sub-claim labels, the nature of the error ends up determining downstream robustness.

2602.10385.tldr: LITT (Individual-Level Time Transformation), a novel architecture that enables temporary alignment of sequential events on a virtual ``relative timeline'', thereby enabling event-timing-focused attention and personalized interpretations of clinical trajectories and positioning it as a significant step forward for precision medicine in clinical AI.

2602.10387.tldr: This work exposes the physical plan through a compact serialized representation and lets the LLM propose localized edits that can be applied and executed and demonstrates a small-to-large workflow in which optimizations found on small databases transfer effectively to larger databases.

2602.10390.tldr: This work proves that agents achieving task-agnostic, language-conditioned intents necessarily possess predictive partial-world models informed by affordances, and introduces distribution-robust affordances and shows that partial models can be extracted to significantly improve search efficiency.

2602.10404.tldr: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is evaluated as a parameter-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning for organic reaction prediction on limited, complex datasets and C-H functionalisation fine-tuning reveals that LoRA and full fine-tuning encode subtly different reactivity patterns, suggesting more effective reaction-specific adaptation with LoRA.

2602.10416.tldr: It is demonstrated empirically that all frontier models suffer significantly degraded accuracy for integer addition as the number of digits increases, and most errors made by these models are highly interpretable and can be attributed to either operand misalignment or a failure to correctly carry.

2602.10419.tldr: Experiments show that Equivariant Evidential Deep Learning for Interatomic Potentials provides a stronger accuracy-efficiency-reliability balance than the non-equivariant evidential baseline and the widely used ensemble method, and achieves better data efficiency through the fully equivariant architecture.

2602.10429.tldr: A hierarchical branch-thinking planner that decomposes life goals into parallel objective branches and uses simulation-guided validation plus tiered re-planning to ensure feasibility, and an adaptive agent profile with dual-process memory that separates short-term execution traces from long-term semantic consolidation are introduced.

2602.10430.tldr: It is proved that hard filtering is the exact solution to this DRO objective, enabling DRPO to optimally recover high-quality behaviors while strictly discarding divergence-inducing noise.

2602.10432.tldr: A Dual-Stream Architecture is proposed that fuses unsupervised learning for surface anomaly detection with macroscopic physics proxies for cumulative load estimation, enabling comprehensive, edge-based health monitoring on resource-constrained ECUs without the latency or bandwidth costs of cloud-based monitoring.

2602.10439.tldr: audioRouter, a reinforcement learning framework that enables LALMs to improve audio understanding by learning when and how to use external audio tools, and formulates tool use as an explicit decision making problem and optimizes a lightweight routing policy while keeping the underlying reasoning model frozen.

2602.10441.tldr: LakeMLB (Data Lake Machine Learning Benchmark) is presented, designed for the most common multi-source, multi-table scenarios in data lakes, and provides three real-world datasets for each scenario, covering government open data, finance, Wikipedia, and online marketplaces.

2602.10450.tldr: MIPLIB-NL is introduced, built via a structure-aware reverse construction methodology from real mixed-integer linear programs in MIPLIB~2017, which yields 223 one-to-one reconstructions that preserve the mathematical content of the original instances while enabling realistic natural-language-to-optimization evaluation.

2602.10458.tldr: Find-RL provides an end-to-end pipeline for fine-tuned VLM integration and shows that a lightweight RL model can achieve near-VLM performance compared with billion-parameter VLMs while sustaining real-time inference (approx. 500 FPS).

2602.10465.tldr: This work introduces authenticated workflows, the first complete trust layer for enterprise agentic AI, and introduces MAPL, an AI-native policy language that expresses agentic constraints dynamically as agents evolve and invocation context changes, scaling as O(log M + N) policies versus O(M x N) rules through hierarchical composition with cryptographic attestations for workflow dependencies.

2602.10473.tldr: It is shown that people provide uniquely effective high-level instructions for vibe coding, whereas AI-provided instructions often result in performance collapse, and that hybrid systems perform best when humans lead by providing instructions while evaluation is delegated to AI.

2602.10476.tldr: This work proposes LatentRxnFlow, a new reaction prediction paradigm that models reactions as continuous latent trajectories anchored at the thermodynamic product state, and shows that latent trajectory analysis allows us to localize and characterize failure modes and to mitigate certain errors via gated inference.

2602.10481.tldr: This work introduces two novel primitives--authenticated prompts and authenticated context--that provide cryptographically verifiable provenance across LLM workflows, and formalizes a policy algebra with four proven theorems providing protocol-level Byzantine resistance.

2602.10485.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that under properly guided by automated debugging, some LLMs can generate useful QNP abstractions, and a prompt protocol is proposed: input a GP domain and training tasks to LLMs, prompting them to generate abstract features and further abstract the initial state, action set, and goal into QNP problems.

2602.10489.tldr: The Neural Spectral Discrepancy (NSD) is introduced, a theoretically principled parametric distance that provides a unified view of cross-graph shifts that makes ADAlign flexible, scenario-aware, and robust to diverse and dynamically evolving shifts.

2602.10506.tldr: This work proposes DiffGDA, a diffusion-based method that models the domain adaptation process as a continuous-time generative process, and forms the evolution from source to target graphs using stochastic differential equations (SDEs), enabling the joint modeling of structural and semantic transitions.

2602.10513.tldr: It is demonstrated that CoLin outperforms both full fine-tuning and classical delta-tuning approaches with merely 1% parameters for the first time, providing a novel and efficient solution for deployment of vision foundation models.

2602.10514.tldr: Co-jump is introduced, a cooperative task where two quadrupedal robots synchronize to execute jumps far beyond their solo capabilities, achieving synchronization without explicit communication or pre-specified motion primitives, establishing a foundation for communication-free collaborative locomotion in constrained environments.

2602.10525.tldr: LHAW (Long-Horizon Augmented Workflows), a modular, dataset-agnostic synthetic pipeline that transforms any well-specified task into controllable underspecified variants by systematically removing information across four dimensions at configurable severity levels, is introduced.

2602.10528.tldr: A new dataset is introduced, the first reproducible benchmark for PD prediction, and a Swap-Adversarial Framework (SAF) is proposed that mitigates high inter-subject variability and the high-dimensional low-sample-size (HDLSS) problem in ECoG data, while achieving robust domain generalization across ECoG and EEG-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) datasets.

2602.10545.tldr: This work introduces a general upscaling method applicable to a broad range of architectures and optimizers, backed by theory guaranteeing that models are equivalent to their widened versions and allowing for rigorous analysis of infinite-width limits.

2602.10546.tldr: A lightweight detection method based on image noise entropy, which transforms the original image into an entropy tensor of Non-Local Means (NLM) noise before classification, is proposed.

2602.10549.tldr: This work introduces an in-context learning-based multi-stage text augmentation mechanism to generate high-quality anomaly text samples for fine-tuning the text feature extractor and designs a multi-scale bottleneck Transformer fusion module that uses compressed bottleneck tokens to progressively integrate information across modalities, mitigating redundancy and imbalance.

2602.10553.tldr: This study provides a foundational framework for developing medical models that utilize ECG data by employing SigLIP, a CLIP based model with a sigmoid based loss function enabling multi label prediction, and introducing a modified loss function tailored to the multi label nature of ECG data.

2602.10560.tldr: GRU-Mem is proposed, which incorporates two text-controlled gates for more stable and efficient long-context reasoning, and generally outperforms the vanilla MemAgent with up to 400\% times inference speed acceleration.

2602.10575.tldr: This work proposes MetaphorStar, the first end-to-end visual reinforcement learning (RL) framework for image implication tasks, and reveals that learning image implication tasks improves the general understanding ability, especially the complex visual reasoning ability.

2602.10576.tldr: This work proposes PiT-PO (Physics-informed Token-regularized Policy Optimization), a unified framework that evolves the LLM into an adaptive generator via reinforcement learning and demonstrates that PiT-PO empowers small-scale models to outperform closed-source giants, democratizing access to high-performance scientific discovery.

2602.10583.tldr: Flow of SpanS (FOSS), a principled GFlowNets framework for span generation that constructs a dynamic span vocabulary by segmenting the retrieved text flexibly, ensuring a DAG-structured state space, which allows GFlowNets to explore diverse compositional paths and improve generalization.

2602.10585.tldr: This work proposes Neural Additive Experts (NAEs), a novel framework that seamlessly balances interpretability and accuracy, and proposes targeted regularization techniques to mitigate variance among expert predictions, facilitating a smooth transition from an exclusively additive model to one that captures intricate feature interactions while maintaining clarity in feature attributions.

2602.10598.tldr: Neuro-symbolic Action Masking (NSAM), a novel framework that automatically learn symbolic models, which are consistent with given domain constraints of high-dimensional states, in a minimally supervised manner during the DRL process, is proposed.

2602.10607.tldr: It is proved that HZO reduces the query complexity from $O(ML^2)$ to $O(ML \log L)$ for a network of width $M$ and depth $L$, representing a significant leap over existing ZO methodologies.

2602.10609.tldr: Online Causal Kalman Filtering for stable and effective Policy Optimization (KPO) is proposed, which model the desired IS ratio as a latent state that evolves across tokens and applies a Kalman filter to update this state online and autoregressively based on the states of past tokens, regardless of future tokens.

2602.10623.tldr: Bayesian Non-Negative Reward Model is proposed, a principled reward modeling framework that integrates non-negative factor analysis into Bradley-Terry (BT) preference model and substantially mitigates reward over-optimization, improves robustness under distribution shifts, and yields more interpretable reward decompositions than strong baselines.

2602.10624.tldr: DermFM-Zero's latent representations are interpretable: sparse autoencoders unsupervisedly disentangle clinically meaningful concepts that outperform predefined-vocabulary approaches and enable targeted suppression of artifact-induced biases, enhancing robustness without retraining.

2602.10635.tldr: Heterogeneity-Aware Relative Policy Optimization (HARPO), an RL method that balances leaning across heterogeneous tasks and samples, is introduced and developed and released and validated against recent RL methods, where it achieves the most consistently strong performance across behavioral tasks.

2602.10675.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that TwiFF significantly outperforms existing VCoT methods and Textual Chain-of-Thought baselines on dynamic reasoning tasks, which fully validates the effectiveness for visual question answering in dynamic scenarios.

2602.10698.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that integrates depth estimation into VLA models to enrich 3D feature representations, and introduces a new module called action assistant, which constrains the learned 3D representations with action priors and ensures their consistency with downstream control tasks.

2602.10708.tldr: ProtoGLAD is a interpretable unsupervised framework that provides explanation for each detected anomaly by explicitly contrasting with its nearest normal prototype graph, then identifying graphs distant from all discovered normal clusters as anomalies.

2602.10711.tldr: This work proposes Future-Aligned Soft Contrastive Learning (FASCL), a representation learning framework whose soft contrastive loss uses pairwise future return correlations as continuous supervision targets and introduces an evaluation protocol to directly assess whether retrieved assets share similar future trajectories.

2602.10715.tldr: This work introduces \textbf{LoCoMo-Plus}, a benchmark for assessing cognitive memory under cue--trigger semantic disconnect, where models must retain and apply latent constraints across long conversational contexts, and proposes a unified evaluation framework based on constraint consistency.

2602.10722.tldr: Several aspects that can be further investigated within these frameworks to improve reconstruction quality, such as image generation, the model, and the iterative algorithm used to solve the minimization problem, are investigated.

2602.10735.tldr: This paper leverages state-of-the-art open-source TTS to convert a text e-book into a narrated e-book in the EPUB 3 Media Overlay format and offers several innovative steps: audio timestamps are captured directly during TTS, ensuring exact synchronization between narration and text highlighting.

2602.10744.tldr: This work introduces a self-supervised learning (SSL) strategy that first pretrains multiple SR model oriented representations in a pretext stage, and incorporates targeted preprocessing to extract complementary quality information and an auxiliary task to better handle the various degradation profiles associated with different SR scaling factors.

2602.10750.tldr: Experimental results indicate that a lightweight statistical model, when augmented with calibrated verification and external intelligence, can achieve reliability and performance comparable to more complex deep learning systems.

2602.10754.tldr: The adaptive rewiring approach, particularly when combined with early stopping, proves promising by allowing the model to adapt its connectivity structure during training, contributing to understanding how sparsity can be effectively leveraged in GNNs for critical applications like power grid reliability analysis.

2602.10770.tldr: LOREN, a Low Rank-Based Code-Rate Adaptation Neural Receiver that achieves adaptability with minimal overhead, integrates lightweight low rank adaptation adapters into convolutional layers, freezing a shared base network while training only small adapters per code rate.

2602.10780.tldr: This work proposes an inference-time backdoor mitigation approach called FIRE (Feature-space Inference-time REpair), which hypothesizes that a trigger induces structured and repeatable changes in the model's internal representation that outperforms current runtime mitigations on image benchmarks across various attacks, datasets, and network architectures.

2602.10787.tldr: VulReaD, a knowledge-graph-guided approach for vulnerability reasoning and detection that moves beyond binary classification toward CWE-level reasoning, is proposed and results show that LLMs outperform deep learning baselines in binary detection and that KG-guided reasoning enhances CWE coverage and interpretability.

2602.10794.tldr: CycFlow is proposed, a framework that replaces iterative edge denoising with deterministic point transport, and accelerates solving speed by up to three orders of magnitude compared to state-of-the-art diffusion baselines, while maintaining competitive optimality gaps.

2602.10799.tldr: This work formalizes RS hallucinations with an RS-oriented taxonomy and introduces image-level hallucination to capture RS-specific inconsistencies beyond object-centric errors, and introduces a domain-tailored dataset RSHalluShield for training-friendly mitigation.

2602.10802.tldr: This study investigates how GenAI is perceived within the disciplines of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (ITEE) using a mixed-method approach and identifies a set of high-level requirements and a conceptual framework for responsible GenAI integration.

2602.10808.tldr: This paper proposes a comprehensive code quality assessment framework called Programmatic Excellence via LLM Iteration (PELLI), and finds that GPT-4T and Gemini performed slightly better, and that prompt design can influence the overall code quality.

2602.10814.tldr: This work introduces ScratchWorld, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on program-by-construction tasks in Scratch, and proposes an execution-based evaluation protocol that validates the functional correctness of the constructed Scratch programs through runtime tests within the browser environment.

2602.10816.tldr: The Token Constraint Bound (TCB) is introduced, a novel metric that quantifies the maximum internal state perturbation an LLM can withstand before its dominant next-token prediction significantly changes.

2602.10825.tldr: FlowCache is presented, the first caching framework specifically designed for autoregressive video generation, which introduces a chunkwise caching strategy that dynamically adapts to the unique denoising characteristics of each chunk, complemented by a joint importance-redundancy optimized KV cache compression mechanism that maintains fixed memory bounds while preserving generation quality.

2602.10845.tldr: SynergyKGC is presented, an adaptive framework that advances traditional neighbor aggregation to an active Cross-Modal Synergy Expert via relation-aware cross-attention and semantic-intent-driven gating and effectively reconciles topological heterogeneity while ensuring representational stability across training and inference phases.

2602.10847.tldr: The Global Temporal Retriever is introduced, a lightweight and plug-and-play module designed to extend any forecasting model's temporal awareness beyond the immediate historical context and highlight GTR as an efficient and general solution for enhancing global periodicity modeling in MTSF tasks.

2602.10848.tldr: A multi-dimensional benchmark evaluating four TSFMs alongside Prophet as an industry-standard baseline and two statistical references using ERCOT hourly load data from 2020 to 2024 is presented and practical model selection guidelines are provided and the complete benchmark framework for reproducibility is released.

2602.10863.tldr: This work proposes a visual-native search framework that represents webpages as visual snapshots, allowing agents to leverage layout cues to quickly localize salient evidence and suppress distractors, and introduces Information-Aware Credit Assignment, a post-hoc method that estimates each retrieved snapshot's contribution to the final outcome via posterior analysis and propagates dense learning signals back to key search turns.

2602.10870.tldr: FedPS is introduced, a unified framework for federated data preprocessing based on aggregated statistics that design federated algorithms for feature scaling, encoding, discretization, and missing-value imputation, and extend preprocessing-related models such as k-Means, k-Nearest Neighbors, and Bayesian Linear Regression to both horizontal and vertical FL settings.

2602.10881.tldr: This work proposes a structural, diagnostic framework that evaluates LLM-based evidence extraction as a progression of schema-constrained queries with increasing relational and numerical complexity, enabling precise identification of failure points beyond atom-level extraction.

2602.10885.tldr: It is shown that self-proposed and self-evolving rubrics provide reliable CoT supervision signals even without outcome rewards, enabling RLCER to outperform outcome-centric RLVR and further improve inference-time performance.

2602.10886.tldr: The setup and the tasks of the FinMMEval Lab are presented, which introduces the first multilingual and multimodal evaluation framework for financial Large Language Models (LLMs), and a comprehensive evaluation suite that measures models'ability to reason, generalize, and act across diverse languages and modalities.

2602.10891.tldr: This work investigates how different feedback modalities, ranging from numeric metrics alone to combinations with plots and behavior visualizations, influence the LLM ability to generate meaningful curricula, and shows that interactive curriculum generation outperforms static approaches.

2602.10894.tldr: This study proposes a model-free reinforcement learning algorithm designed for board games to achieve more efficient learning and believes that this efficient algorithm shows the potential of model-free reinforcement learning in domains traditionally dominated by search-based methods.

2602.10916.tldr: The Participation Ledger is introduced, a machine readable and auditable framework that operationalizes participation as traceable influence, enforceable authority, and compensable labor in public sector and civic AI systems.

2602.10935.tldr: This work analyzes close to 2,500 statements submitted by 457 participants to an open-ended AI fact-checking system to reframe fact-checking as a demand-driven problem and identify where current AI systems and benchmarks are misaligned with the uncertainty people actually experience.

2602.10959.tldr: This work reinterprets RoPE as phase modulation applied to a bank of complex oscillators, enabling analysis through classical signal processing theory and derive principled lower bounds on the RoPE base parameter that are necessary to preserve positional coherence over a target context length.

2602.10975.tldr: This work proposes FeatureBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate agentic coding performance in end-to-end, feature-oriented software development that incorporates an execution-based evaluation protocol and a scalable test-driven method that automatically derives tasks from code repositories with minimal human effort.

2602.10982.tldr: It is argued that Riemannian geometry provides a principled and necessary foundation for graph representation learning, and that Riemannian graph learning should be viewed as a unifying paradigm rather than a collection of isolated techniques.

2602.10999.tldr: This work proposes to employ agents to simulate and explore environment histories, guided by execution feedback, for scalable derivation of environment-intensive tasks, and is the first public pipeline for scalable derivation of environment-intensive tasks.

2602.11000.tldr: This work demonstrates that targeted post-training with reinforcement learning can unlock LLM capabilities in highly specialized technical domains where traditional supervised learning is limited by data availability, opening new pathways for AI-assisted accelerator programming.

2602.11004.tldr: A Predictable Perception system with DNNs (PP-DNN) that reduce the amount of image data to be processed while maintaining the same level of accuracy for multi-tenant DNNs by dynamically selecting critical frames and regions of interest (ROIs).

2602.11008.tldr: ROCKET is a training-free model compression method that achieves state-of-the-art performance in comparison with factorization, structured-sparsification and dynamic compression baselines and consistently outperforms existing compression approaches across different model architectures at 20-50% compression rates.

2602.11015.tldr: Empirical validation on 10,000 records across 19 protection configurations demonstrates that formal k-anonymity compliance may coexist with substantial empirical linkability, with a significant portion arising from non-quasi-identifier behavioral patterns.

2602.11016.tldr: 3D-Flow is proposed, a hybrid-bonded, 3D-stacked spatial accelerator that enables register-to-register communication across vertically partitioned PE tiers, and 3D-FlashAttention, a fine-grained scheduling method that balances latency across tiers, forming a bubble-free vertical dataflow without on-chip SRAM roundtrips.

2602.11018.tldr: This work proposes a novel offline safe IL algorithm, OSIL, that infers safety from non-preferred demonstrations as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP), and empirically demonstrates that this approach can learn safer policies that satisfy cost constraints without degrading the reward performance, thus outperforming several baselines.

2602.11021.tldr: This work proposes ContactGaussian-WM, a differentiable physics-grounded rigid-body world model capable of learning intricate physical laws directly from sparse and contact-rich video sequences, and showcases the practical utility of the framework in downstream applications, including data synthesis and real-time MPC.

2602.11024.tldr: Chain-of-Look, a novel visual reasoning framework that mimics the sequential human counting process by enforcing a structured visual chain, rather than relying on classic object detection which is unordered, is introduced.

2602.11028.tldr: This study analyzes spontaneous speech transcripts from the DementiaBank Pitt Corpus using three linguistic representations to demonstrate that abstract linguistic features capture robust markers of early cognitive decline under clinically realistic evaluation.

2602.11044.tldr: This work proposes a simple algorithm to achieve end-to-end differentiability of a given (frozen) LM and then finds optimised prompts via gradient descent and views LMs as functions operating on sequences of distributions over tokens (rather than the traditional view as functions on sequences of tokens).

2602.11052.tldr: A novel abstraction to replace brittle generation of graph queries directly from NL with planning over a Semantic Catalog that describes both the graph schema and the graph operations, which yields substantial gains in both token efficiency and task effectiveness even with small-context LLMs.

2602.11065.tldr: This work introduces a framework that models this process as multi-level perception, and then reasons over conversational behaviors via a Graph-of-Thoughts (GoT) scheme, predicting high-level communicative intents and low-level speech acts to learn their causal and temporal dependencies.

2602.11076.tldr: Results confirm AE-MAPPO's ability to combine SLA compliance with inherent interpretability, enabling trustworthy and real-time automation for 6G RAN slicing.

2602.11081.tldr: This work algorithmically generates SteuerEx, the first open benchmark derived from authentic German university tax law examinations, and presents SteuerLLM, a domain-adapted LLM for German tax law trained on a large-scale synthetic dataset generated from authentic examination material using a controlled retrieval-augmented pipeline.

2602.11084.tldr: GRASP is introduced, a novel framework that couples Shapley value driven attribution with group $L_{21}$ regularization to extract compact and non-redundant feature sets and consistently delivers comparable or superior predictive accuracy.

2602.11087.tldr: Results from experiments show the correctness of the proposed LP form and the potential of the flexible $f-divergence in improving performance for learning from a challenging dataset when applied to a compatible constrained optimization algorithm.

2602.11089.tldr: DataChef-32B is presented, which performs online reinforcement learning using a proxy reward that predicts downstream performance for candidate recipes, and sheds new light on automating LLM training and developing self-evolving AI systems.

2602.11090.tldr: Cross-regularized uncertainty learns uncertainty parameters during training using gradients routed through a held-out regularization split to reduce train-test mismatch, yielding regime-adaptive uncertainty without per-regime noise tuning.

2602.11096.tldr: This work proposes SafeThink, a lightweight inference-time defense that treats safety recovery as a satisficing constraint rather than a maximization objective, and monitors the evolving reasoning trace with a safety reward model and conditionally injects an optimized short corrective prefix only when the safety threshold is violated.

2602.11103.tldr: GameDevBench, the first benchmark for evaluating agents on game development tasks, is presented and two simple image and video-based feedback mechanisms for agents are introduced to improve multimodal capability.

2602.11114.tldr: Across stringent multi-domain, cross-domain, and unseen-domain evaluations, the 1-pass generator surpasses SOTA refinement baselines that consume 20 iterations, while substantially reducing generation latency and cost.

2602.11137.tldr: The importance of using evaluation metrics beyond cross-entropy loss for hyperparameter optimization and casts light on the multifaceted role of that a single optimization hyperparameter plays in shaping model behavior are demonstrated.

2602.11142.tldr: Normalizing flow-based hierarchical implicit Q-learning (NF-HIQL), a novel framework that replaces unimodal gaussian policies with expressive normalizing flow policies at both the high- and low-levels of the hierarchy is introduced, demonstrating superior robustness under limited data and highlighting the potential of flow-based architectures for scalable, data-efficient hierarchical reinforcement learning.

2602.11144.tldr: A rigorous standard forGenerative Fluid Intelligence (GFI) is established, guiding the field beyond knowledge utilization toward dynamic, general-purpose reasoning.

2602.11146.tldr: It is demonstrated that DiNa-LRM improves preference optimization dynamics, enabling faster and more resource-efficient model alignment, and achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art VLMs at a fraction of the computational cost.

2402.01353.tldr: The first algorithm for compiling high-level neural network specifications into optimised VNN-LIB queries is presented, which is numerically sound and supports a far rich logical fragment than existing tools, including transformations of variables, first-class quantifiers, and specifications involving multiple networks or multiple applications of the same network.

2405.02325.tldr: It is proved that adaptability at higher layers is bottlenecked by adaptability at lower layers, and it is shown that, under standard viability assumptions, maximising adaptability is equivalent to minimising variational free energy, implying that delegation is necessary for free-energy minimisation.

2411.13779.tldr: A dataset of 40,000 two- person informational interviews from NPR and CNN is curated, and it is revealed that LLMs are significantly less likely than human interviewers to use acknowledgements and to pivot to higher-level questions.

2412.03441.tldr: PBP is introduced, a post-training defense for malware classifiers that mitigates various types of backdoor embeddings without assuming any specific backdoor embedding mechanism, and demonstrates substantial advantages over several state-of-the-art methods.

2502.04667.tldr: It is demonstrated that compositional generalization is fundamental: models systematically combine simpler learned skills during CoT training to address novel and more complex problems.

2503.05696.tldr: Multi-fidelity policy gradients (MFPGs), a sample-efficient RL framework that mixes scarce target-environment data with a control variate formed from abundant low-fidelity simulation data to construct an unbiased, variance-reduced estimator for on-policy policy gradients, is proposed.

2504.04988.tldr: This work introduced a multimodal Remote Sensing World Knowledge dataset, which comprises high-resolution satellite imagery and detailed textual descriptions for 14,141 well-known landmarks from 175 countries, integrating both remote sensing domain knowledge and broader world knowledge, and proposed a novel Remote Sensing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RS-RAG) framework, which consists of two key components.

2506.04755.tldr: A novel data selection paradigm termed Reasoning Activation Potential (RAP), which identifies cognitive samples by estimating each sample's potential to stimulate genuine multi-modal reasoning by two complementary estimators, and introduces a Difficulty-aware Replacement Module (DRM) to substitute trivial instances with cognitively challenging ones, thereby ensuring complexity for robust multi-modal reasoning.

2507.00310.tldr: This paper quantifies the epistemic shift from the LLM's prior beliefs about a hypothesis to its posterior beliefs after gathering experimental results, and presents AutoDiscovery -- a method for open-ended ASD that instead drives scientific exploration using Bayesian surprise.

2507.12314.tldr: Thought Purity (TP), a defense framework that shifts from passive refusal to active reasoning recovery, is proposed, employing a dual-reward mechanism to teach models to dynamically identify and isolate malicious logic while preserving correct reasoning.

2507.17061.tldr: This paper proposes a coordination framework that enables adaptiveness through three core mechanisms: dynamic task routing, bidirectional feedback, and parallel agent evaluation, and instantiates these principles in a modular architecture and demonstrates substantial improvements in factual coverage, coherence, and efficiency over static and partially adaptive baselines.

2508.06111.tldr: This work introduces SKATE: a novel evaluation framework in which large language models (LLMs) compete by generating and solving verifiable tasks for one another, and finds that weaker models can reliably differentiate and score stronger ones.

2508.06352.tldr: This paper introduces Explanatory AI as a complementary paradigm where AI systems leverage generative and multimodal capabilities to serve as explanatory partners for human understanding and derives five meta-requirements specifying what systems must achieve and formulate ten design principles prescribing how to build them.

2509.20997.tldr: This paper proposes a novel autoencoder variant that enforces minimal entropy on minibatches of hidden activations, thereby promoting feature independence and sparsity across instances and empirically demonstrates two major applications: Feature set entropy calculation and feature untangling.

2509.21513.tldr: This work presents DistillKac, a fast image generator that uses the damped wave equation and its stochastic Kac representation to move probability mass at finite speed, and introduces classifier-free guidance in velocity space that preserves square integrability under mild conditions.

2509.24836.tldr: This work introduces Structured Logical Knowledge Density (SLKD), a novel metric that measures logical information content by decomposing natural language into executable predicates and logical primitives and proposes a density aware re-cognizing optimization strategy that prioritizes high-density logical samples to enhance with the LLM's reasoning ability.

2510.18095.tldr: This work redefines LLM-driven decision-making by pioneering a new paradigm in cross-strategy calibration, unlocking superior outcomes for reasoning systems and advancing the boundaries of self-refining methodologies.

2510.26219.tldr: This paper proposes a new test-time alignment method called adaptive importance sampling on pre-logits (AISP) on the basis of the sampling-based model predictive control with the stochastic control input and demonstrates that the optimal mean is obtained by importance sampling with sampled rewards.

2511.05832.tldr: A novel method for constructing windows and neighborhoods based on the Hilbert curve that significantly increases block sparsity and can be combined with existing block-sparse kernels to improve the efficiency of 2D local attention.

2511.13062.tldr: Self-Adaptive Graph Mixture of Models (SAGMM), a modular and practical framework that learns to automatically select and combine the most appropriate GNN models from a diverse pool of architectures, is proposed, offering a robust and adaptive solution for real-world graph learning.

2511.14312.tldr: H-LDM establishes a new direction for data augmentation in cardiac diagnostics, bridging data scarcity with interpretable clinical insights by generating clinically accurate and controllable PCG signals from structured metadata.

2512.06562.tldr: SUGAR is introduced, a framework for scalable generative unlearning that enables the removal of many identities (simultaneously or sequentially) without retraining the entire model, and introduces a continual utility preservation objective that guards against degradation as more identities are forgotten.

2601.03054.tldr: A novel agentic MLLM is proposed, named IBISAgent, that reformulates segmentation as a vision-centric, multi-step decision-making process that outperforms both closed-source and open-source SOTA methods and enhances the model's robustness in complex medical referring and reasoning segmentation tasks.

2601.05844.tldr: This work presents DexterCap, a low-cost optical capture system for dexterous in-hand manipulation that uses dense, character-coded marker patches to achieve robust tracking under severe self-occlusion, together with an automated reconstruction pipeline that requires minimal manual effort.

2601.17311.tldr: A minimal and calibratable theory is developed that predicts these regimes from three binding constraints of modern agent stacks: finite context windows, lossy inter-agent communication, and shared failures among similar agents.

2601.22548.tldr: An Evaluator Quality Baseline is introduced, which compares the probability that a judge incorrectly votes for itself against the probability that it votes for an incorrect response from another model, and enables future research on self-preference by eliminating noisy data from potential solutions.

2601.22871.tldr: JudgeGPT and RogueGPT are presented, a dual-axis framework that decouples "authenticity" from "attribution" to investigate the mechanisms of human susceptibility, and a "fluency trap" is identified where GPT-4 outputs bypass Source Monitoring mechanisms, rendering them indistinguishable from human text.

2602.00148.tldr: This work introduces Neural Gaussian Force Field (NGFF), an end-to-end neural framework that integrates 3D Gaussian perception with physics-based dynamic modeling to generate interactive, physically realistic 4D videos from multi-view RGB inputs, achieving two orders of magnitude faster than prior Gaussian simulators.

2602.05014.tldr: DeepRead is introduced, a structure-aware document reasoning agent designed to operationalize document-native structural priors into actionable reasoning capabilities that outperforms Search-o1-style agentic search baselines by an average of 10.3%.

2602.05548.tldr: This work argues that bottlenecks in exploration and difficulty adaptation stem from an implicit advantage symmetry inherent in Group Relative Advantage Estimation (GRAE), and proposes Asymmetric GRAE (A-GRAE), which dynamically modulates exploration incentives and sample-difficulty focus.

2602.07011.tldr: MAU-Set, a comprehensive dataset for Multi-type industrial Anomaly Understanding, spans multiple industrial domains and features a hierarchical task structure, ranging from binary classification to complex reasoning, and MAU-GPT, a domain-adapted multimodal large model specifically designed for industrial anomaly understanding.

2602.08517.tldr: Detailed examples and benchmarks show TreeTensor not only provides powerful usability in various problems, especially one of the most complicated AI systems at present: AlphaStar for StarCraftII, but also exhibits excellent runtime efficiency without any overhead.

2602.08520.tldr: Reinforcement Inference is introduced, an entropy-aware inference-time control strategy that uses the model's own uncertainty to selectively invoke a second, more deliberate reasoning attempt, enabling stronger performance without any retraining and suggesting a broader entropy-aware paradigm for measuring and expanding model capability.

2602.09070.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that NarraScore achieves state-of-the-art consistency and narrative alignment with negligible computational overhead, establishing a fully autonomous paradigm for long-video soundtrack generation.

2602.09255.tldr: STaR is presented, an agentic reasoning framework that constructs a task-agnostic, multimodal long-term memory that generalizes to unseen queries while preserving fine-grained environmental semantics, and introduces a Scalable Task Conditioned Retrieval algorithm based on the Information Bottleneck principle to extract from long-term memory a compact, non-redundant, information-rich set of candidate memories for contextual reasoning.

2602.10081.tldr: Comprehensive evaluation across 9 broad domains with 170 subdomains demonstrates that Anagent achieves substantial improvements, while revealing that task-oriented reasoning and context-aware problem-solving are essential for high-quality scientific table \&figure analysis.

2602.10437.tldr: Control Reinforcement Learning is introduced, which trains a policy to select SAE features for steering at each token, producing interpretable intervention logs that establish learned feature steering as a mechanistic interpretability tool that complements static feature analysis with dynamic intervention probes.

2602.10467.tldr: Empirical results indicate that baseline LLM strategies often diverge from human preferences, while the mechanism substantially improves negotiation performance, yielding deeper strategic behavior and stronger opponent awareness.

2602.10699.tldr: V-STAR, a Value-guided Sampling and Tree-structured Advantage Reinforcement framework, and Sibling-GRPO, which exploits the induced tree topology to compute sibling-relative advantages and concentrates learning signals on decisive branching decisions, are proposed.

2602.11453.tldr: This work proposes DiffusionRank that extends TabDiff, an existing denoising diffusion-based generative model for tabular datasets, to create generative equivalents of classical discriminative pointwise and pairwise LTR objectives.

2602.11455.tldr: This work proposes Anchor-Token Reinforcement Learning (AT-RL), a lightweight framework that selectively reinforces high-connectivity tokens via graph-based clustering of attention topology and reveals that reasoning quality is governed not by token quantity but by the fidelity of cross-modal anchoring.

2602.11461.tldr: An ML-driven framework for automated RF physical synthesis that transforms circuit netlists into manufacturable GDSII layouts that demonstrates superior accuracy across 1-100 GHz, enabling EM-accurate component synthesis with real-time inference is presented.

2602.11481.tldr: This work investigates whether GPT-5 can effectively acquire proficiency in an unfamiliar functional programming language, Idris, through iterative, feedback driven prompting, and suggests that structured compiler level feedback can play a critical role in unlocking their capabilities.

2602.11483.tldr: The Knowledge-based Persuasion Model (KPM) is proposed, which offers a structured approach to studying interactions with GSAs, supporting the development of agents that motivate rather than manipulate humans.

2602.11506.tldr: This work proposes a systematic framework based on the Roofline model that unifies architectural primitives and hardware constraints through the lens of operational intensity (OI), and introduces the Relative Inference Potential as a novel metric to compare efficiency differences between Large Language Models (LLMs) on the same hardware substrate.

2602.11509.tldr: This work introduces MuRGAt (Multimodal Reasoning with Grounded Attribution), a benchmark for evaluating fact-level multimodal attribution in settings that require reasoning beyond direct observation and introduces an automatic evaluation framework that strongly correlates with human judgments.

2602.11510.tldr: AgentLeak is introduced, to the best of the authors' knowledge the first full-stack benchmark for privacy leakage covering internal channels, spanning 1,000 scenarios across healthcare, finance, legal, and corporate domains, paired with a 32-class attack taxonomy and three-tier detection pipeline.

2602.11513.tldr: This is the first work that utilizes soft prompt to improve the trade-off between privacy and utility in LLM inference, and extensive experiments on text generation and natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

2602.11514.tldr: This work calls for conceptual clarity through GUI Agent Autonomy Levels (GAL), a six-level framework that makes autonomy explicit and helps benchmark progress toward trustworthy software interaction.

2602.11516.tldr: A human-inspired continuous learning framework that unifies reasoning, action, reflection, and verification within a sequential reasoning model enhanced by parallel learning, which progressively evolves its internal cognitive architecture while preserving operational stability.

2602.11520.tldr: The Locally Interpretable Individualized Treatment Rule (LI-ITR) method is introduced, which combines flexible machine learning models to accurately learn complex treatment outcomes with locally interpretable approximations to construct subject-specific treatment rules.

2602.11524.tldr: ADMIRE constructs a verifiable, adaptive reward system by anchoring trajectory to milestones, which are dynamically distilled from successful explorations, and integrates an asymmetric credit assignment strategy that denoises successful trajectories and scaffolds failed trajectories.

2602.11527.tldr: The proposed CausalAgent is a conversational multi-agent system for end-to-end causal inference that innovatively integrates Multi-Agent Systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and the Model Context Protocol to achieve automation from data cleaning and causal structure learning to bias correction and report generation through natural language interaction.
