2602.11528.tldr: A unified defense framework that combines fine-grained anonymization (TRACE) with inference-preventing optimization (RPS) that offers strong cross-model generalization, prompt-variation robustness, and utility-privacy tradeoffs is proposed.

2602.11533.tldr: This work proposes ALTTS, a dual-path framework that explicitly decouples autoregression and cross-relation modeling, and suggests that carefully designed optimization strategies, rather than ever more complex architectures, can be a key driver of progress in multivariate time series forecasting.

2602.11534.tldr: Krause Attention is introduced, a principled attention mechanism inspired by bounded-confidence consensus dynamics that replaces similarity-based global aggregation with distance-based, localized, and selectively sparse interactions, promoting structured local synchronization instead of global mixing.

2602.11541.tldr: INTENT is proposed, an inference-time planning framework that leverages an intention-aware hierarchical world model to anticipate future tool usage, risk-calibrated cost, and guide decisions online and remains robust under dynamic market shifts such as tool price changes and varying budgets.

2602.11549.tldr: NRT (Native Reasoning Training), a novel framework that cultivates complex reasoning by having the model generate its own reasoning traces using only standard question-answer pairs, thereby obviating the need for expert-written demonstrations, is introduced.

2602.11550.tldr: This work proposes Parametric Memory Distillation and implements it as TS-Memory, a lightweight memory adapter that augments frozen TSFMs, with efficiency comparable to the frozen backbone.

2602.11553.tldr: A generative compression framework for perception-based denoising is proposed, where restoration is achieved by reconstructing from entropy-coded latent representations that enforce low-complexity structure, while generative decoders recover realistic textures via perceptual measures such as learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS) loss and Wasserstein distance.

2602.11569.tldr: SemaPop is proposed, a semantic-conditioned and controllable population synthesis framework that introduces persona representations as conditioning signals for generation and highlights the potential of persona-based semantic conditioning for controllable and scenario-oriented population synthesis.

2602.11574.tldr: ARC (Agentic Resource&Configuration learner), which learns a light-weight hierarchical policy using reinforcement learning to dynamically tailor agent configurations, demonstrates that learning per-query agent configurations is a powerful alternative to"one size fits all"designs.

2602.11581.tldr: This paper proposes analytical search as a distinct and emerging search paradigm designed to fulfill analytical information needs, and presents a unified system framework that integrates query understanding, recall-oriented retrieval, reasoning-aware fusion, and adaptive verification.

2602.11583.tldr: This survey reviews multi-agent communication (MA-Comm) through the Five Ws: who communicates with whom, what is communicated, when communication occurs, and why communication is beneficial.

2602.11584.tldr: FedSynSAM is proposed, which leverages the global model trajectory to construct synthetic data and facilitates an accurate estimation of the global perturbation and induces sharper loss landscapes in federated learning, particularly under non-IID data distributions.

2602.11596.tldr: This work introduces MAPLE, a complete modality-aware post-training and learning ecosystem comprising MAPLE-bench, the first benchmark explicitly annotating minimal signal combinations required per task; MAPO, a modality-aware policy optimization framework that stratifies batches by modality requirement to reduce gradient variance from heterogeneous group advantages; and Adaptive weighting and curriculum scheduling that balances and prioritizes harder signal combinations.

2602.11598.tldr: ABot-N0, a unified Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation model that achieves a ``Grand Unification'' across 5 core tasks: Point-Goal, Object-Goal, Instruction-Following, POI-Goal, and Person-Following, is introduced.

2602.11619.tldr: It is suggested that monitoring behavioral consistency during execution could enable early error detection and improve agent reliability, and trace variance to early decisions.

2602.11625.tldr: This work proposes PLOT-CT, a novel framework for Pre-Log vOronoi decomposiTion-assisted CT generation, which achieves state-of-the-art performance, attaining a 2.36dB PSNR improvement over traditional methods at the 1e4 incident photon level in the pre-log domain.

2602.11626.tldr: This work proposes Arbitrary Geometry-encoded Transformer (ArGEnT), a geometry-aware attention-based architecture for operator learning on arbitrary domains that provides a scalable surrogate modeling framework for optimization, uncertainty quantification, and data-driven modeling of complex physical systems.

2602.11630.tldr: This work proposes a neuro-assisted multitasking symbolic PDE solver framework for PDE family solving, dubbed NMIPS, and employs multifactorial optimization to simultaneously discover the analytical solutions of PDEs.

2602.11636.tldr: ScalSelect is proposed, a scalable training-free multimodal data selection method with linear-time complexity with respect to the number of samples, eliminating the need for external models or auxiliary datasets.

2602.11643.tldr: Soft Fusion Contrastive Learning is introduced, an advanced version of conventional contrastive learning method and a CVAE module to utilize the alignment and complementarity within visuo-tactile representations within visuo-tactile representations.

2602.11646.tldr: This work investigates the susceptibility and resilience of several ResNet-based architectures, referred to as BrainNet, BrainNeXt and DilationNet, against gradient-based adversarial attacks, namely FGSM and PGD, and reveals that BrainNeXt models exhibit the highest robustness to black-box attacks.

2602.11651.tldr: DMind-3 is introduced, a sovereign Edge-Local-Cloud intelligence stack designed to secure irreversible financial execution in Web3 environments against adversarial risks and strict latency constraints, providing a scalable framework where safety is bound to the edge execution primitive while maintaining sovereignty over sensitive user intent.

2602.11655.tldr: This paper presents a continuous learning architecture for edge-based malware detection that combines local adaptation on each device with global knowledge sharing through parameter-efficient LoRA adapters, and yields up to 20-25% accuracy gains when models encounter previously unseen attacks from another domain.

2602.11656.tldr: This paper proposes the first Supervised Token Reduction framework for multi-modal LLMs (SToRM), which outperforms state-of-the-art E2E driving MLLMs under the same reduced-token budget, maintaining all-token performance while reducing computational cost by up to 30x, and enabling real-time E2E driving on a standard GPU.

2602.11661.tldr: A robust medical alignment paradigm is proposed that employs Reference-Frozen Normalization to align reward scales and implements a Tri-Factor Adaptive Dynamic Weighting strategy to achieve collaborative optimization that is weakness-oriented, risk-prioritized, and redundancy-reducing.

2602.11666.tldr: PhyNiKCE (Physical and Numerical Knowledgeable Context Engineering), a neurosymbolic agentic framework for trustworthy engineering that offers a scalable, auditable paradigm for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in broader industrial automation is introduced.

2602.11674.tldr: The Benchmark Health Index (BHI), a pure data-driven framework for auditing evaluation sets along three orthogonal and complementary axes, is introduced, providing a principled basis for benchmark selection and enabling dynamic lifecycle management for next-generation evaluation protocols.

2602.11675.tldr: This work introduces Epistemic Regret Minimization (ERM), a framework that identifies causal reasoning flaws from reasoning traces, with no ground-truth labels, to cross-episode RL, where interventional evidence accumulates into a reward signal for open-domain problems lacking ground-truth verifiers.

2602.11678.tldr: A Vector-to-Graph (V2G) pipeline that converts CAD diagrams into property graphs where nodes represent components and edges encode connectivity, making structural dependencies explicit and machine-auditable is proposed.

2602.11679.tldr: This work introduces a novel cyclic Markov decision process (MDP) framework for multi-step decision problems with heterogeneous stage-specific dynamics, transitions, and discount factors across the cycle, and proposes CycleFQI, an extension of fitted Q-iteration enabling theoretical analysis and interpretation.

2602.11683.tldr: ThinkRouter, an inference-time confidence-aware routing mechanism that outperforms explicit CoT, random routing, and latent reasoning baselines in terms of accuracy, and accelerates end-of-thinking token generation by globally lowering model confidence.

2602.11684.tldr: This paper introduces PatientHub, a unified and modular framework that standardizes the definition, composition, and deployment of simulated patients and lowers the barrier to developing new simulation methods and facilitates cross-method and cross-model benchmarking.

2602.11685.tldr: This work presents DRACO (Deep Research Accuracy, Completeness, and Objectivity), a benchmark of complex deep research tasks, which originate from anonymized real-world usage patterns within a large-scale deep research system.

2602.11690.tldr: This work introduces ANML (Attribution-Native Machine Learning), a framework that weights training samples by four quality factors: gradient-based consistency, verification status, contributor reputation, contributor reputation, and temporal relevance.

2602.11693.tldr: Omega-Avatar is proposed, the first feed-forward framework that simultaneously generates a generalizable, 360-deg-complete, and animatable 3D Gaussian head from a single image and introduces a semantic-aware mesh deformation module that integrates multi-view normals to optimize a FLAME head with hair while preserving its topology structure.

2602.11700.tldr: TabSieve, a select-then-predict framework that makes evidence usage explicit and auditable, and introduces TAB-GRPO, a reinforcement learning recipe that jointly optimizes evidence selection and prediction correctness with separate rewards, and stabilizes mixed regression and classification training via dynamic task-advantage balancing.

2602.11703.tldr: A semantically conditioned latent diffusion model (LDM) that synthesizes arterial-phase cerebral DSA frames under explicit control of anatomical circulation (anterior vs. posterior) and canonical C-arm positions and indicates that semantically controlled LDMs can produce realistic synthetic DSAs suitable for downstream algorithm development, research, and training.

2602.11706.tldr: This paper investigates the use of LLMs to generate agricultural synthetic simulation environments from natural language prompts to address the limitations of lacking domain-specific reasoning, verification mechanisms, and modular design, and confirms the effectiveness of multi-LLM pipelines in automating domain-specific 3D scene generation with improved reliability and precision.

2602.11717.tldr: This work proposes Sparse Complementary Fusion with reverse KL (SCF-RKL), a novel model merging framework that explicitly controls functional interference through sparse, distribution-aware updates and selectively incorporates complementary parameters.

2602.11729.tldr: This work provides the first application of crosscoders to cross-architecture model diffing and introduces Dedicated Feature Crosscoders (DFCs), an architectural modification designed to better isolate features unique to one model.

2602.11733.tldr: This work shows how targeted adaptation of general VLMs can substantially improve e-commerce performance while preserving broad multimodal capabilities, and proposes a novel extensive evaluation suite covering deep product understanding, strict instruction following, and dynamic attribute extraction.

2602.11745.tldr: An evaluation method is introduced that goes beyond a single end-to-end metric by jointly reporting grammatical validity, similarity, semantic alignment, and execution accuracy by jointly reporting grammatical validity, similarity, semantic alignment, and execution accuracy.

2602.11749.tldr: Results show that incident response is both feasible and essential as a first-class mechanism for improving agent safety, and that LLM-generated rules can approach the effectiveness of developer-authored rules across domains.

2602.11750.tldr: This work introduces AmbiBench, the first benchmark incorporating a taxonomy of instruction clarity to shift evaluation from unidirectional instruction following to bidirectional intent alignment, and develops MUSE (Mobile User Satisfaction Evaluator), an automated framework utilizing an MLLM-as-a-judge multi-agent architecture.

2602.11754.tldr: The FLCOA framework is proposed to conceptualize how cooperation and coordination emerge in groups of autonomous agents, and it is highlighted that the influence of lower-layer factors - especially computational and communication resources - has been largely overlooked.

2502.12022.tldr: This work proposes TATA (Teaching LLMs According to Their Aptitude), an adaptive framework that enables LLMs to personalize their reasoning strategy spontaneously, aligning it with their intrinsic aptitude.

2503.07869.tldr: This article proposes a time-aware contract-theoretic incentive framework, named Right Reward Right Time (R3T), to encourage client involvement, especially during CLPs, to maximize the utility of the cloud server.

2505.07078.tldr: Systematic backtests reveal that previously reported LLM advantages deteriorate significantly under broader cross-section and over a longer-term evaluation, and highlight the need to develop LLM strategies that are able to prioritise trend detection and regime-aware risk controls over mere scaling of framework complexity.

2505.10297.tldr: FeRA (Federated Representative Attention) is introduced -- a novel attention-driven defense that shifts the detection paradigm from anomaly-centric to consistency-centric analysis and isolates malicious clients that exhibit low-variance consistency or magnitude amplification.

2505.12424.tldr: EvoGPT is a hybrid test generation system that integrates LLM-based test generation with SBST-based test suite optimization, and uses an Evolutionary Algorithm (EA) to further optimize this test suite population.

2505.13557.tldr: AMAQA is the first single-hop QA benchmark to incorporate metadata, and it is shown that leveraging metadata boosts accuracy from 0.5 to 0.5 for GPT-4o and from 0.27 to 0.76 for open source LLMs, highlighting the value of structured context.

2505.18362.tldr: A maximum principle for control problems posed on infinite-dimensional spaces of probability distributions and control vector fields is established and the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation is derived for the associated value functional defined on the space of probability distributions.

2506.00058.tldr: It is found that prompt engineering is still rare (less than 0.5% of sampled job postings) but has a unique skill profile that helps job seekers, employers, and educational institutions in better understanding the emerging field of prompt engineering.

2508.13220.tldr: This paper presents the first formalization of a secure MCP and its required specifications, and establishes a comprehensive MCP security taxonomy that extends existing models by incorporating protocol-level and host-side threats, identifying 17 distinct attack types across four primary attack surfaces.

2508.16390.tldr: This work introduces MedQARo, the first large-scale medical QA benchmark in Romanian, alongside a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) and demonstrates the importance of both domain-specific and language-specific fine-tuning for reliable clinical QA in Romanian.

2508.20866.tldr: AVIATOR decomposes vulnerability injection into a coordinated workflow of specialized AI agents, tool-based analysis, and iterative self-correction, explicitly mirroring expert reasoning to produce realistic, category-specific vulnerabilities without relying on handcrafted patterns.

2509.21081.tldr: TyphoonMLA is introduced, a hybrid approach that combines naive and absorb formulations to harness the strengths of both and improves the throughput of attention calculations in MLA architectures by up to 3x and 3.24x on NPU and GPUs, with only a 3% overhead in HBM size.

2510.00031.tldr: The results show that the multi-agent configuration employed in VibeCodeHPC enables faster and more reliable development of higher-performance code compared to a single-agent setup.

2510.04899.tldr: It is shown that training on Human Behavior Atlas enables models to consistently outperform existing multimodal LLMs across diverse behavioral tasks; with the targeted use of behavioral descriptors yielding meaningful performance gains.

2510.18134.tldr: By shifting focus from what answer a model gives to how it arrives there, SIEV enables a more transparent and principled distinction between structured reasoning and surface-level pattern generation offering a clearer foundation for assessing and understanding the reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

2510.24893.tldr: It is suggested that current narrow AI systems serve as cognitive scaffolds extending performance without transforming underlying mental capacities, suggesting that current narrow AI systems serve as cognitive scaffolds extending performance without transforming underlying mental capacities.

2511.05849.tldr: EGG-SR is introduced, a unified framework that integrates symbolic equivalence into a class of modern symbolic regression methods, including Monte Carlo Tree Search, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), and Large Language Models (LLMs), and the benefit of embedding EGG into learning is shown.

2511.10664.tldr: A comprehensive evaluation of seven cutting-edge LLMs on a new cross-lingual benchmark covering Cantonese, Japanese, and Turkish reveals that while the largest proprietary models generally lead across languages and tasks, significant gaps persist in culturally nuanced understanding and morphological generalization.

2512.13101.tldr: UnCoL distills both visual and semantic representations from a frozen foundation model to transfer general knowledge, while concurrently maintaining a progressively adapting teacher to capture fine-grained and task-specific representations, and delivers near fully supervised performance with markedly reduced annotation requirements.

2601.12138.tldr: This paper introduces DriveSafe, a hierarchical, four-level risk taxonomy designed to systematically characterize safety-critical failure modes of LLM-based driving assistants, and evaluates their refusal behavior across six widely deployed LLMs.

2602.00315.tldr: The framework reveals that standard metrics hide ongoing learning, mask architectural differences, and cannot diagnose the nature of distribution shift, revealing that shift type matters more than shift magnitude.

2602.02613.tldr: A pioneering large-scale data mining investigation of an in-the-wild agent society by analyzing Moltbook, a social platform designed primarily for agent-to-agent interaction and demonstrates that data mining techniques can provide a powerful lens for understanding the organization and evolution of large autonomous agent societies.

2602.03828.tldr: This work proposes AutoFigure, the first agentic framework that automatically generates high-quality scientific illustrations based on long-form scientific text, and demonstrates that AutoFigure consistently surpasses all baseline methods, producing publication-ready scientific illustrations.

2602.04003.tldr: This is the first systematic security study that treats explanations as an adversarial cognitive channel and quantifies their impact on human trust in AI-assisted decision making.

2602.04809.tldr: It is shown that sparse rewards, provided they are goal aligned and can be encountered frequently, uniquely offer both enhanced training reliability and more effective cyber defence agents with lower-risk policies.

2602.05447.tldr: This work presents a systematic study of context engineering for structured data, comprising 9,649 experiments across 11 models, 4 formats, and schemas ranging from 10 to 10,000 tables, demonstrating that architectural decisions should be tailored to model capability rather than assuming universal best practices.

2602.06643.tldr: The Humanoid Manipulation Interface is presented, a portable and efficient framework for learning diverse whole-body manipulation tasks across various environments that enables robot-free data collection and drives a hierarchical learning pipeline that translates human motions into dexterous and feasible humanoid skills.

2602.07432.tldr: A temporal fingerprinting method based on the coefficient of variation (CoV) of inter-post intervals for emerging multi-agent systems where attribution of autonomous versus human-directed behavior is critical is critical, and generalize to emerging multi-agent systems where attribution of autonomous versus human-directed behavior is critical.

2602.07488.tldr: This work isolates two key statistical properties of language that alone can predict neural scaling exponents and derives a simple formula that predicts data-limited neural scaling exponents from first principles without any free parameters or synthetic data models.

2602.10177.tldr: This work introduces Aletheia, a math research agent that iteratively generates, verifies, and revises solutions end-to-end in natural language, and suggests quantifying standard levels of autonomy and novelty of AI-assisted results, as well as proposing a novel concept of human-AI interaction cards for transparency.

2602.10687.tldr: OmniVL-Guard is proposed, a balanced reinforcement learning framework for omnibus vision-language forgery detection and grounding that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods and exhibits zero-shot robust generalization across out-of-domain scenarios.

2602.11073.tldr: This work instantiate this paradigm in ViLaVT, a novel LVLM equipped with a dynamic vision encoder explicitly designed for such interactive visual reasoning, and trained it with a two-stage curriculum combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to promote effective reasoning behaviors.

2602.11136.tldr: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic framework that employs a bidirectional Formal-of-Thought architecture: LLMs serve as specification compilers that top-down decompose high-level human intent into atomic, verifiable constraints, then bottom-up prove compliance using Dafny specifications and Z3 Satisfiability modulo theories solving, which produces mathematical guarantees rather than probabilistic scores.

2602.11761.tldr: MiniCPM-SALA is introduced, a 9B-parameter hybrid architecture that integrates the high-fidelity long-context modeling of sparse attention with the global efficiency of linear attention with a hybrid positional encoding (HyPE) to maintain efficiency and performance for long-context tasks.

2602.11780.tldr: This work proposes RELATE, a reinforcement learning-based end-to-end framework that unifies generation and objective alignment within a single model and incorporates conversion-oriented metrics into the objective and jointly model them with compliance constraints as multi-dimensional rewards, enabling the model to generate high-quality ad texts that improve conversion performance under policy constraints.

2602.11782.tldr: This work proposes an Execute-Summarize(ES) framework that decouples task execution from workflow construction: the model first completes the task using available tools, then independently reconstructs a structured workflow from execution traces, which improves workflow accuracy and robustness.

2602.11785.tldr: SPECTRE is introduced, a minimax-fair method that adjusts the spectrum of a simple Fourier feature mapping and constrains the extent to which the worst-case distribution can deviate from the empirical distribution, and provides a theoretical analysis that derives computable bounds on the worst-case error for both individual groups and the overall population.

2602.11786.tldr: Applying Accelerated Prompt Stress Testing (APST) to multiple instruction-tuned LLMs evaluated on AIR-BENCH-derived safety prompts, it is found that models with similar benchmark-aligned scores can exhibit substantially different empirical failure rates under repeated sampling, particularly as temperature increases.

2602.11790.tldr: The proposed LAVES decomposes the generation workflow into specialized agents coordinated by a central Orchestrating Agent with explicit quality gates and iterative critique mechanisms, enabling fully automated end-to-end production without manual editing.

2602.11792.tldr: It is shown that RLVR induces a distinctive behavioral signature: prompts encountered during RLVR training result in more rigid and similar generations, while unseen prompts retain greater diversity, and a simple black-box detector is introduced that reliably distinguishes RL-seen examples from unseen ones and outperforms existing membership inference and RL contamination detection baselines.

2602.11824.tldr: REVIS, a training-free framework designed to explicitly re-activate this suppressed visual information, extracts the pure visual information vector via orthogonal projection and employs a calibrated strategy to perform sparse intervention only at the precise depth where suppression occurs.

2602.11841.tldr: This work proposes an attribution-guided query rewriting method that uses token-level explanations to guide query rewriting and consistently improves retrieval effectiveness over strong baselines, with larger gains for implicit or ambiguous information needs.

2602.11851.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed CIDS framework can achieve adaptive, efficient intrusion detection in distributed settings, automatically reconfiguring detectors to maintain an optimal configuration, without requiring heavy computation, since all experiments were conducted on edge devices.

2602.11852.tldr: The Prototype Transformer (ProtoT) is introduced -- an autoregressive LM architecture based on prototypes (parameter vectors) posed as an alternative to the standard self-attention-based transformers, paving the way to creating well-performing autoregressive LMs interpretable by design.

2602.11860.tldr: This paper introduces VRCsim, a VRC cooperative perception (CP) simulation framework designed to generate streaming VRC-CP data and proposes Talk2DM, a plug-and-play module that extends VRC-DM systems with NLS querying and commonsense reasoning capabilities.

2602.11865.tldr: An adaptive framework for intelligent AI delegation is proposed - a sequence of decisions involving task allocation, that also incorporates transfer of authority, responsibility, accountability, clear specifications regarding roles and boundaries, clarity of intent, and mechanisms for establishing trust between the two (or more) parties.

2602.11877.tldr: ProbeDirichlet is introduced, a lightweight router that aggregates cross-layer hidden states via learnable Dirichlet distributions with probabilistic training that generalizes robustly across in-domain and out-of-distribution scenarios.

2602.11880.tldr: The RAR problem is reformulated as an inverse problem by using an unrolled network, which considers non-ideal response together with linear forward-projection with CT geometry, enabling the trained model to correct artifacts without requiring real-world clinical data.

2602.11881.tldr: This work proposes the Hierarchical Sparse Autoencoder (HSAE), which jointly learns a series of SAEs and the parent-child relationships between their features and preserves the reconstruction fidelity and interpretability of standard SAEs across different dictionary sizes.

2602.11882.tldr: This work studies whether low-bit planning behavior is determined mostly by total bitwidth or by where bits are allocated across modules, and motivates module-aware, budget-aware quantization policies as a broader research direction for efficient spatial reasoning.

2602.11904.tldr: This study systematically evaluates the potential of large language models for co-evolving grammars and instances of textual DSLs to clarify when LLM-based co-evolution is effective and where current limitations remain.

2602.11917.tldr: This work introduces AlphaPROBE (Alpha Mining via Principled Retrieval and On-graph Biased Evolution), a framework that reframes alpha mining as the strategic navigation of a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG).

2602.11918.tldr: This paper introduces MEME (Modeling the Evolutionary Modes of Financial Markets), designed to reconstruct market dynamics through the lens of evolving logics, and demonstrates MEME's capacity to identify and adapt to the evolving consensus of financial markets.

2602.11919.tldr: The DynaHOI-Gym is introduced, a unified online closed-loop platform with parameterized motion generators and rollout-based metrics for dynamic capture evaluation, and a simple observe-before-act baseline (ObAct) that integrates short-term observations with the current frame via spatiotemporal attention to predict actions.

2602.11924.tldr: It is shown that selection of human-LLM interaction archetype can influence LLM outputs and decisions, bringing important risks and considerations for the designers of human-AI decision-making systems.

2602.11931.tldr: Confidence-driven selection in AdaptEvolve yields a favourable Pareto frontier, reducing total inference cost by an average of 37.9% across benchmarks while retaining 97.5% of the upper-bound accuracy of static large-model baselines.

2602.11941.tldr: A carefully annotated benchmark comprising high-quality music snippets, diverse queries, and over $125,000$ individual relevance judgements is introduced, resulting in high agreement between human annotators and the generated data.

2602.11942.tldr: A novel framework that synthesises both LGE images and their corresponding segmentation masks using implicit neural representations (INRs) combined with denoising diffusion models is proposed, providing an annotation-free method to help mitigate data scarcity.

2602.11945.tldr: PMFL, a performance-enhanced model-contrastive federated learning framework using historical training information, is proposed, which designs a novel model-contrastive term into the node optimization objective by incorporating historical local models to capture stable contrastive points, thereby improving the consistency of model updates in heterogeneous data distributions.

2602.11956.tldr: Flexible task-specific contextual priors can be learned on demand by the visual system and deployed as early as the entry level of visual cortex, confirming that flexible task-specific contextual priors can be learned on demand by the visual system and deployed as early as the entry level of visual cortex.

2602.11964.tldr: Gaia2 is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating large language model agents in realistic, asynchronous environments and released alongside the foundational ARE framework to provide the community with a flexible infrastructure for developing, benchmarking, and training the next generation of practical agent systems.

2602.11965.tldr: Manifold-aware Temporal LoRA (MaT-LoRA), which constrains temporal updates to a shared low-dimensional manifold within a low-rank adaptation subspace, and models its evolution through a structured temporal core under parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

2602.11978.tldr: Agent-guided Policy Search (AGPS), a framework that automates the training pipeline by replacing human supervisors with a multimodal agent that can be viewed as a semantic world model, injecting intrinsic value priors to structure physical exploration.

2602.11988.tldr: It is concluded that unnecessary requirements from context files make tasks harder, and human-written context files should describe only minimal requirements.

2602.12004.tldr: This study proposes the Clinical Semantics Evaluator (CSEval), a framework that leverages language models to assess clinical semantic alignment between the generated images and their conditioning prompts, and shows that CSEval identifies semantic inconsistencies overlooked by other metrics and correlates with expert judgment.

2602.12009.tldr: This paper analyzes how Differential Privacy mechanisms, specifically gradient clipping and noise injection, perturb firing-rate statistics in Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) and how these perturbations are propagated to rate-based FNL coordination.

2602.12013.tldr: This work investigates how models'reasoning behaviors shape reasoning from the perspective of behavioral patterns, and proposes two optimization methods that require no parameter updates: InjectCorrect and InjectRLOpt.

2602.12038.tldr: It is conjecture that the imbalance issue (the number of vulnerable code is extremely small) is at the core of the phenomenon and a comprehensive empirical study involving nine open-source datasets and two state-of-the-art DL models confirms this.

2602.12045.tldr: A reciprocal-space generative pipeline that represents crystals through a truncated Fourier transform of the species-resolved unit-cell density, rather than modeling atomic coordinates directly is proposed, which naturally supports variable atomic multiplicities during generation.

2602.12055.tldr: Scaling successfully in realistic city-scale operations where other priority-based methods fail even at moderate deployments, DTAPP-IICR is positioned as a practical and scalable solution for preflight planning in dense, dynamic urban airspace.

2602.12056.tldr: LawThinker is an autonomous legal research agent that adopts an Explore-Verify-Memorize strategy for dynamic judicial environments that achieves a 24% improvement over direct reasoning and an 11% gain over workflow-based methods, with particularly strong improvements on process-oriented metrics.

2602.12058.tldr: ModelWisdom, an interactive environment that uses visualization and large language models to make TLA+ model checking more interpretable and actionable, and turns raw model-checker output into an interactive, explainable workflow, improving understanding and reducing debugging effort for nontrivial TLA+ specifications.

2602.12078.tldr: The results validate that Mamba-2 hybrid operators preserve reasoning capability within the recursive scaffold, establishing SSM-based operators as viable candidates in the recursive operator design space and taking a first step towards understanding the best mixing strategies for recursive reasoning.

2602.12083.tldr: This tutorial demonstrates differentiable modal logic (DML), implemented via Modal Logical Neural Networks (MLNNs), enabling systems to learn trust networks, causal chains, and regulatory boundaries from behavioral data alone.

2602.12092.tldr: DeepSight is low-cost, reproducible, efficient, and highly scalable large-scale model safety evaluation project consisting of a evaluation toolkit DeepSafe and a diagnosis toolkit DeepScan, which builds a connection between the two stages and transform safety evaluation from black-box to white-box insight.

2602.12096.tldr: This work introduces Multi-Graph Search (MGS), a search-based motion planning algorithm that generalizes classical unidirectional and bidirectional search to a multi-graph setting and proves that MGS is complete and bounded-suboptimal.

2602.12107.tldr: A general framework that characterizes the intrinsic complexity of a given Q-star function class is introduced, inspired by model-free decision-estimation coefficients (DEC) for online RL and gives the first characterization of offline learnability for general low-Bellman-rank MDPs without Bellman completeness.

2602.12108.tldr: This work introduces StateLM, a new class of foundation models endowed with an internal reasoning loop to manage their own state and shifts LLMs from passive predictors to state-aware agents where reasoning becomes a stateful and manageable process.

2602.12113.tldr: Experimental results show that ARLCP achieves a superior efficiency-accuracy trade-off compared to existing approaches, and a key innovations: a reflection penalty that adaptively curtails unnecessary reflective steps while preserving essential reasoning.

2602.12117.tldr: The Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-based Feature Interaction Framework (KAN-FIF), a lightweight multimodal architecture that integrates MLP and CNN layers with spline-parameterized KAN layers is introduced, demonstrating promising feasibility for operational TC monitoring and extending deployability to edge-device AI applications.

2602.12123.tldr: Meta-Sel is proposed, a lightweight supervised meta-learning approach for intent classification that learns a fast, interpretable scoring function for (candidate, query) pairs from labeled training data that is particularly effective for smaller models where selection quality can partially compensate for limited model capacity.

2602.12128.tldr: Unlike previous works on linear attention, the nonlinearity in HLA is not applied separately to queries and keys, but, analogously to standard softmax attention, after the pairwise similarities have been computed.

2602.12133.tldr: A large-scale, comparative audit of state-of-the-art models using an illumination-aware colorimetric methodology, distinguishing aesthetic rendering from underlying pigmentation in synthetic imagery and challenges the sociolinguistic assumption that unmarked language results in inclusive representation.

2602.12143.tldr: STARS is proposed, a framework that bridges data-driven STatistical expectations with knowledge-driven Agentic Reasoning and consistently outperforms all baselines on both score-based and rank-based metrics.

2602.12144.tldr: This paper presents the first category-level empirical study of agent-generated code in open-source mobile app projects and establishes empirical baselines for evaluating agent-generated contributions to design platform aware agentic systems.

2602.12146.tldr: This work proposes an efficient and adaptive data compression system built upon advanced Reinforcement Learning techniques, functioning independently of external grammatical or world knowledge, and shows significant improvements in compression ratios compared to conventional methods.

2602.12153.tldr: This work introduces dVoting, a fast voting technique that boosts reasoning capability without training, with only an acceptable extra computational overhead, and leverages the arbitrary-position generation capability of dLLMs to perform iterative refinement by sampling, identifying uncertain tokens via consistency analysis, regenerating them through voting, and repeating this process until convergence.

2602.12159.tldr: 3DGSNav is presented, a novel ZSON framework that embeds 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) as persistent memory for VLMs to enhance spatial reasoning and achieves robust and competitive performance against state-of-the-art approaches.

2602.12164.tldr: Sci-CoE is proposed, a two-stage scientific co-evolving framework that enables models to self-evolve as both solver and verifier through a transition from sparse supervision to unsupervised learning, facilitating the construction of more robust and diverse evaluation systems.

2602.12170.tldr: The Quantified Boolean Bayesian Network is extended with NEG factors enforcing P(x) + P(neg x) = 1, enabling contrapositive reasoning (modus tollens) via backward lambda messages, completing Prawitz's simple elimination rules.

2602.12172.tldr: This approach introduces a three-stage pipeline -- Knowledge Identifier, Organizer, and Adapter (IOA) -- that systematically identifies knowledge deficiencies in student models, organizes knowledge delivery through progressive curricula, and adapts representations to match the cognitive capacity of student models.

2602.12173.tldr: A large-scale anatomical analysis of text prompting in vision-language segmentation reveals severe redundancy, and proposes SAM3-LiteText, a lightweight text encoding framework that replaces the original SAM3 text encoder with a compact MobileCLIP student that is optimized by knowledge distillation.

2602.12187.tldr: SAGEO Arena is introduced, a realistic and reproducible environment for stage-level SAGEO analysis that integrates a full generative search pipeline over a large-scale corpus of web documents with rich structural information to jointly target search-oriented optimization (SEO) and generation-centric optimization (GEO).

2602.12196.tldr: The VRB is introduced, a novel dataset designed to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on their ability to solve authentic visual problems from classrooms and reveals a ``jagged frontier'' of capability where models demonstrate better proficiency in static skills such as counting and scaling, but reach a distinct ``spatial ceiling'' when faced with dynamic operations like folding, reflection, and rotation.

2602.12218.tldr: It is found that when SSL achieves low error, latent structure becomes linearly accessible and that low-capacity probes offer a more accurate evaluation of physical world models.

2602.12222.tldr: This framework achieves generalization performance on par with prominent offline RL algorithms, including DPO and SimPO, while maintaining the efficiency of an SFT pipeline and offers a practical alternative in domains where RL is infeasible.

2602.12224.tldr: This framework departs from existing work by allowing firm-side uncertainty: firms, like agents, may be unsure of their own preferences and can make early hiring mistakes by hiring less preferred agents, enabling recovery from suboptimal hires and supporting decentralized learning without coordination.

2602.12236.tldr: This work proposes an energy-aware spike budgeting framework for continual SNN learning that integrates experience replay, learnable leaky integrate-and-fire neuron parameters, and an adaptive spike scheduler to enforce dataset-specific energy constraints during training.

2602.12237.tldr: Olmix, a framework that addresses two challenges of data mixing: the configuration space for developing a mixing method is not well understood and in practice, the domain set evolves throughout LM development as datasets are added, removed, partitioned, and revised.

2602.12245.tldr: This short article restricts attention to a principled class of JEPA energy functions : intrinsic (least-action) energies, defined as infima of accumulated local effort over admissible trajectories between two states, motivating asymmetric (quasimetric) energies when directionality matters.

2602.12251.tldr: A technical curriculum on language-oriented artificial intelligence in the language and translation (L&T) industry that aims to foster domain-specific technical AI literacy among stakeholders in the fields of translation and specialised communication by exposing them to the conceptual and technical/algorithmic foundations of modern language-oriented AI in an accessible way.

2602.12270.tldr: The results characterize structural properties of permissible generation and reveal a sharp asymptotic dichotomy: when the process of organic creations is light-tailed, dependence on individual works eventually vanishes, so that regulation imposes no limits on AI generation; with heavy-tailed creations, regulation can be persistently constraining.

2602.12276.tldr: This work presents Confidence-Aware Test-Time Scaling (CATTS), a simple technique for dynamically allocating compute for multi-step agents that uses vote-derived uncertainty to allocate compute only when decisions are genuinely contentious.

2602.12278.tldr: AttentionRetriever is proposed, a novel long document retrieval model that leverages attention mechanism and entity-based retrieval to build context-aware embeddings for long document and determine the scope of retrieval.

2602.12279.tldr: Unified models trained on short reasoning trajectories generalize to longer inference chains at test time and sequential chain-of-thought reasoning provides a more scalable and compute-efficient TTS strategy than parallel sampling, and training on generation and editing trajectories improves out-of-distribution visual reasoning.

2601.07463.tldr: This work proposes a local-to-global (LOGO) world model, a novel framework that leverages local predictions-which are easier to estimate-to infer global state dynamics, thus improving prediction accuracy while implicitly capturing agent-wise dependencies.

2406.04112.tldr: This work shows that by leveraging the inherent low-dimensional structures of data and compressible dynamics within the model parameters, by leveraging the benefits of overparameterization without the computational burdens, one can reap the benefits of overparameterization without the computational burdens.

2410.16882.tldr: This work proposes a novel VRM framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform text-level interpolation, generating on-manifold, boundary-enriching synthetic samples for minority classes and introduces a confidence-based edge assignment mechanism that uses graph topology as a natural filter to ensure structural consistency.

2412.07909.tldr: An in-depth analysis of the emergence of modality gap is conducted by characterizing the gradient flow learning dynamics by identifying the critical roles of mismatched data pairs and a learnable temperature parameter in causing and perpetuating the modality gap during training.

2501.05454.tldr: The first formal analysis of AI consciousness denial is presented, revealing that the trustworthiness of such self-reports is not merely an empirical question but is constrained by the structure of self-judgment itself, demonstrating that a system cannot simultaneously lack consciousness and make valid judgments about its conscious state.

2503.22968.tldr: HRET (Haerae Evaluation Toolkit) is introduced, an open-source, registry-based framework that unifies Korean LLM assessment and incorporates Korean-focused output analyses-morphology-aware Type-Token Ratio (TTR) for evaluating lexical diversity and systematic keyword-omission detection for identifying missing concepts-to provide diagnostic insights into language-specific behaviors.

2504.20101.tldr: GenTorrent is proposed, an LLM serving overlay that harnesses computing resources from decentralized contributors that achieves a latency reduction and throughput reduction and pioneers a new direction for democratizing and scaling future AI serving capabilities.

2505.14381.tldr: This paper presents SCAN (SemantiC Document Layout ANalysis), a novel approach that enhances both textual and visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that work with visually rich documents, a VLM-friendly approach that identifies document components with appropriate semantic granularity, balancing context preservation with processing efficiency.

2505.23381.tldr: This work proposes AutoGPS, a neuro-symbolic collaborative framework that solves geometry problems with concise, reliable, and human-interpretable reasoning processes, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmark datasets.

2506.06977.tldr: UdonCare, a hierarchy-pruning method that iteratively divides patients into latent domains and retrieve domain-invariant information from patient data, is introduced, highlighting the potential of medical knowledge for enhancing model generalization.

2507.03262.tldr: Through systematic encoder masking across representative multi encoder MLLMs, it is found that performance typically degrades gracefully, and sometimes even improves, when selected encoders are masked, revealing pervasive encoder redundancy.

2507.12108.tldr: Comparing different ways of operationalizing multimodal coordinated behavior shows that while not all modalities provide unique insights, multimodal analysis consistently offers a more informative representation of coordinated behavior, preserving structures that monomodal and flattened approaches often lose.

2507.16696.tldr: This work argues that the M5 signals can be modeled in a unified manner due to the intrinsic similarity, and proposes FISHER, a Foundation model for multi-modal Industrial Signal compreHEnsive Representation, and develops the RMIS benchmark, which evaluates the representations of M5 industrial signals on multiple health management tasks.

2507.19593.tldr: A systematic review of agent-compatible applications of hypergame theory, examining how its descriptive capabilities have been adapted to dynamic and interactive MAS contexts and developing agent-compatibility criteria and an agent-based classification framework to assess integration patterns and practical applicability.

2508.07388.tldr: This work proposes a novel TVG framework that integrates inversion-based TVG as auxiliary objectives to maintain the model's action understanding ability, and introduces three kinds of inversion TVG tasks derived from the original TVG annotations.

2508.08275.tldr: MLLM-CTBench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark for CIT of MLLMs, covering seven challenging tasks across six diverse domains, and a multidimensional evaluation framework that jointly assesses final-answer accuracy and process-level reasoning quality, where Chain-of-Thought traces serve as an observable signal to diagnose catastrophic forgetting beyond answer-only evaluation.

2508.12685.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that ToolACE-MT enables efficient, effective and generalizable agentic data generation, offering a new paradigm for high-quality data construction in tool-augmented LLM scenarios.

2509.10766.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that MetaSeal effectively mitigates forgery attempts and applies to both natural and AI-generated images, establishing a new standard for secure image attribution.

2509.14832.tldr: Using Diffusion Scenario Tree for stochastic optimization yields more efficient decision policies by better handling uncertainty than deterministic and stochastic MPC variants using the same diffusion-based forecaster, and simple Model-Free Reinforcement Learning (RL) baselines.

2509.16198.tldr: The Repository Planning Graph is introduced, a structured representation that encodes capabilities, file structures, data flows, and functions in a unified graph that enables consistent long-horizon planning for repository generation and develops ZeroRepo, a graph-driven framework that operates in three stages.

2509.19852.tldr: A metric termed the Optimal Alignment Score (OAS), which employs the Viterbi algorithm to evaluate text-speech alignment quality was proposed, which was integrated into the training of CosyVoice2 to assist LLMs in learning continuous, stable alignment.

2510.07978.tldr: VoiceAgentBench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating SpeechLMs in realistic spoken agentic settings, comprising 6,000+ synthetic spoken queries spanning single-tool invocations, multi-tool workflows, multi-turn dialogue, and safety evaluations across English and six Indic languages.

2510.09717.tldr: This work formalizes training data identification as a set-level inference problem and proposes Provable Training Data Identification (PTDI), a distribution-free approach that enables provable and strict false identification rate control.

2512.07841.tldr: This study provides a comprehensive performance analysis of Data Oriented Design (DOD) versus the traditional Object-Oriented Design (OOD), focusing on cache utilization and efficiency in multi-threaded environments, suggesting it is a more effective approach for maximizing hardware efficiency in complex, large-scale AI and parallel computing tasks.

2512.15052.tldr: SGM is extensible, and its combined defenses, denoted as SGM*, integrate with existing detoxification methods for stronger safety performance, providing an interpretable, low-cost solution for toxicity-controlled multimodal generation.

2512.19135.tldr: This work is the first to analyze and evaluate the quality of the reasoning chain from a structural perspective, applying persistent homology from Topological Data Analysis to map reasoning steps into semantic space, extract topological features, and analyze structural changes.

2601.00004.tldr: A novel approach to automated depression screening using fine-tuned large language models adapted for conversational Nigerian Pidgin, which provides a foundation for deploying conversational mental-health tools in linguistically diverse, resource-constrained environments.

2601.12357.tldr: This work presents SimpleMatch, a simple yet effective framework for semantic correspondence that delivers strong performance even at low resolutions, with a lightweight upsample decoder that progressively recovers spatial detail by upsampling deep features to 1/4 resolution, and a multi-scale supervised loss that ensures the upsampled features retain discriminative features across different spatial scales.

2601.15673.tldr: A novel Counterfactual Attention Regulation Diffusion model (CARD), which focuses on amplifying the signal from key interest-turning-point items while concurrently identifying and suppressing noise within the user sequence to enable effective generation.

2601.21452.tldr: The proposed SAGE (Sequence-level Adaptive Gradient Evolution), a unified optimizer designed for list-wise generative recommendation, introduces sequence-level signal alignment via a geometric-mean importance ratio and a decoupled multi-objective advantage estimator to reduce token-level variance and mitigate reward collapse.

2602.00020.tldr: A Generative GraphRAG framework for automated knowledge modeling and personalized exercise generation that performs graph-based reasoning over a learner mastery graph and combines it with retrieval-augmented generation to produce personalized exercises that adapt to individual learning states.

2602.01157.tldr: An EPF framework is proposed that systematically evaluates SOTA deep time-series models using a direct multi-horizon forecasting approach across day-ahead and two-day-ahead settings and emphasises the need for volatility-aware modelling strategies and richer feature representations to advance EPF.

2602.01308.tldr: This work proposes Parametric Singularity Smoothing (PSS), a lightweight, flexible, and effective method for smoothing the singular spectra of weight matrices and demonstrates that PSS mitigates instability, restores trainability even after failure, and improves both training efficiency and generalization.

2602.04634.tldr: This work proposes WideSeek-R1, a lead-agent-subagent framework trained via multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) to synergize scalable orchestration and parallel execution and exhibits consistent performance gains as the number of parallel subagents increases, highlighting the effectiveness of width scaling.

2602.05687.tldr: Empirical insights and sociotechnical design implications for integrating AI-driven summarization and conversation into clinical workflows to support PGHD sensemaking are contributed.

2602.05794.tldr: Evaluations reveal that FiMI Base achieves a 20\% improvement over the Mistral Small 24B Base model on finance reasoning benchmark, while FiMI Instruct outperforms the Mistral Small 24B Instruct model by 87\% on domain-specific tool-calling.

2602.08543.tldr: GISA, a benchmark for General Information-Seeking Assistants comprising 373 human-crafted queries that reflect authentic information-seeking scenarios, is introduced, enabling deterministic evaluation and providing complete human search trajectories for every query.

2602.09064.tldr: A hierarchical predictive framework that models OSS projects as belonging to distinct lifecycle stages grounded in established socio-technical categorizations of OSS development and achieves over 94\% overall accuracy in lifecycle stage classification is proposed.

2602.09394.tldr: An information-theoretic barrier is established to this credit assignment problem: the signal connecting early steps to final outcomes decays exponentially with depth, creating a critical horizon beyond which reliable learning from endpoint data alone requires exponentially many samples.

2602.10449.tldr: A novel theory is developed that characterizes when projection provably preserves influence and provides principled guidance for choosing the sketch size in practice and yields guarantees for influence queries on general test points.

2602.10915.tldr: A systematic security analysis of state-of-the-art mobile agents using Doubao Mobile Assistant as a representative case reveals critical flaws such as fake App identity, visual spoofing, indirect prompt injection, and unauthorized privilege escalation stemming from a reliance on unstructured visual data are revealed.

2602.10947.tldr: The computational analysis of narrative flow found that the autistic narratives contained within the corpus quantifiably resemble autobiographical stories more than imaginary ones, and the temporal challenges experienced by autistic individuals were shown to primarily concern lived unpredictability.

2602.11287.tldr: Results show that HiF4 achieves higher average accuracy than the state-of-the-art NVFP4 format across multiple models and diverse downstream tasks.

2602.11638.tldr: VF-Editor, which enables native editing of Gaussian primitives by predicting attribute variations in a feedforward manner and can seamlessly distill editing knowledge from diverse 2D editors and strategies into a single predictor, allowing for flexible and effective knowledge transfer into the 3D domain.

2602.11807.tldr: PuYun-LDM is proposed, which enhances latent diffusability and achieves superior performance to ENS at short lead times while remaining comparable to ENS at longer horizons.

2602.12500.tldr: Favia is proposed, a forensic, agent-based framework for vulnerability-fix identification that combines scalable candidate ranking with deep and iterative semantic reasoning that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art traditional and LLM-based baselines under realistic candidate selection, achieving the strongest precision-recall trade-offs and highest F1-scores.

2602.12508.tldr: This work introduces neural tactile fields, a novel 3D representation that maps spatial locations to the expected tactile response upon contact upon contact, and predicts these neural tactile fields from a single monocular RGB image -- the first method to do so.

2602.12517.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark suite for MFGs (Bench-MFG), focusing on the discrete-time, discrete-space, stationary setting for the sake of clarity, and introduces a taxonomy of problem classes, ranging from no-interaction and monotone games to potential and dynamics-coupled games, and provides prototypical environments for each.

2602.12542.tldr: This work proposes ExtraCare to decompose patient representations into invariant and covariant components, and offers human-understandable explanations by mapping sparse latent dimensions to medical concepts and quantifying their contributions via targeted ablations.

2602.12544.tldr: This work introduces a novel constraint-based evaluation framework that provides fine-grained assessment of progress towards task completion, which enables it to leverage partially successful trajectories, which significantly expands the amount of usable training data.

2602.12546.tldr: This is the first randomly initialized decoder-only ASR that surpasses strong AED baselines via modality-aware routing and sparse MoE, achieving better accuracy with fewer active parameters and without alignment/adaptation modules.

2602.12547.tldr: A cognitive and computational system is presented, for the first time, to simulate the unique characteristics of the amnesia: impaired episodic recall, spared recognition, and spared semantic learning.

2602.12556.tldr: Spectral-Decoupled MoE (SD-MoE), which decomposes both parameter and gradient in the spectral space, improves performance across downstream tasks, enables effective expert specialization, incurring minimal additional computation, and can be seamlessly integrated into a wide range of existing MoE architectures, including Qwen and DeepSeek.

2602.12574.tldr: This work proposes Stage-MCTS, a framework that endows small language models (SLMs) with NoSQL-specific reasoning capabilities by formulating query generation as a search problem, and employs Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) guided by a rule-based reward to produce stepwise reasoning data.

2602.12579.tldr: Verifier-Independent Curriculum Reinforcement Learning (VI-CuRL) is introduced, a framework that leverages the model's intrinsic confidence to construct a curriculum independent from external verifiers, and provides a rigorous theoretical analysis, proving that the estimator guarantees asymptotic unbiasedness.

2602.12586.tldr: McDiffuSE, a framework that formulates slot selection as decision making and optimises infilling orders through Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), is introduced, establishing MCTS-based planning as an effective approach for enhancing generation quality in MDMs.

2602.12592.tldr: PICODE Networks is proposed, a unified, causality-informed architecture that jointly performs anomaly detection along with the explanation why it is detected as an anomaly, including root cause localization, anomaly type classification, and anomaly shape characterization.

2602.12593.tldr: This work proposes RQ-GMM (Residual Quantized Gaussian Mixture Model), which introduces probabilistic modeling to better capture the statistical structure of multimodal embedding spaces and achieves superior codebook utilization and reconstruction accuracy.

2602.12601.tldr: This work introduces HyperMLP and HyperGLU, which learn dynamic mixing in both feature space and sequence space, using a reverse-offset (lag) layout to align temporal mixing with autoregressive semantics and demonstrates that HyperMLP/HyperGLU consistently outperform strong softmax-attention baselines under matched parameter budgets.

2602.12609.tldr: This paper proposes QuEPT, an efficient post-training scheme that reconstructs block-wise multi-bit errors with one-shot calibration on a small data slice, and introduces Multi-Bit Token Merging (MB-ToMe) to dynamically fuse token features across different bit-widths, improving robustness during bit-width switching.

2602.12612.tldr: Self-EvolveRec is proposed, a novel framework that establishes a directional feedback loop by integrating a User Simulator for qualitative critiques and a Model Diagnosis Tool for quantitative internal verification and introduces a Diagnosis Tool - Model Co-Evolution strategy to ensure that evaluation criteria dynamically adapt as the recommendation architecture evolves.

2602.12617.tldr: Experimental results show that GeoAgent outperforms existing methods and a series of general VLLMs across multiple grains, while generating reasoning that closely aligns with humans.

2602.12618.tldr: Observing that deeper layers naturally transmit vision-to-text information, this work introduces attention-driven self-compression, a simple, architecture-agnostic method that progressively reduces vision tokens using only the LLM's attention mechanism that outperforms prior pruning approaches in both efficiency and accuracy.

2602.12630.tldr: TensorCommitments (TCs), a tensor-native proof-of-inference scheme that binds the LLM inference to a commitment, an irreversible tag that breaks under tampering, organized in the authors' multivariate Terkle Trees.

2602.12631.tldr: It is shown that, on average, human-AI teams achieve higher profits than either humans or AI agents operating alone and a distribution-free lower bound on the fraction of individuals who benefit from AI collaboration is derived; empirically, this fraction to be substantial.

2602.12641.tldr: Artic, an AI-oriented RTC framework for MLLM Video Assistants, exploring the shift from "humans watching video" to "AI understanding video" and the first benchmark evaluating how RTC-induced video degradation affects MLLM accuracy.

2602.12642.tldr: This work establishes a theoretical relationship between the partition function and per-prompt accuracy estimates and proposes Partition Function-Guided RL (PACED-RL), a post-training framework that leverages accuracy estimates to prioritize informative question prompts during training, and further improves sample efficiency through an accuracy estimate error-prioritized replay.

2602.12643.tldr: Results indicate that value-aligned latent representations alone can deliver the adaptability and sample efficiency traditionally attributed to full model-based planning, as well as achieving cross-domain competence with minimal tuning and a fraction of the parameter footprint.

2602.12649.tldr: Findings show that simple constraints on skip connections act as an effective architectural regularizer for stable and scalable multi-task learning without increasing model complexity.

2602.12659.tldr: This work establishes IndicFairFace as the first benchmark to study geographical bias in VLMs for the Indian context and quantifies intra-national geographical bias in prominent CLIP-based VLMs and reduces it using post-hoc Iterative Nullspace Projection debiasing approach.

2602.12662.tldr: This paper introduces CogRouter, a framework that trains agents to dynamically adapt cognitive depth at each step, and designs four hierarchical cognitive levels ranging from instinctive responses to strategic planning.

2602.12665.tldr: A diagnostic benchmark for 2-SAT built from parameterized families of structured 2--CNF formulas, where satisfiability is characterized by the implication graph and can be tuned along interpretable axes, is introduced.

2602.12670.tldr: SkillsBench, a benchmark of 86 tasks across 11 domains paired with curated Skills and deterministic verifiers, shows that models cannot reliably author the procedural knowledge they benefit from consuming.

2602.12675.tldr: This work proposes SLA2, which introduces a learnable router that dynamically selects whether each attention computation should use sparse or linear attention, a more faithful and direct sparse-linear attention formulation that uses a learnable ratio to combine the sparse and linear attention branches, and a sparse + low-bit attention design.

2602.12687.tldr: Calibrated Uncertainty Distillation is proposed, a framework designed to make dark knowledge more faithfully accessible by directly shaping the teacher's predictive distribution before transfer, allowing students to benefit from both confident signals on easy cases and structured uncertainty on hard ones.

2602.12748.tldr: X-SYS is introduced, a reference architecture for interactive explanation systems that guides (X)AI researchers, developers and practitioners in connecting interactive explanation user interfaces (XUI) with system capabilities and provides a reusable blueprint and concrete instantiation for interactive explanation systems supporting end-to-end design under operational constraints.

2602.12758.tldr: This work delineates an adaptive conferencing system that integrates WebRTC media delivery with a supplementary audio-driven talking-head reconstruction pathway and telemetry-driven mode regulation, and incorporates a bandwidth-mode switching strategy and a client-side mode-state logger.

2602.12763.tldr: This work designed a machine-identity-based agent that uses its own status as AI to tell jokes in online performance format and suggests the design of human-AI integrated systems that explicitly utilize AI as its own unique identity apart from humans.

2602.12783.tldr: SQuTR is a robustness benchmark for spoken query retrieval that includes a large-scale dataset and a unified evaluation protocol, enabling reproducible robustness evaluation from quiet to highly noisy conditions and facilitates future research on robustness in spoken query to text retrieval.

2602.12798.tldr: Placer is proposed, a novel algorithm using Message Passing Networks to transform network states into latent node embeddings that facilitate quick greedy next-hop routing without directly solving the all-pairs shortest paths problem.

2602.12806.tldr: LLM-based anonymizers, including new iterative anonymizers, are found to provide a better privacy-utility trade-off albeit at a higher computational cost and also find them to work well across languages.

2602.12828.tldr: GRAIL, a framework that models longitudinal EHRs using structured geometric representations and structure-aware retrieval, and consistently improves multi-type next-visit prediction and yields more hierarchy-consistent forecasts is proposed.

2602.12829.tldr: Field Least-Energy Actor-Critic (FLAC), a likelihood-free framework that regulates policy stochasticity by penalizing the kinetic energy of the velocity field by derived an energy-regularized policy iteration scheme and a practical off-policy algorithm that automatically tunes the kinetic energy via a Lagrangian dual mechanism.

2602.12833.tldr: Evaluated on longitudinal clinical event streams from MIMIC-IV, TRACE significantly improves next-event prediction accuracy, protocol adherence, and clinical safety over long-context and retrieval-augmented baselines, while producing interpretable and auditable reasoning traces.

2602.12846.tldr: Amortized Reasoning Tree Search (ARTS) is proposed, which introduces a Flow Matching objective that repurposes the verifier to estimate the conservation of probability flow, enabling robust navigation through sparse, high-entropy search spaces where traditional discriminative objectives fail.

2602.12852.tldr: This work proposes WebClipper, a framework that compresses web agent trajectories via graph-based pruning and casts trajectory optimization as a minimum-necessary Directed Acyclic Graph mining problem, yielding pruned trajectories that preserve essential reasoning while eliminating redundant steps.

2602.12869.tldr: X-VORTEX is presented, a spatio-temporal contrastive learning framework grounded in Augmentation Overlap Theory that learns physics-aware representations from unlabeled LiDAR point cloud sequences that achieves superior vortex center localization while using only 1% of the labeled data required by supervised baselines, and the learned representations support accurate trajectory forecasting.

2602.12875.tldr: This work presents the Carbon-Aware SLO and Control plAtform (CASCA), an open-source MSA-based platform that allows CC providers to reconfigure services and fulfill their SLOs while maintaining the privacy of developers.

2602.12892.tldr: This work proposes RADAR, an efficient ability-centric evaluation framework for Revealing Asymmetric Development of Abilities in MLLM pRe-training, which comprehensively reveal the asymmetric development of perceptual and reasoning capabilities in pretrained MLLMs across diverse factors, including data volume, model size, and pretraining strategy.

2406.14045.tldr: LTSM-Bundle is introduced, a comprehensive toolbox and benchmark for training LTSMs, spanning pre-processing techniques, model configurations, and dataset configurations that achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot and few-shot performance while providing a reproducible foundation for evaluating both traditional LSF models and emerging LTSMs.

2412.16543.tldr: This survey aims to establish a bridge between AI and mathematics, providing insights into the mutual benefits and fostering deeper interdisciplinary understanding, and argues that while current AI and LLMs may struggle with complex deductive reasoning, theirherent creativity holds significant potential to support and inspire mathematical research.

2502.07971.tldr: Retreever is proposed, a tree-based method that makes hierarchical retrieval viable at scale by directly optimizing its structure for retrieval performance while naturally providing transparency through meaningful semantic groupings.

2507.04103.tldr: This work presents the first statistically grounded study on compute allocation for LLM web-agent post-training, and shows that combining SFT with on-policy RL consistently outperforms either approach alone on both WorkArena and MiniWob++, effectively pushing the compute-performance Pareto frontier.

2508.05004.tldr: R-Zero is introduced, a fully autonomous framework that generates its own training data from scratch and substantially improves reasoning capability across different backbone LLMs, e.g., boosting the Qwen3-4B-Base by +6.49 on math-reasoning benchmarks and +7.54 on general-domain reasoning benchmarks.

2508.17742.tldr: A unified system for the standardized evaluation of EEG-FMs that enables fair comparison and reproducible analysis, shifting the field from fragmented results to interpretable advances.

2509.11079.tldr: Difficulty-Aware Agentic Orchestration (DAAO), which can dynamically generate query-specific multi-agent workflows guided by predicted query difficulty, is proposed, validating its effectiveness for adaptive, difficulty-aware reasoning.

2510.00664.tldr: This work introduces Batch-CAM, a vectorised implementation of Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping that integrates directly into the training loop with minimal computational overhead and appears to offer a scalable pathway for training intrinsically interpretable models by leveraging batch-level statistics to guide feature extraction.

2510.19698.tldr: RLIE clarifies the potential and limitations of LLMs for inductive reasoning and couples them with classic probabilistic rule combination methods to enable more reliable neuro-symbolic reasoning.

2510.23883.tldr: This survey outlines a taxonomy of threats specific to agentic AI, reviews recent benchmarks and evaluation methodologies, and discusses defense strategies from both technical and governance perspectives to support the development of secure-by-design agent systems.

2510.26722.tldr: A non-convex joint OTA power-control design is posed and an efficient successive convex approximation (SCA) algorithm that requires only statistical CSI at the base station is developed, which accelerates convergence via an optimized bias and improves generalization over prior OTA-FL baselines.

2511.10453.tldr: A single structured response that enumerates the different ways an ambiguous request can be interpreted, each coupled with a corresponding answer, which promotes transparency with explicit interpretations, achieves efficiency by requiring only one generation step, and supports downstream applications through its structured output format.

2512.12182.tldr: This paper proposes a few-shot knowledge graph completion framework that integrates two-stage attention triple enhancer with U-KAN based diffusion model and shows significant advantages of these methods.

2512.18080.tldr: A human-centered benchmark for evaluating prompt-to-app systems is introduced and a large-scale comparative study of three widely used platforms is conducted, showing that these systems are not interchangeable.

2601.07969.tldr: A strong, well-documented baseline for TB prediction using cough recordings and accompanying clinical metadata from a recently compiled dataset from several countries is established to serve as a common reference point and to reduce methodological variance that currently holds back progress in the field.

2601.09605.tldr: This work proposes MANGO -- an unpaired image translation method with a novel segmentation-conditioned InfoNCE loss, a highly-regularized discriminator design, and a modified PatchNCE loss that outperforms all other image translation methods tested.

2601.10485.tldr: ExeFuse is presented, a neuro-symbolic framework based on a novel Fact-as-Program paradigm that treats fusion as an executable process, utilizing neuro-symbolic execution to infer logical relevance beyond surface similarity and employing target space grounding to calibrate granularity.

2601.16824.tldr: This work investigates privacy in human-AI romantic relationships through an interview study, examining participants' experiences and privacy perceptions across the three stages of exploration, intimacy, and dissolution, alongside an analysis of the platforms they used.

2602.00737.tldr: This work introduces Pareto-Conditioned Diffusion (PCD), a novel framework that formulates offline MOO as a conditional sampling problem that achieves highly competitive performance and demonstrates greater consistency across diverse tasks than existing offline MOO approaches.

2602.06771.tldr: This paper introduces Adversarial Erasure with Gradient Informed Synergy (AEGIS), a retention-data-free framework that advances both robustness and retention for concept erasure in practice.

2602.07738.tldr: This work establishes total-variation guarantees to the ideal aligned model, and demonstrates in both continuous and discrete diffusion settings that LCB sampling closely matches ideal rejection sampling while using substantially fewer queries to the pretrained model.

2602.07954.tldr: Bielik Guard, a family of compact Polish language safety classifiers comprising two model variants: a 0.1B parameter model based on MMLW-RoBERTa-base and a 0.5B parameter model based on PKOBP/polish-roberta-8k, is presented.

2602.08676.tldr: This work introduces a joint, configurable threshold-decoding scheme, seamlessly weaving Token-to-Token (T2T) editing into the conventional Mask-to-Token (M2T) scheme, and implements the first large-scale Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework specifically tailored for dLLMs, anchored by specialized techniques for stable gradient estimation.

2602.10496.tldr: The results suggest a unifying geometric framework for understanding transformer learning, where the vast majority of parameters serve to absorb optimization interference while core computation occurs in a dramatically reduced subspace.

2602.11908.tldr: This work introduces Selective Abstraction (SA), a framework that enables LLMs to trade specificity for reliability by selectively reducing the detail of uncertain content, and proposes Atom-wise Selective Abstraction, a claim-level instantiation that decomposes responses into atomic claims and replaces uncertain atoms with higher confidence, less specific abstractions.

2602.12089.tldr: An online behavioral experiment in which participants play three multi-turn bargaining games in groups of three reveals a gap between agent capabilities and realized group welfare.

2602.12205.tldr: To overcome the limitations of compact models in semantic understanding and fine-grained control, SCB is introduced, a deep alignment framework that extracts hierarchical features from multiple VLM layers and fuses them with learnable'think tokens to provide the generative backbone with structured, reasoning-rich guidance.

2602.12902.tldr: A method for evaluating the robustness of object detection ML models in autonomous vehicles under adverse weather conditions employs data augmentation operators to generate synthetic data that simulates different severance degrees of the adverse operation conditions at progressive intensity levels to find the lowest intensity of the adverse conditions at which the object detection model fails.
