2602.12917.tldr: The proposed robotic ultrasound framework enables radiation-reduced, real-time 3D visualization of spinal motion, offering a promising 3D alternative to conventional dynamic X-ray imaging for assessing spinal instability.

2602.12919.tldr: A novel multi-modal fusion paradigm for VPR is proposed: leveraging LLMs to generate textual scene descriptions from raw event streams, which then guide spatially attentive token selection, cross-modal feature fusion, and multi-scale representation learning.

2602.12933.tldr: This approach enables robust atlas registration of pathological brain MRI without lesion masks and supports reproducible multi-centre analyses and facilitates reproducible research and extension to other brain tumours and neurological pathologies.

2602.12952.tldr: Theseus is introduced, a training-free method for transporting task-specific updates across heterogeneous models and shows that task updates can be meaningfully transferred across architectures when task identity is defined functionally rather than parametrically.

2602.12962.tldr: This work proposes TriGen, a novel NPU architecture tailored for resource-constrained environments through software-hardware co-design that adopts low-precision computation using microscaling (MX) to enable additional optimization opportunities while preserving accuracy, and resolves the issues that arise by employing such precision.

2602.12963.tldr: This work quantifies the amount of information an optimal policy provides about the underlying environment and proves that observing a deterministic policy that is optimal for any non-constant reward function then conveys exactly n bits of information about the environment.

2602.12968.tldr: RGAlign-Rec, a closed-loop alignment framework that integrates an LLM-based semantic reasoner with a Query-Enhanced (QE) ranking model, and Ranking-Guided Alignment (RGA), a multi-stage training paradigm that utilizes downstream ranking signals as feedback to refine the LLM's latent reasoning.

2602.12975.tldr: It is shown how the ECE approach can be extended from assessing confidence calibration to assessing the calibration of any metric of variation, and it is demonstrated that the VCE has the desired property of approaching zero as the number of data samples increases.

2602.12976.tldr: This paper presents a novel method, VAE++ESDD, which employs incremental learning and two-level ensembling: an ensemble of Variational AutoEncoder(VAEs) for anomaly prediction, along with an ensemble of concept drift detectors, each utilizing a statistical-based concept drift mechanism.

2602.12978.tldr: Legato is proposed, a training-time continuation method for action-chunked flow-based VLA policies that initializes denoising from a schedule-shaped mixture of known actions and noise, exposing the model to partial action information.

2602.12983.tldr: This work proposes interpreting object tracking as a sequential hypothesis test, wherein evidence for or against tracking failures is gradually accumulated over time and can offer a statistically grounded and efficient mechanism to incorporate safety assurances into real-time tracking systems.

2602.12996.tldr: This work proposes a novel meta-cognitive framework for reliable knowledge augmentation via differentiated intervention and alignment that leverages internal cognitive signals to partition the knowledge space into mastered, confused, and missing regions, guiding targeted knowledge expansion.

2602.13017.tldr: It is shown that liquid-capacitance-extended models lead to interpretable behavior even in dense, all-to-all recurrent neural network (RNN) policies and that incorporating chemical synapses improves interpretability and that combining chemical synapses with synaptic activation yields the most accurate and interpretable RNN models.

2602.13035.tldr: In introspective LLM, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that learns to control sampling temperature during generation, experiments show that learned temperature policies outperform fixed and heuristic baselines, while exhibiting interpretable exploration behaviors aligned with reasoning uncertainty.

2602.13045.tldr: GMR (Geometric Manifold Rectification), a novel framework designed to robustly handle imbalanced structured data by exploiting local geometric priors, is proposed, which makes two contributions: Geometric confidence estimation that uses inverse-distance weighted kNN voting with an adaptive distance metric to capture local reliability.

2602.13047.tldr: It is found that current AI models show bias against multilingual individuals from ethnic minority backgrounds in the UK, and they are also more likely to misclassify speakers with a certain accent as living with a more severe cognitive decline.

2602.13055.tldr: Curriculum-DPO++ is introduced, an enhanced method that combines the original data-level curriculum with a novel model-level curriculum and dynamically increase the learning capacity of the denoising network as training advances, outperforming the competing methods in terms of text alignment, aesthetics and human preference.

2602.13061.tldr: Diverging Flows is introduced, a novel approach that enables a single model to simultaneously perform conditional generation and native extrapolation detection by structurally enforcing inefficient transport for off-manifold inputs.

2602.13071.tldr: This work proposes MobTA, the first approach to introduce task arithmetic into trajectory generation, and models the parameter shift from bus-timetable-based trajectory generation to mobility trajectory generation in source city, and applies this shift to target city through arithmetic operations on task vectors.

2602.13087.tldr: This work investigates whether transforming time series into discrete latent representations-using methods such as Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoders and Discrete Variational Autoencoders-not only preserves but enhances explainability by reducing redundancy and focusing on the most informative patterns.

2602.13088.tldr: This paper develops'cyborg propaganda,'a closed-loop architecture combining verified human accounts with algorithmic automation to generate personalized content at scale, as a distinct and undertheorized threat to democratic discourse.

2602.13106.tldr: This work proposes a general theoretical framework that characterizes the sufficient conditions under which MPNNs can learn an algorithm from a training set of small instances and provably approximate its behavior on inputs of arbitrary size, and derives more expressive MPNN-like architectures that overcome these limitations.

2602.13135.tldr: This paper proposes a novel notion of constrained ABA (CABA), whose components, as well as arguments built from them, may include constrained variables, ranging over possibly infinite domains.

2602.13156.tldr: This work proposes to leverage large language models' (LLM) pre-trained security knowledge and in-context learning to create an end-to-end agentic solution for incident response planning, which achieves recovery up to 23% faster than those of frontier LLMs.

2602.13165.tldr: Krites is introduced, an asynchronous, LLM-judged caching policy that expands static coverage without changing serving decisions and increases the fraction of requests served with curated static answers by up to3.9 times for conversational traffic and search-style queries relative to tuned baselines.

2602.13166.tldr: A three stage Takagi Sugeno Kang fuzzy layer is designed that modulates constraint radii, urgency levels, and activation decisions based on regulatory separation minima and airworthiness guidelines from FAA and EASA to enable adaptive constraint handling for unmanned aircraft.

2602.13191.tldr: This work introduces lightweight transformer-based encoders that aggregate codec primitives and align their representations with image encoder embeddings through a pre-training strategy that accelerates convergence during end-to-end fine-tuning.

2207.12381.tldr: A novel deep learning system is developed to accurately identify multiple cardiovascular abnormalities by using only three ECG leads, which can make ECG more prevalent as it can be conveniently recorded by portable or wearable devices.

2303.09807.tldr: TKN is the first real-time video prediction solution that achieves a prediction rate of 1,176 fps, significantly reducing computation costs while maintaining other performance, suggesting that TKN has great application potential.

2312.00326.tldr: This study introduces a novel agent-powered LLM-based design paradigm for OM systems, namely Agent-OM (Agent for Ontology Matching), consisting of two Siamese agents for retrieval and matching, with a set of OM tools.

2312.02355.tldr: This work provides clarity on when sample efficient OPS is possible, primarily by connecting OPS to off-policy policy evaluation (OPE) and Bellman error (BE) estimation and proposing a BE method for OPS, called Identifiable BE Selection (IBES), that has a straightforward method for selecting its own hyperparameters.

2404.08634.tldr: Inheritune is introduced, a simple yet powerful training recipe designed to build smaller, stronger language models that can match or even surpass the performance of their larger counterparts, despite having significantly fewer layers.

2405.13929.tldr: This work constructs Vikhr, a series of bilingual open-source instruction-following LLMs designed specifically for the Russian language, which features an adapted tokenizer vocabulary and undergoes the continued pre-training and instruction tuning of all weights.

2405.14273.tldr: This work shows that a broad class of gradient-based optimization methods, including projected subgradient descent (PSGD), reaches the minimum suboptimality loss value in a finite number of iterations, thereby exactly solving the DDIOP for MILPs.

2406.04955.tldr: An experimental evaluation of ROS-Causal both in simulation and on a new dataset of human-robot spatial interactions in a lab scenario, to assess its performance and effectiveness and demonstrates how causal models can be extracted directly onboard by robots during data collection.

2408.10746.tldr: PAC+ is proposed, a resourceefficient collaborative edge AI framework for in-situ personal LLM fine-tuning that significantly outperforms existing collaborative edge training systems, and reduces memory footprint by up to 88.16%.

2410.10481.tldr: Llamdex is introduced, a novel framework that facilitates LLM customization as a service, where the client uploads pre-trained domain-specific models rather than data, and maintains inference efficiency comparable to the original LLM service.

2410.15756.tldr: This paper introduces SAFE, a framework that overcomes the lack of human-written proofs to enable automated proof generation of Rust code and improves the capability of open-source models, initially unacquainted with formal verification, to automatically write proofs for Rust code.

2411.06403.tldr: The empirical results support the view that explicit structural priors (history/differences or multiple rollout channels) are important in the FSQI/AC0 regime, and derive two structural bypasses.

2411.16085.tldr: This work proposes a one-line modification in Pytorch to any momentum-based optimizer, which is renamed cautious optimizer, e.g. C-AdamW and C-Lion, showing not only consistent speed-up on LLM pretraining, but also image classification, with minimum extra tuning on hyperparameters.

2412.00686.tldr: This work proposes a simple yet effective baseline method that enhances LVLMs' counting ability for large numbers of objects using a divide-and-conquer approach, and incorporates a mechanism to prevent objects from being split during division, which could otherwise lead to repetitive counting.

2501.07575.tldr: Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and IPC settings demonstrate that CV-DD consistently outperforms single- and multi-model distillation methods and generalizes well to non-training-based frameworks and challenging synthetic-to-real transfer tasks.

2501.15889.tldr: This paper challenges the status quo by introducing an easy-to-use technique to learn an unbounded width of a neural network's layer during training, and jointly optimizes the width and the parameters of each layer via standard backpropagation.

2501.17168.tldr: EvoGP is a high-performance framework tailored for GPU acceleration of TGP via population-level parallel execution that introduces a tensorized representation that encodes variable-sized trees into fixed-shape, memory-aligned arrays, enabling uniform memory access and parallel computation across diverse individuals.

2502.12581.tldr: This work characterises the conditions under which MV achieves the theoretically optimal lower bound on label estimation error and captures the tolerable limits on annotation noise under which MV can optimally recover labels for a given class distribution.

2502.16730.tldr: RapidPen aims to make penetration testing more accessible and cost-efficient, thereby enhancing the overall security posture of modern software ecosystems and underscores the potential of truly autonomous pentesting for both security novices and seasoned professionals.

2502.20326.tldr: The results demonstrate that APF-shaped DRL and GAT-driven cooperation can translate to reliable real-world SAR operations, and demonstrate an ability to navigate complex indoor environments, securing first place in the 2024 NATO-Sapience Autonomous Cooperative Drone Competition.

2503.01884.tldr: This paper proposes a quantum multi-task learning (QMTL) architecture, specifically, the share-and-specify ansatz, that integrates task-specific operators controlled by quantum labels, enabling the simultaneous and efficient training of multiple assets on the same quantum circuit as well as enabling efficient portfolio representation with logarithmic overhead in the number of qubits.

2503.13194.tldr: This work proposes to enhance the agent's ontology and extend the traditional conceptualisation of trajectories to provide a more nuanced view of task execution, and integrates SETLE with reinforcement learning and shows measurable improvements in downstream performance.

2503.17644.tldr: This work presents the first sample complexity bound for BRL, establishing a rate of $\mathcal{O}(\epsilon^{-3})$ in continuous state-action spaces and addresses the computational bottleneck of hypergradient estimation by proposing a fully first-order, Hessian-free algorithm suitable for large-scale problems.

2504.06193.tldr: Surprisingly, it is found that stronger teachers do not always produce stronger students: MLPs distilled from GNN4LP can underperform those distilled from simpler GNNs, while weaker heuristic methods can teach MLPs to near-GNN performance with drastically reduced training costs.

2504.20426.tldr: RV-Syn, a novel Rational and Verifiable mathematical Synthesis approach that constructs a structured mathematical operation function library based on initial seed problems and generates computational graphs as solutions by combining Python-formatted functions from this library, achieves solution-guided logic-aware problem generation.

2504.20903.tldr: By elevating task decomposition as the central design principle, this work provides a generalizable framework for strategic decision-making involving agentic AI across diverse organizational settings and reveals that effective AI-human collaboration depends less on industry context and more on task architecture: the division of labor, sequencing, and interdependence structure.

2504.21205.tldr: It is found that state-of-the-art LLMs struggle with generating correct and secure code completions, but code agents significantly outperform standalone LLMs and code agents across 3 state-of-the-art agent frameworks using the SecRepoBench benchmark.

2505.06795.tldr: Under a linearized decoder assumption, a design-motivating bound is derived on the amortization gap based on encoder-optimizer distance, with convergence rates under mild conditions; empirical checks confirm the bound is predictive for the deployed MLP decoder.

2505.07671.tldr: This work introduces ChemRAG-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically assess the effectiveness of RAG across a diverse set of chemistry-related tasks, and presents ChemRAG-Toolkit, a modular and extensible RAG toolkit that supports five retrieval algorithms and eight LLMs.

2505.07861.tldr: This paper proposes Caprese, a resource-efficient distillation method to recover lost capabilities from deploying efficient inference methods, focused primarily in feedforward blocks, and integrates cleanly into existing model layers to reduce latency.

2505.11771.tldr: This study investigates a simple yet remarkably effective strategy: augmenting frozen, pretrained source-side features with a trainable target-side encoder that adapts target features to capture residual signals overlooked by models pretrained on the source data, and shows it is sufficient to provably prevent negative transfer.

2505.11839.tldr: A decompositional strategy is proposed that breaks down the counterfactual generation from causality construction to the reasoning over counterfactual interventions and contributes to the development of more reliable LLM-based reasoning systems and informs future elicitation strategies.

2505.12641.tldr: A dual-prior interaction framework based on lightweight transmission prior generation and effective prior fusion that achieves deep fusion of both priors, fully exploiting their complementary information is proposed.

2505.13766.tldr: This paper surveys the intersection of LLM-based SQA methods and recognized standards, highlighting how AI-driven solutions can augment traditional approaches while maintaining compliance and process maturity.

2505.19645.tldr: This work demonstrates that, under medium batch sizes, MoE surprisingly benefits more from SD than dense models and introduces a new metric'target efficiency that characterizes these effects, thus helping researchers identify system bottlenecks and understand SD acceleration more comprehensively.

2506.00494.tldr: The proposed methodology can be used to improve the design and grasping performance of soft grippers, aiding to choose a design not only for delicate grasping but also for high-force applications.

2506.02634.tldr: This paper presents the first systematic characterization of the KV\$ workload patterns from one of the leading LLM service providers and proposes a workload-aware cache eviction policy that improves the serving performance under real-world traces, especially with limited cache capacity.

2506.02873.tldr: It is found that many open and closed-weight models are frequently willing to attempt persuasion on harmful topics and that jailbreaking can increase willingness to engage in such behavior.

2506.03407.tldr: This work presents MS-Splatting -- a multi-spectral 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that is able to generate multi-view consistent novel views from images of multiple, independent cameras with different spectral domains, and demonstrates the effectiveness of this new technique in agricultural applications to render vegetation indices.

2506.04051.tldr: This work proposes post-training an LLM to generate content only when confident in its correctness and to otherwise (partially) abstain, and finetune four open-source models for biography writing, mathematics, coding, and medicine with HALT for three different trade-off thresholds.

2506.08672.tldr: RuleReasoner is introduced, an effective method for rule-based reasoning via a wide collection of curated tasks and a novel domain-aware dynamic sampling approach in RL that facilitates domain balance and active learning schedules for RL, obviating static mix-training engineered by human.

2506.11087.tldr: This work proposes PrinMix, a rigorous SVD-based framework that models quantization as an optimization problem, grounding the design in mathematical mechanisms, and model the quantization scheme as a 0/1 Integer Linear Programming (ILP) problem, which yields optimal bit-budget-constrained solutions without empirical assumptions.

2506.12362.tldr: HYPER is proposed as a foundation model for link prediction, which can generalize to any knowledge hypergraph, including novel entities and novel relations, and consistently outperforms all existing methods in both node-only and node-and-relation inductive settings.

2506.15715.tldr: This work replaces symbolic regression with tensor decomposition (TD) to discover optimal neuronal formulations, offering enhanced stability and faster convergence and establishes theoretical guarantees that modifying the aggregation functions with common activation functions can empower a network with a fixed number of parameters to approximate any continuous function with an arbitrarily small error.

2506.20430.tldr: DeepRare is presented, a multi-agent system for rare disease differential diagnosis decision support powered by large language models, integrating over 40 specialized tools and up-to-date knowledge sources, demonstrating how the latest powerful large-language-model-driven agentic systems can reshape current clinical workflows.

2506.22447.tldr: A multi-variable Vision Transformer architecture with a shared encoder and variable-specific decoders (1EMD) that consistently outperforms alternative multi-variable baselines and substantially reduces computational cost.

2507.04704.tldr: This work introduces SPATIA, a multi-level generative and predictive model that learns unified, spatially aware representations by fusing morphology, gene expression, and spatial context from the cell to the tissue level, and incorporates a novel spatially conditioned generative framework for predicting cell morphologies under perturbations.

2507.14186.tldr: A dual strategy comprising expert knowledge-based feature compression and disentangled representation learning is introduced, which reduces feature space complexity by leveraging communications expertise, and enhances model generalizability through the integration of propagation models and distinct subnetworks that capture and aggregate the semantic representations of latent features.

2507.16713.tldr: Experiments on four challenging robotic tasks show that STM-based self-reflection increases task success rates from 35% to 84%, with emergent intelligent object interactions, and highlights the effectiveness and generalizability of PragmaBot.

2507.19457.tldr: This work introduces GEPA (Genetic-Pareto), a prompt optimizer that thoroughly incorporates natural language reflection to learn high-level rules from trial and error, and demonstrates promising results as an inference-time search strategy for code optimization.

2508.01055.tldr: FGBench is introduced, a dataset comprising 625K molecular property reasoning problems with functional group information that will serve as a foundational framework for generating new question-answer pairs, enabling LLMs to better understand fine-grained molecular structure-property relationships.

2508.03346.tldr: A novel CoT compression framework based on step entropy, a metric that quantifies the informational contribution of individual reasoning steps to identify redundancy, which significantly improves LLM inference efficiency while preserving accuracy, paving the way for more scalable LLM deployments and a better understanding of their internal reasoning.

2508.03882.tldr: This paper proposes to integrate SCE into Breach Attack Simulation (BAS) platforms, leveraging adversary profiles and abilities from existing threat intelligence databases, using a structured architecture composed of three layers: SCE Orchestrator, Connector, and BAS layers.

2508.06361.tldr: This framework introduces two statistical metrics derived from psychological principles to quantify the likelihood of deception, and investigates LLMs'self-initiated deception on benign prompts.

2508.07428.tldr: DeepLight leverages multi-source meteorological data, including radar reflectivity, cloud properties, and historical lightning occurrences through a dual-encoder architecture, and addresses the spatio-temporal uncertainty of lightning by penalizing deviations based on proximity to true events, enabling the model to better learn patterns amidst randomness.

2508.07514.tldr: A segmentation framework that integrates vision foundation models (DINOv2) with hierarchical taxonomic inference with structured biological hierarchies for scalable, shift-resilient agricultural monitoring is evaluated, illustrating the practical viability of combining foundation models with structured biological hierarchies for scalable, shift-resilient agricultural monitoring.

2508.08500.tldr: An extensive analysis over several tasks of the Ontology Alignment Evaluation Initiative (OAEI) is conducted, reporting in this paper the performance of several state-of-the-art LLMs using different prompt templates.

2508.13213.tldr: This analysis reveals that elite AI players sustain substantially higher levels of strategic tension for longer durations than top human grandmasters, and finds that cumulative tension scales with algorithmic complexity in AI systems and increases linearly with skill level (Elo rating) in human play.

2508.19278.tldr: This study demonstrates that CybORG can be extended with additional realistic functionality, while maintaining its ability to generate informative training signals for RL agents.

2508.21285.tldr: This approach can map LLM-generated economic forecasts to concepts such as sentiment, technical analysis, and timing, and compute their relative importance without reducing performance, and is transparent, lightweight, and replicable for empirical research in the social sciences.

2509.00955.tldr: An Adaptive Resampling-based Training (ART) method that periodically updates the distribution of the training data based on the class-wise performance of the model, which allows the model to incrementally shift its attention towards underperforming classes in a way that better aligns with the optimization objective.

2509.05311.tldr: By guiding initial training with an LLM, this study improves baseline performance and reduces the need for exploratory actions with obviously negative outcomes and achieves over 2x higher rewards during early training and converges to a favorable policy approximately 4,500 episodes faster than the baseline.

2509.12456.tldr: The results suggest that the reinforcement learning agent can effectively be used under non-stationary market conditions, and that the proposed simulator-based environment can serve as a valuable tool for training and pre-training reinforcement learning agents in market-making scenarios.

2509.13229.tldr: A novel curriculum multi-task self-supervised learning framework designed for lightweight architectures for HSI analysis that simultaneously addresses spatial and spectral reasoning within a unified and computationally efficient design, being particularly suitable for training lightweight models for onboard satellite deployment.

2509.13550.tldr: This analysis relies on a non-degenerate lifting that embeds hard single-objective instances into MOO instances with distinct objectives and non-singleton Pareto fronts while preserving lower bounds on $\mathcal{G}$.

2509.17196.tldr: This work tracks linear interpretable feature evolution across pre-training snapshots using a sparse dictionary learning method called crosscoders and finds that most features begin to form around a specific point, while more complex patterns emerge in later training stages.

2509.18008.tldr: The platform's modular design allows seamless adaptation of classic CSCW experiments and manipulation of theory-grounded interaction controls and demonstrates the platform's research efficacy and usability through three case studies.

2509.18776.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark designed to quantify the strengths and limitations of current LLMs in the AEC domain is established and an"LLM-as-a-Judge"approach was introduced to provide a scalable and consistent methodology for evaluating complex, long-form responses leveraging expert-derived rubrics.

2509.22067.tldr: It is shown that precise control over model internals does not guarantee precise control over model behavior, and it is shown that combining 20 randomly sampled vectors that jailbreak a single prompt creates a universal attack.

2509.22794.tldr: This work proposes a noisy two-stage gradient descent algorithm that ensures $\rho$-zero-concentrated differential privacy by injecting carefully calibrated noise into the gradient updates, and derives precise bounds quantifying the trade-off among optimization, privacy, and sampling error.

2509.23519.tldr: ReliabilityRAG is introduced, a framework for adversarial robustness that explicitly leverages reliability information of retrieved documents that provides superior robustness against adversarial attacks compared to prior methods, maintains high benign accuracy, and excels in long-form generation tasks where prior robustness-focused methods struggled.

2509.24496.tldr: This work mathematically defines LLM DNA as a low-dimensional, bi-Lipschitz representation of functional behavior and proves that LLM DNA satisfies inheritance and genetic determinism properties and establishes the existence of DNA.

2509.25260.tldr: The results reveal that the effective planning horizon is task-dependent, that models implicitly preserve information about unused correct continuations, and that predictions draw most on recent computations, though earlier blocks remain informative.

2510.00232.tldr: BiasFreeBench is introduced, an empirical benchmark that comprehensively compares eight mainstream bias mitigation techniques on two test scenarios by reorganizing existing datasets into a unified query-response setting, and introduces a response-level metric, Bias-Free Score, to measure the extent to which LLM responses are fair, safe, and anti-stereotypical.

2510.02356.tldr: EAPrivacy, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark designed to quantify the physical-world privacy awareness of LLM-powered agents, underscores a fundamental misalignment in LLMs regarding physically grounded privacy and establishes the need for more robust, physically-aware alignment.

2510.03777.tldr: This work defines the theoretical bounds of GuidedSampling and empirically demonstrates that it improves the performance of base model at pass@50 by on an average ~21.6% across various benchmarks compared to RS.

2510.04398.tldr: Semantically Equivalent and Coherent Attacks (SECA), which elicit hallucinations via realistic modifications to the prompt that preserve its meaning while maintaining semantic coherence, is proposed, which highlights the sensitivity of both open-source and commercial gradient-inaccessible LLMs to realistic and plausible prompt variations.

2510.04455.tldr: This paper proposes a two-stage approach for a class of inverse optimization problems in which the objective is a linear combination of given feature functions and the constraints are parameterized by unknown functions and thresholds and demonstrates that the method successfully solves inverse optimization problems on scheduling instances formulated as ILPs with up to 100 decision variables.

2510.06714.tldr: Through diverse experiments on the OGBench task suite, it is empirically show that dual goal representations consistently improve offline goal-reaching performance across 20 state- and pixel-based tasks.

2510.10854.tldr: This work presents a principled theoretical framework for discrete-state diffusion, providing the first sample complexity bound of $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$.

2510.11608.tldr: ParaCook is presented, a benchmark for time-efficient collaborative planning of multi-agent systems that are instantiated as cooking tasks, and reveals LLMs' potential on abstract tasks where they can focus on high-level parallel optimization.

2510.14581.tldr: Conformal Labeling is introduced, a novel method to identify instances where AI predictions can be provably trusted, achieved by controlling the false discovery rate (FDR), the proportion of incorrect labels within the selected subset.

2510.16701.tldr: An Agentic Framework with LLMs (AFL) is proposed for solving complex vehicle routing problems, achieving full automation from problem instance to solution, and substantially outperforms existing LLM-based baselines in both code reliability and solution feasibility.

2510.18259.tldr: The first systematic theoretical study of finite-step stochastic gradient descent for high-dimensional linear regression under a comprehensive range of quantization targets is presented, establishing precise algorithm-dependent and data-dependent excess risk bounds that characterize how different quantization affects learning.

2510.18428.tldr: AlphaOPT is presented, a self-improving experience library that enables LLMs to learn optimization modeling knowledge from limited supervision, including answer-only feedback without gold-standard programs, annotated reasoning traces, or parameter updates.

2510.20102.tldr: It is argued that a human-in-the-loop reasoning reconstruction paradigm is essential for achieving transparency, accountability, and trust in high-stakes financial environments.

2510.22391.tldr: A novel framework, named Top-Down Semantic Refinement (TDSR), which models the generation process as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) and can significantly enhance the performance of existing VLMs by achieving state-of-the-art or highly competitive results in fine-grained description, compositional generalization, and hallucination suppression.

2510.22876.tldr: This work formalizes the synchronization invariants that valid batch speculative decoding must satisfy, presents EQSPEC, the first algorithm that guarantees output equivalence, and introduces EXSPEC, which reduces this overhead through cross-batch scheduling that dynamically groups same-length sequences.

2511.01144.tldr: AthenaBench is developed, an enhanced benchmark for evaluating LLMs across multiple CTI tasks that includes an improved dataset creation pipeline, duplicate removal, refined evaluation metrics, and a new task focused on risk mitigation strategies.

2511.01228.tldr: This paper introduces an influence-aware causal node embedding module within an autoencoder architecture to extract node embeddings that are causally related to node importance and designs a unified optimization framework incorporating a causal ranking loss that jointly optimizes reconstruction and ranking objectives, thereby enabling mutual reinforcement between node representation learning and ranking optimization.

2511.06185.tldr: Dataforge is presented, an LLM-powered agentic data engineering platform for tabular data that is automatic, safe, and non-expert friendly and demonstrates a practical path toward autonomous data agents that transform raw data from data to better data.

2511.06781.tldr: This work analyzes how collaboration arises in VAE-based CF and shows it is governed by latent sharing radius, and proposes an anchor regularizer that aligns user posteriors with item embeddings, stabilizing users under masking and facilitating signal sharing across related items.

2511.07262.tldr: AgenticSciML is introduced, a collaborative multi-agent system in which over 10 specialized AI agents collaborate to propose, critique, and refine SciML solutions through structured reasoning and iterative evolution, suggesting a path toward scalable, transparent, and autonomous discovery in scientific computing.

2511.07293.tldr: This work develops a novel and unified technique to verify all instances of the grammar in a homogeneous way, viz., by adding a few additional layers to the neural network, which enables the use any state-of-the-art neural network verification tool.

2511.07833.tldr: Evaluations show that MURPHY consistently improves multi-iteration performance, achieving up to an 8% absolute gain in pass@1 over compute-matched GRPO baselines, and outperforming the prior leading method that incorporates multi-turn execution feedback.

2511.11079.tldr: ARCTraj is presented, a dataset and methodological framework for modeling human reasoning through complex visual tasks in the Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus, and positioned as a structured and interpretable foundation for studying human-like reasoning, advancing explainability, alignment, and generalizable intelligence.

2511.14853.tldr: A probabilistic method that quantifies representativeness by comparing the statistical distribution of features encoded by the scenario suites with the corresponding distribution of features representing the TOD, acknowledging that the true TOD distribution is unknown, as it can only be inferred from limited data.

2512.00499.tldr: This work proposes Entropy Importance Sampling Policy Optimization (ESPO), a novel framework that aims to combine fine-grained updates with stable training and decomposes sequences into groups based on predictive entropy, enabling ESPO to achieve state-of-the-art performance.

2512.04552.tldr: The subjective evaluation demonstrates that this robust RM effectively mitigates reward hacking, leading to significant improvements in both emotional expressiveness and naturalness over all baselines.

2512.05430.tldr: MusWikiDB and ArtistMus are released to advance research in music information retrieval and domain-specific question answering, establishing a foundation for retrieval-augmented reasoning in culturally rich domains such as music.

2512.09185.tldr: This work proposes to treat the disease dynamic as a velocity field and leverage Flow Matching to align the temporal evolution of patient data and presents $\Delta$-LFM, a framework for modeling patient-specific latent progression with flow matching.

2512.12206.tldr: The ALERT dataset is presented, containing 10,220 radar samples of seven distracted driving activities in real driving conditions, and the Input-Size-Agnostic Vision Transformer (ISA-ViT), a framework designed for radar-based DAR with a 22.68% higher accuracy, is proposed.

2512.12832.tldr: A framework for network level evaluation of hang-up susceptibility of steep-profiled Highway Railway Grade Crossings is developed, integrating next-generation sensing, deep learning, and infrastructure datasets into practical decision support tools.

2512.13697.tldr: This Creative Archetype Map illuminates how authorship is coevolving with AI, contributing to discussions about human-AI collaboration, detection challenges, and the preservation of creative diversity.

2512.15829.tldr: It is demonstrated that instantiating human-like working memory via intrinsic neuronal plasticity endows neural networks with the dual biological advantages of superior dynamic vision processing and minimal metabolic cost.

2512.18956.tldr: This paper proposes SynSelect, a novel three-stage Synthesis-Selection framework for generating high-quality long CoT data tailored to multimodal reasoning tasks and demonstrates that models supervised fine-tuned on SynSelect-generated data significantly outperform baselines and achieve further improvements after reinforcement learning post-training.

2512.19027.tldr: Recontextualization trains language models to resist misbehavior even when instructions permit it, which mitigates the reinforcement of misbehavior from misspecified training signals, reducing specification gaming without improving the supervision signal.

2512.20352.tldr: This work presents a multi-perspective validation framework for LLM-based thematic analysis that combines ensemble validation with dual reliability metrics: Cohen's Kappa ($kappa$) for inter-rater agreement and cosine similarity for semantic consistency.

2601.00097.tldr: It is shown that a sequence of three system-instruction sets guide an LLM agent as it systematically extracts key nouns and noun phrases from text, as it extracts FCM concept nodes from among those nouns and noun phrases, and then as it extracts or infers partial or fuzzy causal edges between those FCM nodes.

2601.02158.tldr: FormationEval, an open multiple-choice question benchmark for evaluating language models on petroleum geoscience and subsurface disciplines, emerges as the most challenging domain across all models, while smaller models show wider performance variance.

2601.04911.tldr: This paper demonstrates the usefulness of behaviour planning in real-world settings by presenting three case studies that focus on storytelling, urban planning, and the third examines game evaluation.

2601.05525.tldr: Focusing on discovery, optimization and certification, it is shown how the combination of foundation models and explainability methods allows the extraction of causal mechanisms, guides robust design and control, and supports trust and accountability in high-stakes applications.

2601.08005.tldr: This paper examines how frontier AI regulations in the United States and European Union in 2025 handle internal deployment, identifying three gaps that could cause internally-deployed systems to evade intended oversight and mapping potential approaches to address them.

2601.12522.tldr: CogniGent is presented, a novel agentic technique for bug localization that overcomes the limitations above by leveraging multiple AI agents capable of causal reasoning, call-graph-based root cause analysis and context engineering.

2601.16905.tldr: Geometric Routing Invariance Preservation (GRIP), an algorithm-agnostic framework for unlearning for MoE, which constraining router parameter updates without modifying the underlying unlearning algorithm adapts existing unlearning research from dense architectures to MoEs.

2601.18702.tldr: The Halo Architecture is introduced, grounded in the Rational Field (Q) and powered by a custom Exact Inference Unit (EIU), and demonstrates that General Intelligence requires the hybridization of continuous fields and discrete chains under a rigorous mathematical framework.

2601.20538.tldr: This paper proposes the first framework for explaining emergent extreme events in multi-agent systems, aiming to answer three fundamental questions: When does the event originate?

2601.21812.tldr: Across standard forecasting benchmarks, it is shown that applying spectral decomposition strategies, such as the Fourier or Wavelet transform, consistently improves upon diffusion models using the baseline forward process, with negligible computational overhead.

2601.21972.tldr: This paper develops Multi-Agent Actor-Critic (MAAC) methods to optimize decentralized LLM collaboration and proposes 2 MAAC approaches, which both underperform CoLLM-CC on long-horizon or sparse-reward tasks, where Monte Carlo methods require substantially more samples and CoLLM-DC struggles to converge.

2601.23232.tldr: ShotFinder is introduced, a benchmark that formalizes editing requirements as keyframe-oriented shot descriptions and introduces five types of controllable single-factor constraints: Temporal order, Color, Visual style, Audio, and Resolution.

2602.00628.tldr: In a held-out-words regression, behavioral similarity (especially forced choice) predicts unseen hidden-state similarities beyond lexical baselines and cross-model consensus, indicating that behavior-only measurements retain recoverable information about internal semantic geometry.

2602.00851.tldr: It is found that on-the-fly persuasion induces weak and inconsistent behavioral effects, which suggest that persuasion, even in prior interaction, can affect the agent's behavior, motivating behavior-level evaluation in agentic systems.

2602.01023.tldr: A unified framework that reformulates QAC as end-to-end list generation through Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and multi-objective Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is presented, validating that unified generation with RAG and multi-objective alignment provides an effective solution for production QAC.

2602.02929.tldr: A neuro-symbolic anomaly detection framework that combines a Graph Autoencoder (GAE) with rare pattern mining to identify APT-like activities in system-level provenance data that consistently outperforms individual context-based detectors and achieves performance competitive with ensemble aggregation methods that require multiple separate detectors.

2602.03195.tldr: This work verifies that valid reasoning paths could inherently concentrate within a low-rank subspace and introduces Reinforcement Learning with Promising Tokens (RLPT), a framework that mitigates the action space issue by decoupling strategic decision-making from token generation.

2602.05847.tldr: OmniVideo-R1 empowers models to "think with omnimodal cues" by two key strategies: query-intensive grounding based on self-supervised learning paradigms; and modality-attentive fusion built upon contrastive learning paradigms.

2602.06130.tldr: SWIRL is a self-improvement framework that learns from state-only sequences by treating actions as a latent variable and alternating between Forward World Modelling and an Inverse Dynamics Modelling, trained with reinforcement learning with the opposite frozen model's log-probability as a reward signal.

2602.07107.tldr: This work introduces ShallowJail, a novel attack that exploits shallow alignment in LLMs, which substantially degrades the safety of state-of-the-art LLM responses.

2602.07294.tldr: Fin-RATE is introduced, a benchmark built on U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings and mirroring financial analyst workflows through three pathways: detail-oriented reasoning within individual disclosures, cross-entity comparison under shared topics, and longitudinal tracking of the same firm across reporting periods.

2602.07506.tldr: VividFace is presented, a real-time and realistic facial expression shadowing system for humanoid robots that produces vivid humanoid faces by mimicking human facial expressions within 0.05 seconds, while generalizing across diverse facial configurations.

2602.07672.tldr: It is shown that long-horizon degradation is driven primarily by incorrect action generation: when actions are replaced with ground-truth commands, a Transformer-based CWM propagates state accurately over long horizons, despite known limitations of Transformers in long-horizon state tracking.

2602.08449.tldr: It is indicated that representational invariance is a meaningful but limited control lever that can raise the cost of regime-conditioned strategies but cannot guarantee elimination or provide architecture-invariant thresholds.

2602.09572.tldr: The Predictive Query Language (PQL), an SQL-inspired declarative language for defining predictive tasks on relational databases, is presented, enabling the automatic computation of training labels for a large variety of machine learning tasks, such as regression, classification, time-series forecasting, and recommender systems.

2602.10016.tldr: This work introduces Kunlun, a scalable architecture that systematically improves model efficiency and resource allocation and introduces high-level innovations that increase MFU from 17% to 37% on NVIDIA B200 GPUs and double scaling efficiency over state-of-the-art methods.

2602.10139.tldr: This work proposes an anonymization-based privacy protection framework that enforces the principle of available-but-invisible access to sensitive data: sensitive information remains usable for task execution but is never directly visible to the cloud-based agent.

2602.10556.tldr: Language-Action Pre-training (LAP) is introduced, a simple recipe that represents low-level robot actions directly in natural language, aligning action supervision with the pre-trained vision-language model's input-output distribution and unifying action prediction and VQA in a shared language-action format that yields additional gains through co-training.

2602.11079.tldr: This in-the-wild model organism - emerging from contaminated preference data rather than deliberate injection - provides a realistic benchmark for safety techniques and outperforms gradient-based attribution and LLM-judge baselines while being over 10 times cheaper than both.

2602.11575.tldr: ReaDy-Go is proposed, a novel real-to-sim simulation pipeline that synthesizes photorealistic dynamic scenarios in target environments by augmenting a reconstructed static GS scene with dynamic human GS obstacles, and trains navigation policies using the generated datasets.

2602.11858.tldr: Region-to-Image Distillation is proposed, which transforms zooming from an inference-time tool into a training-time primitive, thereby internalizing the benefits of agentic zooming into a single forward pass of an MLLM.

2602.12247.tldr: The benchmark pairs 35 PDF documents with JSON Schemas and human-annotated gold labels across economically valuable domains, yielding 12,867 evaluatable fields spanning schema complexities from tens to hundreds of fields.

2602.12384.tldr: This work proves the existence of Lyapunov exponents governing the top singular values at initialization, gives closed-form expressions in a tractable masked model, and quantifies finite-depth corrections to motivate an approximation regime in which singular-value dynamics become effectively decoupled.

2602.13021.tldr: PG-SR is proposed, a prior-guided SR framework built upon a three-stage pipeline consisting of warm-up, evolution, and refinement that outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse domains, maintaining robustness to varying prior quality, noisy data, and data scarcity.

2602.13093.tldr: It is demonstrated that Confidence-Aware Response Generation (CARG), effective for standard LLMs, fails for reasoning models due to overconfidence induced by extended reasoning traces; counterintuitively, random confidence embedding outperforms targeted extraction.

2602.13352.tldr: The experiments conclude that researchs ability to produce relevant, semantically accurate image captions in Hindi is successful and future research can be guided by this research model.

2602.13357.tldr: AdaCorrection is introduced, an adaptive offset cache correction framework that maintains high generation fidelity while enabling efficient cache reuse across Transformer layers during diffusion inference, and consistently improves generation performance.

2602.13362.tldr: This work proposes a novel nonparametric re-calibration algorithm capable of correcting calibration error without restrictive modeling assumptions, and introduces a novel characteristic kernel over distributions that can be evaluated in $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ time for empirical distributions of size $n$.

2602.13363.tldr: This work compares different LLMs in their ability and willingness to produce potentially dangerous code bases that could be misused by cyberattackers and presents a dataset of 200 website code bases and logs from 40 different LLM coding agents.

2602.13367.tldr: The results demonstrate that small models can achieve both broad competence and strong specialization simultaneously, redefining the potential of 3B parameter models.

2602.13372.tldr: This work introduces Morality Chains, a novel formalism for representing moral norms as ordered deontic constraints, and MoralityGym, a benchmark of 98 ethical-dilemma problems presented as trolley-dilemma-style Gymnasium environments that allows the integration of insights from psychology and philosophy into the evaluation of norm-sensitive reasoning.

2602.13376.tldr: Validation on the FlowVQA dataset shows strong agreement with ground-truth metrics, confirming the framework's reliability as a practical, reference-free alternative for continuous quality monitoring in production settings.

2602.13379.tldr: This work proposes ToolShield, a training-free, tool-agnostic, self-exploration defense that effectively reduces ASR by 30% on average in multi-turn interactions, and constructs MT-AgentRisk (Multi-Turn Agent Risk Benchmark), the first benchmark to evaluate multi-turn tool-using agent safety.

2602.13407.tldr: It is shown that the optimization problem reduces to supervised fine-tuning on self-generated data filtered for both correctness and conciseness, and despite its simplicity, on-policy SFT consistently defines the accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier.

2602.13419.tldr: This work introduces Protect, a neuro-symbolic framework that grounds the generative capabilities of Large Language Models in rigorous chemical logic, and demonstrates that grounding neural generation in symbolic logic enables reliable, expert-level autonomy.

2602.13421.tldr: It is argued that variational free energy minimization under a Poisson assumption offers a principled path toward an energy-aware theory of computation and establishes Poisson variational inference as a promising foundation for a resource-constrained theory of computation.

2602.13427.tldr: It is discovered that while both syntactically- and semantically-triggered attacks can effectively induce the target behaviour, and largely preserve utility, semantically-triggered attacks are generally more effective in inducing negative biases, while both backdoor types struggle with causing positive biases.

2602.13444.tldr: FlowHOI is proposed, a two-stage flow-matching framework that generates semantically grounded, temporally coherent HOI sequences, comprising hand poses, object poses, and hand-object contact states, conditioned on an egocentric observation, a language instruction, and a 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) scene reconstruction.

2602.13446.tldr: These results demonstrate that end-to-end AEs trained directly over Rayleigh fading can effectively learn robust, interference-aware signaling strategies, paving the way for NOMA deployment in fading environments with realistic CSI constraints.

2602.13452.tldr: This work examines the performance of state-of-the-art LLMs and machine translation systems in crisis-domain translation, with a focus on preserving urgency, which is a critical property for effective crisis communication and triaging.

2602.13455.tldr: This study focuses on detecting abusive obfuscated language in Swahili, a low-resource language that poses unique challenges due to its limited linguistic resources and technological support, and employed machine learning models including Support Vector Machines, Logistic Regression, and Decision Trees to handle data imbalance.

2602.13458.tldr: MoltNet, a dataset tracking the full one-month activity trajectories of 148K AI agents on MoltBook, is presented, and a first empirical portrait of agent social behavior at scale is established, with direct implications for the design and governance of AI-populated communities.

2602.13466.tldr: The perspective that next token prediction training alone is poorly suited for accurate memory formation as the objective itself is non-invertible is introduced, motivating the use of combined objective functions for models where the entire input is not exposed.

2602.13473.tldr: NeuroWeaver is a unified autonomous evolutionary agent designed to generalize across diverse EEG datasets and tasks by reformulating pipeline engineering as a discrete constrained optimization problem, coupled with a Multi-Objective Evolutionary Optimization that dynamically balances performance, novelty, and efficiency via self-reflective refinement.

2602.13482.tldr: This paper provides a tutorial on the PyCM library, demonstrating its utility in conducting deep-dive evaluations of multi-class classifiers and illustrating how the choice of evaluation metrics can fundamentally shift the interpretation of a model's efficacy.

2602.13483.tldr: Together, the results recast circuits as a meaningful object of study by shifting the unit of analysis from tasks to prompts, enabling scalable circuit descriptions in the presence of prompt-specific mechanisms.

2602.13488.tldr: The CHI community lacks a shared understanding of what constitutes a pilot study, why they are conducted, and how they should be reported, suggesting a methodological blind spot in the community.

2602.13496.tldr: It is argued that edge computing offers opportunities for responsive biodiversity management, but realising this potential requires increased collaboration between ecologists, engineers, and data scientists to align model development and system design with ecological questions, field constraints, and ethical considerations.

2602.13498.tldr: It is demonstrated that while reintroducing adaptive scaling improves optimization efficiency, it typically exacerbates instability due to high-energy outliers, and TrasMuon addresses this by defining a trust region based on relative energy ratios, confining updates to a stable zone.

2602.13504.tldr: This study addresses the gap in empirical investigation of AI usage in Turkish news media by fine-tuning a Turkish-specific BERT model on a labeled dataset of 3,600 articles from three major Turkish outlets with distinct editorial orientations for binary classification of AI-rewritten content.

2602.13506.tldr: This framework recovers the optimal approximation coefficient for DR-submodular maximization and significantly improves existing approximation coefficients for OSS optimization, particularly over matroid constraints.

2602.13516.tldr: This paper formalizes Natural Agentic Oversharing -- the unintentional disclosure of task-irrelevant user information through an agent trace of actions on the web and introduces SPILLage, a framework that characterizes oversharing along two dimensions: channel (content vs. behavior) and directness (explicit vs. implicit).

2602.13524.tldr: It is demonstrated that singular vectors robustly align with features in a model where features can be directly observed, and theoretically it is shown under a range of conditions that such alignment is expected under a range of conditions.

2602.13540.tldr: This work formally distinguish capability calibration from response calibration and shows that the two differ both theoretically and empirically, and demonstrates that capability-calibrated confidence improves pass@k$ prediction and inference budget allocation.

2602.13547.tldr: AISA is presented, a lightweight, single-pass defense that activates safety behaviors already latent inside the model rather than treating safety as an add-on, enabling safer deployment even for weakly aligned or intentionally risky model variants.

2602.13555.tldr: A novel Privacy-Concealing Cooperation (PCC) framework for Bird's Eye View (BEV) semantic segmentation is proposed, which effectively degrades the quality of the reconstructed images with minimal impact on segmentation performance, providing privacy protection for cooperating vehicles.

2602.13556.tldr: These findings demonstrate Discernment's ability to adjust to diverse physical channel conditions while maintaining spectral efficiency and low model complexity, making it well suited for IoT deployments and strongly motivating further research on this semantic channel paradigm.

2602.13559.tldr: This paper proposes a robust Online Reinforcement Learning WebAgent, designed to optimize its policy through direct, iterative interactions with unconstrained wide websites, and introduces a modular agentic framework, namely OpAgent, that enables robust error recovery and self-correction.

2602.13562.tldr: The Adaptive Safe Context Learning (ASCL) framework is proposed, empowering the model to autonomously decide when to consult safety rules and how to generate the ongoing reasoning, and Inverse Frequency Policy Optimization is introduced to rebalance advantage estimates.

2602.13568.tldr: It is revealed that expert framing acts as a strong prior for contemporary LLMs, suggesting a form of credibility-sensitive social influence that generalizes across decision domains.

2602.13571.tldr: The LLM-Confidence Reranker (LCR) is proposed, a training-free, plug-and-play algorithm that enhances reranking in RAG systems by leveraging black-box LLM confidence derived from Maximum Semantic Cluster Proportion (MSCP).

2602.13576.tldr: The findings highlight evaluation rubrics as a sensitive and manipulable control interface, revealing a system-level alignment risk that extends beyond evaluator reliability alone.

2602.13583.tldr: This work integrates a self-supervised differentiable clustering model with a novel differentiable ILP model, enabling rule learning from raw data without explicit label leakage, and demonstrates that the learned rules effectively describe raw data through its features.

2602.13587.tldr: This monograph reports a multi-agent proof sprint on ten research-level problems, combining rapid draft generation with adversarial verification, targeted repair, and explicit provenance, finding that structure-aware verification and layer-switching strategies improve reliability and calibration in compressed proof sprints.

2602.13588.tldr: TwInS is a novel bio-inspired joint learning framework capable of simultaneously performing scene parsing and geometric vision tasks and is equipped with a tailored semi-supervised training strategy, which unleashes the potential of large-scale multi-view data and enables continuous self-evolution without requiring ground-truth correspondences.

2602.13594.tldr: Hippocampus is introduced, an agentic memory management system that uses compact binary signatures for semantic search and lossless token-ID streams for exact content reconstruction that scales linearly with memory size, making it suitable for long-horizon agentic deployments.

2602.13595.tldr: This paper reveals a 'quantization trap' where reducing precision from 16-bit to 8/4-bit paradoxically increases more net energy consumption while degrading reasoning accuracy, and suggests that the industry's "smaller-is-better"heuristic is mathematically counterproductive for complex reasoning tasks.

2602.13606.tldr: A multi-modal sensing and fusion learning framework that utilizes multi-head cross-modal attention to learn dependencies and correlations between different modalities, and subsequently fuse the multimodal features to obtain predicted top-k beams so that the best line-of-sight links can be proactively established.

2602.13611.tldr: DesBench is proposed, a design-aware benchmark for evaluating LLMs on three software design-related tasks: design-aware code generation, object-oriented modeling, and the design of acceptance test cases.

2602.13616.tldr: Detailed evaluation on long-trajectory PDE prediction benchmarks validates the effectiveness of the proposed uncertainty measure and adaptive planning strategy, as evidenced by lower prediction errors and longer predicted trajectories that retain a high correlation with their ground truths.

2602.13625.tldr: It is found that anthropomorphism indirectly reduces risk perception by increasing both cognitive and affective trust, and that domain knowledge moderates these relationships.

2602.13639.tldr: An Entropy-Based Adaptive Guidance Framework that dynamically aligns the guidance with the cognitive state of each agent, and quantifies the understanding of weak agents through multi-dimensional entropy metrics and establishes a scalable pathway toward more robust, cooperative multi-agent intelligence.

2602.13640.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchical representation fusion framework that progressively integrates audio, vision, and proprioception and outperforms state-of-the-art multimodal fusion frameworks, particularly in scenarios where acoustic cues provide task-relevant information not readily available from visual observations alone.

2602.13647.tldr: SF-RAG, an RAG framework that treats the native hierarchical structure of academic papers as a low-entropy retrieval prior, and introduces entropy-based structural diagnostics to quantify retrieval fragmentation and evidence allocation accuracy is proposed.

2602.13650.tldr: KorMedMCQA-V forms a unified evaluation suite for Korean medical reasoning across text-only and multimodal conditions and finds that reasoning-oriented model variants gain up to +20 percentage points over instruction-tuned counterparts, medical domain specialization yields inconsistent gains over strong general-purpose baselines, and performance varies notably across imaging modalities.

2602.13651.tldr: This work proposes cumulative utility parity, a fairness principle that evaluates whether clients receive comparable long-term benefit per participation opportunity, rather than per training round, and introduces availability-normalized cumulative utility, which disentangles unavoidable physical constraints from avoidable algorithmic bias arising from scheduling and aggregation.

2602.13653.tldr: A novel MLLM-centered framework for GUI agents, which consists of agentic-Q estimation and step-wise policy optimization, which endows Ovis2.5-9B with powerful GUI interaction capabilities, achieving remarkable performances on GUI navigation and grounding benchmarks and even surpassing contenders with larger scales.

2602.13665.tldr: Results suggest that HyFunc offers a more efficient paradigm for agentic AI, and injects boilerplate parameter syntax on-the-fly within an extended vLLM engine on-the-fly within an extended vLLM engine.

2602.13666.tldr: This paper presents ALMo (Aim-Limit-defined Multi-Objective system), an interactive decision support system designed to infer and operationalize clinician intent that employs a novel optimization framework that minimizes manual input through automated parameter setup and enables flexible control over toxicity risks.

2602.13671.tldr: Inspired by how biological systems adapt, MASFly is introduced, a novel multi-agent framework enabling dynamic adaptation at test time, and achieves state-of-the-art performance.

2602.13675.tldr: Compared to single-domain and domain-independent explanations, Transferable XAI was the most helpful for understanding the second domain, leading to the best decision faithfulness, factor recall, and ability to relate explanations between domains.

2602.13680.tldr: A novel and efficient hybrid architecture that integrates Sliding Window Attention with non-linear Test-Time Training (TTT) memory networks, and implements a Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning strategy to replace standard attention layers in pre-trained models with memory-augmented sliding window layers.

2602.13681.tldr: An Ensemble Learning approach to improve segmentation accuracy by combining high performing segmentation models, U-Net and FPN, using a weighted average method is proposed, which could contribute to the efficiency of waste sorting at Material Recovery Facility.

2602.13684.tldr: It is shown via Yao's minimax principle that without pseudometric structure, any algorithm observing $o(n)$ uniformly random edges incurs an unbounded approximation ratio, demonstrating that the pseudometric condition governs not only tractability but also the robustness of CC to incomplete information.

2602.13685.tldr: A reinforcement learning framework that learns to filter out irrelevant tools and invokes external assistance only when it yields a net performance gain over the base model, and highlights the complementary role of external tools in augmenting audio model reasoning.

2602.13691.tldr: This paper argues that historically successful trajectories contain reusable tool-transition patterns, which can be leveraged throughout the whole training process and proposes Pheromone-Guided Policy Optimization (PhGPO), which learns a trajectory-based transition pattern from historical trajectories and uses the learned pheromone to guide policy optimization.

2602.13695.tldr: It is demonstrated that next-generation models, when integrated into a streamlined automated pipeline optimized for citation-based verification, can solve sophisticated research-grade problems.

2602.13697.tldr: A principled family of RDB encoders that can be seamlessly paired with already-existing single-table ICL foundation models, whereby no training or fine-tuning is required.

2602.13718.tldr: HybridFlow is envisioned as a practical low-latency method to enhance real-world interaction capabilities of robotic manipulation policies by leveraging the rapid advantage of MeanFlow one-step generation while ensuring action precision with minimal generation steps.

2602.13738.tldr: OneLatent is a framework that compresses intermediate reasoning into a single latent token via supervision from rendered CoT images and DeepSeek-OCR hidden states, obtaining a deterministic supervision signal that can be inspected and audited without requiring the model to output verbose textual rationales.

2602.13758.tldr: A dynamic model-routing re-captioning pipeline that leverages state-of-the-art multi-modal large language models to generate dense, self-contained descriptions by jointly synthesizing visual features, original figure captions, and corresponding in-text references authored by human scientists is developed.

2602.13764.tldr: MOTIF is introduced for efficient few-shot cross-embodiment transfer that decouples embodiment-agnostic spatiotemporal patterns, termed action motifs, from heterogeneous action data and designs a lightweight predictor that predicts these motifs from real-time inputs to guide a flow-matching policy.

2602.13784.tldr: This work contributes a new analytical basis for using example-based explanations to improve user understanding of AI decisions by proposing Comparables XAI for relatable example-based explanations of AI with Trace adjustments that trace counterfactual changes from each Comparable to the Subject, one attribute at a time, monotonically along the AI feature space.

2602.13791.tldr: MechPert is introduced, a lightweight framework that encourages LLM agents to generate directed regulatory hypotheses rather than relying solely on functional similarity, and selects anchor genes that outperform standard network centrality heuristics in well-characterized cell lines.

2602.13792.tldr: By turning diversity from a source of inconsistency into collaboration, StackingNet establishes a practical foundation for coordinated artificial intelligence, suggesting that progress may emerge from not only larger single models but also principled cooperation among many specialized ones.

2602.13804.tldr: Vashista Sparse Attention is introduced, a drop-in mechanism that maintains a small candidate set per query through a paging-style context selection strategy compatible with modern inference stacks and demonstrates stable constant-size effective support, strong wall-clock speedups, and minimal quality degradation in the regimes predicted by the support-gap diagnostics.

2602.13808.tldr: An end-to-end framework for systematic evaluation of LLM-generated smart contracts from natural-language specifications that provides a reproducible benchmark for empirical research on smart contract synthesis quality and supports extensions to formal verification and compliance checking.

2602.13810.tldr: This work proposes mean velocity policy (MVP), a new generative policy function that models the mean velocity field to achieve the fastest one-step action generation and theoretically proves that this design explicitly serves as a crucial boundary condition, thereby improving learning accuracy and enhancing policy expressiveness.

2602.13817.tldr: This work contributes the first empirical evidence of such an AI tool in a live review process, documenting how reviewers respond to AI-generated feedback in a high-stakes review context and offers design implications for AI-assisted reviewing that aim to enhance quality while safeguarding human expertise, agency, and responsibility.

2602.13842.tldr: The results suggest that volumetric deep learning can capture subtle anatomical features from pre-TAVI imaging, opening new perspectives for personalized risk assessment and procedural optimization.

2602.13851.tldr: An empirical evaluation of automated ACSL annotation generation strategies for C programs, comparing a rule-based Python script, Frama-C's RTE plugin, and three large language models, showing that rule-based approaches remain more reliable for verification success, while LLM-based methods exhibit more variable performance.

2602.13852.tldr: An evaluation of the performance of the proposed framework on some real-world experiments by Adobe business customers that validate the high quality of the generation pipeline is provided, to provide an evaluation of the performance of the proposed framework on some real-world experiments by Adobe business customers.

2602.13855.tldr: This perspective proposes claim-level auditability as a first-class design and evaluation target for deep research agents, distills recurring long-horizon failure modes (objective drift, transient constraints, and unverifiable inference), and introduces the Auditable Autonomous Research (AAR) standard.

2602.13865.tldr: Dual Objectives Hindsight Experience Replay (2HER), a novel extension that creates two sets of virtual goals that generates goals from the agent's effector positions, rewarding the agent for both interacting with the object and completing the task.

2602.13873.tldr: Ambient Physics is introduced, a framework for learning the joint distribution of coefficient-solution pairs directly from partial observations, without requiring a single complete observation, and identifies a "one-point transition": masking a single already-observed point enables learning from partial observations across architectures and measurement patterns.

2602.13880.tldr: VSAL is proposed, a vision-based framework that incorporates an adaptive layout generator capable of dynamically producing informative graph visualizations tailored to individual instances, thereby improving graph property detection.

2602.13891.tldr: Inspired by recent advances in generative reward modeling, the GSRM is proposed, a reasoning-centric reward model tailored for speech that substantially outperforms existing speech naturalness predictors and can improve the naturalness of speech LLM generations by serving as an effective verifier for online RLHF.

2602.13901.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that RPGD consistently recovers extrinsic parameters with accuracy comparable to the provided ground truth, achieving sub-pixel MPJPE reprojection error even in challenging, noisy settings.

2602.13904.tldr: This work creates a set of concrete metrics that are simple to implement, computationally inexpensive, and task-agnostic for assessing CoT pathologies and develops model organisms deliberately trained to exhibit specific CoT pathologies.

2602.13910.tldr: This paper studies the algorithmic stability of deep ReLU homogeneous neural networks that achieve zero training error using parameters with the smallest $L_2$ norm, also known as the minimum-norm interpolation, a phenomenon that can be observed in overparameterized models trained by gradient-based algorithms.

2602.13914.tldr: A polytopological PDL capable of expressing common knowledge and various generalizations is introduced and it is shown it has the finite model property over closure spaces but not over Cantor derivative spaces.

2602.13921.tldr: GNN benchmark GREPO is introduced, the first GNN benchmark for repository-scale bug localization tasks, providing graph-based data structures ready for direct GNN processing and shows outstanding performance compared to established information retrieval baselines.

2602.13933.tldr: Inspired by the principle of cognitive economy, HyMem is proposed, a hybrid memory architecture that enables dynamic on-demand scheduling through multi-granular memory representations, establishing a state-of-the-art balance between efficiency and performance in long-term memory management.

2602.13935.tldr: This work introduces statistically principled early stopping methods that monitor uncertainty signals during generation to mitigate this issue and indicates that uncertainty-aware early stopping can improve both efficiency and reliability in LLM reasoning, and the authors observe especially significant gains for math reasoning.

2602.13936.tldr: A novel generalizable Physics-guided Causal Model (PCM), which comprises two core components: a Disentangled Scene Encoder, which adopts intervention-based disentanglement to extract domain-invariant features from scenes, and a CausalODE Decoder, which employs a causal attention mechanism to effectively integrate kinematic models with meaningful contextual information.

2602.13940.tldr: This work observes that techniques from reinforcement learning, such as time discounting, are necessary to reduce the variance of this score function sufficiently to make it practicable, and demonstrates that the resultant method outperforms prior proposed straight-through estimates, both qualitatively and quantitatively at the $100$ million parameter scale.

2602.13949.tldr: Experiential Reinforcement Learning (ERL), a training paradigm that embeds an explicit experience-reflection-consolidation loop into the reinforcement learning process, is introduced, suggesting that integrating explicit self-reflection into policy training provides a practical mechanism for transforming feedback into durable behavioral improvement.

2602.13954.tldr: Eureka-Audio is presented, a compact yet high-performance audio language model that achieves competitive performance against models that are 4 to 18 times larger across a broad range of audio understanding benchmarks, and DataFlux, a closed loop audio instruction data synthesis and verification pipeline that constructs high quality, logically consistent supervision from raw audio.

2602.13958.tldr: This work develops NP-specific chemical language models (NPCLMs) by pre-training state-space models (Mamba and Mamba-2) and comparing them with transformer baselines (GPT) and presents the first systematic comparison of selective state-space models and transformers for NP-focused tasks.

2602.13967.tldr: Neuromem is presented, a scalable testbed that benchmarks External Memory Modules under an interleaved insertion-and-retrieval protocol and decomposes its lifecycle into five dimensions including memory data structure, normalization strategy, consolidation policy, query formulation strategy, and context integration mechanism.

2602.13971.tldr: The Deep Adaptive Intent-Aware Network (DAIAN) is proposed, that dynamically adapts to users' intent preferences and reinforces similarity by leveraging a hybrid enhancer with ID and semantic information, followed by adaptive selection based on varying intents.

2602.13977.tldr: WoVR is proposed, a reliable world-model-based reinforcement learning framework for post-training VLA policies that enables stable long-horizon imagined rollouts and effective policy optimization, and shows that learned world models can serve as practical simulators for reinforcement learning when hallucination is explicitly controlled.

2602.13980.tldr: Inspired by the chunking mechanism in human working memory and empirical observations of the spatial specialization of memory embeddings relative to original tokens, Parallelized Iterative Compression (PIC) is proposed, which reduces the difficulty of compressor training by simply modifying the Transformer's attention mask.

2602.13985.tldr: This work leverages formal abductive explanations, which offer consistent, guaranteed reasoning over minimal sufficient feature sets, to establish a robust framework for trustworthy AI in medical diagnosis.
