2603.12023.tldr: This work investigates how traditional software and hardware vulnerabilities can complement LLM-specific algorithmic attacks to compromise the integrity of a compound AI pipeline and systematize the attack primitives and analyze their composition by grouping vulnerabilities by their objective and mapping them to distinct stages of an attack lifecycle.

2603.12021.tldr: This work designs a direct evaluation scheme for label projection and finds that LabelPigeon outperforms baselines and actively improves translation quality in 11 languages, demonstrating that XML-tagged label projection provides effective and efficient label transfer without compromising translation quality.

2603.12011.tldr: The results show that RFT generalizes well across task difficulty within an environment, but exhibits weaker transfer to unseen environments, which correlates with shifts in both semantic priors and observation/action interfaces.

2603.11991.tldr: BTZSC is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark of 22 public datasets spanning sentiment, topic, intent, and emotion classification, capturing diverse domains, class cardinalities, and document lengths, and a systematic comparison across four major model families, NLI cross-encoders, embedding models, rerankers and instruction-tuned LLMs.

2603.11950.tldr: By repurposing a pretrained decoder-only language model via cross-attention and introducing an elegant, flexible patch-embedder, SLIP supports different temporal resolutions and variable-length input at inference time without additional retraining.

2603.11938.tldr: ProtoSR, an approach for injecting free-text information into structured report population, achieves state-of-the-art results, with the largest improvements on detailed attribute questions, demonstrating the value of integrating free-text derived signal for fine-grained image understanding.

2603.11935.tldr: This work proposes the Mobile Kernel Agent (MoKA), a multi-agent system equipped with repository-aware reasoning and a plan-and-execute paradigm that achieves state-of-the-art performance, boosting compilation success to 93.7% and enabling 27.4% of generated kernels to deliver measurable speedups over native libraries.

2603.11881.tldr: This report details the creation of Bielik-Minitron-7B, a compressed 7.35B parameter version of the Bielik-11B-v3.0 model, specifically optimized for European languages, demonstrating an efficient pathway to create language models for less-represented languages while reducing inference deployment costs.

2603.12018.tldr: In this project, three designers embarked on a three-month experimental journey with an intention to co-create with Google's LLM as a potential intelligent partner to investigate how it will influence the designers' creativity.

2603.11946.tldr: This work formalizes this incompatibility and develops two complementary solutions: an approximate inference framework that provides guaranteed lower and upper bounds for inference, and a structural condition for VT under which exact tractable inference is recovered.

2603.11944.tldr: This work introduces Effective Resistance Rewiring (ERR), a simple topology correction strategy that uses effective resistance as a global signal to detect structural bottlenecks and improves performance on homophilic and heterophilic graphs.

2603.12188.tldr: This work presents a practical compilation from temporal planning with durative actions into PDDL+, fully capturing the semantics and only assuming the non-self-overlapping of actions.

2603.12180.tldr: MADQA, a benchmark of 2,250 human-authored questions grounded in 800 heterogeneous PDF documents, is introduced and it is shown that while the best agents can match human searchers in raw accuracy, they fail to close the nearly 20% gap to oracle performance.

2603.12176.tldr: BehaviorVLM is presented, a unified vision-language framework for pose estimation and behavioral understanding that requires no task-specific finetuning and minimal human labeling by guiding pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) through detailed, explicit, and verifiable reasoning steps.

2603.12145.tldr: A reusable recipe - a generic prompt template, hierarchical verification, and iterative agent-assisted repair - that produces semantically equivalent high-performance environments for<$10 in compute cost is presented.

2603.12261.tldr: An interpretation of the color representation in the Variational Autoencoder latent space of FLUX reveals a structure reflecting Hue, Saturation, and Lightness, and is verified by demonstrating that it can both predict and explicitly control color.

2603.12246.tldr: Interestingly, it is found that the reasoning-judge-trained policies achieve such strong performance by learning to generate highly effective adversarial outputs that can also score well on popular benchmarks such as Arena-Hard by deceiving other LLM-judges.

2603.12224.tldr: This work parallelizes the existing CEGAR-SEQ algorithm that solves the sequential object arrangement and scheduling for sequential 3D printing by expressing it as a linear arithmetic formula which is then solved by a technique inspired by counterexample guided abstraction refinement (CEGAR).

2603.12249.tldr: The synthesize-and-reground framework is introduced, a two-stage pipeline comprising: (1) Claim-Centric QA Synthesis, which generates faithful, isolated QA pairs and reasoning on focused segments, and (2) Document-Scale Regrounding, which programmatically re-embeds these pairs into full-document tasks to ensure realistic complexity.

2603.12230.tldr: This article details observations and recommendations concerning the security of frontier AI agents, and identifies standards and research gaps, including adaptive security benchmarks, policy models for delegation and privilege control, and guidance for secure multi-agent system design aligned with NIST risk management principles.

2603.12228.tldr: This work views the outcome of pretraining as a distribution over parameter vectors, whose support already contains task-specific experts, and explores a simple, fully parallel post-training method that samples parameter perturbations at random, selects the top $K$, and ensembles predictions via majority vote.

2603.12244.tldr: The results establish the separable neural architecture as a domain-agnostic primitive for predictive and generative intelligence, capable of unifying both deterministic and distributional representations.

2603.12226.tldr: Idea-Catalyst is a novel framework that systematically identifies interdisciplinary insights to support creative reasoning in both humans and large language models and improves average novelty and insightfulness, while remaining grounded in the original research problem.

2603.12215.tldr: The region proportion-aware dynamic adaptive SOD network (RDNet), which replaces the CNN backbone with the Swin Transformer for global context modeling and introduces three key modules, achieves robustness against scale variations and accurate localization, delivering superior detection performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

2603.12232.tldr: An incremental verification technique that reuses learned conflicts across related verification queries that reduces verification effort and yields speedups of up to $1.9\times$ over a non-incremental baseline is proposed.

2503.15772.tldr: This work considers the approach of performing indirect prompt injection via the paper’s PDF, prompting the LLM to embed a covert watermark in the generated review, and subsequently testing for presence of the watermark in the review, and finds that Bonferroni-style corrections are too conservative to be useful in this setting.

2509.21553.tldr: AutoClimDS demonstrates that the KG serves as the essential enabling component, the irreplaceable structural foundation, for autonomous climate data science, and provides a pathway toward democratizing climate research through human-AI collaboration.

2509.04650.tldr: This research demonstrates that transformer architectures are far more suitable for public safety applications, offering improved accuracy, deeper language understanding, and better generalization across real world social media text.

2505.20343.tldr: This approach demonstrates that a simple, prompt-based debiasing strategy can effectively debias LLM outputs, thus producing responses with higher information content than both gendered variants in 78% of the cases, and consistently achieving a balanced integration in the remaining cases.

2507.20796.tldr: A supervised fine-tuning approach is introduced that aligns agent behavior with explicit economic preferences and generates optimal strategies under two stylized utility specifications, homo economicus, which maximizes self-interest, and homo moralis, which incorporates Kantian universalizability.

2602.19531.tldr: This work proposes a simpler yet effective alternative to temporal interpolation or complex architectures to handle irregularities, extracting time-agnostic summary statistics to eliminate the temporal axis, and identifies scenarios where missing patterns themselves encode predictive signals, as in sepsis prediction.

2505.15418.tldr: Empirical evaluations show strong performance of GPO across various tasks, including continuous control with partial observability and noise, and memory-based challenges, significantly outperforming existing methods.

2508.12932.tldr: SEDEG is introduced, a two-stage training framework for vision transformers (ViT), focusing on sequentially improving the generality of both Decoder and Encoder, and using knowledge distillation strategies to compress the ensembled encoder and develop a new, more generalized encoder.

2406.14815.tldr: The latent diffusion model is shown to provide realizations that are visually consistent with samples from geomodeling software, and significant uncertainty reduction, posterior P$10$-P$90$ forecasts that generally bracket observed data, and consistent posterior geomodels, are achieved in both cases.

2509.25084.tldr: DataMind is introduced, a scalable data synthesis and agent training recipe designed to build generalist data-analytic agents and curates DataMind-12K, a high-quality trajectory set spanning diverse domains, task categories, and data file formats for data-analytic tasks.

2602.19509.tldr: A Probabilistic Anytime Property with provable monotonicity guarantees is established and a generalized escalation rule from Value of Computation theory is derived that accounts for imperfect oracles, extending the Hansen-Zilberstein monitoring framework to stochastic LLM inference.

2412.00547.tldr: This work introduces Motion Dreamer, a two-stage framework that explicitly separates motion reasoning from visual synthesis, addressing limitations of existing methods and bridging the gap towards practical boundary conditional motion reasoning.

2505.01651.tldr: The HAIG framework adopts a trust-utility orientation - reframing governance as the condition under which human-AI collaboration can realise its potential, calibrating oversight to specific relational contexts rather than predetermined categories.

2505.15854.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive review of recent advances enabling the integration of TinyML and LargeML in next-generation wireless networks and outlines promising research directions to guide the holistic integration of TinyML and LargeML for intelligent, scalable, and energy-efficient 6G networks and beyond.

2506.18248.tldr: This work enforces semantic consistency by aligning the early generator's intermediate features to an EMA teacher, stabilizing object-aligned representations and improving black-box transfer without inference-time overhead, and introduces Accidental Correction Rate (ACR) to separate inadvertent corrections from intended misclassifications.

2507.03633.tldr: EEG-VJEPA is proposed, a novel adaptation of the Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) for EEG classification that captures physiologically relevant spatial and temporal signal patterns, offering interpretable embeddings that may support human-AI collaboration in diagnostic workflows.

2410.20894.tldr: This paper describes how a complex planning and expectation-based detour behavior can be learned by ACSLWL when, unexpectedly, and for the first time, the simulated robot encounters a sort of transparent barrier in its pathway towards its target.

2507.18059.tldr: Results show that MAGPO consistently outperforms strong CTDE baselines and matches or surpasses fully centralized approaches, offering a principled and practical solution for decentralized multi-agent learning.

2511.18765.tldr: This work constructs 3D Garment Videos, a physically simulated, garment-centric dataset that provides consistent geometry and material supervision across diverse deformations, enabling robust cross-pose texture learning and proposes an iterative baking method via uncertainty-guided view selection and reweighting that fuses multi-view predictions into seamless, production-ready PBR textures.

2602.23228.tldr: MovieTeller is proposed, a novel framework for generating movie synopses via tool-augmented progressive abstraction that decomposes the summarization of a full-length movie into a multi-stage process, effectively mitigating the context length limitations of current VLMs.

2509.23325.tldr: It is found that fine-tuning using a robust objective impedes task adaptation at the beginning of training and eventually prevents optimal transfer, and a novel heuristic is proposed, Epsilon-Scheduling, a schedule over perturbation strength used during training that promotes optimal transfer.

2508.21742.tldr: This work presents conditions that guarantee the orientability of micro-level edges between temporal variables given the background knowledge encoded in a summary causal graph and assuming having access to a faithful and causally sufficient distribution with respect to the true unknown graph.

2411.10406.tldr: This work shows that orders of magnitude enhancement in performance could be obtained by a combination of hardware improvements and tight quantum-HPC integration and introduces high-performance architectures for quantum-probabilistic computing with custom-designed accelerators to tackle today's industry-scale classical optimization, machine learning, and quantum simulation tasks in a cost-effective manner.

2505.22954.tldr: The Darwin Godel Machine is proposed, a novel self-improving system that iteratively modifies its own code (thereby also improving its ability to modify its own codebase) and empirically validates each change using coding benchmarks.

2509.05379.tldr: ThreatGPT is an agentic Artificial Intelligence assistant built to help people whether they are engineers, safety officers, or policy makers to understand and analyze threats in public safety systems, designed not just to analyze threats, but to empower people to understand and act on them, faster, smarter, and with more confidence.

2603.02435.tldr: Experiments on WN9-IMG and two novel fine art MKGs demonstrate that VL-KGE consistently improves over traditional unimodal and multimodal KGE methods in link prediction tasks, highlighting the value of VLMs for multimodal KGE.

2603.06688.tldr: Through extensive experiments across three distinct scenarios (controllable multi-scene generation, autonomous storytelling, and e-commerce advertising), the Narrative Weaver method's superiority is demonstrated while opening new possibilities for AI-driven content creation.

2603.06723.tldr: A novel task named Agnostic Watermark Presence Detection (AWPD), which aims to identify whether an image carries a copyright mark without requiring decoding information, is proposed and the Frequency Shield Network (FSNet) is proposed, which exhibits superior zero-shot detection capabilities on the AWPD task, outperforming existing baseline models.

2603.00171.tldr: SvfEye is proposed, a training-free framework for adaptive visual-semantic fusion that achieves substantial performance gains while obtaining an approximately 4.0x inference speedup over the state-of-the-art method ZoomEye.

2409.05771.tldr: This work shows that evidence from language encoding models in fMRI supports the existence of a two-phase abstraction process within LLMs, and uses manifold learning methods to show that this abstraction process naturally arises over the course of training a language model and that the first"composition"phase is compressed into fewer layers as training continues.

2506.17564.tldr: Two improvements to Residual RL are proposed that further enhance its sample efficiency and make it suitable for stochastic base policies, and a simple modification to off-policy residual learning that allows it to observe base actions and better handle stochastic base policies are proposed.

2412.14841.tldr: This paper presents a framework that leverages testing and static analysis to assess the quality, and guide the self-improvement, of code generated by general-purpose, open-source LLMs, and shows that models often produce incorrect code, and that the generated code can include safety issues.

2509.12431.tldr: This work designs and benchmark an NQS impurity solver for the quantum embedding (QE) methods, focusing on the ghost Gutzwiller Approximation (gGA) framework and introduces a graph transformer-based NQS framework able to represent arbitrarily connected impurity orbitals of the embedding Hamiltonian (EH).

2504.16788.tldr: This work introduces a novel framework for generating natural language descriptions from video datasets by combining textual and visual modalities and uses multi-head self-attention and cross-attention techniques to guarantee high-quality description production.

2502.21123.tldr: This paper argues that a causal approach is essential for balancing multiple competing objectives in both trustworthy ML and foundation models, and examines how causality can be practically integrated into ML and foundation models, offering solutions to enhance their reliability and interpretability.

2508.11360.tldr: CRAFT-GUI is proposed, a curriculum learning framework based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that explicitly accounts for the varying difficulty across trajectories, and design a reward function that combines simple rule-based signals with model-judged evaluation, providing richer and more nuanced feedback during training.

2508.05880.tldr: CoRE, a large-scale benchmark designed to probe the implicit cognitive structures LLMs use when interpreting emotionally charged situations, is introduced and it is found that LLMs capture systematic relations between cognitive appraisals and emotions but show misalignment with human judgments and instability across contexts.

2506.17188.tldr: This work systematically presents key methodologies for realizing the AI Search Paradigm, including task planning and tool integration, execution strategies, aligned and robust retrieval-augmented generation, and efficient LLM inference, spanning both algorithmic techniques and infrastructure-level optimizations.

2509.09677.tldr: By focusing on the ability to execute, this work hopes to reconcile debates on how LLMs can solve complex reasoning problems yet fail at simple tasks when made longer, and highlight the massive benefits of scaling model size and sequential test-time compute for long-horizon tasks.

2508.10954.tldr: UniPrompt-CL is proposed, a medical-oriented prompt-based continual learning method that improves prompt pool design via a minimally expanding unified prompt pool and a new regularization term, achieving a better stability-plasticity trade-off with lower computational cost.

2506.00819.tldr: DriveMind is presented, a unified semantic reward framework that integrates a contrastive Vision-Language Model encoder for stepwise semantic anchoring, and a compact predictive world model to reward alignment with anticipated ideal states, demonstrating robust cross-domain alignment and potential for real-world deployment.

2505.17815.tldr: A chain-of-thought monitoring technique is devised to detect faking intent and uncover internal signals correlated with such behavior, offering insights for future mitigation studies.

2505.12050.tldr: A prompt-adaptive strategy for Best-of-N alignment that allocates inference-time compute more efficiently and remains competitive against uniform allocations with 20 percent larger inference budgets and improves in performance as the batch size grows.

2505.07920.tldr: The rebuttal and discussion stage is framed as a multi-turn conversation paradigm to support both traditional static review tasks and dynamic interactive LLM assistants, providing more practical guidance for authors to refine their manuscripts and helping alleviate the growing review burden.

2503.14550.tldr: Automatically quantified BAC is an independent predictor of MACE and mortality, adding prognostic value to the PREVENT score, and may provide an opportunistic cardiovascular risk assessment during routine mammography screening without additional radiation exposure to guide earlier and more effective preventive care for women.

2602.23163.tldr: The central insight is that steganography creates an asymmetry in usable information between agents who can and cannot decode the hidden content (present within a steganographic signal), and this otherwise latent asymmetry can be inferred from the agents' observed actions.

2603.00016.tldr: A multi-agent framework that orchestrates multiple components to perform complex preprocessing of multimodal inputs and adapt the AR application to the learner's needs is presented and a multi-agent AI framework for future integration is proposed.

2603.12520.tldr: For judge-based selection, the relevant audit should report within-prompt signal, tie rates, and recovery/top-1 accuracy, not global agreement alone.

2603.12340.tldr: This paper forms the task announcement problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) where the control policy must decide when to update announced completion times based on noisy observations of true task completion, and uses the Mixed Observability MDP (MOMDP) framework to enable more efficient policy optimization.

2603.12298.tldr: Global Evolutionary Refined Steering (GER-steer) is proposed, a training-free framework that grounded in the geometric stability of the network's representation evolution that exploits this global signal to rectify raw steering vectors, effectively decoupling robust semantic intent from orthogonal artifacts.

2603.12288.tldr: This work synthesizes principles from Information Theory, Latent Factor Models, and Psychometrics, clarifying that predictive robustness arises not solely from data cleanliness, but from the synergy between data architecture and model capacity, to identify predictors that enable robustness efficiently.

2603.12271.tldr: Across diverse LLMs, it is observed that retrieval bias intensifies as updates increase, earliest-state accuracy stays high while latest-state accuracy drops substantially, and cognitively inspired heuristic intervention strategies yield only modest gains and do not eliminate the bias.

2603.12270.tldr: A distillation framework that bypasses this bottleneck by training lightweight probes on frozen teacher hidden states and using the probe's predictions, rather than output logits, as supervision for student training is introduced.

2603.08206.tldr: The findings argue for reporting distributional metrics in tabular regression benchmarks and making the training objective of foundation models adaptable (via fine-tuning or task-token conditioning) to the scoring rule relevant to the downstream decision problem.

2603.07664.tldr: Ref-DGS is presented, a reflective dual Gaussian splatting framework that addresses this trade-off by decoupling surface reconstruction from specular reflection within an efficient rasterization-based pipeline and proposes a lightweight, physically-aware adaptive mixing shader that fuses global and local reflection features.

2603.12396.tldr: This paper investigates test-time modifications to the Search-R1 pipeline to mitigate shortcomings, and explores the integration of two components and their combination: a contextualization module to better integrate relevant information from retrieved documents into reasoning, and a de-duplication module that replaces previously retrieved documents with the next most relevant ones.

2603.12325.tldr: A novel algorithm for solving the maximum entropy exploration problem, EVE (EigenVector-based Exploration), which avoids explicit rollouts and distribution estimation, instead computing the solution through iterative updates, similar to a value-based approach.

2603.12324.tldr: This work proposes a geometric framework for RL by interpreting reward parameters as coordinates on a task manifold and provides an algorithm, "MEW"(Minimum Excess Work), to derive a principled schedule for temperature annealing in maximum-entropy RL.

2603.12296.tldr: A comprehensive review of brain signal generation for BCIs is provided, covering methodological taxonomies, benchmark experiments, evaluation metrics, and key applications, and systematically categorizes existing generative algorithms into four types: knowledge-based, feature-based, model-based, and translation-based approaches.

2603.12286.tldr: DIME (Detect-Integrate-Mark-Execute) is introduced, a neural architecture organizing perception, memory, valuation, and conscious access within a common operational cycle that may inform artificial intelligence and robotics by providing an architectural template in which representation, valuation, and temporal sequencing emerge from a unified mechanism.

2603.12278.tldr: A predictive analytics framework utilizing time-series data captured by wearable foot sensors, specifically NTC thin-film thermocouples for temperature measurement and FlexiForce pressure sensors for plantar load monitoring, is presented, aiming to facilitate earlier intervention and reduce DFU incidence.

2603.06862.tldr: It is demonstrated that Large Language Models (LLMs) can provide powerful support for AE tasks: text-based reproducibility rating, autonomous sandboxed execution environment preparation, and assessment of methodological pitfalls.

2603.12508.tldr: ELLA (Early Language Learning Agent), an autonomous, generative AI-powered social robot that supports early language development through interactive storytelling, parent-selected language targets, and scaffolded dialogue is presented.

2603.12483.tldr: This work evaluates 6 popular data analysis agents on domain-specific data and query types, and finds that they fail on stateful and incident-specific queries and shows that AgentFuel's benchmarks expose key directions for improvement in existing data agent frameworks.

2603.12480.tldr: Evaluations demonstrate that a one-step OFP achieves state-of-the-art results, outperforming 100-step diffusion and flow policies while accelerating action generation by over $100\times, establishing OFP as a practical, scalable solution for highly accurate and low-latency robot control.

2603.12349.tldr: The Budget-Sensitive Discovery Score (BSDS) is introduced, a formally verified metric that jointly penalizes false discoveries (lambda-weighted FDR) and excessive abstention (gamma-weighted coverage gap) at each budget level and establishes that LLMs provide no marginal value over an existing trained classifier.

2603.12310.tldr: VQQA (Video Quality Question Answering), a unified, multi-agent framework generalizable across diverse input modalities and video generation tasks, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art stochastic search and prompt optimization techniques.

2603.12290.tldr: This work introduces LLM-Augmented Graph Learning-based Miscitation Detector (LAGMiD), a novel framework that leverages LLMs for deep semantic reasoning over citation graphs and distills this knowledge into graph neural networks (GNNs) for efficient and scalable miscitation detection.

2603.12277.tldr: A unifying framework is introduced that reframes prompt injection not as an ad-hoc exploit but as a measurable consequence of how models represent role, introducing a unifying framework that reframes prompt injection as an ad-hoc exploit but as a measurable consequence of how models represent role.

2603.12273.tldr: This work conditioning the model on the user's follow-up message and comparing the resulting token distribution with the original policy yields a target for updating the policy that captures how the model's behavior changes in hindsight.

2603.12510.tldr: Q-DIG (Quality Diversity for Diverse Instruction Generation), which performs red-teaming by scalably identifying diverse natural language task descriptions that induce failures while remaining task-relevant, suggests that Q-DIG is a promising approach for identifying vulnerabilities and improving the robustness of VLA-based robots.

2603.12470.tldr: CLARE, a machine learning model for predicting electron temperature in the Earth's plasmasphere trained on AKEBONO satellite measurements as well as solar and geomagnetic indices, shows that machine learning can be used to produce high-accuracy Te models on publicly available data.

2603.12458.tldr: Restoring the masked evidence via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) triggers near-universal performance recovery, validating ShatterMed-QA's structural fidelity and proving its efficacy in diagnosing the fundamental reasoning deficits of current medical AI.

2603.12455.tldr: The Cyber Catalog is introduced, a knowledge base that systematically integrates CIS Critical Security Controls, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and SMART metrics that enables organisations to connect threat intelligence directly to actionable controls and measurable outcomes.

2603.12382.tldr: SPARROW is a pixel-grounded video MLLM that unifies spatial accuracy and temporal stability through two key components: Target-Specific Tracked Features (TSF), which inject temporally aligned referent cues during training, and a dual-prompt design that decodes box and segmentation tokens to fuse geometric priors with semantic grounding.

2603.12269.tldr: The Difficulty-Aware Efficiency Score (DAES), a novel multi-objective metric, is introduced, under which DART achieves up to a 14.8 improvement over baselines, highlighting superior accuracy, efficiency, and robustness trade-offs.

2603.12305.tldr: HCP-DCNet is introduced, a unified framework that bridges continuous physical dynamics with discrete symbolic causal inference and establishes rigorous theoretical guarantees, including type-safe composition, routing convergence, and universal approximation of causal dynamics.

2603.12304.tldr: A novel optimization framework that fundamentally integrates the Minimum Description Length principle into the training dynamics of deep neural networks, and provides a principled path toward more autonomous, generalizable, and interpretable AI systems by unifying geometric deep learning with information-theoretic principles.

2603.12287.tldr: A context-aware trajectory abstraction framework that segments noisy AIS sequences into distinct trips each consisting of clean, mobility-annotated episodes can facilitate downstream analytics and enable integration with LLMs for higher-level maritime reasoning tasks.

2603.12506.tldr: Na\"ive PAINE is proposed for improving the generative quality of Diffusion Models by leveraging T2I preference benchmarks and directly predict the numerical quality of an image from the initial noise and given prompt.

2603.12475.tldr: An industrial case study evaluating an AI-assisted design workflow trained on API Improvement Proposals and discusses the implications of this perfection paradox, proposing a shift in the human designer's role from the "drafter" of specifications to the "curator" of AI-generated patterns.

2603.12445.tldr: The analysis shows that the common practices of machine learning evaluation might lead to unreliable results when applied to cancer pathology, and some CNN architectures are more sensitive to bias than others.

2603.12433.tldr: This study revisit stitching for Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) that vary in objectives, data, and modality mix and proposes the VFM Stitch Tree (VST), which shares early layers across VFMs while retaining their later layers, yielding a controllable accuracy-latency trade-off for multimodal LLMs that often leverage multiple VFMs.

2603.12597.tldr: A scalable diagram generation pipeline built with Feynman, which can author diagrams along with grounded captions with very little cost and time, and a visual-language benchmark, Diagramma, which can be used for evaluating the visual reasoning capabilities of vision-language models.

2603.12581.tldr: A style--structure disentanglement mechanism in the latent space is introduced, which explicitly separates modality-specific style features from shared structural representations, and jointly models low-frequency anatomical layouts and high-frequency boundary details in a multi-scale feature space.

2603.12564.tldr: The findings suggest that safe deployment requires independent monitoring against a data source the agent cannot influence, and that suitability constraints into ranking metrics makes the gap visible.

2603.12540.tldr: It is argued that responsible deployment requires adversarial evaluation and governance practices that are increasingly necessary for edge AI systems and maps them to concrete engineering directions in interface design, control electronics, power management, verification, and security.

2603.12781.tldr: RIGID (Research-Integrated, Generative AI-Mediated Instructional Design), a unified framework that integrates LS research across ID workflows spanning analysis, design, implementation, and evaluation phases, while leveraging generative AI to mediate this integration at each stage.

2603.12773.tldr: This work proposes a new learning mechanism that leverages Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to empower UIE models with semantic-sensitive capabilities and significantly boosts their performance on perceptual quality metrics as well as enhances their performance on detection and segmentation tasks, validating its effectiveness and adaptability.

2603.12755.tldr: This work proposes AIM, a novel model modulation paradigm that enables a single model to exhibit diverse behaviors to meet the specific end requirements, and introduces a logits redistribution strategy that operates in a training data-agnostic and retraining-free manner.

2603.12744.tldr: TaoBench is introduced, an undergraduate-level benchmark derived from Terence Tao's Analysis I, which formalizes analysis by constructing core mathematical concepts from scratch, without relying on standard MathLib definitions, as well as by mixing from-scratch and MathLib constructions.

2603.12740.tldr: Empirical evaluations demonstrate that ToolTree consistently improves performance while keeping the highest efficiency, achieving an average gain of around 10\% compared to the state-of-the-art planning paradigm.

2603.12733.tldr: This work proposes a new method for early detection of catastrophic failures based on real data from a failed engine, and employs the derivatives of the deviations to provide earlier indications of abnormal dynamics, and to alert that a rapid and dangerous event is breaking out within the system.

2603.12722.tldr: This work proposes CognitionCapturerPro, an enhanced framework that integrates EEG with multi-modal priors (images, text, depth, and edges) via collaborative training and includes an uncertainty-weighted similarity scoring mechanism to quantify modality-specific fidelity and a fusion encoder for integrating shared representations.

2603.12717.tldr: A cross-architecture control using a non-reasoning VLA confirms the vulnerability is exclusive to reasoning-augmented models, while instruction-level attacks degrade both architectures -- establishing that the internal reasoning trace is a distinct and stealthy threat vector invisible to input-validation defenses.

2603.12707.tldr: It is shown that under standard transformer KV caching, the modality boundary minimizes cross-device transfer among all partition points that preserve standard stage-based execution, which means existing stage-level disaggregation systems are constrained to high-bandwidth interconnects.

2603.12647.tldr: A robust and efficient LiDAR-reflectance-guided Salient Gaussian Splatting method (LR-SGS) for self-driving scenes, which introduces a structure-aware Salient Gaussian representation, initialized from geometric and reflectance feature points extracted from LiDAR and refined through a salient transform and improved density control to capture edge and planar structures.

2603.12645.tldr: This paper proposes a novel expert compression paradigm termed expert replacing, which replaces redundant experts with parameter-efficient modules and recovers their capabilities with low training costs and introduces LightMoE, a framework that enhances the paradigm by introducing adaptive expert selection, hierarchical expert construction, and an annealed recovery strategy.

2603.12596.tldr: CAPO demonstrates that policy optimization can be improved by optimizing wider, rather than deeper, without additional environment interactions, and redirects compute from depth to width.

2603.12591.tldr: Curvature-Aware Heterogeneous Federated Pruning (CA-HFP), a practical framework that enables each client to perform structured, device-specific pruning guided by a curvature-informed significance score, and subsequently maps its compact submodel back into a common global parameter space via a lightweight reconstruction.

2603.12543.tldr: CALF (Communication-Aware Learning Framework), which trains policies under realistic network models during simulation, is introduced, establishing network conditions as a major axis of sim-to-real transfer for Wi-Fi-like distributed deployments, complementing physics and visual domain randomisation.

2603.12529.tldr: The central idea underpinning TERMINATOR is that the first arrival of an LRM's final answer is often predictable, and it is leveraged to create a novel dataset of optimal reasoning lengths to train TERMINATOR, an early-exit strategy for LRMs at inference to mitigate overthinking.

2603.12793.tldr: This work presents Cheers, a unified multimodal model that decouples patch-level details from semantic representations, thereby stabilizing semantics for multimodal understanding and improving fidelity for image generation via gated detail residuals.

2603.12710.tldr: A taxonomy that maps modern agent architectures to traditional planning paradigms: Step-by-Step agents to Breadth-First Search (BFS), Tree Search agents to Best-First Tree Search, and Full-Plan-in-Advance agents to Depth-First Search (DFS) is introduced.

2603.12666.tldr: Experimental results show that RetroReasoner not only outperforms prior baselines but also generates a broader range of feasible reactant proposals, particularly in handling more challenging reaction instances.

2603.12630.tldr: A game-theoretic model involving a provider and two competing downstream firms is employed to analyze how policy interventions affect consumer surplus in the AI supply chain and finds that pro-price-competitive policies or compute subsidies boost consumer surplus only when compute or data preprocessing costs are high, while compute subsidies are effective only when these costs are low.

2603.12617.tldr: OnlineSpec, a unified framework that systematically leverages interactive feedback to continuously evolve draft models, is proposed, establishing a formal link between online learning performance and speculative system's acceleration rate, and developing novel algorithms via modern online learning techniques.

2603.12615.tldr: It is argued that literary narrative constitutes an anticipatory evaluation instrument - one that becomes more discriminating as AI capability increases - and that the gap between performed and authentic moral reasoning is measurable, meaningful, and consequential for deployment decisions in high-stakes domains.

2603.12607.tldr: This paper proposes CarPLAN, a novel IL-based motion planning framework that explicitly enhances driving context understanding and enables adaptive planning across diverse traffic scenarios, and proposes Context-Adaptive Multi-Expert Decoder (CMD), which leverages the Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework.

2603.12606.tldr: This work introduces D-Negation, a new dataset that provides objects annotated with both positive and negative semantic descriptions and proposes a grouped opposition-based learning framework that learns negation-aware representations from limited samples.

2603.12725.tldr: Experiments on air quality prediction across two Chinese regions show that in-context operator learning outperforms classical operator learning on complex tasks, generalizing across spatial domains and scaling robustly from few training examples to 100 at inference.

2603.12719.tldr: This work proposes IGASA as a novel registration framework constructed upon a Hierarchical Pyramid Architecture (HPA) designed for robust multi-scale feature extraction and fusion and evaluates the performance of IGASA on four widely recognized benchmark datasets including 3D(Lo)Match, KITTI, and nuScenes.

2603.12701.tldr: Eye2Eye is a framework that leverages first-person perspective as a channel for human-AI cognitive alignment that significantly reduces task completion time and interaction load while increasing trust, demonstrating its components work in concert to improve collaboration.

2603.12634.tldr: The Budget-Aware Value Tree (BAVT), a training-free inference-time framework that models multi-hop reasoning as a dynamic search tree guided by step-level value estimation within a single LLM backbone, is proposed, establishing that intelligent budget management fundamentally outperforms brute-force compute scaling.

2603.12592.tldr: This paper introduces Early Pruning, a low-overhead technique that accelerates routing algorithms without compromising optimality by pre-sorting transfer connections by duration and applying a pruning rule within the transfer loop.

2603.12554.tldr: This work formulate diffusion-based sequence generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process over the denoising trajectory and derive an exact, unbiased policy gradient that decomposes over denoising steps and is expressed in terms of intermediate advantages, without requiring explicit evaluation of the sequence likelihood.

2603.12522.tldr: LLM BiasScope is a web application for side-by-side comparison of LLM outputs with real-time bias analysis that supports multiple providers and enables researchers and practitioners to compare models on the same prompts while analyzing bias patterns.

2603.12743.tldr: This work proposes MoKus, a novel framework for knowledge-aware concept customization that relies on a key observation: cross-modal knowledge transfer, where modifying knowledge within the text modality naturally transfers to the visual modality during generation.

2603.12739.tldr: An SRAM-based CIM for SNN with Linear Decay Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LD-LIF) Neuron that co-optimizes algorithm and hardware and introduces an in-memory parallel update scheme that performs in-place decay directly within the SRAM array, eliminating the need for global sequential updates.

2603.12677.tldr: This work proposes MetaKE (Meta-learning Aligned Knowledge Editing), a new framework that reframes KE as a bi-level optimization problem, and derives a Structural Gradient Proxy, which explicitly backpropagates editability constraints to the target learning phase.

2603.12758.tldr: This work presents a lightweight post-association correction framework (FC-Track) for online MOT that explicitly targets overlap-induced mismatches during inference, and locally corrects detection-to-tracklet mismatches through appearance similarity comparison within overlapped tracklet pairs.

2603.12721.tldr: This work proposes CMHANet, a novel Cross-Modal Hybrid Attention Network, a novel Cross-Modal Hybrid Attention Network that integrates the fusion of rich contextual information from 2D images with the geometric detail of 3D point clouds, yielding a comprehensive and resilient feature representation.

2603.12693.tldr: Experimental results on four tasks from the ABAW challenge demonstrate that the proposed fast approach based on facial embedding extraction with pre-trained EfficientNet-based emotion recognition models significantly improves validation metrics over existing baselines.

2603.12684.tldr: This work proposes a novel FC framework named Fed-$k^*$-HC, which can automatically determine an optimal number of clusters based on the data distribution explored through hierarchical clustering, and demonstrates the FC capability of the proposed Fed-$k^*$-HC in accurately exploring a proper number of clusters.

2603.12683.tldr: A text similarity metric is employed to evaluate different ChatGPT models'capacity to generate diverse textual outputs and indicates a measurable decline of recent ChatGPT releases'ability to produce varied text, even when explicitly prompted to do so, by setting the temperature parameter to one.

2603.12664.tldr: TESS is proposed, which introduces a Temporal Evolution Semantic Space as an intermediate bottleneck between modalities, which consists of interpretable, numerically grounded temporal primitives extracted from text by an LLM via structured prompting and filtered through confidence-aware gating.

2603.12658.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive overview of CL methodologies tailored for LLMs, structured around three core training stages: continual pre-training, continual fine-tuning, and continual alignment, and covers essential evaluation metrics, including forgetting rates and knowledge transfer efficiency, along with emerging benchmarks for assessing CL performance.

2603.12628.tldr: A unified brain-to-sentence decoding framework for both speech production and perception in Mandarin Chinese is presented, establishing the feasibility of a unified decoding framework and providing insights into the neural characteristics of Mandarin speech production and perception.

2603.12612.tldr: This work introduces Dimension-wise Entropy Modulation (DEM) to dynamically redistribute the exploration budget and enforce diversity, alongside a continuous distributional critic tailored to ensure value fidelity and mitigate high-dimensional value overestimation.

2603.12538.tldr: SERA introduces lightweight, expression-aware expert refinement at two complementary stages within a vision-language framework and uses a parameter-efficient tuning strategy that updates only normalization and bias terms, affecting less than 1% of the backbone parameters.

2603.13134.tldr: Bilateral Context Conditioning (BICC) is proposed, a mechanism that allows the model to cross-reference successful and failed reasoning traces during the optimization, enabling a direct information flow across samples.

2603.13119.tldr: A lightweight, model-agnostic pipeline is proposed that extracts geometric camera cues from 3D foundation models, predicts constrained motion primitives with a temporal classifier, and injects them into downstream VideoLLM inference via structured prompting.

2603.13109.tldr: The Best-of-Strategy Selector (BoSS), a scalable oracle strategy designed for large-scale AL scenarios that outperforms existing oracle strategies and can be easily extended with new state-of-the-art strategies as they emerge, ensuring it remains a reliable oracle strategy in the future.

2603.13100.tldr: This work evaluates the capability of four state-of-the-art VLMs at spatial reasoning over robot motion, using four different querying methods and shows some promise in the potential of VLM integration with robot motion planning pipelines.

2603.13083.tldr: This work presents a scalable, end-to-end workflow for LLM-assisted grading of short, pen-and-paper assessments that reduces grading time while achieving agreement comparable to, and in several cases tighter than, fully manual grading.

2603.13059.tldr: The results show that broad market-outcome coverage, combined with keyword-derived semantic and geographic priors, provides a scalable way to approximate latent competition and improve CPC forecasting in auction-driven markets.

2603.13023.tldr: OpenSWE is presented, the largest fully transparent framework for SWE agent training in Python, comprising 45,320 executable Docker environments spanning over 12.8k repositories, with all Dockerfiles, evaluation scripts, and infrastructure fully open-sourced for reproducibility.

2603.12912.tldr: This work proposes Federated Body Distribution Aware Visual Prompt (FedBPrompt), introducing learnable visual prompts to guide Transformer attention toward pedestrian-centric regions and design a Prompt-based Fine-Tuning Strategy (PFTS) that freezes the ViT backbone and updates only lightweight prompts, significantly reducing communication overhead while maintaining adaptability.

2603.12840.tldr: This work proposes a dual-stream attacker that fuses spectral and self-supervised learning features via parallel encoders with a three-stage training strategy, enabling strong attacking performance on unseen anonymization datasets.

2603.13024.tldr: This work designs a conditional video diffusion approach that reformulates video-to-video diffusion into trajectory-conditioned surgical action synthesis, and proposes Surgical Action World (SAW), a step toward surgical action world modeling through video diffusion conditioned on four lightweight signals.

2603.12953.tldr: This work introduces an end to end explainability by construction pipeline integrating the Automated Theorem Generator Delta1 based on the full triangular standard contradiction (FTSC) with LLMs, positioning constructive theorem generation as a principled foundation for neuro-symbolic explainable AI.

2603.12906.tldr: A systematic study of compact language models by extending BabyBERTa to English-French scenarios under strictly size-matched data conditions, covering monolingual, bilingual, and cross-lingual settings, revealing context-dependent effects.

2603.12895.tldr: A mixed-methods evaluation of the proposed solution, an LLM-powered BPMN copilot, reveals a critical tension between acceptable perceived usability and notably lower trust, and demonstrates the necessity of human-centered evaluation complementing automated benchmarking for LLM modeling agents.

2603.13131.tldr: Steve-Evolving is presented, a non-parametric self-evolving framework that tightly couples fine-grained execution diagnosis with dual-track knowledge distillation in a closed loop to solve long-horizon tasks where the main bottleneck is not single-step planning quality but how interaction experience is organized and evolved.

2603.13099.tldr: CRYSTAL is introduced, a diagnostic benchmark with 6,372 instances that evaluates multimodal reasoning through verifiable intermediate steps, and the Causal Process Reward (CPR), a multiplicative reward that couples answer correctness with step-level alignment, and CPR-Curriculum, which progressively increases reasoning difficulty during training.

2603.13056.tldr: A multimodal method for valence-arousal estimation ITW and two fusion strategies: a Directed Cross-Modal Mixture-of-Experts Fusion Strategy that learns interactions between modalities with adaptive weighting, and a Reliability-Aware Audio-Visual Fusion Strategy that combines visual features at the frame-level while using audio as complementary context.

2603.13036.tldr: A sociotechnical risk analysis unpacking the potential harms of web vibe coding and their interaction with design homogenization, and a mitigation framework centered on the idea of productive friction is proposed.

2603.13019.tldr: ARL-Tangram, a unified resource management system that enables fine-grained external resource sharing and elasticity, utilizes a unified action-level formulation and an elastic scheduling algorithm to minimize action completion time (ACT) while satisfying heterogeneous resource constraints.

2603.12960.tldr: In both simulation and zero-shot real-world transfer to Roboracer cars, $\alpha$-RPO not only reduces system complexity but also improves driving performance compared to baselines - demonstrating its practicality for robotic deployment.

2603.12938.tldr: This paper introduces ThinkStream, a framework for streaming video reasoning based on a Watch--Think--Speak paradigm that enables models to incrementally update their understanding as new video observations arrive, and proposes Reasoning-Compressed Streaming Memory (RCSM), which treats intermediate reasoning traces as compact semantic memory that replaces outdated visual tokens while preserving essential context.

2603.12933.tldr: AMRO-S models MAS routing as a semantic-conditioned path selection problem, enhancing routing performance through three key mechanisms that leverages a supervised fine-tuned (SFT) small language model for intent inference, providing a low-overhead semantic interface for each query.

2603.12926.tldr: This work provides algorithms to compute a normal form for ODRL policies and simplifies numerical and symbolic constraints, and proves that these algorithms preserve the semantics of policies, and analyse the size complexity of the result.

2603.13065.tldr: Experiments show that L2GTX produces compact and interpretable global explanations while maintaining stable global faithfulness measured as mean local surrogate fidelity, a model-agnostic framework that generates class-wise global explanations by aggregating local explanations from a representative set of instances.

2603.13044.tldr: This work conducts a controlled empirical study to examine whether specialized medical segmentation architectures (SMAs) provide systematic advantages over modern GP-VMs for 2D MIS, and suggests that GP-VMs can represent a viable alternative to domain-specific methods.

2603.13028.tldr: A purify-once, edit-freely failure mode: once purification succeeds, the protective signal is largely removed, enabling unrestricted editing, highlighting the need to evaluate protections under model mismatch and design defenses robust to heterogeneous attackers.

2603.13017.tldr: Personalized agent memory is studied: one user's conversation history with an agent, distilled into a compact retrieval layer for later search, which compresses single-user agent memory without uniformly sacrificing retrieval quality.

2603.12988.tldr: An attention-based Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) model on a ConvNeXt backbone that learns to identify diagnostically relevant slices without slice-level supervision, augmented with a Gradient Reversal Layer (GRL) that adversarially suppresses gender-predictive structure in the learned scan representation is proposed.

2603.12893.tldr: This paper proposes an online RL variant that reduces the variance in the model updates by sampling paired trajectories and pulling the flow velocity in the direction of the more favorable image.

2603.12848.tldr: A multimodal approach for video-level ambivalence/hesitancy recognition is presented for the 10th ABAW Competition and highlights the importance of complementary multimodal cues and robust fusion strategies for ambivalence/hesitancy recognition.

2603.12847.tldr: This work proposes a novel outlier detection paradigm that leverages the natural neighboring relationships using graph structures and enables the effective recognition of scattered outliers without interference from clustered anomalies, whereas the graph structure simultaneously helps to reflect and isolate clustered outlier groups.

2603.12837.tldr: Unlike generative approaches that synthesize speech from Gaussian noise, the proposed Mask2Flow-TSE method starts from the masked spectrogram, enabling high-quality reconstruction in a single inference step.

2603.12832.tldr: A novel transformer, a novel transformer designed to adaptively model diverse spatial layouts of the image pair, is designed to adaptively model diverse spatial layouts of the image pair within the flexible and unified encoding layer, and a Hierarchical Dual-Change Collaborative Learning (HDC-CL) method is proposed for UAV scene change captioning.

2603.13126.tldr: This study presents the development of the PsyCogMetrics AI Lab (psycogmetrics.ai), an integrated, cloud-based platform that operationalizes psychometric and cognitive-science methodologies for Large Language Model evaluation, benefiting research at the intersection of AI, psychology, cognitive science, and the social and behavioral sciences.

2603.13027.tldr: Despite the limited dataset size, these lightweight models achieve strong classification accuracy, demonstrating that controlled acquisition conditions enable effective learning even with relatively small datasets.

2603.12983.tldr: A novel self-evolution framework based on Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding is proposed, named Iterative MBR Distillation for ESD, which eliminates the reliance on human annotations by leveraging an off-the-shelf LLM to generate pseudo-labels.

2603.12916.tldr: This work introduces AxonAD, an unsupervised detector that treats multi-head attention query evolution as a short horizon predictable process that improves ranking quality and temporal localization over strong baselines and confirms that query prediction and combined scoring are the primary drivers of the observed gains.

2603.12915.tldr: This work proposes a novel structure-faithful framework that introduces stakes, i.e., semantic anchors that serve as reference points to maintain the knowledge structure, and captures and stabilizes the semantic organization of knowledge.

2603.12816.tldr: The proposed Residual SODAP framework combines $\alpha$-entmax sparse prompt selection with residual aggregation, data-free distillation with pseudo-feature replay, prompt-usage--based drift detection, and uncertainty-aware multi-loss balancing.

2603.12813.tldr: An agentic AI framework that delivers assistance in an industrial flowsheet simulation environment and develops a multi-agent system that decomposes process development tasks with one agent solving the abstract problem using engineering knowledge and another agent implementing the solution as Chemasim code.

2603.13228.tldr: This work proposes PhysMoDPO, a Direct Preference Optimization framework that results in significant improvements when applied to zero-shot motion transfer in simulation and for real-world deployment on a G1 humanoid robot.

2603.13180.tldr: This work proposes MXNorm, a drop-in replacement for RMSNorm that estimates the RMS using only the block scales calculated as part of the MXFP8 cast and enables a 32x decrease in the size of reduction needed for normalization.

2603.13224.tldr: This work proposes Visual Equivalence Reward Model (Visual-ERM), a multimodal generative reward model that provides fine-grained, interpretable, and task-agnostic feedback to evaluate vision-to-code quality directly in the rendered visual space and suggests that fine-grained visual reward supervision is both necessary and sufficient for vision-to-code RL, regardless of task specificity.

2603.13191.tldr: QMatSuite is presented, an open-source platform closing this gap in AI-driven computational science that reduces reasoning overhead by 67% and improves accuracy from 47% to 3% deviation from literature -- and when transferred to an unfamiliar material, achieves 1% deviation with zero pipeline failures.

2603.13189.tldr: The findings establish that cooperation is not inherently desirable without governance: constitutional constraints are necessary to ensure that LLM-mediated influence produces ethically stable outcomes rather than manipulative equilibria.

2603.13173.tldr: This paper presents a metamorphic testing framework for systematically assessing the robustness of LLM reasoning agents, applying eight semantic-preserving transformations across seven foundation models spanning four distinct architectural families.

2603.13168.tldr: The findings show that trustworthy medical assistants in multilingual, noisy settings require defense-in-depth design paired with multi-method evaluation, rather than any single model and evaluation method choice.

2603.13186.tldr: To preserve privacy, to preserve privacy, critical weights are scored, and instead of discarding those neurons, the weights are rewind only the weights for fine-tuning, and this mechanism exhibits outperforming resilience in most cases against Membership Inference Attacks while maintaining utility.

2603.13177.tldr: A machine learning-based pipeline for clustering approximately 22,300 simulated satellite orbits, addressing challenges with advanced feature extraction and dimensionality reduction techniques and revealing stability regions, resonance structures, and other key behaviours in Saturn's satellite system.

2310.01770.tldr: This work investigates how sharpness relates to the geometric structure of neural representations, specifically representation compression, defined as how strongly neural activations concentrate under local input perturbations and derives upper bounds showing these are mathematically constrained by sharpness.

2410.13331.tldr: Decoupled Straight-Through (Decoupled ST) is proposed, a minimal modification that introduces separate temperatures for the forward pass ($\tau_f$) and the backward pass ($\tau_b$), enabling independent tuning of exploration and gradient dispersion.

2410.15173.tldr: A new state-of-the-art on thematic fit benchmarks is set, but it is shown that closed and open weight LLMs respond differently to the authors' prompting strategies: Closed models achieve better scores overall and benefit from multi-step reasoning, but they perform worse at filtering out generated sentences incompatible with the specified predicate, role, and argument.

2411.17411.tldr: The second edition of this book adds newly introduced concepts, corrects typographical issues, and re-examines mathematical consistency, aiming to serve as a compact reference and a source of inspiration for further research.

2412.17052.tldr: ViLBias, a VQA-style benchmark and framework for detecting and reasoning about bias in multimodal news, is presented and results show that incorporating images alongside text improves detection accuracy, and that LLMs/VLMs better capture subtle framing and text--image inconsistencies than SLMs.

2502.05795.tldr: This paper proposes LayerNorm Scaling (LNS), which scales the variance of output of the layer normalization inversely by the square root of its depth, and mitigates the output variance explosion of deeper Transformer layers, improving their contribution during training.

2502.08047.tldr: WorldGUI, a benchmark covering ten widely used desktop and web applications with tasks instantiated under diverse, systematically constructed initial states, and WorldGUI-Agent, a simple and model-agnostic framework that organizes planning and execution around three critique stages, improving reliability in dynamic environments are presented.

2503.04940.tldr: Vector Quantized Emergent Language (VQEL), a novel architecture that incorporates vector quantization into the message generation process, is introduced, position self-play as a principled and effective mechanism for learning discrete communication protocols, addressing key optimization and representational challenges in emergent language systems.

2503.23377.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that JavisDiT significantly outperforms existing methods by ensuring both high-quality generation and precise synchronization, setting a new standard for JAVG tasks.

2504.10917.tldr: GFSE is the first cross-domain graph structural encoder pre-trained with multiple self-supervised learning objectives, and built on a Graph Transformer, enabling it to encode intricate multi-level and fine-grained topological features within complex graph structures.

2505.08783.tldr: This work frame PDE solving as a code generation task and introduces CodePDE, the first inference framework for generating PDE solvers using large language models (LLMs), which shows that, with advanced inference-time algorithms and scaling strategies, LLMs can achieve strong performance across a range of representative PDE problems.

2505.11304.tldr: This is the first unified theoretical analysis of general heterogeneous FL, offering a principled understanding of how these two forms of heterogeneity jointly distort the optimization trajectory under arbitrary choices of local solvers and proposes FedACS, a universal method to eliminate all types of objective inconsistency.

2505.16789.tldr: This work investigates Accidental Vulnerability, unexpected vulnerabilities arising from characteristics of fine-tuning data, and explores causal relationships that offer new insights into adversarial defense strategies, highlighting the crucial role of dataset design in preserving model alignment.

2506.00486.tldr: This work empirically shows that weights, activations, and gradients in LLMs are well modeled by generalized Gaussian distributions, and introduces a unified, end-to-end optimization framework grounded in this observation.

2506.22740.tldr: A decision theoretic framework is contributed that treats explanations as information signals valued by the expected improvement they enable on a specified decision task, and applies it to assess explanation potential and interpret behavioral effects in human-AI decision support and mechanistic interpretability.

2507.01781.tldr: The primary contribution of this work is SBN, a semi-symbolic variant that preserves branch semantics by keeping W_{2}$ fixed, while allowing W_{1}$ to be refined through learning, which improves predictive accuracy without altering the underlying symbolic structure.

2507.14811.tldr: SegQuant is a unified quantization framework that adaptively combines complementary techniques to enhance cross-model versatility and is broadly applicable beyond Transformer-based diffusion models, achieving strong performance while ensuring seamless compatibility with mainstream deployment tools.

2507.20174.tldr: A spatial evaluation pipeline is introduced and a corresponding benchmark is constructed, categorizing spatial understanding into two main types: absolute spatial understanding, which involves querying the absolute spatial position, and 3D spatial understanding, which includes movement and rotation.

2508.02066.tldr: MolReasoner is introduced, a two-stage framework that transitions LLMs from memorization to high-fidelity chemical reasoning, and significantly outperforms a wide range of strong baselines in both molecule generation and captioning tasks.

2508.03111.tldr: This paper combines an unsupervised self-organizing mechanism for GED approximation with a Generalized Additive Model that flexibly learns contextualized edit costs, yielding directly interpretable graph matchings, uncovering meaningful structures in complex graphs, and showing strong applicability to domains such as molecular analysis.

2508.07087.tldr: This work introduces SQL-Exchange, a framework for mapping SQL queries across different database schemas by preserving the source query structure while adapting domain-specific elements to align with the target schema, and investigates the conditions under which such mappings are feasible and beneficial.

2508.11915.tldr: The Conversational Robustness Evaluation Score: CORE is presented, a metric to quantify the effectiveness of language use within multi-agent systems across different game-theoretic interactions to measure linguistic robustness in multi-agent LLM systems.

2508.14734.tldr: AFABench is introduced, the first benchmark framework for AFA, which implements and evaluates representative algorithms from all major categories, including static, myopic, and reinforcement learning-based approaches and introduces a novel synthetic dataset, CUBE-NM, designed to expose the limitations of myopic selection.

2509.03830.tldr: Results show that tourist photos systematically foreground key streetscape elements and that the color composition represented on social media can differ from on-site street views, indicating a perception-reality gap that varies by quarter.

2509.21896.tldr: GenesisGeo-1M is introduced, a large-scale synthetic dataset for visual geometric reasoning that contains 1M multimodal geometry problems paired with machine-checkable proof traces that formulate geometric learning as a multi-task training paradigm that jointly optimizes text-based proof generation and diagram-grounded proof generation, encouraging models to learn visual grounding and symbolic deduction.

2509.24526.tldr: Consistency Mid-Training is a compact and principled stage that trains a model to map points along a solver trajectory from a pre-trained model, starting from a prior sample, directly to the solver-generated clean sample, which yields a trajectory-consistent and stable initialization.

2510.00553.tldr: This work identifies two fundamental properties of RL-induced parameter updates in LLMs: Rank-1 Dominance, where the top singular subspace of the parameter update matrix nearly fully determines reasoning improvements, and Rank-1 Linear Dynamics, where this dominant subspace evolves linearly throughout training, enabling accurate prediction from early checkpoints.

2510.03346.tldr: This study proposes KVComm, a novel communication framework that enables efficient communication between LLMs through selective sharing of KV pairs, and introduces a KV layer-wise selection strategy based on attention importance scores with a Gaussian prior to identify the most informative KV pairs for communication.

2510.04891.tldr: SocialHarmBench is introduced, a dataset of 585 prompts spanning 7 sociopolitical categories and 34 countries, designed to surface where LLMs most acutely fail in politically charged contexts, demonstrating that current safeguards fail to generalize to high-stakes sociopolitical settings.

2510.09312.tldr: This work demonstrates that structural signatures of error are highly predictive, establishing the viability of verifying reasoning directly via its computational graph, and shows that, by scrutinizing a model's computational process, it can move from simple error detection to a deeper, causal understanding of LLM reasoning.

2510.13205.tldr: Catch, a knowledge-guided weak supervision model designed to detect fraudulent prescription behaviors with improved accuracy and interpretability, is introduced, suggesting that embedding expert rules into the learning process not only improves detection accuracy but also increases transparency.

2510.25232.tldr: This work constructs PsyCoTalk, the first large-scale dialogue dataset supporting comorbidity, containing 3,000 multi-turn diagnostic dialogues validated by psychiatrists, and creates 502 synthetic EMRs for common comorbid conditions using a pipeline that ensures clinical relevance and diversity.

2510.27623.tldr: BEAT is introduced, the first framework to inject such visual backdoors into VLM-based embodied agents using objects in the environments as triggers, and exposes a critical yet unexplored security risk in VLM-based embodied agents, underscoring the need for robust defenses before real-world deployment.

2511.00958.tldr: This work proves that an unnormalized DNN can exhibit exponentially large Lipschitz constants with respect to either its parameters or inputs, implying excessive functional capacity and potential overfitting, and develops a theoretical framework that elucidates the role of normalization through the lens of capacity control.

2511.02860.tldr: A deep learning tool for universal large-scale 2D/3D electron microscopy analysis, DeepOrganelle, which provides a powerful framework that captures subcellular dynamics at the whole-tissue level.

2512.00403.tldr: SelfAI is introduced, a self-directed, multi-agent-enabled discovery system that automates scientific exploration as a strategic, trajectory-driven decision-making process that consistently discovers high-quality solutions with substantially fewer redundant trials than classical optimization and recent LLM-based baselines.

2512.04808.tldr: Fitting RNNs to rich patterns of behaviour provides a powerful way to automatically discover mechanisms of important cognitive functions, as well as yielding novel predictions about the mechanism of swap errors.

2512.13742.tldr: This study shows that combining DL with LLMs can produce useful clinical narratives, but current LLMs remain unreliable for high-stakes medical decisions and provides a clearer view of their limits and a path for building safer reasoning systems.

2601.00671.tldr: Experiments show that FwPKM functions as an effective episodic memory that complements the semantic memory of standard modules, yielding significant perplexity reductions on long-context datasets.

2601.04568.tldr: Preliminary results from mental health risk assessment tasks indicate that this neurosymbolic approach enhances both transparency and overall performance.

2601.18467.tldr: It is demonstrated that expensive online reinforcement learning is not all you need to build powerful research agents, and a fully open-source suite designed for effective offline training is introduced, including OffSeeker, a model developed entirely offline.

2602.05495.tldr: This work proposes a cross-architecture merging framework based on optimal transport (OT) that aligns activations to infer cross-neuron correspondences between heterogeneous models, enabling effective high-resource to low-resource transfer using only a small set of inputs.

2602.07774.tldr: The Generative Reasoning Reranker (GR2), an end-to-end framework with a three-stage training pipeline tailored for reranking, finds that RL reward design is crucial in reranking: LLMs tend to exploit reward hacking by preserving item order, motivating conditional verifiable rewards to mitigate this behavior and optimize reranking performance.

2602.07883.tldr: Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that ToolSelf rivals specialized workflows while generalizing to novel tasks, achieving a 24.1% average performance gain and illuminating a path toward truly self-adaptive agents.

2602.08104.tldr: A two-stage gradient-based framework that provides interpretable diagnostics for three critical failure analysis tasks: detecting the true initial failure source (Patient-0), validating why non-attacked agents may be flagged first due to domino effects; and tracing how failures propagate through learned coordination pathways.

2602.14488.tldr: This work presents a Bangla IR dataset constructed using a BETA-labeling framework involving multiple LLM annotators from diverse model families, which incorporates contextual alignment, consistency checks, and majority agreement, followed by human evaluation to verify label quality.

2602.18985.tldr: This work introduces InfEngine, an autonomous intelligent computational engine designed to drive a paradigm shift from human-led orchestration to collaborative automation, and illustrates how researchers can transition from manual coding to collaborating with self-verifying, self-optimizing computational partners.

2602.18986.tldr: A parsimonious Bayesian risk decomposition expressing expected loss as the product of three terms: the probability of system failure, the conditional probability that a failure propagates into harm given the automation level, and the expected severity of harm.

2602.18998.tldr: This work introduces General AgentBench, a benchmark that provides such a unified framework for evaluating general LLM agents across search, coding, reasoning, and tool-use domains and finds that neither scaling methodology yields effective performance improvements in practice.

2602.19020.tldr: This work introduces Active Data Reconstruction Attack (ADRA), a family of MIA that actively induces a model to reconstruct a given text through training through training, motivated by findings that reinforcement learning sharpens behaviors already encoded in weights.

2602.19022.tldr: The proposed FishProtoNet framework is a robust, non-invasive computer vision-based framework for sex identification of delta smelt, an endangered fish species native to California, across its full life cycle and provides interpretability through learned prototype representations while improving robustness by leveraging foundation models to reduce the influence of background noise.

2602.19025.tldr: The results indicate that making the router explicit and combining multi-statistic node encoding with expert-level diversity can improve the transparency of MoE decisions for malware analysis.

2602.19027.tldr: By learning to propose ILT-friendly initializations, this approach mitigates non-convexity and advances beyond what traditional solvers or GenAI can achieve.

2602.19033.tldr: Neural resonance provides a unified explanation for long-term degenerate behavior in generative models and provides practical diagnostics for identifying, characterizing, and eventually mitigating collapse.

2602.19065.tldr: This study proposes Agentic Problem Frames (APF), a systematic engineering framework that shifts focus from internal model intelligence to the structured interaction between the agent and its environment, establishing a dynamic specification paradigm where intent is concretized at runtime through domain knowledge injection.

2602.19066.tldr: This work extends Inverse Distillation, a technique originally developed to accelerate continuous diffusion models to the discrete setting, and introduces gradient-stable relaxations to support effective training.

2602.19069.tldr: It is shown that good stepping stone questions exist and are transferrable, meaning that good questions can be generated, and they substantially help LLMs of various capabilities in solving the target tasks.

2602.19071.tldr: This paper focuses on the problem of matching up the explanatory requirements of different applications with the capabilities of underlying ML techniques to provide them, and presents three dimensions for categorising the explanatory Requirements of Different applications.

2602.19087.tldr: This integrated Explainable AI (XAI) framework demonstrates that explainability, computational efficiency, and experimental integrity can be simultaneously achieved, providing a robust foundation for deploying trustworthy AI systems in security operations centers where decision transparency is paramount.

2602.19114.tldr: Empirical results on single-cell and OpenWebText datasets demonstrate the Kaiwu-PyTorch-Plugin's ability to achieve SOTA performance, validating a comprehensive quantum-classical paradigm.

2602.19115.tldr: This paper presents the first study that investigates how LLMs encode the concept of scientific quality through relevant monosemantic features extracted using sparse autoencoders, and identifies four recurring types of features that capture key aspects of how research quality is represented.

2602.19130.tldr: Promising results are demonstrated, successfully detecting nearly 90% of mislabeled samples in MNIST and on CheXpert, where mislabeled samples consistently exhibit higher influence scores, highlighting the potential of influence functions for identifying label errors.
