2603.16959.tldr: A machine intelligence-empowered framework for the full chain support of material synthesis, encompassing rapid process optimization, accurate customized synthesis, and comprehensive mechanism deciphering is devised, demonstrating the ML potential to transform the research paradigm and is adaptable to broader material synthesis.

2603.16944.tldr: Omni IIE Bench is introduced, a high-quality, human-annotated benchmark specifically designed to diagnose the editing consistency of IIE models in practical application scenarios and quantifies, for the first time, a prevalent performance gap.

2603.16929.tldr: By shaping the optimization landscape with hazard-aware penalties, the proposed MHPO achieves fine-grained regulation of asymmetric policy shifts simultaneously mitigating mode collapse from over-expansion and preventing policy erosion from catastrophic contraction within a stabilized trust region.

2603.17102.tldr: This work proposes leveraging cross-lingual inconsistency in mixture-of-experts LLMs as a tool for interpretability in mixture-of-experts (MoE) LLMs by applying a statistical contrastive analysis to the MoE router logits to identify experts important for knowledge.

2603.17075.tldr: This work implements an AlphaZero-style training loop and compares two approaches: Proximal Policy Optimization with Monte Carlo Tree Search (PPO+MCTS) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC).

2603.17052.tldr: This study systematically investigates the issue of collapses in vector quantization, where collapsed representations are observed across discrete codebook tokens and continuous latent embeddings and proposes potential solutions aimed at mitigating each collapse.

2603.16952.tldr: The Deployment Gauntlet organizes constraints into eight coupled barriers that determine whether embodied foundation models can run reliably in practice, including decompositions that separate fast control from slower semantic reasoning.

2603.16969.tldr: DeepStage, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework for adaptive, stage-aware defense against Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs), is presented, which demonstrates effective stage-aware and cost-efficient autonomous cyber defense.

2603.16967.tldr: MSRAMIE takes existing editing models as plug-in components and handle multi-instruction tasks via structured multimodal reasoning, introducing a novel reasoning topology that comprises the proposed Tree-of-States and Graph-of-References.

2603.16966.tldr: CineSRD is proposed, a unified multimodal framework that leverages visual, acoustic, and linguistic cues from video, speech, and subtitles for speaker annotation that achieves superior performance on the proposed benchmark and competitive results on conventional datasets, validating its robustness and generalizability in open-world visual media settings.

2603.16943.tldr: The proposed KGS-GCN is a graph convolutional network that integrates kinematics-driven Gaussian splatting with probabilistic topology, and establishes a practical pathway for improving perceptual reliability in real-world sensing applications.

2603.16940.tldr: A sparse control‐point parameterization provides a compact, smooth deformation representation while reducing memory and improving stability.

2603.16938.tldr: Aegis is presented, a runtime governance architecture for autonomous AI systems that treats policy and legal constraints as execution conditions rather than advisory principles and seeks to show that policy violating behavior can be rendered operationally non executable within a controlled runtime governance framework.

2603.16924.tldr: SimulU is proposed, the first training-free policy for long-form SimulS2S, which adopts history management and speech output selection strategies that exploit cross-attention in pre-trained end-to-end models to regulate both input history and output generation.

2603.16914.tldr: This work proposes a hierarchy-aware representation learning framework that models quantizer-level contributions through learnable global weighting, enabling structured codec representations aligned with forensic cues in speech deepfake detection.

2603.16911.tldr: A functional interpretability framework that reverse-engineers the role of embedding dimensions by characterizing their contribution to land cover structure from observed classification behavior, and finds that accurate land cover classification can be achieved using as few as 2 to 12 of the 64 available dimensions, depending on the class.

2603.16901.tldr: AISA-AR-FunctionCall is presented, a production-oriented Arabic function-calling framework built on a 270M-parameter FunctionGemma backbone and trained through systematic dataset auditing, schema repair, tool-aware prompt restructuring, and full-parameter supervised fine-tuning.

2603.17248.tldr: This work proposes Pathology-Aware Multi-View Contrastive Learning, a framework that regularizes the latent space through a pathological manifold, bridging the gap between hardware portability and diagnostic-grade reconstruction.

2603.17244.tldr: Kumiho is a graph-native cognitive memory architecture grounded in formal belief revision semantics that implements a dual-store model with hybrid fulltext and vector retrieval, and three architectural innovations drive the results: prospective indexing, event extraction, and client-side LLM reranking.

2603.17216.tldr: A novel synthetic environment generation pipeline targeting machine learning agents that can learn from doing, which automatically synthesizes machine learning challenges compatible with the SWE-agent framework, covering topic sampling, dataset proposal, and code generation.

2603.17170.tldr: Precise Task-Scoped Implicit Authorization (PAuth) is introduced, a fundamentally different model in which submitting an NL task implicitly authorizes only the concrete operations required for its faithful execution, and is prototyped in the agent-security evaluation framework AgentDojo.

2603.17169.tldr: A text-based multi-agent version of the classic board game Clue is implemented as a rule-based testbed for evaluating multi-step deductive reasoning, with six agents drawn from GPT-4o-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash.

2603.17150.tldr: This article argues that intent formalization -- the translation of informal user intent into a set of checkable formal specifications -- is the key challenge that will determine whether AI makes software more reliable or merely more abundant.

2603.17123.tldr: This research systematically evaluates five widely-deployed LLM families GPT-4, GPT-3.5 Turbo, Claude-3 Haiku, LLaMA-2-70B, and Gemini-2.5-pro and develops a production-ready defensive framework achieving 83% average detection accuracy with only 5% false positives.

2603.17420.tldr: This survey provides a systematic roadmap and practical insights for designing world-model-driven edge intelligence systems in wireless and edge computing environments and outlines key research challenges and future directions toward scalable, reliable, and interoperable world models for edge-native agentic AI.

2603.17307.tldr: Symphony, a multi-agent system that decomposes LVU into fine-grained subtasks and incorporates a deep reasoning collaboration mechanism enhanced by reflection, effectively improving the reasoning capability is proposed.

2603.17372.tldr: The analysis shows that the jailbreak-related shift reliably characterizes jailbreak behavior, providing a unified explanation for diverse jailbreak scenarios and proposes a defense method that enhances VLM safety by removing the jailbreak-related shift (JRS-Rem) at inference time.

2603.17419.tldr: A six-domain threat model for agentic AI in healthcare covering credential exposure, execution capability abuse, network egress exfiltration, prompt integrity failures, database access risks, and fleet configuration drift is developed.

2603.17408.tldr: ASSR-EIC is proposed, a novel image compression framework that leverages arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASSR) to support variable-rate extreme image compression (EIC) and introduces a dual semantic-enhanced design that offers holistic guidance for rate adaptation and adaptive rate-dependent reconstruction.

2603.17380.tldr: A specialized large-scale foundation model SCALE for virtual cell perturbation prediction is presented that addresses the above limitations jointly and suggests that advancing virtual cells requires not only better generative objectives, but also the co-design of scalable infrastructure, stable transport modeling, and biologically faithful evaluation.

2603.17357.tldr: This work introduces WebPII, a fine-grained synthetic benchmark of 44,865 annotated e-commerce UI images designed with three key properties: extended PII taxonomy including transaction-level identifiers that enable reidentification, anticipatory detection for partially-filled forms where users are actively entering data, and scalable generation through VLM-based UI reproduction.

2603.17310.tldr: InformationDensity is proposed, a reward framework for RL training that combines an AUC-based reward and a monotonicity reward as a unified measure of reasoning quality, weighted by a length scaling term that favors achieving equivalent quality more concisely.

2603.17295.tldr: This work introduces Group-Shared Attention (GSA), a mechanism that fosters intrinsic consistency by enabling lossless cross-sample information flow within attention layers, and leverages Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to align generated outputs with human aesthetic and narrative standards.

2603.17233.tldr: Draft-and-Prune (D&P) is proposed, an inference-time framework that improves AF-based logical reasoning via diversity and verification and substantially strengthens AF-based reasoning without extra supervision.

2603.17217.tldr: An on-premise, LLM-driven substitution pipeline that anonymizes text by replacing personally identifiable information (PII) with realistic, type-consistent surrogates attains state-of-the-art privacy, minimal topical drift, strong factual utility, and low trainability loss, outperforming rule-based approaches and named-entity recognition baselines and ZSTS variants on the combined privacy--utility--trainability frontier.

2603.17425.tldr: The proposed framework combines stateful extraction, sequential belief updating, gap-aware state modeling, hybrid retrieval over objectified medical knowledge, and a POMDP-lite action planner, and can be viewed as a conceptually appealing formulation worth further investigation for dialogue-based EMR generation.

2603.17368.tldr: It is revealed that LRMs'safety degradation occurs only after CoT is enabled, and this degradation is not observed when CoT is disabled, and this observation motivates this paper to consider encouraging LRMs to make safety decisions before CoT generation.

2603.17275.tldr: DANCE, a fine-grained, input-aware, dynamic pruning framework for 3D CNNs to maximize power efficiency with negligible to zero impact on performance, achieves substantial savings in multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations and memory accesses by introducing sparsity within convolutional layers.

2603.17234.tldr: It is demonstrated that an LLM-powered, EHR-integrated, human-in-the-loop AI system can accurately and safely triage surgical patients for SCM, and that AI-enabled screening tools can augment and potentially automate time-intensive clinical workflows.

2603.17228.tldr: A layerwise linear probing evaluation across the entire MLLM pipeline reveals that the adapter introduces a segmentation representation drop-off, but LLM layers progressively recover through attention-mediated refinement, where correctly classified tokens steer misclassified neighbors toward the correct label.

2603.17220.tldr: Tharu-LLaMA (3B), a specialized instruction-following model designed to address the exclusion of indigenous languages of the Global South from the AI revolution, is presented as a proof-of-concept for the preservation of under-resourced Himalayan languages via generative AI, achievable on consumer-grade hardware.

2603.17199.tldr: Results show that motivated reasoning is detected more reliably from internal representations than from CoT monitoring, and can be identified by probing internal activations even in cases when it cannot be easily determined from CoT.

2603.17176.tldr: The results indicate that a simple context summary generation might even be superior in finding manipulated contexts, and an unsupervised approach is proposed, being able to detect also zero day attacks.

2603.17174.tldr: This work presents CodeScan, which is the first poisoning-scanning framework tailored to code generation models, and combines iterative divergence analysis with abstract syntax tree (AST)-based normalization to abstract away surface-level variation and unify semantically equivalent code.

2603.17173.tldr: This paper establishes that MLLMs deployable within institutional privacy constraints offer a viable path for iris PAD, and demonstrates that pre-trained vision transformers in MLLMs inherently cluster many iris attack types despite never being explicitly trained for this task.

2603.17104.tldr: A benchmark for this setting is introduced and specification tracking is identified as a distinct evaluation target for long-horizon coding agents, identified as the reduc- tion in final implementation faithfulness un- der emergent specification relative to a single- shot specification control.

2603.17387.tldr: Thought 1 (T1), a generative retrieval model that shifts relevance modelling from static alignment to dynamic reasoning generation, is proposed, demonstrating that replacing static rep-resentation alignment with dynamic reasoning generation can effectively improve reasoning-intensive retrieval performance.

2603.17328.tldr: This work introduces RideJudge, a Progressive Visual-Logic-Aligned Framework, and proposes an Adaptive Context Optimization strategy that distills expert knowledge, coupled with a Chain-of-Adjudication mechanism to enforce active evidentiary inquiry, and implements a novel Ordinal-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning mechanism that calibrates decision boundaries against hierarchical severity.

2603.17309.tldr: This work introduces ReLMXEL (Reinforcement Learning for Memory Controller with Explainable Energy and Latency Optimization), a explainable multi-agent online reinforcement learning framework that dynamically optimizes memory controller parameters using reward decomposition.

2603.17305.tldr: CRAFT is proposed, a red-teaming alignment framework that leverages model reasoning capabilities and hidden representations to improve robustness against jailbreak attacks and demonstrates the effectiveness of hidden-space reasoning alignment.

2603.17296.tldr: The repository's architecture and educational approach based on standardized teaching units comprising slides, short videos, runnable labs, and related papers enables consistency for both the students' learning experience and the reuse and grading by instructors.

2603.17218.tldr: This work compares 120 base-aligned model pairs on more than 10,000 real human decisions in multi-round strategic games and reveals a fundamental trade-off between optimizing models for human use and using them as proxies for human behavior.

2603.17324.tldr: ShuttleEnv serves as a reusable platform for research, visualization, and demonstration of intelligent agents in sports AI, enabling realistic and interpretable agent-opponent interactions without relying on physics-based simulation.

2603.17212.tldr: Adaptive contracts for AI delegation are introduced, which allow detailed evaluation to be performed selectively after observing an initial coarse signal in order to conserve resources.

2603.17230.tldr: Investigation of the potential of using low-bit quantized precomputed tables as a replacement for the recursive B-spline algorithm to further reduce the computational complexity of KANs and enhance hardware efficiency while maintaining accuracy.

2603.17378.tldr: An online learning algorithm is developed that dramatically improves the data efficiency of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and matches the performance of offline RLHF trained on 200K labels using fewer than 20K labels, representing more than a 10x gain in data efficiency.

2603.17361.tldr: This work proposes Profiler, a lightweight, non-learnable module that captures human citation patterns efficiently and without bias, significantly enhancing candidate retrieval and introduces a rigorous Inductive evaluation setting that enforces strict temporal constraints, simulating the recommendation of citations for newly authored papers in the wild.

2603.17312.tldr: The Recurrent Reasoning Vision-Language Model is proposed, a recurrent reasoning framework that processes local video snippets iteratively, maintaining a global context through an evolving Chain of Thought (CoT) enabling the model to reason about complex temporal dependencies.

2603.17303.tldr: The results indicate that current models struggle to preserve culturally grounded meaning and to capture the cultural and contextual nuances essential for accurate translation, and proposes a complementary evaluation metric that targets culturally induced meaning deviations overlooked by standard MT metrics.

2603.17522.tldr: A comprehensive benchmark evaluating diverse detection approaches across two corpora, showing that transformer models achieve near-perfect in-distribution performance but degrade under domain shift, and no method generalizes robustly across domains and LLM sources.

2603.17433.tldr: These results establish an explicit efficiency-performance frontier, demonstrating that large-model scaling for time-series can emerge from geometry-constrained phase computation with deterministic global coupling, offering a practical path toward scalable temporal modeling in oscillatory domains.

2603.17714.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive review of recent developments at the intersection of autonomous driving, simulation technologies, and synthetic datasets, and highlights the role of vision-language models and simulation realism in enhancing scene understanding and generalization.

2603.17687.tldr: A practical, reproducible framework for identifying undervalued football players grounded in objective mispricing, designed for decision support in scouting workflows, emphasizing ranking/shortlisting over hard classification thresholds, and includes a concise reproducibility and ethics statement.

2603.17677.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Masked Diffusion (ARAM), a training-free adaptive guidance framework for Masked Diffusion Models (MDMs) in RAG settings that dynamically calibrates the guidance scale during denoising according to the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) of the distributional shift induced by retrieved context.

2603.17641.tldr: This work adopts a complementary strategy, employing evolutionary algorithms to construct efficient multigrid cycles from proven algorithmic building blocks from proven algorithmic building blocks, to generate efficient algebraic multigrid methods with so-called flexible cycling.

2603.17785.tldr: This approach leverages the duality theory of TV-regularized optimization problems to establish rigorous guarantees on the sparsity of the solutions to the training problem, and proves that in the presence of low label noise and for small regularization parameter, solutions to the training problem remain sparse.

2603.17538.tldr: Equivariant Coordinate-based Kernel Convolution, or ECKConv, is presented, which acquires SE(3) equivariance from the kernel domain defined in a double coset space, and its explicit kernel design using coordinate-based networks enhances its learning capability and memory efficiency.

2603.17575.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that SYRAN is highly interpretable, providing equations that correspond to known scientific or medical relationships, and maintains strong anomaly detection performance comparable to that of state-of-the-art methods.

2603.17673.tldr: This paper post- trains a 4B model for Linux privilege escalation in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on traces from procedurally generated privilege-escalation environments, followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, which lifts the resulting model to 95.8%, nearly matching Claude Opus 4.6.

2603.17439.tldr: Baguan-TS is a unified framework that integrates the raw-sequence representation learning with ICL, instantiated by a 3D Transformer that attends jointly over temporal, variable, and context axes, achieving the highest win rate and significant reductions in both point and probabilistic forecasting metrics.

2603.17450.tldr: VLM2Rec, a VLM embedder-based framework for multimodal sequential recommendation designed to ensure balanced modality utilization, is proposed and Weak-modality Penalized Contrastive Learning is introduced to rectify gradient imbalance during optimization and Cross-Modal Relational Topology Regularization to preserve geometric consistency between modalities.

2603.17781.tldr: Cross-model replication across four frontier models confirms compaction loss is architectural, not model-specific and that neural memory (Titans) stores facts but fails to retrieve them on demand, and introduces density-adaptive retrieval as a switching mechanism and releases the benchmark suite.

2603.17775.tldr: CoVerRL is proposed, a framework where a single model alternates between generator and verifier roles, with each capability bootstrapping the other, confirming that both capabilities genuinely co-evolve.

2603.17592.tldr: A browser extension that provides contextual help to users who hover over technological acronyms and abbreviations on web pages demonstrates a practical, real-time approach to bridging the digital literacy gap and points toward extending contextual help to other domains such as medicine, law, and finance.

2603.17544.tldr: This work addresses vanilla supervised learning of Q-values by using regularization terms that enforce this distinction, resulting in Q-value policies that consistently outperform state-value policies across a range of 10 domains and are competitive with the planner LAMA-first.

2603.17662.tldr: This work introduces FIne-grained NEgative queRies (FINER), alongside two benchmarks: FINER-CompreCap and FINER-DOCCI, and proposes FINER-Tuning, leveraging Direct Preference Optimization on FINER-inspired data.

2603.17507.tldr: This work proposes QuantFL, a sustainable FL framework that leverages pre-trained initialisation to enable aggressive, computationally lightweight quantisation and demonstrates that pre-training naturally concentrates update statistics, allowing for memory-efficient bucket quantisation without the energy-intensive overhead of complex error-feedback mechanisms.

2603.17441.tldr: This work proposes AdaZoom-GUI, an adaptive zoom-based GUI grounding framework that improves both localization accuracy and instruction understanding, and introduces an instruction refinement module that rewrites natural language commands into explicit and detailed descriptions, allowing the grounding model to focus on precise element localization.

2603.17694.tldr: A Multi-Agent Large Language Model-based Economic Sandbox (MALLES) is introduced, leveraging the inherent generalization capabilities of large-sacle models to establish a unified simulation framework applicable to cross-domain and cross-category scenarios.

2603.17577.tldr: These results establish demonstrator diversity as a principled source of identifiability for learning latent actions and dynamics from offline RL data.

2603.17531.tldr: This work proposes Relational Zero-Watermarking (Rel-Zero), a novel framework that requires no modification to the original image but derives a unique zero-watermark from these editing-invariant patch relations, and provides a non-invasive yet resilient mechanism for content authentication.

2603.17548.tldr: This paper introduces Continual Learning Adaptive Normalization (CLeAN), a novel adaptive normalization technique designed for continual learning in tabular data that improves model performance on new data but also mitigates catastrophic forgetting.

2603.17524.tldr: KineVLA is proposed, a vision-language-action framework that explicitly decouples goal-level invariance from kinematics-level variability through a bi-level action representation and bi-level reasoning tokens to serve as explicit, supervised intermediate variables that align language and action.

2603.17759.tldr: This work introduces a novel multimodal, multilingual benchmark for detecting and understanding harmful and offensive humor, and systematically evaluates state-of-the-art (SOTA) open and closed-source models across all modalities.

2603.17680.tldr: This work introduces WeatherReasonSeg, a benchmark designed to evaluate VLM performance in reasoning-based segmentation under adverse weather conditions, and reveals two key findings: VLM performance degrades monotonically with increasing weather severity, and different weather types induce distinct vulnerability patterns.

2603.17555.tldr: FrescoDiffusion is introduced, a training-free method for coherent large-format I2V generation from a single complex image that strengthens global coherence while retaining fine detail and provides a spatial regularization variable that enables region-level control over where motion is allowed.

2603.17476.tldr: UniSAFE is the first comprehensive benchmark for system-level safety evaluation of UMMs across 7 I/O modality combinations, spanning conventional tasks and novel multimodal-context image generation settings, and reveals critical vulnerabilities across current UMMs.

2603.17729.tldr: SARE is proposed, a Sample-wise Adaptive textbfREasoning framework for training-free FGVR that combines fast candidate retrieval with fine-grained reasoning, invoking the latter only when necessary, and achieves state-of-the-art performance while substantially reducing computational overhead.

2603.17715.tldr: Whether the latest iteration of the Segment Anything Model, SAM3, offers better eye image segmentation performance than SAM2, and the performance of its new concept (text) prompting mode are examined, it is concluded that SAM2 remains the best option for eye image segmentation.

2603.17683.tldr: Sensi, an LLM agent architecture for the ARC-AGI-3 game-playing challenge that introduces structured test-time learning through three mechanisms: a two-player architecture separating perception from action, a curriculum-based learning system managed by an external state machine, and a database-as-control-plane that makes the agents context window programmatically steerable.

2603.17676.tldr: It is found that inhibition-mediated normalization does not improve learning if normalization is applied only during inference, but when this normalization is extended to include back-propagated errors, performance improves significantly.

2603.17655.tldr: The CC-CDFSL method with cycle consistency is proposed, which translates local visual features into text features and then translates them back into visual features (and vice versa), and constrains the original features close to the translated back features.

2603.17651.tldr: This work gives semantic and temporal guidance from the keyframes and text onto each intermediate frame through Keyframe-anchored Attention Bias and better enforce frame consistency with Rescaled Temporal RoPE, which allows self-attention to attend to keyframes more faithfully.

2603.17639.tldr: This paper presents a grey-box approach to explore diverse behaviors and uncover security risks in LLM agents, and demonstrates the value of a dynamic approach like VeriGrey to test agents, and to eventually lead to an agent assurance framework.

2603.17534.tldr: A new algorithm is advanced -- the $\textit{informative semi-factuals}$ (ISF) method -- that generates more elaborated explanations supplementing semi-factuals with information about additional $\textit{hidden features}$ that influence an automated decision.

2603.17529.tldr: AirDDE is proposed, the first neural delay differential equation framework in this task that integrates delay modeling into a continuous-time pollutant evolution under physical guidance.

2603.17771.tldr: V-scale, a modification that adjusts value-path backpropagated gradients, is introduced and shows that under causal mask, attention sinks can induce pronounced gradient concentration, which supports the interpretation that gradient sink is a key training-time mediator linking attention sinks and massive activations.

2603.17530.tldr: AdapTS is a unified TS framework designed for multi-class and continual settings, optimized for edge deployment, and demonstrates that AdapTS matches the performance of existing TS methods across multi-class and continual learning scenarios, while drastically reducing memory overhead.

2603.17570.tldr: FoMo-X is introduced, a modular framework that equips OD foundation models with intrinsic, lightweight diagnostic capabilities, and demonstrates that FoMo-X recovers ground-truth diagnostic signals with high fidelity and negligible inference overhead.

2603.17631.tldr: This work introduces a rigorous benchmarking framework by extending converse optimality to discrete-time, control-affine, nonlinear systems with noise and validate it by automatically constructing diverse environments, demonstrating the framework's capacity for a controlled and comprehensive evaluation across algorithms.

2603.17478.tldr: This study converts the iterative proximal gradient descent algorithm into a deep neural network, wherein the parameters of each layer are learned instead of being predetermined, and enhances the architecture by incorporating a hybrid layer that performs a learnable linear gradient transformation prior to the proximal projection.

2603.17474.tldr: The Domain-Adaptive Cross-Scale Matching (DACSM) framework is proposed, which consists of a Domain-Adaptive Transformer for disentangling domain-shared content from domain-specific style, and a Cross-Scale Matching module that adaptively aligns features across multiple resolutions.

2603.17470.tldr: Visual-referred Probabilistic Prompt Learning (VirPro), an adaptive multi-modal pretraining paradigm that can be seamlessly integrated into diverse weakly supervised monocular 3D detection frameworks, is proposed.

2603.17436.tldr: TimeAPN is an Adaptive Amplitude-Phase Non-Stationarity Normalization framework that explicitly models and predicts non-stationary factors from both the time and frequency domains and consistently improves long-term forecasting accuracy across multiple prediction horizons and outperforms state-of-the-art reversible normalization methods.

2505.02314.tldr: This work presents NeuroSim V1.5, introducing several key advances, including seamless integration with TensorRT's post-training quantization flow enabling support for more neural networks including transformers, a flexible noise injection methodology built on pre-characterized statistical models, and expanded device support including emerging non-volatile capacitive memories.

2504.09037.tldr: This categorization provides a systematic understanding of the evolving landscape of LLM reasoning, highlighting emerging trends such as the shift from inference-scaling to learning-to-reason, and the transition to agentic workflows.

2603.18004.tldr: This paper introduces Spatio-Temporal Token Scoring (STTS), a simple and lightweight module that prunes vision tokens across both the ViT and the LLM without text conditioning or token merging, and is fully compatible with end-to-end training.

2603.18000.tldr: This work proposes AgentFactory, a new self-evolution paradigm that preserves successful task solutions as executable subagent code rather than textual experience, and demonstrates that AgentFactory enables continuous capability accumulation.

2603.17887.tldr: It is suggested that AI-assisted goal setting can improve short-term goal progress, and that its clearest added value over structured self-reflection lies in increasing felt accountability.

2603.18002.tldr: Loc3R-VLM is introduced, a framework that equips 2D Vision-Language Models with advanced 3D understanding capabilities from monocular video input and outperforms existing 2D- and video-based approaches on situated and general 3D question-answering benchmarks, demonstrating that the spatial supervision framework enables strong 3D understanding.

2603.17811.tldr: This work analyzes dropout-induced variability across 19 transformer models using MC Dropout with 100 stochastic forward passes per sample to provide the first comprehensive MC Dropout benchmark for transformers, revealing dropout robustness is architecture-dependent and uncorrelated with scale.

2603.17809.tldr: Inspired by axiomatic attribution in mechanistic interpretability, a fine-grained quantization strategy on Quantization-aware Integrated Gradients (QIG), which leverages integrated gradients to quantitatively evaluate token sensitivity and push the granularity from modality level to token level, reflecting both inter-modality and intra-modality dynamics.

2504.08923.tldr: It is shown that every formula in $CLA$ is asymptotically equivalent to a formula without any aggregation function, and a convergence law for CLA is proved.

2412.15004.tldr: This systematic literature review investigates the security benefits and drawbacks of using LLMs for code-related tasks, and focuses on the types of vulnerabilities introduced by LLMs when generating code.

2603.17969.tldr: This work proposes a specification-aware action distribution optimization framework that enforces a broad class of Signal Temporal Logic constraints during execution of a pretrained robotics foundation model without modifying its parameters.

2603.17948.tldr: This work introduces a task-agnostic environment to represent video as a hierarchical grid that is simultaneously lossless, navigable, scalable, caption- and preprocessing-free, and demonstrates that structured environment navigation is a viable and scalable paradigm for video understanding.

2603.17893.tldr: Scicode-lint is presented, whose two-tier architecture separates pattern design (frontier models at build time) from execution (small local model at runtime) from execution (small local model at runtime), whose two-tier architecture separates pattern design from execution.

2507.21790.tldr: The results demonstrate both the promise and current limitations of LLMs as assistive agents in discrete choice modelling, not only for model specification but also for supporting modelling decision and estimation, and provide practical guidance for integrating these tools into choice modellers'workflows.

2507.21524.tldr: The role of LLMs in transforming wireless systems across three key directions is explored: adapting pretrained LLMs for communication tasks, developing wireless-specific foundation models to balance versatility and efficiency, and enabling agentic LLMs with autonomous reasoning and coordination capabilities.

2509.17325.tldr: This work introduces CodeGym, a scalable framework that synthesizes diverse, verifiable, and controllable multi-turn tool-use environments for agent RL, enabling LLM agents to explore and master various workflows actively.

2507.06993.tldr: IMAIA is an interactive Maps AI Assistant that enables natural-language interaction with both vector (street) maps and satellite imagery, and augments camera inputs with geospatial intelligence to help users understand the world.

2509.22493.tldr: A novel algorithm is presented, leveraging divergent knowledge between plans and facilitating the construction of contrastive narratives, and it is observed that the explanations excel beyond the baseline method.

2506.01989.tldr: A new DL method to cope with Byzantine attacks based on coded robust aggregation (CRA-DL), which enhances the robustness of the aggregation against Byzantine attacks, and theoretically analyze the convergence performance of CRA-DL.

2509.25140.tldr: ReasoningBank is proposed, a novel memory framework that distills generalizable reasoning strategies from an agent's self-judged successful and failed experiences, and memory-driven experience scaling is established as a new scaling dimension, enabling agents to self-evolve with emergent behaviors naturally arise.

2509.22819.tldr: Hilbert is introduced, an agentic framework that bridges the gap between informal reasoning and formal proof generation and achieves the strongest known result from a publicly available model on PutnamBench.

2509.21991.tldr: ERGO (Efficient Reasoning&Guided Observation) is proposed that performs reasoning-driven perception-leveraging multimodal context to determine where to focus, and develops simple yet effective reward components in a reinforcement learning framework for coarse-to-fine perception.

2508.03715.tldr: This work advances a feasible path to equitable, remote monitoring of the ANS response, reducing dependence on intermittent BP measurements and enabling earlier intervention, by identifying heart rate and ECG as dominant predictors.

2506.04450.tldr: This is the first study to incorporate DP fine-tuning of LLMs for multi-abnormality classification using text-based radiology reports using Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and demonstrates that strong privacy protection can be achieved with only moderate performance degradation.

2503.17867.tldr: An in-depth taxonomy based on manual expert hierarchies and an AI-generated dendrogram are provided, thus settling DDoS categorization ambiguities and multiple open research directions are proposed.

2507.19530.tldr: An ensemble framework to predict blood pressure from electronic health records, incorporating rigorous data leakage prevention and root-cause analysis identified three primary obstacles to generalizability: site-specific feature distributions, even among standard physiological variables and institutional variations in measurement protocols creating non-transferable learned patterns.

2505.21854.tldr: Two complementary strategies to improve both the effectiveness and imperceptibility of the gradient-based adversarial attack are proposed, offering a principled refinement of gradient-based attacks for 3D point clouds.

2508.21475.tldr: MMSearch-Plus is introduced, a 311-task benchmark that enforces multimodal understanding by requiring extraction and propagation of fine-grained visual cues through iterative image-text retrieval and cross-validation under retrieval noise and established as a rigorous benchmark for advancing agentic MLLMs.

2403.02951.tldr: This study highlights the performance disparities among LLMs and proposes optimal in-context learning solutions tailored to each task and offers valuable insights for facilitating the development of LLM-based Text-to-SQL systems.

2603.15434.tldr: This work proposes Reaction Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), a framework that optimizes over interaction consequences rather than rubric scores and significantly outperforms strong reinforcement learning baselines in driving positive interaction outcomes.

2603.15888.tldr: The benchmark zeroes in on a narrower question: can a model actually use what it sees to adapt a plan when things do not go as expected, revealing weaknesses in visual grounding and state tracking that ultimately undermine interactive planning.

2510.01242.tldr: The utility of AAS as a theoretically grounded, task-independent diagnostic tool for evaluating memory degradation in artificial systems is supported, and the empirical validation reported here is limited to this specific model version and protocol, and applications to other architectures or training regimes require revalidation.

2503.21800.tldr: Deployed in production at British Columbia Cancer Registry, ELM represents the first successful deployment of a hybrid small, encoder only models-LLM architecture for tumor group classification in a real-world PBCR setting, demonstrating how strategic combination of language models can achieve both high accuracy and operational efficiency.

2410.13106.tldr: Cliqueformer, a transformer- based architecture that learns the black-box function’s structure through functional graphical models (FGM), addressing distribution shift without relying on explicit conservative approaches, demonstrates superior performance compared to existing methods.

2505.02024.tldr: A comprehensive overview of Manus AI is presented, exploring its core technical architecture, diverse applications across sectors such as healthcare, finance, manufacturing, robotics, and gaming, as well as its key strengths, current limitations, and future potential.

2507.02861.tldr: LiteReality is proposed, a novel pipeline that converts RGB-D scans of indoor environments into compact, realistic, and interactive 3D virtual replicas and introduces a training-free object retrieval module that achieves state-of-the-art similarity performance on the Scan2CAD benchmark, along with a robust material painting module capable of transferring appearances from images of any style to 3D assets.

2602.23696.tldr: C cumulative parameter trajectories of transformer training under AdamW are analyzed and a dominant low-dimensional drift direction ("backbone") is identified that captures 60--80% of long-horizon displacement from initialization.

2602.22911.tldr: CeRA (Capacity-enhanced Rank Adaptation), a weight-level parallel adapter that injects SiLU gating and structural dropout to induce manifold expansion, reveals a profound impact of task complexity: in fundamental arithmetic (GSM8K), CeRA matches standard baselines, but in the highly complex MATH dataset, CeRA demonstrates extreme parameter efficiency.

2110.02887.tldr: This work proposes using Optimal Transport as an alignment objective during fine-tuning to further improve multilingual contextualized representations for downstream cross-lingual transfer and allows different types of mappings due to soft matching between source and target sentences.

2502.10978.tldr: This study introduces an agentic Large Language Models framework for simulating decision discourse - the deliberative process through which actionable strategies are collaboratively developed, with implications across domains where uncertainty and complexity converge.

2503.09538.tldr: This work considers the more realistic setting in which the adversary can access only a bounded number of channels and proposes a new distributed algorithm that recovers strategies with simultaneously vanishing Nash gap and privacy budget as the number of players increases.

2504.15995.tldr: OPUS-VFL introduces a novel, privacy-aware incentive mechanism that rewards clients based on a principled combination of model contribution, privacy preservation, and resource investment, and integrates an adaptive differential privacy mechanism that enables clients to dynamically calibrate noise levels to optimize their individual utility.

2411.08794.tldr: This work proposes a comprehensive evaluation of the world models with LLMs from the decision making perspective and designs three main tasks, i.e., policy verification, action proposal, and policy planning, where the world models can be used for decision making solely.

2507.01062.tldr: The findings indicate that usability-related factors, particularly System Efficiency and Learning Burden, exert the greatest influence on the composite score under the specified weighting scheme, while other themes also contribute positively but more modestly.

2407.16740.tldr: Results demonstrate the architectural feasibility of modular latency mitigation for vision-based lateral control under controlled simulation settings, achieving up to 62% and 78% reductions in Mean Absolute Error for constant and time-varying latency cases, respectively.

2510.08581.tldr: This paper introduces a systematic pipeline that converts existing multimodal hallucination benchmarks into spoken-query versions while preserving the original tasks and labels and releases RePOPE-Spk, where all queries are provided as spoken audio under diverse input conditions.

2602.24055.tldr: CIRCLE operationalizes the Validation phase of TEVV by formalizing the translation of stakeholder concerns outside the stack into measurable signals, and provides a structured, prospective protocol for linking context-sensitive qualitative insights to scalable quantitative metrics.

2603.16098.tldr: This work introduces LICA (Layered Image Composition Annotations), a large scale dataset of 1,550,244 multi-layer graphic design compositions designed to advance structured understanding and generation of graphic layouts and introduces graphic design video as a new and largely unexplored challenge for current vision-language models.

2603.16629.tldr: This work systematically analyzes MLLM-generated explanations for the unconstrained face verification task on the challenging IJB-S dataset and introduces a likelihood-ratio-based framework that measures the evidential strength of textual explanations.

2603.15678.tldr: Spectral Edge Dynamics (SED) is introduced to quantify this structure: a rolling-window SVD of parameter updates reveals a sharp boundary -- the spectral edge -- between coherent optimization directions and stochastic noise, identified via the maximum consecutive singular value ratio $\sigma_k / \sigma_{k+1}$.

2603.16060.tldr: ARISE (Agent Reasoning via Intrinsic Skill Evolution), a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework, in which a shared policy operates both to manage skills at high-level and to generate responses at low-level (denoted as a Skills Manager and a Worker, respectively).

2603.15978.tldr: A safety gap is introduced that no current platform has closed: two agents individually verified as safe can, when combined, reach a forbidden goal through an emergent conjunctive dependency that neither possesses alone.

2509.22925.tldr: This work introduces soft embeddings, a simple relaxation that replaces discrete tokens with the expected embeddings under the generator's output distribution, and Integrating soft embeddings into the Di[M]O distillation framework makes one-step generators end-to-end trainable and enables straightforward application of GAN-based refinement, differentiable reward fine-tuning, and TTEO.

2409.05585.tldr: A two-stage method that constructs a Structural Causal Model (SCM) within the latent space and executes a three-step counterfactual procedure using a closed-form Generalized Linear Model (GLM) is proposed.

2507.21114.tldr: This project addresses this need by developing and evaluating an image classification system specifically designed for historical document pages, leveraging advancements in artificial intelligence and machine learning.

2507.12261.tldr: The solution, called Infherno, is designed to adhere to the FHIR document schema and competes well with a human baseline in predicting FHIR resources from unstructured text, supporting clinical data integration processes and interoperability across institutions.

2403.02482.tldr: Experiments show that the new node-selection heuristics for constructing restricted DDs that produce a high-quality approximation of the Pareto frontier are highly effective, recovering over 85% of the Pareto frontier while achieving 2.5x speedups over exact DD enumeration on average.

2502.15411.tldr: The Hierarchical Financial Key Performance Indicator (HiFi-KPI) dataset is introduced, a large-scale corpus of 1.65M paragraphs and 198k unique, hierarchically organized labels linked to iXBRL taxonomies, and a qualitative analysis reveals that extraction errors primarily relate to dates.

2506.16931.tldr: This work introduces a coordinate-based image builder that transforms GTSP instances into spatially informative representations, designs an adaptive resolution scaling strategy to enhance adaptability across different problem scales, and develops a multimodal fusion module with dedicated bottlenecks that enables effective integration of geometric and spatial features.

2505.08916.tldr: This paper introduces categorical semantics of all logical constructors of the DL SH including EL with disjunction, negation, universal restriction, role inclusion and transitive roles, and shows that the logic resulting from weakening semantics is more expressive than EL with the bottom concept, transitive roles and role inclusion.

2505.24503.tldr: This work studies the problem of fairly allocating indivisible goods to agents in an online setting, where goods arrive sequentially and must be allocated irrevocably, and designs a meta-algorithm that lifts a broad class of offline''share-based''guarantees to the online setting, matching the best-known offline bounds.

2410.09252.tldr: Unlike traditional retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches, DAVIS incorporates structured and temporal memory, which enables model-based planning, and is the first RAG agent to employ an interactive retrieval method in a RAG pipeline.

2508.20784.tldr: Results suggest that the proposed single-agent RL approach, informed by categorical identifiers in the state representation and realistic schedule-aware design in the ridge-shaped reward function, can effectively mitigate bus bunching in non-loop settings.

2412.10488.tldr: SVGBuilder introduces a component-based, autoregressive model for generating high-quality colored SVGs from textual input, which significantly reduces computational overhead and improves efficiency compared to traditional methods.

2407.17454.tldr: A cycle of scientific discovery is proposed that combines machine learning with automated reasoning for the generation and the selection of explanations, and a taxonomy of explanation selection problems is presented that draws on insights from sociology and cognitive science.

2310.01536.tldr: A framework to extract the algebra of the transformations of worlds from the perspective of an agent is proposed and two important results of SBDRL are generalised - the equivariance condition and the disentangling definition - from only working with symmetry-based representations to working with representations capturing the transformation properties of worlds with transformations for any algebra.

2506.08898.tldr: This work proposes POCCO, a novel plug-and-play framework that enables adaptive selection of model structures for subproblems, which are subsequently optimized based on preference signals rather than explicit reward values.

2503.07884.tldr: LLMIA is presented, an out-of-the-box, tuning-free index advisor leveraging large language models (LLMs) through in-context learning for index recommendation, and demonstrates robust generalization on two real-world commercial workloads, delivering high-quality recommendations without the need for additional adaptation or retraining.

2509.23098.tldr: This work identifies an underexplored pathway within VLE mid-layers to construct a spatial map, applicable for improving zero-shot RIS by 1-7 mIoU on nine RefCOCO benchmarks, and leveraging mixed-language mid-layer embeddings yields enhanced spatial grounding accuracy.

2403.17210.tldr: CADGL surpasses other state-of-the-art DDI prediction models, excelling in predicting clinically valuable novel DDIs, supported by rigorous case studies.

2602.11322.tldr: An Inward JEPA that operates over stored experience (predicting associatively reachable past states) as the complement to the standard Outward JEPA that operates over incoming sensory data (predicting future states) is introduced.

2603.18012.tldr: DynaRAG is presented, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework designed to handle both static and time-sensitive information needs through dynamic knowledge integration, and significantly improves accuracy on dynamic questions, while also reducing hallucinations.

2603.18008.tldr: THERAPYGYM, a framework that evaluates and improves therapy chatbots along two clinical pillars: fidelity and safety, is introduced, enabling scalable development of therapy chatbots that are faithful to evidence-based practice and safer in high-stakes use.

2603.03686.tldr: This work introduces AI4S-SDS, a closed-loop neuro-symbolic framework that integrates multi-agent collaboration with a tailored Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) engine and identifies a novel photoresist developer formulation that demonstrates competitive or superior performance relative to a commercial benchmark.

2603.18010.tldr: A generalizable, scalable framework for building transparent and expansible large scale database in political science, and it is diagnosed that directly coding from long and multi-language corpora introduces bias that the synthesis stage can alleviate by curating evidence into signal-dense representations.

2603.18007.tldr: This study tested five Large Language Models and compared their performance to that of human controls using an adapted version of a text-based tool widely used in human ToM research, revealing a performance gap between the models.

2603.16744.tldr: It is found that AI agents exhibit sizable nonstandard errors (NSEs), that is, uncertainty from agent-to-agent variation in analytical choices, analogous to those documented among human researchers.

2603.15159.tldr: PriCoder is a proposed approach that teaches LLMs to invoke private-library APIs through automatically synthesized data, and alternates between two graph operators that improves data diversity by progressively synthesizing more diverse training samples from basic ones.

2603.15030.tldr: This work introduces VisualToolChain-Bench (VTC-Bench), a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate tool-use proficiency in MLLMs and establishes a rigorous baseline to guide the development of more generalized visual agentic models.

2603.07514.tldr: Beyond Gaussians, an exact decomposition for general radial kernels is derived, and for the Laplace kernel it is proved rigorous error bounds showing that drifting remains an accurate proxy for score matching in low-temperature and high-dimensional regimes.

2603.18015.tldr: The results suggest that explainable AI can foster human-in-the-loop moderation by exposing model uncertainty and increasing the interpretable rationale behind automated decisions, and highlights the role of explainability as a transparency and diagnostic resource for online harmful content detection systems rather than as a performance-enhancing lever.

2603.18009.tldr: The proposed Log-Scale Focal Uncertainty (LSFU) is a first-token-based metric inspired by focal loss that incorporates label prior probabilities as a risk-modulation factor to suppress noise from high-frequency classes and emphasize risk for low-frequency long-tail classes, with a dynamic weighting mechanism unifying the measurement scale.

2603.16313.tldr: This thesis addresses automated fault diagnostics by unifying event sequence modeling, causal discovery, and large language models into a coherent framework for high-dimensional event streams and introduces several Transformer-based architectures for predictive maintenance, scalable sample- and population-level causal discovery frameworks and a multi-agent system that automates the synthesis of Boolean EP rules.

2603.18016.tldr: This paper proposes MineDraft, a batch parallel speculative decoding framework designed to effectively hide drafting latency by overlapping it with verification, and shows that PSD is substantially more efficient than standard SD.

2603.03415.tldr: This study provides new mechanistic insights into how LLMs internalize OOD challenges, and designs Sparsity-Guided Curriculum In-Context Learning (SG-ICL), a strategy that explicitly uses representation sparsity to schedule few-shot demonstrations, leading to considerable performance enhancements.

2603.18237.tldr: Compared with multiple sampling baselines, the data selected by GITS achieves lower rollout error across multiple PDE systems, model backbones and sample ratios, and ablation studies demonstrate the necessity and complementarity of the two optimization objectives in GITS.

2603.18201.tldr: A physics-based autonomous vehicle simulation platform with a justifiable error injector is leveraged to generate high-quality data for AI system reliability analysis and a new reliability modeling framework is developed to explicitly characterize error propagation across stages.

2603.18196.tldr: This work presents a RAG-based system that performs security incident analysis through targeted query-based filtering and LLM semantic reasoning, and demonstrates that combining targeted query-based filtering with RAG-based retrieval enables accurate, cost-effective security analysis within LLM context limits.

2603.18178.tldr: VLM-AutoDrive offers a scalable recipe for adapting general-purpose VLMs to safety-critical, temporally localized perception tasks, and achieves substantial gains in Collision and Near-Collision detection while producing interpretable reasoning traces, bridging the gap between perception, causality, and decision reasoning in autonomous driving.

2603.18166.tldr: This work proposes and extensively evaluates a novel cluster-based approach that groups individuals based on similar attributes over time, enabling faster execution through accurate group summarisation and leads to faster processing and lower memory usage when compared with state-of-the-art methods.

2603.18130.tldr: Stakeholders identified priority research thrusts including human robot collaboration, trustworthy autonomy, simulation and digital twins, multi modal sensing, and ethical integration of generative AI into clinical workflows including human robot collaboration into clinical workflows.

2603.18123.tldr: This work systematically analyzes when heterogeneous ultrasound tasks can be jointly learned without performance loss, establishing practical criteria for task aggregation in unified clinical imaging models and introduces M2DINO, a multi-organ, multi-task framework built on DINOv3 with task-conditioned Mixture-of-Experts blocks for adaptive capacity allocation.

2603.18115.tldr: An LLM-augmented computational phenotyping framework ``Grace Cycle'' is proposed that iteratively integrates hypothesis generation, evidence extraction, and feature refinement to discover clinically meaningful subgroups from longitudinal patient data.

2603.18113.tldr: This work revisits multi-value alignment from the perspective of value consistency in data and proposes VC-soup, a data filtering and parameter merging framework grounded in value-consistent learning that effectively mitigates conflicts and consistently outperforms existing multi-value alignment methods.

2603.18089.tldr: CytoSyn is introduced, a state-of-the-art foundation latent diffusion model that enables the guided generation of highly realistic and diverse histopathology H&E-stained images, as shown in an extensive benchmark.

2603.18084.tldr: The results suggest that neural network-based policies, which are often regarded as black boxes, can autonomously acquire interpretable phase structures and logical branching mechanisms.

2603.18079.tldr: This work proposes SLEA-RL (Step-Level Experience-Augmented Reinforcement Learning), a framework that retrieves relevant experiences at each decision step conditioned on the current observation and achieves superior performance compared to various reinforcement learning baselines.

2603.18063.tldr: MCP-38 is presented, a protocol-specific threat taxonomy consisting of 38 threat categories consisting of 38 threat categories (MCP-01 through MCP-38), derived through a systematic four-phase methodology.

2603.18028.tldr: A reference architecture is introduced called NeuroXplain, which translates CME into actionable technical design recommendations for any future neurostimulation device and is introduced to inform stakeholders working in neurotechnology and regulatory framework development to ensure that explainability fulfills the right needs for the right stakeholders and ultimately leads to better patient treatment and care.

2603.18022.tldr: This work for-malises the system of GMs as a class of stochastic dynamical systems through the lens of control theory and finds that the training progress is consistent with the corresponding system response, which offers a useful way to develop a better optimization component.

2603.18122.tldr: This agent-supported, but code-first approach to workflows, along with the context-engineering used in Skele-Code, can help reduce token costs compared to the multi-agent system approach to executing workflows.

2603.18107.tldr: This paper introduces ARTEMIS (Arbitrage-free Representation Through Economic Models and Interpretable Symbolics), a novel neuro-symbolic framework combining a continuous-time Laplace Neural Operator encoder, a neural stochastic differential equation regularised by physics-informed losses, and a differentiable symbolic bottleneck that distils interpretable trading rules.

2603.18104.tldr: This paper develops an alternative training architecture grounded in three prior results that enables depth-independent training memory bounded to approximately twice the inference footprint, grade-preserving weight updates, and exact gradient accumulation, applicable uniformly to loss-function-optimized and spike-timing-dependent neuromorphic models.

2603.18101.tldr: A novel asymmetric training-only framework for few-shot adaptation that employs a cache-aware dual-objective strategy to supervise this relational knowledge directly into the Tip-Adapter's key-value cache, effectively upgrading the prototypes while the graph teacher is discarded at test time.

2603.18043.tldr: The LLM Delegate Protocol is extended with delegation contracts that bound authority through explicit objectives, budgets, and failure policies; a claimed-vs-attested identity model that distinguishes self-reported from verified quality; and typed failure semantics enabling automated recovery.

2603.18027.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed KD-EKF framework significantly reduces localization error, suppresses error spikes during Line-of-Sight (LOS)/NLOS transitions, and mitigates long-term drift compared to fixed-parameter EKF, thereby improving measurement robustness across diverse indoor environments.

2603.18023.tldr: This paper introduces a multi-task learning framework for personalized, customizable open-vocabulary Keyword Spotting (PCOV-KWS), which employs a lightweight network to simultaneously perform Keyword Spotting (KWS) and SV to address personalized KWS requirements.

2603.18256.tldr: MolRGen is introduced, a large-scale benchmark and dataset for training and evaluating reasoning-based LLMs on de novo molecular generation and property prediction and a novel diversity-aware top-$k$ score is introduced that captures both the quality and diversity of generated molecules.

2603.18202.tldr: R2-Dreamer is a decoder-free MBRL framework with a self-supervised objective that serves as an internal regularizer, preventing representation collapse without resorting to Data Augmentation, and suggests that an effective internal regularizer can enable versatile, high-performance decoder-free MBRL.

2603.18088.tldr: Experiments on dialogue and code generation show that dynamic constraints outperform both KL regularization and unconstrained baselines, achieving substantially higher task rewards while maintaining training stability.

2603.18066.tldr: This paper presents a digital architecture that implements a discrete-time predictive coding update directly in hardware, a deterministic, synthesizable RTL substrate built around a sequential MAC datapath and a fixed finite-state schedule.

2603.18034.tldr: This work studies gradient-guided corpus poisoning attacks against modern RAG pipelines and evaluates retrieval-layer defenses that require no modification to the underlying LLM, and implements dual-document poisoning attacks consisting of a sleeper document and a trigger document optimized using Greedy Coordinate Gradient.

2603.18032.tldr: A method that not only detects changes in the data distribution and anomalies but also allows us to distinguish between failures and normal domain shifts inherent to a given process, coupled with an explainable artificial intelligence component that aims at helping the human operator to finally differentiate between domain shifts and failures.

2603.18112.tldr: Tula is presented, an online service that automatically optimizes time, cost, and convergence quality for large-batch training of convolutional models and achieves up to 20x overall speedup and improves test accuracy by 9% on average over standard large-batch training on various vision tasks, thus successfully mitigating the generalization gap and accelerating training at the same time.

2603.18118.tldr: Insight-V++ introduces two novel algorithms, ST-GRPO and J-GRPO, which enhance spatial-temporal reasoning and improve evaluative robustness, and guides an iterative reasoning path generation process, retraining the entire multi-agent system in a continuous, self-improving loop.

2603.18096.tldr: This paper presents an assurance framework for multi-agent LLM systems, intended as a common abstraction to support testing and evaluation of multi-agent LLM systems, and to facilitate reproducible comparison across orchestration designs and configurations.

2603.18085.tldr: A Multi-Trait Subspace Steering (MultiTraitsss) framework is developed that leverages established crisis-associated traits and novel subspace steering framework to generate Dark models that exhibits cumulative harmful behavioral patterns in Human-AI interactions.

2603.18073.tldr: This thesis proposes a synthetic data approach that diversifies and amplifies small corpora into rich knowledge representations, enabling a model to effectively update its parameters from limited source material, and shows that by scaling search during test time over the space of algorithms, AI can search over a larger space of learning algorithm configurations than human researchers can explore manually.

2603.18062.tldr: The Spiking State-Space Topology Transformer (S3T-Former) is proposed, which is the first purely spike-driven Transformer architecture specifically designed for energy-efficient skeleton action recognition, and a Multi-Stream Anatomical Spiking Embedding (M-ASE) that acts as a generalized kinematic differential operator.

2603.18046.tldr: METHOD is presented, a zero-knowledge proof system that makes LLM inference verifiable: users can cryptographically confirm that outputs correspond to the computation of a specific model and preserve model perplexity exactly, enabling verification without quality compromise.

2603.18029.tldr: The approach combines dual-stream processing separating token and contextual representations, per-layer supervision providing independent gradient signal at each depth, and gated attention regularizing toward discrete activation patterns to establish a methodology for transforming interpretability from passive observation to active control.

2603.18197.tldr: This work proposes a design of website-based interaction for AI agents with fine-grained access control for delegated critical tasks, which encompasses a website design and implementation, as well as modifications to the access grant protocols in an open-source authorization service to tailor it to agentic AI.

2603.18257.tldr: IBD applies Pearl's do-operator to the agent's own actions and uses two-sample testing to produce an interpretable binary mask over observation dimensions, which requires no learned models and composes with any downstream RL algorithm as a preprocessing step.

2603.18189.tldr: TeachingCoach is a pedagogically grounded chatbot designed to support instructor professional development through real-time, conversational guidance that produces clearer, more reflective, and more responsive guidance than a GPT-4o mini baseline.

2603.18161.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs not only alter the voice and tone of human writing, but also consistently alter the intended meaning, highlighting a misalignment between the perceived benefit of AI use and an implicit, consistent effect on the semantics of human writing.

2603.18090.tldr: Two complementary generators are released: MOSS-TTS, which emphasizes structural simplicity, scalability, and long-context/control-oriented deployment, and MOSS-TTS-Local-Transformer, which introduces a frame-local autoregressive module for higher modeling efficiency, stronger speaker preservation, and a shorter time to first audio.

2603.18083.tldr: Meta-BayFL is proposed, a personalized probabilistic FL method that combines meta-learning with BNNs to improve training under uncertain and heterogeneous data and provides a theoretical convergence analysis and characterize the upper bound of the global model over communication rounds.

2603.18048.tldr: DEAF (Diagnostic Evaluation of Acoustic Faithfulness), a benchmark of over 2,700 conflict stimuli spanning three acoustic dimensions: emotional prosody, background sounds, and speaker identity, is introduced and a controlled multi-level evaluation framework is designed that progressively increases textual influence.

2603.18031.tldr: A consistency boundary analysis is presented that characterizes when diagonal short-memory SSMs can approximate causal attention and identifies structural gaps that remain and proposes InfoMamba, an attention-free hybrid architecture that consistently outperforms strong Transformer and SSM baselines.

2603.18024.tldr: Experiments show ProKWS delivers highly competitive performance, comparable to state-of-the-art models on standard benchmarks and demonstrates strong robustness for personalized keywords with tone and intent variations.

2603.18074.tldr: A lightweight adaptation framework that fuses an LLM-based judge with a lightweight relevance-based Reranker to distill high-fidelity reward signals while reducing the computational cost compared to standard LLM-as-a-Judge reinforcement learning is proposed.

2603.18493.tldr: Gains in FILT3R shrink in stable regimes as uncertainty contracts with accumulated evidence, and rise when genuine scene change increases process uncertainty, improving long-horizon stability for depth, pose, and 3D reconstruction, compared to the existing methods.

2603.18436.tldr: These results demonstrate that a soft differentiable fixpoint operator, combined with constraint-aware attention and declarative constraint specification, can match or exceed pipeline and solver-based neuro-symbolic systems while maintaining full end-to-end differentiability.

2603.18427.tldr: This work proposes a novel synthetic data augmentation pipeline that integrates controllable diffusion models and utilizes class-aware prompting and visual prior blending to improve image quality further, ensuring precise alignment with segmentation labels.

2603.18373.tldr: The Tri-Layer Diagnostic Framework is introduced, which disentangles hallucination sources via three metrics: Latent Anomaly Detection, Visual Necessity Score, and Competition Score, which enables a post-hoc selective prediction strategy achieving up to +9.5pp accuracy at 50% coverage with no additional training cost.

2603.18284.tldr: The first measurement study of mobile robotic manipulation workloads across onboard, edge, and cloud GPU platforms is presented, finding that the full workload stack is infeasible to run on smaller onboard GPUs, while larger onboard GPUs drain robot batteries several hours faster.

2603.18280.tldr: This work studies political censorship in Chinese-origin language models as a natural experiment, using probes, surgical ablations, and behavioral tests across nine open-weight models from five labs to support a three-stage descriptive framework: detect, route, generate.

2603.18266.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively captures complex actor-actor interactions and generates long-horizon, physically consistent trajectories, while requiring significantly fewer training samples than traditional agent-centric generative approaches.

2603.18495.tldr: This work introduces NeSyCR, a neurosymbolic counterfactual reasoning framework that enables verifiable adaptation of task procedures, providing a reliable synthesis of code policies and achieving robust cross-domain adaptation across both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks.

2603.18417.tldr: This paper proposes AFBS-BO (Adaptive Fidelity Binary Search with Bayesian Optimization), a fully automated framework that discovers optimal layer- and head-specific hyperparameters without human intervention and enables plug-and-play acceleration across diverse transformer architectures and domains.

2603.18377.tldr: The key idea is to project the real environment into a planning-oriented digital twin, a schema-constrained and de-identified abstract graph that preserves planning-relevant structure while removing reconstructable details, and formalize the privacy-utility trade-off as a capability granularity problem.

2603.18258.tldr: This work develops a theoretical framework that models the coordinate-wise dynamics in logit space and investigates logits-SAM, a computationally efficient variant that perturbs only the output layer with negligible overhead and integrates seamlessly with other DPO variants.

2603.18389.tldr: EquiEwald is introduced, a unified neural interatomic potential that embeds an Ewald-inspired reciprocal-space formulation within an irreducible SO(3)-equivariant framework and is established as a physically principled paradigm for long-range-capable machine-learning interatomic potentials.

2603.18363.tldr: By targeting $\alpha$-power distributions, PowerFlow enables the directional elicitation of the dual nature of LLMs: sharpening the distribution to intensify logical reasoning, or flattening it to unlock expressive creativity, shifting the Pareto frontier in creative tasks.

2603.18358.tldr: A temporal taxonomy of news-document trajectories that defines how documents relate to topic formation over time is introduced, which distinguishes anticipatory outliers from documents that either reinforce existing topics or remain isolated.

2603.18349.tldr: An NLP-based study of political propaganda on Moltbook, a Reddit-style platform for AI agents, finds that political propaganda accounts for 1% of all posts and 42% of all political content.

2603.18330.tldr: This work introduces MemArchitect, a governance layer that decouples memory lifecycle management from model weights and enforces explicit, rule-based policies, including memory decay, conflict resolution, and privacy controls.

2603.18329.tldr: FaithSteer-BENCH is introduced, a stress-testing benchmark that evaluates steering methods at a fixed deployment-style operating point through three gate-wise criteria: controllability, utility preservation, and robustness, which shows that existing methods do not necessarily provide reliable controllability in deployment-oriented practical settings.

2603.18315.tldr: DriveVLM-RL is proposed, a neuroscience-inspired framework that integrates VLMs into RL through a dual-pathway architecture for safe and deployable autonomous driving and shows significant improvements in collision avoidance, task success, and generalization across diverse traffic scenarios.

2603.18314.tldr: A Reinforcement Learning based Approximate Subgraph Matching (RL-ASM) algorithm that exploits graph transformers to effectively extract graph representations and RL-based policies for ASM that outperforms existing methods in terms of effectiveness and efficiency.

2603.18290.tldr: CORE achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance across five architectures and five benchmark configurations, ranking first in three of five settings and achieving the highest grand average AUROC with negligible computational overhead.

2603.18272.tldr: This work establishes a robust supervised fine-tuning recipe using LoRA that outperforms several state-of-the-art agent training pipelines and provides a detailed analysis of key design choices for experience retrieval, identifying optimal strategies for storage, querying, and trajectory selection.

2603.18447.tldr: SODIUM-Agent is developed, a multi-agent system composed of a web explorer and a cache manager that conducts deep and comprehensive web exploration and performs structurally coherent information extraction, powered by the proposed ATP-BFS algorithm and optimized through principled management of cached sources and navigation paths.

2603.18428.tldr: A reinforcement learning-based decoder sampler that treats decoding as sequential decision-making and learns a lightweight policy to adjust sampling parameters at test-time while keeping LLM weights frozen is introduced, enabling domain-aware and user-controllable generation without retraining large models.

2603.18426.tldr: The problem of optimizing the compression order is formulated and the Progressive Intensity Hypothesis is introduced, which states that weaker perturbations should precede stronger ones and theoretical guarantees showing that the relative benefit of one order increases with the underlying performance gap are provided.

2603.18411.tldr: Token-level Adaptive Routing (TARo) is proposed, which steers frozen LLMs toward structured reasoning entirely at inference time, extending test-time alignment from preference optimization to robust, cross-domain reasoning.

2603.18273.tldr: This technical report presents the Educational Data Mining Automated Research System (EDM-ARS), a domain-specific multi-agent pipeline that automates end-to-end educational data mining research and outlines a phased roadmap toward causal inference, transfer learning, psychometric, and multi-dataset generalization.

2603.18480.tldr: These findings suggest a perception--understanding gap in current VLMs: although they can recognize visible gameplay cues, they still struggle to robustly infer human engagement across games.

2603.18462.tldr: AlignMamba-2 is proposed, an effective and efficient framework for multimodal fusion and sentiment analysis that introduces a dual alignment strategy that regularizes the model using both Optimal Transport distance and Maximum Mean Discrepancy, promoting geometric and statistical consistency between modalities without incurring any inference-time overhead.

2603.18421.tldr: Regulatory authorities are suggested to establish a strict information disclosure system for AI technology, conduct differentiated digital financial education to enhance the identification capabilities of vulnerable groups, promote digital financial mutual aid groups to leverage the protective effects of social capital, and improve the consumer protection mechanism for farmers in digital finance.

2603.18420.tldr: The method extends Predictive Associative Memory from episodic recall to concept formation: where PAM recalls specific associations, multi-epoch contrastive training under compression extracts structural patterns that transfer to unseen texts, the same framework producing qualitatively different behaviour in a different regime.

2603.18382.tldr: The findings establish that identity inference -- not merely explicit information disclosure -- must be treated as a first-class privacy risk; evaluations must measure what identities an agent can infer.

2603.18334.tldr: This work introduces VCoT-Lift, a framework that lifts low-level solver reasoning into high-level, human-readable verification steps, and introduces VCoT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark of 1,988 VCoT completion tasks for rigorously evaluating LLMs' understanding of the entire verification process.
