2603.18327.tldr: Overall, clinician post-editing demonstrates consistent shifts from conversational phrasing toward standardized, section- appropriate clinical terminology, supporting section-aware ambient AI design.

2603.18300.tldr: ChoiceEval is introduced, a reproducible framework for auditing preferences for brands and cultures in large language models (LLMs) under realistic usage conditions and reveals consistent preferences that persist across user personas, suggesting systematic rather than incidental effects.

2603.18298.tldr: This work proposes the first sparsely supervised framework for monocular 3D object tracking and automatically generates high-quality 3D pseudolabels across entire videos, effectively transforming sparse supervision into dense 3D track annotations and enables existing fully-supervised trackers to effectively operate under extreme label sparsity.

2603.18356.tldr: LGESynthNet, a latent diffusion-based framework for controllable enhancement synthesis, enabling explicit control over size, location, and transmural extent is introduced, enabling explicit control over size, location, and transmural extent.

2603.18353.tldr: Current mechanistic interpretability methods cannot reliably translate internal knowledge into corrected outputs, with implications for AI safety frameworks that assume interpretability enables effective error correction.

2603.18342.tldr: A unified uncertainty quantification approach for predicting rollout success versus failure that uses max-based sliding window pooling to preserve transient risk signals, applies motion-aware stability weighting to emphasize high-frequency action oscillations associated with unstable behaviors, and performs DoF-adaptive calibration via Bayesian Optimization to prioritize kinematically critical axes is proposed.

2603.18331.tldr: This survey presents differential equations as a theoretical foundation for understanding, analyzing, and improving DNNs, and reviews how this framework connects model design, theoretical analysis, and performance improvement.

2603.18294.tldr: E evaluation benchmarks remain misaligned with real-world clinical needs, lacking raw clinical artifacts, adequate representation of vulnerable populations, and longitudinal chronic care scenarios, and the field must adopt standardized query profiling--analogous to clinical trial reporting--to align evaluation with the full complexity of clinical practice.

2603.18261.tldr: LRConv-NeRV is proposed, an efficient NeRV variant that replaces selected dense 3x3 convolutional layers with structured low-rank separable convolutions, trained end-to-end within the decoder architecture, and achieves a more favorable efficiency versus quality trade-off.

2603.18460.tldr: This work developed an interpretable framework for automatic cancer detection using a small dataset of 162 T2-weighted prostate MRI images, addressing data scarcity through transfer learning and augmentation, and achieves competitive performance using only T2-weighted images, reducing acquisition complexity and computational cost.

2603.18459.tldr: Evaluation on real-world benchmarks shows that HypeMed outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both recommendation precision and DDI reduction, simultaneously enhancing the effectiveness and safety of clinical decision support.

2603.18444.tldr: This work reformulate RLVR from a statistical estimation perspective by modeling rewards as samples drawn from a policy-induced distribution and casting advantage computation as the problem of estimating the reward distribution from finite data, and proposes Discounted Beta--Bernoulli (DBB) reward estimation, which leverages historical reward statistics for the non-stationary distribution.

2603.18418.tldr: DermCase is constructed, a long-context benchmark derived from peer-reviewed case reports, that establishes DermLIP-based similarity metrics that achieve stronger alignment with dermatologists for assessing differential diagnosis quality and reveals critical limitations in current models'reasoning capabilities.

2603.18782.tldr: Experiments on both objects and scene scenarios consistently demonstrate superior performance over state-of-the-art baselines in terms of rendering quality and geometric fidelity, highlighting the effectiveness of explicitly embedding point-cloud priors for achieving more accurate and structurally controllable 3D generation.

2603.18773.tldr: AutoPipe is proposed, a budget-aware two-stage framework for configuration selection in LLM post-training that consistently outperforms offline-only baselines and achieves comparable performance with the strongest online HPO baselines while using less than 10\% of their computational cost.

2603.18719.tldr: Ontology- Guided Diffusion shows that explicitly encoding realism structure enables interpretable, data-efficient, and generalisable zero-shot sim2real transfer.

2603.18620.tldr: A 4B-parameter model trained with LSE outperforms self-evolving policies powered by GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5, as well as prompt optimization methods including GEPA and TextGrad, and transfers to guide other models without additional training.

2603.18567.tldr: SpecForge is introduced, an open-source, production-oriented framework for training speculative decoding models with full support for EAGLE-3, and SpecBundle, a suite of production-grade EAGLE-3 draft models trained with SpecForge for mainstream open-source LLMs.

2603.18627.tldr: AFS-Search is introduced, a training-free closed-loop framework built upon FLUX.1-dev that incorporates a training-free closed-loop parallel rollout search and flow steering mechanism, which leverages a Vision-Language Model as a semantic critic to diagnose intermediate latents and dynamically steer the velocity field via precise spatial grounding.

2603.18624.tldr: REST (Receding Horizon Explorative Steiner Tree), a training-free framework that builds an explicit open-vocabulary 3D map from online RGB-D streams and grows an agent-centric tree of safe and informative paths as the option space via sampling-based planning, demonstrating a favorable efficiency-success balance.

2603.18604.tldr: This work presents AutORAN, the first LLM-driven natural language programming framework for agile xApps that automates the entire xApp development pipeline and drastically accelerates the xApp development cycle, streamlining O-RAN innovation.

2603.18596.tldr: This paper conducts a systematic analysis of importance estimation in EWC from a gradient-based perspective and proposes the Logits Reversal (LR) operation, a simple yet effective modification that rectifies EWC's importance estimation.

2603.18579.tldr: Evaluating 7 LLMs across 4 English tasks, 6 non-English languages, and 2 attribution methods, it is found that faithfulness is operator-dependent: operator gaps reach up to 44 percentage points, suggesting that faithfulness should be interpreted comparatively across intervention operators rather than as a single score.

2603.18564.tldr: Transformers are compared against classical baselines that are optimal or suboptimal under the corresponding maximum-likelihood criteria and consistently match or outperform these baselines, demonstrating robust in-context adaptation beyond classical estimators.

2603.18563.tldr: It is proved that off-the-shelf reasoning AI agents can achieve Nash-like play zero-shot, without explicit post-training, and suggested that AI agents naturally exhibit such reasoning patterns and therefore attain stable equilibrium behaviors intrinsically, obviating the need for universal alignment procedures in many real-world strategic interactions.

2603.18558.tldr: Evaluations show that HiMu advances the efficiency-accuracy Pareto front: at 16 frames with Qwen3-VL 8B it outperforms all competing selectors, and with GPT-4o it surpasses agentic systems operating at 32-512 frames while requiring roughly 10x fewer FLOPs.

2603.18507.tldr: This work studies how model optimization, task type, prompt length, and placement can impact expert persona effectiveness across instruction-tuned and reasoning LLMs, and provides insight into conditions under which expert personas fail and succeed, and developed a pipeline to fully leverage the benefits of an expert persona.

2603.18743.tldr: A generalist, continually-learnable LLM agent system that functions as an agent-designing agent that autonomously constructs, adapts, and improves task-specific agents through experience, built on a memory-based reinforcement learning framework with stateful prompts.

2603.18712.tldr: Linear-Network (Li-Net), a novel architecture designed for multi-channel time series forecasting that captures the linear and non-linear dependencies among channels, provides a superior balance between prediction accuracy and computational burden, exhibiting significantly lower memory usage and faster inference times.

2603.18662.tldr: This work proposes Action Applicability Policy Optimization (A2PO), a reinforcement learning paradigm for mastering strategic construction that employs Adaptive Reward Shaping to regulate the timing and quality of visual aids via counterfactual sampling to distinguish necessary from redundant constructions.

2603.18647.tldr: ADLA is proposed, a leakage detection framework that applies the two-sample Anderson--Darling test for leakage detection and can provide improved leakage-detection sensitivity in protected implementations for a low number of traces compared to TVLA.

2603.18597.tldr: These findings establish reproducible baselines for BHDD across diverse modeling paradigms, highlight PETNN's strong performance relative to classical and Transformer-based models, and quantify the gap between energy-inspired PETNNs and a true energy-based model (JEM).

2603.18571.tldr: A new benchmark for subcellular localization that integrates diverse 3D structural representations with fine-grained subcellular localization annotations carefully curated by domain experts is introduced, demonstrating the potential for bridging the gap with intuitive biological interpretability and paving the way for data-driven discoveries in cell biology.

2603.18544.tldr: SCISSR is presented, a scribble-promptable framework for interactive surgical scene segmentation that converts freehand scribbles into dense prompt embeddings compatible with the mask decoder, enabling iterative refinement for a target object by drawing corrective strokes on error regions.

2603.18752.tldr: This work empirically demonstrate, through extensive validation on multiple metrics to assess faithfulness, simulatability, diversity, and plausibility, that WeNLEX is able to produce faithful and plausible explanations, using as little as 5 ground-truth explanations per diagnosis.

2603.18736.tldr: CausalRM, a causal-theoretic reward modeling framework that aims to learn unbiased reward models from observational feedback, is proposed, which effectively learns accurate reward signals from noisy and biased observational feedback and delivers substantial performance improvements on downstream RLHF tasks.

2603.18676.tldr: MANAR is a compatible re-parameterization of MHA with identical semantic roles for its projections, enabling knowledge transfer from pretrained transformers via weight-copy and thus overcoming the adoption barriers of structurally incompatible linear-time alternatives.

2603.18656.tldr: Results show that SCALe consistently improves accuracy over vanilla SFT and matches the performance of the full two-phase SFT + GRPO pipeline while requiring only about one-seventh of the training time, making it a lightweight yet effective alternative.

2603.18762.tldr: ClawTrap is presented, a MITM-based red-teaming framework for real-world OpenClaw security evaluation that supports diverse and customizable attack forms, and provides a reproducible pipeline for rule-driven interception, transformation, and auditing.

2603.18761.tldr: The NeuroGame Transformer is introduced by reconceptualizing attention through a dual perspective: tokens are treated simultaneously as players in a cooperative game and as interacting spins in a statistical physics system, and importance-weighted Monte Carlo estimators with Gibbs-distributed weights are developed.

2603.18756.tldr: A systematic analysis of GRPO indicates that incorporating negative feedback is essential training solely on actions above a baseline limits learning and that simpler REINFORCE based approaches can effectively enhance reasoning in LLMs, offering a more transparent and efficient alternative to GRPO.

2603.18677.tldr: A conceptual and mathematical framework to distinguish cognitive amplification, where AI improves hybrid human AI performance while preserving human expertise, from cognitive delegation, where reasoning is progressively outsourced to the AI system, risking long term atrophy of human capabilities.

2603.18652.tldr: This work applies LLM-as-a-judge for semantic table evaluation, integrated into a matching pipeline that accommodates inconsistencies in parser outputs and shows that LLM-based evaluation achieves substantially higher correlation with human judgment than existing evaluation approaches.

2603.18631.tldr: D-Mem is introduced, a dual-process memory system that retains lightweight vector retrieval for routine queries while establishing an exhaustive Full Deliberation module as a high-fidelity fallback, and employs a Multi-dimensional Quality Gating policy to dynamically bridge these two processes.

2603.18532.tldr: This work shows that VLAs can be RL fine-tuned without sacrificing generality and with reduced labor by leveraging 3D world generative models and highlights the benefits of leveraging the effectively unlimited data from 3D world generative models through an ablation study showing that increasing scene diversity directly improves zero-shot generalization.

2603.18528.tldr: Correlation-Weighted Multi-Reward Optimization is proposed, a framework that leverages the correlation structure among concept rewards to adaptively weight each attribute concept in optimization and encourages the model to consistently satisfy all requested attributes simultaneously.

2603.18508.tldr: This handbook develops domain-adapted transformer architectures for structured visual understanding, relational vehicle representation learning, and multimodal document intelligence, enabling end-to-end automation of vehicle damage analysis, claims evaluation, and underwriting workflows.

2603.18501.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that Diff-SIT establishes a new state-of-the-art in perceptual quality and temporal consistency, particularly in the challenging ultra-low-bitrate regime.

2603.18767.tldr: Diversified Unlearning is proposed, a distributional framework that represents a concept through a set of contextually diverse prompts rather than a single keyword, which enables more precise and robust unlearning.

2603.18740.tldr: This paper studies how LLM-based vulnerability detection in ACR is affected by the framing effect: the tendency to let the presentation of information override its semantic content in forming judgments, and designs a realistic and controlled experimental environment to assess the susceptibility of real-world ACR pipelines to vulnerability reintroduction attacks.

2603.18729.tldr: These findings suggest that for intersectionality-informed software engineering, fairness evaluation should include model-specific validation of mitigation strategies, and workflow-level controls (e.g., agentic architectures involving critique models) in high-impact LLM deployments.

2603.18718.tldr: Memory-augmented LLM agents maintain external memory banks to support long-horizon interaction, yet most existing systems treat construction, retrieval, and utilization as isolated subroutines, creating two coupled challenges: strategic blindness on the forward path of the memory cycle and sparse, delayed supervision on the backward path.

2603.18683.tldr: HISR is proposed, exploiting Hindsight Information to modulate Segmental process Rewards, which closely aligns rewards with sub-goals and underscores significant segments to enhance the reliability of credit assignment.

2603.18655.tldr: Switch is proposed, a novel SSL framework with two key innovations: 1) a multiscale switch (MSS) strategy that employs hierarchical patch mixing to achieve uniform spatial coverage; and 2) a frequency-domain switch (FDS) with contrastive learning that performs amplitude switching in Fourier space for robust feature representations.

2603.18633.tldr: The ORS framework charts a path from narrow technical alignment toward comprehensive philosophical foundations for the synthetic minds already among us, and is applied to emergent scenarios including autonomous research agents, AI-mediated healthcare, and agentic AI ecosystems, demonstrating its capacity to generate proportionate, adaptive governance recommendations.

2603.18623.tldr: OpenT2M, a million-level, high-quality, and open-source motion dataset containing over 2800 hours of human motion, and MonoFrill, a pretrained motion model that achieves compelling T2M results without complicated designs or technique tricks as"frills" are introduced.

2603.18614.tldr: It is shown that ZebraArena requires a combination of in-depth reasoning and accurate external tool calling, which remains a challenge as frontier reasoning models such as GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro only achieves 60% accuracy on the hard instances.

2603.18577.tldr: This work introduces MedForge-90K, a large-scale benchmark of realistic lesion edits across 19 pathologies with expert-guided reasoning supervision via doctor inspection guidelines and gold edit locations, and MedForge-Reasoner, a data-and-method solution for pre-hoc, evidence-grounded medical forgery detection.

2603.18573.tldr: A reference-free simulation framework that trains two independent LLMs, one as the user and one as the conversational recommender, resulting in more realistic and diverse conversations that closely mirror authentic human-AI interactions.

2603.18545.tldr: CoDA is proposed, a chain-of-distribution framework that constructs clinically plausible pipeline shifts by composing acquisition-like shading, reconstruction and display remapping, and delivery and export degradations and introduces a post-hoc repair strategy based on teacher-guided token-space adaptation with patch-level alignment, which improves accuracy on archived CoDA outputs.

2603.18523.tldr: A lightweight intervention strategy is proposed that exploits simple and abundantly available synthetic images to fine-tune arbitrary pretrained LVLMs exclusively on counting, and not only enhances counting accuracy on in-distribution synthetic data, but also yields an average improvement on out-of-distribution counting benchmarks.

2603.18513.tldr: CAFlow is introduced, an adaptive-depth single-step flow-matching framework that routes each image tile to the shallowest network exit that preserves reconstruction quality and outperforms all comparable-compute baselines while remaining competitive with the much larger SwinIR-Medium model.

2603.19066.tldr: It is found that LLM-generated analogies are reliably judged as better than human-generated ones, and are also more closely aligned with the parallelogram structure in a distributional embedding space (GloVe).

2603.19022.tldr: Stability Monitor is introduced, a black-box stability monitoring system that periodically fingerprints an endpoint by sampling outputs from a fixed prompt set and comparing the resulting output distributions over time, and observes substantial provider-to-provider and within-provider stability differences.

2603.18914.tldr: This paper reviews the evolving European Union AI regulatory provisions via analyzing 24 relevant documents published between 2024 and 2025 and deconstructs the regulatory interpretations of security, privacy, and agentic AI, distinguishing them from closely related concepts to resolve ambiguity.

2603.18895.tldr: This paper proposes a measurement framework for evaluating human-AI decision-making centered on team readiness, and introduces a four part taxonomy of evaluation metrics spanning outcomes, reliance behavior, safety signals, and learning over time, and connects these metrics to the Understand-Control-Improve lifecycle of human-AI onboarding and collaboration.

2603.18815.tldr: Under the rollout-as-a-service philosophy, this work presents ProRL Agent, a scalable infrastructure that serves the full agentic rollout lifecycle through an API service and validate ProRL Agent through RL training on software engineering, math, STEM, and coding tasks.

2603.18999.tldr: The results provide the first formal regret-theoretic justification for decentralized competitive allocation in modular architectures and establish cost endogeneity as a fundamental challenge distinct from partial observability.

2603.18859.tldr: RewardFlow is introduced, a lightweight method for estimating state-level rewards tailored to agentic reasoning tasks that substantially outperforms prior RL baselines across four agentic reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating superior performance, robustness, and training efficiency.

2603.18829.tldr: ACP is a temporal admission control protocol that enforces behavioral properties over execution traces by combining static risk scoring with stateful signals (anomaly accumulation, cooldown) through a LedgerQuerier abstraction separating decision logic from state management.

2603.18916.tldr: The manifesto serves as a roadmap for bridging these communities and for guiding the development of APM systems in practice and discusses the extent to which the capabilities can be realized and identify research challenges whose resolution requires further advances in BPM, AI, and multi-agent systems.

2603.18897.tldr: PASTE is a Pattern-Aware Speculative Tool Execution method designed to hide tool latency through speculation, and shows that it reduces average task completion time and improves tool execution throughput by 1.8x.

2603.18894.tldr: Evidence that integrity in institutional AI should be treated as a pre-deployment requirement rather than a post-deployment assumption is presented, and institutional design is implied that institutional design is a precondition for safe delegation.

2603.19042.tldr: A synthetic review connecting three intertwined aspects of AI's role in judicial decision-making: the performance and fairness of AI tools, the strengths and biases of human judges, and the nature of AI-plus-human interactions argues that AI-versus-human comparisons have the potential to yield new insights into both algorithmic tools and human decision-makers.

2603.19011.tldr: It is revealed that current LLM models can reliably detect danger signals but cannot reliably verify safety, the very capability required for privacy-preserving agentic protocols such as NDAI zones.

2603.19005.tldr: The results show that current AI agents struggle with domain-specific reasoning, and challenge the narrative of complete automation by AI and underscore the enduring importance of human expertise in data science, while illuminating directions for the next generation of AI.

2603.18992.tldr: This guide develops the mathematical foundations of the Schrodinger bridge problem, drawing on optimal transport, stochastic control, and path-space optimization, and focuses on its dynamic formulation with direct connections to modern generative modeling.

2603.18886.tldr: This paper builds and releases training data and benchmarks for deriving mathematical objects, the Principia suite, and provides training recipes with strong LLM-judges and verifiers, where it is shown that on-policy judge training boosts performance and how on-policy training can also be used to scale test-time compute via aggregation.

2603.18873.tldr: It is proposed that language learning applications should generate lessons that adapt to an individual's needs through personalized, domain specific lesson scenarios while maintaining foundational support through general, relatable lesson scenarios.

2603.18827.tldr: Both men and women perceive potential threats in the same manner, with men more aware of war, AI controlled drones, terrain recognition, and information war and women seem to have a stronger tendency towards ethical considerations and helping others.

2603.18806.tldr: Trajectory Reduction Policy Optimization (dTRPO) is proposed, which substantially improves the core performance of state-of-the-art dLLMs, and exhibits strong training efficiency due to its offline, single-forward nature, and achieves improved generation efficiency through high-quality outputs.

2603.18793.tldr: This work first solves a generalized eigenvalue problem to extract a stable functional subspace for watermark injection, while introducing an adaptive spectral truncation strategy to achieve an optimal balance between robustness and model utility.

2603.19074.tldr: CAMO is proposed, a conditional neural solver for MOMTSP that generalizes across varying numbers of targets, agents, and preference vectors, and yields high-quality approximations to the Pareto front (PF).

2603.19008.tldr: Hypothesis-Conditioned Query Rewriting (HCQR) is proposed, a training-free pre-retrieval framework that reorients RAG from topic-oriented retrieval to evidence-oriented retrieval, allowing the generator to confirm or overturn the initial hypothesis based on the retrieved evidence.

2603.18979.tldr: This work presents PRIOR, an efficient and reproducible framework that achieves robust terrain traversal with human-like gaits through a simple yet effective design of a parametric gait generator that supplies stable reference trajectories derived from motion capture without adversarial training.

2603.18976.tldr: It is suggested that structured intent representations can improve alignment and usability in human-AI interaction, especially in tasks where user intent is inherently ambiguous.

2603.18968.tldr: This paper introduces intentional interventions, a new time-agnostic operator that induces a twin SCM that is a structural final model (SFM), and shows how SFMs can be used to empirically detect agents and to discover their intentions.

2603.18866.tldr: This paper proposes a new method, Conflict-Based Search with Asynchronous Actions (CBS-AA), which can solve MAPF-AA with completeness and solution optimality guarantees and can reduce the number of branches by up to 90%.

2603.19097.tldr: DaPT, a novel multilingual RAG framework that generates sub-question graphs in parallel for both the source-language query and its English translation counterpart, then merges them before employing a bilingual retrieval-and-answer strategy to sequentially solve sub-questions, significantly enhancing RAG performance on this task.

2603.18994.tldr: This work evaluates rule changes including holding block h, preview holding block p, and additional Tetris block variants using metrics such as training reward and convergence iterations to study difficulty in this domain using Stochastic Gumbel AlphaZero, a budget-aware planning agent for stochastic environments.

2603.18987.tldr: A reproducible simulation framework that couples a Generative Adversarial Network GAN with a Noisy OR patrol detection model is presented to measure how racial bias propagates through the full enforcement pipeline from crime occurrence to police contact and demonstrates that a Conditional Tabular GAN CTGAN debiasing approach partially redistributes detection rates but cannot eliminate structural disparity without accompanying policy intervention.

2603.18911.tldr: XKD-Dial is presented, a progressive four-stage training pipeline for explainable, knowledge-grounded dialogue generation in a bilingual (English-Hindi) setting, comprising three post-hoc explainability analyses applied systematically across the training trajectory to reveal how citation behaviour is learned, not only whether it is learned.

2603.18893.tldr: It is found that greedy-decoded self-reports collapse outputs to few uninformative values, but introspective capacity can be unmasked by calculating logit-based self-reports, and numeric self-report is position as a viable, complementary tool for tracking internal emotive states in conversational AI systems.

2603.18788.tldr: This work introduces Mi:dm K 2.5 Pro, a 32B parameter flagship LLM designed to address enterprise-grade complexity through reasoning-focused optimization, and builds a robust data foundation via a quality-centric curation pipeline utilizing abstract syntax tree (AST) analysis for code, gap-filling synthesis for mathematics and an LLM-based quality evaluator.

2603.18892.tldr: MultihopSpatial is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed for multi-hop and compositional spatial reasoning, and reinforcement learning post-training on the authors' corpus enhances both intrinsic VLM spatial reasoning and downstream embodied manipulation performance.

2603.18881.tldr: Three illustrative vignettes are provided, i.e., exploratory probes, in the hope that they will spark lively discussions and follow-up work on what world AI systems construct, and how brittle are model outputs to minute syntactic variations.

2603.18871.tldr: The Semantic-Augmented DRL (SA-DRL) framework is proposed, which employs a Logit Fusion mechanism to inject the LLM's semantic reasoning directly into the policy as a prior, effectively guiding the agent toward critical intersections.

2603.19054.tldr: Em-Garde is proposed, a novel framework that decouples semantic understanding from streaming perception and demonstrates consistent improvements over prior models in proactive response accuracy and efficiency, validating an effective solution for proactive video understanding under strict computational constraints.

2603.18856.tldr: Empirical results demonstrate that Motion-o improves spatial-temporal grounding and trajectory prediction while remaining fully compatible with existing frameworks, establishing motion reasoning as a critical extension for evidence-based video understanding.

2603.18795.tldr: Perceptio is presented, a perception enhanced LVLM with 2D and 3D spatial reasoning abilities, enabled via explicit semantic segmentation tokens and depth tokens generated directly within the autoregressive sequence, demonstrating that explicit spatial chain-of-thought materially strengthens spatial grounding in LVLMs.

2603.19101.tldr: FedTrident is proposed, which introduces neuron-wise analysis for local model misbehavior detection for local model misbehavior detection, and adaptive client rating for client exclusion according to the local model detection results in each FL round, and machine unlearning for corrupted global model remediation once malicious clients are excluded during FL.

2603.19100.tldr: LuMamba is proposed, a self-supervised framework combining topology-invariant encodings with linear-complexity state-space modeling, using LUNA's learned-query cross-attention mechanism for channel unification, and FEMBA's bidirectional Mamba blocks for efficient temporal modeling within this architecture.

2603.19092.tldr: Experiments across multiple VLMs and an additional state-of-the-art benchmark show that safety decisions are highly sensitive to semantic cues, indicating reliance on learned visual-linguistic associations rather than grounded visual understanding.

2603.19087.tldr: It is shown that humans reliably benefit from randomly assigned cross-domain mappings, while LLMs, on average, generate more original ideas than humans and do not show a statistically significant effect of cross-domain mappings.

2603.19028.tldr: SEM is proposed, a post-hoc, zero-shot debiasing framework that operates in a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latent space that identifies and modulates bias-relevant neurons while preserving query-relevant ones and achieves substantial fairness gains in retrieval and zero-shot classification.

2603.19017.tldr: Cross mixed-effects regression shows that temporal linearity is the strongest predictor of temporal reasoning in high-resource languages, whereas fragmentation is the stronger predictor in low-resource languages.

2603.18908.tldr: This work investigates the extent to which representational convergence enables practical linear alignment between large language models, and learns affine transformations between the final hidden states of independent models and empirically evaluates these mappings across text generation, embedding classification, and out-of-distribution detection.

2603.18896.tldr: PASTA surpasses state-of-the-art methods by preserving both structural and pathological details through its highly interactive dual-arm architecture and multi-modal condition integration and introduces a novel cycle exchange consistency and volumetric generation strategy that significantly enhances PASTA's ability to produce high-quality 3D PET images.

2603.19191.tldr: OS-Themis is proposed, a scalable and accurate multi-agent critic framework that decomposes trajectories into verifiable milestones to isolate critical evidence for decision making and employs a review mechanism to strictly audit the evidence chain before making the final verdict.

2603.19166.tldr: This work empirically demonstrate that state-of-the-art VLM-based grounding approaches struggle with complex metric-semantic language queries, and proposes MAPG (Multi-Agent Probabilistic Grounding), an agentic framework that decomposes language queries into structured subcomponents and queries a VLM to ground each component.

2603.19225.tldr: FinTradeBench, a benchmark for evaluating financial reasoning that integrates company fundamentals and trading signals, is introduced and 14 LLMs under zero-shot prompting and retrieval-augmented settings are evaluated, highlighting fundamental challenges in the numerical and time-series reasoning for current LLMs.

2603.19223.tldr: This work presents F2LLM-v2, a new family of general-purpose, multilingual embedding models in 8 distinct sizes ranging from 80M to 14B, and releases all models, data, code, and intermediate checkpoints to facilitate open-source embedding model research.

2603.19138.tldr: The first large-scale, trace-level study showing that multi-pass LLM reasoning gives rise to structured, token-level implicit patterns that serve as an abstraction of LLM reasoning, and which form a stable, structured system with distinct temporal roles and measurable characteristics.

2603.19229.tldr: NavTrust is the first benchmark that exposes embodied navigation agents to diverse RGB-Depth corruptions and instruction variations in a unified framework, and systematically corrupts input modalities, including RGB, depth, and instructions, in realistic scenarios and evaluates their impact on navigation performance.

2603.19169.tldr: ARIADNE is presented, a two-stage framework coupling preference-aligned perception with RL-based diagnostic reasoning for topologically coherent stenosis detection, demonstrating that preference-based learning over structural constraints mitigates topological violations while maintaining diagnostic sensitivity in interventional cardiology workflows.

2603.19216.tldr: This work proposes DreamPartGen, a framework for semantically grounded, part-aware text-to-3D generation that introduces Duplex Part Latents that jointly model each part's geometry and appearance, and Relational Semantic Latents that capture inter-part dependencies derived from language.

2603.19182.tldr: A conceptual process-control architecture that decomposes LLM reasoning into three explicit layers: memory grounding, structured inference, and boundary enforcement is proposed, indicating that process-level control may offer a promising direction for improving reliability in large language model reasoning.

2603.19173.tldr: SOL-ExecBench reframes GPU kernel benchmarking from beating a mutable software baseline to closing the remaining gap to hardware Speed-of-Light, and reports a SOL Score that quantifies how much of the gap between a release-defined scoring baseline and the hardware SOL bound a candidate kernel closes.

2603.19146.tldr: This work introduces a generalized beam-search framework for discrete diffusion that generates candidates in parallel and supports modular beam-selection objectives and proposes D5P4, which formulates the selection step as MAP inference over a Determinantal Point Process.

2603.19121.tldr: This work introduces CustomTex, a novel framework for instance-level, high-fidelity scene texturing driven by reference images, and establishes a more direct and user-friendly path to high-quality, customizable 3D scene appearance editing.

2603.19220.tldr: Nemotron-Cascade 2 is introduced, an open 30B MoE model with 3B activated parameters that delivers best-in-class reasoning and strong agentic capabilities that aims to achieve Gold Medal-level performance in the 2025 International Mathematical Olympiad, the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI), and the ICPC World Finals.

2603.19163.tldr: Experiments show that cuGenOpt outperforms general MIP solvers by orders of magnitude, achieves competitive quality against specialized solvers on instances up to n=150, and attains 4.73% gap on TSP-442 within 30s.

2603.19152.tldr: Variable Entropy Policy Optimization (VEPO), which leverages Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards to incorporate deterministic structural constraints into the policy alignment process, ensures prescribed sequence length, robust format consistency, and rigorous linguistic well formedness during training.

2603.19144.tldr: This work proposes an internal-representation--level debiasing framework for large language models that models the Transformer as a structured computational graph, and introduces a log-space constraint on sensitive logits and a selective anchor-based objective to preserve definitional semantics.

2508.13876.tldr: An approach is introduced that generates the strategy in the form of pseudocode and enables automatic debugging of the pseudocode and enables automatic debugging of the pseudocode, hence allowing us to identify and fix errors prior to the generation of the generalized plan itself.

2508.08570.tldr: This work proposes a method that leverages the semantic structure inherent in class labels--specifically, superclass information--to naturally reduce reliance on spurious features and achieves robustness to more complex spurious correlations without the need to annotate any source samples.

2504.05786.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive review of methods integrating LLMs with 3D spatial understanding, and proposes a taxonomy that categorizes existing methods into three branches: image-based methods deriving 3D understanding from 2D visual data, point cloud-based methods working directly with 3D representations, and hybrid modality-based methods combining multiple data streams.

2502.19095.tldr: This work replicates a state-of-the-art XSS adversarial attack, highlighting threats to validity in the reference work and extending it toward a more effective evaluation strategy, and introduces an XSS Oracle to mitigate these threats.

2506.04218.tldr: Pseudo-simulation operates on real datasets, similar to open-loop evaluation, but augments them with synthetic observations generated prior to evaluation using 3D Gaussian Splatting, and is better correlated with closed-loop simulations than the best existing open-loop approach.

2502.14400.tldr: Hard Preference Sampling (HPS) is proposed, a novel framework for robust and efficient human preference alignment that improves sample efficiency over existing PL methods and maximizes the reward margin between preferred and dispreferred responses, ensuring clearer distinctions.

2310.11703.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive review of the relevant algorithms in VDBs, with detailed design principles and technological evolution, and conducts an in-depth comparison of several advanced VDB solutions with their strengths, limitations, and typical application scenarios.

2506.14391.tldr: This paper proposes HiLight, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework with global adversarial guidance for large-scale TSC, and introduces an adversarial training mechanism, where the Meta-Policy generates challenging yet informative sub-goals, and the Sub-Policy learns to surpass these targets, leading to more effective coordination.

2509.19080.tldr: World4RL is a framework that employs diffusion-based world models as high-fidelity simulators to refine pre-trained policies entirely in imagined environments for robotic manipulation and enables consistent policy refinement, yielding significantly higher success rates compared to imitation learning and other baselines.

2509.16835.tldr: A semantic-driven topic modeling framework that integrates four modular components: transformer-based embeddings (Sentence-BERT), dimensionality reduction (UMAP), clustering (HDBSCAN), and topic extraction with refinement (HDBSCAN) that achieves higher topic coherence compared to established methods.

2505.11404.tldr: Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that both Patho-CLIP and Patho-R1 achieve robust performance across a wide range of pathology-related tasks, including zero-shot classification, cross-modal retrieval, Visual Question Answering, and Multiple Choice Question.

2505.03424.tldr: GNN-AID is introduced, an open-source framework designed for graph data to address the gap in interpretability and robustness in machine learning models, and how defenses against evasion and poisoning attacks can conflict when applied to graph data.

2509.24897.tldr: It is found that current unified models still struggle to achieve effective synergy, indicating that architectural unification alone is insufficient, and the need for new training strategies and inductive biases to fully unlock the potential of unified modeling.

2509.00402.tldr: A novel personalized subgraph FL framework called Curriculum Guided Personalized SUbgraph Federated Learning (CUFL), which improves weighted model aggregation by estimating client similarity using fine-grained structural indicators reconstructed on a random reference graph.

1709.09051.tldr: An algorithm is described which allows to compute an exact MAP solution from a perhaps fractional optimal (probability) solution of the proposed LP relaxation.

2507.16214.tldr: A complete pipeline integrating advanced computer vision techniques with adaptive nonlinear filtering with an enhanced solution for robust onboard relative navigation, significantly advancing the capabilities required for safe proximity operations during ADR missions.

2506.15047.tldr: Carey, a GPT-4o-based chatbot designed to provide informational and emotional support to AD/ADRD caregivers, is developed and a mapping of caregiver needs, AI chatbot's strengths, gaps, and design recommendations are presented.

2411.13207.tldr: This work presents an automated method for measuring the ISA of LLMs, which covers all 30 security topics in a mobile ISA taxonomy, and proposes a practical mitigation: incorporating security awareness instruction into model system prompts to help LLMs better detect and reject unsafe requests.

2603.19264.tldr: Generative Active Testing (GAT), an uncertainty-aware acquisition framework leveraging LLMs as surrogates for informing the sample selection process, is presented, using a novel Statement Adaptation Module to modify generative tasks into a pseudo-classification format, enabling the capture of sample-level uncertainties across unlabeled candidates.

2603.19259.tldr: Breeze Taigi is introduced, a comprehensive framework centered on standardized benchmarks for evaluating Taigi speech recognition and synthesis systems that leverages parallel Taiwanese Mandarin resources and large-scale synthetic data generation.

2603.17765.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that multimodal fusion significantly improves retrieval performance compared to image-only retrieval, achieving Recall@5 above 0.95 on clinically relevant findings and enabling improved trustworthiness compared to conventional generative approaches.

2603.19262.tldr: This work characterizes observable inference-time update behavior rather than internal Bayesian reasoning, and introduces the {\alpha}-law as a principled diagnostic for monitoring update stability and reasoning quality in LLM inference systems.

2603.19258.tldr: MAPLE leverages differentially private tabular metadata extraction and in-context learning to effectively ground the initial synthetic distribution in the target domain, and achieves a significantly more favorable privacy-utility trade-off.

2603.19253.tldr: This work contributes the first comprehensive evaluation that combines quantitative benchmarking and qualitative error analysis on multiple argument mining datasets using advanced LLM prompting strategies, including Chain-of- Thought prompting, prompt rephrasing, voting, and certainty-based classification.

2603.01038.tldr: This work proposes the Tool-Augmented Reasoning FAS (TAR-FAS) framework, which reformulates the FAS task as a Chain-of-Thought with Visual Tools (CoT-VT) paradigm, allowing MLLMs to begin with intuitive observations and adaptively invoke external visual tools for fine-grained investigation.

2603.01211.tldr: This work conceptualizes cultural intelligence as a suite of core capabilities spanning diverse domains, which is operationalized through a set of indicators designed for reliable measurement, and introduces a broad-purpose, systematic, and extensible framework for assessing cultural intelligence of AI systems.

2603.00523.tldr: This work constructs an ensemble of attribution graphs by pruning a single raw attribution run under multiple configurations, assigns each edge a stability score, and extracts a strict-consensus circuit consisting only of edges that appear in all views, which produces a threshold-robust"core"circuit.

2603.19247.tldr: This work repurposes black-box prompt optimization techniques, originally designed to improve performance on benign tasks, to systematically search for safety failures, suggesting that static benchmarks may underestimate residual risk and indicating that automated, adaptive red-teaming is a necessary component of robust safety evaluation.

2603.19252.tldr: GeoChallenge is introduced, a dataset of 90K automatically generated multiple-choice geometry proof problems, each requiring multi-step reasoning over aligned textual descriptions and diagrams, each requiring multi-step reasoning over aligned textual descriptions and diagrams.

2603.19236.tldr: The proposed approach systematically enhances PRISMA guidelines, providing a responsible pathway for incorporating GenAI into systematic review workflows and ensuring scientific validity and transparency, while the deterministic nature of the statistical layer enhances reproducibility.

2603.15727.tldr: ClawWorm is presented, the first self-replicating worm attack against a production-scale agent framework, achieving a fully autonomous infection cycle initiated by a single message, demonstrating high success rates in end-to-end infection, sustained multi-hop propagation, and payload independence from the worm mechanism.

2602.23148.tldr: The results show that learning explicit transition models yields higher out-of-distribution satisficing-plan success than direct action-sequence prediction in multiple domains, while achieving these gains with significantly fewer training instances and smaller models.

2603.19260.tldr: Experimental results show that HATL consistently outperforms traditional transfer learning approaches across tasks and models, with ADAT achieving BLEU-4 improvements of 15.0% on PHOENIX14T and Isharah and 37.6% on MedASL.

2603.19255.tldr: LARFT (Length-Aware Reinforcement Fine-Tuning), a training framework that aligns the model's length cognition with its action and jointly optimizes the model's internal representation of length information and refines its policy to satisfy length constraints, thereby achieving precise and reliable length instruction following.

2603.19248.tldr: This work proposes DuCCAE (Conversation while Collaboration with Augmentation and Evolution with Augmentation and Evolution), a hybrid engine for immersive conversation deployed within Baidu Search, offering practical guidelines for deploying scalable agentic systems in industrial settings.

2603.16513.tldr: FEAT introduces a multi-layer dual-axis architecture that replaces quadratic attention with hybrid linear encoding and adopts a hybrid structural causal model pipeline and a stable reconstruction objective, enabling linear-complexity cross-sample modeling while preserving expressive representations.

2603.15709.tldr: This survey reviews uncertainty-aware multi-criteria decision-making and organizes the field into a concise, task-oriented taxonomy and concludes with open directions on explainable uncertainty integration, stability, and scalability in large-scale and dynamic decision environments.

2603.04803.tldr: The Diffusion Contrastive Reconstruction (DCR) is introduced, which unifies the learning objective and shows that the DCR loss can jointly optimize D-Ability and P-Ability.

2603.19415.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage routing architecture that addresses limitations through automated fine-grained task discovery and task-aware quality estimation, and consistently outperforms existing baselines and surpasses the strongest individual model while incurring less than half its cost.

2603.19321.tldr: This paper introduces PROMPTATTRIB, a comprehensive solution that tackles EM through attribute-level prompt tuning and logical reasoning, and uses both entity-level and attribute-level prompts to incorporate richer contextual information and employs fuzzy logic formulas to infer the final matching label.

2603.19317.tldr: This work provides a rigorous mathematical framework for understanding neural network generalization and inaugurates the new interdisciplinary direction of Computational $\Gamma$-Algebra.

2603.19310.tldr: MemReward, a graph-based experience memory framework: an initial LLM policy generates rollouts for each query, each comprising a thinking process and a final answer, and these rollouts are stored as experience memory, surpassing Oracle on out-of-domain tasks.

2603.19307.tldr: KD-Brain is proposed, a Prior-Informed Graph Learning framework for explicitly encoding prior knowledge to guide the learning process, which design a Semantic-Conditioned Interaction mechanism that injects semantic priors into the attention query, explicitly navigating the subnetwork interactions based on their functional identities.

2603.19291.tldr: By graphically representing the distribution of errors and their correlations, this approach provides a more detailed and comprehensive view of model performance, enabling users to uncover patterns that traditional aggregate metrics may obscure.

2603.19288.tldr: A joint return and risk modeling framework based on deep neural networks that enables end-to-end learning of dynamic expected returns and risk structures from sequential financial data is proposed, demonstrating that jointly modeling return and covariance dynamics can provide consistent improvements over traditional allocation approaches.

2603.19286.tldr: An approach that integrates LLMs with daily financial news for stock price prediction by utilizing stock name embeddings within attention mechanisms to address the challenge of processing news data and identifying relevant content.

2603.19280.tldr: The purpose of this paper is to highlight the differences in the feature-based and generative AI applications in constructed response scoring systems and propose a set of best practices for the collection of validity evidence to support the use and interpretation of constructed response scores from scoring systems using generative AI.

2603.19274.tldr: The Clinical Understanding and Retrieval Evaluation (CURE) benchmark, comprising $500$ multimodal clinical cases mapped to physician-cited reference literature, is introduced and evaluates reasoning and retrieval under controlled evidence settings to disentangle their respective contributions.

2603.19266.tldr: This work introduces a novel distillation framework that moves beyond simple mimicry to instill a deeper conceptual understanding and uses a reinforcement learning algorithm with a novel Dialogue Structure Utility Bonus to improve generalization.

2603.19281.tldr: URAG is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark designed to assess the uncertainty of RAG systems across various fields like healthcare, programming, science, math, and general text by reformulating open-ended generation tasks into multiple-choice question answering, which allows for principled uncertainty quantification via conformal prediction.

2603.19292.tldr: This paper focuses on verbal aspects of collaboration and conducts a review of collaboration analysis using task-oriented conversation resources, encompassing related theories, coding schemes, tasks, and modeling approaches.

2603.19290.tldr: Inspired by the localized receptive fields (LRF) and membrane-potential dynamics of biological visual neurons, LRF-Dyn is proposed, which uses spiking neurons with localized receptive fields to compute attention while reducing memory requirements and establishing it as a key unit for achieving energy-efficient Spiking Transformers.

2603.19289.tldr: This work proposes an expert prefetching scheme that leverages currently computed internal model representations to speculate future experts, enabling memory transfers to overlap with computation, and examines lightweight estimators that improve expert prediction hit rates, thereby reducing performance degradation.

2603.19312.tldr: LeWorldModel is introduced, the first JEPA that trains stably end-to-end from raw pixels using only two loss terms: a next-embedding prediction loss and a regularizer enforcing Gaussian-distributed latent embeddings.

2603.19426.tldr: It is found that standard probe-based methodologies do not reliably disentangle evaluation context from structural artifacts, limiting the evidential strength of existing results.

2603.19335.tldr: OXRL is presented, a unified framework implementing 51 post-training algorithms with identical infrastructure, enabling the first large-scale apples-to-apples evaluation, and yields a hierarchy of leverage for practitioners.

2603.19333.tldr: POET (Power-Oriented Evolutionary Tuning) introduces a differential-testing-based testbench generation pipeline that treats the original design as a functional oracle, using deterministic simulation to produce golden references and eliminating LLM hallucination from the verification process.

2603.19329.tldr: A hierarchical proof search framework for automated code verification in Lean~4 that decomposes complex verification goals into structurally simpler subgoals before attempting tactic-level proving, with a principled decomposition score that combines constructive justification with structural effectiveness.

2603.19305.tldr: PhyGile performs physics-prefix-guided robot-native motion generation at inference time, directly generating robot-native motions in a 262-dimensional skeletal space with physics-guided prefixes, thereby eliminating inference-time retargeting artifacts and reducing generation-execution discrepancies.

2603.19278.tldr: This work investigates the calibration dynamics of LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation and a novel hyper-network-based adaptation framework as parameter-efficient alternatives to full fine-tuning for RoBERTa, and clarify the relationship between parameter efficiency and probabilistic reliability.

2603.19273.tldr: This work introduces LSR (Linguistic Safety Robustness), the first systematic benchmark for measuring cross-lingual refusal degradation in West African languages: Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, and Igala, and introduces Refusal Centroid Drift (RCD), a metric that quantifies how much of a model's English refusal behavior is lost when harmful intent is encoded in a target language.

2603.19272.tldr: This work gives a formal derivation showing that a causal Transformer layer is exactly a stateless Differentiable Neural Computer (sDNC) where the controller has no recurrent internal state, the external memory is a write-once matrix of value vectors, and multi-head attention corresponds to multiple parallel read heads.

2603.19271.tldr: This paper conceptualizes LLMs as universal text processing machines and presents a comprehensive workflow for employing LLMs in three qualitative and quantitative content analysis tasks: annotation, labeling and text classification, summarization, and information extraction.

2603.19451.tldr: Location-aware Fine-grained representation learning (LoFi) is proposed, which jointly optimizes sigmoid, captioning, and location-aware captioning losses using a lightweight large language model and integrates a fine-grained encoder into retrieval-based in-context learning to enhance chest X-ray grounding across diverse settings.

2603.19423.tldr: These findings demonstrate that current defense paradigms optimize for single-turn refusal benchmarks while rendering multi-step agents fundamentally unreliable, necessitating new approaches that preserve tool execution competence under adversarial conditions.

2603.19350.tldr: The evaluation results show that integrating SA and JS divergence into WGAN-GP yields superior IDS performance and more effective zero-day risk detection, thereby enhancing the data generation ability of WGAN-GP.

2603.19337.tldr: SemanticFL, a novel framework that leverages the rich semantic representations of pre-trained diffusion models to provide privacy-preserving guidance for local training, is introduced, validating its effectiveness in learning robust representations for heterogeneous and multimodal data for perception tasks.

2603.19313.tldr: The Memory-Driven Role-Playing paradigm, Inspired by Stanislavski's"emotional memory"acting theory, frames persona knowledge as the LLM's internal memory store, requiring retrieval and application based solely on dialogue context, thereby providing a rigorous test of depth and autonomous use of knowledge.

2603.19308.tldr: GT-Space constructs a common feature space from ground-truth labels, providing a unified reference for feature alignment, and designs a fusion network trained with contrastive losses across diverse modality combinations.

2603.19303.tldr: While LLMs show potential for basic STROBE screening, their lower agreement with human experts on complex methodological items likely reflects a reliance on surface-level information.

2603.19268.tldr: This work proposes the first full-stack domain-enhanced LLM workflow tailored for the field of combustion science, which integrates automated domain corpus construction, incremental pre-training, instruction fine-tuning, and verifiable reward-based reinforcement learning to ensure that the model truly internalizes physical laws rather than merely learning textual statistical patterns.

2603.19416.tldr: In-context, experiential learning is investigated by examining how interactions with privacy tools during chatbot use enhance users' privacy learning and interface design features that supported or hindered user-led protection of sensitive information.

2603.19330.tldr: PAI is the first technique to accurately predict full benchmark performance without relying on detailed simulation or instruction-wise encoding, and can achieve an average IPC prediction error that is comparable to prior state-of-the-art techniques while requiring 3 orders of magnitude less time.

2603.19322.tldr: This paper proposes a general DL framework by introducing the support set to represent the discrete variables and model the elements of the support set as random variables and learn their joint probability distribution by factorizing the joint probability as the product of conditional probabilities.

2603.19429.tldr: This work explores a middle ground between fully lifted and fully grounded planning by introducing three SAT encodings that keep actions lifted while partially grounding predicates, and its best encoding outperforms the state of the art in length-optimal planning on hard-to-ground domains.

2603.19339.tldr: Spectral Tempering is proposed, a learning-free method that derives an adaptive $\gamma(k)$ directly from the corpus eigenspectrum using local SNR analysis and knee-point normalization, requiring no labeled data or validation-based search.

2603.19325.tldr: TaCT, an interpretable concept-gated fine-tuning framework that solves the issue by selective model improvement: models are adapted specifically for failure cases while preserving performance in common scenarios while preserving performance in common scenarios is proposed.

2603.19306.tldr: A Hybrid Jurisprudential Memory (HJM) grounded in the Micro-Directive Paradigm, which stores precedent standards and continually distills validated multi-agent verification trajectories into updated Micro-Directives for continual learning across cases is introduced.

2603.19302.tldr: STEU is introduced, a parameter-efficient method for behavioral class-level unlearning that updates only PMI-selected token embeddings together with a small classifier head while keeping all encoder layers frozen and suggests that targeted behavioral unlearning can be achieved through sparse embedding edits without modifying deeper encoder representations.

2603.19294.tldr: Mutual Information Preference Optimization (MIPO) is proposed, a contrastive data augmentation method that constructs preference pairs by generating a positive response conditioning on the correct prompt, and a negative response by conditioning on a random, unrelated prompt, between prompts and model responses.

2603.19293.tldr: Experiments show LLM-MRD significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and demonstrates a comprehensive average improvement of 5.19\% in ACC and 6.33\% in F1-Fake when evaluated across all competing methods and datasets.

2603.19276.tldr: A Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) framework that organizes reference materials into a structured knowledge graph to explicitly model dependencies between concepts, confirming the superiority of structural retrieval in verifying the logical reasoning chains required for higher-order academic assessment.

2603.19275.tldr: The experimental results show that the mid-trained model, GatorTronT5-Radio, achieved the best performance, outperforming models without mid-training in both text-based measures (ROUGE-L) and factuality measures (RadGraph-F1).

2603.19284.tldr: This work proposes Category Driven Automatic Algorithm Design with Large Language Models (CDEoH), which explicitly models algorithm categories and jointly balances performance and category diversity in population management, enabling parallel exploration across multiple algorithmic paradigms.

2603.19757.tldr: This work proposes UPL (Uncertainty-aware Prototype Learning), a probabilistic approach designed to incorporate uncertainty modeling into prototype learning for few-shot 3D segmentation and achieves consistent state-of-the-art performance under different settings while providing reliable uncertainty estimation.

2603.19739.tldr: This work presents MOSS-TTSD, a spoken dialogue synthesis model designed for expressive, multi-party conversational speech across multiple languages, and proposes TTSD-eval, an objective evaluation framework based on forced alignment that measures speaker attribution accuracy and speaker similarity without relying on speaker diarization tools.

2603.19677.tldr: GoAgent (Group-of-Agents), a communication topology generation method that explicitly treats collaborative groups as the atomic units of MAS construction, and introduces a conditional information bottleneck (CIB) objective that compresses inter-group communication, preserving task-relevant signals while filtering out redundant historical noise.

2603.19649.tldr: PolicySim is proposed, an LLM-based social simulation sandbox for the proactive assessment and optimization of intervention policies and can accurately simulate platform ecosystems at both micro and macro levels and support effective intervention policy.

2603.19643.tldr: OmniDiT, an omni Virtual Try-On framework based on the Diffusion Transformer, is proposed, which combines try-on and try-off tasks into one unified model and is the first to introduce Shifted Window Attention into the diffusion model, thus achieving a linear complexity.

2603.19628.tldr: A dual prompt-driven feature encoding method that integrates prompt-conditioned feature adaptation and context-aware prompt evolution to promote domain-invariant feature encoding is proposed, and the pyramid illumination prompter is proposed to extract multi-scale frequency-aware illumination prompts.

2603.19584.tldr: PowerLens is a system that tames the reasoning power of Large Language Models (LLMs) for safe and personalized mobile power management on Android devices, enabling zero-shot, context-aware policy generation that adapts to individual preferences through implicit feedback.

2603.19559.tldr: In the high-resolution regime K X, K Y → ∞ , a sharp K − 2 asymptotic expansion is derived for E, which is used to identify the exact optimal leading constants, and characterize asymptotically optimal quantization center densities in terms of conditional second moments.

2603.19516.tldr: This work introduces Gastric-X, a large-scale multimodal benchmark for gastric cancer analysis providing 1.7K cases and aims to probe the nature of VLM understanding: Can current VLMs meaningfully correlate biochemical signals with spatial tumor features and textual reports?

2603.19469.tldr: This work reformalizes existing attacks, such as indirect prompt injection, direct prompt injection, jailbreak, task drift, and memory poisoning, as violations of one or more security properties, thereby providing precise and contextual definitions of these attacks.

2603.19676.tldr: This work introduces ATHENA, a model-agnostic, test-time adaptive steering framework that improves object count fidelity without modifying model architectures or requiring retraining, and presents three progressively more advanced variants of ATHENA that trade additional computation for improved numerical accuracy.

2603.19782.tldr: This work argues for embodied science, a paradigm that reframes scientific discovery as a closed loop tightly coupling agentic reasoning with physical execution, and proposes a unified Perception-Language-Action-Discovery (PLAD) framework.

2603.19722.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Federated method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods for FL with data heterogeneity under diverse noisy clients scenarios.

2603.19685.tldr: The findings demonstrate that combining explicit inference-time planning with milestone-based rewards significantly improves an agent's long-horizon capabilities, paving the way for more robust and general-purpose autonomous systems.

2603.19639.tldr: Comprehensive experiments show that HyEvo consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse reasoning and coding benchmarks, while reducing inference cost and execution latency by up to 19$\times$ and 16$\times$ respectively, compared to the state-of-the-art open-source baseline.

2603.19634.tldr: Preliminary findings regarding participants'search behavior show that MetaCues leads to increased confidence in attitudinal judgments about the search topic as well as broader inquiry, with the latter effect emerging primarily for the topic that was less controversial and with which participants had relatively less familiarity.

2603.19579.tldr: The proposed Pareto Ascent Directional Decomposition based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (PA2D-MORL) method is proposed, which constructs an efficient scheme for multi-objective problem decomposition and policy improvement, leading to a superior approximation of Pareto policy set.

2603.19531.tldr: This work designs a task-specific architecture tailored to this backbone of OVSS, systematically adapting established design principles from prior open-vocabulary segmentation work, and proposes a high-resolution local-global inference strategy based on sliding-window aggregation, which preserves spatial detail while maintaining global context.

2603.19515.tldr: The findings reveal that LLMs struggle to maintain high and consistent performance when concurrently handling multiple cognitive dimensions, and ItinBench provides new insights into building more comprehensive reasoning testbeds that better reflect real-world challenges.

2603.19710.tldr: This work proposes AIGQ (AI-Generated Query architecture), the first end-to-end generative framework for HintQ scenario, and designs Interest-aware List Group Relative Policy Optimization (IL-GRPO), a novel policy gradient algorithm with a dual-component reward mechanism that jointly optimizes individual query relevance and global list properties.

2603.19608.tldr: FB-CLIP is proposed, a framework that enhances anomaly localization via multi-strategy textual representations and foreground-background separation, achieving accurate fine-grained anomaly detection and localization under zero-shot settings.

2603.19594.tldr: ARMOR, a novel CFL-based framework that monitors and safeguards the GM during continual updates, introduces a novel state-space model (SSM) that learns the historical evolution of GM weight tensors and predicts the expected next state of weight tensors of the GM.

2603.19582.tldr: A graph-structured policies provide a more effective interface between evolving morphologies and control for embodied intelligence, indicating that graph-structured policies provide a more effective interface between evolving morphologies and control for embodied intelligence.

2603.19563.tldr: This work builds a hybrid supernet that integrates Vision State Space and Vision Transformer modules, and optimize it with a Cross-Architecture Dual-Domain Knowledge Distillation (CA-DDKD) strategy, which improves the representational capacity of the shared supernet and enhances ranking consistency, enabling reliable fitness estimation during evolution without extra fine-tuning.

2603.19500.tldr: The results indicate that incorporating structured part-level data and providing agent with the visual feedback through the process enables interpretable, controllable, and locally editable text-to-vector sketch generation.

2603.19474.tldr: A novel diffusion model for trajectory recovery named TRACE, which reconstruct dense and continuous trajectories from sparse and incomplete inputs, and strengthens the foundation for mobile and web-connected location services, advancing the quality and fairness of data-driven urban applications.

2603.19465.tldr: A fixed-point iteration of v arising in the optimization of a regularized nuclear norm objective involving the Hadamard product structure is analyzed, and it is proved that the iteration converges monotonically to the unique global optimizer of the potential function.

2603.19461.tldr: DGM-Hyperagents offer a glimpse of open-ended AI systems that do not merely search for better solutions, but continually improve their search for how to improve, to potentially support self-accelerating progress on any computable task.

2603.19664.tldr: KV-Direct, a bounded-memory inference scheme that checkpoints residual vectors (5 KB per token on Gemma 3-4B) instead of full KV pairs instead of full KV pairs, recomputing keys and values on demand, shows recomputation runs up to 5x faster than reading cached tensors at moderate batch sizes.

2603.19621.tldr: By imposing policy regularizations, grounded in classical inventory concepts such as "Base Stock", it is shown that by imposing policy regularizations, this paper can significantly accelerate hyperparameter tuning and improve the final performance of several DRL methods.

2603.19609.tldr: A new synthetic data generation pipeline is developed that produces InsLoD-Loc - the largest instance segmentation dataset for aerial imagery to date, comprising 100k images with precise instance building annotations, which significantly reduces pose estimation ambiguity in dense scenes.

2603.19583.tldr: This work introduces a skills-based agentic framework for HIL embedded development together with IoT-SkillsBench, a benchmark designed to systematically evaluate AI agents in real embedded programming environments and shows that concise human-expert skills with structured expert knowledge enable near-perfect success rates across platforms.

2603.19470.tldr: Experiments on single-turn math and multi-turn tool-integrated reasoning tasks show that ALP not only improves final performance, but also avoids blow up of importance ratio tail and KL spikes during iterative training, along with boosted exploration.

2603.19527.tldr: Clinicians should be aware that AI-generated mental health video content reflects training data and platform design rather than clinical knowledge, and that patients may encounter such content during vulnerable periods.

2603.19512.tldr: FedAgain is introduced, a trust-based Federated Learning (Federated Learning) strategy designed to enhance robustness and generalization for automated kidney stone identification from endoscopic images by maintaining diagnostic accuracy and performance stability under varying conditions.

2603.19504.tldr: The first study of how scientific practitioners use AI for embodied physical tasks is conducted, and findings point toward AI as background infrastructure to support physical work rather than replacing human expertise.

2603.19715.tldr: A neuro-symbolic proof generation framework designed to automate proof search for systems-level verification projects, substantially surpassing previous LLM-based approaches and standalone Sledgehammer, while solving significantly more multi-step proofs.

2603.19667.tldr: A novel Joint-Modal Visual Reconstruction (JMVR) framework that treats EEG and text as independent modalities for joint learning to preserve EEG-specific information for reconstruction and employs a multi-scale EEG encoding strategy to capture both fine- and coarse-grained features.

2603.19615.tldr: CAF-Score is proposed, a reference-free metric that calibrates CLAP's coarse-grained semantic alignment with the fine-grained comprehension and syntactic awareness of LALMs by combining contrastive audio-text embeddings with LALM reasoning, which effectively detects syntactic inconsistencies and subtle hallucinations.

2603.19599.tldr: This work proposes a physics-informed neural network with adaptive clustering learning mechanism, PIACN, that not only models the macroscopic patterns of information dissemination through physics-informed approach for the first time but also considers the influence of information heterogeneity through an adaptive clustering learning mechanism.

2603.19591.tldr: FuXi-ONS is introduced, the first machine-learning ensemble forecasting system for the global ocean, providing 5-day forecasts on a global 1{\deg} grid up to 365 days for sea-surface temperature, sea-surface height, subsurface temperature, salinity and ocean currents.

2603.19574.tldr: How delusion-related language evolves during multi-turn interactions with conversational AI is examined to provide empirical evidence that conversational AI interactions can amplify delusion-related language over extended use and highlight the importance of state-aware safety mechanisms for mitigating such risks.

2603.19565.tldr: An Event Prompter that directly applies extremely lightweight and efficient Discrete Cosine Transform and Inverse DCT operations to the event data, thereby effectively augmenting the RGB branch and fuses the RGB and event modalities.

2603.19546.tldr: Uncertainty-driven Kernel Tensor Learning (UKTL), a novel kernel framework for M$-mode tensors that compares mode-wise subspaces derived from tensor unfoldings, is introduced, enabling expressive and robust similarity measure.

2603.19519.tldr: A novel, easy-to-implement decoding scheme is developed that induces sustained creativity and diversity in large language models, producing as many conceptually unique results as desired, even without access to the inner workings of an LLM's vector space.

2603.19514.tldr: A symbolic mutation strategy is introduced that synthesizes diverse training data by systematically extracting theorems and discarding selected hypotheses, thereby producing diverse counterexample instances and enables a multi-reward expert iteration framework that substantially enhances both the effectiveness and efficiency of training LLMs for counterexample generation and theorem proving.

2603.19452.tldr: TrustFlow is introduced, a reputation propagation algorithm that assigns each software agent a multi-dimensional reputation vector rather than a scalar score, and produces vector reputation that is directly queryable by dot product in the same embedding space as user queries.

2603.19510.tldr: It is proved that two pairwise comparisons per voter, or alternatively a single graded comparison, identify the second moment and enable principled solutions to a range of social choice objectives including inequality-aware welfare criteria such as taking into account the spread of voter utilities and choosing a representative subset.

2603.20028.tldr: A retrospective longitudinal field study of Chiron, an industrial platform that coordinates humans and AI agents across four delivery stages: analysis, planning, implementation, and validation, supports a central thesis: the largest gains appear when AI is embedded in an orchestrated workflow rather than deployed as an isolated coding assistant.

2603.20007.tldr: This work derives closed-form long-range Hamiltonian matrix elements in a nonorthogonal atomic-orbital basis through variational decomposition of the electrostatic energy, deriving a variationally consistent mapping from the electron density matrix to effective atomic charges.

2603.19921.tldr: This work investigates different implementations of span-level precision, recall, and F-score, showing that seemingly similar approaches can yield substantially different rankings, and that certain widely-used techniques are unsuitable for evaluating MT error detection.

2603.19897.tldr: This work proposes Domland, a two-pronged methodology that synergizes the spatial information obtained from FLA and domain-driven analysis to systematically capture the hidden characteristics of configuration tuning cases, explaining how and why a tuner might succeed or fail.

2603.19852.tldr: This work proposes a framework to identify and measure the underlying failure modes by disentangling two effects: Memorization of input features and overfitting to known map geometries, and proposes measures based on evaluation subsets that control for geographical proximity and geometric similarity between training and validation scenes.

2603.20170.tldr: A structured cognitive trajectory model that represents mental state as a dynamic belief graph, jointly inferring latent beliefs, learning their time-varying dependencies, and linking belief evolution to information seeking and decisions is introduced, providing a principled module for augmenting LLMs with ToM in high-uncertainty environment.
