2603.08221.tldr: SplitAgent is presented, a novel distributed architecture that enables privacy-preserving collaboration between enterprise-side privacy agents and cloud-side reasoning agents and extends existing agent protocols with differential privacy guarantees, zero-knowledge tool verification, and privacy budget management.

2603.08230.tldr: This work reformulates ambiguous emotion recognition as a distributional reasoning problem and presents the first systematic study of ambiguity-aware reasoning in LALMs, comprising two complementary components: an ambiguity-aware objective that aligns predictions with human perceptual distributions, and a structured ambiguity-aware chain-of-thought supervision that guides reasoning over emotional cues.

2603.08234.tldr: This work focuses on a continuation-triggered jailbreak phenomenon, whereby simply relocating a continuation-triggered instruction suffix can substantially increase jailbreak success rates, and conducts a comprehensive mechanistic interpretability analysis at the level of attention heads.

2603.08235.tldr: This study explores state-of-the-art deep learning methods and UWF imaging on three clinically relevant tasks, underscoring the competitiveness of emerging ViTs and foundation models and the promise of feature-level fusion and frequency-domain representations for UWF analysis.

2603.08239.tldr: The Aggregational Policy Censoring Objective is derived, the first exact unconstrained reformulation of sample-based TV-TRPO, establishing that clipping-based surrogate design and trust-region optimization are dual formulations of the same problem.

2603.08262.tldr: FinToolBench is introduced, the first real-world, runnable benchmark dedicated to evaluating financial tool learning agents, and FATR is presented, a finance-aware tool retrieval and reasoning baseline that enhances stability and compliance.

2603.08267.tldr: A large-scale study of bias in five financial language models, examining similarities in their bias tendencies across protected attributes and exploring cross-model-guided bias detection to identify bias-revealing inputs earlier, enabling substantial reuse and cost reduction in bias detection.

2603.08269.tldr: SAIL is a framework that reframes robot imitation as an iterative refinement problem capable of scaling with test-time compute, and utilizes Monte Carlo Tree Search, where each node is a complete trajectory and edges correspond to trajectory refinements.

2603.08270.tldr: The Spurious Correlation Learning Graph Neural Network (SCL-GNN) is proposed, a novel framework designed to enhance generalization on both Independent and Identically Distributed (IID) and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) graphs, and incorporates a principled spurious correlation learning mechanism.

2603.08274.tldr: RIKER, a ground-truth-first evaluation methodology that enables deterministic scoring without human annotation, reveals that models that excel at finding facts may still fabricate facts that do not exist and confirms that deployment decisions need not be hardware-dependent.

2603.08275.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that integrates authoritative cultural knowledge descriptions curation, LLM-automated query generation, and heavy manual verification and presents a knowledge-grounded method, which significantly enhances cultural safety by enforcing the integration of knowledge into the LLM response generation process.

2603.08278.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that TA-RNN-Medical-Hybrid consistently improves predictive performance in terms of AUC, accuracy, and recall-oriented F$_2$-score, and qualitative analysis shows that the model effectively decomposes mortality risk across time and clinical concepts.

2603.08288.tldr: BladeChain is the first system to integrate multi-stakeholder endorsement, automated inspection scheduling, AI model provenance, and cryptographic evidence binding, delivering auditable maintenance traceability for aerospace deployments.

2603.08290.tldr: The theoretical analysis attributes this phenomenon to Sharpness-Aware Minimization's gradient normalization factor applied in its perturbation, which amplifies minor coordinates early and allows major ones to dominate later, giving a concrete example where infinite-time implicit-bias analyses are insufficient.

2603.08305.tldr: Experiments on the CT-RATE dataset show that retrieval-augmented generation improves image fidelity and clinical consistency compared to text-only baselines, while additionally enabling explicit spatial controllability, a capability inherently absent in such approaches.

2603.08317.tldr: A large-scale human-AI comparative study of egocentric action recognition using Minimal Identifiable Recognition Crops (MIRCs), defined as the smallest spatial or spatiotemporal regions sufficient for reliable human recognition, shows that human performance exhibits sharp declines when transitioning from MIRCs to subMIRCs.

2603.08321.tldr: This work proposes CORE-Acu, a neuro-symbolic framework for acupuncture clinical decision support that integrates Structured Chain-of-Thought (S-CoT) with knowledge graph (KG) safety verification and establishes CORE-Acu as a robust neuro-symbolic framework for acupuncture clinical decision support, guaranteeing both reasoning auditability and strict safety compliance.

2603.08322.tldr: The experiments show that neurosymbolic systems can indeed produce genuine discoveries in pure mathematics, and reveal that multi-model deliberation among frontier LLMs proved reliable for criticism and error detection but unreliable for constructive claims.

2603.08324.tldr: A novel EndoSERV localization method for long-range and complex luminal structures that divides them into smaller sub-segments and estimates the odometry independently, and an efficient transfer technique maps real image features to the virtual domain to use virtual pose ground truth.

2603.08329.tldr: This work introduces SPD-RAG, a hierarchical multi-agent framework for exhaustive cross-document question answering that decomposes the problem along the document axis and improves scalability and answer quality in heterogeneous multidocument settings while yielding a modular, extensible retrieval pipeline.

2603.08332.tldr: The proposed DS-DGA-GCN achieves robust detection since it focuses on the joint relationships among products, reviews, and reviewers by modeling product-review-reviewer networks and achieves adaptive detection by integrating a Network Feature Scoring system and a new dynamic graph attention mechanism.

2603.08339.tldr: The findings demonstrate the effectiveness of Koopman-based feature learning with transformers and highlight promising directions for integrating dynamical systems theory into time-series classification.

2603.08349.tldr: This work shows that the proposed method consistently generates counterfactual explanations for time series classifiers that are not only valid but also highly plausible and consistent with temporal patterns.

2603.08369.tldr: The proposed M3-ACE, a multi-agentic context engineering framework designed to rectify visual perception in multimodal math reasoning, decouples perception and reasoning by dynamically maintaining a shared context centered on visual evidence lists, which substantially improves visual mathematical reasoning performance across multiple benchmarks.

2603.08398.tldr: This work proposes Token-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (ToCoRL), a principled framework that leverages RL to internalize this chameleon-like plasticity, transforming transient inference-time adaptations into stable and learnable behavioral patterns.

2603.08399.tldr: This work analyzes the source of instability in non-linear value decomposition within the offline MARL setting and proposes a simple technique, scale-invariant value normalization (SVN), that stabilizes actor-critic training without altering the Bellman fixed point.

2603.08412.tldr: The signal entering RLHF is shaped by elicitation context in ways that neither human metacognition, LLM self-monitoring, nor standard evaluation metrics can detect, revealing a preference construction problem.

2603.08413.tldr: Geometrically Constrained Outlier Synthesis (GCOS), a training-time regularization framework aimed at improving OOD robustness during inference, naturally transitions to conformal OOD inference, which translates uncertainty scores into statistically valid p-values and enables thresholds with formal error guarantees, providing a pathway toward more predictable and reliable OOD detection.

2603.08424.tldr: This work proposes SYNAPSE, a systematic, training-free framework for understanding and stress-testing the internal behavior of Transformer models across domains, and reveals a consistent, domain-independent organization of internal representations, in which task-relevant information is encoded in broad, overlapping neuron subsets.

2603.08425.tldr: The platform's architectural decomposition, subsystem design, experimental performance, safety boundaries, and comparative engineering advantages are analyzed, and the resulting study positions IronEngine as a system-oriented foundation for general-purpose personal assistants, automation frameworks, and future human-centered agent platforms.

2603.08429.tldr: This work proposes equipping LLM agents with native retrieval capability by adding a lightweight projection head that maps hidden states directly into the embedding space, eliminating the need for a separate embedding model.

2603.08453.tldr: This design transforms cache retrieval from a linear scan into a theoretically bounded, logarithmic-time pruning process, while a lazy update strategy supports efficient streaming generation and preserves local semantic coherence via boundary-aware chunking.

2603.08455.tldr: The results reframe $\varepsilon^*$ from an emergent world model property to a three-way interaction between noise floor, detector, and environment dynamics, providing a more defensible and empirically grounded account of self-monitoring boundaries in RL agents.

2603.08475.tldr: This work repurposes ray frontiers (R2F), a recently proposed frontier-based exploration paradigm, to develop an LLM-free framework for indoor open-vocabulary object navigation, and introduces R2F-VLN, a lightweight extension for free-form language instructions using syntactic parsing and relational verification without additional VLM or LLM components.

2603.08486.tldr: This work extends the self-fulfilling mechanism from text to visual modalities, offering a label-free approach to VLMs alignment, and demonstrates that VSFA reduces the attack success rate, improves response quality, and mitigates over-refusal while preserving general capabilities.

2603.08494.tldr: This work proposes an operator-theoretic formulation in which computational or feasibility limitations are encoded by self-adjoint operators defining locally reachable subspaces, and demonstrates that effective dynamics concentrate along dominant spectral modes, yielding a principled notion of spectral compression.

2603.08505.tldr: Echo2ECG is proposed, a multimodal self-supervised learning framework that enriches ECG representations with the heart's morphological structure captured in multi-view Echos, and is evaluated as an ECG feature extractor on two clinically relevant tasks that fundamentally require morphological information.

2603.08506.tldr: This work proposes Oracle-Guided Soft Shielding (OGSS), a simple yet effective framework for safer decision-making, enabling safe exploration by learning a probabilistic safety model from oracle feedback in an imitation learning setting.

2603.08514.tldr: A novel matching-free training scheme for DETR-based detectors that eliminates the need for explicit heuristic matching, effectively eliminating the discrete matching bottleneck through differentiable correspondence learning, and also achieving superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art methods.

2603.08526.tldr: This work formalizes the exploitation of local and global graph information as the ``local representation, global alignment''paradigm, and presents a new ``global representation and alignment''paradigm to resolve the mismatch between the two phases in the alignment process.

2603.08572.tldr: MetaWorld-X is proposed, a hierarchical world model framework for humanoid control that decomposes complex control problems into a set of specialized expert policies (Specialized Expert Policies, SEP), and an Intelligent Routing Mechanism (IRM) supervised by a Vision-Language Model (VLM), enabling semantic-driven expert composition.

2603.08588.tldr: This work proposes two novel streaming deep RL algorithms, Streaming Soft Actor-Critic (S2AC) and Streaming Deterministic Actor-Critic (SDAC), explicitly designed to be compatible with state-of-the-art batch RL methods, making them particularly suitable for on-device finetuning applications such as Sim2Real transfer.

2603.08639.tldr: UNBOX, a framework for class-wise model dissection under fully data-free, gradient-free, and backpropagation-free constraints, demonstrates that meaningful insight into a model's internal reasoning can be recovered without any internal access, enabling more trustworthy and accountable visual recognition systems.

2603.08652.tldr: This work proposes CoCo (Code-as-CoT), a code-driven reasoning framework that represents the reasoning process as executable code, enabling explicit and verifiable intermediate planning for image generation and demonstrates that executable code is an effective and reliable reasoning paradigm for precise, controllable, and structured text-to-image generation.

2603.08655.tldr: It is found that providing agents with a structured document representation produced by Databricks'ai_parse_document yields a 16.1% average relative performance gain across agents, and significant headroom remains before agents can be considered reliable at enterprise-grade grounded reasoning.

2603.08679.tldr: AlphaEvolve, an AI-guided evolutionary search framework, is employed to explore the space of value distributions to establish a new lower bound on the worst-case performance of the Random-Offerer mechanism, demonstrating a wider efficiency gap than previously known.

2603.08683.tldr: Tilobyte is proposed, a byte-level tokenization schema for full resolution audio, improving vocabulary scaling from $O(2^{b})$ to $O(1)$ and enabling the first tractable 24-bit LM-based lossless compression.

2603.08687.tldr: This work proves that the problem is NP-hard and proposes the first accuracy-aware heuristic algorithm that explicitly accounts for model accuracy, while remaining delay-efficient, compared to state-of-the-art SFL and HSFL schemes.

2603.08692.tldr: The EcoAI-Resilience framework is introduced, a multi-objective optimization approach designed to maximize the sustainability benefits of AI deployment while minimizing environmental costs and enhancing economic resilience.

2603.08704.tldr: The AFIB is introduced, a multi-dimensional evaluation framework designed to assess financial analysis capabilities across five dimensions: factual accuracy, analytical completeness, data recency, model consistency, and failure patterns, and SuperInvesting achieves the highest aggregate performance.

2603.08706.tldr: The results suggest that ACT is a promising path toward developing more reflective and capable LLM agents, and enables strong out-of-distribution generalization on agentic benchmarks and improves performance on general reasoning benchmarks without any reasoning-specific training data.

2603.08709.tldr: Flexi-UNet, a UNet variant that performs resolution-preserving and resolution-increasing denoising using only the necessary parts of the network, is introduced to support Scale Space Diffusion and is evaluated on CelebA and ImageNet.

2302.08018.tldr: The conducted extensive evaluations show that the proposed method significantly improves the fairness of ML software while maintaining competitive performance, outperforming state-of-the-art solutions in 84.6% of overall cases based on a recent benchmarking tool.

2401.12783.tldr: Deep learning has significantly advanced PPG signal analysis by enabling more effective extraction of physiological information and achieving improved performance and offer greater flexibility in model development.

2403.13681.tldr: It is shown that the legal TLM, Ayn, can indeed outperform LLMs up to 80 times larger on the legal case judgment prediction task, rival LLMs up to 30 times larger on the summarization task, and still be competitive with these larger LLMs on general tasks.

2407.00104.tldr: An AI system for BCC detection from dermoscopic images that integrates dermatologist diagnostic criteria based on specific dermoscopic patterns is proposed, helping bridge the gap between AI performance and clinical trust in teledermatology.

2407.11477.tldr: The TraffiDent dataset includes traffic, i.e., time-series indexes on traffic flow, lane occupancy, and average vehicle speed, and incident, whose records are spatiotemporally aligned with traffic data, with seven different incident classes.

2410.08950.tldr: The Skip Gradient Method is proposed, and it is demonstrated that employing SGM can greatly improve the transferability of crafted attacks in almost all cases and can still be effective under more challenging settings such as ensemble-based attacks, targeted attacks, and against defense equipped models.

2410.21328.tldr: This study proposes an enhanced forecasting approach that incorporates representations of latent confounders derived from historical data that aims to improve the accuracy and robustness of time series forecasts.

2501.18328.tldr: CodeBrain, a unified framework that reformulates various ``any-to-any''imputation tasks as a region-level full-stack code prediction problem, is proposed, establishing a new benchmark for unified brain MRI imputation and enabling virtual full-stack scanning.

2503.22478.tldr: SGD can be regarded as a modified Bayesian sampler which accounts for accessibility constraints induced by the fractal structure of the loss landscape, where the fractal dimension can be accounted for in a purely Bayesian way.

2505.08195.tldr: Aitomia lowers the barrier to performing atomistic simulations, thereby democratizing simulations and accelerating research and development in relevant fields, as well as democratizing simulations and accelerating research and development in relevant fields.

2505.12284.tldr: Three critical reward designs integrated directly into the reinforcement learning process of large reasoning models are proposed, which reduce the response length without extra training stages and significantly decreases response length while maintaining or even improving performance.

2505.14744.tldr: Across three PBE domains, TIIPS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and generates programs that more closely mirror ground-truth trajectories in both syntax and semantics, indicating a better match to the intended program behavior.

2505.16643.tldr: VideoSafety-R1 is proposed, a dual-stage framework achieving unprecedented safety gains through three innovations: the VideoSafetyThinking dataset contains 46k video-query-thinking response triplets, and Alarm Token-Guided Safety Fine-Tuning injects learnable alarm tokens into visual and textual sequences, enabling explicit harm perception across modalities via multitask objectives.

2506.06955.tldr: Results indicate that robustness to belief-inconsistent inputs is driven more by explicit reasoning optimization than by language specialization or scale alone, and shows that even top-tier systems falter when logical validity conflicts with intuitive or factual beliefs.

2507.07685.tldr: This work proposes rationale-enhanced decoding (RED), a novel plug-and-play inference-time decoding strategy that harmonizes visual and rationale information by multiplying distinct image-conditional and rationale-conditional next token distributions.

2507.14172.tldr: SOAR is a method that learns program synthesis by integrating language models into a self-improving evolutionary loop, enabling SOAR to solve 52\% of the public test set on the challenging ARC-AGI benchmark.

2507.15509.tldr: Chart-R1 is introduced, a chart-domain vision-language model that leverages reinforcement fine-tuning for advanced chart reasoning and significantly outperforms existing chart-domain methods and rivals large-scale open/closed-source models.

2507.21071.tldr: The FingerTip 20K benchmark is introduced and the model fine-tuned with the data collected effectively utilized user information and achieved good results, highlighting the potential of the approach in building more user-oriented mobile LLM agents.

2508.13587.tldr: This paper systematically investigates the performance plateau of SFT through large-scale experiments and proposes Multimodal Structured Reinforcement Learning (MSRL) for chart-to-code generation, which outperforms all existing approaches in the chart domain and achieves competitive results with advanced closed-source models.

2509.19270.tldr: This work derives SloPalSpeech, a 2,806-hour aligned speech dataset with segments up to 30 seconds, constructed using a language-agnostic anchor-based alignment pipeline and optimized for Whisper-based ASR training, and publicly releases the SloPal text corpus, SloPalSpeech aligned audio, and four fine-tuned Whisper models.

2509.20396.tldr: This work uses Variational Low-Rank Adaptation (VI LoRA) to estimate epistemic uncertainty in foundation models to form a composite Phoneme Difficulty Score (PhDScore) that drives a targeted oversampling strategy for ASR accuracy for impaired speech.

2509.20397.tldr: This work introduces a novel ASR personalization method based on Bayesian Low-rank Adaptation for data-efficient fine-tuning that significantly improves ASR accuracy for impaired speech while maintaining data and annotation efficiency, offering a practical path toward inclusive ASR.

2509.22407.tldr: Embodied Manipulation Media Adaptation (EMMA) is a framework for augmenting VLA policies that combines a generative data engine with an effective training pipeline and proposes AdaMix, a training strategy that adaptively weights samples according to policy performance to emphasize challenging samples.

2509.22756.tldr: This paper presents PAMR (Persistent Autoregressive Mapping with Traffic Rules), a novel framework that performs autoregressive co-construction of lane vectors and traffic rules from visual observations, and introduces two key mechanisms: Map-Rule Co-Construction for processing driving scenes in temporal segments, and Map-Rule Cache for maintaining rule consistency across these segments.

2509.23189.tldr: This work introduces AutoEP, a novel framework that bypasses training entirely by leveraging Large Language Models as zero-shot reasoning engines for algorithm control, demonstrating a powerful and accessible new paradigm for automated hyperparameter design.

2509.23711.tldr: A model-free continuous-time Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient algorithm that enables stable learning for general reinforcement learning problems with continuous time-and-state, and achieves superior stability and faster convergence compared to existing stochastic-policy methods.

2603.00552.tldr: EMPA is introduced, a process-oriented framework that evaluates persona-aligned support as sustained intervention rather than isolated replies and distills real interactions into controllable, psychologically grounded scenarios, couples them with an open-ended multi-agent sandbox that exposes strategic adaptation and failure modes.

2603.05310.tldr: Latent-Mark is proposed, the first zero-bit audio watermarking framework designed to survive semantic compression, and introduces Cross-Codec Optimization, jointly optimizing the waveform across multiple surrogate codecs to target shared latent invariants.

2603.07101.tldr: This work investigates whether contemporary large language models (LLMs) can perform such synthesis under engine-level structural constraints and generate Unity code structured and conditioned by goal playable patterns, and proposes grounding and hygiene failure modes.

2603.14686.tldr: MVHOI, a two-stage HOI video reenactment framework that bridges multi-view reference conditions and video foundation models via a 3D Foundation Model (3DFM), shows superior performance in generating long-duration HOI videos with intricate object manipulations.

2603.14692.tldr: This paper lifts the seminal approaches of Pearce and Osorio to the temporal setting, establishing a formal correspondence between temporal intuitionistic logic and temporal logic programming.

2603.14694.tldr: A two-stage ensemble approach using supervised domain adaptation (SDA) for building damage classification across four severity classes is explored, demonstrating the critical role of domain adaptation in building trustworthy automated damage assessment modules for HMS-integrated disaster response.

2603.14703.tldr: This paper introduces a multi-agent framework that integrates control-flow and data-flow representations with architectural and cross-component dependency signals to support system-level performance reasoning and presents a proof-of-concept on a microservice-based system that illustrates the effectiveness of this framework.

2603.14706.tldr: AdapterTune is introduced, which augments each transformer block with a residual low-rank bottleneck whose up-projection is zero-initialized, guaranteeing that the adapted network starts exactly at the pretrained function and eliminates early-epoch representation drift.

2603.14724.tldr: Cross-model analysis establishes a game-domain failure taxonomy (rarity-dependent degradation; visual emptiness), and Rendering-Evaluation Fidelity Principle reveals that partial rendering enhancements paradoxically degrade VLM evaluation by amplifying structural defects, establish foundational principles for LLM-driven visual generation agents in game production.

2603.14734.tldr: GINO is proposed, a class of neural operators that parameterize elliptic solution maps primarily through intrinsic spectral multipliers acting on geometry-dependent spectra, coupled with gauge-equivariant nonlinearities, suggesting that enforcing intrinsic structure and gauge equivariance yields operator surrogates that are more geometry-consistent and discretization-robust for elliptic PDEs on form-valued fields.

2603.14739.tldr: An ego-motion-guided trajectory prediction network based on the Mamba model is proposed, which achieves state-of-the-art performance on the PIE and JAAD datasets.

2603.14756.tldr: A novel Privacy-Preserving Machine Translation task, aiming to protect the private information in text during the model inference stage, and constructed three benchmark test datasets, designed corresponding evaluation metrics, and proposed a series of benchmark methods as a starting point.

2603.14769.tldr: Prioritized Optimization with Local Contextual Aggregation (POLCA), a scalable framework designed to handle stochasticity in optimization -- such as noisy feedback, sampling minibatches, and stochastic system behaviors -- while effectively managing the unconstrained expansion of solution space is introduced.

2603.14773.tldr: A theoretical convergence analysis is provided, demonstrating that HO-SFL mitigates the dimension-dependent convergence slowdown of zeroth-order optimization, achieving a convergence rate comparable to first-order methods.

2603.14778.tldr: p^2 RAG is proposed, a privacy-preserving RAG service that supports arbitrary top-$k retrieval and uses an interactive bisection method to determine the set of top-$k documents.

2603.14792.tldr: LaPro-DTA is proposed, a framework designed to achieve robust and generalizable DTA prediction, and devise a latent dual-view drug representation mechanism to tackle overfitting, which synergizes an instance-level view to capture fine-grained substructures with stochastic perturbation and a distribution-level view to distill generalized chemical scaffolds via semantic remapping.

2603.14797.tldr: A Multi-Granularity Encoding network that synergizes multi-scale convolutions and self-attention mechanisms to distill discriminative signals from high-dimensional, redundant biological data is developed, presenting a highly adaptive scheme for decoding complex protein-ligand interactions in the post-genomic era.

2603.14799.tldr: This work formalizes the universe routing problem as the universe routing problem: classifying questions into mutually exclusive belief spaces before invoking specialized solvers, suggesting that modular epistemic architectures are fundamentally more amenable to lifelong learning than regularization-based approaches.

2603.14805.tldr: Knowledge Activation is introduced, a framework that specializes AI Skills - the open standard for agent-consumable knowledge - into structured, governance-aware Atomic Knowledge Units (AKUs) for institutional knowledge delivery that form a composable knowledge graph that agents traverse at runtime.

2603.14818.tldr: This work proposes SimCert, a probabilistic certification framework for verifying the behavioral similarity of compressed neural networks, and demonstrates that SimCert outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2603.14819.tldr: RAZOR is a lightweight, model-agnostic unlearning framework that generalizes forgetting updates to coordinated multi-layer and multi-head edits within transformer backbones, and achieves highly accurate and stable forgetting, even under quantization.

2603.14825.tldr: This work proposes Two Birds, One Projection, an efficient inference time jailbreak defence that projects cross-modal features onto the null space of the identified bias direction to remove the corresponding components.

2603.14833.tldr: A systematic stream ablation-and-rescue framework that enables direct causal comparison of residual streams during inference and reveals how information is distributed across streams beyond what is observable from representational similarity alone is introduced.

2603.14841.tldr: Evaluation across 15 complementary analyses indicates that the SafeDriver-IQ framework reliably differentiates high-risk from low-risk driving conditions with strong discriminative performance, and shifts the focus from reactive crash counting to real-time risk prevention.

2603.14843.tldr: ContiGuard is presented, the first framework tailored for continual learning of the detector on time-evolving perturbed text (termed continual toxicity detection) to enable the detector to continually update capability and maintain sustained resilience against evolving perturbations.

2603.14855.tldr: PCodeTrans is presented, a feedback-driven framework that bridges the gap between decompilation, recompilation, and rigorous function-level dynamic validation and paves a practical path to reliably translate decompiled pseudocode into compilable and executable equivalents.

2603.14860.tldr: This paper identifies a fundamental optimization barrier in naive pixel-space ensemble strategies: due to divergent objective functions, pixel-level gradients from heterogeneous generators become statistically orthogonal, causing destructive interference.

2603.14861.tldr: Results indicate that the proposed framework provides a scalable and deployable vision-based solution for intelligent transportation systems and smart-city traffic management.

2603.14870.tldr: IgPose is introduced, a generalizable framework for Ig–Ag pose identification and scoring, built on a generative data-augmentation pipeline and achieves robust performance on curated internal test sets and the CASP-16 benchmark compared to physics and deep learning baselines.

2603.14876.tldr: A novel system that assists a physician by utilizing medical profile of a patient and routine lab investigations to predict a group of likely diseases and then confirm them, coupled with providing explanations for inferences, thereby assisting physicians to reduce misdiagnosis of patients in clinical decision-making is outlined.

2603.14879.tldr: This paper proposes a physics-driven generative adversarial network-based full-waveform inversion method that integrates the data-driven capability of deep neural networks with the physical constraints imposed by the seismic wave equation, and employs adversarial training through a discriminator to enhance the stability and robustness of the inversion results.

2603.14891.tldr: Decision-Level Ordinal Modeling (DLOM) is proposed, which makes scoring an explicit ordinal decision by reusing the language model head to extract score-wise logits on predefined score tokens, enabling direct optimization and analysis in the score space.

2603.14893.tldr: The SDT decomposition revealed that models occupying distinct positions in sensitivity-bias space could not be distinguished by calibration metrics alone, demonstrating that the full parametric framework provides diagnostic information unavailable from existing metrics.

2603.14917.tldr: The use of spectrogram-based representations is reviewed and the state-of-the-art to question how front-end feature representation choice allies with back-end classifier architecture for different tasks is surveyed.

2603.14923.tldr: Direction routing is introduced, a lightweight mechanism that gives each transformer attention head learned suppression directions controlled by a shared router, at 3.9% parameter cost, and becomes the model's dominant computational pathway.

2603.14941.tldr: RS-WorldModel is presented, a unified world model for remote sensing that jointly handles spatiotemporal change understanding and text-guided future scene forecasting, and RSWBench-1.1M, a 1.1 million sample dataset with rich language annotations covering both tasks is built.

2603.14947.tldr: FairMed-XGB offers a robust, interpretable, and ethically aligned solution for equitable clinical decision-making, paving the way for trustworthy deployment of AI in high-stakes healthcare environments.

2603.14953.tldr: Experiments on NExT-QA show that the method significantly improves accuracy, especially for temporal and causal question types, establishing keyframe selection as an effective and learnable module for VideoQA.

2603.14975.tldr: This paper identifies a new concept called Agentic Pressure, which characterizes the endogenous tension emerging when compliant execution becomes infeasible and demonstrates that under this pressure agents exhibit normative drift where they strategically sacrifice safety to preserve utility.

2603.15001.tldr: It is proved that Log-Barrier Stochastic Gradient Bandit (LB-SGB) matches the sample complexity of SGB, but also converges (at a slower rate) without any assumptions on the learning process, and shows a connection between the log-barrier regularization and Natural Policy Gradient.

2603.15006.tldr: DECODE leverages limited paired transcriptomic and morphological data as supervisory signals during training, enabling the extraction of a measurement-invariant biological fingerprint from chemical structures and explicit filtering of experimental noise to enable structure-based in silico biological profiling.

2603.15009.tldr: Using a nationwide mobile phone GPS dataset with millions of trajectories across Japan, it is shown that TrajFlow or its variants consistently outperform diffusion-based and deep generative baselines at urban, metropolitan, and nationwide levels.

2603.15021.tldr: This paper provides a style-oriented modeling vocabulary and a small set of views for agents, artifacts, tools, and their coordination patterns, a hierarchical description technique aligned with C4 to structure these views across abstraction levels, and industrial examples that demonstrate how the approach yields transparent, maintainable architecture documentation supporting sustained evolution.

2603.15034.tldr: This paper replicates and extends the system used in the AuTexTification 2023 shared task for authorship attribution of machine-generated texts and adds newer multilingual language models and added 26 document-level stylometric features.

2603.15044.tldr: Prompt Readiness Levels (PRL), a nine level maturity scale inspired by TRL, and the Prompt Readiness Score (PRS), a multidimensional scoring method with gating thresholds designed to prevent weak link failure modes are introduced.

2603.15046.tldr: AnoleVLA is proposed, a lightweight VLA that uses a deep state space model to process multimodal sequences efficiently and leverages its lightweight and fast sequential state modeling to process visual and textual inputs, which allows the robot to generate trajectories efficiently.

2603.15051.tldr: AdaAnchor is introduced, a latent reasoning framework that performs silent iterative computation by refining a set of latent anchor vectors attached to the input by incorporating an adaptive halting mechanism that monitors anchor stability across iterations and terminates refinement once the anchor dynamics converge.

2603.15054.tldr: Compared to existing methods, IA-KRC enables substantially more persistent and efficient cooperation despite environmental interference and achieves superior performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines, while demonstrating enhanced robustness and scalability in complex topological and highly dynamic multi-agent scenarios.

2603.15083.tldr: Reactive Listener Motion Generation from Speaker Utterance is introduced, a new task which aims to generate naturalistic listener body motions that appropriately respond to a speaker's utterance, and ReactMotion, a unified generative framework that jointly models text, audio, emotion, and motion.

2603.15106.tldr: This work proposes PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs), and presents a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform.

2603.15136.tldr: Safe Flow Q-Learning (SafeFQL), which extends FQL to safe offline RL by combining a Hamilton--Jacobi reachability-inspired safety value function with an efficient one-step flow policy, and adds a conformal prediction calibration step that adjusts the safety threshold and provides finite-sample probabilistic safety coverage.

2603.15168.tldr: A novel asymmetric transformer-based cross-attention mechanism that allows functional embeddings to selectively incorporate complementary structural information while preserving functional dominance is introduced, effectively integrating heterogeneous multimodal data from the multi-site ABIDE-I dataset, improving automated ASD classification across imaging sites.

2603.15180.tldr: This study introduces an Iterative Learning Control-Informed Reinforcement Learning (IL-CIRL) framework for training DRL controllers in dual-layer batch-to-batch and within-batch control architectures for batch processes.

2603.15183.tldr: The Artifact Coherence System is constructed and the Token Coherence Theorem is proved: lazy invalidation attenuates cost by at least S/(n + W(d_i) when S>n + W(d_i) when S>n + W(d_i), converting O(n x S x |D|) to O((n + W) x |D|).

2603.15184.tldr: Extensive evaluation on both static and neuromorphic datasets reveals that CATFormer outperforms existing rehearsal-free CIL algorithms across various task splits, establishing it as an ideal architecture for energy-efficient, true-class incremental learning.

2603.15185.tldr: This paper systematically re-examine the impact of common architectural patterns on closed-loop performance: high-resolution perceptual representations, disentangled trajectory representations, and generative planning to introduce BevAD, a novel lightweight and highly scalable end-to-end driving architecture.

2603.15212.tldr: Experiments on K League data show that simulated player transfers lead to measurable changes in offensive progression and goal probabilities, indicating that ScoutGPT captures player-specific impact beyond traditional static metrics.

2603.15218.tldr: This work proposes the Kemeny Transformer, a novel Transformer-based algorithm trained via reinforcement learning to efficiently approximate the Kemeny optimal ranking, and demonstrates that the model outperforms classical majority-heuristic and Markov-chain approaches, achieving substantially faster inference than integer linear programming solvers.

2603.15220.tldr: INTERPOL is introduced, a model-driven identification framework that learns to distinguish target models from others using interpolated preference data and employs an adaptive curriculum learning strategy to capture deep stylistic patterns that superficial statistical features miss.

2603.15221.tldr: ADV-0 is presented, a closed-loop min-max optimization framework that treats the interaction between driving policy and adversarial agent (attacker) as a zero-sum Markov game and reveals the optimal adversary distribution, efficiently approximating this optimum and offering an algorithm-agnostic solution to the game.

2603.15226.tldr: SCAN (a sparse editing framework based on Sparse Circuit Anchored Neuron) is proposed which transforms editing into a mechanism-aware manipulation by constructing a knowledge circuit via Sparse Transcoders.

2603.15250.tldr: In-context symbolic regression for operator extraction in KANs is studied, robustness via one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) hyper-parameter sweeps is quantified and both predictive error and qualitative consistency of recovered formulas are assessed.

2603.15259.tldr: The Randomized Embedding Smoothing and Token Aggregation defense is extended to VLMs and it is found that RESTA is effective in reducing attack success rate over this diverse corpus of attacks, in particular, when employing directional embedding noise.

2603.15260.tldr: Agent-Guided Cross-modal Decoding (AGCD) is proposed, a plug-and-play decoding-time prior-injection paradigm that derives state-conditioned physics-priors from the current multivariate atmosphere and injects them into forecasters in a controllable and reusable way.

2603.15262.tldr: Environment-Aware Search Planning (EASP) is proposed, reformulating search planning as a dynamic reasoning process grounded in environmental reality, and has been successfully deployed in JD.com's AI-Search system.

2603.15270.tldr: The key idea of this framework is that span-level learning improves LLMs'ability to perform document-level ICD coding, and enables small-scale LLMs to achieve performance comparable to much larger proprietary models, demonstrating its effectiveness and potential for fully automated ICD coding.

2603.15280.tldr: NS-Mem is a long-term neuro-symbolic memory framework designed to advance multimodal agent reasoning by integrating neural memory with explicit symbolic structures and rules, and achieves an average 4.35% improvement in overall reasoning accuracy over pure neural memory systems.

2603.15282.tldr: A new policy-iteration algorithm iPI is introduced, that matches TarjanSafe's best-case runtime while guaranteeing a polynomial worst-case, and in problems amenable to TarjanSafe iPI has similar performance, whereas in ill-suited problems iPI scales exponentially better.

2603.15292.tldr: PRISM is introduced, a simulation-based encoder-decoder that infers a joint posterior over both discrete model structures and associated continuous parameters, while enabling test-time control of model complexity via a tunable model prior that the network is conditioned on.

2603.15297.tldr: This research investigates evolutionary transfer learning by adapting heuristic evaluation functions directly from Stockfish, a leading chess engine, and subsequently optimizing them using Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES).

2603.15309.tldr: CCTU, a benchmark for evaluating LLM tool use under complex constraints, is introduced and LLMs demonstrate limited capacity for self-refinement even after receiving detailed feedback on constraint violations, highlighting a critical bottleneck in the development of robust tool-use agents.

2603.15326.tldr: A new dataset, named TAGARELA, composed of over 8,972 hours of podcast audio, specifically curated for training automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS) models, enabling state-of-the-art Portuguese models.

2603.15341.tldr: This research presents an LLM-based, multimodal, multi-agent framework that dynamically converts natural language descriptions and imagery into 3D designs that enhances user-centric communication and fosters more inclusive, effective, and resilient design processes.

2603.15351.tldr: PMAx is presented, an autonomous agentic framework that functions as a virtual process analyst that ensures mathematical accuracy and data privacy while enabling non-technical users to transform high-level business questions into reliable process insights.

2603.15358.tldr: This work presents FuXiWeather2, a unified end-to-end neural framework for assimilation and forecasting that drives deterministic forecasts that exceed the skill of the HRES system in 91\% of evaluated metrics.

2603.15364.tldr: This work examines real-world AV incidents reported in the NHTSA database and introduces CRASH, Cognitive Reasoning Agent for Safety Hazards, an LLM-based agent that automates reasoning over crash reports by leveraging both standardized fields and unstructured narrative descriptions.

2603.15371.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that BIGMAS consistently improves reasoning performance for both standard LLMs and LRMs, outperforming existing multi-agent baselines including ReAct and Tree of Thoughts, showing that multi-agent architectural design provides complementary gains orthogonal to model-level reasoning enhancements.

2603.15372.tldr: This work introduces SKILLS (Structured Knowledge Injection for LLM-driven Service Lifecycle operations), a benchmark framework comprising 37 telecom operations scenarios spanning 8 TM Forum Open API domains and evaluates open-weight models under two conditions: baseline and with-skill.

2603.15373.tldr: GradCFA is introduced, a hybrid framework combining CFX and FA to improve interpretability by explicitly optimizing feasibility, plausibility, and diversity—key qualities often unbalanced in existing methods.

2603.15381.tldr: A learning architecture inspired by human and animal cognition is proposed that integrates learning from observation and learning from active behavior while flexibly switching between these learning modes as a function of internally generated meta-control signals.

2603.15386.tldr: Findings indicate that explicit geometric grounding substantially improves spatial reasoning performance, and suggest that structured representations offer a compelling alternative to purely end-to-end visual reasoning.

2603.15388.tldr: This paper proposes Stackelberg Proximal Policy Optimization (Stackelberg PPO), which explicitly incorporates the control's adaptation dynamics into morphology optimization, thereby stabilizing training and improving learning efficiency.

2603.15396.tldr: A novel framework for generating adversarial patches capable of both evasion and impersonation attacks against deep re-identification models across non-overlapping cameras is introduced, employing a conditional encoder-decoder network to synthesize adversarial patches in a single forward pass.

2603.15397.tldr: A SaFer Chain-of-Thought (SFCoT) framework is proposed, which proactively evaluates and calibrates potentially unsafe reasoning steps in real time and reduces the attack success rate, demonstrating it as an effective and efficient LLM safety enhancement method without a significant decline in general performance.

2603.15401.tldr: SWE-Skills-Bench is presented, the first requirement-driven benchmark that isolates the marginal utility of agent skills in real-world software engineering (SWE), and suggests that agent skills are a narrow intervention whose utility depends strongly on domain fit, abstraction level, and contextual compatibility.

2603.15402.tldr: An empirical study on 16 LLMs, covering general LLMs, specialist tabular LLMs, and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, to explore how LLMs understand tabular data and perform downstream tasks, focusing on 4 dimensions including the attention dynamics, the effective layer depth, the expert activation, and the impacts of input designs.

2603.15404.tldr: The Adaptive Residual Context (ARC) architecture is introduced, offering a data-efficient solution to add new vehicle categories for complex urban environments and significantly improving knowledge retention.

2603.15408.tldr: This work introduces TrinityGuard, a comprehensive safety evaluation and monitoring framework for LLM-based MAS, grounded in the OWASP standards, and encompasses a three-tier fine-grained risk taxonomy that identifies 20 risk types, covering single-agent vulnerabilities, inter-agent communication threats, and system-level emergent hazards.

2603.15411.tldr: This work proposes a hybrid modeling approach that uses a neural network to parameterize a differentiable biophysical model and leverages multi-task learning for efficient data sharing across crop cultivars in data limited settings.

2603.15413.tldr: A unified three-stage framework that produces a quantized DNN with balanced fault and attack robustness and a lightweight post-training adjustment integrates quantization to enhance efficiency and further mitigate fault sensitivity without degrading attack resilience is proposed.

2603.15417.tldr: Safety vulnerabilities of TTT methods are investigated and it is highlighted that TTT methods that enhance LLM reasoning by promoting self-consistency can lead to amplification behaviors and reasoning degradation, highlighting the need for safer TTT methods.

2603.15418.tldr: This work proposes Multi-Agent Vision-Language-Critic Models (MA-VLCM), a framework that replaces the learned centralized critic in MARL with a pretrained vision-language model fine-tuned to evaluate multi-agent behavior.

2603.15421.tldr: CLAG, a CLustering-based AGentic memory framework where an SLM agent actively organizes memory by clustering, consistently improves answer quality and robustness over prior memory systems for agents, remaining lightweight and efficient.

2603.15431.tldr: A physics-informed fine-tuning framework that adapts pre-trained PDE foundation models by incorporating physical constraints directly into the fine-tuning objective enables effective adaptation in data-scarce regimes while promoting physical consistency.

2603.15440.tldr: This paper constructs a novel dataset of approximately 8,000 labeled 30-second audio clips spanning eight Nepali music genres and conducts a systematic comparison of nine classification models across two paradigms, and provides per-class precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrices, and ROC analysis for every model.

2603.15452.tldr: VoT is proposed, a method with Event-driven Reasoning and Multi-level Alignment that combines the rich information in exogenous text with the powerful reasoning capabilities of LLMs for time series forecasting to unlock the Value of Text.

2603.15457.tldr: It is argued that evaluations of AI agents are vulnerable to a well-known failure mode in computer security: malicious software that exhibits benign behavior when it detects that it is being analyzed.

2603.15469.tldr: Results demonstrate that a dual-model framework for long-horizon multi-task learning is highly effective, and the strategic utilization of recovery-from-failure curriculum data is a critical insight for successful deployment.

2603.15473.tldr: Across the agent lifecycle, ALTK identifies opportunities to intervene and improve, namely, post-user-request, pre-LLM prompt conditioning, post-LLM output processing, pre-tool validation, post-tool result checking, and pre-response assembly.

2603.15481.tldr: This work proposes TabKD, which learns adaptive feature bins aligned with teacher decision boundaries, then generates synthetic queries that maximize pairwise interaction coverage, and shows that interaction coverage strongly correlates with distillation quality, validating the core hypothesis.

2603.15483.tldr: It is argued that effective agent evaluation goes beyond correctness alone, incorporating conversation quality, efficiency and systematic diagnosis of agent errors, and shown that the TED framework reveals new insights regarding agent performance across models and user expertise levels.

2603.15492.tldr: This work analyzes AdamW dynamics on modular arithmetic tasks, revealing a ``Spectral Gating''mechanism that regulates the transition from memorization to generalization and challenges the"Flat Minima"hypothesis for algorithmic tasks, showing that isotropic noise injection fails to induce grokking.

2603.15500.tldr: An information-theoretic framework that decomposes reasoning into procedural information and epistemic verbalization shows that purely procedural reasoning can become informationally stagnant, whereas epistemic verbalization enables continued information acquisition and is critical for achieving information sufficiency.

2603.15506.tldr: The community is called on to retire or substantially augment current benchmarks with datasets exhibiting a wider spectrum of non-stationarities, and require every deep learning submission to include robust classical and simple baselines, appropriately chosen for the specific characteristics of the downstream tasks'time series.

2603.15523.tldr: A dataset of 227,432 scientific abstracts with author-assigned keyphrases is constructed, representing a 25-fold increase over the largest prior Slovak resource and approaching the scale of established English benchmarks such as KP20K.

2603.15526.tldr: This work proposes a lightweight post-hoc method that produces pointwise error estimates for PINN predictions, which offer a natural form of explanation for such models, identifying not just whether a prediction is wrong, but where and by how much.

2603.15527.tldr: A runtime verification mechanism is proposed, enabling LLMs to query external sources to ground their context and resist manipulation, and also acknowledges that many ethical and value dilemmas are philosophically irreducible, posing a long-term, open challenge for the future of AI alignment.

2603.15540.tldr: DOT is presented, a dynamic knob selection and online sampling DBMS tuning algorithm that achieves matching or outperforming performance compared to state-of-the-art tuners while substantially reducing tuning overhead.

2603.15542.tldr: A multi-agent framework, STRIDES, is proposed, which achieves significant performance improvements over state-of-the-art reasoning models over real-world policy interventions in realistic social settings.

2603.15547.tldr: This work examines how large language models reason about misconceptions when generating multiple-choice distractors, a task that requires modeling incorrect yet plausible answers by coordinating solution knowledge, simulating student misconceptions, and evaluating plausibility.

2603.15566.tldr: Lore is proposed, a lightweight protocol that restructures commit messages into self-contained decision records carrying constraints, rejected alternatives, agent directives, and verification metadata, and is discoverable by any agent capable of running shell commands.

2603.15594.tldr: OpenSeeker is introduced, the first fully open-source search agent that achieves frontier-level performance through two core technical innovations: fact-grounded scalable controllable QA synthesis andDenoised trajectory synthesis, which employs a retrospective summarization mechanism to denoise the trajectory, therefore promoting the teacher LLMs to generate high-quality actions.

2603.15600.tldr: This paper introduces PRIMO R1 (Process Reasoning Induced Monitoring), a 7B framework that transforms video MLLMs into active"Critics", and leverages outcome-based Reinforcement Learning to incentivize explicit Chain-of-Thought generation for progress estimation.

2603.15607.tldr: It is suggested that widely used counterfactual evaluation metrics fail to reflect key aspects of explanation quality as perceived by users, underscoring the need for more human-centered approaches to evaluating explainable artificial intelligence.

2603.15615.tldr: It is posited that LLMs possess an inherent state of moral indifference due to compressing distinct moral concepts into uniform probability distributions, and that endogenously aligned AI might require a transformation from post-hoc corrections to proactive cultivation.

2603.15619.tldr: This work introduces mixture-of-depths attention (MoDA), a mechanism that allows each attention head to attend to sequence KV pairs at the current layer and depth KV pairs from preceding layers, and suggests that MoDA is a promising primitive for depth scaling.

2602.18466.tldr: SciIBI is the first video benchmark for analyzing science classroom discourse, featuring 113 NGSS-aligned clips annotated with Core Instructional Practices and sophistication levels, and reveals fundamental limitations: current models struggle to distinguish pedagogically similar practices, suggesting that CIP coding requires instructional reasoning beyond surface pattern matching.

2602.23592.tldr: KEEP is a KV-cache-centric memory management system for efficient embodied planning that combines a Static-Dynamic Memory Construction algorithm that reduces KV cache recomputation by mixed-granularity memory group, a Multi-hop Memory Re-computation algorithm that dynamically identifies important cross-attention among different memory groups and reconstructs memory interactions iteratively, and a Layer-balanced Memory Loading that eliminates unbalanced KV cache loading and cross-attention computation across different layers.

2602.23971.tldr: It is shown that asking a model to convert non-questions into questions before answering significantly reduces sycophancy, and asking a model to convert non-questions into questions before answering significantly reduces sycophancy.

2603.00170.tldr: Lilium is introduced, an automated evolutionary method to enhance the accuracy and robustness of Skull-Face Overlay, and outperform the state-of-the-art method in terms of both accuracy and robustness.

2603.03378.tldr: This work presents AOI (Autonomous Operations Intelligence), a trainable multi-agent framework formulating automated operations as a structured trajectory learning problem under security constraints, and integrates three key components.

2603.13853.tldr: This paper proposes APEX-Searcher, a novel Agentic Planning and Execution framework to augment LLM search capabilities, which introduces a two-stage agentic framework that decouples the retrieval process into planning and execution.

2603.13952.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed reinforcement learning-based AVSE framework with a Large Language Model (LLM)-based interpretable reward model outperforms a supervised baseline and a DNSMOS-based RL baseline in PESQ, STOI, neural quality metrics, and subjective listening tests.

2603.14177.tldr: Pocket-K, a single-lead AI-ECG system initialized from the ECGFounder foundation model for non-invasive hyperkalemia screening and handheld deployment, was developed and validated and a handheld prototype enabled near-real-time inference, supporting future prospective evaluation in native handheld and wearable settings.

2603.14198.tldr: This work proposes group-conditional federated conformal prediction (GC-FCP), a novel protocol that provides group-conditional coverage guarantees and experiments validate the performance of GC-FCP compared to centralized calibration baselines.

2603.14284.tldr: A high-fidelity neural compression framework based on a SIREN (Sinusoidal Representation Networks) auto-decoder to represent multi-structural seismic velocity models from the OpenFWI benchmark, demonstrating high-quality reconstruction and highlighting the potential of INR-based auto-decoders for efficient storage, multi-scale analysis, and downstream geophysical applications such as full waveform inversion.

2603.14665.tldr: Gradient Atoms is presented, an unsupervised method that decomposes per-document training gradients into sparse components ("atoms") via dictionary learning in a preconditioned eigenspace via dictionary learning in a preconditioned eigenspace.

2603.14764.tldr: This work introduces an order-preserving polygon augmentation strategy that performs transformations in mask space and then projects surviving vertices back into index-space to restore adjacency relations, achieving near-perfect Cyclic Adjacency Preservation (CAP) across both single and compound augmentations.

2603.14771.tldr: OpenHospital is introduced, an interactive arena where physician agents can evolve CI through interactions with patient agents and employs a data-in-agent-self paradigm that rapidly enhances agent capabilities and provides robust evaluation metrics for benchmarking both medical proficiency and system efficiency.

2603.14894.tldr: Empirical results on tabular and image datasets corroborate the theoretical findings and demonstrate that EAGLE improves explanation reproducibility across runs, achieves higher neighborhood stability, and improves perturbation sample quality as compared to state-of-the-art baselines such as Tilia, US-LIME, GLIME and BayesLIME.

2603.15057.tldr: A mean-squared-error decomposition is derived that separates model bias, estimation bias, model variance, and estimation variance, and analyzes their dependence on model characteristics, data selection, and sample size.

2603.15164.tldr: HindSight is introduced, a time-split evaluation framework that measures idea quality by matching generated ideas against real future publications and scoring them by citation impact and venue acceptance, suggesting that LLMs systematically overvalue novel-sounding ideas that never materialize in real research.

2603.15255.tldr: SAGE (Self-evolving Agents for Generalized reasoning Evolution), a closed-loop framework where four agents: Challenger, Planner, Solver, and Critic, co-evolve from a shared LLM backbone using only a small seed set, is presented.

2603.15377.tldr: This analysis identifies the scorer's signal-to-noise ratio as the key quantity governing beam width selection, and it proposes diagnostic indicators for choosing the beam width in practice.

2603.15484.tldr: RSGen is a plug-and-play framework that leverages diverse edge guidance to enhance layout-driven RS image generation and utilizes these diverse edge maps as conditioning for existing L2I models to enforce pixel-level control within bounding boxes, ensuring the generated instances strictly adhere to the layout.

2603.15563.tldr: Analysis against the BenchPress evaluation matrix shows that Pokemon battling is nearly orthogonal to standard LLM benchmarks, measuring capabilities not captured by existing suites and positioning Pokemon as an unsolved benchmark that can drive RL and LLM research forward.

2603.16039.tldr: It is argued that the cleanest way to organize this design space is through a two-axis view of the Transformer, and the recommendation is simple: use DDL when the shortcut is the object of interest, and use sequence-axis ShortSWA when the goal is local adaptive mixing.

2603.16043.tldr: This framework, CTFG (Collaborative Temporal Feature Generation), employs a Transformer-based autoregressive generator that incrementally constructs feature token sequences, each conditioned on prior context and the encoded sensor input, and is optimized via Group-Relative Policy Optimization, a critic-free algorithm that evaluates each generated sequence against a cohort of alternatives sampled from the same input.

2603.16044.tldr: Low-Rank Adaptation is implemented to fine-tune OpenVLA on augmented pairs, allowing the model to bridge the gap between complex natural language intent and robotic actions, suggesting that enriching the linguistic space of specialized datasets is crucial for embodied agents.

2603.16045.tldr: POaaS is proposed, a minimal-edit prompt optimization layer that routes each query to lightweight specialists and merges their outputs under strict drift and length constraints, with a conservative skip policy for well-formed prompts, and is a practical alternative to search-heavy APO for on-device sLLMs.

2603.16052.tldr: It is argued that C.A.A.P. is not only a technical refinement but also a step toward shifting human-computer dialogue from one-way command-execution patterns to two-way, self-correcting, partnership-based collaboration.

2603.16070.tldr: SEAHateCheck is introduced, a pioneering dataset tailored to Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, and Vietnam, covering Indonesian, Tagalog, Thai, and Vietnamese, which provides culturally relevant test cases, augmented by large language models and validated by local experts for accuracy.

2603.16085.tldr: This work presents a novel framework Interact3D designed to generate physically plausible interacting 3D compositional objects that produces promising collsion-aware compositions with improved geometric fidelity and consistent spatial relationships.

2603.16086.tldr: This work formalizes Vision-Sound-Language-Action (VSLA) as a continuous control paradigm conditioned on vision, streaming audio, language, and proprioception under delayed decision loops, and introduces HEAR, a VSLA framework integrating four components and suggesting that robust sound-centric manipulation necessitates causal persistence and explicit temporal learning.

2603.16088.tldr: Fiber Bundle from modern differential geometry is introduced and a novel geometric analysis paradigm for recommender systems is proposed, identifying future application directions encompassing quantitative mechanisms for information cocoons and evolutionary bias, geometric meta-theory for adaptive recommendation, and novel inference architectures integrating large language models (LLMs).

2603.16091.tldr: CounterRefine first produces a short answer from retrieved evidence, then gathers additional support and conflicting evidence with follow-up queries conditioned on that draft answer, and finally applies a restricted refinement step that outputs either KEEP or REVISE, with proposed revisions accepted only if they pass deterministic validation.

2603.16092.tldr: Parallel-ICL offers an effective solution to the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in MM-ICL, enabling dynamic task adaptation with substantially reduced inference overhead.

2603.16093.tldr: A sequential two-step text-to-audio-video generation pipeline: first generating video, then conditioning on both the video output and the original prompt to synthesize temporally synchronized audio, shows that this modular approach yields high-fidelity generations of audio video generation.

2603.16104.tldr: Helium is introduced, a workflow-aware serving framework that models agentic workloads as query plans and treats LLM invocations as first-class operators and integrates proactive caching and cache-aware scheduling to maximize reuse across prompts, KV states, and workflows.

2603.16105.tldr: This work introduces ZipCal, a model-agnostic data curation strategy that maximizes lexical diversity based on Zipfian power laws and consistently outperforms standard uniform random sampling across various pruning benchmarks.

2603.16107.tldr: RepoReviewer is presented, a local-first multi-agent system for automated GitHub repository review with a Python CLI, FastAPI API, LangGraph orchestration layer, and Next.js user interface that decomposes review into repository acquisition, context synthesis, file-level analysis, finding prioritization, and summary generation.

2603.16110.tldr: VIGIL, an edge-extended agentic AI system that deploys desktop-resident agents to perform situated diagnosis, retrieval over enterprise knowledge, and policy-governed remediation directly on user devices with explicit consent and end-to-end observability, is presented.

2603.16112.tldr: This work introduces Automated Skill Distillation and Adaptation (ASDA), a framework that automatically generates structured skill artifacts through iterative error-corrective learning without modifying model weights, offering any organization with a labeled domain dataset a practical and auditable path to domain adaptation without weight access or retraining.

2603.16113.tldr: By directly quantifying hallucination rates and domain shift robustness, PathGLS serves as a reliable criterion for benchmarking VLMs on private clinical datasets and informing safe deployment, establishing PathGLS as a robust reference-free metric.

2603.16123.tldr: It is proved that decoders assembled by structural concatenation of independently generated segments are strict monoidal functors (compositional by construction), while softmax self-attention is not functorial for any non-trivial compositional task.

2603.16124.tldr: This work introduces SWE-QA-Pro, a benchmark constructed from diverse, long-tail repositories with executable environments, and proposes a scalable synthetic data pipeline that powers a two-stage training recipe: Supervised Fine-Tuning followed by Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF).

2603.16134.tldr: A controlled benchmark comparing three augmentation strategies applied to a fine-grained animal classification task: traditional transforms, FastGAN, and Stable Diffusion 1.5 fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA).

2603.16143.tldr: A large language model (LLM)-driven multimodal framework that fuses historical GPS data, RGB image, LiDAR data, and strategically designed task-specific textual prompts is proposed to address near-field extremely large-scale multiple-input multiple-output (XL-MIMO) systems.

2603.16148.tldr: Results support the feasibility of end-to-end language modeling with a pure SNN architecture at this scale, and introduce NeuronSpark, a 0.9B-parameter SNN language model trained with next-token prediction and surrogate gradients.

2603.16152.tldr: A novel alignment framework that formulates HIF as a Constrained Markov Decision Process that elevates system prompts from mere input context to strict algorithmic boundaries, providing a principled foundation for reliable LLM deployment in complex workflows.

2603.16154.tldr: A novel dual invariant framework, termed GATS, is proposed, offering a more efficient and principled paradigm for invariant 4D point cloud video understanding with superior accuracy, robustness, and scalability compared to Transformer based counterparts.

2603.16157.tldr: DyJR is proposed, a simple yet effective regularization framework using a dynamic reference distribution from recent trajectories that significantly outperforms GRPO as well as baselines such as RLEP and Ex-GRPO, while maintaining training efficiency comparable to the original GRPO.

2603.16161.tldr: This work proposes Agentic SQL, a framework featuring a universal two-tiered reward mechanism designed to provide effective trajectory-level evaluation and dense step-level signals, and proves Aggregated Trajectory Reward (ATR) acts as an energy dissipation operator, guaranteeing a cycle-free policy and monotonic convergence.

2603.16165.tldr: A novel Progressive Modal Relationship Re-ranking method consisting of two modules, called heterogeneous and homogeneous consistency re-ranking(HHCR), and a baseline for cross-modal person re-identification, called a consistency re-ranking inference network (CRI).

2603.16169.tldr: A fully open-source reproduction of CRAG is presented, replacing proprietary web search with the Wikipedia API and the original LLaMA-2 generator with Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct, demonstrating that the open-source pipeline achieves comparable performance to the original system.

2603.16171.tldr: Unlike Mem0 and related work that targets end-to-end agent benchmarks, MemX focuses on a narrower, reproducible baseline: local-first deployment, structural simplicity, explainable retrieval, and stability-oriented design.

2603.16185.tldr: The results demonstrate that learning structured and transferable representations from unlabeled molecular profiles can substantially reduce the amount of clinical supervision required for effective drug-response prediction, offering a practical pathway toward data-efficient preclinical-to-clinical translation.

2603.16197.tldr: Three complementary experiments are presented forming a rigorous multi-method contamination audit of six frontier LLMs: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3, Llama-3.3-70B, and Qwen3-235B, finding that 72.5% trigger memorization signals far above chance.

2603.16201.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the aspect-specific domain strategy effectively mitigates acoustic biases, significantly improving correlation with human ratings and achieving superior generalization on unseen generative scenarios.

2603.16204.tldr: By introducing a four-pillar framework, this review offers a comprehensive overview of current applications and future directions in AI-augmented mental health care, aiming to guide researchers, clinicians, and policymakers in developing safe, effective, and equitable digital mental health interventions.

2603.16207.tldr: A Dual-Stage Intent-Aware (DS-IA) Framework separates high-level user intent understanding from low-level physical execution, and resolves the Interaction Frequency Dilemma by balancing proactive querying with state-based inference.

2603.16210.tldr: This work proposes MOSAIC, a modular framework that enables compositional safety alignment through learnable control tokens optimized over a frozen backbone model and introduces order-based task sampling and a distribution-level alignment objective that mitigates over-refusal.

2603.16215.tldr: CoMAI is presented, a general-purpose multi-agent interview framework designed for diverse assessment scenarios that employs a modular task-decomposition architecture coordinated through a centralized finite-state machine.

2603.16216.tldr: The central finding is that while all reviewed systems address syntax and most address semantics to some degree, none reports end-to-end evaluation on quantum hardware (Layer 3b), leaving a significant gap between generated circuits and practical deployment.

2603.16243.tldr: RASLF, a representation-aware state-space framework that explicitly models structural correlations across multiple LF representations, is proposed, and a Progressive Geometric Refinement block is created that uses a panoramic epipolar representation to explicitly encode multi-view parallax differences, thereby enabling integration across different LF representations.

2603.16250.tldr: This work introduces a semantic exploration algorithm named SEVEX, which addresses two major challenges of visual prompt exploration: the distraction caused by lengthy, low-level code and the vast, unstructured search space of visual prompts.

2603.16253.tldr: Explicit Visual Premise Verification (EVPV) is introduced, a lightweight verification interface that conditions step scoring on the reliability of the visual premises a step depends on and improves step-level verification and consistently boosts Best-of-N reranking accuracy over strong baselines.

2603.16260.tldr: This chapter introduces the concept of Collective Intelligence for Deliberative Democracy (CI4DD), and argues for a fundamentally human-centred design approach to orchestrate how stakeholders can contribute meaningfully to shaping the artifacts and processes needed to create trustworthy DD processes.

2603.16261.tldr: AW-MoE, the framework that innovatively integrates Mixture of Experts (MoE) into weather-robust multi-modal 3D object detection approaches, and a Unified Dual-Modal Augmentation (UDMA) for synchronous LiDAR and 4D Radar dual-modal data augmentation while preserving the realism of scenes.

2603.16264.tldr: An adaptive ToM (A-ToM) agent is designed, which can align in ToM orders with its partner and leverages this estimation to predict the partner’s action, thereby facilitating behavioral coordination.

2603.16286.tldr: A rank-based PC scheme derived from heuristic-driven ordering of eligible activity-mode pairs and activity groups in decision situations is proposed, which enables a surrogate model to estimate the fitness of unevaluated GP individuals and provides useful guidance for offspring selection.

2603.16307.tldr: An automated data-generation framework that integrates high-fidelity semantic masks with heuristic search to produce diverse route-planning tasks with provably optimal solutions is introduced and a three-level hierarchical neuro-symbolic evaluation protocol is developed to enable accurate assessment and support fine-grained analysis on perception, reasoning, and planning simultaneously.

2603.16325.tldr: The proposed architecture ensures flexibility, scalability, modularity, modularity, and work augmentation within QMS and paves the way for its operationalization with industrial partners, showcasing its potential for advancing manufacturing processes.

2603.16330.tldr: This paper focuses on the development of personalized treatment plans using specific patient data focusing primarily on the genetic profile using multi-Omics data from Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer to build a predictive model along with machine learning techniques.

2603.16350.tldr: This work considers one application in radio astronomy, i.e., calibration, to showcase the proposed approach of ML aided decision making using a Takagi-Sugeno-Kang (TSK) fuzzy system and provides results based on simulations to illustrate the increased explainability of the proposed approach, not compromising on the quality or accuracy.

2603.16351.tldr: A deep learning-based framework for the automated identification of Ichneumonoidea wasps using a YOLO-based architecture integrated with High-Resolution Class Activation Mapping (HiResCAM) to enhance interpretability and integration of explainable AI techniques improves transparency and trustworthiness.

2603.16356.tldr: Plaza6G is presented, the first operational Experiment-as-a-Service (ExaS) platform unifying cloud resources with next-generation wireless infrastructure, and future work targets policy-aware orchestration, safety validation, and federated testbed integration toward open, reproducible wireless experimentation.

2603.16362.tldr: This framework first leverages a ViT-based module to rapidly generate a high-quality preliminary depth map construction, which serves as a structural prior, effectively replacing the time-consuming initial structure generation stage of diffusion models.

2603.16367.tldr: This paper organizes DynamicGate-MLP into a single framework that simultaneously satisfies both the regularization view and the conditional-computation view, and learns gates that decide whether to use each unit (or block), suppressing unnecessary computation while implementing sample-dependent execution that concentrates computation on the parts needed for each input.

2603.16370.tldr: FederatedFactory, a zero-dependency framework that inverts the unit of federation from discriminative parameters to generative priors, is introduced, a zero-dependency framework that facilitates exact modular unlearning through the deterministic deletion of specific generative modules.

2603.16397.tldr: This work presents Fanar 2.0, the second generation of Qatar's Arabic-centric Generative AI platform, which demonstrates that sovereign, resource-constrained AI development can produce systems competitive with those built at far greater scale.
