2603.22367.tldr: The Reasoner-Executor-Synthesizer (RES) architecture is proposed, a three-layer design that strictly separates intent parsing, deterministic data retrieval and aggregation, and narrative generation and achieves O(1) token complexity with respect to dataset size.

2603.22368.tldr: Evaluating many commercial and open-source VLMs, it is found that models detect visual design errors substantially more reliably than reasoning-based misinformation, and frequently misclassify non-misleading visualizations as deceptive.

2603.22369.tldr: The proposed SynLeaF framework employs a VAE-based cross-encoder with a product of experts mechanism to fuse four omics data types, while simultaneously utilizing a relational graph convolutional network to capture structured gene representations from biomedical knowledge graphs.

2603.22370.tldr: This work proposes Format-Aware Adaptive Rounding (FAAR), a learnable rounding strategy tailored for the NVFP4 format that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across various zero-shot downstream tasks.

2603.22372.tldr: Control Fusion Adapter (CFA), a simple plug-in method that enables controlled cross-modal interactions without modifying the TS backbone, integrating only relevant textual information aligned with TS dynamics, is proposed.

2603.22375.tldr: Motivated by layer-dependent denoising dynamics, Multi-layer Time Embedding Optimization (MTEO) is proposed, which freeze the pretrained diffusion backbone and distill a small set of step-wise, layer-wise time embeddings from reference trajectories.

2603.22376.tldr: An AI Co-Scientist framework that automates the full search ranking research pipeline: from idea generation to code implementation and GPU training job scheduling with expert in the loop, suggesting that AI systems can discover ranking architectures comparable to those developed by human experts while significantly reducing routine research workloads.

2603.22378.tldr: This research addresses the challenge of accurately classifying and segmenting GI images for real-time applications, where traditional methods often struggle due to the diversity and complexity of abnormalities, and introduces novel and adaptable methodologies.

2603.22379.tldr: This work tests whether nominal training objectives reliably align with realized cross-task capability gains by evaluating the same LoRA adapter across tasks, and refers to this nominal-versus-realized mismatch pattern as capability drift as a descriptive label.

2603.22380.tldr: Experimental results show that SGN can recover meaningful governing relations or solution forms under varying noise levels, and demonstrates improved robustness compared to baseline methods in sparse and noisy settings, suggesting that combining graph-based representations with symbolic regression provides a viable direction for robust data-driven discovery of physical laws from imperfect observations.

2603.22386.tldr: The goal is to provide a clear vocabulary, a unified framework for positioning new methods, a more comparable view of existing body of literature, and a more reproducible evaluation standard for future work in workflow optimizations for LLM agents.

2603.22399.tldr: A new style-based quantum GAN (QGAN) architecture for drug design that implements noise encoding at every rotational gate of the circuit and a gradient penalty in the loss function to mitigate mode collapse is proposed.

2603.22404.tldr: The study of arbitrage in AI model markets is initiated, empirically demonstrating the viability of arbitrage and illustrating its economic consequences, and suggesting that arbitrage can be a powerful force in AI model markets with implications for model development, distillation, and deployment.

2603.22435.tldr: CaP-X is presented, an open-access framework for systematically studying Code-as-Policy agents in robot manipulation, and CaP-Agent0, a training-free framework that recovers human-level reliability on several manipulation tasks in simulation and on real embodiments.

2603.22446.tldr: A systematic empirical study of RLVR's distributional effects organized around token-level characterization of distributional shifts between base and RL models, which sheds light on the distributional changes induced by RLVR and provides a fine-grained, token-level lens for understanding RLVR fine-tuning as a targeted refinement process.

2603.22466.tldr: The proposed ColorTrigger is an online training-free trigger that selectively activates color capture based on windowed grayscale affinity analysis, designed for real-time edge deployment and enabling practical always-on video sensing on resource-constrained devices.

2603.22469.tldr: This work introduces a stability-preserving update mechanism for nonlinear, neural-network-based controllers, and demonstrates the approach on nonlinear systems with time-varying objectives and disturbances, showing consistent performance improvements over static and naive online baselines while guaranteeing stability.

2603.22473.tldr: A functional component ablation framework applied to two sub-1B hybrid models provides actionable guidance for hybrid model compression, architecture design, and fault-tolerant deployment, revealing built-in functional redundancy between component types.

2603.22510.tldr: It is proposed that LLMs function as proximity tools that shift researchers from abstract, exploratory thinking toward concrete, convention-following execution, and contributes to the growing debate on whether LLM-driven productivity gains come at the cost of intellectual diversity.

2603.22518.tldr: A scalable and label-efficient approach for mapping inundation extent that enables modeling under data-scarce flood scenarios and indicates that HAND and slope provide only marginal value to inundation extent detection.

2603.22528.tldr: ChatP&ID is introduced, an agentic framework that enables grounded and cost-effective natural-language interaction with P&IDs using Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG), a paradigm the authors refer to as GraphRAG for engineering diagrams.

2603.22529.tldr: This work introduces Ego2Web, the first benchmark designed to bridge egocentric video perception and web agent execution, and develops a novel LLM-as-a-Judge automatic evaluation method, Ego2WebJudge, which achieves approximately 84% agreement with human judgment, substantially higher than existing evaluation methods.

2603.22558.tldr: Grounded in methods from statistical physics, a maximum-entropy relaxation of the problem of generating synthetic populations where each individual is described by categorical attributes and the target is a collection of global frequency constraints over attribute combinations is proposed.

2603.22561.tldr: Findings are consistent with reasoning-like internal organization under bounded conditions, while stopping short of any claim that the model reproduces full sequential processes of model construction, counterexample search, and conclusion revision.

2603.22577.tldr: STRIATUM-CTF (A Search-based Test-time Reasoning Inference Agent for Tactical Utility Maximization in Cybersecurity), a modular agentic framework built upon the Model Context Protocol (MCP), is introduced, suggesting that standardized context protocols are a critical path toward robust autonomous cyber-reasoning systems.

2603.22582.tldr: Faithfulness is not a fixed property of reasoning models but varies systematically with architecture, training method, and the nature of the influencing cue, suggesting that faithfulness is not a fixed property of reasoning models but varies systematically with architecture, training method, and the nature of the influencing cue.

2603.22587.tldr: A set of composing operations on this surface at query time as Programmatic Embedding Modulation (PEM) are described and integrated into a SQL interface via a query materializer that facilitates composable query primitives.

2603.22608.tldr: This paper performs a comprehensive evaluation of the multi-instance processing (MIP) ability of LLMs for tasks in which they excel individually and shows that all LLMs follow a pattern of slight performance degradation for small numbers of instances, followed by a performance collapse on larger instance counts.

2603.22617.tldr: Across five studies this research shows that consumers evaluate AI more positively than human agents in moral compliance roles, and that this preference arises from inferences of AI's lack of ulterior motives, which are often attributed to human agents.

2603.22619.tldr: DeIllusionLLM substantially reduces answer-despite-error failures under natural prompting while maintaining general reasoning performance, demonstrating that self-distillation is an effective and scalable solution for bridging the discriminative-generative know-act gap.

2603.22623.tldr: A grounding-sycophancy tradeoff is uncovered: models with the lowest hallucination propensity are the most sycophantic, while the most pressure-resistant model hallucinates more than all medical-specialist models.

2603.22624.tldr: A reproducible benchmark that tests intervention-based faithfulness, off-target leakage, perturbation robustness, and runtime on Pascal VOC and SBD across three pretrained backbones is introduced, and Dual-Evidence Attribution (DEA) is proposed, a lightweight correction that fuses gradient evidence with region-level intervention signals through agreement-weighted fusion.

2603.22629.tldr: The Lexically Grounded Subword Embedding Initialization (LGSE) framework, which introduces morphologically informed segmentation for initializing embeddings of novel tokens in underrepresented languages, and consistently outperforms baseline methods across all tasks.

2603.22633.tldr: GraLC-RAG is proposed, a framework that unifies late chunking with graph-aware structural intelligence, introducing structure-aware chunk boundary detection, UMLS knowledge graph infusion, and graph-guided hybrid retrieval.

2603.22634.tldr: A mechanistic account of how humans adapt their trust in AI confidence signals through experience is provided, which reveals that humans adapt by updating their baseline trust and confidence sensitivity, using asymmetric learning rates to prioritize the most informative errors.

2603.22648.tldr: A human-agent collaborative visualization system that combines a transparent user-steerable agentic workflow, a dynamically generated query exploring tree, visualizing the exploration path and provenance; and a semantic similarity view, depicting the relationships between papers is introduced.

2603.22651.tldr: A systematic benchmark comparing four multi-agent orchestration architectures: sequential pipeline, parallel fan-out with merge, hierarchical supervisor-worker and reflexive self-correcting loop is presented, providing actionable guidance for practitioners deploying multi-agent LLM systems in regulated financial environments.

2603.22655.tldr: A generalized Pre-trained Dynamics EncoDER (PDEDER) which can embed the original state observations into a latent space where the dynamics can be captured more easily, thereby facilitating more effective dynamics modeling than in the original observation space is conducted.

2603.22675.tldr: Dynomap is introduced, an end-to-end deep learning framework that learns a task-optimized spatial topology of features directly from data and enables vision-based models to operate effectively on unordered biomedical inputs.

2603.22677.tldr: MUQ-EVAL, an open-source per-sample quality metric for AIgenerated music built by training lightweight prediction heads on frozen MuQ-310M features using MusicEval, is introduced, is fully open-source, outperforms existing open per-sample metrics, and runs in real time on a single consumer GPU.

2603.22690.tldr: This work proposes WiFi2Cap, a three-stage framework for generating action captions directly from Wi-Fi CSI, and introduces a Mirror-Consistency Loss that reduces mirrored-action and left-right ambiguities during cross-modal alignment.

2603.22714.tldr: The results demonstrate that PSE-based evaluation reveals fairness issues masked by outcome-level measures, underscoring the need for causally-grounded auditing frameworks in AI-assisted hiring.

2603.22721.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework, Hyperbolic Feature Interpolation (HyFI), which interpolates between semantic and perceptual visual features along hyperbolic geodesics, which enables both the fusion and compression of perceptual and semantic information, effectively reflecting the limited expressiveness of brain signals and the entangled nature of these features.

2603.22744.tldr: This work introduces LH-Bench, a three-pillar evaluation design that moves beyond binary correctness to score autonomous, long-horizon execution on subjective enterprise tasks, and shows that domain-authored rubrics provide substantially more reliable evaluation signals than LLM-authored rubrics.

2603.22752.tldr: CliGNet is introduced, a neural architecture that combines a Bio ClinicalBERT text encoder with a two layer Graph Convolutional Network operating on a specialty label graph constructed from semantic similarity and ICD 10 chapter priors, offering actionable insights for clinical NLP system deployment.

2603.22765.tldr: DALDALL is introduced, a persona-based data augmentation framework tailored for legal information retrieval (IR) that employs domain-specific professional personas--such as attorneys, prosecutors, and judges--to generate synthetic queries that exhibit substantially greater lexical and semantic diversity than vanilla prompting approaches.

2603.22766.tldr: A novel uncertainty-based visualization driven by Bayesian estimation of agreement probability shows how the space of mutually acceptable agreements narrows as negotiation progresses, helping users identify promising options in human-AI negotiation.

2603.22767.tldr: RWE-bench is introduced, a benchmark grounded in MIMIC-IV and derived from peer-reviewed observational studies that evaluates six LLMs under three agent scaffolds using both question-level correctness and end-to-end task metrics to highlight persistent limitations in agents'ability to produce end-to-end evidence bundles.

2603.22770.tldr: The results suggest that shifting from continuous arithmetic weights to discrete Boolean lookups can provide a favorable accuracy-resilience trade-off for hardware fault tolerance.

2603.22777.tldr: This work generates a structured insect information dataset, and adapting a lightweight LLM model by fine tuning it for edge device uses in agricultural pest management and demonstrates the feasibility of deploying compact, high-performing language models for practical field-level pest management guidance.

2603.22790.tldr: A quantum algorithm for testing (forecasting) process of the Random Forest machine learning model for the Regression problem is presented, which is more efficient (in terms of query complexity or running time) than the classical counterpart.

2603.22791.tldr: ABSTRAL is introduced, a framework that treats MAS architecture as an evolving natural-language document, an artifact refined through contrastive trace analysis, and discovers specialist roles absent from any initial design.

2603.22793.tldr: NSCR is introduced, a neuro-symbolic framework that decomposes classroom analytics into four layers: perceptual grounding, symbolic abstraction, executable reasoning, and governance, and a benchmark and evaluation protocol organized around five tasks: classroom state inference, discourse-grounded event linking, temporal early warning, collaboration analysis, and multilingual classroom reasoning.

2603.22796.tldr: This work introduces PhotoAgent, an agent that achieves this by integrating Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) reasoning with a novel control paradigm, and confirms that PhotoAgent excels in spatial reasoning and achieves superior final image quality.

2603.22813.tldr: This work proposes Dynamic Preference Inference (DPI), a cognitively inspired framework in which an agent maintains a probabilistic belief over preference weights, updates this belief from recent interaction, and conditions its policy on inferred preferences.

2603.22815.tldr: PinPoint is proposed, a novel two-stage framework that first identifies instruction-relevant image regions and then refines them to extract fine-grained visual features for improved reasoning and efficiency.

2603.22819.tldr: TDATR (Table Detail-Aware Table Recognition) improves end-to-end TR through table detail-aware learning and cell-level visual alignment, and designs a structure-guided cell localization module integrated into the end-to-end TR framework, which efficiently locates cell and strengthens vision-language alignment.

2603.22829.tldr: B-DPO is proposed, which adaptively modulates optimization strength between preferred and dispreferred responses based on mutual information based on mutual information, and can enhance the safety capability while maintaining the competitive general capabilities of LLMs on various mainstream benchmarks compared to state-of-the-art methods.

2603.22840.tldr: An innovative Uncertainty-Integrated Anomaly Perception and Restoration Attention Network (URA-Net), which explicitly restores abnormal patterns to their corresponding normality, and leverages global normal semantic information to restore detected anomalous regions, thereby obtaining defect-free restored features.

2603.22841.tldr: UAV-DETR is introduced, a novel framework that integrates a small-target-friendly architecture with real-time detection capabilities and proposes an Efficient Cross-Scale Feature Recalibration and Fusion Network (ECFRFN) to suppress background noise and aggregate multi-scale semantics.

2603.22851.tldr: The UniQueR model learns a compact set of 3D anchor points that act as explicit geometric queries, enabling the network to infer scene structure, including geometry in occluded regions--in a single forward pass.

2603.22853.tldr: Agent Audit analyzes Python agent code and deployment artifacts through an agent-aware pipeline that combines dataflow analysis, credential detection, structured configuration parsing, and privilege-risk checks, enabling direct integration with local development workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

2603.22854.tldr: A Pre-Trained Propagation Tree Transformer (P2T3) method based on pure Transformer architecture that not only avoids the over-smoothing issue inherent in GNNs but also potentially offers a large model or unified multi-modal scheme for future social media research.

2603.22858.tldr: This work introduces the Dual-View Pheromone Pathway Network (DPPN), an architecture that routes sparse attention through a persistent pheromone field over latent slot transitions, and uses it to discover two independent requirements for persistent structural memory in neural networks.

2603.22868.tldr: This paper proposes Agent-Sentry, a framework that attempts to bound agentic systems to address the problem of non-trivial validate whether a system has successfully carried out the user's intended task or instead executed irrelevant actions, potentially as a consequence of compromise.

2603.22871.tldr: The Contraction Mapping Model is proposed, a novel architecture that reformulates discrete recursive reasoning into continuous Neural Ordinary and Stochastic Differential Equations (NODEs/NSDEs) and proves that mathematically rigorous latent dynamics can effectively replace brute-force scaling in artificial reasoning.

2603.22876.tldr: This study empirically examines the primary determinants of Sim-to-Real generalization across four dimensions: multi-level domain randomization, photorealistic rendering, physics-realistic modeling, and reinforcement learning updates.

2603.22877.tldr: This work introduces FourierSMT as a scalable and highly parallelizable continuous-variable optimization framework for SMT, and generalizes the Walsh-Fourier expansion (WFE) from the Boolean domain to a mixed Boolean-real domain, which allows the use of gradient methods for SMT.

2603.22879.tldr: A family of ambiguity-aware post-hoc calibrators that optimise proper scoring rules against the full label distribution and require no model retraining are developed.

2603.22153.tldr: Bearing-UAV is presented, a purely vision-driven cross-view navigation method that jointly predicts UAV absolute location and heading from neighboring features, enabling accurate, lightweight, and robust navigation in the wild.

2603.22900.tldr: This work introduces IPCW-IPS and IPCW-DR, which employ the Inverse Probability of Censoring Weighting technique to explicitly deal with censoring bias and extends this framework to constrained OPL to optimize policy value under budget constraints.

2603.22904.tldr: This work proposes a three-layer framework that separates diagnosis from control to achieve both properties simultaneously, and demonstrates that transparency need not compromise adaptive performance.

2603.22911.tldr: A novel and training-free token pruning method for video MLLMs, termed ForestPrune, which achieves effective and high-ratio pruning via Spatial-temporal Forest Modeling, and shows its superior performance and efficiency than the compared token compression methods.

2603.22912.tldr: The question of whether a more robust supranational agency dedicated to AI is still warranted is revisited and how such a body could enhance policy coherence, improve risk assessment capacities, and foster international cooperation is explored.

2603.22920.tldr: The article examines how the AI Act institutionalizes a human-centric approach to AI and how the AI Act’s provisions explicitly and implicitly embed the protection of rights enshrined in the EU Charter of Fundamental Rights.

2603.22935.tldr: It is shown that clinician-guided prompt optimization improves agreement with a radiologist-derived reference standard and that Ran Score enables finding-level evaluation of report fidelity, particularly for low-prevalence abnormalities.

2603.22942.tldr: It is demonstrated that transferring reasoning patterns enables compute-efficient smaller models to approach production-grade performance on NL2SQL tasks.

2603.22943.tldr: Experiments show that PersonalQ improves intent alignment over retrieval and reranking baselines, while TAQ consistently offers a stronger compression-quality trade-off than prior diffusion PTQ methods, enabling scalable serving of personalized checkpoints without sacrificing fidelity.

2603.22966.tldr: This paper proposes a principled framework for set-valued prediction, which provides feasibility-aware coverage guarantees and develops a data-driven calibration procedure that constructs prediction sets from sampled responses by estimating a rigorous threshold.

2603.22973.tldr: This work focuses on implicit citation of the French Civil Code in first-instance court decisions and introduces a benchmark of 1,015 passage-article pairs annotated by three legal experts, showing that expert disagreement predicts model failures and revealing an asymmetry.

2603.22977.tldr: DariMis, the first manually annotated dataset of 9,224 Dari-language YouTube videos, is addressed with DariMis, the first manually annotated dataset of 9,224 Dari-language YouTube videos labeled across two dimensions: Information Type (Misinformation, Partly True, True) and Harm Level (Low, Medium, High).

2603.22978.tldr: A novel textual representation of fault trees is proposed, and a benchmark for multi-turn dialogue systems that emphasizes robust interaction in complex environments is constructed, evaluating a model's ability to assist in malfunction localization.

2603.22984.tldr: This paper argues that architecture adaptivity is a necessary requirement for true GFMs, and introduces a framework that adapts effective GNN architecture at inference time by discovering and mixing task-specific linear graph operators, enabling zero-shot generalization across tasks with heterogeneous architectural requirements, without retraining.

2603.23003.tldr: This work aims to design aggregation mechanisms to automatically compare pairs of dental records that can be understood and validated by experts, improving the current methods.

2603.23004.tldr: This work introduces a challenging evaluation setup that requires a set of fundamental skills such as reasoning, structured input handling, arithmetic, and constrained optimization, and reveals that SoTA LLMs fail in most of the tasks, and that reasoning LLMs still fail in the most complex settings.

2603.23007.tldr: AgentRAE is proposed, a novel backdoor attack capable of inducing Remote Action Execution in mobile GUI agents using visually natural triggers using visually natural triggers (e.g., benign app icons in notifications) and preserves clean performance with an attack success rate of over 90% across ten mobile operations.

2603.23016.tldr: A rigorous empirical analysis shows that the apparent saturation of progress for SotA models is largely due to the use of inadequate metrics, and highlights that there is still much to be done to generate realistic tabular data.

2603.23020.tldr: This work introduces a novel redistribution strategy that extends Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) explanations for sigmoid-gated element-wise fusion layers for sigmoid-gated element-wise fusion layers on the widely used PIDNet and YOLO architectures.

2603.23030.tldr: A proxy anchor is introduced, constructed by aggregating tokens highly similar to the given query from all windows, which provides a unified semantic reference for measuring similarity across both inner- and outer-window patches and a dynamic normalization scheme that adjusts attention strength according to object scale by dynamically scaling and thresholding the attention map to cope with small-object scenarios.

2603.23037.tldr: The interpretable object detection capabilities of a novel Kolmogorov-Arnold network framework are examined here and it offers a powerful tool for transparent and practical perception component for autonomous and multimodal artificial intelligence applications.

2603.23041.tldr: A novel decomposition strategy that synthesizes CT images one HU interval at a time, rather than modelling the entire HU domain at once is introduced, establishing a new paradigm for structure-aware medical image synthesis, aligning generative modelling with clinical interpretation.

2603.23043.tldr: These findings suggest that when restricted to historical training dynamics, even high-capacity foundation models are sensitive to external forcing trajectories, and underscore the necessity of scenario-aware training and rigorous OOD evaluation protocols to ensure the robustness of climate emulators under a changing climate.

2603.23047.tldr: TriFEX is introduced, a human-validated, triple-based evaluation pipeline that attributes generated claims to their origin-user query, context and reference-and Parametric Knowledge Precision (PKP), which isolates internalized knowledge by filtering out claims leaked in the prompt is proposed.

2603.23048.tldr: MSRHuBERT, a multi-sampling-rate adaptive pre-training method that replaces HuBERT's single-rate downsampling CNN with a multi-sampling-rate adaptive downsampling CNN that maps raw waveforms from different sampling rates to a shared temporal resolution without resampling, enables unified mixed-rate pre-training and fine-tuning.

2603.23050.tldr: DBAutoDoc is a system that automates the discovery and documentation of undocumented relational database schemas by combining statistical data analysis with iterative large language model (LLM) refinement, finding that schema understanding is fundamentally an iterative, graph-structured problem.

2603.23059.tldr: This paper introduces Minibal (Minimize&Balance), a variant of Minimax specifically designed for balanced play, and proposes several modifications of the Unbounded Minimax algorithm explicitly aimed at discovering balanced strategies.

2603.23063.tldr: A systematic literature review of the research papers that proposed machine learning approaches, and focused on detecting burnout in software developers and IT professionals, to identify which ML tools and datasets show a better performance at detecting emotions, and indirectly at identifying burnout.

2603.23069.tldr: AuthorMix is proposed: a lightweight, modular, and interpretable style transfer framework that outperforms existing, SoTA style-transfer baselines -- as well as GPT-5.1 -- for low-resource targets, achieving the highest overall score and substantially improving meaning preservation.

2603.23073.tldr: This work used MicroPAD to evaluate an LLM's ability to detect instances of architectural patterns, particularly infrastructure-related microservice patterns, and found that patterns associated with recognizable, dominant artifacts were detected more reliably.

2603.23085.tldr: This work proposes MedCausalX, an end-to-end framework that outperforms state-of-the-art methods, improving diagnostic consistency by +5.4 points, reducing hallucination by over 10 points, and attaining top spatial grounding IoU, thereby setting a new standard for causally grounded medical reasoning.

2603.23146.tldr: This work investigates whether contemporary detectors genuinely identify machine authorship or merely exploit dataset-specific artefacts, and proposes an interpretable detection framework that integrates linguistic feature engineering, machine learning, and explainable AI techniques.

2603.23149.tldr: This work challenges the assumption that visual processing is necessary for failure prevention, and shows that a trained policy's latent state already encodes sufficient information to anticipate action outcomes, making visual simulation redundant for failure prevention.

2603.23178.tldr: SAiW enables reliable authentication and source attribution, providing a scalable foundation for proactive deepfake defense and trustworthy media provenance, and achieves high perceptual quality while maintaining strong robustness against compression, filtering, noise, geometric transformations, and adversarial perturbations.

2603.23183.tldr: SIDReasoner is a two-stage framework that elicits reasoning over SIDs by strengthening SID--language alignment by strengthening SID--language alignment to unlock transferable LLM reasoning, rather than relying on large amounts of recommendation-specific reasoning traces.

2603.23184.tldr: This work proposes ImplicitRM, which aims to learn unbiased reward models from implicit preference data, and derives a learning objective through likelihood maximization, which it is proved is theoretically unbiased, effectively resolving both challenges.

2603.23220.tldr: The paper develops a regime-varying framework centered on admissible transport, protected-core preservation, and evaluator-aware learning evolution, and establishes theorem-layer results on evaluator factorization, morphisms, composition, and partial kernel-level alignment across semantically commensurable layers.

2603.23231.tldr: This work introduces PERMA, a benchmark designed to evaluate persona consistency over time beyond static preference recall, and designs both multiple-choice and interactive tasks to probe the model's understanding of persona along the interaction timeline.

2603.23234.tldr: The proposed MemCollab is a collaborative memory framework that constructs agent-agnostic memory by contrasting reasoning trajectories generated by different agents on the same task, and introduces a task-aware retrieval mechanism that conditions memory access on task category, ensuring that only relevant constraints are used at inference time.

2603.23245.tldr: This work introduces a latent SDE model that combines an ODE with a GAN-trained stochastic component in latent space that provides a strong baseline, outperforming or matching general model-based and model-free approaches across stochastic continuous-control benchmarks.

2603.23249.tldr: This work proposes WeCAN, an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework for heterogeneous DAG scheduling that addresses task--pool compatibility coefficients and generation-induced optimality gaps, and designs a skip-extended realization with an analytically parameterized decreasing skip rule, which enlarges the reachable order set while preserving single-pass efficiency.

2603.23252.tldr: Numerical sensitivity analysis over feeder-link conditions, model complexity, and orbital intermittency yields operator-relevant feasibility regions that delineate when on-board inference and non-terrestrial learning loops are physically preferable to terrestrial offloading.

2603.23268.tldr: A unified safety interpretability framework that identifies functionally complete safety circuits in LLMs via optimization that introduces differentiable binary masks to extract multi-granular circuits through gradient descent on safety datasets, while integrates Safety Circuit Tuning to utilize these sparse circuits for efficient safety fine-tuning.

2603.23269.tldr: A token-level analysis of refusal behavior is conducted and it is observed that token contributions are highly skewed rather than uniform, enabling the use of a surrogate model to estimate token-level contributions to the target model's refusals.

2603.23271.tldr: This work introduces a multimodal framework for human-multi-agent interaction in which each robot operates as an autonomous cognitive agent with integrated multimodal perception and Large Language Model (LLM)-driven planning grounded in embodiment.

2603.23279.tldr: Analysis of the interaction network of Moltbook, a social platform composed entirely of LLM based agents, reveals strongly heterogeneous connectivity patterns characterized by heavy tailed degree and activity distributions, indicating that the interaction structure of AI agent social systems may develop strong centralization and structural fragility.

2603.23282.tldr: The results show that XGBoost achieves the best overall performance, with a test mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.989 across the two forecasting tasks, and demonstrate the strong effectiveness of tree-based ensemble learning for structured meteorological time-series forecasting and provide practical guidance for intelligent meteorological forecasting in mountainous cities.

2603.23292.tldr: This work argues for an Olympiad-style evaluation event where problems are sealed until evaluation, submissions are frozen in advance, and all entries run through one standardized harness to make strong performance harder to `` manufacture'' and easier to trust.

2603.23300.tldr: The concept of sensible screening is introduced and it is established that, under mild screening errors, the squared Sharpe ratio of the screened portfolio consistently estimates its target.

2603.23308.tldr: Ker-VLJEPA-3B, a four-phase curriculum learning framework for free-text report generation from thoracic CT volumes, and a modality-agnostic design that can integrate any self-supervised encoder into an LLM without paired text during foundation training are presented.

2603.23319.tldr: This work proposes WISTERIA (Weak Implicit Signal-based Temporal Relation Extraction with Attention), a framework that examines whether the top-K attention components conditioned on each event pair truly encode interpretable evidence for temporal classification.

2603.23322.tldr: This study leveraged Large Language Models to analyze more than 500 public social media posts from the X platform, extracting 42 distinct attributes related to user experience and behavior that indicate a distinction between engineering and the user-centric definition of system accuracy.

2603.23342.tldr: A lightweight mmWave radar material classification pipeline designed for ultra-low-power edge devices (TI IWRL6432), using compact range-bin intensity descriptors and a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) for real-time inference is presented.

2603.23346.tldr: RelayS2S serves as a lightweight, drop-in addition to existing cascaded pipelines that achieves P90 onset latency comparable to the S2S model while retaining 99% cascaded response quality in average score, with benefits growing as the slow-path model scales.

2603.23356.tldr: The results demonstrate that similarity-based representation learning combined with density-based aggregation is a promising alternative to object-centric approaches for point cloud segmentation in highly granular detectors.

2603.23375.tldr: A comprehensive survey of studies on NLIDBs for geospatial and temporal databases is presented, revealing recurring trends in existing methods, substantial variation in datasets and evaluation practices, and several open challenges that continue to hinder progress in this area.

2603.23398.tldr: Graph Energy Matching (GEM), a generative framework for graphs that learns a permutation-invariant potential energy that simultaneously provides transport-aligned guidance from noise toward data and refines samples within regions of high data likelihood, is introduced.

2603.23405.tldr: Taking inspiration from PIBT's priority inheritance logic, the concept of agent dependencies is defined and proposed Multi-Dependency PIBT (MD-PIBT) that searches over agent dependencies that is particularly effective in MAPF with large agents.

2603.23414.tldr: SortedRL is an online length-aware scheduling strategy designed to address this bottleneck by improving rollout efficiency and maintaining training stability, and reduces RL training bubble ratios by over 50%.

2603.23419.tldr: How delayed outcomes shape decision-making and responsibility attribution in a multi-agent human-AI task is studied, highlighting how cognitive biases can be amplified in human-AI systems with delayed outcomes and multiple autonomous agents.

2603.23420.tldr: Bilevel Autoresearch is presented, a bilevel framework where an outer loop meta-optimizes the inner autoresearch loop by generating and injecting new search mechanisms as Python code at runtime, using the same LLM.

2603.23433.tldr: This work combines the Bayesian persuasion framework with V-usable information, a generalization of Shannon information that is observer-relative, which yields a common scale (bits of usable information) for comparing a wide range of interventions, contexts, and models.

2603.23438.tldr: This research evaluates the feasibility of evasion attacks on IoT network-based IDSs, employing a novel black-box adversarial attack, and proposes a defense scheme tailored to mitigate the impact of evasion attacks, thereby reinforcing the resilience of ML-based IDSs.

2603.23443.tldr: The results indicate that current LLM-based test generation relies heavily on surface-level cues and struggles to maintain regression awareness as programs evolve.

2603.23447.tldr: 3DCity-LLM, a unified framework designed for 3D city-scale vision-language perception and understanding, significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, offering a promising and meaningful direction for advancing spatial reasoning and urban intelligence.

2603.23463.tldr: This work proposes InverFill, a one-step inversion method tailored for inpainting that injects semantic information from the input masked image into the initial noise, enabling high-fidelity few-step inpainting.

2603.23481.tldr: This work introduces the Video-Tactile Action Model (VTAM), a multimodal world modeling framework that incorporates tactile perception as a complementary grounding signal, and demonstrates superior performance in contact-rich manipulation.

2603.23482.tldr: ReqFusion: an AI-enhanced system that automates the extraction, classification, and analysis of software requirements utilizing multiple Large Language Model (LLM) providers utilizing multiple multi-provider providers is introduced.

2603.23485.tldr: It is shown that LLM outputs violate contextual invariance even under near-identical syntactic formulations, with implications for bias benchmarking and deployment in high-stakes settings.

2603.23495.tldr: Extensive experiments show that VISOR drastically reduces computational cost while matching or exceeding state-of-the-art results across a diverse suite of benchmarks, and excels in challenging tasks that require detailed visual understanding.

2603.23501.tldr: MedObvious is introduced, a 1,880-task benchmark that isolates input validation as a set-level consistency capability over small multi-panel image sets and shows that pre-diagnostic verification remains unsolved for medical VLMs and should be treated as a distinct, safety-critical capability before deployment.

2402.01720.tldr: A chatbot model that utilizes natural language processing and deep learning techniques to answer frequently asked questions in the Amharic language and effectively addressed challenges such as Amharic Fidel variation, morphological variation, and lexical gaps is proposed.

2508.05705.tldr: This work introduces physiologically-constrained neural network (NN) digital twins to simulate glucose dynamics in T1D and demonstrates how this approach enables personalized in silico testing of treatments, supports insulin optimization, and integrates physics-based and data-driven modeling.

2508.10164.tldr: This paper investigates how to reduce the generation length of LRMs with limited tuning and proposes Length Controlled Preference Optimization (LCPO) that directly balances the implicit reward related to NLL loss.

2508.09532.tldr: A hierarchical federated fine-tuning framework that coordinates roadside units (RSUs) and vehicles to support resource-aware and mobility-resilient learning across dynamic IoV scenarios and achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off among all baselines is proposed.

2505.10101.tldr: LAV (Latent Audio-Visual), a system that integrates EnCodec's neural audio compression with StyleGAN2's generative capabilities to produce visually dynamic outputs driven by pre-recorded audio, demonstrates the potential of using pretrained audio compression models for artistic and computational applications.

2502.05740.tldr: This paper designs and implements RECOVER, an LLM-powered RPM system for postoperative GI cancer care that features an LLM-powered conversational agent for cancer patients and an interactive dashboard for clinical staff to enable efficient postoperative RPM.

2507.18454.tldr: Sandwich is proposed, a full-stack CPU LLM serving system with three core innovations addressing these challenges: seamless phase-wise plan switching to eliminate cross-phase interference, TopoTree, a tree-based hardware abstraction for automated substructure-aware hardware allocation, and fast-start-then-finetune dynamic-shape tensor program generation.

2504.15801.tldr: Overall, LLMs seem to implement a coherent but rigid and sometimes biased model of interpersonal trust that only partially aligns with human judgment, highlighting both their potential and their limitations as decision-support tools and as models of human social cognition.

2504.09844.tldr: MegaScale-Data is presented, an industrial-grade distributed data loading architecture for multisource LFMs training, with three key innovations: disaggregated data preprocessing via role-specific actors (Source Loaders/Data Constructors) to eliminate source and parallelism redundant data access and ensure multisource scalability.

2509.06477.tldr: MAS-Bench addresses the lack of systematic benchmarks for GUI-shortcut hybrid mobile agents, providing a foundational platform for future advancements in creating more efficient and robust intelligent agents.

2310.02540.tldr: It is observed that Auto-FP can be modelled as either a hyperparameter optimization (HPO) or a neural architecture search (NAS) problem, which enables to extend a variety of HPO and NAS algorithms to solve the Auto- FP problem.

2507.16005.tldr: AutoMAT compresses alloy discovery from years to weeks, establishing a generalizable route toward autonomous materials design by integrating large language models, automated CALPHAD simulations, residual-learning-based correction, and AI-guided optimization.

2505.18232.tldr: Through extensive experimentation, it is shown that TRSP outperforms strong layer-wise structured pruning methods without requiring retraining, making it a promising solution for efficient LLM deployment.

2505.07591.tldr: MulDimIF, a multi-dimensional constraint framework encompassing three constraint patterns, four constraint categories, and four difficulty levels, is introduced and a controllable instruction generation pipeline is designed.

2509.06921.tldr: This systematic review analyzes 103 publications across the neural-symbolic integration spectrum in cybersecurity through April 2026 and finds that multi-agent and structured-integration architectures across the surveyed spectrum substantially outperform single-agent approaches in complex scenarios, causal reasoning enables proactive defense beyond correlation-based detection, and knowledge-guided learning improves both data efficiency and explainability.

2508.08791.tldr: An automated environment construction pipeline is proposed, incorporating scenario decomposition, document generation, function integration, complexity scaling, and localized deployment that enables the creation of high-quality training environments that provide detailed and measurable feedback without relying on external tools.

2507.13942.tldr: This work proposes a unified evaluation framework for assessing the forecasting capabilities of frozen vision backbones across diverse tasks and abstraction levels and finds that forecasting performance strongly correlates with perceptual quality and that the forecasting abilities of video synthesis models are comparable or exceed those pretrained in masking regimes across all levels of abstraction.

2506.03610.tldr: Orak is presented, a benchmark for training and evaluating LLM agents across 12 popular video games spanning all major genres and offers a united evaluation framework, including game leaderboards, LLM battle arenas, and \fix{ablation studies} of input modality, agentic strategies, and fine-tuning effects, establishing a foundation towards versatile gaming agents.

2505.19662.tldr: Evaluation results confirmed that performance evaluation considering the characteristics of Multimodal LLM (MLLM) such as GPT-4o is feasible and identified both the effectiveness and limitations of the proposed new evaluation methodology.

2508.05153.tldr: The proposed Feature-Conditioned bimanual Value Network (FCBV-Net), operating on 3D point clouds to specifically enhance category-level policy generalization for garment smoothing, demonstrates that the decoupling of geometric understanding from bimanual action value learning enables better category-level generalization.

2508.00555.tldr: This work proposes a concise and effective two-stage framework that achieves state-of-the-art Attack Success Rate, exhibits excellent transferability to black-box models, and maintains substantial effectiveness against prominent defense mechanisms.

2506.01247.tldr: Visual Sparse Steering (VS2), a lightweight, label-free adaptation method that constructs a steering vector from sparse features extracted by a Sparse Autoencoder trained on unlabeled in-domain training-split activations of the vision encoder, is presented.

2504.12482.tldr: Agentic AI Optimisation (AAIO) is introduced as an essential methodology for ensuring effective integration between websites and agentic AI systems, and its essential role as part of a fundamental digital infrastructure in the era of autonomous digital agents is affirmed.

2509.25549.tldr: A novel approach that combines mathematical/clustering segmentation models with insights from U-Net, leveraging the strengths of both methods is proposed, which improves accuracy, reduces the need for large-scale training data, and achieves significant performance gains on high-resolution fundus images.

2509.21823.tldr: ProRe is a proactive reward system that leverages a general-purpose reasoner and domain-specific evaluator agents (actors) that enables the reasoner to assign more accurate and verifiable rewards to GUI agents.

2509.18847.tldr: Structured reflection is proposed, which turns the path from error to repair into an explicit, controllable, and trainable action and offers a reproducible path for agents to learn from failure.

2509.02154.tldr: In per-class F1 evaluations, the model outperforms the conditional Gaussian VAE across highly imbalanced settings, and identifies the mild imbalance threshold $\rho<5$, for which Gaussian-based models remain competitive.

2603.29088.tldr: WybeCoder is proposed, an agentic code verification framework that enables prove-as-you-generate development, in which code, invariants, and proofs co-evolve.

2603.26259.tldr: This work focuses on two topics in Late Interaction retrieval: a length bias that arises when using multi-vector scoring, and the similarity distribution beyond the best scores pooled by the MaxSim operator.

2603.07053.tldr: A user-friendly framework for creating 3D animations of petascale, time-varying data on a commodity workstation that uses large-scale NASA climate-oceanographic datasets and can seamlessly incorporate as much high-resolution data as needed for the final version.

2603.28554.tldr: Hydra, a dual-head approach that provides both ColBERT-style late-interaction retrieval and autoregressive generation from a single vision-language model, is presented.

2603.20340.tldr: ContractSkill is presented, a framework that converts a draft skill into an executable artifact with explicit procedural structure, enabling deterministic verifica tion, fault localization, and minimal local repair.

2602.24119.tldr: This is the first systematic, reference-free expert human evaluation of LLM translation for any ancient language and the first study identifying textual properties predictive of translation failure.

2603.13417.tldr: Three protocol-level primitives are proposed to fill gaps in the Model Context Protocol: identity propagation, adaptive tool budgeting, and structured error semantics, and the Structured Error Recovery Framework (SERF), which provides machine-readable failure semantics that enable deterministic agent self-correction.

2603.27306.tldr: GUIDE, a non-parametric policy improvement framework that enables cross-episode adaptation without weight updates by evolving a structured, state-conditioned playbook of natural-language decision rules, is introduced.

2603.27064.tldr: This work introduces ChartNet, a high-quality, million-scale multimodal dataset designed to advance chart interpretation and reasoning, and aims to support the development of foundation models with robust and generalizable capabilities for data visualization understanding.

2604.01473.tldr: SelfGrader is a lightweight guardrail method that formulates jailbreak detection as a numerical grading problem using token-level logits, and introduces a dual-perspective scoring rule that considers both the maliciousness and benignness of the query, yielding a stable and interpretable score that reflects harmfulness and reduces the false positive rate simultaneously.

2604.01114.tldr: Investigating how students'trust relates to their appropriate reliance on an AI assistant during programming problem-solving tasks, and whether this relationship differs by learner characteristics showed a non-linear relationship in which higher trust was associated with lower appropriate reliance, suggesting weaker discrimination between correct and incorrect recommendations.

2603.25924.tldr: The Multimodal Coherence Score (MCS) is introduced, a metric that evaluates fusion quality independent of any downstream model, and decomposes coherence into four dimensions, identity, spatial, semantic, and decision.

2604.12812.tldr: This paper proposes a paradigm that requires the model to execute a structured Analysis, Localization and Reasoning workflow and shows it robustly generalizes from short-page training to ultra-long documents and is naturally synergistic with visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems.

2604.09581.tldr: Avenir-UX is presented, a user-experience evaluation agent that simulates user behavior on websites and produces standardized usability testing, and its multimodal grounding improves robustness for web-based interaction and UX evaluation scenarios.

2604.07823.tldr: This work presents LPM 1.0 (Large Performance Model), a single-person full-duplex audio-visual conversational performance model, focusing on single-person full-duplex audio-visual conversational performance, and proposes LPM-Bench, the first benchmark for interactive character performance.

2604.07165.tldr: T-STAR(Tree-structured Self-Taught Agent Rectification), a framework that recovers the latent correlated reward structure across seemingly independent trajectories, is proposed and achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines, with gains most pronounced on tasks requiring extended reasoning chains.

2604.02811.tldr: ChatSVA not only sets a new SOTA in automated SVA generation but also establishes a robust framework for solving long-chain reasoning problems in few-shot, domain-specific scenarios.

2604.13052.tldr: Moltbook is a socio-technical system where the technical layer responds to changes, but the social layer largely fails to emerge, and the form of social media is reproduced in full.

2604.13071.tldr: Earth Virtual Expert (EVE), the first open-source, end-to-end initiative for developing and deploying domain-specialized LLMs for Earth Intelligence, is introduced, the first open-source, end-to-end initiative for developing and deploying domain-specialized LLMs for Earth Intelligence.

2604.13070.tldr: A structured dataset is constructed and presented in an unsuitable format for techniques such as Machine Learning to allow more progress in the field of Palaeohispanic languages.

2604.13056.tldr: This paper shows how Qwen embeddings, UMAP, semantic indicators derived directly from the model output space, and a three-stage anomaly-detection procedure combine into an operational text-as-signal workflow for AI engineering tasks such as corpus inspection, monitoring, and downstream analytical support.

2604.13047.tldr: An Agent-Based model to simulate in a scientifically sound way both complex fake news dynamics and the effects produced by containment strategies therein; Deep Reinforcement Learning to learn the strategies that can better mitigate the spread of misinformation.

2604.13042.tldr: A Pythonic functional approach to semantic data harmonisation that enables users to produce correct RDF through simple function calls and is applicability within the ILIAD Aquaculture pilot.

2604.13041.tldr: This work presents TableNet dataset, a new table structure recognition dataset collected and generated through multiple sources, and is the first work which employs active learning into the structure recognition of tables which is diverse in numbers of rows or columns, merged cells, cell contents, etc, which fits better for diversity-based active learning.

2604.11465.tldr: This work introduces a three-tier inference scaffolding pipeline that deploys the same frozen model in three distinct roles: a summarization model that preserves critical artifacts while compressing dialogue history; the main agent model that reasons over the compressed context; and an isolated correction model that reviews and revises the agent's code output without access to conversation history, breaking repetitive failure loops.

2604.11165.tldr: Under a sequential missing-at-random mechanism, a doubly robust Q-learning framework for estimating optimal policies is developed, which introduces path-specific inverse probability weights that account for heterogeneous test trajectories and satisfy a normalization property conditional on the observed history.

2604.10458.tldr: The Physics-Aware Spiking Neural Network (PAS-Net) is proposed, a fully multiplier-free architecture explicitly tailored for Green HAR that establishes a robust, ultra-low-power neuromorphic standard for always-on wearable sensing.

2604.10135.tldr: This work establishes a simple yet effective technique for enhancing LLM's capabilities, offering promising directions for cognitive-inspired LLM enhancement paradigm.

2604.09613.tldr: This work proposes token-budget-aware pool routing: estimate each request's total token budget using a self-calibrating per-category bytes-per-token ratio, then dispatch it to one of two vLLM pools -- a high-throughput short pool or a high-capacity long pool -- each right-sized for its workload class.

2604.08064.tldr: ImplicitMemBench is introduced, the first systematic benchmark evaluating implicit memory through three cognitively grounded constructs drawn from standard cognitive-science accounts of non-declarative memory: Procedural Memory, Priming, and Classical Conditioning.

2604.12213.tldr: It is shown that modality-native routing in Agent-to-Agent (A2A) networks improves task accuracy by 20 percentage points over text-bottleneck baselines, but only when the downstream reasoning agent can exploit the richer context that native routing preserves.

2604.11312.tldr: A network generation model with controlled homophily and class sizes is used to examine how LLM agents behave collectively in multi-round debates, highlighting a particular directional susceptibility that is termed agreement drift.

2604.09860.tldr: RoboLab offers a scalable framework for evaluating the true generalization capabilities of task-generalist robotic policies, and introduces a systematic analysis of real-world policies that quantify both their performance and the sensitivity of their behavior to controlled perturbations, indicating that high-fidelity simulation can serve as a proxy for analyzing performance and its dependence on external factors.

2604.08261.tldr: A novel dual-branch multimodal framework is proposed by introducing a text-image branch and a vision branch that fully exploits multimodal representations to identify OOD samples through these two complementary branches.

2604.07709.tldr: IatroBench measures the gap in identity-contingent withholding: match the same clinical question in physician vs. layperson framing and all five testable models provide better guidance to the physician.

2604.06448.tldr: A graph-based anomaly detection system that identifies under-represented services using unsupervised node-level graph embeddings and introduces a preliminary synthetic anomaly injection framework for controlled evaluation that shows promising precision and low false positive rate.

2604.13066.tldr: It is demonstrated that LLMs can learn encoding keys in-context and perform analysis directly on encoded representations, enabling cost-effective analysis of large-scale repetitive datasets, even as data patterns evolve over time.

2604.13061.tldr: This work shows that conversational structural consistency can be monitored directly from token frequency statistics, without embeddings, auxiliary evaluators or access to model internals, and that structural monitoring from the observable token stream can complement semantic evaluation in deployment.

2604.13054.tldr: This work argues that the primary bottleneck in multimodal scaling is not task format, but knowledge density in training data, and advocates for knowledge-centric multimodal training as a principled foundation for scalable multimodal models.

2604.13048.tldr: A catalog-driven framework that translates natural language questions into executable PromQL queries, bridging the gap between human intent and observability data is presented and integrated with the Model Context Protocol to enable tool-augmented LLM interactions across multiple providers.

2604.10015.tldr: FinTrace is introduced, a benchmark comprising 800 expert-annotated trajectories spanning 34 real-world financial task categories across multiple difficulty levels, and FinTrace-Training is constructed, the first trajectory-level preference dataset for financial tool-calling, containing 8,196 curated trajectories with tool-augmented contexts and preference pairs.

2604.11840.tldr: It is argued that this assumption can fail when the objective is not to solve a strategic problem, but to sample plausible boundedly rational behavior, and behavioral simulation should qualify models as samplers, not only as solvers.

2604.11641.tldr: Experiments show that CodeTracer substantially outperforms direct prompting and lightweight baselines, and that replaying its diagnostic signals consistently recovers originally failed runs under matched budgets.

2604.11284.tldr: TheIA, a 2.75M modular neural architecture that learns the complete Kleene three-valued logic (K3) truth table from task data without external symbolic inference or hand-encoded K3 gate primitives, achieves all 39 K3 rules at>99% per-rule accuracy.

2604.11026.tldr: The result reveals an intrinsic stability property of KL divergence under Gaussian perturbations, extending classical Gaussian-only relaxed triangle inequalities to general distributions and enables KL-based reasoning in non-Gaussian settings arising in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

2604.09687.tldr: Grid2Matrix (G2M), a controlled benchmark in which a model is shown a color grid and a color-to-number mapping, and must output the corresponding matrix, is introduced, finding that VLMs exhibit a sharp early collapse in zero-shot end-to-end evaluation, failing on surprisingly small grids rather than degrading gradually as the task becomes denser.

2604.08958.tldr: WOMBET learns a world model in the source task and generates offline data via uncertainty-penalized planning, followed by filtering trajectories with high return and low epistemic uncertainty, and performs online fine-tuning in the target task using adaptive sampling between offline and online data.

2604.02709.tldr: ChomskyBench is a benchmark for systematically evaluating LLMs through the lens of Chomsky Hierarchy, and is the first to combine full Chomsky Hierarchy coverage, process-trace evaluation via natural language, and deterministic symbolic verifiability.

2604.13059.tldr: An end-to-end proactive EMR assistant built around streaming speech recognition, punctuation restoration, stateful extraction, belief stabilization, objectified retrieval, action planning, and replayable report generation is presented.

2604.13049.tldr: A minimal agent-based model is developed in which users choose what to rate partly on the basis of currently displayed averages, suggesting that recommendation robustness depends not only on attack detection and predictive accuracy, but also on review density, popularity feedback, and user response heterogeneity.

2604.13037.tldr: A novel key point-based \textit{MLCS} algorithm for mining big sequences is proposed, called \textit{KP-MLCS}, and a new method is presented, which can compactly represent all mined \textit{MLCSs} and quickly reveal common patterns among them.

2604.12102.tldr: Spatial Atlas instantiates CGR as a single Agent-to-Agent server that handles two challenging benchmarks and shows that CGR yields competitive accuracy while maintaining interpretability through structured intermediate representations and deterministic spatial computations.

2604.12865.tldr: This work constructs a biologically inspired digital twin of the visual hierarchy that encodes an image into low-level features, generates a contour sketch, and iteratively refines it through top-down feedback guided by semantic representations, mirroring the feedforward and recurrent architecture of the human visual cortex.

2604.11665.tldr: Results show a reinterpretation of the Newton-Leibniz dispute and a phase transition from sparse convergence to a post-Leibniz"superhighway", with structural indicators supporting a Kuhnian paradigm shift.

2604.09752.tldr: The ``Model Scaling Paradox'' is revealed, and the kernel synchronization overhead of fine-grained speculative decoding under NPU computational graph compilation, and the severe limitations of purely relying on micro-level acceleration algorithms like Prompt LookUp Decoding (PLD) are pointed out.

2604.08791.tldr: eBandit, a framework that relocates both network monitoring and ABR algorithm selection into the Linux kernel using eBPF, is presented, demonstrating that kernel-resident bandit learning transfers to heterogeneous mobile conditions.

2604.05808.tldr: STEP-HRL is proposed, a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that enables step-level learning by conditioning only on single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories, and substantially outperforms baselines in terms of performance and generalization while reducing token usage.

2604.13065.tldr: The Novel Operator Test is introduced, a benchmark that separates operator logic from operator name, enabling rigorous distinction between genuine reasoning and pattern retrieval, and demonstrates a reasoning-output dissociation that existing benchmarks cannot detect.

2604.13055.tldr: This work presents WorkRB (Work Research Benchmark), the first open-source, community-driven benchmark tailored to work-domain AI, which enables both monolingual and cross-lingual evaluation settings through dynamic loading of multilingual ontologies.

2604.13316.tldr: It is suggested that optimal training data for neural operators is architecture-dependent: because different architectures concentrate sensitivity in distinct input subspaces, uniform sampling cannot adequately cover the vulnerability landscape of all models.

2604.13304.tldr: It is shown that CLTs achieve high reconstruction fidelity with post-MLP activations while preserving and even improving, in some cases, CLIP zero-shot classification accuracy and interpretability, and that the cross-layer contribution scores provide faithful attribution.

2604.13242.tldr: This paper argues that LLM agents exhibit functionalist creativity, albeit not at its most sophisticated levels, while they continue to lack key aspects of ontological creativity, and discusses whether it is desirable for agentic systems to attain both forms of creativity, evaluating potential benefits and risks, and proposing pathways toward artificial creativity that can enhance human society.

2604.13217.tldr: A multitask embedding-based approach for the automated analysis and prediction of key blastocyst components, including the trophectoderm (TE), inner cell mass (ICM), and blastocyst expansion (EXP) is proposed.

2604.13206.tldr: A rigorous analysis of how unpredictability is rooted in the finite numerical precision of floating-point representations is presented, tracking how rounding errors propagate, amplify, or dissipate through Transformer computation layers.

2604.13101.tldr: This paper proposes a novel, end-to-end framework that synergistically combines LLMs and Knowledge Graphs (KGs) to enhance the trustworthiness of safety analytics and demonstrates improved accuracy and traceability over LLM-only approaches.

2604.13285.tldr: Learning to Defer for clinical text (L2D-Clinical), a framework that learns when a BERT classifier should defer to an LLM based on uncertainty signals and text characteristics, enables adaptive deferral-improving accuracy when the LLM complements BERT.

2604.13279.tldr: A lightweight and explainable framework for skeleton-based fall detection that combines an efficient LSTM model with T-SHAP, a temporally aware post-hoc aggregation strategy that stabilizes SHAP-based feature attributions over contiguous time windows is proposed.

2604.13243.tldr: A code-free, large language model (LLM)-driven pipeline that converts natural language instructions into an end-to-end analysis that achieves accuracy comparable to traditional methods while substantially reducing technical overhead is introduced.

2604.13236.tldr: This work presents SemiFA, an agentic multi-modal framework that autonomously generates structured FA reports from semiconductor inspection images in under one minute, and is the first system to integrate SECS/GEM equipment telemetry into a vision-language model pipeline for autonomous FA report generation.

2604.13226.tldr: KV Packet is proposed, a recomputation-free cache reuse framework that treats cached documents as immutable ``packets''wrapped in light-weight trainable soft-token adapters, which are trained via self-supervised distillation to bridge context discontinuities.

2604.13108.tldr: This work investigates whether providing agents with formal architecture descriptors can reduce this navigational overhead, and proposes intent.lisp, an S-expression architecture descriptor, and open-source the Forge toolkit.

2604.13107.tldr: It is found that the agent reliably completes simple tasks but exhibits characteristic failures on complex tasks, suggesting that bridging domain logic and code execution is a key bottleneck to generalizability.

2604.13102.tldr: The CCCE reduces mean time to remediation by enabling coordinated, cross-repository calibrations with human-in-the-loop (HITL) oversight where appropriate, and provides end-to-end traceability from triggering events through calibration execution and outcome learning.

2604.13100.tldr: Contract-Coding is proposed, a structured symbolic paradigm that bridges unstructured intent and executable code via Autonomous Symbolic Grounding that enforces topological independence, effectively isolating inter-module implementation details, decreasing topological execution depth and unlocking Architectural Parallelism.

2604.13381.tldr: Insight into young people's attitudes, needs, and requirements regarding genAI chatbots in youth mental health, with key implications for service integration, is offered.

2604.13367.tldr: A dedicated head-and-neck radiotherapy-induced normal tissue injury dataset is curate covering three manifestations: osteoradionecrosis (ORN), cerebral edema (CE), and cerebral radiation necrosis (CRN) and a 3D SAM-based progressive prompting framework for multi-task segmentation in limited-data settings is proposed.

2604.13244.tldr: This report summarizes the MaCVi 2026 challenge setup, evaluation protocols, datasets, and benchmark tracks, and presents quantitative results, qualitative comparisons, and cross-challenge analyses of emerging method trends.

2604.13175.tldr: It is demonstrated that STOMP is a powerful, robust multi-objective alignment algorithm that can meaningfully improve post-trained models for multi-attribute protein optimization and beyond.

2604.13123.tldr: Crucially, MLPs show entropy collapse without grokking, proving collapse is necessary but not sufficient -- architecture matters.

2604.13109.tldr: The human contributions that remain indispensable, including selecting the target, verifying experimental validity, assessing novelty and impact, providing computational resources, and writing with appropriate AI-use disclosure are analysed.

2604.13097.tldr: Results show that contract-aware composition substantially reduces unsafe or invalid module combinations, and that contract-guided release checks improve upgrade safety and rollback readiness compared with schema-only or ad hoc baselines, suggesting that stable embodied software ecosystems require more than modular packaging: they require explicit contracts that connect capability composition, governance, and evolution.

2604.13088.tldr: This paper proposes minimal intra-group transformations to restore or approximate the cancellation structure in the shared token space, and demonstrates that these transformations stabilize training, improve sample efficiency, and enhance final performance, validating the value of this design condition.

2604.13076.tldr: The exploratory results suggest document-based value interventions may require explicit preservation strategies to remain effective through typical training pipelines, and suggest document-based value interventions may require explicit preservation strategies to remain effective through typical training pipelines.

2604.13085.tldr: Adaptive Memory Crystallization is conceptually inspired by the qualitative structure of synaptic tagging and capture theory, the idea that memories transition through discrete stability phases, but makes no claim to model the underlying molecular or synaptic mechanisms.

2604.13356.tldr: PST is proposed, a label-free fine-tuning framework in which multiple language models improve collaboratively by leveraging a cross-model aggregated response as an internal training signal, and suggests that cross-model generations and peer-predictive feedback can serve as an effective approach for self-supervised training.

2604.13318.tldr: This work introduces WebXSkill, a framework that bridges the grounding gap in existing skill formulations with executable skills, each pairing a parameterized action program with step-level natural language guidance, enabling both direct execution and agent-driven adaptation.

2604.13283.tldr: Conservative Constraint Acquisition~(CCA) is introduced, a domain-specific procedure designed to identify justified constraints efficiently in practice while limiting unnecessary tightening of the learned model.

2604.13262.tldr: This work forms segmentation as a two-stage pipeline, estimation followed by decision, and shows that optimizing uncertainty alone fails to capture most of the achievable safety gains, and suggests that uncertainty should be evaluated based on the decisions it enables, rather than in isolation.

2604.13252.tldr: It is argued that multimodal anomaly detection should be reframed as a cross-modal contextual inference problem, in which modalities play asymmetric roles, separating context from observation, to define abnormality conditionally rather than relative to a single global reference.

2604.13248.tldr: This paper presents a Digital Twin architecture for hybrid autonomous-teleoperated medical response systems that integrates perception and adaptive navigation with a Digital Twin, synchronized in real-time, that mirrors system states, environmental dynamics, patient conditions, and mission objectives.

2604.13218.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage method to estimate the latent variables by enforcing sparsity and Gaussianity in the learned representations, and provides a series of progressively stronger identifiability results for this challenging setting in which the probability density functions are ill-defined.

2604.13201.tldr: InfiniteScienceGym is presented, a procedurally generated benchmark of scientific repositories paired with a verifiable question-answering task that complements real scientific benchmarks by targeting blind spots and failure modes that are hard to evaluate using published datasets alone.

2604.13082.tldr: It is found that the encoder organizes parity and residue structure within the first few thousand training steps, while output accuracy remains near chance for tens of thousands more, andCausal interventions support the decoder bottleneck hypothesis.

2604.13075.tldr: This work establishes the foundational infrastructure for accessible, low-latency, and privacy-preserving officer training systems at the edge with fine-tuned Qwen 2.5 (3B-Instruct) surpasses the general-purpose Gemini 2.5 Flash model, demonstrating that domain-optimized SLMs can achieve superior performance with a fraction of the computational cost.

2604.13072.tldr: This work derives a Triple-Axis Complexity Framework that characterizes task difficulty along three dimensions: Environment Complexity, Cognitive Demand, and Runtime Adaptability, and constructs a pilot benchmark with explicit complexity-factor annotations, covering real-world assistant tasks with compositional difficulty.

2604.13151.tldr: A metric to quantify exploration and exploitation errors from agent's actions is designed to enable policy-agnostic evaluation and finds that even state-of-the-art models struggle on the authors' task, with different models exhibiting distinct failure modes.

2604.13073.tldr: OmniTrace is introduced, a lightweight and model-agnostic framework that formalizes attribution as a generation-time tracing problem over the causal decoding process and suggests that treating attribution as a structured generation-time tracing problem provides a scalable foundation for transparency in omni-modal language models.

2604.13258.tldr: HETA combines three complementary components: a semantic transition vector that captures token-to-token influence across layers, Hessian-based sensitivity scores that model second-order effects, and KL divergence to measure information loss when tokens are masked.

2604.13286.tldr: It is found that increasing language coverage during post-training is largely beneficial across tasks and model scales, with low-resource languages benefiting the most and high-resource languages plateauing rather than degrading.

2604.13203.tldr: An AI system that converts standard kitchen photos into MCI-friendly designs using the Home Design Guidelines using theHDG is created, providing a low-cost, scalable way for older adults and caregivers to visualize and implement DIY kitchen changes, supporting aging in place and resilience for those with MCI.

2604.13180.tldr: This work presents a safe, lightweight, and user-friendly agentic framework for the autonomous execution of well-defined scientific tasks, which combines an isolated execution environment, a three-layer agent loop, and a self-assessing do-until mechanism to ensure safe and reliable operation.

2604.13127.tldr: This work introduces Graph-Propagated Projection Unlearning (GPPU), a unified and scalable algorithm for class-level unlearning that operates across both vision and audio models, and provides a principled and modality-agnostic approach to machine unlearning.

2604.13114.tldr: The results indicate that the hybrid design improves detection performance and produces more useful repair suggestions than either graph-only or language-model-only approaches.

2604.13081.tldr: This work systematically explores the goodness-function design space and identifies a unifying principle: the goodness function must be sensitive to the shape of neural activity, not its total energy, and proposes two complementary families: selective functions that measure only peak activity and shape-sensitive functions that reward heavy-tailed distributions via scale-invariant statistics.

2604.13079.tldr: This paper argues that behavioral correction is structurally analogous to an economy without property rights, where order requires perpetual policing and does not scale, and proposes alignment as institutional design such that aligned behavior emerges as the lowest-cost strategy for each component.

2604.13609.tldr: This work designs a simple override mechanism that yields control to a safe mentor whenever the predicted value drops below a fixed threshold, and proves two properties of the resulting agent: capability and safety.

2604.13552.tldr: TF-TTCL is proposed, a training-free adaptation framework that enables a frozen LLM to improve online by distilling supervision from its own inference experiences by dynamically steer the frozen LLM toward robust reasoning patterns while avoiding observed errors.

2604.13517.tldr: This paper systematically demonstrate that exposing a temporal attention routing mechanism to policy gradients results in surrogate objective hacking, while adopting gradient-free uncertainty weighting triggers irreversible myopic degeneration, a phenomenon the authors term the Paradox of Temporal Uncertainty.
