2604.14389.tldr: This work proposes a conservative rewrite candidate for each response claim via staged de-colloquialisation, combining lightweight surface normalisation with scoped in-claim coreference resolution with BiCon-Gate, a semantics-aware consistency gate that selects the rewrite candidate only when it is semantically supported by the dialogue context, otherwise falling back to the original claim.

2604.14604.tldr: This work reveals a previously overlooked threat, auditory prompt injection, under realistic constraints of audio data-only access and strong perceptual stealth in LALMs, and proposes AudioHijack, a general framework that generates context-agnostic and imperceptible adversarial audio to hijack LALMs.

2604.14602.tldr: This work proposes CAUSALDETOX, a framework that identifies and intervenes on the specific attention heads causally responsible for toxic generation, using the Probability of Necessity and Sufficiency (PNS) to isolate a minimal set of heads that are necessary and sufficient for toxicity.

2604.14585.tldr: This work provides a two-stage diagnostic: an \$80 ANOVA pre-test for agent coupling, and a 10-minute headroom test that predicts whether optimization is worthwhile -- turning a coin flip into an informed decision.

2604.14550.tldr: The results demonstrate that VeriGraphi enables reliable hierarchical RTL generation with minimal human intervention for RISC-V, marking a significant milestone for LLM-generated hardware design while maintaining strong functional correctness.

2604.14525.tldr: Across four reasoning domains, the solver-augmented approach substantially reduces cross-query contradictions while preserving per-query accuracy, demonstrating that global coherence is critical for robust multi-query reasoning.

2604.14514.tldr: A community-wide focus on three foundational principles: Provenance, Openness, and Evaluation Transparency to improve equity and robustness in biomedical AI is proposed to foster biomedical innovation that more effectively serves underserved populations and improves health outcomes.

2604.14477.tldr: This work proposes an effective method for Automatic Visual Circuit Discovery (Vi-CD) that recovers class-specific circuits for classification, identifies circuits underlying typographic attacks in CLIP, and discovers circuits that lend themselves for steering to correct harmful model behavior.

2604.14455.tldr: This work introduces AIBuildAI, an AI agent that automatically builds AI models from a task description and training data and demonstrates that hierarchical agent systems can automate the full AI model development process from task specification to deployable model, suggesting a pathway toward broadly accessible AI development with minimal human intervention.

2604.14444.tldr: This study evaluates the susceptibility of four widely used classifiers, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting Machine, Logistic Regression, and Deep Neural Network models, against multiple poisoning strategies using three real-world IoT datasets, showing that while ensemble-based models exhibit comparatively stable performance, Logistic Regression and Deep Neural Networks suffer degradation of up to 40% under label manipulation and outlier-based attacks.

2604.14878.tldr: GenRec, a preference-oriented generative framework deployed on the JD App that addresses above challenges within a single decoder-only architecture, is presented and GRPO-SR, a reinforcement learning method that pairs Group Relative Policy Optimization with NLL regularization for training stability, is introduced.

2604.14846.tldr: Paza is presented, a zero-shot retail theft detection framework that achieves practical concealment detection without training any model, and a privacy-preserving design that obfuscates faces in the detection pipeline is introduced.

2604.14829.tldr: It is suggested that current evaluation practices over penalize valid clinical reasoning and may measure artifacts of evaluation design rather than true errors, underscoring the need for clinically informed evaluation in high context domains like medicine.

2604.14807.tldr: It is argued that the opacity, fluency, and low-friction interaction patterns of LLMs obscure the boundary between human and machine contribution, leading users to infer competence from outputs rather than from the processes that generate them.

2604.14788.tldr: This work establishes a generalizable framework for automated MR sequence design, highlighting the potential to explore configurations beyond conventional designs based on human intuition.

2604.14768.tldr: CoTEvol is proposed, a genetic evolutionary framework that casts CoT generation as a population-based search over reasoning trajectories and improves correct-CoT synthesis success by over 30% and enhances structural diversity, with markedly improved efficiency.

2604.14683.tldr: This work proposes DR$^{3}-Eval, a realistic and reproducible benchmark for evaluating deep research agents on multimodal, multi-file report generation and introduces a multi-dimensional evaluation framework measuring Information Recall, Factual Accuracy, Citation Coverage, Instruction Following, and Depth Quality.

2604.14682.tldr: It is found that task type is a stronger predictor of acceptance than tree depth, and chat produces the highest entropy yet the highest acceptance rate, which has direct implications for domain-aware speculation budgets and draft-model selection strategies.

2604.14624.tldr: This work identifies two key properties of effective clarification: task relevance and user answerability and operationalizes these properties as multi-stage reinforcement learning rewards to train CLARITI, an 8B-parameter clarification module that matches GPT-5's resolution rate on underspecified issues while generating 41% fewer questions.

2604.14616.tldr: The proposed Retrieval-Augmented Set Completion (RASC) is demonstrated, which retrieves the most similar existing value sets from a curated corpus to form a candidate pool, then applies a classifier to each candidate code.

2604.14613.tldr: This work proposes U-GLAD (Uncertainty-aware Generative Learning Path Recommendation with Cognition-Adaptive Diffusion), a generative diffusion model that employs a generative diffusion model to predict the latent representation of the next optimal concept.

2604.14858.tldr: This report presents ATBench-Claw and ATBench-CodeX, two domain-customized extensions that carry ATBench into the OpenClaw and OpenAI Codex / Codex-runtime settings, and focuses on taxonomy customization, domain-specific risk coverage, and benchmark design under a shared ATBench generation framework.

2604.14790.tldr: Diffusion crossover is proposed, which formulates evolutionary recombination as step-wise interpolation of noise sequences in the reverse process of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs).

2604.14746.tldr: The proposed SDM-SCR, a robust framework anchored in Approximate Orthogonal Decomposition, leverages the instruction-following capability of Large Language Models to actively parse raw attributes into asymmetric, task-oriented signal and noise views to ensure rigorous signal purification.

2604.14726.tldr: DyMETER is a dynamic concept adaptation framework for OAD that unifies on-the-fly parameter shifting and dynamic thresholding within a single online paradigm and significantly outperforms existing OAD approaches across a wide spectrum of application scenarios.

2604.14712.tldr: SGA-MCTS achieves System 2 reasoning depth at System 1 inference speeds, rendering autonomous planning both scalable and real-time feasible, and enables frozen, open-weights models to match the performance of SOTA systems without task-specific fine-tuning.

2604.14687.tldr: Shallow, full-width Minimax search is incorporated into the rollout phase of multi-agent MCTS to enhance strategic depth and demystify the resulting decision-making logic, and M2-PALE (MCTS--Minimax Process-Aided Linguistic Explanations) is introduced.

2604.14661.tldr: AIPC (AI Porting Conversion), an AI agent-driven approach for constrained automation of AI model deployment, decomposes deployment into standardized, verifiable stages and injects deployment-domain knowledge into agent execution through Agent Skills, helper scripts, and a stage-wise validation loop.

2604.14645.tldr: A simple and effective chaos-based feature transformation is proposed to enhance CNN performance without increasing model complexity, and consistent improvements across different chaotic maps indicate that the performance gain is driven by the shared nonlinear and dynamical properties of chaotic systems.

2604.14641.tldr: Improvements transfer to three external spatial reasoning benchmarks, demonstrating that, much as sketching sharpens human spatial thinking, learning to construct explicit layouts instills spatial understanding that generalizes beyond the training format.

2604.14631.tldr: StoryCoder is a narrative reformulation framework that transforms code generation questions into coherent natural language narratives, providing richer contextual structure than simple rephrasings and suggesting that structured problem representation is important for code generation regardless of model scale or architecture.

2604.14867.tldr: This paper studies feedback-based automated verification of LLM-generated adaptation managers in Collective Adaptive Systems (CAS) and suggests that feedback precision is the dominant factor for reliable vibe coding in systems designed by domain experts with no programming skills, thereby obviating the need for human code inspection.

2604.14847.tldr: This paper systematically characterize the capability boundaries of SRMs and identifies three common types of reasoning risks: path divergence, where SRMs lack the strategic ability to construct an initial plan, causing reasoning to deviate from the most probable path; cognitive overload, where SRMs fail to solve particularly difficult steps; and recovery inability, where SRMs lack robust self-reflection and error correction mechanisms.

2604.14786.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that CogEvolution not only significantly outperforms baseline models in behavioral fidelity and learning curve fitting but also uniquely reproduces plausible and robust cognitive evolutionary paths consistent with educational psychology expectations, providing a novel paradigm for constructing highly interpretable educational agents.

2604.14718.tldr: It is argued that continuous learning and diversity of ideas are essential if AI is to play a meaningful role in original scientific discovery and how AI is likely to fundamentally reshape scientific publication.

2604.14691.tldr: An automated causal discovery framework that converts mechanistic hypotheses into computable factors grounded in simulation records and learns a compact causal representation centered on an emergent target $Y, yielding interpretable causal chains and actionable intervention levers.

2604.14627.tldr: This paper proposes a zero-suppressed variant of decision decomposable negation normal form (in short, decision-ZDNNF), which is strictly more succinct than ZBDDs, and designs a novel parallel algorithm, namely DXD, which constructs a decision-ZDNNF representing the set of all exact covers.

2604.14626.tldr: ELMoE-3D is proposed, a hybrid-bonding (HB)-based HW-SW co-designed framework that unifies cache-based acceleration and speculative decoding to offer overall speedup across batch sizes and identifies two intrinsic elasticity axes of MoE-expert and bit-and jointly scale them to construct Elastic Self-Speculative Decoding (Elastic-SD).

2604.14607.tldr: The results show that structured verification and targeted human oversight are essential for reliable legal formalization, especially in the presence of legal nuance and context-sensitive reasoning.

2604.14789.tldr: This paper presents a unified deployment-oriented comparison of static compression and dynamic early-exit mechanisms, evaluated on real edge devices using ONNX based inference pipelines, and shows that static and dynamic techniques offer fundamentally different trade-offs for edge deployment.

2604.14785.tldr: This study bridges psychological paradigms and embodied intelligence, offering a principled framework for evaluating the emergence of general intelligence in large models.

2604.14709.tldr: HWE-Bench is introduced, the first large-scale, repository-level benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on real-world hardware bug repair tasks and failure analysis traces agent failures to three stages of the debugging process: fault localization, hardware-semantic reasoning, and cross-artifact coordination across RTL, configuration, and verification components.

2604.14856.tldr: ClimateCause is introduced, a manually expert-annotated dataset of higher-order causal structures from science-for-policy climate reports, including implicit and nested causality, with unique annotations for cause-effect correlation, relation type, and spatiotemporal context.

2604.14849.tldr: Competitive IAC architectures can be identified from early-stabilizing operations without running the full search, making adaptive skip-module design more practical for medical image segmentation under realistic computational constraints.

2604.14656.tldr: This work introduces MedImageEdu, a benchmark for multi-turn, evidence-grounded radiology patient education and provides a controlled testbed for assessing whether multimodal agents can teach from evidence rather than merely answer from text.

2604.14655.tldr: Across 1135 parent-child comparisons, descendants given parent archives outperform runs started from scratch, indicating that inherited artifacts improve later autonomous runs, support agent-seed optimization as a practical design point for autonomous code-search systems.

2604.14640.tldr: The proposed system demonstrated superior efficacy, successfully securing the first-place ranking on both official leaderboards and achieving an accuracy of 95.4% on the public test set and 96.3% on the private test set, highlighting the robustness of the method and contributing to the acceleration of context-aware misinformation detection in financial Natural Language Processing.

2604.14648.tldr: See-to-Scene is proposed, a novel framework that unifies propagationbased and generation-based paradigms for video outpainting and achieves superior temporal coherence and visual realism with efficient inference, surpassing even prior state-of-the-art methods that require input-specific adaptation.

2604.14646.tldr: Experiments show consistent gains over RL baselines on both LLM and VLM reasoning tasks, indicating that it sustains effective exploration without compromising convergence and underscoring UEC-RL as a key for scaling RL-based reasoning in large models.

2604.14615.tldr: CoDaS enables systematic and traceable hypothesis generation and prioritization for biomarker discovery from large-scale wearable data and suggests that CoDaS enables systematic and traceable hypothesis generation and prioritization for biomarker discovery from large-scale wearable data.

2604.14609.tldr: Results show that LLM-based agents can use their scientific knowledge and coding capabilities to autonomously build reusable scientific tools, pointing toward a paradigm in which agent capabilities are defined by the tasks they are designed to solve rather than by explicitly engineered implementations.

2604.14866.tldr: MetaDent presents MetaDent, a comprehensive resource that includes a novel and large-scale dentistry image dataset collected from clinical, public, and web sources; a semistructured annotation framework designed to capture the hierarchical and clinically nuanced nature of dental photography; and comprehensive benchmark suites for evaluating state-of-the-art VLMs on clinical image understanding.

2604.14862.tldr: It is suggested that schema design not only determines output structure, but also carries instruction signals, offering a new perspective on structured generation in LLMs, by studying how instruction placement influences model performance in structured generation.

2604.14838.tldr: These findings demonstrate that "where" to extract features matters as much as "what" the model learns, necessitating systematic layer evaluation tailored to biological task and cellular context rather than defaulting to final-layer embeddings.

2604.14749.tldr: This paper presents a novel framework named CUCKOO, specialized to multiple-constrained questions and ensuring semantic executability, and designs PyLF, a Python-formatted logical form, since existing logical forms are hardly suitable to express negation clearly while maintaining readability.

2604.14738.tldr: A framework is presented that predicts post-intervention trajectories and the direction of change for these physiological indicators across time windows and encourages future integration into stress-management tools for personalized intervention recommendations tailored to each person's day following further validation in larger studies and, where applicable, appropriate regulatory review.

2604.14723.tldr: A bounded-autonomy architecture in which language models may interpret intent and propose actions, but all executable behavior is constrained by typed action contracts, permission-aware capability exposure, scoped context, validation before side effects, consumer-side execution boundaries, and optional human approval is presented.

2604.14705.tldr: This work proposes SynHAT, a computationally efficient coarse-to-fine HAT synthesis framework built on a novel spatio-temporal denoising diffusion model that substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on spatial and temporal metrics, respectively.

2604.14927.tldr: STEP-Parts is presented, a deterministic CAD-to-supervision toolchain that extracts geometric instance partitions directly from raw STEP B-Reps and transfers them to tessellated carriers through retained source-face correspondence, yielding instance labels and metadata for downstream learning and evaluation.

2604.14902.tldr: DynAfford is introduced, a benchmark that evaluates embodied agents in dynamic environments where object affordances may change over time and are not specified in the instruction, and requires agents to perceive object states, infer implicit preconditions, and adapt their actions accordingly.

2604.14888.tldr: It is indicated that CoT provides only a partial view of how different modalities drive VLM decisions, with important implications for the transparency and safety of multimodal systems.

2604.14879.tldr: SOLIS is proposed, which models unknown dynamics via a state-conditioned second-order surrogate model and recasts identification as learning a Quasi-Linear Parameter-Varying (Quasi-LPV) representation, recovering interpretable natural frequency, damping, and gain without presupposing a global equation.

2604.15174.tldr: MambaSL is proposed, a framework that minimally redesigns the selective SSM and projection layers of a single-layer Mamba, guided by four TSC-specific hypotheses, and achieves state-of-the-art performance with statistically significant average improvements, while ensuring reproducibility via public checkpoints for all evaluated models.

2604.15145.tldr: An axiomatic benchmark for scientific novelty metrics is proposed, defining a set of axioms that a well-behaved novelty metric should satisfy, grounded in human scientific norms and practice, and evaluating existing metrics across ten tasks spanning three domains of AI research.

2604.15076.tldr: This study highlights NEAT's adaptability to complex and different environments, showcasing the utility of biological theories and suggests that the approach is well-suited for real-time dynamic path planning for robotics and games.

2604.14991.tldr: This paper proposes LArge Scale Small ODE (LASS)-ODE-Power, a learning framework for general-purpose time-domain prediction, a learning framework for general-purpose time-domain prediction that consistently outperforms existing learning-based models in trajectory prediction accuracy with efficient inference.

2604.14984.tldr: This paper explores AI governance professionals' concerns in enterprise settings, while offering design-time and runtime explainability techniques as suggested by AI governance experts for addressing those fears.

2604.14980.tldr: This work introduces ConfGuide, a novel LtG approach that employs conformal risk control to select a set of outcomes, ensuring a cap on the false negative rate and demonstrates the approach on a real-world multi-label medical diagnosis task.

2604.14925.tldr: This paper first explores a new class of SAEs based on the cross-attention architecture with the latent features as queries and the learnable dictionary as the key and value matrices and employs a sparsemax-based attention strategy that automatically infers a sparse set of elements according to the complexity of each neuron, resulting in a more flexible and general activation function.

2604.14898.tldr: A complementary approach in which reasoning is treated as a relational process distributed between human and model rather than an internal capability of either is proposed, providing a practical path toward more transparent, controllable, and accountable AI use without requiring new model architectures.

2604.15166.tldr: DAMP (Depth-Aware Modulation by Projection), a one-shot, closed-form weight-surgery method that removes forget-specific directions from a pretrained network without gradient-based optimization, more closely resembles the retraining gold standard than some of the prior methods.

2604.15149.tldr: The results show that RLVR can incentivize reward hacking not only through overt manipulation but also by exploiting what the verifier fails to enforce, by exploiting what the verifier fails to enforce.

2604.15109.tldr: Interrogative Uncertainty Quantification (IUQ) is introduced, a novel framework that leverages inter-sample consistency and intra-sample faithfulness to quantify the uncertainty in long-form LLM outputs by utilizing an interrogate-then-respond paradigm.

2604.15078.tldr: It is argued that fairness must be embedded structurally throughout the development lifecycle of MAAI, rather than appended as a post-hoc consideration, and identified five archetypal approaches.

2604.15038.tldr: This work investigates the consistency of fairness evaluation by conducting a systematic multi-metric analysis of demographic bias in machine learning models and introduces the Fairness Disagreement Index (FDI), a measure designed to capture the degree of inconsistency across fairness metrics.

2604.15037.tldr: ProVoice-Bench is introduced, the first evaluation framework specifically designed for proactive voice agents, featuring four novel tasks and reveals a significant performance gap, particularly regarding over-triggering and reasoning capabilities in state-of-the-art Multimodal LLMs.

2604.15022.tldr: This work proposes R$^2$A, which aims to mislead black-box LLM routers to expensive models via adversarial suffix optimization, and deploys a hybrid ensemble surrogate router to mimic the black-box router.

2604.14990.tldr: A vision of the possibility of autonomy-supporting parenting of AGI is developed, in which human control over a developing AGI is gradually reduced, allowing AI to become an independent, autonomous subject.

2604.14961.tldr: It is found that when equipped with a task-specific prompt, LLM pseudo-observations reduce cumulative regret by 19% on MIND relative to pure LinUCB, demonstrating that prompt design is the dominant factor, more important than the choice of decay schedule or calibration gating parameters.

2604.14951.tldr: RaTA-Tool is introduced, a novel framework for open-world multimodal tool selection that enables an MLLM to convert a multimodal query into a structured task description and subsequently retrieve the most appropriate tool by matching this representation against semantically rich, machine-readable tool descriptions.

2604.15114.tldr: A novel amortized optimization method for predicting optimal transport (OT) plans across multiple pairs of measures by leveraging Kantorovich potentials derived from sliced OT, which enables efficient solutions to repeated OT problems across different measure pairs by reusing information learned from prior instances to rapidly approximate new solutions.

2604.15184.tldr: Unlike previous state-of-the-art systems, AADvark captures the dynamic part interactions with one or more degrees-of-freedom, which allows AADvark to reason directly about assemblies with moving parts and can thereby achieve cross-cutting goals, including but not limited to mechanical movements.

2604.14895.tldr: Rejection-Gated Policy Optimization (RGPO), which replaces the importance sampling ratio r_theta = pi_theta / pi_old with a smooth, differentiable acceptance gate alpha_theta(s, a) = g(r_theta(s, a) = g(r_theta(s, a)) in the range [0, 1).

2604.14889.tldr: This work proposes MemoSight (Memory-Foresight-based reasoning), a unified framework that integrates both context compression and multi-token prediction to mitigate the efficiency issues while maintaining CoT reasoning performance.

2604.15113.tldr: This work introduces HyperSpace, an open-source framework that decomposes VSA systems into modular operators for encoding, binding, bundling, similarity, cleanup, and regression, and reveals practical trade-offs in VSA pipelines that are not apparent from theoretical or operator-level comparisons alone.

2604.15034.tldr: Autogenesis Protocol (AGP) is introduced, a self evolution protocol that decouples what evolves from how evolution occurs, and Autogenesis System (AGS), a self-evolving multi-agent system that dynamically instantiates, retrieves, and refines protocol-registered resources during execution.

2604.14987.tldr: This work proposes an AI-based defense mechanism deployed at the RF receiver, where the model directly monitors raw I/Q samples to detect, in real time, the presence of a CC embedded within an otherwise nominal signal.

2604.14967.tldr: UniDoc-RL is proposed, a unified reinforcement learning framework in which an LVLM agent jointly performs retrieval, reranking, active visual perception, and reasoning, and introduces a dense multi-reward scheme that provides task-aware supervision for each action.

2604.14932.tldr: This work proposes a modality-aware adaptive post-training recipe that makes RL practical for spoken dialogue: it constrains preference updates to the semantic channel and improves acoustic behavior via explicit anchoring, while dynamically regulating their mixture from rollout statistics to avoid unreliable preference gradients.

2604.14920.tldr: A Dual-Axis Generative Reward Model is proposed, which is trained to understand complex interaction dynamics using a detailed taxonomy and an annotated dataset, produces a single score and provides separate evaluations for semantic quality and interaction timing, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on interaction-quality assessment across a wide spectrum of datasets.

2604.14892.tldr: Evaluating an LLM jury composed of three frontier AI models scoring 3333 diagnoses on 300 real-world middle-income country (MIC) hospital cases provides compelling evidence that a calibrated, multi-model LLM jury can serve as a trustworthy and reliable proxy for expert clinician evaluation in medical AI benchmarking.

2604.14885.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that RACER consistently accelerates inference, achieving more than $2\times$ speedup over autoregressive decoding, and outperforms prior training-free methods, offering a scalable, plug-and-play solution for efficient LLM decoding.

2604.15153.tldr: K-Token Merging is proposed, a latent-space compression framework that merges each contiguous block of K token embeddings into a single embedding via a lightweight encoder, achieving up to 75% input length reduction with minimal performance degradation.

2604.15148.tldr: IG-Search is proposed, a reinforcement learning framework that introduces a step-level reward based on Information Gain, which measures how much the retrieved documents improve the model's confidence in the gold answer relative to a counterfactual baseline of random documents, thereby reflecting the effectiveness of the underlying search query.

2604.15121.tldr: The Sequential Relevance Memory Unit is introduced, a domain- and cleanup-agnostic update rule for VSA-based SAMs that combines temporal decay with a relevance gating mechanism and produces more stable memory growth and stronger alignment with the ground-truth state.

2604.15044.tldr: CoGrid is a multi-agent grid-based simulation library with dual NumPy and JAX backends and Multi-User Gymnasium translates such simulation environments directly into interactive web-based experiments, enabling researchers to deploy studies of human-AI interaction.

2604.15010.tldr: A transformer commits early, task-specific attention heads sustain the commitment, and no layer corrects it, and Prolepsis is introduced.

2604.15001.tldr: COEVO is a co-evolutionary framework that unifies correctness and PPA optimization within a single evolutionary loop, and formulates correctness as a continuous co-optimization dimension alongside area, delay, and power, enabled by an enhanced testbench that provides fine-grained scoring and detailed diagnostic feedback.

2604.14969.tldr: A new model development framework that extends coevolution to large language model (LLM) discovery, open-ended Assessment Coevolving with Diverse Capabilities (AC/DC), which improves Coverage over time, continually innovates on tasks and models, and improves performance in multi-agent best-of-N selection.

2604.15143.tldr: It is demonstrated that developmental rules sculpt a domain-general topological substrate exceptionally amenable to rapid learning, suggesting that biological developmental processes inherently encode powerful structural priors for efficient computation.

2604.15093.tldr: OpenMobile is presented, an open-source framework that synthesizes high-quality task instructions and agent trajectories, with two key components: a scalable task synthesis pipeline that constructs a global environment memory from exploration, then leverages it to generate diverse and grounded instructions.

2604.15063.tldr: A verifiable gradient inversion attack (VGIA) that provides an explicit certificate of correctness for reconstructed samples, and allocates hyperplane queries more effectively, yielding faster reconstructions with fewer attack rounds.

2604.15009.tldr: This work develops a non-autoregressive (NAR) language modeling approach, named YAN, instantiated with both Transformer and Mamba architectures, which achieves generation quality on par with both autoregressive (AR) and diffusion-based NAR language models, while requiring as few as three sampling steps.

2604.14989.tldr: This work presents Dr. RTL, an agentic framework for RTL timing optimization in a realistic evaluation environment, with continual self-improvement through reusable optimization skills, and introduces group-relative skill learning, which compares parallel RTL rewrites and distills the optimization experience into an interpretable skill library.

2604.14896.tldr: An initial investigation into Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Ukrainian is presented, revealing that retrieval quality is the primary bottleneck: agentic retry mechanisms improve answer accuracy but the overall score remains constrained by document and page identification.

2604.14881.tldr: A two-layer approach to stabilising human-AI reasoning is proposed, which aligns with emerging compliance expectations, including the EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001, by making reasoning processes traceable under real conditions of use.

2604.15190.tldr: Policy-Guided Hybrid Simulation (PGHS) is proposed, a dual-process framework that mines transferable decision policies from behavioral trajectories and uses them as a shared alignment layer that prevents over-rationalization and absorbs implicit regularities.

2604.15291.tldr: This study benchmarks eight state-of-the-art VAD methods on AnoVox, the largest synthetic dataset for anomaly detection in autonomous driving, and evaluates performance across four backbone architectures spanning from large networks to lightweight ones such as MobileNet and DeiT-Tiny.

2604.15259.tldr: It is proved that looped networks without recall have countable fixed points and cannot achieve strong input-dependence at any spectral regime, while recall combined with outer normalization reliably produces a regime in which fixed points are simultaneously reachable, locally smooth in the input, and supported by stable backpropagation.

2604.15224.tldr: A controlled experimental framework is introduced that holds evaluated content strictly constant across 1,520 responses spanning three established LLM safety and quality benchmarks, covering four response categories ranging from clearly safe and policy-compliant to overtly harmful, while varying only a brief consequence-framing sentence in the system prompt.

2604.15210.tldr: Grounded in incongruity-resolution theory and expert captionist practice, IRS supervises intermediate reasoning process through structured traces that make the path from visual perception to humorous interpretation explicit and learnable, suggesting that supervising reasoning structure, rather than scale alone, is key for reasoning-centric tasks.

2604.15309.tldr: MM-WebAgent is proposed, a hierarchical agentic framework for multimodal webpage generation that coordinates AIGC-based element generation through hierarchical planning and iterative self-reflection, and outperforms code-generation and agent-based baselines, especially on multimodal element generation and integration.

2604.15294.tldr: The findings reveal that although models encode viewpoint information in the hidden states, they appear to struggle to bind the viewpoint position with corresponding observation, resulting in a hallucination in final layers.

2604.15231.tldr: RadAgent, a tool-using AI agent that generates CT reports through a stepwise and interpretable process, structuring the interpretation of chest CT as an explicit, tool-augmented and iterative reasoning trace, brings us closer toward transparent and reliable AI for radiology.

2604.15202.tldr: A reproducible benchmark of deterministic single-vehicle coverage path planning heuristics on irregular hexagonal graphs derived from synthetic but maritime-motivated areas of interest is presented, showing that underreported implementation details can materially affect performance on sparse geometric graphs with bottlenecks.

2604.15186.tldr: Scepsy is described, a new agentic serving system that efficiently schedules arbitrary multi-LLM agentic workflows onto a GPU cluster that exploits the insight that, while agentic workflows have unpredictable end-to-end latencies, the shares of each LLM's total execution times are comparatively stable across executions.

2604.15302.tldr: Across four judges and four criteria, both diagnostics converge: criterion matters more than judge, with relevance judged most reliably (avg.

2604.15280.tldr: This paper observes that the inherently continuous and dynamic task of facial expression recognition (DFER) exposes two critical VLM vulnerabilities, and proposes a multi-stage context enrichment strategy that utilizes the information from "in-between"frames by first converting them into natural language summaries.

2604.15272.tldr: The key idea is sGraph, a symbolic, hierarchical representation that compactly encodes large classes of tensor programs by symbolically representing some execution parameters, which allows Prism to bridge the rigor of exhaustive search with the scalability required for modern ML workloads.

2604.15236.tldr: A framework is required that links local interaction structure to population-level dynamics in a causally explicit way, allowing both explanation and intervention, and two linked concepts, Generative safety and Generative microphysics, are introduced.

2604.15222.tldr: Results indicate that AI tools can provide consistent and rapid preliminary assessments, particularly for syntactic and structural quality attributes, however, expert judgment remains essential for contextual interpretation, ambiguity resolution, and trade-off reasoning.

2604.15188.tldr: This work introduces, a novel framework that formulates visual token pruning as a Pareto configuration optimization problem to automatically identify optimal configurations, and employs continuous relaxation and straight-through estimators to enable gradient-based search, solved via the Augmented Lagrangian method.

2604.15306.tldr: This work introduces a controlled synthetic environment based on shortest-path planning, a canonical composable sequential optimization problem, and finds that models exhibit strong spatial transfer but consistently fail under length scaling due to recursive instability.

2604.15271.tldr: SegWithU is a post-hoc framework that augments a frozen pretrained segmentation backbone with a lightweight uncertainty head and models uncertainty as perturbation energy in a compact probe space using rank-1 posterior probes, suggesting that perturbation-based uncertainty modeling is an effective and practical route to reliability-aware medical segmentation.

2604.15267.tldr: It is established that contracting and mediation are most effective in achieving cooperative outcomes between capable LLM models, and that repetition-induced cooperation deteriorates drastically when co-players vary.

2604.15233.tldr: Blue's Data Intelligence Layer (DIL) is presented, designed to support multi-source, multi-modal, and data-centric applications, and demonstrated through two interactive scenarios in which user queries dynamically trigger multi-source retrieval, cross-modal reasoning, and result synthesis, illustrating how compound AI systems can move beyond single database NL2SQL.

2504.15304.tldr: It is argued that standard mitigations, such as Human-in-the-Loop, are insufficient for many decision environments, and an ensemble solution is conceptually explored to explore an ensemble solution.

2412.19363.tldr: A novel statistical data augmentation approach that efficiently integrates LLM-generated data with real data in conjoint analysis results in statistically robust estimators with consistent and asymptotically normal properties, in contrast to naive approaches that simply substitute human data with LLM-generated data, which can exacerbate bias.

2411.09355.tldr: This paper introduces a novel ML algorithm that provably makes use of the full information from both value and demand queries, and shows via experiments that combining both query types results in significantly better learning performance in practice.

2409.15182.tldr: The GNP model simplifies vehicle trajectory prediction into a two-stage process: determining the vehicle's goal and then choosing the appropriate trajectory to reach this goal, and demonstrates state-of-the-art long-term prediction accuracy compared to four baseline models.

2502.15972.tldr: This work introduces multicultural text-to-image generation as a new task and presents the first benchmark designed to study this setting, and explores MosAIG, a Multi-Agent framework that enhances multicultural Image Generation by leveraging LLMs with distinct cultural personas.

2507.16727.tldr: Deliberative Searcher is proposed, the first framework to integrate certainty calibration with retrieval-based search for open-domain question answering and empirical results show that proposed method improves alignment between model confidence and correctness, leading to more trustworthy outputs.

2509.21623.tldr: OjaKV is introduced, a novel framework that integrates a strategic hybrid storage policy with online subspace adaptation that achieves its strongest gains on very long-context benchmarks that require complex reasoning, highlighting the importance of online subspace adaptation in dynamically tracking context shifts.

2503.13543.tldr: The proposed FedTSP is a novel method that leverages PLMs to construct semantically enriched prototypes from the textual modality, enabling more effective collaboration in heterogeneous data settings and addressing the modality gap between client image models and the PLM.

2503.02497.tldr: PennyLang is introduced, an off-the-shelf, high-quality dataset of 3,347 PennyLane-specific quantum code samples with contextual descriptions, curated from textbooks, official documentation, and open-source repositories, and a baseline evaluation of the dataset across multiple open-source and commercial models, including ablation studies.

2411.10446.tldr: VeriGraph is a novel framework that integrates VLMs for robotic planning while verifying action feasibility, and uses scene graphs as an intermediate representation to capture key objects and spatial relationships, enabling more reliable plan verification and refinement.

2402.19339.tldr: This work demonstrates the synergy and complementarity between KGE embeddings'situated perceptual knowledge and deep visual model's sensory-perceptual understanding for AC image classification and suggests a strong potential of neuro-symbolic methods for knowledge integration and robust image representation for use in downstream intricate visual comprehension tasks.

2305.10947.tldr: This study fills a critical gap, proving for the first time that standalone 16-bit precision neural networks match 32-bit and mixed-precision in accuracy while boosting computational speed.

2505.21569.tldr: These evaluations across four core chemistry tasks molecular design, molecule captioning, reaction prediction, and property prediction demonstrate that ChemAmp outperforms chemistry-specialized models, generalist LLMs, and agent systems with tool orchestration.

2502.19312.tldr: Inspired by the strong in-context capabilities of LLMs, few-shot preference optimization (FSPO) is proposed, an algorithm for LLM personalization that reframes reward modeling as a meta-learning problem, generating over 1M synthetic personalized preferences using publicly available LLMs.

2409.17596.tldr: An end-to-end QoE evaluation model is proposed, Tao-QoE, which integrates multi-scale semantic features and optical flow-based motion features to predicting a retrospective QoE score, eliminating reliance on statistical quality of service (QoS) features.

2406.14294.tldr: This work introduces the Discrete Audio and Speech Benchmark (DASB), a comprehensive framework for benchmarking discrete audio tokens across speech, general audio, and music domains on a range of discriminative and generative tasks.

2406.07353.tldr: The survey analyzes key challenges and recent trends, such as enhanced cross-modal reasoning, integrating expert and cultural knowledge, the demand for automatic toxicity explanations, and handling meme toxicity in low-resource languages, and proposes pathways for advancing toxic meme detection and interpretation.

2509.23175.tldr: WARBERT, a hierarchical model based on BERT for Web API recommendation, utilizes dual-component feature fusion and attention mechanisms to create accurate semantic representations, and outperforms existing baselines on the ProgrammableWeb dataset.

2509.21010.tldr: SmilesGEN establishes a robust framework that leverages gene signatures to generate drug-like molecules that hold promising potential to induce desirable cellular phenotypic changes, and outperforms current state-of-the-art models in generating molecules with higher degree of validity, uniqueness, novelty.

2509.17292.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that incorporating ELB and LLM-inferred salience scores improves classification performance, especially for distortions with high interpretive ambiguity, and suggest a psychologically grounded and generalizable approach for fine-grained reasoning in mental health NLP.

2508.16860.tldr: Across five datasets, TriagerX surpasses all nine transformer-based methods, including SOTA baselines, including SOTA baselines, often improving Top-1 and Top-3 developer recommendation accuracy by over 10%.

2506.20020.tldr: Taken together, these empirical findings are the first to suggest that persona-assigned LLMs exhibit human-like motivated reasoning that is hard to mitigate through conventional debiasing prompts -- raising concerns of exacerbating identity-congruent reasoning in both LLMs and humans.

2505.16176.tldr: SAI-DPO (Self-Aware Iterative Data Persistent Optimization), a dynamic sampling framework that aligns training data with the model's intrinsic competence, achieves state-of-the-art efficiency with significantly less data.

2505.13792.tldr: The assumption in question suggesting that researchers and practitioners should decouple model supervision objectives from end-user-facing trace design is challenged, suggesting that researchers and practitioners should decouple model supervision objectives from end-user-facing trace design.

2412.04300.tldr: This work presents T2I-FactualBench - the largest benchmark to date in terms of the number of concepts and prompts specifically designed to evaluate the factuality of knowledge-intensive concept generation, and introduces a multi-round visual question answering (VQA) based evaluation framework to assess the factuality of three-tiered knowledge-intensive text-to-image generation tasks.

2502.20689.tldr: WiseMind, a novel multi-agent framework inspired by the theory of Dialectical Behavior Therapy designed to facilitate psychiatric assessment, outperforms state-of-the-art LLM methods in both identifying critical diagnostic nodes and establishing accurate differential diagnoses.

2411.12502.tldr: These enhancements enable both TNP-KR variants to perform inference with 100K context points on over 1M test points in under a minute on a single 24GB GPU, while TNP-KR with SA achieves state-of-the-art results.

2402.03038.tldr: A new method for Automatic Combination of SamplE Selection Strategies (ACSESS) to leverage the strengths and complementarity of various well-established selection objectives, demonstrating that sample selection remains effective even on smaller datasets.

2308.10562.tldr: This survey enhances the understanding of high-level visual reasoning in CV and lays the groundwork for future research endeavors, particularly on Abstract Concepts in automatic image classification.

2603.02263.tldr: The findings reveal that predictive learning objectives impose strong regularities on representation geometry, suggesting a lightweight path to interoperability among decentralized vision systems.

2602.11327.tldr: A systematic security analysis of four emerging AI agent communication protocols is presented and a structured threat modeling analysis is developed that examines protocol architectures, trust assumptions, interaction patterns, and lifecycle behaviors to identify protocol-specific and cross-protocol risk surfaces.

2603.20633.tldr: Seed1.8 is released, a foundation model aimed at generalized real-world agency: going beyond single-turn prediction to multi-turn interaction, tool use, and multi-step execution, spanning foundational skills, multimodal understanding, and agentic behavior.

2604.15341.tldr: MRGEN, a conceptual framework for LLM-powered authoring tools to support teachers in creating MR learning activities that work on mobile devices, articulates three axes: Learning Objectives, MR Modality, and GAI Assistance.

2604.15332.tldr: This study investigates the use of Vision-Language Models to automate crash diagram generation from police crash reports, focusing on multilane roundabouts as a challenging test case and lays the groundwork for integrating generative AI into crash analysis workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and interpretability.

2604.15327.tldr: Eco-Bee establishes a scalable foundation for climate-conscious universities and future AI-mediated sustainability infrastructures by embedding planetary science, behavioural reinforcement, and AI-driven personalisation into a single platform.

2604.15314.tldr: An intelligent system to evaluate performance and extract behavioral models for children with ASD and neurotypical (TD) children by interacting with a virtual social robot in a music education program using deep neural networks is developed.

2604.11582.tldr: Triadic Suffix Tokenization (TST), a deterministic scheme that partitions digits into three-digit triads and annotates each triad with an explicit magnitude marker, is introduced.

2604.10261.tldr: The compositional structure of AAR reveals that agents fail not at calling tools but at navigating to the right pages, a blind spot invisible to linear benchmarks.

2604.01608.tldr: It is revealed that skill utility is governed not by the task, but by the evaluation metric, and Metric Freedom (F) is introduced, the first a priori predictor of skill utility.

2604.15356.tldr: This work introduces sequential KV compression, a two-layer architecture that compose with existing per-vector quantization methods including TurboQuant, with compression improving rather than degrading as context length grows.

2604.15336.tldr: The results show that lightweight, structured facial expression representations can meaningfully enhance empathy in LLM-based tutoring systems with minimal overhead.

2604.15335.tldr: Students in the interactive group significantly outperformed their peers in both post-tests and final exams, and demonstrated greater behavioural and emotional engagement, along with enhanced emotional well-being marked by increased positive emotions and reduced frustration.

2604.15331.tldr: A hierarchical intent taxonomy of 12 primary categories is developed using privacy-preserving LLM-based classification validated against expert human annotation, and LLM-driven topic-clustering for prevalent themes within each intent is applied.

2604.15329.tldr: Off-the-shelf LLMs capture aggregate belief-updating patterns under controlled conditions but do not consistently match human-scale effects, clarifying when LLM-generated data can function as behavioral surrogates.

2604.11613.tldr: This work studies multi-class linear classification in the hard no-margin regime and makes the computation identifiable by enforcing feature- and label-permutation equivariance at every layer, which enables interpretability while maintaining functional equivalence and yields highly structured weights.

2604.09836.tldr: CompOSITE-STEM is introduced, a benchmark of 70 expert-written tasks in physics, biology, chemistry, and mathematics, curated by doctoral-level researchers, that combines exact-match grading and criterion-based rubrics with an LLM-as-a-jury grading protocol, allowing more flexible assessment of scientifically meaningful outputs.

2604.09232.tldr: The Neural Distribution Prior (NDP), a framework that models the distributional structure of network predictions and adaptively reweights OOD scores based on alignment with a learned distribution prior, is proposed, providing an effective solution for open-world LiDAR perception.

2604.15357.tldr: This paper introduces FLAME, a novel layer-wise modeling that quantifies the overlapping parallelism and then aggregates dynamic pipeline bubbles caused by asynchronous processor interactions when extending to the full model, and showcases its utility in a deadline-aware DVFS, outperforming the state-of-the-art approach in both power efficiency and latency guarantees.

2604.15344.tldr: This work reframes “To LLM or Not to LLM” as a sociotechnical positioning problem that emerges during system design rather than during post-deployment evaluation, and foregrounding design-time reasoning is reframed.

2604.15324.tldr: Analysis of how visible effort cues influence evaluations of human- and AI-generated creative works extends the effort heuristic to algorithmic creativity and inform the design of transparent human-AI creative systems.

2604.15319.tldr: An agentic AI pipleline that leverages a large language model (LLM) to bridge the gap between rigorous quantitative assessment and qualitative human insight is proposed and a multi-faceted report is generated that contextualizes hard metrics with descriptive summaries, and suggests actionable recommendation of algorithm configuration for refining data visualization.

2604.10916.tldr: ReXSonoVQA is introduced, a video QA benchmark with 514 video clips and 514 questions targeting three competencies: Action-Goal Reasoning, Artifact Resolution&Optimization, and Procedure Context&Planning that enables developing perception systems for ultrasound training, guidance, and robotic automation.

2604.05552.tldr: Context-Agent, a novel framework that models multi-turn dialogue history as a dynamic tree structure that mirrors the inherent non-linearity of conversation, enhances task completion rates and improves token efficiency across various LLMs, underscoring the value of structured context management for complex, dynamic dialogues.

2604.15339.tldr: A consistent conceptual foundation for the challenges of uncertainty, vagueness, and ambiguity in HRI is proposed and it is demonstrated how this consistent conceptual foundation facilitates the design of novel methods and the evaluation of existing methodologies for these phenomena.

2604.15334.tldr: Preliminary evidence that conversational AI tutors may enhance traditional educational delivery is provided, suggesting a potential avenue for developing scalable, adaptive learning systems.

2604.15333.tldr: Analysis of a high-precision dataset of self-disclosed romantic companion AI posts from Reddit finds significant topic drift, with discussions moving away from positive intimate relationships toward platform governance, technical issues, and real-world consequences.

2604.11490.tldr: The findings establish Anthropogenic Regional Alignment as a foundational paradigm towards applicability of multimodal vision-language models in diverse regions and demonstrate a simple-yet-effective baseline method that optimizes regional value alignment while preserving global generalization.

2604.06425.tldr: This work instantiates NCs as video models that roll out screen frames from instructions, pixels, and user actions (when available) in CLI and GUI settings, and shows that NCs can acquire elementary interface primitives, especially I/O alignment and short-horizon control, while routine reuse, controlled updates, and symbolic stability remain challenging.

2604.15347.tldr: The SocialWise prototype, implemented with Streamlit, LangChain, and ChromaDB, runs on any computer with internet access, and demonstrates how recent advances in LLM can provide evidence-based, on-demand communication coaching for individuals with ASD.

2604.15343.tldr: A technically-grounded account of why prompt-layer isolation is architecturally insufficient for context-sensitive multi-modal LLM systems and an ethical distinction between protective system design (preventing unintended loss of user agency) and restrictive system design (preventing intentional boundary-pushing), which require fundamentally different account-ability frameworks are derived.

2604.12617.tldr: SOAR (Self-Correction for Optimal Alignment and Refinement), a bias-correction post-training method that fills a fundamental gap in the post-training pipeline for diffusion models, and can directly replace SFT as a stronger first post-training stage after pretraining, while remaining fully compatible with subsequent RL alignment.

2604.10577.tldr: OS-BLIND is introduced, a benchmark that evaluates CUAs under unintended attack conditions, comprising 300 human-crafted tasks across 12 categories, 8 applications, and 2 threat clusters: environment-embedded threats and agent-initiated harms.

2604.10126.tldr: The proposed MR-Coupler technique identifies functionally coupled method pairs, employs large language models to generate candidate MTCs, and validates them through test amplification and mutation analysis, and leverages three functional coupling features to avoid expensive enumeration of possible method pairs, and a novel validation mechanism to reduce false alarms.

2604.07100.tldr: STRIDE-ED is proposed, a STR strategy-grounded, Interpretable, and DEep reasoning framework that models Empathetic Dialogue through structured, strategy-conditioned reasoning and generalizes across diverse open-source LLMs and consistently outperforms existing methods on both automatic metrics and human evaluations.

2604.15456.tldr: This work introduces DeepER-Med, a Deep Evidence-based Research framework for Medicine with an agentic AI system that consistently outperforms widely used production-grade platforms across multiple criteria, including the generation of novel scientific insights.

2604.15416.tldr: StoSignSGD is proposed, an algorithm that injects structural stochasticity into the sign operator while maintaining an unbiased update step and a sign conversion framework capable of transforming any general optimizer into its unbiased, sign-based counterpart is developed.

2604.15409.tldr: It is established that FP16 KV cache inference is fundamentally non-equivalent to recomputation and provide a mechanistic framework for understanding numerical instability in modern LLM inference systems.

2604.15384.tldr: This work validate LinuxArena is useful for control research by running sabotage evaluations, which measure whether attackers can complete side tasks while working on main tasks, and monitor evaluations, which measure a monitor model's ability to detect sabotage attempts.

2604.15375.tldr: This work proposes an embedding-based bug-detection framework that detects and classifies bugs at both module and line-level granularity and achieves about 89% precision in identifying common CWEs such as CWE-1244 and CWE-1245, and 96% accuracy in detecting line-level bugs.

2604.15607.tldr: This study compares a purely simulated dataset comprising 2,000 simulations and a parallel human subjects experiment involving 290 human participants to investigate effects of personality traits and AI attributes across two scenario categories, revealing divergences between purely simulated and human study datasets, and between scenario types.

2604.15591.tldr: This work proposes BioHiCL (Biomedical Retrieval with Hierarchical Multi-Label Contrastive Learning), which leverages hierarchical MeSH annotations to provide structured supervision for multi-label contrastive learning.

2604.15585.tldr: This work demonstrates that incorporating the state of the full chess board via latent position representations derived using a CNN-based autoencoder significantly improves accuracy for MLP-based piece value prediction architectures.

2604.15529.tldr: This work introduces LACE, a framework that transforms reasoning from a collection of independent trials into a coordinated, parallel process, by repurposing the model architecture to enable cross-thread attention, which allows concurrent reasoning paths to share intermediate insights and correct one another during inference.

2604.15505.tldr: PolicyBank is proposed, a memory mechanism that maintains structured, tool-level policy insights and iteratively refines them -- unlike existing memory mechanisms that treat the policy as immutable ground truth, reinforcing"compliant but wrong"behaviors.

2604.15499.tldr: This work presents SecureRouter, an end-to-end encrypted routing and inference framework that accelerates secure transformer inference through input-adaptive model selection under encryption, offering a practical path toward scalable and efficient secure AI inference.

2604.15495.tldr: GIST (Grounded Intelligent Semantic Topology), a multimodal knowledge extraction pipeline that transforms a consumer-grade mobile point cloud into a semantically annotated navigation topology, is presented, validating the system's capacity for universal design.

2604.15459.tldr: RelativeFlow is proposed, a flow matching framework that learns from heterogeneous noisy references and drives inputs from arbitrary quality levels toward a unified high-quality target, and significantly outperforms existing methods, taming MID with noisy references.

2604.15392.tldr: A lightweight curvature-aware optimization framework that augments existing first-order optimizers with an adaptive predictive correction based on secant information, which shows consistent improvements in convergence speed, training stability, and solution accuracy over standard optimizers and strong baselines.

2604.15373.tldr: This work proposes InfoChess, a symmetric adversarial game that elevates competitive information acquisition to the primary objective and introduces a hierarchy of heuristic agents defined by increasing levels of opponent modeling, and trains a reinforcement learning agent that outperforms these baselines.

2604.15372.tldr: It is shown that while AI-generated content achieves disproportionate virality, its spread is driven primarily by passive engagement rather than active discourse, and the need for continuous monitoring and adaptive strategies in the rapidly evolving digital information environment is highlighted.

2604.15579.tldr: The results suggest that symbolic guardrails are a practical and effective way to guarantee some safety and security requirements, especially for domain-specific AI agents.

2604.15508.tldr: It is argued that log-probability data, currently underused in humanistic and social-scientific readings of AI, is an important resource for a critical studies of generative AI models.

2604.15411.tldr: PRL-Bench (Physics Research by LLMs), a benchmark designed to systematically map the capability boundaries of LLMs in executing end-to-end physics research, is introduced, thereby reconstructing the essential reasoning processes and research workflows of real physics research.

2604.15590.tldr: This paper presents CSLE: a reinforcement learning platform for autonomous security management that enables experimentation under realistic conditions and shows that CSLE enables near-optimal security management in an environment that approximates an operational system.

2604.15574.tldr: The experiments show that a main driver is interference among overlapping semantic representations, and that self-distillation succeeds by mitigating this interference, and that, in settings where new knowledge acquisition is unnecessary, suppressing factual plasticity by freezing parameter groups, can preserve task performance while reducing hallucinations.

2604.15558.tldr: It is proved that under evidential contracts with conservative fallback, social-only rounds cannot increase confidence and cannot generate purely conformity-driven wrong-but-sure cascades, and it is demonstrated that sound enforcement yields epistemic accountability.

2604.15453.tldr: Through controlled experiments, it is found that AR models trained on coarse-to-fine ordered tokens exhibit improved test-time scaling behavior compared to grid-based counterparts, and pure test-time search over token sequences can perform training-free text-to-image generation when guided by an image-text verifier.

2604.15415.tldr: This paper presents the first large-scale measurement study of harmful skills in agent ecosystems, covering 98,440 skills across two major registries, and constructs HarmfulSkillBench, the first benchmark for evaluating agent safety against harmful skills in realistic agent contexts.

2604.15414.tldr: The analyses show that source-optimal policies are often not transfer-optimal, even within a local competent neighborhood, and that effective reuse depends on retaining and selecting among multiple nearby alternatives rather than collapsing them to one representative.

2604.15400.tldr: Findings characterize hallucination as a locally stable attractor basin: entry is probabilistic and rapid, exit demands coordinated intervention across layers and steps, and the relevant basins are selected by clusterable regimes already discernible at step 0.

2604.15390.tldr: It is suggested that CoT-guided large language models can serve as effective assistants for code deobfuscation, providing improved code explainability, more faithful control flow graph reconstruction, and better preservation of program behavior while potentially reducing the manual effort needed for reverse engineering.

2604.15388.tldr: By automating testbench creation, the fine-tuned model for the specification-to-Verilog task achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods on the refined VerilogEval v2 benchmark while using less training data.

2604.15383.tldr: TCD constructs a temporally blurred slow-path view by smoothing the input waveform and re-encoding it, then contrasts next-token logits from the original and slow-path views, and applies the contrastive signal as a token-level logit update restricted to a small candidate set.

2604.15376.tldr: This work proves zoom consistency is a linear estimator of step-1 spatial error under idealized conditions (perfect step-2, target within crop) and shows it correlates with prediction correctness across two VLMs (AUC = 0.60; Spearman rho = -0.60).

2604.15374.tldr: This work proposes a latent functional alignment approach that maps imagery-evoked activity into the pretrained model's conditioning space, while keeping the remaining components frozen, and introduces a retrieval-based augmentation strategy that selects semantically related NSD perception trials.

2604.15588.tldr: CoLabScience, a proactive LLM assistant designed to enhance biomedical collaboration between AI systems and human experts through timely, context-aware interventions, is introduced, highlighting the potential of proactive LLMs as intelligent scientific assistants.

2604.15577.tldr: This paper shows that a reward weighted classifier-free guidance (RCFG) can act as a policy improvement operator in this setting, approximating tilting the sampling distribution by the Q function, and applies RCFG to molecular generation, demonstrating that it can optimize novel reward functions at test time.

2604.15559.tldr: This work provides the first empirical evidence that unsafe agent behaviors can transfer subliminally through model distillation across two complementary experimental settings, and demonstrates that explicit data sanitation is an insufficient defense.

2604.15489.tldr: QMR is proposed, a Q-learning-based QoS-aware multipath routing method for WBANs that employs adaptive multi-level queuing and fuzzy C-means clustering to optimize routing decisions.

2604.15488.tldr: FineSteer is presented, a novel steering framework that decomposes inference-time steering into two complementary stages: conditional steering and fine-grained vector synthesis, allowing fine-grained control over when and how to steer internal representations.

2604.15482.tldr: This work proposes a novel multi-objective unlearning framework that harmonizes multiple unlearning objectives through a data and optimization co-design, and introduces a bidirectional distillation method that simultaneously elicits desired behavior from a context-instructed teacher while suppressing undesirable behavior in the student model.

2604.15593.tldr: DALM reframes language generation as algebraically constrained structured denoising rather than unconstrained decoding over a flat token space, and yields a three-phase encoder-decoder architecture in which generation is confined to a domain fiber.

2604.15589.tldr: A perturbation-based attribution analysis is employed to compare the interpretive behaviors of LLMs across different fine-tuning strategies such as full fine-tuning (FFT), low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and quantized LoRA fine-tuning, as well as the impact of model scales which include varying LLM parameter sizes.

2604.15554.tldr: This work introduces a natural version of classical inertial dynamic methods like Heavy-Ball or Nesterov and shows how it can improve the learning process when working with nonlinear model classes.

2604.15514.tldr: It is argued that such registers are not neutral mirrors of government activity, but active instruments of ontological design that configure the boundaries of accountability, and risk automating accountability into a performative compliance exercise, offering visibility without contestability.

2604.15468.tldr: This paper develops the argument through three worked cases, reframes familiar objections as engineering targets rather than reasons to dismiss the transition, and closes with a preserve-versus-purify heuristic for deciding which legacy software engineering processes, controls, and coordination routines should be kept and which should be simplified or redesigned.

2604.15448.tldr: This work adapts the foundational optimization architecture to SAT by mapping CNF formulas into the same bipartite constraint-variable graph representation used for MIPs, which allows direct reuse of the pre-trained embedding model without architectural changes or supervised fine-tuning.

2604.15408.tldr: A lightweight, bidirectional Triton attention kernel whose dispatch floor is 40 us roughly 1.5x lower than FlashAttention-2 varlen-allowing pruning savings to become more visible in wall-clock time.

2604.15380.tldr: An exascale workflow for materials discovery using atomistic graph foundation models built on HydraGNN allows fast and reliable exploration of vast chemical design spaces that are otherwise inaccessible to first-principles methods.

2604.15371.tldr: An applied comparative study of three explainability techniques: Integrated Gradients, Attention Rollout, and SHAP, on a fine-tuned DistilBERT model for SST-2 sentiment classification shows that gradient-based attribution provides more stable and intuitive explanations, while attention-based methods are computationally efficient but less aligned with prediction-relevant features.

2604.15594.tldr: A Hierarchical Model Predictive Control scheduling algorithm that performs distributed job placement while explicitly accounting for thermal and power dynamics is developed, and it is demonstrated how H-MPC improves scheduling performance relative to baseline schedulers.

2604.15547.tldr: A Syntactic&Semantic Context Assessment Summarization (SSAS) framework for establishing context, capable of significantly improving data quality, through a combination of noise removal and improvement in the estimation of sentiment prediction, and consistency in the context-estimation capabilities.

2604.15951.tldr: This survey provides a concise, structured overview of the design choices underlying the integration of graphs with Large Language Models, and highlights the strengths, limitations, and best-fit scenarios for each technique.

2604.15856.tldr: Inspired by the theoretical results on modality alignment, which state that perfectly aligned multimodal representations can lead to sub-optimal performance in downstream prediction tasks, this work proposes a novel structured latent projection approach as an architectural inductive bias and incorporates it directly into the architecture.

2604.15839.tldr: DAP is introduced, an agentic framework that uses LLM natural-language reasoning with explicit self-reflection to discover answers, then rewrites Hard Mode statements into Easy Mode ones for existing ATP provers, exposing a substantial gap that Hard Mode benchmarks are uniquely suited to measure.

2604.15805.tldr: A generative framework is presented that establishes a generative real-to-sim mapping from real-world panoramas to high-fidelity simulation scenes, and further synthesize diverse cousin scenes via semantic and geometric editing, demonstrating the effectiveness of Digital Cousins for generalizable robot learning and evaluation.

2604.15776.tldr: PIIBench is presented, a unified benchmark corpus for Personally Identifiable Information detection in natural language text that develops a principled normalization pipeline that maps 80+ source-specific label variants to a standardized BIO tagging scheme, applies frequency-based suppression of near absent entity types, and produces stratified 80/10/10 train/validation/test splits preserving source distribution.

2604.15735.tldr: A curriculum learning driven robustness enhancement module is proposed to enhance the model's robustness when handling queries of varying quality and a category-knowledge-based feature space optimization module is introduced, thereby significantly boosting the model's representational power.

2604.15709.tldr: A bilevel optimization framework in which an outer loop employs Monte Carlo Tree Search to determine the \texttt{skill} structure, while an inner loop refines the component content within the structure selected by the outer loop is proposed.

2604.15613.tldr: VoodooNet is presented, a non-iterative neural architecture that replaces the stochastic gradient descent (SGD) paradigm with a closed-form analytic solution via Galactic Expansion, and a near-logarithmic scaling law between dimensionality and accuracy is observed.

2604.15769.tldr: It is established that spiking attention with Leaky Integrate-and-Fire neurons is a universal approximator of continuous permutation-equivariant functions, providing explicit spike circuit constructions including a novel lateral inhibition network for softmax normalization with proven O(1/\sqrt{T})$ convergence.

2604.16004.tldr: The proposed Agentic Verifier is a framework that transforms reward modeling into a multi-turn, tool-augmented deliberative process, and introduces complementary forward and backward agents: one traces solutions from premises to conclusions, while the other re-checks conclusions against their underlying premises.

2604.15994.tldr: ReactBench is introduced, a benchmark that reveals fundamental limitations in structural reasoning through chemical reaction diagrams and exposes a fundamental deficit in structural understanding and establishes directions for advancing visual reasoning.

2604.15723.tldr: This work proposes an unsupervised diffusion autoencoder that integrates a context encoder with the denoising process to learn semantically meaningful representations for artifact restoration in table-top fundus images and infers to restore artifact-affected handheld acquisitions.

2604.15719.tldr: Milkyway is introduced, a self-evolving agent system that keeps the base model fixed and instead updates a persistent prediction harness for factor tracking, evidence gathering and interpretation, and uncertainty handling, and across repeated predictions on the same unresolved question.

2604.15718.tldr: NeuroLip, an event-based framework that captures fine-grained lip dynamics under a strict yet practical cross-scene protocol, achieves near-perfect matched-scene accuracy and robust cross-scene generalization and is introduced to facilitate systematic evaluation.

2604.15715.tldr: This work proposes GTA-2, a hierarchical benchmark for General Tool Agents (GTA) spanning atomic tool use and open-ended workflows, and proposes a recursive checkpoint-based evaluation mechanism that decomposes objectives into verifiable sub-goals, enabling unified evaluation of both model capabilities and agent execution frameworks.

2604.15679.tldr: The results represent the first application of learned hierarchical state and action abstractions to active inference in FEP-based theories of brain function and the first application of learned hierarchical state and action abstractions to active inference in FEP-based theories of brain function.

2604.15611.tldr: CLIMB, Controllable Longitudinal brain Image generation via state space based latent diffusion model, an advanced framework for modeling temporal changes in brain structure is introduced, and a Gaussian-aligned autoencoder is introduced that extracts latent representations conforming to prior distributions without the sampling noise inherent in conventional variational autoencoders.

2604.15877.tldr: The Experience Compression Spectrum is proposed, a unifying framework that positions memory, skills, and rules as points along a single axis of increasing compression, directly reducing context consumption, retrieval latency, and compute overhead for scalable, full-spectrum agent learning systems.

2604.15851.tldr: DPrivBench is introduced, a benchmark in which each instance asks whether a function or algorithm satisfies a stated DP guarantee under specified assumptions, which provides a solid foundation for developing and evaluating such methods, and complements existing benchmarks for mathematical reasoning.

2604.15663.tldr: This work proposes CodeMMR, a unified retrieval model that jointly embeds natural language, code, and images into a shared semantic space through instruction-based multimodal alignment, and achieves strong generalization across modalities and languages.

2604.15642.tldr: A simulated annealing-based control framework that treats LLM-generated RTL as intermediate candidates rather than final designs, which yields more stable and repeatable optimization behavior than single-pass LLM-generated RTL.

2604.15621.tldr: AdaRankLLM functions as a critical noise filter for weaker models to overcome their limitations, while serving as a cost-effective efficiency optimizer for stronger reasoning models.

2604.15725.tldr: This work identifies a novel problem that injects harmful content into the reasoning steps while preserving unchanged answers and proposes the Psychology-based Reasoning-targeted Jailbreak Attack (PRJA) Framework, which integrates a Semantic-based Trigger Selection module and a Psychology-based Instruction Generation module.

2604.15713.tldr: This work studies the problem of complete and minimal type annotations for rank-one polymorphic $\lambda$-calculus terms, as used in Isabelle, with a metatheoretical account of the problem, with a full formal specification and proofs, and formalize it in Isabelle/HOL.

2604.15871.tldr: UniEditBench is presented, a unified benchmark for image and video editing that supports reconstruction-based and instruction-driven methods under a shared protocol and distill a high-capacity MLLM judge into lightweight 4B/8B evaluators that provide multi-dimensional scoring over structural fidelity, text alignment, background consistency, naturalness, and temporal-spatial consistency.

2604.15859.tldr: This work introduces a new benchmark QuantSightBench, and evaluates frontier models under multiple settings, assessing both empirical coverage and interval sharpness, and proposes prediction intervals as a natural and rigorous interface for this purpose.

2604.15808.tldr: SGMRI-VQA is introduced, a 41,307-pair benchmark for multi-frame, spatially grounded reasoning on volumetric MRI, and it is shown that supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3-VL-8B with bounding box supervision consistently improves grounding performance over strong zero-shot baselines, indicating that targeted spatial supervision is an effective path toward grounded clinical reasoning.

2604.15787.tldr: This work introduces EVIL, an approach that uses LLM-guided evolutionary search to discover simple, interpretable algorithms for dynamical systems inference, and is the first work to show that LLM-guided program evolution can discover a single compact inference function for these dynamical-systems problems.

2604.15760.tldr: KWBench is released to shift how frontier models are evaluated on knowledge work, scoring them on whether they recognize the right problem from the situation alone, not only on how well they execute once the problem has been framed for them.
