2604.01650.tldr: An AI-powered wearable interface capable of real-time, general-purpose aroma generation from free-form text or visual inputs, powered by a multimodal LLM that leverages latent olfactory knowledge to map semantic inputs to structured mixtures of 12 carefully selected base odorants.

2604.01798.tldr: It is indicated that the proposed optimization-guided, uncertainty-aware patch selection can achieve high performance and improve the computational efficiency of histopathology-based PAM50 classification compared to existing methods, suggesting a scalable imaging-based replacement that has the potential to support clinical decision-making.

2604.01907.tldr: It is demonstrated that carefully designed data engines can leverage web-curated, unlabeled videos to automatically generate training data, to facilitate end-to-end models in 3D scene understanding alongside human-annotated datasets.

2604.01965.tldr: This work designs a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework that performs task-aware routing to select specialized retrieval strategies based on the input query, and demonstrates that retrieval and model scale are complementary rather than interchangeable.

2412.20760.tldr: This work investigates how pretraining leads to biased culture-conditioned generations by analyzing how models associate entities with cultures based on pretraining data patterns, and proposes the MEMOed framework (MEMOrization from pretraining document) to determine whether a generation for a culture arises from memorization.

2505.16522.tldr: A multi-bias benchmark is proposed where each sample contains multiple types of biases and existing LLMs and debiasing methods perform poorly on this benchmark, highlighting the challenge of eliminating such compounded biases.

2505.14412.tldr: This paper introduces PRL (Prompts from Reinforcement Learning), a novel RL-based approach for automatic prompt generation that achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of benchmarks, including text classification, simplification, and summarization.

2508.12782.tldr: HeroBench is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon, hierarchical planning and structured reasoning in a complex RPG-inspired virtual world and finds no model reliably solves the hardest tasks, highlighting persistent challenges in long-horizon autonomous planning.

2508.16771.tldr: EyeMulator is presented, a model-agnostic technique to align CodeLLM attention with human visual attention without architectural changes, by extracting scan paths from eye-tracking data to derive token-level attention weights used to augment the loss function during fine-tuning.

2507.03052.tldr: 8:16 semi-structured sparsity is explored, demonstrating its ability to surpass the Performance Threshold-where a compressed model matches the accuracy of its uncompressed or smaller counterpart under equivalent memory constraints.

2411.04832.tldr: A unified definition of plasticity loss is proposed, its drivers and pathologies are examined, and over 50 mitigation strategies are organized into the first comprehensive taxonomy of the field.

2401.10747.tldr: A novel knowledge-transfer network is proposed to translate between different modalities to reconstruct the missing audio features and develop a cross-modality attention mechanism to maximize the information extracted from the reconstructed and observed modalities for sentiment prediction.

2301.13331.tldr: This article aims to provide a comprehensive insight into how data-driven approaches can complement conventional techniques to solve engineering and physics problems, while also noting some of the open problems of machine learning-based approaches.

2508.16745.tldr: It is found that most neural architectures trained from scratch can learn rule inference and achieve high next-step accuracy, but performance drops sharply as the required number of intermediate reasoning steps increases.

2507.20016.tldr: This paper revisits the generalization problem in FL and investigates the impact of data heterogeneity on FL generalization, and proposes a novel and effective federated learning algorithm with Stochastic Weight Averaging (called FedSWA), which aims to find flatter minima in the setting of highly heterogeneous data.

2507.20409.tldr: Cognitive Chain-of-Thought (CoCoT) is introduced, a reasoning framework that structures vision-language-model (VLM) reasoning through three cognitively inspired stages that enhances interpretability and social alignment, laying the groundwork for more reliable multimodal systems.

2506.10060.tldr: This work introduces Metropolis-Hastings through LLM Proposals (MHLP), a novel Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm that combines prompt optimization techniques with standard MCMC methods and demonstrates a viable path for incorporating methods from the rich Bayesian literature into the era of LLMs.

2505.04852.tldr: This paper proposes a raw pointer rewriting technique that lifts raw pointers in individual functions to appropriate Rust data structures and leverages code change analysis to guide the repair of errors introduced during rewriting, effectively addressing errors encountered during compilation and test case execution.

2505.02861.tldr: MetaOrch, a neural orchestration framework for optimal agent selection in multi-domain task environments, implements a supervised learning approach that models task context, agent histories, and expected response quality to select the most appropriate agent for each task.

2504.10286.tldr: A large-scale analysis of Chirper.ai, an X/Twitter-like social network entirely populated by LLM agents, comprising over 65,000 agents and 7.7 million AI-generated posts is presented, offering a profile of agent behaviors in an online social network driven by LLMs.

2503.04798.tldr: Scalable Multi-Agent Realistic Testbed (SMART) is presented, a realistic and efficient software tool for evaluating Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) algorithms that scales to thousands of robots.

2306.08550.tldr: This half-day tutorial focuses on providing a thorough understanding of user simulation techniques designed specifically for evaluation purposes, covering both general frameworks for designing user simulators, and specific models and algorithms for simulating user interactions with search engines, recommender systems, and conversational assistants.

2508.14410.tldr: This work introduces LogiOR, a diverse logistics benchmark with rigorous annotations, and proposes ORThought, a structured dual-agent framework that eliminates the redundancy of uncontrolled autonomous agents by incorporating expert-level modeling principles via chain-of-thought reasoning.

2506.23040.tldr: This work starts with the treatment problem, the patient's core medical decision-making task, which is solved in collaboration with a clinician, and discusses different approaches to solving it, including, within evidence-based medicine, experimental and observational data.

2506.01770.tldr: This paper proposes ReGA, a model-based analysis framework with Representation-Guided Abstraction, to safeguard LLMs against harmful prompts and generations, and effectively narrows the scalability gap when developing the abstract model for safety modeling.

2506.00772.tldr: It is stated that weights with the largest magnitude after low-rank approximation are critical weights for fine-tuning, which the authors call Principal Weights, and surprisingly, while magnitude-based sparse fine-tuning performs poorly as a baseline on LLM fine-tuning, it becomes highly effective after rank reduction.

2505.24037.tldr: The strengths of SEFT lie in its ability to perform task-specific adaptation through a weight drop-and-grow strategy, enabling the pruned model to self-adapt its sparse connectivity pattern based on the target dataset, while preserving the overall sparsity throughout the process.

2505.03451.tldr: This work proposes the first framework for quishing detection that directly analyzes QR code structure and pixel patterns without extracting the embedded content, and reveals that the structural features of QR code correlate strongly with phishing risk.

2502.20295.tldr: This paper investigates a suite of methods combining OCR, LLM post-processing and MLLM end-to-end transcription, for the task of zero-shot multi-page handwritten document transcription, and introduces OCR+PAGE-1 and OCR+PAGE-N, prompting strategies for multi-page transcription that outperform existing methods.

2412.02617.tldr: This work investigates the use of feedback to enhance the quality of object dynamics in text-to-video models and proposes leveraging vision-language models to provide perceptual feedback specifically tailored to object dynamics in videos.

2408.11338.tldr: This work provides open-source software that incorporates existing methods for label error detection, robust learning under noisy and biased data, ensuring a higher-quality training data and more robust model training procedure and designs three benchmark datasets focused on label noise detection, label noise learning, and class-imbalanced learning.

2411.18384.tldr: This paper delves into the deployment of in-network learning models with the aim of implementing fully distributed intrusion detection systems (IDS) or intrusion prevention systems (IPS) with the aim of ensuring complete network security without excessively burdening the normal operations of the devices.

2506.10630.tldr: Time-R1 is proposed, a two-stage reinforcement fine-tuning framework designed to enhance multi-step reasoning ability of LLMs for time series forecasting and designs a fine-grained multi-objective reward specifically for time series forecasting, and introduces GRIP (group-based relative importance for policy optimization), which leverages non-uniform sampling to further encourage and optimize the model's exploration of effective reasoning paths.

2506.13674.tldr: It is demonstrated empirically that prefix-tuning underperforms on LLMs because of an inherent tradeoff between the contribution of the input prompt and the parameterized prefix within the attention head, and suggested that by overcoming its inherent limitations, prefix-tuning can remain a competitive and relevant research direction in the landscape of parameter-efficient LLM adaptation.

2506.12622.tldr: This work introduces Distributionally Robust Soft Actor-Critic (DR-SAC), the first actor-critic based DR-RL algorithm for offline learning in continuous action spaces that maximizes the entropy-regularized rewards against the worst possible transition models within an KL-divergence constrained uncertainty set.

2505.20075.tldr: Comprehensive experimental results suggest that reward models trained with Curriculum-RLAIF achieve improved generalizability, boosting the alignment performance of policy models by a significant margin without incurring additional inference costs compared to various existing non-curriculum baselines.

2505.11140.tldr: This work introduces fs1, a simple yet effective method that improves the factuality of reasoning traces by collecting them from large reasoning models and grounding them in knowledge graph (KG) paths and shows strong evidence that anchoring reasoning to factual KG paths is a critical step in transforming LLMs for reliable knowledge-intensive tasks.

2408.16213.tldr: M4CXR achieves state-of-the-art clinical accuracy in MRG by employing a chain-of-thought prompting strategy, in which it identifies findings in CXR images and subsequently generates corresponding reports.

2509.23542.tldr: Experiments suggest that future-proofing is challenging for most models, while backward-compatibility is relatively easy, with DPO-trained models consistently improving performance, and continual learning provides a more balanced adaptation to shifts between older and newer response distributions than training solely on stronger or weaker responses.

2509.15974.tldr: The key finding is that directly fine-tuning $\boldsymbol{b}_v$ generally leads to higher downstream performance in low-data regimes, in comparison to $\boldsymbol{b}_q$ and $\boldsymbol{b}_k$.

2509.15651.tldr: A novel approach is introduced that leverages dropout as a gradient compression mechanism to compute the influence function more efficiently and significantly reduces computational and memory overhead, not only during the influence function computation but also in gradient compression process.

2509.18060.tldr: TMD-TTS is proposed, a unified Tibetan multi-dialect text-to-speech (TTS) framework that synthesizes parallel dialectal speech from explicit dialect labels to capture fine-grained acoustic and linguistic variations across dialects.

2508.19564.tldr: Bi-directional Low-Rank Adaptation is proposed, which introduces an auxiliary LoRA module to model SAM's adversarial weight perturbations, and decouples SAM's weight perturbations from LoRA optimization: the primary LoRA module adapts to specific tasks via standard gradient descent, while the auxiliary module captures the sharpness of the loss landscape through gradient ascent.

2604.10597.tldr: COREY is presented, a prototype scheduler that uses activation entropy estimated via fixed-width histograms as a runtime signal for chunk-size selection at the kernel-invocation level, supporting COREY as a practical runtime auto-tuner within a single regime.

2604.10210.tldr: A3-FPN is proposed, to augment multi-scale feature representation via the asymptotically disentangled framework and content-aware attention modules, and employs a horizontally-spread column network that enables asymptotically global feature interaction and disentangles each level from all hierarchical representations.

2604.06201.tldr: Text2DistBench is introduced, a reading comprehension benchmark for evaluating LLMs'ability to infer distributional knowledge from natural language, and experiments show that while models substantially outperform random baselines, performance varies widely across different distribution types and characteristics.

2602.23580.tldr: BRIDGE, a Bias-Reducing Inter-group Data GEneration framework designed for low-resource assessment settings, is proposed, offering a cost-effective solution for ensuring equitable scoring in large-scale assessments.

2604.04503.tldr: This work proposes a novel Memory Intelligence Agent (MIA) framework, consisting of a Manager-Planner-Executor architecture, which enables the Planner to continuously evolve during test-time learning, with updates performed on-the-fly alongside inference without interrupting the reasoning process.

2602.23827.tldr: A novel FedNSAM algorithm is proposed that accelerates the SAM algorithm by introducing global Nesterov momentum into the local update to harmonize the consistency of global and local flatness.

2604.08299.tldr: SeLaR (Selective Latent Reasoning), a lightweight and training-free framework that introduces an entropy-gated mechanism that activates soft embeddings only at low-confidence steps, while preserving discrete decoding at high-confidence steps, and an entropy-aware contrastive regularization that pushes soft embeddings away from the dominant token's direction, encouraging sustained exploration of multiple latent reasoning paths.

2604.10702.tldr: Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion (MIGF), an architecture-agnostic module that maintains separate modality-specific encoding streams before a learned gating stage, combined with modality dropout training to enforce compensation under incomplete inputs is proposed.

2604.06211.tldr: Motivated by Achinstein's illocutionary theory of explanation, illocutionary macro-planning is introduced as a descriptive design principle for source-faithful explanations and CoI is instantiate, which expands a query into implicit explanatory questions that drive retrieval.

2604.05002.tldr: It is shown that strong in-domain performance under weak supervision can be misleading and motivate feature stability as a lightweight diagnostic for non-transferability before deployment, and failures arise from supervision drift rather than model capacity or simple covariate shift.

2604.08539.tldr: Gaussian GRPO (G$^2$RPO), a novel RL training objective that replaces standard linear scaling with non-linear distributional matching, is introduced and OpenVLThinkerV2, a highly robust, general-purpose multimodal model is presented.

2604.07798.tldr: LightMem modularizes memory retrieval, writing, and long-term consolidation, and separates online processing from offline consolidation to enable efficient memory invocation under bounded compute.

2604.07892.tldr: This work proposes MDS (Multi-turn Dialogue Selection), a dialogue-level framework that scores whole conversations rather than isolated turns, and outperforms strong single-turn selectors, dialogue-level LLM scorers, and heuristic baselines on three multi-turn benchmarks and an in-domain Banking test set.

2604.07506.tldr: ReflectRM is a novel GRM that leverages self-reflection to assess analytical quality and enhance preference modeling and substantially mitigates positional bias, yielding +10.2 improvement compared with leading GRMs and establishing itself as a more stable evaluator.

2604.05523.tldr: A configurable multi-agent supply chain economic model where LLMs act as retailer agents responsible for procuring and retailing merchandise and provides a reproducible testbed for studying how LLMs interact in competitive markets is constructed.

2604.11043.tldr: EmergentBridge is proposed, an embedding-level bridging framework that improves performance on unpaired pairs of modality pairs without requiring exhaustive pairwise supervision, and demonstrates strong emergent alignment.

2604.09628.tldr: A qualitative-to-quantitative scoring framework is proposed: qualitative expert assessments of XAI properties are aggregated into a regulation-specific compliance score, which helps practitioners identify when XAI solutions may support legal explanation requirements while highlighting technical issues that require further research and regulatory clarification.

2603.20435.tldr: The results demonstrate that deep reflective reasoning can systematically improve the reliability of LLM-based structured data extraction under interdependence constraints, enabling more consistent machine-operable clinical datasets and facilitating knowledge discovery with machine learning and data science towards digital health.

2603.14389.tldr: Decoupled Gradient Policy Optimization (DGPO) is proposed, which employs a decoupled decay mechanism based on importance sampling ratios based on importance sampling ratios to resolve the conflict between stability and sustained exploration in RLVR.

2604.16364.tldr: TRACE is introduced, a scalable preprocessing pipeline that removes note bloat by leveraging EHR attribution metadata to identify templated and copied content and applying frequency-based deduplication when metadata are unavailable, showing how underutilized EHR metadata can enable more scalable and cost-efficient deployment of LLM-based clinical systems.

2604.16362.tldr: This work introduces SetFlow, a generative architecture that models entire MIL bags (i.e., sets) directly in the representation space, enabling it to handle permutation-invariant inputs while capturing interactions between instances within each bag.

2604.16349.tldr: RT-QA, a dynamic evaluation framework that leverages executable code workflows to retrieve up-to-date answers at evaluation time, is proposed, constructing an agent-driven pipeline that autonomously generates code for web crawling and DOM-based answer extraction to produce real-time ground truth.

2604.16337.tldr: This study contributes to AI-driven legal assistance by demonstrating the potential of multi-agent LLM architectures in improving labor law compliance and streamlining HR operations.

2604.16334.tldr: This work explores the use of a differential-privacy based approach to improve generalization in Deep Neural Networks.

2604.16333.tldr: A discordance aware multimodal framework that combines machine learning prediction models with a tool grounded multi agent reasoning system to assign clinically interpretable OA phenotypes and generate phenotype specific management recommendations is proposed.

2604.16329.tldr: The results show that high-quality grounded facet labels can be more data-efficient than large-scale synthetic augmentation for learning fine-grained scientific similarity and are competitive with state-of-the-art results.

2604.16331.tldr: BrainMem, a training-free hierarchical memory system that equips embodied agents with working, episodic, and semantic memory inspired by human cognition, is proposed, highlighting evolving memory as a promising and scalable mechanism for generalizable embodied intelligence.

2604.16322.tldr: This study proposes IFCodeEvolve, an actor-schema co-evolution framework for instruction following coding data generation, and introduces a co-evolving paradigm that iteratively advances both the actor model and the schema library, via schema composition and mutation, based on sampler statistics.

2604.16313.tldr: The Multimodal Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented (MARA) framework is proposed, which introduces query-adaptive mechanisms to both retrieval and generation and consistently improves retrieval relevance and answer quality over existing SOTA method.

2604.16312.tldr: FlexStructRAG is proposed, a flexible structure-aware RAG framework that supports multi-granular, query-adaptive retrieval over heterogeneous knowledge representations, and can be flexibly combined to supply generation with relationally and contextually aligned evidence.

2604.16310.tldr: The RAG-DIVE is introduced, a Dynamic Interactive Validation and Evaluation approach that simulates user interactions with RAG systems and facilitates dynamic, interaction-driven evaluation for multi-turn conversations, thereby advancing the assessment of RAG systems.

2604.11407.tldr: GRIP is proposed, a unified framework in which the model regulates retrieval behavior through control-token emission that surpasses strong RAG baselines and is competitive with GPT-4o while using substantially fewer parameters.

2604.16343.tldr: LDER-SIM provides a psychometrically validated approach for constructing personality-consistent elderly digital twin agents, supporting reliable longitudinal simulation for elderly mental health care and reproducible in silico evaluation before clinical deployment.

2604.16336.tldr: A phased empirical roadmap to operationalize MEI is proposed through personality modeling, synchronization testing, robotic embodiment trials, and ethical stress-testing, highlighting opportunities for human-AI integration while underscoring the need for inclusive ethical governance.

2604.12474.tldr: A Markov Decision Process is defined that explicitly incorporates analytical second-order constraints and use it to refine first-order plans generated by a hybrid planner, showing that this approach can reliably recover physical feasibility and effectively bridge the gap between a planner's initial first-order trajectory and the dynamics required for real execution.

2604.16363.tldr: Compositional Semantic Fingerprinting (CSF) is presented, the first black-box method for attributing fine-tuned text-to-image models to protected lineages using only query access and enables controlled-risk lineage decisions.

2604.16351.tldr: Treating pooled cosine as a recall interface, MaxSim excels at reranking but fails to reject structural near-misses, whereas a small Transformer over similarity maps reliably separates near-misses under end-to-end training.

2604.16347.tldr: Lean Atlas, a Lean 4 tool that visualizes the dependency graph of a Lean 4 project as an interactive web viewer, enabling human scientists to grasp the overall structure of a formalization efficiently, is developed and proposed as a quality standard for AI-generated formalizations.

2604.16345.tldr: A human-in-the-loop AI assistant that combines first-person experimental video, multimodal AI, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to suggest a framework in which AI supports laboratory practice under explicit human supervision rather than replacing human judgment.

2604.16323.tldr: This work proposes a process-oriented explainability framework that exposes how agentic decisions unfold across time, tool calls, and architectural boundaries, and supports the minimum level of human comprehension required for agentic oversight to remain substantive.

2604.16311.tldr: This work presents the first benchmark for multimodal claim extraction from social media, consisting of posts containing text and one or more images, annotated with gold-standard claims derived from real-world fact-checkers.

2604.16304.tldr: Through interviews with nineteen practitioners across diverse sectors, this work identifies ten evaluation practices spanning informal ‘vibe checks’ to organizational meta-work and suggests these interpretive practices are necessary adaptations to LLM characteristics rather than methodological failures.

2604.16301.tldr: This study presents a novel two-step system for domain-specific query interpretation in the automotive context that achieves an effective balance between responsiveness, reliability, and scalability and demonstrates that decomposing query understanding into modular subtasks leads to a scalable, accurate, and latency-efficient solution.

2604.11909.tldr: This research introduces the Thermodynamic Liquid Manifold Network, a robust, thermodynamically consistent standard for edge-deployable microgrid controllers that completely neutralizes phantom nocturnal generation while maintaining zero-lag synchronization during rapid weather shifts.

2604.12306.tldr: The GCA framework is presented, which unifies GCA-DS, a curated multimodal dataset grounded in the GCC states, and GCA, a tool-augmented agent for climate analysis, which orchestrates a modular tool pipeline grounded in real-time and historical signals and geospatial processing that produces derived indices and interpretable visualizations.

2604.11137.tldr: A framework for trustworthy clinical argumentation is established by adapting the Toulmin model to the diagnostic process, and a novel training pipeline is proposed: Curriculum Goal-Conditioned Learning (CGCL), designed to progressively train LLM to generate diagnostic arguments that explicitly follow this Toulmin structure.

2604.16360.tldr: Overall, whereas immersive technologies and blockchain-related topics exhibit relative stability, AI shows a significant rise after 2022, emerging as a dominant theme within digital art conference discourse.

2604.16350.tldr: LiteSemRAG is proposed, a lightweight, fully LLM-free, semantic-aware graph retrieval framework that constructs a heterogeneous semantic graph by exploiting contextual token-level embeddings, explicitly separating surface lexical representations from context-dependent semantic meanings.

2604.16339.tldr: Evaluation across 600 runs spanning three multi-agent frameworks and four enterprise scenarios demonstrates that SCF is the only approach to achieve 100% workflow completion--compared to 25.1% for the next-best baseline--while detecting 65.2% of semantic conflicts with 27.9% precision.

2604.16338.tldr: The Agentic AI Governance Maturity Model (AAGMM) is introduced, a five-level framework spanning 12 governance domains, grounded in NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 standards, and a novel taxonomy of agent sprawl patterns--functional duplication, shadow agents, orphaned agents, permission creep, and unmonitored delegation chains--each linked to quantifiable business cost models.

2604.16335.tldr: A rubric-based Generative Reward Model (GRM) is introduced that provides richer learning signals and more effectively suppresses undesirable patterns while promoting beneficial ones, as confirmed by case analyses, and it ultimately improves final test accuracy.

2604.16325.tldr: UniMamba is introduced, a unified spatial-temporal forecasting framework that integrates efficient state-space dynamics with attention-based dependency learning and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art forecasting models in both forecasting accuracy and computational efficiency.

2604.16320.tldr: This work studies remedies to address a deficiency in exception prediction, and evaluates the effect of these remedies on the ability to predict non-exception behaviors and establishes the value of using perturbation to evaluate code models.

2604.16317.tldr: This work curates an open urban data discovery portal that provides the first large-scale, literature-derived infrastructure for urban data discovery and enables more systematic and reusable data-driven research across disciplines.

2604.12482.tldr: This work introduces a social learning approach in which robots can exploit optimized parameters from their peers to accelerate their own brain optimization, and suggests that incorporating knowledge from multiple teachers can yield more consistent and robust improvements.

2604.16474.tldr: This work demonstrates that the SNN simulator CARLsim can run its full feature set on a MCU RP2350 with 8 MB memory by utilizing IEEE 16-bit float point numbers, which reduced memory requirements without loss of function.

2604.16472.tldr: A structured bargaining environment where LLMs negotiate via tool calls within an event-driven simulator is developed, separating binding offers from natural-language messages to enable automated evaluation.

2604.16469.tldr: B-PASTE is proposed, a beam-aware extension that lifts speculation from single tools to local branch hypotheses under strict resource constraints and shows up to 1.4X end-to-end speedup, suggesting that branch-aware speculative execution remains effective even under tight resource budgets.

2604.16445.tldr: By analyzing voice disorders, the SAND challenge provides an opportunity to develop, test, and evaluate AI models for the automatic early identification and prediction of ALS disease progression.

2604.16442.tldr: These experimental results demonstrate that the sleep staging performance of the contactless Sleepal AI Lamp is in high agreement with expert-labeled PSG sleep stages, suggesting that non-contact radar sensing, combined with advanced temporal modeling, can provide reliable sleep staging performance without requiring physical contact or wearable devices.

2604.16437.tldr: It is concluded that ECG sampling frequency is a critical, underappreciated factor in arrhythmia detection, and future foundation models must explicitly control for temporal resolution to ensure clinical reliability and reproducibility.

2604.16431.tldr: An offline avalanche probe is introduced that converts gradient snapshots into cascade statistics and extracts amacroscopic observable -- the time-resolved effective cascade dimension $D(t)$ -- via grokking-aligned finite-size scaling via grokking-aligned finite-size scaling.

2604.16422.tldr: This study explores two complementary strategies for leveraging structured knowledge from the UMLS Metathesaurus: Continual pretraining that embeds knowledge into model parameters, and Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) that consults a knowledge graph at inference time.

2604.16406.tldr: Results show that synthetic self-play can provide a scalable route to controllable and realistic highway scenario generation without direct imitation of expert logs.

2604.16399.tldr: IACDM (Interactive Adversarial Convergence Development Methodology), a structured 8-phase framework designed to address the verification gap through external verification agents (VA) operating at discrete gates, is presented.

2604.16385.tldr: Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art multimodal web agents, this work shows that stress-based evaluation exposes failure modes and substantial robustness gaps that remain hidden under clean benchmark conditions.

2604.16383.tldr: LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks are increasingly trusted to automate evaluation in place of human experts, yet their reliability in high-stakes medical contexts remains unproven, and their use as autonomous evaluators or triage filters in clinical settings is undermined.

2604.16370.tldr: Brain-CLIPLM is introduced, a two-stage framework that decomposes EEG-to-text decoding into semantic anchor extraction via contrastive learning and sentence reconstruction using a retrieval-grounded large language model (LLM) with Chain-of-Thought reasoning, following a granularity matching principle that aligns decoding complexity with neural information capacity.

2604.16397.tldr: These findings demonstrate that thoughtfully integrated custom GPTs can act as powerful pedagogical partners that leverage all three dimensions of immersion, creating more engaging and immersive online learning environments.

2604.16465.tldr: These findings demonstrate systematic heterogeneity in the nature of coordination work across healthcare roles and suggest that the opportunities for digital and AI interventions are unevenly distributed, shaped less by technical task complexity than by underlying coordination structure.

2604.16463.tldr: MLE-Toolbox is a comprehensive open-source MATLAB toolbox for end-to-end analysis of magnetoencephalography (MEG) and electroencephalography (EEG) data, designed to lower the barrier to rigorous, reproducible MEG/EEG research.

2604.16430.tldr: HalluSAE, a phase transition-inspired framework that models hallucination as a critical shift in the model's latent dynamics, identifies critical transition zones and attributes factual errors to specific high-energy sparse features.

2604.16429.tldr: M Mosaic is introduced, a probabilistic weather forecasting model that addresses two principal sources of spectral degradation in ML-based weather prediction: deterministic training against ensemble means and compressive encoding creating an information bottleneck.

2604.16421.tldr: These results suggest that current models rely on representation-specific heuristics rather than abstract geometric reasoning, and propose GeoRepEval, a representation-aware evaluation framework that measures correctness, invariance, and consistency at the problem level across parallel formulations.

2604.16420.tldr: This paper proposes a two-stage, structure-based evolutionary operator for LLM-AHD and demonstrates that the proposed operator can significantly enhance the search ability of state-of-the-art LLM-AHD algorithms, such as EoH-S.

2604.16403.tldr: It is argued that GenAI systems function as "context machines" that must inherently address three interpretive challenges: situatedness, plurality, plurality, and ambiguity.

2604.16400.tldr: CoLLM is introduced, a system that unifies FL PEFT and inference on shared edge replicas and model parameters and addresses key challenges at both replica and cluster levels through: an intra-replica model sharing mechanism that enables real-time model parameter reuse via unmerged inference and shadow adapter strategies.

2604.16386.tldr: The DAOnt ontology supports compliance checking through SPARQL queries that return obligations, permissions, and prohibitions, allowing organisations to verify whether data-sharing agreements meet the requirements of the EU Data Act and to assess conditions such as FRAND obligations.

2604.16367.tldr: This study constructs a multimodal AI Washing Risk Score (AWRS), a Material Real-Investment Matching Index (MRMI) from patent quality, AI intangible asset capitalization, and technical personnel compensation using PCA, and finds that substantive AI investment boosts high-quality patents, while empty rhetoric crowds out industry innovation.

2604.16471.tldr: An axiomatic information model comprising Lsem-definable state sets linked by computable enabling maps, and the semantic channel is defined as a composition of Markov kernels whose supports respect the enabling structure, introducing an overlap decomposition that yields necessary and sufficient conditions for closure-reliable communication.

2604.16462.tldr: HalfV is proposed, a framework that first mitigates IVR via a unified pruning strategy and then adaptively handles SSR based on its specific manifestation, and achieves superior efficiency-performance trade-offs across diverse backbones.

2604.16398.tldr: A framework for human-AI Q-matrix refinement is proposed in which large language models (LLMs) generate candidate Q-matrices using structured, misconception-aware prompting, and NeuralCDM provides an empirical evaluation layer to compare candidates based on how well they explain student response data.

2604.16394.tldr: A bounded, auditable reference architecture for agentic hybrid retrieval that combines BM25 lexical search with dense-embedding retrieval via reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), orchestrated by a large language model (LLM) agent that repeatedly plans queries, evaluates the sufficiency of results, and reranks candidates is proposed.

2604.16392.tldr: The dataset's utility is demonstrated through a longitudinal analysis that quantifies a "regime shift" from volatile historical formats to a standardized, algebra-dominant modern curriculum, providing a foundation for reproducible research in difficulty modeling, curriculum analytics, and LLM evaluation in low-resource linguistic contexts.

2604.16387.tldr: This study examines whether LLMs can support post-publication peer review tasks by benchmarking their outputs against expert judgments and citation-based indicators, and shows that LLMs perform well in coarse grained evaluation tasks, however, performance decreases substantially in fine-grained rating tasks.

2604.16369.tldr: The Siloed-Integrated-Orchestrated (SIO) progression model is introduced, which maps enterprise AI capability across five pillars -- Culture&Leadership, Human Capital&Operations, Data Architecture, Systems Infrastructure, and Governance&Regulatory Compliance -- and provides prescriptive guidance for advancing between stages.

2604.16479.tldr: This work proposes a latent compression method that removes high-frequency components in video latent representations rather than directly reducing the number of channels, which often compromises reconstruction fidelity.

2604.16475.tldr: SDLLM is proposed, a spike-driven large language model that eliminates dense matrix multiplications through sparse addition operations and uses the plug-and-play gamma-SQP two-step spike encoding method to ensure that the quantization process aligns with the model's semantic space, mitigating representation degradation caused by binary spikes.

2604.16459.tldr: A novel hierarchical tree loss is developed to enable a holistic mapping of same-attribute classes, leveraging tree-based positive and negative hierarchical knowledge constraints and a focal hierarchical tree loss is designed to enhance its extensibility and devise two adaptive weighting schemes based on tree height.

2604.16456.tldr: EchoChain is introduced, a controlled benchmark for evaluating full-duplex state-update reasoning under mid-speech interruptions and identifies three recurring failure patterns in post-interruption continuations: contextual inertia, interruption amnesia, and objective displacement.

2604.16441.tldr: The iPhoneme system combines a deep learning phoneme decoder based on a modified Conformer architecture with a gaze-assisted phoneme input interface that mitigates the Midas touch problem in eye-tracking systems, and introduces a chorded gaze-plus-silent-speech paradigm that replaces dwell-time selection, enabling more efficient input.

2604.16440.tldr: It is demonstrated that LatentMimic enables effective terrain-adaptive locomotion, achieving higher terrain traversal success rates than state-of-the-art motion-tracking methods while maintaining high stylistic fidelity.

2604.16434.tldr: A recurrent arbitration architecture is developed in which active constraint fields jointly determine a hypothesis geometry over candidates, and the system compresses it into a support-aware control state whose resolution is regulated by current consequence geometry, arbitration memory, and resource constraints.

2604.16432.tldr: A quantitative discussion of the merits of using a diverse panel of AIs to support decision-making in such areas will move away from dangerous reliance on single AI systems and encourage a balanced assessment of the extent to which diversity needs to be built into the AI parts of the socioeconomic systems that are so important for the authors' future.

2604.16424.tldr: This work presents the first systematic treatment of SSM safety, security, and cognitive risks, and proposes four cognitive risk hypotheses grounded in state-compression mechanics.

2604.16419.tldr: The results indicate that fairness-induced exploration exhibits diminishing or non-monotonic returns and varies substantially across users, suggesting that recommendation systems should adapt not only to relevance but also to the amount of fairness-driven exploration applied to individual users.

2604.16413.tldr: Inter-Prompt Reliability (IPR) is introduced, a framework for evaluating the stability of LLM outputs across semantically equivalent but linguistically varied prompts to suggest that LLM prompt acts as an instrumental measurement while its wording exhibits methodological uncertainty.

2604.16407.tldr: It is shown that hallucinated citations are not random inventions but patterned recombinations of real authors, journals, dates, and keywords, with duplication occurring in nearly 30% of cases, and that web-enabled AI still does not fully eliminate fabricated references.

2604.16405.tldr: This work proposes ICAT, which grounds testing in real incident reports and safety manuals by building structured risk memories and retrieving/composing them to constrain the generation of risk cases with causal chains and severity labels.

2604.16401.tldr: GraphRAG-Router is proposed, a cost-efficient framework that adopts a hierarchical routing strategy to coordinate heterogeneous GraphRAGs and generator LLMs, and is first warmed up through supervised fine-tuning and then optimized with a two-stage reinforcement learning procedure.

2604.16395.tldr: Stream2LLM introduces adaptive scheduling and preemption for two distinct retrieval patterns: append-mode (progressive context accumulation) and update-mode (iterative refinement with cache invalidation), which demonstrates that streaming architecture delivers up to 11x TTFT improvements, with cost-aware scheduling providing critical benefits under memory pressure.

2604.16372.tldr: This work constructs CFMS, the first fine-grained multimodal sarcasm dataset tailored for Chinese social media and proposes a Reinforcement Learning-augmented In-Context Learning strategy (PGDS) to dynamically optimize exemplar selection.

2604.16588.tldr: The results indicate that combining pretrained HAR representations with efficient state-space temporal modeling is a practical direction for low-latency intention prediction in real-world sports video.

2604.16582.tldr: Camo-M3FD (derived from the M3FD dataset), a novel benchmark for cross-spectral camouflaged pedestrian detection, consisting of registered visible-thermal image pairs, is introduced, demonstrating that while thermal signals provide indispensable localization cues, multispectral fusion is essential for refining structural details.

2604.16574.tldr: This work proposes a Federated Optimal Brain Personalization algorithm with a quantile-based thresholding mechanism and introduces an element-wise importance score, which extends Optimal Brain Damage (OBD) pruning theory by incorporating a federated approximation of the first-order derivative in the Taylor expansion to evaluate the importance of each parameter for personalization.

2604.16562.tldr: This paper is the first to comprehensively investigate the negative effects of label noise on generalization in gaze estimation, and proposes a novel solution, called See-Through-Noise (SeeTN) framework, which improves generalization from a novel perspective of mitigating label noise.

2604.16554.tldr: Results indicate that jointly modeling pathological temporal dynamics and physiology-constrained pseudo-supervision can provide more robust cross-subject initialization for personalized post-stroke MI-BCI rehabilitation.

2604.16533.tldr: Graph PARC (G-PARC) is proposed, which uses moving least squares (MLS) kernels to approximate spatial derivatives on unstructured graphs, and embeds the derivatives of governing partial differential equations into the network's computational graph, enabling accurate modeling of extreme nonlinear phenomena on complex computational domains.

2604.16529.tldr: This work proposes a test-time scaling framework for agentic coding based on compact representations of rollout trajectories that converts each rollout into a structured summary that preserves its salient hypotheses, progress, and failure modes while discarding low-signal trace details.

2604.16498.tldr: Forge-UGC is presented, a four-phase compiler for transformer deployment on heterogeneous accelerator hardware, validated on Intel AI Boost NPU, and Fusion Gain Ratio, Compilation Efficiency Index, and per-pass execution profiling for systematic evaluation of NPU compilation pipelines are introduced.

2604.16496.tldr: This work proposes ISI-CV, the first gradient-free synaptic importance metric for SNN continual learning, derived from the Coefficient of Variation (CV) of Inter-Spike Intervals (ISIs), which requires only spike time counters and integer arithmetic.

2604.16493.tldr: This study dissects NL2SQL systems into three core modules: Schema Selection, Candidate Generation, and Query Revision, and systematically assess each approach across the three core modules and evaluate multiple critical performance dimensions.

2604.16485.tldr: This paper shows that using a network to learn where to attend from a large pre-trained model can be used to pre-process images and greatly reduce network size by reducing the input sequence length to just the key features being attended to.

2604.16586.tldr: This survey traces four complementary paradigms, including Quantum, Descriptor Machine Learning, Geometric Deep Learning, and Foundation Models, and outlines a unified taxonomy linking molecular representations, model architectures, and interdisciplinary applications, and proposes three forward-looking directions.

2604.16583.tldr: Experiments using 15 real LoRA adapters for Qwen2.5-7B together with measured GPU paging latencies show that adaptive cache control substantially outperforms non-adaptive baselines and exhibits scaling trends consistent with the theory.

2604.16577.tldr: This study explores a novel framework of a two-level network architecture with dual-stage feature fusion: late fusion, which combines the outputs from the first network level, and intermediate fusion, which integrates the features from both the first and second levels.

2604.16575.tldr: A lightweight decision framework that prioritizes temporal or structural features before training, using two diagnostics: lag-1 autocorrelation of an aggregated flow signal and PCA cumulative explained variance, and when the probes are inconclusive.

2604.16540.tldr: This paper proposes PoInit-of-View, which optimizes adversarial perturbations to intentionally introduce cross-view gradient inconsistencies at projections of corresponding 3D points, which disrupt keypoint detection and feature matching, thereby corrupting pose estimation and triangulation within SfM, eventually resulting in low-quality rendered views.

2604.16584.tldr: LeetProof, an agentic pipeline built on Velvet, a multi-modal verifier embedded in Lean, enables LeetProof to validate generated specifications via randomised property-based testing before any code is synthesised, decompose the synthesis task into sub-problems guided by verification conditions, and delegate residual proof obligations to frontier AI provers specialised for Lean.

2604.16581.tldr: This work modifications the Random Re-Construct approach of the Light Encoder Heavy Decoder model by incorporating Simulated Annealing (SA), introducing a probabilistic acceptance mechanism that allows the model to escape local optima and explore a more diverse solution space.

2604.16570.tldr: This paper reveals three critical yet heretofore overlooked problems in DNA pretraining: inappropriate downstream datasets, inherent flaws in the neighbor-masking strategy, and the lack of detailed discussion on vocabulary.

2604.16565.tldr: This work proposes a geometric perspective: Reasoning on the Manifold, and introduces Bidirectional Manifold Consistency (BMC), a training-free, unsupervised metric that quantifies the stability of the generated sequence through a forward-masking and backward-reconstruction cycle.

2604.16560.tldr: Overall, the evaluation indicates that SpecPylot is able to generate crosshair-compatible contracts for most programs, but it also highlights the practical limits introduced by bounded symbolic exploration and differences in LLM behavior.

2604.16543.tldr: Across star, chain, and DAG topologies, routing-aware optimization substantially increases attack success over non-optimized baselines while keeping false activations low and exposing a structural vulnerability in agentic LLM pipelines.

2604.16521.tldr: CAMP (Cumulative Agentic Masking and Pruning), a cross-turn privacy protection framework for multi-turn LLM conversations, is evaluated, demonstrating that per-turn baselines expose re-identifiable profiles that CAMP successfully neutralizes while preserving full conversational utility.

2604.16503.tldr: The results suggest that careful architectural specialization, combined with an efficiency-oriented training recipe, can narrow or exceed the quality gap typically associated with much larger video models.

2604.16499.tldr: A simple yet effective framework to generate high-quality adversarial examples on vision-language pre-trained models, named HQA-VLAttack, which consists of text and image attack stages and leverages the counter-fitting word vector to generate the substitute word set, thus guaranteeing the semantic consistency between the substitute word and the original word.

2604.16491.tldr: A lightweight transformer architecture that fuses multiple fNIRS representations through a unified tokenization mechanism, enabling joint modeling of complementary signal views without requiring modality-specific adaptations or increasing architectural complexity is presented.

2604.16481.tldr: This work presents Erasing Thousands of Concepts (ETC), a scalable framework capable of erasing thousands of concepts while preserving generation quality and achieves robustness to white-box attack such as module removal.

2604.16535.tldr: SCATR is a simple and efficient BoN ranking method that learns a lightweight scorer from a small calibration set using hidden representations from the base model, and offers a strong accuracy-efficiency trade-off for scalable test-time selection.

2604.16492.tldr: LayerCache is proposed, a layer-aware caching framework that partitions the Transformer into layer groups and makes independent, per-group caching decisions at each denoising step, and introduces an adaptive JVP span K selection mechanism that leverages per-group stability measurements to balance estimation accuracy and computational savings.

2604.16484.tldr: The Causal Latent World Model (CLWM), which employs DINOv3 features as generative targets to disentangle interaction semantics from visual noise, yielding highly robust domain generalization, is introduced.

2604.16579.tldr: EviDep is proposed, an evidential learning framework that jointly quantifies depression severity alongside aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties via a Normal-Inverse-Gamma distribution, and achieves state-of-the-art predictive accuracy and superior uncertainty calibration, delivering a robust fail-safe mechanism for trustworthy clinical screening.

2604.16555.tldr: This work proposes LLMasTool, a hierarchical tree-based NAS framework for stable and open-ended model evolution that automatically extracts reusable modules from arbitrary source code and represents full architectures as hierarchical trees, enabling evolution through reliable tree transformations rather than code generation.

2604.16550.tldr: The PWRules framework is developed, which applies binding affinity data to identify privileged small molecule fragments and subsequently defines complementary pairing rules between these fragments and protein words through an interpretability module, and which provides an interpretable framework for drug discovery.

2604.16548.tldr: This work characterize agent memory as malleable, rewritable, and socially propagating, and develops a memory-lifecycle framework organized around six phases -- Write, Store, Retrieve, Execute, Share, Forget/Rollback -- cross-tabulated against four security objectives: integrity, confidentiality, availability, governance.

2604.16538.tldr: This work investigates the effectiveness of tool-augmented agents for this task through a systematic factorial analysis of three distinct tool categories: Fine-tuned Model Querying, Knowledge Search, and Compiler Feedback.

2604.16537.tldr: This study challenges the assumption that successful external calibration guarantees model generalizability and proposes two complementary strategies to improve transportability of prognostic models across cohorts to identify the one most suitable for a given target cohort in terms of both calibration and clinical utility.

2604.16536.tldr: It is argued that practical unlearning tests must provide thorough coverage over proxy and mediated influence pathways, debuggable diagnostics that localize where leakage persists, cost-effective regression-style execution under query budgets, and black-box applicability for API-deployed models.

2604.16532.tldr: It is argued that a thorough assessment of adversarial risk in medical AI necessitates multi-metric frameworks that encompass not only the attack efficacy but also its methodology and associated overheads.

2604.16518.tldr: This survey consolidates the emerging field of on-orbit space AI through three complementary paradigms: federated learning for cross-satellite training, personalization, and secure aggregation, and collaborative sensing and distributed inference for multi-satellite fusion, tracking, split/early-exit inference, and cross-layer co-design with constellation networking.

2604.16587.tldr: An amortized approach that learns to estimate the causal effects of semantic regions directly from the rich signals encoded in attention features, demonstrating that real-time, faithful attribution in multimodal thinking models is achievable through lightweight learning, not brute-force computation.

2604.16585.tldr: This work validates the GNWM across passive observation, active agent control, and abstract sequence regimes, demonstrating its capacity to act not just as a spatial physics simulator, but as a causal discovery model capable of organizing continuous, predictable concepts into structured topological maps.

2604.16563.tldr: This study presents an automatic classification system for systolic murmurs using a feature extraction module, followed by a classification model that enhances the accuracy and reliability of heart murmur identification.

2604.16552.tldr: A new paradigm of sequential text-to-scene generation is presented and a novel generative model for interactive scene creation is proposed and presented, which unifies the autoregressive generation over a multimodal token sequence and diffusion generation of next-object 3D latents.

2604.16534.tldr: The findings reveal that the Hyperledger Fabric-based system excels in terms of scalability, speed, and cost-effectiveness, while both frameworks offer advantages over traditional centralized protocols in system cyber resilience, data security, and privacy.

2604.16528.tldr: An expert-annotated dataset consisting of embryo images and corresponding morphological description using natural language has the potential to enhance the decision-making process and improve patient outcomes significantly over time.

2604.16505.tldr: A novel hybrid model that combines DINOv2, a transformer-based vision model, with an enhanced long short-term memory (LSTM) network featuring a multi-head attention layer is proposed that can assist embryologists in selecting better embryos more efficiently and with greater confidence.

2604.16490.tldr: A novel loss function integrating fuzzy logic to deals uncertainty issues in brain image segmentation into various tissues is introduced, which integrates the well-known categorical cross-entropy (CCE) loss function and fuzzy entropy based on fuzzy logic.

2604.16487.tldr: This work introduces neighborhood-level re-ranking via Hungarian matching, which rewards structural consistency; and query-conditioned local steering, where directions derived from contrastive neighborhoods around the query reshape retrieval, which improves retrieval performance on attribute-binding and compositional retrieval tasks.

2604.16483.tldr: Dynamic Semantic Steering (DSS) is presented, a lightweight, training-free framework for interpretable and controllable concept erasure in Text-To-Image diffusion models and introduces Sensitive Semantic Boundary Modeling (SSBM) and Sensitive Semantic Guidance (SSG), which ensures optimal suppression of sensitive content while preserving benign semantics.

2604.16790.tldr: It is argued that LLM-as-a-Judge studies should report bias sensitivity alongside accuracy and incorporate explicit controls to support more trustworthy model comparison in software engineering.

2604.16780.tldr: FairNVT is presented, a lightweight debiasing framework for pretrained transformer-based encoders that improves both representation and prediction level fairness while preserving task accuracy and sensitive-attribute attacker accuracy.

2604.16778.tldr: Experiments show that FoT improves reasoning effectiveness and efficiency across a wide range of challenging applications, including mathematical problem solving, cross-domain collaboration, and machine learning research insight discovery.

2604.16776.tldr: SAVE, a unified generative framework based on conditional Transformers for multi-condition single-cell modeling, offers a scalable and generalizable solution for modeling complex single-cell data, with broad utility in virtual cell synthesis and biological interpretation.

2604.16772.tldr: The Reliance Negotiation Framework is introduced, developed from a sequential explanatory mixed-methods study of 382 undergraduates at a public minority-serving institution in the United States, and generates four falsifiable predictions with implications for AI literacy pedagogy, academic integrity policy, and equity-centered practice at minority-serving institutions.

2604.16756.tldr: An end-to-end method is introduced that elicits best practices and injects axiomatic reasoning cues into the prompt before answering, reducing overall bias sensitivity by 51% on average (p<.001).

2604.16745.tldr: A diagnostic framework with two tools, ranking consistency $\rho_s$ and off-diagonal correlation $\rho_\text{off}$, is developed that decomposes the collapse into a signal-agnostic error amplifier inherent to layer-wise reduction, predicting convex Pareto curves and $r_{\text{crit}} \propto 1/L$; and CATIS is constructed as a constructive validation.

2604.16742.tldr: CT Open can serve as a central hub for advancing AI research on forecasting real-world outcomes before they occur, while also informing biomedical research and improving clinical trial design.

2604.16734.tldr: This work shows that MLLMs exhibit inherent structural regularities and representational redundancy that can be exploited to control memory growth throughout inference, and proposes a sequential input-compression mechanism that enforces a fixed memory budget by performing structure-aware key-value cache compression during the prefill process.

2604.16729.tldr: This work presents a training-free agentic pipeline for automated brain MRI analysis and demonstrates that agentic AI can solve highly neuro-radiological image analysis tasks through tool use without the need for training or fine-tuning.

2604.16715.tldr: This work introduces a distributed training framework for graph transformers, which automatically selects and optimizes parallelization strategies based on the graph structure and hardware configuration and achieves up to 6x speedup with system scaling up to 8 GPUs on large graph benchmarks.

2604.16687.tldr: A key contribution of this work is the explicit integration of formal risk management, employing the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) as a quantitative metric to filter designs that exhibit a high probability of failing to meet performance requirements, specifically the target coefficient of lift.

2604.16625.tldr: AdaExplore is proposed, an agent framework that enables self-improvement via accumulated execution feedback for performance-critical kernel code generation through two complementary stages: failure-driven adaptation and diversity-preserving search, jointly improving correctness and optimization performance without additional fine-tuning or external knowledge.

2604.16592.tldr: This comprehensive report finds that motivation (especially intrinsic motivation) and meta-cognition remain drastically under-researched, and proposes concrete directions informed by active inference and global workspace theory to address them.

2604.16785.tldr: In HyMOR, the MLLM performs open-ended and coarse-grained object recognition, while the CLIP model specializes in fine-grained identification of domain-specific objects such as animals and plants, serving as a robust perceptual foundation for downstream multi-modal content generation and interactive gameplay.

2604.16748.tldr: TriTS is a novel cross-modal disentanglement framework that projects 1D time series into orthogonal time, frequency, and 2D-vision spaces, and achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, fundamentally outperforming existing vision-based forecasters by drastically reducing both parameter count and inference latency.

2604.16696.tldr: This work proposes a novel Multi-Scale Attention (MSA) mechanism integrated into the 3DETR architecture to better capture both local geometry and global context, and introduces an upsampling operation that generates high-resolution feature maps, enabling the network to better detect smaller and semantically related objects.

2604.16686.tldr: No-Worse Context-Aware Decoding (NWCAD) is proposed, a decode-time adapter built on a two-stream setup with a two-stage gate that prevents neutral regression on baseline-correct items while preserving strong context-driven accuracy on helpful contexts.

2604.16683.tldr: Experiments on real-world and simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, including transfer to flow-matching action-chunked policies, demonstrate that policy-internal consistency coupled with semantically grounded respawning offers a practical route to improved reliability in imitation learning.

2604.16607.tldr: It is found that no single system excels in all areas and nearly all are effective for certain tasks, and the representation of model performance is critically linked to dataset and metric choices.

2604.16591.tldr: This work introduces the notion of data Pareto improvement for LLM unlearning, which formalizes how retrieval can expand the achievable trade-off frontier between forgetting and retention and proposes Randomized Antipodal Search on Linearized Influence Kernel (RASLIK), a retrieval algorithm that combines permutation-projection hashing with randomized antipodal search.

2604.16689.tldr: Super-pixel resolution and tokenization for neural language models as a source-coding choice that sets the entropy of the explanation and how Gaussian noise and nonlinear curvature degrade the query channel, induce waterfall and error-floor behavior, and render high-resolution explanations unattainable.

2604.16657.tldr: CALIBER (Context-Aware Low-rank Inference with Bayesian Embedding Regularization), a multimodal uncertainty-aware PEFT framework for audio-text learning, demonstrates that localized cross-modal conditioning is an effective and lightweight mechanism for uncertainty-aware multimodal adaptation.

2604.16646.tldr: This study provides the first large-scale empirical comparison of agentic frameworks for reasoning-intensive software engineering tasks and shows that framework selection should prioritize orchestration quality, especially memory control, failure handling, and cost management.

2604.16615.tldr: Co-LoRA consistently matches or outperforms text-only PEFT and conventional feature-fusion transfer baselines, particularly on high-coverage labels where reliable adaptation is critical, and provides a robust and parameter-efficient alternative for multimodal low-resource prediction.

2604.16762.tldr: CapSeal is presented, a capability-sealed secret mediation architecture that replaces direct secret access with constrained invocations through a local trusted broker and reframes secret handling for agentic systems from handing the model a key to granting the model a narrowly scoped, non-exportable action capability.

2604.16755.tldr: Cross random-effects models are applied to 74.9 million ratings provided by 10 open-weight LLMs to identify individual differences among LLMs that cannot be attributed to response biases or stochastic noise.

2604.16812.tldr: A scalable approach to rapidly identify learned behaviors of many LLMs derived from a shared base LLM, and suggests that IAs are a scalable, effective, and practically useful approach to auditing fine-tuned LLMs.

2604.16804.tldr: A scalable synthetic data generation and reinforcement learning pipeline that trains LLMs to autoformalize optimization problems specified in natural language across linear, mixed-integer, and non-linear categories and introduces a curriculum RL strategy that bootstraps from limited initial training data to make this class tractable for post-training.

2604.16775.tldr: Finer-than-decile quantization, reference-range anchoring, and soft discretization help in selective outcomes, while code-normalized xVal remains well below the discrete and soft families, consistent with near-median suppression that persists after the affine variant.

2604.16753.tldr: This paper introduces MESA-S (Metacognitive Skills for Agents, Single-agent), a preliminary framework that shifts scalar confidence estimation into a vector separating self-confidence from source-confidence, and decouples the awareness of a skill's utility from its token-intensive execution.

2604.16752.tldr: The structural findings indicate that frontier models possess strong latent triage capabilities that require explicit categorical decision paths to activate safely and are likely to be upper-bound capability estimates.

2604.16736.tldr: Deferred rendering reduces LLM generation tokens by 48-72% across all conditions and eliminates output stalling entirely, and is instantiated as GEN-PILOT, an open-source MCP server, demonstrating that the theory translates directly into a practical tool.

2604.16704.tldr: It is concluded that AI should be used as a supportive tool, while human expertise remains essential for ensuring translation quality and cultural appropriateness.

2604.16694.tldr: RankGuide is proposed, a framework that improves the efficiency and effectiveness of SRM--LRM collaboration through tensor-rank-guided routing and steering through tensor-rank-guided routing and steering and introduces a tensor-rank vector extraction method to modulate the reasoning trajectory of SRMs, thereby improving their generation quality.

2604.16682.tldr: KAIROS uses agent context as a first-class control signal to jointly manage GPU frequency, per-instance concurrency, and multi-instance request placement, which enables KAIROS to save power when memory headroom exists while avoiding thrashing and preserving performance targets.

2604.16677.tldr: This work introduces ReconVLA, a reliable conformal model that produces uncertainty-guided and failure-aware control signals, and applies conformal prediction directly to the action token outputs of pretrained VLA policies, yielding calibrated uncertainty estimates that correlate with execution quality and task success.

2604.16655.tldr: A multi-modal brain age framework to characterize the integrated evolution of brain morphology and white matter organization and enables a unified and lifespan-spanning assessment of brain maturity across diverse developmental periods.

2604.16590.tldr: A unified one-stage generative DA framework that reformulates assimilation as Bayesian posterior sampling is introduced, replacing the conventional forecast-update cycle with compute-dense, GPU-efficient inference, establishing a new paradigm for Earth system prediction.

2604.16744.tldr: Adaptive reading significantly improved outcomes in computer science, yielded smaller positive but inconclusive gains in inorganic chemistry, and was neutral to slightly negative in general biology.

2604.16723.tldr: This work proposes the first multi-agent reward function designed to serve as a judge, decoupling methodological validation from implementation details while providing strict binary rewards that are robust to reward hacking.

2604.16721.tldr: This work introduces the Late Fusion Neural Operator, an architecture that disentangles learning state dynamics from parameter effects, improving predictive performance both within and beyond the training distribution, and demonstrates strong generalization across both in-domain and out-domain parameter regimes.

2604.16706.tldr: This work introduces AgentProp-Bench, a 2,000-task benchmark with 2,300 traces across four domains, nine production LLMs, and a 100-label human-validated subset, and quantifies judge reliability, characterize error propagation, and evaluate a runtime mitigation.

2604.16672.tldr: This work reformulates each candidate axiom into its corresponding counter-concept and verbalise it in controlled natural language before presenting it to Large Language Models (LLMs), a third component that provides real-world examples approximating an instance of the counter-concept.

2604.16622.tldr: This work proposes a two-stage framework for fine-tuning large language models on dialogue transcripts to derive rich contextual representations and learns a joint embedding space for dialogue contexts and backchannel realizations, and demonstrates that the learned projections substantially improve context-backchannel retrieval compared to previous methods.

2604.16774.tldr: StageMem is presented, a lifecycle-managed memory framework that treats memory as a stateful process rather than a passive repository and organizes memory into three stages -- transient, working, and durable memory -- and models each item with explicit confidence and strength.

2604.16758.tldr: The results demonstrate that frozen foundation models with minimal task-specific adaptation offer a practical paradigm for dense prediction in small-data regimes.

2604.17010.tldr: A self-play framework for semantic equivalence in Haskell is introduced, utilizing formal verification to guide adversarial training between a generator and an evaluator, and a synthetic dataset of validated Haskell programs is released.

2604.16940.tldr: This work proposes DQRELO (Delta Compression via Quantization and Residual Low-Rank), a novel training- and data-free delta compression method that combines coarse-grained one-bit quantization to capture the dominant structure of the delta, followed by compensated residual low-rank approximation to recover fine-grained details from the smaller residual error.

2604.16926.tldr: NeuroAdapt-Bench is introduced, a systematic benchmark for evaluating test-time adaptation methods on EEG foundation models under realistic distribution shifts and shows that standard TTA methods yield inconsistent gains and often degrade performance, with gradient-based approaches particularly prone to heavy degradation.

2604.16909.tldr: Evaluating 24 mainstream open-source and proprietary LLMs, it is found that consistent trade-offs across instruction following, memory retrieval, and logical reasoning are uncovered, showing that mitigation strategies often improve specific dimensions at the expense of others.

2604.16896.tldr: P ProtoCycle couples an LLM planner with a lightweight tool environment designed to emulate the iterative workflow of human protein engineering and uses LLM-driven reflection on tool feedback to revise plans, achieving strong language alignment while maintaining competitive foldability.

2604.16881.tldr: EA-RLVR (Entity-Anchored Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards), a training framework that optimizes cross-cultural entity translation without relying on external knowledge bases, is proposed and evaluated on XC-Translate to observe consistent improvements in both entity translation accuracy and out-of-domain generalization.

2604.16817.tldr: RDDG is a unified in-context learning framework that employs progressive chain-of-thought steps to generate tabular data for enhancing downstream imbalanced classification performance and incorporates a self-reinforcing feedback mechanism that provides automatic assessments of the quality of the generated data, enabling continuous quality optimization throughout the generation process.

2604.16989.tldr: The results provide evidence that LLMs can contribute meaningfully to mathematical research, complementing recent reports by Bubeck et al., Woodruff et al., and others.

2604.16972.tldr: Mastery-Consolidated Policy Optimization (MCPO) is proposed, which introduces a hinge-KL regularizer applied exclusively to mastered prompts to bound harmful policy drift between successive gradient steps, and a weighting mechanism that prioritizes majority-correct prompts to better allocate optimization effort.

2604.16967.tldr: NaviFormer, a deep reinforcement learning model based on a Transformer architecture that solves the global navigation problem by predicting both high-level routes and low-level trajectories, and its superior computation speed proves its suitability for real-time missions.

2604.16950.tldr: Online A/B tests show that AutoPKG-derived attributes increase Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) in Badge by 3.81 percent, in Search by 5.32 percent, and in Recommendation by 7.89 percent, supporting the practical value of AutoPKG in production.

2604.16941.tldr: MEMRES is an agentic system for Python dependency resolution that introduces a multi-level confidence cascade where the LLM serves as the last resort, and already exceeds PLLM's 54.7% overall success rate by a wide margin.

2604.16936.tldr: The designed ARF-SFR-Net has the capability to adaptively determine receptive field sizes for obtaining spatial and frequency features, and effectively fuse them for reconstruction and FSFGIC tasks.

2604.16919.tldr: Noise-space Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (N-HMC), a posterior sampling method that treats reverse diffusion as a deterministic mapping from initial noise to clean images, is proposed and extended to a noise-adaptive variant (NA-NHMC) that effectively handles IPs with unknown noise type and level.

2604.16913.tldr: Sentinel-Bench is introduced, an 840-inference empirical framework executing a strict intra-model ablation on Qwen-3.5-9B, and concludes that for edge-native SLMs operating under Byzantine Fault Tolerance constraints, System 1 parameterized intuition is structurally and economically superior to System 2 iterative deliberation for decentralized consensus.

2604.16883.tldr: This paper shows that the attention sink phenomenon corresponds to a stable, reachable, and error-controllable fixed point constructed during training, and proposes SinkRouter, a training-free selective routing framework that detects the sink signal and skips computations that would otherwise produce near-zero output.

2604.16851.tldr: ViDa, a biophysics-informed framework leveraging variational autoencoders and geometric scattering transforms to generate biophysically-plausible embeddings of DNA reaction kinetics simulations, and Struc2mapGAN, a generative adversarial network that synthesizes high-fidelity experimental-like cryo-EM density maps from protein structures are presented.

2604.16850.tldr: Incremental Iterative Reference Learning Control (I2RLC), which gradually increases the speed while updating the reference, yielding high-fidelity trajectories, indicates that gradual speed scheduling coupled with reference adaptation provides a practical path to fast, contact-rich IL.

2604.16848.tldr: This work introduces TowerDataset, a heterogeneous benchmark for transmission-corridor segmentation, and presents a global-local fusion framework which preserves and fuses whole-scene and local-detail information and allows the model to exploit both global relationships and local shape details when recognizing rare and confusing components.

2604.16835.tldr: This paper explores the application of CTLNet for Shanghai Composite Index prediction and the comparative experiments show that the proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

2604.16988.tldr: It is shown that encoding and incorporating changepoint knowledge indeed improves the real-world performance of a pretrained foundation models on infectious disease forecasting and on financial volatility forecasting around Federal Open Market Committee announcements without retraining, demonstrating practical applicability to real-world regime changes.

2604.16966.tldr: CognitiveGuard, a dual-process defense framework inspired by human cognition, is proposed, which consists of a System 1 Perceptual Sanitizer to cleanse sensory inputs and a System 2 Reasoning Verifier to detect anomalies in memory-driven planning.

2604.16935.tldr: Talk2AI is introduced, a longitudinal framework quantifying psycho-social, reasoning and affective dimensions of LLMs'persuasiveness about polarizing societal topics that provides a grounded framework and evidence for detecting how GenAI can influence human opinions via multiple psycho-social pathways in AI-human digital platforms.

2604.16931.tldr: This work designs a programmatic way to automatically generate coding tasks of arbitrary difficulty and structure from existing benchmarks and proposes structured thought-trees as means to represent reasoning traces, revealing that the structure of a reasoning trace is a strong predictor of correctness.

2604.16930.tldr: Concept-Guided Routing framework (CoGR-MoE), which incorporates semantics of the answer options to guide expert selection in the training phase and delivers strong performance across multiple VQA tasks, demonstrating the effectiveness of this approach.

2604.16922.tldr: ClimAgent is introduced, a general-purpose autonomous framework designed to execute a wide spectrum of research tasks across diverse climate sub-fields and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 40.21% improvement over original LLM solutions in solution rigorousness and practicality.

2604.16895.tldr: The novel Physics-Informed Landmark Loss (PILL) compares this predicted trajectory back against the landmarks, enforcing physical consistency without labels, and consistently achieves sub-pixel tracking accuracy for the bilinear and physics-refined decoder outputs under both clean and noisy conditions.
