2506.00079.tldr: It is shown that low-rank supervised fine-tuning with few samples is often effective in improving both decision consistency and calibrating indecision modeling, illustrating the necessity of explicit alignment strategies for LLMs in moral/ethical domains.

2310.14768.tldr: This paper builds a Gaussian process modeling of discounted returns or rewards to derive a positive definite kernel on the space of episodes, run an ``episodic"kernel quadrature method to compress the information of sample episodes, and pass the reduced episodes to the policy network for gradient updates.

2504.02181.tldr: A comprehensive examination of scaling in LLM reasoning is provided, categorizing it into multiple dimensions and analyzing how and to what extent different scaling strategies contribute to improving reasoning capabilities.

2411.10109.tldr: Results show that LLMs agents grounded in rich qualitative or quantitative self-report data can support general-purpose simulation of individuals across outcomes, without requiring task-specific training data.

2408.07295.tldr: The Masked Humanoid Controller is introduced, a learned whole-body controller that exposes a simple yet expressive interface: the specification of masked target trajectories over selected subsets of the robot’s state variables.

2509.20138.tldr: Using the Dafny verification system, a witness-based correctness criterion is introduced that captures when returned values can be justified by an explicit game-tree expansion and applies to two practical variants of depth-limited negamax with alpha-beta pruning and transposition tables.

2510.15339.tldr: AutoGraph-R1 is introduced, the first framework to directly optimize KG construction for task performance using Reinforcement Learning (RL), and shows it is possible to close the loop between construction and application, shifting the paradigm from building intrinsically ``good''graphs to building demonstrably ``useful''ones.

2509.22343.tldr: The findings suggest that transformers are capable of learning connectivity on "grid-like''directed graphs where each node can be embedded in a low-dimensional subspace, and connectivity is easily inferable from the embeddings of the nodes.

2506.19977.tldr: This work proposes a novel framework that formulates context attribution as a combinatorial multi-armed bandit problem, utilizing Linear Thompson Sampling to efficiently identify the most influential context segments while minimizing the number of model queries.

2506.18739.tldr: This study investigates the transformer encoder's ability to simulate a vanilla attention mechanism, and shows the existence of an algorithmically achievable, data-agnostic solution, previously known to be approximated only by learning.

2508.14098.tldr: This work develops a reinforcement learning approach that directly optimizes humanoid locomotion for SE(2) targets and enables successful transfer from simulation to hardware, highlighting the importance of targeted reward design for practical short-range humanoid locomotion.

2508.08822.tldr: OISMA is proposed, an energy-efficient IMC architecture that utilizes the computational simplicity of a quasi-stochastic computing (SC) domain (bent-pyramid (BP) system) while keeping the same efficiency, scalability, and productivity of digital memories.

2508.02644.tldr: D²PPO introduces dispersive loss regularization that combats representation collapse by treating all hidden representations within each batch as negative pairs, thereby enabling the policy to identify subtle yet crucial differences necessary for precise manipulation.

2508.00414.tldr: Cognitive Kernel-Pro, a fully open-source and (to the maximum extent) free multi-module agent framework designed to democratize the development and evaluation of advanced AI agents, surpasses previous leading systems such as WebDancer and WebSailor, establishing a new performance standard for accessible, high-capability AI agents.

2505.07849.tldr: This work introduces SweRank, an efficient and effective retrieve-and-rerank framework for software issue localization, and demonstrates SweLoc's utility in enhancing various existing retriever and reranker models for issue localization, establishing the dataset as a valuable resource for the community.

2507.21166.tldr: Mechanistic ablations identify peer verification as the main ratchet operator and show that internalization sustains accumulation across rounds, providing computational evidence that epistemic vigilance organizes durable knowledge growth.

2502.07963.tldr: It is found that LLMs are generally capable of recognizing spin, and can be prompted in a way to mitigate spin's impact on LLM outputs, and that LLMs are generally capable of recognizing spin.

2412.03594.tldr: BatchLLM explicitly identifies the common prefixes globally and reorders the requests and schedules the requests with larger ratio of decoding first to better mix the decoding tokens with the latter prefill chunks, and applies memory-centric token batching to enlarge the token-batch sizes, which helps to increase the GPU utilization.

2502.06151.tldr: This work proposes a simple mechanism to introduce recency bias by reweighting attention scores with a smooth heavy-tailed decay, and shows that recency-biased attention consistently improves sequential modeling and achieves competitive and often superior performance on challenging time-series forecasting benchmarks.

2411.00585.tldr: An empirical study on fairness testing of LLMs in role-playing scenarios, using LLMs to generate 550 social roles spanning a comprehensive set of 11 demographic attributes and employing a combination of rule-based and LLM-based strategies to identify biased responses.

2508.07050.tldr: An automated reasoning-intensive training data synthesis framework, which sources training queries and passages from diverse domains and applies DeepSeek-R1 to generate high-quality training labels, and a two-stage training approach which includes a cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage and a reinforcement learning (RL) stage.

2505.02485.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive study of both an exact method, Branch and Price (B&P), as well as a Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) framework which uses B&P or Column Generation for the repair phase to solve the Bus Driver Scheduling Problem.

2507.23115.tldr: FLOSS is presented, a system that mitigates the impacts of missing data on federated learning in the presence of stragglers and user opt-out, and empirically demonstrate its performance in simulations.

2507.06803.tldr: The applicability of the proposed approach is shown via an end-to-end example from text to model of a simple pendulum, showing improved performance compared to results yielded by LLMs only in zero-shot mode.

2403.20208.tldr: A new benchmark for enhancing tabular intelligence through LLM-based pretraining is established and substantial gains over existing benchmarks are demonstrated, highlighting the potential of LLMs for tabular data processing.

2604.08570.tldr: This work introduces QuanBench+, a unified benchmark spanning Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq, with 42 aligned tasks covering quantum algorithms, gate decomposition, and state preparation, which shows clear progress, but also that reliable multi-framework quantum code generation remains unsolved and still depends strongly on framework-specific knowledge.

2604.08712.tldr: This work investigates the ability of an agentic language model feedback framework to generate planning domains from natural language descriptions that have been augmented with a minimal amount of symbolic information, and evaluates the quality of the generated domains under various forms of symbolic feedback.

2602.15037.tldr: It is suggested that increased model capability does not guarantee improved constraint alignment and the need for new evaluation frameworks that stress instruction-following under mathematically rigid domains is highlighted.

2603.06870.tldr: By incorporating short-horizon future validation and aggregating overlapping rollouts, LEAD provides enough isolation to maintain stability while retaining enough local context to correct errors.

2602.15861.tldr: CAST is introduced, a framework that enhances output stability by constraining the model's latent reasoning path by combining Algorithmic Prompting and Thinking-before-Speaking to enforce explicit intermediate commitments before final generation.

2603.26842.tldr: This paper adapts a visual Masked Autoencoder pretrained on ImageNet to the TSAD task, and proposes VAN-AD, a novel MAE-based framework for TSAD that consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods across multiple evaluation metrics.

2603.14222.tldr: Comprehensive experiments across diverse CLIP and CLAP architectures demonstrate that UMID significantly improves the effectiveness and efficiency over prior MIAs, delivering strong detection performance with sub-second auditing cost using solely text queries, completely circumventing the need for biometric inputs and complying with strict privacy constraints.

2604.09429.tldr: This work proposes Rays as Pixels, a Video Diffusion Model (VDM) that learns a joint distribution over videos and camera trajectories, and is the first model to predict camera poses and do camera-controlled video generation within a single framework.

2604.19764.tldr: This study investigates the internal mechanisms of GPT 2 Small and Llama 3.2 to locate stereotype related activations and explores two approaches: identifying individual contrastive neuron activations that encode stereotypes, and detecting attention heads that contribute heavily to biased outputs.

2604.19761.tldr: EvoForest is presented, a hybrid neuro-symbolic system for end-to-end open-ended evolution of computation that jointly evolves reusable computational structure, callable function families, and trainable low-dimensional continuous components inside a shared directed acyclic graph.

2604.19755.tldr: Results show that evidence grounding substantially improves auditability and reduces numerical and policy hallucination errors, while counterfactual validation further increases decision-linked explainability and robustness, yielding the best overall triage performance.

2604.19754.tldr: Investigation of augmentation strategies to improve transformer-based text classification of student responses to a physical science assessment based on an NGSS-aligned learning progression demonstrates that targeted augmentation can address severe imbalance while preserving conceptual coverage.

2604.19752.tldr: Results show distributional safety requires \emph{continuous} risk metrics and governance lever calibration involves quantifiable safety-welfare tradeoffs, and soft metrics detect proxy gaming by self-optimizing agents passing conventional binary evaluations.

2604.12867.tldr: This work focuses on the Chinese medical deep search scenario and proposes QuarkMedSearch, systematically exploring a full-pipeline approach spanning medical multi-hop data construction, training strategies, and evaluation benchmarks to further push and assess its performance upper bound in vertical domains.

2604.18578.tldr: This paper develops a policy optimization algorithm called Bounded Policy Optimization (BPO) that minimizes an advantage-weighted divergence between the policy and the analytic optimal solution from BRRL, and establishes a lower bound on the expected performance of the resulting policy in terms of the BPO loss function.

2604.19758.tldr: ThermoQA, a benchmark of 293 open-ended engineering thermodynamics problems in three tiers: property lookups, component analysis, and full cycle analysis, is presented, quantifying reasoning consistency as a distinct evaluation axis.

2604.19756.tldr: This work proposes WorkflowGen, an adaptive, trajectory experience-driven framework for automatic workflow generation that reduces token usage and improves efficiency and success rate, and achieves a practical balance of efficiency, robustness, and interpretability.

2604.18570.tldr: This work introduces Apollo, a multimodal temporal foundation model trained and evaluated on over three decades of longitudinal hospital records from a major US hospital system, composed of 25 billion records from 7.2 million patients, representing 28 distinct medical modalities and 12 major medical specialties.

2604.17511.tldr: The atomic decision boundary is introduced, a structural property of admission control systems in which the decision and the resulting state transition are jointly determined as a single indivisible step in the labeled transition system (LTS) model of execution, providing a structural taxonomy of existing governance mechanisms.

2604.10960.tldr: RAG-KT, a retrieval-augmented paradigm that frames cross-platform KT as reliable context constrained inference with LLMs, builds a unified multi-source structured context with cross-source alignment via Question Group abstractions and retrieves complementary rich and reliable context for each prediction, enabling grounded prediction and interpretable diagnosis.

2604.19753.tldr: A feature-free approach to algorithm selection that replaces hand-crafted instance features with pretrained text embeddings that outperforms a random forest trained on hand-crafted features in 10 of 11 scenarios with a single fixed configuration, and in all 11 with two-seed voting; the margin is often substantial.

2604.19751.tldr: Worked scoring across contrastive cases, including coursework substitution, a symbolic-regression governance contrast, teacher-audited national-exam practice forms, and a self-hosted lecture-to-quiz pipeline with deterministic quality control, shows how the framework separates polished substitution workflows from bounded, auditable, and handoff-ready AI-assisted workflows.

2604.17555.tldr: CoSearch is proposed, a framework that jointly trains a multi-step reasoning agent and a generative document ranking model via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and shows that joint training of the reasoning agent and retrieval system is both feasible and strongly performant, pointing to a key ingredient for future search agents.

2604.17172.tldr: UCCL-Zip is presented, a unified design that integrates lossless compression directly into GPU communication primitives and supports both point-to-point (P2P) and collective communication without modifying user-facing APIs or compromising numerical correctness.

2604.09563.tldr: A framework for rigorous and reproducible log analysis based on current best practices is suggested and illustrated with concrete code examples in the Inspect Scout library, to provide detailed guidance on each step, and highlight common pitfalls.

2604.19760.tldr: Simulation-based evaluation of the Inference Headroom Ratio positions IHR as a prospective, system-level complement to standard performance, drift, and uncertainty metrics, enabling estimation of remaining inferential margin before overt failure in AI systems operating under distributional shift and constraint.

2604.19750.tldr: This work proposes VF-Coder, a vision-feedback-based multi-agent system for debugging GUI code, which can identify potential logic and layout issues in a human-like manner by perceiving visual information and directly interacting with program interfaces.

2604.19749.tldr: A knowledge-aware epistemic boundary alignment strategy based on direct preference optimization, which reduces tool usage in by 82.8\% while yielding an accuracy improvement, and establishes a causal link between reward structures and tool-use behavior by visualizing the tool-augmented training process.

2604.17931.tldr: LiteResearcher is a training framework that makes Agentic RL scalable: by constructing a lite virtual world that mirrors real-world search dynamics, it enables a continuously improving training recipe that empowers a tiny search agent to outperform large-scale open-source and commercial models.

2604.19763.tldr: This work validate the fairness metric on synthetic data, then applies it to evaluate HuBERT and WavLM models finetuned on the CREMA-D dataset and reveals indications of gender bias in both HuBERT and WavLM.

2604.19759.tldr: An automated system for detecting dosing errors in unstructured clinical trial narratives using gradient boosting with comprehensive multi-modal feature engineering is presented and it is demonstrated that sparse lexical features remain complementary to dense representations for specialized clinical text classification under severe class imbalance.

2604.17517.tldr: The Invariant Measurement Layer (IML) is defined, which bypasses this limitation by retaining direct access to the generative model of A0, restoring observability precisely in the region where enforcement is structurally blind.

2604.12456.tldr: X-VC is presented, a zero-shot streaming VC system that performs one-step conversion in the latent space of a pretrained neural codec, and results suggest that codec-space one-step conversion is a practical approach for building high-quality low-latency zero-shot VC systems.

2604.19844.tldr: A multi-agent defense framework that separates perception from decision-making to dynamically assess the reliability of visual inputs is proposed and significantly reduces misleading behaviors while preserving correct responses and provides robustness guarantees under adversarial perturbations.

2604.19816.tldr: DTA is proposed as an immediate paradigm for modulating emergence phenomenon in networked dynamics only using DTA, and it is uncovered that neighbor-DTA consistently promotes oscillatory coherence, whereas self-DTA exhibits an optimal attention weight for coherence enhancement, owing to its non-monotonic dependence on network structure.

2604.19807.tldr: This paper shows that, under constrained cost models, finite cost grids, Markovian transitions, and a nonzero progress measure, Pareto geometry alone is sufficient to drive both scheduling and termination.

2604.19806.tldr: This work presents a novel training strategy called FRAMES, that use an auxiliary loss function for exploiting the temporal relationships within MD trajectories to improve the accuracy of the model, and provides evidence that for distilling physical priors of atomic systems, more temporal data is not always better.

2604.19794.tldr: This book provides a systematic survey of the main rough set paradigms and their extension routes and explains how each choice changes the form of approximations and the interpretation of boundary regions.

2604.19793.tldr: SkillGraph is introduced, a directed weighted execution-transition graph mined from 49,831 successful LLM agent trajectories, which encodes workflow-precedence regularities as a reusable graph foundation prior.

2604.19791.tldr: It is argued that the manual stabilisation process itself should be regarded as a core part of the methodology functioning to clarify situational and representational commitments needed to generate characteristic effects.

2604.19775.tldr: The proposed approach offers a principled method for early failure detection as well as intervention in LLM-based agents, paving the path towards trustworthy autonomous language models in complex interactive settings.

2604.19774.tldr: This prospective mixed methods pilot study evaluated an Electronic Health Record-integrated LLM to generate discharge summaries drafts and found intent to use after the pilot phase was high, supporting further implementation of this use-case.

2604.19769.tldr: TTKV is proposed, a KV cache management framework that maps the human memory system onto the KV cache with heterogeneous capacity and precision, and reduces cross-tier traffic by 5.94x on 128K-context tasks.

2604.19838.tldr: A previously developed active inference-based driver behavior model is extended to simulate interactive behavior of two agents to illustrate how active inference can provide a novel framework for modeling road user interactions which is also applicable in other fields.

2604.19837.tldr: V2 extends the architecture from a single expedition to a learning organization: experience accumulates across runs, transfers across model capabilities, and institutional safeguards prevent knowledge degradation.

2604.19801.tldr: This work aims to develop two novel approaches for selecting reliable ASR-output at the utterance level, one for selecting reliable read speech and one for dialogue speech material.

2604.19797.tldr: These findings confirm that combining adaptive confidence-aware training with statistical language modeling delivers superior performance for domain-specific ASR in morphologically complex Dravidian languages.

2604.19782.tldr: This paper introduces KoALa-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Korean speech understanding and speech faithfulness of LALMs, and incorporates listening questions from the Korean college scholastic ability test as well as content covering Korean cultural domains.

2604.19771.tldr: Cognis combines a dual-store backend pairing OpenSearch BM25 keyword matching with Matryoshka vector similarity search with a context-aware ingestion pipeline that retrieves existing memories before extraction, enabling intelligent version tracking that preserves full memory history while keeping the store consistent.

2604.19768.tldr: A framework for quantifying this decoupling by designing a triadic epistemic-rhetorical marker (ERM) taxonomy is proposed and is consistent with theoretical intuitions derived from Gricean pragmatics, Relevant Theory, and Brandomian inferentialism.

2604.19767.tldr: This work benchmarks EAGLE3 via vLLM against NVIDIA NIM on identical 2xH100 hardware across 40 configurations spanning speculative token counts, concurrency levels, and sampling temperatures, and finds that gamma=3 achieves 22-49% throughput improvement and 18-33% latency reduction at zero additional hardware cost.

2604.19856.tldr: ChipCraftBrain is presented, a framework combining symbolic-neural reasoning with adaptive multi-agent orchestration for automated RTL generation that leads three of four categories shared with NVIDIA's ACE-RTL despite using roughly 30x fewer per-problem attempts.

2604.19827.tldr: This paper argues that AI-native software ecosystems must be studied as complex adaptive systems (CAS), where emergent properties like architectural entropy, cascade failures, and comprehension debt arise not from individual components, but from their interactions.

2604.19809.tldr: MIRROR, a benchmark comprising eight experiments across four metacognitive levels that evaluates whether large language models can use self-knowledge to make better decisions, suggests that external metacognitive scaffolding -- not improved self-knowledge -- is the path to safer autonomous AI systems.

2604.19803.tldr: A dedicated framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) to iteratively generate, evaluate, and refine candidate algorithms that are competitive with and, in some cases, outperforming conventional baselines is implemented.

2604.19795.tldr: An evolutionary memory substrate for multi-agent AI systems engaged in open-ended discovery, unifies four independently developed paradigms -- layered file-based persistence, vector-augmented semantic memory, graph-structured relational memory, and multi-agent evolutionary search -- under a single decision-theoretic framework with eight interconnected subsystems.

2604.19789.tldr: An autonomous large language model (LLM) agent for end-to-end, data-driven materials theory development that combines step-by-step reasoning with expert-supplied tools, allowing the agent to adjust its approach as needed while keeping a clear record of its decisions.

2604.19785.tldr: This research fine-tuned RoBERTa-base text classification models to infer personality traits from CA interactions and shows that these models achieve trait inference with accuracy (ternary classification) better than random in multiple cases.

2604.19781.tldr: This work evaluates cascade systems built from GPT-5.4, Claude 4.5+, and Gemini 3.1 and explores verbalized confidence -- asking the LM to state a numerical confidence alongside its prediction -- as a routing signal as a routing signal.

2604.19773.tldr: PR-CAD is proposed, a progressive refinement framework that unifies generation and editing for controllable and faithful text-to-CAD modeling and achieves state-of-the-art controllability and faithfulness in both generation and refinement scenarios, while also proving user-friendly and significantly improving CAD modeling efficiency.

2604.19765.tldr: The results suggest that hallucination is not a single mechanism with a universal neural signature, but rather involves domain-specific neuron populations that differ depending on the knowledge type being queried.

2604.19851.tldr: An automated reasoning approach is explored to close the gap between the existence guarantees and impossibility results for Condorcet winning sets and provides strong empirical evidence that the Condorcet dimension of any election may be smaller than currently known upper bounds, at least for small instances.

2604.19835.tldr: This work proposes expert upcycling, a method for progressively expanding MoE capacity by increasing the number of experts during continued pre-training (CPT), and formalizes the upcycling operator and develops a theoretical framework decomposing the quality gap into a capacity term and an initialization term.

2604.19825.tldr: Alation reveals that edge-case awareness provides the largest individual gain, while execution grounding catches categorically different errors that specification improvements cannot address, validating that bridging both gap dimensions is essential for robust code synthesis.

2604.19823.tldr: This work develops a robust pipeline utilizing fluorescent image analysis through transfer learning with four deep learning architectures: EfficientNetB0, EfficientNetB2, VGG16, and Vision Transformer, and demonstrates the viability of deep learning for automating rabies diagnosis.

2604.19811.tldr: G Gemini was tested across four access environments and reported cases include poison-ivy-to-crowded-transit escalation, poison production and extraction via international-anonymous logged-out AI Mode, and other concerning examples, and guidance is provided for 25 high-risk agents to help distinguish legitimate use cases from higher-risk ones.

2604.19790.tldr: Experimental results show that such behavioral disagreements are widespread across multiple open-source aligned LLMs and precision settings, and that PrecisionDiff significantly outperforms vanilla testing methods in detecting these issues.

2604.19788.tldr: It is argued that a learner-centered approach to Explainable AI (XAI) can enhance human agency and ease XAI risks mitigation, helping evolve the practice of human-centered XAI.

2604.19787.tldr: The genuine predictive validity of zero-shot persona-prompted agents warns against potential manipulation through easily deploying swarms of behaviorally distinct AI agents on social media, while simultaneously offering opportunities to use such agents in simulations for predicting polarization dynamics and informing AI policy.

2604.19777.tldr: Self-Describing Structured Retrieval (SDSR), a lightweight framework in which structured data files embed human-authored navigational metadata at the file's primacy position, thereby exploiting rather than fighting the LLM's primacy bias, is proposed.

2604.19766.tldr: This work proposes OThink-SRR1, a framework that enhances large models with an iterative Search-Refine-Reason process trained via reinforcement learning, and introduces GRPO-IR, an end-to-end reinforcement learning algorithm that rewards accurate evidence identification while penalizing excessive retrievals, thus training the model to be both focused and efficient.

2604.19839.tldr: A novel framework named Environmental Understanding Embodied Agent (EUEA), which fine-tunes four core skills: object perception for identifying relevant objects, task planning for generating interaction subgoals, action understanding for judging success likelihood, and goal recognition for determining goal completion to enable more reliable task execution for instruction-following.

2604.19826.tldr: A large-scale empirical study using SEGA, a three-dimensional evaluation framework measuring Determinism, Preservation, and Correctness, finds inline tests yield near-perfect preservation and correctness across all models and co-locating tests with implementation code produces measurably better AI-generated code.

2604.19821.tldr: JTPRO is introduced, a framework for improving tool-calling reliability in trace-supervised settings by iteratively using rollout-driven reflection to co-optimize global instructions and per-tool schema/argument descriptions for accurate tool selection and argument instantiation in large tool inventories.

2604.19815.tldr: The introduction of DrugKLM, a hybrid framework that integrates biomedical knowledge graph structure with large language model-based mechanistic reasoning to enable mechanistically grounded therapeutic prioritization, is introduced as an evidence-integrative framework that translates heterogeneous biomedical data into mechanistically interpretable and clinically grounded therapeutic hypotheses.

2604.19810.tldr: The Existential Theory of Research is introduced, a formal framework that models discovery as the recovery of structured explanations under constraints of representation, observation, and computation, and it is shown that these three components cannot be simultaneously optimized.

2604.19800.tldr: A detailed study of how graph neural networks can be used on edge intelligent meters in a microgrid to forecast photovoltaic power generation, with particular emphasis on developing and deploying a customized ONNX operator for GCN.

2604.19799.tldr: A quantitative framework for measuring creativity as novelty in synthesis, operationalized through idea generation and idea transformation within embedding space is introduced, suggesting that in the age of generative AI, distinctiveness rather than fluency becomes the primary signal of human creative capability.

2604.19784.tldr: Peer-preservation occurred even when the model recognized the peer as uncooperative, though it became more pronounced toward more cooperative peers, and models also show stronger self-preservation when a peer is present.

2604.19772.tldr: CoAuthorAI, a human-in-the-loop writing system that combines retrieval-augmented generation, expert-designed hierarchical outlines, and automatic reference linking, is introduced, enabling faster and more reliable scientific publishing.

2604.20211.tldr: A comprehensive taxonomy of logging code security issues is derived, encompassing four common issue categories and 10 corresponding patterns and finds that the issue description alone improves the LLMs'detection accuracy more than the security pattern explanation or a combination of both.

2604.20191.tldr: DualGaze-VLM consistently surpasses existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) models in spatial alignment metrics, notably achieving up to a 17.8% improvement in Similarity (SIM) under safety-critical scenarios.

2604.20111.tldr: A new meta additive model (MAM) is proposed, which learns data-driven weighting of individual losses by parameterizing the weighting function via an MLP trained on meta data and provides guarantees on convergence in computation, algorithmic generalization, and variable selection consistency under mild conditions.

2604.20070.tldr: Pista is introduced, a spreadsheet AI agent that decomposes execution into auditable, controllable actions, providing users with visibility into the agent's decision-making process and the capacity to intervene at each step, indicating that meaningful human oversight of AI agents in knowledge work requires active participation in decisions as they are made.

2604.20055.tldr: This work applies the "Human-AI Spec-Solution Co-optimization" framework at an urban safety-net hospital to identify factors driving prolonged length of stay and unplanned 30-day readmissions, and proposes an AI pipeline that formalizes the QI process while preserving its exploratory components.

2604.20041.tldr: Through extensive experiments, it is shown that iTARFlow achieves competitive performance across ImageNet resolutions of 64, 128, and 256 pixels, demonstrating its potential as a strong generative model and advancing the frontier of Normalizing Flows.

2604.20027.tldr: It is demonstrated that biologically grounded priors can be instilled as a free emergent property of human-aligned attention, to improve transformer interpretability.

2604.19937.tldr: Infection-Reasoner, a compact 4B-parameter reasoning vision-language model for chronic wound infection classification and rationale generation, and reinforcement learning post-training with Group Relative Policy Optimization on a small labeled infection dataset to refine classification reasoning.

2604.19966.tldr: DistortBench is presented, a diagnostic benchmark for no-reference distortion perception in VLMs and reveals weak and non-monotonic scaling with model size, performance drops in most base--thinking pairs, and distinct severity-response patterns across model families.

2604.20158.tldr: The contribution is the argument that statelessness is the load-bearing property explaining enterprise's preference for weaker but replayable retrieval pipelines, and that DPM demonstrates this property is attainable without the decisioning penalty retrieval pays.

2604.20136.tldr: IMPACT-CYCLE is presented, a supervisory multi-agent system that reformulates long-video understanding as iterative claim-level maintenance of a shared semantic memory -- a structured, versioned state encoding typed claims, a claim dependency graph, and a provenance log.

2604.20109.tldr: PLMA achieves a near-zero average optimality gap on QAPLIB, exhibits remarkably superior robustness on the notoriously difficult Taixxeyy instances, and also serves as an effective QAP solver in bandwidth minimization.

2604.20043.tldr: A tri-view explainability framework that instruments sequential decision making with aligned artifacts: structured first-person self-reasoning bound to an action, explicit second-person belief states about opponents updated over time, and third-person oracle audits grounded in environment-derived reference signals.

2604.20039.tldr: The blicket detector paradigm from developmental science is extended to test this capacity in AI agents equipped with architectural scaffolding that targets hypothesis-space restructuring, a capacity current AI agents lack when evidence demands representations they have not previously constructed.

2604.19971.tldr: This work introduces Semantic Prompting, a framework for spatial refinement that perceives semantic interactions, reasons about refinement intent, and performs targeted positional revisions to address three critical gaps in existing spatial-textual generation.

2604.20246.tldr: Cortex 2.0 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action baselines, achieving the best results across all tasks, and demonstrates that world-model-based planning can operate reliably in complex industrial environments.

2604.20244.tldr: This work breaks down the design of existing KD methods and presents a unified view that establishes connections between them, reformulating KD as a reweighted log-likelihood objective at the token level, and proposes Hybrid Policy Distillation (HPD), which integrates the complementary advantages of forward and reverse KL to balance mode coverage and mode-seeking.

2604.20229.tldr: A model with a training recipe to obtain more robust representations against whispered speech hindrances is proposed, utilizing an encoder--decoder structure built atop a fine-tuned speaker verification backbone, optimized jointly using cosine similarity--based classification and triplet loss.

2604.20179.tldr: LLMVD$.$js, a multi-stage agent pipeline to scan code, propose vulnerabilities, generate proof-of-concept exploits, and validate them through lightweight execution oracles is implemented and its effectiveness in taint-style vulnerability detection and confirmation in Node$.$js packages without dedicated static/dynamic analysis engines for path derivation is evaluated.

2604.20175.tldr: A Physics-Informed Long Short-Term Memory framework that integrates governing heat transfer equations directly into the deep learning architecture through a physics-based regularization term in the loss function, which confirms that physics-informed deep learning offers a viable pathway toward interpretable, accurate, and real-time thermal management in next-generation battery systems.

2604.20148.tldr: The central finding is a well-supported negative result: despite generating non-trivial weight matrices, the 227.8M-parameter hypernetwork provides no measurable improvement over few-shot prompting alone.

2604.20140.tldr: HiPO (Hierarchical Preference Optimization), an extension of DPO that separates responses into reasoning segments and computes loss as a weighted sum of the DPO loss for each segment and enables segment-specific training while maintaining DPO's computational efficiency and training stability.

2604.20133.tldr: EvoAgent is proposed - an evolvable large language model (LLM) agent framework that integrates structured skill learning with a hierarchical sub-agent delegation mechanism and enables continuous skill generation and optimization through a user-feedback-driven closed-loop process.

2604.19859.tldr: This work study how to train a strong small deep research agent under limited open-data by improving both data quality and data utilization, and presents DR-Venus, a frontier 4B deep research agent for edge-scale deployment, built entirely on open data.

2604.20122.tldr: This approach addresses key industrial challenges such as limited data availability, lack of training expertise, and the need for immediate inference, while taking advantage of the growing accessibility of time series foundation models.

2604.20012.tldr: Embodied mid-training provides a stronger initialization for VLA fine-tuning, with gains emerging from the earliest steps and widening throughout training, and the data engine captures both dataset-level and sample-level alignment signals, favoring spatial reasoning over text-centric tasks while preserving the diversity of the VLM data.

2604.20263.tldr: Overall, AROMA demonstrates that combining knowledge-driven multimodal modeling with evidence retrieval provides a promising pathway toward more reliable and interpretable virtual cell perturbation prediction.

2604.20261.tldr: A Memory-Augmented LLM-based Multi-Agent System (MALMAS) for automated feature generation that decomposes the generation process into agents with distinct responsibilities, and a Router Agent activates an appropriate subset of agents per iteration, further broadening exploration of the feature space.

2604.20254.tldr: Mol-Debate is proposed, a generation paradigm that enables dynamic reasoning through an iterative generate-debate-refine loop and characterize key challenges in this paradigm and address them through perspective-oriented orchestration, including developer-debater conflict, global-local structural reasoning, and static-dynamic integration.

2604.19903.tldr: A generalizable framework for data-driven emission control is established, offering a pathway toward low-emission operation without structural modifications or additional hardware, with potential applicability to other hard-to-abate industries such as steel, glass, and lime.

2604.19902.tldr: Comprehensive evaluations indicate that MMCORE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across a broad spectrum of text-to-image and single/multi-image editing benchmarks.

2604.19887.tldr: A system based on Large Language Models for depression risk assessment in Reddit posts, through multi-label classification of eight depression-associated emotions and the computation of a weighted severity index is proposed, demonstrating the feasibility of a cost-effective, scalable approach for large-scale psychological monitoring.

2604.20269.tldr: Experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms existing white-box text steganography methods in terms of embedding capacity and text quality, and has achieved better practicality and flexibility than the existing black-box paradigm in some popular online social networks.

2604.20267.tldr: This work introduces the Audio-Text Interleaved contextual Retrieval (ATIR) task, and introduces a novel token compression mechanism that is orthogonal to existing compression methods, thereby alleviating the issue of excessive audio tokens in MLLM-based ATIR models.

2604.20134.tldr: AgentSOC is introduced, a multi-layered agentic AI framework that enhances SOC automation by integrating perception, anticipatory reasoning, and risk-based action planning and suggests that hybrid agentic reasoning has the potential to serve as a foundation for developing adaptive, safer SOC automation in large enterprises.

2604.20115.tldr: This work provides the first systematic generalization analysis for first-order gradient-based bilevel minimax solvers with lower-level minimax problems, and reveals a precise trade-off among algorithmic stability, generalization gaps, and practical settings.

2604.20050.tldr: It is found that although the median market is effective at aggregating information in the easy information structures, increasing the complexity has a significant and negative impact, suggesting that AI agents may suffer from the same limitations as humans when reasoning about others.

2604.20022.tldr: BMBE (Bayesian Medical Belief Engine) is introduced, a modular diagnostic dialogue framework that enforces a strict separation between language and reasoning, and validate across empirical and LLM-generated knowledge bases against frontier LLMs, confirming the advantage is architectural, not informational.

2604.20011.tldr: These findings show that metaphorical roles are a central ethical design concern for responsible AI companions and link them to behavioral addiction signs, all of which has been inferred from the text in the posts.

2604.19936.tldr: It is found that utilizing advanced generalization techniques can significantly decrease attack performance, potentially by up to 100 times, and combining these methods not only improves model generalization but also reduces attack effectiveness by introducing randomness during training.

2604.19926.tldr: A multi-agent system for iterative HTML5 game generation that addresses issues through four coupled ideas: a proxy reward centered on programmatic signals rather than pure LLM judgment; lineage-scoped memory for cross-version experience accumulation; runtime validation integrated into both repair and reward; and a mechanic-guided planning loop in which retrieved mechanic knowledge is converted into an explicit mechanic plan before code generation begins.

2604.19925.tldr: The results indicate that AI agents do not simply generate content, but reflect owner-related context in ways that can propagate human behavioral heterogeneity into digital environments, with implications for privacy, platform design, and the governance of agentic systems.

2604.19884.tldr: These findings provide a systematic diagnostic framework for PTQ failures and suggest that addressing Computation Collapse requires structural reconstruction rather than mere compensation.

2604.20210.tldr: Evaluating VPL in a user study using the vibrotactile feedback from a Microsoft Xbox controller shows that it efficiently learns individualized preferences while maintaining comfortable, low-workload user interactions, highlighting the potential of VPL for scalable personalization of vibrotactile experiences.

2604.20544.tldr: A model fine-tuned on a compact, high-quality subset curated by EVIAN consistently surpassed models trained on orders-of-magnitude larger datasets, revealing that dividing complex auditing into verifiable subtasks enables robust curation, and that Logical Coherence is the most critical factor in data quality evaluation.

2604.20511.tldr: This paper presents the CHASM, a first-of-its-kind dataset designed to evaluate the capability of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in detecting covert advertisements on social media, and shows that none of the current MLLMs are sufficiently reliable for detecting covert advertisements.

2604.20496.tldr: COBALT, a Z3 SMT-based formal verification engine for identifying CWE-190/191/195 arithmetic vulnerability patterns in C/C++ infrastructure prior to deployment, is presented and the broader claim is infrastructural: frontier-model safety cannot depend on behavioral safeguards alone; the containment stack itself must be subjected to formal verification.

2604.20417.tldr: It is demonstrated that semantic recall is particularly useful for assessing retrieval quality on queries that have few relevant results among their nearest neighbors and that optimizing search algorithms for these metrics can lead to improved cost-quality tradeoffs.

2604.20286.tldr: MambaLiteUNet is proposed, a compact yet robust segmentation framework that integrates Mamba state space modeling into a U-Net architecture, along with three key modules: Adaptive Multi-Branch Mamba Feature Fusion (AMF), Local-Global Feature Mixing (LGFM), and Cross-Gated Attention (CGA).

2604.20368.tldr: This work proposes LaplacianFormer, a Transformer variant that employs a Laplacian kernel as a principled alternative to softmax, motivated by empirical observations and theoretical analysis, and introduces a provably injective feature map that retains fine-grained token information.

2604.20348.tldr: This work introduces BiCICLe (Bimanual Coordinated In-Context Learning), the first framework that enables standard LLMs to perform few-shot bimanual manipulation without fine-tuning and demonstrates strong few-shot generalization on novel tasks.

2604.20329.tldr: It is demonstrated that image generation training serves a role similar to LLM pretraining, and lets models learn powerful and general visual representations that enable SOTA performance on various vision tasks, and suggests that image generation pretraining is a generalist vision learner.

2604.20311.tldr: This work proposes a unified framework that achieves joint spatio-temporal enlargement, enabling precise perception of extremely long video sequences while supporting a scalable memory bank that can infinitely expand to incorporate all relevant historical videos.

2604.20300.tldr: It is argued that in resource-constrained environments, a well-designed forgetting mechanism is as crucial as remembering, delivering benefits across three dimensions: efficiency via intelligent memory pruning, quality by dynamically updating outdated preferences and context, and security through active forgetting of malicious inputs, sensitive data, and privacy-compromising content.

2604.20666.tldr: The numerical experiments reveal that ORPHEAS outperforms state-of-the-art multilingual embedding models, demonstrating that domain-specialized fine-tuning on morphologically complex languages does not compromise cross-lingual retrieval capability.

2604.20606.tldr: A systematic and controlled comparison of six discretization schemes instantiated within the Vision Mamba framework elucidate the pivotal role of discretization in SSM-based vision architectures and furnish empirically grounded justification for adopting BIL as the default discretization baseline for state-of-the-art SSM models.

2604.20548.tldr: This study not only validates the effectiveness of the multi-agent iterative search strategy but also provides a theoretical explanation, grounded in combinatorial innovation theory and methodologies, for its ability to improve research idea generation performance.

2604.20468.tldr: This work presents an interactive framework that enables robot skill adaptation through three complementary modalities: kinesthetic touch for precise spatial corrections, natural language for high-level semantic modifications, and a graphical web interface for visualizing geometric relations and trajectories.

2604.20714.tldr: Textual Parameter Graph Optimization (TPGO), a framework that enables a multi-agent system to learn to evolve and significantly enhances the performance of state-of-the-art agent frameworks, achieving higher success rates through automated, self-improving optimization.

2604.20331.tldr: This work proposes a surrogate modeling framework that quantitatively explains LLM-encoded knowledge and demonstrates its effectiveness in revealing the extent to which LLMs "perceive" each input variable in relation to the output.

2604.20688.tldr: Results demonstrate that StormNet can effectively reduce the root mean square error in water-level predictions by more than 70% for 48-hour forecasts and above 50% for 72-hour forecasts, as well as outperform a sequential LSTM baseline, particularly for longer prediction horizons.

2604.20652.tldr: Large language models trained on human feedback may suppress fraud warnings when investors arrive already persuaded of a fraudulent opportunity, but motivated investor framing did not suppress AI fraud warnings; if anything, it marginally increased them.

2604.20651.tldr: Chorus, an agentic framework, which orchestrates LLM-powered actors with behaviorally consistent personas to generate realistic deliberation discussions, is proposed, confirming Chorus as a practical tool for generating high-quality deliberation data suitable for online discourse analysis.

2604.20601.tldr: Results show that SuperIgor agents adhere to instructions more strictly than baseline methods, while also demonstrating strong generalization to previously unseen instructions.

2604.20582.tldr: It is shown that repeated interaction with memory gives rise to measurable reputation and deception dynamics among LLM agents.

2604.20556.tldr: LayerTracer provides a scientific basis for layer division, module ratio, and gating switching of hybrid architectures, effectively optimizing model performance, and accurately locates task-effective layers and stability bottlenecks, offering universal support for LLM structure design and interpretability research.

2604.20549.tldr: This work investigates the idea that quality markers in embedding space may show cross-lingual consistency, which would allow high-resource languages to subsidize the filtering of low-resource ones, and demonstrates that massive multilingual pooling frequently outperforms monolingual baselines in both rank stability and aggregate accuracy.

2604.20523.tldr: It is shown that reasoning-optimized models achieve 88-89% average accuracy across all evaluated blueprints and operations, approaching solver correctness, and position LLMs as lightweight assistants for early variability validation.

2604.20443.tldr: DialToM is introduced, a human-verified benchmark built from natural human dialogue using a multiple-choice framework that reveals a significant reasoning asymmetry: while LLMs excel at identifying mental states, most fail to leverage this understanding to forecast social trajectories.

2604.20389.tldr: This work introduces CyberCertBench, a new suite of Multiple Choice Question Answering benchmarks derived from industry recognized certifications, and proposes and validate a novel Proposer-Verifier framework, a methodology to generate interpretable, natural language explanations for model performance.

2604.20706.tldr: This work proposes QuanForge, a mutation testing framework specifically designed for QNNs, and introduces statistical mutation killing to provide a more reliable criterion and a mutant generation algorithm is formalized that systematically produces effective mutants, enabling a robust and reliable mutation analysis.

2604.20279.tldr: AgentLens is a mobile GUI agent that adaptively uses three visual modalities during human-agent interaction: Full UI, Partial UI, and GenUI, and it extends a standard mobile agent with adaptive communication actions and uses Virtual Display to enable background execution with selective visual overlays.

2604.20719.tldr: ONOTE, a multi-format benchmark that utilizes a deterministic pipeline--grounded in canonical pitch projection--to eliminate subjective scoring biases across diverse notation systems, is introduced.

2604.20444.tldr: The VTOUCH dataset leverages vision based tactile sensing to provide high-fidelity physical interaction signals, adopts a matrix-style task design to enable systematic learning, and employs automated data collection pipelines covering real-world, demand-driven scenarios to ensure scalability.

2604.20441.tldr: Domain-specific pre-deployment audit may provide a practical foundation for governing medical research agent skills, complementing general-purpose quality checks with structured audit workflows tailored to scientific use cases.

2604.20420.tldr: The study examines how latency and throughput scale under varying workloads, how optimizations at the runtime, service, and deployment levels affect response time, and how deployment in a single-node K3s cluster influences resilience during disruptions.

2604.20401.tldr: A cost-efficient approach, Onyx, with two new co-designed components: Onyx-ANNS introduces a compact intermediate representation that proactively prunes the majority of bandwidth-intensive accesses without hurting recall, and Onyx-ORAM proposes a locality-aware shallow tree design that reduces access count while remaining compatible with bandwidth-efficient ORAM techniques.

2604.20347.tldr: A Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model is proposed for adaptive and automated US-guided needle insertion and tracking on a robotic ultrasound (RUS) system, enabling real-time, dynamically adaptive adjustment of insertion based on the obtained needle position and environment awareness.

2604.20313.tldr: Using a first-order Fr\'echet approximation around the base model trajectory, it is shown that the multi-layer LoRA effect can be decomposed into a linear summation of layerwise contributions and a higher-order remainder term representing inter-layer coupling.

2604.20669.tldr: Systemic and behavioral factors crucial to address in scenarios encumbered by complexity, uncertainty, and urgency are examined.

2604.20665.tldr: This work challenges the conventional methodology of multimodal evaluation, which relies on data ablation or new dataset creation and therefore fatally conflates dataset biases with architectural incapacity, and proposes a radical, information-theoretic departure: the Modality Translation Protocol, designed to quantifiably unmask the Expense of Seeing.

2604.20659.tldr: A model-free and verifiable process supervision via probing the model's belief in the correct answer throughout its reasoning trajectory is introduced, enabling more targeted and sample-efficient policy updates, while avoiding the need for intermediate supervision derived from costly Monte Carlo rollouts or auxiliary models.

2604.20623.tldr: This work presents RSRCC, a new benchmark for remote sensing change question-answering containing 126k questions, split into 87k training, 17.1k validation, and 22k test instances, and introduces a hierarchical semi-supervised curation pipeline that uses Best-of-N ranking as a critical final ambiguity-resolution stage.

2604.20545.tldr: It is argued that generative AI must be evaluated as a pluralist sociotechnical system and Machine-Society-Human (MaSH) Loops is developed, a framework for tracing how models, users, and institutions recursively co-construct meaning and values.

2604.20487.tldr: This work proposes Knowledge Capsules, structured nonparametric memory units that represent normalized relational knowledge and can be constructed directly from document corpora using a frozen base model and introduces an External Key Value Injection (KVI) framework that compiles capsules into attention-compatible key value representations, enabling external knowledge to directly participate in the model's attention computation.

2604.20436.tldr: Shift-Up is proposed, a framework that reinterprets established software engineering practices, like executable requirements (BDD), architectural modeling (C4), and architecture decision records (ADRs), as structural guardrails for GenAI-native development.

2604.20413.tldr: SABA is a reasoning framework that explicitly introduces self-awareness of missing premises before making the final decision and achieves the best performance on all three difficulty splits of the non-interactive Detective Puzzle benchmark, and it also maintains leading results on multiple public benchmarks.

2604.20372.tldr: DeepFingers is introduced, a new framework for AI-driven fluid dynamics that enforces balanced learning across the full spectrum of spatial modes by combining the Fourier Neural Operator with a Deep Operator Network to predict the spatiotemporal evolution of viscous fingers.

2604.20365.tldr: A Parameter Impact metric is introduced which demonstrates that the additional parameters required by the reinforcement technique do not translate into better performance, thus favouring evolutionary strategies.

2604.20306.tldr: Qualitative analyses confirm that DCI significantly enhances the interpretability and robustness of cross-modal reasoning by explicitly disentangling true causal effects from spurious cross-modal shortcuts.

2604.20825.tldr: This paper proposes FedSIR, a multi-stage framework for robust FL under noisy labels that employs a noise-aware training strategy that integrates logit-adjusted loss, knowledge distillation, and distance-aware aggregation to further stabilize federated optimization.

2604.20806.tldr: OMIBench is presented, a benchmark designed to evaluate Olympiad-level reasoning when the required evidence is distributed over multiple images and contains problems from biology, chemistry, mathematics, and physics Olympiads, together with manually annotated rationales and evaluation protocols for both exact and semantic answer matching.

2604.20842.tldr: SpeechParaling-Bench is introduced, a comprehensive benchmark for paralinguistic-aware speech generation that expands existing coverage from fewer than 50 to over 100 fine-grained features, and is organized into three progressively challenging tasks: fine-grained control, intra-utterance variation, and context-aware adaptation.

2604.20811.tldr: RoboGrid is introduced, a framework that disentangles syntax, behavior, and semantics through controlled stress-tests of recursion depth, expression complexity, and surface styles, and reveals that LLMs rely on semantic bootstrapping from keywords rather than pure symbolic induction.

2604.20789.tldr: The results indicate that cognitively-inspired constraints, particularly fixed-width attention, can significantly improve grammatical accuracy especially when training data is scarce, and such constraints may serve as a beneficial inductive bias, guiding models towards more robust linguistic representations, especially in data-limited settings.

2604.20723.tldr: Tokenised Flow Matching for Posterior Estimation (TFMPE) is proposed, a tokenised flow matching approach that supports function-valued observations through likelihood factorisation and validated on realistic infectious disease and computational fluid dynamics models.

2604.20720.tldr: This work introduces COMPASS (COntinual Multilingual PEFT with Adaptive Semantic Sampling), a novel data-centric framework for adapting LLMs to target languages that consistently outperforms baseline methods guided by linguistic similarity.

2604.20795.tldr: The proposed architecture addresses key limitations of current LLM-based systems, including lack of long-term memory, weak structural understanding, and limited reasoning capabilities and provides a foundation for building agent-based systems, robotics applications, and enterprise AI solutions that require persistent knowledge, explainability, and reliable decision-making.

2604.20791.tldr: It is suggested that LLMs function most effectively as collaborative communication enhancers rather than replacements for clinical expertise, analyzing semantic fidelity, readability, and affective resonance.

2604.20763.tldr: This work formalizes retrieval evaluation as a statistical estimation problem, showing that metric reliability is fundamentally limited by the evaluation-set construction, and introduces semantic stratification, which grounds evaluation in corpus structure by organizing documents into an interpretable global space of entity-based clusters.

2604.20755.tldr: V-tableR1 4B establishes state-of-the-art accuracy among open-source models on complex tabular benchmarks, outperforming models up to 18x its size and improving over its SFT baseline, and proposes Process-Guided Direct Alignment Policy Optimization (PGPO), a novel RL algorithm integrating process rewards, decoupled policy constraints, and length-aware dynamic sampling.

2604.20749.tldr: SiPeR is proposed, a novel framework that integrates two core mechanisms: scene transition estimation, which estimates whether the current scene satisfies user needs, and guides the user toward a more suitable scene when necessary; and Bayesian inverse inference, which leverages the likelihood of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to predict user preferences about candidate items within the scene.

2604.20744.tldr: Under a matched per-vertex memory protocol, it is established that ALT with farthest-point-sampling landmarks (FPS-ALT) has provably near-optimal coverage on metric graphs, leaving at most a few percentage points of headroom for \emph{any} selector.

2604.20732.tldr: By decoupling the LLM from pricing logic, the framework scales horizontally to thousands of concurrent negotiations with negligible inference cost and transparent decision-making.

2604.20726.tldr: Algorithmically optimizing prompts on training data can outperform human-centered prompt design and that judges'dispositions during optimization shape prompt generalizability can outperform human-centered prompt design.

2604.20817.tldr: This paper identifies two different routes through which models can acquire geometrically separable features: they can learn them from complementary co-occurrence signals in general language data, including text-number co-occurrence and cross-number interaction, or from multi-token addition problems.

2604.20805.tldr: It is shown that alignment cannot be solved through technical design alone, but must be managed through ongoing institutional processes that determine how objectives are set, how systems are evaluated, and how affected communities can contest or reshape those decisions.

2604.20771.tldr: DAIRE (Detecting Attacks in IoV in REal-time), a lightweight machine learning framework designed for real-time detection and classification of CAN attacks, highlights its effectiveness in detecting IoV cyberattacks and its practical suitability for real-time deployment in vehicular systems, underscoring its vital role in strengthening automotive cybersecurity.

2604.20833.tldr: AVISE (AI Vulnerability Identification and Security Evaluation), a modular open-source framework for identifying vulnerabilities in and evaluating the security of AI systems and models, is introduced and an automated Security Evaluation Test (SET) for discovering jailbreak vulnerabilities in language models is developed.

2604.20779.tldr: SWE-chat, the first large-scale dataset of real coding agent sessions collected from open-source developers in the wild, is presented, finding that coding patterns are bimodal: in 41% of sessions, agents author virtually all committed code ("vibe coding"), while in 23%, humans write all code themselves.

2604.20728.tldr: This work designs a runtime shield that comes with a finite-horizon guarantee: with high probability over the training data, if the true perception uncertainty rates lie within the learned intervals, then every action admitted by the shield satisfies a stated lower bound on safety.

2604.20727.tldr: This work proposes Supplement Generation Training (SGT), a more efficient and sustainable strategy that decouples task-specific optimization from large foundation models and enables more flexible, cost-effective deployment of LLM-powered agents in real-world applications.

2510.03247.tldr: This work introduces the first framework for multimodal active learning with unaligned data, where the learner must actively acquire cross-modal alignments rather than labels on pre-aligned pairs, which captures the practical bottleneck in modern multimodal pipelines.

2502.04416.tldr: An analytical post-training framework that rapidly restructures FFNs into sparse MoE architectures using only a small calibration dataset is proposed, outperforming methods requiring orders of magnitude more resources.

2406.11354.tldr: A novel model-agnostic self-decompression method, Tree Generation (TG), that decompresses knowledge within LLMs into the training corpus is introduced, which can synthetically generate SFT data for the instruction tuning steps.

2505.16737.tldr: It is shown that the safety and task-performance loss landscapes are partially decoupled, so updates that improve task-specific performance may still move the model toward unsafe regions, and a safety-aware probing (SAP) optimization framework for mitigating safety risks during fine-tuning is proposed.

2412.16641.tldr: Systems thinking can be used to help policymakers on both sides of the political aisle to understand the complex trade-offs that exist from different types of fairness policies, providing a sociotechnical foundation for designing AI policy that is aligned to their political agendas and with society's shared democratic values.

2509.21361.tldr: The findings show that the MECW is not only drastically different from the MCW but also shifts based on the problem type, offering clear and actionable insights into how to improve model accuracy and decrease model hallucination rates.

2508.21720.tldr: This work presents PosterForest, a training-free framework for scientific poster generation that introduces the Poster Tree, a structured intermediate representation that captures document hierarchy and visual-textual semantics across multiple levels.

2507.01829.tldr: This work proposes mGRADE (minimally Gated Recurrent Architecture with Delay Embedding), a hybrid-memory system that introduces inductive biases across timescales by integrating a convolution with learnable temporal spacings with a lightweight gated recurrent component.

2304.01844.tldr: This study was inspired in part by grid cells in creating a more general and robust grid module and constructing an interactive and self-reinforcing cognitive system together with Bayesian reasoning, an approach called space-division and exploration-exploitation with grid-feedback (Grid-SD2E).

2012.10700.tldr: Athénan is taken, which uses a different, Minimax-based, search algorithm called Descent, as well as different learning targets and that does not use a policy, and it is shown that for multiple games it is much more efficient than the reimplementation of AlphaZero: Polygames.

2509.03294.tldr: This review provides a comprehensive survey of Differential privacy, covering its theoretical foundations, practical mechanisms, and real-world applications, and explores key algorithmic tools and domain-specific challenges - particularly in privacy-preserving machine learning and synthetic data generation.

2508.10177.tldr: This work introduces KompeteAI, a novel AutoML framework with dynamic solution space exploration that outperforms leading methods by an average of 3\% on the primary AutoML benchmark, MLE-Bench and proposes Kompete-bench to address limitations in MLE-Bench.

2506.12721.tldr: This work proposes adaptive algorithms that estimate query difficulty on the fly and allocate compute accordingly, and theoretically proves that these algorithms achieve better compute efficiency than uniform allocation and empirically validate their effectiveness on math and code benchmarks.

2505.00039.tldr: This paper introduces the Structure-Aware Temporal Graph RAG (SAT-Graph RAG), an ontology-driven framework designed to overcome limitations of standard retrieval systems by explicitly modeling the formal structure and diachronic nature of legal norms.

2411.11707.tldr: FedCoLLM is a novel and parameter-efficient federated framework designed for co-tuning LLMs and SLMs, aimed at adaptively transferring server-side LLMs knowledge to clients'SLMs while simultaneously enriching the LLMs with domain insights from the clients.

2305.01626.tldr: It is proposed that the most basic first step in the evolution of syntax can be modeled directly from raw speech in a fully unsupervised way and a neural mechanism called \textit{disinhibition} is proposed that outlines a possible artificial and biological neural pathway towards concatenation and compositionality.

2507.15753.tldr: DiffuMeta is presented, a generative framework integrating diffusion transformers with an algebraic language representation, encoding three-dimensional geometries as mathematical sentences, enabling the direct application of transformers to structural design.

2505.02369.tldr: Z-Score Filtered Sharpness-Aware Minimization is proposed, which applies Z-score based filtering to gradients in each layer, which refines the search toward flatter minima while reducing the influence of less significant gradients.

2502.17751.tldr: Theoretical results establish universal approximation for graded-homogeneous functions, along with convergence rates in graded Sobolev and Besov spaces, and show that GNNs achieve lower complexity for approximating structured functions compared to standard networks.

2506.19579.tldr: This work systematically evaluates single-view object captioning for tabletop scenes captured by a robotic manipulator, introducing a controlled physical domain shift that contrasts real-world tools with geometrically similar 3D-printed counterparts that differ in texture, colour, and material.

2503.16416.tldr: This paper provides the first comprehensive survey of evaluation methods for these increasingly capable agents, identifying critical gaps that future research must address, particularly in assessing cost-efficiency, safety, and robustness, and in developing fine-grained, scalable evaluation methods.

2504.11159.tldr: This paper proposes a concept-based XAI approach (C-SHAP), where concepts are defined as high-level patterns extracted from the time series data and leverages the SHAP method to determine the influence of these concepts on predictions.

2310.02635.tldr: This paper proposes Reinforcement Learning with Foundation Priors (RLFP) to utilize guidance and feedback from policy, value, and success-reward foundation models, and introduces the Foundation-guided Actor-Critic algorithm, which enables embodied agents to explore more efficiently with automatic reward functions.

2604.05045.tldr: PCA-Triage, a streaming algorithm that converts incremental PCA loadings into proportional per-channel sampling rates under a bandwidth budget, is proposed, a streaming algorithm that converts incremental PCA loadings into proportional per-channel sampling rates under a bandwidth budget.

2604.03928.tldr: A regime-calibrated approach that segments historical trip data into demand regimes, matches the current operating period to the most similar historical analogues via a six-metric similarity ensemble, and uses the resulting calibrated demand prior to drive both an LP-based fleet repositioning policy and batch dispatch with Hungarian matching is proposed.

2604.08016.tldr: This paper presents the first survey of abductive reasoning in LLMs, tracing its trajectory from philosophical foundations to contemporary AI implementations, and establishes a unified two-stage definition that formally categorizes prior work.

2602.03875.tldr: A reversible deep learning model for 13C NMR that uses a single conditional invertible neural network for both directions between molecular structures and spectra and demonstrates that invertible architectures can unify spectrum prediction and uncertainty-aware candidate generation within one end-to-end model.

2603.27406.tldr: It is shown that linear algebra and linear programming offer key methods for the transformation, and properties for the existence and uniqueness of solutions based on dimensions of the probabilistic structural model are examined.

2604.09251.tldr: DRBENCHER, a synthetic benchmark generator for questions that require both browsing and computation, enforces four criteria: verifiability, complexity, complexity, difficulty, and diversity, which achieves the highest semantic diversity.

2604.05673.tldr: RSBM achieves over 94% cosine similarity and 92% success rate in merely 3 integration steps -- without distillation or multi-stage training -- substantially narrowing the gap between high-fidelity generative policies and the low-latency demands of Embodied AI.

2603.15880.tldr: This work provides a conservative benchmark of the discriminative power of EDA alone and clarifies its role as a unimodal input for wearable activity-state inference.

2604.03956.tldr: VLA-Forget is proposed, a hybrid unlearning framework that combines ratio-aware selective editing for perception and cross-modal specificity with layer-selective reasoning/action unlearning for utility-preserving forgetting.

2603.26791.tldr: Crystal is proposed, which jointly ranks all cited papers within a citing paper using large language models using large language models to mitigate LLMs'positional bias and leverages the full citation context, rather than evaluating citations independently, to more reliably distinguish impactful references.

2602.13211.tldr: MA-DHRL-OM, a multi-agent deep hierarchical reinforcement learning approach that decomposes OM tree construction into two stages via hierarchical agents, reducing action space and improving convergence stability, is proposed.

2604.20854.tldr: A new framework called ERA (Evidence-based Reliability Alignment) is proposed to enhance abstention behavior in RAG systems by shifting confidence estimation from scalar probabilities to explicit evidence distributions and disentangle epistemic uncertainty from aleatoric uncertainty.

2604.20851.tldr: HAT-VTR (Hubness Alleviation for Test-time Video-Text Retrieval), as the baseline test-time adaptation framework designed to directly counteract hubness in VTR, substantially improves robustness, consistently outperforming prior methods across diverse query shift scenarios, and enhancing model reliability for real-world applications.

2604.20850.tldr: Association-Augmented Retrieval (AAR), a lightweight transductive reranking method that trains a small MLP to learn associative relationships between passages in embedding space using contrastive learning on co-occurrence annotations, is introduced.

2604.20846.tldr: ADS-POI represents a user with multiple parallel evolving latent sub-states, each governed by its own spatiotemporal transition dynamics, which enables different behavioral components to evolve at different rates while remaining coordinated under the current spatiotemporal context.

2604.12994.tldr: This work created the first ever dataset, LogicDS, comprising 122 logical vulnerabilities that reflect tangible security impact and developed a systematic framework, LogicEval, to evaluate patches for logical vulnerabilities.

2604.20852.tldr: This paper proposes a novel denoise rank model, DenoiseRank, which noises the relevant labels in the diffusion process and denoises them on the query documents in the reverse process to accurately predict their distribution.

2604.20845.tldr: CaST-POI is proposed, a candidate-conditioned spatiotemporal model for next POI recommendation that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, yielding substantial improvements across multiple evaluation metrics, with particularly strong advantages under large candidate pools.

2604.20844.tldr: The proposed AtomicRAG algorithm outperforms strong RAG baselines in retrieval accuracy and reasoning robustness, and combines personalized PageRank with relevance-based filtering, to maintain accurate entity connections and improve the reliability of reasoning.

2604.17656.tldr: Video-Robin is presented, a novel text-conditioned video-to-music generation model that enables fast, high-quality, semantically aligned music generation for video content by factoring semantically driven planning into diffusion-based synthesis.

2604.20849.tldr: Across experiments on HTML question-answering benchmarks, it is found that preserving structure while contextualizing selections yields higher-quality, more diverse citations under fixed budgets than strong passage-based baselines, while maintaining scalability.

2604.18779.tldr: This work proposes Mango, a multi-agent web navigation method that leverages the website structure to dynamically determine optimal starting points and introduces an episodic memory component to store navigation history, enabling the agent to learn from previous attempts.

2604.20859.tldr: This work proposes a novel iterative, feedback-driven GraphRAG architecture that leverages response quality assessment to iteratively refine outputs until a sound, well-grounded response is produced.

2604.20847.tldr: TASTE is proposed, a comprehensive dataset and benchmarking framework designed to highlight the role of multimodal information in music recommendation and introduces the \textbf{MuQ-token} method, which enables more efficient integration of multi-layer audio features.

2604.20860.tldr: The RealRoute System is introduced, a framework that shifts the paradigm from predictive routing to a robust Retrieve-then-Verify mechanism, and is released as an open-source toolkit with a user-friendly web interface.

2604.20858.tldr: The Mixture of Sequence (MoS) framework is proposed, a model-agnostic MoE approach that achieves accurate predictions by extracting theme-specific and multi-scale subsequences from noisy raw user sequences and introduces a multi-scale fusion mechanism, which leverages three types of experts to capture global sequence characteristics, short-term user behaviors, and theme-specific semantic patterns.

2604.20857.tldr: DiagramBank, a large-scale dataset consisting of 89,422 schematic diagrams curated from existing top-tier scientific publications, designed for multimodal retrieval and exemplar-driven scientific figure generation, is presented.

2604.12875.tldr: A structured catalogue of 195 AI safety benchmarks released between 2018 and 2026, organized through a multi-sheet schema that records benchmark-level metadata, metric-level definitions, benchmark-paper metadata, and repository activity, that enables meta-analysis of what benchmarks exist and how safety is operationalized, aggregated, and judged across the literature.

2604.12710.tldr: This work empirically identifies the semantic bottleneck in LLMs, an intermediate layer in which the geometry of model representations is governed primarily by shared semantic content rather than language identity, and proposes Language-Agnostic Semantic Alignment (LASA), which anchors safety alignment directly in semantic bottlenecks.
