2604.05887.tldr: HybridKV is proposed, a hybrid KV cache compression framework that integrates complementary strategies in three stages: heads are first classified into static or dynamic types using text-centric attention; then a top-down budget allocation scheme hierarchically assigns KV budgets; finally, static heads are compressed by text-prior pruning and dynamic heads by chunk-wise retrieval.

2604.05906.tldr: It is shown that selectively aggregating cross-attention maps from heads most relevant to a target concept can improve visual interpretability and help diagnose prompt misinterpretations in T2I generation.

2604.05929.tldr: This paper theoretically characterizes ReLU neural networks capable of generating graphs within a prescribed graph edit distance from a given graph, and shows the existence of constant depth and O(n^2 d) size ReLU networks that deterministically generate graphs within edit distance d from a given input graph with n vertices.

2604.05930.tldr: This work proposes a multimodal pun generation pipeline and introduces MultiPun, a dataset comprising diverse types of puns alongside adversarial non-pun distractors, revealing that most models struggle to distinguish genuine puns from these distractors.

2604.05931.tldr: Saliency-Guided Representation with Consistency Policy Learning (SRCP), a novel framework that improves zero-shot generalization of SR methods in visual URL and integrates a fast-sampling consistency policy with URL-specific classifier-free guidance and tailored training objectives to improve skill-conditioned policy modeling and controllability.

2604.05939.tldr: The Context-Value-Action (CVA) architecture is proposed, grounded in the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) model and Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values, which effectively mitigates polarization while offering superior behavioral fidelity and interpretability.

2604.05943.tldr: This work proposes a coherent methodology that makes it possible for a single GPT-based model to learn and perform well across diverse MARL environments and tasks, including StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge, Google Research Football and POGEMA.

2604.05952.tldr: This work proposes a novel deep research agent that incorporates progressive confidence estimation and calibration within the report generation pipeline and leverages a deliberative search model, featuring deep retrieval and multi-hop reasoning to ground outputs in verifiable evidence while assigning confidence scores to individual claims.

2604.05953.tldr: A polynomial-time algorithm for computing an optimal committee of size $k$ under any given Thiele voting rule for elections on the Voter Interval domain and a concavity theorem for families of intervals is presented, which shows that, given two solutions of different sizes, one can construct a solution of any intermediate size whose score is at least the corresponding linear interpolation of the two scores.

2604.05955.tldr: bench is constructed by mining and validating design constraints from real-world pull requests, linking them to issue instances, and automatically checking patch compliance using an LLM-based verifier, yielding 495 issues and 1,787 validated constraints across six repositories, aligned with SWE-bench-Verified and SWE-bench-Pro.

2604.05965.tldr: Theoretical analysis validates PLC can facilitate stalemate escape and asymptotically converge to a Pareto consensus equilibrium and extensive experiments show that PLC surpasses baselines in both fixed-preference alignment and global Pareto frontier quality.

2604.05969.tldr: MCPSHIELD is presented, a comprehensive formal security framework for MCP-based AI agents integrating capability based access control, cryptographic tool attestation, information flow tracking, and runtime policy enforcement and reveals that no existing single defense covers more than 34 percent of the identified threat landscape.

2604.05987.tldr: Evaluation demonstrates that Flowr significantly reduces manual coordination overhead, improves demand-supply alignment, and enables proactive exception handling at a scale unachievable through manual processes.

2604.05995.tldr: A simple diagnostic framework is introduced that subjects models to discriminative self-assessment under in-context learning (ICL) settings that better reflect real-world application environments, specifically designed to scrutinize the subtle behavioral nuances induced by memory modifications.

2604.06013.tldr: The claim is not that blinded analysis produces better results, but that without blinding, there is no way to know to what degree the agent is adhering to the analytical process the researcher designed.

2604.06019.tldr: CritBench is introduced, a novel framework designed to evaluate the cybersecurity capabilities of LLM agents within IEC 61850 Digital Substation environments, and develops a domain-specific tool scaffold to facilitate industrial protocol interaction.

2604.06028.tldr: A multi-stage validation framework for LLM-based clinical information extraction that enables rigorous assessment under weak supervision is proposed and demonstrates that scalable, trustworthy deployment of LLM-based clinical information extraction is feasible without annotation-intensive evaluation.

2604.06091.tldr: These findings reveal that multi-agent systems are sensitive not only to individual reasoning but also to the social dynamics of their configuration, highlighting critical vulnerabilities in AI delegates that mirror the psychological biases observed in human group decision-making.

2604.06132.tldr: Claw-Eval highlights actionable directions for agent development, shedding light on what it takes to build agents that are not only capable but reliably deployable.

2604.06269.tldr: MAT-Cell is proposed, a neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that reframes single-cell analysis from black-box classification into constructive, verifiable proof generation and employs a dialectic verification process with homogeneous rebuttal agents to audit and prune reasoning paths, forming syllogistic derivation trees that enforce logical consistency.

2604.06377.tldr: UNLOCK is introduced, a training-free and label-free framework that extracts a capability direction by contrasting activations between capability-present and capability-absent Source variants, aligns it with a Target model through a low-rank linear transformation, and applies it at inference time to elicit the behavior.

2604.06518.tldr: This work proposes an adaptive differentially private federated learning framework for medical image segmentation that dynamically adjusts privacy mechanisms to better balance the privacy–utility trade-off, and demonstrates the practical viability of ADP-FL for high-performance, privacy-preserving medical image segmentation in real-world federated settings.

2604.06728.tldr: URMF is proposed, a unified framework that explicitly models modality reliability during interaction and fusion and performs unified unimodal aleatoric uncertainty modeling over text, image, and interaction-aware latent representations by parameterizing each modality as a learnable Gaussian posterior.

2604.06940.tldr: NICO-TSP (Neural Improvement for Combinatorial Optimization): a 2-opt improvement framework for TSP that serves both as a competitive replacement for classical local search and as a powerful test-time refinement module for constructive solvers.

2604.07039.tldr: It is argued that a robot should be modeled as a single persistent intelligent subject whose capabilities are extended through installable packages through Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs), in which each robot corresponds to one persistent agent and capabilities are provided through Embodied Capability Modules (ECMs).

2604.07669.tldr: MolReAct is introduced, a framework that formulates lead optimization as a Markov Decision Process over a synthesis-constrained action space defined by validated reaction templates, and confirms that both tool-augmented reaction proposals and trajectory-level policy optimization contribute complementary gains.

2604.07988.tldr: This paper proposes a new abstraction called LogAct, where each agent is a deconstructed state machine playing a shared log, allowing the agent to analyze its own execution history using LLM inference, which in turn enables semantic variants of recovery, health check, and optimization.

2604.07989.tldr: An intent-aware infographic retrieval framework that better aligns user queries with infographic designs and can adapt the designs to their own data with high-level edit intents, supported by an interactive agent that performs low-level adaptation.

2604.08000.tldr: This work proposes DD-MM-PAS (Demand Detection, Memory Modeling, Proactive Agent System) as a general paradigm for streaming proactive AI agent and introduces LatentNeeds-Bench, a real-world benchmark built from user-consented data and refined through thousands of rounds of human editing.

2604.08001.tldr: A comprehensive analysis of major competition platforms such as Kaggle and Zindi, examining their workflows, evaluation methodologies, and reward structures and demonstrates that MLCs function at the intersection of academic research and industrial application, fostering the exchange of knowledge, data, and practical methodologies across domains.

2604.08004.tldr: It is hypothesized that robust CX generation methods will be better suited to address the challenge of providing valid and plausible counterfactuals when inputs are incomplete, and that while robust CX methods achieve higher validity than non-robust ones, all methods struggle to find valid counterfactuals.

2604.08008.tldr: This work introduces SearchAD, a large-scale rare image retrieval dataset for AD containing over 423k frames drawn from 11 established datasets, and establishes the first large-scale dataset for retrieval-driven data curation and long-tail perception research in AD.

2604.08030.tldr: This paper operationalizes personalization as individual actionability, characterized along two dimensions: hard constraints that specify which features are individually actionable, and soft, individualized constraints that capture preferences over action values and costs within the causal algorithmic recourse framework.

2604.08032.tldr: It is revealed that while these explanations are highly valuable in complex multi-vessel encounters, they can increase cognitive workload, suggesting that future maritime interfaces may benefit most from demand-driven or scenario-specific explanation strategies.

2604.08033.tldr: The Spatial Trajectory Graph is introduced, a neurosymbolic paradigm built on a “verify-before-commit” discipline that transforms open-ended planning into a verifiable optimization problem by grounding semantic hypotheses against a physical world model and cleanly separating language inference from deterministic scheduling.

2604.08037.tldr: Comparative experiments on the present setup show the feasibility of privacy-aware personalized talking-head training in federated environments, while suggesting that stronger component-wise, privacy-utility, and qualitative claims need further standardized evaluation.

2604.08039.tldr: LINE is introduced, a novel, training-free iterative approach tailored for open-vocabulary concept labeling in vision models that achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple model architectures and provides a complete generation history, which enables polysemanticity evaluation and produces supporting visual explanations that rival gradient-dependent activation maximization methods.

2604.08042.tldr: 3DrawAgent is introduced, a training-free, language-driven framework for 3D sketch generation that leverages large language models to sequentially draw 3D Bezier curves under geometric feedback and introduces a relative experience optimization strategy that adapts the recently proposed Group Reward Policy Optimization (GRPO) paradigm.

2604.08062.tldr: This work presents a gaze-grounded multimodal LLM assistant that uses egocentric video with gaze overlays to identify likely points of difficulty and target follow-up retrospective assistance and suggests that gaze-aware LLM assistants can reason about cognitive needs to improve cognitive outcomes of users.

2604.08070.tldr: This paper introduces AtlasOCR, the first open-source Darija OCR model built by fine-tuning a 3B parameter Vision Language Model (VLM), and details the comprehensive approach, from curating a unique Darija-specific dataset leveraging both synthetic generation with OCRSmith library and carefully sourced real-world data, to implementing efficient fine-tuning strategies.

2604.08113.tldr: This work proposes TADP-RME (Trust-Adaptive Differential Privacy with Reverse Manifold Embedding), a framework that enhances reliability under varying levels of user trust and consistently outperforms existing methods against inference attacks, providing a unified approach for reliable learning in adversarial environments.

2604.08115.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that Revise effectively corrects OCR outputs, enabling more structured representation and systematic management of document contents, highlighting the potential to overcome the structural management limitations of existing Document AI frameworks.

2604.08120.tldr: Crucially, Tempo compresses hour-long videos substantially below theoretical limits, proving true long-form video understanding relies on intent-driven efficiency rather than greedily padded context windows.

2604.08121.tldr: A unified flow method that performs continuous flow matching for video and discrete flow matching for text within a single process, enabling coherent multimodal generation and validating generation-centric architectures as a scalable path toward unified multimodal intelligence.

2604.08123.tldr: A case for micro-serving diffusion workflows with LegoDiffusion, a system that decomposes a workflow into loosely coupled model-execution nodes that can be independently managed and scheduled, which outperforms existing diffusion workflow serving systems.

2604.08124.tldr: A novel framework, Hierarchical Experience (HiExp), is proposed, to enhance the performance and training stability of search agents and extract empirical knowledge through contrastive analysis and a multi-level clustering mechanism, transforming raw reasoning trajectories into hierarchical experience knowledge.

2604.08133.tldr: This work introduces the concept of \emph{activation budget} as a constraint on the number of expert activations and proposes Alloc-MoE, a unified framework that optimizes budget allocation coordinately at both the layer and token levels to minimize performance degradation.

2604.08140.tldr: A Byte-Grounded Traffic Description (BGTD) benchmark for the first time is proposed, combining raw bytes with structured expert annotations to address data scarcity and provides necessary behavioral features and verifiable chains of evidence for multimodal reasoning towards explainable encrypted traffic interpretation.

2604.08159.tldr: Face-D(^2)CL, a framework for facial DeepFake detection, leverages multi-domain synergistic representation to fuse spatial and frequency-domain features for the comprehensive capture of diverse forgery traces, and employs a dual continual learning mechanism that combines Elastic Weight Consolidation and Orthogonal Gradient Constraint.

2604.08168.tldr: ViVa is a video-generative value model that repurposes a pretrained video generator for value estimation, and generalizes to novel objects, highlighting the promise of video-generative models for value estimation.

2604.08169.tldr: Three methods of activation steering are evaluated, which substantially recover target traits (honesty and compassion) while preserving coherence and StTP and StMP better maintain general capabilities and produce less repetition in multi-turn conversations.

2604.08171.tldr: OceanMAE is an ocean-specific masked autoencoder that extends standard MAE pre-training by integrating multispectral Sentinel-2 observations with physically meaningful ocean descriptors during self-supervised learning to learn more informative and ocean-aware latent representations from large- scale unlabeled data.

2604.08178.tldr: This work presents Plan-RewardBench, a trajectory-level preference benchmark designed to evaluate how well judges distinguish preferred versus distractor agent trajectories in complex tool-using scenarios, and reveals that all three evaluator families face substantial challenges.

2604.08184.tldr: The All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection (AT-ADD) Grand Challenge for ACM Multimedia 2026 is proposed, designed to bridge controlled academic evaluation with practical multimedia forensics, and aims to accelerate the development of robust and generalizable audio forensic technologies.

2604.08203.tldr: This work introduces MedVR, a novel reinforcement learning framework that enables annotation-free visual reasoning for medical VLMs and achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse public medical VQA benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing models.

2604.08213.tldr: This work proposes EditCaption, a scalable two-stage post-training pipeline for VLM-based instruction synthesis, which offers a practical path to scalable, human-aligned instruction synthesis for image editing data.

2604.08226.tldr: The Clinical World Model is introduced, a framework that formalizes care as a tripartite interaction among Patient, Provider, and Ecosystem and supplies a common grammar through which clinical AI can be specified, evaluated, and bounded across stakeholders.

2604.08232.tldr: A tailored training pipeline comprising hybrid supervised fine-tuning as a cold start, followed by online reinforcement learning with the proposed hybrid reasoning strategy to explicitly activate reasoning only for high-entropy actions is proposed, significantly reducing computational overhead while improving decision quality.

2604.08245.tldr: This work establishes a new theoretical foundation and technical path for next-generation AI with physical common sense, causal reasoning, and mathematical rigor by embedding physical meta-principles into neural network architecture by constructing the Meta-Principle Physics Architecture.

2604.08260.tldr: Behavior-Aware Item Modeling (BAIM) is proposed, a framework that enriches item representations by integrating dynamic procedural solution information, and consistently outperforms strong pretraining-based baselines under repeated learner interactions.

2604.08263.tldr: Responsible-DKT is proposed, a neural-symbolic deep knowledge tracing approach that integrates symbolic educational knowledge into sequential neural models for responsible learner modelling and offers intrinsic interpretability via a grounded computation graph that exposes the logic behind each prediction, enabling both local and global explanations.

2604.08276.tldr: The Asymmetric Collaborative Framework is proposed, which structurally decouples covert communication from semantic reasoning via orthogonal statistical and cognitive layers via orthogonal statistical and cognitive layers by deploying a prefix-independent decoding paradigm governed by a shared steganographic configuration.

2604.08284.tldr: The results suggest that rule knowledge is not uniformly localized, and therefore cannot be reliably edited by a single-layer or contiguous-block intervention, and proposes Distributed Multi-Layer Editing (DMLE), which applies a shared early-layer update to formulas and descriptions and a separate middle-layer update to instances.

2604.08293.tldr: The results indicate that a structured, standards-oriented approach can effectively guide LLMs in producing system-level architectural documentation that is both usable and cost-effective.

2604.08294.tldr: This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLMs across activity domains, establishing a rigorous baseline for future VLM-based AQA research and providing an actionable outline for failure modes requiring mitigation prior to reliable real-world deployment.

2604.08295.tldr: U-CECE is proposed, a unified, model-agnostic multi-resolution framework for conceptual counterfactual explanations that adapts to data regime and compute budget and shows that the retrieved structural counterfactuals are semantically equivalent to, and often preferred over, exact GED-based ground-truth explanations.

2604.08304.tldr: It is proposed that secure RAG is fundamentally about the security of the external knowledge-access pipeline, and an operational boundary is established to separate inherent LLM flaws from RAG-introduced or RAG-amplified threats.

2604.08305.tldr: HistDiT is introduced, a novel latent conditional Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture that establishes a new benchmark for visual fidelity in virtual histological staining and outperforms existing baselines, as demonstrated through rigorous quantitative and qualitative evaluations.

2604.08326.tldr: This work introduces ProMedical, a unified alignment framework grounded in fine-grained clinical criteria that generalizes robustly to external benchmarks, demonstrating performance comparable to state-of-the-art models on UltraMedical.

2604.08333.tldr: As the first attempt to dissect classification performance degradation in medical MLLMs, the findings reveal four failure modes: quality limitation in visual representation, fidelity loss in connector projection, comprehension deficit in LLM reasoning, and misalignment of semantic mapping.

2604.08335.tldr: A feedforward graph architecture in which heterogeneous frozen large language models serve as computational nodes, communicating through a shared continuous latent space via learned linear projections, and Gradient flow through multiple frozen model boundaries is empirically verified to be tractable.

2604.08337.tldr: InstAP, an Instance-Aware Pre-training framework that jointly optimizes global vision-text alignment and fine-grained, instance-level contrastive alignment by grounding textual mentions to specific spatial-temporal regions, is introduced.

2604.08340.tldr: PokeGym is introduced, a visually-driven long-horizon benchmark instantiated within Pokemon Legends: Z-A, a visually complex 3D open-world Role-Playing Game and reveals a key limitation of current VLMs: physical deadlock recovery, rather than high-level planning, constitutes the primary bottleneck, with deadlocks showing a strong negative correlation with task success.

2604.08344.tldr: It is suggested that GenAI reshapes the distribution of regulatory responsibility in collaboration and offer implications for the human-centred design of AI-supported collaborative learning.

2604.08358.tldr: A convolutional neural network decoder is introduced that exploits the geometric structure of QEC codes, and is used to probe a novel "waterfall" regime of error suppression, demonstrating that the logical error rates required for large-scale fault-tolerant algorithms are attainable with modest code sizes at current physical error rates, and within the real-time budgets of several leading hardware platforms.

2604.08366.tldr: This work proposes Mixture Optimization via Scaling-Aware Iterative Collection (MOSAIC), a general data selection framework that operates by partitioning the dataset into domains and optimizing a data mixture by iteratively adding data from domains that maximize the change in metrics.

2604.08369.tldr: TrACE is the first training-free, per-timestep adaptive-compute controller for LLM agents to be evaluated on multi-step sequential decision tasks, and it is shown that inter-rollout agreement is a reliable signal of step-level success.

2604.08377.tldr: SkillClaw is a framework for collective skill evolution in multi-user agent ecosystems, which treats cross-user and over-time interactions as the primary signal for improving skills and enables cross-user knowledge transfer and cumulative capability improvement.

2604.08381.tldr: A Generative Adversarial Network and Large Language Model-driven data augmentation framework to dynamically model users'linguistic patterns for enhanced Chinese sarcasm detection, which outperforms all existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches.

2604.08384.tldr: Across multiple source-to-target adaptation settings, TASU2 improves in-domain and out-of-domain recognition over TASU, and consistently outperforms strong baselines including text-only fine-tuning and TTS-based augmentation, while mitigating source-domain performance degradation.

2604.08388.tldr: Together, these results show that heavy domain supervised fine-tuning can suppress general tool-use ability without permanently erasing it, and that a small amount of domain-specific agentic data can awaken dormant tool-use capabilities.

2604.08395.tldr: This work demonstrates for the first time that the stealthiness of existing VLM backdoor attacks has been substantially overestimated and introduces Phantasia, a context-adaptive backdoor attack that dynamically aligns its poisoned outputs with the semantics of each input.

2604.08398.tldr: A new pre-training paradigm for time-series data called ADAPT is presented, which can efficiently align the physical properties of data in the time-series domain, enabling mixed-batch pre-training despite the extreme discrepancies in the input sizes and channel dimensions of pre-training data.

2604.08400.tldr: This work recasts the multivariate time series forecasting problem as a series of scalar regression problems which can be solved zero-shot by any tabular foundation model with regression capabilities, and introduces a generally applicable framework for multivariate time series forecasting using tabular foundation models.

2604.08401.tldr: This paper proposes a novel framework that enforces verification over internal belief states within the agent before action commitment, achieving faithful reasoning, and structurally generates persona-based diverse candidate beliefs for selection under a faithfulness-relevant structure space.

2604.08412.tldr: It is shown that, in multi-speaker environments with temporally ambiguous utterances, the device-addressed speech detection task is more effectively modelled as a sequential routing problem over interaction history than as an utterance-local classification task.

2604.08418.tldr: A revised version of DMBN-Positional Time Encoding is proposed, termed DMBN-Positional Time Encoding (DMBN-PTE), that facilitates learning a more robust representation of temporal information, and preliminary results of its effectiveness in expanding the applicability of the architecture are provided.

2604.08423.tldr: A reinforcement learning primitive, the Dataset Policy Gradient (DPG), which can precisely optimize synthetic data generators to produce a dataset of targeted examples to suggest that DPG is a powerful and flexible technique for shaping model properties using only synthetic training examples.

2604.08424.tldr: This work addresses eXplainable Artificial Intelligence for onboard Fault Detection, Isolation and Recovery within the Attitude and Orbit Control Subsystem by introducing a framework that enhances interpretability in neural anomaly detectors by proposing a method to derive low-dimensional, semantically annotated encodings from intermediate neural activations, called peepholes.

2604.08425.tldr: DiADEM, a neural architecture that learns how much each demographic axis matters for predicting who will disagree and on what, is introduced, demonstrating that explicitly modeling who annotators are not just what they label is essential for NLP systems that aim to faithfully represent human interpretive diversity.

2604.08426.tldr: This work evaluates modern KV offloading on Text2JSON and other context-intensive tasks and finds significant performance degradation on both Llama 3 and Qwen 3 models, highlighting the need for a comprehensive and rigorous evaluation of long-context compression techniques.

2604.08432.tldr: This work establishes a practical pathway from simulation to experimental demonstration of photonic KANs using commodity telecom hardware and uses a fully differentiable physics model for end-to-end optimisation of optical parameters.

2604.08435.tldr: This work proposes HST-HGN, a novel Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Hypergraph Network driven by Bidirectional State Space Models, which encapsulates high-order synergistic facial deformations, effectively overcoming the limitations of conventional methods.

2604.08455.tldr: KnowU-Bench is introduced, an online benchmark for personalized mobile agents built on a reproducible Android emulation environment, covering 42 general GUI tasks, 86 personalized tasks, and 64 proactive tasks, and provides comprehensive evaluation of the complete proactive decision chain, evaluated through a hybrid protocol combining rule-based verification with LLM-as-a-Judge scoring.

2604.08460.tldr: This work investigates how to recover component-level health indicators from operational sensor data under realistic degradation and maintenance patterns and introduces self-supervised learning approaches that learn latent representations without access to true health labels, a scenario reflective of real-world operational constraints.

2604.08461.tldr: This paper proposes OVS-DINO, a novel framework that revitalizes latent edge-sensitivity of DINO through structural alignment with the Segment Anything Model (SAM), and introduces a Structure-Aware Encoder and a Structure-Modulated Decoder to effectively activate boundary features of DINO using SAM's structural priors.

2604.08465.tldr: It is argued that architectural design choices outperform model selection as a primary alignment strategy in deployed multi-agent analytical systems and poses a structural challenge for Computer System Validation of such platforms in regulated environments, for which two architectural mitigations are proposed.

2604.08468.tldr: Test-Time Variational Synthesis is introduced, a novel framework that enables LRMs to self-evolve by dynamically augmenting the training stream from unlabeled test queries, and outperforms state-of-the-art supervised RL-based techniques trained on vast, high-quality labeled data.

2604.08476.tldr: Faithful GRPO is proposed, a variant of GRPO that enforces consistency and grounding as constraints via Lagrangian dual ascent and substantially improves reasoning quality, reducing the inconsistency rate and improving visual grounding scores.

2604.08499.tldr: PIArena is introduced, a unified and extensible platform for prompt injection evaluation that enables users to easily integrate state-of-the-art attacks and defenses and evaluate them across a variety of existing and new benchmarks.

2604.08502.tldr: The C-Score (Consistency Score), a confidence-weighted, annotation-free metric that quantifies intra-class explanation reproducibility via intensity-emphasised pairwise soft IoU across correctly classified instances, is proposed.

2604.08504.tldr: The study of language generation in the limit is initiated, a model recently introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan, and it is proved that no $\varepsilon$-DP algorithm can identify a collection containing two languages with an infinite intersection and a finite set difference, a condition far stronger than the classical non-private characterization of identification.

2604.08523.tldr: ClawBench is introduced, an evaluation framework of 153 simple tasks that people need to accomplish regularly in their lives and work, spanning 144 live platforms across 15 categories, from completing purchases and booking appointments to submitting job applications.

2604.08524.tldr: It is shown that steering vectors can be sparsified by up to 90-99% while retaining most performance, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions, and that different steering methodologies agree on a subset of important dimensions.

2604.08525.tldr: This paper provides a framework for categorizing the ways in which conflicting incentives might lead LLMs to change the way they interact with users, inspired by literature from linguistics and advertising regulation and presents a suite of evaluations to examine how current models handle these tradeoffs.

2604.08529.tldr: PSI identifies shared state as the missing systems layer that transforms AI-generated personal software from isolated apps into coherent personal computing environments and shows that later-generated instruments can be integrated automatically through the same contract.

2604.08536.tldr: This work introduces RewardFlow, an inversion-free framework that steers pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models at inference time through multi-reward Langevin dynamics, and introduces a differentiable VQA-based reward that provides fine-grained semantic supervision through language-vision reasoning.

2604.08540.tldr: A multi-granular evaluation framework that combines lightweight specialist models with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) is proposed, enabling evaluation from perceptual quality to fine-grained semantic controllability inText-to-Audio-Video generation.

2604.08541.tldr: The Routing Distraction hypothesis is proposed: when processing visual inputs, the routing mechanism fails to adequately activate task-relevant reasoning experts, and a routing-guided intervention method is designed that enhances domain expert activation.

2604.08545.tldr: HDRO is a framework that reframes tool efficiency from a competing scalar objective to a strictly conditional one, and maintains two orthogonal optimization channels: an accuracy channel that maximizes task correctness, and an efficiency channel that enforces execution economy exclusively within accurate trajectories via conditional advantage estimation.

2307.01139.tldr: This work presents SciTune as a tuning framework to improve the ability of LLMs to follow multimodal instructions generated from scientific publications, and trains a large multimodal model LLaMA-SciTune that connects a vision encoder and LLM for science-focused visual and language understanding.

2308.12067.tldr: This paper introduces MM-LIMA, which is fine-tuned on a small dataset comprising only 200 examples, amounting to approximately 6% of the instruction-following data used in the alignment dataset for MiniGPT-4, and presents an effective and trainable data selector to automatically identify and filter low-quality vision-language data.

2405.11597.tldr: Experiments on two naturalistic language comprehension fMRI datasets show that \textsc{PredFT} outperforms current decoding models on several evaluation metrics.

2407.05087.tldr: This work linearizes the nonlocal means algorithm with deep learning and proposes a linear attention mechanism based deep nonlocal means filtering (LDNLM), which employs deep channel convolution neural networks to extract the information of the neighborhood matrix and obtain representation vectors of every pixel.

2410.21316.tldr: Deep Optimizer States is designed and implemented, a novel technique to split the LLM into subgroups whose update phase is scheduled on either the CPU or the GPU based on the proposed performance model that addresses the trade-off between data movement cost, acceleration on the GPUs vs the CPUs, and competition for shared resources.

2412.15803.tldr: This work introduces WebLLM, an open-source JavaScript framework that enables high-performance LLM inference entirely within web browsers and paves the way for universally accessible, privacy-preserving, personalized, and locally powered LLM applications in web browsers.

2412.17574.tldr: This work introduces HumanVBench, a comprehensive video benchmark designed to rigorously probe the nuanced human-centric video understanding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models, featuring two automated pipelines that synthesize high-quality video annotations and challenging multiple-choice questions with minimal human labor.

2501.06416.tldr: This paper conducts three human studies to establish a novel research direction in model alignment: designing interfaces and training interventions to increase human conformance with the modeling assumptions of the algorithm that will learn from their input.

2501.18490.tldr: The results demonstrate that the proposed CL approach achieves superior performance compared to a policy trained conventionally in one stage, with the same reward function and hyperparameters, while significantly reducing computational resource needs (samples) and convergence time.

2502.13166.tldr: This work proposes AdaInit, a foundational framework that leverages large language models with the submartingale property to iteratively synthesize initial parameters for QNNs that yield non-negligible gradient variance, thereby mitigating BPs.

2502.18026.tldr: A novel subgraph inference framework, ExPath, that explicitly integrates experimental data to classify various graphs (bio-networks) in biological databases and can seamlessly integrate biological foundation models to encode the experimental molecular data is proposed.

2503.23514.tldr: This work introduces LIFESTATE-BENCH, a benchmark designed to assess lifelong learning in LLMs, and demonstrates that nonparametric methods significantly outperform parametric ones in managing stateful learning.

2504.04099.tldr: This paper proposes Temporal Attention Real-time Accumulative Connection (TARAC), a novel training-free framework that dynamically accumulates and re-injects historical attention to sustain visual grounding in large Vision-Language Models.

2505.04278.tldr: This paper innovatively utilize the Location-Scale Noise Model (LSNM) to relax the fixed uncertainty assumption of ANM, and proposes an uncertainty-aware noise schedule, which dynamically adjusts the noise levels to accurately reflect the data uncertainty at each step and integrates the time-varying variances into the diffusion process.

2505.04842.tldr: This work proposes RL$^V, a RL method that augments any ``value-free''RL method by jointly training the LLM as both a reasoner and a generative verifier using RL-generated data, adding verification capabilities without significant overhead.

2505.04864.tldr: Auto-Regressive Transformation (ART) is proposed, a novel method that iteratively estimates the coarse-to-fine transformations through an auto-regressive pipeline that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on planar images and achieves comparable performance on 3D scene images.

2505.17022.tldr: GoT-R1 is presented, a framework that applies reinforcement learning to enhance semantic-spatial reasoning in visual generation by successfully transferring sophisticated reasoning capabilities to the visual generation domain and demonstrates significant improvements on T2I-CompBench benchmark.

2505.17682.tldr: Experimental results on two real-world datasets demonstrate that BehaviorLM robustly predicts both anchor and tail behaviors and effectively leverages LLM behavioral knowledge to master tail behavior prediction with few-shot examples.

2507.01264.tldr: A novel framework that leverages Large Language Models for few-shot code generation to automatically synthesize driving scenarios within the CARLA simulator, which has flexibility in scenario scripting, efficient code-based control of traffic participants, and enforcement of realistic physical dynamics.

2507.14800.tldr: An LLM-based experience-driven day-ahead Volt/Var schedule solution for distribution networks, which enables the self-evolution of LLM agent's strategies through the collaboration and interaction of multiple modules, specifically, experience storage, experience retrieval, experience generation, and experience modification.

2507.15640.tldr: It is proved that more general heuristics can be parameterized by proposing Data Mixing Agent, the first model-based, end-to-end framework that learns to re-weight domains.

2507.17596.tldr: This work proposes PRIX (Plan from Raw pIXels), a novel and efficient end-to-end driving architecture that operates using only camera data, without explicit BEV representation and forgoing the need for LiDAR.

2508.04955.tldr: AdvDINO is presented, a domain-adversarial SSL framework that integrates a gradient reversal layer into the DINOv2 architecture to promote domain-invariant feature learning and mitigates slide-specific biases to learn more robust and biologically meaningful representations than non-adversarial baselines.

2508.09533.tldr: COXNet is proposed, a novel framework for RGBT tiny object detection, addressing issues through three core innovations: the Cross-Layer Fusion Module, fusing high-level visible and low-level thermal features for enhanced semantic and spatial accuracy, and the Dynamic Alignment and Scale Refinement module.

2508.17188.tldr: Experimental results show that PosterGen consistently matches in content fidelity, and significantly outperforms existing methods in visual designs, generating posters that are presentation-ready with minimal human refinements.

2508.17784.tldr: Viewing SFT as a special case of policy gradient methods with constant positive advantages, PSFT is derived that stabilizes optimization and leads to generalization, while leaving room for further optimization in subsequent post-training stages.

2509.13047.tldr: This work presents a novel approach that achieves a 261x cost reduction for maritime intelligence by using LLMs as one-time teachers rather than using them directly for inference, and shows that smaller, cheaper models - when fine tuned properly - can provide similar accuracy compared to larger models that are prohibitively expensive.

2509.21982.tldr: RISK provides a scalable, domain-specific solution for automating complex web interactions in e-commerce risk management and achieves a top task success rate of 70.5% in online evaluation.

2602.17709.tldr: Rigorous benchmarking across microscopic forces and macroscopic observables demonstrates that UBio-MolFM achieves ab initio-level fidelity on large, out-of-distribution biomolecular systems and realistic MD observables.

2603.02473.tldr: It is argued that, under current retrieval practices, improving retrieval quality yields larger gains than increasing write-time sophistication more than increasing write-time sophistication.

2603.22816.tldr: The Step-Level Reasoning Capacity metric is introduced and it is proved it is a consistent causal estimator, and LC-CoSR, a training method with Lyapunov stability guarantees that directly reduces rigidity is proposed, a training method with Lyapunov stability guarantees that directly reduces rigidity.

2603.27195.tldr: AutoMS is introduced, a multi-agent neuro-symbolic framework that reformulates inverse design as an LLM-driven evolutionary search that achieves a state-of-the-art 83.8% success rate on 17 diverse cross-physics tasks, significantly outperforming both traditional evolutionary algorithms and existing agentic baselines.

2603.27494.tldr: A novel two-stage reinforcement learning framework that does not require trajectory supervision is proposed that provides a more efficient approach for perceiving and reasoning fine-grained details in MLLMs.

2604.00013.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that C2F-Thinker achieves competitive performance on fine-grained sentiment regression tasks while significantly outperforming baselines in cross-domain generalization, highlighting its potential in building trustworthy and robust sentiment analysis systems for real-world applications.

2604.01687.tldr: CoEvoSkills is proposed, a self-evolving skills framework that enables agents to autonomously construct complex, multi-file skill packages and couples a Skill Generator that iteratively refines skills with a Surrogate Verifier that co-evolves to provide informative and actionable feedback without access to ground-truth test content.

2604.02369.tldr: This work presents a human-inspired perspective on this emerging landscape by organizing agent communication into three layers: communication, syntactic, and semantic, and systematically analyze 18 representative protocols to show a clear imbalance in current protocol design.

2604.03147.tldr: From 211k emotion-labeled texts, emotion steering vectors are derived, then VA axes are learned as linear combinations of their top PCA components via ridge regression on the model's self-reported valence-arousal scores, and the resulting VA subspace exhibits circular geometry consistent with established models of human emotion perception.

2604.03401.tldr: The preliminary findings suggest that LLMs may show promise for multimodal behavior understanding, although they still struggle with spatial reasoning about classroom layouts, and outline directions for improving LLM spatial comprehension in educational analytics contexts.

2604.04552.tldr: StableTTA allows lightweight architectures to outperform ViT by 11.75\% in top-1 accuracy while reducing parameter count and computational cost by 97.1\% and 89.1\%, respectively, enabling high-accuracy inference on resource-constrained devices.

2604.05165.tldr: A ``CSI-free" paradigm powered by a Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (HMARL) architecture to control mechanically reconfigurable reflective surfaces establishes a scalable and cost-effective blueprint for intelligent wireless environments.

2604.05663.tldr: Experiments conducted in SUMO across heterogeneous real-world networks from Jinan, Hangzhou, and Yizhuang demonstrate that CuraLight consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing average travel time, average queue length, and average waiting time by 7.02 percent.

2604.07003.tldr: This work introduces EmoMAS, a Bayesian multi-agent framework that transforms emotional decision-making from reactive to strategic, and establishes a new paradigm for effective, private, and adaptive negotiation AI suitable for high-stakes edge deployment.

2604.07413.tldr: This work constructs a high-quality multimodal dataset that combines real-world 2D images and 3D point clouds, annotated with fine-grained domain semantics, and evaluates 18 state-of-the-art MLLMs across three manufacturing tasks, revealing significant performance gaps.

2604.07717.tldr: This study develops the first practical NLP tool for identifying HIV stigma in clinical notes, and compares GatorTron-large and BERT as encoder-based baselines and GPT-OSS-20B, LLaMA-8B, and MedGemma-27B as generative LLMs, under zero-shot and few-shot prompting.

2604.08557.tldr: It is shown that violating this assumption, by re-masking committed refusal tokens and injecting a short affirmative prefix, achieves 74-82% ASR on HarmBench across all three publicly available safety-tuned dLLMs, rising to 92-98% with a generic 8-token compliance prefix.

2604.08718.tldr: LeanGate, a lightweight feed-forward frame-gating network that predicts a geometric utility score to assess a frame's mapping value prior to the heavy GFM feature extraction and matching stages, and achieves a 5x end-to-end throughput speedup.

2604.08963.tldr: A baseline empirical study investigating how basic MAS topologies and feedback loops influence prejudice, and introduces Discrim-Eval-Open, an open-ended benchmark that bypasses individual model neutrality through forced comparative judgments across demographic groups.

2604.09502.tldr: A simple experimental design is implemented that cleanly separates primary algorithmic monoculture -- baseline action similarity -- from strategic algorithmic monoculture, whereby agents adjust similarity in response to incentives.

2604.10386.tldr: TrajOnco, a training-free, multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework designed for scalable multi-cancer early detection, performs temporal reasoning over sequential clinical events to generate patient-level summaries, evidence-linked rationales, and predicted risk scores.

2604.10391.tldr: A lightweight framework that adapts frozen VFMs to fisheye geometry through two components: a frozen DINOv2 backbone with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) that transfers rich self-supervised features to fisheye without task-specific pretraining, and Fisheye Rotary Position Embedding (FishRoPE), which reparameterizes the attention mechanism in the spherical coordinates of the fisheye projection.

2604.10392.tldr: This work presents VeriSpecGen, a traceable refinement framework that synthesizes intent-aligned specifications in Lean through requirement-level attribution and localized repair, and demonstrates that training on these trajectories substantially improves specification synthesis by 62-106% relative and transfers gains to general reasoning abilities.

2604.10397.tldr: DETAnt-HOI, a temporally corrected benchmark derived from VidHOI and Action Genome for more faithful multi-horizon evaluation, and HOI-DA, a pair-centric framework that jointly performs subject-object localization, present HOI detection, and future anticipation by modeling future interactions as residual transitions from current pair states are introduced.

2604.10409.tldr: IMPACT is the first real industrial assembly benchmark that jointly provides synchronized ego-exo RGB-D capture, decoupled bimanual annotation, compliance-aware state tracking, and explicit anomaly--recovery supervision within a single real industrial workflow.

2604.10426.tldr: CodaRAG is proposed, a framework that evolves retrieval from passive lookup into active associative discovery and demonstrates CodaRAG's superior ability to systematically robustify associative evidence retrieval for factual, reasoning, and creative tasks.

2604.10429.tldr: This paper proposes to train a safe RL policy on a reduced-order model, which ignores the dynamics of the inner states, but it treats it as an action that influences the outer state, reducing the complexity of the training.

2604.10441.tldr: VeriSim is introduced, a truth-preserving patient simulation framework that injects controllable, clinically evidence-grounded noise into patient responses while maintaining strict adherence to medical ground truth through a hybrid UMLS-LLM verification mechanism.

2604.10460.tldr: This work introduces a steganography enabled attribution framework that embeds cryptographically signed identifiers into images at creation time and uses multimodal harmful content detection as a trigger for attribution verification, and integrates a CLIP-based fusion model for multimodal harmful-content detection.

2604.10470.tldr: This work constructs JurisCQAD, a large-scale dataset of over 43,000 real-world Chinese legal queries annotated with expert-validated positive and negative responses, and designs a structured task decomposition that converts each query into a legal element graph integrating entities, events, intents, and legal issues.

2604.10475.tldr: A novel LLM-based framework, named Persona-Enriched Multi-Agent Negotiation for Travel (PEMANT), which first integrates behavioral theory for individualized persona modeling and then conducts household-level trip planning negotiations via a structured multi-agent conversation.

2604.10480.tldr: By grounding data construction in explicit lineage structures, this work advances post-training data curation toward a more systematic and controllable paradigm.

2604.10485.tldr: This work proposes Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Pose Estimation for Pose Estimation (UDAPose), a novel framework that synthesizes low-light images and dynamically fuses visual cues with pose priors for improved pose estimation and introduces a Dynamic Control of Attention (DCA) module that adaptively balances image cues with learned pose priors in the Transformer architecture.

2604.10502.tldr: This work proposes a novel moderation framework that leverages analogical examples to enhance rule induction and decision reliability, and demonstrates that analogical example-driven methods can advance robust, explainable, and generalizable content moderation in real-world applications.

2604.10503.tldr: Findings reveal how foundational signal processing choices propagate bias, providing crucial guidance for developing inclusive audio systems and demonstrate that adaptive frequency decomposition offers practical paths toward equitable audio processing.

2604.10504.tldr: Caro (Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization), a novel two-stage training framework to induce robust analogical reasoning in LLMs, substantially outperforms state-of-the-art reasoning models, specialized moderation models, and advanced fine-tuning and retrieval-augmented methods.

2604.10505.tldr: Promise Theory represents the fundamentals of signalling, comprehension, trust, risk, and feedback between agents, and offers some lessons about success and failure in agent based systems.

2604.10506.tldr: This work develops a new Chain-of-Thought (CoT) dataset that decomposes intricate reasoning into detailed spatiotemporal steps and definitive judgments, and presents a progressive training framework that confirms the method's ability to develop authentic dynamic reasoning and reduce the inherent temporal biases of current VLMs.

2604.10508.tldr: Error-type analysis shows assertion errors are the hardest to repair at ~45%, while syntax and name errors are repaired at substantially higher rates, connecting to broader findings on the limits of LLM self-correction.

2604.10513.tldr: This work introduces an analytics pipeline implemented as part of the Agent Mentor open-source library that monitors and incrementally adapts the system prompts defining another agent's behavior and describes its underlying mechanism, with particular emphasis on identifying semantic features associated with undesired behaviors and using them to derive corrective statements.

2604.10514.tldr: Data-efficient phase segmentation for manual small-incision cataract surgery (SICS) is studied through a controlled comparison of visual representations and strong transferability of modern vision foundation models to surgical workflow understanding is indicated.

2604.10517.tldr: EgoTSR is a curriculum-based framework for learning task-oriented spatiotemporal reasoning built on the premise that embodied reasoning should evolve from explicit spatial understanding to internalized task-state assessment and finally to long-horizon planning, significantly outperforming existing open-source and closed-source state-of-the-art models.

2604.10520.tldr: ReFEree is proposed, a reference-free and fine-grained method for evaluating factual consistency in real-world code summaries and achieves the highest correlation with human judgment among 13 baselines, improving 15-18% over the previous state-of-the-art.

2604.10527.tldr: This work proposes a task-composition learning (TCL) strategy that decomposes RMOT into image grounding and object tracking, allowing STORM to leverage data-rich sub-tasks and learn structured spatial--temporal reasoning.

2604.10529.tldr: A high-precision classifier to measure artificial intelligence (AI) patents by fine-tuning PatentSBERTa on manually labeled data from the USPTO’s AI Patent Dataset substantially improves the existing USPTO approach and generalizes well to Chinese patents based on citation and lexical validation.

2604.10530.tldr: This paper proposes a preliminary reliance-control framework where the level of control can be used as a way to identify AI overreliance and underreliance, and provides an understanding of the appropriate degree of reliance as essential to developers making the most of these powerful technologies.

2604.10531.tldr: PepBenchmark is presented, which unifies datasets, preprocessing, and evaluation protocols for peptide drug discovery, facilitating methodological advances and translation into real-world applications.

2604.10534.tldr: An addition to the MCP defence area is presented, showing that machine learning models can perform exceptionally well in separating malicious and benign data points, and shows that these models can outperform traditional rule-based solutions currently in use in the field.

2604.10539.tldr: This paper proposes a novel KV cache management strategy, IceCache, which integrates semantic token clustering with PagedAttention, and attains competitive or even superior latency and accuracy while using only 25% of the KV cache token budget, demonstrating its effectiveness in long-sequence scenarios.

2604.10542.tldr: VidAudio-Bench is established as a comprehensive and scalable framework for diagnosing V2A systems and new insights into multimodal audio generation are provided.

2604.10544.tldr: Preliminary experimental results indicate that WaveMoE has the potential to further improve forecasting performance by incorporating wavelet-domain corpora, and a new perspective that integrates explicit frequency-domain representations into scalable foundation models is proposed.

2604.10547.tldr: Agent^2 RL-Bench is introduced, a benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training -- whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, and run complete RL pipelines that improve foundation models, and reveals that supervised pipelines dominate agent-driven post-training under fixed budgets.

2604.10549.tldr: Failure Ontology (F), a formal framework for detecting, classifying, and remediating blind spots across a human lifetime, is introduced and the Failure Learning Efficiency Theorem is proved, proving that failure-based learning achieves higher sample efficiency than success-based learning under bounded historical data.

2604.10567.tldr: This work investigates non-autoregressive decoding in dLLMs by systematically analyzing its inference dynamics along the temporal axis and presents a minimal-intervention approach that guides early token selection, employing a lightweight planner and end-of-sequence temperature annealing.

2604.10571.tldr: It is shown that the distribution of fitness effects (DFE) of architectural modifications follows a heavy-tailed Student's t-distribution with proportions that place AI between compact viral genomes and simple eukaryotes, demonstrating that the statistical structure of evolution is substrate-independent, determined by fitness landscape topology rather than the mechanism of selection.

2604.10579.tldr: Experiments in simulation and the real world show that policies trained with AffordGen achieve high success rates and enable zero-shot generalization to truly unseen objects, significantly improving data efficiency in robot learning.

2604.10585.tldr: A methodology for evaluating the calibration impact of reward hacking and motivate calibration-aware training objectives is established and the findings establish a methodology for evaluating the calibration impact of reward hacking and motivate calibration-aware training objectives.

2604.10589.tldr: This work introduces a hierarchical categorical framework for Schema-Based Learning structured across four interconnected levels linking schema semantics, cognition, embodiment, architectural abstraction, and world-level interaction.

2604.10590.tldr: This work introduces a Cross-Lingual Mapping Task in the pre-training phase, which enhances cross-lingual alignment without compromising monolingual fluency, and introduces a Language Alignment Coefficient to robustly quantify cross-lingual consistency, even in limited-data scenarios.

2604.10591.tldr: This work presents GeoMeld, a large-scale multimodal dataset with approximately 2.5 million spatially aligned samples, and introduces GeoMeld-FM, a pretraining framework that combines multi-pretext masked autoencoding over aligned modalities, JEPA representation learning, and caption-vision contrastive alignment.

2604.10603.tldr: An original algorithm, MoEITS, for MoE-LLMs simplification is presented, characterized by a refined simplicity, underpinned by standardized Information Theoretic frameworks and demonstrates that MoEITS outperforms state-of-the-art techniques by generating models that are both effective across all benchmarks and computationally efficient.

2604.10604.tldr: Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzy Logic (NSFL), a framework that adapts formal t-norms and t-conorms to neural embedding spaces without requiring retraining, lays the foundation for future dynamic scaling and learned manifold logic.

2604.10627.tldr: A shared backbone with embedded specializations is supported and a causal framework for studying multilingual brain-model alignment is provided and provides a causal framework for studying multilingual brain-model alignment.

2604.10645.tldr: This paper introduces the concept of vibe-driven model-based engineering as a novel approach to integrate the best of both worlds (AI and MDE) to accelerate the development of reliable complex systems.

2604.10652.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed MPSF-FL framework not only enhances the performance in diverse VRPs, but also improves the generalizability in unseen problems.

2604.10658.tldr: Cognitive Core is proposed: a governed decision substrate built from nine typed cognitive primitives, a four-tier governance model where human review is a condition of execution rather than a post-hoc check, a tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chain audit ledger endogenous to computation, and a demand-driven delegation architecture supporting both declared and autonomously reasoned epistemic sequences.

2604.10660.tldr: Contrastive pointwise mutual information (CPMI) is proposed, a novel automatic reward labeling method that leverages the model's internal probability to infer step-level supervision while significantly reducing the computational burden of annotating dataset.

2604.10661.tldr: DynamicsLLM, an enhanced implementation of the Dynamics method that leverages LLMs to intelligently generate execution traces, and a novel hybrid approach designed to improve the coverage of code smell-related events in applications with a small number of activities are proposed.

2604.10664.tldr: A preference-agile multi-objective optimization (PAMOO) is proposed in this paper to permit users to dynamically adjust and interactively assign the preferences on the fly and presents the first dynamic MOO method for challenging dynamic sequential MOO decision problems.

2604.10667.tldr: This work introduces a framework that automatically learns context-sensitive constraints from LLM interactions through a two-phase process: syntactic exploration to gather diverse outputs for constraint learning, and constraint exploitation to enforce these learned rules during generation.

2604.10673.tldr: It is argued that principle-specified alignment includes an interpretive component: it involves context-sensitive judgments about how principles should be read, applied, and prioritized in practice, and because such judgments are expressed in behavior, many alignment-relevant choices appear only in the distribution of responses a model generates at deployment time.

2604.10674.tldr: Skill-SD is introduced, a framework that turns the agent's own trajectories into dynamic training-only supervision and substantially outperforms the standard RL baseline, improving both vanilla GRPO and vanilla OPD on agentic benchmarks.

2604.10678.tldr: This work proposes FedRio (Personalized Federated Social Bot Detection with Cooperative Reinforced Contrastive Adversarial Distillation), a federated knowledge extraction mechanism based on generative adversarial networks that consistently outperforms state-of-the-art federated learning baselines in detection accuracy, communication efficiency, and feature space consistency.

2604.10688.tldr: Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement (SCOPE) is proposed, a dual-path adaptive training framework that routes on-policy rollouts by correctness into two complementary supervision paths, accounting for the intrinsic difficulty variance across prompts.

2604.10690.tldr: It is suggested that large language models do not develop robust spatial world models, but rather exhibit representation-specific and prompting-dependent reasoning that succeeds only under narrow conditions, which has critical implications for deploying foundation models in applications requiring spatial abstraction.

2604.10696.tldr: Camyla transforms raw datasets into literature-grounded research proposals, executable experiments, and complete manuscripts without human intervention and outperforms AutoML and NAS systems on aggregate segmentation performance and exceeds six open-ended research agents on both task completion and baseline-surpassing frequency.

2604.10701.tldr: Generative Actor-Critic (GenAC), which replaces one-shot scalar value prediction with a generative critic that performs chain-of-thought reasoning before producing a value estimate that improves value approximation, ranking reliability, and out-of-distribution generalization and suggests that stronger value modeling is a promising direction for improving credit assignment in LLM reinforcement learning.

2604.10717.tldr: CanaryRAG is proposed, a runtime defense mechanism inspired by stack canaries in software security that embeds carefully designed canary tokens into retrieved chunks and reformulates RAG extraction defense as a dual-path runtime integrity game.

2604.10718.tldr: SciPredict is introduced, a benchmark comprising 405 tasks derived from recent empirical studies in 33 specialized sub-fields of physics, biology, and chemistry demonstrating that superhuman performance in experimental science requires not just better predictions, but better awareness of prediction reliability.

2604.10720.tldr: This work proposes a method for training open-weight artificial programming learners using authentic student process data, and introduces a training pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning with preference optimization to align models with authentic student debugging behavior.

2604.10721.tldr: This work presents a simple yet effective framework to adapt MLLMs for NGCG via parameter-efficient finetuning, which optimizes latent representations within the MLLM while preserving its pretrained multimodal knowledge, enabling strong cross-modal alignment without redesigning model architectures.

2604.10727.tldr: A tail-dependent information-theoretic framework for sub-Weibull data, where the tail parameter $\theta$ controls the tail heaviness, and a decorrelation lemma that bounds change-of-measure expectations using a shifted-log $f_\theta$-divergence, which admits explicit comparisons to R\'enyi divergence without MGF arguments.

2604.10730.tldr: The analysis reveals that students expect all 11 cognitive skills to be of diminishing importance in the future, when AI use and integration increases, and highlights the need for educational interventions that explicitly reinforce cognitive skill development within learning environments that are now often relying on AI.

2604.10733.tldr: These findings demonstrate that agreeableness functions as a reliable predictor of persona-induced sycophancy, with direct implications for the deployment of role-playing AI systems and the development of alignment strategies that account for personality-mediated deceptive behaviors.

2604.10739.tldr: It is shown that optimal thinking length varies across problem difficulty, suggesting that uniform compute allocation is suboptimal, and the cost-aware evaluation framework reveals that stopping at moderate budgets can reduce computation significantly while maintaining comparable accuracy.

2604.10748.tldr: This approach improves automated MCQ generation by integrating structured knowledge representations with LLMs and a data-driven difficulty estimation model and demonstrates that the method generates high-quality MCQs whose difficulty estimation is interpretable and aligns with human perceptions.

2604.10760.tldr: The result is a narrow claim for artificial life: in this minimal architecture, helping appears when another's need is routed into self-regulation, and no partner-welfare reward term is introduced.

2604.10765.tldr: Different methodologies of lung cancer detection using different deep learning algorithms - InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, VGG16, ResNet152 - are explored for their efficacy in classifying lung cancer cases to provide insights into the strengths and limitations of each approach.

2604.10783.tldr: Clinical Narrative-informed Preference Rewards (CN-PR), a framework for learning reward functions directly from discharge summaries by treating them as scalable supervision for trajectory-level preferences, is proposed.

2604.10784.tldr: TorchUMM is presented, the first unified codebase for comprehensive evaluation, analysis, and post-training across diverse UMM backbones, tasks, and datasets, and supports a broad spectrum of models covering a wide range of scales and design paradigms.

2604.10786.tldr: This study investigates whether BERT embeddings encode dimensions of fictional narrative semantics -- time, space, causality, and character using an LLM to accelerate annotation and shows that unsupervised clustering aligns near-randomly with predefined categories, suggesting that narrative dimensions are encoded but not as discretely separable clusters.

2604.10788.tldr: TInR-U is proposed, a tool-internalized reasoning framework for unified reasoning and tool usage that achieves superior performance in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency.

2604.10800.tldr: A unified cross-language vulnerability lifecycle framework built around three LLM-driven reasoning stages-hybrid structural-semantic detection, execution-grounded agentic validation, and validation-aware iterative repair-governed by a strict invariant demonstrates that execution-grounded closed-loop reasoning is a principled and practically deployable mechanism for trustworthy LLM-driven agentic AI.

2604.10825.tldr: It is found that (1) scaling beyond 7B yields diminishing returns, (2) longer context history degrades performance, (3) chain-of-thought prompting hurts rather than helps, and (4) a vision-language architecture provides an advantage at 7B but hurts at 32B.

2604.10827.tldr: It is argued that the optimal strategy depends on the model's diversity profile, the spread of probability mass across solution approaches, and that this must be characterized before any exploration strategy is adopted, and formalized through a theoretical framework decomposing reasoning uncertainty and derive conditions under which tree-style depth refinement outperforms parallel sampling.

2604.10833.tldr: This account explains why explicit disclaimers often fail to disrupt delusional involvement and clarifies the ethical and clinical implications for the design and use of conversational AI.

2604.10834.tldr: This work prompts four top-performing LLMs on LiveBench to detect nine security-relevant codes in free-text comments by human subjects analyzing vulnerable code snippets, and finds marked improvements only when using detailed code descriptions.

2604.10841.tldr: This review reframes photonic computing from a circuits-and-systems perspective, moving beyond building-block progress toward cross-layer system analysis and full-stack design automation, and argues that Electronic-Photonic Design Automation will be pivotal, enabling closed-loop co-optimization across simulation, inverse design, system modeling, and physical implementation.

2604.10843.tldr: The methods were evaluated using quantitative measures to assess their robustness against the challenges of intraretinal cyst segmentation and were found to be better than the previous state of the art approaches giving more than 70\% dice coefficient on all vendors irrespective of their quality.

2604.10849.tldr: Correlation analyses show consistent and significant Pearson and Spearman coefficients between some of the Task2Vec-based readiness and final performance, with values often exceeding 0.9 across dataset$times$client configurations, validating this approach as a robust proxy for FL outcomes.

2604.10853.tldr: An executable and auditable benchmark that aligns natural-language contract text with a formal ontology and evidence-linked ground truth is presented, enabling systematic comparison of methods and demonstrating that explicit modeling improves consistency and diagnosis for gap/overlap analyses.

2604.10856.tldr: This paper demonstrates that OL policies suffer from Observational Domain Shift and Objective Mismatch, and proposes a Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) framework that calibrates observational shift, reduces state-action biases, and enforces temporal consistency.

2604.10857.tldr: This work establishes the first score query lower bounds for diffusion sampling, and proves that for $d$-dimensional distributions, given access to score estimates with polynomial accuracy $\varepsilon=d^{-O(1)}$ (in any $L^p$ sense), any sampling algorithm requires $\widetilde{\Omega}(\sqrt{d})$ adaptive score queries.

2604.10865.tldr: This paper proposes Tabular-Augmented Contrastive Clustering (TagCC), a novel framework that anchors statistical tabular representations to open-world textual concepts via semantic-aware transformation and enriches the statistical tabular representations with the open-world semantics encapsulated in these anchors.

2604.10874.tldr: An AOP-oriented Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework, AOP-Smart, which uses Key Events, Key Event Relationships, and specific AOP information to retrieve relevant knowledge for user questions, thereby improving the reliability of the generated results of large language models.

2604.10875.tldr: How an audit standard’s design influences its effectiveness through a case study of ASB 018, a standard for auditing probabilistic genotyping software—software that the U.S. criminal legal system increasingly uses to analyze DNA samples.

2604.10882.tldr: DIB-OD is proposed, a novel framework designed to preserve the invariant core for robust heterogeneous graph adaptation through a Decoupled Information Bottleneck and Online Distillation framework and a self-adaptive semantic regularizer is introduced to protect this core from corruption during target-domain adaptation.

2604.10884.tldr: This work presents a diagnosis-driven framework that detects behavioral inconsistency from the empirical distribution of key performance indicators (KPIs), localizes divergence to gateway logic using model-based diagnosis, maps that logic back to verbatim narrative segments, and repairs the source text through evidence-based refinement.

2604.10885.tldr: A method to review public acceptance of products based on their brand by analyzing the facial expression of the customer intending to buy the product from a supermarket or hypermarket is proposed by a modified Harris algorithm.

2604.10893.tldr: Adaptive Stealing (AS), a novel SWA featuring enhanced design flexibility through Position-Based Seal Construction and Adaptive Selection modules, is proposed, a novel SWA featuring enhanced design flexibility through Position-Based Seal Construction and Adaptive Selection modules.

2604.10900.tldr: The overall evidence supports a simple conclusion: effective reasoning KV compression depends less on more elaborate scorer engineering than on combining core preservation with selective scratch consolidation to lower the usable budget frontier.

2604.10904.tldr: It is found that conventional reconstruction metrics poorly track task performance, where diagnostic accuracy remains largely stable even as reconstruction PSNR declines with increasing image noise, and the importance of holistic performance and fairness assessments throughout the entire medical imaging workflow, especially as generative reconstruction models are increasingly deployed.

2604.10905.tldr: The next-generation and most capable large audio-language model in the Audio Flamingo series, designed to advance understanding and reasoning over speech, environmental sounds and music, is presented and its robustness and generalization ability is highlighted.

2604.10908.tldr: This work presents a working symbolic engine resolving four engineering issues: rule-data separation, shared-fiber handling, read-only meta-layer design, read-only meta-layer design, and intersective convergence and establishes RCU formally via four theorems.

2604.10918.tldr: This work proposes Component-Specific Policy Optimization (CSPO), an RL framework that disentangles optimization across LaTeX tables components-structure, style, and content, alleviating reward ambiguity and enabling targeted component-wise optimization.

2604.10923.tldr: This work proposes the Mem2Evolve, a novel paradigm of co-evolutionary Capability Expansion and Experience Distillation, which integrates two core components: Experience Memory and Asset Memory, and leverages accumulated experience to guide the dynamic creation of assets.

2604.10933.tldr: QShield, a modular hybrid quantum-classical neural network architecture designed to enhance the adversarial robustness of classical deep learning models, achieves a practical balance between predictive accuracy and adversarial robustness, positioning it as a promising approach for secure and reliable machine learning in sensitive and safety-critical applications.

2604.10949.tldr: This work provides the first model-internal probing of unification, demonstrating that real multimodal synergy requires consistency in information flow, not just shared parameters.

2604.10958.tldr: This work derives explicit linear regret bounds characterizing the effects of data variation, entropic exploration, and quadratic regularization characterizing the effects of data variation, entropic exploration, and quadratic regularization in continuous-time online learning.

2604.10963.tldr: This work proposes leveraging the universal representation capabilities of visual foundation models to estimate inherent data uncertainty, analyzing the feature diversity of the model's decoded representations and quantify their singular value energy to define the semantic perception scale for each class, thereby measuring sample difficulty and aleatoric uncertainty.

2604.10973.tldr: The Coarse-to-Fine Multimodal Synthesis framework (CFMS) is proposed, a novel two-stage paradigm that hierarchically decouples high-level visual perception from granular symbolic reasoning.

2604.10978.tldr: Investigating students'AI use concealment intention in higher education by integrating the cognition-affect-conation framework with a dual-method approach combining structural equation modelling and fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis reveals two opposing mechanisms shaping concealment intention.

2604.10985.tldr: This study presents a controlled and systematic investigation of how changes in the pretrained LLM backbone affect downstream VLM task performance, and finds that newer LLM backbones do not always lead to better VLMs, but the performance depends on the downstream VLM task.

2604.10988.tldr: WebForge is presented, the first fully automated framework that resolves this trilemma through a four-agent pipeline -- Plan, Generate, Refine, and Validate -- that produces interactive, self-contained web environments end-to-end without human annotation.

2604.10989.tldr: The Multi-agent Driven Formal Instruction Generation Framework (MAFIG) is proposed, which constrains the decision scope to local functional modules affected by emergency situations and repairs scheduling logic rapidly by generating formal instructions.
