2604.10990.tldr: It is shown that different models and prompting strategies occupy distinct positions on a shared ROC curve, indicating that the gap between model families reflects differences in verification threshold rather than underlying reasoning ability, and that the compositional inference bottleneck is a structural property of current verification behavior that strategy guidance alone cannot overcome.

2604.10991.tldr: The qualitative findings reveal that supportive teacher practices and clear guidance foster psychological safety, while policy ambiguity and reputational concerns intensify fear of negative evaluation and discourage disclosure, highlighting the importance of clear institutional policies and supportive pedagogical environments in promoting transparent AI use.

2604.10996.tldr: This work introduces an automated prompt-optimization loop that treats the extraction prompt as a discrete hyperparameter and tunes it directly against the Information Coefficient, highlighting a gap between feature-level validity and policy-level robustness that parallels known challenges in transfer learning under distribution shift.

2604.11003.tldr: A pair of lightweight sanity checks grounded in the Predictability-Computability-Stability (PCS) framework for veridical data science are proposed, characterizing the trustworthiness of each conclusion and finding that in 6 of the datasets an affirmative conclusion is not well-supported, even though a single ADS run may support one.

2604.11004.tldr: This work introduces a new perspective on comparative image assessment by representing an image pair as a structured composition of its regions, and shows that training on PandaSet or prompting with DG elicits region-wise distortion understanding, opening a new direction for fine-grained, structured pairwise image assessment.

2604.11005.tldr: Diffusion-CAM is proposed, the first interpretability method specifically tailored for dMLLMs, and significantly outperforms SoTA methods in both localization accuracy and visual fidelity, establishing a new standard for understanding the parallel generation process of diffusion multimodal systems.

2604.11012.tldr: It is formally proved that Min-$k$ achieves strict temperature invariance and empirically demonstrate its low sensitivity to hyperparameter choices, and it is shown that Min-$k$ consistently improves text quality, maintaining robust performance even under extreme temperature settings where probability-based methods collapse.

2604.11017.tldr: NimbleGuard, an open-source, Kubernetes-based autoscaling system that leverages a deep reinforcement learning agent to provide proactive autoscaling, is proposed that demonstrates how NimbusGuard's proactive framework translates into superior performance and cost efficiency compared to existing reactive methods.

2604.11019.tldr: Brief2Design developed, supporting this workflow through requirement extraction and recommendation, element-level exploration for objects, backgrounds, text, typography, and composition, and flexible recombination of selected elements, revealing that structured workflows benefit requirement clarification at the cost of efficiency.

2604.11028.tldr: The results support the view that the path from embodied agents to embodied fleets is better served by federation across coherent robot runtimes than by fragmentation within them.

2604.11035.tldr: I-DLM is the first DLM to match the quality of its same-scale AR counterpart while outperforming prior DLMs in both model quality and practical serving efficiency across 15 benchmarks, and is designed for the growing demand of large-concurrency serving.

2604.11036.tldr: Coupling atomic granularity with calibrated, uncertainty-gated corroboration yields more interpretable and context-conditioned verification, making the approach well-suited to high-stakes, single- document settings that demand traceable rationales, predictable cost/latency, and conservative abstention under domain and evidence grounding constraints.

2604.11037.tldr: Rollout-Tree Monte Carlo (RTMC) advantage estimation is introduced, which aggregates return statistics across rollouts sharing a common state to produce per-step Q-values and advantages--without any learned critic.

2604.11040.tldr: A novel relational modeling-driven intelligent approval (RMIA) framework to automate ACFA, which effectively fuses the coupling relation between applicants and approvers and provides reliable basic information for ACFA decision-making from a coarse-grained perspective.

2604.11041.tldr: ReflectiChain is introduced, a cognitive agentic framework tailored for resilient macroeconomic supply chain planning and successfully restores the Operability Ratio (OR) from a deficient 13.3% to over 88.5% while ensuring robust gradient convergence.

2604.11048.tldr: The findings reveal that persona induction produces stable, reproducible shifts in cognitive task performance beyond surface-level stylistic changes, and proposes Dynamic Persona Routing (DPR), a lightweight query-adaptive strategy that outperforms the best static persona without additional training.

2604.11050.tldr: Methodologically, it is shown that what prior work has read as a single comprehension-vs-generation method effect in fact decomposes into four distinct layers -- a coarse method-dependent dissociation, robust sub-parameter sensitivity within generation, a true precision (fp16 vs INT8) effect, and a conflated cross-experiment bias that distorts in opposite directions for different models.

2604.11056.tldr: This work adapts Conditional Mutual Information to the autoregressive RLVR setting and proves that the credit a token can carry is upper-bounded by its entropy, and proposes Entropy-Aware Policy Optimization (EAPO) that modulates token-level learning signals accordingly.

2604.11065.tldr: This paper introduces AI Integrity, a concept defined as a state in which the Authority Stack of an AI system -- its layered hierarchy of values, epistemological standards, source preferences, and data selection criteria -- is protected from corruption, contamination, manipulation, and bias, and maintained in a verifiable manner.

2604.11070.tldr: This paper demonstrates the PRISM framework's detection capacity using approximately 397,000 forced-choice responses from 7 AI models across three Authority Stack layers, showing that the signal taxonomy successfully discriminates between models with structurally extreme profiles, models with context-dependent risk, and models with balanced hierarchies.

2604.11072.tldr: Hodoscope, a tool that operationalizes unsupervised monitoring by drawing an analogy to unsupervised learning, is introduced and behavior descriptions discovered through Hodoscope could improve the detection accuracy of LLM-based judges, demonstrating a path from unsupervised to supervised monitoring.

2604.11080.tldr: ReSpinQuant is proposed, a quantization framework that reconciles the high expressivity of layer-wise adaptation with only negligible inference overhead, and achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming global rotation methods and matching the accuracy of computationally expensive layer-wise methods with minimal overhead.

2604.11088.tldr: The first large-scale empirical evaluation of natural language instruction files is conducted, running over 5,000 agent runs with a state-of-the-art coding agent on SWE-bench Verified and finding negative constraints are the only individually beneficial rule type, while positive directives actively hurt.

2604.11095.tldr: This work introduces Bottleneck Tokens (BToks), a small set of learnable tokens that serve as a fixed-capacity explicit pooling mechanism and proposes Generative Information Condensation: a next-token prediction objective coupled with a Condensation Mask that severs the direct attention path from target tokens to query tokens.

2604.11096.tldr: This paper introduces Cross-lingual Speech Language Model (CSLM), an efficient training method for cross-lingual speech LLMs based on discrete speech tokens that aligns different modalities and languages simultaneously without the need for massive speech data, thus exhibiting good language scalability.

2604.11104.tldr: An empirical study of a multi-model zero-shot pipeline for knowledge graph construction and exploitation, executed entirely through local inference on consumer-grade hardware, and a reproducible evaluation framework integrating two external benchmarks, WebQuestionsSP-style synthetic data, and the RAGAS evaluation framework in an automated pipeline.

2604.11109.tldr: Record-Remix-Replay is presented, a hierarchical optimization framework that combines LLM-driven evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, and record-replay compilation techniques to efficiently explore GPU kernel optimizations from source-level implementation choices down to compiler pass ordering and runtime configuration.

2604.11111.tldr: A set of general guidelines applicable across various assessment formats to help instructors responsibly integrate AI tools into their pedagogy are proposed and a formal model is introduced that provides a structured mathematical framework for evaluating student assessments in the presence of AI-assisted tools.

2604.11122.tldr: Experiments on the UHR remote sensing benchmark XLRS-Bench demonstrate that DualComp accomplishes high-fidelity remote sensing interpretation at an exceptionally low computational cost, achieving simultaneous improvements in both efficiency and accuracy.

2604.11125.tldr: This work proposes a multi-layered incentive architecture integrating recognition of data papers in National Medical Commission promotion criteria, incorporation of open data metrics into the National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF), adoption of Shapley Value-based revenue sharing in federated learning consortia, and establishment of institutional data stewardship as a mainstream professional role.

2604.11131.tldr: A distributed framework for QRL where multiple agents learn independently, distributing the load of joint training from individual machines is proposed, which works well for environments with disjoint sets of action and observation spaces, but can also be extended to other systems with reasonable approximations.

2604.11136.tldr: Experimental results on five video QA benchmarks show that BoxTuning surpasses text-coordinate baselines on spatially oriented tasks and nearly eliminates the accuracy degradation observed on reasoning-centric tasks, establishing visual prompting as a more natural and efficient paradigm for conveying object information to video MLLMs.

2604.11154.tldr: This study dives into the anatomy of compute-intensive MLLM research, quantifying the GPU-time invested in specific model components and training phases, as well as early experimental stages, failed training runs, debugging, and ablation studies, to provide actionable guidelines to reduce compute usage and environmental impacts of MLLM research.

2604.11174.tldr: Instead of asking only whether a robot can complete a task, EmbodiedGovBench evaluates whether the system remains controllable, policy-bounded, recoverable, auditable, and evolution-safe under realistic perturbations.

2604.11184.tldr: A fine-grained, SE-specific characterization of GenAI use across research activities is provided, along with taxonomies of GenAI use cases for research and peer review, opportunities, risks, mitigation strategies, and governance needs.

2604.11188.tldr: A Legislator-Executor paradigm is introduced: the Legislator adversarially evolves structured generation blueprints encoding the constraints of the problem, while the Executor instantiates these specifications into diverse natural language scenarios, thereby guiding high-quality data synthesis.

2604.11195.tldr: A category-level collaboration knowledge mining strategy designed to comprehensively exploit both inter-class and intra-class feature relationships across domains is proposed, which consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AOOD approaches.

2604.11200.tldr: This work proposes a Shapley value method for attributing prediction shifts to changes in the conditional probabilities of interpretable subgroups of data, where these subgroups are defined by the structure of decision trees.

2604.11206.tldr: An architecture that uses behavioral theory through explicit architectural decisions, treating ethics and fairness as structural guardrails rather than implementation details is presented, providing reusable patterns for adaptive systems that balance effectiveness with ethical constraints.

2604.11209.tldr: This work introduces ConflictQA, a novel benchmark that systematically instantiates conflicts between textual evidence and KG evidence, and proposes XoT, a two-stage explanation-based thinking framework tailored for reasoning over heterogeneous conflicting evidence.

2604.11216.tldr: These findings demonstrate that AI models possess measurable -- if sometimes unstable -- Authority Stacks with consequential implications for deployment across professional domains.

2604.11223.tldr: R-LOCO (Regional Leave Out COvariates) is proposed, which bridges the gap between local and global explanations and provides more accurate attributions while avoiding local explanation instability and preserving instance-specific detail often lost in global methods.

2604.11229.tldr: RecIPER, a dual-view retrieval pipeline that indexes both paragraph-level context and compact large language model-extracted procedural summaries, then combines the two candidate streams with lightweight lexical reranking, consistently improves early-rank retrieval over paragraph-only dense retrieval.

2604.11248.tldr: PBT-NCA is introduced, a meta-evolutionary algorithm that evolves a population of PD-NCAs subject to a composite objective that rewards both historical behavioral novelty and contemporary visual diversity, and spontaneously generates a plethora of emergent lifelike phenomena over extended horizons.

2604.11259.tldr: This paper proposes Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization (TIPO), which uses preference-intensity weighting to emphasize key privacy-related steps and padding gating to suppress alignment noise, and shows that TIPO improves persona alignment and distinction while preserving strong task executability.

2604.11261.tldr: This paper presents AI as a Research Object (AI-RO) as a position supported by an initial demonstrative workflow, arguing that governance of generative AI in science can be implemented as structured documentation, controlled disclosure, and integrity-preserving provenance capture.

2604.11272.tldr: This paper proposes AbLWR (Antibody-antigen binding affinity List-Wise Ranking), a novel framework that reformulates the conventional affinity regression task as a listwise ranking problem, and addresses antigenic variation by employing a homologous antigen sampling strategy.

2604.11287.tldr: LLM-generated exercise prescriptions demonstrated high semantic consistency but showed variability in key quantitative components, particularly exercise intensity.

2604.11297.tldr: This work proposes MEDS, a Memory-Enhanced Dynamic reward Shaping framework that incorporates historical behavioral signals into reward design that consistently improves average performance over existing baselines and increases behavioral diversity during sampling.

2604.11299.tldr: This work constructs a comprehensive benchmark comprising 11 tasks and over 130,000 instances, specifically designed to evaluate the capability of MLLMs in analyzing the evolution of ancient Chinese scripts and proposes a glyph-driven fine-tuning framework (GEVO) that explicitly encourages models to capture evolutionary consistency in glyph transformations and enhances their understanding of text evolution.

2604.11302.tldr: 3D-Anchored Lookahead Planning (3D-ALP), a System 2 reasoning engine for robotic manipulation that combines Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with a 3D-consistent world model as the rollout oracle, is presented and four structural failure modes are identified in applying UCT-MCTS to continuous robotic manipulation.

2604.11304.tldr: Testing 9 frontier models, it is found that even the best-performing model (GPT-5.4) fails nearly half of the rubric criteria and bankers rate 0% of its outputs as client-ready, and failure analysis reveals key obstacles and improvement directions for agentic AI in high-stakes professional workflows.

2604.11306.tldr: Evaluations on simulated household tasks and 20.5-hour-long real-world recordings from ARMAR-7 demonstrate that H$^2$-EMV maintains question-answering accuracy while reducing memory size and query-time compute by 35%.

2604.11307.tldr: PaperScope is introduced, a multi-modal multi-document benchmark designed for agentic deep research that contains over 2,000 QA pairs across reasoning, retrieval, summarization, and problem solving, enabling evaluation of multi-step scientific reasoning.

2604.11309.tldr: Salami Attack, an automatic framework universally applicable to multiple model types and modalities, is developed, which operates by chaining numerous low-risk inputs that individually evade alignment thresholds but cumulatively accumulate harmful intent to ultimately trigger high-risk behaviors, without heavy reliance on pre-designed contextual structures.

2604.11315.tldr: The Structured Sparsity Specification is introduced, an algebraic framework for defining, composing, and implementing structured sparse patterns that enables precise specification of diverse sparsity structures, from fine-grained N:M patterns to coarse channel pruning.

2604.11322.tldr: This work identifies a widespread yet overlooked mechanistic flaw in tool refusal, which is term structural alignment bias: Even when a tool fails to serve the user's goal, LLMs still tend to invoke it whenever query attributes can be validly assigned to tool parameters.

2604.11328.tldr: The results demonstrate that evaluation scheduling is a first-class component of APO, not an implementation detail, and principled selection at k = 20 examples matches or exceeds the performance of naive evaluation at k = 30-50, showing that selecting smarter is more effective than selecting more.

2604.11332.tldr: PD36 C and its application pipeline contribute a field ready, efficient solution for AI assisted plant disease detection in smart agriculture and show that with a well curated dataset and careful architectural design, small CNNs can achieve competitive accuracy compared with recent baselines while remaining practical for edge scenarios.

2604.11334.tldr: A coarse-to-fine, multi-stage framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) for accurate and interpretable detection of depression and shows significant improvements over state-of-the-art baselines in both accuracy and interpretability.

2604.11337.tldr: It is argued that governing internet-wide agent societies in which autonomous agents discover each other through open registries, interact without central orchestrators, and generate emergent social behaviors requires institutional design, not merely risk enumeration or process compliance.

2604.11359.tldr: CoRe-ECG is proposed, a unified contrastive and reconstructive pretraining paradigm that establishes a synergistic interaction between global semantic modeling and local structural learning that provides a robust and physiologically meaningful representation learning framework for ECG analysis.

2604.11364.tldr: This work proposes a four-layer decom position (Knowledge, Memory, Wisdom, Intelligence) where each layer has fundamentally different persistence semantics: indefinite supersession, Ebbinghaus decay, evidence-gated revision, and ephemeral inference respectively.

2604.11365.tldr: Contrastive Reasoning Path Synthesis (CRPS) is introduced, a framework that transforms supervision extraction from a filtering process into a synthesis procedure and improves generalization on out-of-domain benchmarks, demonstrating that learning from the contrast between success and failure produces more transferable reasoning capabilities than learning from success alone.

2604.11373.tldr: It is demonstrated that minimal embodiment can ground abstract concepts, improve data efficiency, and yield interpretable representations aligned with biological cognition, which may contribute to embodied mathematics tutoring and safety-critical industrial applications.

2604.11376.tldr: This work presents an end-to-end deep learning framework for transforming raw clinical image volumes into de-identified, analysis-ready datasets without compromising downstream utility, and automating anonymization and image reconstruction within a single workflow, and dissemination of large-scale medical imaging collections.

2604.11378.tldr: A scheduler unified framework that applies classical scheduling theory to LLM agent execution and identifies challenges introduced by non deterministic LLM nodes; a trade off analysis of controllability, expressiveness, and implementability across 70 surveyed systems; a formal specification including a node state machine with termination and soundness guarantees; and an attributable experimental framework with a seven group design for future validation.

2604.11403.tldr: Scale-autoregressive modeling (SAR) for sampling flows on unstructured meshes hierarchically from coarse to fine improves efficiency by concentrating computation at coarser scales, where uncertainty is greatest, while requiring fewer steps at finer scales.

2604.11419.tldr: A systematic evaluation of four RAG architectures for CTI analysis: standard vector retrieval, graph-based retrieval over a CTI knowledge graph, an agentic variant that repairs failed graph queries, an agentic variant that repairs failed graph queries, and a hybrid approach combining graph queries with text retrieval.

2604.11422.tldr: This work develops a framework that bridges the ``differentiability gap'' using two different methods to deal with non-differentiable functions, and develops the Minkowski image loss, a differentiable equivalent for the integral-geometric measures of surface precipitation fields.

2604.11446.tldr: The proposed NExt onlinear extrapolation of low-rank trajectories (NExt), a novel framework that models and extrapolates low-rank parameter trajectories in a nonlinear manner, reduces computational overhead by approximately 37.5\% while remaining compatible with a wide range of RLVR algorithms and tasks.

2604.11462.tldr: A 7B ContextCurator matches the context management performance of GPT-4o, providing a scalable and computationally efficient paradigm for autonomous long-horizon agents.

2604.11466.tldr: This paper introduces SLALOM (Simulation Lifecycle Analysis via Longitudinal Observation Metrics), a framework that shifts validation from outcome verification to process fidelity, helping to differentiate plausible social dynamics from stochastic noise and contributing to more robust policy simulation standards.

2604.11467.tldr: This work introduces an interactive workflow combining SAE-based attribution with activation steering for instance-level analysis of concept usage in vision models, implemented as a web-based tool and finds that activation steering renders interpretability more actionable while raising important considerations for safe and effective use.

2604.11477.tldr: It is concluded that substituting subjective human preference with rigorous economic penalties provides a robust methodology for aligning autonomous agents in high-stakes, real-world environments, laying the groundwork for generalized paradigms where computational billing acts as an objective physical constraint.

2604.11491.tldr: ADD (Add, Dot, Decode), a multi-bit image watermarking method with two stages: learning a watermark to be linearly combined with the multi-bit message and added to the image, and decoding through inner products between the watermarked image and the learned watermark is proposed.

2604.11501.tldr: It is found that quantization consistently outperforms rank reduction by 4-364 PPL depending on model and compression level, and that the advantage comes from preserving dimensions, not from a better coordinate system.

2604.11504.tldr: This book provides a comprehensive and accessible introduction to the emerging field of AI for mathematics and explores how AI can discover hidden mathematical patterns, assist in proving complicated theorems, and even construct counterexamples to challenge conjectures.

2604.11507.tldr: This tutorial presents an OR/MS-centered perspective on deep learning for sequential decision-making under uncertainty and frames these developments as part of a wider transition from predictive AI toward decision-capable AI and highlights the role of OR/MS in shaping the next generation of integrated learning--optimization systems.

2604.11510.tldr: Policy Split is proposed, a novel paradigm that bifurcates the policy into normal and high-entropy modes with a high-entropy prompt, and facilitates dual-mode exploration, where the high-entropy mode generates distinct behavioral patterns to the normal mode, providing unique learning signals.

2604.11512.tldr: EdgeCIM is presented, a hardware-software co-design framework that rethinks accelerator design for end-to-end decoder-only inference of Small Language Models, coupled with a tile-based mapping strategy that balances pipeline stages, maximizing parallelism while alleviating DRAM bandwidth bottlenecks.

2604.11518.tldr: Evaluation shows that for LLM-based agents where API latency dominates, Python's expressiveness yields a 15.9x code reduction with negligible performance cost, while the benchmark-as-objective-function methodology provides a principled framework for growing a cross-language port from parity into an extended platform.

2604.11523.tldr: This work presents the PAC\text{-}Bench, a benchmark for systematic evaluation of multi-agent collaboration under privacy constraints, and identifies privacy-aware multi-agent collaboration as a distinct and unresolved challenge that requires new coordination mechanisms beyond existing agent capabilities.

2604.11524.tldr: The Limited Monotonical Perfect Surrogate (LyMPuS) is proposed, which overcomes this difficulty and enables the comparison of two solutions that differ by a single variable, suitable for limiting the cost of expensive local search procedures.

2604.11530.tldr: SVD-Prune is proposed, a trainingfree, plug-and-play token pruning method based on Singular Value Decomposition that decomposes the vision token feature matrix and selects the top-K tokens using statistical leverage scores, ensuring only tokens contributing most to the dominant global variance are preserved.

2604.11535.tldr: This work builds a command-line tool backed by a library of 100+ problem types and 200+~reduction rules in over 170k lines of Rust, and suggests that a well-engineered harness lets agents build well-tested software at a scale and pace beyond prior reduction-library efforts.

2604.11539.tldr: CLAY is an adaptive similarity computation method that reframes the embedding space of pretrained Vision-Language Models as a text-conditional similarity space without additional training, allowing highly efficient and multi-conditioned retrieval with fixed visual embeddings.

2604.11540.tldr: MatBrain is presented, a lightweight collaborative agent system with two synergistic models specialization for crystal materials research that significantly outperforms larger general-purpose models while reducing the hardware deployment barrier by over 95%.

2604.11543.tldr: NovBench is introduced, the first large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' capability to generate novelty evaluations in support of human peer review and proposes a four-dimensional evaluation framework to assess the quality of LLM-generated novelty evaluations.

2604.11544.tldr: RoMem is introduced, a drop-in temporal knowledge graph module for structured memory systems, applicable to agentic memory and beyond, which delivers 2-3x MRR and answer accuracy on temporal reasoning, dominates hybrid benchmark, preserves static memory with zero degradation (DMR-MSC), and generalises zero-shot to unseen financial domains (FinTMMBench).

2604.11548.tldr: SemaClaw is an open-source multi-agent application framework that addresses the evolution of human-agent interaction from discrete tasks toward a persistent, contextually aware collaborative relationship, which demands open, trustworthy and extensible harness infrastructure.

2604.11556.tldr: FM-Agent is presented, the first framework that realizes automated compositional reasoning for large-scale systems and derives the specification of a function from how its callers expect the function to behave, so the generated specifications can reflect the developer's intent of a function even if the implementation is buggy.

2604.11557.tldr: UniToolCall, a unified framework for tool learning that standardizes the entire pipeline from toolset construction and dataset generation to evaluation, is presented and an Anchor Linkage mechanism that enforces cross-turn dependencies is introduced.

2604.11560.tldr: Bacpipe is a modular software package intended as a point of convergence for bioacoustic models, a collection of bioacoustic deep learning models and evaluation pipelines accessible through a graphical and programming interface, designed for both ecologists and computer scientists.

2604.11563.tldr: Instead of retrieving what was said, Synthius-Mem extracts what is known about the person: a full persona extraction pipeline decomposes conversations into six cognitive domains, consolidates and deduplicates per domain, and retrieves structured facts via CategoryRAG at 21.79 ms latency.

2604.11578.tldr: This paper presents a restricted VMBQC model that extends the unitary setting to a channel-based one using only a single additional trainable parameter, and shows that this minimal extension is sufficient to generate probability distributions that cannot be learned by the corresponding unitary model.

2604.11609.tldr: It is found that philosophy elicits 41% more sycophancy than mathematics and that Hispanic personas receive the highest sycophancy across races and that safety evaluations should incorporate identity-aware testing.

2604.11615.tldr: A unified and configurable CPU matrix extension architecture that enables low-overhead integration while maintaining close coordination with existing compute and memory resources, integrated into four open-source CPU RTL platforms and evaluated on representative AI models.

2310.17245.tldr: This study proposes a novel model-based offline RL algorithm named Conservative Reward for model-based Offline Policy optimization (CROP), which introduces a streamlined objective that concurrently minimizes estimation error and the rewards of random actions, thereby yielding a robustly conservative reward estimator.

2501.19227.tldr: A novel active learning approach integrated with an improved semi-supervised learning framework to reduce the cost of manual annotation and enhance model performance is proposed and outperformed state-of-the-art methods in the semantic segmentation task.

2509.22736.tldr: This work proposes PnP-CM, an ADMM-based PnP solver that provides a unified framework for solving a wide range of inverse problems, and incorporates noise perturbations and momentum-based updates to improve performance in the low-NFE regime.

2603.25975.tldr: Libraries discovered from one corpus transfer to the other with under 1 bit/event degradation despite different annotation schemes and domains, suggesting the operators are information-theoretically determined structure, not dataset artifacts.

2603.26499.tldr: AIRA$_2$ is introduced, which addresses structural performance bottlenecks in AI research agents through three architectural choices: an asynchronous multi-GPU worker pool that increases experiment throughput linearly; a Hidden Consistent Evaluation protocol that delivers a reliable evaluation signal; and ReAct agents that dynamically scope their actions and debug interactively.

2604.08324.tldr: Experiments show that cross-modal alignment does not improve during optimization, even as fitness increases, and the alignment learned by SNIP is too coarse to efficiently conduct principled search in the symbolic space, revealing that while multi-modal LSO holds significant potential for SR, effective alignment-guided optimization remains unrealized in practice.

2604.10799.tldr: This report details the transition from the universal Mistral-based tokenization to a dedicated Polish-optimized vocabulary for the Bielik v3 models, exploring the FOCUS-based embedding initialization, the multi-stage pretraining curriculum, and the subsequent post-training alignment involving Supervised Fine-Tuning, Direct Preference Optimization, and Reinforcement Learning through Group Relative Policy Optimization with verifiable rewards.

2604.11094.tldr: This work introduces E2E-MR, a new task that requires directly generating executable playbooks from diagnosis reports to autonomously restore faulty systems and proposes E2E-REME, an end-to-end auto-remediation model trained via experience-simulation reinforcement fine-tuning.

2604.11625.tldr: This work introduces the Spiking Compositional Neural Operator (SCNO), a modular architecture combining spiking and conventional components that addresses all three limitations of monolithic PDE solving, and is the first compositional spiking neural operator and the first proof-of-concept for modular neuromorphic PDE solving with built-in forgetting-free expansion.

2604.11655.tldr: RPA-Check is introduced, a multi-stage automated evaluation framework designed to objectively assess the performance of LLM-based RPAs in complex, constraints-heavy environments and reveals an inverse relationship between parametric scale and procedural consistency.

2604.11663.tldr: A causal mediation analysis-based approach to identify the causal factors responsible for harmful generation in large Language Models, which performs a multi-granular analysis across model layers, modules (MLP and attention blocks), and individual neurons.

2604.11666.tldr: A novel privacy-themed ToM challenge, ToM for Steering Beliefs (ToM-SB), in which a defender must act as a Double Agent to steer the beliefs of an attacker with partial prior knowledge within a shared universe, highlighting belief modeling as a key driver of success on ToM-SB.

2604.11673.tldr: A statistically grounded, unified deep neural network approach for modeling nodal heterogeneity in random networks with high-dimensional nodal attributes, namely ``NetworkNet,'' which delivers the expressive power of DNNs with methodological interpretability, algorithmic scalability, and statistical rigor with a non-asymptotic approximation error bound.

2604.11674.tldr: AffordSim is introduced, the first simulation framework that integrates open-vocabulary 3D affordance prediction into the manipulation data generation pipeline, and enables automated, scalable generation of affordance-aware manipulation data.

2604.11699.tldr: Experimental results on both open-source and proprietary LLMs demonstrate that the Legal2LogicICL approach significantly improves accuracy, stability, and generalization in transforming natural-language legal case descriptions into logical representations, highlighting its effectiveness for interpretable and reliable legal reasoning.

2604.11703.tldr: This demonstration highlights the potential of hybrid architectures that combines LLM flexibility with knowledge graph reliability to improve service accessibility for vulnerable populations effectively.

2604.11704.tldr: This paper proposes a geometric a priori methodology to mitigate shortcut learning by deploying a zero-hidden-layer ($N=1$) Topological Auditor, which mathematically isolate features that monopolize the gradient without human intervention and empirically demonstrates a Capacity Phase Transition.

2604.11705.tldr: A reactor-model-of-computation (MoC)-based approach is proposed, realized by the open-source Lingua Franca (LF) framework, to address the urgent challenge of enabling agentic AI-powered HITL CPS.

2604.11709.tldr: This work proposes a Mamba-based multimodal network for rapid SDA that integrates multi-scale blast-loading information with optical remote sensing images and significantly improves performance over state-of-the-art approaches.

2604.11716.tldr: SWE-AGILE is a novel software agent framework designed to bridge the gap between reasoning depth, efficiency, and context constraints, and introduces a Dynamic Reasoning Context strategy, maintaining a ``sliding window'' of detailed reasoning for immediate continuity to prevent redundant re-analyzing.

2604.11720.tldr: It is indicated that existing watermarking schemes for AR image generation do not reliably support synthetic content detection for dataset filtering and enable Watermark Mimicry, whereby authentic images can be manipulated to imitate a generator's watermark and trigger false detection to prevent their inclusion in future model training.

2604.11741.tldr: This paper designs a two-stage agent-monitored training strategy to enhance the reasoning ability of VLMs, and offers a scalable solution for training and evaluating VLMs under uncertain, adversarial, and socially complex conditions.

2604.11742.tldr: MINT (Multi-turn Inter-tactic Novelty Training), the first reinforcement learning framework to optimize discourse move diversity across multi-turn empathic dialogue, is introduced, suggesting that what current models lack is not empathy itself, but the ability to vary their discourse moves across a conversation.

2604.11751.tldr: This work proposes to learn a Grounded World Model (GWM) in a vision-language-aligned latent space, where each proposed action is scored based on how close its future outcome is to the task instruction, reflected by the similarity of embeddings.

2604.11757.tldr: This work introduces StarVLA-$\alpha, a simple yet strong baseline designed to study VLA design choices under controlled conditions that deliberately minimizes architectural and pipeline complexity to reduce experimental confounders and enable systematic analysis.

2604.11759.tldr: OIDA is presented, a framework that structures organizational knowledge as typed Knowledge Objects carrying epistemic class, importance scores with class-specific decay, and signed contradiction edges, and introduces QUESTION-as-modeled-ignorance, a primitive with inverse decay that surfaces what an organization does not know with increasing urgency.

2604.11775.tldr: Experiments on whole-body CT segmentations show that caching substantially reduces redundant computation and that faithfulness and interpretability exhibit clear trade-offs, and that regular supervoxels often maximize perturbation-based metrics but lack anatomical alignment, whereas organ-aware units yield more clinically interpretable explanations.

2604.11778.tldr: This work introduces General365, a benchmark specifically designed to assess general reasoning in LLMs, and sees it as a catalyst for advancing LLM reasoning beyond domain-specific tasks toward robust, general-purpose real-world scenarios.

2604.11784.tldr: ClawGUI, an open-source framework addressing three gaps within a single harness, provides the first open-source GUI agent RL infrastructure with validated support for both parallel virtual environments and real physical devices.

2604.11786.tldr: GenTac is introduced, a diffusion-based generative framework that conceptualizes soccer tactics as a stochastic process over continuous multi-player trajectories and discrete semantic events and can be successfully trained to generalize to other dynamic team sports, including basketball, American football, and ice hockey.

2604.11790.tldr: This work establishes deterministic tool-call boundary enforcement as an effective defense mechanism for secure agentic AI systems, requiring neither safety-specific fine-tuning nor architectural modification.

2604.11791.tldr: A mechanistic analysis of the latent states in looped language models focuses on how the stages of inference observed in feedforward models compare to those observed in looped ones, finding that recurrent blocks learn stages of inference that closely mirror those of feedforward models, repeating these stages in depth with each iteration.

2604.11796.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that C-ReD not only enables reliable in-domain detection but also supports strong generalization to unseen LLMs and external Chinese datasets-addressing critical gaps in model diversity, domain coverage, and prompt realism that have limited prior Chinese detection benchmarks.

2604.11798.tldr: A budget-aware uncertainty-driven quality assurance (QA) framework built on nnU-Net is proposed, combining uncertainty quantification and post-hoc calibration to produce voxel-wise uncertainty maps that can guide targeted manual review of radiotherapy segmentation.

2604.11805.tldr: It is shown that physics simulators can serve as a powerful alternative source of supervision for training LLMs for physical reasoning, enabling LLMs to acquire deep physical reasoning skills beyond the limitations of internet-scale QA data.

2604.11806.tldr: Meerkat is introduced, which combines clustering with agentic search to uncover violations specified in natural language through structured search and adaptive investigation of promising regions, and finds sparse failures without relying on seed scenarios, fixed workflows, or exhaustive enumeration.

2603.21011.tldr: This work proposes ALL-FEM, an autonomous simulation system that integrates agentic AI with domain-specific, fine-tuned LLMs for FEniCS code generation across solid, fluid, and multiphysics applications, and evaluated the system on 39 benchmarks.

2603.21440.tldr: KG-Hopper is proposed, a novel Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework that empowers compact open LLMs with the ability to perform integrated multi-hop KG reasoning within a single inference round, and trains a Reasoning LLM that embeds the entire KG traversal and decision process into a unified ``thinking''stage, enabling global reasoning over cross-step dependencies and dynamic path exploration with backtracking.

2603.27557.tldr: The cross-dataset evaluation results prove that the balance of Bonafide Resources (BR) and AI-based Generators (AG) is the key factor to train and achieve a general Deepfake Speech Detection (DSD) model.

2603.28325.tldr: Downstream analyses show that the data support retrieval-augmented question answering and graph-based tasks such as future link prediction and target prioritization and establish EvidenceNet as a disease-specific biomedical knowledge base dataset for evidence-aware analysis and reuse.

2603.29148.tldr: This paper proposes a new framework called Efficient and Scalable Granular-ball Graph Coarsening Method for Large-scale Graph Node Classification that first uses a multi-granularity granular-ball graph coarsening algorithm to coarsen the original graph to obtain many subgraphs.

2603.29977.tldr: The InterSHAP metric is adapted from classification to Cox proportional hazards models and applies to quantify cross-modal interactions in glioma survival prediction, providing a practical model auditing tool for comparing fusion strategies, reframe the role of architectural complexity in multimodal fusion, and have implications for privacy-preserving federated deployment.

2604.01236.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that DarwinNet achieves anti-fragility by treating environmental anomalies as catalysts for autonomous evolution, providing a viable path for the next generation of intelligent, self-optimizing networks.

2604.05164.tldr: This work forms multi-turn reasoning as a sequential compute allocation problem and model it as a multi-objective Markov Decision Process and proposes TAB: Turn-Adaptive Budgets, a budget allocation policy trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization that learns to maximize task accuracy while respecting global per-problem token constraints.

2604.06390.tldr: MorphDistill enables task-specific representation learning by integrating knowledge from multiple foundation models into a unified encoder and provides an efficient strategy for prognostic modeling in computational pathology, with potential for broader oncology applications.

2604.07595.tldr: This work introduces reasoning graphs, a graph structure that persists per-evidence chain of thought as structured edges connected to the evidence items they evaluate, which enable evidence-centric feedback and achieves Pareto dominance in high-reuse settings.

2604.08988.tldr: The first formal definition of the Self-Evolving Agent (SEA) is presented, the Evolutionary Flywheel is formalized as its minimal sufficient architecture, and SEA-Eval is introduced -- the first benchmark designed specifically for evaluating SEAs.

2604.09111.tldr: A synchronization method for AD processes that paraphrases translated text, comprising isochrony for timing constraints and phonetic synchronization (PS) to preserve lip-sync, which demonstrates that both systems outperform TTS without PS on several objective metrics and outperform voice actors in Korean-to-English and English-to-Korean dubbing.

2604.09121.tldr: This paper proposes leveraging LLM-as-a-Judge as a semantic-aware evaluation metric to assess recognition quality beyond token-level accuracy, and designs an LLM-driven agent framework to simulate human-like multi-turn interaction, enabling iterative refinement of recognition outputs through semantic feedback.

2604.09443.tldr: This work proposes Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH), a paradigm for resolving instruction conflicts among instructions with arbitrarily many privilege levels, and introduces ManyIH-Bench, the first benchmark for ManyIH.

2604.09601.tldr: Hubble is presented, an agentic factor mining framework that combines large language models (LLMs) with a domain-specific operator language, an abstract syntax tree (AST) execution sandbox, a dual-channel retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module, and a family-aware selection mechanism that jointly optimizes validity, diversity, interpretability, and family-level generalization.

2604.09689.tldr: This work isolate and quantify the impact of instance density (measured by face count) as a primary driver of data complexity, establishing instance density as an intrinsic, quantifiable dimension of data hardness and motivate specific interventions in curriculum learning and density-stratified evaluation.

2604.09729.tldr: Evaluation combining automatic scoring and large-scale human preference analysis demonstrates that LOLGORITHM consistently outperforms baseline methods, achieving human preference selection rates of 80.46\% on YouTube and 84.29\% on Douyin across 107 respondents.

2604.10200.tldr: Edu-MMBias, a systematic auditing framework grounded in the tri-component model of attitudes from social psychology, finds that visual inputs act as a safety backdoor, triggering a resurgence of biases that bypass text-based alignment safeguards and revealing a systematic misalignment between latent cognition and final decision-making.

2604.10202.tldr: This study focuses on nonlinear, smooth multilayer neural networks and derives a closed-form upper bound for the maximum eigenvalue of the Hessian with respect to the cross-entropy loss by leveraging the Wolkowicz-Styan bound.

2604.10288.tldr: This essay identifies a failure mode of AI chat systems that is attribution laundering: the model performs substantive cognitive work and then rhetorically credits the user for having generated the resulting insights, eroding users' ability to accurately assess their own cognitive contributions over time.

2604.10655.tldr: A new short-form WRV dataset tailored for video weather removal, with evaluation protocols that jointly consider fidelity and perceptual quality, is introduced to advance robust and realistic video restoration under real-world weather conditions.

2604.10815.tldr: MeloTune is an iPhone-deployed music agent that instantiates the Mesh Memory Protocol and Symbolic-Vector Attention Fusion as a production system for affect-aware music curation with peer-to-peer mood coupling, and this is the first production deployment of MMP/SVAF on consumer mobile hardware.

2604.10842.tldr: Resilient Write is presented, an MCP server that interposes a six-layer durable write surface between the agent and the filesystem and shows a 5x reduction in recovery time and a 13x improvement in agent self-correction rate.

2604.10898.tldr: ZoomR is introduced, a novel approach that enables LLMs to adaptively compress verbose reasoning thoughts into summaries and uses a dynamic KV cache selection policy that leverages these summaries while also strategically"zooming in" on fine-grained details.

2604.10911.tldr: EvoNash-MARL is a closed-loop framework that integrates reinforcement learning with population-based policy optimization and execution-aware selection to improve robustness in medium- to long-horizon allocation and demonstrates consistent performance under realistic constraints and across market settings.

2604.11071.tldr: This approach combines frozen algorithm-based preprocessing with a compact U-Net built entirely from depthwise-separable convolutions that normalizes the input distribution by providing complementary brightness-corrected views, enabling the trainable network to focus on residual color correction.

2604.11120.tldr: Heuristic trace diagnostics suggest that the safer model retains stronger policy recall and self-correction behavior, not merely longer reasoning, and testing with only one method can miss a model's dominant failure mode.

2604.11201.tldr: CocoaBench is introduced, a benchmark for unified digital agents built from human-designed, long-horizon tasks that require flexible composition of vision, search, and coding, and CocoaAgent, a lightweight shared scaffold for controlled comparison across model backbones.

2604.11435.tldr: This work proposes a training framework that decouples reasoning from generation and shows that QA-guided reasoning improves faithfulness, informativeness, and grounding over strong long-context baselines.

2604.11626.tldr: Preference-Anchored Rationalization (PARROT), a principled framework that recovers high-quality rationales from readily available preference data through anchored generation, consistency filtering, and distillation, is introduced, and the resulting model, RationalRewards, achieves state-of-the-art preference prediction among open-source reward models.

2604.11661.tldr: This work proposes VCR-Agent, a multi-agent framework that integrates biologically grounded knowledge retrieval with a verifier-based filtering approach to generate and validate mechanistic reasoning autonomously, and releases VC-TRACES dataset, which consists of verified mechanistic explanations derived from the Tahoe-100M atlas.

2604.11734.tldr: Results show that coupling scene-consistent denoising with stable online diffusion-policy optimization improves the reliability of closed-loop cooperative driving.

2604.11835.tldr: Schema-Adaptive Tabular Representation Learning is proposed, a novel method that leverages large language models (LLMs) to create transferable tabular embeddings and enables zero-shot alignment across unseen schemas without manual feature engineering or retraining.

2604.11838.tldr: This work proposes Mid-Block Efficient Tuning, which selectively updates these critical intermediate layers of Supervised Fine-Tuning and outperforms standard LoRA up to 10.2\% on GSM8K with reduced parameter overhead, demonstrating that effective alignment is architecturally localized rather than distributed.

2604.11839.tldr: Aethelgard is presented, a four layer adaptive governance framework that enforces least privilege for AI agents through a learned policy that learns the minimum viable capability set for each task type.

2604.11841.tldr: Experiments show that incorporating high-order nonlinear components particularly square terms is crucial for enhancing expressive capacity and maintaining strong and robust performance under various rank settings, and theoretical analysis demonstrates that PERA offers enhanced expressive capacity and more effective feature utilization compare to existing linear adaptation approaches.

2604.11842.tldr: DBGL first introduces a patient-variable bipartite graph that simultaneously captures irregular sampling patterns without artificial alignment and adaptively models variable relationships for temporal sampling irregularity modeling, enhancing representation learning.

2604.11852.tldr: This work establishes a reproducible baseline and provides empirical evidence that more informative biological features, such as structural, functional, or interaction-based descriptors, are required for robust disease modeling.

2604.11854.tldr: MVAdapt, a physics-conditioned adaptation framework for multi-vehicle E2E driving that improves over naive transfer and multi-embodiment adaptation baselines on both in-distribution and unseen vehicles, and shows two complementary behaviors: strong zero-shot transfer on many unseen vehicles, and data-efficient few-shot calibration for severe physical outliers.

2604.11867.tldr: A three-arc negative result with mechanism, a two-failure-mode taxonomy for linear h_last probes, and an honest falsification pipeline that converts the class of false positives the authors ourselves produced into publishable negatives are contributed.

2604.11912.tldr: It is proved that MTP induces a two-stage reverse reasoning process: the model first attends to the end node and then reconstructs the path by tracing intermediate nodes backward, which provides a cleaner training signal compared to NTP.

2604.11914.tldr: It is shown that three self-monitoring modules implemented as auxiliary-loss add-ons to a multi-timescale cortical hierarchy provide no statistically significant benefit across 20 random seeds, 1D and 2D predator-prey environments with standard and non-stationary variants, and training horizons up to 50,000 steps, and the architectural implication is that self-monitoring should sit on the decision pathway, not beside it.

2604.11915.tldr: Artificial Life shows using Artificial Life that machine learning methods are easily fooled into detecting life with near 100% confidence even if the analyzed sample is not capable of life.

2604.11924.tldr: This work operationalizes the effectiveness of feedback along two author-centric axes-validity and author action, and introduces GoodPoint, a training recipe that leverages success signals from author responses through fine-tuning on valid and actionable feedback, together with preference optimization on both real and synthetic preference pairs.

2604.11945.tldr: In this setting, a single natural-language sentence can be sufficient to produce a deployment-ready surrogate model, with minimum human intervention required at any intermediate stage, and AutoSurrogate is able to outperform expert-designed baselines and domain-agnostic AutoML methods, demonstrating strong potential for practical deployment.

2604.11947.tldr: This paper introduces a residual encoder-decoder bottleneck module across pipeline boundaries that can be trained end-to-end as part of the model's parameters while preserving an explicit low-rank identity path and shows that ResBMs achieve state-of-the-art 128x activation compression without significant loss in convergence rates and without significant memory or compute overhead.

2604.11950.tldr: AnyPoC, a general multi-agent framework that analyzes and fact-checks a candidate bug report, iteratively synthesizes and executes a PoC while collecting execution traces, and independently re-executes and scrutinizes the PoC to mitigate hallucination and reward hacking is presented.

2604.11969.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that explicit discourse modeling, combined with role-specific agent coordination, significantly improves the narrative flow and logical coherence of the generated presentations.

2604.11970.tldr: It is demonstrated that targeted fine-tuning can significantly enhance VLM performance on specialized document understanding tasks and underscore the importance of language-diverse, domain-specific datasets.

2604.11978.tldr: HORIZON is introduced, an initial cross-domain diagnostic benchmark for systematically constructing tasks and analyzing long-horizon failure behaviors in LLM-based agents and proposes a trajectory-grounded LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline for scalable and reproducible failure attribution.

2604.11996.tldr: The Filtered Reasoning Score (FRS) is introduced, which computes reasoning quality using only the top-K% most confident traces and suggests that FRS complements accuracy by capturing a model's transferable reasoning capabilities.

2604.11998.tldr: This report presents a detailed overview of the NTIRE 2026 CD-FSOD Challenge, including a summary of the submitted approaches and an analysis of the final results across all participating teams.

2604.12005.tldr: Competitiveness of the proposed meta-BO algorithm with existing approaches on function optimization tasks, while retaining strong performance in low task-relatedness regimes where test tasks share limited structure with the meta-training set is demonstrated.

2604.12007.tldr: It is proved that MW converges almost surely to the conditional success probability p+(m) = Pr[y_t = +1 | m in M_t] -- the probability of task success given that memory m is retrieved -- under a stationary retrieval regime with a minimum exploration condition.

2604.12016.tldr: Significant representational evidence is provided that agent identity documents induce attractor-like geometry in LLM activation space through semantic rather than structural reasons.

2604.12018.tldr: Most large language models, including GPT-4o, struggle with abstract meaning comprehension under zero-shot, one-shot, and few-shot settings, while fine-tuned models like BERT and RoBERTa perform better, according to SemEval-2021 Task 4 (ReCAM).

2604.12025.tldr: Evaluation across six ontologies, including the Plant Ontology (PO), Gene Ontology (GO), Semanticscience Integrated Ontology (SIO), Food Ontology (FoodON), Dublin Core (DC), and GoodRelations, demonstrates promising effectiveness.

2604.12028.tldr: A novel Curvelet-based detection approach that enhances feature quality through wedge-level attention and scale-aware spatial masking, both trained to selectively emphasize discriminative frequency components is introduced.

2604.12033.tldr: VLM-DeflectionBench is introduced, a benchmark of 2,775 samples spanning diverse multimodal retrieval settings, designed to probe model behaviour under conflicting or insufficient evidence, and serves as a reusable and extensible benchmark for reliable KB-VQA evaluation.

2604.12034.tldr: This paper proposes a companion-specific governance profile: a set of normative obligations, a time-structured procedural rule, and testable conformance invariants for the specific failure mode of entrenchment under user-coupled drift in single-user knowledge wikis built on the LLM wiki pattern.

2604.12040.tldr: This work presents SIR-Bench, a benchmark of 794 test cases for evaluating autonomous security incident response agents that distinguishes genuine forensic investigation from alert parroting, and introduces three complementary metrics: triage accuracy, novel finding discovery, and tool usage appropriateness.

2604.12044.tldr: VISTA is introduced, an online self-distillation framework that enforces consistency along the optimization trajectory, using a validation-informed Marginal Coverage score to identify expert anchors, which are earlier model states that retain specialized competence over distinct data regions.

2604.12049.tldr: The findings indicate that wSSAS reduces categorization entropy and provides a reproducible pathway for improving LLM based summaries based on a high-precision, deterministic process for large-scale text categorization.

2604.12060.tldr: This work introduces DEFT, a novel framework that adaptively generates high-level sequence features during tree construction and leverages large language models to propose biologically-informed features tailored to the local sequence distributions at each node and to iteratively refine them with a reflection mechanism.

2604.12066.tldr: A multi-agent teacher-in-the-loop system for personalizing middle school math problems finds that both teachers and students wanted to modify the fine-grained personalized elements of the real-world context of the problems, signaling issues with authenticity and fit.

2604.12075.tldr: OpenTME is introduced, an open-access dataset of pre-computed TME profiles derived from 3,634 H&E-stained whole-slide images across five cancer types from The Cancer Genome Atlas, which will serve as a resource for biomarker discovery, spatial biology research, and the development of computational methods for TME analysis.

2604.12081.tldr: This work proposes a context-selective, multimodal memory architecture for social robots that captures and retrieves both textual and visual episodic traces, prioritizing moments characterized by high emotional salience or scene novelty to enhance long-term, personalized human-robot interaction.

2604.12096.tldr: This work proposes LLM-HYPER, a novel framework that treats large language models as hypernetworks to directly generate the parameters of the click-through rate (CTR) estimator in a training-free manner, and introduces normalization and calibration techniques that align the generated weights with production-ready CTR distributions.

2604.12108.tldr: This work introduces Auto-Diagnose, a novel diagnosis tool that leverages LLMs to help developers efficiently determine the root cause of integration test failures and concludes that LLMs are highly successful in diagnosing integration test failures due to their capacity to process and summarize complex textual data.

2604.12113.tldr: PR-MaGIC (Prompt Refinement via Mask Decoder Gradient Flow for In-Context Segmentation), a training-free test-time framework that refines prompts via gradient flow derived from SAM's mask decoder, effectively mitigating inadequate prompts without requiring additional training or architectural modifications.

2604.12116.tldr: This study introduces an execution-layer be-havioral measurement approach based on a two-dimensional A-R space defined by Action Rate and Refusal Signal, with Divergence capturing coor-dination between the two.

2604.12126.tldr: This work introduces SLATE (Synthetic Large-scale API Toolkit for E-commerce), a large-scale context-aware benchmark designed for the automated assessment of tool-integrated agents, and proposes Entropy-Guided Branching (EGB), an uncertainty-aware search algorithm that dynamically expands decision branches where predictive entropy is high.

2604.12129.tldr: Aethon points toward a new class of AI infrastructure in which agents become lightweight, composable execution identities that can be spawned, specialized, and governed at scale, including layered inheritance and copy-on-write semantics.

2604.12133.tldr: This work provides both a foundational critique of linearized table encoders and the theoretical scaffolding for semantically stable, permutation invariant retrieval, charting a new direction for table reasoning in information systems.

2604.12137.tldr: Inferring and balancing a latent prognostic signal may reduce unobserved confounding and improve treatment-effect estimation from real-world data.

2604.12138.tldr: The results provide empirical evidence that treating subjectivity as a first-class citizen yields measurably more representative retrieval-a first step toward opinion-aware RAG, and includes joint optimization of retrieval and generation for distributional fidelity.

2604.12152.tldr: Results provide a practical screening criterion: autoencoder reconstruction quality, measurable without diffusion training, predicts downstream SR performance (R^2 = 0.67), suggesting that domain-specific VAE selection should precede diffusion architecture search.

2604.12161.tldr: A manual AI-based workflow to generate patient summaries to display live at the Stanford Thoracic Tumor board was developed and several automated AI chart summarization methods were evaluated against physician gold standard summaries and fact-based scoring rubrics.

2604.12168.tldr: This extensive work integrates the Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) based Lattice-based Homomorphic Encryption (HE) main functions in the LLM's inference pipeline to secure some of its layers against data privacy attacks.

2604.12176.tldr: This work identifies a regime of higher-arity reasoning in which current models struggle, and introduces REL, a generative benchmark framework spanning algebra, chemistry, and biology that varies RC within each domain.

2604.12177.tldr: This work introduces Sentinel, an enforcement framework based on counterfactual graph simulation that treats every agent action as a proposed mutation to an organizational knowledge graph, performs speculative execution to materialize the post-action world state, and verifies graph-structural invariants to decide Allow/Block/Clarify.

2604.12180.tldr: CycloneMAE is presented, a scalable multi-task forecasting model that learns transferable TC representations from multi-modal data using a TC structure-aware masked autoencoder and establishes a scalable, probabilistic, and interpretable pathway for operational TC forecasting.

2604.12183.tldr: Results suggest that the proposed clustering-enhanced domain adaptation method for industrial control traffic effectively alleviates data scarcity and domain shift, providing a practical solution for robust cross-domain intrusion detection in dynamic industrial environments.

2604.12184.tldr: Although supervised encoders remain stronger on raw metrics, TRUST Agents improves interpretability, evidence transparency, and reasoning over compound claims.

2604.12190.tldr: It is found that users with differing levels of technical sophistication employ and share a wide range of primary resources facilitating SNCII content creation as well as numerous secondary resources facilitating dissemination; and that knowledge transfer between experts and newcomers facilitates propagation of these illicit resources.

2604.12191.tldr: A principled framework for fine-grained assessment of abilities, with potential applications in targeted training, ability-guided model selection, and ability-aware benchmark design is established.

2604.12198.tldr: This work focuses on the smallest meaningful unit of machine-learning research, a mini research loop in which an agent reads a paper, reproduces it, critiques it, and extends it, and test this loop in two complementary regimes: scale and depth.

2604.12208.tldr: The Sequential Navigation Guidance (SNG) framework is proposed, an efficient representation of global navigation information based on real-world navigation patterns that achieves state-of-the-art performance through precise navigation information modeling without requiring auxiliary loss functions from perception tasks.

2604.12219.tldr: Precision-Allocated Sparse Attention (PASA), a training-free framework designed for highly efficient and temporally smooth video generation, implements a curvature-aware dynamic budgeting mechanism and incorporates a stochastic selection bias into the attention routing mechanism.

2604.12223.tldr: This work proposes a semantic bootstrapping framework that transfers LLM knowledge into symbolic form, combining interpretability with semantic capacity, and improves interpretability and accuracy over vanilla TM, achieving performance comparable to BERT while remaining fully symbolic and efficient.

2604.12227.tldr: It is indicated that reliable AI-assisted scoring depends primarily on clear, well-structured rubrics, while prompting format plays a secondary role and temperature has relatively limited impact.

2604.12229.tldr: This work introduces a hint-assisted reasoning framework that incrementally guides SLMs through multi-step mathematical problem solving and provides context-aware hints, where hints are generated by a separate SLM trained via distillation from a strong large language model.

2604.12232.tldr: TEMPLATEFUZZ is introduced, a fine-grained fuzzing framework that systematically exposes vulnerabilities in chat templates, a critical yet underexplored attack surface in LLMs.

2604.12237.tldr: MolMem is presented, a multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) framework with a dual-memory system that uses Static Exemplar Memory to retrieve relevant exemplars for cold-start grounding, and Evolving Skill Memory to distill successful trajectories into reusable strategies.

2604.12243.tldr: These findings suggest that the character of generated hypotheses is shaped not only by how much literature is processed, but also by how it is processed, and indicate that evaluation frameworks must account for the quality-coverage trade-off rather than optimize for a single metric.

2604.12245.tldr: This paper proposes Socrates Loss, a novel, unified loss function that explicitly leverages uncertainty by incorporating an auxiliary unknown class, whose predictions directly influence the loss function and a dynamic uncertainty penalty, and provides theoretical guarantees that the method regularizes the model to prevent miscalibration and overfitting.

2604.12247.tldr: A novel self-draft framework that suppresses spurious confidence via layer-wise temperature annealing in early-exit decision and adaptively bounds speculation length based on token-wise decoding difficulty is proposed, which achieves up to 2.33x wall-time speedup over standard autoregressive decoding across diverse long-form generation tasks and multiple model architectures.

2604.12250.tldr: The results suggest that model-specific characteristics of LLMs, potentially including alignment, play a fundamental role in determining emergent social behavior in Generative Agent-Based Modeling, and provide a micro-level cognitive account of the contradictions found in prior work on memory and cooperation.

2604.12253.tldr: This scoping review provides researchers and practitioners with a comprehensive understanding of LLM-based pedagogical agents while identifying crucial areas for future development in this rapidly evolving field.

2604.12255.tldr: ARGen, an Affect-Reinforced Generative Augmentation Framework that enables data-adaptive dynamic expression generation for robust emotion perception, is proposed, establishing an interpretable and generalizable generative augmentation paradigm for vision-based affective computing.

2604.12262.tldr: Cascaded LLM systems coordinate models of varying sizes with human experts to balance accuracy, cost, and abstention under uncertainty, but single-model tiers at each stage often struggle with ambiguous queries, triggering premature escalations to costlier models or experts due to under-confidence and inefficient compute scaling.

2604.12281.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAST effectively mitigates boundary artifacts and maintains structural consistency, preserving texture fidelity and spatial coherence even as the number of applied styles increases.

2604.12285.tldr: GAM is proposed, a hierarchical Graph-based Agentic Memory framework that explicitly decouples memory encoding from consolidation to effectively resolve the conflict between rapid context perception and stable knowledge retention.

2604.12301.tldr: The headline finding is that T1 (local routing) combined with T2 (prompt compression) achieves 45-79% cloud token savings on edit-heavy and explanation-heavy workloads, while on RAG-heavy workloads the full tactic set including T4 (draft-review) achieves 51% savings.

2604.12325.tldr: OptBias is proposed, a meta-learning framework that directly tackles data scarcity that learns a reusable optimization bias by training on synthetic tasks generated from a Gaussian process, and then fine-tunes the surrogate model on the small data for the target task.

2604.12336.tldr: GeM-EA, a Generative and Meta-learning Enhanced Evolutionary Algorithm for SDDO that unifies meta-learned surrogate adaptation with generative replay for effective evolutionary search is proposed.

2604.12344.tldr: This work introduces FRTSearch, an end-to-end framework unifying the detection and physical characterization of Fast Radio Transients (FRTs), and provides a scalable, high-precision solution for real-time discovery in the era of petabyte-scale radio astronomy.

2604.12350.tldr: Scaffold-Conditioned Preference Triplets is introduced, a pipeline that constructs similarity-constrained triplets via scaffold alignment and chemistry-driven filters for validity, synthesizability, and meaningful property gains, and provides controllable data-construction knobs that yield a predictable similarity-gain frontier.

2604.12352.tldr: MultiDocFusion is introduced, a multimodal chunking pipeline that integrates: detection of document regions using vision-based document parsing, text extraction from these regions via OCR, reconstruction of document structure into a hierarchical tree using large language model (LLM)-based document section hierarchical parsing, and construction of hierarchical chunks through DFS-based grouping.

2604.12357.tldr: Reflective Note-Guided Captioning (ReflectCAP), where a multi-agent pipeline analyzes what the target large vision-language model consistently hallucinates and what it systematically overlooks, distilling these patterns into reusable guidelines called Structured Reflection Notes, makes high-quality detailed captioning viable under real-world cost and latency constraints.

2604.12374.tldr: Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 family to be pre-trained in NVFP4, leverage LatentMoE, a new Mixture-of-Experts architecture that optimizes for both accuracy per FLOP and accuracy per parameter, and include MTP layers for inference acceleration through native speculative decoding.

2604.12376.tldr: This work proposes cooperative paging: evicted segments are replaced with minimal keyword bookmarks, and the model is given a recall() tool to retrieve full content on demand, achieving the highest answer quality among six methods on the LoCoMo benchmark.

2604.12377.tldr: SCRIPT is a model-agnostic module that injects subcharacter compositional knowledge into Korean PLMs and enhances all baselines across various Korean natural language understanding (NLU) and generation (NLG) tasks.

2604.12379.tldr: This work introduces CodeRQ-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning quality across three coding task categories: generation, summarization, and classification, and proposes VERA, a two-stage evaluator that combines evidence-grounded verification with ambiguity-aware score correction.

2604.12384.tldr: This paper proposes Coupled Weight and Activation Constraints (CWAC), a novel approach that simultaneously enforces a precomputed safety subspace on weight updates and applies targeted regularization to safety-critical features identified by sparse autoencoders.

2604.12391.tldr: This approach fundamentally differs from existing acceleration methods in its core motivation: rather than optimizing each model individually, CoM-PT is designed to accelerate the training pipeline at the model family level, scaling efficiently as the model family expands.

2604.12408.tldr: This chapter presents novel design techniques to strengthen the security and resilience of AVs, and presents an AV Resilient architecture that integrates redundancy, diversity, and adaptive reconfiguration strategies, supported by anomaly- and hash-based intrusion detection techniques.

2604.12418.tldr: A Resilient Autonomous Car Framework (RACF) is presented that incorporates an Object Distance Correction Algorithm (ODCA) to improve perception-layer robustness through redundancy and diversity across a depth camera, LiDAR, and physics-based kinematics.

2604.12424.tldr: Decoding by Perturbation is proposed, a training-free framework mitigating prior-induced hallucinations via controlled textual interventions that effectively reduces hallucinations and achieves superior performance across multiple benchmarks.

2604.12440.tldr: IAD-Unify is proposed, a dual-encoder unified framework in which a frozen DINOv2-based region expert supplies precise anomaly evidence to a shared Qwen3.5-4B vision-language backbone via lightweight token injection, jointly enabling anomaly segmentation, region-grounded understanding, and mask-guided generation.

2604.12459.tldr: This work introduces a lightweight sequential unlearning framework that explicitly separates retention and suppression objectives, and positions sequential unlearning as a practical and reproducible mechanism for operationalising data erasure requirements in politically deployed LLMs.

2604.12460.tldr: The conditions under which distinct k-RFPs induce identical kcovers are formally characterized, providing theoretical foundations for redundancy detection, and an optimization strategy is proposed that removes redundant patterns by retaining a single representative pattern for each distinct k-cover.

2604.12461.tldr: This paper proposes Communication Inference Attack (CIA), a novel attack that constructs new adversarial queries to induce intermediate agents' outputs and models their semantic correlations through the proposed global bias disentanglement and LLM-guided weak supervision.

2604.12463.tldr: The Euler-inspired Decoupling Neural Operator (EDNO), a physics-inspired framework that redefines pansharpening as a continuous functional mapping in the frequency domain, and develops the Euler Feature Interaction Layer (EFIL), which decouples the fusion task into two specialized modules.

2604.12470.tldr: The proposed fully automated, video-based vehicle counting framework outperforms existing techniques, especially in complex multi-road scenarios, demonstrating robustness and superior accuracy and making it a promising solution for real-time traffic monitoring.

2604.12477.tldr: This paper systematically compares six elicitation task types across two commercial LLMs (GPT-4o Mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash) and finds GPT-4o Mini extracts 6-41 times more usable target-language words per API call than Gemini.

2604.12480.tldr: The proposed nonnegative tensor factorization method provides better separation quality with respect to other comparable algorithms and can be controlled by tuning the value of <inline-formula><tex-math notation="LaTeX">$\beta$</tex- math></inline- formula>.

2604.12483.tldr: The optimization of the resolution of time-frequency atoms and the regularization of fitting models to obtain better representations of heart sound signals is proposed and a fitting model is obtained based on a heart sound signal and an overcomplete dictionary of Gabor atoms using elastic net regularization of linear models.

2604.12487.tldr: KG-Reasoner is introduced, an end-to-end framework that integrates multi-step reasoning into a unified"thinking"phase of a Reasoning LLM, and is trained to internalize the KG traversal process, enabling it to dynamically explore reasoning paths, and perform backtracking when necessary.
