2604.12490.tldr: This paper argues that deepfakes are wrong when they usurp the authors' authority to determine the provenance of their own agency by exploiting their biometric features as a generative resource and has a specific right against the algorithmic conscription of their identity.

2604.12493.tldr: A framework for measuring planning and mechanistic evidence of how models'planning abilities grow with scale are offered.

2604.12498.tldr: This work assembled an internal study corpus of 582,683 chemistry-specific full-text research articles with structured full text, token-aware paragraph chunks, paragraph-level embeddings generated with the intfloat/e5-large-v2 model, and record-level metadata including abstracts and licensing information.

2604.12502.tldr: This work introduces SEATrack, a Simple, Efficient, and Adaptive two-stream multimodal tracker that tackles this performance-efficiency dilemma from two complementary perspectives, and introduces a Hierarchical Mixture of Experts (HMoE) that enables efficient global relation modeling, effectively balancing expressiveness and computational efficiency in cross-modal fusion.

2604.12503.tldr: A novel graph-based soft prompting framework that shifts the reasoning paradigm from node-level path traversal to subgraph-level reasoning, enabling LLM to reason over richer structural context and identify relevant entities beyond immediate graph neighbors, thereby reducing sensitivity to missing edges.

2604.12512.tldr: An overview of the NTIRE 2026 challenge is presented, establishing a novel benchmark exploring the ability of MLLMs to mimic human expert cognition in evaluating high-quality image pairs, and identifying the visually superior image within a high-quality pair.

2604.12526.tldr: This work constrains each new LoRA update during training so that it lies in the orthogonal complement of the subspaces used by earlier unlearning tasks, which preserves task isolation without requiring dynamic routing at deployment.

2604.12534.tldr: This work introduces a comprehensive framework for FOL argument similarity, built upon an extended axiomatic foundation, a four-level parametric model covering predicates, literals, clauses, and formulae similarity, and formal constraints enforcing desirable properties.

2604.12537.tldr: MODIX (Multimodal Information-Driven Positional IndeX Scaling), a training-free framework that dynamically adapts positional strides based on modality-specific contributions, consistently improves multimodal reasoning and adaptively reallocates attention according to task-dependent information distributions, suggesting that positional encoding should be treated as an adaptive resource in Transformers for multimodal sequence modeling.

2604.12540.tldr: These findings challenge the assumption that LLM generation quality predicts augmentation success, and provide actionable guidance: data augmentation should be treated as a task-specific intervention rather than a universally beneficial preprocessing step.

2604.12543.tldr: A Two-Stage LLM Meta-Verification Framework that consists of an Explainer LLM that converts raw XAI outputs into natural-language narratives, a Verifier LLM that assesses them in terms of faithfulness, coherence, completeness, and hallucination risk, and an iterative refeed mechanism that uses the Verifier's feedback to refine and improve them.

2604.12545.tldr: This work proposes an evaluation framework for assessing LLMs' emotional responses to red tape across diverse cultural contexts and introduces \textbf{RAMO}, an interactive interface for simulating citizens' emotional responses to red tape and for collecting human data to improve models.

2604.12573.tldr: Experiments show IDEA with Qwen-3-32B (78.6%) outperforms DeepSeek R1 (68.1%) and GPT-5.2 (77.9%), achieving perfect factor exclusion and exact calibration -- precision unattainable through prompting alone.

2604.12596.tldr: This is the first time a few-shot foundation model has been shown to surpass supervised approaches on common benchmark tasks, with performance further improving upon fine-tuning.

2604.12601.tldr: LLM-driven evolutionary computation is applied to automatically optimize prompts for the LLM password guessing framework to strengthen LLM-based password auditing and underlining how attack pipelines show tendency via automated improvements.

2604.12615.tldr: This report summarizes the results of the first edition of the Large Language Model (LLM) Testing competition, held as part of the DeepTest workshop at ICSE 2026, with the objective of identifying user inputs for which the system fails to appropriately mention warnings contained in the manual.

2604.12616.tldr: This work introduces MemJack, aory-augmented multi-agent framework that explicitly leverages visual semantics to orchestrate automated jailbreak attacks, and maintains highly coherent extended multi-turn jailbreak attack interactions across different images, thereby improving the attack success rate (ASR) on new images.

2604.12622.tldr: MMSD achieves lower payload size than the recent SPIC baseline while preserving strong semantic consistency, whereas SAMR provides a better quality-compression trade-off than standard JPEG and SQ-GAN under comparable operating conditions.

2604.12625.tldr: This work proposes Neural Dynamic GI (NDGI), a novel compression technique specifically designed for temporal lightmap sets that achieves high-quality dynamic GI while maintaining remarkably low storage and memory requirements, with only modest real-time decompression overhead.

2604.12627.tldr: This work proposes \textbf{KnowRL} (Knowledge-Guided Reinforcement Learning), an RL training framework that treats hint design as a minimal-sufficient guidance problem and identifies a pruning interaction paradox and explicitly optimize for robust subset curation under this dependency structure.

2604.12632.tldr: Calibration-Aware Policy Optimization (CAPO) adopts a logistic AUC surrogate loss that is theoretically consistent and admits regret bound, enabling uncertainty-aware advantage estimation and achieves a Pareto-optimal precision-coverage trade-off.

2604.12634.tldr: The viability of Predict-Answer/Act and Reason-Predict-Reason-Answer/Act paradigms where models predict -- prior to responding -- how an LLM judge would score their output is investigated, suggesting that models can learn to predict their own performance limitations, paving the way for more efficient and self-aware AI systems.

2604.12645.tldr: A contextual multi-task reinforcement learning paradigm is proposed, allowing us to learn controllers that can be reused for various tasks, e.g., detecting oysters in one reef and detecting corals in another, to take a step towards more sustainable procedures in autonomous reef monitoring.

2604.12648.tldr: TimeSAF is a new framework based on hierarchical asynchronous fusion that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and further exhibits strong generalization in both few-shot and zero-shot transfer settings.

2604.12651.tldr: RALP improves state-of-the-art KGE models by over 5% MRR across datasets and enhances generalization via high-quality inferred triples, and highlights prompt-based LLM reasoning as a flexible alternative to embedding-based methods.

2604.12660.tldr: A generalization of safe conditional syntax splittings that broadens the applicability of splitting postulates is proposed, and it is shown that, while every inductive inference operator satisfying generalized conditional syntax splitting also satisfies conditional syntax splitting, the reverse does not hold.

2604.12663.tldr: The Human-centric Topic Modeling (GCTM-OT) is introduced, a novel task formulation that integrates a human-provided goal directly into the topic modeling process to produce interpretable, diverse and goal-oriented topics.

2604.12686.tldr: Bi-Directional Low-Rank Adaptation (BID-LoRA), a novel framework featuring three dedicated adapter pathways-retain, new, and unlearn applied to attention layers, combined with escape unlearning that pushes forget-class embeddings to positions maximally distant from retained knowledge, updating only 5% of parameters.

2604.12700.tldr: This work introduces MISID, a comprehensive multimodal, multi-turn, and multi-participant benchmark for intent recognition, and proposes FRACTAM, a baseline framework that enhances mainstream models' performance in complex strategic tasks, improving hidden intent detection and inference while maintaining robust perceptual accuracy.

2604.12709.tldr: This work formalizes the task-adapted CS-MRI optimization problem by maximizing the mutual information between undersampled k-space measurements and clinical tasks to enable probabilistic inference for addressing the uncertainty problem and leverage amortized optimization and tractable variational bounds for mutual information to jointly optimize sampling, reconstruction, and task-inference models.

2604.12717.tldr: A case-based learning framework that converts experience from past tasks into reusable knowledge assets, allowing agents to transfer prior case experience to new tasks and perform more structured analysis, to suggest that case-based learning offers a promising path for building professional agents for real-world work.

2604.12743.tldr: There was a small negative correlation between whether a given AI tool was able to correctly classify the cognitive demand of tasks and whether the AI was able to upgrade tasks, showing that the ability to modify tasks represents a distinct capability from the ability to classify them.

2604.12757.tldr: The GF-Score (GREAT-Fairness Score) is introduced, a framework that decomposes the certified GREAT Score into per-class robustness profiles and quantifies their disparity through four metrics grounded in welfare economics: the Robustness Disparity Index (RDI), the Normalized Robustness Gini Coefficient (NRGC), Worst-Case Class Robustness (WCR), and a Fairness-Penalized GREAT Score (FP-GREAT).

2604.12767.tldr: CLASP is proposed, a plug-and-play token reduction framework based on class-adaptive layer fusion and dual-stage pruning that consistently outperforms existing methods across a wide range of benchmarks, pruning ratios, and MLLM architectures.

2604.12777.tldr: Extensive experiments on challenging in-the-wild benchmarks validate the cognition-centric approach, demonstrating that emulating the brain's strategies for emotion processing yields state-of-the-art performance and enhances model interpretability.

2604.12778.tldr: The DoseRAD2026 dataset and challenge provide a public benchmark of paired CT and MRI data with beam-level photon and proton Monte Carlo dose distributions for developing and evaluating advanced dose calculation methods.

2604.12780.tldr: Criticality-Aware Adversarial Training (CAAT), a novel method that adaptively allocates resources to the most robustness-critical parameters, fine-tuning only selected modules, is introduced, which outperforms state-of-the-art lightweight AT methods with fewer trainable parameters.

2604.12782.tldr: A token-persistent structural clustering effect, where high-magnitude outliers consistently occupy fixed channels across tokens across tokens is demonstrated and OSC, a hardware-efficient framework for outlier suppression, is proposed.

2604.12798.tldr: This paper revisits FlashAttention and proposes Vector Relieved Flash Attention (VFA), a hardware-friendly method that reduces rowmax-driven updates of the running maximum while retaining the online-softmax structure and integrates VFA with block-sparse skipping methods such as BLASST to form Vector Relieved Sparse Attention (VSA), which reduces both block count and per-block overhead.

2604.12811.tldr: This work proves geometric convergence of asynchronous retrieval dynamics, which implies $O(\log N)$ convergence time once the trajectory enters the basin of attraction, and develops an algorithmic analysis of DAM retrieval dynamics that yields finite-size guarantees under explicit, verifiable pattern conditions.

2604.12820.tldr: This work proposes RePAIR, a prompt-aware model repair framework comprising a watchdog model for unlearning intent detection, a surgeon model for generating repair procedures, and a patient model whose parameters are updated autonomously, and develops Steering Through Activation Manipulation with PseudoInverse with PseudoInverse (STAMP), a training-free, single-sample unlearning method.

2604.12832.tldr: The robustness of deep learning models to such errors in echocardiography (echo) segmentation is examined and a novel strategy for detecting and refurbishing erroneous labels during model training is evaluated.

2604.12857.tldr: This survey analyzes how existing simulation platforms fall short of the needs of mixed autonomy research and outlines directions to narrow this gap and introduces a taxonomy that organizes methods into three families: agent-level behavior models, environment-level simulation methods, and cognitive and physics-informed methods.

2604.12874.tldr: This paper proposes LIFE, a reasoning and Learning framework that is Incremental, Flexible, and Energy efficient that is implemented as an agent centric system rather than a single monolithic model.

2604.12879.tldr: This work proposes a learning-based framework that integrates grasp guidance, whole-body control, and tactile feedback for mobile fast grasping, achieving robust manipulation across diverse object geometries through effective sim-to-real transfer.

2604.12898.tldr: BEAM's exterior layer evolves high-level algorithmic structures with function placeholders through genetic algorithm (GA), while the interior layer realizes these placeholders via Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to facilitate complex code generation.

2604.12911.tldr: This work proposes a simple alternative: evaluate multilingual capability via round-trip translation, and introduces Lost in Translation (LiT), a challenging round-trip translation benchmark spanning widely spoken languages worldwide, for realistic evaluation of multilingual frontier models.

2604.12913.tldr: E evaluation on the HumanEval-Decompile benchmark demonstrates that CoDe-R (using a 1.3B backbone) establishes a new State-of-the-Art (SOTA) in the lightweight regime, and is the first 1.3B model to exceed an Average Re-executability Rate of 50.00%, significantly outperforming the baseline and effectively bridging the gap between efficient models and expert-level performance.

2604.12944.tldr: This survey presents a comprehensive analysis of hallucinations in Vid-LLMs and introduces a systematic taxonomy that categorizes them into two core types: dynamic distortion and content fabrication, each comprising two subtypes with representative cases.

2604.12948.tldr: Token analysis shows dual-trace encoding achieves this gain at no additional cost for single-session retrieval, consistent with encoding specificity theory [8].

2604.12986.tldr: This paper argues that prompt-based safety is architecturally insufficient for agents with execution capability and introduces Parallax, a paradigm for safe autonomous AI execution grounded in four principles: Cognitive-Executive Separation, which structurally prevents the reasoning system from executing actions; Adversarial Validation with Graduated Determinism, which interposes an independent, multi-tiered validator between reasoning and execution.

2604.12988.tldr: ROSE is introduced, an intent-centered metric that focuses on whether the predicted SQL answers the question, rather than consistency with the ground-truth SQL under the reference-dependent paradigm, and is outperforming the next-best metric by nearly 24% in Cohen's Kappa.

2604.13010.tldr: Lightning OPD is proposed, an offline on-policy distillation framework that enforces teacher consistency by precomputing teacher log-probabilities over SFT rollouts and shares the same optimum as standard OPD, with bounded gradient discrepancy and an implicit regularization effect that helps prevent policy drift.

2604.13013.tldr: The strong correlation (though not universal) observed between the surrogate objective and the complete cost justifies the use of the surrogate objective while still necessitating a joint solution of both levels, thereby validating the effectiveness of the proposed bilevel framework and highlighting its potential for efficiently solving large-scale routing problems with a hierarchical structure.

2604.13017.tldr: This work introduces PAL (Personal Adaptive Learner), an AI-powered platform that transforms lecture videos into interactive learning experiences and contributes a novel framework for responsive digital learning.

2604.13021.tldr: The first study of vision-language transfer learning on abdominal CT enterography provides the first baselines for this underexplored modality and offers practical guidance for building vision-language systems for volumetric medical imaging.

2604.13029.tldr: Results show that visual preference optimization benefits from combining on-policy data construction with instance-specific criterion-level feedback, and show that rDPO achieves 61.01, markedly outperforming the style-constrained baseline and surpassing the 59.48 base model.

2406.14429.tldr: This work introduces a novel approach for distributed collaborative diffusion models inspired by split learning, which facilitates collaborative training of diffusion models while alleviating client computational burdens during image synthesis.

2502.08597.tldr: The relationship between the notions of survival and market dominance studied in economics and the framework of regret minimization are formally established, thus bridging these theories.

2508.07630.tldr: This work introduces InterChart, a diagnostic benchmark that evaluates how well vision-language models (VLMs) reason across multiple related charts, a task central to real-world applications such as scientific reporting, financial analysis, and public policy dashboards.

2506.11991.tldr: Experiments show that VGR achieves superior performance on multi-modal benchmarks requiring comprehensive image detail understanding, and uses only 30\% of the image token count while delivering scores of +4.1 on MMStar, +7.1 on AI2D, and a +12.9 improvement on ChartQA.

2505.22003.tldr: The model was fine-tuned on extensive datasets from the Indian legal domain, including Indian Constitution, Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) and so forth, providing a robust understanding of the complexities of Indian law.

2510.00072.tldr: This work introduces Geo-R1, a reasoning-centric post-training framework that unlocks geospatial reasoning in vision-language models by combining thinking scaffolding and elevating, and achieves state-of-the-art performance across various geospatial reasoning benchmarks.

2506.18315.tldr: This paper introduces Property-Generated Solver, a novel framework that leverages Property-Based Testing (PBT) to validate high-level program properties or invariants, instead of relying on specific input-output examples.

2506.13015.tldr: A novel approach that leverages differential geometry, particularly concepts from Riemannian geometry, to integrate multiple models into a unified transfer learning framework, namely Geometric Embedding Alignment via cuRvature matching in transfer learning (GEAR), which ensures comprehensive geometric representation across datapoints.

2507.14201.tldr: ExCyTIn-Bench is presented, the first benchmark to Evaluate an LLM agent x on the task of Cyber Threat Investigation through security questions derived from investigation graphs, and comprehensive experiments with different models confirm the difficulty of the task.

2507.01955.tldr: Standard vision tasks are translated into equivalent text-promptable and API-compatible tasks via prompt chaining to create a standardized benchmarking framework and observe that the models are not close to the state-of-the-art specialist models at any task.

2505.23875.tldr: RelSC, a new graph-regression dataset built from program graphs that combine syntactic and semantic information extracted from source code, is introduced, revealing consistent performance differences between the homogeneous and multi-relational settings, emphasising the importance of structural representation.

2505.23723.tldr: A novel agentic ML training framework with three key components, which enables LLM agents to generate diverse actions for enhanced RL exploration and an agentic ML-specific reward module, which unifies varied ML feedback signals into consistent rewards for RL optimization is proposed.

2411.17429.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art rewiring approaches, delving into their theoretical underpinnings, practical implementations, and performance trade-offs.

2210.15304.tldr: A systematic experimental study tests 12 explainers on eight representative message-passing architectures trained on six carefully designed graph and node classification datasets to provide key insights on the choice and applicability of GNN explainers.

2506.00166.tldr: DSA presents a promising path towards more modular, efficient, and adaptable AI safety and alignment, boosting safety on StrongReject by 93% while maintaining 98% performance on MTBench -- a total reduction in alignment tax of 8 percentage points compared to standard safety alignment fine-tuning.

2505.10887.tldr: This paper introduces InfantAgent-Next, a generalist agent capable of interacting with computers in a multimodal manner, encompassing text, images, audio, and video, that integrates tool-based and pure vision agents within a highly modular architecture.

2412.02125.tldr: Preference Goal Tuning enhances the performance of agents across nearly all tasks in the Minecraft Skillforge benchmark and demonstrates robustness to the execution environment.

2408.11513.tldr: The proposed Primal-Dual based Regularized Accelerated Natural Policy Gradient (PDR-ANPG) algorithm uses entropy and quadratic regularizers to reach this goal, a significant improvement of the state-of-the-art last-iterate guarantees of general parameterized CMDPs.

2405.00892.tldr: This work presents a novel automated pipeline for generating binary classification datasets that addresses this critical gap through several algorithmic innovations: intelligent multi-source label fusion, confidence-aware filtering, automated label correction, and systematic fine-grained benchmark generation.

2403.02290.tldr: This paper explores the connection between the data-driven Koopman operator and Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), resulting in the development of two new RL algorithms to address limitations of the Bellman equation.

2508.12232.tldr: LinkAnchor is the first autonomous LLM-based agent designed for issue-to-commit link recovery and outperforms state-of-the-art issue-to-commit link recovery approaches by 60-262% in Hit@1 score across all the authors' case study projects.

2504.10368.tldr: S1-Bench is introduced, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the performance of Large Reasoning Models on simple tasks that favor intuitive system 1 thinking rather than deliberative system 2 reasoning, and paves the way toward dual-system compatibility in the development of LRMs.

2508.19932.tldr: CAS (Conversational Agent for Scam Elucidation) is presented, a novel Agentic AI framework that addresses this problem by collecting and managing user scam feedback in a safe and scalable manner and is a blueprint for building similar AI-driven systems to collect and manage scam intelligence in other sensitive domains.

2501.00885.tldr: It is argued that LLM behavior is partially driven by representation-based information processing, and then a series of practical techniques for investigating these representations and developing explanations on their basis are described and defended.

2604.27977.tldr: D3-Gym, the first automatically constructed dataset with verifiable environments for scientific Data-Driven Discovery, is introduced, the first automatically constructed dataset with verifiable environments representing real-world scientific tasks.

2604.27077.tldr: Through extensive empirical validation, it is found that the novel nGPT parameterization, called $\nu$GPT exhibits learning rate transfer across width, depth, and token horizon.

2604.26173.tldr: It is observed that high-entropy tokens tend to cluster into consecutive groups during inference, providing a more stable notion of model uncertainty than individual tokens, and this work proposes the Lowest Centroid method, which selects the response with the lowest entropy centroid among multiple candidates.

2604.24920.tldr: From ASU, a security-property taxonomy is derived that separates the problem's structural obligations from the realization-level robustness conditions any concrete construction must establish, enabling principled comparison of existing agentic-secret defenses against a problem-grounded specification.

2604.17465.tldr: Because dropout has been used as a training-regularization technique, while Gaussian noise is sometimes added during inference, the possibility of a data-agnostic ``training awareness''signal and the implications for AI safety are discussed.

2603.15988.tldr: A three-stage framework that leverages unlabeled dysarthric speech and large-scale typical speech datasets to scale training and significantly outperforms SOTA DSQA predictors such as SpICE and the full framework achieves an average SRCC of 0.761 across unseen test datasets.

2602.13305.tldr: The WildfireVLM system is deployed using a service-oriented architecture that supports real-time processing, visual risk dashboards, and long-term wildfire tracking, demonstrating the value of combining computer vision with language-based reasoning for scalable wildfire monitoring.

2604.04385.tldr: This paper localizes the policy routing mechanism in alignment-trained language models by injecting the plaintext gate activation into the cipher forward pass and restoring 48% of refusals in Phi-4-mini, localizing the bypass to the routing interface.

2604.28158.tldr: Intern-Atlas is introduced, a methodological evolution graph that automatically identifies method-level entities, infers lineage relationships among methodologies, and captures the bottlenecks that drive transitions between successive innovations, and enables downstream applications in idea evaluation and automated idea generation.

2604.28139.tldr: Claw-Eval-Live is introduced, a live benchmark for workflow agents that separates a refreshable signal layer, updated across releases from public workflow-demand signals, from a reproducible, time-stamped release snapshot and suggests that workflow-agent evaluation should be grounded twice, in fresh external demand and in verifiable agent action.

2604.28075.tldr: The experiments indicate that the German language models achieve state-of-the-art results despite training on 10-360x fewer tokens than comparable models, and suggest that semantic concentration through quality filtering offers a more viable path to efficient language modeling than simply maximizing unique data volume.

2604.28031.tldr: It is found that iterative pressure reliably increases structural complexity and often reduces adherence to original constraints in multi-turn LLM-assisted scientific ideation.

2604.27807.tldr: This paper explores emerging methodologies, architectures, and frameworks for designing dependable autonomous and embedded systems in the era of AI, highlighting advances in reliability modeling, secure system design, and certification approaches that account for imperfect, learning-enabled components.

2604.27209.tldr: Comet-H is proposed, an iterative prompt automaton that orchestrates ideation, implementation, evaluation, grounding, and paper-writing as coupled coordinates of a single workspace state and identifies two LM-specific failure modes: hallucination accumulation and desynchronization.

2604.27906.tldr: This paper presents an iterative, schema-aware write path that decomposes memory ingestion into object detection, field detection, and field-value extraction, with validation gates, local retries, and stateful prompt control, and shows that architecture matters more than retrieval scale or model strength alone.

2604.18239.tldr: A plug-and-play \emph{reward calibration} (RC) that adaptively rebalances chosen versus rejected updates to satisfy the DB and mitigate likelihood displacement, without redesigning the base objective is proposed.

2603.14259.tldr: GenRecEdit explicitly models the relationship between the full sequence context and next-token generation, adopts iterative token-level editing to inject multi-token item representations, and introduces a one-to-one trigger mechanism to reduce interference among multiple edits during inference.

2604.27855.tldr: The results show that latency relaxation expands feasible geography, while migration frictions, egress costs, state locality, legal constraints, and capacity limits can sharply reduce realized benefits.

2604.17450.tldr: Semantic Gradient Descent is proposed, a teacher-student framework that compiles agentic workflows into discrete execution plans comprising DAG topologies, system prompts, and deterministic executable code that treats placement of deterministic code as a trace-driven, per-node optimisation target, generalising the whole-problem offloading of PAL and PoT.

2605.00185.tldr: This work formally analyzes the interaction between these two sources of bias and cast the solution as identifying a group-imbalance-agnostic barycenter of the predictive information that induces similar representations across all subgroups, and shows that group fairness concerns can be reduced.

2605.00113.tldr: NDBench is proposed, a 576-output benchmark involving two frontier models, three system prompt types, four canonical ND profiles, and four canonical ND profiles, and 24 prompts across four categories, one of which involves an adversarial masking strategy.

2605.00111.tldr: The proposed framework treats intermediate-domain learning as a dynamically regulated process, where feature mixing and regularization strength are adaptively controlled using feedback signals derived from model uncertainty and training stability.

2605.00068.tldr: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization (HL-MBO), a framework that integrates expert knowledge with few-shot, uncertainty-aware machine learning to accelerate discovery in data-scarce, high-stakes scientific domains, is presented.

2605.00271.tldr: This work proposes REALM, a cross-modal framework that learns an RGB and Event Aligned Latent Manifold by projecting event representations into the pretrained latent space of RGB foundation models, and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in wide-baseline feature matching, significantly outperforming specialized architectures.

2605.00270.tldr: This study demonstrates the efficacy of coupling neural semantic extraction with formal solvers to enforce logical soundness and explainability in the aggregation of noisy human reasoning.

2605.00257.tldr: CA-ThinkFlow is presented as a parameter-efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework which operates with a 14B, 4-bit-quantized reasoning model, 14B-DeepSeek-R1, and a layout-aware Docling extraction system which maintains document structure during extraction.

2605.00224.tldr: TUR-DPO is proposed, a topology- and uncertainty-aware variant of DPO that rewards how answers are derived, not only what they say, by eliciting lightweight reasoning topologies and combining semantic faithfulness, utility, and topology quality into a calibrated uncertainty signal.

2605.00123.tldr: LOCA, a method that gives Local, CAusal explanations of jailbreak success by identifying a minimal set of interpretable, intermediate representation changes that causally induce model refusal on an otherwise successful jailbreak request, is introduced.

2605.00072.tldr: This work presents XekRung, a frontier large language model for cybersecurity, designed to provide comprehensive security capabilities, and introduces a multi-dimensional evaluation system to guide the iterative improvement of both domain-specific and general-purpose abilities.

2605.00060.tldr: The complete 6,084-line, framework-free implementation is reproducible given the public Volve download and an API key, and the case studies and qualitative ablation analysis suggest that domain-specialized tool design, rather than model scale alone, is the primary driver of analytical quality in technical operations.

2605.00043.tldr: SiriusHelper serves as a unified online assistant that automatically identifies user intent and routes queries to the right handling path, including dedicated expert workflows for specialized scenarios (e.g., SQL execution diagnosis) and introduces automated ticket understanding and SOP distillation.

2605.00033.tldr: This work proposes CONF-LA (Confidence-score-based Online Fixation-to-Line Assignment), a principled, low-latency approach that integrates knowledge about reading behavior and Gaussian line likelihoods over fixations to compute a posterior-line-score and defers assignments when uncertainty is high.

2605.00020.tldr: AirFM-DDA is proposed, an Air-interface Foundation Model operating in the Delay-Doppler-Angle (DDA) domain for physicallayer tasks that achieves superior zero-shot generalization across unseen scenarios and datasets, consistently outperforming the baselines on channel prediction and estimation tasks.

2605.00248.tldr: This framework aims to provide a foundation for theoretical and empirical work to understand, predict, and control emergent collective agents in multi-agent AI systems and uses causal games and causal abstraction to solve a puzzle regarding multi-agent incentives in actor-critic models.

2605.00236.tldr: The Attention Redistribution Attack (ARA), a white-box adversarial attack that identifies safety-critical attention heads and crafts nonsemantic adversarial tokens that redirect attention away from safety-relevant positions, is introduced.

2605.00071.tldr: This work presents a compliance-aware architecture that combines x402-style, signature-based payment authorisation and relayed execution with programmable compliance embedded as an on-chain guardrail via a policy wrapper and policy manager coordinating modular checks.

2605.00310.tldr: GeoSR-Bench is the first SR benchmark that directly connects improved image resolution from SR models with downstream Earth monitoring tasks, including land cover segmentation, infrastructure mapping, and biophysical variable estimation and reveals the need to integrate downstream tasks into SR model development and evaluation.

2605.00300.tldr: TokenArena is a continuous benchmark that measures inference at endpoint granularity along five core axes (output speed, time to first token, workload-blended price, effective context, and quality on the live endpoint) and synthesizes them into three headline composites: joules per correct answer, dollars per correct answer, and endpoint fidelity.

2605.00273.tldr: By training diffusion models on mosaic, this work finds that scene complexity plays a dominant role rather than concept imbalance, and that counting is uniquely difficult to learn in low-data regimes, highlighting fundamental limitations of diffusion models.

2605.00254.tldr: It is found that lower-cost switchless topologies are more cost-effective than the scale-up topology across all serving scenarios explored, improving cost-effectiveness by 20.6-56.2% and the 3D full-mesh topology is Pareto-optimal in terms of the performance-cost tradeoff.

2605.00242.tldr: MAEPose is presented, a masked autoencoding-based human pose estimation approach that operates directly on mmWave spectrogram videos, and learns spatiotemporal motion-aware generalized representations from unlabelled radar video, and leverages its heatmap decoder for multi-frame pose estimation predictions.

2605.00133.tldr: Kisan AI is developed, a smart profit-aware crop advisory system that resolves the above-mentioned limitation through a research-driven, full-stack application and unifies all modules into a single, mobile-installable platform accessible to farmers across India.

2605.00119.tldr: ArabCulture-Dialogue is introduced, a culturally grounded conversational dataset covering 13 Arabic-speaking countries, in both MSA and each country's respective dialect, spanning 12 daily-life topics and 54 fine-grained subtopics and indicates that the performance gap between MSA and Arabic dialects still exists.

2605.00074.tldr: It is shown that this baseline collapses to a 100% false-flag rate when the hazardous sequence comes from a taxonomic family absent from the reference set: under Conformal Risk Control's certified miss-rate constraint, a low-discrimination signal forces the threshold below the entire test-benign mass.

2605.00073.tldr: This work proposes AgentReputation, a decentralized, three-layer reputation framework for agentic AI systems that separates task execution, reputation services, and tamper-proof persistence to both leverage their respective strengths and enable independent evolution.

2605.00063.tldr: This survey systematizes existing RIR benchmarks by knowledge domains and modalities, introduces a structured taxonomy that categorizes methods based on where and how reasoning is integrated into the retrieval pipeline, alongside an analysis of their trade-offs and practical applications.

2605.00056.tldr: Overall, distribution-aware ensembles with clustering diagnostics offer robust, interpretable assessments of groundwater contamination, and this study develops a predictive framework integrating response transformations with nested cross-validated ensemble machine learning.

2605.00015.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate TimeRFT can consistently outperform SFT-based adaptation methods across various real-world forecasting tasks and training data regimes, enhancing prediction accuracy and generalization against unforeseen distribution shifts.

2605.00011.tldr: A novel resource heterogeneity-aware device scheduling approach designed to efficiently schedule heterogeneous devices across multiple concurrent FL jobs, with the goal of minimizing their average job completion time (JCT).

2605.00292.tldr: Caracal, a novel architecture that replaces attention with a parameter-efficient, $\mathcal{O}(L \log L)$ Multi-Head Fourier (MHF) module, is introduced, offering a scalable and simple pathway for efficient long-sequence modeling.

2605.00276.tldr: Experiments show that the proposed agentic AI framework achieves 77.4\% accuracy on the TOP Benchmark, significantly outperforming single-agent and workflow-based multi-agent baselines, demonstrating the importance of orchestrated agentic reasoning for robust trip planning optimization.

2605.00267.tldr: Boundary Point Jailbreaking, currently the strongest jailbreak against deployed classifiers, achieves near-perfect classifier evasion with near-zero degradation across safeguarded models, and is recommended that safety cases for frontier models should not rely on a meaningful capability degradation from jailbreaks.

2605.00199.tldr: RSAT, a method that trains small language models (SLMs, 1-8B) to produce step-by-step reasoning with cell-level citations grounded in table evidence, is introduced, confirming that attribution must be integrated into reasoning, not retrofitted.

2605.00197.tldr: A systematic analysis of the consequences and interactions of key design choices in simulated social networks, including the choice of base model used to model individual agents, and how they are connected to each other suggests that the geometry of the design space is non-trivial.

2605.00116.tldr: The ViLegalNLI establishes a foundational benchmark for Vietnamese legal NLI and supports future research in legal reasoning, statutory text understanding, and the development of reliable AI systems for legal analysis and decision support.

2605.00059.tldr: This work proposes Dynamic-TD3, a physically enhanced framework that enforces strict safety constraints while maintaining maneuverability by modeling navigation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP).

2605.00022.tldr: This work opens-source these regression-weighted subsets as the HUMANS benchmark, an efficient proxy for LAM evaluation that captures both benchmark performance and user preferences and demonstrates that in regression modeling, well-curated subsets outpredict the full benchmark, showing quality over quantity.

2605.00007.tldr: This work introduces Mean-Field Path-Integral Diffusion (MF-PID), a framework in which samples are promoted to interacting agents whose drift depends self-consistently on the evolving population density, and proves that the self-consistent MF guidance is the exact linear interpolant between initial and target global means.

2605.00313.tldr: It is argued that closing the synthesizability gap demands a pivot to a synthesis-first paradigm in which executable synthesis protocols, not just atomic configurations, are treated as primary design variables.

2605.00256.tldr: Remote SAMsing is proposed, an open-source pipeline that solves both problems without modifying SAM2 or requiring training data and generalizes to MNF false-color imagery without retraining and scales to production-sized images.

2605.00245.tldr: ARMOR 2025 is introduced, a military aligned safety benchmark grounded in three core military doctrines the Law of War, the Rules of Engagement, and the Joint Ethics Regulation, that enables systematic testing of accuracy and refusal across military relevant decision types.

2605.00226.tldr: Analyzing LLMs'internal processes can expose systematic vulnerabilities that warrant caution before deploying LLMs in strategic domains without robust guardrails, and shows how analyzing LLMs'internal processes can expose systematic vulnerabilities that warrant caution before deploying them in strategic domains without robust guardrails.

2605.00136.tldr: This work proposes a Factorized Intervention Framework that isolates the cost of prompt formatting, the overhead of the tool-calling protocol, and the actual gain from executing tools, and reveals a critical tradeoff: under semantic noise, the gains from tools often fail to offset the"tool-use tax", which is the performance degradation introduced by the tool-calling protocol itself.

2605.00087.tldr: DeGenTWeb is described, which systematically identifies LLM-dominant websites: sites whose content has been generated using LLMs with little human input, and how to adapt detectors of LLM-generated text for use on web pages, and how to aggregate detection results from multiple pages on a site for accurate site-level categorization.

2605.00086.tldr: NorBERTo provides a modern, mid-sized encoder designed for realistic deployment scenarios: it is straight-forward to fine-tune, efficient to serve, and well suited as a backbone for retrieval-augmented generation and other downstream Portuguese NLP systems.

2605.00082.tldr: The Hyperspherical Forward-Forward (HFF) is introduced, a novel reformulation of the Forward-Forward algorithm that reframe the local objective of each layer from a binary goodness-of-fit task to a direct multi-class classification problem within a hyperspherical feature space.

2605.00012.tldr: The results prove that LLM Overview systems have biases and that reinforcement learning in most of the cases can optimize snippet's content to manipulate LLM Overview results and prove that LLM Overview selections are driven by comparative rather than absolute advantages among candidate sources.

2605.00005.tldr: This work develops a formal analytical model that characterizes distributed inference latency as a function of the sensing frequency, platform throughput, network delay, and task-specific safety constraints, and demonstrates that, when provisioned with high-throughput compute resources, cloud platforms can effectively amortize network and queueing delays, enabling them to match or surpass on-device performance for real-time decision-making.

2605.00632.tldr: By retrieving semantically similar examples during generation, BlenderRAG improves compilation success rates from 40.8% to 70.0% and semantic normalized alignment from 0.41 to 0.77 (CLIP similarity) across four state-of-the-art LLMs.

2605.00600.tldr: Dirichlet-approximated possibilistic posterior predictions (DAPPr) is introduced, a principled framework leveraging possibility theory that achieves competitive or superior uncertainty quantification performance compared to state-of-the-art evidential deep learning methods while maintaining both principled derivation and computational efficiency.

2605.00592.tldr: This work proposes that a decision be considered fair if it has a fair explanation, and defines a fair explanation as a prime-implicant reason for the decision that does not contain any protected feature (where the constraints are taken into account in the definition of prime-implicant).

2605.00572.tldr: This paper investigates instance-aware parameter configuration for Bilevel Late Acceptance Hill Climbing, a state-of-the-art metaheuristic for the Electric Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem, and achieves an average objective value reduction of $0.28\% across eight held-out test instances relative to a globally tuned configuration.

2605.00551.tldr: This work proposes A11y-Compressor, a framework that transforms linearized accessibility trees into compact and structured representations and applies a lightweight and structured transformation pipeline with modal detection, redundancy reduction, and semantic structuring.

2605.00528.tldr: This work presents SAGA, a distributed scheduler that implements workflow-aware scheduling through three mechanisms: agent Execution Graphs that capture workflow structure to predict KV cache reuse across tool-call boundaries, and session-affinity batching with work stealing that co-locates correlated requests while maintaining global load balance.

2605.00497.tldr: This work introduces striving co-creation, a process for inferring broader life goals from unstructured observations of computer use and supports an editing interface that gives people agency over how they are understood by the system, feeding their corrections back into subsequent rounds of striving induction.

2605.00462.tldr: This paper uses custom TensorFlow provided by the Poplar SDK to adapt the program for the IPU-POD16 platform and investigates its ease of use and performance scalability, and shows how to utilize the \emph{popdist} library to overcome a performance bottleneck in feeding training data to the IPU on the host side.

2605.00421.tldr: This work demonstrates that small, efficiently fine-tuned models - which the authors collectively call RadLite - can serve as practical multi-task radiology AI assistants deployable entirely on consumer hardware without GPU requirements.

2605.00369.tldr: This work proposes AlphaInventory, an end-to-end inventory-policy evolution and inference framework grounded in confidence-interval-based certification, which outperforms classical inventory policies and deep learning based methods in canonical inventory settings.

2605.00354.tldr: VQ-SAD is a neuro-symbolic model that utilizes both symbolic and neural structural information for a diffusion based model with learnable forward process that slightly outperforms SOTA models for diffusion based molecule generation on QM9 and ZINC250k datasets.

2605.00466.tldr: PAMod is proposed, a lightweight yet powerful framework that models cyclical distribution shifts via Phase-Amplitude Modulation in the normalized feature space, offering an elegant unification of distribution adaptation and representation learning.

2605.00438.tldr: Interleaved Vision--Language Reasoning (IVLR) is introduced, a policy framework built around \trace{}, an explicit intermediate representation that alternates textual subgoals with visual keyframes over the full task horizon, suggesting that the trace can tolerate local corruption and moderate execution drift, but remains limited under stale or incorrect global plans.

2605.00436.tldr: It is revealed that large-language models are susceptible to presumptions when making decisions even with reasoning steps, and the importance of proper task phrasing to reduce the risk of presumptions in LLMs is highlighted.

2605.00435.tldr: Reinforced Mode Regulation is proposed, a lightweight, online state-space intervention that regulates dominant self-reinforcing directions in the Transformer value cache (implemented as low-rank damping) and substantially reduces mode collapse and enables stable, high-quality generation at extremely low entropy rates.

2605.00433.tldr: RECRL is proposed, a novel requirement-aware curriculum reinforcement learning framework for enhancing LLM-based code generation that automatically perceives model-specific requirement difficulty, optimizes challenging requirements to improve training data utilization, and employs an adaptive curriculum sampling strategy to construct training batches with smoothly varying difficulty.

2605.00424.tldr: This paper gives a trust schema that includes an explicit verification level on every skill manifest, a capability gate whose HITL policy is a function of that verification level, and a portable runtime profile with ten normative guidelines abstracted from a working open-source reference implementation.

2605.00414.tldr: This work unifies decision trees and diffusion models by establishing a crisp mathematical correspondence between hierarchical decision trees and diffusion processes in appropriate limiting regimes, and reveals a shared optimization principle: GTSM, for which gradient boosting (in an idealized version) is asymptotically optimal.

2605.00402.tldr: This work proposes a structured multi-layer recurrent SNN architecture composed of locally dense recurrent layers augmented with sparse small-world long-range projections to a readout population, and introduces a biologically motivated learning framework that combines population-based winner-take-all teaching signals and low-dimensional modulatory neuron populations.

2605.00382.tldr: The Fairness Monitor Agent is proposed, a modular component that plugs into any existing code generation pipeline without modifying it that reduces bias by 65.1% compared to a developer agent alone and improves functional correctness from 75.80% to 83.97%, outperforming all other studied approaches.

2605.00347.tldr: It is shown that pretrained VLMs provide strong action priors, significantly improving sample efficiency during RL training and reducing the need for manual design choices such as action engineering, compared to classical deep RL trained from scratch.

2605.00336.tldr: This paper studies budgeted context selection, where a subset of document units is chosen under a strict token budget so an off-the-shelf generator can meet fixed cost and latency constraints, and proposes a monotone submodular objective that balances relevance, coverage, and diversity.

2605.00327.tldr: The proposed DynamicPO (Dynamic Preference Optimization), a lightweight and plug-and-play framework comprising two adaptive mechanisms: Dynamic Boundary Negative Selection, which identifies and prioritizes informative negatives near the model's decision boundary, and Dual-Margin Dynamic beta Adjustment, which calibrates optimization strength per sample according to boundary ambiguity.

2605.00650.tldr: A theoretical analysis of AdaMeZO is presented, corroborated by extensive experiments demonstrating AdaMeZO's performance, showing that AdaMeZO can outperform MeZO while requiring up to $70\%$ fewer forward passes and affirm AdaMeZO's ability to adapt to diverse loss landscapes.

2605.00482.tldr: C-MTAD-GAT is proposed, an anomaly detection framework designed to operate as a single shared model across large populations of network elements that produces per-element, per-feature anomaly scores converted to alerts via fully unsupervised thresholds calibrated from validation residuals.

2605.00642.tldr: GUI-SD is presented, the first OPSD framework tailored for GUI grounding, which constructs a visually enriched privileged context for the teacher using a target bounding box and a Gaussian soft mask, providing informative guidance without leaking exact coordinates.

2605.00556.tldr: The findings suggest that future designs should prioritise effortless driver interventions, transparent communication of automation intent, and context-sensitive authority allocation to strengthen meaningful human control in partially automated driving.

2605.00529.tldr: Psi-RAG supports diverse tasks from token-level question answering to document-level summarization, and on cross-document multi-hop QA benchmarks, it outperforms RAPTOR by 25.9% and HippoRAG 2 by 7.4% in average F1 score.

2605.00519.tldr: It is concluded that for consumer-grade inference, the optimal hardware is defined by a complex interplay between compute density (Nvidia) and memory capacity (Apple), moderated by the significant"ecosystem friction" of proprietary quantization workflows.

2605.00425.tldr: AEM is presented, a supervision-free credit assignment method that adaptively modulates entropy dynamics during RL training to achieve a more effective exploration-exploitation trade-off and derive a practical proxy to reshape training dynamics, enabling a natural transition from exploration to exploitation.

2605.00422.tldr: Binarized Weights and Low-bit Activations is proposed, the first post-training quantization framework that preserves high accuracy while achieving 1-bit weight quantization together with low-bit activations, demonstrating strong potential for real-world LLM compression and acceleration.

2605.00412.tldr: This paper argues that the bottleneck of world models is no longer only whether they can generate realistic futures, but whether those futures are physically meaningful and useful for action, and proposes the Hamiltonian World Models as a physically grounded perspective on world modeling.

2605.00314.tldr: Semia is presented, a static auditor for agent skills that lifts each skill into the Skill Description Language (SDL), a Datalog fact base that captures LLM-triggered actions, prose-defined conditions, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

2605.00371.tldr: GaMMA inherits the streamlined encoder-decoder design of LLaVA, enabling effective cross-modal learning between music and language, and effectively unifies both time-series and non-time-series music understanding tasks within one set of parameters.

2605.00361.tldr: Text mining to publications indexed in a leading academic database is applied to map scholarly discourse on ChatGPT in programming education to support responsible integration and highlight the need for stronger assessment and governance mechanisms.

2605.00351.tldr: HyperODE RCA is presented, a unified framework that combines hypergraph attention learning, latent ordinary differential equations, and multimodal cross attention fusion for fine grained root cause analysis for cloud native microservice systems.

2605.00334.tldr: Small and mid-sized open-weight models are already sufficient for much of the short-horizon, structured tool use work that dominates real agent pipelines, and in aggregate, the strongest open-weight model matches GPT-5 on the authors' benchmark while being substantially cheaper and faster to run.

2605.00583.tldr: Four jailbreak attacks exploiting the vision component are introduced exploiting the vision component of vision-language models, highlighting that robust VLM alignment requires treating vision as a first-class target for safety post-training.

2605.00505.tldr: This perspective paper argues that denoising-maximizing usable evidence density and verifiability within a context window-is becoming the primary bottleneck across the full information access pipeline and provides a pipeline-organized taxonomy of signal-to-noise optimization techniques.

2605.00440.tldr: A methodology is proposed to infer the latent role specified by the prompt, embed this role into the content during the probabilistic generation process and subsequently recover the nature of AI participation from the resulting text.

2605.00410.tldr: Agent Capsules is presented, an adaptive execution runtime that treats multi-agent pipeline execution as an optimization problem with empirical quality constraints, and delivers efficiency through automatic policy resolution, cache-aligned prompts, and topology-aware context injection.

2605.00343.tldr: Modated multiple regression analysis showed that institutional support significantly predicted both teacher confidence and attitudes toward AI, however, teacher concerns did not significantly moderate these relationships.

2605.00315.tldr: This position paper addresses the nexus of responsible GeoAI into four interrelated theoretical dimensions, specifically Representativeness, Explainability, Sustainability, and Ethics, and proposes a conceptual governance Model of responsible GeoAI that categorizes its governance practices into Data, Application, and Society scopes.

2605.00644.tldr: This work presents a learning framework that effectively interweaves their MLE updates with corresponding MCMC refinements in both the data and latent spaces and serves as complementary models that enable effective EBM sampling and learning, yielding realistic and coherent multimodal EBM samples.

2605.00582.tldr: Evidence that AI washing inflates user expectations without altering actual interaction outcomes is contributed, highlighting a critical transparency issue and establishing Fitts'Law as a rigorous methodological lens for auditing AI-labelled input devices.

2605.00545.tldr: Unbalanced Schr\"odinger Bridge (USB), a simulation-free framework for learning underlying dynamics that effectively integrates both stochastic and unbalanced effects which also models the discrete, jump-like birth-death dynamics at single-cell resolution, is presented.

2605.00515.tldr: The Space Network of Experts (Space-XNet) framework targeting the distributed execution of a popular mixture-of-experts (MoE) model in space achieves at least a threefold latency reduction compared with conventional random and ablation-based placement strategies.

2605.00814.tldr: Persistent Visual Memory (PVM), a lightweight learnable module designed to ensure sustained, on-demand visual perception, is proposed, which can resist length-induced signal decay and accelerate internal prediction convergence.

2605.00782.tldr: GeoContra turns fluent code production into verifiable spatial analysis, catching negative travel times, CRS/field-schema violations, missing predicates, and brittle output casts that otherwise yield executable but geographically invalid results.

2605.00776.tldr: The Directed Social Regard (DSR) approach to multi-dimensional, multi-valence sentiment analysis is presented, comprised of a pair of transformer-based models that detects span-level targets of sentiment in a message and then scores all spans within the message context along three (-1, 1) axes of regard that are motivated by social science theories of moral disengagement and moral framing.

2605.00721.tldr: The Room Acoustics and Speaker Distance Estimation (SDE) Challenge at ICASSP 2025 explores the effectiveness of augmented room impulse response (RIR) data for improving SDE model performance with results demonstrating that the augmentation approach significantly improves estimation accuracy, particularly at medium to long distances.

2605.00664.tldr: A strategy to optimize the initial noise within the structured 3D latent diffusion framework, ensuring high-fidelity 3D inpainting by leveraging a backpropagation approximation grounded in the rectified flow model, with the spectral parameterization specially designed for robust and efficient structured 3D latent optimization.

2605.00793.tldr: An end-to-end unsupervised low-dose computed tomography denoising framework that addresses the limitation that real clinical data cannot be directly used for supervised learning, while still achieving excellent performance.

2605.00733.tldr: An Anchor Principle is identified for federated multimodal contrastive unlearning: forgotten alignments persist through three residual anchors arising from bilinear cross-modal coupling, principal-angle subspace entanglement, and continued federated updates.

2605.00731.tldr: Decoupled relation Subspace Alignment (DRSA), a novel, plug-and-play relation-driven alignment framework that can be seamlessly integrated as a universal preprocessing module, significantly and consistently enhancing the cross-domain and few-shot knowledge transfer capabilities of state-of-the-art GFMs.

2605.00762.tldr: K-SVFair-FBF, a fairness-aware bandit algorithm that adaptively estimates $K-Shapley value with unknown valuation function, is proposed, which not only learns the valuation function under full feedback setting but also mitigates the noise arising from Monte Carlo approximations.

2605.00737.tldr: This work introduces a principled framework inspired by decision-making theory to evaluate web search tool-use decisions along three key factors: necessity, utility, and affordability and trains lightweight estimators of need and utility based on models'hidden states.

2605.00667.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that SAC-ALaM outperforms state-of-the-art safe RL baselines in both safety and return, while also stabilizing training dynamics and learning well-calibrated multipliers for risk identification.

2605.00654.tldr: A special class of Markov coherent risk measures, called mini-batch measures, are introduced and a high-probability regret bound is proved of $\mathcal{O}\big(H^2 N^H \sqrt{ K}\big)$, where $H$ is the horizon, $N$ is the mini-batch size, and $K$ is the number of episodes.

2605.00789.tldr: Experimental results demonstrate that with only 55% of the original vision tokens, LightKV halves the vision-token KV cache size, reduces computation by up to 40%, and preserves general-purpose performance while significantly outperforming existing baselines.

2605.00742.tldr: This position paper argues that the control layer of an agentic AI system (that orchestrates LLMs and tools) is a clear case where Bayesian principles should shine, and articulates practical properties for Bayesian control that fit modern agentic AI systems and human-AI collaboration.

2605.00803.tldr: This work presents AutoMat, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents'ability to reproduce claims from computational materials science, and curates a set of claims from real materials science papers to test whether coding agents can recover and execute the end-to-end workflow needed to support (or undermine) such claims.

2509.12464.tldr: This work introduces a simple, drop-in fix: during pruning the authors jointly reconstruct activations from the input and the model's on-policy chain-of-thought traces, which integrates seamlessly into existing pruning workflows and boosts their performance significantly.

2505.19607.tldr: This work proposes Energy-based Preference Optimization for Test-time Adaptation for Test-time Adaptation (EPOTTA), which is based on a sampling free strategy that first parameterize the target model using a pretrained model and residual energy function, enabling marginal likelihood maximization of target data without sampling.

2301.08719.tldr: This work discusses the trade-offs of four approaches for sampling digital cohorts and the associated potential for study bias with selecting specific patient distributions, and introduces terminology and a classification of digital human models.

2501.09775.tldr: The results of the evaluation of questions on a wide range of topics in seven different models show that LLMs are more confident in their answers when they provide reasoning before the answer, regardless of whether the selected answer is correct.

2412.13235.tldr: A new branch and bound-based algorithm for the logic-constrained shortest path problem, which combines a one-to-one shortest path problem with satisfiability constraints imposed on the routing graph and develops tailored variants of the most prominent rules.

2502.03814.tldr: This survey provides the first comprehensive exploration of LLM integration into MRS, systematically categorizes their applications across high-level task allocation, mid-level motion planning, low-level action generation, and human intervention, and outlines opportunities for future research.

2412.15251.tldr: This work introduces AgentPS, a novel framework that integrates Agentic Process Supervision into MLLMs by sequentially reasoning over ancillary questions during fine-tuning, and establishes it as a scalable and effective solution for complex multimodal classification in large-scale industrial applications.

2408.01055.tldr: This work proposes Healer, the first LLM-assisted self-healing framework for handling runtime errors, and evaluates the performance of Healer using four different code benchmarks and three state-of-the-art LLMs, GPT-3.5, GPT-4, and CodeQwen-7B.

2405.10271.tldr: This work presents AutoFLIP, a novel framework that optimizes FL through an adaptive hybrid pruning approach, grounded in a federated loss exploration phase, and offers the way for efficient FL deployment in real-world applications for a scalable and broad applicability.

2506.01982.tldr: Audio analysis revealed that expressive and improvisational performances exhibited unique acoustic features, while emotion analysis showed stronger emotional responses, and neurophysiological measurements indicated greater relaxation in improvisational performances.

2504.20018.tldr: This paper defines multi-vector search index tuning and proposes a framework to solve it, and develops algorithms to find indexes that minimize latency and meet storage and recall constraints.

2507.21153.tldr: Through rigorous testing and ablation studies, the paper validates the effectiveness of the DRL model's architecture and parameters, offering a robust solution for energy management in data centers, and highlights the potential of DRL in advancing energy optimization strategies and addressing sustainability challenges.

2407.12173.tldr: This paper proposes an efficient time step sampling method based on an image spectral analysis of the diffusion process, aimed at optimizing the denoising process by introducing a Beta distribution-like sampling technique that prioritizes critical steps in the early and late stages of the process.

2509.10468.tldr: DECOR introduces contextualized token composition to refine token embeddings based on user interaction context, and decomposed embedding fusion that integrates pretrained codebook embeddings with newly learned collaborative embeddings.

2509.04470.tldr: COCORELI integrates medium-sized LLM agents with novel abstraction mechanisms and a discourse module to parse instructions to in-context learn dynamic, high-level representations of the environment and its abstraction abilities extend beyond ENVIRONMENT.

2509.00673.tldr: The results reveal a surprising trade-off: censored models significantly outperform their uncensored counterparts in both accuracy and robustness, achieving 78.7% versus 64.1% strict accuracy.

2507.23386.tldr: Causal2Vec is proposed, a general-purpose embedding model tailored to enhance the performance of decoder-only LLMs without altering their original architectures or introducing significant computational overhead.

2506.06057.tldr: CatShift is introduced, a label-only dataset-inference framework that capitalizes on catastrophic forgetting: the tendency of an LLM to overwrite previously learned knowledge when exposed to new data, offering a robust and practical solution for safeguarding proprietary data.

2504.20605.tldr: TF1-EN-3M, the first open dataset of three million English-language fables generated exclusively by instruction-tuned models no larger than 8B parameters, is released, demonstrating that large-scale moral storytelling no longer requires proprietary giant models.

2507.15774.tldr: An original original $\texttt{PRO-DYN}$ nomenclature is developed to analyze existing models through the lens of dynamics to support the need to incorporate a learnable dynamics block and its use as the final predictor.

2412.01459.tldr: This study examines how the general public and academic AI experts perceive AI's capabilities and impact across 71 scenarios, providing an empirical foundation for value-sensitive AI governance and trust-building strategies across stakeholder groups.

2507.04441.tldr: This work shows that CP is intrinsically a UQ mechanism, that is, its cardinal UQ capabilities are a structural feature of the method, and demonstrates that CP bridges the Bayesian, frequentist, and imprecise probabilistic approaches to predictive statistical reasoning.

2509.17677.tldr: EngiBench is introduced, a hierarchical benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs on solving engineering problems and reveals that current LLMs still lack the high-level reasoning needed for real-world engineering, highlighting the need for future models with deeper and more reliable problem-solving capabilities.

2603.00042.tldr: LittleBit-2 is proposed, a framework employing Internal Latent Rotation and Joint Iterative Quantization (Joint-ITQ), which acts as a geometric preconditioner, aligning coherent latent distributions with the binary hypercube with zero inference overhead.

2602.19171.tldr: HistCAD is presented, a large-scale dataset featuring constraint-aware modeling sequences that compactly represent procedural operations while ensuring compatibility with native CAD software, encompassing five aligned modalities: modeling sequences, multi-view renderings, STEP-format B-reps, native parametric files, and textual annotations.

2603.14643.tldr: The effectiveness of ArgEval on treatment recommendation for glioblastoma, an aggressive brain tumour, is investigated, and it is shown that it can produce explainable guidance aligned with clinical practice.

2603.26816.tldr: This work developed an uncertainty-aware belief model that encodes physics-informed features to improve prediction in semi-supervised learning, and posit PiCSRL as a sample-efficient adaptive sensing method across Earth observation domains for improved observation-to-target mapping.

2603.13331.tldr: The results show that grokking is a predictable consequence of norm separation between competing interpolating representations and provide the first quantitative scaling law for the delay of grokking.

2603.26845.tldr: GISclaw is presented, an open-source agent system that integrates an LLM reasoning core with a persistent Python sandbox, a comprehensive suite of open-source GIS libraries (GeoPandas, rasterio, scipy, scikit-learn), and a web-based interactive interface for full-stack geospatial analysis spanning vector, raster, and tabular data.

2604.03641.tldr: Delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning (DHRL) is proposed, a framework grounded in MDP homomorphisms that collapses belief-equivalent augmented states and enables efficient policy learning on the resulting abstract MDP without loss of optimality.

2603.27343.tldr: Working Memory Fidelity-Active Manipulation is introduced, a calibrated no-scratchpad probe of cumulative arithmetic state tracking, and three construct-isolation ablations support the interpretation that cumulative state tracking under load, rather than single-step arithmetic or entity tracking alone, is the primary difficulty source.

2604.25853.tldr: G-Loss is presented, a graph-guided loss function that incorporates semi-supervised label propagation to use structural relationships within the embedding manifold to build a document-similarity graph that captures global semantic relationships.

2604.25224.tldr: ValueAlpha is a pre-calibration metrology layer for AI-finance evaluation: it determines whether a proposed LLM-judge-based investment-rationale claim is stable enough, agreed enough, and uncontaminated enough to be reported at all.

2604.17654.tldr: A framework for post-training language models (LMs) that explicitly encourages optimistic exploration and promotes a synergy between exploration and exploitation is presented, and Poly-EPO, which instantiates this framework with an objective that explicitly synergizes exploration and exploitation is proposed.

2605.00842.tldr: This study links emergent misalignment to feature superposition, providing a basis for understanding and mitigating this phenomenon, and shows that a geometry-aware approach, filtering training samples closest to toxic features, reduces misalignment by 34.5%, substantially outperforming random removal and achieving comparable or slightly lower misalignment than LLM-as-a-judge-based filtering.

2605.00839.tldr: This roadmap outlines the advances needed in methods, integration strategies, and industrial adoption to ensure that AI-driven smart manufacturing delivers reliable, sustainable, and scalable impact for the future of manufacturing ecosystems.

2605.00831.tldr: GhostServe protects the streaming KV cache in the shadow by applying erasure coding to generate and store the parity shards in host memory, allowing the inference process to resume seamlessly without costly full recomputation or state replication in the event of device failures.

2604.27947.tldr: This FCM is a gradient descent based, physics constrained, Jacobian version of an FCM, which has several quirks; it uses residual memory, back propagation through time, and a fixed point anchor that is recursively implemented to update its weights.

2604.26157.tldr: This work presents an alternative requiring no hand-written compositional rules, based on a neural cellular automaton (NCA) with a discrete bottleneck: all compositional rules are learned from data through local iteration.

2604.27743.tldr: A geometric and information-theoretic framework for encoder-decoder learning built on the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle is developed, and SIGReg serves as the distributional regularizer for both the semi-supervised and self-supervised settings.

2604.27167.tldr: It is found that chain-of-thought reasoning worsens Nash play in small models but achieves near-perfect Nash play above 70B parameters, and three phenomena invisible in self-play are revealed: a small model can unravel any partner's cooperation by defecting early; two large models reinforce each other's cooperative instincts indefinitely.

2604.23289.tldr: This paper proposes a simple yet effective framework, MetaErr, whose goal is to predict whether a base deep neural network will succeed or fail in predicting a particular data sample, by observing the base models performance on a given learning task.

2605.00843.tldr: Investigating job postings reveals a sharp post-2021 increase in AI-related skill mentions: prompt engineering, fine-tuning and model validation, accompanied by a decline in routine tasks: data entry and manual coding, signaling a structural convergence toward hybrid human-AI expertise as a new foundation of employability.

2605.00841.tldr: This study presents a novel, AI-driven framework for assessing Environmental, Social, and Governance performance in European small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and demonstrates the AI system's high consistency with human-derived outputs, thereby supporting more effective monitoring and intervention strategies aligned with the European Green Deal.

2604.27924.tldr: This survey synthesizes techniques for peer review generation, including fine-tuning strategies, agent-based systems, RL-based methods, and emerging paradigms to enhance generation; after-review tasks including rebuttals, meta-review and revision aligned to reviews; and evaluation methods spanning human-centered, reference-based, LLM-based and aspect-oriented.

2604.23940.tldr: A multi-agent framework that transforms decompiled code into re-executable source through Multi-level Constraint-Guided Decompilation (MCGD), demonstrating that constraint-guided agentic refinement can bridge the gap between raw decompiler output and practically useful source code.

2605.00871.tldr: NAKUL is introduced, extending SSMs for medical signal analysis through three contributions: Dynamic Kernel Generation-parallel SSM branches with varying kernel sizes are weighted by a meta-network that analyzes input statistics, enabling adaptive temporal scale selection and Graph-Guided Spatial Attention-fixed electrode topology provides spatial biases to multi-head attention for principled cross-channel interaction.

2605.00870.tldr: A lightweight change-detection gate based on dynamic template matching that runs continuously at only approximately 16kFLOPs per step, requires no offline training, and does not need prior definition of target activity classes is presented.

2605.00857.tldr: FUSED, a Foundation-guided Source-free EEG Decoding framework that integrates a large-scale FM with a compact Specialist Model via dual-branch co-adaptation, is proposed, the first work to leverage EEG FMs within the SFDA framework for cross-subject EEG decoding.

2605.00856.tldr: 1BT, a One-Block Transformer for compact and efficient EEG-based cognitive workload assessment, which aggregates multi-channel temporal sequences via a minimal latent bottleneck, using a single cross-attention module followed by lightweight self-attention.

2605.00847.tldr: A collection of linear probes that extract hierarchical structure, specifically depth and pairwise distance, from latent representations from latent representations, and demonstrate that models represent hierarchy not only at the level of syntax and concepts, but at deeper levels of abstraction -- including the reasoning process itself.

2604.27660.tldr: This paper proposes Ctx2Skill, a self-evolving framework that autonomously discovers, refines, and selects context-specific skills without human supervision or external feedback, and introduces a Cross-time Replay mechanism that identifies the skill set achieving the best balance across representative cases for the Reasoner side, ensuring robust and generalizable skill evolution.

2605.00861.tldr: The results demonstrate that voice range serves as a primary indicator of model capability, with VITS showing the largest range among tested models and underscore the need for voice mapping to evaluate vocal effort.

2604.28123.tldr: This work introduces PRISM, a three-stage pipeline that mitigates this drift by inserting an explicit distribution-alignment stage between SFT and RLVR, and casts alignment as a black-box, response-level adversarial game between the policy and a Mixture-of-Experts discriminator with dedicated perception and reasoning experts.

2604.25000.tldr: This work formalizes this residual openness as a closure-gap vector, defines delegation envelopes as pre-authorized regions of action space, distinguish misclosure from undersearch, and outline benchmark metrics for testing when closure interventions outperform additional inference-time search.

2604.23878.tldr: The 15-algorithm ablation reveals a cooperative survival network: under stress, 9 of 15 algorithms become individually critical (delta-Q up to -93.7%, Wilcoxon, 10 seeds, alpha=0.7%)
