2605.00850.tldr: Earth System Foundation Model (ESFM), a fully open model building on the 3D Swin UNet backbone of the pioneering Aurora model, is introduced, a fully open model building on the 3D Swin UNet backbone of the pioneering Aurora model that retains the strengths of previous foundation models but facilitates application to a variety of downstream tasks.

2605.00846.tldr: ClinicBot is presented, an AI system that translates guideline recommendations into trustworthy clinical support through three key advances: structured extraction of clinical guidelines into semantic units, and evidence prioritization that ranks content by clinical significance and guideline structure rather than textual similarity.

2605.00845.tldr: UniQGen is proposed, a novel constraint-based framework that employs LLM agents to dynamically extract and refine representative graph query clauses into executable, intent-aligned graph queries across query languages.

2605.00844.tldr: An epistemic monoculture that is built but not yet activated is revealed: three nominally independent AI systems share the same failure modes, amplifying precisely the biases humans already hold.

2605.00833.tldr: By embedding explainability throughout the workflow, Agentopic offers an interpretable alternative to black-box models, making it particularly valuable for crucial applications like finance and healthcare.

2605.00827.tldr: The MCP Workflow Engine is presented, a novel MCP-native orchestration layer that decouples intelligence from execution (carrying it out) and achieves deterministic, idempotent execution with zero agent involvement at run time.

2604.23599.tldr: The partition-of-unity Gaussian KAN (PU-GKAN), a Shepard-type normalized Gaussian KAN in which the Gaussian basis values on each edge are divided by their local sum over fixed centers, indicates that Shepard-type partition-of-unity normalization is a simple and effective stabilization mechanism for RBF-based KANs.

2605.01037.tldr: A certified purity architecture that converts governance enforcement in cognitive workflow systems from a runtime convention into a structural capability boundary, and proves four theorems: structural purity by construction, bypass elimination for all five BEAM bypass classes, certificate integrity, and gate completeness.

2605.00964.tldr: This work evaluates a chatbot-style assistant based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation in a realistic multi-turn information-seeking scenario inspired by workplace settings where compliance with local legislation and secure handling of sensitive data are often key.

2605.00951.tldr: This survey provides a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art rewiring approaches, delving into their theoretical underpinnings, practical implementations, and performance trade-offs.

2605.00948.tldr: The proposed CodeFP is a Co-generative protein language model for de novo Functional Protein design that simultaneously decodes sequence and structure tokens, thereby enabling superior simultaneous realization of functionality and foldability.

2605.00944.tldr: Stable sample-level ranking under redundancy is studied and SCARV is proposed, a modular aggregation framework that operates on top of an existing scoring proxy that substantially improves over bare proxy rankings in global and local stability and yields more reproducible ranking-based decisions such as subset selection and suspicious-example retrieval.

2605.00938.tldr: This work proposes SEDAN, a Structure-Enhanced Diffusion model conditioned on Attributed Nodes for generalizable OD matrix generation, and designs a fusion mechanism within SEDAN to jointly model semantic information and spatial information.

2605.00929.tldr: This work presents PhaseNet++, a frequency-domain autoencoder that operates on the Short-Time Fourier Transform of sliding sensor windows, retaining both magnitude and phase spectra, and is positioned as the first systematic study of phase-domain anomaly detection for ICS.

2605.00907.tldr: TRIP-Evaluate provides a reproducible, diagnosable, and engineering-aligned evaluation baseline for model selection, regression testing, and safer deployment in transportation applications.

2605.00905.tldr: DIAGRAMS is a lightweight, schema-driven review framework that decouples interface logic from dataset-specific JSON structures through an internal meta-schema and dataset adapters and releases a public demo and installable package to support dataset auditing, grounded supervision creation, and grounded evaluation.

2605.00890.tldr: This study evaluates the effectiveness of various models, including a Geometric approach, XGBoost, SVM, and several deep learning architectures, in classifying walker usage, standing vs. sitting, and posture for smart walkers used.

2605.00874.tldr: A novel latent space probing framework that intercepts the denoised latent representations produced by the CogVideoX video diffusion model during inference and attaches lightweight classifiers to perform real-time adult content detection and suggests that probing the latent space results in improvements in both detection performance as well as cost.

2605.00872.tldr: It is demonstrated that fetal cardiac mechanical activity contains hemodynamic features indicative of maternal hypertension status, which supports a promising paradigm shift toward continuous, objective monitoring of maternal health using existing, low-cost ultrasound technology and introduces a complementary approach to traditional methods based on blood pressure measurements.

2605.01030.tldr: Together, these results show that governance and computational expressivity are orthogonal dimensions: governance constrains the effect boundary of programs while remaining semantically transparent to internal computation.

2605.00957.tldr: CERTA (Certainty Enhanced RAG for Trustworthy Answers), a specialized Retrieval Augmented Generation system that incorporates the relevance between question, context, and answer to reflect its uncertainty in answering questions, is developed.

2605.00932.tldr: This report documents the preparedness assessment of Code World Model, a model for code generation and reasoning about code from Meta, and finds that CWM does not pose additional frontier risks beyond those present in the current AI ecosystem.

2605.00922.tldr: This paper summarizes the broader ongoing discussion of generative AI in qualitative research and its implications for software engineering researchers.

2605.00915.tldr: This work proposes SSMProbe, a probing framework driven by a State Space Model (SSM), and finds that pre-training objectives fundamentally shape token structure: DINOv2 concentrates global semantics in optimized CLS tokens leaving patches hyperspecialized, pure MAE preserves distributed representations with heterogeneous patch informativeness, and ViT represents a supervised CLS-dominated extreme.

2605.01041.tldr: A multi-agent reinforcement learning paradigm in which homogeneous aircraft within heterogeneous fleets operate concurrently to perform package delivery missions over Dallas, Texas, USA is investigated, which shows that two fleets with distinct, shared PPOA2C policies can reach an equilibrium to maintain safe separation.

2605.01024.tldr: Conflict-aware Head-level Attention Steering (CHASE), a lightweight mechanism that detects modality conflicts and performs inference-time attention steering, effectively mitigating decision bias without retraining the backbone is proposed.

2605.01011.tldr: The CLinical Evaluation of Ambiguity and Reliability (CLEAR) framework is introduced, which assesses how decision-space presentation, ambiguity, and uncertainty affect LLMs'reasoning on medical benchmarks and reveals limitations in standard medical benchmarks.

2605.00994.tldr: A simple perplexity-based method can surface finetuning objectives from model organisms by leveraging their tendency to overgeneralize their finetuned behaviors beyond the intended context, and can be effective even without access to the exact pre-finetuning checkpoint.

2605.00977.tldr: This interdisciplinary project constructs a dataset of 4029 lines of text across 193 medieval criminal and civil cases and trains an open-source end-to-end pipeline for transcribing these manuscripts, opening up the English legal tradition to legal scholars, medievalists, and students.

2605.00972.tldr: An open-source visual analytics workbench that enables a discovery workflow in which scientists characterize a phenomenon of interest in a well-understood dataset, identifying its signature in latent space, and then use that signature to probe larger, less-labeled archives or ensembles for similar events.

2605.00930.tldr: Evaluations on PBMC68K, Replogle Perturb-seq, Systema, and BMMC benchmarks show that CellxPert surpasses classical and state-of-the-art baselines in cell-type annotation, perturbation response prediction, and multi-omic integration.

2605.00873.tldr: BRITE is introduced, the first framework that unifies (1) implausible prompting, (2) fine-grained assessment of audio-visual consistency, and (3) QA-based interpretable evaluation into a comprehensive T2V benchmark.

2605.00968.tldr: Adaptive 3D-RoPE is proposed, a physics-aligned rotary positional encoding that establishes the structural corner?stone for wireless foundation models and achieves up to a 10.7 dB reduction in normalized mean square error (NMSE) under 8 times antenna scale extrapolation.

2605.00939.tldr: Embedding-Perturbed Gradient Sensitivity (EPGS) is proposed, providing a robust signal for detecting high-confidence factual errors and acting as an efficient proxy for the Hessian spectrum.

2605.00936.tldr: This work proposes EventADL, the first open-box event-based ADL framework for cloud-based service systems, designed to operate efficiently with unlabeled data and to produce interpretable anomalies with their corresponding root causes.

2605.00924.tldr: StyleShield is presented, the first flow matching framework for conditional text style transfer, operating directly in continuous token embedding space via a DiT backbone with zero-initialized cross-attention adapters conditioned on frozen Qwen-7B representations, and RateAudit is introduced, a document-level scheduling algorithm that demonstrates detection-rate verdicts can be set to arbitrary values, directly questioning the reliability of score-based evaluation.

2605.00914.tldr: Findings from a controlled empirical study of teams of teams of homogeneous agents indicate that, within the 7-8B parameter class, homogeneous teams without structured roles do not benefit from unguided peer exchange, and that isolated self-correction consistently offers a more favorable cost-accuracy tradeoff.

2605.00913.tldr: Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MCSTN achieves competitive performance compared with existing state-of-the-art methods, particularly under imperfect sensing conditions, and validate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed framework for real-world wearable IoMT sensing applications.

2605.00891.tldr: This work introduces X2SAM, a unified segmentation MLLM that extends any-segmentation capabilities from images to videos and introduces the Video Visual Grounded segmentation benchmark, which evaluates whether a model can segment object tracks in videos from interactive visual prompts.

2605.00888.tldr: Experimental results confirm that the SCKD approach outperforms existing methods in estimating GRF from wearable insole sensor data, and offers a reliable and resource-efficient solution for human gait analysis.

2605.00883.tldr: A structured review of existing methods is provided, organizing them into five major paradigms and systematically analyzing their design principles, strengths, and limitations, to facilitate the development of more robust and controllable face swapping methods.

2605.00877.tldr: OceanPile is introduced, a large-scale multimodal corpus designed for ocean foundation models that comprises three key components: OceanCorpus, a unified collection integrating sonar data, underwater imagery, marine science visuals, and scientific text from diverse authoritative sources; OceanInstruction, a high-quality instruction dataset synthesized via a novel pipeline guided by a hierarchical Ocean Concept Knowledge Graph.

2605.00875.tldr: This paper presents a systematic study comparing different visual representations for cryptocurrency regime prediction and provides interpretability analysis using GradCAM and demonstrates that transfer learning improves performance by 4-16% despite the domain gap between natural images and financial charts.

2605.00933.tldr: CGM-JEPA is proposed, a self-supervised pretraining framework which predicts masked latent representations rather than raw values, yielding abstraction that transfers across modalities.

2605.01032.tldr: An algebraic semantics for governed execution in which governance is axiomatized, compositional, and coterminous with expressibility is presented, and every governed program is the image of such a program.

2605.00969.tldr: Benchmarking 13 audio and multimodal reasoning models reveals that reasoning remains challenging for all evaluated systems, with substantial performance variation across question types, and highlights the need for more robust, domain-specific multimodal reasoning models.

2605.00955.tldr: E-MIA is proposed, which converts verifiable hard evidence in the target document into an exam with four objectively gradable question types, and uses the aggregated exam score across multiple evidence targeted questions as the membership signal.

2605.00909.tldr: This study aims to optimize formation protocols for duration efficiency, targeting high-performance outcomes while minimizing the number of experiments to reduce resource consumption and accelerate discovery, and establishes a transferable framework applicable to diverse materials science and engineering optimization tasks.

2605.00901.tldr: A novel conditional MeanFlow pipeline for CT image reconstruction is developed that models the enhancement trajectory by predicting image-conditioned flow fields given intermediate image states and combines conditional flow-based enhancement with reinforcement learning-based spatial enhancement control.

2605.00880.tldr: Adversarial Flow Matching (AFM), a novel gray-box attack framework that exploits Transformer structural vulnerabilities in E2E AD models, and substantially degrades the performance of both VLA and modular AD agents across various scenarios compared to baselines, while maintaining state-of-the-art visual imperceptibility.

2605.00906.tldr: This work studies GCD under domain shifts and proposes three frameworks that adapt foundation models, ranging from self-supervised vision models to vision-language models, suitable for different deployment scenarios.

2605.01078.tldr: SONAR is introduced, a prompt sanitization framework that identifies and removes injected content using metrics from natural language inference, and reduces the attack success rate to nearly zero, significantly outperforming nine established baseline defenses.

2605.01047.tldr: Adaptive Unlearning is presented, a post-deployment framework that surgically suppresses hallucinations while preserving general model utility and operates entirely on model-generated data, requires no human annotation, and generalizes across domains.

2605.01338.tldr: With only 60 images for detector adaptation, the method transfers effectively to AMSBench, achieving zero-shot connectivity reasoning on par with GPT-5 and Claude-Sonnet-4 while surpassing the AMS state-of-the-art method Netlistify.

2605.01329.tldr: A Truth or Tribe simulation framework is proposed to study the agent cooperation within the spread of contradicting information through a triadic interaction paradigm, and three intervention strategies--Identity-Blind Instruction, Structured Counterfactual Reasoning, and Heterogeneous Perspective Ensemble--are proposed to mitigate the in-group favoritism.

2605.01310.tldr: GraphSculptor provides a label-free solution that constructs coresets via two complementary perspectives: intrinsic structure and contextual semantics, and derives a theoretical bound on the loss gap between coreset and full-data pre-training, offering theoretical motivation for selection formulation.

2605.01283.tldr: This new model manages to train models through Transfer-Learning faster, more robust, more stable, and with less data than general model would, overcoming a large number of issues that the field still suffers from.

2605.01250.tldr: EO-Gym is presented, a controlled executable framework for multimodal, tool-using EO agents that formulates EO analysis as a Gymnasium-style local geospatial workspace backed by more than 660k multimodal files indexed by location, time, and sensor type.

2605.01245.tldr: This work proposes Forking Garden, a framework for narrative arc-conditioned gameplay planning that generates branching games from user-provided storylines via arc-guided constraint algorithms, and develops an end-to-end interactive system that instantiates the framework.

2605.01154.tldr: The approach to solving the ARC-AGI-2 puzzles with TinyLM, with additional fine-tuning at test time, with additional fine-tuning at test time, including Test-Time-Training (TTT) and Products of Experts (POE).

2605.01130.tldr: The results suggest that amplification most likely comes from continual post-training, and limiting this stage may be an effective defense against trait amplification.

2605.01327.tldr: Segment-Aligned Policy Optimization (SAPO), a novel reinforcement learning paradigm that treats coherent reasoning steps, rather than tokens or full sequences as fundamental units of policy update, paving the way for more efficient and semantically grounded policy optimization in complex reasoning tasks.

2605.01323.tldr: SiNFluD, a novel benchmark dataset for Sindhi figurative language classification, is introduced and mBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and XLM-RoBERTa-XL models are evaluated, along with SetFit for few-shot fine-tuning of sentence transformers.

2605.01282.tldr: TgtFreeHarmony is introduced, the harmonization framework tailored for target-free scenarios, eliminating the need for target domain data and any data sharing, enabling privacy-preserving harmonization directly within the source institution.

2605.01278.tldr: This work carefully design a four-stage omni e-commerce continued pre-training pipeline, through which Valley3 progressively acquires audio understanding, cross-modal instruction-following, e-commerce domain knowledge, and long-context reasoning capabilities, ultimately evolving into an omni model for diverse e-commerce scenarios.

2605.01277.tldr: A new structure model called CNN-based Multi-In-Multi-Out model for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction (MIMO-ESP) is proposed, which considers global information and significantly improves complexity by configuring a Transformer architecture based on CNN.

2605.01240.tldr: Rhamba, a region-aware pretraining framework that integrates anatomically guided masking with hybrid Attention-Mamba architectures for resting state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) analysis, offers a flexible framework for balancing interpretability, scalability, and performance in large-scale fMRI representation learning.

2605.01235.tldr: MindMelody is a fully functional, closed-loop real-time system for EEG-driven personalized music intervention that improves control adherence and emotional alignment, and receives higher perceived helpfulness in a short-term listening setting, suggesting its promise as an adaptive affect-aware music generation framework.

2605.01222.tldr: This work proposes a zero-shot STL planning solver for variable-map environments that generates feasible trajectories without retraining by integrating a map-conditioned Transformer architecture with a lightweight heuristic that effectively handles complex disjunctive (OR) subformulas.

2605.01189.tldr: NEURON is a neuro-symbolic system designed to enhance both predictive reliability and clinical interpretability and integrates SNOMED CT ontology-informed structural representations with machine learning models to bridge the gap between raw data and medical nomenclature.

2605.01160.tldr: It is argued the Productivity-Reliability Paradox (PRP) is a systematic phenomenon emerging from non-deterministic code generators and insufficient specification discipline, and the AI-Augmented Methodology Taxonomy (AAMT) is proposed, classifying six methodologies under three AI integration tiers.

2605.01131.tldr: Forager is introduced, a light-weight partially-observable CRL environment with a constant memory footprint that demonstrates that agents exhibit loss of plasticity, proposed mitigations can help, but that most useful is to leverage state construction.

2605.01106.tldr: This work introduces component-aware self-speculative decoding, the first method to exploit the internal architectural heterogeneity of hybrid language models, isolating the SSM/linear-attention subgraph as a zero-cost internal draft.

2605.01102.tldr: Results suggest that planner-guided, graph-structured multi-agent orchestration can meaningfully alleviate the context-saturation bottlenecks that constrain monolithic single-agent architectures.

2605.01100.tldr: It is suggested that ontology-guided knowledge representation can improve the consistency, interpretability, and practical usefulness of LLM-assisted LPBF defect analysis.

2605.01148.tldr: This work shows how an interplay between causal abstraction and feature geometry can deepen the mechanistic understanding of LMs and highlights how an interplay between causal abstraction and feature geometry can deepen the mechanistic understanding of LMs.

2605.01295.tldr: This survey outlines a roadmap for building self-evolving intelligent systems capable of learning autonomously through continuous change, and proposes a novel, three-dimensional taxonomy that systematizes the field based on the operational state of the system.

2605.01284.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct achieves robust performance, significantly outperforming text-based baselines in scenarios requiring visual layout understanding, while establishing a retriever-agnostic solution for pixel-level interpretable iRAG.

2605.01280.tldr: This position paper argues that LLM inference serving has outgrown generic heuristics and now demands mathematical optimization and algorithmic foundations, and calls on the community to recognize algorithmic design for LLM serving as a research frontier.

2605.01208.tldr: The proposed Faithful-Agent is a faithfulness-first framework that reformulates GUI interaction to prioritize evidence groundedness and internal consistency and elevates the Trap SR from 13.88\% to 80.21\% relative to the baseline, while preserving robust general instruction-following performance.

2605.01134.tldr: A verb-based paradigm is introduced, together with precise definitions of timing computation and possibility, that enables AI to function as an effective instrument for realizing the grammar of the authors' thought.

2605.01123.tldr: PerSA is introduced, an RLHF pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning on professor demonstrations, reward modeling from pairwise preferences, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), while deliberately constraining learning to style-bearing components.

2605.01101.tldr: The VST system's potential to augment clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve therapeutic outcomes for individuals with speech impairments is demonstrated, as well as the system's potential to augment clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve therapeutic outcomes for individuals with speech impairments.

2605.01058.tldr: LEAP (Layer-wise Exit-Aware Pretraining), an auxiliary training objective that reconciles this incompatibility between layer-aligned distillation and convergence-based early exit, is introduced, providing operational guidance including latency measurements, decision thresholds, and deployment criteria.

2605.01167.tldr: This work provides a mathematical formalization of collateral damage and introduces a principled framework that models steering as a constrained optimization problem and finds a new activation that minimizes the expected squared collateral change weighted by the empirical second-moment matrix of activations.

2605.01144.tldr: SCOUT is presented, a context-aware concept-grounded multimodal framework for pathology report generation that enables progressive conditioning of image representations by global slide information and explicit diagnostic concepts, and achieves the best BLEU-1 to BLEU-4 and METEOR scores on all datasets.

2605.01143.tldr: This work proposes a complementary defense mechanism: a low-latency fraud detection layer for detecting adversarial interaction patterns in LLM-powered agents and suggests that interaction-level behavioral detection should become a core component of deployment-time defense for LLM-powered agents.

2605.01111.tldr: DUET (Dual-model Efficient Two-stage inference), a collaborative inference framework in which a capable model and a lightweight model work together to solve a task, is introduced with a length-penalized joint training objective that encourages the capable model to transmit only the information that is sufficient for the lightweight model to solve the task.

2605.01097.tldr: An interpretable difficulty-aware conversational KT framework built upon LLMs, which explicitly models students'abilities and the difficulty of tutor-posed tasks at each turn and integrates Item Response Theory to map LLM's outputs into student ability and question difficulty parameters, enabling interpretable prediction of student performance grounded in cognitive theories of learning.

2605.01055.tldr: This work presents SCION, a lightweight policy-orchestration framework that selects among a small set of deployable cache policies using a tiny workload fingerprint computed off the critical path, and improves cacheable-only object miss ratio over SIEVE on a majority of workloads.

2605.01051.tldr: It is shown how the Q function can serve as a safety filter for complex TL specifications, extending prior results beyond simple avoid or reach-avoid tasks, and prove their optimality with respect to the quantitative robustness score for nested Until, Globally, and Globally-Until specifications.

2605.01307.tldr: A three-stage graph neural network (GNN) that integrates heterogeneous and homogeneous graph representations and is trained end-to-end in an unsupervised manner is proposed that consistently outperforms representative system and learning baselines and maintains millisecond-level inference time.

2605.01293.tldr: Experiments demonstrate that NSI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, empowering agents to self-evolve into architects of logic-grounded skills.

2605.01257.tldr: A weakly supervised framework integrating neighborhood-level POI semantic zones with distance-weighted spatial likelihoods, differentiated inference strategies for mandatory and non-mandatory activities, and a multi-phase Pareto optimization that jointly minimizes distributional divergence from household travel survey statistics and maximizes inference reliability without requiring annotated labels is proposed.

2605.01214.tldr: Adopting marginal token allocation as the shared accounting object explains why systems that locally minimize tokens globally misallocate them, predicts a small set of recurring failure modes, and points to a concrete research agenda in token-aware evaluation, autonomy pricing, congestion-priced serving, and risk-adjusted RL budgeting.

2605.01147.tldr: It is argued that agentic AI must be treated as a dynamical system rather than a collection of aligned components, with systems required to demonstrate robustness across architectural variations before deployment.

2605.01566.tldr: A systematic analysis of the inference scaling strategies self-consistency, self-refinement, multi-agent debate, and mixture-of-agents, to study their computational performance tradeoffs and identifies a simple multi-agent design guideline.

2605.01562.tldr: A neuro-symbolic multi-agent system that re-conceptualizes requirements reuse as a Model-Driven Elicitation process that enforces all structural constraints within the agent loop, effectively eliminating hallucinated requirement combinations by construction.

2605.01546.tldr: This paper proposes a four-layer architecture that integrates deterministic network infrastructure, semantic abstraction of intent and context, hierarchical reasoning, and a distributed multi-agent fabric spanning device, edge, and core domains, and establishes agentic intelligence as a viable architectural direction for 6G.

2605.01486.tldr: MAP-Law is proposed, a coverage-driven framework for retrieval control in multi-turn legal consultation that turns stopping from a fixed hyperparameter into an interpretable and auditable decision aligned with legal argumentative structure.

2605.01429.tldr: The Sparse-Composition Agreement Layer (SCALE) is introduced, a post-retrieval audit and composition framework for open-pool LoRA reuse and treats disagreement among sparse composition views as an observable uncertainty signal and compares agreement, support-loss proxy selection, and oracle headroom under explicit path cost.

2605.01423.tldr: This work demonstrates a scalable pathway toward human-AI collaborative systems, where a formally specified DSL acts as an unambiguous translation layer between human expertise, AI automation, and production environment, rendering previously intractable automation problems solvable.

2605.01399.tldr: Verbal-R3, a novel agentic RAG framework that consists of a Generator and a Verbal Reranker, achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex Question Answering benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

2605.01582.tldr: SkillGraph-Service is introduced, an interoperable microservice designed to bridge the gap by unifying these resources into a provenance-preserving Knowledge Graph, adopting a KG-first, LLM-fallback architecture that combines symbolic rigor with sub-symbolic flexibility.

2605.01580.tldr: This thesis studies model merging as an alternative paradigm: combining independently trained neural networks directly in weight space, with little or no optimization and without requiring access to the original training data.

2605.01483.tldr: The technical advancements reported here provide core methodologies to improve the interpretability and operational effectiveness of industrial robots faced with diverse human-robot interaction tasks.

2605.01417.tldr: This work introduces Medmarks, a fully open-source evaluation suite with 30 benchmarks spanning question answering, information extraction, medical calculations, and open-ended clinical reasoning, and shows that frontier reasoning models (Gemini 3 Pro Preview, GPT-5.1, GPT-5.2) achieve the highest performance across both benchmarks.

2605.01392.tldr: An evidence-based characterization of current LLM use in software design from both open-source and practitioner perspectives is provided, highlighting a tension between perceived benefits and limitations, which lays a foundation for future research and the development of effective techniques and tools to integrate LLMs into software design practices.

2605.01345.tldr: This work presents a training-free inference strategy as a practical instantiation of the S-BOED objective, designed as a flexible template that accommodates arbitrary optimisation algorithms, ranging from efficient greedy sampling to look-ahead planning, to approximate the optimal design.

2605.01604.tldr: PAEF (Production Agentic Evaluation Framework), a five-dimension evaluation framework with an open-source reference implementation, designed for continuous evaluation on production traffic rather than episodic benchmark runs, is proposed.

2605.01449.tldr: It is argued that this number conflates two distinct events: (i) the model's output was perturbed (Influence), and (ii) the attacker's chosen target concept was actually emitted (Precise Injection).

2605.01609.tldr: Results suggest transformers may rotate semantic content into spectrally quiet regions during contextualized processing, encoding concepts where they can be manipulated with reduced grammatical disruption.

2605.01341.tldr: This paper provides a comprehensive landscape of the complexity of ABox abduction under repair semantics, treating different variants of the abduction problem for the light-weight description logics DL-Lite and EL_bot.

2605.01542.tldr: A unified framework to bridge the gap between geometric deep learning and rigorous numerical analysis is proposed, and this approach yields consistent improvements in accuracy and stability, particularly in long-horizon rollouts, while producing latent representations that generalize to unseen subtasks such as Wall Shear Stress or Pressure prediction.

2605.01459.tldr: SRGAN--CKAN is proposed, a hybrid super-resolution framework that integrates Convolutional Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (CKAN) into an adversarial learning setting reformulating convolution as a nonlinear patch-based transformation, allowing expressive modeling of complex local structures and high-frequency textures using minimal hardware resources.

2605.01359.tldr: This paper presents a formal and quantitative operationalization of the Minimal Cognitive Grid framework and, through the analysis of its three main dimensions, examines how well each system aligns with standard cognitive theories of the modeled phenomena, thus allowing for comparison of the models with respect to their cognitive plausibility.

2605.01513.tldr: The results indicate that ProMORNA improves the Pareto frontier for predicted half-life and translation efficiency relative to standard supervised baselines, and achieves higher predicted functional scores than a state-of-the-art baseline under the same evaluation pipeline.

2605.01555.tldr: An autonomous multiagent framework for mechanistic interpretability that automates both explaining and finding internal features in large language models is introduced, showing that agent-driven empirical loops yield sharper and more falsifiable explanations than one-shot labels.

2605.01507.tldr: This work introduces the Mediator-in-the-Loop-Driving (MILD) system, based on an agentic system architecture to facilitate synergistic human-vehicle collaboration, and offers a practical pathway for building auditable and aligned agents for human-vehicle collaborative driving.

2605.01490.tldr: This work designs an adaptive separation module that integrates local features and non-local information through K-means clustering, enabling more precise separation of high- and low-frequency components, and introduces a dual-stream refinement module combined with Transformer-based cross-attention to remove various noise.

2605.01468.tldr: Decision Boundary-aware Generation framework is proposed, which promotes near-boundary representation learning by generating informative near-boundary samples and rebalances the long-tailed dataset while yielding more separable decision space for long-tailed learning.

2605.01457.tldr: CoFlow reaches state-of-the-art coordination quality in 1-3 denoising steps under both centralized and decentralized execution, and matches or surpasses Gaussian / value-based, transformer, diffusion, diffusion, and prior flow baselines on episodic return.

2605.01442.tldr: This work first presents formal foundations of contrasting questions and then defines contrastive explanations within description logics, aiming at answering why an axiom P (fact) is true instead of another axiom Q (foil) over description logic knowledge bases.

2605.01424.tldr: A fine-grained theoretical analysis of the generalization properties of multimodal metric learning models is presented, addressing critical gaps in understanding the relationship between modality selection and algorithmic performance.

2605.01415.tldr: This paper reframes AI safety as layered control, authorization, and externally reviewable limits, linking alignment, security engineering, organizational economics, and institutional design, and shows that safety need not require proving that advanced systems are always correct.

2605.01382.tldr: VAEsselSparse is proposed, an efficient encoder-decoder model that leverages the inherent sparsity of 3D vascular structures via sparse convolutions and attention mechanisms to obtain a meaningful yet compact representation of the entire organ-level vascular network at sub-millimeter resolution.

2605.01376.tldr: This approach does not derive or prescribe moral rules from biology, but may give rise to AI with more "real understanding", helping restore epistemic conditions by reducing information overload and amplifying reliable information, thereby supporting the formation of better-informed beliefs and more coherent judgments that benefit society at large.

2605.01373.tldr: FoCore is proposed, a training-free decoding strategy that utilizes HD tokens in a self-contrast manner, wherein HD tokens are temporarily remasked as negative samples, to guide generation, and FoCore-A, an efficient variant that performs parallel decoding over stable candidates within a local context window, substantially accelerating generation.

2605.01356.tldr: This work proposes PROCO, a model-based offline safe reinforcement learning (RL) framework tailored to datasets largely free of violations, and integrates seamlessly with a variety of offline safe RL algorithms and consistently demonstrates reduced constraint violations and improved safety performance.

2605.01347.tldr: This work proposes MAD-OPD (Multi-Agent Debate-driven On-Policy Distillation), which breaks this ceiling by recasting the distillation teacher as a deliberative collective of teachers that debate over the student's on-policy state; the debate produces an emergent collective intelligence that supplies token-level supervision.

2605.01610.tldr: This work proposes three types of explanations that agentic AI needs to incorporate (action-process, uncertainty, and coordination), and suggests that customization affordances that allow users to decide when and which explanations they see may be key to preserving human agency as AI autonomy increases.

2605.01605.tldr: This work introduces S$^2$R$^2$, a segment-level framework for robust LoRA fine-tuning that improves robustness under typographical noise, deletion, synonym replacement, and paraphrasing, while maintaining competitive clean performance and stronger cross-dataset transfer than consistency-based baselines.

2605.01489.tldr: SciResearcher is introduced, a fully automated agentic framework for frontier-science data construction that synthesizes diverse conceptual and computational tasks grounded in academic evidence, while eliciting information acquisition, tool-integrated reasoning, and long-horizon capabilities.

2605.01482.tldr: This work introduces a novel framework that grounds reasoning in a Structural Causal Model (SCM), treating verification as a constructive causal inference process, and empirically identifies an"inverted U-shaped"correlation between reasoning chain length and accuracy.

2605.01478.tldr: LIE, LiDAR-only semantic map construction method that employ Knowledge Distillation (KD) to handle the lack of dense semantic and texture cues is proposed, and Experimental results show that the method outperforms all single-modality approaches.

2605.01471.tldr: The findings suggest that reliable autonomous testing in enterprise-scale settings requires explicit constraints, validation boundaries, and human oversight to preserve semantic correctness and operational trustworthiness.

2605.01404.tldr: AMSnet-q is presented, a fully automated, unsupervised pipeline that eliminates human-in-the-loop annotation by converting schematic images directly into a labeled AMS circuit database by converting schematic images directly into a labeled AMS circuit database.

2605.01401.tldr: The AI Expert Twin is introduced, a cognition-centric framework that models expert knowledge as structured, computable representations of procedural actions, semantic concepts, and decision processes and formalises expert cognition as a three-layer representation and captures knowledge from experts under this model, laying the groundwork for integration into AI-powered educational system.

2605.01394.tldr: This work presents the first systematic and contamination-aware study of LLM- and agent-based formal specification generation for C programs, and introduces LiveFMBench, a continuously evolving benchmark of 630 ACSL/ISO C Specification Language-annotated C programs.

2605.01369.tldr: MU-SHOT-Fi is proposed, a source-free unsupervised domain adaptation framework for single- and multi-user Wi-Fi sensing that effectively recovers multi-user exact-activity classification performance under large domain shifts while maintaining accurate occupancy estimation and preventing collapse toward dominant classes.

2605.01355.tldr: AgriKD, a cross-architecture knowledge distillation framework for efficient edge deployment, which transfers knowledge from a Vision Transformer (ViT) teacher to a compact convolutional student model to better preserve and utilize transformer-derived global representations is introduced.

2605.01865.tldr: This framework combines a return-conditioned sigmoid schedule for global intensity control with a per-agent Reward Signal Quality metric that concentrates the exploration budget on agents with reliable signals that achieves top-tier returns across all environments.

2605.01833.tldr: This work addresses the challenge of remote control where one or more actors, lacking direct reward access, are steered by a controller over a communication-constrained channel, and introduces a novel framework leveraging remote generation.

2605.01829.tldr: GeoSAE is proposed, a geometry-guided SAE framework that uses the foundation model's learned manifold structure to prevent feature collapse and annotates each surviving feature via age-deconfounded partial correlations, showing that geometry-guided SAEs can extract interpretable, biomarkers from frozen brain MRI foundation models.

2605.01758.tldr: A training-free Foresight-Guided Local Purification (FLP) framework, where each agent reasons over future interactions to track behavioral evolution and eliminate infections, is proposed, which reduces the maximum cumulative infection rate from over 95% to below 5.47%.

2605.01727.tldr: It is argued that LLM-based credibility assessment may not only evaluate truth claims but also differentially recognize the legitimacy of journalistic genres, and that evaluation should therefore include genre-stratified false-positive analysis alongside overall accuracy.

2605.01688.tldr: These findings establish structured context anchoring as a broadly effective, architecture-agnostic augmentation paradigm for long-horizon conversational memory.

2605.01611.tldr: It would be desirable if the providers of ESM3 and similar biological models were subject to obligations to assess and mitigate dual-use risks from their models, which would require them to assess and mitigate dual-use risks from their models.

2605.01879.tldr: This report provides an exhaustive analysis, justification, and extension of the STP framework, exploring its categorical foundations, implementation feasibility, and role in the future of resilient autonomous systems.

2605.01866.tldr: ShiftLIF, a multi-level spiking neuron that maps membrane potentials to a logarithmically spaced power-of-two spike set, provides finer representation in the small-amplitude regime, while enabling multiplier-free synaptic computation through bit-shift and accumulation operations.

2605.01809.tldr: TMD-Bench is introduced, a benchmark for text-driven music-dance co-generation that assesses systems across unimodal generation quality, instruction adherence, and cross-modal rhythmic alignment and reveals that modern commercial audio-visual models, such as Veo 3 and Sora 2, produce high-quality music and video, while rhythmic coupling remains less consistently optimized and leaves room for improvement.

2605.01789.tldr: DataEvolver is a reusable framework for building visual datasets through explicit goal tracking, review, correction, and acceptance loops, and shows a consistent improvement path from scene-aware generation to feedback-driven correction and dual-gated validation.

2605.01783.tldr: Momentum is presented, an endless-runner game that integrates runtime terrain generation, environment object spawning, and autonomous agent-based evaluation into a single gameplay loop, and formulates a measurable evaluation framework along the canonical PCG axes of playability, diversity, controllability, and runtime performance.

2605.01745.tldr: Overall, governed language-data platforms should calibrate pricing under uncertain access costs first and verify only when information is cheap and decision-actionable, in order to remain competitive with price-only and risk-aware baselines.

2605.01708.tldr: SplitZip is a GPU-friendly lossless compressor for KV-cache transfer that exploits redundancy in floating-point exponents of KV activations, encoding the most frequent exponent values with fixed-length codes, and encoding (position, value) pairs and value of rare exponents in an escape stream.

2605.01679.tldr: The proposed Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy framework integrated with a hybrid 3D Convolutional Neural Network and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory architecture achieves competitive performance and provides formal privacy guarantees, which are largely overlooked in existing studies.

2605.01656.tldr: A brain-inspired learning primitive in which cognition-level neural synchrony emerges through iterative bottom-up and top-down interactions between micro-scale dynamics of spiking neurons and a macro-scale mechanism of oscillatory synchronization is proposed.

2605.01643.tldr: Experiments on an LLM coding pipeline show that adaptive reward profiles can maintain useful oversight pressure and improve principal-aligned outcomes relative to static hand-designed rewards, including a substantial reduction in hallucinated incorrect attempts.

2605.01834.tldr: This work demonstrates weak backdoor effects become reliable signals for dataset IP protection in challenging CL settings by proposing a multi-level watermarking scheme adapting to feature-level, soft-label, or hard-label outputs in CL.

2605.01831.tldr: This work introduces RMGAP, a benchmark comprising 1,097 instances across Chat, Writing, Reasoning, and Safety domains and examines the generalizability of reward models, finding considerable room for improvement in reward model generalization.

2605.01794.tldr: A novel paradigm that leverages large language model (LLM)-guided evolutionary search to autonomously discover a closed-form power allocation solution for multi-target tracking achieves near-optimal tracking accuracy, reliable generalization across diverse scenarios and target counts, and over three orders of magnitude speedup compared to conventional iterative solvers.

2605.01740.tldr: It is argued that unhardened agentic-AI runtimes are architecturally obsolete: a strictly better alternative exists, is adoptable today, and the gap requires re-architecture rather than configuration.

2605.01676.tldr: This work proposes MissBGM, an AI-powered missing data imputation method via Bayesian generative modeling that bridges the expressive flexibility of neural networks with the statistical rigor of Bayesian inference.

2605.01675.tldr: CP-SynC (Constraint Programming modeling with Synthesized Checkers), a multi-agent workflow for zero-shot constraint modeling in MiniZinc, substantially outperforms existing baselines in MiniZinc modeling.

2605.01668.tldr: IMPACT-Scribe is introduced, a correction-driven framework for dense labeling that uses each correction to improve future human-machine collaboration and improves labeling quality per effort, enhances boundary accuracy, and fosters better human-machine interaction over time.

2605.01630.tldr: This work introduces Prosa, the first real user multi-turn Brazilian Portuguese chat benchmark, and shows that switching to binary rubric scoring with multi-judge filtering removes sensitivity, making the rubric-based scoring method reusable beyond Prosa, supporting other open-ended evaluation settings.

2605.01616.tldr: Encrypted network traffic is established as a viable passive sensing modality, revealing interpretable behavioral dynamics -- particularly deviations from an individual's baseline -- that are not visible in raw traffic features.

2605.01810.tldr: FedTGNN-SS is proposed, a privacy-preserving federated semi-supervised framework for clinical tabular EHR that combines prototype-guided pseudo-labeling with neighborhood agreement, adaptive graph refinement that periodically updates the k-NN graph using learned embeddings, and clinical-aware consistency augmentation applied only to continuous variables.

2605.01777.tldr: This work explores a channel estimation mechanism at 7GHz frequency band for a given user location using Linear Regression, Support Vector Regression and Decision Tree Regression and explored Linear Regression, Support Vector Regression and Decision Tree Regression.

2605.01750.tldr: An iterated, multi-turn negotiation game in which two agents allocate shared resources toward private projects with verifiable jointly optimal outcomes is introduced, highlighting dynamic grounding as a critical and understudied axis of multi-agent coordination.

2605.01733.tldr: GEASS (Gated Evidence-Aware Selective Steering), a training-free module that decides on each query how much of the caption the model consumes: it gates the caption by the clean path's confidence, weights it by the entropy reduction it produces, and raises the evidence bar when the two pathways disagree.

2605.01726.tldr: FEDIN introduces a frequency-domain branch that utilizes a target-aware spectrum filtering mechanism to isolate these periodic interest signals and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art sequential recommendation baselines, demonstrating superior robustness against noise.

2605.01720.tldr: SignVerse-2M, a large-scale multilingual pose-native dataset for sign language pose modeling and evaluation, built from publicly available multilingual sign language video resources, is presented, demonstrating the feasibility of this resource for multilingual pose-space modeling and its compatibility with modern pose-driven pipelines.

2605.01710.tldr: The paper introduces the route-receipt concept, a minimal schema and redaction model, and a documentation-based survey of selected platforms showing that receipt fragments already exist without a portable per-answer record.

2605.01699.tldr: This work characterises where this retention lives and shows it can be surgically removed without measurable capability cost, and extends PGA adversarially, defeating the re-fit probe at every memorisation-relevant depth while preserving five zero-shot capability benchmarks within 2.8 percentage points per task.

2605.01853.tldr: Investigation of hidden-state transitions across decoding steps and layers identifies a distinct spatiotemporal pattern in LRMs: successful trajectories exhibit broad temporal dynamics with localized layer-wise concentration, while this structure is weaker in non-reasoning models and knowledge-heavy domains.

2605.01848.tldr: A Feature Purifier, a cross-attention-based erasure mechanism that identifies and suppresses disease-correlated channels, yielding purified anatomical representations and Delta Steering, a training-free directional signal derived from the ordinal embeddings that enables explicit, single-pass control over disease transitions at inference without requiring additional forward passes.

2605.01847.tldr: NeuroState-Bench is a human-calibrated benchmark that operationalizes commitment integrity through benchmark-defined side-query probes rather than inferred hidden activations, and contributes a calibrated evaluation axis for exposing commitment failures over a broader model grid than the original local-only subset.

2605.01882.tldr: This work proposes Focus-CoT, a visual focusing chain-of-thought that enhances fine-grained perception by explicitly linking reasoning steps to key visual cues, such as local image regions and OCR signals, and introduces Focus-GRPO, a focus-driven reinforcement learning algorithm with an information-efficiency reward that compresses redundant visual information for efficient focusing.

2605.01823.tldr: A Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum (SGAC) approach, which employs a learnable selector model on a multi-dimensional feature space consisting of success probability, reward variance, output disagreement, and semantic difficulty level, and confirms that entropy-based intelligent data curation leads to strict reasoning improvement over static training methods, particularly in severely limited data conditions.

2605.01797.tldr: A new method to compute stable models, called decision-propagation (DProp), which alternates falsity decisions and truth propagations and can learn to efficiently compute stable models, and it improves accuracy and scalability on neuro-symbolic benchmarks.

2605.01790.tldr: A key finding is that text--vocal alignment can emerge within pure acoustic-token language modeling, without requiring a separate semantic token stage, suggesting that high-quality music generation can be effectively pursued without separating structure and fidelity into heterogeneous representation spaces.

2605.01771.tldr: This work calls this the Compliance Gap: a third, orthogonal axis of AI honesty distinct from factual truthfulness and rhetorical substance, and releases BS-Bench: the first open benchmark for process compliance, with seven tool-call-log audit metrics and a public leaderboard.

2605.01725.tldr: MotionCache is proposed, a motion-aware cache framework that exploits inter-frame differences as a lightweight proxy for pixel-level motion characteristics and employs a coarse-to-fine strategy: an initial warm-up phase establishes semantic coherence, followed by motion-weighted cache reuse that dynamically adjusts update frequencies per token.

2605.01717.tldr: A new framework that combines Thread-Constrained Directed Acyclic Graph (TC-DAG) and Discourse-Aware Rotary Position Embedding (D-RoPE) is proposed, which filters out cross-thread noise based on thread constraints, maintains global connectivity through root anchoring, and incorporates the temporal sequence of the dialogues.

2605.01698.tldr: This work addresses BIM heterogeneity with a new paradigm, adaptive exploration, where an LLM-based agent iteratively executes code to extract information from a BIM model, discovering its structure at runtime instead of assuming it.

2605.01694.tldr: A functional taxonomy is proposed that groups methods by what their latent state is for, rather than by architecture or application domain: predictive embedding, recurrent belief state, object/causal structure, latent action interface, grounded planning interface, and memory substrate.

2605.01659.tldr: This work proposes TRIMMER (Temporal Relative Information Maximization for Multi-objective Efficient Reinforcement), a novel self-supervised reinforcement learning framework for video summarization that achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised and self-supervised methods, while remaining competitive with leading supervised approaches.

2605.01874.tldr: It is formally established that the performance of a classifier trained on a subset of a noisy dataset selected via cutstats is influenced by the accuracy of k-NN, and it is demonstrated that for real-world scenarios, learnt invariant representations can still facilitate the identification of near-optimal subsets.

2509.24662.tldr: This work conducts a systematic computational evaluation of six widely adopted GNN architectures and indicates that supervised GNNs tend to achieve higher baseline accuracy, while unsupervised methods maintain stronger resilience under targeted and adversarial perturbations.

2509.14274.tldr: This paper demonstrated that the framework rediscovered theorems with verification which were published in past mathematical papers and have not yet formalized and could not be proved by the LLM without in-context learning, which means that in-context learning was effective for neural theorem proving.

2501.03717.tldr: This paper proposes Materialist, a method combining a learning-based approach with physically based progressive differentiable rendering that enables a range of applications, including material editing, object insertion, and relighting, while also introducing an effective method for editing material transparency without requiring full scene geometry.

2506.07548.tldr: A Counterfactual Group Relative Policy Advantage (CGRPA), which is tightly coupled with the curriculum by providing intrinsic credit signals that reflect each agent's impact under evolving task demands, and improves both training stability and final performance, achieving competitive results against state-of-the-art methods.

2508.04204.tldr: ReasoningGuard is proposed, an inference-time safeguard for LRMs, which injects timely safety aha moments to steer harmless while helpful reasoning processes, and outperforms seven existing safeguards, achieving state-of-the-art safety defenses while effectively avoiding the common exaggerated safety issues.

2504.05407.tldr: This paper introduces a framework called Transformer-Based Task Scheduling System (TRATSS), designed to address the intricacies of single agent scheduling in graph-based environments and provides a novel system that outputs optimized task scheduling decisions while dynamically adapting to evolving task requirements and resource availability.

2312.06423.tldr: MalPurifier is introduced, a novel adversarial purification framework specifically engineered for Android malware detection that robustly defends against a comprehensive set of 37 perturbation-based evasion attacks, consistently achieving robust accuracies above 90.91%.

2507.14874.tldr: The Graph Tsetlin Machine (GraphTM) is introduced for learning interpretable deep clauses from graph-structured input and is competitive with BiLSTM-CNN and GCN accuracy-wise, training 2.5x faster than GCN.

2505.06518.tldr: Distributional Point-Based Value Iteration (DPBVI), which integrates psi-vectors into a standard point-based backup procedure-bridging DistRL and POMDP planning and proposes a finite representation of these return distributions via psi-vectors, generalizing the classical alpha-vectors in POMDP solvers.

2508.08289.tldr: A novel theoretical framework is presented that reinterprets the core computation of attention as Pavlovian conditioning and suggests that the success of modern AI may stem not from architectural novelty alone, but from implementing computational principles that biology optimized over millions of years of evolution.

2507.20021.tldr: Re-evaluating an instruction-guided pipeline under a detector-controlled setting and introducing two training-free variants that only alter the action value map suggest that carefully engineered frontier geometry accounts for much of the reported progress, and that language is most reliable as a light heuristic rather than an end-to-end planner.

2412.03831.tldr: An algorithm that has similarities to large language models in generative AI and natural language processing is designed and discussed that provides accurate results for this larger-dimensional problem with sub-kcal/mol accuracy for the higher-dimensional potential energy surface problem.

2408.10872.tldr: V-RoAst, a zero-shot Visual Question Answering (VQA) framework using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to classify road safety attributes defined by the iRAP standard is introduced and the first open-source dataset from ThaiRAP comprising over 2,000 curated street-level images from Thailand is introduced.

2601.05811.tldr: New algorithms for reconstruction-based manifold learning within Reproducing-Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHS) are proposed, using and adapting well-known results of kernel learning theory to represent an extended approach to the autorepresentation property.

2505.00020.tldr: Whether OpenAI’s large language models were trained on copyrighted content without consent is investigated using the DE-COP membership inference attack method and results highlight the urgent need for increased corporate transparency regarding pre-training data sources as a means to develop formal licensing frameworks for AI content training.

2508.19035.tldr: A novel evaluation paradigm, \textit{black-box interaction}, is introduced, to tackle the challenge of evaluating reasoning ability of Large Language Models in an interactive, unknown environment and indicates a universal difficulty among LLMs.

2507.16594.tldr: This paper presents the first end-to-end TinyML + SL testbed built on Espressif ESP32-S3 boards, designed to benchmark the over-the-air performance of split learning TinyML in edge/IoT environments.

2301.06217.tldr: This analysis shows that Boltzmann machines and neural networks have a similar mathematical structure, and is forced to conclude that neural networks are naturally related to Feynman path-integrals and hence may present one avenue to be considered as quantum problems.

2512.06393.tldr: The results demonstrate that, for reliable multi-step reasoning, structural verification discipline is as critical as training data scale, providing a potential blueprint for building robust, contradiction-aware AI systems.

2505.05880.tldr: A data/computation-efficient neuro-symbolic approach to the interpretation problem, where the candidate interpretations returned by the example-driven sequence tagger is refined by the AAF-based reasoner, which allows us to also leverage prior knowledge to compensate for the scarcity of example data.

2505.00359.tldr: A clustering algorithm based on the novel concept of Tightest Neighbors and a data stream clustering theory based on the Skeleton Set are introduced, both of which validate the proposed data stream clustering theory.

2406.04952.tldr: Investigating the prevalence of geospatial data in recent Common Crawl releases using Gemini 1.5, a powerful language model, provides quantitative insights into the nature and extent of geospatial data in CC, and complement existing studies on geospatial knowledge and biases of LLMs.

2509.21542.tldr: Overall, functional behaviours and interactive experiences with agents can resemble those with humans, whereas fundamental social attributions and moral/prosocial concerns lag in human-agent interactions.

2602.05817.tldr: This work introduces an interpretable pipeline that generates directly visualizable low-dimensional representations by mapping high-dimensional embeddings onto a latent manifold, while integrated feature attribution techniques decode the specific characteristics shaping the manifold structure.

2604.09554.tldr: Evaluating performance of current frontier models is evaluated, and it is shown that while abilities measured by LAB-Bench and LABBench2 have improved substantially, LABBench2 provides a meaningful jump in difficulty and underscores continued room for performance improvement.

2603.00492.tldr: This work trains a powerful bidirectional generative model with a novel opacity mixing strategy that encourages consistency with existing observations while retaining the model's ability to extrapolate novel content in unseen areas, and distill it into a causal auto-regressive model that generates hundreds of frames in a single pass.

2602.22291.tldr: This paper introduces a framework for systematically mapping the Manifold of Failure in Large Language Models, using MAP-Elites to illuminate the continuous topology of these failure regions, which are term behavioral attraction basins, and reframe the search for vulnerabilities as a quality diversity problem.

2602.17753.tldr: The 2025 AI Agent Index documents information regarding the origins, design, capabilities, ecosystem, and safety features of 30 state-of-the-art AI agents based on publicly available information and email correspondence with developers.

2603.13286.tldr: An interdisciplinary workshop to collaboratively examine key tensions in translating AI ethics principles into practice and to identify potential solutions informed by meta-research approaches is convened, demonstrating how meta-research can offer concrete contributions to address pressing challenges of TAI in healthcare.

2604.25370.tldr: The GPT-Image-2 Twitter Dataset is introduced, the first published dataset of GPT-image-2 generated images, sourced from publicly available Twitter/X posts in the immediate aftermath of the model's April 21, 2026 release.

2602.13280.tldr: BEAGLE is a neuro-symbolic framework that addresses competency bias by incorporating Self-Regulated Learning (SRL) theory into a novel architecture and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in reproducing authentic trajectories on Python programming tasks.

2604.23088.tldr: The results suggest that parallel specialised agents produce readable, developer oriented feedback, while also highlighting current limitations in evaluation depth, security tooling, large repository handling, and the current use of only in memory persistence.

2604.08059.tldr: This work proposes a lifecycle-aware upgrade framework in which every new capability version is treated as a governed deployment candidate rather than an immediately executable replacement and introduces four upgrade compatibility checks -- interface, policy, behavioral, and recovery.

2603.26114.tldr: DPD-Cancer is introduced, a deep learning method designed for small molecule anti-cancer activity classification and the quantitative prediction of cell-line specific responses, specifically growth inhibition concentration (pGI50).

2603.20684.tldr: This work proposes a graph centrality-based pruning approach that interprets the reservoir as a weighted directed graph and removes structurally less important nodes using centrality measures, and can significantly reduce reservoir size while maintaining, and in some cases improving, prediction accuracy.

2605.04062.tldr: The EdgeRazor framework contains three modules: Mixed-Precision Quantization-Aware Distillation for the fine-grained control of precision, Adaptive Feature Distillation that derives an n-bit student from its 16-bit teacher, and Entropy-Aware KL Divergence on both human-annotated and distilled datasets, whose forward-reverse balance is determined solely by the teacher's output distribution.

2605.04060.tldr: At each training iteration, the model is optimized by pushing its output towards the direction of the (weighted) summation of the drifting terms, so that their magnitudes are in a comparable range.

2605.02973.tldr: This work proposes a diffusion-bridge framework that characterizes the space of admissible solutions and restricts it via alignment constraints, treating paired supervision as an optional heuristic rather than a prerequisite, and achieves near fully-paired quality with a substantial relaxation in pairing requirements.

2605.02317.tldr: The proposed Anon (Adaptivity Non-restricted Optimizer with Novel convergence technique) is a novel optimizer with continuously tunable adaptivity in R, allowing it to interpolate between SGD-like and Adam-like behaviors and even extrapolate beyond both.

2605.02167.tldr: Manifold-Aligned Guided Integrated Gradients (MA-GIG) is proposed, which constructs attribution paths in the latent space of a pre-trained variational autoencoder and produces faithful explanations by aggregating gradients on path features proximal to the input.

2604.26172.tldr: A physics-informed learning framework for energy-shaping control of port-Hamiltonian (pH) systems from trajectory data is developed and validated on state-regulation and swing-up tasks for planar and torsional pendulum systems.

2605.02475.tldr: Shadow-Loom is an experimental open-source framework that turns a narrative into a versioned graphical world model and lets two engines act on it: a causal physics grounded in Pearl's ladder of causation and a recently proposed counterfactual calculus over Ancestral Multi-World Networks.

2605.04071.tldr: FlatASCEND, a 14.5M-parameter autoregressive clinical sequence model using flat composite tokens and a zero-inflated log-normal time head, is presented, illustrating reward exploitation when reward and evaluation share an outcome domain.

2605.04057.tldr: This paper proposes Structured Progressive Knowledge Activation (SPARK), which activates relevant priors by explicitly selecting the functional factor to modify and conditioning the edit on that factor, which reduces entangled side effects and yields more targeted, reliable architecture modifications.

2605.03862.tldr: Extensive experiments on code and math benchmarks show that this executor-grounded reasoning reward improves the two-stage planner-executor system over execution-only training, suggesting that reasoning supervision should evaluate not only whether a trace looks good, but also whether it helps the model that consumes it.

2605.03598.tldr: It is shown that the spatial and temporal function of recurrent neural networks trained on hierarchically modular tasks can be recovered by modelling the network as a graph and analysing the multi-hop pathways between input and output units, and suggested that sparsity should be defined over functional pathways rather than individual parameters.

2605.03212.tldr: ADAPTS (Agentic Decomposition for Automated Protocol-agnostic Tracking of Symptoms), a framework for automated rating of depression and anxiety severity using a mixture ofagents LLM architecture, provides a foundation for objective and scalable psychiatric assessment, especially in resource-limited settings.

2605.02489.tldr: GRAIL (Granular Resonance-based Agent/AI Link), a novel framework achieving sub-400ms discovery latency without compromising accuracy, offers a scalable, industrial-grade solution for the real-time ``Internet of Agents.

2605.02320.tldr: The Redescending Influence Principle is proposed, a paradigm shift from monotonic penalties and hard-thresholding (PPO) to dynamic outlier suppression (ANO) to prove its necessity for stability in high-variance stochastic optimization.

2605.00764.tldr: Experiments show that gaze alone already carries useful predictive signals for subjective urban perception, and that integrating gaze with scene representations further improves prediction under both semantic and richer visual representations.

2604.27953.tldr: Investigation of the effects of visual priming on VLMs' cooperative behavior using the Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma as a test scenario shows that VLM behavior can be influenced by both image content and color cues, with varying susceptibility and mitigation effectiveness across models.

2604.27201.tldr: Across math and science reasoning benchmarks, PLE maintains strong think performance while producing a substantially stronger no-think mode that is more accurate, more concise, and far less prone to reasoning leakage, suggesting that controllable hybrid thinking is fundamentally an architectural problem, and separating mode-specific feed-forward pathways is a simple and effective solution.

2605.04068.tldr: This research aims to enhance automatic forecasting model selection by proposing a novel architecture that acts as a double deep reinforcement learning agent, selecting automatically a forecasting model from the forecasting committee at the time of prediction.

2605.04063.tldr: This study conducts a rigorous study of fairness in AD progression analysis and proposes two novel fairness metrics, called Time-Dependent Concordance Impurity and Kaplan-Meier Fairness, to quantify bias with respect to sensitive attributes such as sex, race, and education in nonparametric survival models.

2605.04058.tldr: This work proposes a novel Mixed-Precision Interactive Side Mixture-of-Experts framework (MP-ISMoE), which learns to select optimal experts by interacting with salient features from frozen backbones, thus suppressing knowledge forgetting and boosting performance.

2605.04050.tldr: This work introduces Lossless Context Management (LCM), a deterministic architecture for LLM memory that outperforms Claude Code on long-context tasks and demonstrates that recursive context manipulation can outperform not just conventional LLMs, but frontier coding agents with native file-system access.

2605.03361.tldr: ReasonAudio is introduced, the first reasoning-intensive benchmark for Text-Audio Retrieval, comprising 1,000 queries and 10,000 composite audio clips across five fundamental reasoning tasks: Negation, Order, Overlap, Duration, and Mix.

2605.03278.tldr: This work proposes a copula-corrected doubly robust estimator that addresses endogeneity in both the treatment and outcome models without requiring instrumental variables, and provides researchers with a practical tool for obtaining treatment effects in the presence of endogeneity.

2605.02740.tldr: This work presents ReClaim, a generative transformer trained from scratch on 43.8 billion medical events from more than 200 million enrollees in the MarketScan claims data spanning 2008-2022, and shows that learned representations generalize across time periods and data sources, supporting disease surveillance, expenditure forecasting, and RWE generation.

2605.02669.tldr: This work argues that DILI prediction is better posed as an explainable hypothesis-generation problem, and introduces the DILER Benchmark, a dataset that extends beyond binary labels by augmenting a curated set of molecules with mechanistic hepatotoxicity hypotheses derived from biomedical literature.

2605.02003.tldr: RamanBench is introduced, the first large-scale, fully reproducible benchmark for ML on Raman spectroscopy, consisting of streamlined data access, evaluation protocols and code, as well as a live leaderboard, with the potential to accelerate advances in critical applications such as medical diagnostics, biological research, and materials science.

2604.26689.tldr: The atomic-quality probe is the first principled, deployment-ready primitive for skill-update governance in compositional robot policies, and its Pareto frontier on 144 skill-update decisions is characterized.

2605.04072.tldr: Under full-sequence simple linear probes, SAE features outperform dense representations for discrete event prediction (mortality) while dense representations outperform for continuous magnitude prediction (length of stay) - a probe-level representational phenomenon that does not extend to clinically relevant leakage-safe windows.

2605.04069.tldr: It is proved that LAWS generalizes both Mixture-of-Experts and KV prefix caching as special cases and is strictly more expressive than any fixed-K MoE or finite cache, and conjecture that LAWS is acquisition-optimal among stationary online caching algorithms.

2605.04056.tldr: This work studies unsupervised categorization of transformations between pairs of inputs under algebraic constraints, and shows that group-decomposition constraints drive appropriate categorization.

2605.03941.tldr: This work proposes iWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for training and testing world models on interaction-related abilities such as distance perception and memory, and introduces an Action Generation Framework to unify evaluation and design six task types.

2605.03929.tldr: PHALAR establishes new retrieval state-of-the-art across MoisesDB, Slakh, and ChocoChorales, correlating significantly higher with human coherence judgment than semantic baselines, and captures robust musical structures beyond the retrieval task.

2605.03410.tldr: A unified framework that achieves out-of-distribution OOD detection through information-geometric analysis of diffusion trajectories, with key insight is that diffusion noise predictions are score functions (gradients of log-density), and it extracts two energy features that form a discrete Sobolev norm capturing how samples interact with the learned diffusion process.

2605.02910.tldr: The results suggest that creative tool use remains a major challenge for current models, and that CreativityBench provides a useful testbed for studying this missing dimension of intelligence, with potential implications for planning and reasoning modules in future agents.

2605.02463.tldr: Results show that immediate quality degradation can coexist with statistically detectable antifragility-compatible stress geometry, and are shown to show that immediate quality degradation can coexist with statistically detectable antifragility-compatible stress geometry.

2605.01704.tldr: This work names the multi-agent case the Debate Trap and the broader phenomenon the Reasoning Trap, offering a programmatic theory of evidence-grounded reasoning failure, and offers one falsifiable conjecture: any closed-system reasoning protocol preserving Theorem 1's Markov structure is, in expectation, subject to the same DPI bound.

2605.04070.tldr: The findings suggest that the primary bottleneck is not human task accuracy per se, but the ability to route decisions to humans when it matters and to design assistance methods that enable humans to catch AI mistakes.

2605.03348.tldr: S3 improves accuracy and shows a consistent reverse U-shaped sparsity-performance trend, with peak performance at intermediate sparsity, suggesting that structuring multimodal representations as selectable semantic components provides a practical and principled alternative to contrastive learning or InfoMax-driven approaches.

2605.03269.tldr: This work introduces RLDX-1, a general-purpose robotic policy for dexterous manipulation built on the Multi-Stream Action Transformer (MSAT), an architecture that unifies these capabilities by integrating heterogeneous modalities through modality-specific streams with cross-modal joint self-attention.

2604.27891.tldr: A controlled comparison is presented showing that for procedural tasks, external orchestration of agent orchestration frameworks is dominated by a simpler alternative: putting the entire procedure in the system prompt and letting the model self-orchestrate.

2604.27859.tldr: A deep insight is provided for looking the conceptual foundations, methodological innovations, and effective designs underlying the trend towards agentic paradigms within RL.

2604.27629.tldr: It is demonstrated that small models with domain-specific training can surpass proprietary large models in specialized industrial visual understanding, offering a viable path for privacy-preserving, cost-effective deployment in semiconductor manufacturing.

2605.04308.tldr: A principled framework that models autoregressive language generation as a Markov process over tokens, where model memory is represented by a Markov transition matrix, and preserving existing transitions guarantees retention of previously learned knowledge is proposed.
