2605.04225.tldr: This work proposes a centralized, fully end-to-end auto-regressive framework that jointly generates allocation decisions and routing sequences and enables the model to implicitly balance workload distribution with routing efficiency, avoiding local optima common in decentralized methods.

2605.04193.tldr: An Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor (ANDRE), a novel ILP framework that learns first-order logic programs by optimizing over a continuous rule space with attention-based logical operators that approximate logical min-max semantics, enabling accurate, stable, and interpretable reasoning over probabilistic data.

2605.04373.tldr: ReGuard is a framework that discovers worst-case scenarios for a given RL controller and protects it against them at inference time without retraining, and shrinks gaps 57% to 6$\times$ larger than those found by the strongest baselines but also shrinks them by 79% via lightweight rule-based protection while preserving nominal performance.

2605.04361.tldr: A crossover effect is found on multi-agent software design across 10 tasks, 7 context-injection conditions, and over 2,700 runs, and it is found that an irrelevant document performs as well as or better than every relevant artifact on several tasks.

2605.04356.tldr: This paper develops methods to align language models in fuzzy domains where human experts are still able to provide high-quality supervision signal, but only for a small number of model outputs, using online natural language feedback.

2605.04109.tldr: This paper studies the tradeoffs between power, resource utilization, inference speed, and model accuracy when varying the depth and width of LGNs synthesized for Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA).

2605.04098.tldr: Estimation of benchmark performance substantially overestimates the real-world clinical capability of current dermatology MLLMs, suggesting potential utility for screening but insufficient reliability for clinical deployment.

2605.04097.tldr: Overall, CTM-AI offers a principled, testable blueprint for general AI inspired by a model of consciousness, combining the Conscious Turing Machine (CTM), a formal machine model of consciousness, with today's foundation models.

2605.04084.tldr: FASQ (Flexible Accelerated Subspace Quantization), a calibration-free framework that applies product quantization to LLM weight matrices, is presented, offering calibration-free compression, continuous size-quality trade-offs, and real-time inference on a single consumer GPU.

2605.04083.tldr: This work argues that the central challenge in post-training today is the faithful encoding of expert requirements into the evaluation itself, and presents AsymmetryZero, a framework for operationalizing human expert preferences as semantic evals.

2605.04079.tldr: Experimental results show that the LoRA-MoE framework achieves powerful diagnostic performance while activating significantly fewer parameters during inference, highlighting the potential of the proposed approach as an accurate and computationally efficient solution for handwriting-based Alzheimer's disease screening and digital health applications.

2605.04363.tldr: The first test-time posterior adjustment method designed for tabular foundation models, DistPFN rescales predicted class probabilities by downweighting the influence of the training prior and emphasizing the contribution of the model's predicted posterior, without architectural modification or additional training is proposed.

2605.04305.tldr: SWAN's approach of anchoring watermarks in AMR semantic structures provides a simple, effective, and prompt-based method for robust text provenance verification under paraphrasing, opening new avenues for semantic-level watermarking research.

2605.04295.tldr: Extensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed Adaptive Conformal Semantic Entropy (ACSE) approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art uncertainty quantification baselines using discriminative performance, conformal guarantees, and probabilistic calibration indicators.

2605.04243.tldr: A novel neuro-symbolic question-answering framework governed by a Probabilistic Inconsistency Signal that explicitly isolates perceptual errors from reasoning failures is introduced, charting a verifiable path forward for reliable neuro-symbolic AI.

2605.04230.tldr: Layerwise LQR is introduced, a framework for learning structured inverse preconditioners under a global layerwise optimal-control objective and establishes LLQR as a practical framework for geometry-aware second-order methods and a reference for evaluating scalable approximations.

2605.04209.tldr: It is proved that distinguishing the backdoor-injected model from this reference is at least as hard as Sparse PCA detection, which is computationally infeasible under standard hardness assumptions.

2605.04198.tldr: Across several 2D and 3D flow benchmarks, DW-Net models consistently improve the Pareto frontier over single-wave U-Nets, achieving higher accuracy at matched cost or similar accuracy at reduced cost, and reaching low-error regimes with up to 3x less training time under identical training settings.

2605.04118.tldr: ProtDBench is introduced, a standardized and throughput-aware evaluation framework for protein binder design that supports systematic and controlled comparison of protein binder design methods under realistic evaluation settings.

2605.04341.tldr: Results suggest that, under compute-constrained distillation, retaining behavior is less about matching perplexity or removing more parameters than it is about controlling how dense computation is transferred to low-rank pathways.

2605.04313.tldr: This work introduces NoisyCausal, a new benchmark designed to evaluate causal reasoning under structured noise, and proposes a modular reasoning framework that combines LLMs with explicit causal structure to address these challenges.

2605.04274.tldr: The key insight of MCBP is to use mean curvature as a principled descriptor of boundary structure: high-curvature regions naturally correspond to transitions between clusters, geometric irregularities, and low-density interfaces, which yields a unified geometric interpretation of boundary, outlier, and transition points.

2605.04263.tldr: Parallel prefix verification is introduced, a speculative generation framework that accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by parallelizing prefix verification on a semantic level, enabling semantic-level verification without sequential checks.

2605.04180.tldr: ETHER, a modular word-level fabrication detector integrating Text2Table Decomposition, Word Masking and Filling and Hybrid Sentence Pair Evaluation to enhance factual alignment, is introduced, offering a comprehensive framework for reliable and domain-specific factuality detection.

2605.04169.tldr: Experiments on recorded surgical procedures show that structured modeling of team interactions improves early identification of prolonged interventions and provides coherent, actionable explanations, and advances surgical AI toward real-time, team-aware, and actionable decision support in the operating room.

2605.04135.tldr: The 'publication elicitation gap' is measured in a pre-registered audit of 112,303 LLM-keyword-matched candidate records, comparing tested models to the contemporaneous frontier on the Epoch AI Capabilities Index (ECI), reproduced under Arena Elo and Artificial Analysis.

2605.04131.tldr: Evaluated LLM performance on multimodal physics problems, identifies specific failure modes through an empirical error taxonomy, and tests practical interventions designed to overcome multimodal processing limitations to improve AI tutoring reliability on image-rich STEM content.

2605.04076.tldr: The RGF-AFFD is the first integrated deployment blueprint to simultaneously satisfy OCC, SR 11-7, CFPB, and FinCEN requirements, supported by a community bank implementation vignette and four evidence-based policy recommendations.

2605.04075.tldr: RetentiveKV is an entropy-driven KV cache optimization method that reformulates KV eviction from"discrete context truncation" to"continuous memory evolution"based on State Space Models and integrates tokens scheduled for eviction into a continuous state space through entropy-guided state transitions.

2605.04368.tldr: It is proved that this generalization maintains the ordering of policies in the presence of termination, and thus extends differential TD to episodic problems and shows equivalence with a form of linear TD, thereby inheriting theoretical guarantees that have been shown for those algorithms.

2605.04357.tldr: Coral, an adaptive heterogeneity-aware multi-LLM serving system that applies a lossless two-stage decomposition that preserves joint optimality while cutting online solve time from hours to tens of seconds, is introduced.

2605.04333.tldr: A new RDMA-based transport protocol, MRC, sprays across many paths and actively load-balances between them, eliminating the issue of flow collisions, and allows AI training jobs to ride out many network failures that previously would have interrupted training.

2605.04330.tldr: It is found that in sufficiently deep models with a bidirectional prefix mask, implicit reasoning approaches explicit CoT performance across graph topologies and problem widths, though CoT remains necessary for depth extrapolation.

2605.04227.tldr: Pro$^2$Assist is introduced, a step-aware proactive assistant that continuously tracks fine-grained task progress and reasons over the user's evolving state to provide timely assistance throughout tasks.

2605.04221.tldr: It is suggested that automated prompt optimization combined with lightweight preference-based post-training can support scalable clinical information extraction using locally deployed small language models.

2605.04128.tldr: The bidirectional loop between enhanced understanding, controllable spatial editing, and novel-view-assisted reasoning enables the model to move beyond general visual competence toward stronger spatial intelligence.

2605.04107.tldr: TSCG is presented, a deterministic tool-schema compiler that resolves this mismatch at the API boundary, converting JSON schemas into token-efficient structured text without model access, fine-tuning, or runtime search.

2605.04102.tldr: Meta-LegNet is introduced, a graph learning framework that combines SE(3)-equivariant atom-level message passing with voxel-based multiscale aggregation and cross-domain meta-learning to learn transferable representations of local adsorption environments across diverse catalyst--adsorbate systems.

2605.04078.tldr: This work proposes validity-calibrated reasoning distillation, a framework that treats reasoning distillation as a problem of local learning-signal allocation rather than path alignment, and indicates that effective LLM reasoning distillation is governed not by rigid trajectory imitation, but by principled, locally calibrated allocation of learning signal.

2605.04074.tldr: This paper proposes the first physics-informed DLinear time-series model that can accurately forecast power utilization of an AI data center 5-80 minutes (short-term forecasting) into the future and is not only more accurate than the state-of-the-art (SOTA) models tested, but the forecast profile respects the underlying physics under power throttling and load transient events.

2605.04100.tldr: The experiments show that RETD avoids the instability of naive centered emphatic learning, preserves favorable emphatic geometry, and exhibits a robust intermediate regime for the regularization parameter \(c\) across the diagnostics.

2605.04085.tldr: This study presents the first FMECA-based framework for systematic patient safety risk assessment of LLM-generated clinical summaries, and provides a structured and reproducible method for identifying clinically relevant risks caused by these summaries.

2605.04081.tldr: A Tabu-based structure learning algorithm that searches for a time-ordered directed structure while allowing edge-specific lags up to a specified maximum lag, providing theoretical guarantees of validity and local optimality and describing a parallel implementation for improved scalability.

2605.04080.tldr: The research shows that people tend to maintain consistent patterns in how they write advertisements and present images online, even when they try to stay anonymous, and demonstrates how to link related accounts and identify repeated behaviour across illegal online markets.

2605.04077.tldr: This work proposes Balanced Aggregation (BA), a simple drop-in replacement that computes token-level means separately within the positive and negative subsets and then combines them with sequence-count-based weights, highlighting aggregation as a critical design dimension in GRPO-style RLVR.

2605.04073.tldr: In a case study of bail decisions from the Unified Judicial System of Pennsylvania, this work evaluates five contemporary approaches to handling label indeterminacy across three machine learning models, including a novel label imputation method motivated by the dynamics of bail decisions.

2605.04312.tldr: Agent Island is introduced, a multiplayer simulation environment in which language-model agents compete in a game of interagent cooperation, conflict, and persuasion, and a Bayesian Plackett-Luce model is ranked with a Bayesian Plackett-Luce model, allowing to quantify uncertainty in player skill.

2605.04215.tldr: Predict-then-Diffuse, a simple and model-agnostic framework, that enables compute-budgeted inference per input query by first estimating the response length and then using it to run inference with D-LLM, and introduces a data-driven safety mechanism, which trades a negligible padding overhead.

2605.04115.tldr: This work extends the low-rank framework from activity to learning by deriving gradient-descent dynamics directly in a reduced overlap space, forming a closed-form, low-dimensional system of ODEs that governs learning in this space, exact for linear RNNs and asymptotically exact for nonlinear RNNs in the large-$N$ Gaussian limit.

2605.04702.tldr: The proposed FaithfulFaces provides a pose-faithful facial prior that guides generative foundations toward robust identity-preserving generation and develops a specialized pipeline to curate a high-quality video dataset featuring substantial facial pose diversity.

2605.04680.tldr: This work proposes Adaptive Blur with Visual Priors to mitigate perceptual-structural mismatch by reweighting visual inputs according to retinotopic priors, and proposes Biomimetic Visual Feature Extraction to learn multi-level visual representations consistent with hierarchical cortical processing, enhancing subject-invariant encoding.

2605.04638.tldr: This work proposes the first gradient-based UQ method for free-form generation, SemGrad, which is sampling-free and computationally efficient and builds on the key intuition that a confident LLM should maintain stable output distributions under semantically equivalent input perturbations.

2605.04523.tldr: Blations show that diversity in model families, scales, and prompting strategies is essential, with the ensemble consistently beating any single model.

2605.04503.tldr: DiffCap-Bench is introduced, a comprehensive IDC benchmark covering ten distinct difference categories to ensure diversity and compositional complexity, and an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation protocol grounded in human-validated Difference Lists is proposed, enabling a robust assessment of models'ability to both capture and describe visual changes.

2605.04405.tldr: This work proposes a new perspective on deepfake detection: moving from static pattern recognition to dynamical stability analysis, and introduces Hamiltonian Action Anomaly Detection (HAAD), supporting a physics-inspired stability prior for digital forensics.

2605.04677.tldr: CodeEvolve extends OpenEvolve with runtime-guided target selection, Monte Carlo Tree Search, automated code refinement, and language-specific evaluation pipelines for Java and Salesforce Apex, and achieves an average speedup of 15.22 across seven hotspot functions and outperforms single-pass LLM optimization on five of them.

2605.04622.tldr: A computational model for the learning of jazz harmonic patterns based on library learning is presented, which searches over a space of programs composed of primitive harmonic relations in order to discover concise generative explanations of the corpus.

2605.04532.tldr: This vision paper presents a comparative analysis of the Terms of Service for widely used AI coding assistants and agent-enabled development tools, and outlines a research roadmap for accountable agents in software engineering.

2605.04522.tldr: DePAI offers a path to scalable, resilient self-organization that integrates physical infrastructure, AI, and community ownership under transparent rules, on-chain incentives, and permissionless participation, aiming to preserve human autonomy.

2605.04449.tldr: GEM (Graph-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts), a novel framework that combines language models and graph-structured dialogue understanding with ReAct agent-based reasoning for superior DST performance, demonstrates that combining structured dialogue representation with dynamic expert routing and agent-based reasoning provides a powerful paradigm for dialogue state tracking.

2605.04595.tldr: This paper introduces the first queueing-theoretic framework that explicitly incorporates both computation and GPU memory constraints into the analysis of LLM inference, and derives rigorous stability and instability conditions that determine whether an LLM inference service can sustain incoming demand without unbounded queue growth.

2605.04594.tldr: Experiments on five real-world heterogeneous graphs demonstrate that HeterSEED consistently outperforms representative heterogeneous graph neural networks and recent heterophily-aware baselines, especially in strongly heterophilic regimes.

2605.04547.tldr: The view that efficient audio diffusion training can benefit from treating external guidance, internal organization, and optimization emphasis as stage-dependent components rather than fixed ingredients is supported.

2605.04539.tldr: RLearner-LLM with Hybrid-DPO is proposed: an automated preference pipeline that fuses a DeBERTa-v3 NLI signal with a verifier LLM score, removing human annotation while overcoming the"alignment tax" of single-signal optimization.

2605.04530.tldr: This work presents SADE (Symptom-Aware Diagnostic Escalation), an agent that encodes the classical Cisco troubleshooting methodology as an explicit policy, and pairs a phase-gated diagnostic workflow with a routed library of fault-family skills and high-yield diagnostic helpers.

2605.04510.tldr: Extensive computational experiments show that the optimization algorithm scales to otherwise intractable real-world instances; and that the methodology can enhance suppression effectiveness in practice, resulting in significant reductions in area burned over a wildfire season and guiding resource sharing across wildfire jurisdictions.

2605.04506.tldr: Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that Ilov3Splat outperforms prior open-vocabulary 3D-GS methods in both object selection and instance segmentation, offering a flexible and accurate solution for language-driven 3D scene understanding.

2605.04495.tldr: CAR (Confidence-Aware Reranking), a query-guided, training-free, and plug-and-play reranking framework that uses generator confidence change as a document usefulness signal, is proposed.

2605.04489.tldr: Findings confirm that the hybrid approach effectively captures the linguistic complexity of Vietnamese and contextual nuances in specialized domains, offering a robust contribution to low-resource NER research.

2605.04478.tldr: CCL-D, a high-precision diagnostic system designed to detect and locate slow/hang anomalies in large-scale distributed training, achieves near-complete coverage of known slow/hang anomalies and pinpointed affected ranks within 6 minutes—substantially outperforming existing solutions.

2605.04443.tldr: The results suggest that altered spatial-frequency reliance is likely an emergent property of learning more human-like representations rather than the primary mechanism by which neural alignment confers adversarial robustness, and motivate the need for future research examining representational properties beyond spatial-frequency profiles.

2605.04418.tldr: This paper systematically demystifies the role of explicit manifold constraints in LLM pre-training by introducing the Msign-Aligned Constrained Riemannian Optimizer (MACRO), a provably convergent, single-loop optimization framework that achieves highly competitive performance while rigorously preserving the theoretical guarantees of exact Riemannian optimization.

2605.04410.tldr: This paper proposes the XAI Evaluation Card, a documentation template analogous to model cards, designed to accompany any study that introduces an XAI evaluation metric, and argues that adopting this template as a community norm would reduce evaluation fragmentation, support meta-analysis, and improve accountability in XAI research.

2605.04683.tldr: It is shown that average hard attention can be used to simulate arithmetic circuits if they are given as an input to an encoder if they are given as an input to an encoder.

2605.04616.tldr: This paper examines the deployment of several AI learning technologies developed within a multidisciplinary, national research institute in the United States focused on adult learning and online education and presents a set of 19 design guidelines intended to inform future AI-supported adult learning technologies.

2605.04613.tldr: VocalParse is presented, a unified singing voice transcription (SVT) model built upon a Large Audio Language Model (LALM) that introduces an interleaved prompting formulation that jointly models lyrics, melody, and word-note correspondence, yielding a generated sequence that directly maps to a structured musical score.

2605.04608.tldr: This work proposes SensingAgents, a novel multi-agent system for robust IMU activity recognition that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art single-agent and multi-agent LLM models, and highlights the potential of multi-agent collaborative reasoning for advancing the robustness and interpretability of ubiquitous sensing systems.

2605.04590.tldr: RLFSeg is proposed, a novel framework that leverages Rectified Flow to learn direct mapping from the image to the segmentation mask within the latent space, resulting in substantially better performance than previous diffusion-based methods, especially on zero-shot scenarios.

2605.04700.tldr: This work analyses the structure of token-aligned gradients in ALMs to propose Token-Aware Gradient Optimization (TAGO), which enables sparse jailbreak optimization by retaining only waveform gradients aligned with audio tokens that have high gradient energy, while masking the remaining gradients at each iteration.

2605.04624.tldr: AuditRepairBench is released, a paired-execution trace corpus of 576,000 registered cells (96,000 executed) that operationalizes evaluator-channel-blocking ranking instability within a declared observability boundary.

2605.04615.tldr: A contamination-limited, multitask, multitask code search pipeline that goes beyond retrieval to cover the full code search pipeline, together with a fine-tuned code reranker that achieves consistent gains across all three tasks.

2605.04606.tldr: Reference-based Category Discovery (RefCD), an unsupervised detector that enables category-aware\footnotemark[1] detection without any manually annotated labels, and can learn category information in an unsupervised paradigm even without category labels.

2605.04572.tldr: A method of Sample-Level Quantification of Safety Degradation (SQSD), which quantifies the influence of each training sample on safety degradation by measuring their induced parameter updates' projection difference between danger and safety directions, is proposed.

2605.04568.tldr: The proposed Dream-MPC is a novel approach that generates few candidate trajectories from a rolled-out policy and optimizes each trajectory by gradient ascent using a learned world model, uncertainty regularization and amortization of optimization iterations over time by reusing previously optimized actions.

2605.04504.tldr: Results validate that spectral disentanglement with counterfactual supervision effectively bridges the gap in the stability-generalization trade-off, and serve as a universal plug-and-play booster, revitalizing text-oriented baselines like CoOp and MaPLe via visual-side guidance.

2605.04501.tldr: EBOD (Example-Based Object Detection), which integrates a prompt-based detector (SAM3) with robust feature matching modules (DINOv3 and LightGlue) and effectively suppresses the repeated occurrence of false positives and false negatives by leveraging previous error examples, without requiring additional model retraining.

2605.04500.tldr: A two-stage Language Generalization framework that focuses on capturing variety-specific cues while also exploiting rich overlap offered by high-resource source variety and a lightweight VACAI-Bowl architecture that learns variety-specific attributes with one branch while a parallel branch captures variety-invariant attributes using adversarial training is proposed.

2605.04468.tldr: Anchored Learning is proposed, a simple framework that explicitly controls distributional updates during offline fine-tuning via a dynamically evolving moving anchor that admits a linear KL-divergence upper bound per iteration, ensuring a stable transition between model distributions.

2605.04436.tldr: Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms traditional multi-agent reinforcement learning baselines in terms of task success rate and system efficiency.

2605.04421.tldr: FLUID is proposed, a CT Transformer that incorporates continuous dynamics directly into the attention computation by replacing it with Liquid Attention Network (LAN), and demonstrates superior noise robustness and a self-correcting inductive bias in autonomous vehicle control.

2605.04396.tldr: This work shows that the memorization-versus-reasoning fate of a Transformer is determined within a sharp, identifiable window of training, and shows that the critical-window phenomenon is task-specific: it does not appear on grokking with modular arithmetic, where properly tuned constant weight decay matches scheduled weight decay.

2605.04375.tldr: A new paradigm called ``Experiment-as-Code (EaC) Labs,''where a core concept is to encode experiments as declarative configurations that can be compiled down to device-level APIs, representing a novel synthesis across the physical, systems, and intelligence layers to unleash the next breakthrough in AI for Science.

2605.04557.tldr: This paper proposes a simple yet efficient method for controlling the synthesis process by leveraging only skip connection features using windowed cross-attention modules and discusses the limitations in current evaluation approaches, amplifying the necessity of a consistent alignment assessment.

2605.04505.tldr: JASTIN is a generalizable, instruction-driven audio evaluation framework that formulates audio assessment as a self-instructed reasoning task that consistently outperforms general MLLMs across speech, sound, music, and out-of-domain evaluation tasks without the need for task-specific retraining.

2605.04499.tldr: Pen-Strategist framework is proposed, consisting of a novel domain-specific reasoning model that derives pentesting strategies via logical reasoning and a classifier that converts the strategies into actionable steps and demonstrates superior performance compared to the Claude-4.6-Sonnet.

2605.04488.tldr: Across all five model families, reasoning changes self-labeled ethical frameworks more often than binary verdicts and reduces demographic-judgment inconsistency in three of five models and does not increase it for any model.

2605.04454.tldr: This paper argues that deployment-relevant alignment cannot be inferred from model-level evaluation alone, and proposes a system-level evaluation agenda: alignment profiles instead of single scores, fixed-scaffolding protocols for comparable interactional evaluation, and reporting templates that make the inferential distance between evaluation evidence and deployment claims explicit.

2605.04453.tldr: StableI2I provides accurate, fine-grained, and interpretable evaluations of content fidelity and consistency, with strong correlations to human subjective judgments and serves as a practical and reliable evaluation tool for diagnosing content consistency and benchmarking model performance in real-world I2I systems.

2605.04431.tldr: A comprehensive empirical study shows that RFT failures are both observable from training dynamics and distinguishable through their empirical fault fingerprints, and proposes RFT-FM, an automatic failure management framework for reinforcement fine-tuning that unifies anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, and auto remediation in a closed loop.

2605.04797.tldr: Audiovisual deepfake detection is studied by measuring how consistently crowd workers distinguish authentic from manipulated videos and, when they flag a video as manipulated, how accurately they identify the manipulation type and how consistently they report manipulation timestamps.

2605.04761.tldr: Results suggest that the Personalized Thinking Model produces outputs with acceptable fidelity, was generally perceived by users as reflecting their thinking, and showed a pattern consistent with semantic abstraction across layers.

2605.04752.tldr: This study proposes FLO-EMD, a hybrid approach that couples motion-guided attention with empirical, data-driven temporal decomposition and achieves 97.5% overall test accuracy, outperforming established baselines and remaining robust across diverse environmental conditions.

2605.04740.tldr: A modular architecture that orchestrates a multi-LLM pipeline, utilizing GPT-4.1-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Llama 3.1, to synthesize quantitative rubric data and qualitative observations into coherent, actionable feedback.

2605.04733.tldr: EBM-RL (Eye-Brain-Mouth Reinforcement Learning), a decoupled GRPO-based framework that explicitly separates observation, reasoning, and utterance, promotes human-like sensory grounding by compelling the model to first attend to visual cues, then form internal interpretations, and finally generate context-appropriate dialogue.

2605.04724.tldr: This work provides an initial Offensive-AI benchmark for playlist-based PII inference using architectures that leverage set- and graph-structured data and introduces a defense showing encouraging mitigation effects.

2605.05092.tldr: Driver-WM is introduced, a driver-centric latent world model that rolls out in-cabin dynamics causally conditioned on out-cabin traffic context and yields robust long-horizon geometric forecasting for reactive high-motion maneuvers and improves semantic alignment for both driver and traffic states.

2605.05026.tldr: This work shows that a hallucination filter based on such instabilities matches or exceeds the performance of the recently proposed temporal one and proposes Intrinsic Quenching (IQ), a direct corrective mechanism that deflates it to alleviate hallucinations.

2605.05017.tldr: This position paper argues that optimizing these components independently creates a systemic privacy crisis when deployed in sensitive settings, thereby advancing the position that privacy in EAI is a life cycle-level architectural constraint rather than a stage-local feature.

2605.04993.tldr: The problem of early prediction of charging demand is studied, where the total energy of a session is estimated using only information available at plug-in time and during the first minutes of charging, to demonstrate that reliable demand estimates can be obtained early in the session with minimal data.

2605.04922.tldr: Graph-based multi-agent scientific ideation framework EIG is introduced, a graph-based multi-agent scientific ideation framework that can generate high-performance research ideas across various benchmark-native metrics, such as novelty, feasibility, and clarity.

2605.04901.tldr: An attack is proposed that aligns differently shuffled activations to a common permutation and subsequently exploits them to extract model weights and recover model weights with L1-norm differences compared to the oracle weights.

2605.04897.tldr: The proposed True Memory, a six-layer architecture that shifts the center of the system from a storage schema to a multi-stage retrieval pipeline operating over events preserved verbatim, runs as a single SQLite file on commodity CPU with no external database, vector index, graph store, or GPU.

2605.04875.tldr: TechToken is introduced, a transformer-based model that treats technologies, classified by International Patent Classification codes, as words in its vocabulary, learning the language of technologies by embedding these codes during fine-tuning and showing that it accurately predicts first technological combinations.

2605.04971.tldr: Two mechanisms are identified: residual connections create cross-layer gradient coherence that aligns weight updates across layers, and symmetry-breaking nonlinearities constrain all layers to a shared coordinate frame, preventing the rotation drift that would otherwise destabilize weight structure.

2605.05071.tldr: VIsion-based BEamforming (VIBE), a hybrid model-based, closed-loop, learning architecture for real-time double-directional mmWave beam management primed by camera sensing, is presented.

2605.04908.tldr: Gosset is benchmarked against four frontier systems with web access on niche oncology/immunology targets where most of the pipeline lives in the long tail of preclinical and Asian-developed assets, suggesting that each of these systems can close most of the recall gap by swapping generic web search for a curated index behind the same chat interface.

2605.04903.tldr: This work proposes Delta-Code Generation, where fine-tuned LLMs generate compact unified diffs (deltas) to refine baseline architectures rather than synthesizing entire models rather than synthesizing entire models.

2605.04722.tldr: This paper studies the exact first-order and local second-order geometry of SOC-ICNNs from the dual viewpoint and shows that supporting slopes, subdifferentials, directional derivatives, and local Hessians can be recovered directly from optimal dual variables.

2605.05066.tldr: It is proved that any model satisfying Efficiency and Compactness can recall at most O(poly(d)/log V) key-value pairs from a sequence of arbitrary length, where d is the model dimension and V is the vocabulary size.

2605.05055.tldr: This work proposes an adaptive framework for AoA-based localization that consists of two alternative learning strategies, each suited either for large or small training datasets, and investigates offline learning when large training datasets are available.

2605.05054.tldr: W warped product flow matching (WP-FM), a unified Riemannian framework that reformulates alignment on a warped product manifold is proposed, which enables independent radial evolution and constant-speed angular geodesic transport and achieves a new state-of-the-art for multi-step few-shot adaptation.

2605.05007.tldr: Uno-Orchestra is introduced, a unified orchestration policy that selectively decomposes a task and dispatches each subtask to an admissible (model, primitive) pair, with both decisions learned together from curated RL trajectories grounded in real worker interactions.

2605.05003.tldr: Standard reward benchmarks are shown to be insufficient for assessing social alignment and the need for evaluations that directly measure the social preferences encoded in reward models are highlighted, leading to a framework that converts social evaluation datasets into pairwise preference data.

2605.04970.tldr: It is shown that skill neologisms can be learned to improve model capabilities on specific skills while being composable with out-of-distribution skills, and that independently trained skill neologisms can be composed zero-shot.

2605.04930.tldr: A controlled diagnostic framework is introduced that isolates seven biologically motivated pathologies and introduces an error-type decomposition that reveals methods with similar aggregate accuracy commit qualitatively different errors, offering actionable insights for method development and practical guidance for practitioners.

2605.04916.tldr: This work introduces Neural Rule Inducer, a pretrained model for zero-shot rule induction that represents literals using domain-agnostic statistical properties such as class-conditional rates, entropy, and co-occurrence, which generalize across variable identities and counts without retraining.

2605.04906.tldr: Strat-Reasoner is proposed, a novel RL-based framework that improves LLMs's strategic reasoning ability in multi-agent games and introduces a novel recursive reasoning paradigm where an agent's reasoning also integrates other agents'reasoning processes.

2605.04759.tldr: Gyan's meaning representation structure captures the complete compositional context and attempts to mimic humans by expanding the context to a'world model', demonstrating that it is possible to create models which are trustable and reliable for mission critical tasks.

2605.04747.tldr: This work introduces Knowledge-Free Correlated Agreement (KFCA) to reward client contributions in federated learning (FL) without relying on ground truth, a public test set, or distribution knowledge, showing efficient real-time reward computation suitable for decentralized and blockchain-based incentive designs.

2605.04729.tldr: AISSA (AI-based Student Slides Analysis tool), a web-based system that combines large language models (LLMs) and Learning Analytics dashboards to support scalable, rubric-based feedback on presentation slides, is introduced.

2605.04711.tldr: The Budget-Aware Optimizer Configurator (BAOC) is proposed to reduce memory cost by assigning suitable optimizer configurations to individual blocks under given budgets, and maintains training quality while significantly reducing the memory usage of optimizer states.

2605.05091.tldr: This work explores the use of Think Aloud traces as an additional form of data constraint during automated model discovery and suggests that process-level language data not only improve model fit, but also systematically reshape the structure of the discovered cognitive models.

2605.05090.tldr: An automated, contrastive evaluation pipeline for auditing the behavioral impact of interventions on large language models, which produces human-readable, statistically validated natural-language hypotheses describing how the models differ, along with recurring themes that summarize patterns across validated hypotheses.

2605.05058.tldr: This paper presents a systematic taxonomy of jailbreak attacks and defenses and introduces Security Cube, a unified, multi-dimensional framework for comprehensive evaluation of these techniques and aims to pave the way towards more robust, interpretable, and trustworthy LLM systems.

2605.04979.tldr: This work considers the problem of on-line learning in T-MDPs, both in the PAC and the regret-minimisation regimes, and shows that well-known bandit algorithms -- \textsc{Lucb} and \textsc{Ucb} -- can be applied on T-MDPs by treating each policy as an arm.

2605.04973.tldr: Evaluation indicates improved architectural consistency and deployability compared to general-purpose AI code generation workflows, suggesting that constraint-aware retrieval is essential for aligning AI-assisted service development with production software engineering practices.

2605.04960.tldr: Entropy-Progress Aligned GRPO is proposed, a framework that mines the model's intrinsic information flow for dense, self-supervised guidance that achieves superior accuracy and efficiency compared to GRPO and its variants.

2605.04943.tldr: DART (Damage Assessment via Rope Transformer), a vision-language foundation model that addresses the full rope inspection workflow through a unified multi-task architecture, is presented, providing actionable inspection intelligence from a single shared representation.

2605.04882.tldr: FairEnc, a fair pretraining method for vision-language models (VLMs) that enables simultaneous debiasing across multiple sensitive attributes, jointly mitigates biases in both textual and visual modalities with respect to multiple sensitive attributes, including race, gender, ethnicity, and language.

2605.04880.tldr: A novel modified harmonic mean operator is presented that correctly computes reward rates even under non-stationary reward rates even under such conditions, and yields model-free learning algorithms that can work with SMDPs, while maintaining robustness to non-stationary reward and duration distributions over time.

2605.04831.tldr: This work systematically evaluate the modeling of human story preferences and introduces StoryRMB, the first benchmark for assessing reward models on story preferences, which achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance on StoryRMB, outperforming much larger models.

2605.04785.tldr: AgentTrust, a runtime safety layer that intercepts agent tool calls before execution and returns a structured verdict: allow, warn, block, or review, is presented and is released under the AGPL-3.0 license and provides a Model Context Protocol server for MCP-compatible agents.

2605.04847.tldr: Quantile-free Prediction Interval GNN (QpiGNN), a framework that builds on quantile regression (QR) to enable GNN-based UQ by directly optimizing coverage and interval width without requiring quantile inputs or post-processing, is introduced.

2605.04808.tldr: The DecodingTrust-Agent Platform (DTap) is introduced, the first controllable and interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents, spanning 14 real-world domains and over 50 simulation environments that replicate widely used systems such as Google Workspace, Paypal, and Slack.

2605.05049.tldr: Piper is introduced, a framework that leverages resource modeling to identify efficient training strategies for MoE models on target HPC platforms, applying pipeline parallelism with optimized schedules and a novel all-to-all algorithm that delivers 1.2-9X bandwidth over vendor implementation.

2605.05040.tldr: PBSD is proposed, which revisits on-policy self-distillation through a reward-regularized perspective, and derives a reward-regularized objective whose analytic optimum is a reward-reweighted teacher distribution, yielding a target policy provably superior to the original teacher under this objective.

2605.04939.tldr: A modular (decomposed) representation is used, where each feature of the state is handled by a separate learning procedure, and the results aggregated, and the efficacy of the approach is demonstrated in numerous experiments with simulated robot swarms carrying out foraging.

2502.10148.tldr: This work introduces COMPASS, a multi-agent framework that overcomes limitations by integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for decentralized, closed-loop decision-making and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art MARL baselines.

2502.04512.tldr: It is argued that the defining properties of open-ended AI systems introduce a distinct and underexplored class of safety challenges, including loss of predictability, emergent misalignment, and difficulties in maintaining effective control as systems evolve beyond their initial design assumptions, that must be addressed preemptively.

2605.05097.tldr: In Memini, episodic sensitivity, gradual consolidation, and selective forgetting emerge as facets of a single mechanism, reframing external memory as a learning substrate that reorganizes through its own dynamics.

2605.05206.tldr: Dual-Stage Registers (DSR) are introduced, a register-based intervention for both components: trained registers when available, recursive test-time registers otherwise, and diffusion registers for the denoiser that consistently reduce outlier artifacts and improve generation quality.

2605.05191.tldr: This work introduces Context-ReAct, a general agentic paradigm for elastic context orchestration that integrates reasoning, context management, and tool use in a unified loop and develops LongSeeker, a long-horizon search agent fine-tuned from Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized trajectories.

2605.05172.tldr: Q2RL is efficient enough to be applied in an on-robot RL setting, learning robust policies for contact-rich and high precision manipulation tasks such as pipe assembly and kitting, in 1-2 hours of online interaction, achieving success rates of up to 100% and up to 3.75x improvement against the original BC policy.

2504.14602.tldr: The K2MUSE dataset is presented, which includes a comprehensive collection of multimodal data, comprising kinematic, kinetic, amplitude mode ultrasound (AUS), and surface electromyography (sEMG) measurements, and is released with the corresponding structured documentation, preprocessing pipelines, and example code, thereby providing a comprehensive resource for rehabilitation robot development, biomechanical analysis, and wearable sensing research.

2501.06332.tldr: This article proposes a novel aggregation method and compares it with different existing aggregation methods of low rank adapters trained in a federated fine-tuning of large machine learning models and evaluates their performance with respect to selected GLUE benchmark datasets.

2407.20068.tldr: A utility-oriented optimal threshold correction method and an appending strategy, which enhances the performance of SVT by increasing the precision and recall, respectively, are developed and substantiated both theoretically and empirically.

2310.00795.tldr: This review paper aims to offer a comprehensive synthesis of recent advances in healthcare applications of generative AI, with an emphasis on diffusion and transformer models, and discusses current capabilities, existing limitations, and outline promising research directions to address emerging challenges.

2303.09271.tldr: A highly efficient oracle is presented that can determine the correctness of explanations, surpassing the runtime performance of current state‐of‐the‐art alternatives by several orders of magnitude.

2605.05159.tldr: This work fine-tunes separate Gemma~3 models (12B and 27B parameters) per language using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) augmented with synthetic data generated by a large language model (LLM), augmented with synthetic data generated by a large language model (LLM).

2605.05151.tldr: It is demonstrated that superposition is not necessary for competitive performance on standard forecasting benchmarks, suggesting they may not demand the rich compositional representations that drive transformer success in language modeling, and helping explain the persistent competitiveness of simple linear models.

2605.05123.tldr: A novel adaptive approach for policy selection and fine-tuning under online interaction budgets in O2O-RL is proposed, which adaptively select and fine-tune the policies based on their predicted performance via an upper-confidence-bound approach thereby making efficient use of online interactions.

2605.05110.tldr: LineRides is presented, a line-guided learning framework that enables a custom bicycle robot to acquire diverse, commandable stunt behaviors from a user-provided spatial guideline and sparse key-orientations, without demonstrations or explicit timing.

2505.13246.tldr: The AP represents a transformative approach to scientific communication by creating responsive knowledge synthesis systems while maintaining scientific rigor, and integrating multi-agent verification with traditional publishing pathways creates a more efficient, accessible and collaborative research ecosystem.

2503.10070.tldr: Despite its low cost, AhaRobot enables imitation learning of complex household behaviors involving bimanual coordination, upper-body mobility, and contact-rich interaction, with data quality comparable to VR-based collection.

2309.09550.tldr: A brain-inspired continual learning algorithm with adaptive reorganization of neural pathways, which employs Self-Organizing Regulation networks to reorganize the single and limited Spiking Neural Network (SOR-SNN) into rich sparse neural pathways to efficiently cope with incremental tasks.

2206.06369.tldr: It is found that GNNs are surprisingly effective at predicting the highly non-linear targets from topological information only, and for the first time, performance that is suitable for practical use cases is achieved.

2605.05170.tldr: An updated multi-agent harness powered by frontier models released in April 2026 is introduced, able to handle 80x larger tasks, at higher quality, fully autonomously, as well as analyze Design Conductor's token usage and other empirical characteristics, including its limitations.

2605.05166.tldr: First-token confidence, phi_first, computed from the normalized entropy of the top-K logits at the first content-bearing answer token of a single greedy decode, matches or modestly exceeds semantic self-consistency on closed-book short-answer factual question answering.

2605.05164.tldr: A hybrid hyperbolic-Euclidean representation is introduced that embeds WSI features in dual geometric spaces, enabling complementary modeling of hierarchical tissue structures and local morphological details and indicates that geometry-aware representation learning offers a promising direction for next-generation computational pathology.

2605.05155.tldr: Aes3D, the first systematic framework for assessing the aesthetics of 3D neural rendering scenes, is proposed, and Aes3DGSNet, a lightweight model that directly predicts scene-level aesthetic scores from 3DGS representations, is presented, a lightweight model that operates solely on 3D Gaussian primitives.

2605.05148.tldr: This work conducts a comprehensive study of the key modeling choices that govern the design of a practical learned image codec, jointly optimized for perceptual quality and runtime, and combines the various optimizations to construct a new codec that achieves a significantly improved tradeoff between speed and perceptual quality.

2605.05103.tldr: Concept Fields provide a fast, lightweight, and interpretable signal for groundedness and novelty, complementary to LLM-as-judge and white-box detectors, complementary to LLM-as-judge and white-box detectors.

2507.07982.tldr: This work proposes Geometry Forcing, a simple yet effective method that encourages video diffusion models to internalize 3D representations and introduces two complementary alignment objectives: Angular Alignment, which enforces directional consistency via cosine similarity, and Scale Alignment, which preserves scale-related information by regressing geometric features from normalized diffusion representations.

2507.00435.tldr: This work introduces RoboEval, a structured evaluation framework and benchmark for robotic manipulation that augments binary success with principled behavioral and outcome metrics and validate these metrics by analyzing their stability under variation, discriminative power across policies with similar success rates, and correlation with task success.

2408.12622.tldr: This paper systematically analyzed every major AI risk framework published to date-74 frameworks containing 1,725 distinct risks-and organized them into a unified system, creating a comprehensive catalog of AI risks.

2504.13614.tldr: The Adaptive Long-term Embedding with Denoising and Augmentation for Recommendation (ALDA4Rec) method is introduced, a novel model that constructs an item-item graph, filters noise through community detection, and enriches user-item interactions.

2503.05383.tldr: AVACraft is introduced, a multimodal StarCraft II benchmark supporting both Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) and Vision-Language Model (VLM) paradigms, exposing trade-offs between training efficiency, performance ceilings, interpretability, and deployment cost.

2502.04419.tldr: This work presents the first systematic investigation in understanding, analyzing, and mitigating bias inheritance, and proposes three mitigation strategies: token-based, mask-based, and loss-based approaches, which can work differently on various tasks and bias.

2502.03962.tldr: This article proposes a gradient‐free Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) technique to automate the process of quantum circuit design and introduces a novel formulation of the action space based on a sampling scheme and a progressive widening technique to explore the space dynamically.

2412.19538.tldr: This work constructs an efficient multi-stage HRL-based multi-robot task planner for hyper scale MRTP in RMFS, and the planning process is represented with a special temporal graph topology.

2605.05125.tldr: An LLM-driven evolutionary imputer that proposes executable imputation operators rather than individual entries is introduced, and this imputer achieves the best pooled rank over biomarker and causal metrics, leading in point-wise accuracy and temporal extrapolation while preserving average treatment effect (ATE) recovery as statistical baselines degrade.

2605.05118.tldr: An analysis of GMD through the lens of Wasserstein Gradient Flows (WGF), i.e., the path of steepest descent for a functional in the space of probability measures, equipped with the geometry of optimal transport.

2505.24791.tldr: This paper identifies that strict sequential dependency in inference is unnecessary to generate high-quality samples and proposes to selectively use Jacobi decoding strategy that accelerates its autoregressive inference through parallel iterative optimization.

2603.26498.tldr: TCM-Serve is designed, a modality-aware scheduler that lets motorcycles flow quickly through cars and trucks, ensuring interactive responsiveness while avoiding starvation, and delivers LLM-like responsiveness for MLLMs, with modality-aware scheduling and by making the most efficient use of the available resources.

2604.17896.tldr: Empirical results show that augmenting VLA training with feasibility supervision improves both physical reliability and overall task performance, while also enhancing learning efficiency in the low-data regime.

2603.13824.tldr: These findings indicate that fragility arises primarily during semantic-to-acoustic realization rather than multi-modal embedding alignment, and highlights the need for multi-level stability assessment in generative audio systems.

2508.05170.tldr: ReCode (Reasoning-Reinforced Code Generation), a novel RL training framework comprising a reward model with synthesized optimized and degraded reasoning variants to assess the quality of reasoning process, is proposed and Experimental results show that a 7B model trained with ReCode outperforms the base version by 16.1% and reaches performance comparable to GPT-4-Turbo.

2603.20562.tldr: PCFJudge is introduced, an inference-time method that reruns the same factuality-first listwise prompt over multiple orderings of the same candidate set and aggregates the resulting scores, ranks, and uncertainty signals into a single consensus decision.

2509.14448.tldr: VCBench is introduced, the first benchmark for predicting founder success in venture capital (VC), a domain where signals are sparse, outcomes are uncertain, and even top investors perform modestly, and nine state-of-the-art large language models are evaluated.

2604.09408.tldr: Failure analysis identifies three key help-seeking patterns: overconfident wrong beliefs with no gap detection; high uncertainty detection yet persistent errors; broad, imprecise escalation without self-correction, which confirm poor help-seeking is a model-level flaw, not task-specific.

2602.21204.tldr: Overall, the results reframe TTT not as test-time memorization, but as learned linear attention with enhanced representational capacity, which enables principled architectural simplifications, admits fully parallel formulations that preserve performance while improving efficiency, and provides a systematic reduction of diverse TTT variants to a standard linear attention form.

2508.05691.tldr: These findings show that the approach of privatizing the verification task can make adaptive evasion substantially harder while maintaining performance in the clean setting, and show that the approach of privatizing the verification task can make adaptive evasion substantially harder while maintaining performance in the clean setting.

2508.11659.tldr: This work proposes a biologically plau-sible Feedback-regulated REsidual recurrent neural network (FRE-RNN) and studies its learning performance in EP framework, which substantially enhances the applicabil-ity and practicality of EP in large-scale networks that un-derpin artificial intelligence.

2508.09193.tldr: MIPCGRL is proposed, a multi-objective representation learning method for instructed content generators, which incorporates sentence embeddings as conditions and achieves up to a 13.8\% improvement in controllability with multi-objective instructions.

2404.02534.tldr: The role of informed embedding initialization and synthetic data in enhancing the performance of MAFT models in downstream tasks is surveyed and improves baseline over SOTA AfroXLMR-base and OFA by 12.3 and 3.8 points respectively.

2505.06799.tldr: This work proposes a novel quantum echo-state network (QESN) design and implementation algorithm that can operate within the presence of noise on current IBM hardware, and applies classical control-theoretic response analysis to characterize the QESN, emphasizing its rich nonlinear dynamics and memory.

2501.04046.tldr: This work defines user influence level as a function of community endorsement and develops a model that significantly outperforms the baseline by leveraging demographic and personality data, which consistently improves RankDCG scores across eight different domains.

2411.12220.tldr: DeTrigger is proposed, a scalable and efficient backdoor-robust federated learning framework that leverages insights from adversarial attack methodologies that achieves up to 251x faster detection than traditional methods and mitigates backdoor attacks by up to 98.9%, with minimal impact on global model accuracy.

2211.00642.tldr: A virtual load monitoring framework formulated via Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) is proposed and relevant implementation details needed for the construction, training, and deployment of BNN data-based virtual monitoring models are provided.

2506.18682.tldr: The proposed UNet-MSAM achieves significant improvements in semantic segmentation performance across multiple HSI datasets, demonstrating the potential of HSI processing for AD and providing valuable insights into designing robust, multi-scale spectral feature extractors for real-world applications.

2505.10443.tldr: Evaluating whether state-of-the-art LLMs with up to 8B parameters can reason about Python programs or are simply guessing shows that LLMs trained for code produce correct predictions based on flawed reasoning between 10% and 50% of cases.

2412.09125.tldr: This paper presents what they believe to be the first technique for goal-driven query answering over first- and second-order dependencies with equality reasoning, and presents the results of an extensive empirical evaluation, which show that goal-driven query answering can be orders of magnitude faster than computing the full universal model.

2501.00106.tldr: This paper introduces LicenseGPT, a fine-tuned foundation model specifically designed for dataset license compliance analysis and demonstrates that LicenseGPT reduces analysis time by 94.44%, from 108 seconds to 6 seconds per license, without compromising accuracy.

2410.01871.tldr: An auction-based regulatory mechanism that provably incentivizes devices to deploy compliant models and to participate in the regulation process is proposed, outperforming simpler frameworks that merely impose minimum compliance standards.

2405.02079.tldr: This paper introduces argumentative LLMs (ArgLLMs), a method for augmenting LLMs with argumentative reasoning, and defines novel properties to characterise contestability and assess ArgLLMs formally in terms of these properties.

2112.11447.tldr: To effectively exploit transfering knowledge from teachers to students, a novel modality relation distillation paradigm by modeling the relationship information among different modality are adopted, that is learning the teacher modality-level Gram Matrix.

2506.11563.tldr: This position paper discusses a novel learning paradigm where FFMs not only harness their generalization capabilities but are specifically designed to preserve the integrity of user personality, illustrated thoroughly within the recommendation contexts.

2505.21938.tldr: This work proposes a more practical threat model, Fake Data Injection, which reflects realistic adversarial constraints: the attacker can inject only a limited number of bounded fake feedback samples into the learner's history, simulating legitimate interactions.

2411.19182.tldr: This work reframing disordered diffusion as a powerful tool for text-vision-to-image generation (TV2I) tasks, achieving pixel-level condition fidelity while maintaining visual and semantic coherence throughout the image.

2408.13471.tldr: DiGGR (Disentangled Generative Graph Representation Learning), a self-supervised learning framework that aims to learn latent disentangled factors and utilizes them to guide graph mask modeling, thereby enhancing the disentanglement of learned representations and enabling end-to-end joint learning.

2510.01189.tldr: Results show that LLMs can be effectively employed to automate and enhance the understanding of user moral preferences and decision-making process in the early stages of software development.

2509.14594.tldr: A membership inference attack (MIA) methodology tailored for synthetic text is developed, providing first empirical evidence that the use of public datasets - potentially present in pre-training corpora - can invalidate claimed privacy guarantees.

2409.07985.tldr: A formal decision-making model of the red-teaming exercise of the red-teaming exercise as a multi-objective, partially observable, stochastic game is introduced and applied to model, evaluate and synthesise protocols for deploying untrusted language models as programming assistants.

2603.03331.tldr: PulseLM is introduced, a large-scale PPG-text dataset designed to bridge raw PPG waveforms and natural language through a unified, closed-ended question answering (QA) formulation that provides a standardized foundation for studying multimodal physiological reasoning, cross-dataset generalization, and scalable benchmarking of PPG-based language models.

2602.18473.tldr: CoTAR (Core Token Aggregation-Redistribution), a centralized MLP-based module designed to replace decentralized attention, introduces a global core token that serves as a proxy to facilitate inter-token interactions, thereby enforcing a centralized aggregation and redistribution strategy.

2602.11229.tldr: Latent Generative Solvers (LGS), a two-stage framework that maps diverse PDE states into a shared latent physics space with a pretrained VAE, and learns probabilistic latent dynamics with a Transformer trained by flow matching, is introduced.

2603.00113.tldr: It is argued that LLM-based agents are not (yet) a panacea for social simulation because of over-optimism, and a unified formulation of AI agent-based social simulation as an environment-involved partially observable Markov game with explicit exposure and scheduling mechanisms is proposed.

2603.06811.tldr: Context specification is introduced and described as a process to support and inform the deployment decision making process and serves as a foundational roadmap for evaluating what AI systems are likely to do in the deployment contexts that organizations actually manage.

2602.13310.tldr: This paper introduces Visual Para-Thinker, representing the inaugural parallel reasoning framework for MLLMs, and develops a native multimodal implementation that facilitates high-efficiency parallel processing in the vLLM framework.

2603.02087.tldr: By overcoming cross-dataset variability, this framework facilitates the standardized, large-scale extraction of clinical biomarkers across diverse endoscopy platforms.

2604.17573.tldr: The Grounded Continuous Evaluation (GCE) framework is proposed and ISOPro, a simulation-based fine-tuning and evaluation system, is presented, which replaces the learned reward model with a deterministic ground-truth verifier, eliminating reward hacking by construction in verifiable-reward domains.

2604.27644.tldr: An anchored-curriculum framework in which a unified policy alternates between a Proposer that synthesizes novel specifications and a Solver that produces verified solutions, which proposes a paradigm shift from learning to answer to learning to question.

2604.26733.tldr: This work presents FutureWorld, a live agentic reinforcement learning environment that closes the training loop between prediction, outcome realization, and parameters update, and shows that training is effective and the results show that training is effective.

2604.24916.tldr: This study proposes a high-fidelity MuJoCo simulation that explicitly models the discrete roller mechanics of ETH-type omni-wheels, thereby capturing parasitic vibrations and contact discontinuities that are previously ignored.

2604.03675.tldr: This work presents Prefix-based Rollout reuse for Agentic search with Intermediate Step rEwards (PRAISE), a framework for improving both data efficiency and credit assignment in agentic search training and shows that PRAISE consistently improves performance over strong baselines.

2604.09063.tldr: Frequency-Aware Diffusion for Skeleton-Text Matching (FDSM) is proposed, integrating a Semantic-Guided Spectral Residual Module, a Timestep-Adaptive Spectral Loss, and Curriculum-based Semantic Abstraction to address challenges of Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition.

2603.20531.tldr: It is found that models report highest confidence precisely when they are fabricating, and a tensor interface is constructed that escapes the impossibility by exporting computational byproducts that are structurally coupled to correctness under standard training.

2604.18555.tldr: Experiments support claims that biased EDEN (with optimized $S$) is more accurate than TurboQuant$_{\text{mse}}$, and unbiased EDEN is markedly more accurate than TurboQuant$_{\text{prod}}$, often by more than a bit.

2603.15646.tldr: This work proposes Alternating Reinforcement Learning with Rubric Rewards (ARL-RR), a framework that eliminates the need for a fixed scalarization by optimizing one semantic rubric meta-class at a time, and introduces a lightweight, search-based adaptation procedure that selects the next meta-class dynamically based on task performance.

2604.17866.tldr: Extensive experiments on six QA benchmarks spanning single-hop and multi-hop settings demonstrate that LAnR outperforms existing RAG methods, while achieving improved inference efficiency through reduced number of retrieval calls and tighter model integration.

2604.17415.tldr: This work shows that many reward-based fine-tuning methods can be written under a common framework, which is called reward score matching (RSM), and develops simpler redesigns that improve alignment effectiveness and compute efficiency across representative settings with differentiable and black-box rewards.

2603.27389.tldr: A prediction-based scoring method that quantifies non-Markovian structure in observation trajectories and correctly identifies partial observability and guides architecture selection is introduced, fully recovering performance lost to non-Markovian observations.

2603.14209.tldr: ChArtist is presented, a domain-specific diffusion model for generating pictorial charts automatically, offering two distinct types of control: 1) spatial control that aligns well with the chart structure, and 2) subject-driven control that respects the visual characteristics of a reference image.

2605.05227.tldr: This work introduces ADAPT (Adaptive Data reweighting for Pretraining and FineTuning), a dynamic online framework that reweights training samples with adaptive per-sample learning rates guided by similarity-based quality signals, without changing the number of training samples.

2605.05223.tldr: This work presents a geometric framework for analyzing the instability of feature unions, and derives an asymptotic compositional-collapse threshold under a spherical dictionary model, characterized by the Gaussian mean width of the signal cone.

2605.05220.tldr: This paper establishes a link between steering and affine concept erasure, and establishes a principled theoretical framework for concept switching, LEACE-Switch, and introduces MidSteer (Minimal Disturbance concept Steering), a more general affine framework for concept manipulation that relaxes assumptions and enables directed, minimal-disturbance transformations.

2605.05218.tldr: This work establishes the first rigorous connection between chaos theory and predictive multiplicity, providing principled guidance for deploying machine learning in safety-critical chaotic domains.

2605.03562.tldr: It is argued that persistent cache error should be measured in model-visible coordinates, and HeadQ, a key-side method that stores a low-rank residual side code in a calibration-learned query basis and applies it as an additive logit correction, is proposed.

2605.05360.tldr: The algorithm (named CopyCop) can identify such copycat GNNs, unlike existing watermarking and fingerprinting methods, and is accurate and robust against a broad class of adversarial attacks and transformations.

2605.05353.tldr: GenAI can be successfully used at scale to assess students' written work, based on clear rubrics, and these assessments generally align with human assessments as shown with Gwets AC2 inter-rater reliability values of 0.33 for all the models except one.

2605.05287.tldr: A layered isolation architecture combining policy-aware ingestion, retrieval-time gating, and shared inference, enforced through server-side agentic orchestration is introduced, creating natural enforcement points for multitenant isolation while allowing client-side frameworks to retain control over agent composition and latency-sensitive operations.

2605.05267.tldr: A unified taxonomy is established that categorizes generated code quality issues across nine dimensions and training data quality issues into code and non-code attributes and formalizes a causal framework detailing 18 typical propagation mapping mechanisms.

2605.05226.tldr: This work introduces a supervision-internalization method for reinforcement learning for reasoning, enabling the model to automatically extract process-level learning signals through identifying, correcting, and reusing failed reasoning trajectories, thereby achieving finer-grained policy optimization under outcome-only supervision.

2605.05224.tldr: This work provides the first systematic investigation of unlearnable examples across diverse training paradigms and proposes a hierarchical deception strategy, Shallow Semantic Camouflage (SSC), that confines the generation process to a semantically valid subspace, aiming to bypass the semantic suppression introduced by pretrained weights.

2605.05215.tldr: This work adapts DINOv3 to the document domain via context-aware SimMIM fine-tuning and supervised metric learning with composite loss that encourages inter-class separability and intra-class compactness and provides a production-aligned basis for discovering novel and campaign-scale fraud under distribution shift.

2605.05348.tldr: GenAD, an AD generation pipeline that incorporates accessibility guidelines and contextual video information, and RefineAD, an editing interface for human revisions are investigated, suggesting this threshold is content-dependent; as visual complexity increases, so does the quality needed from AI drafts.

2605.05262.tldr: InformationTree, a training-time tree-search framework coupling UUCB with a learned Adaptive Budget Allocator (ABA) and an asynchronous Speculative Expansion scheme, is presented, which outperforms flat GRPO, DeepSearch, Tree-GRPO, AT2PO, CW-GRPO, and RC-GRPO and outperforms tool-rich coding and OS agents.

2605.05248.tldr: The central contribution is reclassifying eval from a language primitive into a governed effect, a language design where programrepresentations are first-class values, form manipulation is pure computation, and materialization is a governed effect subject to structural inspection.

2605.05246.tldr: A robust, deployable EDA denoising framework that generalizes across multiple measurement locations and harsh environments and enhances clinically relevant prediction performance while remaining suitable for deployment in resource-constrained wearable Internet of Things systems operating in harsh environments is proposed.

2605.05244.tldr: This work presents a new, two-staged approach to predict fact faithfulness of the output of retrieval-augmented generations, and helps to establish a novel type of certified RAG systems for a broad range of natural language industry applications.

2605.05344.tldr: Open-SAT is proposed, a training-free query embedding refinement algorithm that operates at inference time to improve alignment between user queries and satellite image content, leveraging LLM guidance without the need for additional training or supervision.

2605.05341.tldr: Adapt elastic net SAEs (AEN-SAEs), a fully differentiable architecture grounded in classical sparse regression, are introduced, showing that AEN-SAEs mitigate feature starvation without auxiliary heuristics while maintaining competitive reconstruction abilities.

2605.05340.tldr: ImmersedPrivacy is presented, an interactive audio-visual evaluation framework that simulates realistic physical environments using a Unity-based simulator and reveals that current VLMs in the physical world suffer from perceptual fragility and fail to let their knowledge of privacy cues govern their situated behavior.

2605.05330.tldr: Graph Normalization is introduced, a principled dynamical system on graphs that serves as a differentiable approximation engine for the NP-hard Maximum Weight Independent Set (MWIS) problem and opens new avenues for deep learning architectures requiring differentiable,"hard" decisions under constraints.

2605.05257.tldr: Results suggest that longitudinal retrieval can improve resume tailoring when relevant prior experience exists, while also highlighting the need for confidence-gated retrieval when domain overlap is weak, and suggest that longitudinal retrieval can improve resume tailoring when relevant prior experience exists.

2605.05250.tldr: Hemitator is proposed, a theory-grounded user simulation framework that explicitly models human decision-making under choice overload and introduces a modular Decision Module that separates utility-based item selection from overload-aware commitment decisions.

2605.05242.tldr: Direct corpus interaction (DCI) is studied, where an agent searches the raw corpus directly with general-purpose terminal tools, without any embedding model, vector index, or retrieval API, and indicates that as language agents become stronger, retrieval quality depends not only on reasoning ability but also on the resolution of the interface through which the model interacts with the corpus.

2605.05225.tldr: MACS introduces an Entropy-Weighted Load mechanism to quantify the semantic value of visual tokens, addressing information heterogeneity, and the Dynamic Modality-Adaptive Capacity mechanism allocates expert resources based on the real-time modal composition of the input.

2605.03989.tldr: Experience-RAG Skill is presented, an agent-oriented pluggable retrieval orchestration layer positioned between the agent and the retriever pool, suggesting that retrieval strategy selection can be productively encapsulated as a reusable agent skill rather than being hard-coded in the upper workflow.

2605.03652.tldr: AniMatrix is a video generation model that targets artistic rather than physical correctness through a dual-channel conditioning mechanism and a three-step transition: redefine correctness, override the physics prior, and distinguish art from failure.

2605.05228.tldr: The work shows that proposed evolution with an appropriate set of operators and parameters can fast improve the accuracy of the quantization states of the network based on nearest neighbour rounding does not guarantee optimal accuracy.

2605.05222.tldr: Token-Selective Attention (TSA), a learned per-token gate on residual updates between consecutive transformer blocks that produces a continuous halting probability, making the mechanism end-to-end differentiable with 1.7% parameter overhead and no changes to the base architecture.

2605.05219.tldr: Sparse prefix caching is formalized as checkpoint placement under a distribution over overlap depths, yielding an exact O(NM) dynamic program that consistently improves the Pareto frontier traced by standard heuristics on real-world data.

2605.05214.tldr: MedMamba, a principle-driven multi-scale bidirectional state space architecture tailored for medical time series classification, is proposed, suggesting that principle-guided state space modeling offers an effective and scalable alternative to Transformer-based approaches for medical time series analysis.

2605.05209.tldr: It is proved weakness is minimax-optimal under exchangeable demands, and that PAC-Bayes bounds work because they correlate with it, and that Simplicity is dataset dependent, whereas weakness is invariant.

2605.03482.tldr: This work formalizes memory poisoning attacks on retrieval-augmented agents as a Stackelberg game with a unified evaluation framework spanning three attack classes with escalating access assumptions, and formally characterize a discrete synonym-invariance loophole that marks the boundary of what continuous-space defenses can guarantee.

2605.03354.tldr: The feature-space separation between the two circuit groups enables per-operation failure localization at 76.2% accuracy without supervision, providing a stage-level diagnostic for otherwise silent agent-memory failures.

2605.03227.tldr: The findings suggest that LLMs may simulate reasoning patterns rather than reliably perform exact symbolic computation, and for deterministic tasks, combining LLMs with external tools or using specialized models provides a more reliable and efficient solution.

2605.05331.tldr: ViTok-v2 is introduced, which addresses existing ViT tokenizers' limitations with native resolution support via NaFlex for generalization across resolutions and aspect ratios, and a novel DINOv3 perceptual loss that replaces both LPIPS and GAN objectives for stable training at any scale.

2605.05252.tldr: This paper presents an automated framework for large-scale audit transaction testing using AIbased document intelligence that leverages Snowflake's Document AI to extract structured data from unstructured PDF statements using a small labeled corpus.
