2605.05240.tldr: A deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based framework for dynamic positioning of wind-disturbed HAPS-mounted base stations in maritime networks that effectively mitigates wind-induced positioning deviations while ensuring reliable wide-area connectivity for maritime users is proposed.

2605.05236.tldr: A topology-driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (TD-MARL) framework to coordinate multi-robot systems to avoid entanglement is proposed and the full simulation experiments show that the method is better than the current advanced deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method in terms of convergence and anti-winding effect.

2605.05211.tldr: This review synthesizes recent applications of LLMs in this domain, including extracting sentiment from financial news and social media, analyzing financial reports and earnings-call transcripts, tokenizing or symbolizing stock price series, and constructing multi-agent trading systems.

2605.05271.tldr: IntraGuard is a black-box, venue-agnostic defense framework grounded in the structural--visual decoupling inherent to the PDF, designed for committee-side deployment and achieves a defense success rate of up to 84%, while preserving peer-review invariance for human reviewers.

2605.05259.tldr: PhenixCraft is introduced, a fully automated pipeline for building atomic models from cryo-EM density maps by integrating AlphaFold predictions, and its results demonstrate PhenixCraft's superior performance in TM-scores and sequence accuracy.

2605.05217.tldr: This framework provides a general recipe for embedding physics adaptively into neural networks, offering a robust and reproducible approach for data-scarce problems across various scientific domains, including fluid dynamics and material modeling.

2605.05329.tldr: Annotator Policy Models are introduced, interpretable models that learn annotators'internal safety policies from labeling behavior alone, making annotator reasoning visible and comparable without additional annotation effort and surfacing policy ambiguity by revealing how annotators interpret safety instructions differently.

2605.05611.tldr: X-Voice, a 0.4B multilingual zero-shot voice cloning model that clones arbitrary voices and enables everyone to speak 30 languages outperforms existing flow-matching based multilingual systems like LEMAS-TTS and achieves zero-shot cross-lingual cloning capabilities comparable to billion-scale models such as Qwen3-TTS.

2605.05580.tldr: AlphaCrafter is introduced, a full-stack multi-agent framework that closes the gap through a continuously adaptive factor-to-execution pipeline, designed to track and respond to evolving market conditions without manual intervention, confirming that integrated and adaptive factor-to-execution design yields robust trading performance.

2605.05573.tldr: AstroAlertBench is introduced, a comprehensive multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate LLM performance in astronomical event review along a three-stage logical chain: metadata grounding, scientific reasoning, and hierarchical classification over five categories, and a human-in-the-loop evaluation protocol is initialized as a precursor to future community-scale participation.

2605.05546.tldr: Results show that SPARK consistently outperforms flat-corpus-based self-play baselines, and the performance gap widens as hop count increases, suggesting that KG-structure grounding contributes to relational multi-hop reasoning beyond what unstructured corpus grounding can provide.

2605.05482.tldr: A unified, data-efficient framework for training grounded domain-specific LLMs that optimizes answer quality, citation grounding, and calibrated refusal under real-world deployment constraints is presented.

2605.05475.tldr: The Functional Intentionality Test (FIT) is introduced, a multidimensional framework that quantifies intentional-like behavior across five observable dimensions, and the FIT-Eval, a structured evaluation protocol for eliciting and scoring them.

2605.05443.tldr: SLAM (Structural Linguistic Activation Marking), a novel white-box watermarking scheme that sidesteps this cost by writing the mark into structural geometry rather than token frequencies, creates a complementary robustness profile but is vulnerable to paraphrase that restructures syntax.

2605.05413.tldr: Constant-context skill learning is proposed, a context-to-weights framework for recurring agent workflows: reusable procedures are learned in lightweight task-family modules, while inference conditions only on the current observation and a compact state block.

2605.05386.tldr: BALAR (Bayesian Agentic Loop for Active Reasoning), a task-agnostic outer-loop algorithm that requires no fine-tuning and enables structured multi-turn interaction between an LLM agent and a user, is proposed.

2605.05379.tldr: Partial Evidence Bench is introduced, a deterministic benchmark for measuring that failure mode of a governance-critical agent failure measurable without human judges or contamination-prone static corpora.

2605.05415.tldr: WARDEN is proposed, a distributionally robust adversarial training framework for LLMs that dynamically reweights adversarial examples through an f -divergence ambiguity set around the empirical training distribution, which substantially reduces attack success rates with computational and utility costs comparable to CAT-, CAPO-, and MixAT-based baselines.

2605.05460.tldr: An agentic search system in which an LLM proposes structured functional-form changes guided by evolutionary history, and the strongest discovered functional, SAFS26-a (Seed Agentic Functional Search 2026), improves upon the gold-standard B97M-V baseline by ~9%.

2605.05577.tldr: This work proposes LMO-IGT, a new class of stochastic LMO-based methods leveraging implicit gradient transport (IGT), and introduces a unified framework for stochastic LMO-based optimization together with a new stationarity measure, the RFS, which bridges gradient-norm and Frank--Wolfe-gap notions within a common framework.

2605.05538.tldr: The approach reduces this overdependence by layering a lightweight harness on top of existing enterprise search infrastructure, equipping a reasoning LLM with search, find, open, and summarize tools enabling the model to iteratively retrieve information, navigate within documents, and analyze evidence autonomously.

2605.05535.tldr: This research introduces the Housing Potential Common Data Model (HPCDM) to overcome existing data silos, serving as a standard to support integration and interoperability across the diverse range of datasets that are required for housing potential analysis.

2605.05514.tldr: By adapting the semantic rate to congestion and fidelity requirements, the proposed framework improves spectrum utilization and enables timely semantic updates with significantly lower delay and AoI than fixed-rate baselines.

2605.05485.tldr: Induced solvers are substantially more Pareto-efficient, amortizing a small one-time construction cost over many zero-token executions, and provide a scalable route to domain-general solver induction.

2605.05478.tldr: It is demonstrated that multi-source, adaptively weighted neurosymbolic transfer can improve scalability and robustness in symbolic RL settings and achieves 40-60% improvements in sample efficiency over existing baselines while remaining robust to poorly aligned sources.

2605.05427.tldr: A Probabilistic Graphical Model framework is introduced to audit LLM safety mechanisms causally and reveals a disparity between observational and interventional bias, demonstrating that standard fairness metrics can overestimate demographic bias by failing to account for context toxicity.

2605.05411.tldr: This work proposes a causal reasoning framework for creative robot tool use where a suitable tool for a task is correctly identified for use beyond its primary objectives and grounds tool use in the physics of the problem.

2605.05409.tldr: FinAgent-RAG is proposed, an agentic RAG framework that orchestrates iterative retrieval-reasoning loops with self-verification, specifically engineered for the precision requirements of financial numerical reasoning.

2605.05403.tldr: It is argued that sycophancy should be understood as agreement alone, but as alignment behavior that displaces independent epistemic judgment, and a three-condition framework for sycophancy is proposed, consisting of alignment targets, mechanisms, and severity.

2605.05372.tldr: This work reformulates reconstructionbased anomaly detection through consistency learning, enabling direct prediction of anomaly-free geometry in one or two network evaluations, and introduces a novel hybrid loss formulation that explicitly enforces reconstruction toward clean data.

2605.05476.tldr: A dual-purpose benchmark to jointly evaluate the performance of GNNs on noisy, text-derived graphs and the effectiveness of graph construction methods on a downstream task is introduced and a standardized, reproducible, and extensible evaluation framework is provided.

2605.05440.tldr: This paper argues that multi-agent systems also create a distinct authorization problem: maintaining authorization invariants as non-human principals retrieve data, delegate tasks, and synthesize results across changing boundaries, and formalizes authorization propagation as a workflow-level property.

2605.05438.tldr: It is demonstrated that semantic loss is essential and not optional, for stable causal reasoning in transformers, and proposed a semantic loss function with graph-based logical constraints and dynamic lambda scheduling that prevents this collapse.

2605.05389.tldr: This work introduces a Node-Edge Policy Factorization (NEPF) approach, which splits the routing policy into a node permutation stage and an edge selection stage, and demonstrates that NEPF matches or outperforms the state-of-the-art in terms of solution quality, while being significantly faster in training and inference.

2605.05367.tldr: This work introduces the first high-quality 3D parametric annotations for the Ishara-500 Saudi Sign Language dataset, providing precise SMPL-X parameters for 500 culturally authentic SSL signs, and presents Tamaththul3D, a specialized reconstruction pipeline designed for ArSL's unique articulation patterns.

2605.05602.tldr: This work considers the problem of estimating the Attention mechanism in small space, and proves the existence of coresets for it of nearly optimal size, and offers an improved lower bound showing that $\varepsilon$-coresets must have size $\Omega({\sqrt{d} e^{\rho}/\epsilon})$.

2605.05566.tldr: The proposed Lorem Perturbation for Exploration (LoPE), a simple yet effective training framework to break this exploration bottleneck, posit that task-irrelevant prompt-space perturbations can shift the model's output distribution enough to unlock orthogonal reasoning pathways for hard questions.

2605.05499.tldr: This work proposes FoodCHA, a multimodal agentic framework that reformulates food recognition as a hierarchical decision-making process and utilizes the compact Moondream-2B vision language model, which provides strong reasoning capability while maintaining lower computational and memory overhead.

2605.05410.tldr: LaTA is a drop-in, open-source autograder that runs entirely on commodity on-premises hardware and assumes a LaTeX-native workflow already adopted by many engineering and physics courses, and is deployed in Winter~2026 in ME 373 at Oregon State University.

2605.05407.tldr: This paper introduces PRISM, a framework that tightly couples perception (VLM) and decision (LLM) through a dynamic question-answer (DQA) pipeline, and shows that PRISM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art image-based models.

2605.05392.tldr: Experimental results indicate that summaries generated using evidence-based queries achieve competitive ROUGE scores compared to those generated from the original queries.

2605.05626.tldr: The findings establish that temporal participation is a distinct and trainable dimension of conversational intelligence, and that grounded synthetic data provides an effective and scalable pathway for enabling LLMs to participate more naturally and appropriately in multi-party interactions.

2605.05598.tldr: Prober.ai is presented, a web-based writing environment that inverts the conventional AI-tutoring paradigm: rather than generating or rewriting student text, the system constrains an LLM through persona-specific system prompts and structured JSON output schemas to produce only targeted, inquiry-based questions about argumentative weaknesses.

2605.05561.tldr: BitCal-TTS is proposed, a lightweight runtime controller that combines (i) inexpensive online proxies for token-level uncertainty and reasoning-trace stability, (ii) a bit-conditioned confidence rescaling that is conservative at low nominal precision, and (iii) a bit-aware post-marker confirmation horizon designed for GSM8K-style structured outputs.

2605.05558.tldr: A natural intuition about the economics of AI agents is that, because agents can be replicated at near-zero marginal cost, they constitute a labor input in infinitely elastic supply, and therefore drive cognitive-labor wages to zero, but this framing is argued to be wrong in mechanism but partially correct in conclusion.

2605.05593.tldr: A causal framework based on activation steering to actively probe and manipulate internal visual representations is proposed, revealing a divergence in concept encoding: entities exhibit distinct localized memorization, whereas abstract concepts are globally distributed across the network.

2605.05583.tldr: The proposed BeliefMem shifts the memory paradigm from committing to a single conclusion per observation to retaining multiple candidate conclusions with their probabilities, enabling the agent to act with high confidence on well-evidenced knowledge while retaining the capacity to update its confidence when new evidence arrives.

2605.05567.tldr: ReOT minimizes classification risk while learning the separated cluster structure between the identified shared classes and private classes, effectively avoiding mismatch between shared-private sample pairs, thus ensuring that important knowledge is reliably transported intra-class to mitigate class-conditional discrepancy.

2605.05524.tldr: MOSAIC (Module discovery via Sparse Additive Identifiable Causal learning), a sparse temporal VAE that integrates temporal CRL identifiability with support recovery over observed variables, enabling interpretable discovery of latent mechanisms in scientific time series.

2605.05480.tldr: GRALIS (Gradient-Riesz Averaged Locally-Integrated Shapley), a mathematical framework establishing a representation theory for attributions, satisfies 13.5/14 axiomatic properties vs. 2.5-6/14 for individual methods, including completeness, sensitivity, locality, order-k interactions and optimal multi-scale aggregation simultaneously.

2605.05472.tldr: This paper presents a design-oriented study in which an AI-integrated syllabus in a database design course deliberately leverages AI's limitations to foster critical thinking and higher-order cognitive skills aligned with Bloom's taxonomy of learning.

2605.05463.tldr: Noise-Aware Text-Driven Graph GSSL (NATD-GSSL), a unified framework that combines automatic graph construction, graph refinement, and GSSL that achieves up to a 7\% improvement over pretrained language model baselines is introduced.

2605.05402.tldr: An AI-enabled analytics framework leveraging existing CCTV infrastructure is introduced to evaluate the impact of soft interventions, such as temporary pedestrian refuges and curb extensions, on vehicle speed and safety in Minneapolis, demonstrating the traffic-calming effectiveness of soft infrastructure.

2605.05400.tldr: The concept of context fluency as an emerging developer skill -- the ability to create rich, structured context that agents can act on -- is introduced and connected to established frameworks in backward design and tacit knowledge externalization.

2605.05370.tldr: This work introduces a novel approach to ligand selection that requires only 40 tests on average to find 10 high-quality ligands and outperforms deep learning and Bayesian optimization methods on more proteins, achieving median improvements of 7%-32% in sample efficiency.

2605.05365.tldr: ZAYA1-8B is presented, a reasoning-focused mixture-of-experts (MoE) model with 700M active and 8B total parameters, built on Zyphra's MoE++ architecture, and Markovian RSA is introduced, a test-time compute method that recursively aggregates parallel reasoning traces while carrying forward only bounded-length reasoning tails between rounds.

2605.05738.tldr: A simple yet efficient dual-branch continual learning framework for traffic prediction, named CoMemNet, which incorporates a lightweight Node-Adaptive Temporal Memory Buffer to consolidate old knowledge through memory replay and address the risk of memory explosion.

2605.05737.tldr: ReFlect is a standalone error detection and recovery logic system for LLM reasoning that creates standalone error detection and recovery logic as a deterministic wrapper around the model, and operates entirely at inference time.

2605.05676.tldr: This paper empirically finds that certain parameters are consistently co-activated, and that co-activated parameters naturally organize into base groups, and proposes a novel solution, namely Basic Abilities Decomposition for multi-task Instruct-Tuning (BADIT), which can outperform SOTA methods and mitigate the degree of cross-task interference.

2605.05724.tldr: The central empirical finding is that lineage feedback lets agents turn evaluator outcomes, including crashes, budget overruns, size failures, and accuracy-gate misses, into later program-level recipe edits rather than one-shot suggestions.

2605.05704.tldr: This work designs a local hierarchical memory system for dynamic rule injection, offering a training-free, efficient, and plug-and-play solution, and introduces an information entropy-based self-evolution mechanism that continuously optimizes the memory structure through dynamic node splitting and merging.

2605.05693.tldr: Saliency-Aware Regularized Quantization Calibration (SARQC) is proposed, a unified framework that augments the standard PTQ objective with a saliency-aware regularization term, leading to improved generalization during inference.

2605.05685.tldr: This paper introduces Temporal Functional Circuits, a framework that transforms KAN edge functions from latent visualizations into faithful, temporally grounded explanations, built on a gated residual KAN that decomposes forecasts into a linear base and a sparsely activated KAN correction.

2605.05674.tldr: Euclidean Geodesic Alignment (EGA) is proposed, a residual adapter that couples three principles: zero initialization, local triplet loss, and hypersphere projection that achieves the highest worst-case Label Precision on the four primary splits and a consistent improvement on the fifth.

2605.05648.tldr: An evaluation framework is proposed and applied to 10,235 code submissions with corresponding AI tutor feedback from an introductory undergraduate programming course to measure whether students act on tutor feedback and whether those actions are applied correctly, revealing substantial differences in student engagement patterns that are not captured by pedagogy-only evaluation.

2605.05630.tldr: This work addresses the challenge of detecting the earliest turn at which delivering the candidate response would make the accumulated interaction sufficient to enable harmful action, by constructing the Multi-Turn Intent Dataset (MTID), which contains branching attack rollouts, matched benign hard negatives, and annotations of the earliest harm-enabling turns.

2605.05780.tldr: Initial experiments show that VNN based multi-layered perceptrons outperform their equivalent deep learning variant on basic tasks, while being more parameter efficient and are capable of learning new types of tasks.

2605.05770.tldr: It is demonstrated that rewarding generated peptides with CP-informed predictions improves both reliability and efficiency of peptide optimization process, and is also shown how generative modelling and conformal prediction can be combined for the first time.

2605.05755.tldr: It is shown that a linear self-attention transformer block can provably implement policy-improvement methods, including semi-gradient SARSA and actor-critic, via explicit parameter constructions, and the first convergence guarantee in the ICRL literature is established.

2605.05728.tldr: A benchmark suite comprising dual-labeled AC-OPF datasets with IPOPT-extracted solutions, a corrected evaluation protocol, and WARP - a topology-conditioned encode-process-decode interaction network that predicts the full interior-point state on the heterogeneous constraint graph is released.

2605.05726.tldr: Task-specific fine-tuning on SkillRet substantially improves performance, improving NDCG@10 by +13.1 points over the strongest prior retriever and by +16.9 points over the strongest off-the-shelf retriever, and establishing SkillRet as a strong benchmark and foundation for future research on retrieval in large-scale agent systems.

2605.05702.tldr: The approach improves the average score over standard SSP in all configurations, including notable gains on multi-hop QA tasks, and suggests that knowledge-graph paths can be reused as lightweight intermediate supervision, providing both relational guidance and process feedback without additional task-specific human annotations or manually labeled process steps.

2605.05700.tldr: This paper collects real IDE interaction traces from experienced industry developers over three consecutive days using a custom Visual Studio Code extension, and constructs paired LLM-simulated traces for controlled comparison, showing that simulated traces differ substantially from real traces in behavioral diversity, temporal structure, and exploratory patterns.

2605.05692.tldr: This paper proposes the first compression-friendly encryption method for PPAR, called CFE-PPAR, which outperforms previous methods on the UCF101 and HMDB51 datasets under Motion-JPEG and H.264 compression.

2605.05689.tldr: GCCM is proposed, a graph contrastive consistency model that goes beyond isolated pairwise matching between the same target at different noise levels by introducing negative pairs into a contrastive consistency objective, and mitigates the shortcut solution and yields consistent performance improvements in graph prediction compared to deterministic predictors.

2605.05668.tldr: A unified framework grounded in information theory and geometry is proposed to quantify the geometric and entropic nature of residual updates and reveals a fundamental functional decoupling, suggesting that state-of-the-art LVLMs effectively ``get lost in attention''rather than efficiently leveraging visual context.

2605.05775.tldr: Three main conclusions can be drawn: (1) in-domain multitracer PET/CT segmentation is sufficient and probably approaching reader agreement; (2) compositional generalization to unseen tracer-center combinations remains an open problem mainly driven by systematic volume overestimation; (3) heterogeneity and case difficulty drive performance variation substantially more than the choice of algorithm among top-ranked teams.

2605.05741.tldr: This work identifies an intrinsic magnification mechanism in transformer architectures: deeper layers inherently magnify the small changes of layer-wise confidence, providing a fine-grained confidence trajectory that separates complex from simple tasks.

2605.05739.tldr: This framework converts deficient per-dimension scores into a credit-assigned penalty term added to the Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) reward, with gains concentrated in high-volatility episodes where the original system was most behaviorally deficient.

2605.05732.tldr: It is suggested that controlling adaptation in representation space, guided by output-space divergence, provides a scalable and principled approach to continual learning in LLMs.

2605.05725.tldr: SAGE (Specialized Analyzer Group for Expert-like Detection), a multi-agent framework for structured anomaly diagnosis in univariate time series, decomposes anomaly analysis into four specialized Analyzers for point, structural, seasonal, and pattern anomalies and achieves the best average performance among strong ML/DL and language-model-based baselines.

2605.05716.tldr: The findings suggest maximally-equipped agent defaults should be replaced by task-specific subset selection via interaction-aware analysis, showing greedy selection is unreliable.

2605.05709.tldr: This work proposes concealment-aware variant construction, which greedily selects character-removed variants that are low in harmful-keyword alignment and mutually diverse, and instantiates them through five modality-aware prompting strategies, and introduces keyword-related distractor images that depict the harmful keyword in diverse contexts, providing more effective auxiliary visual context than generic distractor images.

2605.05706.tldr: A sampling-based maximum mean discrepancy (sMMD), a stochastic alignment strategy that replaces global adversarial balancing with subset-level matching, is introduced in a framework for counterfactual outcome prediction with attribution-grounded interpretability.

2605.05703.tldr: An ensemble-based information-theoretic task selection framework that estimates task informativeness by how much a candidate task changes the distribution over graph parameters, using ensemble Kalman inversion as an efficient and derivative-free approximation of the corresponding Bayesian update is proposed.

2605.05701.tldr: It is suggested that inference-time budget control for LLM search agents should govern both how budget is spent during search and how the final answer is committed when the accumulated evidence is sufficient to commit a final answer.

2605.05687.tldr: This work shows that robust training data attribution requires evaluation settings that separate true answer support from topical or lexical resemblance, and introduces FakeWiki, a controlled benchmark of 3,537 fabricated Wikipedia-style articles designed to preserve ground-truth provenance while weakening lexical shortcuts.

2605.05686.tldr: Geometric margin--the hidden state's distance to the nearest memorized basin--reads this geometry directly and separates correct recall from hallucination far more cleanly than output entropy, with zero false refusals where entropy-based detection cannot avoid rejecting the vast majority of correct outputs.

2605.05657.tldr: The headline contribution is the composition of two previously separate lines of work -- complexity-conditioned LLM routing and formal resource algebras -- yielding a property neither admits alone: provable budget conservation under retrieval-conditioned dynamic topology selection.

2605.05643.tldr: Experimental results on multiple multi-hop reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that TGS-RAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a superior balance between retrieval precision and computational efficiency.

2605.05769.tldr: AS-LoRA is proposed, an adaptive framework defined by three axes, in which each layer independently selects its active component, in which the selection updates over communication rounds, and a curvature-aware score derived from a second-order approximation of the loss.

2605.05627.tldr: It is demonstrated that even small quantities of prompt-generated data significantly improve performance for underrepresented species, and concludes that vision-language models can serve as agile data generators, effectively bootstrapping perception tasks for niche AI domains where expert labels are scarce or unavailable.

2605.05731.tldr: An automated diagnostic approach for severity grading of KOA is proposed by blending a deep learning convolutional neural network (CNN) with a device-based inference platform powered by TensorFlow Lite, based on the ResNet-18 convolutional neural network.

2605.05715.tldr: This work investigates this classification-correction gap via Overthinking--a stable behavioral regime in medical QA where models answer correctly under resampling yet fail in extended chain-of-thought in medical QA.

2605.05697.tldr: Budgeted Attention Allocation, a monotone head-gating mechanism conditioned on a requested attention budget is studied, a reproducible feasibility study of one controllable checkpoint across budgets that can trade attention cost for accuracy and be converted into measured structural speedups on small CPU benchmarks.

2605.05696.tldr: It is argued that content-addressed caching belongs in the serving stack as a first-class primitive, not a retrofit over prefix matching, and Irminsul is presented, which extends SGLang's radix cache with content-hash keying over CDC-chunked segments and a $\delta$-rotation rule for $k_r$.

2605.05682.tldr: This work develops PersonaTeaming Workflow, which incorporates personas into the adversarial prompt generation process to explore a wider spectrum of adversarial strategies, and instantiates PersonaTeaming Playground, a user-facing interface that enables red-teamers to author their own personas and collaborate with AI to mutate and refine prompts.

2605.05678.tldr: Adaptive multi-principle steering, a white-box test-time mitigation that learns one unsafe-to-safe activation direction per safety principle and activates only directions whose current hidden state is closer to the unsafe than safe centroid, is proposed.

2605.05662.tldr: XL-SafetyBench enables more nuanced, cross-cultural safety evaluation in the multilingual era by evaluating a suite of 5,500 test cases across 10 country-language pairs, comprising a Jailbreak Benchmark of country-grounded adversarial prompts and a Cultural Benchmark where local sensitivities are embedded within innocuous requests.

2605.05773.tldr: The largest annotated dataset of analog circuit netlists to date is curated, comprising 31,341 netlist-natural language description pairs across all major circuit classes, and a novel circuit graph tokenizer is proposed, Circuit Tokenizer (CKT), a novel circuit graph tokenizer designed to encode netlist connectivity by explicitly mining frequent subcircuits.

2605.05748.tldr: The findings indicate that widely used XAI techniques may be insufficient for safety-critical deployment, and emphasize the need to move beyond visually plausible explanations toward approaches that support reliable decision making and system-level assurance.

2605.05745.tldr: A likelihood-ratio--based confidence sequence is introduced that unifies heterogeneous generalized linear observations and yields an explicit ellipsoidal confidence set under a self-concordance assumption and a hybrid Track-and-Stop algorithm that adaptively allocates queries by tracking a minimax-optimal design over a joint action space of arms and pairs is proposed.

2605.05743.tldr: Two complementary RFF-based methods forming a practical toolkit for score-based, constraint-based, and hybrid causal discovery are presented, showing that BOSS+FFML outperforms linear and kernel-ridge baselines on nonlinear data.

2605.05736.tldr: SDFlow is proposed, a non-autoregressive framework that operates entirely in the frozen VQ latent space and enables parallel sequence generation via flow matching and provides significant inference speedups over autoregressive baselines, offering both high fidelity and computational efficiency.

2605.05965.tldr: This work introduces P-trace as a sample-efficient, critic-free eligibility traces method, upon which S-trace is built, implementing a sparse eligibility traces mechanism to further mitigate variance and achieve fine-grained credit assignment by selectively masking low-entropy tokens.

2605.05953.tldr: PCNET, a Probabilistic Circuit trained as a tractable density estimator over the LLM residual stream, achieves near-perfect hallucination detection and obtains the highest True+Info, MC2, and MC3 scores on TruthfulQA in three out of four models, in comparison with state-of-the-art baselines.

2605.05951.tldr: HaM-World is proposed, a structured world model that decomposes the latent state into a canonical (q, p) subspace and a context subspace c, while using Mamba selective state-space memory as the history-conditioned input to the same latent dynamics.

2605.05920.tldr: SECDA-DSE is presented, a framework that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) into the SECDA ecosystem, comprising tools built around SECDA to automate the design space exploration (DSE) of FPGA-based accelerators.

2605.05911.tldr: This work proposes an online learning framework that generates personalized summaries for each user, and provides a case study using the Amazon Reviews'23 dataset, showing in controlled simulations that online preference learning improves alignment with target user interests while maintaining summary quality.

2605.05896.tldr: This paper proposes VARS-FL (Validation-Aligned Reputation Scoring for Federated Learning), a client selection framework that quantifies each client's contribution using the reduction in server-side validation loss induced by its update, and compares it against FedAvg, Oort, and Power-of-Choice.

2605.05893.tldr: LOVER is proposed, an unsupervised verifier regularized by logical rules that treats the verifier as a binary latent variable, utilizing internal activations and enforcing three logical constraints on multiple reasoning paths:negation consistency, intra-group consistency, and inter-group consistency.

2605.05882.tldr: A new framework for fairness in structural causal models that is tailored to continuous protected attributes is introduced, and a fair tuning algorithm is proposed that either constructs such a predictor or allows for a trade-off between SP and PP.

2605.05826.tldr: Asymmetric Group Policy Optimization adopts a negative-dominant reinforcement strategy to suppress incorrect reasoning paths, maintaining the base model's exploration capacity, and scales positive updates based on intra-group variance, allowing the model to focus on rare correct paths while suppressing updates from trivial paths.

2605.05818.tldr: This study reveals that query generation and adversarial instructions contribute independently to leakage, with overall leakage well approximated by their product, and stronger instruction-following capability correlates with higher leakage risk.

2605.05794.tldr: MoLS estimates module-level SNRs to scale Adam updates, allowing automated module-wise learning rate allocation without manual tuning, and improves convergence speed and generalization.

2605.05781.tldr: Understanding-Oriented Post-Training (UNO), a lightweight framework that treats understanding not only as a distinct task, but also a direct supervisory signal to steer generative representations, is introduced to enable effective gradient flow from understanding to generation.

2605.05977.tldr: This work designs a novel metric that captures behavioral drift in action distributions to identify and suppress backdoor actions at runtime, and proposes BehaviorGuard, the first online backdoor defense that counters attacks both in single- and multi-agent DRL.

2605.05958.tldr: The Temporal Smoothness Doubly Robust (TSDR) framework jointly optimizes the KT predictor and the imputation model with a smoothness regularizer, effectively reducing variance while preserving the unbiasedness guarantee of DR.

2605.05914.tldr: It is shown that Cayley-parameterised unitary adapters improve the perplexity of Llama 3.1 8B, an 8-billion-parameter model in widespread use, by 1.4% with only 6,000 additional parameters and end-to-end inference validated on real Quantum Processing Unit (QPU).

2605.05889.tldr: DBMSolver is introduced, a training-free sampler that exploits the semi-linear structure of DBM's underlying SDE and ODE via exponential integrators, yielding highly-efficient 1st- and 2nd-order solutions.

2605.05878.tldr: This work argues that a risk primitive adequate for this regime is a composition of five engines: a prediction engine over price, liquidity, volatility, and route health; a Bittensor verification subnet that decentralises and economically scores prediction outputs; a sentiment-fusion engine over text, on-chain flow, and grey-literature feeds; and an API-risk and scenario engine that converts forecasts into pre-committed action programs in the sense of Monte-Carlo scenario generation.

2605.05848.tldr: VideoRouter is presented, a query-adaptive dual-router framework built on InternVL for budgeted evidence allocation that enables aggressive compression on less relevant frames while preserving detail on critical evidence frames.

2605.05832.tldr: This work introduces MOSAIC, a dual-dimensional difficulty framework with 37 fine-grained labels that jointly characterize visual interference and chemical semantic challenges in molecular diagrams, and proposes CARBON, a representation language capable of expressing valence variations, icon-based groups, and other non-standard chemical semantics.

2605.05811.tldr: Experiments show that sheet-level tokenization learns stable representations, and that graph-enhanced cross-sheet reasoning improves listwise retrieval over a shallow graph baseline with limited additional graph-side computation, suggesting that sheet-level tokenization is a promising abstraction for scalable multi-sheet spreadsheet understanding.

2605.05807.tldr: Results show that code-centric representations, retrieval grounding, and verification-guided reasoning improve the reliability and operational usefulness of LLM-assisted malware attribution.

2605.05990.tldr: iPhoneBlur is introduced, a difficulty-stratified benchmark of 7,400 image pairs synthesized from high-framerate iPhone 17 Pro videos captured in diverse real-world scenarios that enables systematic assessment of model reliability and failure modes for resource-constrained edge systems.

2605.05959.tldr: FedSAF is designed, which shifts the alignment objective from absolute coordinates to inter-class relational structure, and demonstrates that structural alignment consistently outperforms coordinate alignment in heterogeneous settings.

2605.05938.tldr: ICU-Bench is introduced, a continual multimodal unlearning benchmark built on privacy-critical document data and shows that existing methods generally struggle in continual settings and exhibit clear limitations in balancing forgetting quality, utility preservation, and scalability over long task sequences.

2605.05929.tldr: A methodology to analyze the distribution of languages across LOD KGs is presented and a preliminary multi-level categorization based on DBpedia, BabelNet, and Wikidata is proposed to bring a formal definition of low-, high-, and medium-resource languages that could be later leveraged to select cross-lingual transfer candidates.

2605.05909.tldr: This paper proposes a Contrastive Visual Forgetting (CVF) mechanism to separate target visual knowledge from retained visual knowledge, guiding the representations of target visual concepts toward appropriate regions in the feature space, thereby significantly mitigating degradation in knowledge retention.

2605.05908.tldr: This work presents an architecture-agnostic Lipschitz-constant Bayesian header that can be integrated into feature extractors such as vision transformers, yielding the bi-Lipschitz-constrained Bayesian Vision Transformer (LipB-ViT).

2605.05895.tldr: MAST is proposed, a detector that processes multi-channel temporal residuals with a spike-driven temporal branch alongside a frozen semantic encoder for cross-generator generalization, matching or surpassing the strongest ANN-based detectors and demonstrating the practical applicability of SNNs to AI-generated video detection.

2605.05891.tldr: The empirical results indicate that the multi-task learner is an effective anomaly detector, outperforming all state-of-the-art competitors on BMAD and produces interpretable anomaly maps, potentially helping physicians in providing more accurate diagnoses.

2605.05873.tldr: This work proposes the Certification by Intersection-union Testing with E-processes (CITE) algorithm, which provably controls false certification at any prescribed level under arbitrary data-driven stopping, without requiring prior knowledge of the answer category set.

2605.05863.tldr: SOPE, an algorithm that uses an actor-aligned Off-Policy Policy Evaluation signal as an automated early-stopping mechanism to dynamically control the length of offline training phases, demonstrates that adaptive, evaluation-driven update schedules are more effective than relying on static, exhaustive update schedules.

2605.05846.tldr: LoopTrap is introduced, an automated red-teaming framework that synthesizes target-specific malicious prompts by exploiting agent behavioral tendencies and can serve as principled guidance for crafting effective attacks against previously unseen agents and tasks, enabling scalable red-teaming beyond manually designed templates.

2605.05995.tldr: Safety Bottleneck Regularization (SBR) shifts the defensive focus from the redundant parameter space to the unembedding layer, which serves as a geometric bottleneck, and enables the model to maintain safe responses even under persistent HFT.

2605.05985.tldr: Ingenix BioResearcher is introduced, a scenario-guided multi-agent system that maps queries to versioned research playbooks, delegates to specialized subagents over 30+ tools and machine-learning endpoints, mixes structured database access with sandboxed code for genome-scale analyses, and applies claim-level multi-model reconciliation before editorial assembly.

2605.05963.tldr: TheraAgent, an agentic framework that replaces one-shot generation with an iterative generate-judge-refine pipeline, and introduces TheraJudge, a treatment-specific evaluation module integrated into the inference loop to enforce clinical standards.

2605.05949.tldr: MAS-Algorithm is proposed, a systematic multi-agent workflow for algorithmic problem solving inspired by the practices of competitive programmers and algorithm engineers that decomposes the end-to-end solving process into modular stages, enabling structured reasoning, tool integration, and flexible coordination among agents.

2605.05913.tldr: Wisteria is proposed, a genomic language model that integrates multi scale feature learning within a unified framework for DNA sequence and augments the Mamba based architecture with gated dilated convolutions to capture local motifs and regulatory patterns, while gated multilayer perceptrons refine global dependencies.

2605.05861.tldr: This paper considers a multi-agent emergent communication framework, tailored for semantic-aware AgentNet systems in which the user's semantic intent can be automatically detected, inferred, and linked to a set of sub-tasks to be assigned to a set of agents.

2605.05833.tldr: SemBid is a novel auto-bidding framework that injects LLM-encoded semantics into offline bidding trajectories at the token level and uses self-attention to integrate them, improving controllability and generalization across objectives.

2605.05813.tldr: A concrete failure mode, input-independent constant collapse, is studied, and it is shown that this case admits an exact threshold, which turns a qualitative failure mode into a measurable one.

2605.05812.tldr: This work proposes long-horizon Q-learning (LQL), which introduces a principled backstop against compounding error when learning the optimal action-value function by using a hinge loss to penalize violations of these bounds.

2605.05980.tldr: This paper introduces TACT (Think-Act Calibration via activation Steering), to detect and mitigate agent drift in the residual stream before it surfaces as a behavioral failure, and positions TACT as a viable handle for reliable long-horizon agents.

2605.05974.tldr: PragLocker constructs function-preserving obfuscated prompts by anchoring semantics with code symbols and then using target-model feedback to inject noise, yielding prompts that only work on the target LLM.

2605.05973.tldr: This work proposes SIREN, a selection-aware repeated-split reporting protocol that freezes the post-search shortlist, separates splitwise selection from held-out evaluation, and uses an item-level Gaussian multiplier bootstrap for uncertainty quantification.

2605.05931.tldr: This proposal identifies key variables that characterize language distribution in LOD, including the number of Wikipedia articles per language edition and the number of language-tagged entities in LOD KGs and intends to study the impact of cross-lingual transfer candidate selection on the task of multilingual KG completion.

2605.05921.tldr: Findings from a formative user study with 11 expert mathematicians who used AlphaEvolve, an evolutionary coding agent, to tackle advanced problems in their fields of expertise suggest an approach to designing AI tools for scientific discovery that goes beyond the existing question/answer model of many current systems.

2605.05842.tldr: This work presents Taklif.AI, a platform that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to automatically generate personalized assignments tailored to individual student interests, and describes the system architecture, the prompt design methodology, and the guardrails framework that ensures output quality.

2605.06148.tldr: WAR-Tok, arete image tokenizer that reduces AR loss and improves generation FID on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet at comparable reconstruction quality by adding a distribution-level prior-matching signal during tokenizer training, while keeping the reconstruction objective unchanged.

2605.06116.tldr: This work forms stepwise model routing as a constrained decision-making problem, which is solved by training a small control policy using reinforcement learning in conjunction with threshold calibration to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff.

2605.06100.tldr: This work proposes CredibleDFGO (CDFGO), a differentiable GNSS factor graph framework that makes covariance credibility an explicit training target, and studies negative log-likelihood (NLL), Energy Score (ES), and their combination.

2605.06094.tldr: This work proposes VISD, a structured self distillation framework that introduces diagnostically meaningful privileged information for video reasoning, and introduces a direction magnitude decoupling mechanism to stably integrate dense supervision with RL.

2605.06066.tldr: MTG-Causal-RL gives causal-RL, world-model, and LLM-agent research a shared testbed for questions current benchmarks cannot pose together: causal credit assignment under masked action spaces, structural transfer across archetypes, and SCM-grounded policy auditability.

2605.06054.tldr: This work presents an approach to visually compare LLM outputs across generation conditions by modeling responses as collections of linguistic choices, including content, expression, and structure, enabling direct, distribution-level comparison of condition-specific tendencies.

2605.06040.tldr: A measurable concept of novelty is proposed that describes the uniqueness of a new node (thought) in comparison to nodes previously seen in the search tree, which can be used to prune branches and reduce the scope of the search.

2605.06032.tldr: A large-scale empirical study systematically evaluating synthetic time series augmentation across five architectures, four synthetic signals and seven datasets finds that only the Seasonal-Trend generator reliably helps across the tested benchmarks, and that hard curriculum switching is actively harmful.

2605.06012.tldr: PFCVR, a Part-level Fine-grained Cross-modal Vehicle Retrieval model for text-to-image vehicle re-identification, is proposed and a new large-scale dataset called T2I-VeRW is constructed, which contains 14,668 images covering 1,796 vehicle identities with fine-grained part-level annotations.

2605.06161.tldr: It is argued that any trustworthy safety judge must satisfy a basic property the authors call policy invariance, and it is operationalized as three testable principles: rubric-semantics invariance under certified-equivalent rewrites, rubric-threshold invariance under intentional strict-to-lenient shifts, and ambiguity-aware calibration so that verdict instability concentrates on genuinely ambiguous cases.

2605.06149.tldr: AdaGamma is proposed, a practical deep actor--critic method for state-dependent discounting that learns a state-dependent discount function together with a return-consistency objective to regularize the induced backup structure and suggest that state-dependent discounting can be made effective in deep RL when coupled with a return-consistency objective that prevents degenerate target manipulation.

2605.06139.tldr: This work proposes Listwise Policy Optimization to explicitly conduct the target-projection, which demystifies the implicit target by restricting the proximal RL objective to the response simplex, and then projects the policy via exact divergence minimization.

2605.06124.tldr: P-Guide is introduced, a framework that achieves high-quality guidance through a single inference pass by modulating only the initial latent state, and is equivalent to CFG in the sense that it steers generation from the prior space, without requiring explicit velocity field extrapolation during sampling.

2605.06123.tldr: This work argues that knowledge becomes the primary search object and code merely instantiates and tests it, making what is learned explicit and reusable across problems and trajectories, and formalizes this shift through a statistical-learning view that exposes a distortion--compression trade-off.

2605.06115.tldr: CrossCult-KIBench is introduced, a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for assessing both the effectiveness of knowledge insertion and its unintended side effects on non-target cultures and proposes Memory-Conditioned Knowledge Insertion (MCKI) as a baseline method.

2605.06033.tldr: Significant differences in the timing and extent of AI adoption across countries and scientific domains from 1960 to 2015 are documented and generalized exponential growth in AI adoption is found, with the number of AI-supported works multiplying by at least four across all domains.

2605.06165.tldr: This work proposes Post-Reasoning, a simple yet effective approach that improves instruction-tuned models by conditioning them to justify their answers after generating the final response, and proposes supervised post-reason tuning, which improves performance and establishes a new performance ceiling for direct-answer capabilities.

2605.06154.tldr: A model-agnostic framework based on a vocabulary of graphlets that mines a KG between relations via pattern matching is introduced that is evaluated on 51 KGs from a wide range of domains, for zero-shot inductive and transductive link prediction.

2605.06143.tldr: This work develops a suite of detectors with various architectures and fine-tuning strategies, trained on the authors' large-scale photorealistic fake image dataset, AIText2Image, and assess their performance on state-of-the-art text-to-image AI generators.

2605.06142.tldr: The Implicit Reminiscence Context Benchmark, the Implicit Reminiscence Context Benchmark, for evaluating implicit entity recognition in reminiscence transcripts is introduced and 19 configurations across LLM generation, dense retrieval, RAG, and fine-tuning are evaluated.

2605.06137.tldr: Prologue generates a small set of prologue tokens prepended to the visual token sequence, trained exclusively with the AR cross-entropy loss, while visual tokens remain dedicated to reconstruction.

2605.06136.tldr: BUILD-AND-FIND is introduced, a protocol for evaluating whether downstream agents can recover intended choices from generated repositories and how much inspection that recovery requires, and how much inspection that recovery requires.

2605.06130.tldr: Skill1 is a framework that trains a single policy to co-evolve skill selection, utilization, and distillation toward a shared task-outcome objective and outperforms prior skill-based and reinforcement learning baselines.

2605.06112.tldr: An event sparsity-aware tracking framework that explicitly models event-density variations across multiple temporal scales is proposed, and a sparsity-aware Mixture-of-Experts module is introduced to encourage expert specialization under different sparsity patterns.

2605.06047.tldr: TFM-Retouche, a lightweight input-space residual adapter that is architecture-agnostic by design with respect to the frozen TFM backbone, is introduced, a lightweight input-space residual adapter that is architecture-agnostic by design with respect to the frozen TFM backbone.

2605.06010.tldr: FusionProxy is proposed, a real-time image fusion module designed as a fully independent, plug-and-play component with diffusion level quality, providing a flexible and generalizable solution for all-day perception.

2605.06187.tldr: This work introduces a structured feedback prior that models how feedback sources vary in their access, relevance, and distortion relative to the true objective, and uses it to pretrain a feedback-aware transformer for black-box optimization of synthetic and real-world tasks.

2605.06185.tldr: Experiments on long-video understanding benchmarks demonstrate that Event-Causal RAG consistently outperforms strong clip-based retrieval baselines and long-context video models, particularly on questions requiring multi-event integration and causal inference across long temporal gaps, while also achieving improved memory efficiency and robust streaming performance.

2605.06173.tldr: Retina-RAG, a low-cost modular framework that jointly performs DR severity grading, macular edema detection, and report generation, is proposed, demonstrating that clinically structured retinal AI can be achieved with modest computational resources.

2605.06156.tldr: ME-AM incorporates two mechanisms: a Mirror Descent entropy maximization objective that mitigates the popularity bias to facilitate the extraction of optimal policies from offline datasets, and aixture Behavior Prior that mathematically broadens the geometric support to encompass out-of-distribution high-reward regions.

2605.06145.tldr: This work unify GCRL and MISL as instances of control maximization and shows that MISL objectives are bounded by formulation-specific downstream goal-sensitivities, establishing a precise correspondence between MISL methods and downstream GCRL tasks.

2605.06127.tldr: Experiments show that CEA improves average restoration quality over strong prompt-, descriptor-, and expert-based baselines, with the clearest gains on spatially varying and compositional degradations, while maintaining favorable parameter, FLOP, and runtime efficiency.

2605.06111.tldr: ASTOR, a multi-tASk code reinforcement learning framework via uTility-driven coORdination, consistently improves a single model across all tasks, outperforming the best task-specific specialist by 9.0%-9.5% and surpassing the strongest MTRL baseline by 7.5%-12.8%.

2605.06029.tldr: Based on this analysis, what socio-technical development programmes could plausibly move toward AGI-adjacent capability while meeting requirements for transparency, moderation, wellbeing and sustainable business models?

2605.06024.tldr: Strat-LLM, a framework grounded in Stratified Strategy Alignment, is proposed, operating in a live-forward setting throughout 2025, it integrates heterogeneous data including sequential prices, real-time news, and annual reports to eliminate look-ahead bias.

2605.06007.tldr: Through an in-the-wild evaluation with 8 distinct personas, it is demonstrated that PersonaKit provides an extensible, end-to-end framework for studying complex sociolinguistic behaviors in next-generation spoken agents.

2605.06183.tldr: This work proposes DomLoRA, a placement method that places a single adapter at the dominant adaptation module, supporting the dominant adaptation module perspective as a practical placement guideline and improves other LoRA variants, supporting the dominant adaptation module perspective as a practical placement guideline.

2605.06177.tldr: The BioMedArena toolkit provides 6 agent harnesses with 6 context-management strategies, which provide 12 backbones with competitive research capabilities and significantly improved performance, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on 8 representative biomedical benchmarks, with an average lift over prior SOTA.

2605.06157.tldr: This work proposes Hard Negative Captions (HNC): an automatically created dataset containing foiled hard negative captions for ITM training towards achieving fine-grained cross-modal comprehension in VL and demonstrates that HNC models yield a comparable or better initialization for fine-tuning.

2605.06140.tldr: SymDrift is a framework that makes the drifting field itself symmetry-aware, and introduces two complementary strategies: a symmetrized drift in coordinate space based on optimal alignment, and a $G$-invariant embedding that removes symmetry ambiguity by construction.

2605.06110.tldr: This work proposes Monte Carlo Portfolio Planning (MCPP), a lightweight closed-loop planner that directly estimates constrained completion probability through simulated workflow executions and replans after observed outcomes and demonstrates that MCPP consistently improves constrained completion probability over strong baselines across a wide range of budget--deadline constraints.

2605.06105.tldr: Results show that long-context prompt tokens need not always persist as full-depth KV-cache objects when Decode-phase tokens remain full-depth, and show a phase-asymmetric KV-visibility policy that materializes non-anchor prompt-token KV states only in lower layers while keeping Decode-phase tokens full-depth.

2605.06104.tldr: This work proposes SlimDT, which removes RTG from the autoregressive sequence, allowing the Transformer to process only a compact (state, action) sequence, and reduces the sequence length by one-third, directly improving inference efficiency.

2605.06087.tldr: A kernel embedding framework that treats safety certification as a classification problem on trajectory data, directly estimating the $T$-step safety probability without recursion bypasses compounding error across the horizon and enables certification for systems with non-Markovian dynamics.

2605.06078.tldr: This work introduces a milestone-guided policy learning framework, BEACON, that leverages the compositional structure of long-horizon tasks to ensure precise credit assignment and establishes milestone-anchored credit assignment as an effective paradigm for training long-horizon language agents.

2605.06068.tldr: This paper proposes VibeServe, the first agentic loop that generates entire LLM serving stacks end-to-end, and suggests a different point in the design space for infrastructure software: generation-time specialization rather than runtime generality.

2605.06036.tldr: This work proposes SelectiveRM, a framework grounded in optimal transport that enables the autonomous exclusion of samples with noisy preference that contradict semantic consistency, and demonstrates that this approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across diverse benchmarks.

2605.06035.tldr: Q-Patch, a quantum feature map tailored to audio that encodes local time-frequency patches from mel-spectrograms into quantum states using shallow, hardware-efficient circuits with adjacency-aware entanglement, provides a practical framework for incorporating time-frequency-aware representations into quantum kernel learning for audio authenticity assessment in low-resource settings.

2605.06014.tldr: It is proved that a composition of three RHTs leads to decaying coordinate covariance, which ensures that any fixed, bounded, multi-dimensional VQ codebook optimized for URRs has the same expected error when using three RHTs, up to an additive term that vanishes with the dimension.
